mantras.sanskrit: अग्निमीळे पुरोहितं यज्ञस्य देवमृत्विजम् । होतारं रत्नधातमम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnimīḷe purohitaṃ yajñasya devamṛtvijam | hotāraṃ ratnadhātamam ||

translations.english: I glorify Agni, the high priest of the sacrifice, the divine, the ministrant, who presents the oblation (to the gods), and is the possessor of great wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निः पूर्वेभिॠषिभिरीड्यो नूतनैरुत । स देवाँ एह वक्षति ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniḥ pūrvebhiṝṣibhirīḍyo nūtanairuta | sa devā~ eha vakṣati ||

translations.english: May that Agni who is to be celebrated by both ancient and modern sages conduct the gods hither.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निना रयिमश्नवत्पोषमेव दिवेदिवे । यशसं वीरवत्तमम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agninā rayimaśnavatpoṣameva divedive | yaśasaṃ vīravattamam ||

translations.english: Through Agni the worshipper obtains that affluence which increases day by day, which is the source of fame and multiplier of mankind.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने यं यज्ञमध्वरं विश्वतः परिभूरसि । स इद्देवेषु गच्छति ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne yaṃ yajñamadhvaraṃ viśvataḥ paribhūrasi | sa iddeveṣu gacchati ||

translations.english: Agni, the unobstructed sacrifice of which you are on every side the protector, assuredly reaches the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निर्होता कविक्रतुः सत्यश्चित्रश्रवस्तमः । देवो देवेभिरा गमत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirhotā kavikratuḥ satyaścitraśravastamaḥ | devo devebhirā gamat ||

translations.english: May Agni, the presenter of oblations, the attainer of knowledge, he who is true, renowned, and divine, come hither with the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: यदङ्ग दाशुषे त्वमग्ने भद्रं करिष्यसि । तवेत्तत्सत्यमङ्गिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadaṅga dāśuṣe tvamagne bhadraṃ kariṣyasi | tavettatsatyamaṅgiraḥ ||

translations.english: Whatever good you may, Agni, bestow upon the giver (of the oblation), that verily, Aṅgiras shall revert to you.

mantras.sanskrit: उप त्वाग्ने दिवेदिवे दोषावस्तर्धिया वयम् । नमो भरन्त एमसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa tvāgne divedive doṣāvastardhiyā vayam | namo bharanta emasi ||

translations.english: We approach you, Agni, with reverential homage in our thoughts, daily, both morning and evening.

mantras.sanskrit: राजन्तमध्वराणां गोपामृतस्य दीदिविम् । वर्धमानं स्वे दमे ॥
mantras.transliteration: rājantamadhvarāṇāṃ gopāmṛtasya dīdivim | vardhamānaṃ sve dame ||

translations.english: You, the radiant, the protector of sacrifice, the constant illuminator of truth, increasing in your own dwelling.

mantras.sanskrit: स नः पितेव सूनवेऽग्ने सूपायनो भव । सचस्वा नः स्वस्तये ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa naḥ piteva sūnave'gne sūpāyano bhava | sacasvā naḥ svastaye ||

translations.english: Agni, be to us easy of access, as is a father to his son; be ever present with us for our good.

mantras.sanskrit: वायवा याहि दर्शतेमे सोमा अरंकृताः । तेषां पाहि श्रुधी हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāyavā yāhi darśateme somā araṃkṛtāḥ | teṣāṃ pāhi śrudhī havam ||

translations.english: Vāyu, plural asant to behold, approach; these libations are prepared for you drink of them; hear our invocation.

mantras.sanskrit: वाय उक्थेभिर्जरन्ते त्वामच्छा जरितारः । सुतसोमा अहर्विदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāya ukthebhirjarante tvāmacchā jaritāraḥ | sutasomā aharvidaḥ ||

translations.english: Vāyu, your praisers praise you with holy praises having poured out Soma juice, and knowing the (fit) season.

mantras.sanskrit: वायो तव प्रपृञ्चती धेना जिगाति दाशुषे । उरूची सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāyo tava prapṛñcatī dhenā jigāti dāśuṣe | urūcī somapītaye ||

translations.english: Vāyu, your approving speech comes to the giver (of the libation), and to many (others who invite you) to drink of the Soma juice.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रवायू इमे सुता उप प्रयोभिरा गतम् । इन्दवो वामुशन्ति हि ॥
mantras.transliteration: indravāyū ime sutā upa prayobhirā gatam | indavo vāmuśanti hi ||

translations.english: Indra and Vāyu, these libations are poured out (for you); come hither with food (for us); verily the drops (of the Soma juice) await you both.

mantras.sanskrit: वायविन्द्रश्च चेतथः सुतानां वाजिनीवसू । तावा यातमुप द्रवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāyavindraśca cetathaḥ sutānāṃ vājinīvasū | tāvā yātamupa dravat ||

translations.english: Indra and Vāyu, abiding in the sacrificial rite, you are aware of these libations; come both (then) quickly hither.

mantras.sanskrit: वायविन्द्रश्च सुन्वत आ यातमुप निष्कृतम् । मक्ष्वित्था धिया नरा ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāyavindraśca sunvata ā yātamupa niṣkṛtam | makṣvitthā dhiyā narā ||

translations.english: Vāyu and Indra, come to the rite of the sacrificer, for thus, men, will completion be speedily (attained) by the ceremony.

mantras.sanskrit: मित्रं हुवे पूतदक्षं वरुणं च रिशादसम् । धियं घृताचीं साधन्ता ॥
mantras.transliteration: mitraṃ huve pūtadakṣaṃ varuṇaṃ ca riśādasam | dhiyaṃ ghṛtācīṃ sādhantā ||

translations.english: I invoke Mitra, of pure vigour, and Varuṇa, the devourer of foes; the joint accomplishers of the act bestowing water (on the earth).

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतेन मित्रावरुणावृतावृधावृतस्पृशा । क्रतुं बृहन्तमाशाथे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtena mitrāvaruṇāvṛtāvṛdhāvṛtaspṛśā | kratuṃ bṛhantamāśāthe ||

translations.english: Mitra and Varuṇa, augmenters of water, dispensers of water, you connect this perfect rite with its true (reward).

mantras.sanskrit: कवी नो मित्रावरुणा तुविजाता उरुक्षया । दक्षं दधाते अपसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kavī no mitrāvaruṇā tuvijātā urukṣayā | dakṣaṃ dadhāte apasam ||

translations.english: Sapient Mitra and Varuṇa, prosper our sacrifice and increase our strength; you are born for the benefit of many, you are the refuge of multitudes.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्विना यज्वरीरिषो द्रवत्पाणी शुभस्पती । पुरुभुजा चनस्यतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvinā yajvarīriṣo dravatpāṇī śubhaspatī | purubhujā canasyatam ||

translations.english: Aśvins, cherishers of pious acts, long-armed, accept with outstretched hands the sacrificial viands.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्विना पुरुदंससा नरा शवीरया धिया । धिष्ण्या वनतं गिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvinā purudaṃsasā narā śavīrayā dhiyā | dhiṣṇyā vanataṃ giraḥ ||

translations.english: Aśvins, abounding in mighty acts, guides (of devotion), endowed with fortitude, listen with unaverted minds to our praises.

mantras.sanskrit: दस्रा युवाकवः सुता नासत्या वृक्तबर्हिषः । आ यातं रुद्रवर्तनी ॥
mantras.transliteration: dasrā yuvākavaḥ sutā nāsatyā vṛktabarhiṣaḥ | ā yātaṃ rudravartanī ||

translations.english: Aśvins, destroyers of foes, exempt from untruth, leaders in the van of heroes, come to the mixed libations sprinkled on the lopped sacred grass.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रा याहि चित्रभानो सुता इमे त्वायवः । अण्वीभिस्तना पूतासः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrā yāhi citrabhāno sutā ime tvāyavaḥ | aṇvībhistanā pūtāsaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, of wonderful splendour, come hither; these libations, ever pure, expressed by the fingers (of the priests) are desirous of you.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रा याहि धियेषितो विप्रजूतः सुतावतः । उप ब्रह्माणि वाघतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrā yāhi dhiyeṣito viprajūtaḥ sutāvataḥ | upa brahmāṇi vāghataḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, apprehended by the understanding and appreciated by the wise, approach and accept the prayers of the priest as he offers the libation.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रा याहि तूतुजान उप ब्रह्माणि हरिवः । सुते दधिष्व नश्चनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrā yāhi tūtujāna upa brahmāṇi harivaḥ | sute dadhiṣva naścanaḥ ||

translations.english: Fleet Indra with the tawny coursers, come hither to the prayer (of the priest), and in this libation accept our (proffered) food.

mantras.sanskrit: ओमासश्चर्षणीधृतो विश्वे देवास आ गत । दाश्वांसो दाशुषः सुतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: omāsaścarṣaṇīdhṛto viśve devāsa ā gata | dāśvāṃso dāśuṣaḥ sutam ||

translations.english: Universal Gods, protectors and supporters of men, bestowers (of rewards) come to the libation of the worshipper.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वे देवासो अप्तुरः सुतमा गन्त तूर्णयः । उस्रा इव स्वसराणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśve devāso apturaḥ sutamā ganta tūrṇayaḥ | usrā iva svasarāṇi ||

translations.english: May the swift-moving universal Gods, the shedders of rain, come to the libation, as the solar rays come diligently tot he days.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वे देवासो अस्रिध एहिमायासो अद्रुहः । मेधं जुषन्त वह्नयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśve devāso asridha ehimāyāso adruhaḥ | medhaṃ juṣanta vahnayaḥ ||

translations.english: May the universal Gods, who are exempt from decay, omniscient, devoid of malice, and bearers of (riches), accept the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: पावका नः सरस्वती वाजेभिर्वाजिनीवती । यज्ञं वष्टु धियावसुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pāvakā naḥ sarasvatī vājebhirvājinīvatī | yajñaṃ vaṣṭu dhiyāvasuḥ ||

translations.english: May Sarasvatī, the purifier, the bestower of food, the recompenser of worship with wealth, be attracted by our offered viands to our rite.

mantras.sanskrit: चोदयित्री सूनृतानां चेतन्ती सुमतीनाम् । यज्ञं दधे सरस्वती ॥
mantras.transliteration: codayitrī sūnṛtānāṃ cetantī sumatīnām | yajñaṃ dadhe sarasvatī ||

translations.english: Sarasvatī, the inspirer of those who delight in truth, the instrumental uctress of the right-minded, has accepted our sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: महो अर्णः सरस्वती प्र चेतयति केतुना । धियो विश्वा वि राजति ॥
mantras.transliteration: maho arṇaḥ sarasvatī pra cetayati ketunā | dhiyo viśvā vi rājati ||

translations.english: Sarasvatī, makes manifest by her acts a mighty river, and (in her own form) enlightens all understandings.

mantras.sanskrit: सुरूपकृत्नुमूतये सुदुघामिव गोदुहे । जुहूमसि द्यविद्यवि ॥
mantras.transliteration: surūpakṛtnumūtaye sudughāmiva goduhe | juhūmasi dyavidyavi ||

translations.english: Day by day we invoke the doer of good works for our protection, as a good cow for the milking (is called by the milker).

mantras.sanskrit: उप नः सवना गहि सोमस्य सोमपाः पिब । गोदा इद्रेवतो मदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa naḥ savanā gahi somasya somapāḥ piba | godā idrevato madaḥ ||

translations.english: Drinker of the Soma juice, come to our (daily) rites, and drink of the libation; the satisfaction of (you who are) the bestower of riches, is verily (the cause of) the gift of cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: अथा ते अन्तमानां विद्याम सुमतीनाम् । मा नो अति ख्य आ गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: athā te antamānāṃ vidyāma sumatīnām | mā no ati khya ā gahi ||

translations.english: We recognize you in the midst of the right-minded, who are nearest to you; come to us; pass us not by to reveal (yourself to others).

mantras.sanskrit: परेहि विग्रमस्तृतमिन्द्रं पृच्छा विपश्चितम् । यस्ते सखिभ्य आ वरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: parehi vigramastṛtamindraṃ pṛcchā vipaścitam | yaste sakhibhya ā varam ||

translations.english: Go, worshipper, to the wise and uninjured Indra, who bestows the best (of blessings) on your friends, and ask him of the (fitness of the) learned (priest who recites his praise).

mantras.sanskrit: उत ब्रुवन्तु नो निदो निरन्यतश्चिदारत । दधाना इन्द्र इद्दुवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta bruvantu no nido niranyataścidārata | dadhānā indra idduvaḥ ||

translations.english: Let our ministers, earnestly performing his worship, exclaim, Depart your revilers from hence and every other plural ce (where he is adored).

mantras.sanskrit: उत नः सुभगाँ अरिर्वोचेयुर्दस्म कृष्टयः । स्यामेदिन्द्रस्य शर्मणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta naḥ subhagā~ arirvoceyurdasma kṛṣṭayaḥ | syāmedindrasya śarmaṇi ||

translations.english: Destroyer of foes, let our enemies say we are prosperous; let men (congratulate us); may we ever abide, in the felicity (derived from the favour) of Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: एमाशुमाशवे भर यज्ञश्रियं नृमादनम् । पतयन्मन्दयत्सखम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: emāśumāśave bhara yajñaśriyaṃ nṛmādanam | patayanmandayatsakham ||

translations.english: Offer to Indra, the pervader (of every rite of libation), the juice that is present (at the three ceremonies), the grace of the sacrifice, the exhilarator of mankind, the perfecter of the act, the favourite of (that Indra) who gives happiness (to the offerer).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य पीत्वा शतक्रतो घनो वृत्राणामभवः । प्रावो वाजेषु वाजिनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya pītvā śatakrato ghano vṛtrāṇāmabhavaḥ | prāvo vājeṣu vājinam ||

translations.english: Having drunk, Śatakratu, of this (Soma juice), you became the slayer of the Vṛtras; you defend the warrior in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: तं त्वा वाजेषु वाजिनं वाजयामः शतक्रतो । धनानामिन्द्र सातये ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ tvā vājeṣu vājinaṃ vājayāmaḥ śatakrato | dhanānāmindra sātaye ||

translations.english: We offer to you, Śatakratu, the mighty in battle, (sacrificial) food for the acquisition, Indra, of riches.

mantras.sanskrit: यो रायोऽवनिर्महान्त्सुपारः सुन्वतः सखा । तस्मा इन्द्राय गायत ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo rāyo'vanirmahāntsupāraḥ sunvataḥ sakhā | tasmā indrāya gāyata ||

translations.english: Sing unto that Indra who is the protector of wealth, the mighty, the accomplisher of good deeds, the friend of the offerer of the libation.

mantras.sanskrit: आ त्वेता नि षीदतेन्द्रमभि प्र गायत । सखायः स्तोमवाहसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tvetā ni ṣīdatendramabhi pra gāyata | sakhāyaḥ stomavāhasaḥ ||

translations.english: Hasten hither, friends, offering praises; sit down, and sing repeatedly the praises of Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: पुरूतमं पुरूणामीशानं वार्याणाम् । इन्द्रं सोमे सचा सुते ॥
mantras.transliteration: purūtamaṃ purūṇāmīśānaṃ vāryāṇām | indraṃ some sacā sute ||

translations.english: When the libation is poured forth, respectively praise Indra, the discomfiter of many enemies, the lord of many blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: स घा नो योग आ भुवत्स राये स पुरंध्याम् । गमद्वाजेभिरा स नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa ghā no yoga ā bhuvatsa rāye sa puraṃdhyām | gamadvājebhirā sa naḥ ||

translations.english: May he be to us for the attainment of our objects; may he be to us for the acquisition of riches; may he be to us for the acquisition of knowledge; may he come to us with food.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य संस्थे न वृण्वते हरी समत्सु शत्रवः । तस्मा इन्द्राय गायत ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya saṃsthe na vṛṇvate harī samatsu śatravaḥ | tasmā indrāya gāyata ||

translations.english: Sing to that Indra, whose enemies in combat await not his coursers harnessed in his car.

mantras.sanskrit: सुतपाव्ने सुता इमे शुचयो यन्ति वीतये । सोमासो दध्याशिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sutapāvne sutā ime śucayo yanti vītaye | somāso dadhyāśiraḥ ||

translations.english: These pure Soma juices, mixed with curds, are poured out for the satisfaction of the drinker of the libations.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं सुतस्य पीतये सद्यो वृद्धो अजायथाः । इन्द्र ज्यैष्ठ्याय सुक्रतो ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ sutasya pītaye sadyo vṛddho ajāyathāḥ | indra jyaiṣṭhyāya sukrato ||

translations.english: Your, Indra, performer of good works, has suddenly become of augmented vigour for the sake of drinking the libation, and (maintaining) seniority (among the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: आ त्वा विशन्त्वाशवः सोमास इन्द्र गिर्वणः । शं ते सन्तु प्रचेतसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tvā viśantvāśavaḥ somāsa indra girvaṇaḥ | śaṃ te santu pracetase ||

translations.english: Indra, who are the object of praises, may these pervading Soma juices enter into you; may they be propitious for your (attainment of) superior intelligence.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वां स्तोमा अवीवृधन्त्वामुक्था शतक्रतो । त्वां वर्धन्तु नो गिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāṃ stomā avīvṛdhantvāmukthā śatakrato | tvāṃ vardhantu no giraḥ ||

translations.english: The chants (of the Soma) have magnified you, Śatakratu, the hymns (of the Ṛk) have magnified you; may our praises magnify you.

mantras.sanskrit: अक्षितोतिः सनेदिमं वाजमिन्द्रः सहस्रिणम् । यस्मिन्विश्वानि पौंस्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: akṣitotiḥ sanedimaṃ vājamindraḥ sahasriṇam | yasminviśvāni pauṃsyā ||

translations.english: May Indra, the unobstructed protector, enjoy these manifold (sacrificial) viands, in which all manly properties abide.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नो मर्ता अभि द्रुहन्तनूनामिन्द्र गिर्वणः । ईशानो यवया वधम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā no martā abhi druhantanūnāmindra girvaṇaḥ | īśāno yavayā vadham ||

translations.english: Indra, who are the object of praises, let no men do injury to our person ns; you are mighty, keep off violence.

mantras.sanskrit: युञ्जन्ति ब्रध्नमरुषं चरन्तं परि तस्थुषः । रोचन्ते रोचना दिवि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuñjanti bradhnamaruṣaṃ carantaṃ pari tasthuṣaḥ | rocante rocanā divi ||

translations.english: The circumstationed (inhabitants of the three worlds) associate with (Indra), the mighty (Sun), the indestructive (fire), the moving (wind), and the lights that shine in the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: युञ्जन्त्यस्य काम्या हरी विपक्षसा रथे । शोणा धृष्णू नृवाहसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuñjantyasya kāmyā harī vipakṣasā rathe | śoṇā dhṛṣṇū nṛvāhasā ||

translations.english: They (the charioteers) harness to his car his two desirable coursers, plural ced on either hand, bay coloured, high-spirited, chief-bearing.

mantras.sanskrit: केतुं कृण्वन्नकेतवे पेशो मर्या अपेशसे । समुषद्भिरजायथाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ketuṃ kṛṇvannaketave peśo maryā apeśase | samuṣadbhirajāyathāḥ ||

translations.english: Mortals, you owe your (daily) birth (to such an Indra), who with the rays of the morning gives sense to the senseless, and to the formless form.

mantras.sanskrit: आदह स्वधामनु पुनर्गर्भत्वमेरिरे । दधाना नाम यज्ञियम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ādaha svadhāmanu punargarbhatvamerire | dadhānā nāma yajñiyam ||

translations.english: Thereafter verily those who bear names invoked in holy rites (the Maruts) having seen the rain (about to be engendered), instrumental gated him to resume his embryo condition (in the clouds).

mantras.sanskrit: वीळु चिदारुजत्नुभिर्गुहा चिदिन्द्र वह्निभिः । अविन्द उस्रिया अनु ॥
mantras.transliteration: vīḷu cidārujatnubhirguhā cidindra vahnibhiḥ | avinda usriyā anu ||

translations.english: Associated with the conveying Maruts, the traversers of plural ces difficult of access, your Indra, have discovered the cows hidden in the cave.

mantras.sanskrit: देवयन्तो यथा मतिमच्छा विदद्वसुं गिरः । महामनूषत श्रुतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: devayanto yathā matimacchā vidadvasuṃ giraḥ | mahāmanūṣata śrutam ||

translations.english: The reciters of praises praise the mighty (troop of Maruts), who are celebrated, and conscious of the power of bestowing wealth, in like manner as they (glorify) the counsellor (Indra).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रेण सं हि दृक्षसे संजग्मानो अबिभ्युषा । मन्दू समानवर्चसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: indreṇa saṃ hi dṛkṣase saṃjagmāno abibhyuṣā | mandū samānavarcasā ||

translations.english: May you be seen, Maruts, accompanied by the undaunted Indra; (both) rejoicing, and of equal splendour.

mantras.sanskrit: अनवद्यैरभिद्युभिर्मखः सहस्वदर्चति । गणैरिन्द्रस्य काम्यैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: anavadyairabhidyubhirmakhaḥ sahasvadarcati | gaṇairindrasya kāmyaiḥ ||

translations.english: This right is performed in adoration of the powerful Indra, along with the irreproachable, heavenward- tending, and amiable bands (of the Maruts).

mantras.sanskrit: अतः परिज्मन्ना गहि दिवो वा रोचनादधि । समस्मिन्नृञ्जते गिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ataḥ parijmannā gahi divo vā rocanādadhi | samasminnṛñjate giraḥ ||

translations.english: Therefore, circumambient (troop of Maruts), come hither, whether from the region of the sky or from the solar sphere; for in this rite (the priest) fully recites your praises.

mantras.sanskrit: इतो वा सातिमीमहे दिवो वा पार्थिवादधि । इन्द्रं महो वा रजसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ito vā sātimīmahe divo vā pārthivādadhi | indraṃ maho vā rajasaḥ ||

translations.english: We invoke, Indra, whether he come from this earthly region, or from the heaven above, or from the vast firmament; that he may give (us) wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रमिद्गाथिनो बृहदिन्द्रमर्केभिरर्किणः । इन्द्रं वाणीरनूषत ॥
mantras.transliteration: indramidgāthino bṛhadindramarkebhirarkiṇaḥ | indraṃ vāṇīranūṣata ||

translations.english: The chanters (of the Soma) extol Indra with songs, the reciters of the Ṛk with prayers, the priests of the Yajuṣ, with texts.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र इद्धर्योः सचा सम्मिश्ल आ वचोयुजा । इन्द्रो वज्री हिरण्ययः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra iddharyoḥ sacā sammiśla ā vacoyujā | indro vajrī hiraṇyayaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, the blender of all things, comes verily with his steeds that are harnessed at his word; Indra, the richly-decorated, the wielder of the thunderbolt.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रो दीर्घाय चक्षस आ सूर्यं रोहयद्दिवि । वि गोभिरद्रिमैरयत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indro dīrghāya cakṣasa ā sūryaṃ rohayaddivi | vi gobhiradrimairayat ||

translations.english: Indra, to render all things visible, elevated the sun in the sky, and charged the cloud with (abundant) waters.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र वाजेषु नोऽव सहस्रप्रधनेषु च । उग्र उग्राभिरूतिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra vājeṣu no'va sahasrapradhaneṣu ca | ugra ugrābhirūtibhiḥ ||

translations.english: Invincible Indra, protect us in battles abounding in spoil, with insuperable defenceṣ

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रं वयं महाधन इन्द्रमर्भे हवामहे । युजं वृत्रेषु वज्रिणम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraṃ vayaṃ mahādhana indramarbhe havāmahe | yujaṃ vṛtreṣu vajriṇam ||

translations.english: We invoke Indra for great affluence, Indra for limited wealth; (our) ally, and wielder of the thunder-bolt against (our) enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो वृषन्नमुं चरुं सत्रादावन्नपा वृधि । अस्मभ्यमप्रतिष्कुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no vṛṣannamuṃ caruṃ satrādāvannapā vṛdhi | asmabhyamapratiṣkutaḥ ||

translations.english: Shedder of rain, granter of all desires, set open this cloud. You are never uncompliant with our (requests).

mantras.sanskrit: तुञ्जेतुञ्जे य उत्तरे स्तोमा इन्द्रस्य वज्रिणः । न विन्धे अस्य सुष्टुतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tuñjetuñje ya uttare stomā indrasya vajriṇaḥ | na vindhe asya suṣṭutim ||

translations.english: Whatever excellent praises are given to other dignities, they are (also the due) of Indra the thunderer; I do not know his fitting praise.

mantras.sanskrit: वृषा यूथेव वंसगः कृष्टीरियर्त्योजसा । ईशानो अप्रतिष्कुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣā yūtheva vaṃsagaḥ kṛṣṭīriyartyojasā | īśāno apratiṣkutaḥ ||

translations.english: The shedder of rain, the mighty lord, the always compliant, invests men with his strength, as a bull (defends) a herd of kine.

mantras.sanskrit: य एकश्चर्षणीनां वसूनामिरज्यति । इन्द्रः पञ्च क्षितीनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya ekaścarṣaṇīnāṃ vasūnāmirajyati | indraḥ pañca kṣitīnām ||

translations.english: Indra, who alone rules over men, over riches, and over the five (classes) of the dwellers on earth.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रं वो विश्वतस्परि हवामहे जनेभ्यः । अस्माकमस्तु केवलः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraṃ vo viśvataspari havāmahe janebhyaḥ | asmākamastu kevalaḥ ||

translations.english: We invoke for you, Indra, who is everywhere among men; may he be exclusively our own.

mantras.sanskrit: एन्द्र सानसिं रयिं सजित्वानं सदासहम् । वर्षिष्ठमूतये भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: endra sānasiṃ rayiṃ sajitvānaṃ sadāsaham | varṣiṣṭhamūtaye bhara ||

translations.english: Indra, bring for our protection riches, most abundant, enjoyable, the source of victory, the humbler of our foes. [

mantras.sanskrit: नि येन मुष्टिहत्यया नि वृत्रा रुणधामहै । त्वोतासो न्यर्वता ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni yena muṣṭihatyayā ni vṛtrā ruṇadhāmahai | tvotāso nyarvatā ||

translations.english: By which we may repel our enemies, whether (encountering them) hand to hand, or on horse-back; ever protected by you. (muṣṭihatyayā = muṣṭiprahāreṇa) = lit. by striking with the fist; on horseback = with a horse (a reference to infantry and cavalry)].

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र त्वोतास आ वयं वज्रं घना ददीमहि । जयेम सं युधि स्पृधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra tvotāsa ā vayaṃ vajraṃ ghanā dadīmahi | jayema saṃ yudhi spṛdhaḥ ||

translations.english: Defended by you, Indra, we possess a ponderous weapon, wherewith we may entirely conquer our opponents.

mantras.sanskrit: वयं शूरेभिरस्तृभिरिन्द्र त्वया युजा वयम् । सासह्याम पृतन्यतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayaṃ śūrebhirastṛbhirindra tvayā yujā vayam | sāsahyāma pṛtanyataḥ ||

translations.english: With you for our ally, Indra, and (aided by) missile-hurling heroes, we are able to overcome (our foes) arrayed in hosts.

mantras.sanskrit: महाँ इन्द्रः परश्च नु महित्वमस्तु वज्रिणे । द्यौर्न प्रथिना शवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahā~ indraḥ paraśca nu mahitvamastu vajriṇe | dyaurna prathinā śavaḥ ||

translations.english: Mighty is Indra, and supreme; may magnitude ever (belong) to the bearer of the thunderbolt; may his strong (armies) be ever vast as the heavens.

mantras.sanskrit: समोहे वा य आशत नरस्तोकस्य सनितौ । विप्रासो वा धियायवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samohe vā ya āśata narastokasya sanitau | viprāso vā dhiyāyavaḥ ||

translations.english: Whatever men have recourse to Indra in battle, or for the acquisition of offspring, and the wise who are desirous of understanding (obtain their desires).

mantras.sanskrit: यः कुक्षिः सोमपातमः समुद्र इव पिन्वते । उर्वीरापो न काकुदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ kukṣiḥ somapātamaḥ samudra iva pinvate | urvīrāpo na kākudaḥ ||

translations.english: The belly of Indra, which quaffs the Soma juice abundantly, swells like the ocean, (and is ever) moist, like the ample fluids of the palate.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा ह्यस्य सूनृता विरप्शी गोमती मही । पक्वा शाखा न दाशुषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā hyasya sūnṛtā virapśī gomatī mahī | pakvā śākhā na dāśuṣe ||

translations.english: Verily the words of Indra to his worshipper are true, manifold, cow- conferring, and to be held in honour; (they are) like a branch (loaded with) ripe (fruit).

mantras.sanskrit: एवा हि ते विभूतय ऊतय इन्द्र मावते । सद्यश्चित्सन्ति दाशुषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā hi te vibhūtaya ūtaya indra māvate | sadyaścitsanti dāśuṣe ||

translations.english: Verily, Indra, your glories are at all times the protectors of every such worshipper as I am.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा ह्यस्य काम्या स्तोम उक्थं च शंस्या । इन्द्राय सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā hyasya kāmyā stoma ukthaṃ ca śaṃsyā | indrāya somapītaye ||

translations.english: Verily his chanted and recited praises are to be desired and repeated to Indra, that he may drink the Soma juice.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रेहि मत्स्यन्धसो विश्वेभिः सोमपर्वभिः । महाँ अभिष्टिरोजसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrehi matsyandhaso viśvebhiḥ somaparvabhiḥ | mahā~ abhiṣṭirojasā ||

translations.english: Come, Indra, and be regaled with all viands libations, and thence, mighty in strength, be victorious (over your foes).

mantras.sanskrit: एमेनं सृजता सुते मन्दिमिन्द्राय मन्दिने । चक्रिं विश्वानि चक्रये ॥
mantras.transliteration: emenaṃ sṛjatā sute mandimindrāya mandine | cakriṃ viśvāni cakraye ||

translations.english: The libation being prepared, present the exhilaratina and efficacious (draught) to the rejoicing Indra, the accomplisher of all things.

mantras.sanskrit: मत्स्वा सुशिप्र मन्दिभिः स्तोमेभिर्विश्वचर्षणे । सचैषु सवनेष्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: matsvā suśipra mandibhiḥ stomebhirviśvacarṣaṇe | sacaiṣu savaneṣvā ||

translations.english: Indra with the handsome chin, be plural ased with these animating praises; do your, who are to be reverenced by all mankind, (come) to these rites (with the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: असृग्रमिन्द्र ते गिरः प्रति त्वामुदहासत । अजोषा वृषभं पतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asṛgramindra te giraḥ prati tvāmudahāsata | ajoṣā vṛṣabhaṃ patim ||

translations.english: I have addressed to you, Indra, the showerer (of blessings), the protector (of your worshipers), praises which have reached you, and of which you have approved.

mantras.sanskrit: सं चोदय चित्रमर्वाग्राध इन्द्र वरेण्यम् । असदित्ते विभु प्रभु ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ codaya citramarvāgrādha indra vareṇyam | asaditte vibhu prabhu ||

translations.english: plural ce before us, Indra, precious and multiform riches, for enough and more than enough are assuredly yours.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मान्त्सु तत्र चोदयेन्द्र राये रभस्वतः । तुविद्युम्न यशस्वतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmāntsu tatra codayendra rāye rabhasvataḥ | tuvidyumna yaśasvataḥ ||

translations.english: Opulent Indra, encourage us in this rite for the acquirement of wealth, for we are diligent and renowned.

mantras.sanskrit: सं गोमदिन्द्र वाजवदस्मे पृथु श्रवो बृहत् । विश्वायुर्धेह्यक्षितम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ gomadindra vājavadasme pṛthu śravo bṛhat | viśvāyurdhehyakṣitam ||

translations.english: Grant us, Indra, wealth beyond measure or calculation, inexhaustible, the source of cattle, of food, of all life.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मे धेहि श्रवो बृहद्द्युम्नं सहस्रसातमम् । इन्द्र ता रथिनीरिषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asme dhehi śravo bṛhaddyumnaṃ sahasrasātamam | indra tā rathinīriṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, grant us great renown and wealth acquired in a thousand ways, and those (articles) of food (which are brought from the field) in carts.

mantras.sanskrit: वसोरिन्द्रं वसुपतिं गीर्भिर्गृणन्त ऋग्मियम् । होम गन्तारमूतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: vasorindraṃ vasupatiṃ gīrbhirgṛṇanta ṛgmiyam | homa gantāramūtaye ||

translations.english: We invoke for the preservation of our property, Indra, the lord of wealth, the object of sacred verses, the repairer (to the plural ce of sacrifice), praising him with our praises.

mantras.sanskrit: सुतेसुते न्योकसे बृहद्बृहत एदरिः । इन्द्राय शूषमर्चति ॥
mantras.transliteration: sutesute nyokase bṛhadbṛhata edariḥ | indrāya śūṣamarcati ||

translations.english: With libations repeatedly effused, the sacrificer glorifies the vast prowess of Indra, the mighty, the dweller in (an eternal mansion).

mantras.sanskrit: गायन्ति त्वा गायत्रिणोऽर्चन्त्यर्कमर्किणः । ब्रह्माणस्त्वा शतक्रत उद्वंशमिव येमिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: gāyanti tvā gāyatriṇo'rcantyarkamarkiṇaḥ | brahmāṇastvā śatakrata udvaṃśamiva yemire ||

translations.english: The chanters (of the Soma) hymn you, Śatakratu; the reciters of the Ṛk praise you, who are worthy of praise; the Bra-hmaṇas raise you aloft, like a bamboo pole.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्सानोः सानुमारुहद्भूर्यस्पष्ट कर्त्वम् । तदिन्द्रो अर्थं चेतति यूथेन वृष्णिरेजति ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatsānoḥ sānumāruhadbhūryaspaṣṭa kartvam | tadindro arthaṃ cetati yūthena vṛṣṇirejati ||

translations.english: Indra, the showever (of blessings), knows the object (of his worshipper), who has performed many acts of worship (with the Soma gathered) on the ridges of the mountain, and (therefore) comes with the troop (of Maruts).

mantras.sanskrit: युक्ष्वा हि केशिना हरी वृषणा कक्ष्यप्रा । अथा न इन्द्र सोमपा गिरामुपश्रुतिं चर ॥
mantras.transliteration: yukṣvā hi keśinā harī vṛṣaṇā kakṣyaprā | athā na indra somapā girāmupaśrutiṃ cara ||

translations.english: Indra, drinker of the Soma, having put to your long-maned, vigorous, and well-conditioned steeds, come nigh to hear our praises.

mantras.sanskrit: एहि स्तोमाँ अभि स्वराभि गृणीह्या रुव । ब्रह्म च नो वसो सचेन्द्र यज्ञं च वर्धय ॥
mantras.transliteration: ehi stomā~ abhi svarābhi gṛṇīhyā ruva | brahma ca no vaso sacendra yajñaṃ ca vardhaya ||

translations.english: Come, Vasu, (to this our rite); reply to our hymns, answer (to our praises), respond to (our prayers); be propitious, Indra, to our sacrifice, and (bestow upon us abundant) food.

mantras.sanskrit: उक्थमिन्द्राय शंस्यं वर्धनं पुरुनिष्षिधे । शक्रो यथा सुतेषु णो रारणत्सख्येषु च ॥
mantras.transliteration: ukthamindrāya śaṃsyaṃ vardhanaṃ puruniṣṣidhe | śakro yathā suteṣu ṇo rāraṇatsakhyeṣu ca ||

translations.english: The hymn, the cause of increase, is to be repeated to Indra, the repeller of many foes, that Śakra may speak (with kindness) to our sons and to our friends.

mantras.sanskrit: तमित्सखित्व ईमहे तं राये तं सुवीर्ये । स शक्र उत नः शकदिन्द्रो वसु दयमानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamitsakhitva īmahe taṃ rāye taṃ suvīrye | sa śakra uta naḥ śakadindro vasu dayamānaḥ ||

translations.english: We have recourse to Indra for his friendship, for wealth, for perfect might; for he, the powerful Indra, conferring wealth, is able (to protect us).

mantras.sanskrit: सुविवृतं सुनिरजमिन्द्र त्वादातमिद्यशः । गवामप व्रजं वृधि कृणुष्व राधो अद्रिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: suvivṛtaṃ sunirajamindra tvādātamidyaśaḥ | gavāmapa vrajaṃ vṛdhi kṛṇuṣva rādho adrivaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, by you is food (rendered) everywhere abundant, easy of attainment, and assuredly perfect; wielder of the thunderbolt, set open the cow-pastures, and provide (ample) wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: नहि त्वा रोदसी उभे ऋघायमाणमिन्वतः । जेषः स्वर्वतीरपः सं गा अस्मभ्यं धूनुहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahi tvā rodasī ubhe ṛghāyamāṇaminvataḥ | jeṣaḥ svarvatīrapaḥ saṃ gā asmabhyaṃ dhūnuhi ||

translations.english: Heaven and earth are unable to sustain you when destroying your enemies; you may command the waters of heaven; send us lberally kine.

mantras.sanskrit: आश्रुत्कर्ण श्रुधी हवं नू चिद्दधिष्व मे गिरः । इन्द्र स्तोममिमं मम कृष्वा युजश्चिदन्तरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: āśrutkarṇa śrudhī havaṃ nū ciddadhiṣva me giraḥ | indra stomamimaṃ mama kṛṣvā yujaścidantaram ||

translations.english: Oh! your whose ears hear all things, listen quickly to my invocation; hold in your heart my praises; keep near to you this my hymn, as it were (the words of) a friend.

mantras.sanskrit: विद्मा हि त्वा वृषन्तमं वाजेषु हवनश्रुतम् । वृषन्तमस्य हूमह ऊतिं सहस्रसातमाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vidmā hi tvā vṛṣantamaṃ vājeṣu havanaśrutam | vṛṣantamasya hūmaha ūtiṃ sahasrasātamām ||

translations.english: We know you, liberal rainer (of blessings), the hearer of our call in battles; we invoke the thousand-fold profitable protection of you, the showerer (of bounties).

mantras.sanskrit: आ तू न इन्द्र कौशिक मन्दसानः सुतं पिब । नव्यमायुः प्र सू तिर कृधी सहस्रसामृषिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tū na indra kauśika mandasānaḥ sutaṃ piba | navyamāyuḥ pra sū tira kṛdhī sahasrasāmṛṣim ||

translations.english: Come quickly, Indra, sone of Kuśika, delighted drink the libation; prolong the life that merits commendation; make me, who am a Ṛṣi abundantly endowed (with possessions).

mantras.sanskrit: परि त्वा गिर्वणो गिर इमा भवन्तु विश्वतः । वृद्धायुमनु वृद्धयो जुष्टा भवन्तु जुष्टयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari tvā girvaṇo gira imā bhavantu viśvataḥ | vṛddhāyumanu vṛddhayo juṣṭā bhavantu juṣṭayaḥ ||

translations.english: May these our praises be on all occasions around you, deserver of praise; may they augment the power of you, who are long-lived, and being agreeable to you, may they yield delight (to us).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रं विश्वा अवीवृधन्त्समुद्रव्यचसं गिरः । रथीतमं रथीनां वाजानां सत्पतिं पतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraṃ viśvā avīvṛdhantsamudravyacasaṃ giraḥ | rathītamaṃ rathīnāṃ vājānāṃ satpatiṃ patim ||

translations.english: All our praises magnify Indra, expansive as the ocean, the most valiant of warriors who fight in chariots, the lord of food, the protector of the virtuous.

mantras.sanskrit: सख्ये त इन्द्र वाजिनो मा भेम शवसस्पते । त्वामभि प्र णोनुमो जेतारमपराजितम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sakhye ta indra vājino mā bhema śavasaspate | tvāmabhi pra ṇonumo jetāramaparājitam ||

translations.english: Supported by your friendship, Indra, cherisher of strength, we have no fear, but glorify you, the conqueror, the unconquered.

mantras.sanskrit: पूर्वीरिन्द्रस्य रातयो न वि दस्यन्त्यूतयः । यदी वाजस्य गोमतः स्तोतृभ्यो मंहते मघम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pūrvīrindrasya rātayo na vi dasyantyūtayaḥ | yadī vājasya gomataḥ stotṛbhyo maṃhate magham ||

translations.english: The ancient liberalities of Indra, his protections, will not be wanting to him who presents to the reciters of the hymns, wealth of food and cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: पुरां भिन्दुर्युवा कविरमितौजा अजायत । इन्द्रो विश्वस्य कर्मणो धर्ता वज्री पुरुष्टुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: purāṃ bhinduryuvā kaviramitaujā ajāyata | indro viśvasya karmaṇo dhartā vajrī puruṣṭutaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra was born the destroyer of cities, ever young, ever wise, of unbounded strength, the sustainer of all pious acts, the wielder of the thunderbolt, the many-praised.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं वलस्य गोमतोऽपावरद्रिवो बिलम् । त्वां देवा अबिभ्युषस्तुज्यमानास आविषुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ valasya gomato'pāvaradrivo bilam | tvāṃ devā abibhyuṣastujyamānāsa āviṣuḥ ||

translations.english: Your, wielder of the thunderbolt, did open the cave of Vala, who had there concealed the cattle; and the gods whom he had oppressed, no longer feared when they had obtained you (for their ally).

mantras.sanskrit: तवाहं शूर रातिभिः प्रत्यायं सिन्धुमावदन् । उपातिष्ठन्त गिर्वणो विदुष्टे तस्य कारवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tavāhaṃ śūra rātibhiḥ pratyāyaṃ sindhumāvadan | upātiṣṭhanta girvaṇo viduṣṭe tasya kāravaḥ ||

translations.english: (Attracted) by your bounties, I again come, Hero, to you, celebrating (your liberality) while offering this libation; the performers of the rite approach you, who are worthy of praise, for they have known your (munificence).

mantras.sanskrit: मायाभिरिन्द्र मायिनं त्वं शुष्णमवातिरः । विदुष्टे तस्य मेधिरास्तेषां श्रवांस्युत्तिर ॥
mantras.transliteration: māyābhirindra māyinaṃ tvaṃ śuṣṇamavātiraḥ | viduṣṭe tasya medhirāsteṣāṃ śravāṃsyuttira ||

translations.english: Your slewest, Indra, by stratagems, the wily Śuṣṇa; the wise have known of this your (greatness); bestow upon them (abundant) food.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रमीशानमोजसाभि स्तोमा अनूषत । सहस्रं यस्य रातय उत वा सन्ति भूयसीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indramīśānamojasābhi stomā anūṣata | sahasraṃ yasya rātaya uta vā santi bhūyasīḥ ||

translations.english: The reciters of sacred hymns praise with all their might, Indra, the ruler of the world, whose bounties are (computed) by thousands or even more.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निं दूतं वृणीमहे होतारं विश्ववेदसम् । अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe hotāraṃ viśvavedasam | asya yajñasya sukratum ||

translations.english: We select Agni, the messenger of the gods, their invoker, the possessor of all riches, the perfecter of this rite.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निमग्निं हवीमभिः सदा हवन्त विश्पतिम् । हव्यवाहं पुरुप्रियम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnimagniṃ havīmabhiḥ sadā havanta viśpatim | havyavāhaṃ purupriyam ||

translations.english: (The offerers of oblations) invoke with their invocations, Agni, Agni, the lord of men, the bearer of offerings, the beloved of many.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने देवाँ इहा वह जज्ञानो वृक्तबर्हिषे । असि होता न ईड्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne devā~ ihā vaha jajñāno vṛktabarhiṣe | asi hotā na īḍyaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, genitive rated (by attrition), bring hither the gods to the clipped sacred grass; you are their invoker for us, and are to be adored.

mantras.sanskrit: ताँ उशतो वि बोधय यदग्ने यासि दूत्यम् । देवैरा सत्सि बर्हिषि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā~ uśato vi bodhaya yadagne yāsi dūtyam | devairā satsi barhiṣi ||

translations.english: As you discharge the duty of messenger, arouse them desirous of the oblation; sit down with them on the sacred grass.

mantras.sanskrit: घृताहवन दीदिवः प्रति ष्म रिषतो दह । अग्ने त्वं रक्षस्विनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ghṛtāhavana dīdivaḥ prati ṣma riṣato daha | agne tvaṃ rakṣasvinaḥ ||

translations.english: Resplendent Agni, invoked by oblations of clarified butter, consume our adversaries, who are defended by evil spirits.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निनाग्निः समिध्यते कविर्गृहपतिर्युवा । हव्यवाड्जुह्वास्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnināgniḥ samidhyate kavirgṛhapatiryuvā | havyavāḍjuhvāsyaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, the ever young and wise, the guardian of the dwelling (of the sacrificer), the bearer of offerings, whose mouth is (the vehicle) of oblations, is kindled by Agni.

mantras.sanskrit: कविमग्निमुप स्तुहि सत्यधर्माणमध्वरे । देवममीवचातनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kavimagnimupa stuhi satyadharmāṇamadhvare | devamamīvacātanam ||

translations.english: Praise in the sacrifice, Agni, be the protector of that offerr of oblations who worships you, the messenger of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्त्वामग्ने हविष्पतिर्दूतं देव सपर्यति । तस्य स्म प्राविता भव ॥
mantras.transliteration: yastvāmagne haviṣpatirdūtaṃ deva saparyati | tasya sma prāvitā bhava ||

translations.english: Resplendent Agni, be the protector of that offerr of oblations who worships you, the messenger of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: यो अग्निं देववीतये हविष्माँ आविवासति । तस्मै पावक मृळय ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo agniṃ devavītaye haviṣmā~ āvivāsati | tasmai pāvaka mṛḷaya ||

translations.english: Be propitious, Pāvaka, to him, who, presenting oblations for the gratification of the celestials, approaches Agni.

mantras.sanskrit: स नः पावक दीदिवोऽग्ने देवाँ इहा वह । उप यज्ञं हविश्च नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa naḥ pāvaka dīdivo'gne devā~ ihā vaha | upa yajñaṃ haviśca naḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, the bright, the purifier, bring hither the gods to our sacrifice, to our oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: स नः स्तवान आ भर गायत्रेण नवीयसा । रयिं वीरवतीमिषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa naḥ stavāna ā bhara gāyatreṇa navīyasā | rayiṃ vīravatīmiṣam ||

translations.english: Praised with our newest hymn, bestow upon us riches and food, the source of progeny.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने शुक्रेण शोचिषा विश्वाभिर्देवहूतिभिः । इमं स्तोमं जुषस्व नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne śukreṇa śociṣā viśvābhirdevahūtibhiḥ | imaṃ stomaṃ juṣasva naḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, shining with pure radiance, and charged with all the invocations of the gods, be plural ased by this our praise.

mantras.sanskrit: सुसमिद्धो न आ वह देवाँ अग्ने हविष्मते । होतः पावक यक्षि च ॥
mantras.transliteration: susamiddho na ā vaha devā~ agne haviṣmate | hotaḥ pāvaka yakṣi ca ||

translations.english: Agni, who are Susamiddha, invoker, purifier, bring hither the gods to the offerers of our oblation, and do your sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: मधुमन्तं तनूनपाद्यज्ञं देवेषु नः कवे । अद्या कृणुहि वीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: madhumantaṃ tanūnapādyajñaṃ deveṣu naḥ kave | adyā kṛṇuhi vītaye ||

translations.english: Wise (Agni) who are Tanūnapāt (= devourer of clarified butter), present this day our well-favoured sacrifice to the gods for their food.

mantras.sanskrit: नराशंसमिह प्रियमस्मिन्यज्ञ उप ह्वये । मधुजिह्वं हविष्कृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: narāśaṃsamiha priyamasminyajña upa hvaye | madhujihvaṃ haviṣkṛtam ||

translations.english: I invoke the beloved Narāśamśa, the sweet-tongued, the offere of oblations, to this sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने सुखतमे रथे देवाँ ईळित आ वह । असि होता मनुर्हितः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne sukhatame rathe devā~ īḷita ā vaha | asi hotā manurhitaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, (who are) Īḷita (= worshipped), bring hither the gods in an easy-moving chariot, for you are the invoker instrumental tuted by men.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तृणीत बर्हिरानुषग्घृतपृष्ठं मनीषिणः । यत्रामृतस्य चक्षणम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: stṛṇīta barhirānuṣagghṛtapṛṣṭhaṃ manīṣiṇaḥ | yatrāmṛtasya cakṣaṇam ||

translations.english: Strew, learned priests, the sacred grass, well bound together (in bundles), and sprinkled with clarified butter, the semblance of ambrosia.

mantras.sanskrit: वि श्रयन्तामृतावृधो द्वारो देवीरसश्चतः । अद्या नूनं च यष्टवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi śrayantāmṛtāvṛdho dvāro devīrasaścataḥ | adyā nūnaṃ ca yaṣṭave ||

translations.english: Let the bright doors, the augmenters of sacrifice, (hitherto) unentered, be set open, for certainly today is the sacrifice to be made.

mantras.sanskrit: नक्तोषासा सुपेशसास्मिन्यज्ञ उप ह्वये । इदं नो बर्हिरासदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: naktoṣāsā supeśasāsminyajña upa hvaye | idaṃ no barhirāsade ||

translations.english: I invoke the lovely night and dawn to sit upon the sacred grass, at this our sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: ता सुजिह्वा उप ह्वये होतारा दैव्या कवी । यज्ञं नो यक्षतामिमम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā sujihvā upa hvaye hotārā daivyā kavī | yajñaṃ no yakṣatāmimam ||

translations.english: I call the two eloquent divine and sage invokers (of the gods), that they may celebrate this our sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: इळा सरस्वती मही तिस्रो देवीर्मयोभुवः । बर्हिः सीदन्त्वस्रिधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: iḷā sarasvatī mahī tisro devīrmayobhuvaḥ | barhiḥ sīdantvasridhaḥ ||

translations.english: May the three undecaying goddesses, givers of delight, Iḷā, Sarasvatī, and Mahī (= Bhāratī), sit down upon the sacred grass.

mantras.sanskrit: इह त्वष्टारमग्रियं विश्वरूपमुप ह्वये । अस्माकमस्तु केवलः ॥
mantras.transliteration: iha tvaṣṭāramagriyaṃ viśvarūpamupa hvaye | asmākamastu kevalaḥ ||

translations.english: I invoke the chief and multiform Tvaṣṭṛ (= Viśvakarmā); may he be solely ours.

mantras.sanskrit: अव सृजा वनस्पते देव देवेभ्यो हविः । प्र दातुरस्तु चेतनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ava sṛjā vanaspate deva devebhyo haviḥ | pra dāturastu cetanam ||

translations.english: Present, divine Vanaspati (= lord of the woods), our oblation to the gods, and may true knowledge be (the reward) of the giver.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वाहा यज्ञं कृणोतनेन्द्राय यज्वनो गृहे । तत्र देवाँ उप ह्वये ॥
mantras.transliteration: svāhā yajñaṃ kṛṇotanendrāya yajvano gṛhe | tatra devā~ upa hvaye ||

translations.english: Perform the sacrifice conveyed through Svāhā (= an exclamation used in pouring the oblation on the fire) to Indra, in the house of the worshipper; therefore I call the gods hither.

mantras.sanskrit: ऐभिरग्ने दुवो गिरो विश्वेभिः सोमपीतये । देवेभिर्याहि यक्षि च ॥
mantras.transliteration: aibhiragne duvo giro viśvebhiḥ somapītaye | devebhiryāhi yakṣi ca ||

translations.english: Come, Agni, to our adoration, and to our praises, with all these gods, to drink the Soma juice; and (do you) offer sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: आ त्वा कण्वा अहूषत गृणन्ति विप्र ते धियः । देवेभिरग्न आ गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tvā kaṇvā ahūṣata gṛṇanti vipra te dhiyaḥ | devebhiragna ā gahi ||

translations.english: The kaṇvās (=medhāvinaḥ or sages; ṛtvija or officiating priests) invoke you, sapient Agni, and extol your deeds; come, Agni, Agni, with the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रवायू बृहस्पतिं मित्राग्निं पूषणं भगम् । आदित्यान्मारुतं गणम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indravāyū bṛhaspatiṃ mitrāgniṃ pūṣaṇaṃ bhagam | ādityānmārutaṃ gaṇam ||

translations.english: Sacrifice (Agni), to Indra, Vāyu, Bṛhaspati, Mitra, Agni, Pūṣan and Bhaga, the Ādityas, and the troop of Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वो भ्रियन्त इन्दवो मत्सरा मादयिष्णवः । द्रप्सा मध्वश्चमूषदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vo bhriyanta indavo matsarā mādayiṣṇavaḥ | drapsā madhvaścamūṣadaḥ ||

translations.english: For all of you are poured out these juices, satisfying, exhilarating, sweet, falling in drops, or gathered in ladles.

mantras.sanskrit: ईळते त्वामवस्यवः कण्वासो वृक्तबर्हिषः । हविष्मन्तो अरंकृतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: īḷate tvāmavasyavaḥ kaṇvāso vṛktabarhiṣaḥ | haviṣmanto araṃkṛtaḥ ||

translations.english: The wise priests desirous of the protection (of the gods) having spread the sacred grass, presenting oblations, and offering ornaments, praise you.

mantras.sanskrit: घृतपृष्ठा मनोयुजो ये त्वा वहन्ति वह्नयः । आ देवान्त्सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ghṛtapṛṣṭhā manoyujo ye tvā vahanti vahnayaḥ | ā devāntsomapītaye ||

translations.english: Let the coursers who convey you, glossy-backed, and harnessed at will, bring the gods to drink the Soma juice.

mantras.sanskrit: तान्यजत्राँ ऋतावृधोऽग्ने पत्नीवतस्कृधि । मध्वः सुजिह्व पायय ॥
mantras.transliteration: tānyajatrā~ ṛtāvṛdho'gne patnīvataskṛdhi | madhvaḥ sujihva pāyaya ||

translations.english: Agni, make those objects of veneration, augmenters of pious acts, (participant of the offering), together with their wives; give them, bright-tongued, to drink of the Soma juice.

mantras.sanskrit: ये यजत्रा य ईड्यास्ते ते पिबन्तु जिह्वया । मधोरग्ने वषट्कृति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye yajatrā ya īḍyāste te pibantu jihvayā | madhoragne vaṣaṭkṛti ||

translations.english: Let those objects of veneration and of praise, drink with your tongue, of the Soma juice, at the moment of libation.

mantras.sanskrit: आकीं सूर्यस्य रोचनाद्विश्वान्देवाँ उषर्बुधः । विप्रो होतेह वक्षति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ākīṃ sūryasya rocanādviśvāndevā~ uṣarbudhaḥ | vipro hoteha vakṣati ||

translations.english: Let the wise invoker (of the gods) bring hither from the shining (sphere) of the sun, all the divinities awaking with the dawn.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वेभिः सोम्यं मध्वग्न इन्द्रेण वायुना । पिबा मित्रस्य धामभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvebhiḥ somyaṃ madhvagna indreṇa vāyunā | pibā mitrasya dhāmabhiḥ ||

translations.english: With all the gods, with Indra, Vāyu and the glories (rays) of Mitra (= various forms of Mitra), drink, Agni the sweet Soma juice.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं होता मनुर्हितोऽग्ने यज्ञेषु सीदसि । सेमं नो अध्वरं यज ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ hotā manurhito'gne yajñeṣu sīdasi | semaṃ no adhvaraṃ yaja ||

translations.english: Your, Agni appointed by man as the invoker (of the gods) are present at sacrifices; do you present this our oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: युक्ष्वा ह्यरुषी रथे हरितो देव रोहितः । ताभिर्देवाँ इहा वह ॥
mantras.transliteration: yukṣvā hyaruṣī rathe harito deva rohitaḥ | tābhirdevā~ ihā vaha ||

translations.english: Yoke, divine Agni, your fleet and powerful mares, Rohits (tābhiḥ vaḍavābhiḥ = mares; rohit= red) to your chariott and by them hither bring the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र सोमं पिब ऋतुना त्वा विशन्त्विन्दवः । मत्सरासस्तदोकसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra somaṃ piba ṛtunā tvā viśantvindavaḥ | matsarāsastadokasaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, drink with Ṛtu (proper duty, also person nified divinity of a season) the Soma juice; let the satisfying drops entered into you, and there abide.

mantras.sanskrit: मरुतः पिबत ऋतुना पोत्राद्यज्ञं पुनीतन । यूयं हि ष्ठा सुदानवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: marutaḥ pibata ṛtunā potrādyajñaṃ punītana | yūyaṃ hi ṣṭhā sudānavaḥ ||

translations.english: Maruts, drink with Ṛtu from the sacrificial vase; consecrate the rite, for you are bountiful.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि यज्ञं गृणीहि नो ग्नावो नेष्टः पिब ऋतुना । त्वं हि रत्नधा असि ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi yajñaṃ gṛṇīhi no gnāvo neṣṭaḥ piba ṛtunā | tvaṃ hi ratnadhā asi ||

translations.english: Neṣṭā (= Tvaṣṭā), with your spouse, commend our sacrifice to the gods; drink with Ṛtu, for you are possessed of riches.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने देवाँ इहा वह सादया योनिषु त्रिषु । परि भूष पिब ऋतुना ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne devā~ ihā vaha sādayā yoniṣu triṣu | pari bhūṣa piba ṛtunā ||

translations.english: Agni, bring the gods hither, arrange them in three plural ces (Āhavanīya, Dakṣiṇa and Gārhapatya--three fires) decorate them; drink with Ṛtu.

mantras.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणादिन्द्र राधसः पिबा सोममृतूँरनु । तवेद्धि सख्यमस्तृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: brāhmaṇādindra rādhasaḥ pibā somamṛtū~ranu | taveddhi sakhyamastṛtam ||

translations.english: Drink the Soma juice, Indra from the precious vase of the Brāhmaṇa ( = Brāhmanical wealth) after Ṛtu, for whom your friendship is uninterrupteḍ  brāhmaṇād-rādhasaḥ = lit. from brāhmanical wealth; explained as a costly or wealthy vessel: dhanabhūtāt pātrāt; brāhmaṇād = brāhmaṇācchaṃsi, one of the sixteen priests employed in sacrifices, who perhaps holds some ladle or vase in which the offering is presented: tasya sambandhyucchiṣṭas camasaḥ, the relation is the ladle that has the leavings].

mantras.sanskrit: युवं दक्षं धृतव्रत मित्रावरुण दूळभम् । ऋतुना यज्ञमाशाथे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ dakṣaṃ dhṛtavrata mitrāvaruṇa dūḷabham | ṛtunā yajñamāśāthe ||

translations.english: Mitra and Varuṇa, propitious to pious acts, be present with Ṛtu at our sacrifice, efficacious and undisturbed (by foes).

mantras.sanskrit: द्रविणोदा द्रविणसो ग्रावहस्तासो अध्वरे । यज्ञेषु देवमीळते ॥
mantras.transliteration: draviṇodā draviṇaso grāvahastāso adhvare | yajñeṣu devamīḷate ||

translations.english: (The priests) desirous of wealth, holding stones in their hands, praise the divine (Agni) Draviṇodas (= Agni, donor of wealth), both in the primary (e.g. Agniṣṭoma) and subsidiary (e.g. Ukthya) sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: द्रविणोदा ददातु नो वसूनि यानि शृण्विरे । देवेषु ता वनामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: draviṇodā dadātu no vasūni yāni śṛṇvire | deveṣu tā vanāmahe ||

translations.english: May Draviṇodas give us riches that may be heard of; we ask them for the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: द्रविणोदाः पिपीषति जुहोत प्र च तिष्ठत । नेष्ट्रादृतुभिरिष्यत ॥
mantras.transliteration: draviṇodāḥ pipīṣati juhota pra ca tiṣṭhata | neṣṭrādṛtubhiriṣyata ||

translations.english: Draviṇodas desires to drink with the Ṛtu from the cup of Neṣṭā (= tvaṣṭā or one of 16 officiating priests); hasten, (priest, to the hall of offering); present the oblation, and depart.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्त्वा तुरीयमृतुभिर्द्रविणोदो यजामहे । अध स्मा नो ददिर्भव ॥
mantras.transliteration: yattvā turīyamṛtubhirdraviṇodo yajāmahe | adha smā no dadirbhava ||

translations.english: Since Draviṇodas, we adore you for the fourth time (i.e. in four ṛks) along with the Ṛtu; therefore be a benefactor unto us.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्विना पिबतं मधु दीद्यग्नी शुचिव्रता । ऋतुना यज्ञवाहसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvinā pibataṃ madhu dīdyagnī śucivratā | ṛtunā yajñavāhasā ||

translations.english: Aśvins, performers of pious acts, bright with sacrificial fires, acceptors, with the Ṛtus, of the sacrifice drink the sweet draught.

mantras.sanskrit: गार्हपत्येन सन्त्य ऋतुना यज्ञनीरसि । देवान्देवयते यज ॥
mantras.transliteration: gārhapatyena santya ṛtunā yajñanīrasi | devāndevayate yaja ||

translations.english: Giver of rewards (Agni = santya, from san, to give), being identified with the household fire, and partaker with Ṛtu of the sacrifice, worship the gods on behalf of their adorer.

mantras.sanskrit: आ त्वा वहन्तु हरयो वृषणं सोमपीतये । इन्द्र त्वा सूरचक्षसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tvā vahantu harayo vṛṣaṇaṃ somapītaye | indra tvā sūracakṣasaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, let your coursers hither bring you, bestower of desires, to drink the Soma juice; may (the priests), radiant as the Sun, (make you manifest).

mantras.sanskrit: इमा धाना घृतस्नुवो हरी इहोप वक्षतः । इन्द्रं सुखतमे रथे ॥
mantras.transliteration: imā dhānā ghṛtasnuvo harī ihopa vakṣataḥ | indraṃ sukhatame rathe ||

translations.english: Let his coursers convey Indra in an easy moving chariot hither, where these grains (of parched barley), steeped in clarified butter, are strewn (upon the altar).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रं प्रातर्हवामह इन्द्रं प्रयत्यध्वरे । इन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraṃ prātarhavāmaha indraṃ prayatyadhvare | indraṃ somasya pītaye ||

translations.english: We invoke Indra at the morning rite, we invoke him at the succeeding sacrifice, we invoke Indra to drink the Soma juice.

mantras.sanskrit: उप नः सुतमा गहि हरिभिरिन्द्र केशिभिः । सुते हि त्वा हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa naḥ sutamā gahi haribhirindra keśibhiḥ | sute hi tvā havāmahe ||

translations.english: Come, Indra, to our libation with our long-maned steeds; the libation being poured out, we invoke you.

mantras.sanskrit: सेमं नः स्तोममा गह्युपेदं सवनं सुतम् । गौरो न तृषितः पिब ॥
mantras.transliteration: semaṃ naḥ stomamā gahyupedaṃ savanaṃ sutam | gauro na tṛṣitaḥ piba ||

translations.english: Do you accept this our praise, and come to this our sacrifice, for  which the libation is prepared; drink like a thirsty stag (gaura).

mantras.sanskrit: इमे सोमास इन्दवः सुतासो अधि बर्हिषि । ताँ इन्द्र सहसे पिब ॥
mantras.transliteration: ime somāsa indavaḥ sutāso adhi barhiṣi | tā~ indra sahase piba ||

translations.english: These dripping Soma juices are effused upon the sacred grass; drink them, Indra, (to recruit your) vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं ते स्तोमो अग्रियो हृदिस्पृगस्तु शंतमः । अथा सोमं सुतं पिब ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ te stomo agriyo hṛdispṛgastu śaṃtamaḥ | athā somaṃ sutaṃ piba ||

translations.english: May this our excellent hymn, touching your heart, be grateful to you, and thence drink the effused libation.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वमित्सवनं सुतमिन्द्रो मदाय गच्छति । वृत्रहा सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvamitsavanaṃ sutamindro madāya gacchati | vṛtrahā somapītaye ||

translations.english: Indra, the destroyer of enemies, repairs assuredly to every ceremony where the libation is poured out, to drink the Soma juice for (his) exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: सेमं नः काममा पृण गोभिरश्वैः शतक्रतो । स्तवाम त्वा स्वाध्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: semaṃ naḥ kāmamā pṛṇa gobhiraśvaiḥ śatakrato | stavāma tvā svādhyaḥ ||

translations.english: Do you, Śatakratu, accomplish our desire with (the gift of) cattle and horse; profoundly meditating, we praise you.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रावरुणयोरहं सम्राजोरव आ वृणे । ता नो मृळात ईदृशे ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāvaruṇayorahaṃ samrājorava ā vṛṇe | tā no mṛḷāta īdṛśe ||

translations.english: I seek the protection of the sovereign rulers (= possessed of extensive dominion or shining very brilliantly), Indra and Varuṇa; may they both favour us accordingly.

mantras.sanskrit: गन्तारा हि स्थोऽवसे हवं विप्रस्य मावतः । धर्तारा चर्षणीनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: gantārā hi stho'vase havaṃ viprasya māvataḥ | dhartārā carṣaṇīnām ||

translations.english: For you are ever ready, guardians of mankind, to grant protection on the appeal of a minister such as I am.

mantras.sanskrit: अनुकामं तर्पयेथामिन्द्रावरुण राय आ । ता वां नेदिष्ठमीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: anukāmaṃ tarpayethāmindrāvaruṇa rāya ā | tā vāṃ nediṣṭhamīmahe ||

translations.english: Satisfy us with wealth, Indra and Varuṇa, according to our desires; we desire you ever near us.

mantras.sanskrit: युवाकु हि शचीनां युवाकु सुमतीनाम् । भूयाम वाजदाव्नाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvāku hi śacīnāṃ yuvāku sumatīnām | bhūyāma vājadāvnām ||

translations.english: The mingled (libations; yuvāku = mixture of curds and ghee; śacīnām, mixture of butter milk, water and meal) of our pious rites, the mingled yuvāku sumatīnām = (laudations) of our right-minded (= sumatīnām, priests, are prepared); may we be (included) among the givers of food.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रः सहस्रदाव्नां वरुणः शंस्यानाम् । क्रतुर्भवत्युक्थ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraḥ sahasradāvnāṃ varuṇaḥ śaṃsyānām | kraturbhavatyukthyaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra is a giver among the givers of thousands;Varuṇa is to be praised among those who are deserving of laudation.

mantras.sanskrit: तयोरिदवसा वयं सनेम नि च धीमहि । स्यादुत प्ररेचनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tayoridavasā vayaṃ sanema ni ca dhīmahi | syāduta prarecanam ||

translations.english: Through their protection, we enjoy (riches) and heap them up, and still there is abundance.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रावरुण वामहं हुवे चित्राय राधसे । अस्मान्त्सु जिग्युषस्कृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāvaruṇa vāmahaṃ huve citrāya rādhase | asmāntsu jigyuṣaskṛtam ||

translations.english: I invoke you both, Indra and Varuṇa, quickly bestow happiness upon us, for our minds are devoted to you both.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रावरुण नू नु वां सिषासन्तीषु धीष्वा । अस्मभ्यं शर्म यच्छतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāvaruṇa nū nu vāṃ siṣāsantīṣu dhīṣvā | asmabhyaṃ śarma yacchatam ||

translations.english: Indra and Varuṇa, quickly bestow happiness upon us, for our minds are devoted to you both.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वामश्नोतु सुष्टुतिरिन्द्रावरुण यां हुवे । यामृधाथे सधस्तुतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vāmaśnotu suṣṭutirindrāvaruṇa yāṃ huve | yāmṛdhāthe sadhastutim ||

translations.english: May the earnest priase which I offer to Indra and Varuṇa reach you both--that conjoint praise which you (accepting), dignify.

mantras.sanskrit: सोमानं स्वरणं कृणुहि ब्रह्मणस्पते । कक्षीवन्तं य औशिजः ॥
mantras.transliteration: somānaṃ svaraṇaṃ kṛṇuhi brahmaṇaspate | kakṣīvantaṃ ya auśijaḥ ||

translations.english: Brahmaṇaspati (=Agni, connected with prayer) make the offerer of the libation illustrious among the gods, like Kakṣīvat, the son of Uśij (and Dīrghatamas).

mantras.sanskrit: यो रेवान्यो अमीवहा वसुवित्पुष्टिवर्धनः । स नः सिषक्तु यस्तुरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo revānyo amīvahā vasuvitpuṣṭivardhanaḥ | sa naḥ siṣaktu yasturaḥ ||

translations.english: May he who is opulent, the healer of disease, the acquirer of riches, the augmenter of nourishment, the prompt (bestower of rewards) be favourable to us.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नः शंसो अररुषो धूर्तिः प्रणङ्मर्त्यस्य । रक्षा णो ब्रह्मणस्पते ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā naḥ śaṃso araruṣo dhūrtiḥ praṇaṅmartyasya | rakṣā ṇo brahmaṇaspate ||

translations.english: Protect us, Brahmaṇaspati, so that no calumnious censure of a melevolent man may reach us.

mantras.sanskrit: स घा वीरो न रिष्यति यमिन्द्रो ब्रह्मणस्पतिः । सोमो हिनोति मर्त्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa ghā vīro na riṣyati yamindro brahmaṇaspatiḥ | somo hinoti martyam ||

translations.english: The liberal man, whom Indra, Brahmaṇaspati, and Soma protect, never perishes.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं तं ब्रह्मणस्पते सोम इन्द्रश्च मर्त्यम् । दक्षिणा पात्वंहसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ taṃ brahmaṇaspate soma indraśca martyam | dakṣiṇā pātvaṃhasaḥ ||

translations.english: Do you, Brahmaṇaspati, and do you, Soma, Indra and Dakṣiṇā (= present person nified as a feminine le divinity), protect that man from sin.

mantras.sanskrit: सदसस्पतिमद्भुतं प्रियमिन्द्रस्य काम्यम् । सनिं मेधामयासिषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sadasaspatimadbhutaṃ priyamindrasya kāmyam | saniṃ medhāmayāsiṣam ||

translations.english: I solicit understanding from Sadasaspati (= Agni, protector of the assembly), the wonderful, the friend of Indra, the desirable, the bountiful.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्मादृते न सिध्यति यज्ञो विपश्चितश्चन । स धीनां योगमिन्वति ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasmādṛte na sidhyati yajño vipaścitaścana | sa dhīnāṃ yogaminvati ||

translations.english: Without whose aid the sacrifice even of the wise is not perfected; he pervades the association of our thoughts (or, the object of our pious acts; dhī = buddhi, understanding or karma).

mantras.sanskrit: आदृध्नोति हविष्कृतिं प्राञ्चं कृणोत्यध्वरम् । होत्रा देवेषु गच्छति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ādṛdhnoti haviṣkṛtiṃ prāñcaṃ kṛṇotyadhvaram | hotrā deveṣu gacchati ||

translations.english: He rewrds the presenter of the oblation; he brings the sacrifice to its conclusion; (through him) our invocation reaches the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: नराशंसं सुधृष्टममपश्यं सप्रथस्तमम् । दिवो न सद्ममखसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: narāśaṃsaṃ sudhṛṣṭamamapaśyaṃ saprathastamam | divo na sadmamakhasam ||

translations.english: I have beheld Nārāśaṃsa (i.e. Agni or the person nified yajña or sacrifice at which men praise the gods), the most resolute, the most renowned, and radiant as the heavens.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रति त्यं चारुमध्वरं गोपीथाय प्र हूयसे । मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: prati tyaṃ cārumadhvaraṃ gopīthāya pra hūyase | marudbhiragna ā gahi ||

translations.english: Earnestly are you invoked to this perfect rite, to drink the Soma juice; come, Agni, with the Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: नहि देवो न मर्त्यो महस्तव क्रतुं परः । मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahi devo na martyo mahastava kratuṃ paraḥ | marudbhiragna ā gahi ||

translations.english: Nor god nor man has power over a rite (dedicated) to you, who are mighty; come, Agni, with the Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: ये महो रजसो विदुर्विश्वे देवासो अद्रुहः । मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye maho rajaso vidurviśve devāso adruhaḥ | marudbhiragna ā gahi ||

translations.english: Who all are divine (devāsaḥ = dyotamānāḥ, shining) and devoid of malignity and who know (how to cause the descent) of great waters; come, Agni, with the (sapta-gaṇā or all seven troops of) Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: य उग्रा अर्कमानृचुरनाधृष्टास ओजसा । मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya ugrā arkamānṛcuranādhṛṣṭāsa ojasā | marudbhiragna ā gahi ||

translations.english: Who are fierce, and send down rain (arka, from arc to worship; āpo vā arkaḥ (Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa 10.6.5.2); hence, arka connotes water or rain), and are unsurpassed in strength; come, Agni with the Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: ये शुभ्रा घोरवर्पसः सुक्षत्रासो रिशादसः । मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye śubhrā ghoravarpasaḥ sukṣatrāso riśādasaḥ | marudbhiragna ā gahi ||

translations.english: Who are brilliant, of terrific forms, who are possessors of great wealth, and are devourers of the malevolent; come, Agni with the Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: ये नाकस्याधि रोचने दिवि देवास आसते । मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye nākasyādhi rocane divi devāsa āsate | marudbhiragna ā gahi ||

translations.english: Who are divinities abiding in the radiant heaven above the sun; come, Agni with the Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: य ईङ्खयन्ति पर्वतान्तिरः समुद्रमर्णवम् । मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya īṅkhayanti parvatāntiraḥ samudramarṇavam | marudbhiragna ā gahi ||

translations.english: Who scatter the clouds, and agitate the sea (with waves): come, Agni with the Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: आ ये तन्वन्ति रश्मिभिस्तिरः समुद्रमोजसा । मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā ye tanvanti raśmibhistiraḥ samudramojasā | marudbhiragna ā gahi ||

translations.english: Who spread (through the firmament) along with the rays (of the sun) and with their strength agitate the ocean: come, Agni, with the Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि त्वा पूर्वपीतये सृजामि सोम्यं मधु । मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi tvā pūrvapītaye sṛjāmi somyaṃ madhu | marudbhiragna ā gahi ||

translations.english: I pour out the sweet Soma juice for your drinking, (as) of old; come, Agni with the Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं देवाय जन्मने स्तोमो विप्रेभिरासया । अकारि रत्नधातमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ devāya janmane stomo viprebhirāsayā | akāri ratnadhātamaḥ ||

translations.english: This hymn, the bestower of riches, has been addressed by the sages, with their own mouths, to the (class of) divinities having birth (lit. to the divine or brilliant birth; e.g. Ṛbhus--Ṛbhu, Vibhu and Vāja were pious men, who through penance became divinities).

mantras.sanskrit: य इन्द्राय वचोयुजा ततक्षुर्मनसा हरी । शमीभिर्यज्ञमाशत ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya indrāya vacoyujā tatakṣurmanasā harī | śamībhiryajñamāśata ||

translations.english: They who created mentally for Indra the horses that are harnessed (carved) at his words, have partaken of the sacrifice performed with holy acts. (śamībhiḥ = ceremonies; i.e. they have pervaded, appropriated or accepted the sacrifice peformed with tongs, ladles, and utensils; an intimation of the mechanical skills of Ṛbhu).

mantras.sanskrit: तक्षन्नासत्याभ्यां परिज्मानं सुखं रथम् । तक्षन्धेनुं सबर्दुघाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: takṣannāsatyābhyāṃ parijmānaṃ sukhaṃ ratham | takṣandhenuṃ sabardughām ||

translations.english: They constructed for the Nāsatyās, a universally-moving and easy car, and a cow yielding milk. (takṣan = atakṣan, lit. they (Ṛbhus) chipped or fabricated, mechanically, the appendages of Indra and Aśvin).

mantras.sanskrit: युवाना पितरा पुनः सत्यमन्त्रा ऋजूयवः । ऋभवो विष्ट्यक्रत ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvānā pitarā punaḥ satyamantrā ṛjūyavaḥ | ṛbhavo viṣṭyakrata ||

translations.english: The Ṛbhus, uttering unfailing prayers, endowed with rectitude, and succeeding (in all pious acts; viṣṭī = vyāptiyuktaḥ, i.e. encountering no opposition in all acts), made their (aged) parents young.

mantras.sanskrit: सं वो मदासो अग्मतेन्द्रेण च मरुत्वता । आदित्येभिश्च राजभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ vo madāso agmatendreṇa ca marutvatā | ādityebhiśca rājabhiḥ ||

translations.english: Ṛbhus, the exhilarating juices are offered to you, along with Indra, attended by the Maruts and along with the brilliang Ādityas.

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्यं चमसं नवं त्वष्टुर्देवस्य निष्कृतम् । अकर्त चतुरः पुनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tyaṃ camasaṃ navaṃ tvaṣṭurdevasya niṣkṛtam | akarta caturaḥ punaḥ ||

translations.english: The Ṛbhus have divided unto four the new ladle, the work of the divine Tvaṣṭā (i.e. devasambandhiḥ takṣana.vyāpāraḥ = divinity whose duty in relations to gods is carpentry; cf. tvaṣṭā tvaṣṭuḥ śiṣyāḥ Ṛbhavaḥ = Ṛbhus are the disciples of Tvaṣṭā; four ladles are an apparent reference to an innovation in the objects of libation for sharing).

mantras.sanskrit: ते नो रत्नानि धत्तन त्रिरा साप्तानि सुन्वते । एकमेकं सुशस्तिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te no ratnāni dhattana trirā sāptāni sunvate | ekamekaṃ suśastibhiḥ ||

translations.english: May they, moved by our praises, give to the offere of the libation many precious things, and perfect the thrice seven sacrifices

mantras.sanskrit: अधारयन्त वह्नयोऽभजन्त सुकृत्यया । भागं देवेषु यज्ञियम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhārayanta vahnayo'bhajanta sukṛtyayā | bhāgaṃ deveṣu yajñiyam ||

translations.english: Offerers (of sacrifices), they held (a moral existence); by their pious acts they obtained a share of sacrifices with the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: इहेन्द्राग्नी उप ह्वये तयोरित्स्तोममुश्मसि । ता सोमं सोमपातमा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ihendrāgnī upa hvaye tayoritstomamuśmasi | tā somaṃ somapātamā ||

translations.english: Invoke hither Indra and Agni, to whom we desire to present our praise; let them, who are both copious drinkers of the Soma juice, (accept the libation).

mantras.sanskrit: ता यज्ञेषु प्र शंसतेन्द्राग्नी शुम्भता नरः । ता गायत्रेषु गायत ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā yajñeṣu pra śaṃsatendrāgnī śumbhatā naraḥ | tā gāyatreṣu gāyata ||

translations.english: Praise, men, Indra and Agni, in sacrifices, decorate them (with ornaments) and hymn them with hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: ता मित्रस्य प्रशस्तय इन्द्राग्नी ता हवामहे । सोमपा सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā mitrasya praśastaya indrāgnī tā havāmahe | somapā somapītaye ||

translations.english: We invoke Indra and Agni, for the benefit of our friend (the instrumental tutor of the rite), drinkers of the Soma juice, to drink the libation.

mantras.sanskrit: उग्रा सन्ता हवामह उपेदं सवनं सुतम् । इन्द्राग्नी एह गच्छताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ugrā santā havāmaha upedaṃ savanaṃ sutam | indrāgnī eha gacchatām ||

translations.english: We invoke the two who are fierce (to their foes) to attend the rite, where the libation is prepared; Indra and Agni, come hither.

mantras.sanskrit: ता महान्ता सदस्पती इन्द्राग्नी रक्ष उब्जतम् । अप्रजाः सन्त्वत्रिणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā mahāntā sadaspatī indrāgnī rakṣa ubjatam | aprajāḥ santvatriṇaḥ ||

translations.english: May those two, Indra and Agni who are mighty, and guardians of the assembly, render the Rākṣas innocuous, and may the devourers (of men) be destitute of progeny.

mantras.sanskrit: तेन सत्येन जागृतमधि प्रचेतुने पदे । इन्द्राग्नी शर्म यच्छतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tena satyena jāgṛtamadhi pracetune pade | indrāgnī śarma yacchatam ||

translations.english: By this unfailing sacrifice, by you rendered vigilant, Indra and Agni, in the station which affords knowledge (of the consequence of acts), and bestow upon us happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रातर्युजा वि बोधयाश्विनावेह गच्छताम् । अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: prātaryujā vi bodhayāśvināveha gacchatām | asya somasya pītaye ||

translations.english: Awaken, the Aśvins, associated for the morning sacrifice; let them both come hither to drink of this Soma juice.

mantras.sanskrit: या सुरथा रथीतमोभा देवा दिविस्पृशा । अश्विना ता हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā surathā rathītamobhā devā divispṛśā | aśvinā tā havāmahe ||

translations.english: We invoke the two Aśvins, who are both divine, the best of charioteers, riding in an excellent car and attaining heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: या वां कशा मधुमत्यश्विना सूनृतावती । तया यज्ञं मिमिक्षतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā vāṃ kaśā madhumatyaśvinā sūnṛtāvatī | tayā yajñaṃ mimikṣatam ||

translations.english: Aśvins, stir up (mimikṣatam = mix intimately, rapidly like a whip) the sacrifice with your whip that is wet the foam (of your horses), and lashing loudly.

mantras.sanskrit: नहि वामस्ति दूरके यत्रा रथेन गच्छथः । अश्विना सोमिनो गृहम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahi vāmasti dūrake yatrā rathena gacchathaḥ | aśvinā somino gṛham ||

translations.english: The abode of the offerer of the libation is not far from you, Aśvins, going thither in your car.

mantras.sanskrit: हिरण्यपाणिमूतये सवितारमुप ह्वये । स चेत्ता देवता पदम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: hiraṇyapāṇimūtaye savitāramupa hvaye | sa cettā devatā padam ||

translations.english: Invoke Savitā (Sun), the golden- handed, to protect me; he will appoint the station of the worshippers.

mantras.sanskrit: अपां नपातमवसे सवितारमुप स्तुहि । तस्य व्रतान्युश्मसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: apāṃ napātamavase savitāramupa stuhi | tasya vratānyuśmasi ||

translations.english: Glorify Savitā, who is no friend to water, or our protection; we desire to celebrate his worship.(apām napāt = son of the waters).

mantras.sanskrit: विभक्तारं हवामहे वसोश्चित्रस्य राधसः । सवितारं नृचक्षसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vibhaktāraṃ havāmahe vasościtrasya rādhasaḥ | savitāraṃ nṛcakṣasam ||

translations.english: We invoke Savitā, the enlightener of men, the dispenser of various home-insuring wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: सखाय आ नि षीदत सविता स्तोम्यो नु नः । दाता राधांसि शुम्भति ॥
mantras.transliteration: sakhāya ā ni ṣīdata savitā stomyo nu naḥ | dātā rādhāṃsi śumbhati ||

translations.english: Sit down, friends; Savitā verily is to be praised by us, for he is the giver of riches.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने पत्नीरिहा वह देवानामुशतीरुप । त्वष्टारं सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne patnīrihā vaha devānāmuśatīrupa | tvaṣṭāraṃ somapītaye ||

translations.english: Agni, bring hither the loving wives of the gods, and Tvaṣṭā, to drink the Soma juice.

mantras.sanskrit: आ ग्ना अग्न इहावसे होत्रां यविष्ठ भारतीम् । वरूत्रीं धिषणां वह ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā gnā agna ihāvase hotrāṃ yaviṣṭha bhāratīm | varūtrīṃ dhiṣaṇāṃ vaha ||

translations.english: Youthful Agni, bring hither for our protection the wives (of the gods), Hotrā (wife of Agni or person nified invocation), Bhāratī (an Āditya), Varutrī (= varaṇīyā, chosen), and Dhiṣaṇā (= vāc or vāg-devī, goddess of speech).

mantras.sanskrit: अभि नो देवीरवसा महः शर्मणा नृपत्नीः । अच्छिन्नपत्राः सचन्ताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi no devīravasā mahaḥ śarmaṇā nṛpatnīḥ | acchinnapatrāḥ sacantām ||

translations.english: May the goddesses, whose wings are unclipt the protectresses of mankind, favour us with perfection, and with entire felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: इहेन्द्राणीमुप ह्वये वरुणानीं स्वस्तये । अग्नायीं सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ihendrāṇīmupa hvaye varuṇānīṃ svastaye | agnāyīṃ somapītaye ||

translations.english: Invoke hither, Indrāṇī, Varuṇānī, and Agnāyī, for our welfare, and to drink the Soma juice.

mantras.sanskrit: मही द्यौः पृथिवी च न इमं यज्ञं मिमिक्षताम् । पिपृतां नो भरीमभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahī dyauḥ pṛthivī ca na imaṃ yajñaṃ mimikṣatām | pipṛtāṃ no bharīmabhiḥ ||

translations.english: May the great heven and the earth be plural ased to blend this sacrifice (with their own dews) and fill us with nutriment.

mantras.sanskrit: तयोरिद्घृतवत्पयो विप्रा रिहन्ति धीतिभिः । गन्धर्वस्य ध्रुवे पदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tayoridghṛtavatpayo viprā rihanti dhītibhiḥ | gandharvasya dhruve pade ||

translations.english: The wise taste, through their pious acts, the ghee-resembling waters of these two, (abiding) in the permanent region of the Gandharvas. (Antarikṣa, the sphere of gandharvas, yakṣas and apsarasas, the firmament between heaven and earth).

mantras.sanskrit: स्योना पृथिवि भवानृक्षरा निवेशनी । यच्छा नः शर्म सप्रथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: syonā pṛthivi bhavānṛkṣarā niveśanī | yacchā naḥ śarma saprathaḥ ||

translations.english: Earth be your wide-spreading, free from thorns, and our abiding plural ce; give us great happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: अतो देवा अवन्तु नो यतो विष्णुर्विचक्रमे । पृथिव्याः सप्त धामभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ato devā avantu no yato viṣṇurvicakrame | pṛthivyāḥ sapta dhāmabhiḥ ||

translations.english: May the gods preserve us (from that portion) of the earth whence Viṣṇu (aided) by the seven metres, stepped.

mantras.sanskrit: इदं विष्णुर्वि चक्रमे त्रेधा नि दधे पदम् । समूळ्हमस्य पांसुरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: idaṃ viṣṇurvi cakrame tredhā ni dadhe padam | samūḷhamasya pāṃsure ||

translations.english: Viṣṇu traversed this (world); three times he plural nted his foot and the whole (world) was collected in the dust of his (footstep).

mantras.sanskrit: त्रीणि पदा वि चक्रमे विष्णुर्गोपा अदाभ्यः । अतो धर्माणि धारयन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: trīṇi padā vi cakrame viṣṇurgopā adābhyaḥ | ato dharmāṇi dhārayan ||

translations.english: Viṣṇu, the preserver, the uninjurable, stepped three steps, upholding thereby righteous acts.

mantras.sanskrit: विष्णोः कर्माणि पश्यत यतो व्रतानि पस्पशे । इन्द्रस्य युज्यः सखा ॥
mantras.transliteration: viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi paśyata yato vratāni paspaśe | indrasya yujyaḥ sakhā ||

translations.english: Behold the deeds of Viṣṇu, through which (the worshipper) has accomplished (pious) vows; he is the worthy friend of Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: तद्विष्णोः परमं पदं सदा पश्यन्ति सूरयः । दिवीव चक्षुराततम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ | divīva cakṣurātatam ||

translations.english: The wise ever contemplate that supreme station of Viṣṇu, as the eye ranges over the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: तद्विप्रासो विपन्यवो जागृवांसः समिन्धते । विष्णोर्यत्परमं पदम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadviprāso vipanyavo jāgṛvāṃsaḥ samindhate | viṣṇoryatparamaṃ padam ||

translations.english: The wise, ever vigilant and diligent in praise, amply glorify that which is the supreme station of Viṣṇu.

mantras.sanskrit: तीव्राः सोमास आ गह्याशीर्वन्तः सुता इमे । वायो तान्प्रस्थितान्पिब ॥
mantras.transliteration: tīvrāḥ somāsa ā gahyāśīrvantaḥ sutā ime | vāyo tānprasthitānpiba ||

translations.english: These sharp and blessing-bearing Soma juices are poured out; come, Vāyu, and drink of them as presented.

mantras.sanskrit: उभा देवा दिविस्पृशेन्द्रवायू हवामहे । अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ubhā devā divispṛśendravāyū havāmahe | asya somasya pītaye ||

translations.english: We invoke both the divinities abiding in heaven, Indra and Vāyu, to drink of this Soma juice.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रवायू मनोजुवा विप्रा हवन्त ऊतये । सहस्राक्षा धियस्पती ॥
mantras.transliteration: indravāyū manojuvā viprā havanta ūtaye | sahasrākṣā dhiyaspatī ||

translations.english: The wise invoke, for their preservation, Indra and Vāyu, who are swift as thought, have a thousand eyes, and are protectors of pious acts.

mantras.sanskrit: मित्रं वयं हवामहे वरुणं सोमपीतये । जज्ञाना पूतदक्षसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: mitraṃ vayaṃ havāmahe varuṇaṃ somapītaye | jajñānā pūtadakṣasā ||

translations.english: We invoke Mitra and Varuṇa, becoming present at the sacrifice, and of pure strength, to drink the Soma juice.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतेन यावृतावृधावृतस्य ज्योतिषस्पती । ता मित्रावरुणा हुवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtena yāvṛtāvṛdhāvṛtasya jyotiṣaspatī | tā mitrāvaruṇā huve ||

translations.english: I invoke Mitra and Varuṇa, who with true speech, are the encouragers of pious acts, and are lords of true lighṭ

mantras.sanskrit: वरुणः प्राविता भुवन्मित्रो विश्वाभिरूतिभिः । करतां नः सुराधसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: varuṇaḥ prāvitā bhuvanmitro viśvābhirūtibhiḥ | karatāṃ naḥ surādhasaḥ ||

translations.english: May Varuṇa be our especial protector; may Mitra defend us with all defences; may they make us most opulent.

mantras.sanskrit: मरुत्वन्तं हवामह इन्द्रमा सोमपीतये । सजूर्गणेन तृम्पतु ॥
mantras.transliteration: marutvantaṃ havāmaha indramā somapītaye | sajūrgaṇena tṛmpatu ||

translations.english: We invoke Indra, attended by the Maruts to drink the Soma juice; may he, with his associates, be satisfied.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रज्येष्ठा मरुद्गणा देवासः पूषरातयः । विश्वे मम श्रुता हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrajyeṣṭhā marudgaṇā devāsaḥ pūṣarātayaḥ | viśve mama śrutā havam ||
