translations.english: Divine Maruts, of whom Indra is the chief and Pūṣan is the donor, or benefactor; in what way, is not specified.

mantras.sanskrit: हत वृत्रं सुदानव इन्द्रेण सहसा युजा । मा नो दुःशंस ईशत ॥
mantras.transliteration: hata vṛtraṃ sudānava indreṇa sahasā yujā | mā no duḥśaṃsa īśata ||

translations.english: Liberal donors, along with the mighty and associated Indra, destroy Vṛtra; let not the evil one prevail against us.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वान्देवान्हवामहे मरुतः सोमपीतये । उग्रा हि पृश्निमातरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvāndevānhavāmahe marutaḥ somapītaye | ugrā hi pṛśnimātaraḥ ||

translations.english: We invoke all the divine Maruts, who are fierce, and have the (many-   coloured) earth for their mother, to drink the Soma juice.

mantras.sanskrit: जयतामिव तन्यतुर्मरुतामेति धृष्णुया । यच्छुभं याथना नरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: jayatāmiva tanyaturmarutāmeti dhṛṣṇuyā | yacchubhaṃ yāthanā naraḥ ||

translations.english: Whenever, leaders (of men), you accept an auspicious (offering), then the shout of the Maruts spreads with exultation, like (that) of conquerors.

mantras.sanskrit: हस्काराद्विद्युतस्पर्यतो जाता अवन्तु नः । मरुतो मृळयन्तु नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: haskārādvidyutasparyato jātā avantu naḥ | maruto mṛḷayantu naḥ ||

translations.english: May the Maruts, born from the brilliant lightning, everywhere preserve us, and make us happy.

mantras.sanskrit: आ पूषञ्चित्रबर्हिषमाघृणे धरुणं दिवः । आजा नष्टं यथा पशुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā pūṣañcitrabarhiṣamāghṛṇe dharuṇaṃ divaḥ | ājā naṣṭaṃ yathā paśum ||

translations.english: Resplendent and (swift) moving Pūṣan, bring from heaven the Soma juice, in combination with the variegated sacred grass, as (a man brings back) an animal that was lost.

mantras.sanskrit: पूषा राजानमाघृणिरपगूळ्हं गुहा हितम् । अविन्दच्चित्रबर्हिषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pūṣā rājānamāghṛṇirapagūḷhaṃ guhā hitam | avindaccitrabarhiṣam ||

translations.english: The resplendent Pūṣan has found the royal (Soma juice), although concealed, hidden in a secret plural ce, strewed amongst the sacred grass.

mantras.sanskrit: उतो स मह्यमिन्दुभिः षड्युक्ताँ अनुसेषिधत् । गोभिर्यवं न चर्कृषत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uto sa mahyamindubhiḥ ṣaḍyuktā~ anuseṣidhat | gobhiryavaṃ na carkṛṣat ||

translations.english: Verily he has brought to me successively the six (seasons), connected with the drops (of the Soma juice) as (a husbandsman) repeatedly plural ughs (the earth) for barley.

mantras.sanskrit: अम्बयो यन्त्यध्वभिर्जामयो अध्वरीयताम् । पृञ्चतीर्मधुना पयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ambayo yantyadhvabhirjāmayo adhvarīyatām | pṛñcatīrmadhunā payaḥ ||

translations.english: Mothers to us, who are desirous of sacrificing, the kindred (waters) flow by the paths (of sacrifice) qualifying the milk (of kine) with sweetnesṣ

mantras.sanskrit: अमूर्या उप सूर्ये याभिर्वा सूर्यः सह । ता नो हिन्वन्त्वध्वरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: amūryā upa sūrye yābhirvā sūryaḥ saha | tā no hinvantvadhvaram ||

translations.english: May those waters which are contiguous to the Sun, and those with which the Sun is associated, be propitious to our rite.

mantras.sanskrit: अपो देवीरुप ह्वये यत्र गावः पिबन्ति नः । सिन्धुभ्यः कर्त्वं हविः ॥
mantras.transliteration: apo devīrupa hvaye yatra gāvaḥ pibanti naḥ | sindhubhyaḥ kartvaṃ haviḥ ||

translations.english: Invoke the divine waters in which our cattle drink; offer oblations to the following (streams).

mantras.sanskrit: अप्स्वन्तरमृतमप्सु भेषजमपामुत प्रशस्तये । देवा भवत वाजिनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: apsvantaramṛtamapsu bheṣajamapāmuta praśastaye | devā bhavata vājinaḥ ||

translations.english: Ambrosia is in the waters; in the waters are medicinal herbs; therefore, divine (priest), be prompt in their praise.

mantras.sanskrit: अप्सु मे सोमो अब्रवीदन्तर्विश्वानि भेषजा । अग्निं च विश्वशम्भुवमापश्च विश्वभेषजीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: apsu me somo abravīdantarviśvāni bheṣajā | agniṃ ca viśvaśambhuvamāpaśca viśvabheṣajīḥ ||

translations.english: Soma has declared to me, 'all medicaments, as well as Agni, the benefactor of the universe, are in the waters'; the waters, contain all healing herbs.

mantras.sanskrit: आपः पृणीत भेषजं वरूथं तन्वे मम । ज्योक्च सूर्यं दृशे ॥
mantras.transliteration: āpaḥ pṛṇīta bheṣajaṃ varūthaṃ tanve mama | jyokca sūryaṃ dṛśe ||

translations.english: Waters, bring to perfection all disease-dispelling medicaments for (the good of) my body, that I may long behold the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: इदमापः प्र वहत यत्किं च दुरितं मयि । यद्वाहमभिदुद्रोह यद्वा शेप उतानृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: idamāpaḥ pra vahata yatkiṃ ca duritaṃ mayi | yadvāhamabhidudroha yadvā śepa utānṛtam ||

translations.english: Waters, take away whatever sin has been (found) in me whether I have (knowingly) done wrong, or have pronounced imprecations (against holy men) or (have spoken) untruth.

mantras.sanskrit: आपो अद्यान्वचारिषं रसेन समगस्महि । पयस्वानग्न आ गहि तं मा सं सृज वर्चसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: āpo adyānvacāriṣaṃ rasena samagasmahi | payasvānagna ā gahi taṃ mā saṃ sṛja varcasā ||

translations.english: I have this day entered into the waters; we have mingled with their essence; Agni, abiding in the waters, approach, and fill me, thus (bathed), with vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: सं माग्ने वर्चसा सृज सं प्रजया समायुषा । विद्युर्मे अस्य देवा इन्द्रो विद्यात्सह ऋषिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ māgne varcasā sṛja saṃ prajayā samāyuṣā | vidyurme asya devā indro vidyātsaha ṛṣibhiḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, confer upon me vigour, progeny and life, so that the gods may know the (sacrifice) of this my (employer), and Indra with the Ṛṣis, may know it.

mantras.sanskrit: कस्य नूनं कतमस्यामृतानां मनामहे चारु देवस्य नाम । को नो मह्या अदितये पुनर्दात्पितरं च दृशेयं मातरं च ॥
mantras.transliteration: kasya nūnaṃ katamasyāmṛtānāṃ manāmahe cāru devasya nāma | ko no mahyā aditaye punardātpitaraṃ ca dṛśeyaṃ mātaraṃ ca ||

translations.english: Of whom, or of which divinity of the immortals, shall we invoke the auspicious name? who will give us to the great Aditi that I may again behold my father and my mother.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्नेर्वयं प्रथमस्यामृतानां मनामहे चारु देवस्य नाम । स नो मह्या अदितये पुनर्दात्पितरं च दृशेयं मातरं च ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnervayaṃ prathamasyāmṛtānāṃ manāmahe cāru devasya nāma | sa no mahyā aditaye punardātpitaraṃ ca dṛśeyaṃ mātaraṃ ca ||

translations.english: Let us invoke the auspicious name of Agni, the first divinity of the immortals, that he may give us to the great Aditi, and that I may behold agin my father and my mother.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि त्वा देव सवितरीशानं वार्याणाम् । सदावन्भागमीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi tvā deva savitarīśānaṃ vāryāṇām | sadāvanbhāgamīmahe ||

translations.english: Ever-protecting Savitā, we solicit (our) portion of you, who are the lord of affluence.

mantras.sanskrit: यश्चिद्धि त इत्था भगः शशमानः पुरा निदः । अद्वेषो हस्तयोर्दधे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaściddhi ta itthā bhagaḥ śaśamānaḥ purā nidaḥ | adveṣo hastayordadhe ||

translations.english: That wealth which has been retained in your hands, and is entitled to commendation, as exempt from envy or reproach.

mantras.sanskrit: भगभक्तस्य ते वयमुदशेम तवावसा । मूर्धानं राय आरभे ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhagabhaktasya te vayamudaśema tavāvasā | mūrdhānaṃ rāya ārabhe ||

translations.english: We are assiduous in attaining the summit of affluence, through the protection of you, who are the possessor of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: नहि ते क्षत्रं न सहो न मन्युं वयश्चनामी पतयन्त आपुः । नेमा आपो अनिमिषं चरन्तीर्न ये वातस्य प्रमिनन्त्यभ्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahi te kṣatraṃ na saho na manyuṃ vayaścanāmī patayanta āpuḥ | nemā āpo animiṣaṃ carantīrna ye vātasya praminantyabhvam ||

translations.english: These birds, that are flying (through the air), have not obtained, Varuṇa, your bodily strength or your prowess, or (are able to endure your) wrath; neither do these waters that flow increasingly, nor (do the gales) of wind, surpass your speed.

mantras.sanskrit: अबुध्ने राजा वरुणो वनस्योर्ध्वं स्तूपं ददते पूतदक्षः । नीचीनाः स्थुरुपरि बुध्न एषामस्मे अन्तर्निहिताः केतवः स्युः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abudhne rājā varuṇo vanasyordhvaṃ stūpaṃ dadate pūtadakṣaḥ | nīcīnāḥ sthurupari budhna eṣāmasme antarnihitāḥ ketavaḥ syuḥ ||

translations.english: The regal Varuṇa, of pure vigour (abiding) in the baseless (firmament), sustains on high a heap of light, the rays (of which) are pointed downwards, while their base is above; may they become concentrated in us as the sources of existence.

mantras.sanskrit: उरुं हि राजा वरुणश्चकार सूर्याय पन्थामन्वेतवा उ । अपदे पादा प्रतिधातवेऽकरुतापवक्ता हृदयाविधश्चित् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uruṃ hi rājā varuṇaścakāra sūryāya panthāmanvetavā u | apade pādā pratidhātave'karutāpavaktā hṛdayāvidhaścit ||

translations.english: The regal Varuṇa verily made with the path of the sun, (by which) to travel on his daily course; a path to traverse in pathless (space); may he be the repeller of every afflicter of the heart.

mantras.sanskrit: शतं ते राजन्भिषजः सहस्रमुर्वी गभीरा सुमतिष्टे अस्तु । बाधस्व दूरे निॠतिं पराचैः कृतं चिदेनः प्र मुमुग्ध्यस्मत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śataṃ te rājanbhiṣajaḥ sahasramurvī gabhīrā sumatiṣṭe astu | bādhasva dūre niṝtiṃ parācaiḥ kṛtaṃ cidenaḥ pra mumugdhyasmat ||

translations.english: Yours, O king, are a hundred and a thousand medicaments; may your favour, comprehensive and profound, be (with us); keep afar from us Nirṛti, with unfriendly looks, and liberate us from whatever sin we may have committed.

mantras.sanskrit: अमी य ऋक्षा निहितास उच्चा नक्तं ददृश्रे कुह चिद्दिवेयुः । अदब्धानि वरुणस्य व्रतानि विचाकशच्चन्द्रमा नक्तमेति ॥
mantras.transliteration: amī ya ṛkṣā nihitāsa uccā naktaṃ dadṛśre kuha ciddiveyuḥ | adabdhāni varuṇasya vratāni vicākaśaccandramā naktameti ||

translations.english: These constellations plural ced on high, which are visible by night, and go elsewhere by day, are the undisturbed holy acts of Varuṇa (and by his command) the moon moves resplendent by night.

mantras.sanskrit: तत्त्वा यामि ब्रह्मणा वन्दमानस्तदा शास्ते यजमानो हविर्भिः । अहेळमानो वरुणेह बोध्युरुशंस मा न आयुः प्र मोषीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tattvā yāmi brahmaṇā vandamānastadā śāste yajamāno havirbhiḥ | aheḷamāno varuṇeha bodhyuruśaṃsa mā na āyuḥ pra moṣīḥ ||

translations.english: Praising you with (devout) prayer, I implore you for that (life) which the instrumental tutor of the sacrifice solicits with oblations; Varuṇa, undisdainful, bestow a thought upon us; much-lauded, take not away our existence.

mantras.sanskrit: तदिन्नक्तं तद्दिवा मह्यमाहुस्तदयं केतो हृद आ वि चष्टे । शुनःशेपो यमह्वद्गृभीतः सो अस्मान्राजा वरुणो मुमोक्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadinnaktaṃ taddivā mahyamāhustadayaṃ keto hṛda ā vi caṣṭe | śunaḥśepo yamahvadgṛbhītaḥ so asmānrājā varuṇo mumoktu ||

translations.english: This (your praise) they repeat to me by night and by day; this knowledge speaks to my heart; may he whom the fettered Śunahśepas has invoked, may the regal Varuṇa set us free.

mantras.sanskrit: शुनःशेपो ह्यह्वद्गृभीतस्त्रिष्वादित्यं द्रुपदेषु बद्धः । अवैनं राजा वरुणः ससृज्याद्विद्वाँ अदब्धो वि मुमोक्तु पाशान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śunaḥśepo hyahvadgṛbhītastriṣvādityaṃ drupadeṣu baddhaḥ | avainaṃ rājā varuṇaḥ sasṛjyādvidvā~ adabdho vi mumoktu pāśān ||

translations.english: Śunahśepas, seized and bound to the three-footed tree, has invoked the son of Aditi; may the regal Varuṇa, wise and irresistible, liberate him; may he let loose his bonds.

mantras.sanskrit: अव ते हेळो वरुण नमोभिरव यज्ञेभिरीमहे हविर्भिः । क्षयन्नस्मभ्यमसुर प्रचेता राजन्नेनांसि शिश्रथः कृतानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ava te heḷo varuṇa namobhirava yajñebhirīmahe havirbhiḥ | kṣayannasmabhyamasura pracetā rājannenāṃsi śiśrathaḥ kṛtāni ||

translations.english: Varuṇa, we deprecate your wrath with prostrations, with sacrifices, with oblations; averter of misfortune, wise and illustrious, be present amongst us, and mitigate the evils we have committed.

mantras.sanskrit: उदुत्तमं वरुण पाशमस्मदवाधमं वि मध्यमं श्रथाय । अथा वयमादित्य व्रते तवानागसो अदितये स्याम ॥
mantras.transliteration: uduttamaṃ varuṇa pāśamasmadavādhamaṃ vi madhyamaṃ śrathāya | athā vayamāditya vrate tavānāgaso aditaye syāma ||

translations.english: Varuṇa, loosen for me the upper, the middle, the lower band; so, son of Aditi, shall we, through faultlessness in the worship, become freed from siṇ

mantras.sanskrit: यच्चिद्धि ते विशो यथा प्र देव वरुण व्रतम् । मिनीमसि द्यविद्यवि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yacciddhi te viśo yathā pra deva varuṇa vratam | minīmasi dyavidyavi ||

translations.english: Inasmuch as all people commit errors, so do we, divine Varuṇa, daily disfigure your worship by imperfections.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नो वधाय हत्नवे जिहीळानस्य रीरधः । मा हृणानस्य मन्यवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā no vadhāya hatnave jihīḷānasya rīradhaḥ | mā hṛṇānasya manyave ||

translations.english: Make us not the objects of death, through your fatal indignation, through the wrath of you so displeasured.

mantras.sanskrit: वि मृळीकाय ते मनो रथीरश्वं न संदितम् । गीर्भिर्वरुण सीमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi mṛḷīkāya te mano rathīraśvaṃ na saṃditam | gīrbhirvaruṇa sīmahi ||

translations.english: We soothe your mind, Varuṇa, by our praises, for our good, as a charioteer his weary steed.

mantras.sanskrit: परा हि मे विमन्यवः पतन्ति वस्यैष्टये । वयो न वसतीरुप ॥
mantras.transliteration: parā hi me vimanyavaḥ patanti vasyaiṣṭaye | vayo na vasatīrupa ||

translations.english: My tranquil (meditations) revert to the desire of life, as birds hover around their nests. = vasya iṣṭaye = vasumataḥ, precious (i.e. jīvasya, life's).

mantras.sanskrit: कदा क्षत्रश्रियं नरमा वरुणं करामहे । मृळीकायोरुचक्षसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kadā kṣatraśriyaṃ naramā varuṇaṃ karāmahe | mṛḷīkāyorucakṣasam ||

translations.english: When for our happiness, shall we bring hither Varuṇa, eminent in strength, the guide (of men), the regarder of many?

mantras.sanskrit: तदित्समानमाशाते वेनन्ता न प्र युच्छतः । धृतव्रताय दाशुषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: taditsamānamāśāte venantā na pra yucchataḥ | dhṛtavratāya dāśuṣe ||

translations.english: Partake, (Mitra and Varuṇa), of the common (oblation), being propitious to the giver and celebrator of this pious rite.

mantras.sanskrit: वेदा यो वीनां पदमन्तरिक्षेण पतताम् । वेद नावः समुद्रियः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vedā yo vīnāṃ padamantarikṣeṇa patatām | veda nāvaḥ samudriyaḥ ||

translations.english: He, who knows the path of the birds flying through the air; he, abiding in the ocean, knows (also) the course of ships.

mantras.sanskrit: वेद मासो धृतव्रतो द्वादश प्रजावतः । वेदा य उपजायते ॥
mantras.transliteration: veda māso dhṛtavrato dvādaśa prajāvataḥ | vedā ya upajāyate ||

translations.english: He, who accepting the rites (dedicated to him) knows the twelve months and their productions and that which is supplementarily engendered.

mantras.sanskrit: वेद वातस्य वर्तनिमुरोॠष्वस्य बृहतः । वेदा ये अध्यासते ॥
mantras.transliteration: veda vātasya vartanimuroṝṣvasya bṛhataḥ | vedā ye adhyāsate ||

translations.english: He, who knows the path of the vast, the graceful, and the excellent wind, and who knows those who reside above.

mantras.sanskrit: नि षसाद धृतव्रतो वरुणः पस्त्यास्वा । साम्राज्याय सुक्रतुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni ṣasāda dhṛtavrato varuṇaḥ pastyāsvā | sāmrājyāya sukratuḥ ||

translations.english: He, Varuṇa, the acceptor of holy rites, the doer of good deeds, has sat down amongs the (divine) progeny, to exercise supreme dominion (over them).

mantras.sanskrit: अतो विश्वान्यद्भुता चिकित्वाँ अभि पश्यति । कृतानि या च कर्त्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ato viśvānyadbhutā cikitvā~ abhi paśyati | kṛtāni yā ca kartvā ||

translations.english: Through him, the sage beholds all the marvels that hav ebeen or will be wrought.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो विश्वाहा सुक्रतुरादित्यः सुपथा करत् । प्र ण आयूंषि तारिषत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no viśvāhā sukraturādityaḥ supathā karat | pra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣat ||

translations.english: May that very wise son of Aditi, keep us all our days in the right path, and prolong our lives.

mantras.sanskrit: बिभ्रद्द्रापिं हिरण्ययं वरुणो वस्त निर्णिजम् । परि स्पशो नि षेदिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: bibhraddrāpiṃ hiraṇyayaṃ varuṇo vasta nirṇijam | pari spaśo ni ṣedire ||

translations.english: Varuṇa clothes his well-nourished (person n), wearing golden armour, whence the (reflected)  rays are spread around.

mantras.sanskrit: न यं दिप्सन्ति दिप्सवो न द्रुह्वाणो जनानाम् । न देवमभिमातयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: na yaṃ dipsanti dipsavo na druhvāṇo janānām | na devamabhimātayaḥ ||

translations.english: A divine (being), whom enemies dare not to offend; nor the oppressors of mankind, nor the iniquitous, (venture to displease).

mantras.sanskrit: उत यो मानुषेष्वा यशश्चक्रे असाम्या । अस्माकमुदरेष्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta yo mānuṣeṣvā yaśaścakre asāmyā | asmākamudareṣvā ||

translations.english: Who has distributed unlimited food to mankind, and especially to us.

mantras.sanskrit: परा मे यन्ति धीतयो गावो न गव्यूतीरनु । इच्छन्तीरुरुचक्षसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: parā me yanti dhītayo gāvo na gavyūtīranu | icchantīrurucakṣasam ||

translations.english: My thoughts ever turn back to him who is beheld of many, as the kine return to the pastures.

mantras.sanskrit: सं नु वोचावहै पुनर्यतो मे मध्वाभृतम् । होतेव क्षदसे प्रियम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ nu vocāvahai punaryato me madhvābhṛtam | hoteva kṣadase priyam ||

translations.english: Let us together proclaim that my offering has been prepared, and that you, as if the offerer, accept the valued (oblation).

mantras.sanskrit: दर्शं नु विश्वदर्शतं दर्शं रथमधि क्षमि । एता जुषत मे गिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: darśaṃ nu viśvadarśataṃ darśaṃ rathamadhi kṣami | etā juṣata me giraḥ ||

translations.english: I have seen him whose appearance is grateful to all; I have beheld his chariot upon earth; he has accepted these my praiseṣ

mantras.sanskrit: इमं मे वरुण श्रुधी हवमद्या च मृळय । त्वामवस्युरा चके ॥
mantras.transliteration: imaṃ me varuṇa śrudhī havamadyā ca mṛḷaya | tvāmavasyurā cake ||

translations.english: Hear, Varuṇa, this my invocation; make us this day happy; I have appealed to you, hoping for protection.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं विश्वस्य मेधिर दिवश्च ग्मश्च राजसि । स यामनि प्रति श्रुधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ viśvasya medhira divaśca gmaśca rājasi | sa yāmani prati śrudhi ||

translations.english: You, who are possessed of wisdom, shine over heaven and earth, and all the world; do you hear and reply (to my prayers), with (promise of) prosperity.

mantras.sanskrit: उदुत्तमं मुमुग्धि नो वि पाशं मध्यमं चृत । अवाधमानि जीवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: uduttamaṃ mumugdhi no vi pāśaṃ madhyamaṃ cṛta | avādhamāni jīvase ||

translations.english: Loose us from the upper bonds, untie the centre and the lower, that we may live.

mantras.sanskrit: वसिष्वा हि मियेध्य वस्त्राण्यूर्जां पते । सेमं नो अध्वरं यज ॥
mantras.transliteration: vasiṣvā hi miyedhya vastrāṇyūrjāṃ pate | semaṃ no adhvaraṃ yaja ||

translations.english: Lord of sustenance, assume your vestments (of light) and offer this our sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: नि नो होता वरेण्यः सदा यविष्ठ मन्मभिः । अग्ने दिवित्मता वचः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni no hotā vareṇyaḥ sadā yaviṣṭha manmabhiḥ | agne divitmatā vacaḥ ||

translations.english: (Propitiated) by brilliant strains, do your, ever-youthful Agni, selected by us, become our ministrant priest, (invested) with radiance.

mantras.sanskrit: आ हि ष्मा सूनवे पितापिर्यजत्यापये । सखा सख्ये वरेण्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā hi ṣmā sūnave pitāpiryajatyāpaye | sakhā sakhye vareṇyaḥ ||

translations.english: You, Agni, are verily as a loving father to a son, as a kinsman to a kinsman, as a friend to a friend.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो बर्ही रिशादसो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । सीदन्तु मनुषो यथा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no barhī riśādaso varuṇo mitro aryamā | sīdantu manuṣo yathā ||

translations.english: Let Varuṇa, Mitra and Āryaman, sit down upon our sacred grass, as they did at the sacrifice of Manu.

mantras.sanskrit: पूर्व्य होतरस्य नो मन्दस्व सख्यस्य च । इमा उ षु श्रुधी गिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pūrvya hotarasya no mandasva sakhyasya ca | imā u ṣu śrudhī giraḥ ||

translations.english: Preceding sacrificer, be plural ased with this our sacrifice and with our friendship, and listen to these your praises.

mantras.sanskrit: यच्चिद्धि शश्वता तना देवंदेवं यजामहे । त्वे इद्धूयते हविः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yacciddhi śaśvatā tanā devaṃdevaṃ yajāmahe | tve iddhūyate haviḥ ||

translations.english: Whatever we offer in repeated and plural ntiful oblation to any other deity, is assuredly offered to you.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रियो नो अस्तु विश्पतिर्होता मन्द्रो वरेण्यः । प्रियाः स्वग्नयो वयम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: priyo no astu viśpatirhotā mandro vareṇyaḥ | priyāḥ svagnayo vayam ||

translations.english: May the lord of men, the sacrificing priest, the gracious, the chosen, be kind to us; may we, possessed of holy fires, be   loved of you.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वग्नयो हि वार्यं देवासो दधिरे च नः । स्वग्नयो मनामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: svagnayo hi vāryaṃ devāso dadhire ca naḥ | svagnayo manāmahe ||

translations.english: As the brilliant (priests), possessed of holy fires, have taken charge of our oblations, so we, with holy fires, pray to you.

mantras.sanskrit: अथा न उभयेषाममृत मर्त्यानाम् । मिथः सन्तु प्रशस्तयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: athā na ubhayeṣāmamṛta martyānām | mithaḥ santu praśastayaḥ ||

translations.english: Immortal Agni, may the praises of mankind be henceforth mutually (the sources of happiness) to both, (to ourselves and to you).

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वेभिरग्ने अग्निभिरिमं यज्ञमिदं वचः । चनो धाः सहसो यहो ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvebhiragne agnibhirimaṃ yajñamidaṃ vacaḥ | cano dhāḥ sahaso yaho ||

translations.english: Agni, son of strength, (accept) this sacrifice, and this our praise, with all your fires, and grant us (abundant) food.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्वं न त्वा वारवन्तं वन्दध्या अग्निं नमोभिः । सम्राजन्तमध्वराणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvaṃ na tvā vāravantaṃ vandadhyā agniṃ namobhiḥ | samrājantamadhvarāṇām ||

translations.english: (I proceed) to address you, the soverign lord of sacrifice, with praises, (for you scatter our fores) like a horse (who brushes off flies with) his tail.

mantras.sanskrit: स घा नः सूनुः शवसा पृथुप्रगामा सुशेवः । मीढ्वाँ अस्माकं बभूयात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa ghā naḥ sūnuḥ śavasā pṛthupragāmā suśevaḥ | mīḍhvā~ asmākaṃ babhūyāt ||

translations.english: May he, the son of strength, who moves everywhere fleetly, be propitious to us, and shower down (blessings).

mantras.sanskrit: स नो दूराच्चासाच्च नि मर्त्यादघायोः । पाहि सदमिद्विश्वायुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no dūrāccāsācca ni martyādaghāyoḥ | pāhi sadamidviśvāyuḥ ||

translations.english: Do you, Agni, who go everywhere, ever protect us, whether near or afar, from men seeking to do us injury.

mantras.sanskrit: इममू षु त्वमस्माकं सनिं गायत्रं नव्यांसम् । अग्ने देवेषु प्र वोचः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imamū ṣu tvamasmākaṃ saniṃ gāyatraṃ navyāṃsam | agne deveṣu pra vocaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, announce to the gods this our offering, and these our newest hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो भज परमेष्वा वाजेषु मध्यमेषु । शिक्षा वस्वो अन्तमस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no bhaja parameṣvā vājeṣu madhyameṣu | śikṣā vasvo antamasya ||

translations.english: Procure for us the food that is in heaven and mid-air, and grant us the wealth that is on earth.

mantras.sanskrit: विभक्तासि चित्रभानो सिन्धोरूर्मा उपाक आ । सद्यो दाशुषे क्षरसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: vibhaktāsi citrabhāno sindhorūrmā upāka ā | sadyo dāśuṣe kṣarasi ||

translations.english: You, Citrabhānu, are the   distributor of riches, as the waves of a river are parted by interjacent (islets); you ever pour (rewards) upon the giver (of oblations).

mantras.sanskrit: यमग्ने पृत्सु मर्त्यमवा वाजेषु यं जुनाः । स यन्ता शश्वतीरिषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yamagne pṛtsu martyamavā vājeṣu yaṃ junāḥ | sa yantā śaśvatīriṣaḥ ||

translations.english: The mortal whom you, Agni, protect in battle, whom you incite to combat, will always command (food).

mantras.sanskrit: नकिरस्य सहन्त्य पर्येता कयस्य चित् । वाजो अस्ति श्रवाय्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nakirasya sahantya paryetā kayasya cit | vājo asti śravāyyaḥ ||

translations.english: No one will ever be the vanquisher of this your worshipper, subduer of enemies, for notorious in his prowess.

mantras.sanskrit: स वाजं विश्वचर्षणिरर्वद्भिरस्तु तरुता । विप्रेभिरस्तु सनिता ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa vājaṃ viśvacarṣaṇirarvadbhirastu tarutā | viprebhirastu sanitā ||

translations.english: May he who is worshipped by all men, convey us with horses through the battle; may he, (propitiated) by the priests, be the bestower (of bounties).

mantras.sanskrit: जराबोध तद्विविड्ढि विशेविशे यज्ञियाय । स्तोमं रुद्राय दृशीकम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: jarābodha tadviviḍḍhi viśeviśe yajñiyāya | stomaṃ rudrāya dṛśīkam ||

translations.english: Jarābodha, enter into the oblation for the completion of the sacrifice that benefits all mankind; the worshipper offers agreeable laudation to the terrible (Agni).

mantras.sanskrit: स नो महाँ अनिमानो धूमकेतुः पुरुश्चन्द्रः । धिये वाजाय हिन्वतु ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no mahā~ animāno dhūmaketuḥ puruścandraḥ | dhiye vājāya hinvatu ||

translations.english: May the vast, illimitable, smoke- bannered, resplendent Agni be plural ased with our rite, and grant us food.

mantras.sanskrit: स रेवाँ इव विश्पतिर्दैव्यः केतुः शृणोतु नः । उक्थैरग्निर्बृहद्भानुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa revā~ iva viśpatirdaivyaḥ ketuḥ śṛṇotu naḥ | ukthairagnirbṛhadbhānuḥ ||

translations.english: May Agni, the lord of men, the invoker and messenger of the gods, the brilliant-rayed, hear us with our hymns, as a prince (listens to the bards).

mantras.sanskrit: नमो महद्भ्यो नमो अर्भकेभ्यो नमो युवभ्यो नम आशिनेभ्यः । यजाम देवान्यदि शक्नवाम मा ज्यायसः शंसमा वृक्षि देवाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: namo mahadbhyo namo arbhakebhyo namo yuvabhyo nama āśinebhyaḥ | yajāma devānyadi śaknavāma mā jyāyasaḥ śaṃsamā vṛkṣi devāḥ ||

translations.english: Veneration to the great gods, veneration to the lesser, veneration to the young, veneration to the old we worship (all) the gods as well as we are able; may I not omit the praise of the elder divinities.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्र ग्रावा पृथुबुध्न ऊर्ध्वो भवति सोतवे । उलूखलसुतानामवेद्विन्द्र जल्गुलः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatra grāvā pṛthubudhna ūrdhvo bhavati sotave | ulūkhalasutānāmavedvindra jalgulaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, as the broad-based stone is raised to express the Soma juice, recognize and partake of the effusion of the mortar.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्र द्वाविव जघनाधिषवण्या कृता । उलूखलसुतानामवेद्विन्द्र जल्गुलः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatra dvāviva jaghanādhiṣavaṇyā kṛtā | ulūkhalasutānāmavedvindra jalgulaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, (in the rite) in which the two patters for containing the juice, as (broad as a woman's) hips, are employed, recognize and partake of the effusion of the mortar.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्र नार्यपच्यवमुपच्यवं च शिक्षते । उलूखलसुतानामवेद्विन्द्र जल्गुलः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatra nāryapacyavamupacyavaṃ ca śikṣate | ulūkhalasutānāmavedvindra jalgulaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, (in the rite) in which the housewife repeats egress from and ingress into (the sacrificial chamber), recognize and partake of the effusion of the mortar.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्र मन्थां विबध्नते रश्मीन्यमितवा इव । उलूखलसुतानामवेद्विन्द्र जल्गुलः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatra manthāṃ vibadhnate raśmīnyamitavā iva | ulūkhalasutānāmavedvindra jalgulaḥ ||

translations.english: When they bind the churning-staff (with a cord), like reins to restrain (a horse), Indra, recognize and partake of the effusion of the mortar.

mantras.sanskrit: यच्चिद्धि त्वं गृहेगृह उलूखलक युज्यसे । इह द्युमत्तमं वद जयतामिव दुन्दुभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yacciddhi tvaṃ gṛhegṛha ulūkhalaka yujyase | iha dyumattamaṃ vada jayatāmiva dundubhiḥ ||

translations.english: If indeed, O Mortar, you are present in every house, give forth (in this rite) a lusty sound, like the drum of a victorious host.

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्म ते वनस्पते वातो वि वात्यग्रमित् । अथो इन्द्राय पातवे सुनु सोममुलूखल ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta sma te vanaspate vāto vi vātyagramit | atho indrāya pātave sunu somamulūkhala ||

translations.english: Lorf of the forest, as the wind genitive ly blows before you, so do thou, O Mortar, prepare the Soma juice for the beverage of Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: आयजी वाजसातमा ता ह्युच्चा विजर्भृतः । हरी इवान्धांसि बप्सता ॥
mantras.transliteration: āyajī vājasātamā tā hyuccā vijarbhṛtaḥ | harī ivāndhāṃsi bapsatā ||

translations.english: Implements of sacrifice, bestowers of food, loud-sounding, sport like the horses of Indra champing the grain.

mantras.sanskrit: ता नो अद्य वनस्पती ऋष्वावृष्वेभिः सोतृभिः । इन्द्राय मधुमत्सुतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā no adya vanaspatī ṛṣvāvṛṣvebhiḥ sotṛbhiḥ | indrāya madhumatsutam ||

translations.english: Do you two forest lords, of plural asing form, prepare with agreeable libations our sweet (Soma) juices for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: उच्छिष्टं चम्वोर्भर सोमं पवित्र आ सृज । नि धेहि गोरधि त्वचि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ucchiṣṭaṃ camvorbhara somaṃ pavitra ā sṛja | ni dhehi goradhi tvaci ||

translations.english: Bring the remains of the Soma juice upon the plural tters, sprinkle it upon the blades of kuśa grass and plural ce the reminder upon the cow-hide.

mantras.sanskrit: यच्चिद्धि सत्य सोमपा अनाशस्ता इव स्मसि । आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ ॥
mantras.transliteration: yacciddhi satya somapā anāśastā iva smasi | ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣvaśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha ||

translations.english: Veracious drinker of the Soma juice, although we be unworthy, do your, Indra, of boundless wealth enrich us with thousands of excellent cows and horses.

mantras.sanskrit: शिप्रिन्वाजानां पते शचीवस्तव दंसना । आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ ॥
mantras.transliteration: śiprinvājānāṃ pate śacīvastava daṃsanā | ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣvaśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha ||

translations.english: Your benevolence, handsome and mighty lord of food, endures for ever; therefore, Indra, of boundless wealth, enrich us with thousands of excellent cows and horses.

mantras.sanskrit: नि ष्वापया मिथूदृशा सस्तामबुध्यमाने । आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni ṣvāpayā mithūdṛśā sastāmabudhyamāne | ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣvaśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha ||

translations.english: Cast asleep (the two feminine le messengers of Yama); looking at each other, let them sleep, never waking; Indra, of boundless wealth, enrich us with thousands of excellent cows and horses.

mantras.sanskrit: ससन्तु त्या अरातयो बोधन्तु शूर रातयः । आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ ॥
mantras.transliteration: sasantu tyā arātayo bodhantu śūra rātayaḥ | ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣvaśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha ||

translations.english: May those who are our enemies, slumber, and those, O hero, who are our friends, be awake; Indra, of boundless wealth, enrich us with thousands of excellent cows and horses.

mantras.sanskrit: समिन्द्र गर्दभं मृण नुवन्तं पापयामुया । आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ ॥
mantras.transliteration: samindra gardabhaṃ mṛṇa nuvantaṃ pāpayāmuyā | ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣvaśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha ||

translations.english: Indra, destroy this ass, (our adversary), praising you with such discordant speech; and do your, Indra, of boundless wealth, enrich us with thousands of excellent cows and horses.

mantras.sanskrit: पताति कुण्डृणाच्या दूरं वातो वनादधि । आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ ॥
mantras.transliteration: patāti kuṇḍṛṇācyā dūraṃ vāto vanādadhi | ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣvaśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha ||

translations.english: Let us (adverse) breeze, with crooked course, alight afar off on the forest; Indra, of boundless wealth, enrich us with thousands of excellent cows and horses.

mantras.sanskrit: सर्वं परिक्रोशं जहि जम्भया कृकदाश्वम् । आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ ॥
mantras.transliteration: sarvaṃ parikrośaṃ jahi jambhayā kṛkadāśvam | ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣvaśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha ||

translations.english: Destroy every one that reviles us; slay every one that does us injury; Indra, of boundless wealth, enrich us with thousands of excellent cows and horses.

mantras.sanskrit: आ व इन्द्रं क्रिविं यथा वाजयन्तः शतक्रतुम् । मंहिष्ठं सिञ्च इन्दुभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā va indraṃ kriviṃ yathā vājayantaḥ śatakratum | maṃhiṣṭhaṃ siñca indubhiḥ ||

translations.english: Let us, who are desirous of food, satisfy this your Indra, who is mighty, and of a hundred sacrifices, with drops (of Soma juice), as a well (is filled)(with water).

mantras.sanskrit: शतं वा यः शुचीनां सहस्रं वा समाशिराम् । एदु निम्नं न रीयते ॥
mantras.transliteration: śataṃ vā yaḥ śucīnāṃ sahasraṃ vā samāśirām | edu nimnaṃ na rīyate ||

translations.english: May he who is (the recipient) of a hundred pure, and of a thousand distilled, (libations), come (to the rite), as water to low (plural ces).

mantras.sanskrit: सं यन्मदाय शुष्मिण एना ह्यस्योदरे । समुद्रो न व्यचो दधे ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ yanmadāya śuṣmiṇa enā hyasyodare | samudro na vyaco dadhe ||

translations.english: All which (libations), being accusative ulated for the gratification of the powerful Indra, is contained in his belly, as water in the ocean.

mantras.sanskrit: अयमु ते समतसि कपोत इव गर्भधिम् । वचस्तच्चिन्न ओहसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayamu te samatasi kapota iva garbhadhim | vacastaccinna ohase ||

translations.english: This libation is (prepared) for you; you approach it as a pigeon his pregnant (mate), for on that account do you accept our prayer.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तोत्रं राधानां पते गिर्वाहो वीर यस्य ते । विभूतिरस्तु सूनृता ॥
mantras.transliteration: stotraṃ rādhānāṃ pate girvāho vīra yasya te | vibhūtirastu sūnṛtā ||

translations.english: Hero, Indra, lord of affluence, accepter of praise, may genitive ine prosperity be (the reward of him) who offers you laudation.

mantras.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वस्तिष्ठा न ऊतयेऽस्मिन्वाजे शतक्रतो । समन्येषु ब्रवावहै ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūrdhvastiṣṭhā na ūtaye'sminvāje śatakrato | samanyeṣu bravāvahai ||

translations.english: Rise up, Śatakratu, for our defence in this conflict; we will talk together in other matters.

mantras.sanskrit: योगेयोगे तवस्तरं वाजेवाजे हवामहे । सखाय इन्द्रमूतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: yogeyoge tavastaraṃ vājevāje havāmahe | sakhāya indramūtaye ||

translations.english: On every occasion, in every engagement, we invoke as friends the most powerful Indra for our defence.

mantras.sanskrit: आ घा गमद्यदि श्रवत्सहस्रिणीभिरूतिभिः । वाजेभिरुप नो हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā ghā gamadyadi śravatsahasriṇībhirūtibhiḥ | vājebhirupa no havam ||

translations.english: If he hear our invocation, let him indeed come to us with numerous bounties, and with (abundant) food.

mantras.sanskrit: अनु प्रत्नस्यौकसो हुवे तुविप्रतिं नरम् । यं ते पूर्वं पिता हुवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: anu pratnasyaukaso huve tuvipratiṃ naram | yaṃ te pūrvaṃ pitā huve ||

translations.english: I invoke the man (Indra), who visits many worshippers from his ancient dwelling-plural ce--you, Indra, whom my father formerly invoked.

mantras.sanskrit: तं त्वा वयं विश्ववारा शास्महे पुरुहूत । सखे वसो जरितृभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ tvā vayaṃ viśvavārā śāsmahe puruhūta | sakhe vaso jaritṛbhyaḥ ||

translations.english: We implore you as our friend, who are preferred and invoked by all, (to be favourable) to your worshippers, protector of dwellings.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्माकं शिप्रिणीनां सोमपाः सोमपाव्नाम् । सखे वज्रिन्त्सखीनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmākaṃ śipriṇīnāṃ somapāḥ somapāvnām | sakhe vajrintsakhīnām ||

translations.english: Drinker of Soma juice, wielder of the thunderbolt, O friend, (bestow upon) us, your friends, and drinkers of the Soma juice, (abundance of cows) with projecting jaws. (śipirṇīnām, genitive plural of the feminine nine śipriṇī, having a nose of a jaw; hence gavām and samūha (of cows and a herd) are added].

mantras.sanskrit: तथा तदस्तु सोमपाः सखे वज्रिन्तथा कृणु । यथा त उश्मसीष्टये ॥
mantras.transliteration: tathā tadastu somapāḥ sakhe vajrintathā kṛṇu | yathā ta uśmasīṣṭaye ||

translations.english: So be it, drinker of the Soma juice, wielder of the thunderbolt, our friend, that you will do, through your favour, whatever we desire.

mantras.sanskrit: रेवतीर्नः सधमाद इन्द्रे सन्तु तुविवाजाः । क्षुमन्तो याभिर्मदेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: revatīrnaḥ sadhamāda indre santu tuvivājāḥ | kṣumanto yābhirmadema ||

translations.english: So, Indra, rejoicing along with us, we may have (abundant food) and cows may be ours, robust and rich in milk, with which we may be happy.

mantras.sanskrit: आ घ त्वावान्त्मनाप्तः स्तोतृभ्यो धृष्णवियानः । ऋणोरक्षं न चक्र्योः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā gha tvāvāntmanāptaḥ stotṛbhyo dhṛṣṇaviyānaḥ | ṛṇorakṣaṃ na cakryoḥ ||

translations.english: O Dhṛṣnu, let some such divinity as you are, self-presented, promptly bestow, when solicited, (bounties) upon your praisers, as (they whirl) the axle of the wheels (of a car).

mantras.sanskrit: आ यद्दुवः शतक्रतवा कामं जरितॄणाम् । ऋणोरक्षं न शचीभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yadduvaḥ śatakratavā kāmaṃ jaritṝṇām | ṛṇorakṣaṃ na śacībhiḥ ||

translations.english: Such wealth, Śatakratu, as your praisers desire, you bestow upon them, as the axle (revolves) with the movements (of the wagon).

mantras.sanskrit: शश्वदिन्द्रः पोप्रुथद्भिर्जिगाय नानदद्भिः शाश्वसद्भिर्धनानि । स नो हिरण्यरथं दंसनावान्त्स नः सनिता सनये स नोऽदात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaśvadindraḥ popruthadbhirjigāya nānadadbhiḥ śāśvasadbhirdhanāni | sa no hiraṇyarathaṃ daṃsanāvāntsa naḥ sanitā sanaye sa no'dāt ||

translations.english: Indra has ever won riches (from his foes), with his champing, neighing, and snorting (steeds); he, the abounding in acts, the bountiful, has given us as a gift a golden chariot.

mantras.sanskrit: आश्विनावश्वावत्येषा यातं शवीरया । गोमद्दस्रा हिरण्यवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: āśvināvaśvāvatyeṣā yātaṃ śavīrayā | gomaddasrā hiraṇyavat ||

translations.english: Aśvins, come hither, with viands borne or many steeds. Dasrās, (let our dwelling) be filled with cattle and with gold.

mantras.sanskrit: समानयोजनो हि वां रथो दस्रावमर्त्यः । समुद्रे अश्विनेयते ॥
mantras.transliteration: samānayojano hi vāṃ ratho dasrāvamartyaḥ | samudre aśvineyate ||

translations.english: Dasrās, your chariot, harnessed for both alike, is imperishable; it travels, Aśvins, through the air.

mantras.sanskrit: न्यघ्न्यस्य मूर्धनि चक्रं रथस्य येमथुः । परि द्यामन्यदीयते ॥
mantras.transliteration: nyaghnyasya mūrdhani cakraṃ rathasya yemathuḥ | pari dyāmanyadīyate ||

translations.english: You have one wheel on the top of the solid (mountain), while the other revolves in the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: कस्त उषः कधप्रिये भुजे मर्तो अमर्त्ये । कं नक्षसे विभावरि ॥
mantras.transliteration: kasta uṣaḥ kadhapriye bhuje marto amartye | kaṃ nakṣase vibhāvari ||

translations.english: Uṣas, who are plural ased by praise, what mortal enjoy you, immortal? Whom, mighty one, do your affect?

mantras.sanskrit: वयं हि ते अमन्मह्यान्तादा पराकात् । अश्वे न चित्रे अरुषि ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayaṃ hi te amanmahyāntādā parākāt | aśve na citre aruṣi ||

translations.english: Diffusive, many-tinted, brilliant (Uṣas), we know not (your limits), whether they be nigh or remote.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं त्येभिरा गहि वाजेभिर्दुहितर्दिवः । अस्मे रयिं नि धारय ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ tyebhirā gahi vājebhirduhitardivaḥ | asme rayiṃ ni dhāraya ||

translations.english: Daughter of heaven, approach with these viands, and perpetuate our wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने प्रथमो अङ्गिरा ऋषिर्देवो देवानामभवः शिवः सखा । तव व्रते कवयो विद्मनापसोऽजायन्त मरुतो भ्राजदृष्टयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne prathamo aṅgirā ṛṣirdevo devānāmabhavaḥ śivaḥ sakhā | tava vrate kavayo vidmanāpaso'jāyanta maruto bhrājadṛṣṭayaḥ ||

translations.english: You, Agni, was th first Aṅgiras Ṛṣi, a divinity, you were the auspicious friend of the deities. In your rite the wise, the all-discerning, the bright-weaponed Maruts were engendered.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने प्रथमो अङ्गिरस्तमः कविर्देवानां परि भूषसि व्रतम् । विभुर्विश्वस्मै भुवनाय मेधिरो द्विमाता शयुः कतिधा चिदायवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne prathamo aṅgirastamaḥ kavirdevānāṃ pari bhūṣasi vratam | vibhurviśvasmai bhuvanāya medhiro dvimātā śayuḥ katidhā cidāyave ||

translations.english: You, Agni, the first and chief Aṅgiras, grace the worship of the gods; sapient, maniforld, for the benefit of all the world, intelligent, the off-spring of two mothers, and reposing in various ways for the use of man.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने प्रथमो मातरिश्वन आविर्भव सुक्रतूया विवस्वते । अरेजेतां रोदसी होतृवूर्येऽसघ्नोर्भारमयजो महो वसो ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne prathamo mātariśvana āvirbhava sukratūyā vivasvate | arejetāṃ rodasī hotṛvūrye'saghnorbhāramayajo maho vaso ||

translations.english: Agni, pre-eminent over the wind, become manifest to the worshipper, in approbation of his worship. Heaven and earth tremble (at your power); you have sustained the burden in the rite for which the priest was appointed; your, Vasu, has worshipped the venerable (gods).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने मनवे द्यामवाशयः पुरूरवसे सुकृते सुकृत्तरः । श्वात्रेण यत्पित्रोर्मुच्यसे पर्या त्वा पूर्वमनयन्नापरं पुनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne manave dyāmavāśayaḥ purūravase sukṛte sukṛttaraḥ | śvātreṇa yatpitrormucyase paryā tvā pūrvamanayannāparaṃ punaḥ ||

translations.english: Your, Agni, has announced heaven to Manu; you have more than requited Purūravas doing homage to you. When you are set free by the attrition of your parents, they bear you first to the east, then to the west (of the altar).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने वृषभः पुष्टिवर्धन उद्यतस्रुचे भवसि श्रवाय्यः । य आहुतिं परि वेदा वषट्कृतिमेकायुरग्रे विश आविवाससि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne vṛṣabhaḥ puṣṭivardhana udyatasruce bhavasi śravāyyaḥ | ya āhutiṃ pari vedā vaṣaṭkṛtimekāyuragre viśa āvivāsasi ||

translations.english: Your, Agni, are the showerer (of desires), the augmenter of the prosperity (of your worshipper); you are to be called upon as the ladle is lifted up; upon him who fully understands the invocation and makes the oblation, you, the provider of sustenance, first bestow light, and then upon all men.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने वृजिनवर्तनिं नरं सक्मन्पिपर्षि विदथे विचर्षणे । यः शूरसाता परितक्म्ये धने दभ्रेभिश्चित्समृता हंसि भूयसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne vṛjinavartaniṃ naraṃ sakmanpiparṣi vidathe vicarṣaṇe | yaḥ śūrasātā paritakmye dhane dabhrebhiścitsamṛtā haṃsi bhūyasaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, excellently wise, you direct the man who follows improper paths, to acts that are fitted to reclaim him; you who, in the strife of heroes, (grateful to them) as widely- scattered wealth, destryed in the combat the mighty by the feeble.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं तमग्ने अमृतत्व उत्तमे मर्तं दधासि श्रवसे दिवेदिवे । यस्तातृषाण उभयाय जन्मने मयः कृणोषि प्रय आ च सूरये ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ tamagne amṛtatva uttame martaṃ dadhāsi śravase divedive | yastātṛṣāṇa ubhayāya janmane mayaḥ kṛṇoṣi praya ā ca sūraye ||

translations.english: You sustain, Agni, that mortal (who worships you), in the best immortality by daily food; you bestow on the sage, who is desirous (of creatures) of both kinds of birth, happiness and sustenance.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं नो अग्ने सनये धनानां यशसं कारुं कृणुहि स्तवानः । ऋध्याम कर्मापसा नवेन देवैर्द्यावापृथिवी प्रावतं नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ no agne sanaye dhanānāṃ yaśasaṃ kāruṃ kṛṇuhi stavānaḥ | ṛdhyāma karmāpasā navena devairdyāvāpṛthivī prāvataṃ naḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, who are praised by us for the sake of wealth, render illustrious the performer of the rite; may we improve the act by a new offspring (given by you). Preserve us, heaven and earth, along with the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं नो अग्ने पित्रोरुपस्थ आ देवो देवेष्वनवद्य जागृविः । तनूकृद्बोधि प्रमतिश्च कारवे त्वं कल्याण वसु विश्वमोपिषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ no agne pitrorupastha ā devo deveṣvanavadya jāgṛviḥ | tanūkṛdbodhi pramatiśca kārave tvaṃ kalyāṇa vasu viśvamopiṣe ||

translations.english: Irreproachable Agni, a vigilant god amongst the gods, (abiding) in the proximity of (your) parents, and bestowing upon us embodied  (progeny), aweke us. Be well disposed to the offerer of the oblation; for you, auspicious Agni, grant all riches.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने प्रमतिस्त्वं पितासि नस्त्वं वयस्कृत्तव जामयो वयम् । सं त्वा रायः शतिनः सं सहस्रिणः सुवीरं यन्ति व्रतपामदाभ्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne pramatistvaṃ pitāsi nastvaṃ vayaskṛttava jāmayo vayam | saṃ tvā rāyaḥ śatinaḥ saṃ sahasriṇaḥ suvīraṃ yanti vratapāmadābhya ||

translations.english: You, Agni, are well disposed to us, you are our protector, you are the giver of life to us; we are your kinsmen. Uninjurable Agni, hundreds and thousands of treasures belong to you, who are the defender of pious acts and attended by good men.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने प्रथममायुमायवे देवा अकृण्वन्नहुषस्य विश्पतिम् । इळामकृण्वन्मनुषस्य शासनीं पितुर्यत्पुत्रो ममकस्य जायते ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmagne prathamamāyumāyave devā akṛṇvannahuṣasya viśpatim | iḷāmakṛṇvanmanuṣasya śāsanīṃ pituryatputro mamakasya jāyate ||

translations.english: The gods formerly made you, Agni, the living genitive ral of the mortal Nahuṣa; they made Iḷā, the instrumental uctress of Manu, when the son of my father was born.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं नो अग्ने तव देव पायुभिर्मघोनो रक्ष तन्वश्च वन्द्य । त्राता तोकस्य तनये गवामस्यनिमेषं रक्षमाणस्तव व्रते ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ no agne tava deva pāyubhirmaghono rakṣa tanvaśca vandya | trātā tokasya tanaye gavāmasyanimeṣaṃ rakṣamāṇastava vrate ||

translations.english: Agni, who are worthy to be praised, preserve us who are opulent with your bounties, and also the person ns (of our sons); you are the defender of cattle for the son of my son, who is ever assiduous in your worship.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने यज्यवे पायुरन्तरोऽनिषङ्गाय चतुरक्ष इध्यसे । यो रातहव्योऽवृकाय धायसे कीरेश्चिन्मन्त्रं मनसा वनोषि तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne yajyave pāyurantaro'niṣaṅgāya caturakṣa idhyase | yo rātahavyo'vṛkāya dhāyase kīreścinmantraṃ manasā vanoṣi tam ||

translations.english: Your, four-eyed Agni, blaze as the protector of the worshipper, who are at hand for the (security of the) uninterrupted (rite); you cherish in your mind the prayer of your adorer, who offers the oblation to you, the harmless, the benevolent.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्न उरुशंसाय वाघते स्पार्हं यद्रेक्णः परमं वनोषि तत् । आध्रस्य चित्प्रमतिरुच्यसे पिता प्र पाकं शास्सि प्र दिशो विदुष्टरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagna uruśaṃsāya vāghate spārhaṃ yadrekṇaḥ paramaṃ vanoṣi tat | ādhrasya citpramatirucyase pitā pra pākaṃ śāssi pra diśo viduṣṭaraḥ ||

translations.english: You, Agni, desire (that the worshipper may acquire) that excellent wealth which is reqquisite for the many-commended priest; you are called the well-intentioned protector. You, who are all-wise, instrumental ucted the disciple, and (define) the points of the horizon.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने प्रयतदक्षिणं नरं वर्मेव स्यूतं परि पासि विश्वतः । स्वादुक्षद्मा यो वसतौ स्योनकृज्जीवयाजं यजते सोपमा दिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne prayatadakṣiṇaṃ naraṃ varmeva syūtaṃ pari pāsi viśvataḥ | svādukṣadmā yo vasatau syonakṛjjīvayājaṃ yajate sopamā divaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, you dend the man who gives presents (to the priests) on every side, like well-stitched armour. The man who keeps choice viands in his dwelling, and with them entertains (his guests), performs the sacrifice of life, and is the likeness of heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: इमामग्ने शरणिं मीमृषो न इममध्वानं यमगाम दूरात् । आपिः पिता प्रमतिः सोम्यानां भृमिरस्यृषिकृन्मर्त्यानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: imāmagne śaraṇiṃ mīmṛṣo na imamadhvānaṃ yamagāma dūrāt | āpiḥ pitā pramatiḥ somyānāṃ bhṛmirasyṛṣikṛnmartyānām ||

translations.english: Agni, forgive us this our negligence, this path in which we have gone astray; you are to be sought as the protector and encourager of those who offer suitable libations; you are the fulfiller (of the end of rites), you make yourself visible to mortals.

mantras.sanskrit: मनुष्वदग्ने अङ्गिरस्वदङ्गिरो ययातिवत्सदने पूर्ववच्छुचे । अच्छ याह्या वहा दैव्यं जनमा सादय बर्हिषि यक्षि च प्रियम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: manuṣvadagne aṅgirasvadaṅgiro yayātivatsadane pūrvavacchuce | accha yāhyā vahā daivyaṃ janamā sādaya barhiṣi yakṣi ca priyam ||

translations.english: Pure Agni, who goes about (to receive oblations), go in your presence to the halll of sacrifice, as did Manu, and Aṅgiras, and Yayāti, and others of old; bring hither the divine person nages, seat them on the sacred grass, and offer them grateful (sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: एतेनाग्ने ब्रह्मणा वावृधस्व शक्ती वा यत्ते चकृमा विदा वा । उत प्र णेष्यभि वस्यो अस्मान्त्सं नः सृज सुमत्या वाजवत्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: etenāgne brahmaṇā vāvṛdhasva śaktī vā yatte cakṛmā vidā vā | uta pra ṇeṣyabhi vasyo asmāntsaṃ naḥ sṛja sumatyā vājavatyā ||

translations.english: . Agni, do your thrive through this our prayer, which we make according to our ability, according to our knowledge; do you, therefore, lead us to opulence, and endow us with right understanding securing (abundant) food.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य नु वीर्याणि प्र वोचं यानि चकार प्रथमानि वज्री । अहन्नहिमन्वपस्ततर्द प्र वक्षणा अभिनत्पर्वतानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrasya nu vīryāṇi pra vocaṃ yāni cakāra prathamāni vajrī | ahannahimanvapastatarda pra vakṣaṇā abhinatparvatānām ||

translations.english: I declare the former valorous deeds of Indra, which the thunderer has achieved; he clove the cloud; he cast the waters down (to earth); he broke (a way) for the torrents of the mountain.

mantras.sanskrit: अहन्नहिं पर्वते शिश्रियाणं त्वष्टास्मै वज्रं स्वर्यं ततक्ष । वाश्रा इव धेनवः स्यन्दमाना अञ्जः समुद्रमव जग्मुरापः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahannahiṃ parvate śiśriyāṇaṃ tvaṣṭāsmai vajraṃ svaryaṃ tatakṣa | vāśrā iva dhenavaḥ syandamānā añjaḥ samudramava jagmurāpaḥ ||

translations.english: He clove the cloud, seeking refuge on the mountain; Tvaṣṭa) sharpened his far-whirling bolt; the flowing waters quickly hastened to the ocean, like cows (hastening) to their calves.

mantras.sanskrit: वृषायमाणोऽवृणीत सोमं त्रिकद्रुकेष्वपिबत्सुतस्य । आ सायकं मघवादत्त वज्रमहन्नेनं प्रथमजामहीनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣāyamāṇo'vṛṇīta somaṃ trikadrukeṣvapibatsutasya | ā sāyakaṃ maghavādatta vajramahannenaṃ prathamajāmahīnām ||

translations.english: Impetuous as a bull, he quaffed the Soma juice, he drank of the libation at the triple sacrifice. Maghvan took his shaft, the thunderbolt, and with it struck the first born of the clouds.

mantras.sanskrit: यदिन्द्राहन्प्रथमजामहीनामान्मायिनाममिनाः प्रोत मायाः । आत्सूर्यं जनयन्द्यामुषासं तादीत्ना शत्रुं न किला विवित्से ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadindrāhanprathamajāmahīnāmānmāyināmamināḥ prota māyāḥ | ātsūryaṃ janayandyāmuṣāsaṃ tādītnā śatruṃ na kilā vivitse ||

translations.english: Inasmuch, Indra, as you have divided the first-born of the clouds, you have destroyed the delusions of the deluders, and then engendering the sun, the dawn, the firmament, you have not left an enemy (to oppose you).

mantras.sanskrit: अहन्वृत्रं वृत्रतरं व्यंसमिन्द्रो वज्रेण महता वधेन । स्कन्धांसीव कुलिशेना विवृक्णाहिः शयत उपपृक्पृथिव्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahanvṛtraṃ vṛtrataraṃ vyaṃsamindro vajreṇa mahatā vadhena | skandhāṃsīva kuliśenā vivṛkṇāhiḥ śayata upapṛkpṛthivyāḥ ||

translations.english: With his vast destroying thunderbolt, Indra struck the darkling mutilated Vṛtra; as the trunks of trees are felled by the axe, so lies Ahi prostrate on the earth.

mantras.sanskrit: अयोद्धेव दुर्मद आ हि जुह्वे महावीरं तुविबाधमृजीषम् । नातारीदस्य समृतिं वधानां सं रुजानाः पिपिष इन्द्रशत्रुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayoddheva durmada ā hi juhve mahāvīraṃ tuvibādhamṛjīṣam | nātārīdasya samṛtiṃ vadhānāṃ saṃ rujānāḥ pipiṣa indraśatruḥ ||

translations.english: The arrogant Vṛtra, as if unequaled, defied Indra, the mighty hero, the destroyer of many, the scatterer of foes; he has not escaped the contact of the fate (Indra's) enemies. The foe of Indra has crushed the (banks of the) rivers.

mantras.sanskrit: अपादहस्तो अपृतन्यदिन्द्रमास्य वज्रमधि सानौ जघान । वृष्णो वध्रिः प्रतिमानं बुभूषन्पुरुत्रा वृत्रो अशयद्व्यस्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: apādahasto apṛtanyadindramāsya vajramadhi sānau jaghāna | vṛṣṇo vadhriḥ pratimānaṃ bubhūṣanpurutrā vṛtro aśayadvyastaḥ ||

translations.english: Having neither hand nor foot, he defied Indra, who struck him with the thunderbolt upon his mountain-like shoulder, like one emasculated who pretends to virility; then Vṛtra, mutilated of many members, slept.

mantras.sanskrit: नदं न भिन्नममुया शयानं मनो रुहाणा अति यन्त्यापः । याश्चिद्वृत्रो महिना पर्यतिष्ठत्तासामहिः पत्सुतःशीर्बभूव ॥
mantras.transliteration: nadaṃ na bhinnamamuyā śayānaṃ mano ruhāṇā ati yantyāpaḥ | yāścidvṛtro mahinā paryatiṣṭhattāsāmahiḥ patsutaḥśīrbabhūva ||

translations.english: The waters, that delight the minds (of men), flow over him, recumbent on this earth, as a river (bursts through) its broken (banks). Ahi has been prostrated beneath the feet of the waters, which Vṛtra, by his might, had obstructed.

mantras.sanskrit: नीचावया अभवद्वृत्रपुत्रेन्द्रो अस्या अव वधर्जभार । उत्तरा सूरधरः पुत्र आसीद्दानुः शये सहवत्सा न धेनुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nīcāvayā abhavadvṛtraputrendro asyā ava vadharjabhāra | uttarā sūradharaḥ putra āsīddānuḥ śaye sahavatsā na dhenuḥ ||

translations.english: The mother of Vṛtra was bending over her son, when Indra struck her nether part with his shaft; so the mother was above and the son underneath, and Dānu slept (with her son), like  a cow with its calf.

mantras.sanskrit: अतिष्ठन्तीनामनिवेशनानां काष्ठानां मध्ये निहितं शरीरम् । वृत्रस्य निण्यं वि चरन्त्यापो दीर्घं तम आशयदिन्द्रशत्रुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: atiṣṭhantīnāmaniveśanānāṃ kāṣṭhānāṃ madhye nihitaṃ śarīram | vṛtrasya niṇyaṃ vi carantyāpo dīrghaṃ tama āśayadindraśatruḥ ||

translations.english: The waters carry off the nameless body of Vṛtra, tossed into the midst of the never- stopping, never-resting currents. The foe of Indra has slept a long darkness.

mantras.sanskrit: दासपत्नीरहिगोपा अतिष्ठन्निरुद्धा आपः पणिनेव गावः । अपां बिलमपिहितं यदासीद्वृत्रं जघन्वाँ अप तद्ववार ॥
mantras.transliteration: dāsapatnīrahigopā atiṣṭhanniruddhā āpaḥ paṇineva gāvaḥ | apāṃ bilamapihitaṃ yadāsīdvṛtraṃ jaghanvā~ apa tadvavāra ||

translations.english: The waters, the wives of the destroyer, guarded by Ahi, stood obstructed, like the cows by Paṇis; but by laying Vṛtra, Indra set open the cave that had confined them.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्व्यो वारो अभवस्तदिन्द्र सृके यत्त्वा प्रत्यहन्देव एकः । अजयो गा अजयः शूर सोममवासृजः सर्तवे सप्त सिन्धून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvyo vāro abhavastadindra sṛke yattvā pratyahandeva ekaḥ | ajayo gā ajayaḥ śūra somamavāsṛjaḥ sartave sapta sindhūn ||

translations.english: When the single resplendent Vṛtra returned the blow (which had been inflicted), Indra, by your thunderbolt, you became (furious), like a horse's tail. You have rescued the kine; you have won, Hero, the Soma juice; you have let loose the seven rivers to flow.

mantras.sanskrit: नास्मै विद्युन्न तन्यतुः सिषेध न यां मिहमकिरद्ध्रादुनिं च । इन्द्रश्च यद्युयुधाते अहिश्चोतापरीभ्यो मघवा वि जिग्ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: nāsmai vidyunna tanyatuḥ siṣedha na yāṃ mihamakiraddhrāduniṃ ca | indraśca yadyuyudhāte ahiścotāparībhyo maghavā vi jigye ||

translations.english: Neither the lightning nor the thunder (discharged by Vṛtra), nor the rain which he showered, nor the thunderbolt, harmed Indra, when he and Ahi contended and Maghvat triumphed also over other (attacks).

mantras.sanskrit: अहेर्यातारं कमपश्य इन्द्र हृदि यत्ते जघ्नुषो भीरगच्छत् । नव च यन्नवतिं च स्रवन्तीः श्येनो न भीतो अतरो रजांसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: aheryātāraṃ kamapaśya indra hṛdi yatte jaghnuṣo bhīragacchat | nava ca yannavatiṃ ca sravantīḥ śyeno na bhīto ataro rajāṃsi ||

translations.english: When fear entered, Indra, into your heart when about to slay Ahi, what other destroyer of him did you look for, that, alarmed, you did traverse ninety and nine streams like a (swift) hawk?

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रो यातोऽवसितस्य राजा शमस्य च शृङ्गिणो वज्रबाहुः । सेदु राजा क्षयति चर्षणीनामरान्न नेमिः परि ता बभूव ॥
mantras.transliteration: indro yāto'vasitasya rājā śamasya ca śṛṅgiṇo vajrabāhuḥ | sedu rājā kṣayati carṣaṇīnāmarānna nemiḥ pari tā babhūva ||

translations.english: Then Indra, the wilder of the thunderbolt, became the sovereign of all that is moveable or immoveable, of hornless and horned cattle; and as he abides the monarch of men, he comprehended all things (within him), as the circumference comprehends the spokes of a wheel.

mantras.sanskrit: एतायामोप गव्यन्त इन्द्रमस्माकं सु प्रमतिं वावृधाति । अनामृणः कुविदादस्य रायो गवां केतं परमावर्जते नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: etāyāmopa gavyanta indramasmākaṃ su pramatiṃ vāvṛdhāti | anāmṛṇaḥ kuvidādasya rāyo gavāṃ ketaṃ paramāvarjate naḥ ||

translations.english: Come, let us get to Indra, (to recover our stolen cattle), for he, devoid of malice, exhilarates our minds; thereupon he will bestow upon us perfect knowledge of this wealth, (which consists) of kine.

mantras.sanskrit: उपेदहं धनदामप्रतीतं जुष्टां न श्येनो वसतिं पतामि । इन्द्रं नमस्यन्नुपमेभिरर्कैर्यः स्तोतृभ्यो हव्यो अस्ति यामन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: upedahaṃ dhanadāmapratītaṃ juṣṭāṃ na śyeno vasatiṃ patāmi | indraṃ namasyannupamebhirarkairyaḥ stotṛbhyo havyo asti yāman ||

translations.english: I fly, like a hawk to its cherished nest, to that Indra who is to be invoked by his worshipper in battle, glorifying with excellent hymns, him who is invincible and the giver of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: नि सर्वसेन इषुधीँरसक्त समर्यो गा अजति यस्य वष्टि । चोष्कूयमाण इन्द्र भूरि वामं मा पणिर्भूरस्मदधि प्रवृद्ध ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni sarvasena iṣudhī~rasakta samaryo gā ajati yasya vaṣṭi | coṣkūyamāṇa indra bhūri vāmaṃ mā paṇirbhūrasmadadhi pravṛddha ||

translations.english: The commander fo the whole host has bound his quiver (on his back); the lord drives the cattle (to the dwelling) of whom he plural ases. Mighty Indra, bestowing upon us abundant wealth, take not advantage of us like a dealer.

mantras.sanskrit: वधीर्हि दस्युं धनिनं घनेनँ एकश्चरन्नुपशाकेभिरिन्द्र । धनोरधि विषुणक्ते व्यायन्नयज्वानः सनकाः प्रेतिमीयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vadhīrhi dasyuṃ dhaninaṃ ghanena~ ekaścarannupaśākebhirindra | dhanoradhi viṣuṇakte vyāyannayajvānaḥ sanakāḥ pretimīyuḥ ||

translations.english: Verily, Indra, you have slain the wealthy barbarian with your bold; your, singly assailing (him), although with auxiliaries (the Maruts) at hand. Perceiving the impending manifold destructiveness of your bow, they, the Sanakas, the neglecters of sacrifice, perished.

mantras.sanskrit: परा चिच्छीर्षा ववृजुस्त इन्द्रायज्वानो यज्वभिः स्पर्धमानाः । प्र यद्दिवो हरिवः स्थातरुग्र निरव्रताँ अधमो रोदस्योः ॥
mantras.transliteration: parā cicchīrṣā vavṛjusta indrāyajvāno yajvabhiḥ spardhamānāḥ | pra yaddivo harivaḥ sthātarugra niravratā~ adhamo rodasyoḥ ||

translations.english: The neglecters of sacrifice, contending with the sacrificers, Indra, fled with averted faces. Indra, fierce, unyielding, lord of steeds, (they appeared) when you did blow the disregarders of religion from off the heaven, and earth and sky.

mantras.sanskrit: अयुयुत्सन्ननवद्यस्य सेनामयातयन्त क्षितयो नवग्वाः । वृषायुधो न वध्रयो निरष्टाः प्रवद्भिरिन्द्राच्चितयन्त आयन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayuyutsannanavadyasya senāmayātayanta kṣitayo navagvāḥ | vṛṣāyudho na vadhrayo niraṣṭāḥ pravadbhirindrāccitayanta āyan ||

translations.english: (The adherants of Vṛtra) encountered the army of the irreproachable (Indra); men of holy lives encouraged him. Scattered before him, conscious (of their inferiority), like the emasculated contending with men, they fled by precipitous paths.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमेतान्रुदतो जक्षतश्चायोधयो रजस इन्द्र पारे । अवादहो दिव आ दस्युमुच्चा प्र सुन्वतः स्तुवतः शंसमावः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvametānrudato jakṣataścāyodhayo rajasa indra pāre | avādaho diva ā dasyumuccā pra sunvataḥ stuvataḥ śaṃsamāvaḥ ||

translations.english: You have destroyed them, Indra, whether weeping or laughing, on the farthest verge of the sky; you have consumed the robber, (having dragged him) from heaven, and have received the praises of the worshipper, praising you and offering libations.

mantras.sanskrit: चक्राणासः परीणहं पृथिव्या हिरण्येन मणिना शुम्भमानाः । न हिन्वानासस्तितिरुस्त इन्द्रं परि स्पशो अदधात्सूर्येण ॥
mantras.transliteration: cakrāṇāsaḥ parīṇahaṃ pṛthivyā hiraṇyena maṇinā śumbhamānāḥ | na hinvānāsastitirusta indraṃ pari spaśo adadhātsūryeṇa ||

translations.english: Decorated with gold and jewels, they were spreading over the circuit of the earth; but mighty as they were, they triumphed not over Indra; he dispersed them with the (rising) sun.

mantras.sanskrit: परि यदिन्द्र रोदसी उभे अबुभोजीर्महिना विश्वतः सीम् । अमन्यमानाँ अभि मन्यमानैर्निर्ब्रह्मभिरधमो दस्युमिन्द्र ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari yadindra rodasī ubhe abubhojīrmahinā viśvataḥ sīm | amanyamānā~ abhi manyamānairnirbrahmabhiradhamo dasyumindra ||

translations.english: Indra, as you enjoy both heaven and earth, investing the universe with your magnitude, you have blown away the robber with the prayers which are repeated on behalf of those who do not comprehend them.

mantras.sanskrit: न ये दिवः पृथिव्या अन्तमापुर्न मायाभिर्धनदां पर्यभूवन् । युजं वज्रं वृषभश्चक्र इन्द्रो निर्ज्योतिषा तमसो गा अदुक्षत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: na ye divaḥ pṛthivyā antamāpurna māyābhirdhanadāṃ paryabhūvan | yujaṃ vajraṃ vṛṣabhaścakra indro nirjyotiṣā tamaso gā adukṣat ||

translations.english: When the waters descended not upon the ends of the earth, and overspread not that giver of affluence with its productions, then Indra, the showerer, grasped his bolt, and with its brightness milked out the waters from the darkness.

mantras.sanskrit: अनु स्वधामक्षरन्नापो अस्यावर्धत मध्य आ नाव्यानाम् । सध्रीचीनेन मनसा तमिन्द्र ओजिष्ठेन हन्मनाहन्नभि द्यून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: anu svadhāmakṣarannāpo asyāvardhata madhya ā nāvyānām | sadhrīcīnena manasā tamindra ojiṣṭhena hanmanāhannabhi dyūn ||

translations.english: The waters flowed to provide the food of Indra, but (Vṛtra) increased in the midst of the navigable (rivers); then Indra, with his fatal and powerful shaft, slew Vṛtra, whose thought were ever turned towards him.

mantras.sanskrit: न्याविध्यदिलीबिशस्य दृळ्हा वि शृङ्गिणमभिनच्छुष्णमिन्द्रः । यावत्तरो मघवन्यावदोजो वज्रेण शत्रुमवधीः पृतन्युम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nyāvidhyadilībiśasya dṛḷhā vi śṛṅgiṇamabhinacchuṣṇamindraḥ | yāvattaro maghavanyāvadojo vajreṇa śatrumavadhīḥ pṛtanyum ||

translations.english: Indra set free (the waters) obstructed by (Vṛtra), when sleeping in the caves of the earth, and slew the horned dryer up (of the world). You, Maghavan, with equal swiftness and strength, did kill with your thunderbolt the enemy defying you to battle.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि सिध्मो अजिगादस्य शत्रून्वि तिग्मेन वृषभेणा पुरोऽभेत् । सं वज्रेणासृजद्वृत्रमिन्द्रः प्र स्वां मतिमतिरच्छाशदानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi sidhmo ajigādasya śatrūnvi tigmena vṛṣabheṇā puro'bhet | saṃ vajreṇāsṛjadvṛtramindraḥ pra svāṃ matimatiracchāśadānaḥ ||

translations.english: The weapon of Indra fell upon his adversaries; with his sharp and excellent (shaft) he destroyed their cities; he then reached Vṛtra with his thunderbolt, and (by) slaying him, exhilarated his mind.

mantras.sanskrit: आवः कुत्समिन्द्र यस्मिञ्चाकन्प्रावो युध्यन्तं वृषभं दशद्युम् । शफच्युतो रेणुर्नक्षत द्यामुच्छ्वैत्रेयो नृषाह्याय तस्थौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: āvaḥ kutsamindra yasmiñcākanprāvo yudhyantaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ daśadyum | śaphacyuto reṇurnakṣata dyāmucchvaitreyo nṛṣāhyāya tasthau ||

translations.english: You, Indra, have protected Kutsa, grateful for his praises; you have defended the excellent Daśadyu engaged in battle; the dust of your courser's hoofs ascended to heaven; the son of Śvita, (through your favour), rose up, to be again unborn by men.

mantras.sanskrit: आवः शमं वृषभं तुग्र्यासु क्षेत्रजेषे मघवञ्छ्वित्र्यं गाम् । ज्योक्चिदत्र तस्थिवांसो अक्रञ्छत्रूयतामधरा वेदनाकः ॥
mantras.transliteration: āvaḥ śamaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tugryāsu kṣetrajeṣe maghavañchvitryaṃ gām | jyokcidatra tasthivāṃso akrañchatrūyatāmadharā vedanākaḥ ||

translations.english: You have protected, Maghavan, the excellent son of Śvitā, when combating for his lands, and encouraged (by you) when immersed in water; do you inflict sharp pains on those of hostile minds, who have long stood (in enmity) against us.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिश्चिन्नो अद्या भवतं नवेदसा विभुर्वां याम उत रातिरश्विना । युवोर्हि यन्त्रं हिम्येव वाससोऽभ्यायंसेन्या भवतं मनीषिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: triścinno adyā bhavataṃ navedasā vibhurvāṃ yāma uta rātiraśvinā | yuvorhi yantraṃ himyeva vāsaso'bhyāyaṃsenyā bhavataṃ manīṣibhiḥ ||

translations.english: Wise Aśvins, be present with us thrice today; vast is your vehicle, as well as your munificence; your union is like that of the shining (day) and dewy (night); (suffer yourselves) to be detained by the learned (priests).

mantras.sanskrit: त्रयः पवयो मधुवाहने रथे सोमस्य वेनामनु विश्व इद्विदुः । त्रयः स्कम्भासः स्कभितास आरभे त्रिर्नक्तं याथस्त्रिर्वश्विना दिवा ॥
mantras.transliteration: trayaḥ pavayo madhuvāhane rathe somasya venāmanu viśva idviduḥ | trayaḥ skambhāsaḥ skabhitāsa ārabhe trirnaktaṃ yāthastrirvaśvinā divā ||

translations.english: Three are the solid (wheels) of your abundance-bearing chariot, as all (the gods) have known (it to be), when attendant on Vena, the beloved of Soma; three are the columns plural ced (above it) for support, and in it thrice do you journey by night, and thrice by day.

mantras.sanskrit: समाने अहन्त्रिरवद्यगोहना त्रिरद्य यज्ञं मधुना मिमिक्षतम् । त्रिर्वाजवतीरिषो अश्विना युवं दोषा अस्मभ्यमुषसश्च पिन्वतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: samāne ahantriravadyagohanā triradya yajñaṃ madhunā mimikṣatam | trirvājavatīriṣo aśvinā yuvaṃ doṣā asmabhyamuṣasaśca pinvatam ||

translations.english: Thrice in one entire day do you repair the faults (of your worshippers); thrice today sprinkle the oblation with sweetness; and thrice, evening and morning, Aśvins, grant us strength-bestowing food.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिर्वर्तिर्यातं त्रिरनुव्रते जने त्रिः सुप्राव्ये त्रेधेव शिक्षतम् । त्रिर्नान्द्यं वहतमश्विना युवं त्रिः पृक्षो अस्मे अक्षरेव पिन्वतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: trirvartiryātaṃ triranuvrate jane triḥ suprāvye tredheva śikṣatam | trirnāndyaṃ vahatamaśvinā yuvaṃ triḥ pṛkṣo asme akṣareva pinvatam ||

translations.english: Thrice, Aśvins, visit our dwelling, and the man who is well-disposed towards us; thrice repair to him who deserves your protection, and instrumental uct us in three-fold knowledge; thrice grant us gratifying (rewards); thrice shower upon us food, as (Indra pours down) rain.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिर्नो रयिं वहतमश्विना युवं त्रिर्देवताता त्रिरुतावतं धियः । त्रिः सौभगत्वं त्रिरुत श्रवांसि नस्त्रिष्ठं वां सूरे दुहिता रुहद्रथम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: trirno rayiṃ vahatamaśvinā yuvaṃ trirdevatātā trirutāvataṃ dhiyaḥ | triḥ saubhagatvaṃ triruta śravāṃsi nastriṣṭhaṃ vāṃ sūre duhitā ruhadratham ||

translations.english: Aśvins, thrice bestow upon us riches; thrice approach the divine rite; thrice preserve our intellects; thrice grant us prosperity, thrice food. The daughter of the sun has ascended your three-wheeled car.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिर्नो अश्विना दिव्यानि भेषजा त्रिः पार्थिवानि त्रिरु दत्तमद्भ्यः । ओमानं शंयोर्ममकाय सूनवे त्रिधातु शर्म वहतं शुभस्पती ॥
mantras.transliteration: trirno aśvinā divyāni bheṣajā triḥ pārthivāni triru dattamadbhyaḥ | omānaṃ śaṃyormamakāya sūnave tridhātu śarma vahataṃ śubhaspatī ||

translations.english: Thrice grant us, Aśvins, the medicaments of heaven, and those of earth, and those of the firmament; give to my son the prosperity of Śamyu; cherishers of wholesome (herbs), preserve the well-being of the three humours (of the body).

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिर्नो अश्विना यजता दिवेदिवे परि त्रिधातु पृथिवीमशायतम् । तिस्रो नासत्या रथ्या परावत आत्मेव वातः स्वसराणि गच्छतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: trirno aśvinā yajatā divedive pari tridhātu pṛthivīmaśāyatam | tisro nāsatyā rathyā parāvata ātmeva vātaḥ svasarāṇi gacchatam ||

translations.english: Aśvins, who are to be thrice worshipped, day by day, repose on the triple (couch of) sacred grass upon the earth, (that form the altar); car-borne Nāsatyas, repair from afar to the threefold (plural ce of sacrifice), as the vital air to (living) bodies.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिरश्विना सिन्धुभिः सप्तमातृभिस्त्रय आहावास्त्रेधा हविष्कृतम् । तिस्रः पृथिवीरुपरि प्रवा दिवो नाकं रक्षेथे द्युभिरक्तुभिर्हितम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: triraśvinā sindhubhiḥ saptamātṛbhistraya āhāvāstredhā haviṣkṛtam | tisraḥ pṛthivīrupari pravā divo nākaṃ rakṣethe dyubhiraktubhirhitam ||

translations.english: Come, Aśvins, thrice with the seven mother-sttreams; the three rivers are ready; the triple oblation is prepared; rising above the three worlds, you defend the sun in the sky, who is established for both night and day.

mantras.sanskrit: क्व त्री चक्रा त्रिवृतो रथस्य क्व त्रयो वन्धुरो ये सनीळाः । कदा योगो वाजिनो रासभस्य येन यज्ञं नासत्योपयाथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kva trī cakrā trivṛto rathasya kva trayo vandhuro ye sanīḷāḥ | kadā yogo vājino rāsabhasya yena yajñaṃ nāsatyopayāthaḥ ||

translations.english: Where, Nāsatyas, ae the three wheels of your triangular car? where the three fastenings and props (of the awning?) When will be the harnessing of the powerful ass, that you may come to the sacrifice?

mantras.sanskrit: आ नासत्या गच्छतं हूयते हविर्मध्वः पिबतं मधुपेभिरासभिः । युवोर्हि पूर्वं सवितोषसो रथमृताय चित्रं घृतवन्तमिष्यति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā nāsatyā gacchataṃ hūyate havirmadhvaḥ pibataṃ madhupebhirāsabhiḥ | yuvorhi pūrvaṃ savitoṣaso rathamṛtāya citraṃ ghṛtavantamiṣyati ||

translations.english: Come, Nāsatyas, to the sacrifice; the oblation is offered; drink the juice with mouths that relish the sweet savour. Before dawn, even, Savitā send (to bring you) to the rite, your wonderful car shining with clarified butter.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नासत्या त्रिभिरेकादशैरिह देवेभिर्यातं मधुपेयमश्विना । प्रायुस्तारिष्टं नी रपांसि मृक्षतं सेधतं द्वेषो भवतं सचाभुवा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā nāsatyā tribhirekādaśairiha devebhiryātaṃ madhupeyamaśvinā | prāyustāriṣṭaṃ nī rapāṃsi mṛkṣataṃ sedhataṃ dveṣo bhavataṃ sacābhuvā ||

translations.english: Come, Nāsatyas, with the thrice eleven divinities; come, Aśvins, to drink the oblation prolong our lives, efface our faults, restrain our enemies, and be ever with us.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो अश्विना त्रिवृता रथेनार्वाञ्चं रयिं वहतं सुवीरम् । शृण्वन्ता वामवसे जोहवीमि वृधे च नो भवतं वाजसातौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no aśvinā trivṛtā rathenārvāñcaṃ rayiṃ vahataṃ suvīram | śṛṇvantā vāmavase johavīmi vṛdhe ca no bhavataṃ vājasātau ||

translations.english: Borne in your car that traverses the three worlds, bring to us Aśvins, present affluence, attended by (male) progeny; I call upon you both, listening to me, for protection; be to us for vigour in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: ह्वयाम्यग्निं प्रथमं स्वस्तये ह्वयामि मित्रावरुणाविहावसे । ह्वयामि रात्रीं जगतो निवेशनीं ह्वयामि देवं सवितारमूतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: hvayāmyagniṃ prathamaṃ svastaye hvayāmi mitrāvaruṇāvihāvase | hvayāmi rātrīṃ jagato niveśanīṃ hvayāmi devaṃ savitāramūtaye ||

translations.english: Invoke Agni first, for protection: I invoke for protection, Mitra and Varuṇa; invoke Night, who brings rest to the world; invoke the divine Savitā for my preservation.

mantras.sanskrit: आ कृष्णेन रजसा वर्तमानो निवेशयन्नमृतं मर्त्यं च । हिरण्ययेन सविता रथेना देवो याति भुवनानि पश्यन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā kṛṣṇena rajasā vartamāno niveśayannamṛtaṃ martyaṃ ca | hiraṇyayena savitā rathenā devo yāti bhuvanāni paśyan ||

translations.english: Revolving through the darkened firmament, arousing mortal and immortal, the divine Savitā travels in his golden chariot, beholding the (several) worlds.

mantras.sanskrit: याति देवः प्रवता यात्युद्वता याति शुभ्राभ्यां यजतो हरिभ्याम् । आ देवो याति सविता परावतोऽप विश्वा दुरिता बाधमानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yāti devaḥ pravatā yātyudvatā yāti śubhrābhyāṃ yajato haribhyām | ā devo yāti savitā parāvato'pa viśvā duritā bādhamānaḥ ||

translations.english: The divine Savitā travels by an upward and by a downward path; deserving adoration, he journeys with two white horses; he comes hither from a distance, removing all sins.

mantras.sanskrit: अभीवृतं कृशनैर्विश्वरूपं हिरण्यशम्यं यजतो बृहन्तम् । आस्थाद्रथं सविता चित्रभानुः कृष्णा रजांसि तविषीं दधानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhīvṛtaṃ kṛśanairviśvarūpaṃ hiraṇyaśamyaṃ yajato bṛhantam | āsthādrathaṃ savitā citrabhānuḥ kṛṣṇā rajāṃsi taviṣīṃ dadhānaḥ ||

translations.english: The many-rayed adorable Savitā, having power (to disperse) darkness from the world, has mounted his nigh-standing chariot, decorated with many kinds of golden ornaments, and furnished with golden yokes.

mantras.sanskrit: वि जनाञ्छ्यावाः शितिपादो अख्यन्रथं हिरण्यप्रौगं वहन्तः । शश्वद्विशः सवितुर्दैव्यस्योपस्थे विश्वा भुवनानि तस्थुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi janāñchyāvāḥ śitipādo akhyanrathaṃ hiraṇyapraugaṃ vahantaḥ | śaśvadviśaḥ saviturdaivyasyopasthe viśvā bhuvanāni tasthuḥ ||

translations.english: His white-footed coursers, harnessed to his car with a golden yoke, have manifested light to manking. Men and all the regions are ever in the presence of divine Savitā.

mantras.sanskrit: तिस्रो द्यावः सवितुर्द्वा उपस्थाँ एका यमस्य भुवने विराषाट् । आणिं न रथ्यममृताधि तस्थुरिह ब्रवीतु य उ तच्चिकेतत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tisro dyāvaḥ saviturdvā upasthā~ ekā yamasya bhuvane virāṣāṭ | āṇiṃ na rathyamamṛtādhi tasthuriha bravītu ya u tacciketat ||

translations.english: Three are the spheres; two are in the proximity of Savitā, one leads men to the dwelling of Yama. The immortal (luminaries) depend upon Savitā as a car upon the pin of the axle; let him who knows (the greatness of Savitā) declare it.

mantras.sanskrit: वि सुपर्णो अन्तरिक्षाण्यख्यद्गभीरवेपा असुरः सुनीथः । क्वेदानीं सूर्यः कश्चिकेत कतमां द्यां रश्मिरस्या ततान ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi suparṇo antarikṣāṇyakhyadgabhīravepā asuraḥ sunīthaḥ | kvedānīṃ sūryaḥ kaściketa katamāṃ dyāṃ raśmirasyā tatāna ||

translations.english: Suparṇa, (the solar ray), deep-quivering, life-bestowing, well-directed, has illuminated the three regions. Where now is Sūrya Who knows to what sphere his rays have extended?

mantras.sanskrit: अष्टौ व्यख्यत्ककुभः पृथिव्यास्त्री धन्व योजना सप्त सिन्धून् । हिरण्याक्षः सविता देव आगाद्दधद्रत्ना दाशुषे वार्याणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: aṣṭau vyakhyatkakubhaḥ pṛthivyāstrī dhanva yojanā sapta sindhūn | hiraṇyākṣaḥ savitā deva āgāddadhadratnā dāśuṣe vāryāṇi ||

translations.english: He has lighted up the eight points of the horizon, the three regions of living beings, the seven rivers; may the golden-eyes Savitā come hither, bestowing upon the offerer of the oblation desirable riches.

mantras.sanskrit: हिरण्यपाणिः सविता विचर्षणिरुभे द्यावापृथिवी अन्तरीयते । अपामीवां बाधते वेति सूर्यमभि कृष्णेन रजसा द्यामृणोति ॥
mantras.transliteration: hiraṇyapāṇiḥ savitā vicarṣaṇirubhe dyāvāpṛthivī antarīyate | apāmīvāṃ bādhate veti sūryamabhi kṛṣṇena rajasā dyāmṛṇoti ||

translations.english: The gold-handed, all-beholding, Savitā travels between the two regions of heaven and earth, dispels diseases, approaches the sun, and overspreads the sky with gloom, alternating radiance.

mantras.sanskrit: हिरण्यहस्तो असुरः सुनीथः सुमृळीकः स्ववाँ यात्वर्वाङ् । अपसेधन्रक्षसो यातुधानानस्थाद्देवः प्रतिदोषं गृणानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: hiraṇyahasto asuraḥ sunīthaḥ sumṛḷīkaḥ svavā~ yātvarvāṅ | apasedhanrakṣaso yātudhānānasthāddevaḥ pratidoṣaṃ gṛṇānaḥ ||

translations.english: May the golden-handed, life-bestowing, well-guiding, exhilarating, and affluent Savitā, be present (at the sacrifice); for the deity, if worshipped in the evening, it at hand, driving away rākṣas and yātudhānas.

mantras.sanskrit: ये ते पन्थाः सवितः पूर्व्यासोऽरेणवः सुकृता अन्तरिक्षे । तेभिर्नो अद्य पथिभिः सुगेभी रक्षा च नो अधि च ब्रूहि देव ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye te panthāḥ savitaḥ pūrvyāso'reṇavaḥ sukṛtā antarikṣe | tebhirno adya pathibhiḥ sugebhī rakṣā ca no adhi ca brūhi deva ||

translations.english: Your paths, Savitā, are prepared of old, and free from dust, and well plural ced in the firmament; (coming) by those paths easy to be traversed, preserve us today. Deity, speak to us.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वो यह्वं पुरूणां विशां देवयतीनाम् । अग्निं सूक्तेभिर्वचोभिरीमहे यं सीमिदन्य ईळते ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vo yahvaṃ purūṇāṃ viśāṃ devayatīnām | agniṃ sūktebhirvacobhirīmahe yaṃ sīmidanya īḷate ||

translations.english: We implore with sacred hymns the mighty Agni, whom other (ṛṣis) also praise, for the benefit of you who are many people, worshipping the gods of you who are many people, worshipping the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: जनासो अग्निं दधिरे सहोवृधं हविष्मन्तो विधेम ते । स त्वं नो अद्य सुमना इहाविता भवा वाजेषु सन्त्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: janāso agniṃ dadhire sahovṛdhaṃ haviṣmanto vidhema te | sa tvaṃ no adya sumanā ihāvitā bhavā vājeṣu santya ||

translations.english: Men have recourse to Agni, the augmenter of vigour; offering oblations, we worship you; do you liberal giver of food, be well disposed to us here this day, and be our protector.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र त्वा दूतं वृणीमहे होतारं विश्ववेदसम् । महस्ते सतो वि चरन्त्यर्चयो दिवि स्पृशन्ति भानवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra tvā dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe hotāraṃ viśvavedasam | mahaste sato vi carantyarcayo divi spṛśanti bhānavaḥ ||

translations.english: We select you, Agni, the messenger and invoker of the gods, who are endowed with all knowledge. The flames of you, who are mighty and eternal, spread around the rays, touch of the heavens.

mantras.sanskrit: देवासस्त्वा वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा सं दूतं प्रत्नमिन्धते । विश्वं सो अग्ने जयति त्वया धनं यस्ते ददाश मर्त्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: devāsastvā varuṇo mitro aryamā saṃ dūtaṃ pratnamindhate | viśvaṃ so agne jayati tvayā dhanaṃ yaste dadāśa martyaḥ ||

translations.english: The deities Varuṇa, Mitra and Aryaman kindle you, (their) ancient messenger. The man who has offered you (oblations), obtains through you, Agni, universal wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: मन्द्रो होता गृहपतिरग्ने दूतो विशामसि । त्वे विश्वा संगतानि व्रता ध्रुवा यानि देवा अकृण्वत ॥
mantras.transliteration: mandro hotā gṛhapatiragne dūto viśāmasi | tve viśvā saṃgatāni vratā dhruvā yāni devā akṛṇvata ||

translations.english: You, Agni, are the giver of delight, the invoker and messenger of the gods, the domestic guardian of mankind; the good and durable actions which the gods perform are all aggregated in you.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वे इदग्ने सुभगे यविष्ठ्य विश्वमा हूयते हविः । स त्वं नो अद्य सुमना उतापरं यक्षि देवान्त्सुवीर्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: tve idagne subhage yaviṣṭhya viśvamā hūyate haviḥ | sa tvaṃ no adya sumanā utāparaṃ yakṣi devāntsuvīryā ||

translations.english: Youthful and auspicious Agni, whatever oblation may be presented to you, do you, well disposed towards us; either now or at any other time, convey it to the powerful gods.

mantras.sanskrit: तं घेमित्था नमस्विन उप स्वराजमासते । होत्राभिरग्निं मनुषः समिन्धते तितिर्वांसो अति स्रिधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ ghemitthā namasvina upa svarājamāsate | hotrābhiragniṃ manuṣaḥ samindhate titirvāṃso ati sridhaḥ ||
