translations.english: In this manner the devout adore you, who are such (as described), bright with your own radiance. Men, with (seven) ministrant priests, kindle Agni (with oblations), victorious over their enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: घ्नन्तो वृत्रमतरन्रोदसी अप उरु क्षयाय चक्रिरे । भुवत्कण्वे वृषा द्युम्न्याहुतः क्रन्ददश्वो गविष्टिषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: ghnanto vṛtramataranrodasī apa uru kṣayāya cakrire | bhuvatkaṇve vṛṣā dyumnyāhutaḥ krandadaśvo gaviṣṭiṣu ||

translations.english: The destroying (deities along with you) have slain Vṛtra; they have made earth and heaven and the firmament the spacious dwelling-plural ce (of living creatures); may Agni, possessed of wealth, when invoked, be a benefactor to Kaṇva, like a horse that neighs in a conflict for cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: सं सीदस्व महाँ असि शोचस्व देववीतमः । वि धूममग्ने अरुषं मियेध्य सृज प्रशस्त दर्शतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ sīdasva mahā~ asi śocasva devavītamaḥ | vi dhūmamagne aruṣaṃ miyedhya sṛja praśasta darśatam ||

translations.english: Take your seat, Agni, on the sacred grass, for you are mighty; shine forth, for you are devoted to the gods; adorable and excellent Agni, emit the moving and graceful smoke.

mantras.sanskrit: यं त्वा देवासो मनवे दधुरिह यजिष्ठं हव्यवाहन । यं कण्वो मेध्यातिथिर्धनस्पृतं यं वृषा यमुपस्तुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ tvā devāso manave dadhuriha yajiṣṭhaṃ havyavāhana | yaṃ kaṇvo medhyātithirdhanaspṛtaṃ yaṃ vṛṣā yamupastutaḥ ||

translations.english: Bearer of oblations, (you are he) whom the gods detained for the sake of Manu; whom, giver of wealth, Kaṇva, the host of pious guests, has detained; whom Indra detained, and whom (now) some other worshipper has detained.

mantras.sanskrit: यमग्निं मेध्यातिथिः कण्व ईध ऋतादधि । तस्य प्रेषो दीदियुस्तमिमा ऋचस्तमग्निं वर्धयामसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yamagniṃ medhyātithiḥ kaṇva īdha ṛtādadhi | tasya preṣo dīdiyustamimā ṛcastamagniṃ vardhayāmasi ||

translations.english: The rays of that Agni, whom Kaṇva made more brilliant than the sun, pre-eminently shine; him do these our hymns, him do we, extol.

mantras.sanskrit: रायस्पूर्धि स्वधावोऽस्ति हि तेऽग्ने देवेष्वाप्यम् । त्वं वाजस्य श्रुत्यस्य राजसि स नो मृळ महाँ असि ॥
mantras.transliteration: rāyaspūrdhi svadhāvo'sti hi te'gne deveṣvāpyam | tvaṃ vājasya śrutyasya rājasi sa no mṛḷa mahā~ asi ||

translations.english: Agni, giver of food, complete our treasures, for the friendship of the gods is obtainable through you. You are lord over famous viands; make us hapy, for you are great.

mantras.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्व ऊ षु ण ऊतये तिष्ठा देवो न सविता । ऊर्ध्वो वाजस्य सनिता यदञ्जिभिर्वाघद्भिर्विह्वयामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūrdhva ū ṣu ṇa ūtaye tiṣṭhā devo na savitā | ūrdhvo vājasya sanitā yadañjibhirvāghadbhirvihvayāmahe ||

translations.english: Stand up erect for our protection, like the divine Savitā; erect, you are the giver of food, for which we invoke you with unguents, and priests (offering oblations).

mantras.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वो नः पाह्यंहसो नि केतुना विश्वं समत्रिणं दह । कृधी न ऊर्ध्वाञ्चरथाय जीवसे विदा देवेषु नो दुवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūrdhvo naḥ pāhyaṃhaso ni ketunā viśvaṃ samatriṇaṃ daha | kṛdhī na ūrdhvāñcarathāya jīvase vidā deveṣu no duvaḥ ||

translations.english: Erect, preserve us by knowledge from sin; consume every malignant spirit; raise us aloft, that we may pass (through the world); and that we may live, convey our sealth (of oblations) to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: पाहि नो अग्ने रक्षसः पाहि धूर्तेरराव्णः । पाहि रीषत उत वा जिघांसतो बृहद्भानो यविष्ठ्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: pāhi no agne rakṣasaḥ pāhi dhūrterarāvṇaḥ | pāhi rīṣata uta vā jighāṃsato bṛhadbhāno yaviṣṭhya ||

translations.english: Youthful and most resplendent Agni, protect us against evil spirits, and from the malevolent (man), who gives no gifts; protect us from noxious (animals), and from those who seek to kill us.

mantras.sanskrit: घनेव विष्वग्वि जह्यराव्णस्तपुर्जम्भ यो अस्मध्रुक् । यो मर्त्यः शिशीते अत्यक्तुभिर्मा नः स रिपुरीशत ॥
mantras.transliteration: ghaneva viṣvagvi jahyarāvṇastapurjambha yo asmadhruk | yo martyaḥ śiśīte atyaktubhirmā naḥ sa ripurīśata ||

translations.english: Agni, with the burning rays, destroy entirely our foes, who make no gifts, as (potter's ware) with a club; let not one who is inimical to us, nor the man who attacks us with sharp weapons, prevail against us.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निर्वव्ने सुवीर्यमग्निः कण्वाय सौभगम् । अग्निः प्रावन्मित्रोत मेध्यातिथिमग्निः साता उपस्तुतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirvavne suvīryamagniḥ kaṇvāya saubhagam | agniḥ prāvanmitrota medhyātithimagniḥ sātā upastutam ||

translations.english: Agni is solicited for power-conferring (affluence); he has granted prosperity to Kaṇva, he has protected our friends, as well as the (sage who was) the host of the holy and (every other) worshipper (who has had recourse to him) for riches.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निना तुर्वशं यदुं परावत उग्रादेवं हवामहे । अग्निर्नयन्नववास्त्वं बृहद्रथं तुर्वीतिं दस्यवे सहः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agninā turvaśaṃ yaduṃ parāvata ugrādevaṃ havāmahe | agnirnayannavavāstvaṃ bṛhadrathaṃ turvītiṃ dasyave sahaḥ ||

translations.english: We invoke from afar, along with Agni, Turvaśa, Yadu and Ugradeva; let Agni, the arrester of the robber, bring hither Navavāstu, Bṛhadratha and Turvīti.

mantras.sanskrit: नि त्वामग्ने मनुर्दधे ज्योतिर्जनाय शश्वते । दीदेथ कण्व ऋतजात उक्षितो यं नमस्यन्ति कृष्टयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni tvāmagne manurdadhe jyotirjanāya śaśvate | dīdetha kaṇva ṛtajāta ukṣito yaṃ namasyanti kṛṣṭayaḥ ||

translations.english: Manu detained you, Agni, (to give) light to the various races of mankind. Born for the sake of sacrifice, and satiated with oblations, you, whom men reverence, have blazed for Kaṇva.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वेषासो अग्नेरमवन्तो अर्चयो भीमासो न प्रतीतये । रक्षस्विनः सदमिद्यातुमावतो विश्वं समत्रिणं दह ॥
mantras.transliteration: tveṣāso agneramavanto arcayo bhīmāso na pratītaye | rakṣasvinaḥ sadamidyātumāvato viśvaṃ samatriṇaṃ daha ||

translations.english: The flames of Agni are luminous, powerful, fearful, and not to be trusted. Ever assuredly and entirely consume the mighty spirits of evil and all our other adversarieṣ

mantras.sanskrit: क्रीळं वः शर्धो मारुतमनर्वाणं रथेशुभम् । कण्वा अभि प्र गायत ॥
mantras.transliteration: krīḷaṃ vaḥ śardho mārutamanarvāṇaṃ ratheśubham | kaṇvā abhi pra gāyata ||

translations.english: Celebrate, Kaṇvas, the aggregate strength of the Maruts, sportive, with horses, but shining in their car.

mantras.sanskrit: ये पृषतीभिॠष्टिभिः साकं वाशीभिरञ्जिभिः । अजायन्त स्वभानवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye pṛṣatībhiṝṣṭibhiḥ sākaṃ vāśībhirañjibhiḥ | ajāyanta svabhānavaḥ ||

translations.english: Who, borne by spotted deer, were born self-radiant, with weapons, war-cries and decorations.

mantras.sanskrit: इहेव शृण्व एषां कशा हस्तेषु यद्वदान् । नि यामञ्चित्रमृञ्जते ॥
mantras.transliteration: iheva śṛṇva eṣāṃ kaśā hasteṣu yadvadān | ni yāmañcitramṛñjate ||

translations.english: I hear the craking of the whips in their hands, wonderfully inspiring (courage) in the fight.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वः शर्धाय घृष्वये त्वेषद्युम्नाय शुष्मिणे । देवत्तं ब्रह्म गायत ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vaḥ śardhāya ghṛṣvaye tveṣadyumnāya śuṣmiṇe | devattaṃ brahma gāyata ||

translations.english: Address the god-given prayer to those who are your strength, the destroyers of foes, the powerful, possessed of brilliant reputation.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र शंसा गोष्वघ्न्यं क्रीळं यच्छर्धो मारुतम् । जम्भे रसस्य वावृधे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra śaṃsā goṣvaghnyaṃ krīḷaṃ yacchardho mārutam | jambhe rasasya vāvṛdhe ||

translations.english: Praise the sportive and unresisted might of the Maruts, who were born amongst kine, and whose strength has been nourished by (the enjoyment of) the milk.

mantras.sanskrit: को वो वर्षिष्ठ आ नरो दिवश्च ग्मश्च धूतयः । यत्सीमन्तं न धूनुथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: ko vo varṣiṣṭha ā naro divaśca gmaśca dhūtayaḥ | yatsīmantaṃ na dhūnutha ||

translations.english: Which is the chief leader among you, agitators of heaven and earth, who shake all around like the top (of a tree)?

mantras.sanskrit: नि वो यामाय मानुषो दध्र उग्राय मन्यवे । जिहीत पर्वतो गिरिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni vo yāmāya mānuṣo dadhra ugrāya manyave | jihīta parvato giriḥ ||

translations.english: The house-holder, in dread of your fierce and violent approach, has plural nted a firm (buttress); for the many-ridged mountain is shattered (before you).

mantras.sanskrit: येषामज्मेषु पृथिवी जुजुर्वाँ इव विश्पतिः । भिया यामेषु रेजते ॥
mantras.transliteration: yeṣāmajmeṣu pṛthivī jujurvā~ iva viśpatiḥ | bhiyā yāmeṣu rejate ||

translations.english: At whose impetuous approach, earth trembles like an enfeebled monarch through dread (of his enemies).

mantras.sanskrit: स्थिरं हि जानमेषां वयो मातुर्निरेतवे । यत्सीमनु द्विता शवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sthiraṃ hi jānameṣāṃ vayo māturniretave | yatsīmanu dvitā śavaḥ ||

translations.english: Stable is their birth plural ce, (the sky), yet the birds (are able) to issue from (the sphere of) their parent; for your strength is everywhere (divided between two--regions, or heaven and earth.

mantras.sanskrit: उदु त्ये सूनवो गिरः काष्ठा अज्मेष्वत्नत । वाश्रा अभिज्ञु यातवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: udu tye sūnavo giraḥ kāṣṭhā ajmeṣvatnata | vāśrā abhijñu yātave ||

translations.english: They are the genitive rations of speech; they spread out the waters in their courses; they urge the lowing (cattle) to enter (the water) up to their knees (to drink).

mantras.sanskrit: त्यं चिद्घा दीर्घं पृथुं मिहो नपातममृध्रम् । प्र च्यावयन्ति यामभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tyaṃ cidghā dīrghaṃ pṛthuṃ miho napātamamṛdhram | pra cyāvayanti yāmabhiḥ ||

translations.english: They drive before them in their course, the long, vast, uninjurable, rain-retaining cloud.

mantras.sanskrit: मरुतो यद्ध वो बलं जनाँ अचुच्यवीतन । गिरीँरचुच्यवीतन ॥
mantras.transliteration: maruto yaddha vo balaṃ janā~ acucyavītana | girī~racucyavītana ||

translations.english: Maruts, as you have vigour, invogorate mankind; give animation to the clouds.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्ध यान्ति मरुतः सं ह ब्रुवतेऽध्वन्ना । शृणोति कश्चिदेषाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaddha yānti marutaḥ saṃ ha bruvate'dhvannā | śṛṇoti kaścideṣām ||

translations.english: Wherever the Maruts pass, they fill the way with clamour; every one hears their (noise).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र यात शीभमाशुभिः सन्ति कण्वेषु वो दुवः । तत्रो षु मादयाध्वै ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra yāta śībhamāśubhiḥ santi kaṇveṣu vo duvaḥ | tatro ṣu mādayādhvai ||

translations.english: Come quickly, with your swift (vehicles); the offerings of the kaṇvas are prepared; be plural ased with them.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्ति हि ष्मा मदाय वः स्मसि ष्मा वयमेषाम् । विश्वं चिदायुर्जीवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: asti hi ṣmā madāya vaḥ smasi ṣmā vayameṣām | viśvaṃ cidāyurjīvase ||

translations.english: The offering is prepared for your gratification; we are your (worshipper), that we may live all our life.

mantras.sanskrit: कद्ध नूनं कधप्रियः पिता पुत्रं न हस्तयोः । दधिध्वे वृक्तबर्हिषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kaddha nūnaṃ kadhapriyaḥ pitā putraṃ na hastayoḥ | dadhidhve vṛktabarhiṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Maruts, who are fond of praise, and for whom the sacred grass is trimmed, when will you take us by both hands as a father does his son?

mantras.sanskrit: क्व नूनं कद्वो अर्थं गन्ता दिवो न पृथिव्याः । क्व वो गावो न रण्यन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: kva nūnaṃ kadvo arthaṃ gantā divo na pṛthivyāḥ | kva vo gāvo na raṇyanti ||

translations.english: Where indeed are you (at present)? When will your arrival take plural ce? Pass from the heaven, not from the earth. Where do they worship you cry (to you) like cattle?

mantras.sanskrit: क्व वः सुम्ना नव्यांसि मरुतः क्व सुविता । क्वो विश्वानि सौभगा ॥
mantras.transliteration: kva vaḥ sumnā navyāṃsi marutaḥ kva suvitā | kvo viśvāni saubhagā ||

translations.english: Where, Maruts, are your new treasures? Where your valuable (riches)? Where all your auspicious (gifts)?

mantras.sanskrit: यद्यूयं पृश्निमातरो मर्तासः स्यातन । स्तोता वो अमृतः स्यात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadyūyaṃ pṛśnimātaro martāsaḥ syātana | stotā vo amṛtaḥ syāt ||

translations.english: That you, sons of Pṛśni, may become mortals, and your panegyrist become immortal.

mantras.sanskrit: मा वो मृगो न यवसे जरिता भूदजोष्यः । पथा यमस्य गादुप ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā vo mṛgo na yavase jaritā bhūdajoṣyaḥ | pathā yamasya gādupa ||

translations.english: Never may your worshipper be indifferent to you, as a deer (is never indifferent) to pasture, so that he may not tread the path of Yama.

mantras.sanskrit: मो षु णः परापरा निॠतिर्दुर्हणा वधीत् । पदीष्ट तृष्णया सह ॥
mantras.transliteration: mo ṣu ṇaḥ parāparā niṝtirdurhaṇā vadhīt | padīṣṭa tṛṣṇayā saha ||

translations.english: Let not the most powerful and indestructible Nirṛti destroy us; let him perish with our (evil) desires.

mantras.sanskrit: सत्यं त्वेषा अमवन्तो धन्वञ्चिदा रुद्रियासः । मिहं कृण्वन्त्यवाताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: satyaṃ tveṣā amavanto dhanvañcidā rudriyāsaḥ | mihaṃ kṛṇvantyavātām ||

translations.english: In truth the brilliant and vigorous Maruts, cherishes by Rudra, send down rain without wind upon the desert.

mantras.sanskrit: वाश्रेव विद्युन्मिमाति वत्सं न माता सिषक्ति । यदेषां वृष्टिरसर्जि ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāśreva vidyunmimāti vatsaṃ na mātā siṣakti | yadeṣāṃ vṛṣṭirasarji ||

translations.english: The lightning roars like a parent cow that bellows for its calf, and hence the rain is set free by the Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवा चित्तमः कृण्वन्ति पर्जन्येनोदवाहेन । यत्पृथिवीं व्युन्दन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: divā cittamaḥ kṛṇvanti parjanyenodavāhena | yatpṛthivīṃ vyundanti ||

translations.english: They spread darkness over the day by a water-bearing cloud, and thence inundate the earth.

mantras.sanskrit: अध स्वनान्मरुतां विश्वमा सद्म पार्थिवम् । अरेजन्त प्र मानुषाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha svanānmarutāṃ viśvamā sadma pārthivam | arejanta pra mānuṣāḥ ||

translations.english: At the roaring of the Maruts, every dwelling of earth (shakes), and men also tremble.

mantras.sanskrit: मरुतो वीळुपाणिभिश्चित्रा रोधस्वतीरनु । यातेमखिद्रयामभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: maruto vīḷupāṇibhiścitrā rodhasvatīranu | yātemakhidrayāmabhiḥ ||

translations.english: Maruts, with strong hands, come along the beautifully-embanked rivers, with obstructed progress.

mantras.sanskrit: स्थिरा वः सन्तु नेमयो रथा अश्वास एषाम् । सुसंस्कृता अभीशवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sthirā vaḥ santu nemayo rathā aśvāsa eṣām | susaṃskṛtā abhīśavaḥ ||

translations.english: May the felloes of your wheels be firm; may your cars and their steeds be steady, and your fingers well-skilled (to hold the reins).

mantras.sanskrit: अच्छा वदा तना गिरा जरायै ब्रह्मणस्पतिम् । अग्निं मित्रं न दर्शतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: acchā vadā tanā girā jarāyai brahmaṇaspatim | agniṃ mitraṃ na darśatam ||

translations.english: Declare in our presence, (priests), with voice attuned to praise Brahmaṇaspati (lord of the sacriricial food), Agni and the beautiful Mitra.

mantras.sanskrit: मिमीहि श्लोकमास्ये पर्जन्य इव ततनः । गाय गायत्रमुक्थ्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mimīhi ślokamāsye parjanya iva tatanaḥ | gāya gāyatramukthyam ||

translations.english: Utter the verse that is in your mouths, spread it out like a cloud spreading rain; chant the measured hymn.

mantras.sanskrit: वन्दस्व मारुतं गणं त्वेषं पनस्युमर्किणम् । अस्मे वृद्धा असन्निह ॥
mantras.transliteration: vandasva mārutaṃ gaṇaṃ tveṣaṃ panasyumarkiṇam | asme vṛddhā asanniha ||

translations.english: Glorify the host of Maruts, brilliant, deserving of praise, entitled to adoration; may they be exalted by this our worship.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र यदित्था परावतः शोचिर्न मानमस्यथ । कस्य क्रत्वा मरुतः कस्य वर्पसा कं याथ कं ह धूतयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra yaditthā parāvataḥ śocirna mānamasyatha | kasya kratvā marutaḥ kasya varpasā kaṃ yātha kaṃ ha dhūtayaḥ ||

translations.english: When Maruts, who make (all things) tremble, you direct your awful (vigour) downwards from afar, as light (descends from heaven), by whose worship by whose praise (are you attracted)? to what (plural ce of sacrifice), to whom, indeed, do you repair?

mantras.sanskrit: स्थिरा वः सन्त्वायुधा पराणुदे वीळू उत प्रतिष्कभे । युष्माकमस्तु तविषी पनीयसी मा मर्त्यस्य मायिनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sthirā vaḥ santvāyudhā parāṇude vīḷū uta pratiṣkabhe | yuṣmākamastu taviṣī panīyasī mā martyasya māyinaḥ ||

translations.english: Strong be your weapons for driving away (your) foes, firm in resisting them; yours be the strength that merits praise, not (the strength) of a treacherous mortal.

mantras.sanskrit: परा ह यत्स्थिरं हथ नरो वर्तयथा गुरु । वि याथन वनिनः पृथिव्या व्याशाः पर्वतानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: parā ha yatsthiraṃ hatha naro vartayathā guru | vi yāthana vaninaḥ pṛthivyā vyāśāḥ parvatānām ||

translations.english: Directing Maruts, when you demolish what is stable, when you scatter what is ponderous, then you make your way through the forest (trees) of earth and the defiles of the mountains.

mantras.sanskrit: नहि वः शत्रुर्विविदे अधि द्यवि न भूम्यां रिशादसः । युष्माकमस्तु तविषी तना युजा रुद्रासो नू चिदाधृषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahi vaḥ śatrurvivide adhi dyavi na bhūmyāṃ riśādasaḥ | yuṣmākamastu taviṣī tanā yujā rudrāso nū cidādhṛṣe ||

translations.english: Destroyers of foes, no adversary of yours is known above the heavens, nor (is any) upon earth; may your collective strength be quickly exerted, sons of Rudra, to humble (your enemies).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वेपयन्ति पर्वतान्वि विञ्चन्ति वनस्पतीन् । प्रो आरत मरुतो दुर्मदा इव देवासः सर्वया विशा ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vepayanti parvatānvi viñcanti vanaspatīn | pro ārata maruto durmadā iva devāsaḥ sarvayā viśā ||

translations.english: They make the mountains tremble, they drive apart the forest-trees. Go, divine Maruts, whither you will, with all your progeny, like those intoxicated.

mantras.sanskrit: उपो रथेषु पृषतीरयुग्ध्वं प्रष्टिर्वहति रोहितः । आ वो यामाय पृथिवी चिदश्रोदबीभयन्त मानुषाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: upo ratheṣu pṛṣatīrayugdhvaṃ praṣṭirvahati rohitaḥ | ā vo yāmāya pṛthivī cidaśrodabībhayanta mānuṣāḥ ||

translations.english: You have harnessed the spotted deer to your chariot; the red deer yoked between them, (aids to) drag the car; the firmament listens for your coming, and men are alarmed.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वो मक्षू तनाय कं रुद्रा अवो वृणीमहे । गन्ता नूनं नोऽवसा यथा पुरेत्था कण्वाय बिभ्युषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vo makṣū tanāya kaṃ rudrā avo vṛṇīmahe | gantā nūnaṃ no'vasā yathā puretthā kaṇvāya bibhyuṣe ||

translations.english: Rudras, we have recourse to your assistance for the sake of our progeny; come quickly to the timid Kaṇva, as you formerly came, for our protection.

mantras.sanskrit: युष्मेषितो मरुतो मर्त्येषित आ यो नो अभ्व ईषते । वि तं युयोत शवसा व्योजसा वि युष्माकाभिरूतिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuṣmeṣito maruto martyeṣita ā yo no abhva īṣate | vi taṃ yuyota śavasā vyojasā vi yuṣmākābhirūtibhiḥ ||

translations.english: Should any adversary, instrumental gated by you, or by man, assail us, withhold from him food and strength and your assistance.

mantras.sanskrit: असामि हि प्रयज्यवः कण्वं दद प्रचेतसः । असामिभिर्मरुत आ न ऊतिभिर्गन्ता वृष्टिं न विद्युतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asāmi hi prayajyavaḥ kaṇvaṃ dada pracetasaḥ | asāmibhirmaruta ā na ūtibhirgantā vṛṣṭiṃ na vidyutaḥ ||

translations.english: Pracetasas, who are to be unreservedly worshipped, uphold (the sacrificer) Kaṇva; come to us, Maruts, with undivided protective assistance, as the lightning (bring) the rain.

mantras.sanskrit: असाम्योजो बिभृथा सुदानवोऽसामि धूतयः शवः । ऋषिद्विषे मरुतः परिमन्यव इषुं न सृजत द्विषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asāmyojo bibhṛthā sudānavo'sāmi dhūtayaḥ śavaḥ | ṛṣidviṣe marutaḥ parimanyava iṣuṃ na sṛjata dviṣam ||

translations.english: Bounteous givers, you enjoy unimpaired vigour; shakers (of the earth), you possess undiminished strength; Maruts, let loose your anger, like an arrow, upon the wrathful enemy of the ṛṣis.

mantras.sanskrit: उत्तिष्ठ ब्रह्मणस्पते देवयन्तस्त्वेमहे । उप प्र यन्तु मरुतः सुदानव इन्द्र प्राशूर्भवा सचा ॥
mantras.transliteration: uttiṣṭha brahmaṇaspate devayantastvemahe | upa pra yantu marutaḥ sudānava indra prāśūrbhavā sacā ||

translations.english: Rise us, Brhmaṇaspati; devoted to the gods, we solicit you, bounteous Maruts, be nigh at hand; Indra, be a partaker fo the libation.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामिद्धि सहसस्पुत्र मर्त्य उपब्रूते धने हिते । सुवीर्यं मरुत आ स्वश्व्यं दधीत यो व आचके ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmiddhi sahasasputra martya upabrūte dhane hite | suvīryaṃ maruta ā svaśvyaṃ dadhīta yo va ācake ||

translations.english: Man celebrates you, son of strength, for the wealth abandoned (by the foe). Maruts, may be who praises you obtain wealth, yielding excellent steeds and eminent vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रैतु ब्रह्मणस्पतिः प्र देव्येतु सूनृता । अच्छा वीरं नर्यं पङ्क्तिराधसं देवा यज्ञं नयन्तु नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: praitu brahmaṇaspatiḥ pra devyetu sūnṛtā | acchā vīraṃ naryaṃ paṅktirādhasaṃ devā yajñaṃ nayantu naḥ ||

translations.english: May Brahmaṇaspati approach us;  may the goddess, speaker of truth, approach us; may the gods (drive away) every adversary, and present, conduct us to the sacrifice which is beneficial to man, and (abounds) with respectably-presented offerings.

mantras.sanskrit: यो वाघते ददाति सूनरं वसु स धत्ते अक्षिति श्रवः । तस्मा इळां सुवीरामा यजामहे सुप्रतूर्तिमनेहसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo vāghate dadāti sūnaraṃ vasu sa dhatte akṣiti śravaḥ | tasmā iḷāṃ suvīrāmā yajāmahe supratūrtimanehasam ||

translations.english: He who presents to the ministrant (priest) wealth fit to be accepted, enjoys inexhaustible abundance; for him we worship, Iḷā, attended by brave warriors, inflicting much injury, receiving none.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र नूनं ब्रह्मणस्पतिर्मन्त्रं वदत्युक्थ्यम् । यस्मिन्निन्द्रो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा देवा ओकांसि चक्रिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra nūnaṃ brahmaṇaspatirmantraṃ vadatyukthyam | yasminnindro varuṇo mitro aryamā devā okāṃsi cakrire ||

translations.english: Verily Brahmaṇaspati proclaims the sacred prayer, in which the divinities, Indra, Varuṇa, Mitra and Aryaman, have made their abode.

mantras.sanskrit: तमिद्वोचेमा विदथेषु शम्भुवं मन्त्रं देवा अनेहसम् । इमां च वाचं प्रतिहर्यथा नरो विश्वेद्वामा वो अश्नवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamidvocemā vidatheṣu śambhuvaṃ mantraṃ devā anehasam | imāṃ ca vācaṃ pratiharyathā naro viśvedvāmā vo aśnavat ||

translations.english: Let us recite, gods, that felicitous and faultless prayer at sacrifices; if you, leaders, desire (to hear) this prayer, then will all that is to be spoken reach unto you.

mantras.sanskrit: को देवयन्तमश्नवज्जनं को वृक्तबर्हिषम् । प्रप्र दाश्वान्पस्त्याभिरस्थितान्तर्वावत्क्षयं दधे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ko devayantamaśnavajjanaṃ ko vṛktabarhiṣam | prapra dāśvānpastyābhirasthitāntarvāvatkṣayaṃ dadhe ||

translations.english: Who, (except Brahmaṇaspati), may approach the man who is devoted to the gods, by whom the clipped sacred grass is spread; the giver of the oblation has proceeded with the priests (to the hall of sacrifice), for he has a dwelling (abounding) internally with precious things.

mantras.sanskrit: उप क्षत्रं पृञ्चीत हन्ति राजभिर्भये चित्सुक्षितिं दधे । नास्य वर्ता न तरुता महाधने नार्भे अस्ति वज्रिणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa kṣatraṃ pṛñcīta hanti rājabhirbhaye citsukṣitiṃ dadhe | nāsya vartā na tarutā mahādhane nārbhe asti vajriṇaḥ ||

translations.english: Let Brahmaṇaspati concentrate his strength associated with the regal (divinities), he slays (the foe); in the time of danger he maintains his station; armed with the thunderbolt, there is no encourager nor discourager of him in a great battle or a small.

mantras.sanskrit: यं रक्षन्ति प्रचेतसो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । नू चित्स दभ्यते जनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ rakṣanti pracetaso varuṇo mitro aryamā | nū citsa dabhyate janaḥ ||

translations.english: The man whom the wise Varuṇa, Mitra and Aryaman protect quickly subdues (his foes).

mantras.sanskrit: यं बाहुतेव पिप्रति पान्ति मर्त्यं रिषः । अरिष्टः सर्व एधते ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ bāhuteva piprati pānti martyaṃ riṣaḥ | ariṣṭaḥ sarva edhate ||

translations.english: Hw whom they heap (with riches), as if (collected) by his own arms; the man whom they defend from the malignant; every such man, safe from injury, prospers.

mantras.sanskrit: वि दुर्गा वि द्विषः पुरो घ्नन्ति राजान एषाम् । नयन्ति दुरिता तिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi durgā vi dviṣaḥ puro ghnanti rājāna eṣām | nayanti duritā tiraḥ ||

translations.english: The kings (Varuṇa etc.) first destroy their strongholds, and then the foes of those (who worship him), and put aside their evil deeds.

mantras.sanskrit: सुगः पन्था अनृक्षर आदित्यास ऋतं यते । नात्रावखादो अस्ति वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sugaḥ panthā anṛkṣara ādityāsa ṛtaṃ yate | nātrāvakhādo asti vaḥ ||

translations.english: Ādityas, to you repairing to the sacrifice, the path is easy and free from thorns; no unworthy oblation is here prepared for you.

mantras.sanskrit: यं यज्ञं नयथा नर आदित्या ऋजुना पथा । प्र वः स धीतये नशत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ yajñaṃ nayathā nara ādityā ṛjunā pathā | pra vaḥ sa dhītaye naśat ||

translations.english: Ādityas, guides, may the sacrifice which you come to by a straight path, be to you for your gratification.

mantras.sanskrit: स रत्नं मर्त्यो वसु विश्वं तोकमुत त्मना । अच्छा गच्छत्यस्तृतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa ratnaṃ martyo vasu viśvaṃ tokamuta tmanā | acchā gacchatyastṛtaḥ ||

translations.english: That mortal (whom you favour), exempt from harm, obtains all valuable wealth, and offspring like himself.

mantras.sanskrit: कथा राधाम सखायः स्तोमं मित्रस्यार्यम्णः । महि प्सरो वरुणस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: kathā rādhāma sakhāyaḥ stomaṃ mitrasyāryamṇaḥ | mahi psaro varuṇasya ||

translations.english: How, my friends, shall we recite priase (worthy) of the great glory of Mitra, Varuṇa and Aryaman?

mantras.sanskrit: मा वो घ्नन्तं मा शपन्तं प्रति वोचे देवयन्तम् । सुम्नैरिद्व आ विवासे ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā vo ghnantaṃ mā śapantaṃ prati voce devayantam | sumnairidva ā vivāse ||

translations.english: I do not denounce to you him who assails or reviles the man devoted to the gods. I rather propitiate you with offered wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: चतुरश्चिद्ददमानाद्बिभीयादा निधातोः । न दुरुक्ताय स्पृहयेत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: caturaściddadamānādbibhīyādā nidhātoḥ | na duruktāya spṛhayet ||

translations.english: For he (the worshipper) loves not, but fears to speak evil (of any one), as a gamester fears (his adversary) holding the four (dice), until they are thrown.

mantras.sanskrit: सं पूषन्नध्वनस्तिर व्यंहो विमुचो नपात् । सक्ष्वा देव प्र णस्पुरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ pūṣannadhvanastira vyaṃho vimuco napāt | sakṣvā deva pra ṇaspuraḥ ||

translations.english: Pūṣanm convey us over the road, remove the wicked (obsructer of the way). Son of the cloud, deity, go before us.

mantras.sanskrit: यो नः पूषन्नघो वृको दुःशेव आदिदेशति । अप स्म तं पथो जहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo naḥ pūṣannagho vṛko duḥśeva ādideśati | apa sma taṃ patho jahi ||

translations.english: If a wicked (adversary), Pūṣan, a robber, or one who delights in evil, points out to us (the way we ought not to go), do you drive him from the road.

mantras.sanskrit: अप त्यं परिपन्थिनं मुषीवाणं हुरश्चितम् । दूरमधि स्रुतेरज ॥
mantras.transliteration: apa tyaṃ paripanthinaṃ muṣīvāṇaṃ huraścitam | dūramadhi sruteraja ||

translations.english: Drive him far away, apart fom the road, the hinderer of our journey, a thief, a deceiver.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं तस्य द्वयाविनोऽघशंसस्य कस्य चित् । पदाभि तिष्ठ तपुषिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ tasya dvayāvino'ghaśaṃsasya kasya cit | padābhi tiṣṭha tapuṣim ||

translations.english: Trample with your feet upon the mischievous (body) of that evil-minded pilferer of both (what is present and what is absent), whoever he be.

mantras.sanskrit: आ तत्ते दस्र मन्तुमः पूषन्नवो वृणीमहे । येन पितॄनचोदयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tatte dasra mantumaḥ pūṣannavo vṛṇīmahe | yena pitṝnacodayaḥ ||

translations.english: Sagacious and handsome Pūṣan, we solicit of you that protection wherewith you have encouraged the patriarchs.

mantras.sanskrit: अधा नो विश्वसौभग हिरण्यवाशीमत्तम । धनानि सुषणा कृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhā no viśvasaubhaga hiraṇyavāśīmattama | dhanāni suṣaṇā kṛdhi ||

translations.english: Therefore do you, who are possessed of all prosperity and well-equipped with golden weapons, bestow upon us riches that may be liberally distributed.

mantras.sanskrit: अति नः सश्चतो नय सुगा नः सुपथा कृणु । पूषन्निह क्रतुं विदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ati naḥ saścato naya sugā naḥ supathā kṛṇu | pūṣanniha kratuṃ vidaḥ ||

translations.english: Lead us past our opponents; conduct us by an easy path; know, Pūṣan, how to protect us on this (journey).

mantras.sanskrit: अभि सूयवसं नय न नवज्वारो अध्वने । पूषन्निह क्रतुं विदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi sūyavasaṃ naya na navajvāro adhvane | pūṣanniha kratuṃ vidaḥ ||

translations.english: Lead us where there is abundant fodder; let there be no extreme heat by the way; Pūṣan, know to protect us on this (journey).

mantras.sanskrit: शग्धि पूर्धि प्र यंसि च शिशीहि प्रास्युदरम् । पूषन्निह क्रतुं विदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śagdhi pūrdhi pra yaṃsi ca śiśīhi prāsyudaram | pūṣanniha kratuṃ vidaḥ ||

translations.english: Be favourable to us, fill us (with abundance), give us (all goood things), sharpen us (with vigour), fill our bellies, Pūṣan, know how to protect us on this (journey).

mantras.sanskrit: न पूषणं मेथामसि सूक्तैरभि गृणीमसि । वसूनि दस्ममीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: na pūṣaṇaṃ methāmasi sūktairabhi gṛṇīmasi | vasūni dasmamīmahe ||

translations.english: We do not censure Pūṣan, but praise him with hymns; we solicit the good-looking (Pūṣan) for riches.

mantras.sanskrit: कद्रुद्राय प्रचेतसे मीळ्हुष्टमाय तव्यसे । वोचेम शंतमं हृदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: kadrudrāya pracetase mīḷhuṣṭamāya tavyase | vocema śaṃtamaṃ hṛde ||

translations.english: When may we repeat a most grateful hymn to the wise, the most bountiful and mighty Rudra, who is (cherished) in our hearts?

mantras.sanskrit: यथा नो अदितिः करत्पश्वे नृभ्यो यथा गवे । यथा तोकाय रुद्रियम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathā no aditiḥ karatpaśve nṛbhyo yathā gave | yathā tokāya rudriyam ||

translations.english: By which earth may (be induced to) grant the gifts of Rudra to our cattle, our people, our cows, and our progeny.

mantras.sanskrit: यथा नो मित्रो वरुणो यथा रुद्रश्चिकेतति । यथा विश्वे सजोषसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathā no mitro varuṇo yathā rudraściketati | yathā viśve sajoṣasaḥ ||

translations.english: By which Mitra and Varuṇa, and Rudra and all the gods, being gratified, may show us (favour).

mantras.sanskrit: गाथपतिं मेधपतिं रुद्रं जलाषभेषजम् । तच्छंयोः सुम्नमीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: gāthapatiṃ medhapatiṃ rudraṃ jalāṣabheṣajam | tacchaṃyoḥ sumnamīmahe ||

translations.english: We ask the felicity of Śaṃyu, from Rudra, the encourager of hymns, the protector of sacrifices, possessed of medicaments that confer delight.

mantras.sanskrit: यः शुक्र इव सूर्यो हिरण्यमिव रोचते । श्रेष्ठो देवानां वसुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ śukra iva sūryo hiraṇyamiva rocate | śreṣṭho devānāṃ vasuḥ ||

translations.english: Who is so brilliant as Śaṃyu, who gratifies like gold, the best of the gods, the provider of habitations?

mantras.sanskrit: शं नः करत्यर्वते सुगं मेषाय मेष्ये । नृभ्यो नारिभ्यो गवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaṃ naḥ karatyarvate sugaṃ meṣāya meṣye | nṛbhyo nāribhyo gave ||

translations.english: Who bestows easily-obtained happiness on our steeds, our rams, our ewes, our men, our women, and our cows?

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मे सोम श्रियमधि नि धेहि शतस्य नृणाम् । महि श्रवस्तुविनृम्णम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asme soma śriyamadhi ni dhehi śatasya nṛṇām | mahi śravastuvinṛmṇam ||

translations.english: Soma, grant us prosperity more than (sufficient for) a hundred men, and much strength-engendering food.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नः सोमपरिबाधो मारातयो जुहुरन्त । आ न इन्दो वाजे भज ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā naḥ somaparibādho mārātayo juhuranta | ā na indo vāje bhaja ||

translations.english: Let not the adversaries of Soma, let not our enemies, harm us; cherish us, Indra, with (abundant) food.

mantras.sanskrit: यास्ते प्रजा अमृतस्य परस्मिन्धामन्नृतस्य । मूर्धा नाभा सोम वेन आभूषन्तीः सोम वेदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yāste prajā amṛtasya parasmindhāmannṛtasya | mūrdhā nābhā soma vena ābhūṣantīḥ soma vedaḥ ||

translations.english: Soma, who are immortal, and abide in an excellent dwelling, have regard for your subjects, when at their head in the hall of sacrifice you observe them (engaed in) decorating you.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने विवस्वदुषसश्चित्रं राधो अमर्त्य । आ दाशुषे जातवेदो वहा त्वमद्या देवाँ उषर्बुधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne vivasvaduṣasaścitraṃ rādho amartya | ā dāśuṣe jātavedo vahā tvamadyā devā~ uṣarbudhaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, who are immortal, and cognisant of all begotten things, bring from the dawn to the donor (of the oblation) wealth of many sorts, with an excellent habitation; bring hither today the gods awaking with the morning.

mantras.sanskrit: जुष्टो हि दूतो असि हव्यवाहनोऽग्ने रथीरध्वराणाम् । सजूरश्विभ्यामुषसा सुवीर्यमस्मे धेहि श्रवो बृहत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: juṣṭo hi dūto asi havyavāhano'gne rathīradhvarāṇām | sajūraśvibhyāmuṣasā suvīryamasme dhehi śravo bṛhat ||

translations.english: For you, Agni, are the accepted messenger of the gods, the bearer of oblations, the vehicle of sacrifices; associated with Uṣas and the Aśvins, bestow upon us abundant and invigorating food.

mantras.sanskrit: अद्या दूतं वृणीमहे वसुमग्निं पुरुप्रियम् । धूमकेतुं भाऋजीकं व्युष्टिषु यज्ञानामध्वरश्रियम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: adyā dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe vasumagniṃ purupriyam | dhūmaketuṃ bhāṛjīkaṃ vyuṣṭiṣu yajñānāmadhvaraśriyam ||

translations.english: We select today Agni, the messenger, the giver of dwellings, the beloved of many, the smoke-bannered, the light-shedding, the protector of the worship of the worshipper at the break of day.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रेष्ठं यविष्ठमतिथिं स्वाहुतं जुष्टं जनाय दाशुषे । देवाँ अच्छा यातवे जातवेदसमग्निमीळे व्युष्टिषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: śreṣṭhaṃ yaviṣṭhamatithiṃ svāhutaṃ juṣṭaṃ janāya dāśuṣe | devā~ acchā yātave jātavedasamagnimīḷe vyuṣṭiṣu ||

translations.english: I praise Agni at the break of day, the best and youngest (of the gods), the guest (of man), the universally-invoked, who is friendly to the man that offers (oblations), who knows all that are born, that he may go (to bring) the other divinities.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तविष्यामि त्वामहं विश्वस्यामृत भोजन । अग्ने त्रातारममृतं मियेध्य यजिष्ठं हव्यवाहन ॥
mantras.transliteration: staviṣyāmi tvāmahaṃ viśvasyāmṛta bhojana | agne trātāramamṛtaṃ miyedhya yajiṣṭhaṃ havyavāhana ||

translations.english: Agni, immortal sustainer of the universe, bearer of oblations, deserving of adoration, I will praise you, who are exempt from death, the preserver of the sacrificer.

mantras.sanskrit: सुशंसो बोधि गृणते यविष्ठ्य मधुजिह्वः स्वाहुतः । प्रस्कण्वस्य प्रतिरन्नायुर्जीवसे नमस्या दैव्यं जनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: suśaṃso bodhi gṛṇate yaviṣṭhya madhujihvaḥ svāhutaḥ | praskaṇvasya pratirannāyurjīvase namasyā daivyaṃ janam ||

translations.english: Juvenile Agni, whose flames delight, who ar euniversally invoked, and are praised (by us) on behalf of the worshipper, understand (our wishes), and granting Praskaṇva to live a lengthened life, do honour to the divine man.

mantras.sanskrit: होतारं विश्ववेदसं सं हि त्वा विश इन्धते । स आ वह पुरुहूत प्रचेतसोऽग्ने देवाँ इह द्रवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: hotāraṃ viśvavedasaṃ saṃ hi tvā viśa indhate | sa ā vaha puruhūta pracetaso'gne devā~ iha dravat ||

translations.english: All people kindle you, Agni, the sacrificer, the omniscient; do you, Agni, who are invoked by many, quickly bring hither the sapient deities.

mantras.sanskrit: सवितारमुषसमश्विना भगमग्निं व्युष्टिषु क्षपः । कण्वासस्त्वा सुतसोमास इन्धते हव्यवाहं स्वध्वर ॥
mantras.transliteration: savitāramuṣasamaśvinā bhagamagniṃ vyuṣṭiṣu kṣapaḥ | kaṇvāsastvā sutasomāsa indhate havyavāhaṃ svadhvara ||

translations.english: Object of holy rites, (bring hither) on the dawn following the night, Savitā, Uṣas and Aśvins, Bhaga and Agni; the Kaṇvas pouring out libations, kindle the water of the burnt offering.

mantras.sanskrit: पतिर्ह्यध्वराणामग्ने दूतो विशामसि । उषर्बुध आ वह सोमपीतये देवाँ अद्य स्वर्दृशः ॥
mantras.transliteration: patirhyadhvarāṇāmagne dūto viśāmasi | uṣarbudha ā vaha somapītaye devā~ adya svardṛśaḥ ||

translations.english: You, Agni, are the protector of the sacrifices of the people, and the messenger (of the gods); bring hither today the gods awaking at dawn, and contemplating the sun, to drink the Soma juice.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने पूर्वा अनूषसो विभावसो दीदेथ विश्वदर्शतः । असि ग्रामेष्वविता पुरोहितोऽसि यज्ञेषु मानुषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne pūrvā anūṣaso vibhāvaso dīdetha viśvadarśataḥ | asi grāmeṣvavitā purohito'si yajñeṣu mānuṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Resplendent Agni, visible to all, you have blazed after many preceding dawns, you are the protector (of people) in villages, you are the associate of man plural ced on the east (of the altar).

mantras.sanskrit: नि त्वा यज्ञस्य साधनमग्ने होतारमृत्विजम् । मनुष्वद्देव धीमहि प्रचेतसं जीरं दूतममर्त्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni tvā yajñasya sādhanamagne hotāramṛtvijam | manuṣvaddeva dhīmahi pracetasaṃ jīraṃ dūtamamartyam ||

translations.english: We plural ce you, Agni, as Manu plural ced you, who are the implement of sacrifice, the invoker, the ministering priest, very wise, the destroyer (of foes), immortal, the messenger (of the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: यद्देवानां मित्रमहः पुरोहितोऽन्तरो यासि दूत्यम् । सिन्धोरिव प्रस्वनितास ऊर्मयोऽग्नेर्भ्राजन्ते अर्चयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaddevānāṃ mitramahaḥ purohito'ntaro yāsi dūtyam | sindhoriva prasvanitāsa ūrmayo'gnerbhrājante arcayaḥ ||

translations.english: When, cherisher of friends, you are present as the Purohita at a sacrifice, and discharge the mission of the gods, then your flames roar like the resounding billows of the ocean.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रुधि श्रुत्कर्ण वह्निभिर्देवैरग्ने सयावभिः । आ सीदन्तु बर्हिषि मित्रो अर्यमा प्रातर्यावाणो अध्वरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śrudhi śrutkarṇa vahnibhirdevairagne sayāvabhiḥ | ā sīdantu barhiṣi mitro aryamā prātaryāvāṇo adhvaram ||

translations.english: Agni, with sharp ears, hear me; let Mitra and Aryaman, and Aryaman, and (other) early-stirring deities, with all the accompanying oblation-bearing gods, sit down at the sacrifice upon the sacred grass.

mantras.sanskrit: शृण्वन्तु स्तोमं मरुतः सुदानवोऽग्निजिह्वा ऋतावृधः । पिबतु सोमं वरुणो धृतव्रतोऽश्विभ्यामुषसा सजूः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śṛṇvantu stomaṃ marutaḥ sudānavo'gnijihvā ṛtāvṛdhaḥ | pibatu somaṃ varuṇo dhṛtavrato'śvibhyāmuṣasā sajūḥ ||

translations.english: Let the munificent Maruts, who have tongues of fire, and are encouragers of sacrifice, hear our praise; let the rite-fulfilling Varuṇa, with the Aśvins, and with Uṣas, drink the Soma juice.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने वसूँरिह रुद्राँ आदित्याँ उत । यजा स्वध्वरं जनं मनुजातं घृतप्रुषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne vasū~riha rudrā~ ādityā~ uta | yajā svadhvaraṃ janaṃ manujātaṃ ghṛtapruṣam ||

translations.english: Agni, do you, in this our rite, worship the Vasus, the Rudras, the Ādityas, or any other (living) being sprung from Manu, sacrificing well and sprinkling water.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रुष्टीवानो हि दाशुषे देवा अग्ने विचेतसः । तान्रोहिदश्व गिर्वणस्त्रयस्त्रिंशतमा वह ॥
mantras.transliteration: śruṣṭīvāno hi dāśuṣe devā agne vicetasaḥ | tānrohidaśva girvaṇastrayastriṃśatamā vaha ||

translations.english: Verily the discriminating gods are givers of rewards to the offerer (of oblations); lord of red coursers, propitiated by our praises, bring hither the three and thirty divinities.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रियमेधवदत्रिवज्जातवेदो विरूपवत् । अङ्गिरस्वन्महिव्रत प्रस्कण्वस्य श्रुधी हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: priyamedhavadatrivajjātavedo virūpavat | aṅgirasvanmahivrata praskaṇvasya śrudhī havam ||

translations.english: Agni, accomplisher of solemn acts, cognisant of all who are born, hear the invocation of praskaṇva, as you have heard those of Priyamedha of Atri, of Virūpa, of Aṅgiras.

mantras.sanskrit: महिकेरव ऊतये प्रियमेधा अहूषत । राजन्तमध्वराणामग्निं शुक्रेण शोचिषा ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahikerava ūtaye priyamedhā ahūṣata | rājantamadhvarāṇāmagniṃ śukreṇa śociṣā ||

translations.english: The performers of great ceremonies, the offerers of acceptable sacrifices, have invoked for (their protection), Agni, shining amidst the solemnities, with pure resplendence.

mantras.sanskrit: घृताहवन सन्त्येमा उ षु श्रुधी गिरः । याभिः कण्वस्य सूनवो हवन्तेऽवसे त्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ghṛtāhavana santyemā u ṣu śrudhī giraḥ | yābhiḥ kaṇvasya sūnavo havante'vase tvā ||

translations.english: Invoked by oblations, giver of rewards, listen to these praises with which the sons of Kaṇva invoke you for protection.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वां चित्रश्रवस्तम हवन्ते विक्षु जन्तवः । शोचिष्केशं पुरुप्रियाग्ने हव्याय वोळ्हवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāṃ citraśravastama havante vikṣu jantavaḥ | śociṣkeśaṃ purupriyāgne havyāya voḷhave ||

translations.english: Agni, granter of abundant sustenance, who are beloved of many, the sons of men invoke you, radiant-haired, to bear the oblation (to the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: नि त्वा होतारमृत्विजं दधिरे वसुवित्तमम् । श्रुत्कर्णं सप्रथस्तमं विप्रा अग्ने दिविष्टिषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni tvā hotāramṛtvijaṃ dadhire vasuvittamam | śrutkarṇaṃ saprathastamaṃ viprā agne diviṣṭiṣu ||

translations.english: The wise have plural ced you, Agni, in (their) sacrifices as the invoker, the ministrant priest, the donor of vast wealth, the quick-hearing the far-renowned.

mantras.sanskrit: आ त्वा विप्रा अचुच्यवुः सुतसोमा अभि प्रयः । बृहद्भा बिभ्रतो हविरग्ने मर्ताय दाशुषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tvā viprā acucyavuḥ sutasomā abhi prayaḥ | bṛhadbhā bibhrato haviragne martāya dāśuṣe ||

translations.english: The wise (priests), with effused libations of Soma juice, have summoned you, vast and brilliant Agni, to partake of the (sacrificial food) as they hold the oblation on the part of the individual who presents it.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रातर्याव्णः सहस्कृत सोमपेयाय सन्त्य । इहाद्य दैव्यं जनं बर्हिरा सादया वसो ॥
mantras.transliteration: prātaryāvṇaḥ sahaskṛta somapeyāya santya | ihādya daivyaṃ janaṃ barhirā sādayā vaso ||

translations.english: Strength-genitive rated, giver of rewards, provider of dwellings, plural ce here today upon the sacred grass the morning-moving deities, or (other) deified being, to drink the Soma juice.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्वाञ्चं दैव्यं जनमग्ने यक्ष्व सहूतिभिः । अयं सोमः सुदानवस्तं पात तिरोअह्न्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: arvāñcaṃ daivyaṃ janamagne yakṣva sahūtibhiḥ | ayaṃ somaḥ sudānavastaṃ pāta tiroahnyam ||

translations.english: Worship with conjoint invocations, Agni, the present deified being; bounteous divinities, this is the Soma juice; drink it, for it was yesterday expressed.

mantras.sanskrit: एषो उषा अपूर्व्या व्युच्छति प्रिया दिवः । स्तुषे वामश्विना बृहत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣo uṣā apūrvyā vyucchati priyā divaḥ | stuṣe vāmaśvinā bṛhat ||

translations.english: The beloved Uṣas, until now unseen, scatters darkness from the sky; Aśvins, I greatly praise you.

mantras.sanskrit: या दस्रा सिन्धुमातरा मनोतरा रयीणाम् । धिया देवा वसुविदा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā dasrā sindhumātarā manotarā rayīṇām | dhiyā devā vasuvidā ||

translations.english: Who are divine, of plural asing appearance, children of the sea, willing dispensers of wealth, and granters of dwellings (in recompense of) pious acts.

mantras.sanskrit: वच्यन्ते वां ककुहासो जूर्णायामधि विष्टपि । यद्वां रथो विभिष्पतात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vacyante vāṃ kakuhāso jūrṇāyāmadhi viṣṭapi | yadvāṃ ratho vibhiṣpatāt ||

translations.english: Since your chariot proceeds, (drawn) by your steeds, above the glorious heavens, your praises are proclaimed (by us).

mantras.sanskrit: हविषा जारो अपां पिपर्ति पपुरिर्नरा । पिता कुटस्य चर्षणिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: haviṣā jāro apāṃ piparti papurirnarā | pitā kuṭasya carṣaṇiḥ ||

translations.english: (Aśvins); guides; the sun, (the evaporator) of the waters, the nourisher, the protector and beholder of the (solemn) rite, nourishes (the gods) with our oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: आदारो वां मतीनां नासत्या मतवचसा । पातं सोमस्य धृष्णुया ॥
mantras.transliteration: ādāro vāṃ matīnāṃ nāsatyā matavacasā | pātaṃ somasya dhṛṣṇuyā ||

translations.english: Nāsatyas, accepting our praises, partake of the exhilarating Soma, the animator of your minds.

mantras.sanskrit: या नः पीपरदश्विना ज्योतिष्मती तमस्तिरः । तामस्मे रासाथामिषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā naḥ pīparadaśvinā jyotiṣmatī tamastiraḥ | tāmasme rāsāthāmiṣam ||

translations.english: Aśvins, grant us that invigorating food which may satisfy us, having dispelled the gloom (of want).

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो नावा मतीनां यातं पाराय गन्तवे । युञ्जाथामश्विना रथम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no nāvā matīnāṃ yātaṃ pārāya gantave | yuñjāthāmaśvinā ratham ||

translations.english: Come as a ship, to bear us over an ocean of praises; harness, Aśvins, your car.

mantras.sanskrit: अरित्रं वां दिवस्पृथु तीर्थे सिन्धूनां रथः । धिया युयुज्र इन्दवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aritraṃ vāṃ divaspṛthu tīrthe sindhūnāṃ rathaḥ | dhiyā yuyujra indavaḥ ||

translations.english: Your vessel, vaster than the sky, stops on the seashore; your chariot (waits on the land); the drops (of Soma) are expressed for yor worship.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवस्कण्वास इन्दवो वसु सिन्धूनां पदे । स्वं वव्रिं कुह धित्सथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: divaskaṇvāsa indavo vasu sindhūnāṃ pade | svaṃ vavriṃ kuha dhitsathaḥ ||

translations.english: Kaṇvas (ask this of the Aśvins); (How) do the rays (of the sun proceed) from the sky? (How) does the dawn (rise) in the region of the waters? Where do you desire to manifest your own person ns?

mantras.sanskrit: अभूदु भा उ अंशवे हिरण्यं प्रति सूर्यः । व्यख्यज्जिह्वयासितः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhūdu bhā u aṃśave hiraṇyaṃ prati sūryaḥ | vyakhyajjihvayāsitaḥ ||

translations.english: There was light to irradiate the dawn; the sun (rose) like god; the fire shone with darkened flames.

mantras.sanskrit: अभूदु पारमेतवे पन्था ऋतस्य साधुया । अदर्शि वि स्रुतिर्दिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhūdu pārametave panthā ṛtasya sādhuyā | adarśi vi srutirdivaḥ ||

translations.english: A fit path was made for the sun to go beyond the boundary (of night); the radiance of the luminary became visible.

mantras.sanskrit: तत्तदिदश्विनोरवो जरिता प्रति भूषति । मदे सोमस्य पिप्रतोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tattadidaśvinoravo jaritā prati bhūṣati | made somasya pipratoḥ ||

translations.english: The worshipper acknowledges whatever boon he receives from the Aśvins, satiate with the enjoyment of Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: वावसाना विवस्वति सोमस्य पीत्या गिरा । मनुष्वच्छम्भू आ गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāvasānā vivasvati somasya pītyā girā | manuṣvacchambhū ā gatam ||

translations.english: Causers of felicity, co-dwellers with your worshipper, as with Manu come hither to drink of Soma, and (accept) our praise.

mantras.sanskrit: युवोरुषा अनु श्रियं परिज्मनोरुपाचरत् । ऋता वनथो अक्तुभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvoruṣā anu śriyaṃ parijmanorupācarat | ṛtā vanatho aktubhiḥ ||

translations.english: May Uṣas follow the lustre of your approach, circumambient Aśvins, and may you be plural ased with the oblations offered by night.

mantras.sanskrit: उभा पिबतमश्विनोभा नः शर्म यच्छतम् । अविद्रियाभिरूतिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ubhā pibatamaśvinobhā naḥ śarma yacchatam | avidriyābhirūtibhiḥ ||

translations.english: Aśvins, may you both drink (the oblation), and bestow upon us happiness, through your irreproachable protection.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं वां मधुमत्तमः सुतः सोम ऋतावृधा । तमश्विना पिबतं तिरोअह्न्यं धत्तं रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ vāṃ madhumattamaḥ sutaḥ soma ṛtāvṛdhā | tamaśvinā pibataṃ tiroahnyaṃ dhattaṃ ratnāni dāśuṣe ||

translations.english: Aśvins, encouragers of sacrifice, this most sweet Soma is prepared for you; drink it of yesterday's expressing, and grant riches to the donor.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिवन्धुरेण त्रिवृता सुपेशसा रथेना यातमश्विना । कण्वासो वां ब्रह्म कृण्वन्त्यध्वरे तेषां सु शृणुतं हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: trivandhureṇa trivṛtā supeśasā rathenā yātamaśvinā | kaṇvāso vāṃ brahma kṛṇvantyadhvare teṣāṃ su śṛṇutaṃ havam ||

translations.english: Come, Aśvins, with your three-columned triangular car; the Kaṇvas repeat your praise at the sacrifice; graciously hear their invocation.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्विना मधुमत्तमं पातं सोममृतावृधा । अथाद्य दस्रा वसु बिभ्रता रथे दाश्वांसमुप गच्छतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvinā madhumattamaṃ pātaṃ somamṛtāvṛdhā | athādya dasrā vasu bibhratā rathe dāśvāṃsamupa gacchatam ||

translations.english: Aśvins, encouragers of sacrifice, drink this most sweet Soma; approach today the giver of the offering, you who are of plural asing aspects and bearers of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिषधस्थे बर्हिषि विश्ववेदसा मध्वा यज्ञं मिमिक्षतम् । कण्वासो वां सुतसोमा अभिद्यवो युवां हवन्ते अश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: triṣadhasthe barhiṣi viśvavedasā madhvā yajñaṃ mimikṣatam | kaṇvāso vāṃ sutasomā abhidyavo yuvāṃ havante aśvinā ||

translations.english: Omniscient Aśvins, stationed on the thrice-heaped sacred grass, sprinkle the sacrifice with the sweet juice; the illustrious Kaṇvas, with effused libations, invoke you.

mantras.sanskrit: याभिः कण्वमभिष्टिभिः प्रावतं युवमश्विना । ताभिः ष्वस्माँ अवतं शुभस्पती पातं सोममृतावृधा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yābhiḥ kaṇvamabhiṣṭibhiḥ prāvataṃ yuvamaśvinā | tābhiḥ ṣvasmā~ avataṃ śubhaspatī pātaṃ somamṛtāvṛdhā ||

translations.english: With such desired aids as you protected Kaṇva with, do you, cherish of pious acts, preserve us; encouragers of sacrifice, drink the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: सुदासे दस्रा वसु बिभ्रता रथे पृक्षो वहतमश्विना । रयिं समुद्रादुत वा दिवस्पर्यस्मे धत्तं पुरुस्पृहम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sudāse dasrā vasu bibhratā rathe pṛkṣo vahatamaśvinā | rayiṃ samudrāduta vā divasparyasme dhattaṃ puruspṛham ||

translations.english: Good-looking Aśvins, as you brought in your car, bearers of wealth, abundance to Sudās, so bring to us in the riches that many covet, whether from the firmament or the sky beyond.

mantras.sanskrit: यन्नासत्या परावति यद्वा स्थो अधि तुर्वशे । अतो रथेन सुवृता न आ गतं साकं सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yannāsatyā parāvati yadvā stho adhi turvaśe | ato rathena suvṛtā na ā gataṃ sākaṃ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ ||

translations.english: Nāsatyas, whether you abide far off or close at hand, come to us in your well-constructed car, with the rays of the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्वाञ्चा वां सप्तयोऽध्वरश्रियो वहन्तु सवनेदुप । इषं पृञ्चन्ता सुकृते सुदानव आ बर्हिः सीदतं नरा ॥
mantras.transliteration: arvāñcā vāṃ saptayo'dhvaraśriyo vahantu savanedupa | iṣaṃ pṛñcantā sukṛte sudānava ā barhiḥ sīdataṃ narā ||

translations.english: Let your coursers, the grace of the sacrifice, bring you to be present at our rite; guides (of men) bestowing food upon the pious and liberal donor (of the offering), sit down on the sacred grass.

mantras.sanskrit: तेन नासत्या गतं रथेन सूर्यत्वचा । येन शश्वदूहथुर्दाशुषे वसु मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: tena nāsatyā gataṃ rathena sūryatvacā | yena śaśvadūhathurdāśuṣe vasu madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||

translations.english: Come, Nāsatyas, with your sun-clad chariot, in which you have ever conveyed wealth to the donor (of the offering), to drink of the sweet Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: उक्थेभिरर्वागवसे पुरूवसू अर्कैश्च नि ह्वयामहे । शश्वत्कण्वानां सदसि प्रिये हि कं सोमं पपथुरश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: ukthebhirarvāgavase purūvasū arkaiśca ni hvayāmahe | śaśvatkaṇvānāṃ sadasi priye hi kaṃ somaṃ papathuraśvinā ||

translations.english: We invoke with chanted and recited hymns, the very affluent Aśvins, to be present for our protection. Have you not ever drunk the Soma in the favoured dwelling of the Kaṇvas?

mantras.sanskrit: सह वामेन न उषो व्युच्छा दुहितर्दिवः । सह द्युम्नेन बृहता विभावरि राया देवि दास्वती ॥
mantras.transliteration: saha vāmena na uṣo vyucchā duhitardivaḥ | saha dyumnena bṛhatā vibhāvari rāyā devi dāsvatī ||

translations.english: Uṣas, daughter of heaven, dawn upon us with riches; diffuser of light, dawn upon us with abundant food; bountiful goddess, dawn upon with wealth (of cattle).

mantras.sanskrit: अश्वावतीर्गोमतीर्विश्वसुविदो भूरि च्यवन्त वस्तवे । उदीरय प्रति मा सूनृता उषश्चोद राधो मघोनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvāvatīrgomatīrviśvasuvido bhūri cyavanta vastave | udīraya prati mā sūnṛtā uṣaścoda rādho maghonām ||

translations.english: Abounding with horses, abounding with kine, bestowers of every sort of wealth, (the divinities of morning) are possessed of much that is necessary for the habitations (of men); Uṣas, speak to me kind words; send us the affluence of the wealthy.

mantras.sanskrit: उवासोषा उच्छाच्च नु देवी जीरा रथानाम् । ये अस्या आचरणेषु दध्रिरे समुद्रे न श्रवस्यवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uvāsoṣā ucchācca nu devī jīrā rathānām | ye asyā ācaraṇeṣu dadhrire samudre na śravasyavaḥ ||

translations.english: The divine Uṣas has dwelt (in heaven of old); may she dawn today, the excitress of chariots which are harnessed at her coming, as those who are desirous of wealth (send ships) to sea.

mantras.sanskrit: उषो ये ते प्र यामेषु युञ्जते मनो दानाय सूरयः । अत्राह तत्कण्व एषां कण्वतमो नाम गृणाति नृणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uṣo ye te pra yāmeṣu yuñjate mano dānāya sūrayaḥ | atrāha tatkaṇva eṣāṃ kaṇvatamo nāma gṛṇāti nṛṇām ||

translations.english: Uṣas, at your comings wise men turn their minds to benefactions; of these men, the most wise Kaṇva proclaims the fame.

mantras.sanskrit: आ घा योषेव सूनर्युषा याति प्रभुञ्जती । जरयन्ती वृजनं पद्वदीयत उत्पातयति पक्षिणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā ghā yoṣeva sūnaryuṣā yāti prabhuñjatī | jarayantī vṛjanaṃ padvadīyata utpātayati pakṣiṇaḥ ||

translations.english: Uṣas, nourishing (all), comes daily like a matron, the directress (of household duties), conducting all transient (creatures) to decay; (at her coming) each biped stirs and she wakes up the birds.

mantras.sanskrit: वि या सृजति समनं व्यर्थिनः पदं न वेत्योदती । वयो नकिष्टे पप्तिवांस आसते व्युष्टौ वाजिनीवति ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi yā sṛjati samanaṃ vyarthinaḥ padaṃ na vetyodatī | vayo nakiṣṭe paptivāṃsa āsate vyuṣṭau vājinīvati ||

translations.english: She animates the diligent, and sends clients (to their patrons); and shedder of dews, knows not delay; bestower of food, at your rising the soaring birds no longer suspend (their flight).

mantras.sanskrit: एषायुक्त परावतः सूर्यस्योदयनादधि । शतं रथेभिः सुभगोषा इयं वि यात्यभि मानुषान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣāyukta parāvataḥ sūryasyodayanādadhi | śataṃ rathebhiḥ subhagoṣā iyaṃ vi yātyabhi mānuṣān ||

translations.english: This auspicious Uṣas has harnessed (her vehicles) from afar, above the rising of the sun; and she comes gloriously upon man, with a hundred chariots.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वमस्या नानाम चक्षसे जगज्ज्योतिष्कृणोति सूनरी । अप द्वेषो मघोनी दुहिता दिव उषा उच्छदप स्रिधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvamasyā nānāma cakṣase jagajjyotiṣkṛṇoti sūnarī | apa dveṣo maghonī duhitā diva uṣā ucchadapa sridhaḥ ||

translations.english: All living beings adore her, that she may be visible; bringer of good, she lights up the world; the affluent daughter of heaven drives away the malevolent and disperses the absorbers (of moisture).

mantras.sanskrit: उष आ भाहि भानुना चन्द्रेण दुहितर्दिवः । आवहन्ती भूर्यस्मभ्यं सौभगं व्युच्छन्ती दिविष्टिषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: uṣa ā bhāhi bhānunā candreṇa duhitardivaḥ | āvahantī bhūryasmabhyaṃ saubhagaṃ vyucchantī diviṣṭiṣu ||

translations.english: Shine around, Uṣas, with cheering lustre, bringing us every day much happiness, and scattering darkness.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वस्य हि प्राणनं जीवनं त्वे वि यदुच्छसि सूनरि । सा नो रथेन बृहता विभावरि श्रुधि चित्रामघे हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvasya hi prāṇanaṃ jīvanaṃ tve vi yaducchasi sūnari | sā no rathena bṛhatā vibhāvari śrudhi citrāmaghe havam ||

translations.english: Inasmuch, bringer of good, as you dawn, the breath and life of all (creatures) rest in you; diffuser of light, come to us with your spacious car; possessor of wondrous wealth, hear our invocation.

mantras.sanskrit: उषो वाजं हि वंस्व यश्चित्रो मानुषे जने । तेना वह सुकृतो अध्वराँ उप ये त्वा गृणन्ति वह्नयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uṣo vājaṃ hi vaṃsva yaścitro mānuṣe jane | tenā vaha sukṛto adhvarā~ upa ye tvā gṛṇanti vahnayaḥ ||

translations.english: Uṣas, accept the (sacrificial) food which of many kinds exists among the human race, and thereby bring to the ceremony the pious, who offering oblations, praise you.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वान्देवाँ आ वह सोमपीतयेऽन्तरिक्षादुषस्त्वम् । सास्मासु धा गोमदश्वावदुक्थ्यमुषो वाजं सुवीर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvāndevā~ ā vaha somapītaye'ntarikṣāduṣastvam | sāsmāsu dhā gomadaśvāvadukthyamuṣo vājaṃ suvīryam ||

translations.english: Uṣas, bring from the firmament all the gods, to drink the Soma, and to you yourself bestow upon us excellent and invigorating food, along with cattle and horses.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्या रुशन्तो अर्चयः प्रति भद्रा अदृक्षत । सा नो रयिं विश्ववारं सुपेशसमुषा ददातु सुग्म्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasyā ruśanto arcayaḥ prati bhadrā adṛkṣata | sā no rayiṃ viśvavāraṃ supeśasamuṣā dadātu sugmyam ||

translations.english: May that Uṣas whose bright auspicious rays are visible all around, grant us desirable, agreeable, and easily-attainable riches.

mantras.sanskrit: ये चिद्धि त्वामृषयः पूर्व ऊतये जुहूरेऽवसे महि । सा नः स्तोमाँ अभि गृणीहि राधसोषः शुक्रेण शोचिषा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye ciddhi tvāmṛṣayaḥ pūrva ūtaye juhūre'vase mahi | sā naḥ stomā~ abhi gṛṇīhi rādhasoṣaḥ śukreṇa śociṣā ||

translations.english: Adorable Uṣas, whom the ancient sages invoked for protection and for food, do you, (radiant) with pure light, (plural ased) by our offerings, accept our praises.

mantras.sanskrit: उषो यदद्य भानुना वि द्वारावृणवो दिवः । प्र नो यच्छतादवृकं पृथु च्छर्दिः प्र देवि गोमतीरिषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uṣo yadadya bhānunā vi dvārāvṛṇavo divaḥ | pra no yacchatādavṛkaṃ pṛthu cchardiḥ pra devi gomatīriṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Uṣas, since you have today set upon the two gates of heaven with light, grant us a spacious and secure habitation; bestow upon us, goddess, cattle and food.

mantras.sanskrit: सं नो राया बृहता विश्वपेशसा मिमिक्ष्वा समिळाभिरा । सं द्युम्नेन विश्वतुरोषो महि सं वाजैर्वाजिनीवति ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ no rāyā bṛhatā viśvapeśasā mimikṣvā samiḷābhirā | saṃ dyumnena viśvaturoṣo mahi saṃ vājairvājinīvati ||

translations.english: Adorable Uṣas, associate us with much and multiform wealth, and with abundant cattle, with all foe-confounding fame, and giver of sustenance, with food.

mantras.sanskrit: उषो भद्रेभिरा गहि दिवश्चिद्रोचनादधि । वहन्त्वरुणप्सव उप त्वा सोमिनो गृहम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uṣo bhadrebhirā gahi divaścidrocanādadhi | vahantvaruṇapsava upa tvā somino gṛham ||

translations.english: Uṣas, come by auspicious ways from above the bright (region of the) firmament; let the purple (kine) bring you to the dwelling of the offerr of Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: सुपेशसं सुखं रथं यमध्यस्था उषस्त्वम् । तेना सुश्रवसं जनं प्रावाद्य दुहितर्दिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: supeśasaṃ sukhaṃ rathaṃ yamadhyasthā uṣastvam | tenā suśravasaṃ janaṃ prāvādya duhitardivaḥ ||

translations.english: Uṣas, in the ample and beautiful chariot in which you ride, come today, daughter of heaven, to the pious offerer of the oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: वयश्चित्ते पतत्रिणो द्विपच्चतुष्पदर्जुनि । उषः प्रारन्नृतूँरनु दिवो अन्तेभ्यस्परि ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayaścitte patatriṇo dvipaccatuṣpadarjuni | uṣaḥ prārannṛtū~ranu divo antebhyaspari ||

translations.english: White-complexioned Uṣas, upon your coming, bipeds and quadrupeds (are in motion), and the winged birds flock around from the boundaries of the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: व्युच्छन्ती हि रश्मिभिर्विश्वमाभासि रोचनम् । तां त्वामुषर्वसूयवो गीर्भिः कण्वा अहूषत ॥
mantras.transliteration: vyucchantī hi raśmibhirviśvamābhāsi rocanam | tāṃ tvāmuṣarvasūyavo gīrbhiḥ kaṇvā ahūṣata ||

translations.english: You, Uṣas, dispersing the darkness, illumine the shining universe with your rays; such as you are, Kaṇvas, desirous of wealth, praise you with their hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: उदु त्यं जातवेदसं देवं वहन्ति केतवः । दृशे विश्वाय सूर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: udu tyaṃ jātavedasaṃ devaṃ vahanti ketavaḥ | dṛśe viśvāya sūryam ||

translations.english: His coursers bear on high the divine all-knowing Sun, that he may be seen by all (the worlds).

mantras.sanskrit: अप त्ये तायवो यथा नक्षत्रा यन्त्यक्तुभिः । सूराय विश्वचक्षसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: apa tye tāyavo yathā nakṣatrā yantyaktubhiḥ | sūrāya viśvacakṣase ||

translations.english: (At the approach) of the all-illuminating Sun, the constellations depart with the night, like thieves.

mantras.sanskrit: अदृश्रमस्य केतवो वि रश्मयो जनाँ अनु । भ्राजन्तो अग्नयो यथा ॥
mantras.transliteration: adṛśramasya ketavo vi raśmayo janā~ anu | bhrājanto agnayo yathā ||

translations.english: His illuminating rays behold men in succession, like blazing fires.

mantras.sanskrit: तरणिर्विश्वदर्शतो ज्योतिष्कृदसि सूर्य । विश्वमा भासि रोचनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taraṇirviśvadarśato jyotiṣkṛdasi sūrya | viśvamā bhāsi rocanam ||

translations.english: You, Sūrya, outstrip all in speed; you are visible to all; you are the source of light; you shine throughout the entire firmament.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रत्यङ्देवानां विशः प्रत्यङ्ङुदेषि मानुषान् । प्रत्यङ्विश्वं स्वर्दृशे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pratyaṅdevānāṃ viśaḥ pratyaṅṅudeṣi mānuṣān | pratyaṅviśvaṃ svardṛśe ||

translations.english: You rise in the presence of the Maruts, you rise in the presence of mankind, and so as to be seen in the presence of the whole (region) of heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: येना पावक चक्षसा भुरण्यन्तं जनाँ अनु । त्वं वरुण पश्यसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yenā pāvaka cakṣasā bhuraṇyantaṃ janā~ anu | tvaṃ varuṇa paśyasi ||

translations.english: With that light with which you, the purifier and defender from evil, look upon this creature-bearing world.

mantras.sanskrit: वि द्यामेषि रजस्पृथ्वहा मिमानो अक्तुभिः । पश्यञ्जन्मानि सूर्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi dyāmeṣi rajaspṛthvahā mimāno aktubhiḥ | paśyañjanmāni sūrya ||

translations.english: You traverse the vast ethereal space, measuring days and nights, and contemplating all that have birth.

mantras.sanskrit: सप्त त्वा हरितो रथे वहन्ति देव सूर्य । शोचिष्केशं विचक्षण ॥
mantras.transliteration: sapta tvā harito rathe vahanti deva sūrya | śociṣkeśaṃ vicakṣaṇa ||

translations.english: Divine and light-diffusing Sūrya, your seven coursers bear you, bright-haired, in your car.

mantras.sanskrit: अयुक्त सप्त शुन्ध्युवः सूरो रथस्य नप्त्यः । ताभिर्याति स्वयुक्तिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayukta sapta śundhyuvaḥ sūro rathasya naptyaḥ | tābhiryāti svayuktibhiḥ ||

translations.english: The Sun has yoked the seven mares that safely draw his chariot, and comes with them self-harnessed.

mantras.sanskrit: उद्वयं तमसस्परि ज्योतिष्पश्यन्त उत्तरम् । देवं देवत्रा सूर्यमगन्म ज्योतिरुत्तमम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: udvayaṃ tamasaspari jyotiṣpaśyanta uttaram | devaṃ devatrā sūryamaganma jyotiruttamam ||

translations.english: Beholding the up-springing light above the darkness, we approach the divine Sun among the gods, the excellent light.

mantras.sanskrit: उद्यन्नद्य मित्रमह आरोहन्नुत्तरां दिवम् । हृद्रोगं मम सूर्य हरिमाणं च नाशय ॥
mantras.transliteration: udyannadya mitramaha ārohannuttarāṃ divam | hṛdrogaṃ mama sūrya harimāṇaṃ ca nāśaya ||

translations.english: Radiant with benevolent light, rising today and mountina into the highest heaven, do you O Sun, remove sickness of my heart, and the yellowness (of my body).

mantras.sanskrit: शुकेषु मे हरिमाणं रोपणाकासु दध्मसि । अथो हारिद्रवेषु मे हरिमाणं नि दध्मसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: śukeṣu me harimāṇaṃ ropaṇākāsu dadhmasi | atho hāridraveṣu me harimāṇaṃ ni dadhmasi ||

translations.english: Let us transfer the yellowness (of my body) to the parrots, to the starlings, or to the haritāla (tree).

mantras.sanskrit: उदगादयमादित्यो विश्वेन सहसा सह । द्विषन्तं मह्यं रन्धयन्मो अहं द्विषते रधम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: udagādayamādityo viśvena sahasā saha | dviṣantaṃ mahyaṃ randhayanmo ahaṃ dviṣate radham ||

translations.english: This Āditya has risen with all (his) might, destroying my adversary, for I am unable to resist my enemy (sickness).

mantras.sanskrit: अभि त्यं मेषं पुरुहूतमृग्मियमिन्द्रं गीर्भिर्मदता वस्वो अर्णवम् । यस्य द्यावो न विचरन्ति मानुषा भुजे मंहिष्ठमभि विप्रमर्चत ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi tyaṃ meṣaṃ puruhūtamṛgmiyamindraṃ gīrbhirmadatā vasvo arṇavam | yasya dyāvo na vicaranti mānuṣā bhuje maṃhiṣṭhamabhi vipramarcata ||

translations.english: Anime with praises that ram, (Indra), who is adored by many, who is gratified by hymns, and is an ocean of wealth; whose good deeds spread abroad for the benefit of mankind, like the rays of light; worship the powerful and wise Indra, for the enjoyment of prosperity.

mantras.sanskrit: अभीमवन्वन्त्स्वभिष्टिमूतयोऽन्तरिक्षप्रां तविषीभिरावृतम् । इन्द्रं दक्षास ऋभवो मदच्युतं शतक्रतुं जवनी सूनृतारुहत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhīmavanvantsvabhiṣṭimūtayo'ntarikṣaprāṃ taviṣībhirāvṛtam | indraṃ dakṣāsa ṛbhavo madacyutaṃ śatakratuṃ javanī sūnṛtāruhat ||

translations.english: The protecting and fostering Ṛbhus hastened to the presence of Indra, of graceful motion, and irradiating the firmament, imbued with vigour, the humiliator of his enemies, the performer of a hundred pious acts; and by them, encouraging words were uttered.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं गोत्रमङ्गिरोभ्योऽवृणोरपोतात्रये शतदुरेषु गातुवित् । ससेन चिद्विमदायावहो वस्वाजावद्रिं वावसानस्य नर्तयन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ gotramaṅgirobhyo'vṛṇorapotātraye śatadureṣu gātuvit | sasena cidvimadāyāvaho vasvājāvadriṃ vāvasānasya nartayan ||

translations.english: You have opened the cloud for the Aṅgirasas you have shown the way to Atri, who vexes his adversaries by a hundred doors (by a number of yantras, means or contrivances); you have granted wealth, with food, to Vimada; you are wielding your thunderbolt in defence of a worshipper engaged in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमपामपिधानावृणोरपाधारयः पर्वते दानुमद्वसु । वृत्रं यदिन्द्र शवसावधीरहिमादित्सूर्यं दिव्यारोहयो दृशे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamapāmapidhānāvṛṇorapādhārayaḥ parvate dānumadvasu | vṛtraṃ yadindra śavasāvadhīrahimāditsūryaṃ divyārohayo dṛśe ||

translations.english: You have opened the receptacle of the waters; you have detained in the mountain the treasure of the malignant; when you had slain Vṛtra, the destryer, you made the sun visible in the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं मायाभिरप मायिनोऽधमः स्वधाभिर्ये अधि शुप्तावजुह्वत । त्वं पिप्रोर्नृमणः प्रारुजः पुरः प्र ऋजिश्वानं दस्युहत्येष्वाविथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ māyābhirapa māyino'dhamaḥ svadhābhirye adhi śuptāvajuhvata | tvaṃ piprornṛmaṇaḥ prārujaḥ puraḥ pra ṛjiśvānaṃ dasyuhatyeṣvāvitha ||

translations.english: You, Indra, by the devices, have humbled the deceivers who presented oblations to their own mouths; propitious to men, you have destroyed the cities of Pipru, and have well defended Ṛjiśvan in robber-destroying (contest).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं कुत्सं शुष्णहत्येष्वाविथारन्धयोऽतिथिग्वाय शम्बरम् । महान्तं चिदर्बुदं नि क्रमीः पदा सनादेव दस्युहत्याय जज्ञिषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ kutsaṃ śuṣṇahatyeṣvāvithārandhayo'tithigvāya śambaram | mahāntaṃ cidarbudaṃ ni kramīḥ padā sanādeva dasyuhatyāya jajñiṣe ||

translations.english: You have defended Kutsa in fatal fights with Śuśna; you have destroyed Śambara in defence of Atithigva; you have trodden with your foot upon the great Arbuda; frm remote times were you born for the destruction of oppressors.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वे विश्वा तविषी सध्र्यग्घिता तव राधः सोमपीथाय हर्षते । तव वज्रश्चिकिते बाह्वोर्हितो वृश्चा शत्रोरव विश्वानि वृष्ण्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: tve viśvā taviṣī sadhryagghitā tava rādhaḥ somapīthāya harṣate | tava vajraścikite bāhvorhito vṛścā śatrorava viśvāni vṛṣṇyā ||

translations.english: In you, Indra, is all vigour fully concentrated; you will delight to drink the Soma; it is known by us that the thunderbolt is deposited in your hands; cut off all prowess from the foe.

mantras.sanskrit: वि जानीह्यार्यान्ये च दस्यवो बर्हिष्मते रन्धया शासदव्रतान् । शाकी भव यजमानस्य चोदिता विश्वेत्ता ते सधमादेषु चाकन ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi jānīhyāryānye ca dasyavo barhiṣmate randhayā śāsadavratān | śākī bhava yajamānasya coditā viśvettā te sadhamādeṣu cākana ||

translations.english: Discriminate between the Āryas and they who are Dasyus; restraining those who perform no religious rites, compel them to submit to the performer of sacrifices; be you, who are powerful, the encourager of the sacrificer; I am desirous of celebrating all your deeds in ceremonies that give you satisfaction.

mantras.sanskrit: अनुव्रताय रन्धयन्नपव्रतानाभूभिरिन्द्रः श्नथयन्ननाभुवः । वृद्धस्य चिद्वर्धतो द्यामिनक्षतः स्तवानो वम्रो वि जघान संदिहः ॥
mantras.transliteration: anuvratāya randhayannapavratānābhūbhirindraḥ śnathayannanābhuvaḥ | vṛddhasya cidvardhato dyāminakṣataḥ stavāno vamro vi jaghāna saṃdihaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra abides, humbling the neglecters of holy acts in favour of those who observe them; and punishing those who turn away from his worship in favour of those who are present (with their praise); Vamra, while praising him, whether old or adolescent, and spreading through heaven, carried off the accusative ulated (materials of the sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: तक्षद्यत्त उशना सहसा सहो वि रोदसी मज्मना बाधते शवः । आ त्वा वातस्य नृमणो मनोयुज आ पूर्यमाणमवहन्नभि श्रवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: takṣadyatta uśanā sahasā saho vi rodasī majmanā bādhate śavaḥ | ā tvā vātasya nṛmaṇo manoyuja ā pūryamāṇamavahannabhi śravaḥ ||

translations.english: If Uṣanās should sharpen your vigour by his own, then would your might terrify by its intensity both heaven and earth. Friend of man, let the will harnessed steeds, with the velocity of the wind, convey you, replete (with vigour), to (partake of the sacrificial) food.

mantras.sanskrit: मन्दिष्ट यदुशने काव्ये सचाँ इन्द्रो वङ्कू वङ्कुतराधि तिष्ठति । उग्रो ययिं निरपः स्रोतसासृजद्वि शुष्णस्य दृंहिता ऐरयत्पुरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mandiṣṭa yaduśane kāvye sacā~ indro vaṅkū vaṅkutarādhi tiṣṭhati | ugro yayiṃ nirapaḥ srotasāsṛjadvi śuṣṇasya dṛṃhitā airayatpuraḥ ||

translations.english: When Indra is delighted with acceptable hymns, he ascends (his car), drawn by more and more obliquely-curving coursers; fierce, he extracts the waters from the passing (cloud) in a torrent, and has overwhelmed the extensive cities of Śuṣṇa.

mantras.sanskrit: आ स्मा रथं वृषपाणेषु तिष्ठसि शार्यातस्य प्रभृता येषु मन्दसे । इन्द्र यथा सुतसोमेषु चाकनोऽनर्वाणं श्लोकमा रोहसे दिवि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā smā rathaṃ vṛṣapāṇeṣu tiṣṭhasi śāryātasya prabhṛtā yeṣu mandase | indra yathā sutasomeṣu cākano'narvāṇaṃ ślokamā rohase divi ||

translations.english: You mount your chariot willingly, Indra, for the sake of drinking the libations; such as you delight in having been prepared (at the sacrifice of) Śāryāta; be plural ased with them, as you are gratified by the effused Soma (at the sacrifices) of others, so do you obtain imperishable fame in heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: अददा अर्भां महते वचस्यवे कक्षीवते वृचयामिन्द्र सुन्वते । मेनाभवो वृषणश्वस्य सुक्रतो विश्वेत्ता ते सवनेषु प्रवाच्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: adadā arbhāṃ mahate vacasyave kakṣīvate vṛcayāmindra sunvate | menābhavo vṛṣaṇaśvasya sukrato viśvettā te savaneṣu pravācyā ||

translations.english: You have given, Indra, the youthful Vṛcaya to the aged Kakṣīvat, praising you and offering oblations; you, Śatakratu, were Menā, the daughter of Vṛṣaṇaśva; all these your deeds are to be recited at your worship.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रो अश्रायि सुध्यो निरेके पज्रेषु स्तोमो दुर्यो न यूपः । अश्वयुर्गव्यू रथयुर्वसूयुरिन्द्र इद्रायः क्षयति प्रयन्ता ॥
mantras.transliteration: indro aśrāyi sudhyo nireke pajreṣu stomo duryo na yūpaḥ | aśvayurgavyū rathayurvasūyurindra idrāyaḥ kṣayati prayantā ||

translations.english: Indra has been had recourse to, that he may assist the pious in their distress. Praise by the Pajras, is (as stable) as the post of a doorway. Indra, the giver of riches, who is possessed of (who desires to possess, expecting as gifts from the instrumental tutor of the ceremony) horses, cattle, chariots and wealth is present.

mantras.sanskrit: इदं नमो वृषभाय स्वराजे सत्यशुष्माय तवसेऽवाचि । अस्मिन्निन्द्र वृजने सर्ववीराः स्मत्सूरिभिस्तव शर्मन्त्स्याम ॥
mantras.transliteration: idaṃ namo vṛṣabhāya svarāje satyaśuṣmāya tavase'vāci | asminnindra vṛjane sarvavīrāḥ smatsūribhistava śarmantsyāma ||

translations.english: This adoration is offered to the shedder of rain, the self-resplendent, the possessor of true vigour, the mighty; may we be aided, Indra, in his conflict, by many heroes, and abide in a prosperoud (habitation, bestowed) by you.

mantras.sanskrit: त्यं सु मेषं महया स्वर्विदं शतं यस्य सुभ्वः साकमीरते । अत्यं न वाजं हवनस्यदं रथमेन्द्रं ववृत्यामवसे सुवृक्तिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tyaṃ su meṣaṃ mahayā svarvidaṃ śataṃ yasya subhvaḥ sākamīrate | atyaṃ na vājaṃ havanasyadaṃ rathamendraṃ vavṛtyāmavase suvṛktibhiḥ ||

translations.english: Worship well that ram who makes heaven known, whom a hundred worshippers at once are assiduous in praising. I implore Indra with many prayers to ascend the car, which hastens like a fleet courser to the sacrificer for my protection.

mantras.sanskrit: स पर्वतो न धरुणेष्वच्युतः सहस्रमूतिस्तविषीषु वावृधे । इन्द्रो यद्वृत्रमवधीन्नदीवृतमुब्जन्नर्णांसि जर्हृषाणो अन्धसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa parvato na dharuṇeṣvacyutaḥ sahasramūtistaviṣīṣu vāvṛdhe | indro yadvṛtramavadhīnnadīvṛtamubjannarṇāṃsi jarhṛṣāṇo andhasā ||

translations.english: When Indra, who delights in the sacrificial food, had slain the stream-obstructing Vṛtra, and was pouring down the waters, he stood firm amid the torrents like a mountain, and endowed with a thousand means of protecting (his votaries) increased in vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: स हि द्वरो द्वरिषु वव्र ऊधनि चन्द्रबुध्नो मदवृद्धो मनीषिभिः । इन्द्रं तमह्वे स्वपस्यया धिया मंहिष्ठरातिं स हि पप्रिरन्धसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa hi dvaro dvariṣu vavra ūdhani candrabudhno madavṛddho manīṣibhiḥ | indraṃ tamahve svapasyayā dhiyā maṃhiṣṭharātiṃ sa hi paprirandhasaḥ ||

translations.english: He who is victorious over his enemies, who is spread through the dewy (firmament), the root of happiness, who is exhilarated by the Soma him I invoke, the most bountiful Indra, along with learned priests, with a mind disposed to pious adoration, for he is the bestower of abundant food.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यं पृणन्ति दिवि सद्मबर्हिषः समुद्रं न सुभ्वः स्वा अभिष्टयः । तं वृत्रहत्ये अनु तस्थुरूतयः शुष्मा इन्द्रमवाता अह्रुतप्सवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yaṃ pṛṇanti divi sadmabarhiṣaḥ samudraṃ na subhvaḥ svā abhiṣṭayaḥ | taṃ vṛtrahatye anu tasthurūtayaḥ śuṣmā indramavātā ahrutapsavaḥ ||

translations.english: Tha Indra whom in heaven the libations sprinkled on the sacred grass replenish, as the kindred rivers hastening to it fill the ocean; that Indra whom the Maruts, the driers up of moisture, who are unobstructed, and of undistorted forms, attended as auxiliaries at the death of Vṛtra.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि स्ववृष्टिं मदे अस्य युध्यतो रघ्वीरिव प्रवणे सस्रुरूतयः । इन्द्रो यद्वज्री धृषमाणो अन्धसा भिनद्वलस्य परिधीँरिव त्रितः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi svavṛṣṭiṃ made asya yudhyato raghvīriva pravaṇe sasrurūtayaḥ | indro yadvajrī dhṛṣamāṇo andhasā bhinadvalasya paridhī~riva tritaḥ ||

translations.english: His allies, exhilarated (by libations), preceded him, warring against the withholder of the rain, as rivers rush down declivities. Indra, animated by the sacrificial food, broke through the defences of Vala as did Trita through the coverings (of the well).

mantras.sanskrit: परीं घृणा चरति तित्विषे शवोऽपो वृत्वी रजसो बुध्नमाशयत् । वृत्रस्य यत्प्रवणे दुर्गृभिश्वनो निजघन्थ हन्वोरिन्द्र तन्यतुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: parīṃ ghṛṇā carati titviṣe śavo'po vṛtvī rajaso budhnamāśayat | vṛtrasya yatpravaṇe durgṛbhiśvano nijaghantha hanvorindra tanyatum ||

translations.english: When, Indra, you had smitten with my thunderbolt the check of the wide-extended Vṛtra, who, having obstructed the waters reposed in the region above the firmament, your fame spread afar, your prowess was renowned.

mantras.sanskrit: ह्रदं न हि त्वा न्यृषन्त्यूर्मयो ब्रह्माणीन्द्र तव यानि वर्धना । त्वष्टा चित्ते युज्यं वावृधे शवस्ततक्ष वज्रमभिभूत्योजसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: hradaṃ na hi tvā nyṛṣantyūrmayo brahmāṇīndra tava yāni vardhanā | tvaṣṭā citte yujyaṃ vāvṛdhe śavastatakṣa vajramabhibhūtyojasam ||

translations.english: The hymns, Indra, that glorify you, attain unto you, as rivulets (flow into) a lake. Tvaṣṭā has augmented your appropriate vigour; he has sharpened your bolt with overpowering might.

mantras.sanskrit: जघन्वाँ उ हरिभिः सम्भृतक्रतविन्द्र वृत्रं मनुषे गातुयन्नपः । अयच्छथा बाह्वोर्वज्रमायसमधारयो दिव्या सूर्यं दृशे ॥
mantras.transliteration: jaghanvā~ u haribhiḥ sambhṛtakratavindra vṛtraṃ manuṣe gātuyannapaḥ | ayacchathā bāhvorvajramāyasamadhārayo divyā sūryaṃ dṛśe ||

translations.english: Indra, performer of holy acts, desirous of going to man, you with your steeds have slain Vṛtra (have set free) the waters, have taken in your hands your thunderbolt of metal, and have made the sun visible in the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: बृहत्स्वश्चन्द्रममवद्यदुक्थ्यमकृण्वत भियसा रोहणं दिवः । यन्मानुषप्रधना इन्द्रमूतयः स्वर्नृषाचो मरुतोऽमदन्ननु ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhatsvaścandramamavadyadukthyamakṛṇvata bhiyasā rohaṇaṃ divaḥ | yanmānuṣapradhanā indramūtayaḥ svarnṛṣāco maruto'madannanu ||

translations.english: Through fear (of Vṛtra, they, the worshippers), recited the suitable hymn of the Bṛhat (Sāma), self-illuminating, strength-bestowing, and ascending to heaven; on which his allies, (the Maruts), combating for men, (guardians) of heaven, and vivifiers of mankind animated Indra (to destroy him).

mantras.sanskrit: द्यौश्चिदस्यामवाँ अहेः स्वनादयोयवीद्भियसा वज्र इन्द्र ते । वृत्रस्य यद्बद्बधानस्य रोदसी मदे सुतस्य शवसाभिनच्छिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dyauścidasyāmavā~ aheḥ svanādayoyavīdbhiyasā vajra indra te | vṛtrasya yadbadbadhānasya rodasī made sutasya śavasābhinacchiraḥ ||

translations.english: The strong heaven was rent asunder with fear at the clamour of that Ahi, when you, Indra, was inspired by (drinking) the effused (Soma), and your thunderbolt in its vigour struck off the head of Vṛtra, the obstructor of heaven and earth.

mantras.sanskrit: यदिन्न्विन्द्र पृथिवी दशभुजिरहानि विश्वा ततनन्त कृष्टयः । अत्राह ते मघवन्विश्रुतं सहो द्यामनु शवसा बर्हणा भुवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadinnvindra pṛthivī daśabhujirahāni viśvā tatananta kṛṣṭayaḥ | atrāha te maghavanviśrutaṃ saho dyāmanu śavasā barhaṇā bhuvat ||

translations.english: Although, Indra, the earth were of tenfold (its extent), and men multiplied every day, yet, Maghavan, your prowess would be equally renowned; the exploits achieved by your might would be spread abroad with the heavens.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमस्य पारे रजसो व्योमनः स्वभूत्योजा अवसे धृषन्मनः । चकृषे भूमिं प्रतिमानमोजसोऽपः स्वः परिभूरेष्या दिवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamasya pāre rajaso vyomanaḥ svabhūtyojā avase dhṛṣanmanaḥ | cakṛṣe bhūmiṃ pratimānamojaso'paḥ svaḥ paribhūreṣyā divam ||
