translations.english: Firm-minded Indra, abiding (secure) in your strength beyond the limit of the wide-expanded firmament, you have framed the earth for our preservation; you have been the type of vigour; you have encompassed the firmament and the sky as far as to the heavens.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं भुवः प्रतिमानं पृथिव्या ऋष्ववीरस्य बृहतः पतिर्भूः । विश्वमाप्रा अन्तरिक्षं महित्वा सत्यमद्धा नकिरन्यस्त्वावान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ bhuvaḥ pratimānaṃ pṛthivyā ṛṣvavīrasya bṛhataḥ patirbhūḥ | viśvamāprā antarikṣaṃ mahitvā satyamaddhā nakiranyastvāvān ||

translations.english: You are the type of the extended earth you are the lord of the vast god-frequent (svarga) verily with your bulk you fillest all the firmament of a truth, there is none other such as you.

mantras.sanskrit: न यस्य द्यावापृथिवी अनु व्यचो न सिन्धवो रजसो अन्तमानशुः । नोत स्ववृष्टिं मदे अस्य युध्यत एको अन्यच्चकृषे विश्वमानुषक् ॥
mantras.transliteration: na yasya dyāvāpṛthivī anu vyaco na sindhavo rajaso antamānaśuḥ | nota svavṛṣṭiṃ made asya yudhyata eko anyaccakṛṣe viśvamānuṣak ||

translations.english: you, Indra, of whom heaven and earth have not attained the amplitude; of whom the waters of heaven have not reached the limit; of whom, when warring with excited animation against the withholder of the rains, (his adversaries have not equalled the prowess); you alone have made everything else, (than yourself), dependent (upon you).

mantras.sanskrit: आर्चन्नत्र मरुतः सस्मिन्नाजौ विश्वे देवासो अमदन्ननु त्वा । वृत्रस्य यद्भृष्टिमता वधेन नि त्वमिन्द्र प्रत्यानं जघन्थ ॥
mantras.transliteration: ārcannatra marutaḥ sasminnājau viśve devāso amadannanu tvā | vṛtrasya yadbhṛṣṭimatā vadhena ni tvamindra pratyānaṃ jaghantha ||

translations.english: The Maruts worshipped you in this (encounter); all the gods in this engagement imitated you in exultation, when you had struck the face of Vṛtra with your angular and fatal (bolt).

mantras.sanskrit: न्यू षु वाचं प्र महे भरामहे गिर इन्द्राय सदने विवस्वतः । नू चिद्धि रत्नं ससतामिवाविदन्न दुःष्टुतिर्द्रविणोदेषु शस्यते ॥
mantras.transliteration: nyū ṣu vācaṃ pra mahe bharāmahe gira indrāya sadane vivasvataḥ | nū ciddhi ratnaṃ sasatāmivāvidanna duḥṣṭutirdraviṇodeṣu śasyate ||

translations.english: We ever offer fitting praise to the mighty Indra, in the dwelling of the worshpper, by which he (the deity) has quickly acquired riches, as (a thief) hastily hastily carried (off the property) of the sleeping. Praise ill expressed is not valued among the munificent.

mantras.sanskrit: दुरो अश्वस्य दुर इन्द्र गोरसि दुरो यवस्य वसुन इनस्पतिः । शिक्षानरः प्रदिवो अकामकर्शनः सखा सखिभ्यस्तमिदं गृणीमसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: duro aśvasya dura indra gorasi duro yavasya vasuna inaspatiḥ | śikṣānaraḥ pradivo akāmakarśanaḥ sakhā sakhibhyastamidaṃ gṛṇīmasi ||

translations.english: You, Indra, are the giver of horses, of cattle, or barley, the master and protector of wealth, the foremost in liberality, (the being) of many days; you disappoint not desires (addressed to you); you are a friend to our friend; such an Indra we praise.

mantras.sanskrit: शचीव इन्द्र पुरुकृद्द्युमत्तम तवेदिदमभितश्चेकिते वसु । अतः संगृभ्याभिभूत आ भर मा त्वायतो जरितुः काममूनयीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śacīva indra purukṛddyumattama tavedidamabhitaścekite vasu | ataḥ saṃgṛbhyābhibhūta ā bhara mā tvāyato jarituḥ kāmamūnayīḥ ||

translations.english: Wise and resplendent Indra, the achiever of great deeds, the riches that are spread around are known to be yours; having collected them, victor (over your enemies), bring them to us; disappoint not the expectation of the worshipper who trusts in you.

mantras.sanskrit: एभिर्द्युभिः सुमना एभिरिन्दुभिर्निरुन्धानो अमतिं गोभिरश्विना । इन्द्रेण दस्युं दरयन्त इन्दुभिर्युतद्वेषसः समिषा रभेमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ebhirdyubhiḥ sumanā ebhirindubhirnirundhāno amatiṃ gobhiraśvinā | indreṇa dasyuṃ darayanta indubhiryutadveṣasaḥ samiṣā rabhemahi ||

translations.english: Propitiated by these offerings, be these libations, dispel poverty with cattle and horses; may we subduing our adversary, and relived from enemies by Indra, (plural ased) by our libations, enjoy together abundant food.

mantras.sanskrit: समिन्द्र राया समिषा रभेमहि सं वाजेभिः पुरुश्चन्द्रैरभिद्युभिः । सं देव्या प्रमत्या वीरशुष्मया गोअग्रयाश्वावत्या रभेमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: samindra rāyā samiṣā rabhemahi saṃ vājebhiḥ puruścandrairabhidyubhiḥ | saṃ devyā pramatyā vīraśuṣmayā goagrayāśvāvatyā rabhemahi ||

translations.english: Indra, may we become possessed of riches, and of food; and with energies agreeable to many, and shining around, may we prosper through your divine favour, the source of prowess, of cattle and of horses.

mantras.sanskrit: ते त्वा मदा अमदन्तानि वृष्ण्या ते सोमासो वृत्रहत्येषु सत्पते । यत्कारवे दश वृत्राण्यप्रति बर्हिष्मते नि सहस्राणि बर्हयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te tvā madā amadantāni vṛṣṇyā te somāso vṛtrahatyeṣu satpate | yatkārave daśa vṛtrāṇyaprati barhiṣmate ni sahasrāṇi barhayaḥ ||

translations.english: Those who were your allies, (the Maruts), brought you joy; protector of the pious, those libations and oblations (that were offered you on slaying Vṛtra), yielded you delight, when you, unimpeded by foes, did destroy the ten thousand obstacles oposed to him who praised you and offered you oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: युधा युधमुप घेदेषि धृष्णुया पुरा पुरं समिदं हंस्योजसा । नम्या यदिन्द्र सख्या परावति निबर्हयो नमुचिं नाम मायिनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yudhā yudhamupa ghedeṣi dhṛṣṇuyā purā puraṃ samidaṃ haṃsyojasā | namyā yadindra sakhyā parāvati nibarhayo namuciṃ nāma māyinam ||

translations.english: Humiliator (of adversaries), you go from battle to battle, and destroy by your might city after city; with you foe-prostrating associate, (the thunderbolt), you Indra, did slay afar off the deceiver named Namuci.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं करञ्जमुत पर्णयं वधीस्तेजिष्ठयातिथिग्वस्य वर्तनी । त्वं शता वङ्गृदस्याभिनत्पुरोऽनानुदः परिषूता ऋजिश्वना ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ karañjamuta parṇayaṃ vadhīstejiṣṭhayātithigvasya vartanī | tvaṃ śatā vaṅgṛdasyābhinatpuro'nānudaḥ pariṣūtā ṛjiśvanā ||

translations.english: You have slain Karañja and Parṇaya with your bright gleaming spear, in the cause of Atithigva; unaided, you did demolish the hundred cities of Vaṅgrida, when besieged by Ṛjiṣvan.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमेताञ्जनराज्ञो द्विर्दशाबन्धुना सुश्रवसोपजग्मुषः । षष्टिं सहस्रा नवतिं नव श्रुतो नि चक्रेण रथ्या दुष्पदावृणक् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvametāñjanarājño dvirdaśābandhunā suśravasopajagmuṣaḥ | ṣaṣṭiṃ sahasrā navatiṃ nava śruto ni cakreṇa rathyā duṣpadāvṛṇak ||

translations.english: You, renowned Indra, overthrown by your not-to-be- overtaken chariot-wheel, the twenty kings of men, who had come against Suśravas unaided, and their sixty thousand and ninety-nine followers.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमाविथ सुश्रवसं तवोतिभिस्तव त्रामभिरिन्द्र तूर्वयाणम् । त्वमस्मै कुत्समतिथिग्वमायुं महे राज्ञे यूने अरन्धनायः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamāvitha suśravasaṃ tavotibhistava trāmabhirindra tūrvayāṇam | tvamasmai kutsamatithigvamāyuṃ mahe rājñe yūne arandhanāyaḥ ||

translations.english: You, Indra, have preserved Suśravas by your succour, Turvayāṇa by your assistance; you have made Kutsa, Atithigva, and Ātu subject to the mighty though youthful Suśravas.

mantras.sanskrit: य उदृचीन्द्र देवगोपाः सखायस्ते शिवतमा असाम । त्वां स्तोषाम त्वया सुवीरा द्राघीय आयुः प्रतरं दधानाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya udṛcīndra devagopāḥ sakhāyaste śivatamā asāma | tvāṃ stoṣāma tvayā suvīrā drāghīya āyuḥ prataraṃ dadhānāḥ ||

translations.english: Protected by the gods, we remain, Indra, at the close of the sacrifice, your most fortunate friends; we praise you, as enjoying through you excellent offspring, and a long and prosperous life.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नो अस्मिन्मघवन्पृत्स्वंहसि नहि ते अन्तः शवसः परीणशे । अक्रन्दयो नद्यो रोरुवद्वना कथा न क्षोणीर्भियसा समारत ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā no asminmaghavanpṛtsvaṃhasi nahi te antaḥ śavasaḥ parīṇaśe | akrandayo nadyo roruvadvanā kathā na kṣoṇīrbhiyasā samārata ||

translations.english: Urge us not, Maghavan, to this iniquity, to these iniquitous conflicts, for the limit of your strength is not to be surpassed; you have made the waters of the rivers roar; how (is it possible) that the earth should be filled with terror?

mantras.sanskrit: अर्चा शक्राय शाकिने शचीवते शृण्वन्तमिन्द्रं महयन्नभि ष्टुहि । यो धृष्णुना शवसा रोदसी उभे वृषा वृषत्वा वृषभो न्यृञ्जते ॥
mantras.transliteration: arcā śakrāya śākine śacīvate śṛṇvantamindraṃ mahayannabhi ṣṭuhi | yo dhṛṣṇunā śavasā rodasī ubhe vṛṣā vṛṣatvā vṛṣabho nyṛñjate ||

translations.english: Offer adoration to the wise and powerful Śakra; glorifying the listening Indra, praise him who purifies both heaven and earth by his irresistible might, who is the sender of showers, and by his bounty gratifies our desires.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्चा दिवे बृहते शूष्यं वचः स्वक्षत्रं यस्य धृषतो धृषन्मनः । बृहच्छ्रवा असुरो बर्हणा कृतः पुरो हरिभ्यां वृषभो रथो हि षः ॥
mantras.transliteration: arcā dive bṛhate śūṣyaṃ vacaḥ svakṣatraṃ yasya dhṛṣato dhṛṣanmanaḥ | bṛhacchravā asuro barhaṇā kṛtaḥ puro haribhyāṃ vṛṣabho ratho hi ṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Offer exhilarating praises to the great and illustrious Indra, of whom, undaunted, the steady mind is concentrated in its own firmness; for he, who is of great renown, the giver of rain, the repeller of enemies, who is obeyed his steeds, the showerer (of bounties), is hastening hither.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं दिवो बृहतः सानु कोपयोऽव त्मना धृषता शम्बरं भिनत् । यन्मायिनो व्रन्दिनो मन्दिना धृषच्छितां गभस्तिमशनिं पृतन्यसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ divo bṛhataḥ sānu kopayo'va tmanā dhṛṣatā śambaraṃ bhinat | yanmāyino vrandino mandinā dhṛṣacchitāṃ gabhastimaśaniṃ pṛtanyasi ||

translations.english: You have shaken the summit of the spacious heaven; you have slain Śambara by your resolute self; you have hurled with exulting and determined mind the sharp and bright-rayed thunderbolt against assembled Asuras.

mantras.sanskrit: नि यद्वृणक्षि श्वसनस्य मूर्धनि शुष्णस्य चिद्व्रन्दिनो रोरुवद्वना । प्राचीनेन मनसा बर्हणावता यदद्या चित्कृणवः कस्त्वा परि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni yadvṛṇakṣi śvasanasya mūrdhani śuṣṇasya cidvrandino roruvadvanā | prācīnena manasā barhaṇāvatā yadadyā citkṛṇavaḥ kastvā pari ||

translations.english: Since you, loud-shouting, have poured the rain upon the brow of the breathing (wind), and (on the head) of the maturing and absorbing (sun), who shall prevent you from doing today (as you will), endowed with an unaltered and resolute mind?

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमाविथ नर्यं तुर्वशं यदुं त्वं तुर्वीतिं वय्यं शतक्रतो । त्वं रथमेतशं कृत्व्ये धने त्वं पुरो नवतिं दम्भयो नव ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamāvitha naryaṃ turvaśaṃ yaduṃ tvaṃ turvītiṃ vayyaṃ śatakrato | tvaṃ rathametaśaṃ kṛtvye dhane tvaṃ puro navatiṃ dambhayo nava ||

translations.english: You have protected Narya, Turvaśa, Yadu and Turvīti, of the face of Vayya; you have protected their chariots and horses in the unavoidable engagement; you have demolished ninety-nine cities (of Śambara).

mantras.sanskrit: स घा राजा सत्पतिः शूशुवज्जनो रातहव्यः प्रति यः शासमिन्वति । उक्था वा यो अभिगृणाति राधसा दानुरस्मा उपरा पिन्वते दिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa ghā rājā satpatiḥ śūśuvajjano rātahavyaḥ prati yaḥ śāsaminvati | ukthā vā yo abhigṛṇāti rādhasā dānurasmā uparā pinvate divaḥ ||

translations.english: That eminent person n, the cherisher of the pious, (he instrumental tutor of the ceremony), promotes his own prosperity, who, while offering oblations to Indra, pronounces his praise; or who, along with the offerings he presents, recites hymns (in honour of him); for him the bounteous Indra causes the clouds to rain from heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: असमं क्षत्रमसमा मनीषा प्र सोमपा अपसा सन्तु नेमे । ये त इन्द्र ददुषो वर्धयन्ति महि क्षत्रं स्थविरं वृष्ण्यं च ॥
mantras.transliteration: asamaṃ kṣatramasamā manīṣā pra somapā apasā santu neme | ye ta indra daduṣo vardhayanti mahi kṣatraṃ sthaviraṃ vṛṣṇyaṃ ca ||

translations.english: Unequalled is his might; unequalled is his wisdom; may these drinkers of the Soma become equal to him the pious act, for they, Indra, who present to you oblations, augment your vast strength and your manly vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: तुभ्येदेते बहुला अद्रिदुग्धाश्चमूषदश्चमसा इन्द्रपानाः । व्यश्नुहि तर्पया काममेषामथा मनो वसुदेयाय कृष्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: tubhyedete bahulā adridugdhāścamūṣadaścamasā indrapānāḥ | vyaśnuhi tarpayā kāmameṣāmathā mano vasudeyāya kṛṣva ||

translations.english: These copious Soma juices, expressed with stones and contained in ladles, are prepared for you; they are the beverage of Indra; quaff them; satiate your appetite with them; and then fix your mind on the wealth that is to be given (to us).

mantras.sanskrit: अपामतिष्ठद्धरुणह्वरं तमोऽन्तर्वृत्रस्य जठरेषु पर्वतः । अभीमिन्द्रो नद्यो वव्रिणा हिता विश्वा अनुष्ठाः प्रवणेषु जिघ्नते ॥
mantras.transliteration: apāmatiṣṭhaddharuṇahvaraṃ tamo'ntarvṛtrasya jaṭhareṣu parvataḥ | abhīmindro nadyo vavriṇā hitā viśvā anuṣṭhāḥ pravaṇeṣu jighnate ||

translations.english: The darkness obstructed the current of the waters; the cloud was within the belly of Vṛtra; but Indra precipitated all the waters which the obstructor had concealed, in succession, down to the hollows (of the earth).

mantras.sanskrit: स शेवृधमधि धा द्युम्नमस्मे महि क्षत्रं जनाषाळिन्द्र तव्यम् । रक्षा च नो मघोनः पाहि सूरीन्राये च नः स्वपत्या इषे धाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa śevṛdhamadhi dhā dyumnamasme mahi kṣatraṃ janāṣāḷindra tavyam | rakṣā ca no maghonaḥ pāhi sūrīnrāye ca naḥ svapatyā iṣe dhāḥ ||

translations.english: Bestow upon us, Indra, increasing reputation; (bestow upon us) great, augmenting, and foe subduing strength; preserve us in affluence; cherish those who are wise; and supply us with wealth from which proceed excellent progeny and food.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवश्चिदस्य वरिमा वि पप्रथ इन्द्रं न मह्ना पृथिवी चन प्रति । भीमस्तुविष्माञ्चर्षणिभ्य आतपः शिशीते वज्रं तेजसे न वंसगः ॥
mantras.transliteration: divaścidasya varimā vi papratha indraṃ na mahnā pṛthivī cana prati | bhīmastuviṣmāñcarṣaṇibhya ātapaḥ śiśīte vajraṃ tejase na vaṃsagaḥ ||

translations.english: The amplitude of Indra was vaster than the (space of) heaven; earth was not comparable to him in bulk; formidable and most mighty, he has been ever the afflicter (of the enemies of) those men (who worship him); he has his thunderbolt for sharpness, as a bull (his horns).

mantras.sanskrit: सो अर्णवो न नद्यः समुद्रियः प्रति गृभ्णाति विश्रिता वरीमभिः । इन्द्रः सोमस्य पीतये वृषायते सनात्स युध्म ओजसा पनस्यते ॥
mantras.transliteration: so arṇavo na nadyaḥ samudriyaḥ prati gṛbhṇāti viśritā varīmabhiḥ | indraḥ somasya pītaye vṛṣāyate sanātsa yudhma ojasā panasyate ||

translations.english: The firmament-abiding Indra graps the wide-spread waters with his comprehenisve faculties, as the ocean (receives the rivers); he rushes (impetuous) as a bull, to drik of the Soma; he, the warrior, even covets praise for his prowess.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं तमिन्द्र पर्वतं न भोजसे महो नृम्णस्य धर्मणामिरज्यसि । प्र वीर्येण देवताति चेकिते विश्वस्मा उग्रः कर्मणे पुरोहितः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ tamindra parvataṃ na bhojase maho nṛmṇasya dharmaṇāmirajyasi | pra vīryeṇa devatāti cekite viśvasmā ugraḥ karmaṇe purohitaḥ ||

translations.english: You Indra, have not (struck) the cloud for (your own) enjoyment; you rulest over those who are possessed of great wealth; that divinity is known by us to surpass all others in strength; the haughty (Indra) takes precedence of all gods, on account of his exploits.

mantras.sanskrit: स इद्वने नमस्युभिर्वचस्यते चारु जनेषु प्रब्रुवाण इन्द्रियम् । वृषा छन्दुर्भवति हर्यतो वृषा क्षेमेण धेनां मघवा यदिन्वति ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa idvane namasyubhirvacasyate cāru janeṣu prabruvāṇa indriyam | vṛṣā chandurbhavati haryato vṛṣā kṣemeṇa dhenāṃ maghavā yadinvati ||

translations.english: He verily is glorified by adoring (sages) in the forest; he proclaims his beautiful vigour amongst men ; he is the granter of their wishes (to those who solicit him); he is the encourager of those who desire to worship (him), when the wealthy offerer of oblations, enjoying his protection, recites his praise.

mantras.sanskrit: स इन्महानि समिथानि मज्मना कृणोति युध्म ओजसा जनेभ्यः । अधा चन श्रद्दधति त्विषीमत इन्द्राय वज्रं निघनिघ्नते वधम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa inmahāni samithāni majmanā kṛṇoti yudhma ojasā janebhyaḥ | adhā cana śraddadhati tviṣīmata indrāya vajraṃ nighanighnate vadham ||

translations.english: Indra the warrior, engages in many great conflicts for (the good of) man, with overwhelming prowess; when he hurls his fatal shaft, every one immediately has faith in the resplendent Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: स हि श्रवस्युः सदनानि कृत्रिमा क्ष्मया वृधान ओजसा विनाशयन् । ज्योतींषि कृण्वन्नवृकाणि यज्यवेऽव सुक्रतुः सर्तवा अपः सृजत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa hi śravasyuḥ sadanāni kṛtrimā kṣmayā vṛdhāna ojasā vināśayan | jyotīṃṣi kṛṇvannavṛkāṇi yajyave'va sukratuḥ sartavā apaḥ sṛjat ||

translations.english: Ambitious of renown, destroying the well-built dwellings of the asuras, expanding like the earth, and setting the (heavenly) luminaries free from concealment, he, the performer of good deeds, enables the waters to flow for the benefit of his worshippers.

mantras.sanskrit: दानाय मनः सोमपावन्नस्तु तेऽर्वाञ्चा हरी वन्दनश्रुदा कृधि । यमिष्ठासः सारथयो य इन्द्र ते न त्वा केता आ दभ्नुवन्ति भूर्णयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dānāya manaḥ somapāvannastu te'rvāñcā harī vandanaśrudā kṛdhi | yamiṣṭhāsaḥ sārathayo ya indra te na tvā ketā ā dabhnuvanti bhūrṇayaḥ ||

translations.english: Drinker of Soma, may your mind incline to grant our desires; hearer of praises, let your coursers be present (at our sacrifice); your charioteers are skillful in restraining (your steeds); nor, Indra, can crafty (enemies) bearing arms prevail against you.

mantras.sanskrit: अप्रक्षितं वसु बिभर्षि हस्तयोरषाळ्हं सहस्तन्वि श्रुतो दधे । आवृतासोऽवतासो न कर्तृभिस्तनूषु ते क्रतव इन्द्र भूरयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aprakṣitaṃ vasu bibharṣi hastayoraṣāḷhaṃ sahastanvi śruto dadhe | āvṛtāso'vatāso na kartṛbhistanūṣu te kratava indra bhūrayaḥ ||

translations.english: You hold in your hands unexhausted wealth; you, renowned (Indra), have irresistible strength in your body; your limbs are invested with (glorious) exploits, as well as (are surrounded by those who come for water); in your member, Indra, are many exploits.

mantras.sanskrit: एष प्र पूर्वीरव तस्य चम्रिषोऽत्यो न योषामुदयंस्त भुर्वणिः । दक्षं महे पाययते हिरण्ययं रथमावृत्या हरियोगमृभ्वसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa pra pūrvīrava tasya camriṣo'tyo na yoṣāmudayaṃsta bhurvaṇiḥ | dakṣaṃ mahe pāyayate hiraṇyayaṃ rathamāvṛtyā hariyogamṛbhvasam ||

translations.english: Veracious (Indra) has risen up (as ardently) as a horse (approaches) a mare, to partake of the copious libations (contained) in the (sacrificial) ladles; having stayed his well-horsed, golden, and splendid chariot, heplies himself, capable of heroid (actions with Soma).

mantras.sanskrit: तं गूर्तयो नेमन्निषः परीणसः समुद्रं न संचरणे सनिष्यवः । पतिं दक्षस्य विदथस्य नू सहो गिरिं न वेना अधि रोह तेजसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ gūrtayo nemanniṣaḥ parīṇasaḥ samudraṃ na saṃcaraṇe saniṣyavaḥ | patiṃ dakṣasya vidathasya nū saho giriṃ na venā adhi roha tejasā ||

translations.english: His adorers, bearing oblations, are thronging round (him), as (merchants) covetous of gain crowd the ocean (in vessels) on a voyage ascend quickly, with a hymn to the powerful Indra, the protector of the solemn sacrifice, as wome (climb) a mountain.

mantras.sanskrit: स तुर्वणिर्महाँ अरेणु पौंस्ये गिरेर्भृष्टिर्न भ्राजते तुजा शवः । येन शुष्णं मायिनमायसो मदे दुध्र आभूषु रामयन्नि दामनि ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa turvaṇirmahā~ areṇu pauṃsye girerbhṛṣṭirna bhrājate tujā śavaḥ | yena śuṣṇaṃ māyinamāyaso made dudhra ābhūṣu rāmayanni dāmani ||

translations.english: He is quick in action, and mighty; his faultless and desructive prowess shines in manly (conflict) like the peak of a mountain (afar), with which, clothed in metal (armour), he, the supressor of the malignant, when exhilarated (by Soma), cast the wily Śuṣṇa into prison and into bonds.

mantras.sanskrit: देवी यदि तविषी त्वावृधोतय इन्द्रं सिषक्त्युषसं न सूर्यः । यो धृष्णुना शवसा बाधते तम इयर्ति रेणुं बृहदर्हरिष्वणिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: devī yadi taviṣī tvāvṛdhotaya indraṃ siṣaktyuṣasaṃ na sūryaḥ | yo dhṛṣṇunā śavasā bādhate tama iyarti reṇuṃ bṛhadarhariṣvaṇiḥ ||

translations.english: Divine strength waits, like the sun upon the dawn, upon that Indra who is made more powerful for protection by you, (his worshipper), who with resolute vigour resists the gloom, and inflicts severe castigation uon his enemies, making them cry aloud (with pain).

mantras.sanskrit: वि यत्तिरो धरुणमच्युतं रजोऽतिष्ठिपो दिव आतासु बर्हणा । स्वर्मीळ्हे यन्मद इन्द्र हर्ष्याहन्वृत्रं निरपामौब्जो अर्णवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi yattiro dharuṇamacyutaṃ rajo'tiṣṭhipo diva ātāsu barhaṇā | svarmīḷhe yanmada indra harṣyāhanvṛtraṃ nirapāmaubjo arṇavam ||

translations.english: . When you, destroying Indra, did distribute the (previously) hidden life-sustaining, undecaying waters through the different quarters of the heaven, then, animated (by Soma), you did engage in battle, and with exulting (prowess) slew Vṛtra, and did send down an ocean of waters.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं दिवो धरुणं धिष ओजसा पृथिव्या इन्द्र सदनेषु माहिनः । त्वं सुतस्य मदे अरिणा अपो वि वृत्रस्य समया पाष्यारुजः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ divo dharuṇaṃ dhiṣa ojasā pṛthivyā indra sadaneṣu māhinaḥ | tvaṃ sutasya made ariṇā apo vi vṛtrasya samayā pāṣyārujaḥ ||

translations.english: You, mighty Indra, send down from the heaven by your power, upon the realms of earth, the (world) sustaining rain; exhilarated (by Soma), you have expelled the waters (from the clouds), and have crushed Vṛtra by a solid rock.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र मंहिष्ठाय बृहते बृहद्रये सत्यशुष्माय तवसे मतिं भरे । अपामिव प्रवणे यस्य दुर्धरं राधो विश्वायु शवसे अपावृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra maṃhiṣṭhāya bṛhate bṛhadraye satyaśuṣmāya tavase matiṃ bhare | apāmiva pravaṇe yasya durdharaṃ rādho viśvāyu śavase apāvṛtam ||

translations.english: I offer especial praise to the most bountiful, the excellent, th eopulent, the verily powerful and stately Indra, whose irresistible impetuosity is like (the rush) of waters down a precipice, and by whom widely-diffused wealth is laid open (to his worshippers) to sustain (their) strength.

mantras.sanskrit: अध ते विश्वमनु हासदिष्टय आपो निम्नेव सवना हविष्मतः । यत्पर्वते न समशीत हर्यत इन्द्रस्य वज्रः श्नथिता हिरण्ययः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha te viśvamanu hāsadiṣṭaya āpo nimneva savanā haviṣmataḥ | yatparvate na samaśīta haryata indrasya vajraḥ śnathitā hiraṇyayaḥ ||

translations.english: All the world, Indra, was intent upon your worship; the oblations of the sacrificer (flowed) like water (falling) to a depth); for the fatal golden thunderbolt of Indra, when hurling it (against the foe), did not sleep upon the mountain.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मै भीमाय नमसा समध्वर उषो न शुभ्र आ भरा पनीयसे । यस्य धाम श्रवसे नामेन्द्रियं ज्योतिरकारि हरितो नायसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmai bhīmāya namasā samadhvara uṣo na śubhra ā bharā panīyase | yasya dhāma śravase nāmendriyaṃ jyotirakāri harito nāyase ||

translations.english: Beautiful Uṣas, now present the oblation in this rite to the formidable, praise-deserving Indra, whose all-sustaining, celebrated, and characteristic radiance has impelled him hither and thither, (in quest) of (sacrificial) food, as (a charioteer drives) his horses (in various directions).

mantras.sanskrit: इमे त इन्द्र ते वयं पुरुष्टुत ये त्वारभ्य चरामसि प्रभूवसो । नहि त्वदन्यो गिर्वणो गिरः सघत्क्षोणीरिव प्रति नो हर्य तद्वचः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ime ta indra te vayaṃ puruṣṭuta ye tvārabhya carāmasi prabhūvaso | nahi tvadanyo girvaṇo giraḥ saghatkṣoṇīriva prati no harya tadvacaḥ ||

translations.english: Much-lauded and most opulent Indra, we are thy, who, relying (on your favour), approach you; accepter of praise, no other than you receie our commendations; be plural ased (with our address), as the earth (cherishes) her creatures.

mantras.sanskrit: भूरि त इन्द्र वीर्यं तव स्मस्यस्य स्तोतुर्मघवन्काममा पृण । अनु ते द्यौर्बृहती वीर्यं मम इयं च ते पृथिवी नेम ओजसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhūri ta indra vīryaṃ tava smasyasya stoturmaghavankāmamā pṛṇa | anu te dyaurbṛhatī vīryaṃ mama iyaṃ ca te pṛthivī nema ojase ||

translations.english: Great is your prowess, Indra; we are yours; satisfy Maghavan, the desires of this your worshipper, the vast heaven has acknowledged your might; this earth has been bowed down through your vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं तमिन्द्र पर्वतं महामुरुं वज्रेण वज्रिन्पर्वशश्चकर्तिथ । अवासृजो निवृताः सर्तवा अपः सत्रा विश्वं दधिषे केवलं सहः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ tamindra parvataṃ mahāmuruṃ vajreṇa vajrinparvaśaścakartitha | avāsṛjo nivṛtāḥ sartavā apaḥ satrā viśvaṃ dadhiṣe kevalaṃ sahaḥ ||

translations.english: You, thunderer, have shattered with your bolt the broad and massive cloud into fragments, and have sent down the waters that were confined in it, to flow (at will); verily you alone possess all power.

mantras.sanskrit: नू चित्सहोजा अमृतो नि तुन्दते होता यद्दूतो अभवद्विवस्वतः । वि साधिष्ठेभिः पथिभी रजो मम आ देवताता हविषा विवासति ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū citsahojā amṛto ni tundate hotā yaddūto abhavadvivasvataḥ | vi sādhiṣṭhebhiḥ pathibhī rajo mama ā devatātā haviṣā vivāsati ||

translations.english: The strength-genitive rated, immortal Agni quickly issues forth, when he is the invoker of the gods, and the messenger (of the worshipper) (then proceeding) by suitable paths, he has made the firmament, and worships (the deities) in the sacrifice with oblationṣ

mantras.sanskrit: आ स्वमद्म युवमानो अजरस्तृष्वविष्यन्नतसेषु तिष्ठति । अत्यो न पृष्ठं प्रुषितस्य रोचते दिवो न सानु स्तनयन्नचिक्रदत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā svamadma yuvamāno ajarastṛṣvaviṣyannataseṣu tiṣṭhati | atyo na pṛṣṭhaṃ pruṣitasya rocate divo na sānu stanayannacikradat ||

translations.english: Undecaying Agni, combining his food (with his flame), and devouring it quickly, ascends the dry wood; the blaze of theconsuming (element) spreads like a (fleet) courser, and roars like a roaring (cloud) in the height of heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: क्राणा रुद्रेभिर्वसुभिः पुरोहितो होता निषत्तो रयिषाळमर्त्यः । रथो न विक्ष्वृञ्जसान आयुषु व्यानुषग्वार्या देव ऋण्वति ॥
mantras.transliteration: krāṇā rudrebhirvasubhiḥ purohito hotā niṣatto rayiṣāḷamartyaḥ | ratho na vikṣvṛñjasāna āyuṣu vyānuṣagvāryā deva ṛṇvati ||

translations.english: The immortal, and resplendent Agni, the bearer of oblations, honoured by the Rudras and the Vasus the invoker of the gods, who presides over oblations and is the distributor of riches, praised by his worshippers, and admired like a chariot amongst mankind, accepts the oblations that are successively presented.

mantras.sanskrit: वि वातजूतो अतसेषु तिष्ठते वृथा जुहूभिः सृण्या तुविष्वणिः । तृषु यदग्ने वनिनो वृषायसे कृष्णं त एम रुशदूर्मे अजर ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi vātajūto ataseṣu tiṣṭhate vṛthā juhūbhiḥ sṛṇyā tuviṣvaṇiḥ | tṛṣu yadagne vanino vṛṣāyase kṛṣṇaṃ ta ema ruśadūrme ajara ||

translations.english: Excited by the wind, and roaring loudly, Agni penetrates easily with his flames and diffusive (intensity) among the timber; when, undecaying and fiercely-blazing Agni, you rush rapidly like a bull amongst the forest trees, your path is blackened.

mantras.sanskrit: तपुर्जम्भो वन आ वातचोदितो यूथे न साह्वाँ अव वाति वंसगः । अभिव्रजन्नक्षितं पाजसा रजः स्थातुश्चरथं भयते पतत्रिणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tapurjambho vana ā vātacodito yūthe na sāhvā~ ava vāti vaṃsagaḥ | abhivrajannakṣitaṃ pājasā rajaḥ sthātuścarathaṃ bhayate patatriṇaḥ ||

translations.english: The flame-weaponed and breeze-excited Agni, assailing the unexhaled moisture (of the trees), with all his strength, in a volume of fire, rushes triumphant (against all things) in the forest, like a bull, and all, whether stationary or moveable, are afraid of him as he flies along.

mantras.sanskrit: दधुष्ट्वा भृगवो मानुषेष्वा रयिं न चारुं सुहवं जनेभ्यः । होतारमग्ने अतिथिं वरेण्यं मित्रं न शेवं दिव्याय जन्मने ॥
mantras.transliteration: dadhuṣṭvā bhṛgavo mānuṣeṣvā rayiṃ na cāruṃ suhavaṃ janebhyaḥ | hotāramagne atithiṃ vareṇyaṃ mitraṃ na śevaṃ divyāya janmane ||

translations.english: The Bhṛgus amongst men, for the sake of a divine birth, cherished you like a precious treasure Agni, who sacrifices for men, who are the invoker (of the gods), the (welcome) guest at sacrifices, and who are to be valued like an affectionate friend.

mantras.sanskrit: होतारं सप्त जुह्वो यजिष्ठं यं वाघतो वृणते अध्वरेषु । अग्निं विश्वेषामरतिं वसूनां सपर्यामि प्रयसा यामि रत्नम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: hotāraṃ sapta juhvo yajiṣṭhaṃ yaṃ vāghato vṛṇate adhvareṣu | agniṃ viśveṣāmaratiṃ vasūnāṃ saparyāmi prayasā yāmi ratnam ||

translations.english: I worship with oblations that Agni whom the seven invoking priests invite as the invoker of the gods; who is most worthy of worship at sacrifices, and who is the donor of all riches; I solicit of him wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: अच्छिद्रा सूनो सहसो नो अद्य स्तोतृभ्यो मित्रमहः शर्म यच्छ । अग्ने गृणन्तमंहस उरुष्योर्जो नपात्पूर्भिरायसीभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: acchidrā sūno sahaso no adya stotṛbhyo mitramahaḥ śarma yaccha | agne gṛṇantamaṃhasa uruṣyorjo napātpūrbhirāyasībhiḥ ||

translations.english: Son of strength, favourably-shining Agni, grant to your worshipper on this occasion uninterrupted felicity; offspring of food, preserve him who praises you from sin with guards of metal.

mantras.sanskrit: भवा वरूथं गृणते विभावो भवा मघवन्मघवद्भ्यः शर्म । उरुष्याग्ने अंहसो गृणन्तं प्रातर्मक्षू धियावसुर्जगम्यात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhavā varūthaṃ gṛṇate vibhāvo bhavā maghavanmaghavadbhyaḥ śarma | uruṣyāgne aṃhaso gṛṇantaṃ prātarmakṣū dhiyāvasurjagamyāt ||

translations.english: Variously-shining Agni, be a shelter to him who praises you; be prosperity, Maghavan, to the wealthy (offerers of oblations); protect, Agni, your worshipper from sin; may Agni, who is rich with righteous acts, come (to us) quickly in the morning.

mantras.sanskrit: वया इदग्ने अग्नयस्ते अन्ये त्वे विश्वे अमृता मादयन्ते । वैश्वानर नाभिरसि क्षितीनां स्थूणेव जनाँ उपमिद्ययन्थ ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayā idagne agnayaste anye tve viśve amṛtā mādayante | vaiśvānara nābhirasi kṣitīnāṃ sthūṇeva janā~ upamidyayantha ||

translations.english: Whatever other fires there may be, they are but ramifications, Agni, of you; but they all rejoice, being immortal in you; you, Vaiśvānara, are the navel of men, and suppor tthem like a deep-plural nted column.

mantras.sanskrit: मूर्धा दिवो नाभिरग्निः पृथिव्या अथाभवदरती रोदस्योः । तं त्वा देवासोऽजनयन्त देवं वैश्वानर ज्योतिरिदार्याय ॥
mantras.transliteration: mūrdhā divo nābhiragniḥ pṛthivyā athābhavadaratī rodasyoḥ | taṃ tvā devāso'janayanta devaṃ vaiśvānara jyotiridāryāya ||

translations.english: Agni, the head of heaven, the navel of earth, became the ruler over both earth and heaven; all the gods engendered you, Vaiśvānara, in the form of light, for the venerable sage.

mantras.sanskrit: आ सूर्ये न रश्मयो ध्रुवासो वैश्वानरे दधिरेऽग्ना वसूनि । या पर्वतेष्वोषधीष्वप्सु या मानुषेष्वसि तस्य राजा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā sūrye na raśmayo dhruvāso vaiśvānare dadhire'gnā vasūni | yā parvateṣvoṣadhīṣvapsu yā mānuṣeṣvasi tasya rājā ||

translations.english: Treasures were deposited in the Agni, Vaiśvānara, like the permanent rays (of light) in the sun; you are the sovereign of all the treasures that exist in the mountains, in the herbs, in the waters, or amongst men.

mantras.sanskrit: बृहती इव सूनवे रोदसी गिरो होता मनुष्यो न दक्षः । स्वर्वते सत्यशुष्माय पूर्वीर्वैश्वानराय नृतमाय यह्वीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhatī iva sūnave rodasī giro hotā manuṣyo na dakṣaḥ | svarvate satyaśuṣmāya pūrvīrvaiśvānarāya nṛtamāya yahvīḥ ||

translations.english: . Heaven and earth expanded as it were for their son. The experienced sacrificer recites, like a bard, many ancient and copious praises addressed to the graceful-moving, truly-vigorous, and all-guiding Vaiśvānara.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवश्चित्ते बृहतो जातवेदो वैश्वानर प्र रिरिचे महित्वम् । राजा कृष्टीनामसि मानुषीणां युधा देवेभ्यो वरिवश्चकर्थ ॥
mantras.transliteration: divaścitte bṛhato jātavedo vaiśvānara pra ririce mahitvam | rājā kṛṣṭīnāmasi mānuṣīṇāṃ yudhā devebhyo varivaścakartha ||

translations.english: Vaiśvānara, who knows all that are born, your magnitude has exceeded that of the spacious heaven; you are the monarch of manu-descended men; you have regained for the gods in battle, the wealth (carries off by the asuras).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र नू महित्वं वृषभस्य वोचं यं पूरवो वृत्रहणं सचन्ते । वैश्वानरो दस्युमग्निर्जघन्वाँ अधूनोत्काष्ठा अव शम्बरं भेत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra nū mahitvaṃ vṛṣabhasya vocaṃ yaṃ pūravo vṛtrahaṇaṃ sacante | vaiśvānaro dasyumagnirjaghanvā~ adhūnotkāṣṭhā ava śambaraṃ bhet ||

translations.english: I extol the greatness of that showerer of rain whom men celebrate as the slayer of Vṛtra; the Agni, Vaiśvānara, slew the stealer (of the waters) and sent them down (upon earth), and clove the (obstructing) cloud.

mantras.sanskrit: वैश्वानरो महिम्ना विश्वकृष्टिर्भरद्वाजेषु यजतो विभावा । शातवनेये शतिनीभिरग्निः पुरुणीथे जरते सूनृतावान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vaiśvānaro mahimnā viśvakṛṣṭirbharadvājeṣu yajato vibhāvā | śātavaneye śatinībhiragniḥ puruṇīthe jarate sūnṛtāvān ||

translations.english: Vaiśvānara by his magnitude is all men, and is to be worshipped as the diffuser of manifold light in offerings of nutritious viands; Agni, the speaker of truth, praises with many commendations Puruṇītha, the son of Śātavani.

mantras.sanskrit: वह्निं यशसं विदथस्य केतुं सुप्राव्यं दूतं सद्योअर्थम् । द्विजन्मानं रयिमिव प्रशस्तं रातिं भरद्भृगवे मातरिश्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: vahniṃ yaśasaṃ vidathasya ketuṃ suprāvyaṃ dūtaṃ sadyoartham | dvijanmānaṃ rayimiva praśastaṃ rātiṃ bharadbhṛgave mātariśvā ||

translations.english: Mātariśvan brought, as a friend, to Bhṛgu, the celebrated Vahni, the illuminato of sacrifices, the careful protector (of his votaries), the swift-moving messenger (of the gods), the offspring of two parents, (to be to him) as it were a precious treasure.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य शासुरुभयासः सचन्ते हविष्मन्त उशिजो ये च मर्ताः । दिवश्चित्पूर्वो न्यसादि होतापृच्छ्यो विश्पतिर्विक्षु वेधाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya śāsurubhayāsaḥ sacante haviṣmanta uśijo ye ca martāḥ | divaścitpūrvo nyasādi hotāpṛcchyo viśpatirvikṣu vedhāḥ ||

translations.english: Both (gods and men) are the worshippers of this ruler; those who are to be desired (of the gods), and those who are mortal, beaing oblations; for this venerable invoker (of the gods), the lord of men, and distributor (of desired benefits), was plural ced by the officiating priests (upon the altar), before the sun was in the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: तं नव्यसी हृद आ जायमानमस्मत्सुकीर्तिर्मधुजिह्वमश्याः । यमृत्विजो वृजने मानुषासः प्रयस्वन्त आयवो जीजनन्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ navyasī hṛda ā jāyamānamasmatsukīrtirmadhujihvamaśyāḥ | yamṛtvijo vṛjane mānuṣāsaḥ prayasvanta āyavo jījananta ||

translations.english: May our newest celebration come before that Agni, who is sweet-tongued, and is to be engendered in the heart; whom men, the descendants of Manu, sacrificing and presenting oblations to him, beget in the time and battle.

mantras.sanskrit: उशिक्पावको वसुर्मानुषेषु वरेण्यो होताधायि विक्षु । दमूना गृहपतिर्दम आँ अग्निर्भुवद्रयिपती रयीणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uśikpāvako vasurmānuṣeṣu vareṇyo hotādhāyi vikṣu | damūnā gṛhapatirdama ā~ agnirbhuvadrayipatī rayīṇām ||

translations.english: Agni, the desirable, the purifying, the giver of dwellings, the excellent, the invoker (of the gods) has been plural ced (upon the altar) among men; may he be inimical (to our foes), the protector of (our) dwellings and the guardian of the treasures in (this) mansion.

mantras.sanskrit: तं त्वा वयं पतिमग्ने रयीणां प्र शंसामो मतिभिर्गोतमासः । आशुं न वाजम्भरं मर्जयन्तः प्रातर्मक्षू धियावसुर्जगम्यात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ tvā vayaṃ patimagne rayīṇāṃ pra śaṃsāmo matibhirgotamāsaḥ | āśuṃ na vājambharaṃ marjayantaḥ prātarmakṣū dhiyāvasurjagamyāt ||

translations.english: We, born of the race of Gotama, praise you, Agni, with acceptable (hymns), as the lord of riches; rubbing you, the bearer of oblations, (as a rider rubs down), a horse; may he who has acquired wealth by sacred rites, come hither quickly in the morning.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मा इदु प्र तवसे तुराय प्रयो न हर्मि स्तोमं माहिनाय । ऋचीषमायाध्रिगव ओहमिन्द्राय ब्रह्माणि राततमा ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmā idu pra tavase turāya prayo na harmi stomaṃ māhināya | ṛcīṣamāyādhrigava ohamindrāya brahmāṇi rātatamā ||

translations.english: I offer adoration to that powerful, rapid, mighty, praise-meriting, and unobstructed Indra; adoration that is acceptable, and oblations that are grateful, as food (to a hungry man).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मा इदु प्रय इव प्र यंसि भराम्याङ्गूषं बाधे सुवृक्ति । इन्द्राय हृदा मनसा मनीषा प्रत्नाय पत्ये धियो मर्जयन्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmā idu praya iva pra yaṃsi bharāmyāṅgūṣaṃ bādhe suvṛkti | indrāya hṛdā manasā manīṣā pratnāya patye dhiyo marjayanta ||

translations.english: I offer (oblations, acceptable as) food (to the hungry), to that Indra; I raise (to him) exclamations that may be of efficacy in discomfiting (my foe); others (also) worship Indra, the ancient lord, in heart, in mind, and in understanding.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मा इदु त्यमुपमं स्वर्षां भराम्याङ्गूषमास्येन । मंहिष्ठमच्छोक्तिभिर्मतीनां सुवृक्तिभिः सूरिं वावृधध्यै ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmā idu tyamupamaṃ svarṣāṃ bharāmyāṅgūṣamāsyena | maṃhiṣṭhamacchoktibhirmatīnāṃ suvṛktibhiḥ sūriṃ vāvṛdhadhyai ||

translations.english: I offer with my mouth a loud acclamation, with powerful and pure words of praise, to exalt him who is the type (of all), the giver (of good things), the great, the wise.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मा इदु स्तोमं सं हिनोमि रथं न तष्टेव तत्सिनाय । गिरश्च गिर्वाहसे सुवृक्तीन्द्राय विश्वमिन्वं मेधिराय ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmā idu stomaṃ saṃ hinomi rathaṃ na taṣṭeva tatsināya | giraśca girvāhase suvṛktīndrāya viśvaminvaṃ medhirāya ||

translations.english: I prepare praises fo rhim, as a carpenter constructs a car, (that the driver) may thence (obtain) food; praises well deserved, to him who is entitled to commendation, and excellent oblations to the wise Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मा इदु सप्तिमिव श्रवस्येन्द्रायार्कं जुह्वा समञ्जे । वीरं दानौकसं वन्दध्यै पुरां गूर्तश्रवसं दर्माणम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmā idu saptimiva śravasyendrāyārkaṃ juhvā samañje | vīraṃ dānaukasaṃ vandadhyai purāṃ gūrtaśravasaṃ darmāṇam ||

translations.english: To propitiate that Indra for the sake of food, I combinepraise with utterance, as (a man harnesses) a horse (to a car), in order to celebrate the heroic, munificent, and food-conferring Indra, the destroyer of the cities (of the asuras).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मा इदु त्वष्टा तक्षद्वज्रं स्वपस्तमं स्वर्यं रणाय । वृत्रस्य चिद्विदद्येन मर्म तुजन्नीशानस्तुजता कियेधाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmā idu tvaṣṭā takṣadvajraṃ svapastamaṃ svaryaṃ raṇāya | vṛtrasya cidvidadyena marma tujannīśānastujatā kiyedhāḥ ||

translations.english: For that Indra, verily Tvaṣṭā sharpened the well-acting, sure-aimed thunderbolt for the battle, with which fatal (weapon) the foe-subduing and mighty sovereign severed the limbs of Vṛtra.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्येदु मातुः सवनेषु सद्यो महः पितुं पपिवाञ्चार्वन्ना । मुषायद्विष्णुः पचतं सहीयान्विध्यद्वराहं तिरो अद्रिमस्ता ॥
mantras.transliteration: asyedu mātuḥ savaneṣu sadyo mahaḥ pituṃ papivāñcārvannā | muṣāyadviṣṇuḥ pacataṃ sahīyānvidhyadvarāhaṃ tiro adrimastā ||

translations.english: Quickly quaffing the libations, and devouring the grateful viands (presented) at the three (daily) sacrifices which are dedicated to the creator (of the world), he, the pervadere of the universe, stole the ripe (treasures of the asuras); the vanquisher (of his foes), the hurler of the thunderbolt, encountering pierced the cloud.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मा इदु ग्नाश्चिद्देवपत्नीरिन्द्रायार्कमहिहत्य ऊवुः । परि द्यावापृथिवी जभ्र उर्वी नास्य ते महिमानं परि ष्टः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmā idu gnāściddevapatnīrindrāyārkamahihatya ūvuḥ | pari dyāvāpṛthivī jabhra urvī nāsya te mahimānaṃ pari ṣṭaḥ ||

translations.english: To that Indra the women, the wives of the gods, addressed their hymns, on the destruction of Ahi; he encompasses the extensive heaven and earth; they two do not surpass your vastness.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्येदेव प्र रिरिचे महित्वं दिवस्पृथिव्याः पर्यन्तरिक्षात् । स्वराळिन्द्रो दम आ विश्वगूर्तः स्वरिरमत्रो ववक्षे रणाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: asyedeva pra ririce mahitvaṃ divaspṛthivyāḥ paryantarikṣāt | svarāḷindro dama ā viśvagūrtaḥ svariramatro vavakṣe raṇāya ||

translations.english: His magnitude verily exceeds that of the heaven, and earth and sky; Indra, self-irradiating in his dwelling, equal to every exploit, engaged with no unworthy foe, and killed in conflict, calls to battle.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्येदेव शवसा शुषन्तं वि वृश्चद्वज्रेण वृत्रमिन्द्रः । गा न व्राणा अवनीरमुञ्चदभि श्रवो दावने सचेताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asyedeva śavasā śuṣantaṃ vi vṛścadvajreṇa vṛtramindraḥ | gā na vrāṇā avanīramuñcadabhi śravo dāvane sacetāḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, by his vigour, cut to pieces with his thunderbolt Vṛtra, the absorber (of moisture), and set free the preserving waters, like cows (recovered from thieves); and, consentient (to the wishes)of the giver of the oblation, (grants him) food.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्येदु त्वेषसा रन्त सिन्धवः परि यद्वज्रेण सीमयच्छत् । ईशानकृद्दाशुषे दशस्यन्तुर्वीतये गाधं तुर्वणिः कः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asyedu tveṣasā ranta sindhavaḥ pari yadvajreṇa sīmayacchat | īśānakṛddāśuṣe daśasyanturvītaye gādhaṃ turvaṇiḥ kaḥ ||

translations.english: Through his power, the rivers sport, since he has opened (a way for them) by his thunderbolt; establishing his supremacy and granting a (recompense) to the giver (of the oblation), he, the swift-moving provided a resting plural ce for Tūrvīti.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मा इदु प्र भरा तूतुजानो वृत्राय वज्रमीशानः कियेधाः । गोर्न पर्व वि रदा तिरश्चेष्यन्नर्णांस्यपां चरध्यै ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmā idu pra bharā tūtujāno vṛtrāya vajramīśānaḥ kiyedhāḥ | gorna parva vi radā tiraśceṣyannarṇāṃsyapāṃ caradhyai ||

translations.english: Indra, who are the quick moving and strength-endowed lord (of all), hurl your thunderbolt against this Vṛtra and sever his joints, as (butchers cut up) a cow, that the rains may issue from him, and the waters flow (over the earth).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्येदु प्र ब्रूहि पूर्व्याणि तुरस्य कर्माणि नव्य उक्थैः । युधे यदिष्णान आयुधान्यृघायमाणो निरिणाति शत्रून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asyedu pra brūhi pūrvyāṇi turasya karmāṇi navya ukthaiḥ | yudhe yadiṣṇāna āyudhānyṛghāyamāṇo niriṇāti śatrūn ||

translations.english: Proclaim, with new hymns, the former exploits of that quick-moving Indra, when wielding his weapons in battle, he encounters and destroys his enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्येदु भिया गिरयश्च दृळ्हा द्यावा च भूमा जनुषस्तुजेते । उपो वेनस्य जोगुवान ओणिं सद्यो भुवद्वीर्याय नोधाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asyedu bhiyā girayaśca dṛḷhā dyāvā ca bhūmā januṣastujete | upo venasya joguvāna oṇiṃ sadyo bhuvadvīryāya nodhāḥ ||

translations.english: Through fear of him, the stable mountains (are still), and through dread of his appearance, heaven and earth tremble; may, Nodhas, praising repeatedly the preserving power of that beloved Indra, be speedily (blessed) with vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मा इदु त्यदनु दाय्येषामेको यद्वव्ने भूरेरीशानः । प्रैतशं सूर्ये पस्पृधानं सौवश्व्ये सुष्विमावदिन्द्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmā idu tyadanu dāyyeṣāmeko yadvavne bhūrerīśānaḥ | praitaśaṃ sūrye paspṛdhānaṃ sauvaśvye suṣvimāvadindraḥ ||

translations.english: To him has that praise been offered which he, sole (victor over his foes), and lord of maniford wealth, prefers (to receive) from those (who praise him). Indra has defended the pious sacrificer Etaśa when contending with Sūrya, the son of Svaśva.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा ते हारियोजना सुवृक्तीन्द्र ब्रह्माणि गोतमासो अक्रन् । ऐषु विश्वपेशसं धियं धाः प्रातर्मक्षू धियावसुर्जगम्यात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā te hāriyojanā suvṛktīndra brahmāṇi gotamāso akran | aiṣu viśvapeśasaṃ dhiyaṃ dhāḥ prātarmakṣū dhiyāvasurjagamyāt ||

translations.english: Indra, harnesser of steeds, the descendants of Gotama have offered to you prayers of efficacy to secure your presence; bestow upon them every sort of affluence; may he who has acquired wealth by pious acts, come hither quickly in the morning.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र मन्महे शवसानाय शूषमाङ्गूषं गिर्वणसे अङ्गिरस्वत् । सुवृक्तिभिः स्तुवत ऋग्मियायार्चामार्कं नरे विश्रुताय ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra manmahe śavasānāya śūṣamāṅgūṣaṃ girvaṇase aṅgirasvat | suvṛktibhiḥ stuvata ṛgmiyāyārcāmārkaṃ nare viśrutāya ||

translations.english: We mediate like Aṅgiras, an acceptable adress to that powerful and praise-deserving Indra, who is to be adored by his worshippers (with prayers) of efficacy, to bring him to the ceremony; let us repeat a prayer to the celebrated leader of all.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वो महे महि नमो भरध्वमाङ्गूष्यं शवसानाय साम । येना नः पूर्वे पितरः पदज्ञा अर्चन्तो अङ्गिरसो गा अविन्दन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vo mahe mahi namo bharadhvamāṅgūṣyaṃ śavasānāya sāma | yenā naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ padajñā arcanto aṅgiraso gā avindan ||

translations.english: Do you, priests, offer to the vast and most powerful, Indra, earnest veneration, a chant fit to be sung aloud; for through him our forefathers, the Aṅgirasas, worshipping him, and knowing the footmark, recovered (the stolen) cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्याङ्गिरसां चेष्टौ विदत्सरमा तनयाय धासिम् । बृहस्पतिर्भिनदद्रिं विदद्गाः समुस्रियाभिर्वावशन्त नरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrasyāṅgirasāṃ ceṣṭau vidatsaramā tanayāya dhāsim | bṛhaspatirbhinadadriṃ vidadgāḥ samusriyābhirvāvaśanta naraḥ ||

translations.english: When the search was set on foot by Indra and the Aṅgirasas, Suramā secured food for her young; then Bṛhaspati slew the devourer and rescued the kine, and the gods, with the cattle, proclaimed their joy alouḍ

mantras.sanskrit: स सुष्टुभा स स्तुभा सप्त विप्रैः स्वरेणाद्रिं स्वर्यो नवग्वैः । सरण्युभिः फलिगमिन्द्र शक्र वलं रवेण दरयो दशग्वैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa suṣṭubhā sa stubhā sapta vipraiḥ svareṇādriṃ svaryo navagvaiḥ | saraṇyubhiḥ phaligamindra śakra valaṃ raveṇa darayo daśagvaiḥ ||

translations.english: Powerful Indra, who are to be gratified with a laudatory and well-accented hymn by the seven priests, whether engaged for nine months, or for ten; and, desirous of (safe) protection, you have terrified by your voice the divisible fructifying cloud.

mantras.sanskrit: गृणानो अङ्गिरोभिर्दस्म वि वरुषसा सूर्येण गोभिरन्धः । वि भूम्या अप्रथय इन्द्र सानु दिवो रज उपरमस्तभायः ॥
mantras.transliteration: gṛṇāno aṅgirobhirdasma vi varuṣasā sūryeṇa gobhirandhaḥ | vi bhūmyā aprathaya indra sānu divo raja uparamastabhāyaḥ ||

translations.english: Destroyer of foes, praised by the Aṅgirasas, you have scattered the darkness with the dawn, and with the rays of the sun; you have made straight the elevations of the earth; you have strengthened the foundations of the ethereal region.

mantras.sanskrit: तदु प्रयक्षतममस्य कर्म दस्मस्य चारुतममस्ति दंसः । उपह्वरे यदुपरा अपिन्वन्मध्वर्णसो नद्यश्चतस्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadu prayakṣatamamasya karma dasmasya cārutamamasti daṃsaḥ | upahvare yaduparā apinvanmadhvarṇaso nadyaścatasraḥ ||

translations.english: The deeds of that graceful Indra are most admirable; his exploits are most glorious, in that he has replenished the four rivers of sweet water, spread over the surface of the earth.

mantras.sanskrit: द्विता वि वव्रे सनजा सनीळे अयास्यः स्तवमानेभिरर्कैः । भगो न मेने परमे व्योमन्नधारयद्रोदसी सुदंसाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dvitā vi vavre sanajā sanīḷe ayāsyaḥ stavamānebhirarkaiḥ | bhago na mene parame vyomannadhārayadrodasī sudaṃsāḥ ||

translations.english: He who is not to be attained by violence, but (is easily propitiated) by those who praise him with sacred hymns, parted twofold the eternal and united (sphered of heaven and earth); the graceful Indra cherished the heaven and earth, like the sun in the august and most excellent sky.

mantras.sanskrit: सनाद्दिवं परि भूमा विरूपे पुनर्भुवा युवती स्वेभिरेवैः । कृष्णेभिरक्तोषा रुशद्भिर्वपुर्भिरा चरतो अन्यान्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: sanāddivaṃ pari bhūmā virūpe punarbhuvā yuvatī svebhirevaiḥ | kṛṣṇebhiraktoṣā ruśadbhirvapurbhirā carato anyānyā ||

translations.english: (Night and dawn), of various complexion, repeatedly born, but ever youthful, have traversed in their revolutions alternately, from a remote period, earth and heaven; night with her dark, dawn with her luminous limbs.

mantras.sanskrit: सनेमि सख्यं स्वपस्यमानः सूनुर्दाधार शवसा सुदंसाः । आमासु चिद्दधिषे पक्वमन्तः पयः कृष्णासु रुशद्रोहिणीषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: sanemi sakhyaṃ svapasyamānaḥ sūnurdādhāra śavasā sudaṃsāḥ | āmāsu ciddadhiṣe pakvamantaḥ payaḥ kṛṣṇāsu ruśadrohiṇīṣu ||

translations.english: The son of strength assiduous in good works, diligent in pious acts, retains his ancient friendship (for his votary). You, (Indra), provide within the yet immature cows, whether black or red, the mature and glossy milk.

mantras.sanskrit: सनात्सनीळा अवनीरवाता व्रता रक्षन्ते अमृताः सहोभिः । पुरू सहस्रा जनयो न पत्नीर्दुवस्यन्ति स्वसारो अह्रयाणम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sanātsanīḷā avanīravātā vratā rakṣante amṛtāḥ sahobhiḥ | purū sahasrā janayo na patnīrduvasyanti svasāro ahrayāṇam ||

translations.english: From a remote time the contiguous, unshifting, and unwearied fingers practise with (all) their energies many thousand acts of devotion (towards Indra); and like the wives (of the gods), the protecting sisters worship him who is without shame.

mantras.sanskrit: सनायुवो नमसा नव्यो अर्कैर्वसूयवो मतयो दस्म दद्रुः । पतिं न पत्नीरुशतीरुशन्तं स्पृशन्ति त्वा शवसावन्मनीषाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sanāyuvo namasā navyo arkairvasūyavo matayo dasma dadruḥ | patiṃ na patnīruśatīruśantaṃ spṛśanti tvā śavasāvanmanīṣāḥ ||

translations.english: Beautiful Indra, who are to be praised with holy hymns, the pious who are desirous of holy rites, those who are anxious for riches, and those who are wise, repair to you with veneration; powerful Indra, their minds adhere to you, as affectionate wives to a loving husbaṇḍ+

mantras.sanskrit: सनादेव तव रायो गभस्तौ न क्षीयन्ते नोप दस्यन्ति दस्म । द्युमाँ असि क्रतुमाँ इन्द्र धीरः शिक्षा शचीवस्तव नः शचीभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sanādeva tava rāyo gabhastau na kṣīyante nopa dasyanti dasma | dyumā~ asi kratumā~ indra dhīraḥ śikṣā śacīvastava naḥ śacībhiḥ ||

translations.english: Beautiful Indra, the riches that have long since been held in your hands have suffered neither loss nor diminution. You, Indra, are illustrious, addicted to good works, and resolute; enrich us, you who are diligent in action, by your acts.

mantras.sanskrit: सनायते गोतम इन्द्र नव्यमतक्षद्ब्रह्म हरियोजनाय । सुनीथाय नः शवसान नोधाः प्रातर्मक्षू धियावसुर्जगम्यात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sanāyate gotama indra navyamatakṣadbrahma hariyojanāya | sunīthāya naḥ śavasāna nodhāḥ prātarmakṣū dhiyāvasurjagamyāt ||

translations.english: Mighty Indra, Nodhas, the son of Gotama, has composed for us this new hymn, (addressed) to you, who have been forever, who harness your coursers (to your car) and are the sure guide (of all). May he who has acquired wealth by propitious acts, come hither quickly in the morning.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं महाँ इन्द्र यो ह शुष्मैर्द्यावा जज्ञानः पृथिवी अमे धाः । यद्ध ते विश्वा गिरयश्चिदभ्वा भिया दृळ्हासः किरणा नैजन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ mahā~ indra yo ha śuṣmairdyāvā jajñānaḥ pṛthivī ame dhāḥ | yaddha te viśvā girayaścidabhvā bhiyā dṛḷhāsaḥ kiraṇā naijan ||

translations.english: Indra, you are the mighty one, who, becoming manifest in (the hour of) alarm, did sustain by your energies heaven and earth; then, through fear of you, all creatures, and the mountains, and all other vast and solid things, trembled, like the (tremulous) rays of the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यद्धरी इन्द्र विव्रता वेरा ते वज्रं जरिता बाह्वोर्धात् । येनाविहर्यतक्रतो अमित्रान्पुर इष्णासि पुरुहूत पूर्वीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yaddharī indra vivratā verā te vajraṃ jaritā bāhvordhāt | yenāviharyatakrato amitrānpura iṣṇāsi puruhūta pūrvīḥ ||

translations.english: When, Indra, you harness your variously moving horses, your praiser plural ces your thunderbolt in your hands, wherewith, accom;oisher of undesired acts, you assail your enemies, and glorified by many, destroy their numerous cities.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं सत्य इन्द्र धृष्णुरेतान्त्वमृभुक्षा नर्यस्त्वं षाट् । त्वं शुष्णं वृजने पृक्ष आणौ यूने कुत्साय द्युमते सचाहन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ satya indra dhṛṣṇuretāntvamṛbhukṣā naryastvaṃ ṣāṭ | tvaṃ śuṣṇaṃ vṛjane pṛkṣa āṇau yūne kutsāya dyumate sacāhan ||

translations.english: You, Indra, the best of all beings, the assailer and humiliator (of your foes), the chief ot the Ṛbhus, the friend of man, the subduer of enemies, did aid the young and illustrious Kutsa, and slew Śuṣna, in the deadly and close-fought fight.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं ह त्यदिन्द्र चोदीः सखा वृत्रं यद्वज्रिन्वृषकर्मन्नुभ्नाः । यद्ध शूर वृषमणः पराचैर्वि दस्यूँर्योनावकृतो वृथाषाट् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ ha tyadindra codīḥ sakhā vṛtraṃ yadvajrinvṛṣakarmannubhnāḥ | yaddha śūra vṛṣamaṇaḥ parācairvi dasyū~ryonāvakṛto vṛthāṣāṭ ||

translations.english: You verily did animate him to (acquire) such (renown) as that which, sender of rain and wielder of the thunderbolt, you (dis-acquire) when you slew Vṛtra, and when, munificent hero, who easily conquer (your foes) you did put to fight the Dasyus in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं ह त्यदिन्द्रारिषण्यन्दृळ्हस्य चिन्मर्तानामजुष्टौ । व्यस्मदा काष्ठा अर्वते वर्घनेव वज्रिञ्छ्नथिह्यमित्रान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ ha tyadindrāriṣaṇyandṛḷhasya cinmartānāmajuṣṭau | vyasmadā kāṣṭhā arvate varghaneva vajriñchnathihyamitrān ||

translations.english: Do you, Indra, who are unwilling to harm any resolute (mortal), set open all the quarters (of the horizon) to the horses of us who praise you, (when we are exposed) to the aversion (of our enemies); and, wielder of the thunderbolt, demolish our foes, as with a club.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वां ह त्यदिन्द्रार्णसातौ स्वर्मीळ्हे नर आजा हवन्ते । तव स्वधाव इयमा समर्य ऊतिर्वाजेष्वतसाय्या भूत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāṃ ha tyadindrārṇasātau svarmīḷhe nara ājā havante | tava svadhāva iyamā samarya ūtirvājeṣvatasāyyā bhūt ||

translations.english: Men invoke you, such as you are, in the thick-throned and wealth-bestowing conflict. May this your succour, powerful Indra, ever be granted in war, worthy to be enjoyed (by warriors) in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं ह त्यदिन्द्र सप्त युध्यन्पुरो वज्रिन्पुरुकुत्साय दर्दः । बर्हिर्न यत्सुदासे वृथा वर्गंहो राजन्वरिवः पूरवे कः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ ha tyadindra sapta yudhyanpuro vajrinpurukutsāya dardaḥ | barhirna yatsudāse vṛthā vargaṃho rājanvarivaḥ pūrave kaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, warring on behalf of Purukutsa, you did overturn the seven cities; you did cut off for Sudāsa wealth of Aṅhas, as if (it had been a tuft) of sacred grass, and did give it to him, O king, ever satiating you (with oblations).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं त्यां न इन्द्र देव चित्रामिषमापो न पीपयः परिज्मन् । यया शूर प्रत्यस्मभ्यं यंसि त्मनमूर्जं न विश्वध क्षरध्यै ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ tyāṃ na indra deva citrāmiṣamāpo na pīpayaḥ parijman | yayā śūra pratyasmabhyaṃ yaṃsi tmanamūrjaṃ na viśvadha kṣaradhyai ||

translations.english: Increase, divine Indra, for us throughout the earth, abundant food, (that it may be as plural ntiful) as water, by which, hero, you bestow upon us (existence), as you cause water to flow on every side.

mantras.sanskrit: अकारि त इन्द्र गोतमेभिर्ब्रह्माण्योक्ता नमसा हरिभ्याम् । सुपेशसं वाजमा भरा नः प्रातर्मक्षू धियावसुर्जगम्यात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: akāri ta indra gotamebhirbrahmāṇyoktā namasā haribhyām | supeśasaṃ vājamā bharā naḥ prātarmakṣū dhiyāvasurjagamyāt ||

translations.english: Praises have been offered to you, Indra, by the sons of Gotama; (they have been) uttered with reverence (to you), borne (hither) by your steeds; grant us various sorts of food. May he who has acquired wealthy by pious acts, come hither quickly in the morning.

mantras.sanskrit: वृष्णे शर्धाय सुमखाय वेधसे नोधः सुवृक्तिं प्र भरा मरुद्भ्यः । अपो न धीरो मनसा सुहस्त्यो गिरः समञ्जे विदथेष्वाभुवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣṇe śardhāya sumakhāya vedhase nodhaḥ suvṛktiṃ pra bharā marudbhyaḥ | apo na dhīro manasā suhastyo giraḥ samañje vidatheṣvābhuvaḥ ||

translations.english: Offer, Nodhas, earnest praise to the company of the Maruts, the senders of rain and ripeners of fruit, deserving of adoration. Composed, and with folded hands, I utter the praises conceived in my mind, which are efficacious in sacred rites, (and flow rreadily) as the waters.

mantras.sanskrit: ते जज्ञिरे दिव ऋष्वास उक्षणो रुद्रस्य मर्या असुरा अरेपसः । पावकासः शुचयः सूर्या इव सत्वानो न द्रप्सिनो घोरवर्पसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te jajñire diva ṛṣvāsa ukṣaṇo rudrasya maryā asurā arepasaḥ | pāvakāsaḥ śucayaḥ sūryā iva satvāno na drapsino ghoravarpasaḥ ||

translations.english: They were born handsome and vigorous from the sky, the sons of Rudra, the conquerors of their foes, pure from sin, and purifying (all), radiant as suns, powerful as evil spirits, diffusers of rain-drops, and of fearful forms.

mantras.sanskrit: युवानो रुद्रा अजरा अभोग्घनो ववक्षुरध्रिगावः पर्वता इव । दृळ्हा चिद्विश्वा भुवनानि पार्थिवा प्र च्यावयन्ति दिव्यानि मज्मना ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvāno rudrā ajarā abhogghano vavakṣuradhrigāvaḥ parvatā iva | dṛḷhā cidviśvā bhuvanāni pārthivā pra cyāvayanti divyāni majmanā ||

translations.english: Youthful Rudras, and undecaying destructive of those who do not worship (the gods), of unobstructed progress, and immoveable as mountains they are desirous of granting (the wishes of the worshipper), and by their strength agitate all substances, whether of heaven or of earth.

mantras.sanskrit: चित्रैरञ्जिभिर्वपुषे व्यञ्जते वक्षस्सु रुक्माँ अधि येतिरे शुभे । अंसेष्वेषां नि मिमृक्षुॠष्टयः साकं जज्ञिरे स्वधया दिवो नरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: citrairañjibhirvapuṣe vyañjate vakṣassu rukmā~ adhi yetire śubhe | aṃseṣveṣāṃ ni mimṛkṣuṝṣṭayaḥ sākaṃ jajñire svadhayā divo naraḥ ||

translations.english: They decorate their person ns with various ornaments; they have plural ced, for elegance, brilliant (garlands) on their breasts; lances are borne upon their shoulders, and with them and their own strength have they been both, leaders, from the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: ईशानकृतो धुनयो रिशादसो वातान्विद्युतस्तविषीभिरक्रत । दुहन्त्यूधर्दिव्यानि धूतयो भूमिं पिन्वन्ति पयसा परिज्रयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: īśānakṛto dhunayo riśādaso vātānvidyutastaviṣībhirakrata | duhantyūdhardivyāni dhūtayo bhūmiṃ pinvanti payasā parijrayaḥ ||

translations.english: Enriching their worshipper, agitating the clouds, devourers of foes, they create the winds are lightnings by their power; the cirumambient and agitating Maruts milk heavenly udders, and sprinkle the earth with water.

mantras.sanskrit: पिन्वन्त्यपो मरुतः सुदानवः पयो घृतवद्विदथेष्वाभुवः । अत्यं न मिहे वि नयन्ति वाजिनमुत्सं दुहन्ति स्तनयन्तमक्षितम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pinvantyapo marutaḥ sudānavaḥ payo ghṛtavadvidatheṣvābhuvaḥ | atyaṃ na mihe vi nayanti vājinamutsaṃ duhanti stanayantamakṣitam ||

translations.english: The munificent Maruts scatter the nutritious waters, as priests at sacrifices the clarified butter; as grooms lead forth a horse, they bring forth the rain from the fleeting-cloud, and milk it, thundering, and unexhausted.

mantras.sanskrit: महिषासो मायिनश्चित्रभानवो गिरयो न स्वतवसो रघुष्यदः । मृगा इव हस्तिनः खादथा वना यदारुणीषु तविषीरयुग्ध्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahiṣāso māyinaścitrabhānavo girayo na svatavaso raghuṣyadaḥ | mṛgā iva hastinaḥ khādathā vanā yadāruṇīṣu taviṣīrayugdhvam ||

translations.english: Vast, possessed of knowledge, bright-shining, like mountains in stability and quick in motion, you, like elephants, break down the forests when you put vigour into your ruddy (mares).

mantras.sanskrit: सिंहा इव नानदति प्रचेतसः पिशा इव सुपिशो विश्ववेदसः । क्षपो जिन्वन्तः पृषतीभिॠष्टिभिः समित्सबाधः शवसाहिमन्यवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: siṃhā iva nānadati pracetasaḥ piśā iva supiśo viśvavedasaḥ | kṣapo jinvantaḥ pṛṣatībhiṝṣṭibhiḥ samitsabādhaḥ śavasāhimanyavaḥ ||

translations.english: The most wise Maruts roar like lions; the all-knowing are graceful as the spotted deer, destroyign (their foes), delighting (their worshippers); of deadly strength in their anger, they come with their antelopes and their arms, (to defend the sacrificer) against interruption.

mantras.sanskrit: रोदसी आ वदता गणश्रियो नृषाचः शूराः शवसाहिमन्यवः । आ वन्धुरेष्वमतिर्न दर्शता विद्युन्न तस्थौ मरुतो रथेषु वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: rodasī ā vadatā gaṇaśriyo nṛṣācaḥ śūrāḥ śavasāhimanyavaḥ | ā vandhureṣvamatirna darśatā vidyunna tasthau maruto ratheṣu vaḥ ||

translations.english: Maruts, who are distinguished in troops, who are benevolent to men, who are heroes, and whose strength is deadly in your anger, you make heaven and earth resound (at your coming); your (glory) sits in the seat-furnished chariots, conspicuous as (a beautiful) form, or as the lovely lightning.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्ववेदसो रयिभिः समोकसः सम्मिश्लासस्तविषीभिर्विरप्शिनः । अस्तार इषुं दधिरे गभस्त्योरनन्तशुष्मा वृषखादयो नरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvavedaso rayibhiḥ samokasaḥ sammiślāsastaviṣībhirvirapśinaḥ | astāra iṣuṃ dadhire gabhastyoranantaśuṣmā vṛṣakhādayo naraḥ ||

translations.english: The Maruts, who are all-knowing, co-dwellers with wealth, combined with strength, loud-sounding, repellers of foes, of infinite prowess, whose weapon (of offence) is Indra, and who are leaders (of men), hold in their hands the shaft.

mantras.sanskrit: हिरण्ययेभिः पविभिः पयोवृध उज्जिघ्नन्त आपथ्यो न पर्वतान् । मखा अयासः स्वसृतो ध्रुवच्युतो दुध्रकृतो मरुतो भ्राजदृष्टयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: hiraṇyayebhiḥ pavibhiḥ payovṛdha ujjighnanta āpathyo na parvatān | makhā ayāsaḥ svasṛto dhruvacyuto dudhrakṛto maruto bhrājadṛṣṭayaḥ ||

translations.english: Augmenters of rain, they drive with golden wheels the clouds asunder, as elephants (in a herd break down the trees in their way); they are honoured with sacrifices, visitants of the hall of offering, spontaneous assailers (of their foes), subverters of what are stable, immoveable themselves, and wearers of shining weapons.

mantras.sanskrit: घृषुं पावकं वनिनं विचर्षणिं रुद्रस्य सूनुं हवसा गृणीमसि । रजस्तुरं तवसं मारुतं गणमृजीषिणं वृषणं सश्चत श्रिये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ghṛṣuṃ pāvakaṃ vaninaṃ vicarṣaṇiṃ rudrasya sūnuṃ havasā gṛṇīmasi | rajasturaṃ tavasaṃ mārutaṃ gaṇamṛjīṣiṇaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ saścata śriye ||

translations.english: We invoke with praise the foe-destroying, all-purifying, water-shedding, all-surveying band of Maruts, the offspring of Rudra; (priests) to obtain prosperity, have recourse to the dust-raising and powerful band of Maruts, receiving libations from sacred vessels, and showering down (benefits).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र नू स मर्तः शवसा जनाँ अति तस्थौ व ऊती मरुतो यमावत । अर्वद्भिर्वाजं भरते धना नृभिरापृच्छ्यं क्रतुमा क्षेति पुष्यति ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra nū sa martaḥ śavasā janā~ ati tasthau va ūtī maruto yamāvata | arvadbhirvājaṃ bharate dhanā nṛbhirāpṛcchyaṃ kratumā kṣeti puṣyati ||

translations.english: The man whom, Maruts, you defend with your protection, quickly surpasses all men in strength; with his horses he acquires food, and with his men, riches; he performs the required worship, and he prospers.

mantras.sanskrit: चर्कृत्यं मरुतः पृत्सु दुष्टरं द्युमन्तं शुष्मं मघवत्सु धत्तन । धनस्पृतमुक्थ्यं विश्वचर्षणिं तोकं पुष्येम तनयं शतं हिमाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: carkṛtyaṃ marutaḥ pṛtsu duṣṭaraṃ dyumantaṃ śuṣmaṃ maghavatsu dhattana | dhanaspṛtamukthyaṃ viśvacarṣaṇiṃ tokaṃ puṣyema tanayaṃ śataṃ himāḥ ||

translations.english: Maruts, grant to your wealthy (worshippers a son), eminent for good works, invincible in battle, illustrious, the annihilator (of his adversaries), the seizer of wealth, the deserver of praise, and all-discerning; may we cherish such a son and such a grandson for a hundred winterṣ

mantras.sanskrit: नू ष्ठिरं मरुतो वीरवन्तमृतीषाहं रयिमस्मासु धत्त । सहस्रिणं शतिनं शूशुवांसं प्रातर्मक्षू धियावसुर्जगम्यात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū ṣṭhiraṃ maruto vīravantamṛtīṣāhaṃ rayimasmāsu dhatta | sahasriṇaṃ śatinaṃ śūśuvāṃsaṃ prātarmakṣū dhiyāvasurjagamyāt ||

translations.english: Grant us, Maruts, durable riches, attended by posterity, and mortifying to our enemies; (riches) recknoned by hundreds and thousands, and ever increasing; may they who have acquired wealth by pious acts, come hither quickly in the morning.

mantras.sanskrit: पश्वा न तायुं गुहा चतन्तं नमो युजानं नमो वहन्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: paśvā na tāyuṃ guhā catantaṃ namo yujānaṃ namo vahantam ||

translations.english: [1-2] The firm and plural cid divinites followed you, Agni, by your footmarks, when hiding in the hollow (of the water), like a thief (who has stolen) an animal; you, claiming oblations, and bearing them to the gods; all the deities who are entitled to worship, sit down near to you.

mantras.sanskrit: सजोषा धीराः पदैरनु ग्मन्नुप त्वा सीदन्विश्वे यजत्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sajoṣā dhīrāḥ padairanu gmannupa tvā sīdanviśve yajatrāḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतस्य देवा अनु व्रता गुर्भुवत्परिष्टिर्द्यौर्न भूम ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtasya devā anu vratā gurbhuvatpariṣṭirdyaurna bhūma ||

translations.english: [3-4] The gods followed the traces of the fugitive; the search spread everywhere, and earth became like heaven; the waters swelled (to conceal him), who was much enlarged by praise, and was manifested as it were in the womb in the waters, the source of sacrificial food.

mantras.sanskrit: वर्धन्तीमापः पन्वा सुशिश्विमृतस्य योना गर्भे सुजातम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vardhantīmāpaḥ panvā suśiśvimṛtasya yonā garbhe sujātam ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: पुष्टिर्न रण्वा क्षितिर्न पृथ्वी गिरिर्न भुज्म क्षोदो न शम्भु ॥
mantras.transliteration: puṣṭirna raṇvā kṣitirna pṛthvī girirna bhujma kṣodo na śambhu ||

translations.english: [5-6] Agni is grateful as nourishment, vast as the earth, productive (of vegetable food), as a mountain, delightful as water; he is like a horse urged to a charge in battle and like flowing waters; who can arrest him?

mantras.sanskrit: अत्यो नाज्मन्त्सर्गप्रतक्तः सिन्धुर्न क्षोदः क ईं वराते ॥
mantras.transliteration: atyo nājmantsargaprataktaḥ sindhurna kṣodaḥ ka īṃ varāte ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: जामिः सिन्धूनां भ्रातेव स्वस्रामिभ्यान्न राजा वनान्यत्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: jāmiḥ sindhūnāṃ bhrāteva svasrāmibhyānna rājā vanānyatti ||

translations.english: [7-8] He is the kind kinsman of the waters, like a brother to his sister; he consumes the forest as a rājā (destroys) his enemies; when excited by the wind, he traverses the woods, and shears the hairs of the earth.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्वातजूतो वना व्यस्थादग्निर्ह दाति रोमा पृथिव्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadvātajūto vanā vyasthādagnirha dāti romā pṛthivyāḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: श्वसित्यप्सु हंसो न सीदन्क्रत्वा चेतिष्ठो विशामुषर्भुत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śvasityapsu haṃso na sīdankratvā cetiṣṭho viśāmuṣarbhut ||

translations.english: [9-10] He breathes amidst the waters like a sitting swan; awakened at the dawn, he restores by his operations consciousness to men; he is a creator, like Soma; born from the waters (where he lurked) like an animal with coiled-up limbs, he became enlarged and his light (spread) afar.

mantras.sanskrit: सोमो न वेधा ऋतप्रजातः पशुर्न शिश्वा विभुर्दूरेभाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: somo na vedhā ṛtaprajātaḥ paśurna śiśvā vibhurdūrebhāḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: रयिर्न चित्रा सूरो न संदृगायुर्न प्राणो नित्यो न सूनुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: rayirna citrā sūro na saṃdṛgāyurna prāṇo nityo na sūnuḥ ||

translations.english: [1-2] Agni who is like wondrous wealth, like the all-surveying Sun, like vital breath, like a well-conducted son, like a rider-bearing steed, like a milk-yielding cow, who is pure and radiant, consumes the forests.

mantras.sanskrit: तक्वा न भूर्णिर्वना सिषक्ति पयो न धेनुः शुचिर्विभावा ॥
mantras.transliteration: takvā na bhūrṇirvanā siṣakti payo na dhenuḥ śucirvibhāvā ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: दाधार क्षेममोको न रण्वो यवो न पक्वो जेता जनानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dādhāra kṣemamoko na raṇvo yavo na pakvo jetā janānām ||

translations.english: [3-4] Like a secure mansion, he proects property; he (nourishes people) like barley; he is the conqueror of (hostile)) men; he is like a ṛṣi, the praiser (of the gods), eminent amongst (devout) person ns; as a spirited horse (goes to battle), he repairs delighted to the hall of sacrifice; may be bestow upon us food.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋषिर्न स्तुभ्वा विक्षु प्रशस्तो वाजी न प्रीतो वयो दधाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛṣirna stubhvā vikṣu praśasto vājī na prīto vayo dadhāti ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: दुरोकशोचिः क्रतुर्न नित्यो जायेव योनावरं विश्वस्मै ॥
mantras.transliteration: durokaśociḥ kraturna nityo jāyeva yonāvaraṃ viśvasmai ||

translations.english: [5-6] Agni of unattainable brightness, is like a vigilant sacrificer; he is an ornament to all (in the sacrificial chamber), like a woman in a dwelling; when he shines with wonderful lustre, he is like the white (sun) or like a golden chariot amongst men, resplendent in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: चित्रो यदभ्राट् छ्वेतो न विक्षु रथो न रुक्मी त्वेषः समत्सु ॥
mantras.transliteration: citro yadabhrāṭ chveto na vikṣu ratho na rukmī tveṣaḥ samatsu ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: सेनेव सृष्टामं दधात्यस्तुर्न दिद्युत्त्वेषप्रतीका ॥
mantras.transliteration: seneva sṛṣṭāmaṃ dadhātyasturna didyuttveṣapratīkā ||

translations.english: [7-8] He terrifies (his adversaries) like an army sent (against an enemy), or like the bright-pointed shaft of an archer. Agni, as Yama, is all that is born; as Yama, all that will be born; he is the lover of maidens, the husband of wives.

mantras.sanskrit: यमो ह जातो यमो जनित्वं जारः कनीनां पतिर्जनीनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yamo ha jāto yamo janitvaṃ jāraḥ kanīnāṃ patirjanīnām ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: तं वश्चराथा वयं वसत्यास्तं न गावो नक्षन्त इद्धम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ vaścarāthā vayaṃ vasatyāstaṃ na gāvo nakṣanta iddham ||

translations.english: [9-10] Let us approach that blazing Agni with animal and vegetable offerings, as cows hasten to their stalls. He has tossed about his flames (in every direction), like running streams of water; the rays comingle (with the radiance) visible in the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: सिन्धुर्न क्षोदः प्र नीचीरैनोन्नवन्त गावः स्वर्दृशीके ॥
mantras.transliteration: sindhurna kṣodaḥ pra nīcīrainonnavanta gāvaḥ svardṛśīke ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: वनेषु जायुर्मर्तेषु मित्रो वृणीते श्रुष्टिं राजेवाजुर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vaneṣu jāyurmarteṣu mitro vṛṇīte śruṣṭiṃ rājevājuryam ||

translations.english: [1-2] Born in the woods, the friend of man, Agni protects his worshipper, as a rājā favours an able man; kind as a defender, prosperous as a performer of (good) works, may he, the invoker of the gods, the bearer of oblations, be propitious.

mantras.sanskrit: क्षेमो न साधुः क्रतुर्न भद्रो भुवत्स्वाधीर्होता हव्यवाट् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kṣemo na sādhuḥ kraturna bhadro bhuvatsvādhīrhotā havyavāṭ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: हस्ते दधानो नृम्णा विश्वान्यमे देवान्धाद्गुहा निषीदन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: haste dadhāno nṛmṇā viśvānyame devāndhādguhā niṣīdan ||

translations.english: [3-4] Holding in his hand all (sacrificial) wealth, and hiding in the hollows (of the waters), he filled the gods with alarm; the leaders, (the gods), the upholders of acts, then recognize Agni when they have recited the prayers conceived in the heart.

mantras.sanskrit: विदन्तीमत्र नरो धियंधा हृदा यत्तष्टान्मन्त्राँ अशंसन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vidantīmatra naro dhiyaṃdhā hṛdā yattaṣṭānmantrā~ aśaṃsan ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: अजो न क्षां दाधार पृथिवीं तस्तम्भ द्यां मन्त्रेभिः सत्यैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ajo na kṣāṃ dādhāra pṛthivīṃ tastambha dyāṃ mantrebhiḥ satyaiḥ ||

translations.english: [5-6] Like the unborn (sun) he sustains the earth and the firmament, and props up the heaven with true prayers; Agni, in whom is all sustenance, cherish the plural ces that are grateful to animals; repair (to the spots) where there is no pasturage.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रिया पदानि पश्वो नि पाहि विश्वायुरग्ने गुहा गुहं गाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: priyā padāni paśvo ni pāhi viśvāyuragne guhā guhaṃ gāḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: य ईं चिकेत गुहा भवन्तमा यः ससाद धारामृतस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya īṃ ciketa guhā bhavantamā yaḥ sasāda dhārāmṛtasya ||

translations.english: [7-8] He who knows Agni hidden in the hollows; he who approaches him as the maintainer of truth; those who, performing worship, repeat his praises, to them assuredly he promises affluence.

mantras.sanskrit: वि ये चृतन्त्यृता सपन्त आदिद्वसूनि प्र ववाचास्मै ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi ye cṛtantyṛtā sapanta ādidvasūni pra vavācāsmai ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: वि यो वीरुत्सु रोधन्महित्वोत प्रजा उत प्रसूष्वन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi yo vīrutsu rodhanmahitvota prajā uta prasūṣvantaḥ ||

translations.english: [9-10] The wise, (first) honouring Agni, as they do a dwelling, worship him who implants their (peculiar) virtues in herbs, as progeny in their parents, and who, the source of knowledge and of all sustenance, (abides) in the domicile of the waters.

mantras.sanskrit: चित्तिरपां दमे विश्वायुः सद्मेव धीराः सम्माय चक्रुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: cittirapāṃ dame viśvāyuḥ sadmeva dhīrāḥ sammāya cakruḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: श्रीणन्नुप स्थाद्दिवं भुरण्युः स्थातुश्चरथमक्तून्व्यूर्णोत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śrīṇannupa sthāddivaṃ bhuraṇyuḥ sthātuścarathamaktūnvyūrṇot ||

translations.english: [1-2] The bearer (of the oblations), Agni, mixing them (with other ingredients), ascends to heaven, and clothes all things, moveable and immoveable, and the nights themselves, (with light), radiant amongst the gods, and in himself alone comprehending the virtues of all these (substances).

mantras.sanskrit: परि यदेषामेको विश्वेषां भुवद्देवो देवानां महित्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari yadeṣāmeko viśveṣāṃ bhuvaddevo devānāṃ mahitvā ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: आदित्ते विश्वे क्रतुं जुषन्त शुष्काद्यद्देव जीवो जनिष्ठाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: āditte viśve kratuṃ juṣanta śuṣkādyaddeva jīvo janiṣṭhāḥ ||

translations.english: [3-4] When, divine Agni, you are born living from the dry wood, (by attrition), then all (your worshippers) perform the sacred ceremony, and obtain verily true divinity by praising you, who are immortal, with hymns that reach you.

mantras.sanskrit: भजन्त विश्वे देवत्वं नाम ऋतं सपन्तो अमृतमेवैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhajanta viśve devatvaṃ nāma ṛtaṃ sapanto amṛtamevaiḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतस्य प्रेषा ऋतस्य धीतिर्विश्वायुर्विश्वे अपांसि चक्रुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtasya preṣā ṛtasya dhītirviśvāyurviśve apāṃsi cakruḥ ||

translations.english: [5-6] Praises are addressed to him who has repaired (to the solemnity); oblations (are offered) to him who has gone (to the sacrifice); in him is all sustenance, (and to him) have all (devout person ns) performed (the customary) rites. Do you, Agni, knowing (the thoughts of the worshipper), grant riches to him who presents to you oblations, or who wishes (to be able to present them).

mantras.sanskrit: यस्तुभ्यं दाशाद्यो वा ते शिक्षात्तस्मै चिकित्वान्रयिं दयस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: yastubhyaṃ dāśādyo vā te śikṣāttasmai cikitvānrayiṃ dayasva ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: होता निषत्तो मनोरपत्ये स चिन्न्वासां पती रयीणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: hotā niṣatto manorapatye sa cinnvāsāṃ patī rayīṇām ||

translations.english: [7-8] You have abided with the descendants of Manu as the invoker (of the gods); you are indeed the lord of their possessions; they have desired (of you) procreative vigour in their bodies, and, associated with their own excellent offspring, they contemplate (all things) undisturbed.

mantras.sanskrit: इच्छन्त रेतो मिथस्तनूषु सं जानत स्वैर्दक्षैरमूराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: icchanta reto mithastanūṣu saṃ jānata svairdakṣairamūrāḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: पितुर्न पुत्राः क्रतुं जुषन्त श्रोषन्ये अस्य शासं तुरासः ॥
mantras.transliteration: piturna putrāḥ kratuṃ juṣanta śroṣanye asya śāsaṃ turāsaḥ ||

translations.english: [9-10] Hastening to obey the commands of Agni, like sons (obedient of the orders) of a father, they celebrate his worship; abounding in food, Agni sets open before them treasures that are the doorf of sacrifice; and he who delights in the sacrificial chamber has studded the sky with constellations.

mantras.sanskrit: वि राय और्णोद्दुरः पुरुक्षुः पिपेश नाकं स्तृभिर्दमूनाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi rāya aurṇodduraḥ purukṣuḥ pipeśa nākaṃ stṛbhirdamūnāḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: शुक्रः शुशुक्वाँ उषो न जारः पप्रा समीची दिवो न ज्योतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śukraḥ śuśukvā~ uṣo na jāraḥ paprā samīcī divo na jyotiḥ ||

translations.english: [1-2] White-shining (Agni), like the (sun), the extinguisher of the dawn, is the illuminator (of all) and fills united (heaven and earth with light), like the lustre of the radiant (sun). You, as soon as manifested, have pervaded all the world with devout acts, being (both) the father and son of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: परि प्रजातः क्रत्वा बभूथ भुवो देवानां पिता पुत्रः सन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari prajātaḥ kratvā babhūtha bhuvo devānāṃ pitā putraḥ san ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: वेधा अदृप्तो अग्निर्विजानन्नूधर्न गोनां स्वाद्मा पितूनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vedhā adṛpto agnirvijānannūdharna gonāṃ svādmā pitūnām ||

translations.english: [3-4] The wise, the humble, and discrimating Agni, is the giver of flavour to food, as the udder of cows (gives sweetness to the milk); invited (to the ceremony), he sits in the sacrificial chamber, diffusing happiness like a benevolent man, amongst mankind.

mantras.sanskrit: जने न शेव आहूर्यः सन्मध्ये निषत्तो रण्वो दुरोणे ॥
mantras.transliteration: jane na śeva āhūryaḥ sanmadhye niṣatto raṇvo duroṇe ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: पुत्रो न जातो रण्वो दुरोणे वाजी न प्रीतो विशो वि तारीत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: putro na jāto raṇvo duroṇe vājī na prīto viśo vi tārīt ||

translations.english: [5-6] He diffuses happiness in a dwelling like a son(newly) born; he overcomes (opposing) men like an animated charger; whatever (divine) beings I may along with other men invoke (to the ceremony), you, Agni, assume all (their) celestial nature.

mantras.sanskrit: विशो यदह्वे नृभिः सनीळा अग्निर्देवत्वा विश्वान्यश्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśo yadahve nṛbhiḥ sanīḷā agnirdevatvā viśvānyaśyāḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: नकिष्ट एता व्रता मिनन्ति नृभ्यो यदेभ्यः श्रुष्टिं चकर्थ ॥
mantras.transliteration: nakiṣṭa etā vratā minanti nṛbhyo yadebhyaḥ śruṣṭiṃ cakartha ||
