translations.english: [7-8] Never may (malignant spirits) interrupt those rites in which you have given the (hope of) reward to the person ns (who celebrate them) for should (such spirits) disturb your worship, then, assisted by followers like yourself, you put the intruders to flight.

mantras.sanskrit: तत्तु ते दंसो यदहन्त्समानैर्नृभिर्यद्युक्तो विवे रपांसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tattu te daṃso yadahantsamānairnṛbhiryadyukto vive rapāṃsi ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: उषो न जारो विभावोस्रः संज्ञातरूपश्चिकेतदस्मै ॥
mantras.transliteration: uṣo na jāro vibhāvosraḥ saṃjñātarūpaściketadasmai ||

translations.english: [9-10] May Agni, who is possessed of manifold light, like the extinguisher of the dawn, the granter of dwellings, and of cognizable form, consider (the desires of) this, (his worshipper); (his rays), spontaneously bearing the oblation, open the doors (of the sacrificial chamber), and all spread through the visible heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: त्मना वहन्तो दुरो व्यृण्वन्नवन्त विश्वे स्वर्दृशीके ॥
mantras.transliteration: tmanā vahanto duro vyṛṇvannavanta viśve svardṛśīke ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: वनेम पूर्वीरर्यो मनीषा अग्निः सुशोको विश्वान्यश्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vanema pūrvīraryo manīṣā agniḥ suśoko viśvānyaśyāḥ ||

translations.english: [1-2] We solicit abundant (food) Agni, who is to be approached by meditation, and shines with pure light, pervades all holy rites, knowing well the acts that are to be addressed to the deities, and (those) which regulate) the birth of the human race.

mantras.sanskrit: आ दैव्यानि व्रता चिकित्वाना मानुषस्य जनस्य जन्म ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā daivyāni vratā cikitvānā mānuṣasya janasya janma ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: गर्भो यो अपां गर्भो वनानां गर्भश्च स्थातां गर्भश्चरथाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: garbho yo apāṃ garbho vanānāṃ garbhaśca sthātāṃ garbhaścarathām ||

translations.english: [3-4] (They offer oblations) on the mountain, or in the mansion, to that Agni, who is within the waters within woods, and  within all moveable and immoveable things, immortal and performing pious acts, like a benevolent (prince) among his people.

mantras.sanskrit: अद्रौ चिदस्मा अन्तर्दुरोणे विशां न विश्वो अमृतः स्वाधीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adrau cidasmā antarduroṇe viśāṃ na viśvo amṛtaḥ svādhīḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: स हि क्षपावाँ अग्नी रयीणां दाशद्यो अस्मा अरं सूक्तैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa hi kṣapāvā~ agnī rayīṇāṃ dāśadyo asmā araṃ sūktaiḥ ||

translations.english: [5-6] Agni, the lord of night, grants riches to the worshipper who adores him with sacred hymns. Agni, who are omniscient, and  know the origin of gods and men, protect all these (beings dwelling) upon earth.

mantras.sanskrit: एता चिकित्वो भूमा नि पाहि देवानां जन्म मर्ताँश्च विद्वान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: etā cikitvo bhūmā ni pāhi devānāṃ janma martā~śca vidvān ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: वर्धान्यं पूर्वीः क्षपो विरूपाः स्थातुश्च रथमृतप्रवीतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vardhānyaṃ pūrvīḥ kṣapo virūpāḥ sthātuśca rathamṛtapravītam ||

translations.english: [7-8] Agni, whom many variously-tinted (mornings) and nights increase, whom, invested with truth, all moveable and immoveable things augment, has been propitiated, and is kindly seated at the holy rite, as the invoker (of the gods), and rendering all (pious) acts (productive) of reward.

mantras.sanskrit: अराधि होता स्वर्निषत्तः कृण्वन्विश्वान्यपांसि सत्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: arādhi hotā svarniṣattaḥ kṛṇvanviśvānyapāṃsi satyā ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: गोषु प्रशस्तिं वनेषु धिषे भरन्त विश्वे बलिं स्वर्णः ॥
mantras.transliteration: goṣu praśastiṃ vaneṣu dhiṣe bharanta viśve baliṃ svarṇaḥ ||

translations.english: [9-10] Agni, confer excellence upon our valued cattle, and may all men bring us acceptable tribute; offering in many laces sacrifices to you, men receive riches from you, as (sons) from an aged father.

mantras.sanskrit: वि त्वा नरः पुरुत्रा सपर्यन्पितुर्न जिव्रेर्वि वेदो भरन्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi tvā naraḥ purutrā saparyanpiturna jivrervi vedo bharanta ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: साधुर्न गृध्नुरस्तेव शूरो यातेव भीमस्त्वेषः समत्सु ॥
mantras.transliteration: sādhurna gṛdhnurasteva śūro yāteva bhīmastveṣaḥ samatsu ||

translations.english: (May Agni), who is like one who succeeds (in his undertakings), and acquires (what he wishes for), who is like a warrior casting a dart, and resembles a fearful adversary, who is brilliant in combats, (be to us a friend).

mantras.sanskrit: उप प्र जिन्वन्नुशतीरुशन्तं पतिं न नित्यं जनयः सनीळाः । स्वसारः श्यावीमरुषीमजुष्रञ्चित्रमुच्छन्तीमुषसं न गावः ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa pra jinvannuśatīruśantaṃ patiṃ na nityaṃ janayaḥ sanīḷāḥ | svasāraḥ śyāvīmaruṣīmajuṣrañcitramucchantīmuṣasaṃ na gāvaḥ ||

translations.english: The contiguous fingers, loving the affectionate Agni, as wives love their own husbands, plural ase him (with offered oblations), and honour him, who is entitled to honour, (with gesticulations), as the rays of light (are assiduous in the service) of the dawn, which is (at first) dark, (then) glimmering, and (finally) radiant.

mantras.sanskrit: वीळु चिद्दृळ्हा पितरो न उक्थैरद्रिं रुजन्नङ्गिरसो रवेण । चक्रुर्दिवो बृहतो गातुमस्मे अहः स्वर्विविदुः केतुमुस्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vīḷu ciddṛḷhā pitaro na ukthairadriṃ rujannaṅgiraso raveṇa | cakrurdivo bṛhato gātumasme ahaḥ svarvividuḥ ketumusrāḥ ||

translations.english: Our forefathers, the Aṅgirasas, by their praises (of Agni), terrified the strong and daring devourer, (Paṇi), by the sound; they made for us a path to the vast heaven, and obtained accessible day, the ensign of day, (Āditya) and the cows (that had been stolen).

mantras.sanskrit: दधन्नृतं धनयन्नस्य धीतिमादिदर्यो दिधिष्वो विभृत्राः । अतृष्यन्तीरपसो यन्त्यच्छा देवाञ्जन्म प्रयसा वर्धयन्तीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dadhannṛtaṃ dhanayannasya dhītimādidaryo didhiṣvo vibhṛtrāḥ | atṛṣyantīrapaso yantyacchā devāñjanma prayasā vardhayantīḥ ||

translations.english: They secured hi, (Agni, in the sacrificial chamber), they made his worship the source of wealth; whence opulent votaries preserve his fires and practise his rites. Free from all (other) desire, assiduous in his adoration, and sustaining gods and men by their offerings, they come into his presence.

mantras.sanskrit: मथीद्यदीं विभृतो मातरिश्वा गृहेगृहे श्येतो जेन्यो भूत् । आदीं राज्ञे न सहीयसे सचा सन्ना दूत्यं भृगवाणो विवाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: mathīdyadīṃ vibhṛto mātariśvā gṛhegṛhe śyeto jenyo bhūt | ādīṃ rājñe na sahīyase sacā sannā dūtyaṃ bhṛgavāṇo vivāya ||

translations.english: When the diffusive vital air excites Agni, he becomes bright and manifest in every mansion, and the instrumental tutor of the rite, imitating Bhṛgu, prevails on him to perform the function of messenger, as a prince who has become a friend sends an ambassador to his more powerful (conqueror).

mantras.sanskrit: महे यत्पित्र ईं रसं दिवे करव त्सरत्पृशन्यश्चिकित्वान् । सृजदस्ता धृषता दिद्युमस्मै स्वायां देवो दुहितरि त्विषिं धात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahe yatpitra īṃ rasaṃ dive karava tsaratpṛśanyaścikitvān | sṛjadastā dhṛṣatā didyumasmai svāyāṃ devo duhitari tviṣiṃ dhāt ||

translations.english: When (the worshipper) offers an oblation to his great and illustrious protector, the grasping (rākṣas), recognizing you, Agni, retires; but Agni, the archer, sends after him a blazing arrow from his dreadful bow, and the god bestows light upon his own daughter (the dawn).

mantras.sanskrit: स्व आ यस्तुभ्यं दम आ विभाति नमो वा दाशादुशतो अनु द्यून् । वर्धो अग्ने वयो अस्य द्विबर्हा यासद्राया सरथं यं जुनासि ॥
mantras.transliteration: sva ā yastubhyaṃ dama ā vibhāti namo vā dāśāduśato anu dyūn | vardho agne vayo asya dvibarhā yāsadrāyā sarathaṃ yaṃ junāsi ||

translations.english: When (the worshipper) kindles you in his own dwelling, and presents an oblation to you, daily desiring it, do you, Agni, augmented in two ways, (as middling and as best), increase his means of sustenance; may he whom you sen dwith his car to battle, return with wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निं विश्वा अभि पृक्षः सचन्ते समुद्रं न स्रवतः सप्त यह्वीः । न जामिभिर्वि चिकिते वयो नो विदा देवेषु प्रमतिं चिकित्वान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniṃ viśvā abhi pṛkṣaḥ sacante samudraṃ na sravataḥ sapta yahvīḥ | na jāmibhirvi cikite vayo no vidā deveṣu pramatiṃ cikitvān ||

translations.english: All (sacrificial) viands concentrate in Agni, as the seven great rivers flwo into the ocean; our food is not partaken of by our kinsmen, therefore do you, who know (all things), make our desires known to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यदिषे नृपतिं तेज आनट् छुचि रेतो निषिक्तं द्यौरभीके । अग्निः शर्धमनवद्यं युवानं स्वाध्यं जनयत्सूदयच्च ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yadiṣe nṛpatiṃ teja ānaṭ chuci reto niṣiktaṃ dyaurabhīke | agniḥ śardhamanavadyaṃ yuvānaṃ svādhyaṃ janayatsūdayacca ||

translations.english: May that (digestive) faculty (of Agni) with regards food, be imparted to the devout and illustrious protector of priests, as the source of virile vigour; and may Agni be born as (his) robust, irreproachable, youthful and intelligent son, and instrumental gate him (to acts of worship).

mantras.sanskrit: मनो न योऽध्वनः सद्य एत्येकः सत्रा सूरो वस्व ईशे । राजाना मित्रावरुणा सुपाणी गोषु प्रियममृतं रक्षमाणा ॥
mantras.transliteration: mano na yo'dhvanaḥ sadya etyekaḥ satrā sūro vasva īśe | rājānā mitrāvaruṇā supāṇī goṣu priyamamṛtaṃ rakṣamāṇā ||

translations.english: The sun, who traverses alone the path of heaven with the speed of thought, is at once lord of all treasures; the two kings, Mitra and Varuṇa, with bounteous hands, are the guardians of the precious ambrosia of our cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नो अग्ने सख्या पित्र्याणि प्र मर्षिष्ठा अभि विदुष्कविः सन् । नभो न रूपं जरिमा मिनाति पुरा तस्या अभिशस्तेरधीहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā no agne sakhyā pitryāṇi pra marṣiṣṭhā abhi viduṣkaviḥ san | nabho na rūpaṃ jarimā mināti purā tasyā abhiśasteradhīhi ||

translations.english: Dissolve not, Agni, our ancestral friendship, for you are cognizant of the past as well as of the present; in like manner as light (speeds over) the sky, so decay impairs (my body); think of me before that source of destruction (prevails).

mantras.sanskrit: नि काव्या वेधसः शश्वतस्कर्हस्ते दधानो नर्या पुरूणि । अग्निर्भुवद्रयिपती रयीणां सत्रा चक्राणो अमृतानि विश्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni kāvyā vedhasaḥ śaśvataskarhaste dadhāno naryā purūṇi | agnirbhuvadrayipatī rayīṇāṃ satrā cakrāṇo amṛtāni viśvā ||

translations.english: Agni, holding in his hands many good things for men, appropriates the prayers addressed to the eternal creator. Agni is the lord of riches, quickly bestowing (on those who praise him) all golden (gifts).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मे वत्सं परि षन्तं न विन्दन्निच्छन्तो विश्वे अमृता अमूराः । श्रमयुवः पदव्यो धियंधास्तस्थुः पदे परमे चार्वग्नेः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asme vatsaṃ pari ṣantaṃ na vindannicchanto viśve amṛtā amūrāḥ | śramayuvaḥ padavyo dhiyaṃdhāstasthuḥ pade parame cārvagneḥ ||

translations.english: All the immortals, and the unbewildered (Maruts), wishing for him who was (dear) to us as a son, and was everywhere around, discovered him not; oppressed with fatigue, wandering on foot, and cognizant of his acts, they stopped at the last beautiful (hiding) plural ce of Agni.

mantras.sanskrit: तिस्रो यदग्ने शरदस्त्वामिच्छुचिं घृतेन शुचयः सपर्यान् । नामानि चिद्दधिरे यज्ञियान्यसूदयन्त तन्वः सुजाताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tisro yadagne śaradastvāmicchuciṃ ghṛtena śucayaḥ saparyān | nāmāni ciddadhire yajñiyānyasūdayanta tanvaḥ sujātāḥ ||

translations.english: Inasmuch, Agni, as the pure (Maruts) worshipped you, (equally) pure, with clarified butter for three years, therefore they acquired names worthy (to be treated) at sacrifice, and, being regenerated obtained celestial bodies.

mantras.sanskrit: आ रोदसी बृहती वेविदानाः प्र रुद्रिया जभ्रिरे यज्ञियासः । विदन्मर्तो नेमधिता चिकित्वानग्निं पदे परमे तस्थिवांसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā rodasī bṛhatī vevidānāḥ pra rudriyā jabhrire yajñiyāsaḥ | vidanmarto nemadhitā cikitvānagniṃ pade parame tasthivāṃsam ||

translations.english: Those who are to be worshipped, (the gods), inquiring between the expansive heaven and earth (for Agni), recited (hymns) dedicated to Rudra; the troop of mortal (Maruts), with (Indra), the shrer of half the oblation, knowing where Agni was hiding found him in his excellent retreat.

mantras.sanskrit: संजानाना उप सीदन्नभिज्ञु पत्नीवन्तो नमस्यं नमस्यन् । रिरिक्वांसस्तन्वः कृण्वत स्वाः सखा सख्युर्निमिषि रक्षमाणाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃjānānā upa sīdannabhijñu patnīvanto namasyaṃ namasyan | ririkvāṃsastanvaḥ kṛṇvata svāḥ sakhā sakhyurnimiṣi rakṣamāṇāḥ ||

translations.english: The gods, discovering you, sat down, and with their wives paid reverntial adoration to you upon their knees. Secure on beholding their friend, of being protected, your friends, the gods, abandoned the rest of their bodies in sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिः सप्त यद्गुह्यानि त्वे इत्पदाविदन्निहिता यज्ञियासः । तेभी रक्षन्ते अमृतं सजोषाः पशूञ्च स्थातॄञ्चरथं च पाहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: triḥ sapta yadguhyāni tve itpadāvidannihitā yajñiyāsaḥ | tebhī rakṣante amṛtaṃ sajoṣāḥ paśūñca sthātṝñcarathaṃ ca pāhi ||

translations.english: (Devout men), competent to offer sacrifices, have known the thrice seven mystic rites comprised in you, and with them, worshipped you; do you, therefore, with like affection, protect their cattle, and all that (belongs to them), moveable or stationary.

mantras.sanskrit: विद्वाँ अग्ने वयुनानि क्षितीनां व्यानुषक्छुरुधो जीवसे धाः । अन्तर्विद्वाँ अध्वनो देवयानानतन्द्रो दूतो अभवो हविर्वाट् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vidvā~ agne vayunāni kṣitīnāṃ vyānuṣakchurudho jīvase dhāḥ | antarvidvā~ adhvano devayānānatandro dūto abhavo havirvāṭ ||

translations.english: Agni, who are cognizant of all things to be known, ever provide for the subsistence of men, grief-alleviating (food); so shall you be the diligent bearer of oblations, and messenger of the gods, knowing the paths between (earth and heaven), by which they travel.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वाध्यो दिव आ सप्त यह्वी रायो दुरो व्यृतज्ञा अजानन् । विदद्गव्यं सरमा दृळ्हमूर्वं येना नु कं मानुषी भोजते विट् ॥
mantras.transliteration: svādhyo diva ā sapta yahvī rāyo duro vyṛtajñā ajānan | vidadgavyaṃ saramā dṛḷhamūrvaṃ yenā nu kaṃ mānuṣī bhojate viṭ ||

translations.english: The seven pure rivers that flow from heaven (are directed, Agni, by you; by you, the priests), skilled in sacrifices, knew the doors of the (cave where) the treasure, (their cattle), were concealed for you Saramā discovered the abundant milk of the kine with which man, the progeny of Manu, still is nourished.

mantras.sanskrit: आ ये विश्वा स्वपत्यानि तस्थुः कृण्वानासो अमृतत्वाय गातुम् । मह्ना महद्भिः पृथिवी वि तस्थे माता पुत्रैरदितिर्धायसे वेः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā ye viśvā svapatyāni tasthuḥ kṛṇvānāso amṛtatvāya gātum | mahnā mahadbhiḥ pṛthivī vi tasthe mātā putrairaditirdhāyase veḥ ||

translations.english: You have been fed, (Agni, with oblations) ever since the Ādityas, devising a road to immortality; instrumental tuted all (the sacred rites) that secured them from failing and mother earth, Aditi, strove with her magnitude to uphold (the world), along with her mighty sons.

mantras.sanskrit: अधि श्रियं नि दधुश्चारुमस्मिन्दिवो यदक्षी अमृता अकृण्वन् । अध क्षरन्ति सिन्धवो न सृष्टाः प्र नीचीरग्ने अरुषीरजानन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhi śriyaṃ ni dadhuścārumasmindivo yadakṣī amṛtā akṛṇvan | adha kṣaranti sindhavo na sṛṣṭāḥ pra nīcīragne aruṣīrajānan ||

translations.english: (The offerers of oblations) have plural ced in this (Agni) the graceful honours (of the ceremony), and the two portions of clarified butter that are the two eyes (of the sacrifice); then the immortals come from heaven, and your bright flames, Agni, spread in all directions like rushing rivers, and the gods perceive it (and rejoice).

mantras.sanskrit: रयिर्न यः पितृवित्तो वयोधाः सुप्रणीतिश्चिकितुषो न शासुः । स्योनशीरतिथिर्न प्रीणानो होतेव सद्म विधतो वि तारीत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: rayirna yaḥ pitṛvitto vayodhāḥ supraṇītiścikituṣo na śāsuḥ | syonaśīratithirna prīṇāno hoteva sadma vidhato vi tārīt ||

translations.english: Agni, like patrimonial wealth, is the giver of food; he is a director, like the instrumental uctions of one learned in scripture; he rests in the sacrificial chamber like a welcome guest, and like an officiating priest, he brings prosperity on the house of the worshipper.

mantras.sanskrit: देवो न यः सविता सत्यमन्मा क्रत्वा निपाति वृजनानि विश्वा । पुरुप्रशस्तो अमतिर्न सत्य आत्मेव शेवो दिधिषाय्यो भूत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: devo na yaḥ savitā satyamanmā kratvā nipāti vṛjanāni viśvā | purupraśasto amatirna satya ātmeva śevo didhiṣāyyo bhūt ||

translations.english: He who is like the divine Sun, who know the truth (of things), preserves by his actions (his votaries) in all encounters; like nature, he is unchangeable and, like soul, is the source of happiness; he is ever to be cherished.

mantras.sanskrit: देवो न यः पृथिवीं विश्वधाया उपक्षेति हितमित्रो न राजा । पुरःसदः शर्मसदो न वीरा अनवद्या पतिजुष्टेव नारी ॥
mantras.transliteration: devo na yaḥ pṛthivīṃ viśvadhāyā upakṣeti hitamitro na rājā | puraḥsadaḥ śarmasado na vīrā anavadyā patijuṣṭeva nārī ||

translations.english: He who, like the divine (Sun), is the supporter of the universe, abides on earth like a prince, (surrounded by) faithful friends; in his presence, men sit down like sons in the dwelling of a parent, and (in purity he resembles) an irreproachable and beloved wife.

mantras.sanskrit: तं त्वा नरो दम आ नित्यमिद्धमग्ने सचन्त क्षितिषु ध्रुवासु । अधि द्युम्नं नि दधुर्भूर्यस्मिन्भवा विश्वायुर्धरुणो रयीणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ tvā naro dama ā nityamiddhamagne sacanta kṣitiṣu dhruvāsu | adhi dyumnaṃ ni dadhurbhūryasminbhavā viśvāyurdharuṇo rayīṇām ||

translations.english: Such as you are, Agni, men preserve you constantly kindled in their dwellings, in secure plural ces, and offer upon you abundant (sacrificial) food; do you, in whom is all existence, be the bearer of riches (for our advantage).

mantras.sanskrit: वि पृक्षो अग्ने मघवानो अश्युर्वि सूरयो ददतो विश्वमायुः । सनेम वाजं समिथेष्वर्यो भागं देवेषु श्रवसे दधानाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi pṛkṣo agne maghavāno aśyurvi sūrayo dadato viśvamāyuḥ | sanema vājaṃ samitheṣvaryo bhāgaṃ deveṣu śravase dadhānāḥ ||

translations.english: May your opulent worshippers, Agni, obtain (abundant) food; may the learned (who praise you) and offer you (oblations), acquire long life; may we gain in battles booty from our foes, presenting their portion to the gods for (the acquisition of) renown.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतस्य हि धेनवो वावशानाः स्मदूध्नीः पीपयन्त द्युभक्ताः । परावतः सुमतिं भिक्षमाणा वि सिन्धवः समया सस्रुरद्रिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtasya hi dhenavo vāvaśānāḥ smadūdhnīḥ pīpayanta dyubhaktāḥ | parāvataḥ sumatiṃ bhikṣamāṇā vi sindhavaḥ samayā sasruradrim ||

translations.english: The cows, loving (Agni, who has come to thehall of sacrifice), sharing his splendour, have brought with full udders (their milk) to be drunk. The rivers, soliciting his good will, have flowed from a distance in the vicinity of the mountain.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वे अग्ने सुमतिं भिक्षमाणा दिवि श्रवो दधिरे यज्ञियासः । नक्ता च चक्रुरुषसा विरूपे कृष्णं च वर्णमरुणं च सं धुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tve agne sumatiṃ bhikṣamāṇā divi śravo dadhire yajñiyāsaḥ | naktā ca cakruruṣasā virūpe kṛṣṇaṃ ca varṇamaruṇaṃ ca saṃ dhuḥ ||

translations.english: (The gods), who are entitled to worship, soliciting your good will, have entrusted to you, resplendent Agni, the (sacrificial) food, and, (for the due observance of sacred rites), they have made the night and morning of different colours, or black and purple.

mantras.sanskrit: यान्राये मर्तान्त्सुषूदो अग्ने ते स्याम मघवानो वयं च । छायेव विश्वं भुवनं सिसक्ष्यापप्रिवान्रोदसी अन्तरिक्षम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yānrāye martāntsuṣūdo agne te syāma maghavāno vayaṃ ca | chāyeva viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ sisakṣyāpaprivānrodasī antarikṣam ||

translations.english: May we, mortals, whom you have directed (to the performance of sacrifices) for the sake of riches, become opulent; filling heaven and earth, and the firmament (with your radiance), you protect the whole world like a (sheltering) shade.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्वद्भिरग्ने अर्वतो नृभिर्नॄन्वीरैर्वीरान्वनुयामा त्वोताः । ईशानासः पितृवित्तस्य रायो वि सूरयः शतहिमा नो अश्युः ॥
mantras.transliteration: arvadbhiragne arvato nṛbhirnṝnvīrairvīrānvanuyāmā tvotāḥ | īśānāsaḥ pitṛvittasya rāyo vi sūrayaḥ śatahimā no aśyuḥ ||

translations.english: Defended, Agni, by you, may we destroy the horses (of your enemies) by (our) horses, their men by (our) men, their sons by (our) sons, and may our sons, learned and inheritors of ancestral wealth, live for a hundred winters.

mantras.sanskrit: एता ते अग्न उचथानि वेधो जुष्टानि सन्तु मनसे हृदे च । शकेम रायः सुधुरो यमं तेऽधि श्रवो देवभक्तं दधानाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: etā te agna ucathāni vedho juṣṭāni santu manase hṛde ca | śakema rāyaḥ sudhuro yamaṃ te'dhi śravo devabhaktaṃ dadhānāḥ ||

translations.english: May these our praises, sapient Agni, be grateful to you, both in mind and heart; may we be competent to detain your well-supporting wealth, offering upon you their share of the (sacrificial food of the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: उपप्रयन्तो अध्वरं मन्त्रं वोचेमाग्नये । आरे अस्मे च शृण्वते ॥
mantras.transliteration: upaprayanto adhvaraṃ mantraṃ vocemāgnaye | āre asme ca śṛṇvate ||

translations.english: Hastening to the sacrifice, let us repeat a prayer to Agni, who fears us from afar.

mantras.sanskrit: यः स्नीहितीषु पूर्व्यः संजग्मानासु कृष्टिषु । अरक्षद्दाशुषे गयम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ snīhitīṣu pūrvyaḥ saṃjagmānāsu kṛṣṭiṣu | arakṣaddāśuṣe gayam ||

translations.english: Who, existing of old, has preserved wealth for the sacrificer, when malevolent men are assembled together.

mantras.sanskrit: उत ब्रुवन्तु जन्तव उदग्निर्वृत्रहाजनि । धनंजयो रणेरणे ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta bruvantu jantava udagnirvṛtrahājani | dhanaṃjayo raṇeraṇe ||

translations.english: Let men praise Agni as soon as genitive rated, the slayer of Vṛtra, and the winner of booty in many a battle.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य दूतो असि क्षये वेषि हव्यानि वीतये । दस्मत्कृणोष्यध्वरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya dūto asi kṣaye veṣi havyāni vītaye | dasmatkṛṇoṣyadhvaram ||

translations.english: (The sacrificer), in whose house you are the messenger of the gods, whose offering you convey for their food, and whose sacrifice you render acceptable.

mantras.sanskrit: तमित्सुहव्यमङ्गिरः सुदेवं सहसो यहो । जना आहुः सुबर्हिषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamitsuhavyamaṅgiraḥ sudevaṃ sahaso yaho | janā āhuḥ subarhiṣam ||

translations.english: Him, Aṅgiras, son of strength, men call forunate in his sacrifice, his deity, his oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: आ च वहासि ताँ इह देवाँ उप प्रशस्तये । हव्या सुश्चन्द्र वीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā ca vahāsi tā~ iha devā~ upa praśastaye | havyā suścandra vītaye ||

translations.english: Bring hither, radiant Agni, the gods, to (receive) our praise and our oblations for their food.

mantras.sanskrit: न योरुपब्दिरश्व्यः शृण्वे रथस्य कच्चन । यदग्ने यासि दूत्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: na yorupabdiraśvyaḥ śṛṇve rathasya kaccana | yadagne yāsi dūtyam ||

translations.english: Whenever you go, Agni, on a mission of the gods, the neighing of the horses of your (swift) moving chariot, however audible is not heard.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वोतो वाज्यह्रयोऽभि पूर्वस्मादपरः । प्र दाश्वाँ अग्ने अस्थात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvoto vājyahrayo'bhi pūrvasmādaparaḥ | pra dāśvā~ agne asthāt ||

translations.english: He who was formerly subject to a superior, having been protected, Agni, by you, now stands in your presence as an offerer (of oblations) without bashfulness, and supplied with food.

mantras.sanskrit: उत द्युमत्सुवीर्यं बृहदग्ने विवाससि । देवेभ्यो देव दाशुषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta dyumatsuvīryaṃ bṛhadagne vivāsasi | devebhyo deva dāśuṣe ||

translations.english: Verily, divine Agni, you are desirous of bestowing upon the offerer (of oblations) to the gods, ample (wealth), brilliant, and giving vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: जुषस्व सप्रथस्तमं वचो देवप्सरस्तमम् । हव्या जुह्वान आसनि ॥
mantras.transliteration: juṣasva saprathastamaṃ vaco devapsarastamam | havyā juhvāna āsani ||

translations.english: Accept our most exhaustive prayers, propitiatory of the gods, accepting our oblations in your mouth.

mantras.sanskrit: अथा ते अङ्गिरस्तमाग्ने वेधस्तम प्रियम् । वोचेम ब्रह्म सानसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: athā te aṅgirastamāgne vedhastama priyam | vocema brahma sānasi ||

translations.english: And then, most wise Agni, chief of the Aṅgiras, may we address (to you) an acceptable and gratifying prayer.

mantras.sanskrit: कस्ते जामिर्जनानामग्ने को दाश्वध्वरः । को ह कस्मिन्नसि श्रितः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kaste jāmirjanānāmagne ko dāśvadhvaraḥ | ko ha kasminnasi śritaḥ ||

translations.english: Who, Agni, is your kinsman amongst people? Who is worthy to offer you sacrifice? Who, indeed, are you and where do you abide?

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं जामिर्जनानामग्ने मित्रो असि प्रियः । सखा सखिभ्य ईड्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ jāmirjanānāmagne mitro asi priyaḥ | sakhā sakhibhya īḍyaḥ ||

translations.english: You, Agni, are the kinsman of people. You are the protector of sacrificers. You are extolled by priests, since you are the friend of all.

mantras.sanskrit: यजा नो मित्रावरुणा यजा देवाँ ऋतं बृहत् । अग्ने यक्षि स्वं दमम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajā no mitrāvaruṇā yajā devā~ ṛtaṃ bṛhat | agne yakṣi svaṃ damam ||

translations.english: Worship for us, Mitra and Varuṇa; worship for us, all the gods; (celebrate) a great sacrifice; be present in your own dwelling.

mantras.sanskrit: का त उपेतिर्मनसो वराय भुवदग्ने शंतमा का मनीषा । को वा यज्ञैः परि दक्षं त आप केन वा ते मनसा दाशेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: kā ta upetirmanaso varāya bhuvadagne śaṃtamā kā manīṣā | ko vā yajñaiḥ pari dakṣaṃ ta āpa kena vā te manasā dāśema ||

translations.english: What approximation of the mind, Agni, to you, can be accomplished for our good; what can a hundred encomiums (effect); who, by sacrifices has obtained your might; with what intent may we offer you (oblations)?

mantras.sanskrit: एह्यग्न इह होता नि षीदादब्धः सु पुरएता भवा नः । अवतां त्वा रोदसी विश्वमिन्वे यजा महे सौमनसाय देवान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ehyagna iha hotā ni ṣīdādabdhaḥ su puraetā bhavā naḥ | avatāṃ tvā rodasī viśvaminve yajā mahe saumanasāya devān ||

translations.english: Come, Agni, hither; invoker (of the gods), sit down; be our preceder; for you are irresistible; may the all-expansive heaven and earth defend you, that you may worship the gods to their great satisfaction.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सु विश्वान्रक्षसो धक्ष्यग्ने भवा यज्ञानामभिशस्तिपावा । अथा वह सोमपतिं हरिभ्यामातिथ्यमस्मै चकृमा सुदाव्ने ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra su viśvānrakṣaso dhakṣyagne bhavā yajñānāmabhiśastipāvā | athā vaha somapatiṃ haribhyāmātithyamasmai cakṛmā sudāvne ||

translations.english: Utterly consume all the rākṣasas, Agni, and be the protector of our sacrifices against interruption. Bring hither the guardian of Soma, (Indra), with his steeds, that we may show hospitality to the giver of food.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रजावता वचसा वह्निरासा च हुवे नि च सत्सीह देवैः । वेषि होत्रमुत पोत्रं यजत्र बोधि प्रयन्तर्जनितर्वसूनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: prajāvatā vacasā vahnirāsā ca huve ni ca satsīha devaiḥ | veṣi hotramuta potraṃ yajatra bodhi prayantarjanitarvasūnām ||

translations.english: I invoke (you), who are the conveyor (of oblations), with your flames, with a hymn productive of progeny (to the worshipper); sit down here with the gods, and do you, who are deserving of worship, discharge the office of Hotā, or of Potā and awaken us, you who are the depository and genitive rator of riches.

mantras.sanskrit: यथा विप्रस्य मनुषो हविर्भिर्देवाँ अयजः कविभिः कविः सन् । एवा होतः सत्यतर त्वमद्याग्ने मन्द्रया जुह्वा यजस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathā viprasya manuṣo havirbhirdevā~ ayajaḥ kavibhiḥ kaviḥ san | evā hotaḥ satyatara tvamadyāgne mandrayā juhvā yajasva ||

translations.english: As at the sacrifice of the holy Manu, you, a sage amongst sages, did worship the gods with oblations, so also, Agni, veracious invoker of the gods, do you today (present the oblations), with an exhilarating ladle.

mantras.sanskrit: कथा दाशेमाग्नये कास्मै देवजुष्टोच्यते भामिने गीः । यो मर्त्येष्वमृत ऋतावा होता यजिष्ठ इत्कृणोति देवान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kathā dāśemāgnaye kāsmai devajuṣṭocyate bhāmine gīḥ | yo martyeṣvamṛta ṛtāvā hotā yajiṣṭha itkṛṇoti devān ||

translations.english: What (oblations) may we offer to Agni? What praise is addressed to the luminous (Agni) that is agreeable to the gods? that Agni who is immortal and observant of truth, who is the invoker of the gods, the performer of sacrifices, and who, (present) amongst men, conveys oblations to the deities.

mantras.sanskrit: यो अध्वरेषु शंतम ऋतावा होता तमू नमोभिरा कृणुध्वम् । अग्निर्यद्वेर्मर्ताय देवान्त्स चा बोधाति मनसा यजाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo adhvareṣu śaṃtama ṛtāvā hotā tamū namobhirā kṛṇudhvam | agniryadvermartāya devāntsa cā bodhāti manasā yajāti ||

translations.english: Bring hither, with praises, him who is most constant in sacrifice, observant of truth, and the invoker (of the gods), for Agni, when he repairs to the gods on the part of man, knows those (who are to be worshipped), and worships them with reverence.

mantras.sanskrit: स हि क्रतुः स मर्यः स साधुर्मित्रो न भूदद्भुतस्य रथीः । तं मेधेषु प्रथमं देवयन्तीर्विश उप ब्रुवते दस्ममारीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa hi kratuḥ sa maryaḥ sa sādhurmitro na bhūdadbhutasya rathīḥ | taṃ medheṣu prathamaṃ devayantīrviśa upa bruvate dasmamārīḥ ||

translations.english: For he is the performer of rites, he is the destroyer and reviver (of all things), and, like a friend he is the donor of unattained wealth; all men reverencing the gods, and approaching the well-looking Agni, repeat his name first in holy rites.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो नृणां नृतमो रिशादा अग्निर्गिरोऽवसा वेतु धीतिम् । तना च ये मघवानः शविष्ठा वाजप्रसूता इषयन्त मन्म ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no nṛṇāṃ nṛtamo riśādā agnirgiro'vasā vetu dhītim | tanā ca ye maghavānaḥ śaviṣṭhā vājaprasūtā iṣayanta manma ||

translations.english: May Agni, who is the chief director of sacrifices, and the destroyer of enemies, accept our praise and worship with oblations, and may those who are affluent with great wealth, who are endowed with strength, and by whom the sacrificial food has been prepared, be desirous to offer adoration.

mantras.sanskrit: एवाग्निर्गोतमेभिॠतावा विप्रेभिरस्तोष्ट जातवेदाः । स एषु द्युम्नं पीपयत्स वाजं स पुष्टिं याति जोषमा चिकित्वान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: evāgnirgotamebhiṝtāvā viprebhirastoṣṭa jātavedāḥ | sa eṣu dyumnaṃ pīpayatsa vājaṃ sa puṣṭiṃ yāti joṣamā cikitvān ||

translations.english: Thus has Agni, the celebrator of sacrifices, and by whom all things are known, been hymned by the pious descendant of Gotama; to them he has given the bright Soma to drink, along with the sacrificial food, and gratified by our devotion, he obtains nutriment (for himself).

mantras.sanskrit: अभि त्वा गोतमा गिरा जातवेदो विचर्षणे । द्युम्नैरभि प्र णोनुमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi tvā gotamā girā jātavedo vicarṣaṇe | dyumnairabhi pra ṇonumaḥ ||

translations.english: Knower and beholder of all that exists (jātanām veditaḥ). Gotama celebrates you, Agni, with praise; we praise you repeatedly with commendatory (hymns).

mantras.sanskrit: तमु त्वा गोतमो गिरा रायस्कामो दुवस्यति । द्युम्नैरभि प्र णोनुमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamu tvā gotamo girā rāyaskāmo duvasyati | dyumnairabhi pra ṇonumaḥ ||

translations.english: To you; that (Agni) whom Gotama, desirous of riches, worships with praise, we offer adoration with commendatory (hymns).

mantras.sanskrit: तमु त्वा वाजसातममङ्गिरस्वद्धवामहे । द्युम्नैरभि प्र णोनुमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamu tvā vājasātamamaṅgirasvaddhavāmahe | dyumnairabhi pra ṇonumaḥ ||

translations.english: We invoke you, such as you are, the giver of abundant food, in like manner as did Aṅgiras; we praise you repeatedly with commendatory (hymns).

mantras.sanskrit: तमु त्वा वृत्रहन्तमं यो दस्यूँरवधूनुषे । द्युम्नैरभि प्र णोनुमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamu tvā vṛtrahantamaṃ yo dasyū~ravadhūnuṣe | dyumnairabhi pra ṇonumaḥ ||

translations.english: We praise you repeatedly with commendatory (hymns), who are the destroyer of Vṛtra, and who put the Dasyus to flight.

mantras.sanskrit: अवोचाम रहूगणा अग्नये मधुमद्वचः । द्युम्नैरभि प्र णोनुमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: avocāma rahūgaṇā agnaye madhumadvacaḥ | dyumnairabhi pra ṇonumaḥ ||

translations.english: The descendants of Rāhugaṇa have recited sweet speeches to Agni; we praise him repeatedly with commendatory (hymns).

mantras.sanskrit: हिरण्यकेशो रजसो विसारेऽहिर्धुनिर्वात इव ध्रजीमान् । शुचिभ्राजा उषसो नवेदा यशस्वतीरपस्युवो न सत्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: hiraṇyakeśo rajaso visāre'hirdhunirvāta iva dhrajīmān | śucibhrājā uṣaso navedā yaśasvatīrapasyuvo na satyāḥ ||

translations.english: The golden-haired Agni is the agitator of the clouds when the rain is poured forth, and, moving with the swiftness of the wind, shines with a bright radiance. The mornings know not (of the showers, like honest (people), who, provided with food, are intent upon their own labours.

mantras.sanskrit: आ ते सुपर्णा अमिनन्तँ एवैः कृष्णो नोनाव वृषभो यदीदम् । शिवाभिर्न स्मयमानाभिरागात्पतन्ति मिहः स्तनयन्त्यभ्रा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā te suparṇā aminanta~ evaiḥ kṛṣṇo nonāva vṛṣabho yadīdam | śivābhirna smayamānābhirāgātpatanti mihaḥ stanayantyabhrā ||

translations.english: The falling (rays), accompanied by the moving (Maruts), strike against (the cloud); the black shedder of rain has roared; when this is done, (the shower) comes with delightful and smiling (drops), the rain descends, the clouds thunder.

mantras.sanskrit: यदीमृतस्य पयसा पियानो नयन्नृतस्य पथिभी रजिष्ठैः । अर्यमा मित्रो वरुणः परिज्मा त्वचं पृञ्चन्त्युपरस्य योनौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadīmṛtasya payasā piyāno nayannṛtasya pathibhī rajiṣṭhaiḥ | aryamā mitro varuṇaḥ parijmā tvacaṃ pṛñcantyuparasya yonau ||

translations.english: When this, (the lightning, Agni), nourishes the world with the milk of the rain, and conducts it by the most direct ways to (the enjoyment of) water, then Mitra, Aryaman, Varuṇa and the circumambient (troop of Maruts) pierce through the (investing) membrane into the womb of the cloud.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने वाजस्य गोमत ईशानः सहसो यहो । अस्मे धेहि जातवेदो महि श्रवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne vājasya gomata īśānaḥ sahaso yaho | asme dhehi jātavedo mahi śravaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, sone of strength, lord of food and of cattle, give us abundant sustenance, you who know all that exists.

mantras.sanskrit: स इधानो वसुष्कविरग्निरीळेन्यो गिरा । रेवदस्मभ्यं पुर्वणीक दीदिहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa idhāno vasuṣkaviragnirīḷenyo girā | revadasmabhyaṃ purvaṇīka dīdihi ||

translations.english: He, the blazing Agni, who is wise, and the granter of dwellings, is to be praised by our hymns; oḥ! you whose mouth (glows) with many (flames), shine (propitiously, so) that food-providing wealth may be ours.

mantras.sanskrit: क्षपो राजन्नुत त्मनाग्ने वस्तोरुतोषसः । स तिग्मजम्भ रक्षसो दह प्रति ॥
mantras.transliteration: kṣapo rājannuta tmanāgne vastorutoṣasaḥ | sa tigmajambha rakṣaso daha prati ||

translations.english: Shining Agni, drive off (all disturbers of the rite), either by yourself or (your servants) whether by day or by night; sharp-visaged Agni, destroy the rākṣasas entirely.

mantras.sanskrit: अवा नो अग्न ऊतिभिर्गायत्रस्य प्रभर्मणि । विश्वासु धीषु वन्द्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: avā no agna ūtibhirgāyatrasya prabharmaṇi | viśvāsu dhīṣu vandya ||

translations.english: Agni, who in all rites are to be praised, guard us with your protection, (propitiated) by the recitation of the metrical hymn.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो अग्ने रयिं भर सत्रासाहं वरेण्यम् । विश्वासु पृत्सु दुष्टरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no agne rayiṃ bhara satrāsāhaṃ vareṇyam | viśvāsu pṛtsu duṣṭaram ||

translations.english: Grant us, Agni, riches that dispel poverty that are desirable (to all), and cannot be taken (from us) in all encounters (with our foes).

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो अग्ने सुचेतुना रयिं विश्वायुपोषसम् । मार्डीकं धेहि जीवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no agne sucetunā rayiṃ viśvāyupoṣasam | mārḍīkaṃ dhehi jīvase ||

translations.english: Grant us, Agni, for our livelihood, wealth, with sound understanding, conferring happiness, and sustaining (us) through life.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र पूतास्तिग्मशोचिषे वाचो गोतमाग्नये । भरस्व सुम्नयुर्गिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra pūtāstigmaśociṣe vāco gotamāgnaye | bharasva sumnayurgiraḥ ||

translations.english: Gotama, desirous of wealth, offers to the sharp-flaming Agni pure prayers and praises.

mantras.sanskrit: यो नो अग्नेऽभिदासत्यन्ति दूरे पदीष्ट सः । अस्माकमिद्वृधे भव ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo no agne'bhidāsatyanti dūre padīṣṭa saḥ | asmākamidvṛdhe bhava ||

translations.english: May he, Agni, who annoys us, whether nigh or afar perish; and do you be to us (propitious) for our advancement.

mantras.sanskrit: सहस्राक्षो विचर्षणिरग्नी रक्षांसि सेधति । होता गृणीत उक्थ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sahasrākṣo vicarṣaṇiragnī rakṣāṃsi sedhati | hotā gṛṇīta ukthyaḥ ||

translations.english: The thousand-eyed, all-beholding, Agni, drives away the rākṣasas, and (praised by us) with holy hymns, he, the (invoker of the gods) celebrates their praise.

mantras.sanskrit: इत्था हि सोम इन्मदे ब्रह्मा चकार वर्धनम् । शविष्ठ वज्रिन्नोजसा पृथिव्या निः शशा अहिमर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: itthā hi soma inmade brahmā cakāra vardhanam | śaviṣṭha vajrinnojasā pṛthivyā niḥ śaśā ahimarcannanu svarājyam ||

translations.english: Mighty wielder of the thunderbolt, when the priest had thus exalted you (by praise), and exhilarating Soma (had been drunk), you did expel, by your vigour, Ahi from the earth, manifesting your own soverignty.

mantras.sanskrit: स त्वामदद्वृषा मदः सोमः श्येनाभृतः सुतः । येना वृत्रं निरद्भ्यो जघन्थ वज्रिन्नोजसार्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa tvāmadadvṛṣā madaḥ somaḥ śyenābhṛtaḥ sutaḥ | yenā vṛtraṃ niradbhyo jaghantha vajrinnojasārcannanu svarājyam ||

translations.english: That exceedingly exhilarating Soma, which was brought by the hawk (from heaven), when poured forth, has exhilarated you, so that in your vigour, thunderer, you have struck Vṛtra from the sky, manifesting your own sovereignty.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रेह्यभीहि धृष्णुहि न ते वज्रो नि यंसते । इन्द्र नृम्णं हि ते शवो हनो वृत्रं जया अपोऽर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: prehyabhīhi dhṛṣṇuhi na te vajro ni yaṃsate | indra nṛmṇaṃ hi te śavo hano vṛtraṃ jayā apo'rcannanu svarājyam ||

translations.english: Hasten, assail, subdue; your thunderbolt cannot fail; your vigour, Indra, destroys men; slay Vṛtra, win the waters, manifesting your own sovereignty.

mantras.sanskrit: निरिन्द्र भूम्या अधि वृत्रं जघन्थ निर्दिवः । सृजा मरुत्वतीरव जीवधन्या इमा अपोऽर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nirindra bhūmyā adhi vṛtraṃ jaghantha nirdivaḥ | sṛjā marutvatīrava jīvadhanyā imā apo'rcannanu svarājyam ||

translations.english: Youu have struck Vṛtra from off the earth and from heaven; (now) let loose the wind-bound, life-sustaining rain, manifesting your own sovereignty.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रो वृत्रस्य दोधतः सानुं वज्रेण हीळितः । अभिक्रम्याव जिघ्नतेऽपः सर्माय चोदयन्नर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indro vṛtrasya dodhataḥ sānuṃ vajreṇa hīḷitaḥ | abhikramyāva jighnate'paḥ sarmāya codayannarcannanu svarājyam ||

translations.english: Indignant Indra, encountering him, has struck with his bolt the jaw of the trembling Vṛtra, setting the waters free to flow, and manifesting his own soverignty.

mantras.sanskrit: अधि सानौ नि जिघ्नते वज्रेण शतपर्वणा । मन्दान इन्द्रो अन्धसः सखिभ्यो गातुमिच्छत्यर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhi sānau ni jighnate vajreṇa śataparvaṇā | mandāna indro andhasaḥ sakhibhyo gātumicchatyarcannanu svarājyam ||

translations.english: Indra has struck him on the temple with his hundred-edged thunderbolt, and, exulting, wishes to provide means of sustenance for his friends, manifesting his own sovereignty.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र तुभ्यमिदद्रिवोऽनुत्तं वज्रिन्वीर्यम् । यद्ध त्यं मायिनं मृगं तमु त्वं माययावधीरर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra tubhyamidadrivo'nuttaṃ vajrinvīryam | yaddha tyaṃ māyinaṃ mṛgaṃ tamu tvaṃ māyayāvadhīrarcannanu svarājyam ||

translations.english: Cloud-borne, Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, verily your prowess is undisputed, since you, with (superior) craft, have slain that deceptive deer, manifesting your own sovereignty.

mantras.sanskrit: वि ते वज्रासो अस्थिरन्नवतिं नाव्या अनु । महत्त इन्द्र वीर्यं बाह्वोस्ते बलं हितमर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi te vajrāso asthirannavatiṃ nāvyā anu | mahatta indra vīryaṃ bāhvoste balaṃ hitamarcannanu svarājyam ||

translations.english: Your thunderbolts were scattered widely over ninety-and-nine rivers; great is your prowess, strength is deposited in your arms, manifesting your own sovereignty.

mantras.sanskrit: सहस्रं साकमर्चत परि ष्टोभत विंशतिः । शतैनमन्वनोनवुरिन्द्राय ब्रह्मोद्यतमर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sahasraṃ sākamarcata pari ṣṭobhata viṃśatiḥ | śatainamanvanonavurindrāya brahmodyatamarcannanu svarājyam ||

translations.english: A thousand mortals worshipped him together, twenty have hymned (his praise); a hundred (sages) repeatedly glorify him; so, Indra, is the oblation lifted up, manifesting your own sovereignty.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रो वृत्रस्य तविषीं निरहन्त्सहसा सहः । महत्तदस्य पौंस्यं वृत्रं जघन्वाँ असृजदर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indro vṛtrasya taviṣīṃ nirahantsahasā sahaḥ | mahattadasya pauṃsyaṃ vṛtraṃ jaghanvā~ asṛjadarcannanu svarājyam ||

translations.english: Indra overcame by his strength the strength of Vṛtra; great is his manhood, wherewith, having slain Vṛtra, he lest loose the waters, manifesting his own sovereignty.

mantras.sanskrit: इमे चित्तव मन्यवे वेपेते भियसा मही । यदिन्द्र वज्रिन्नोजसा वृत्रं मरुत्वाँ अवधीरर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ime cittava manyave vepete bhiyasā mahī | yadindra vajrinnojasā vṛtraṃ marutvā~ avadhīrarcannanu svarājyam ||

translations.english: This heaven and earth trembled, thunderer, at your wrath, when, attended by the Maruts, you slew Vṛtra by your prowess, manifesting your own sovereignty.

mantras.sanskrit: न वेपसा न तन्यतेन्द्रं वृत्रो वि बीभयत् । अभ्येनं वज्र आयसः सहस्रभृष्टिरायतार्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: na vepasā na tanyatendraṃ vṛtro vi bībhayat | abhyenaṃ vajra āyasaḥ sahasrabhṛṣṭirāyatārcannanu svarājyam ||

translations.english: Vṛtra deterred not Indra by his trembling or his clamour; the many-edged iron thunderbolt fell upon him; (Indra) manifesting his own sovereignty.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्वृत्रं तव चाशनिं वज्रेण समयोधयः । अहिमिन्द्र जिघांसतो दिवि ते बद्बधे शवोऽर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadvṛtraṃ tava cāśaniṃ vajreṇa samayodhayaḥ | ahimindra jighāṃsato divi te badbadhe śavo'rcannanu svarājyam ||

translations.english: When you (Indra), did encounter with your bolt Vṛtra and the thunderbolt (which he hurled), then Indra, the strength of you determination to slay Ahi was displayed in the heavens, manifesting your own sovereignty.

mantras.sanskrit: अभिष्टने ते अद्रिवो यत्स्था जगच्च रेजते । त्वष्टा चित्तव मन्यव इन्द्र वेविज्यते भियार्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhiṣṭane te adrivo yatsthā jagacca rejate | tvaṣṭā cittava manyava indra vevijyate bhiyārcannanu svarājyam ||

translations.english: At your shout, wielder of the thunderbolt, all things, moveable or immoveable, trembled; even Tvaṣṭā shook with fear, Indra, at your wrath, manifesting your own sovereignty.

mantras.sanskrit: नहि नु यादधीमसीन्द्रं को वीर्या परः । तस्मिन्नृम्णमुत क्रतुं देवा ओजांसि सं दधुरर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahi nu yādadhīmasīndraṃ ko vīryā paraḥ | tasminnṛmṇamuta kratuṃ devā ojāṃsi saṃ dadhurarcannanu svarājyam ||

translations.english: We know not of a certainty the all-pervading Indra; who (does know him, abiding) afar off in his strength? for in him have the gods concentrated riches, and worship, and power, manifesting his own sovereignty.

mantras.sanskrit: यामथर्वा मनुष्पिता दध्यङ्धियमत्नत । तस्मिन्ब्रह्माणि पूर्वथेन्द्र उक्था समग्मतार्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yāmatharvā manuṣpitā dadhyaṅdhiyamatnata | tasminbrahmāṇi pūrvathendra ukthā samagmatārcannanu svarājyam ||

translations.english: In like manner as of old, so in whatever act of worship Atharvan or father Manu, or Dadhyañc engaged, their oblations and their hymns were all congregated in that Indra, manifesting his own sovereignty.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रो मदाय वावृधे शवसे वृत्रहा नृभिः । तमिन्महत्स्वाजिषूतेमर्भे हवामहे स वाजेषु प्र नोऽविषत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indro madāya vāvṛdhe śavase vṛtrahā nṛbhiḥ | taminmahatsvājiṣūtemarbhe havāmahe sa vājeṣu pra no'viṣat ||

translations.english: Indra, the slayer of Vṛtra, has been augmented in strength and satisfaction by (the adoration of) men; we invoke him in great conflicts as well as in little conflicts; may he defend us in battles.

mantras.sanskrit: असि हि वीर सेन्योऽसि भूरि पराददिः । असि दभ्रस्य चिद्वृधो यजमानाय शिक्षसि सुन्वते भूरि ते वसु ॥
mantras.transliteration: asi hi vīra senyo'si bhūri parādadiḥ | asi dabhrasya cidvṛdho yajamānāya śikṣasi sunvate bhūri te vasu ||

translations.english: For you, here, Indra, are a host; you are the giver of much booty; you are the exalter of the humble; you bestow (riches) on the worshipper who offers you oblations, for abundant is your wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: यदुदीरत आजयो धृष्णवे धीयते धना । युक्ष्वा मदच्युता हरी कं हनः कं वसौ दधोऽस्माँ इन्द्र वसौ दधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadudīrata ājayo dhṛṣṇave dhīyate dhanā | yukṣvā madacyutā harī kaṃ hanaḥ kaṃ vasau dadho'smā~ indra vasau dadhaḥ ||

translations.english: When battles arise, wealth devolves on the victor; yoke your horses, humblers of the pride (of the foe), that you may destroy one and enrich another; plural ce us, Indra, in affluence.

mantras.sanskrit: क्रत्वा महाँ अनुष्वधं भीम आ वावृधे शवः । श्रिय ऋष्व उपाकयोर्नि शिप्री हरिवान्दधे हस्तयोर्वज्रमायसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kratvā mahā~ anuṣvadhaṃ bhīma ā vāvṛdhe śavaḥ | śriya ṛṣva upākayorni śiprī harivāndadhe hastayorvajramāyasam ||

translations.english: Mighty through sacrifice, formidable (to foes), partaking of the sacrificial food, Indra has augmented his strength; plural asing in appearance, having a handsome chin, and possessing (bright) coursers, he grasps the metal thunder-bolt in his contiguous hands for (our) prosperity.

mantras.sanskrit: आ पप्रौ पार्थिवं रजो बद्बधे रोचना दिवि । न त्वावाँ इन्द्र कश्चन न जातो न जनिष्यतेऽति विश्वं ववक्षिथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā paprau pārthivaṃ rajo badbadhe rocanā divi | na tvāvā~ indra kaścana na jāto na janiṣyate'ti viśvaṃ vavakṣitha ||

translations.english: He has filled the space of earth and the firmament (with his glory); he has fixed the constellations in the sky; no one has been ever born, now will be born, Indra, like you; you have sustained the universe.

mantras.sanskrit: यो अर्यो मर्तभोजनं पराददाति दाशुषे । इन्द्रो अस्मभ्यं शिक्षतु वि भजा भूरि ते वसु भक्षीय तव राधसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo aryo martabhojanaṃ parādadāti dāśuṣe | indro asmabhyaṃ śikṣatu vi bhajā bhūri te vasu bhakṣīya tava rādhasaḥ ||

translations.english: May Indra, the protector, who returns to the giver (of oblations) the food that is fit for mortals, bestow (such food) on us; distribute your wealth, which is abundant, so that I may obtain (a portion) of your riches.

mantras.sanskrit: मदेमदे हि नो ददिर्यूथा गवामृजुक्रतुः । सं गृभाय पुरू शतोभयाहस्त्या वसु शिशीहि राय आ भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: mademade hi no dadiryūthā gavāmṛjukratuḥ | saṃ gṛbhāya purū śatobhayāhastyā vasu śiśīhi rāya ā bhara ||

translations.english: The upright performer of (pious) acts is the donor of herds of cattle to us, when receiving frequent enjoyment (from our libations); take up, Indra, with both hands, many hundred (sorts) of treasure; sharpen (our intellects), bring us wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: मादयस्व सुते सचा शवसे शूर राधसे । विद्मा हि त्वा पुरूवसुमुप कामान्त्ससृज्महेऽथा नोऽविता भव ॥
mantras.transliteration: mādayasva sute sacā śavase śūra rādhase | vidmā hi tvā purūvasumupa kāmāntsasṛjmahe'thā no'vitā bhava ||

translations.english: Enjoy along with us, O hero, the suffused libation for (the increase of our) strength and wealth; we know you (to be) the possessor of vast riches, and address to our desires; be, therefore, our protector.

mantras.sanskrit: एते त इन्द्र जन्तवो विश्वं पुष्यन्ति वार्यम् । अन्तर्हि ख्यो जनानामर्यो वेदो अदाशुषां तेषां नो वेद आ भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: ete ta indra jantavo viśvaṃ puṣyanti vāryam | antarhi khyo janānāmaryo vedo adāśuṣāṃ teṣāṃ no veda ā bhara ||

translations.english: These, your creatures, Indra, cherish (the oblation) that may be partaken of by all; you, lord of all, know what are the riches of those men who make no offerings; bring their wealth to us.

mantras.sanskrit: उपो षु शृणुही गिरो मघवन्मातथा इव । यदा नः सूनृतावतः कर आदर्थयास इद्योजा न्विन्द्र ते हरी ॥
mantras.transliteration: upo ṣu śṛṇuhī giro maghavanmātathā iva | yadā naḥ sūnṛtāvataḥ kara ādarthayāsa idyojā nvindra te harī ||

translations.english: Approach, Maghavan, and listen to our praises; be not different (from what you have hitherto been) since you have inspired us with true speech, you are solicited with it; therefore, quickly yoke your horses.

mantras.sanskrit: अक्षन्नमीमदन्त ह्यव प्रिया अधूषत । अस्तोषत स्वभानवो विप्रा नविष्ठया मती योजा न्विन्द्र ते हरी ॥
mantras.transliteration: akṣannamīmadanta hyava priyā adhūṣata | astoṣata svabhānavo viprā naviṣṭhayā matī yojā nvindra te harī ||

translations.english: (Your worshippers) have eaten the food which you had given, and have rejoiced, and have trembled through their precious (bodies); self-illuminated sages have glorified you with commendable thoughts; therefore, Indra, quickly yoke your horses.

mantras.sanskrit: सुसंदृशं त्वा वयं मघवन्वन्दिषीमहि । प्र नूनं पूर्णवन्धुरः स्तुतो याहि वशाँ अनु योजा न्विन्द्र ते हरी ॥
mantras.transliteration: susaṃdṛśaṃ tvā vayaṃ maghavanvandiṣīmahi | pra nūnaṃ pūrṇavandhuraḥ stuto yāhi vaśā~ anu yojā nvindra te harī ||

translations.english: We praise you, Maghavan, who look benignly (upon all); thus praised by us, repair (in your car), filled with treasure, to those who desire your presence; Indra, quickly yoke your horses.

mantras.sanskrit: स घा तं वृषणं रथमधि तिष्ठाति गोविदम् । यः पात्रं हारियोजनं पूर्णमिन्द्र चिकेतति योजा न्विन्द्र ते हरी ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa ghā taṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rathamadhi tiṣṭhāti govidam | yaḥ pātraṃ hāriyojanaṃ pūrṇamindra ciketati yojā nvindra te harī ||

translations.english: May he ascend that chariot which rains (blessings), and grants cattle, and which provides the vessel filled with the mixture of Soma and grain; quickly, Indra, yoke your horses.

mantras.sanskrit: युक्तस्ते अस्तु दक्षिण उत सव्यः शतक्रतो । तेन जायामुप प्रियां मन्दानो याह्यन्धसो योजा न्विन्द्र ते हरी ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuktaste astu dakṣiṇa uta savyaḥ śatakrato | tena jāyāmupa priyāṃ mandāno yāhyandhaso yojā nvindra te harī ||

translations.english: Performer of many (holy) acts, let your steeds be harnessed on the right and on the left, and when exhilarated by the (sacrificial) food, repair in your chariot to your beloved wife; quickly, Indra, yoke your horses.

mantras.sanskrit: युनज्मि ते ब्रह्मणा केशिना हरी उप प्र याहि दधिषे गभस्त्योः । उत्त्वा सुतासो रभसा अमन्दिषुः पूषण्वान्वज्रिन्त्समु पत्न्यामदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yunajmi te brahmaṇā keśinā harī upa pra yāhi dadhiṣe gabhastyoḥ | uttvā sutāso rabhasā amandiṣuḥ pūṣaṇvānvajrintsamu patnyāmadaḥ ||

translations.english: I harness your long-maned steeds wiht (sacred prayers); depart; take the reins in your hands; the effused and exciting juices have exhilarated you wilder of the thunderbolt; thus filled with nutriment, rejoice with your spouse.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्वावति प्रथमो गोषु गच्छति सुप्रावीरिन्द्र मर्त्यस्तवोतिभिः । तमित्पृणक्षि वसुना भवीयसा सिन्धुमापो यथाभितो विचेतसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvāvati prathamo goṣu gacchati suprāvīrindra martyastavotibhiḥ | tamitpṛṇakṣi vasunā bhavīyasā sindhumāpo yathābhito vicetasaḥ ||

translations.english: The man who is well protected, Indra, by your cares, (and dwells) in a mansion where there are horses, is the first who goes to (that where there are) cows; enrich him with abundant riches, as the unconscious rivers flow in all directions to the ocean.

mantras.sanskrit: आपो न देवीरुप यन्ति होत्रियमवः पश्यन्ति विततं यथा रजः । प्राचैर्देवासः प्र णयन्ति देवयुं ब्रह्मप्रियं जोषयन्ते वरा इव ॥
mantras.transliteration: āpo na devīrupa yanti hotriyamavaḥ paśyanti vitataṃ yathā rajaḥ | prācairdevāsaḥ pra ṇayanti devayuṃ brahmapriyaṃ joṣayante varā iva ||

translations.english: In like manner, as the bright waters flow to the sacrificial ladle, so they (the gods) look down (upon it); as the diffusive light (descends to earth), the gods convey it, desirous of being presented to them by progressive (movements to the altar), and are impatient to enjoy it, filled with the oblation, as bridegrooms (long for their brides).

mantras.sanskrit: अधि द्वयोरदधा उक्थ्यं वचो यतस्रुचा मिथुना या सपर्यतः । असंयत्तो व्रते ते क्षेति पुष्यति भद्रा शक्तिर्यजमानाय सुन्वते ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhi dvayoradadhā ukthyaṃ vaco yatasrucā mithunā yā saparyataḥ | asaṃyatto vrate te kṣeti puṣyati bhadrā śaktiryajamānāya sunvate ||

translations.english: You have associated, Indra, words of sacred praise with both (the grain and butter of oblation), plural ced together in ladles and jointly presented to you, so that (the sacrificer), undisturbed, remains (engaged) in your worship, and is prosperous; for to the sacrificer pouring out oblations (to you), auspicious power is granted.

mantras.sanskrit: आदङ्गिराः प्रथमं दधिरे वय इद्धाग्नयः शम्या ये सुकृत्यया । सर्वं पणेः समविन्दन्त भोजनमश्वावन्तं गोमन्तमा पशुं नरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ādaṅgirāḥ prathamaṃ dadhire vaya iddhāgnayaḥ śamyā ye sukṛtyayā | sarvaṃ paṇeḥ samavindanta bhojanamaśvāvantaṃ gomantamā paśuṃ naraḥ ||

translations.english: The Aṅgirasas first prepared (for Indra) the sacrificial food, and then, with kindled fire, (worshipped him) with a most holy rite; they, the instrumental tutors (of the ceremony); acquired all the wealth of Paṇi, comprising horses, and cows, and (other) animals.

mantras.sanskrit: यज्ञैरथर्वा प्रथमः पथस्तते ततः सूर्यो व्रतपा वेन आजनि । आ गा आजदुशना काव्यः सचा यमस्य जातममृतं यजामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajñairatharvā prathamaḥ pathastate tataḥ sūryo vratapā vena ājani | ā gā ājaduśanā kāvyaḥ sacā yamasya jātamamṛtaṃ yajāmahe ||

translations.english: Atharvan first by sacrifices discovered the path (of the stolen cattle); then the bright sun, the cherisher of pious acts, was born. Atharvan regained the cattle; Kāvya (Uṣanās) was associated with him. Let us worship the immortal (Indra), who was born to restrain (the asuras).

mantras.sanskrit: बर्हिर्वा यत्स्वपत्याय वृज्यतेऽर्को वा श्लोकमाघोषते दिवि । ग्रावा यत्र वदति कारुरुक्थ्यस्तस्येदिन्द्रो अभिपित्वेषु रण्यति ॥
mantras.transliteration: barhirvā yatsvapatyāya vṛjyate'rko vā ślokamāghoṣate divi | grāvā yatra vadati kārurukthyastasyedindro abhipitveṣu raṇyati ||

translations.english: Whether the holy grass be cut (for the rite) that brings down blessings, whether the priest repeats (the sacred) verse in the brilliant (sacrifice), whether the stone (that expresses the Soma) sound like the priest who repeats the hymn, on all these occasions Indra rejoices.

mantras.sanskrit: असावि सोम इन्द्र ते शविष्ठ धृष्णवा गहि । आ त्वा पृणक्त्विन्द्रियं रजः सूर्यो न रश्मिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asāvi soma indra te śaviṣṭha dhṛṣṇavā gahi | ā tvā pṛṇaktvindriyaṃ rajaḥ sūryo na raśmibhiḥ ||

translations.english: The Soma has been expressed, Indra, for you; potent humber (of your foes), approach; may vigour fill you (by Soma), as the sun fills the firmament with his rays.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रमिद्धरी वहतोऽप्रतिधृष्टशवसम् । ऋषीणां च स्तुतीरुप यज्ञं च मानुषाणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indramiddharī vahato'pratidhṛṣṭaśavasam | ṛṣīṇāṃ ca stutīrupa yajñaṃ ca mānuṣāṇām ||

translations.english: May his horses bear Indra, who is of irresistible prowess, to the praises and sacrifices of sages and of men.

mantras.sanskrit: आ तिष्ठ वृत्रहन्रथं युक्ता ते ब्रह्मणा हरी । अर्वाचीनं सु ते मनो ग्रावा कृणोतु वग्नुना ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tiṣṭha vṛtrahanrathaṃ yuktā te brahmaṇā harī | arvācīnaṃ su te mano grāvā kṛṇotu vagnunā ||

translations.english: Slayer of Vṛtra, ascend your chariot, for your horses have been yoked by prayer; may the stone (that bruises the Soma) attract, by its sound, your mind towards us.

mantras.sanskrit: इममिन्द्र सुतं पिब ज्येष्ठममर्त्यं मदम् । शुक्रस्य त्वाभ्यक्षरन्धारा ऋतस्य सादने ॥
mantras.transliteration: imamindra sutaṃ piba jyeṣṭhamamartyaṃ madam | śukrasya tvābhyakṣarandhārā ṛtasya sādane ||

translations.english: Drink, Indra, this excellent, immortal exhilarating libation, the dropf of which pellucid (beverage) flow towards you in the chamber of sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राय नूनमर्चतोक्थानि च ब्रवीतन । सुता अमत्सुरिन्दवो ज्येष्ठं नमस्यता सहः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāya nūnamarcatokthāni ca bravītana | sutā amatsurindavo jyeṣṭhaṃ namasyatā sahaḥ ||

translations.english: Offer worship quickly to Indra; recite hymns (in his praise); let the effused drops exhilarate him; pay adoration to his superior strength.

mantras.sanskrit: नकिष्ट्वद्रथीतरो हरी यदिन्द्र यच्छसे । नकिष्ट्वानु मज्मना नकिः स्वश्व आनशे ॥
mantras.transliteration: nakiṣṭvadrathītaro harī yadindra yacchase | nakiṣṭvānu majmanā nakiḥ svaśva ānaśe ||

translations.english: When, Indra, you harness your horses, there is no one a better charioteer than you; no one is equal to you in strength; no one, although well-horsed, has overtaken you.

mantras.sanskrit: य एक इद्विदयते वसु मर्ताय दाशुषे । ईशानो अप्रतिष्कुत इन्द्रो अङ्ग ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya eka idvidayate vasu martāya dāśuṣe | īśāno apratiṣkuta indro aṅga ||

translations.english: He who alone bestows wealth upon the man who offers him oblations, is the undisputed sovereign, Indra--ho!

mantras.sanskrit: कदा मर्तमराधसं पदा क्षुम्पमिव स्फुरत् । कदा नः शुश्रवद्गिर इन्द्रो अङ्ग ॥
mantras.transliteration: kadā martamarādhasaṃ padā kṣumpamiva sphurat | kadā naḥ śuśravadgira indro aṅga ||

translations.english: When all he trample with his foot upon the man who offers no oblations, as if upon a coiled-up snake; when will Indra listen to our praises? ho!

mantras.sanskrit: यश्चिद्धि त्वा बहुभ्य आ सुतावाँ आविवासति । उग्रं तत्पत्यते शव इन्द्रो अङ्ग ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaściddhi tvā bahubhya ā sutāvā~ āvivāsati | ugraṃ tatpatyate śava indro aṅga ||

translations.english: Indra, grant formidable strength to him who worships him, having libations prepared--ho!

mantras.sanskrit: स्वादोरित्था विषूवतो मध्वः पिबन्ति गौर्यः । या इन्द्रेण सयावरीर्वृष्णा मदन्ति शोभसे वस्वीरनु स्वराज्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: svādoritthā viṣūvato madhvaḥ pibanti gauryaḥ | yā indreṇa sayāvarīrvṛṣṇā madanti śobhase vasvīranu svarājyam ||

translations.english: The white cows drink of the sweet Soma thus poured forth, and associated with the bountiful Indra, for the sake of beauty, rejoice; abiding (in their stalls), they are expectant of his sovereignty.

mantras.sanskrit: ता अस्य पृशनायुवः सोमं श्रीणन्ति पृश्नयः । प्रिया इन्द्रस्य धेनवो वज्रं हिन्वन्ति सायकं वस्वीरनु स्वराज्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā asya pṛśanāyuvaḥ somaṃ śrīṇanti pṛśnayaḥ | priyā indrasya dhenavo vajraṃ hinvanti sāyakaṃ vasvīranu svarājyam ||

translations.english: Desirous of his contact, those bridled cows dilute the Soma with their milk; the kine that are loved of Indra direct his destructive thunderbolt against his foes, abiding (in their stalls) expectant of his sovereignty.

mantras.sanskrit: ता अस्य नमसा सहः सपर्यन्ति प्रचेतसः । व्रतान्यस्य सश्चिरे पुरूणि पूर्वचित्तये वस्वीरनु स्वराज्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā asya namasā sahaḥ saparyanti pracetasaḥ | vratānyasya saścire purūṇi pūrvacittaye vasvīranu svarājyam ||

translations.english: These intelligent kine reverence his prowess with the adoration (of their milk); they celebrate his manly exploits as an example to later (adversaries); abiding (in their stalls), expectant of his sovereignty.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रो दधीचो अस्थभिर्वृत्राण्यप्रतिष्कुतः । जघान नवतीर्नव ॥
mantras.transliteration: indro dadhīco asthabhirvṛtrāṇyapratiṣkutaḥ | jaghāna navatīrnava ||

translations.english: Indra, with the bones of Dadhīci, slew ninety times nine Vṛtras.

mantras.sanskrit: इच्छन्नश्वस्य यच्छिरः पर्वतेष्वपश्रितम् । तद्विदच्छर्यणावति ॥
mantras.transliteration: icchannaśvasya yacchiraḥ parvateṣvapaśritam | tadvidaccharyaṇāvati ||

translations.english: Wishing for the horse's head hidden in the mountains, he found is Śaryaṇāvat.

mantras.sanskrit: अत्राह गोरमन्वत नाम त्वष्टुरपीच्यम् । इत्था चन्द्रमसो गृहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: atrāha goramanvata nāma tvaṣṭurapīcyam | itthā candramaso gṛhe ||

translations.english: The (solar rays) found on this occasion the light of Tvaṣṭā verily concealed in the mansion of the moving moon.

mantras.sanskrit: को अद्य युङ्क्ते धुरि गा ऋतस्य शिमीवतो भामिनो दुर्हृणायून् । आसन्निषून्हृत्स्वसो मयोभून्य एषां भृत्यामृणधत्स जीवात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ko adya yuṅkte dhuri gā ṛtasya śimīvato bhāmino durhṛṇāyūn | āsanniṣūnhṛtsvaso mayobhūnya eṣāṃ bhṛtyāmṛṇadhatsa jīvāt ||

translations.english: Who yokes todya to the pole of the car (of Indra) his vigorous and radiant steeds, whose fury is unbearable, in whose mouths are arrows, who trample on the hearts (of enemies), who give happiness (to friends). (The sacrificer) who praises their (performance of their) duties obtains (long) life.

mantras.sanskrit: क ईषते तुज्यते को बिभाय को मंसते सन्तमिन्द्रं को अन्ति । कस्तोकाय क इभायोत रायेऽधि ब्रवत्तन्वे को जनाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: ka īṣate tujyate ko bibhāya ko maṃsate santamindraṃ ko anti | kastokāya ka ibhāyota rāye'dhi bravattanve ko janāya ||

translations.english: Who goes forth, (through dread of foes, when Indra is at hand); who is harmed (by his enemies); who is terrified; who is aware that Indra is present, who that he is night? What need is there that any one should importune Indra for his son, his elephant, his property, his person n, or his people?

mantras.sanskrit: को अग्निमीट्टे हविषा घृतेन स्रुचा यजाता ऋतुभिर्ध्रुवेभिः । कस्मै देवा आ वहानाशु होम को मंसते वीतिहोत्रः सुदेवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ko agnimīṭṭe haviṣā ghṛtena srucā yajātā ṛtubhirdhruvebhiḥ | kasmai devā ā vahānāśu homa ko maṃsate vītihotraḥ sudevaḥ ||

translations.english: Who praises the (sacrificial) fire, (lighted for Indra), or worships him with the oblation of clarified butter, presented in the ladle, according to the constant seasons? To whom do the gods quickly bring (the wealth) that has been called for? What sacrificer, engaged in offering oblations and favoured by the gods, thoroughly knows Indra?

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमङ्ग प्र शंसिषो देवः शविष्ठ मर्त्यम् । न त्वदन्यो मघवन्नस्ति मर्डितेन्द्र ब्रवीमि ते वचः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamaṅga pra śaṃsiṣo devaḥ śaviṣṭha martyam | na tvadanyo maghavannasti marḍitendra bravīmi te vacaḥ ||

translations.english: Powerful, Indra, be present and be favourable to the mortal (who adores you); there is no other giver of felicity, Maghavan, than you; hence, Indra, I recite your praise.

mantras.sanskrit: मा ते राधांसि मा त ऊतयो वसोऽस्मान्कदा चना दभन् । विश्वा च न उपमिमीहि मानुष वसूनि चर्षणिभ्य आ ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā te rādhāṃsi mā ta ūtayo vaso'smānkadā canā dabhan | viśvā ca na upamimīhi mānuṣa vasūni carṣaṇibhya ā ||

translations.english: Granter of dwellings, let not your treasury, let not your benefits, ever be detrimental to us. Friend of mankind, bring to us, who are acquainted with prayers, all sorts of riches.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ये शुम्भन्ते जनयो न सप्तयो यामन्रुद्रस्य सूनवः सुदंससः । रोदसी हि मरुतश्चक्रिरे वृधे मदन्ति वीरा विदथेषु घृष्वयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra ye śumbhante janayo na saptayo yāmanrudrasya sūnavaḥ sudaṃsasaḥ | rodasī hi marutaścakrire vṛdhe madanti vīrā vidatheṣu ghṛṣvayaḥ ||

translations.english: The Maruts who are going forth decorate themselves like feminine les; they are gliders (through the air), the sons of Rudra, and doers of good works by which they promote the welfare of earth and heaven; heroes, who grind (solid rocks), they delight in sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: त उक्षितासो महिमानमाशत दिवि रुद्रासो अधि चक्रिरे सदः । अर्चन्तो अर्कं जनयन्त इन्द्रियमधि श्रियो दधिरे पृश्निमातरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ta ukṣitāso mahimānamāśata divi rudrāso adhi cakrire sadaḥ | arcanto arkaṃ janayanta indriyamadhi śriyo dadhire pṛśnimātaraḥ ||

translations.english: They, inaugurated by the gods, have attained majesty; the sons of Rudra have established their dwelling above the sky; glorify him (Indra) who merits to be glorified, they have inspired him with vigour; the sons of Pṛśni have acquired dominion.

mantras.sanskrit: गोमातरो यच्छुभयन्ते अञ्जिभिस्तनूषु शुभ्रा दधिरे विरुक्मतः । बाधन्ते विश्वमभिमातिनमप वर्त्मान्येषामनु रीयते घृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: gomātaro yacchubhayante añjibhistanūṣu śubhrā dadhire virukmataḥ | bādhante viśvamabhimātinamapa vartmānyeṣāmanu rīyate ghṛtam ||

translations.english: When the sonf of earth embellish themselves with ornaments, they shine resplendent in their person ns with (brilliant) decorations; they keep aloof every adversary; the waters follow their path.

mantras.sanskrit: वि ये भ्राजन्ते सुमखास ऋष्टिभिः प्रच्यावयन्तो अच्युता चिदोजसा । मनोजुवो यन्मरुतो रथेष्वा वृषव्रातासः पृषतीरयुग्ध्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi ye bhrājante sumakhāsa ṛṣṭibhiḥ pracyāvayanto acyutā cidojasā | manojuvo yanmaruto ratheṣvā vṛṣavrātāsaḥ pṛṣatīrayugdhvam ||

translations.english: They who are worthily worshipped shine with various weapons; incapable of being overthrown, they are the over-throwers (of mountains); Maruts, swift as thought, entrusted with the duty of sending rain, yoke the spotted deer to your cars.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र यद्रथेषु पृषतीरयुग्ध्वं वाजे अद्रिं मरुतो रंहयन्तः । उतारुषस्य वि ष्यन्ति धाराश्चर्मेवोदभिर्व्युन्दन्ति भूम ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra yadratheṣu pṛṣatīrayugdhvaṃ vāje adriṃ maruto raṃhayantaḥ | utāruṣasya vi ṣyanti dhārāścarmevodabhirvyundanti bhūma ||

translations.english: When, Maruts, urging on the cloud, for the sake of (providing) food, you have yoked the deer to your chariots, the drops fall from the radiant (sun), and moisten the earth, like a hide, with water.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वो वहन्तु सप्तयो रघुष्यदो रघुपत्वानः प्र जिगात बाहुभिः । सीदता बर्हिरुरु वः सदस्कृतं मादयध्वं मरुतो मध्वो अन्धसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vo vahantu saptayo raghuṣyado raghupatvānaḥ pra jigāta bāhubhiḥ | sīdatā barhiruru vaḥ sadaskṛtaṃ mādayadhvaṃ maruto madhvo andhasaḥ ||

translations.english: Let your quick-paced, smooth-gliding coursers bear you (hither); and moving swiftly, come with your hands (filled with good things); sit, Maruts, upon the broad seat of sacred grass, and regale yourselves with the sweet sacrificial food.

mantras.sanskrit: तेऽवर्धन्त स्वतवसो महित्वना नाकं तस्थुरुरु चक्रिरे सदः । विष्णुर्यद्धावद्वृषणं मदच्युतं वयो न सीदन्नधि बर्हिषि प्रिये ॥
mantras.transliteration: te'vardhanta svatavaso mahitvanā nākaṃ tasthururu cakrire sadaḥ | viṣṇuryaddhāvadvṛṣaṇaṃ madacyutaṃ vayo na sīdannadhi barhiṣi priye ||

translations.english: Confiding in their own strength, they have increased in (power); they have attained heaven by their greatness, and have made (for themselves) a spacious abode; may they, for whom Viṣṇu defends (the sacrifice) that bestows all desires and confers delight, come (quickly), like birds, and sit down upon the plural asant and sacred grass.

mantras.sanskrit: शूरा इवेद्युयुधयो न जग्मयः श्रवस्यवो न पृतनासु येतिरे । भयन्ते विश्वा भुवना मरुद्भ्यो राजान इव त्वेषसंदृशो नरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śūrā ivedyuyudhayo na jagmayaḥ śravasyavo na pṛtanāsu yetire | bhayante viśvā bhuvanā marudbhyo rājāna iva tveṣasaṃdṛśo naraḥ ||

translations.english: Like heroes, like combatants, like men anxious for food, the swift-moving (Maruts) have engaged in battles; all beings fear the Maruts, who are the leaders (of the rain), and awful of aspect, like princes.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वष्टा यद्वज्रं सुकृतं हिरण्ययं सहस्रभृष्टिं स्वपा अवर्तयत् । धत्त इन्द्रो नर्यपांसि कर्तवेऽहन्वृत्रं निरपामौब्जदर्णवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṣṭā yadvajraṃ sukṛtaṃ hiraṇyayaṃ sahasrabhṛṣṭiṃ svapā avartayat | dhatta indro naryapāṃsi kartave'hanvṛtraṃ nirapāmaubjadarṇavam ||

translations.english: Indra, wields the well-made, golden, many-bladed thunderbolt, which the skillful Tvaṣṭā has framed for him, that he may achieve great exploits in war. He has slain Vṛtra and sent forth an ocean of water.

mantras.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वं नुनुद्रेऽवतं त ओजसा दादृहाणं चिद्बिभिदुर्वि पर्वतम् । धमन्तो वाणं मरुतः सुदानवो मदे सोमस्य रण्यानि चक्रिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūrdhvaṃ nunudre'vataṃ ta ojasā dādṛhāṇaṃ cidbibhidurvi parvatam | dhamanto vāṇaṃ marutaḥ sudānavo made somasya raṇyāni cakrire ||

translations.english: By their power, they bore the well aloft, and clove asunder the mountain that obstructed their path; the munificent Maruts, blowing upon their pipe, have conferred, when exhilarated by the Soma, desirable (gifts upon the sacrificer).

mantras.sanskrit: जिह्मं नुनुद्रेऽवतं तया दिशासिञ्चन्नुत्सं गोतमाय तृष्णजे । आ गच्छन्तीमवसा चित्रभानवः कामं विप्रस्य तर्पयन्त धामभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: jihmaṃ nunudre'vataṃ tayā diśāsiñcannutsaṃ gotamāya tṛṣṇaje | ā gacchantīmavasā citrabhānavaḥ kāmaṃ viprasya tarpayanta dhāmabhiḥ ||

translations.english: They brought the crooked well to the plural ce (where the Muni was), and sprinkled the water upon the thirsty Gotama; the variously-radiant (Maruts) come to his succour, gratifyinng the desire of the sage with life-sustaining (waters).

mantras.sanskrit: या वः शर्म शशमानाय सन्ति त्रिधातूनि दाशुषे यच्छताधि । अस्मभ्यं तानि मरुतो वि यन्त रयिं नो धत्त वृषणः सुवीरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā vaḥ śarma śaśamānāya santi tridhātūni dāśuṣe yacchatādhi | asmabhyaṃ tāni maruto vi yanta rayiṃ no dhatta vṛṣaṇaḥ suvīram ||

translations.english: Whatever blessings (are diffused) through the three worlds, and are in your gift, do you bestow upon the donor (of the oblation), who addressed you with praise; bestow them, also, Maruts, upon us, and grant us, bestowers of all good, riches, whence springs prosperity.

mantras.sanskrit: मरुतो यस्य हि क्षये पाथा दिवो विमहसः । स सुगोपातमो जनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: maruto yasya hi kṣaye pāthā divo vimahasaḥ | sa sugopātamo janaḥ ||

translations.english: The man in whose mansion, resplendent Maruts, descending from the sky, you drink (the libation), is provided with most able protectors.

mantras.sanskrit: यज्ञैर्वा यज्ञवाहसो विप्रस्य वा मतीनाम् । मरुतः शृणुता हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajñairvā yajñavāhaso viprasya vā matīnām | marutaḥ śṛṇutā havam ||

translations.english: Maruts, bearers of oblations, hear the invocation of the praises of the worshipper with or (without) sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: उत वा यस्य वाजिनोऽनु विप्रमतक्षत । स गन्ता गोमति व्रजे ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta vā yasya vājino'nu vipramatakṣata | sa gantā gomati vraje ||

translations.english: And may he for whom ministrant priests have sharp-ended the sapient (troop of the Maruts), walk among pastures crowded with cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य वीरस्य बर्हिषि सुतः सोमो दिविष्टिषु । उक्थं मदश्च शस्यते ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya vīrasya barhiṣi sutaḥ somo diviṣṭiṣu | ukthaṃ madaśca śasyate ||

translations.english: The libation is poured out for the hero at the sacrifice, on the appointed days, and the hymn is repeated, and their (is excited).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य श्रोषन्त्वा भुवो विश्वा यश्चर्षणीरभि । सूरं चित्सस्रुषीरिषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya śroṣantvā bhuvo viśvā yaścarṣaṇīrabhi | sūraṃ citsasruṣīriṣaḥ ||

translations.english: May the Maruts, victorious over all men, hear (the praises) of this (their worshipper), and may (abundant) food be obtained by him who praises them.

mantras.sanskrit: पूर्वीभिर्हि ददाशिम शरद्भिर्मरुतो वयम् । अवोभिश्चर्षणीनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pūrvībhirhi dadāśima śaradbhirmaruto vayam | avobhiścarṣaṇīnām ||

translations.english: Enjoying the protection of you who behold all things, we have offered you, Maruts, (oblations) for many years.

mantras.sanskrit: सुभगः स प्रयज्यवो मरुतो अस्तु मर्त्यः । यस्य प्रयांसि पर्षथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: subhagaḥ sa prayajyavo maruto astu martyaḥ | yasya prayāṃsi parṣatha ||

translations.english: Maruts, who are to be especially worshipped, may the man whose offering you accept be ever prosperous.

mantras.sanskrit: शशमानस्य वा नरः स्वेदस्य सत्यशवसः । विदा कामस्य वेनतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaśamānasya vā naraḥ svedasya satyaśavasaḥ | vidā kāmasya venataḥ ||

translations.english: Possessors of true vigour, be cognizant of the wishes of him who praises you, and toils in your service, desirous of (your favour).

mantras.sanskrit: यूयं तत्सत्यशवस आविष्कर्त महित्वना । विध्यता विद्युता रक्षः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yūyaṃ tatsatyaśavasa āviṣkarta mahitvanā | vidhyatā vidyutā rakṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Possessors of true vigour, you have displayed your might, with the lustre (of which) you have destroyed the rākṣasas.

mantras.sanskrit: गूहता गुह्यं तमो वि यात विश्वमत्रिणम् । ज्योतिष्कर्ता यदुश्मसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: gūhatā guhyaṃ tamo vi yāta viśvamatriṇam | jyotiṣkartā yaduśmasi ||

translations.english: Dissipate the concealing darkness; drive away every devouring (foe); show us the light we long for.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रत्वक्षसः प्रतवसो विरप्शिनोऽनानता अविथुरा ऋजीषिणः । जुष्टतमासो नृतमासो अञ्जिभिर्व्यानज्रे के चिदुस्रा इव स्तृभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pratvakṣasaḥ pratavaso virapśino'nānatā avithurā ṛjīṣiṇaḥ | juṣṭatamāso nṛtamāso añjibhirvyānajre ke cidusrā iva stṛbhiḥ ||

translations.english: Annihilators (of adversaries) endowed with great strength, loud-shouting, unbending inseparable partakers of the evening oblation, constantly worshipped, and leaders (of the clouds), (the Maruts), by their person nal decorations,a re conspicuous (in the sky) like certain rays of the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: उपह्वरेषु यदचिध्वं ययिं वय इव मरुतः केन चित्पथा । श्चोतन्ति कोशा उप वो रथेष्वा घृतमुक्षता मधुवर्णमर्चते ॥
mantras.transliteration: upahvareṣu yadacidhvaṃ yayiṃ vaya iva marutaḥ kena citpathā | ścotanti kośā upa vo ratheṣvā ghṛtamukṣatā madhuvarṇamarcate ||

translations.english: When, Maruts, flying like birds along a certain path (of the sky), you collect the moving passing (clouds) in the nearest portions (of the firmament), then, coming into collision with your cars, they pour forth (the waters); therefore, do you shower upon your worshipper the honey-coloured rain.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रैषामज्मेषु विथुरेव रेजते भूमिर्यामेषु यद्ध युञ्जते शुभे । ते क्रीळयो धुनयो भ्राजदृष्टयः स्वयं महित्वं पनयन्त धूतयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: praiṣāmajmeṣu vithureva rejate bhūmiryāmeṣu yaddha yuñjate śubhe | te krīḷayo dhunayo bhrājadṛṣṭayaḥ svayaṃ mahitvaṃ panayanta dhūtayaḥ ||

translations.english: When they assemble (the clouds) for the good work, earth trembles at their impetuous movements, like a wife (whose husband is away); sportive, capricious, armed with bright weapons, and agitating (the solid rocks) they manifest their inherent might.

mantras.sanskrit: स हि स्वसृत्पृषदश्वो युवा गणोऽया ईशानस्तविषीभिरावृतः । असि सत्य ऋणयावानेद्योऽस्या धियः प्राविताथा वृषा गणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa hi svasṛtpṛṣadaśvo yuvā gaṇo'yā īśānastaviṣībhirāvṛtaḥ | asi satya ṛṇayāvānedyo'syā dhiyaḥ prāvitāthā vṛṣā gaṇaḥ ||

translations.english: The troop of Maruts is self-moving deer-borne, ever young, lords of this (earth), and invested with vigour; you, who are sincere liberators from debt, irreproachable, and shedders of rain, are the protectors of this our rite.

mantras.sanskrit: पितुः प्रत्नस्य जन्मना वदामसि सोमस्य जिह्वा प्र जिगाति चक्षसा । यदीमिन्द्रं शम्यृक्वाण आशतादिन्नामानि यज्ञियानि दधिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pituḥ pratnasya janmanā vadāmasi somasya jihvā pra jigāti cakṣasā | yadīmindraṃ śamyṛkvāṇa āśatādinnāmāni yajñiyāni dadhire ||

translations.english: We declare by our birth from our ancient sire, that the tongue (of praise) accompanies the manifesting (invocation of the Maruts) at the libations of the Soma; for, inasmuch as they stood by encouraging Indra in the conflict, they have acquired names that are to be recited at sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रियसे कं भानुभिः सं मिमिक्षिरे ते रश्मिभिस्त ऋक्वभिः सुखादयः । ते वाशीमन्त इष्मिणो अभीरवो विद्रे प्रियस्य मारुतस्य धाम्नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śriyase kaṃ bhānubhiḥ saṃ mimikṣire te raśmibhista ṛkvabhiḥ sukhādayaḥ | te vāśīmanta iṣmiṇo abhīravo vidre priyasya mārutasya dhāmnaḥ ||

translations.english: Combing with the solar rays, they have willingly poured down (rain) for the welfare (of mankind), and, hymned by the priests, have been plural ased partakers of the (sacrificial food); addressed with praises, moving swiftly, and exempt from fear they have become possessed of a station agreeable and suitable to the Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: आ विद्युन्मद्भिर्मरुतः स्वर्कै रथेभिर्यात ऋष्टिमद्भिरश्वपर्णैः । आ वर्षिष्ठया न इषा वयो न पप्तता सुमायाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vidyunmadbhirmarutaḥ svarkai rathebhiryāta ṛṣṭimadbhiraśvaparṇaiḥ | ā varṣiṣṭhayā na iṣā vayo na paptatā sumāyāḥ ||

translations.english: Come, Maruts, with your brilliant light-moving, well-weaponed, steed-harnessed chariots; doers of good deeds, descend like birds, (and bring us) abundant food.

mantras.sanskrit: तेऽरुणेभिर्वरमा पिशङ्गैः शुभे कं यान्ति रथतूर्भिरश्वैः । रुक्मो न चित्रः स्वधितीवान्पव्या रथस्य जङ्घनन्त भूम ॥
mantras.transliteration: te'ruṇebhirvaramā piśaṅgaiḥ śubhe kaṃ yānti rathatūrbhiraśvaiḥ | rukmo na citraḥ svadhitīvānpavyā rathasya jaṅghananta bhūma ||

translations.english: To what glorifier (of the gods) do they repair with their ruddy, tawny, car-bearing horses for his advantage? bright as burnished (gold), and armed with the thunderbolt, they furrow the earth with their chariot-wheels.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रिये कं वो अधि तनूषु वाशीर्मेधा वना न कृणवन्त ऊर्ध्वा । युष्मभ्यं कं मरुतः सुजातास्तुविद्युम्नासो धनयन्ते अद्रिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śriye kaṃ vo adhi tanūṣu vāśīrmedhā vanā na kṛṇavanta ūrdhvā | yuṣmabhyaṃ kaṃ marutaḥ sujātāstuvidyumnāso dhanayante adrim ||

translations.english: Maruts, the threatening (weapons) are upon your person ns, (able to win) dominion; (to you) they praise lofty sacrifices, like (tall) trees; well-born Maruts, for you do wealthy worshippers enrich the stone (that grinds the Soma)].

mantras.sanskrit: अहानि गृध्राः पर्या व आगुरिमां धियं वार्कार्यां च देवीम् । ब्रह्म कृण्वन्तो गोतमासो अर्कैरूर्ध्वं नुनुद्र उत्सधिं पिबध्यै ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahāni gṛdhrāḥ paryā va āgurimāṃ dhiyaṃ vārkāryāṃ ca devīm | brahma kṛṇvanto gotamāso arkairūrdhvaṃ nunudra utsadhiṃ pibadhyai ||

translations.english: Fortunate days have befallen you, (sons of Gotama), when thirsty, and have given lustre to the rite for which water was essential; the sons of Gotama, (offering) oblations with sacred hymns, have raised aloft the well (provided) for their dwelling.
