mantras.sanskrit: एतत्त्यन्न योजनमचेति सस्वर्ह यन्मरुतो गोतमो वः । पश्यन्हिरण्यचक्रानयोदंष्ट्रान्विधावतो वराहून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: etattyanna yojanamaceti sasvarha yanmaruto gotamo vaḥ | paśyanhiraṇyacakrānayodaṃṣṭrānvidhāvato varāhūn ||

translations.english: This hymn is known to be the same as that which Gotama recited Maruts, in your (praise) when he beheld you seated in your chariots with golden wheels, armed with weapons, hurrying hither and thither, and destroying your mightiest foes.

mantras.sanskrit: एषा स्या वो मरुतोऽनुभर्त्री प्रति ष्टोभति वाघतो न वाणी । अस्तोभयद्वृथासामनु स्वधां गभस्त्योः ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣā syā vo maruto'nubhartrī prati ṣṭobhati vāghato na vāṇī | astobhayadvṛthāsāmanu svadhāṃ gabhastyoḥ ||

translations.english: This is that praise, Maruts, which, suited (to your merits) glorifies every one of you. The speech of the priest has now glorified you, without difficulty, with sacred verses, since (you have plural ced) food in our hands.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो भद्राः क्रतवो यन्तु विश्वतोऽदब्धासो अपरीतास उद्भिदः । देवा नो यथा सदमिद्वृधे असन्नप्रायुवो रक्षितारो दिवेदिवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no bhadrāḥ kratavo yantu viśvato'dabdhāso aparītāsa udbhidaḥ | devā no yathā sadamidvṛdhe asannaprāyuvo rakṣitāro divedive ||

translations.english: May auspicious works, unmolested, unimpeded, and subversive (of foes), come to us from every quarter; may the gods, turning not away from us, but granting us protection day by day, be ever with us for our advancement.

mantras.sanskrit: देवानां भद्रा सुमतिॠजूयतां देवानां रातिरभि नो नि वर्तताम् । देवानां सख्यमुप सेदिमा वयं देवा न आयुः प्र तिरन्तु जीवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: devānāṃ bhadrā sumatiṝjūyatāṃ devānāṃ rātirabhi no ni vartatām | devānāṃ sakhyamupa sedimā vayaṃ devā na āyuḥ pra tirantu jīvase ||

translations.english: May the benevolent favour of the gods (be ours); may the bounty of the gods, ever approving of the upright, light upon us; may we obtain the friendship of the gods, and may the gods extend our days to longevity.

mantras.sanskrit: तान्पूर्वया निविदा हूमहे वयं भगं मित्रमदितिं दक्षमस्रिधम् । अर्यमणं वरुणं सोममश्विना सरस्वती नः सुभगा मयस्करत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tānpūrvayā nividā hūmahe vayaṃ bhagaṃ mitramaditiṃ dakṣamasridham | aryamaṇaṃ varuṇaṃ somamaśvinā sarasvatī naḥ subhagā mayaskarat ||

translations.english: We invoke them with an ancient text, Bhaga, Mitra, Aditi, Dakṣa, Asridh, Aryaman, Varuṇa, Soma, the Aśvins; and may the gracious Sarasvatī grant us happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: तन्नो वातो मयोभु वातु भेषजं तन्माता पृथिवी तत्पिता द्यौः । तद्ग्रावाणः सोमसुतो मयोभुवस्तदश्विना शृणुतं धिष्ण्या युवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tanno vāto mayobhu vātu bheṣajaṃ tanmātā pṛthivī tatpitā dyauḥ | tadgrāvāṇaḥ somasuto mayobhuvastadaśvinā śṛṇutaṃ dhiṣṇyā yuvam ||

translations.english: May the wind waft to us the grateful medicament; may mother earth, may father heaven, (convey) it (to us); may the stones that express Soma, and are productive of plural asure (bring) it (to us); Aśvins, who are to be meditated upon, hear (our submission).

mantras.sanskrit: तमीशानं जगतस्तस्थुषस्पतिं धियंजिन्वमवसे हूमहे वयम् । पूषा नो यथा वेदसामसद्वृधे रक्षिता पायुरदब्धः स्वस्तये ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamīśānaṃ jagatastasthuṣaspatiṃ dhiyaṃjinvamavase hūmahe vayam | pūṣā no yathā vedasāmasadvṛdhe rakṣitā pāyuradabdhaḥ svastaye ||

translations.english: We invoke that lord of living beings, that protector of things immoveable, Indra, who is to be propitiated by pious rites, for our protection; as Pūṣan has ever been our defender for the increase of our riches, so may he (continue) the unmolested guardian of our welfare.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वस्ति न इन्द्रो वृद्धश्रवाः स्वस्ति नः पूषा विश्ववेदाः । स्वस्ति नस्तार्क्ष्यो अरिष्टनेमिः स्वस्ति नो बृहस्पतिर्दधातु ॥
mantras.transliteration: svasti na indro vṛddhaśravāḥ svasti naḥ pūṣā viśvavedāḥ | svasti nastārkṣyo ariṣṭanemiḥ svasti no bṛhaspatirdadhātu ||

translations.english: May Indra, who listens to much praise, guard our welfare; may Pūṣan, who knows all things, guard our welfare; may Tārkṣya, with unblemished weapons, guard our welfare.

mantras.sanskrit: पृषदश्वा मरुतः पृश्निमातरः शुभंयावानो विदथेषु जग्मयः । अग्निजिह्वा मनवः सूरचक्षसो विश्वे नो देवा अवसा गमन्निह ॥
mantras.transliteration: pṛṣadaśvā marutaḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ śubhaṃyāvāno vidatheṣu jagmayaḥ | agnijihvā manavaḥ sūracakṣaso viśve no devā avasā gamanniha ||

translations.english: May the Maruts, whose coursers are spotted deer, who are the sons of Pṛśni, gracefully-moving frequenters of sacrifices, (seated) on the tongue of Agni, regarders (of all), and radiant as the sun, may all the gods come hither for our preservation.

mantras.sanskrit: भद्रं कर्णेभिः शृणुयाम देवा भद्रं पश्येमाक्षभिर्यजत्राः । स्थिरैरङ्गैस्तुष्टुवांसस्तनूभिर्व्यशेम देवहितं यदायुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ śṛṇuyāma devā bhadraṃ paśyemākṣabhiryajatrāḥ | sthirairaṅgaistuṣṭuvāṃsastanūbhirvyaśema devahitaṃ yadāyuḥ ||

translations.english: Let us hear, gods, with our ears, what is good; objects of sacrifice, let us see with our eyes what is good; let us, engaged in your praises, enjoy, with firm limb and (sound) bodies, the term of life granted by the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: शतमिन्नु शरदो अन्ति देवा यत्रा नश्चक्रा जरसं तनूनाम् । पुत्रासो यत्र पितरो भवन्ति मा नो मध्या रीरिषतायुर्गन्तोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śataminnu śarado anti devā yatrā naścakrā jarasaṃ tanūnām | putrāso yatra pitaro bhavanti mā no madhyā rīriṣatāyurgantoḥ ||

translations.english: Since a hundred years were appointed (for the life of man), interpose not, gods, in the midst of our passing existence, by inflicting infirmity in our bodies so that our sons become our sires (i.e. let us not become so feeble and firm as to be, infants and to require the paternal care of our own sons].

mantras.sanskrit: अदितिर्द्यौरदितिरन्तरिक्षमदितिर्माता स पिता स पुत्रः । विश्वे देवा अदितिः पञ्च जना अदितिर्जातमदितिर्जनित्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: aditirdyauraditirantarikṣamaditirmātā sa pitā sa putraḥ | viśve devā aditiḥ pañca janā aditirjātamaditirjanitvam ||

translations.english: Aditi is heaven; Aditi is the firmament; Aditi is mother, father and son; Aditi is all the gods; Aditi is the five classes of people; Aditi is genitive ration and birth.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋजुनीती नो वरुणो मित्रो नयतु विद्वान् । अर्यमा देवैः सजोषाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛjunītī no varuṇo mitro nayatu vidvān | aryamā devaiḥ sajoṣāḥ ||

translations.english: May Varuṇa and the wise Mitra lead us, by straight paths, (to our desires) and Aryaman, rejoicing with the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: ते हि वस्वो वसवानास्ते अप्रमूरा महोभिः । व्रता रक्षन्ते विश्वाहा ॥
mantras.transliteration: te hi vasvo vasavānāste apramūrā mahobhiḥ | vratā rakṣante viśvāhā ||

translations.english: For they are the distributors of wealth (over the world); and never heedless, discharge their functions every day.

mantras.sanskrit: ते अस्मभ्यं शर्म यंसन्नमृता मर्त्येभ्यः । बाधमाना अप द्विषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te asmabhyaṃ śarma yaṃsannamṛtā martyebhyaḥ | bādhamānā apa dviṣaḥ ||

translations.english: May they, who are immortal, bestow upon us mortals, happiness, annihilating our foes.

mantras.sanskrit: वि नः पथः सुविताय चियन्त्विन्द्रो मरुतः । पूषा भगो वन्द्यासः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi naḥ pathaḥ suvitāya ciyantvindro marutaḥ | pūṣā bhago vandyāsaḥ ||

translations.english: May the adorable Indra, the Maruts, Pūṣan, and Bhaga, so direct our paths, (that they may lead) to the attainment of good gifts.

mantras.sanskrit: उत नो धियो गोअग्राः पूषन्विष्णवेवयावः । कर्ता नः स्वस्तिमतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta no dhiyo goagrāḥ pūṣanviṣṇavevayāvaḥ | kartā naḥ svastimataḥ ||

translations.english: Pūṣan, Viṣṇu, Maruts, make our rites restorative of our cattle; make us prosperous

mantras.sanskrit: मधु वाता ऋतायते मधु क्षरन्ति सिन्धवः । माध्वीर्नः सन्त्वोषधीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: madhu vātā ṛtāyate madhu kṣaranti sindhavaḥ | mādhvīrnaḥ santvoṣadhīḥ ||

translations.english: The winds bring sweet (rewards) to the sacrificer; the rivers bring sweet (waters); may the herbs yield sweetness to us.

mantras.sanskrit: मधु नक्तमुतोषसो मधुमत्पार्थिवं रजः । मधु द्यौरस्तु नः पिता ॥
mantras.transliteration: madhu naktamutoṣaso madhumatpārthivaṃ rajaḥ | madhu dyaurastu naḥ pitā ||

translations.english: May night and moring be sweet; may the region of the earth (lokā rajāṃsyucyate-Nirukta 4.19) be full of sweetness; may the protecting heaven be sweet to us.

mantras.sanskrit: मधुमान्नो वनस्पतिर्मधुमाँ अस्तु सूर्यः । माध्वीर्गावो भवन्तु नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: madhumānno vanaspatirmadhumā~ astu sūryaḥ | mādhvīrgāvo bhavantu naḥ ||

translations.english: May Vanaspati be possessed of sweetness towards us; may the sun be imbued with sweetness; may the cattle be sweet to us.

mantras.sanskrit: शं नो मित्रः शं वरुणः शं नो भवत्वर्यमा । शं न इन्द्रो बृहस्पतिः शं नो विष्णुरुरुक्रमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaṃ no mitraḥ śaṃ varuṇaḥ śaṃ no bhavatvaryamā | śaṃ na indro bṛhaspatiḥ śaṃ no viṣṇururukramaḥ ||

translations.english: May Mitra be propitious to us; may Varuṇa, may Aryaman, be propitious to us; may Indra and Bṛhaspati be propitious to us; may the wide-stepping Viṣṇu be propitious to us.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं सोम प्र चिकितो मनीषा त्वं रजिष्ठमनु नेषि पन्थाम् । तव प्रणीती पितरो न इन्दो देवेषु रत्नमभजन्त धीराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ soma pra cikito manīṣā tvaṃ rajiṣṭhamanu neṣi panthām | tava praṇītī pitaro na indo deveṣu ratnamabhajanta dhīrāḥ ||

translations.english: You, Soma, are thoroughly apprehended by our understanding; you lead us along a straight path; by your guidance, Indra, our righteous fathers obtained wealth among the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं सोम क्रतुभिः सुक्रतुर्भूस्त्वं दक्षैः सुदक्षो विश्ववेदाः । त्वं वृषा वृषत्वेभिर्महित्वा द्युम्नेभिर्द्युम्न्यभवो नृचक्षाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ soma kratubhiḥ sukraturbhūstvaṃ dakṣaiḥ sudakṣo viśvavedāḥ | tvaṃ vṛṣā vṛṣatvebhirmahitvā dyumnebhirdyumnyabhavo nṛcakṣāḥ ||

translations.english: You, Soma, are the doer of good by holy acts; you are powerful by your energies, and know all things; you are the showerer (of benefits) by your bounties, and (are great) by your greatness; you, the guide of men, has been well nourished by sacrificial offerings.

mantras.sanskrit: राज्ञो नु ते वरुणस्य व्रतानि बृहद्गभीरं तव सोम धाम । शुचिष्ट्वमसि प्रियो न मित्रो दक्षाय्यो अर्यमेवासि सोम ॥
mantras.transliteration: rājño nu te varuṇasya vratāni bṛhadgabhīraṃ tava soma dhāma | śuciṣṭvamasi priyo na mitro dakṣāyyo aryamevāsi soma ||

translations.english: Your acts are (like those) of the royal Varuṇa; your glory, Soma, is great and profound; you are the purifier (of all), like the beloved Mitra; you are the augmenter of all, like Aryaman.

mantras.sanskrit: या ते धामानि दिवि या पृथिव्यां या पर्वतेष्वोषधीष्वप्सु । तेभिर्नो विश्वैः सुमना अहेळन्राजन्त्सोम प्रति हव्या गृभाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā te dhāmāni divi yā pṛthivyāṃ yā parvateṣvoṣadhīṣvapsu | tebhirno viśvaiḥ sumanā aheḷanrājantsoma prati havyā gṛbhāya ||

translations.english: Endowed with all the glories (that are displayed) by you in heaven, on earth, in the mountains, in the plural nts, in the waters, do you, illustrious Soma, well-disposed towards us, and devoid of anger, accept our oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं सोमासि सत्पतिस्त्वं राजोत वृत्रहा । त्वं भद्रो असि क्रतुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ somāsi satpatistvaṃ rājota vṛtrahā | tvaṃ bhadro asi kratuḥ ||

translations.english: You, Soma, are the protector, the soverign of the pious, or even the slayer of Vṛtra; you are holy sacrifice..

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं च सोम नो वशो जीवातुं न मरामहे । प्रियस्तोत्रो वनस्पतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ ca soma no vaśo jīvātuṃ na marāmahe | priyastotro vanaspatiḥ ||

translations.english: You, Soma, fond of praise, the lord of plural nts, are life to us; if you will, we shall not die.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं सोम महे भगं त्वं यून ऋतायते । दक्षं दधासि जीवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ soma mahe bhagaṃ tvaṃ yūna ṛtāyate | dakṣaṃ dadhāsi jīvase ||

translations.english: You bestow, Soma, upon him who worships, you, whether old or young, wealth, what he may enjoy and live.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं नः सोम विश्वतो रक्षा राजन्नघायतः । न रिष्येत्त्वावतः सखा ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ naḥ soma viśvato rakṣā rājannaghāyataḥ | na riṣyettvāvataḥ sakhā ||

translations.english: Defend us, royal Soma, from every one seeking to harm us; the friend of one like you can never perish.

mantras.sanskrit: सोम यास्ते मयोभुव ऊतयः सन्ति दाशुषे । ताभिर्नोऽविता भव ॥
mantras.transliteration: soma yāste mayobhuva ūtayaḥ santi dāśuṣe | tābhirno'vitā bhava ||

translations.english: Soma, be our protector with those assistances which are sources of happiness to the donor (of oblations).

mantras.sanskrit: इमं यज्ञमिदं वचो जुजुषाण उपागहि । सोम त्वं नो वृधे भव ॥
mantras.transliteration: imaṃ yajñamidaṃ vaco jujuṣāṇa upāgahi | soma tvaṃ no vṛdhe bhava ||

translations.english: Accepting this our sacrifice, and this our praise, approach, Soma, and be to us as the augmenter of our rite.

mantras.sanskrit: सोम गीर्भिष्ट्वा वयं वर्धयामो वचोविदः । सुमृळीको न आ विश ॥
mantras.transliteration: soma gīrbhiṣṭvā vayaṃ vardhayāmo vacovidaḥ | sumṛḷīko na ā viśa ||

translations.english: Acquainted with hymns, we elevate you with praises; do you, who are benignant, approach.

mantras.sanskrit: गयस्फानो अमीवहा वसुवित्पुष्टिवर्धनः । सुमित्रः सोम नो भव ॥
mantras.transliteration: gayasphāno amīvahā vasuvitpuṣṭivardhanaḥ | sumitraḥ soma no bhava ||

translations.english: Be unto us, Soma, the bestower of wealth, the remover of disease, the cognizant of riches, the augmenter of nutriment, an excellent friend.

mantras.sanskrit: सोम रारन्धि नो हृदि गावो न यवसेष्वा । मर्य इव स्व ओक्ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: soma rārandhi no hṛdi gāvo na yavaseṣvā | marya iva sva okye ||

translations.english: Soma, dwell happy in our hearts, like cattle in fresh pastures, like men in their own abodes.

mantras.sanskrit: यः सोम सख्ये तव रारणद्देव मर्त्यः । तं दक्षः सचते कविः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ soma sakhye tava rāraṇaddeva martyaḥ | taṃ dakṣaḥ sacate kaviḥ ||

translations.english: The experienced sage commends the mortal who, through affection, divine Soma, praises you.

mantras.sanskrit: उरुष्या णो अभिशस्तेः सोम नि पाह्यंहसः । सखा सुशेव एधि नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uruṣyā ṇo abhiśasteḥ soma ni pāhyaṃhasaḥ | sakhā suśeva edhi naḥ ||

translations.english: Protect us, Soma, from calumny, preserve us from sin; plural ased with our service, be our friend.

mantras.sanskrit: आ प्यायस्व समेतु ते विश्वतः सोम वृष्ण्यम् । भवा वाजस्य संगथे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā pyāyasva sametu te viśvataḥ soma vṛṣṇyam | bhavā vājasya saṃgathe ||

translations.english: Increase, Soma, may vigour come to you from every side; be diligent in the supply of food (to us).

mantras.sanskrit: आ प्यायस्व मदिन्तम सोम विश्वेभिरंशुभिः । भवा नः सुश्रवस्तमः सखा वृधे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā pyāyasva madintama soma viśvebhiraṃśubhiḥ | bhavā naḥ suśravastamaḥ sakhā vṛdhe ||

translations.english: Exulting Soma, increase with all twining plural nts; be to us a friend; well supplied with food, we may prosper.

mantras.sanskrit: सं ते पयांसि समु यन्तु वाजाः सं वृष्ण्यान्यभिमातिषाहः । आप्यायमानो अमृताय सोम दिवि श्रवांस्युत्तमानि धिष्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ te payāṃsi samu yantu vājāḥ saṃ vṛṣṇyānyabhimātiṣāhaḥ | āpyāyamāno amṛtāya soma divi śravāṃsyuttamāni dhiṣva ||

translations.english: May the milky juices flow around you; may sacrificial offerings and vigour be concentrated in the destroyer of foes; and, being fully nourished, do you provide, Soma, excellent viands in heaven for our immortality.

mantras.sanskrit: या ते धामानि हविषा यजन्ति ता ते विश्वा परिभूरस्तु यज्ञम् । गयस्फानः प्रतरणः सुवीरोऽवीरहा प्र चरा सोम दुर्यान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā te dhāmāni haviṣā yajanti tā te viśvā paribhūrastu yajñam | gayasphānaḥ prataraṇaḥ suvīro'vīrahā pra carā soma duryān ||

translations.english: Whichever of your glories (men) worship with oblations, may our sacrifice be invested with them all; come to our mansions, Soma, who are the bestower of wealth, the transporter (over difficulties); attended by valiant heroes, the non-destroyer of progeny.

mantras.sanskrit: सोमो धेनुं सोमो अर्वन्तमाशुं सोमो वीरं कर्मण्यं ददाति । सादन्यं विदथ्यं सभेयं पितृश्रवणं यो ददाशदस्मै ॥
mantras.transliteration: somo dhenuṃ somo arvantamāśuṃ somo vīraṃ karmaṇyaṃ dadāti | sādanyaṃ vidathyaṃ sabheyaṃ pitṛśravaṇaṃ yo dadāśadasmai ||

translations.english: To him who present (offerings), Soma gives a cow, a swift horse, and a son who is able in affairs, skilful in domestic concerns, assiduous in worship, eminent in society, and who is an honour to his father.

mantras.sanskrit: अषाळ्हं युत्सु पृतनासु पप्रिं स्वर्षामप्सां वृजनस्य गोपाम् । भरेषुजां सुक्षितिं सुश्रवसं जयन्तं त्वामनु मदेम सोम ॥
mantras.transliteration: aṣāḷhaṃ yutsu pṛtanāsu papriṃ svarṣāmapsāṃ vṛjanasya gopām | bhareṣujāṃ sukṣitiṃ suśravasaṃ jayantaṃ tvāmanu madema soma ||

translations.english: We rejoice, Soma, contemplating you, invincible in battle, triumphant amongst hosts, the granter of heaven, the giver of rain, the preserver of strength, born amidst sacrifices, occupying a brilliant dwelling, renowned and victorious.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमिमा ओषधीः सोम विश्वास्त्वमपो अजनयस्त्वं गाः । त्वमा ततन्थोर्वन्तरिक्षं त्वं ज्योतिषा वि तमो ववर्थ ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamimā oṣadhīḥ soma viśvāstvamapo ajanayastvaṃ gāḥ | tvamā tatanthorvantarikṣaṃ tvaṃ jyotiṣā vi tamo vavartha ||

translations.english: You, Soma, have genitive rated all these herbs, the water and the kine; you have spread out the spacious firmament; you have scattered darkness with light.

mantras.sanskrit: देवेन नो मनसा देव सोम रायो भागं सहसावन्नभि युध्य । मा त्वा तनदीशिषे वीर्यस्योभयेभ्यः प्र चिकित्सा गविष्टौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: devena no manasā deva soma rāyo bhāgaṃ sahasāvannabhi yudhya | mā tvā tanadīśiṣe vīryasyobhayebhyaḥ pra cikitsā gaviṣṭau ||

translations.english: Divine and potent Soma, bestow upon us, with your brilliant mind, a portion of wealth; may no (adversary) annoy you; you are supreme over the valour of (any) two (mutual) opponents; defend us (from our enemies) in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: एता उ त्या उषसः केतुमक्रत पूर्वे अर्धे रजसो भानुमञ्जते । निष्कृण्वाना आयुधानीव धृष्णवः प्रति गावोऽरुषीर्यन्ति मातरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: etā u tyā uṣasaḥ ketumakrata pūrve ardhe rajaso bhānumañjate | niṣkṛṇvānā āyudhānīva dhṛṣṇavaḥ prati gāvo'ruṣīryanti mātaraḥ ||

translations.english: These divinities of the morning have spread light (over the world); they make manifest the light in the eastern portion of the firmament, brightening all things, like warriors burnishing their weapons; the radiant and progressing mothers (of the earth), they travel daily (on their course).

mantras.sanskrit: उदपप्तन्नरुणा भानवो वृथा स्वायुजो अरुषीर्गा अयुक्षत । अक्रन्नुषासो वयुनानि पूर्वथा रुशन्तं भानुमरुषीरशिश्रयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: udapaptannaruṇā bhānavo vṛthā svāyujo aruṣīrgā ayukṣata | akrannuṣāso vayunāni pūrvathā ruśantaṃ bhānumaruṣīraśiśrayuḥ ||

translations.english: Their purple rays have readily shot upwards; they have yoked the easily-yoked and ruddy kine (to their car); the deities of the dawn have restored, as of yore, the consciousness (of sentient creatures), and bright-rayed have attended upon the glorious sun.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्चन्ति नारीरपसो न विष्टिभिः समानेन योजनेना परावतः । इषं वहन्तीः सुकृते सुदानवे विश्वेदह यजमानाय सुन्वते ॥
mantras.transliteration: arcanti nārīrapaso na viṣṭibhiḥ samānena yojanenā parāvataḥ | iṣaṃ vahantīḥ sukṛte sudānave viśvedaha yajamānāya sunvate ||

translations.english: The feminine le leaders (of the morning) illuminate with their inherent radiance the remotest parts (of the heaven), with a simultaneous effort, like warriors (with their shining arms in the van of battle), bringing every kind of food to the performer of good works, to the bountiful, and to the worshipper who presents libations.

mantras.sanskrit: अधि पेशांसि वपते नृतूरिवापोर्णुते वक्ष उस्रेव बर्जहम् । ज्योतिर्विश्वस्मै भुवनाय कृण्वती गावो न व्रजं व्युषा आवर्तमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhi peśāṃsi vapate nṛtūrivāporṇute vakṣa usreva barjaham | jyotirviśvasmai bhuvanāya kṛṇvatī gāvo na vrajaṃ vyuṣā āvartamaḥ ||

translations.english: Uṣas cuts off the accusative ulated (glooms), as a barber (cuts off the hair); she bares her bosom as a cow yields her udder (to the milker); and, as cattle hasten to their pastures, she speeds to the east, and shedding light upon all the world, dissipates the darkness.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रत्यर्ची रुशदस्या अदर्शि वि तिष्ठते बाधते कृष्णमभ्वम् । स्वरुं न पेशो विदथेष्वञ्जञ्चित्रं दिवो दुहिता भानुमश्रेत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pratyarcī ruśadasyā adarśi vi tiṣṭhate bādhate kṛṣṇamabhvam | svaruṃ na peśo vidatheṣvañjañcitraṃ divo duhitā bhānumaśret ||

translations.english: Her brilliant light is first seen towards (the east); it spreads and disperses the thick darkness; she anoints her beauty as the priests anoint the sacrificial food in sacrifices; the daughter of the sky awaits the glorious sun.

mantras.sanskrit: अतारिष्म तमसस्पारमस्योषा उच्छन्ती वयुना कृणोति । श्रिये छन्दो न स्मयते विभाती सुप्रतीका सौमनसायाजीगः ॥
mantras.transliteration: atāriṣma tamasaspāramasyoṣā ucchantī vayunā kṛṇoti | śriye chando na smayate vibhātī supratīkā saumanasāyājīgaḥ ||

translations.english: We have crossed over the boundary of darkness. Uṣas restores the consciousness (of living beings); bright-shining, she smiles, like a flatterer to obtain favour, and, lovely in all her radiance, she has swallowed, for our delight the darkness.

mantras.sanskrit: भास्वती नेत्री सूनृतानां दिवः स्तवे दुहिता गोतमेभिः । प्रजावतो नृवतो अश्वबुध्यानुषो गोअग्राँ उप मासि वाजान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhāsvatī netrī sūnṛtānāṃ divaḥ stave duhitā gotamebhiḥ | prajāvato nṛvato aśvabudhyānuṣo goagrā~ upa māsi vājān ||

translations.english: The brilliant daughter of the sky, the exciter of plural asant voices, is praised by the descendants of Gotama. Uṣas, grant us food associated with progeny and dependants, and distinguished by horses and cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: उषस्तमश्यां यशसं सुवीरं दासप्रवर्गं रयिमश्वबुध्यम् । सुदंससा श्रवसा या विभासि वाजप्रसूता सुभगे बृहन्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uṣastamaśyāṃ yaśasaṃ suvīraṃ dāsapravargaṃ rayimaśvabudhyam | sudaṃsasā śravasā yā vibhāsi vājaprasūtā subhage bṛhantam ||

translations.english: May I obtain, Uṣas, that ample wealth with confers fame, posterity, troops of slaves, and is characterized by horses; which you, who abount in riches and are the giver of food, display, (when gratified) by hymns and holy sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वानि देवी भुवनाभिचक्ष्या प्रतीची चक्षुरुर्विया वि भाति । विश्वं जीवं चरसे बोधयन्ती विश्वस्य वाचमविदन्मनायोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvāni devī bhuvanābhicakṣyā pratīcī cakṣururviyā vi bhāti | viśvaṃ jīvaṃ carase bodhayantī viśvasya vācamavidanmanāyoḥ ||

translations.english: The divine (Uṣas), having lighted up the whole world, spreads, expanding with her radiance, towards the west, arousing all living creatures to their labours; she hears the speech of all endowed with thought.

mantras.sanskrit: पुनःपुनर्जायमाना पुराणी समानं वर्णमभि शुम्भमाना । श्वघ्नीव कृत्नुर्विज आमिनाना मर्तस्य देवी जरयन्त्यायुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: punaḥpunarjāyamānā purāṇī samānaṃ varṇamabhi śumbhamānā | śvaghnīva kṛtnurvija āminānā martasya devī jarayantyāyuḥ ||

translations.english: The divine and ancient Uṣas, born again and again and bright with unchanging hues, wastes away the life of a mortal, like the wife of a hunter cutting up and dividing the birds.

mantras.sanskrit: व्यूर्ण्वती दिवो अन्ताँ अबोध्यप स्वसारं सनुतर्युयोति । प्रमिनती मनुष्या युगानि योषा जारस्य चक्षसा वि भाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: vyūrṇvatī divo antā~ abodhyapa svasāraṃ sanutaryuyoti | praminatī manuṣyā yugāni yoṣā jārasya cakṣasā vi bhāti ||

translations.english: She has been seen illuminating the boundaries of the sky, and driving into disappearance the spontaneously-retiring (night); wearing away the ages of the human race, she shines with light like the bride of the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: पशून्न चित्रा सुभगा प्रथाना सिन्धुर्न क्षोद उर्विया व्यश्वैत् । अमिनती दैव्यानि व्रतानि सूर्यस्य चेति रश्मिभिर्दृशाना ॥
mantras.transliteration: paśūnna citrā subhagā prathānā sindhurna kṣoda urviyā vyaśvait | aminatī daivyāni vratāni sūryasya ceti raśmibhirdṛśānā ||

translations.english: The affluent and adorable Uṣas has sent her rays abroad, as (a cowherd drives) the cattle (to pasture), and spreads expansive, like flowing water; she is beheld associated with the rays of the sun, unimpeding sacred ceremonies.

mantras.sanskrit: उषस्तच्चित्रमा भरास्मभ्यं वाजिनीवति । येन तोकं च तनयं च धामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: uṣastaccitramā bharāsmabhyaṃ vājinīvati | yena tokaṃ ca tanayaṃ ca dhāmahe ||

translations.english: Uṣas, possessor of food, bring us that various wealth by which we may sustain sons and grandsons.

mantras.sanskrit: उषो अद्येह गोमत्यश्वावति विभावरि । रेवदस्मे व्युच्छ सूनृतावति ॥
mantras.transliteration: uṣo adyeha gomatyaśvāvati vibhāvari | revadasme vyuccha sūnṛtāvati ||

translations.english: Luminous Uṣas, possessor of cows and horses, true of speech, dawn here today upon this (ceremony), that is to bring us wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: युक्ष्वा हि वाजिनीवत्यश्वाँ अद्यारुणाँ उषः । अथा नो विश्वा सौभगान्या वह ॥
mantras.transliteration: yukṣvā hi vājinīvatyaśvā~ adyāruṇā~ uṣaḥ | athā no viśvā saubhagānyā vaha ||

translations.english: Possessor of food, Uṣas, yoke, indeed, today your purple steeds and bring to us all good things.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्विना वर्तिरस्मदा गोमद्दस्रा हिरण्यवत् । अर्वाग्रथं समनसा नि यच्छतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvinā vartirasmadā gomaddasrā hiraṇyavat | arvāgrathaṃ samanasā ni yacchatam ||

translations.english: Aśvins, destroyers of foes, turn with favourable intentions your chariot towards our abode, which contains cattle and gold.

mantras.sanskrit: यावित्था श्लोकमा दिवो ज्योतिर्जनाय चक्रथुः । आ न ऊर्जं वहतमश्विना युवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yāvitthā ślokamā divo jyotirjanāya cakrathuḥ | ā na ūrjaṃ vahatamaśvinā yuvam ||

translations.english: Aśvins, who have sent adorable light from heaven to man, bring us strength.

mantras.sanskrit: एह देवा मयोभुवा दस्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी । उषर्बुधो वहन्तु सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: eha devā mayobhuvā dasrā hiraṇyavartanī | uṣarbudho vahantu somapītaye ||

translations.english: May the steeds awakened at dawn bring hither, to drink the Soma, the divine Aśvins, who are the givers o fhappiness, the destroyers of foes, seated in a golden chariot.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्नीषोमाविमं सु मे शृणुतं वृषणा हवम् । प्रति सूक्तानि हर्यतं भवतं दाशुषे मयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnīṣomāvimaṃ su me śṛṇutaṃ vṛṣaṇā havam | prati sūktāni haryataṃ bhavataṃ dāśuṣe mayaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni and Soma, showerers (of desires), favourably hear this my invocation, graciously accept my hymns, and bestow felicity on the donor (of the oblation).

mantras.sanskrit: अग्नीषोमा यो अद्य वामिदं वचः सपर्यति । तस्मै धत्तं सुवीर्यं गवां पोषं स्वश्व्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnīṣomā yo adya vāmidaṃ vacaḥ saparyati | tasmai dhattaṃ suvīryaṃ gavāṃ poṣaṃ svaśvyam ||

translations.english: Agni and Soma, grant to him who addresses this prayer to you both, store of cattle with sound strength and good horses.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्नीषोमा य आहुतिं यो वां दाशाद्धविष्कृतिम् । स प्रजया सुवीर्यं विश्वमायुर्व्यश्नवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnīṣomā ya āhutiṃ yo vāṃ dāśāddhaviṣkṛtim | sa prajayā suvīryaṃ viśvamāyurvyaśnavat ||

translations.english: Agni and Soma, may he who offers you the oblation of clarified butter, enjoy sound strength, with progeny, through all his life.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्नीषोमा चेति तद्वीर्यं वां यदमुष्णीतमवसं पणिं गाः । अवातिरतं बृसयस्य शेषोऽविन्दतं ज्योतिरेकं बहुभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnīṣomā ceti tadvīryaṃ vāṃ yadamuṣṇītamavasaṃ paṇiṃ gāḥ | avātirataṃ bṛsayasya śeṣo'vindataṃ jyotirekaṃ bahubhyaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni and Soma, that prowess of yours, by which you have carried off the cows that were the food of Paṇi, is (well) known to us; you have slain the offspring of Bṛsya and you have obtained the luminary (the sun), for the benefit of the many.

mantras.sanskrit: युवमेतानि दिवि रोचनान्यग्निश्च सोम सक्रतू अधत्तम् । युवं सिन्धूँरभिशस्तेरवद्यादग्नीषोमावमुञ्चतं गृभीतान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvametāni divi rocanānyagniśca soma sakratū adhattam | yuvaṃ sindhū~rabhiśasteravadyādagnīṣomāvamuñcataṃ gṛbhītān ||

translations.english: You two, Agni and Soma, acting together, have sustained these constallations in the sky; you have liberated the rivers that had been defiled from the notorious imputation.

mantras.sanskrit: आन्यं दिवो मातरिश्वा जभारामथ्नादन्यं परि श्येनो अद्रेः । अग्नीषोमा ब्रह्मणा वावृधानोरुं यज्ञाय चक्रथुरु लोकम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ānyaṃ divo mātariśvā jabhārāmathnādanyaṃ pari śyeno adreḥ | agnīṣomā brahmaṇā vāvṛdhānoruṃ yajñāya cakrathuru lokam ||

translations.english: Agni and Soma, the wind brought one of you from heaven, a hawk carried off the other by force from the summit of the mountain; growing vast by praise, you have made the world wide for (the performance of) sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्नीषोमा हविषः प्रस्थितस्य वीतं हर्यतं वृषणा जुषेथाम् । सुशर्माणा स्ववसा हि भूतमथा धत्तं यजमानाय शं योः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnīṣomā haviṣaḥ prasthitasya vītaṃ haryataṃ vṛṣaṇā juṣethām | suśarmāṇā svavasā hi bhūtamathā dhattaṃ yajamānāya śaṃ yoḥ ||

translations.english: Agni and Soma, partake of the proffered oblation; be gracious to us; showerers (of desires), be plural ased; prosperous and diligent protectors, be propitious, and grant to the sacrificer health and exemption from illness.

mantras.sanskrit: यो अग्नीषोमा हविषा सपर्याद्देवद्रीचा मनसा यो घृतेन । तस्य व्रतं रक्षतं पातमंहसो विशे जनाय महि शर्म यच्छतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo agnīṣomā haviṣā saparyāddevadrīcā manasā yo ghṛtena | tasya vrataṃ rakṣataṃ pātamaṃhaso viśe janāya mahi śarma yacchatam ||

translations.english: Agni and Soma, protect his sacrifice and defend him from illness, who, with a mind devoted to the gods, worships you with clarified butter and oblations; grant to the man engaged (in devotion) extreme felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्नीषोमा सवेदसा सहूती वनतं गिरः । सं देवत्रा बभूवथुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnīṣomā savedasā sahūtī vanataṃ giraḥ | saṃ devatrā babhūvathuḥ ||

translations.english: Agni and Soma, endowed with the like wealth, and invoked by a common invocation, share our praises, for you have (ever) been the chief of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्नीषोमावनेन वां यो वां घृतेन दाशति । तस्मै दीदयतं बृहत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnīṣomāvanena vāṃ yo vāṃ ghṛtena dāśati | tasmai dīdayataṃ bṛhat ||

translations.english: Agni and Soma, give ample (recompense) to him who presents to you both, this clarified butter.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्नीषोमाविमानि नो युवं हव्या जुजोषतम् । आ यातमुप नः सचा ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnīṣomāvimāni no yuvaṃ havyā jujoṣatam | ā yātamupa naḥ sacā ||

translations.english: Agni and Soma, bepleased with these our oblations, come to us together.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्नीषोमा पिपृतमर्वतो न आ प्यायन्तामुस्रिया हव्यसूदः । अस्मे बलानि मघवत्सु धत्तं कृणुतं नो अध्वरं श्रुष्टिमन्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnīṣomā pipṛtamarvato na ā pyāyantāmusriyā havyasūdaḥ | asme balāni maghavatsu dhattaṃ kṛṇutaṃ no adhvaraṃ śruṣṭimantam ||

translations.english: Agni and Soma, cherish our horses, and may our cows, affordin g(milk that yields butter for) oblations, be well nourished; give to us, who are affluent, strength (to perform) religious rites, and make our sacrifice productive of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: इमं स्तोममर्हते जातवेदसे रथमिव सं महेमा मनीषया । भद्रा हि नः प्रमतिरस्य संसद्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
mantras.transliteration: imaṃ stomamarhate jātavedase rathamiva saṃ mahemā manīṣayā | bhadrā hi naḥ pramatirasya saṃsadyagne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||

translations.english: To him who is worthy of praise, and all-knowing, we construct, with our minds, this hymn, as (a workman makes) a car; happy is our understanding when engaged in his adoration; let us not suffer injury, Agni, through your friendship.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्मै त्वमायजसे स साधत्यनर्वा क्षेति दधते सुवीर्यम् । स तूताव नैनमश्नोत्यंहतिरग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasmai tvamāyajase sa sādhatyanarvā kṣeti dadhate suvīryam | sa tūtāva nainamaśnotyaṃhatiragne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||

translations.english: He, for whom you sacrifice, accomplishes (his objects), abides free from aggression, and enjoys (wealth, the source of) strength; he prospers, and poverty never approaches him; let us not suffer injury, Agni, through your friendship.

mantras.sanskrit: शकेम त्वा समिधं साधया धियस्त्वे देवा हविरदन्त्याहुतम् । त्वमादित्याँ आ वह तान्ह्युश्मस्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
mantras.transliteration: śakema tvā samidhaṃ sādhayā dhiyastve devā haviradantyāhutam | tvamādityā~ ā vaha tānhyuśmasyagne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||

translations.english: May we be able to kindle you; perfect the rite, for through you the gods partake of the offered oblations; bring hither the Ādityas, for we love them; let us not suffer injury, Agni, through your friendship.

mantras.sanskrit: भरामेध्मं कृणवामा हवींषि ते चितयन्तः पर्वणापर्वणा वयम् । जीवातवे प्रतरं साधया धियोऽग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
mantras.transliteration: bharāmedhmaṃ kṛṇavāmā havīṃṣi te citayantaḥ parvaṇāparvaṇā vayam | jīvātave prataraṃ sādhayā dhiyo'gne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||

translations.english: We bring fuel, we offer oblations, reminding you of the successive seasons (of worship); do you thoroughly complete the rite, in order to prolong our lives; let us not suffer injury, Agni, through your friendship.

mantras.sanskrit: विशां गोपा अस्य चरन्ति जन्तवो द्विपच्च यदुत चतुष्पदक्तुभिः । चित्रः प्रकेत उषसो महाँ अस्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśāṃ gopā asya caranti jantavo dvipacca yaduta catuṣpadaktubhiḥ | citraḥ praketa uṣaso mahā~ asyagne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||

translations.english: His genitive al (flames), the preservers of mankind, spread around, and both bipeds and quadrupeds are enlivened by his rays; shining with various lustre, and illuminating (the world by night), you are superior to the dawn; let us not, Agni, suffer injury through your friendship.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमध्वर्युरुत होतासि पूर्व्यः प्रशास्ता पोता जनुषा पुरोहितः । विश्वा विद्वाँ आर्त्विज्या धीर पुष्यस्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamadhvaryuruta hotāsi pūrvyaḥ praśāstā potā januṣā purohitaḥ | viśvā vidvā~ ārtvijyā dhīra puṣyasyagne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||

translations.english: You are the sacrificing or the invoking priest, you are the principal (presenter of the offering), the director (of the ceremonies), their performer, or by birth the family priest; thus conversant with all the priestly functions, you perform perfectly the rite; let us not, Agni, suffer injury through your friendship.

mantras.sanskrit: यो विश्वतः सुप्रतीकः सदृङ्ङसि दूरे चित्सन्तळिदिवाति रोचसे । रात्र्याश्चिदन्धो अति देव पश्यस्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo viśvataḥ supratīkaḥ sadṛṅṅasi dūre citsantaḷidivāti rocase | rātryāścidandho ati deva paśyasyagne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||

translations.english: You are of graceful form, and alike on every side, and, although remote, shine as if nigh; you see, divine Agni, beyond the darkness of night; let us not, Agni suffer injury through your friendship.

mantras.sanskrit: पूर्वो देवा भवतु सुन्वतो रथोऽस्माकं शंसो अभ्यस्तु दूढ्यः । तदा जानीतोत पुष्यता वचोऽग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
mantras.transliteration: pūrvo devā bhavatu sunvato ratho'smākaṃ śaṃso abhyastu dūḍhyaḥ | tadā jānītota puṣyatā vaco'gne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||

translations.english: Gods, let the chariot of the offerer of the libation be foremost; let our denunciations overwhelm the wicked; understand and fulfil my words let us not suffer injury, Agni, through your friendship.

mantras.sanskrit: वधैर्दुःशंसाँ अप दूढ्यो जहि दूरे वा ये अन्ति वा के चिदत्रिणः । अथा यज्ञाय गृणते सुगं कृध्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
mantras.transliteration: vadhairduḥśaṃsā~ apa dūḍhyo jahi dūre vā ye anti vā ke cidatriṇaḥ | athā yajñāya gṛṇate sugaṃ kṛdhyagne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||

translations.english: Overcome with your fatal (weapons) the wicked and the impious, all who are enemies, whether distant or near; and then provide an easy (path) for the sacrificer who praises you; let us not, Agni, suffer injury through your friendship.

mantras.sanskrit: यदयुक्था अरुषा रोहिता रथे वातजूता वृषभस्येव ते रवः । आदिन्वसि वनिनो धूमकेतुनाग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadayukthā aruṣā rohitā rathe vātajūtā vṛṣabhasyeva te ravaḥ | ādinvasi vanino dhūmaketunāgne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||

translations.english: When you have yoked the bright red horses (ete vai devāśvāḥ: Taittirīya Saṃhitā 1.7.4.3), swift as the wind, to your car, your roar is like that of a bull, and you enwrap the forest trees with a banner of smoke; let us not, Agni, suffer injury through your friendship.

mantras.sanskrit: अध स्वनादुत बिभ्युः पतत्रिणो द्रप्सा यत्ते यवसादो व्यस्थिरन् । सुगं तत्ते तावकेभ्यो रथेभ्योऽग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha svanāduta bibhyuḥ patatriṇo drapsā yatte yavasādo vyasthiran | sugaṃ tatte tāvakebhyo rathebhyo'gne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||

translations.english: At your roaring, even the birds are terrified; when your flames consuming the grass, have spread in all directions, (the wood) is easy of access to you and to your chariots; let us not, Agni, suffer injury through your friendship.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धायसेऽवयातां मरुतां हेळो अद्भुतः । मृळा सु नो भूत्वेषां मनः पुनरग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ mitrasya varuṇasya dhāyase'vayātāṃ marutāṃ heḷo adbhutaḥ | mṛḷā su no bhūtveṣāṃ manaḥ punaragne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||

translations.english: May this, (your adorer) enjoy the support of Mitra and of Varuṇa; wonderful is the fury of the Maruts; (dwellers in the region) below (the heavens), encourage us, and may their minds again (be gracious) to us; let us not suffer injury, Agni, through your friendship.

mantras.sanskrit: देवो देवानामसि मित्रो अद्भुतो वसुर्वसूनामसि चारुरध्वरे । शर्मन्त्स्याम तव सप्रथस्तमेऽग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
mantras.transliteration: devo devānāmasi mitro adbhuto vasurvasūnāmasi cāruradhvare | śarmantsyāma tava saprathastame'gne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||

translations.english: You, brilliant (Agni), are the especial friend of the gods; you, who are graceful in the sacrifice are the confirmer of all riches; may we be present in your most spacious chamber of sacrifice; let us not, Agni, suffer injury through your friendship.

mantras.sanskrit: तत्ते भद्रं यत्समिद्धः स्वे दमे सोमाहुतो जरसे मृळयत्तमः । दधासि रत्नं द्रविणं च दाशुषेऽग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव ॥
mantras.transliteration: tatte bhadraṃ yatsamiddhaḥ sve dame somāhuto jarase mṛḷayattamaḥ | dadhāsi ratnaṃ draviṇaṃ ca dāśuṣe'gne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||

translations.english: plural asant is it to you when you are lighted in your own abode, and propitiated by libations, are praised (by the priests); then, much delighted, you give rewards and riches to the worshipper; let us not, Agni, suffer injury through your friendship.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्मै त्वं सुद्रविणो ददाशोऽनागास्त्वमदिते सर्वताता । यं भद्रेण शवसा चोदयासि प्रजावता राधसा ते स्याम ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasmai tvaṃ sudraviṇo dadāśo'nāgāstvamadite sarvatātā | yaṃ bhadreṇa śavasā codayāsi prajāvatā rādhasā te syāma ||

translations.english: (Fortunate is the worshipper) to whom, (assiduos) in all pious works, you, possessor of riches, invisible Agni, grant exemption from sin, whom you associate with auspicious strength, may he be (enriched) by you with wealth that comprehends progeny.

mantras.sanskrit: स त्वमग्ने सौभगत्वस्य विद्वानस्माकमायुः प्र तिरेह देव । तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa tvamagne saubhagatvasya vidvānasmākamāyuḥ pra tireha deva | tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

translations.english: Do you, divine Agni, who kno what is good fortune, on this occasion prolong our existence, and may Mitra, Varuṇa, Aditi, ocean, earth and heaven, preserve it to us.

mantras.sanskrit: द्वे विरूपे चरतः स्वर्थे अन्यान्या वत्समुप धापयेते । हरिरन्यस्यां भवति स्वधावाञ्छुक्रो अन्यस्यां ददृशे सुवर्चाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dve virūpe carataḥ svarthe anyānyā vatsamupa dhāpayete | hariranyasyāṃ bhavati svadhāvāñchukro anyasyāṃ dadṛśe suvarcāḥ ||

translations.english: Two periods, of different complexions, revolve for their own purposes, and each in succession severally nourishes a son; in one, Hari is the receiver of oblations, in the other, the brilliant Agni is beheld.

mantras.sanskrit: दशेमं त्वष्टुर्जनयन्त गर्भमतन्द्रासो युवतयो विभृत्रम् । तिग्मानीकं स्वयशसं जनेषु विरोचमानं परि षीं नयन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: daśemaṃ tvaṣṭurjanayanta garbhamatandrāso yuvatayo vibhṛtram | tigmānīkaṃ svayaśasaṃ janeṣu virocamānaṃ pari ṣīṃ nayanti ||

translations.english: The vigilant and youthful Ten beget, through the wind, this embryo Agni, inherent (in all beings), sharp-visaged, universally renowned, shining among men; him they conduct (to every dwelling).

mantras.sanskrit: त्रीणि जाना परि भूषन्त्यस्य समुद्र एकं दिव्येकमप्सु । पूर्वामनु प्र दिशं पार्थिवानामृतून्प्रशासद्वि दधावनुष्ठु ॥
mantras.transliteration: trīṇi jānā pari bhūṣantyasya samudra ekaṃ divyekamapsu | pūrvāmanu pra diśaṃ pārthivānāmṛtūnpraśāsadvi dadhāvanuṣṭhu ||

translations.english: They contemplate three plural ces of his birth; one in the ocean, one in the heaven, one in the firmament; and, dividing the seasons of the year for the benefit of earthly creatures, he formed, in regular succession, the eastern quarteṛ

mantras.sanskrit: क इमं वो निण्यमा चिकेत वत्सो मातॄर्जनयत स्वधाभिः । बह्वीनां गर्भो अपसामुपस्थान्महान्कविर्निश्चरति स्वधावान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ka imaṃ vo niṇyamā ciketa vatso mātṝrjanayata svadhābhiḥ | bahvīnāṃ garbho apasāmupasthānmahānkavirniścarati svadhāvān ||

translations.english: Which of you discerns the hidden Agni? a son, he begets his mothers by oblations; the germ of many (waters), he issues from the ocrean, mighty and wise, the recipient of oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: आविष्ट्यो वर्धते चारुरासु जिह्मानामूर्ध्वः स्वयशा उपस्थे । उभे त्वष्टुर्बिभ्यतुर्जायमानात्प्रतीची सिंहं प्रति जोषयेते ॥
mantras.transliteration: āviṣṭyo vardhate cārurāsu jihmānāmūrdhvaḥ svayaśā upasthe | ubhe tvaṣṭurbibhyaturjāyamānātpratīcī siṃhaṃ prati joṣayete ||

translations.english: Appearing amongst them (the waters), the bright-shining (Agni) increases, rising above the flanks of the waving waters, spreading his own renown; both (heaven and earth) are alarmed, as the radiant Agni is born, and, approaching the lion, they pay him honour.

mantras.sanskrit: उभे भद्रे जोषयेते न मेने गावो न वाश्रा उप तस्थुरेवैः । स दक्षाणां दक्षपतिर्बभूवाञ्जन्ति यं दक्षिणतो हविर्भिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ubhe bhadre joṣayete na mene gāvo na vāśrā upa tasthurevaiḥ | sa dakṣāṇāṃ dakṣapatirbabhūvāñjanti yaṃ dakṣiṇato havirbhiḥ ||

translations.english: Both the auspicious ones (day and night or two pieces of wood rubbed together to produce flame) wait upon him like two feminine le attendants, as lowing kine (follow their calves) by the paths (that they have gone); he has been the lord of might among the mighty, whom (the priests) on the right (of the altar) anoint.

mantras.sanskrit: उद्यंयमीति सवितेव बाहू उभे सिचौ यतते भीम ऋञ्जन् । उच्छुक्रमत्कमजते सिमस्मान्नवा मातृभ्यो वसना जहाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: udyaṃyamīti saviteva bāhū ubhe sicau yatate bhīma ṛñjan | ucchukramatkamajate simasmānnavā mātṛbhyo vasanā jahāti ||

translations.english: Like the sun, he stretches forth his arms, and the formidable Agni, decorating both heaven and earth (with brightness), labours (in his duties); he draws up from everything the essential (moisture), and clothes (the earth) with new vestments (derived) from his maternal (rains).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वेषं रूपं कृणुत उत्तरं यत्सम्पृञ्चानः सदने गोभिरद्भिः । कविर्बुध्नं परि मर्मृज्यते धीः सा देवताता समितिर्बभूव ॥
mantras.transliteration: tveṣaṃ rūpaṃ kṛṇuta uttaraṃ yatsampṛñcānaḥ sadane gobhiradbhiḥ | kavirbudhnaṃ pari marmṛjyate dhīḥ sā devatātā samitirbabhūva ||

translations.english: Associated in the firmament with the moving waters, he assumes an excellent and lustrous form, and the wise sustainer (of all things) sweeps over the source (of the rains with his radiance), whence a concentration of light is spread abroad by the sportive deity.

mantras.sanskrit: उरु ते ज्रयः पर्येति बुध्नं विरोचमानं महिषस्य धाम । विश्वेभिरग्ने स्वयशोभिरिद्धोऽदब्धेभिः पायुभिः पाह्यस्मान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uru te jrayaḥ paryeti budhnaṃ virocamānaṃ mahiṣasya dhāma | viśvebhiragne svayaśobhiriddho'dabdhebhiḥ pāyubhiḥ pāhyasmān ||

translations.english: The vast and victorious radiance of you, the mighty one, pervades the firmament; Agni, who have been kindled by us, preserve us with all your undiminished and protecting glories.

mantras.sanskrit: धन्वन्त्स्रोतः कृणुते गातुमूर्मिं शुक्रैरूर्मिभिरभि नक्षति क्षाम् । विश्वा सनानि जठरेषु धत्तेऽन्तर्नवासु चरति प्रसूषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhanvantsrotaḥ kṛṇute gātumūrmiṃ śukrairūrmibhirabhi nakṣati kṣām | viśvā sanāni jaṭhareṣu dhatte'ntarnavāsu carati prasūṣu ||

translations.english: He causes the waters to flow in a torrent through the sky, and with those pure waves he inundates the earth; he gathers all (articles of) food in the stomach, and for that purpose sojourns in the new-sprung parents (of the gain).

mantras.sanskrit: एवा नो अग्ने समिधा वृधानो रेवत्पावक श्रवसे वि भाहि । तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā no agne samidhā vṛdhāno revatpāvaka śravase vi bhāhi | tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, who are the purifier, growing with the fuel we have supplied, blaze for the sake of (securing) food to us, who are possessed of wealth; and may Mitra, Varuṇa, Aditi--ocean, earth, and heaven, preserve it to us.

mantras.sanskrit: स प्रत्नथा सहसा जायमानः सद्यः काव्यानि बळधत्त विश्वा । आपश्च मित्रं धिषणा च साधन्देवा अग्निं धारयन्द्रविणोदाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa pratnathā sahasā jāyamānaḥ sadyaḥ kāvyāni baḷadhatta viśvā | āpaśca mitraṃ dhiṣaṇā ca sādhandevā agniṃ dhārayandraviṇodām ||

translations.english: Engendered by force, Agni verily appropriates, as soon as born, the offerings of the sages; the waters and voice make him their friend, and the gods retain him as the giver of (sacrificial) wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: स पूर्वया निविदा कव्यतायोरिमाः प्रजा अजनयन्मनूनाम् । विवस्वता चक्षसा द्यामपश्च देवा अग्निं धारयन्द्रविणोदाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa pūrvayā nividā kavyatāyorimāḥ prajā ajanayanmanūnām | vivasvatā cakṣasā dyāmapaśca devā agniṃ dhārayandraviṇodām ||

translations.english: (Propitiated) by the primitive laudatory hymn of Āyu, he created the progeny of Manus, and pervades, with his all-investing splendour, the heavens and the firmament; the gods retain Agni as the giver of (sacrificial) wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: तमीळत प्रथमं यज्ञसाधं विश आरीराहुतमृञ्जसानम् । ऊर्जः पुत्रं भरतं सृप्रदानुं देवा अग्निं धारयन्द्रविणोदाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamīḷata prathamaṃ yajñasādhaṃ viśa ārīrāhutamṛñjasānam | ūrjaḥ putraṃ bharataṃ sṛpradānuṃ devā agniṃ dhārayandraviṇodām ||

translations.english: Approachinghim,let all men adore Agni, the chief (of the gods), the accomplisher of sacrifices, who is gratified by oblations and propitiated by praises--the offspring of food, the sustainer of (all men), the giver of continual gifts; the gods retain Agni as the giver of (sacrificial) wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: स मातरिश्वा पुरुवारपुष्टिर्विदद्गातुं तनयाय स्वर्वित् । विशां गोपा जनिता रोदस्योर्देवा अग्निं धारयन्द्रविणोदाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa mātariśvā puruvārapuṣṭirvidadgātuṃ tanayāya svarvit | viśāṃ gopā janitā rodasyordevā agniṃ dhārayandraviṇodām ||

translations.english: May Agni, the dweller in the firmament, the nourisher with abundant benefits, the bestower of svarga, the protector of mankind, the progenitor of heaven and earth, instrumental uct my sons in the right way; the gods retain Agni as the giver of (sacrificial) wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: नक्तोषासा वर्णमामेम्याने धापयेते शिशुमेकं समीची । द्यावाक्षामा रुक्मो अन्तर्वि भाति देवा अग्निं धारयन्द्रविणोदाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: naktoṣāsā varṇamāmemyāne dhāpayete śiśumekaṃ samīcī | dyāvākṣāmā rukmo antarvi bhāti devā agniṃ dhārayandraviṇodām ||

translations.english: The night and the day, mutually effacing each other's comlexion, give nourishment combined together, to one infant, who, radiant, shines between earth and heaven the gods retain Agni as the giver of (sacrificial) wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: रायो बुध्नः संगमनो वसूनां यज्ञस्य केतुर्मन्मसाधनो वेः । अमृतत्वं रक्षमाणास एनं देवा अग्निं धारयन्द्रविणोदाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: rāyo budhnaḥ saṃgamano vasūnāṃ yajñasya keturmanmasādhano veḥ | amṛtatvaṃ rakṣamāṇāsa enaṃ devā agniṃ dhārayandraviṇodām ||

translations.english: The source of opulence, the bestower of riches, the director of the sacrifice, the accomplisher of the desires (of the man) who has recourse to him; him the gods, preserving their immortality, retain as the giver of (sacrificial) wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: नू च पुरा च सदनं रयीणां जातस्य च जायमानस्य च क्षाम् । सतश्च गोपां भवतश्च भूरेर्देवा अग्निं धारयन्द्रविणोदाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū ca purā ca sadanaṃ rayīṇāṃ jātasya ca jāyamānasya ca kṣām | sataśca gopāṃ bhavataśca bhūrerdevā agniṃ dhārayandraviṇodām ||

translations.english: The gods retain Agni as the giver of (sacrificial) wealth, who now is, and heretofore has been, the abode of riches, the receptacle of all that has been, and all that will be, born, and the preserver of all (that) exists, (as well as of all) that are coming into existence.

mantras.sanskrit: द्रविणोदा द्रविणसस्तुरस्य द्रविणोदाः सनरस्य प्र यंसत् । द्रविणोदा वीरवतीमिषं नो द्रविणोदा रासते दीर्घमायुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: draviṇodā draviṇasasturasya draviṇodāḥ sanarasya pra yaṃsat | draviṇodā vīravatīmiṣaṃ no draviṇodā rāsate dīrghamāyuḥ ||

translations.english: May Draviṇodā grant us (a portion) of moveable wealth; may Draviṇodā grant us (a portion) of that which is stationary; may Draviṇodā give us food attended byprogeny; may Draviṇodā bestow upon us long life.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा नो अग्ने समिधा वृधानो रेवत्पावक श्रवसे वि भाहि । तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā no agne samidhā vṛdhāno revatpāvaka śravase vi bhāhi | tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

translations.english: Thus, Agni, who are the purifier gowing with the fuel (we have supplied), blaze for the sake of securing food to us, who are possessed of wealth and may Mitra, Varuṇa, Aditi--ocean, earth, and heaven, preserve it to us.

mantras.sanskrit: अप नः शोशुचदघमग्ने शुशुग्ध्या रयिम् । अप नः शोशुचदघम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: apa naḥ śośucadaghamagne śuśugdhyā rayim | apa naḥ śośucadagham ||

translations.english: May our sin, Agni, be repented of; manifest riches to us; may our sin be repented of.

mantras.sanskrit: सुक्षेत्रिया सुगातुया वसूया च यजामहे । अप नः शोशुचदघम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sukṣetriyā sugātuyā vasūyā ca yajāmahe | apa naḥ śośucadagham ||

translations.english: We worship you for plural asant fields, for good roads, and for riches; may our sin be repented of.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र यद्भन्दिष्ठ एषां प्रास्माकासश्च सूरयः । अप नः शोशुचदघम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra yadbhandiṣṭha eṣāṃ prāsmākāsaśca sūrayaḥ | apa naḥ śośucadagham ||

translations.english: (in like manner as, among these your worshippers, Kutsa) is the pre-eminent panegyrist, so are our encomiasts (of you) the most distinguished; may our sin be repented of.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र यत्ते अग्ने सूरयो जायेमहि प्र ते वयम् । अप नः शोशुचदघम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra yatte agne sūrayo jāyemahi pra te vayam | apa naḥ śośucadagham ||

translations.english: Inasmuch as your worshippers (are blessed with descentants), so may we, (by repeating your praise), obtain posterity; may our sin be repented of.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र यदग्नेः सहस्वतो विश्वतो यन्ति भानवः । अप नः शोशुचदघम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra yadagneḥ sahasvato viśvato yanti bhānavaḥ | apa naḥ śośucadagham ||

translations.english: Since the victorious flames of Agni penetrate universally, may our sin be repented of.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं हि विश्वतोमुख विश्वतः परिभूरसि । अप नः शोशुचदघम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ hi viśvatomukha viśvataḥ paribhūrasi | apa naḥ śośucadagham ||

translations.english: You, whose countenance is turned to all sides, are our defender; may our sin be repented of.

mantras.sanskrit: द्विषो नो विश्वतोमुखाति नावेव पारय । अप नः शोशुचदघम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dviṣo no viśvatomukhāti nāveva pāraya | apa naḥ śośucadagham ||

translations.english: Do you, whose countenance is turned to all sides, send off our adversaries, as if in a ship, (to the opposite shore); may our sin be repented of.

mantras.sanskrit: स नः सिन्धुमिव नावयाति पर्षा स्वस्तये । अप नः शोशुचदघम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa naḥ sindhumiva nāvayāti parṣā svastaye | apa naḥ śośucadagham ||

translations.english: Do you convey us in a ship across the sea, for our welfare; may our sin be repented of.

mantras.sanskrit: वैश्वानरस्य सुमतौ स्याम राजा हि कं भुवनानामभिश्रीः । इतो जातो विश्वमिदं वि चष्टे वैश्वानरो यतते सूर्येण ॥
mantras.transliteration: vaiśvānarasya sumatau syāma rājā hi kaṃ bhuvanānāmabhiśrīḥ | ito jāto viśvamidaṃ vi caṣṭe vaiśvānaro yatate sūryeṇa ||

translations.english: May we continue in the favour of Vaiśvānara, for verily he is the august sovereign of all beings; as soon as genitive rated from this (wood), he surveys the universe; he accompanies the rising sun.

mantras.sanskrit: पृष्टो दिवि पृष्टो अग्निः पृथिव्यां पृष्टो विश्वा ओषधीरा विवेश । वैश्वानरः सहसा पृष्टो अग्निः स नो दिवा स रिषः पातु नक्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pṛṣṭo divi pṛṣṭo agniḥ pṛthivyāṃ pṛṣṭo viśvā oṣadhīrā viveśa | vaiśvānaraḥ sahasā pṛṣṭo agniḥ sa no divā sa riṣaḥ pātu naktam ||

translations.english: Agni, who is present in the sky, and present upon earth, and who, present, has pervaded all herbs; may the Agni Vaiśvānara, who is present in vigour, guard us night and day, against our enemies

mantras.sanskrit: वैश्वानर तव तत्सत्यमस्त्वस्मान्रायो मघवानः सचन्ताम् । तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vaiśvānara tava tatsatyamastvasmānrāyo maghavānaḥ sacantām | tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

translations.english: Vaiśvānara, may this (your adoration be attended) by real (fruit); may precious treasure wait uon us, and may Mitra, Varuṇa, Aditi--ocean, earth, and heaven, preserve them to us].

mantras.sanskrit: जातवेदसे सुनवाम सोममरातीयतो नि दहाति वेदः । स नः पर्षदति दुर्गाणि विश्वा नावेव सिन्धुं दुरितात्यग्निः ॥
mantras.transliteration: jātavedase sunavāma somamarātīyato ni dahāti vedaḥ | sa naḥ parṣadati durgāṇi viśvā nāveva sindhuṃ duritātyagniḥ ||

translations.english: We offer oblations of Soma to Jātavedas, may he consume the wealth of those who feel enmity against us; may he transport us over all difficulties; may Agni convey us, as in a boat over a river, across all wickedness.

mantras.sanskrit: स यो वृषा वृष्ण्येभिः समोका महो दिवः पृथिव्याश्च सम्राट् । सतीनसत्वा हव्यो भरेषु मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa yo vṛṣā vṛṣṇyebhiḥ samokā maho divaḥ pṛthivyāśca samrāṭ | satīnasatvā havyo bhareṣu marutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||

translations.english: May he who is the showerer of desires, who is co-dweller with (all) energies the supreme ruler over the vast heaven and earth, the sender of water, and to be invoked in battles; may Indra, associated with the Maruts, be our protection.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्यानाप्तः सूर्यस्येव यामो भरेभरे वृत्रहा शुष्मो अस्ति । वृषन्तमः सखिभिः स्वेभिरेवैर्मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasyānāptaḥ sūryasyeva yāmo bharebhare vṛtrahā śuṣmo asti | vṛṣantamaḥ sakhibhiḥ svebhirevairmarutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||

translations.english: May he whose course, like that of the sun, is not to be overtaken, who in every battle is the slayer of his foes, the witherer (of opponents), who, with his swift-moving friends (the winds), is the most bountiful (of givers); may Indra, associated with the Maruts be our protection.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवो न यस्य रेतसो दुघानाः पन्थासो यन्ति शवसापरीताः । तरद्द्वेषाः सासहिः पौंस्येभिर्मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
mantras.transliteration: divo na yasya retaso dughānāḥ panthāso yanti śavasāparītāḥ | taraddveṣāḥ sāsahiḥ pauṃsyebhirmarutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||

translations.english: May he, whose rays, powerful and unattainable issue forth like those of the sun, milking (the clouds); he who is victorious over his adversaries, triumphant by his manly energies; may Indra, associated with the Maruts, be our protection.

mantras.sanskrit: सो अङ्गिरोभिरङ्गिरस्तमो भूद्वृषा वृषभिः सखिभिः सखा सन् । ऋग्मिभिॠग्मी गातुभिर्ज्येष्ठो मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
mantras.transliteration: so aṅgirobhiraṅgirastamo bhūdvṛṣā vṛṣabhiḥ sakhibhiḥ sakhā san | ṛgmibhiṝgmī gātubhirjyeṣṭho marutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||

translations.english: He is the swiftest among the swift, most bountiful amongst the bountiful, a friend with friends, venerable among those who claim veneration, and pre-eminent among those deserving of praise; may Indra, associated with the Maruts, be our protection.

mantras.sanskrit: स सूनुभिर्न रुद्रेभिॠभ्वा नृषाह्ये सासह्वाँ अमित्रान् । सनीळेभिः श्रवस्यानि तूर्वन्मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa sūnubhirna rudrebhiṝbhvā nṛṣāhye sāsahvā~ amitrān | sanīḷebhiḥ śravasyāni tūrvanmarutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||

translations.english: Mighty with the Rudras, as if with his sons, victorious in battle over his enemies, and sending down with his co-dwellers (the waters which are productive of) food; Indra, associated with the Maruts, be our protection.

mantras.sanskrit: स मन्युमीः समदनस्य कर्तास्माकेभिर्नृभिः सूर्यं सनत् । अस्मिन्नहन्त्सत्पतिः पुरुहूतो मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa manyumīḥ samadanasya kartāsmākebhirnṛbhiḥ sūryaṃ sanat | asminnahantsatpatiḥ puruhūto marutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||

translations.english: May he, the represser of (hostile) wrath, the author of war, the protector of the good, the invoked of many, share with our people on this day the (light of the) sun; may Indra, associated with the Maruts, be our protection.

mantras.sanskrit: तमूतयो रणयञ्छूरसातौ तं क्षेमस्य क्षितयः कृण्वत त्राम् । स विश्वस्य करुणस्येश एको मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamūtayo raṇayañchūrasātau taṃ kṣemasya kṣitayaḥ kṛṇvata trām | sa viśvasya karuṇasyeśa eko marutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||

translations.english: Hi, his allies, the Maruts, animate in battle; him, men regard as the preserver of their property; he alone presides over every act of worship; may Indra, associated with the Maruts, be our protection.

mantras.sanskrit: तमप्सन्त शवस उत्सवेषु नरो नरमवसे तं धनाय । सो अन्धे चित्तमसि ज्योतिर्विदन्मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamapsanta śavasa utsaveṣu naro naramavase taṃ dhanāya | so andhe cittamasi jyotirvidanmarutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||

translations.english: To him, a leader (to victory), his worshippers apply in contests of strength for protection and for wealth, as he grants them the light (of conquest) in the bewildering darkness (of battle); may Indra, associated with the Maruts, be our protection.

mantras.sanskrit: स सव्येन यमति व्राधतश्चित्स दक्षिणे संगृभीता कृतानि । स कीरिणा चित्सनिता धनानि मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa savyena yamati vrādhataścitsa dakṣiṇe saṃgṛbhītā kṛtāni | sa kīriṇā citsanitā dhanāni marutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||

translations.english: With his left hand he restrains the malignant, with his right he receives the (sacrificial) offerings; he is the giver of riches, (when propitiated) by one who celebrates his praise; may Indra, associated with the Maruts, be our protection.

mantras.sanskrit: स ग्रामेभिः सनिता स रथेभिर्विदे विश्वाभिः कृष्टिभिर्न्वद्य । स पौंस्येभिरभिभूरशस्तीर्मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa grāmebhiḥ sanitā sa rathebhirvide viśvābhiḥ kṛṣṭibhirnvadya | sa pauṃsyebhirabhibhūraśastīrmarutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||

translations.english: He, along with his attendants, is a benefactor; he is quickly recognized by all men today, through his chariots; by his manly energies he is victor over unruly (adversaries); may Indra, associated with the Maruts, be our protection.

mantras.sanskrit: स जामिभिर्यत्समजाति मीळ्हेऽजामिभिर्वा पुरुहूत एवैः । अपां तोकस्य तनयस्य जेषे मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa jāmibhiryatsamajāti mīḷhe'jāmibhirvā puruhūta evaiḥ | apāṃ tokasya tanayasya jeṣe marutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||

translations.english: Invoked by many, he goes to battle with his kinsmen, or with (followers) not of his kindred; he secures the (triumph) of those who trust him, and of their sons and grandsons; may Indra, associated with the Maruts, be our protection.

mantras.sanskrit: स वज्रभृद्दस्युहा भीम उग्रः सहस्रचेताः शतनीथ ऋभ्वा । चम्रीषो न शवसा पाञ्चजन्यो मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa vajrabhṛddasyuhā bhīma ugraḥ sahasracetāḥ śatanītha ṛbhvā | camrīṣo na śavasā pāñcajanyo marutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||

translations.english: He is the wielder of the thunderbolt, the slayer of robbers, fearful and fierce, knowing many things, much eulogized and mighty, and like the Soma, inspiring the five classes of beings with vigour; may Indra, associated with the Maruts, be our protection.

mantras.sanskrit: तस्य वज्रः क्रन्दति स्मत्स्वर्षा दिवो न त्वेषो रवथः शिमीवान् । तं सचन्ते सनयस्तं धनानि मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
mantras.transliteration: tasya vajraḥ krandati smatsvarṣā divo na tveṣo ravathaḥ śimīvān | taṃ sacante sanayastaṃ dhanāni marutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||

translations.english: His thunderbolt draws cries (from his enemies), he is the sender of good waters, brilliant as (the luminary) of heaven, the thunderer, the promoter of beneficent acts, upon him do donations and riches attend; may Indra, associated with the Maruts, be our protection.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्याजस्रं शवसा मानमुक्थं परिभुजद्रोदसी विश्वतः सीम् । स पारिषत्क्रतुभिर्मन्दसानो मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasyājasraṃ śavasā mānamukthaṃ paribhujadrodasī viśvataḥ sīm | sa pāriṣatkratubhirmandasāno marutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||

translations.english: May he, of whom the excellent measure (of all things), through strength, eternally and everywhere cherishes heaven and earth, propitiated by our acts, convey us beyond (evil); may Indra, associated with the Maruts, be our protection.

mantras.sanskrit: न यस्य देवा देवता न मर्ता आपश्चन शवसो अन्तमापुः । स प्ररिक्वा त्वक्षसा क्ष्मो दिवश्च मरुत्वान्नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
mantras.transliteration: na yasya devā devatā na martā āpaścana śavaso antamāpuḥ | sa prarikvā tvakṣasā kṣmo divaśca marutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||

translations.english: Nor gods, nor men, nor waters, have reached the limit of the strength of that beneficent (divinity) for he surpasses both earth and heaven by his foe-consuming (might); may Indra, associated with the Maruts, be our protection.

mantras.sanskrit: रोहिच्छ्यावा सुमदंशुर्ललामीर्द्युक्षा राय ऋज्राश्वस्य । वृषण्वन्तं बिभ्रती धूर्षु रथं मन्द्रा चिकेत नाहुषीषु विक्षु ॥
mantras.transliteration: rohicchyāvā sumadaṃśurlalāmīrdyukṣā rāya ṛjrāśvasya | vṛṣaṇvantaṃ bibhratī dhūrṣu rathaṃ mandrā ciketa nāhuṣīṣu vikṣu ||

translations.english: The red and black coursers, long-limbed, well-caparisoned, and celestial, an dharnessed, well-plural ased, to the yoke of the chariot in which the showerer of benefits is conveyed, for the enrichment of Ṛjrāśva, an dis recognized amongst human hosts.

mantras.sanskrit: एतत्त्यत्त इन्द्र वृष्ण उक्थं वार्षागिरा अभि गृणन्ति राधः । ऋज्राश्वः प्रष्टिभिरम्बरीषः सहदेवो भयमानः सुराधाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: etattyatta indra vṛṣṇa ukthaṃ vārṣāgirā abhi gṛṇanti rādhaḥ | ṛjrāśvaḥ praṣṭibhirambarīṣaḥ sahadevo bhayamānaḥ surādhāḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, showerer (of benefits), the Vārṣāgirās, Ṛjrāśva and his companions, Ambariṣa, Sahadeva, Bhayamāna, and Surādhās, address to you this propitiatory praise].

mantras.sanskrit: दस्यूञ्छिम्यूँश्च पुरुहूत एवैर्हत्वा पृथिव्यां शर्वा नि बर्हीत् । सनत्क्षेत्रं सखिभिः श्वित्न्येभिः सनत्सूर्यं सनदपः सुवज्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dasyūñchimyū~śca puruhūta evairhatvā pṛthivyāṃ śarvā ni barhīt | sanatkṣetraṃ sakhibhiḥ śvitnyebhiḥ sanatsūryaṃ sanadapaḥ suvajraḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, who is invoked by many, attended by the moving (Maruts), having attacked the Dasyus and the Śimyus, slew them with his thunderbolt; the thunderer then divided the fields with his white-complexioned friends, and rescued the sun and set free the water.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वाहेन्द्रो अधिवक्ता नो अस्त्वपरिह्वृताः सनुयाम वाजम् । तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvāhendro adhivaktā no astvaparihvṛtāḥ sanuyāma vājam | tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

translations.english: May Indra be daily our vindicator, and may we, with undiverted course, enjoy (abundant) food; and may Mitra, Varuṇa, Aditi--ocean, earth and heaven, preserve it to us].

mantras.sanskrit: प्र मन्दिने पितुमदर्चता वचो यः कृष्णगर्भा निरहन्नृजिश्वना । अवस्यवो वृषणं वज्रदक्षिणं मरुत्वन्तं सख्याय हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra mandine pitumadarcatā vaco yaḥ kṛṣṇagarbhā nirahannṛjiśvanā | avasyavo vṛṣaṇaṃ vajradakṣiṇaṃ marutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe ||

translations.english: Offer adoration with oblations to him who is delighted (with praise), who, with Ṛjiśvan, destroyed the pregnant wives of Kṛṣṇa; desirous of protection, we invoke, to become our friend, him, who is the showerer (of benefits), who holds the thunderbolt in his right hand, attended by the Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: यो व्यंसं जाहृषाणेन मन्युना यः शम्बरं यो अहन्पिप्रुमव्रतम् । इन्द्रो यः शुष्णमशुषं न्यावृणङ्मरुत्वन्तं सख्याय हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo vyaṃsaṃ jāhṛṣāṇena manyunā yaḥ śambaraṃ yo ahanpiprumavratam | indro yaḥ śuṣṇamaśuṣaṃ nyāvṛṇaṅmarutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe ||

translations.english: We invoke to be our friend, Indra, who is attended by the Maruts; he who, with increasing wrath, slew the mutilated Vṛtra and Śambara, and the unrighteous Pipru, and who extirpated the unabsorbable Śuṣṇa

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य द्यावापृथिवी पौंस्यं महद्यस्य व्रते वरुणो यस्य सूर्यः । यस्येन्द्रस्य सिन्धवः सश्चति व्रतं मरुत्वन्तं सख्याय हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya dyāvāpṛthivī pauṃsyaṃ mahadyasya vrate varuṇo yasya sūryaḥ | yasyendrasya sindhavaḥ saścati vrataṃ marutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe ||

translations.english: We invoke to become our friend, Indra, who is attended by the Maruts; whose great power (pervades) heaven and earth, in whose service Varuṇa and Sūrya are steadfast, and whose commadn the rivers obey.

mantras.sanskrit: यो अश्वानां यो गवां गोपतिर्वशी य आरितः कर्मणिकर्मणि स्थिरः । वीळोश्चिदिन्द्रो यो असुन्वतो वधो मरुत्वन्तं सख्याय हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo aśvānāṃ yo gavāṃ gopatirvaśī ya āritaḥ karmaṇikarmaṇi sthiraḥ | vīḷościdindro yo asunvato vadho marutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe ||

translations.english: Who is th elord over all horses and cattle, who is independent, who, propitiated by praise, is constant in every act, and who is the slayer of the obstinate abstainer from libations; we invoke to become our friend, Indra, attended by the Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: यो विश्वस्य जगतः प्राणतस्पतिर्यो ब्रह्मणे प्रथमो गा अविन्दत् । इन्द्रो यो दस्यूँरधराँ अवातिरन्मरुत्वन्तं सख्याय हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo viśvasya jagataḥ prāṇataspatiryo brahmaṇe prathamo gā avindat | indro yo dasyū~radharā~ avātiranmarutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe ||

translations.english: Who is the lord of all moving and breathing creatures, who first recovered the (stolen) kine for the Brāhmaṇa, and who slew the humbled Dasyus; we invoke to become our friend, Indra, attended by the Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: यः शूरेभिर्हव्यो यश्च भीरुभिर्यो धावद्भिर्हूयते यश्च जिग्युभिः । इन्द्रं यं विश्वा भुवनाभि संदधुर्मरुत्वन्तं सख्याय हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ śūrebhirhavyo yaśca bhīrubhiryo dhāvadbhirhūyate yaśca jigyubhiḥ | indraṃ yaṃ viśvā bhuvanābhi saṃdadhurmarutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe ||

translations.english: Who is to be invoked by the brave and by the timid, by the vanquished and by victors, and whom all eings plural ce before them (in their ites); we invoke to become our friend, Indra, attended by the Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: रुद्राणामेति प्रदिशा विचक्षणो रुद्रेभिर्योषा तनुते पृथु ज्रयः । इन्द्रं मनीषा अभ्यर्चति श्रुतं मरुत्वन्तं सख्याय हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: rudrāṇāmeti pradiśā vicakṣaṇo rudrebhiryoṣā tanute pṛthu jrayaḥ | indraṃ manīṣā abhyarcati śrutaṃ marutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe ||

translations.english: The radiant Indra proceeds (along the firmament) with the manifestation of the Rudras; through the Rudras, speech spreads with more expansive celerity, and praise glorifies the renowned Indra; him, attended by the Maruts, we invoke to become our friend.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्वा मरुत्वः परमे सधस्थे यद्वावमे वृजने मादयासे । अत आ याह्यध्वरं नो अच्छा त्वाया हविश्चकृमा सत्यराधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadvā marutvaḥ parame sadhasthe yadvāvame vṛjane mādayāse | ata ā yāhyadhvaraṃ no acchā tvāyā haviścakṛmā satyarādhaḥ ||

translations.english: Attended by the winds, giver of true wealth, whether you may be plural ased (to dwell) in a stately mansion or in a lowly dwelling, come to our sacrifice; desirous of your presence, we offer you oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वायेन्द्र सोमं सुषुमा सुदक्ष त्वाया हविश्चकृमा ब्रह्मवाहः । अधा नियुत्वः सगणो मरुद्भिरस्मिन्यज्ञे बर्हिषि मादयस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāyendra somaṃ suṣumā sudakṣa tvāyā haviścakṛmā brahmavāhaḥ | adhā niyutvaḥ sagaṇo marudbhirasminyajñe barhiṣi mādayasva ||

translations.english: Desirous of you, Indra, who are possessed of excellent strenghth, we pour forth to you libations desirous of you, who are obtained by prayer, we offer you oblations; therefore, do you, who are possessed of horses, sit down with plural asure upon the sacred grass, attended by the Maruts, at this sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: मादयस्व हरिभिर्ये त इन्द्र वि ष्यस्व शिप्रे वि सृजस्व धेने । आ त्वा सुशिप्र हरयो वहन्तूशन्हव्यानि प्रति नो जुषस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: mādayasva haribhirye ta indra vi ṣyasva śipre vi sṛjasva dhene | ā tvā suśipra harayo vahantūśanhavyāni prati no juṣasva ||

translations.english: Rejoice, Indra, with the steeds who are of your nature; open your jaws, set wide your throat (to drink Soma); let your horses bring you, who have a handsome chin, (hither), and, benignant towards us, be plural ased by our oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: मरुत्स्तोत्रस्य वृजनस्य गोपा वयमिन्द्रेण सनुयाम वाजम् । तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
mantras.transliteration: marutstotrasya vṛjanasya gopā vayamindreṇa sanuyāma vājam | tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

translations.english: Protected by that destroyer (of foes), who is united in praise with the Maruts, we may receive sustenance from Indra; and may Mitra, Varuṇa, Aditi -- ocean, earth and heaven, preserve it to us.

mantras.sanskrit: इमां ते धियं प्र भरे महो महीमस्य स्तोत्रे धिषणा यत्त आनजे । तमुत्सवे च प्रसवे च सासहिमिन्द्रं देवासः शवसामदन्ननु ॥
mantras.transliteration: imāṃ te dhiyaṃ pra bhare maho mahīmasya stotre dhiṣaṇā yatta ānaje | tamutsave ca prasave ca sāsahimindraṃ devāsaḥ śavasāmadannanu ||

translations.english: I address to you, who are mighty, this excellent hymn, because your understanding has been gratified by my praise; the gods have successively delighted that victorious Indra with the power (of praise), for the sake of prosperity and wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य श्रवो नद्यः सप्त बिभ्रति द्यावाक्षामा पृथिवी दर्शतं वपुः । अस्मे सूर्याचन्द्रमसाभिचक्षे श्रद्धे कमिन्द्र चरतो वितर्तुरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya śravo nadyaḥ sapta bibhrati dyāvākṣāmā pṛthivī darśataṃ vapuḥ | asme sūryācandramasābhicakṣe śraddhe kamindra carato vitarturam ||

translations.english: The seven rivers display his glory; heaven, and earth, and sky display his visible form; the sun and moon, Indra,perform their revolution, that we may see, and have faith in what we see.

mantras.sanskrit: तं स्मा रथं मघवन्प्राव सातये जैत्रं यं ते अनुमदाम संगमे । आजा न इन्द्र मनसा पुरुष्टुत त्वायद्भ्यो मघवञ्छर्म यच्छ नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ smā rathaṃ maghavanprāva sātaye jaitraṃ yaṃ te anumadāma saṃgame | ājā na indra manasā puruṣṭuta tvāyadbhyo maghavañcharma yaccha naḥ ||

translations.english: Maghavan, despatch your chariot to bring us wealth; that victorious car which, Indra, who are much praised by us in time of war, we rejoice to behold in battle; do you, Maghavan, grant happiness to those who are devoted to you.

mantras.sanskrit: वयं जयेम त्वया युजा वृतमस्माकमंशमुदवा भरेभरे । अस्मभ्यमिन्द्र वरिवः सुगं कृधि प्र शत्रूणां मघवन्वृष्ण्या रुज ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayaṃ jayema tvayā yujā vṛtamasmākamaṃśamudavā bharebhare | asmabhyamindra varivaḥ sugaṃ kṛdhi pra śatrūṇāṃ maghavanvṛṣṇyā ruja ||

translations.english: May we, having you for our ally, overcome our adversaries in every encounter; defend our portion; render riches easily attained by us; enfeeble Maghavan, the vigour of our enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: नाना हि त्वा हवमाना जना इमे धनानां धर्तरवसा विपन्यवः । अस्माकं स्मा रथमा तिष्ठ सातये जैत्रं हीन्द्र निभृतं मनस्तव ॥
mantras.transliteration: nānā hi tvā havamānā janā ime dhanānāṃ dhartaravasā vipanyavaḥ | asmākaṃ smā rathamā tiṣṭha sātaye jaitraṃ hīndra nibhṛtaṃ manastava ||

translations.english: Many are the men who call upon you for your protection; mount your car to bring wealth to us, for your mind, Indra, is composed, and resolved of victory.

mantras.sanskrit: गोजिता बाहू अमितक्रतुः सिमः कर्मन्कर्मञ्छतमूतिः खजंकरः । अकल्प इन्द्रः प्रतिमानमोजसाथा जना वि ह्वयन्ते सिषासवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: gojitā bāhū amitakratuḥ simaḥ karmankarmañchatamūtiḥ khajaṃkaraḥ | akalpa indraḥ pratimānamojasāthā janā vi hvayante siṣāsavaḥ ||

translations.english: Your arms are the winners of cattle, your wisdom is unbounded, you are most excellent, the granter of a hundred aids in every rite; the author of war, Indra is uncontrolled; the type of strength; wherefore men, who are desirous of wealth, invoke him in various ways.

mantras.sanskrit: उत्ते शतान्मघवन्नुच्च भूयस उत्सहस्राद्रिरिचे कृष्टिषु श्रवः । अमात्रं त्वा धिषणा तित्विषे मह्यधा वृत्राणि जिघ्नसे पुरंदर ॥
mantras.transliteration: utte śatānmaghavannucca bhūyasa utsahasrādririce kṛṣṭiṣu śravaḥ | amātraṃ tvā dhiṣaṇā titviṣe mahyadhā vṛtrāṇi jighnase puraṃdara ||

translations.english: The food, Maghavan, (which is to be given by you) to men, may be more than sufficient for a hundred, oor for more, even, than a thousand; great praise has glorified you, who are without limit, whereupon you destroy your enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिविष्टिधातु प्रतिमानमोजसस्तिस्रो भूमीर्नृपते त्रीणि रोचना । अतीदं विश्वं भुवनं ववक्षिथाशत्रुरिन्द्र जनुषा सनादसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: triviṣṭidhātu pratimānamojasastisro bhūmīrnṛpate trīṇi rocanā | atīdaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ vavakṣithāśatrurindra januṣā sanādasi ||

translations.english: Strong as a twice-twisted rope, you are the type of strength; protector of men, that are more than able to sustain the three spheres, the three luminaries, and all this world of beings, Indra, who have from birth ever been without a rival.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वां देवेषु प्रथमं हवामहे त्वं बभूथ पृतनासु सासहिः । सेमं नः कारुमुपमन्युमुद्भिदमिन्द्रः कृणोतु प्रसवे रथं पुरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāṃ deveṣu prathamaṃ havāmahe tvaṃ babhūtha pṛtanāsu sāsahiḥ | semaṃ naḥ kārumupamanyumudbhidamindraḥ kṛṇotu prasave rathaṃ puraḥ ||

translations.english: We invoke you, Indra, the first among the gods; you have been the victor in battles; may Indra put foremost in the battle this our chariot, which is efficient, impetuous, and the uprooter (of all impediments).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं जिगेथ न धना रुरोधिथार्भेष्वाजा मघवन्महत्सु च । त्वामुग्रमवसे सं शिशीमस्यथा न इन्द्र हवनेषु चोदय ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ jigetha na dhanā rurodhithārbheṣvājā maghavanmahatsu ca | tvāmugramavase saṃ śiśīmasyathā na indra havaneṣu codaya ||

translations.english: You conquer, and withhold not the booty; in trifling or in serious conflicts, we sharpen you, fierce Maghavan, for our defence; do you, therefore, inspirit us in our defiances.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वाहेन्द्रो अधिवक्ता नो अस्त्वपरिह्वृताः सनुयाम वाजम् । तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvāhendro adhivaktā no astvaparihvṛtāḥ sanuyāma vājam | tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

translations.english: May Indra daily be our vindicator, and may we, with undiverted course, enjoy abundant food; and may Mitra, Varuṇa, Aditi--ocean, earth, and heaven, preserve it to us.

mantras.sanskrit: तत्त इन्द्रियं परमं पराचैरधारयन्त कवयः पुरेदम् । क्षमेदमन्यद्दिव्यन्यदस्य समी पृच्यते समनेव केतुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tatta indriyaṃ paramaṃ parācairadhārayanta kavayaḥ puredam | kṣamedamanyaddivyanyadasya samī pṛcyate samaneva ketuḥ ||

translations.english: The sages have formerly been possessed of this your supreme power, Indra, as if it were present with them, one light of whom shines upon the earth, the other in heaven, and both are in combination with each other, as banner (mingles with banner) in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: स धारयत्पृथिवीं पप्रथच्च वज्रेण हत्वा निरपः ससर्ज । अहन्नहिमभिनद्रौहिणं व्यहन्व्यंसं मघवा शचीभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa dhārayatpṛthivīṃ paprathacca vajreṇa hatvā nirapaḥ sasarja | ahannahimabhinadrauhiṇaṃ vyahanvyaṃsaṃ maghavā śacībhiḥ ||

translations.english: He upholds, and has spread out, the earth; having struck (the clouds), he has extricated the waters; he has slain Ahi, he has pierced Rauhiṇa, he has destroyed, by his prowess, the mutilated (Vṛtra).

mantras.sanskrit: स जातूभर्मा श्रद्दधान ओजः पुरो विभिन्दन्नचरद्वि दासीः । विद्वान्वज्रिन्दस्यवे हेतिमस्यार्यं सहो वर्धया द्युम्नमिन्द्र ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa jātūbharmā śraddadhāna ojaḥ puro vibhindannacaradvi dāsīḥ | vidvānvajrindasyave hetimasyāryaṃ saho vardhayā dyumnamindra ||

translations.english: Armed with the thunderbolt, and confident in his strength, he has gone on destroying the cities of the Dasyus. Thunderer, acknowledging (the praises of your worshipper) cast, for his sake, your shaft agains the Dasyu, and augment the strength and glory of the Ārya.

mantras.sanskrit: तदूचुषे मानुषेमा युगानि कीर्तेन्यं मघवा नाम बिभ्रत् । उपप्रयन्दस्युहत्याय वज्री यद्ध सूनुः श्रवसे नाम दधे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadūcuṣe mānuṣemā yugāni kīrtenyaṃ maghavā nāma bibhrat | upaprayandasyuhatyāya vajrī yaddha sūnuḥ śravase nāma dadhe ||
