translations.english: Maghavan, possessing a name that is to be glorified, offers to him who celebrates it, these (revolving) ages of man; the thunderer, the scatterer (of his foes), sallying forth to destroy the Dasyus, has obtained a name (renowned for victorious) prowess.

mantras.sanskrit: तदस्येदं पश्यता भूरि पुष्टं श्रदिन्द्रस्य धत्तन वीर्याय । स गा अविन्दत्सो अविन्ददश्वान्त्स ओषधीः सो अपः स वनानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadasyedaṃ paśyatā bhūri puṣṭaṃ śradindrasya dhattana vīryāya | sa gā avindatso avindadaśvāntsa oṣadhīḥ so apaḥ sa vanāni ||

translations.english: Behold this, the vast and extensive (might of Indra); have confidence in his prowess; he has recovered the cattle, he has recovered the horses, the plural nts, the waters, the woods.

mantras.sanskrit: भूरिकर्मणे वृषभाय वृष्णे सत्यशुष्माय सुनवाम सोमम् । य आदृत्या परिपन्थीव शूरोऽयज्वनो विभजन्नेति वेदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhūrikarmaṇe vṛṣabhāya vṛṣṇe satyaśuṣmāya sunavāma somam | ya ādṛtyā paripanthīva śūro'yajvano vibhajanneti vedaḥ ||

translations.english: We offer the Soma libation to him who is the performer of many exploits, the best (of the gods), the showerer (of benefits), the possessor of true strength, the hero who, holding respect for wealth, takes it from him who performs no sacrifice, like a foot-pad (from a traveller), and proceeds (to give it) to the sacrificer.

mantras.sanskrit: तदिन्द्र प्रेव वीर्यं चकर्थ यत्ससन्तं वज्रेणाबोधयोऽहिम् । अनु त्वा पत्नीर्हृषितं वयश्च विश्वे देवासो अमदन्ननु त्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadindra preva vīryaṃ cakartha yatsasantaṃ vajreṇābodhayo'him | anu tvā patnīrhṛṣitaṃ vayaśca viśve devāso amadannanu tvā ||

translations.english: You did perform, Indra, a glorious deed, when you did awaken the sleeping Ahi with your thunderbolt; then the wives (of the gods), the Maruts, and all the gods, imitated your exultation.

mantras.sanskrit: शुष्णं पिप्रुं कुयवं वृत्रमिन्द्र यदावधीर्वि पुरः शम्बरस्य । तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śuṣṇaṃ pipruṃ kuyavaṃ vṛtramindra yadāvadhīrvi puraḥ śambarasya | tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

translations.english: Inasmuch, Indra, as you have slain Śuṣṇa, Pipru, Kuyava and Vṛtra, and destroyed the cities of Śambara, therefore may Mitra, Varuṇa, Aditi--ocean, earth, and heaven, grant us that (which we desire).

mantras.sanskrit: योनिष्ट इन्द्र निषदे अकारि तमा नि षीद स्वानो नार्वा । विमुच्या वयोऽवसायाश्वान्दोषा वस्तोर्वहीयसः प्रपित्वे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yoniṣṭa indra niṣade akāri tamā ni ṣīda svāno nārvā | vimucyā vayo'vasāyāśvāndoṣā vastorvahīyasaḥ prapitve ||

translations.english: The altar has been raised, Indra, for your seat; hasten to sit upon it as a neighing horse (hastens to his stable); slackening the reins, and letting your coursers free, who, at the season of sacrifice, bear you night and day.

mantras.sanskrit: ओ त्ये नर इन्द्रमूतये गुर्नू चित्तान्त्सद्यो अध्वनो जगम्यात् । देवासो मन्युं दासस्य श्चम्नन्ते न आ वक्षन्त्सुविताय वर्णम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: o tye nara indramūtaye gurnū cittāntsadyo adhvano jagamyāt | devāso manyuṃ dāsasya ścamnante na ā vakṣantsuvitāya varṇam ||

translations.english: These person ns have come to Indra (to solicit) his protection; may he quickly direct them on the way; may the gods repress the wrathof the destroyer, and bring to our solemnity the obviator of evil.

mantras.sanskrit: अव त्मना भरते केतवेदा अव त्मना भरते फेनमुदन् । क्षीरेण स्नातः कुयवस्य योषे हते ते स्यातां प्रवणे शिफायाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ava tmanā bharate ketavedā ava tmanā bharate phenamudan | kṣīreṇa snātaḥ kuyavasya yoṣe hate te syātāṃ pravaṇe śiphāyāḥ ||

translations.english: (The Asura), knowing the wealth of others, carries it off of himself; present in the water, he carries off, of himself, the foam; the two wives of Kuyava bathe with the water; may they be drowned in the depths of the Śiphā river.

mantras.sanskrit: युयोप नाभिरुपरस्यायोः प्र पूर्वाभिस्तिरते राष्टि शूरः । अञ्जसी कुलिशी वीरपत्नी पयो हिन्वाना उदभिर्भरन्ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuyopa nābhiruparasyāyoḥ pra pūrvābhistirate rāṣṭi śūraḥ | añjasī kuliśī vīrapatnī payo hinvānā udabhirbharante ||

translations.english: The abiding-plural ce of the vagrant (Kuyava) was concealed (in the midst) of the water; the hero increases with the waters formerly (carried off), and is renowned (throughout the world); the Añjasī, kuliśī and Vīrapatni rivers, plural asing him with their substance, sustain him with their waters.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रति यत्स्या नीथादर्शि दस्योरोको नाच्छा सदनं जानती गात् । अध स्मा नो मघवञ्चर्कृतादिन्मा नो मघेव निष्षपी परा दाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prati yatsyā nīthādarśi dasyoroko nācchā sadanaṃ jānatī gāt | adha smā no maghavañcarkṛtādinmā no magheva niṣṣapī parā dāḥ ||

translations.english: Since the track that leads to the dwelling of the Dasyu has been seen by us, as a cow knows the way to her stall, therefore do you, Maghavan, (defend us) from his repeated violence; do not you cast away as a libertine throws away wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: स त्वं न इन्द्र सूर्ये सो अप्स्वनागास्त्व आ भज जीवशंसे । मान्तरां भुजमा रीरिषो नः श्रद्धितं ते महत इन्द्रियाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa tvaṃ na indra sūrye so apsvanāgāstva ā bhaja jīvaśaṃse | māntarāṃ bhujamā rīriṣo naḥ śraddhitaṃ te mahata indriyāya ||

translations.english: Excite in us, Indra, veneration for the sun, for the waters, and for those who are worthy of the praise of living beings, as exempt from sin; injure not our offspring while yet in the womb, for our trust is in yourmighty power.

mantras.sanskrit: अधा मन्ये श्रत्ते अस्मा अधायि वृषा चोदस्व महते धनाय । मा नो अकृते पुरुहूत योनाविन्द्र क्षुध्यद्भ्यो वय आसुतिं दाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhā manye śratte asmā adhāyi vṛṣā codasva mahate dhanāya | mā no akṛte puruhūta yonāvindra kṣudhyadbhyo vaya āsutiṃ dāḥ ||

translations.english: Hence, Indra, I meditate on you; on his (your power) has our trust been plural ced; showerer (of benefits), direct us to great wealth; consign us not, you who are invoked by many, to a destitute dwelling; give, Indra, food and drink to the hungry.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नो वधीरिन्द्र मा परा दा मा नः प्रिया भोजनानि प्र मोषीः । आण्डा मा नो मघवञ्छक्र निर्भेन्मा नः पात्रा भेत्सहजानुषाणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā no vadhīrindra mā parā dā mā naḥ priyā bhojanāni pra moṣīḥ | āṇḍā mā no maghavañchakra nirbhenmā naḥ pātrā bhetsahajānuṣāṇi ||

translations.english: Harm us not, Indra, abandon us not; deprive us not of the enjoyments that aare dear to us; injure not, affluent Śakra, our unborn offspring; harm not those who are capable (only of crawling) on their knees.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्वाङेहि सोमकामं त्वाहुरयं सुतस्तस्य पिबा मदाय । उरुव्यचा जठर आ वृषस्व पितेव नः शृणुहि हूयमानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: arvāṅehi somakāmaṃ tvāhurayaṃ sutastasya pibā madāya | uruvyacā jaṭhara ā vṛṣasva piteva naḥ śṛṇuhi hūyamānaḥ ||

translations.english: Come into our presence; they have called you, fond of the Soma; it is prepared; drink of it for your exhilaration; vast of limb, distend your stomach, and when invoked hear us, as a father (listens to the words of his sons).

mantras.sanskrit: चन्द्रमा अप्स्वन्तरा सुपर्णो धावते दिवि । न वो हिरण्यनेमयः पदं विन्दन्ति विद्युतो वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
mantras.transliteration: candramā apsvantarā suparṇo dhāvate divi | na vo hiraṇyanemayaḥ padaṃ vindanti vidyuto vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||

translations.english: The graceful-movingmoonspeeds along the middle region in the sky; bright golden rays (my eyes) behold not your abidding-plural ce. Heaven and earth, be conscious of this (my affliction).

mantras.sanskrit: अर्थमिद्वा उ अर्थिन आ जाया युवते पतिम् । तुञ्जाते वृष्ण्यं पयः परिदाय रसं दुहे वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
mantras.transliteration: arthamidvā u arthina ā jāyā yuvate patim | tuñjāte vṛṣṇyaṃ payaḥ paridāya rasaṃ duhe vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||

translations.english: Those who seek for wealth, obtain it; a wife enjoys (the presence of) her husband, and from their union progeny is engendered. Heaven and earth, be conscious of this (my affliction).

mantras.sanskrit: मो षु देवा अदः स्वरव पादि दिवस्परि । मा सोम्यस्य शम्भुवः शूने भूम कदा चन वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
mantras.transliteration: mo ṣu devā adaḥ svarava pādi divaspari | mā somyasya śambhuvaḥ śūne bhūma kadā cana vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||

translations.english: Never, Gods, may this (my ancestry), abiding above in heaven, be excluded (from it); never may we be in want (of a son), the cause of joy (to his progenitors), entitled to libations of the Soma. Heaven and earth, be conscious of this (my affliction).

mantras.sanskrit: यज्ञं पृच्छाम्यवमं स तद्दूतो वि वोचति । क्व ऋतं पूर्व्यं गतं कस्तद्बिभर्ति नूतनो वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajñaṃ pṛcchāmyavamaṃ sa taddūto vi vocati | kva ṛtaṃ pūrvyaṃ gataṃ kastadbibharti nūtano vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||

translations.english: I implore the first (of the gods), the object of sacrifice, that he will become my messenger, and narrate (my condition to the other deities). Where, Agni, is your former benevolence, what new being now possesses it? Heaven and earth, be conscious of this (my affliction).

mantras.sanskrit: अमी ये देवाः स्थन त्रिष्वा रोचने दिवः । कद्व ऋतं कदनृतं क्व प्रत्ना व आहुतिर्वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
mantras.transliteration: amī ye devāḥ sthana triṣvā rocane divaḥ | kadva ṛtaṃ kadanṛtaṃ kva pratnā va āhutirvittaṃ me asya rodasī ||

translations.english: Gods, who are present in the three worlds, who abide in the light of the sun, where now is your truth, where your untruth, where the ancient invocation (that I have addressed) to you? Heaven and earth, be conscious of (my affliction).

mantras.sanskrit: कद्व ऋतस्य धर्णसि कद्वरुणस्य चक्षणम् । कदर्यम्णो महस्पथाति क्रामेम दूढ्यो वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
mantras.transliteration: kadva ṛtasya dharṇasi kadvaruṇasya cakṣaṇam | kadaryamṇo mahaspathāti krāmema dūḍhyo vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||

translations.english: Where, deities, is your observance of the truth, where the (benignant) regard of Varuṇa, where is the path of the mighty Aryaman, (so that) we may overcome the malevolent? Heaven and earth, be conscious of this (my affliction).

mantras.sanskrit: अहं सो अस्मि यः पुरा सुते वदामि कानि चित् । तं मा व्यन्त्याध्यो वृको न तृष्णजं मृगं वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ so asmi yaḥ purā sute vadāmi kāni cit | taṃ mā vyantyādhyo vṛko na tṛṣṇajaṃ mṛgaṃ vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||

translations.english: I am he, Gods, who formerly recited (your praise) when the libation was poured out; yet sorrows assail me, like a wolf (that falls upon) a thirsty deer. Heaven and earth, be conscious of this (my affliction).

mantras.sanskrit: सं मा तपन्त्यभितः सपत्नीरिव पर्शवः । मूषो न शिश्ना व्यदन्ति माध्यः स्तोतारं ते शतक्रतो वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ mā tapantyabhitaḥ sapatnīriva parśavaḥ | mūṣo na śiśnā vyadanti mādhyaḥ stotāraṃ te śatakrato vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||

translations.english: The ribs (of the well close) round me, like the rival wives (of one husband); cares consume me, Śatakratu, although your worshipper, as a rat (gnaws a weaver's) threads. Heaven and earth, be conscious of this (my affliction).

mantras.sanskrit: अमी ये सप्त रश्मयस्तत्रा मे नाभिरातता । त्रितस्तद्वेदाप्त्यः स जामित्वाय रेभति वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
mantras.transliteration: amī ye sapta raśmayastatrā me nābhirātatā | tritastadvedāptyaḥ sa jāmitvāya rebhati vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||

translations.english: Those which are the seven rays (of the sun), in them is my navel expanded; Trita, the son of the waters, knows that (it is so), and he praises them for his extrication (from the well). Heaven and earth, be conscious of this (my affliction).

mantras.sanskrit: अमी ये पञ्चोक्षणो मध्ये तस्थुर्महो दिवः । देवत्रा नु प्रवाच्यं सध्रीचीना नि वावृतुर्वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
mantras.transliteration: amī ye pañcokṣaṇo madhye tasthurmaho divaḥ | devatrā nu pravācyaṃ sadhrīcīnā ni vāvṛturvittaṃ me asya rodasī ||

translations.english: May the five shedders (of benefits), who abide in the centre of the expanded heavens, having together conveyed my prayers quickly to the gods, (speedily) return. Heaven and earth, be conscious of this (my affliction).

mantras.sanskrit: सुपर्णा एत आसते मध्य आरोधने दिवः । ते सेधन्ति पथो वृकं तरन्तं यह्वतीरपो वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
mantras.transliteration: suparṇā eta āsate madhya ārodhane divaḥ | te sedhanti patho vṛkaṃ tarantaṃ yahvatīrapo vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||

translations.english: The rays of the sun abide in the surrounding centre of heaven; they drive back the wolf crossing the great waters from the path. Heaven and earth, be conscious of this (my affliction).

mantras.sanskrit: नव्यं तदुक्थ्यं हितं देवासः सुप्रवाचनम् । ऋतमर्षन्ति सिन्धवः सत्यं तातान सूर्यो वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
mantras.transliteration: navyaṃ tadukthyaṃ hitaṃ devāsaḥ supravācanam | ṛtamarṣanti sindhavaḥ satyaṃ tātāna sūryo vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||

translations.english: That new praiseworthy and commended (vigour) is seated in you, ye Gods, (by which) the rivers urge on the waters, and the sun diffuses his constant (light). Heaven and earth, be conscious of this (my affliction).

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने तव त्यदुक्थ्यं देवेष्वस्त्याप्यम् । स नः सत्तो मनुष्वदा देवान्यक्षि विदुष्टरो वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne tava tyadukthyaṃ deveṣvastyāpyam | sa naḥ satto manuṣvadā devānyakṣi viduṣṭaro vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||

translations.english: Worthy of praise, Agni, is that your relationship 9with the gods), do you, who are most wise, seated at our (solemnity) worship (the gods), as (at the sacrifice of) Manu.

mantras.sanskrit: सत्तो होता मनुष्वदा देवाँ अच्छा विदुष्टरः । अग्निर्हव्या सुषूदति देवो देवेषु मेधिरो वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
mantras.transliteration: satto hotā manuṣvadā devā~ acchā viduṣṭaraḥ | agnirhavyā suṣūdati devo deveṣu medhiro vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||

translations.english: May that wise and liberal Agni, a sage amongst the gods, seated at our rite, as at the sacrifice of Manu, be the invoker of the deities, and offer them oblations. Heaven and earth, be conscious of this (my affliction).

mantras.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा कृणोति वरुणो गातुविदं तमीमहे । व्यूर्णोति हृदा मतिं नव्यो जायतामृतं वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
mantras.transliteration: brahmā kṛṇoti varuṇo gātuvidaṃ tamīmahe | vyūrṇoti hṛdā matiṃ navyo jāyatāmṛtaṃ vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||

translations.english: Varuṇa performs the rite of preservation; we desire him as guide of our way; (to him, the repeater of praise) addresses praise with his (whole) heart; may he who is entitled to laudation become our true (support). Heaven and earth, be conscious of this (my affliction).

mantras.sanskrit: असौ यः पन्था आदित्यो दिवि प्रवाच्यं कृतः । न स देवा अतिक्रमे तं मर्तासो न पश्यथ वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
mantras.transliteration: asau yaḥ panthā ādityo divi pravācyaṃ kṛtaḥ | na sa devā atikrame taṃ martāso na paśyatha vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||

translations.english: The sun, who is avowedly made the path in heaven, is not to be disregarded, Gods, by you; but you, mortals, regard him not. Heaven and earth be conscious of this (my affliction).

mantras.sanskrit: त्रितः कूपेऽवहितो देवान्हवत ऊतये । तच्छुश्राव बृहस्पतिः कृण्वन्नंहूरणादुरु वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
mantras.transliteration: tritaḥ kūpe'vahito devānhavata ūtaye | tacchuśrāva bṛhaspatiḥ kṛṇvannaṃhūraṇāduru vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||

translations.english: Trita, fallen into the well, invokes the Gods for succour; Bṛhaspati, who liberates many from sin, heard (the submission). Heaven and earth, be conscious of this (my affliction).

mantras.sanskrit: अरुणो मा सकृद्वृकः पथा यन्तं ददर्श हि । उज्जिहीते निचाय्या तष्टेव पृष्ट्यामयी वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी ॥
mantras.transliteration: aruṇo mā sakṛdvṛkaḥ pathā yantaṃ dadarśa hi | ujjihīte nicāyyā taṣṭeva pṛṣṭyāmayī vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||

translations.english: Once, a tawny wolf beheld me faring on my way, and having seen me, rushed upon me, (rearing) as a carpenter, whose back aches (with stooping, standing erect in his work).

mantras.sanskrit: एनाङ्गूषेण वयमिन्द्रवन्तोऽभि ष्याम वृजने सर्ववीराः । तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
mantras.transliteration: enāṅgūṣeṇa vayamindravanto'bhi ṣyāma vṛjane sarvavīrāḥ | tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

translations.english: By this recitation, may we, becoming possessed of Indra, and strong with multiplied progeny, overcome our foes in battle; and may Mitra, Varuṇa, Aditi---ocean, earth and heaven, be gracious to us in this (request).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रं मित्रं वरुणमग्निमूतये मारुतं शर्धो अदितिं हवामहे । रथं न दुर्गाद्वसवः सुदानवो विश्वस्मान्नो अंहसो निष्पिपर्तन ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraṃ mitraṃ varuṇamagnimūtaye mārutaṃ śardho aditiṃ havāmahe | rathaṃ na durgādvasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmānno aṃhaso niṣpipartana ||

translations.english: We invoke, for our preservation, Indra, Mitra, Varuṇa, Agni, the might of the Maruts, and Aditi; may they, who are bountiful and bestowers of dwellings, extricate us from all sin, as a chariot from a defile.

mantras.sanskrit: त आदित्या आ गता सर्वतातये भूत देवा वृत्रतूर्येषु शम्भुवः । रथं न दुर्गाद्वसवः सुदानवो विश्वस्मान्नो अंहसो निष्पिपर्तन ॥
mantras.transliteration: ta ādityā ā gatā sarvatātaye bhūta devā vṛtratūryeṣu śambhuvaḥ | rathaṃ na durgādvasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmānno aṃhaso niṣpipartana ||

translations.english: Sons of Aditi, come with all (your hosts) to battle; be to us the cause of happiness in combats, and may they, whoare bountiful and bestowers of dwellings, extricate us from all sin, as a chariot from a defile.

mantras.sanskrit: अवन्तु नः पितरः सुप्रवाचना उत देवी देवपुत्रे ऋतावृधा । रथं न दुर्गाद्वसवः सुदानवो विश्वस्मान्नो अंहसो निष्पिपर्तन ॥
mantras.transliteration: avantu naḥ pitaraḥ supravācanā uta devī devaputre ṛtāvṛdhā | rathaṃ na durgādvasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmānno aṃhaso niṣpipartana ||

translations.english: May the Pitrṣ, who are easily to be praised protect us; and may the two divinities, heaven and earth, the promoters of sacrifices, and of whom, the gods are progeny, protect us; and may they, who are bountiful and givers of dwellings, extricate us from sin, as a chariot from a defile.

mantras.sanskrit: नराशंसं वाजिनं वाजयन्निह क्षयद्वीरं पूषणं सुम्नैरीमहे । रथं न दुर्गाद्वसवः सुदानवो विश्वस्मान्नो अंहसो निष्पिपर्तन ॥
mantras.transliteration: narāśaṃsaṃ vājinaṃ vājayanniha kṣayadvīraṃ pūṣaṇaṃ sumnairīmahe | rathaṃ na durgādvasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmānno aṃhaso niṣpipartana ||

translations.english: Exciting him who is the praised of men and the giver of food, (to be present) at this rite, we solicit (also) with our praises him who is the purifier and destroyer of heroes; may they, who are bountiful and the givers of food, extricate us from sun, as a chariot from a defile

mantras.sanskrit: बृहस्पते सदमिन्नः सुगं कृधि शं योर्यत्ते मनुर्हितं तदीमहे । रथं न दुर्गाद्वसवः सुदानवो विश्वस्मान्नो अंहसो निष्पिपर्तन ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhaspate sadaminnaḥ sugaṃ kṛdhi śaṃ yoryatte manurhitaṃ tadīmahe | rathaṃ na durgādvasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmānno aṃhaso niṣpipartana ||

translations.english: Bṛhaspati, always confer happiness upon us, we solicit that faculty of both (alleviating pain and obvitaing peril) implanted in you by Manu; may they, who are bountiful and the givers of dwellings extricate us from all sins, as a chariot from a defile.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रं कुत्सो वृत्रहणं शचीपतिं काटे निबाळ्ह ऋषिरह्वदूतये । रथं न दुर्गाद्वसवः सुदानवो विश्वस्मान्नो अंहसो निष्पिपर्तन ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraṃ kutso vṛtrahaṇaṃ śacīpatiṃ kāṭe nibāḷha ṛṣirahvadūtaye | rathaṃ na durgādvasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmānno aṃhaso niṣpipartana ||

translations.english: Kutsa, the ṛṣi, thrown into a well, has invoked to his succour, Indra, the slayer of enemies, the encourager of good works; may they, who are bountiful and the givers of dwellings, extricate us from all sin, as a chariot from a defile.

mantras.sanskrit: देवैर्नो देव्यदितिर्नि पातु देवस्त्राता त्रायतामप्रयुच्छन् । तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
mantras.transliteration: devairno devyaditirni pātu devastrātā trāyatāmaprayucchan | tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

translations.english: May the goddess, Aditi, with the gods, protect us, and may the radiant guardian, (the sun), be vigilant fo rour protection; and may they, who are bountiful and the givers of dwellings, extricate us from all sin, as a chariot from a defile.

mantras.sanskrit: यज्ञो देवानां प्रत्येति सुम्नमादित्यासो भवता मृळयन्तः । आ वोऽर्वाची सुमतिर्ववृत्यादंहोश्चिद्या वरिवोवित्तरासत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajño devānāṃ pratyeti sumnamādityāso bhavatā mṛḷayantaḥ | ā vo'rvācī sumatirvavṛtyādaṃhościdyā varivovittarāsat ||

translations.english: May our sacrifice give satisfaction to the gods; Ādityas, be gracious, and may your good intentions be directed towards us, so as to be abundant source of affliction to the poor.

mantras.sanskrit: उप नो देवा अवसा गमन्त्वङ्गिरसां सामभिः स्तूयमानाः । इन्द्र इन्द्रियैर्मरुतो मरुद्भिरादित्यैर्नो अदितिः शर्म यंसत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa no devā avasā gamantvaṅgirasāṃ sāmabhiḥ stūyamānāḥ | indra indriyairmaruto marudbhirādityairno aditiḥ śarma yaṃsat ||

translations.english: May the gods, who are to be lauded by the hymns of the Aṅgirasas, come hither for our protection; may Indra with his treasures, the Maruts with the vital airs, and Aditi with the Ādityas (come and) give us felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: तन्न इन्द्रस्तद्वरुणस्तदग्निस्तदर्यमा तत्सविता चनो धात् । तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tanna indrastadvaruṇastadagnistadaryamā tatsavitā cano dhāt | tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

translations.english: May Indra, may Varuṇa, may Agni, may Aryaman, may Savitā, bestow upon us that food (which we solicit); and may Mitra, Varuṇa, Aditi--ocean, earth and heaven, preserve it (to us).

mantras.sanskrit: य इन्द्राग्नी चित्रतमो रथो वामभि विश्वानि भुवनानि चष्टे । तेना यातं सरथं तस्थिवांसाथा सोमस्य पिबतं सुतस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya indrāgnī citratamo ratho vāmabhi viśvāni bhuvanāni caṣṭe | tenā yātaṃ sarathaṃ tasthivāṃsāthā somasya pibataṃ sutasya ||

translations.english: Indra and Agni, sitting together in your car, that wonderful car which illuminates all beings, approach and drink of the effused Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: यावदिदं भुवनं विश्वमस्त्युरुव्यचा वरिमता गभीरम् । तावाँ अयं पातवे सोमो अस्त्वरमिन्द्राग्नी मनसे युवभ्याम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yāvadidaṃ bhuvanaṃ viśvamastyuruvyacā varimatā gabhīram | tāvā~ ayaṃ pātave somo astvaramindrāgnī manase yuvabhyām ||

translations.english: Vast as is the whole universe in expanse, and profound indepth, such, Indra and Agni, may this Soma be for you, sufficient for your desires.

mantras.sanskrit: चक्राथे हि सध्र्यङ्नाम भद्रं सध्रीचीना वृत्रहणा उत स्थः । ताविन्द्राग्नी सध्र्यञ्चा निषद्या वृष्णः सोमस्य वृषणा वृषेथाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: cakrāthe hi sadhryaṅnāma bhadraṃ sadhrīcīnā vṛtrahaṇā uta sthaḥ | tāvindrāgnī sadhryañcā niṣadyā vṛṣṇaḥ somasya vṛṣaṇā vṛṣethām ||

translations.english: You have made your associated names renowned, since, slayers of Vṛtra, you have been allied (for his death); the showerers of benefits, Indra and Agni, are the two seated together (on the altar); receive (your portion) of the Soma libation.

mantras.sanskrit: समिद्धेष्वग्निष्वानजाना यतस्रुचा बर्हिरु तिस्तिराणा । तीव्रैः सोमैः परिषिक्तेभिरर्वागेन्द्राग्नी सौमनसाय यातम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: samiddheṣvagniṣvānajānā yatasrucā barhiru tistirāṇā | tīvraiḥ somaiḥ pariṣiktebhirarvāgendrāgnī saumanasāya yātam ||

translations.english: The first being kindled the two (priests stand by) sprinkling the clarified butter from the ladles, which they raise, and spreading the sacred grass (upon the altar); therefore, Indra and Agni, come before us for our gratification, (attracted) by stimulating Soma sprinkled all round.

mantras.sanskrit: यानीन्द्राग्नी चक्रथुर्वीर्याणि यानि रूपाण्युत वृष्ण्यानि । या वां प्रत्नानि सख्या शिवानि तेभिः सोमस्य पिबतं सुतस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: yānīndrāgnī cakrathurvīryāṇi yāni rūpāṇyuta vṛṣṇyāni | yā vāṃ pratnāni sakhyā śivāni tebhiḥ somasya pibataṃ sutasya ||

translations.english: Whatever heroic exploits you ahve achieved whatever forms (you have created), whatever benefits (you have poured down), whatever ancient and fortunate friendships (you have contracted, come with them all), and drink of the effused Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: यदब्रवं प्रथमं वां वृणानोऽयं सोमो असुरैर्नो विहव्यः । तां सत्यां श्रद्धामभ्या हि यातमथा सोमस्य पिबतं सुतस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadabravaṃ prathamaṃ vāṃ vṛṇāno'yaṃ somo asurairno vihavyaḥ | tāṃ satyāṃ śraddhāmabhyā hi yātamathā somasya pibataṃ sutasya ||

translations.english: Come and witness the sincere faith with which, selecting you two, I first promised (you the libation); drink of the effused libation, for the Soma is prepared by the priests.

mantras.sanskrit: यदिन्द्राग्नी मदथः स्वे दुरोणे यद्ब्रह्मणि राजनि वा यजत्रा । अतः परि वृषणावा हि यातमथा सोमस्य पिबतं सुतस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadindrāgnī madathaḥ sve duroṇe yadbrahmaṇi rājani vā yajatrā | ataḥ pari vṛṣaṇāvā hi yātamathā somasya pibataṃ sutasya ||

translations.english: If, adorable Indra and Agni, you have ever been delighted (withlibations) in your own dwelling, in tha tof a Brāhmaṇa, or in that of a prince, then, showerers of benefits, come hither from wherever you may be, and drink of the effused Soma libation.

mantras.sanskrit: यदिन्द्राग्नी यदुषु तुर्वशेषु यद्द्रुह्युष्वनुषु पूरुषु स्थः । अतः परि वृषणावा हि यातमथा सोमस्य पिबतं सुतस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadindrāgnī yaduṣu turvaśeṣu yaddruhyuṣvanuṣu pūruṣu sthaḥ | ataḥ pari vṛṣaṇāvā hi yātamathā somasya pibataṃ sutasya ||

translations.english: If, Indra and Agni, you are amongst men who are in offensive, malevolent, or tyrannical, or those who live (to fulfil the duties of life), or those who receive the fruits (of good deeds), then, showerers of benefits, come hither from wherever you may be, and drink of the effused Soma libation.

mantras.sanskrit: यदिन्द्राग्नी अवमस्यां पृथिव्यां मध्यमस्यां परमस्यामुत स्थः । अतः परि वृषणावा हि यातमथा सोमस्य पिबतं सुतस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadindrāgnī avamasyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ madhyamasyāṃ paramasyāmuta sthaḥ | ataḥ pari vṛṣaṇāvā hi yātamathā somasya pibataṃ sutasya ||

translations.english: Whether, Indra and Agni, you are in the lower, the central, or the upper region of the world, showerers of benefits, come hither from wherever you may be, and drink of the effused Soma libation.

mantras.sanskrit: यदिन्द्राग्नी परमस्यां पृथिव्यां मध्यमस्यामवमस्यामुत स्थः । अतः परि वृषणावा हि यातमथा सोमस्य पिबतं सुतस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadindrāgnī paramasyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ madhyamasyāmavamasyāmuta sthaḥ | ataḥ pari vṛṣaṇāvā hi yātamathā somasya pibataṃ sutasya ||

translations.english: Whether, Indra and Agni, you are in the upper, central, or lower region of the world, come,showerers of benefits, hither from wherever you may be, and drink of the effused Soma libation.

mantras.sanskrit: यदिन्द्राग्नी दिवि ष्ठो यत्पृथिव्यां यत्पर्वतेष्वोषधीष्वप्सु । अतः परि वृषणावा हि यातमथा सोमस्य पिबतं सुतस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadindrāgnī divi ṣṭho yatpṛthivyāṃ yatparvateṣvoṣadhīṣvapsu | ataḥ pari vṛṣaṇāvā hi yātamathā somasya pibataṃ sutasya ||

translations.english: Whether, Indra and Agni, you are in heaven or upon earth, in the mountains, in the herbs, or in the waters, showerers of benefits, come hither from wherever you may be, and drink of the effused Soma libation.

mantras.sanskrit: यदिन्द्राग्नी उदिता सूर्यस्य मध्ये दिवः स्वधया मादयेथे । अतः परि वृषणावा हि यातमथा सोमस्य पिबतं सुतस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadindrāgnī uditā sūryasya madhye divaḥ svadhayā mādayethe | ataḥ pari vṛṣaṇāvā hi yātamathā somasya pibataṃ sutasya ||

translations.english: Although, Indra and Agni, in the midst of the sky, on the rising of the sun, you may be exhilarated by your own splendour, yet, showerers of benefits, come hither from wherever you maybe, and drink of the effused Soma libation.

mantras.sanskrit: एवेन्द्राग्नी पपिवांसा सुतस्य विश्वास्मभ्यं सं जयतं धनानि । तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
mantras.transliteration: evendrāgnī papivāṃsā sutasya viśvāsmabhyaṃ saṃ jayataṃ dhanāni | tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

translations.english: Thus, Indra and Agni, drinking deep of the libation, grant to us all (kinds of) wealth; and may Mitra, Varuṇa and Aditi--ocean, earth, and heaven, preserve it to us.

mantras.sanskrit: वि ह्यख्यं मनसा वस्य इच्छन्निन्द्राग्नी ज्ञास उत वा सजातान् । नान्या युवत्प्रमतिरस्ति मह्यं स वां धियं वाजयन्तीमतक्षम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi hyakhyaṃ manasā vasya icchannindrāgnī jñāsa uta vā sajātān | nānyā yuvatpramatirasti mahyaṃ sa vāṃ dhiyaṃ vājayantīmatakṣam ||

translations.english: Indra and Agni, desirous of wealth, I consider you, in my mind, as kinsmen and relations; the clear understanding you have given me, (is given) by no one else, and (so gifted), I have composed this hymn to you, intimating my wish for sustenance.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्रवं हि भूरिदावत्तरा वां विजामातुरुत वा घा स्यालात् । अथा सोमस्य प्रयती युवभ्यामिन्द्राग्नी स्तोमं जनयामि नव्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśravaṃ hi bhūridāvattarā vāṃ vijāmāturuta vā ghā syālāt | athā somasya prayatī yuvabhyāmindrāgnī stomaṃ janayāmi navyam ||

translations.english: I have heard, Indra and Agni, that you are more munificent givers than an unworthy bridegroom, or the brother of a bride; therefore, as I offer you a Soma libation, I address you, Indra and Agni, with a new hymn.

mantras.sanskrit: मा च्छेद्म रश्मीँरिति नाधमानाः पितॄणां शक्तीरनुयच्छमानाः । इन्द्राग्निभ्यां कं वृषणो मदन्ति ता ह्यद्री धिषणाया उपस्थे ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā cchedma raśmī~riti nādhamānāḥ pitṝṇāṃ śaktīranuyacchamānāḥ | indrāgnibhyāṃ kaṃ vṛṣaṇo madanti tā hyadrī dhiṣaṇāyā upasthe ||

translations.english: Never may we cut off the long line (of posterity); thus soliciting and asking for descendants endowed with the vigour of their progenitors, the (worshippers), begetting children, praise Indra and Agni for their happiness, and they two, destroyers of foes, are nigh (to hear this adoration).

mantras.sanskrit: युवाभ्यां देवी धिषणा मदायेन्द्राग्नी सोममुशती सुनोति । तावश्विना भद्रहस्ता सुपाणी आ धावतं मधुना पृङ्क्तमप्सु ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvābhyāṃ devī dhiṣaṇā madāyendrāgnī somamuśatī sunoti | tāvaśvinā bhadrahastā supāṇī ā dhāvataṃ madhunā pṛṅktamapsu ||

translations.english: The sacred prayer, desiring your presence, offers to you both, Indra and Agni, for your exhilaration, the Soma libation; do you two, who have horses, handsome arms, and graceful hands, come quickly and mix (the libation) with sweetness in the waters.

mantras.sanskrit: युवामिन्द्राग्नी वसुनो विभागे तवस्तमा शुश्रव वृत्रहत्ये । तावासद्या बर्हिषि यज्ञे अस्मिन्प्र चर्षणी मादयेथां सुतस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvāmindrāgnī vasuno vibhāge tavastamā śuśrava vṛtrahatye | tāvāsadyā barhiṣi yajñe asminpra carṣaṇī mādayethāṃ sutasya ||

translations.english: I have heard, (when you were present) at the division of the treasure (among the worshippers), that you two, Indra and Agni, were most vigorous in the destruction of Vṛtra; beholders of all things seated at this sacrifice upon the sacred grass, be exhilarated, (by drinking of the effused libation).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र चर्षणिभ्यः पृतनाहवेषु प्र पृथिव्या रिरिचाथे दिवश्च । प्र सिन्धुभ्यः प्र गिरिभ्यो महित्वा प्रेन्द्राग्नी विश्वा भुवनात्यन्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra carṣaṇibhyaḥ pṛtanāhaveṣu pra pṛthivyā riricāthe divaśca | pra sindhubhyaḥ pra giribhyo mahitvā prendrāgnī viśvā bhuvanātyanyā ||

translations.english: Attending to the summons at the time of battle, you surpass all me (in magnitude); you are vaster than the earth, than the sky, than the rivers, than the mountains; you exceed all other existent things.

mantras.sanskrit: आ भरतं शिक्षतं वज्रबाहू अस्माँ इन्द्राग्नी अवतं शचीभिः । इमे नु ते रश्मयः सूर्यस्य येभिः सपित्वं पितरो न आसन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā bharataṃ śikṣataṃ vajrabāhū asmā~ indrāgnī avataṃ śacībhiḥ | ime nu te raśmayaḥ sūryasya yebhiḥ sapitvaṃ pitaro na āsan ||

translations.english: Bring wealth, thunderers, and give it to us; protect us, Indra and Agni, by your deeds; may those rays of the sun, by which our forefathers have attained together a hevenly region, shine also upon us.

mantras.sanskrit: पुरंदरा शिक्षतं वज्रहस्तास्माँ इन्द्राग्नी अवतं भरेषु । तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
mantras.transliteration: puraṃdarā śikṣataṃ vajrahastāsmā~ indrāgnī avataṃ bhareṣu | tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

translations.english: Indra and Agni, wielders of the thunderbolt, overturners of cities, grant us wealth, defens us in battles; and may Mitra, Varuṇa, Aditi--ocean, earth and heaven, be propitious to this (our prayer).

mantras.sanskrit: ततं मे अपस्तदु तायते पुनः स्वादिष्ठा धीतिरुचथाय शस्यते । अयं समुद्र इह विश्वदेव्यः स्वाहाकृतस्य समु तृप्णुत ऋभवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tataṃ me apastadu tāyate punaḥ svādiṣṭhā dhītirucathāya śasyate | ayaṃ samudra iha viśvadevyaḥ svāhākṛtasya samu tṛpṇuta ṛbhavaḥ ||

translations.english: Ṛbhus, the rite formerly celebrated by me is again repeated, and the melodious hymn is recited in your praise; in this ceremony, the Soma is sufficient for all the gods; drink of it to your utmost content when offered on the fire.

mantras.sanskrit: आभोगयं प्र यदिच्छन्त ऐतनापाकाः प्राञ्चो मम के चिदापयः । सौधन्वनासश्चरितस्य भूमनागच्छत सवितुर्दाशुषो गृहम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ābhogayaṃ pra yadicchanta aitanāpākāḥ prāñco mama ke cidāpayaḥ | saudhanvanāsaścaritasya bhūmanāgacchata saviturdāśuṣo gṛham ||

translations.english: When, Ṛbhus, you who are amongst my ancestors, yet immature (in wisdom), but desirous of enjoying (the Soma libations), retired to the forest to perform (penance), then, sons of Sudhanvan, throught he plural nitude of your completed (devotions), you came to the (sacrificial) hall of the worshipper Savitā.

mantras.sanskrit: तत्सविता वोऽमृतत्वमासुवदगोह्यं यच्छ्रवयन्त ऐतन । त्यं चिच्चमसमसुरस्य भक्षणमेकं सन्तमकृणुता चतुर्वयम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tatsavitā vo'mṛtatvamāsuvadagohyaṃ yacchravayanta aitana | tyaṃ ciccamasamasurasya bhakṣaṇamekaṃ santamakṛṇutā caturvayam ||

translations.english: Then Savitā bestowed upon you immortality, when you came to him, who is not to be concealed, and representd (your desire) to partake of the libations; and that ladle for the sacrificial viands which the Asura had formed single, you made fourfold.

mantras.sanskrit: विष्ट्वी शमी तरणित्वेन वाघतो मर्तासः सन्तो अमृतत्वमानशुः । सौधन्वना ऋभवः सूरचक्षसः संवत्सरे समपृच्यन्त धीतिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viṣṭvī śamī taraṇitvena vāghato martāsaḥ santo amṛtatvamānaśuḥ | saudhanvanā ṛbhavaḥ sūracakṣasaḥ saṃvatsare samapṛcyanta dhītibhiḥ ||

translations.english: Associated with the priests, and quickly performing the holy rites, they, being yet mortals, acquired immortality and the son of Sudhanvan, the Ṛbhus, brilliant as the sun, became connected with the ceremonies (appropriated to the different season) of the year.

mantras.sanskrit: क्षेत्रमिव वि ममुस्तेजनेनँ एकं पात्रमृभवो जेहमानम् । उपस्तुता उपमं नाधमाना अमर्त्येषु श्रव इच्छमानाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kṣetramiva vi mamustejanena~ ekaṃ pātramṛbhavo jehamānam | upastutā upamaṃ nādhamānā amartyeṣu śrava icchamānāḥ ||

translations.english: Lauded by the bystanders, the Ṛbhus, with a sharp weapon, meted outt the single sacrificial ladle, like a field (measured by a rod), soliciting the best (libations) and desiring (to participate of) sacrificial food amongs thte gods.

mantras.sanskrit: आ मनीषामन्तरिक्षस्य नृभ्यः स्रुचेव घृतं जुहवाम विद्मना । तरणित्वा ये पितुरस्य सश्चिर ऋभवो वाजमरुहन्दिवो रजः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā manīṣāmantarikṣasya nṛbhyaḥ sruceva ghṛtaṃ juhavāma vidmanā | taraṇitvā ye piturasya saścira ṛbhavo vājamaruhandivo rajaḥ ||

translations.english: To the leaders (of the sacrifice), dwelling in the firmament, we present, as with a ladle, the appointed clarified butter, and praise with knowledge those Ṛbhus, who, having equalled the velocityof the protector (of the universe, the sun), ascended to the region of heaven, through (the offerings) of (sacrificial) food.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋभुर्न इन्द्रः शवसा नवीयानृभुर्वाजेभिर्वसुभिर्वसुर्ददिः । युष्माकं देवा अवसाहनि प्रियेऽभि तिष्ठेम पृत्सुतीरसुन्वताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛbhurna indraḥ śavasā navīyānṛbhurvājebhirvasubhirvasurdadiḥ | yuṣmākaṃ devā avasāhani priye'bhi tiṣṭhema pṛtsutīrasunvatām ||

translations.english: The most excellent Ṛbhu is in strength our defender; Ṛbhu, through gifts of food and of wealth, is our asylum; may he bestow them upon us, Gods, through your protection; may we, upon a favourable occasion, overcome the hosts of those who offer no libations.

mantras.sanskrit: निश्चर्मण ऋभवो गामपिंशत सं वत्सेनासृजता मातरं पुनः । सौधन्वनासः स्वपस्यया नरो जिव्री युवाना पितराकृणोतन ॥
mantras.transliteration: niścarmaṇa ṛbhavo gāmapiṃśata saṃ vatsenāsṛjatā mātaraṃ punaḥ | saudhanvanāsaḥ svapasyayā naro jivrī yuvānā pitarākṛṇotana ||

translations.english: Ṛbhus, you covered the cow with a hide, and reunited themother with the calf; sons of Sudhanvan, leaders (of sacrifice), through your good works you rendered your aged parents young.

mantras.sanskrit: वाजेभिर्नो वाजसातावविड्ढ्यृभुमाँ इन्द्र चित्रमा दर्षि राधः । तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vājebhirno vājasātāvaviḍḍhyṛbhumā~ indra citramā darṣi rādhaḥ | tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, associated with the Ṛbhus, supply us, in the distribution of viands, with food, and consent to bestow upon us wonderful riches; and may Mitra, Varuṇa, Aditi--ocean, earth, and heaven, preserve them fo rus.

mantras.sanskrit: तक्षन्रथं सुवृतं विद्मनापसस्तक्षन्हरी इन्द्रवाहा वृषण्वसू । तक्षन्पितृभ्यामृभवो युवद्वयस्तक्षन्वत्साय मातरं सचाभुवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: takṣanrathaṃ suvṛtaṃ vidmanāpasastakṣanharī indravāhā vṛṣaṇvasū | takṣanpitṛbhyāmṛbhavo yuvadvayastakṣanvatsāya mātaraṃ sacābhuvam ||

translations.english: The Ṛbhus, possessed of skill in their work, constructed (for the Aśvins) a well-built car; they framed the vigorous horses bearing Indra; they gave youthful existence to their parents; they gave to the calf its accompanying mother.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो यज्ञाय तक्षत ऋभुमद्वयः क्रत्वे दक्षाय सुप्रजावतीमिषम् । यथा क्षयाम सर्ववीरया विशा तन्नः शर्धाय धासथा स्विन्द्रियम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no yajñāya takṣata ṛbhumadvayaḥ kratve dakṣāya suprajāvatīmiṣam | yathā kṣayāma sarvavīrayā viśā tannaḥ śardhāya dhāsathā svindriyam ||

translations.english: Prepare fully for our sacrifice resplendent sacrificial food, and for our rite and for our strength, such nutriments as may be the cause of excellent progeny, so that we may live (surrounded) by vigorous descendants, such wealth do you confer upon us for our benefit.

mantras.sanskrit: आ तक्षत सातिमस्मभ्यमृभवः सातिं रथाय सातिमर्वते नरः । सातिं नो जैत्रीं सं महेत विश्वहा जामिमजामिं पृतनासु सक्षणिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā takṣata sātimasmabhyamṛbhavaḥ sātiṃ rathāya sātimarvate naraḥ | sātiṃ no jaitrīṃ saṃ maheta viśvahā jāmimajāmiṃ pṛtanāsu sakṣaṇim ||

translations.english: Ṛbhus conductors (of sacrifice), bestow ample sustenance upon us, upon our chariots, upon our horses; let every one daily acknowledge our victorious wealth, and may we triumph in battle over our foes; whether strangers or kinsmen.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋभुक्षणमिन्द्रमा हुव ऊतय ऋभून्वाजान्मरुतः सोमपीतये । उभा मित्रावरुणा नूनमश्विना ते नो हिन्वन्तु सातये धिये जिषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛbhukṣaṇamindramā huva ūtaya ṛbhūnvājānmarutaḥ somapītaye | ubhā mitrāvaruṇā nūnamaśvinā te no hinvantu sātaye dhiye jiṣe ||

translations.english: I invoke the mighty Indra for protection, and the Ṛbhu, Vājas and Maruts to drink the Soma, also both Mitra, Varuṇa and the Aśvins; and may they direct us to opulence, to holy rites, and to victory.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋभुर्भराय सं शिशातु सातिं समर्यजिद्वाजो अस्माँ अविष्टु । तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛbhurbharāya saṃ śiśātu sātiṃ samaryajidvājo asmā~ aviṣṭu | tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

translations.english: May Ṛbhu supply us with wealth for war; may Vāja, victorious in battle, protect us, and may Mitra, Varuṇa, Aditi--ocean, earth, and heaven, be propitious ot this our prayer.

mantras.sanskrit: ईळे द्यावापृथिवी पूर्वचित्तयेऽग्निं घर्मं सुरुचं यामन्निष्टये । याभिर्भरे कारमंशाय जिन्वथस्ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: īḷe dyāvāpṛthivī pūrvacittaye'gniṃ gharmaṃ surucaṃ yāmanniṣṭaye | yābhirbhare kāramaṃśāya jinvathastābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||

translations.english: I praise Heaven and Earth for preliminary meditation, (prior to the coming of the Aśvins); I praise the hot and bright-shining Agni upon their approach, (as preparatory) to their worship; with those appliances with which you sound the conch-shell in battle for your share (in the booty), with those aids, Aśvins, come willingly hither.

mantras.sanskrit: युवोर्दानाय सुभरा असश्चतो रथमा तस्थुर्वचसं न मन्तवे । याभिर्धियोऽवथः कर्मन्निष्टये ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvordānāya subharā asaścato rathamā tasthurvacasaṃ na mantave | yābhirdhiyo'vathaḥ karmanniṣṭaye tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||

translations.english: Earnest and exclusive adorers stand, Aśvins, round your car, (to benefit) by your bounty, as (disciples listen) to the words (of a teacher) for instrumental uction; with those aids with which you defend the pious who are engaged in acts of worship, come, Aśvins,wilingly hither.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं तासां दिव्यस्य प्रशासने विशां क्षयथो अमृतस्य मज्मना । याभिर्धेनुमस्वं पिन्वथो नरा ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ tāsāṃ divyasya praśāsane viśāṃ kṣayatho amṛtasya majmanā | yābhirdhenumasvaṃ pinvatho narā tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||

translations.english: By the vigour infused from celestial nectar, you are able, leaders (of sacrifice), to rule over those beings (who people the three worldds); with those aids by which you gave (milk) to the barren cow, come, Aśvins, willingly hither.

mantras.sanskrit: याभिः परिज्मा तनयस्य मज्मना द्विमाता तूर्षु तरणिर्विभूषति । याभिस्त्रिमन्तुरभवद्विचक्षणस्ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yābhiḥ parijmā tanayasya majmanā dvimātā tūrṣu taraṇirvibhūṣati | yābhistrimanturabhavadvicakṣaṇastābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||

translations.english: With those aids by which the circumambient (wind), endowed with the vigour of his son, the measurer of the two worlds (of heaven and earth), and swiftest of the swift, beautifies (all things), and by which (Kakṣīvat) became learned in the three kinds of sacrifice; with them come, Aśvins, willingly hither.

mantras.sanskrit: याभी रेभं निवृतं सितमद्भ्य उद्वन्दनमैरयतं स्वर्दृशे । याभिः कण्वं प्र सिषासन्तमावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yābhī rebhaṃ nivṛtaṃ sitamadbhya udvandanamairayataṃ svardṛśe | yābhiḥ kaṇvaṃ pra siṣāsantamāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||

translations.english: With those aids by which you raised up from the water, Rebha, who had been cst bound (into a well), and also Vandana (similarly circumstanced), to behold the sky; by which you protected Kaṇva, when longing to see the light; with them, Aśvins, come willingly hither.

mantras.sanskrit: याभिरन्तकं जसमानमारणे भुज्युं याभिरव्यथिभिर्जिजिन्वथुः । याभिः कर्कन्धुं वय्यं च जिन्वथस्ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yābhirantakaṃ jasamānamāraṇe bhujyuṃ yābhiravyathibhirjijinvathuḥ | yābhiḥ karkandhuṃ vayyaṃ ca jinvathastābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||

translations.english: With those aids by which you rescued Antaka, (when cast into) a deep (pool), and about to be destroyed; by which, inflicting no distress, you preserved Bhujyu, and by which you relieved Karkandhu and Vayya; with them, Aśvins, come willingly hither.

mantras.sanskrit: याभिः शुचन्तिं धनसां सुषंसदं तप्तं घर्ममोम्यावन्तमत्रये । याभिः पृश्निगुं पुरुकुत्समावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yābhiḥ śucantiṃ dhanasāṃ suṣaṃsadaṃ taptaṃ gharmamomyāvantamatraye | yābhiḥ pṛśniguṃ purukutsamāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||

translations.english: With those aids by which you enriched Śucanti, and gave him a handsome habitation, and rendered the scorching heat plural asurable to Atri, and by which you preserved Pṛśnigu and Purukutsa; with them, Aśvins, come willingly hither.

mantras.sanskrit: याभिः शचीभिर्वृषणा परावृजं प्रान्धं श्रोणं चक्षस एतवे कृथः । याभिर्वर्तिकां ग्रसिताममुञ्चतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yābhiḥ śacībhirvṛṣaṇā parāvṛjaṃ prāndhaṃ śroṇaṃ cakṣasa etave kṛthaḥ | yābhirvartikāṃ grasitāmamuñcataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||

translations.english: Showerers (of benefits), with those aids by which you enabled (the lame) Parāvṛj (to walk), the blind (Ṛjraśva) to see, and (the cripple) Śroṇa to go, and by which you set free the quail when seized (by a wolf); with those aids, Aśvins, come willingly hither.

mantras.sanskrit: याभिः सिन्धुं मधुमन्तमसश्चतं वसिष्ठं याभिरजरावजिन्वतम् । याभिः कुत्सं श्रुतर्यं नर्यमावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yābhiḥ sindhuṃ madhumantamasaścataṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ yābhirajarāvajinvatam | yābhiḥ kutsaṃ śrutaryaṃ naryamāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||

translations.english: With those aids by which you caused the sweet stream to flow, by which you, who are exempt from decay, gratified Vāsiṣṭha, and by which you protected (ṛṣis:) Kutsa, Śrutarya, and Narya; with them, Aśvins, come willingly hitheṛ

mantras.sanskrit: याभिर्विश्पलां धनसामथर्व्यं सहस्रमीळ्ह आजावजिन्वतम् । याभिर्वशमश्व्यं प्रेणिमावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yābhirviśpalāṃ dhanasāmatharvyaṃ sahasramīḷha ājāvajinvatam | yābhirvaśamaśvyaṃ preṇimāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||

translations.english: With those aids by which you enabled the opulent Viśpalā, when she was unable to move, to go to the battle rich in a thousand spoils, and by which you protected the devout Vaśa, the son of Aśva; with them, Aśvins, come willingly hither.

mantras.sanskrit: याभिः सुदानू औशिजाय वणिजे दीर्घश्रवसे मधु कोशो अक्षरत् । कक्षीवन्तं स्तोतारं याभिरावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yābhiḥ sudānū auśijāya vaṇije dīrghaśravase madhu kośo akṣarat | kakṣīvantaṃ stotāraṃ yābhirāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||

translations.english: With those aids by which, beauteous donors, the cloud (was made to) shed its sweet (water), for the sake of the merchant Dīrghaśravas, the son of Uṣij, and by which you protected the devout Kakṣīvat; with them, Aśvins, come willingly hither.

mantras.sanskrit: याभी रसां क्षोदसोद्नः पिपिन्वथुरनश्वं याभी रथमावतं जिषे । याभिस्त्रिशोक उस्रिया उदाजत ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yābhī rasāṃ kṣodasodnaḥ pipinvathuranaśvaṃ yābhī rathamāvataṃ jiṣe | yābhistriśoka usriyā udājata tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||

translations.english: With those aids by which you filled the (dry) river-bed

mantras.sanskrit: याभिः सूर्यं परियाथः परावति मन्धातारं क्षैत्रपत्येष्वावतम् । याभिर्विप्रं प्र भरद्वाजमावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yābhiḥ sūryaṃ pariyāthaḥ parāvati mandhātāraṃ kṣaitrapatyeṣvāvatam | yābhirvipraṃ pra bharadvājamāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||

translations.english: With those aids by which you encompassed the sun, when afar off, (to extricate him from eclipse); by which you defended Mandhātā in (the discharge of) his soverign functions, and by whciḥ you protected the sage Bharadvāja; with them, Aśvins, come willingly hither.

mantras.sanskrit: याभिर्महामतिथिग्वं कशोजुवं दिवोदासं शम्बरहत्य आवतम् । याभिः पूर्भिद्ये त्रसदस्युमावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yābhirmahāmatithigvaṃ kaśojuvaṃ divodāsaṃ śambarahatya āvatam | yābhiḥ pūrbhidye trasadasyumāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||

translations.english: With those aids by which you defended the mighty and hospitable Divodāsa, (when, having undertaken) the death of Śambara, he hid himself in the water (through fear of the asuras); by which you protected Trasadasyu in war; with them, Aśvins, come willingly hither.

mantras.sanskrit: याभिर्वम्रं विपिपानमुपस्तुतं कलिं याभिर्वित्तजानिं दुवस्यथः । याभिर्व्यश्वमुत पृथिमावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yābhirvamraṃ vipipānamupastutaṃ kaliṃ yābhirvittajāniṃ duvasyathaḥ | yābhirvyaśvamuta pṛthimāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||

translations.english: With those aids by which you preserved Vamra, praised by all around him, when drinking (the dews of the earth); by which you protected Kali when he had taken a wife, and Pṛthi,when had lost his horse; with them, Aśvins, come willingly hither.

mantras.sanskrit: याभिर्नरा शयवे याभिरत्रये याभिः पुरा मनवे गातुमीषथुः । याभिः शारीराजतं स्यूमरश्मये ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yābhirnarā śayave yābhiratraye yābhiḥ purā manave gātumīṣathuḥ | yābhiḥ śārīrājataṃ syūmaraśmaye tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||

translations.english: With those aids, leaders (of sacrifices), which you afforded to Śayu, to Atri, and formerly to Manu, anxious (to show them) the way (to escape from evil); with those by which you shot arrows (upon the foes) of Syūmaraśmi; with them, Aśvis, willingly come hither.

mantras.sanskrit: याभिः पठर्वा जठरस्य मज्मनाग्निर्नादीदेच्चित इद्धो अज्मन्ना । याभिः शर्यातमवथो महाधने ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yābhiḥ paṭharvā jaṭharasya majmanāgnirnādīdeccita iddho ajmannā | yābhiḥ śaryātamavatho mahādhane tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||

translations.english: WIth those aids by which Paddarvan shone with with strngth of orm in battle, like a blazing fire piled up (with fuel); by which you defended Śaryāta in war; with them, Aśvins, come willingly hither.

mantras.sanskrit: याभिरङ्गिरो मनसा निरण्यथोऽग्रं गच्छथो विवरे गोअर्णसः । याभिर्मनुं शूरमिषा समावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yābhiraṅgiro manasā niraṇyatho'graṃ gacchatho vivare goarṇasaḥ | yābhirmanuṃ śūramiṣā samāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||

translations.english: Aṅgiras, (prise the Aśvins); Aśvins, with those aids by which, with (gratified) minds, you delight (in praise), and thence preceded the gods to the cavern, to recover the stolen cattle; by which you sustained the heroic Manu with food; with them, Aśvins, come willingly hither.

mantras.sanskrit: याभिः पत्नीर्विमदाय न्यूहथुरा घ वा याभिररुणीरशिक्षतम् । याभिः सुदास ऊहथुः सुदेव्यं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yābhiḥ patnīrvimadāya nyūhathurā gha vā yābhiraruṇīraśikṣatam | yābhiḥ sudāsa ūhathuḥ sudevyaṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||

translations.english: With those aids by which you gave a wife to Vimada, by which you recovered the ruddy kine, by which you conferred excellent wealth upon Sudās; with them, Aśvins, come willingly hither.

mantras.sanskrit: याभिः शंताती भवथो ददाशुषे भुज्युं याभिरवथो याभिरध्रिगुम् । ओम्यावतीं सुभरामृतस्तुभं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yābhiḥ śaṃtātī bhavatho dadāśuṣe bhujyuṃ yābhiravatho yābhiradhrigum | omyāvatīṃ subharāmṛtastubhaṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||

translations.english: With those aids by which you are bestowers of happiness upon the donor (of oblations), by which you have protected Bhujyu and Adhrigu, and by which you have granted delighting and nourishing (food) to Ritastubh; with them. Aśvins, come willingly hither.

mantras.sanskrit: याभिः कृशानुमसने दुवस्यथो जवे याभिर्यूनो अर्वन्तमावतम् । मधु प्रियं भरथो यत्सरड्भ्यस्ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yābhiḥ kṛśānumasane duvasyatho jave yābhiryūno arvantamāvatam | madhu priyaṃ bharatho yatsaraḍbhyastābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||

translations.english: With those aids by which you defended Kṛśānu in battle, with which you succoured the horse of the young Purukutsa in speed, and by which you deliver the plural asant honey to the bees; with them, Aśvins, come willingly hither.

mantras.sanskrit: याभिर्नरं गोषुयुधं नृषाह्ये क्षेत्रस्य साता तनयस्य जिन्वथः । याभी रथाँ अवथो याभिरर्वतस्ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yābhirnaraṃ goṣuyudhaṃ nṛṣāhye kṣetrasya sātā tanayasya jinvathaḥ | yābhī rathā~ avatho yābhirarvatastābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||

translations.english: With those aids by which you succoured the worshipper contending in war for cattle, by which you assist him in the acquisition of houses and wealth, by which you preserve his chariots and horses; with them, Aśvins, come willingly hitheṛ

mantras.sanskrit: याभिः कुत्समार्जुनेयं शतक्रतू प्र तुर्वीतिं प्र च दभीतिमावतम् । याभिर्ध्वसन्तिं पुरुषन्तिमावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yābhiḥ kutsamārjuneyaṃ śatakratū pra turvītiṃ pra ca dabhītimāvatam | yābhirdhvasantiṃ puruṣantimāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||

translations.english: With those aids by which you, who are worshipped in many rites, protected Kutsa, the son of Arjuna, as well as Turviti, Dhabhiti, Dhvasant, and Puruśanti; with them, Aśvins, come willingly hither.

mantras.sanskrit: अप्नस्वतीमश्विना वाचमस्मे कृतं नो दस्रा वृषणा मनीषाम् । अद्यूत्येऽवसे नि ह्वये वां वृधे च नो भवतं वाजसातौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: apnasvatīmaśvinā vācamasme kṛtaṃ no dasrā vṛṣaṇā manīṣām | adyūtye'vase ni hvaye vāṃ vṛdhe ca no bhavataṃ vājasātau ||

translations.english: Aśvins, sanctify our words with works; showerers (of benefits), subduers of foes (invigorate) our understandin g(for the sacred study); we invoke you both, in the last watch of the night, for our preservation; be to us for increase in the provision of food.

mantras.sanskrit: द्युभिरक्तुभिः परि पातमस्मानरिष्टेभिरश्विना सौभगेभिः । तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dyubhiraktubhiḥ pari pātamasmānariṣṭebhiraśvinā saubhagebhiḥ | tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

translations.english: Cherish us, Aśvins, always, by night or day, with undiminished blessings; and may Mitra, Varuṇa, Aditi--ocean, earth and heaven, be favourable to this our (prayer).

mantras.sanskrit: इदं श्रेष्ठं ज्योतिषां ज्योतिरागाच्चित्रः प्रकेतो अजनिष्ट विभ्वा । यथा प्रसूता सवितुः सवायँ एवा रात्र्युषसे योनिमारैक् ॥
mantras.transliteration: idaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotirāgāccitraḥ praketo ajaniṣṭa vibhvā | yathā prasūtā savituḥ savāya~ evā rātryuṣase yonimāraik ||

translations.english: This most excellent luminary of all luminaries has arrived; the wonderful and diffusive manifester (of all things) has been born; in like manner as night is the offspring of the sun, so she becomes the birth-plural ce of the dawn.

mantras.sanskrit: रुशद्वत्सा रुशती श्वेत्यागादारैगु कृष्णा सदनान्यस्याः । समानबन्धू अमृते अनूची द्यावा वर्णं चरत आमिनाने ॥
mantras.transliteration: ruśadvatsā ruśatī śvetyāgādāraigu kṛṣṇā sadanānyasyāḥ | samānabandhū amṛte anūcī dyāvā varṇaṃ carata āmināne ||

translations.english: The white-shining dawn, the parent of the sun, has arrived; dark night has sought her own abode; both allied to the same (sun), immortal, succeeding to each other, and mutually effacing each other's complexion, they traverse the heavens.

mantras.sanskrit: समानो अध्वा स्वस्रोरनन्तस्तमन्यान्या चरतो देवशिष्टे । न मेथेते न तस्थतुः सुमेके नक्तोषासा समनसा विरूपे ॥
mantras.transliteration: samāno adhvā svasroranantastamanyānyā carato devaśiṣṭe | na methete na tasthatuḥ sumeke naktoṣāsā samanasā virūpe ||

translations.english: The path of the sisters is unending; they travel it alternately, guided by the radiant (sun); combined in purpose, though of different forms, night and dawn, giving birth (to all things), obstruct not eachother, neither do they stand still.

mantras.sanskrit: भास्वती नेत्री सूनृतानामचेति चित्रा वि दुरो न आवः । प्रार्प्या जगद्व्यु नो रायो अख्यदुषा अजीगर्भुवनानि विश्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhāsvatī netrī sūnṛtānāmaceti citrā vi duro na āvaḥ | prārpyā jagadvyu no rāyo akhyaduṣā ajīgarbhuvanāni viśvā ||

translations.english: Brilliant guide of the speakers of truth, the many-tinted dawn, is recognized by us; she has opened our doors; having illuminated the world, she has made our riches manifest. Uṣās gives back all the regions (that had been swallowed up by night).

mantras.sanskrit: जिह्मश्ये चरितवे मघोन्याभोगय इष्टये राय उ त्वम् । दभ्रं पश्यद्भ्य उर्विया विचक्ष उषा अजीगर्भुवनानि विश्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: jihmaśye caritave maghonyābhogaya iṣṭaye rāya u tvam | dabhraṃ paśyadbhya urviyā vicakṣa uṣā ajīgarbhuvanāni viśvā ||

translations.english: The opulent (dawn) arouses to exertion the man bowed down in sleep--one man to enjoyments, another to devotion, another to (the acquisition of) wealth; she has enabled those who were almost sightless to see distinctly. The expansive Uṣas has given back all the regions.

mantras.sanskrit: क्षत्राय त्वं श्रवसे त्वं महीया इष्टये त्वमर्थमिव त्वमित्यै । विसदृशा जीविताभिप्रचक्ष उषा अजीगर्भुवनानि विश्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: kṣatrāya tvaṃ śravase tvaṃ mahīyā iṣṭaye tvamarthamiva tvamityai | visadṛśā jīvitābhipracakṣa uṣā ajīgarbhuvanāni viśvā ||

translations.english: The dawn rouses one man to acquire wealth, another to earn food, another to achieve greatness, another to sacrifices, another to his own (pursuits), another to activity, and lights all men to their various means of maintaining life. Uṣās has given back all the regions.

mantras.sanskrit: एषा दिवो दुहिता प्रत्यदर्शि व्युच्छन्ती युवतिः शुक्रवासाः । विश्वस्येशाना पार्थिवस्य वस्व उषो अद्येह सुभगे व्युच्छ ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣā divo duhitā pratyadarśi vyucchantī yuvatiḥ śukravāsāḥ | viśvasyeśānā pārthivasya vasva uṣo adyeha subhage vyuccha ||

translations.english: The daughter of heaven, young, white-robed, the mistress of all earthly treasure, is beheld dissipating the darkness. Auspicious Uṣās,shine upon us today in this (hall of sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: परायतीनामन्वेति पाथ आयतीनां प्रथमा शश्वतीनाम् । व्युच्छन्ती जीवमुदीरयन्त्युषा मृतं कं चन बोधयन्ती ॥
mantras.transliteration: parāyatīnāmanveti pātha āyatīnāṃ prathamā śaśvatīnām | vyucchantī jīvamudīrayantyuṣā mṛtaṃ kaṃ cana bodhayantī ||

translations.english: Following the path

mantras.sanskrit: उषो यदग्निं समिधे चकर्थ वि यदावश्चक्षसा सूर्यस्य । यन्मानुषान्यक्ष्यमाणाँ अजीगस्तद्देवेषु चकृषे भद्रमप्नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uṣo yadagniṃ samidhe cakartha vi yadāvaścakṣasā sūryasya | yanmānuṣānyakṣyamāṇā~ ajīgastaddeveṣu cakṛṣe bhadramapnaḥ ||

translations.english: Uṣās, inasmuch as you have caused the sacred fire to be kindled, inasmuch as you have lighted the world with the light of the sun, inasmuch as you have wakened men to perform sacrifice, you have done good service to the godṣ

mantras.sanskrit: कियात्या यत्समया भवाति या व्यूषुर्याश्च नूनं व्युच्छान् । अनु पूर्वाः कृपते वावशाना प्रदीध्याना जोषमन्याभिरेति ॥
mantras.transliteration: kiyātyā yatsamayā bhavāti yā vyūṣuryāśca nūnaṃ vyucchān | anu pūrvāḥ kṛpate vāvaśānā pradīdhyānā joṣamanyābhireti ||

translations.english: For how long a period is it that the dawns have risen? for how long a period will they rise? still desirous to bring us light, Uṣās pursues the functions of those that have gone before, and, shining brightly, proceeds with the others (that are to follow).

mantras.sanskrit: ईयुष्टे ये पूर्वतरामपश्यन्व्युच्छन्तीमुषसं मर्त्यासः । अस्माभिरू नु प्रतिचक्ष्याभूदो ते यन्ति ये अपरीषु पश्यान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: īyuṣṭe ye pūrvatarāmapaśyanvyucchantīmuṣasaṃ martyāsaḥ | asmābhirū nu praticakṣyābhūdo te yanti ye aparīṣu paśyān ||

translations.english: Those mortals who beheld the pristine Uṣās dawning have passed away; to us she is now visible, and they approach who may behold her in after times.

mantras.sanskrit: यावयद्द्वेषा ऋतपा ऋतेजाः सुम्नावरी सूनृता ईरयन्ती । सुमङ्गलीर्बिभ्रती देववीतिमिहाद्योषः श्रेष्ठतमा व्युच्छ ॥
mantras.transliteration: yāvayaddveṣā ṛtapā ṛtejāḥ sumnāvarī sūnṛtā īrayantī | sumaṅgalīrbibhratī devavītimihādyoṣaḥ śreṣṭhatamā vyuccha ||

translations.english: The beings hostile (to acts of devotion) now withdraw, for she is the protectress of sacred rites, who is manifested for their performance; she is the giver of happiness, the awakener of plural asant voices, the enjoyer of felicity, and provider of food for the gods; most excellent Uṣās dawn today on this (sacrificial hall).

mantras.sanskrit: शश्वत्पुरोषा व्युवास देव्यथो अद्येदं व्यावो मघोनी । अथो व्युच्छादुत्तराँ अनु द्यूनजरामृता चरति स्वधाभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaśvatpuroṣā vyuvāsa devyatho adyedaṃ vyāvo maghonī | atho vyucchāduttarā~ anu dyūnajarāmṛtā carati svadhābhiḥ ||

translations.english: The divine Uṣās dawned continually in former times; the source of wealth, she still rises on this (world); so will she give light hereafter, through future days, for, exempt from decay or death, she goes on in her splendour.

mantras.sanskrit: व्यञ्जिभिर्दिव आतास्वद्यौदप कृष्णां निर्णिजं देव्यावः । प्रबोधयन्त्यरुणेभिरश्वैरोषा याति सुयुजा रथेन ॥
mantras.transliteration: vyañjibhirdiva ātāsvadyaudapa kṛṣṇāṃ nirṇijaṃ devyāvaḥ | prabodhayantyaruṇebhiraśvairoṣā yāti suyujā rathena ||

translations.english: The divine Uṣās lights up with her beams the quarters of the heavens; she has thrown off her gloomy form, and, awaking (those who sleep), comes in her car, drawn by purple steeds.

mantras.sanskrit: आवहन्ती पोष्या वार्याणि चित्रं केतुं कृणुते चेकिताना । ईयुषीणामुपमा शश्वतीनां विभातीनां प्रथमोषा व्यश्वैत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: āvahantī poṣyā vāryāṇi citraṃ ketuṃ kṛṇute cekitānā | īyuṣīṇāmupamā śaśvatīnāṃ vibhātīnāṃ prathamoṣā vyaśvait ||

translations.english: Bringing with her life-sustaining blessings, and giving consciousness (to the unconscious), she imparts (to the world) her wonderful radiance. The similitude of numerous dawns that have gone by, the first of the billiant (dawns that are to come), Uṣās has today appeared.

mantras.sanskrit: उदीर्ध्वं जीवो असुर्न आगादप प्रागात्तम आ ज्योतिरेति । आरैक्पन्थां यातवे सूर्यायागन्म यत्र प्रतिरन्त आयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: udīrdhvaṃ jīvo asurna āgādapa prāgāttama ā jyotireti | āraikpanthāṃ yātave sūryāyāganma yatra pratiranta āyuḥ ||

translations.english: Arise; inspiring life revives; darkness has departed; light approaches. Uṣās has opened the road for the sun to travel; let us repair to where they distribute food.

mantras.sanskrit: स्यूमना वाच उदियर्ति वह्निः स्तवानो रेभ उषसो विभातीः । अद्या तदुच्छ गृणते मघोन्यस्मे आयुर्नि दिदीहि प्रजावत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: syūmanā vāca udiyarti vahniḥ stavāno rebha uṣaso vibhātīḥ | adyā taduccha gṛṇate maghonyasme āyurni didīhi prajāvat ||

translations.english: The offerer of praise, the reciter of praise, celebrating the brilliant Uṣas, repeats the well-connected words (of the Veda). Possessor of affluence, dawn today upon him who praise you; bestow upon us food, whence progeny may be obtained.

mantras.sanskrit: या गोमतीरुषसः सर्ववीरा व्युच्छन्ति दाशुषे मर्त्याय । वायोरिव सूनृतानामुदर्के ता अश्वदा अश्नवत्सोमसुत्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā gomatīruṣasaḥ sarvavīrā vyucchanti dāśuṣe martyāya | vāyoriva sūnṛtānāmudarke tā aśvadā aśnavatsomasutvā ||

translations.english: May he who has offered the libation obtain, upon the conclusion of his praises, (enunciated), life the wind, (with speed), (the favour of) those Uṣasas who are givers of horses, and of cattle, and of progeny, and who shed light upon the mortal presenting to them (offerings).

mantras.sanskrit: माता देवानामदितेरनीकं यज्ञस्य केतुर्बृहती वि भाहि । प्रशस्तिकृद्ब्रह्मणे नो व्युच्छा नो जने जनय विश्ववारे ॥
mantras.transliteration: mātā devānāmaditeranīkaṃ yajñasya keturbṛhatī vi bhāhi | praśastikṛdbrahmaṇe no vyucchā no jane janaya viśvavāre ||

translations.english: Mother of the gods, rival of Aditi, illuminator of the sacrificer, mighty Uṣās, shine forth; approving of our prayer, dawn upon us. Do you, who are cherished by all, make us eminent among the people.

mantras.sanskrit: यच्चित्रमप्न उषसो वहन्तीजानाय शशमानाय भद्रम् । तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaccitramapna uṣaso vahantījānāya śaśamānāya bhadram | tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

translations.english: Whatever valuable wealth the Uṣās convey is beneficial to the sacrificer and to the praiser. May Mitra, Varuṇa, Aditi--ocean, earth, and heaven, be favourable to this our prayer.

mantras.sanskrit: इमा रुद्राय तवसे कपर्दिने क्षयद्वीराय प्र भरामहे मतीः । यथा शमसद्द्विपदे चतुष्पदे विश्वं पुष्टं ग्रामे अस्मिन्ननातुरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: imā rudrāya tavase kapardine kṣayadvīrāya pra bharāmahe matīḥ | yathā śamasaddvipade catuṣpade viśvaṃ puṣṭaṃ grāme asminnanāturam ||

translations.english: We offer these praises to the mighty Rudra, with the braided hair, the destroyer of heroes, in order that health may be enjoyed by bipeds and quadrupeds, and that all being sin this villag may be (well) nourished and exempt from disease.

mantras.sanskrit: मृळा नो रुद्रोत नो मयस्कृधि क्षयद्वीराय नमसा विधेम ते । यच्छं च योश्च मनुरायेजे पिता तदश्याम तव रुद्र प्रणीतिषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: mṛḷā no rudrota no mayaskṛdhi kṣayadvīrāya namasā vidhema te | yacchaṃ ca yośca manurāyeje pitā tadaśyāma tava rudra praṇītiṣu ||

translations.english: Be gracious to us, Rudra; grant us happiness, for we worship the destroyer of heroes with oblations; and, by your directions, Rudra, may we obtain that freedom from disease and exemption from dangers which our progenitor, Manu, bestowed upon us, (having obtained them form the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: अश्याम ते सुमतिं देवयज्यया क्षयद्वीरस्य तव रुद्र मीढ्वः । सुम्नायन्निद्विशो अस्माकमा चरारिष्टवीरा जुहवाम ते हविः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśyāma te sumatiṃ devayajyayā kṣayadvīrasya tava rudra mīḍhvaḥ | sumnāyannidviśo asmākamā carāriṣṭavīrā juhavāma te haviḥ ||

translations.english: Rudra, showerer (of benefits), may we obtain, through our worship of the gods, the favour of you, who are the destroyer of heroes;come to our posterity, purposing to promote their happiness, while we, having our sons in safety, offer you oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वेषं वयं रुद्रं यज्ञसाधं वङ्कुं कविमवसे नि ह्वयामहे । आरे अस्मद्दैव्यं हेळो अस्यतु सुमतिमिद्वयमस्या वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tveṣaṃ vayaṃ rudraṃ yajñasādhaṃ vaṅkuṃ kavimavase ni hvayāmahe | āre asmaddaivyaṃ heḷo asyatu sumatimidvayamasyā vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: We invoke for our preservation the illustrious Rudra, the accomplisher of sacrifices, the tortuous, the wise; may he remove far from us his celestial wrath, for we earnestly solicit his favour.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवो वराहमरुषं कपर्दिनं त्वेषं रूपं नमसा नि ह्वयामहे । हस्ते बिभ्रद्भेषजा वार्याणि शर्म वर्म च्छर्दिरस्मभ्यं यंसत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: divo varāhamaruṣaṃ kapardinaṃ tveṣaṃ rūpaṃ namasā ni hvayāmahe | haste bibhradbheṣajā vāryāṇi śarma varma cchardirasmabhyaṃ yaṃsat ||

translations.english: We invoke, from heaven, with reverence, him who has excellent food, who is radiant, and has braided hair, who is brilliant, and is to be ascertained (by sacred study), holding in his hands excellent medicaments; mayhe grant us health, defensive armour, and a (secure) dwelling.

mantras.sanskrit: इदं पित्रे मरुतामुच्यते वचः स्वादोः स्वादीयो रुद्राय वर्धनम् । रास्वा च नो अमृत मर्तभोजनं त्मने तोकाय तनयाय मृळ ॥
mantras.transliteration: idaṃ pitre marutāmucyate vacaḥ svādoḥ svādīyo rudrāya vardhanam | rāsvā ca no amṛta martabhojanaṃ tmane tokāya tanayāya mṛḷa ||

translations.english: This praise, the sweetest of the sweet, and cause of increase (to the reciter), is addressed to Rudra, the father of the Maruts; immortal Rudra, grant us food sufficient for mortals, and bestow happiness on me, my son, and my grandson.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नो महान्तमुत मा नो अर्भकं मा न उक्षन्तमुत मा न उक्षितम् । मा नो वधीः पितरं मोत मातरं मा नः प्रियास्तन्वो रुद्र रीरिषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā no mahāntamuta mā no arbhakaṃ mā na ukṣantamuta mā na ukṣitam | mā no vadhīḥ pitaraṃ mota mātaraṃ mā naḥ priyāstanvo rudra rīriṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Injure not, Rudra, those amongst us who are old or young, who are capable of begetting, or who are begotten, nor a father, nor a mother, nor afflict our precious person ns.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नस्तोके तनये मा न आयौ मा नो गोषु मा नो अश्वेषु रीरिषः । वीरान्मा नो रुद्र भामितो वधीर्हविष्मन्तः सदमित्त्वा हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā nastoke tanaye mā na āyau mā no goṣu mā no aśveṣu rīriṣaḥ | vīrānmā no rudra bhāmito vadhīrhaviṣmantaḥ sadamittvā havāmahe ||

translations.english: Harm us not, Rudra, in our sons or grandsons, or other male descendants, nor in our cattle, nor in our horses; inflamed with anger, kill not our valiant men, for we, presenting clarified butter perpetually invoke you.

mantras.sanskrit: उप ते स्तोमान्पशुपा इवाकरं रास्वा पितर्मरुतां सुम्नमस्मे । भद्रा हि ते सुमतिर्मृळयत्तमाथा वयमव इत्ते वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa te stomānpaśupā ivākaraṃ rāsvā pitarmarutāṃ sumnamasme | bhadrā hi te sumatirmṛḷayattamāthā vayamava itte vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: I restore to you the praises (derived from you), as a shepherd (returns his sheep to their owner); father of the Maruts, bestow happiness upon me; your auspicious benignityis the cause of successive delight, therefore we especially solicit your protection.

mantras.sanskrit: आरे ते गोघ्नमुत पूरुषघ्नं क्षयद्वीर सुम्नमस्मे ते अस्तु । मृळा च नो अधि च ब्रूहि देवाधा च नः शर्म यच्छ द्विबर्हाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: āre te goghnamuta pūruṣaghnaṃ kṣayadvīra sumnamasme te astu | mṛḷā ca no adhi ca brūhi devādhā ca naḥ śarma yaccha dvibarhāḥ ||

translations.english: Destroyer of heroes, may your cow-killing or man-slaying (weapon) be far away, and let the felicity granted by you be ours; favour us; speak, brilliant hero, in our behalf, and grant us, you who are mighty over the two (realms of heaven and earth), prosperity.

mantras.sanskrit: अवोचाम नमो अस्मा अवस्यवः शृणोतु नो हवं रुद्रो मरुत्वान् । तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
mantras.transliteration: avocāma namo asmā avasyavaḥ śṛṇotu no havaṃ rudro marutvān | tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

translations.english: Desirous of protection, we have said: reverence be to him; may Rudra, with the Maruts, hear our invocation; and may Mitra, Varuṇa, Aditi--ocean, earth and heaven, be favourable to this (our prayer).

mantras.sanskrit: चित्रं देवानामुदगादनीकं चक्षुर्मित्रस्य वरुणस्याग्नेः । आप्रा द्यावापृथिवी अन्तरिक्षं सूर्य आत्मा जगतस्तस्थुषश्च ॥
mantras.transliteration: citraṃ devānāmudagādanīkaṃ cakṣurmitrasya varuṇasyāgneḥ | āprā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṃ sūrya ātmā jagatastasthuṣaśca ||

translations.english: Thewonderful hostof rays has risen; th eye of Mitra, Varuṇa and Agni; the sun, the soul of all that moves or is immoveable, has filled (with his glory) the heaven, the earth, and the firmament.

mantras.sanskrit: सूर्यो देवीमुषसं रोचमानां मर्यो न योषामभ्येति पश्चात् । यत्रा नरो देवयन्तो युगानि वितन्वते प्रति भद्राय भद्रम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sūryo devīmuṣasaṃ rocamānāṃ maryo na yoṣāmabhyeti paścāt | yatrā naro devayanto yugāni vitanvate prati bhadrāya bhadram ||

translations.english: The sun follows the divine and brilliant Uṣā, as a man (follows a young and elegant) woman; at which season, pious men perform (the ceremonies established for) ages, worshipping the auspicious (sun), for the sake of good (reward).

mantras.sanskrit: भद्रा अश्वा हरितः सूर्यस्य चित्रा एतग्वा अनुमाद्यासः । नमस्यन्तो दिव आ पृष्ठमस्थुः परि द्यावापृथिवी यन्ति सद्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhadrā aśvā haritaḥ sūryasya citrā etagvā anumādyāsaḥ | namasyanto diva ā pṛṣṭhamasthuḥ pari dyāvāpṛthivī yanti sadyaḥ ||

translations.english: The auspicious, swift horses of the sun, well-limbed, road-traversing, who merit to be plural ased with praise, revernced byus, have ascended to the summit of the sky, and quickly circumambulate earth and heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: तत्सूर्यस्य देवत्वं तन्महित्वं मध्या कर्तोर्विततं सं जभार । यदेदयुक्त हरितः सधस्थादाद्रात्री वासस्तनुते सिमस्मै ॥
mantras.transliteration: tatsūryasya devatvaṃ tanmahitvaṃ madhyā kartorvitataṃ saṃ jabhāra | yadedayukta haritaḥ sadhasthādādrātrī vāsastanute simasmai ||

translations.english: Such is the divinity, such is the majesty of the sun, that when he has set, he has withdrawn (into himself) the diffused (light which had been shed) upon the unfinished task; when he has unyoked his coursers from his car, then night extends the veiling darkness over all.

mantras.sanskrit: तन्मित्रस्य वरुणस्याभिचक्षे सूर्यो रूपं कृणुते द्योरुपस्थे । अनन्तमन्यद्रुशदस्य पाजः कृष्णमन्यद्धरितः सं भरन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: tanmitrasya varuṇasyābhicakṣe sūryo rūpaṃ kṛṇute dyorupasthe | anantamanyadruśadasya pājaḥ kṛṣṇamanyaddharitaḥ saṃ bharanti ||

translations.english: The sun, is the sight of Mitra and Varuṇa, displays his form (of brightness) in the middle of the heavens, and his rays extend, on one hand, his infinite and brilliant power, or, on the other, (by their departure), bring on the blackness of night.

mantras.sanskrit: अद्या देवा उदिता सूर्यस्य निरंहसः पिपृता निरवद्यात् । तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adyā devā uditā sūryasya niraṃhasaḥ pipṛtā niravadyāt | tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

translations.english: This day, gods, with the rising of the sun, deliver us from heinous sin; and may Mitra, Varuṇa, Aditi--ocean, earth and heaven, be favourable to this (our prayer).

mantras.sanskrit: नासत्याभ्यां बर्हिरिव प्र वृञ्जे स्तोमाँ इयर्म्यभ्रियेव वातः । यावर्भगाय विमदाय जायां सेनाजुवा न्यूहतू रथेन ॥
mantras.transliteration: nāsatyābhyāṃ barhiriva pra vṛñje stomā~ iyarmyabhriyeva vātaḥ | yāvarbhagāya vimadāya jāyāṃ senājuvā nyūhatū rathena ||

translations.english: In like manner as a worshipper strews the sacred grass for the Nāsatyas, so do I urge on their laudations, as the wind drives on the clouds; they, who gave a bride to the youthful Vimada, and bore her away in their car, outstripping the rival host.

mantras.sanskrit: वीळुपत्मभिराशुहेमभिर्वा देवानां वा जूतिभिः शाशदाना । तद्रासभो नासत्या सहस्रमाजा यमस्य प्रधने जिगाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: vīḷupatmabhirāśuhemabhirvā devānāṃ vā jūtibhiḥ śāśadānā | tadrāsabho nāsatyā sahasramājā yamasya pradhane jigāya ||

translations.english: Nāsatyas,borne by strong and rapid (steeds), and (urged) by the encouragements of the gods, the ass of you, thus instrumental gated, overcame a thousand (enemies) in conflict, in the war grateful to Yama.

mantras.sanskrit: तुग्रो ह भुज्युमश्विनोदमेघे रयिं न कश्चिन्ममृवाँ अवाहाः । तमूहथुर्नौभिरात्मन्वतीभिरन्तरिक्षप्रुद्भिरपोदकाभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tugro ha bhujyumaśvinodameghe rayiṃ na kaścinmamṛvā~ avāhāḥ | tamūhathurnaubhirātmanvatībhirantarikṣaprudbhirapodakābhiḥ ||

translations.english: Tugra, verily, Aśvins, sent (his son) Bhujyu to sea, as a dying man parts with his riches; but you brought him back in vessels of your own, floating over the ocean, and keeping out the waters.

mantras.sanskrit: तिस्रः क्षपस्त्रिरहातिव्रजद्भिर्नासत्या भुज्युमूहथुः पतंगैः । समुद्रस्य धन्वन्नार्द्रस्य पारे त्रिभी रथैः शतपद्भिः षळश्वैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tisraḥ kṣapastrirahātivrajadbhirnāsatyā bhujyumūhathuḥ pataṃgaiḥ | samudrasya dhanvannārdrasya pāre tribhī rathaiḥ śatapadbhiḥ ṣaḷaśvaiḥ ||

translations.english: Threenights, and three days, Nāsatyas, have you conveyed Bhujyu in three rapid, revolving cars, having a hundred wheels, and drawn by six horses, along the dry bed of the ocean to the short of the sea.

mantras.sanskrit: अनारम्भणे तदवीरयेथामनास्थाने अग्रभणे समुद्रे । यदश्विना ऊहथुर्भुज्युमस्तं शतारित्रां नावमातस्थिवांसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: anārambhaṇe tadavīrayethāmanāsthāne agrabhaṇe samudre | yadaśvinā ūhathurbhujyumastaṃ śatāritrāṃ nāvamātasthivāṃsam ||

translations.english: this exploit you achieved, Aśvins, in the ocean, where there is nothing to give support, nothing to rest upon,nothing to cling to, that you brought Bhujyu, sailing in a hundred-oared ship, to his father's house.

mantras.sanskrit: यमश्विना ददथुः श्वेतमश्वमघाश्वाय शश्वदित्स्वस्ति । तद्वां दात्रं महि कीर्तेन्यं भूत्पैद्वो वाजी सदमिद्धव्यो अर्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yamaśvinā dadathuḥ śvetamaśvamaghāśvāya śaśvaditsvasti | tadvāṃ dātraṃ mahi kīrtenyaṃ bhūtpaidvo vājī sadamiddhavyo aryaḥ ||

translations.english: Aśvins, the white horse you gave to Pedu, whose horses were indestrucible, was ever to him success; that, your precious gift, is always to be celebrated; the horse of Pedu, the scatterer (of enemies), is always to be invoked.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं नरा स्तुवते पज्रियाय कक्षीवते अरदतं पुरंधिम् । कारोतराच्छफादश्वस्य वृष्णः शतं कुम्भाँ असिञ्चतं सुरायाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ narā stuvate pajriyāya kakṣīvate aradataṃ puraṃdhim | kārotarācchaphādaśvasya vṛṣṇaḥ śataṃ kumbhā~ asiñcataṃ surāyāḥ ||

translations.english: You gave, leaders (of sacrifice), to Kakṣīvat, of the race of Pajra, various knowledge; you filled from the hoof of your vigorous steed, as if from a cask, a hundred jars of wine.

mantras.sanskrit: हिमेनाग्निं घ्रंसमवारयेथां पितुमतीमूर्जमस्मा अधत्तम् । ऋबीसे अत्रिमश्विनावनीतमुन्निन्यथुः सर्वगणं स्वस्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: himenāgniṃ ghraṃsamavārayethāṃ pitumatīmūrjamasmā adhattam | ṛbīse atrimaśvināvanītamunninyathuḥ sarvagaṇaṃ svasti ||

translations.english: You quenched with cold (water) the blazing flames (that encompassed Atri), and supplied him with food-supported strength; you extricated him, Aśvins, from the dark (cavern) into which he had been thrown headlong and restored him to every kind of welfare.

mantras.sanskrit: परावतं नासत्यानुदेथामुच्चाबुध्नं चक्रथुर्जिह्मबारम् । क्षरन्नापो न पायनाय राये सहस्राय तृष्यते गोतमस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: parāvataṃ nāsatyānudethāmuccābudhnaṃ cakrathurjihmabāram | kṣarannāpo na pāyanāya rāye sahasrāya tṛṣyate gotamasya ||

translations.english: Nāsatyas, you raised up the well, and made th ebase, which had been turned upwards, the curved mouth, so that the water issued for the beverage of the thirsty Gotama, the offerer.

mantras.sanskrit: जुजुरुषो नासत्योत वव्रिं प्रामुञ्चतं द्रापिमिव च्यवानात् । प्रातिरतं जहितस्यायुर्दस्रादित्पतिमकृणुतं कनीनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: jujuruṣo nāsatyota vavriṃ prāmuñcataṃ drāpimiva cyavānāt | prātirataṃ jahitasyāyurdasrāditpatimakṛṇutaṃ kanīnām ||

translations.english: Nāsatyas, you stripped off from the aged Cyavana his entire skin, as if it had been a coat of mail; you reversed, Dasras, the life of the sage who was without kindred, and constituted him the husband of many maidens.

mantras.sanskrit: तद्वां नरा शंस्यं राध्यं चाभिष्टिमन्नासत्या वरूथम् । यद्विद्वांसा निधिमिवापगूळ्हमुद्दर्शतादूपथुर्वन्दनाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadvāṃ narā śaṃsyaṃ rādhyaṃ cābhiṣṭimannāsatyā varūtham | yadvidvāṃsā nidhimivāpagūḷhamuddarśatādūpathurvandanāya ||

translations.english: Nāsatyas, leaders, glorious was that exploit of yours, one to be celebrated, to be adored, to be desired by us, when, becoming aware (of the circumstance), you extricated Vandanā, (hidden), like a concealed treasure, from the (well) that was visible (to travellers).

mantras.sanskrit: तद्वां नरा सनये दंस उग्रमाविष्कृणोमि तन्यतुर्न वृष्टिम् । दध्यङ्ह यन्मध्वाथर्वणो वामश्वस्य शीर्ष्णा प्र यदीमुवाच ॥
