mantras.transliteration: tadvāṃ narā sanaye daṃsa ugramāviṣkṛṇomi tanyaturna vṛṣṭim | dadhyaṅha yanmadhvātharvaṇo vāmaśvasya śīrṣṇā pra yadīmuvāca ||

translations.english: I proclaim, leadeers (of sacriifce), for the skae of acquiring wealth, that inimitable deed which you performed, as the thunder (announces) rain, when provided by you with the head of a horse. Dadhyañc, the son of Atharvan, taught you the mystic science.

mantras.sanskrit: अजोहवीन्नासत्या करा वां महे यामन्पुरुभुजा पुरंधिः । श्रुतं तच्छासुरिव वध्रिमत्या हिरण्यहस्तमश्विनावदत्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ajohavīnnāsatyā karā vāṃ mahe yāmanpurubhujā puraṃdhiḥ | śrutaṃ tacchāsuriva vadhrimatyā hiraṇyahastamaśvināvadattam ||

translations.english: The intelligent (Vadhrimati) invoked you. Nāsatyas, who are the accom;ishers (of desires) and the protectors of many, with a sacred hymn; her prayer was heard, like (the instrumental uction of) a teacher, and you, Aśvins, gave to the wife of an impotent husband, Hiraṇyahasta, her son.

mantras.sanskrit: आस्नो वृकस्य वर्तिकामभीके युवं नरा नासत्यामुमुक्तम् । उतो कविं पुरुभुजा युवं ह कृपमाणमकृणुतं विचक्षे ॥
mantras.transliteration: āsno vṛkasya vartikāmabhīke yuvaṃ narā nāsatyāmumuktam | uto kaviṃ purubhujā yuvaṃ ha kṛpamāṇamakṛṇutaṃ vicakṣe ||

translations.english: Nāsatyas, leaders, you liberated the quail from the mouth of the dog that had seized her, and you, who are the benefactors of many, have granted to the sage who praises you, to behold (true wisdom).

mantras.sanskrit: चरित्रं हि वेरिवाच्छेदि पर्णमाजा खेलस्य परितक्म्यायाम् । सद्यो जङ्घामायसीं विश्पलायै धने हिते सर्तवे प्रत्यधत्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: caritraṃ hi verivācchedi parṇamājā khelasya paritakmyāyām | sadyo jaṅghāmāyasīṃ viśpalāyai dhane hite sartave pratyadhattam ||

translations.english: The foot of (Vispalā, the wife of) Khela, was cut off, like the wing of a bird, in an engagement by night; immediately you gave her a metallic leg, that she might walk, the hidden treasure (of the enemy being the object of the conflict).

mantras.sanskrit: शतं मेषान्वृक्ये चक्षदानमृज्राश्वं तं पितान्धं चकार । तस्मा अक्षी नासत्या विचक्ष आधत्तं दस्रा भिषजावनर्वन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śataṃ meṣānvṛkye cakṣadānamṛjrāśvaṃ taṃ pitāndhaṃ cakāra | tasmā akṣī nāsatyā vicakṣa ādhattaṃ dasrā bhiṣajāvanarvan ||

translations.english: When his father caused,Ṛjrāśvā, as he was giving to a she-wolf a hundred sheep cut up in pieces, to become blind, you, Dasras, physicians (of the gods), gave him eyes (that had been) unable to find their way, with which he might see.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वां रथं दुहिता सूर्यस्य कार्ष्मेवातिष्ठदर्वता जयन्ती । विश्वे देवा अन्वमन्यन्त हृद्भिः समु श्रिया नासत्या सचेथे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāṃ rathaṃ duhitā sūryasya kārṣmevātiṣṭhadarvatā jayantī | viśve devā anvamanyanta hṛdbhiḥ samu śriyā nāsatyā sacethe ||

translations.english: The daughter of the sun ascended your car, (like a runner) to a goal; when you won (the race) with your swift horse, all the gods looked on with (anxious hearts), and you, Nāsatyas, were associated with glory.

mantras.sanskrit: यदयातं दिवोदासाय वर्तिर्भरद्वाजायाश्विना हयन्ता । रेवदुवाह सचनो रथो वां वृषभश्च शिंशुमारश्च युक्ता ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadayātaṃ divodāsāya vartirbharadvājāyāśvinā hayantā | revaduvāha sacano ratho vāṃ vṛṣabhaśca śiṃśumāraśca yuktā ||

translations.english: When, Aśvins, being invited, you went to his dwelling (to give due rewards) to Divodāsa, offering oblations, then your helping chariot conveyed (food and) treasure, and the bull and the porpoise were yoked together.

mantras.sanskrit: रयिं सुक्षत्रं स्वपत्यमायुः सुवीर्यं नासत्या वहन्ता । आ जह्नावीं समनसोप वाजैस्त्रिरह्नो भागं दधतीमयातम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: rayiṃ sukṣatraṃ svapatyamāyuḥ suvīryaṃ nāsatyā vahantā | ā jahnāvīṃ samanasopa vājaistrirahno bhāgaṃ dadhatīmayātam ||

translations.english: Nāsatyas, bearing strength and wealth with posterity and vigour-sustaining food, you came, with one intention, to the family of Jahnu, (provide) with (sacrificial) viands, and possessing a third portion of the daily (offerings).

mantras.sanskrit: परिविष्टं जाहुषं विश्वतः सीं सुगेभिर्नक्तमूहथू रजोभिः । विभिन्दुना नासत्या रथेन वि पर्वताँ अजरयू अयातम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pariviṣṭaṃ jāhuṣaṃ viśvataḥ sīṃ sugebhirnaktamūhathū rajobhiḥ | vibhindunā nāsatyā rathena vi parvatā~ ajarayū ayātam ||

translations.english: Undecaying Nāsatyas, you bore away by night, in your foe-overwhelming car, Jāhuṣa, surrounded on every side by (enemies), through practicable roads, and went to (inaccessible) mountains.

mantras.sanskrit: एकस्या वस्तोरावतं रणाय वशमश्विना सनये सहस्रा । निरहतं दुच्छुना इन्द्रवन्ता पृथुश्रवसो वृषणावरातीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ekasyā vastorāvataṃ raṇāya vaśamaśvinā sanaye sahasrā | nirahataṃ ducchunā indravantā pṛthuśravaso vṛṣaṇāvarātīḥ ||

translations.english: You preserved Vaśa, Aśvins, (that he might obtain) in a single day a thousand acceptable gifts; showerers (of benefits), associated with Indra, you destroyed the malignant enemies of Pṛthuśravas.

mantras.sanskrit: शरस्य चिदार्चत्कस्यावतादा नीचादुच्चा चक्रथुः पातवे वाः । शयवे चिन्नासत्या शचीभिर्जसुरये स्तर्यं पिप्यथुर्गाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śarasya cidārcatkasyāvatādā nīcāduccā cakrathuḥ pātave vāḥ | śayave cinnāsatyā śacībhirjasuraye staryaṃ pipyathurgām ||

translations.english: You raised the water from the bottom to the top of the well, for the drinking of Śara, the son of Ṛcitka, and by your powers, Nāsatyas, you filled, for the sake of the weary Śayu, the barren cow (with milk).

mantras.sanskrit: अवस्यते स्तुवते कृष्णियाय ऋजूयते नासत्या शचीभिः । पशुं न नष्टमिव दर्शनाय विष्णाप्वं ददथुर्विश्वकाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: avasyate stuvate kṛṣṇiyāya ṛjūyate nāsatyā śacībhiḥ | paśuṃ na naṣṭamiva darśanāya viṣṇāpvaṃ dadathurviśvakāya ||

translations.english: Nāsatyas, by your acts you restored to Viśvaka, the son of Kṛṣṇa, soliciting your protection, adoring you, and a lover of rectitude, hs son Viṣṇāpu, (welcome) to his sight as an animal that has been lost.

mantras.sanskrit: दश रात्रीरशिवेना नव द्यूनवनद्धं श्नथितमप्स्वन्तः । विप्रुतं रेभमुदनि प्रवृक्तमुन्निन्यथुः सोममिव स्रुवेण ॥
mantras.transliteration: daśa rātrīraśivenā nava dyūnavanaddhaṃ śnathitamapsvantaḥ | viprutaṃ rebhamudani pravṛktamunninyathuḥ somamiva sruveṇa ||

translations.english: Aśvins, you raised up, like Soma in a ladle, Rebha, who for ten nights and nine days, had lain (in a well), bound with tight bonds, wounded, immersed, and suffering distress form the water.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वां दंसांस्यश्विनाववोचमस्य पतिः स्यां सुगवः सुवीरः । उत पश्यन्नश्नुवन्दीर्घमायुरस्तमिवेज्जरिमाणं जगम्याम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vāṃ daṃsāṃsyaśvināvavocamasya patiḥ syāṃ sugavaḥ suvīraḥ | uta paśyannaśnuvandīrghamāyurastamivejjarimāṇaṃ jagamyām ||

translations.english: Thus, Aśvins, have I declared your exploits; may I become the master (of this plural ce), having abundant cattle and a numerous progeny, and retaining my sight, and enjoying a long life; may I enter into old age, as (a master enters) his house.

mantras.sanskrit: मध्वः सोमस्याश्विना मदाय प्रत्नो होता विवासते वाम् । बर्हिष्मती रातिर्विश्रिता गीरिषा यातं नासत्योप वाजैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: madhvaḥ somasyāśvinā madāya pratno hotā vivāsate vām | barhiṣmatī rātirviśritā gīriṣā yātaṃ nāsatyopa vājaiḥ ||

translations.english: Aśvins for your gratification by the plural asant Soma, your ancient worshipper adores you; the offering is poured upon the sacred gras, thehymn is ready (for repetition); come, Nāsatyas, with food and with vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: यो वामश्विना मनसो जवीयान्रथः स्वश्वो विश आजिगाति । येन गच्छथः सुकृतो दुरोणं तेन नरा वर्तिरस्मभ्यं यातम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo vāmaśvinā manaso javīyānrathaḥ svaśvo viśa ājigāti | yena gacchathaḥ sukṛto duroṇaṃ tena narā vartirasmabhyaṃ yātam ||

translations.english: With that car, Aśvins, which, rapid as thought, drawn by good horses, appears before men, and withwhich you repair to the dwelling of the virtuous, come, leaders of (sacrifice), to our abode.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋषिं नरावंहसः पाञ्चजन्यमृबीसादत्रिं मुञ्चथो गणेन । मिनन्ता दस्योरशिवस्य माया अनुपूर्वं वृषणा चोदयन्ता ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛṣiṃ narāvaṃhasaḥ pāñcajanyamṛbīsādatriṃ muñcatho gaṇena | minantā dasyoraśivasya māyā anupūrvaṃ vṛṣaṇā codayantā ||

translations.english: You liberated, leaders (of rites), the sage Atri, who was venerated by the five classes of men from the wicked prison, together with his troop (of children), destroying his enemies and baffling, showerers (of benefits), the devices of the malignant Dasyus.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्वं न गूळ्हमश्विना दुरेवैॠषिं नरा वृषणा रेभमप्सु । सं तं रिणीथो विप्रुतं दंसोभिर्न वां जूर्यन्ति पूर्व्या कृतानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvaṃ na gūḷhamaśvinā durevaiṝṣiṃ narā vṛṣaṇā rebhamapsu | saṃ taṃ riṇītho viprutaṃ daṃsobhirna vāṃ jūryanti pūrvyā kṛtāni ||

translations.english: Leaders (of sacrifice), showerers (of benefits), you restored Rebha, cast by unassailable (enemies) into the water, and wounded, like a (sick) horse, by your (healing) skill; your ancient exploits do not fade (from recollection).

mantras.sanskrit: सुषुप्वांसं न निॠतेरुपस्थे सूर्यं न दस्रा तमसि क्षियन्तम् । शुभे रुक्मं न दर्शतं निखातमुदूपथुरश्विना वन्दनाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: suṣupvāṃsaṃ na niṝterupasthe sūryaṃ na dasrā tamasi kṣiyantam | śubhe rukmaṃ na darśataṃ nikhātamudūpathuraśvinā vandanāya ||

translations.english: You extricated, Dasras, the sage (Vandanā) cast into a well, like a handsome and splendid ornament designed for embellishment, and (lying) Aśvins, like one sleepin gon the lap of the earth or like the sun disappearing in darkness.

mantras.sanskrit: तद्वां नरा शंस्यं पज्रियेण कक्षीवता नासत्या परिज्मन् । शफादश्वस्य वाजिनो जनाय शतं कुम्भाँ असिञ्चतं मधूनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadvāṃ narā śaṃsyaṃ pajriyeṇa kakṣīvatā nāsatyā parijman | śaphādaśvasya vājino janāya śataṃ kumbhā~ asiñcataṃ madhūnām ||

translations.english: That (exploit) of yours, leaders (of sacrifice), is to be celebrated, Nāsatyas, by Kakṣīvat, of the race of Pajra, when you filled for the (expectant) man a hundred vases of sweet (liquors) from the hoof of your fleet horse.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं नरा स्तुवते कृष्णियाय विष्णाप्वं ददथुर्विश्वकाय । घोषायै चित्पितृषदे दुरोणे पतिं जूर्यन्त्या अश्विनावदत्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ narā stuvate kṛṣṇiyāya viṣṇāpvaṃ dadathurviśvakāya | ghoṣāyai citpitṛṣade duroṇe patiṃ jūryantyā aśvināvadattam ||

translations.english: You restored, leaders (of sacrifices), Viṣṇāpu (his lost son) to Viśvaka, the son of Kṛṣṇa, when he praised you; you bestowed, Aśvins, a husband upon Ghoṣā, growing old and tarrying inher father's dwelling.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं श्यावाय रुशतीमदत्तं महः क्षोणस्याश्विना कण्वाय । प्रवाच्यं तद्वृषणा कृतं वां यन्नार्षदाय श्रवो अध्यधत्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ śyāvāya ruśatīmadattaṃ mahaḥ kṣoṇasyāśvinā kaṇvāya | pravācyaṃ tadvṛṣaṇā kṛtaṃ vāṃ yannārṣadāya śravo adhyadhattam ||

translations.english: You gave, Aśvins, a lovely bride to Śyāvā; you gave sight to Kaṇva, unable to see his way; showerers (of benefits), the deed is to be glorified by which you gave hearing to the son of Nṛṣad.

mantras.sanskrit: पुरू वर्पांस्यश्विना दधाना नि पेदव ऊहथुराशुमश्वम् । सहस्रसां वाजिनमप्रतीतमहिहनं श्रवस्यं तरुत्रम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: purū varpāṃsyaśvinā dadhānā ni pedava ūhathurāśumaśvam | sahasrasāṃ vājinamapratītamahihanaṃ śravasyaṃ tarutram ||

translations.english: Aśvins, who assume many forms, you gave to Pedu a swift horse, the bringer of a thousand (treasures), powerful, irresistible, the destroyer of foes, the object of praise, the bearer (over dangers).

mantras.sanskrit: एतानि वां श्रवस्या सुदानू ब्रह्माङ्गूषं सदनं रोदस्योः । यद्वां पज्रासो अश्विना हवन्ते यातमिषा च विदुषे च वाजम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: etāni vāṃ śravasyā sudānū brahmāṅgūṣaṃ sadanaṃ rodasyoḥ | yadvāṃ pajrāso aśvinā havante yātamiṣā ca viduṣe ca vājam ||

translations.english: Liberal givers, these your exploits are to be celebrated, and the resounding prayer propitiates you while abiding in heaven and earth; when the descendants of Pajra invite you, Aśvins, come with food, and grant strength to the sage (who worships you).

mantras.sanskrit: सूनोर्मानेनाश्विना गृणाना वाजं विप्राय भुरणा रदन्ता । अगस्त्ये ब्रह्मणा वावृधाना सं विश्पलां नासत्यारिणीतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sūnormānenāśvinā gṛṇānā vājaṃ viprāya bhuraṇā radantā | agastye brahmaṇā vāvṛdhānā saṃ viśpalāṃ nāsatyāriṇītam ||

translations.english: Aśvins, glorified by the praises of the son (of the jar), and giving food, nourishers (of men), to the sage (Bharadvāja), exalted by Agastya withprayer, you restored Nāsatyas, Viṣpalā.

mantras.sanskrit: कुह यान्ता सुष्टुतिं काव्यस्य दिवो नपाता वृषणा शयुत्रा । हिरण्यस्येव कलशं निखातमुदूपथुर्दशमे अश्विनाहन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kuha yāntā suṣṭutiṃ kāvyasya divo napātā vṛṣaṇā śayutrā | hiraṇyasyeva kalaśaṃ nikhātamudūpathurdaśame aśvināhan ||

translations.english: Wither were you going, sons of heaven, showerers (of benefits), when, on your way to the dwellingof Kāvya, (to receive his) adoration, you raised up (Rebha), Aśvins, on the tenth day, like a buried vessel full of gold?

mantras.sanskrit: युवं च्यवानमश्विना जरन्तं पुनर्युवानं चक्रथुः शचीभिः । युवो रथं दुहिता सूर्यस्य सह श्रिया नासत्यावृणीत ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ cyavānamaśvinā jarantaṃ punaryuvānaṃ cakrathuḥ śacībhiḥ | yuvo rathaṃ duhitā sūryasya saha śriyā nāsatyāvṛṇīta ||

translations.english: You rendered, by your power, Aśvins, the aged Cyavana again young; the daughter of the sun, Nāsatyas, invested your chariot with beauty.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं तुग्राय पूर्व्येभिरेवैः पुनर्मन्यावभवतं युवाना । युवं भुज्युमर्णसो निः समुद्राद्विभिरूहथुॠज्रेभिरश्वैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ tugrāya pūrvyebhirevaiḥ punarmanyāvabhavataṃ yuvānā | yuvaṃ bhujyumarṇaso niḥ samudrādvibhirūhathuṝjrebhiraśvaiḥ ||

translations.english: Dissipators of affliction, as you were praised with former praises by Tugra, so were you again adored (by him), when you brought Bhujyu safe from the tossing ocean with swift ships and rapid horses.

mantras.sanskrit: अजोहवीदश्विना तौग्र्यो वां प्रोळ्हः समुद्रमव्यथिर्जगन्वान् । निष्टमूहथुः सुयुजा रथेन मनोजवसा वृषणा स्वस्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ajohavīdaśvinā taugryo vāṃ proḷhaḥ samudramavyathirjaganvān | niṣṭamūhathuḥ suyujā rathena manojavasā vṛṣaṇā svasti ||

translations.english: Th sun of Tugra, brought back by you, Aśvins, (to his father), glorified you whenhe ahd crossed the ocean in safety, and you bore him, showerers (of benefits), with your well-harnessed car, swift as thought, to safety.

mantras.sanskrit: अजोहवीदश्विना वर्तिका वामास्नो यत्सीममुञ्चतं वृकस्य । वि जयुषा ययथुः सान्वद्रेर्जातं विष्वाचो अहतं विषेण ॥
mantras.transliteration: ajohavīdaśvinā vartikā vāmāsno yatsīmamuñcataṃ vṛkasya | vi jayuṣā yayathuḥ sānvadrerjātaṃ viṣvāco ahataṃ viṣeṇa ||

translations.english: The quail glorified you, Aśvins, when you saved her from the mouth of the wolf; you carried off (Jāhuṣa) to the top of the mountain in your triumphant chariot; and slew the son of Viṣvāñc with a poisoned (arrow).

mantras.sanskrit: शतं मेषान्वृक्ये मामहानं तमः प्रणीतमशिवेन पित्रा । आक्षी ऋज्राश्वे अश्विनावधत्तं ज्योतिरन्धाय चक्रथुर्विचक्षे ॥
mantras.transliteration: śataṃ meṣānvṛkye māmahānaṃ tamaḥ praṇītamaśivena pitrā | ākṣī ṛjrāśve aśvināvadhattaṃ jyotirandhāya cakrathurvicakṣe ||

translations.english: You restored eyes to Ṛjrāśva, who, on presenting a hundred sheep to the she-wolf, had been condemned to darkness by his indignant father, and gave light to the blind, wherewith to behold all things.

mantras.sanskrit: शुनमन्धाय भरमह्वयत्सा वृकीरश्विना वृषणा नरेति । जारः कनीन इव चक्षदान ऋज्राश्वः शतमेकं च मेषान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śunamandhāya bharamahvayatsā vṛkīraśvinā vṛṣaṇā nareti | jāraḥ kanīna iva cakṣadāna ṛjrāśvaḥ śatamekaṃ ca meṣān ||

translations.english: (Desiring) that the enjoyment (arising from the perfection) of the senses (should be restored to the blind), the she-wolf invoked you, (saying), "Aśvins, showerers (of benefits), leaders (of sacrifices), Ṛjrāśva, (lavish) as a youthful gallant, (has given me) a hundred and one sheep, cutting them into fragments".

mantras.sanskrit: मही वामूतिरश्विना मयोभूरुत स्रामं धिष्ण्या सं रिणीथः । अथा युवामिदह्वयत्पुरंधिरागच्छतं सीं वृषणाववोभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahī vāmūtiraśvinā mayobhūruta srāmaṃ dhiṣṇyā saṃ riṇīthaḥ | athā yuvāmidahvayatpuraṃdhirāgacchataṃ sīṃ vṛṣaṇāvavobhiḥ ||

translations.english: Aśvins, your powerful protection is the source of happiness; worthy of laudation, you have made whole the maimed; therefore, has the intelligent (Ghoṣā) called upon you; showerers (of benefits) come hither with your succours.

mantras.sanskrit: अधेनुं दस्रा स्तर्यं विषक्तामपिन्वतं शयवे अश्विना गाम् । युवं शचीभिर्विमदाय जायां न्यूहथुः पुरुमित्रस्य योषाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhenuṃ dasrā staryaṃ viṣaktāmapinvataṃ śayave aśvinā gām | yuvaṃ śacībhirvimadāya jāyāṃ nyūhathuḥ purumitrasya yoṣām ||

translations.english: Dasras, you fille dthe milkless, barren, and emaciated cow of Śayu with milk; you brought, by your powers, the daughter of Purumitra, as a wife, of Vimada.

mantras.sanskrit: यवं वृकेणाश्विना वपन्तेषं दुहन्ता मनुषाय दस्रा । अभि दस्युं बकुरेणा धमन्तोरु ज्योतिश्चक्रथुरार्याय ॥
mantras.transliteration: yavaṃ vṛkeṇāśvinā vapanteṣaṃ duhantā manuṣāya dasrā | abhi dasyuṃ bakureṇā dhamantoru jyotiścakrathurāryāya ||

translations.english: Aśvins, causing the barley to be sown (in the fields that had been prepared) by the plural ugh; milking (the clouds) for the sake of Manu; destroying the Dasyu with the thunderbolt; you have bestowed brilliant light upon the Ārya.

mantras.sanskrit: आथर्वणायाश्विना दधीचेऽश्व्यं शिरः प्रत्यैरयतम् । स वां मधु प्र वोचदृतायन्त्वाष्ट्रं यद्दस्रावपिकक्ष्यं वाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ātharvaṇāyāśvinā dadhīce'śvyaṃ śiraḥ pratyairayatam | sa vāṃ madhu pra vocadṛtāyantvāṣṭraṃ yaddasrāvapikakṣyaṃ vām ||

translations.english: You replaced, Aśvins, with the head of a horse, (the head of) Dadhyañc, the son of Atharvan, and, true to his promise, he revealed to you the mystic knowledge which he had learned from Tvaṣṭā, and which was as a ligature of the waist to you.

mantras.sanskrit: सदा कवी सुमतिमा चके वां विश्वा धियो अश्विना प्रावतं मे । अस्मे रयिं नासत्या बृहन्तमपत्यसाचं श्रुत्यं रराथाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sadā kavī sumatimā cake vāṃ viśvā dhiyo aśvinā prāvataṃ me | asme rayiṃ nāsatyā bṛhantamapatyasācaṃ śrutyaṃ rarāthām ||

translations.english: Sapient Aśvins, I ever solicit your favour; protect all my religious duties, and grant, Nāsatyas, abundant and excellent wealth, together with offsprings.

mantras.sanskrit: हिरण्यहस्तमश्विना रराणा पुत्रं नरा वध्रिमत्या अदत्तम् । त्रिधा ह श्यावमश्विना विकस्तमुज्जीवस ऐरयतं सुदानू ॥
mantras.transliteration: hiraṇyahastamaśvinā rarāṇā putraṃ narā vadhrimatyā adattam | tridhā ha śyāvamaśvinā vikastamujjīvasa airayataṃ sudānū ||

translations.english: Liberal Aśvins, leaders (of sacrifices), you gave to Vadhṛmati her son Hiraṇyahasta; bounteous Aśvins, you restored to life the triply-mutilated Śyāva.

mantras.sanskrit: एतानि वामश्विना वीर्याणि प्र पूर्व्याण्यायवोऽवोचन् । ब्रह्म कृण्वन्तो वृषणा युवभ्यां सुवीरासो विदथमा वदेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: etāni vāmaśvinā vīryāṇi pra pūrvyāṇyāyavo'vocan | brahma kṛṇvanto vṛṣaṇā yuvabhyāṃ suvīrāso vidathamā vadema ||

translations.english: These, your ancient exploits, Aśvins, our forefathers have celebrated, and we offer adoration to you, showerers (of benefits) repeating your praises, accompanied by our dependants.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वां रथो अश्विना श्येनपत्वा सुमृळीकः स्ववाँ यात्वर्वाङ् । यो मर्त्यस्य मनसो जवीयान्त्रिवन्धुरो वृषणा वातरंहाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāṃ ratho aśvinā śyenapatvā sumṛḷīkaḥ svavā~ yātvarvāṅ | yo martyasya manaso javīyāntrivandhuro vṛṣaṇā vātaraṃhāḥ ||

translations.english: May your elegant and rich car, swift as a hawk, come, Aśvins, to our presence, fo rit as quick as the mind of man, surmounted, showerers (of benefits) by three columns, and rapid as the wind.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिवन्धुरेण त्रिवृता रथेन त्रिचक्रेण सुवृता यातमर्वाक् । पिन्वतं गा जिन्वतमर्वतो नो वर्धयतमश्विना वीरमस्मे ॥
mantras.transliteration: trivandhureṇa trivṛtā rathena tricakreṇa suvṛtā yātamarvāk | pinvataṃ gā jinvatamarvato no vardhayatamaśvinā vīramasme ||

translations.english: Come to us with your tri-columnar, triangular, three-wheeled, and well-constructed car; replenish our cows (with milk), give spirit to our horses, and augment, Aśvins, our posterity.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रवद्यामना सुवृता रथेन दस्राविमं शृणुतं श्लोकमद्रेः । किमङ्ग वां प्रत्यवर्तिं गमिष्ठाहुर्विप्रासो अश्विना पुराजाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pravadyāmanā suvṛtā rathena dasrāvimaṃ śṛṇutaṃ ślokamadreḥ | kimaṅga vāṃ pratyavartiṃ gamiṣṭhāhurviprāso aśvinā purājāḥ ||

translations.english: Dasras (having come) with your quick-moving well-constructed car, hear this hymn, (recited by one) who reveres you; do not the ancient sages say that you are most prompt, Aśvins, (to avert) poverty from the worshipper?

mantras.sanskrit: आ वां श्येनासो अश्विना वहन्तु रथे युक्तास आशवः पतंगाः । ये अप्तुरो दिव्यासो न गृध्रा अभि प्रयो नासत्या वहन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāṃ śyenāso aśvinā vahantu rathe yuktāsa āśavaḥ pataṃgāḥ | ye apturo divyāso na gṛdhrā abhi prayo nāsatyā vahanti ||

translations.english: May your quick-moving, prancing steeds, rapid as hawks, yoked to your car, bear you, Aśvins, (hither), who, quick as (falling) water, like vultures flying through the air, convey you, Nāsatyas, to the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वां रथं युवतिस्तिष्ठदत्र जुष्ट्वी नरा दुहिता सूर्यस्य । परि वामश्वा वपुषः पतंगा वयो वहन्त्वरुषा अभीके ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāṃ rathaṃ yuvatistiṣṭhadatra juṣṭvī narā duhitā sūryasya | pari vāmaśvā vapuṣaḥ pataṃgā vayo vahantvaruṣā abhīke ||

translations.english: Leaders (of sacrifice), the youthful daughter of Sūrya ascended, delighted, this your car; may your strong-bodied prancing, fleet, and shining horses, bring you near uṣ

mantras.sanskrit: उद्वन्दनमैरतं दंसनाभिरुद्रेभं दस्रा वृषणा शचीभिः । निष्टौग्र्यं पारयथः समुद्रात्पुनश्च्यवानं चक्रथुर्युवानम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: udvandanamairataṃ daṃsanābhirudrebhaṃ dasrā vṛṣaṇā śacībhiḥ | niṣṭaugryaṃ pārayathaḥ samudrātpunaścyavānaṃ cakrathuryuvānam ||

translations.english: By your deeds, Dasras, you raised up Vandanā, and, showerers (of benefits), Rebha; you bore the son of Tugra over the sea, and made Cyavana young.

mantras.sanskrit: युवमत्रयेऽवनीताय तप्तमूर्जमोमानमश्विनावधत्तम् । युवं कण्वायापिरिप्ताय चक्षुः प्रत्यधत्तं सुष्टुतिं जुजुषाणा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvamatraye'vanītāya taptamūrjamomānamaśvināvadhattam | yuvaṃ kaṇvāyāpiriptāya cakṣuḥ pratyadhattaṃ suṣṭutiṃ jujuṣāṇā ||

translations.english: You (gave relief) to the imprisoned Atri, (quenching the) scorching heat, and fed him with grateful food; solicitous of worthy praise, you gave sight of Kaṇva, blinded (by darkness).

mantras.sanskrit: युवं धेनुं शयवे नाधितायापिन्वतमश्विना पूर्व्याय । अमुञ्चतं वर्तिकामंहसो निः प्रति जङ्घां विश्पलाया अधत्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ dhenuṃ śayave nādhitāyāpinvatamaśvinā pūrvyāya | amuñcataṃ vartikāmaṃhaso niḥ prati jaṅghāṃ viśpalāyā adhattam ||

translations.english: You filled his cow with milk, Aśvins, for the ancient Śayu, when imploring (yoru aid); you liberated the quail from danger; you gave a leg to Viśpalā.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं श्वेतं पेदव इन्द्रजूतमहिहनमश्विनादत्तमश्वम् । जोहूत्रमर्यो अभिभूतिमुग्रं सहस्रसां वृषणं वीड्वङ्गम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ śvetaṃ pedava indrajūtamahihanamaśvinādattamaśvam | johūtramaryo abhibhūtimugraṃ sahasrasāṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vīḍvaṅgam ||

translations.english: You gave to Pedu, Aśvins, the white and foe-trampling steed which you had received from Indra, loud-neighing (in battle), defying enemies, high-spirited, the acquirer of a thousand tresures, vigorous, and firm in body.

mantras.sanskrit: ता वां नरा स्ववसे सुजाता हवामहे अश्विना नाधमानाः । आ न उप वसुमता रथेन गिरो जुषाणा सुविताय यातम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā vāṃ narā svavase sujātā havāmahe aśvinā nādhamānāḥ | ā na upa vasumatā rathena giro juṣāṇā suvitāya yātam ||

translations.english: Earnestly we call you, leaders (of the sacrifice), such (as you have been described), and who are well born, to our succour, soliciting, Aśvins, wealth; contented with our laudations, come to us with your wealthy car, to brign us felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: आ श्येनस्य जवसा नूतनेनास्मे यातं नासत्या सजोषाः । हवे हि वामश्विना रातहव्यः शश्वत्तमाया उषसो व्युष्टौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā śyenasya javasā nūtanenāsme yātaṃ nāsatyā sajoṣāḥ | have hi vāmaśvinā rātahavyaḥ śaśvattamāyā uṣaso vyuṣṭau ||

translations.english: Come to us, auspicious Nāsatyas, with the fresh velocity of a hawk; bearing an oblation, I invoke you, Aśvins, at the rising of the ever constant dawn.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वां रथं पुरुमायं मनोजुवं जीराश्वं यज्ञियं जीवसे हुवे । सहस्रकेतुं वनिनं शतद्वसुं श्रुष्टीवानं वरिवोधामभि प्रयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāṃ rathaṃ purumāyaṃ manojuvaṃ jīrāśvaṃ yajñiyaṃ jīvase huve | sahasraketuṃ vaninaṃ śatadvasuṃ śruṣṭīvānaṃ varivodhāmabhi prayaḥ ||

translations.english: Desiringfood, I invoke, (Aśvins), to support my life, your wonderful car, swift as thought, drawn by fleet horses, worthy of veneration, many-bannered, bringing rain, containing wealth, abundantly yielding delight, and conferring riches.

mantras.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वा धीतिः प्रत्यस्य प्रयामन्यधायि शस्मन्त्समयन्त आ दिशः । स्वदामि घर्मं प्रति यन्त्यूतय आ वामूर्जानी रथमश्विनारुहत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūrdhvā dhītiḥ pratyasya prayāmanyadhāyi śasmantsamayanta ā diśaḥ | svadāmi gharmaṃ prati yantyūtaya ā vāmūrjānī rathamaśvināruhat ||

translations.english: Upon its moving, our minds have been raised on high in praise; our hymns reach (the Aśvins). I sweeten the oblation; the assistants come nigh; Ūrjāni, (the daughter of the sun), has ascended, Aśvins, your car.

mantras.sanskrit: सं यन्मिथः पस्पृधानासो अग्मत शुभे मखा अमिता जायवो रणे । युवोरह प्रवणे चेकिते रथो यदश्विना वहथः सूरिमा वरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ yanmithaḥ paspṛdhānāso agmata śubhe makhā amitā jāyavo raṇe | yuvoraha pravaṇe cekite ratho yadaśvinā vahathaḥ sūrimā varam ||

translations.english: When devout and unnumbered (men), victorious in battle, mutually contending for wealth, come together, your car, Aśvins, is perceived on its downward course, in which you bear excellent (treasure) to the worshipper.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं भुज्युं भुरमाणं विभिर्गतं स्वयुक्तिभिर्निवहन्ता पितृभ्य आ । यासिष्टं वर्तिर्वृषणा विजेन्यं दिवोदासाय महि चेति वामवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ bhujyuṃ bhuramāṇaṃ vibhirgataṃ svayuktibhirnivahantā pitṛbhya ā | yāsiṣṭaṃ vartirvṛṣaṇā vijenyaṃ divodāsāya mahi ceti vāmavaḥ ||

translations.english: You brought back to his ancestor (Bhujyu, who, borne by his own steeds, had perished), (but that you rescued him) with your self-harnessed horses, and sent showerers (o fbenefits), to his distant dwellign; and great was the succour whichit is know you rendered to Divodāsa.

mantras.sanskrit: युवोरश्विना वपुषे युवायुजं रथं वाणी येमतुरस्य शर्ध्यम् । आ वां पतित्वं सख्याय जग्मुषी योषावृणीत जेन्या युवां पती ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvoraśvinā vapuṣe yuvāyujaṃ rathaṃ vāṇī yematurasya śardhyam | ā vāṃ patitvaṃ sakhyāya jagmuṣī yoṣāvṛṇīta jenyā yuvāṃ patī ||

translations.english: Aśvins, your admirable (horses) bore the car which you had carnessed, (first) to the goal, for the sake of honour, and the damsel, who was the prize, came through  affection, to you, and acknowledged your (husbandship), saying, "you are (my) lords".

mantras.sanskrit: युवं रेभं परिषूतेरुरुष्यथो हिमेन घर्मं परितप्तमत्रये । युवं शयोरवसं पिप्यथुर्गवि प्र दीर्घेण वन्दनस्तार्यायुषा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ rebhaṃ pariṣūteruruṣyatho himena gharmaṃ paritaptamatraye | yuvaṃ śayoravasaṃ pipyathurgavi pra dīrgheṇa vandanastāryāyuṣā ||

translations.english: You preserved Rebha from the violence around him; you quenched with snow, for Atri, the scorching heat; you genitive rated milk in the cow of Śayu; and (by you) was Vandanā endowed with prolonged life.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं वन्दनं निॠतं जरण्यया रथं न दस्रा करणा समिन्वथः । क्षेत्रादा विप्रं जनथो विपन्यया प्र वामत्र विधते दंसना भुवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ vandanaṃ niṝtaṃ jaraṇyayā rathaṃ na dasrā karaṇā saminvathaḥ | kṣetrādā vipraṃ janatho vipanyayā pra vāmatra vidhate daṃsanā bhuvat ||

translations.english: Skillful Dasras, you restored Vandanā, when debilitated by old age, as a (wheelwright repairs a worn-out) car; (moved) by his praises, you brought forth the sage (Vāmadeva) from the womb; may your (glorious) deeds be (displayed) for him who in this plural ce offers you worship.

mantras.sanskrit: अगच्छतं कृपमाणं परावति पितुः स्वस्य त्यजसा निबाधितम् । स्वर्वतीरित ऊतीर्युवोरह चित्रा अभीके अभवन्नभिष्टयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agacchataṃ kṛpamāṇaṃ parāvati pituḥ svasya tyajasā nibādhitam | svarvatīrita ūtīryuvoraha citrā abhīke abhavannabhiṣṭayaḥ ||

translations.english: You repaired to him who, aflicted by the abandonment of his own father, praised you from afar; hence your prompt and wonderful succours have been wished to be at hand (by all).

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्या वां मधुमन्मक्षिकारपन्मदे सोमस्यौशिजो हुवन्यति । युवं दधीचो मन आ विवासथोऽथा शिरः प्रति वामश्व्यं वदत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta syā vāṃ madhumanmakṣikārapanmade somasyauśijo huvanyati | yuvaṃ dadhīco mana ā vivāsatho'thā śiraḥ prati vāmaśvyaṃ vadat ||

translations.english: That honey-seeking bee also murmured your praise; the son of Us;ij invokes you to the exhilaratin of Soma; you conciliated the mind of Dadhyañc, so that, provided with the head of a horse, he taught you (the mystic science).

mantras.sanskrit: युवं पेदवे पुरुवारमश्विना स्पृधां श्वेतं तरुतारं दुवस्यथः । शर्यैरभिद्युं पृतनासु दुष्टरं चर्कृत्यमिन्द्रमिव चर्षणीसहम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ pedave puruvāramaśvinā spṛdhāṃ śvetaṃ tarutāraṃ duvasyathaḥ | śaryairabhidyuṃ pṛtanāsu duṣṭaraṃ carkṛtyamindramiva carṣaṇīsaham ||

translations.english: Aśvins, you gave to Pedu the white (horse) desired by many, the breaker-through of combatants, shining, unconquerable by foes in battle, fit for every work; like Indra, the conquerer of men.

mantras.sanskrit: का राधद्धोत्राश्विना वां को वां जोष उभयोः । कथा विधात्यप्रचेताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kā rādhaddhotrāśvinā vāṃ ko vāṃ joṣa ubhayoḥ | kathā vidhātyapracetāḥ ||

translations.english: What praise may propitiate you, Aśvins? who may give satisfaction to you both? how may an ignorant (man) pay fitting homage?

mantras.sanskrit: विद्वांसाविद्दुरः पृच्छेदविद्वानित्थापरो अचेताः । नू चिन्नु मर्ते अक्रौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: vidvāṃsāvidduraḥ pṛcchedavidvānitthāparo acetāḥ | nū cinnu marte akrau ||

translations.english: Thus may an ignorant man inquire the means of worshipping the all-wise, for every (one) other (than the Aśvins) is unknowing; they, the unconquered, quickly(show favour) to the man (who worships them).

mantras.sanskrit: ता विद्वांसा हवामहे वां ता नो विद्वांसा मन्म वोचेतमद्य । प्रार्चद्दयमानो युवाकुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā vidvāṃsā havāmahe vāṃ tā no vidvāṃsā manma vocetamadya | prārcaddayamāno yuvākuḥ ||

translations.english: We invoke you, who know all things; may you, who are omniscient, declare to us today the praise tha tis acceptable; desirous of your presence, I reverence you, offering (oblations).

mantras.sanskrit: वि पृच्छामि पाक्या न देवान्वषट्कृतस्याद्भुतस्य दस्रा । पातं च सह्यसो युवं च रभ्यसो नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi pṛcchāmi pākyā na devānvaṣaṭkṛtasyādbhutasya dasrā | pātaṃ ca sahyaso yuvaṃ ca rabhyaso naḥ ||

translations.english: I invite not the gods immature (in wisdom), but you, Dasras; drink of the wonderful and strength-giving burnt-offering, and make us vigorous.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र या घोषे भृगवाणे न शोभे यया वाचा यजति पज्रियो वाम् । प्रैषयुर्न विद्वान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra yā ghoṣe bhṛgavāṇe na śobhe yayā vācā yajati pajriyo vām | praiṣayurna vidvān ||

translations.english: Powerful is the hymn that was repeated by the son of Ghoṣā, and by Bhṛgu, and with which hymn the Aṅgirasas adore you; may the sage (kakṣīvat), desirous (of food), obtain it abundantly.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रुतं गायत्रं तकवानस्याहं चिद्धि रिरेभाश्विना वाम् । आक्षी शुभस्पती दन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śrutaṃ gāyatraṃ takavānasyāhaṃ ciddhi rirebhāśvinā vām | ākṣī śubhaspatī dan ||

translations.english: Hear the song of the stumbling (blind man), for verily, Aśvins, I glorify you, recovering my eyes (through you), who are protectors of good works

mantras.sanskrit: युवं ह्यास्तं महो रन्युवं वा यन्निरततंसतम् । ता नो वसू सुगोपा स्यातं पातं नो वृकादघायोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ hyāstaṃ maho ranyuvaṃ vā yanniratataṃsatam | tā no vasū sugopā syātaṃ pātaṃ no vṛkādaghāyoḥ ||

translations.english: You have been givers of great riches; you have again caused them to disappear; do you, who are donors of dwellings, become our preservers; protect us from the felonous robber.

mantras.sanskrit: मा कस्मै धातमभ्यमित्रिणे नो माकुत्रा नो गृहेभ्यो धेनवो गुः । स्तनाभुजो अशिश्वीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā kasmai dhātamabhyamitriṇe no mākutrā no gṛhebhyo dhenavo guḥ | stanābhujo aśiśvīḥ ||

translations.english: deliver us not, Aśvins, to our enemies; never may our cows, who nourish us with their udders, stray from our houses, separated from their calves.

mantras.sanskrit: दुहीयन्मित्रधितये युवाकु राये च नो मिमीतं वाजवत्यै । इषे च नो मिमीतं धेनुमत्यै ॥
mantras.transliteration: duhīyanmitradhitaye yuvāku rāye ca no mimītaṃ vājavatyai | iṣe ca no mimītaṃ dhenumatyai ||

translations.english: Those who adore you obtain (wealth) for the support of their friends; direct us to opulence, bestowing food; direct us to food, associated with kine.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्विनोरसनं रथमनश्वं वाजिनीवतोः । तेनाहं भूरि चाकन ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvinorasanaṃ rathamanaśvaṃ vājinīvatoḥ | tenāhaṃ bhūri cākana ||

translations.english: I have obtained, without horses, the car of the food-bestowing Aśvins, and expect (to gain) by it much (wealth).

mantras.sanskrit: अयं समह मा तनूह्याते जनाँ अनु । सोमपेयं सुखो रथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ samaha mā tanūhyāte janā~ anu | somapeyaṃ sukho rathaḥ ||

translations.english: This (is he who has obtained you), wealth- bearing (car); augment (my prosperity); may the delightful car bear the Soma beverage (to the Aśvins).

mantras.sanskrit: अध स्वप्नस्य निर्विदेऽभुञ्जतश्च रेवतः । उभा ता बस्रि नश्यतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha svapnasya nirvide'bhuñjataśca revataḥ | ubhā tā basri naśyataḥ ||

translations.english: Now am I disdainful of sleep, and of the rich man who benefits not others, for both (the morning sleep and the selfish rich man) quickly perish.

mantras.sanskrit: कदित्था नॄँ: पात्रं देवयतां श्रवद्गिरो अङ्गिरसां तुरण्यन् । प्र यदानड्विश आ हर्म्यस्योरु क्रंसते अध्वरे यजत्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kaditthā nṝ~: pātraṃ devayatāṃ śravadgiro aṅgirasāṃ turaṇyan | pra yadānaḍviśa ā harmyasyoru kraṃsate adhvare yajatraḥ ||

translations.english: When willIndra, the protector of men and granter of riches, listen to the praises thus (recited) of the Aṅgirasas, who are devoted to the gods? When he perceives the ministers of the master of the mansion, and is to be the object of worship in the sacrifice, he greatly exults.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तम्भीद्ध द्यां स धरुणं प्रुषायदृभुर्वाजाय द्रविणं नरो गोः । अनु स्वजां महिषश्चक्षत व्रां मेनामश्वस्य परि मातरं गोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: stambhīddha dyāṃ sa dharuṇaṃ pruṣāyadṛbhurvājāya draviṇaṃ naro goḥ | anu svajāṃ mahiṣaścakṣata vrāṃ menāmaśvasya pari mātaraṃ goḥ ||

translations.english: He verily upholds the heaven; he, the brilliant, the leader of the (stolen) herd, pours forth the flowing (water), for the sake of food; the mighty Indra manifests himself after his own daughter (the dawn); he made the feminine le of the horse unnaturally the mother of the cow.

mantras.sanskrit: नक्षद्धवमरुणीः पूर्व्यं राट् तुरो विशामङ्गिरसामनु द्यून् । तक्षद्वज्रं नियुतं तस्तम्भद्द्यां चतुष्पदे नर्याय द्विपादे ॥
mantras.transliteration: nakṣaddhavamaruṇīḥ pūrvyaṃ rāṭ turo viśāmaṅgirasāmanu dyūn | takṣadvajraṃ niyutaṃ tastambhaddyāṃ catuṣpade naryāya dvipāde ||

translations.english: May he, illuminating the purple (dawn), listen to the invocation (addressed to him) of old, daily besowing wealth upon the race of Aṅgiras; he has sharpened his fatal shaft; he has supported the heaven for the good of men, of quadrupeds, andbipeds.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य मदे स्वर्यं दा ऋतायापीवृतमुस्रियाणामनीकम् । यद्ध प्रसर्गे त्रिककुम्निवर्तदप द्रुहो मानुषस्य दुरो वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya made svaryaṃ dā ṛtāyāpīvṛtamusriyāṇāmanīkam | yaddha prasarge trikakumnivartadapa druho mānuṣasya duro vaḥ ||

translations.english: In the exhilaration of the Soma, you have restored the celebrated herd of cattle, hidden (in the cave), for the sake of sacrifice, (to the Aṅgirasas); when, Indra, the threefold crest engages in combat, he opens the doors of the tyrannical descendants of Manu

mantras.sanskrit: तुभ्यं पयो यत्पितरावनीतां राधः सुरेतस्तुरणे भुरण्यू । शुचि यत्ते रेक्ण आयजन्त सबर्दुघायाः पय उस्रियायाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tubhyaṃ payo yatpitarāvanītāṃ rādhaḥ suretasturaṇe bhuraṇyū | śuci yatte rekṇa āyajanta sabardughāyāḥ paya usriyāyāḥ ||

translations.english: When your parents, (heaven and earth), theprotectors (of the world), brought the nutritious and invigorating oblation to you, who are quick in act, and when they offered you the pure and precious milk of the cow.

mantras.sanskrit: अध प्र जज्ञे तरणिर्ममत्तु प्र रोच्यस्या उषसो न सूरः । इन्दुर्येभिराष्ट स्वेदुहव्यैः स्रुवेण सिञ्चञ्जरणाभि धाम ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha pra jajñe taraṇirmamattu pra rocyasyā uṣaso na sūraḥ | induryebhirāṣṭa sveduhavyaiḥ sruveṇa siñcañjaraṇābhi dhāma ||

translations.english: Now is Indra manifested; may he, the over-comer (of his foes), grant us happiness,he, who shines brightly, like the sun of this dawn; may the excellent Soma, being sprinklled upon the plural ceof sacrifice with a ladle, (exhilarate us), by whom, presenting the oblations we had prepared, it was imbibed.

mantras.sanskrit: स्विध्मा यद्वनधितिरपस्यात्सूरो अध्वरे परि रोधना गोः । यद्ध प्रभासि कृत्व्याँ अनु द्यूननर्विशे पश्विषे तुराय ॥
mantras.transliteration: svidhmā yadvanadhitirapasyātsūro adhvare pari rodhanā goḥ | yaddha prabhāsi kṛtvyā~ anu dyūnanarviśe paśviṣe turāya ||

translations.english: When the bright-edged hatchet is ready for its work, the directing priest is able to have the victim bound in the sacrifice; when Indra, you shine upon the days that are appropriated to sacred rites, then (success attends) upon the man who goes with his cart (for fuel), the driver (of cattle), or the active (shepherd).

mantras.sanskrit: अष्टा महो दिव आदो हरी इह द्युम्नासाहमभि योधान उत्सम् । हरिं यत्ते मन्दिनं दुक्षन्वृधे गोरभसमद्रिभिर्वाताप्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: aṣṭā maho diva ādo harī iha dyumnāsāhamabhi yodhāna utsam | hariṃ yatte mandinaṃ dukṣanvṛdhe gorabhasamadribhirvātāpyam ||

translations.english: Send hither your horses, the quaffers of the exhilarating libation; overcome, warrior, the adversary plural ndering us of our treasure; when they express with stones, for the increase (of your strength), the delightful, exhilarating, invigorating (Soma), to be overtaken by you, who are swifter than the wind.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमायसं प्रति वर्तयो गोर्दिवो अश्मानमुपनीतमृभ्वा । कुत्साय यत्र पुरुहूत वन्वञ्छुष्णमनन्तैः परियासि वधैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamāyasaṃ prati vartayo gordivo aśmānamupanītamṛbhvā | kutsāya yatra puruhūta vanvañchuṣṇamanantaiḥ pariyāsi vadhaiḥ ||

translations.english: You did hurl your metal bolt upon the quick-moving (asura), the swift destroyer of foes, that was brought (to you) by Ṛbhu from heaven; when you, who are worshipped by many, striking Śuṣṇa, for the sake of Kutsa, did encompass him with numberless fatal (weapons).

mantras.sanskrit: पुरा यत्सूरस्तमसो अपीतेस्तमद्रिवः फलिगं हेतिमस्य । शुष्णस्य चित्परिहितं यदोजो दिवस्परि सुग्रथितं तदादः ॥
mantras.transliteration: purā yatsūrastamaso apītestamadrivaḥ phaligaṃ hetimasya | śuṣṇasya citparihitaṃ yadojo divaspari sugrathitaṃ tadādaḥ ||

translations.english: When the sun (had emerged) from the struggle with darkness, you did break, wielder of the thunderbolt, the cloud that had been his annoyance, and did under the well-fastened covering in which Śuṣṇa had enveloped him.

mantras.sanskrit: अनु त्वा मही पाजसी अचक्रे द्यावाक्षामा मदतामिन्द्र कर्मन् । त्वं वृत्रमाशयानं सिरासु महो वज्रेण सिष्वपो वराहुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: anu tvā mahī pājasī acakre dyāvākṣāmā madatāmindra karman | tvaṃ vṛtramāśayānaṃ sirāsu maho vajreṇa siṣvapo varāhum ||

translations.english: Then the vast, powerful, and immoveable earth and heaven animated you, Indra, to glorious needs, and you did hurl down into the waters, with your mightythunderbolt, the everywhere-spreading and destroying Vṛtra.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमिन्द्र नर्यो याँ अवो नॄन्तिष्ठा वातस्य सुयुजो वहिष्ठान् । यं ते काव्य उशना मन्दिनं दाद्वृत्रहणं पार्यं ततक्ष वज्रम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamindra naryo yā~ avo nṝntiṣṭhā vātasya suyujo vahiṣṭhān | yaṃ te kāvya uśanā mandinaṃ dādvṛtrahaṇaṃ pāryaṃ tatakṣa vajram ||

translations.english: Indra, friend of man, mount the horses whom you cherish, who are fleet as the wind, are easily yoked, and who bear (theri burden) well; you have sharpened the foe-destroying thunderbolt, the slayer of Vṛtra, which inspiring (weapon) Uśanas, the son of Kavi, gave you.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं सूरो हरितो रामयो नॄन्भरच्चक्रमेतशो नायमिन्द्र । प्रास्य पारं नवतिं नाव्यानामपि कर्तमवर्तयोऽयज्यून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ sūro harito rāmayo nṝnbharaccakrametaśo nāyamindra | prāsya pāraṃ navatiṃ nāvyānāmapi kartamavartayo'yajyūn ||

translations.english: Stop, Sūra, your yellow horses, for this Etaśa, Indra, drags the wheel; having driven those who offer no sacrifices to the opposite bank of the ninety rivers, you compel them (to do) what is to be done.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं नो अस्या इन्द्र दुर्हणायाः पाहि वज्रिवो दुरितादभीके । प्र नो वाजान्रथ्यो अश्वबुध्यानिषे यन्धि श्रवसे सूनृतायै ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ no asyā indra durhaṇāyāḥ pāhi vajrivo duritādabhīke | pra no vājānrathyo aśvabudhyāniṣe yandhi śravase sūnṛtāyai ||

translations.english: Indra, bearer of the thunderbolt, preserve us from this (poverty), that is so difficult to be destroyed, and from misfortune in war; grant us riches, conspicuous for chariots, remarkable for horses, for the sake of food, of fame, and of truth.

mantras.sanskrit: मा सा ते अस्मत्सुमतिर्वि दसद्वाजप्रमहः समिषो वरन्त । आ नो भज मघवन्गोष्वर्यो मंहिष्ठास्ते सधमादः स्याम ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā sā te asmatsumatirvi dasadvājapramahaḥ samiṣo varanta | ā no bhaja maghavangoṣvaryo maṃhiṣṭhāste sadhamādaḥ syāma ||

translations.english: Famous for affluence, Indra, never may your favour be withdrawn from us; may food ever sustain us; opulent Maghavan, make us possessors of cattle, and may we, most assiduous in your adoration, be happy, together (with our families).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वः पान्तं रघुमन्यवोऽन्धो यज्ञं रुद्राय मीळ्हुषे भरध्वम् । दिवो अस्तोष्यसुरस्य वीरैरिषुध्येव मरुतो रोदस्योः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vaḥ pāntaṃ raghumanyavo'ndho yajñaṃ rudrāya mīḷhuṣe bharadhvam | divo astoṣyasurasya vīrairiṣudhyeva maruto rodasyoḥ ||

translations.english: Present, mild-tempered (priests), the sacrificial viands which you have prepared, to there warm-showering Rudra. I praise him who, with his heroid (followers) as (with shafts) from a quiver, expelled (the asuras) from heaven; and (I praise) the Maruts, (who abide) between heaven and earth.

mantras.sanskrit: पत्नीव पूर्वहूतिं वावृधध्या उषासानक्ता पुरुधा विदाने । स्तरीर्नात्कं व्युतं वसाना सूर्यस्य श्रिया सुदृशी हिरण्यैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: patnīva pūrvahūtiṃ vāvṛdhadhyā uṣāsānaktā purudhā vidāne | starīrnātkaṃ vyutaṃ vasānā sūryasya śriyā sudṛśī hiraṇyaiḥ ||

translations.english: Animated by our diversified praise, hasten, Morning and Night, to attend to our first invocation, as a wife (to the first call of her husband); and may the--Dawn, beautiful with the lustre of the (rising) Sun, and robbing like the Sun (her) vast expanse with golden rays, (come to our early rite).

mantras.sanskrit: ममत्तु नः परिज्मा वसर्हा ममत्तु वातो अपां वृषण्वान् । शिशीतमिन्द्रापर्वता युवं नस्तन्नो विश्वे वरिवस्यन्तु देवाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mamattu naḥ parijmā vasarhā mamattu vāto apāṃ vṛṣaṇvān | śiśītamindrāparvatā yuvaṃ nastanno viśve varivasyantu devāḥ ||

translations.english: May the circumambient divinity, the wearer of various forms, grant us delight; may the wind, the shedder of rain, grant us delight; do you, Indra and Parvata, sharpen our (intellects), and may all the gods show us favour.

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्या मे यशसा श्वेतनायै व्यन्ता पान्तौशिजो हुवध्यै । प्र वो नपातमपां कृणुध्वं प्र मातरा रास्पिनस्यायोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tyā me yaśasā śvetanāyai vyantā pāntauśijo huvadhyai | pra vo napātamapāṃ kṛṇudhvaṃ pra mātarā rāspinasyāyoḥ ||

translations.english: Whenever I, the son of Uśij, worship with my offerings (of food) those two (Aśvins) who eat and drink (of oblations and libations) at (the season) of the world-whitening (dawn); do you, Priests, glorify the grandson of the waters (Agni), and render (the divinities of the day and night) the mothers (as it were) of the man who repeats their praise.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वो रुवण्युमौशिजो हुवध्यै घोषेव शंसमर्जुनस्य नंशे । प्र वः पूष्णे दावन आँ अच्छा वोचेय वसुतातिमग्नेः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vo ruvaṇyumauśijo huvadhyai ghoṣeva śaṃsamarjunasya naṃśe | pra vaḥ pūṣṇe dāvana ā~ acchā voceya vasutātimagneḥ ||

translations.english: I, the son of Uśij, address to you (Aśvins) audible praises, in like manner as Ghoṣā praised you for the removal of her white-tinted (skin); I glorify (gods) the bountiful Pūṣan (associated) with you, and I proclaim the munificence of Agni.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रुतं मे मित्रावरुणा हवेमोत श्रुतं सदने विश्वतः सीम् । श्रोतु नः श्रोतुरातिः सुश्रोतुः सुक्षेत्रा सिन्धुरद्भिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śrutaṃ me mitrāvaruṇā havemota śrutaṃ sadane viśvataḥ sīm | śrotu naḥ śroturātiḥ suśrotuḥ sukṣetrā sindhuradbhiḥ ||

translations.english: Mitra and Varuṇa, hear these my invocations, and moreover listen to those (that are) everywhere (uttered) in the chamber of sacrifice; and may Sindhu, the renowned bestower of wealth, hear us, (fertilizing our) broad fields with water.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तुषे सा वां वरुण मित्र रातिर्गवां शता पृक्षयामेषु पज्रे । श्रुतरथे प्रियरथे दधानाः सद्यः पुष्टिं निरुन्धानासो अग्मन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: stuṣe sā vāṃ varuṇa mitra rātirgavāṃ śatā pṛkṣayāmeṣu pajre | śrutarathe priyarathe dadhānāḥ sadyaḥ puṣṭiṃ nirundhānāso agman ||

translations.english: I praise you, Mitra and Varuṇa, for your gift of numerous cattle to the Pajra, and (from those praises) may abundant food (proceed). May (the gods), bestowing nourishment on me, come quickly unimpeded, (each) in his famous and favourite car.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य स्तुषे महिमघस्य राधः सचा सनेम नहुषः सुवीराः । जनो यः पज्रेभ्यो वाजिनीवानश्वावतो रथिनो मह्यं सूरिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya stuṣe mahimaghasya rādhaḥ sacā sanema nahuṣaḥ suvīrāḥ | jano yaḥ pajrebhyo vājinīvānaśvāvato rathino mahyaṃ sūriḥ ||

translations.english: I laud the treasures of that opulent (assemblyof the gods); may we, men who (are blessed) with excellent descendants, partake of them together; the assembly conferring upon the Pajras abundant food, has been my benefactor, and has made me the master of horses and chariots.

mantras.sanskrit: जनो यो मित्रावरुणावभिध्रुगपो न वां सुनोत्यक्ष्णयाध्रुक् । स्वयं स यक्ष्मं हृदये नि धत्त आप यदीं होत्राभिॠतावा ॥
mantras.transliteration: jano yo mitrāvaruṇāvabhidhrugapo na vāṃ sunotyakṣṇayādhruk | svayaṃ sa yakṣmaṃ hṛdaye ni dhatta āpa yadīṃ hotrābhiṝtāvā ||

translations.english: The mman who does you wrong, Mitra and Varuṇa, who injures you in any way, who does not present you with oblations, contracts for himself sickness in his heart; but he who, performing worship, (celebrates it) with praises.

mantras.sanskrit: स व्राधतो नहुषो दंसुजूतः शर्धस्तरो नरां गूर्तश्रवाः । विसृष्टरातिर्याति बाळ्हसृत्वा विश्वासु पृत्सु सदमिच्छूरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa vrādhato nahuṣo daṃsujūtaḥ śardhastaro narāṃ gūrtaśravāḥ | visṛṣṭarātiryāti bāḷhasṛtvā viśvāsu pṛtsu sadamicchūraḥ ||

translations.english: He, borne by well-trained horses, endowed with surpassing strength, renowned above men, munificent in gifts, moves a hero, ever undaunted in all combats, (even) against mightymen.

mantras.sanskrit: अध ग्मन्ता नहुषो हवं सूरेः श्रोता राजानो अमृतस्य मन्द्राः । नभोजुवो यन्निरवस्य राधः प्रशस्तये महिना रथवते ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha gmantā nahuṣo havaṃ sūreḥ śrotā rājāno amṛtasya mandrāḥ | nabhojuvo yanniravasya rādhaḥ praśastaye mahinā rathavate ||

translations.english: Royal bestowers of delight, listen to the invocation of (your) undying worshipper, and then come hither, that you who traverse the sky may be propitiated by the greatness of the (sacrificial) wealth presented to you by the sacrificer, who acknowledges no other protector.

mantras.sanskrit: एतं शर्धं धाम यस्य सूरेरित्यवोचन्दशतयस्य नंशे । द्युम्नानि येषु वसुताती रारन्विश्वे सन्वन्तु प्रभृथेषु वाजम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: etaṃ śardhaṃ dhāma yasya sūrerityavocandaśatayasya naṃśe | dyumnāni yeṣu vasutātī rāranviśve sanvantu prabhṛtheṣu vājam ||

translations.english: The gods have declared: we confer present vigour upon the worshipper (who invokes us) to partake of the (ibation). May all (the gods) in whom splendour and riches abound, bestow (abundant) food at (solemn) sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: मन्दामहे दशतयस्य धासेर्द्विर्यत्पञ्च बिभ्रतो यन्त्यन्ना । किमिष्टाश्व इष्टरश्मिरेत ईशानासस्तरुष ऋञ्जते नॄन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mandāmahe daśatayasya dhāserdviryatpañca bibhrato yantyannā | kimiṣṭāśva iṣṭaraśmireta īśānāsastaruṣa ṛñjate nṝn ||

translations.english: We rejoice tha tfor the satisfaction of the ten (organs of sense), the (priests) bearing the twice five (ladles of) sacrificial food, proceed (to the altar). What can Iṣṭaśva, (what can) Iṣṭaraśmi, (what can) those who are now lords of the earth, achieve (with respect) to the leaders of men, the conquerors of their foes?

mantras.sanskrit: हिरण्यकर्णं मणिग्रीवमर्णस्तन्नो विश्वे वरिवस्यन्तु देवाः । अर्यो गिरः सद्य आ जग्मुषीरोस्राश्चाकन्तूभयेष्वस्मे ॥
mantras.transliteration: hiraṇyakarṇaṃ maṇigrīvamarṇastanno viśve varivasyantu devāḥ | aryo giraḥ sadya ā jagmuṣīrosrāścākantūbhayeṣvasme ||

translations.english: May all the gods favour us with a person n decorated with golden earrings and jewel necklace; may the venerable (company of the deities) be propitiated by the praises issuing (from the mouth of the worshipper); may our offerings be acceptable to them, and (may they be plural ased) with both (our praises and offerings).

mantras.sanskrit: चत्वारो मा मशर्शारस्य शिश्वस्त्रयो राज्ञ आयवसस्य जिष्णोः । रथो वां मित्रावरुणा दीर्घाप्साः स्यूमगभस्तिः सूरो नाद्यौत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: catvāro mā maśarśārasya śiśvastrayo rājña āyavasasya jiṣṇoḥ | ratho vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā dīrghāpsāḥ syūmagabhastiḥ sūro nādyaut ||

translations.english: The four (silly) sons of Maśar'śāra, the three of the victorious monarch Āyavasa (annoy) me. Let your spacious and bright-rayed chariot, Mitra and Varuṇa, blaze (before them) like the sun (filling them with fear).

mantras.sanskrit: पृथू रथो दक्षिणाया अयोज्यैनं देवासो अमृतासो अस्थुः । कृष्णादुदस्थादर्या विहायाश्चिकित्सन्ती मानुषाय क्षयाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: pṛthū ratho dakṣiṇāyā ayojyainaṃ devāso amṛtāso asthuḥ | kṛṣṇādudasthādaryā vihāyāścikitsantī mānuṣāya kṣayāya ||

translations.english: The spacious chariot of the graceful (dawn) has been harnessed; the immortal gods have ascended it; the noble and all-pervading Uṣā has risen up from the darkness, bringing health to human habitations.

mantras.sanskrit: पूर्वा विश्वस्माद्भुवनादबोधि जयन्ती वाजं बृहती सनुत्री । उच्चा व्यख्यद्युवतिः पुनर्भूरोषा अगन्प्रथमा पूर्वहूतौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: pūrvā viśvasmādbhuvanādabodhi jayantī vājaṃ bṛhatī sanutrī | uccā vyakhyadyuvatiḥ punarbhūroṣā aganprathamā pūrvahūtau ||

translations.english: First of all the world is she awake, triumphing over transitory (darkness); the mighty, the giver (of light) from on high, she beholds (all things); ever youthful, ever reviving, she comes first to the invocation.

mantras.sanskrit: यदद्य भागं विभजासि नृभ्य उषो देवि मर्त्यत्रा सुजाते । देवो नो अत्र सविता दमूना अनागसो वोचति सूर्याय ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadadya bhāgaṃ vibhajāsi nṛbhya uṣo devi martyatrā sujāte | devo no atra savitā damūnā anāgaso vocati sūryāya ||

translations.english: Well-born and divine Uṣā, who are the protectress of mortals; whatever share (of light) you apportion today to men, may the radiant Savitā bedisposed (to confirm) the gift, and declar us free from sin; so that (he) the sun (may come to our sacrificial hall).

mantras.sanskrit: गृहंगृहमहना यात्यच्छा दिवेदिवे अधि नामा दधाना । सिषासन्ती द्योतना शश्वदागादग्रमग्रमिद्भजते वसूनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: gṛhaṃgṛhamahanā yātyacchā divedive adhi nāmā dadhānā | siṣāsantī dyotanā śaśvadāgādagramagramidbhajate vasūnām ||

translations.english: Ahana, charged with downward-bending (light), goes daily from house to house; she comes, perpetually diffusing light, and desirous of bestowing (benefits), and accepts the choicest portions of (the sacrificial) treasures.

mantras.sanskrit: भगस्य स्वसा वरुणस्य जामिरुषः सूनृते प्रथमा जरस्व । पश्चा स दघ्या यो अघस्य धाता जयेम तं दक्षिणया रथेन ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhagasya svasā varuṇasya jāmiruṣaḥ sūnṛte prathamā jarasva | paścā sa daghyā yo aghasya dhātā jayema taṃ dakṣiṇayā rathena ||

translations.english: Uṣā, endowed with truth, who are the sister of Bhaga, the sister of Varuṇa, be you hymned first (of the gods); then let the worker of iniquity depart, for we shall overcome him with our chariot, through your assistance.

mantras.sanskrit: उदीरतां सूनृता उत्पुरंधीरुदग्नयः शुशुचानासो अस्थुः । स्पार्हा वसूनि तमसापगूळ्हाविष्कृण्वन्त्युषसो विभातीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: udīratāṃ sūnṛtā utpuraṃdhīrudagnayaḥ śuśucānāso asthuḥ | spārhā vasūni tamasāpagūḷhāviṣkṛṇvantyuṣaso vibhātīḥ ||

translations.english: Let words of truth be spoken; let works of wisdom (be performed); let the blazing fires rise up, so that the many radiant Uṣā may make manifest the desirable treasures hidden by the darkness.

mantras.sanskrit: अपान्यदेत्यभ्यन्यदेति विषुरूपे अहनी सं चरेते । परिक्षितोस्तमो अन्या गुहाकरद्यौदुषाः शोशुचता रथेन ॥
mantras.transliteration: apānyadetyabhyanyadeti viṣurūpe ahanī saṃ carete | parikṣitostamo anyā guhākaradyauduṣāḥ śośucatā rathena ||

translations.english: The twofold day proceeds unseparated; one (part going) forward, one backward; one of these two alternating (periods) effects the concealment (of things); the dawn illumines them with her radiant chariot.

mantras.sanskrit: सदृशीरद्य सदृशीरिदु श्वो दीर्घं सचन्ते वरुणस्य धाम । अनवद्यास्त्रिंशतं योजनान्येकैका क्रतुं परि यन्ति सद्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sadṛśīradya sadṛśīridu śvo dīrghaṃ sacante varuṇasya dhāma | anavadyāstriṃśataṃ yojanānyekaikā kratuṃ pari yanti sadyaḥ ||

translations.english: The same today, the same tomorrow, the irreproachable (dawn) precede the distant course of Varuṇa by thirtyyojanas, and each in succession revolves in its (appointed) office.

mantras.sanskrit: जानत्यह्नः प्रथमस्य नाम शुक्रा कृष्णादजनिष्ट श्वितीची । ऋतस्य योषा न मिनाति धामाहरहर्निष्कृतमाचरन्ती ॥
mantras.transliteration: jānatyahnaḥ prathamasya nāma śukrā kṛṣṇādajaniṣṭa śvitīcī | ṛtasya yoṣā na mināti dhāmāharaharniṣkṛtamācarantī ||

translations.english: The self-illumined dawn, announcing the declination of the first (portion) of the day, is born white-shining out of the gloom; cleansing (with the radiance) of the sun, she impairs not his splendour, but daily adds embellishment (to his lustre).

mantras.sanskrit: कन्येव तन्वा शाशदानाँ एषि देवि देवमियक्षमाणम् । संस्मयमाना युवतिः पुरस्तादाविर्वक्षांसि कृणुषे विभाती ॥
mantras.transliteration: kanyeva tanvā śāśadānā~ eṣi devi devamiyakṣamāṇam | saṃsmayamānā yuvatiḥ purastādāvirvakṣāṃsi kṛṇuṣe vibhātī ||

translations.english: Goddess, manifest in person n like a maiden, you go to the resplendent and munificent (sun), and, like a youthful bride (beforeher husband), you uncover, smiling, yor bosom in his presence.

mantras.sanskrit: सुसंकाशा मातृमृष्टेव योषाविस्तन्वं कृणुषे दृशे कम् । भद्रा त्वमुषो वितरं व्युच्छ न तत्ते अन्या उषसो नशन्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: susaṃkāśā mātṛmṛṣṭeva yoṣāvistanvaṃ kṛṇuṣe dṛśe kam | bhadrā tvamuṣo vitaraṃ vyuccha na tatte anyā uṣaso naśanta ||

translations.english: Radiant as a bride decorated by her mother, you willingly display your person n to the view. Do you, auspicious Uṣā, remove the investing (gloom), for, other dawns than you do not disperse it.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्वावतीर्गोमतीर्विश्ववारा यतमाना रश्मिभिः सूर्यस्य । परा च यन्ति पुनरा च यन्ति भद्रा नाम वहमाना उषासः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvāvatīrgomatīrviśvavārā yatamānā raśmibhiḥ sūryasya | parā ca yanti punarā ca yanti bhadrā nāma vahamānā uṣāsaḥ ||

translations.english: Possessed of horses, possessed of cows, existing through all time, vying with the rays of the sun (in dissipating darkness), auspicious dawns, sending down benefits (on mankind), pass away and again return.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतस्य रश्मिमनुयच्छमाना भद्रम्भद्रं क्रतुमस्मासु धेहि । उषो नो अद्य सुहवा व्युच्छास्मासु रायो मघवत्सु च स्युः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtasya raśmimanuyacchamānā bhadrambhadraṃ kratumasmāsu dhehi | uṣo no adya suhavā vyucchāsmāsu rāyo maghavatsu ca syuḥ ||

translations.english: Co-operating with the rays of the true (sun), confirm in us every propitious act; earnestly invoked byus today, disperse, Uṣā, (the darkness), that wealth may devolve upon us, (already) affluent (in sacrificial treasures).

mantras.sanskrit: उषा उच्छन्ती समिधाने अग्ना उद्यन्त्सूर्य उर्विया ज्योतिरश्रेत् । देवो नो अत्र सविता न्वर्थं प्रासावीद्द्विपत्प्र चतुष्पदित्यै ॥
mantras.transliteration: uṣā ucchantī samidhāne agnā udyantsūrya urviyā jyotiraśret | devo no atra savitā nvarthaṃ prāsāvīddvipatpra catuṣpadityai ||

translations.english: When the (sacred) fire is kindled, Uṣā sheds abundant light, dispersing (the darkness) like the rising sun; may the divine Savitābestow upon usfor our use, wealth of both bipeds and quadrupeds.

mantras.sanskrit: अमिनती दैव्यानि व्रतानि प्रमिनती मनुष्या युगानि । ईयुषीणामुपमा शश्वतीनामायतीनां प्रथमोषा व्यद्यौत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: aminatī daivyāni vratāni praminatī manuṣyā yugāni | īyuṣīṇāmupamā śaśvatīnāmāyatīnāṃ prathamoṣā vyadyaut ||

translations.english: Unimpeding divine rites, although wearing away the ages of mankind, the dawn shines the similitude of the (mornings) that have passed, or that are to be forever, the first of those that are to come.

mantras.sanskrit: एषा दिवो दुहिता प्रत्यदर्शि ज्योतिर्वसाना समना पुरस्तात् । ऋतस्य पन्थामन्वेति साधु प्रजानतीव न दिशो मिनाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣā divo duhitā pratyadarśi jyotirvasānā samanā purastāt | ṛtasya panthāmanveti sādhu prajānatīva na diśo mināti ||

translations.english: She, the daughter of heaven, is beheld in the east, gracious and arrayed in light; she travels steadily along the path of the sun, as if cognizant (of his plural asure), and damages not the quarters (of the horizon).

mantras.sanskrit: उपो अदर्शि शुन्ध्युवो न वक्षो नोधा इवाविरकृत प्रियाणि । अद्मसन्न ससतो बोधयन्ती शश्वत्तमागात्पुनरेयुषीणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: upo adarśi śundhyuvo na vakṣo nodhā ivāvirakṛta priyāṇi | admasanna sasato bodhayantī śaśvattamāgātpunareyuṣīṇām ||

translations.english: She is beheld nigh at hand, (radiant) as the breast of the illuminator (the sun); and, like Nodhas, has made manifest many plural asing (objects); like a matron she awakens (her) sleeping (children), and of all (feminine les who are) stirring betimes, she, the most unvarying, repeatedly appears.

mantras.sanskrit: पूर्वे अर्धे रजसो अप्त्यस्य गवां जनित्र्यकृत प्र केतुम् । व्यु प्रथते वितरं वरीय ओभा पृणन्ती पित्रोरुपस्था ॥
mantras.transliteration: pūrve ardhe rajaso aptyasya gavāṃ janitryakṛta pra ketum | vyu prathate vitaraṃ varīya obhā pṛṇantī pitrorupasthā ||

translations.english: Born in the eastern quarter of the spacious firmament, she displays a banner of rays of light. plural ced on the lap of both parents (heaven and earth), filling them (with radiance), she enjoys vast and wide-spread renown.

mantras.sanskrit: एवेदेषा पुरुतमा दृशे कं नाजामिं न परि वृणक्ति जामिम् । अरेपसा तन्वा शाशदाना नार्भादीषते न महो विभाती ॥
mantras.transliteration: evedeṣā purutamā dṛśe kaṃ nājāmiṃ na pari vṛṇakti jāmim | arepasā tanvā śāśadānā nārbhādīṣate na maho vibhātī ||

translations.english: Verily she, the wide-expanded Uṣā, neglects not (to give) the joy of sight to those of her own or of a different nature; visible in her faultless person n, and brightly shining, she passes not by the littleror the great.

mantras.sanskrit: अभ्रातेव पुंस एति प्रतीची गर्तारुगिव सनये धनानाम् । जायेव पत्य उशती सुवासा उषा हस्रेव नि रिणीते अप्सः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhrāteva puṃsa eti pratīcī gartārugiva sanaye dhanānām | jāyeva patya uśatī suvāsā uṣā hasreva ni riṇīte apsaḥ ||

translations.english: She goes to the west, as (a woman who has) no brother (repairs) to her male (relatives); and like one ascending the hall (of justice) for the recovery of property, (she mounts in the sky to claim her lustre); and like a wife desirous to plural ase her husband, Uṣā puts on becoming attire, and smiling as it were, displays her charms.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वसा स्वस्रे ज्यायस्यै योनिमारैगपैत्यस्याः प्रतिचक्ष्येव । व्युच्छन्ती रश्मिभिः सूर्यस्याञ्ज्यङ्क्ते समनगा इव व्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: svasā svasre jyāyasyai yonimāraigapaityasyāḥ praticakṣyeva | vyucchantī raśmibhiḥ sūryasyāñjyaṅkte samanagā iva vrāḥ ||

translations.english: The sister (night) has prepared a birth-plural ce for her elder sister (day), and having amde it known to her, departs. Uṣā, dispersing the darkness with the rays of the sun, illumines the world, like congregated lightnings.

mantras.sanskrit: आसां पूर्वासामहसु स्वसॄणामपरा पूर्वामभ्येति पश्चात् । ताः प्रत्नवन्नव्यसीर्नूनमस्मे रेवदुच्छन्तु सुदिना उषासः ॥
mantras.transliteration: āsāṃ pūrvāsāmahasu svasṝṇāmaparā pūrvāmabhyeti paścāt | tāḥ pratnavannavyasīrnūnamasme revaducchantu sudinā uṣāsaḥ ||

translations.english: Of all these sisters who have gone before, a successor daily follows the one that has preceded. So may new dawns, like the old, bringing fortunate days, shine upon us blessed with affluence.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र बोधयोषः पृणतो मघोन्यबुध्यमानाः पणयः ससन्तु । रेवदुच्छ मघवद्भ्यो मघोनि रेवत्स्तोत्रे सूनृते जारयन्ती ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra bodhayoṣaḥ pṛṇato maghonyabudhyamānāḥ paṇayaḥ sasantu | revaduccha maghavadbhyo maghoni revatstotre sūnṛte jārayantī ||

translations.english: Awaken, wealth-abounding, Uṣā, those whose delight (in holy offerings); let the (niggard) traders, reluctant wake (for such a purpose), sleep on. Arise, opulent Uṣā, bearing wealth to the liberal (worshipper); speaker of truth, who are the waster away (of living creatures), arise, bearing wealth to him who praises you.

mantras.sanskrit: अवेयमश्वैद्युवतिः पुरस्ताद्युङ्क्ते गवामरुणानामनीकम् । वि नूनमुच्छादसति प्र केतुर्गृहंगृहमुप तिष्ठाते अग्निः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aveyamaśvaidyuvatiḥ purastādyuṅkte gavāmaruṇānāmanīkam | vi nūnamucchādasati pra keturgṛhaṃgṛhamupa tiṣṭhāte agniḥ ||

translations.english: This youthful Uṣā, approached from the east; she harnesses her team of purple oxen. Assuredly she will disperse the darkness, a manifest sign (of day) in the firmament; the (sacred) fire is kindled in every dwelling.

mantras.sanskrit: उत्ते वयश्चिद्वसतेरपप्तन्नरश्च ये पितुभाजो व्युष्टौ । अमा सते वहसि भूरि वाममुषो देवि दाशुषे मर्त्याय ॥
mantras.transliteration: utte vayaścidvasaterapaptannaraśca ye pitubhājo vyuṣṭau | amā sate vahasi bhūri vāmamuṣo devi dāśuṣe martyāya ||

translations.english: At your dawning, (Uṣā), the various birds rise up from their nests, and men who have to earn their bread (quit their homes). You bring, divine (Uṣā), much wealth to the liberal mortal who is present in the chamber (of sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्तोढ्वं स्तोम्या ब्रह्मणा मेऽवीवृधध्वमुशतीरुषासः । युष्माकं देवीरवसा सनेम सहस्रिणं च शतिनं च वाजम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: astoḍhvaṃ stomyā brahmaṇā me'vīvṛdhadhvamuśatīruṣāsaḥ | yuṣmākaṃ devīravasā sanema sahasriṇaṃ ca śatinaṃ ca vājam ||

translations.english: Praiseworthy Uṣās, be glorified by this (my hymn); graciously disposed towards us, augment (our prosperity); and may we obtain, goddesses, through your favour, wealth; a hundred and a thousand fold.

mantras.sanskrit: प्राता रत्नं प्रातरित्वा दधाति तं चिकित्वान्प्रतिगृह्या नि धत्ते । तेन प्रजां वर्धयमान आयू रायस्पोषेण सचते सुवीरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prātā ratnaṃ prātaritvā dadhāti taṃ cikitvānpratigṛhyā ni dhatte | tena prajāṃ vardhayamāna āyū rāyaspoṣeṇa sacate suvīraḥ ||

translations.english: Having come in the early morning, (Svanaya) presents precious (wealth), knowing it (to be worthy of acceptance); and having, (therefore), accepted it, (Kakṣīvat) brings it (to his father); wherewith the parent of excellent sons, maintaining his progeny, passes his life in the enjoyment of affluence.

mantras.sanskrit: सुगुरसत्सुहिरण्यः स्वश्वो बृहदस्मै वय इन्द्रो दधाति । यस्त्वायन्तं वसुना प्रातरित्वो मुक्षीजयेव पदिमुत्सिनाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: sugurasatsuhiraṇyaḥ svaśvo bṛhadasmai vaya indro dadhāti | yastvāyantaṃ vasunā prātaritvo mukṣījayeva padimutsināti ||

translations.english: May he (the Rājā) be rich in kine, in gold, in horses; may Indra grant abundant food to him who delays you, returning home in the early morning, by costly gifts, as (a hunter arrests the) wandering (animals) by his snares.

mantras.sanskrit: आयमद्य सुकृतं प्रातरिच्छन्निष्टेः पुत्रं वसुमता रथेन । अंशोः सुतं पायय मत्सरस्य क्षयद्वीरं वर्धय सूनृताभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: āyamadya sukṛtaṃ prātaricchanniṣṭeḥ putraṃ vasumatā rathena | aṃśoḥ sutaṃ pāyaya matsarasya kṣayadvīraṃ vardhaya sūnṛtābhiḥ ||

translations.english: Desirous (of again beholding you), I have this day obtained you, who have done in the morning a good deed; the performer of a sacrifice with a wealth-laden car, refresh yoursel fwiththe effused libation of the exhilarating (Soma), and augment with sincere prayers (the prosperity) of the chief of the flourishing race.

mantras.sanskrit: उप क्षरन्ति सिन्धवो मयोभुव ईजानं च यक्ष्यमाणं च धेनवः । पृणन्तं च पपुरिं च श्रवस्यवो घृतस्य धारा उप यन्ति विश्वतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa kṣaranti sindhavo mayobhuva ījānaṃ ca yakṣyamāṇaṃ ca dhenavaḥ | pṛṇantaṃ ca papuriṃ ca śravasyavo ghṛtasya dhārā upa yanti viśvataḥ ||

translations.english: The copiously-yielding and joy-conferringkine, distil (their milk) for the celebration of the (Soma) sacrifice; and for him who has undertaken its celebration; the nutritious streams of butter coverage from every quarter towards him, who both propitiates (his progenitors), and benefits (mankind).

mantras.sanskrit: नाकस्य पृष्ठे अधि तिष्ठति श्रितो यः पृणाति स ह देवेषु गच्छति । तस्मा आपो घृतमर्षन्ति सिन्धवस्तस्मा इयं दक्षिणा पिन्वते सदा ॥
mantras.transliteration: nākasya pṛṣṭhe adhi tiṣṭhati śrito yaḥ pṛṇāti sa ha deveṣu gacchati | tasmā āpo ghṛtamarṣanti sindhavastasmā iyaṃ dakṣiṇā pinvate sadā ||

translations.english: He who propitiates (the gods), gives to the gods, and sits at ease upon the summit of heaven; to him the flowing waters bear their essence; to him this fertile (earth) ever yields abundance.

mantras.sanskrit: दक्षिणावतामिदिमानि चित्रा दक्षिणावतां दिवि सूर्यासः । दक्षिणावन्तो अमृतं भजन्ते दक्षिणावन्तः प्र तिरन्त आयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dakṣiṇāvatāmidimāni citrā dakṣiṇāvatāṃ divi sūryāsaḥ | dakṣiṇāvanto amṛtaṃ bhajante dakṣiṇāvantaḥ pra tiranta āyuḥ ||

translations.english: These wonderful (rewards) verily are for those who give (pious) donations; for the donors of (pious) gifts the suns shine in heaven; the givers of (pious) donations attain immortality; the givers of (pious) gifts prolong their (worldly) existence.

mantras.sanskrit: मा पृणन्तो दुरितमेन आरन्मा जारिषुः सूरयः सुव्रतासः । अन्यस्तेषां परिधिरस्तु कश्चिदपृणन्तमभि सं यन्तु शोकाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā pṛṇanto duritamena āranmā jāriṣuḥ sūrayaḥ suvratāsaḥ | anyasteṣāṃ paridhirastu kaścidapṛṇantamabhi saṃ yantu śokāḥ ||

translations.english: May those who propitiate (the gods), never commit degrading sin; may those who praise the gods and observe holy vows, never experience decay; may some (honourable) individual ever be their defence; and may afflictions fall upon him who does not propitiate (the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: अमन्दान्त्स्तोमान्प्र भरे मनीषा सिन्धावधि क्षियतो भाव्यस्य । यो मे सहस्रममिमीत सवानतूर्तो राजा श्रव इच्छमानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: amandāntstomānpra bhare manīṣā sindhāvadhi kṣiyato bhāvyasya | yo me sahasramamimīta savānatūrto rājā śrava icchamānaḥ ||

translations.english: I repeat with a (willing) mind, the unreluctant praises of Bhavya, dwellingon th ebanks of the Sindhu; a prince of unequalled (might), desirous of renown, who has enabled me to celebrate a thousand sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: शतं राज्ञो नाधमानस्य निष्काञ्छतमश्वान्प्रयतान्त्सद्य आदम् । शतं कक्षीवाँ असुरस्य गोनां दिवि श्रवोऽजरमा ततान ॥
mantras.transliteration: śataṃ rājño nādhamānasya niṣkāñchatamaśvānprayatāntsadya ādam | śataṃ kakṣīvā~ asurasya gonāṃ divi śravo'jaramā tatāna ||

translations.english: From which genitive rous prince, soliciting (my acceptance), I, Kakṣīvat, unhesitatingly accepted a hundred niṣkas, a hundred vigorous steeds, and a hundred bulls, whereby he has spread his imperishable fame through heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: उप मा श्यावाः स्वनयेन दत्ता वधूमन्तो दश रथासो अस्थुः । षष्टिः सहस्रमनु गव्यमागात्सनत्कक्षीवाँ अभिपित्वे अह्नाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa mā śyāvāḥ svanayena dattā vadhūmanto daśa rathāso asthuḥ | ṣaṣṭiḥ sahasramanu gavyamāgātsanatkakṣīvā~ abhipitve ahnām ||

translations.english: Ten chariots drawn by bay steeds, and carrying my wives, stood near me, given meby Svanaya; and a thousand and sixty cows followed; these, after a short interval of time, did Kakṣīvat deliver (to his father).

mantras.sanskrit: चत्वारिंशद्दशरथस्य शोणाः सहस्रस्याग्रे श्रेणिं नयन्ति । मदच्युतः कृशनावतो अत्यान्कक्षीवन्त उदमृक्षन्त पज्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: catvāriṃśaddaśarathasya śoṇāḥ sahasrasyāgre śreṇiṃ nayanti | madacyutaḥ kṛśanāvato atyānkakṣīvanta udamṛkṣanta pajrāḥ ||

translations.english: Forty bay horses, (harnessed) to the chariots, lead the procession in front of a thousand (followers). The Pajras, the kinsmen of Kakṣīvat, rub down the high-spirited steeds, decorated with golden trappings.

mantras.sanskrit: पूर्वामनु प्रयतिमा ददे वस्त्रीन्युक्ताँ अष्टावरिधायसो गाः । सुबन्धवो ये विश्या इव व्रा अनस्वन्तः श्रव ऐषन्त पज्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pūrvāmanu prayatimā dade vastrīnyuktā~ aṣṭāvaridhāyaso gāḥ | subandhavo ye viśyā iva vrā anasvantaḥ śrava aiṣanta pajrāḥ ||

translations.english: I have accepted a prior grant, (kinsmen), for you; three and eight harnessed chariots and cattle of incalculable value; may the kindred Pajras, like well-disposed relations, be desirous of acquiring renown by their abundant offerings.

mantras.sanskrit: आगधिता परिगधिता या कशीकेव जङ्गहे । ददाति मह्यं यादुरी याशूनां भोज्या शता ॥
mantras.transliteration: āgadhitā parigadhitā yā kaśīkeva jaṅgahe | dadāti mahyaṃ yādurī yāśūnāṃ bhojyā śatā ||

translations.english: She, who, when her desires are assented to, clings as tenaciously as a feminine le weasel, and who is ripe for enjoyment, yields me infinite delight.

mantras.sanskrit: उपोप मे परा मृश मा मे दभ्राणि मन्यथाः । सर्वाहमस्मि रोमशा गन्धारीणामिवाविका ॥
mantras.transliteration: upopa me parā mṛśa mā me dabhrāṇi manyathāḥ | sarvāhamasmi romaśā gandhārīṇāmivāvikā ||

translations.english: Approach me, (husband); deem me not immature; I am covered with down like a eve of the gandhārins.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निं होतारं मन्ये दास्वन्तं वसुं सूनुं सहसो जातवेदसं विप्रं न जातवेदसम् । य ऊर्ध्वया स्वध्वरो देवो देवाच्या कृपा । घृतस्य विभ्राष्टिमनु वष्टि शोचिषाजुह्वानस्य सर्पिषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniṃ hotāraṃ manye dāsvantaṃ vasuṃ sūnuṃ sahaso jātavedasaṃ vipraṃ na jātavedasam | ya ūrdhvayā svadhvaro devo devācyā kṛpā | ghṛtasya vibhrāṣṭimanu vaṣṭi śociṣājuhvānasya sarpiṣaḥ ||

translations.english: I venerate Agni, the invoker (of the gods), the munificent, the giver of dwellings, the son of strength; he who knows all that exists, like a sage who is endowed with knowledge; who, the divine regenerator of sacrifices, through his lofty and reverntial devotion, covets for the gods the blaze of the liquefied butter which is offered in oblation with his flames.

mantras.sanskrit: यजिष्ठं त्वा यजमाना हुवेम ज्येष्ठमङ्गिरसां विप्र मन्मभिर्विप्रेभिः शुक्र मन्मभिः । परिज्मानमिव द्यां होतारं चर्षणीनाम् । शोचिष्केशं वृषणं यमिमा विशः प्रावन्तु जूतये विशः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajiṣṭhaṃ tvā yajamānā huvema jyeṣṭhamaṅgirasāṃ vipra manmabhirviprebhiḥ śukra manmabhiḥ | parijmānamiva dyāṃ hotāraṃ carṣaṇīnām | śociṣkeśaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ yamimā viśaḥ prāvantu jūtaye viśaḥ ||

translations.english: We, the instrumental tutors of the ceremony, invoke you, Agni, who are most deserving of worship, and are the eldest of the Aṅgirasas, with (acceptable) prayers; and with prayers (recited) by the priests, (we adore) you, who, like the traverser of the sky, (the sun), are the invoker (of the gods on behalf) of men, and whom, the bright-haired showeree (of blessings), many people approaching propitiate for the attainment of felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: स हि पुरू चिदोजसा विरुक्मता दीद्यानो भवति द्रुहंतरः परशुर्न द्रुहंतरः । वीळु चिद्यस्य समृतौ श्रुवद्वनेव यत्स्थिरम् । निःषहमाणो यमते नायते धन्वासहा नायते ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa hi purū cidojasā virukmatā dīdyāno bhavati druhaṃtaraḥ paraśurna druhaṃtaraḥ | vīḷu cidyasya samṛtau śruvadvaneva yatsthiram | niḥṣahamāṇo yamate nāyate dhanvāsahā nāyate ||

translations.english: Verily, that Agni, far shining with brilliant vigour, is the destroyer of foes, like a hatchet that cuts down trees; whatever is most solid and stable dissolves like water at his contact; unsparing, he sports (amidst enemies), nor desists (from their destruction), like an archer who retreats not (frombattle).

mantras.sanskrit: दृळ्हा चिदस्मा अनु दुर्यथा विदे तेजिष्ठाभिररणिभिर्दाष्ट्यवसेऽग्नये दाष्ट्यवसे । प्र यः पुरूणि गाहते तक्षद्वनेव शोचिषा । स्थिरा चिदन्ना नि रिणात्योजसा नि स्थिराणि चिदोजसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: dṛḷhā cidasmā anu duryathā vide tejiṣṭhābhiraraṇibhirdāṣṭyavase'gnaye dāṣṭyavase | pra yaḥ purūṇi gāhate takṣadvaneva śociṣā | sthirā cidannā ni riṇātyojasā ni sthirāṇi cidojasā ||

translations.english: They have presented substantial donations to him, as (they give riches) to a sage, and by resplendent means he grants us (grace) for our preservation; (the worshipper) presents (gifts) to Agni for preservation; he who pervades the (many offerings made to him) consumes them (as rapidly) as (he consumes) forests; he matures the standing corn by his potency; he destroys whatever (things) are stationary by his potency.

mantras.sanskrit: तमस्य पृक्षमुपरासु धीमहि नक्तं यः सुदर्शतरो दिवातरादप्रायुषे दिवातरात् । आदस्यायुर्ग्रभणवद्वीळु शर्म न सूनवे । भक्तमभक्तमवो व्यन्तो अजरा अग्नयो व्यन्तो अजराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamasya pṛkṣamuparāsu dhīmahi naktaṃ yaḥ sudarśataro divātarādaprāyuṣe divātarāt | ādasyāyurgrabhaṇavadvīḷu śarma na sūnave | bhaktamabhaktamavo vyanto ajarā agnayo vyanto ajarāḥ ||

translations.english: We plural ce near the altar the (sacrificial) food of him who is more conspicuous by night than by day; (we offer it) to him who is scarcely alive by day; hence his (sacrificial) food finds prompt acceptance, like dwelling (given by a father) to a son; these undecaying fires, (although) discriminating between the devout and the undevout, grant (both) protection, and accepting (the offerings of the pious), they are exempt from decay.

mantras.sanskrit: स हि शर्धो न मारुतं तुविष्वणिरप्नस्वतीषूर्वरास्विष्टनिरार्तनास्विष्टनिः । आदद्धव्यान्याददिर्यज्ञस्य केतुरर्हणा । अध स्मास्य हर्षतो हृषीवतो विश्वे जुषन्त पन्थां नरः शुभे न पन्थाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa hi śardho na mārutaṃ tuviṣvaṇirapnasvatīṣūrvarāsviṣṭanirārtanāsviṣṭaniḥ | ādaddhavyānyādadiryajñasya keturarhaṇā | adha smāsya harṣato hṛṣīvato viśve juṣanta panthāṃ naraḥ śubhe na panthām ||

translations.english: He roars aloud, like the roaring of the winds, amidst the sanctified and selected (rites of sacred) solemnities; he who is to be worshipped, who is to be adored (for victory) over hosts (of enemies); he, the receiver 9of oblations), the manifester of the sacrifice; he, who is deserving of veneration, devours the oblations; hence, all men for their good pursue the path of Agni, who gives plural asure (to his worshipper), being plural ased (himself), in like manner as men follow a path (that leads) to happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: द्विता यदीं कीस्तासो अभिद्यवो नमस्यन्त उपवोचन्त भृगवो मथ्नन्तो दाशा भृगवः । अग्निरीशे वसूनां शुचिर्यो धर्णिरेषाम् । प्रियाँ अपिधीँर्वनिषीष्ट मेधिर आ वनिषीष्ट मेधिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dvitā yadīṃ kīstāso abhidyavo namasyanta upavocanta bhṛgavo mathnanto dāśā bhṛgavaḥ | agnirīśe vasūnāṃ śuciryo dharṇireṣām | priyā~ apidhī~rvaniṣīṣṭa medhira ā vaniṣīṣṭa medhiraḥ ||

translations.english: The descendants of Bhṛgu, celebrating him (Agni) in both his forms, glorifying him, and payig him homage, proclaim his praises; the descendants of Bhṛgu, rubbing (the flame) for the oblation. For the radiant Agni, who is the guardian of all these treasures, has power (to distribute them). Mayhe, the receier of sacrifices, partake of the agreeable (offerings) given to satiety; may he, the receiver of sacrifices, partake (of the oblations).

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वासां त्वा विशां पतिं हवामहे सर्वासां समानं दम्पतिं भुजे सत्यगिर्वाहसं भुजे । अतिथिं मानुषाणां पितुर्न यस्यासया । अमी च विश्वे अमृतास आ वयो हव्या देवेष्वा वयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvāsāṃ tvā viśāṃ patiṃ havāmahe sarvāsāṃ samānaṃ dampatiṃ bhuje satyagirvāhasaṃ bhuje | atithiṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ piturna yasyāsayā | amī ca viśve amṛtāsa ā vayo havyā deveṣvā vayaḥ ||

translations.english: We invoke you, the protector of all people, the same alike to all, the preserver of the house, to enjoy (the oblation); you, who are the wafter of our infallible prayer, to enjoy (the oblation); we invoke you, who are the guest of men, to whom all these immortals apply for their sustenance, as (a son) to a father; you, to whom the priests offer oblations amongst the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने सहसा सहन्तमः शुष्मिन्तमो जायसे देवतातये रयिर्न देवतातये । शुष्मिन्तमो हि ते मदो द्युम्निन्तम उत क्रतुः । अध स्मा ते परि चरन्त्यजर श्रुष्टीवानो नाजर ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne sahasā sahantamaḥ śuṣmintamo jāyase devatātaye rayirna devatātaye | śuṣmintamo hi te mado dyumnintama uta kratuḥ | adha smā te pari carantyajara śruṣṭīvāno nājara ||

translations.english: You, Agni, the destroyer (of enemies) by your strength, the possessor of great splendour, as born for the sake of sacrificing to the gods, as riches (are genitive rated) for the sake of sacrificing to the gods; verily your exhilaration is most brilliant, your worship is most productive of renown; hence, undecaying Agni, (sacrificers) wait upon you, like envoys (upon a prince; upon you), who preserve (your votaries) from decay.
