mantras.transliteration: ādiddhotāraṃ vṛṇate diviṣṭiṣu bhagamiva papṛcānāsa ṛñjate | devānyatkratvā majmanā puruṣṭuto martaṃ śaṃsaṃ viśvadhā veti dhāyase ||

translations.english: Pious worshippers then adore the invoker (of the gods), for (the propitiation of) the dwellers in heaven, as (such men) adore a powerful prince, since the many-lauded, and all upholding (Agni) knows how by (holy) act and (bodily) strength to bring together the gods and their mortal worshipper for the sake of obtaining (mutual) sustenance.

mantras.sanskrit: वि यदस्थाद्यजतो वातचोदितो ह्वारो न वक्वा जरणा अनाकृतः । तस्य पत्मन्दक्षुषः कृष्णजंहसः शुचिजन्मनो रज आ व्यध्वनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi yadasthādyajato vātacodito hvāro na vakvā jaraṇā anākṛtaḥ | tasya patmandakṣuṣaḥ kṛṣṇajaṃhasaḥ śucijanmano raja ā vyadhvanaḥ ||

translations.english: Since the adorable (Agni), impelled by the wind, spreads in various directions, like an insincere and unrestrained chatterer, (who utters indiscriminate) praises, therefore the world is assiduous in the worship of him, the consumer of all, whose way is dark, who is pure of birth and follows various paths.

mantras.sanskrit: रथो न यातः शिक्वभिः कृतो द्यामङ्गेभिररुषेभिरीयते । आदस्य ते कृष्णासो दक्षि सूरयः शूरस्येव त्वेषथादीषते वयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ratho na yātaḥ śikvabhiḥ kṛto dyāmaṅgebhiraruṣebhirīyate | ādasya te kṛṣṇāso dakṣi sūrayaḥ śūrasyeva tveṣathādīṣate vayaḥ ||

translations.english: Like a chariot drawn by ropes, Agni, set in movement by his own revolving members (his flames), proceeds to the heavens; the paths he traverses are blackened by smoke, as he consumes (the fuel), and (beasts and) birds fly from his radiance as (enemies fly from the prowess) of a hero.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वया ह्यग्ने वरुणो धृतव्रतो मित्रः शाशद्रे अर्यमा सुदानवः । यत्सीमनु क्रतुना विश्वथा विभुररान्न नेमिः परिभूरजायथाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvayā hyagne varuṇo dhṛtavrato mitraḥ śāśadre aryamā sudānavaḥ | yatsīmanu kratunā viśvathā vibhurarānna nemiḥ paribhūrajāyathāḥ ||

translations.english: By you, Agni; Varuṇa, observant of his duties and Mitra and Aryaman, bountiful divinities, are animated, so that yo have been born comprehending them all universally in all (their) functions, and encompassing (them all) as the circumference (encompasses) the spokes (of a wheel).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने शशमानाय सुन्वते रत्नं यविष्ठ देवतातिमिन्वसि । तं त्वा नु नव्यं सहसो युवन्वयं भगं न कारे महिरत्न धीमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne śaśamānāya sunvate ratnaṃ yaviṣṭha devatātiminvasi | taṃ tvā nu navyaṃ sahaso yuvanvayaṃ bhagaṃ na kāre mahiratna dhīmahi ||

translations.english: Most youthful Agni, for the good of him who praises you and offers you libations, you make the precious (offering) acceptable to the gods; new-born of strength we glorify you who are to be lauded; to whom rich offerings (are to be presented); (we glorify you) in (our) hymn as (men eulogize) a powerful prince.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मे रयिं न स्वर्थं दमूनसं भगं दक्षं न पपृचासि धर्णसिम् । रश्मीँरिव यो यमति जन्मनी उभे देवानां शंसमृत आ च सुक्रतुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asme rayiṃ na svarthaṃ damūnasaṃ bhagaṃ dakṣaṃ na papṛcāsi dharṇasim | raśmī~riva yo yamati janmanī ubhe devānāṃ śaṃsamṛta ā ca sukratuḥ ||

translations.english: In like manner as you confer upon us riches, (so you bestow upon us) a well-disposed, docile, and energetic (son); the receptacle (of learning and other merits), one who is the performer of holy rites, Agni, who regulates as it were his own rays, (and the condition) both (his) births, (or heaven and earth), he regulates at (our) sacrifice the adoration of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: उत नः सुद्योत्मा जीराश्वो होता मन्द्रः शृणवच्चन्द्ररथः । स नो नेषन्नेषतमैरमूरोऽग्निर्वामं सुवितं वस्यो अच्छ ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta naḥ sudyotmā jīrāśvo hotā mandraḥ śṛṇavaccandrarathaḥ | sa no neṣanneṣatamairamūro'gnirvāmaṃ suvitaṃ vasyo accha ||

translations.english: May he who is one with light, who has fleet horses, the invoker (of the gods), full of joy, and borne in a golden chariot, listen to us; may that irresistible, yet plural cable Agni, conduct us, by the most efficacious (means), to that desirable and accessible (heaven).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्ताव्यग्निः शिमीवद्भिरर्कैः साम्राज्याय प्रतरं दधानः । अमी च ये मघवानो वयं च मिहं न सूरो अति निष्टतन्युः ॥
mantras.transliteration: astāvyagniḥ śimīvadbhirarkaiḥ sāmrājyāya prataraṃ dadhānaḥ | amī ca ye maghavāno vayaṃ ca mihaṃ na sūro ati niṣṭatanyuḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, possessing eminent (fitness) for supreme sovereignty, has been glorified by us, with holy rites (śimī śaktiḥ: Nirukta 2.1.24), and with hymns. Let all who are presen1, as well as we ourselves, enriched (by his favour), shout aloud (the praise of Agni), as (loudly as) the sun (causes) the rain-cloud (to thunder).

mantras.sanskrit: समिद्धो अग्न आ वह देवाँ अद्य यतस्रुचे । तन्तुं तनुष्व पूर्व्यं सुतसोमाय दाशुषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: samiddho agna ā vaha devā~ adya yatasruce | tantuṃ tanuṣva pūrvyaṃ sutasomāya dāśuṣe ||

translations.english: Agni, who are samiddha, bring the gods today (to the worshipper), whose ladle is uplifted; extent (the merit of) former sacrificer to the giver (of the offering), by whom the Soma is poured forth.

mantras.sanskrit: घृतवन्तमुप मासि मधुमन्तं तनूनपात् । यज्ञं विप्रस्य मावतः शशमानस्य दाशुषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ghṛtavantamupa māsi madhumantaṃ tanūnapāt | yajñaṃ viprasya māvataḥ śaśamānasya dāśuṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Tanūnapāt, be present at this well-flavoured and cutter-fed sacrifice, (the offering) of a pious offerer (of oblations); glorifying you.

mantras.sanskrit: शुचिः पावको अद्भुतो मध्वा यज्ञं मिमिक्षति । नराशंसस्त्रिरा दिवो देवो देवेषु यज्ञियः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śuciḥ pāvako adbhuto madhvā yajñaṃ mimikṣati | narāśaṃsastrirā divo devo deveṣu yajñiyaḥ ||

translations.english: The pure, purifying, wonderful Narāśaṃsa, an adorable god among gods, (having come) from heaven, thrice mixes the sacrifice with the sweet (Soma).

mantras.sanskrit: ईळितो अग्न आ वहेन्द्रं चित्रमिह प्रियम् । इयं हि त्वा मतिर्ममाच्छा सुजिह्व वच्यते ॥
mantras.transliteration: īḷito agna ā vahendraṃ citramiha priyam | iyaṃ hi tvā matirmamācchā sujihva vacyate ||

translations.english: Agni, who are Iḷita, bring hither Indra, the wonderful, the beloved; this my praise is recited, bright-tongued, before you.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तृणानासो यतस्रुचो बर्हिर्यज्ञे स्वध्वरे । वृञ्जे देवव्यचस्तममिन्द्राय शर्म सप्रथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: stṛṇānāso yatasruco barhiryajñe svadhvare | vṛñje devavyacastamamindrāya śarma saprathaḥ ||

translations.english: The priests, bearing ladles, are strewing the sacred grass in this holy sacrifice, to prepare a god-frequented and well-spread abode for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: वि श्रयन्तामृतावृधः प्रयै देवेभ्यो महीः । पावकासः पुरुस्पृहो द्वारो देवीरसश्चतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi śrayantāmṛtāvṛdhaḥ prayai devebhyo mahīḥ | pāvakāsaḥ puruspṛho dvāro devīrasaścataḥ ||

translations.english: Let the bright, separable doors, the augmenters of sacrifice, the purifiers of rites, the desired of many, be set open for the gods to enter.

mantras.sanskrit: आ भन्दमाने उपाके नक्तोषासा सुपेशसा । यह्वी ऋतस्य मातरा सीदतां बर्हिरा सुमत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā bhandamāne upāke naktoṣāsā supeśasā | yahvī ṛtasya mātarā sīdatāṃ barhirā sumat ||

translations.english: Beautiful night and morning, ever hymned, ever associated, progeny (yahuḥ sunuḥ--Nirukta 2.2.11) (of time), parents of sacrifice, sit down of your own good will on the sacred grass.

mantras.sanskrit: मन्द्रजिह्वा जुगुर्वणी होतारा दैव्या कवी । यज्ञं नो यक्षतामिमं सिध्रमद्य दिविस्पृशम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mandrajihvā jugurvaṇī hotārā daivyā kavī | yajñaṃ no yakṣatāmimaṃ sidhramadya divispṛśam ||

translations.english: May the two plural asing-tongued receivers of praise, the divine and sage invokers (of the gods), officiate today at this our sacrifice, which confers (rewards) and attains heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: शुचिर्देवेष्वर्पिता होत्रा मरुत्सु भारती । इळा सरस्वती मही बर्हिः सीदन्तु यज्ञियाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śucirdeveṣvarpitā hotrā marutsu bhāratī | iḷā sarasvatī mahī barhiḥ sīdantu yajñiyāḥ ||

translations.english: May the pure hotā, plural ced among the gods, and Bhāratī, among the Maruts, and may the adorable Iḷā, Sarasvatī, Mahī, sit down upon the sacred grass.

mantras.sanskrit: तन्नस्तुरीपमद्भुतं पुरु वारं पुरु त्मना । त्वष्टा पोषाय वि ष्यतु राये नाभा नो अस्मयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tannasturīpamadbhutaṃ puru vāraṃ puru tmanā | tvaṣṭā poṣāya vi ṣyatu rāye nābhā no asmayuḥ ||

translations.english: May Tvaṣṭā, favourably disposed towards us, send to us, for our nourishment and prosperity, the quick (falling), wonderful, abundant (water), in the centre (of the cloud, effecting), of itself much (good).

mantras.sanskrit: अवसृजन्नुप त्मना देवान्यक्षि वनस्पते । अग्निर्हव्या सुषूदति देवो देवेषु मेधिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: avasṛjannupa tmanā devānyakṣi vanaspate | agnirhavyā suṣūdati devo deveṣu medhiraḥ ||

translations.english: Vanaspati, here present of your own accord, convey our offerings to the gods; the divine and intelligent Agni accepts (the oblations) for the deities.

mantras.sanskrit: पूषण्वते मरुत्वते विश्वदेवाय वायवे । स्वाहा गायत्रवेपसे हव्यमिन्द्राय कर्तन ॥
mantras.transliteration: pūṣaṇvate marutvate viśvadevāya vāyave | svāhā gāyatravepase havyamindrāya kartana ||

translations.english: (Priests), present the oblation with svāhā to Indra, in the form of Gāyatra, along with Pūṣan and the Maruts; also to the assembled gods, and the Vāyu.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वाहाकृतान्या गह्युप हव्यानि वीतये । इन्द्रा गहि श्रुधी हवं त्वां हवन्ते अध्वरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: svāhākṛtānyā gahyupa havyāni vītaye | indrā gahi śrudhī havaṃ tvāṃ havante adhvare ||

translations.english: Approach, Indra, to partake of the oblations consecrated with svāhā; approach and hear the invocation, as they invoke you to the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र तव्यसीं नव्यसीं धीतिमग्नये वाचो मतिं सहसः सूनवे भरे । अपां नपाद्यो वसुभिः सह प्रियो होता पृथिव्यां न्यसीददृत्वियः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra tavyasīṃ navyasīṃ dhītimagnaye vāco matiṃ sahasaḥ sūnave bhare | apāṃ napādyo vasubhiḥ saha priyo hotā pṛthivyāṃ nyasīdadṛtviyaḥ ||

translations.english: I offer devoutly to Agni, the son of strength, an invigorating and most new sacrifice, with words of adoration; (that Agni), the grandson of the waters, who, (present) in due season, the friend and ministering priest (of the sacrificer), sits upon the altar with (many) good things.

mantras.sanskrit: स जायमानः परमे व्योमन्याविरग्निरभवन्मातरिश्वने । अस्य क्रत्वा समिधानस्य मज्मना प्र द्यावा शोचिः पृथिवी अरोचयत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa jāyamānaḥ parame vyomanyāviragnirabhavanmātariśvane | asya kratvā samidhānasya majmanā pra dyāvā śociḥ pṛthivī arocayat ||

translations.english: As soon as born, what that (Agni) manifested to Matariśvan in the highest atmosphere, and his radiance, kindled by vigorous effort, spread through heaven and earth.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य त्वेषा अजरा अस्य भानवः सुसंदृशः सुप्रतीकस्य सुद्युतः । भात्वक्षसो अत्यक्तुर्न सिन्धवोऽग्ने रेजन्ते अससन्तो अजराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya tveṣā ajarā asya bhānavaḥ susaṃdṛśaḥ supratīkasya sudyutaḥ | bhātvakṣaso atyakturna sindhavo'gne rejante asasanto ajarāḥ ||

translations.english: His radiance is undecaying; the rays of him who is of plural asing aspect, are everywhere visible and bright; the intensely shining, all-pervading, unceasing, undecaying (rays) of Agni, desist not (from their functions).

mantras.sanskrit: यमेरिरे भृगवो विश्ववेदसं नाभा पृथिव्या भुवनस्य मज्मना । अग्निं तं गीर्भिर्हिनुहि स्व आ दमे य एको वस्वो वरुणो न राजति ॥
mantras.transliteration: yamerire bhṛgavo viśvavedasaṃ nābhā pṛthivyā bhuvanasya majmanā | agniṃ taṃ gīrbhirhinuhi sva ā dame ya eko vasvo varuṇo na rājati ||

translations.english: Bring to his own abode with hymns that Agni, the possessor of all riches, whom the descendants of Bhṛgu plural ced by the strength of all beings upon the navel of the earth; for, like Varuṇa, he reigns sole (monarch) over (all) treasure.

mantras.sanskrit: न यो वराय मरुतामिव स्वनः सेनेव सृष्टा दिव्या यथाशनिः । अग्निर्जम्भैस्तिगितैरत्ति भर्वति योधो न शत्रून्त्स वना न्यृञ्जते ॥
mantras.transliteration: na yo varāya marutāmiva svanaḥ seneva sṛṣṭā divyā yathāśaniḥ | agnirjambhaistigitairatti bharvati yodho na śatrūntsa vanā nyṛñjate ||

translations.english: Agni, who, like the roaring of the winds, like a victorious host, like the thunderbolt in heaven, is not to be arrested, devours and destroys (our foes) with sharpened teeth (bharva hiṃsāyām; bharvatirattikarmā: Nirukta 9.23), and, as a warrior (annihilates his enemies), he, (Agni), lays waste the woods.

mantras.sanskrit: कुविन्नो अग्निरुचथस्य वीरसद्वसुष्कुविद्वसुभिः काममावरत् । चोदः कुवित्तुतुज्यात्सातये धियः शुचिप्रतीकं तमया धिया गृणे ॥
mantras.transliteration: kuvinno agnirucathasya vīrasadvasuṣkuvidvasubhiḥ kāmamāvarat | codaḥ kuvittutujyātsātaye dhiyaḥ śucipratīkaṃ tamayā dhiyā gṛṇe ||

translations.english: May Agni be ever desirous of our praise; may the giver of wealth satisfy our utmost expectation with riches; may the inspirer (of our devotion) hasten our rites to fruition. I glorify him, the radiant-limbed (Agni), with this laudation.

mantras.sanskrit: घृतप्रतीकं व ऋतस्य धूर्षदमग्निं मित्रं न समिधान ऋञ्जते । इन्धानो अक्रो विदथेषु दीद्यच्छुक्रवर्णामुदु नो यंसते धियम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ghṛtapratīkaṃ va ṛtasya dhūrṣadamagniṃ mitraṃ na samidhāna ṛñjate | indhāno akro vidatheṣu dīdyacchukravarṇāmudu no yaṃsate dhiyam ||

translations.english: The kindler (of the sacrificial fire) propitiates Agni, of glistening form; the upholder of your ceremony, like a friend; well kindled and well supplied (with fuel); blazing brightly at holy rites, he illumines our pure and pious observances.

mantras.sanskrit: अप्रयुच्छन्नप्रयुच्छद्भिरग्ने शिवेभिर्नः पायुभिः पाहि शग्मैः । अदब्धेभिरदृपितेभिरिष्टेऽनिमिषद्भिः परि पाहि नो जाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aprayucchannaprayucchadbhiragne śivebhirnaḥ pāyubhiḥ pāhi śagmaiḥ | adabdhebhiradṛpitebhiriṣṭe'nimiṣadbhiḥ pari pāhi no jāḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, never heedless (of us), guard us with never heedless, auspicious, and joy-bestowing cares; do you, who are desired (by all), protect us, and those born of us, with unobstructed unovercome, and never slumbering (vigilance).

mantras.sanskrit: एति प्र होता व्रतमस्य माययोर्ध्वां दधानः शुचिपेशसं धियम् । अभि स्रुचः क्रमते दक्षिणावृतो या अस्य धाम प्रथमं ह निंसते ॥
mantras.transliteration: eti pra hotā vratamasya māyayordhvāṃ dadhānaḥ śucipeśasaṃ dhiyam | abhi srucaḥ kramate dakṣiṇāvṛto yā asya dhāma prathamaṃ ha niṃsate ||

translations.english: The ministering priest, (qualified) by experience, and possessing exalted and graceful devotion,proceeds (to celebrate) his, (Agni's), worship, having circumambulated (the altar), he takes up the ladles which are first to present theoblations.

mantras.sanskrit: अभीमृतस्य दोहना अनूषत योनौ देवस्य सदने परीवृताः । अपामुपस्थे विभृतो यदावसदध स्वधा अधयद्याभिरीयते ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhīmṛtasya dohanā anūṣata yonau devasya sadane parīvṛtāḥ | apāmupasthe vibhṛto yadāvasadadha svadhā adhayadyābhirīyate ||

translations.english: The drops of rain, enveloped (by the solar rays), are renewed in the dwelling of the divine (sun), their birth-plural ce; when he, (Agni), abides cherished on the lap of the waters, then (the world) drinks the nectareous (rain), with which he, (as the lightning), associates.

mantras.sanskrit: युयूषतः सवयसा तदिद्वपुः समानमर्थं वितरित्रता मिथः । आदीं भगो न हव्यः समस्मदा वोळ्हुर्न रश्मीन्त्समयंस्त सारथिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuyūṣataḥ savayasā tadidvapuḥ samānamarthaṃ vitaritratā mithaḥ | ādīṃ bhago na havyaḥ samasmadā voḷhurna raśmīntsamayaṃsta sārathiḥ ||

translations.english: The two (priests, the hotī and adhvaryu), of equal honour, and alike assiduous, labouring mutually for a common object, combine the form of Agni (with their respective functions); whereupon he to whom the oblation is to be offered, collects the drops (of clarified butter), as Bhaga (accepts the worship of all), or as a charioteer (gathers the reins of the horses) that draw (the car).

mantras.sanskrit: यमीं द्वा सवयसा सपर्यतः समाने योना मिथुना समोकसा । दिवा न नक्तं पलितो युवाजनि पुरू चरन्नजरो मानुषा युगा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yamīṃ dvā savayasā saparyataḥ samāne yonā mithunā samokasā | divā na naktaṃ palito yuvājani purū carannajaro mānuṣā yugā ||

translations.english: He, whom the two, a pair of equal power, dwelling in the same plural ce, and engaged in the same ceremony, worship night and day; he, whether old or young, has been engendered for the sake of mortal couples, accepting many (oblations), and exempt from decay.

mantras.sanskrit: तमीं हिन्वन्ति धीतयो दश व्रिशो देवं मर्तास ऊतये हवामहे । धनोरधि प्रवत आ स ऋण्वत्यभिव्रजद्भिर्वयुना नवाधित ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamīṃ hinvanti dhītayo daśa vriśo devaṃ martāsa ūtaye havāmahe | dhanoradhi pravata ā sa ṛṇvatyabhivrajadbhirvayunā navādhita ||

translations.english: The ten fingers intertwined propitiate that divine (Agni), whom we mortals invoke for protection; he darts (his rays) like swift (arrows) from a bow, and accepts the new praises (uttered) by those who crowd round the altar.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं ह्यग्ने दिव्यस्य राजसि त्वं पार्थिवस्य पशुपा इव त्मना । एनी त एते बृहती अभिश्रिया हिरण्ययी वक्वरी बर्हिराशाते ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ hyagne divyasya rājasi tvaṃ pārthivasya paśupā iva tmanā | enī ta ete bṛhatī abhiśriyā hiraṇyayī vakvarī barhirāśāte ||

translations.english: You, Agni, reign over (the dweller in) heaven, and over those of earth, according to thine own (will), as a herdsman over his (herd), and those two, (heaven and earth), bright, vast, adorable, beneficent, and sounding (agreeably), partake of the oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने जुषस्व प्रति हर्य तद्वचो मन्द्र स्वधाव ऋतजात सुक्रतो । यो विश्वतः प्रत्यङ्ङसि दर्शतो रण्वः संदृष्टौ पितुमाँ इव क्षयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne juṣasva prati harya tadvaco mandra svadhāva ṛtajāta sukrato | yo viśvataḥ pratyaṅṅasi darśato raṇvaḥ saṃdṛṣṭau pitumā~ iva kṣayaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, who confers happiness, who accepts oblations, who was born for sacrifice, and are the performer of good works, be plural ased (with this rite), attend to this prayer; for you are in presence of all (the world), are visible (to all), are plural asant in their sight, and are their refuge, like a (bountiful) distributor of food.

mantras.sanskrit: तं पृच्छता स जगामा स वेद स चिकित्वाँ ईयते सा न्वीयते । तस्मिन्त्सन्ति प्रशिषस्तस्मिन्निष्टयः स वाजस्य शवसः शुष्मिणस्पतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ pṛcchatā sa jagāmā sa veda sa cikitvā~ īyate sā nvīyate | tasmintsanti praśiṣastasminniṣṭayaḥ sa vājasya śavasaḥ śuṣmiṇaspatiḥ ||

translations.english: Ask (of Agni what you desire), for he goes (everywhere), he knows (all things); possessed of intelligence, he proceeds (to ascertain what is to be done), and is had recourse to (by his worshippers); for in him is the power of restraining (unreasonable desires) in him (is the power of granting) enjoyment; he is the giver of food and of strength; the protector of the mighty.

mantras.sanskrit: तमित्पृच्छन्ति न सिमो वि पृच्छति स्वेनेव धीरो मनसा यदग्रभीत् । न मृष्यते प्रथमं नापरं वचोऽस्य क्रत्वा सचते अप्रदृपितः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamitpṛcchanti na simo vi pṛcchati sveneva dhīro manasā yadagrabhīt | na mṛṣyate prathamaṃ nāparaṃ vaco'sya kratvā sacate apradṛpitaḥ ||

translations.english: They ask of Agni, but no one asks improperly; for a sensible man (replies to solicitation) as he has determined in his own mind; Agni tolerates not a speech that anticipates (his reply), nor endures a rejoinder; he who is devoid of arrogance is favoured by his protection.

mantras.sanskrit: तमिद्गच्छन्ति जुह्वस्तमर्वतीर्विश्वान्येकः शृणवद्वचांसि मे । पुरुप्रैषस्ततुरिर्यज्ञसाधनोऽच्छिद्रोतिः शिशुरादत्त सं रभः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamidgacchanti juhvastamarvatīrviśvānyekaḥ śṛṇavadvacāṃsi me | purupraiṣastaturiryajñasādhano'cchidrotiḥ śiśurādatta saṃ rabhaḥ ||

translations.english: To him the (sacrificial) ladles are directed; to him (our) praises are addressed; he alone hears all my prayers; be is the instrumental gator of many, the transporter (across the world), the instrumental ument of sacrifice, the unintermitting preserver (of mankind), and (genitive le as) an infant; provided with the preparations (of sacrifice), he accepts libations.

mantras.sanskrit: उपस्थायं चरति यत्समारत सद्यो जातस्तत्सार युज्येभिः । अभि श्वान्तं मृशते नान्द्ये मुदे यदीं गच्छन्त्युशतीरपिष्ठितम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: upasthāyaṃ carati yatsamārata sadyo jātastatsāra yujyebhiḥ | abhi śvāntaṃ mṛśate nāndye mude yadīṃ gacchantyuśatīrapiṣṭhitam ||

translations.english: When (the priest) proceeds to effect his development, he is (at once) manifested; and as soon as engendered, is associated with his objects; he provides for the gratification (of his worshipper), plural cidly engaged in the agreeable (rite), when the (oblations) that desire (his acceptance) reach him present (at the sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: स ईं मृगो अप्यो वनर्गुरुप त्वच्युपमस्यां नि धायि । व्यब्रवीद्वयुना मर्त्येभ्योऽग्निर्विद्वाँ ऋतचिद्धि सत्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa īṃ mṛgo apyo vanargurupa tvacyupamasyāṃ ni dhāyi | vyabravīdvayunā martyebhyo'gnirvidvā~ ṛtaciddhi satyaḥ ||

translations.english: He, the searcher, the accessible, the dweller in woods, has been plural ced (amidst the fuel), as in the similitude of (an enveloping) skin; the wise Agni, the appreciater of sacrifice, the veracious, has declared to mortals (the knowledge of) their religious duties.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिमूर्धानं सप्तरश्मिं गृणीषेऽनूनमग्निं पित्रोरुपस्थे । निषत्तमस्य चरतो ध्रुवस्य विश्वा दिवो रोचनापप्रिवांसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: trimūrdhānaṃ saptaraśmiṃ gṛṇīṣe'nūnamagniṃ pitrorupasthe | niṣattamasya carato dhruvasya viśvā divo rocanāpaprivāṃsam ||

translations.english: Glorify the three-headed, seven-rayed Agni, who is sibject to no diminution, seated on the lap of his parents, (heaven and earth); and gratifying all (desires); as the universal radiance of the divine (Agni), whether moving or stationary, (spreads around).

mantras.sanskrit: उक्षा महाँ अभि ववक्ष एने अजरस्तस्थावितऊतिॠष्वः । उर्व्याः पदो नि दधाति सानौ रिहन्त्यूधो अरुषासो अस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: ukṣā mahā~ abhi vavakṣa ene ajarastasthāvitaūtiṝṣvaḥ | urvyāḥ pado ni dadhāti sānau rihantyūdho aruṣāso asya ||

translations.english: The great showerer (of benefits) has pervaded these two (worlds); undecaying and adorable, he is (ever) present, bestowing protection; he plural ces his foot on the summit of the earth, and his radiant (flames) lick the udder (of the firmament).

mantras.sanskrit: समानं वत्समभि संचरन्ती विष्वग्धेनू वि चरतः सुमेके । अनपवृज्याँ अध्वनो मिमाने विश्वान्केताँ अधि महो दधाने ॥
mantras.transliteration: samānaṃ vatsamabhi saṃcarantī viṣvagdhenū vi carataḥ sumeke | anapavṛjyā~ adhvano mimāne viśvānketā~ adhi maho dadhāne ||

translations.english: (there are) two well-disposed cows together approaching their common progeny, and fully nourishing (him); pointingout the paths that are free from all that is to be avoided, and possessing more than the great intelligence (necessary for his development).

mantras.sanskrit: धीरासः पदं कवयो नयन्ति नाना हृदा रक्षमाणा अजुर्यम् । सिषासन्तः पर्यपश्यन्त सिन्धुमाविरेभ्यो अभवत्सूर्यो नॄन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhīrāsaḥ padaṃ kavayo nayanti nānā hṛdā rakṣamāṇā ajuryam | siṣāsantaḥ paryapaśyanta sindhumāvirebhyo abhavatsūryo nṝn ||

translations.english: Experienced sages (kavayaḥ: ye vā anūcāste kavayaḥ--Aitareya Brāhmaṇa 2.2) bring the invincible (Agni), to his station (onthe altar); cherishing him in manifold (ways) in their hearts; desirous of propitiating him, they worshipthe (boon) shedding (Agni); and to those men he is manifest as the Sun.

mantras.sanskrit: दिदृक्षेण्यः परि काष्ठासु जेन्य ईळेन्यो महो अर्भाय जीवसे । पुरुत्रा यदभवत्सूरहैभ्यो गर्भेभ्यो मघवा विश्वदर्शतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: didṛkṣeṇyaḥ pari kāṣṭhāsu jenya īḷenyo maho arbhāya jīvase | purutrā yadabhavatsūrahaibhyo garbhebhyo maghavā viśvadarśataḥ ||

translations.english: He is willing to be seen in the (ten) regions (of space); the victorious, the adorable, the source of life to great and small; inasmuch as in many plural ces the opulent (possessor of sacrificial food), who is visible to all, is the parent of that (pious) progeny.

mantras.sanskrit: कथा ते अग्ने शुचयन्त आयोर्ददाशुर्वाजेभिराशुषाणाः । उभे यत्तोके तनये दधाना ऋतस्य सामन्रणयन्त देवाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kathā te agne śucayanta āyordadāśurvājebhirāśuṣāṇāḥ | ubhe yattoke tanaye dadhānā ṛtasya sāmanraṇayanta devāḥ ||

translations.english: How have your shining and evaporating (rays), Agni, supported life (and supplied) food; so that, enjoying both, the devout (worshippers), possessing sons and grandsons, may repeat the hymns of the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: बोधा मे अस्य वचसो यविष्ठ मंहिष्ठस्य प्रभृतस्य स्वधावः । पीयति त्वो अनु त्वो गृणाति वन्दारुस्ते तन्वं वन्दे अग्ने ॥
mantras.transliteration: bodhā me asya vacaso yaviṣṭha maṃhiṣṭhasya prabhṛtasya svadhāvaḥ | pīyati tvo anu tvo gṛṇāti vandāruste tanvaṃ vande agne ||

translations.english: Youthful (Agni), to whom oblations are due, appreciate this my reverential and earnest praise; one man reviles (you), another propitiates (you); I, your worshipper, glorify, your person n.

mantras.sanskrit: ये पायवो मामतेयं ते अग्ने पश्यन्तो अन्धं दुरितादरक्षन् । ररक्ष तान्त्सुकृतो विश्ववेदा दिप्सन्त इद्रिपवो नाह देभुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye pāyavo māmateyaṃ te agne paśyanto andhaṃ duritādarakṣan | rarakṣa tāntsukṛto viśvavedā dipsanta idripavo nāha debhuḥ ||

translations.english: Your fostering (rays), Agni, beholding the blind son of Mamatā, relieved him of the affliction; he who knows all things protect the pious, and (their) malevolent enemies are unable to do them harm.

mantras.sanskrit: यो नो अग्ने अररिवाँ अघायुररातीवा मर्चयति द्वयेन । मन्त्रो गुरुः पुनरस्तु सो अस्मा अनु मृक्षीष्ट तन्वं दुरुक्तैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo no agne ararivā~ aghāyurarātīvā marcayati dvayena | mantro guruḥ punarastu so asmā anu mṛkṣīṣṭa tanvaṃ duruktaiḥ ||

translations.english: When a wicked (man), with twofold (malignity of thought and speech), obstructing our offerings, and refraining from gifts (himself), reviles us, may his prayer be heavy on him, and involve his person n (in the consequences of) his evil words.

mantras.sanskrit: उत वा यः सहस्य प्रविद्वान्मर्तो मर्तं मर्चयति द्वयेन । अतः पाहि स्तवमान स्तुवन्तमग्ने माकिर्नो दुरिताय धायीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta vā yaḥ sahasya pravidvānmarto martaṃ marcayati dvayena | ataḥ pāhi stavamāna stuvantamagne mākirno duritāya dhāyīḥ ||

translations.english: When, Son of Strength, a man skilful (in deception) assails another man with a doubly (malignant prayer), do you, Agni, duly propitiated, protect him who worships you (from its effects); consign us not to misfortune.

mantras.sanskrit: मथीद्यदीं विष्टो मातरिश्वा होतारं विश्वाप्सुं विश्वदेव्यम् । नि यं दधुर्मनुष्यासु विक्षु स्वर्ण चित्रं वपुषे विभावम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mathīdyadīṃ viṣṭo mātariśvā hotāraṃ viśvāpsuṃ viśvadevyam | ni yaṃ dadhurmanuṣyāsu vikṣu svarṇa citraṃ vapuṣe vibhāvam ||

translations.english: The wind, penetrating (amidst the fuel), has excited (Agni), the invoker (of the gods), the multiform, the minister of all the deities, whom they have established amongst mortal worshippers for the accomplishment of sacrifice, like the wonderful and variously radiant sun.

mantras.sanskrit: ददानमिन्न ददभन्त मन्माग्निर्वरूथं मम तस्य चाकन् । जुषन्त विश्वान्यस्य कर्मोपस्तुतिं भरमाणस्य कारोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dadānaminna dadabhanta manmāgnirvarūthaṃ mama tasya cākan | juṣanta viśvānyasya karmopastutiṃ bharamāṇasya kāroḥ ||

translations.english: Let not (my enemies) prevail against me, when presenting acceptable (oblations), for (Agni) is desirous of my so offered adoration, and all they (the gods) are gratified by the (pious) acts of me, the reciter of their praise, and the celebrator (of the sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: नित्ये चिन्नु यं सदने जगृभ्रे प्रशस्तिभिर्दधिरे यज्ञियासः । प्र सू नयन्त गृभयन्त इष्टावश्वासो न रथ्यो रारहाणाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nitye cinnu yaṃ sadane jagṛbhre praśastibhirdadhire yajñiyāsaḥ | pra sū nayanta gṛbhayanta iṣṭāvaśvāso na rathyo rārahāṇāḥ ||

translations.english: Him, whom the worshippers lay hold of in his perpetual abode, they detain by their praises, and the holders convey him diligently to the sacrifice, as rapid coursers, harnessed to a car, (bear the rider to his destination).

mantras.sanskrit: पुरूणि दस्मो नि रिणाति जम्भैराद्रोचते वन आ विभावा । आदस्य वातो अनु वाति शोचिरस्तुर्न शर्यामसनामनु द्यून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: purūṇi dasmo ni riṇāti jambhairādrocate vana ā vibhāvā | ādasya vāto anu vāti śocirasturna śaryāmasanāmanu dyūn ||

translations.english: The destroyer, (Agni), consumes numerous (trees) by his flames, and shares with manifold radiance in the forest; the favouring wind blows (the flames) onwards day by day, like the swift arrows (śaryā iṣavaḥ śaramayyaḥ--Nirukta 5.4) of an archer.

mantras.sanskrit: न यं रिपवो न रिषण्यवो गर्भे सन्तं रेषणा रेषयन्ति । अन्धा अपश्या न दभन्नभिख्या नित्यास ईं प्रेतारो अरक्षन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: na yaṃ ripavo na riṣaṇyavo garbhe santaṃ reṣaṇā reṣayanti | andhā apaśyā na dabhannabhikhyā nityāsa īṃ pretāro arakṣan ||

translations.english: The blind (of intellect), or those who see not (physically), detract not from his glory, whom no enemies no malevolent adversaries, harm, even whilst yet in (his) embryo (condition), for his constant encouragers defend him.

mantras.sanskrit: महः स राय एषते पतिर्दन्निन इनस्य वसुनः पद आ । उप ध्रजन्तमद्रयो विधन्नित् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahaḥ sa rāya eṣate patirdannina inasya vasunaḥ pada ā | upa dhrajantamadrayo vidhannit ||

translations.english: Agni, the lord of great wealth, the granter (of desires) comes (to the plural ce of sacrifice); he, the lord of lords, comes to the plural ce of affluence, (the altar); the stones prepare (the libation fo rhim) as he approaches.

mantras.sanskrit: स यो वृषा नरां न रोदस्योः श्रवोभिरस्ति जीवपीतसर्गः । प्र यः सस्राणः शिश्रीत योनौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa yo vṛṣā narāṃ na rodasyoḥ śravobhirasti jīvapītasargaḥ | pra yaḥ sasrāṇaḥ śiśrīta yonau ||

translations.english: He, who is, as it were, the genitive rator of men as well as of heaven and earth, of whom creation has imbibed life, abides with his glories; he it is who, entering into the womb (of being), procreates (all living creatures).

mantras.sanskrit: आ यः पुरं नार्मिणीमदीदेदत्यः कविर्नभन्यो नार्वा । सूरो न रुरुक्वाञ्छतात्मा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yaḥ puraṃ nārmiṇīmadīdedatyaḥ kavirnabhanyo nārvā | sūro na rurukvāñchatātmā ||

translations.english: He who is wise, and goes (wheresoever he will), like the rapid ethereal (wind), has lighted up the delightful spot, (the altar), and, identical with many forms, is radiant as the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि द्विजन्मा त्री रोचनानि विश्वा रजांसि शुशुचानो अस्थात् । होता यजिष्ठो अपां सधस्थे ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi dvijanmā trī rocanāni viśvā rajāṃsi śuśucāno asthāt | hotā yajiṣṭho apāṃ sadhasthe ||

translations.english: He the twice-born, illuminating the three bright (regions), and shining over all the lustrous spheres, the adorable invoker of the gods, is present at the plural ce where the waters are collected.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं स होता यो द्विजन्मा विश्वा दधे वार्याणि श्रवस्या । मर्तो यो अस्मै सुतुको ददाश ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ sa hotā yo dvijanmā viśvā dadhe vāryāṇi śravasyā | marto yo asmai sutuko dadāśa ||

translations.english: He is the offerer of oblations, who is of twofold birth; and, through desire of (sacrificial) food, has in his keeping all good things; the man who presents offerings to him is the parent of excellent offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: पुरु त्वा दाश्वान्वोचेऽरिरग्ने तव स्विदा । तोदस्येव शरण आ महस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: puru tvā dāśvānvoce'riragne tava svidā | todasyeva śaraṇa ā mahasya ||

translations.english: Presenting many offerings, I address you, Agni, ever coming into your presence (like a servant) in the dwelling of a mighty master.

mantras.sanskrit: व्यनिनस्य धनिनः प्रहोषे चिदररुषः । कदा चन प्रजिगतो अदेवयोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vyaninasya dhaninaḥ prahoṣe cidararuṣaḥ | kadā cana prajigato adevayoḥ ||

translations.english: (I ask you also to withhold your favour) from (those) two godless (person ns), from the rich man, who acknowledging you not as his lord, is chary of gifts at sacred rites, and from him who rarely praises (the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: स चन्द्रो विप्र मर्त्यो महो व्राधन्तमो दिवि । प्रप्रेत्ते अग्ने वनुषः स्याम ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa candro vipra martyo maho vrādhantamo divi | praprette agne vanuṣaḥ syāma ||

translations.english: Sage Agni, the mortal (who propitiates you) becomes a moon in heaven, the most eminent of the great (deities); may we, therefore, ever be in an especial manner your worshippers.

mantras.sanskrit: मित्रं न यं शिम्या गोषु गव्यवः स्वाध्यो विदथे अप्सु जीजनन् । अरेजेतां रोदसी पाजसा गिरा प्रति प्रियं यजतं जनुषामवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mitraṃ na yaṃ śimyā goṣu gavyavaḥ svādhyo vidathe apsu jījanan | arejetāṃ rodasī pājasā girā prati priyaṃ yajataṃ januṣāmavaḥ ||

translations.english: Heaven and earth have been terrified by the strength and the noise (of him), whom pious worshippers, desirous of acquiring cattle, have genitive rated by their (sacred) acts, amidst the waters (of the firmament), at the sacrifice, as a friend for the preservation of living beings, the benefactor (of man), and entitled to adoration.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्ध त्यद्वां पुरुमीळ्हस्य सोमिनः प्र मित्रासो न दधिरे स्वाभुवः । अध क्रतुं विदतं गातुमर्चत उत श्रुतं वृषणा पस्त्यावतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaddha tyadvāṃ purumīḷhasya sominaḥ pra mitrāso na dadhire svābhuvaḥ | adha kratuṃ vidataṃ gātumarcata uta śrutaṃ vṛṣaṇā pastyāvataḥ ||

translations.english: Since they, (the priests), like friends, have prepared for you both, (Mitra and Varuṇa a libation) of the abundantly-flowing and spontaneous Soma, therefore do you consent to come to the rite of the worshipper, and listen, showerers (of blessings), to the (prayers of the) householdeṛ

mantras.sanskrit: आ वां भूषन्क्षितयो जन्म रोदस्योः प्रवाच्यं वृषणा दक्षसे महे । यदीमृताय भरथो यदर्वते प्र होत्रया शिम्या वीथो अध्वरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāṃ bhūṣankṣitayo janma rodasyoḥ pravācyaṃ vṛṣaṇā dakṣase mahe | yadīmṛtāya bharatho yadarvate pra hotrayā śimyā vītho adhvaram ||

translations.english: For the sake (of obtaining) great vigour, showerers (of benefits), men glorify your birth from heaven and earth, which is to be extolled, inasmuch as you bestow (his desires) upon the worshipper (as the reward) of his sacrifice, and accept the rite (that is solemnized) with praise and oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सा क्षितिरसुर या महि प्रिय ऋतावानावृतमा घोषथो बृहत् । युवं दिवो बृहतो दक्षमाभुवं गां न धुर्युप युञ्जाथे अपः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra sā kṣitirasura yā mahi priya ṛtāvānāvṛtamā ghoṣatho bṛhat | yuvaṃ divo bṛhato dakṣamābhuvaṃ gāṃ na dhuryupa yuñjāthe apaḥ ||

translations.english: Powerful divinities, most acceptable to you both is that spot, (where you are worshipped); accepters of sacrifice, proclaim the great ceremony (as duly performed); for you two connect the efficacious and comprehensive rise with the vast heaven, like a cow with a burden.

mantras.sanskrit: मही अत्र महिना वारमृण्वथोऽरेणवस्तुज आ सद्मन्धेनवः । स्वरन्ति ता उपरताति सूर्यमा निम्रुच उषसस्तक्ववीरिव ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahī atra mahinā vāramṛṇvatho'reṇavastuja ā sadmandhenavaḥ | svaranti tā uparatāti sūryamā nimruca uṣasastakvavīriva ||

translations.english: You bring (the cattle) to their acceptable (pasture) upon earth, whence the milk-yielding cows, protected by your power, return unharmed to their stalls; they cry to the sun (in heaven) above, both at evening and at dawn, as one (cries aloud) who detects a thief.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वामृताय केशिनीरनूषत मित्र यत्र वरुण गातुमर्चथः । अव त्मना सृजतं पिन्वतं धियो युवं विप्रस्य मन्मनामिरज्यथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāmṛtāya keśinīranūṣata mitra yatra varuṇa gātumarcathaḥ | ava tmanā sṛjataṃ pinvataṃ dhiyo yuvaṃ viprasya manmanāmirajyathaḥ ||

translations.english: The tresses of Agni minister, Mitra and Varuṇa, to your sacrifice, when you honour (with your presence) the sacrificial chamber; send down of your own accord (the rain), and prosper our offerings, for you have command over the praise of the pious men.

mantras.sanskrit: यो वां यज्ञैः शशमानो ह दाशति कविर्होता यजति मन्मसाधनः । उपाह तं गच्छथो वीथो अध्वरमच्छा गिरः सुमतिं गन्तमस्मयू ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo vāṃ yajñaiḥ śaśamāno ha dāśati kavirhotā yajati manmasādhanaḥ | upāha taṃ gacchatho vītho adhvaramacchā giraḥ sumatiṃ gantamasmayū ||

translations.english: Come to the devout (worshipper), who, glorifying you, and providing (all that is) acceptable, presents you with oblations; (to him), the sage, the invoker, who offers you worship; accept his sacrifice; favourably disposed towards us, (accept) our praises.

mantras.sanskrit: युवां यज्ञैः प्रथमा गोभिरञ्जत ऋतावाना मनसो न प्रयुक्तिषु । भरन्ति वां मन्मना संयता गिरोऽदृप्यता मनसा रेवदाशाथे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvāṃ yajñaiḥ prathamā gobhirañjata ṛtāvānā manaso na prayuktiṣu | bharanti vāṃ manmanā saṃyatā giro'dṛpyatā manasā revadāśāthe ||

translations.english: Accepter of sacrifices, you are the first whom (worshippers) propitiate with offerings, the produce of the cow; like (the application) of the mind (in the first instrumental nce) to the results (of the senses); hymns (prompted) by thoughts wholly intent upon you, celebrate (your praise); do you, with humble minds, bestow upon us wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: रेवद्वयो दधाथे रेवदाशाथे नरा मायाभिरितऊति माहिनम् । न वां द्यावोऽहभिर्नोत सिन्धवो न देवत्वं पणयो नानशुर्मघम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: revadvayo dadhāthe revadāśāthe narā māyābhiritaūti māhinam | na vāṃ dyāvo'habhirnota sindhavo na devatvaṃ paṇayo nānaśurmagham ||

translations.english: You distribute food, accompanied by riches; you bestow upon us, leaders (of sacrifice), wealth, ample, and defended by your wise provisions; the days with the nights have not attained your divinity; neither have the rivers, nor have the asuras, and they have not obtained (your) wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं वस्त्राणि पीवसा वसाथे युवोरच्छिद्रा मन्तवो ह सर्गाः । अवातिरतमनृतानि विश्व ऋतेन मित्रावरुणा सचेथे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ vastrāṇi pīvasā vasāthe yuvoracchidrā mantavo ha sargāḥ | avātiratamanṛtāni viśva ṛtena mitrāvaruṇā sacethe ||

translations.english: Robust Mitra and Varuṇa, you wear vestments (of light); your natures are to be regarded as without defect; you annihilate all untruths; you associate (us) with sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: एतच्चन त्वो वि चिकेतदेषां सत्यो मन्त्रः कविशस्त ऋघावान् । त्रिरश्रिं हन्ति चतुरश्रिरुग्रो देवनिदो ह प्रथमा अजूर्यन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: etaccana tvo vi ciketadeṣāṃ satyo mantraḥ kaviśasta ṛghāvān | triraśriṃ hanti caturaśrirugro devanido ha prathamā ajūryan ||

translations.english: He amongst those (who are your followers), who observes truth, who is considerate, who is commended by the wise, who is able to (inflict) harm, carefully weighs (the means whereby), fierce and well-armed, he slays (a foe) less efficiently accoutred, and (by which) the revilers of the gods, however mighty, may perish.

mantras.sanskrit: अपादेति प्रथमा पद्वतीनां कस्तद्वां मित्रावरुणा चिकेत । गर्भो भारं भरत्या चिदस्य ऋतं पिपर्त्यनृतं नि तारीत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: apādeti prathamā padvatīnāṃ kastadvāṃ mitrāvaruṇā ciketa | garbho bhāraṃ bharatyā cidasya ṛtaṃ pipartyanṛtaṃ ni tārīt ||

translations.english: Who knows, Mitra and Varuṇa, that it is your doing, that the footless dawn is the precursor of footed beings; and that your infant (progeny, the sun), sustains the burden of this (world); he diffuses (the) truth (of light), and disperses the falsehood (of darkness).

mantras.sanskrit: प्रयन्तमित्परि जारं कनीनां पश्यामसि नोपनिपद्यमानम् । अनवपृग्णा वितता वसानं प्रियं मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धाम ॥
mantras.transliteration: prayantamitpari jāraṃ kanīnāṃ paśyāmasi nopanipadyamānam | anavapṛgṇā vitatā vasānaṃ priyaṃ mitrasya varuṇasya dhāma ||

translations.english: We behold the lover of the maiden (dawns), ever in movement, never resting for an instrumental nt, wearing inseparable and diffusive (radiance), the beloved abode of Mitra and Varuṇa

mantras.sanskrit: अनश्वो जातो अनभीशुरर्वा कनिक्रदत्पतयदूर्ध्वसानुः । अचित्तं ब्रह्म जुजुषुर्युवानः प्र मित्रे धाम वरुणे गृणन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: anaśvo jāto anabhīśurarvā kanikradatpatayadūrdhvasānuḥ | acittaṃ brahma jujuṣuryuvānaḥ pra mitre dhāma varuṇe gṛṇantaḥ ||

translations.english: Without steeds, without stay, (he is nevertheless) borne swift-moving and loud-sounding; he travels, ascending higher and higher, connecting the inconceivable mystery (of sacred rites) with the radiance (abiding) in Mitra and Varuṇa, (which men), eulogizing, glorify.

mantras.sanskrit: आ धेनवो मामतेयमवन्तीर्ब्रह्मप्रियं पीपयन्त्सस्मिन्नूधन् । पित्वो भिक्षेत वयुनानि विद्वानासाविवासन्नदितिमुरुष्येत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā dhenavo māmateyamavantīrbrahmapriyaṃ pīpayantsasminnūdhan | pitvo bhikṣeta vayunāni vidvānāsāvivāsannaditimuruṣyet ||

translations.english: May the cow, propitious to the devout son of Mamatā, be possessed of well-filled udders; knowing the rites (necessary to be performed), let him beg (the residue) of the offerings for his eating, and worshipping (you both) complete the perfect (ceremony).

mantras.sanskrit: आ वां मित्रावरुणा हव्यजुष्टिं नमसा देवाववसा ववृत्याम् । अस्माकं ब्रह्म पृतनासु सह्या अस्माकं वृष्टिर्दिव्या सुपारा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā havyajuṣṭiṃ namasā devāvavasā vavṛtyām | asmākaṃ brahma pṛtanāsu sahyā asmākaṃ vṛṣṭirdivyā supārā ||

translations.english: Divine Mitra and Varuṇa, may I render the oblation acceptable to you with reverence and prayer; may the sacred rite enable us (to overcome) in battles, and may the heavenly rain be to us the means of satisfying our wants.

mantras.sanskrit: यजामहे वां महः सजोषा हव्येभिर्मित्रावरुणा नमोभिः । घृतैर्घृतस्नू अध यद्वामस्मे अध्वर्यवो न धीतिभिर्भरन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajāmahe vāṃ mahaḥ sajoṣā havyebhirmitrāvaruṇā namobhiḥ | ghṛtairghṛtasnū adha yadvāmasme adhvaryavo na dhītibhirbharanti ||

translations.english: Mighty Mitra and Varuṇa, dispensers of butter, we worship you, rejoicing, with oblations; with reverential homage, and with (offerings of) water; so that our ministrant priests may propitiate you by (our) devotions.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रस्तुतिर्वां धाम न प्रयुक्तिरयामि मित्रावरुणा सुवृक्तिः । अनक्ति यद्वां विदथेषु होता सुम्नं वां सूरिर्वृषणावियक्षन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: prastutirvāṃ dhāma na prayuktirayāmi mitrāvaruṇā suvṛktiḥ | anakti yadvāṃ vidatheṣu hotā sumnaṃ vāṃ sūrirvṛṣaṇāviyakṣan ||

translations.english: The purpose of worshipping you, Mitra and Varuṇa, is not the performance, but (even by so much) I may attain to your glory, and there is acquittance (of my duty); for when the priest offers you oblations in sacrifices, then the pious man, showerers (of benefits), being desirous of worshipping you, (obtains) felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: पीपाय धेनुरदितिॠताय जनाय मित्रावरुणा हविर्दे । हिनोति यद्वां विदथे सपर्यन्त्स रातहव्यो मानुषो न होता ॥
mantras.transliteration: pīpāya dhenuraditiṝtāya janāya mitrāvaruṇā havirde | hinoti yadvāṃ vidathe saparyantsa rātahavyo mānuṣo na hotā ||

translations.english: Let the productive cow, Mitra and Varuṇa, furnish abundant nutriment to the pious man who presents you with oblations, as when Rātahavya, glorifying you, propitiates you in the solemnity, like the ministrant priest of a man (who instrumental tutes the rite).

mantras.sanskrit: उत वां विक्षु मद्यास्वन्धो गाव आपश्च पीपयन्त देवीः । उतो नो अस्य पूर्व्यः पतिर्दन्वीतं पातं पयस उस्रियायाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta vāṃ vikṣu madyāsvandho gāva āpaśca pīpayanta devīḥ | uto no asya pūrvyaḥ patirdanvītaṃ pātaṃ payasa usriyāyāḥ ||

translations.english: May the divine cows, and the waters, supply you with (sacrificial) food, for the prosperity of the people whom you favour; or may (Agni), the former protector of this (our patron), be the donor (of the oblation); eat (of the butter and curds), drink of the milk of the kine.

mantras.sanskrit: विष्णोर्नु कं वीर्याणि प्र वोचं यः पार्थिवानि विममे रजांसि । यो अस्कभायदुत्तरं सधस्थं विचक्रमाणस्त्रेधोरुगायः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viṣṇornu kaṃ vīryāṇi pra vocaṃ yaḥ pārthivāni vimame rajāṃsi | yo askabhāyaduttaraṃ sadhasthaṃ vicakramāṇastredhorugāyaḥ ||

translations.english: Earnetly I glorify the exploits of Viṣṇu, who made the three worlds; who sustained the lofty aggregate site (of the spheres); thrice traversing (the whole); who is praised by the exalted.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र तद्विष्णुः स्तवते वीर्येण मृगो न भीमः कुचरो गिरिष्ठाः । यस्योरुषु त्रिषु विक्रमणेष्वधिक्षियन्ति भुवनानि विश्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra tadviṣṇuḥ stavate vīryeṇa mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ | yasyoruṣu triṣu vikramaṇeṣvadhikṣiyanti bhuvanāni viśvā ||

translations.english: Viṣṇu is therefore glorified, that by his prowess he is like a fearful, ravenous, and mountain-haunting wild beast, and because of that in his three paces all worlds abide.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र विष्णवे शूषमेतु मन्म गिरिक्षित उरुगायाय वृष्णे । य इदं दीर्घं प्रयतं सधस्थमेको विममे त्रिभिरित्पदेभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra viṣṇave śūṣametu manma girikṣita urugāyāya vṛṣṇe | ya idaṃ dīrghaṃ prayataṃ sadhasthameko vimame tribhiritpadebhiḥ ||

translations.english: May acceptable vigour attend Viṣṇu, who abides in prayer, the hymned of many, the showerer (of benefits), who alone made, by three steps, this spacious and durable aggregate (of the three worlds).

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य त्री पूर्णा मधुना पदान्यक्षीयमाणा स्वधया मदन्ति । य उ त्रिधातु पृथिवीमुत द्यामेको दाधार भुवनानि विश्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya trī pūrṇā madhunā padānyakṣīyamāṇā svadhayā madanti | ya u tridhātu pṛthivīmuta dyāmeko dādhāra bhuvanāni viśvā ||

translations.english: Whose three imperishable paces, filled with ambrosia, delight (mankind) with sacred food; who verily alone upholds the three elements, and earth and heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: तदस्य प्रियमभि पाथो अश्यां नरो यत्र देवयवो मदन्ति । उरुक्रमस्य स हि बन्धुरित्था विष्णोः पदे परमे मध्व उत्सः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadasya priyamabhi pātho aśyāṃ naro yatra devayavo madanti | urukramasya sa hi bandhuritthā viṣṇoḥ pade parame madhva utsaḥ ||

translations.english: May I attain his favourite path, in which god-seeking men delight; (the path) of that wide-stepping Viṣṇu, in whose exalted station there is a (perpetual) flow of felicity; for to such a degree is he the friend (of the pious).

mantras.sanskrit: ता वां वास्तून्युश्मसि गमध्यै यत्र गावो भूरिशृङ्गा अयासः । अत्राह तदुरुगायस्य वृष्णः परमं पदमव भाति भूरि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā vāṃ vāstūnyuśmasi gamadhyai yatra gāvo bhūriśṛṅgā ayāsaḥ | atrāha tadurugāyasya vṛṣṇaḥ paramaṃ padamava bhāti bhūri ||

translations.english: We pary (to Viṣṇu) that you may both go to those regions where the many-pointed and wide-spreading rays (of light expand); for here the supreme station of the many-hymned, the showerer (of benefits), shines (with) great (splendour).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वः पान्तमन्धसो धियायते महे शूराय विष्णवे चार्चत । या सानुनि पर्वतानामदाभ्या महस्तस्थतुरर्वतेव साधुना ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vaḥ pāntamandhaso dhiyāyate mahe śūrāya viṣṇave cārcata | yā sānuni parvatānāmadābhyā mahastasthaturarvateva sādhunā ||

translations.english: Offer your nutritious viands to the great hero, (Indra), who is plural ased by praise, and to Viṣṇu, the two invincible deities who ride upon the radiant summit of the clouds as upon a well-trained steed.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वेषमित्था समरणं शिमीवतोरिन्द्राविष्णू सुतपा वामुरुष्यति । या मर्त्याय प्रतिधीयमानमित्कृशानोरस्तुरसनामुरुष्यथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tveṣamitthā samaraṇaṃ śimīvatorindrāviṣṇū sutapā vāmuruṣyati | yā martyāya pratidhīyamānamitkṛśānorasturasanāmuruṣyathaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra and Viṣṇu, the devout worshipper glorifies the radiant approach of you two, who are the granters of desires, and who bestow upon the mortal who worships you an immediately-receivable (reward), through the distribution of that fire which is the scatterer (of desired blessings).

mantras.sanskrit: ता ईं वर्धन्ति मह्यस्य पौंस्यं नि मातरा नयति रेतसे भुजे । दधाति पुत्रोऽवरं परं पितुर्नाम तृतीयमधि रोचने दिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā īṃ vardhanti mahyasya pauṃsyaṃ ni mātarā nayati retase bhuje | dadhāti putro'varaṃ paraṃ piturnāma tṛtīyamadhi rocane divaḥ ||

translations.english: These (oblations) augment his (Indra's), mighty manhood, by which he fits the parents (of all creatures heaven and earth), for genitive ration and enjoyment; whereby, in the upper region of the sky, the son has an inferior and superior appellation, and a third (name) of father.

mantras.sanskrit: तत्तदिदस्य पौंस्यं गृणीमसीनस्य त्रातुरवृकस्य मीळ्हुषः । यः पार्थिवानि त्रिभिरिद्विगामभिरुरु क्रमिष्टोरुगायाय जीवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tattadidasya pauṃsyaṃ gṛṇīmasīnasya trāturavṛkasya mīḷhuṣaḥ | yaḥ pārthivāni tribhiridvigāmabhiruru kramiṣṭorugāyāya jīvase ||

translations.english: Therefore, verily, we celebrate the manhood of that lord (of all), the preserver, the innocuous, the vigorous who traversed the three regions with three wide steps in different directions for the many-praised (preservation of) existence.

mantras.sanskrit: द्वे इदस्य क्रमणे स्वर्दृशोऽभिख्याय मर्त्यो भुरण्यति । तृतीयमस्य नकिरा दधर्षति वयश्चन पतयन्तः पतत्रिणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dve idasya kramaṇe svardṛśo'bhikhyāya martyo bhuraṇyati | tṛtīyamasya nakirā dadharṣati vayaścana patayantaḥ patatriṇaḥ ||

translations.english: Man glorifying (Viṣṇu), tracks two steps of that heaven-beholding (deity), but he apprehends not the third; nor can the soaring-winged birds (pursue it).

mantras.sanskrit: चतुर्भिः साकं नवतिं च नामभिश्चक्रं न वृत्तं व्यतीँरवीविपत् । बृहच्छरीरो विमिमान ऋक्वभिर्युवाकुमारः प्रत्येत्याहवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: caturbhiḥ sākaṃ navatiṃ ca nāmabhiścakraṃ na vṛttaṃ vyatī~ravīvipat | bṛhaccharīro vimimāna ṛkvabhiryuvākumāraḥ pratyetyāhavam ||

translations.english: He causes, by his gyrations, ninety and four periodical revolutions, like a circular wheel, vast of body, and evolving in many forms, through the praises (addressed to him); ever young, though not infantine, he comes at our invocations.

mantras.sanskrit: भवा मित्रो न शेव्यो घृतासुतिर्विभूतद्युम्न एवया उ सप्रथाः । अधा ते विष्णो विदुषा चिदर्ध्यः स्तोमो यज्ञश्च राध्यो हविष्मता ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhavā mitro na śevyo ghṛtāsutirvibhūtadyumna evayā u saprathāḥ | adhā te viṣṇo viduṣā cidardhyaḥ stomo yajñaśca rādhyo haviṣmatā ||

translations.english: Be (to us), Viṣṇu, like a friend, the giver of happiness, the acepter of oblations, abounding with food, the granter of protection, and every way accessible; on which account your praise is to be repeatedly recited by the wise, and your worship to be celebrated by the offerer of oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: यः पूर्व्याय वेधसे नवीयसे सुमज्जानये विष्णवे ददाशति । यो जातमस्य महतो महि ब्रवत्सेदु श्रवोभिर्युज्यं चिदभ्यसत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ pūrvyāya vedhase navīyase sumajjānaye viṣṇave dadāśati | yo jātamasya mahato mahi bravatsedu śravobhiryujyaṃ cidabhyasat ||

translations.english: He who presents (offerings) to Viṣṇu, the ancient, the creator, the recent, the self-born; he who celebrates the great birth of that mighty one; he verily possessed of abundance, attains (the station) that is to be sought (by all).

mantras.sanskrit: तमु स्तोतारः पूर्व्यं यथा विद ऋतस्य गर्भं जनुषा पिपर्तन । आस्य जानन्तो नाम चिद्विवक्तन महस्ते विष्णो सुमतिं भजामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamu stotāraḥ pūrvyaṃ yathā vida ṛtasya garbhaṃ januṣā pipartana | āsya jānanto nāma cidvivaktana mahaste viṣṇo sumatiṃ bhajāmahe ||

translations.english: Hymners, propitiate of your own accord that ancient Viṣṇu, since you know him as the germ of sacrifice, cognizant of his greatness, celebrate his name; may we, Viṣṇu, enjoy your favour.

mantras.sanskrit: तमस्य राजा वरुणस्तमश्विना क्रतुं सचन्त मारुतस्य वेधसः । दाधार दक्षमुत्तममहर्विदं व्रजं च विष्णुः सखिवाँ अपोर्णुते ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamasya rājā varuṇastamaśvinā kratuṃ sacanta mārutasya vedhasaḥ | dādhāra dakṣamuttamamaharvidaṃ vrajaṃ ca viṣṇuḥ sakhivā~ aporṇute ||

translations.english: The royal Varuṇa associates (himself) with the sacrifice of the pious worshipper, assisted by the company of the priests; the Aśvins (unite with it); Viṣṇu, with his friend (Indra), possesses supreme heaven-conferring power, and sits upon the clouds.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यो विवाय सचथाय दैव्य इन्द्राय विष्णुः सुकृते सुकृत्तरः । वेधा अजिन्वत्त्रिषधस्थ आर्यमृतस्य भागे यजमानमाभजत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yo vivāya sacathāya daivya indrāya viṣṇuḥ sukṛte sukṛttaraḥ | vedhā ajinvattriṣadhastha āryamṛtasya bhāge yajamānamābhajat ||

translations.english: The divine Viṣṇu, the best of the doers of good deeds, who came to the pious instrumental tutor of the rite, to assist (at its celebration), knowing (the desire of the worshipper), and present at the three connected periods (of worship), shows favour to te Arya, and admits the author if the ceremony to a share of the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: अबोध्यग्निर्ज्म उदेति सूर्यो व्युषाश्चन्द्रा मह्यावो अर्चिषा । आयुक्षातामश्विना यातवे रथं प्रासावीद्देवः सविता जगत्पृथक् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abodhyagnirjma udeti sūryo vyuṣāścandrā mahyāvo arciṣā | āyukṣātāmaśvinā yātave rathaṃ prāsāvīddevaḥ savitā jagatpṛthak ||

translations.english: Agni is awakened upon earth; the Sun rises; the spreading dawn, exhilarating (all) by her radiance, has dispersed (the darkness); harness, (therefore), Aśvins your chariot, to come (to the sacrifice), that the divine Savitā may animate allbeings to (the performance of) their several (duties).

mantras.sanskrit: यद्युञ्जाथे वृषणमश्विना रथं घृतेन नो मधुना क्षत्रमुक्षतम् । अस्माकं ब्रह्म पृतनासु जिन्वतं वयं धना शूरसाता भजेमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadyuñjāthe vṛṣaṇamaśvinā rathaṃ ghṛtena no madhunā kṣatramukṣatam | asmākaṃ brahma pṛtanāsu jinvataṃ vayaṃ dhanā śūrasātā bhajemahi ||

translations.english: When, Aśvins, you harness your bounty-shedding chariot, refresh our strength with trickling honey; bestow (abundant) food upon our people; may we acquire riches in the strife of heroes.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्वाङ्त्रिचक्रो मधुवाहनो रथो जीराश्वो अश्विनोर्यातु सुष्टुतः । त्रिवन्धुरो मघवा विश्वसौभगः शं न आ वक्षद्द्विपदे चतुष्पदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: arvāṅtricakro madhuvāhano ratho jīrāśvo aśvinoryātu suṣṭutaḥ | trivandhuro maghavā viśvasaubhagaḥ śaṃ na ā vakṣaddvipade catuṣpade ||

translations.english: May the three-wheeled car of the Aśvins, drawn by swift horses, laden with honey, three-canopied, filled with treasure, and every way auspicious, come to our presence, and bring prosperity to our people and our cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: आ न ऊर्जं वहतमश्विना युवं मधुमत्या नः कशया मिमिक्षतम् । प्रायुस्तारिष्टं नी रपांसि मृक्षतं सेधतं द्वेषो भवतं सचाभुवा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā na ūrjaṃ vahatamaśvinā yuvaṃ madhumatyā naḥ kaśayā mimikṣatam | prāyustāriṣṭaṃ nī rapāṃsi mṛkṣataṃ sedhataṃ dveṣo bhavataṃ sacābhuvā ||

translations.english: Bring us, Aśvins, vigour; animate us with your honied speech; prolong our existence; wipe away our sins; destroy our foes; be ever our associates.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं ह गर्भं जगतीषु धत्थो युवं विश्वेषु भुवनेष्वन्तः । युवमग्निं च वृषणावपश्च वनस्पतीँरश्विनावैरयेथाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ ha garbhaṃ jagatīṣu dhattho yuvaṃ viśveṣu bhuvaneṣvantaḥ | yuvamagniṃ ca vṛṣaṇāvapaśca vanaspatī~raśvināvairayethām ||

translations.english: You, Aśvins, sustain the germ in all moving creatures; you are in the interior of all beings; do you, showerers of benefits, supply (for our own use) fire and water and the trees of the forest.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं ह स्थो भिषजा भेषजेभिरथो ह स्थो रथ्या राथ्येभिः । अथो ह क्षत्रमधि धत्थ उग्रा यो वां हविष्मान्मनसा ददाश ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ ha stho bhiṣajā bheṣajebhiratho ha stho rathyā rāthyebhiḥ | atho ha kṣatramadhi dhattha ugrā yo vāṃ haviṣmānmanasā dadāśa ||

translations.english: You two are physicians, (conversant) with (all) medicaments; you ride in a chariot (drawn by) well-trained steeds; therefore, mighty (divinities), resolutely uphold (the worshipper), who, with a mind (devoted to you), offers you oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: वसू रुद्रा पुरुमन्तू वृधन्ता दशस्यतं नो वृषणावभिष्टौ । दस्रा ह यद्रेक्ण औचथ्यो वां प्र यत्सस्राथे अकवाभिरूती ॥
mantras.transliteration: vasū rudrā purumantū vṛdhantā daśasyataṃ no vṛṣaṇāvabhiṣṭau | dasrā ha yadrekṇa aucathyo vāṃ pra yatsasrāthe akavābhirūtī ||

translations.english: Dasras, showerers (of benefits), granters of dwellings, dispellers of sin, cognizant of many (things), increasing (through praise), and fulfillers (of desires), inasmuch as Aucatthya offer you (sacrificial) wealth, and you protect (your worshippers) with unobjectionable aids, bestow uponus (our prayers).

mantras.sanskrit: को वां दाशत्सुमतये चिदस्यै वसू यद्धेथे नमसा पदे गोः । जिगृतमस्मे रेवतीः पुरंधीः कामप्रेणेव मनसा चरन्ता ॥
mantras.transliteration: ko vāṃ dāśatsumataye cidasyai vasū yaddhethe namasā pade goḥ | jigṛtamasme revatīḥ puraṃdhīḥ kāmapreṇeva manasā carantā ||

translations.english: Granters of dwellings, who may make you offerings so propitiatory of that your good will, that (invoked) by our adoration, to the site of the altar, you may entertain (favourable intentions towards us), and grant us kine rich in milk, coming with minds made up to grant the desires (of the worshipper).

mantras.sanskrit: युक्तो ह यद्वां तौग्र्याय पेरुर्वि मध्ये अर्णसो धायि पज्रः । उप वामवः शरणं गमेयं शूरो नाज्म पतयद्भिरेवैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yukto ha yadvāṃ taugryāya perurvi madhye arṇaso dhāyi pajraḥ | upa vāmavaḥ śaraṇaṃ gameyaṃ śūro nājma patayadbhirevaiḥ ||

translations.english: In like manner, Aśvins, as your strong-drawn (car), able to cross (the sea), was plural ced,harnessed, in the middle of the water, for (the rescue of) the son of Tugra, so may I attain to your preserving protection (with the same alacrity) as a victorious hero (returns home) with bounding steeds.

mantras.sanskrit: उपस्तुतिरौचथ्यमुरुष्येन्मा मामिमे पतत्रिणी वि दुग्धाम् । मा मामेधो दशतयश्चितो धाक्प्र यद्वां बद्धस्त्मनि खादति क्षाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: upastutiraucathyamuruṣyenmā māmime patatriṇī vi dugdhām | mā māmedho daśatayaścito dhākpra yadvāṃ baddhastmani khādati kṣām ||

translations.english: May the praise addressed to you, Aśvins, preserve the son of Ucatthya; let not those revolving (days and nights) exhaust me; let not the ten times kindled fire consume me; let it not be, that one who is your, (dependant), bound (with bonds), should of himself bite the earth.

mantras.sanskrit: न मा गरन्नद्यो मातृतमा दासा यदीं सुसमुब्धमवाधुः । शिरो यदस्य त्रैतनो वितक्षत्स्वयं दास उरो अंसावपि ग्ध ॥
mantras.transliteration: na mā garannadyo mātṛtamā dāsā yadīṃ susamubdhamavādhuḥ | śiro yadasya traitano vitakṣatsvayaṃ dāsa uro aṃsāvapi gdha ||

translations.english: Let not the maternal waters swallow me, since the slaves hurled down this decrepit (old man); in like manner as Traitana wounded his head, so has the slave wounded his own, and has struck his breast and shoulders.

mantras.sanskrit: दीर्घतमा मामतेयो जुजुर्वान्दशमे युगे । अपामर्थं यतीनां ब्रह्मा भवति सारथिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dīrghatamā māmateyo jujurvāndaśame yuge | apāmarthaṃ yatīnāṃ brahmā bhavati sārathiḥ ||

translations.english: Dīrghatamas, the son of Mamatā, has grown old after the tenth yuga (has passed); he is the Brahmā of those who seek to obtain the object of their (pious) works; he is their charioteer.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र द्यावा यज्ञैः पृथिवी ऋतावृधा मही स्तुषे विदथेषु प्रचेतसा । देवेभिर्ये देवपुत्रे सुदंससेत्था धिया वार्याणि प्रभूषतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra dyāvā yajñaiḥ pṛthivī ṛtāvṛdhā mahī stuṣe vidatheṣu pracetasā | devebhirye devaputre sudaṃsasetthā dhiyā vāryāṇi prabhūṣataḥ ||

translations.english: I glorify with sacred rites themighty Heaven and Earth, the augmenters of sacrifice, who (are to be contemplated) with devotion at holy ceremonies; those two, who, cherishing their worshippers as children, are venerated by the devout, and therefore with favour bestow (upon us) desirable blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: उत मन्ये पितुरद्रुहो मनो मातुर्महि स्वतवस्तद्धवीमभिः । सुरेतसा पितरा भूम चक्रतुरुरु प्रजाया अमृतं वरीमभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta manye pituradruho mano māturmahi svatavastaddhavīmabhiḥ | suretasā pitarā bhūma cakratururu prajāyā amṛtaṃ varīmabhiḥ ||

translations.english: Verily I propitiate, by my invocations, the mind of the benevolent father, and the great and spontaneous (affection) of the mother (of all beings). The parents, with kindness, have secured, by their excellent protections, the vast and manifold immortality of their progeny.

mantras.sanskrit: ते सूनवः स्वपसः सुदंससो मही जज्ञुर्मातरा पूर्वचित्तये । स्थातुश्च सत्यं जगतश्च धर्मणि पुत्रस्य पाथः पदमद्वयाविनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te sūnavaḥ svapasaḥ sudaṃsaso mahī jajñurmātarā pūrvacittaye | sthātuśca satyaṃ jagataśca dharmaṇi putrasya pāthaḥ padamadvayāvinaḥ ||

translations.english: These, your children, the performers of good works, and of goodly appearance, recognize you as their great parents, through experience of former (kindness); preserve uninterrupted stability in the functions of your progeny, whether stationary or moving, (depending for existence) on none other than you.

mantras.sanskrit: ते मायिनो ममिरे सुप्रचेतसो जामी सयोनी मिथुना समोकसा । नव्यंनव्यं तन्तुमा तन्वते दिवि समुद्रे अन्तः कवयः सुदीतयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te māyino mamire supracetaso jāmī sayonī mithunā samokasā | navyaṃnavyaṃ tantumā tanvate divi samudre antaḥ kavayaḥ sudītayaḥ ||

translations.english: Those provident and intelligent sisters, (the rays of light), conceived of the same womb, (ever) united (with each other), and dwelling in the same abode, metre out (all things); knowing (their functions), and bright-shining, they spread in ever new (directions) throughout the radiant firmament.

mantras.sanskrit: तद्राधो अद्य सवितुर्वरेण्यं वयं देवस्य प्रसवे मनामहे । अस्मभ्यं द्यावापृथिवी सुचेतुना रयिं धत्तं वसुमन्तं शतग्विनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadrādho adya saviturvareṇyaṃ vayaṃ devasya prasave manāmahe | asmabhyaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī sucetunā rayiṃ dhattaṃ vasumantaṃ śatagvinam ||

translations.english: We solicit today of the divine sun, his favour being propitiated, that wealth which is desirable. Benignant Heaven and Earth, bestow upon us riches, (consisting of) habitations and hundreds (of cattle and the like).

mantras.sanskrit: ते हि द्यावापृथिवी विश्वशम्भुव ऋतावरी रजसो धारयत्कवी । सुजन्मनी धिषणे अन्तरीयते देवो देवी धर्मणा सूर्यः शुचिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te hi dyāvāpṛthivī viśvaśambhuva ṛtāvarī rajaso dhārayatkavī | sujanmanī dhiṣaṇe antarīyate devo devī dharmaṇā sūryaḥ śuciḥ ||

translations.english: Those two, the divine Heaven and Earth, are the diffusers of happiness on all, encouragers of truth, able to sustain the water (of the rains), auspicious of birth, and energetic (in action); in the interval between whom proceeds the pure and divine Sun for (the discharge of his) duties.

mantras.sanskrit: उरुव्यचसा महिनी असश्चता पिता माता च भुवनानि रक्षतः । सुधृष्टमे वपुष्ये न रोदसी पिता यत्सीमभि रूपैरवासयत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uruvyacasā mahinī asaścatā pitā mātā ca bhuvanāni rakṣataḥ | sudhṛṣṭame vapuṣye na rodasī pitā yatsīmabhi rūpairavāsayat ||

translations.english: Wide-spreading, vast, unconnected, the father and mother (of all beings), they two preservethe worlds. Resolute, as if (for the good) of embodied (beings), are Heaven and Earth, and the father ahs invested evry thing with (visible) forms.

mantras.sanskrit: स वह्निः पुत्रः पित्रोः पवित्रवान्पुनाति धीरो भुवनानि मायया । धेनुं च पृश्निं वृषभं सुरेतसं विश्वाहा शुक्रं पयो अस्य दुक्षत ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa vahniḥ putraḥ pitroḥ pavitravānpunāti dhīro bhuvanāni māyayā | dhenuṃ ca pṛśniṃ vṛṣabhaṃ suretasaṃ viśvāhā śukraṃ payo asya dukṣata ||

translations.english: The pure and the resolute son of (these) parents, the bearer (of rewards), sanctifies the worlds by his intelligence;. as well as the cow (the earth), and the vigorous bull (the heaven), and daily milks the pellucid milk (of the sky).

mantras.sanskrit: अयं देवानामपसामपस्तमो यो जजान रोदसी विश्वशम्भुवा । वि यो ममे रजसी सुक्रतूययाजरेभिः स्कम्भनेभिः समानृचे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ devānāmapasāmapastamo yo jajāna rodasī viśvaśambhuvā | vi yo mame rajasī sukratūyayājarebhiḥ skambhanebhiḥ samānṛce ||

translations.english: He it is, amongst gods (the most divine), amongst (pious) works the most pious, who gave birth to the all-delighting heaven and earth; who measured them both, and, for the sake of holy rites, propped them up with undecaying pillars.

mantras.sanskrit: ते नो गृणाने महिनी महि श्रवः क्षत्रं द्यावापृथिवी धासथो बृहत् । येनाभि कृष्टीस्ततनाम विश्वहा पनाय्यमोजो अस्मे समिन्वतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: te no gṛṇāne mahinī mahi śravaḥ kṣatraṃ dyāvāpṛthivī dhāsatho bṛhat | yenābhi kṛṣṭīstatanāma viśvahā panāyyamojo asme saminvatam ||

translations.english: Glorified by us, grant to us, Heaven and Earth abundant food and great strength; whereby we may daily multiply mankind; bestow upon us commendable vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: किमु श्रेष्ठः किं यविष्ठो न आजगन्किमीयते दूत्यं कद्यदूचिम । न निन्दिम चमसं यो महाकुलोऽग्ने भ्रातर्द्रुण इद्भूतिमूदिम ॥
mantras.transliteration: kimu śreṣṭhaḥ kiṃ yaviṣṭho na ājagankimīyate dūtyaṃ kadyadūcima | na nindima camasaṃ yo mahākulo'gne bhrātardruṇa idbhūtimūdima ||

translations.english: Is this our senior or our junior who has come (to us); has he come upon a message (from the gods); what is it we should say? Agni,brother, we revile not the ladle which is of exalted race; verily we assert the dignity of the wooden (implement).

mantras.sanskrit: एकं चमसं चतुरः कृणोतन तद्वो देवा अब्रुवन्तद्व आगमम् । सौधन्वना यद्येवा करिष्यथ साकं देवैर्यज्ञियासो भविष्यथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: ekaṃ camasaṃ caturaḥ kṛṇotana tadvo devā abruvantadva āgamam | saudhanvanā yadyevā kariṣyatha sākaṃ devairyajñiyāso bhaviṣyatha ||

translations.english: Make fourfold the single ladle; so the gods command you; and for that purpose have I come, sons of Sudhanvan; if you accomplish this, you will be entitled to sacrifices along with the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निं दूतं प्रति यदब्रवीतनाश्वः कर्त्वो रथ उतेह कर्त्वः । धेनुः कर्त्वा युवशा कर्त्वा द्वा तानि भ्रातरनु वः कृत्व्येमसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniṃ dūtaṃ prati yadabravītanāśvaḥ kartvo ratha uteha kartvaḥ | dhenuḥ kartvā yuvaśā kartvā dvā tāni bhrātaranu vaḥ kṛtvyemasi ||

translations.english: Then said they, in answer to Agni, the messenger (of the gods). Whatever is to be done, whether a horse is to be made, or a car is to be made, or a cow is to be made, or the two (old parents) are to be made young, having done all these (acts), Brother Agni, we are then ready to do (what you desire) to be done.

mantras.sanskrit: चकृवांस ऋभवस्तदपृच्छत क्वेदभूद्यः स्य दूतो न आजगन् । यदावाख्यच्चमसाञ्चतुरः कृतानादित्त्वष्टा ग्नास्वन्तर्न्यानजे ॥
mantras.transliteration: cakṛvāṃsa ṛbhavastadapṛcchata kvedabhūdyaḥ sya dūto na ājagan | yadāvākhyaccamasāñcaturaḥ kṛtānādittvaṣṭā gnāsvantarnyānaje ||

translations.english: So doing Ṛbhus, you inquired: where, indeed, is he who came to us as a messenger? When Tvaṣṭā observed the one ladle become four, he was immediately lost amongst the women.

mantras.sanskrit: हनामैनाँ इति त्वष्टा यदब्रवीच्चमसं ये देवपानमनिन्दिषुः । अन्या नामानि कृण्वते सुते सचाँ अन्यैरेनान्कन्या नामभिः स्परत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: hanāmainā~ iti tvaṣṭā yadabravīccamasaṃ ye devapānamanindiṣuḥ | anyā nāmāni kṛṇvate sute sacā~ anyairenānkanyā nāmabhiḥ sparat ||

translations.english: When Tvaṣṭā said: let us slay those who have profaned the ladle, (designed) for the drinking of the gods; then they made use of other names for one another as the libation was poured out; and the maiden (mother) propitiated them by different appellations.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रो हरी युयुजे अश्विना रथं बृहस्पतिर्विश्वरूपामुपाजत । ऋभुर्विभ्वा वाजो देवाँ अगच्छत स्वपसो यज्ञियं भागमैतन ॥
mantras.transliteration: indro harī yuyuje aśvinā rathaṃ bṛhaspatirviśvarūpāmupājata | ṛbhurvibhvā vājo devā~ agacchata svapaso yajñiyaṃ bhāgamaitana ||

translations.english: Indra has caparisoned his horses; the Aśvins have harnessed their car; Bṛhaspati has accepted the omniform (cow); therefore, Ṛbhu, Vibhva and Vāja, go the gods, doers of good deeds, enjoy your sacrificial portion.

mantras.sanskrit: निश्चर्मणो गामरिणीत धीतिभिर्या जरन्ता युवशा ताकृणोतन । सौधन्वना अश्वादश्वमतक्षत युक्त्वा रथमुप देवाँ अयातन ॥
mantras.transliteration: niścarmaṇo gāmariṇīta dhītibhiryā jarantā yuvaśā tākṛṇotana | saudhanvanā aśvādaśvamatakṣata yuktvā rathamupa devā~ ayātana ||

translations.english: Sons of Sudhanvan, from a hideless (cow) you have formed a living one; by your marvellous acts you have made your aged parents young; from one horse you have fabricated another; harness now your chariot, and repair unto the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: इदमुदकं पिबतेत्यब्रवीतनेदं वा घा पिबता मुञ्जनेजनम् । सौधन्वना यदि तन्नेव हर्यथ तृतीये घा सवने मादयाध्वै ॥
mantras.transliteration: idamudakaṃ pibatetyabravītanedaṃ vā ghā pibatā muñjanejanam | saudhanvanā yadi tanneva haryatha tṛtīye ghā savane mādayādhvai ||

translations.english: They, (the gods), have said, sons of Sudhanvan, drink of this water, (the Soma); or drink that which has been filtered through the muñja grass; or, if you be plural ased with neither of these, be exhilarated (by that which is drunk) at the third (daily) sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: आपो भूयिष्ठा इत्येको अब्रवीदग्निर्भूयिष्ठ इत्यन्यो अब्रवीत् । वधर्यन्तीं बहुभ्यः प्रैको अब्रवीदृता वदन्तश्चमसाँ अपिंशत ॥
mantras.transliteration: āpo bhūyiṣṭhā ityeko abravīdagnirbhūyiṣṭha ityanyo abravīt | vadharyantīṃ bahubhyaḥ praiko abravīdṛtā vadantaścamasā~ apiṃśata ||

translations.english: Waters are the most excellent said one (of them). Agni is that most excellent, said another; the third declared to many the Earth (to be the most excellent), and thus speaking true things the Ṛbhus divided the ladle.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रोणामेक उदकं गामवाजति मांसमेकः पिंशति सूनयाभृतम् । आ निम्रुचः शकृदेको अपाभरत्किं स्वित्पुत्रेभ्यः पितरा उपावतुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śroṇāmeka udakaṃ gāmavājati māṃsamekaḥ piṃśati sūnayābhṛtam | ā nimrucaḥ śakṛdeko apābharatkiṃ svitputrebhyaḥ pitarā upāvatuḥ ||

translations.english: One pours the red water (the blood) upon the ground; one cuts the flesh, divided into fragments by the chopper; and a third seperates the excrement from the other parts; in what manner may the parents (of the sacrifice) render assistance to their sons?

mantras.sanskrit: उद्वत्स्वस्मा अकृणोतना तृणं निवत्स्वपः स्वपस्यया नरः । अगोह्यस्य यदसस्तना गृहे तदद्येदमृभवो नानु गच्छथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: udvatsvasmā akṛṇotanā tṛṇaṃ nivatsvapaḥ svapasyayā naraḥ | agohyasya yadasastanā gṛhe tadadyedamṛbhavo nānu gacchatha ||

translations.english: Ṛbhus, leaders (of the rains), you have caused the grass to grow upon the high plural ces; you have caused the waters to flow over the low plural ces; for (the promotion of) good works; as you have reposed for a while in the dwelling of the unapprehensible (Sun), so desist not today from (the discharge of) this (your function).

mantras.sanskrit: सम्मील्य यद्भुवना पर्यसर्पत क्व स्वित्तात्या पितरा व आसतुः । अशपत यः करस्नं व आददे यः प्राब्रवीत्प्रो तस्मा अब्रवीतन ॥
mantras.transliteration: sammīlya yadbhuvanā paryasarpata kva svittātyā pitarā va āsatuḥ | aśapata yaḥ karasnaṃ va ādade yaḥ prābravītpro tasmā abravītana ||

translations.english: As you glide along enveloping the regions (in clouds); where, then, are the parents (of the world)? curse him who arrests your arm; reply sternly to him who speaks disrespectfully (to you).

mantras.sanskrit: सुषुप्वांस ऋभवस्तदपृच्छतागोह्य क इदं नो अबूबुधत् । श्वानं बस्तो बोधयितारमब्रवीत्संवत्सर इदमद्या व्यख्यत ॥
mantras.transliteration: suṣupvāṃsa ṛbhavastadapṛcchatāgohya ka idaṃ no abūbudhat | śvānaṃ basto bodhayitāramabravītsaṃvatsara idamadyā vyakhyata ||

translations.english: Ṛbhus, reposing in the solar orb, you inquire: who awakens us, unapprehensive (Sun), to this office (of sending rain). The Sun replies: the awakener is the wind; and the year (being ended), you again today light up this (world).

mantras.sanskrit: दिवा यान्ति मरुतो भूम्याग्निरयं वातो अन्तरिक्षेण याति । अद्भिर्याति वरुणः समुद्रैर्युष्माँ इच्छन्तः शवसो नपातः ॥
mantras.transliteration: divā yānti maruto bhūmyāgnirayaṃ vāto antarikṣeṇa yāti | adbhiryāti varuṇaḥ samudrairyuṣmā~ icchantaḥ śavaso napātaḥ ||

translations.english: Sons of Strength, the Maruts, desirous of your coming, advance from the sky; Agni comes (to meet you) from the earth; the wind traverses the firmament; and Varuṇa comes with undulating waters.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नो मित्रो वरुणो अर्यमायुरिन्द्र ऋभुक्षा मरुतः परि ख्यन् । यद्वाजिनो देवजातस्य सप्तेः प्रवक्ष्यामो विदथे वीर्याणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā no mitro varuṇo aryamāyurindra ṛbhukṣā marutaḥ pari khyan | yadvājino devajātasya sapteḥ pravakṣyāmo vidathe vīryāṇi ||

translations.english: Let neither Mitra nor Varuṇa, Aryaman, Āyu, Indra, Ṛbhukṣin,nor the Maruts, censure us; when we proclaim in the sacrifice the virtus of the swift horse sprung from the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: यन्निर्णिजा रेक्णसा प्रावृतस्य रातिं गृभीतां मुखतो नयन्ति । सुप्राङजो मेम्यद्विश्वरूप इन्द्रापूष्णोः प्रियमप्येति पाथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yannirṇijā rekṇasā prāvṛtasya rātiṃ gṛbhītāṃ mukhato nayanti | suprāṅajo memyadviśvarūpa indrāpūṣṇoḥ priyamapyeti pāthaḥ ||

translations.english: When they, (the priests), bring the prepared offering to the presence (of the horse), who has been bathed and decorated with rich (trappings), the various-coloured goat going before him, bleating, becomes an acceptable offering to Indra and Pūṣan.

mantras.sanskrit: एष च्छागः पुरो अश्वेन वाजिना पूष्णो भागो नीयते विश्वदेव्यः । अभिप्रियं यत्पुरोळाशमर्वता त्वष्टेदेनं सौश्रवसाय जिन्वति ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa cchāgaḥ puro aśvena vājinā pūṣṇo bhāgo nīyate viśvadevyaḥ | abhipriyaṃ yatpuroḷāśamarvatā tvaṣṭedenaṃ sauśravasāya jinvati ||

translations.english: This goat, the portion of Pu+ṣan fit for all the gods, is brought first with the fleet courser, to that Tvaṣṭā may prepare him along with the horse, as an acceptable preliminary offering for the (sacrificial) food.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्धविष्यमृतुशो देवयानं त्रिर्मानुषाः पर्यश्वं नयन्ति । अत्रा पूष्णः प्रथमो भाग एति यज्ञं देवेभ्यः प्रतिवेदयन्नजः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaddhaviṣyamṛtuśo devayānaṃ trirmānuṣāḥ paryaśvaṃ nayanti | atrā pūṣṇaḥ prathamo bhāga eti yajñaṃ devebhyaḥ prativedayannajaḥ ||

translations.english: When the priests at the season (of the ceremony), lead forth the horse, the offering devoted to the gods, thrice round (the sacrificial fire); then the goat, the portion of Pūṣan, goes first, announcing the sacrificer to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: होताध्वर्युरावया अग्निमिन्धो ग्रावग्राभ उत शंस्ता सुविप्रः । तेन यज्ञेन स्वरंकृतेन स्विष्टेन वक्षणा आ पृणध्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: hotādhvaryurāvayā agnimindho grāvagrābha uta śaṃstā suvipraḥ | tena yajñena svaraṃkṛtena sviṣṭena vakṣaṇā ā pṛṇadhvam ||

translations.english: The invoker of the gods, the minister of the rite, the offerer of the oblation, the kindler of the fire, the bruiser of the Soma, the director of the ceremony, the saage (superintendent of the whole); do you replenish the rivers by this well-ordered, well-conducted, sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: यूपव्रस्का उत ये यूपवाहाश्चषालं ये अश्वयूपाय तक्षति । ये चार्वते पचनं सम्भरन्त्युतो तेषामभिगूर्तिर्न इन्वतु ॥
mantras.transliteration: yūpavraskā uta ye yūpavāhāścaṣālaṃ ye aśvayūpāya takṣati | ye cārvate pacanaṃ sambharantyuto teṣāmabhigūrtirna invatu ||

translations.english: Whether they be those who cut the (sacrificial) post, or those who bear the post, or those who fasten the rings on the top of the post, to which the horse (is bound); or those who prepare the vessels in which the food of the horse is dressed; let the exertions of them all fulfil our expectation.

mantras.sanskrit: उप प्रागात्सुमन्मेऽधायि मन्म देवानामाशा उप वीतपृष्ठः । अन्वेनं विप्रा ऋषयो मदन्ति देवानां पुष्टे चकृमा सुबन्धुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa prāgātsumanme'dhāyi manma devānāmāśā upa vītapṛṣṭhaḥ | anvenaṃ viprā ṛṣayo madanti devānāṃ puṣṭe cakṛmā subandhum ||

translations.english: May my desire be of itself accomplished, such as it has been entertained, that the smooth-backed steed should come to (gratify) the expectations of the gods; we have made him well-secured for the nutriment of the gods; let the wise saints now rejoice.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्वाजिनो दाम संदानमर्वतो या शीर्षण्या रशना रज्जुरस्य । यद्वा घास्य प्रभृतमास्ये तृणं सर्वा ता ते अपि देवेष्वस्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadvājino dāma saṃdānamarvato yā śīrṣaṇyā raśanā rajjurasya | yadvā ghāsya prabhṛtamāsye tṛṇaṃ sarvā tā te api deveṣvastu ||

translations.english: May the halter and the heel-ropes of the fleet courser, and the head-ropes, the  girths, and any other (part of the harness); and the grass that has been put into his mouth; may all these be with you, (horse), amongst the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: यदश्वस्य क्रविषो मक्षिकाश यद्वा स्वरौ स्वधितौ रिप्तमस्ति । यद्धस्तयोः शमितुर्यन्नखेषु सर्वा ता ते अपि देवेष्वस्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadaśvasya kraviṣo makṣikāśa yadvā svarau svadhitau riptamasti | yaddhastayoḥ śamituryannakheṣu sarvā tā te api deveṣvastu ||

translations.english: Whatever the flies may eat of the raw flesh of the horse; whatever (grease) is smeared upon the brush or upon the axe; (what is smeared) upon the hands or the nails of the immolator, may all this be with you, (horse), amongst the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: यदूवध्यमुदरस्यापवाति य आमस्य क्रविषो गन्धो अस्ति । सुकृता तच्छमितारः कृण्वन्तूत मेधं शृतपाकं पचन्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadūvadhyamudarasyāpavāti ya āmasya kraviṣo gandho asti | sukṛtā tacchamitāraḥ kṛṇvantūta medhaṃ śṛtapākaṃ pacantu ||

translations.english: Whatever undigested grass fall from this belly; whatever particle of raw flesh may remain; let the immolators make the whole free from defect, and so cook the pure (offering) that it may be perfectly dressed.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्ते गात्रादग्निना पच्यमानादभि शूलं निहतस्यावधावति । मा तद्भूम्यामा श्रिषन्मा तृणेषु देवेभ्यस्तदुशद्भ्यो रातमस्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatte gātrādagninā pacyamānādabhi śūlaṃ nihatasyāvadhāvati | mā tadbhūmyāmā śriṣanmā tṛṇeṣu devebhyastaduśadbhyo rātamastu ||

translations.english: Whatever (portion) of your slaughtered (body) fall from your carcass when it is being roasted by the fire, (escaping) from the spit; let it not be left on the ground,nor on the (sacred) grass, but let it (all) be given to the longing gods.

mantras.sanskrit: ये वाजिनं परिपश्यन्ति पक्वं य ईमाहुः सुरभिर्निर्हरेति । ये चार्वतो मांसभिक्षामुपासत उतो तेषामभिगूर्तिर्न इन्वतु ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye vājinaṃ paripaśyanti pakvaṃ ya īmāhuḥ surabhirnirhareti | ye cārvato māṃsabhikṣāmupāsata uto teṣāmabhigūrtirna invatu ||

translations.english: Let their exertions be for our good who watch the cooking of the horse; who say, it is fragrant; therefore give us some; who solicit the flesh of the horse as alms.
