translations.english: Heaven and earth are insufficient for the girth of that Indra, who, with his greatness, rules over the leaders (of sacrifice); as the atmosphere encompasses the earth, so he encompasses (the three worlds), and, being the master of the rain, he upholds the sky as well as the firmament and the earth.

mantras.sanskrit: समत्सु त्वा शूर सतामुराणं प्रपथिन्तमं परितंसयध्यै । सजोषस इन्द्रं मदे क्षोणीः सूरिं चिद्ये अनुमदन्ति वाजैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samatsu tvā śūra satāmurāṇaṃ prapathintamaṃ paritaṃsayadhyai | sajoṣasa indraṃ made kṣoṇīḥ sūriṃ cidye anumadanti vājaiḥ ||

translations.english: Those people, who, jointly worshipping Indra, diligently endeavour, O hero, to propitiate you, the invigorator in combats, the guide in the right way; provide, for his gratification, with sacrificial viands.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा हि ते शं सवना समुद्र आपो यत्त आसु मदन्ति देवीः । विश्वा ते अनु जोष्या भूद्गौः सूरीँश्चिद्यदि धिषा वेषि जनान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā hi te śaṃ savanā samudra āpo yatta āsu madanti devīḥ | viśvā te anu joṣyā bhūdgauḥ sūrī~ścidyadi dhiṣā veṣi janān ||

translations.english: The libations (offered) to you are, verily, the cause of happiness, since the divine waters (effused) in the firmament for the benefit of mankind afford you satisfaction. All praise, Indra, is acceptable to you, and you reward with understanding those who praise you.

mantras.sanskrit: असाम यथा सुषखाय एन स्वभिष्टयो नरां न शंसैः । असद्यथा न इन्द्रो वन्दनेष्ठास्तुरो न कर्म नयमान उक्था ॥
mantras.transliteration: asāma yathā suṣakhāya ena svabhiṣṭayo narāṃ na śaṃsaiḥ | asadyathā na indro vandaneṣṭhāsturo na karma nayamāna ukthā ||

translations.english: May we be, as it were, your valued friends, O Lord, and obtain our desires, like those (who gain their objects) by the praise of princes. May Indra, propitiated by our eulogies, be brought to the sacrifice by our hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: विष्पर्धसो नरां न शंसैरस्माकासदिन्द्रो वज्रहस्तः । मित्रायुवो न पूर्पतिं सुशिष्टौ मध्यायुव उप शिक्षन्ति यज्ञैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viṣpardhaso narāṃ na śaṃsairasmākāsadindro vajrahastaḥ | mitrāyuvo na pūrpatiṃ suśiṣṭau madhyāyuva upa śikṣanti yajñaiḥ ||

translations.english: Emulous in commendation, like (those contending for the favour) of men, may Indra, the wielder of the thunderbolt, be equally (a friend) to us; like those who, desirous of his friendship, (conciliate) the lord of a city (ruling) with good government, so do our intermediate (representatives) propitiate (Indra) with sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: यज्ञो हि ष्मेन्द्रं कश्चिदृन्धञ्जुहुराणश्चिन्मनसा परियन् । तीर्थे नाच्छा तातृषाणमोको दीर्घो न सिध्रमा कृणोत्यध्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajño hi ṣmendraṃ kaścidṛndhañjuhurāṇaścinmanasā pariyan | tīrthe nācchā tātṛṣāṇamoko dīrgho na sidhramā kṛṇotyadhvā ||

translations.english: One man propitiates Indra, augmenting (his vigour) by sacrifice; another, who is insincere, worships (him), with mind averted, (to worldly thoughts); (to the first he is) like a lake to a thirsty (pilgrim) near a sacred spot; (to the other) like a long road, which retards the end (of the journey).

mantras.sanskrit: मो षू ण इन्द्रात्र पृत्सु देवैरस्ति हि ष्मा ते शुष्मिन्नवयाः । महश्चिद्यस्य मीळ्हुषो यव्या हविष्मतो मरुतो वन्दते गीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mo ṣū ṇa indrātra pṛtsu devairasti hi ṣmā te śuṣminnavayāḥ | mahaścidyasya mīḷhuṣo yavyā haviṣmato maruto vandate gīḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, associated with the Maruts in battles (with the clouds), abandon us not; for a share of the offering is set apart, mighty one, for you, for whom, the shedder of rain and accepter of oblations, the worship is offered with oblations, whilst the hymn glorifies the Marutṣ

mantras.sanskrit: एष स्तोम इन्द्र तुभ्यमस्मे एतेन गातुं हरिवो विदो नः । आ नो ववृत्याः सुविताय देव विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa stoma indra tubhyamasme etena gātuṃ harivo vido naḥ | ā no vavṛtyāḥ suvitāya deva vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

translations.english: This hymn, Indra, is addressed to you. Lord of steeds, learn by it the way to our sacrifice, and come hither for our good, that we may thence obtain food, strength, and long life.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं राजेन्द्र ये च देवा रक्षा नॄन्पाह्यसुर त्वमस्मान् । त्वं सत्पतिर्मघवा नस्तरुत्रस्त्वं सत्यो वसवानः सहोदाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ rājendra ye ca devā rakṣā nṝnpāhyasura tvamasmān | tvaṃ satpatirmaghavā nastarutrastvaṃ satyo vasavānaḥ sahodāḥ ||

translations.english: You, Indra, are king; they who are gods (are subject) to you; therefore, scatterer (of foes), do you protect and cherish us men; you are the protector of the good, the possessor of wealth, the extricator of us (from sin); you are true, the invester (of all with your lustre) the giver of strength.

mantras.sanskrit: दनो विश इन्द्र मृध्रवाचः सप्त यत्पुरः शर्म शारदीर्दर्त् । ऋणोरपो अनवद्यार्णा यूने वृत्रं पुरुकुत्साय रन्धीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dano viśa indra mṛdhravācaḥ sapta yatpuraḥ śarma śāradīrdart | ṛṇorapo anavadyārṇā yūne vṛtraṃ purukutsāya randhīḥ ||

translations.english: You have humbled the people, suing for pardon when you have destroyed their seven new cities; you the irrproachable have dispersed the flowing waters; you have destroyed Vṛtra for the sake of the youthful Purukutsa.

mantras.sanskrit: अजा वृत इन्द्र शूरपत्नीर्द्यां च येभिः पुरुहूत नूनम् । रक्षो अग्निमशुषं तूर्वयाणं सिंहो न दमे अपांसि वस्तोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ajā vṛta indra śūrapatnīrdyāṃ ca yebhiḥ puruhūta nūnam | rakṣo agnimaśuṣaṃ tūrvayāṇaṃ siṃho na dame apāṃsi vastoḥ ||

translations.english: Go the cities inhabited by the rākṣasas, and thence to heaven (attended), receiver of many sacrifices by those who (attend you). Defend, like a lion, the untamed, quick-moving Agni, that he may abide in his dwelling, fulfilling his functions.

mantras.sanskrit: शेषन्नु त इन्द्र सस्मिन्योनौ प्रशस्तये पवीरवस्य मह्ना । सृजदर्णांस्यव यद्युधा गास्तिष्ठद्धरी धृषता मृष्ट वाजान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śeṣannu ta indra sasminyonau praśastaye pavīravasya mahnā | sṛjadarṇāṃsyava yadyudhā gāstiṣṭhaddharī dhṛṣatā mṛṣṭa vājān ||

translations.english: Let (your foes, Indra), humbled by the might of your thunderbolt rest in their own station, for your glory; when you move, (armed) with your weapons, you send down the waters; arresting your horses, increase, by your power, (the abundance of) food.

mantras.sanskrit: वह कुत्समिन्द्र यस्मिञ्चाकन्त्स्यूमन्यू ऋज्रा वातस्याश्वा । प्र सूरश्चक्रं वृहतादभीकेऽभि स्पृधो यासिषद्वज्रबाहुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vaha kutsamindra yasmiñcākantsyūmanyū ṛjrā vātasyāśvā | pra sūraścakraṃ vṛhatādabhīke'bhi spṛdho yāsiṣadvajrabāhuḥ ||

translations.english: Bear, Indra, with your obedient horses, as swift as the wind, (the sage) Kutsa, to that ceremony (to which) you desire (to convey him); let the sun bring near the wheel of his chariot, and let the thunder-armed advance against his opponents.

mantras.sanskrit: जघन्वाँ इन्द्र मित्रेरूञ्चोदप्रवृद्धो हरिवो अदाशून् । प्र ये पश्यन्नर्यमणं सचायोस्त्वया शूर्ता वहमाना अपत्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: jaghanvā~ indra mitrerūñcodapravṛddho harivo adāśūn | pra ye paśyannaryamaṇaṃ sacāyostvayā śūrtā vahamānā apatyam ||

translations.english: Indra, lord of steeds, invigorated by our animating praise, you have slain those who make you no offerings and disturb your worshippers; but they who look upon you as (their) protector, and are associated for (the presentation of sacrificial) food, obtain from the posterity.

mantras.sanskrit: रपत्कविरिन्द्रार्कसातौ क्षां दासायोपबर्हणीं कः । करत्तिस्रो मघवा दानुचित्रा नि दुर्योणे कुयवाचं मृधि श्रेत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: rapatkavirindrārkasātau kṣāṃ dāsāyopabarhaṇīṃ kaḥ | karattisro maghavā dānucitrā ni duryoṇe kuyavācaṃ mṛdhi śret ||

translations.english: The sage praises you, Indra, for the grant of desirable (food), since you have made the earth the bed of the asura; Maghavan has made the three (regions) marvellous by his gifts, and has destroyed for (the prince) Duryoṇi (the asura), Kuyavāca, in combat.

mantras.sanskrit: सना ता त इन्द्र नव्या आगुः सहो नभोऽविरणाय पूर्वीः । भिनत्पुरो न भिदो अदेवीर्ननमो वधरदेवस्य पीयोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sanā tā ta indra navyā āguḥ saho nabho'viraṇāya pūrvīḥ | bhinatpuro na bhido adevīrnanamo vadharadevasya pīyoḥ ||

translations.english: The sages have celebrated your everlasting (as well as your) recent (exploits, in achieving which) you have endured many injuries in putting an end to war; verily, you have demolished hostile and undivine cities; you have bowed down the thunderbolt of the undivine asura.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं धुनिरिन्द्र धुनिमतीॠणोरपः सीरा न स्रवन्तीः । प्र यत्समुद्रमति शूर पर्षि पारया तुर्वशं यदुं स्वस्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ dhunirindra dhunimatīṝṇorapaḥ sīrā na sravantīḥ | pra yatsamudramati śūra parṣi pārayā turvaśaṃ yaduṃ svasti ||

translations.english: You, Indra, are the terrifier (of your foes); you have made the trembling waters overspread (the earth) like flowing rivers; but, hero, when you fill the ocean you have protected in their well-being Turvaśa and Yadu.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमस्माकमिन्द्र विश्वध स्या अवृकतमो नरां नृपाता । स नो विश्वासां स्पृधां सहोदा विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamasmākamindra viśvadha syā avṛkatamo narāṃ nṛpātā | sa no viśvāsāṃ spṛdhāṃ sahodā vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

translations.english: Be you, Indra, at all times our especial defender; the preserver of our people, the bestower of strength upon all these our emulous (followers); that we may obtain food, strength, and long life.

mantras.sanskrit: मत्स्यपायि ते महः पात्रस्येव हरिवो मत्सरो मदः । वृषा ते वृष्ण इन्दुर्वाजी सहस्रसातमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: matsyapāyi te mahaḥ pātrasyeva harivo matsaro madaḥ | vṛṣā te vṛṣṇa indurvājī sahasrasātamaḥ ||

translations.english: Lord of steeds, you are exhilarated when the sacred (Soma) has been imbibed by you as by its (appropriate) vessel; for to you, showerer (of benefits), it is exhilarating, inebriating, invigorating, the yielder of delight, (satisfying as) food, and the giver of a thousand (plural asures).

mantras.sanskrit: आ नस्ते गन्तु मत्सरो वृषा मदो वरेण्यः । सहावाँ इन्द्र सानसिः पृतनाषाळमर्त्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā naste gantu matsaro vṛṣā mado vareṇyaḥ | sahāvā~ indra sānasiḥ pṛtanāṣāḷamartyaḥ ||

translations.english: May our soma libation reach you, (for it is) exhilarating, invigorating, inebriating, most precious; it is companionable, Indra, enjoyable, the over-thrower of hosts, immortal.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं हि शूरः सनिता चोदयो मनुषो रथम् । सहावान्दस्युमव्रतमोषः पात्रं न शोचिषा ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ hi śūraḥ sanitā codayo manuṣo ratham | sahāvāndasyumavratamoṣaḥ pātraṃ na śociṣā ||

translations.english: You are a hero, a benefactor, accelerate the vehicle of man (that bears him to heaven); consume, mightyone, the irreligious Dasyu, as a (woode) vessel is burnt by fire.

mantras.sanskrit: मुषाय सूर्यं कवे चक्रमीशान ओजसा । वह शुष्णाय वधं कुत्सं वातस्याश्वैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: muṣāya sūryaṃ kave cakramīśāna ojasā | vaha śuṣṇāya vadhaṃ kutsaṃ vātasyāśvaiḥ ||

translations.english: Sage Indra, who are the lord, you have carried off by your strength one wheel of (the chariot of) the sun. Take up your bolt for the death of Śuṣṇa, and proceed with your horses, swift as the wind, to Kutsa.

mantras.sanskrit: शुष्मिन्तमो हि ते मदो द्युम्निन्तम उत क्रतुः । वृत्रघ्ना वरिवोविदा मंसीष्ठा अश्वसातमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śuṣmintamo hi te mado dyumnintama uta kratuḥ | vṛtraghnā varivovidā maṃsīṣṭhā aśvasātamaḥ ||

translations.english: Your inebriety is most intense; nevertheless, your acts (for our good) are most beneficent. You desire, bountiful giver of horses, that (both your inebriety and your beneficence should be the means of) destroying enemies and distributing riches.

mantras.sanskrit: यथा पूर्वेभ्यो जरितृभ्य इन्द्र मय इवापो न तृष्यते बभूथ । तामनु त्वा निविदं जोहवीमि विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathā pūrvebhyo jaritṛbhya indra maya ivāpo na tṛṣyate babhūtha | tāmanu tvā nividaṃ johavīmi vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

translations.english: Inasmuch Indra, as you have been the (giver of) happiness to your ancient encomiasts, like water to one who is thirsty, therefore I constantly repeat this your praise, that I may thence obtain food, strength and long life.

mantras.sanskrit: मत्सि नो वस्यैष्टय इन्द्रमिन्दो वृषा विश । ऋघायमाण इन्वसि शत्रुमन्ति न विन्दसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: matsi no vasyaiṣṭaya indramindo vṛṣā viśa | ṛghāyamāṇa invasi śatrumanti na vindasi ||

translations.english: Soma, exhilarate Indra (at the sacrifice we offer), for the sake of obtaining wealth; pervade him, showerer (ofbenefits), for when imbibed you are the annihilator (of enemies), and suffer not a foe to be nigh.

mantras.sanskrit: तस्मिन्ना वेशया गिरो य एकश्चर्षणीनाम् । अनु स्वधा यमुप्यते यवं न चर्कृषद्वृषा ॥
mantras.transliteration: tasminnā veśayā giro ya ekaścarṣaṇīnām | anu svadhā yamupyate yavaṃ na carkṛṣadvṛṣā ||

translations.english: Pervade with our praise him who is the sole sustainer of men, to whom the oblation is presented and who, the showerer (of benefits), causes (every desire) to bud like barley.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य विश्वानि हस्तयोः पञ्च क्षितीनां वसु । स्पाशयस्व यो अस्मध्रुग्दिव्येवाशनिर्जहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya viśvāni hastayoḥ pañca kṣitīnāṃ vasu | spāśayasva yo asmadhrugdivyevāśanirjahi ||

translations.english: In whosehands are all the treasures (that are desired by) the five classes of beings; destroy, Indra, him who oppresses us; slay him, (as if you were yourself) the heavenly thunderbolt.

mantras.sanskrit: असुन्वन्तं समं जहि दूणाशं यो न ते मयः । अस्मभ्यमस्य वेदनं दद्धि सूरिश्चिदोहते ॥
mantras.transliteration: asunvantaṃ samaṃ jahi dūṇāśaṃ yo na te mayaḥ | asmabhyamasya vedanaṃ daddhi sūriścidohate ||

translations.english: Slay every one who offers not libations, however difficult to be destroyed; slay every one who is no delight to you; bestow upon us his wealth, for the pious (worshipper) deserves it.

mantras.sanskrit: आवो यस्य द्विबर्हसोऽर्केषु सानुषगसत् । आजाविन्द्रस्येन्दो प्रावो वाजेषु वाजिनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: āvo yasya dvibarhaso'rkeṣu sānuṣagasat | ājāvindrasyendo prāvo vājeṣu vājinam ||

translations.english: Soma, you protect him in whose prayers, doubly devout, there is the combination (of praise and oblation); protect, especially, Indra in war; protect the vigorous Indra in battles.

mantras.sanskrit: यथा पूर्वेभ्यो जरितृभ्य इन्द्र मय इवापो न तृष्यते बभूथ । तामनु त्वा निविदं जोहवीमि विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathā pūrvebhyo jaritṛbhya indra maya ivāpo na tṛṣyate babhūtha | tāmanu tvā nividaṃ johavīmi vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

translations.english: Inasmuch Indra, as you have been the giver of happiness to your ancient encomiasts, like water to one who is thirsty, therefore I constantly repeat this your praise, that I may thence obtain food, strength, and long life.

mantras.sanskrit: आ चर्षणिप्रा वृषभो जनानां राजा कृष्टीनां पुरुहूत इन्द्रः । स्तुतः श्रवस्यन्नवसोप मद्रिग्युक्त्वा हरी वृषणा याह्यर्वाङ् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā carṣaṇiprā vṛṣabho janānāṃ rājā kṛṣṭīnāṃ puruhūta indraḥ | stutaḥ śravasyannavasopa madrigyuktvā harī vṛṣaṇā yāhyarvāṅ ||

translations.english: May Indra, who is the cherisher of men, the benefactor of mankind,t he lord of men, the adored of many, (come to us), Indra, who are praised (by us), and are desirous of the oblation, harness your vigorous steeds, and come down to me for (my preservation).

mantras.sanskrit: ये ते वृषणो वृषभास इन्द्र ब्रह्मयुजो वृषरथासो अत्याः । ताँ आ तिष्ठ तेभिरा याह्यर्वाङ्हवामहे त्वा सुत इन्द्र सोमे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye te vṛṣaṇo vṛṣabhāsa indra brahmayujo vṛṣarathāso atyāḥ | tā~ ā tiṣṭha tebhirā yāhyarvāṅhavāmahe tvā suta indra some ||

translations.english: Mount, Indra, your steeds, who are young and vigorous, tractable to prayer, and harnessed to a bounty-shedding car; come down with them to us. We invoke you, Indra, the libation being poured out.

mantras.sanskrit: आ तिष्ठ रथं वृषणं वृषा ते सुतः सोमः परिषिक्ता मधूनि । युक्त्वा वृषभ्यां वृषभ क्षितीनां हरिभ्यां याहि प्रवतोप मद्रिक् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tiṣṭha rathaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vṛṣā te sutaḥ somaḥ pariṣiktā madhūni | yuktvā vṛṣabhyāṃ vṛṣabha kṣitīnāṃ haribhyāṃ yāhi pravatopa madrik ||

translations.english: Ascend your bounty-shedding car, for you the Soma, the showerer of benefits, is effused, the sweet libations are prepared. Bounty-shedding Indra, having harnessed them, come with your vigorous steeds for (the good of) mankind; come with your rapid (car) to my presence.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं यज्ञो देवया अयं मियेध इमा ब्रह्माण्ययमिन्द्र सोमः । स्तीर्णं बर्हिरा तु शक्र प्र याहि पिबा निषद्य वि मुचा हरी इह ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ yajño devayā ayaṃ miyedha imā brahmāṇyayamindra somaḥ | stīrṇaṃ barhirā tu śakra pra yāhi pibā niṣadya vi mucā harī iha ||

translations.english: This is the sacrifice offered to the gods; this is the offering of the victim; these are the prayers; this, Indra, is the Soma; the sacred grass is ready strewn; come, therefore, Indra, quickly, sit down, drink (the libation); here let loose your steeds.

mantras.sanskrit: ओ सुष्टुत इन्द्र याह्यर्वाङुप ब्रह्माणि मान्यस्य कारोः । विद्याम वस्तोरवसा गृणन्तो विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: o suṣṭuta indra yāhyarvāṅupa brahmāṇi mānyasya kāroḥ | vidyāma vastoravasā gṛṇanto vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

translations.english: Glorified by us, Indra, come to (our) presence to accept the prayers of the venerable offerer (of the oblation); so that we may ever enjoy prosperity through your protection, and thence obtain food, strength and long life.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्ध स्या त इन्द्र श्रुष्टिरस्ति यया बभूथ जरितृभ्य ऊती । मा नः कामं महयन्तमा धग्विश्वा ते अश्यां पर्याप आयोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaddha syā ta indra śruṣṭirasti yayā babhūtha jaritṛbhya ūtī | mā naḥ kāmaṃ mahayantamā dhagviśvā te aśyāṃ paryāpa āyoḥ ||

translations.english: Inasmuch, Indra, as the praise by which you are (induced to bestow) protection on your adorers is heard (by all), therefore disappoint not the desire (that would raise us) to greatness; may I obtain, through your (favour), all things that are obtainable by man.

mantras.sanskrit: न घा राजेन्द्र आ दभन्नो या नु स्वसारा कृणवन्त योनौ । आपश्चिदस्मै सुतुका अवेषन्गमन्न इन्द्रः सख्या वयश्च ॥
mantras.transliteration: na ghā rājendra ā dabhanno yā nu svasārā kṛṇavanta yonau | āpaścidasmai sutukā aveṣangamanna indraḥ sakhyā vayaśca ||

translations.english: Let not the royal Indra frustrate those our actions, which the sisters, (Day and Night), are directing to their object. May these invigorating offerings propitiate hi, so that he may bestow upon us friendly (regard), and (abundant) food.

mantras.sanskrit: जेता नृभिरिन्द्रः पृत्सु शूरः श्रोता हवं नाधमानस्य कारोः । प्रभर्ता रथं दाशुष उपाक उद्यन्ता गिरो यदि च त्मना भूत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: jetā nṛbhirindraḥ pṛtsu śūraḥ śrotā havaṃ nādhamānasya kāroḥ | prabhartā rathaṃ dāśuṣa upāka udyantā giro yadi ca tmanā bhūt ||

translations.english: Indra, the hero, the victor in battles, along with the leaders (of his hosts, the Maruts), will hear the invocation of his supplicating worshipper, and when disposed to accept his praises, will, of his own accord, drive his chariot close to the donor (of the oblation).

mantras.sanskrit: एवा नृभिरिन्द्रः सुश्रवस्या प्रखादः पृक्षो अभि मित्रिणो भूत् । समर्य इषः स्तवते विवाचि सत्राकरो यजमानस्य शंसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā nṛbhirindraḥ suśravasyā prakhādaḥ pṛkṣo abhi mitriṇo bhūt | samarya iṣaḥ stavate vivāci satrākaro yajamānasya śaṃsaḥ ||

translations.english: Verily, Indra through desire of (sacrificial) food, is the devourer (of that which is presented) by (his) worshippers, and overcomes (the adversaries) of his friend; in the many-voiced assembly (of men), Indra, the faithful (performer of his promise), commending (the piety) of his worshipper, approves of the (offered) food.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वया वयं मघवन्निन्द्र शत्रूनभि ष्याम महतो मन्यमानान् । त्वं त्राता त्वमु नो वृधे भूर्विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvayā vayaṃ maghavannindra śatrūnabhi ṣyāma mahato manyamānān | tvaṃ trātā tvamu no vṛdhe bhūrvidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

translations.english: By you, opulent Indra, may we overcome our mighty and formidable enemies; you are our protector; may you be propitious to our prosperity, that we may thence obtain food, strength and long life.

mantras.sanskrit: पूर्वीरहं शरदः शश्रमाणा दोषा वस्तोरुषसो जरयन्तीः । मिनाति श्रियं जरिमा तनूनामप्यू नु पत्नीर्वृषणो जगम्युः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pūrvīrahaṃ śaradaḥ śaśramāṇā doṣā vastoruṣaso jarayantīḥ | mināti śriyaṃ jarimā tanūnāmapyū nu patnīrvṛṣaṇo jagamyuḥ ||

translations.english: (Lopāmudrā): Many years have I been serving you diligently, both day and night, and through mornings, bringing on old age; decay now impairs the beauty of my limbs; what, therefore, is now (to be done); let husbands approach their wives.

mantras.sanskrit: ये चिद्धि पूर्व ऋतसाप आसन्त्साकं देवेभिरवदन्नृतानि । ते चिदवासुर्नह्यन्तमापुः समू नु पत्नीर्वृषभिर्जगम्युः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye ciddhi pūrva ṛtasāpa āsantsākaṃ devebhiravadannṛtāni | te cidavāsurnahyantamāpuḥ samū nu patnīrvṛṣabhirjagamyuḥ ||

translations.english: The ancient sages, disseminators of truth, who, verily, conversed of tuths with the gods, begot (progeny), nor thereby violated (their vow of continence), therefore should wives be approached by their husbands.

mantras.sanskrit: न मृषा श्रान्तं यदवन्ति देवा विश्वा इत्स्पृधो अभ्यश्नवाव । जयावेदत्र शतनीथमाजिं यत्सम्यञ्चा मिथुनावभ्यजाव ॥
mantras.transliteration: na mṛṣā śrāntaṃ yadavanti devā viśvā itspṛdho abhyaśnavāva | jayāvedatra śatanīthamājiṃ yatsamyañcā mithunāvabhyajāva ||

translations.english: (Agastya): Penance has not been practised in vain; since the gods protect us, we may indulge all our desires; in this world we may triumph in many conflicts, if we exert ourselves mutually together.

mantras.sanskrit: नदस्य मा रुधतः काम आगन्नित आजातो अमुतः कुतश्चित् । लोपामुद्रा वृषणं नी रिणाति धीरमधीरा धयति श्वसन्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nadasya mā rudhataḥ kāma āgannita ājāto amutaḥ kutaścit | lopāmudrā vṛṣaṇaṃ nī riṇāti dhīramadhīrā dhayati śvasantam ||

translations.english: Desire, either from this cause or from that, has come upon me whilst engaged in prayer and suppressing (passion); let Lopāmudrā approach her husband; the unsteady feminine le beguiles the firm and resolute man.

mantras.sanskrit: इमं नु सोममन्तितो हृत्सु पीतमुप ब्रुवे । यत्सीमागश्चकृमा तत्सु मृळतु पुलुकामो हि मर्त्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imaṃ nu somamantito hṛtsu pītamupa bruve | yatsīmāgaścakṛmā tatsu mṛḷatu pulukāmo hi martyaḥ ||

translations.english: (Pupil): I beseech the Soma, which has been drunk in my heart, that it may fully expiate the sin we have committed; man is subject to many desires.

mantras.sanskrit: अगस्त्यः खनमानः खनित्रैः प्रजामपत्यं बलमिच्छमानः । उभौ वर्णावृषिरुग्रः पुपोष सत्या देवेष्वाशिषो जगाम ॥
mantras.transliteration: agastyaḥ khanamānaḥ khanitraiḥ prajāmapatyaṃ balamicchamānaḥ | ubhau varṇāvṛṣirugraḥ pupoṣa satyā deveṣvāśiṣo jagāma ||

translations.english: Agastya, a venerable sage, working with (fit) implements, desiring progeny, offspring, and strength, practised both classes (of obligations), and received true benedictions from the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: युवो रजांसि सुयमासो अश्वा रथो यद्वां पर्यर्णांसि दीयत् । हिरण्यया वां पवयः प्रुषायन्मध्वः पिबन्ता उषसः सचेथे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvo rajāṃsi suyamāso aśvā ratho yadvāṃ paryarṇāṃsi dīyat | hiraṇyayā vāṃ pavayaḥ pruṣāyanmadhvaḥ pibantā uṣasaḥ sacethe ||

translations.english: Aśvins, your horses are traversers of the (three) regions, when your chariot proceeds to (its desired) quarters; the golden fellies of your wheels grant (whatever is wished for); drinking the Soma, you participate in the morning (rite).

mantras.sanskrit: युवमत्यस्याव नक्षथो यद्विपत्मनो नर्यस्य प्रयज्योः । स्वसा यद्वां विश्वगूर्ती भराति वाजायेट्टे मधुपाविषे च ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvamatyasyāva nakṣatho yadvipatmano naryasya prayajyoḥ | svasā yadvāṃ viśvagūrtī bharāti vājāyeṭṭe madhupāviṣe ca ||

translations.english: Direct downwards (the course) of your (car) swift moving, variously going, friendly to man, and to be especially venerated, when all adorable, your sister (dawn) prepares (for your approach), and (the instrumental tutor of the ceremony) worships you, drinkers of the Soma, for the sake (of obtaining) strength and food.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं पय उस्रियायामधत्तं पक्वमामायामव पूर्व्यं गोः । अन्तर्यद्वनिनो वामृतप्सू ह्वारो न शुचिर्यजते हविष्मान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ paya usriyāyāmadhattaṃ pakvamāmāyāmava pūrvyaṃ goḥ | antaryadvanino vāmṛtapsū hvāro na śuciryajate haviṣmān ||

translations.english: Youhave restored milk to the cow; you have (brought) down the prior mature (secretion) into the unripe (or barren udder) of the cow; the devout offerer of the oblation worships you, whose forms are truth, (as vigilant in the midst of the ceremony), as a thief (in the midst) of a thicket.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं ह घर्मं मधुमन्तमत्रयेऽपो न क्षोदोऽवृणीतमेषे । तद्वां नरावश्विना पश्वैष्टी रथ्येव चक्रा प्रति यन्ति मध्वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ ha gharmaṃ madhumantamatraye'po na kṣodo'vṛṇītameṣe | tadvāṃ narāvaśvinā paśvaiṣṭī rathyeva cakrā prati yanti madhvaḥ ||

translations.english: You rendered the heat as soothing as sweet butter to Atri; wishing (for relief), and invested it with coolness,like water; therefore, for you, Aśvins, leaders (of rites) the fire-offering (is made); to you the Soma (drips) run like chariot wheels (down a declivity).

mantras.sanskrit: आ वां दानाय ववृतीय दस्रा गोरोहेण तौग्र्यो न जिव्रिः । अपः क्षोणी सचते माहिना वां जूर्णो वामक्षुरंहसो यजत्रा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāṃ dānāya vavṛtīya dasrā goroheṇa taugryo na jivriḥ | apaḥ kṣoṇī sacate māhinā vāṃ jūrṇo vāmakṣuraṃhaso yajatrā ||

translations.english: Dasras, may I bring you, by the vehicle of my prayers, (hither), to bestow (upon me your aid), like the infirm son of Tugra; heaven and earth combine (to worship you) through your greatness; may this, your aged (worshipper), adorable (Aśvins), enjoy long life, (exempt) from sin.

mantras.sanskrit: नि यद्युवेथे नियुतः सुदानू उप स्वधाभिः सृजथः पुरंधिम् । प्रेषद्वेषद्वातो न सूरिरा महे ददे सुव्रतो न वाजम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni yadyuvethe niyutaḥ sudānū upa svadhābhiḥ sṛjathaḥ puraṃdhim | preṣadveṣadvāto na sūrirā mahe dade suvrato na vājam ||

translations.english: Bountiful givers, when you yoke your horses you replenish the earth with viands; may this your worshipper be (swift) as the wind to propitiate and plural ase you, that, through your great (favour), he may, like a pious man, obtain food.

mantras.sanskrit: वयं चिद्धि वां जरितारः सत्या विपन्यामहे वि पणिर्हितावान् । अधा चिद्धि ष्माश्विनावनिन्द्या पाथो हि ष्मा वृषणावन्तिदेवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayaṃ ciddhi vāṃ jaritāraḥ satyā vipanyāmahe vi paṇirhitāvān | adhā ciddhi ṣmāśvināvanindyā pātho hi ṣmā vṛṣaṇāvantidevam ||

translations.english: Your sincere adorers, we verily praise you in various ways. The pitcher has been plural ced (ready for the Soma). Irreproachable Aśvins, showerers (of benefits) drink freely of the juice in the presence of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: युवां चिद्धि ष्माश्विनावनु द्यून्विरुद्रस्य प्रस्रवणस्य सातौ । अगस्त्यो नरां नृषु प्रशस्तः काराधुनीव चितयत्सहस्रैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvāṃ ciddhi ṣmāśvināvanu dyūnvirudrasya prasravaṇasya sātau | agastyo narāṃ nṛṣu praśastaḥ kārādhunīva citayatsahasraiḥ ||

translations.english: Aśvins, Agastya, eminent among the leader of men, arouses you daily with numerous (invocations) like an instrumental ument of sound, for the sake of obtaining a manifold (flow) of a torrent (of rain).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र यद्वहेथे महिना रथस्य प्र स्यन्द्रा याथो मनुषो न होता । धत्तं सूरिभ्य उत वा स्वश्व्यं नासत्या रयिषाचः स्याम ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra yadvahethe mahinā rathasya pra syandrā yātho manuṣo na hotā | dhattaṃ sūribhya uta vā svaśvyaṃ nāsatyā rayiṣācaḥ syāma ||

translations.english: When, by the virtue of your chariot, you come (to the sacrifice), and when, like the ministering priest (after discharging his rfunction), you depart, gliding away, you give to the devout (worshippers a reward), thogh it be store of good horses; may we be enriched, Nāsatyās (by your favour).

mantras.sanskrit: तं वां रथं वयमद्या हुवेम स्तोमैरश्विना सुविताय नव्यम् । अरिष्टनेमिं परि द्यामियानं विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ vāṃ rathaṃ vayamadyā huvema stomairaśvinā suvitāya navyam | ariṣṭanemiṃ pari dyāmiyānaṃ vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

translations.english: We invoke today, Aśvins, with hymns, for the sake of good things, your praiseworthy chariot of undamaged wheels, and traversing the sky, that we may obtain (from it) food, strength and long life.

mantras.sanskrit: कदु प्रेष्टाविषां रयीणामध्वर्यन्ता यदुन्निनीथो अपाम् । अयं वां यज्ञो अकृत प्रशस्तिं वसुधिती अवितारा जनानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kadu preṣṭāviṣāṃ rayīṇāmadhvaryantā yadunninītho apām | ayaṃ vāṃ yajño akṛta praśastiṃ vasudhitī avitārā janānām ||

translations.english: When, beloved (Aśvins), do you bear aloft (the materials) of food and riches, that, desirous of the sacrifice, you may send down the rain; this sacrifice offers you adoration, givers of riches, protectors of men.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वामश्वासः शुचयः पयस्पा वातरंहसो दिव्यासो अत्याः । मनोजुवो वृषणो वीतपृष्ठा एह स्वराजो अश्विना वहन्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāmaśvāsaḥ śucayaḥ payaspā vātaraṃhaso divyāso atyāḥ | manojuvo vṛṣaṇo vītapṛṣṭhā eha svarājo aśvinā vahantu ||

translations.english: Aśvins, may your horses, pure, rain-drinking, swift as the wind, heaven-born, quick-moving, fleet as thought, vigorous, well-backed, and self-irradiating, bring you hither.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वां रथोऽवनिर्न प्रवत्वान्त्सृप्रवन्धुरः सुविताय गम्याः । वृष्णः स्थातारा मनसो जवीयानहम्पूर्वो यजतो धिष्ण्या यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāṃ ratho'vanirna pravatvāntsṛpravandhuraḥ suvitāya gamyāḥ | vṛṣṇaḥ sthātārā manaso javīyānahampūrvo yajato dhiṣṇyā yaḥ ||

translations.english: Aśvins, excellent and steady, may your chariot, vast as the earth, broad-fronted, rapid as the rain (fleet) as thought, cumulative and adorable, come hither for (our) good.

mantras.sanskrit: इहेह जाता समवावशीतामरेपसा तन्वा नामभिः स्वैः । जिष्णुर्वामन्यः सुमखस्य सूरिर्दिवो अन्यः सुभगः पुत्र ऊहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: iheha jātā samavāvaśītāmarepasā tanvā nāmabhiḥ svaiḥ | jiṣṇurvāmanyaḥ sumakhasya sūrirdivo anyaḥ subhagaḥ putra ūhe ||

translations.english: Born here (in the middle region) and here (in the upper region), you are glorified together, as faultless in your forms and (perfect in) your own many excellences; one (of you) the victorious son (of the firmament), the devout (promoter) of sacred sacrifice, the other, the auspicious son of heaven, (each) upholds (the world).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वां निचेरुः ककुहो वशाँ अनु पिशङ्गरूपः सदनानि गम्याः । हरी अन्यस्य पीपयन्त वाजैर्मथ्रा रजांस्यश्विना वि घोषैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vāṃ niceruḥ kakuho vaśā~ anu piśaṅgarūpaḥ sadanāni gamyāḥ | harī anyasya pīpayanta vājairmathrā rajāṃsyaśvinā vi ghoṣaiḥ ||

translations.english: Aśvins, may the golden-coloured (car of one of you), traversing at will the quarters of space, come to our dwellings; may mankind encourage the horses of the other by food, by friction, and by shouts.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वां शरद्वान्वृषभो न निष्षाट् पूर्वीरिषश्चरति मध्व इष्णन् । एवैरन्यस्य पीपयन्त वाजैर्वेषन्तीरूर्ध्वा नद्यो न आगुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vāṃ śaradvānvṛṣabho na niṣṣāṭ pūrvīriṣaścarati madhva iṣṇan | evairanyasya pīpayanta vājairveṣantīrūrdhvā nadyo na āguḥ ||

translations.english: (One of you), the disperser (of the clouds), like Indra, the annihilator (of his foes), desirous of the oblation, proceeds (bestowing) abundant food. (Devout worshippers) cherish with (sacrificial) viands, (the faculties) of the other, for the sake of favours, which flow upon us like swelling rivers.

mantras.sanskrit: असर्जि वां स्थविरा वेधसा गीर्बाळ्हे अश्विना त्रेधा क्षरन्ती । उपस्तुताववतं नाधमानं यामन्नयामञ्छृणुतं हवं मे ॥
mantras.transliteration: asarji vāṃ sthavirā vedhasā gīrbāḷhe aśvinā tredhā kṣarantī | upastutāvavataṃ nādhamānaṃ yāmannayāmañchṛṇutaṃ havaṃ me ||

translations.english: Aśvins, creators, the perpetual threefold hymn addressed to you, has been uttered, (to secure) your steady (favour); thus glorified protect him who solicits (your bounty), and whether moving or resting, hear his invocation.

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्या वां रुशतो वप्ससो गीस्त्रिबर्हिषि सदसि पिन्वते नॄन् । वृषा वां मेघो वृषणा पीपाय गोर्न सेके मनुषो दशस्यन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta syā vāṃ ruśato vapsaso gīstribarhiṣi sadasi pinvate nṝn | vṛṣā vāṃ megho vṛṣaṇā pīpāya gorna seke manuṣo daśasyan ||

translations.english: May the praise of your resplendent forms, (uttered) in the hall of sacrifice, thrice strewn with sacred grass, bring prosperity to the conductors (of the sacrifice). Showerers (of benefits), may the raining-cloud, proceeding to man, nourish him lik a a sprinkling of water.

mantras.sanskrit: युवां पूषेवाश्विना पुरंधिरग्निमुषां न जरते हविष्मान् । हुवे यद्वां वरिवस्या गृणानो विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvāṃ pūṣevāśvinā puraṃdhiragnimuṣāṃ na jarate haviṣmān | huve yadvāṃ varivasyā gṛṇāno vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

translations.english: The wise offerer of oblations, like Pūṣan, praises you, Aśvins, as (he would praise) Agni and Uṣā, (at the season) at which I invoke you praising with devotion that we may thence obtain food, strength, and long life.

mantras.sanskrit: अभूदिदं वयुनमो षु भूषता रथो वृषण्वान्मदता मनीषिणः । धियंजिन्वा धिष्ण्या विश्पलावसू दिवो नपाता सुकृते शुचिव्रता ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhūdidaṃ vayunamo ṣu bhūṣatā ratho vṛṣaṇvānmadatā manīṣiṇaḥ | dhiyaṃjinvā dhiṣṇyā viśpalāvasū divo napātā sukṛte śucivratā ||

translations.english: The information, sage (priests), has been received; be ready with your praises, for the (benefit) showering car (of the Aśvins has arrived); propitiate (the divinities), for they show favour to the doer of good works; they are entitled to praise, rich in benevolence to mankind the grandsons of heaven, and observers of holy rites.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रतमा हि धिष्ण्या मरुत्तमा दस्रा दंसिष्ठा रथ्या रथीतमा । पूर्णं रथं वहेथे मध्व आचितं तेन दाश्वांसमुप याथो अश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: indratamā hi dhiṣṇyā maruttamā dasrā daṃsiṣṭhā rathyā rathītamā | pūrṇaṃ rathaṃ vahethe madhva ācitaṃ tena dāśvāṃsamupa yātho aśvinā ||

translations.english: Dasras, in truth most imperial, adorable, swifter than the winds, and eminent in good works, riders in a car, and most distinguished charioteers, bring hither your car, full heaped up with ambrosia, and with it come, Aśvins, to the donor (of the offering).

mantras.sanskrit: किमत्र दस्रा कृणुथः किमासाथे जनो यः कश्चिदहविर्महीयते । अति क्रमिष्टं जुरतं पणेरसुं ज्योतिर्विप्राय कृणुतं वचस्यवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: kimatra dasrā kṛṇuthaḥ kimāsāthe jano yaḥ kaścidahavirmahīyate | ati kramiṣṭaṃ jurataṃ paṇerasuṃ jyotirviprāya kṛṇutaṃ vacasyave ||

translations.english: What makes you here, Aśvins; why do you tarry, (where) any man who makes no oblation is respected; humble him; take away the life of the niggard; grant light to the pious man striving to speak your praise.

mantras.sanskrit: जम्भयतमभितो रायतः शुनो हतं मृधो विदथुस्तान्यश्विना । वाचंवाचं जरितू रत्निनीं कृतमुभा शंसं नासत्यावतं मम ॥
mantras.transliteration: jambhayatamabhito rāyataḥ śuno hataṃ mṛdho vidathustānyaśvinā | vācaṃvācaṃ jaritū ratninīṃ kṛtamubhā śaṃsaṃ nāsatyāvataṃ mama ||

translations.english: Annihilate, Aśvins, the dogs who bark at us; slay them warring (against us); you know their (means of harm); render every word of him who praises you affluent in precious (rewards); accept Nāsatyas, both of you, may praise.

mantras.sanskrit: युवमेतं चक्रथुः सिन्धुषु प्लवमात्मन्वन्तं पक्षिणं तौग्र्याय कम् । येन देवत्रा मनसा निरूहथुः सुपप्तनी पेतथुः क्षोदसो महः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvametaṃ cakrathuḥ sindhuṣu plavamātmanvantaṃ pakṣiṇaṃ taugryāya kam | yena devatrā manasā nirūhathuḥ supaptanī petathuḥ kṣodaso mahaḥ ||

translations.english: You constructed a plural asant, substantial winged bark, borne on the ocean waters for the son of Tugra, by which, with minddevoted to the gods, you bore him up, and quickly descending (from the sky), you made a path for him across the great waters.

mantras.sanskrit: अवविद्धं तौग्र्यमप्स्वन्तरनारम्भणे तमसि प्रविद्धम् । चतस्रो नावो जठलस्य जुष्टा उदश्विभ्यामिषिताः पारयन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: avaviddhaṃ taugryamapsvantaranārambhaṇe tamasi praviddham | catasro nāvo jaṭhalasya juṣṭā udaśvibhyāmiṣitāḥ pārayanti ||

translations.english: Four ships launched into the midst of the receptable (of the waters), sent by the Aśvins, brought safe to shore the son of Tugra, who had been cast headlong into the waters (by his foes), and plural nged in extricable darkness.

mantras.sanskrit: कः स्विद्वृक्षो निःष्ठितो मध्ये अर्णसो यं तौग्र्यो नाधितः पर्यषस्वजत् । पर्णा मृगस्य पतरोरिवारभ उदश्विना ऊहथुः श्रोमताय कम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kaḥ svidvṛkṣo niḥṣṭhito madhye arṇaso yaṃ taugryo nādhitaḥ paryaṣasvajat | parṇā mṛgasya patarorivārabha udaśvinā ūhathuḥ śromatāya kam ||

translations.english: What was the tree that was stationed in the midst of the ocean, to which the supplicating son of Tugra clung; as leaves (are caught hold of) for the support of a falling animal; you, Aśvins, bore him up to safety, to your great renown.

mantras.sanskrit: तद्वां नरा नासत्यावनु ष्याद्यद्वां मानास उचथमवोचन् । अस्मादद्य सदसः सोम्यादा विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadvāṃ narā nāsatyāvanu ṣyādyadvāṃ mānāsa ucathamavocan | asmādadya sadasaḥ somyādā vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

translations.english: May the praise which your devout adorers have uttered be acceptable to you, Nāsatyas, leaders (in pious rites); be propitiated today by the libations of our assembly, that we may obtain food, strength and long life.

mantras.sanskrit: तं युञ्जाथां मनसो यो जवीयान्त्रिवन्धुरो वृषणा यस्त्रिचक्रः । येनोपयाथः सुकृतो दुरोणं त्रिधातुना पतथो विर्न पर्णैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ yuñjāthāṃ manaso yo javīyāntrivandhuro vṛṣaṇā yastricakraḥ | yenopayāthaḥ sukṛto duroṇaṃ tridhātunā patatho virna parṇaiḥ ||

translations.english: Showerers of benefits, harness the car which has three benches, three wheels, and is as quick as thought; with which, embellished with three metals, you come to the dwelling of the pious (worshipper), and in which you travel like a bird with wings.

mantras.sanskrit: सुवृद्रथो वर्तते यन्नभि क्षां यत्तिष्ठथः क्रतुमन्तानु पृक्षे । वपुर्वपुष्या सचतामियं गीर्दिवो दुहित्रोषसा सचेथे ॥
mantras.transliteration: suvṛdratho vartate yannabhi kṣāṃ yattiṣṭhathaḥ kratumantānu pṛkṣe | vapurvapuṣyā sacatāmiyaṃ gīrdivo duhitroṣasā sacethe ||

translations.english: Your easy-rolling car alights upon the earth, where favourable to the sacred rite, you stop for the sake of the (sacrificial) food; may this hymn, promotive of your person nal (welfare), be associated with your forms, and do you unite with the dawn, the daughter of heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: आ तिष्ठतं सुवृतं यो रथो वामनु व्रतानि वर्तते हविष्मान् । येन नरा नासत्येषयध्यै वर्तिर्याथस्तनयाय त्मने च ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tiṣṭhataṃ suvṛtaṃ yo ratho vāmanu vratāni vartate haviṣmān | yena narā nāsatyeṣayadhyai vartiryāthastanayāya tmane ca ||

translations.english: Ascend your rolling car, which approaches the sacred rite of the offerer of the oblation; the car in which, Nāsatyas, leaders, you purpose to come to the sacrifice, and proceed to the dwelling (of the worshipper), for (bestowing upon him) offspring, and for his own (good).

mantras.sanskrit: मा वां वृको मा वृकीरा दधर्षीन्मा परि वर्क्तमुत माति धक्तम् । अयं वां भागो निहित इयं गीर्दस्राविमे वां निधयो मधूनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā vāṃ vṛko mā vṛkīrā dadharṣīnmā pari varktamuta māti dhaktam | ayaṃ vāṃ bhāgo nihita iyaṃ gīrdasrāvime vāṃ nidhayo madhūnām ||

translations.english: Let not the wolf, let not the she-wolf, harm me safe (in your protection); abandon me not, nor deliver me (to another). This your share (of the offering) is prepared; this prayer, Dasras, (is addressed) to you; these treasures of Soma are for you.

mantras.sanskrit: युवां गोतमः पुरुमीळ्हो अत्रिर्दस्रा हवतेऽवसे हविष्मान् । दिशं न दिष्टामृजूयेव यन्ता मे हवं नासत्योप यातम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvāṃ gotamaḥ purumīḷho atrirdasrā havate'vase haviṣmān | diśaṃ na diṣṭāmṛjūyeva yantā me havaṃ nāsatyopa yātam ||

translations.english: Gotama, Purimiḷha, Atri, (each) offering oblations, invokes you for his protection; like unto a wayfarer, who (makes for his intended direction) by a straight (path) do you, Dasras, come (direct) to my invocation).

mantras.sanskrit: अतारिष्म तमसस्पारमस्य प्रति वां स्तोमो अश्विनावधायि । एह यातं पथिभिर्देवयानैर्विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: atāriṣma tamasaspāramasya prati vāṃ stomo aśvināvadhāyi | eha yātaṃ pathibhirdevayānairvidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

translations.english: (Through your aid) Aśvins, we cross over this (limit of) darkness; to you this (our) hymn has been addressed; come hither by the paths traversed by the gods, that we may obtain food, and strength, and long life.

mantras.sanskrit: ता वामद्य तावपरं हुवेमोच्छन्त्यामुषसि वह्निरुक्थैः । नासत्या कुह चित्सन्तावर्यो दिवो नपाता सुदास्तराय ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā vāmadya tāvaparaṃ huvemocchantyāmuṣasi vahnirukthaiḥ | nāsatyā kuha citsantāvaryo divo napātā sudāstarāya ||

translations.english: We invoke you two, (Aśvins), today; the same two on any other day; when the morning dawns. Nāsatyas, grandsons of heaven, wherever you may be, the pious reciter (of the hymn) invokes you with praises on behalf of the liberal donor (of the offering).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मे ऊ षु वृषणा मादयेथामुत्पणीँर्हतमूर्म्या मदन्ता । श्रुतं मे अच्छोक्तिभिर्मतीनामेष्टा नरा निचेतारा च कर्णैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asme ū ṣu vṛṣaṇā mādayethāmutpaṇī~rhatamūrmyā madantā | śrutaṃ me acchoktibhirmatīnāmeṣṭā narā nicetārā ca karṇaiḥ ||

translations.english: Showerers (of benefits), rejoicing in (our) libations), make us happy, and destroy the niggard (withholder) of offerings; hear, leaders, with your ears, my praises addressed to you with pure words, for you are seekers (after praise), you are retentive (of laudation).

mantras.sanskrit: श्रिये पूषन्निषुकृतेव देवा नासत्या वहतुं सूर्यायाः । वच्यन्ते वां ककुहा अप्सु जाता युगा जूर्णेव वरुणस्य भूरेः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śriye pūṣanniṣukṛteva devā nāsatyā vahatuṃ sūryāyāḥ | vacyante vāṃ kakuhā apsu jātā yugā jūrṇeva varuṇasya bhūreḥ ||

translations.english: Divine Aśvins, in whom is no untruth, (darting) like arrows to acquire glory, and to carry off Sūrya, to you are addressed the prayers that are recited at holy rites, for (the completion of) the uninterrupted, sin-removing (sacrifice), as ancient ages (offered them).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मे सा वां माध्वी रातिरस्तु स्तोमं हिनोतं मान्यस्य कारोः । अनु यद्वां श्रवस्या सुदानू सुवीर्याय चर्षणयो मदन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: asme sā vāṃ mādhvī rātirastu stomaṃ hinotaṃ mānyasya kāroḥ | anu yadvāṃ śravasyā sudānū suvīryāya carṣaṇayo madanti ||

translations.english: Receivers of the oblation, may your liberality be displayed towards us; be plural ased with the hymn of the venerable author, so that men may honour the instrumental tutor of the ceremony, as (they honour) you, liberal donors, for the sake of renown.

mantras.sanskrit: एष वां स्तोमो अश्विनावकारि मानेभिर्मघवाना सुवृक्ति । यातं वर्तिस्तनयाय त्मने चागस्त्ये नासत्या मदन्ता ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa vāṃ stomo aśvināvakāri mānebhirmaghavānā suvṛkti | yātaṃ vartistanayāya tmane cāgastye nāsatyā madantā ||

translations.english: Aśvins, possessors of wealth, this sin-removing hymn has been addressed to you, together with respectful (oblations); Nāsatyas be favourable to Agastya; come to his dwelling for (conferring on him) progeny, and for his own (good).

mantras.sanskrit: अतारिष्म तमसस्पारमस्य प्रति वां स्तोमो अश्विनावधायि । एह यातं पथिभिर्देवयानैर्विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: atāriṣma tamasaspāramasya prati vāṃ stomo aśvināvadhāyi | eha yātaṃ pathibhirdevayānairvidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

translations.english: (Through your aid), Aśvins, we cross over the limit of darkness; to you this (our hymn) has been addressed; come hither by the path traversed by thd gods, thatwe may obtain food, strength and long life.

mantras.sanskrit: कतरा पूर्वा कतरापरायोः कथा जाते कवयः को वि वेद । विश्वं त्मना बिभृतो यद्ध नाम वि वर्तेते अहनी चक्रियेव ॥
mantras.transliteration: katarā pūrvā katarāparāyoḥ kathā jāte kavayaḥ ko vi veda | viśvaṃ tmanā bibhṛto yaddha nāma vi vartete ahanī cakriyeva ||

translations.english: Which of these two, (Heaven and Earth), is prior which posterior; how were they engendered; (declare), sages, who knows this? verily, you uphold the universe of itself, and the days (and nights) revolve as if they had wheels.

mantras.sanskrit: भूरिं द्वे अचरन्ती चरन्तं पद्वन्तं गर्भमपदी दधाते । नित्यं न सूनुं पित्रोरुपस्थे द्यावा रक्षतं पृथिवी नो अभ्वात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhūriṃ dve acarantī carantaṃ padvantaṃ garbhamapadī dadhāte | nityaṃ na sūnuṃ pitrorupasthe dyāvā rakṣataṃ pṛthivī no abhvāt ||

translations.english: Footless and motionless, they sustain numerous moving and footed races, as a son is even (nursed) on the lap of his parents; defend us, Heaven and Earth, from great (danger).

mantras.sanskrit: अनेहो दात्रमदितेरनर्वं हुवे स्वर्वदवधं नमस्वत् । तद्रोदसी जनयतं जरित्रे द्यावा रक्षतं पृथिवी नो अभ्वात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: aneho dātramaditeranarvaṃ huve svarvadavadhaṃ namasvat | tadrodasī janayataṃ jaritre dyāvā rakṣataṃ pṛthivī no abhvāt ||

translations.english: I solicit of Aditi, wealth, without pain or decay, like heaven (in fullness of enjoyment), exempt from injury, and abounding in food; grant, Heaven and Earth, such wealth to him who praises you; defend us, Heaven and Earth, from great (danger).

mantras.sanskrit: अतप्यमाने अवसावन्ती अनु ष्याम रोदसी देवपुत्रे । उभे देवानामुभयेभिरह्नां द्यावा रक्षतं पृथिवी नो अभ्वात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: atapyamāne avasāvantī anu ṣyāma rodasī devaputre | ubhe devānāmubhayebhirahnāṃ dyāvā rakṣataṃ pṛthivī no abhvāt ||

translations.english: May we ever be (devoted to) that Heaven and Earth, who are not subject to annoyance, who satisfy (all beings) with food, who have the gods (and men) for sons, and who are both endowed with the double (condition) of the divine days (and nights); defend us, Heaven and Earth, from great (danger).

mantras.sanskrit: संगच्छमाने युवती समन्ते स्वसारा जामी पित्रोरुपस्थे । अभिजिघ्रन्ती भुवनस्य नाभिं द्यावा रक्षतं पृथिवी नो अभ्वात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃgacchamāne yuvatī samante svasārā jāmī pitrorupasthe | abhijighrantī bhuvanasya nābhiṃ dyāvā rakṣataṃ pṛthivī no abhvāt ||

translations.english: Going always together, equally young, and of the like termination, sisters, and kindred, and scenting the navel of the world, plural ced on their lap as its parents; defend us, Heaven and Earth, from great danger.

mantras.sanskrit: उर्वी सद्मनी बृहती ऋतेन हुवे देवानामवसा जनित्री । दधाते ये अमृतं सुप्रतीके द्यावा रक्षतं पृथिवी नो अभ्वात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: urvī sadmanī bṛhatī ṛtena huve devānāmavasā janitrī | dadhāte ye amṛtaṃ supratīke dyāvā rakṣataṃ pṛthivī no abhvāt ||

translations.english: I invoke to the sacrifice, for the preservation of gods (and men), the two vast, all-supporting, and mighty parents (of the rain and corn); who, beautiful in form, sustain ambrosial (showers); defend us, Heaven and Earth, from great danger.

mantras.sanskrit: उर्वी पृथ्वी बहुले दूरेअन्ते उप ब्रुवे नमसा यज्ञे अस्मिन् । दधाते ये सुभगे सुप्रतूर्ती द्यावा रक्षतं पृथिवी नो अभ्वात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: urvī pṛthvī bahule dūreante upa bruve namasā yajñe asmin | dadhāte ye subhage supratūrtī dyāvā rakṣataṃ pṛthivī no abhvāt ||

translations.english: I glorify with reverence, at this sacrifice, (the two), who are vast, expansive, multiform, infinite, auspicious;who support (all beings) by their bounty; defend us, Heaven and Earth, from great danger.

mantras.sanskrit: देवान्वा यच्चकृमा कच्चिदागः सखायं वा सदमिज्जास्पतिं वा । इयं धीर्भूया अवयानमेषां द्यावा रक्षतं पृथिवी नो अभ्वात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: devānvā yaccakṛmā kaccidāgaḥ sakhāyaṃ vā sadamijjāspatiṃ vā | iyaṃ dhīrbhūyā avayānameṣāṃ dyāvā rakṣataṃ pṛthivī no abhvāt ||

translations.english: May this sacrifice be the means of expiating those offences which we may have committed against the gods, against a friend at any time, against a son-in-law; defend us, Heaven and Earth, from great danger.

mantras.sanskrit: उभा शंसा नर्या मामविष्टामुभे मामूती अवसा सचेताम् । भूरि चिदर्यः सुदास्तरायेषा मदन्त इषयेम देवाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ubhā śaṃsā naryā māmaviṣṭāmubhe māmūtī avasā sacetām | bhūri cidaryaḥ sudāstarāyeṣā madanta iṣayema devāḥ ||

translations.english: May both these, accepting praise, and friendly to man, be favourable to me; may they both be associated as guardians for my protection; deities, we your adorers, propitiating you with (sacrificial) food, desire ample (wealth), for the sake of makign liberal donations.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतं दिवे तदवोचं पृथिव्या अभिश्रावाय प्रथमं सुमेधाः । पातामवद्याद्दुरितादभीके पिता माता च रक्षतामवोभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtaṃ dive tadavocaṃ pṛthivyā abhiśrāvāya prathamaṃ sumedhāḥ | pātāmavadyādduritādabhīke pitā mātā ca rakṣatāmavobhiḥ ||

translations.english: Endowed with understanding, I repeat to Heaven and Earth this initial praise, to be heard around; may paternal (heaven) and maternal (earth) preserve us from reprehensible iniquity; and ever nigh defend us with their protection.

mantras.sanskrit: इदं द्यावापृथिवी सत्यमस्तु पितर्मातर्यदिहोपब्रुवे वाम् । भूतं देवानामवमे अवोभिर्विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: idaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī satyamastu pitarmātaryadihopabruve vām | bhūtaṃ devānāmavame avobhirvidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

translations.english: May this (hymn), Heaven and Earth,be successful; (the hymn) which, Father and Mother, I repeat to you both on this occasion; be ever with your protection in the proximity of those who praise you; that we may obtain food, strength, and long life.

mantras.sanskrit: आ न इळाभिर्विदथे सुशस्ति विश्वानरः सविता देव एतु । अपि यथा युवानो मत्सथा नो विश्वं जगदभिपित्वे मनीषा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā na iḷābhirvidathe suśasti viśvānaraḥ savitā deva etu | api yathā yuvāno matsathā no viśvaṃ jagadabhipitve manīṣā ||

translations.english: May the divine Savitā, the benefactor of all men, come benignantly to our solemnity, together with the divinities of earth, and do you, who are (always) young, willingly present at our sacrifice, exhilarate us, as (you exhilarate) the whole world.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो विश्व आस्क्रा गमन्तु देवा मित्रो अर्यमा वरुणः सजोषाः । भुवन्यथा नो विश्वे वृधासः करन्त्सुषाहा विथुरं न शवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no viśva āskrā gamantu devā mitro aryamā varuṇaḥ sajoṣāḥ | bhuvanyathā no viśve vṛdhāsaḥ karantsuṣāhā vithuraṃ na śavaḥ ||

translations.english: May all the triumphant gods, Mitra, Aryaman, Varuṇa equally well plural ased, come (to our rite); may they all be propitious to us; may they not leave us in want of food, after overcoming (our foes).

mantras.sanskrit: प्रेष्ठं वो अतिथिं गृणीषेऽग्निं शस्तिभिस्तुर्वणिः सजोषाः । असद्यथा नो वरुणः सुकीर्तिरिषश्च पर्षदरिगूर्तः सूरिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: preṣṭhaṃ vo atithiṃ gṛṇīṣe'gniṃ śastibhisturvaṇiḥ sajoṣāḥ | asadyathā no varuṇaḥ sukīrtiriṣaśca parṣadarigūrtaḥ sūriḥ ||

translations.english: I praise with hymns, (O gods), your best beloved guest, Agni, who is prompt (to partake of the oblation) and who is well plural ased along (with you); so that (thereby) Varuṇa, the possessor of renown, the subduer of foes, the animator (of men), may fill us with food.

mantras.sanskrit: उप व एषे नमसा जिगीषोषासानक्ता सुदुघेव धेनुः । समाने अहन्विमिमानो अर्कं विषुरूपे पयसि सस्मिन्नूधन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa va eṣe namasā jigīṣoṣāsānaktā sudugheva dhenuḥ | samāne ahanvimimāno arkaṃ viṣurūpe payasi sasminnūdhan ||

translations.english: I approach you, (deities), with reverence, night and day, in the hope of overcoming (sin), as (willingly), as a genitive tle cow (comes to be milked), mixing (for you) on the appropriate day the (sacrificial) food, (consisting) of multiform (preparations) of milk (genitive rated) from the same udder.

mantras.sanskrit: उत नोऽहिर्बुध्न्यो मयस्कः शिशुं न पिप्युषीव वेति सिन्धुः । येन नपातमपां जुनाम मनोजुवो वृषणो यं वहन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta no'hirbudhnyo mayaskaḥ śiśuṃ na pipyuṣīva veti sindhuḥ | yena napātamapāṃ junāma manojuvo vṛṣaṇo yaṃ vahanti ||

translations.english: May, Ahirbudhnya grant us happiness; may Sindhu come, nourishing us as a (cow her) calf, whereby we may propitiate the grandson of the waters, (Agni), whom the clouds, swift as thought, convey.

mantras.sanskrit: उत न ईं त्वष्टा गन्त्वच्छा स्मत्सूरिभिरभिपित्वे सजोषाः । आ वृत्रहेन्द्रश्चर्षणिप्रास्तुविष्टमो नरां न इह गम्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta na īṃ tvaṣṭā gantvacchā smatsūribhirabhipitve sajoṣāḥ | ā vṛtrahendraścarṣaṇiprāstuviṣṭamo narāṃ na iha gamyāḥ ||

translations.english: Or may Tvaṣṭā come to this sacrifice, equally well plural ased with those who praise (him) at the excellent (rite) at which he is present; may the most potent Indra, the protector of man, the destroyer of Vṛtra, come to the (solemnity) of our leaders.

mantras.sanskrit: उत न ईं मतयोऽश्वयोगाः शिशुं न गावस्तरुणं रिहन्ति । तमीं गिरो जनयो न पत्नीः सुरभिष्टमं नरां नसन्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta na īṃ matayo'śvayogāḥ śiśuṃ na gāvastaruṇaṃ rihanti | tamīṃ giro janayo na patnīḥ surabhiṣṭamaṃ narāṃ nasanta ||

translations.english: For our minds, yoked together like horses tend to the ever youthful Indra, as cows to their calves; and the praises of men, (addressed) to him, are genitive rating most fragrant (fruit), as wives bear (children to their husbands).

mantras.sanskrit: उत न ईं मरुतो वृद्धसेनाः स्मद्रोदसी समनसः सदन्तु । पृषदश्वासोऽवनयो न रथा रिशादसो मित्रयुजो न देवाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta na īṃ maruto vṛddhasenāḥ smadrodasī samanasaḥ sadantu | pṛṣadaśvāso'vanayo na rathā riśādaso mitrayujo na devāḥ ||

translations.english: Or may the Maruts, being of one mind, come from heaven and earth (to the sacrifice); they who are a mighty host, who have parti-coloured steeds, who are like protecting chariots, and who are devourers of foes may they come like friendly deities.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र नु यदेषां महिना चिकित्रे प्र युञ्जते प्रयुजस्ते सुवृक्ति । अध यदेषां सुदिने न शरुर्विश्वमेरिणं प्रुषायन्त सेनाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra nu yadeṣāṃ mahinā cikitre pra yuñjate prayujaste suvṛkti | adha yadeṣāṃ sudine na śarurviśvameriṇaṃ pruṣāyanta senāḥ ||

translations.english: For, verily, their greatness is well known, (as) they diligently discharge their functions; by which their spot pours rain upon every arid soil, as light spreads (universally) on a fine day.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रो अश्विनाववसे कृणुध्वं प्र पूषणं स्वतवसो हि सन्ति । अद्वेषो विष्णुर्वात ऋभुक्षा अच्छा सुम्नाय ववृतीय देवान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pro aśvināvavase kṛṇudhvaṃ pra pūṣaṇaṃ svatavaso hi santi | adveṣo viṣṇurvāta ṛbhukṣā acchā sumnāya vavṛtīya devān ||

translations.english: Propitiate the Aśvins and Pūṣan, for my protection; (propitiate) those (deities), who are of independent powers, as Viṣṇu, devoid of hatred, Vāyu and Ṛbhukṣin, and may I influence the gods to be present for my felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: इयं सा वो अस्मे दीधितिर्यजत्रा अपिप्राणी च सदनी च भूयाः । नि या देवेषु यतते वसूयुर्विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: iyaṃ sā vo asme dīdhitiryajatrā apiprāṇī ca sadanī ca bhūyāḥ | ni yā deveṣu yatate vasūyurvidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

translations.english: Objects of admiration, may that wealth-abounding effulgence which manifests itself amongst the gods, give animation to our existence, and (permanence to) our dwellings; that we may (thence) obtain food, strength, and long life.

mantras.sanskrit: पितुं नु स्तोषं महो धर्माणं तविषीम् । यस्य त्रितो व्योजसा वृत्रं विपर्वमर्दयत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pituṃ nu stoṣaṃ maho dharmāṇaṃ taviṣīm | yasya trito vyojasā vṛtraṃ viparvamardayat ||

translations.english: I glorify Pitu, the great, the upholder, the strong, by whose invigorating power Trita slew themutilated Vṛtra.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वादो पितो मधो पितो वयं त्वा ववृमहे । अस्माकमविता भव ॥
mantras.transliteration: svādo pito madho pito vayaṃ tvā vavṛmahe | asmākamavitā bhava ||

translations.english: Savoury Pitā; sweet pitā; we worship you; become our protector.

mantras.sanskrit: उप नः पितवा चर शिवः शिवाभिरूतिभिः । मयोभुरद्विषेण्यः सखा सुशेवो अद्वयाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa naḥ pitavā cara śivaḥ śivābhirūtibhiḥ | mayobhuradviṣeṇyaḥ sakhā suśevo advayāḥ ||

translations.english: Come to us, Pitā, auspicious with auspicious aids; a source of delight;not unpalatable; a friend well respected, and having none (but agreeable properties).

mantras.sanskrit: तव त्ये पितो रसा रजांस्यनु विष्ठिताः । दिवि वाता इव श्रिताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava tye pito rasā rajāṃsyanu viṣṭhitāḥ | divi vātā iva śritāḥ ||

translations.english: Your flavours, Pitā, are diffused through the regions, as the winds are spread through the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: तव त्ये पितो ददतस्तव स्वादिष्ठ ते पितो । प्र स्वाद्मानो रसानां तुविग्रीवा इवेरते ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava tye pito dadatastava svādiṣṭha te pito | pra svādmāno rasānāṃ tuvigrīvā iverate ||

translations.english: Those (men), Pitā, (are the enjoyers of your bounty), who are your distributors, most sweet Pitā, (to others); they who are the relishers of your flavours, are as if they had stiff necks.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वे पितो महानां देवानां मनो हितम् । अकारि चारु केतुना तवाहिमवसावधीत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tve pito mahānāṃ devānāṃ mano hitam | akāri cāru ketunā tavāhimavasāvadhīt ||

translations.english: The thoughts of the mighty gods are fixed, Pitā, upon you; by your kind and intelligent assistance, (Indra) slew Ahi.

mantras.sanskrit: यददो पितो अजगन्विवस्व पर्वतानाम् । अत्रा चिन्नो मधो पितोऽरं भक्षाय गम्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadado pito ajaganvivasva parvatānām | atrā cinno madho pito'raṃ bhakṣāya gamyāḥ ||

translations.english: When, Pitā, this (product) of the water-wealthy clouds, (the rain), arrives; then do you, sweet Pitā, be at hand with sufficiency for our eating.

mantras.sanskrit: यदपामोषधीनां परिंशमारिशामहे । वातापे पीव इद्भव ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadapāmoṣadhīnāṃ pariṃśamāriśāmahe | vātāpe pīva idbhava ||

translations.english: And since we enjoy the abundance of the waters and the plural nts; therefore, Body, do you grow fat.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्ते सोम गवाशिरो यवाशिरो भजामहे । वातापे पीव इद्भव ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatte soma gavāśiro yavāśiro bhajāmahe | vātāpe pīva idbhava ||

translations.english: And since we enjoy, Soma, your mixture with boiled milk or boiled barley; therefore, Body, do you grow fat.

mantras.sanskrit: करम्भ ओषधे भव पीवो वृक्क उदारथिः । वातापे पीव इद्भव ॥
mantras.transliteration: karambha oṣadhe bhava pīvo vṛkka udārathiḥ | vātāpe pīva idbhava ||

translations.english: Vegetable cake of fried meal, do you be substantial, wholesome, and invigorating; and, Body, do you grow fat.

mantras.sanskrit: तं त्वा वयं पितो वचोभिर्गावो न हव्या सुषूदिम । देवेभ्यस्त्वा सधमादमस्मभ्यं त्वा सधमादम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ tvā vayaṃ pito vacobhirgāvo na havyā suṣūdima | devebhyastvā sadhamādamasmabhyaṃ tvā sadhamādam ||

translations.english: We extract from you, Pitā, by our praises, (the sacrificial food), as cows yield butter for oblation; from you, who are exhilarating to the gods; exhilarating also to us.

mantras.sanskrit: समिद्धो अद्य राजसि देवो देवैः सहस्रजित् । दूतो हव्या कविर्वह ॥
mantras.transliteration: samiddho adya rājasi devo devaiḥ sahasrajit | dūto havyā kavirvaha ||

translations.english: You shine today, divine conqueror of thousands, kindled by the priests; do you, who are the sapient messenger (of the gods), convey (to them) our oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: तनूनपादृतं यते मध्वा यज्ञः समज्यते । दधत्सहस्रिणीरिषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tanūnapādṛtaṃ yate madhvā yajñaḥ samajyate | dadhatsahasriṇīriṣaḥ ||

translations.english: The adorable Tanūnapāt proceeds to the rite and combines with the oblation, bearing (for the sacrificer) infinite (abundance of) food.

mantras.sanskrit: आजुह्वानो न ईड्यो देवाँ आ वक्षि यज्ञियान् । अग्ने सहस्रसा असि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ājuhvāno na īḍyo devā~ ā vakṣi yajñiyān | agne sahasrasā asi ||

translations.english: Agni, who are to be glorified, bring hither, being invoked by us, the adorable gods, for you are the donor of thousands.

mantras.sanskrit: प्राचीनं बर्हिरोजसा सहस्रवीरमस्तृणन् । यत्रादित्या विराजथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: prācīnaṃ barhirojasā sahasravīramastṛṇan | yatrādityā virājatha ||

translations.english: By the power (of their prayers) they have strewn the sacred grass, the seat of numerous heroes, pointing to the east; on which, Ādityas, you are manifest.

mantras.sanskrit: विराट् सम्राड्विभ्वीः प्रभ्वीर्बह्वीश्च भूयसीश्च याः । दुरो घृतान्यक्षरन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: virāṭ samrāḍvibhvīḥ prabhvīrbahvīśca bhūyasīśca yāḥ | duro ghṛtānyakṣaran ||

translations.english: They have sprinkled water on the doors (of the hall of sacrifice), which are variously and perfectly radiant, manifold, excellent, many, and numerous.

mantras.sanskrit: सुरुक्मे हि सुपेशसाधि श्रिया विराजतः । उषासावेह सीदताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: surukme hi supeśasādhi śriyā virājataḥ | uṣāsāveha sīdatām ||

translations.english: Let the brilliant and beautiful Day and Night, who shine with surpassing lustre, sit down here (upon the sacred grass).

mantras.sanskrit: प्रथमा हि सुवाचसा होतारा दैव्या कवी । यज्ञं नो यक्षतामिमम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: prathamā hi suvācasā hotārā daivyā kavī | yajñaṃ no yakṣatāmimam ||

translations.english: Let these two chief, well-spoken, divine sages, the invokers (of the gods), perform this our sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: भारतीळे सरस्वति या वः सर्वा उपब्रुवे । ता नश्चोदयत श्रिये ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhāratīḷe sarasvati yā vaḥ sarvā upabruve | tā naścodayata śriye ||

translations.english: Bhāratī, Iḷā, Sarasvatī, I invoke you all, that you may direct us to prosperity.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वष्टा रूपाणि हि प्रभुः पशून्विश्वान्त्समानजे । तेषां नः स्फातिमा यज ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṣṭā rūpāṇi hi prabhuḥ paśūnviśvāntsamānaje | teṣāṃ naḥ sphātimā yaja ||

translations.english: Tvaṣṭā, who is the master (in fashioning) the forms (of beings), has made all animals distinct; grant us, (Tvaṣṭa), their increase.

mantras.sanskrit: उप त्मन्या वनस्पते पाथो देवेभ्यः सृज । अग्निर्हव्यानि सिष्वदत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa tmanyā vanaspate pātho devebhyaḥ sṛja | agnirhavyāni siṣvadat ||

translations.english: Vanaspati, deliver of yourself the victim to the gods, so that Agni may taste the oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: पुरोगा अग्निर्देवानां गायत्रेण समज्यते । स्वाहाकृतीषु रोचते ॥
mantras.transliteration: purogā agnirdevānāṃ gāyatreṇa samajyate | svāhākṛtīṣu rocate ||

translations.english: Agni, the preceder of the gods

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने नय सुपथा राये अस्मान्विश्वानि देव वयुनानि विद्वान् । युयोध्यस्मज्जुहुराणमेनो भूयिष्ठां ते नमौक्तिं विधेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne naya supathā rāye asmānviśvāni deva vayunāni vidvān | yuyodhyasmajjuhurāṇameno bhūyiṣṭhāṃ te namauktiṃ vidhema ||

translations.english: Agni, knowing all kinds of knowledge, lead us by good ways to wealth; remove from from us the sun that would force us astray, that we may offer to you most ample adoratioṇ

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने त्वं पारया नव्यो अस्मान्त्स्वस्तिभिरति दुर्गाणि विश्वा । पूश्च पृथ्वी बहुला न उर्वी भवा तोकाय तनयाय शं योः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne tvaṃ pārayā navyo asmāntsvastibhirati durgāṇi viśvā | pūśca pṛthvī bahulā na urvī bhavā tokāya tanayāya śaṃ yoḥ ||

translations.english: Adorable Agni, convey us by the sacred sets (of worship), beyond all evil ways; may our city be spacious; our land be extensive; be the bestower of happiness upon our offspring, upon our sons.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने त्वमस्मद्युयोध्यमीवा अनग्नित्रा अभ्यमन्त कृष्टीः । पुनरस्मभ्यं सुविताय देव क्षां विश्वेभिरमृतेभिर्यजत्र ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne tvamasmadyuyodhyamīvā anagnitrā abhyamanta kṛṣṭīḥ | punarasmabhyaṃ suvitāya deva kṣāṃ viśvebhiramṛtebhiryajatra ||

translations.english: Agni, do you remove from us disease, and those men who, unprotected by Agni, are adverse to us; and, adorable divinity (visit) the earth, with all the immortals, for our welfare.

mantras.sanskrit: पाहि नो अग्ने पायुभिरजस्रैरुत प्रिये सदन आ शुशुक्वान् । मा ते भयं जरितारं यविष्ठ नूनं विदन्मापरं सहस्वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pāhi no agne pāyubhirajasrairuta priye sadana ā śuśukvān | mā te bhayaṃ jaritāraṃ yaviṣṭha nūnaṃ vidanmāparaṃ sahasvaḥ ||

translations.english: Cherish us, Agni, with incessant bounties; shine always in your favourite abode; let no danger, youngest (of the gods), assails your worshipper today; nor, mighty one, let t assail him any other season.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नो अग्नेऽव सृजो अघायाविष्यवे रिपवे दुच्छुनायै । मा दत्वते दशते मादते नो मा रीषते सहसावन्परा दाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā no agne'va sṛjo aghāyāviṣyave ripave ducchunāyai | mā datvate daśate mādate no mā rīṣate sahasāvanparā dāḥ ||

translations.english: Abandon us not, Agni, to a wicked, voracious, malevolent foe; (abandon us) not to one who has fangs, and who bites; nor to one without teeth; nor to the malignant; nor give us up, powerful Agni, to disgrace.

mantras.sanskrit: वि घ त्वावाँ ऋतजात यंसद्गृणानो अग्ने तन्वे वरूथम् । विश्वाद्रिरिक्षोरुत वा निनित्सोरभिह्रुतामसि हि देव विष्पट् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi gha tvāvā~ ṛtajāta yaṃsadgṛṇāno agne tanve varūtham | viśvādririkṣoruta vā ninitsorabhihrutāmasi hi deva viṣpaṭ ||

translations.english: Agni, born for sacrifice, (a man) praising you, who are excellent, for (the sake of cherishing) his body, becomes such as you are; exempts himself from all who are inclined to harm or revile him; for you, Agni, are the especial adversary of those who do wrong.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं ताँ अग्न उभयान्वि विद्वान्वेषि प्रपित्वे मनुषो यजत्र । अभिपित्वे मनवे शास्यो भूर्मर्मृजेन्य उशिग्भिर्नाक्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ tā~ agna ubhayānvi vidvānveṣi prapitve manuṣo yajatra | abhipitve manave śāsyo bhūrmarmṛjenya uśigbhirnākraḥ ||

translations.english: Adorable Agni, you are sagacious, and in a short time discriminate between both those men (who do and do not worshhip you); approach the worshipper at the proper time, and be compliant (with his wishes); like an instrumental tutor of the rite, (who is directed) by the desires (of the priests).

mantras.sanskrit: अवोचाम निवचनान्यस्मिन्मानस्य सूनुः सहसाने अग्नौ । वयं सहस्रमृषिभिः सनेम विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: avocāma nivacanānyasminmānasya sūnuḥ sahasāne agnau | vayaṃ sahasramṛṣibhiḥ sanema vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

translations.english: We address our pious prayers to you, Agni, the son of prayer, the subduer of foes; may we procure, by these sacred supplications, infinite wealth, that we may thence obtain food, strength and long life.

mantras.sanskrit: अनर्वाणं वृषभं मन्द्रजिह्वं बृहस्पतिं वर्धया नव्यमर्कैः । गाथान्यः सुरुचो यस्य देवा आशृण्वन्ति नवमानस्य मर्ताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: anarvāṇaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ mandrajihvaṃ bṛhaspatiṃ vardhayā navyamarkaiḥ | gāthānyaḥ suruco yasya devā āśṛṇvanti navamānasya martāḥ ||

translations.english: (Priests), augment by your hymns Bṛhaspati, who deserts not (his worshipper); the showerer (of benefits) the plural asant-tongued, the adorable; of whom resplendent gods and men, (the ministers) of the instrumental tutor of the sacrifice, emulous in sacred songs, proclaim (the praise).

mantras.sanskrit: तमृत्विया उप वाचः सचन्ते सर्गो न यो देवयतामसर्जि । बृहस्पतिः स ह्यञ्जो वरांसि विभ्वाभवत्समृते मातरिश्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamṛtviyā upa vācaḥ sacante sargo na yo devayatāmasarji | bṛhaspatiḥ sa hyañjo varāṃsi vibhvābhavatsamṛte mātariśvā ||

translations.english: The hymns of the (rainy) season are addressed to him, who is verily the creator (of the rain), and has granted it (to the prayers) of the devout; for that Bṛhaspati is the manifester (of all), the expansive wind that (dispensing) blessings has been produced for (the diffusion of) water.

mantras.sanskrit: उपस्तुतिं नमस उद्यतिं च श्लोकं यंसत्सवितेव प्र बाहू । अस्य क्रत्वाहन्यो यो अस्ति मृगो न भीमो अरक्षसस्तुविष्मान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: upastutiṃ namasa udyatiṃ ca ślokaṃ yaṃsatsaviteva pra bāhū | asya kratvāhanyo yo asti mṛgo na bhīmo arakṣasastuviṣmān ||

translations.english: He is ready (to accept) the offered praise, the presentation of the homage, the hymn, as the sun (is ready) to put forth his rays; by the acts of him whom the rākṣasas (oppose not), the daily (revolving sun) exists, and he is strong as a fearful beast of prey.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य श्लोको दिवीयते पृथिव्यामत्यो न यंसद्यक्षभृद्विचेताः । मृगाणां न हेतयो यन्ति चेमा बृहस्पतेरहिमायाँ अभि द्यून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya śloko divīyate pṛthivyāmatyo na yaṃsadyakṣabhṛdvicetāḥ | mṛgāṇāṃ na hetayo yanti cemā bṛhaspaterahimāyā~ abhi dyūn ||

translations.english: The gloryof this Bṛhaspati spreads through heaven and earth like the sun; receiving worship, and giving intelligence, he bestows (the rewards of sacrifice); like the weapons of the hunters, so these (weapons) of Bṛhaspati fall daily upon the workers of guile.

mantras.sanskrit: ये त्वा देवोस्रिकं मन्यमानाः पापा भद्रमुपजीवन्ति पज्राः । न दूढ्ये अनु ददासि वामं बृहस्पते चयस इत्पियारुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye tvā devosrikaṃ manyamānāḥ pāpā bhadramupajīvanti pajrāḥ | na dūḍhye anu dadāsi vāmaṃ bṛhaspate cayasa itpiyārum ||

translations.english: Divine Bṛhaspati, you do not bestow desired (wealth) upon those stupid (men), who, sinful and mean subsist, considering you, who are auspicious, as an old ox; but you favour him who offers (you) libations.

mantras.sanskrit: सुप्रैतुः सूयवसो न पन्था दुर्नियन्तुः परिप्रीतो न मित्रः । अनर्वाणो अभि ये चक्षते नोऽपीवृता अपोर्णुवन्तो अस्थुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: supraituḥ sūyavaso na panthā durniyantuḥ pariprīto na mitraḥ | anarvāṇo abhi ye cakṣate no'pīvṛtā aporṇuvanto asthuḥ ||

translations.english: Be a (plural asant) way to him who goes well and makes good offerings, like the affectionate friend of (a ruler who) restrains the bad; and may those sinless men who instrumental uct us, although yet enveloped (by ignorance), stand extricated from their covering.

mantras.sanskrit: सं यं स्तुभोऽवनयो न यन्ति समुद्रं न स्रवतो रोधचक्राः । स विद्वाँ उभयं चष्टे अन्तर्बृहस्पतिस्तर आपश्च गृध्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ yaṃ stubho'vanayo na yanti samudraṃ na sravato rodhacakrāḥ | sa vidvā~ ubhayaṃ caṣṭe antarbṛhaspatistara āpaśca gṛdhraḥ ||

translations.english: To whom praises (necessarily) proceed, as men (assemble round a master); as rivers, rolling between their banks, flow to the ocean; that wise Bṛhaspati greedy (after rain), and stationary in the midst, contemplates both (the ferry and the water).

mantras.sanskrit: एवा महस्तुविजातस्तुविष्मान्बृहस्पतिर्वृषभो धायि देवः । स नः स्तुतो वीरवद्धातु गोमद्विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā mahastuvijātastuviṣmānbṛhaspatirvṛṣabho dhāyi devaḥ | sa naḥ stuto vīravaddhātu gomadvidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

translations.english: So, Bṛhaspati, the mighty, be beneficent, the powerful, the showerer (of benefits), the divine, has been glorified; praised by us, may he make us possessed of progeny and cattle, that hence we may obtain food, strength and long life.

mantras.sanskrit: कङ्कतो न कङ्कतोऽथो सतीनकङ्कतः । द्वाविति प्लुषी इति न्यदृष्टा अलिप्सत ॥
mantras.transliteration: kaṅkato na kaṅkato'tho satīnakaṅkataḥ | dvāviti pluṣī iti nyadṛṣṭā alipsata ||

translations.english: Some creature of little venom, some creature of great venom; or some venomous aquatic reptile; creatures of two kinds, both destructive (of life),or (poisonous) unseen creatures, have anointed me with their poison.

mantras.sanskrit: अदृष्टान्हन्त्यायत्यथो हन्ति परायती । अथो अवघ्नती हन्त्यथो पिनष्टि पिंषती ॥
mantras.transliteration: adṛṣṭānhantyāyatyatho hanti parāyatī | atho avaghnatī hantyatho pinaṣṭi piṃṣatī ||

translations.english: (the antidote), coming (to the bitten person n), destroys the unseen (venomous creatures); departing (it destroys them); deprived (of substance), it destroys them (by its odour); being ground, it pulverises them.

mantras.sanskrit: शरासः कुशरासो दर्भासः सैर्या उत । मौञ्जा अदृष्टा वैरिणाः सर्वे साकं न्यलिप्सत ॥
mantras.transliteration: śarāsaḥ kuśarāso darbhāsaḥ sairyā uta | mauñjā adṛṣṭā vairiṇāḥ sarve sākaṃ nyalipsata ||

translations.english: (Blades of) śarā grass, (of) kuśarā, (of) darbha, (of) sairyā, (of) muñja, (of) vīraṇa, all (the haunt) of unseen (venomous creatures), have together anointed me (with their venom).

mantras.sanskrit: नि गावो गोष्ठे असदन्नि मृगासो अविक्षत । नि केतवो जनानां न्यदृष्टा अलिप्सत ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni gāvo goṣṭhe asadanni mṛgāso avikṣata | ni ketavo janānāṃ nyadṛṣṭā alipsata ||

translations.english: The cows had lain down in their stalls; the wild beasts had retreated (to their lairs); the senses of men were at rest; when the unseen (venomous creatures) anointed me (with their venom).

mantras.sanskrit: एत उ त्ये प्रत्यदृश्रन्प्रदोषं तस्करा इव । अदृष्टा विश्वदृष्टाः प्रतिबुद्धा अभूतन ॥
mantras.transliteration: eta u tye pratyadṛśranpradoṣaṃ taskarā iva | adṛṣṭā viśvadṛṣṭāḥ pratibuddhā abhūtana ||

translations.english: Or they may be discovered (in the dark), as thieves in the (dusk of) evening; for although they be unseen, yet all are seen by them; therefore, men, be vigilant.

mantras.sanskrit: द्यौर्वः पिता पृथिवी माता सोमो भ्रातादितिः स्वसा । अदृष्टा विश्वदृष्टास्तिष्ठतेलयता सु कम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dyaurvaḥ pitā pṛthivī mātā somo bhrātāditiḥ svasā | adṛṣṭā viśvadṛṣṭāstiṣṭhatelayatā su kam ||

translations.english: Heaven, (serpents), is your father; Earth, your mother; Soma, your brother; Aditi, your sister; unseen all-seeing abide (in your own holes); enjoy (your own) good plural asure.

mantras.sanskrit: ये अंस्या ये अङ्ग्याः सूचीका ये प्रकङ्कताः । अदृष्टाः किं चनेह वः सर्वे साकं नि जस्यत ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye aṃsyā ye aṅgyāḥ sūcīkā ye prakaṅkatāḥ | adṛṣṭāḥ kiṃ caneha vaḥ sarve sākaṃ ni jasyata ||

translations.english: Those (who move with their) shoulders, those (who move with their) bodies, those who sting with sharp fangs, those who are virulently venomous; what do you here, you unseen, depart together far from us.

mantras.sanskrit: उत्पुरस्तात्सूर्य एति विश्वदृष्टो अदृष्टहा । अदृष्टान्त्सर्वाञ्जम्भयन्त्सर्वाश्च यातुधान्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: utpurastātsūrya eti viśvadṛṣṭo adṛṣṭahā | adṛṣṭāntsarvāñjambhayantsarvāśca yātudhānyaḥ ||

translations.english: The all-seeing Sun rises in the east, the destroyer of the unseen, driving away all the unseen (venomous creatures), and all evil spirits.

mantras.sanskrit: उदपप्तदसौ सूर्यः पुरु विश्वानि जूर्वन् । आदित्यः पर्वतेभ्यो विश्वदृष्टो अदृष्टहा ॥
mantras.transliteration: udapaptadasau sūryaḥ puru viśvāni jūrvan | ādityaḥ parvatebhyo viśvadṛṣṭo adṛṣṭahā ||

translations.english: The Sun has risen on high, destroying all the many (poisons); Āditya, the all-seeing, the destroyer of the unseen, (rises) for (the good of) living beings.

mantras.sanskrit: सूर्ये विषमा सजामि दृतिं सुरावतो गृहे । सो चिन्नु न मराति नो वयं मरामारे अस्य योजनं हरिष्ठा मधु त्वा मधुला चकार ॥
mantras.transliteration: sūrye viṣamā sajāmi dṛtiṃ surāvato gṛhe | so cinnu na marāti no vayaṃ marāmāre asya yojanaṃ hariṣṭhā madhu tvā madhulā cakāra ||

translations.english: I deposit the poison in the solar orb, like a leather bottle in the house of a vendor of spirits; verily, that adorable (Sun) never dies; nor, (through his favour), shall we die (of the venom); for, though afar off, yet drawn by his coursers, he will overtake (the poison); the science of antidoes converted you, (Poison), to ambrosia.

mantras.sanskrit: इयत्तिका शकुन्तिका सका जघास ते विषम् । सो चिन्नु न मराति नो वयं मरामारे अस्य योजनं हरिष्ठा मधु त्वा मधुला चकार ॥
mantras.transliteration: iyattikā śakuntikā sakā jaghāsa te viṣam | so cinnu na marāti no vayaṃ marāmāre asya yojanaṃ hariṣṭhā madhu tvā madhulā cakāra ||

translations.english: That little insignifcant bird has swallowed your venom; she does not die; nor shall we die; for, although afar off, yet drawn by his coursers, (the Sun) will overtake (the poison); the science of antidotes has converted you, (Poison), to ambrosia.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिः सप्त विष्पुलिङ्गका विषस्य पुष्यमक्षन् । ताश्चिन्नु न मरन्ति नो वयं मरामारे अस्य योजनं हरिष्ठा मधु त्वा मधुला चकार ॥
mantras.transliteration: triḥ sapta viṣpuliṅgakā viṣasya puṣyamakṣan | tāścinnu na maranti no vayaṃ marāmāre asya yojanaṃ hariṣṭhā madhu tvā madhulā cakāra ||

translations.english: May the thrice-seven sparks (of Agni) consume the influence of the venom; they verily do not perish;nor shall we die; for, although afar off, the Sun, drawn by his coursers, will overtake the poison; the science of antidotes has converted you, (Poison), to ambrosia.

mantras.sanskrit: नवानां नवतीनां विषस्य रोपुषीणाम् । सर्वासामग्रभं नामारे अस्य योजनं हरिष्ठा मधु त्वा मधुला चकार ॥
mantras.transliteration: navānāṃ navatīnāṃ viṣasya ropuṣīṇām | sarvāsāmagrabhaṃ nāmāre asya yojanaṃ hariṣṭhā madhu tvā madhulā cakāra ||

translations.english: I recite the names of ninety and nine (rivers), the destroyers of poison; although afar off, (the Sun), drawn by his coursers, will overtake the poison; the science of antidotes has converted you, (Poison), to ambrosia.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिः सप्त मयूर्यः सप्त स्वसारो अग्रुवः । तास्ते विषं वि जभ्रिर उदकं कुम्भिनीरिव ॥
mantras.transliteration: triḥ sapta mayūryaḥ sapta svasāro agruvaḥ | tāste viṣaṃ vi jabhrira udakaṃ kumbhinīriva ||

translations.english: May the thrice-seven peahens, the seven-sister rivers, carry off, (O Body), your poison, as maidens, with pitchers, carry away water.

mantras.sanskrit: इयत्तकः कुषुम्भकस्तकं भिनद्म्यश्मना । ततो विषं प्र वावृते पराचीरनु संवतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: iyattakaḥ kuṣumbhakastakaṃ bhinadmyaśmanā | tato viṣaṃ pra vāvṛte parācīranu saṃvataḥ ||

translations.english: May the insignificant mongoose (carry off) your venom, (Poison); if not, I will crush the vile (creature) with a stone; so may the poison depart (from my body) and go to distant regions.

mantras.sanskrit: कुषुम्भकस्तदब्रवीद्गिरेः प्रवर्तमानकः । वृश्चिकस्यारसं विषमरसं वृश्चिक ते विषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kuṣumbhakastadabravīdgireḥ pravartamānakaḥ | vṛścikasyārasaṃ viṣamarasaṃ vṛścika te viṣam ||

translations.english: Hastening forth at the command (of Agastya), thus spoke the mongoose: the venom of the scorpion is innocuous; scorpion, your venom is innocuous.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने द्युभिस्त्वमाशुशुक्षणिस्त्वमद्भ्यस्त्वमश्मनस्परि । त्वं वनेभ्यस्त्वमोषधीभ्यस्त्वं नृणां नृपते जायसे शुचिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne dyubhistvamāśuśukṣaṇistvamadbhyastvamaśmanaspari | tvaṃ vanebhyastvamoṣadhībhyastvaṃ nṛṇāṃ nṛpate jāyase śuciḥ ||

translations.english: Sovereign of men, Agni, you are born for the days (of sacrifice), pure and all-irradiating, from the waters, from the stones, from trees, and from plural nts.

mantras.sanskrit: तवाग्ने होत्रं तव पोत्रमृत्वियं तव नेष्ट्रं त्वमग्निदृतायतः । तव प्रशास्त्रं त्वमध्वरीयसि ब्रह्मा चासि गृहपतिश्च नो दमे ॥
