mantras.transliteration: tavāgne hotraṃ tava potramṛtviyaṃ tava neṣṭraṃ tvamagnidṛtāyataḥ | tava praśāstraṃ tvamadhvarīyasi brahmā cāsi gṛhapatiśca no dame ||

translations.english: Yours Agni, is the office of the Hotā, of the Potā, of the Ṛtvij, of the Neṣṭā; you are the Agnīdhra of the devout; yours is the functionof the Praśāstā; you are the Adhvaryu (adhvaryu radhvarayur adhvaram kāmayata iti vā (Nirukta 1.8) and the Brahmā; and the householder in our dwelling.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्न इन्द्रो वृषभः सतामसि त्वं विष्णुरुरुगायो नमस्यः । त्वं ब्रह्मा रयिविद्ब्रह्मणस्पते त्वं विधर्तः सचसे पुरंध्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagna indro vṛṣabhaḥ satāmasi tvaṃ viṣṇururugāyo namasyaḥ | tvaṃ brahmā rayividbrahmaṇaspate tvaṃ vidhartaḥ sacase puraṃdhyā ||

translations.english: You, Agni, are Indra, the showerer (of bounties) on the good; you are adorable Viṣṇu, the hymned of many; you Brahmaṇaspati, are Brahmā, the possessor of riches; you, the author of various (conditions) are associated with wisdom.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने राजा वरुणो धृतव्रतस्त्वं मित्रो भवसि दस्म ईड्यः । त्वमर्यमा सत्पतिर्यस्य सम्भुजं त्वमंशो विदथे देव भाजयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne rājā varuṇo dhṛtavratastvaṃ mitro bhavasi dasma īḍyaḥ | tvamaryamā satpatiryasya sambhujaṃ tvamaṃśo vidathe deva bhājayuḥ ||

translations.english: You, Agni, are the royal Varuṇa, observant of holy vows; you are the adorable Mitra, the destroyer (of foes); you are Aryaman, the protector of the virtuous, whose (liberality) is enjoyed by all; you are a portion (of the sun); be the distributor (of good things), divine (Agni), at our sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने त्वष्टा विधते सुवीर्यं तव ग्नावो मित्रमहः सजात्यम् । त्वमाशुहेमा ररिषे स्वश्व्यं त्वं नरां शर्धो असि पुरूवसुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne tvaṣṭā vidhate suvīryaṃ tava gnāvo mitramahaḥ sajātyam | tvamāśuhemā rariṣe svaśvyaṃ tvaṃ narāṃ śardho asi purūvasuḥ ||

translations.english: You, Agni, are Tvaṣṭā, (the giver) of great wealth to (your) worshipper; these praises are yours; do you, of benevolent power, (admit) our affinity; you, who are prompt to encourage (us), give us good (store of) horses; you, who abound with opulence, are the strength of men.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने रुद्रो असुरो महो दिवस्त्वं शर्धो मारुतं पृक्ष ईशिषे । त्वं वातैररुणैर्यासि शंगयस्त्वं पूषा विधतः पासि नु त्मना ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne rudro asuro maho divastvaṃ śardho mārutaṃ pṛkṣa īśiṣe | tvaṃ vātairaruṇairyāsi śaṃgayastvaṃ pūṣā vidhataḥ pāsi nu tmanā ||

translations.english: You, Agni, are Rudra, the expeller (of foes) from the expanse of heaven; you are the strength of the Maruts; you are supreme over (sacrificial) food; you, who are plural asantly domiciled (in the hall of sacrifice), go with ruddy horses, (fleet as) the wind; as Pūṣan, you cherish, of yours own will, those who offer worship.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने द्रविणोदा अरंकृते त्वं देवः सविता रत्नधा असि । त्वं भगो नृपते वस्व ईशिषे त्वं पायुर्दमे यस्तेऽविधत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne draviṇodā araṃkṛte tvaṃ devaḥ savitā ratnadhā asi | tvaṃ bhago nṛpate vasva īśiṣe tvaṃ pāyurdame yaste'vidhat ||

translations.english: You, Agni, are Draviṇodās, to him who honours you; you are the divine Savitā, the possessor of precious things; protector of men, you are Bhaga, and rule over wealth; you are the cherisher of him who worships you in his dwelling.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने दम आ विश्पतिं विशस्त्वां राजानं सुविदत्रमृञ्जते । त्वं विश्वानि स्वनीक पत्यसे त्वं सहस्राणि शता दश प्रति ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmagne dama ā viśpatiṃ viśastvāṃ rājānaṃ suvidatramṛñjate | tvaṃ viśvāni svanīka patyase tvaṃ sahasrāṇi śatā daśa prati ||

translations.english: The people adore you, Agni, the protector of the people in their dwellings; they propitiate you as a benevolent sovereign; leader of a radiant host, you are lord over all offerings; you are the distributor of tens, and hundreds, and thousands (of good things).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने पितरमिष्टिभिर्नरस्त्वां भ्रात्राय शम्या तनूरुचम् । त्वं पुत्रो भवसि यस्तेऽविधत्त्वं सखा सुशेवः पास्याधृषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmagne pitaramiṣṭibhirnarastvāṃ bhrātrāya śamyā tanūrucam | tvaṃ putro bhavasi yaste'vidhattvaṃ sakhā suśevaḥ pāsyādhṛṣaḥ ||

translations.english: (Devout) men (worship) you, Agni, as a father, with sacred rites; they (cherish) you, who are the illumination of the body, with acts (of kindness), as a brother; you are as a son to him who propitiates you; and you protect us, a faithful and firm friend.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्न ऋभुराके नमस्यस्त्वं वाजस्य क्षुमतो राय ईशिषे । त्वं वि भास्यनु दक्षि दावने त्वं विशिक्षुरसि यज्ञमातनिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagna ṛbhurāke namasyastvaṃ vājasya kṣumato rāya īśiṣe | tvaṃ vi bhāsyanu dakṣi dāvane tvaṃ viśikṣurasi yajñamātaniḥ ||

translations.english: You, Agni, are (ever) resplendent, and are to be glorified when present; you are lord over all renowned food and riches; you shine brightly, and you consume (the oblation) for him who offers it; you are the especial accomplisher of the sacrifice, and bestower (of its rewards).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने अदितिर्देव दाशुषे त्वं होत्रा भारती वर्धसे गिरा । त्वमिळा शतहिमासि दक्षसे त्वं वृत्रहा वसुपते सरस्वती ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne aditirdeva dāśuṣe tvaṃ hotrā bhāratī vardhase girā | tvamiḷā śatahimāsi dakṣase tvaṃ vṛtrahā vasupate sarasvatī ||

translations.english: You, divine Agni, are Aditi to the donor of the oblation; you are Hotā and Bhāratī, and thive by praise; you are Iḷā of a hundred winters to him who makes you gifts; you, lord of wealth, are the destroyer of Vṛtra, Sarasvatī.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने सुभृत उत्तमं वयस्तव स्पार्हे वर्ण आ संदृशि श्रियः । त्वं वाजः प्रतरणो बृहन्नसि त्वं रयिर्बहुलो विश्वतस्पृथुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne subhṛta uttamaṃ vayastava spārhe varṇa ā saṃdṛśi śriyaḥ | tvaṃ vājaḥ prataraṇo bṛhannasi tvaṃ rayirbahulo viśvataspṛthuḥ ||

translations.english: When, well-cherished Agni, you are (the giver of) excellent food; in your desirable and delightful hues, beauties (abound) you (are) food; (you are) the transporter (beyond sin); you are mighty; you are wealth; you are manifold, and everhwhere diffused.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामग्न आदित्यास आस्यं त्वां जिह्वां शुचयश्चक्रिरे कवे । त्वां रातिषाचो अध्वरेषु सश्चिरे त्वे देवा हविरदन्त्याहुतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmagna ādityāsa āsyaṃ tvāṃ jihvāṃ śucayaścakrire kave | tvāṃ rātiṣāco adhvareṣu saścire tve devā haviradantyāhutam ||

translations.english: The Ādityas have made you, Agni, their mouth; the pure (deities) have made you, Kavi, their tongue; the (gods), the givers of wealth, depdn upon you at sacrifices; they eat the offered oblation through you.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वे अग्ने विश्वे अमृतासो अद्रुह आसा देवा हविरदन्त्याहुतम् । त्वया मर्तासः स्वदन्त आसुतिं त्वं गर्भो वीरुधां जज्ञिषे शुचिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tve agne viśve amṛtāso adruha āsā devā haviradantyāhutam | tvayā martāsaḥ svadanta āsutiṃ tvaṃ garbho vīrudhāṃ jajñiṣe śuciḥ ||

translations.english: All the benignant immortal gods eat the offered oblation through you, as their mouth; mortals taste the flavour (of all viands) through you; you are born pure the embryo of plural nts.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं तान्त्सं च प्रति चासि मज्मनाग्ने सुजात प्र च देव रिच्यसे । पृक्षो यदत्र महिना वि ते भुवदनु द्यावापृथिवी रोदसी उभे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ tāntsaṃ ca prati cāsi majmanāgne sujāta pra ca deva ricyase | pṛkṣo yadatra mahinā vi te bhuvadanu dyāvāpṛthivī rodasī ubhe ||

translations.english: You are associated, Agni, by your vigour, with those (gods); divine, well-born Agni, you exceed (them in strength); for the (sacrificial) food that is here prepared is, by your power, subsequently diffused through both regions, heaven and earth.

mantras.sanskrit: ये स्तोतृभ्यो गोअग्रामश्वपेशसमग्ने रातिमुपसृजन्ति सूरयः । अस्माञ्च ताँश्च प्र हि नेषि वस्य आ बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye stotṛbhyo goagrāmaśvapeśasamagne rātimupasṛjanti sūrayaḥ | asmāñca tā~śca pra hi neṣi vasya ā bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

translations.english: The pious are they who present, as a gift, to the reciters of your praises, an excellent cow and an excellent horse; do you, Agni, lead both us and them to the best of abodes, (or heaven), that we and our worthy descendants may repeat the solemn prayer to you at the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: यज्ञेन वर्धत जातवेदसमग्निं यजध्वं हविषा तना गिरा । समिधानं सुप्रयसं स्वर्णरं द्युक्षं होतारं वृजनेषु धूर्षदम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajñena vardhata jātavedasamagniṃ yajadhvaṃ haviṣā tanā girā | samidhānaṃ suprayasaṃ svarṇaraṃ dyukṣaṃ hotāraṃ vṛjaneṣu dhūrṣadam ||

translations.english: Exalt with sacrifice, Agni, who knows all that has been born; worship him with oblations, and with ample praise; him who is well kindled, well fed, much lauded, resplendent, the conveyer of oblations, the giver of strength (to the body).

mantras.sanskrit: अभि त्वा नक्तीरुषसो ववाशिरेऽग्ने वत्सं न स्वसरेषु धेनवः । दिव इवेदरतिर्मानुषा युगा क्षपो भासि पुरुवार संयतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi tvā naktīruṣaso vavāśire'gne vatsaṃ na svasareṣu dhenavaḥ | diva ivedaratirmānuṣā yugā kṣapo bhāsi puruvāra saṃyataḥ ||

translations.english: The mornings and evenings, Agni, are desirous (of worshipping) you, as cows in their stalls long for their calves; adored of many, you, self-controlled, are verily spread through the sky; you (are present at all) the sacred rites of men, and shine brightly by night.

mantras.sanskrit: तं देवा बुध्ने रजसः सुदंससं दिवस्पृथिव्योररतिं न्येरिरे । रथमिव वेद्यं शुक्रशोचिषमग्निं मित्रं न क्षितिषु प्रशंस्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ devā budhne rajasaḥ sudaṃsasaṃ divaspṛthivyoraratiṃ nyerire | rathamiva vedyaṃ śukraśociṣamagniṃ mitraṃ na kṣitiṣu praśaṃsyam ||

translations.english: The gods have stationed at the root of the world, that Agni who is of goodly appearance; the pervader of heaven and earth; who is to be known as a car (to convey men to their wishes); who shines with pure radiance, and who is to be honoured as a friend among mankind.

mantras.sanskrit: तमुक्षमाणं रजसि स्व आ दमे चन्द्रमिव सुरुचं ह्वार आ दधुः । पृश्न्याः पतरं चितयन्तमक्षभिः पाथो न पायुं जनसी उभे अनु ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamukṣamāṇaṃ rajasi sva ā dame candramiva surucaṃ hvāra ā dadhuḥ | pṛśnyāḥ pataraṃ citayantamakṣabhiḥ pātho na pāyuṃ janasī ubhe anu ||

translations.english: They have plural ced him in his solitary dwelling, who is shedding moisture upon the earth; resplendent as gold, traversing the firmament, animate with flames; and pervading the two parents (of all things, heaven and earth), like refreshing water.

mantras.sanskrit: स होता विश्वं परि भूत्वध्वरं तमु हव्यैर्मनुष ऋञ्जते गिरा । हिरिशिप्रो वृधसानासु जर्भुरद्द्यौर्न स्तृभिश्चितयद्रोदसी अनु ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa hotā viśvaṃ pari bhūtvadhvaraṃ tamu havyairmanuṣa ṛñjate girā | hiriśipro vṛdhasānāsu jarbhuraddyaurna stṛbhiścitayadrodasī anu ||

translations.english: May he, the presenter of oblations (to the gods), be around all sacrifices; men propitiate him with oblations and with praises, when blazing with radiant tresses among the growing plural nts, and enlivening heaven and earth (with his sparks), like the sky with stars.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो रेवत्समिधानः स्वस्तये संददस्वान्रयिमस्मासु दीदिहि । आ नः कृणुष्व सुविताय रोदसी अग्ने हव्या मनुषो देव वीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no revatsamidhānaḥ svastaye saṃdadasvānrayimasmāsu dīdihi | ā naḥ kṛṇuṣva suvitāya rodasī agne havyā manuṣo deva vītaye ||

translations.english: You, Agni, are he who, for our good, are possessed of riches; kindled by us, blaze as the liberal donor of wealth to us; render heaven and earth propitious to us so that, divine Agni, (the gods) may partake of the oblations of the instrumental tutor of the rite.

mantras.sanskrit: दा नो अग्ने बृहतो दाः सहस्रिणो दुरो न वाजं श्रुत्या अपा वृधि । प्राची द्यावापृथिवी ब्रह्मणा कृधि स्वर्ण शुक्रमुषसो वि दिद्युतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dā no agne bṛhato dāḥ sahasriṇo duro na vājaṃ śrutyā apā vṛdhi | prācī dyāvāpṛthivī brahmaṇā kṛdhi svarṇa śukramuṣaso vi didyutaḥ ||

translations.english: Bestow upon us, Agni, infinite possessions; grant us thousands (of cattle and dependents); open to us, for your reputation, the doors of abudance; make heaven and earth, propitiated by sacred prayer, favourable to us, and may the mornings light you up like the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: स इधान उषसो राम्या अनु स्वर्ण दीदेदरुषेण भानुना । होत्राभिरग्निर्मनुषः स्वध्वरो राजा विशामतिथिश्चारुरायवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa idhāna uṣaso rāmyā anu svarṇa dīdedaruṣeṇa bhānunā | hotrābhiragnirmanuṣaḥ svadhvaro rājā viśāmatithiścārurāyave ||

translations.english: Kindled at the beautiful dawn, (Agni) shines with brilliant lustre, like the sun; adored by the hymns of the worshipper, Agni, the king of men, (comes as) an agreeable guest to the instrumental tutor of the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा नो अग्ने अमृतेषु पूर्व्य धीष्पीपाय बृहद्दिवेषु मानुषा । दुहाना धेनुर्वृजनेषु कारवे त्मना शतिनं पुरुरूपमिषणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā no agne amṛteṣu pūrvya dhīṣpīpāya bṛhaddiveṣu mānuṣā | duhānā dhenurvṛjaneṣu kārave tmanā śatinaṃ pururūpamiṣaṇi ||

translations.english: Among men our praise, Agni, celebrate syou, who are first among the greatly-splendid immortals; (may it be to us) as a cow spontaneously yielding at sacrifices to the worshipper, infinite and multiform (blessings according to his) desire.

mantras.sanskrit: वयमग्ने अर्वता वा सुवीर्यं ब्रह्मणा वा चितयेमा जनाँ अति । अस्माकं द्युम्नमधि पञ्च कृष्टिषूच्चा स्वर्ण शुशुचीत दुष्टरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayamagne arvatā vā suvīryaṃ brahmaṇā vā citayemā janā~ ati | asmākaṃ dyumnamadhi pañca kṛṣṭiṣūccā svarṇa śuśucīta duṣṭaram ||

translations.english: May we manifest vigour among other men, Agni, through the steed and the food (which you have given); and may our unsurpassed wealth shine like the sun over (that of) the five classes of beings.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो बोधि सहस्य प्रशंस्यो यस्मिन्त्सुजाता इषयन्त सूरयः । यमग्ने यज्ञमुपयन्ति वाजिनो नित्ये तोके दीदिवांसं स्वे दमे ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no bodhi sahasya praśaṃsyo yasmintsujātā iṣayanta sūrayaḥ | yamagne yajñamupayanti vājino nitye toke dīdivāṃsaṃ sve dame ||

translations.english: Vigorous Agni, hear (our prayers); for you are he who is to be lauded; to whom the well-born priests address (their hymns); and whom, entitled to worship, and radiant in thine own abode, the offerers of the oblation approach, for the sake of never-failing posterity.

mantras.sanskrit: उभयासो जातवेदः स्याम ते स्तोतारो अग्ने सूरयश्च शर्मणि । वस्वो रायः पुरुश्चन्द्रस्य भूयसः प्रजावतः स्वपत्यस्य शग्धि नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ubhayāso jātavedaḥ syāma te stotāro agne sūrayaśca śarmaṇi | vasvo rāyaḥ puruścandrasya bhūyasaḥ prajāvataḥ svapatyasya śagdhi naḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, knowing all that is born, may we, both adorers and priests, be thine for the sake of felicity; and do you bestow upon us wealth of dwellings, of cattle, of much gold, of many dependents and virtuous offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: ये स्तोतृभ्यो गोअग्रामश्वपेशसमग्ने रातिमुपसृजन्ति सूरयः । अस्माञ्च ताँश्च प्र हि नेषि वस्य आ बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye stotṛbhyo goagrāmaśvapeśasamagne rātimupasṛjanti sūrayaḥ | asmāñca tā~śca pra hi neṣi vasya ā bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

translations.english: The pious are they who present, as a gift, to the reciters of your praises, an excellent cow and an elegant horse; do you, Agni, lead us and them to the best of abodes, (or heaven), that we and our worthy descendants may repeat the solemn prayer to you at the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: समिद्धो अग्निर्निहितः पृथिव्यां प्रत्यङ्विश्वानि भुवनान्यस्थात् । होता पावकः प्रदिवः सुमेधा देवो देवान्यजत्वग्निरर्हन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: samiddho agnirnihitaḥ pṛthivyāṃ pratyaṅviśvāni bhuvanānyasthāt | hotā pāvakaḥ pradivaḥ sumedhā devo devānyajatvagnirarhan ||

translations.english: Agni, the well-kindled, plural ced upon (the altar of) the earth, stands in the presence of all beings; the invoker (of the gods), the purifier, the ancient, the intelligent, the divine; let the venerable Agni minister to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: नराशंसः प्रति धामान्यञ्जन्तिस्रो दिवः प्रति मह्ना स्वर्चिः । घृतप्रुषा मनसा हव्यमुन्दन्मूर्धन्यज्ञस्य समनक्तु देवान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: narāśaṃsaḥ prati dhāmānyañjantisro divaḥ prati mahnā svarciḥ | ghṛtapruṣā manasā havyamundanmūrdhanyajñasya samanaktu devān ||

translations.english: May the bright Narāśaṃsa, illuminating the receptacles (of the offering) making manifest by his greatness the three radiant (regions) and diffusing the oblation at the season of sacrifice with butter-dispensing purpose, satisfy the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: ईळितो अग्ने मनसा नो अर्हन्देवान्यक्षि मानुषात्पूर्वो अद्य । स आ वह मरुतां शर्धो अच्युतमिन्द्रं नरो बर्हिषदं यजध्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: īḷito agne manasā no arhandevānyakṣi mānuṣātpūrvo adya | sa ā vaha marutāṃ śardho acyutamindraṃ naro barhiṣadaṃ yajadhvam ||

translations.english: Agni, who are the venerable īḷita, do you, with mind favourably disposed towards us, offer today sacrifice to the gods, before the human (ministrant priest) as such, bring hither the company of the Maruts, the undecaying Indra, to whom, seated on the sacred grass, do you priests offer worship.

mantras.sanskrit: देव बर्हिर्वर्धमानं सुवीरं स्तीर्णं राये सुभरं वेद्यस्याम् । घृतेनाक्तं वसवः सीदतेदं विश्वे देवा आदित्या यज्ञियासः ॥
mantras.transliteration: deva barhirvardhamānaṃ suvīraṃ stīrṇaṃ rāye subharaṃ vedyasyām | ghṛtenāktaṃ vasavaḥ sīdatedaṃ viśve devā ādityā yajñiyāsaḥ ||

translations.english: Divine grass, let the Vasus, the VIśvedevas, the adorable Āditya, sit upon this flourishing, invigrating, well-grown, sacred grass, strewn for the sakeof wealth upon this altar, and sprinkled with butter.

mantras.sanskrit: वि श्रयन्तामुर्विया हूयमाना द्वारो देवीः सुप्रायणा नमोभिः । व्यचस्वतीर्वि प्रथन्तामजुर्या वर्णं पुनाना यशसं सुवीरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi śrayantāmurviyā hūyamānā dvāro devīḥ suprāyaṇā namobhiḥ | vyacasvatīrvi prathantāmajuryā varṇaṃ punānā yaśasaṃ suvīram ||

translations.english: Let the divine doors, spacious and easily accessible, and to be saluted with prostrations, be set open; let them be celebrated as expansive, uninjurable, and conferring sanctity upon the illustrious class (of worshippers), possessed of virtuous progeny.

mantras.sanskrit: साध्वपांसि सनता न उक्षिते उषासानक्ता वय्येव रण्विते । तन्तुं ततं संवयन्ती समीची यज्ञस्य पेशः सुदुघे पयस्वती ॥
mantras.transliteration: sādhvapāṃsi sanatā na ukṣite uṣāsānaktā vayyeva raṇvite | tantuṃ tataṃ saṃvayantī samīcī yajñasya peśaḥ sudughe payasvatī ||

translations.english: In regard of our good deeds, Day and Night, perpetually reverenced, are interweaving in concert, like two famous feminine le weavers, the extended thread, (to complete) the web of the sacrifice, liberal yielders (of rewards), containers of water.

mantras.sanskrit: दैव्या होतारा प्रथमा विदुष्टर ऋजु यक्षतः समृचा वपुष्टरा । देवान्यजन्तावृतुथा समञ्जतो नाभा पृथिव्या अधि सानुषु त्रिषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: daivyā hotārā prathamā viduṣṭara ṛju yakṣataḥ samṛcā vapuṣṭarā | devānyajantāvṛtuthā samañjato nābhā pṛthivyā adhi sānuṣu triṣu ||

translations.english: Let the two divine invokers of the gods, the first (to be reverenced), most wise, sincerely worshipping with sacred texts, most excellent in form, offering homage to the gods in due season, present oblations in the three high plural ces upon the navel of the earth.

mantras.sanskrit: सरस्वती साधयन्ती धियं न इळा देवी भारती विश्वतूर्तिः । तिस्रो देवीः स्वधया बर्हिरेदमच्छिद्रं पान्तु शरणं निषद्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: sarasvatī sādhayantī dhiyaṃ na iḷā devī bhāratī viśvatūrtiḥ | tisro devīḥ svadhayā barhiredamacchidraṃ pāntu śaraṇaṃ niṣadya ||

translations.english: May the three goddesses, Sarasvatī, perfecting our understanding, the divine iḷā, and all-impressive Bhāratī, having come to our dwelling, protect this faultless rite, (offered) for our welfare.

mantras.sanskrit: पिशङ्गरूपः सुभरो वयोधाः श्रुष्टी वीरो जायते देवकामः । प्रजां त्वष्टा वि ष्यतु नाभिमस्मे अथा देवानामप्येतु पाथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: piśaṅgarūpaḥ subharo vayodhāḥ śruṣṭī vīro jāyate devakāmaḥ | prajāṃ tvaṣṭā vi ṣyatu nābhimasme athā devānāmapyetu pāthaḥ ||

translations.english: May a tawny-hued, well-grown (son), the bestower of food, active, manly, a worshipper of the gods, be born; may Tvaṣṭā prolong for us a continuous (line of) progeny, and may the food of the gods come also to us.

mantras.sanskrit: वनस्पतिरवसृजन्नुप स्थादग्निर्हविः सूदयाति प्र धीभिः । त्रिधा समक्तं नयतु प्रजानन्देवेभ्यो दैव्यः शमितोप हव्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vanaspatiravasṛjannupa sthādagnirhaviḥ sūdayāti pra dhībhiḥ | tridhā samaktaṃ nayatu prajānandevebhyo daivyaḥ śamitopa havyam ||

translations.english: May Agni, who is Vanaspati, approving (of our rite), approach; and by his especial acts fully dress the victim; may the divine immolator convey the burnt-offering to the gods, knowing it to have been thrice consecrated.

mantras.sanskrit: घृतं मिमिक्षे घृतमस्य योनिर्घृते श्रितो घृतम्वस्य धाम । अनुष्वधमा वह मादयस्व स्वाहाकृतं वृषभ वक्षि हव्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ghṛtaṃ mimikṣe ghṛtamasya yonirghṛte śrito ghṛtamvasya dhāma | anuṣvadhamā vaha mādayasva svāhākṛtaṃ vṛṣabha vakṣi havyam ||

translations.english: I sprinkle the butter, for butter is his birth-plural ce; he is nourished by butter; butter is his radiance; Agni, showerer (of benefits), bring the gods to the offered oblation; exhilarate them; convey to them the offering that has been reverently sanctified.

mantras.sanskrit: हुवे वः सुद्योत्मानं सुवृक्तिं विशामग्निमतिथिं सुप्रयसम् । मित्र इव यो दिधिषाय्यो भूद्देव आदेवे जने जातवेदाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: huve vaḥ sudyotmānaṃ suvṛktiṃ viśāmagnimatithiṃ suprayasam | mitra iva yo didhiṣāyyo bhūddeva ādeve jane jātavedāḥ ||

translations.english: I invoke, on your behalf, the resplendent, the sinless Agni, the guest of mortals, the accepter of (sacrificial) food, who, knowing all that has been born, is like a friend, the supporter (of all beings) from men to gods.

mantras.sanskrit: इमं विधन्तो अपां सधस्थे द्वितादधुर्भृगवो विक्ष्वायोः । एष विश्वान्यभ्यस्तु भूमा देवानामग्निररतिर्जीराश्वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imaṃ vidhanto apāṃ sadhasthe dvitādadhurbhṛgavo vikṣvāyoḥ | eṣa viśvānyabhyastu bhūmā devānāmagniraratirjīrāśvaḥ ||

translations.english: The Bhṛgus, worshipping Agni, have twice made him manifest; (once) in the abode of the waters, and (once) among the sons of men; may that Agni, the sovereign of the gods, mounted on a rapid courser, ever overcome all (our foes).

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निं देवासो मानुषीषु विक्षु प्रियं धुः क्षेष्यन्तो न मित्रम् । स दीदयदुशतीरूर्म्या आ दक्षाय्यो यो दास्वते दम आ ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniṃ devāso mānuṣīṣu vikṣu priyaṃ dhuḥ kṣeṣyanto na mitram | sa dīdayaduśatīrūrmyā ā dakṣāyyo yo dāsvate dama ā ||

translations.english: The gods, intending to dwell (in heaven), left, as a dear friend among the human races, that Agni, who, present in the chamber of sacrifice, is bounteous to the donor of offerings, and shines on the nights when he is wished for.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य रण्वा स्वस्येव पुष्टिः संदृष्टिरस्य हियानस्य दक्षोः । वि यो भरिभ्रदोषधीषु जिह्वामत्यो न रथ्यो दोधवीति वारान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya raṇvā svasyeva puṣṭiḥ saṃdṛṣṭirasya hiyānasya dakṣoḥ | vi yo bharibhradoṣadhīṣu jihvāmatyo na rathyo dodhavīti vārān ||

translations.english: The cherishing of Agni is as agreeable as (the cherishing) of one's self; (plural asant) is his appearance, when spreading abroad, and consuming (the fuel); he brandishes his flame among the bushes, as a chariot-horse lashes with his tail.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यन्मे अभ्वं वनदः पनन्तोशिग्भ्यो नामिमीत वर्णम् । स चित्रेण चिकिते रंसु भासा जुजुर्वाँ यो मुहुरा युवा भूत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yanme abhvaṃ vanadaḥ panantośigbhyo nāmimīta varṇam | sa citreṇa cikite raṃsu bhāsā jujurvā~ yo muhurā yuvā bhūt ||

translations.english: Whose greatness my colleagues loudly extol; who has manifested his real form to the priests; who is recognized at oblations by his variegated radiance, and who, though frequently growing old, again and again becomes young.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यो वना तातृषाणो न भाति वार्ण पथा रथ्येव स्वानीत् । कृष्णाध्वा तपू रण्वश्चिकेत द्यौरिव स्मयमानो नभोभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yo vanā tātṛṣāṇo na bhāti vārṇa pathā rathyeva svānīt | kṛṣṇādhvā tapū raṇvaściketa dyauriva smayamāno nabhobhiḥ ||

translations.english: Who shines amidst the forests, as if satisfying himself (with food); who (rushes along), like water down a declivity, and thunders like a chariot (of war); dark-pathed consuming, yet delightful, he is regarded like the sky smiling with constellations.

mantras.sanskrit: स यो व्यस्थादभि दक्षदुर्वीं पशुर्नैति स्वयुरगोपाः । अग्निः शोचिष्माँ अतसान्युष्णन्कृष्णव्यथिरस्वदयन्न भूम ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa yo vyasthādabhi dakṣadurvīṃ paśurnaiti svayuragopāḥ | agniḥ śociṣmā~ atasānyuṣṇankṛṣṇavyathirasvadayanna bhūma ||

translations.english: He who is in many plural ces, who spreads over the whole earth, like an animal without a herdsman, that goes according to its own will; Agni, the bright-shining, consuming the dry bushes, by whom the pain of blackness (is inflicted on the trees), entirely drinks up (their moisture).

mantras.sanskrit: नू ते पूर्वस्यावसो अधीतौ तृतीये विदथे मन्म शंसि । अस्मे अग्ने संयद्वीरं बृहन्तं क्षुमन्तं वाजं स्वपत्यं रयिं दाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū te pūrvasyāvaso adhītau tṛtīye vidathe manma śaṃsi | asme agne saṃyadvīraṃ bṛhantaṃ kṣumantaṃ vājaṃ svapatyaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||

translations.english: Verily, your praise has been recited (by us) at the third (daily) sacrifice, as it was in the repetition on your first propitiation; give us, Agni, ample and notorious food, posterity, riches, such as may be the support of numerous dependents.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वया यथा गृत्समदासो अग्ने गुहा वन्वन्त उपराँ अभि ष्युः । सुवीरासो अभिमातिषाहः स्मत्सूरिभ्यो गृणते तद्वयो धाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvayā yathā gṛtsamadāso agne guhā vanvanta uparā~ abhi ṣyuḥ | suvīrāso abhimātiṣāhaḥ smatsūribhyo gṛṇate tadvayo dhāḥ ||

translations.english: By you, (Agni), may the Gṛtsamadas, repeating your praise, become masters of the precious secret (treasures); so that they may be possessed of excellent dependents, and be able to resist (their) enemies; and do you give to (your) pious worshippers and to him who glorifies (you), such (abundant) food.

mantras.sanskrit: होताजनिष्ट चेतनः पिता पितृभ्य ऊतये । प्रयक्षञ्जेन्यं वसु शकेम वाजिनो यमम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: hotājaniṣṭa cetanaḥ pitā pitṛbhya ūtaye | prayakṣañjenyaṃ vasu śakema vājino yamam ||

translations.english: An invoker (of the gods), our instrumental uctor and protector has been born for the preservation of our patrons; may we, possessed of (sacrificial) food, be able to acquire worshipful, conquerable, and manageable riches.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यस्मिन्त्सप्त रश्मयस्तता यज्ञस्य नेतरि । मनुष्वद्दैव्यमष्टमं पोता विश्वं तदिन्वति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yasmintsapta raśmayastatā yajñasya netari | manuṣvaddaivyamaṣṭamaṃ potā viśvaṃ tadinvati ||

translations.english: In whom, as conductor of the sacrifice, the seven rays are manifested, and who, as a human Potā, officiate in the eighth plural ce to perfect every divine (rite).

mantras.sanskrit: दधन्वे वा यदीमनु वोचद्ब्रह्माणि वेरु तत् । परि विश्वानि काव्या नेमिश्चक्रमिवाभवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dadhanve vā yadīmanu vocadbrahmāṇi veru tat | pari viśvāni kāvyā nemiścakramivābhavat ||

translations.english: Whatever (offerings the priest) presents, whatever prayers he recites, he, (Agni), knows them all; he comprehends all priestly acts, as the circumference (includes the spokes) of a wheel.

mantras.sanskrit: साकं हि शुचिना शुचिः प्रशास्ता क्रतुनाजनि । विद्वाँ अस्य व्रता ध्रुवा वया इवानु रोहते ॥
mantras.transliteration: sākaṃ hi śucinā śuciḥ praśāstā kratunājani | vidvā~ asya vratā dhruvā vayā ivānu rohate ||

translations.english: The pure regulator (of the sacrifice) is born verily together with the holy act; the wise (worshipper) performs all his, (Agni's), prescribed rites in succession, as the branches spring (from a common stem).

mantras.sanskrit: ता अस्य वर्णमायुवो नेष्टुः सचन्त धेनवः । कुवित्तिसृभ्य आ वरं स्वसारो या इदं ययुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā asya varṇamāyuvo neṣṭuḥ sacanta dhenavaḥ | kuvittisṛbhya ā varaṃ svasāro yā idaṃ yayuḥ ||

translations.english: The sister fingers, which are the kine of the Neṣṭā, are those which accomplish him, (Agni's), worship; and in various ways are combined for this purpose through the three (sacred fires).

mantras.sanskrit: यदी मातुरुप स्वसा घृतं भरन्त्यस्थित । तासामध्वर्युरागतौ यवो वृष्टीव मोदते ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadī māturupa svasā ghṛtaṃ bharantyasthita | tāsāmadhvaryurāgatau yavo vṛṣṭīva modate ||

translations.english: When the sister (vessel), bearing the clarified butter, is plural ced near the maternal (altar), the Adhvaryu rejoices at their approach, like barley (at the fall of) rain.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वः स्वाय धायसे कृणुतामृत्विगृत्विजम् । स्तोमं यज्ञं चादरं वनेमा ररिमा वयम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: svaḥ svāya dhāyase kṛṇutāmṛtvigṛtvijam | stomaṃ yajñaṃ cādaraṃ vanemā rarimā vayam ||

translations.english: May he, the ministering priest, discharge the office of priest at his own ceremony; and may we worthily repeat (his) praise, and offer (him) sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: यथा विद्वाँ अरं करद्विश्वेभ्यो यजतेभ्यः । अयमग्ने त्वे अपि यं यज्ञं चकृमा वयम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathā vidvā~ araṃ karadviśvebhyo yajatebhyaḥ | ayamagne tve api yaṃ yajñaṃ cakṛmā vayam ||

translations.english: And do you, Agni, (grant), that this wise (worshipper) may worthily offer (worship) to all the adorable (divinities), and that the sacrifice which we offer may also be perfected in you.

mantras.sanskrit: इमां मे अग्ने समिधमिमामुपसदं वनेः । इमा उ षु श्रुधी गिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imāṃ me agne samidhamimāmupasadaṃ vaneḥ | imā u ṣu śrudhī giraḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, accept this my fuel, this my oblation; listen, well plural ased, to my praises.

mantras.sanskrit: अया ते अग्ने विधेमोर्जो नपादश्वमिष्टे । एना सूक्तेन सुजात ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayā te agne vidhemorjo napādaśvamiṣṭe | enā sūktena sujāta ||

translations.english: May we propitiate you, Agni, by this (oblation), grandsonof strength, (who are) gratified by prompt sacrifice, (may we plural ase you), well-born, by this hymn.

mantras.sanskrit: तं त्वा गीर्भिर्गिर्वणसं द्रविणस्युं द्रविणोदः । सपर्येम सपर्यवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ tvā gīrbhirgirvaṇasaṃ draviṇasyuṃ draviṇodaḥ | saparyema saparyavaḥ ||

translations.english: Granter of riches, may we, your worshippers, propitiate you, who are desirous of (sacrificial) wealth, and deserving of laudation, by our praise.

mantras.sanskrit: स बोधि सूरिर्मघवा वसुपते वसुदावन् । युयोध्यस्मद्द्वेषांसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa bodhi sūrirmaghavā vasupate vasudāvan | yuyodhyasmaddveṣāṃsi ||

translations.english: Lord of wealth, giver of wealth, possessor of riches, who are wise, understand (our prayers), and scatter our enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो वृष्टिं दिवस्परि स नो वाजमनर्वाणम् । स नः सहस्रिणीरिषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no vṛṣṭiṃ divaspari sa no vājamanarvāṇam | sa naḥ sahasriṇīriṣaḥ ||

translations.english: (For you are) he (who gives) us rain from heaven; he (who gives) us undecaying strenght, he (who gives) us infinite (abundance of) food.

mantras.sanskrit: ईळानायावस्यवे यविष्ठ दूत नो गिरा । यजिष्ठ होतरा गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: īḷānāyāvasyave yaviṣṭha dūta no girā | yajiṣṭha hotarā gahi ||

translations.english: Youngest (of the gods), their messenger, their invoker, most deserving of worship, come, upon our praise, to him who offers (you) adoration, and is desirous of (your) protection.

mantras.sanskrit: अन्तर्ह्यग्न ईयसे विद्वाञ्जन्मोभया कवे । दूतो जन्येव मित्र्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: antarhyagna īyase vidvāñjanmobhayā kave | dūto janyeva mitryaḥ ||

translations.english: Sage Agni, you penetrate the innermost (man), knowing the birth of both (the worshipper and the worshipped); like a messenger favourable to men, especially to his friends.

mantras.sanskrit: स विद्वाँ आ च पिप्रयो यक्षि चिकित्व आनुषक् । आ चास्मिन्त्सत्सि बर्हिषि ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa vidvā~ ā ca piprayo yakṣi cikitva ānuṣak | ā cāsmintsatsi barhiṣi ||

translations.english: Do you, Agni, who are all-wise, fulfil (our desire); do you, who are intelligent, worship (the gods) in order; and sit down on this sacred grass.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रेष्ठं यविष्ठ भारताग्ने द्युमन्तमा भर । वसो पुरुस्पृहं रयिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śreṣṭhaṃ yaviṣṭha bhāratāgne dyumantamā bhara | vaso puruspṛhaṃ rayim ||

translations.english: Youngest (of the gods), Agni descendant of Bhārata, granter of dwellings, bring (to us) excellent, splendid and enviable riches.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नो अरातिरीशत देवस्य मर्त्यस्य च । पर्षि तस्या उत द्विषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā no arātirīśata devasya martyasya ca | parṣi tasyā uta dviṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Let no enemy prevail against us, whether of god or man; protect us from both such foes.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वा उत त्वया वयं धारा उदन्या इव । अति गाहेमहि द्विषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvā uta tvayā vayaṃ dhārā udanyā iva | ati gāhemahi dviṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Let us, through your favour, overwhelm all our foes like torrents of water.

mantras.sanskrit: शुचिः पावक वन्द्योऽग्ने बृहद्वि रोचसे । त्वं घृतेभिराहुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śuciḥ pāvaka vandyo'gne bṛhadvi rocase | tvaṃ ghṛtebhirāhutaḥ ||

translations.english: Purifier, Agni, holy, adorable, you shine exceedingly when (you are) worshipped with (oblations of) butter.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं नो असि भारताग्ने वशाभिरुक्षभिः । अष्टापदीभिराहुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ no asi bhāratāgne vaśābhirukṣabhiḥ | aṣṭāpadībhirāhutaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, descendantof Bharatā, you are entirely ours, when sacrificed to with pregnant kine, with barren cows, or bulls.

mantras.sanskrit: द्र्वन्नः सर्पिरासुतिः प्रत्नो होता वरेण्यः । सहसस्पुत्रो अद्भुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: drvannaḥ sarpirāsutiḥ pratno hotā vareṇyaḥ | sahasasputro adbhutaḥ ||

translations.english: Feeder upon fuel, to whom butter is offered (you are) the ancient, the invoker of the gods, the excellent son of strength, the wonderful.

mantras.sanskrit: वाजयन्निव नू रथान्योगाँ अग्नेरुप स्तुहि । यशस्तमस्य मीळ्हुषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vājayanniva nū rathānyogā~ agnerupa stuhi | yaśastamasya mīḷhuṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Praise quickly the yoked chariot of the glorious and munificent Agni, like one who is desirous of food.

mantras.sanskrit: यः सुनीथो ददाशुषेऽजुर्यो जरयन्नरिम् । चारुप्रतीक आहुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ sunītho dadāśuṣe'juryo jarayannarim | cārupratīka āhutaḥ ||

translations.english: Who, sagacious, invincible, and of graceful gait destroys, when propitiated, his foe, for him who presents (offerings).

mantras.sanskrit: य उ श्रिया दमेष्वा दोषोषसि प्रशस्यते । यस्य व्रतं न मीयते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya u śriyā dameṣvā doṣoṣasi praśasyate | yasya vrataṃ na mīyate ||

translations.english: Who invested with radiance, is glorified, morning and evening, in (our) dwelling; whose worship is never neglected.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यः स्वर्ण भानुना चित्रो विभात्यर्चिषा । अञ्जानो अजरैरभि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yaḥ svarṇa bhānunā citro vibhātyarciṣā | añjāno ajarairabhi ||

translations.english: Who, many-tinted, shines with radiance, like the sun with (his) lustre, spreading (light) over (all) by his imperishable (flames).

mantras.sanskrit: अत्रिमनु स्वराज्यमग्निमुक्थानि वावृधुः । विश्वा अधि श्रियो दधे ॥
mantras.transliteration: atrimanu svarājyamagnimukthāni vāvṛdhuḥ | viśvā adhi śriyo dadhe ||

translations.english: Our praises have increased the self-irradiating devouringn Agni; he is possessed of all glory.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्नेरिन्द्रस्य सोमस्य देवानामूतिभिर्वयम् । अरिष्यन्तः सचेमह्यभि ष्याम पृतन्यतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnerindrasya somasya devānāmūtibhirvayam | ariṣyantaḥ sacemahyabhi ṣyāma pṛtanyataḥ ||

translations.english: May we, uninjured, be secure in the protection of Agni, Indra, Soma and the gods, and confident in battle overcome (our enemies).

mantras.sanskrit: नि होता होतृषदने विदानस्त्वेषो दीदिवाँ असदत्सुदक्षः । अदब्धव्रतप्रमतिर्वसिष्ठः सहस्रम्भरः शुचिजिह्वो अग्निः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni hotā hotṛṣadane vidānastveṣo dīdivā~ asadatsudakṣaḥ | adabdhavratapramatirvasiṣṭhaḥ sahasrambharaḥ śucijihvo agniḥ ||

translations.english: May Agni, the invoker (of the gods), the intelligent, the resplendent, the radiant, the very powerful; he who knows (how to maintain) his rites undisturbed; who is steady in (his own) plural ce, and is the cherisher of thousands, sit in the station of the invoking priest.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं दूतस्त्वमु नः परस्पास्त्वं वस्य आ वृषभ प्रणेता । अग्ने तोकस्य नस्तने तनूनामप्रयुच्छन्दीद्यद्बोधि गोपाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ dūtastvamu naḥ paraspāstvaṃ vasya ā vṛṣabha praṇetā | agne tokasya nastane tanūnāmaprayucchandīdyadbodhi gopāḥ ||

translations.english: Showerer (of benefits), Agni, be you our messenger (to the gods); our preserver from evil; the conveyer to us of wealth; the protector of our sons and grandsons, and of our person ns; understand (our prayer), ever heedful and resplendent.

mantras.sanskrit: विधेम ते परमे जन्मन्नग्ने विधेम स्तोमैरवरे सधस्थे । यस्माद्योनेरुदारिथा यजे तं प्र त्वे हवींषि जुहुरे समिद्धे ॥
mantras.transliteration: vidhema te parame janmannagne vidhema stomairavare sadhasthe | yasmādyonerudārithā yaje taṃ pra tve havīṃṣi juhure samiddhe ||

translations.english: We adore you, Agni, in your loftiest birth-(plural ce), and with hymns in thine inferior station; I worship that seat whence you have issued; the priests have offered you, when kindled oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने यजस्व हविषा यजीयाञ्छ्रुष्टी देष्णमभि गृणीहि राधः । त्वं ह्यसि रयिपती रयीणां त्वं शुक्रस्य वचसो मनोता ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne yajasva haviṣā yajīyāñchruṣṭī deṣṇamabhi gṛṇīhi rādhaḥ | tvaṃ hyasi rayipatī rayīṇāṃ tvaṃ śukrasya vacaso manotā ||

translations.english: Agni, who are the chief of sacrificers, worship (the gods) with the oblation, and earnestly commend to them the (sacrificial) food that is to be given (them); for you, indeed, are the soverign lord of riches; you are the appreciator of our pious prayer.

mantras.sanskrit: उभयं ते न क्षीयते वसव्यं दिवेदिवे जायमानस्य दस्म । कृधि क्षुमन्तं जरितारमग्ने कृधि पतिं स्वपत्यस्य रायः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ubhayaṃ te na kṣīyate vasavyaṃ divedive jāyamānasya dasma | kṛdhi kṣumantaṃ jaritāramagne kṛdhi patiṃ svapatyasya rāyaḥ ||

translations.english: Beautiful Agni, the two dwelling-plural ces (heaven and earth) of you, who are born day by day, never perish; confer upon him who praises you (abundant) food, and make him the master of riches, (supporting) virtuous offering.

mantras.sanskrit: सैनानीकेन सुविदत्रो अस्मे यष्टा देवाँ आयजिष्ठः स्वस्ति । अदब्धो गोपा उत नः परस्पा अग्ने द्युमदुत रेवद्दिदीहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: sainānīkena suvidatro asme yaṣṭā devā~ āyajiṣṭhaḥ svasti | adabdho gopā uta naḥ paraspā agne dyumaduta revaddidīhi ||

translations.english: Do you with this (your) host (of attendants), be of good promise to us; do you, the especial worshipper of the gods, their unassailable protector, as well as our preserver, light up (all) with shining and affluent well-being.

mantras.sanskrit: जोहूत्रो अग्निः प्रथमः पितेवेळस्पदे मनुषा यत्समिद्धः । श्रियं वसानो अमृतो विचेता मर्मृजेन्यः श्रवस्यः स वाजी ॥
mantras.transliteration: johūtro agniḥ prathamaḥ piteveḷaspade manuṣā yatsamiddhaḥ | śriyaṃ vasāno amṛto vicetā marmṛjenyaḥ śravasyaḥ sa vājī ||

translations.english: The adorable Agni, the first (of the gods) and their nourisher when kindled by man upon the altar; he who is clothed in radiance, is immortal, discriminating, food-bestowing, powerful; he is to be worshipped.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रूया अग्निश्चित्रभानुर्हवं मे विश्वाभिर्गीर्भिरमृतो विचेताः । श्यावा रथं वहतो रोहिता वोतारुषाह चक्रे विभृत्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śrūyā agniścitrabhānurhavaṃ me viśvābhirgīrbhiramṛto vicetāḥ | śyāvā rathaṃ vahato rohitā votāruṣāha cakre vibhṛtraḥ ||

translations.english: May Agni, who is immortal, of manifold wisdom, and wonderful splendour, hear my invocation, (preferred) with all laudations; tawny, or red, or purple horses draw his car; he has been borne in various directions.

mantras.sanskrit: उत्तानायामजनयन्त्सुषूतं भुवदग्निः पुरुपेशासु गर्भः । शिरिणायां चिदक्तुना महोभिरपरीवृतो वसति प्रचेताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uttānāyāmajanayantsuṣūtaṃ bhuvadagniḥ purupeśāsu garbhaḥ | śiriṇāyāṃ cidaktunā mahobhiraparīvṛto vasati pracetāḥ ||

translations.english: They have genitive rated (Agni) when soundly sleeping on his upturned (couch); that Agni who is an embryo in many (vegetable) forms, and who, (rendered manifest) by the oblations, abides conscious in the night, unenveloped by darkness.

mantras.sanskrit: जिघर्म्यग्निं हविषा घृतेन प्रतिक्षियन्तं भुवनानि विश्वा । पृथुं तिरश्चा वयसा बृहन्तं व्यचिष्ठमन्नै रभसं दृशानम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: jigharmyagniṃ haviṣā ghṛtena pratikṣiyantaṃ bhuvanāni viśvā | pṛthuṃ tiraścā vayasā bṛhantaṃ vyaciṣṭhamannai rabhasaṃ dṛśānam ||

translations.english: I offer oblations with butter to Agni, who spreads through all regions, vast, expanding, with all-comprehending form, nourished (with sacrificial) food, powerful, conspicuous.

mantras.sanskrit: आ विश्वतः प्रत्यञ्चं जिघर्म्यरक्षसा मनसा तज्जुषेत । मर्यश्रीः स्पृहयद्वर्णो अग्निर्नाभिमृशे तन्वा जर्भुराणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā viśvataḥ pratyañcaṃ jigharmyarakṣasā manasā tajjuṣeta | maryaśrīḥ spṛhayadvarṇo agnirnābhimṛśe tanvā jarbhurāṇaḥ ||

translations.english: I offer oblations to Agni, who is present at all (sacrifices); may he accept (them), offered with an unhesitating mind, (to him) who is the refuge of man, endowed with any form that may be desired, blazing with a radiance (that it is) not (possible) to endure.

mantras.sanskrit: ज्ञेया भागं सहसानो वरेण त्वादूतासो मनुवद्वदेम । अनूनमग्निं जुह्वा वचस्या मधुपृचं धनसा जोहवीमि ॥
mantras.transliteration: jñeyā bhāgaṃ sahasāno vareṇa tvādūtāso manuvadvadema | anūnamagniṃ juhvā vacasyā madhupṛcaṃ dhanasā johavīmi ||

translations.english: Overpowering (your foes) with lustre, may you recognize your portion; may we, having you for our messenger, recite (praise) like Manu; desiring wealth, I offer oblation with the sacrificial ladle and with praises, to that entire Agni, who rewards (the worshipper) with the sweet (fruit) of the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रुधी हवमिन्द्र मा रिषण्यः स्याम ते दावने वसूनाम् । इमा हि त्वामूर्जो वर्धयन्ति वसूयवः सिन्धवो न क्षरन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śrudhī havamindra mā riṣaṇyaḥ syāma te dāvane vasūnām | imā hi tvāmūrjo vardhayanti vasūyavaḥ sindhavo na kṣarantaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, hear (my) invocation; disregard it not; may we be (thought worthy) of the gift of your treasures; these oblations, designed to obtain wealth, flowing (abundantly) like rivers, bring to you augmented vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: सृजो महीरिन्द्र या अपिन्वः परिष्ठिता अहिना शूर पूर्वीः । अमर्त्यं चिद्दासं मन्यमानमवाभिनदुक्थैर्वावृधानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sṛjo mahīrindra yā apinvaḥ pariṣṭhitā ahinā śūra pūrvīḥ | amartyaṃ ciddāsaṃ manyamānamavābhinadukthairvāvṛdhānaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, hero, you have set free the copious (waters) which were formerly arrested by Ahi, and which you have distributed; invogorated by hymns, you have cast down headlong the slave, conceiting himself immortal.

mantras.sanskrit: उक्थेष्विन्नु शूर येषु चाकन्त्स्तोमेष्विन्द्र रुद्रियेषु च । तुभ्येदेता यासु मन्दसानः प्र वायवे सिस्रते न शुभ्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uktheṣvinnu śūra yeṣu cākantstomeṣvindra rudriyeṣu ca | tubhyedetā yāsu mandasānaḥ pra vāyave sisrate na śubhrāḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, hero, these brilliant (laudations), in (the form of) hymns, in which you delight, and in (that of) the praises uttered by the worshipper by which you are gratified, are addressed to you, to bring you (to your sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: शुभ्रं नु ते शुष्मं वर्धयन्तः शुभ्रं वज्रं बाह्वोर्दधानाः । शुभ्रस्त्वमिन्द्र वावृधानो अस्मे दासीर्विशः सूर्येण सह्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śubhraṃ nu te śuṣmaṃ vardhayantaḥ śubhraṃ vajraṃ bāhvordadhānāḥ | śubhrastvamindra vāvṛdhāno asme dāsīrviśaḥ sūryeṇa sahyāḥ ||

translations.english: We are invigorating your brilliant strength (by our praises), and plural cing the thunderbolt in your hands; do you, Indra, radiant, increasing in strenght, and (encouraged) by the sun, overpower, for our (good), the servile people.

mantras.sanskrit: गुहा हितं गुह्यं गूळ्हमप्स्वपीवृतं मायिनं क्षियन्तम् । उतो अपो द्यां तस्तभ्वांसमहन्नहिं शूर वीर्येण ॥
mantras.transliteration: guhā hitaṃ guhyaṃ gūḷhamapsvapīvṛtaṃ māyinaṃ kṣiyantam | uto apo dyāṃ tastabhvāṃsamahannahiṃ śūra vīryeṇa ||

translations.english: Indra, hero, you have slain by your prow the glorified Ahi, hidden privy in a cave, lurking in concealment, covered by the waters in which he was abiding, and arresting the rains in the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तवा नु त इन्द्र पूर्व्या महान्युत स्तवाम नूतना कृतानि । स्तवा वज्रं बाह्वोरुशन्तं स्तवा हरी सूर्यस्य केतू ॥
mantras.transliteration: stavā nu ta indra pūrvyā mahānyuta stavāma nūtanā kṛtāni | stavā vajraṃ bāhvoruśantaṃ stavā harī sūryasya ketū ||

translations.english: We glorify, Indra, your mighty (deeds) of old; we glorify your (more) recent exploits; we praise the thunderbolt shining in your arms, and we celebrate the horses, the signs of (Indra as) the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: हरी नु त इन्द्र वाजयन्ता घृतश्चुतं स्वारमस्वार्ष्टाम् । वि समना भूमिरप्रथिष्टारंस्त पर्वतश्चित्सरिष्यन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: harī nu ta indra vājayantā ghṛtaścutaṃ svāramasvārṣṭām | vi samanā bhūmiraprathiṣṭāraṃsta parvataścitsariṣyan ||

translations.english: Your swift horses, Indra, have uttered a loud sound, announcing rain; the level earth anxiously expects its fall, as the gathering cloud has passed.

mantras.sanskrit: नि पर्वतः साद्यप्रयुच्छन्त्सं मातृभिर्वावशानो अक्रान् । दूरे पारे वाणीं वर्धयन्त इन्द्रेषितां धमनिं पप्रथन्नि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni parvataḥ sādyaprayucchantsaṃ mātṛbhirvāvaśāno akrān | dūre pāre vāṇīṃ vardhayanta indreṣitāṃ dhamaniṃ paprathanni ||

translations.english: The cloud, not heedless (of its office), is suspended (in the sky); resonant with maternal (waters), it has spread about; (the winds), augmenting the sound in the distant horizon; have promulgated the voice uttered by Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रो महां सिन्धुमाशयानं मायाविनं वृत्रमस्फुरन्निः । अरेजेतां रोदसी भियाने कनिक्रदतो वृष्णो अस्य वज्रात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indro mahāṃ sindhumāśayānaṃ māyāvinaṃ vṛtramasphuranniḥ | arejetāṃ rodasī bhiyāne kanikradato vṛṣṇo asya vajrāt ||

translations.english: The mighty Indra has shattered the guileful Vṛtra reposing in the cloud;heaven and earth shook, alarmed at the thundering bolt of the showerer.

mantras.sanskrit: अरोरवीद्वृष्णो अस्य वज्रोऽमानुषं यन्मानुषो निजूर्वात् । नि मायिनो दानवस्य माया अपादयत्पपिवान्त्सुतस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: aroravīdvṛṣṇo asya vajro'mānuṣaṃ yanmānuṣo nijūrvāt | ni māyino dānavasya māyā apādayatpapivāntsutasya ||

translations.english: The thunderbolt of the showerer roared aloud, when (Indra), the friend of man, sought to slay the enemy of mankind. Drinking the Soma, he (Indra), baffled the devices of the guileful Dānava.

mantras.sanskrit: पिबापिबेदिन्द्र शूर सोमं मन्दन्तु त्वा मन्दिनः सुतासः । पृणन्तस्ते कुक्षी वर्धयन्त्वित्था सुतः पौर इन्द्रमाव ॥
mantras.transliteration: pibāpibedindra śūra somaṃ mandantu tvā mandinaḥ sutāsaḥ | pṛṇantaste kukṣī vardhayantvitthā sutaḥ paura indramāva ||

translations.english: Drink, hero, Indra, drink the Soma;may the exhilarating juices delight you; may they, distending your flanks, augment (your prowess), and in this manner may the replenishing effused libation satisfy Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वे इन्द्राप्यभूम विप्रा धियं वनेम ऋतया सपन्तः । अवस्यवो धीमहि प्रशस्तिं सद्यस्ते रायो दावने स्याम ॥
mantras.transliteration: tve indrāpyabhūma viprā dhiyaṃ vanema ṛtayā sapantaḥ | avasyavo dhīmahi praśastiṃ sadyaste rāyo dāvane syāma ||

translations.english: May we, your pious (worshipper), abide in you; approaching you with devotion, may we enjoy (the reward of) our adoration; desirous of protection, we meditate your glorification; may we ever be (thought worthy) of the gift of your treasures.

mantras.sanskrit: स्याम ते त इन्द्र ये त ऊती अवस्यव ऊर्जं वर्धयन्तः । शुष्मिन्तमं यं चाकनाम देवास्मे रयिं रासि वीरवन्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: syāma te ta indra ye ta ūtī avasyava ūrjaṃ vardhayantaḥ | śuṣmintamaṃ yaṃ cākanāma devāsme rayiṃ rāsi vīravantam ||

translations.english: May we, (through) your (favour), Indra, be such as those are, who, desirous of your protection, augment (by their praises) your vigour; divine (Indra), you grant the wealth which we desire, (the source of) great power and of (numerous) progeny.

mantras.sanskrit: रासि क्षयं रासि मित्रमस्मे रासि शर्ध इन्द्र मारुतं नः । सजोषसो ये च मन्दसानाः प्र वायवः पान्त्यग्रणीतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: rāsi kṣayaṃ rāsi mitramasme rāsi śardha indra mārutaṃ naḥ | sajoṣaso ye ca mandasānāḥ pra vāyavaḥ pāntyagraṇītim ||

translations.english: You grant a habitation; you grant friends; you grant us, Indra, the strength of the Maruts; the winds, who, propitious and exulting, drink copiously of the first offering (of the Soma).

mantras.sanskrit: व्यन्त्विन्नु येषु मन्दसानस्तृपत्सोमं पाहि द्रह्यदिन्द्र । अस्मान्त्सु पृत्स्वा तरुत्रावर्धयो द्यां बृहद्भिरर्कैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vyantvinnu yeṣu mandasānastṛpatsomaṃ pāhi drahyadindra | asmāntsu pṛtsvā tarutrāvardhayo dyāṃ bṛhadbhirarkaiḥ ||

translations.english: Let those in whom you are delighted repair (to the libation), and do you, Indra, confiding, drink the satiating Soma; liberator (from evil), associated with the mighty and adorable (Maruts), augment our prosperity, and (that of) heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: बृहन्त इन्नु ये ते तरुत्रोक्थेभिर्वा सुम्नमाविवासान् । स्तृणानासो बर्हिः पस्त्यावत्त्वोता इदिन्द्र वाजमग्मन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhanta innu ye te tarutrokthebhirvā sumnamāvivāsān | stṛṇānāso barhiḥ pastyāvattvotā idindra vājamagman ||

translations.english: Liberator (from evil), they who worship you, the giver of happiness, with holy hymns, quickly become great; they who strew the sacred grass (in honour of you) are protected by you, and, together with their famiies, obtain (abundant) food.

mantras.sanskrit: उग्रेष्विन्नु शूर मन्दसानस्त्रिकद्रुकेषु पाहि सोममिन्द्र । प्रदोधुवच्छ्मश्रुषु प्रीणानो याहि हरिभ्यां सुतस्य पीतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ugreṣvinnu śūra mandasānastrikadrukeṣu pāhi somamindra | pradodhuvacchmaśruṣu prīṇāno yāhi haribhyāṃ sutasya pītim ||

translations.english: Indra, hero, exulting in the solemn Trikadruka rites quaff the Soma, and repeatedly shaking it from your beard, repair, well plural ased with your steeds, to the drinking of the effused libation.

mantras.sanskrit: धिष्वा शवः शूर येन वृत्रमवाभिनद्दानुमौर्णवाभम् । अपावृणोर्ज्योतिरार्याय नि सव्यतः सादि दस्युरिन्द्र ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhiṣvā śavaḥ śūra yena vṛtramavābhinaddānumaurṇavābham | apāvṛṇorjyotirāryāya ni savyataḥ sādi dasyurindra ||

translations.english: Indra, hero, keep up the strength wherewith you have crushed Vṛtra, the spider-like son of Dānu, and let open the light to the Ārya; the Dasyu has been set aside on your left hand.

mantras.sanskrit: सनेम ये त ऊतिभिस्तरन्तो विश्वाः स्पृध आर्येण दस्यून् । अस्मभ्यं तत्त्वाष्ट्रं विश्वरूपमरन्धयः साख्यस्य त्रिताय ॥
mantras.transliteration: sanema ye ta ūtibhistaranto viśvāḥ spṛdha āryeṇa dasyūn | asmabhyaṃ tattvāṣṭraṃ viśvarūpamarandhayaḥ sākhyasya tritāya ||

translations.english: Let us honour those men, who, through your protection, surpass all their rivals, as the Dasyus (are surpassed) by the Arya; this (have you wrought) for us; you have slain Viśvarūpa, the son of Tvaṣṭā, through friendship of Trita.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य सुवानस्य मन्दिनस्त्रितस्य न्यर्बुदं वावृधानो अस्तः । अवर्तयत्सूर्यो न चक्रं भिनद्वलमिन्द्रो अङ्गिरस्वान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya suvānasya mandinastritasya nyarbudaṃ vāvṛdhāno astaḥ | avartayatsūryo na cakraṃ bhinadvalamindro aṅgirasvān ||

translations.english: Invigorated (by the libation) of the exulting Trita, offering you the Soma, you have annihilated Arbuda; Indra, aided by the Aṅgirasa, has whirled round his bolt, as the tun turns round his wheel, and slain Bala.

mantras.sanskrit: नूनं सा ते प्रति वरं जरित्रे दुहीयदिन्द्र दक्षिणा मघोनी । शिक्षा स्तोतृभ्यो माति धग्भगो नो बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nūnaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre duhīyadindra dakṣiṇā maghonī | śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhagbhago no bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

translations.english: That opulent donation, which proceeds, Indra, from you, assuredly bestows upon him who praises you the boon (which he desires); grant it to us, your prisers; do not you, who are the object of adoration, disregard (our prayer); so that, blessed with worthy descendants, we may glorify you at this sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: यो जात एव प्रथमो मनस्वान्देवो देवान्क्रतुना पर्यभूषत् । यस्य शुष्माद्रोदसी अभ्यसेतां नृम्णस्य मह्ना स जनास इन्द्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo jāta eva prathamo manasvāndevo devānkratunā paryabhūṣat | yasya śuṣmādrodasī abhyasetāṃ nṛmṇasya mahnā sa janāsa indraḥ ||

translations.english: He, who as soon as born,is the first (of the deities); who has done honour to the gods by his exploits; he, at whose might heaven and earth are alarmed, and (who is known) by the greatness of his strength, he, men, is Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: यः पृथिवीं व्यथमानामदृंहद्यः पर्वतान्प्रकुपिताँ अरम्णात् । यो अन्तरिक्षं विममे वरीयो यो द्यामस्तभ्नात्स जनास इन्द्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ pṛthivīṃ vyathamānāmadṛṃhadyaḥ parvatānprakupitā~ aramṇāt | yo antarikṣaṃ vimame varīyo yo dyāmastabhnātsa janāsa indraḥ ||

translations.english: He, who fixed firm the moving earth; who tranquilized the incensed mountains; who spread the spacious firmament; who consolidated the heaven; he, men, is Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: यो हत्वाहिमरिणात्सप्त सिन्धून्यो गा उदाजदपधा वलस्य । यो अश्मनोरन्तरग्निं जजान संवृक्समत्सु स जनास इन्द्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo hatvāhimariṇātsapta sindhūnyo gā udājadapadhā valasya | yo aśmanorantaragniṃ jajāna saṃvṛksamatsu sa janāsa indraḥ ||

translations.english: He, who having destroyed Ahi, set free the seven rivers; who recovered the cows detained by Bala; who genitive rated fire in the clouds; who is invincible in battle; he, men, is Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: येनेमा विश्वा च्यवना कृतानि यो दासं वर्णमधरं गुहाकः । श्वघ्नीव यो जिगीवाँल्लक्षमाददर्यः पुष्टानि स जनास इन्द्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yenemā viśvā cyavanā kṛtāni yo dāsaṃ varṇamadharaṃ guhākaḥ | śvaghnīva yo jigīvā~llakṣamādadaryaḥ puṣṭāni sa janāsa indraḥ ||

translations.english: He, by whom all these perishable (regions) have been made; who consigned the base servile tribe to the cavern; who seizes triumphant the cherished (tresures) of the enemy, as a hunter (strikes) his prey; he, men, is Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: यं स्मा पृच्छन्ति कुह सेति घोरमुतेमाहुर्नैषो अस्तीत्येनम् । सो अर्यः पुष्टीर्विज इवा मिनाति श्रदस्मै धत्त स जनास इन्द्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ smā pṛcchanti kuha seti ghoramutemāhurnaiṣo astītyenam | so aryaḥ puṣṭīrvija ivā mināti śradasmai dhatta sa janāsa indraḥ ||

translations.english: He, whom, terrible, they ask for, (saying), Where is he? or, verily, they say of him, he is not (in any one plural ce); but who, inflicting (chastisement), destroys the cherisshed (treasures) of the enemy; in him have faith; for he, men, is Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: यो रध्रस्य चोदिता यः कृशस्य यो ब्रह्मणो नाधमानस्य कीरेः । युक्तग्राव्णो योऽविता सुशिप्रः सुतसोमस्य स जनास इन्द्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo radhrasya coditā yaḥ kṛśasya yo brahmaṇo nādhamānasya kīreḥ | yuktagrāvṇo yo'vitā suśipraḥ sutasomasya sa janāsa indraḥ ||

translations.english: He, who is the encourager of the rich, and of the poor, and of the priest, who recites his praise, and is a suppliant; who, of goodly features, is the protector of him, who, with ready stones, expresses the Soma juice; he, men, is Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्याश्वासः प्रदिशि यस्य गावो यस्य ग्रामा यस्य विश्वे रथासः । यः सूर्यं य उषसं जजान यो अपां नेता स जनास इन्द्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasyāśvāsaḥ pradiśi yasya gāvo yasya grāmā yasya viśve rathāsaḥ | yaḥ sūryaṃ ya uṣasaṃ jajāna yo apāṃ netā sa janāsa indraḥ ||

translations.english: He, under whose control are horses and cattle, and villages, and all chariots; he who gave birth to the sun and to the dawn; and who is the leader of the waters; he, men, is Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: यं क्रन्दसी संयती विह्वयेते परेऽवर उभया अमित्राः । समानं चिद्रथमातस्थिवांसा नाना हवेते स जनास इन्द्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ krandasī saṃyatī vihvayete pare'vara ubhayā amitrāḥ | samānaṃ cidrathamātasthivāṃsā nānā havete sa janāsa indraḥ ||

translations.english: Whom (two hosts), calling and mutually encountering, call upon; whom both adversaries, high and low, (appeal to); whom two (charioteers), standing in the same car, severally invoke; he, men, is Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्मान्न ऋते विजयन्ते जनासो यं युध्यमाना अवसे हवन्ते । यो विश्वस्य प्रतिमानं बभूव यो अच्युतच्युत्स जनास इन्द्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasmānna ṛte vijayante janāso yaṃ yudhyamānā avase havante | yo viśvasya pratimānaṃ babhūva yo acyutacyutsa janāsa indraḥ ||

translations.english: Without whom men do not conquer; whom, when engaged in conflict, they invoke for succour; he, who is the prototype of the universe and the caster down of the unyielding; he, men, is Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: यः शश्वतो मह्येनो दधानानमन्यमानाञ्छर्वा जघान । यः शर्धते नानुददाति शृध्यां यो दस्योर्हन्ता स जनास इन्द्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ śaśvato mahyeno dadhānānamanyamānāñcharvā jaghāna | yaḥ śardhate nānudadāti śṛdhyāṃ yo dasyorhantā sa janāsa indraḥ ||

translations.english: He, who with the thunderbolt has destroyed many committing great sin, and offering (him) no homage; who grants not success to the confident; who is the slayer of the Dasyus; he, men, is Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: यः शम्बरं पर्वतेषु क्षियन्तं चत्वारिंश्यां शरद्यन्वविन्दत् । ओजायमानं यो अहिं जघान दानुं शयानं स जनास इन्द्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ śambaraṃ parvateṣu kṣiyantaṃ catvāriṃśyāṃ śaradyanvavindat | ojāyamānaṃ yo ahiṃ jaghāna dānuṃ śayānaṃ sa janāsa indraḥ ||

translations.english: He, who discovered Śambara dwelling in the mountains for forty years; who slew Ahi, growing in strength, and the sleeping son of Dānu; he, men, is Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: यः सप्तरश्मिर्वृषभस्तुविष्मानवासृजत्सर्तवे सप्त सिन्धून् । यो रौहिणमस्फुरद्वज्रबाहुर्द्यामारोहन्तं स जनास इन्द्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ saptaraśmirvṛṣabhastuviṣmānavāsṛjatsartave sapta sindhūn | yo rauhiṇamasphuradvajrabāhurdyāmārohantaṃ sa janāsa indraḥ ||

translations.english: He, the seven-rayed, the showerer, the powerful, who let loose the seven rivers to flow; who, armed with the thunderbolt, crushed Rauhiṇa when scaling heaven; he, men, is Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: द्यावा चिदस्मै पृथिवी नमेते शुष्माच्चिदस्य पर्वता भयन्ते । यः सोमपा निचितो वज्रबाहुर्यो वज्रहस्तः स जनास इन्द्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dyāvā cidasmai pṛthivī namete śuṣmāccidasya parvatā bhayante | yaḥ somapā nicito vajrabāhuryo vajrahastaḥ sa janāsa indraḥ ||

translations.english: He, to whom heaven and earth bow down; he, at whose might the mountains are appalled; he, who is the drinker of the Soma, the firm (of frame), the adamant-armed, the wielder of the thunderbolt; he, men, is Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: यः सुन्वन्तमवति यः पचन्तं यः शंसन्तं यः शशमानमूती । यस्य ब्रह्म वर्धनं यस्य सोमो यस्येदं राधः स जनास इन्द्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ sunvantamavati yaḥ pacantaṃ yaḥ śaṃsantaṃ yaḥ śaśamānamūtī | yasya brahma vardhanaṃ yasya somo yasyedaṃ rādhaḥ sa janāsa indraḥ ||

translations.english: He, who protects (the worshipper) offering the libation, or preparing (the mixed curds and butter), repeating his praise and soliciting his assistance, he, of whom the sacred prayer, the (offered) Soma, the (presented sacrificial) food, augment (the vigour); he, men, is Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: यः सुन्वते पचते दुध्र आ चिद्वाजं दर्दर्षि स किलासि सत्यः । वयं त इन्द्र विश्वह प्रियासः सुवीरासो विदथमा वदेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ sunvate pacate dudhra ā cidvājaṃ dardarṣi sa kilāsi satyaḥ | vayaṃ ta indra viśvaha priyāsaḥ suvīrāso vidathamā vadema ||

translations.english: Indra, who are difficult of approach; you, verily, are a true (benefactor), who bestows (abundant) food upon him who offers the libation, who prepares (the mixed curds and butter); may we, enjoying your favour, blessed with progeny, daily repeat (your praises) at the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतुर्जनित्री तस्या अपस्परि मक्षू जात आविशद्यासु वर्धते । तदाहना अभवत्पिप्युषी पय्ॐऽशोः पीयूषं प्रथमं तदुक्थ्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛturjanitrī tasyā apaspari makṣū jāta āviśadyāsu vardhate | tadāhanā abhavatpipyuṣī payoṃ'śoḥ pīyūṣaṃ prathamaṃ tadukthyam ||

translations.english: The season (of the rains) is the parent (of the Soma), which, as soon as born of her, enters into the waters in which it grows; thence it is fit for expression, as concentrating (the essence of the) water, and the juice of the Soma is especially to be praised (as the libation proper for Indra).

mantras.sanskrit: सध्रीमा यन्ति परि बिभ्रतीः पयो विश्वप्स्न्याय प्र भरन्त भोजनम् । समानो अध्वा प्रवतामनुष्यदे यस्ताकृणोः प्रथमं सास्युक्थ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sadhrīmā yanti pari bibhratīḥ payo viśvapsnyāya pra bharanta bhojanam | samāno adhvā pravatāmanuṣyade yastākṛṇoḥ prathamaṃ sāsyukthyaḥ ||

translations.english: The aggregated (streams) come, bearing everywhere the water, and conveying it as sustenance for the asylum of all rivers, (the ocean); the samepath is (assigned) to all the descending (currents) to follow; and as he, who has (assigned) them (their course), you, (Indra), are especially to be praised.

mantras.sanskrit: अन्वेको वदति यद्ददाति तद्रूपा मिनन्तदपा एक ईयते । विश्वा एकस्य विनुदस्तितिक्षते यस्ताकृणोः प्रथमं सास्युक्थ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: anveko vadati yaddadāti tadrūpā minantadapā eka īyate | viśvā ekasya vinudastitikṣate yastākṛṇoḥ prathamaṃ sāsyukthyaḥ ||

translations.english: One (priest) announces (the offering) that he, (the instrumental tutor of the rite) presents; another performs the act that apportions the limbs (of the victim); a third corrects all the deficiencies of either, and as he, who has enjoyed these (functions), your, (Indra), are especially to be praised.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रजाभ्यः पुष्टिं विभजन्त आसते रयिमिव पृष्ठं प्रभवन्तमायते । असिन्वन्दंष्ट्रैः पितुरत्ति भोजनं यस्ताकृणोः प्रथमं सास्युक्थ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prajābhyaḥ puṣṭiṃ vibhajanta āsate rayimiva pṛṣṭhaṃ prabhavantamāyate | asinvandaṃṣṭraiḥ pituratti bhojanaṃ yastākṛṇoḥ prathamaṃ sāsyukthyaḥ ||

translations.english: Distributing nourishment to their progeny, they, (the householders), abide (in their dwellings), as if offering ample and sustaining wealth to a guest; constructing (useful works, a man) eats with his teeth the food (given him) by (his) protector and as he, who has enjoined these (things to be done), you, (Indra), are especially to be praised.

mantras.sanskrit: अधाकृणोः पृथिवीं संदृशे दिवे यो धौतीनामहिहन्नारिणक्पथः । तं त्वा स्तोमेभिरुदभिर्न वाजिनं देवं देवा अजनन्त्सास्युक्थ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhākṛṇoḥ pṛthivīṃ saṃdṛśe dive yo dhautīnāmahihannāriṇakpathaḥ | taṃ tvā stomebhirudabhirna vājinaṃ devaṃ devā ajanantsāsyukthyaḥ ||

translations.english: Inasmuch as you have rendered earth visible to heaven, and have set open the path of the rivers by slaying Ahi; therefore the gods have rendered you divine by praises, as (men) invigorate a horse by water; (and) you are, (Indra), to be praised.

mantras.sanskrit: यो भोजनं च दयसे च वर्धनमार्द्रादा शुष्कं मधुमद्दुदोहिथ । स शेवधिं नि दधिषे विवस्वति विश्वस्यैक ईशिषे सास्युक्थ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo bhojanaṃ ca dayase ca vardhanamārdrādā śuṣkaṃ madhumaddudohitha | sa śevadhiṃ ni dadhiṣe vivasvati viśvasyaika īśiṣe sāsyukthyaḥ ||

translations.english: (You are he) who bestows both food and increase, and milk the dry nutritious (grain) from out of the humid stalk; he, who gives wealth to the worshipper, and are sole sovereign of the universe you are he, (Indra), who is to be praised.

mantras.sanskrit: यः पुष्पिणीश्च प्रस्वश्च धर्मणाधि दाने व्यवनीरधारयः । यश्चासमा अजनो दिद्युतो दिव उरुरूर्वाँ अभितः सास्युक्थ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ puṣpiṇīśca prasvaśca dharmaṇādhi dāne vyavanīradhārayaḥ | yaścāsamā ajano didyuto diva ururūrvā~ abhitaḥ sāsyukthyaḥ ||

translations.english: You who have caused, by culture, the flowering and fruitful (plural nts) to spread over the field; who have genitive rated the various luminaries of heaven; and who, of vast bulk, comprehend vast (bodies); you are he who is to be praised.

mantras.sanskrit: यो नार्मरं सहवसुं निहन्तवे पृक्षाय च दासवेशाय चावहः । ऊर्जयन्त्या अपरिविष्टमास्यमुतैवाद्य पुरुकृत्सास्युक्थ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo nārmaraṃ sahavasuṃ nihantave pṛkṣāya ca dāsaveśāya cāvahaḥ | ūrjayantyā apariviṣṭamāsyamutaivādya purukṛtsāsyukthyaḥ ||

translations.english: You, who are (famed for) many exploits, put on today an unclouded countenance, (as prepared) to slay Sahavasu, the son of Nṛmara, with the sharpened (edge of the thunderbolt), in defence of the (sacrificial) food, and for the destruction of dasyu; you are he who is to be praised.

mantras.sanskrit: शतं वा यस्य दश साकमाद्य एकस्य श्रुष्टौ यद्ध चोदमाविथ । अरज्जौ दस्यून्त्समुनब्दभीतये सुप्राव्यो अभवः सास्युक्थ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śataṃ vā yasya daśa sākamādya ekasya śruṣṭau yaddha codamāvitha | arajjau dasyūntsamunabdabhītaye suprāvyo abhavaḥ sāsyukthyaḥ ||

translations.english: You, for whose sole plural asure a thousand (steeds are ready); by whom all are to be fed; and who protects the instrumental tutor (of the sacrifice); who, for the sake of Dabhīti, has caste the Dasyus into unfettered (captivity), and who are to be approached (by all), you are he who is to be praised.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वेदनु रोधना अस्य पौंस्यं ददुरस्मै दधिरे कृत्नवे धनम् । षळस्तभ्ना विष्टिरः पञ्च संदृशः परि परो अभवः सास्युक्थ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvedanu rodhanā asya pauṃsyaṃ dadurasmai dadhire kṛtnave dhanam | ṣaḷastabhnā viṣṭiraḥ pañca saṃdṛśaḥ pari paro abhavaḥ sāsyukthyaḥ ||

translations.english: You are he, from whose manhood all the rivers (have proceeded); to whom (the pious) have given (offerings); to whom, doer of mighty deeds, they have presented wealth; you are he, who have regulated the six expansive (objects), and are the protector of the five (races), that look up to you; you are he who is to be praised.

mantras.sanskrit: सुप्रवाचनं तव वीर वीर्यं यदेकेन क्रतुना विन्दसे वसु । जातूष्ठिरस्य प्र वयः सहस्वतो या चकर्थ सेन्द्र विश्वास्युक्थ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: supravācanaṃ tava vīra vīryaṃ yadekena kratunā vindase vasu | jātūṣṭhirasya pra vayaḥ sahasvato yā cakartha sendra viśvāsyukthyaḥ ||

translations.english: Your heroism, hero, is to be glorified, by which, with single effort, you have acquired wealth; (wherewith) the (sacrificial) food of (every) solemn and constant (ceremony is provided); for all (the acts) you have performed, you, Indra, are he who is to be praised.

mantras.sanskrit: अरमयः सरपसस्तराय कं तुर्वीतये च वय्याय च स्रुतिम् । नीचा सन्तमुदनयः परावृजं प्रान्धं श्रोणं श्रवयन्त्सास्युक्थ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aramayaḥ sarapasastarāya kaṃ turvītaye ca vayyāya ca srutim | nīcā santamudanayaḥ parāvṛjaṃ prāndhaṃ śroṇaṃ śravayantsāsyukthyaḥ ||

translations.english: You have provided a passage for the easy crossing of the flowing waters for Turvati and Vayya; rendering (yourself) renowned, you have uplifted the blind and lame Paravṛj from the lowliness (of affliction); you are he who is to be praised.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मभ्यं तद्वसो दानाय राधः समर्थयस्व बहु ते वसव्यम् । इन्द्र यच्चित्रं श्रवस्या अनु द्यून्बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmabhyaṃ tadvaso dānāya rādhaḥ samarthayasva bahu te vasavyam | indra yaccitraṃ śravasyā anu dyūnbṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

translations.english: Possessor of riches, exert your ability to bestow wealth upon us; for yours is great affluence; may you, Indra, be disposed to grant us exceeding abundance day by day, so that, blessed with worthy descendants, we may glorify you at (our) sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: अध्वर्यवो भरतेन्द्राय सोममामत्रेभिः सिञ्चता मद्यमन्धः । कामी हि वीरः सदमस्य पीतिं जुहोत वृष्णे तदिदेष वष्टि ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhvaryavo bharatendrāya somamāmatrebhiḥ siñcatā madyamandhaḥ | kāmī hi vīraḥ sadamasya pītiṃ juhota vṛṣṇe tadideṣa vaṣṭi ||

translations.english: Priests, bring the Soma libation for Indra; sprinkle with ladles the exhilarating beverage; he, the hero, is ever desirous of the draught; offer the libation to the showerer (of benefits), for, verily, he desires it.

mantras.sanskrit: अध्वर्यवो यो अपो वव्रिवांसं वृत्रं जघानाशन्येव वृक्षम् । तस्मा एतं भरत तद्वशायँ एष इन्द्रो अर्हति पीतिमस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhvaryavo yo apo vavrivāṃsaṃ vṛtraṃ jaghānāśanyeva vṛkṣam | tasmā etaṃ bharata tadvaśāya~ eṣa indro arhati pītimasya ||

translations.english: Priests, offer the libation to him who slew the rain-arresting Vṛtra, as (he strikes down) a tree with (his) thunderbolt; to him who desires it; and Indra is worthy of (Soma).

mantras.sanskrit: अध्वर्यवो यो दृभीकं जघान यो गा उदाजदप हि वलं वः । तस्मा एतमन्तरिक्षे न वातमिन्द्रं सोमैरोर्णुत जूर्न वस्त्रैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhvaryavo yo dṛbhīkaṃ jaghāna yo gā udājadapa hi valaṃ vaḥ | tasmā etamantarikṣe na vātamindraṃ somairorṇuta jūrna vastraiḥ ||

translations.english: Priests, offer this libation, which, like the wind in the firmament, (is the cause of rain), to him who slew Dṛbhīka, destroyed Bala, andliberated the cows; heap Indra with Soma, as an old man (is covered) with garments.

mantras.sanskrit: अध्वर्यवो य उरणं जघान नव चख्वांसं नवतिं च बाहून् । यो अर्बुदमव नीचा बबाधे तमिन्द्रं सोमस्य भृथे हिनोत ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhvaryavo ya uraṇaṃ jaghāna nava cakhvāṃsaṃ navatiṃ ca bāhūn | yo arbudamava nīcā babādhe tamindraṃ somasya bhṛthe hinota ||

translations.english: Priests, propitiate, by the offering of the Soma that Indra, who slew Uraṇa, displaying nine and ninety arms; and hurled Arbuda down headlong.

mantras.sanskrit: अध्वर्यवो यः स्वश्नं जघान यः शुष्णमशुषं यो व्यंसम् । यः पिप्रुं नमुचिं यो रुधिक्रां तस्मा इन्द्रायान्धसो जुहोत ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhvaryavo yaḥ svaśnaṃ jaghāna yaḥ śuṣṇamaśuṣaṃ yo vyaṃsam | yaḥ pipruṃ namuciṃ yo rudhikrāṃ tasmā indrāyāndhaso juhota ||

translations.english: Priests, offer the Soma to that Indra, who slew Svaśna, the unabsorbable Śuṣṇa, and mutilated (Vṛtra), who destroyed Pipru, Namuci and Rudhikrā.

mantras.sanskrit: अध्वर्यवो यः शतं शम्बरस्य पुरो बिभेदाश्मनेव पूर्वीः । यो वर्चिनः शतमिन्द्रः सहस्रमपावपद्भरता सोममस्मै ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhvaryavo yaḥ śataṃ śambarasya puro bibhedāśmaneva pūrvīḥ | yo varcinaḥ śatamindraḥ sahasramapāvapadbharatā somamasmai ||

translations.english: Priests, present the Soma to him who, with the adamantine (thuderbolt), demolished the hundred ancient cities of Śambara, and cast down the hundred thousand (descendants) of Varcin.

mantras.sanskrit: अध्वर्यवो यः शतमा सहस्रं भूम्या उपस्थेऽवपज्जघन्वान् । कुत्सस्यायोरतिथिग्वस्य वीरान्न्यावृणग्भरता सोममस्मै ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhvaryavo yaḥ śatamā sahasraṃ bhūmyā upasthe'vapajjaghanvān | kutsasyāyoratithigvasya vīrānnyāvṛṇagbharatā somamasmai ||

translations.english: Priests, present the Soma to him, who, slaying hundreds and thousands (of asuras), cast them down upon the lap of the earth; who destroyed the assailants of Kutsa, Āyu and Atithigva.

mantras.sanskrit: अध्वर्यवो यन्नरः कामयाध्वे श्रुष्टी वहन्तो नशथा तदिन्द्रे । गभस्तिपूतं भरत श्रुतायेन्द्राय सोमं यज्यवो जुहोत ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhvaryavo yannaraḥ kāmayādhve śruṣṭī vahanto naśathā tadindre | gabhastipūtaṃ bharata śrutāyendrāya somaṃ yajyavo juhota ||

translations.english: Priests, leaders (of the ceremony), may you, quickly bringing the offering to Indra, receive that (recompense) which you may desire; solemnizing the sacrifice, offer the Soma, purified by expressing, to the renowned Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: अध्वर्यवः कर्तना श्रुष्टिमस्मै वने निपूतं वन उन्नयध्वम् । जुषाणो हस्त्यमभि वावशे व इन्द्राय सोमं मदिरं जुहोत ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhvaryavaḥ kartanā śruṣṭimasmai vane nipūtaṃ vana unnayadhvam | juṣāṇo hastyamabhi vāvaśe va indrāya somaṃ madiraṃ juhota ||

translations.english: Priests, offer to him the prompt (libation); lift it up, purified with water, in the ladle; well plural ased, he desires it from your hand; present the exhilarating Soma to Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: अध्वर्यवः पयसोधर्यथा गोः सोमेभिरीं पृणता भोजमिन्द्रम् । वेदाहमस्य निभृतं म एतद्दित्सन्तं भूयो यजतश्चिकेत ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhvaryavaḥ payasodharyathā goḥ somebhirīṃ pṛṇatā bhojamindram | vedāhamasya nibhṛtaṃ ma etadditsantaṃ bhūyo yajataściketa ||

translations.english: Priests, fill the bountiful Indra with libations as the udder of a cow is filled with milk; so shall the adorable (Indra) fully comprehend (the liberality) of him who desires to present the gift, and shall say (to him), I acknowledge the secret (virtue) of this my (draught).

mantras.sanskrit: अध्वर्यवो यो दिव्यस्य वस्वो यः पार्थिवस्य क्षम्यस्य राजा । तमूर्दरं न पृणता यवेनेन्द्रं सोमेभिस्तदपो वो अस्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhvaryavo yo divyasya vasvo yaḥ pārthivasya kṣamyasya rājā | tamūrdaraṃ na pṛṇatā yavenendraṃ somebhistadapo vo astu ||

translations.english: Priests, fill with libations, as a granary (is filled) with barley, Indra, who is the lord of the riches of heaven, of mid-heaven, of earth; and may such (pious) act be for your (good).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मभ्यं तद्वसो दानाय राधः समर्थयस्व बहु ते वसव्यम् । इन्द्र यच्चित्रं श्रवस्या अनु द्यून्बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmabhyaṃ tadvaso dānāya rādhaḥ samarthayasva bahu te vasavyam | indra yaccitraṃ śravasyā anu dyūnbṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

translations.english: Possessor of riches, exert your ability to bestow wealth upon us; for yours is great affluence; may, you, Indra, be disposed to grant us exceeding abundance day by day, so that, blessed with worthy descendants, we may glorify you at our sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र घा न्वस्य महतो महानि सत्या सत्यस्य करणानि वोचम् । त्रिकद्रुकेष्वपिबत्सुतस्यास्य मदे अहिमिन्द्रो जघान ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra ghā nvasya mahato mahāni satyā satyasya karaṇāni vocam | trikadrukeṣvapibatsutasyāsya made ahimindro jaghāna ||

translations.english: Verily, I proclaim the great and authentic deeds of the mighty and true (Indra); of him who drank the effused Soma at the Trikadruka rites, and in his exhilaration slew Ahi.

mantras.sanskrit: अवंशे द्यामस्तभायद्बृहन्तमा रोदसी अपृणदन्तरिक्षम् । स धारयत्पृथिवीं पप्रथच्च सोमस्य ता मद इन्द्रश्चकार ॥
mantras.transliteration: avaṃśe dyāmastabhāyadbṛhantamā rodasī apṛṇadantarikṣam | sa dhārayatpṛthivīṃ paprathacca somasya tā mada indraścakāra ||

translations.english: Who fixed the heaven in unsupported (space) and filled the spacious firmament, and heaven and earth, (with light); he it is who has upheld, and has made the earth renowned; in the exhilaration of the Soma, Indra has done these (deeds).

mantras.sanskrit: सद्मेव प्राचो वि मिमाय मानैर्वज्रेण खान्यतृणन्नदीनाम् । वृथासृजत्पथिभिर्दीर्घयाथैः सोमस्य ता मद इन्द्रश्चकार ॥
mantras.transliteration: sadmeva prāco vi mimāya mānairvajreṇa khānyatṛṇannadīnām | vṛthāsṛjatpathibhirdīrghayāthaiḥ somasya tā mada indraścakāra ||

translations.english: (He it is) who has measured the eastern (quarters) with measures like a chamber; who has dug with the thunderbolt the beds of the rivers, and has easily sent them forth by long-continued paths; in the exhilaration of the Soma, Indra has done these (deeds).

mantras.sanskrit: स प्रवोळ्हॄन्परिगत्या दभीतेर्विश्वमधागायुधमिद्धे अग्नौ । सं गोभिरश्वैरसृजद्रथेभिः सोमस्य ता मद इन्द्रश्चकार ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa pravoḷhṝnparigatyā dabhīterviśvamadhāgāyudhamiddhe agnau | saṃ gobhiraśvairasṛjadrathebhiḥ somasya tā mada indraścakāra ||

translations.english: Encountering the (asuras), carrying off Dabhiti, he burnt all their weapons in a kindled fire, and enriched (the prince) with their cattle, their horses and their chariots; in the exhilaration of the Soma, Indra has done these (deeds).

mantras.sanskrit: स ईं महीं धुनिमेतोररम्णात्सो अस्नातॄनपारयत्स्वस्ति । त उत्स्नाय रयिमभि प्र तस्थुः सोमस्य ता मद इन्द्रश्चकार ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa īṃ mahīṃ dhunimetoraramṇātso asnātṝnapārayatsvasti | ta utsnāya rayimabhi pra tasthuḥ somasya tā mada indraścakāra ||

translations.english: He tranquilized this great river, (so that it) might be crossed; he conveyed across it in safety (the sages) who had been unable to pass over it, and who, having crossed, proceeded to realize the wealthy they sought; in the exhilaration of the Soma, Indra has done these (deeds).

mantras.sanskrit: सोदञ्चं सिन्धुमरिणान्महित्वा वज्रेणान उषसः सं पिपेष । अजवसो जविनीभिर्विवृश्चन्त्सोमस्य ता मद इन्द्रश्चकार ॥
mantras.transliteration: sodañcaṃ sindhumariṇānmahitvā vajreṇāna uṣasaḥ saṃ pipeṣa | ajavaso javinībhirvivṛścantsomasya tā mada indraścakāra ||

translations.english: By his great power he turned the Sindhu towards the north; with his thunderbolt he ground to pieces the wagon of the dawn, scattering the tardy enemy with his swift forces; in the exhilaration of the Soma, Indra has done these (deeds).

mantras.sanskrit: स विद्वाँ अपगोहं कनीनामाविर्भवन्नुदतिष्ठत्परावृक् । प्रति श्रोणः स्थाद्व्यनगचष्ट सोमस्य ता मद इन्द्रश्चकार ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa vidvā~ apagohaṃ kanīnāmāvirbhavannudatiṣṭhatparāvṛk | prati śroṇaḥ sthādvyanagacaṣṭa somasya tā mada indraścakāra ||

translations.english: Conscious of the disappearance of the damsels, the (ṛṣi) Parivṛj, becoming manifest, stood up; the lame man overtook (them), the blind man beheld (them); in the exhilaration of the Soma, Indra has done these (deeds).

mantras.sanskrit: भिनद्वलमङ्गिरोभिर्गृणानो वि पर्वतस्य दृंहितान्यैरत् । रिणग्रोधांसि कृत्रिमाण्येषां सोमस्य ता मद इन्द्रश्चकार ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhinadvalamaṅgirobhirgṛṇāno vi parvatasya dṛṃhitānyairat | riṇagrodhāṃsi kṛtrimāṇyeṣāṃ somasya tā mada indraścakāra ||

translations.english: Praised by the Aṅgirasas, he destroyed Bala; he forced upon the firm shut (doors) of the mountain; he broke down their artificial defences; in the exhilaration of the Soma, Indra has done these (deeds).

mantras.sanskrit: स्वप्नेनाभ्युप्या चुमुरिं धुनिं च जघन्थ दस्युं प्र दभीतिमावः । रम्भी चिदत्र विविदे हिरण्यं सोमस्य ता मद इन्द्रश्चकार ॥
mantras.transliteration: svapnenābhyupyā cumuriṃ dhuniṃ ca jaghantha dasyuṃ pra dabhītimāvaḥ | rambhī cidatra vivide hiraṇyaṃ somasya tā mada indraścakāra ||

translations.english: You have slain the Dasyus Cumuri and Dhuni, having cast them into (profound) sleep; you have protected Dabhīti, while his chamberlain gained in that (contest) the gold (of the asuras); in the exhilaration of the Soma, Indra has done these (deeds).

mantras.sanskrit: नूनं सा ते प्रति वरं जरित्रे दुहीयदिन्द्र दक्षिणा मघोनी । शिक्षा स्तोतृभ्यो माति धग्भगो नो बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nūnaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre duhīyadindra dakṣiṇā maghonī | śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhagbhago no bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
