translations.english: That opulent donation which proceeds, Indra, from you, assuredly bestows upon him who praises you the boon (that he desires); grant it to (us) your adorers; do not you, who are the object of adoration, disregard our prayers; so that, blessed with worthy descendants, we may glorify you at this sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वः सतां ज्येष्ठतमाय सुष्टुतिमग्नाविव समिधाने हविर्भरे । इन्द्रमजुर्यं जरयन्तमुक्षितं सनाद्युवानमवसे हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vaḥ satāṃ jyeṣṭhatamāya suṣṭutimagnāviva samidhāne havirbhare | indramajuryaṃ jarayantamukṣitaṃ sanādyuvānamavase havāmahe ||

translations.english: I bear the libation for you to the best of the holy (gods, to be poured) on the kindled fire, (and I offer to him fitting praise); we invoke for (our) protection the ever-youthful Indra, the undecaying, the causer of decay, sprinkled (with the Soma).

mantras.sanskrit: यस्मादिन्द्राद्बृहतः किं चनेमृते विश्वान्यस्मिन्त्सम्भृताधि वीर्या । जठरे सोमं तन्वी सहो महो हस्ते वज्रं भरति शीर्षणि क्रतुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasmādindrādbṛhataḥ kiṃ canemṛte viśvānyasmintsambhṛtādhi vīryā | jaṭhare somaṃ tanvī saho maho haste vajraṃ bharati śīrṣaṇi kratum ||

translations.english: For without that mighty Indra, this (world) were nothing; in him all powers whatever are aggregated; he receives the Soma into his stomach, and in his body (exhibits) strength and energy; he bears the thunderbolt in his hand, and wisdom in his head.

mantras.sanskrit: न क्षोणीभ्यां परिभ्वे त इन्द्रियं न समुद्रैः पर्वतैरिन्द्र ते रथः । न ते वज्रमन्वश्नोति कश्चन यदाशुभिः पतसि योजना पुरु ॥
mantras.transliteration: na kṣoṇībhyāṃ paribhve ta indriyaṃ na samudraiḥ parvatairindra te rathaḥ | na te vajramanvaśnoti kaścana yadāśubhiḥ patasi yojanā puru ||

translations.english: Your might, Indra, is not to be overcome by (that of) heaven and earth; nor is your chariot (to be stopped) by oceans or by mountains; no one can escape from your thunderbolt, when you traverse many leagues with rapid (horses).

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वे ह्यस्मै यजताय धृष्णवे क्रतुं भरन्ति वृषभाय सश्चते । वृषा यजस्व हविषा विदुष्टरः पिबेन्द्र सोमं वृषभेण भानुना ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśve hyasmai yajatāya dhṛṣṇave kratuṃ bharanti vṛṣabhāya saścate | vṛṣā yajasva haviṣā viduṣṭaraḥ pibendra somaṃ vṛṣabheṇa bhānunā ||

translations.english: All men offer worship to that adorable, powerful, and munificent (Indra), who is associated (with praise); therefore, (do you), who are liberal and most wise, worship him with oblations; and drink, Indra, the Soma, together with the Sun, the showerer (of benefits).

mantras.sanskrit: वृष्णः कोशः पवते मध्व ऊर्मिर्वृषभान्नाय वृषभाय पातवे । वृषणाध्वर्यू वृषभासो अद्रयो वृषणं सोमं वृषभाय सुष्वति ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣṇaḥ kośaḥ pavate madhva ūrmirvṛṣabhānnāya vṛṣabhāya pātave | vṛṣaṇādhvaryū vṛṣabhāso adrayo vṛṣaṇaṃ somaṃ vṛṣabhāya suṣvati ||

translations.english: The juice of the gratifying and exhilarating (Soma), the exciter (of) those who drink it, flows to the showerer (of benefits), the dispenser of food, for his beverage; the two priests, the sprinklers of the oblation; and the stones (that express the Soma), offer to the best (of the deities), the Soma, the shedder (of blessings).

mantras.sanskrit: वृषा ते वज्र उत ते वृषा रथो वृषणा हरी वृषभाण्यायुधा । वृष्णो मदस्य वृषभ त्वमीशिष इन्द्र सोमस्य वृषभस्य तृप्णुहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣā te vajra uta te vṛṣā ratho vṛṣaṇā harī vṛṣabhāṇyāyudhā | vṛṣṇo madasya vṛṣabha tvamīśiṣa indra somasya vṛṣabhasya tṛpṇuhi ||

translations.english: Your thunderbolt, Indra, is the rainer (of bounties); your chariot, the showerer (of blessings); your two horses, the shedders (of desires); your weapons the diffusers (of wishes); you reign, showerer (of benefits), over the inebriating Soma, the sprinkler (of delight); satiate yourself, Indra, with the good-diffusing Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ते नावं न समने वचस्युवं ब्रह्मणा यामि सवनेषु दाधृषिः । कुविन्नो अस्य वचसो निबोधिषदिन्द्रमुत्सं न वसुनः सिचामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra te nāvaṃ na samane vacasyuvaṃ brahmaṇā yāmi savaneṣu dādhṛṣiḥ | kuvinno asya vacaso nibodhiṣadindramutsaṃ na vasunaḥ sicāmahe ||

translations.english: Victorious in battle, (through) your (favour) I approach you, who are gratified by praise, in sacred rites with prayer, as a boat (to bear me over misfortune); may Indra listen attentively to these our words; we pour out libations to Indra, (who is a receptacle) of treasure, as a well (is of water).

mantras.sanskrit: पुरा सम्बाधादभ्या ववृत्स्व नो धेनुर्न वत्सं यवसस्य पिप्युषी । सकृत्सु ते सुमतिभिः शतक्रतो सं पत्नीभिर्न वृषणो नसीमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: purā sambādhādabhyā vavṛtsva no dhenurna vatsaṃ yavasasya pipyuṣī | sakṛtsu te sumatibhiḥ śatakrato saṃ patnībhirna vṛṣaṇo nasīmahi ||

translations.english: Conduct us beforehand away from evil, as a cow grazing in a meadow leads her calf (out of peril); may we, Śatakratu, envelop you, if but once, with acceptable praises, as youthful husbands (are embraced) by their wives.

mantras.sanskrit: नूनं सा ते प्रति वरं जरित्रे दुहीयदिन्द्र दक्षिणा मघोनी । शिक्षा स्तोतृभ्यो माति धग्भगो नो बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nūnaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre duhīyadindra dakṣiṇā maghonī | śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhagbhago no bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

translations.english: That opulent donation which proceeds, Indra, from you, assuredly bestows upon him who praises you, the boon (that he desires); grant (it) to (us) your adorers; do not you, who are the object of adoration, disregard our prayers; so that, blessed with worthy descendants, we may glorify you at this sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: तदस्मै नव्यमङ्गिरस्वदर्चत शुष्मा यदस्य प्रत्नथोदीरते । विश्वा यद्गोत्रा सहसा परीवृता मदे सोमस्य दृंहितान्यैरयत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadasmai navyamaṅgirasvadarcata śuṣmā yadasya pratnathodīrate | viśvā yadgotrā sahasā parīvṛtā made somasya dṛṃhitānyairayat ||

translations.english: Address, worshippers, after the manner of Aṅgiras, a new (hymn) to that Indra, whose withering (energies) were developed of old; who, in the exhilaration of the Soma, forced open the obstructed and solid clouds.

mantras.sanskrit: स भूतु यो ह प्रथमाय धायस ओजो मिमानो महिमानमातिरत् । शूरो यो युत्सु तन्वं परिव्यत शीर्षणि द्यां महिना प्रत्यमुञ्चत ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa bhūtu yo ha prathamāya dhāyasa ojo mimāno mahimānamātirat | śūro yo yutsu tanvaṃ parivyata śīrṣaṇi dyāṃ mahinā pratyamuñcata ||

translations.english: May that (Indra) be (excited), who, manifesting his energy, exerted his might for the first drinking of the Soma; a hero, who in combats protected his own person n and by his greatness sustained the heaven upon his head.

mantras.sanskrit: अधाकृणोः प्रथमं वीर्यं महद्यदस्याग्रे ब्रह्मणा शुष्ममैरयः । रथेष्ठेन हर्यश्वेन विच्युताः प्र जीरयः सिस्रते सध्र्यक्पृथक् ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhākṛṇoḥ prathamaṃ vīryaṃ mahadyadasyāgre brahmaṇā śuṣmamairayaḥ | ratheṣṭhena haryaśvena vicyutāḥ pra jīrayaḥ sisrate sadhryakpṛthak ||

translations.english: Verily, Indra, you have displayed your first great prowess, when, (propitiated) by the prayer (of the worshipper), you have put forth your withering (vigour) in his presence; and when the congregated enemies (of the gods), hurled down by you in youur chariot, drawn by your horses, fled, scattered.

mantras.sanskrit: अधा यो विश्वा भुवनाभि मज्मनेशानकृत्प्रवया अभ्यवर्धत । आद्रोदसी ज्योतिषा वह्निरातनोत्सीव्यन्तमांसि दुधिता समव्ययत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhā yo viśvā bhuvanābhi majmaneśānakṛtpravayā abhyavardhata | ādrodasī jyotiṣā vahnirātanotsīvyantamāṃsi dudhitā samavyayat ||

translations.english: He indeed, the ancient Indra, making himself by his might sovereign over all worlds, became supreme over (all); and thenceforth sustaining heaven and earth, he overspread them with effulgence, and scattering the malignant glooms, he pervaded (all things).

mantras.sanskrit: स प्राचीनान्पर्वतान्दृंहदोजसाधराचीनमकृणोदपामपः । अधारयत्पृथिवीं विश्वधायसमस्तभ्नान्मायया द्यामवस्रसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa prācīnānparvatāndṛṃhadojasādharācīnamakṛṇodapāmapaḥ | adhārayatpṛthivīṃ viśvadhāyasamastabhnānmāyayā dyāmavasrasaḥ ||

translations.english: By his strength, he fixed the wandering mountains; he directed the downward course of the waters; he upheld the earth, the nurse (of all creatures); and by his craft he stopped the heaven from falling.

mantras.sanskrit: सास्मा अरं बाहुभ्यां यं पिताकृणोद्विश्वस्मादा जनुषो वेदसस्परि । येना पृथिव्यां नि क्रिविं शयध्यै वज्रेण हत्व्यवृणक्तुविष्वणिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sāsmā araṃ bāhubhyāṃ yaṃ pitākṛṇodviśvasmādā januṣo vedasaspari | yenā pṛthivyāṃ ni kriviṃ śayadhyai vajreṇa hatvyavṛṇaktuviṣvaṇiḥ ||

translations.english: Sufficient was he for (the protection of) this (world), which he, its defender, fabricated with his two arms for the sake of all mankind, over whom he was supreme by his wisdom; whereby, (also), he the loud-shouting, having struck Krivi (asura) with the thunderbolt, consigned him to (eternal) slumber on the earth.

mantras.sanskrit: अमाजूरिव पित्रोः सचा सती समानादा सदसस्त्वामिये भगम् । कृधि प्रकेतमुप मास्या भर दद्धि भागं तन्वो येन मामहः ॥
mantras.transliteration: amājūriva pitroḥ sacā satī samānādā sadasastvāmiye bhagam | kṛdhi praketamupa māsyā bhara daddhi bhāgaṃ tanvo yena māmahaḥ ||

translations.english: As a virtuous (maiden), growing old in the same dwelling with her parents, (claims from them her support), so come I to you for wealth; make it conspicuous, measure it, bring it (hither), grant (a sufficient) portion for my bodily sustenance, (such as that) wherewith you honour (your worshippers).

mantras.sanskrit: भोजं त्वामिन्द्र वयं हुवेम ददिष्ट्वमिन्द्रापांसि वाजान् । अविड्ढीन्द्र चित्रया न ऊती कृधि वृषन्निन्द्र वस्यसो नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhojaṃ tvāmindra vayaṃ huvema dadiṣṭvamindrāpāṃsi vājān | aviḍḍhīndra citrayā na ūtī kṛdhi vṛṣannindra vasyaso naḥ ||

translations.english: We invoke you, Indra, the bestower of enjoyment; you grant food, Indra, (in requital of pious) works; protect us, Indra, with manifold protections; Indra, showerer (of benefits), render us affluent.

mantras.sanskrit: नूनं सा ते प्रति वरं जरित्रे दुहीयदिन्द्र दक्षिणा मघोनी । शिक्षा स्तोतृभ्यो माति धग्भगो नो बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nūnaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre duhīyadindra dakṣiṇā maghonī | śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhagbhago no bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

translations.english: That opulent donation which proceeds, Indra, from you, assuredly bestows upon him who praises you, the boon that he desires; grant (it) to (us) your adorers; do not you, who are the object of adoration, disregard our prayers; so that, blessed with worthy descendants, we may glorify you at this sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: प्राता रथो नवो योजि सस्निश्चतुर्युगस्त्रिकशः सप्तरश्मिः । दशारित्रो मनुष्यः स्वर्षाः स इष्टिभिर्मतिभी रंह्यो भूत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: prātā ratho navo yoji sasniścaturyugastrikaśaḥ saptaraśmiḥ | daśāritro manuṣyaḥ svarṣāḥ sa iṣṭibhirmatibhī raṃhyo bhūt ||

translations.english: A laudable and pure sacrifice, has been instrumental tuted at dawn; having four pairs (of stones for bruising the Soma); three tones (of prayer); seven metres, and ten vessels; beneficial to man, conferring heaven, and sanctifiable with solemn rites and praises.

mantras.sanskrit: सास्मा अरं प्रथमं स द्वितीयमुतो तृतीयं मनुषः स होता । अन्यस्या गर्भमन्य ऊ जनन्त सो अन्येभिः सचते जेन्यो वृषा ॥
mantras.transliteration: sāsmā araṃ prathamaṃ sa dvitīyamuto tṛtīyaṃ manuṣaḥ sa hotā | anyasyā garbhamanya ū jananta so anyebhiḥ sacate jenyo vṛṣā ||

translations.english: That (sacrifice) is sufficient for him, (Indra), whether (offered) for the first, the second, or the third time; it is the bearer (of good) to man; other (priests) engender the embryo of a different (rite), but this victorious (sacrifice), the showerer (of benefits) combines with other (ceremonies).

mantras.sanskrit: हरी नु कं रथ इन्द्रस्य योजमायै सूक्तेन वचसा नवेन । मो षु त्वामत्र बहवो हि विप्रा नि रीरमन्यजमानासो अन्ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: harī nu kaṃ ratha indrasya yojamāyai sūktena vacasā navena | mo ṣu tvāmatra bahavo hi viprā ni rīramanyajamānāso anye ||

translations.english: I harness quickly and easily the horses to the car of Indra for its journey, by new and well-recited prayer; many wise (worshippers) are present here; let not other instrumental tutors of sacred rites tempt you (away).

mantras.sanskrit: आ द्वाभ्यां हरिभ्यामिन्द्र याह्या चतुर्भिरा षड्भिर्हूयमानः । आष्टाभिर्दशभिः सोमपेयमयं सुतः सुमख मा मृधस्कः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā dvābhyāṃ haribhyāmindra yāhyā caturbhirā ṣaḍbhirhūyamānaḥ | āṣṭābhirdaśabhiḥ somapeyamayaṃ sutaḥ sumakha mā mṛdhaskaḥ ||

translations.english: Come, Indra, when invoked, with two horses, or with four, or with six, or with eight, or with ten, to drink the Soma; object of worship, Soma is poured out; do not wrong (to the libation).

mantras.sanskrit: आ विंशत्या त्रिंशता याह्यर्वाङा चत्वारिंशता हरिभिर्युजानः । आ पञ्चाशता सुरथेभिरिन्द्रा षष्ट्या सप्तत्या सोमपेयम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā viṃśatyā triṃśatā yāhyarvāṅā catvāriṃśatā haribhiryujānaḥ | ā pañcāśatā surathebhirindrā ṣaṣṭyā saptatyā somapeyam ||

translations.english: Come to our presence, Indra, having harnessed your car with twenty, thirty, or forty horses; or with fifty well-trained steeds; or with sixty or with seventy, Indra, to drink the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: आशीत्या नवत्या याह्यर्वाङा शतेन हरिभिरुह्यमानः । अयं हि ते शुनहोत्रेषु सोम इन्द्र त्वाया परिषिक्तो मदाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: āśītyā navatyā yāhyarvāṅā śatena haribhiruhyamānaḥ | ayaṃ hi te śunahotreṣu soma indra tvāyā pariṣikto madāya ||

translations.english: Come, Indra, to our presence, conveyed by eighty, ninety, or a hundred horses; this Soma has been poured into the goblet, Indra, for your exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: मम ब्रह्मेन्द्र याह्यच्छा विश्वा हरी धुरि धिष्वा रथस्य । पुरुत्रा हि विहव्यो बभूथास्मिञ्छूर सवने मादयस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: mama brahmendra yāhyacchā viśvā harī dhuri dhiṣvā rathasya | purutrā hi vihavyo babhūthāsmiñchūra savane mādayasva ||

translations.english: Come hither, Indra, (having heard) my prayer; yoke your two universal steeds to the pole of your chariot; you have been the object of invocation in many ways by many (worshippers), but now, hero, be exhilarated in this (our) sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: न म इन्द्रेण सख्यं वि योषदस्मभ्यमस्य दक्षिणा दुहीत । उप ज्येष्ठे वरूथे गभस्तौ प्रायेप्राये जिगीवांसः स्याम ॥
mantras.transliteration: na ma indreṇa sakhyaṃ vi yoṣadasmabhyamasya dakṣiṇā duhīta | upa jyeṣṭhe varūthe gabhastau prāyeprāye jigīvāṃsaḥ syāma ||

translations.english: Never may my friendship with Indra be disunited; may his liberality (ever) yield us (our desires); may we be within the excellent defence of (his protecting) arms; may we be victorious in every battle.

mantras.sanskrit: नूनं सा ते प्रति वरं जरित्रे दुहीयदिन्द्र दक्षिणा मघोनी । शिक्षा स्तोतृभ्यो माति धग्भगो नो बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nūnaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre duhīyadindra dakṣiṇā maghonī | śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhagbhago no bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

translations.english: That opulent donation which proceeds, Indra, from you, assuredly bestows upon him who praises you, the boon that he desires; grant (it) to (us) your adorers; do not you, who are the object of adoration, disregard our prayers; so that, blessed with worthy descendants, we may glorify you in this sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: अपाय्यस्यान्धसो मदाय मनीषिणः सुवानस्य प्रयसः । यस्मिन्निन्द्रः प्रदिवि वावृधान ओको दधे ब्रह्मण्यन्तश्च नरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: apāyyasyāndhaso madāya manīṣiṇaḥ suvānasya prayasaḥ | yasminnindraḥ pradivi vāvṛdhāna oko dadhe brahmaṇyantaśca naraḥ ||

translations.english: It has been partaken (by Indra) for his exhilaration, of this agreeable (sacrificial) food, the libation of his devout (worshipper); thriving by which ancient (Soma),he has bestowed a (fitting) dwelling, where the adoring conductors (of the ceremony) abide.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य मन्दानो मध्वो वज्रहस्तोऽहिमिन्द्रो अर्णोवृतं वि वृश्चत् । प्र यद्वयो न स्वसराण्यच्छा प्रयांसि च नदीनां चक्रमन्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya mandāno madhvo vajrahasto'himindro arṇovṛtaṃ vi vṛścat | pra yadvayo na svasarāṇyacchā prayāṃsi ca nadīnāṃ cakramanta ||

translations.english: Exhilarated by the Soma, Indra, armed with the thunderbolt, severed the rain-confining cloud; whereupon the currents of the rivers proceeded (towards the ocean), like birds to their own nests.

mantras.sanskrit: स माहिन इन्द्रो अर्णो अपां प्रैरयदहिहाच्छा समुद्रम् । अजनयत्सूर्यं विदद्गा अक्तुनाह्नां वयुनानि साधत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa māhina indro arṇo apāṃ prairayadahihācchā samudram | ajanayatsūryaṃ vidadgā aktunāhnāṃ vayunāni sādhat ||

translations.english: The adorable Indra, the slayer of Ahi, sent the current of the waters towards the ocean; he genitive rated the sun; he discovered the cattle; he effected the manifestation of the days by light.

mantras.sanskrit: सो अप्रतीनि मनवे पुरूणीन्द्रो दाशद्दाशुषे हन्ति वृत्रम् । सद्यो यो नृभ्यो अतसाय्यो भूत्पस्पृधानेभ्यः सूर्यस्य सातौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: so apratīni manave purūṇīndro dāśaddāśuṣe hanti vṛtram | sadyo yo nṛbhyo atasāyyo bhūtpaspṛdhānebhyaḥ sūryasya sātau ||

translations.english: To the presenter (ofthe libation) Indra gives many unparalleled gifts; he slays Vṛtra; he who was the arbiter among his worshippers when contending for the possession of the Sun.

mantras.sanskrit: स सुन्वत इन्द्रः सूर्यमा देवो रिणङ्मर्त्याय स्तवान् । आ यद्रयिं गुहदवद्यमस्मै भरदंशं नैतशो दशस्यन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa sunvata indraḥ sūryamā devo riṇaṅmartyāya stavān | ā yadrayiṃ guhadavadyamasmai bharadaṃśaṃ naitaśo daśasyan ||

translations.english: The divine Indra, when lauded (by Etaśa), humbled the Sun (in behalf) of the mortal who offered to him the libation; for the munificent Etaśa presented him with mysterious and inestimable riches; as (a father gives) his portion (to a son).

mantras.sanskrit: स रन्धयत्सदिवः सारथये शुष्णमशुषं कुयवं कुत्साय । दिवोदासाय नवतिं च नवेन्द्रः पुरो व्यैरच्छम्बरस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa randhayatsadivaḥ sārathaye śuṣṇamaśuṣaṃ kuyavaṃ kutsāya | divodāsāya navatiṃ ca navendraḥ puro vyairacchambarasya ||

translations.english: The radiant Indra subjected to Kutsa, his charioteer, (the asuras), Śuṣṇa, Aśuṣa, and Kuyava; and, for the sake of Divodāsa, demolished the ninety and nine cities of Śambara.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा त इन्द्रोचथमहेम श्रवस्या न त्मना वाजयन्तः । अश्याम तत्साप्तमाशुषाणा ननमो वधरदेवस्य पीयोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā ta indrocathamahema śravasyā na tmanā vājayantaḥ | aśyāma tatsāptamāśuṣāṇā nanamo vadharadevasya pīyoḥ ||

translations.english: Through desire of food, Indra, we, contributing to your vigour, spontaneously address to you (our) praise; secure of you, may we rely upon your friendship; hurl your thunderbolt against the godless Pīyu.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा ते गृत्समदाः शूर मन्मावस्यवो न वयुनानि तक्षुः । ब्रह्मण्यन्त इन्द्र ते नवीय इषमूर्जं सुक्षितिं सुम्नमश्युः ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā te gṛtsamadāḥ śūra manmāvasyavo na vayunāni takṣuḥ | brahmaṇyanta indra te navīya iṣamūrjaṃ sukṣitiṃ sumnamaśyuḥ ||

translations.english: Thus, hero, have the Gṛtsamadas

mantras.sanskrit: नूनं सा ते प्रति वरं जरित्रे दुहीयदिन्द्र दक्षिणा मघोनी । शिक्षा स्तोतृभ्यो माति धग्भगो नो बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nūnaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre duhīyadindra dakṣiṇā maghonī | śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhagbhago no bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

translations.english: That opulent donation which proceeds, Indra, from you, assuredly bestows upon him who praises you, the boon (that he desires); grant it to us yor adorers; do not you, who are the object of adoration, disregard our prayers; so that, blessed with worthy descendants, we may glorify you in this sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: वयं ते वय इन्द्र विद्धि षु णः प्र भरामहे वाजयुर्न रथम् । विपन्यवो दीध्यतो मनीषा सुम्नमियक्षन्तस्त्वावतो नॄन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayaṃ te vaya indra viddhi ṣu ṇaḥ pra bharāmahe vājayurna ratham | vipanyavo dīdhyato manīṣā sumnamiyakṣantastvāvato nṝn ||

translations.english: We bring to you, Indra, (sacrificial) food, as one desiring food brings his wagon; regard us benevolently when glorifying you, rendering (you) illustrious by (our) praise, and soliciting such guides as you are to felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं न इन्द्र त्वाभिरूती त्वायतो अभिष्टिपासि जनान् । त्वमिनो दाशुषो वरूतेत्थाधीरभि यो नक्षति त्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ na indra tvābhirūtī tvāyato abhiṣṭipāsi janān | tvamino dāśuṣo varūtetthādhīrabhi yo nakṣati tvā ||

translations.english: (Defend us), Indra, with your protections, for you are the defender against enemies of those men who rely upon you; you are the lord of the offerer (of the libation) and the repeller (of foes), and with these acts (protect) him who worships you.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो युवेन्द्रो जोहूत्रः सखा शिवो नरामस्तु पाता । यः शंसन्तं यः शशमानमूती पचन्तं च स्तुवन्तं च प्रणेषत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no yuvendro johūtraḥ sakhā śivo narāmastu pātā | yaḥ śaṃsantaṃ yaḥ śaśamānamūtī pacantaṃ ca stuvantaṃ ca praṇeṣat ||

translations.english: May that young, adorable Indra, ever be the friend, the benefactor, and protector of us, his worshipper; who, with his protection, may conduct (to the object of his worship) him who repeats (to him) prayer and praise, who prepares the oblation, and recites (his) commendations.

mantras.sanskrit: तमु स्तुष इन्द्रं तं गृणीषे यस्मिन्पुरा वावृधुः शाशदुश्च । स वस्वः कामं पीपरदियानो ब्रह्मण्यतो नूतनस्यायोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamu stuṣa indraṃ taṃ gṛṇīṣe yasminpurā vāvṛdhuḥ śāśaduśca | sa vasvaḥ kāmaṃ pīparadiyāno brahmaṇyato nūtanasyāyoḥ ||

translations.english: I laud that Indra, I glorify him, in whom of old (his worshippers) prospered, and overcame (their enemies); may he, when solicited, gratify the desire of wealth of his present pious adorer.

mantras.sanskrit: सो अङ्गिरसामुचथा जुजुष्वान्ब्रह्मा तूतोदिन्द्रो गातुमिष्णन् । मुष्णन्नुषसः सूर्येण स्तवानश्नस्य चिच्छिश्नथत्पूर्व्याणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: so aṅgirasāmucathā jujuṣvānbrahmā tūtodindro gātumiṣṇan | muṣṇannuṣasaḥ sūryeṇa stavānaśnasya cicchiśnathatpūrvyāṇi ||

translations.english: Propitiated by the hymns of the Aṅgirasas, Indra granted their prayer, and directed them on the way (to recover their cattle); carrying off the dawns by the (light of the) sun, he, animated by praise, demolished the ancient cities of Aśna.

mantras.sanskrit: स ह श्रुत इन्द्रो नाम देव ऊर्ध्वो भुवन्मनुषे दस्मतमः । अव प्रियमर्शसानस्य साह्वाञ्छिरो भरद्दासस्य स्वधावान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa ha śruta indro nāma deva ūrdhvo bhuvanmanuṣe dasmatamaḥ | ava priyamarśasānasya sāhvāñchiro bharaddāsasya svadhāvān ||

translations.english: May the renowned and graceful Indra, who is verily divine, be present over men; may he, the vigorous conqueror of foes, cast down the precious head of the malignant Dāsa.

mantras.sanskrit: स वृत्रहेन्द्रः कृष्णयोनीः पुरंदरो दासीरैरयद्वि । अजनयन्मनवे क्षामपश्च सत्रा शंसं यजमानस्य तूतोत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa vṛtrahendraḥ kṛṣṇayonīḥ puraṃdaro dāsīrairayadvi | ajanayanmanave kṣāmapaśca satrā śaṃsaṃ yajamānasya tūtot ||

translations.english: Indra, the slayer of Vṛtra, the destroyer of cities, has scattered the black-sprung servile (hosts); he engendered the earth and the waters for Manu; may he fulfill the entire prayer of the sacrificer.

mantras.sanskrit: तस्मै तवस्यमनु दायि सत्रेन्द्राय देवेभिरर्णसातौ । प्रति यदस्य वज्रं बाह्वोर्धुर्हत्वी दस्यून्पुर आयसीर्नि तारीत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tasmai tavasyamanu dāyi satrendrāya devebhirarṇasātau | prati yadasya vajraṃ bāhvordhurhatvī dasyūnpura āyasīrni tārīt ||

translations.english: Vigour has been perpetually imparted to Indra by his worshippers (with oblations), for the sake of obtaining rain; for which purpose they have plural ced the thunderbolt in his hands, wherewith,having slain the Dasyus, he has destroyed their metal cities.

mantras.sanskrit: नूनं सा ते प्रति वरं जरित्रे दुहीयदिन्द्र दक्षिणा मघोनी । शिक्षा स्तोतृभ्यो माति धग्भगो नो बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nūnaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre duhīyadindra dakṣiṇā maghonī | śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhagbhago no bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

translations.english: That opulent donation which proceeds, Indra, from you, assuredly bestows upon him who praises you, the boon (that he desires); grant it to us yor adorers; do not you, who are the object of adoration, disregard our prayers; so that, blessed with worthy descendants, we may glorify you in this sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वजिते धनजिते स्वर्जिते सत्राजिते नृजित उर्वराजिते । अश्वजिते गोजिते अब्जिते भरेन्द्राय सोमं यजताय हर्यतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvajite dhanajite svarjite satrājite nṛjita urvarājite | aśvajite gojite abjite bharendrāya somaṃ yajatāya haryatam ||

translations.english: Bring the desired Soma to the adorable Indra the lord of all, the lord of wealth, the lord of heaven, the perpetual lord, the lord of man, the lord of earth, the lord of horses, the lord of cattle, the lord of water.

mantras.sanskrit: अभिभुवेऽभिभङ्गाय वन्वतेऽषाळ्हाय सहमानाय वेधसे । तुविग्रये वह्नये दुष्टरीतवे सत्रासाहे नम इन्द्राय वोचत ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhibhuve'bhibhaṅgāya vanvate'ṣāḷhāya sahamānāya vedhase | tuvigraye vahnaye duṣṭarītave satrāsāhe nama indrāya vocata ||

translations.english: Offer adoration to Indra, the overcomer, the destroyer, the munificent, the invincible, the all-enduring, the creator, the all-adorable; the sustainer, the unassailable, the ever-victorious.

mantras.sanskrit: सत्रासाहो जनभक्षो जनंसहश्च्यवनो युध्मो अनु जोषमुक्षितः । वृतंचयः सहुरिर्विक्ष्वारित इन्द्रस्य वोचं प्र कृतानि वीर्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: satrāsāho janabhakṣo janaṃsahaścyavano yudhmo anu joṣamukṣitaḥ | vṛtaṃcayaḥ sahurirvikṣvārita indrasya vocaṃ pra kṛtāni vīryā ||

translations.english: I proclaim the mighty exploits of that Indra, who is, ever victorious; the benefactor of man, the overthrower of (the strong) man, the caster down (of foes), the warrior, who is gratified by our libations, the granter of desires, the subduer of enemies, the refuge of the people.

mantras.sanskrit: अनानुदो वृषभो दोधतो वधो गम्भीर ऋष्वो असमष्टकाव्यः । रध्रचोदः श्नथनो वीळितस्पृथुरिन्द्रः सुयज्ञ उषसः स्वर्जनत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: anānudo vṛṣabho dodhato vadho gambhīra ṛṣvo asamaṣṭakāvyaḥ | radhracodaḥ śnathano vīḷitaspṛthurindraḥ suyajña uṣasaḥ svarjanat ||

translations.english: Unequalled in liberty, the showerer (of benefits), the slayer of the malevolent, profound, mighty, (endowed with) impenetrable sagacity, the dispenser of prosperity, the enfeebler (of foes), firm (of frame), vast (in bulk) the performer of pious acts, Indra has given birth to the light of the morning.

mantras.sanskrit: यज्ञेन गातुमप्तुरो विविद्रिरे धियो हिन्वाना उशिजो मनीषिणः । अभिस्वरा निषदा गा अवस्यव इन्द्रे हिन्वाना द्रविणान्याशत ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajñena gātumapturo vividrire dhiyo hinvānā uśijo manīṣiṇaḥ | abhisvarā niṣadā gā avasyava indre hinvānā draviṇānyāśata ||

translations.english: The wise Uśijas, celebrating his praises, have obtained by their sacrifice, from the sender of water (knowledge) of the path (of their cattle); seeking the aid of Indra, and celebrating his praises, they have acquired, whilst uttering hymns and offering adoration (valuable) treasures.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र श्रेष्ठानि द्रविणानि धेहि चित्तिं दक्षस्य सुभगत्वमस्मे । पोषं रयीणामरिष्टिं तनूनां स्वाद्मानं वाचः सुदिनत्वमह्नाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra śreṣṭhāni draviṇāni dhehi cittiṃ dakṣasya subhagatvamasme | poṣaṃ rayīṇāmariṣṭiṃ tanūnāṃ svādmānaṃ vācaḥ sudinatvamahnām ||

translations.english: Indra, bestow upon us most excellent treasures; (give us) the reputation of ability (to celebrate sacred rites); grant us prosperity, increase of wealth, security of person n, sweetness of speech, and auspiciousness of days.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिकद्रुकेषु महिषो यवाशिरं तुविशुष्मस्तृपत्सोममपिबद्विष्णुना सुतं यथावशत् । स ईं ममाद महि कर्म कर्तवे महामुरुं सैनं सश्चद्देवो देवं सत्यमिन्द्रं सत्य इन्दुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: trikadrukeṣu mahiṣo yavāśiraṃ tuviśuṣmastṛpatsomamapibadviṣṇunā sutaṃ yathāvaśat | sa īṃ mamāda mahi karma kartave mahāmuruṃ sainaṃ saścaddevo devaṃ satyamindraṃ satya induḥ ||

translations.english: The adorable and powerful (Indra), partaking of the Soma, mixed with barley, effused at the Tṛkadruka rites, has drunk with Viṣṇu as much as he wished; the draught has excited that great and mighty Indra to perform great deeds; may that divine (Soma) pervade the divine (Indra), the true Soma (pervade) the true Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: अध त्विषीमाँ अभ्योजसा क्रिविं युधाभवदा रोदसी अपृणदस्य मज्मना प्र वावृधे । अधत्तान्यं जठरे प्रेमरिच्यत सैनं सश्चद्देवो देवं सत्यमिन्द्रं सत्य इन्दुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha tviṣīmā~ abhyojasā kriviṃ yudhābhavadā rodasī apṛṇadasya majmanā pra vāvṛdhe | adhattānyaṃ jaṭhare premaricyata sainaṃ saścaddevo devaṃ satyamindraṃ satya induḥ ||

translations.english: Thereupon, resplendent, he has overcome Krivi in conflict by his prowess;he has filled heaven and earth (with his lustre), and has been invigorated by the efficacy of the draught; one portion he has taken to himself; the other he has distributed (to the gods); may that divine (Soma) pervade the divine (Indra), the true Soma, the true (Indra).

mantras.sanskrit: साकं जातः क्रतुना साकमोजसा ववक्षिथ साकं वृद्धो वीर्यैः सासहिर्मृधो विचर्षणिः । दाता राधः स्तुवते काम्यं वसु सैनं सश्चद्देवो देवं सत्यमिन्द्रं सत्य इन्दुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sākaṃ jātaḥ kratunā sākamojasā vavakṣitha sākaṃ vṛddho vīryaiḥ sāsahirmṛdho vicarṣaṇiḥ | dātā rādhaḥ stuvate kāmyaṃ vasu sainaṃ saścaddevo devaṃ satyamindraṃ satya induḥ ||

translations.english: Cognate with (pious) works and with power, you desire to support (the universe); mighty with heroic (energies); you are the subduer of the malevolent; (you are) the distinguisher (between the doer of good and ill); the giver of the substantial wealth he desires to him who praises you; may the divine (Soma) pervade the divine (Indra), the true Soma, the true (Indra).

mantras.sanskrit: तव त्यन्नर्यं नृतोऽप इन्द्र प्रथमं पूर्व्यं दिवि प्रवाच्यं कृतम् । यद्देवस्य शवसा प्रारिणा असुं रिणन्नपः । भुवद्विश्वमभ्यादेवमोजसा विदादूर्जं शतक्रतुर्विदादिषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava tyannaryaṃ nṛto'pa indra prathamaṃ pūrvyaṃ divi pravācyaṃ kṛtam | yaddevasya śavasā prāriṇā asuṃ riṇannapaḥ | bhuvadviśvamabhyādevamojasā vidādūrjaṃ śatakraturvidādiṣam ||

translations.english: Indra, the delighter (of all), the first act performed by you in ancient time was for the good of man, and deserving of renown in heaven, when, arresting by force the breath of the (enemy) of the gods, you did send down the rain; may Indra prevail by his prowess over all that is godless; may Śatakratu obtain vigour; may he obtain (sacrificial) food.

mantras.sanskrit: गणानां त्वा गणपतिं हवामहे कविं कवीनामुपमश्रवस्तमम् । ज्येष्ठराजं ब्रह्मणां ब्रह्मणस्पत आ नः शृण्वन्नूतिभिः सीद सादनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: gaṇānāṃ tvā gaṇapatiṃ havāmahe kaviṃ kavīnāmupamaśravastamam | jyeṣṭharājaṃ brahmaṇāṃ brahmaṇaspata ā naḥ śṛṇvannūtibhiḥ sīda sādanam ||

translations.english: We invoke the Brahmaṇaspati, chief leaderof the (heavenly) bands; a sage of sage; aboundingbeyondmeasure in (every kind of) food;best lord of prayer; hearing our invocations, come with your protections, and sit down in the chamber of sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: देवाश्चित्ते असुर्य प्रचेतसो बृहस्पते यज्ञियं भागमानशुः । उस्रा इव सूर्यो ज्योतिषा महो विश्वेषामिज्जनिता ब्रह्मणामसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: devāścitte asurya pracetaso bṛhaspate yajñiyaṃ bhāgamānaśuḥ | usrā iva sūryo jyotiṣā maho viśveṣāmijjanitā brahmaṇāmasi ||

translations.english: Bṛhaspati, destroyer of the asuras, through you the intelligent gods have obtained the sacrificialportion; in like manner as the adorable sun genitive rates the (solar) rays by his radiance, so are you the genitive rator of all prayers.

mantras.sanskrit: आ विबाध्या परिरापस्तमांसि च ज्योतिष्मन्तं रथमृतस्य तिष्ठसि । बृहस्पते भीमममित्रदम्भनं रक्षोहणं गोत्रभिदं स्वर्विदम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vibādhyā parirāpastamāṃsi ca jyotiṣmantaṃ rathamṛtasya tiṣṭhasi | bṛhaspate bhīmamamitradambhanaṃ rakṣohaṇaṃ gotrabhidaṃ svarvidam ||

translations.english: Having repelled revilers and (dispersed) the darkness you stand Bṛhaspati, on the radiant chariot of sacrifice, (which is) formidable (to foes), the humiliator of enemies, the destroyer of evil spirits, the cleaver of the clouds, the attainer of heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: सुनीतिभिर्नयसि त्रायसे जनं यस्तुभ्यं दाशान्न तमंहो अश्नवत् । ब्रह्मद्विषस्तपनो मन्युमीरसि बृहस्पते महि तत्ते महित्वनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sunītibhirnayasi trāyase janaṃ yastubhyaṃ dāśānna tamaṃho aśnavat | brahmadviṣastapano manyumīrasi bṛhaspate mahi tatte mahitvanam ||

translations.english: You lead men, Bṛhaspati, by virtuous instrumental uctions; you preserve them (from calamity); sin will never overtake him who presents (offerings) to you; you are the afflicter of him who hates (holy) prayers; you are the punisher of wrath; such is your great mightiness.

mantras.sanskrit: न तमंहो न दुरितं कुतश्चन नारातयस्तितिरुर्न द्वयाविनः । विश्वा इदस्माद्ध्वरसो वि बाधसे यं सुगोपा रक्षसि ब्रह्मणस्पते ॥
mantras.transliteration: na tamaṃho na duritaṃ kutaścana nārātayastitirurna dvayāvinaḥ | viśvā idasmāddhvaraso vi bādhase yaṃ sugopā rakṣasi brahmaṇaspate ||

translations.english: The man whom you, Brahmaṇaspati, a kind protector, defend, neither sorrow nor sin, nor adversaries nor dissemblers ever harm, for you drive away from him all injurious (things).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं नो गोपाः पथिकृद्विचक्षणस्तव व्रताय मतिभिर्जरामहे । बृहस्पते यो नो अभि ह्वरो दधे स्वा तं मर्मर्तु दुच्छुना हरस्वती ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ no gopāḥ pathikṛdvicakṣaṇastava vratāya matibhirjarāmahe | bṛhaspate yo no abhi hvaro dadhe svā taṃ marmartu ducchunā harasvatī ||

translations.english: You, Bṛhaspati, are our protector and the guide of (our) path; (you are) the discerner (of all things); we worship with praises for your adoration; may his own precipitate malice involve him (in destruction) who practises deceit against us.

mantras.sanskrit: उत वा यो नो मर्चयादनागसोऽरातीवा मर्तः सानुको वृकः । बृहस्पते अप तं वर्तया पथः सुगं नो अस्यै देववीतये कृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta vā yo no marcayādanāgaso'rātīvā martaḥ sānuko vṛkaḥ | bṛhaspate apa taṃ vartayā pathaḥ sugaṃ no asyai devavītaye kṛdhi ||

translations.english: Turn aside from (the true) path, Bṛhaspati, the arrogant and savage man who advances to injure us, although unoffending and keep us in the right way for (the completion of) this offering to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रातारं त्वा तनूनां हवामहेऽवस्पर्तरधिवक्तारमस्मयुम् । बृहस्पते देवनिदो नि बर्हय मा दुरेवा उत्तरं सुम्नमुन्नशन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: trātāraṃ tvā tanūnāṃ havāmahe'vaspartaradhivaktāramasmayum | bṛhaspate devanido ni barhaya mā durevā uttaraṃ sumnamunnaśan ||

translations.english: Bṛhaspati, defender (from calamity), we invoke you, the protector of our person ns, the speaker of encouraging words and well disposed towards us; do you destroy the revilers of the gods; let not the malevolent attain supreme felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वया वयं सुवृधा ब्रह्मणस्पते स्पार्हा वसु मनुष्या ददीमहि । या नो दूरे तळितो या अरातयोऽभि सन्ति जम्भया ता अनप्नसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvayā vayaṃ suvṛdhā brahmaṇaspate spārhā vasu manuṣyā dadīmahi | yā no dūre taḷito yā arātayo'bhi santi jambhayā tā anapnasaḥ ||

translations.english: Through you, Brahmaṇaspati, (our) benefactor, may we obtain desirable wealth from men destroy those (our) unrighteous enemies, whether nigh or far off, who prevail against us.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वया वयमुत्तमं धीमहे वयो बृहस्पते पप्रिणा सस्निना युजा । मा नो दुःशंसो अभिदिप्सुरीशत प्र सुशंसा मतिभिस्तारिषीमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvayā vayamuttamaṃ dhīmahe vayo bṛhaspate papriṇā sasninā yujā | mā no duḥśaṃso abhidipsurīśata pra suśaṃsā matibhistāriṣīmahi ||

translations.english: Through you, Bṛhaspati, (who are) the fulfiller of our desires; pure, and associated (with us), we possess excellent food; let not the wicked man who wishes to deceive us be our master; but let us, excelling in (pious) praises, attain (prosperity).

mantras.sanskrit: अनानुदो वृषभो जग्मिराहवं निष्टप्ता शत्रुं पृतनासु सासहिः । असि सत्य ऋणया ब्रह्मणस्पत उग्रस्य चिद्दमिता वीळुहर्षिणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: anānudo vṛṣabho jagmirāhavaṃ niṣṭaptā śatruṃ pṛtanāsu sāsahiḥ | asi satya ṛṇayā brahmaṇaspata ugrasya ciddamitā vīḷuharṣiṇaḥ ||

translations.english: You, Brahmaṇaspati, who have no requiter (of your bounty), who are the showerer (of benefits), the repairer to combat, the consumer of foes, the victor in battles, you are true, the discharger of debts, the humiliator of the fierce and of the exulting.

mantras.sanskrit: अदेवेन मनसा यो रिषण्यति शासामुग्रो मन्यमानो जिघांसति । बृहस्पते मा प्रणक्तस्य नो वधो नि कर्म मन्युं दुरेवस्य शर्धतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adevena manasā yo riṣaṇyati śāsāmugro manyamāno jighāṃsati | bṛhaspate mā praṇaktasya no vadho ni karma manyuṃ durevasya śardhataḥ ||

translations.english: Let not, Bṛhaspati, the murderous (weapon) of that man reach us, who, with unrighteous mind, seeks to harm us; who, fierce and arrogant, designs to kill (your) worshippers; may we baffle the wrath of the strong evil-doer].

mantras.sanskrit: भरेषु हव्यो नमसोपसद्यो गन्ता वाजेषु सनिता धनंधनम् । विश्वा इदर्यो अभिदिप्स्वो मृधो बृहस्पतिर्वि ववर्हा रथाँ इव ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhareṣu havyo namasopasadyo gantā vājeṣu sanitā dhanaṃdhanam | viśvā idaryo abhidipsvo mṛdho bṛhaspatirvi vavarhā rathā~ iva ||

translations.english: Bṛhaspati is to be invoked in battles; he is to be approached with reverence; he who moves amidst combats, the distributor of repeated wealth; the lord Bṛhaspati has verily overturned all the assailing malignant (hosts), like chariots (overturned in battle).

mantras.sanskrit: तेजिष्ठया तपनी रक्षसस्तप ये त्वा निदे दधिरे दृष्टवीर्यम् । आविस्तत्कृष्व यदसत्त उक्थ्यं बृहस्पते वि परिरापो अर्दय ॥
mantras.transliteration: tejiṣṭhayā tapanī rakṣasastapa ye tvā nide dadhire dṛṣṭavīryam | āvistatkṛṣva yadasatta ukthyaṃ bṛhaspate vi parirāpo ardaya ||

translations.english: Consume with your brightest (weapon) the rākṣasas, who have held your witnessed prowess in disdain; manifest, Bṛhaspati, your glorified (vigour), such as it was (of old), and destroy those who speak against you.

mantras.sanskrit: बृहस्पते अति यदर्यो अर्हाद्द्युमद्विभाति क्रतुमज्जनेषु । यद्दीदयच्छवस ऋतप्रजात तदस्मासु द्रविणं धेहि चित्रम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhaspate ati yadaryo arhāddyumadvibhāti kratumajjaneṣu | yaddīdayacchavasa ṛtaprajāta tadasmāsu draviṇaṃ dhehi citram ||

translations.english: Bṛhaspati, born of truth, grant us that wonderful treasure, wherewith the pious man may worship exceedingly; that (wealth) which shines amongst men; which is endowed with lustre, (is) the means of (performing holy) rites, and invogirates (its possessor) with strength.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नः स्तेनेभ्यो ये अभि द्रुहस्पदे निरामिणो रिपवोऽन्नेषु जागृधुः । आ देवानामोहते वि व्रयो हृदि बृहस्पते न परः साम्नो विदुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā naḥ stenebhyo ye abhi druhaspade nirāmiṇo ripavo'nneṣu jāgṛdhuḥ | ā devānāmohate vi vrayo hṛdi bṛhaspate na paraḥ sāmno viduḥ ||

translations.english: Deliver us not to the thieves, the enemies delighting in violence, who seize ever upon the food (of others); those who cherish in their hearts the abandonment (of the gods); (they), Bṛhaspati, who do not know the extent of (your) power (against evil spirits).

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वेभ्यो हि त्वा भुवनेभ्यस्परि त्वष्टाजनत्साम्नःसाम्नः कविः । स ऋणचिदृणया ब्रह्मणस्पतिर्द्रुहो हन्ता मह ऋतस्य धर्तरि ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvebhyo hi tvā bhuvanebhyaspari tvaṣṭājanatsāmnaḥsāmnaḥ kaviḥ | sa ṛṇacidṛṇayā brahmaṇaspatirdruho hantā maha ṛtasya dhartari ||

translations.english: Tvaṣṭā engendered you (chief) amongst all beings, (whence) you are the reciter of many a holy hymn: Brahmaṇaspati acknowledges a debt to the performer of a sacred rite; he is the acquitter (of the debt), and the destoyer of the oppressor.

mantras.sanskrit: तव श्रिये व्यजिहीत पर्वतो गवां गोत्रमुदसृजो यदङ्गिरः । इन्द्रेण युजा तमसा परीवृतं बृहस्पते निरपामौब्जो अर्णवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava śriye vyajihīta parvato gavāṃ gotramudasṛjo yadaṅgiraḥ | indreṇa yujā tamasā parīvṛtaṃ bṛhaspate nirapāmaubjo arṇavam ||

translations.english: When Bṛhaspati, descendant of Aṅgiras, for your glory, Parvata had concealed the herd o fkine, you did set them free, and with thine associate, Indra, did send down the ocean of water which had been enveloped by darkness.

mantras.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणस्पते त्वमस्य यन्ता सूक्तस्य बोधि तनयं च जिन्व । विश्वं तद्भद्रं यदवन्ति देवा बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: brahmaṇaspate tvamasya yantā sūktasya bodhi tanayaṃ ca jinva | viśvaṃ tadbhadraṃ yadavanti devā bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

translations.english: Brahmaṇaspati, who are the regulator of this (world), understand (the purport) of (our) hymn, and grant us posterity; for all is prosperous that the gods protect; (and therefore) may we blessed with excellent descendants, glorify you at this sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: सेमामविड्ढि प्रभृतिं य ईशिषेऽया विधेम नवया महा गिरा । यथा नो मीढ्वान्त्स्तवते सखा तव बृहस्पते सीषधः सोत नो मतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: semāmaviḍḍhi prabhṛtiṃ ya īśiṣe'yā vidhema navayā mahā girā | yathā no mīḍhvāntstavate sakhā tava bṛhaspate sīṣadhaḥ sota no matim ||

translations.english: Inasmuch, Bṛhaspati, as you rule (over all), accept this our propitiation; we worship you with this new and solemn hymn; since this your friend, our benefactor, celebrates you, do you fulfil our desires.

mantras.sanskrit: यो नन्त्वान्यनमन्न्योजसोतादर्दर्मन्युना शम्बराणि वि । प्राच्यावयदच्युता ब्रह्मणस्पतिरा चाविशद्वसुमन्तं वि पर्वतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo nantvānyanamannyojasotādardarmanyunā śambarāṇi vi | prācyāvayadacyutā brahmaṇaspatirā cāviśadvasumantaṃ vi parvatam ||

translations.english: (You are) that Brahmaṇaspati who, by his might, has humbled those who deserved humiliation; who in his wrath rent the clouds asunder; who sent down the undescending (waters); and made way into the mountain (cave), opulent (in cattle).

mantras.sanskrit: तद्देवानां देवतमाय कर्त्वमश्रथ्नन्दृळ्हाव्रदन्त वीळिता । उद्गा आजदभिनद्ब्रह्मणा वलमगूहत्तमो व्यचक्षयत्स्वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taddevānāṃ devatamāya kartvamaśrathnandṛḷhāvradanta vīḷitā | udgā ājadabhinadbrahmaṇā valamagūhattamo vyacakṣayatsvaḥ ||

translations.english: That was the exploit, (performed) for the most divine of the gods, by which the firm (shut gates) were thrown open, the strong (barriers) were relaxed, (by him) who set the cows at liberty; who, by the (force of the) sacred prayer, destroyed Bala who dispersed the darkness and displayed the light.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्मास्यमवतं ब्रह्मणस्पतिर्मधुधारमभि यमोजसातृणत् । तमेव विश्वे पपिरे स्वर्दृशो बहु साकं सिसिचुरुत्समुद्रिणम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśmāsyamavataṃ brahmaṇaspatirmadhudhāramabhi yamojasātṛṇat | tameva viśve papire svardṛśo bahu sākaṃ sisicurutsamudriṇam ||

translations.english: That stone-like, solid, down-hanging, water-laden (cloud), which Brahmaṇaspati has with his strength divided, the universal solar rays have drunk up; but they have again shed together the showering and water-spreading (rain).

mantras.sanskrit: सना ता का चिद्भुवना भवीत्वा माद्भिः शरद्भिर्दुरो वरन्त वः । अयतन्ता चरतो अन्यदन्यदिद्या चकार वयुना ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sanā tā kā cidbhuvanā bhavītvā mādbhiḥ śaradbhirduro varanta vaḥ | ayatantā carato anyadanyadidyā cakāra vayunā brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||

translations.english: For you, (worshipper), the constant and manifold (bounties of Brahmaṇaspati), through months and through years, set open the gates of the future rains, and he has appointed those results of prayer, which the two regions mutually and without effort provide.

mantras.sanskrit: अभिनक्षन्तो अभि ये तमानशुर्निधिं पणीनां परमं गुहा हितम् । ते विद्वांसः प्रतिचक्ष्यानृता पुनर्यत उ आयन्तदुदीयुराविशम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhinakṣanto abhi ye tamānaśurnidhiṃ paṇīnāṃ paramaṃ guhā hitam | te vidvāṃsaḥ praticakṣyānṛtā punaryata u āyantadudīyurāviśam ||

translations.english: Those sages, who searching on every side, discovered the precious treasure (of cattle) hidden in the cave of the Paṇis, having seen through the false (illusions of the asura), and again coming (thither) forced an entrance.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतावानः प्रतिचक्ष्यानृता पुनरात आ तस्थुः कवयो महस्पथः । ते बाहुभ्यां धमितमग्निमश्मनि नकिः षो अस्त्यरणो जहुर्हि तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtāvānaḥ praticakṣyānṛtā punarāta ā tasthuḥ kavayo mahaspathaḥ | te bāhubhyāṃ dhamitamagnimaśmani nakiḥ ṣo astyaraṇo jahurhi tam ||

translations.english: Those sages, eminent for truth, having seen through the false (illusions of the asura), again pursued the main road thither, and with their hands cast against the rock the destructive fire, which, till then, was not there.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतज्येन क्षिप्रेण ब्रह्मणस्पतिर्यत्र वष्टि प्र तदश्नोति धन्वना । तस्य साध्वीरिषवो याभिरस्यति नृचक्षसो दृशये कर्णयोनयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtajyena kṣipreṇa brahmaṇaspatiryatra vaṣṭi pra tadaśnoti dhanvanā | tasya sādhvīriṣavo yābhirasyati nṛcakṣaso dṛśaye karṇayonayaḥ ||

translations.english: Whatever Brahmaṇaspati aims at with the truth-strung quick-darting bow, that (mark) he surely attains; holy are its arrows with which he shoots (intended) for the eyes of men, and having their abode in the ear.

mantras.sanskrit: स संनयः स विनयः पुरोहितः स सुष्टुतः स युधि ब्रह्मणस्पतिः । चाक्ष्मो यद्वाजं भरते मती धनादित्सूर्यस्तपति तप्यतुर्वृथा ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa saṃnayaḥ sa vinayaḥ purohitaḥ sa suṣṭutaḥ sa yudhi brahmaṇaspatiḥ | cākṣmo yadvājaṃ bharate matī dhanāditsūryastapati tapyaturvṛthā ||

translations.english: He, Brahmaṇaspati, is the aggregator and subjugator (of objects); the family priest (of the gods) and the renowned in battle; the beholder (of all), who bestows food and desired treasures, whence the radiant sun shines without exertion.

mantras.sanskrit: विभु प्रभु प्रथमं मेहनावतो बृहस्पतेः सुविदत्राणि राध्या । इमा सातानि वेन्यस्य वाजिनो येन जना उभये भुञ्जते विशः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vibhu prabhu prathamaṃ mehanāvato bṛhaspateḥ suvidatrāṇi rādhyā | imā sātāni venyasya vājino yena janā ubhaye bhuñjate viśaḥ ||

translations.english: Expansive, vast, and excellent riches, are the attainable (bounties) of Bṛhaspati, the sender of the rain; these are the gifts of the adorable giver of food, whereby both (descriptions of worshippers) entering here enjoy (abundance).

mantras.sanskrit: योऽवरे वृजने विश्वथा विभुर्महामु रण्वः शवसा ववक्षिथ । स देवो देवान्प्रति पप्रथे पृथु विश्वेदु ता परिभूर्ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo'vare vṛjane viśvathā vibhurmahāmu raṇvaḥ śavasā vavakṣitha | sa devo devānprati paprathe pṛthu viśvedu tā paribhūrbrahmaṇaspatiḥ ||

translations.english: He, who is all-pervading and delighting, is willing to sustain by his strength the noble, worshipper, as well as one who is in low distress; greatly is that Brahmaṇaspati renowned amongst the gods, and therefore is he verily supreme above all (beings).

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वं सत्यं मघवाना युवोरिदापश्चन प्र मिनन्ति व्रतं वाम् । अच्छेन्द्राब्रह्मणस्पती हविर्नोऽन्नं युजेव वाजिना जिगातम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvaṃ satyaṃ maghavānā yuvoridāpaścana pra minanti vrataṃ vām | acchendrābrahmaṇaspatī havirno'nnaṃ yujeva vājinā jigātam ||

translations.english: All truth, lords of wealth, (Indra and Brahmaṇaspati), is (inherent) in you both; the waters injure not your rites; come to our presence (to receive) our oblations, like a pair of steeds (to receive) their provender.

mantras.sanskrit: उताशिष्ठा अनु शृण्वन्ति वह्नयः सभेयो विप्रो भरते मती धना । वीळुद्वेषा अनु वश ऋणमाददिः स ह वाजी समिथे ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: utāśiṣṭhā anu śṛṇvanti vahnayaḥ sabheyo vipro bharate matī dhanā | vīḷudveṣā anu vaśa ṛṇamādadiḥ sa ha vājī samithe brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||

translations.english: The very swift horses (of Brahmaṇaspati) listen to (our invocation); the priest of the assembly offers with praise the (sacrificial) wealth; may Brahmaṇaspati, the hater of the oppressor, accept (the payment of) the debt, agreeably to his plural asure; may he be the accepter of the (sacrificial) food presented at this ceremony.

mantras.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणस्पतेरभवद्यथावशं सत्यो मन्युर्महि कर्मा करिष्यतः । यो गा उदाजत्स दिवे वि चाभजन्महीव रीतिः शवसासरत्पृथक् ॥
mantras.transliteration: brahmaṇaspaterabhavadyathāvaśaṃ satyo manyurmahi karmā kariṣyataḥ | yo gā udājatsa dive vi cābhajanmahīva rītiḥ śavasāsaratpṛthak ||

translations.english: The purpose of Brahmaṇaspati, engaging in a great work, has been successful, according to his wish; for he it was who recovered (the stolen) cattle for (the dwellers in) heaven; and distrubuted them; so that of their own power they took different directions, like (the branches of) a mighty river.

mantras.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणस्पते सुयमस्य विश्वहा रायः स्याम रथ्यो वयस्वतः । वीरेषु वीराँ उप पृङ्धि नस्त्वं यदीशानो ब्रह्मणा वेषि मे हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: brahmaṇaspate suyamasya viśvahā rāyaḥ syāma rathyo vayasvataḥ | vīreṣu vīrā~ upa pṛṅdhi nastvaṃ yadīśāno brahmaṇā veṣi me havam ||

translations.english: May we, Brahmaṇaspati, be daily in the possession of well-regulated and food-supplying wealth; do you add for us posterity to posterity, since you, who are the ruler (of all) accept my invocation with (offered sacrificial) food.

mantras.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणस्पते त्वमस्य यन्ता सूक्तस्य बोधि तनयं च जिन्व । विश्वं तद्भद्रं यदवन्ति देवा बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: brahmaṇaspate tvamasya yantā sūktasya bodhi tanayaṃ ca jinva | viśvaṃ tadbhadraṃ yadavanti devā bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

translations.english: Brahmaṇaspati, who are the regulator of this (world), understand (the purport of) our hymn, and grant us posterity; for all is prosperous that the gods protect; (and therefore) may we, blessed with excellent descendants, glorify you at this sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्धानो अग्निं वनवद्वनुष्यतः कृतब्रह्मा शूशुवद्रातहव्य इत् । जातेन जातमति स प्र सर्सृते यंयं युजं कृणुते ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indhāno agniṃ vanavadvanuṣyataḥ kṛtabrahmā śūśuvadrātahavya it | jātena jātamati sa pra sarsṛte yaṃyaṃ yujaṃ kṛṇute brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||

translations.english: Kindling the fire, may (the worshipper) overcome the malevolent (disturbers of the rite); may he, repeating prayers, and laden with oblations, prosper; he whom Brahmaṇaspati makes his associates, lives to behold the son of his son.

mantras.sanskrit: वीरेभिर्वीरान्वनवद्वनुष्यतो गोभी रयिं पप्रथद्बोधति त्मना । तोकं च तस्य तनयं च वर्धते यंयं युजं कृणुते ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vīrebhirvīrānvanavadvanuṣyato gobhī rayiṃ paprathadbodhati tmanā | tokaṃ ca tasya tanayaṃ ca vardhate yaṃyaṃ yujaṃ kṛṇute brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||

translations.english: (Surrounded) by his descendants, may he surpas the malevolent descendants (of his adversaries), for he is famed for great wealth of cattle, and understands (all things) of himself; his sons and grandsons prosper whom Brahmaṇaspati makes his associate.

mantras.sanskrit: सिन्धुर्न क्षोदः शिमीवाँ ऋघायतो वृषेव वध्रीँरभि वष्ट्योजसा । अग्नेरिव प्रसितिर्नाह वर्तवे यंयं युजं कृणुते ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sindhurna kṣodaḥ śimīvā~ ṛghāyato vṛṣeva vadhrī~rabhi vaṣṭyojasā | agneriva prasitirnāha vartave yaṃyaṃ yujaṃ kṛṇute brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||

translations.english: As a river (washes away) its banks, so the devout worshipper, (of Brahmaṇaspati), overpowers his enemies by his strength, as a bull (overcomes) an ox; like the spreading flame of fire, it is impossible to stop him, whom Brahmaṇaspati makes his associate.

mantras.sanskrit: तस्मा अर्षन्ति दिव्या असश्चतः स सत्वभिः प्रथमो गोषु गच्छति । अनिभृष्टतविषिर्हन्त्योजसा यंयं युजं कृणुते ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tasmā arṣanti divyā asaścataḥ sa satvabhiḥ prathamo goṣu gacchati | anibhṛṣṭataviṣirhantyojasā yaṃyaṃ yujaṃ kṛṇute brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||

translations.english: For him, the unobstructed rains of heaven descend; first among the devout, he acqires (wealth) in cattle; of irresistible vigour, he destroys his enemies by his strength, whom Brahmaṇaspati makes his associate.

mantras.sanskrit: तस्मा इद्विश्वे धुनयन्त सिन्धवोऽच्छिद्रा शर्म दधिरे पुरूणि । देवानां सुम्ने सुभगः स एधते यंयं युजं कृणुते ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tasmā idviśve dhunayanta sindhavo'cchidrā śarma dadhire purūṇi | devānāṃ sumne subhagaḥ sa edhate yaṃyaṃ yujaṃ kṛṇute brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||

translations.english: Verily, for him all rivers flow; him do uninterrupted and numerous plural asures await; blessed with the felicity of the gods, he ever prospers, whom Brahmaṇaspati makes his associate.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋजुरिच्छंसो वनवद्वनुष्यतो देवयन्निददेवयन्तमभ्यसत् । सुप्रावीरिद्वनवत्पृत्सु दुष्टरं यज्वेदयज्योर्वि भजाति भोजनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛjuricchaṃso vanavadvanuṣyato devayannidadevayantamabhyasat | suprāvīridvanavatpṛtsu duṣṭaraṃ yajvedayajyorvi bhajāti bhojanam ||

translations.english: May the sincere praiser (of Brahmaṇaspati) verily overcome (his) enemies; may the worshipper of the gods overcome him assuredly who does not reverence them; may the propitiatir (of Brahmaṇaspati) overcome him who is difficult to be overcome in battles; may he who offers sacrifice appropriate the food of him who does not sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: यजस्व वीर प्र विहि मनायतो भद्रं मनः कृणुष्व वृत्रतूर्ये । हविष्कृणुष्व सुभगो यथाससि ब्रह्मणस्पतेरव आ वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajasva vīra pra vihi manāyato bhadraṃ manaḥ kṛṇuṣva vṛtratūrye | haviṣkṛṇuṣva subhago yathāsasi brahmaṇaspaterava ā vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: Offer worship, O man, (to Brahmaṇaspati); proceed resolutely against those who are meditating (hostility); keep your mind firm in contending against foes; offer oblations whereby you may be prosperous; we also solicit the protection of Brahmaṇaspati.

mantras.sanskrit: स इज्जनेन स विशा स जन्मना स पुत्रैर्वाजं भरते धना नृभिः । देवानां यः पितरमाविवासति श्रद्धामना हविषा ब्रह्मणस्पतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa ijjanena sa viśā sa janmanā sa putrairvājaṃ bharate dhanā nṛbhiḥ | devānāṃ yaḥ pitaramāvivāsati śraddhāmanā haviṣā brahmaṇaspatim ||

translations.english: He who with a believing mind worships Brahmaṇaspati, the father of the gods, with oblations, he verily receives food, together with his sons, his kindred, his descendants, his people, and (obtains) riches together with (all) men.

mantras.sanskrit: यो अस्मै हव्यैर्घृतवद्भिरविधत्प्र तं प्राचा नयति ब्रह्मणस्पतिः । उरुष्यतीमंहसो रक्षती रिष्ॐऽहोश्चिदस्मा उरुचक्रिरद्भुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo asmai havyairghṛtavadbhiravidhatpra taṃ prācā nayati brahmaṇaspatiḥ | uruṣyatīmaṃhaso rakṣatī riṣoṃ'hościdasmā urucakriradbhutaḥ ||

translations.english: Brahmaṇaspati leads by a straight path (to his reward), the worshipper who propitiates him with oblations of butter; he guards him against sin; he protects him from foes and from distress; and wonderful (in might) confers upon him many (favours).

mantras.sanskrit: इमा गिर आदित्येभ्यो घृतस्नूः सनाद्राजभ्यो जुह्वा जुहोमि । शृणोतु मित्रो अर्यमा भगो नस्तुविजातो वरुणो दक्षो अंशः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imā gira ādityebhyo ghṛtasnūḥ sanādrājabhyo juhvā juhomi | śṛṇotu mitro aryamā bhago nastuvijāto varuṇo dakṣo aṃśaḥ ||

translations.english: I present continually, with the ladle (of speech), these oblation-dropping hymns to the royal Ādityas; may Mitra, Aryaman, Bhaga, the multi-present Varuṇa, the powerful Aṃśa, hear us.

mantras.sanskrit: इमं स्तोमं सक्रतवो मे अद्य मित्रो अर्यमा वरुणो जुषन्त । आदित्यासः शुचयो धारपूता अवृजिना अनवद्या अरिष्टाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imaṃ stomaṃ sakratavo me adya mitro aryamā varuṇo juṣanta | ādityāsaḥ śucayo dhārapūtā avṛjinā anavadyā ariṣṭāḥ ||

translations.english: May those of equal exploits, Mitra, Aryaman, Varuṇa, be plural ased today by this my praise; they who are Ādityas, luminous, purified by showers, who abandon none (that worship them), who are irreproachable unassailable.

mantras.sanskrit: त आदित्यास उरवो गभीरा अदब्धासो दिप्सन्तो भूर्यक्षाः । अन्तः पश्यन्ति वृजिनोत साधु सर्वं राजभ्यः परमा चिदन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ta ādityāsa uravo gabhīrā adabdhāso dipsanto bhūryakṣāḥ | antaḥ paśyanti vṛjinota sādhu sarvaṃ rājabhyaḥ paramā cidanti ||

translations.english: Those Ādityas, mighty, profound, unsubdued, subduing, many-eyed, behold the innermost (thoughts of men), whether wicked or virtuous, whether far from or nigh to those royal (deities).

mantras.sanskrit: धारयन्त आदित्यासो जगत्स्था देवा विश्वस्य भुवनस्य गोपाः । दीर्घाधियो रक्षमाणा असुर्यमृतावानश्चयमाना ऋणानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhārayanta ādityāso jagatsthā devā viśvasya bhuvanasya gopāḥ | dīrghādhiyo rakṣamāṇā asuryamṛtāvānaścayamānā ṛṇāni ||

translations.english: The divine Ādityas are the upholders (of all things), moveable or immoveable; the protectors of the universe; the provident in acts; the collectors of rain; the possessors of veracity; the acquitters of our debts.

mantras.sanskrit: विद्यामादित्या अवसो वो अस्य यदर्यमन्भय आ चिन्मयोभु । युष्माकं मित्रावरुणा प्रणीतौ परि श्वभ्रेव दुरितानि वृज्याम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vidyāmādityā avaso vo asya yadaryamanbhaya ā cinmayobhu | yuṣmākaṃ mitrāvaruṇā praṇītau pari śvabhreva duritāni vṛjyām ||

translations.english: May I be conscious, Ādityas, of this your protection, the cause of happiness (and security) in danger; Aryaman, Mitra and Varuṇa, may I, through your guidance, escape the sins which are like pitfalls (in my path).

mantras.sanskrit: सुगो हि वो अर्यमन्मित्र पन्था अनृक्षरो वरुण साधुरस्ति । तेनादित्या अधि वोचता नो यच्छता नो दुष्परिहन्तु शर्म ॥
mantras.transliteration: sugo hi vo aryamanmitra panthā anṛkṣaro varuṇa sādhurasti | tenādityā adhi vocatā no yacchatā no duṣparihantu śarma ||

translations.english: Aryaman, Mitra and Varuṇa, easy is the path (you show us), and free from thorns, and plural asant; therefore, Ādityas (lead us) by (it); speak to us favourably, and grant us happiness difficult to be disturbed.

mantras.sanskrit: पिपर्तु नो अदिती राजपुत्राति द्वेषांस्यर्यमा सुगेभिः । बृहन्मित्रस्य वरुणस्य शर्मोप स्याम पुरुवीरा अरिष्टाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pipartu no aditī rājaputrāti dveṣāṃsyaryamā sugebhiḥ | bṛhanmitrasya varuṇasya śarmopa syāma puruvīrā ariṣṭāḥ ||

translations.english: May Aditi, the mother of royal song, plural ce us beyond the malice (of our enemies); may Aryaman lead us by easy paths, and may we, blessed with many descendants, and safe from harm, attain the great happiness of  Mitra and Varuṇa.

mantras.sanskrit: तिस्रो भूमीर्धारयन्त्रीँरुत द्यून्त्रीणि व्रता विदथे अन्तरेषाम् । ऋतेनादित्या महि वो महित्वं तदर्यमन्वरुण मित्र चारु ॥
mantras.transliteration: tisro bhūmīrdhārayantrī~ruta dyūntrīṇi vratā vidathe antareṣām | ṛtenādityā mahi vo mahitvaṃ tadaryamanvaruṇa mitra cāru ||

translations.english: They uphold the three worlds, the three heavens, and in their sacrifices three ceremonies (are comprised); by truth, Ādityas, has your great might (been produced), such as is most excellent; Aryaman, Mitra and Varuṇa. (They uphold the three worlds: tisro bhumir dhārayan: bhūmi  = loka, world, or sphere; earth, firmament, and heaven which the Ādityas support by supplying them with rain; the three heavens: trīḥ dyūn, the three luminous objects, dīptan; the three lokas above the sky: mahar, jana, satya; or the three luminous deities: agni, vāyu and sūrya; three ceremonies: trīṇi vratā vidathe antar eṣām = lit. the three ceremonies in the sacrifice, in the midst of them; the three daily ceremonials are essentially one worship of the Ādityas; alternative meaning:in the midst of those worlds, there are three acts intended especially as the acts of the Ādityas, the absorption, retention, and redistribution of dew on rain].

mantras.sanskrit: त्री रोचना दिव्या धारयन्त हिरण्ययाः शुचयो धारपूताः । अस्वप्नजो अनिमिषा अदब्धा उरुशंसा ऋजवे मर्त्याय ॥
mantras.transliteration: trī rocanā divyā dhārayanta hiraṇyayāḥ śucayo dhārapūtāḥ | asvapnajo animiṣā adabdhā uruśaṃsā ṛjave martyāya ||

translations.english: The Ādityas, decorated with golden ornaments, brilliant, purified by showers, who never slumber, nor close their eyelids, who are unassailable, and praised by many, uphold the three bright heavenly regions for the sake of the upright man.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं विश्वेषां वरुणासि राजा ये च देवा असुर ये च मर्ताः । शतं नो रास्व शरदो विचक्षेऽश्यामायूंषि सुधितानि पूर्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ viśveṣāṃ varuṇāsi rājā ye ca devā asura ye ca martāḥ | śataṃ no rāsva śarado vicakṣe'śyāmāyūṃṣi sudhitāni pūrvā ||

translations.english: Varuṇa, destroyer of foes, you are the sovereign over all, whether they be gods or mortals; grant to us to behold a hundred years, and that we may enjoy lives such as were enjoyed by ancient (sages).

mantras.sanskrit: न दक्षिणा वि चिकिते न सव्या न प्राचीनमादित्या नोत पश्चा । पाक्या चिद्वसवो धीर्या चिद्युष्मानीतो अभयं ज्योतिरश्याम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: na dakṣiṇā vi cikite na savyā na prācīnamādityā nota paścā | pākyā cidvasavo dhīryā cidyuṣmānīto abhayaṃ jyotiraśyām ||

translations.english: Neither is the right hand known to us, Ādityas, nor is the left; neither is that which is in front, nor that which is behind, (discerned by me); givers of dwellings, may I, who an immature (in knowledge), and timid (in spirit), obtain, when guided by you, the light that is free from fear.

mantras.sanskrit: यो राजभ्य ऋतनिभ्यो ददाश यं वर्धयन्ति पुष्टयश्च नित्याः । स रेवान्याति प्रथमो रथेन वसुदावा विदथेषु प्रशस्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo rājabhya ṛtanibhyo dadāśa yaṃ vardhayanti puṣṭayaśca nityāḥ | sa revānyāti prathamo rathena vasudāvā vidatheṣu praśastaḥ ||

translations.english: He who presents offerings to the royal and true (Ādityas); he whom their constant favours exalt; he proceeds, wealthy, renowned, munificent, and honoured, to sacrifices, in his chariot.

mantras.sanskrit: शुचिरपः सूयवसा अदब्ध उप क्षेति वृद्धवयाः सुवीरः । नकिष्टं घ्नन्त्यन्तितो न दूराद्य आदित्यानां भवति प्रणीतौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: śucirapaḥ sūyavasā adabdha upa kṣeti vṛddhavayāḥ suvīraḥ | nakiṣṭaṃ ghnantyantito na dūrādya ādityānāṃ bhavati praṇītau ||

translations.english: Pure, unmolested, possessing (abundant) food and virtuous descendants, he dwells amidst fertilizing waters; no one, whether nigh or afar, harms him who is (safe) in the good guidance of the Ādityas.

mantras.sanskrit: अदिते मित्र वरुणोत मृळ यद्वो वयं चकृमा कच्चिदागः । उर्वश्यामभयं ज्योतिरिन्द्र मा नो दीर्घा अभि नशन्तमिस्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adite mitra varuṇota mṛḷa yadvo vayaṃ cakṛmā kaccidāgaḥ | urvaśyāmabhayaṃ jyotirindra mā no dīrghā abhi naśantamisrāḥ ||

translations.english: Aditi, Mitra, Varuṇa, have pity upon us, even though we may have committed some offence against you; may I obtain, Indra, that great light which is free from peril; let not the protracted glooms (of night) envelop us.

mantras.sanskrit: उभे अस्मै पीपयतः समीची दिवो वृष्टिं सुभगो नाम पुष्यन् । उभा क्षयावाजयन्याति पृत्सूभावर्धौ भवतः साधू अस्मै ॥
mantras.transliteration: ubhe asmai pīpayataḥ samīcī divo vṛṣṭiṃ subhago nāma puṣyan | ubhā kṣayāvājayanyāti pṛtsūbhāvardhau bhavataḥ sādhū asmai ||

translations.english: Both (heaven and earth) combined, cherish him (whom the Ādityas protect); verily prosperous, he thrives, with the rain of heaven; victorious in battles, (he defends) both his own dwelling (and assails) that of his foe; to him both portions (of creation) are propitious.

mantras.sanskrit: या वो माया अभिद्रुहे यजत्राः पाशा आदित्या रिपवे विचृत्ताः । अश्वीव ताँ अति येषं रथेनारिष्टा उरावा शर्मन्त्स्याम ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā vo māyā abhidruhe yajatrāḥ pāśā ādityā ripave vicṛttāḥ | aśvīva tā~ ati yeṣaṃ rathenāriṣṭā urāvā śarmantsyāma ||

translations.english: Adorable Ādityas, may I pass (safe) in your car from the illusions which (you devise) for the malignant, the snares which are spread for your foes, (in like manner) as a horseman (passes over a road); and thus may we abide secure in infinite felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: माहं मघोनो वरुण प्रियस्य भूरिदाव्न आ विदं शूनमापेः । मा रायो राजन्त्सुयमादव स्थां बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: māhaṃ maghono varuṇa priyasya bhūridāvna ā vidaṃ śūnamāpeḥ | mā rāyo rājantsuyamādava sthāṃ bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

translations.english: May I never (have to) represent, Varuṇa, the destittution of a (once) opulent, dear, and munificent kinsman; may I never, royal Varuṇa, be devoid of well-regulated riches; (and) may we, blessed with excellent descendants, worthily glorify you at this sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: इदं कवेरादित्यस्य स्वराजो विश्वानि सान्त्यभ्यस्तु मह्ना । अति यो मन्द्रो यजथाय देवः सुकीर्तिं भिक्षे वरुणस्य भूरेः ॥
mantras.transliteration: idaṃ kaverādityasya svarājo viśvāni sāntyabhyastu mahnā | ati yo mandro yajathāya devaḥ sukīrtiṃ bhikṣe varuṇasya bhūreḥ ||

translations.english: (The worshipper repeats) this praise of the sage; the self-radiant Āditya; may he preside over all beings by his power; I beg for fame of the sovereign Varuṇa, a deity who, when much plural ased (is propitious) to hsi adorer.

mantras.sanskrit: तव व्रते सुभगासः स्याम स्वाध्यो वरुण तुष्टुवांसः । उपायन उषसां गोमतीनामग्नयो न जरमाणा अनु द्यून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava vrate subhagāsaḥ syāma svādhyo varuṇa tuṣṭuvāṃsaḥ | upāyana uṣasāṃ gomatīnāmagnayo na jaramāṇā anu dyūn ||

translations.english: May we, Varuṇa, deeply meditating on you, earnestly praising you, and (engaged) in your worship, be prosperous; glorifying you daily, like the fires (that are kindled in your honour) at the coming of the luminous dawns.

mantras.sanskrit: तव स्याम पुरुवीरस्य शर्मन्नुरुशंसस्य वरुण प्रणेतः । यूयं नः पुत्रा अदितेरदब्धा अभि क्षमध्वं युज्याय देवाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava syāma puruvīrasya śarmannuruśaṃsasya varuṇa praṇetaḥ | yūyaṃ naḥ putrā aditeradabdhā abhi kṣamadhvaṃ yujyāya devāḥ ||

translations.english: Varuṇa, chief guide (of men), may we abide in the felicity of you, who are endowed with great powers, and are glorified by many; divine sons of Aditi, unharmed (by foes), have compassion upon us through your benevolence.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सीमादित्यो असृजद्विधर्ताँ ऋतं सिन्धवो वरुणस्य यन्ति । न श्राम्यन्ति न वि मुचन्त्येते वयो न पप्तू रघुया परिज्मन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra sīmādityo asṛjadvidhartā~ ṛtaṃ sindhavo varuṇasya yanti | na śrāmyanti na vi mucantyete vayo na paptū raghuyā parijman ||

translations.english: The Āditya, the upholder, has created all this water; the rivers flow by the power of Varuṇa; they never weary, they never stop; they have descended with swiftness, like birds upon the circumambient (earth).

mantras.sanskrit: वि मच्छ्रथाय रशनामिवाग ऋध्याम ते वरुण खामृतस्य । मा तन्तुश्छेदि वयतो धियं मे मा मात्रा शार्यपसः पुर ऋतोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi macchrathāya raśanāmivāga ṛdhyāma te varuṇa khāmṛtasya | mā tantuśchedi vayato dhiyaṃ me mā mātrā śāryapasaḥ pura ṛtoḥ ||

translations.english: Cast off from me sin, Varuṇa, as if it were a rope; may we obtain from you a channel (filled) with water; cut not the thread of me (engaged in) weaving pious works; blight not the elements of holy rites before the season (of their maturity).

mantras.sanskrit: अपो सु म्यक्ष वरुण भियसं मत्सम्राळृतावोऽनु मा गृभाय । दामेव वत्साद्वि मुमुग्ध्यंहो नहि त्वदारे निमिषश्चनेशे ॥
mantras.transliteration: apo su myakṣa varuṇa bhiyasaṃ matsamrāḷṛtāvo'nu mā gṛbhāya | dāmeva vatsādvi mumugdhyaṃho nahi tvadāre nimiṣaścaneśe ||

translations.english: Keep off all danger from me, Varuṇa; supreme monarch, endowed with truth, bestow your favour upon me; cast off (from me) sin, like a tether from a calf; no one rules for the twinkling of an eye, apart from you.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नो वधैर्वरुण ये त इष्टावेनः कृण्वन्तमसुर भ्रीणन्ति । मा ज्योतिषः प्रवसथानि गन्म वि षू मृधः शिश्रथो जीवसे नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā no vadhairvaruṇa ye ta iṣṭāvenaḥ kṛṇvantamasura bhrīṇanti | mā jyotiṣaḥ pravasathāni ganma vi ṣū mṛdhaḥ śiśratho jīvase naḥ ||

translations.english: Harm us not, Varuṇa, with those destructive (weapons), repeller (of foes), demolish him who does evil at your sacrifice; let us not depart (before our time) from the regions of light; scatter the malevolent, that we may live.

mantras.sanskrit: नमः पुरा ते वरुणोत नूनमुतापरं तुविजात ब्रवाम । त्वे हि कं पर्वते न श्रितान्यप्रच्युतानि दूळभ व्रतानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: namaḥ purā te varuṇota nūnamutāparaṃ tuvijāta bravāma | tve hi kaṃ parvate na śritānyapracyutāni dūḷabha vratāni ||

translations.english: As we have offered adoration to you, Varuṇa, of old, in like manner as we offer it now, so may we offer it in future (to you), who are everywhere present; for in you, who are difficult of attainment, as in an (immoveable) mountain, all holy acts are assembled, and are not to be dissevered.

mantras.sanskrit: पर ऋणा सावीरध मत्कृतानि माहं राजन्नन्यकृतेन भोजम् । अव्युष्टा इन्नु भूयसीरुषास आ नो जीवान्वरुण तासु शाधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: para ṛṇā sāvīradha matkṛtāni māhaṃ rājannanyakṛtena bhojam | avyuṣṭā innu bhūyasīruṣāsa ā no jīvānvaruṇa tāsu śādhi ||

translations.english: Discharge, Varuṇa, the debts (contracted), by my progenitors, and those now (contracted) by me; and may I not, royal Varuṇa, be dependent (on the debts contracted) by another; many are the mornings that have, as it were, indeed not dawned; make us, Varuṇa, alive in them.

mantras.sanskrit: यो मे राजन्युज्यो वा सखा वा स्वप्ने भयं भीरवे मह्यमाह । स्तेनो वा यो दिप्सति नो वृको वा त्वं तस्माद्वरुण पाह्यस्मान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo me rājanyujyo vā sakhā vā svapne bhayaṃ bhīrave mahyamāha | steno vā yo dipsati no vṛko vā tvaṃ tasmādvaruṇa pāhyasmān ||

translations.english: Protect us, Varuṇa, against every peril which a kinsman or a friend threatens me with alarmed in sleep; or from a thief or a wolf that attempts to destroy us.

mantras.sanskrit: माहं मघोनो वरुण प्रियस्य भूरिदाव्न आ विदं शूनमापेः । मा रायो राजन्त्सुयमादव स्थां बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: māhaṃ maghono varuṇa priyasya bhūridāvna ā vidaṃ śūnamāpeḥ | mā rāyo rājantsuyamādava sthāṃ bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

translations.english: May I nver (have to) represent, Varuṇa, the destitution of a (once) opulent, dear, and munificent kinsman; may I never, royal (Varuṇa), be devoid of well-regulated riches; and may we, blessed with excellent descendants, worthily glorify you at this sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: धृतव्रता आदित्या इषिरा आरे मत्कर्त रहसूरिवागः । शृण्वतो वो वरुण मित्र देवा भद्रस्य विद्वाँ अवसे हुवे वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhṛtavratā ādityā iṣirā āre matkarta rahasūrivāgaḥ | śṛṇvato vo varuṇa mitra devā bhadrasya vidvā~ avase huve vaḥ ||

translations.english: Ādityas, upholders of pious works, and who are to be sought by all, remove sin far from me, like a woman delivered in secret; knowing, Mitra, Varuṇa and (universal) gods, the good that follows from your hearing our prayers, I invoke you for (our) protection.

mantras.sanskrit: यूयं देवाः प्रमतिर्यूयमोजो यूयं द्वेषांसि सनुतर्युयोत । अभिक्षत्तारो अभि च क्षमध्वमद्या च नो मृळयतापरं च ॥
mantras.transliteration: yūyaṃ devāḥ pramatiryūyamojo yūyaṃ dveṣāṃsi sanutaryuyota | abhikṣattāro abhi ca kṣamadhvamadyā ca no mṛḷayatāparaṃ ca ||

translations.english: You, gods, are intelligence, you are vigour; do you drive away the malevolent subduers (of enemies), overcome them entirely, and grant us felicity both now and in future.

mantras.sanskrit: किमू नु वः कृणवामापरेण किं सनेन वसव आप्येन । यूयं नो मित्रावरुणादिते च स्वस्तिमिन्द्रामरुतो दधात ॥
mantras.transliteration: kimū nu vaḥ kṛṇavāmāpareṇa kiṃ sanena vasava āpyena | yūyaṃ no mitrāvaruṇādite ca svastimindrāmaruto dadhāta ||

translations.english: What may we do for you, gods, either now, or in the future; what may we do, Vasus, by perpetual and practicable (acts of devotion); do you, Mitra, Varuṇa, Aditi, Indra and the Maruts, maintain our bell-being.

mantras.sanskrit: हये देवा यूयमिदापयः स्थ ते मृळत नाधमानाय मह्यम् । मा वो रथो मध्यमवाळृते भून्मा युष्मावत्स्वापिषु श्रमिष्म ॥
mantras.transliteration: haye devā yūyamidāpayaḥ stha te mṛḷata nādhamānāya mahyam | mā vo ratho madhyamavāḷṛte bhūnmā yuṣmāvatsvāpiṣu śramiṣma ||

translations.english: O Gods, you, verily, are our kinsmen; being so, grant felicity to me your suppliant; let not your chariot be tardy in coming to the sacrifice; let us never be weary of relatives such as you are.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र व एको मिमय भूर्यागो यन्मा पितेव कितवं शशास । आरे पाशा आरे अघानि देवा मा माधि पुत्रे विमिव ग्रभीष्ट ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra va eko mimaya bhūryāgo yanmā piteva kitavaṃ śaśāsa | āre pāśā āre aghāni devā mā mādhi putre vimiva grabhīṣṭa ||

translations.english: Alone among you, I have committed many offences, (which correct) as a father corrects a naughty (son); far from me, gods, bebonds; far from be sins; size not upon me (your) son as (a fowler) catches a bird.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्वाञ्चो अद्या भवता यजत्रा आ वो हार्दि भयमानो व्ययेयम् । त्राध्वं नो देवा निजुरो वृकस्य त्राध्वं कर्तादवपदो यजत्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: arvāñco adyā bhavatā yajatrā ā vo hārdi bhayamāno vyayeyam | trādhvaṃ no devā nijuro vṛkasya trādhvaṃ kartādavapado yajatrāḥ ||

translations.english: Adorable (deities), be present today, that, apprehensive of danger, I may feel sure of your healthy (support); protect us, gods, from the rapacity of the wolf; protect us, adorable (deities), from him who would work us misfortune.

mantras.sanskrit: माहं मघोनो वरुण प्रियस्य भूरिदाव्न आ विदं शूनमापेः । मा रायो राजन्त्सुयमादव स्थां बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: māhaṃ maghono varuṇa priyasya bhūridāvna ā vidaṃ śūnamāpeḥ | mā rāyo rājantsuyamādava sthāṃ bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

translations.english: May I never (have to) represent, Varuṇa, the destitution of a (once) opulent, dear, and munificent kinsman; may I never, royal (Varuṇa), be devoid of well-regulated riches, and may we, blessed with excellent descendants, worthily glorify you at this sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतं देवाय कृण्वते सवित्र इन्द्रायाहिघ्ने न रमन्त आपः । अहरहर्यात्यक्तुरपां कियात्या प्रथमः सर्ग आसाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtaṃ devāya kṛṇvate savitra indrāyāhighne na ramanta āpaḥ | aharaharyātyakturapāṃ kiyātyā prathamaḥ sarga āsām ||

translations.english: The waters cease not (to flow in libations) to the divine Indra, the sender of rain, the animator (of all), the slayer of Ahi; day by day proceeds the current of the waters; at what period of time was their first creation.

mantras.sanskrit: यो वृत्राय सिनमत्राभरिष्यत्प्र तं जनित्री विदुष उवाच । पथो रदन्तीरनु जोषमस्मै दिवेदिवे धुनयो यन्त्यर्थम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo vṛtrāya sinamatrābhariṣyatpra taṃ janitrī viduṣa uvāca | patho radantīranu joṣamasmai divedive dhunayo yantyartham ||

translations.english: His mother, (Aditi), declared to him the man who had offered (sacrificial) food to Vṛtra;obedient to his plural asure, the rivers, tracing out their paths, flow day by day to their object, (the ocean).

mantras.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वो ह्यस्थादध्यन्तरिक्षेऽधा वृत्राय प्र वधं जभार । मिहं वसान उप हीमदुद्रोत्तिग्मायुधो अजयच्छत्रुमिन्द्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūrdhvo hyasthādadhyantarikṣe'dhā vṛtrāya pra vadhaṃ jabhāra | mihaṃ vasāna upa hīmadudrottigmāyudho ajayacchatrumindraḥ ||

translations.english: Inasmuch as he had soared aloft above the firmament Indra hurled against Vṛtra his destructive (thunderbolt); enveloped in a cloud, he rushed upon Indra, but the wielder of the sharp-edged weapon triumphed over his foe.

mantras.sanskrit: बृहस्पते तपुषाश्नेव विध्य वृकद्वरसो असुरस्य वीरान् । यथा जघन्थ धृषता पुरा चिदेवा जहि शत्रुमस्माकमिन्द्र ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhaspate tapuṣāśneva vidhya vṛkadvaraso asurasya vīrān | yathā jaghantha dhṛṣatā purā cidevā jahi śatrumasmākamindra ||

translations.english: Pierce, Bṛhaspati, with a radiant shaft,  as with a thunderbolt, the sons of the asura guarding his gates; in like manner as you did formerly slay Vṛtra by your own prowess, so do you now destroy our enemy.

mantras.sanskrit: अव क्षिप दिवो अश्मानमुच्चा येन शत्रुं मन्दसानो निजूर्वाः । तोकस्य सातौ तनयस्य भूरेरस्माँ अर्धं कृणुतादिन्द्र गोनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ava kṣipa divo aśmānamuccā yena śatruṃ mandasāno nijūrvāḥ | tokasya sātau tanayasya bhūrerasmā~ ardhaṃ kṛṇutādindra gonām ||

translations.english: Do you, who are on high, cast down fromheaven the adamantine (thunderbolt), wherewith, when exhilarated, you did slay your foe; and make us affluent in the possession of many sons, and grandsons, and cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र हि क्रतुं वृहथो यं वनुथो रध्रस्य स्थो यजमानस्य चोदौ । इन्द्रासोमा युवमस्माँ अविष्टमस्मिन्भयस्थे कृणुतमु लोकम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra hi kratuṃ vṛhatho yaṃ vanutho radhrasya stho yajamānasya codau | indrāsomā yuvamasmā~ aviṣṭamasminbhayasthe kṛṇutamu lokam ||

translations.english: Indra and Soma, eradicate the worker (of evil), whom you hate; be the encouragers of the liberal instrumental tutor of the rite; protect us in this plural ce of peril, and make the world (free from fear).

mantras.sanskrit: न मा तमन्न श्रमन्नोत तन्द्रन्न वोचाम मा सुनोतेति सोमम् । यो मे पृणाद्यो ददद्यो निबोधाद्यो मा सुन्वन्तमुप गोभिरायत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: na mā tamanna śramannota tandranna vocāma mā sunoteti somam | yo me pṛṇādyo dadadyo nibodhādyo mā sunvantamupa gobhirāyat ||

translations.english: Let not Indra vexme, or weary me, or make me slothful; never may we say (to another), do not offer the Soma; (for it is Indra) who will fulfil (my wishes), who will give (me riches), who will hear (my prayers), who will reward me, presenting libations, with cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: सरस्वति त्वमस्माँ अविड्ढि मरुत्वती धृषती जेषि शत्रून् । त्यं चिच्छर्धन्तं तविषीयमाणमिन्द्रो हन्ति वृषभं शण्डिकानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sarasvati tvamasmā~ aviḍḍhi marutvatī dhṛṣatī jeṣi śatrūn | tyaṃ cicchardhantaṃ taviṣīyamāṇamindro hanti vṛṣabhaṃ śaṇḍikānām ||

translations.english: Sarasvatī, do you protect us; associated with the Maruts and firm (of purpose), overcome our foes, whiilst Indra slays the chief of the Śaṇḍikas, defying him and confiding in his strength.

mantras.sanskrit: यो नः सनुत्य उत वा जिघत्नुरभिख्याय तं तिगितेन विध्य । बृहस्पत आयुधैर्जेषि शत्रून्द्रुहे रीषन्तं परि धेहि राजन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo naḥ sanutya uta vā jighatnurabhikhyāya taṃ tigitena vidhya | bṛhaspata āyudhairjeṣi śatrūndruhe rīṣantaṃ pari dhehi rājan ||

translations.english: Detecting him who is lying in ambush (against us), who is purposing our death, pierce him, Bṛhaspati, with your sharp (thunderbolt), and overthrow (our) enemies with (your) weapons; hurl, monarch, your destroying (shaft) against the oppressor.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्माकेभिः सत्वभिः शूर शूरैर्वीर्या कृधि यानि ते कर्त्वानि । ज्योगभूवन्ननुधूपितासो हत्वी तेषामा भरा नो वसूनि ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmākebhiḥ satvabhiḥ śūra śūrairvīryā kṛdhi yāni te kartvāni | jyogabhūvannanudhūpitāso hatvī teṣāmā bharā no vasūni ||

translations.english: Achieve, hero, along with our valiant heroes, the exploits that are to be achieved by you; long have (our enemies) been inflated (with pride); slay them, and bring to us their treasures.

mantras.sanskrit: तं वः शर्धं मारुतं सुम्नयुर्गिरोप ब्रुवे नमसा दैव्यं जनम् । यथा रयिं सर्ववीरं नशामहा अपत्यसाचं श्रुत्यं दिवेदिवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ vaḥ śardhaṃ mārutaṃ sumnayurgiropa bruve namasā daivyaṃ janam | yathā rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ naśāmahā apatyasācaṃ śrutyaṃ divedive ||
