translations.english: As the rivers pursue their course, the waters rush to the ocean like the drivers of cars (to a goal), so the vast Indra (hastens) from his dwelling (in the firmament), when the humble Som alibation propitiates him.

mantras.sanskrit: समुद्रेण सिन्धवो यादमाना इन्द्राय सोमं सुषुतं भरन्तः । अंशुं दुहन्ति हस्तिनो भरित्रैर्मध्वः पुनन्ति धारया पवित्रैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samudreṇa sindhavo yādamānā indrāya somaṃ suṣutaṃ bharantaḥ | aṃśuṃ duhanti hastino bharitrairmadhvaḥ punanti dhārayā pavitraiḥ ||

translations.english: As the rivers are solicitious (to mix) with the ocean, so (are the priests) bearing the efficient libation to Indra; holding in their hands they milk the Soma, and purify the sweet Soma (as they fall) indrops through the purifying filters.

mantras.sanskrit: ह्रदा इव कुक्षयः सोमधानाः समी विव्याच सवना पुरूणि । अन्ना यदिन्द्रः प्रथमा व्याश वृत्रं जघन्वाँ अवृणीत सोमम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: hradā iva kukṣayaḥ somadhānāḥ samī vivyāca savanā purūṇi | annā yadindraḥ prathamā vyāśa vṛtraṃ jaghanvā~ avṛṇīta somam ||

translations.english: The stomach of Indra (is) as capacious (a receptacle) of Soma, as a lake, for he has partaken of it at many sacrifices; and inasmuch as he has eaten the first (sacrificial) viands, he has been the slayer of Vṛtra, and has shared the Soma (with the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: आ तू भर माकिरेतत्परि ष्ठाद्विद्मा हि त्वा वसुपतिं वसूनाम् । इन्द्र यत्ते माहिनं दत्रमस्त्यस्मभ्यं तद्धर्यश्व प्र यन्धि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tū bhara mākiretatpari ṣṭhādvidmā hi tvā vasupatiṃ vasūnām | indra yatte māhinaṃ datramastyasmabhyaṃ taddharyaśva pra yandhi ||

translations.english: Quickly, Indra, bring (wealth); let no one impede you, for we know you to be the lord of wealth, of all treasures; and since, Indra, your greatness is munificence, therefore, lord of the tawny steeds, grant us (riches).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मे प्र यन्धि मघवन्नृजीषिन्निन्द्र रायो विश्ववारस्य भूरेः । अस्मे शतं शरदो जीवसे धा अस्मे वीराञ्छश्वत इन्द्र शिप्रिन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asme pra yandhi maghavannṛjīṣinnindra rāyo viśvavārasya bhūreḥ | asme śataṃ śarado jīvase dhā asme vīrāñchaśvata indra śiprin ||

translations.english: Opulent Indra, receiver of the spiritless Soma, give to us riches in universally desired quantity; grant us to live a hundred years; bestow upon us, Indra wiht the handsome chin, numerous posterity.

mantras.sanskrit: शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन्भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ । शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नन्तं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau | śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||

translations.english: We invoke for our protection the opulent Indra, distinguished in this combat; the leader in the food-bestowing (strife), hearing (our praises), terrible in battles, the destroyer of foes, the conqueror of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: वार्त्रहत्याय शवसे पृतनाषाह्याय च । इन्द्र त्वा वर्तयामसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: vārtrahatyāya śavase pṛtanāṣāhyāya ca | indra tvā vartayāmasi ||

translations.english: We excite you, Indra, to exert the strength that destroys Vṛtra, and overpowers hostile armies.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्वाचीनं सु ते मन उत चक्षुः शतक्रतो । इन्द्र कृण्वन्तु वाघतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: arvācīnaṃ su te mana uta cakṣuḥ śatakrato | indra kṛṇvantu vāghataḥ ||

translations.english: May your praisers, Indra, who is worshipped in a hundred rites, direct your mind and your eyes towards us.

mantras.sanskrit: नामानि ते शतक्रतो विश्वाभिर्गीर्भिरीमहे । इन्द्राभिमातिषाह्ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: nāmāni te śatakrato viśvābhirgīrbhirīmahe | indrābhimātiṣāhye ||

translations.english: We recite, Indra, who is worshipped in a hundred rites, (your many) names in all our hymns for strength to resist our foes.

mantras.sanskrit: पुरुष्टुतस्य धामभिः शतेन महयामसि । इन्द्रस्य चर्षणीधृतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: puruṣṭutasya dhāmabhiḥ śatena mahayāmasi | indrasya carṣaṇīdhṛtaḥ ||

translations.english: We repeat the praise of the many-lauded Indra the supporter of man, invested with a hundred glories.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रं वृत्राय हन्तवे पुरुहूतमुप ब्रुवे । भरेषु वाजसातये ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraṃ vṛtrāya hantave puruhūtamupa bruve | bhareṣu vājasātaye ||

translations.english: I invoke you, Indra, who is invoked of many for the slaying of Vṛtra, and the granting of food (as the spoil) of battle.

mantras.sanskrit: वाजेषु सासहिर्भव त्वामीमहे शतक्रतो । इन्द्र वृत्राय हन्तवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: vājeṣu sāsahirbhava tvāmīmahe śatakrato | indra vṛtrāya hantave ||

translations.english: Be victorious, Indra, in battles; we solicit you, object of many rites, to destroy Vṛtra.

mantras.sanskrit: द्युम्नेषु पृतनाज्ये पृत्सुतूर्षु श्रवस्सु च । इन्द्र साक्ष्वाभिमातिषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: dyumneṣu pṛtanājye pṛtsutūrṣu śravassu ca | indra sākṣvābhimātiṣu ||

translations.english: Overcome, Indra, those who are adverse to us in riches, in battle, in hostile hosts, in strength.

mantras.sanskrit: शुष्मिन्तमं न ऊतये द्युम्निनं पाहि जागृविम् । इन्द्र सोमं शतक्रतो ॥
mantras.transliteration: śuṣmintamaṃ na ūtaye dyumninaṃ pāhi jāgṛvim | indra somaṃ śatakrato ||

translations.english: Drink, Indra, object of many rites, for our preservation, the most invigorating, fame-conferring, sleep-dispelling, Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणि शतक्रतो या ते जनेषु पञ्चसु । इन्द्र तानि त आ वृणे ॥
mantras.transliteration: indriyāṇi śatakrato yā te janeṣu pañcasu | indra tāni ta ā vṛṇe ||

translations.english: Indra, object of many rites, I regard the organs of sense, that exist in the five races (of beings dependent) on you as yours.

mantras.sanskrit: अगन्निन्द्र श्रवो बृहद्द्युम्नं दधिष्व दुष्टरम् । उत्ते शुष्मं तिरामसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: agannindra śravo bṛhaddyumnaṃ dadhiṣva duṣṭaram | utte śuṣmaṃ tirāmasi ||

translations.english: May the abundant (sacrificial) food (we offer) reach you, Indra; grant us wealth that may not easily be surpassed; we augment your vigour (by our offerings).

mantras.sanskrit: अर्वावतो न आ गह्यथो शक्र परावतः । उ लोको यस्ते अद्रिव इन्द्रेह तत आ गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: arvāvato na ā gahyatho śakra parāvataḥ | u loko yaste adriva indreha tata ā gahi ||

translations.english: COme to us Śakra, whether from afar or nigh; whatever, Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, be your region, come from thence hither.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि तष्टेव दीधया मनीषामत्यो न वाजी सुधुरो जिहानः । अभि प्रियाणि मर्मृशत्पराणि कवीँरिच्छामि संदृशे सुमेधाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi taṣṭeva dīdhayā manīṣāmatyo na vājī sudhuro jihānaḥ | abhi priyāṇi marmṛśatparāṇi kavī~ricchāmi saṃdṛśe sumedhāḥ ||

translations.english: Repeat (to Indra) pious praise, as a carpenter (plural nes the wood), and engaging (zealously in sacred rites), as a quick horse bearing well his burden; endowed with intelligence, and refllecting upon the future acts acceptable (to Indra), I desire to behold the sages (whohave gone to heaven).

mantras.sanskrit: इनोत पृच्छ जनिमा कवीनां मनोधृतः सुकृतस्तक्षत द्याम् । इमा उ ते प्रण्यो वर्धमाना मनोवाता अध नु धर्मणि ग्मन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: inota pṛccha janimā kavīnāṃ manodhṛtaḥ sukṛtastakṣata dyām | imā u te praṇyo vardhamānā manovātā adha nu dharmaṇi gman ||

translations.english: Ask of the lords (of earth, the holy teachers), the birth of those deified sages, who with well-governed minds, and diligent in sacred rites, fabricated the heavens; and may these propitiatory (praises), augmenting (your power) and rapid as the wind, reach you at this solemn rite.

mantras.sanskrit: नि षीमिदत्र गुह्या दधाना उत क्षत्राय रोदसी समञ्जन् । सं मात्राभिर्ममिरे येमुरुर्वी अन्तर्मही समृते धायसे धुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni ṣīmidatra guhyā dadhānā uta kṣatrāya rodasī samañjan | saṃ mātrābhirmamire yemururvī antarmahī samṛte dhāyase dhuḥ ||

translations.english: Comprehending hidden (mysteries) here on earth, they have, through their power, made manifest (the things of) heaven and earth; they have set limits to themby their elements; they connected them both mutually united, wide-spread and vast, and fixed the intermediate (firmament) to sustain them.

mantras.sanskrit: आतिष्ठन्तं परि विश्वे अभूषञ्छ्रियो वसानश्चरति स्वरोचिः । महत्तद्वृष्णो असुरस्य नामा विश्वरूपो अमृतानि तस्थौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: ātiṣṭhantaṃ pari viśve abhūṣañchriyo vasānaścarati svarociḥ | mahattadvṛṣṇo asurasya nāmā viśvarūpo amṛtāni tasthau ||

translations.english: They all ornamented (Indra) standing (in his car) and, clothed in beauty, he proceeds self-radiant; wonderful are the acts of that showerer (of benefits), the influencer (of consciences), who omniform, presides over the ambrosial (waters).

mantras.sanskrit: असूत पूर्वो वृषभो ज्यायानिमा अस्य शुरुधः सन्ति पूर्वीः । दिवो नपाता विदथस्य धीभिः क्षत्रं राजाना प्रदिवो दधाथे ॥
mantras.transliteration: asūta pūrvo vṛṣabho jyāyānimā asya śurudhaḥ santi pūrvīḥ | divo napātā vidathasya dhībhiḥ kṣatraṃ rājānā pradivo dadhāthe ||

translations.english: The showerer (of benefits), the preceder and elder (of the gods), genitive rated (the waters); they are the abundant allayers of his thirst; sovereign Indra and Varuṇa, grandsons of heaven, you possess the wealth (that is to be acquired) by the rites of the splendid sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रीणि राजाना विदथे पुरूणि परि विश्वानि भूषथः सदांसि । अपश्यमत्र मनसा जगन्वान्व्रते गन्धर्वाँ अपि वायुकेशान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: trīṇi rājānā vidathe purūṇi pari viśvāni bhūṣathaḥ sadāṃsi | apaśyamatra manasā jaganvānvrate gandharvā~ api vāyukeśān ||

translations.english: Royal Indra and Varuṇa, embellish the three universal sacrifices (and make them) full (of all requisites) for this celebration; you have gone to the rite, for I have beheld in my mind, at this solemnity, the gandharvas with hair (waving) in the wind.

mantras.sanskrit: तदिन्न्वस्य वृषभस्य धेनोरा नामभिर्ममिरे सक्म्यं गोः । अन्यदन्यदसुर्यं वसाना नि मायिनो ममिरे रूपमस्मिन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadinnvasya vṛṣabhasya dhenorā nāmabhirmamire sakmyaṃ goḥ | anyadanyadasuryaṃ vasānā ni māyino mamire rūpamasmin ||

translations.english: Those who, for (the sake of) the showerer (of benefits), milk the agreeable (produce) of the cow, (who is known) by (many) names, they invested with the diversified strength (of the asuras) and practising delusive art have deposited their own nature in him.

mantras.sanskrit: तदिन्न्वस्य सवितुर्नकिर्मे हिरण्ययीममतिं यामशिश्रेत् । आ सुष्टुती रोदसी विश्वमिन्वे अपीव योषा जनिमानि वव्रे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadinnvasya saviturnakirme hiraṇyayīmamatiṃ yāmaśiśret | ā suṣṭutī rodasī viśvaminve apīva yoṣā janimāni vavre ||

translations.english: No one (distinguishes) my golden lustre from that of this Savitā, in which (lustre) he has taken refuge; gratified by pious praise, he cherishes the all-fostering heaven and earth as a woman cherishes her offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं प्रत्नस्य साधथो महो यद्दैवी स्वस्तिः परि णः स्यातम् । गोपाजिह्वस्य तस्थुषो विरूपा विश्वे पश्यन्ति मायिनः कृतानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ pratnasya sādhatho maho yaddaivī svastiḥ pari ṇaḥ syātam | gopājihvasya tasthuṣo virūpā viśve paśyanti māyinaḥ kṛtāni ||

translations.english: You two secure the great felicity of the ancient (worshipper), that which is happiness in heaven; do you (therefore) be even about us; all those who exercise illusion, contemplate the manifold expoits of the everlasting and blandly-speaking Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन्भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ । शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नन्तं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau | śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||

translations.english: We invoke for our protection the opulent Indra, distinguished in this combat, the leader in the food-bestowing (strife), hearing (our praises), terrible in battles, the destroyer of foes, the conqueror of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रं मतिर्हृद आ वच्यमानाच्छा पतिं स्तोमतष्टा जिगाति । या जागृविर्विदथे शस्यमानेन्द्र यत्ते जायते विद्धि तस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraṃ matirhṛda ā vacyamānācchā patiṃ stomataṣṭā jigāti | yā jāgṛvirvidathe śasyamānendra yatte jāyate viddhi tasya ||

translations.english: The praise that is prompted by the heart, and is uttered by the reciters of sacred hymns, proceeds to the presence of the lord, and is his awakener when repeated at the sacrifice; be cognizant Indra, of this praise, which is born for you.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवश्चिदा पूर्व्या जायमाना वि जागृविर्विदथे शस्यमाना । भद्रा वस्त्राण्यर्जुना वसाना सेयमस्मे सनजा पित्र्या धीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: divaścidā pūrvyā jāyamānā vi jāgṛvirvidathe śasyamānā | bhadrā vastrāṇyarjunā vasānā seyamasme sanajā pitryā dhīḥ ||

translations.english: That praise which is begotten before (the dawn) of day is the awakener of Indra, when repeated at the (morning) sacrifice; auspicious and clothed in white raiment is this our ancient and paternal hymn.

mantras.sanskrit: यमा चिदत्र यमसूरसूत जिह्वाया अग्रं पतदा ह्यस्थात् । वपूंषि जाता मिथुना सचेते तमोहना तपुषो बुध्न एता ॥
mantras.transliteration: yamā cidatra yamasūrasūta jihvāyā agraṃ patadā hyasthāt | vapūṃṣi jātā mithunā sacete tamohanā tapuṣo budhna etā ||

translations.english: The parent of twins (the dawn), has brought forth the twin (Aśvins) on this occasion, (in the praise of whom) the tip of my tongue remains tremulous; they two, the dispersers of darkness, combine, assuming bodies as a pair (of twins) at the origin of the day.

mantras.sanskrit: नकिरेषां निन्दिता मर्त्येषु ये अस्माकं पितरो गोषु योधाः । इन्द्र एषां दृंहिता माहिनावानुद्गोत्राणि ससृजे दंसनावान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nakireṣāṃ ninditā martyeṣu ye asmākaṃ pitaro goṣu yodhāḥ | indra eṣāṃ dṛṃhitā māhināvānudgotrāṇi sasṛje daṃsanāvān ||

translations.english: There are no revilers among men of those who were our progenitors and combatants for (the recovery of) the cattle; for the mighty Indra, the achiever of great deeds, liberated for them the numerous herds.

mantras.sanskrit: सखा ह यत्र सखिभिर्नवग्वैरभिज्ञ्वा सत्वभिर्गा अनुग्मन् । सत्यं तदिन्द्रो दशभिर्दशग्वैः सूर्यं विवेद तमसि क्षियन्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sakhā ha yatra sakhibhirnavagvairabhijñvā satvabhirgā anugman | satyaṃ tadindro daśabhirdaśagvaiḥ sūryaṃ viveda tamasi kṣiyantam ||

translations.english: A friend, accompanied by the faithful friends who had celebrated the nine months rite, and tracking the cows upon their knees, and in like manner accompanied by those ten who had accomplished the ten months' rite, Indra made manifest the true (light of the sun) (theretofore) dweling in (the) darkness (of the cave).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रो मधु सम्भृतमुस्रियायां पद्वद्विवेद शफवन्नमे गोः । गुहा हितं गुह्यं गूळ्हमप्सु हस्ते दधे दक्षिणे दक्षिणावान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indro madhu sambhṛtamusriyāyāṃ padvadviveda śaphavanname goḥ | guhā hitaṃ guhyaṃ gūḷhamapsu haste dadhe dakṣiṇe dakṣiṇāvān ||

translations.english: Indra discovered the sweet milk secreted in the cow, and thereupon, brought forth (from their concealment) the herd (of cattle) having feet and having hoofs; munificent (in gifts), he held in his right hand that which had been hidden in the cavern, which was concealed in the waters.

mantras.sanskrit: ज्योतिर्वृणीत तमसो विजानन्नारे स्याम दुरितादभीके । इमा गिरः सोमपाः सोमवृद्ध जुषस्वेन्द्र पुरुतमस्य कारोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: jyotirvṛṇīta tamaso vijānannāre syāma duritādabhīke | imā giraḥ somapāḥ somavṛddha juṣasvendra purutamasya kāroḥ ||

translations.english: The discriminating (Indra) has separated the light from the darkness; may we, removed afar from evil, be ever in security; Indra, drinker of the Soma, who is nurished by Soma, be plural ased with these praises of your worshipper who is the discomfiter of his foes.

mantras.sanskrit: ज्योतिर्यज्ञाय रोदसी अनु ष्यादारे स्याम दुरितस्य भूरेः । भूरि चिद्धि तुजतो मर्त्यस्य सुपारासो वसवो बर्हणावत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: jyotiryajñāya rodasī anu ṣyādāre syāma duritasya bhūreḥ | bhūri ciddhi tujato martyasya supārāso vasavo barhaṇāvat ||

translations.english: May light be spread throughout heaven and earth for (the promotion of the) sacrifice; may we be far removed from exceeding ill; Vasus, who are to be rendered present (by pious praise), bestow increasing affluence upon the men who is liberal of gifts.

mantras.sanskrit: शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन्भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ । शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नन्तं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau | śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||

translations.english: We invoke for our protection the opulent Indra, distinguished in this combat, the leader in the food-bestowing (strife), hearing (our praises), terrible in battles, the destroyer of foes, the conqueror of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र त्वा वृषभं वयं सुते सोमे हवामहे । स पाहि मध्वो अन्धसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra tvā vṛṣabhaṃ vayaṃ sute some havāmahe | sa pāhi madhvo andhasaḥ ||

translations.english: We invoke you, Indra, showerer (of benefits), to the effused libation; you drink of the exhilarating Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र क्रतुविदं सुतं सोमं हर्य पुरुष्टुत । पिबा वृषस्व तातृपिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra kratuvidaṃ sutaṃ somaṃ harya puruṣṭuta | pibā vṛṣasva tātṛpim ||

translations.english: Indra, the praised of many, accept the effused Soma, the conferrer of knowledge; drink, imbibe the satisfactory draught.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र प्र णो धितावानं यज्ञं विश्वेभिर्देवेभिः । तिर स्तवान विश्पते ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra pra ṇo dhitāvānaṃ yajñaṃ viśvebhirdevebhiḥ | tira stavāna viśpate ||

translations.english: Indra, lord of men, who is praised (by the devout) and aided by the gods, perfect this our sacrifice in which the oblation is offered (to you).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र सोमाः सुता इमे तव प्र यन्ति सत्पते । क्षयं चन्द्रास इन्दवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra somāḥ sutā ime tava pra yanti satpate | kṣayaṃ candrāsa indavaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, lord of the virtuous, these effused Soma juices, exhilarating and brilliant, proceed to your abode.

mantras.sanskrit: दधिष्वा जठरे सुतं सोममिन्द्र वरेण्यम् । तव द्युक्षास इन्दवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dadhiṣvā jaṭhare sutaṃ somamindra vareṇyam | tava dyukṣāsa indavaḥ ||

translations.english: Receive, Indra, into your stomach this excellent effused libation, these bright (drops) abide with you in heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: गिर्वणः पाहि नः सुतं मधोर्धाराभिरज्यसे । इन्द्र त्वादातमिद्यशः ॥
mantras.transliteration: girvaṇaḥ pāhi naḥ sutaṃ madhordhārābhirajyase | indra tvādātamidyaśaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, who is glorified with praise, drink this our libation, for you are sprinkled with the drops of the exhilarating (draught); the (sacrificial) food is verily purified by you.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि द्युम्नानि वनिन इन्द्रं सचन्ते अक्षिता । पीत्वी सोमस्य वावृधे ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi dyumnāni vanina indraṃ sacante akṣitā | pītvī somasya vāvṛdhe ||

translations.english: The brilliant and imperishable (Soma), offered by the worshipper, encompasses Indra; having drunk of the libation, he increases (in vigour).

mantras.sanskrit: अर्वावतो न आ गहि परावतश्च वृत्रहन् । इमा जुषस्व नो गिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: arvāvato na ā gahi parāvataśca vṛtrahan | imā juṣasva no giraḥ ||

translations.english: Slayer of Vṛtra, whether from nigh or from afar, come to us, accept these our praises.

mantras.sanskrit: यदन्तरा परावतमर्वावतं च हूयसे । इन्द्रेह तत आ गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadantarā parāvatamarvāvataṃ ca hūyase | indreha tata ā gahi ||

translations.english: Whether you are called from nigh or from afar, or from mid-space, come hither, Indra, from thence.

mantras.sanskrit: आ तू न इन्द्र मद्र्यग्घुवानः सोमपीतये । हरिभ्यां याह्यद्रिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tū na indra madryagghuvānaḥ somapītaye | haribhyāṃ yāhyadrivaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, come to me with your horses, when invoked to drink the Soma at our (sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: सत्तो होता न ऋत्वियस्तिस्तिरे बर्हिरानुषक् । अयुज्रन्प्रातरद्रयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: satto hotā na ṛtviyastistire barhirānuṣak | ayujranprātaradrayaḥ ||

translations.english: The invoking priest is seated at the proper season; the sacred grass woven together has been spread; the stones are plural ced in contact for the morning (libation).

mantras.sanskrit: इमा ब्रह्म ब्रह्मवाहः क्रियन्त आ बर्हिः सीद । वीहि शूर पुरोळाशम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: imā brahma brahmavāhaḥ kriyanta ā barhiḥ sīda | vīhi śūra puroḷāśam ||

translations.english: Bearer of prayers, these prayers are offered (by us); sit down on the sacred grass; partake, hero, of the oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: रारन्धि सवनेषु ण एषु स्तोमेषु वृत्रहन् । उक्थेष्विन्द्र गिर्वणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: rārandhi savaneṣu ṇa eṣu stomeṣu vṛtrahan | uktheṣvindra girvaṇaḥ ||

translations.english: Slayer of Vṛtra, Indra, who is gratified by praise, be plural ased with these our praises and prayers at our (daily) sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: मतयः सोमपामुरुं रिहन्ति शवसस्पतिम् । इन्द्रं वत्सं न मातरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: matayaḥ somapāmuruṃ rihanti śavasaspatim | indraṃ vatsaṃ na mātaraḥ ||

translations.english: Our praises caress the mighty Indra, the drinker of the Soma, as cows lick their calves.

mantras.sanskrit: स मन्दस्वा ह्यन्धसो राधसे तन्वा महे । न स्तोतारं निदे करः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa mandasvā hyandhaso rādhase tanvā mahe | na stotāraṃ nide karaḥ ||

translations.english: Be exhilarated bodily (by drinking) of the libation which we offer for the sake of ample wealth; expose not your adorer to reproach.

mantras.sanskrit: वयमिन्द्र त्वायवो हविष्मन्तो जरामहे । उत त्वमस्मयुर्वसो ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayamindra tvāyavo haviṣmanto jarāmahe | uta tvamasmayurvaso ||

translations.english: Devoted, Indra, to you and offering oblations, we glorify you giver of dwellings; do you be favourably disposed to us.

mantras.sanskrit: मारे अस्मद्वि मुमुचो हरिप्रियार्वाङ्याहि । इन्द्र स्वधावो मत्स्वेह ॥
mantras.transliteration: māre asmadvi mumuco haripriyārvāṅyāhi | indra svadhāvo matsveha ||

translations.english: Lover of horses, Indra, loosen not your steeds while far from us, but come (with them) to our presence; enjoyer of the offering, be exhilarated at this sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्वाञ्चं त्वा सुखे रथे वहतामिन्द्र केशिना । घृतस्नू बर्हिरासदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: arvāñcaṃ tvā sukhe rathe vahatāmindra keśinā | ghṛtasnū barhirāsade ||

translations.english: May your long-maned and sleek-coated steeds bring you down in your easy chariot to sit upon the sacred grass.

mantras.sanskrit: उप नः सुतमा गहि सोममिन्द्र गवाशिरम् । हरिभ्यां यस्ते अस्मयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa naḥ sutamā gahi somamindra gavāśiram | haribhyāṃ yaste asmayuḥ ||

translations.english: Come, Indra, to this our effused Soma mixed with milk and curds, with your horses (yoked to your car), which is favourably disposed to us.

mantras.sanskrit: तमिन्द्र मदमा गहि बर्हिःष्ठां ग्रावभिः सुतम् । कुविन्न्वस्य तृप्णवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamindra madamā gahi barhiḥṣṭhāṃ grāvabhiḥ sutam | kuvinnvasya tṛpṇavaḥ ||

translations.english: Come, Indra, to the exhilarating (Soma) expressed by the stones, poured upon the sacred grass; drink of it to satiety, for there is plural nty.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रमित्था गिरो ममाच्छागुरिषिता इतः । आवृते सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: indramitthā giro mamācchāguriṣitā itaḥ | āvṛte somapītaye ||

translations.english: May my praises, addressed from hence and in thi smanner, attain Indra, to bring him hither to drink the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये स्तोमैरिह हवामहे । उक्थेभिः कुविदागमत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraṃ somasya pītaye stomairiha havāmahe | ukthebhiḥ kuvidāgamat ||

translations.english: We invoke Indra to this rite with prayers to drink the Soma; may he, repeatedly invoked, come hither.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र सोमाः सुता इमे तान्दधिष्व शतक्रतो । जठरे वाजिनीवसो ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra somāḥ sutā ime tāndadhiṣva śatakrato | jaṭhare vājinīvaso ||

translations.english: Indra, these Soma are poured out; take them, Śatakratu, into your stomach; you who is rich in (abundant) food.

mantras.sanskrit: विद्मा हि त्वा धनंजयं वाजेषु दधृषं कवे । अधा ते सुम्नमीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: vidmā hi tvā dhanaṃjayaṃ vājeṣu dadhṛṣaṃ kave | adhā te sumnamīmahe ||

translations.english: Far-seeing Indra, we know you to be victorious and winner of wealth in battles; therefore we ask of you riches.

mantras.sanskrit: इममिन्द्र गवाशिरं यवाशिरं च नः पिब । आगत्या वृषभिः सुतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: imamindra gavāśiraṃ yavāśiraṃ ca naḥ piba | āgatyā vṛṣabhiḥ sutam ||

translations.english: Having come (to our rite) drink, Indra, this our (libation), effused by the stones, and mixed with milk and curds, and with barley.

mantras.sanskrit: तुभ्येदिन्द्र स्व ओक्ये सोमं चोदामि पीतये । एष रारन्तु ते हृदि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tubhyedindra sva okye somaṃ codāmi pītaye | eṣa rārantu te hṛdi ||

translations.english: I offer to you, Indra, this Soma for your drinking, to be taken into its proper receptacle;may it delight your heart.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वां सुतस्य पीतये प्रत्नमिन्द्र हवामहे । कुशिकासो अवस्यवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāṃ sutasya pītaye pratnamindra havāmahe | kuśikāso avasyavaḥ ||

translations.english: Descendants of Kuśa, desirous of protection, we invoke you, Indra, who is of old, to drink of the libation.

mantras.sanskrit: आ याह्यर्वाङुप वन्धुरेष्ठास्तवेदनु प्रदिवः सोमपेयम् । प्रिया सखाया वि मुचोप बर्हिस्त्वामिमे हव्यवाहो हवन्ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yāhyarvāṅupa vandhureṣṭhāstavedanu pradivaḥ somapeyam | priyā sakhāyā vi mucopa barhistvāmime havyavāho havante ||

translations.english: Descend to us riding in your car, for verily yours is this ancient libation; unharness your beloved and friendly (horses) near to the sacred grass, for these offerers of the oblation present it to you.

mantras.sanskrit: आ याहि पूर्वीरति चर्षणीराँ अर्य आशिष उप नो हरिभ्याम् । इमा हि त्वा मतयः स्तोमतष्टा इन्द्र हवन्ते सख्यं जुषाणाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yāhi pūrvīrati carṣaṇīrā~ arya āśiṣa upa no haribhyām | imā hi tvā matayaḥ stomataṣṭā indra havante sakhyaṃ juṣāṇāḥ ||

translations.english: Passing by multitudes, come hither, noble Indra, with your steeds, (to receive) our benedictions; for these praises, Indra, composed by the devout, invoke you propitiating your friendship.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो यज्ञं नमोवृधं सजोषा इन्द्र देव हरिभिर्याहि तूयम् । अहं हि त्वा मतिभिर्जोहवीमि घृतप्रयाः सधमादे मधूनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no yajñaṃ namovṛdhaṃ sajoṣā indra deva haribhiryāhi tūyam | ahaṃ hi tvā matibhirjohavīmi ghṛtaprayāḥ sadhamāde madhūnām ||

translations.english: Divine Indra, come quickly with your steeds, and well plural ased, to our food-augmenting sacrifice; offering (sacred) food with butter, I invoke you verily with praises in the chamber of the sweet libations.

mantras.sanskrit: आ च त्वामेता वृषणा वहातो हरी सखाया सुधुरा स्वङ्गा । धानावदिन्द्रः सवनं जुषाणः सखा सख्युः शृणवद्वन्दनानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā ca tvāmetā vṛṣaṇā vahāto harī sakhāyā sudhurā svaṅgā | dhānāvadindraḥ savanaṃ juṣāṇaḥ sakhā sakhyuḥ śṛṇavadvandanāni ||

translations.english: May these two vigorous friendly burden-bearing and well-limbed steeds convey you hither, where, Indra, approving of the ceremony (in wihc the offering) is parched grain, may hear as a friend the praises of his friend (the worshipper).

mantras.sanskrit: कुविन्मा गोपां करसे जनस्य कुविद्राजानं मघवन्नृजीषिन् । कुविन्म ऋषिं पपिवांसं सुतस्य कुविन्मे वस्वो अमृतस्य शिक्षाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kuvinmā gopāṃ karase janasya kuvidrājānaṃ maghavannṛjīṣin | kuvinma ṛṣiṃ papivāṃsaṃ sutasya kuvinme vasvo amṛtasya śikṣāḥ ||

translations.english: Possessor of wealth, accept of the spiritless Soma; make me the protector, or rather a monarch of men; make me verily a holy sage, a drinker of the libation; make me verily the possessor of imperishable wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: आ त्वा बृहन्तो हरयो युजाना अर्वागिन्द्र सधमादो वहन्तु । प्र ये द्विता दिव ऋञ्जन्त्याताः सुसम्मृष्टासो वृषभस्य मूराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tvā bṛhanto harayo yujānā arvāgindra sadhamādo vahantu | pra ye dvitā diva ṛñjantyātāḥ susammṛṣṭāso vṛṣabhasya mūrāḥ ||

translations.english: May your mighty horses, Indra, harnessed (in your car), and alike exhilaarated (by Soma), bring you our presence, for they are the destroyers (of the foes) of the showerer (of benefits), and kindly rubbed by his hand they traverse, going quickly, the regions of the sky, making them as it were twofold.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र पिब वृषधूतस्य वृष्ण आ यं ते श्येन उशते जभार । यस्य मदे च्यावयसि प्र कृष्टीर्यस्य मदे अप गोत्रा ववर्थ ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra piba vṛṣadhūtasya vṛṣṇa ā yaṃ te śyena uśate jabhāra | yasya made cyāvayasi pra kṛṣṭīryasya made apa gotrā vavartha ||

translations.english: Drink, Indra, of the bountiful (libation) expressed by the beneficent (stones); that which the falcon has borne to you desiring it, in whose exhilaration you cast down (opposing) men, in whose exhilaration you have set open the clouds.

mantras.sanskrit: शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन्भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ । शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नन्तं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau | śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||

translations.english: We invoke for our protection the opulent Indra distinguished in this combat, the leader in the food-bestowing (strife), hearing (our praises), terrible in battles, the destroyer of foes, the conqueror of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं ते अस्तु हर्यतः सोम आ हरिभिः सुतः । जुषाण इन्द्र हरिभिर्न आ गह्या तिष्ठ हरितं रथम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ te astu haryataḥ soma ā haribhiḥ sutaḥ | juṣāṇa indra haribhirna ā gahyā tiṣṭha haritaṃ ratham ||

translations.english: May this desirable and gratifying Soma expressed by the stones,by, Indra, for you ascend the verdant chariot, and with your tawny (steeds) come to us.

mantras.sanskrit: हर्यन्नुषसमर्चयः सूर्यं हर्यन्नरोचयः । विद्वाँश्चिकित्वान्हर्यश्व वर्धस इन्द्र विश्वा अभि श्रियः ॥
mantras.transliteration: haryannuṣasamarcayaḥ sūryaṃ haryannarocayaḥ | vidvā~ścikitvānharyaśva vardhasa indra viśvā abhi śriyaḥ ||

translations.english: Desiring (the Soma), you honour the dawn; desirng the Soma, yu have lighted up the sun; knowing and discriminating (all our wishes), lord of the tawny steeds, you augment upon us all (sorts of) prosperity.

mantras.sanskrit: द्यामिन्द्रो हरिधायसं पृथिवीं हरिवर्पसम् । अधारयद्धरितोर्भूरि भोजनं ययोरन्तर्हरिश्चरत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dyāmindro haridhāyasaṃ pṛthivīṃ harivarpasam | adhārayaddharitorbhūri bhojanaṃ yayorantarhariścarat ||

translations.english: Indra has upheld the yellow-rayed heaven; the verdant tinted earth; there is abundant pasture (for his steeds) in the two azure spheres of heaven and earth, between which Hari travels.

mantras.sanskrit: जज्ञानो हरितो वृषा विश्वमा भाति रोचनम् । हर्यश्वो हरितं धत्त आयुधमा वज्रं बाह्वोर्हरिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: jajñāno harito vṛṣā viśvamā bhāti rocanam | haryaśvo haritaṃ dhatta āyudhamā vajraṃ bāhvorharim ||

translations.english: The azure-coloured showerer (of benefits), illumes, as soon as born, the whole luminous region; the lord of the tawny steeds holds in his hands the yellow weapon, the destroying thunderbolt.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रो हर्यन्तमर्जुनं वज्रं शुक्रैरभीवृतम् । अपावृणोद्धरिभिरद्रिभिः सुतमुद्गा हरिभिराजत ॥
mantras.transliteration: indro haryantamarjunaṃ vajraṃ śukrairabhīvṛtam | apāvṛṇoddharibhiradribhiḥ sutamudgā haribhirājata ||

translations.english: Indra has uncovered the desirable white-coloured, fast-flowing Soma, effused by the expressing stones, and overlaid with the shining (milk and other liquids), in like manner as when, borne by his tawny steeds, he rescued the cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: आ मन्द्रैरिन्द्र हरिभिर्याहि मयूररोमभिः । मा त्वा के चिन्नि यमन्विं न पाशिनोऽति धन्वेव ताँ इहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā mandrairindra haribhiryāhi mayūraromabhiḥ | mā tvā ke cinni yamanviṃ na pāśino'ti dhanveva tā~ ihi ||

translations.english: Come,Indra, with your exulting peacock-haired steeds; let no person ns detain you, as (fowlers) throwing snares catch a bird;pass them by (quickly) as (travellers cross) a desert.

mantras.sanskrit: वृत्रखादो वलंरुजः पुरां दर्मो अपामजः । स्थाता रथस्य हर्योरभिस्वर इन्द्रो दृळ्हा चिदारुजः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛtrakhādo valaṃrujaḥ purāṃ darmo apāmajaḥ | sthātā rathasya haryorabhisvara indro dṛḷhā cidārujaḥ ||

translations.english: The evourer of Vṛtra, the fracturer of the cloud, the sender of the waters, the demolisher of cities, Indra, the destroyer of powerful enemies, has mounted his chariot to urge his horses to our presence.

mantras.sanskrit: गम्भीराँ उदधीँरिव क्रतुं पुष्यसि गा इव । प्र सुगोपा यवसं धेनवो यथा ह्रदं कुल्या इवाशत ॥
mantras.transliteration: gambhīrā~ udadhī~riva kratuṃ puṣyasi gā iva | pra sugopā yavasaṃ dhenavo yathā hradaṃ kulyā ivāśata ||

translations.english: You cherish the celebrator of the pious rite as you fill the deep seas (with water); or as a careful herdsman (cherishes) the cows; (you imbibe the Soma) as cows (obtain) fodder, (and the Soma juices) flow into you as rivulets flow into a lake.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नस्तुजं रयिं भरांशं न प्रतिजानते । वृक्षं पक्वं फलमङ्कीव धूनुहीन्द्र सम्पारणं वसु ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā nastujaṃ rayiṃ bharāṃśaṃ na pratijānate | vṛkṣaṃ pakvaṃ phalamaṅkīva dhūnuhīndra sampāraṇaṃ vasu ||

translations.english: Grant us riches, securing (us against foes), (as a father bestows) his portion on (a son) arrived at maturity; send down upon us, Indra, wealth adequate (to our desires), as a crookbringd down the ripe fruit from a tree.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वयुरिन्द्र स्वराळसि स्मद्दिष्टिः स्वयशस्तरः । स वावृधान ओजसा पुरुष्टुत भवा नः सुश्रवस्तमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: svayurindra svarāḷasi smaddiṣṭiḥ svayaśastaraḥ | sa vāvṛdhāna ojasā puruṣṭuta bhavā naḥ suśravastamaḥ ||

translations.english: You are possessed of opulence, Indra; you are the lord of heaven, auspicious and renowned; may you who is adored of many, increasing in vigour, be to us a most (bountiful bestower) of food.

mantras.sanskrit: युध्मस्य ते वृषभस्य स्वराज उग्रस्य यूनः स्थविरस्य घृष्वेः । अजूर्यतो वज्रिणो वीर्याणीन्द्र श्रुतस्य महतो महानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yudhmasya te vṛṣabhasya svarāja ugrasya yūnaḥ sthavirasya ghṛṣveḥ | ajūryato vajriṇo vīryāṇīndra śrutasya mahato mahāni ||

translations.english: Vast are the energies of you, Indra, the warrior, (the showerer of benefits), the lord of wealth, the fierce; who is (both) young and old; the overcomer of foes, the undecaying, the wielder of the thunderbolt, and who is mighty and renowned.

mantras.sanskrit: महाँ असि महिष वृष्ण्येभिर्धनस्पृदुग्र सहमानो अन्यान् । एको विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजा स योधया च क्षयया च जनान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahā~ asi mahiṣa vṛṣṇyebhirdhanaspṛdugra sahamāno anyān | eko viśvasya bhuvanasya rājā sa yodhayā ca kṣayayā ca janān ||

translations.english: Adorable and powerful Indra, you are great and magnificent, overcoming adversaries by your prowess; you alone are lord of all the world; do you war (upon our enemies), and give safe dwellings to men.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र मात्राभी रिरिचे रोचमानः प्र देवेभिर्विश्वतो अप्रतीतः । प्र मज्मना दिव इन्द्रः पृथिव्याः प्रोरोर्महो अन्तरिक्षादृजीषी ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra mātrābhī ririce rocamānaḥ pra devebhirviśvato apratītaḥ | pra majmanā diva indraḥ pṛthivyāḥ prorormaho antarikṣādṛjīṣī ||

translations.english: The resplendent and every way unlimited Indra, drinking the spiritless Soma, far surpasses the elements, (far exceeds) the gods in power; he is more vast than heaven and earth, or the widespread spacious firmament.

mantras.sanskrit: उरुं गभीरं जनुषाभ्युग्रं विश्वव्यचसमवतं मतीनाम् । इन्द्रं सोमासः प्रदिवि सुतासः समुद्रं न स्रवत आ विशन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: uruṃ gabhīraṃ januṣābhyugraṃ viśvavyacasamavataṃ matīnām | indraṃ somāsaḥ pradivi sutāsaḥ samudraṃ na sravata ā viśanti ||

translations.english: The Soma daily poured out enter into the vast and profund Indra, fierce from his birth, all-pervading, the protector of the pious (worshipper), as rivers flow into the sea.

mantras.sanskrit: यं सोममिन्द्र पृथिवीद्यावा गर्भं न माता बिभृतस्त्वाया । तं ते हिन्वन्ति तमु ते मृजन्त्यध्वर्यवो वृषभ पातवा उ ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ somamindra pṛthivīdyāvā garbhaṃ na mātā bibhṛtastvāyā | taṃ te hinvanti tamu te mṛjantyadhvaryavo vṛṣabha pātavā u ||

translations.english: Which Soma, Indra, the heaven and earth, containing for you, as a mother contains the embryo; showerer (of benefits), the priests pour it out for you they purify it for your drinking.

mantras.sanskrit: मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र वृषभो रणाय पिबा सोममनुष्वधं मदाय । आ सिञ्चस्व जठरे मध्व ऊर्मिं त्वं राजासि प्रदिवः सुतानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: marutvā~ indra vṛṣabho raṇāya pibā somamanuṣvadhaṃ madāya | ā siñcasva jaṭhare madhva ūrmiṃ tvaṃ rājāsi pradivaḥ sutānām ||

translations.english: Indra, attended by the Maruts, the showerer (of benefits), drink the Soma offered after the other presentations, for your exhilaration for battle; take into your belly the (full) wave of the inebriating (Soma), for you are lord of libations from the days of old.

mantras.sanskrit: सजोषा इन्द्र सगणो मरुद्भिः सोमं पिब वृत्रहा शूर विद्वान् । जहि शत्रूँरप मृधो नुदस्वाथाभयं कृणुहि विश्वतो नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sajoṣā indra sagaṇo marudbhiḥ somaṃ piba vṛtrahā śūra vidvān | jahi śatrū~rapa mṛdho nudasvāthābhayaṃ kṛṇuhi viśvato naḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, hero, rejoicing with and accompanied by the host of Maruts, drink the Soma, for you are the slayer of Vṛtra the sage; subdue our enemies, drive away the malevolent, make us safe on every side from peril.

mantras.sanskrit: उत ऋतुभिॠतुपाः पाहि सोममिन्द्र देवेभिः सखिभिः सुतं नः । याँ आभजो मरुतो ये त्वान्वहन्वृत्रमदधुस्तुभ्यमोजः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta ṛtubhiṝtupāḥ pāhi somamindra devebhiḥ sakhibhiḥ sutaṃ naḥ | yā~ ābhajo maruto ye tvānvahanvṛtramadadhustubhyamojaḥ ||

translations.english: Drinker of the Soma in season, drink with your divine friend the Maruts the Soma that is presented by us; those Maruts whose aid you have enjoyed (in battle), and who, following you have given you the strength whereby you have slain Vṛtra.

mantras.sanskrit: ये त्वाहिहत्ये मघवन्नवर्धन्ये शाम्बरे हरिवो ये गविष्टौ । ये त्वा नूनमनुमदन्ति विप्राः पिबेन्द्र सोमं सगणो मरुद्भिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye tvāhihatye maghavannavardhanye śāmbare harivo ye gaviṣṭau | ye tvā nūnamanumadanti viprāḥ pibendra somaṃ sagaṇo marudbhiḥ ||

translations.english: They who encouraged you, Maghavan, to slay Ahi, who (aided you) in the conflict with Śambara, and in the recovery of the cattle, and who, possessed of wisdom, contribute verily to your exhilaration, with them, the troop of the maruts, do you Indra, drink the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: मरुत्वन्तं वृषभं वावृधानमकवारिं दिव्यं शासमिन्द्रम् । विश्वासाहमवसे नूतनायोग्रं सहोदामिह तं हुवेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: marutvantaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ vāvṛdhānamakavāriṃ divyaṃ śāsamindram | viśvāsāhamavase nūtanāyograṃ sahodāmiha taṃ huvema ||

translations.english: We invoke to this sacrifice for present protection Indra, the chief of the Maruts, the showerer (of benefits) augmenting (in glory), overcoming many foes, divine regulator (of good and ill), the subduer of all (enemies), the fierce, the bestower of strength.

mantras.sanskrit: सद्यो ह जातो वृषभः कनीनः प्रभर्तुमावदन्धसः सुतस्य । साधोः पिब प्रतिकामं यथा ते रसाशिरः प्रथमं सोम्यस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: sadyo ha jāto vṛṣabhaḥ kanīnaḥ prabhartumāvadandhasaḥ sutasya | sādhoḥ piba pratikāmaṃ yathā te rasāśiraḥ prathamaṃ somyasya ||

translations.english: May the showerer (of rain), who, as soon as born, is the object of affection, protect the offerer of the effused libation; drink at will, Indra, before (the other gods), of the pure Soma mixed with milk.

mantras.sanskrit: यज्जायथास्तदहरस्य कामेंऽशोः पीयूषमपिबो गिरिष्ठाम् । तं ते माता परि योषा जनित्री महः पितुर्दम आसिञ्चदग्रे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajjāyathāstadaharasya kāmeṃ'śoḥ pīyūṣamapibo giriṣṭhām | taṃ te mātā pari yoṣā janitrī mahaḥ piturdama āsiñcadagre ||

translations.english: On the day on which you were born, you did drink at will the mountain-abiding nectar of this Soma, for your youthful parent mother (Aditi), in the dwelling of your great sire (Kaśyapa), gave it to you before she gave the breast.

mantras.sanskrit: उपस्थाय मातरमन्नमैट्ट तिग्ममपश्यदभि सोममूधः । प्रयावयन्नचरद्गृत्सो अन्यान्महानि चक्रे पुरुधप्रतीकः ॥
mantras.transliteration: upasthāya mātaramannamaiṭṭa tigmamapaśyadabhi somamūdhaḥ | prayāvayannacaradgṛtso anyānmahāni cakre purudhapratīkaḥ ||

translations.english: Approaching his mother he asked for food, and beheld the acrid Soma upon her bosom; eager he proceeds, dislodging the adversaries (of the gods); and, putting forth manifold (energy), he performed great (deeds).

mantras.sanskrit: उग्रस्तुराषाळभिभूत्योजा यथावशं तन्वं चक्र एषः । त्वष्टारमिन्द्रो जनुषाभिभूयामुष्या सोममपिबच्चमूषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: ugrasturāṣāḷabhibhūtyojā yathāvaśaṃ tanvaṃ cakra eṣaḥ | tvaṣṭāramindro januṣābhibhūyāmuṣyā somamapibaccamūṣu ||

translations.english: Fierce, rapid in assault, of overpowering strength he made his form obedient to his will; having overcome Tvaṣṭā by his innate (vigour), and carried off the Soma, he draink it (deposited) in the ladles.

mantras.sanskrit: शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन्भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ । शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नन्तं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau | śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||

translations.english: We invoke for our protection the opulent Indra, distinguished in this combat, the leader in the food-bestowing (strife), hearing (our praises), terrible in battles, the destroyer of foes, the conqueror of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: शंसा महामिन्द्रं यस्मिन्विश्वा आ कृष्टयः सोमपाः काममव्यन् । यं सुक्रतुं धिषणे विभ्वतष्टं घनं वृत्राणां जनयन्त देवाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaṃsā mahāmindraṃ yasminviśvā ā kṛṣṭayaḥ somapāḥ kāmamavyan | yaṃ sukratuṃ dhiṣaṇe vibhvataṣṭaṃ ghanaṃ vṛtrāṇāṃ janayanta devāḥ ||

translations.english: I glorify the mighty Indra, in whom all men, drinking the Soma, obtain their wishes; whom the powerful (heaven and earth) and the gods begot, the doer of great deeds, the slayer of the Vṛtras, who was fashioned by Vibhu (the creator).

mantras.sanskrit: यं नु नकिः पृतनासु स्वराजं द्विता तरति नृतमं हरिष्ठाम् । इनतमः सत्वभिर्यो ह शूषैः पृथुज्रया अमिनादायुर्दस्योः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ nu nakiḥ pṛtanāsu svarājaṃ dvitā tarati nṛtamaṃ hariṣṭhām | inatamaḥ satvabhiryo ha śūṣaiḥ pṛthujrayā aminādāyurdasyoḥ ||

translations.english: Whom, when borne by his steeds, foremost and eminent in battles, breaking in two the (hostile host), no one ever surpasses; supreme in a way, attended by his faithful Maruts, and hastening to combat, he has destroyed with foe-withering (energies) the existence of the Dasyu.

mantras.sanskrit: सहावा पृत्सु तरणिर्नार्वा व्यानशी रोदसी मेहनावान् । भगो न कारे हव्यो मतीनां पितेव चारुः सुहवो वयोधाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sahāvā pṛtsu taraṇirnārvā vyānaśī rodasī mehanāvān | bhago na kāre havyo matīnāṃ piteva cāruḥ suhavo vayodhāḥ ||

translations.english: Vigorous, rushing through (hostile hosts), like a war-horse, he has pervaded heaven and earth, sending down rain; he is to be worshipped with oblations at the solemn (rite) like Bhaga; he is as the father of those who adore (him); he is beautiful, worthy of invocation, the bestower of food.

mantras.sanskrit: धर्ता दिवो रजसस्पृष्ट ऊर्ध्वो रथो न वायुर्वसुभिर्नियुत्वान् । क्षपां वस्ता जनिता सूर्यस्य विभक्ता भागं धिषणेव वाजम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhartā divo rajasaspṛṣṭa ūrdhvo ratho na vāyurvasubhirniyutvān | kṣapāṃ vastā janitā sūryasya vibhaktā bhāgaṃ dhiṣaṇeva vājam ||

translations.english: The upholder of heaven and of the firmament, the wind, like a chariot traversing the upper (region) accompanied by the Vasus; the clother of the night (with gloom), the parent of the sun, the distributor of the portion (allotted to the pious), like the words (of the wealthy appropriating to all) the food.

mantras.sanskrit: शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन्भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ । शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नन्तं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau | śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||

translations.english: We invoke for our protection the opulent Indra, distinguished in this combat, the leader in the food-bestowing (strife), hearing (our praises), terrible in battles, the destroyer of foes, the conqueror of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रः स्वाहा पिबतु यस्य सोम आगत्या तुम्रो वृषभो मरुत्वान् । ओरुव्यचाः पृणतामेभिरन्नैरास्य हविस्तन्वः काममृध्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraḥ svāhā pibatu yasya soma āgatyā tumro vṛṣabho marutvān | oruvyacāḥ pṛṇatāmebhirannairāsya havistanvaḥ kāmamṛdhyāḥ ||

translations.english: May Indra drink the libation; he of whom is the Soma, having come to the sacrifice; he who is the repeller (of adversaries), the showerer (of benefits), the lord of the Maruts; may he, the wide-pervading, be plural ased with these (sacrificial) viands; may the oblation be adequate to the wants of his body.

mantras.sanskrit: आ ते सपर्यू जवसे युनज्मि ययोरनु प्रदिवः श्रुष्टिमावः । इह त्वा धेयुर्हरयः सुशिप्र पिबा त्वस्य सुषुतस्य चारोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā te saparyū javase yunajmi yayoranu pradivaḥ śruṣṭimāvaḥ | iha tvā dheyurharayaḥ suśipra pibā tvasya suṣutasya cāroḥ ||

translations.english: I yoke (to your car), to bring you quickly, your two docile horses, whose speed you have of old employed; may your horses, handsome Indra, bring you hither, and drink promptly of this well-effused agreeable libation.

mantras.sanskrit: गोभिर्मिमिक्षुं दधिरे सुपारमिन्द्रं ज्यैष्ठ्याय धायसे गृणानाः । मन्दानः सोमं पपिवाँ ऋजीषिन्त्समस्मभ्यं पुरुधा गा इषण्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: gobhirmimikṣuṃ dadhire supāramindraṃ jyaiṣṭhyāya dhāyase gṛṇānāḥ | mandānaḥ somaṃ papivā~ ṛjīṣintsamasmabhyaṃ purudhā gā iṣaṇya ||

translations.english: His adorers support with cattle, Indra, who is willing to bestow upon them their desires, and ready to come to the sacrifice, for the sake of obtaining eminent prosperity and prolonged life; acceptor of the spiritless Soma, who are the drinker of the Soma, and are exhilarated (by the draught), grant to us freely cattle in abundance.

mantras.sanskrit: इमं कामं मन्दया गोभिरश्वैश्चन्द्रवता राधसा पप्रथश्च । स्वर्यवो मतिभिस्तुभ्यं विप्रा इन्द्राय वाहः कुशिकासो अक्रन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: imaṃ kāmaṃ mandayā gobhiraśvaiścandravatā rādhasā paprathaśca | svaryavo matibhistubhyaṃ viprā indrāya vāhaḥ kuśikāso akran ||

translations.english: Gratify this our desire (of wealth) with cows, with horses, with shining treasure, and make us renowned; the wise Kuśikas, desirous of heaven, offer praise of you, Indra, with pious (prayers).

mantras.sanskrit: शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन्भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ । शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नन्तं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau | śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||

translations.english: We invoke for our protection the opulent Indra, distinguished in this combat, the leader in the food-bestowing (strife), hearing (our praises), terrible in battles, the destroyer of foes, the conqueror of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: चर्षणीधृतं मघवानमुक्थ्यमिन्द्रं गिरो बृहतीरभ्यनूषत । वावृधानं पुरुहूतं सुवृक्तिभिरमर्त्यं जरमाणं दिवेदिवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: carṣaṇīdhṛtaṃ maghavānamukthyamindraṃ giro bṛhatīrabhyanūṣata | vāvṛdhānaṃ puruhūtaṃ suvṛktibhiramartyaṃ jaramāṇaṃ divedive ||

translations.english: Let abundant praises celebrate Indra, the stay of man, the possessor of opulence, the adorable, prospering with increase, the invoked of many, the immortal, who is daily to be propitiated with sacred hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: शतक्रतुमर्णवं शाकिनं नरं गिरो म इन्द्रमुप यन्ति विश्वतः । वाजसनिं पूर्भिदं तूर्णिमप्तुरं धामसाचमभिषाचं स्वर्विदम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śatakratumarṇavaṃ śākinaṃ naraṃ giro ma indramupa yanti viśvataḥ | vājasaniṃ pūrbhidaṃ tūrṇimapturaṃ dhāmasācamabhiṣācaṃ svarvidam ||

translations.english: My praises constantly propitiate Indra, the object of many rites, the sender of rain, attended by the Maruts, the leader (of all), the giver of food, the destroyer of cities, the swift (in combat), the prompt (dispenser) of waters, the distributor of riches, the subduer of foes, the conferrer of heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: आकरे वसोर्जरिता पनस्यतेऽनेहसः स्तुभ इन्द्रो दुवस्यति । विवस्वतः सदन आ हि पिप्रिये सत्रासाहमभिमातिहनं स्तुहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ākare vasorjaritā panasyate'nehasaḥ stubha indro duvasyati | vivasvataḥ sadana ā hi pipriye satrāsāhamabhimātihanaṃ stuhi ||

translations.english: Indra, the enfeebler (of adversaries), is praised as a mine of wealth; he is propitiated by righteous commendations; he is gratified in the dwelling of the offerer of oblations; glorify Indra, the conqueror, the destroyer of his enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: नृणामु त्वा नृतमं गीर्भिरुक्थैरभि प्र वीरमर्चता सबाधः । सं सहसे पुरुमायो जिहीते नमो अस्य प्रदिव एक ईशे ॥
mantras.transliteration: nṛṇāmu tvā nṛtamaṃ gīrbhirukthairabhi pra vīramarcatā sabādhaḥ | saṃ sahase purumāyo jihīte namo asya pradiva eka īśe ||

translations.english: The priests glorify you, heroic leader of men, with praises and with prayers; Indra, the author of many delusions, exerts himself for (the acquisition of) strength; he from of old is the lord of this (oblation).

mantras.sanskrit: पूर्वीरस्य निष्षिधो मर्त्येषु पुरू वसूनि पृथिवी बिभर्ति । इन्द्राय द्याव ओषधीरुतापो रयिं रक्षन्ति जीरयो वनानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: pūrvīrasya niṣṣidho martyeṣu purū vasūni pṛthivī bibharti | indrāya dyāva oṣadhīrutāpo rayiṃ rakṣanti jīrayo vanāni ||

translations.english: Many are his prohibitions (against evil enjoined) to men; many are the treasures that the earth enshrines; for Indra the heavens, the plural nts, the waters, men and priests, preserve their riches.

mantras.sanskrit: तुभ्यं ब्रह्माणि गिर इन्द्र तुभ्यं सत्रा दधिरे हरिवो जुषस्व । बोध्यापिरवसो नूतनस्य सखे वसो जरितृभ्यो वयो धाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tubhyaṃ brahmāṇi gira indra tubhyaṃ satrā dadhire harivo juṣasva | bodhyāpiravaso nūtanasya sakhe vaso jaritṛbhyo vayo dhāḥ ||

translations.english: To you, Indra, (the pious) address prayers, and praises, and sacrifices; accept them, lord of horses; give all things, partake of this present oblation, and grant food to the worshippers.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र मरुत्व इह पाहि सोमं यथा शार्याते अपिबः सुतस्य । तव प्रणीती तव शूर शर्मन्ना विवासन्ति कवयः सुयज्ञाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra marutva iha pāhi somaṃ yathā śāryāte apibaḥ sutasya | tava praṇītī tava śūra śarmannā vivāsanti kavayaḥ suyajñāḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, accompanied, by the Maruts, drink the Soma at this ceremony as you have drunk of this libation of the son of Śāryāti; your far-reaching and devout worshippers, being in security, adore you through their offerings.

mantras.sanskrit: स वावशान इह पाहि सोमं मरुद्भिरिन्द्र सखिभिः सुतं नः । जातं यत्त्वा परि देवा अभूषन्महे भराय पुरुहूत विश्वे ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa vāvaśāna iha pāhi somaṃ marudbhirindra sakhibhiḥ sutaṃ naḥ | jātaṃ yattvā pari devā abhūṣanmahe bharāya puruhūta viśve ||

translations.english: Do you, Indra, who is gratified by the Soma, drink the Soma that has been effused by us, together with your friends, the Maruts, at this ceremony; you who is invoked of many, and whom all the gods equipped as soon as born for the great battle (with the asuras).

mantras.sanskrit: अप्तूर्ये मरुत आपिरेषोऽमन्दन्निन्द्रमनु दातिवाराः । तेभिः साकं पिबतु वृत्रखादः सुतं सोमं दाशुषः स्वे सधस्थे ॥
mantras.transliteration: aptūrye maruta āpireṣo'mandannindramanu dātivārāḥ | tebhiḥ sākaṃ pibatu vṛtrakhādaḥ sutaṃ somaṃ dāśuṣaḥ sve sadhasthe ||

translations.english: Maruts, this is your friend for sending of the waters; they (the Maruts), the givers of strength, have yielded Indra gratification; may the devourer of Vṛtra drink with them the libation offered by the worshipper in his abode.

mantras.sanskrit: इदं ह्यन्वोजसा सुतं राधानां पते । पिबा त्वस्य गिर्वणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: idaṃ hyanvojasā sutaṃ rādhānāṃ pate | pibā tvasya girvaṇaḥ ||

translations.english: Lord of riches, entitled to praise, this libation has been effused agreeably to (our) strength; do you drink of it quickly.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्ते अनु स्वधामसत्सुते नि यच्छ तन्वम् । स त्वा ममत्तु सोम्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaste anu svadhāmasatsute ni yaccha tanvam | sa tvā mamattu somyam ||

translations.english: Invigorate your body with the Soma that has been poured out as food for you; may it exhilarate you, delighting in the Soma draught.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ते अश्नोतु कुक्ष्योः प्रेन्द्र ब्रह्मणा शिरः । प्र बाहू शूर राधसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra te aśnotu kukṣyoḥ prendra brahmaṇā śiraḥ | pra bāhū śūra rādhase ||

translations.english: May this libation, Indra, penetrate to your flanks; may it, (aided) by prayer, reach your head; may it spread, hero, through your arms, (that they may distribute) wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: धानावन्तं करम्भिणमपूपवन्तमुक्थिनम् । इन्द्र प्रातर्जुषस्व नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhānāvantaṃ karambhiṇamapūpavantamukthinam | indra prātarjuṣasva naḥ ||

translations.english: Accept, Indra, at our morning sacrifice, this libation, combined with fresh barley, with parched grain and curds, and with cakes, and sanctified by holy prayer.

mantras.sanskrit: पुरोळाशं पचत्यं जुषस्वेन्द्रा गुरस्व च । तुभ्यं हव्यानि सिस्रते ॥
mantras.transliteration: puroḷāśaṃ pacatyaṃ juṣasvendrā gurasva ca | tubhyaṃ havyāni sisrate ||

translations.english: Accept, Indra, the prepared cakes and butter; eat them eagerly; the oblations flow for you.

mantras.sanskrit: पुरोळाशं च नो घसो जोषयासे गिरश्च नः । वधूयुरिव योषणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: puroḷāśaṃ ca no ghaso joṣayāse giraśca naḥ | vadhūyuriva yoṣaṇām ||

translations.english: Eat, Indra, our (offered) cakes and butter, derive enjoyment from our praises, as a lover from his mistress.

mantras.sanskrit: पुरोळाशं सनश्रुत प्रातःसावे जुषस्व नः । इन्द्र क्रतुर्हि ते बृहन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: puroḷāśaṃ sanaśruta prātaḥsāve juṣasva naḥ | indra kraturhi te bṛhan ||

translations.english: Indra, renowned of old, accept our cakes and butter, offered at dawn; for great are your deeds.

mantras.sanskrit: माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य धानाः पुरोळाशमिन्द्र कृष्वेह चारुम् । प्र यत्स्तोता जरिता तूर्ण्यर्थो वृषायमाण उप गीर्भिरीट्टे ॥
mantras.transliteration: mādhyaṃdinasya savanasya dhānāḥ puroḷāśamindra kṛṣveha cārum | pra yatstotā jaritā tūrṇyartho vṛṣāyamāṇa upa gīrbhirīṭṭe ||

translations.english: Partake, Indra, of the barley and the delicious cakes and butter of the midday sacrifice, when your zealous worshipper, hastening to adore you, and eager as a bull, is present, and celebrates (yo) with hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: तृतीये धानाः सवने पुरुष्टुत पुरोळाशमाहुतं मामहस्व नः । ऋभुमन्तं वाजवन्तं त्वा कवे प्रयस्वन्त उप शिक्षेम धीतिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tṛtīye dhānāḥ savane puruṣṭuta puroḷāśamāhutaṃ māmahasva naḥ | ṛbhumantaṃ vājavantaṃ tvā kave prayasvanta upa śikṣema dhītibhiḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, who is praised of many, accept readily from our friend of barley, and cakes, and butter, offered at the third (or evening) sacrifice; ladenwith sacrificial viands, we approach with praises to your sage Indra, who is accompanied by the ṛbhus and by Vāja.

mantras.sanskrit: पूषण्वते ते चकृमा करम्भं हरिवते हर्यश्वाय धानाः । अपूपमद्धि सगणो मरुद्भिः सोमं पिब वृत्रहा शूर विद्वान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pūṣaṇvate te cakṛmā karambhaṃ harivate haryaśvāya dhānāḥ | apūpamaddhi sagaṇo marudbhiḥ somaṃ piba vṛtrahā śūra vidvān ||

translations.english: We have prepared the parched grain and curds for you, associated with Pūṣan; the fried barley for you, lord of the tawny horses, associated with your steeds; attend by the troop of Maruts, eat the cakes; hero, who is wise, and the slayer of Vṛtra, drink the libation.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रति धाना भरत तूयमस्मै पुरोळाशं वीरतमाय नृणाम् । दिवेदिवे सदृशीरिन्द्र तुभ्यं वर्धन्तु त्वा सोमपेयाय धृष्णो ॥
mantras.transliteration: prati dhānā bharata tūyamasmai puroḷāśaṃ vīratamāya nṛṇām | divedive sadṛśīrindra tubhyaṃ vardhantu tvā somapeyāya dhṛṣṇo ||

translations.english: Offer to him quickly (priests) the fried barley; offer to the most heroic of leaders the cakes and butter; may the like offerings, victorious Indra, presented to you daily, augment your vigour for the drinking of the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रापर्वता बृहता रथेन वामीरिष आ वहतं सुवीराः । वीतं हव्यान्यध्वरेषु देवा वर्धेथां गीर्भिरिळया मदन्ता ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāparvatā bṛhatā rathena vāmīriṣa ā vahataṃ suvīrāḥ | vītaṃ havyānyadhvareṣu devā vardhethāṃ gīrbhiriḷayā madantā ||

translations.english: Indra and Parvata, bring hither, in a spacious car, delightful viands (genitive rative of) good progeny; partake, deities, of the oblations (offered)at (our) sacrifices, and gratified by the (sacrificial) food, be elevated by our praises.

mantras.sanskrit: तिष्ठा सु कं मघवन्मा परा गाः सोमस्य नु त्वा सुषुतस्य यक्षि । पितुर्न पुत्रः सिचमा रभे त इन्द्र स्वादिष्ठया गिरा शचीवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tiṣṭhā su kaṃ maghavanmā parā gāḥ somasya nu tvā suṣutasya yakṣi | piturna putraḥ sicamā rabhe ta indra svādiṣṭhayā girā śacīvaḥ ||

translations.english: Tarry a while contentedly, Maghavan (at our rite); go not away; for I offer to you (the libation) of the copiously-effused Soma; powerful Indra, I lay hold of the skirts (of your robe) with sweet-flavoured commendations, as a son (clings to the garment) of a father.

mantras.sanskrit: शंसावाध्वर्यो प्रति मे गृणीहीन्द्राय वाहः कृणवाव जुष्टम् । एदं बर्हिर्यजमानस्य सीदाथा च भूदुक्थमिन्द्राय शस्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaṃsāvādhvaryo prati me gṛṇīhīndrāya vāhaḥ kṛṇavāva juṣṭam | edaṃ barhiryajamānasya sīdāthā ca bhūdukthamindrāya śastam ||

translations.english: Adhvaryu, let us two offer praise; do you concur with me; let us address plural asing praise to Indra; sit down, Indra, on the sacred grass (prepared by) the instrumental tutor of the rite; and may our commendations be most acceptable to Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: जायेदस्तं मघवन्त्सेदु योनिस्तदित्त्वा युक्ता हरयो वहन्तु । यदा कदा च सुनवाम सोममग्निष्ट्वा दूतो धन्वात्यच्छ ॥
mantras.transliteration: jāyedastaṃ maghavantsedu yonistadittvā yuktā harayo vahantu | yadā kadā ca sunavāma somamagniṣṭvā dūto dhanvātyaccha ||

translations.english: A man's wife, Maghavan, is hiw dwelling; verily she is his plural ce of birth; thither let your horses, harnessed (to your car), convey you; we prepare the Soma at the fit season; may Agni come as our messenger befor eyou.

mantras.sanskrit: परा याहि मघवन्ना च याहीन्द्र भ्रातरुभयत्रा ते अर्थम् । यत्रा रथस्य बृहतो निधानं विमोचनं वाजिनो रासभस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: parā yāhi maghavannā ca yāhīndra bhrātarubhayatrā te artham | yatrā rathasya bṛhato nidhānaṃ vimocanaṃ vājino rāsabhasya ||

translations.english: Depart, Maghavan; come Indra; both ways, protector, there is a motive for you whether it be standing in your vast chariot, or liberating your neighing steed.

mantras.sanskrit: अपाः सोममस्तमिन्द्र प्र याहि कल्याणीर्जाया सुरणं गृहे ते । यत्रा रथस्य बृहतो निधानं विमोचनं वाजिनो दक्षिणावत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: apāḥ somamastamindra pra yāhi kalyāṇīrjāyā suraṇaṃ gṛhe te | yatrā rathasya bṛhato nidhānaṃ vimocanaṃ vājino dakṣiṇāvat ||

translations.english: When you have drunk the Soma, then, Indra, go home; an auspicious life (abides) plural asantly in your dwelling; in either (case) there is the standing in your car or liberating the steeds for provender.

mantras.sanskrit: इमे भोजा अङ्गिरसो विरूपा दिवस्पुत्रासो असुरस्य वीराः । विश्वामित्राय ददतो मघानि सहस्रसावे प्र तिरन्त आयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ime bhojā aṅgiraso virūpā divasputrāso asurasya vīrāḥ | viśvāmitrāya dadato maghāni sahasrasāve pra tiranta āyuḥ ||

translations.english: These (sacrificers) are the Bhojas, of whom the diversified Aṅgirasas (are the priests); and the heroic sons of the expeller (of the foes of the gods) from heaven, bestowing riches upon Viśvāmitra at the sacrifice of a thousand (victims), prolong (his) life.

mantras.sanskrit: रूपंरूपं मघवा बोभवीति मायाः कृण्वानस्तन्वं परि स्वाम् । त्रिर्यद्दिवः परि मुहूर्तमागात्स्वैर्मन्त्रैरनृतुपा ऋतावा ॥
mantras.transliteration: rūpaṃrūpaṃ maghavā bobhavīti māyāḥ kṛṇvānastanvaṃ pari svām | triryaddivaḥ pari muhūrtamāgātsvairmantrairanṛtupā ṛtāvā ||

translations.english: Maghavan becomes repeatedly (manifest) in various forms, practising delusions with respect to his own peculiar person n; and invoked by his appropriate prayers, he comes in a moment from heaven to the three (daily rites), and, although observant of seasons, is the drinker (of the Soma) irrespective of season.

mantras.sanskrit: महाँ ऋषिर्देवजा देवजूतोऽस्तभ्नात्सिन्धुमर्णवं नृचक्षाः । विश्वामित्रो यदवहत्सुदासमप्रियायत कुशिकेभिरिन्द्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahā~ ṛṣirdevajā devajūto'stabhnātsindhumarṇavaṃ nṛcakṣāḥ | viśvāmitro yadavahatsudāsamapriyāyata kuśikebhirindraḥ ||

translations.english: The great ṛṣi the genitive rator of the gods, the attracted by the deities, the overlooker of the leaders (at holy rites), Viśvāmitra attested the watery stream when he sacrificed for Sudās; Indra, with the Kuśikas was plural ased.

mantras.sanskrit: हंसा इव कृणुथ श्लोकमद्रिभिर्मदन्तो गीर्भिरध्वरे सुते सचा । देवेभिर्विप्रा ऋषयो नृचक्षसो वि पिबध्वं कुशिकाः सोम्यं मधु ॥
mantras.transliteration: haṃsā iva kṛṇutha ślokamadribhirmadanto gīrbhiradhvare sute sacā | devebhirviprā ṛṣayo nṛcakṣaso vi pibadhvaṃ kuśikāḥ somyaṃ madhu ||

translations.english: Sages and saints overlookers of the leaders (of sacred rites), Kuśikas, when the Soma is expresssed with stones at the sacrifice, then exhilarating (the gods) with praises, sing the holy strain (aloud) like (screaming) swans, and, together with the gods, drink the sweet juice of the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: उप प्रेत कुशिकाश्चेतयध्वमश्वं राये प्र मुञ्चता सुदासः । राजा वृत्रं जङ्घनत्प्रागपागुदगथा यजाते वर आ पृथिव्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa preta kuśikāścetayadhvamaśvaṃ rāye pra muñcatā sudāsaḥ | rājā vṛtraṃ jaṅghanatprāgapāgudagathā yajāte vara ā pṛthivyāḥ ||

translations.english: Approach, Kuśikas, the steed of Sudās; animate (him), and let him loose to (win) riches (for the raja); for the king (of the gods) has slain Vṛtra in the East, in the West, in the North, therefore let (Sudās) worship him in the best (regions) of the earth.

mantras.sanskrit: य इमे रोदसी उभे अहमिन्द्रमतुष्टवम् । विश्वामित्रस्य रक्षति ब्रह्मेदं भारतं जनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya ime rodasī ubhe ahamindramatuṣṭavam | viśvāmitrasya rakṣati brahmedaṃ bhārataṃ janam ||

translations.english: I have made Indra glorified by these two, heaven and earth, and this prayer of Viśvāmitra protects the race of Bharata.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वामित्रा अरासत ब्रह्मेन्द्राय वज्रिणे । करदिन्नः सुराधसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvāmitrā arāsata brahmendrāya vajriṇe | karadinnaḥ surādhasaḥ ||

translations.english: The Viśvāmitras have addressed the prayer to Indra, the wielder of the thunderbolt; may he therefore render us very opulent.

mantras.sanskrit: किं ते कृण्वन्ति कीकटेषु गावो नाशिरं दुह्रे न तपन्ति घर्मम् । आ नो भर प्रमगन्दस्य वेदो नैचाशाखं मघवन्रन्धया नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kiṃ te kṛṇvanti kīkaṭeṣu gāvo nāśiraṃ duhre na tapanti gharmam | ā no bhara pramagandasya vedo naicāśākhaṃ maghavanrandhayā naḥ ||

translations.english: What do the cattle for you among the Kīkaṭas; they yield no milk to mix with the Soma, they need not the vessel (for the libation); bring them to us; (bring also) the wealth of the son of the usurer, and give us Maghavan, (the possessions) of the low branches (of the community).

mantras.sanskrit: ससर्परीरमतिं बाधमाना बृहन्मिमाय जमदग्निदत्ता । आ सूर्यस्य दुहिता ततान श्रवो देवेष्वमृतमजुर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sasarparīramatiṃ bādhamānā bṛhanmimāya jamadagnidattā | ā sūryasya duhitā tatāna śravo deveṣvamṛtamajuryam ||

translations.english: The daughter of Sūrya given by Jamadagni gliding everywhere and dissipating ignorance, has emitted a mighty (sound), and has diffused ambrosial imperishable food among the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: ससर्परीरभरत्तूयमेभ्योऽधि श्रवः पाञ्चजन्यासु कृष्टिषु । सा पक्ष्या नव्यमायुर्दधाना यां मे पलस्तिजमदग्नयो ददुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sasarparīrabharattūyamebhyo'dhi śravaḥ pāñcajanyāsu kṛṣṭiṣu | sā pakṣyā navyamāyurdadhānā yāṃ me palastijamadagnayo daduḥ ||

translations.english: May she, gliding everywhere, quickly bring us food (suited) to the five races of men; may she, the daughter of the sun whom the grey-haired jamadagnis gave to me, (be) the bestower of new life.

mantras.sanskrit: स्थिरौ गावौ भवतां वीळुरक्षो मेषा वि वर्हि मा युगं वि शारि । इन्द्रः पातल्ये ददतां शरीतोररिष्टनेमे अभि नः सचस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: sthirau gāvau bhavatāṃ vīḷurakṣo meṣā vi varhi mā yugaṃ vi śāri | indraḥ pātalye dadatāṃ śarītorariṣṭaneme abhi naḥ sacasva ||

translations.english: May the horse be steady, the axle be strong, the pole be not defective, the yoke not be rotten; may Indra preserve the two yoke-pins from decay; car with uninjured felloes, be ready for us.

mantras.sanskrit: बलं धेहि तनूषु नो बलमिन्द्रानळुत्सु नः । बलं तोकाय तनयाय जीवसे त्वं हि बलदा असि ॥
mantras.transliteration: balaṃ dhehi tanūṣu no balamindrānaḷutsu naḥ | balaṃ tokāya tanayāya jīvase tvaṃ hi baladā asi ||

translations.english: Give strength, Indra, to our bodies; give strength to our vehicles; (give) strength to our sons and grandsons; that they may live (long); for you are giver of strength.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि व्ययस्व खदिरस्य सारमोजो धेहि स्पन्दने शिंशपायाम् । अक्ष वीळो वीळित वीळयस्व मा यामादस्मादव जीहिपो नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi vyayasva khadirasya sāramojo dhehi spandane śiṃśapāyām | akṣa vīḷo vīḷita vīḷayasva mā yāmādasmādava jīhipo naḥ ||

translations.english: Fix firmly the substance of the khayar (axle), give solidity to the śiśu (floor) of the car; strong axle, strongly fixed by us, be strong; cast us not from out of our conveyance.

mantras.sanskrit: अयमस्मान्वनस्पतिर्मा च हा मा च रीरिषत् । स्वस्त्या गृहेभ्य आवसा आ विमोचनात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayamasmānvanaspatirmā ca hā mā ca rīriṣat | svastyā gṛhebhya āvasā ā vimocanāt ||

translations.english: May this lord of the forest never desert us nor do us harm; may we travel prosperously home until the stopping (of the car), until the unharnessing (of the steeds).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रोतिभिर्बहुलाभिर्नो अद्य याच्छ्रेष्ठाभिर्मघवञ्छूर जिन्व । यो नो द्वेष्ट्यधरः सस्पदीष्ट यमु द्विष्मस्तमु प्राणो जहातु ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrotibhirbahulābhirno adya yācchreṣṭhābhirmaghavañchūra jinva | yo no dveṣṭyadharaḥ saspadīṣṭa yamu dviṣmastamu prāṇo jahātu ||

translations.english: Indra, hero,possessor of wealth, protect us this day against our foes with many and excellent defences; may the vile wretch who hates us fall (before us); may the breath of life depart from him whom we hate.

mantras.sanskrit: परशुं चिद्वि तपति शिम्बलं चिद्वि वृश्चति । उखा चिदिन्द्र येषन्ती प्रयस्ता फेनमस्यति ॥
mantras.transliteration: paraśuṃ cidvi tapati śimbalaṃ cidvi vṛścati | ukhā cidindra yeṣantī prayastā phenamasyati ||

translations.english: As (the tree) suffers pain from the axe, as the śimbal flower is (easily) cut off, as the injured cauldron leaking scatters foam, so may mine enemy perish.

mantras.sanskrit: न सायकस्य चिकिते जनासो लोधं नयन्ति पशु मन्यमानाः । नावाजिनं वाजिना हासयन्ति न गर्दभं पुरो अश्वान्नयन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: na sāyakasya cikite janāso lodhaṃ nayanti paśu manyamānāḥ | nāvājinaṃ vājinā hāsayanti na gardabhaṃ puro aśvānnayanti ||

translations.english: Men, (the might) of the destroyer is not known toyou; regarding him as a mere animal, they lead him away desirous (silently to complete his devotions); the wise condescend not to turn the foolish into ridicule, they do not lead the ass before the horse.

mantras.sanskrit: इम इन्द्र भरतस्य पुत्रा अपपित्वं चिकितुर्न प्रपित्वम् । हिन्वन्त्यश्वमरणं न नित्यं ज्यावाजं परि णयन्त्याजौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: ima indra bharatasya putrā apapitvaṃ cikiturna prapitvam | hinvantyaśvamaraṇaṃ na nityaṃ jyāvājaṃ pari ṇayantyājau ||

translations.english: These sons of Bharata, Indra, understand severance (from the Vasiṣṭhas), not association (with them); they urge their steeds (against them) as against a constant foe; they bear a stout bow (for their destruction) in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: इमं महे विदथ्याय शूषं शश्वत्कृत्व ईड्याय प्र जभ्रुः । शृणोतु नो दम्येभिरनीकैः शृणोत्वग्निर्दिव्यैरजस्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imaṃ mahe vidathyāya śūṣaṃ śaśvatkṛtva īḍyāya pra jabhruḥ | śṛṇotu no damyebhiranīkaiḥ śṛṇotvagnirdivyairajasraḥ ||

translations.english: They recite repeatedly this gratifying praise to the great product of sacrifice (Agni); may he who is (endowed) with domestic radiance hear us; may the imperishable Agni, (endowed) with divine radiance, hear us.

mantras.sanskrit: महि महे दिवे अर्चा पृथिव्यै कामो म इच्छञ्चरति प्रजानन् । ययोर्ह स्तोमे विदथेषु देवाः सपर्यवो मादयन्ते सचायोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahi mahe dive arcā pṛthivyai kāmo ma icchañcarati prajānan | yayorha stome vidatheṣu devāḥ saparyavo mādayante sacāyoḥ ||

translations.english: Knowing their greatness, offer worship to the vast heaven and to the earth; my desire, wishing (for felicity) proceed (to them), in whose praise the gods,desirous of adoration, delight together with their worshippers at the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: युवोॠतं रोदसी सत्यमस्तु महे षु णः सुविताय प्र भूतम् । इदं दिवे नमो अग्ने पृथिव्यै सपर्यामि प्रयसा यामि रत्नम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvoṝtaṃ rodasī satyamastu mahe ṣu ṇaḥ suvitāya pra bhūtam | idaṃ dive namo agne pṛthivyai saparyāmi prayasā yāmi ratnam ||

translations.english: Heaven and earth, may your truth be ever inviolable; be propitious to us for the due completion of the rite; this adoration (Agni) is offered to heaven and earth; I worship (them) with (sacrificial) food; I solicit of them precious (wealth).

mantras.sanskrit: उतो हि वां पूर्व्या आविविद्र ऋतावरी रोदसी सत्यवाचः । नरश्चिद्वां समिथे शूरसातौ ववन्दिरे पृथिवि वेविदानाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uto hi vāṃ pūrvyā āvividra ṛtāvarī rodasī satyavācaḥ | naraścidvāṃ samithe śūrasātau vavandire pṛthivi vevidānāḥ ||

translations.english: Heaven and earth, endowed with truth, they who are the ancient declarers of the truth, have obtained from you (what they desired); and so, earth, men cognizant (of the greaness of you both) have worshipped you for the sake of triumphing over (hostile) heroes in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: को अद्धा वेद क इह प्र वोचद्देवाँ अच्छा पथ्या का समेति । ददृश्र एषामवमा सदांसि परेषु या गुह्येषु व्रतेषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: ko addhā veda ka iha pra vocaddevā~ acchā pathyā kā sameti | dadṛśra eṣāmavamā sadāṃsi pareṣu yā guhyeṣu vrateṣu ||

translations.english: Who knows what is the truth, or who may here declare it? What is the proper path that leads to the gods? Their inferior abiding plural ces are beheld, as are those which (are situated) in superior mysterious rites.

mantras.sanskrit: कविर्नृचक्षा अभि षीमचष्ट ऋतस्य योना विघृते मदन्ती । नाना चक्राते सदनं यथा वेः समानेन क्रतुना संविदाने ॥
mantras.transliteration: kavirnṛcakṣā abhi ṣīmacaṣṭa ṛtasya yonā vighṛte madantī | nānā cakrāte sadanaṃ yathā veḥ samānena kratunā saṃvidāne ||

translations.english: The far-seeing beholder of mankind (the sun), surveys this heaven and earth, rejoicing when deficient in moisture in the womb of the waters (the firmament), both concurring in community (of function), although they occupy various dwellings, like the diversified nests of a bird.

mantras.sanskrit: समान्या वियुते दूरेअन्ते ध्रुवे पदे तस्थतुर्जागरूके । उत स्वसारा युवती भवन्ती आदु ब्रुवाते मिथुनानि नाम ॥
mantras.transliteration: samānyā viyute dūreante dhruve pade tasthaturjāgarūke | uta svasārā yuvatī bhavantī ādu bruvāte mithunāni nāma ||

translations.english: Common (in function), disjoined, of distant termination, they remain vigilant in a permanent station; being, as it were, sisters, and ever young; they therefore address each other by twin appellations.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वेदेते जनिमा सं विविक्तो महो देवान्बिभ्रती न व्यथेते । एजद्ध्रुवं पत्यते विश्वमेकं चरत्पतत्रि विषुणं वि जातम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvedete janimā saṃ vivikto maho devānbibhratī na vyathete | ejaddhruvaṃ patyate viśvamekaṃ caratpatatri viṣuṇaṃ vi jātam ||

translations.english: These two keep all born things discrete, and, although comprehending the great divinities, are not distressed; all moving and stationary beings rest upon one (basis), whether animals, or birds, or creatures of various kinds.

mantras.sanskrit: सना पुराणमध्येम्यारान्महः पितुर्जनितुर्जामि तन्नः । देवासो यत्र पनितार एवैरुरौ पथि व्युते तस्थुरन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sanā purāṇamadhyemyārānmahaḥ piturjaniturjāmi tannaḥ | devāso yatra panitāra evairurau pathi vyute tasthurantaḥ ||

translations.english: I consider at present the eternal and ancient sisterhood to us of you, our great protectress and progenitrix, within whose vast and separated path your eulogists, the gods, travel in their chariots.

mantras.sanskrit: इमं स्तोमं रोदसी प्र ब्रवीम्यृदूदराः शृणवन्नग्निजिह्वाः । मित्रः सम्राजो वरुणो युवान आदित्यासः कवयः पप्रथानाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imaṃ stomaṃ rodasī pra bravīmyṛdūdarāḥ śṛṇavannagnijihvāḥ | mitraḥ samrājo varuṇo yuvāna ādityāsaḥ kavayaḥ paprathānāḥ ||

translations.english: I repeat this hymn, heaven and earth, to you; and may the soft-bellied, fire-tongued Mitra, royal Varuṇa, the youthful Ādityas, all cognizant of the past, and proclaiming (their own acts), hear it.

mantras.sanskrit: हिरण्यपाणिः सविता सुजिह्वस्त्रिरा दिवो विदथे पत्यमानः । देवेषु च सवितः श्लोकमश्रेरादस्मभ्यमा सुव सर्वतातिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: hiraṇyapāṇiḥ savitā sujihvastrirā divo vidathe patyamānaḥ | deveṣu ca savitaḥ ślokamaśrerādasmabhyamā suva sarvatātim ||

translations.english: The golden-handed, soft-tongued Savitā is descending from heaven (to be present) thrice (daily) at the sacrifice; accept, Savitā, the praise (recited) by the worshippers, and thereupon grant to us all our desires.

mantras.sanskrit: सुकृत्सुपाणिः स्ववाँ ऋतावा देवस्त्वष्टावसे तानि नो धात् । पूषण्वन्त ऋभवो मादयध्वमूर्ध्वग्रावाणो अध्वरमतष्ट ॥
mantras.transliteration: sukṛtsupāṇiḥ svavā~ ṛtāvā devastvaṣṭāvase tāni no dhāt | pūṣaṇvanta ṛbhavo mādayadhvamūrdhvagrāvāṇo adhvaramataṣṭa ||

translations.english: May the divine Tvaṣṭā, the able artificer, the dextrous-handed, the possessor of wealth, the observer of truth, bestow upon us those things (which are necessary) for our preservation; ṛbhus, associated with Pūṣan, make us joyful, as they (the priests), with uplifted stones, prepare the sacred libation.

mantras.sanskrit: विद्युद्रथा मरुत ऋष्टिमन्तो दिवो मर्या ऋतजाता अयासः । सरस्वती शृणवन्यज्ञियासो धाता रयिं सहवीरं तुरासः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vidyudrathā maruta ṛṣṭimanto divo maryā ṛtajātā ayāsaḥ | sarasvatī śṛṇavanyajñiyāso dhātā rayiṃ sahavīraṃ turāsaḥ ||

translations.english: May the Maruts, whose cars are the lightning, who are armed with spears, resplendent, destroyers of foes, from whom the waters proceed, (who are) unresting and adorable, and may Sarasvatī hear (my prayer); and may you (maruts), speedy in your liberality, bestow (upon us) riches and good offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: विष्णुं स्तोमासः पुरुदस्ममर्का भगस्येव कारिणो यामनि ग्मन् । उरुक्रमः ककुहो यस्य पूर्वीर्न मर्धन्ति युवतयो जनित्रीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viṣṇuṃ stomāsaḥ purudasmamarkā bhagasyeva kāriṇo yāmani gman | urukramaḥ kakuho yasya pūrvīrna mardhanti yuvatayo janitrīḥ ||

translations.english: May (our) praises and prayers, the causes of good fortune, attain at this sacrifice Viṣṇu, the object of many rites; he, the wide-stepping; whose commands the many-blending regions of space, the genitive rators (of all beings), do not disobey.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रो विश्वैर्वीर्यैः पत्यमान उभे आ पप्रौ रोदसी महित्वा । पुरंदरो वृत्रहा धृष्णुषेणः संगृभ्या न आ भरा भूरि पश्वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indro viśvairvīryaiḥ patyamāna ubhe ā paprau rodasī mahitvā | puraṃdaro vṛtrahā dhṛṣṇuṣeṇaḥ saṃgṛbhyā na ā bharā bhūri paśvaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, invested with all energies, has filled both heaven and earth with his greatness; do you, who are the destroyer of cities, the slayer of Vṛtra, the leader of a conquering host, collect cattle and bestow them abundantly upon us.

mantras.sanskrit: नासत्या मे पितरा बन्धुपृच्छा सजात्यमश्विनोश्चारु नाम । युवं हि स्थो रयिदौ नो रयीणां दात्रं रक्षेथे अकवैरदब्धा ॥
mantras.transliteration: nāsatyā me pitarā bandhupṛcchā sajātyamaśvinoścāru nāma | yuvaṃ hi stho rayidau no rayīṇāṃ dātraṃ rakṣethe akavairadabdhā ||

translations.english: Nāsatyas, my protectors, inquirers (after the wishes) of your kinsman, beautiful is your cognate appellation of Aśvins; be to us the liberal donors of riches; do you, who are irresistible, protect the offerer (of the oblation) with unblameable (defences).]

mantras.sanskrit: महत्तद्वः कवयश्चारु नाम यद्ध देवा भवथ विश्व इन्द्रे । सख ऋभुभिः पुरुहूत प्रियेभिरिमां धियं सातये तक्षता नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahattadvaḥ kavayaścāru nāma yaddha devā bhavatha viśva indre | sakha ṛbhubhiḥ puruhūta priyebhirimāṃ dhiyaṃ sātaye takṣatā naḥ ||

translations.english: Sages acquainted with the past, excellent is that beautiful appellation under which you have both become gods in (the sphere of) Indra; do you, Indra, the invoked of many, a friend, (associated) with the beloved ṛbhus, shape this prayer for our benefit.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्यमा णो अदितिर्यज्ञियासोऽदब्धानि वरुणस्य व्रतानि । युयोत नो अनपत्यानि गन्तोः प्रजावान्नः पशुमाँ अस्तु गातुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aryamā ṇo aditiryajñiyāso'dabdhāni varuṇasya vratāni | yuyota no anapatyāni gantoḥ prajāvānnaḥ paśumā~ astu gātuḥ ||

translations.english: May Aryaman, Aditi, the adorable (gods), and the unimpeded functions of Varuṇa (protect) us; keep us from (following) the course unpropitious to offspring, and may our dwelling be abundant in progeny and cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: देवानां दूतः पुरुध प्रसूतोऽनागान्नो वोचतु सर्वताता । शृणोतु नः पृथिवी द्यौरुतापः सूर्यो नक्षत्रैरुर्वन्तरिक्षम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: devānāṃ dūtaḥ purudha prasūto'nāgānno vocatu sarvatātā | śṛṇotu naḥ pṛthivī dyaurutāpaḥ sūryo nakṣatrairurvantarikṣam ||

translations.english: May the messenger of the gods, engendered in many plural ces, everywhere proclaim us void of offence; may earth and heaven, the waters, the sun, and the vast firmament, with the constellation, hear us.

mantras.sanskrit: शृण्वन्तु नो वृषणः पर्वतासो ध्रुवक्षेमास इळया मदन्तः । आदित्यैर्नो अदितिः शृणोतु यच्छन्तु नो मरुतः शर्म भद्रम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śṛṇvantu no vṛṣaṇaḥ parvatāso dhruvakṣemāsa iḷayā madantaḥ | ādityairno aditiḥ śṛṇotu yacchantu no marutaḥ śarma bhadram ||

translations.english: May the (divine) showerers (of benefits), the deities of the mountains, and those abiding in fixed habitations, propitiated by the sacrificial food, hear us; may Aditi, with the Ādityas, heqar us; may the Maruts grant us auspicious felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: सदा सुगः पितुमाँ अस्तु पन्था मध्वा देवा ओषधीः सं पिपृक्त । भगो मे अग्ने सख्ये न मृध्या उद्रायो अश्यां सदनं पुरुक्षोः ॥
