translations.english: How may we present rejoicing (fit offering) to Agni the showerer (of benefits); to Vaiśvānara, he, who, bright with great lustre, sustains the heaven, with his entire vast and insupportable (bulk), as a pillar (sustains a roof).

mantras.sanskrit: मा निन्दत य इमां मह्यं रातिं देवो ददौ मर्त्याय स्वधावान् । पाकाय गृत्सो अमृतो विचेता वैश्वानरो नृतमो यह्वो अग्निः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā nindata ya imāṃ mahyaṃ rātiṃ devo dadau martyāya svadhāvān | pākāya gṛtso amṛto vicetā vaiśvānaro nṛtamo yahvo agniḥ ||

translations.english: Reproach not the divine (Agni), who, accepting the oblation, has given this wealth to me, his mortal (worshipper) of mature (intellect); Agni, who is wise, immortal, discriminating, (who is) Vaiśvānara, chief conductor (of rites), the mighty.

mantras.sanskrit: साम द्विबर्हा महि तिग्मभृष्टिः सहस्ररेता वृषभस्तुविष्मान् । पदं न गोरपगूळ्हं विविद्वानग्निर्मह्यं प्रेदु वोचन्मनीषाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sāma dvibarhā mahi tigmabhṛṣṭiḥ sahasraretā vṛṣabhastuviṣmān | padaṃ na gorapagūḷhaṃ vividvānagnirmahyaṃ predu vocanmanīṣām ||

translations.english: May Agni, filling both (the middling and most excellent condition), bright shining, of manifold vigour, the showerer of (benefits), the possessor of affluence, (who comprehends), by (his) wisdom the mysterious sacred hymn, as (they track) the footsteps of a (missing) cow, reveal (the sense) to me.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ताँ अग्निर्बभसत्तिग्मजम्भस्तपिष्ठेन शोचिषा यः सुराधाः । प्र ये मिनन्ति वरुणस्य धाम प्रिया मित्रस्य चेततो ध्रुवाणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra tā~ agnirbabhasattigmajambhastapiṣṭhena śociṣā yaḥ surādhāḥ | pra ye minanti varuṇasya dhāma priyā mitrasya cetato dhruvāṇi ||

translations.english: May the sharp-toothed Agni, possessed of excellent wealth, consume with his fierce radiance those (adversaries) who injure the firm and valued glories of the sapient Varuṇa and Mitra.

mantras.sanskrit: अभ्रातरो न योषणो व्यन्तः पतिरिपो न जनयो दुरेवाः । पापासः सन्तो अनृता असत्या इदं पदमजनता गभीरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhrātaro na yoṣaṇo vyantaḥ patiripo na janayo durevāḥ | pāpāsaḥ santo anṛtā asatyā idaṃ padamajanatā gabhīram ||

translations.english: Like women who have no brethren, going (about from their own to their father's house), women adverse to their lords going astray, so the wicked, false (in thought), false (in speech), they give birth to this deep abyss (of hell).

mantras.sanskrit: इदं मे अग्ने कियते पावकामिनते गुरुं भारं न मन्म । बृहद्दधाथ धृषता गभीरं यह्वं पृष्ठं प्रयसा सप्तधातु ॥
mantras.transliteration: idaṃ me agne kiyate pāvakāminate guruṃ bhāraṃ na manma | bṛhaddadhātha dhṛṣatā gabhīraṃ yahvaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ prayasā saptadhātu ||

translations.english: Purifier, Agni, bestow on me, not neglecting your worship, this acceptable and vast (wealth), like a heavy load on a feeble (bearer), together with invigorating food; (wealth), secure, abundant, tangible, and consisting of the seven elements.

mantras.sanskrit: तमिन्न्वेव समना समानमभि क्रत्वा पुनती धीतिरश्याः । ससस्य चर्मन्नधि चारु पृश्नेरग्रे रुप आरुपितं जबारु ॥
mantras.transliteration: taminnveva samanā samānamabhi kratvā punatī dhītiraśyāḥ | sasasya carmannadhi cāru pṛśneragre rupa ārupitaṃ jabāru ||

translations.english: May our (self) purifying praise, suited to his glory, and accompanied by worship, quickly attain to that omniform (Vaiśvānara) whose swift-ascending brilliant (orb) is stationed on the east of the earth, to mount, like the sun, above this immoveable heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रवाच्यं वचसः किं मे अस्य गुहा हितमुप निणिग्वदन्ति । यदुस्रियाणामप वारिव व्रन्पाति प्रियं रुपो अग्रं पदं वेः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pravācyaṃ vacasaḥ kiṃ me asya guhā hitamupa niṇigvadanti | yadusriyāṇāmapa vāriva vranpāti priyaṃ rupo agraṃ padaṃ veḥ ||

translations.english: What objection (can be offered) to this my assertion, that they affirm that the milk of the kine, which (the milkers) obtain like water, is plural ced in concealment (by Vaiśvānara), and cherishes the excellent and valued expanse of the wide earth.

mantras.sanskrit: इदमु त्यन्महि महामनीकं यदुस्रिया सचत पूर्व्यं गौः । ऋतस्य पदे अधि दीद्यानं गुहा रघुष्यद्रघुयद्विवेद ॥
mantras.transliteration: idamu tyanmahi mahāmanīkaṃ yadusriyā sacata pūrvyaṃ gauḥ | ṛtasya pade adhi dīdyānaṃ guhā raghuṣyadraghuyadviveda ||

translations.english: I recognize this adorable assemblage of the great (deities), which from of old the milk-shedding cow affects, shining above the region of water, (the firmament), in secret; swift gliding, swift moving.

mantras.sanskrit: अध द्युतानः पित्रोः सचासामनुत गुह्यं चारु पृश्नेः । मातुष्पदे परमे अन्ति षद्गोर्वृष्णः शोचिषः प्रयतस्य जिह्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha dyutānaḥ pitroḥ sacāsāmanuta guhyaṃ cāru pṛśneḥ | mātuṣpade parame anti ṣadgorvṛṣṇaḥ śociṣaḥ prayatasya jihvā ||

translations.english: Then, radiant in association with the parents, (heaven and earth), he is awakened (to drink) the agreeable secretion of the cow, and the tongue of the assiduous (performer of holy rites), the resplendent showerer (of benefits), approaching the excellent station of the maternal (cow), seeks to drink the milk.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतं वोचे नमसा पृच्छ्यमानस्तवाशसा जातवेदो यदीदम् । त्वमस्य क्षयसि यद्ध विश्वं दिवि यदु द्रविणं यत्पृथिव्याम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtaṃ voce namasā pṛcchyamānastavāśasā jātavedo yadīdam | tvamasya kṣayasi yaddha viśvaṃ divi yadu draviṇaṃ yatpṛthivyām ||

translations.english: Interrogated with respect, I declare the truth, that this (wealth is acquired), Jātavedas, by the praise of you; you rule over it, (over) all that (it may be), the wealth that is in heaven or on earth.

mantras.sanskrit: किं नो अस्य द्रविणं कद्ध रत्नं वि नो वोचो जातवेदश्चिकित्वान् । गुहाध्वनः परमं यन्नो अस्य रेकु पदं न निदाना अगन्म ॥
mantras.transliteration: kiṃ no asya draviṇaṃ kaddha ratnaṃ vi no voco jātavedaścikitvān | guhādhvanaḥ paramaṃ yanno asya reku padaṃ na nidānā aganma ||

translations.english: What is the value of this (wealth) to us? what is its advantage? inform us, Jātavedas, for you know; (tell us) what is the best (course) for us on this secret path, so that we may follow unreproached the direct road.

mantras.sanskrit: का मर्यादा वयुना कद्ध वाममच्छा गमेम रघवो न वाजम् । कदा नो देवीरमृतस्य पत्नीः सूरो वर्णेन ततनन्नुषासः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kā maryādā vayunā kaddha vāmamacchā gamema raghavo na vājam | kadā no devīramṛtasya patnīḥ sūro varṇena tatanannuṣāsaḥ ||

translations.english: Wha tis the limit, what are the objects, which is the desirable (end) to which we rush like swift (chargers) to the battle? when for us will the divine dawns, the brides of the immortal (sun), overspread (the world) with light.

mantras.sanskrit: अनिरेण वचसा फल्ग्वेन प्रतीत्येन कृधुनातृपासः । अधा ते अग्ने किमिहा वदन्त्यनायुधास आसता सचन्ताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: anireṇa vacasā phalgvena pratītyena kṛdhunātṛpāsaḥ | adhā te agne kimihā vadantyanāyudhāsa āsatā sacantām ||

translations.english: (Men are) not satisfied by unproductive, frivolous, inconclusive, scanty speech; then what, Agni, do they here say to you? devoid of the implements (of worship), let them suffer from distress.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य श्रिये समिधानस्य वृष्णो वसोरनीकं दम आ रुरोच । रुशद्वसानः सुदृशीकरूपः क्षितिर्न राया पुरुवारो अद्यौत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya śriye samidhānasya vṛṣṇo vasoranīkaṃ dama ā ruroca | ruśadvasānaḥ sudṛśīkarūpaḥ kṣitirna rāyā puruvāro adyaut ||

translations.english: For the prosperity of this (instrumental tutor of the rite), the host (of the flames) of the kindled (Agni), the showerer (of benefits), the giver of dwellings, has blazed in the hall (of sacrifice); clothed in radiance, beautiful in semblance, and glorified by many, he shines like a man with opulence.

mantras.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्व ऊ षु णो अध्वरस्य होतरग्ने तिष्ठ देवताता यजीयान् । त्वं हि विश्वमभ्यसि मन्म प्र वेधसश्चित्तिरसि मनीषाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūrdhva ū ṣu ṇo adhvarasya hotaragne tiṣṭha devatātā yajīyān | tvaṃ hi viśvamabhyasi manma pra vedhasaścittirasi manīṣām ||

translations.english: Agni, ministrant of the sacrifice, do you who are entitled to worship, be above usin this offering to the gods; for you prevail over all that is desirable; you inspire the praise of the worshipper.

mantras.sanskrit: अमूरो होता न्यसादि विक्ष्वग्निर्मन्द्रो विदथेषु प्रचेताः । ऊर्ध्वं भानुं सवितेवाश्रेन्मेतेव धूमं स्तभायदुप द्याम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: amūro hotā nyasādi vikṣvagnirmandro vidatheṣu pracetāḥ | ūrdhvaṃ bhānuṃ savitevāśrenmeteva dhūmaṃ stabhāyadupa dyām ||

translations.english: The unperplexed, the sagacious, exhilarating Agni, the ministrant priest, has been plural ced among men for (the celebration of) sacrifices; like the sun, he spreads light above, and props the smoke above the sky like a pillar.

mantras.sanskrit: यता सुजूर्णी रातिनी घृताची प्रदक्षिणिद्देवतातिमुराणः । उदु स्वरुर्नवजा नाक्रः पश्वो अनक्ति सुधितः सुमेकः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatā sujūrṇī rātinī ghṛtācī pradakṣiṇiddevatātimurāṇaḥ | udu svarurnavajā nākraḥ paśvo anakti sudhitaḥ sumekaḥ ||

translations.english: The ladle filled (with butter) is prepared; prompt (in act), opulent (with the oblation), the multiplying (priest), conducting (the worship) of the gods, circumambulates (the fire); the newly-trimmed post is set up, the impending shining axe falls upon the victims.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तीर्णे बर्हिषि समिधाने अग्ना ऊर्ध्वो अध्वर्युर्जुजुषाणो अस्थात् । पर्यग्निः पशुपा न होता त्रिविष्ट्येति प्रदिव उराणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: stīrṇe barhiṣi samidhāne agnā ūrdhvo adhvaryurjujuṣāṇo asthāt | paryagniḥ paśupā na hotā triviṣṭyeti pradiva urāṇaḥ ||

translations.english: When the sacred grass is strewn and the fire is kindled, the Adhvaryu rises, propitiating (the gods), and Agni, the offerer of the oblation, ancient and multiplying (the offering), thrice circumambulates (the victim) like a keeper of cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: परि त्मना मितद्रुरेति होताग्निर्मन्द्रो मधुवचा ऋतावा । द्रवन्त्यस्य वाजिनो न शोका भयन्ते विश्वा भुवना यदभ्राट् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari tmanā mitadrureti hotāgnirmandro madhuvacā ṛtāvā | dravantyasya vājino na śokā bhayante viśvā bhuvanā yadabhrāṭ ||

translations.english: Agni, the sacrificer, the exhilarator, the sweet-spoken, the object of sacrifice, moving measuredly, circumambulates (the victim) of his own (accord); the bright (rays) of him (fed) with (sacrificial) food, spread around; all the regions are alarmed when he blazes.

mantras.sanskrit: भद्रा ते अग्ने स्वनीक संदृग्घोरस्य सतो विषुणस्य चारुः । न यत्ते शोचिस्तमसा वरन्त न ध्वस्मानस्तन्वी रेप आ धुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhadrā te agne svanīka saṃdṛgghorasya sato viṣuṇasya cāruḥ | na yatte śocistamasā varanta na dhvasmānastanvī repa ā dhuḥ ||

translations.english: Bright-shining, Agni, beautiful and auspicious is the semblance of you who are terrible and wide-spreading, for (the nights) hide not your splendour with darkness, nor do the malignant (spirits) inflict any injury on your person n.

mantras.sanskrit: न यस्य सातुर्जनितोरवारि न मातरापितरा नू चिदिष्टौ । अधा मित्रो न सुधितः पावकोऽग्निर्दीदाय मानुषीषु विक्षु ॥
mantras.transliteration: na yasya sāturjanitoravāri na mātarāpitarā nū cidiṣṭau | adhā mitro na sudhitaḥ pāvako'gnirdīdāya mānuṣīṣu vikṣu ||

translations.english: Of whom, progenitor (of mankind), the benevolence is never checked; whose parents need not urge him to exertion; so that the well-satisfied, purifying Agni shines like a friend among men, the descendants of Manu.

mantras.sanskrit: द्विर्यं पञ्च जीजनन्त्संवसानाः स्वसारो अग्निं मानुषीषु विक्षु । उषर्बुधमथर्यो न दन्तं शुक्रं स्वासं परशुं न तिग्मम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dviryaṃ pañca jījanantsaṃvasānāḥ svasāro agniṃ mānuṣīṣu vikṣu | uṣarbudhamatharyo na dantaṃ śukraṃ svāsaṃ paraśuṃ na tigmam ||

translations.english: Agni, whom the twice five sisters dwelling among men, the descendants of Manu, have engendered, like feminine les, (awaking) him at dawn, feeding on oblations, brilliant of goodly aspect, and shharp as an axe.

mantras.sanskrit: तव त्ये अग्ने हरितो घृतस्ना रोहितास ऋज्वञ्चः स्वञ्चः । अरुषासो वृषण ऋजुमुष्का आ देवतातिमह्वन्त दस्माः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava tye agne harito ghṛtasnā rohitāsa ṛjvañcaḥ svañcaḥ | aruṣāso vṛṣaṇa ṛjumuṣkā ā devatātimahvanta dasmāḥ ||

translations.english: Your horses, Agni, breathing foam, red-coloured, straight-going well-plural ced, bright-shining, vigorous, well-membered, and of graceful form, are summoned to the worthy of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: ये ह त्ये ते सहमाना अयासस्त्वेषासो अग्ने अर्चयश्चरन्ति । श्येनासो न दुवसनासो अर्थं तुविष्वणसो मारुतं न शर्धः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye ha tye te sahamānā ayāsastveṣāso agne arcayaścaranti | śyenāso na duvasanāso arthaṃ tuviṣvaṇaso mārutaṃ na śardhaḥ ||

translations.english: Those, your rays, Agni, triumphant, wide-spreading, radiant, adorable, go like hawk-faced horses (to their  goal), loud-sounding like the company of the Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: अकारि ब्रह्म समिधान तुभ्यं शंसात्युक्थं यजते व्यू धाः । होतारमग्निं मनुषो नि षेदुर्नमस्यन्त उशिजः शंसमायोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: akāri brahma samidhāna tubhyaṃ śaṃsātyukthaṃ yajate vyū dhāḥ | hotāramagniṃ manuṣo ni ṣedurnamasyanta uśijaḥ śaṃsamāyoḥ ||

translations.english: Well-kindled Agni, for you the prayer has been composed; may (the priest) propitiate (you) by (his) praise; the (sacrificer) offers worship; bestow upon us manifold (wealth); desiring (riches), men sit down adoring Agni, the invoker of the gods, the glorifier of mankind.

mantras.sanskrit: अयमिह प्रथमो धायि धातृभिर्होता यजिष्ठो अध्वरेष्वीड्यः । यमप्नवानो भृगवो विरुरुचुर्वनेषु चित्रं विभ्वं विशेविशे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayamiha prathamo dhāyi dhātṛbhirhotā yajiṣṭho adhvareṣvīḍyaḥ | yamapnavāno bhṛgavo virurucurvaneṣu citraṃ vibhvaṃ viśeviśe ||

translations.english: This invoker of the gods and minister of frequent worship, who is to be glorified at sacrifices, has been plural ced first (of the gods) by the performers of the rite; the Agni whom Apnavāna and other Bhṛgus lighted in the woods for the sake of all men, marvellous (in his acts), and soverign (over all).

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने कदा त आनुषग्भुवद्देवस्य चेतनम् । अधा हि त्वा जगृभ्रिरे मर्तासो विक्ष्वीड्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne kadā ta ānuṣagbhuvaddevasya cetanam | adhā hi tvā jagṛbhrire martāso vikṣvīḍyam ||

translations.english: When, Agni, is the light of you, bright-shining, to be manifested; for therefore have mortals accepted you as to be worshipped among mankind.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतावानं विचेतसं पश्यन्तो द्यामिव स्तृभिः । विश्वेषामध्वराणां हस्कर्तारं दमेदमे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtāvānaṃ vicetasaṃ paśyanto dyāmiva stṛbhiḥ | viśveṣāmadhvarāṇāṃ haskartāraṃ damedame ||

translations.english: Contemplating you in every dwelling, truthful intelligent, (brilliant with sparks) like the sky with stars, the perfecter of all sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: आशुं दूतं विवस्वतो विश्वा यश्चर्षणीरभि । आ जभ्रुः केतुमायवो भृगवाणं विशेविशे ॥
mantras.transliteration: āśuṃ dūtaṃ vivasvato viśvā yaścarṣaṇīrabhi | ā jabhruḥ ketumāyavo bhṛgavāṇaṃ viśeviśe ||

translations.english: Men have brought, for the sake of all people, the swift messenger of the worshipper (to the gods), who (rules) over all mankind, the manifester, the resplendent.

mantras.sanskrit: तमीं होतारमानुषक्चिकित्वांसं नि षेदिरे । रण्वं पावकशोचिषं यजिष्ठं सप्त धामभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamīṃ hotāramānuṣakcikitvāṃsaṃ ni ṣedire | raṇvaṃ pāvakaśociṣaṃ yajiṣṭhaṃ sapta dhāmabhiḥ ||

translations.english: They (the worshippers) have seated him in his due order, the invoker (of the gods), the intelligent, the agreeable, the purifyingly-radiant, the performer of frequent sacrifice, (brilliant) with seven flames.

mantras.sanskrit: तं शश्वतीषु मातृषु वन आ वीतमश्रितम् । चित्रं सन्तं गुहा हितं सुवेदं कूचिदर्थिनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ śaśvatīṣu mātṛṣu vana ā vītamaśritam | citraṃ santaṃ guhā hitaṃ suvedaṃ kūcidarthinam ||

translations.english: Him, abiding in the maternal (waters) and in the woods, loved, yet unapproached, wonderful, hidden in a cave, endowed with knowledge, seeking (oblations) from any quarter.

mantras.sanskrit: ससस्य यद्वियुता सस्मिन्नूधन्नृतस्य धामन्रणयन्त देवाः । महाँ अग्निर्नमसा रातहव्यो वेरध्वराय सदमिदृतावा ॥
mantras.transliteration: sasasya yadviyutā sasminnūdhannṛtasya dhāmanraṇayanta devāḥ | mahā~ agnirnamasā rātahavyo veradhvarāya sadamidṛtāvā ||

translations.english: Whom, when they desist from slumber, the devout propitiate in the abode of water at every sacrifice; the mighty Agni, to whom oblations are to be offered with reverence, who truthful always, accepts the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: वेरध्वरस्य दूत्यानि विद्वानुभे अन्ता रोदसी संचिकित्वान् । दूत ईयसे प्रदिव उराणो विदुष्टरो दिव आरोधनानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: veradhvarasya dūtyāni vidvānubhe antā rodasī saṃcikitvān | dūta īyase pradiva urāṇo viduṣṭaro diva ārodhanāni ||

translations.english: You who are all-knowing understand the functions of a messenger (of the gods) at the sacrifice; well informed of both heaven and earth and the intermediate (firmament), and a most intelligent, ancient, and amplifying envoy, you go up the ascents of heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: कृष्णं त एम रुशतः पुरो भाश्चरिष्ण्वर्चिर्वपुषामिदेकम् । यदप्रवीता दधते ह गर्भं सद्यश्चिज्जातो भवसीदु दूतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kṛṣṇaṃ ta ema ruśataḥ puro bhāścariṣṇvarcirvapuṣāmidekam | yadapravītā dadhate ha garbhaṃ sadyaścijjāto bhavasīdu dūtaḥ ||

translations.english: Dark is the path of you wo are bright; the light is before you; your moving radiance is the chief of (all luminous) bodies; when the present (worshippers) take up the germ (in the sticks of attrition) you are speedily genitive rated, and become indeed the messenger (of the sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: सद्यो जातस्य ददृशानमोजो यदस्य वातो अनुवाति शोचिः । वृणक्ति तिग्मामतसेषु जिह्वां स्थिरा चिदन्ना दयते वि जम्भैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sadyo jātasya dadṛśānamojo yadasya vāto anuvāti śociḥ | vṛṇakti tigmāmataseṣu jihvāṃ sthirā cidannā dayate vi jambhaiḥ ||

translations.english: The light of the speedily-genitive rated is visible, and when the win fans the flame, he (Agni) spreads his blazing tongue among the trees, and with his (glowing) teeth consumes the standing (fuel, his) food.

mantras.sanskrit: तृषु यदन्ना तृषुणा ववक्ष तृषुं दूतं कृणुते यह्वो अग्निः । वातस्य मेळिं सचते निजूर्वन्नाशुं न वाजयते हिन्वे अर्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: tṛṣu yadannā tṛṣuṇā vavakṣa tṛṣuṃ dūtaṃ kṛṇute yahvo agniḥ | vātasya meḷiṃ sacate nijūrvannāśuṃ na vājayate hinve arvā ||

translations.english: When quickly, with rapid (radiance), he has carried off his food, the mighty Agni makes (himself) the fleet messenger (of the worshipper); consuming (the fuel), he allies himself with the force of the wind, and as (a horseman) urges his fast steed, so the rapid going Agni, invigorates and urges (his flames).

mantras.sanskrit: दूतं वो विश्ववेदसं हव्यवाहममर्त्यम् । यजिष्ठमृञ्जसे गिरा ॥
mantras.transliteration: dūtaṃ vo viśvavedasaṃ havyavāhamamartyam | yajiṣṭhamṛñjase girā ||

translations.english: I propitiate you with praise, the messenger (of the gods), the omniscient, the bearer of oblations, the immortal, the chief sacrificer.

mantras.sanskrit: स हि वेदा वसुधितिं महाँ आरोधनं दिवः । स देवाँ एह वक्षति ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa hi vedā vasudhitiṃ mahā~ ārodhanaṃ divaḥ | sa devā~ eha vakṣati ||

translations.english: The mighty one knows how to bestow the (desired) wealth (upon the worshipper); he knows the ascents of heaven; may he bring the gods hither.

mantras.sanskrit: स वेद देव आनमं देवाँ ऋतायते दमे । दाति प्रियाणि चिद्वसु ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa veda deva ānamaṃ devā~ ṛtāyate dame | dāti priyāṇi cidvasu ||

translations.english: He, the divine (Agni), knows how the gods are to be reverenced; to the sincere (worshipper) in his dwelling he gives wealth that is desired.

mantras.sanskrit: स होता सेदु दूत्यं चिकित्वाँ अन्तरीयते । विद्वाँ आरोधनं दिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa hotā sedu dūtyaṃ cikitvā~ antarīyate | vidvā~ ārodhanaṃ divaḥ ||

translations.english: He is the invoker (of the gods), comprehending the deity of (their) messenger; and, knowing the ascent of the sky, he travels between earth and heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: ते स्याम ये अग्नये ददाशुर्हव्यदातिभिः । य ईं पुष्यन्त इन्धते ॥
mantras.transliteration: te syāma ye agnaye dadāśurhavyadātibhiḥ | ya īṃ puṣyanta indhate ||

translations.english: May we be they who propitiate Agni with gifts of oblations, and who, cherishing him, feed him with fuel.

mantras.sanskrit: ते राया ते सुवीर्यैः ससवांसो वि शृण्विरे । ये अग्ना दधिरे दुवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te rāyā te suvīryaiḥ sasavāṃso vi śṛṇvire | ye agnā dadhire duvaḥ ||

translations.english: They are renowned for riches and for progeny, who, venerating Agni, offer him oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मे रायो दिवेदिवे सं चरन्तु पुरुस्पृहः । अस्मे वाजास ईरताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asme rāyo divedive saṃ carantu puruspṛhaḥ | asme vājāsa īratām ||

translations.english: Many riches, envied by many, devolve upon us day by day, and (abundant) food await us.

mantras.sanskrit: स विप्रश्चर्षणीनां शवसा मानुषाणाम् । अति क्षिप्रेव विध्यति ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa vipraścarṣaṇīnāṃ śavasā mānuṣāṇām | ati kṣipreva vidhyati ||

translations.english: May the wise Agni entirely obviate, by his powe,r the removable (ills) of men the descendants of Manu.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने मृळ महाँ असि य ईमा देवयुं जनम् । इयेथ बर्हिरासदम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne mṛḷa mahā~ asi ya īmā devayuṃ janam | iyetha barhirāsadam ||

translations.english: Agni, make us happy, for you are mighty, (you) who come to this devout man to sit down on the sacred grass.

mantras.sanskrit: स मानुषीषु दूळभो विक्षु प्रावीरमर्त्यः । दूतो विश्वेषां भुवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa mānuṣīṣu dūḷabho vikṣu prāvīramartyaḥ | dūto viśveṣāṃ bhuvat ||

translations.english: May that Agni, who is difficult to overcome, who is immortal, who is pre-eminent among men the descendants of Manu, becomes the messenger of all the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: स सद्म परि णीयते होता मन्द्रो दिविष्टिषु । उत पोता नि षीदति ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa sadma pari ṇīyate hotā mandro diviṣṭiṣu | uta potā ni ṣīdati ||

translations.english: He is conveyed into the sacrificial hall as the Hotā to be adored at sacrifices, or as the Potā he sits down (on the sacred grass).

mantras.sanskrit: उत ग्ना अग्निरध्वर उतो गृहपतिर्दमे । उत ब्रह्मा नि षीदति ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta gnā agniradhvara uto gṛhapatirdame | uta brahmā ni ṣīdati ||

translations.english: Agni may be the officiating priest at the sacrifice, or the master of the house in the sacrificial chamber, or he sits down as the Brahman.

mantras.sanskrit: वेषि ह्यध्वरीयतामुपवक्ता जनानाम् । हव्या च मानुषाणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: veṣi hyadhvarīyatāmupavaktā janānām | havyā ca mānuṣāṇām ||

translations.english: You, who are the director (of the ceremonial), accept the oblations of devoutly-worshipping men the descendants of Manu.

mantras.sanskrit: वेषीद्वस्य दूत्यं यस्य जुजोषो अध्वरम् । हव्यं मर्तस्य वोळ्हवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: veṣīdvasya dūtyaṃ yasya jujoṣo adhvaram | havyaṃ martasya voḷhave ||

translations.english: You are willing (to fulfil) the office of messenger for the mortal whose oblations at the sacrifice you are plural ased to convey.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्माकं जोष्यध्वरमस्माकं यज्ञमङ्गिरः । अस्माकं शृणुधी हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmākaṃ joṣyadhvaramasmākaṃ yajñamaṅgiraḥ | asmākaṃ śṛṇudhī havam ||

translations.english: Be plural ased by our sacrifice; (be plural ased) Aṅgiras, by our offering hear our invocation.

mantras.sanskrit: परि ते दूळभो रथोऽस्माँ अश्नोतु विश्वतः । येन रक्षसि दाशुषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari te dūḷabho ratho'smā~ aśnotu viśvataḥ | yena rakṣasi dāśuṣaḥ ||

translations.english: May your inviolable car, whereby you defend the donors of oblations, be everywhere around us.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने तमद्याश्वं न स्तोमैः क्रतुं न भद्रं हृदिस्पृशम् । ऋध्यामा त ओहैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne tamadyāśvaṃ na stomaiḥ kratuṃ na bhadraṃ hṛdispṛśam | ṛdhyāmā ta ohaiḥ ||

translations.english: We celebrate you today, Agni, who are like a horse (in conveying our burden) with your praises, conveying (our wishes to the gods), and (who are) like a benefactor, propitious and affectionate.

mantras.sanskrit: अधा ह्यग्ने क्रतोर्भद्रस्य दक्षस्य साधोः । रथीॠतस्य बृहतो बभूथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhā hyagne kratorbhadrasya dakṣasya sādhoḥ | rathīṝtasya bṛhato babhūtha ||

translations.english: Be now the conveyer, Agni, of our auspicious, powerful, efficacious, truthful, and great sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: एभिर्नो अर्कैर्भवा नो अर्वाङ्स्वर्ण ज्योतिः । अग्ने विश्वेभिः सुमना अनीकैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ebhirno arkairbhavā no arvāṅsvarṇa jyotiḥ | agne viśvebhiḥ sumanā anīkaiḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, who like the sun are light, propitiated by these our hymns, come to our presence with all your hosts (of radiance).

mantras.sanskrit: आभिष्टे अद्य गीर्भिर्गृणन्तोऽग्ने दाशेम । प्र ते दिवो न स्तनयन्ति शुष्माः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ābhiṣṭe adya gīrbhirgṛṇanto'gne dāśema | pra te divo na stanayanti śuṣmāḥ ||

translations.english: Glorifying you, Agni, today, with these our praises, may we offer you (oblations); your (flames), bright as those of the sun, roar aloud.

mantras.sanskrit: तव स्वादिष्ठाग्ने संदृष्टिरिदा चिदह्न इदा चिदक्तोः । श्रिये रुक्मो न रोचत उपाके ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava svādiṣṭhāgne saṃdṛṣṭiridā cidahna idā cidaktoḥ | śriye rukmo na rocata upāke ||

translations.english: Your lovely radiance, Agni, whether by day or by night, shines upon (all objects) like an ornament (to give them) beauty.

mantras.sanskrit: घृतं न पूतं तनूररेपाः शुचि हिरण्यम् । तत्ते रुक्मो न रोचत स्वधावः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ghṛtaṃ na pūtaṃ tanūrarepāḥ śuci hiraṇyam | tatte rukmo na rocata svadhāvaḥ ||

translations.english: Giver of sustenance, (Agni), your favour is free from fault, like clarified butter; your pure and golden lustre shines like an ornament.

mantras.sanskrit: कृतं चिद्धि ष्मा सनेमि द्वेषोऽग्न इनोषि मर्तात् । इत्था यजमानादृतावः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kṛtaṃ ciddhi ṣmā sanemi dveṣo'gna inoṣi martāt | itthā yajamānādṛtāvaḥ ||

translations.english: Truthful, Agni, verily you remove from the mortal who instrumental tutes (your) worship, whatever sin has been committed (by him) of old.

mantras.sanskrit: शिवा नः सख्या सन्तु भ्रात्राग्ने देवेषु युष्मे । सा नो नाभिः सदने सस्मिन्नूधन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śivā naḥ sakhyā santu bhrātrāgne deveṣu yuṣme | sā no nābhiḥ sadane sasminnūdhan ||

translations.english: May our friendly and fraternal attentions to your deities prove fortunate; for such (attentions shown) in every sacrifice (form) our security in the sphere (of the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: भद्रं ते अग्ने सहसिन्ननीकमुपाक आ रोचते सूर्यस्य । रुशद्दृशे ददृशे नक्तया चिदरूक्षितं दृश आ रूपे अन्नम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhadraṃ te agne sahasinnanīkamupāka ā rocate sūryasya | ruśaddṛśe dadṛśe naktayā cidarūkṣitaṃ dṛśa ā rūpe annam ||

translations.english: Powerful Agni, your auspicious radiance shines upon the proximity of the sun (by day); your bright and visible (lustre) is conspicuous by night, as the bland and plural asing food (of sacrifice, the oblation) becomes manifest in your form.

mantras.sanskrit: वि षाह्यग्ने गृणते मनीषां खं वेपसा तुविजात स्तवानः । विश्वेभिर्यद्वावनः शुक्र देवैस्तन्नो रास्व सुमहो भूरि मन्म ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi ṣāhyagne gṛṇate manīṣāṃ khaṃ vepasā tuvijāta stavānaḥ | viśvebhiryadvāvanaḥ śukra devaistanno rāsva sumaho bhūri manma ||

translations.english: Agni, who are engendered repeatedly, and glorified by sacrifice, set open heaven to him who offers you adoration; resplendent (Agni), bestow upon us that ample and acceptable (wealth), which, radiant (deity), you with all the gods, have given (to other worshippers).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वदग्ने काव्या त्वन्मनीषास्त्वदुक्था जायन्ते राध्यानि । त्वदेति द्रविणं वीरपेशा इत्थाधिये दाशुषे मर्त्याय ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvadagne kāvyā tvanmanīṣāstvadukthā jāyante rādhyāni | tvadeti draviṇaṃ vīrapeśā itthādhiye dāśuṣe martyāya ||

translations.english: The offerings (to the gods) are engendered, Agni, of you; from you (proceed) praises; from you effective prayers; from you come a vigorous frame and wealth to man who worships with sincerity and offers oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वद्वाजी वाजम्भरो विहाया अभिष्टिकृज्जायते सत्यशुष्मः । त्वद्रयिर्देवजूतो मयोभुस्त्वदाशुर्जूजुवाँ अग्ने अर्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvadvājī vājambharo vihāyā abhiṣṭikṛjjāyate satyaśuṣmaḥ | tvadrayirdevajūto mayobhustvadāśurjūjuvā~ agne arvā ||

translations.english: From you, who are vigorous, to conveyer of oblations, the vast, the granter of what is desired, is born (a son) of real strength; from you comes wealth approved of by the gods, the source of happiness; from you, Agni, (is obtained) a swift unarrested horse.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने प्रथमं देवयन्तो देवं मर्ता अमृत मन्द्रजिह्वम् । द्वेषोयुतमा विवासन्ति धीभिर्दमूनसं गृहपतिममूरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmagne prathamaṃ devayanto devaṃ martā amṛta mandrajihvam | dveṣoyutamā vivāsanti dhībhirdamūnasaṃ gṛhapatimamūram ||

translations.english: Immortal Agni, devout mortals worship with holy rites you the first deity (of the gods), whose tongue exhilarates (them), the dissipator of sin, the humiliator (of the demons) the lord of the mansion, the unperplexed.

mantras.sanskrit: आरे अस्मदमतिमारे अंह आरे विश्वां दुर्मतिं यन्निपासि । दोषा शिवः सहसः सूनो अग्ने यं देव आ चित्सचसे स्वस्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: āre asmadamatimāre aṃha āre viśvāṃ durmatiṃ yannipāsi | doṣā śivaḥ sahasaḥ sūno agne yaṃ deva ā citsacase svasti ||

translations.english: Agni, son of strength, since you protect (your worshippers), far (remove) from us all iniquity; far (remove from us) sin; far (from us) all evil thoughts; for proeperous is he of whom you who are radiant by night promote the well-being.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्त्वामग्न इनधते यतस्रुक्त्रिस्ते अन्नं कृणवत्सस्मिन्नहन् । स सु द्युम्नैरभ्यस्तु प्रसक्षत्तव क्रत्वा जातवेदश्चिकित्वान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yastvāmagna inadhate yatasruktriste annaṃ kṛṇavatsasminnahan | sa su dyumnairabhyastu prasakṣattava kratvā jātavedaścikitvān ||

translations.english: May he who with uplifted ladle kindles you, and thrice every day presents to you the (sacrificial) food, knowing your glory, Jātavedas, to be invigorated by the act, surpass (all others) in riches.

mantras.sanskrit: इध्मं यस्ते जभरच्छश्रमाणो महो अग्ने अनीकमा सपर्यन् । स इधानः प्रति दोषामुषासं पुष्यन्रयिं सचते घ्नन्नमित्रान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: idhmaṃ yaste jabharacchaśramāṇo maho agne anīkamā saparyan | sa idhānaḥ prati doṣāmuṣāsaṃ puṣyanrayiṃ sacate ghnannamitrān ||

translations.english: He who, labouring diligently, brings you fuel, honouring, Agni, your great glory; he who kindles you in the evening and at dawn; he, prosperous and destroying his enemies, acquires riches.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निरीशे बृहतः क्षत्रियस्याग्निर्वाजस्य परमस्य रायः । दधाति रत्नं विधते यविष्ठो व्यानुषङ्मर्त्याय स्वधावान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirīśe bṛhataḥ kṣatriyasyāgnirvājasya paramasya rāyaḥ | dadhāti ratnaṃ vidhate yaviṣṭho vyānuṣaṅmartyāya svadhāvān ||

translations.english: Agni is the possessor of great strength of excellent food of riches, the young (of the gods); abounding in sustenance, he gives to the mortal who worships him precious (wealth) according to (his devotion).

mantras.sanskrit: यच्चिद्धि ते पुरुषत्रा यविष्ठाचित्तिभिश्चकृमा कच्चिदागः । कृधी ष्वस्माँ अदितेरनागान्व्येनांसि शिश्रथो विष्वगग्ने ॥
mantras.transliteration: yacciddhi te puruṣatrā yaviṣṭhācittibhiścakṛmā kaccidāgaḥ | kṛdhī ṣvasmā~ aditeranāgānvyenāṃsi śiśratho viṣvagagne ||

translations.english: If, young (of the gods), with the inconsiderateness common to men, we have ever committed any offence against you, make us free from the defects of earth efface entirely, Agni our offences.

mantras.sanskrit: महश्चिदग्न एनसो अभीक ऊर्वाद्देवानामुत मर्त्यानाम् । मा ते सखायः सदमिद्रिषाम यच्छा तोकाय तनयाय शं योः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahaścidagna enaso abhīka ūrvāddevānāmuta martyānām | mā te sakhāyaḥ sadamidriṣāma yacchā tokāya tanayāya śaṃ yoḥ ||

translations.english: Let not us, Agni, who are your friends, ever suffer harm from any great or comprehensive offence against either gods or men; bestow forgiveness upon our sons and grandsons, the reward of what has been well done.

mantras.sanskrit: यथा ह त्यद्वसवो गौर्यं चित्पदि षिताममुञ्चता यजत्राः । एवो ष्वस्मन्मुञ्चता व्यंहः प्र तार्यग्ने प्रतरं न आयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathā ha tyadvasavo gauryaṃ citpadi ṣitāmamuñcatā yajatrāḥ | evo ṣvasmanmuñcatā vyaṃhaḥ pra tāryagne prataraṃ na āyuḥ ||

translations.english: Adorable Vasus, in like manner as you have liberated the cow bound by the foot, so set us free entirely from sin; and may our existence, Agni, be prolonged.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रत्यग्निरुषसामग्रमख्यद्विभातीनां सुमना रत्नधेयम् । यातमश्विना सुकृतो दुरोणमुत्सूर्यो ज्योतिषा देव एति ॥
mantras.transliteration: pratyagniruṣasāmagramakhyadvibhātīnāṃ sumanā ratnadheyam | yātamaśvinā sukṛto duroṇamutsūryo jyotiṣā deva eti ||

translations.english: Favourably-minded, Agni has manifested (his might) in regard to the wealth-bestowing procession of the resplendent dawns; proceed, Aśvins, to the dwelling of the pious (worshipper); the divine sun rises with splendour.

mantras.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वं भानुं सविता देवो अश्रेद्द्रप्सं दविध्वद्गविषो न सत्वा । अनु व्रतं वरुणो यन्ति मित्रो यत्सूर्यं दिव्यारोहयन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūrdhvaṃ bhānuṃ savitā devo aśreddrapsaṃ davidhvadgaviṣo na satvā | anu vrataṃ varuṇo yanti mitro yatsūryaṃ divyārohayanti ||

translations.english: The divine Savitā diffuses his light on high, dispersing the dew, and like a vigorous (bull) ardent for the cow; then Varuṇa, and Mitra, and other (divinities), hasten to (fulfil) their offices when they elevate the sun in the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: यं सीमकृण्वन्तमसे विपृचे ध्रुवक्षेमा अनवस्यन्तो अर्थम् । तं सूर्यं हरितः सप्त यह्वीः स्पशं विश्वस्य जगतो वहन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ sīmakṛṇvantamase vipṛce dhruvakṣemā anavasyanto artham | taṃ sūryaṃ haritaḥ sapta yahvīḥ spaśaṃ viśvasya jagato vahanti ||

translations.english: Seven great courses convey that sun, whom the (deities), occupants of enduring mansions, and not heedless (of their offices), have formed for the driving away of darkness, (and who is) the animator of the whole world.

mantras.sanskrit: वहिष्ठेभिर्विहरन्यासि तन्तुमवव्ययन्नसितं देव वस्म । दविध्वतो रश्मयः सूर्यस्य चर्मेवावाधुस्तमो अप्स्वन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vahiṣṭhebhirviharanyāsi tantumavavyayannasitaṃ deva vasma | davidhvato raśmayaḥ sūryasya carmevāvādhustamo apsvantaḥ ||

translations.english: Divine (sun), you proceed with most powerful (horses), spreading your web (or rays), and cutting down the black abode (of night); the tremulous rays of the sun throw off the darknes which is spread like a skin over the firmament.

mantras.sanskrit: अनायतो अनिबद्धः कथायं न्यङ्ङुत्तानोऽव पद्यते न । कया याति स्वधया को ददर्श दिवः स्कम्भः समृतः पाति नाकम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: anāyato anibaddhaḥ kathāyaṃ nyaṅṅuttāno'va padyate na | kayā yāti svadhayā ko dadarśa divaḥ skambhaḥ samṛtaḥ pāti nākam ||

translations.english: This sun, not far removed, and unobstructed, whether (looking) downwards or looking upwards, is harmed by no one; what is the power by which he travels? who has (truly) beheld him who, as the collective pillar of heaven, sustains the sky?

mantras.sanskrit: प्रत्यग्निरुषसो जातवेदा अख्यद्देवो रोचमाना महोभिः । आ नासत्योरुगाया रथेनेमं यज्ञमुप नो यातमच्छ ॥
mantras.transliteration: pratyagniruṣaso jātavedā akhyaddevo rocamānā mahobhiḥ | ā nāsatyorugāyā rathenemaṃ yajñamupa no yātamaccha ||

translations.english: The resplendent Agni, by whom all is known, has manifested (his might) in regard to the dawns radiant with lustre; far-going Nāsatyas, come with your car to this our sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वं केतुं सविता देवो अश्रेज्ज्योतिर्विश्वस्मै भुवनाय कृण्वन् । आप्रा द्यावापृथिवी अन्तरिक्षं वि सूर्यो रश्मिभिश्चेकितानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūrdhvaṃ ketuṃ savitā devo aśrejjyotirviśvasmai bhuvanāya kṛṇvan | āprā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṃ vi sūryo raśmibhiścekitānaḥ ||

translations.english: The divine Savitā displays his banner on high, diffusing light through all worlds; contemplating (all things), the sun has filled heaven and earth and the firmament with his rays.

mantras.sanskrit: आवहन्त्यरुणीर्ज्योतिषागान्मही चित्रा रश्मिभिश्चेकिताना । प्रबोधयन्ती सुविताय देव्युषा ईयते सुयुजा रथेन ॥
mantras.transliteration: āvahantyaruṇīrjyotiṣāgānmahī citrā raśmibhiścekitānā | prabodhayantī suvitāya devyuṣā īyate suyujā rathena ||

translations.english: The great and intelligent dawn, variegated with (many-coloured) rays of purple tint, bringing opulence, has come with (her) lustre; the divine Uṣas, arousing (the sleepers), proceeds with her well-harnessed car (to distribute) felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वां वहिष्ठा इह ते वहन्तु रथा अश्वास उषसो व्युष्टौ । इमे हि वां मधुपेयाय सोमा अस्मिन्यज्ञे वृषणा मादयेथाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāṃ vahiṣṭhā iha te vahantu rathā aśvāsa uṣaso vyuṣṭau | ime hi vāṃ madhupeyāya somā asminyajñe vṛṣaṇā mādayethām ||

translations.english: May those robust and active horses bring you, (Aśvins), hither at the breaking of the dawn, and may these Soma juices prepared, showerers (of benefits), for your drinking, exhilarate you at this (our sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: अनायतो अनिबद्धः कथायं न्यङ्ङुत्तानोऽव पद्यते न । कया याति स्वधया को ददर्श दिवः स्कम्भः समृतः पाति नाकम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: anāyato anibaddhaḥ kathāyaṃ nyaṅṅuttāno'va padyate na | kayā yāti svadhayā ko dadarśa divaḥ skambhaḥ samṛtaḥ pāti nākam ||

translations.english: This sun, not far removed and unobstructed, whether looking downwards or looking upwards, is harmed by no one; what is the power by which he travels? who has (truly) beheld him who, as the collective pillar of heaven, sustains the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निर्होता नो अध्वरे वाजी सन्परि णीयते । देवो देवेषु यज्ञियः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirhotā no adhvare vājī sanpari ṇīyate | devo deveṣu yajñiyaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, the invoker (of the gods), like a horse (that bears a burden), is brought to our sacrifice; a deity adorable among deities.

mantras.sanskrit: परि त्रिविष्ट्यध्वरं यात्यग्नी रथीरिव । आ देवेषु प्रयो दधत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari triviṣṭyadhvaraṃ yātyagnī rathīriva | ā deveṣu prayo dadhat ||

translations.english: Agni, thrice (a day), comes to our sacrifice like charioteer, bearing the sacrificial food to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: परि वाजपतिः कविरग्निर्हव्यान्यक्रमीत् । दधद्रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari vājapatiḥ kaviragnirhavyānyakramīt | dadhadratnāni dāśuṣe ||

translations.english: The sage, Agni, the lord of food, has encompassed the oblation, giving precious things to the donor.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं यः सृञ्जये पुरो दैववाते समिध्यते । द्युमाँ अमित्रदम्भनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ yaḥ sṛñjaye puro daivavāte samidhyate | dyumā~ amitradambhanaḥ ||

translations.english: Radiant as this Agni, the subduer of foes, who is kindled on the (altar) of the cast as (he was kindled) for Sṛñjaya, the son of Devavāta.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य घा वीर ईवतोऽग्नेरीशीत मर्त्यः । तिग्मजम्भस्य मीळ्हुषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya ghā vīra īvato'gnerīśīta martyaḥ | tigmajambhasya mīḷhuṣaḥ ||

translations.english: May the mortal who is strenuous (in worship) acquire authority over this Agni, the sharp-rayed, the showerer (of benefits).

mantras.sanskrit: तमर्वन्तं न सानसिमरुषं न दिवः शिशुम् । मर्मृज्यन्ते दिवेदिवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamarvantaṃ na sānasimaruṣaṃ na divaḥ śiśum | marmṛjyante divedive ||

translations.english: They diligently worship him daily who is like a horse (to convey oblations), who is liberal and resplendent as the son of heaven, (the sun).

mantras.sanskrit: बोधद्यन्मा हरिभ्यां कुमारः साहदेव्यः । अच्छा न हूत उदरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: bodhadyanmā haribhyāṃ kumāraḥ sāhadevyaḥ | acchā na hūta udaram ||

translations.english: When the prince, the son of Sahadeva, promised (to present) me with two horses, I withdrew not when called before him.

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्या यजता हरी कुमारात्साहदेव्यात् । प्रयता सद्य आ ददे ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tyā yajatā harī kumārātsāhadevyāt | prayatā sadya ā dade ||

translations.english: But immediately accepted those two excellent and well-trained horses from the prince, the son of Sahadeva.

mantras.sanskrit: एष वां देवावश्विना कुमारः साहदेव्यः । दीर्घायुरस्तु सोमकः ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa vāṃ devāvaśvinā kumāraḥ sāhadevyaḥ | dīrghāyurastu somakaḥ ||

translations.english: Divine Aśvins, may this prince, Somaka, the son of Sahadeva, your (worshipper), enjoy long life.

mantras.sanskrit: तं युवं देवावश्विना कुमारं साहदेव्यम् । दीर्घायुषं कृणोतन ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ yuvaṃ devāvaśvinā kumāraṃ sāhadevyam | dīrghāyuṣaṃ kṛṇotana ||

translations.english: Divine Aśvins, do you two make the prince, the son of Sahadeva, long-lived.

mantras.sanskrit: आ सत्यो यातु मघवाँ ऋजीषी द्रवन्त्वस्य हरय उप नः । तस्मा इदन्धः सुषुमा सुदक्षमिहाभिपित्वं करते गृणानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā satyo yātu maghavā~ ṛjīṣī dravantvasya haraya upa naḥ | tasmā idandhaḥ suṣumā sudakṣamihābhipitvaṃ karate gṛṇānaḥ ||

translations.english: May the truthful Maghavan the accepter of the spiritless Soma, come to us; may his horses hasten to us; to him we offer this sacrifice, the very potent beverage; may he grant the fulfilment of our desires.

mantras.sanskrit: अव स्य शूराध्वनो नान्तेऽस्मिन्नो अद्य सवने मन्दध्यै । शंसात्युक्थमुशनेव वेधाश्चिकितुषे असुर्याय मन्म ॥
mantras.transliteration: ava sya śūrādhvano nānte'sminno adya savane mandadhyai | śaṃsātyukthamuśaneva vedhāścikituṣe asuryāya manma ||

translations.english: Hero, Indra, set us free today to give you exhilaration at this sacrifice, as (they let loose a horse) at the end of the road; may the worshipper, like Uśanās, repeat an acceptable prayer to you, the knower (of all things), the destroyer of the asuras.

mantras.sanskrit: कविर्न निण्यं विदथानि साधन्वृषा यत्सेकं विपिपानो अर्चात् । दिव इत्था जीजनत्सप्त कारूनह्ना चिच्चक्रुर्वयुना गृणन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kavirna niṇyaṃ vidathāni sādhanvṛṣā yatsekaṃ vipipāno arcāt | diva itthā jījanatsapta kārūnahnā ciccakrurvayunā gṛṇantaḥ ||

translations.english: Like a sage (knowing) what is hidden, and fulfilling sacred rites, so the showerer (of benefits), quaffing copiously the effused (libation), exults (in the draught), and he genitive rates the seven efficient (rays) from heaven, which, being glorified, have made (manifest) the objects of (human) perception by day.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वर्यद्वेदि सुदृशीकमर्कैर्महि ज्योती रुरुचुर्यद्ध वस्तोः । अन्धा तमांसि दुधिता विचक्षे नृभ्यश्चकार नृतमो अभिष्टौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: svaryadvedi sudṛśīkamarkairmahi jyotī rurucuryaddha vastoḥ | andhā tamāṃsi dudhitā vicakṣe nṛbhyaścakāra nṛtamo abhiṣṭau ||

translations.english: When the vast luminous heaven manifested by the rays (of light) is displayed, then are (the deities) resplendent according to (their heavenly) abode; the chief of leaders, (Indra), in his approach has scattered the thick glooms so that men may see.

mantras.sanskrit: ववक्ष इन्द्रो अमितमृजीष्युभे आ पप्रौ रोदसी महित्वा । अतश्चिदस्य महिमा वि रेच्यभि यो विश्वा भुवना बभूव ॥
mantras.transliteration: vavakṣa indro amitamṛjīṣyubhe ā paprau rodasī mahitvā | ataścidasya mahimā vi recyabhi yo viśvā bhuvanā babhūva ||

translations.english: Indra, as the accepter of the stale Soma, sustains infinite greatness, and has filled both heaven and earth by his magnitude; therefore has the vastness of him who has surpassed all the regions, exceeded (the world).

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वानि शक्रो नर्याणि विद्वानपो रिरेच सखिभिर्निकामैः । अश्मानं चिद्ये बिभिदुर्वचोभिर्व्रजं गोमन्तमुशिजो वि वव्रुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvāni śakro naryāṇi vidvānapo rireca sakhibhirnikāmaiḥ | aśmānaṃ cidye bibhidurvacobhirvrajaṃ gomantamuśijo vi vavruḥ ||

translations.english: Knowing all things profitable for men, Śakra has, with his willing friends (the Maruts), sent forth the waters, for they, with (loud) shouts, divided the clouds, and, desiring (to fulfil) their office, set open the pasturage of the cows (of the Aṅgirasas).

mantras.sanskrit: अपो वृत्रं वव्रिवांसं पराहन्प्रावत्ते वज्रं पृथिवी सचेताः । प्रार्णांसि समुद्रियाण्यैनोः पतिर्भवञ्छवसा शूर धृष्णो ॥
mantras.transliteration: apo vṛtraṃ vavrivāṃsaṃ parāhanprāvatte vajraṃ pṛthivī sacetāḥ | prārṇāṃsi samudriyāṇyainoḥ patirbhavañchavasā śūra dhṛṣṇo ||

translations.english: Your protecting thunderbolt has slain Vṛtra obstructing the (issue of the waters), the conscious earth (co-operating) with you; valiant hero, preserver (of the regions), send down by your strength the waters of the firmament.

mantras.sanskrit: अपो यदद्रिं पुरुहूत दर्दराविर्भुवत्सरमा पूर्व्यं ते । स नो नेता वाजमा दर्षि भूरिं गोत्रा रुजन्नङ्गिरोभिर्गृणानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: apo yadadriṃ puruhūta dardarāvirbhuvatsaramā pūrvyaṃ te | sa no netā vājamā darṣi bhūriṃ gotrā rujannaṅgirobhirgṛṇānaḥ ||

translations.english: Invoked of many, when you had divided the cloud for (the escape of) the waters, Saramā appeared before you; and you, the bringer of abundant food, have shown us favour, dividing the clouds and glorified by the Aṅgirasas.

mantras.sanskrit: अच्छा कविं नृमणो गा अभिष्टौ स्वर्षाता मघवन्नाधमानम् । ऊतिभिस्तमिषणो द्युम्नहूतौ नि मायावानब्रह्मा दस्युरर्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: acchā kaviṃ nṛmaṇo gā abhiṣṭau svarṣātā maghavannādhamānam | ūtibhistamiṣaṇo dyumnahūtau ni māyāvānabrahmā dasyurarta ||

translations.english: Maghavan, who are honoured by men, you have repaired to the presence of the sage for (the sake of) bestowing (upon him) wealth, and when soliciting (you) in his need (for aid); defending (him) with your protection, the guileful, impious Dasyu has been destroyed in the contest for the spoil.

mantras.sanskrit: आ दस्युघ्ना मनसा याह्यस्तं भुवत्ते कुत्सः सख्ये निकामः । स्वे योनौ नि षदतं सरूपा वि वां चिकित्सदृतचिद्ध नारी ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā dasyughnā manasā yāhyastaṃ bhuvatte kutsaḥ sakhye nikāmaḥ | sve yonau ni ṣadataṃ sarūpā vi vāṃ cikitsadṛtaciddha nārī ||

translations.english: With a mind resolved on killing the Dasyu, you came (to his dwelling), and Kutsa was eager for your friendship; now have you two alighted in his, (Indra's), habitation, and being entirely similar in form the truthful woman has been perplexed (to discriminate between you).

mantras.sanskrit: यासि कुत्सेन सरथमवस्युस्तोदो वातस्य हर्योरीशानः । ऋज्रा वाजं न गध्यं युयूषन्कविर्यदहन्पार्याय भूषात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yāsi kutsena sarathamavasyustodo vātasya haryorīśānaḥ | ṛjrā vājaṃ na gadhyaṃ yuyūṣankaviryadahanpāryāya bhūṣāt ||

translations.english: You go with Kutsa in the same chariot, determined to defend him; (you) who are the tormentor (of foes), the lord of horses (of the speech) of the wind; on the same day wherein, yoking (to the car) the straight-going steeds, as if to receive food, the sage (Kutsa) has been enabled to cross over (the sea) of calamity.

mantras.sanskrit: कुत्साय शुष्णमशुषं नि बर्हीः प्रपित्वे अह्नः कुयवं सहस्रा । सद्यो दस्यून्प्र मृण कुत्स्येन प्र सूरश्चक्रं वृहतादभीके ॥
mantras.transliteration: kutsāya śuṣṇamaśuṣaṃ ni barhīḥ prapitve ahnaḥ kuyavaṃ sahasrā | sadyo dasyūnpra mṛṇa kutsyena pra sūraścakraṃ vṛhatādabhīke ||

translations.english: For Kutsa, you have slain the unhappy Śuṣṇa and in the forepart of the day, attended by thousands (you have slain) Kuyava with the thunderbolt; you have swiftly destroyed the Dasyus, and you have cut them to pieces in the battle, with the wheel (of the chariot of) the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं पिप्रुं मृगयं शूशुवांसमृजिश्वने वैदथिनाय रन्धीः । पञ्चाशत्कृष्णा नि वपः सहस्रात्कं न पुरो जरिमा वि दर्दः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ pipruṃ mṛgayaṃ śūśuvāṃsamṛjiśvane vaidathināya randhīḥ | pañcāśatkṛṣṇā ni vapaḥ sahasrātkaṃ na puro jarimā vi dardaḥ ||

translations.english: You have subjugated Pipru and the mighty Mṛgayā for the sake of Ṛjiṣvan, the son of Vidathin, you have slain the fifty thousand Kṛṣṇas; and, as old age (destroys) life, you have demolished the cities (of Śambara).

mantras.sanskrit: सूर उपाके तन्वं दधानो वि यत्ते चेत्यमृतस्य वर्पः । मृगो न हस्ती तविषीमुषाणः सिंहो न भीम आयुधानि बिभ्रत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sūra upāke tanvaṃ dadhāno vi yatte cetyamṛtasya varpaḥ | mṛgo na hastī taviṣīmuṣāṇaḥ siṃho na bhīma āyudhāni bibhrat ||

translations.english: While having (your) person n in the proximity of the sun, your form becomes redolent of ambrosia, and you are like the deer-like elephant, consuming the strength (of the strong), and are like a terrible lion when wielding your weapons.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रं कामा वसूयन्तो अग्मन्त्स्वर्मीळ्हे न सवने चकानाः । श्रवस्यवः शशमानास उक्थैरोको न रण्वा सुदृशीव पुष्टिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraṃ kāmā vasūyanto agmantsvarmīḷhe na savane cakānāḥ | śravasyavaḥ śaśamānāsa ukthairoko na raṇvā sudṛśīva puṣṭiḥ ||

translations.english: Relying (upon Indra) for protection, and desirous of riches, (pious men) repair to him soliciting his presence in the sacrifice, as if in the battle, asking for food, celebrating his praise with hymns, for he is the refuge (of his worshippers), and resembles the grateful and lovely (goddess) of nutrition.

mantras.sanskrit: तमिद्व इन्द्रं सुहवं हुवेम यस्ता चकार नर्या पुरूणि । यो मावते जरित्रे गध्यं चिन्मक्षू वाजं भरति स्पार्हराधाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamidva indraṃ suhavaṃ huvema yastā cakāra naryā purūṇi | yo māvate jaritre gadhyaṃ cinmakṣū vājaṃ bharati spārharādhāḥ ||

translations.english: Let us invoke that gracious Indra who has made so many things good for man; who, bestowing enviable opulence, quickly brings acceptable food to a worshipper like me.

mantras.sanskrit: तिग्मा यदन्तरशनिः पताति कस्मिञ्चिच्छूर मुहुके जनानाम् । घोरा यदर्य समृतिर्भवात्यध स्मा नस्तन्वो बोधि गोपाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tigmā yadantaraśaniḥ patāti kasmiñcicchūra muhuke janānām | ghorā yadarya samṛtirbhavātyadha smā nastanvo bodhi gopāḥ ||

translations.english: Hero, indra, when in any conflict of men the sharp thunderbolt falls in the midst (of them), and when, lord there is a terrible battle, then the defender of our person ns is made known.

mantras.sanskrit: भुवोऽविता वामदेवस्य धीनां भुवः सखावृको वाजसातौ । त्वामनु प्रमतिमा जगन्मोरुशंसो जरित्रे विश्वध स्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhuvo'vitā vāmadevasya dhīnāṃ bhuvaḥ sakhāvṛko vājasātau | tvāmanu pramatimā jaganmoruśaṃso jaritre viśvadha syāḥ ||

translations.english: Be you the protector of the pious acts of Vāmadeva; be you in battle an unfailing friend; we come to you, eminent in wisdom; may you be ever benignant to your praiser.

mantras.sanskrit: एभिर्नृभिरिन्द्र त्वायुभिष्ट्वा मघवद्भिर्मघवन्विश्व आजौ । द्यावो न द्युम्नैरभि सन्तो अर्यः क्षपो मदेम शरदश्च पूर्वीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ebhirnṛbhirindra tvāyubhiṣṭvā maghavadbhirmaghavanviśva ājau | dyāvo na dyumnairabhi santo aryaḥ kṣapo madema śaradaśca pūrvīḥ ||

translations.english: In every battle, Maghavan, may we, along with those men who trust in you and offer rich gifts, like those who are resplendent with riches, triumphing over their foes, glorify you many nights and years.

mantras.sanskrit: एवेदिन्द्राय वृषभाय वृष्णे ब्रह्माकर्म भृगवो न रथम् । नू चिद्यथा नः सख्या वियोषदसन्न उग्रोऽविता तनूपाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: evedindrāya vṛṣabhāya vṛṣṇe brahmākarma bhṛgavo na ratham | nū cidyathā naḥ sakhyā viyoṣadasanna ugro'vitā tanūpāḥ ||

translations.english: Therefore we offer to the vigorous Indra, the showerer (of benefits), holy adoration, that he may never withdraw his friendly (actions) from us, and that he may be our powerful protector, the defender of (our) person ns, as the Bhṛgus (fabricate) a car (for use).

mantras.sanskrit: नू ष्टुत इन्द्र नू गृणान इषं जरित्रे नद्यो न पीपेः । अकारि ते हरिवो ब्रह्म नव्यं धिया स्याम रथ्यः सदासाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū ṣṭuta indra nū gṛṇāna iṣaṃ jaritre nadyo na pīpeḥ | akāri te harivo brahma navyaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ ||

translations.english: Glorified (in the past), glorified, Indra, at present, satisfy your worshipper with food, as rivers (are filled with water); lord of horses, a new hymn has been made for you; may we possessed of chariots, be ever delighted in (your) praise.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं महाँ इन्द्र तुभ्यं ह क्षा अनु क्षत्रं मंहना मन्यत द्यौः । त्वं वृत्रं शवसा जघन्वान्त्सृजः सिन्धूँरहिना जग्रसानान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ mahā~ indra tubhyaṃ ha kṣā anu kṣatraṃ maṃhanā manyata dyauḥ | tvaṃ vṛtraṃ śavasā jaghanvāntsṛjaḥ sindhū~rahinā jagrasānān ||

translations.english: You, Indra, are mighty; the vast earth confesses to you (your) strength, as does the heaven; you have slain Vṛtra by your vigour, you have set free the rivers arrested by Ahi.

mantras.sanskrit: तव त्विषो जनिमन्रेजत द्यौ रेजद्भूमिर्भियसा स्वस्य मन्योः । ऋघायन्त सुभ्वः पर्वतास आर्दन्धन्वानि सरयन्त आपः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava tviṣo janimanrejata dyau rejadbhūmirbhiyasā svasya manyoḥ | ṛghāyanta subhvaḥ parvatāsa ārdandhanvāni sarayanta āpaḥ ||

translations.english: At the birth of you who are resplendent, trembled the heaven (and) trembled the earth through fear of your wrath; the mighty clouds were confined; they destroyed (the distress of drought), spreading the waters over the dry plural ces.

mantras.sanskrit: भिनद्गिरिं शवसा वज्रमिष्णन्नाविष्कृण्वानः सहसान ओजः । वधीद्वृत्रं वज्रेण मन्दसानः सरन्नापो जवसा हतवृष्णीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhinadgiriṃ śavasā vajramiṣṇannāviṣkṛṇvānaḥ sahasāna ojaḥ | vadhīdvṛtraṃ vajreṇa mandasānaḥ sarannāpo javasā hatavṛṣṇīḥ ||

translations.english: The subduer of foes, manifesting his energy and hurling his thunderbolt, shattered the mountain by his strength; he slew Vṛtra with the thunderbolt, exulting, and the waters whose obstructor was destroyed rushed forth with rapidity.

mantras.sanskrit: सुवीरस्ते जनिता मन्यत द्यौरिन्द्रस्य कर्ता स्वपस्तमो भूत् । य ईं जजान स्वर्यं सुवज्रमनपच्युतं सदसो न भूम ॥
mantras.transliteration: suvīraste janitā manyata dyaurindrasya kartā svapastamo bhūt | ya īṃ jajāna svaryaṃ suvajramanapacyutaṃ sadaso na bhūma ||

translations.english: Heaven, your progenitor, conceived (I have obtained) a worthy son; the maker of Indra was the accomplisher of a most excellent work; he who begot the adorable (Indra), armed with the thunderbolt, irremovable from his station, and endowed with greatness.

mantras.sanskrit: य एक इच्च्यावयति प्र भूमा राजा कृष्टीनां पुरुहूत इन्द्रः । सत्यमेनमनु विश्वे मदन्ति रातिं देवस्य गृणतो मघोनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya eka iccyāvayati pra bhūmā rājā kṛṣṭīnāṃ puruhūta indraḥ | satyamenamanu viśve madanti rātiṃ devasya gṛṇato maghonaḥ ||

translations.english: All men, praising the munificence of the divine Maghavan, verily glorify him who alone casts downmany, Indra, the king of men, the adored of many.

mantras.sanskrit: सत्रा सोमा अभवन्नस्य विश्वे सत्रा मदासो बृहतो मदिष्ठाः । सत्राभवो वसुपतिर्वसूनां दत्रे विश्वा अधिथा इन्द्र कृष्टीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: satrā somā abhavannasya viśve satrā madāso bṛhato madiṣṭhāḥ | satrābhavo vasupatirvasūnāṃ datre viśvā adhithā indra kṛṣṭīḥ ||

translations.english: Truly are all libations his, the inebriating draughts are truly most exhilarating to the mighty Indra; truly are you the lord of wealth, of (all sorts of) treasures; you, Indra, support all people by the gift (of riches).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमध प्रथमं जायमानोऽमे विश्वा अधिथा इन्द्र कृष्टीः । त्वं प्रति प्रवत आशयानमहिं वज्रेण मघवन्वि वृश्चः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamadha prathamaṃ jāyamāno'me viśvā adhithā indra kṛṣṭīḥ | tvaṃ prati pravata āśayānamahiṃ vajreṇa maghavanvi vṛścaḥ ||

translations.english: [7-8] (We praise) the slayer of many foes, the courageous, the discomfiter (of enemies), the great, the unbounded, the showerer (of benefits), the wielder of the bright thunderbolt, him who is the destroyer of Vṛtra, the bestower of food, the giver of wealth, Maghavan, the possessor of riches.

mantras.sanskrit: सत्राहणं दाधृषिं तुम्रमिन्द्रं महामपारं वृषभं सुवज्रम् । हन्ता यो वृत्रं सनितोत वाजं दाता मघानि मघवा सुराधाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: satrāhaṇaṃ dādhṛṣiṃ tumramindraṃ mahāmapāraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ suvajram | hantā yo vṛtraṃ sanitota vājaṃ dātā maghāni maghavā surādhāḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: अयं वृतश्चातयते समीचीर्य आजिषु मघवा शृण्व एकः । अयं वाजं भरति यं सनोत्यस्य प्रियासः सख्ये स्याम ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ vṛtaścātayate samīcīrya ājiṣu maghavā śṛṇva ekaḥ | ayaṃ vājaṃ bharati yaṃ sanotyasya priyāsaḥ sakhye syāma ||

translations.english: This Maghavan, who destroys assembled hosts, is he who is renowned as chief in battles; he brings the food which he bestows (upon the worshipper); may we be held dear in his friendship.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं शृण्वे अध जयन्नुत घ्नन्नयमुत प्र कृणुते युधा गाः । यदा सत्यं कृणुते मन्युमिन्द्रो विश्वं दृळ्हं भयत एजदस्मात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ śṛṇve adha jayannuta ghnannayamuta pra kṛṇute yudhā gāḥ | yadā satyaṃ kṛṇute manyumindro viśvaṃ dṛḷhaṃ bhayata ejadasmāt ||

translations.english: This (Indra), is renowned, whether conquering or slaying (his foes), or whether in conflict he recovers the cattle; when Indra truly entertains anger all that is stationary or moveable is in fear of him.

mantras.sanskrit: समिन्द्रो गा अजयत्सं हिरण्या समश्विया मघवा यो ह पूर्वीः । एभिर्नृभिर्नृतमो अस्य शाकै रायो विभक्ता सम्भरश्च वस्वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samindro gā ajayatsaṃ hiraṇyā samaśviyā maghavā yo ha pūrvīḥ | ebhirnṛbhirnṛtamo asya śākai rāyo vibhaktā sambharaśca vasvaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, the lord of opulence, who has overcomemany (enemies), has completely won (their) cattle, (their) gold, (their) horses; chief leader by his energies, praised by these his worshippers, he is the distributor of riches, the bestower of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: कियत्स्विदिन्द्रो अध्येति मातुः कियत्पितुर्जनितुर्यो जजान । यो अस्य शुष्मं मुहुकैरियर्ति वातो न जूतः स्तनयद्भिरभ्रैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kiyatsvidindro adhyeti mātuḥ kiyatpiturjanituryo jajāna | yo asya śuṣmaṃ muhukairiyarti vāto na jūtaḥ stanayadbhirabhraiḥ ||

translations.english: Some portion (of his strength) Indra derives from his mother, some portion from his father; he who, though his progenitor, has begotten (the world), and animates its vigour repeatedly, as the wind is driven by thundering clouds.

mantras.sanskrit: क्षियन्तं त्वमक्षियन्तं कृणोतीयर्ति रेणुं मघवा समोहम् । विभञ्जनुरशनिमाँ इव द्यौरुत स्तोतारं मघवा वसौ धात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kṣiyantaṃ tvamakṣiyantaṃ kṛṇotīyarti reṇuṃ maghavā samoham | vibhañjanuraśanimā~ iva dyauruta stotāraṃ maghavā vasau dhāt ||

translations.english: You are the Maghavan who makes one man destitute, another prosperous, who (scatters from his worshipper) the accusative ulated dust (of sin), the destroyer (of foes), like the heaven with the thunderbolt, Maghavan conducts his worshipper to wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं चक्रमिषणत्सूर्यस्य न्येतशं रीरमत्ससृमाणम् । आ कृष्ण ईं जुहुराणो जिघर्ति त्वचो बुध्ने रजसो अस्य योनौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ cakramiṣaṇatsūryasya nyetaśaṃ rīramatsasṛmāṇam | ā kṛṣṇa īṃ juhurāṇo jigharti tvaco budhne rajaso asya yonau ||

translations.english: He has hurled the wheel (of the chariot) of the sun, and has stopped Etaśa going forth to (battle); the dark undulating cloud bedews him, (staying) at the root of radiance in the regions of its waters.

mantras.sanskrit: असिक्न्यां यजमानो न होता ॥
mantras.transliteration: asiknyāṃ yajamāno na hotā ||

translations.english: As the sacrificer (pours the oblation) at night upon the fire.

mantras.sanskrit: गव्यन्त इन्द्रं सख्याय विप्रा अश्वायन्तो वृषणं वाजयन्तः । जनीयन्तो जनिदामक्षितोतिमा च्यावयामोऽवते न कोशम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: gavyanta indraṃ sakhyāya viprā aśvāyanto vṛṣaṇaṃ vājayantaḥ | janīyanto janidāmakṣitotimā cyāvayāmo'vate na kośam ||

translations.english: May we (who are) wishing for cattle, for horses, for food, for wives, through his friendship induce Indra, the showerer (of benefits), the giver of wives, the unwearied granter of protection, to come down, as a bucket (is lowered) into a well.

mantras.sanskrit: त्राता नो बोधि ददृशान आपिरभिख्याता मर्डिता सोम्यानाम् । सखा पिता पितृतमः पितॄणां कर्तेमु लोकमुशते वयोधाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: trātā no bodhi dadṛśāna āpirabhikhyātā marḍitā somyānām | sakhā pitā pitṛtamaḥ pitṝṇāṃ kartemu lokamuśate vayodhāḥ ||

translations.english: Be our preserver, you who are looking (benevolently upon) all; a kinsman (to us); a supervisor (of all things), a bestower of felicity on those who are worthy (to offer) libations; a friend, a protector, a defender in the highest degree among defenders, a creator; (be you, who bestows) the world of heaven upon him who desires it, the giver to us of food.

mantras.sanskrit: सखीयतामविता बोधि सखा गृणान इन्द्र स्तुवते वयो धाः । वयं ह्या ते चकृमा सबाध आभिः शमीभिर्महयन्त इन्द्र ॥
mantras.transliteration: sakhīyatāmavitā bodhi sakhā gṛṇāna indra stuvate vayo dhāḥ | vayaṃ hyā te cakṛmā sabādha ābhiḥ śamībhirmahayanta indra ||

translations.english: Regard yourself as a protector of those who desire your friendship; be a friend deserving of commendation; grant, Indra, food to him who praises (you); suffering difficulties, we make our suppications to you, worshipping you with these holy rites.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तुत इन्द्रो मघवा यद्ध वृत्रा भूरीण्येको अप्रतीनि हन्ति । अस्य प्रियो जरिता यस्य शर्मन्नकिर्देवा वारयन्ते न मर्ताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: stuta indro maghavā yaddha vṛtrā bhūrīṇyeko apratīni hanti | asya priyo jaritā yasya śarmannakirdevā vārayante na martāḥ ||

translations.english: When Indra, the possessor of opulence, is glorified, he singly destroys many unyielding foes; the worshipper is dear to him (who relies) on his protection, and neither gods nor men molest him.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा न इन्द्रो मघवा विरप्शी करत्सत्या चर्षणीधृदनर्वा । त्वं राजा जनुषां धेह्यस्मे अधि श्रवो माहिनं यज्जरित्रे ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā na indro maghavā virapśī karatsatyā carṣaṇīdhṛdanarvā | tvaṃ rājā januṣāṃ dhehyasme adhi śravo māhinaṃ yajjaritre ||

translations.english: The many-voiced Indra, the possessor of opulence, the supporter of men, the irresistible bestows upon us, when praised by us, assured (rewards); you, (Indra), are the king of men; grant to us abundantly that great fame which (is due) to (your) worshipper.

mantras.sanskrit: नू ष्टुत इन्द्र नू गृणान इषं जरित्रे नद्यो न पीपेः । अकारि ते हरिवो ब्रह्म नव्यं धिया स्याम रथ्यः सदासाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū ṣṭuta indra nū gṛṇāna iṣaṃ jaritre nadyo na pīpeḥ | akāri te harivo brahma navyaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ ||

translations.english: Glorified (in the past), glorified, Indra, at present satisfy your worshipper with food, as rivers (are filled with water); lord of horses, a new hymn has been made for you; may we, possessed of chariots, be ever diligent in your praise.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं पन्था अनुवित्तः पुराणो यतो देवा उदजायन्त विश्वे । अतश्चिदा जनिषीष्ट प्रवृद्धो मा मातरममुया पत्तवे कः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ panthā anuvittaḥ purāṇo yato devā udajāyanta viśve | ataścidā janiṣīṣṭa pravṛddho mā mātaramamuyā pattave kaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra speaks: This is the old and recognized path by which all the gods are born; so, when full-grown, let him be born in the same manner; let him not cause the loss of this his mother.

mantras.sanskrit: नाहमतो निरया दुर्गहैतत्तिरश्चता पार्श्वान्निर्गमाणि । बहूनि मे अकृता कर्त्वानि युध्यै त्वेन सं त्वेन पृच्छै ॥
mantras.transliteration: nāhamato nirayā durgahaitattiraścatā pārśvānnirgamāṇi | bahūni me akṛtā kartvāni yudhyai tvena saṃ tvena pṛcchai ||

translations.english: Vāmadeva speaks: Let me not come forth by this path, for it is difficult (of issue); let me come forth obliquely from the side; many acts unperformed by others are to be accomplished by me; let me contend (in war) with one (enemy), in controversy with one opponent.

mantras.sanskrit: परायतीं मातरमन्वचष्ट न नानु गान्यनु नू गमानि । त्वष्टुर्गृहे अपिबत्सोममिन्द्रः शतधन्यं चम्वोः सुतस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: parāyatīṃ mātaramanvacaṣṭa na nānu gānyanu nū gamāni | tvaṣṭurgṛhe apibatsomamindraḥ śatadhanyaṃ camvoḥ sutasya ||

translations.english: He, (Indra), has asserted (that it will) cause the death of my mother; let me not proceed by the usual way, but proceed quickly, according (to my will); in the dwelling of Tvaṣṭā Indra drank the costly Soma from the vessels of the offerers.

mantras.sanskrit: किं स ऋधक्कृणवद्यं सहस्रं मासो जभार शरदश्च पूर्वीः । नही न्वस्य प्रतिमानमस्त्यन्तर्जातेषूत ये जनित्वाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kiṃ sa ṛdhakkṛṇavadyaṃ sahasraṃ māso jabhāra śaradaśca pūrvīḥ | nahī nvasya pratimānamastyantarjāteṣūta ye janitvāḥ ||

translations.english: Aditi speaks: What irregular act has he committed whom (I, his mother), bore for a thousand months and for many years? there is no analogy between him and those who have been or will be born.

mantras.sanskrit: अवद्यमिव मन्यमाना गुहाकरिन्द्रं माता वीर्येणा न्यृष्टम् । अथोदस्थात्स्वयमत्कं वसान आ रोदसी अपृणाज्जायमानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: avadyamiva manyamānā guhākarindraṃ mātā vīryeṇā nyṛṣṭam | athodasthātsvayamatkaṃ vasāna ā rodasī apṛṇājjāyamānaḥ ||

translations.english: Deeming it disreputable (that he should be brought forth) in secret, his mother endowed (Indra) with (extraordinary) vigour; therefore, as soon as born he sprung up of his own accord, invested with splendour, and filled both heaven and earth.

mantras.sanskrit: एता अर्षन्त्यललाभवन्तीॠतावरीरिव संक्रोशमानाः । एता वि पृच्छ किमिदं भनन्ति कमापो अद्रिं परिधिं रुजन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: etā arṣantyalalābhavantīṝtāvarīriva saṃkrośamānāḥ | etā vi pṛccha kimidaṃ bhananti kamāpo adriṃ paridhiṃ rujanti ||

translations.english: These (rivers) flew murmuring as if, being filled with water, they were uttering sounds (of joy); ask them what is this they say; what is the encompassing cloud that the waters break through?

mantras.sanskrit: किमु ष्विदस्मै निविदो भनन्तेन्द्रस्यावद्यं दिधिषन्त आपः । ममैतान्पुत्रो महता वधेन वृत्रं जघन्वाँ असृजद्वि सिन्धून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kimu ṣvidasmai nivido bhanantendrasyāvadyaṃ didhiṣanta āpaḥ | mamaitānputro mahatā vadhena vṛtraṃ jaghanvā~ asṛjadvi sindhūn ||

translations.english: What do the sacred expiatory strains declare to me? the waters reeive the reproach of Indra; my son has slain Vṛtra with the mighty thunderbolt; he has set those rivers free.

mantras.sanskrit: ममच्चन त्वा युवतिः परास ममच्चन त्वा कुषवा जगार । ममच्चिदापः शिशवे ममृड्युर्ममच्चिदिन्द्रः सहसोदतिष्ठत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mamaccana tvā yuvatiḥ parāsa mamaccana tvā kuṣavā jagāra | mamaccidāpaḥ śiśave mamṛḍyurmamaccidindraḥ sahasodatiṣṭhat ||

translations.english: Vāmadeva speaks: exulting one youthful mother brought you forth; exulting, Kuṣavā swallowed you; exulting, the waters gave delight to the infant; Indra, exulting, rose up by his strength.

mantras.sanskrit: ममच्चन ते मघवन्व्यंसो निविविध्वाँ अप हनू जघान । अधा निविद्ध उत्तरो बभूवाञ्छिरो दासस्य सं पिणग्वधेन ॥
mantras.transliteration: mamaccana te maghavanvyaṃso nivividhvā~ apa hanū jaghāna | adhā nividdha uttaro babhūvāñchiro dāsasya saṃ piṇagvadhena ||

translations.english: Vyaṃsa, exulting and striking (hard blows), smote you, Maghavan, upon the jaw; whereupon, being so smitten, you proved the stronger, and did crush the head of the slave with the thunderbolt.

mantras.sanskrit: गृष्टिः ससूव स्थविरं तवागामनाधृष्यं वृषभं तुम्रमिन्द्रम् । अरीळ्हं वत्सं चरथाय माता स्वयं गातुं तन्व इच्छमानम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: gṛṣṭiḥ sasūva sthaviraṃ tavāgāmanādhṛṣyaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tumramindram | arīḷhaṃ vatsaṃ carathāya mātā svayaṃ gātuṃ tanva icchamānam ||

translations.english: As a helper bears a calf, his mother, (Aditi), bore Indra, mature (in years), strong, irresisitble, vigorous, energetic, invincible, (destined) to follow his own course, heedful of his person n.

mantras.sanskrit: उत माता महिषमन्ववेनदमी त्वा जहति पुत्र देवाः । अथाब्रवीद्वृत्रमिन्द्रो हनिष्यन्त्सखे विष्णो वितरं वि क्रमस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta mātā mahiṣamanvavenadamī tvā jahati putra devāḥ | athābravīdvṛtramindro haniṣyantsakhe viṣṇo vitaraṃ vi kramasva ||

translations.english: His mother inquired of the mighty Indra, have these deities deserted you, my son? then Indra and Viṣṇu, my friend (if you) purpose slaying Vṛtra exert your greatest prowess.

mantras.sanskrit: कस्ते मातरं विधवामचक्रच्छयुं कस्त्वामजिघांसच्चरन्तम् । कस्ते देवो अधि मार्डीक आसीद्यत्प्राक्षिणाः पितरं पादगृह्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: kaste mātaraṃ vidhavāmacakracchayuṃ kastvāmajighāṃsaccarantam | kaste devo adhi mārḍīka āsīdyatprākṣiṇāḥ pitaraṃ pādagṛhya ||

translations.english: Who has made your mother a widow? who has sought to slay the sleeping and the walking? what deity has been more gracious than you since you have slain the father, having seized him by the foot?

mantras.sanskrit: अवर्त्या शुन आन्त्राणि पेचे न देवेषु विविदे मर्डितारम् । अपश्यं जायाममहीयमानामधा मे श्येनो मध्वा जभार ॥
mantras.transliteration: avartyā śuna āntrāṇi pece na deveṣu vivide marḍitāram | apaśyaṃ jāyāmamahīyamānāmadhā me śyeno madhvā jabhāra ||

translations.english: In extreme destitution I have cooked the entrails of a dog; I have not found a comforter among the gods; I have beheld my wife disrsepected; then the falcon, (Indra), has brought to me sweet water.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा त्वामिन्द्र वज्रिन्नत्र विश्वे देवासः सुहवास ऊमाः । महामुभे रोदसी वृद्धमृष्वं निरेकमिद्वृणते वृत्रहत्ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā tvāmindra vajrinnatra viśve devāsaḥ suhavāsa ūmāḥ | mahāmubhe rodasī vṛddhamṛṣvaṃ nirekamidvṛṇate vṛtrahatye ||

translations.english: Indra, wielder of the thuderbolt, all the protecting deities who are reverently invoked, and both the heaven and the earth, glorify you who are verily one alone, mighty, vast, and plural asing of aspect, for the destruction of Vṛtra.

mantras.sanskrit: अवासृजन्त जिव्रयो न देवा भुवः सम्राळिन्द्र सत्ययोनिः । अहन्नहिं परिशयानमर्णः प्र वर्तनीररदो विश्वधेनाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: avāsṛjanta jivrayo na devā bhuvaḥ samrāḷindra satyayoniḥ | ahannahiṃ pariśayānamarṇaḥ pra vartanīrarado viśvadhenāḥ ||

translations.english: As elders (send forth their young), so the gods have sent you (against Vṛtra); thence you became, Indra who is the abode of truth, the soverign of the world; you have slain the slumbering Ahi for (the release of) the water and have marked out (the channels of) all the delighting rivers.

mantras.sanskrit: अतृप्णुवन्तं वियतमबुध्यमबुध्यमानं सुषुपाणमिन्द्र । सप्त प्रति प्रवत आशयानमहिं वज्रेण वि रिणा अपर्वन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: atṛpṇuvantaṃ viyatamabudhyamabudhyamānaṃ suṣupāṇamindra | sapta prati pravata āśayānamahiṃ vajreṇa vi riṇā aparvan ||

translations.english: On the day of full moon you have slain with the thunderbolt the insatiable, unnerved, ignorant, unapprehending, slumbering Ahi, obstructing the gliding-downward-flowing (streams).

mantras.sanskrit: अक्षोदयच्छवसा क्षाम बुध्नं वार्ण वातस्तविषीभिरिन्द्रः । दृळ्हान्यौभ्नादुशमान ओजोऽवाभिनत्ककुभः पर्वतानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: akṣodayacchavasā kṣāma budhnaṃ vārṇa vātastaviṣībhirindraḥ | dṛḷhānyaubhnāduśamāna ojo'vābhinatkakubhaḥ parvatānām ||

translations.english: Indra, by his strength, has agitated the exhausted firmament, as wind, by its violent (gusts, agitates) the water; exulting in his strength, he has divided the solid (clouds), and has shattered the peaks of the mountains.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि प्र दद्रुर्जनयो न गर्भं रथा इव प्र ययुः साकमद्रयः । अतर्पयो विसृत उब्ज ऊर्मीन्त्वं वृताँ अरिणा इन्द्र सिन्धून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi pra dadrurjanayo na garbhaṃ rathā iva pra yayuḥ sākamadrayaḥ | atarpayo visṛta ubja ūrmīntvaṃ vṛtā~ ariṇā indra sindhūn ||

translations.english: The Maruts have hastened to you like mother to their young; like chariots they have rushed in along (with you); you, Indra, have satisfied the following streams; you have shattered the clouds; you have set free the obstructed rivers.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं महीमवनिं विश्वधेनां तुर्वीतये वय्याय क्षरन्तीम् । अरमयो नमसैजदर्णः सुतरणाँ अकृणोरिन्द्र सिन्धून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ mahīmavaniṃ viśvadhenāṃ turvītaye vayyāya kṣarantīm | aramayo namasaijadarṇaḥ sutaraṇā~ akṛṇorindra sindhūn ||

translations.english: You have made the vast, all-cherishing, and exuberant earth, delighted with (abundant) food, and tremulous water, for (the sake of) Turvīti and Vayyā; you have made the rivers easy to be crosseḍ

mantras.sanskrit: प्राग्रुवो नभन्वो न वक्वा ध्वस्रा अपिन्वद्युवतीॠतज्ञाः । धन्वान्यज्राँ अपृणक्तृषाणाँ अधोगिन्द्रः स्तर्यो दंसुपत्नीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prāgruvo nabhanvo na vakvā dhvasrā apinvadyuvatīṝtajñāḥ | dhanvānyajrā~ apṛṇaktṛṣāṇā~ adhogindraḥ staryo daṃsupatnīḥ ||

translations.english: Indra has filled the youthful rivers, the parents of plural nty, the corroders (of their banks), like  armies destructive (of their foes); he has inundated the dry lands, and (satisfied) the thirsty travellers; he has milked the barren cows whom the asuras had become the lords of.

mantras.sanskrit: पूर्वीरुषसः शरदश्च गूर्ता वृत्रं जघन्वाँ असृजद्वि सिन्धून् । परिष्ठिता अतृणद्बद्बधानाः सीरा इन्द्रः स्रवितवे पृथिव्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: pūrvīruṣasaḥ śaradaśca gūrtā vṛtraṃ jaghanvā~ asṛjadvi sindhūn | pariṣṭhitā atṛṇadbadbadhānāḥ sīrā indraḥ sravitave pṛthivyā ||

translations.english: Having slain Vṛtra, he has liberated many mornings and years (that had been) swallowed up by darkness, and has set the rivers free; Indra has released the imprisoned rivers, encompassed (by the cloud), to flow upon the earth.

mantras.sanskrit: वम्रीभिः पुत्रमग्रुवो अदानं निवेशनाद्धरिव आ जभर्थ । व्यन्धो अख्यदहिमाददानो निर्भूदुखच्छित्समरन्त पर्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: vamrībhiḥ putramagruvo adānaṃ niveśanāddhariva ā jabhartha | vyandho akhyadahimādadāno nirbhūdukhacchitsamaranta parva ||

translations.english: Lord of horses, you have brought the son of Agru from his dwelling, where he was being devoured by the ants; when extricated, although blind, he distinguished the serpent; and when he came forth the joints that had been sundered in the ant-hill were restrung.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ते पूर्वाणि करणानि विप्राविद्वाँ आह विदुषे करांसि । यथायथा वृष्ण्यानि स्वगूर्तापांसि राजन्नर्याविवेषीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra te pūrvāṇi karaṇāni viprāvidvā~ āha viduṣe karāṃsi | yathāyathā vṛṣṇyāni svagūrtāpāṃsi rājannaryāviveṣīḥ ||

translations.english: The sage, (Vāmadeva), knowing, royal Indra, the ancient deeds of you who are all wise, has proclaimed the actions, such as you ahve performed them, genitive rative of rain, self-evolved, and beneficial to man.

mantras.sanskrit: नू ष्टुत इन्द्र नू गृणान इषं जरित्रे नद्यो न पीपेः । अकारि ते हरिवो ब्रह्म नव्यं धिया स्याम रथ्यः सदासाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū ṣṭuta indra nū gṛṇāna iṣaṃ jaritre nadyo na pīpeḥ | akāri te harivo brahma navyaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ ||

translations.english: Glorified (in the past), glorified, Indra, at present, satisfy your worshipper with food, as rivers (are filled with water); lord of horses, a new hymn has been made for you; may we, possessed of chariots, be ever diligent in your praise.

mantras.sanskrit: आ न इन्द्रो दूरादा न आसादभिष्टिकृदवसे यासदुग्रः । ओजिष्ठेभिर्नृपतिर्वज्रबाहुः संगे समत्सु तुर्वणिः पृतन्यून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā na indro dūrādā na āsādabhiṣṭikṛdavase yāsadugraḥ | ojiṣṭhebhirnṛpatirvajrabāhuḥ saṃge samatsu turvaṇiḥ pṛtanyūn ||

translations.english: May the illustrious Indra, the granter of desires, come to us, whether from afar or nigh, for our protection; he who is the lord of men, armed with the thunderbolt, overcoming his foes in conflict and in combats, (attended) by the most illustrious (Maruts).

mantras.sanskrit: आ न इन्द्रो हरिभिर्यात्वच्छार्वाचीनोऽवसे राधसे च । तिष्ठाति वज्री मघवा विरप्शीमं यज्ञमनु नो वाजसातौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā na indro haribhiryātvacchārvācīno'vase rādhase ca | tiṣṭhāti vajrī maghavā virapśīmaṃ yajñamanu no vājasātau ||

translations.english: May Indra, looking down upon us, come with his steeds to our presence for our protection and enrichment; may the mighty thunderer, the possessor of wealth, (aiding us) in battle, be present at this our sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: इमं यज्ञं त्वमस्माकमिन्द्र पुरो दधत्सनिष्यसि क्रतुं नः । श्वघ्नीव वज्रिन्त्सनये धनानां त्वया वयमर्य आजिं जयेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: imaṃ yajñaṃ tvamasmākamindra puro dadhatsaniṣyasi kratuṃ naḥ | śvaghnīva vajrintsanaye dhanānāṃ tvayā vayamarya ājiṃ jayema ||

translations.english: You, Indra, plural cing us before you, shall receive this sacrifice, our holy offering; and as the huntsman (kills his game), may we, your worshippers, holder of the thunderbolt, for the acquisition of riches through you to be victorious in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: उशन्नु षु णः सुमना उपाके सोमस्य नु सुषुतस्य स्वधावः । पा इन्द्र प्रतिभृतस्य मध्वः समन्धसा ममदः पृष्ठ्येन ॥
mantras.transliteration: uśannu ṣu ṇaḥ sumanā upāke somasya nu suṣutasya svadhāvaḥ | pā indra pratibhṛtasya madhvaḥ samandhasā mamadaḥ pṛṣṭhyena ||

translations.english: Indra, the giver of food, be near to us, favourably disposed; and anxious for our (good), drink of the effused, prepared, exhilarating Soma, and be plural ased by the (sacrificial) food (offered with the noon-day hymn.

mantras.sanskrit: वि यो ररप्श ऋषिभिर्नवेभिर्वृक्षो न पक्वः सृण्यो न जेता । मर्यो न योषामभि मन्यमानोऽच्छा विवक्मि पुरुहूतमिन्द्रम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi yo rarapśa ṛṣibhirnavebhirvṛkṣo na pakvaḥ sṛṇyo na jetā | maryo na yoṣāmabhi manyamāno'cchā vivakmi puruhūtamindram ||

translations.english: Like a man boasting of his wife, I glorify that Indra who is invoked of many, who is hymned by recent sages (who is) like a tree with ripe fruit, like a victorious (warrior), skilful in arms.

mantras.sanskrit: गिरिर्न यः स्वतवाँ ऋष्व इन्द्रः सनादेव सहसे जात उग्रः । आदर्ता वज्रं स्थविरं न भीम उद्नेव कोशं वसुना न्यृष्टम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: girirna yaḥ svatavā~ ṛṣva indraḥ sanādeva sahase jāta ugraḥ | ādartā vajraṃ sthaviraṃ na bhīma udneva kośaṃ vasunā nyṛṣṭam ||

translations.english: He who is vast and self-sustained like a mountain, the radiant and formidable Indra, born of old for the destruction (of the foes of the gods), the wielder of the ancient thunderbolt, charged with splendour, like a jar (filled) with water.

mantras.sanskrit: न यस्य वर्ता जनुषा न्वस्ति न राधस आमरीता मघस्य । उद्वावृषाणस्तविषीव उग्रास्मभ्यं दद्धि पुरुहूत रायः ॥
mantras.transliteration: na yasya vartā januṣā nvasti na rādhasa āmarītā maghasya | udvāvṛṣāṇastaviṣīva ugrāsmabhyaṃ daddhi puruhūta rāyaḥ ||

translations.english: Of whom there is no opposer by (reason of) his birth nor any destroyer of the wealth that accomplishes (pious works); powerful and resplendent (Indra), the invoked of many, do you who are the showerer (of benefits) bestow upon us riches.

mantras.sanskrit: ईक्षे रायः क्षयस्य चर्षणीनामुत व्रजमपवर्तासि गोनाम् । शिक्षानरः समिथेषु प्रहावान्वस्वो राशिमभिनेतासि भूरिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: īkṣe rāyaḥ kṣayasya carṣaṇīnāmuta vrajamapavartāsi gonām | śikṣānaraḥ samitheṣu prahāvānvasvo rāśimabhinetāsi bhūrim ||

translations.english: You rule over the riches and the dwellings of men; you are the rescuer of the herd of cattle; you are the giver of the instrumental uction, the smiter in battles, and the distributor of great heaps of riches.

mantras.sanskrit: कया तच्छृण्वे शच्या शचिष्ठो यया कृणोति मुहु का चिदृष्वः । पुरु दाशुषे विचयिष्ठो अंहोऽथा दधाति द्रविणं जरित्रे ॥
mantras.transliteration: kayā tacchṛṇve śacyā śaciṣṭho yayā kṛṇoti muhu kā cidṛṣvaḥ | puru dāśuṣe vicayiṣṭho aṃho'thā dadhāti draviṇaṃ jaritre ||
