translations.english: By what wisdom is he who is most wise renowned by that wherewith the mighty Indra repeatedly does (great things); he is the especial effacer of the manifold sin of the worshipper, and bestows wealth upon his adorer.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नो मर्धीरा भरा दद्धि तन्नः प्र दाशुषे दातवे भूरि यत्ते । नव्ये देष्णे शस्ते अस्मिन्त उक्थे प्र ब्रवाम वयमिन्द्र स्तुवन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā no mardhīrā bharā daddhi tannaḥ pra dāśuṣe dātave bhūri yatte | navye deṣṇe śaste asminta ukthe pra bravāma vayamindra stuvantaḥ ||

translations.english: Harm us not, but cherish us, Indra; bestow upon us that abundant wealth which it is yours to give to the donor (of the oblation); praising you, we celebrate you at this sacred rite, which is new and excellent, and (at which the oblation) is proper to be presented.

mantras.sanskrit: नू ष्टुत इन्द्र नू गृणान इषं जरित्रे नद्यो न पीपेः । अकारि ते हरिवो ब्रह्म नव्यं धिया स्याम रथ्यः सदासाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū ṣṭuta indra nū gṛṇāna iṣaṃ jaritre nadyo na pīpeḥ | akāri te harivo brahma navyaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ ||

translations.english: Glorified (in the past) glorified, Indra, at present, satisfy your worshipper with food, as rivers (are filled with water); lord of horses, a new hymn has been made for you; may we, possessed of chariots, be ever delighted in your praise.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यात्विन्द्रोऽवस उप न इह स्तुतः सधमादस्तु शूरः । वावृधानस्तविषीर्यस्य पूर्वीर्द्यौर्न क्षत्रमभिभूति पुष्यात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yātvindro'vasa upa na iha stutaḥ sadhamādastu śūraḥ | vāvṛdhānastaviṣīryasya pūrvīrdyaurna kṣatramabhibhūti puṣyāt ||

translations.english: May Indra come to us for protection, and being praised (by us), may the mighty hero be exhilarated along with (us) at this rite; he whose energies are many; may he, like the radiant sun, recruit his own overpowering vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: तस्येदिह स्तवथ वृष्ण्यानि तुविद्युम्नस्य तुविराधसो नॄन् । यस्य क्रतुर्विदथ्यो न सम्राट् साह्वान्तरुत्रो अभ्यस्ति कृष्टीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tasyediha stavatha vṛṣṇyāni tuvidyumnasya tuvirādhaso nṝn | yasya kraturvidathyo na samrāṭ sāhvāntarutro abhyasti kṛṣṭīḥ ||

translations.english: Glorify the powerful leaders of that renowned and opulent (Indra), whose victorious and protecting energy rules over men, like a universal sovereign entitled to veneration.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यात्विन्द्रो दिव आ पृथिव्या मक्षू समुद्रादुत वा पुरीषात् । स्वर्णरादवसे नो मरुत्वान्परावतो वा सदनादृतस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yātvindro diva ā pṛthivyā makṣū samudrāduta vā purīṣāt | svarṇarādavase no marutvānparāvato vā sadanādṛtasya ||

translations.english: May Indra, accompanied by the Maruts come quickly for our protection, from the heaven, from the earth, from the firmament, or from the waters; from the sphere of the sun, from (any) distant region, from the abode of the rains.

mantras.sanskrit: स्थूरस्य रायो बृहतो य ईशे तमु ष्टवाम विदथेष्विन्द्रम् । यो वायुना जयति गोमतीषु प्र धृष्णुया नयति वस्यो अच्छ ॥
mantras.transliteration: sthūrasya rāyo bṛhato ya īśe tamu ṣṭavāma vidatheṣvindram | yo vāyunā jayati gomatīṣu pra dhṛṣṇuyā nayati vasyo accha ||

translations.english: We glorify, in solemn rites, this Indra who rules over substantial, abundant riches; who by his prowess is victor over (hostile) hosts; who by his munificence brings excellent (wealth) to the presence (of his worshippers).

mantras.sanskrit: उप यो नमो नमसि स्तभायन्नियर्ति वाचं जनयन्यजध्यै । ऋञ्जसानः पुरुवार उक्थैरेन्द्रं कृण्वीत सदनेषु होता ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa yo namo namasi stabhāyanniyarti vācaṃ janayanyajadhyai | ṛñjasānaḥ puruvāra ukthairendraṃ kṛṇvīta sadaneṣu hotā ||

translations.english: Let the invoking priest bring to our dwellings that (Indra) who, firmly fixing the (world) returns food for (sacrificial food), and (utters) a voice enjoining (men) to worship; he who is to be propitiated by praises, who is adored by many.

mantras.sanskrit: धिषा यदि धिषण्यन्तः सरण्यान्त्सदन्तो अद्रिमौशिजस्य गोहे । आ दुरोषाः पास्त्यस्य होता यो नो महान्त्संवरणेषु वह्निः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhiṣā yadi dhiṣaṇyantaḥ saraṇyāntsadanto adrimauśijasya gohe | ā duroṣāḥ pāstyasya hotā yo no mahāntsaṃvaraṇeṣu vahniḥ ||

translations.english: When the repeaters of (his) commendations, abiding in the dwelling of the worshipper, approach Indra with praise, may he who is our (great) sustainer in conflicts, whose wrath is difficult to be (appeased), becomes the ministering priest of the master of the house.

mantras.sanskrit: सत्रा यदीं भार्वरस्य वृष्णः सिषक्ति शुष्मः स्तुवते भराय । गुहा यदीमौशिजस्य गोहे प्र यद्धिये प्रायसे मदाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: satrā yadīṃ bhārvarasya vṛṣṇaḥ siṣakti śuṣmaḥ stuvate bharāya | guhā yadīmauśijasya gohe pra yaddhiye prāyase madāya ||

translations.english: True it is that this might of the son of the protector of the world, the showerer (of benefits), affects for his advantage the offerer of praise; it (prevails) in the secret (thoughts) of the worshipper, and in his dwelling, for (the accomplishment of his) pious acts, (the attainment of his) desires, and his delight.

mantras.sanskrit: वि यद्वरांसि पर्वतस्य वृण्वे पयोभिर्जिन्वे अपां जवांसि । विदद्गौरस्य गवयस्य गोहे यदी वाजाय सुध्यो वहन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi yadvarāṃsi parvatasya vṛṇve payobhirjinve apāṃ javāṃsi | vidadgaurasya gavayasya gohe yadī vājāya sudhyo vahanti ||

translations.english: Inasmuch as he has opened the doors of the cloud, and has supplied the rapid courses of the waters with (additional) torrents, so when the pious have recourse to Indra for food, he finds (it) in the haunt of the Gaura and Gavaya.

mantras.sanskrit: भद्रा ते हस्ता सुकृतोत पाणी प्रयन्तारा स्तुवते राध इन्द्र । का ते निषत्तिः किमु नो ममत्सि किं नोदुदु हर्षसे दातवा उ ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhadrā te hastā sukṛtota pāṇī prayantārā stuvate rādha indra | kā te niṣattiḥ kimu no mamatsi kiṃ nodudu harṣase dātavā u ||

translations.english: Your auspicious hands, Indra, are the doers of good deeds; your two hands, Indra, are the extenders of wealth to him who praises you; what, Indra, is this delay? why do you not exhilarate us? why are you not delighted to make us gifts?

mantras.sanskrit: एवा वस्व इन्द्रः सत्यः सम्राड्ढन्ता वृत्रं वरिवः पूरवे कः । पुरुष्टुत क्रत्वा नः शग्धि रायो भक्षीय तेऽवसो दैव्यस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā vasva indraḥ satyaḥ samrāḍḍhantā vṛtraṃ varivaḥ pūrave kaḥ | puruṣṭuta kratvā naḥ śagdhi rāyo bhakṣīya te'vaso daivyasya ||

translations.english: Thus (glorified), Indra, who is faithful (to his word), the lord of wealth, the slayer of Vṛtra, bestows rihes on man; so you, the praised of many, give us riches for our pious acts, that I may eat of your divine food.

mantras.sanskrit: नू ष्टुत इन्द्र नू गृणान इषं जरित्रे नद्यो न पीपेः । अकारि ते हरिवो ब्रह्म नव्यं धिया स्याम रथ्यः सदासाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū ṣṭuta indra nū gṛṇāna iṣaṃ jaritre nadyo na pīpeḥ | akāri te harivo brahma navyaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ ||

translations.english: Glorified (in the past), glorified, Indra, at present, satisfy your worshipper with food, as rivers (are filled with water); lord of horses, a new hymn has been made for you; may we, possessed of chariots, be ever delighted in your praise.

mantras.sanskrit: यन्न इन्द्रो जुजुषे यच्च वष्टि तन्नो महान्करति शुष्म्या चित् । ब्रह्म स्तोमं मघवा सोममुक्था यो अश्मानं शवसा बिभ्रदेति ॥
mantras.transliteration: yanna indro jujuṣe yacca vaṣṭi tanno mahānkarati śuṣmyā cit | brahma stomaṃ maghavā somamukthā yo aśmānaṃ śavasā bibhradeti ||

translations.english: Since the great and mighty Indra is propitiated by our (oblations), since he desires (them) from us, may he, the possessor of opulence, who comes wielding the thunderbolt of his strength, accept the (sacrificial) food, the hymn, the Soma libation, and the prayers.

mantras.sanskrit: वृषा वृषन्धिं चतुरश्रिमस्यन्नुग्रो बाहुभ्यां नृतमः शचीवान् । श्रिये परुष्णीमुषमाण ऊर्णां यस्याः पर्वाणि सख्याय विव्ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣā vṛṣandhiṃ caturaśrimasyannugro bāhubhyāṃ nṛtamaḥ śacīvān | śriye paruṣṇīmuṣamāṇa ūrṇāṃ yasyāḥ parvāṇi sakhyāya vivye ||

translations.english: The showerer (of benefits), casting with his hands the quadrangular bolt that causes rain, fierce, the chief of leaders, the achiever of (glorious) acts, is desirous of the prosperity of the investing Paruṣṇi (river), whose (bordering) districts he has frequented through regard.

mantras.sanskrit: यो देवो देवतमो जायमानो महो वाजेभिर्महद्भिश्च शुष्मैः । दधानो वज्रं बाह्वोरुशन्तं द्याममेन रेजयत्प्र भूम ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo devo devatamo jāyamāno maho vājebhirmahadbhiśca śuṣmaiḥ | dadhāno vajraṃ bāhvoruśantaṃ dyāmamena rejayatpra bhūma ||

translations.english: Who diine, most divine, as soon as born (was endowed) with abundant viands, and great energies, holding in his arms the willing thunderbolt, and causing by his strength (both) heaven and earth to tremble.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वा रोधांसि प्रवतश्च पूर्वीर्द्यौॠष्वाज्जनिमन्रेजत क्षाः । आ मातरा भरति शुष्म्या गोर्नृवत्परिज्मन्नोनुवन्त वाताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvā rodhāṃsi pravataśca pūrvīrdyauṝṣvājjanimanrejata kṣāḥ | ā mātarā bharati śuṣmyā gornṛvatparijmannonuvanta vātāḥ ||

translations.english: All the high plural ces, and the many low paces, the heaven and the earth, trembled (through fear) of the mighty (Indra) at his birth; the strong (Indra) cherishes the parents of the moving (Sun), and the winds, like men, make a noise in their peregrination.

mantras.sanskrit: ता तू त इन्द्र महतो महानि विश्वेष्वित्सवनेषु प्रवाच्या । यच्छूर धृष्णो धृषता दधृष्वानहिं वज्रेण शवसाविवेषीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā tū ta indra mahato mahāni viśveṣvitsavaneṣu pravācyā | yacchūra dhṛṣṇo dhṛṣatā dadhṛṣvānahiṃ vajreṇa śavasāviveṣīḥ ||

translations.english: Of you, Indra, who are mighty, great are deeds, and to be proclaimed at all sacrifices, inasmuch as, high-minded hero, you, sustaining (the world), have by your strength slain Ahi with the resistless thunderbolt.

mantras.sanskrit: ता तू ते सत्या तुविनृम्ण विश्वा प्र धेनवः सिस्रते वृष्ण ऊध्नः । अधा ह त्वद्वृषमणो भियानाः प्र सिन्धवो जवसा चक्रमन्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā tū te satyā tuvinṛmṇa viśvā pra dhenavaḥ sisrate vṛṣṇa ūdhnaḥ | adhā ha tvadvṛṣamaṇo bhiyānāḥ pra sindhavo javasā cakramanta ||

translations.english: Most powerful Indra, all these, your exploits, are verily true: (through fear of you), the showerer (of benefits), the cows shed (milk) from their udders; then, benevolent-minded (Indra), the rivers, fearing you, flow with rapidity.

mantras.sanskrit: अत्राह ते हरिवस्ता उ देवीरवोभिरिन्द्र स्तवन्त स्वसारः । यत्सीमनु प्र मुचो बद्बधाना दीर्घामनु प्रसितिं स्यन्दयध्यै ॥
mantras.transliteration: atrāha te harivastā u devīravobhirindra stavanta svasāraḥ | yatsīmanu pra muco badbadhānā dīrghāmanu prasitiṃ syandayadhyai ||

translations.english: Then, Indra, lord of horses, the divine sister (rivers) praise (you) for your protection when you did set them free to flow, after having been impeded (by Vṛtra) through a long confinement.

mantras.sanskrit: पिपीळे अंशुर्मद्यो न सिन्धुरा त्वा शमी शशमानस्य शक्तिः । अस्मद्र्यक्छुशुचानस्य यम्या आशुर्न रश्मिं तुव्योजसं गोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pipīḷe aṃśurmadyo na sindhurā tvā śamī śaśamānasya śaktiḥ | asmadryakchuśucānasya yamyā āśurna raśmiṃ tuvyojasaṃ goḥ ||

translations.english: The exhilarating Soma juice has been expressed; now may the curren flow to you, and may the expiatory power of the illustrious utterer of praise be directed towards us, as the quick rider holds firmly the reins of the steed.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मे वर्षिष्ठा कृणुहि ज्येष्ठा नृम्णानि सत्रा सहुरे सहांसि । अस्मभ्यं वृत्रा सुहनानि रन्धि जहि वधर्वनुषो मर्त्यस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: asme varṣiṣṭhā kṛṇuhi jyeṣṭhā nṛmṇāni satrā sahure sahāṃsi | asmabhyaṃ vṛtrā suhanāni randhi jahi vadharvanuṣo martyasya ||

translations.english: Enduring Indra, bestow upon us energies, excellent, superior, powerful; bring under subjection to us enemies deserving of death; demolish the weapon of the malevolent man.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्माकमित्सु शृणुहि त्वमिन्द्रास्मभ्यं चित्राँ उप माहि वाजान् । अस्मभ्यं विश्वा इषणः पुरंधीरस्माकं सु मघवन्बोधि गोदाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmākamitsu śṛṇuhi tvamindrāsmabhyaṃ citrā~ upa māhi vājān | asmabhyaṃ viśvā iṣaṇaḥ puraṃdhīrasmākaṃ su maghavanbodhi godāḥ ||

translations.english: Hear our praises, Indra, and bestow upon us many kinds of food; fulfil all our desires, and know yourself, Maghavan, to be to us the donor of cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: नू ष्टुत इन्द्र नू गृणान इषं जरित्रे नद्यो न पीपेः । अकारि ते हरिवो ब्रह्म नव्यं धिया स्याम रथ्यः सदासाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū ṣṭuta indra nū gṛṇāna iṣaṃ jaritre nadyo na pīpeḥ | akāri te harivo brahma navyaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ ||

translations.english: Glorified (in the past), glorified, Indra, at present, satisfy your worshipper with food, as rivers (are filled with water); lord of horses, a new hymn has been made for you; may we, possessed of chariots, be ever diligent in (your) praise.

mantras.sanskrit: कथा महामवृधत्कस्य होतुर्यज्ञं जुषाणो अभि सोममूधः । पिबन्नुशानो जुषमाणो अन्धो ववक्ष ऋष्वः शुचते धनाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: kathā mahāmavṛdhatkasya hoturyajñaṃ juṣāṇo abhi somamūdhaḥ | pibannuśāno juṣamāṇo andho vavakṣa ṛṣvaḥ śucate dhanāya ||

translations.english: In what manner may (any one) extol the mighty Indra? at the sacrifice of what worshipper may he, propitiated, be present, drinking the sacrificial Soma beverage, desirous of the (sacred) food, and plural ased (by the oblation)? the mighty Indra is borne (to the rite) for the purpose of bestowing brilliant wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: को अस्य वीरः सधमादमाप समानंश सुमतिभिः को अस्य । कदस्य चित्रं चिकिते कदूती वृधे भुवच्छशमानस्य यज्योः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ko asya vīraḥ sadhamādamāpa samānaṃśa sumatibhiḥ ko asya | kadasya citraṃ cikite kadūtī vṛdhe bhuvacchaśamānasya yajyoḥ ||

translations.english: What hero has enjoyed his fellowship (in battle)? who has been a sharer in his benevolent thoughts? when does any one appreciate his wonderful bounty? when is he (presen) for the promotion of the prosperity of the man who glorifies and worships him?

mantras.sanskrit: कथा शृणोति हूयमानमिन्द्रः कथा शृण्वन्नवसामस्य वेद । का अस्य पूर्वीरुपमातयो ह कथैनमाहुः पपुरिं जरित्रे ॥
mantras.transliteration: kathā śṛṇoti hūyamānamindraḥ kathā śṛṇvannavasāmasya veda | kā asya pūrvīrupamātayo ha kathainamāhuḥ papuriṃ jaritre ||

translations.english: How is that Indra hears (the worshipper) who invokes him? and, hearing, how does he know his necessities? what are his gifts of old; why have they termed him the fulfiller (of the desires) of him who offers praise?

mantras.sanskrit: कथा सबाधः शशमानो अस्य नशदभि द्रविणं दीध्यानः । देवो भुवन्नवेदा म ऋतानां नमो जगृभ्वाँ अभि यज्जुजोषत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kathā sabādhaḥ śaśamāno asya naśadabhi draviṇaṃ dīdhyānaḥ | devo bhuvannavedā ma ṛtānāṃ namo jagṛbhvā~ abhi yajjujoṣat ||

translations.english: How does he who glorifies Indra, and is diligent in his worship, although encountering opposition, obtain from him wealth? may the divine Indra be the appreciation of my praises, when accepting the sacrificial food he is propitiated towards me.

mantras.sanskrit: कथा कदस्या उषसो व्युष्टौ देवो मर्तस्य सख्यं जुजोष । कथा कदस्य सख्यं सखिभ्यो ये अस्मिन्कामं सुयुजं ततस्रे ॥
mantras.transliteration: kathā kadasyā uṣaso vyuṣṭau devo martasya sakhyaṃ jujoṣa | kathā kadasya sakhyaṃ sakhibhyo ye asminkāmaṃ suyujaṃ tatasre ||

translations.english: When, in what manner, at the dawning of this morning, has the divine Indra accepted the friendship of a mortal? when and in what manner, (is) his friendship (manifested) to the friends who have spread out the desirable and suitable (offering) before him?

mantras.sanskrit: किमादमत्रं सख्यं सखिभ्यः कदा नु ते भ्रात्रं प्र ब्रवाम । श्रिये सुदृशो वपुरस्य सर्गाः स्वर्ण चित्रतममिष आ गोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kimādamatraṃ sakhyaṃ sakhibhyaḥ kadā nu te bhrātraṃ pra bravāma | śriye sudṛśo vapurasya sargāḥ svarṇa citratamamiṣa ā goḥ ||

translations.english: May we in any manner proclaim your friendship for your friends? when may (we make known) your fraternal regard? the efforts of the well-looking Indra are for the happiness of all; the wonderful form of the moving (Indra) is, like the sun, ever wished for.

mantras.sanskrit: द्रुहं जिघांसन्ध्वरसमनिन्द्रां तेतिक्ते तिग्मा तुजसे अनीका । ऋणा चिद्यत्र ऋणया न उग्रो दूरे अज्ञाता उषसो बबाधे ॥
mantras.transliteration: druhaṃ jighāṃsandhvarasamanindrāṃ tetikte tigmā tujase anīkā | ṛṇā cidyatra ṛṇayā na ugro dūre ajñātā uṣaso babādhe ||

translations.english: Resolving to kil the oppressing, malevolent (rākṣasi), not acknowledging Indra, he sharpened his sharp weapons for (her) destruction, and the fierce (Indra) the canceller of debts, has kept afar the unknown dawns in which the debts (are to be paid).

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतस्य हि शुरुधः सन्ति पूर्वीॠतस्य धीतिर्वृजिनानि हन्ति । ऋतस्य श्लोको बधिरा ततर्द कर्णा बुधानः शुचमान आयोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtasya hi śurudhaḥ santi pūrvīṝtasya dhītirvṛjināni hanti | ṛtasya śloko badhirā tatarda karṇā budhānaḥ śucamāna āyoḥ ||

translations.english: Many are the waters of ṛta; the adoration of ṛta destroys iniquities; the intelligent and brilliant praise of ṛta has opened the deaf (ears) of man.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतस्य दृळ्हा धरुणानि सन्ति पुरूणि चन्द्रा वपुषे वपूंषि । ऋतेन दीर्घमिषणन्त पृक्ष ऋतेन गाव ऋतमा विवेशुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtasya dṛḷhā dharuṇāni santi purūṇi candrā vapuṣe vapūṃṣi | ṛtena dīrghamiṣaṇanta pṛkṣa ṛtena gāva ṛtamā viveśuḥ ||

translations.english: Many are the stable, sustaining, delightful forms of the embodied ṛta; the ṛta are (the pious) expectant of food; by ṛta have the kine entered into the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतं येमान ऋतमिद्वनोत्यृतस्य शुष्मस्तुरया उ गव्युः । ऋताय पृथ्वी बहुले गभीरे ऋताय धेनू परमे दुहाते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtaṃ yemāna ṛtamidvanotyṛtasya śuṣmasturayā u gavyuḥ | ṛtāya pṛthvī bahule gabhīre ṛtāya dhenū parame duhāte ||

translations.english: The (worshipper) subjecting ṛta (to his will) verily enjoys ṛta; the strength ṛta is (developed) with speed, and is desirous of (possessing) water; to ṛta belong the wide and profound heaven and earth; supreme kine, they yield their milk to ṛta.

mantras.sanskrit: नू ष्टुत इन्द्र नू गृणान इषं जरित्रे नद्यो न पीपेः । अकारि ते हरिवो ब्रह्म नव्यं धिया स्याम रथ्यः सदासाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū ṣṭuta indra nū gṛṇāna iṣaṃ jaritre nadyo na pīpeḥ | akāri te harivo brahma navyaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ ||

translations.english: Glorified (in the past), glorified, Indra, at present, satisfy your worshipper with food, as rivers (are filled with water); lord of horses, a new hymn has been made for you; may we possessed of chariots, be ever diligent in our praise.

mantras.sanskrit: का सुष्टुतिः शवसः सूनुमिन्द्रमर्वाचीनं राधस आ ववर्तत् । ददिर्हि वीरो गृणते वसूनि स गोपतिर्निष्षिधां नो जनासः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kā suṣṭutiḥ śavasaḥ sūnumindramarvācīnaṃ rādhasa ā vavartat | dadirhi vīro gṛṇate vasūni sa gopatirniṣṣidhāṃ no janāsaḥ ||

translations.english: What suitable praise may bring the son of strength, Indra, before us, to give us wealth; the hero, the lord of cattle, is the donor, oḥ man, of the wealth of his adversaries to him who glorifies him.

mantras.sanskrit: स वृत्रहत्ये हव्यः स ईड्यः स सुष्टुत इन्द्रः सत्यराधाः । स यामन्ना मघवा मर्त्याय ब्रह्मण्यते सुष्वये वरिवो धात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa vṛtrahatye havyaḥ sa īḍyaḥ sa suṣṭuta indraḥ satyarādhāḥ | sa yāmannā maghavā martyāya brahmaṇyate suṣvaye varivo dhāt ||

translations.english: He, Indra, is to be invoked for the destruction of Vṛtra; he, the deservedly praised, is to be worshipped; the real donor of wealth, he, Maghavan, gives wealth, (acquired) in battle, to the mortal offers him prayer and libations.

mantras.sanskrit: तमिन्नरो वि ह्वयन्ते समीके रिरिक्वांसस्तन्वः कृण्वत त्राम् । मिथो यत्त्यागमुभयासो अग्मन्नरस्तोकस्य तनयस्य सातौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: taminnaro vi hvayante samīke ririkvāṃsastanvaḥ kṛṇvata trām | mitho yattyāgamubhayāso agmannarastokasya tanayasya sātau ||

translations.english: Men verily call upon him in battle; the (devout) inflicters of austerity upon their person ns constitute him their preserver; when both (the worshipper and the priest) approach together the bountiful Indra, men (succeed) in (obtaining) the gift of sons and grandsons.

mantras.sanskrit: क्रतूयन्ति क्षितयो योग उग्राशुषाणासो मिथो अर्णसातौ । सं यद्विशोऽववृत्रन्त युध्मा आदिन्नेम इन्द्रयन्ते अभीके ॥
mantras.transliteration: kratūyanti kṣitayo yoga ugrāśuṣāṇāso mitho arṇasātau | saṃ yadviśo'vavṛtranta yudhmā ādinnema indrayante abhīke ||

translations.english: Powerful Indra, men variously dispersed, come mutually together to celebrate sacred rites for the sake of obtaining rain; when men who are combatants assemble in battle, there are some of them who rely upon Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: आदिद्ध नेम इन्द्रियं यजन्त आदित्पक्तिः पुरोळाशं रिरिच्यात् । आदित्सोमो वि पपृच्यादसुष्वीनादिज्जुजोष वृषभं यजध्यै ॥
mantras.transliteration: ādiddha nema indriyaṃ yajanta āditpaktiḥ puroḷāśaṃ riricyāt | āditsomo vi papṛcyādasuṣvīnādijjujoṣa vṛṣabhaṃ yajadhyai ||

translations.english: Thereupon some verily worship the powerful (Indra); thereupon one man prepares the buttered cake that he may offer it to (Indra); thereupon the offerer of the Soma he distinguishes from him who presents no libation; thereupon some one rejoices to worship the showerer (of benefits).

mantras.sanskrit: कृणोत्यस्मै वरिवो य इत्थेन्द्राय सोममुशते सुनोति । सध्रीचीनेन मनसाविवेनन्तमित्सखायं कृणुते समत्सु ॥
mantras.transliteration: kṛṇotyasmai varivo ya itthendrāya somamuśate sunoti | sadhrīcīnena manasāvivenantamitsakhāyaṃ kṛṇute samatsu ||

translations.english: Indra bestows wealth upon him who offers a libation to him, desiring it, though in another sphere; and, with a humble mind, makes him who is devoted to him his friend in combats.

mantras.sanskrit: य इन्द्राय सुनवत्सोममद्य पचात्पक्तीरुत भृज्जाति धानाः । प्रति मनायोरुचथानि हर्यन्तस्मिन्दधद्वृषणं शुष्ममिन्द्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya indrāya sunavatsomamadya pacātpaktīruta bhṛjjāti dhānāḥ | prati manāyorucathāni haryantasmindadhadvṛṣaṇaṃ śuṣmamindraḥ ||

translations.english: Indra accepting graciously the praises of his devoted (worshipper), who today pours out the libation to him who toasts the buttered cakes, or fries barley for Indra, exercises towards him the power that grants his desires.

mantras.sanskrit: यदा समर्यं व्यचेदृघावा दीर्घं यदाजिमभ्यख्यदर्यः । अचिक्रदद्वृषणं पत्न्यच्छा दुरोण आ निशितं सोमसुद्भिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadā samaryaṃ vyacedṛghāvā dīrghaṃ yadājimabhyakhyadaryaḥ | acikradadvṛṣaṇaṃ patnyacchā duroṇa ā niśitaṃ somasudbhiḥ ||

translations.english: When the destroyer (of enemies) distinguishes a mortal foe; when the lord is engaged in the long (continued) battle, (his) bride summons to the dwelling the showerer (of benefits), encompassed by the offerers of the libation.

mantras.sanskrit: भूयसा वस्नमचरत्कनीयोऽविक्रीतो अकानिषं पुनर्यन् । स भूयसा कनीयो नारिरेचीद्दीना दक्षा वि दुहन्ति प्र वाणम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhūyasā vasnamacaratkanīyo'vikrīto akāniṣaṃ punaryan | sa bhūyasā kanīyo nārirecīddīnā dakṣā vi duhanti pra vāṇam ||

translations.english: A man has realized a small price for an article of great value, and again coming (to the buyer he says) this has not been sold; I require the full price; but he does not recover a small price by a large (equivalent); whether helpless or clever they adhere to their bargain.

mantras.sanskrit: क इमं दशभिर्ममेन्द्रं क्रीणाति धेनुभिः । यदा वृत्राणि जङ्घनदथैनं मे पुनर्ददत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ka imaṃ daśabhirmamendraṃ krīṇāti dhenubhiḥ | yadā vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanadathainaṃ me punardadat ||

translations.english: Who buys him, my Indra, with ten kine? when he shall have slain (your) foes, then let (the purchaser) give him again to me.

mantras.sanskrit: नू ष्टुत इन्द्र नू गृणान इषं जरित्रे नद्यो न पीपेः । अकारि ते हरिवो ब्रह्म नव्यं धिया स्याम रथ्यः सदासाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū ṣṭuta indra nū gṛṇāna iṣaṃ jaritre nadyo na pīpeḥ | akāri te harivo brahma navyaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ ||

translations.english: Glorified (in the past), glorified, Indra, at present, satisfy your worshipper with food, as rivers (are filled with water); lord of horses, a new hymn has been made for you; may we, possessed of chariots, be ever diligent in your praise.

mantras.sanskrit: को अद्य नर्यो देवकाम उशन्निन्द्रस्य सख्यं जुजोष । को वा महेऽवसे पार्याय समिद्धे अग्नौ सुतसोम ईट्टे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ko adya naryo devakāma uśannindrasya sakhyaṃ jujoṣa | ko vā mahe'vase pāryāya samiddhe agnau sutasoma īṭṭe ||

translations.english: What friend of man, or worshipper of the gods, deserving the friendship of Indra, has today enjoyed (it)? or what offerer of the libation on the kindled fire praises him (sufficiently) for his great and unbounded protection?

mantras.sanskrit: को नानाम वचसा सोम्याय मनायुर्वा भवति वस्त उस्राः । क इन्द्रस्य युज्यं कः सखित्वं को भ्रात्रं वष्टि कवये क ऊती ॥
mantras.transliteration: ko nānāma vacasā somyāya manāyurvā bhavati vasta usrāḥ | ka indrasya yujyaṃ kaḥ sakhitvaṃ ko bhrātraṃ vaṣṭi kavaye ka ūtī ||

translations.english: Who has reverenced with (suitable) words the (deity) worthy of the libation? who is devoted (to him)? who supports the cattle (given by him)? who desires the society of Indra? who his friendship? who his fraternity? who (has recourse) to the sage Indra for protection?

mantras.sanskrit: को देवानामवो अद्या वृणीते क आदित्याँ अदितिं ज्योतिरीट्टे । कस्याश्विनाविन्द्रो अग्निः सुतस्यांशोः पिबन्ति मनसाविवेनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ko devānāmavo adyā vṛṇīte ka ādityā~ aditiṃ jyotirīṭṭe | kasyāśvināvindro agniḥ sutasyāṃśoḥ pibanti manasāvivenam ||

translations.english: Who solicits today the protection of the gods? who glorifies the Ādityas, Aditi, light? of whose effused libation to the Aśvins, Indra, Agni, drink at will propitiated by his praise?

mantras.sanskrit: तस्मा अग्निर्भारतः शर्म यंसज्ज्योक्पश्यात्सूर्यमुच्चरन्तम् । य इन्द्राय सुनवामेत्याह नरे नर्याय नृतमाय नृणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tasmā agnirbhārataḥ śarma yaṃsajjyokpaśyātsūryamuccarantam | ya indrāya sunavāmetyāha nare naryāya nṛtamāya nṛṇām ||

translations.english: May Agni, the bearer of oblations, grant him felicity, and long behold the rising sun (in the dwelling of him) who says, let us offer libations to Indra, leader (of rites) the friend of man, the chief leader among leaders.

mantras.sanskrit: न तं जिनन्ति बहवो न दभ्रा उर्वस्मा अदितिः शर्म यंसत् । प्रियः सुकृत्प्रिय इन्द्रे मनायुः प्रियः सुप्रावीः प्रियो अस्य सोमी ॥
mantras.transliteration: na taṃ jinanti bahavo na dabhrā urvasmā aditiḥ śarma yaṃsat | priyaḥ sukṛtpriya indre manāyuḥ priyaḥ suprāvīḥ priyo asya somī ||

translations.english: Him neither many nor few can molest; may Aditi grant him infinite happiness; the performer of pious acts is dear (to Indra); dear to Indra is he whose mind is intent upon him; dear is he who approaches him with homage; dear to him is the offerer of the libation.

mantras.sanskrit: सुप्राव्यः प्राशुषाळेष वीरः सुष्वेः पक्तिं कृणुते केवलेन्द्रः । नासुष्वेरापिर्न सखा न जामिर्दुष्प्राव्योऽवहन्तेदवाचः ॥
mantras.transliteration: suprāvyaḥ prāśuṣāḷeṣa vīraḥ suṣveḥ paktiṃ kṛṇute kevalendraḥ | nāsuṣverāpirna sakhā na jāmirduṣprāvyo'vahantedavācaḥ ||

translations.english: This hero, Indra, the prompt discomfiter (of foes), who is to be approached with homage, grants special maturity to the presenter of the libation; he is not the kinsman, nor friend, nor relative, of him who offers no libation (to him); he is difficult of access, and the punisher of him who repeats not (his) praise.

mantras.sanskrit: न रेवता पणिना सख्यमिन्द्रोऽसुन्वता सुतपाः सं गृणीते । आस्य वेदः खिदति हन्ति नग्नं वि सुष्वये पक्तये केवलो भूत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: na revatā paṇinā sakhyamindro'sunvatā sutapāḥ saṃ gṛṇīte | āsya vedaḥ khidati hanti nagnaṃ vi suṣvaye paktaye kevalo bhūt ||

translations.english: (Indra), the drinker of the effused Soma, contract no friendship with the wealthy trader who offers not any libation; he takes away his wealth; destroys him when destitute; but he is a special (friend) to him who presents the libation and oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रं परेऽवरे मध्यमास इन्द्रं यान्तोऽवसितास इन्द्रम् । इन्द्रं क्षियन्त उत युध्यमाना इन्द्रं नरो वाजयन्तो हवन्ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraṃ pare'vare madhyamāsa indraṃ yānto'vasitāsa indram | indraṃ kṣiyanta uta yudhyamānā indraṃ naro vājayanto havante ||

translations.english: The most exalted, the most humble, (invoke) Indra; the middle (classes) invoke Indra; those going, those stopping, (invoke) Indra; those dwelling at home, those going in battle, (invoke) Indra; men needing food invoke Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: अहं मनुरभवं सूर्यश्चाहं कक्षीवाँ ऋषिरस्मि विप्रः । अहं कुत्समार्जुनेयं न्यृञ्जेऽहं कविरुशना पश्यता मा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ manurabhavaṃ sūryaścāhaṃ kakṣīvā~ ṛṣirasmi vipraḥ | ahaṃ kutsamārjuneyaṃ nyṛñje'haṃ kaviruśanā paśyatā mā ||

translations.english: I have been Manu and Sūrya; I am the wise ṛṣi: Kakṣīvat; I have befriended Kutsa, the son of Arjuni; I am the far-seeing Uśanās; so behold me.

mantras.sanskrit: अहं भूमिमददामार्यायाहं वृष्टिं दाशुषे मर्त्याय । अहमपो अनयं वावशाना मम देवासो अनु केतमायन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ bhūmimadadāmāryāyāhaṃ vṛṣṭiṃ dāśuṣe martyāya | ahamapo anayaṃ vāvaśānā mama devāso anu ketamāyan ||

translations.english: I gave the earth to the venerable (Manu); I have bestowed rain upon the mortal who presents (oblations); I have let forth the sounding waters; the gods obey my will.

mantras.sanskrit: अहं पुरो मन्दसानो व्यैरं नव साकं नवतीः शम्बरस्य । शततमं वेश्यं सर्वताता दिवोदासमतिथिग्वं यदावम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ puro mandasāno vyairaṃ nava sākaṃ navatīḥ śambarasya | śatatamaṃ veśyaṃ sarvatātā divodāsamatithigvaṃ yadāvam ||

translations.english: Exhilarated (by the Soma beverage) I have destroyed the ninety and nine cities of Śambara, the hundredth I gave to be occupied by Divodāsa when I protected him, Atithigva, at his sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सु ष विभ्यो मरुतो विरस्तु प्र श्येनः श्येनेभ्य आशुपत्वा । अचक्रया यत्स्वधया सुपर्णो हव्यं भरन्मनवे देवजुष्टम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra su ṣa vibhyo maruto virastu pra śyenaḥ śyenebhya āśupatvā | acakrayā yatsvadhayā suparṇo havyaṃ bharanmanave devajuṣṭam ||

translations.english: May this bird, Maruts, be pre-eminent over (other) hawks, since with a wheelless car the swift-winged bore the Soma, accepted by the gods, to Manu.

mantras.sanskrit: भरद्यदि विरतो वेविजानः पथोरुणा मनोजवा असर्जि । तूयं ययौ मधुना सोम्येनोत श्रवो विविदे श्येनो अत्र ॥
mantras.transliteration: bharadyadi virato vevijānaḥ pathoruṇā manojavā asarji | tūyaṃ yayau madhunā somyenota śravo vivide śyeno atra ||

translations.english: When the bird, intimidating (its guardians), carried off from hence (the Soma) it was at large; (flying) swift as thought along the vast path (of the firmament), it went rapidly with the sweet Soma, and the hawks thence acquired the celebrity in this world.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋजीपी श्येनो ददमानो अंशुं परावतः शकुनो मन्द्रं मदम् । सोमं भरद्दादृहाणो देवावान्दिवो अमुष्मादुत्तरादादाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛjīpī śyeno dadamāno aṃśuṃ parāvataḥ śakuno mandraṃ madam | somaṃ bharaddādṛhāṇo devāvāndivo amuṣmāduttarādādāya ||

translations.english: The straight-flying hawk, conveying the Soma from afar; the bird, attended by the gods, brought, resolute of purpose, the adorable exhilarating Soma, having taken it from that lofty heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: आदाय श्येनो अभरत्सोमं सहस्रं सवाँ अयुतं च साकम् । अत्रा पुरंधिरजहादरातीर्मदे सोमस्य मूरा अमूरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ādāya śyeno abharatsomaṃ sahasraṃ savā~ ayutaṃ ca sākam | atrā puraṃdhirajahādarātīrmade somasya mūrā amūraḥ ||

translations.english: Having taken it, the hawk brought the Soma with him to a thousand and ten thousand sacrifices, and this being provided, the performer of many (great) deeds, the unbewildered (Indra) destroyed, in the exhilaration of the Soma, (his) bewildered foes.

mantras.sanskrit: गर्भे नु सन्नन्वेषामवेदमहं देवानां जनिमानि विश्वा । शतं मा पुर आयसीररक्षन्नध श्येनो जवसा निरदीयम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: garbhe nu sannanveṣāmavedamahaṃ devānāṃ janimāni viśvā | śataṃ mā pura āyasīrarakṣannadha śyeno javasā niradīyam ||

translations.english: Being still in the germ, I have known all the births of these divinities in their order; a hundred bodies of metal confined me, but as a hawk I came forth with speed.

mantras.sanskrit: न घा स मामप जोषं जभाराभीमास त्वक्षसा वीर्येण । ईर्मा पुरंधिरजहादरातीरुत वाताँ अतरच्छूशुवानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: na ghā sa māmapa joṣaṃ jabhārābhīmāsa tvakṣasā vīryeṇa | īrmā puraṃdhirajahādarātīruta vātā~ ataracchūśuvānaḥ ||

translations.english: That embryo did not beguile me into satisfaction, but by the keen energy (of divine wisdom), I triumphed over it; the impeller of all, the sustainer of many, abandoned the foes (of knowledge), and, expanding, passed beyond the winds (of worldly troubles).

mantras.sanskrit: अव यच्छ्येनो अस्वनीदध द्योर्वि यद्यदि वात ऊहुः पुरंधिम् । सृजद्यदस्मा अव ह क्षिपज्ज्यां कृशानुरस्ता मनसा भुरण्यन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ava yacchyeno asvanīdadha dyorvi yadyadi vāta ūhuḥ puraṃdhim | sṛjadyadasmā ava ha kṣipajjyāṃ kṛśānurastā manasā bhuraṇyan ||

translations.english: When the hawk screamed (with exultation) on his descent from heaven, and (the guardians of the Soma) perceived that the Soma was (carried away) by it then, the archer of Kṛśānu, pursuing with the speed of thought, and stringing his bow, let fly an arrow against it.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋजिप्य ईमिन्द्रावतो न भुज्युं श्येनो जभार बृहतो अधि ष्णोः । अन्तः पतत्पतत्र्यस्य पर्णमध यामनि प्रसितस्य तद्वेः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛjipya īmindrāvato na bhujyuṃ śyeno jabhāra bṛhato adhi ṣṇoḥ | antaḥ patatpatatryasya parṇamadha yāmani prasitasya tadveḥ ||

translations.english: The straight-flying hawk carried off the Soma from above the vast heaven, as (the Aśvins carried off) Bhujyu from the region of Indra, and a falling feather from the middle of the bird dropped from him wounded in the conflict.

mantras.sanskrit: अध श्वेतं कलशं गोभिरक्तमापिप्यानं मघवा शुक्रमन्धः । अध्वर्युभिः प्रयतं मध्वो अग्रमिन्द्रो मदाय प्रति धत्पिबध्यै शूरो मदाय प्रति धत्पिबध्यै ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha śvetaṃ kalaśaṃ gobhiraktamāpipyānaṃ maghavā śukramandhaḥ | adhvaryubhiḥ prayataṃ madhvo agramindro madāya prati dhatpibadhyai śūro madāya prati dhatpibadhyai ||

translations.english: Now may Maghavan accept the pure nutitious (sacrificial) food in a white pitcher, mixed with milk and curds, offered by the priests; the upper part of the sweet (beverage) to drink for his exhilaration; may the hero accept (it) to drink for (his) exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वा युजा तव तत्सोम सख्य इन्द्रो अपो मनवे सस्रुतस्कः । अहन्नहिमरिणात्सप्त सिन्धूनपावृणोदपिहितेव खानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvā yujā tava tatsoma sakhya indro apo manave sasrutaskaḥ | ahannahimariṇātsapta sindhūnapāvṛṇodapihiteva khāni ||

translations.english: Through that friendship, Soma, which has united you with your (friend) Indra, he has made the waters flow for man; he has slain Ahi; he has sent forth the seven rivers, and has opened the shut-up sources (of the streams).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वा युजा नि खिदत्सूर्यस्येन्द्रश्चक्रं सहसा सद्य इन्दो । अधि ष्णुना बृहता वर्तमानं महो द्रुहो अप विश्वायु धायि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvā yujā ni khidatsūryasyendraścakraṃ sahasā sadya indo | adhi ṣṇunā bṛhatā vartamānaṃ maho druho apa viśvāyu dhāyi ||

translations.english: With you, Soma, for his ally, Indra has quickly taken off by force the wheel of the chariot of the sun, abiding above with the vast and stationary (firmament); the everywhere going wheel (of the car) of the great oppressor has been taken away.

mantras.sanskrit: अहन्निन्द्रो अदहदग्निरिन्दो पुरा दस्यून्मध्यंदिनादभीके । दुर्गे दुरोणे क्रत्वा न यातां पुरू सहस्रा शर्वा नि बर्हीत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahannindro adahadagnirindo purā dasyūnmadhyaṃdinādabhīke | durge duroṇe kratvā na yātāṃ purū sahasrā śarvā ni barhīt ||

translations.english: Indra has slain the Dasyus, Soma, in battle; Agni has consumed them before the noon; he (Indra) has destroyed the whole of many thosands, as (robbers are the destroyers of those) going upon (their own) business, in a difficult and dangerous (plural ce).

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वस्मात्सीमधमाँ इन्द्र दस्यून्विशो दासीरकृणोरप्रशस्ताः । अबाधेथाममृणतं नि शत्रूनविन्देथामपचितिं वधत्रैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvasmātsīmadhamā~ indra dasyūnviśo dāsīrakṛṇorapraśastāḥ | abādhethāmamṛṇataṃ ni śatrūnavindethāmapacitiṃ vadhatraiḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, you have made these Dasyus devoid of all (good qualities); you have made the races without rites abject; may you, (Soma and Indra), repel (and) destroy (your) enemies; accept (our) homage for their destruction.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा सत्यं मघवाना युवं तदिन्द्रश्च सोमोर्वमश्व्यं गोः । आदर्दृतमपिहितान्यश्ना रिरिचथुः क्षाश्चित्ततृदाना ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā satyaṃ maghavānā yuvaṃ tadindraśca somorvamaśvyaṃ goḥ | ādardṛtamapihitānyaśnā riricathuḥ kṣāścittatṛdānā ||

translations.english: Possessors of wealth, destroyers of foes, Indra and Soma, it is indeed true that you have distributed great numbers of horses, and of the cattle which had been concealed and the land which you had recovered by your strength.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नः स्तुत उप वाजेभिरूती इन्द्र याहि हरिभिर्मन्दसानः । तिरश्चिदर्यः सवना पुरूण्याङ्गूषेभिर्गृणानः सत्यराधाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā naḥ stuta upa vājebhirūtī indra yāhi haribhirmandasānaḥ | tiraścidaryaḥ savanā purūṇyāṅgūṣebhirgṛṇānaḥ satyarādhāḥ ||

translations.english: Honoured with accepted (sacrificial) viands, come, Indra, exulting, with your steeds, to our many rites, for our protection; you who are the lord, glorified by hymns, whose wealth is truth.

mantras.sanskrit: आ हि ष्मा याति नर्यश्चिकित्वान्हूयमानः सोतृभिरुप यज्ञम् । स्वश्वो यो अभीरुर्मन्यमानः सुष्वाणेभिर्मदति सं ह वीरैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā hi ṣmā yāti naryaścikitvānhūyamānaḥ sotṛbhirupa yajñam | svaśvo yo abhīrurmanyamānaḥ suṣvāṇebhirmadati saṃ ha vīraiḥ ||

translations.english: May Indra, the friend of man, the omniscient, come to the sacrifice when invoked by the offerers of libations; he is possessed of good horses, who is fearless honoured by the effusers of libations, who rejoices with the heroes (the Maruts).

mantras.sanskrit: श्रावयेदस्य कर्णा वाजयध्यै जुष्टामनु प्र दिशं मन्दयध्यै । उद्वावृषाणो राधसे तुविष्मान्करन्न इन्द्रः सुतीर्थाभयं च ॥
mantras.transliteration: śrāvayedasya karṇā vājayadhyai juṣṭāmanu pra diśaṃ mandayadhyai | udvāvṛṣāṇo rādhase tuviṣmānkaranna indraḥ sutīrthābhayaṃ ca ||

translations.english: Let (his worshipper) cause his ears to listen so as to invigorate him (by praise), and to give him plural asure in every acceptable plural ce; and being well moistened with the Soma juice, may the vigorous Indra render the holy plural ces (conducive) to our wealth, and free from danger.

mantras.sanskrit: अच्छा यो गन्ता नाधमानमूती इत्था विप्रं हवमानं गृणन्तम् । उप त्मनि दधानो धुर्याशून्त्सहस्राणि शतानि वज्रबाहुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: acchā yo gantā nādhamānamūtī itthā vipraṃ havamānaṃ gṛṇantam | upa tmani dadhāno dhuryāśūntsahasrāṇi śatāni vajrabāhuḥ ||

translations.english: (That Indra), who repairs to the suppliant or (his) protection, to the sage in this manner invoking and praising him; he who, armed with the thunderbolt, plural ces, of his own accord, hundred and thousands of swift-going (horses) in the shafts (of their cars).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वोतासो मघवन्निन्द्र विप्रा वयं ते स्याम सूरयो गृणन्तः । भेजानासो बृहद्दिवस्य राय आकाय्यस्य दावने पुरुक्षोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvotāso maghavannindra viprā vayaṃ te syāma sūrayo gṛṇantaḥ | bhejānāso bṛhaddivasya rāya ākāyyasya dāvane purukṣoḥ ||

translations.english: Opulent Indra, may we, who are protectedby you, who are intelligent, devout, and offerers of praise, be participant with you for the sake of distributing brilliant wealth, and abundant food, entitled to (our) commendation.

mantras.sanskrit: नकिरिन्द्र त्वदुत्तरो न ज्यायाँ अस्ति वृत्रहन् । नकिरेवा यथा त्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nakirindra tvaduttaro na jyāyā~ asti vṛtrahan | nakirevā yathā tvam ||

translations.english: There is no one, Indra, superior to you; no one more excellent (than you); slayer of Vṛtra there is no one, verily, such as you are.

mantras.sanskrit: सत्रा ते अनु कृष्टयो विश्वा चक्रेव वावृतुः । सत्रा महाँ असि श्रुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: satrā te anu kṛṣṭayo viśvā cakreva vāvṛtuḥ | satrā mahā~ asi śrutaḥ ||

translations.english: Verily men are attached to you as are all the wheels (to the body of the wagon); in truth you are great and renowned.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वे चनेदना त्वा देवास इन्द्र युयुधुः । यदहा नक्तमातिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśve canedanā tvā devāsa indra yuyudhuḥ | yadahā naktamātiraḥ ||

translations.english: Verily all the gods, with you (for) their strength, have warred (with the asuras); wherefore you have destroyed by day and by night.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्रोत बाधितेभ्यश्चक्रं कुत्साय युध्यते । मुषाय इन्द्र सूर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatrota bādhitebhyaścakraṃ kutsāya yudhyate | muṣāya indra sūryam ||

translations.english: In wihc (contests), for the sake of Kutsa and his allies, you hae stolen, Indra, the (wheel of the car) of the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्र देवाँ ऋघायतो विश्वाँ अयुध्य एक इत् । त्वमिन्द्र वनूँरहन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatra devā~ ṛghāyato viśvā~ ayudhya eka it | tvamindra vanū~rahan ||

translations.english: In which (contest) you singly indeed have warred with all those opposing the gods; you, Indra, have slain the malignant.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्रोत मर्त्याय कमरिणा इन्द्र सूर्यम् । प्रावः शचीभिरेतशम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatrota martyāya kamariṇā indra sūryam | prāvaḥ śacībhiretaśam ||

translations.english: In which (contests), Indra you have, for the sake of a mortal, discomfited the sun, and have protected Etaśa by (your) exploits.

mantras.sanskrit: किमादुतासि वृत्रहन्मघवन्मन्युमत्तमः । अत्राह दानुमातिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kimādutāsi vṛtrahanmaghavanmanyumattamaḥ | atrāha dānumātiraḥ ||

translations.english: Wherefore, slayer of Vṛtra, opulent Indra, have you thereupon become most incensed, and in consequence, have slain the son of Danu (Vṛtra) in this firmament.

mantras.sanskrit: एतद्घेदुत वीर्यमिन्द्र चकर्थ पौंस्यम् । स्त्रियं यद्दुर्हणायुवं वधीर्दुहितरं दिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: etadgheduta vīryamindra cakartha pauṃsyam | striyaṃ yaddurhaṇāyuvaṃ vadhīrduhitaraṃ divaḥ ||

translations.english: Inasmuch, Indra, as you have displayed such manly prowess, you have slain the woman, the daughter of the sky, when meditating mischief.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवश्चिद्घा दुहितरं महान्महीयमानाम् । उषासमिन्द्र सं पिणक् ॥
mantras.transliteration: divaścidghā duhitaraṃ mahānmahīyamānām | uṣāsamindra saṃ piṇak ||

translations.english: You Indra, who are mighty, have enriched glorious dawn, the daughter of heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: अपोषा अनसः सरत्सम्पिष्टादह बिभ्युषी । नि यत्सीं शिश्नथद्वृषा ॥
mantras.transliteration: apoṣā anasaḥ saratsampiṣṭādaha bibhyuṣī | ni yatsīṃ śiśnathadvṛṣā ||

translations.english: The terrified Uṣas descended from the broken wagon when the (showerer of benefits) had smashed it.

mantras.sanskrit: एतदस्या अनः शये सुसम्पिष्टं विपाश्या । ससार सीं परावतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: etadasyā anaḥ śaye susampiṣṭaṃ vipāśyā | sasāra sīṃ parāvataḥ ||

translations.english: Then her shattered wagon reposed (on the bank) of the Vipās' (river), and she departed from afar.

mantras.sanskrit: उत सिन्धुं विबाल्यं वितस्थानामधि क्षमि । परि ष्ठा इन्द्र मायया ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta sindhuṃ vibālyaṃ vitasthānāmadhi kṣami | pari ṣṭhā indra māyayā ||

translations.english: You have spread abroad upon the earth, by your contrivance, the swollen Sindhu when arrested (on its course).

mantras.sanskrit: उत शुष्णस्य धृष्णुया प्र मृक्षो अभि वेदनम् । पुरो यदस्य सम्पिणक् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta śuṣṇasya dhṛṣṇuyā pra mṛkṣo abhi vedanam | puro yadasya sampiṇak ||

translations.english: By valour you have carried off the wealth of Śuṣṇa, when you had demolished his cities.

mantras.sanskrit: उत दासं कौलितरं बृहतः पर्वतादधि । अवाहन्निन्द्र शम्बरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta dāsaṃ kaulitaraṃ bṛhataḥ parvatādadhi | avāhannindra śambaram ||

translations.english: You have slain the slave Śambara, the son Kulitara hurling him off the huge mountain.

mantras.sanskrit: उत दासस्य वर्चिनः सहस्राणि शतावधीः । अधि पञ्च प्रधीँरिव ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta dāsasya varcinaḥ sahasrāṇi śatāvadhīḥ | adhi pañca pradhī~riva ||

translations.english: You have slain the five hundreds and thousands (of the followers) of the slave Varin, (surrounding) him like the fellies (round the spokes of the wheel).

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्यं पुत्रमग्रुवः परावृक्तं शतक्रतुः । उक्थेष्विन्द्र आभजत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tyaṃ putramagruvaḥ parāvṛktaṃ śatakratuḥ | uktheṣvindra ābhajat ||

translations.english: You, Indra, who are Śatakratu, have made Parāvṛj, the son of Agru, participant in sacred hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्या तुर्वशायदू अस्नातारा शचीपतिः । इन्द्रो विद्वाँ अपारयत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tyā turvaśāyadū asnātārā śacīpatiḥ | indro vidvā~ apārayat ||

translations.english: The lord of acts, the wise Indra, has borne across (their difficulties), Turvaśas and Yadu, when denied inauguration.

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्या सद्य आर्या सरयोरिन्द्र पारतः । अर्णाचित्ररथावधीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tyā sadya āryā sarayorindra pārataḥ | arṇācitrarathāvadhīḥ ||

translations.english: You have slain at once those two Āryas, Arṇa and Citraratha, (dwellig) on the opposite (bank) of the Sarayu.

mantras.sanskrit: अनु द्वा जहिता नयोऽन्धं श्रोणं च वृत्रहन् । न तत्ते सुम्नमष्टवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: anu dvā jahitā nayo'ndhaṃ śroṇaṃ ca vṛtrahan | na tatte sumnamaṣṭave ||

translations.english: Slayer of Vṛtra you have restored the (one who was) blind, the (other who was) lame, both abandoned by their kin); (it is not possible) to exceed the happiness what is given by you.

mantras.sanskrit: शतमश्मन्मयीनां पुरामिन्द्रो व्यास्यत् । दिवोदासाय दाशुषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: śatamaśmanmayīnāṃ purāmindro vyāsyat | divodāsāya dāśuṣe ||

translations.english: Indra has overturned a hundred stone-built cities for Divodās, the donor of oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्वापयद्दभीतये सहस्रा त्रिंशतं हथैः । दासानामिन्द्रो मायया ॥
mantras.transliteration: asvāpayaddabhītaye sahasrā triṃśataṃ hathaiḥ | dāsānāmindro māyayā ||

translations.english: He put to sleep, by delusion, with his destructive (weapons), thirty thousand of the servile (races), for the sake of Dabhīti.

mantras.sanskrit: स घेदुतासि वृत्रहन्त्समान इन्द्र गोपतिः । यस्ता विश्वानि चिच्युषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa ghedutāsi vṛtrahantsamāna indra gopatiḥ | yastā viśvāni cicyuṣe ||

translations.english: Slayer of Vṛtra, you are the same to all your worshippers, the lord of cattle, who cast down all these (your enemies).

mantras.sanskrit: उत नूनं यदिन्द्रियं करिष्या इन्द्र पौंस्यम् । अद्या नकिष्टदा मिनत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta nūnaṃ yadindriyaṃ kariṣyā indra pauṃsyam | adyā nakiṣṭadā minat ||

translations.english: When, indeed, Indra, you excite your vigorous manhood, there is no one at the present time who may resist it.

mantras.sanskrit: वामंवामं त आदुरे देवो ददात्वर्यमा । वामं पूषा वामं भगो वामं देवः करूळती ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāmaṃvāmaṃ ta ādure devo dadātvaryamā | vāmaṃ pūṣā vāmaṃ bhago vāmaṃ devaḥ karūḷatī ||

translations.english: Destroyer of foes, may the divine Aryaman distribute your precious wealth; (may) Pūṣa (bestow it), (may), Bhaga (bestow it); may the toothless deity bestow the desired wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: कया नश्चित्र आ भुवदूती सदावृधः सखा । कया शचिष्ठया वृता ॥
mantras.transliteration: kayā naścitra ā bhuvadūtī sadāvṛdhaḥ sakhā | kayā śaciṣṭhayā vṛtā ||

translations.english: By what means may he who is ever augmenting, who is wonderful, who is our friend, be present with us, by what most effective rite?

mantras.sanskrit: कस्त्वा सत्यो मदानां मंहिष्ठो मत्सदन्धसः । दृळ्हा चिदारुजे वसु ॥
mantras.transliteration: kastvā satyo madānāṃ maṃhiṣṭho matsadandhasaḥ | dṛḷhā cidāruje vasu ||

translations.english: What genitive ine and most esteemed of the exhilarating juies of the (sacriiial) beverage may delight you to demolish the substantial treasures (of the foe)?

mantras.sanskrit: अभी षु णः सखीनामविता जरितॄणाम् । शतं भवास्यूतिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhī ṣu ṇaḥ sakhīnāmavitā jaritṝṇām | śataṃ bhavāsyūtibhiḥ ||

translations.english: Do you, the protector of us your friends and praisers, be present with a hundred protections.

mantras.sanskrit: अभी न आ ववृत्स्व चक्रं न वृत्तमर्वतः । नियुद्भिश्चर्षणीनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhī na ā vavṛtsva cakraṃ na vṛttamarvataḥ | niyudbhiścarṣaṇīnām ||

translations.english: (Induced) by the praise of men, return like a revolving wheel to us, dependent (upon your favour).

mantras.sanskrit: प्रवता हि क्रतूनामा हा पदेव गच्छसि । अभक्षि सूर्ये सचा ॥
mantras.transliteration: pravatā hi kratūnāmā hā padeva gacchasi | abhakṣi sūrye sacā ||

translations.english: You come in a downward (direction) to sacfred rites, as if to your own station; I glorify you together with the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: सं यत्त इन्द्र मन्यवः सं चक्राणि दधन्विरे । अध त्वे अध सूर्ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ yatta indra manyavaḥ saṃ cakrāṇi dadhanvire | adha tve adha sūrye ||

translations.english: When you praises, and these sacred rites, Indra, are addressed to you, they first belong to you and next to Sūrya.

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्मा हि त्वामाहुरिन्मघवानं शचीपते । दातारमविदीधयुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta smā hi tvāmāhurinmaghavānaṃ śacīpate | dātāramavidīdhayum ||

translations.english: Lord of holy acts, they call you Maghavan, the munificent, the resplendent.

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्मा सद्य इत्परि शशमानाय सुन्वते । पुरू चिन्मंहसे वसु ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta smā sadya itpari śaśamānāya sunvate | purū cinmaṃhase vasu ||

translations.english: And verily you give promptly abundant wealth to him who praises you and offers you libations.

mantras.sanskrit: नहि ष्मा ते शतं चन राधो वरन्त आमुरः । न च्यौत्नानि करिष्यतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahi ṣmā te śataṃ cana rādho varanta āmuraḥ | na cyautnāni kariṣyataḥ ||

translations.english: Adversaries diminish not your hundred-fold opulence nor resist the energies of you opposing (them).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्माँ अवन्तु ते शतमस्मान्त्सहस्रमूतयः । अस्मान्विश्वा अभिष्टयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmā~ avantu te śatamasmāntsahasramūtayaḥ | asmānviśvā abhiṣṭayaḥ ||

translations.english: May your hundred, your thousand, protections preserve us; may all (your) desires (be for our defence).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्माँ इहा वृणीष्व सख्याय स्वस्तये । महो राये दिवित्मते ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmā~ ihā vṛṇīṣva sakhyāya svastaye | maho rāye divitmate ||

translations.english: Select us, Indra, on this occasion, for your friendship, for (our) welfare, for vast and splendid riches.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्माँ अविड्ढि विश्वहेन्द्र राया परीणसा । अस्मान्विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmā~ aviḍḍhi viśvahendra rāyā parīṇasā | asmānviśvābhirūtibhiḥ ||

translations.english: Favour us, Indra, daily with infinite riches (protect) us with all protections.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मभ्यं ताँ अपा वृधि व्रजाँ अस्तेव गोमतः । नवाभिरिन्द्रोतिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmabhyaṃ tā~ apā vṛdhi vrajā~ asteva gomataḥ | navābhirindrotibhiḥ ||

translations.english: With fresh protections, Indra, like a warrior, open for us those pastures filled with cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्माकं धृष्णुया रथो द्युमाँ इन्द्रानपच्युतः । गव्युरश्वयुरीयते ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmākaṃ dhṛṣṇuyā ratho dyumā~ indrānapacyutaḥ | gavyuraśvayurīyate ||

translations.english: May our chariot, Indra, foe-repelling, brilliant unfailing, proceed (everywhere), possessing us of cattle and of horses.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्माकमुत्तमं कृधि श्रवो देवेषु सूर्य । वर्षिष्ठं द्यामिवोपरि ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmākamuttamaṃ kṛdhi śravo deveṣu sūrya | varṣiṣṭhaṃ dyāmivopari ||

translations.english: Sūrya, make our fame exalted among the gods, as (you have plural ced) the sky, the shedder of most copious rain, above (all other regions).

mantras.sanskrit: आ तू न इन्द्र वृत्रहन्नस्माकमर्धमा गहि । महान्महीभिरूतिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tū na indra vṛtrahannasmākamardhamā gahi | mahānmahībhirūtibhiḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, slayer of Vṛtra, come to us quickly; you, who are mighty, (come) with mighty protections.

mantras.sanskrit: भृमिश्चिद्घासि तूतुजिरा चित्र चित्रिणीष्वा । चित्रं कृणोष्यूतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhṛmiścidghāsi tūtujirā citra citriṇīṣvā | citraṃ kṛṇoṣyūtaye ||

translations.english: Wonderful Indra, wanderer at times (through space), you are verily the granter of (our) desires, and do what is marvellous for the protection (of those who are engaged) in wondrous works.

mantras.sanskrit: दभ्रेभिश्चिच्छशीयांसं हंसि व्राधन्तमोजसा । सखिभिर्ये त्वे सचा ॥
mantras.transliteration: dabhrebhiścicchaśīyāṃsaṃ haṃsi vrādhantamojasā | sakhibhirye tve sacā ||

translations.english: You destroy by your might the fierce assailing foe, associated with the humble friends who are along with you.

mantras.sanskrit: वयमिन्द्र त्वे सचा वयं त्वाभि नोनुमः । अस्माँअस्माँ इदुदव ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayamindra tve sacā vayaṃ tvābhi nonumaḥ | asmā~asmā~ idudava ||

translations.english: We, Indra, are along with you; we zealously glorify you; do verily protect us all.

mantras.sanskrit: स नश्चित्राभिरद्रिवोऽनवद्याभिरूतिभिः । अनाधृष्टाभिरा गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa naścitrābhiradrivo'navadyābhirūtibhiḥ | anādhṛṣṭābhirā gahi ||

translations.english: Wielder of the thunderbolt, do you come to us with wondrous, irreproachable, irresistible protections.

mantras.sanskrit: भूयामो षु त्वावतः सखाय इन्द्र गोमतः । युजो वाजाय घृष्वये ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhūyāmo ṣu tvāvataḥ sakhāya indra gomataḥ | yujo vājāya ghṛṣvaye ||

translations.english: May we, Indra, be the friends of one like you, possessed of cattle, allied (to him) for (the sake of) abundant food.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं ह्येक ईशिष इन्द्र वाजस्य गोमतः । स नो यन्धि महीमिषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ hyeka īśiṣa indra vājasya gomataḥ | sa no yandhi mahīmiṣam ||

translations.english: For you alone, Indra, are lord over food combined with cattle; therefore do you grant us ample food.

mantras.sanskrit: न त्वा वरन्ते अन्यथा यद्दित्ससि स्तुतो मघम् । स्तोतृभ्य इन्द्र गिर्वणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: na tvā varante anyathā yadditsasi stuto magham | stotṛbhya indra girvaṇaḥ ||

translations.english: None change your purpose, Indra, object of laudation, when, being praised, you desire to bestow wealth upon the praisers.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि त्वा गोतमा गिरानूषत प्र दावने । इन्द्र वाजाय घृष्वये ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi tvā gotamā girānūṣata pra dāvane | indra vājāya ghṛṣvaye ||

translations.english: The Gotamas glorify you, Indra, with praise, that you may grant wealth, and for the sake of abundant food.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ते वोचाम वीर्या या मन्दसान आरुजः । पुरो दासीरभीत्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra te vocāma vīryā yā mandasāna ārujaḥ | puro dāsīrabhītya ||

translations.english: We proclaim your prowess, whereby exhilarated (by the Soma), and having gone against them, you have demolished the servile cities.

mantras.sanskrit: ता ते गृणन्ति वेधसो यानि चकर्थ पौंस्या । सुतेष्विन्द्र गिर्वणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā te gṛṇanti vedhaso yāni cakartha pauṃsyā | suteṣvindra girvaṇaḥ ||

translations.english: The pious celebrate your manly exploits, Indra, object of laudation, when the juices (of the Soma) are effused.

mantras.sanskrit: अवीवृधन्त गोतमा इन्द्र त्वे स्तोमवाहसः । ऐषु धा वीरवद्यशः ॥
mantras.transliteration: avīvṛdhanta gotamā indra tve stomavāhasaḥ | aiṣu dhā vīravadyaśaḥ ||

translations.english: The Gotamas, offerers of praise, exalt you, Indra; bestow upon them food and prosperity.

mantras.sanskrit: यच्चिद्धि शश्वतामसीन्द्र साधारणस्त्वम् । तं त्वा वयं हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yacciddhi śaśvatāmasīndra sādhāraṇastvam | taṃ tvā vayaṃ havāmahe ||

translations.english: Although, Indra, you are the common property of (all) worshippers, we invoke you (such) as your are (for ourselves).

mantras.sanskrit: अर्वाचीनो वसो भवास्मे सु मत्स्वान्धसः । सोमानामिन्द्र सोमपाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: arvācīno vaso bhavāsme su matsvāndhasaḥ | somānāmindra somapāḥ ||

translations.english: Giver of dwellings, be present with us; drinker of the Soma, be exhilarated by the beverage of the juices.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्माकं त्वा मतीनामा स्तोम इन्द्र यच्छतु । अर्वागा वर्तया हरी ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmākaṃ tvā matīnāmā stoma indra yacchatu | arvāgā vartayā harī ||

translations.english: May the praise (of us) who are devoted (to you), Indra, give you to us; guide your horses towards us.

mantras.sanskrit: पुरोळाशं च नो घसो जोषयासे गिरश्च नः । वधूयुरिव योषणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: puroḷāśaṃ ca no ghaso joṣayāse giraśca naḥ | vadhūyuriva yoṣaṇām ||

translations.english: Eat (Indra) our cakes and butter; be plural ased by our praises as a libertine (by the caresses) of a woman.

mantras.sanskrit: सहस्रं व्यतीनां युक्तानामिन्द्रमीमहे । शतं सोमस्य खार्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sahasraṃ vyatīnāṃ yuktānāmindramīmahe | śataṃ somasya khāryaḥ ||

translations.english: We solicit, Indra for a thousand well-trained, swift-going horses, for a hundred jars of Soma juice.

mantras.sanskrit: सहस्रा ते शता वयं गवामा च्यावयामसि । अस्मत्रा राध एतु ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: sahasrā te śatā vayaṃ gavāmā cyāvayāmasi | asmatrā rādha etu te ||

translations.english: We seek to bring down from you thousands and hundreds of cattle; may riches come to us from you.

mantras.sanskrit: दश ते कलशानां हिरण्यानामधीमहि । भूरिदा असि वृत्रहन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: daśa te kalaśānāṃ hiraṇyānāmadhīmahi | bhūridā asi vṛtrahan ||

translations.english: May we obtain from you, ten golden ewers, for you, slayer of Vṛtra, are a bountiful giver.

mantras.sanskrit: भूरिदा भूरि देहि नो मा दभ्रं भूर्या भर । भूरि घेदिन्द्र दित्ससि ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhūridā bhūri dehi no mā dabhraṃ bhūryā bhara | bhūri ghedindra ditsasi ||

translations.english: A bountiful giver are you, Indra; give bountifully to us; (give) not little; bring much; for verily you desire to give much.

mantras.sanskrit: भूरिदा ह्यसि श्रुतः पुरुत्रा शूर वृत्रहन् । आ नो भजस्व राधसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhūridā hyasi śrutaḥ purutrā śūra vṛtrahan | ā no bhajasva rādhasi ||

translations.english: Verily you are renowned among many as a bountiful giver, hero, slayer of Vṛtra, make us sharers in wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ते बभ्रू विचक्षण शंसामि गोषणो नपात् । माभ्यां गा अनु शिश्रथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra te babhrū vicakṣaṇa śaṃsāmi goṣaṇo napāt | mābhyāṃ gā anu śiśrathaḥ ||

translations.english: Wise Indra, I praise your brown (horses); bestower of kine, (who are) not regardless (of your worshippers); with those two steeds terrify not our cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: कनीनकेव विद्रधे नवे द्रुपदे अर्भके । बभ्रू यामेषु शोभेते ॥
mantras.transliteration: kanīnakeva vidradhe nave drupade arbhake | babhrū yāmeṣu śobhete ||

translations.english: Like two puppets on an arranged, new and slender stage, your two brown (steeds) are brilliant at sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: अरं म उस्रयाम्णेऽरमनुस्रयाम्णे । बभ्रू यामेष्वस्रिधा ॥
mantras.transliteration: araṃ ma usrayāmṇe'ramanusrayāmṇe | babhrū yāmeṣvasridhā ||

translations.english: Your two innocuous brown (steeds) are sufficient at sacrifices for me, whether going (to them) in (a wagon drawn by) oxen, or going without (such) a conveyance.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ऋभुभ्यो दूतमिव वाचमिष्य उपस्तिरे श्वैतरीं धेनुमीळे । ये वातजूतास्तरणिभिरेवैः परि द्यां सद्यो अपसो बभूवुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra ṛbhubhyo dūtamiva vācamiṣya upastire śvaitarīṃ dhenumīḷe | ye vātajūtāstaraṇibhirevaiḥ pari dyāṃ sadyo apaso babhūvuḥ ||

translations.english: I send my prayer as a messenger to the ṛbhus; I solicit (of them) the cow, the yielder of the white milk, for the dilution (of the Soma libation); for they, as swift as the wind, the doers of good works, were borne quickly across the firmament by rapid steeds.

mantras.sanskrit: यदारमक्रन्नृभवः पितृभ्यां परिविष्टी वेषणा दंसनाभिः । आदिद्देवानामुप सख्यमायन्धीरासः पुष्टिमवहन्मनायै ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadāramakrannṛbhavaḥ pitṛbhyāṃ pariviṣṭī veṣaṇā daṃsanābhiḥ | ādiddevānāmupa sakhyamāyandhīrāsaḥ puṣṭimavahanmanāyai ||

translations.english: When the ṛbhus, by honouring their parents with renovated (youth), and by other works, had achieved enough, they thereupon proceeded to the society of the gods, and, considerate, they bring nourishment to the devout (worshipper).

mantras.sanskrit: पुनर्ये चक्रुः पितरा युवाना सना यूपेव जरणा शयाना । ते वाजो विभ्वाँ ऋभुरिन्द्रवन्तो मधुप्सरसो नोऽवन्तु यज्ञम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: punarye cakruḥ pitarā yuvānā sanā yūpeva jaraṇā śayānā | te vājo vibhvā~ ṛbhurindravanto madhupsaraso no'vantu yajñam ||

translations.english: May they who rendered their decrepid and dropsy parents, when, like two dry posts, again perpetually young, Vāja, Vibhavan, and Ṛbhu associated with Indra, drinkers of the Soma juice, protect our sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्संवत्समृभवो गामरक्षन्यत्संवत्समृभवो मा अपिंशन् । यत्संवत्समभरन्भासो अस्यास्ताभिः शमीभिरमृतत्वमाशुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatsaṃvatsamṛbhavo gāmarakṣanyatsaṃvatsamṛbhavo mā apiṃśan | yatsaṃvatsamabharanbhāso asyāstābhiḥ śamībhiramṛtatvamāśuḥ ||

translations.english: Inasmuch as for a year the Ṛbhus preserved the (dead) cow, inasmuch as for a year they invested it with flesh, inasmuch as for a year they continued its beauty they obtained by their acts of immortality.

mantras.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठ आह चमसा द्वा करेति कनीयान्त्रीन्कृणवामेत्याह । कनिष्ठ आह चतुरस्करेति त्वष्ट ऋभवस्तत्पनयद्वचो वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: jyeṣṭha āha camasā dvā kareti kanīyāntrīnkṛṇavāmetyāha | kaniṣṭha āha caturaskareti tvaṣṭa ṛbhavastatpanayadvaco vaḥ ||

translations.english: The eldest said, let us make two ladles; the younger said, let us make three: Tvaṣṭā, Ṛbhus, has applauded your proposal.

mantras.sanskrit: सत्यमूचुर्नर एवा हि चक्रुरनु स्वधामृभवो जग्मुरेताम् । विभ्राजमानाँश्चमसाँ अहेवावेनत्त्वष्टा चतुरो ददृश्वान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: satyamūcurnara evā hi cakruranu svadhāmṛbhavo jagmuretām | vibhrājamānā~ścamasā~ ahevāvenattvaṣṭā caturo dadṛśvān ||

translations.english: The men, (the Ṛbhus), spoke the truth, for such (ladles) they made, and thereupon the Ṛbhus partook of that libation; Tvaṣṭā, beholding the four ladles, brilliant as day, was content.

mantras.sanskrit: द्वादश द्यून्यदगोह्यस्यातिथ्ये रणन्नृभवः ससन्तः । सुक्षेत्राकृण्वन्ननयन्त सिन्धून्धन्वातिष्ठन्नोषधीर्निम्नमापः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dvādaśa dyūnyadagohyasyātithye raṇannṛbhavaḥ sasantaḥ | sukṣetrākṛṇvannanayanta sindhūndhanvātiṣṭhannoṣadhīrnimnamāpaḥ ||

translations.english: When the Ṛbhus, reposing for twelve days, remained in the hospitality of the uncealable (sun) they rendered the fields fertile, they led forth the rivers, plural nts sprung upon the waste, and waters (spread over) the low (plural ces).

mantras.sanskrit: रथं ये चक्रुः सुवृतं नरेष्ठां ये धेनुं विश्वजुवं विश्वरूपाम् । त आ तक्षन्त्वृभवो रयिं नः स्ववसः स्वपसः सुहस्ताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: rathaṃ ye cakruḥ suvṛtaṃ nareṣṭhāṃ ye dhenuṃ viśvajuvaṃ viśvarūpām | ta ā takṣantvṛbhavo rayiṃ naḥ svavasaḥ svapasaḥ suhastāḥ ||

translations.english: May those Ṛbhus who constructed the firm-abiding wheel-conducting car; who formed the all-impelling multiform cow; they who are the bestowers of food, the doers of great deeds, and dexterous of hand, fabricate our riches.

mantras.sanskrit: अपो ह्येषामजुषन्त देवा अभि क्रत्वा मनसा दीध्यानाः । वाजो देवानामभवत्सुकर्मेन्द्रस्य ऋभुक्षा वरुणस्य विभ्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: apo hyeṣāmajuṣanta devā abhi kratvā manasā dīdhyānāḥ | vājo devānāmabhavatsukarmendrasya ṛbhukṣā varuṇasya vibhvā ||

translations.english: The gods were plural ased by their works, illustrious in act and in thought; Vāja was the artificer of the gods, Ṛbhukṣin of Indra, Vibhavan of Varuṇa.

mantras.sanskrit: ये हरी मेधयोक्था मदन्त इन्द्राय चक्रुः सुयुजा ये अश्वा । ते रायस्पोषं द्रविणान्यस्मे धत्त ऋभवः क्षेमयन्तो न मित्रम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye harī medhayokthā madanta indrāya cakruḥ suyujā ye aśvā | te rāyaspoṣaṃ draviṇānyasme dhatta ṛbhavaḥ kṣemayanto na mitram ||

translations.english: May those Ṛbhus who gratified the horses (of Indra) by pious praise, who constructed for Indra his two docile steeds, bestow upon us satiety of riches, and wealth (of cattle), like those who devise prosperity for a friend.

mantras.sanskrit: इदाह्नः पीतिमुत वो मदं धुर्न ऋते श्रान्तस्य सख्याय देवाः । ते नूनमस्मे ऋभवो वसूनि तृतीये अस्मिन्त्सवने दधात ॥
mantras.transliteration: idāhnaḥ pītimuta vo madaṃ dhurna ṛte śrāntasya sakhyāya devāḥ | te nūnamasme ṛbhavo vasūni tṛtīye asmintsavane dadhāta ||

translations.english: The gods verily have given you the beverage at the (third sacrifice of the) day, and its exhilarqation, not through regard, but (as the gift of one) wearied out (by penance); Ṛbhus, who are so (eminent), grant us, verily, wealth at this third (diurnal) sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋभुर्विभ्वा वाज इन्द्रो नो अच्छेमं यज्ञं रत्नधेयोप यात । इदा हि वो धिषणा देव्यह्नामधात्पीतिं सं मदा अग्मता वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛbhurvibhvā vāja indro no acchemaṃ yajñaṃ ratnadheyopa yāta | idā hi vo dhiṣaṇā devyahnāmadhātpītiṃ saṃ madā agmatā vaḥ ||

translations.english: Ṛbhu, Vibhvan, Vāja and Indra, do you come to this our sacrifice, to distribute the precious things, for the divine work has indeed now desired the drinking (of the Soma) on the (appointed hours of the) days; therefore the exhilarating draughts are collected for you.

mantras.sanskrit: विदानासो जन्मनो वाजरत्ना उत ऋतुभिॠभवो मादयध्वम् । सं वो मदा अग्मत सं पुरंधिः सुवीरामस्मे रयिमेरयध्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vidānāso janmano vājaratnā uta ṛtubhiṝbhavo mādayadhvam | saṃ vo madā agmata saṃ puraṃdhiḥ suvīrāmasme rayimerayadhvam ||

translations.english: Resplendent with (sacrificial) food, prescient of your (celestial) birth, be exhilarated, Ṛbhus along with the Ṛtus; the inebriating draughts are collected for you as well as pious praise; do you confer upon us riches with excellent posterity.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं वो यज्ञ ऋभवोऽकारि यमा मनुष्वत्प्रदिवो दधिध्वे । प्र वोऽच्छा जुजुषाणासो अस्थुरभूत विश्वे अग्रियोत वाजाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ vo yajña ṛbhavo'kāri yamā manuṣvatpradivo dadhidhve | pra vo'cchā jujuṣāṇāso asthurabhūta viśve agriyota vājāḥ ||

translations.english: This sacrifice, Ṛbhus, has been instrumental tuted for you, who are eminently resplendent, which you have accepted after the manner of men; before you have the propitiatory (libations) been plural ced, for Vājas, you are all entitled to precedence.

mantras.sanskrit: अभूदु वो विधते रत्नधेयमिदा नरो दाशुषे मर्त्याय । पिबत वाजा ऋभवो ददे वो महि तृतीयं सवनं मदाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhūdu vo vidhate ratnadheyamidā naro dāśuṣe martyāya | pibata vājā ṛbhavo dade vo mahi tṛtīyaṃ savanaṃ madāya ||

translations.english: Now, leaders (of rites), the treasure that ought to be presented is to be given to the mortqal performing (the sacred rite), the offerer (of the libation); drink, Vājas (drink), Ṛbhus; I present it to you at the third solemn (diurnal) ceremony for your exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वाजा यातोप न ऋभुक्षा महो नरो द्रविणसो गृणानाः । आ वः पीतयोऽभिपित्वे अह्नामिमा अस्तं नवस्व इव ग्मन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vājā yātopa na ṛbhukṣā maho naro draviṇaso gṛṇānāḥ | ā vaḥ pītayo'bhipitve ahnāmimā astaṃ navasva iva gman ||

translations.english: Vājas, Ṛbhukṣans, leaders (of rites), come to us eulogizing exceeding wealth; these draughts (of Soma) proceed to you at the decline of day, like newly-delivered cows to their stalls.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नपातः शवसो यातनोपेमं यज्ञं नमसा हूयमानाः । सजोषसः सूरयो यस्य च स्थ मध्वः पात रत्नधा इन्द्रवन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā napātaḥ śavaso yātanopemaṃ yajñaṃ namasā hūyamānāḥ | sajoṣasaḥ sūrayo yasya ca stha madhvaḥ pāta ratnadhā indravantaḥ ||

translations.english: Sons of strength, come to this sacrifice, invoked with veneration; givers of precious things, associated with Indra, with whom you are intelligent, participate in being gratified (by the libation), drink ofthe sweet Soma juice.

mantras.sanskrit: सजोषा इन्द्र वरुणेन सोमं सजोषाः पाहि गिर्वणो मरुद्भिः । अग्रेपाभिॠतुपाभिः सजोषा ग्नास्पत्नीभी रत्नधाभिः सजोषाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sajoṣā indra varuṇena somaṃ sajoṣāḥ pāhi girvaṇo marudbhiḥ | agrepābhiṝtupābhiḥ sajoṣā gnāspatnībhī ratnadhābhiḥ sajoṣāḥ ||

translations.english: Sympathizing in satisfaction with Varuṇa, drink, Indra, the Soma juice; drink it, you who are entitled to praise, sympathizing with the Maruts; drink, sympathizing with the first drinkers, with the drinkers (at the sacriices) of the Ṛtus; sympathizing with the protectresses of the wives (of the gods), the giver of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: सजोषस आदित्यैर्मादयध्वं सजोषस ऋभवः पर्वतेभिः । सजोषसो दैव्येना सवित्रा सजोषसः सिन्धुभी रत्नधेभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sajoṣasa ādityairmādayadhvaṃ sajoṣasa ṛbhavaḥ parvatebhiḥ | sajoṣaso daivyenā savitrā sajoṣasaḥ sindhubhī ratnadhebhiḥ ||

translations.english: Ṛbhus, be exhilarated, sympathizing with the Ādityas, sympathizing with the Parvatas, sympathizing with the divine Savitā, sympathizing with the wealth-bestowing (deities of the) rivers.

mantras.sanskrit: ये अश्विना ये पितरा य ऊती धेनुं ततक्षुॠभवो ये अश्वा । ये अंसत्रा य ऋधग्रोदसी ये विभ्वो नरः स्वपत्यानि चक्रुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye aśvinā ye pitarā ya ūtī dhenuṃ tatakṣuṝbhavo ye aśvā | ye aṃsatrā ya ṛdhagrodasī ye vibhvo naraḥ svapatyāni cakruḥ ||

translations.english: Ṛbhus, who by your assistance (gratiied) the Aśvins, who (renovated your) parents, who (restored) the cow, who fabricated the horses, who made armour (for the gods), who separated earth and heaven, and who, the all-pervading leaders (of rites), accomplished (acts productive of) good results.

mantras.sanskrit: ये गोमन्तं वाजवन्तं सुवीरं रयिं धत्थ वसुमन्तं पुरुक्षुम् । ते अग्रेपा ऋभवो मन्दसाना अस्मे धत्त ये च रातिं गृणन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye gomantaṃ vājavantaṃ suvīraṃ rayiṃ dhattha vasumantaṃ purukṣum | te agrepā ṛbhavo mandasānā asme dhatta ye ca rātiṃ gṛṇanti ||

translations.english: Ṛbhus, who posses wealth, comprising cattle, food, progeny, dwellings, and abundant sustenance, do you, who are the first drinkers (of the Soma), bestow upon us, when exhilarated, (that wealth and upon those) who laud your liberality.

mantras.sanskrit: नापाभूत न वोऽतीतृषामानिःशस्ता ऋभवो यज्ञे अस्मिन् । समिन्द्रेण मदथ सं मरुद्भिः सं राजभी रत्नधेयाय देवाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nāpābhūta na vo'tītṛṣāmāniḥśastā ṛbhavo yajñe asmin | samindreṇa madatha saṃ marudbhiḥ saṃ rājabhī ratnadheyāya devāḥ ||

translations.english: Ṛbhus, go not away; let us not leave you (thirsting); (be present) unreproached at this sacrifice; be exhilarated, deities, along with Indra, with the Maruts, and with (other) brilliant (divinities), for the distribution of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: इहोप यात शवसो नपातः सौधन्वना ऋभवो माप भूत । अस्मिन्हि वः सवने रत्नधेयं गमन्त्विन्द्रमनु वो मदासः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ihopa yāta śavaso napātaḥ saudhanvanā ṛbhavo māpa bhūta | asminhi vaḥ savane ratnadheyaṃ gamantvindramanu vo madāsaḥ ||

translations.english: Come hither, sons of strength, sons of Sudhanvan; Ṛbhus, keep not away; may the exhilarating juices proceed to you at this sacrifice, after the munificent Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: आगन्नृभूणामिह रत्नधेयमभूत्सोमस्य सुषुतस्य पीतिः । सुकृत्यया यत्स्वपस्यया चँ एकं विचक्र चमसं चतुर्धा ॥
mantras.transliteration: āgannṛbhūṇāmiha ratnadheyamabhūtsomasya suṣutasya pītiḥ | sukṛtyayā yatsvapasyayā ca~ ekaṃ vicakra camasaṃ caturdhā ||

translations.english: The munificene of the Ṛbhus come to me on this occasion, (since) there has been the drinking of the effused Soma, in consequence of one ladle having been made fourfold by their dexterous and excellent work.

mantras.sanskrit: व्यकृणोत चमसं चतुर्धा सखे वि शिक्षेत्यब्रवीत । अथैत वाजा अमृतस्य पन्थां गणं देवानामृभवः सुहस्ताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vyakṛṇota camasaṃ caturdhā sakhe vi śikṣetyabravīta | athaita vājā amṛtasya panthāṃ gaṇaṃ devānāmṛbhavaḥ suhastāḥ ||

translations.english: You have made the ladle fourfold, and have said (to Agni), assent (to the division); therefore have you gone, Vājas, the path of the immortals; dexterous-handed Ṛbhus (you have joined) the company of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: किम्मयः स्विच्चमस एष आस यं काव्येन चतुरो विचक्र । अथा सुनुध्वं सवनं मदाय पात ऋभवो मधुनः सोम्यस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: kimmayaḥ sviccamasa eṣa āsa yaṃ kāvyena caturo vicakra | athā sunudhvaṃ savanaṃ madāya pāta ṛbhavo madhunaḥ somyasya ||

translations.english: What sort of ladle was that which by skill you have made four? now pour forth the Soma for their exhilaration; drink, Ṛbhus, of the sweet Soma libation.

mantras.sanskrit: शच्याकर्त पितरा युवाना शच्याकर्त चमसं देवपानम् । शच्या हरी धनुतरावतष्टेन्द्रवाहावृभवो वाजरत्नाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śacyākarta pitarā yuvānā śacyākarta camasaṃ devapānam | śacyā harī dhanutarāvataṣṭendravāhāvṛbhavo vājaratnāḥ ||

translations.english: By your (marvellous) deeds you have made your parents youg; by your deeds you have made the ladle (fit) for the drinking of the gods; by your deeds you have made the two horses, the bearers of Indra, swifter than (an arrow from) a bow, Ṛbhus, who are rich in (sacrificial) food.

mantras.sanskrit: यो वः सुनोत्यभिपित्वे अह्नां तीव्रं वाजासः सवनं मदाय । तस्मै रयिमृभवः सर्ववीरमा तक्षत वृषणो मन्दसानाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo vaḥ sunotyabhipitve ahnāṃ tīvraṃ vājāsaḥ savanaṃ madāya | tasmai rayimṛbhavaḥ sarvavīramā takṣata vṛṣaṇo mandasānāḥ ||

translations.english: Distributors of food, Ṛbhus, showerers (of benefits), exhilarated (by the Soma draught), fabricated wealth, comprising all posterity for him who pours out for your exhilaration, the acrid libation at the deline of day.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रातः सुतमपिबो हर्यश्व माध्यंदिनं सवनं केवलं ते । समृभुभिः पिबस्व रत्नधेभिः सखीँर्याँ इन्द्र चकृषे सुकृत्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: prātaḥ sutamapibo haryaśva mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ kevalaṃ te | samṛbhubhiḥ pibasva ratnadhebhiḥ sakhī~ryā~ indra cakṛṣe sukṛtyā ||

translations.english: Drink, lord of horses, Indra, the libation offered at dawn; the noon-day libation is alone for you; but (in the evening) drink with the munificent Ṛbhus, whom, Indra, you have made your friends by good deeds.

mantras.sanskrit: ये देवासो अभवता सुकृत्या श्येना इवेदधि दिवि निषेद । ते रत्नं धात शवसो नपातः सौधन्वना अभवतामृतासः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye devāso abhavatā sukṛtyā śyenā ivedadhi divi niṣeda | te ratnaṃ dhāta śavaso napātaḥ saudhanvanā abhavatāmṛtāsaḥ ||

translations.english: Do you, sons of strength, who have become gods by (your) good deeds, soaring aloft in the sky like falcons, bestow upon us riches; sons of Sudhanvan, you have become immortals.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्तृतीयं सवनं रत्नधेयमकृणुध्वं स्वपस्या सुहस्ताः । तदृभवः परिषिक्तं व एतत्सं मदेभिरिन्द्रियेभिः पिबध्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yattṛtīyaṃ savanaṃ ratnadheyamakṛṇudhvaṃ svapasyā suhastāḥ | tadṛbhavaḥ pariṣiktaṃ va etatsaṃ madebhirindriyebhiḥ pibadhvam ||

translations.english: Dexterous-handed, since you have instrumental tuted, through desire of good works, the third sacrifice, which is the bestower of wealth, therefore, Ṛbhus, drink this effused Soma with exhilarated senseṣ

mantras.sanskrit: अनश्वो जातो अनभीशुरुक्थ्यो रथस्त्रिचक्रः परि वर्तते रजः । महत्तद्वो देव्यस्य प्रवाचनं द्यामृभवः पृथिवीं यच्च पुष्यथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: anaśvo jāto anabhīśurukthyo rathastricakraḥ pari vartate rajaḥ | mahattadvo devyasya pravācanaṃ dyāmṛbhavaḥ pṛthivīṃ yacca puṣyatha ||

translations.english: The glorious three-wheeled car (of the Aśvins made, Ṛbhus by you) traverses the firmament without horses, without reins; great was that proclamation of your divine (power), by which, Ṛbhus, you cherish heaven and earth.

mantras.sanskrit: रथं ये चक्रुः सुवृतं सुचेतसोऽविह्वरन्तं मनसस्परि ध्यया । ताँ ऊ न्वस्य सवनस्य पीतय आ वो वाजा ऋभवो वेदयामसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: rathaṃ ye cakruḥ suvṛtaṃ sucetaso'vihvarantaṃ manasaspari dhyayā | tā~ ū nvasya savanasya pītaya ā vo vājā ṛbhavo vedayāmasi ||

translations.english: We invoke you respectfully, Vājas and Ṛbhus, to drink of this libation, for you are the wise sages, who, by mental meditation, made the well-constructed undeviating car (of the Aśvins).

mantras.sanskrit: तद्वो वाजा ऋभवः सुप्रवाचनं देवेषु विभ्वो अभवन्महित्वनम् । जिव्री यत्सन्ता पितरा सनाजुरा पुनर्युवाना चरथाय तक्षथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadvo vājā ṛbhavaḥ supravācanaṃ deveṣu vibhvo abhavanmahitvanam | jivrī yatsantā pitarā sanājurā punaryuvānā carathāya takṣatha ||

translations.english: Therefore, Vāja, Ṛbhu, Vibhvan, was your greatness proclaimed among the gods, that you made your aged and inform parents young (and able) to go (withere they would).

mantras.sanskrit: एकं वि चक्र चमसं चतुर्वयं निश्चर्मणो गामरिणीत धीतिभिः । अथा देवेष्वमृतत्वमानश श्रुष्टी वाजा ऋभवस्तद्व उक्थ्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ekaṃ vi cakra camasaṃ caturvayaṃ niścarmaṇo gāmariṇīta dhītibhiḥ | athā deveṣvamṛtatvamānaśa śruṣṭī vājā ṛbhavastadva ukthyam ||

translations.english: You have made the single ladle fourfold; by your (marvellous) acts you have clothed the cow with a (new) hide; therefore you have obtained immortality among the gods; such acts, Vājas and Ṛbhus, are to be eagerly glorified.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋभुतो रयिः प्रथमश्रवस्तमो वाजश्रुतासो यमजीजनन्नरः । विभ्वतष्टो विदथेषु प्रवाच्यो यं देवासोऽवथा स विचर्षणिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛbhuto rayiḥ prathamaśravastamo vājaśrutāso yamajījanannaraḥ | vibhvataṣṭo vidatheṣu pravācyo yaṃ devāso'vathā sa vicarṣaṇiḥ ||

translations.english: From the Ṛbhus may wealth, the best and most productive of food, (come to me); that which the leaders of rites renowned together with the Vājas, have engendered; that which has been fabricated by Vibhvan and is to be celebrated at sacrifice; that which, deities you protect, that is to be beheld.

mantras.sanskrit: स वाज्यर्वा स ऋषिर्वचस्यया स शूरो अस्ता पृतनासु दुष्टरः । स रायस्पोषं स सुवीर्यं दधे यं वाजो विभ्वाँ ऋभवो यमाविषुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa vājyarvā sa ṛṣirvacasyayā sa śūro astā pṛtanāsu duṣṭaraḥ | sa rāyaspoṣaṃ sa suvīryaṃ dadhe yaṃ vājo vibhvā~ ṛbhavo yamāviṣuḥ ||

translations.english: He is vigorous and skilled in war, he is a ṛṣi worthy of homage, he is a hero, the discomfiter of foes, invincible in battles, he is possessed of ample wealth, and (is blessed) with excellent posterity, whom Vāja and Vibhvan, whom the Ṛbhus protect.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रेष्ठं वः पेशो अधि धायि दर्शतं स्तोमो वाजा ऋभवस्तं जुजुष्टन । धीरासो हि ष्ठा कवयो विपश्चितस्तान्व एना ब्रह्मणा वेदयामसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: śreṣṭhaṃ vaḥ peśo adhi dhāyi darśataṃ stomo vājā ṛbhavastaṃ jujuṣṭana | dhīrāso hi ṣṭhā kavayo vipaścitastānva enā brahmaṇā vedayāmasi ||

translations.english: An excellent and agreeable form has been assumed by you; (this is our own) praise; Vājas and Ṛbhus be gratified (thereby), for you are wise, experienced, and intelligent; such we make you known (to be) by this (our) prayer.

mantras.sanskrit: यूयमस्मभ्यं धिषणाभ्यस्परि विद्वांसो विश्वा नर्याणि भोजना । द्युमन्तं वाजं वृषशुष्ममुत्तममा नो रयिमृभवस्तक्षता वयः ॥
