mantras.transliteration: yūyamasmabhyaṃ dhiṣaṇābhyaspari vidvāṃso viśvā naryāṇi bhojanā | dyumantaṃ vājaṃ vṛṣaśuṣmamuttamamā no rayimṛbhavastakṣatā vayaḥ ||

translations.english: Do you who are wise, (bestow) upon us, in requital of our praises, all enjoyments that are good for man and fabricate for us, Ṛbhus, riches and food, resplendent invigorating, overpowering (foes), and most excellent.

mantras.sanskrit: इह प्रजामिह रयिं रराणा इह श्रवो वीरवत्तक्षता नः । येन वयं चितयेमात्यन्यान्तं वाजं चित्रमृभवो ददा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: iha prajāmiha rayiṃ rarāṇā iha śravo vīravattakṣatā naḥ | yena vayaṃ citayemātyanyāntaṃ vājaṃ citramṛbhavo dadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Gratified (by your worship), fabricate for us, on this occasion, progeny and wealth, and reputation, with numerous adherents; grant to us, Ṛbhus, abundant sustenance wherewith we may greatly excel others.

mantras.sanskrit: उप नो वाजा अध्वरमृभुक्षा देवा यात पथिभिर्देवयानैः । यथा यज्ञं मनुषो विक्ष्वासु दधिध्वे रण्वाः सुदिनेष्वह्नाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa no vājā adhvaramṛbhukṣā devā yāta pathibhirdevayānaiḥ | yathā yajñaṃ manuṣo vikṣvāsu dadhidhve raṇvāḥ sudineṣvahnām ||

translations.english: Divine Vājas, Ṛbhus, come to our sacrifice by the path travelled by the gods, inasmuch as you, gracious (Ṛbhus), have maintained sacrifice among the people, (the progeny) of Manu, for (the sake of) securing the prosperous course of days.

mantras.sanskrit: ते वो हृदे मनसे सन्तु यज्ञा जुष्टासो अद्य घृतनिर्णिजो गुः । प्र वः सुतासो हरयन्त पूर्णाः क्रत्वे दक्षाय हर्षयन्त पीताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te vo hṛde manase santu yajñā juṣṭāso adya ghṛtanirṇijo guḥ | pra vaḥ sutāso harayanta pūrṇāḥ kratve dakṣāya harṣayanta pītāḥ ||

translations.english: May these sacrifices be (acceptable) to you in heart and mind; may today the sufficient (juices) mixed with butter to you; the full libations are prepared for you; may they, when drunk, animate you for glorious deeds.

mantras.sanskrit: त्र्युदायं देवहितं यथा वः स्तोमो वाजा ऋभुक्षणो ददे वः । जुह्वे मनुष्वदुपरासु विक्षु युष्मे सचा बृहद्दिवेषु सोमम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tryudāyaṃ devahitaṃ yathā vaḥ stomo vājā ṛbhukṣaṇo dade vaḥ | juhve manuṣvaduparāsu vikṣu yuṣme sacā bṛhaddiveṣu somam ||

translations.english: As the offering suited to the gods at the third (daily) sacrifice supports, you, Vājas, Ṛbhukṣans; as the praise (then recited supports you); therefore, like Manu, I offer you the Soma juice, along with the very radiant (deities) among the people assembled at the solemnity.

mantras.sanskrit: पीवोअश्वाः शुचद्रथा हि भूतायःशिप्रा वाजिनः सुनिष्काः । इन्द्रस्य सूनो शवसो नपातोऽनु वश्चेत्यग्रियं मदाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: pīvoaśvāḥ śucadrathā hi bhūtāyaḥśiprā vājinaḥ suniṣkāḥ | indrasya sūno śavaso napāto'nu vaścetyagriyaṃ madāya ||

translations.english: Vājins, you are borne by stout horses mounted on a brilliant car, have jaws of metal and are possessed of treasures; sons of Indra, grandsons of strength, this last sacrifice is for your exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋभुमृभुक्षणो रयिं वाजे वाजिन्तमं युजम् । इन्द्रस्वन्तं हवामहे सदासातममश्विनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛbhumṛbhukṣaṇo rayiṃ vāje vājintamaṃ yujam | indrasvantaṃ havāmahe sadāsātamamaśvinam ||

translations.english: We invoke you, Ṛbhukṣans, for splendid wealth, mutually co-operating, most invigorating in war, affecting the senses, ever munificent, and comprehending horses.

mantras.sanskrit: सेदृभवो यमवथ यूयमिन्द्रश्च मर्त्यम् । स धीभिरस्तु सनिता मेधसाता सो अर्वता ॥
mantras.transliteration: sedṛbhavo yamavatha yūyamindraśca martyam | sa dhībhirastu sanitā medhasātā so arvatā ||

translations.english: May the man whom you, Ṛbhus and Indra, favour, be ever liberal by his acts, and possessed of a horse at the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: वि नो वाजा ऋभुक्षणः पथश्चितन यष्टवे । अस्मभ्यं सूरयः स्तुता विश्वा आशास्तरीषणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi no vājā ṛbhukṣaṇaḥ pathaścitana yaṣṭave | asmabhyaṃ sūrayaḥ stutā viśvā āśāstarīṣaṇi ||

translations.english: Vājas, Ṛbhukṣaṇs, direct us in the way to sacrifice; for you, who are intelligent, being glorified (by us), are able to traverse all the quarters (of space).

mantras.sanskrit: तं नो वाजा ऋभुक्षण इन्द्र नासत्या रयिम् । समश्वं चर्षणिभ्य आ पुरु शस्त मघत्तये ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ no vājā ṛbhukṣaṇa indra nāsatyā rayim | samaśvaṃ carṣaṇibhya ā puru śasta maghattaye ||

translations.english: Vājas, Ṛbhukṣaṇs, Indra, Nāsatyas, command that ample wealth with horses be sent to men for their enrichment.

mantras.sanskrit: उतो हि वां दात्रा सन्ति पूर्वा या पूरुभ्यस्त्रसदस्युर्नितोशे । क्षेत्रासां ददथुरुर्वरासां घनं दस्युभ्यो अभिभूतिमुग्रम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uto hi vāṃ dātrā santi pūrvā yā pūrubhyastrasadasyurnitośe | kṣetrāsāṃ dadathururvarāsāṃ ghanaṃ dasyubhyo abhibhūtimugram ||

translations.english: Trasadasyu has bestowed upon many the ancient (gifts) which were obtained by the liberal (prince) through your (favour, Heaven and Earth) you two have given a horse, a son, a weapon (for the destruction) of the Dasyus, fierce and foe-subduing.

mantras.sanskrit: उत वाजिनं पुरुनिष्षिध्वानं दधिक्रामु ददथुर्विश्वकृष्टिम् । ऋजिप्यं श्येनं प्रुषितप्सुमाशुं चर्कृत्यमर्यो नृपतिं न शूरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta vājinaṃ puruniṣṣidhvānaṃ dadhikrāmu dadathurviśvakṛṣṭim | ṛjipyaṃ śyenaṃ pruṣitapsumāśuṃ carkṛtyamaryo nṛpatiṃ na śūram ||

translations.english: And you two have given the swift Dadhikrā, the repeller of many (foes), the defender of all men, the straight-going, the graceful-moving, the resplendent, the rapid, the destroyer of enemies like a heroic prince.

mantras.sanskrit: यं सीमनु प्रवतेव द्रवन्तं विश्वः पूरुर्मदति हर्षमाणः । पड्भिर्गृध्यन्तं मेधयुं न शूरं रथतुरं वातमिव ध्रजन्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ sīmanu pravateva dravantaṃ viśvaḥ pūrurmadati harṣamāṇaḥ | paḍbhirgṛdhyantaṃ medhayuṃ na śūraṃ rathaturaṃ vātamiva dhrajantam ||

translations.english: Whom all men, rejoicing, praise, rushing everywhere, as if down a precipice, springing with his feet like a hero eager for war, drawing a car, and going as swift as the wind.

mantras.sanskrit: यः स्मारुन्धानो गध्या समत्सु सनुतरश्चरति गोषु गच्छन् । आविॠजीको विदथा निचिक्यत्तिरो अरतिं पर्याप आयोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ smārundhāno gadhyā samatsu sanutaraścarati goṣu gacchan | āviṝjīko vidathā nicikyattiro aratiṃ paryāpa āyoḥ ||

translations.english: Who, opposing the mingled multitude in battles, rushes eager, passing through the regions, whose vigour is manifestl, who, understanding what is to be known, puts to shame the adversary of the (pious) man.

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्मैनं वस्त्रमथिं न तायुमनु क्रोशन्ति क्षितयो भरेषु । नीचायमानं जसुरिं न श्येनं श्रवश्चाच्छा पशुमच्च यूथम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta smainaṃ vastramathiṃ na tāyumanu krośanti kṣitayo bhareṣu | nīcāyamānaṃ jasuriṃ na śyenaṃ śravaścācchā paśumacca yūtham ||

translations.english: Whom men call after in battles, as after a thief carrying off a garment, or as (after) a hungry hawk pouncing (upon his prey); they call after him, hastening to obtain food, or a herd of cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्मासु प्रथमः सरिष्यन्नि वेवेति श्रेणिभी रथानाम् । स्रजं कृण्वानो जन्यो न शुभ्वा रेणुं रेरिहत्किरणं ददश्वान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta smāsu prathamaḥ sariṣyanni veveti śreṇibhī rathānām | srajaṃ kṛṇvāno janyo na śubhvā reṇuṃ rerihatkiraṇaṃ dadaśvān ||

translations.english: And who, issuing forth the first in those encounters, rushes in various directions with rows of chariots; like an elegant (courser), friendly to man, decorated with a garland, raising the dust, and champing his bit.

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्य वाजी सहुरिॠतावा शुश्रूषमाणस्तन्वा समर्ये । तुरं यतीषु तुरयन्नृजिप्योऽधि भ्रुवोः किरते रेणुमृञ्जन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta sya vājī sahuriṝtāvā śuśrūṣamāṇastanvā samarye | turaṃ yatīṣu turayannṛjipyo'dhi bhruvoḥ kirate reṇumṛñjan ||

translations.english: And that swift (horse) enduring in battle, bestowing food, and doing service with his limbs, rushing swiftly upon the quick-moving (host of the enemy), going straight onward, and tossing up the dust, throws it above his brows.

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्मास्य तन्यतोरिव द्योॠघायतो अभियुजो भयन्ते । यदा सहस्रमभि षीमयोधीद्दुर्वर्तुः स्मा भवति भीम ऋञ्जन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta smāsya tanyatoriva dyoṝghāyato abhiyujo bhayante | yadā sahasramabhi ṣīmayodhīddurvartuḥ smā bhavati bhīma ṛñjan ||

translations.english: And the adversaries of that foe-destroying steed, like (those) of the brilliant thunderbolt, are alarmed; for when he contends, even against thousands on every side, then, rousing (his spirit), he is fearful and irresistible.

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्मास्य पनयन्ति जना जूतिं कृष्टिप्रो अभिभूतिमाशोः । उतैनमाहुः समिथे वियन्तः परा दधिक्रा असरत्सहस्रैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta smāsya panayanti janā jūtiṃ kṛṣṭipro abhibhūtimāśoḥ | utainamāhuḥ samithe viyantaḥ parā dadhikrā asaratsahasraiḥ ||

translations.english: Men praise the overpowering rapidty of that fleet (steed), who is the accomplisher (of the desires) of mankind, and following him to battle, they have said, Dadhikrā with (his) thousands has gone forth against the foe.

mantras.sanskrit: आ दधिक्राः शवसा पञ्च कृष्टीः सूर्य इव ज्योतिषापस्ततान । सहस्रसाः शतसा वाज्यर्वा पृणक्तु मध्वा समिमा वचांसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā dadhikrāḥ śavasā pañca kṛṣṭīḥ sūrya iva jyotiṣāpastatāna | sahasrasāḥ śatasā vājyarvā pṛṇaktu madhvā samimā vacāṃsi ||

translations.english: Dadhikrā has spread abroad the five classes of beings by his strength, as the sun (diffuses) the waters by his radiance; may he, the giver of hundreds and thousands, associate these praises with agreeable (rewards).

mantras.sanskrit: आशुं दधिक्रां तमु नु ष्टवाम दिवस्पृथिव्या उत चर्किराम । उच्छन्तीर्मामुषसः सूदयन्त्वति विश्वानि दुरितानि पर्षन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: āśuṃ dadhikrāṃ tamu nu ṣṭavāma divaspṛthivyā uta carkirāma | ucchantīrmāmuṣasaḥ sūdayantvati viśvāni duritāni parṣan ||

translations.english: Verily we praise that swift Dadhikrā and scatter (proved before him) from heaven and earth; may the gloom-dispelling dawns preserve for me (all good things), and bear me beyond all evils.

mantras.sanskrit: महश्चर्कर्म्यर्वतः क्रतुप्रा दधिक्राव्णः पुरुवारस्य वृष्णः । यं पूरुभ्यो दीदिवांसं नाग्निं ददथुर्मित्रावरुणा ततुरिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahaścarkarmyarvataḥ kratuprā dadhikrāvṇaḥ puruvārasya vṛṣṇaḥ | yaṃ pūrubhyo dīdivāṃsaṃ nāgniṃ dadathurmitrāvaruṇā taturim ||

translations.english: Fulfiller of religious rites, I reiterate the praise of the great Dadhikrā, the liberal, many-honoured showerer (of benefits), whom Mitra and Varuṇa gave for the good of many, the transporter (beyond calamity), as brilliant as Agni.

mantras.sanskrit: यो अश्वस्य दधिक्राव्णो अकारीत्समिद्धे अग्ना उषसो व्युष्टौ । अनागसं तमदितिः कृणोतु स मित्रेण वरुणेना सजोषाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo aśvasya dadhikrāvṇo akārītsamiddhe agnā uṣaso vyuṣṭau | anāgasaṃ tamaditiḥ kṛṇotu sa mitreṇa varuṇenā sajoṣāḥ ||

translations.english: May Aditi, consentient with Mitra and Varuṇa render him free from sin who has performed the worship of the steed Dadhikrā, when the fire has been kindled at the opening of the dawn.

mantras.sanskrit: दधिक्राव्ण इष ऊर्जो महो यदमन्महि मरुतां नाम भद्रम् । स्वस्तये वरुणं मित्रमग्निं हवामह इन्द्रं वज्रबाहुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dadhikrāvṇa iṣa ūrjo maho yadamanmahi marutāṃ nāma bhadram | svastaye varuṇaṃ mitramagniṃ havāmaha indraṃ vajrabāhum ||

translations.english: While we glorify the name of the great Dadhikrā the means of sustenance and of strength, the prosperity of those who praise (him), let us invoke (also) for our welfare Varuṇa, Mitra, Agni, and Indra, the bearer of the thunderbolt.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रमिवेदुभये वि ह्वयन्त उदीराणा यज्ञमुपप्रयन्तः । दधिक्रामु सूदनं मर्त्याय ददथुर्मित्रावरुणा नो अश्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indramivedubhaye vi hvayanta udīrāṇā yajñamupaprayantaḥ | dadhikrāmu sūdanaṃ martyāya dadathurmitrāvaruṇā no aśvam ||

translations.english: Those who are preparing for battle, those who are proceeding to sacrifice, both invoke (Dadhikra) as if (he was) Indra; Mitra and Varuṇa have given to us the horse Dadhikrā as an encourager to man.

mantras.sanskrit: दधिक्राव्णो अकारिषं जिष्णोरश्वस्य वाजिनः । सुरभि नो मुखा करत्प्र ण आयूंषि तारिषत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣaṃ jiṣṇoraśvasya vājinaḥ | surabhi no mukhā karatpra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣat ||

translations.english: I have celebrated the praise of Dadhikrā, the rapid and victorious stee; may he make our mouths fragrant, may he prolong our lives.

mantras.sanskrit: दधिक्राव्ण इदु नु चर्किराम विश्वा इन्मामुषसः सूदयन्तु । अपामग्नेरुषसः सूर्यस्य बृहस्पतेराङ्गिरसस्य जिष्णोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dadhikrāvṇa idu nu carkirāma viśvā inmāmuṣasaḥ sūdayantu | apāmagneruṣasaḥ sūryasya bṛhaspaterāṅgirasasya jiṣṇoḥ ||

translations.english: May we repeatedly recite (the praise) of Dadhikrāvaṇ; may all rising dawns excite me (to the adoration) of the waters, of Agni, of Uṣas, of Sūrya, of Bṛhaspati, and of Jiṣṇu, the son of Aṅgiras.

mantras.sanskrit: सत्वा भरिषो गविषो दुवन्यसच्छ्रवस्यादिष उषसस्तुरण्यसत् । सत्यो द्रवो द्रवरः पतंगरो दधिक्रावेषमूर्जं स्वर्जनत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: satvā bhariṣo gaviṣo duvanyasacchravasyādiṣa uṣasasturaṇyasat | satyo dravo dravaraḥ pataṃgaro dadhikrāveṣamūrjaṃ svarjanat ||

translations.english: May Dadhikrāvaṇ, the active, the cherisher, the giver of cattle, who abides with the devout, the swift-going, be willing to accept (the sacrificial) food at the time of the desirable dawn; may he who is true, moving, rapid, and leaping like a grasshopper, produce (for us) food, strength and heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्मास्य द्रवतस्तुरण्यतः पर्णं न वेरनु वाति प्रगर्धिनः । श्येनस्येव ध्रजतो अङ्कसं परि दधिक्राव्णः सहोर्जा तरित्रतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta smāsya dravatasturaṇyataḥ parṇaṃ na veranu vāti pragardhinaḥ | śyenasyeva dhrajato aṅkasaṃ pari dadhikrāvṇaḥ sahorjā taritrataḥ ||

translations.english: And after him who is quick-going, hastening, eager (to arrive at his goald, men) follow (as other birds pursue) the flight of a swift (bird) striving together to keep up by the side of Dadhikrāvan. the transporter (of others) as swift as a hawk.

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्य वाजी क्षिपणिं तुरण्यति ग्रीवायां बद्धो अपिकक्ष आसनि । क्रतुं दधिक्रा अनु संतवीत्वत्पथामङ्कांस्यन्वापनीफणत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta sya vājī kṣipaṇiṃ turaṇyati grīvāyāṃ baddho apikakṣa āsani | kratuṃ dadhikrā anu saṃtavītvatpathāmaṅkāṃsyanvāpanīphaṇat ||

translations.english: And that horse bound by his neck, his flanks, his mouth, accelerates his paces; Dadhikrā increasing in vigour after the (sacred rite), following the windings of the roads, goes still more rapidly.

mantras.sanskrit: हंसः शुचिषद्वसुरन्तरिक्षसद्धोता वेदिषदतिथिर्दुरोणसत् । नृषद्वरसदृतसद्व्योमसदब्जा गोजा ऋतजा अद्रिजा ऋतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: haṃsaḥ śuciṣadvasurantarikṣasaddhotā vediṣadatithirduroṇasat | nṛṣadvarasadṛtasadvyomasadabjā gojā ṛtajā adrijā ṛtam ||

translations.english: He is the Haṃsa, (the sun), dwelling; Vasu (the wind), dwelling in the firmament; the invoker of the gods (Agni), dwelling on the altar; the guest (of the worshipper), dweling in the house (as the culinary fire); the dweller among men, (as consciousness), the dweller in the most excellent (orbl, the sun), the dweller in truth, the dweller in the sky (the air), born in the waters, in the rays of light, in the verity (of manifestation) in the (eastern) mountain, the truth (itself).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रा को वां वरुणा सुम्नमाप स्तोमो हविष्माँ अमृतो न होता । यो वां हृदि क्रतुमाँ अस्मदुक्तः पस्पर्शदिन्द्रावरुणा नमस्वान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrā ko vāṃ varuṇā sumnamāpa stomo haviṣmā~ amṛto na hotā | yo vāṃ hṛdi kratumā~ asmaduktaḥ pasparśadindrāvaruṇā namasvān ||

translations.english: Indra (and Varuṇa), Varuṇa (and Indra), what praise of you accompanied by oblations may obtain for us felicity, (such as) the immortal invoker of the gods, (Agni, may bestow); may (the praise) which is addressed by us to you both, Indra and Varuṇa, sanctified by acts and prompted by veneration, touch your heartṣ

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रा ह यो वरुणा चक्र आपी देवौ मर्तः सख्याय प्रयस्वान् । स हन्ति वृत्रा समिथेषु शत्रूनवोभिर्वा महद्भिः स प्र शृण्वे ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrā ha yo varuṇā cakra āpī devau martaḥ sakhyāya prayasvān | sa hanti vṛtrā samitheṣu śatrūnavobhirvā mahadbhiḥ sa pra śṛṇve ||

translations.english: Divine Indra and Varuṇa, the mortal diligent in offering (you) sacrificial food, who has through friendship made you his kinsmen, destroys (his own) sins, and his enemies in battle; and by your great favours he becomes renowned.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रा ह रत्नं वरुणा धेष्ठेत्था नृभ्यः शशमानेभ्यस्ता । यदी सखाया सख्याय सोमैः सुतेभिः सुप्रयसा मादयैते ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrā ha ratnaṃ varuṇā dheṣṭhetthā nṛbhyaḥ śaśamānebhyastā | yadī sakhāyā sakhyāya somaiḥ sutebhiḥ suprayasā mādayaite ||

translations.english: Indra and Varuṇa (you are) most liberal givers of wealth to men praising you in various ways, when as friends well plural ed with (sacrificial) food, you are exhilarated by the Soma juice effused through friendship.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रा युवं वरुणा दिद्युमस्मिन्नोजिष्ठमुग्रा नि वधिष्टं वज्रम् । यो नो दुरेवो वृकतिर्दभीतिस्तस्मिन्मिमाथामभिभूत्योजः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrā yuvaṃ varuṇā didyumasminnojiṣṭhamugrā ni vadhiṣṭaṃ vajram | yo no durevo vṛkatirdabhītistasminmimāthāmabhibhūtyojaḥ ||

translations.english: Fierce Indra and Varuṇa you hurled the bright-shining and most mighty thunderbolt against this (our foe), who is difficult ot be resisted by us; (who is) rapacious, malevolent; grant us strength to overcome him.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रा युवं वरुणा भूतमस्या धियः प्रेतारा वृषभेव धेनोः । सा नो दुहीयद्यवसेव गत्वी सहस्रधारा पयसा मही गौः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrā yuvaṃ varuṇā bhūtamasyā dhiyaḥ pretārā vṛṣabheva dhenoḥ | sā no duhīyadyavaseva gatvī sahasradhārā payasā mahī gauḥ ||

translations.english: Indra and Varuṇa, be the exciters of this our praise, as the bull is of the cows; may that cow (of praise) yield us (reward), like a large cow that has gone forth to pasture, whose thousand channels (are filled) with milk.

mantras.sanskrit: तोके हिते तनय उर्वरासु सूरो दृशीके वृषणश्च पौंस्ये । इन्द्रा नो अत्र वरुणा स्यातामवोभिर्दस्मा परितक्म्यायाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: toke hite tanaya urvarāsu sūro dṛśīke vṛṣaṇaśca pauṃsye | indrā no atra varuṇā syātāmavobhirdasmā paritakmyāyām ||

translations.english: May Indra and Varuṇa, the overthrowers (of foes), be around us with (their) protections; (that thereby we may have) good sons and grandsons, and fertile lands, and long life, and virility.

mantras.sanskrit: युवामिद्ध्यवसे पूर्व्याय परि प्रभूती गविषः स्वापी । वृणीमहे सख्याय प्रियाय शूरा मंहिष्ठा पितरेव शम्भू ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvāmiddhyavase pūrvyāya pari prabhūtī gaviṣaḥ svāpī | vṛṇīmahe sakhyāya priyāya śūrā maṃhiṣṭhā pitareva śambhū ||

translations.english: Desirous of (possessing) cattlle, we have recourse to you, Indra and Varuṇa, for full protection, you who are powerful and kind as (kinsmen); we have recourse to you, adorable heroes, for (your) friendship and affection, (to you who are), like parents, givers of happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: ता वां धियोऽवसे वाजयन्तीराजिं न जग्मुर्युवयूः सुदानू । श्रिये न गाव उप सोममस्थुरिन्द्रं गिरो वरुणं मे मनीषाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā vāṃ dhiyo'vase vājayantīrājiṃ na jagmuryuvayūḥ sudānū | śriye na gāva upa somamasthurindraṃ giro varuṇaṃ me manīṣāḥ ||

translations.english: Liberal givers, those (our) praises soliciting (abundant) food have proceeded to you for (your) protection; longing for you as (soldiers long) for battle, and as cattle approach the Soma for (its) advantage, so my heartfelt hymns (approach) Indra and Varuṇa.

mantras.sanskrit: इमा इन्द्रं वरुणं मे मनीषा अग्मन्नुप द्रविणमिच्छमानाः । उपेमस्थुर्जोष्टार इव वस्वो रघ्वीरिव श्रवसो भिक्षमाणाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imā indraṃ varuṇaṃ me manīṣā agmannupa draviṇamicchamānāḥ | upemasthurjoṣṭāra iva vasvo raghvīriva śravaso bhikṣamāṇāḥ ||

translations.english: These my earnest praises approach Indra and Varuṇa, desirous to obtain wealth, as dependants attend (upon an opulent man) for the sake of riches, like humble (feminine les) begging for food.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्व्यस्य त्मना रथ्यस्य पुष्टेर्नित्यस्य रायः पतयः स्याम । ता चक्राणा ऊतिभिर्नव्यसीभिरस्मत्रा रायो नियुतः सचन्ताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvyasya tmanā rathyasya puṣṭernityasya rāyaḥ patayaḥ syāma | tā cakrāṇā ūtibhirnavyasībhirasmatrā rāyo niyutaḥ sacantām ||

translations.english: May we of our own (right) be the masters of permanent riches, comprising horses, chariots, and nourishment; may those two, traversing (the regions), direct their Niyut steeds towards us, associating (them) with riches and with recent protections.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो बृहन्ता बृहतीभिरूती इन्द्र यातं वरुण वाजसातौ । यद्दिद्यवः पृतनासु प्रक्रीळान्तस्य वां स्याम सनितार आजेः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no bṛhantā bṛhatībhirūtī indra yātaṃ varuṇa vājasātau | yaddidyavaḥ pṛtanāsu prakrīḷāntasya vāṃ syāma sanitāra ājeḥ ||

translations.english: Mighty Indra and Varuṇa, come to us in battle with (your) powerful protections, and where the bright (weapons) plural y amidst the (hostile) hosts, may we triumph in that conflict (through) your (favour).

mantras.sanskrit: मम द्विता राष्ट्रं क्षत्रियस्य विश्वायोर्विश्वे अमृता यथा नः । क्रतुं सचन्ते वरुणस्य देवा राजामि कृष्टेरुपमस्य वव्रेः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mama dvitā rāṣṭraṃ kṣatriyasya viśvāyorviśve amṛtā yathā naḥ | kratuṃ sacante varuṇasya devā rājāmi kṛṣṭerupamasya vavreḥ ||

translations.english: Twofold is my empire, that of the whole kṣatriya race, and all the immortals are ours; the gods associate me with the acts of Varuṇa; I rule over (those) of the proximate form of man.

mantras.sanskrit: अहं राजा वरुणो मह्यं तान्यसुर्याणि प्रथमा धारयन्त । क्रतुं सचन्ते वरुणस्य देवा राजामि कृष्टेरुपमस्य वव्रेः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ rājā varuṇo mahyaṃ tānyasuryāṇi prathamā dhārayanta | kratuṃ sacante varuṇasya devā rājāmi kṛṣṭerupamasya vavreḥ ||

translations.english: I am the king Varuṇa; on me (the gods) bestow those principal energies (that are) destructive of the asuras; (they) associate me with the worship of Varuṇa; I rule over (the nets) of the proximate form of man.

mantras.sanskrit: अहमिन्द्रो वरुणस्ते महित्वोर्वी गभीरे रजसी सुमेके । त्वष्टेव विश्वा भुवनानि विद्वान्त्समैरयं रोदसी धारयं च ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahamindro varuṇaste mahitvorvī gabhīre rajasī sumeke | tvaṣṭeva viśvā bhuvanāni vidvāntsamairayaṃ rodasī dhārayaṃ ca ||

translations.english: I am Indra, I am Varuṇa, I am those two in greatness; (I am) the vast, profound, beautiful, heaven and earth; intelligent, I give Tvaṣṭā-like animation to all beings; I uphold earth and heaven].

mantras.sanskrit: अहमपो अपिन्वमुक्षमाणा धारयं दिवं सदन ऋतस्य । ऋतेन पुत्रो अदितेॠतावोत त्रिधातु प्रथयद्वि भूम ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahamapo apinvamukṣamāṇā dhārayaṃ divaṃ sadana ṛtasya | ṛtena putro aditeṝtāvota tridhātu prathayadvi bhūma ||

translations.english: I have distributed the moisture-shedding waters; I have upheld the sky as the abode of the water; by the water I have become the preserver of the water, the son of Aditi, illustrating the threefold elementary space.

mantras.sanskrit: मां नरः स्वश्वा वाजयन्तो मां वृताः समरणे हवन्ते । कृणोम्याजिं मघवाहमिन्द्र इयर्मि रेणुमभिभूत्योजाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: māṃ naraḥ svaśvā vājayanto māṃ vṛtāḥ samaraṇe havante | kṛṇomyājiṃ maghavāhamindra iyarmi reṇumabhibhūtyojāḥ ||

translations.english: Warriors well mounted, ardent for contest invoke me; selected (combatants invoke) me in battle; I, the affluent Indra, instrumental gate the conflict, and, endowed with victorious prowess, I raise up the dust (in the battle).

mantras.sanskrit: अहं ता विश्वा चकरं नकिर्मा दैव्यं सहो वरते अप्रतीतम् । यन्मा सोमासो ममदन्यदुक्थोभे भयेते रजसी अपारे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ tā viśvā cakaraṃ nakirmā daivyaṃ saho varate apratītam | yanmā somāso mamadanyadukthobhe bhayete rajasī apāre ||

translations.english: I have done all these (deeds); no one resists my divine, unsurpassed vigour; and when the Soma juices, when sacred songs, exhilarate me, then the unbounded heaven and earth are both alarmed.

mantras.sanskrit: विदुष्टे विश्वा भुवनानि तस्य ता प्र ब्रवीषि वरुणाय वेधः । त्वं वृत्राणि शृण्विषे जघन्वान्त्वं वृताँ अरिणा इन्द्र सिन्धून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: viduṣṭe viśvā bhuvanāni tasya tā pra bravīṣi varuṇāya vedhaḥ | tvaṃ vṛtrāṇi śṛṇviṣe jaghanvāntvaṃ vṛtā~ ariṇā indra sindhūn ||

translations.english: All beings recognize you (Varuṇa), and your, worshipper, address these (encomiums) to Varuṇa; you, Indra, are renowned as slaying Vṛtra; you have set the obstructed rivers free to flow.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्माकमत्र पितरस्त आसन्त्सप्त ऋषयो दौर्गहे बध्यमाने । त आयजन्त त्रसदस्युमस्या इन्द्रं न वृत्रतुरमर्धदेवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmākamatra pitarasta āsantsapta ṛṣayo daurgahe badhyamāne | ta āyajanta trasadasyumasyā indraṃ na vṛtraturamardhadevam ||

translations.english: The seven ṛṣis were the protectors of this our (kingdom) when the son of Durgaha was in bonds; performing worship they obtained for (his queen) from the favour of Indra and Varuṇa, Trasadasyu, like Indra the slayer of foes, dwelling near the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: पुरुकुत्सानी हि वामदाशद्धव्येभिरिन्द्रावरुणा नमोभिः । अथा राजानं त्रसदस्युमस्या वृत्रहणं ददथुरर्धदेवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: purukutsānī hi vāmadāśaddhavyebhirindrāvaruṇā namobhiḥ | athā rājānaṃ trasadasyumasyā vṛtrahaṇaṃ dadathurardhadevam ||

translations.english: The wife of Purukutsa propitiated you two, Indra and Varuṇa, with oblations and prostrations, and therefore you gave her the king Trasadasyu, the slayer of foes dwelling near the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: राया वयं ससवांसो मदेम हव्येन देवा यवसेन गावः । तां धेनुमिन्द्रावरुणा युवं नो विश्वाहा धत्तमनपस्फुरन्तीम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: rāyā vayaṃ sasavāṃso madema havyena devā yavasena gāvaḥ | tāṃ dhenumindrāvaruṇā yuvaṃ no viśvāhā dhattamanapasphurantīm ||

translations.english: May we, glorifying you both, be delighted by riches; may the gods be plural ased by oblations, the cows by pasture; and do you, Indra and Varuṇa, daily grant us that same cow, (riches) free from any imperfection.

mantras.sanskrit: क उ श्रवत्कतमो यज्ञियानां वन्दारु देवः कतमो जुषाते । कस्येमां देवीममृतेषु प्रेष्ठां हृदि श्रेषाम सुष्टुतिं सुहव्याम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ka u śravatkatamo yajñiyānāṃ vandāru devaḥ katamo juṣāte | kasyemāṃ devīmamṛteṣu preṣṭhāṃ hṛdi śreṣāma suṣṭutiṃ suhavyām ||

translations.english: Which of those who are entitled to sacrifice will listen (to our prayers)? which of the gods will hear our praise? which will be propitiated (by it)? upon the heart of whom among the immortals may we impress the devout affectionate adoration, accompanied by sacred oblations?

mantras.sanskrit: को मृळाति कतम आगमिष्ठो देवानामु कतमः शम्भविष्ठः । रथं कमाहुर्द्रवदश्वमाशुं यं सूर्यस्य दुहितावृणीत ॥
mantras.transliteration: ko mṛḷāti katama āgamiṣṭho devānāmu katamaḥ śambhaviṣṭhaḥ | rathaṃ kamāhurdravadaśvamāśuṃ yaṃ sūryasya duhitāvṛṇīta ||

translations.english: Who will make us happy? which of the gods is the most prompt to come to our sacrifice? which is the most willing to grant us felicity? what chariot do they say is quick and drawn by rapid steeds? That which the daughter of Sūrya selected.

mantras.sanskrit: मक्षू हि ष्मा गच्छथ ईवतो द्यूनिन्द्रो न शक्तिं परितक्म्यायाम् । दिव आजाता दिव्या सुपर्णा कया शचीनां भवथः शचिष्ठा ॥
mantras.transliteration: makṣū hi ṣmā gacchatha īvato dyūnindro na śaktiṃ paritakmyāyām | diva ājātā divyā suparṇā kayā śacīnāṃ bhavathaḥ śaciṣṭhā ||

translations.english: Moving, you proceed rapidly by day, as Indra, at the end of the night, (manifests his) power; descended from heaven, divine, of graceful motion, (Aśvins), by which of (your) acts are you most distinguished?

mantras.sanskrit: का वां भूदुपमातिः कया न आश्विना गमथो हूयमाना । को वां महश्चित्त्यजसो अभीक उरुष्यतं माध्वी दस्रा न ऊती ॥
mantras.transliteration: kā vāṃ bhūdupamātiḥ kayā na āśvinā gamatho hūyamānā | ko vāṃ mahaścittyajaso abhīka uruṣyataṃ mādhvī dasrā na ūtī ||

translations.english: What may be the fit measure (of your merits)? invoked by what praises do you come to us? who (can exist as) the object of your great wrath? Dasras, dispensers of sweet (water), defend us with your protection.

mantras.sanskrit: उरु वां रथः परि नक्षति द्यामा यत्समुद्रादभि वर्तते वाम् । मध्वा माध्वी मधु वां प्रुषायन्यत्सीं वां पृक्षो भुरजन्त पक्वाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uru vāṃ rathaḥ pari nakṣati dyāmā yatsamudrādabhi vartate vām | madhvā mādhvī madhu vāṃ pruṣāyanyatsīṃ vāṃ pṛkṣo bhurajanta pakvāḥ ||

translations.english: Your chariot travels widely round the heaven until it plural ces you beyond the firmament; dispensers of sweet (water, the priests) are diluting the Soma juice with milk, that the boiled (barley) may be united with the libation offered to you.

mantras.sanskrit: सिन्धुर्ह वां रसया सिञ्चदश्वान्घृणा वयोऽरुषासः परि ग्मन् । तदू षु वामजिरं चेति यानं येन पती भवथः सूर्यायाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sindhurha vāṃ rasayā siñcadaśvānghṛṇā vayo'ruṣāsaḥ pari gman | tadū ṣu vāmajiraṃ ceti yānaṃ yena patī bhavathaḥ sūryāyāḥ ||

translations.english: The flowing (stream) has sprinkled your steeds with moisture; the radiant horses (like) birds (in swiftness) pass on, bright with lustre; well known as that quick-moving chariot, whereby you became the lords of Sūrya.

mantras.sanskrit: इहेह यद्वां समना पपृक्षे सेयमस्मे सुमतिर्वाजरत्ना । उरुष्यतं जरितारं युवं ह श्रितः कामो नासत्या युवद्रिक् ॥
mantras.transliteration: iheha yadvāṃ samanā papṛkṣe seyamasme sumatirvājaratnā | uruṣyataṃ jaritāraṃ yuvaṃ ha śritaḥ kāmo nāsatyā yuvadrik ||

translations.english: May the earnest praise, distributors of food, wherewith I associate you both like-minded at this sacrifice, be (beneficial) to us; do you protect your worshipper; my desire, Nāsatyas, directed towards you is gratified.

mantras.sanskrit: तं वां रथं वयमद्या हुवेम पृथुज्रयमश्विना संगतिं गोः । यः सूर्यां वहति वन्धुरायुर्गिर्वाहसं पुरुतमं वसूयुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ vāṃ rathaṃ vayamadyā huvema pṛthujrayamaśvinā saṃgatiṃ goḥ | yaḥ sūryāṃ vahati vandhurāyurgirvāhasaṃ purutamaṃ vasūyum ||

translations.english: We invoke, Aśvins, today, your rapid car, the associator of the solar ray; the banked car which bears Sūrya, vast, wealthy, and laden with praises.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं श्रियमश्विना देवता तां दिवो नपाता वनथः शचीभिः । युवोर्वपुरभि पृक्षः सचन्ते वहन्ति यत्ककुहासो रथे वाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ śriyamaśvinā devatā tāṃ divo napātā vanathaḥ śacībhiḥ | yuvorvapurabhi pṛkṣaḥ sacante vahanti yatkakuhāso rathe vām ||

translations.english: Aśvins, grandsons of heaven, divinities, you enjoy that glory of your actions, that (sacrificial) food is administered to your person ns, and powerul horses draw you in your chariot.

mantras.sanskrit: को वामद्या करते रातहव्य ऊतये वा सुतपेयाय वार्कैः । ऋतस्य वा वनुषे पूर्व्याय नमो येमानो अश्विना ववर्तत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ko vāmadyā karate rātahavya ūtaye vā sutapeyāya vārkaiḥ | ṛtasya vā vanuṣe pūrvyāya namo yemāno aśvinā vavartat ||

translations.english: What offer of oblations addresses you today with hymns for the sake (of obtaining) protection, for the drinking of the Soma, or for the ancient fulfilment of the sacrifice? what offer of adoration may bring you Aśvins may bring you Aśvins (to this rite)?

mantras.sanskrit: हिरण्ययेन पुरुभू रथेनेमं यज्ञं नासत्योप यातम् । पिबाथ इन्मधुनः सोम्यस्य दधथो रत्नं विधते जनाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: hiraṇyayena purubhū rathenemaṃ yajñaṃ nāsatyopa yātam | pibātha inmadhunaḥ somyasya dadhatho ratnaṃ vidhate janāya ||

translations.english: Nāsatyas, who are manifold, come with your golden chariot to this sacrifice; drink of the sweet Soma beverage, and give precious things to the man who celebrates (your worship).

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो यातं दिवो अच्छा पृथिव्या हिरण्ययेन सुवृता रथेन । मा वामन्ये नि यमन्देवयन्तः सं यद्ददे नाभिः पूर्व्या वाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no yātaṃ divo acchā pṛthivyā hiraṇyayena suvṛtā rathena | mā vāmanye ni yamandevayantaḥ saṃ yaddade nābhiḥ pūrvyā vām ||

translations.english: Come to our presence, whether from heaven or earth, with your well-constructed golden chariot; let not other devout worshippers detain yhou, for a prior attraction awaits you (here).

mantras.sanskrit: नू नो रयिं पुरुवीरं बृहन्तं दस्रा मिमाथामुभयेष्वस्मे । नरो यद्वामश्विना स्तोममावन्त्सधस्तुतिमाजमीळ्हासो अग्मन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū no rayiṃ puruvīraṃ bṛhantaṃ dasrā mimāthāmubhayeṣvasme | naro yadvāmaśvinā stomamāvantsadhastutimājamīḷhāso agman ||

translations.english: Dasras, mete out for us both great opulence, comprising many descendants, since the leaders of the rite (the Purumīḷhas), have addressed to you, Aśvins, their praise, and the Ajamīḷhas have united with it their laudation.

mantras.sanskrit: इहेह यद्वां समना पपृक्षे सेयमस्मे सुमतिर्वाजरत्ना । उरुष्यतं जरितारं युवं ह श्रितः कामो नासत्या युवद्रिक् ॥
mantras.transliteration: iheha yadvāṃ samanā papṛkṣe seyamasme sumatirvājaratnā | uruṣyataṃ jaritāraṃ yuvaṃ ha śritaḥ kāmo nāsatyā yuvadrik ||

translations.english: May you earn praise wherewith, distributors of food, I associate you both like-minded at this sacrifice, be (beneficial) to us; do you protect your worshipper; my desire, Nāsatyas, directed towards you is gratified.

mantras.sanskrit: एष स्य भानुरुदियर्ति युज्यते रथः परिज्मा दिवो अस्य सानवि । पृक्षासो अस्मिन्मिथुना अधि त्रयो दृतिस्तुरीयो मधुनो वि रप्शते ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa sya bhānurudiyarti yujyate rathaḥ parijmā divo asya sānavi | pṛkṣāso asminmithunā adhi trayo dṛtisturīyo madhuno vi rapśate ||

translations.english: The sun rises; your chariot, (Aśvins), traversing (the regions), is associated with the divine (orb) on the summit (of the eastern mountain in it are three analogous kinds of food, and the leather vessel of the sweet Soma juice appears as the fourth.

mantras.sanskrit: उद्वां पृक्षासो मधुमन्त ईरते रथा अश्वास उषसो व्युष्टिषु । अपोर्णुवन्तस्तम आ परीवृतं स्वर्ण शुक्रं तन्वन्त आ रजः ॥
mantras.transliteration: udvāṃ pṛkṣāso madhumanta īrate rathā aśvāsa uṣaso vyuṣṭiṣu | aporṇuvantastama ā parīvṛtaṃ svarṇa śukraṃ tanvanta ā rajaḥ ||

translations.english: Your food-bearing, Soma-laden, well-horsed chariots, appearing at the opening of the dawn, scattering the surrounding darkness like the sun, and spreading bright radiance over the firmament.

mantras.sanskrit: मध्वः पिबतं मधुपेभिरासभिरुत प्रियं मधुने युञ्जाथां रथम् । आ वर्तनिं मधुना जिन्वथस्पथो दृतिं वहेथे मधुमन्तमश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: madhvaḥ pibataṃ madhupebhirāsabhiruta priyaṃ madhune yuñjāthāṃ ratham | ā vartaniṃ madhunā jinvathaspatho dṛtiṃ vahethe madhumantamaśvinā ||

translations.english: Drink of the Soma juice, with mouths (fit for) imbibing the beverage; harness your beloved chariot for the Soma juice; (come to the dwelling) of the sacrifice; enliven the path with the Soma; bring, Aśvins, the leather vessels filled with the Soma-juice.

mantras.sanskrit: हंसासो ये वां मधुमन्तो अस्रिधो हिरण्यपर्णा उहुव उषर्बुधः । उदप्रुतो मन्दिनो मन्दिनिस्पृशो मध्वो न मक्षः सवनानि गच्छथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: haṃsāso ye vāṃ madhumanto asridho hiraṇyaparṇā uhuva uṣarbudhaḥ | udapruto mandino mandinispṛśo madhvo na makṣaḥ savanāni gacchathaḥ ||

translations.english: Come to sacrifices as flies to honey, (with those horses) that are swift of speed, genitive le, unrefractory, golden-winged, bearers (of burden), wakers at dawn, dispensers of water, exulting and sipping the Soma juice.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वध्वरासो मधुमन्तो अग्नय उस्रा जरन्ते प्रति वस्तोरश्विना । यन्निक्तहस्तस्तरणिर्विचक्षणः सोमं सुषाव मधुमन्तमद्रिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: svadhvarāso madhumanto agnaya usrā jarante prati vastoraśvinā | yanniktahastastaraṇirvicakṣaṇaḥ somaṃ suṣāva madhumantamadribhiḥ ||

translations.english: The ssacred fires, the instrumental uments of holy sacrifice the conveyers of libations, praise the associated Aśvins at the break of day, when the observant (priest) the conductor of the rite, with washed hands has expressed by the (grinding) stones the sweet-flavoured Soma juice.

mantras.sanskrit: आकेनिपासो अहभिर्दविध्वतः स्वर्ण शुक्रं तन्वन्त आ रजः । सूरश्चिदश्वान्युयुजान ईयते विश्वाँ अनु स्वधया चेतथस्पथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ākenipāso ahabhirdavidhvataḥ svarṇa śukraṃ tanvanta ā rajaḥ | sūraścidaśvānyuyujāna īyate viśvā~ anu svadhayā cetathaspathaḥ ||

translations.english: The near-advancing (rays), dispersing (the darkness) by the (light of day), are overspreading the firmament with lustre like the sun; the sun, harnessing his horses, (proceeds on his way); do you make known all his paths by (following) after (him) with sacrificial food.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वामवोचमश्विना धियंधा रथः स्वश्वो अजरो यो अस्ति । येन सद्यः परि रजांसि याथो हविष्मन्तं तरणिं भोजमच्छ ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vāmavocamaśvinā dhiyaṃdhā rathaḥ svaśvo ajaro yo asti | yena sadyaḥ pari rajāṃsi yātho haviṣmantaṃ taraṇiṃ bhojamaccha ||

translations.english: Celebrating (sacred) rites, I glorify you, Aśvins; well-horsed and undecaying is that chariot, whereby you quickly traverse the regions (of space), and come to (our sacrifice) abounding in oblations, promptly passing away, and the yielder of enjoyment.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्रं पिबा मधूनां सुतं वायो दिविष्टिषु । त्वं हि पूर्वपा असि ॥
mantras.transliteration: agraṃ pibā madhūnāṃ sutaṃ vāyo diviṣṭiṣu | tvaṃ hi pūrvapā asi ||

translations.english: Drink first, Vāyu, the effused libation of the Soma at the rites that secure heaven, for you verily are the first drinker.

mantras.sanskrit: शतेना नो अभिष्टिभिर्नियुत्वाँ इन्द्रसारथिः । वायो सुतस्य तृम्पतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śatenā no abhiṣṭibhirniyutvā~ indrasārathiḥ | vāyo sutasya tṛmpatam ||

translations.english: Vāyu, who are drawn by the Niyuts, and have Indra for charioteer, come (for the fulfilment) of our numerous wishes, and do you (and Indra) drink of the libation.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वां सहस्रं हरय इन्द्रवायू अभि प्रयः । वहन्तु सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāṃ sahasraṃ haraya indravāyū abhi prayaḥ | vahantu somapītaye ||

translations.english: Indra and Vāyu, may a thousand steeds, eager for food, bring you to drink the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: रथं हिरण्यवन्धुरमिन्द्रवायू स्वध्वरम् । आ हि स्थाथो दिविस्पृशम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: rathaṃ hiraṇyavandhuramindravāyū svadhvaram | ā hi sthātho divispṛśam ||

translations.english: Mount, Indra and Vāyu, the golden-seated chariot, propitious to sacrifice, soaring to heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: रथेन पृथुपाजसा दाश्वांसमुप गच्छतम् । इन्द्रवायू इहा गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: rathena pṛthupājasā dāśvāṃsamupa gacchatam | indravāyū ihā gatam ||

translations.english: Indra and Vāyu, come with your very strong chariot to the sacrifice; come hither.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रवायू अयं सुतस्तं देवेभिः सजोषसा । पिबतं दाशुषो गृहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: indravāyū ayaṃ sutastaṃ devebhiḥ sajoṣasā | pibataṃ dāśuṣo gṛhe ||

translations.english: Indra and Vāyu, this (libation) is poured out sympathizing with the gods, drink it in the dwelling of the donor.

mantras.sanskrit: इह प्रयाणमस्तु वामिन्द्रवायू विमोचनम् । इह वां सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: iha prayāṇamastu vāmindravāyū vimocanam | iha vāṃ somapītaye ||

translations.english: Hither be your course; here, Indra and Vāyu, be the letting of your horses loose, for your drinking of the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: वायो शुक्रो अयामि ते मध्वो अग्रं दिविष्टिषु । आ याहि सोमपीतये स्पार्हो देव नियुत्वता ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāyo śukro ayāmi te madhvo agraṃ diviṣṭiṣu | ā yāhi somapītaye spārho deva niyutvatā ||

translations.english: Purified (by holy acts) I bring to you, Vāyu, the Soma, first (offered to you at sacrifices) that seek to gain heaven; deity, who are ever longed over, come with your Niyut steeds to drink the Soma juice.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रश्च वायवेषां सोमानां पीतिमर्हथः । युवां हि यन्तीन्दवो निम्नमापो न सध्र्यक् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraśca vāyaveṣāṃ somānāṃ pītimarhathaḥ | yuvāṃ hi yantīndavo nimnamāpo na sadhryak ||

translations.english: Indra and Vāyu, you are fit for the drinking of these Soma libations, for the drops flow towards you as waters (run) together in a deep plural ce.

mantras.sanskrit: वायविन्द्रश्च शुष्मिणा सरथं शवसस्पती । नियुत्वन्ता न ऊतय आ यातं सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāyavindraśca śuṣmiṇā sarathaṃ śavasaspatī | niyutvantā na ūtaya ā yātaṃ somapītaye ||

translations.english: Indra and Vāyu, who are lords of strength, vigorous and drawn by the Niyut steeds, come (riding in) the same car; drink the Soma for our protection.

mantras.sanskrit: या वां सन्ति पुरुस्पृहो नियुतो दाशुषे नरा । अस्मे ता यज्ञवाहसेन्द्रवायू नि यच्छतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā vāṃ santi puruspṛho niyuto dāśuṣe narā | asme tā yajñavāhasendravāyū ni yacchatam ||

translations.english: Leaders (of rites), conveyers of sacrifices, Indra and Vāyu, give to us for the offer (of the oblation), those Niyuts who are your (steeds), and are desired of many.

mantras.sanskrit: विहि होत्रा अवीता विपो न रायो अर्यः । वायवा चन्द्रेण रथेन याहि सुतस्य पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: vihi hotrā avītā vipo na rāyo aryaḥ | vāyavā candreṇa rathena yāhi sutasya pītaye ||

translations.english: Drink, Vāyu, the oblations yet untested, like (a prince) the terrifier of foes; (bestow) upon the worshipper wealth; come with your brilliant car to drink the Soma juice.

mantras.sanskrit: निर्युवाणो अशस्तीर्नियुत्वाँ इन्द्रसारथिः । वायवा चन्द्रेण रथेन याहि सुतस्य पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: niryuvāṇo aśastīrniyutvā~ indrasārathiḥ | vāyavā candreṇa rathena yāhi sutasya pītaye ||

translations.english: Vāyu, who are the represser of calumnies, who are drawn by the Niyuts, and have Indra for your charioteer come with your brilliant car to drink the Soma juice.

mantras.sanskrit: अनु कृष्णे वसुधिती येमाते विश्वपेशसा । वायवा चन्द्रेण रथेन याहि सुतस्य पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: anu kṛṣṇe vasudhitī yemāte viśvapeśasā | vāyavā candreṇa rathena yāhi sutasya pītaye ||

translations.english: The dark nurses of wealth, the universal forms (heaven and earth), attend upon you; come Vāyu with your brilliant car to drink the Soma juice.

mantras.sanskrit: वहन्तु त्वा मनोयुजो युक्तासो नवतिर्नव । वायवा चन्द्रेण रथेन याहि सुतस्य पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: vahantu tvā manoyujo yuktāso navatirnava | vāyavā candreṇa rathena yāhi sutasya pītaye ||

translations.english: May the ninety-nine steeds harnessed together, that are as swift as thought, convey you; come, Vāyu, with your brilliant car, to drink the Soma juice.

mantras.sanskrit: वायो शतं हरीणां युवस्व पोष्याणाम् । उत वा ते सहस्रिणो रथ आ यातु पाजसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāyo śataṃ harīṇāṃ yuvasva poṣyāṇām | uta vā te sahasriṇo ratha ā yātu pājasā ||

translations.english: Harness, Vāyu, a hundred plural mp steeds, or even a thousand, and let your chariot come with rapidity (hither).

mantras.sanskrit: इदं वामास्ये हविः प्रियमिन्द्राबृहस्पती । उक्थं मदश्च शस्यते ॥
mantras.transliteration: idaṃ vāmāsye haviḥ priyamindrābṛhaspatī | ukthaṃ madaśca śasyate ||

translations.english: (I present) the agreeable oblation to your mouths, Indra and Bṛhaspati, and the hymn and the exhilarating beverage are offered.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं वां परि षिच्यते सोम इन्द्राबृहस्पती । चारुर्मदाय पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ vāṃ pari ṣicyate soma indrābṛhaspatī | cārurmadāya pītaye ||

translations.english: This delicious Soma is effused, Indra and Bṛhaspati, for you, (your) drinking and exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: आ न इन्द्राबृहस्पती गृहमिन्द्रश्च गच्छतम् । सोमपा सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā na indrābṛhaspatī gṛhamindraśca gacchatam | somapā somapītaye ||

translations.english: Indra and Bṛhaspati, come to our dwelling, drinkers of Soma, to drink the Soma juice.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मे इन्द्राबृहस्पती रयिं धत्तं शतग्विनम् । अश्वावन्तं सहस्रिणम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asme indrābṛhaspatī rayiṃ dhattaṃ śatagvinam | aśvāvantaṃ sahasriṇam ||

translations.english: Grant to us, Indra and Bṛhaspati riches comprising a hundred (cattle), a thousand horses.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राबृहस्पती वयं सुते गीर्भिर्हवामहे । अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrābṛhaspatī vayaṃ sute gīrbhirhavāmahe | asya somasya pītaye ||

translations.english: Indra and Bṛhaspati, we invoke you with praises, when the libation is effused, to drink of this Soma juice.

mantras.sanskrit: सोममिन्द्राबृहस्पती पिबतं दाशुषो गृहे । मादयेथां तदोकसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: somamindrābṛhaspatī pibataṃ dāśuṣo gṛhe | mādayethāṃ tadokasā ||

translations.english: Drink, Indra and Bṛhaspati, the Soma; in the dwelling of the donor, and be exhilarated in his abode.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्तस्तम्भ सहसा वि ज्मो अन्तान्बृहस्पतिस्त्रिषधस्थो रवेण । तं प्रत्नास ऋषयो दीध्यानाः पुरो विप्रा दधिरे मन्द्रजिह्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yastastambha sahasā vi jmo antānbṛhaspatistriṣadhastho raveṇa | taṃ pratnāsa ṛṣayo dīdhyānāḥ puro viprā dadhire mandrajihvam ||

translations.english: The ancient sages, illustrious, intelligent, have plural ced before (them) the plural asing-tongued Bṛhaspati, who propped up by (his) strength the ends of the earth, and who abides with noise in the three regions.

mantras.sanskrit: धुनेतयः सुप्रकेतं मदन्तो बृहस्पते अभि ये नस्ततस्रे । पृषन्तं सृप्रमदब्धमूर्वं बृहस्पते रक्षतादस्य योनिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhunetayaḥ supraketaṃ madanto bṛhaspate abhi ye nastatasre | pṛṣantaṃ sṛpramadabdhamūrvaṃ bṛhaspate rakṣatādasya yonim ||

translations.english: Bṛhaspati, protect the fruit-yielding, progressive, uninjured ample sacrifice of this (your worshipp0er, at which) they who are the terrifiers (of foes), the delighters of you who are possessed of great wisdom, glorify (you) in our behalf.

mantras.sanskrit: बृहस्पते या परमा परावदत आ त ऋतस्पृशो नि षेदुः । तुभ्यं खाता अवता अद्रिदुग्धा मध्वः श्चोतन्त्यभितो विरप्शम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhaspate yā paramā parāvadata ā ta ṛtaspṛśo ni ṣeduḥ | tubhyaṃ khātā avatā adridugdhā madhvaḥ ścotantyabhito virapśam ||

translations.english: Those (steeds), Bṛhaspati, which had come from that distant (region), the best (of all), have sat down in connection with the ceremony, and to you the Soma juices expressed by the stones flow copiously, (accompanied) by the sounds of praise, like deep wells that supply water.

mantras.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिः प्रथमं जायमानो महो ज्योतिषः परमे व्योमन् । सप्तास्यस्तुविजातो रवेण वि सप्तरश्मिरधमत्तमांसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhaspatiḥ prathamaṃ jāyamāno maho jyotiṣaḥ parame vyoman | saptāsyastuvijāto raveṇa vi saptaraśmiradhamattamāṃsi ||

translations.english: Bṛhaspati, when first being born in the highest heaven of supreme light, seven-mouthed, multiform, (combined) with sound, and seven-rayed, has subdued the darkness.

mantras.sanskrit: स सुष्टुभा स ऋक्वता गणेन वलं रुरोज फलिगं रवेण । बृहस्पतिरुस्रिया हव्यसूदः कनिक्रदद्वावशतीरुदाजत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa suṣṭubhā sa ṛkvatā gaṇena valaṃ ruroja phaligaṃ raveṇa | bṛhaspatirusriyā havyasūdaḥ kanikradadvāvaśatīrudājat ||

translations.english: (Aided) by the praised and brilliant troop (of the Aṅgirasas), he destroyed with sound the mischievous Bala, Bṛhaspati, shouting aloud, set free the boon-bestowing, oblation-supplying kine.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा पित्रे विश्वदेवाय वृष्णे यज्ञैर्विधेम नमसा हविर्भिः । बृहस्पते सुप्रजा वीरवन्तो वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā pitre viśvadevāya vṛṣṇe yajñairvidhema namasā havirbhiḥ | bṛhaspate suprajā vīravanto vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||

translations.english: Thus may we offer worship with sacrifices, with oblations, with praise, to the paternal, universal deity, the showerer (of benefits); and may we, Bṛhaspati, become possessed of riches, and be blessed with excellent progeny and valiant descendants.

mantras.sanskrit: स इद्राजा प्रतिजन्यानि विश्वा शुष्मेण तस्थावभि वीर्येण । बृहस्पतिं यः सुभृतं बिभर्ति वल्गूयति वन्दते पूर्वभाजम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa idrājā pratijanyāni viśvā śuṣmeṇa tasthāvabhi vīryeṇa | bṛhaspatiṃ yaḥ subhṛtaṃ bibharti valgūyati vandate pūrvabhājam ||

translations.english: That prince overcomes by his strength and prowess, all hostile people, who cherishes liberally Bṛhaspati, and glorifies and honours him as the first sharer (of the offering).

mantras.sanskrit: स इत्क्षेति सुधित ओकसि स्वे तस्मा इळा पिन्वते विश्वदानीम् । तस्मै विशः स्वयमेवा नमन्ते यस्मिन्ब्रह्मा राजनि पूर्व एति ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa itkṣeti sudhita okasi sve tasmā iḷā pinvate viśvadānīm | tasmai viśaḥ svayamevā namante yasminbrahmā rājani pūrva eti ||

translations.english: Verily he abides prosperous in his own abode; for him the earth bears fruit at all seasons; to him (his) subjects willingly pay homage, the prince, to whom the Brāhmaṇa first, (duly reverenced), repairs.

mantras.sanskrit: अप्रतीतो जयति सं धनानि प्रतिजन्यान्युत या सजन्या । अवस्यवे यो वरिवः कृणोति ब्रह्मणे राजा तमवन्ति देवाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: apratīto jayati saṃ dhanāni pratijanyānyuta yā sajanyā | avasyave yo varivaḥ kṛṇoti brahmaṇe rājā tamavanti devāḥ ||

translations.english: Unopposed he is the master of the riches of hostile people, and of his own subjects; the Rājā who bestows riches upon the Brāhmaṇa seeking his protection him the gods protect.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रश्च सोमं पिबतं बृहस्पतेऽस्मिन्यज्ञे मन्दसाना वृषण्वसू । आ वां विशन्त्विन्दवः स्वाभुवोऽस्मे रयिं सर्ववीरं नि यच्छतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraśca somaṃ pibataṃ bṛhaspate'sminyajñe mandasānā vṛṣaṇvasū | ā vāṃ viśantvindavaḥ svābhuvo'sme rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ ni yacchatam ||

translations.english: Bṛhaspati, do you and Indra, both exulting and showering riches, drink the Soma at this sacrifice; may the all-pervading drops enter you; bestow upon us riches, comprising all male descendants.

mantras.sanskrit: बृहस्पत इन्द्र वर्धतं नः सचा सा वां सुमतिर्भूत्वस्मे । अविष्टं धियो जिगृतं पुरंधीर्जजस्तमर्यो वनुषामरातीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhaspata indra vardhataṃ naḥ sacā sā vāṃ sumatirbhūtvasme | aviṣṭaṃ dhiyo jigṛtaṃ puraṃdhīrjajastamaryo vanuṣāmarātīḥ ||

translations.english: Bṛhaspati, Indra, elevate us; may the favourable disposition of you both be combined for us; protect our rites; be awake to our laudations, confound the arrogant (foes) of us who are the donors (of oblations).

mantras.sanskrit: इदमु त्यत्पुरुतमं पुरस्ताज्ज्योतिस्तमसो वयुनावदस्थात् । नूनं दिवो दुहितरो विभातीर्गातुं कृणवन्नुषसो जनाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: idamu tyatpurutamaṃ purastājjyotistamaso vayunāvadasthāt | nūnaṃ divo duhitaro vibhātīrgātuṃ kṛṇavannuṣaso janāya ||

translations.english: This widely-spread and sense-bestowing light has sprung up in the east from out of the darkness; verily the brilliant Dawns, the daughters of heaven, are giving to man (the faculty to act).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्थुरु चित्रा उषसः पुरस्तान्मिता इव स्वरवोऽध्वरेषु । व्यू व्रजस्य तमसो द्वारोच्छन्तीरव्रञ्छुचयः पावकाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asthuru citrā uṣasaḥ purastānmitā iva svaravo'dhvareṣu | vyū vrajasya tamaso dvārocchantīravrañchucayaḥ pāvakāḥ ||

translations.english: The many-limbed Dawns rise up in the east, like the pillars plural nted at sacrifices (round the altar); radiant and purifying, they are manifested, opening the gates of the obstructing gloom.

mantras.sanskrit: उच्छन्तीरद्य चितयन्त भोजान्राधोदेयायोषसो मघोनीः । अचित्रे अन्तः पणयः ससन्त्वबुध्यमानास्तमसो विमध्ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ucchantīradya citayanta bhojānrādhodeyāyoṣaso maghonīḥ | acitre antaḥ paṇayaḥ sasantvabudhyamānāstamaso vimadhye ||

translations.english: The gloom-dispelling, affluent Dawns animate the pious worshippers to offer (sacrificial) treasure; may the churlish (traffickers) sleep on unawakened, in the unlovely depth of darkness.

mantras.sanskrit: कुवित्स देवीः सनयो नवो वा यामो बभूयादुषसो वो अद्य । येना नवग्वे अङ्गिरे दशग्वे सप्तास्ये रेवती रेवदूष ॥
mantras.transliteration: kuvitsa devīḥ sanayo navo vā yāmo babhūyāduṣaso vo adya | yenā navagve aṅgire daśagve saptāsye revatī revadūṣa ||

translations.english: Divine Dawns, may your chariot, whether old or new, be frequent at this day's (worship), wherewith, affluent Dawns, possessing riches, (you shine) upon the seven-mouthed (troop of the) Aṅgirasas, the observers of the nine or ten days' rite.

mantras.sanskrit: यूयं हि देवीॠतयुग्भिरश्वैः परिप्रयाथ भुवनानि सद्यः । प्रबोधयन्तीरुषसः ससन्तं द्विपाच्चतुष्पाच्चरथाय जीवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yūyaṃ hi devīṝtayugbhiraśvaiḥ pariprayātha bhuvanāni sadyaḥ | prabodhayantīruṣasaḥ sasantaṃ dvipāccatuṣpāccarathāya jīvam ||

translations.english: Divine Dawns, with horses that frequent sacrifices you quickly travel round the regions (of space); awake the sleeping being, whether biped or quadruped, to pursue (his functions).

mantras.sanskrit: क्व स्विदासां कतमा पुराणी यया विधाना विदधुॠभूणाम् । शुभं यच्छुभ्रा उषसश्चरन्ति न वि ज्ञायन्ते सदृशीरजुर्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kva svidāsāṃ katamā purāṇī yayā vidhānā vidadhuṝbhūṇām | śubhaṃ yacchubhrā uṣasaścaranti na vi jñāyante sadṛśīrajuryāḥ ||

translations.english: Where is that ancient one of those (Dawns), through whom the works of the Ṛbhus were accomplished? For as the bright Dawns happily proceed, they are not distinguished, being alike and undecaying.

mantras.sanskrit: ता घा ता भद्रा उषसः पुरासुरभिष्टिद्युम्ना ऋतजातसत्याः । यास्वीजानः शशमान उक्थैः स्तुवञ्छंसन्द्रविणं सद्य आप ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā ghā tā bhadrā uṣasaḥ purāsurabhiṣṭidyumnā ṛtajātasatyāḥ | yāsvījānaḥ śaśamāna ukthaiḥ stuvañchaṃsandraviṇaṃ sadya āpa ||

translations.english: Verily those auspicious Dawns have been of old, rich with desired blessings, truthful (bestowers) of the results of sacrifice; at which the sacrificer, adoring with (silent) praise, glorifying (with hymns), has quickly obtained wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: ता आ चरन्ति समना पुरस्तात्समानतः समना पप्रथानाः । ऋतस्य देवीः सदसो बुधाना गवां न सर्गा उषसो जरन्ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā ā caranti samanā purastātsamānataḥ samanā paprathānāḥ | ṛtasya devīḥ sadaso budhānā gavāṃ na sargā uṣaso jarante ||

translations.english: They spread around of smilar form, (coming) from the east, (coming) from the same region alike renowned; the divine Dawns, arousing the assembly of the sacrifice are glorified like the (rays) creative of the waters.

mantras.sanskrit: ता इन्न्वेव समना समानीरमीतवर्णा उषसश्चरन्ति । गूहन्तीरभ्वमसितं रुशद्भिः शुक्रास्तनूभिः शुचयो रुचानाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā innveva samanā samānīramītavarṇā uṣasaścaranti | gūhantīrabhvamasitaṃ ruśadbhiḥ śukrāstanūbhiḥ śucayo rucānāḥ ||

translations.english: Those Dawns proceed verily all alike, of similar form, of infinite hues, pure, bright, illumining, concealing by their radiant person ns the very great gloom.

mantras.sanskrit: रयिं दिवो दुहितरो विभातीः प्रजावन्तं यच्छतास्मासु देवीः । स्योनादा वः प्रतिबुध्यमानाः सुवीर्यस्य पतयः स्याम ॥
mantras.transliteration: rayiṃ divo duhitaro vibhātīḥ prajāvantaṃ yacchatāsmāsu devīḥ | syonādā vaḥ pratibudhyamānāḥ suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma ||

translations.english: Divine, resplendent daughters of heaven, bestow upon us wealth, comprehending progeny; awaking you for our benefit, may we be the lords of excellent descendants.

mantras.sanskrit: तद्वो दिवो दुहितरो विभातीरुप ब्रुव उषसो यज्ञकेतुः । वयं स्याम यशसो जनेषु तद्द्यौश्च धत्तां पृथिवी च देवी ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadvo divo duhitaro vibhātīrupa bruva uṣaso yajñaketuḥ | vayaṃ syāma yaśaso janeṣu taddyauśca dhattāṃ pṛthivī ca devī ||

translations.english: Daughters of heaven, resplendent Dawns, I address you (as) the announcer of the sacrificer; may we be (the possessors) of celebrity among men, and may heaven and the divine earth perpetuate (it).

mantras.sanskrit: प्रति ष्या सूनरी जनी व्युच्छन्ती परि स्वसुः । दिवो अदर्शि दुहिता ॥
mantras.transliteration: prati ṣyā sūnarī janī vyucchantī pari svasuḥ | divo adarśi duhitā ||

translations.english: The daughter of heaven has been seen; the kind conductress (of men), the parent (of benefits) shedding radiance upon (the departure of her) sister nighṭ

mantras.sanskrit: अश्वेव चित्रारुषी माता गवामृतावरी । सखाभूदश्विनोरुषाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśveva citrāruṣī mātā gavāmṛtāvarī | sakhābhūdaśvinoruṣāḥ ||

translations.english: Like a beautiful mare, the radiant mother of the rays of light, the object of sacrifice, (she) is the friend of the Aśvins.

mantras.sanskrit: उत सखास्यश्विनोरुत माता गवामसि । उतोषो वस्व ईशिषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta sakhāsyaśvinoruta mātā gavāmasi | utoṣo vasva īśiṣe ||

translations.english: You are the friend of the Aśvins; you are the mother of the rays of light; you, Uṣas, rule over riches.

mantras.sanskrit: यावयद्द्वेषसं त्वा चिकित्वित्सूनृतावरि । प्रति स्तोमैरभुत्स्महि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yāvayaddveṣasaṃ tvā cikitvitsūnṛtāvari | prati stomairabhutsmahi ||

translations.english: With praises we awaken you, you who are endowed with truth; you, baffler of animosities, the restorer of consciousness.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रति भद्रा अदृक्षत गवां सर्गा न रश्मयः । ओषा अप्रा उरु ज्रयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prati bhadrā adṛkṣata gavāṃ sargā na raśmayaḥ | oṣā aprā uru jrayaḥ ||

translations.english: The auspicious rays are visible like showers of rain, the dawn has filled (the world) with ample light.

mantras.sanskrit: आपप्रुषी विभावरि व्यावर्ज्योतिषा तमः । उषो अनु स्वधामव ॥
mantras.transliteration: āpapruṣī vibhāvari vyāvarjyotiṣā tamaḥ | uṣo anu svadhāmava ||

translations.english: Brilliant Uṣas, filling (the world with light), you disperse the darkness with radiance; thereafter protect the oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: आ द्यां तनोषि रश्मिभिरान्तरिक्षमुरु प्रियम् । उषः शुक्रेण शोचिषा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā dyāṃ tanoṣi raśmibhirāntarikṣamuru priyam | uṣaḥ śukreṇa śociṣā ||

translations.english: You overspread, Uṣas, the heaven with rays, as well as the vast and beloved firmament with pure lustre.

mantras.sanskrit: तद्देवस्य सवितुर्वार्यं महद्वृणीमहे असुरस्य प्रचेतसः । छर्दिर्येन दाशुषे यच्छति त्मना तन्नो महाँ उदयान्देवो अक्तुभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taddevasya saviturvāryaṃ mahadvṛṇīmahe asurasya pracetasaḥ | chardiryena dāśuṣe yacchati tmanā tanno mahā~ udayāndevo aktubhiḥ ||

translations.english: We solicit of the divine, powerful, and intelligen Savitā that desirable and ample (wealth), along with which he grants a dwelling to the offerer of the oblation of his own accord; may the great deity grant us such every day.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवो धर्ता भुवनस्य प्रजापतिः पिशङ्गं द्रापिं प्रति मुञ्चते कविः । विचक्षणः प्रथयन्नापृणन्नुर्वजीजनत्सविता सुम्नमुक्थ्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: divo dhartā bhuvanasya prajāpatiḥ piśaṅgaṃ drāpiṃ prati muñcate kaviḥ | vicakṣaṇaḥ prathayannāpṛṇannurvajījanatsavitā sumnamukthyam ||

translations.english: The supporter of heaven, the protector of the world, the wise (Savitā) puts on his golden armour discrimiator (of objects), filling (the world with light) Savitā has engendered great and laudable felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: आप्रा रजांसि दिव्यानि पार्थिवा श्लोकं देवः कृणुते स्वाय धर्मणे । प्र बाहू अस्राक्सविता सवीमनि निवेशयन्प्रसुवन्नक्तुभिर्जगत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: āprā rajāṃsi divyāni pārthivā ślokaṃ devaḥ kṛṇute svāya dharmaṇe | pra bāhū asrāksavitā savīmani niveśayanprasuvannaktubhirjagat ||

translations.english: The divine (Savitā) fills (with radiance) the celestial and terrestrial regions, and boasts of his own function; Savitā puts forth his arms or (the work of) production, regulating the world, and animating it with light.

mantras.sanskrit: अदाभ्यो भुवनानि प्रचाकशद्व्रतानि देवः सविताभि रक्षते । प्रास्राग्बाहू भुवनस्य प्रजाभ्यो धृतव्रतो महो अज्मस्य राजति ॥
mantras.transliteration: adābhyo bhuvanāni pracākaśadvratāni devaḥ savitābhi rakṣate | prāsrāgbāhū bhuvanasya prajābhyo dhṛtavrato maho ajmasya rājati ||

translations.english: The divine Savitā unrestrained, illumining the regions, protects the righteous acts (of men); he extends his arms for (the direction of) the people of the earth; observant of obligations, he rules over the wide world.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिरन्तरिक्षं सविता महित्वना त्री रजांसि परिभुस्त्रीणि रोचना । तिस्रो दिवः पृथिवीस्तिस्र इन्वति त्रिभिर्व्रतैरभि नो रक्षति त्मना ॥
mantras.transliteration: trirantarikṣaṃ savitā mahitvanā trī rajāṃsi paribhustrīṇi rocanā | tisro divaḥ pṛthivīstisra invati tribhirvratairabhi no rakṣati tmanā ||

translations.english: Savitā, encompassing them by his magnitude, pervades th three (divisions of the) firmament, the three worlds, the three brilliant sphere, the three heavens, the threefold earth may he, by his three functions, of his own (plural asure) protect us.

mantras.sanskrit: बृहत्सुम्नः प्रसवीता निवेशनो जगतः स्थातुरुभयस्य यो वशी । स नो देवः सविता शर्म यच्छत्वस्मे क्षयाय त्रिवरूथमंहसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhatsumnaḥ prasavītā niveśano jagataḥ sthāturubhayasya yo vaśī | sa no devaḥ savitā śarma yacchatvasme kṣayāya trivarūthamaṃhasaḥ ||

translations.english: May that divine Savitā, who is the source of great happiness, the engenderer (of good works), the comprehender (of all beings), the regulator of both the moveable and the stationary, grant us happiness in the three worlds, and (be) to us for the destruction of sin.

mantras.sanskrit: आगन्देव ऋतुभिर्वर्धतु क्षयं दधातु नः सविता सुप्रजामिषम् । स नः क्षपाभिरहभिश्च जिन्वतु प्रजावन्तं रयिमस्मे समिन्वतु ॥
mantras.transliteration: āgandeva ṛtubhirvardhatu kṣayaṃ dadhātu naḥ savitā suprajāmiṣam | sa naḥ kṣapābhirahabhiśca jinvatu prajāvantaṃ rayimasme saminvatu ||

translations.english: May the divine Savitā approach along with the Ṛtus, prosper our dwelling, and bestow upon us good progeny and food; may he be favourable to us by night and by day; may he heap upon us wealth comprehending offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: अभूद्देवः सविता वन्द्यो नु न इदानीमह्न उपवाच्यो नृभिः । वि यो रत्ना भजति मानवेभ्यः श्रेष्ठं नो अत्र द्रविणं यथा दधत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhūddevaḥ savitā vandyo nu na idānīmahna upavācyo nṛbhiḥ | vi yo ratnā bhajati mānavebhyaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ no atra draviṇaṃ yathā dadhat ||

translations.english: The divine Savitā has been manifested; he is at once to be glorified by us; he is to be praised by the priests at the present (rite), and at the close (of the day), in order that he who apportions precious things to be descendants of Manu may bestow upon us, on this occasion, most excellent wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: देवेभ्यो हि प्रथमं यज्ञियेभ्योऽमृतत्वं सुवसि भागमुत्तमम् । आदिद्दामानं सवितर्व्यूर्णुषेऽनूचीना जीविता मानुषेभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: devebhyo hi prathamaṃ yajñiyebhyo'mṛtatvaṃ suvasi bhāgamuttamam | ādiddāmānaṃ savitarvyūrṇuṣe'nūcīnā jīvitā mānuṣebhyaḥ ||

translations.english: First you engender for the adorable gods the best portion, immortality; then, Savitā, you set open (the day) to the donor (of the oblation), and (grant) successive existences to men.

mantras.sanskrit: अचित्ती यच्चकृमा दैव्ये जने दीनैर्दक्षैः प्रभूती पूरुषत्वता । देवेषु च सवितर्मानुषेषु च त्वं नो अत्र सुवतादनागसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: acittī yaccakṛmā daivye jane dīnairdakṣaiḥ prabhūtī pūruṣatvatā | deveṣu ca savitarmānuṣeṣu ca tvaṃ no atra suvatādanāgasaḥ ||

translations.english: If, Savitā, through ignorance, through pride in feeble or powerful (dependants), or through human infirmity, we have committed (offence) against your divine person n, or against gods or men, do you on this occasion hold us to be unoffending.

mantras.sanskrit: न प्रमिये सवितुर्दैव्यस्य तद्यथा विश्वं भुवनं धारयिष्यति । यत्पृथिव्या वरिमन्ना स्वङ्गुरिर्वर्ष्मन्दिवः सुवति सत्यमस्य तत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: na pramiye saviturdaivyasya tadyathā viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ dhārayiṣyati | yatpṛthivyā varimannā svaṅgurirvarṣmandivaḥ suvati satyamasya tat ||

translations.english: (It is) not (fit) to obstruct (the acts) of the divine Savitā, since by them he upholds the whole world, wheeby his gracious hand spreads fertility over the extent of the earth, and the magnitude of the heaven; such is his true (power).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रज्येष्ठान्बृहद्भ्यः पर्वतेभ्यः क्षयाँ एभ्यः सुवसि पस्त्यावतः । यथायथा पतयन्तो वियेमिर एवैव तस्थुः सवितः सवाय ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrajyeṣṭhānbṛhadbhyaḥ parvatebhyaḥ kṣayā~ ebhyaḥ suvasi pastyāvataḥ | yathāyathā patayanto viyemira evaiva tasthuḥ savitaḥ savāya te ||

translations.english: You elevate those, of whom Indra is chief, above the vast clouds; for these, (your worshippers), you provide dwelling (plural ces) filled in habitations; as when advancing they detained you, so in like manner at your command they stayed.

mantras.sanskrit: ये ते त्रिरहन्त्सवितः सवासो दिवेदिवे सौभगमासुवन्ति । इन्द्रो द्यावापृथिवी सिन्धुरद्भिरादित्यैर्नो अदितिः शर्म यंसत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye te trirahantsavitaḥ savāso divedive saubhagamāsuvanti | indro dyāvāpṛthivī sindhuradbhirādityairno aditiḥ śarma yaṃsat ||

translations.english: May Indra, heaven and earth, Sindhu with the waters, and Aditi with the Ādityas, bestow happiness upon us, who, offering libations, Savitā, pour out the auspicious Soma, day by day, thrice a day.

mantras.sanskrit: को वस्त्राता वसवः को वरूता द्यावाभूमी अदिते त्रासीथां नः । सहीयसो वरुण मित्र मर्तात्को वोऽध्वरे वरिवो धाति देवाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ko vastrātā vasavaḥ ko varūtā dyāvābhūmī adite trāsīthāṃ naḥ | sahīyaso varuṇa mitra martātko vo'dhvare varivo dhāti devāḥ ||

translations.english: Which of you, Vasus, is a defender? Which is a protector? Heaven and earth and Aditi preserve us; defend us, Mitra and Varuṇa, from the strong man; who is it, gods, that offers you wealth at the sacrifice?

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ये धामानि पूर्व्याण्यर्चान्वि यदुच्छान्वियोतारो अमूराः । विधातारो वि ते दधुरजस्रा ऋतधीतयो रुरुचन्त दस्माः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra ye dhāmāni pūrvyāṇyarcānvi yaducchānviyotāro amūrāḥ | vidhātāro vi te dadhurajasrā ṛtadhītayo rurucanta dasmāḥ ||

translations.english: The (deities) who bestow ancient plural ces (of enjoyment on their worshippers), and (with minds) unperplexed, are the separators of light (from darkness); they, the eternal distributors (of rewards), grant (what is desired), and shine of plural asing aspect, the true (recompensers) of pious actṣ

mantras.sanskrit: प्र पस्त्यामदितिं सिन्धुमर्कैः स्वस्तिमीळे सख्याय देवीम् । उभे यथा नो अहनी निपात उषासानक्ता करतामदब्धे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra pastyāmaditiṃ sindhumarkaiḥ svastimīḷe sakhyāya devīm | ubhe yathā no ahanī nipāta uṣāsānaktā karatāmadabdhe ||

translations.english: I adore the venerated Aditi, the Sindhu and the divine Svasti for their friendship; (I praise you) both, Day and Night, that you may protect us unimpeded; night and morning do (what we desire).

mantras.sanskrit: व्यर्यमा वरुणश्चेति पन्थामिषस्पतिः सुवितं गातुमग्निः । इन्द्राविष्णू नृवदु षु स्तवाना शर्म नो यन्तममवद्वरूथम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vyaryamā varuṇaśceti panthāmiṣaspatiḥ suvitaṃ gātumagniḥ | indrāviṣṇū nṛvadu ṣu stavānā śarma no yantamamavadvarūtham ||

translations.english: Aryaman and Varuṇa instrumental uct us in the path (of worship); Agni, the lord of food points out the way to happiness; Indra and Viṣṇu, being glorified, bestow upon us desirable prosperity comprehending descendants and strength.

mantras.sanskrit: आ पर्वतस्य मरुतामवांसि देवस्य त्रातुरव्रि भगस्य । पात्पतिर्जन्यादंहसो नो मित्रो मित्रियादुत न उरुष्येत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā parvatasya marutāmavāṃsi devasya trāturavri bhagasya | pātpatirjanyādaṃhaso no mitro mitriyāduta na uruṣyet ||

translations.english: I have recourse to the protection of Parvata, of the Maruts, and of the divine protector, Bhaga; may the lord (Varuṇa) preserve us from human wretchedness, and may Mitra defend us with a friendly regard.

mantras.sanskrit: नू रोदसी अहिना बुध्न्येन स्तुवीत देवी अप्येभिरिष्टैः । समुद्रं न संचरणे सनिष्यवो घर्मस्वरसो नद्यो अप व्रन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū rodasī ahinā budhnyena stuvīta devī apyebhiriṣṭaiḥ | samudraṃ na saṃcaraṇe saniṣyavo gharmasvaraso nadyo apa vran ||

translations.english: Divine Heaven and Earth, I praise you together with Ahirbudhnya for those (good things that are) desired, as those desirous of acquiring (riches) praise the ocean on traversing it (in which) the sounding rivers disappear.

mantras.sanskrit: देवैर्नो देव्यदितिर्नि पातु देवस्त्राता त्रायतामप्रयुच्छन् । नहि मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धासिमर्हामसि प्रमियं सान्वग्नेः ॥
mantras.transliteration: devairno devyaditirni pātu devastrātā trāyatāmaprayucchan | nahi mitrasya varuṇasya dhāsimarhāmasi pramiyaṃ sānvagneḥ ||

translations.english: May the divine Aditi, with the gods, preserve us; may the ever-attentive protecting (deity, Indra), protect us; we are not able to withhold the elevated (sacrificial) food of Mitra, of Varuṇa, of Agni.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निरीशे वसव्यस्याग्निर्महः सौभगस्य । तान्यस्मभ्यं रासते ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirīśe vasavyasyāgnirmahaḥ saubhagasya | tānyasmabhyaṃ rāsate ||

translations.english: Agni is lord over treasure; Agni (is lord) over great good fortune; may he bestow them upon us.

mantras.sanskrit: उषो मघोन्या वह सूनृते वार्या पुरु । अस्मभ्यं वाजिनीवति ॥
mantras.transliteration: uṣo maghonyā vaha sūnṛte vāryā puru | asmabhyaṃ vājinīvati ||

translations.english: Opulent, Uṣas, truth-speaking, food-abounding, bestow upon us many good things.

mantras.sanskrit: तत्सु नः सविता भगो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । इन्द्रो नो राधसा गमत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tatsu naḥ savitā bhago varuṇo mitro aryamā | indro no rādhasā gamat ||

translations.english: May Savitā, Bhaga, Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman, Indra, come to us with the wealth (that each bestow).

mantras.sanskrit: मही द्यावापृथिवी इह ज्येष्ठे रुचा भवतां शुचयद्भिरर्कैः । यत्सीं वरिष्ठे बृहती विमिन्वन्रुवद्धोक्षा पप्रथानेभिरेवैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahī dyāvāpṛthivī iha jyeṣṭhe rucā bhavatāṃ śucayadbhirarkaiḥ | yatsīṃ variṣṭhe bṛhatī viminvanruvaddhokṣā paprathānebhirevaiḥ ||

translations.english: Vast and most excellent Heaven and Earth, be present with splendour at this (sacrifice, attracted) by sanctifying hymns; since that the showerer sounds everywhere with (his) heralds, the rapid (winds), passing through the two spacious and mighty (regions).

mantras.sanskrit: देवी देवेभिर्यजते यजत्रैरमिनती तस्थतुरुक्षमाणे । ऋतावरी अद्रुहा देवपुत्रे यज्ञस्य नेत्री शुचयद्भिरर्कैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: devī devebhiryajate yajatrairaminatī tasthaturukṣamāṇe | ṛtāvarī adruhā devaputre yajñasya netrī śucayadbhirarkaiḥ ||

translations.english: May the divine, adorable, benevolent, fertilizing, truthful, unoppressive Heaven and Earth, the leaders of sacrifice, whose sons are the gods, be present with the adorable gods, (attracted) by sanctifying hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: स इत्स्वपा भुवनेष्वास य इमे द्यावापृथिवी जजान । उर्वी गभीरे रजसी सुमेके अवंशे धीरः शच्या समैरत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa itsvapā bhuvaneṣvāsa ya ime dyāvāpṛthivī jajāna | urvī gabhīre rajasī sumeke avaṃśe dhīraḥ śacyā samairat ||

translations.english: Verily he was the doer of a good work in the regions, who genitive rated these two, Heaven and Earth, and firm of purpose, gave an impulse by his deed to the two vast immoveable, beautiful, unsupported worlds.

mantras.sanskrit: नू रोदसी बृहद्भिर्नो वरूथैः पत्नीवद्भिरिषयन्ती सजोषाः । उरूची विश्वे यजते नि पातं धिया स्याम रथ्यः सदासाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū rodasī bṛhadbhirno varūthaiḥ patnīvadbhiriṣayantī sajoṣāḥ | urūcī viśve yajate ni pātaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ ||

translations.english: May Heaven and Earth, vast, universal, adorable, united in satisfaction and disposed to give us food, protect us with our spacious dwelings, inhabited by our wives, and may we for our (pious) acts be possessed of chariots and slaves.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वां महि द्यवी अभ्युपस्तुतिं भरामहे । शुची उप प्रशस्तये ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vāṃ mahi dyavī abhyupastutiṃ bharāmahe | śucī upa praśastaye ||

translations.english: We offer earnest praise you both resplendent (Heaven and Earth); we approach you who are pure to offer adoration.

mantras.sanskrit: पुनाने तन्वा मिथः स्वेन दक्षेण राजथः । ऊह्याथे सनादृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: punāne tanvā mithaḥ svena dakṣeṇa rājathaḥ | ūhyāthe sanādṛtam ||

translations.english: Mutually sanctifying (each other) of your own substance you shine by your own power, and ever beat away the offering.

mantras.sanskrit: मही मित्रस्य साधथस्तरन्ती पिप्रती ऋतम् । परि यज्ञं नि षेदथुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahī mitrasya sādhathastarantī pipratī ṛtam | pari yajñaṃ ni ṣedathuḥ ||

translations.english: Mighty (Heaven and Earth), you fulfil the desires of your friend; distributing food and giving sustenance you have sat down at the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: क्षेत्रस्य पतिना वयं हितेनेव जयामसि । गामश्वं पोषयित्न्वा स नो मृळातीदृशे ॥
mantras.transliteration: kṣetrasya patinā vayaṃ hiteneva jayāmasi | gāmaśvaṃ poṣayitnvā sa no mṛḷātīdṛśe ||

translations.english: With the master of the field, our friend, we triumph; may he bestow upon us cattle, horses, nourishment, for by such (gifts) he makes us happy.

mantras.sanskrit: क्षेत्रस्य पते मधुमन्तमूर्मिं धेनुरिव पयो अस्मासु धुक्ष्व । मधुश्चुतं घृतमिव सुपूतमृतस्य नः पतयो मृळयन्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: kṣetrasya pate madhumantamūrmiṃ dhenuriva payo asmāsu dhukṣva | madhuścutaṃ ghṛtamiva supūtamṛtasya naḥ patayo mṛḷayantu ||

translations.english: Lord of the field, bestow upon us sweet abundant, (water), as the cow (yields her) milk, dropping like honey, blend as butter; may the lords of the water make us happy.

mantras.sanskrit: मधुमतीरोषधीर्द्याव आपो मधुमन्नो भवत्वन्तरिक्षम् । क्षेत्रस्य पतिर्मधुमान्नो अस्त्वरिष्यन्तो अन्वेनं चरेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: madhumatīroṣadhīrdyāva āpo madhumanno bhavatvantarikṣam | kṣetrasya patirmadhumānno astvariṣyanto anvenaṃ carema ||

translations.english: May the herbs (of the field) be sweet for us; may the heavens, the waters, the firmament, be kind to us; may the lord of the field be gracious to us; let us, undeterred (by foes), have recourse to him.

mantras.sanskrit: शुनं वाहाः शुनं नरः शुनं कृषतु लाङ्गलम् । शुनं वरत्रा बध्यन्तां शुनमष्ट्रामुदिङ्गय ॥
mantras.transliteration: śunaṃ vāhāḥ śunaṃ naraḥ śunaṃ kṛṣatu lāṅgalam | śunaṃ varatrā badhyantāṃ śunamaṣṭrāmudiṅgaya ||

translations.english: May the oxen (draw) happily, the men (labour) happily; the plural ugh furrows happily; may the traces bind happily; wield the goad happily.

mantras.sanskrit: शुनासीराविमां वाचं जुषेथां यद्दिवि चक्रथुः पयः । तेनेमामुप सिञ्चतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śunāsīrāvimāṃ vācaṃ juṣethāṃ yaddivi cakrathuḥ payaḥ | tenemāmupa siñcatam ||

translations.english: Śuna and Sīra be plural ased by this our praise, and consequently sprinkle this (earth) with the water which you have reated in heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्वाची सुभगे भव सीते वन्दामहे त्वा । यथा नः सुभगाससि यथा नः सुफलाससि ॥
mantras.transliteration: arvācī subhage bhava sīte vandāmahe tvā | yathā naḥ subhagāsasi yathā naḥ suphalāsasi ||

translations.english: Auspicious Sītā, be present, we glorify you; that you may be propitious to us, that you may yield us abundant fruit.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रः सीतां नि गृह्णातु तां पूषानु यच्छतु । सा नः पयस्वती दुहामुत्तरामुत्तरां समाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraḥ sītāṃ ni gṛhṇātu tāṃ pūṣānu yacchatu | sā naḥ payasvatī duhāmuttarāmuttarāṃ samām ||

translations.english: May Indra take hold of Sītā; may Pūṣan guide her; may she, well stored with water, yield it as milk, year after year.

mantras.sanskrit: शुनं नः फाला वि कृषन्तु भूमिं शुनं कीनाशा अभि यन्तु वाहैः । शुनं पर्जन्यो मधुना पयोभिः शुनासीरा शुनमस्मासु धत्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śunaṃ naḥ phālā vi kṛṣantu bhūmiṃ śunaṃ kīnāśā abhi yantu vāhaiḥ | śunaṃ parjanyo madhunā payobhiḥ śunāsīrā śunamasmāsu dhattam ||

translations.english: May the plural ugh shares break up our land happily; may the plural ughman go happily with the oxen; may Parjanya (water the earth) with sweet showers happily; grant, Śuna and Sīra, prosperity to us.

mantras.sanskrit: समुद्रादूर्मिर्मधुमाँ उदारदुपांशुना सममृतत्वमानट् । घृतस्य नाम गुह्यं यदस्ति जिह्वा देवानाममृतस्य नाभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samudrādūrmirmadhumā~ udāradupāṃśunā samamṛtatvamānaṭ | ghṛtasya nāma guhyaṃ yadasti jihvā devānāmamṛtasya nābhiḥ ||

translations.english: The sweet water swells up from the firmament; by the (solar) ray (man) obtains immortality; that which is he secret name of clarified butter is the tongue of the gods, the navel of ambrosia.

mantras.sanskrit: वयं नाम प्र ब्रवामा घृतस्यास्मिन्यज्ञे धारयामा नमोभिः । उप ब्रह्मा शृणवच्छस्यमानं चतुःशृङ्गोऽवमीद्गौर एतत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayaṃ nāma pra bravāmā ghṛtasyāsminyajñe dhārayāmā namobhiḥ | upa brahmā śṛṇavacchasyamānaṃ catuḥśṛṅgo'vamīdgaura etat ||

translations.english: We celebrate the name Ghṛta at this sacrifice, we offer it with adoration; may the four-horned Brahmā listen to its being glorified; the fair-complexioned-deity perfect this rite.

mantras.sanskrit: चत्वारि शृङ्गा त्रयो अस्य पादा द्वे शीर्षे सप्त हस्तासो अस्य । त्रिधा बद्धो वृषभो रोरवीति महो देवो मर्त्याँ आ विवेश ॥
mantras.transliteration: catvāri śṛṅgā trayo asya pādā dve śīrṣe sapta hastāso asya | tridhā baddho vṛṣabho roravīti maho devo martyā~ ā viveśa ||

translations.english: Four are his horns; three are his feet; his heads are two, his hands are seven; the triple-bound showerer (of benefits) roars aloud; the mighty deity has entered among men.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिधा हितं पणिभिर्गुह्यमानं गवि देवासो घृतमन्वविन्दन् । इन्द्र एकं सूर्य एकं जजान वेनादेकं स्वधया निष्टतक्षुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tridhā hitaṃ paṇibhirguhyamānaṃ gavi devāso ghṛtamanvavindan | indra ekaṃ sūrya ekaṃ jajāna venādekaṃ svadhayā niṣṭatakṣuḥ ||

translations.english: The gods discovered the Ghī concealed by the Paṇis, plural ced three-fold in the cow; Indra genitive rated one (portion), Sūrya another, the (other gods) fabricated one from the resplendent (Agni), for the sake of the oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: एता अर्षन्ति हृद्यात्समुद्राच्छतव्रजा रिपुणा नावचक्षे । घृतस्य धारा अभि चाकशीमि हिरण्ययो वेतसो मध्य आसाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: etā arṣanti hṛdyātsamudrācchatavrajā ripuṇā nāvacakṣe | ghṛtasya dhārā abhi cākaśīmi hiraṇyayo vetaso madhya āsām ||

translations.english: These hundred-channeled showers fall from the heart-delighting firmament, unobserved by the hostile (cloud); I look upon these showers of Ghī, (and behold) the golden Vetasa in the midst of them.

mantras.sanskrit: सम्यक्स्रवन्ति सरितो न धेना अन्तर्हृदा मनसा पूयमानाः । एते अर्षन्त्यूर्मयो घृतस्य मृगा इव क्षिपणोरीषमाणाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samyaksravanti sarito na dhenā antarhṛdā manasā pūyamānāḥ | ete arṣantyūrmayo ghṛtasya mṛgā iva kṣipaṇorīṣamāṇāḥ ||

translations.english: They flow uninterruptedly like plural asing rivers, purified by the mind that is seated in the heart; these streams of Ghī descend (upon the fire), like deer flying from the hunter.

mantras.sanskrit: सिन्धोरिव प्राध्वने शूघनासो वातप्रमियः पतयन्ति यह्वाः । घृतस्य धारा अरुषो न वाजी काष्ठा भिन्दन्नूर्मिभिः पिन्वमानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sindhoriva prādhvane śūghanāso vātapramiyaḥ patayanti yahvāḥ | ghṛtasya dhārā aruṣo na vājī kāṣṭhā bhindannūrmibhiḥ pinvamānaḥ ||

translations.english: The stream of Ghī fall copious, swift as the wind, and rapid as the waters of a river down a declivity, breaking through the confining banks, and hurrying on with their waves, like a high-spirited steed.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि प्रवन्त समनेव योषाः कल्याण्यः स्मयमानासो अग्निम् । घृतस्य धाराः समिधो नसन्त ता जुषाणो हर्यति जातवेदाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi pravanta samaneva yoṣāḥ kalyāṇyaḥ smayamānāso agnim | ghṛtasya dhārāḥ samidho nasanta tā juṣāṇo haryati jātavedāḥ ||

translations.english: The streams of Ghī incline to Agni as devoted wives, auspicious and smiling, to a husband; they feed (the flame) like fuel, and Jātavedas, propitiated, accepts them.
