mantras.sanskrit: कन्या इव वहतुमेतवा उ अञ्ज्यञ्जाना अभि चाकशीमि । यत्र सोमः सूयते यत्र यज्ञो घृतस्य धारा अभि तत्पवन्ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: kanyā iva vahatumetavā u añjyañjānā abhi cākaśīmi | yatra somaḥ sūyate yatra yajño ghṛtasya dhārā abhi tatpavante ||

translations.english: I contemplate these streams of Ghī as they flow from where the Soma is effused, where the sacrifice (is solemnized), as maidens decorating themselves with unguents to go to the bridegroom.

mantras.sanskrit: अभ्यर्षत सुष्टुतिं गव्यमाजिमस्मासु भद्रा द्रविणानि धत्त । इमं यज्ञं नयत देवता नो घृतस्य धारा मधुमत्पवन्ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhyarṣata suṣṭutiṃ gavyamājimasmāsu bhadrā draviṇāni dhatta | imaṃ yajñaṃ nayata devatā no ghṛtasya dhārā madhumatpavante ||

translations.english: (Priests) address the pious praise, (the source) of herds of cattle; bestow upon us auspicious riches; convey this our sacrifice to the gods, (where at) the streams of Ghī with sweetness descend.

mantras.sanskrit: धामन्ते विश्वं भुवनमधि श्रितमन्तः समुद्रे हृद्यन्तरायुषि । अपामनीके समिथे य आभृतस्तमश्याम मधुमन्तं त ऊर्मिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhāmante viśvaṃ bhuvanamadhi śritamantaḥ samudre hṛdyantarāyuṣi | apāmanīke samithe ya ābhṛtastamaśyāma madhumantaṃ ta ūrmim ||

translations.english: The whole world, (Agni), finds an asylum in your effulgence, whether it be in the ocean, in the heart (of man), in the life (of living beings), in the assemblage of the waters, or in warfare; may we attain the sweet-flavoured wave which is established in your (essence).

mantras.sanskrit: अबोध्यग्निः समिधा जनानां प्रति धेनुमिवायतीमुषासम् । यह्वा इव प्र वयामुज्जिहानाः प्र भानवः सिस्रते नाकमच्छ ॥
mantras.transliteration: abodhyagniḥ samidhā janānāṃ prati dhenumivāyatīmuṣāsam | yahvā iva pra vayāmujjihānāḥ pra bhānavaḥ sisrate nākamaccha ||

translations.english: Agni is awakened by the fuel (supplied) by the priests at the dawn, approaching like a cow (to pasture); his flames rise up to the sky like stately (trees) throwing aloft their branches.

mantras.sanskrit: अबोधि होता यजथाय देवानूर्ध्वो अग्निः सुमनाः प्रातरस्थात् । समिद्धस्य रुशददर्शि पाजो महान्देवस्तमसो निरमोचि ॥
mantras.transliteration: abodhi hotā yajathāya devānūrdhvo agniḥ sumanāḥ prātarasthāt | samiddhasya ruśadadarśi pājo mahāndevastamaso niramoci ||

translations.english: The offer of the oblation is awakened for the worship of the gods; favourably minded, Agni has rise up with the dawn; the radiant vigour of the kindled (fire) is manifested; the great deity has been liberated from the darkness.

mantras.sanskrit: यदीं गणस्य रशनामजीगः शुचिरङ्क्ते शुचिभिर्गोभिरग्निः । आद्दक्षिणा युज्यते वाजयन्त्युत्तानामूर्ध्वो अधयज्जुहूभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadīṃ gaṇasya raśanāmajīgaḥ śuciraṅkte śucibhirgobhiragniḥ | āddakṣiṇā yujyate vājayantyuttānāmūrdhvo adhayajjuhūbhiḥ ||

translations.english: When Agni has seized upon the (confining) girdle of the aggregated (world), then, bright-shining, he makes all manifest with brilliant rays; thereupon the precious food-desiring (oblations) is added (to the flame), and Agni, soaring aloft, drinks it as it is (spread out) recumbent by the ladles.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निमच्छा देवयतां मनांसि चक्षूंषीव सूर्ये सं चरन्ति । यदीं सुवाते उषसा विरूपे श्वेतो वाजी जायते अग्रे अह्नाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnimacchā devayatāṃ manāṃsi cakṣūṃṣīva sūrye saṃ caranti | yadīṃ suvāte uṣasā virūpe śveto vājī jāyate agre ahnām ||

translations.english: The minds of the devout turn to Agni, as the eyes (of men) look towards the sun; when the multiform (heaven and earth) bring him forth along with the dawn, he is born as a white courser in the beginning of the days.

mantras.sanskrit: जनिष्ट हि जेन्यो अग्रे अह्नां हितो हितेष्वरुषो वनेषु । दमेदमे सप्त रत्ना दधानोऽग्निर्होता नि षसादा यजीयान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: janiṣṭa hi jenyo agre ahnāṃ hito hiteṣvaruṣo vaneṣu | damedame sapta ratnā dadhāno'gnirhotā ni ṣasādā yajīyān ||

translations.english: (Agni), capable of birth, is born in the beginning of the days; radiant, he is deposited in the friendly woods, and then the adorable Agni, the offerer of the oblation, displaying seven precious (rays), is seated in every house.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निर्होता न्यसीदद्यजीयानुपस्थे मातुः सुरभा उ लोके । युवा कविः पुरुनिष्ठ ऋतावा धर्ता कृष्टीनामुत मध्य इद्धः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirhotā nyasīdadyajīyānupasthe mātuḥ surabhā u loke | yuvā kaviḥ puruniṣṭha ṛtāvā dhartā kṛṣṭīnāmuta madhya iddhaḥ ||

translations.english: The adorable Agni, the offerer of the oblation, has sat down in a fragrant plural ce on the top of his mother (earth); youthful, wise, many-stationed, the celebrator of sacrifice, the sustainer (of all), kindled (he abides) among men.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र णु त्यं विप्रमध्वरेषु साधुमग्निं होतारमीळते नमोभिः । आ यस्ततान रोदसी ऋतेन नित्यं मृजन्ति वाजिनं घृतेन ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra ṇu tyaṃ vipramadhvareṣu sādhumagniṃ hotāramīḷate namobhiḥ | ā yastatāna rodasī ṛtena nityaṃ mṛjanti vājinaṃ ghṛtena ||

translations.english: They glorify at present withhymns that Agni who is intelligent, the fulfiller (of desires) at sacrifices, the offer of oblations, who has charged heaven and earth with water, and whom they always worship with clarified butter as the bestower of food.

mantras.sanskrit: मार्जाल्यो मृज्यते स्वे दमूनाः कविप्रशस्तो अतिथिः शिवो नः । सहस्रशृङ्गो वृषभस्तदोजा विश्वाँ अग्ने सहसा प्रास्यन्यान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mārjālyo mṛjyate sve damūnāḥ kavipraśasto atithiḥ śivo naḥ | sahasraśṛṅgo vṛṣabhastadojā viśvā~ agne sahasā prāsyanyān ||

translations.english: Entitled to worship, he is worshipped in his own (abode); humble-minded, eminent among sages, our auspicious guest, the thousand-rayed, the showerer (of benefits), of well-known might, you, Agni, surpass all others in strength.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सद्यो अग्ने अत्येष्यन्यानाविर्यस्मै चारुतमो बभूथ । ईळेन्यो वपुष्यो विभावा प्रियो विशामतिथिर्मानुषीणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra sadyo agne atyeṣyanyānāviryasmai cārutamo babhūtha | īḷenyo vapuṣyo vibhāvā priyo viśāmatithirmānuṣīṇām ||

translations.english: (Too) quickly, Agni, do you pass to others from him to whom you have been manifest; most beautiful, adorable, radiant, many-shining, the loved of people, the guest of men.

mantras.sanskrit: तुभ्यं भरन्ति क्षितयो यविष्ठ बलिमग्ने अन्तित ओत दूरात् । आ भन्दिष्ठस्य सुमतिं चिकिद्धि बृहत्ते अग्ने महि शर्म भद्रम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tubhyaṃ bharanti kṣitayo yaviṣṭha balimagne antita ota dūrāt | ā bhandiṣṭhasya sumatiṃ cikiddhi bṛhatte agne mahi śarma bhadram ||

translations.english: To you, young (of the gods), men present oblations, whether nigh or from far; accept the praise of him who most extols you; for the felicity (which you confer). Agni is great, vast, auspicious.

mantras.sanskrit: आद्य रथं भानुमो भानुमन्तमग्ने तिष्ठ यजतेभिः समन्तम् । विद्वान्पथीनामुर्वन्तरिक्षमेह देवान्हविरद्याय वक्षि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ādya rathaṃ bhānumo bhānumantamagne tiṣṭha yajatebhiḥ samantam | vidvānpathīnāmurvantarikṣameha devānhaviradyāya vakṣi ||

translations.english: Ascend today, radiant Agni, your resplendent, well-conducted chariot, together with the adorable (gods), cognizant of the ways (of worship), bring hither, by the vast firmament, the gods to partake of the oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: अवोचाम कवये मेध्याय वचो वन्दारु वृषभाय वृष्णे । गविष्ठिरो नमसा स्तोममग्नौ दिवीव रुक्ममुरुव्यञ्चमश्रेत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: avocāma kavaye medhyāya vaco vandāru vṛṣabhāya vṛṣṇe | gaviṣṭhiro namasā stomamagnau divīva rukmamuruvyañcamaśret ||

translations.english: We have uttered aloud this encomiastic praise to the wise, holy, vigorous (Agni), the showerer (of benefits); Gaviṣṭhira offers with reverence (this) praise to Agni like the wide-sojourning (sun), effulgent in the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: कुमारं माता युवतिः समुब्धं गुहा बिभर्ति न ददाति पित्रे । अनीकमस्य न मिनज्जनासः पुरः पश्यन्ति निहितमरतौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: kumāraṃ mātā yuvatiḥ samubdhaṃ guhā bibharti na dadāti pitre | anīkamasya na minajjanāsaḥ puraḥ paśyanti nihitamaratau ||

translations.english: The young mother cherishes her mutilated boy in secret, and gives him not up to the father; men behold not his mutilated form, but (see him) when plural ced before (them) in an unresting (position).

mantras.sanskrit: कमेतं त्वं युवते कुमारं पेषी बिभर्षि महिषी जजान । पूर्वीर्हि गर्भः शरदो ववर्धापश्यं जातं यदसूत माता ॥
mantras.transliteration: kametaṃ tvaṃ yuvate kumāraṃ peṣī bibharṣi mahiṣī jajāna | pūrvīrhi garbhaḥ śarado vavardhāpaśyaṃ jātaṃ yadasūta mātā ||

translations.english: Young mother, what boy is this whom you, (become) a malevolent spirit, foster? The mighty (queen) has given him birth; the embryo has thrived through many years; I have seen him born as the mother brought him forth.

mantras.sanskrit: हिरण्यदन्तं शुचिवर्णमारात्क्षेत्रादपश्यमायुधा मिमानम् । ददानो अस्मा अमृतं विपृक्वत्किं मामनिन्द्राः कृणवन्ननुक्थाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: hiraṇyadantaṃ śucivarṇamārātkṣetrādapaśyamāyudhā mimānam | dadāno asmā amṛtaṃ vipṛkvatkiṃ māmanindrāḥ kṛṇavannanukthāḥ ||

translations.english: I have seen him from a near plural ce, golden-toothed, bright-coloured, wielding (flames like) weapons, (when) offering to him the ambrosial, all-diffusing (oblation); what can those who acknowledge not Indra, who repeat not his praise, do unto me.

mantras.sanskrit: क्षेत्रादपश्यं सनुतश्चरन्तं सुमद्यूथं न पुरु शोभमानम् । न ता अगृभ्रन्नजनिष्ट हि षः पलिक्नीरिद्युवतयो भवन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: kṣetrādapaśyaṃ sanutaścarantaṃ sumadyūthaṃ na puru śobhamānam | na tā agṛbhrannajaniṣṭa hi ṣaḥ paliknīridyuvatayo bhavanti ||

translations.english: I have seen him passing secretly from plural ce (to plural ce) like a herd (of cattle), shining brightly of his own accord; they apprehended not those (flames of his), but he has (again) been born, and they who had become grey-haired are (once more) young.

mantras.sanskrit: के मे मर्यकं वि यवन्त गोभिर्न येषां गोपा अरणश्चिदास । य ईं जगृभुरव ते सृजन्त्वाजाति पश्व उप नश्चिकित्वान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ke me maryakaṃ vi yavanta gobhirna yeṣāṃ gopā araṇaścidāsa | ya īṃ jagṛbhurava te sṛjantvājāti paśva upa naścikitvān ||

translations.english: Who have disunited my people from the cattle? was there not for them an invincible protector? may they who have seized upon that (people) perish, for he who knows (our wishes) approaches to (protect) the cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: वसां राजानं वसतिं जनानामरातयो नि दधुर्मर्त्येषु । ब्रह्माण्यत्रेरव तं सृजन्तु निन्दितारो निन्द्यासो भवन्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: vasāṃ rājānaṃ vasatiṃ janānāmarātayo ni dadhurmartyeṣu | brahmāṇyatrerava taṃ sṛjantu ninditāro nindyāso bhavantu ||

translations.english: Enemies have secreted amongmortals, the king of living beings, the asylum of men; may the prayers of Atri set him free; may those who revile be reviled.

mantras.sanskrit: शुनश्चिच्छेपं निदितं सहस्राद्यूपादमुञ्चो अशमिष्ट हि षः । एवास्मदग्ने वि मुमुग्धि पाशान्होतश्चिकित्व इह तू निषद्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: śunaścicchepaṃ niditaṃ sahasrādyūpādamuñco aśamiṣṭa hi ṣaḥ | evāsmadagne vi mumugdhi pāśānhotaścikitva iha tū niṣadya ||

translations.english: You have liberated the fettered Śunahśepa from a thousand stakes, for he was patient in endurance; so Agni, free us from our bonds, having sat down here (at our sacrifice), intelligent offerer of oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: हृणीयमानो अप हि मदैयेः प्र मे देवानां व्रतपा उवाच । इन्द्रो विद्वाँ अनु हि त्वा चचक्ष तेनाहमग्ने अनुशिष्ट आगाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: hṛṇīyamāno apa hi madaiyeḥ pra me devānāṃ vratapā uvāca | indro vidvā~ anu hi tvā cacakṣa tenāhamagne anuśiṣṭa āgām ||

translations.english: When angered, (Agni), depart from me; the protector of the worship of the gods, (Indra), has spoken to me; the wise Indra has looked upon you, and instrumental ucted by him, I have come, Agni, to you.

mantras.sanskrit: वि ज्योतिषा बृहता भात्यग्निराविर्विश्वानि कृणुते महित्वा । प्रादेवीर्मायाः सहते दुरेवाः शिशीते शृङ्गे रक्षसे विनिक्षे ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi jyotiṣā bṛhatā bhātyagnirāvirviśvāni kṛṇute mahitvā | prādevīrmāyāḥ sahate durevāḥ śiśīte śṛṅge rakṣase vinikṣe ||

translations.english: Agni, shines with great and varied radiance; he makes all things manifest by his might; he overcomes undivine malignant delusions; he sharpens his horns for the destruction of the rākṣasas.

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्वानासो दिवि षन्त्वग्नेस्तिग्मायुधा रक्षसे हन्तवा उ । मदे चिदस्य प्र रुजन्ति भामा न वरन्ते परिबाधो अदेवीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta svānāso divi ṣantvagnestigmāyudhā rakṣase hantavā u | made cidasya pra rujanti bhāmā na varante paribādho adevīḥ ||

translations.english: My roaring (flames), Agni, be manifest in the sky as sharp weapons wherewith to slay the rākṣasas; in his exhilaration his shining (rays) inflict (destruction), and undivine opposing (hosts) arrest him not.

mantras.sanskrit: एतं ते स्तोमं तुविजात विप्रो रथं न धीरः स्वपा अतक्षम् । यदीदग्ने प्रति त्वं देव हर्याः स्वर्वतीरप एना जयेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: etaṃ te stomaṃ tuvijāta vipro rathaṃ na dhīraḥ svapā atakṣam | yadīdagne prati tvaṃ deva haryāḥ svarvatīrapa enā jayema ||

translations.english: This praise have I, a devout worshipper, composed for you, (Agni), who are born with many (faculties), as a steady dexterous (artisan fabricates) a car; if, divine Agni, you approve of it, then may we obtain abundant flowing water.

mantras.sanskrit: तुविग्रीवो वृषभो वावृधानोऽशत्र्वर्यः समजाति वेदः । इतीममग्निममृता अवोचन्बर्हिष्मते मनवे शर्म यंसद्धविष्मते मनवे शर्म यंसत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tuvigrīvo vṛṣabho vāvṛdhāno'śatrvaryaḥ samajāti vedaḥ | itīmamagnimamṛtā avocanbarhiṣmate manave śarma yaṃsaddhaviṣmate manave śarma yaṃsat ||

translations.english: The many-necked, the showerer (of benefits), ever increasing, collects together the wealth of the enemy without opposition; the immortals have enjoined Agni that he will bestow happiness on the man who offers sacrifice; that he will bestow happiness on the man who offers oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने वरुणो जायसे यत्त्वं मित्रो भवसि यत्समिद्धः । त्वे विश्वे सहसस्पुत्र देवास्त्वमिन्द्रो दाशुषे मर्त्याय ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne varuṇo jāyase yattvaṃ mitro bhavasi yatsamiddhaḥ | tve viśve sahasasputra devāstvamindro dāśuṣe martyāya ||

translations.english: You, Agni, are born Varuṇa, you become Mitra when kindled; in you, son of strength, are all the gods; you are Indra, son of strength, to the mortal who presents (oblations).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमर्यमा भवसि यत्कनीनां नाम स्वधावन्गुह्यं बिभर्षि । अञ्जन्ति मित्रं सुधितं न गोभिर्यद्दम्पती समनसा कृणोषि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamaryamā bhavasi yatkanīnāṃ nāma svadhāvanguhyaṃ bibharṣi | añjanti mitraṃ sudhitaṃ na gobhiryaddampatī samanasā kṛṇoṣi ||

translations.english: You are Aryaman in relation to maidens; you bear, enjoy of sacrificial food, a mysterious name; they anoint you, like a welcome friend, with milk and butter, when you make husband and wife of one mind.

mantras.sanskrit: तव श्रिये मरुतो मर्जयन्त रुद्र यत्ते जनिम चारु चित्रम् । पदं यद्विष्णोरुपमं निधायि तेन पासि गुह्यं नाम गोनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava śriye maruto marjayanta rudra yatte janima cāru citram | padaṃ yadviṣṇorupamaṃ nidhāyi tena pāsi guhyaṃ nāma gonām ||

translations.english: For your glory the Maruts sweep (the firmament), when your birth, Rudra, is beautiful and wonderful; the middle step of Viṣṇu has been plural ced, so you cherish the mysterious name of the waters.

mantras.sanskrit: तव श्रिया सुदृशो देव देवाः पुरू दधाना अमृतं सपन्त । होतारमग्निं मनुषो नि षेदुर्दशस्यन्त उशिजः शंसमायोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava śriyā sudṛśo deva devāḥ purū dadhānā amṛtaṃ sapanta | hotāramagniṃ manuṣo ni ṣedurdaśasyanta uśijaḥ śaṃsamāyoḥ ||

translations.english: Divine (Agni), gods, (made) comely by your glory, and bearing (the) great (affection), sip the ambrosia; men adore Agni, the conveyer of theburnt-offering, presenting oblations on behalfof the instrumental tutor of the rite, desirous of (its) reward.

mantras.sanskrit: न त्वद्धोता पूर्वो अग्ने यजीयान्न काव्यैः परो अस्ति स्वधावः । विशश्च यस्या अतिथिर्भवासि स यज्ञेन वनवद्देव मर्तान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: na tvaddhotā pūrvo agne yajīyānna kāvyaiḥ paro asti svadhāvaḥ | viśaśca yasyā atithirbhavāsi sa yajñena vanavaddeva martān ||

translations.english: There is no more venerable offerer of oblation, Agni, than you, nor (one) prior to you; neither, giver of food, is any one subsequent (tobe more glorified by hymns); the man of whom you are the guest destroys hostile men by sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: वयमग्ने वनुयाम त्वोता वसूयवो हविषा बुध्यमानाः । वयं समर्ये विदथेष्वह्नां वयं राया सहसस्पुत्र मर्तान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayamagne vanuyāma tvotā vasūyavo haviṣā budhyamānāḥ | vayaṃ samarye vidatheṣvahnāṃ vayaṃ rāyā sahasasputra martān ||

translations.english: May we, desirous of wealth, Agni,and arousing you by oblations, secure in your protection, acquire (riches); may we (be victorious) in battle, (successful) in sacrifices every day; and may we, son of strength, obtain with riches male (descendants).

mantras.sanskrit: यो न आगो अभ्येनो भरात्यधीदघमघशंसे दधात । जही चिकित्वो अभिशस्तिमेतामग्ने यो नो मर्चयति द्वयेन ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo na āgo abhyeno bharātyadhīdaghamaghaśaṃse dadhāta | jahī cikitvo abhiśastimetāmagne yo no marcayati dvayena ||

translations.english: May Agni inflict (evil) upon the evil-doer, who commits offence, or wickedness against us; destroy, sagacious Agni, the calumniator who injures us in these two ways.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामस्या व्युषि देव पूर्वे दूतं कृण्वाना अयजन्त हव्यैः । संस्थे यदग्न ईयसे रयीणां देवो मर्तैर्वसुभिरिध्यमानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmasyā vyuṣi deva pūrve dūtaṃ kṛṇvānā ayajanta havyaiḥ | saṃsthe yadagna īyase rayīṇāṃ devo martairvasubhiridhyamānaḥ ||

translations.english: Former (worshippers) constituting you, divine (Agni), the messenger (of the gods), have worshipped you with oblations at the dawn of day; when you proceed to the plural ce (of the aggregation) of the wealth (of sacrifice), bright-shining, kindled by the mortals who have given you an abode.

mantras.sanskrit: अव स्पृधि पितरं योधि विद्वान्पुत्रो यस्ते सहसः सून ऊहे । कदा चिकित्वो अभि चक्षसे नोऽग्ने कदाँ ऋतचिद्यातयासे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ava spṛdhi pitaraṃ yodhi vidvānputro yaste sahasaḥ sūna ūhe | kadā cikitvo abhi cakṣase no'gne kadā~ ṛtacidyātayāse ||

translations.english: Convey him (to safety) in war, son of strength, who like a wise son offers to you (reverence) as to a father; when, sagacious Agni do you look upon us; when, director of sacrifice, do you direct us (to good ways).

mantras.sanskrit: भूरि नाम वन्दमानो दधाति पिता वसो यदि तज्जोषयासे । कुविद्देवस्य सहसा चकानः सुम्नमग्निर्वनते वावृधानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhūri nāma vandamāno dadhāti pitā vaso yadi tajjoṣayāse | kuviddevasya sahasā cakānaḥ sumnamagnirvanate vāvṛdhānaḥ ||

translations.english: Glorifying you, he offers the copious oblation, if, bestower of dwellings, you as a father are plural ased to accept it; Agni, ever augmenting, and desirous (to be friend), by hismight, the devout (worshipper, offering) copious oblations, bestows upon him happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमङ्ग जरितारं यविष्ठ विश्वान्यग्ने दुरिताति पर्षि । स्तेना अदृश्रन्रिपवो जनासोऽज्ञातकेता वृजिना अभूवन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamaṅga jaritāraṃ yaviṣṭha viśvānyagne duritāti parṣi | stenā adṛśranripavo janāso'jñātaketā vṛjinā abhūvan ||

translations.english: Agni, young (of the gods), verily you bear your adorer (safe) beyond all calamities; thieves have been detected, and hostile men with cover evil intentions, have been avoided (by us).

mantras.sanskrit: इमे यामासस्त्वद्रिगभूवन्वसवे वा तदिदागो अवाचि । नाहायमग्निरभिशस्तये नो न रीषते वावृधानः परा दात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ime yāmāsastvadrigabhūvanvasave vā tadidāgo avāci | nāhāyamagnirabhiśastaye no na rīṣate vāvṛdhānaḥ parā dāt ||

translations.english: These (encomiums) are directed towards you, but perhaps an offence has thereby been uttered to (you), the giver of dwellings;may Agni,augmenting (by our praise), yield us not up to the maligner or the malevolent.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने वसुपतिं वसूनामभि प्र मन्दे अध्वरेषु राजन् । त्वया वाजं वाजयन्तो जयेमाभि ष्याम पृत्सुतीर्मर्त्यानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmagne vasupatiṃ vasūnāmabhi pra mande adhvareṣu rājan | tvayā vājaṃ vājayanto jayemābhi ṣyāma pṛtsutīrmartyānām ||

translations.english: Royal Agni, I glorify at sacrifices you who are the lord of vast riches; may we who are in want of food obtain food through you, and (through you) may we overcome hosts of (hostile) men.

mantras.sanskrit: हव्यवाळग्निरजरः पिता नो विभुर्विभावा सुदृशीको अस्मे । सुगार्हपत्याः समिषो दिदीह्यस्मद्र्यक्सं मिमीहि श्रवांसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: havyavāḷagnirajaraḥ pitā no vibhurvibhāvā sudṛśīko asme | sugārhapatyāḥ samiṣo didīhyasmadryaksaṃ mimīhi śravāṃsi ||

translations.english: May the undecaying Agni, the bearer of oblations, be a father to us, all-pervading and resplendent (may he be) to us of plural asing aspect; supply us plural ntifully with food in return for our well-maintained household fire grant us viand abundantly.

mantras.sanskrit: विशां कविं विश्पतिं मानुषीणां शुचिं पावकं घृतपृष्ठमग्निम् । नि होतारं विश्वविदं दधिध्वे स देवेषु वनते वार्याणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśāṃ kaviṃ viśpatiṃ mānuṣīṇāṃ śuciṃ pāvakaṃ ghṛtapṛṣṭhamagnim | ni hotāraṃ viśvavidaṃ dadhidhve sa deveṣu vanate vāryāṇi ||

translations.english: You (priests) possess the wise lord of human beings, the pure, the purifying, Agni, cherished with oblations of butter, the offer of the burnt-offering, the all-knowing; he among the gods bestows desirable (riches).

mantras.sanskrit: जुषस्वाग्न इळया सजोषा यतमानो रश्मिभिः सूर्यस्य । जुषस्व नः समिधं जातवेद आ च देवान्हविरद्याय वक्षि ॥
mantras.transliteration: juṣasvāgna iḷayā sajoṣā yatamāno raśmibhiḥ sūryasya | juṣasva naḥ samidhaṃ jātaveda ā ca devānhaviradyāya vakṣi ||

translations.english: Be propitiated, Agni, sharing in satisfaction with Iḷā, viewing with the rays of the sun; be gratified, Jātavedas, by our fuel, and bring the gods to partake of the oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: जुष्टो दमूना अतिथिर्दुरोण इमं नो यज्ञमुप याहि विद्वान् । विश्वा अग्ने अभियुजो विहत्या शत्रूयतामा भरा भोजनानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: juṣṭo damūnā atithirduroṇa imaṃ no yajñamupa yāhi vidvān | viśvā agne abhiyujo vihatyā śatrūyatāmā bharā bhojanāni ||

translations.english: Proppitiated, lowly-minded, a guest in the dwelling, come, you who are wise, to this our sacrifice; having destroyed Agni, all our adversaries, bring off the possessions of those who bear us enmity.

mantras.sanskrit: वधेन दस्युं प्र हि चातयस्व वयः कृण्वानस्तन्वे स्वायै । पिपर्षि यत्सहसस्पुत्र देवान्त्सो अग्ने पाहि नृतम वाजे अस्मान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vadhena dasyuṃ pra hi cātayasva vayaḥ kṛṇvānastanve svāyai | piparṣi yatsahasasputra devāntso agne pāhi nṛtama vāje asmān ||

translations.english: Demolish, Agni, with your weapon, the Dasyu, appropriating the sustenance to your own person n; and inasmuch, son of strength, as you satisfy the gods, so do you, Agni, chief of leaders, protect us in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: वयं ते अग्न उक्थैर्विधेम वयं हव्यैः पावक भद्रशोचे । अस्मे रयिं विश्ववारं समिन्वास्मे विश्वानि द्रविणानि धेहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayaṃ te agna ukthairvidhema vayaṃ havyaiḥ pāvaka bhadraśoce | asme rayiṃ viśvavāraṃ saminvāsme viśvāni draviṇāni dhehi ||

translations.english: We worship you, Agni, with hymns; we (worship you), purifier, and of auspicious lustre, with oblations; bestow upon us all desired riches; bestow upon us all sorts of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्माकमग्ने अध्वरं जुषस्व सहसः सूनो त्रिषधस्थ हव्यम् । वयं देवेषु सुकृतः स्याम शर्मणा नस्त्रिवरूथेन पाहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmākamagne adhvaraṃ juṣasva sahasaḥ sūno triṣadhastha havyam | vayaṃ deveṣu sukṛtaḥ syāma śarmaṇā nastrivarūthena pāhi ||

translations.english: Accept, Agni, our sacrifice; son of strength, the abider in the three regions, (accept our) oblation; may we be (regarded) among the goddess doers of good; cherish us with triply-protected felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वानि नो दुर्गहा जातवेदः सिन्धुं न नावा दुरिताति पर्षि । अग्ने अत्रिवन्नमसा गृणानोऽस्माकं बोध्यविता तनूनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvāni no durgahā jātavedaḥ sindhuṃ na nāvā duritāti parṣi | agne atrivannamasā gṛṇāno'smākaṃ bodhyavitā tanūnām ||

translations.english: You convey us, Jātavedas, across all intolerable evils, as (people are carried) over a river by a boat; Agni, who are glorified by us with reverence, such as (that shown) by Atri, know yourself the protector of our person ns.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्त्वा हृदा कीरिणा मन्यमानोऽमर्त्यं मर्त्यो जोहवीमि । जातवेदो यशो अस्मासु धेहि प्रजाभिरग्ने अमृतत्वमश्याम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yastvā hṛdā kīriṇā manyamāno'martyaṃ martyo johavīmi | jātavedo yaśo asmāsu dhehi prajābhiragne amṛtatvamaśyām ||

translations.english: Inasmuch as I who am a mortal earnestly invoke you who are an immortal, praising you with a devoted heart; therefore, Jātavedas, grant us food, and may I obtain immortality through my posterity.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्मै त्वं सुकृते जातवेद उ लोकमग्ने कृणवः स्योनम् । अश्विनं स पुत्रिणं वीरवन्तं गोमन्तं रयिं नशते स्वस्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasmai tvaṃ sukṛte jātaveda u lokamagne kṛṇavaḥ syonam | aśvinaṃ sa putriṇaṃ vīravantaṃ gomantaṃ rayiṃ naśate svasti ||

translations.english: Upon whatsoever performer of good works you, Agni, who are Jātavedas, cast a favourable regard, he enjoys welfare, and riches, comprehending horses, cattle, sons and male descendants.

mantras.sanskrit: सुसमिद्धाय शोचिषे घृतं तीव्रं जुहोतन । अग्नये जातवेदसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: susamiddhāya śociṣe ghṛtaṃ tīvraṃ juhotana | agnaye jātavedase ||

translations.english: Offer abundant butter to the replendent Susamiddha, to Agni, to Jātavedas.

mantras.sanskrit: नराशंसः सुषूदतीमं यज्ञमदाभ्यः । कविर्हि मधुहस्त्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: narāśaṃsaḥ suṣūdatīmaṃ yajñamadābhyaḥ | kavirhi madhuhastyaḥ ||

translations.english: Narāśaṃsa animates this sacrifice he who is uninjurable, who verily is wise and sweet-handed.

mantras.sanskrit: ईळितो अग्न आ वहेन्द्रं चित्रमिह प्रियम् । सुखै रथेभिरूतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: īḷito agna ā vahendraṃ citramiha priyam | sukhai rathebhirūtaye ||

translations.english: Agno, who are Īḷita, bring hither the wonderful and friendly Indra, with his easy going chariots for our protection.

mantras.sanskrit: ऊर्णम्रदा वि प्रथस्वाभ्यर्का अनूषत । भवा नः शुभ्र सातये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūrṇamradā vi prathasvābhyarkā anūṣata | bhavā naḥ śubhra sātaye ||

translations.english: (Grass), soft as wool, be spread; the worshippers praise you; be to us radiant (grass the source of) liberality.

mantras.sanskrit: देवीर्द्वारो वि श्रयध्वं सुप्रायणा न ऊतये । प्रप्र यज्ञं पृणीतन ॥
mantras.transliteration: devīrdvāro vi śrayadhvaṃ suprāyaṇā na ūtaye | prapra yajñaṃ pṛṇītana ||

translations.english: Open divine doors, our passages to preservation; fill full the sacrifice (with its rewards).

mantras.sanskrit: सुप्रतीके वयोवृधा यह्वी ऋतस्य मातरा । दोषामुषासमीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: supratīke vayovṛdhā yahvī ṛtasya mātarā | doṣāmuṣāsamīmahe ||

translations.english: We glorify the evening and the morning lovely, food-bestowing, mighty, the mothers of sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: वातस्य पत्मन्नीळिता दैव्या होतारा मनुषः । इमं नो यज्ञमा गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vātasya patmannīḷitā daivyā hotārā manuṣaḥ | imaṃ no yajñamā gatam ||

translations.english: Praised (by us), divine invokers of the gods, come moving on the path of the wind, to this sacrifice of our patron.

mantras.sanskrit: इळा सरस्वती मही तिस्रो देवीर्मयोभुवः । बर्हिः सीदन्त्वस्रिधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: iḷā sarasvatī mahī tisro devīrmayobhuvaḥ | barhiḥ sīdantvasridhaḥ ||

translations.english: May Iḷā, Sarasvatī, Mahī, the three goddesses who are the sources of happiness, sit down, benevolent, upon the sacred grass.

mantras.sanskrit: शिवस्त्वष्टरिहा गहि विभुः पोष उत त्मना । यज्ञेयज्ञे न उदव ॥
mantras.transliteration: śivastvaṣṭarihā gahi vibhuḥ poṣa uta tmanā | yajñeyajñe na udava ||

translations.english: Tvaṣṭā, being propitious, you who are diffusive in kindness, come to your own accord protect us in repeated sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्र वेत्थ वनस्पते देवानां गुह्या नामानि । तत्र हव्यानि गामय ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatra vettha vanaspate devānāṃ guhyā nāmāni | tatra havyāni gāmaya ||

translations.english: Wherever you know, Vanaspati, the secret forms of the gods to be, thither convey the oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वाहाग्नये वरुणाय स्वाहेन्द्राय मरुद्भ्यः । स्वाहा देवेभ्यो हविः ॥
mantras.transliteration: svāhāgnaye varuṇāya svāhendrāya marudbhyaḥ | svāhā devebhyo haviḥ ||

translations.english: The oblation is offered with reverence to Agni, to Varuṇa; with reverence to Indra, to the Maruts; with reverence to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निं तं मन्ये यो वसुरस्तं यं यन्ति धेनवः । अस्तमर्वन्त आशवोऽस्तं नित्यासो वाजिन इषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniṃ taṃ manye yo vasurastaṃ yaṃ yanti dhenavaḥ | astamarvanta āśavo'staṃ nityāso vājina iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||

translations.english: I glorify that Agni who is the giver of dwellings; to whom, as to their home, the kine, the light-faced steeds, the constant offers of oblations, repair; do you, (Agni), bring food to your adorers.

mantras.sanskrit: सो अग्निर्यो वसुर्गृणे सं यमायन्ति धेनवः । समर्वन्तो रघुद्रुवः सं सुजातासः सूरय इषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: so agniryo vasurgṛṇe saṃ yamāyanti dhenavaḥ | samarvanto raghudruvaḥ saṃ sujātāsaḥ sūraya iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||

translations.english: He is Agni, who is praised as the giver of dwellings, to whom the kine, the light-faced steeds, the well-born, devout worshippers repair; do you Agni, bring food to your adorers.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निर्हि वाजिनं विशे ददाति विश्वचर्षणिः । अग्नी राये स्वाभुवं स प्रीतो याति वार्यमिषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirhi vājinaṃ viśe dadāti viśvacarṣaṇiḥ | agnī rāye svābhuvaṃ sa prīto yāti vāryamiṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||

translations.english: Agni, the all-beholding, gives, verily, to the man (who worships him, a son) possessing abundant food; Agni, when propitiated proceeds (to bestow) that wealth which is of its own nature precious; do you, Agni, bring food to your adorers.

mantras.sanskrit: आ ते अग्न इधीमहि द्युमन्तं देवाजरम् । यद्ध स्या ते पनीयसी समिद्दीदयति द्यवीषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā te agna idhīmahi dyumantaṃ devājaram | yaddha syā te panīyasī samiddīdayati dyavīṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||

translations.english: We kindle you, divine Agni, bright, undecaying so that your glorious blaze shines in heaven; do you bring food to your adorers.

mantras.sanskrit: आ ते अग्न ऋचा हविः शुक्रस्य शोचिषस्पते । सुश्चन्द्र दस्म विश्पते हव्यवाट् तुभ्यं हूयत इषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā te agna ṛcā haviḥ śukrasya śociṣaspate | suścandra dasma viśpate havyavāṭ tubhyaṃ hūyata iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||

translations.english: To you, radiant Agni, lord of light, giver of plural asure, destroyer (of foes), protector of man, the bearer of oblations, to you the oblation is offered with the sacred verse; do you bring to your adorers.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रो त्ये अग्नयोऽग्निषु विश्वं पुष्यन्ति वार्यम् । ते हिन्विरे त इन्विरे त इषण्यन्त्यानुषगिषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: pro tye agnayo'gniṣu viśvaṃ puṣyanti vāryam | te hinvire ta invire ta iṣaṇyantyānuṣagiṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||

translations.english: These fires cherish all that is precious in the fires (of sacrifice); they give delight; they spread abroad; they crave perpetually (sacrificial) food; bring, Agni, food to your adorers.

mantras.sanskrit: तव त्ये अग्ने अर्चयो महि व्राधन्त वाजिनः । ये पत्वभिः शफानां व्रजा भुरन्त गोनामिषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava tye agne arcayo mahi vrādhanta vājinaḥ | ye patvabhiḥ śaphānāṃ vrajā bhuranta gonāmiṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||

translations.english: These your flames Agni, fed with abundant food, increase, as, by their descent, they seek the pastures of the hoofed cattle; bring, Agni, food to your adorers.

mantras.sanskrit: नवा नो अग्न आ भर स्तोतृभ्यः सुक्षितीरिषः । ते स्याम य आनृचुस्त्वादूतासो दमेदम इषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: navā no agna ā bhara stotṛbhyaḥ sukṣitīriṣaḥ | te syāma ya ānṛcustvādūtāso damedama iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||

translations.english: Grant, Agni, to us who praise you, new dwellings, and (abundant) food; may we be those who worship you having you for a messenger (to the gods) in every house; bring Agni, food to your adorers.

mantras.sanskrit: उभे सुश्चन्द्र सर्पिषो दर्वी श्रीणीष आसनि । उतो न उत्पुपूर्या उक्थेषु शवसस्पत इषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: ubhe suścandra sarpiṣo darvī śrīṇīṣa āsani | uto na utpupūryā uktheṣu śavasaspata iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||

translations.english: Giver of delight, you receive into your mouth the two ladles (full) of butter; so may you fulfil (our desires), lord of strength, at our solemn rites; bring, Agni, food to your adorers.

mantras.sanskrit: एवाँ अग्निमजुर्यमुर्गीर्भिर्यज्ञेभिरानुषक् । दधदस्मे सुवीर्यमुत त्यदाश्वश्व्यमिषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā~ agnimajuryamurgīrbhiryajñebhirānuṣak | dadhadasme suvīryamuta tyadāśvaśvyamiṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||

translations.english: Thus have they repaired to Agni with praises and with sacrifices successively, and have established (the manner of his worship); and he has given us male descendants, and wealth of fleet horses; bring, Agni, food to your adorers.

mantras.sanskrit: सखायः सं वः सम्यञ्चमिषं स्तोमं चाग्नये । वर्षिष्ठाय क्षितीनामूर्जो नप्त्रे सहस्वते ॥
mantras.transliteration: sakhāyaḥ saṃ vaḥ samyañcamiṣaṃ stomaṃ cāgnaye | varṣiṣṭhāya kṣitīnāmūrjo naptre sahasvate ||

translations.english: Friends, offer fitting praise and food to Agni, the most liberal benefactor of men, the powerful son of strength.

mantras.sanskrit: कुत्रा चिद्यस्य समृतौ रण्वा नरो नृषदने । अर्हन्तश्चिद्यमिन्धते संजनयन्ति जन्तवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kutrā cidyasya samṛtau raṇvā naro nṛṣadane | arhantaścidyamindhate saṃjanayanti jantavaḥ ||

translations.english: Where is (the deity) upon whose presence the rejoicing conductors (of the ceremony) are offering homage in the hall of sacrifice, (he) whom they kindle, and living beings genitive rate.

mantras.sanskrit: सं यदिषो वनामहे सं हव्या मानुषाणाम् । उत द्युम्नस्य शवस ऋतस्य रश्मिमा ददे ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ yadiṣo vanāmahe saṃ havyā mānuṣāṇām | uta dyumnasya śavasa ṛtasya raśmimā dade ||

translations.english: When we present to him (sacrificial food), when (he accepts) the oblations of men, then the power of the brilliant (viands), he assumes the radiance of the rite.

mantras.sanskrit: स स्मा कृणोति केतुमा नक्तं चिद्दूर आ सते । पावको यद्वनस्पतीन्प्र स्मा मिनात्यजरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa smā kṛṇoti ketumā naktaṃ ciddūra ā sate | pāvako yadvanaspatīnpra smā minātyajaraḥ ||

translations.english: Verily he gives a signal by night to one who is far off, when he, the purifier, the undecaying, consumes the forest lords.

mantras.sanskrit: अव स्म यस्य वेषणे स्वेदं पथिषु जुह्वति । अभीमह स्वजेन्यं भूमा पृष्ठेव रुरुहुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ava sma yasya veṣaṇe svedaṃ pathiṣu juhvati | abhīmaha svajenyaṃ bhūmā pṛṣṭheva ruruhuḥ ||

translations.english: At whose worship (the priests) pour the dripping (butter) upon the flames, and (the drops) mount upon the fire as if they were its own numerous offspring, as (boys ride) upon the back (of a father).

mantras.sanskrit: यं मर्त्यः पुरुस्पृहं विदद्विश्वस्य धायसे । प्र स्वादनं पितूनामस्ततातिं चिदायवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ martyaḥ puruspṛhaṃ vidadviśvasya dhāyase | pra svādanaṃ pitūnāmastatātiṃ cidāyave ||

translations.english: Him who is the desired of many, the (devout) man recognizes as the sustainer of all, the flavour of food, the provider of dwellings for men.

mantras.sanskrit: स हि ष्मा धन्वाक्षितं दाता न दात्या पशुः । हिरिश्मश्रुः शुचिदन्नृभुरनिभृष्टतविषिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa hi ṣmā dhanvākṣitaṃ dātā na dātyā paśuḥ | hiriśmaśruḥ śucidannṛbhuranibhṛṣṭataviṣiḥ ||

translations.english: He crops the dry ground strewn (with grass and wood), like an animal grazing; he with a golden beard, with shining teeth, vast, and of irresistible strength.

mantras.sanskrit: शुचिः ष्म यस्मा अत्रिवत्प्र स्वधितीव रीयते । सुषूरसूत माता क्राणा यदानशे भगम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śuciḥ ṣma yasmā atrivatpra svadhitīva rīyate | suṣūrasūta mātā krāṇā yadānaśe bhagam ||

translations.english: Bright as an axe is he to whom the (worshipper), like Atri, proceeds (to offer worship); he whom his prolific mother has brought forth, bestowing (a benefactor on the world), when (Agni) obtains (sacrificial) food.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यस्ते सर्पिरासुतेऽग्ने शमस्ति धायसे । ऐषु द्युम्नमुत श्रव आ चित्तं मर्त्येषु धाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yaste sarpirāsute'gne śamasti dhāyase | aiṣu dyumnamuta śrava ā cittaṃ martyeṣu dhāḥ ||

translations.english: To you, Agni, the accepter of the oblation, the upholder (of all), there is plural asure (from our praise); do you bestow upon these your worshippers wealth, and food and a heart (grateful for your favour).

mantras.sanskrit: इति चिन्मन्युमध्रिजस्त्वादातमा पशुं ददे । आदग्ने अपृणतोऽत्रिः सासह्याद्दस्यूनिषः सासह्यान्नॄन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: iti cinmanyumadhrijastvādātamā paśuṃ dade | ādagne apṛṇato'triḥ sāsahyāddasyūniṣaḥ sāsahyānnṝn ||

translations.english: May the sage who is in this manner the offerer of exclusive praise (Agni, to you), accept the cattle which are to be given to you; and thereupon may Atri overcome (hostile) men.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामग्न ऋतायवः समीधिरे प्रत्नं प्रत्नास ऊतये सहस्कृत । पुरुश्चन्द्रं यजतं विश्वधायसं दमूनसं गृहपतिं वरेण्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmagna ṛtāyavaḥ samīdhire pratnaṃ pratnāsa ūtaye sahaskṛta | puruścandraṃ yajataṃ viśvadhāyasaṃ damūnasaṃ gṛhapatiṃ vareṇyam ||

translations.english: Manifest of strength, Agni, ancient worshippers have kindled you of old for their preservation; you, the delighter of many, the adorable, the all-sustaining, the lowly-minded, the lord of the house, the excellent.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने अतिथिं पूर्व्यं विशः शोचिष्केशं गृहपतिं नि षेदिरे । बृहत्केतुं पुरुरूपं धनस्पृतं सुशर्माणं स्ववसं जरद्विषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmagne atithiṃ pūrvyaṃ viśaḥ śociṣkeśaṃ gṛhapatiṃ ni ṣedire | bṛhatketuṃ pururūpaṃ dhanaspṛtaṃ suśarmāṇaṃ svavasaṃ jaradviṣam ||

translations.english: Men have established you, (Agni), their ancient guest, as the lord of the house; (you), the blazing-haired, the vast bannered, the multiform, the dispenser of wealth, the bestower of happiness, the kind protector, the destruction of decaying (trees).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने मानुषीरीळते विशो होत्राविदं विविचिं रत्नधातमम् । गुहा सन्तं सुभग विश्वदर्शतं तुविष्वणसं सुयजं घृतश्रियम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmagne mānuṣīrīḷate viśo hotrāvidaṃ viviciṃ ratnadhātamam | guhā santaṃ subhaga viśvadarśataṃ tuviṣvaṇasaṃ suyajaṃ ghṛtaśriyam ||

translations.english: Human beings glorify you, Agni, the appreciator burnt-offerings, the discriminator (of truth), the main liberal giver of precious (things), abiding (awhile), auspicious one, in secret, (at other times) visible to all, loud sounding, offering worship, thriving upon clarified butter.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने धर्णसिं विश्वधा वयं गीर्भिर्गृणन्तो नमसोप सेदिम । स नो जुषस्व समिधानो अङ्गिरो देवो मर्तस्य यशसा सुदीतिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmagne dharṇasiṃ viśvadhā vayaṃ gīrbhirgṛṇanto namasopa sedima | sa no juṣasva samidhāno aṅgiro devo martasya yaśasā sudītibhiḥ ||

translations.english: We approach you, all-sustaining Agni, adoring you in many ways with hymns and with prostrations; do you, Aṅgiras, when kindled, be propitious to us; may the divine (Agni be plural ased) by the (sacrificial) food (offered by the) worshippers, and by the bright flames (of his sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने पुरुरूपो विशेविशे वयो दधासि प्रत्नथा पुरुष्टुत । पुरूण्यन्ना सहसा वि राजसि त्विषिः सा ते तित्विषाणस्य नाधृषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne pururūpo viśeviśe vayo dadhāsi pratnathā puruṣṭuta | purūṇyannā sahasā vi rājasi tviṣiḥ sā te titviṣāṇasya nādhṛṣe ||

translations.english: Agni, the praised of many, you who are multiform, giver of old food to every mortal; you reign with strength over the various (sacrificial) viands; the splendour of you when blazing brightly is not rivalled (by any).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने समिधानं यविष्ठ्य देवा दूतं चक्रिरे हव्यवाहनम् । उरुज्रयसं घृतयोनिमाहुतं त्वेषं चक्षुर्दधिरे चोदयन्मति ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmagne samidhānaṃ yaviṣṭhya devā dūtaṃ cakrire havyavāhanam | urujrayasaṃ ghṛtayonimāhutaṃ tveṣaṃ cakṣurdadhire codayanmati ||

translations.english: Agni, young (of the deities), the gods have made you, when kindled, their messenger, the bearer of oblations; you, who are rapid in movement, and of whom butter is the source, they have made, when invoked, the brilliant eye (of the universe), instrumental gated by the understanding.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने प्रदिव आहुतं घृतैः सुम्नायवः सुषमिधा समीधिरे । स वावृधान ओषधीभिरुक्षितोऽभि ज्रयांसि पार्थिवा वि तिष्ठसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmagne pradiva āhutaṃ ghṛtaiḥ sumnāyavaḥ suṣamidhā samīdhire | sa vāvṛdhāna oṣadhībhirukṣito'bhi jrayāṃsi pārthivā vi tiṣṭhase ||

translations.english: The ancient seekers after happiness hav ekindled you, Agni, when invoked, (and fed you) with abundant fuel; and you (thereby) increasing, and supplied with shrubs, are dominat over all terrestrial viands.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने हविष्मन्तो देवं मर्तास ईळते । मन्ये त्वा जातवेदसं स हव्या वक्ष्यानुषक् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmagne haviṣmanto devaṃ martāsa īḷate | manye tvā jātavedasaṃ sa havyā vakṣyānuṣak ||

translations.english: Mortals bearing oblations glorify you, Agni, the divine; I praise you, Jātavedas, for that you convey successively oblations (to the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निर्होता दास्वतः क्षयस्य वृक्तबर्हिषः । सं यज्ञासश्चरन्ति यं सं वाजासः श्रवस्यवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirhotā dāsvataḥ kṣayasya vṛktabarhiṣaḥ | saṃ yajñāsaścaranti yaṃ saṃ vājāsaḥ śravasyavaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, is the invoker of the gods (on behalf of) him, the donor (of the oblation), the abode (of the fruit of good works), by whom the sacred grass has been strewn; (he) in whom congregate all sacrifices securing food and fame.

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्म यं शिशुं यथा नवं जनिष्टारणी । धर्तारं मानुषीणां विशामग्निं स्वध्वरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta sma yaṃ śiśuṃ yathā navaṃ janiṣṭāraṇī | dhartāraṃ mānuṣīṇāṃ viśāmagniṃ svadhvaram ||

translations.english: He (it is) whom the two sticks have engendered like a new-born babe; the supporter of men and descendants of Manu, the fit object of sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्म दुर्गृभीयसे पुत्रो न ह्वार्याणाम् । पुरू यो दग्धासि वनाग्ने पशुर्न यवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta sma durgṛbhīyase putro na hvāryāṇām | purū yo dagdhāsi vanāgne paśurna yavase ||

translations.english: You are laid hold of with difficulty like the young of tortuously-twining (snakes); you who are the consumer of many forests, as an animal is of fodder.

mantras.sanskrit: अध स्म यस्यार्चयः सम्यक्संयन्ति धूमिनः । यदीमह त्रितो दिव्युप ध्मातेव धमति शिशीते ध्मातरी यथा ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha sma yasyārcayaḥ samyaksaṃyanti dhūminaḥ | yadīmaha trito divyupa dhmāteva dhamati śiśīte dhmātarī yathā ||

translations.english: Of whom smoke-emitting, the flames intensely collect; then, when diffused in the three regions, Agni inflates himself in the firmament, like the blower of a bellows, and sharpens (his flames), as (the fire blazes from the blast) of the blower.

mantras.sanskrit: तवाहमग्न ऊतिभिर्मित्रस्य च प्रशस्तिभिः । द्वेषोयुतो न दुरिता तुर्याम मर्त्यानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tavāhamagna ūtibhirmitrasya ca praśastibhiḥ | dveṣoyuto na duritā turyāma martyānām ||

translations.english: By the protections of you, Agni, the friend (of all), and by our praises (of you), may we pass safe from the evil acts of men, as if from malignant (enemies).

mantras.sanskrit: तं नो अग्ने अभी नरो रयिं सहस्व आ भर । स क्षेपयत्स पोषयद्भुवद्वाजस्य सातय उतैधि पृत्सु नो वृधे ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ no agne abhī naro rayiṃ sahasva ā bhara | sa kṣepayatsa poṣayadbhuvadvājasya sātaya utaidhi pṛtsu no vṛdhe ||

translations.english: Powerful Agni, bestow upon us the instrumental tutors (of pious rites), that wealth (which we desire); may he discomfit (our foes); may he cherish us; may he ever ready to bestow upon us food; and do you, Agni, be present in battles for our succesṣ

mantras.sanskrit: अग्न ओजिष्ठमा भर द्युम्नमस्मभ्यमध्रिगो । प्र नो राया परीणसा रत्सि वाजाय पन्थाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agna ojiṣṭhamā bhara dyumnamasmabhyamadhrigo | pra no rāyā parīṇasā ratsi vājāya panthām ||

translations.english: Agni, of irresistible prowess, bring to us most powerful treasure; (invest us) with surrounding wealth; mark out the paths to abundance.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं नो अग्ने अद्भुत क्रत्वा दक्षस्य मंहना । त्वे असुर्यमारुहत्क्राणा मित्रो न यज्ञियः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ no agne adbhuta kratvā dakṣasya maṃhanā | tve asuryamāruhatkrāṇā mitro na yajñiyaḥ ||

translations.english: Marvellous Agni, (gratified) by our acts, (produce) in us greatness of vigour; in you abides the strength destroying evil spirits; you who are to be worshipped like Mitra, are the doer (of great deeds).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं नो अग्न एषां गयं पुष्टिं च वर्धय । ये स्तोमेभिः प्र सूरयो नरो मघान्यानशुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ no agna eṣāṃ gayaṃ puṣṭiṃ ca vardhaya | ye stomebhiḥ pra sūrayo naro maghānyānaśuḥ ||

translations.english: Augment, Agni, our dwelling and prosperity, for the devout men (who have propitiated you) by their praises have acquired riches.

mantras.sanskrit: ये अग्ने चन्द्र ते गिरः शुम्भन्त्यश्वराधसः । शुष्मेभिः शुष्मिणो नरो दिवश्चिद्येषां बृहत्सुकीर्तिर्बोधति त्मना ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye agne candra te giraḥ śumbhantyaśvarādhasaḥ | śuṣmebhiḥ śuṣmiṇo naro divaścidyeṣāṃ bṛhatsukīrtirbodhati tmanā ||

translations.english: Delightful Agni, those men who glorify you with hymns become rich in horses, and are invigorated with (foe-destroying) energies; and their great renown, spread through the firmament arouses (you) of your own accord.

mantras.sanskrit: तव त्ये अग्ने अर्चयो भ्राजन्तो यन्ति धृष्णुया । परिज्मानो न विद्युतः स्वानो रथो न वाजयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava tye agne arcayo bhrājanto yanti dhṛṣṇuyā | parijmāno na vidyutaḥ svāno ratho na vājayuḥ ||

translations.english: These your bright and fierce flames, Agni, spread around like the circumambient lightning, and are like a rattling chariot rushing (into battle) for booty.

mantras.sanskrit: नू नो अग्न ऊतये सबाधसश्च रातये । अस्माकासश्च सूरयो विश्वा आशास्तरीषणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū no agna ūtaye sabādhasaśca rātaye | asmākāsaśca sūrayo viśvā āśāstarīṣaṇi ||

translations.english: Be prompt, Agni, for our protection, and for the gift of poverty-repelling (riches); and may our pious descendants be able to compass all their desires.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं नो अग्ने अङ्गिरः स्तुतः स्तवान आ भर । होतर्विभ्वासहं रयिं: स्तोतृभ्यः स्तवसे च न उतैधि पृत्सु नो वृधे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ no agne aṅgiraḥ stutaḥ stavāna ā bhara | hotarvibhvāsahaṃ rayiṃ: stotṛbhyaḥ stavase ca na utaidhi pṛtsu no vṛdhe ||

translations.english: Agni, who are Aṅgiras, glorified in the past, glorified (at present), invoker (of the gods), bring unto us riches (enabling us) to overcome the mighty; give to your praisers (ability) to praise you, and be (at hand) for our success in battles.

mantras.sanskrit: जनस्य गोपा अजनिष्ट जागृविरग्निः सुदक्षः सुविताय नव्यसे । घृतप्रतीको बृहता दिविस्पृशा द्युमद्वि भाति भरतेभ्यः शुचिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: janasya gopā ajaniṣṭa jāgṛviragniḥ sudakṣaḥ suvitāya navyase | ghṛtapratīko bṛhatā divispṛśā dyumadvi bhāti bharatebhyaḥ śuciḥ ||

translations.english: The vigilant, the powerful Agni, the protector of man, has been engendered for the present prosperity (of the world); fed with butter, (blazing) with intense (radiance) reaching to the sky, the pure Agni shines brilliantly for the Bharatas.

mantras.sanskrit: यज्ञस्य केतुं प्रथमं पुरोहितमग्निं नरस्त्रिषधस्थे समीधिरे । इन्द्रेण देवैः सरथं स बर्हिषि सीदन्नि होता यजथाय सुक्रतुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajñasya ketuṃ prathamaṃ purohitamagniṃ narastriṣadhasthe samīdhire | indreṇa devaiḥ sarathaṃ sa barhiṣi sīdanni hotā yajathāya sukratuḥ ||

translations.english: The priests have first kindled, in three plural ces, Agni, the banner of sacrifice, the family priests, (riding) in the same car with Indra and the gods; he, the performer of pious acts, the invoker (of the gods), has sat down on the sacred grass for the (celebration of the) rite.

mantras.sanskrit: असम्मृष्टो जायसे मात्रोः शुचिर्मन्द्रः कविरुदतिष्ठो विवस्वतः । घृतेन त्वावर्धयन्नग्न आहुत धूमस्ते केतुरभवद्दिवि श्रितः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asammṛṣṭo jāyase mātroḥ śucirmandraḥ kavirudatiṣṭho vivasvataḥ | ghṛtena tvāvardhayannagna āhuta dhūmaste keturabhavaddivi śritaḥ ||

translations.english: You are born unobstructed of two mothers; pure, adorable, wise, you have sprung up from (the devotion of) the householder; they have augmented you with butter; Agni, to whom burnt-offerings are made, the smoke is your banner spread abroad in the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निर्नो यज्ञमुप वेतु साधुयाग्निं नरो वि भरन्ते गृहेगृहे । अग्निर्दूतो अभवद्धव्यवाहनोऽग्निं वृणाना वृणते कविक्रतुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirno yajñamupa vetu sādhuyāgniṃ naro vi bharante gṛhegṛhe | agnirdūto abhavaddhavyavāhano'gniṃ vṛṇānā vṛṇate kavikratum ||

translations.english: May Agni, the fulfiller (of all desires) come to our sacrifice; men cherish Agni in every dwelling; Agni, the bearer of oblations, has become the messenger (of the gods); those adoring Agni adore him as the accomplisher of the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: तुभ्येदमग्ने मधुमत्तमं वचस्तुभ्यं मनीषा इयमस्तु शं हृदे । त्वां गिरः सिन्धुमिवावनीर्महीरा पृणन्ति शवसा वर्धयन्ति च ॥
mantras.transliteration: tubhyedamagne madhumattamaṃ vacastubhyaṃ manīṣā iyamastu śaṃ hṛde | tvāṃ giraḥ sindhumivāvanīrmahīrā pṛṇanti śavasā vardhayanti ca ||

translations.english: To you, Agni, this most sweet speech (is addressed) may this praise be gratification of your heart; pious hymns fill you, and augment you with vigour, as large rivers (replenish) the sea.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने अङ्गिरसो गुहा हितमन्वविन्दञ्छिश्रियाणं वनेवने । स जायसे मथ्यमानः सहो महत्त्वामाहुः सहसस्पुत्रमङ्गिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmagne aṅgiraso guhā hitamanvavindañchiśriyāṇaṃ vanevane | sa jāyase mathyamānaḥ saho mahattvāmāhuḥ sahasasputramaṅgiraḥ ||

translations.english: The Aṅgirasas discovered you, Agni, hidden in secret, and taking refuge from wood to wood; you are genitive rated, being churned with great force; therefore they have called you, Aṅgiras, the son of strength.

mantras.sanskrit: प्राग्नये बृहते यज्ञियाय ऋतस्य वृष्णे असुराय मन्म । घृतं न यज्ञ आस्ये सुपूतं गिरं भरे वृषभाय प्रतीचीम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: prāgnaye bṛhate yajñiyāya ṛtasya vṛṣṇe asurāya manma | ghṛtaṃ na yajña āsye supūtaṃ giraṃ bhare vṛṣabhāya pratīcīm ||

translations.english: I offer to the great, the adorable Agni, the rain of water, the vigorous, the showerer (of benefits), the present acceptable praise, like well-purified butter (poured) at sacrifices into his mouth.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतं चिकित्व ऋतमिच्चिकिद्ध्यृतस्य धारा अनु तृन्धि पूर्वीः । नाहं यातुं सहसा न द्वयेन ऋतं सपाम्यरुषस्य वृष्णः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtaṃ cikitva ṛtamiccikiddhyṛtasya dhārā anu tṛndhi pūrvīḥ | nāhaṃ yātuṃ sahasā na dvayena ṛtaṃ sapāmyaruṣasya vṛṣṇaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, who know (the purpose of) the sacrifice, assent to this rite; be favourable to the copious showers of water; (endowed) with strength, (I undertake) not (to obstruct) sacred acts, nor adjure the rite with both (truth and untruth), but (repeate the praise) of the resplendent showerer (of benefits).

mantras.sanskrit: कया नो अग्न ऋतयन्नृतेन भुवो नवेदा उचथस्य नव्यः । वेदा मे देव ऋतुपा ऋतूनां नाहं पतिं सनितुरस्य रायः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kayā no agna ṛtayannṛtena bhuvo navedā ucathasya navyaḥ | vedā me deva ṛtupā ṛtūnāṃ nāhaṃ patiṃ saniturasya rāyaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, bestower of water, by what (act of) truth may you, who are adorable, be cognizant of our adoration; may the divine Agni, the guardian of the seasons, recognize me; (I know) him not (yet) as the lord of the riches of which I am the possessor.

mantras.sanskrit: के ते अग्ने रिपवे बन्धनासः के पायवः सनिषन्त द्युमन्तः । के धासिमग्ने अनृतस्य पान्ति क आसतो वचसः सन्ति गोपाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ke te agne ripave bandhanāsaḥ ke pāyavaḥ saniṣanta dyumantaḥ | ke dhāsimagne anṛtasya pānti ka āsato vacasaḥ santi gopāḥ ||

translations.english: Who, Agni, among your (followers) are the imprisoners of foes? who among them are the protectors (of men) the splendid distributors of gifts? who among them defend the asserters of untruth? who are the encouragers of evil deeds?

mantras.sanskrit: सखायस्ते विषुणा अग्न एते शिवासः सन्तो अशिवा अभूवन् । अधूर्षत स्वयमेते वचोभिॠजूयते वृजिनानि ब्रुवन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sakhāyaste viṣuṇā agna ete śivāsaḥ santo aśivā abhūvan | adhūrṣata svayamete vacobhiṝjūyate vṛjināni bruvantaḥ ||

translations.english: These your friends, Agni, everywhere dispersed, were formerly unhappy (in abandoning your worship), but are again fortunate (by its renewal); may they who, with (censorious) words, impute fraudulent (practices) to me who pursue a straight path, bring eveil upon themselves.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्ते अग्ने नमसा यज्ञमीट्ट ऋतं स पात्यरुषस्य वृष्णः । तस्य क्षयः पृथुरा साधुरेतु प्रसर्स्राणस्य नहुषस्य शेषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaste agne namasā yajñamīṭṭa ṛtaṃ sa pātyaruṣasya vṛṣṇaḥ | tasya kṣayaḥ pṛthurā sādhuretu prasarsrāṇasya nahuṣasya śeṣaḥ ||

translations.english: May the dwelling of him, Agni, who celebrate your worship with reverence, of him who protects the sacrifice (offered) to the resplendent showerer (of benefits), be well stored; and may a virtuous successor of the man who diligently worships you come in his plural ce.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्चन्तस्त्वा हवामहेऽर्चन्तः समिधीमहि । अग्ने अर्चन्त ऊतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: arcantastvā havāmahe'rcantaḥ samidhīmahi | agne arcanta ūtaye ||

translations.english: Adoring you, Agni, we invoke you, adoring you we kindle you, adoring you for protection.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्नेः स्तोमं मनामहे सिध्रमद्य दिविस्पृशः । देवस्य द्रविणस्यवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agneḥ stomaṃ manāmahe sidhramadya divispṛśaḥ | devasya draviṇasyavaḥ ||

translations.english: Desirous of wealth, we recite today the effectual praise of the divine Agni, (whose radiance) reaches the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निर्जुषत नो गिरो होता यो मानुषेष्वा । स यक्षद्दैव्यं जनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirjuṣata no giro hotā yo mānuṣeṣvā | sa yakṣaddaivyaṃ janam ||

translations.english: May Agni, who among men is the invoker of the gods, accept our praises; may he offer sacrifice to the divine beings.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने सप्रथा असि जुष्टो होता वरेण्यः । त्वया यज्ञं वि तन्वते ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne saprathā asi juṣṭo hotā vareṇyaḥ | tvayā yajñaṃ vi tanvate ||

translations.english: You, Agni, are mighty and gracious, the (ministrant) priest, the desired (of all) through your worshippers complete the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने वाजसातमं विप्रा वर्धन्ति सुष्टुतम् । स नो रास्व सुवीर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmagne vājasātamaṃ viprā vardhanti suṣṭutam | sa no rāsva suvīryam ||

translations.english: Wise worshippers exalt you, Agni, the bountiful giver of food, the deservedly lauded; do you bestow upon us excellent strength.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने नेमिरराँ इव देवाँस्त्वं परिभूरसि । आ राधश्चित्रमृञ्जसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne nemirarā~ iva devā~stvaṃ paribhūrasi | ā rādhaścitramṛñjase ||

translations.english: Agni, you encompass the gods as the circumference (surrounds) the spokes (of a wheel); bestow manifold wealth upon us.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निं स्तोमेन बोधय समिधानो अमर्त्यम् । हव्या देवेषु नो दधत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniṃ stomena bodhaya samidhāno amartyam | havyā deveṣu no dadhat ||

translations.english: Waken the immortal Agni with praise, that, being kindled, he may bear our oblations to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: तमध्वरेष्वीळते देवं मर्ता अमर्त्यम् । यजिष्ठं मानुषे जने ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamadhvareṣvīḷate devaṃ martā amartyam | yajiṣṭhaṃ mānuṣe jane ||

translations.english: Mortals worship him, an immortal divinity, at their sacrifices, most adorable among the human race.

mantras.sanskrit: तं हि शश्वन्त ईळते स्रुचा देवं घृतश्चुता । अग्निं हव्याय वोळ्हवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ hi śaśvanta īḷate srucā devaṃ ghṛtaścutā | agniṃ havyāya voḷhave ||

translations.english: Numerous (worshippers), pouring out butter from the (sacrificial) ladle, glorify him the divine Agni, that he may convey their oblation (to the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निर्जातो अरोचत घ्नन्दस्यूञ्ज्योतिषा तमः । अविन्दद्गा अपः स्वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirjāto arocata ghnandasyūñjyotiṣā tamaḥ | avindadgā apaḥ svaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, as soon as born, blazes brightly, destroying the dasyus, and (dispersing) the darkness by his lustre; he has discovered the cows, the waters, the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निमीळेन्यं कविं घृतपृष्ठं सपर्यत । वेतु मे शृणवद्धवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnimīḷenyaṃ kaviṃ ghṛtapṛṣṭhaṃ saparyata | vetu me śṛṇavaddhavam ||

translations.english: Worship the adorable Agni, the sage, whose summit blazes with butter; may he hear and comprehend my invocations.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निं घृतेन वावृधुः स्तोमेभिर्विश्वचर्षणिम् । स्वाधीभिर्वचस्युभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniṃ ghṛtena vāvṛdhuḥ stomebhirviśvacarṣaṇim | svādhībhirvacasyubhiḥ ||

translations.english: They have augmented, Agni, the beholder of all, with oblations and with praises, along with the gods, the objects of pious meditation, desirous of praise.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वेधसे कवये वेद्याय गिरं भरे यशसे पूर्व्याय । घृतप्रसत्तो असुरः सुशेवो रायो धर्ता धरुणो वस्वो अग्निः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vedhase kavaye vedyāya giraṃ bhare yaśase pūrvyāya | ghṛtaprasatto asuraḥ suśevo rāyo dhartā dharuṇo vasvo agniḥ ||

translations.english: I offer praise to Agni, the creator, the far-seeing, the adorable, the renowned, the first (of the gods); he who is propitiated by oblations, the strong, the giver of happiness, the possessor of riches, the receiver of oblations, the bestower of oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतेन ऋतं धरुणं धारयन्त यज्ञस्य शाके परमे व्योमन् । दिवो धर्मन्धरुणे सेदुषो नॄञ्जातैरजाताँ अभि ये ननक्षुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtena ṛtaṃ dharuṇaṃ dhārayanta yajñasya śāke parame vyoman | divo dharmandharuṇe seduṣo nṝñjātairajātā~ abhi ye nanakṣuḥ ||

translations.english: They are detaining by sacrifice the true recipient (of offerings) in the most eminent plural ce of the ceremony, who brings together the leaders (of the rite), the unborn with the born, (or gods and men), as seated at the solemnity which is the stay of heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: अङ्होयुवस्तन्वस्तन्वते वि वयो महद्दुष्टरं पूर्व्याय । स संवतो नवजातस्तुतुर्यात्सिङ्हं न क्रुद्धमभितः परि ष्ठुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aṅhoyuvastanvastanvate vi vayo mahadduṣṭaraṃ pūrvyāya | sa saṃvato navajātastuturyātsiṅhaṃ na kruddhamabhitaḥ pari ṣṭhuḥ ||

translations.english: They who (present) to the chief (of the gods) the great food (of sacrifice), unattainable (by the rākṣasas), enjoy forms exempt from defect; may that new-born Agni scatter assembled (hosts); let them stand from around me as (deer avoid) an angry lion.

mantras.sanskrit: मातेव यद्भरसे पप्रथानो जनंजनं धायसे चक्षसे च । वयोवयो जरसे यद्दधानः परि त्मना विषुरूपो जिगासि ॥
mantras.transliteration: māteva yadbharase paprathāno janaṃjanaṃ dhāyase cakṣase ca | vayovayo jarase yaddadhānaḥ pari tmanā viṣurūpo jigāsi ||

translations.english: When, everywhere predominating, you cherish all men like a mother, and (are implored by all) to behold and to support them; and when, being detained, you mature every kind of food, then, multiform (Agni), you comprise (all beings) in yourself.

mantras.sanskrit: वाजो नु ते शवसस्पात्वन्तमुरुं दोघं धरुणं देव रायः । पदं न तायुर्गुहा दधानो महो राये चितयन्नत्रिमस्पः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vājo nu te śavasaspātvantamuruṃ doghaṃ dharuṇaṃ deva rāyaḥ | padaṃ na tāyurguhā dadhāno maho rāye citayannatrimaspaḥ ||

translations.english: Divine, Agni, may the (sacrificial) food, the vast yielder (of benefits to men), the sustainer of riches, support the utmost of your vigour; and do you considering (the means of acquiring) great riches, like a thief keeping concealed the article (he has stolen), be propitious to Atri.

mantras.sanskrit: बृहद्वयो हि भानवेऽर्चा देवायाग्नये । यं मित्रं न प्रशस्तिभिर्मर्तासो दधिरे पुरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhadvayo hi bhānave'rcā devāyāgnaye | yaṃ mitraṃ na praśastibhirmartāso dadhire puraḥ ||

translations.english: Offer abundant (sacrificial) food to the brilliant divine Agni, whom mortals have plural ced before them by praises as a friend.

mantras.sanskrit: स हि द्युभिर्जनानां होता दक्षस्य बाह्वोः । वि हव्यमग्निरानुषग्भगो न वारमृण्वति ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa hi dyubhirjanānāṃ hotā dakṣasya bāhvoḥ | vi havyamagnirānuṣagbhago na vāramṛṇvati ||

translations.english: For that Agni, (endowed) with the lustre of the strength of his arms, is the ministrant priest of mortals, who (presents) the oblation to the gods in succession, and like Bhaga distributes desirable wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य स्तोमे मघोनः सख्ये वृद्धशोचिषः । विश्वा यस्मिन्तुविष्वणि समर्ये शुष्ममादधुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya stome maghonaḥ sakhye vṛddhaśociṣaḥ | viśvā yasmintuviṣvaṇi samarye śuṣmamādadhuḥ ||

translations.english: (May we be assiduous) in the praise, (and cherished) in the friendship of that very radiant possessor of wealth, on whom, loud-sounding and all-ruling, (his) universal (worshippers) have conferred vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: अधा ह्यग्न एषां सुवीर्यस्य मंहना । तमिद्यह्वं न रोदसी परि श्रवो बभूवतुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhā hyagna eṣāṃ suvīryasya maṃhanā | tamidyahvaṃ na rodasī pari śravo babhūvatuḥ ||

translations.english: Now verily, Agni, (be disposed) for bestowing excellent strength on these (your worshippers); heaven and earth have invested him with glory like the vast (sun).

mantras.sanskrit: नू न एहि वार्यमग्ने गृणान आ भर । ये वयं ये च सूरयः स्वस्ति धामहे सचोतैधि पृत्सु नो वृधे ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū na ehi vāryamagne gṛṇāna ā bhara | ye vayaṃ ye ca sūrayaḥ svasti dhāmahe sacotaidhi pṛtsu no vṛdhe ||

translations.english: Glorified by us, Agni, come quickly, and bring us desirable wealth; we who (are your worshippers) we (who are your) adorers, offer you welcome together with oblations; be you favourable to us; be (our) success in battles.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यज्ञैर्देव मर्त्य इत्था तव्यांसमूतये । अग्निं कृते स्वध्वरे पूरुरीळीतावसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yajñairdeva martya itthā tavyāṃsamūtaye | agniṃ kṛte svadhvare pūrurīḷītāvase ||

translations.english: Divine Agni, a mortal thus with sacrifices (calls upon you) who are endowed with lustre for protection; Puru adores Agni for protection when the sacred rite is solemnized.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य हि स्वयशस्तर आसा विधर्मन्मन्यसे । तं नाकं चित्रशोचिषं मन्द्रं परो मनीषया ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya hi svayaśastara āsā vidharmanmanyase | taṃ nākaṃ citraśociṣaṃ mandraṃ paro manīṣayā ||

translations.english: Performer of various functions, who are deservedly renowned, you praise by your words that Agni, who is possessed of wonderful splendour, who is exempt from pain, who is adorable and supreme in understanding.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य वासा उ अर्चिषा य आयुक्त तुजा गिरा । दिवो न यस्य रेतसा बृहच्छोचन्त्यर्चयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya vāsā u arciṣā ya āyukta tujā girā | divo na yasya retasā bṛhacchocantyarcayaḥ ||

translations.english: He who is endowed with vigour, is (glorified) by praise, and by whose radiance, like that of the sky, the rays of light shine brightly; by his lustre, verily, (the sun is luminous).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य क्रत्वा विचेतसो दस्मस्य वसु रथ आ । अधा विश्वासु हव्योऽग्निर्विक्षु प्र शस्यते ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya kratvā vicetaso dasmasya vasu ratha ā | adhā viśvāsu havyo'gnirvikṣu pra śasyate ||

translations.english: By the worship of him who is plural asing of aspect, the provident (heap) wealth in their cars; Agni, to whom oblations are due, is then glorified by all people.

mantras.sanskrit: नू न इद्धि वार्यमासा सचन्त सूरयः । ऊर्जो नपादभिष्टये पाहि शग्धि स्वस्तय उतैधि पृत्सु नो वृधे ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū na iddhi vāryamāsā sacanta sūrayaḥ | ūrjo napādabhiṣṭaye pāhi śagdhi svastaya utaidhi pṛtsu no vṛdhe ||

translations.english: Quickly, (Agni, give us) desirable (wealth), such as the devout, combining with (pious) praise, (obtain); son of strength (be favourable) to (my) desires; protect us (from calamity); be alert for our prosperity; come for our success in battles.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रातरग्निः पुरुप्रियो विशः स्तवेतातिथिः । विश्वानि यो अमर्त्यो हव्या मर्तेषु रण्यति ॥
mantras.transliteration: prātaragniḥ purupriyo viśaḥ stavetātithiḥ | viśvāni yo amartyo havyā marteṣu raṇyati ||

translations.english: Let Agni, the beloved of many, the guest of man, be present at dawn; he who, immortal, desires the oblations of mortalṣ

mantras.sanskrit: द्विताय मृक्तवाहसे स्वस्य दक्षस्य मंहना । इन्दं। स धत्त आनुषक्स्तोता चित्ते अमर्त्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: dvitāya mṛktavāhase svasya dakṣasya maṃhanā | indaṃ| sa dhatta ānuṣakstotā citte amartya ||

translations.english: Be (willing to make) a grant of your own strength to Dvita, the bearer of the pure oblations; for he, immortal Agni, your diligent praiser, brings to you continually the Soma juice.

mantras.sanskrit: तं वो दीर्घायुशोचिषं गिरा हुवे मघोनाम् । अरिष्टो येषां रथो व्यश्वदावन्नीयते ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ vo dīrghāyuśociṣaṃ girā huve maghonām | ariṣṭo yeṣāṃ ratho vyaśvadāvannīyate ||

translations.english: I invoke you bright-shining, through a long life, with praise, (for the benefit) of the affluent, that their chariot, giver of horses, may proceed unimpeded.

mantras.sanskrit: चित्रा वा येषु दीधितिरासन्नुक्था पान्ति ये । स्तीर्णं बर्हिः स्वर्णरे श्रवांसि दधिरे परि ॥
mantras.transliteration: citrā vā yeṣu dīdhitirāsannukthā pānti ye | stīrṇaṃ barhiḥ svarṇare śravāṃsi dadhire pari ||

translations.english: Among whom the ceremonial of many kinds is observed; who perpetuate the sacred hymns by their recital; by them the sacrificial viands are plural ced upon the strewn grass (at the sacrifice which) leads (the worshipper) to heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: ये मे पञ्चाशतं ददुरश्वानां सधस्तुति । द्युमदग्ने महि श्रवो बृहत्कृधि मघोनां नृवदमृत नृणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye me pañcāśataṃ daduraśvānāṃ sadhastuti | dyumadagne mahi śravo bṛhatkṛdhi maghonāṃ nṛvadamṛta nṛṇām ||

translations.english: Immortal Agni, bestow upon those opulent men, who, upon (my) praise (of you), gave to me fifty horses, and brilliang, ample, and abundant food, (supporting numerous) dependants.

mantras.sanskrit: अभ्यवस्थाः प्र जायन्ते प्र वव्रेर्वव्रिश्चिकेत । उपस्थे मातुर्वि चष्टे ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhyavasthāḥ pra jāyante pra vavrervavriściketa | upasthe māturvi caṣṭe ||

translations.english: Unprosperous circumstances affect Vavri; may the accepter (of oblations) become cognizant (of them), as, reclining on the lap of his mother, he beholds all things.

mantras.sanskrit: जुहुरे वि चितयन्तोऽनिमिषं नृम्णं पान्ति । आ दृळ्हां पुरं विविशुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: juhure vi citayanto'nimiṣaṃ nṛmṇaṃ pānti | ā dṛḷhāṃ puraṃ viviśuḥ ||

translations.english: They who know (your power) invoke you incessantly and nourish (your) strength (by oblations); they dwell in an impregnable city.

mantras.sanskrit: आ श्वैत्रेयस्य जन्तवो द्युमद्वर्धन्त कृष्टयः । निष्कग्रीवो बृहदुक्थ एना मध्वा न वाजयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā śvaitreyasya jantavo dyumadvardhanta kṛṣṭayaḥ | niṣkagrīvo bṛhaduktha enā madhvā na vājayuḥ ||

translations.english: Living men, with collars of gold, earnest in praise, desirous of food, augment by this laudation the vigour of you abiding in the white firmament.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रियं दुग्धं न काम्यमजामि जाम्योः सचा । घर्मो न वाजजठरोऽदब्धः शश्वतो दभः ॥
mantras.transliteration: priyaṃ dugdhaṃ na kāmyamajāmi jāmyoḥ sacā | gharmo na vājajaṭharo'dabdhaḥ śaśvato dabhaḥ ||

translations.english: May (Agni) with his two relatives, (heaven and earth), hear this faultless (praise), acceptable as milk; he who, like the mixed oblation, is filled with food, and unsubsdued, is ever the subduer of his foes.

mantras.sanskrit: क्रीळन्नो रश्म आ भुवः सं भस्मना वायुना वेविदानः । ता अस्य सन्धृषजो न तिग्माः सुसंशिता वक्ष्यो वक्षणेस्थाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: krīḷanno raśma ā bhuvaḥ saṃ bhasmanā vāyunā vevidānaḥ | tā asya sandhṛṣajo na tigmāḥ susaṃśitā vakṣyo vakṣaṇesthāḥ ||

translations.english: Radiant (Agni), who are made manifest by the wind and are sporting amidst the ashes (of the forest), be present with us; and may the fierce fiery flames, destructive of foes, be genitive le to this your worshipper.

mantras.sanskrit: यमग्ने वाजसातम त्वं चिन्मन्यसे रयिम् । तं नो गीर्भिः श्रवाय्यं देवत्रा पनया युजम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yamagne vājasātama tvaṃ cinmanyase rayim | taṃ no gīrbhiḥ śravāyyaṃ devatrā panayā yujam ||

translations.english: That (sacrificial) wealth, Agni, bounteous giver of food, of which you approve, and which deserves to be commanded by our praises, do you convey to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: ये अग्ने नेरयन्ति ते वृद्धा उग्रस्य शवसः । अप द्वेषो अप ह्वरोऽन्यव्रतस्य सश्चिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye agne nerayanti te vṛddhā ugrasya śavasaḥ | apa dveṣo apa hvaro'nyavratasya saścire ||

translations.english: may those prosperous men who do not offer oblations to you become destitute of great strength, and may (the followers) of other (than Vaidika) observances incur (your) enmity and punishment.

mantras.sanskrit: होतारं त्वा वृणीमहेऽग्ने दक्षस्य साधनम् । यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यं गिरा प्रयस्वन्तो हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: hotāraṃ tvā vṛṇīmahe'gne dakṣasya sādhanam | yajñeṣu pūrvyaṃ girā prayasvanto havāmahe ||

translations.english: We, Prayasvats, have recourse to you, the invoker (of the gods), the means of strength; we glorify you first at sacrifices with praise.

mantras.sanskrit: इत्था यथा त ऊतये सहसावन्दिवेदिवे । राय ऋताय सुक्रतो गोभिः ष्याम सधमादो वीरैः स्याम सधमादः ॥
mantras.transliteration: itthā yathā ta ūtaye sahasāvandivedive | rāya ṛtāya sukrato gobhiḥ ṣyāma sadhamādo vīraiḥ syāma sadhamādaḥ ||

translations.english: Possessor of strength, day by day so (provide) that we may enjoy your protection; doer of good deeds, may we (be deserving) of wealth through sacrifice, and may we be happy with cattle, happy with male descendants.

mantras.sanskrit: मनुष्वत्त्वा नि धीमहि मनुष्वत्समिधीमहि । अग्ने मनुष्वदङ्गिरो देवान्देवयते यज ॥
mantras.transliteration: manuṣvattvā ni dhīmahi manuṣvatsamidhīmahi | agne manuṣvadaṅgiro devāndevayate yaja ||

translations.english: Like Manu, we meditate, Agni, upon you; like Manu, we kindle you; worship the gods on behalf of the (worshipper), devout as Manu.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं हि मानुषे जनेऽग्ने सुप्रीत इध्यसे । स्रुचस्त्वा यन्त्यानुषक्सुजात सर्पिरासुते ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ hi mānuṣe jane'gne suprīta idhyase | srucastvā yantyānuṣaksujāta sarpirāsute ||

translations.english: When you are plural ased, Agni, you shine upon the human race; well-born, feeder upon clarified butter, the ladles are constantly uplifted to you.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वां विश्वे सजोषसो देवासो दूतमक्रत । सपर्यन्तस्त्वा कवे यज्ञेषु देवमीळते ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāṃ viśve sajoṣaso devāso dūtamakrata | saparyantastvā kave yajñeṣu devamīḷate ||

translations.english: All the consentient divinities have made you their messenger; therefore the pious worship you who are divine, wise Agni, at sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: देवं वो देवयज्ययाग्निमीळीत मर्त्यः । समिद्धः शुक्र दीदिह्यृतस्य योनिमासदः ससस्य योनिमासदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: devaṃ vo devayajyayāgnimīḷīta martyaḥ | samiddhaḥ śukra dīdihyṛtasya yonimāsadaḥ sasasya yonimāsadaḥ ||

translations.english: Man praises you, divine Agni, to convey his offerings to the gods; bright Agni, blaze when kindled; take your seat in the chamber (of sacrifice), in the chamber of the sincere Sasa.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र विश्वसामन्नत्रिवदर्चा पावकशोचिषे । यो अध्वरेष्वीड्यो होता मन्द्रतमो विशि ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra viśvasāmannatrivadarcā pāvakaśociṣe | yo adhvareṣvīḍyo hotā mandratamo viśi ||

translations.english: Sing, Viśvasāman, like Atri, (a hymn) to the dispenser of purifying light; (to him) who is to be praised at sacrifices, the invoker of the gods, the most adorable by man.

mantras.sanskrit: न्यग्निं जातवेदसं दधाता देवमृत्विजम् । प्र यज्ञ एत्वानुषगद्या देवव्यचस्तमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nyagniṃ jātavedasaṃ dadhātā devamṛtvijam | pra yajña etvānuṣagadyā devavyacastamaḥ ||

translations.english: Cherish the divine Agni, by whom all that exists is known, the priest (of the rite); may the sacrifice most suitable for the gods duly this day proceed to them.

mantras.sanskrit: चिकित्विन्मनसं त्वा देवं मर्तास ऊतये । वरेण्यस्य तेऽवस इयानासो अमन्महि ॥
mantras.transliteration: cikitvinmanasaṃ tvā devaṃ martāsa ūtaye | vareṇyasya te'vasa iyānāso amanmahi ||

translations.english: Men have recourse to you, divine Agni, who are of intelligent mind, for security; we praise you who are most excellent, seeking your protection.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने चिकिद्ध्यस्य न इदं वचः सहस्य । तं त्वा सुशिप्र दम्पते स्तोमैर्वर्धन्त्यत्रयो गीर्भिः शुम्भन्त्यत्रयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne cikiddhyasya na idaṃ vacaḥ sahasya | taṃ tvā suśipra dampate stomairvardhantyatrayo gīrbhiḥ śumbhantyatrayaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, son of strength, recognize the words of this our (laudation); handsome-chinned, lord of the dwelling, the sons of Atri exalt you, such (as you are), by thei rpraise; they embellish you by their hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने सहन्तमा भर द्युम्नस्य प्रासहा रयिम् । विश्वा यश्चर्षणीरभ्यासा वाजेषु सासहत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne sahantamā bhara dyumnasya prāsahā rayim | viśvā yaścarṣaṇīrabhyāsā vājeṣu sāsahat ||

translations.english: Bestow, Agni, upon Dyumna, a son, overcoming foes by his prowess; one who may with glory subdue all men in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: तमग्ने पृतनाषहं रयिं सहस्व आ भर । त्वं हि सत्यो अद्भुतो दाता वाजस्य गोमतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamagne pṛtanāṣahaṃ rayiṃ sahasva ā bhara | tvaṃ hi satyo adbhuto dātā vājasya gomataḥ ||

translations.english: Mighty Agni, grant us a son able to encounter hosts; for you are true and wonderful, and the giver of food with cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वे हि त्वा सजोषसो जनासो वृक्तबर्हिषः । होतारं सद्मसु प्रियं व्यन्ति वार्या पुरु ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśve hi tvā sajoṣaso janāso vṛktabarhiṣaḥ | hotāraṃ sadmasu priyaṃ vyanti vāryā puru ||

translations.english: Allmen concurring in satisfaction, bearing the clipped sacred grass, solicit you, as the kind invoker of the gods, to the chambers (of sacrifice) for infinite wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: स हि ष्मा विश्वचर्षणिरभिमाति सहो दधे । अग्न एषु क्षयेष्वा रेवन्नः शुक्र दीदिहि द्युमत्पावक दीदिहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa hi ṣmā viśvacarṣaṇirabhimāti saho dadhe | agna eṣu kṣayeṣvā revannaḥ śukra dīdihi dyumatpāvaka dīdihi ||

translations.english: May the (sage) on whom all men rely possess foe-subduing strength; radiant Agni, so shine in our habitation that they may abound in riches; shine, purifying Agni, dispensing light.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने त्वं नो अन्तम उत त्राता शिवो भवा वरूथ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne tvaṃ no antama uta trātā śivo bhavā varūthyaḥ ||

translations.english: [1-2] Agni, who are to be adored, be ever nigh to us, our protector and benefactor; do you, who are the giver of dwellings and dispenser of food, be present with us; bestow upon us most brilliant wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: वसुरग्निर्वसुश्रवा अच्छा नक्षि द्युमत्तमं रयिं दाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vasuragnirvasuśravā acchā nakṣi dyumattamaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: स नो बोधि श्रुधी हवमुरुष्या णो अघायतः समस्मात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no bodhi śrudhī havamuruṣyā ṇo aghāyataḥ samasmāt ||

translations.english: [3-4] Understand us, Agni; hear our invocation; defend us from all malevolent (people); most bright and resplendent Agni, we earnestly solicit you for the happiness (of ourselves) and our friends.

mantras.sanskrit: तं त्वा शोचिष्ठ दीदिवः सुम्नाय नूनमीमहे सखिभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ tvā śociṣṭha dīdivaḥ sumnāya nūnamīmahe sakhibhyaḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: अच्छा वो अग्निमवसे देवं गासि स नो वसुः । रासत्पुत्र ऋषूणामृतावा पर्षति द्विषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: acchā vo agnimavase devaṃ gāsi sa no vasuḥ | rāsatputra ṛṣūṇāmṛtāvā parṣati dviṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Celebrate the divine Agni for his protection; may he who presides over dwellings grant (our desires); may the son of the ṛṣis, the observers of truth, save us from those who hate us.

mantras.sanskrit: स हि सत्यो यं पूर्वे चिद्देवासश्चिद्यमीधिरे । होतारं मन्द्रजिह्वमित्सुदीतिभिर्विभावसुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa hi satyo yaṃ pūrve ciddevāsaścidyamīdhire | hotāraṃ mandrajihvamitsudītibhirvibhāvasum ||

translations.english: That Agni is true whom ancients, whom the gods have kindled, as the bright-tongued invoker of the gods, radiant with holy splendours.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो धीती वरिष्ठया श्रेष्ठया च सुमत्या । अग्ने रायो दिदीहि नः सुवृक्तिभिर्वरेण्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no dhītī variṣṭhayā śreṣṭhayā ca sumatyā | agne rāyo didīhi naḥ suvṛktibhirvareṇya ||

translations.english: Agni, to be propitiated by praises, (gratified) by our choice and most excellent adoration and hymns, bestow upon us riches.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निर्देवेषु राजत्यग्निर्मर्तेष्वाविशन् । अग्निर्नो हव्यवाहनोऽग्निं धीभिः सपर्यत ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirdeveṣu rājatyagnirmarteṣvāviśan | agnirno havyavāhano'gniṃ dhībhiḥ saparyata ||

translations.english: Agni shines among the gods; Agni is present among mortals; Agni is the bearer of our oblations glorify Agni with praises.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निस्तुविश्रवस्तमं तुविब्रह्माणमुत्तमम् । अतूर्तं श्रावयत्पतिं पुत्रं ददाति दाशुषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnistuviśravastamaṃ tuvibrahmāṇamuttamam | atūrtaṃ śrāvayatpatiṃ putraṃ dadāti dāśuṣe ||

translations.english: May Agni bestow upon the donor (of the oblation) son, abounding in food, abounding in devotion, excellent, unharmed, conferring honour upon his progenitors.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निर्ददाति सत्पतिं सासाह यो युधा नृभिः । अग्निरत्यं रघुष्यदं जेतारमपराजितम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirdadāti satpatiṃ sāsāha yo yudhā nṛbhiḥ | agniratyaṃ raghuṣyadaṃ jetāramaparājitam ||

translations.english: May Agni bestow a son, the protector of the good, who, with his followers, may be victorious in battle; may he bestow a swift-footed steed, conquering, unconquered.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्वाहिष्ठं तदग्नये बृहदर्च विभावसो । महिषीव त्वद्रयिस्त्वद्वाजा उदीरते ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadvāhiṣṭhaṃ tadagnaye bṛhadarca vibhāvaso | mahiṣīva tvadrayistvadvājā udīrate ||

translations.english: That (praise) which best conveys (our veneration, is due) to Agni; affluent in splendour, grant us, (Agni), great (wealth), for from you vast riches and ample food proceed.

mantras.sanskrit: तव द्युमन्तो अर्चयो ग्रावेवोच्यते बृहत् । उतो ते तन्यतुर्यथा स्वानो अर्त त्मना दिवः ॥
