mantras.transliteration: tava dyumanto arcayo grāvevocyate bṛhat | uto te tanyaturyathā svāno arta tmanā divaḥ ||

translations.english: Brilliant, Agni, are your rays; mighty are you termed, like the stone (that bruises the Soma), and your voice spontaneously spreads through the sky like thundeṛ

mantras.sanskrit: एवाँ अग्निं वसूयवः सहसानं ववन्दिम । स नो विश्वा अति द्विषः पर्षन्नावेव सुक्रतुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā~ agniṃ vasūyavaḥ sahasānaṃ vavandima | sa no viśvā ati dviṣaḥ parṣannāveva sukratuḥ ||

translations.english: Thus, we Vasuyus, glorify the vigorous Agni; may he, the performer of great deeds, enable us to pass over all our enemies as (we cross a river) with a boat.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने पावक रोचिषा मन्द्रया देव जिह्वया । आ देवान्वक्षि यक्षि च ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne pāvaka rociṣā mandrayā deva jihvayā | ā devānvakṣi yakṣi ca ||

translations.english: Divine purifier, Agni, with your radiant and plural asing tongue, bring hither and worship the gods

mantras.sanskrit: तं त्वा घृतस्नवीमहे चित्रभानो स्वर्दृशम् । देवाँ आ वीतये वह ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ tvā ghṛtasnavīmahe citrabhāno svardṛśam | devā~ ā vītaye vaha ||

translations.english: Feeder upon butter, bright and variegated radiance we solicit you, the beholder of heaven, to (partake of) the (sacrificial) food.

mantras.sanskrit: वीतिहोत्रं त्वा कवे द्युमन्तं समिधीमहि । अग्ने बृहन्तमध्वरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: vītihotraṃ tvā kave dyumantaṃ samidhīmahi | agne bṛhantamadhvare ||

translations.english: We kindle you at the sacrifice, wise Agni, whose food is the oblation, who are brilliant and vast.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने विश्वेभिरा गहि देवेभिर्हव्यदातये । होतारं त्वा वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne viśvebhirā gahi devebhirhavyadātaye | hotāraṃ tvā vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: Come, Agni, with all the gods, to the donor (of the oblation); we have recourse to you as their invoker.

mantras.sanskrit: यजमानाय सुन्वत आग्ने सुवीर्यं वह । देवैरा सत्सि बर्हिषि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajamānāya sunvata āgne suvīryaṃ vaha | devairā satsi barhiṣi ||

translations.english: To the instrumental tutor of the rite, pouring out the libation, bring excellent vigour; sit down with the gods upon the sacred grass.

mantras.sanskrit: समिधानः सहस्रजिदग्ने धर्माणि पुष्यसि । देवानां दूत उक्थ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samidhānaḥ sahasrajidagne dharmāṇi puṣyasi | devānāṃ dūta ukthyaḥ ||

translations.english: Victor over thousands, you favour, when kindled our holy rites, the honoured messenger of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: न्यग्निं जातवेदसं होत्रवाहं यविष्ठ्यम् । दधाता देवमृत्विजम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nyagniṃ jātavedasaṃ hotravāhaṃ yaviṣṭhyam | dadhātā devamṛtvijam ||

translations.english: Reverence Agni, by whom all that is, is known, the bearer of oblations, the young of the gods, the divine, the ministrant priest.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र यज्ञ एत्वानुषगद्या देवव्यचस्तमः । स्तृणीत बर्हिरासदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra yajña etvānuṣagadyā devavyacastamaḥ | stṛṇīta barhirāsade ||

translations.english: May the sacrifice most solemnly offered by the devout duly proceed today (to the gods); spread the sacred grass for their seat.

mantras.sanskrit: एदं मरुतो अश्विना मित्रः सीदन्तु वरुणः । देवासः सर्वया विशा ॥
mantras.transliteration: edaṃ maruto aśvinā mitraḥ sīdantu varuṇaḥ | devāsaḥ sarvayā viśā ||

translations.english: May the Maruts, the Aśvins, Mitra, Varuṇa, the gods, with all their attendants, sit down upon this grass.

mantras.sanskrit: अनस्वन्ता सत्पतिर्मामहे मे गावा चेतिष्ठो असुरो मघोनः । त्रैवृष्णो अग्ने दशभिः सहस्रैर्वैश्वानर त्र्यरुणश्चिकेत ॥
mantras.transliteration: anasvantā satpatirmāmahe me gāvā cetiṣṭho asuro maghonaḥ | traivṛṣṇo agne daśabhiḥ sahasrairvaiśvānara tryaruṇaściketa ||

translations.english: Agni who are the protector of the good, most wise, powerful and opulent; Tryaruṇa, the son of Trivṛṣṇa, has become renowned, Vaiśvānara, in that he has bestowed upon me a pair of cattle with a wagon, and with them thousands of treasure.

mantras.sanskrit: यो मे शता च विंशतिं च गोनां हरी च युक्ता सुधुरा ददाति । वैश्वानर सुष्टुतो वावृधानोऽग्ने यच्छ त्र्यरुणाय शर्म ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo me śatā ca viṃśatiṃ ca gonāṃ harī ca yuktā sudhurā dadāti | vaiśvānara suṣṭuto vāvṛdhāno'gne yaccha tryaruṇāya śarma ||

translations.english: Agni, Vaiśvānara, who are deservedly praised and exaulted (by us), bestow happiness upon Tryaruṇa, who gives me hundreds (of Suvarṇas), twenty cattle and a pair of burden-bearing horses.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा ते अग्ने सुमतिं चकानो नविष्ठाय नवमं त्रसदस्युः । यो मे गिरस्तुविजातस्य पूर्वीर्युक्तेनाभि त्र्यरुणो गृणाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā te agne sumatiṃ cakāno naviṣṭhāya navamaṃ trasadasyuḥ | yo me girastuvijātasya pūrvīryuktenābhi tryaruṇo gṛṇāti ||

translations.english: As Tryaruṇa, plural ased by the eulogies of me who has many children, presses with earnest (mind, gifts upon me), so does Trasadsyu, desirous Agni, of your valued favour through your exceeding praise.

mantras.sanskrit: यो म इति प्रवोचत्यश्वमेधाय सूरये । दददृचा सनिं यते ददन्मेधामृतायते ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo ma iti pravocatyaśvamedhāya sūraye | dadadṛcā saniṃ yate dadanmedhāmṛtāyate ||

translations.english: When Aśvamedha gives to him who solicits of him as a benefactor, saying (bestow wealth) upon me, and comes (to him) with a verse (in your praise), do you, Agni, grant intelligence to (the Rājā) who wishes to offer sacrifice (to you).

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य मा परुषाः शतमुद्धर्षयन्त्युक्षणः । अश्वमेधस्य दानाः सोमा इव त्र्याशिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya mā paruṣāḥ śatamuddharṣayantyukṣaṇaḥ | aśvamedhasya dānāḥ somā iva tryāśiraḥ ||

translations.english: Whose hundred robust oxen yield me delight, as triple-mixed Soma, the offering of Aśvamedha (gratifies you).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी शतदाव्न्यश्वमेधे सुवीर्यम् । क्षत्रं धारयतं बृहद्दिवि सूर्यमिवाजरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāgnī śatadāvnyaśvamedhe suvīryam | kṣatraṃ dhārayataṃ bṛhaddivi sūryamivājaram ||

translations.english: Indra and Agni, bestow upon the munificent Aśvamedha infinite wealth with excellent posterity, undecaying as the sun in heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: समिद्धो अग्निर्दिवि शोचिरश्रेत्प्रत्यङ्ङुषसमुर्विया वि भाति । एति प्राची विश्ववारा नमोभिर्देवाँ ईळाना हविषा घृताची ॥
mantras.transliteration: samiddho agnirdivi śociraśretpratyaṅṅuṣasamurviyā vi bhāti | eti prācī viśvavārā namobhirdevā~ īḷānā haviṣā ghṛtācī ||

translations.english: Agni, when kindled, spreads lustre through the firmament, and shines widely in the presence of the dawn; Viśvavārā, facing the east, glorifying the gods with praises, and bearing the ladle with the oblation, proceeds (to the sacred fire).

mantras.sanskrit: समिध्यमानो अमृतस्य राजसि हविष्कृण्वन्तं सचसे स्वस्तये । विश्वं स धत्ते द्रविणं यमिन्वस्यातिथ्यमग्ने नि च धत्त इत्पुरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samidhyamāno amṛtasya rājasi haviṣkṛṇvantaṃ sacase svastaye | viśvaṃ sa dhatte draviṇaṃ yaminvasyātithyamagne ni ca dhatta itpuraḥ ||

translations.english: When about to be kindled, Agni, you rule over ambrosial (water); you are present with the offerer of the oblation for his welfare; he to whom you repair acquires universal wealth; he plural ces you, Agni the dues of hospitality.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने शर्ध महते सौभगाय तव द्युम्नान्युत्तमानि सन्तु । सं जास्पत्यं सुयममा कृणुष्व शत्रूयतामभि तिष्ठा महांसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne śardha mahate saubhagāya tava dyumnānyuttamāni santu | saṃ jāspatyaṃ suyamamā kṛṇuṣva śatrūyatāmabhi tiṣṭhā mahāṃsi ||

translations.english: Repress, Agni, (our foes to ensure our) exceeding prosperity; may your riches ever be excellent; preserve in concord the relation of man and wife, and overpower the energies of the hostile.

mantras.sanskrit: समिद्धस्य प्रमहसोऽग्ने वन्दे तव श्रियम् । वृषभो द्युम्नवाँ असि समध्वरेष्विध्यसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: samiddhasya pramahaso'gne vande tava śriyam | vṛṣabho dyumnavā~ asi samadhvareṣvidhyase ||

translations.english: I praise the glory, Agni, of you when kindled and blazing fiercely; you are the affluent showerer (of benefits), you are fitly lighted at sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: समिद्धो अग्न आहुत देवान्यक्षि स्वध्वर । त्वं हि हव्यवाळसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: samiddho agna āhuta devānyakṣi svadhvara | tvaṃ hi havyavāḷasi ||

translations.english: Agni, who are kindled and invoked, worship the gods at the holy rite, for you are the bearer of the oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: आ जुहोता दुवस्यताग्निं प्रयत्यध्वरे । वृणीध्वं हव्यवाहनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā juhotā duvasyatāgniṃ prayatyadhvare | vṛṇīdhvaṃ havyavāhanam ||

translations.english: Offer worship and adoration to Agni when the sacrifice is solemnized; select the bearer of the oblation to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: त्र्यर्यमा मनुषो देवताता त्री रोचना दिव्या धारयन्त । अर्चन्ति त्वा मरुतः पूतदक्षास्त्वमेषामृषिरिन्द्रासि धीरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tryaryamā manuṣo devatātā trī rocanā divyā dhārayanta | arcanti tvā marutaḥ pūtadakṣāstvameṣāmṛṣirindrāsi dhīraḥ ||

translations.english: In the adoration of the gods by Manu there are three effulgences, and they, (the Maruts), uphold three luminaries in heaven; the Maruts of pure energy worship you, for you, Indra, are their intelligent ṛṣi

mantras.sanskrit: अनु यदीं मरुतो मन्दसानमार्चन्निन्द्रं पपिवांसं सुतस्य । आदत्त वज्रमभि यदहिं हन्नपो यह्वीरसृजत्सर्तवा उ ॥
mantras.transliteration: anu yadīṃ maruto mandasānamārcannindraṃ papivāṃsaṃ sutasya | ādatta vajramabhi yadahiṃ hannapo yahvīrasṛjatsartavā u ||

translations.english: When the Maruts worship Indra, exulting and drinking of the effused libation, he grasps the thunderbolt wherewith he destroys Ahi, and sets the abundant waters free to flow.

mantras.sanskrit: उत ब्रह्माणो मरुतो मे अस्येन्द्रः सोमस्य सुषुतस्य पेयाः । तद्धि हव्यं मनुषे गा अविन्ददहन्नहिं पपिवाँ इन्द्रो अस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta brahmāṇo maruto me asyendraḥ somasya suṣutasya peyāḥ | taddhi havyaṃ manuṣe gā avindadahannahiṃ papivā~ indro asya ||

translations.english: Or,mighty Maruts, and you also, Indra, drink of this my copiously-effused libation; then the offered libation obtains cattle for the offerer, and Indra, drinking of it, kills Ahi.

mantras.sanskrit: आद्रोदसी वितरं वि ष्कभायत्संविव्यानश्चिद्भियसे मृगं कः । जिगर्तिमिन्द्रो अपजर्गुराणः प्रति श्वसन्तमव दानवं हन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ādrodasī vitaraṃ vi ṣkabhāyatsaṃvivyānaścidbhiyase mṛgaṃ kaḥ | jigartimindro apajargurāṇaḥ prati śvasantamava dānavaṃ han ||

translations.english: Thereupon he fixed firmly heaven and earth, and resolutely advancing, filled (Vṛtra), like a deer, with terror, stripping off his covering, Indra, slew the Dānava, endeavouring to hide, and panting with affright.

mantras.sanskrit: अध क्रत्वा मघवन्तुभ्यं देवा अनु विश्वे अददुः सोमपेयम् । यत्सूर्यस्य हरितः पतन्तीः पुरः सतीरुपरा एतशे कः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha kratvā maghavantubhyaṃ devā anu viśve adaduḥ somapeyam | yatsūryasya haritaḥ patantīḥ puraḥ satīruparā etaśe kaḥ ||

translations.english: Then, for this exploit, all the gods gave you Maghavan, in succession, the Soma beverage; whence you have retarded, for the sake of Etaśa, the advancing horses of the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: नव यदस्य नवतिं च भोगान्त्साकं वज्रेण मघवा विवृश्चत् । अर्चन्तीन्द्रं मरुतः सधस्थे त्रैष्टुभेन वचसा बाधत द्याम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nava yadasya navatiṃ ca bhogāntsākaṃ vajreṇa maghavā vivṛścat | arcantīndraṃ marutaḥ sadhasthe traiṣṭubhena vacasā bādhata dyām ||

translations.english: Whereupon Maghavan has destroyed with his thunderbolt at once his (Śambara's) ninety and nine cities; the Maruts glorifying Indra in a common dwelling with the Triṣṭubh hymn, he destroyed the bright (city of the asura).

mantras.sanskrit: सखा सख्ये अपचत्तूयमग्निरस्य क्रत्वा महिषा त्री शतानि । त्री साकमिन्द्रो मनुषः सरांसि सुतं पिबद्वृत्रहत्याय सोमम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sakhā sakhye apacattūyamagnirasya kratvā mahiṣā trī śatāni | trī sākamindro manuṣaḥ sarāṃsi sutaṃ pibadvṛtrahatyāya somam ||

translations.english: To aid (the undertaking of) his friend, Agni, the friend (of Indra) has quickly consumed three hundred buffaloes; and Indra, for the destruction of Vṛtra, has at once quaffed vessels of Soma, offered by Manu.

mantras.sanskrit: त्री यच्छता महिषाणामघो मास्त्री सरांसि मघवा सोम्यापाः । कारं न विश्वे अह्वन्त देवा भरमिन्द्राय यदहिं जघान ॥
mantras.transliteration: trī yacchatā mahiṣāṇāmagho māstrī sarāṃsi maghavā somyāpāḥ | kāraṃ na viśve ahvanta devā bharamindrāya yadahiṃ jaghāna ||

translations.english: When you had eaten the flesh of the three hundred buffaloes, when you who are Maghavan had drunk the three vessels of Soma, when he had slain Ahi, then all the gods summoned Indra, full of food, as if he had been a servant, to the battle.

mantras.sanskrit: उशना यत्सहस्यैरयातं गृहमिन्द्र जूजुवानेभिरश्वैः । वन्वानो अत्र सरथं ययाथ कुत्सेन देवैरवनोर्ह शुष्णम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uśanā yatsahasyairayātaṃ gṛhamindra jūjuvānebhiraśvaiḥ | vanvāno atra sarathaṃ yayātha kutsena devairavanorha śuṣṇam ||

translations.english: When, Indra, you and Uśanas, with vigorous and rapid courses went to the dwelling of Kutsa, then destroying his foes, you went in one chariot with Kutsa and the gods, and verily you have slain Śuṣṇa

mantras.sanskrit: प्रान्यच्चक्रमवृहः सूर्यस्य कुत्सायान्यद्वरिवो यातवेऽकः । अनासो दस्यूँरमृणो वधेन नि दुर्योण आवृणङ्मृध्रवाचः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prānyaccakramavṛhaḥ sūryasya kutsāyānyadvarivo yātave'kaḥ | anāso dasyū~ramṛṇo vadhena ni duryoṇa āvṛṇaṅmṛdhravācaḥ ||

translations.english: You have formerly detached one wheel (of the car) of Sūrya; another you have given to Kutsa wherewith to acquire wealth; with the thunderbolt you have confounded the voiceless Dasyus, you have destroyed in battle the speech-bereft (foes).

mantras.sanskrit: स्तोमासस्त्वा गौरिवीतेरवर्धन्नरन्धयो वैदथिनाय पिप्रुम् । आ त्वामृजिश्वा सख्याय चक्रे पचन्पक्तीरपिबः सोममस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: stomāsastvā gaurivīteravardhannarandhayo vaidathināya piprum | ā tvāmṛjiśvā sakhyāya cakre pacanpaktīrapibaḥ somamasya ||

translations.english: May the praises of Gaurivīti exalt you; you have humbled Pipru for the son of Vidathin; Ṛjiśvan preparing dressed viands, has, through your friendship brought you (to his presence), and you have drunk of his libation.

mantras.sanskrit: नवग्वासः सुतसोमास इन्द्रं दशग्वासो अभ्यर्चन्त्यर्कैः । गव्यं चिदूर्वमपिधानवन्तं तं चिन्नरः शशमाना अप व्रन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: navagvāsaḥ sutasomāsa indraṃ daśagvāso abhyarcantyarkaiḥ | gavyaṃ cidūrvamapidhānavantaṃ taṃ cinnaraḥ śaśamānā apa vran ||

translations.english: The observers of the nine month's celebration, those of the ten months, pouring out libations, worship Indra with hymns; the leaders (of rites), glorifying him, have set open the cave (concealing the cattle).

mantras.sanskrit: कथो नु ते परि चराणि विद्वान्वीर्या मघवन्या चकर्थ । या चो नु नव्या कृणवः शविष्ठ प्रेदु ता ते विदथेषु ब्रवाम ॥
mantras.transliteration: katho nu te pari carāṇi vidvānvīryā maghavanyā cakartha | yā co nu navyā kṛṇavaḥ śaviṣṭha predu tā te vidatheṣu bravāma ||

translations.english: Although, knowing the heroic acts which, Maghavan, you have performed, how may I adequately offer you adoration; most mighty Indra, we ever celebrate sacred rites the recent exploits which you have achieved.

mantras.sanskrit: एता विश्वा चकृवाँ इन्द्र भूर्यपरीतो जनुषा वीर्येण । या चिन्नु वज्रिन्कृणवो दधृष्वान्न ते वर्ता तविष्या अस्ति तस्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: etā viśvā cakṛvā~ indra bhūryaparīto januṣā vīryeṇa | yā cinnu vajrinkṛṇavo dadhṛṣvānna te vartā taviṣyā asti tasyāḥ ||

translations.english: Unmatched (by any), you have done, Indra, all these many (deeds) by your innate energy; wielder of the thunderbolt, whatever you, the humbler of (foes), have undertaken, there is no one the arrester of this your prowess.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र ब्रह्म क्रियमाणा जुषस्व या ते शविष्ठ नव्या अकर्म । वस्त्रेव भद्रा सुकृता वसूयू रथं न धीरः स्वपा अतक्षम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra brahma kriyamāṇā juṣasva yā te śaviṣṭha navyā akarma | vastreva bhadrā sukṛtā vasūyū rathaṃ na dhīraḥ svapā atakṣam ||

translations.english: Most mighty Indra, be plural ased to accept the prayers which we are about to offer, and the present praises which we repeat; firm, doing pious acts, and desirous of wealth; I have fabricated acceptable and pious works like (rich) garments, and like a chariot.

mantras.sanskrit: क्व स्य वीरः को अपश्यदिन्द्रं सुखरथमीयमानं हरिभ्याम् । यो राया वज्री सुतसोममिच्छन्तदोको गन्ता पुरुहूत ऊती ॥
mantras.transliteration: kva sya vīraḥ ko apaśyadindraṃ sukharathamīyamānaṃ haribhyām | yo rāyā vajrī sutasomamicchantadoko gantā puruhūta ūtī ||

translations.english: Where is that hero? who has seen Indra seated in his easy chariot travelling with his horses, the thunder, the invoked of many, who, desirous of the libation is proceeding with riches to the habitation (of his worshipper) for his preservation?

mantras.sanskrit: अवाचचक्षं पदमस्य सस्वरुग्रं निधातुरन्वायमिच्छन् । अपृच्छमन्याँ उत ते म आहुरिन्द्रं नरो बुबुधाना अशेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: avācacakṣaṃ padamasya sasvarugraṃ nidhāturanvāyamicchan | apṛcchamanyā~ uta te ma āhurindraṃ naro bubudhānā aśema ||

translations.english: I have looked down upon the secret and fearful plural ce of his abiding; I have repaired, desiring him, (to the plural ce of) the self-sustainer; I have inquired (of him) from others; they, the leaders (of rites), the search after wisdom, have said to me, let us have recourse to Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र नु वयं सुते या ते कृतानीन्द्र ब्रवाम यानि नो जुजोषः । वेददविद्वाञ्छृणवच्च विद्वान्वहतेऽयं मघवा सर्वसेनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra nu vayaṃ sute yā te kṛtānīndra bravāma yāni no jujoṣaḥ | vedadavidvāñchṛṇavacca vidvānvahate'yaṃ maghavā sarvasenaḥ ||

translations.english: When the libation is offered, Indra, we celebrate your exploits; those (exploits) which you have been praised (to achieve) for us; let him who is ignorant acquire knowledge (of them); let him who is acquainted (with them) make them known; this Maghavan (is) the lord of hosts.

mantras.sanskrit: स्थिरं मनश्चकृषे जात इन्द्र वेषीदेको युधये भूयसश्चित् । अश्मानं चिच्छवसा दिद्युतो वि विदो गवामूर्वमुस्रियाणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sthiraṃ manaścakṛṣe jāta indra veṣīdeko yudhaye bhūyasaścit | aśmānaṃ cicchavasā didyuto vi vido gavāmūrvamusriyāṇām ||

translations.english: As soon as genitive rated, Indra, you have made your mind resolved; you have gone alone to contend against numerous (foes); you have rent asunder the rock by your strength; you have rescued the herd of milk-yielding kine.

mantras.sanskrit: परो यत्त्वं परम आजनिष्ठाः परावति श्रुत्यं नाम बिभ्रत् । अतश्चिदिन्द्रादभयन्त देवा विश्वा अपो अजयद्दासपत्नीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: paro yattvaṃ parama ājaniṣṭhāḥ parāvati śrutyaṃ nāma bibhrat | ataścidindrādabhayanta devā viśvā apo ajayaddāsapatnīḥ ||

translations.english: When you have been born most excellent and supreme, bearing a name widely renowned, then the gods have been in dread of Indra, and he has subjugated all the waters, the brides of the slave (Vṛtra).

mantras.sanskrit: तुभ्येदेते मरुतः सुशेवा अर्चन्त्यर्कं सुन्वन्त्यन्धः । अहिमोहानमप आशयानं प्र मायाभिर्मायिनं सक्षदिन्द्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tubhyedete marutaḥ suśevā arcantyarkaṃ sunvantyandhaḥ | ahimohānamapa āśayānaṃ pra māyābhirmāyinaṃ sakṣadindraḥ ||

translations.english: These devoted Maruts eulogise you with pious praise, and pour out to you the sacrificial food; Indra has overcome by his device the guileful Ahi, harassing the gods and arresting the waters.

mantras.sanskrit: वि षू मृधो जनुषा दानमिन्वन्नहन्गवा मघवन्त्संचकानः । अत्रा दासस्य नमुचेः शिरो यदवर्तयो मनवे गातुमिच्छन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi ṣū mṛdho januṣā dānaminvannahangavā maghavantsaṃcakānaḥ | atrā dāsasya namuceḥ śiro yadavartayo manave gātumicchan ||

translations.english: Maghavan, who are glorified by us, assailing with the thunderbolt the antagonist (of the gods), you have slain those who were ever hostile (to you) from your birth; desiring to do good to Manu, you have bruised the head of the slave Namuci.

mantras.sanskrit: युजं हि मामकृथा आदिदिन्द्र शिरो दासस्य नमुचेर्मथायन् । अश्मानं चित्स्वर्यं वर्तमानं प्र चक्रियेव रोदसी मरुद्भ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yujaṃ hi māmakṛthā ādidindra śiro dāsasya namucermathāyan | aśmānaṃ citsvaryaṃ vartamānaṃ pra cakriyeva rodasī marudbhyaḥ ||

translations.english: Verily you have made me, Indra, your associate when grinding the head of the slave Namuci like a sounding and rolling cloud; and the heaven and earth (have been caused) by the Maruts (to revolve like a wheel).

mantras.sanskrit: स्त्रियो हि दास आयुधानि चक्रे किं मा करन्नबला अस्य सेनाः । अन्तर्ह्यख्यदुभे अस्य धेने अथोप प्रैद्युधये दस्युमिन्द्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: striyo hi dāsa āyudhāni cakre kiṃ mā karannabalā asya senāḥ | antarhyakhyadubhe asya dhene athopa praidyudhaye dasyumindraḥ ||

translations.english: The slave (Namuci) made women his weapons what will his feminine le hosts do unto me? The two his best beloved, (Indra) confined in the inner apartments, and then went forth to combat against the Dasyus.

mantras.sanskrit: समत्र गावोऽभितोऽनवन्तेहेह वत्सैर्वियुता यदासन् । सं ता इन्द्रो असृजदस्य शाकैर्यदीं सोमासः सुषुता अमन्दन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: samatra gāvo'bhito'navanteheha vatsairviyutā yadāsan | saṃ tā indro asṛjadasya śākairyadīṃ somāsaḥ suṣutā amandan ||

translations.english: When the cows were separated from their calves, they wandered about hither and thither; but when the well-offered libations had exhilarated hi, then Indra, with his vigorous (maruts), reunited them (with their calves).

mantras.sanskrit: यदीं सोमा बभ्रुधूता अमन्दन्नरोरवीद्वृषभः सादनेषु । पुरंदरः पपिवाँ इन्द्रो अस्य पुनर्गवामददादुस्रियाणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadīṃ somā babhrudhūtā amandannaroravīdvṛṣabhaḥ sādaneṣu | puraṃdaraḥ papivā~ indro asya punargavāmadadādusriyāṇām ||

translations.english: When the libations effused by Babhru had exhilarated him, the showerer (of benefits) shouted aloud in the combats; Indra, the destroyer fo cities, quaffing (the Soma), restored to him his milk-yielding cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: भद्रमिदं रुशमा अग्ने अक्रन्गवां चत्वारि ददतः सहस्रा । ऋणंचयस्य प्रयता मघानि प्रत्यग्रभीष्म नृतमस्य नृणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhadramidaṃ ruśamā agne akrangavāṃ catvāri dadataḥ sahasrā | ṛṇaṃcayasya prayatā maghāni pratyagrabhīṣma nṛtamasya nṛṇām ||

translations.english: The Suśamās giving me four thousand cows, Agni, have done well; we have accepted the wealth, the donation of the leader of leaders rṇañcaya.

mantras.sanskrit: सुपेशसं माव सृजन्त्यस्तं गवां सहस्रै रुशमासो अग्ने । तीव्रा इन्द्रमममन्दुः सुतासोऽक्तोर्व्युष्टौ परितक्म्यायाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: supeśasaṃ māva sṛjantyastaṃ gavāṃ sahasrai ruśamāso agne | tīvrā indramamamanduḥ sutāso'ktorvyuṣṭau paritakmyāyāḥ ||

translations.english: The Ruśamās, Agni, have presented to me a beautiful abode, with thousands of cattle; the sharp libations have exhilarated Indra upon the breaking up of the (gloom-) investing night.

mantras.sanskrit: औच्छत्सा रात्री परितक्म्या याँ ऋणंचये राजनि रुशमानाम् । अत्यो न वाजी रघुरज्यमानो बभ्रुश्चत्वार्यसनत्सहस्रा ॥
mantras.transliteration: aucchatsā rātrī paritakmyā yā~ ṛṇaṃcaye rājani ruśamānām | atyo na vājī raghurajyamāno babhruścatvāryasanatsahasrā ||

translations.english: The (gloom-) investing night has dispersed with the dawn (upon the appearance of) Ṛṇañcaya, the rājā of the ruśamās; Babhru being summoned, going like a fleet courser, has received the four thousand (cattle).

mantras.sanskrit: चतुःसहस्रं गव्यस्य पश्वः प्रत्यग्रभीष्म रुशमेष्वग्ने । घर्मश्चित्तप्तः प्रवृजे य आसीदयस्मयस्तम्वादाम विप्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: catuḥsahasraṃ gavyasya paśvaḥ pratyagrabhīṣma ruśameṣvagne | gharmaścittaptaḥ pravṛje ya āsīdayasmayastamvādāma viprāḥ ||

translations.english: We have accepted, Agni, the four thousand cattle from the Ruśamās; and the glowing, the golden ewer prepared for the solemnity, we who are wise have accepted it.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रो रथाय प्रवतं कृणोति यमध्यस्थान्मघवा वाजयन्तम् । यूथेव पश्वो व्युनोति गोपा अरिष्टो याति प्रथमः सिषासन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indro rathāya pravataṃ kṛṇoti yamadhyasthānmaghavā vājayantam | yūtheva paśvo vyunoti gopā ariṣṭo yāti prathamaḥ siṣāsan ||

translations.english: Indra, the possessor of opulence, directs downwards the car over which, intended (to receive sacrificial) viands, he presides; he proceeds unimpeded, the first of the gods, driving (his enemies before him), as a herdsman drives the herds of cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: आ प्र द्रव हरिवो मा वि वेनः पिशङ्गराते अभि नः सचस्व । नहि त्वदिन्द्र वस्यो अन्यदस्त्यमेनाँश्चिज्जनिवतश्चकर्थ ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā pra drava harivo mā vi venaḥ piśaṅgarāte abhi naḥ sacasva | nahi tvadindra vasyo anyadastyamenā~ścijjanivataścakartha ||

translations.english: Hasten to us, lord of horses; be not indifferent to us; distributor of manifold wealth, befriend us; for there is nothing else that is better, Indra, than you; you have given wives to those who were without women.

mantras.sanskrit: उद्यत्सहः सहस आजनिष्ट देदिष्ट इन्द्र इन्द्रियाणि विश्वा । प्राचोदयत्सुदुघा वव्रे अन्तर्वि ज्योतिषा संववृत्वत्तमोऽवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: udyatsahaḥ sahasa ājaniṣṭa dediṣṭa indra indriyāṇi viśvā | prācodayatsudughā vavre antarvi jyotiṣā saṃvavṛtvattamo'vaḥ ||

translations.english: When the light (of the sun) overpowers the light (of the dawn) Indra grants all (sorts of) wealth (to the worshipper); he has liberated the kine from the interior of the obstructing (mountain); he dissipates the enveloping darkness with light.

mantras.sanskrit: अनवस्ते रथमश्वाय तक्षन्त्वष्टा वज्रं पुरुहूत द्युमन्तम् । ब्रह्माण इन्द्रं महयन्तो अर्कैरवर्धयन्नहये हन्तवा उ ॥
mantras.transliteration: anavaste rathamaśvāya takṣantvaṣṭā vajraṃ puruhūta dyumantam | brahmāṇa indraṃ mahayanto arkairavardhayannahaye hantavā u ||

translations.english: The Ṛbhus have fabricated your car, Indra, the invoked of many, adapted to its horses; Tvaṣṭā (had made) your radiant thunderbolt; the venerable (Aṅgirasas), praising Indra with hymns, have given him vigour for the destruction of Ahi.

mantras.sanskrit: वृष्णे यत्ते वृषणो अर्कमर्चानिन्द्र ग्रावाणो अदितिः सजोषाः । अनश्वासो ये पवयोऽरथा इन्द्रेषिता अभ्यवर्तन्त दस्यून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣṇe yatte vṛṣaṇo arkamarcānindra grāvāṇo aditiḥ sajoṣāḥ | anaśvāso ye pavayo'rathā indreṣitā abhyavartanta dasyūn ||

translations.english: When the Maruts, the showerers (of benefits), glorify you, Indra, the showerer (of desires), with praises, and the exulting stones delight (to bruise the Soma), then, without horses, without chariots, they, the purifying (Maruts), dispatched by Indra, have overcome the Dasyus.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ते पूर्वाणि करणानि वोचं प्र नूतना मघवन्या चकर्थ । शक्तीवो यद्विभरा रोदसी उभे जयन्नपो मनवे दानुचित्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra te pūrvāṇi karaṇāni vocaṃ pra nūtanā maghavanyā cakartha | śaktīvo yadvibharā rodasī ubhe jayannapo manave dānucitrāḥ ||

translations.english: I celebrate, Maghavan, your ancient exploits, and those which you have newly achieved; wielder of the thunderbolt, subjugating both heaven and earth, you have distributed the wonderfully bountiful waters to man.

mantras.sanskrit: तदिन्नु ते करणं दस्म विप्राहिं यद्घ्नन्नोजो अत्रामिमीथाः । शुष्णस्य चित्परि माया अगृभ्णाः प्रपित्वं यन्नप दस्यूँरसेधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadinnu te karaṇaṃ dasma viprāhiṃ yadghnannojo atrāmimīthāḥ | śuṣṇasya citpari māyā agṛbhṇāḥ prapitvaṃ yannapa dasyū~rasedhaḥ ||

translations.english: Handsome and sagacious Indra, this is your deed, that, slaying Ahi, you have here displayed your vigour; you have arrested the devices of Śuṣṇa urging the combat; you have overcome the Dasyus.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमपो यदवे तुर्वशायारमयः सुदुघाः पार इन्द्र । उग्रमयातमवहो ह कुत्सं सं ह यद्वामुशनारन्त देवाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamapo yadave turvaśāyāramayaḥ sudughāḥ pāra indra | ugramayātamavaho ha kutsaṃ saṃ ha yadvāmuśanāranta devāḥ ||

translations.english: You, Indra, (abiding on the further bank), have rendered the fertilizing waters agreeable to Yadu and Turvaśu; you two, (Indra and Kutsa), have assailed the fierce (Śuṣṇa), and (having slain him), you have conveyed Kutsa (to his dwelling), and Uśanās and the gods have therefore honoured you both.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राकुत्सा वहमाना रथेना वामत्या अपि कर्णे वहन्तु । निः षीमद्भ्यो धमथो निः षधस्थान्मघोनो हृदो वरथस्तमांसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrākutsā vahamānā rathenā vāmatyā api karṇe vahantu | niḥ ṣīmadbhyo dhamatho niḥ ṣadhasthānmaghono hṛdo varathastamāṃsi ||

translations.english: May your steeds bring you both, Indra and Kutsa riding in one chariot, to the worshipper; you have expelled him (Śuṣṇa) from the waters, from his proper abode; you have driven the glooms (of ignorance) from the heart of the affluent (adorer).

mantras.sanskrit: वातस्य युक्तान्त्सुयुजश्चिदश्वान्कविश्चिदेषो अजगन्नवस्युः । विश्वे ते अत्र मरुतः सखाय इन्द्र ब्रह्माणि तविषीमवर्धन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vātasya yuktāntsuyujaścidaśvānkaviścideṣo ajagannavasyuḥ | viśve te atra marutaḥ sakhāya indra brahmāṇi taviṣīmavardhan ||

translations.english: The sage Avasyu has obtained docile horses, endowed (with the speed) of the wind; all your adorers, Indra, in this world, your friends, augment your vigour by their praises.

mantras.sanskrit: सूरश्चिद्रथं परितक्म्यायां पूर्वं करदुपरं जूजुवांसम् । भरच्चक्रमेतशः सं रिणाति पुरो दधत्सनिष्यति क्रतुं नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sūraścidrathaṃ paritakmyāyāṃ pūrvaṃ karaduparaṃ jūjuvāṃsam | bharaccakrametaśaḥ saṃ riṇāti puro dadhatsaniṣyati kratuṃ naḥ ||

translations.english: He, (Indra), has formerly arrested in battle the rapid chariot of the sun; Etaśa has born away the wheel, and (with it Indra) demolishes (his foes); may he, giving us precedence, be propitiated by our rite.

mantras.sanskrit: आयं जना अभिचक्षे जगामेन्द्रः सखायं सुतसोममिच्छन् । वदन्ग्रावाव वेदिं भ्रियाते यस्य जीरमध्वर्यवश्चरन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: āyaṃ janā abhicakṣe jagāmendraḥ sakhāyaṃ sutasomamicchan | vadangrāvāva vediṃ bhriyāte yasya jīramadhvaryavaścaranti ||

translations.english: Indra, oḥ people, has come to see you, wishing to behold his friend the offerer of the libation; let us creaking stones, for whose rotation the priests hasten, supply the altar.

mantras.sanskrit: ये चाकनन्त चाकनन्त नू ते मर्ता अमृत मो ते अंह आरन् । वावन्धि यज्यूँरुत तेषु धेह्योजो जनेषु येषु ते स्याम ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye cākananta cākananta nū te martā amṛta mo te aṃha āran | vāvandhi yajyū~ruta teṣu dhehyojo janeṣu yeṣu te syāma ||

translations.english: Immortal (Indra), let not the more wishing, anxiously wishing for you, fall into sin; be indeed plural ased with the sacrificers, and grant vigour to those men among whom may we be (especially) yours.

mantras.sanskrit: अदर्दरुत्समसृजो वि खानि त्वमर्णवान्बद्बधानाँ अरम्णाः । महान्तमिन्द्र पर्वतं वि यद्वः सृजो वि धारा अव दानवं हन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: adardarutsamasṛjo vi khāni tvamarṇavānbadbadhānā~ aramṇāḥ | mahāntamindra parvataṃ vi yadvaḥ sṛjo vi dhārā ava dānavaṃ han ||

translations.english: You, Indra, have rent the cloud asunder, you have set open the flood-gates, you have liberated the obstructed streams, you have opened the vast cloud, and have given vent to the showers, having slain the Dānava.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमुत्साँ ऋतुभिर्बद्बधानाँ अरंह ऊधः पर्वतस्य वज्रिन् । अहिं चिदुग्र प्रयुतं शयानं जघन्वाँ इन्द्र तविषीमधत्थाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamutsā~ ṛtubhirbadbadhānā~ araṃha ūdhaḥ parvatasya vajrin | ahiṃ cidugra prayutaṃ śayānaṃ jaghanvā~ indra taviṣīmadhatthāḥ ||

translations.english: You, thunder, (have set free) the obstructed clouds in their seasons; you have invigorated the strength of the cloud; fierce Indra, destroying the mighty Ahi when slumbering (in the waters), you have established the reputation of your prowess.

mantras.sanskrit: त्यस्य चिन्महतो निर्मृगस्य वधर्जघान तविषीभिरिन्द्रः । य एक इदप्रतिर्मन्यमान आदस्मादन्यो अजनिष्ट तव्यान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tyasya cinmahato nirmṛgasya vadharjaghāna taviṣībhirindraḥ | ya eka idapratirmanyamāna ādasmādanyo ajaniṣṭa tavyān ||

translations.english: Indra, by his prowess, has annihilated the weapon of that mighty beast, from whom another more powerful conceiving himself one and unmatched was genitive rated.

mantras.sanskrit: त्यं चिदेषां स्वधया मदन्तं मिहो नपातं सुवृधं तमोगाम् । वृषप्रभर्मा दानवस्य भामं वज्रेण वज्री नि जघान शुष्णम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tyaṃ cideṣāṃ svadhayā madantaṃ miho napātaṃ suvṛdhaṃ tamogām | vṛṣaprabharmā dānavasya bhāmaṃ vajreṇa vajrī ni jaghāna śuṣṇam ||

translations.english: The wielder of the thunderbolt, the render of the rain-cloud, has destroyed with his bolt the mighty Śuṣṇa, the wrath-born (son) of the Dānava, the walker in darkness, the protector of there showering cloud, exhilarating himself with the food of these (living creatures).

mantras.sanskrit: त्यं चिदस्य क्रतुभिर्निषत्तममर्मणो विददिदस्य मर्म । यदीं सुक्षत्र प्रभृता मदस्य युयुत्सन्तं तमसि हर्म्ये धाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tyaṃ cidasya kratubhirniṣattamamarmaṇo vidadidasya marma | yadīṃ sukṣatra prabhṛtā madasya yuyutsantaṃ tamasi harmye dhāḥ ||

translations.english: You have discovered, Indra, by his acts, the secret vital part of him who thought himself invulnerable, when, powerful Indra, in the exhilaration of the Soma, they have detected him preparing for combat in his dark abode.

mantras.sanskrit: त्यं चिदित्था कत्पयं शयानमसूर्ये तमसि वावृधानम् । तं चिन्मन्दानो वृषभः सुतस्योच्चैरिन्द्रो अपगूर्या जघान ॥
mantras.transliteration: tyaṃ ciditthā katpayaṃ śayānamasūrye tamasi vāvṛdhānam | taṃ cinmandāno vṛṣabhaḥ sutasyoccairindro apagūryā jaghāna ||

translations.english: Indra, the showerer (of benefits) exhilarated by the effused juices, uplifting (his thunderbolt), has slain him enjoying the dews of the firmament, sleeping (amidst the waters), and thriving in sunless darkness.

mantras.sanskrit: उद्यदिन्द्रो महते दानवाय वधर्यमिष्ट सहो अप्रतीतम् । यदीं वज्रस्य प्रभृतौ ददाभ विश्वस्य जन्तोरधमं चकार ॥
mantras.transliteration: udyadindro mahate dānavāya vadharyamiṣṭa saho apratītam | yadīṃ vajrasya prabhṛtau dadābha viśvasya jantoradhamaṃ cakāra ||

translations.english: When Indra raised his powerful irresistible weapon against the mighty Dānava, when he struck him with the blow of the thunderbolt, he made him the lowest of all creatures.

mantras.sanskrit: त्यं चिदर्णं मधुपं शयानमसिन्वं वव्रं मह्याददुग्रः । अपादमत्रं महता वधेन नि दुर्योण आवृणङ्मृध्रवाचम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tyaṃ cidarṇaṃ madhupaṃ śayānamasinvaṃ vavraṃ mahyādadugraḥ | apādamatraṃ mahatā vadhena ni duryoṇa āvṛṇaṅmṛdhravācam ||

translations.english: The fierce Indra seized upon him, that vast moving (Vṛtra), when slumbering, (after) having drunk the Soma, subduing (his foes), and enveloping (the world), and then slew him with his great weapons in battle, footless, measureless, speechless.

mantras.sanskrit: को अस्य शुष्मं तविषीं वरात एको धना भरते अप्रतीतः । इमे चिदस्य ज्रयसो नु देवी इन्द्रस्यौजसो भियसा जिहाते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ko asya śuṣmaṃ taviṣīṃ varāta eko dhanā bharate apratītaḥ | ime cidasya jrayaso nu devī indrasyaujaso bhiyasā jihāte ||

translations.english: Who may resist the withering might of that Indra; he, single and irresistible, carries off the riches (of the enemy); these two divine (beings, heaven and earth), proceed swiftly through fear of the strength of the quick-moving Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: न्यस्मै देवी स्वधितिर्जिहीत इन्द्राय गातुरुशतीव येमे । सं यदोजो युवते विश्वमाभिरनु स्वधाव्ने क्षितयो नमन्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: nyasmai devī svadhitirjihīta indrāya gāturuśatīva yeme | saṃ yadojo yuvate viśvamābhiranu svadhāvne kṣitayo namanta ||

translations.english: The divine, self-sustaining (heaven) comes to him; the moving (earth), like a loving (wife), resigns herself to Indra; when he shares all his vigour with these (his people), then, in due succession, men offer reverence to the potent Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: एकं नु त्वा सत्पतिं पाञ्चजन्यं जातं शृणोमि यशसं जनेषु । तं मे जगृभ्र आशसो नविष्ठं दोषा वस्तोर्हवमानास इन्द्रम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ekaṃ nu tvā satpatiṃ pāñcajanyaṃ jātaṃ śṛṇomi yaśasaṃ janeṣu | taṃ me jagṛbhra āśaso naviṣṭhaṃ doṣā vastorhavamānāsa indram ||

translations.english: Verily I hear you as chief among men, the protector of the good, friendly to the five classes of beings, the begotten, the renowned; may my (progeny), representing (their wishes), and uttering, his praises night and day, propitiates the glorified Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा हि त्वामृतुथा यातयन्तं मघा विप्रेभ्यो ददतं शृणोमि । किं ते ब्रह्माणो गृहते सखायो ये त्वाया निदधुः काममिन्द्र ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā hi tvāmṛtuthā yātayantaṃ maghā viprebhyo dadataṃ śṛṇomi | kiṃ te brahmāṇo gṛhate sakhāyo ye tvāyā nidadhuḥ kāmamindra ||

translations.english: I hear of you influencing (creatures) according to the season, and giving riches to the pious; but what do your devoted friends (obtain), who have entrusted their desires, Indra, to you.

mantras.sanskrit: महि महे तवसे दीध्ये नॄनिन्द्रायेत्था तवसे अतव्यान् । यो अस्मै सुमतिं वाजसातौ स्तुतो जने समर्यश्चिकेत ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahi mahe tavase dīdhye nṝnindrāyetthā tavase atavyān | yo asmai sumatiṃ vājasātau stuto jane samaryaściketa ||

translations.english: Feeble as I am, I offer praise to the great and vigorous Indra, for this purpose, (that he may grant) strength to (our) people; he who, associated with the Maruts, shows favour to this person n when praised for the sake of sustenance.

mantras.sanskrit: स त्वं न इन्द्र धियसानो अर्कैर्हरीणां वृषन्योक्त्रमश्रेः । या इत्था मघवन्ननु जोषं वक्षो अभि प्रार्यः सक्षि जनान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa tvaṃ na indra dhiyasāno arkairharīṇāṃ vṛṣanyoktramaśreḥ | yā itthā maghavannanu joṣaṃ vakṣo abhi prāryaḥ sakṣi janān ||

translations.english: You, Indra, meditating upon us, fasten the traces of yourborses, (incited), showerer (of benefits), by those praises in which you have suitable delight, and do you therefore overcome (for us) hostile men.

mantras.sanskrit: न ते त इन्द्राभ्यस्मदृष्वायुक्तासो अब्रह्मता यदसन् । तिष्ठा रथमधि तं वज्रहस्ता रश्मिं देव यमसे स्वश्वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: na te ta indrābhyasmadṛṣvāyuktāso abrahmatā yadasan | tiṣṭhā rathamadhi taṃ vajrahastā raśmiṃ deva yamase svaśvaḥ ||

translations.english: Since, mighty Indra, those who, differing from us, and not united with you through their lack of devotion, are not yours; therefore, divine holder of of the thunderbolt, who are possessed of excellent horses, ascend the car, whose reins you guide, (to come to our sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: पुरू यत्त इन्द्र सन्त्युक्था गवे चकर्थोर्वरासु युध्यन् । ततक्षे सूर्याय चिदोकसि स्वे वृषा समत्सु दासस्य नाम चित् ॥
mantras.transliteration: purū yatta indra santyukthā gave cakarthorvarāsu yudhyan | tatakṣe sūryāya cidokasi sve vṛṣā samatsu dāsasya nāma cit ||

translations.english: Inasmuch, Indra, as many praises are yours, therefore, combating for the sake of (shedding) water on fertile (lands), you have effected (the discomfiture of its obstructors); you, who are the showerer (of benefits), have on behalf of the sun, destroyed in his own dwelling the very name of (the asura), Dāsa, in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: वयं ते त इन्द्र ये च नरः शर्धो जज्ञाना याताश्च रथाः । आस्माञ्जगम्यादहिशुष्म सत्वा भगो न हव्यः प्रभृथेषु चारुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayaṃ te ta indra ye ca naraḥ śardho jajñānā yātāśca rathāḥ | āsmāñjagamyādahiśuṣma satvā bhago na havyaḥ prabhṛtheṣu cāruḥ ||

translations.english: We, Indra, are yours, and yours are they who are the leaders (of rites), promoters of (your) strength, and willing applicants (to you); all-powerful Indra, may adherents worthy of commendation and faithful, come to us, like Bhaga, in battles.

mantras.sanskrit: पपृक्षेण्यमिन्द्र त्वे ह्योजो नृम्णानि च नृतमानो अमर्तः । स न एनीं वसवानो रयिं दाः प्रार्यः स्तुषे तुविमघस्य दानम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: papṛkṣeṇyamindra tve hyojo nṛmṇāni ca nṛtamāno amartaḥ | sa na enīṃ vasavāno rayiṃ dāḥ prāryaḥ stuṣe tuvimaghasya dānam ||

translations.english: Glorious, Indra, is your strength, exulting, immortal, and clothing (the world with light); do you give us riches, and brilliant wealth, and I will greatly praise the munificence of the opulent lord.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा न इन्द्रोतिभिरव पाहि गृणतः शूर कारून् । उत त्वचं ददतो वाजसातौ पिप्रीहि मध्वः सुषुतस्य चारोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā na indrotibhirava pāhi gṛṇataḥ śūra kārūn | uta tvacaṃ dadato vājasātau piprīhi madhvaḥ suṣutasya cāroḥ ||

translations.english: Hero, Indra, with your protection defend us, praising and worshipping (you), and be propitiated (by drinking) of the well-effused and agreeable Soma juice that yields (a defensive) covering in combat.

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्ये मा पौरुकुत्स्यस्य सूरेस्त्रसदस्योर्हिरणिनो रराणाः । वहन्तु मा दश श्येतासो अस्य गैरिक्षितस्य क्रतुभिर्नु सश्चे ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tye mā paurukutsyasya sūrestrasadasyorhiraṇino rarāṇāḥ | vahantu mā daśa śyetāso asya gairikṣitasya kratubhirnu saśce ||

translations.english: May those ten bright homes, the tift to me of the pious gold-possessing Trasadasyu, the son of Purukutsa, of the raceof Girikṣita, convey me (to the sacrifice) and may I proceed quickly with the rites.

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्ये मा मारुताश्वस्य शोणाः क्रत्वामघासो विदथस्य रातौ । सहस्रा मे च्यवतानो ददान आनूकमर्यो वपुषे नार्चत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tye mā mārutāśvasya śoṇāḥ kratvāmaghāso vidathasya rātau | sahasrā me cyavatāno dadāna ānūkamaryo vapuṣe nārcat ||

translations.english: Or may those bay, well-actioned horses, the donation of Vidhata, the son of Marutaśva, (convey me); or (may) the thousands (of treasure) which he was bestowing upon and giving to me, entitled to respect, and the ornaments which he presented (to decorate) the person n, (contribute to the ceremony).

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्ये मा ध्वन्यस्य जुष्टा लक्ष्मण्यस्य सुरुचो यतानाः । मह्ना रायः संवरणस्य ऋषेर्व्रजं न गावः प्रयता अपि ग्मन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tye mā dhvanyasya juṣṭā lakṣmaṇyasya suruco yatānāḥ | mahnā rāyaḥ saṃvaraṇasya ṛṣervrajaṃ na gāvaḥ prayatā api gman ||

translations.english: Or may the bright and active steeds bestowed upon me by dhvanya, the son of Lakṣmaṇa (bear me); the riches endowed with greatness, that have been presented, have passed (to the dwellings) of the Ṛṣi Saṃvaraṇa, like cows to their stallṣ

mantras.sanskrit: अजातशत्रुमजरा स्वर्वत्यनु स्वधामिता दस्ममीयते । सुनोतन पचत ब्रह्मवाहसे पुरुष्टुताय प्रतरं दधातन ॥
mantras.transliteration: ajātaśatrumajarā svarvatyanu svadhāmitā dasmamīyate | sunotana pacata brahmavāhase puruṣṭutāya prataraṃ dadhātana ||

translations.english: The undecaying, heaven-conferring, unlimited (sacrificial) food, goes to the tamer (of enemies), whose adversarie are unborn; therefore (priests) pour out (the libation), dress (the cakes and butter), diligently discharge (your offices) to him who is the accepter of prayer, who si glorified by many.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यः सोमेन जठरमपिप्रतामन्दत मघवा मध्वो अन्धसः । यदीं मृगाय हन्तवे महावधः सहस्रभृष्टिमुशना वधं यमत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yaḥ somena jaṭharamapipratāmandata maghavā madhvo andhasaḥ | yadīṃ mṛgāya hantave mahāvadhaḥ sahasrabhṛṣṭimuśanā vadhaṃ yamat ||

translations.english: Maghavan, who fills his belly with the Soma, to be exhilarated (by drinking) of the sweet-savoured beverage, whereupon he has lifted up his destructive thousand-edged weapon, desiring to slay (the asura) Mmṛga.

mantras.sanskrit: यो अस्मै घ्रंस उत वा य ऊधनि सोमं सुनोति भवति द्युमाँ अह । अपाप शक्रस्ततनुष्टिमूहति तनूशुभ्रं मघवा यः कवासखः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo asmai ghraṃsa uta vā ya ūdhani somaṃ sunoti bhavati dyumā~ aha | apāpa śakrastatanuṣṭimūhati tanūśubhraṃ maghavā yaḥ kavāsakhaḥ ||

translations.english: He who pours out the libation to that Indra, by day or by night, undoubtely becomes illustrious; Śakra disregards tthe man who is proud of his descendants and vain of his person n, and who, though wealthy, is the friend of the base.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्यावधीत्पितरं यस्य मातरं यस्य शक्रो भ्रातरं नात ईषते । वेतीद्वस्य प्रयता यतंकरो न किल्बिषादीषते वस्व आकरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasyāvadhītpitaraṃ yasya mātaraṃ yasya śakro bhrātaraṃ nāta īṣate | vetīdvasya prayatā yataṃkaro na kilbiṣādīṣate vasva ākaraḥ ||

translations.english: Śakra does not turn away from him whose father, whose mother, whose brother he has slain, but is willing to accept his offerings; the regulator (of acts), the bestower of riches, does not turn away from iniquity.

mantras.sanskrit: न पञ्चभिर्दशभिर्वष्ट्यारभं नासुन्वता सचते पुष्यता चन । जिनाति वेदमुया हन्ति वा धुनिरा देवयुं भजति गोमति व्रजे ॥
mantras.transliteration: na pañcabhirdaśabhirvaṣṭyārabhaṃ nāsunvatā sacate puṣyatā cana | jināti vedamuyā hanti vā dhunirā devayuṃ bhajati gomati vraje ||

translations.english: He desires not (association in) enterprises with five or with ten; he associates not with the man who does not present libations; and cherishes not (his dependents) may, the terrifier (of foes) punishes him or slays him, but he plural ces the devout man in a pasturage stocked with cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: वित्वक्षणः समृतौ चक्रमासजोऽसुन्वतो विषुणः सुन्वतो वृधः । इन्द्रो विश्वस्य दमिता विभीषणो यथावशं नयति दासमार्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vitvakṣaṇaḥ samṛtau cakramāsajo'sunvato viṣuṇaḥ sunvato vṛdhaḥ | indro viśvasya damitā vibhīṣaṇo yathāvaśaṃ nayati dāsamāryaḥ ||

translations.english: Thinning (his enemies) in battle, and accelerating the wheels (of his car), he turns away from him who offers no libation, and augments (the prosperity of) the offerer; Indra, the subduer of all, the formidable, the lord, conducts the Dāsa at his plural asure.

mantras.sanskrit: समीं पणेरजति भोजनं मुषे वि दाशुषे भजति सूनरं वसु । दुर्गे चन ध्रियते विश्व आ पुरु जनो यो अस्य तविषीमचुक्रुधत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: samīṃ paṇerajati bhojanaṃ muṣe vi dāśuṣe bhajati sūnaraṃ vasu | durge cana dhriyate viśva ā puru jano yo asya taviṣīmacukrudhat ||

translations.english: He proceeds to plural nder the wealth of the (avaricious), and bestows the riches that are prized by man upon the donor (of the libation); every man is involved in great difficulty who provokes the might of Indra to wrath.

mantras.sanskrit: सं यज्जनौ सुधनौ विश्वशर्धसाववेदिन्द्रो मघवा गोषु शुभ्रिषु । युजं ह्यन्यमकृत प्रवेपन्युदीं गव्यं सृजते सत्वभिर्धुनिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ yajjanau sudhanau viśvaśardhasāvavedindro maghavā goṣu śubhriṣu | yujaṃ hyanyamakṛta pravepanyudīṃ gavyaṃ sṛjate satvabhirdhuniḥ ||

translations.english: When Indra, the possessor of opulence, discriminates between two men, both wealthy, and exerting themselves (against each other) for the sake of valuable cattle, he takes one of them as his associate, causing (his adversaries) to tremble, and the agitator (of the clouds), together with the Maruts, bestows upon him herds of cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: सहस्रसामाग्निवेशिं गृणीषे शत्रिमग्न उपमां केतुमर्यः । तस्मा आपः संयतः पीपयन्त तस्मिन्क्षत्रममवत्त्वेषमस्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: sahasrasāmāgniveśiṃ gṛṇīṣe śatrimagna upamāṃ ketumaryaḥ | tasmā āpaḥ saṃyataḥ pīpayanta tasminkṣatramamavattveṣamastu ||

translations.english: I, Arya, Agni, praise Śatri, the son of Agniveśa, the bestower of thousands, a type for comparison; may the collected waters yield him abundance; may wealth and strength, and glory be upon him.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्ते साधिष्ठोऽवस इन्द्र क्रतुष्टमा भर । अस्मभ्यं चर्षणीसहं सस्निं वाजेषु दुष्टरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaste sādhiṣṭho'vasa indra kratuṣṭamā bhara | asmabhyaṃ carṣaṇīsahaṃ sasniṃ vājeṣu duṣṭaram ||

translations.english: Perfect for our protection, Indra, that your act which is most effective, which is the subduer of men, holy, and difficult to be encountered in battles.

mantras.sanskrit: यदिन्द्र ते चतस्रो यच्छूर सन्ति तिस्रः । यद्वा पञ्च क्षितीनामवस्तत्सु न आ भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadindra te catasro yacchūra santi tisraḥ | yadvā pañca kṣitīnāmavastatsu na ā bhara ||

translations.english: Whatever protections, Indra, may be yours, whether four, or, hero, three, or those accorded to the five (classes) of men, bestow them freely upon us.

mantras.sanskrit: आ तेऽवो वरेण्यं वृषन्तमस्य हूमहे । वृषजूतिर्हि जज्ञिष आभूभिरिन्द्र तुर्वणिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā te'vo vareṇyaṃ vṛṣantamasya hūmahe | vṛṣajūtirhi jajñiṣa ābhūbhirindra turvaṇiḥ ||

translations.english: We invoke the desirable protection of you, the most liberal showerer (of benefits); that (protection) which you, the distributor of rain, the quick destroyer (of foes), grant, (associated) with the present (Maruts).

mantras.sanskrit: वृषा ह्यसि राधसे जज्ञिषे वृष्णि ते शवः । स्वक्षत्रं ते धृषन्मनः सत्राहमिन्द्र पौंस्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣā hyasi rādhase jajñiṣe vṛṣṇi te śavaḥ | svakṣatraṃ te dhṛṣanmanaḥ satrāhamindra pauṃsyam ||

translations.english: You are the showerer (of benefits); you are born to (bestow) riches; your strength rains (blessings); your self-invigorated mind is the restrainer (of adversaies); your manhood, Indra, is the destroyer of multitudes.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं तमिन्द्र मर्त्यममित्रयन्तमद्रिवः । सर्वरथा शतक्रतो नि याहि शवसस्पते ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ tamindra martyamamitrayantamadrivaḥ | sarvarathā śatakrato ni yāhi śavasaspate ||

translations.english: Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, rider in all-pervading car, object of many rites, and lord of strength, proceed against the mortal who entertains hostility towards you.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामिद्वृत्रहन्तम जनासो वृक्तबर्हिषः । उग्रं पूर्वीषु पूर्व्यं हवन्ते वाजसातये ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmidvṛtrahantama janāso vṛktabarhiṣaḥ | ugraṃ pūrvīṣu pūrvyaṃ havante vājasātaye ||

translations.english: Slayer of Vṛtra, men with clipped sacred grass invoked you, who are fierce and foremost among many, for aid in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्माकमिन्द्र दुष्टरं पुरोयावानमाजिषु । सयावानं धनेधने वाजयन्तमवा रथम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmākamindra duṣṭaraṃ puroyāvānamājiṣu | sayāvānaṃ dhanedhane vājayantamavā ratham ||

translations.english: Defend, Indra, our chariot, difficult (to be stopped), mingling foremost in combats, followed by attendants, and eagerly striving for repeated spoil.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्माकमिन्द्रेहि नो रथमवा पुरंध्या । वयं शविष्ठ वार्यं दिवि श्रवो दधीमहि दिवि स्तोमं मनामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmākamindrehi no rathamavā puraṃdhyā | vayaṃ śaviṣṭha vāryaṃ divi śravo dadhīmahi divi stomaṃ manāmahe ||

translations.english: Come, Indra, to us; defend by your providence our car; we contemplate in you who, most mighty one, are divine, all desirable vigour; (to you), who are divine, we offer praise.

mantras.sanskrit: स आ गमदिन्द्रो यो वसूनां चिकेतद्दातुं दामनो रयीणाम् । धन्वचरो न वंसगस्तृषाणश्चकमानः पिबतु दुग्धमंशुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa ā gamadindro yo vasūnāṃ ciketaddātuṃ dāmano rayīṇām | dhanvacaro na vaṃsagastṛṣāṇaścakamānaḥ pibatu dugdhamaṃśum ||

translations.english: May that Indra who is the donor of wealth, who knows (how) to distribute riches, come (to our sacrifice) marching boldly like a warrior; and may he, being thirsty, and desirous (of the draught), drink of the effused Soma juice.

mantras.sanskrit: आ ते हनू हरिवः शूर शिप्रे रुहत्सोमो न पर्वतस्य पृष्ठे । अनु त्वा राजन्नर्वतो न हिन्वन्गीर्भिर्मदेम पुरुहूत विश्वे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā te hanū harivaḥ śūra śipre ruhatsomo na parvatasya pṛṣṭhe | anu tvā rājannarvato na hinvangīrbhirmadema puruhūta viśve ||

translations.english: Hero, lord of horses, may the Soma, ascend to your destructive jaw, as if to the summit of a mountain; may we all, royal Indra, who are invoked of many, give plural asure to you with our hymns, as to horses with fodder.

mantras.sanskrit: चक्रं न वृत्तं पुरुहूत वेपते मनो भिया मे अमतेरिदद्रिवः । रथादधि त्वा जरिता सदावृध कुविन्नु स्तोषन्मघवन्पुरूवसुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: cakraṃ na vṛttaṃ puruhūta vepate mano bhiyā me amateridadrivaḥ | rathādadhi tvā jaritā sadāvṛdha kuvinnu stoṣanmaghavanpurūvasuḥ ||

translations.english: Wielder of the thunderbolt, the invoked of many, my mind trembles through dread of poverty like a whirling wheel; Maghavan, ever prosperous, may your worshipper, Puruvasu, praise you promptly and abundantly, seated in your chariot.

mantras.sanskrit: एष ग्रावेव जरिता त इन्द्रेयर्ति वाचं बृहदाशुषाणः । प्र सव्येन मघवन्यंसि रायः प्र दक्षिणिद्धरिवो मा वि वेनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa grāveva jaritā ta indreyarti vācaṃ bṛhadāśuṣāṇaḥ | pra savyena maghavanyaṃsi rāyaḥ pra dakṣiṇiddharivo mā vi venaḥ ||

translations.english: This your adorer, Indra, like the stone (that expresses the Soma juice), urges praise to you, participating in the great (reward); you bestow, Maghavan, riches with your left hand, you bestow them, lord of horses, with the right be not reluctant.

mantras.sanskrit: वृषा त्वा वृषणं वर्धतु द्यौर्वृषा वृषभ्यां वहसे हरिभ्याम् । स नो वृषा वृषरथः सुशिप्र वृषक्रतो वृषा वज्रिन्भरे धाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣā tvā vṛṣaṇaṃ vardhatu dyaurvṛṣā vṛṣabhyāṃ vahase haribhyām | sa no vṛṣā vṛṣarathaḥ suśipra vṛṣakrato vṛṣā vajrinbhare dhāḥ ||

translations.english: May the effective eulogium melt you, the showerer (of benefits); you, the showerer, are borne (to the sacrifice) by vigorous steeds sender of rain, you of the handsome shin, wielder of the thunderbolt, showerer, whose car showers down (blessings), do you defend us in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: यो रोहितौ वाजिनौ वाजिनीवान्त्रिभिः शतैः सचमानावदिष्ट । यूने समस्मै क्षितयो नमन्तां श्रुतरथाय मरुतो दुवोया ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo rohitau vājinau vājinīvāntribhiḥ śataiḥ sacamānāvadiṣṭa | yūne samasmai kṣitayo namantāṃ śrutarathāya maruto duvoyā ||

translations.english: Maruts, may all men bow in obedience to that youthful Śrutaratha, the possessor of abundance, who has bestowed (upon us) two bay steeds accompanied by three hundred (cattle).

mantras.sanskrit: सं भानुना यतते सूर्यस्याजुह्वानो घृतपृष्ठः स्वञ्चाः । तस्मा अमृध्रा उषसो व्युच्छान्य इन्द्राय सुनवामेत्याह ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ bhānunā yatate sūryasyājuhvāno ghṛtapṛṣṭhaḥ svañcāḥ | tasmā amṛdhrā uṣaso vyucchānya indrāya sunavāmetyāha ||

translations.english: The piously worshipped (Agni), when invoked, glistening with the oblation, vies with the splendour of the sun; may the dawns rise innoxious to him who says, let us offer oblations to Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: समिद्धाग्निर्वनवत्स्तीर्णबर्हिर्युक्तग्रावा सुतसोमो जराते । ग्रावाणो यस्येषिरं वदन्त्ययदध्वर्युर्हविषाव सिन्धुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: samiddhāgnirvanavatstīrṇabarhiryuktagrāvā sutasomo jarāte | grāvāṇo yasyeṣiraṃ vadantyayadadhvaryurhaviṣāva sindhum ||

translations.english: He whose fire is kindled, whose sacred grass is strewn, offers worship; he whose stone is uplifted, whose Soma juice is effused, offers praise; the priests, of whom the stones utter the sounds of bruising, descends with the oblation (for previous ablution) to the stream.

mantras.sanskrit: वधूरियं पतिमिच्छन्त्येति य ईं वहाते महिषीमिषिराम् । आस्य श्रवस्याद्रथ आ च घोषात्पुरू सहस्रा परि वर्तयाते ॥
mantras.transliteration: vadhūriyaṃ patimicchantyeti ya īṃ vahāte mahiṣīmiṣirām | āsya śravasyādratha ā ca ghoṣātpurū sahasrā pari vartayāte ||

translations.english: The bride (of Indra), devoted to her lord, attends him (to the rite), who thus brings (with him) his accompanying queen; may his car convey to us ample food; may it sound loudly; may it scatter around many thousands (of riches).

mantras.sanskrit: न स राजा व्यथते यस्मिन्निन्द्रस्तीव्रं सोमं पिबति गोसखायम् । आ सत्वनैरजति हन्ति वृत्रं क्षेति क्षितीः सुभगो नाम पुष्यन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: na sa rājā vyathate yasminnindrastīvraṃ somaṃ pibati gosakhāyam | ā satvanairajati hanti vṛtraṃ kṣeti kṣitīḥ subhago nāma puṣyan ||

translations.english: That prince suffers no evil in whose realm Indra drinks the sharp Soma juice mixed with milk; attended by faithful (followers), he moves (in all directions); he destroys his enemy, he protects his subjects enjoying prosperity, he cherishes the name of (Indra).

mantras.sanskrit: पुष्यात्क्षेमे अभि योगे भवात्युभे वृतौ संयती सं जयाति । प्रियः सूर्ये प्रियो अग्ना भवाति य इन्द्राय सुतसोमो ददाशत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: puṣyātkṣeme abhi yoge bhavātyubhe vṛtau saṃyatī saṃ jayāti | priyaḥ sūrye priyo agnā bhavāti ya indrāya sutasomo dadāśat ||

translations.english: He cherishes (his kin); he (reigns) in welfare and prosperity; he is victorious in present and continuous (time); dear is he to the sun, dear to Agni, who, with prepared libation, offers it to Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: उरोष्ट इन्द्र राधसो विभ्वी रातिः शतक्रतो । अधा नो विश्वचर्षणे द्युम्ना सुक्षत्र मंहय ॥
mantras.transliteration: uroṣṭa indra rādhaso vibhvī rātiḥ śatakrato | adhā no viśvacarṣaṇe dyumnā sukṣatra maṃhaya ||

translations.english: Indra of many exploits, liberal is the distribution of your abundnat riches; therefore, all-beholder, possessor of excellent wealth, bestow upon us opulence.

mantras.sanskrit: यदीमिन्द्र श्रवाय्यमिषं शविष्ठ दधिषे । पप्रथे दीर्घश्रुत्तमं हिरण्यवर्ण दुष्टरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadīmindra śravāyyamiṣaṃ śaviṣṭha dadhiṣe | paprathe dīrghaśruttamaṃ hiraṇyavarṇa duṣṭaram ||

translations.english: Although, most mighty Indra, you possess well-known abundance (of food), yet golden-hued (deity) it is most notoriously reported as difficult(to be procured).

mantras.sanskrit: शुष्मासो ये ते अद्रिवो मेहना केतसापः । उभा देवावभिष्टये दिवश्च ग्मश्च राजथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śuṣmāso ye te adrivo mehanā ketasāpaḥ | ubhā devāvabhiṣṭaye divaśca gmaśca rājathaḥ ||

translations.english: Wielder of the thunderbolt, yours are the strong (Maruts), who are adorable, and whose exploits are renowned; both divinities, (you and they), rule at plural asure over heaven and earth.

mantras.sanskrit: उतो नो अस्य कस्य चिद्दक्षस्य तव वृत्रहन् । अस्मभ्यं नृम्णमा भरास्मभ्यं नृमणस्यसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: uto no asya kasya ciddakṣasya tava vṛtrahan | asmabhyaṃ nṛmṇamā bharāsmabhyaṃ nṛmaṇasyase ||

translations.english: Slayer of Vṛtra, bring to us, your (worshippers), the wealth of any powerful (man) whatsoever, for you are disposed to enrich us.

mantras.sanskrit: नू त आभिरभिष्टिभिस्तव शर्मञ्छतक्रतो । इन्द्र स्याम सुगोपाः शूर स्याम सुगोपाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū ta ābhirabhiṣṭibhistava śarmañchatakrato | indra syāma sugopāḥ śūra syāma sugopāḥ ||

translations.english: May we, Śatakratu, speedily (partake of) your felicity through these our prayers; may we be well secured, Indra, (by you); may we be carefully protected, hero, by you.

mantras.sanskrit: यदिन्द्र चित्र मेहनास्ति त्वादातमद्रिवः । राधस्तन्नो विदद्वस उभयाहस्त्या भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadindra citra mehanāsti tvādātamadrivaḥ | rādhastanno vidadvasa ubhayāhastyā bhara ||

translations.english: Wonderful Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, since precious treasure is to be distributed by you, bestow it, possessor of riches, with both hands, upon us.

mantras.sanskrit: यन्मन्यसे वरेण्यमिन्द्र द्युक्षं तदा भर । विद्याम तस्य ते वयमकूपारस्य दावने ॥
mantras.transliteration: yanmanyase vareṇyamindra dyukṣaṃ tadā bhara | vidyāma tasya te vayamakūpārasya dāvane ||

translations.english: Whatever food you consider desirable, Indra, bestow it; let us be to you (in the relation of your) gift of unlimited sustenance.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्ते दित्सु प्रराध्यं मनो अस्ति श्रुतं बृहत् । तेन दृळ्हा चिदद्रिव आ वाजं दर्षि सातये ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatte ditsu prarādhyaṃ mano asti śrutaṃ bṛhat | tena dṛḷhā cidadriva ā vājaṃ darṣi sātaye ||

translations.english: Since your bountiful and praiseworthy will is notorious and vast, therefore, thunder, you have made ready for bestowing upon us substantial food.

mantras.sanskrit: मंहिष्ठं वो मघोनां राजानं चर्षणीनाम् । इन्द्रमुप प्रशस्तये पूर्वीभिर्जुजुषे गिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: maṃhiṣṭhaṃ vo maghonāṃ rājānaṃ carṣaṇīnām | indramupa praśastaye pūrvībhirjujuṣe giraḥ ||

translations.english: With ancient (hymns) the pious approach Indra, to laud him who is most worthy of the beverage (the offering) of you who are opulent; (him) who is theking of men.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मा इत्काव्यं वच उक्थमिन्द्राय शंस्यम् । तस्मा उ ब्रह्मवाहसे गिरो वर्धन्त्यत्रयो गिरः शुम्भन्त्यत्रयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmā itkāvyaṃ vaca ukthamindrāya śaṃsyam | tasmā u brahmavāhase giro vardhantyatrayo giraḥ śumbhantyatrayaḥ ||

translations.english: To that Indra, is the poetical and articulate prayer to be recited; to him the conveyers of pious praise, the sons of Atri, raise their hymns; the sons of Atri illume their hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: आ याह्यद्रिभिः सुतं सोमं सोमपते पिब । वृषन्निन्द्र वृषभिर्वृत्रहन्तम ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yāhyadribhiḥ sutaṃ somaṃ somapate piba | vṛṣannindra vṛṣabhirvṛtrahantama ||

translations.english: Come, Indra, (to our sacrifice); drink, lord of the Soma, of the juice expressed by the stones; showerer (of benefits), utter destroyer of Vṛtra, (come) with the showering (Maruts).

mantras.sanskrit: वृषा ग्रावा वृषा मदो वृषा सोमो अयं सुतः । वृषन्निन्द्र वृषभिर्वृत्रहन्तम ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣā grāvā vṛṣā mado vṛṣā somo ayaṃ sutaḥ | vṛṣannindra vṛṣabhirvṛtrahantama ||

translations.english: The stone is the showerer, the inebriation is the showerer, this effused Soma is the showerer; showerer (of benefits), Indra, utter destroyer of Vṛtra, come with the showering (Maruts).

mantras.sanskrit: वृषा त्वा वृषणं हुवे वज्रिञ्चित्राभिरूतिभिः । वृषन्निन्द्र वृषभिर्वृत्रहन्तम ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣā tvā vṛṣaṇaṃ huve vajriñcitrābhirūtibhiḥ | vṛṣannindra vṛṣabhirvṛtrahantama ||

translations.english: Effusing the libation, I invoke you, the showerer (of benefits), for your marvellous protections; showerer (of benefits), Indra, utter destroyer of Vṛtra, come with the showering (Maruts).

mantras.sanskrit: ऋजीषी वज्री वृषभस्तुराषाट् छुष्मी राजा वृत्रहा सोमपावा । युक्त्वा हरिभ्यामुप यासदर्वाङ्माध्यंदिने सवने मत्सदिन्द्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛjīṣī vajrī vṛṣabhasturāṣāṭ chuṣmī rājā vṛtrahā somapāvā | yuktvā haribhyāmupa yāsadarvāṅmādhyaṃdine savane matsadindraḥ ||

translations.english: May the accepter of the spiritless libation, the wilder of the thunderbolt, the showerer (of benefits), the overcomer of quick- (flying foes), the mighty, the monarch, the slayer of Vṛtra, the drinker of the Soma, having harnessed his horses, come down (to us); may Indra be exhilarated at the mid-day sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्त्वा सूर्य स्वर्भानुस्तमसाविध्यदासुरः । अक्षेत्रविद्यथा मुग्धो भुवनान्यदीधयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yattvā sūrya svarbhānustamasāvidhyadāsuraḥ | akṣetravidyathā mugdho bhuvanānyadīdhayuḥ ||

translations.english: When, Sūrya, the son of the Asura Svarbhānu, overspread you with darkness, the worlds were beheld like one bewildered knowing not his plural ce.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वर्भानोरध यदिन्द्र माया अवो दिवो वर्तमाना अवाहन् । गूळ्हं सूर्यं तमसापव्रतेन तुरीयेण ब्रह्मणाविन्ददत्रिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: svarbhānoradha yadindra māyā avo divo vartamānā avāhan | gūḷhaṃ sūryaṃ tamasāpavratena turīyeṇa brahmaṇāvindadatriḥ ||

translations.english: When, Indra, you were dissipating those illusions of Svarbhānu which were spread below the sun, then Atri, by his fourth sacred prayer, discovered the sun concealed by the darkness impeding his functions.

mantras.sanskrit: मा मामिमं तव सन्तमत्र इरस्या द्रुग्धो भियसा नि गारीत् । त्वं मित्रो असि सत्यराधास्तौ मेहावतं वरुणश्च राजा ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā māmimaṃ tava santamatra irasyā drugdho bhiyasā ni gārīt | tvaṃ mitro asi satyarādhāstau mehāvataṃ varuṇaśca rājā ||

translations.english: Sūrya speaks: Let not the violator, Atri, through hunger, swallow with fearful (darkness) me who am yours; you are Mitra, whose wealth is truth; do you and the royal Varuṇa both protect me.

mantras.sanskrit: ग्राव्णो ब्रह्मा युयुजानः सपर्यन्कीरिणा देवान्नमसोपशिक्षन् । अत्रिः सूर्यस्य दिवि चक्षुराधात्स्वर्भानोरप माया अघुक्षत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: grāvṇo brahmā yuyujānaḥ saparyankīriṇā devānnamasopaśikṣan | atriḥ sūryasya divi cakṣurādhātsvarbhānorapa māyā aghukṣat ||

translations.english: Then the Brahman, (Atri), applying the stones together, propitiating the gods with praise, and adoring them with reverence, plural ced the eye of Sūrya in the sky; he dispersed the delusions of Svarbhānu.

mantras.sanskrit: यं वै सूर्यं स्वर्भानुस्तमसाविध्यदासुरः । अत्रयस्तमन्वविन्दन्नह्यन्ये अशक्नुवन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ vai sūryaṃ svarbhānustamasāvidhyadāsuraḥ | atrayastamanvavindannahyanye aśaknuvan ||

translations.english: The sun, whom the Asura, Svarbhānu, had enveloped with darkness, the sons of Atri subsequently recovered; no others were able (to effect his release).

mantras.sanskrit: को नु वां मित्रावरुणावृतायन्दिवो वा महः पार्थिवस्य वा दे । ऋतस्य वा सदसि त्रासीथां नो यज्ञायते वा पशुषो न वाजान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ko nu vāṃ mitrāvaruṇāvṛtāyandivo vā mahaḥ pārthivasya vā de | ṛtasya vā sadasi trāsīthāṃ no yajñāyate vā paśuṣo na vājān ||

translations.english: Who, Mitra and Varuṇa, desiring to sacrifice to you, (is able to do so)? do you, whether (abiding) in the region of heaven, or of the vast earth, or of the firmament, protect us, and give to the donor (of the oblation), and to the sacrificer, cattle and food.

mantras.sanskrit: ते नो मित्रो वरुणो अर्यमायुरिन्द्र ऋभुक्षा मरुतो जुषन्त । नमोभिर्वा ये दधते सुवृक्तिं स्तोमं रुद्राय मीळ्हुषे सजोषाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te no mitro varuṇo aryamāyurindra ṛbhukṣā maruto juṣanta | namobhirvā ye dadhate suvṛktiṃ stomaṃ rudrāya mīḷhuṣe sajoṣāḥ ||

translations.english: May those divinities, Mitra and Varuṇa, Aryaman, Āyu, Indra, Ṛbhukṣin, the Maruts who accept pious praise, be plural ased by our adorations, partaking of the gratification afforded to Rudra, the showerer (of benefits).

mantras.sanskrit: आ वां येष्ठाश्विना हुवध्यै वातस्य पत्मन्रथ्यस्य पुष्टौ । उत वा दिवो असुराय मन्म प्रान्धांसीव यज्यवे भरध्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāṃ yeṣṭhāśvinā huvadhyai vātasya patmanrathyasya puṣṭau | uta vā divo asurāya manma prāndhāṃsīva yajyave bharadhvam ||

translations.english: I invoke you, Aśvins, the restrainers (of desire), for the acceleration ofyour chariot with the swiftness of the wind; (priests) offer praise and oblations to the celestial destroyer of life, to the accmplisher of the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सक्षणो दिव्यः कण्वहोता त्रितो दिवः सजोषा वातो अग्निः । पूषा भगः प्रभृथे विश्वभोजा आजिं न जग्मुराश्वश्वतमाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra sakṣaṇo divyaḥ kaṇvahotā trito divaḥ sajoṣā vāto agniḥ | pūṣā bhagaḥ prabhṛthe viśvabhojā ājiṃ na jagmurāśvaśvatamāḥ ||

translations.english: May the divine accepter of sacrifice, of whom the Kaṇvas are the priests, Tṛta, Vāyu and Agni, concurring in satisfaction with (the ruler of) heaven, or (Sūrya and) Pūṣan and Bhaga, and they who are the protectors of the universe, (come quickly) to the sacrifice, as the fleet course rush to battle.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वो रयिं युक्ताश्वं भरध्वं राय एषेऽवसे दधीत धीः । सुशेव एवैरौशिजस्य होता ये व एवा मरुतस्तुराणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vo rayiṃ yuktāśvaṃ bharadhvaṃ rāya eṣe'vase dadhīta dhīḥ | suśeva evairauśijasya hotā ye va evā marutasturāṇām ||

translations.english: Maruts, do you bring wealth comprising horses; to acquire and preserve riches the wise man offers you praise; may the ministrant priest, (Atri), of the son of Uśij (Kakṣīvat), be made happy by those swift-going (horses) which are the swift-going (horses), Maruts, of you who are rapid in motion.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वो वायुं रथयुजं कृणुध्वं प्र देवं विप्रं पनितारमर्कैः । इषुध्यव ऋतसापः पुरंधीर्वस्वीर्नो अत्र पत्नीरा धिये धुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vo vāyuṃ rathayujaṃ kṛṇudhvaṃ pra devaṃ vipraṃ panitāramarkaiḥ | iṣudhyava ṛtasāpaḥ puraṃdhīrvasvīrno atra patnīrā dhiye dhuḥ ||

translations.english: Prevail, (priests), by your prayers, on Vāyu, the divine, the fulfiller of desires, the adorable, to harness his chariot; may the light-moving accepters of sacrifice, the lovely and excellent wives (of the gods), come hither to our rite.

mantras.sanskrit: उप व एषे वन्द्येभिः शूषैः प्र यह्वी दिवश्चितयद्भिरर्कैः । उषासानक्ता विदुषीव विश्वमा हा वहतो मर्त्याय यज्ञम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa va eṣe vandyebhiḥ śūṣaiḥ pra yahvī divaścitayadbhirarkaiḥ | uṣāsānaktā viduṣīva viśvamā hā vahato martyāya yajñam ||

translations.english: Mighty Day and Night, to you, along with the adorable (deities) of heaven, I present (the oblation) with prayers delighting and explicit; knowing, like two sages, all (that is required), do you bring (it) to the worshipper for his sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि वो अर्चे पोष्यावतो नॄन्वास्तोष्पतिं त्वष्टारं रराणः । धन्या सजोषा धिषणा नमोभिर्वनस्पतीँरोषधी राय एषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi vo arce poṣyāvato nṝnvāstoṣpatiṃ tvaṣṭāraṃ rarāṇaḥ | dhanyā sajoṣā dhiṣaṇā namobhirvanaspatī~roṣadhī rāya eṣe ||

translations.english: I glorify you, leaders (of rites), cherishers (of many), gratifying (with oblation, you) Tvaṣṭā the lord of foundations, and the goddess of speech, bestower of opulence, and share in the satisfaction (of the other divinities); also the lords of the forest, and the herbs, that I may obtain riches.

mantras.sanskrit: तुजे नस्तने पर्वताः सन्तु स्वैतवो ये वसवो न वीराः । पनित आप्त्यो यजतः सदा नो वर्धान्नः शंसं नर्यो अभिष्टौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: tuje nastane parvatāḥ santu svaitavo ye vasavo na vīrāḥ | panita āptyo yajataḥ sadā no vardhānnaḥ śaṃsaṃ naryo abhiṣṭau ||

translations.english: May the Parvatas be (bountiful) to us in liberal donations; may they be favourable (to us) who are the establishers (of the world) like heroes; may the adored and adorable (deity), who is accessible (to all), who is friendly to man, ever grant us increase, being propitiated by our praise.

mantras.sanskrit: वृष्णो अस्तोषि भूम्यस्य गर्भं त्रितो नपातमपां सुवृक्ति । गृणीते अग्निरेतरी न शूषैः शोचिष्केशो नि रिणाति वना ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣṇo astoṣi bhūmyasya garbhaṃ trito napātamapāṃ suvṛkti | gṛṇīte agniretarī na śūṣaiḥ śociṣkeśo ni riṇāti vanā ||

translations.english: I glorify with unqualified praise the embryo of the earth-fertilizing rain, the grandson of the waters, Agni, who is threefold, who rages (upon me) not, when travelling with (his) withering rays, but, bright-haired consumes the forests.

mantras.sanskrit: कथा महे रुद्रियाय ब्रवाम कद्राये चिकितुषे भगाय । आप ओषधीरुत नोऽवन्तु द्यौर्वना गिरयो वृक्षकेशाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kathā mahe rudriyāya bravāma kadrāye cikituṣe bhagāya | āpa oṣadhīruta no'vantu dyaurvanā girayo vṛkṣakeśāḥ ||

translations.english: Howcan we offer (fit praise) to the mighty posterity of Rudra, or to the all-knowing Bhaga, for (the sake of obtaining) riches; may the waters, may the plural nts, protect us, and the heaven, the woods, and the mountains, whose tresses are trees.

mantras.sanskrit: शृणोतु न ऊर्जां पतिर्गिरः स नभस्तरीयाँ इषिरः परिज्मा । शृण्वन्त्वापः पुरो न शुभ्राः परि स्रुचो बबृहाणस्याद्रेः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śṛṇotu na ūrjāṃ patirgiraḥ sa nabhastarīyā~ iṣiraḥ parijmā | śṛṇvantvāpaḥ puro na śubhrāḥ pari sruco babṛhāṇasyādreḥ ||

translations.english: May the lord of vigour, (Vāyu), hear our prayers, he who traverses the firmament, the circumambient; may the waters hear, bright as cities, flowing round the towering mountains.

mantras.sanskrit: विदा चिन्नु महान्तो ये व एवा ब्रवाम दस्मा वार्यं दधानाः । वयश्चन सुभ्व आव यन्ति क्षुभा मर्तमनुयतं वधस्नैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vidā cinnu mahānto ye va evā bravāma dasmā vāryaṃ dadhānāḥ | vayaścana subhva āva yanti kṣubhā martamanuyataṃ vadhasnaiḥ ||

translations.english: Mighty Maruts, of goodly aspect, quickly hear (the praises) that we who repair to you repeat, offering acceptable (oblations); (the Maruts) coming hither, well disposed, come down to us, (destroying) with their weapons the mortals opposed to them, (overcome) by agitation.

mantras.sanskrit: आ दैव्यानि पार्थिवानि जन्मापश्चाच्छा सुमखाय वोचम् । वर्धन्तां द्यावो गिरश्चन्द्राग्रा उदा वर्धन्तामभिषाता अर्णाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā daivyāni pārthivāni janmāpaścācchā sumakhāya vocam | vardhantāṃ dyāvo giraścandrāgrā udā vardhantāmabhiṣātā arṇāḥ ||

translations.english: I offer adoration to the company of the Maruts deserving of sacred sacrifice, to obtain the waters, whether born of heaven or earth; may my praises prosper; may the joy-bestowing heavens (flourish); may the rivers cherished (by the Maruts) be filled with water.

mantras.sanskrit: पदेपदे मे जरिमा नि धायि वरूत्री वा शक्रा या पायुभिश्च । सिषक्तु माता मही रसा नः स्मत्सूरिभिॠजुहस्त ऋजुवनिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: padepade me jarimā ni dhāyi varūtrī vā śakrā yā pāyubhiśca | siṣaktu mātā mahī rasā naḥ smatsūribhiṝjuhasta ṛjuvaniḥ ||

translations.english: My praise has been continually proffered as a protectress, powerful with (the means of) preservation; may the maternal and venerable earth accept our (praises), and, (plural ased) with her pious (worshippers) be (to us) straight-handed, and the giver of good.

mantras.sanskrit: कथा दाशेम नमसा सुदानूनेवया मरुतो अच्छोक्तौ प्रश्रवसो मरुतो अच्छोक्तौ । मा नोऽहिर्बुध्न्यो रिषे धादस्माकं भूदुपमातिवनिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kathā dāśema namasā sudānūnevayā maruto acchoktau praśravaso maruto acchoktau | mā no'hirbudhnyo riṣe dhādasmākaṃ bhūdupamātivaniḥ ||

translations.english: How may we (duly) worship the liberal (Maruts) with praise, how adore the Maruts with present praise in a fitting manner, the glorious Maruts with present praise? may Ahirbudhnya contrive nor for our harm; may he be the destroyer (of our enemies).

mantras.sanskrit: इति चिन्नु प्रजायै पशुमत्यै देवासो वनते मर्त्यो व आ देवासो वनते मर्त्यो वः । अत्रा शिवां तन्वो धासिमस्या जरां चिन्मे निॠतिर्जग्रसीत ॥
mantras.transliteration: iti cinnu prajāyai paśumatyai devāso vanate martyo va ā devāso vanate martyo vaḥ | atrā śivāṃ tanvo dhāsimasyā jarāṃ cinme niṝtirjagrasīta ||

translations.english: The mortal (sacrificer) worships you, gods, at all times for progeny and cattle; verily, gods, the mortal worships you; may Nirṛti, on this occasion, sustain my body with salutary food, and keep off decay.

mantras.sanskrit: तां वो देवाः सुमतिमूर्जयन्तीमिषमश्याम वसवः शसा गोः । सा नः सुदानुर्मृळयन्ती देवी प्रति द्रवन्ती सुविताय गम्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tāṃ vo devāḥ sumatimūrjayantīmiṣamaśyāma vasavaḥ śasā goḥ | sā naḥ sudānurmṛḷayantī devī prati dravantī suvitāya gamyāḥ ||

translations.english: Divine Vasus, may we obtain from the adorable cow invigorating and mind-sustaining food; may that liberal and benignant goddess, hastening (I, her), come for our felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि न इळा यूथस्य माता स्मन्नदीभिरुर्वशी वा गृणातु । उर्वशी वा बृहद्दिवा गृणानाभ्यूर्ण्वाना प्रभृथस्यायोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi na iḷā yūthasya mātā smannadībhirurvaśī vā gṛṇātu | urvaśī vā bṛhaddivā gṛṇānābhyūrṇvānā prabhṛthasyāyoḥ ||

translations.english: May Iḷā, the mother of the herd, and Urvaśī with the rivers, be favourable to us; may the bright-shining Urvaśī (come), commanding our devotion, and investing the worshipper with light.

mantras.sanskrit: सिषक्तु न ऊर्जव्यस्य पुष्टेः ॥
mantras.transliteration: siṣaktu na ūrjavyasya puṣṭeḥ ||

translations.english: May she cherish us (as the servants) of our patron Ūrjavya.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र शंतमा वरुणं दीधिती गीर्मित्रं भगमदितिं नूनमश्याः । पृषद्योनिः पञ्चहोता शृणोत्वतूर्तपन्था असुरो मयोभुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra śaṃtamā varuṇaṃ dīdhitī gīrmitraṃ bhagamaditiṃ nūnamaśyāḥ | pṛṣadyoniḥ pañcahotā śṛṇotvatūrtapanthā asuro mayobhuḥ ||

translations.english: May our most animating praise, together with our offerings, successfully attain Varuṇa, Mitra, Bhaga and Aditi; may the ministrant of the five (vital airs, Vāyu), the dweller in the dappled (firmament), he whose path is unimpeded, who is the giver of life, the bestower of happiness, hear.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रति मे स्तोममदितिर्जगृभ्यात्सूनुं न माता हृद्यं सुशेवम् । ब्रह्म प्रियं देवहितं यदस्त्यहं मित्रे वरुणे यन्मयोभु ॥
mantras.transliteration: prati me stomamaditirjagṛbhyātsūnuṃ na mātā hṛdyaṃ suśevam | brahma priyaṃ devahitaṃ yadastyahaṃ mitre varuṇe yanmayobhu ||

translations.english: May Aditi accept my affectionate and devoted praise, as a mother (the endearments of) a son; the plural asing, delightful prayer that is approved of by the gods I address to Varuṇa and Mitra.

mantras.sanskrit: उदीरय कवितमं कवीनामुनत्तैनमभि मध्वा घृतेन । स नो वसूनि प्रयता हितानि चन्द्राणि देवः सविता सुवाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: udīraya kavitamaṃ kavīnāmunattainamabhi madhvā ghṛtena | sa no vasūni prayatā hitāni candrāṇi devaḥ savitā suvāti ||

translations.english: Celebrate, (priests), the most prophetic of the prophets; imbue him with the sweet libation, and may the divine Savitā bestow upon us ample, beneficial and delightful riches.

mantras.sanskrit: समिन्द्र णो मनसा नेषि गोभिः सं सूरिभिर्हरिवः सं स्वस्ति । सं ब्रह्मणा देवहितं यदस्ति सं देवानां सुमत्या यज्ञियानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: samindra ṇo manasā neṣi gobhiḥ saṃ sūribhirharivaḥ saṃ svasti | saṃ brahmaṇā devahitaṃ yadasti saṃ devānāṃ sumatyā yajñiyānām ||

translations.english: With a (willing) mind, Indra, you associate us with cattle, with pious (priests) and, lord of steeds, with prosperity, with (sacrificial) food that is agreeable to the gods, and with the favour of the adorable deities.

mantras.sanskrit: देवो भगः सविता रायो अंश इन्द्रो वृत्रस्य संजितो धनानाम् । ऋभुक्षा वाज उत वा पुरंधिरवन्तु नो अमृतासस्तुरासः ॥
mantras.transliteration: devo bhagaḥ savitā rāyo aṃśa indro vṛtrasya saṃjito dhanānām | ṛbhukṣā vāja uta vā puraṃdhiravantu no amṛtāsasturāsaḥ ||

translations.english: May the divine Bhaga, Savitā, the lord of wealth, Aṃśa, Indra (the slayer) of Vṛtra, (all) the conquerors of riches, Ṛbhukṣin, Vāja and also Purandhi, immortals, hastening (to our sacrifice) preserve us.

mantras.sanskrit: मरुत्वतो अप्रतीतस्य जिष्णोरजूर्यतः प्र ब्रवामा कृतानि । न ते पूर्वे मघवन्नापरासो न वीर्यं नूतनः कश्चनाप ॥
mantras.transliteration: marutvato apratītasya jiṣṇorajūryataḥ pra bravāmā kṛtāni | na te pūrve maghavannāparāso na vīryaṃ nūtanaḥ kaścanāpa ||

translations.english: We celebrate the exploits of Marutvat, the unrecoiling, the victorious, the undecaying; neither the ancients, Maghavan, nor their successors, have attained your prowess, nor has any one recent attained it.

mantras.sanskrit: उप स्तुहि प्रथमं रत्नधेयं बृहस्पतिं सनितारं धनानाम् । यः शंसते स्तुवते शम्भविष्ठः पुरूवसुरागमज्जोहुवानम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa stuhi prathamaṃ ratnadheyaṃ bṛhaspatiṃ sanitāraṃ dhanānām | yaḥ śaṃsate stuvate śambhaviṣṭhaḥ purūvasurāgamajjohuvānam ||

translations.english: Glorify the first donor of precious treasure, Bṛhaspati, the distributor of riches, the bestower of great happiness upon him who recites or chants (his praise), who comes laden with ample wealth to his invoker.

mantras.sanskrit: तवोतिभिः सचमाना अरिष्टा बृहस्पते मघवानः सुवीराः । ये अश्वदा उत वा सन्ति गोदा ये वस्त्रदाः सुभगास्तेषु रायः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tavotibhiḥ sacamānā ariṣṭā bṛhaspate maghavānaḥ suvīrāḥ | ye aśvadā uta vā santi godā ye vastradāḥ subhagāsteṣu rāyaḥ ||

translations.english: Associated, Bṛhaspati, with your protections, (men) are unharmed (by foes), and become opulent and blessed with descendants; may wealth devolve on those who are genitive rous, and givers of horses, of cows, of clothes.

mantras.sanskrit: विसर्माणं कृणुहि वित्तमेषां ये भुञ्जते अपृणन्तो न उक्थैः । अपव्रतान्प्रसवे वावृधानान्ब्रह्मद्विषः सूर्याद्यावयस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: visarmāṇaṃ kṛṇuhi vittameṣāṃ ye bhuñjate apṛṇanto na ukthaiḥ | apavratānprasave vāvṛdhānānbrahmadviṣaḥ sūryādyāvayasva ||
