translations.english: Render transitory the riches of those who partake of enjoyment without giving satisfaction (to those who are eminent) by holy hymns; put apart from the sun those who perform not sacred rites, and who, though prospering in their posterity, are the adversaries of prayer.

mantras.sanskrit: य ओहते रक्षसो देववीतावचक्रेभिस्तं मरुतो नि यात । यो वः शमीं शशमानस्य निन्दात्तुच्छ्यान्कामान्करते सिष्विदानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya ohate rakṣaso devavītāvacakrebhistaṃ maruto ni yāta | yo vaḥ śamīṃ śaśamānasya nindāttucchyānkāmānkarate siṣvidānaḥ ||

translations.english: Send, Maruts, into darkness with (cars) devoid of wheels, the man who invites the rākṣasas to the food of the gods; (him also) who reviles me when offering praise to you; while sweating, he toils (to realize) vain desires.

mantras.sanskrit: तमु ष्टुहि यः स्विषुः सुधन्वा यो विश्वस्य क्षयति भेषजस्य । यक्ष्वा महे सौमनसाय रुद्रं नमोभिर्देवमसुरं दुवस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamu ṣṭuhi yaḥ sviṣuḥ sudhanvā yo viśvasya kṣayati bheṣajasya | yakṣvā mahe saumanasāya rudraṃ namobhirdevamasuraṃ duvasya ||

translations.english: Praise him who has the sure arrow, the strong bow, who presides over all sanitary drugs; worship Rudra for a comprehensive and sound understanding; adore the powerful divinity with prostrations.

mantras.sanskrit: दमूनसो अपसो ये सुहस्ता वृष्णः पत्नीर्नद्यो विभ्वतष्टाः । सरस्वती बृहद्दिवोत राका दशस्यन्तीर्वरिवस्यन्तु शुभ्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: damūnaso apaso ye suhastā vṛṣṇaḥ patnīrnadyo vibhvataṣṭāḥ | sarasvatī bṛhaddivota rākā daśasyantīrvarivasyantu śubhrāḥ ||

translations.english: May the dexterous-handed, humble-minded artist (of the gods, the Ṛbhus); may the wives of the showerer (Indra); may the rivers carved out by Vibhu; may Sarasvatī and the brilliant Rākā, the illustrious granters of desires, be willing to grant us riches.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सू महे सुशरणाय मेधां गिरं भरे नव्यसीं जायमानाम् । य आहना दुहितुर्वक्षणासु रूपा मिनानो अकृणोदिदं नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra sū mahe suśaraṇāya medhāṃ giraṃ bhare navyasīṃ jāyamānām | ya āhanā duhiturvakṣaṇāsu rūpā mināno akṛṇodidaṃ naḥ ||

translations.english: To the great protector, (Indra), I offer devout pious praise, new and originated (at this time); to him, the showerer, who, for his daughter (earth), giving form to the rivers, has provided this water for our (use).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सुष्टुतिः स्तनयन्तं रुवन्तमिळस्पतिं जरितर्नूनमश्याः । यो अब्दिमाँ उदनिमाँ इयर्ति प्र विद्युता रोदसी उक्षमाणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra suṣṭutiḥ stanayantaṃ ruvantamiḷaspatiṃ jaritarnūnamaśyāḥ | yo abdimā~ udanimā~ iyarti pra vidyutā rodasī ukṣamāṇaḥ ||

translations.english: May your pious praise, oḥ worshipper, assuredly reach the thundering, roaring lord of Iḷā, who, impelling the clouds and distributing the rain, proceeds, illuminating the heaven and earth with lightning.

mantras.sanskrit: एष स्तोमो मारुतं शर्धो अच्छा रुद्रस्य सूनूँर्युवन्यूँरुदश्याः । कामो राये हवते मा स्वस्त्युप स्तुहि पृषदश्वाँ अयासः ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa stomo mārutaṃ śardho acchā rudrasya sūnū~ryuvanyū~rudaśyāḥ | kāmo rāye havate mā svastyupa stuhi pṛṣadaśvā~ ayāsaḥ ||

translations.english: May this hymn reach up to the presence of the might of the Maruts the youthful sons of Rudra; the desire of riches incites me to holiness; glorify those who go to sacrifice on spotted steeds.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रैष स्तोमः पृथिवीमन्तरिक्षं वनस्पतीँरोषधी राये अश्याः । देवोदेवः सुहवो भूतु मह्यं मा नो माता पृथिवी दुर्मतौ धात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: praiṣa stomaḥ pṛthivīmantarikṣaṃ vanaspatī~roṣadhī rāye aśyāḥ | devodevaḥ suhavo bhūtu mahyaṃ mā no mātā pṛthivī durmatau dhāt ||

translations.english: {Text is missing}

mantras.sanskrit: उरौ देवा अनिबाधे स्याम ॥
mantras.transliteration: urau devā anibādhe syāma ||

translations.english: May we ever, gods, enjoy great and uninterrupted felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: समश्विनोरवसा नूतनेन मयोभुवा सुप्रणीती गमेम । आ नो रयिं वहतमोत वीराना विश्वान्यमृता सौभगानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: samaśvinoravasā nūtanena mayobhuvā supraṇītī gamema | ā no rayiṃ vahatamota vīrānā viśvānyamṛtā saubhagāni ||

translations.english: May we ever be participant of the unprecedented, joy-conferring and well-guided protection of the Aśvins; bring to us, immortal (Aśvins), riches, male progeny, and all good things.

mantras.sanskrit: आ धेनवः पयसा तूर्ण्यर्था अमर्धन्तीरुप नो यन्तु मध्वा । महो राये बृहतीः सप्त विप्रो मयोभुवो जरिता जोहवीति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā dhenavaḥ payasā tūrṇyarthā amardhantīrupa no yantu madhvā | maho rāye bṛhatīḥ sapta vipro mayobhuvo jaritā johavīti ||

translations.english: May the kine, quick-moving, doing no harm, come to us, (laden) with their sweet fluid; the wise worshipper invokes the seven vast and joy-diffusing (rivers) for the sake of ample riches.

mantras.sanskrit: आ सुष्टुती नमसा वर्तयध्यै द्यावा वाजाय पृथिवी अमृध्रे । पिता माता मधुवचाः सुहस्ता भरेभरे नो यशसावविष्टाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā suṣṭutī namasā vartayadhyai dyāvā vājāya pṛthivī amṛdhre | pitā mātā madhuvacāḥ suhastā bharebhare no yaśasāvaviṣṭām ||

translations.english: (I purpose) to approach with pious praise, and with oblations, for (the sake of) uninjured heaven and earth may the paternal (heaven), and the sweet-spoken, free-handed, maternal (earth), both enjoying renown, defens us in every battle.

mantras.sanskrit: अध्वर्यवश्चकृवांसो मधूनि प्र वायवे भरत चारु शुक्रम् । होतेव नः प्रथमः पाह्यस्य देव मध्वो ररिमा ते मदाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhvaryavaścakṛvāṃso madhūni pra vāyave bharata cāru śukram | hoteva naḥ prathamaḥ pāhyasya deva madhvo rarimā te madāya ||

translations.english: Priests, who are preparing (the libation), first offer to Vāyu the delightful and brilliant (Soma); and do you, divine Vāyu, like the Hotā, first drink of this sweet juice, which we offer for your exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: दश क्षिपो युञ्जते बाहू अद्रिं सोमस्य या शमितारा सुहस्ता । मध्वो रसं सुगभस्तिर्गिरिष्ठां चनिश्चदद्दुदुहे शुक्रमंशुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: daśa kṣipo yuñjate bāhū adriṃ somasya yā śamitārā suhastā | madhvo rasaṃ sugabhastirgiriṣṭhāṃ caniścadadduduhe śukramaṃśuḥ ||

translations.english: The ten express of the juice, (the fingers), and the two arms of the priests, which are the dexterous immolators of the Soma, take hold of the stone; the exulting, skilful-fingered (priest) milks the mountain-born juice of the sweet Soma, and that Soma (yields its) pure juice.

mantras.sanskrit: असावि ते जुजुषाणाय सोमः क्रत्वे दक्षाय बृहते मदाय । हरी रथे सुधुरा योगे अर्वागिन्द्र प्रिया कृणुहि हूयमानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asāvi te jujuṣāṇāya somaḥ kratve dakṣāya bṛhate madāya | harī rathe sudhurā yoge arvāgindra priyā kṛṇuhi hūyamānaḥ ||

translations.english: The Soma has been effused, (Indra), for your gratification, for (giving you) strength in action, and for your great exhilaration; therefore Indra, when invoked by us, put to your two beloved, docile, well-trained horses in your car, and come down.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो महीमरमतिं सजोषा ग्नां देवीं नमसा रातहव्याम् । मधोर्मदाय बृहतीमृतज्ञामाग्ने वह पथिभिर्देवयानैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no mahīmaramatiṃ sajoṣā gnāṃ devīṃ namasā rātahavyām | madhormadāya bṛhatīmṛtajñāmāgne vaha pathibhirdevayānaiḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, being well plural asd with us, bring to us, by paths frequented by the gods, the divine (feminine le), Gnā, mighty and omnipresent, to whom oblations are offered with reverence, who is vast and cognizant of rites, to partake of the exhilaration of the sweet Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: अञ्जन्ति यं प्रथयन्तो न विप्रा वपावन्तं नाग्निना तपन्तः । पितुर्न पुत्र उपसि प्रेष्ठ आ घर्मो अग्निमृतयन्नसादि ॥
mantras.transliteration: añjanti yaṃ prathayanto na viprā vapāvantaṃ nāgninā tapantaḥ | piturna putra upasi preṣṭha ā gharmo agnimṛtayannasādi ||

translations.english: The vessel which the priests, celebrating (it), supply with butter, as if roasting a marrow-yielding animal with fire, has been plural ced, desirous of the sacrifice, upon the fire, like a son upon the lap of his father.

mantras.sanskrit: अच्छा मही बृहती शंतमा गीर्दूतो न गन्त्वश्विना हुवध्यै । मयोभुवा सरथा यातमर्वाग्गन्तं निधिं धुरमाणिर्न नाभिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: acchā mahī bṛhatī śaṃtamā gīrdūto na gantvaśvinā huvadhyai | mayobhuvā sarathā yātamarvāggantaṃ nidhiṃ dhuramāṇirna nābhim ||

translations.english: May this adoring, earnest, and gratifying praise go like a messenger to summon the Aśvins hither; come, Aśvins, givers of happiness, riding in one chariot, come down to the deposited (Soma), as the bolt (is essential) to the axle of the wagon.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र तव्यसो नमौक्तिं तुरस्याहं पूष्ण उत वायोरदिक्षि । या राधसा चोदितारा मतीनां या वाजस्य द्रविणोदा उत त्मन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra tavyaso namauktiṃ turasyāhaṃ pūṣṇa uta vāyoradikṣi | yā rādhasā coditārā matīnāṃ yā vājasya draviṇodā uta tman ||

translations.english: I offer adoration to the powerful and rapid Pūṣaṇ, and to (the powerful and rapid) Vāyu, who are both instrumental gators of the desire of wealth and of food, (who are both) distributors of riches.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नामभिर्मरुतो वक्षि विश्वाना रूपेभिर्जातवेदो हुवानः । यज्ञं गिरो जरितुः सुष्टुतिं च विश्वे गन्त मरुतो विश्व ऊती ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā nāmabhirmaruto vakṣi viśvānā rūpebhirjātavedo huvānaḥ | yajñaṃ giro jarituḥ suṣṭutiṃ ca viśve ganta maruto viśva ūtī ||

translations.english: Bring hither Jātavedas, who are invoked by us all, the Maruts, under their several names and forms; come all you Maruts, with all your protecting faculties, to the sacrifice, the paises, and the adoration of the worshipper.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो दिवो बृहतः पर्वतादा सरस्वती यजता गन्तु यज्ञम् । हवं देवी जुजुषाणा घृताची शग्मां नो वाचमुशती शृणोतु ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no divo bṛhataḥ parvatādā sarasvatī yajatā gantu yajñam | havaṃ devī jujuṣāṇā ghṛtācī śagmāṃ no vācamuśatī śṛṇotu ||

translations.english: May the radiant Sarasvatī come to the sacrifice from the heavens or the spacious firmament; may the goddess, the showerer of water, propitiated by our invocation, and desirous of our gratifying praises hear.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वेधसं नीलपृष्ठं बृहन्तं बृहस्पतिं सदने सादयध्वम् । सादद्योनिं दम आ दीदिवांसं हिरण्यवर्णमरुषं सपेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vedhasaṃ nīlapṛṣṭhaṃ bṛhantaṃ bṛhaspatiṃ sadane sādayadhvam | sādadyoniṃ dama ā dīdivāṃsaṃ hiraṇyavarṇamaruṣaṃ sapema ||

translations.english: (Priests) plural ce the mighty Bṛhaspati, the creator whose back is dark blue, in the chamber (of sacrifice); let us worship him who is seated in the interior of the mansion, everywhere shining, golden-hued, resplendent.

mantras.sanskrit: आ धर्णसिर्बृहद्दिवो रराणो विश्वेभिर्गन्त्वोमभिर्हुवानः । ग्ना वसान ओषधीरमृध्रस्त्रिधातुशृङ्गो वृषभो वयोधाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā dharṇasirbṛhaddivo rarāṇo viśvebhirgantvomabhirhuvānaḥ | gnā vasāna oṣadhīramṛdhrastridhātuśṛṅgo vṛṣabho vayodhāḥ ||

translations.english: May the sustainer of all, (Agni), the greatly radiant, the delighter, come, with all his protecting (faculties), when invoked; he who is clothed with flames and with plural nts; who is irresistible; who has horns of three colours, the showerer (of benefits), the accepter of oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: मातुष्पदे परमे शुक्र आयोर्विपन्यवो रास्पिरासो अग्मन् । सुशेव्यं नमसा रातहव्याः शिशुं मृजन्त्यायवो न वासे ॥
mantras.transliteration: mātuṣpade parame śukra āyorvipanyavo rāspirāso agman | suśevyaṃ namasā rātahavyāḥ śiśuṃ mṛjantyāyavo na vāse ||

translations.english: The holders of the (sacrificial) ladles, the ministrant priests of the man (who instrumental tutes the rite), have repaired to the bright and most excellent plural ce of the maternal (earth); offerers of the oblations, they foster the tender infant, (Agni), with worship, as people rub (the limbs of a child to promote his) existence.

mantras.sanskrit: बृहद्वयो बृहते तुभ्यमग्ने धियाजुरो मिथुनासः सचन्त । देवोदेवः सुहवो भूतु मह्यं मा नो माता पृथिवी दुर्मतौ धात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhadvayo bṛhate tubhyamagne dhiyājuro mithunāsaḥ sacanta | devodevaḥ suhavo bhūtu mahyaṃ mā no mātā pṛthivī durmatau dhāt ||

translations.english: Married pairs, worn by devout rites; jointly offer abundant sacrificial food, Agni, to you who are mighty; may each individual divinity be successfully invoked by me; let them not take us into unfavourable thought.

mantras.sanskrit: उरौ देवा अनिबाधे स्याम ॥
mantras.transliteration: urau devā anibādhe syāma ||

translations.english: [16-17] May we ever be participant of the unprecedent joy-conferring, and well-guiding protection of the Aśvins bring to us, immortal (Aśvins), riches, male progeny, and all good things.

mantras.sanskrit: समश्विनोरवसा नूतनेन मयोभुवा सुप्रणीती गमेम । आ नो रयिं वहतमोत वीराना विश्वान्यमृता सौभगानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: samaśvinoravasā nūtanena mayobhuvā supraṇītī gamema | ā no rayiṃ vahatamota vīrānā viśvānyamṛtā saubhagāni ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: तं प्रत्नथा पूर्वथा विश्वथेमथा ज्येष्ठतातिं बर्हिषदं स्वर्विदम् । प्रतीचीनं वृजनं दोहसे गिराशुं जयन्तमनु यासु वर्धसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ pratnathā pūrvathā viśvathemathā jyeṣṭhatātiṃ barhiṣadaṃ svarvidam | pratīcīnaṃ vṛjanaṃ dohase girāśuṃ jayantamanu yāsu vardhase ||

translations.english: In like manneer as the ancient (sages), those our predecessors, as all sages, and those of the present period (have obtained their wishes by his praise), so do you by praise extract (my desires) from him who is the oldest and best (of the gods), who is seated on the sacred grass, who is cognizant of heaven, coming to our presence, vigorous, swift, victorious, for by such praises you exalt him.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रिये सुदृशीरुपरस्य याः स्वर्विरोचमानः ककुभामचोदते । सुगोपा असि न दभाय सुक्रतो परो मायाभिॠत आस नाम ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: śriye sudṛśīruparasya yāḥ svarvirocamānaḥ kakubhāmacodate | sugopā asi na dabhāya sukrato paro māyābhiṝta āsa nāma te ||

translations.english: Do you, (Indra), who are radiant in heaven, spread through the regions, for the good (of mankind), those the beautiful (waters) of the unyielding cloud; doer of good deeds, you are the preserver (of men), not (destined) for their detriment; you are superior to all delusions; you names abides in the world of truth.

mantras.sanskrit: अत्यं हविः सचते सच्च धातु चारिष्टगातुः स होता सहोभरिः । प्रसर्स्राणो अनु बर्हिर्वृषा शिशुर्मध्ये युवाजरो विस्रुहा हितः ॥
mantras.transliteration: atyaṃ haviḥ sacate sacca dhātu cāriṣṭagātuḥ sa hotā sahobhariḥ | prasarsrāṇo anu barhirvṛṣā śiśurmadhye yuvājaro visruhā hitaḥ ||

translations.english: He, (Agni), is associated with the perpetual oblation that is the true (source of good); the sustainer of all, he is of unrestricted movement, the offerer (of burnt-offerings), the cherisher of strength; gliding especially over the sacred grass, the showerer (of benefits); an infant, a youth, exempt from decay, whose plural ce is among plural nts.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र व एते सुयुजो यामन्निष्टये नीचीरमुष्मै यम्य ऋतावृधः । सुयन्तुभिः सर्वशासैरभीशुभिः क्रिविर्नामानि प्रवणे मुषायति ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra va ete suyujo yāmanniṣṭaye nīcīramuṣmai yamya ṛtāvṛdhaḥ | suyantubhiḥ sarvaśāsairabhīśubhiḥ krivirnāmāni pravaṇe muṣāyati ||

translations.english: These well-combined rays (of the sun) are descending with intent to proceed on the path (of the sacrifice), amplifiers of the ceremony for this (its instrumental tutor); operating with these swift-moving, all-regulating rays, he, (Āditya) steals the waters (that flow) in low plural ces.

mantras.sanskrit: संजर्भुराणस्तरुभिः सुतेगृभं वयाकिनं चित्तगर्भासु सुस्वरुः । धारवाकेष्वृजुगाथ शोभसे वर्धस्व पत्नीरभि जीवो अध्वरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃjarbhurāṇastarubhiḥ sutegṛbhaṃ vayākinaṃ cittagarbhāsu susvaruḥ | dhāravākeṣvṛjugātha śobhase vardhasva patnīrabhi jīvo adhvare ||

translations.english: Object of honest eulogies (Agni), you shine among the reciters of your praises when the Soma is received at its effusion by the wooden (cups), and you accepting (the beverage), are animated by the heart-affecting (praises); giver of life, increase in the sacrifice your protecting flames.

mantras.sanskrit: यादृगेव ददृशे तादृगुच्यते सं छायया दधिरे सिध्रयाप्स्वा । महीमस्मभ्यमुरुषामुरु ज्रयो बृहत्सुवीरमनपच्युतं सहः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yādṛgeva dadṛśe tādṛgucyate saṃ chāyayā dadhire sidhrayāpsvā | mahīmasmabhyamuruṣāmuru jrayo bṛhatsuvīramanapacyutaṃ sahaḥ ||

translations.english: Such as (the deity) is beheld, such is he said (to be); they abide with concentrated splendour in the waters; (may they bestow) upon us honourable and ample (riches) great energy, numerous male offspring and undecaying vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: वेत्यग्रुर्जनिवान्वा अति स्पृधः समर्यता मनसा सूर्यः कविः । घ्रंसं रक्षन्तं परि विश्वतो गयमस्माकं शर्म वनवत्स्वावसुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vetyagrurjanivānvā ati spṛdhaḥ samaryatā manasā sūryaḥ kaviḥ | ghraṃsaṃ rakṣantaṃ pari viśvato gayamasmākaṃ śarma vanavatsvāvasuḥ ||

translations.english: The sage Sūrya, advancing, accompanied by his bride, (the dawn), proceeds boldly, intent on combat with his enemies; may he on whom riches are dependent, secure our entire felicity, (and grant) a brilliant and everywhere protecting mansion.

mantras.sanskrit: ज्यायांसमस्य यतुनस्य केतुन ऋषिस्वरं चरति यासु नाम ते । यादृश्मिन्धायि तमपस्यया विदद्य उ स्वयं वहते सो अरं करत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: jyāyāṃsamasya yatunasya ketuna ṛṣisvaraṃ carati yāsu nāma te | yādṛśmindhāyi tamapasyayā vidadya u svayaṃ vahate so araṃ karat ||

translations.english: The (pious man) proceeds to you, most excellent (of the gods, who are indicated) by the sign of this moving (revolution); who are hymned by the ṛṣis in whose praises youyr name (is glorified); he obtains that blessing by his devotion, on whatsoever (his desire) has been fixed; and he also, who of his own accord offers (worship) acquires abundant (reward).

mantras.sanskrit: समुद्रमासामव तस्थे अग्रिमा न रिष्यति सवनं यस्मिन्नायता । अत्रा न हार्दि क्रवणस्य रेजते यत्रा मतिर्विद्यते पूतबन्धनी ॥
mantras.transliteration: samudramāsāmava tasthe agrimā na riṣyati savanaṃ yasminnāyatā | atrā na hārdi kravaṇasya rejate yatrā matirvidyate pūtabandhanī ||

translations.english: The chief of these (our praises) proceed to the ocean-like sun; that chamber of sacrifice fails not in which (his praises) are prolonged; there are heart's desire of the worshiper is not disappointed where the mind is known to be attached to the pure (sun).

mantras.sanskrit: स हि क्षत्रस्य मनसस्य चित्तिभिरेवावदस्य यजतस्य सध्रेः । अवत्सारस्य स्पृणवाम रण्वभिः शविष्ठं वाजं विदुषा चिदर्ध्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa hi kṣatrasya manasasya cittibhirevāvadasya yajatasya sadhreḥ | avatsārasya spṛṇavāma raṇvabhiḥ śaviṣṭhaṃ vājaṃ viduṣā cidardhyam ||

translations.english: He verily (it to be glorified); let us, with the plural asant thoughts of Kṣatra, Manasa, Avada, Vajada, Sadhri and Avatsara, fill up the invigorating food (the portion) to be shared by the wise.

mantras.sanskrit: श्येन आसामदितिः कक्ष्यो मदो विश्ववारस्य यजतस्य मायिनः । समन्यमन्यमर्थयन्त्येतवे विदुर्विषाणं परिपानमन्ति ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: śyena āsāmaditiḥ kakṣyo mado viśvavārasya yajatasya māyinaḥ | samanyamanyamarthayantyetave vidurviṣāṇaṃ paripānamanti te ||

translations.english: Swift is the excessive and girth-distending inebriation of Viśvavārā, Yajata and Māyin; (by drinking) of these (juices) they urge one another to drink; they find the copious draught the prompt giver of intoxication.

mantras.sanskrit: सदापृणो यजतो वि द्विषो वधीद्बाहुवृक्तः श्रुतवित्तर्यो वः सचा । उभा स वरा प्रत्येति भाति च यदीं गणं भजते सुप्रयावभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sadāpṛṇo yajato vi dviṣo vadhīdbāhuvṛktaḥ śrutavittaryo vaḥ sacā | ubhā sa varā pratyeti bhāti ca yadīṃ gaṇaṃ bhajate suprayāvabhiḥ ||

translations.english: May Sadāpṛṇa, Yajata, Bahuvṛkta, Śrutavit, Tarya, associated with you, destoy, your foes; the ṛṣi obtains his desires in both (worlds), and shines brightly, whenever he adores with well-mingled (offerings and praises) the host (of heaven).

mantras.sanskrit: सुतम्भरो यजमानस्य सत्पतिर्विश्वासामूधः स धियामुदञ्चनः । भरद्धेनू रसवच्छिश्रिये पयोऽनुब्रुवाणो अध्येति न स्वपन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sutambharo yajamānasya satpatirviśvāsāmūdhaḥ sa dhiyāmudañcanaḥ | bharaddhenū rasavacchiśriye payo'nubruvāṇo adhyeti na svapan ||

translations.english: Sutambhara, is the ministrant priest of the instrumental tutor of the sacrifice, the causer of the upward ascent of all holy rites; the cow offers juicy (milk); the milk is distributed; announcing this in order (Avastāra) studies (the holy texts) without repose.

mantras.sanskrit: यो जागार तमृचः कामयन्ते यो जागार तमु सामानि यन्ति । यो जागार तमयं सोम आह तवाहमस्मि सख्ये न्योकाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo jāgāra tamṛcaḥ kāmayante yo jāgāra tamu sāmāni yanti | yo jāgāra tamayaṃ soma āha tavāhamasmi sakhye nyokāḥ ||

translations.english: Him who is ever vigilant, holy verses desire; to him who is ever vigilant sacred songs proceed; him who is ever vigilant the Soma thus addresses, I am always abiding in your fellowship.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निर्जागार तमृचः कामयन्तेऽग्निर्जागार तमु सामानि यन्ति । अग्निर्जागार तमयं सोम आह तवाहमस्मि सख्ये न्योकाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirjāgāra tamṛcaḥ kāmayante'gnirjāgāra tamu sāmāni yanti | agnirjāgāra tamayaṃ soma āha tavāhamasmi sakhye nyokāḥ ||

translations.english: Agni is ever vigilant, and him holy verses desire; Agni is ever vigilant, and to him sacred songs proceed; Agni is ever vigilant, and him the Soma addresses, I am ever abiding in your fellowship.

mantras.sanskrit: विदा दिवो विष्यन्नद्रिमुक्थैरायत्या उषसो अर्चिनो गुः । अपावृत व्रजिनीरुत्स्वर्गाद्वि दुरो मानुषीर्देव आवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vidā divo viṣyannadrimukthairāyatyā uṣaso arcino guḥ | apāvṛta vrajinīrutsvargādvi duro mānuṣīrdeva āvaḥ ||

translations.english: (Indra) recovered (the hidden cattle), hurling his thunderbolt from heaven at the prayers of the Aṅgirasas; the rays of the approaching dawn are spread around; the divine sun, scattering the clustered gloom, has risen and set open the doors of (the habitations of) men.

mantras.sanskrit: वि सूर्यो अमतिं न श्रियं सादोर्वाद्गवां माता जानती गात् । धन्वर्णसो नद्यः खादोअर्णाः स्थूणेव सुमिता दृंहत द्यौः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi sūryo amatiṃ na śriyaṃ sādorvādgavāṃ mātā jānatī gāt | dhanvarṇaso nadyaḥ khādoarṇāḥ sthūṇeva sumitā dṛṃhata dyauḥ ||

translations.english: The sun distributes his radiance as it was a substance; the parent of the rays of light, (the dawn), knowing his approach, comes from the spacious (firmament); the rivers with running waters flow, breaking down their banks; the heaven is stable like a well-constructed pillar.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मा उक्थाय पर्वतस्य गर्भो महीनां जनुषे पूर्व्याय । वि पर्वतो जिहीत साधत द्यौराविवासन्तो दसयन्त भूम ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmā ukthāya parvatasya garbho mahīnāṃ januṣe pūrvyāya | vi parvato jihīta sādhata dyaurāvivāsanto dasayanta bhūma ||

translations.english: To me, when offering praise, as to an ancient author of sacred songs, the burden of the cloud (descends); the cloud parts (with its burden); the sky performs (its office); he assiduously worshipping Aṅgirasas are exhausted by much (adoration).

mantras.sanskrit: सूक्तेभिर्वो वचोभिर्देवजुष्टैरिन्द्रा न्वग्नी अवसे हुवध्यै । उक्थेभिर्हि ष्मा कवयः सुयज्ञा आविवासन्तो मरुतो यजन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: sūktebhirvo vacobhirdevajuṣṭairindrā nvagnī avase huvadhyai | ukthebhirhi ṣmā kavayaḥ suyajñā āvivāsanto maruto yajanti ||

translations.english: I Indra and Agni, I invoke you for my salvation with well-uttered words, agreeable to the gods; for verily, sages excelling in sacrifice, and diligently adoring, worship you with sacred songs, prompt as the Maruts (in devotion).

mantras.sanskrit: एतो न्वद्य सुध्यो भवाम प्र दुच्छुना मिनवामा वरीयः । आरे द्वेषांसि सनुतर्दधामायाम प्राञ्चो यजमानमच्छ ॥
mantras.transliteration: eto nvadya sudhyo bhavāma pra ducchunā minavāmā varīyaḥ | āre dveṣāṃsi sanutardadhāmāyāma prāñco yajamānamaccha ||

translations.english: Come today quickly; let us be engaged in pious acts; let us entirely annihilate the hostile; let us keep off all sacred enemies; let us hasten to the presence of the instrumental tutor of the rite.

mantras.sanskrit: एता धियं कृणवामा सखायोऽप या माताँ ऋणुत व्रजं गोः । यया मनुर्विशिशिप्रं जिगाय यया वणिग्वङ्कुरापा पुरीषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: etā dhiyaṃ kṛṇavāmā sakhāyo'pa yā mātā~ ṛṇuta vrajaṃ goḥ | yayā manurviśiśipraṃ jigāya yayā vaṇigvaṅkurāpā purīṣam ||

translations.english: Come, friends, let us celebrate that solemn rite which was effectual in setting open the (secret) stalls of the (stolen) cattle; by which Manu overcame Viśiśipra; by which the merchant, going to the wood (for it), obtained the water.

mantras.sanskrit: अनूनोदत्र हस्तयतो अद्रिरार्चन्येन दश मासो नवग्वाः । ऋतं यती सरमा गा अविन्दद्विश्वानि सत्याङ्गिराश्चकार ॥
mantras.transliteration: anūnodatra hastayato adrirārcanyena daśa māso navagvāḥ | ṛtaṃ yatī saramā gā avindadviśvāni satyāṅgirāścakāra ||

translations.english: At this sacrifice the stone (set in motion) by the hands (of the priests) makes a noise, whereby the nine-months ministrants celebrated the ten-months worship; when Saramā, going to the ceremony, discovered the cattle, and Aṅgiras rendered all the rites effective.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वे अस्या व्युषि माहिनायाः सं यद्गोभिरङ्गिरसो नवन्त । उत्स आसां परमे सधस्थ ऋतस्य पथा सरमा विदद्गाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśve asyā vyuṣi māhināyāḥ saṃ yadgobhiraṅgiraso navanta | utsa āsāṃ parame sadhastha ṛtasya pathā saramā vidadgāḥ ||

translations.english: When all the Aṅgirasas, on the opening of this adorable dawn, came in contact with the (discovered) cattle, then milk and the rest were offered in the august assembly, for Saramā had found cows by the path of truth.

mantras.sanskrit: आ सूर्यो यातु सप्ताश्वः क्षेत्रं यदस्योर्विया दीर्घयाथे । रघुः श्येनः पतयदन्धो अच्छा युवा कविर्दीदयद्गोषु गच्छन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā sūryo yātu saptāśvaḥ kṣetraṃ yadasyorviyā dīrghayāthe | raghuḥ śyenaḥ patayadandho acchā yuvā kavirdīdayadgoṣu gacchan ||

translations.english: May Sūrya, lord of seven steeds, arrive, for he has a distant goal (to reach) by a tedious route; fleet as a hawk he pounces upon the offered (sacrificial) food; ever young and far-seeing, he shines, moving amidst rays of light.

mantras.sanskrit: आ सूर्यो अरुहच्छुक्रमर्णोऽयुक्त यद्धरितो वीतपृष्ठाः । उद्ना न नावमनयन्त धीरा आशृण्वतीरापो अर्वागतिष्ठन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā sūryo aruhacchukramarṇo'yukta yaddharito vītapṛṣṭhāḥ | udnā na nāvamanayanta dhīrā āśṛṇvatīrāpo arvāgatiṣṭhan ||

translations.english: Sūrya has ascended above the glistening water, as soon as he has put to his bright-backed steeds; sage (worshippers) have drawn him, like a ship, across the sea; the waters hearing his commands, have come down.

mantras.sanskrit: धियं वो अप्सु दधिषे स्वर्षां ययातरन्दश मासो नवग्वाः । अया धिया स्याम देवगोपा अया धिया तुतुर्यामात्यंहः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhiyaṃ vo apsu dadhiṣe svarṣāṃ yayātarandaśa māso navagvāḥ | ayā dhiyā syāma devagopā ayā dhiyā tuturyāmātyaṃhaḥ ||

translations.english: I offer to you, (gods), for the sake of water, an all-bestowing sacrifice, whereby the nine-months ministrants have completed the ten-months rite; may we, by this sacrifice, be the protected of the gods; may we, by this sacrifice, cross over the boundaries of sin.

mantras.sanskrit: हयो न विद्वाँ अयुजि स्वयं धुरि तां वहामि प्रतरणीमवस्युवम् । नास्या वश्मि विमुचं नावृतं पुनर्विद्वान्पथः पुरएत ऋजु नेषति ॥
mantras.transliteration: hayo na vidvā~ ayuji svayaṃ dhuri tāṃ vahāmi prataraṇīmavasyuvam | nāsyā vaśmi vimucaṃ nāvṛtaṃ punarvidvānpathaḥ puraeta ṛju neṣati ||

translations.english: The sage, (Pratikṣatra), has, of his own accord, attached himself to the burden (of sacrifice), like a horse (to a chariot); I support that transcendent and preservative load; I do not desire release from it, nor yet its reiterated imposition; the sage, going first, conducts (men) by the right path.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्न इन्द्र वरुण मित्र देवाः शर्धः प्र यन्त मारुतोत विष्णो । उभा नासत्या रुद्रो अध ग्नाः पूषा भगः सरस्वती जुषन्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: agna indra varuṇa mitra devāḥ śardhaḥ pra yanta mārutota viṣṇo | ubhā nāsatyā rudro adha gnāḥ pūṣā bhagaḥ sarasvatī juṣanta ||

translations.english: Agni, Indra, Varuṇa, Mitra, gods, confer (upon us) strength; or, company of the Maruts, or Viṣṇu, (bestow it); and may both the Nāsatyas, Rudra, the wives of the gods, Pūṣan, Bhaga, Sarasvatī, be plural ased (by our adoration).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी मित्रावरुणादितिं स्वः पृथिवीं द्यां मरुतः पर्वताँ अपः । हुवे विष्णुं पूषणं ब्रह्मणस्पतिं भगं नु शंसं सवितारमूतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāgnī mitrāvaruṇāditiṃ svaḥ pṛthivīṃ dyāṃ marutaḥ parvatā~ apaḥ | huve viṣṇuṃ pūṣaṇaṃ brahmaṇaspatiṃ bhagaṃ nu śaṃsaṃ savitāramūtaye ||

translations.english: I invoke for protection Indra and Agni, Mitra and Varuṇa, Aditi, Svar, Earth, Heaven, the Maruts, the clouds, the waters, Viṣṇu, Pūṣaṇ, Brahmaṇaspati and Savitā.

mantras.sanskrit: उत नो विष्णुरुत वातो अस्रिधो द्रविणोदा उत सोमो मयस्करत् । उत ऋभव उत राये नो अश्विनोत त्वष्टोत विभ्वानु मंसते ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta no viṣṇuruta vāto asridho draviṇodā uta somo mayaskarat | uta ṛbhava uta rāye no aśvinota tvaṣṭota vibhvānu maṃsate ||

translations.english: Or may Viṣṇu grant us felicity, or the innoxious wind, or Soma the bestower of riches; or may the Ṛbhus, the Aśvins, Tvaṣṭā, or Vibhvan be favourably disposed to our enrichment.

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्यन्नो मारुतं शर्ध आ गमद्दिविक्षयं यजतं बर्हिरासदे । बृहस्पतिः शर्म पूषोत नो यमद्वरूथ्यं वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tyanno mārutaṃ śardha ā gamaddivikṣayaṃ yajataṃ barhirāsade | bṛhaspatiḥ śarma pūṣota no yamadvarūthyaṃ varuṇo mitro aryamā ||

translations.english: Or may the adorable, heaven-abiding company of the Maruts, come to us to take their seats on the sacred grass; or may Bṛhaspati, Pūṣaṇ, Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman, bestow upon us domestic happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्ये नः पर्वतासः सुशस्तयः सुदीतयो नद्यस्त्रामणे भुवन् । भगो विभक्ता शवसावसा गमदुरुव्यचा अदितिः श्रोतु मे हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tye naḥ parvatāsaḥ suśastayaḥ sudītayo nadyastrāmaṇe bhuvan | bhago vibhaktā śavasāvasā gamaduruvyacā aditiḥ śrotu me havam ||

translations.english: Or may the glorious mountains, the beneficient rivers, be to us for our preservation; may Bhaga, the apportioner of wealth, come with abundance and protection; may this wide-pervading Aditi hear my invocation.

mantras.sanskrit: देवानां पत्नीरुशतीरवन्तु नः प्रावन्तु नस्तुजये वाजसातये । याः पार्थिवासो या अपामपि व्रते ता नो देवीः सुहवाः शर्म यच्छत ॥
mantras.transliteration: devānāṃ patnīruśatīravantu naḥ prāvantu nastujaye vājasātaye | yāḥ pārthivāso yā apāmapi vrate tā no devīḥ suhavāḥ śarma yacchata ||

translations.english: May the wives of the gods, desiring (our homage), defend us; may they so protect us that (we may obtain) vigorous (offspring) and abundant food; whether terrestrial, or those in charge of the waters (in the firmament), do you, goddesses, earnestly invoked, bestow upon us felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: उत ग्ना व्यन्तु देवपत्नीरिन्द्राण्यग्नाय्यश्विनी राट् । आ रोदसी वरुणानी शृणोतु व्यन्तु देवीर्य ऋतुर्जनीनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta gnā vyantu devapatnīrindrāṇyagnāyyaśvinī rāṭ | ā rodasī varuṇānī śṛṇotu vyantu devīrya ṛturjanīnām ||

translations.english: Or may the goddesses, the wives of the gods, accept (the offering); Indrāṇī, Agnāyī, the radiant Aśvinī Rodasi, Varuṇāni, may each hear (our prayer); may the goddesses partake (of the oblation); may the (person nified) season of the wives of the gods, accept it.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रयुञ्जती दिव एति ब्रुवाणा मही माता दुहितुर्बोधयन्ती । आविवासन्ती युवतिर्मनीषा पितृभ्य आ सदने जोहुवाना ॥
mantras.transliteration: prayuñjatī diva eti bruvāṇā mahī mātā duhiturbodhayantī | āvivāsantī yuvatirmanīṣā pitṛbhya ā sadane johuvānā ||

translations.english: Arousing (men to their labours), the adorable (Dawn) comes from the heaven, a mighty mother, the awakener of her daughter (earth); pious, ever young, and glorified (she comes), when invoked, to the chamber of sacrifice with the protcting (gods0.

mantras.sanskrit: अजिरासस्तदप ईयमाना आतस्थिवांसो अमृतस्य नाभिम् । अनन्तास उरवो विश्वतः सीं परि द्यावापृथिवी यन्ति पन्थाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ajirāsastadapa īyamānā ātasthivāṃso amṛtasya nābhim | anantāsa uravo viśvataḥ sīṃ pari dyāvāpṛthivī yanti panthāḥ ||

translations.english: The rays (of light) extending round, fulfilling, their duty (of bringing on the day), abiding in contact with the orb of the immortal (sun), unlimited and diffusive, spread everywhere through heaven and earth.

mantras.sanskrit: उक्षा समुद्रो अरुषः सुपर्णः पूर्वस्य योनिं पितुरा विवेश । मध्ये दिवो निहितः पृश्निरश्मा वि चक्रमे रजसस्पात्यन्तौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: ukṣā samudro aruṣaḥ suparṇaḥ pūrvasya yoniṃ piturā viveśa | madhye divo nihitaḥ pṛśniraśmā vi cakrame rajasaspātyantau ||

translations.english: The showerer (of rain), the shedder of dew, the radiant and quick-going (car) has entered the region of the paternal east; the many-tinted and pervading (luminary) proceeds to both extremities of the firmament, (and so) preserves (the world).

mantras.sanskrit: चत्वार ईं बिभ्रति क्षेमयन्तो दश गर्भं चरसे धापयन्ते । त्रिधातवः परमा अस्य गावो दिवश्चरन्ति परि सद्यो अन्तान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: catvāra īṃ bibhrati kṣemayanto daśa garbhaṃ carase dhāpayante | tridhātavaḥ paramā asya gāvo divaścaranti pari sadyo antān ||

translations.english: The four (chief priests) sustain him (with oblation and praises), seeking their own welfare; the ten (regions of space) invigorate him, their embryo, to travel (his daily course); his three elementary rays swiftly traverse the boundaries of the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: इदं वपुर्निवचनं जनासश्चरन्ति यन्नद्यस्तस्थुरापः । द्वे यदीं बिभृतो मातुरन्ये इहेह जाते यम्या सबन्धू ॥
mantras.transliteration: idaṃ vapurnivacanaṃ janāsaścaranti yannadyastasthurāpaḥ | dve yadīṃ bibhṛto māturanye iheha jāte yamyā sabandhū ||

translations.english: (Behold), men, this indescribable form from which the rivers (spring), and where the waters dwell; when (form, the firmament), the two, (day and night), associated and equally allied, as well as other (seasons), born (of it, as of a parent), here and there sustain.

mantras.sanskrit: वि तन्वते धियो अस्मा अपांसि वस्त्रा पुत्राय मातरो वयन्ति । उपप्रक्षे वृषणो मोदमाना दिवस्पथा वध्वो यन्त्यच्छ ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi tanvate dhiyo asmā apāṃsi vastrā putrāya mātaro vayanti | upaprakṣe vṛṣaṇo modamānā divaspathā vadhvo yantyaccha ||

translations.english: To him (worshippers) multiply praises and acts of adoration; for (him as for) a son, the (divine) mothers weave garments (of light); rejoicing in the contact of their impregnation, the wives of the sun, (the solar rays), come to our presence by the path of the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: तदस्तु मित्रावरुणा तदग्ने शं योरस्मभ्यमिदमस्तु शस्तम् । अशीमहि गाधमुत प्रतिष्ठां नमो दिवे बृहते सादनाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadastu mitrāvaruṇā tadagne śaṃ yorasmabhyamidamastu śastam | aśīmahi gādhamuta pratiṣṭhāṃ namo dive bṛhate sādanāya ||

translations.english: May this (hymn), Mitra and Varuṇa, be valued (by you); may it, Agni, be valued (by you) as the means to us of happiness unmixed; may we (thence) obtain stability and permanence; reverence be to you and mighty asylum (of the universe).

mantras.sanskrit: कदु प्रियाय धाम्ने मनामहे स्वक्षत्राय स्वयशसे महे वयम् । आमेन्यस्य रजसो यदभ्र आँ अपो वृणाना वितनोति मायिनी ॥
mantras.transliteration: kadu priyāya dhāmne manāmahe svakṣatrāya svayaśase mahe vayam | āmenyasya rajaso yadabhra ā~ apo vṛṇānā vitanoti māyinī ||

translations.english: When may we offer adoration to the benevolent splendour, strong in its own (strength), self-sustaining with food, deserving of worship; when the delusive (energy of Agni), investing (the heavens), spreads the waters above the clouds over the unbounded firmament.

mantras.sanskrit: ता अत्नत वयुनं वीरवक्षणं समान्या वृतया विश्वमा रजः । अपो अपाचीरपरा अपेजते प्र पूर्वाभिस्तिरते देवयुर्जनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā atnata vayunaṃ vīravakṣaṇaṃ samānyā vṛtayā viśvamā rajaḥ | apo apācīraparā apejate pra pūrvābhistirate devayurjanaḥ ||

translations.english: These dawns diffuse the consciousness that is apprehended by pious men, and (overspread) the whole world with uniform, investing (light); the devout man disregards the dawns which have turned back, and (those which) are to come, and improves (his understanding) by those which have proceeded.

mantras.sanskrit: आ ग्रावभिरहन्येभिरक्तुभिर्वरिष्ठं वज्रमा जिघर्ति मायिनि । शतं वा यस्य प्रचरन्त्स्वे दमे संवर्तयन्तो वि च वर्तयन्नहा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā grāvabhirahanyebhiraktubhirvariṣṭhaṃ vajramā jigharti māyini | śataṃ vā yasya pracarantsve dame saṃvartayanto vi ca vartayannahā ||

translations.english: (Animated) by the libations offered by day and by night, (Indra) sharpens his vast thunderbolt against the beguiler (Vṛtra); he whose hundred (rays) attend him in his own abode, sending away, and bringing back (revolving) days.

mantras.sanskrit: तामस्य रीतिं परशोरिव प्रत्यनीकमख्यं भुजे अस्य वर्पसः । सचा यदि पितुमन्तमिव क्षयं रत्नं दधाति भरहूतये विशे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tāmasya rītiṃ paraśoriva pratyanīkamakhyaṃ bhuje asya varpasaḥ | sacā yadi pitumantamiva kṣayaṃ ratnaṃ dadhāti bharahūtaye viśe ||

translations.english: (I behold) the practice of that (Agni) as of a deputy (or axe); I celebrate the host (of rays) of that (resplendent) form, (designed) for the enjoyment (of mankind); if he be with (the worshipper), he bestows upon the man who invokes him at a sacrifice such opulence as a mansion abounding with food.

mantras.sanskrit: स जिह्वया चतुरनीक ऋञ्जते चारु वसानो वरुणो यतन्नरिम् । न तस्य विद्म पुरुषत्वता वयं यतो भगः सविता दाति वार्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa jihvayā caturanīka ṛñjate cāru vasāno varuṇo yatannarim | na tasya vidma puruṣatvatā vayaṃ yato bhagaḥ savitā dāti vāryam ||

translations.english: Blazing with his (fiery) tongue in the four quarters (of the horizon) he proceeds (to the sacrifice), wearing beautiful (lustre), the disperser of darkness, extirpating foes; we know him not (as endowed) with manhood, whereby this adorable Savitā bestows desirable (wealth).

mantras.sanskrit: देवं वो अद्य सवितारमेषे भगं च रत्नं विभजन्तमायोः । आ वां नरा पुरुभुजा ववृत्यां दिवेदिवे चिदश्विना सखीयन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: devaṃ vo adya savitārameṣe bhagaṃ ca ratnaṃ vibhajantamāyoḥ | ā vāṃ narā purubhujā vavṛtyāṃ divedive cidaśvinā sakhīyan ||

translations.english: For you, (worshippers), I approach today the divine Savitā and Bhaga, the distributors of precious (wealth) among men; Aśvins, (leaders of rites), enjoyers of many (good things), desiring your friendship, I solicit your daily presence.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रति प्रयाणमसुरस्य विद्वान्त्सूक्तैर्देवं सवितारं दुवस्य । उप ब्रुवीत नमसा विजानञ्ज्येष्ठं च रत्नं विभजन्तमायोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prati prayāṇamasurasya vidvāntsūktairdevaṃ savitāraṃ duvasya | upa bruvīta namasā vijānañjyeṣṭhaṃ ca ratnaṃ vibhajantamāyoḥ ||

translations.english: Knowing the approach of the expeller (of the foes of the gods from heaven), worship the divine Savitā with holy hymns; praise him with reverence, distinguishing him as distributing precious (treasures) among men.

mantras.sanskrit: अदत्रया दयते वार्याणि पूषा भगो अदितिर्वस्त उस्रः । इन्द्रो विष्णुर्वरुणो मित्रो अग्निरहानि भद्रा जनयन्त दस्माः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adatrayā dayate vāryāṇi pūṣā bhago aditirvasta usraḥ | indro viṣṇurvaruṇo mitro agnirahāni bhadrā janayanta dasmāḥ ||

translations.english: Pūṣan, Bhaga, Aditi bestow (severally) excellent viands; the fierce (sun) robes (himself with radiance); the good-looking (deities), Indra, Viṣṇu, Varuṇa, Mitra, Agni, give birth to happy days.

mantras.sanskrit: तन्नो अनर्वा सविता वरूथं तत्सिन्धव इषयन्तो अनु ग्मन् । उप यद्वोचे अध्वरस्य होता रायः स्याम पतयो वाजरत्नाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tanno anarvā savitā varūthaṃ tatsindhava iṣayanto anu gman | upa yadvoce adhvarasya hotā rāyaḥ syāma patayo vājaratnāḥ ||

translations.english: May the irreproachable Savitā (grant) us that desirable (wealth); may the flowing rivers hasten to (convey) it to us; for which purpose I, the ministering priest of the sacrifice, repeat (pious praises); affluent in food, may we be the lords of (manifold) riches.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ये वसुभ्य ईवदा नमो दुर्ये मित्रे वरुणे सूक्तवाचः । अवैत्वभ्वं कृणुता वरीयो दिवस्पृथिव्योरवसा मदेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra ye vasubhya īvadā namo durye mitre varuṇe sūktavācaḥ | avaitvabhvaṃ kṛṇutā varīyo divaspṛthivyoravasā madema ||

translations.english: May ample wealth devolve upon those who have presented victims to the Vasus, and upon those who have repeated praises to Mitra and Varuṇa confer upon them, (gods), felicity, and may we rejoice in the protection of heaven and earth.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वो देवस्य नेतुर्मर्तो वुरीत सख्यम् । विश्वो राय इषुध्यति द्युम्नं वृणीत पुष्यसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvo devasya neturmarto vurīta sakhyam | viśvo rāya iṣudhyati dyumnaṃ vṛṇīta puṣyase ||

translations.english: Let every man solicit the friendship of the divine leader (of heaven and sun); let every man desire (of him) riches; let him request affluence (wherewith) to nourish (his descendants).

mantras.sanskrit: ते ते देव नेतर्ये चेमाँ अनुशसे । ते राया ते ह्यापृचे सचेमहि सचथ्यैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te te deva netarye cemā~ anuśase | te rāyā te hyāpṛce sacemahi sacathyaiḥ ||

translations.english: Divine (leader of heaven), these (worshippers) are yours, and (so are they) who praise these (other gods); these (borth) we associate with opulence, we (seek) to unite with (our) desires.

mantras.sanskrit: अतो न आ नॄनतिथीनतः पत्नीर्दशस्यत । आरे विश्वं पथेष्ठां द्विषो युयोतु यूयुविः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ato na ā nṝnatithīnataḥ patnīrdaśasyata | āre viśvaṃ patheṣṭhāṃ dviṣo yuyotu yūyuviḥ ||

translations.english: Worship, therefore, the leaders (of our rites), our guests, (the gods), and the wives (of the deities); may the (divine) discriminator drive to a distance every adversary, (and all our) enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्र वह्निरभिहितो दुद्रवद्द्रोण्यः पशुः । नृमणा वीरपस्त्योऽर्णा धीरेव सनिता ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatra vahnirabhihito dudravaddroṇyaḥ paśuḥ | nṛmaṇā vīrapastyo'rṇā dhīreva sanitā ||

translations.english: Whence the victim fit to be bound, the subject (of the sacrifice), has been stationed (at the sacrificial post); he, (Savitā), with mind well disposed towards the worshiper, the donor of dwellings and descendants is like a clever wife, the bestower (of wealth).

mantras.sanskrit: एष ते देव नेता रथस्पतिः शं रयिः । शं राये शं स्वस्तय इषःस्तुतो मनामहे देवस्तुतो मनामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa te deva netā rathaspatiḥ śaṃ rayiḥ | śaṃ rāye śaṃ svastaya iṣaḥstuto manāmahe devastuto manāmahe ||

translations.english: Leader (of heaven), may this your protecting chariot, laden with riches, (come for our) happiness; praisers of the honoured (Savitā), we glorify him for felicity through well-being; praisers of the gods, we glorify (them).

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने सुतस्य पीतये विश्वैरूमेभिरा गहि । देवेभिर्हव्यदातये ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne sutasya pītaye viśvairūmebhirā gahi | devebhirhavyadātaye ||

translations.english: Come, Agni, with all the protecting deities, to drink the libation; come with the gods

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतधीतय आ गत सत्यधर्माणो अध्वरम् । अग्नेः पिबत जिह्वया ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtadhītaya ā gata satyadharmāṇo adhvaram | agneḥ pibata jihvayā ||

translations.english: (Gods who are) devoutly praised and worshipped in truth, come to the sacrifice, and drink the libation with the tongue of Agni.

mantras.sanskrit: विप्रेभिर्विप्र सन्त्य प्रातर्यावभिरा गहि । देवेभिः सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: viprebhirvipra santya prātaryāvabhirā gahi | devebhiḥ somapītaye ||

translations.english: Sage and adorable Agni, come with the wise and early-stirring divinities to drink the Soma libation.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं सोमश्चमू सुतोऽमत्रे परि षिच्यते । प्रिय इन्द्राय वायवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ somaścamū suto'matre pari ṣicyate | priya indrāya vāyave ||

translations.english: This Soma juice, effused into the ladles, is poured out into the vase, acceptable to Indra and Vāyu.

mantras.sanskrit: वायवा याहि वीतये जुषाणो हव्यदातये । पिबा सुतस्यान्धसो अभि प्रयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāyavā yāhi vītaye juṣāṇo havyadātaye | pibā sutasyāndhaso abhi prayaḥ ||

translations.english: Come, Vāyu, propitious to the offerer of the libation, to partake of the sacrificial food, and drink of the effused juice.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रश्च वायवेषां सुतानां पीतिमर्हथः । ताञ्जुषेथामरेपसावभि प्रयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraśca vāyaveṣāṃ sutānāṃ pītimarhathaḥ | tāñjuṣethāmarepasāvabhi prayaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra and Vāyu, you ought to tdrink these libations; be gratified by them, benevolent (divinities), and partake of the sacrificial food.

mantras.sanskrit: सुता इन्द्राय वायवे सोमासो दध्याशिरः । निम्नं न यन्ति सिन्धवोऽभि प्रयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sutā indrāya vāyave somāso dadhyāśiraḥ | nimnaṃ na yanti sindhavo'bhi prayaḥ ||

translations.english: The Soma juices mixed with curds are poured out to Indra and to Vāyu; the sacrificial viands proceed to you as rivers flow downwards.

mantras.sanskrit: सजूर्विश्वेभिर्देवेभिरश्विभ्यामुषसा सजूः । आ याह्यग्ने अत्रिवत्सुते रण ॥
mantras.transliteration: sajūrviśvebhirdevebhiraśvibhyāmuṣasā sajūḥ | ā yāhyagne atrivatsute raṇa ||

translations.english: Accompanied by all the gods, accompanied by the Aśvins, and by Uṣas, come Agni, and like Atri delight in the libation.

mantras.sanskrit: सजूर्मित्रावरुणाभ्यां सजूः सोमेन विष्णुना । आ याह्यग्ने अत्रिवत्सुते रण ॥
mantras.transliteration: sajūrmitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ sajūḥ somena viṣṇunā | ā yāhyagne atrivatsute raṇa ||

translations.english: Accompanied by Mitra and Varuṇa, accompanied by Soma and Viṣṇu, come, Agni and like Atri, delight in the libation.

mantras.sanskrit: सजूरादित्यैर्वसुभिः सजूरिन्द्रेण वायुना । आ याह्यग्ने अत्रिवत्सुते रण ॥
mantras.transliteration: sajūrādityairvasubhiḥ sajūrindreṇa vāyunā | ā yāhyagne atrivatsute raṇa ||

translations.english: Accompanied by Āditya and the Vasus accompanied by Indra nad by Vāyu, come, Agni, and like, Atri, delight in the libation.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वस्ति नो मिमीतामश्विना भगः स्वस्ति देव्यदितिरनर्वणः । स्वस्ति पूषा असुरो दधातु नः स्वस्ति द्यावापृथिवी सुचेतुना ॥
mantras.transliteration: svasti no mimītāmaśvinā bhagaḥ svasti devyaditiranarvaṇaḥ | svasti pūṣā asuro dadhātu naḥ svasti dyāvāpṛthivī sucetunā ||

translations.english: May the Aśvins contribute to our prosperity; may Bhaga, and the divine Aditi (contribute) to (our) prosperity; may the irrestible Viṣṇu, the scatterer (of foes), bestow upon us prosperity; may the conscious Heaven and Earth (bestow upon us) prosperity.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वस्तये वायुमुप ब्रवामहै सोमं स्वस्ति भुवनस्य यस्पतिः । बृहस्पतिं सर्वगणं स्वस्तये स्वस्तय आदित्यासो भवन्तु नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: svastaye vāyumupa bravāmahai somaṃ svasti bhuvanasya yaspatiḥ | bṛhaspatiṃ sarvagaṇaṃ svastaye svastaya ādityāso bhavantu naḥ ||

translations.english: We glorify Vāyu for prosperity, Soma for prosperity, he who is the protector of the world; (we praise) Bṛhaspati (attended by) all the companies (of the deities), for prosperity, and for our prosperity may the Ādityas be ours.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वे देवा नो अद्या स्वस्तये वैश्वानरो वसुरग्निः स्वस्तये । देवा अवन्त्वृभवः स्वस्तये स्वस्ति नो रुद्रः पात्वंहसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśve devā no adyā svastaye vaiśvānaro vasuragniḥ svastaye | devā avantvṛbhavaḥ svastaye svasti no rudraḥ pātvaṃhasaḥ ||

translations.english: May all the gods be with us today for our prosperity may Agni, the benefactor of all men, and giver of dwellings, (be with us) for (our) prosperity; may the divine Ṛbhus protect us for (our) prosperity; may Rudra preserve us from iniquity for (our) prosperity.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वस्ति मित्रावरुणा स्वस्ति पथ्ये रेवति । स्वस्ति न इन्द्रश्चाग्निश्च स्वस्ति नो अदिते कृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: svasti mitrāvaruṇā svasti pathye revati | svasti na indraścāgniśca svasti no adite kṛdhi ||

translations.english: Mitra and Varuṇa, grant us prosperity; path (of the firmament), and goddess of riches, (grant us) prosperity; may Indra and Agni (grant us) prosperity; Aditi, bestow prosperity upon us.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वस्ति पन्थामनु चरेम सूर्याचन्द्रमसाविव । पुनर्ददताघ्नता जानता सं गमेमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: svasti panthāmanu carema sūryācandramasāviva | punardadatāghnatā jānatā saṃ gamemahi ||

translations.english: May we ever follow prosperously our path, like the sun and the moon; may we be associated with a requiting, grateful and recognisant (kinsman).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र श्यावाश्व धृष्णुयार्चा मरुद्भिॠक्वभिः । ये अद्रोघमनुष्वधं श्रवो मदन्ति यज्ञियाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra śyāvāśva dhṛṣṇuyārcā marudbhiṝkvabhiḥ | ye adroghamanuṣvadhaṃ śravo madanti yajñiyāḥ ||

translations.english: Offer, worship with person verance, Śyāvāśva, to the praise-deserving Maruts; they who are adorable and delight in the daily offered and inoffensive sacrificial food.

mantras.sanskrit: ते हि स्थिरस्य शवसः सखायः सन्ति धृष्णुया । ते यामन्ना धृषद्विनस्त्मना पान्ति शश्वतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te hi sthirasya śavasaḥ sakhāyaḥ santi dhṛṣṇuyā | te yāmannā dhṛṣadvinastmanā pānti śaśvataḥ ||

translations.english: They are the firm friends of steady vigour, who, proceeding resolute on their way, willingly protect (our) numerous (descendants).

mantras.sanskrit: ते स्यन्द्रासो नोक्षणोऽति ष्कन्दन्ति शर्वरीः । मरुतामधा महो दिवि क्षमा च मन्महे ॥
mantras.transliteration: te syandrāso nokṣaṇo'ti ṣkandanti śarvarīḥ | marutāmadhā maho divi kṣamā ca manmahe ||

translations.english: Gliding along, and shedding moisture, they pass through the nights; therefore we now celebrate the might of the Maruts, manifested in both heaven and earth.

mantras.sanskrit: मरुत्सु वो दधीमहि स्तोमं यज्ञं च धृष्णुया । विश्वे ये मानुषा युगा पान्ति मर्त्यं रिषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: marutsu vo dadhīmahi stomaṃ yajñaṃ ca dhṛṣṇuyā | viśve ye mānuṣā yugā pānti martyaṃ riṣaḥ ||

translations.english: We enjoin you, (priests), to offer earnestly praise and sacrifice to the Maruts, who through all human ages, protect the mortal worshipper from harm.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्हन्तो ये सुदानवो नरो असामिशवसः । प्र यज्ञं यज्ञियेभ्यो दिवो अर्चा मरुद्भ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: arhanto ye sudānavo naro asāmiśavasaḥ | pra yajñaṃ yajñiyebhyo divo arcā marudbhyaḥ ||

translations.english: Offer sacrifice to the adorable Maruts, who (have come) from heaven, who are worthy of worship, munificent leaders (of rites), and possessors of unequalled strength.

mantras.sanskrit: आ रुक्मैरा युधा नर ऋष्वा ऋष्टीरसृक्षत । अन्वेनाँ अह विद्युतो मरुतो जज्झतीरिव भानुरर्त त्मना दिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā rukmairā yudhā nara ṛṣvā ṛṣṭīrasṛkṣata | anvenā~ aha vidyuto maruto jajjhatīriva bhānurarta tmanā divaḥ ||

translations.english: Leaders (of the rains), the mighty Maruts shine with brilliant ornaments and weapons, and hurl javelin (at their foes, the clouds); the lightnings like roaring (torrents), daily follow the Maruts; the radiance of the resplendent (cohort) spontaneously breaks forth.

mantras.sanskrit: ये वावृधन्त पार्थिवा य उरावन्तरिक्ष आ । वृजने वा नदीनां सधस्थे वा महो दिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye vāvṛdhanta pārthivā ya urāvantarikṣa ā | vṛjane vā nadīnāṃ sadhasthe vā maho divaḥ ||

translations.english: The Maruts, who are of the earth are augmented, so are those in the vast firmament; they increase in the force of the rivers, and in the aggregate of the spacious heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: शर्धो मारुतमुच्छंस सत्यशवसमृभ्वसम् । उत स्म ते शुभे नरः प्र स्यन्द्रा युजत त्मना ॥
mantras.transliteration: śardho mārutamucchaṃsa satyaśavasamṛbhvasam | uta sma te śubhe naraḥ pra syandrā yujata tmanā ||

translations.english: Glorify the truth-invigorated and infinite strength of the Maruts, for they, the leaders (of the rains), gliding along, are labouring voluntarily for (our) good.

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्म ते परुष्ण्यामूर्णा वसत शुन्ध्यवः । उत पव्या रथानामद्रिं भिन्दन्त्योजसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta sma te paruṣṇyāmūrṇā vasata śundhyavaḥ | uta pavyā rathānāmadriṃ bhindantyojasā ||

translations.english: Whether they (abide) on the Paruṣṇi (river), or, purifying (all), they clothe themselves with light, or whether they break through the clouds with strength by the wheels of their chariots.

mantras.sanskrit: आपथयो विपथयोऽन्तस्पथा अनुपथाः । एतेभिर्मह्यं नामभिर्यज्ञं विष्टार ओहते ॥
mantras.transliteration: āpathayo vipathayo'ntaspathā anupathāḥ | etebhirmahyaṃ nāmabhiryajñaṃ viṣṭāra ohate ||

translations.english: (Whether), following the paths that lead (to us), or that spread diversely, or those that sink into the hollows (of the mountain), or those that extend smoothly, they, (however) scattered, accept the sacrifice for my benefit, (when invoked by these appellations).

mantras.sanskrit: अधा नरो न्योहतेऽधा नियुत ओहते । अधा पारावता इति चित्रा रूपाणि दर्श्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhā naro nyohate'dhā niyuta ohate | adhā pārāvatā iti citrā rūpāṇi darśyā ||

translations.english: Now, leaders (of the rains), they support (the world); now, blending together, they bear (the oblation) now, situated remote, (they uphold distant objects); so may their manifold forms be manifest.

mantras.sanskrit: छन्दःस्तुभः कुभन्यव उत्समा कीरिणो नृतुः । ते मे के चिन्न तायव ऊमा आसन्दृशि त्विषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: chandaḥstubhaḥ kubhanyava utsamā kīriṇo nṛtuḥ | te me ke cinna tāyava ūmā āsandṛśi tviṣe ||

translations.english: The reciters of sacred metres, desirous of water, and celebrating (the Maruts), have drawn them to (provide) a well (for Gotama); some of them (invisible) as thieves, have been my defenders; some have been (obvious) to view through the light (of life).

mantras.sanskrit: य ऋष्वा ऋष्टिविद्युतः कवयः सन्ति वेधसः । तमृषे मारुतं गणं नमस्या रमया गिरा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya ṛṣvā ṛṣṭividyutaḥ kavayaḥ santi vedhasaḥ | tamṛṣe mārutaṃ gaṇaṃ namasyā ramayā girā ||

translations.english: Glorify, Ṛṣi, with grateful praise, the company of the Maruts, who are manifest, bright with lightning lances, who are wise, and the creators (of all things).

mantras.sanskrit: अच्छ ऋषे मारुतं गणं दाना मित्रं न योषणा । दिवो वा धृष्णव ओजसा स्तुता धीभिरिषण्यत ॥
mantras.transliteration: accha ṛṣe mārutaṃ gaṇaṃ dānā mitraṃ na yoṣaṇā | divo vā dhṛṣṇava ojasā stutā dhībhiriṣaṇyata ||

translations.english: Approach, Ṛṣi, with offerings and with praise, the company of the Maruts like a friend; come, sustaining (Maruts), with your strength, from heaven of (any other region), glorified by our hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: नू मन्वान एषां देवाँ अच्छा न वक्षणा । दाना सचेत सूरिभिर्यामश्रुतेभिरञ्जिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū manvāna eṣāṃ devā~ acchā na vakṣaṇā | dānā saceta sūribhiryāmaśrutebhirañjibhiḥ ||

translations.english: Glorifying them promptly, desiring not to bring (other) deities to (his) presence, let (the worshipper) associate his gifts with those wise (divinities) renowned for their velocity, and distributors (of rewards).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ये मे बन्ध्वेषे गां वोचन्त सूरयः पृश्निं वोचन्त मातरम् । अधा पितरमिष्मिणं रुद्रं वोचन्त शिक्वसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra ye me bandhveṣe gāṃ vocanta sūrayaḥ pṛśniṃ vocanta mātaram | adhā pitaramiṣmiṇaṃ rudraṃ vocanta śikvasaḥ ||

translations.english: To me, inquiring of their kindred, the sage (Maruts) have uttered a reply; they have declaree Pṛṣṇi (to be their) mother; the mighty ones have declared the food-bestowing Rudra (to be their) father.

mantras.sanskrit: सप्त मे सप्त शाकिन एकमेका शता ददुः । यमुनायामधि श्रुतमुद्राधो गव्यं मृजे नि राधो अश्व्यं मृजे ॥
mantras.transliteration: sapta me sapta śākina ekamekā śatā daduḥ | yamunāyāmadhi śrutamudrādho gavyaṃ mṛje ni rādho aśvyaṃ mṛje ||

translations.english: May the seven times seven all-potent (Maruts, aggregated as) a single troop, bestow upon me hundreds (of cattle) may I possess wealth of cows, renowned upon the (banks of) the Yamunā; may I possess wealth of horses.

mantras.sanskrit: को वेद जानमेषां को वा पुरा सुम्नेष्वास मरुताम् । यद्युयुज्रे किलास्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ko veda jānameṣāṃ ko vā purā sumneṣvāsa marutām | yadyuyujre kilāsyaḥ ||

translations.english: Who knows the birth of these (Maruts)? who has formerly been (participant) of the enjoyments of them (by whom) the spotted deer are harnessed (to their chariots)?

mantras.sanskrit: ऐतान्रथेषु तस्थुषः कः शुश्राव कथा ययुः । कस्मै सस्रुः सुदासे अन्वापय इळाभिर्वृष्टयः सह ॥
mantras.transliteration: aitānratheṣu tasthuṣaḥ kaḥ śuśrāva kathā yayuḥ | kasmai sasruḥ sudāse anvāpaya iḷābhirvṛṣṭayaḥ saha ||

translations.english: Who has head them, when standing in their cars, (declare) whither they go? Upon what liberal worshipper do their kindred rains descend together with manifold food?

mantras.sanskrit: ते म आहुर्य आययुरुप द्युभिर्विभिर्मदे । नरो मर्या अरेपस इमान्पश्यन्निति ष्टुहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: te ma āhurya āyayurupa dyubhirvibhirmade | naro maryā arepasa imānpaśyanniti ṣṭuhi ||

translations.english: To me have they spoken; they have come to me with radiant steeds to (drink) the exhilarating beverage; to them (they have said), when, beholding them, who are the formless leaders (of rites), and friends of man, repeat our prais.

mantras.sanskrit: ये अञ्जिषु ये वाशीषु स्वभानवः स्रक्षु रुक्मेषु खादिषु । श्राया रथेषु धन्वसु ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye añjiṣu ye vāśīṣu svabhānavaḥ srakṣu rukmeṣu khādiṣu | śrāyā ratheṣu dhanvasu ||

translations.english: (The praise of them) who are all self-irradiating splendid in ornaments, in arms, in garlands, in breast-plural tes, in bracelets, in chariots, in bows.

mantras.sanskrit: युष्माकं स्मा रथाँ अनु मुदे दधे मरुतो जीरदानवः । वृष्टी द्यावो यतीरिव ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuṣmākaṃ smā rathā~ anu mude dadhe maruto jīradānavaḥ | vṛṣṭī dyāvo yatīriva ||

translations.english: I contemplate your chariots, munificent Maruts, with delight, like wandering lights in the rains.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यं नरः सुदानवो ददाशुषे दिवः कोशमचुच्यवुः । वि पर्जन्यं सृजन्ति रोदसी अनु धन्वना यन्ति वृष्टयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yaṃ naraḥ sudānavo dadāśuṣe divaḥ kośamacucyavuḥ | vi parjanyaṃ sṛjanti rodasī anu dhanvanā yanti vṛṣṭayaḥ ||

translations.english: Leaders (of the rain), munificent givers, they cause that which is the treasury (of water) to fall from the sky for (the benefit of) the donor (of the offering); they let loose the rain cloud, and the shedders of rain spread (everywhere) with (abundant) water.

mantras.sanskrit: ततृदानाः सिन्धवः क्षोदसा रजः प्र सस्रुर्धेनवो यथा । स्यन्ना अश्वा इवाध्वनो विमोचने वि यद्वर्तन्त एन्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tatṛdānāḥ sindhavaḥ kṣodasā rajaḥ pra sasrurdhenavo yathā | syannā aśvā ivādhvano vimocane vi yadvartanta enyaḥ ||

translations.english: The gliding (torrents), issuing (from the clouds), overspread the firmament with water, as cows (yield milk), and like rapid horses let loose upon the road, the rivers rush in various directions.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यात मरुतो दिव आन्तरिक्षादमादुत । माव स्थात परावतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yāta maruto diva āntarikṣādamāduta | māva sthāta parāvataḥ ||

translations.english: Come, Maruts, from heaven, from the firmament, or from this (earth); tarry not far off.

mantras.sanskrit: मा वो रसानितभा कुभा क्रुमुर्मा वः सिन्धुर्नि रीरमत् । मा वः परि ष्ठात्सरयुः पुरीषिण्यस्मे इत्सुम्नमस्तु वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā vo rasānitabhā kubhā krumurmā vaḥ sindhurni rīramat | mā vaḥ pari ṣṭhātsarayuḥ purīṣiṇyasme itsumnamastu vaḥ ||

translations.english: Let not the Rasa, the Anitabhā, the Kubhā, or the wide-roving ocean delay you; let not the watery Sarayu oppose you; may the happiness of your (approach) be ours.

mantras.sanskrit: तं वः शर्धं रथानां त्वेषं गणं मारुतं नव्यसीनाम् । अनु प्र यन्ति वृष्टयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ vaḥ śardhaṃ rathānāṃ tveṣaṃ gaṇaṃ mārutaṃ navyasīnām | anu pra yanti vṛṣṭayaḥ ||

translations.english: I praise that brilliant company of the Maruts, who have your strength of recent chariots, you whom the rains attend.

mantras.sanskrit: शर्धंशर्धं व एषां व्रातंव्रातं गणंगणं सुशस्तिभिः । अनु क्रामेम धीतिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śardhaṃśardhaṃ va eṣāṃ vrātaṃvrātaṃ gaṇaṃgaṇaṃ suśastibhiḥ | anu krāmema dhītibhiḥ ||

translations.english: Let us wait with sacred praises and holy rites upon your several strength, and separate troop, and individual company.

mantras.sanskrit: कस्मा अद्य सुजाताय रातहव्याय प्र ययुः । एना यामेन मरुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kasmā adya sujātāya rātahavyāya pra yayuḥ | enā yāmena marutaḥ ||

translations.english: To what well-born and oblation-giving (worshipper) will the Maruts today in tthis their car?

mantras.sanskrit: येन तोकाय तनयाय धान्यं बीजं वहध्वे अक्षितम् । अस्मभ्यं तद्धत्तन यद्व ईमहे राधो विश्वायु सौभगम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yena tokāya tanayāya dhānyaṃ bījaṃ vahadhve akṣitam | asmabhyaṃ taddhattana yadva īmahe rādho viśvāyu saubhagam ||

translations.english: With the same (goodwill) that you bestow imperishable grain-seed upon a son or grandson, bestow it upon us, for we ask of you life-sustaining and auspicious wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: अतीयाम निदस्तिरः स्वस्तिभिर्हित्वावद्यमरातीः । वृष्ट्वी शं योराप उस्रि भेषजं स्याम मरुतः सह ॥
mantras.transliteration: atīyāma nidastiraḥ svastibhirhitvāvadyamarātīḥ | vṛṣṭvī śaṃ yorāpa usri bheṣajaṃ syāma marutaḥ saha ||

translations.english: May we overcomeour secret and reviling adversaries, having departed from iniquity by good deeds; may we possess, Maruts, through the rain (sent by you), unmixed happiness, water, cattle and herbs.

mantras.sanskrit: सुदेवः समहासति सुवीरो नरो मरुतः स मर्त्यः । यं त्रायध्वे स्याम ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: sudevaḥ samahāsati suvīro naro marutaḥ sa martyaḥ | yaṃ trāyadhve syāma te ||

translations.english: Renowned (host of) Maruts, leaders (of rites), that mortal is favoured by the gods, and blessed with progeny, whom you protet; may we be such as he is.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तुहि भोजान्त्स्तुवतो अस्य यामनि रणन्गावो न यवसे । यतः पूर्वाँ इव सखीँरनु ह्वय गिरा गृणीहि कामिनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: stuhi bhojāntstuvato asya yāmani raṇangāvo na yavase | yataḥ pūrvā~ iva sakhī~ranu hvaya girā gṛṇīhi kāminaḥ ||

translations.english: Praise the givers of enjoyment, (the Maruts), at the sacrifice of this worshiper, (for they) delight in (pious praise) like cattle in fodder; wherefore call upon them as if upon friends; praise them, desirous of praise, with a sacred hymn.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र शर्धाय मारुताय स्वभानव इमां वाचमनजा पर्वतच्युते । घर्मस्तुभे दिव आ पृष्ठयज्वने द्युम्नश्रवसे महि नृम्णमर्चत ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra śardhāya mārutāya svabhānava imāṃ vācamanajā parvatacyute | gharmastubhe diva ā pṛṣṭhayajvane dyumnaśravase mahi nṛmṇamarcata ||

translations.english: Offer praise to the company of the Maruts, the self-irradiating, the precipitators of mountains; present liberal oblations to the assuagers of heat, to those who come from the sky, to whom solemn rites are familiar, to the givers of abundant food.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वो मरुतस्तविषा उदन्यवो वयोवृधो अश्वयुजः परिज्रयः । सं विद्युता दधति वाशति त्रितः स्वरन्त्यापोऽवना परिज्रयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vo marutastaviṣā udanyavo vayovṛdho aśvayujaḥ parijrayaḥ | saṃ vidyutā dadhati vāśati tritaḥ svarantyāpo'vanā parijrayaḥ ||

translations.english: Your (cohort), Maruts, is conspicous, mighty shedding water and augmenting food; yoking your horse (to your cars), spreading everywhere, and combined with the lightning, the triple-stationed company roars aloud, and the circumambient waters fall upon the earth.

mantras.sanskrit: विद्युन्महसो नरो अश्मदिद्यवो वातत्विषो मरुतः पर्वतच्युतः । अब्दया चिन्मुहुरा ह्रादुनीवृतः स्तनयदमा रभसा उदोजसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vidyunmahaso naro aśmadidyavo vātatviṣo marutaḥ parvatacyutaḥ | abdayā cinmuhurā hrādunīvṛtaḥ stanayadamā rabhasā udojasaḥ ||

translations.english: The Maruts (appear) radiant with lightning, leaders (of the rain), armed with weapons of adamant, blazing with the wind, the precipitators of mountains, the repeated distributors of water, wielders of the thunderbolt, roaring in concert, combining (to send rain), and of exceeding strength.

mantras.sanskrit: व्यक्तून्रुद्रा व्यहानि शिक्वसो व्यन्तरिक्षं वि रजांसि धूतयः । वि यदज्राँ अजथ नाव ईं यथा वि दुर्गाणि मरुतो नाह रिष्यथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: vyaktūnrudrā vyahāni śikvaso vyantarikṣaṃ vi rajāṃsi dhūtayaḥ | vi yadajrā~ ajatha nāva īṃ yathā vi durgāṇi maruto nāha riṣyatha ||

translations.english: Powerful Rudras, you urge on the nights and days the firmament and the worlds; agitators (of all things), you toss the clouds like ships (in the sea), so (you throw down) the strong plural ces (of the enemy); but, Maruts you do no harm.

mantras.sanskrit: तद्वीर्यं वो मरुतो महित्वनं दीर्घं ततान सूर्यो न योजनम् । एता न यामे अगृभीतशोचिषोऽनश्वदां यन्न्ययातना गिरिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadvīryaṃ vo maruto mahitvanaṃ dīrghaṃ tatāna sūryo na yojanam | etā na yāme agṛbhītaśociṣo'naśvadāṃ yannyayātanā girim ||

translations.english: Your prowess, Maruts, has spread wide your glory as the sun (sends afar his) radiance, or the white (horses of the gods travel far) in their course; of unbounded lustre, you close the cloud withholding the waters.

mantras.sanskrit: अभ्राजि शर्धो मरुतो यदर्णसं मोषथा वृक्षं कपनेव वेधसः । अध स्मा नो अरमतिं सजोषसश्चक्षुरिव यन्तमनु नेषथा सुगम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhrāji śardho maruto yadarṇasaṃ moṣathā vṛkṣaṃ kapaneva vedhasaḥ | adha smā no aramatiṃ sajoṣasaścakṣuriva yantamanu neṣathā sugam ||

translations.english: Maruts, dispensers of rain, your strength is manifested when, shaking the water-laden cloud, you let loose the shower; conjointly propitiated, conduct us by an easy path leading to prosperity, as the eye (shows the way).

mantras.sanskrit: न स जीयते मरुतो न हन्यते न स्रेधति न व्यथते न रिष्यति । नास्य राय उप दस्यन्ति नोतय ऋषिं वा यं राजानं वा सुषूदथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: na sa jīyate maruto na hanyate na sredhati na vyathate na riṣyati | nāsya rāya upa dasyanti notaya ṛṣiṃ vā yaṃ rājānaṃ vā suṣūdatha ||

translations.english: The sage, or the sovereign, whom you, Maruts, direct, is never overcome nor slain; he perishes not, nor suffers pain, nor undergoes injury, nor are his riches or his safety imperilled.

mantras.sanskrit: नियुत्वन्तो ग्रामजितो यथा नरोऽर्यमणो न मरुतः कबन्धिनः । पिन्वन्त्युत्सं यदिनासो अस्वरन्व्युन्दन्ति पृथिवीं मध्वो अन्धसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: niyutvanto grāmajito yathā naro'ryamaṇo na marutaḥ kabandhinaḥ | pinvantyutsaṃ yadināso asvaranvyundanti pṛthivīṃ madhvo andhasā ||

translations.english: Lords of the Niyut steeds, overcomers of multitudes leaders (of rites), radiant as the Ādityas, are the dispensers of water; when sovereign lords, they fill the clouds, and, loud sounding, moisten the earth with sweet (watery) sustenance.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रवत्वतीयं पृथिवी मरुद्भ्यः प्रवत्वती द्यौर्भवति प्रयद्भ्यः । प्रवत्वतीः पथ्या अन्तरिक्ष्याः प्रवत्वन्तः पर्वता जीरदानवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pravatvatīyaṃ pṛthivī marudbhyaḥ pravatvatī dyaurbhavati prayadbhyaḥ | pravatvatīḥ pathyā antarikṣyāḥ pravatvantaḥ parvatā jīradānavaḥ ||

translations.english: This wide-extended earth is for the Maruts; the spacious heaven is for the spreading winds; the paths of the firmament are provided (for their course); for them the expanding clouds quickly bestow (their gifts).

mantras.sanskrit: यन्मरुतः सभरसः स्वर्णरः सूर्य उदिते मदथा दिवो नरः । न वोऽश्वाः श्रथयन्ताह सिस्रतः सद्यो अस्याध्वनः पारमश्नुथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: yanmarutaḥ sabharasaḥ svarṇaraḥ sūrya udite madathā divo naraḥ | na vo'śvāḥ śrathayantāha sisrataḥ sadyo asyādhvanaḥ pāramaśnutha ||

translations.english: Maruts of combined strength, leaders of the universe, guides of heaven, when the sun has risen you rejoice (in the Soma beverage), then your rapid steeds know no relaxation, but quickly you reach the limits of this road (to the sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: अंसेषु व ऋष्टयः पत्सु खादयो वक्षस्सु रुक्मा मरुतो रथे शुभः । अग्निभ्राजसो विद्युतो गभस्त्योः शिप्राः शीर्षसु वितता हिरण्ययीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aṃseṣu va ṛṣṭayaḥ patsu khādayo vakṣassu rukmā maruto rathe śubhaḥ | agnibhrājaso vidyuto gabhastyoḥ śiprāḥ śīrṣasu vitatā hiraṇyayīḥ ||

translations.english: Lances (gleam), Maruts, upon your shoulders, anklets on your feet, golden cuirasses on your breasts, and pure (waters shine) in your chariots; lightning blazing with fire in your hands, and golden tiarsa are towering on your heads.

mantras.sanskrit: तं नाकमर्यो अगृभीतशोचिषं रुशत्पिप्पलं मरुतो वि धूनुथ । समच्यन्त वृजनातित्विषन्त यत्स्वरन्ति घोषं विततमृतायवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ nākamaryo agṛbhītaśociṣaṃ ruśatpippalaṃ maruto vi dhūnutha | samacyanta vṛjanātitviṣanta yatsvaranti ghoṣaṃ vitatamṛtāyavaḥ ||

translations.english: Maruts, when moving, you agitate the heaven of unchecked radiance, and (stir) the bright water; when you combine your energies and are shining brilliantly, and when purposing to send down rain, you utter a loud shout.

mantras.sanskrit: युष्मादत्तस्य मरुतो विचेतसो रायः स्याम रथ्यो वयस्वतः । न यो युच्छति तिष्यो यथा दिवोऽस्मे रारन्त मरुतः सहस्रिणम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuṣmādattasya maruto vicetaso rāyaḥ syāma rathyo vayasvataḥ | na yo yucchati tiṣyo yathā divo'sme rāranta marutaḥ sahasriṇam ||

translations.english: May we, who are possessed of chariots, intelligent Maruts, become (proprietors) of wealth, comprising food bestowed by you; of wealth that vanishes not, as Tiṣya (declines not) from the sky; therefore, Maruts, gratify us with infinite (riches).

mantras.sanskrit: यूयं रयिं मरुतः स्पार्हवीरं यूयमृषिमवथ सामविप्रम् । यूयमर्वन्तं भरताय वाजं यूयं धत्थ राजानं श्रुष्टिमन्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yūyaṃ rayiṃ marutaḥ spārhavīraṃ yūyamṛṣimavatha sāmavipram | yūyamarvantaṃ bharatāya vājaṃ yūyaṃ dhattha rājānaṃ śruṣṭimantam ||

translations.english: You bestow, Maruts, wealth and enviable posterity; you protect the sage learned in the Sāma; you grant horses and food to (me) the ministrant priest; you render a prince prosperous.

mantras.sanskrit: तद्वो यामि द्रविणं सद्यऊतयो येना स्वर्ण ततनाम नॄँरभि । इदं सु मे मरुतो हर्यता वचो यस्य तरेम तरसा शतं हिमाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadvo yāmi draviṇaṃ sadyaūtayo yenā svarṇa tatanāma nṝ~rabhi | idaṃ su me maruto haryatā vaco yasya tarema tarasā śataṃ himāḥ ||

translations.english: Therefore do I solicit wealth of you, who are prompt to grant protection, whereby we may multiply our descendants, as the sun (spreads wide his rays); be propitiated, Maruts, by this my praise, by the efficacy whereof may we pass over a hundred winters.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रयज्यवो मरुतो भ्राजदृष्टयो बृहद्वयो दधिरे रुक्मवक्षसः । ईयन्ते अश्वैः सुयमेभिराशुभिः शुभं यातामनु रथा अवृत्सत ॥
mantras.transliteration: prayajyavo maruto bhrājadṛṣṭayo bṛhadvayo dadhire rukmavakṣasaḥ | īyante aśvaiḥ suyamebhirāśubhiḥ śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata ||

translations.english: The adorable Maruts, armed with bright lances and cuirassed with golden breast-plural tes, enjoy vigorous existence; may the ears of the quick-moving (Maruts) arrive for our good.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वयं दधिध्वे तविषीं यथा विद बृहन्महान्त उर्विया वि राजथ । उतान्तरिक्षं ममिरे व्योजसा शुभं यातामनु रथा अवृत्सत ॥
mantras.transliteration: svayaṃ dadhidhve taviṣīṃ yathā vida bṛhanmahānta urviyā vi rājatha | utāntarikṣaṃ mamire vyojasā śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata ||

translations.english: Maruts, you have of yourselves maintained your vigour according as you judge (fit); you shine most mighty and vast, and you pervade the firmament with your power; may the cars of the quick-moving (Maruts) arrive for our good.

mantras.sanskrit: साकं जाताः सुभ्वः साकमुक्षिताः श्रिये चिदा प्रतरं वावृधुर्नरः । विरोकिणः सूर्यस्येव रश्मयः शुभं यातामनु रथा अवृत्सत ॥
mantras.transliteration: sākaṃ jātāḥ subhvaḥ sākamukṣitāḥ śriye cidā prataraṃ vāvṛdhurnaraḥ | virokiṇaḥ sūryasyeva raśmayaḥ śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata ||

translations.english: Born simultaneously, mighty, co-dispensers of moisture, they have grown exceedingly in glory; leaders (of rites), and radiant (are they) as the rays of the sun; may the cars of the quick-moving (Maruts) arrive for our good.

mantras.sanskrit: आभूषेण्यं वो मरुतो महित्वनं दिदृक्षेण्यं सूर्यस्येव चक्षणम् । उतो अस्माँ अमृतत्वे दधातन शुभं यातामनु रथा अवृत्सत ॥
mantras.transliteration: ābhūṣeṇyaṃ vo maruto mahitvanaṃ didṛkṣeṇyaṃ sūryasyeva cakṣaṇam | uto asmā~ amṛtatve dadhātana śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata ||

translations.english: Your might, Maruts, is to be glorified; it is to be contemplated like the orb of the sun; sustain us ever in immortality; may the cars of the quick-moving (Maruts) arrive for our good.

mantras.sanskrit: उदीरयथा मरुतः समुद्रतो यूयं वृष्टिं वर्षयथा पुरीषिणः । न वो दस्रा उप दस्यन्ति धेनवः शुभं यातामनु रथा अवृत्सत ॥
mantras.transliteration: udīrayathā marutaḥ samudrato yūyaṃ vṛṣṭiṃ varṣayathā purīṣiṇaḥ | na vo dasrā upa dasyanti dhenavaḥ śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata ||

translations.english: You send (the rain), Maruts, from the firmament; charged with the waters you shower down the rain; destroyers of foes, your kine are never dry; may the cars of the quick-moving (Maruts) arrive for our good.

mantras.sanskrit: यदश्वान्धूर्षु पृषतीरयुग्ध्वं हिरण्ययान्प्रत्यत्काँ अमुग्ध्वम् । विश्वा इत्स्पृधो मरुतो व्यस्यथ शुभं यातामनु रथा अवृत्सत ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadaśvāndhūrṣu pṛṣatīrayugdhvaṃ hiraṇyayānpratyatkā~ amugdhvam | viśvā itspṛdho maruto vyasyatha śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata ||

translations.english: When you yoke your spotted mares to the poles (of your chariots), you lay aside your golden breast-plural tes, for you dissipate all hostility; may the cars of the quick-moving (Maruts) arrive for our good.

mantras.sanskrit: न पर्वता न नद्यो वरन्त वो यत्राचिध्वं मरुतो गच्छथेदु तत् । उत द्यावापृथिवी याथना परि शुभं यातामनु रथा अवृत्सत ॥
mantras.transliteration: na parvatā na nadyo varanta vo yatrācidhvaṃ maruto gacchathedu tat | uta dyāvāpṛthivī yāthanā pari śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata ||

translations.english: Let not the mountains, let not the rivers, arrest you; whither you purpose, (Maruts), thither repair, and compass heaven and earth; may the cars of the quick-moving (Maruts) arrive for our good.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्पूर्व्यं मरुतो यच्च नूतनं यदुद्यते वसवो यच्च शस्यते । विश्वस्य तस्य भवथा नवेदसः शुभं यातामनु रथा अवृत्सत ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatpūrvyaṃ maruto yacca nūtanaṃ yadudyate vasavo yacca śasyate | viśvasya tasya bhavathā navedasaḥ śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata ||

translations.english: Whatever (rite has been addressed to you), Maruts, of old; whatever is recent; whatever (hymn) is recited, Vasus, whatever prayer is repeated, do you be cognizant of all; may the cars of the quick-moving (Maruts) arrive for our good.

mantras.sanskrit: मृळत नो मरुतो मा वधिष्टनास्मभ्यं शर्म बहुलं वि यन्तन । अधि स्तोत्रस्य सख्यस्य गातन शुभं यातामनु रथा अवृत्सत ॥
mantras.transliteration: mṛḷata no maruto mā vadhiṣṭanāsmabhyaṃ śarma bahulaṃ vi yantana | adhi stotrasya sakhyasya gātana śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata ||

translations.english: Send us felicity, Maruts, harm us not; bestow upon us exceeding happiness; reward our adoration by your friendship; may the cars of the quick-moving (Maruts) arrive for our good.

mantras.sanskrit: यूयमस्मान्नयत वस्यो अच्छा निरंहतिभ्यो मरुतो गृणानाः । जुषध्वं नो हव्यदातिं यजत्रा वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yūyamasmānnayata vasyo acchā niraṃhatibhyo maruto gṛṇānāḥ | juṣadhvaṃ no havyadātiṃ yajatrā vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||

translations.english: Do you, Maruts, conduct us to opulence; propitiated by our praises, extricate us from sin; accept, adorable (Maruts), our offered oblation, and may we be the possessors of riches.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने शर्धन्तमा गणं पिष्टं रुक्मेभिरञ्जिभिः । विशो अद्य मरुतामव ह्वये दिवश्चिद्रोचनादधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne śardhantamā gaṇaṃ piṣṭaṃ rukmebhirañjibhiḥ | viśo adya marutāmava hvaye divaścidrocanādadhi ||

translations.english: I invoke, Agni, the victorious company (of the Maruts) decorated with brilliant ornaments; (I invoke them), the people of the Maruts, to descend today from above the shining heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: यथा चिन्मन्यसे हृदा तदिन्मे जग्मुराशसः । ये ते नेदिष्ठं हवनान्यागमन्तान्वर्ध भीमसंदृशः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathā cinmanyase hṛdā tadinme jagmurāśasaḥ | ye te nediṣṭhaṃ havanānyāgamantānvardha bhīmasaṃdṛśaḥ ||

translations.english: In whatever manner you honour the (Maruts, Agni) in your heart, may they come to me as benefactors; gratify, (by oblations), those fierce-looking Maruts, who most promptly come to your invocations.

mantras.sanskrit: मीळ्हुष्मतीव पृथिवी पराहता मदन्त्येत्यस्मदा । ऋक्षो न वो मरुतः शिमीवाँ अमो दुध्रो गौरिव भीमयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mīḷhuṣmatīva pṛthivī parāhatā madantyetyasmadā | ṛkṣo na vo marutaḥ śimīvā~ amo dudhro gauriva bhīmayuḥ ||

translations.english: As the (people of the) earth having a powerful lord have recourse to him when oppressed (by others), so comes (the host of the Maruts) exulting to us; your company, Maruts, active as fire, is as difficult to be resisted as a formidable ox.

mantras.sanskrit: नि ये रिणन्त्योजसा वृथा गावो न दुर्धुरः । अश्मानं चित्स्वर्यं पर्वतं गिरिं प्र च्यावयन्ति यामभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni ye riṇantyojasā vṛthā gāvo na durdhuraḥ | aśmānaṃ citsvaryaṃ parvataṃ giriṃ pra cyāvayanti yāmabhiḥ ||

translations.english: They who with ease destroy (their foes) by their prowess, like horses difficult to be restrained, they send down by their movements the vast and sounding water-laden cloud.

mantras.sanskrit: उत्तिष्ठ नूनमेषां स्तोमैः समुक्षितानाम् । मरुतां पुरुतममपूर्व्यं गवां सर्गमिव ह्वये ॥
mantras.transliteration: uttiṣṭha nūnameṣāṃ stomaiḥ samukṣitānām | marutāṃ purutamamapūrvyaṃ gavāṃ sargamiva hvaye ||

translations.english: Rise up (Maruts); verily by my praises I invoke the mighty and unpreceded (troop) of these exalted (maruts) like a heap of waters.

mantras.sanskrit: युङ्ग्ध्वं ह्यरुषी रथे युङ्ग्ध्वं रथेषु रोहितः । युङ्ग्ध्वं हरी अजिरा धुरि वोळ्हवे वहिष्ठा धुरि वोळ्हवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuṅgdhvaṃ hyaruṣī rathe yuṅgdhvaṃ ratheṣu rohitaḥ | yuṅgdhvaṃ harī ajirā dhuri voḷhave vahiṣṭhā dhuri voḷhave ||

translations.english: Yoke the bright steeds to the car, yoke the red steeds to the cars; yoke the swift pair of horses to bear the burden; the strong bearing to bear the burden.

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्य वाज्यरुषस्तुविष्वणिरिह स्म धायि दर्शतः । मा वो यामेषु मरुतश्चिरं करत्प्र तं रथेषु चोदत ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta sya vājyaruṣastuviṣvaṇiriha sma dhāyi darśataḥ | mā vo yāmeṣu marutaściraṃ karatpra taṃ ratheṣu codata ||

translations.english: And let not that horse, bright-shining, loud-neighing, of graceful form, who has been plural ced (in harness), delay you, Maruts, on your journey; urge him on in the car.

mantras.sanskrit: रथं नु मारुतं वयं श्रवस्युमा हुवामहे । आ यस्मिन्तस्थौ सुरणानि बिभ्रती सचा मरुत्सु रोदसी ॥
mantras.transliteration: rathaṃ nu mārutaṃ vayaṃ śravasyumā huvāmahe | ā yasmintasthau suraṇāni bibhratī sacā marutsu rodasī ||

translations.english: We invoke the food-laden chariot of the Maruts, in which Rodasi stood with the Maruts, bearing the delicious (waters).

mantras.sanskrit: तं वः शर्धं रथेशुभं त्वेषं पनस्युमा हुवे । यस्मिन्त्सुजाता सुभगा महीयते सचा मरुत्सु मीळ्हुषी ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ vaḥ śardhaṃ ratheśubhaṃ tveṣaṃ panasyumā huve | yasmintsujātā subhagā mahīyate sacā marutsu mīḷhuṣī ||
