translations.english: I invoke that, your cohort, gracing the chariot, brilliant and adorable, amidst which the rain-bestowing (goddess), of goodly origin and auspicious, is worshipped together with the Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: आ रुद्रास इन्द्रवन्तः सजोषसो हिरण्यरथाः सुविताय गन्तन । इयं वो अस्मत्प्रति हर्यते मतिस्तृष्णजे न दिव उत्सा उदन्यवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā rudrāsa indravantaḥ sajoṣaso hiraṇyarathāḥ suvitāya gantana | iyaṃ vo asmatprati haryate matistṛṣṇaje na diva utsā udanyave ||

translations.english: Rudras, servants of Indra, mutually kind, riding in golden cars, come to the accessible (sacrifice); this our praise is addressed to you; (come to us as you came) from heaven, (bringing) oozing water to the thirsty (Gotama) longing for moisture.

mantras.sanskrit: वाशीमन्त ऋष्टिमन्तो मनीषिणः सुधन्वान इषुमन्तो निषङ्गिणः । स्वश्वाः स्थ सुरथाः पृश्निमातरः स्वायुधा मरुतो याथना शुभम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāśīmanta ṛṣṭimanto manīṣiṇaḥ sudhanvāna iṣumanto niṣaṅgiṇaḥ | svaśvāḥ stha surathāḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ svāyudhā maruto yāthanā śubham ||

translations.english: Intelligent Maruts, you are armed with swords, with lances, with bows with arrows, with quivers; you are well mounted and have handsome chariots; sons of Pṛṣṇi you are well armed; come for our good.

mantras.sanskrit: धूनुथ द्यां पर्वतान्दाशुषे वसु नि वो वना जिहते यामनो भिया । कोपयथ पृथिवीं पृश्निमातरः शुभे यदुग्राः पृषतीरयुग्ध्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhūnutha dyāṃ parvatāndāśuṣe vasu ni vo vanā jihate yāmano bhiyā | kopayatha pṛthivīṃ pṛśnimātaraḥ śubhe yadugrāḥ pṛṣatīrayugdhvam ||

translations.english: You agitate the clouds in the sky; (you give) wealth to the donor (of oblations); through fear of your approach the forests bow down; sons of Pṛṣṇi, you incense the earth when, for the purpose of (sending) water, you, fierce (Maruts), yoke your spotted steeds.

mantras.sanskrit: वातत्विषो मरुतो वर्षनिर्णिजो यमा इव सुसदृशः सुपेशसः । पिशङ्गाश्वा अरुणाश्वा अरेपसः प्रत्वक्षसो महिना द्यौरिवोरवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vātatviṣo maruto varṣanirṇijo yamā iva susadṛśaḥ supeśasaḥ | piśaṅgāśvā aruṇāśvā arepasaḥ pratvakṣaso mahinā dyaurivoravaḥ ||

translations.english: The Maruts, radiant with light, purifiers of the rain, like twins of goodly aspect and graceful form, masters of tawny and of ruddy steeds, devoid of guile, thinners (of foes) and vast in magnitude as the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: पुरुद्रप्सा अञ्जिमन्तः सुदानवस्त्वेषसंदृशो अनवभ्रराधसः । सुजातासो जनुषा रुक्मवक्षसो दिवो अर्का अमृतं नाम भेजिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: purudrapsā añjimantaḥ sudānavastveṣasaṃdṛśo anavabhrarādhasaḥ | sujātāso januṣā rukmavakṣaso divo arkā amṛtaṃ nāma bhejire ||

translations.english: Shedders of abundant showers, wearers of ornaments, munificent, of brilliant aspect, of inexhaustible wealth well descendent by birth, wearing golden breast-plural tes, entitled to adoration, (coming) from heaven, accept teḥ ambrosial oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋष्टयो वो मरुतो अंसयोरधि सह ओजो बाह्वोर्वो बलं हितम् । नृम्णा शीर्षस्वायुधा रथेषु वो विश्वा वः श्रीरधि तनूषु पिपिशे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛṣṭayo vo maruto aṃsayoradhi saha ojo bāhvorvo balaṃ hitam | nṛmṇā śīrṣasvāyudhā ratheṣu vo viśvā vaḥ śrīradhi tanūṣu pipiśe ||

translations.english: Lances rest, Maruts, upon your shoulders; strength (of) foes-destroying power is seated in your arms; golden (tiaras) are on your heads, weapons are plural ced in your chariots, all glory is assembled in your limbs.

mantras.sanskrit: गोमदश्वावद्रथवत्सुवीरं चन्द्रवद्राधो मरुतो ददा नः । प्रशस्तिं नः कृणुत रुद्रियासो भक्षीय वोऽवसो दैव्यस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: gomadaśvāvadrathavatsuvīraṃ candravadrādho maruto dadā naḥ | praśastiṃ naḥ kṛṇuta rudriyāso bhakṣīya vo'vaso daivyasya ||

translations.english: Maruts, bestow upon us affluence, comprehending cattle, horses, cars, treasure, and male descendants; sons of Rudra, grant us distinction; may I ever enjoy your divine protection.

mantras.sanskrit: हये नरो मरुतो मृळता नस्तुवीमघासो अमृता ऋतज्ञाः । सत्यश्रुतः कवयो युवानो बृहद्गिरयो बृहदुक्षमाणाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: haye naro maruto mṛḷatā nastuvīmaghāso amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ | satyaśrutaḥ kavayo yuvāno bṛhadgirayo bṛhadukṣamāṇāḥ ||

translations.english: Ho, Maruts, leaders (of rites), be propitious to us, you who are infinitely opulent, immortal, shedders of rain, renowned for truth, wise, young, greatly glorified, and worshipped with copious oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: तमु नूनं तविषीमन्तमेषां स्तुषे गणं मारुतं नव्यसीनाम् । य आश्वश्वा अमवद्वहन्त उतेशिरे अमृतस्य स्वराजः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamu nūnaṃ taviṣīmantameṣāṃ stuṣe gaṇaṃ mārutaṃ navyasīnām | ya āśvaśvā amavadvahanta uteśire amṛtasya svarājaḥ ||

translations.english: I praise today that brilliant company of the adorable Maruts, lords of swift horses, who pass along in strength, who, self-radiant, preside over the ambrosial rain.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वेषं गणं तवसं खादिहस्तं धुनिव्रतं मायिनं दातिवारम् । मयोभुवो ये अमिता महित्वा वन्दस्व विप्र तुविराधसो नॄन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tveṣaṃ gaṇaṃ tavasaṃ khādihastaṃ dhunivrataṃ māyinaṃ dātivāram | mayobhuvo ye amitā mahitvā vandasva vipra tuvirādhaso nṝn ||

translations.english: Adore, priest, the resplendent and powerful company, whose arms (are decorated) with bracelets, whose function is the agitation (of the trees), who are wise, and by whom wealth is conferred; they who are bestowers of felicity, whose greatness is unbounded; glorify the opulent leaders (of rites).

mantras.sanskrit: आ वो यन्तूदवाहासो अद्य वृष्टिं ये विश्वे मरुतो जुनन्ति । अयं यो अग्निर्मरुतः समिद्ध एतं जुषध्वं कवयो युवानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vo yantūdavāhāso adya vṛṣṭiṃ ye viśve maruto junanti | ayaṃ yo agnirmarutaḥ samiddha etaṃ juṣadhvaṃ kavayo yuvānaḥ ||

translations.english: May the universal Maruts, who urge on the rain, come to you today laden with water; Maruts, who are wise and young, be plural ased by this fire which is kindled for you.

mantras.sanskrit: यूयं राजानमिर्यं जनाय विभ्वतष्टं जनयथा यजत्राः । युष्मदेति मुष्टिहा बाहुजूतो युष्मत्सदश्वो मरुतः सुवीरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yūyaṃ rājānamiryaṃ janāya vibhvataṣṭaṃ janayathā yajatrāḥ | yuṣmadeti muṣṭihā bāhujūto yuṣmatsadaśvo marutaḥ suvīraḥ ||

translations.english: Adorable Maruts, you cause (a son) to be born to the man (who worships you), a ruler, an over-comer of foes, and modelled by Vibhvan; from you, Maruts, comes a valiant descendant, strong-fisted, mighty armed; from you (he acquires) an excellent steed.

mantras.sanskrit: अरा इवेदचरमा अहेव प्रप्र जायन्ते अकवा महोभिः । पृश्नेः पुत्रा उपमासो रभिष्ठाः स्वया मत्या मरुतः सं मिमिक्षुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: arā ivedacaramā aheva prapra jāyante akavā mahobhiḥ | pṛśneḥ putrā upamāso rabhiṣṭhāḥ svayā matyā marutaḥ saṃ mimikṣuḥ ||

translations.english: Like the spokes of a wheel, none (of you) are inferior (to the rest), but equal as days (of like duration); the sons of Pṛṣṇi are born all alike, none inferior in splendour; rapid in speed, the Maruts, of their own free favour send down (the rains).

mantras.sanskrit: यत्प्रायासिष्ट पृषतीभिरश्वैर्वीळुपविभिर्मरुतो रथेभिः । क्षोदन्त आपो रिणते वनान्यवोस्रियो वृषभः क्रन्दतु द्यौः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatprāyāsiṣṭa pṛṣatībhiraśvairvīḷupavibhirmaruto rathebhiḥ | kṣodanta āpo riṇate vanānyavosriyo vṛṣabhaḥ krandatu dyauḥ ||

translations.english: When, Maruts, you come with stout-axled cars drawn by spotted steeds, then the waters descend, the forests are damaged,a nd the bright showerer (of the rain), influenced by the solar rays, may emit a downward sound.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रथिष्ट यामन्पृथिवी चिदेषां भर्तेव गर्भं स्वमिच्छवो धुः । वातान्ह्यश्वान्धुर्यायुयुज्रे वर्षं स्वेदं चक्रिरे रुद्रियासः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prathiṣṭa yāmanpṛthivī cideṣāṃ bharteva garbhaṃ svamicchavo dhuḥ | vātānhyaśvāndhuryāyuyujre varṣaṃ svedaṃ cakrire rudriyāsaḥ ||

translations.english: On their approach the earth becomes capable of fertility, and they deposit in her water as their germ, as the husband genitive rates the embryo of the child; they have harnessed their horses fleet as the wind; the sons of Rudra have emitted their person iration, (the rain).

mantras.sanskrit: हये नरो मरुतो मृळता नस्तुवीमघासो अमृता ऋतज्ञाः । सत्यश्रुतः कवयो युवानो बृहद्गिरयो बृहदुक्षमाणाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: haye naro maruto mṛḷatā nastuvīmaghāso amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ | satyaśrutaḥ kavayo yuvāno bṛhadgirayo bṛhadukṣamāṇāḥ ||

translations.english: Ho, Maruts, leaders (of rites), be propitious to us, you who are infinitely opulent, immortal, shedders of rain, renowned for truth, wise, young, greatly glorified, and worshipped with copious oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वः स्पळक्रन्त्सुविताय दावनेऽर्चा दिवे प्र पृथिव्या ऋतं भरे । उक्षन्ते अश्वान्तरुषन्त आ रजोऽनु स्वं भानुं श्रथयन्ते अर्णवैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vaḥ spaḷakrantsuvitāya dāvane'rcā dive pra pṛthivyā ṛtaṃ bhare | ukṣante aśvāntaruṣanta ā rajo'nu svaṃ bhānuṃ śrathayante arṇavaiḥ ||

translations.english: The priest glorifies you, Maruts, for the good of the donor of the oblation; offer worship to the shining (heaven); I bring offerings to the earth; they, the Maruts, scatter the rapid (rain); they traverse the firmament; they combine their own radiance with (that of) the clouds.

mantras.sanskrit: अमादेषां भियसा भूमिरेजति नौर्न पूर्णा क्षरति व्यथिर्यती । दूरेदृशो ये चितयन्त एमभिरन्तर्महे विदथे येतिरे नरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: amādeṣāṃ bhiyasā bhūmirejati naurna pūrṇā kṣarati vyathiryatī | dūredṛśo ye citayanta emabhirantarmahe vidathe yetire naraḥ ||

translations.english: From their approach, the earth trembles with fear as a crowded boat goes quivering (through the water) visible from afar, they are recognized by their movements; the Maruts, leaders (of rites), pass between (heaven and earth) to the solemn sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: गवामिव श्रियसे शृङ्गमुत्तमं सूर्यो न चक्षू रजसो विसर्जने । अत्या इव सुभ्वश्चारवः स्थन मर्या इव श्रियसे चेतथा नरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: gavāmiva śriyase śṛṅgamuttamaṃ sūryo na cakṣū rajaso visarjane | atyā iva subhvaścāravaḥ sthana maryā iva śriyase cetathā naraḥ ||

translations.english: You bear, for your decoration, an excellent (diadem) like the horn of cattle; as the sun, the eye (of day, dispenses light), so (are you diligent) in the distribution of the rains; graceful are you, and rapid as horses, and like (pious) mortals, you, leaders (of rites), consider (holy ceremonies) for their glory.

mantras.sanskrit: को वो महान्ति महतामुदश्नवत्कस्काव्या मरुतः को ह पौंस्या । यूयं ह भूमिं किरणं न रेजथ प्र यद्भरध्वे सुविताय दावने ॥
mantras.transliteration: ko vo mahānti mahatāmudaśnavatkaskāvyā marutaḥ ko ha pauṃsyā | yūyaṃ ha bhūmiṃ kiraṇaṃ na rejatha pra yadbharadhve suvitāya dāvane ||

translations.english: Who may exalt the great excellences of you who are adorable? who may (offer you fitting) praises? who (glorify your) manly (deeds)? For you make the earth tremble like a ray (of light) when you confer the gift (of rain) for (the diffusion of) fertility.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्वा इवेदरुषासः सबन्धवः शूरा इव प्रयुधः प्रोत युयुधुः । मर्या इव सुवृधो वावृधुर्नरः सूर्यस्य चक्षुः प्र मिनन्ति वृष्टिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvā ivedaruṣāsaḥ sabandhavaḥ śūrā iva prayudhaḥ prota yuyudhuḥ | maryā iva suvṛdho vāvṛdhurnaraḥ sūryasya cakṣuḥ pra minanti vṛṣṭibhiḥ ||

translations.english: Resplendent as steeds, of one kindred, they engage in combat like valiant heroes; like (prosperous) men, they, the leaders (of rites), have increased (in power), and cover the eye of the sun with showers.

mantras.sanskrit: ते अज्येष्ठा अकनिष्ठास उद्भिदोऽमध्यमासो महसा वि वावृधुः । सुजातासो जनुषा पृश्निमातरो दिवो मर्या आ नो अच्छा जिगातन ॥
mantras.transliteration: te ajyeṣṭhā akaniṣṭhāsa udbhido'madhyamāso mahasā vi vāvṛdhuḥ | sujātāso januṣā pṛśnimātaro divo maryā ā no acchā jigātana ||

translations.english: None of them are older, none younger (than the others); the destroyers of (foes), none hold a middle (rank), but all excel in glory; honourable by birth having Pṛṣṇi for your mother, do you, Maruts, favourable to man, come from heaven to our presence.

mantras.sanskrit: वयो न ये श्रेणीः पप्तुरोजसान्तान्दिवो बृहतः सानुनस्परि । अश्वास एषामुभये यथा विदुः प्र पर्वतस्य नभनूँरचुच्यवुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayo na ye śreṇīḥ papturojasāntāndivo bṛhataḥ sānunaspari | aśvāsa eṣāmubhaye yathā viduḥ pra parvatasya nabhanū~racucyavuḥ ||

translations.english: Like birds (that fly) in rows they pass along in their strength above the vast summit (of the sky) to the ends of the firmament; their horses have caused the waters of the cloud to descend, as both (gods and mortals) know.

mantras.sanskrit: मिमातु द्यौरदितिर्वीतये नः सं दानुचित्रा उषसो यतन्ताम् । आचुच्यवुर्दिव्यं कोशमेत ऋषे रुद्रस्य मरुतो गृणानाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mimātu dyauraditirvītaye naḥ saṃ dānucitrā uṣaso yatantām | ācucyavurdivyaṃ kośameta ṛṣe rudrasya maruto gṛṇānāḥ ||

translations.english: May the heaven and the earth yield (rain) for our sustenance; may the wonderfully bounteous dawns exert themselves (for our good); may these sons of Rudra, lauded, Ṛṣi, (by you), send down the celestial rain.

mantras.sanskrit: ईळे अग्निं स्ववसं नमोभिरिह प्रसत्तो वि चयत्कृतं नः । रथैरिव प्र भरे वाजयद्भिः प्रदक्षिणिन्मरुतां स्तोममृध्याम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: īḷe agniṃ svavasaṃ namobhiriha prasatto vi cayatkṛtaṃ naḥ | rathairiva pra bhare vājayadbhiḥ pradakṣiṇinmarutāṃ stomamṛdhyām ||

translations.english: I adore the protecting Agni with hymns; may he, propitiated on this occasion, approve of our acts; offer (worship with praises), intended to obtain food; as if (proceeding) with cars (to the goal), circumambulating (the fire); may I exalt the praise of the maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: आ ये तस्थुः पृषतीषु श्रुतासु सुखेषु रुद्रा मरुतो रथेषु । वना चिदुग्रा जिहते नि वो भिया पृथिवी चिद्रेजते पर्वतश्चित् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā ye tasthuḥ pṛṣatīṣu śrutāsu sukheṣu rudrā maruto ratheṣu | vanā cidugrā jihate ni vo bhiyā pṛthivī cidrejate parvataścit ||

translations.english: Fierce Maruts, sons of Rudra, who ride in easy chariots (drawn by) celebrated steeds, (at your coming) the woods bow down with fear, the earth tremles, and the mountains (shake).

mantras.sanskrit: पर्वतश्चिन्महि वृद्धो बिभाय दिवश्चित्सानु रेजत स्वने वः । यत्क्रीळथ मरुत ऋष्टिमन्त आप इव सध्र्यञ्चो धवध्वे ॥
mantras.transliteration: parvataścinmahi vṛddho bibhāya divaścitsānu rejata svane vaḥ | yatkrīḷatha maruta ṛṣṭimanta āpa iva sadhryañco dhavadhve ||

translations.english: The mountain, vast and lofty (though it be), is alarmed at your noise, and the summit of the firmament trembles when, lance-armed Maruts, you are sporting; you rush along together like waters.

mantras.sanskrit: वरा इवेद्रैवतासो हिरण्यैरभि स्वधाभिस्तन्वः पिपिश्रे । श्रिये श्रेयांसस्तवसो रथेषु सत्रा महांसि चक्रिरे तनूषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: varā ivedraivatāso hiraṇyairabhi svadhābhistanvaḥ pipiśre | śriye śreyāṃsastavaso ratheṣu satrā mahāṃsi cakrire tanūṣu ||

translations.english: Like wealthy bridegrooms who have decorated their person ns with golden (ornaments) and purifying waters, so the noble and powerful Maruts, associated together in their chariots, have made great (preparation) in their several person ns for their embellishment.

mantras.sanskrit: अज्येष्ठासो अकनिष्ठास एते सं भ्रातरो वावृधुः सौभगाय । युवा पिता स्वपा रुद्र एषां सुदुघा पृश्निः सुदिना मरुद्भ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ajyeṣṭhāso akaniṣṭhāsa ete saṃ bhrātaro vāvṛdhuḥ saubhagāya | yuvā pitā svapā rudra eṣāṃ sudughā pṛśniḥ sudinā marudbhyaḥ ||

translations.english: They are brothers, of whom no one is the elder, no one the younger, but who grew up together for their mutual prosperity; may their father, Rudra, ever youthful, the doer of good deeds, and Pṛṣṇi, (their mother), easy to be milked, grant favourable days for (the sake of) the Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: यदुत्तमे मरुतो मध्यमे वा यद्वावमे सुभगासो दिवि ष्ठ । अतो नो रुद्रा उत वा न्वस्याग्ने वित्ताद्धविषो यद्यजाम ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaduttame maruto madhyame vā yadvāvame subhagāso divi ṣṭha | ato no rudrā uta vā nvasyāgne vittāddhaviṣo yadyajāma ||

translations.english: Auspicious Maruts, whether you abide in the upper, the middle, or \the lower heaven, (come), Rudras, to us from thence; and do you, Agni, accept the oblation which this day we offer.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निश्च यन्मरुतो विश्ववेदसो दिवो वहध्व उत्तरादधि ष्णुभिः । ते मन्दसाना धुनयो रिशादसो वामं धत्त यजमानाय सुन्वते ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniśca yanmaruto viśvavedaso divo vahadhva uttarādadhi ṣṇubhiḥ | te mandasānā dhunayo riśādaso vāmaṃ dhatta yajamānāya sunvate ||

translations.english: Maruts, who are omniscient, since you and Agni abide above the summits of the upper (region) of the sky, do you who cause (your enemies) to tremble, and are the consumers of (our) foes, do you, being plural ased, bestow upon the sacrificer who offers you oblations desirable wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने मरुद्भिः शुभयद्भिॠक्वभिः सोमं पिब मन्दसानो गणश्रिभिः । पावकेभिर्विश्वमिन्वेभिरायुभिर्वैश्वानर प्रदिवा केतुना सजूः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne marudbhiḥ śubhayadbhiṝkvabhiḥ somaṃ piba mandasāno gaṇaśribhiḥ | pāvakebhirviśvaminvebhirāyubhirvaiśvānara pradivā ketunā sajūḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, drink the Soma-juice, rejoicing, along with the Maruts, resplendent, adorable, associated in troops, purifying all, animating and long-lived; drink, Vaiśvānara, who are identified with the ancient emblem (of flame).

mantras.sanskrit: के ष्ठा नरः श्रेष्ठतमा य एकएक आयय । परमस्याः परावतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ke ṣṭhā naraḥ śreṣṭhatamā ya ekaeka āyaya | paramasyāḥ parāvataḥ ||

translations.english: Who are you, most excellent leadeers (of rites), who come one by one from a region exceedingly remote?

mantras.sanskrit: क्व वोऽश्वाः क्वाभीशवः कथं शेक कथा यय । पृष्ठे सदो नसोर्यमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kva vo'śvāḥ kvābhīśavaḥ kathaṃ śeka kathā yaya | pṛṣṭhe sado nasoryamaḥ ||

translations.english: Where are your horses? where your reins? what is your capability? where are you going? The saddle is on the back (of the steeds), the bridle in their nostrils.

mantras.sanskrit: जघने चोद एषां वि सक्थानि नरो यमुः । पुत्रकृथे न जनयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: jaghane coda eṣāṃ vi sakthāni naro yamuḥ | putrakṛthe na janayaḥ ||

translations.english: The goad is (applied) to their flanks; the drivers force them to spread their thighs apart, like women in bringing forth children.

mantras.sanskrit: परा वीरास एतन मर्यासो भद्रजानयः । अग्नितपो यथासथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: parā vīrāsa etana maryāso bhadrajānayaḥ | agnitapo yathāsatha ||

translations.english: Heroes, friendly to man, of honourable birth, you are as if blazing with fire.

mantras.sanskrit: सनत्साश्व्यं पशुमुत गव्यं शतावयम् । श्यावाश्वस्तुताय या दोर्वीरायोपबर्बृहत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sanatsāśvyaṃ paśumuta gavyaṃ śatāvayam | śyāvāśvastutāya yā dorvīrāyopabarbṛhat ||

translations.english: She, (Śaśiyasī), who has thrown her arms round the hero Taranta, who was eulogized by Śyāvāśva, has given me cattle comprising horses, and cows, and hundreds of sheep.

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्वा स्त्री शशीयसी पुंसो भवति वस्यसी । अदेवत्रादराधसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tvā strī śaśīyasī puṃso bhavati vasyasī | adevatrādarādhasaḥ ||

translations.english: Śaśīyasi, though a feminine le, is more excellent than a man who reverences not the gods, nor bestows wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: वि या जानाति जसुरिं वि तृष्यन्तं वि कामिनम् । देवत्रा कृणुते मनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi yā jānāti jasuriṃ vi tṛṣyantaṃ vi kāminam | devatrā kṛṇute manaḥ ||

translations.english: For she discerns one who suffers pain, one who is in want, or one desirous (of any thing), and directs her mind towards the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: उत घा नेमो अस्तुतः पुमाँ इति ब्रुवे पणिः । स वैरदेय इत्समः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta ghā nemo astutaḥ pumā~ iti bruve paṇiḥ | sa vairadeya itsamaḥ ||

translations.english: And, eulogizing (him), I proclaim that the man, her (other) half is, (as it were), uncommended, for he is ever the same in munificent donations.

mantras.sanskrit: उत मेऽरपद्युवतिर्ममन्दुषी प्रति श्यावाय वर्तनिम् । वि रोहिता पुरुमीळ्हाय येमतुर्विप्राय दीर्घयशसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta me'rapadyuvatirmamanduṣī prati śyāvāya vartanim | vi rohitā purumīḷhāya yematurviprāya dīrghayaśase ||

translations.english: Young and affable, she has explained to me, Śyāvāśva, the road, and two ruddy horses have borne me to the valiant and renowned Purumīḷha.

mantras.sanskrit: यो मे धेनूनां शतं वैददश्विर्यथा ददत् । तरन्त इव मंहना ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo me dhenūnāṃ śataṃ vaidadaśviryathā dadat | taranta iva maṃhanā ||

translations.english: Who, the son of Vidadaśva, has given me a hundred (head) of cattle, and, like Taranta, many precious gifts.

mantras.sanskrit: य ईं वहन्त आशुभिः पिबन्तो मदिरं मधु । अत्र श्रवांसि दधिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya īṃ vahanta āśubhiḥ pibanto madiraṃ madhu | atra śravāṃsi dadhire ||

translations.english: Those (Maruts) who are brought hither by swift horses, drinking the inembriating juice, receive here gratification.

mantras.sanskrit: येषां श्रियाधि रोदसी विभ्राजन्ते रथेष्वा । दिवि रुक्म इवोपरि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yeṣāṃ śriyādhi rodasī vibhrājante ratheṣvā | divi rukma ivopari ||

translations.english: They by whose glory heaven and earth are surpassed; who shine splendid in their chariots like the radiant (sun) in the heaven above.

mantras.sanskrit: युवा स मारुतो गणस्त्वेषरथो अनेद्यः । शुभंयावाप्रतिष्कुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvā sa māruto gaṇastveṣaratho anedyaḥ | śubhaṃyāvāpratiṣkutaḥ ||

translations.english: That company of Maruts, ever young, riding in bright chariots, irreproachable, auspicious, motive, unobstructed.

mantras.sanskrit: को वेद नूनमेषां यत्रा मदन्ति धूतयः । ऋतजाता अरेपसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ko veda nūnameṣāṃ yatrā madanti dhūtayaḥ | ṛtajātā arepasaḥ ||

translations.english: Who knows of a certainty their (abode), where the intimidators (of their foes) rejoice? born for (the distribution of) water, exempt from defects.

mantras.sanskrit: यूयं मर्तं विपन्यवः प्रणेतार इत्था धिया । श्रोतारो यामहूतिषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: yūyaṃ martaṃ vipanyavaḥ praṇetāra itthā dhiyā | śrotāro yāmahūtiṣu ||

translations.english: Desirous of praise, you are the guides (to happiness) of the man who propitiates (you) by this pious rite; you are bearers of invocations to the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: ते नो वसूनि काम्या पुरुश्चन्द्रा रिशादसः । आ यज्ञियासो ववृत्तन ॥
mantras.transliteration: te no vasūni kāmyā puruścandrā riśādasaḥ | ā yajñiyāso vavṛttana ||

translations.english: Do you, who are destroyers of the male violent, abounding in wealth, and entitled to adoration, bestow upon us desirable riches.

mantras.sanskrit: एतं मे स्तोममूर्म्ये दार्भ्याय परा वह । गिरो देवि रथीरिव ॥
mantras.transliteration: etaṃ me stomamūrmye dārbhyāya parā vaha | giro devi rathīriva ||

translations.english: Bear to Dārbhya, oḥ night, turning away (from me to him), this my eulogy (of the Maruts); convey my praises, goddess, as a charioteer (conveys the contents of his vehicle to their destination).

mantras.sanskrit: उत मे वोचतादिति सुतसोमे रथवीतौ । न कामो अप वेति मे ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta me vocatāditi sutasome rathavītau | na kāmo apa veti me ||

translations.english: And say on my behalf to Rathavīti, when the libation is poured out, my love (for your daughter) does not depart.

mantras.sanskrit: एष क्षेति रथवीतिर्मघवा गोमतीरनु । पर्वतेष्वपश्रितः ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa kṣeti rathavītirmaghavā gomatīranu | parvateṣvapaśritaḥ ||

translations.english: This opulent Rathavīti dwells upon the (banks of the) Gomatī (river), and has his home on (the skirts of) the (Himālaya) mountains.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतेन ऋतमपिहितं ध्रुवं वां सूर्यस्य यत्र विमुचन्त्यश्वान् । दश शता सह तस्थुस्तदेकं देवानां श्रेष्ठं वपुषामपश्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtena ṛtamapihitaṃ dhruvaṃ vāṃ sūryasya yatra vimucantyaśvān | daśa śatā saha tasthustadekaṃ devānāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vapuṣāmapaśyam ||

translations.english: I have beheld the permanent orb of the sun, your (dwelling plural ce), concealed by water, where (the hymns of the pious) liberate (his) steeds; where a thousand rays abide together; the one most excellent of the (embodied) forms of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: तत्सु वां मित्रावरुणा महित्वमीर्मा तस्थुषीरहभिर्दुदुह्रे । विश्वाः पिन्वथः स्वसरस्य धेना अनु वामेकः पविरा ववर्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: tatsu vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā mahitvamīrmā tasthuṣīrahabhirduduhre | viśvāḥ pinvathaḥ svasarasya dhenā anu vāmekaḥ pavirā vavarta ||

translations.english: Exceeding is that your greatness, Mitra and Varuṇa, whereby the ever-moving sun has, through (succeeding) days, milked forth the stationary waters; you augment all the (world-illuming) rays of the self-revolving (sun); the one chariot of you two (perpetually) goes round.

mantras.sanskrit: अधारयतं पृथिवीमुत द्यां मित्रराजाना वरुणा महोभिः । वर्धयतमोषधीः पिन्वतं गा अव वृष्टिं सृजतं जीरदानू ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhārayataṃ pṛthivīmuta dyāṃ mitrarājānā varuṇā mahobhiḥ | vardhayatamoṣadhīḥ pinvataṃ gā ava vṛṣṭiṃ sṛjataṃ jīradānū ||

translations.english: Royal Mitra and Varuṇa, you uphold, by your energies, earth and heaven; prompt benefactors, cause the plural nts to grow, give nourishment to the cattle, send down the rain.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वामश्वासः सुयुजो वहन्तु यतरश्मय उप यन्त्वर्वाक् । घृतस्य निर्णिगनु वर्तते वामुप सिन्धवः प्रदिवि क्षरन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāmaśvāsaḥ suyujo vahantu yataraśmaya upa yantvarvāk | ghṛtasya nirṇiganu vartate vāmupa sindhavaḥ pradivi kṣaranti ||

translations.english: May your easily-harnessed horses bear you both (hither), and with well-guided reins come down; the embodied form of water follows you, the rivers flow as of old.

mantras.sanskrit: अनु श्रुताममतिं वर्धदुर्वीं बर्हिरिव यजुषा रक्षमाणा । नमस्वन्ता धृतदक्षाधि गर्ते मित्रासाथे वरुणेळास्वन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: anu śrutāmamatiṃ vardhadurvīṃ barhiriva yajuṣā rakṣamāṇā | namasvantā dhṛtadakṣādhi garte mitrāsāthe varuṇeḷāsvantaḥ ||

translations.english: Augmenting the well-known and ample form (of man), in like manner as the sacred grass is preserved by prayer, do you, Mitra and Varuṇa, who are invigorated by (sacrificial) viands, and abound in food, ascend your car in the midst of the plural ce of sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: अक्रविहस्ता सुकृते परस्पा यं त्रासाथे वरुणेळास्वन्तः । राजाना क्षत्रमहृणीयमाना सहस्रस्थूणं बिभृथः सह द्वौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: akravihastā sukṛte paraspā yaṃ trāsāthe varuṇeḷāsvantaḥ | rājānā kṣatramahṛṇīyamānā sahasrasthūṇaṃ bibhṛthaḥ saha dvau ||

translations.english: Be open-handed and benignant to the performer of pious acts, whom you protect in the midst of the plural ce of sacrifice; for you two, who are soverigns, and free from wrath, uphold together a mansion of a thousand columns.

mantras.sanskrit: हिरण्यनिर्णिगयो अस्य स्थूणा वि भ्राजते दिव्यश्वाजनीव । भद्रे क्षेत्रे निमिता तिल्विले वा सनेम मध्वो अधिगर्त्यस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: hiraṇyanirṇigayo asya sthūṇā vi bhrājate divyaśvājanīva | bhadre kṣetre nimitā tilvile vā sanema madhvo adhigartyasya ||

translations.english: The substance (of their chariot) is of gold; its pillars are of metal, and it shines in the firmament like lightning; may we load the vehicle with the libation in an auspicious plural ce, or in the sacrificial hall, (where the columns) are erected.

mantras.sanskrit: हिरण्यरूपमुषसो व्युष्टावयःस्थूणमुदिता सूर्यस्य । आ रोहथो वरुण मित्र गर्तमतश्चक्षाथे अदितिं दितिं च ॥
mantras.transliteration: hiraṇyarūpamuṣaso vyuṣṭāvayaḥsthūṇamuditā sūryasya | ā rohatho varuṇa mitra gartamataścakṣāthe aditiṃ ditiṃ ca ||

translations.english: At the break of dawn, at the rising of the sun, ascend Mitra and Varuṇa, your golden-bodied, metal-pillared car, and thence, behold the earth and its inhabitants.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्बंहिष्ठं नातिविधे सुदानू अच्छिद्रं शर्म भुवनस्य गोपा । तेन नो मित्रावरुणावविष्टं सिषासन्तो जिगीवांसः स्याम ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadbaṃhiṣṭhaṃ nātividhe sudānū acchidraṃ śarma bhuvanasya gopā | tena no mitrāvaruṇāvaviṣṭaṃ siṣāsanto jigīvāṃsaḥ syāma ||

translations.english: Munificent Mitra and Varuṇa, protectors of the universe, (it is yours to grant) exceeding and perfect felicity, such as it is impossible to disturb; bless us with that (felicity), and may we ever be (possessed) of the riches we desire, and be confident of vicotry (over our enemies).

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतस्य गोपावधि तिष्ठथो रथं सत्यधर्माणा परमे व्योमनि । यमत्र मित्रावरुणावथो युवं तस्मै वृष्टिर्मधुमत्पिन्वते दिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtasya gopāvadhi tiṣṭhatho rathaṃ satyadharmāṇā parame vyomani | yamatra mitrāvaruṇāvatho yuvaṃ tasmai vṛṣṭirmadhumatpinvate divaḥ ||

translations.english: Guardians of water, observers of truth, you ascend your car in the highest heaven; to him whom you, Mitra and Varuṇa, protect, the rain sends down the sweet (shower) from the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: सम्राजावस्य भुवनस्य राजथो मित्रावरुणा विदथे स्वर्दृशा । वृष्टिं वां राधो अमृतत्वमीमहे द्यावापृथिवी वि चरन्ति तन्यवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samrājāvasya bhuvanasya rājatho mitrāvaruṇā vidathe svardṛśā | vṛṣṭiṃ vāṃ rādho amṛtatvamīmahe dyāvāpṛthivī vi caranti tanyavaḥ ||

translations.english: Imperial rulers of this world, you shine, Mitra and Varuṇa, at this sacrifice, the beholders of heaven; we ask of you the wealth (that is) rain, and immortality for your forms traverse earth and heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: सम्राजा उग्रा वृषभा दिवस्पती पृथिव्या मित्रावरुणा विचर्षणी । चित्रेभिरभ्रैरुप तिष्ठथो रवं द्यां वर्षयथो असुरस्य मायया ॥
mantras.transliteration: samrājā ugrā vṛṣabhā divaspatī pṛthivyā mitrāvaruṇā vicarṣaṇī | citrebhirabhrairupa tiṣṭhatho ravaṃ dyāṃ varṣayatho asurasya māyayā ||

translations.english: Imperial and mighty showerers, lords of heaven and earth, beholders of the universe, you approach, Mitra and Varuṇa, with variegated clouds to hear the sound (of your praises), and cause the sky to (send down) rain by the power of the emitter of showers.

mantras.sanskrit: माया वां मित्रावरुणा दिवि श्रिता सूर्यो ज्योतिश्चरति चित्रमायुधम् । तमभ्रेण वृष्ट्या गूहथो दिवि पर्जन्य द्रप्सा मधुमन्त ईरते ॥
mantras.transliteration: māyā vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā divi śritā sūryo jyotiścarati citramāyudham | tamabhreṇa vṛṣṭyā gūhatho divi parjanya drapsā madhumanta īrate ||

translations.english: Your deevice, Mitra and Varuṇa, is manifested in heaven, when the light (that is) the sun, your wonderful weapon, moves (in the firmament); him you invest in the sky with the cloud (and) with rain; and (your) sweet drops, Parjanya, fall (at their desire).

mantras.sanskrit: रथं युञ्जते मरुतः शुभे सुखं शूरो न मित्रावरुणा गविष्टिषु । रजांसि चित्रा वि चरन्ति तन्यवो दिवः सम्राजा पयसा न उक्षतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: rathaṃ yuñjate marutaḥ śubhe sukhaṃ śūro na mitrāvaruṇā gaviṣṭiṣu | rajāṃsi citrā vi caranti tanyavo divaḥ samrājā payasā na ukṣatam ||

translations.english: The Maruts harness their easy-going chariot, Mitra and Varuṇa, for (the emission of) water, as a hero (harnesses his war-car); their forms traverse the different spheres to distribute the rain; do you, therefore, supreme rulers, shed upon us water from heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: वाचं सु मित्रावरुणाविरावतीं पर्जन्यश्चित्रां वदति त्विषीमतीम् । अभ्रा वसत मरुतः सु मायया द्यां वर्षयतमरुणामरेपसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vācaṃ su mitrāvaruṇāvirāvatīṃ parjanyaścitrāṃ vadati tviṣīmatīm | abhrā vasata marutaḥ su māyayā dyāṃ varṣayatamaruṇāmarepasam ||

translations.english: The cloud, (through your will), Mitra and Varuṇa, utters a wonderful sound, indicative of radiance, and announcing (abundant) food; the Maruts thoroughly invest the clouds with (their) devices, and, (along with them), you two cause the purple and faultless sky to send down rain.

mantras.sanskrit: धर्मणा मित्रावरुणा विपश्चिता व्रता रक्षेथे असुरस्य मायया । ऋतेन विश्वं भुवनं वि राजथः सूर्यमा धत्थो दिवि चित्र्यं रथम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dharmaṇā mitrāvaruṇā vipaścitā vratā rakṣethe asurasya māyayā | ṛtena viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ vi rājathaḥ sūryamā dhattho divi citryaṃ ratham ||

translations.english: Discerning, sagacious, Mitra and Varuṇa, by your office you protect pious rites, through the power of the emitter of showers; you illumine the whole world with water; you sustain the sun, the adorable chariot in the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: वरुणं वो रिशादसमृचा मित्रं हवामहे । परि व्रजेव बाह्वोर्जगन्वांसा स्वर्णरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: varuṇaṃ vo riśādasamṛcā mitraṃ havāmahe | pari vrajeva bāhvorjaganvāṃsā svarṇaram ||

translations.english: We invoke you, Mitra and Varuṇa, with this hymn; each the discomfiter of foes, the conductor to heaven, like (two herdsmen) driving, by (the strength of their) arms, the herds of cattle before them.

mantras.sanskrit: ता बाहवा सुचेतुना प्र यन्तमस्मा अर्चते । शेवं हि जार्यं वां विश्वासु क्षासु जोगुवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā bāhavā sucetunā pra yantamasmā arcate | śevaṃ hi jāryaṃ vāṃ viśvāsu kṣāsu joguve ||

translations.english: Do you two, with discriminating hand, bestow upon me, your worshipper, (what I desire); for the desirable felicity (that is given by you) spreads through all lands.

mantras.sanskrit: यन्नूनमश्यां गतिं मित्रस्य यायां पथा । अस्य प्रियस्य शर्मण्यहिंसानस्य सश्चिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yannūnamaśyāṃ gatiṃ mitrasya yāyāṃ pathā | asya priyasya śarmaṇyahiṃsānasya saścire ||

translations.english: That I may now pursue the (right) direction, may I proceed by the path of Mitra, for all (good things) are aggregated in the happiness, (the gift) of that beloved and benignant (deity).

mantras.sanskrit: युवाभ्यां मित्रावरुणोपमं धेयामृचा । यद्ध क्षये मघोनां स्तोतॄणां च स्पूर्धसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvābhyāṃ mitrāvaruṇopamaṃ dheyāmṛcā | yaddha kṣaye maghonāṃ stotṝṇāṃ ca spūrdhase ||

translations.english: May I obtain from you, Mitra and Varuṇa, by my praise, such  wealth as to excite envy in the dwellings of the rich and the devout.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो मित्र सुदीतिभिर्वरुणश्च सधस्थ आ । स्वे क्षये मघोनां सखीनां च वृधसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no mitra sudītibhirvaruṇaśca sadhastha ā | sve kṣaye maghonāṃ sakhīnāṃ ca vṛdhase ||

translations.english: Come, Mitra (come), Varuṇa, with your splendour to our assembly, and augment (the prosperity) of the affluent (worshipper), and of (those who are) your friends in their respective abodes.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं नो येषु वरुण क्षत्रं बृहच्च बिभृथः । उरु णो वाजसातये कृतं राये स्वस्तये ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ no yeṣu varuṇa kṣatraṃ bṛhacca bibhṛthaḥ | uru ṇo vājasātaye kṛtaṃ rāye svastaye ||

translations.english: You, Mitra and Varuṇa, bring us strength and abundant (food) for (those praises) which (we offer); be largely bountiful to us in food, in riches, in prosperity.

mantras.sanskrit: उच्छन्त्यां मे यजता देवक्षत्रे रुशद्गवि । सुतं सोमं न हस्तिभिरा पड्भिर्धावतं नरा बिभ्रतावर्चनानसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ucchantyāṃ me yajatā devakṣatre ruśadgavi | sutaṃ somaṃ na hastibhirā paḍbhirdhāvataṃ narā bibhratāvarcanānasam ||

translations.english: Deities who are to be worshipped at the sacrifice to the gods, at the (first) shining ray (of light) at dawn; behold my Soma libation poured out; hasten, with rapid steeds, leaders (of rites), propitious to Arcanānas.

mantras.sanskrit: यश्चिकेत स सुक्रतुर्देवत्रा स ब्रवीतु नः । वरुणो यस्य दर्शतो मित्रो वा वनते गिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaściketa sa sukraturdevatrā sa bravītu naḥ | varuṇo yasya darśato mitro vā vanate giraḥ ||

translations.english: He who knows (how to honour you two) among the gods, is ghe performer of good works; let him, communicate (that knowledge) to us, he of whom the graceful Varuṇa or Mitra accepts the laudation.

mantras.sanskrit: ता हि श्रेष्ठवर्चसा राजाना दीर्घश्रुत्तमा । ता सत्पती ऋतावृध ऋतावाना जनेजने ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā hi śreṣṭhavarcasā rājānā dīrghaśruttamā | tā satpatī ṛtāvṛdha ṛtāvānā janejane ||

translations.english: They two, verily excelling in radiance, royal (deities), who hear (invocations) from the greatest distance; lords of the virtuous, favourers of the sacrifice, are in movement (for the good of) each individual man.

mantras.sanskrit: ता वामियानोऽवसे पूर्वा उप ब्रुवे सचा । स्वश्वासः सु चेतुना वाजाँ अभि प्र दावने ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā vāmiyāno'vase pūrvā upa bruve sacā | svaśvāsaḥ su cetunā vājā~ abhi pra dāvane ||

translations.english: Approaching you, ancient (divinities), I invoke you together for protection; possessed of good steeds, (we praise you) who are provident to give us food.

mantras.sanskrit: मित्रो अंहोश्चिदादुरु क्षयाय गातुं वनते । मित्रस्य हि प्रतूर्वतः सुमतिरस्ति विधतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mitro aṃhościdāduru kṣayāya gātuṃ vanate | mitrasya hi pratūrvataḥ sumatirasti vidhataḥ ||

translations.english: Mitra grants even to the sinful (worshipper) the (means of) repairing to his spacious dwelling; the favour of Mitra, the destroyer fo foes, is (granted) to (his) adorer.

mantras.sanskrit: वयं मित्रस्यावसि स्याम सप्रथस्तमे । अनेहसस्त्वोतयः सत्रा वरुणशेषसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayaṃ mitrasyāvasi syāma saprathastame | anehasastvotayaḥ satrā varuṇaśeṣasaḥ ||

translations.english: May we ever be in the comprehensive guardianship of Mitra, and, free from sin, enjoy, (Mitra), your protection, being at the same time the children of Varuṇa

mantras.sanskrit: युवं मित्रेमं जनं यतथः सं च नयथः । मा मघोनः परि ख्यतं मो अस्माकमृषीणां गोपीथे न उरुष्यतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ mitremaṃ janaṃ yatathaḥ saṃ ca nayathaḥ | mā maghonaḥ pari khyataṃ mo asmākamṛṣīṇāṃ gopīthe na uruṣyatam ||

translations.english: You come, Mitra and Varuṇa, to this man, and guide him (to his desires); deny us not when we are rich (in offerings); (deny us not), who are (the sons) of ṛṣis protect us in the presenting of the libation.

mantras.sanskrit: आ चिकितान सुक्रतू देवौ मर्त रिशादसा । वरुणाय ऋतपेशसे दधीत प्रयसे महे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā cikitāna sukratū devau marta riśādasā | varuṇāya ṛtapeśase dadhīta prayase mahe ||

translations.english: Man, endowed with intelligence, (adore) the two deities, the performers of good deeds, the destroyers of foes; offer (oblations) to the adorable accepter of (sacrificial) food, to Varuṇa, whose form is water.

mantras.sanskrit: ता हि क्षत्रमविह्रुतं सम्यगसुर्यमाशाते । अध व्रतेव मानुषं स्वर्ण धायि दर्शतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā hi kṣatramavihrutaṃ samyagasuryamāśāte | adha vrateva mānuṣaṃ svarṇa dhāyi darśatam ||

translations.english: Inasmuch as you two are possessed of irresistible and asura-subduing strength, therefore has holy sacrifice been established among men, as the sun (has been plural ced) in the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: ता वामेषे रथानामुर्वीं गव्यूतिमेषाम् । रातहव्यस्य सुष्टुतिं दधृक्स्तोमैर्मनामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā vāmeṣe rathānāmurvīṃ gavyūtimeṣām | rātahavyasya suṣṭutiṃ dadhṛkstomairmanāmahe ||

translations.english: We glorify you both, that your chariots may precede ours by a long distance; accepting the pious worship of Rātahavya with (his) praises.

mantras.sanskrit: अधा हि काव्या युवं दक्षस्य पूर्भिरद्भुता । नि केतुना जनानां चिकेथे पूतदक्षसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhā hi kāvyā yuvaṃ dakṣasya pūrbhiradbhutā | ni ketunā janānāṃ cikethe pūtadakṣasā ||

translations.english: Now, adorable and wonderful deities, (propitiated) by the former (praises) of (me, your) worshipper; do you, who are of pure vigour, consider with approving minds (the adoration) of these men.

mantras.sanskrit: तदृतं पृथिवि बृहच्छ्रवएष ऋषीणाम् । ज्रयसानावरं पृथ्वति क्षरन्ति यामभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadṛtaṃ pṛthivi bṛhacchravaeṣa ṛṣīṇām | jrayasānāvaraṃ pṛthvati kṣaranti yāmabhiḥ ||

translations.english: Earth, in you is abundant water for the necessities of the Ṛṣis; the two active (deities) dispense by their movement sufficiently copious (rain).

mantras.sanskrit: आ यद्वामीयचक्षसा मित्र वयं च सूरयः । व्यचिष्ठे बहुपाय्ये यतेमहि स्वराज्ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yadvāmīyacakṣasā mitra vayaṃ ca sūrayaḥ | vyaciṣṭhe bahupāyye yatemahi svarājye ||

translations.english: We and the devout (invoke) you, Mitra and Varuṇa, who are far-seeing; may we proceed to your spacious and much frequented kingdom.

mantras.sanskrit: बळित्था देव निष्कृतमादित्या यजतं बृहत् । वरुण मित्रार्यमन्वर्षिष्ठं क्षत्रमाशाथे ॥
mantras.transliteration: baḷitthā deva niṣkṛtamādityā yajataṃ bṛhat | varuṇa mitrāryamanvarṣiṣṭhaṃ kṣatramāśāthe ||

translations.english: Divine sons of Aditi, Mitra, Varuṇa, Aryaman, verily you are possessed, at the present time, of perfect, adorable, vast, exceeding strength.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यद्योनिं हिरण्ययं वरुण मित्र सदथः । धर्तारा चर्षणीनां यन्तं सुम्नं रिशादसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yadyoniṃ hiraṇyayaṃ varuṇa mitra sadathaḥ | dhartārā carṣaṇīnāṃ yantaṃ sumnaṃ riśādasā ||

translations.english: When you come, Varuṇa and Mitra, to the delightful plural ce of sacrifice, then, supporters of men, destroyers of foes, you bring felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वे हि विश्ववेदसो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । व्रता पदेव सश्चिरे पान्ति मर्त्यं रिषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśve hi viśvavedaso varuṇo mitro aryamā | vratā padeva saścire pānti martyaṃ riṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Mitra, Varuṇa, Aryaman, who are possessed of omniscience, are all associated at our rites, as if in (their respective) station, and protect the worshipper from the malignant.

mantras.sanskrit: ते हि सत्या ऋतस्पृश ऋतावानो जनेजने । सुनीथासः सुदानव्ॐऽहोश्चिदुरुचक्रयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te hi satyā ṛtaspṛśa ṛtāvāno janejane | sunīthāsaḥ sudānavoṃ'hościdurucakrayaḥ ||

translations.english: They verily are observers of truth, distributors of water, protectors of holy rites among men; guides in the right way, liberal donors, and benefactors even of the sinner (who worships them).

mantras.sanskrit: को नु वां मित्रास्तुतो वरुणो वा तनूनाम् । तत्सु वामेषते मतिरत्रिभ्य एषते मतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ko nu vāṃ mitrāstuto varuṇo vā tanūnām | tatsu vāmeṣate matiratribhya eṣate matiḥ ||

translations.english: Which of you, Mitra and Varuṇa, has not been celebrated in (our) praise, for therefore do our thoughts tend towards you; the thoughts of the lineage of Atri tend towards you.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वो मित्राय गायत वरुणाय विपा गिरा । महिक्षत्रावृतं बृहत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vo mitrāya gāyata varuṇāya vipā girā | mahikṣatrāvṛtaṃ bṛhat ||

translations.english: Sing loud with lusty praise to Mitra and Varuṇa; (come), mighty deities, to the great sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: सम्राजा या घृतयोनी मित्रश्चोभा वरुणश्च । देवा देवेषु प्रशस्ता ॥
mantras.transliteration: samrājā yā ghṛtayonī mitraścobhā varuṇaśca | devā deveṣu praśastā ||

translations.english: Mitra and Varuṇa, who are both sovereign rulers, originators of the rain, eminent deities among the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: ता नः शक्तं पार्थिवस्य महो रायो दिव्यस्य । महि वां क्षत्रं देवेषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā naḥ śaktaṃ pārthivasya maho rāyo divyasya | mahi vāṃ kṣatraṃ deveṣu ||

translations.english: They two are able (to grant us) of great terrestrial and celestial riches; great is your might among the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतमृतेन सपन्तेषिरं दक्षमाशाते । अद्रुहा देवौ वर्धेते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtamṛtena sapanteṣiraṃ dakṣamāśāte | adruhā devau vardhete ||

translations.english: Rewarding with rain the holy rite, they favour the zealous worshipper; benevolent deities, may you prosper.

mantras.sanskrit: वृष्टिद्यावा रीत्यापेषस्पती दानुमत्याः । बृहन्तं गर्तमाशाते ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣṭidyāvā rītyāpeṣaspatī dānumatyāḥ | bṛhantaṃ gartamāśāte ||

translations.english: Senders of rain from heaven, granters of desires, lords of sustenance, suited to the liberal donors (of oblations), they ascend their spacious car.

mantras.sanskrit: त्री रोचना वरुण त्रीँरुत द्यून्त्रीणि मित्र धारयथो रजांसि । वावृधानावमतिं क्षत्रियस्यानु व्रतं रक्षमाणावजुर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: trī rocanā varuṇa trī~ruta dyūntrīṇi mitra dhārayatho rajāṃsi | vāvṛdhānāvamatiṃ kṣatriyasyānu vrataṃ rakṣamāṇāvajuryam ||

translations.english: Mitra and Varuṇa, you uphold the three realms of light, the three heavens, the three regions (of the earth), augmenting the force of the vigorous (indra) and protecting the imperishable rite.

mantras.sanskrit: इरावतीर्वरुण धेनवो वां मधुमद्वां सिन्धवो मित्र दुह्रे । त्रयस्तस्थुर्वृषभासस्तिसृणां धिषणानां रेतोधा वि द्युमन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: irāvatīrvaruṇa dhenavo vāṃ madhumadvāṃ sindhavo mitra duhre | trayastasthurvṛṣabhāsastisṛṇāṃ dhiṣaṇānāṃ retodhā vi dyumantaḥ ||

translations.english: Mitra and Varuṇa, the cows are full o fmilk through your (command), and the rivers yield through your (will) sweet water; through you the three radiant receptacles and showerers of rain stand severally in their three spheres.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रातर्देवीमदितिं जोहवीमि मध्यंदिन उदिता सूर्यस्य । राये मित्रावरुणा सर्वतातेळे तोकाय तनयाय शं योः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prātardevīmaditiṃ johavīmi madhyaṃdina uditā sūryasya | rāye mitrāvaruṇā sarvatāteḷe tokāya tanayāya śaṃ yoḥ ||

translations.english: I invoke the divine and bright Aditi at dawn, and at mid-day, when the sun is high; I worship you, Mitra and Varuṇa, at all seasons, for the sake of riches, for sons and grandsons, for prosperity and happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: या धर्तारा रजसो रोचनस्योतादित्या दिव्या पार्थिवस्य । न वां देवा अमृता आ मिनन्ति व्रतानि मित्रावरुणा ध्रुवाणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā dhartārā rajaso rocanasyotādityā divyā pārthivasya | na vāṃ devā amṛtā ā minanti vratāni mitrāvaruṇā dhruvāṇi ||

translations.english: I worship you two, divine Ādityas, who are upholders of the celestial and terrestrial worlds; the immortal gods impair not, Mitra and Varuṇa, your eternal works.

mantras.sanskrit: पुरूरुणा चिद्ध्यस्त्यवो नूनं वां वरुण । मित्र वंसि वां सुमतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: purūruṇā ciddhyastyavo nūnaṃ vāṃ varuṇa | mitra vaṃsi vāṃ sumatim ||

translations.english: May I, Mitra and Varuṇa, enjoy your favour through which there is assuredly protection.

mantras.sanskrit: ता वां सम्यगद्रुह्वाणेषमश्याम धायसे । वयं ते रुद्रा स्याम ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā vāṃ samyagadruhvāṇeṣamaśyāma dhāyase | vayaṃ te rudrā syāma ||

translations.english: Benignant (deities), may we obtain from you, (who are) such (deities), food for our sustenance; may we Rudras, be yours.

mantras.sanskrit: पातं नो रुद्रा पायुभिरुत त्रायेथां सुत्रात्रा । तुर्याम दस्यून्तनूभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pātaṃ no rudrā pāyubhiruta trāyethāṃ sutrātrā | turyāma dasyūntanūbhiḥ ||

translations.english: Protect us with your protections; preserve us with kind preservation; may we, with our descendants, overcome the Dasyus.

mantras.sanskrit: मा कस्याद्भुतक्रतू यक्षं भुजेमा तनूभिः । मा शेषसा मा तनसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā kasyādbhutakratū yakṣaṃ bhujemā tanūbhiḥ | mā śeṣasā mā tanasā ||

translations.english: Workers of wondrous deeds, let us not depend upon the bounty of any other (than you), either in our person ns, or with our sons and grandsons.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो गन्तं रिशादसा वरुण मित्र बर्हणा । उपेमं चारुमध्वरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no gantaṃ riśādasā varuṇa mitra barhaṇā | upemaṃ cārumadhvaram ||

translations.english: Mitra and Varuṇa, scatterers of foes, destroyers of enemies, come to this our accessible sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वस्य हि प्रचेतसा वरुण मित्र राजथः । ईशाना पिप्यतं धियः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvasya hi pracetasā varuṇa mitra rājathaḥ | īśānā pipyataṃ dhiyaḥ ||

translations.english: Sagacious Mitra and Varuṇa, you reign over all bestow fullness, lords, upon our ancient rites.

mantras.sanskrit: उप नः सुतमा गतं वरुण मित्र दाशुषः । अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa naḥ sutamā gataṃ varuṇa mitra dāśuṣaḥ | asya somasya pītaye ||

translations.english: Come, Mitra and Varuṇa, to our effused libation to drink of the Soma of the offerer.

mantras.sanskrit: आ मित्रे वरुणे वयं गीर्भिर्जुहुमो अत्रिवत् । नि बर्हिषि सदतं सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā mitre varuṇe vayaṃ gīrbhirjuhumo atrivat | ni barhiṣi sadataṃ somapītaye ||

translations.english: We invoke Mitra and Varuṇa with hymns, like (our progenitor) Atri; do you sit down upon the sacred grass to drink the Soma libation.

mantras.sanskrit: व्रतेन स्थो ध्रुवक्षेमा धर्मणा यातयज्जना । नि बर्हिषि सदतं सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: vratena stho dhruvakṣemā dharmaṇā yātayajjanā | ni barhiṣi sadataṃ somapītaye ||

translations.english: Steady are you in your functions, whom men animate by (their) devotion; come and sit down upon the sacred grass to drink the Soma libation.

mantras.sanskrit: मित्रश्च नो वरुणश्च जुषेतां यज्ञमिष्टये । नि बर्हिषि सदतां सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: mitraśca no varuṇaśca juṣetāṃ yajñamiṣṭaye | ni barhiṣi sadatāṃ somapītaye ||

translations.english: May Mitra and Varuṇa, accept wiht satisfaction our sacrifice; come and sit down upon the sacred grass to drink the Soma libation.

mantras.sanskrit: यदद्य स्थः परावति यदर्वावत्यश्विना । यद्वा पुरू पुरुभुजा यदन्तरिक्ष आ गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadadya sthaḥ parāvati yadarvāvatyaśvinā | yadvā purū purubhujā yadantarikṣa ā gatam ||

translations.english: Whether, Aśvins, you are at present far, whether you are nigh, whether you are (straying) many plural ces, or whether you are in mid-air, do you, who partake of many offerings, come hither.

mantras.sanskrit: इह त्या पुरुभूतमा पुरू दंसांसि बिभ्रता । वरस्या याम्यध्रिगू हुवे तुविष्टमा भुजे ॥
mantras.transliteration: iha tyā purubhūtamā purū daṃsāṃsi bibhratā | varasyā yāmyadhrigū huve tuviṣṭamā bhuje ||

translations.english: I approach you (to invite you) hither, you who are the encouragers of many; (who are) the achievers of many (great) exploits, most excellent and irresistible, I invoke you, who are most mighty, for protection.

mantras.sanskrit: ईर्मान्यद्वपुषे वपुश्चक्रं रथस्य येमथुः । पर्यन्या नाहुषा युगा मह्ना रजांसि दीयथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: īrmānyadvapuṣe vapuścakraṃ rathasya yemathuḥ | paryanyā nāhuṣā yugā mahnā rajāṃsi dīyathaḥ ||

translations.english: You hae arrested one luminous wheel of (your) car for illumining the form (of the sun), while with the other you traverse the spheres (to regulate) by your power the ages of mankind.

mantras.sanskrit: तदू षु वामेना कृतं विश्वा यद्वामनु ष्टवे । नाना जातावरेपसा समस्मे बन्धुमेयथुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadū ṣu vāmenā kṛtaṃ viśvā yadvāmanu ṣṭave | nānā jātāvarepasā samasme bandhumeyathuḥ ||

translations.english: May the praise, universal (deities), wherewith I laud you, be agreeable to you, as offered by this (your worshipper); and do yo, who are severally born, and free from blame bestow upon us food.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यद्वां सूर्या रथं तिष्ठद्रघुष्यदं सदा । परि वामरुषा वयो घृणा वरन्त आतपः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yadvāṃ sūryā rathaṃ tiṣṭhadraghuṣyadaṃ sadā | pari vāmaruṣā vayo ghṛṇā varanta ātapaḥ ||

translations.english: When Sūrya has ascended your ever easy-moving car, then bright-waving, resplendent rays (of light) encompass you.

mantras.sanskrit: युवोरत्रिश्चिकेतति नरा सुम्नेन चेतसा । घर्मं यद्वामरेपसं नासत्यास्ना भुरण्यति ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvoratriściketati narā sumnena cetasā | gharmaṃ yadvāmarepasaṃ nāsatyāsnā bhuraṇyati ||

translations.english: Leaders (of rites), Atri recognized (your benevolence) with (a grateful) mind on account of the relief (you afforded him), when, Nāsatyās, through his praise of you, he found the (fiery) heat innocuous.

mantras.sanskrit: उग्रो वां ककुहो ययिः शृण्वे यामेषु संतनिः । यद्वां दंसोभिरश्विनात्रिर्नराववर्तति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ugro vāṃ kakuho yayiḥ śṛṇve yāmeṣu saṃtaniḥ | yadvāṃ daṃsobhiraśvinātrirnarāvavartati ||

translations.english: Your strong, lofty, moving, ever-progressing (ear) has been renowned at sacrifices ever since; Aśvins, leaders (of rites), Atri was rescued by your acts.

mantras.sanskrit: मध्व ऊ षु मधूयुवा रुद्रा सिषक्ति पिप्युषी । यत्समुद्राति पर्षथः पक्वाः पृक्षो भरन्त वाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: madhva ū ṣu madhūyuvā rudrā siṣakti pipyuṣī | yatsamudrāti parṣathaḥ pakvāḥ pṛkṣo bharanta vām ||

translations.english: Mixers of the Soma juice, Rudras, (our) nutritious (adoration) bedews you will with the libation, when you traverse (the limits) of the firmament, and the prepared viands (of the sacrifice) support you.

mantras.sanskrit: सत्यमिद्वा उ अश्विना युवामाहुर्मयोभुवा । ता यामन्यामहूतमा यामन्ना मृळयत्तमा ॥
mantras.transliteration: satyamidvā u aśvinā yuvāmāhurmayobhuvā | tā yāmanyāmahūtamā yāmannā mṛḷayattamā ||

translations.english: Truly have they called you, Aśvins, the bestowers of felicity; such may you be when earnestly invoked to our sacrifice; bountiful bestowers of felicity at our sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: इमा ब्रह्माणि वर्धनाश्विभ्यां सन्तु शंतमा । या तक्षाम रथाँ इवावोचाम बृहन्नमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imā brahmāṇi vardhanāśvibhyāṃ santu śaṃtamā | yā takṣāma rathā~ ivāvocāma bṛhannamaḥ ||

translations.english: May these praises exalting the Aśvins be productive of happiness, the praise that we fabricate as (a wheelwright) a car; we proclaim aloud fervent adoration.

mantras.sanskrit: कूष्ठो देवावश्विनाद्या दिवो मनावसू । तच्छ्रवथो वृषण्वसू अत्रिर्वामा विवासति ॥
mantras.transliteration: kūṣṭho devāvaśvinādyā divo manāvasū | tacchravatho vṛṣaṇvasū atrirvāmā vivāsati ||

translations.english: Divine Ādityas, affluent in praise, descended this day from heaven upon the earth, hear that (laudation), which, liberal showerers (of benefits), Atri ever address to you.

mantras.sanskrit: कुह त्या कुह नु श्रुता दिवि देवा नासत्या । कस्मिन्ना यतथो जने को वां नदीनां सचा ॥
mantras.transliteration: kuha tyā kuha nu śrutā divi devā nāsatyā | kasminnā yatatho jane ko vāṃ nadīnāṃ sacā ||

translations.english: The divine Nāsatyās, where are they? where are they heard if in heaven? to what worshipper do you come? who may be the associate of your praises?

mantras.sanskrit: कं याथः कं ह गच्छथः कमच्छा युञ्जाथे रथम् । कस्य ब्रह्माणि रण्यथो वयं वामुश्मसीष्टये ॥
mantras.transliteration: kaṃ yāthaḥ kaṃ ha gacchathaḥ kamacchā yuñjāthe ratham | kasya brahmāṇi raṇyatho vayaṃ vāmuśmasīṣṭaye ||

translations.english: To whom do you proceed? to whom do you repair? to (go to) whose presence do you harness your car? by whose prayers are you gratified? We are anxious for your arrival.

mantras.sanskrit: पौरं चिद्ध्युदप्रुतं पौर पौराय जिन्वथः । यदीं गृभीततातये सिंहमिव द्रुहस्पदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pauraṃ ciddhyudaprutaṃ paura paurāya jinvathaḥ | yadīṃ gṛbhītatātaye siṃhamiva druhaspade ||

translations.english: Pauras, send to Paura the rain-shedding cloud drive it to him who is engaged in sacrifice, as (hunters chase) a lion in a forest.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र च्यवानाज्जुजुरुषो वव्रिमत्कं न मुञ्चथः । युवा यदी कृथः पुनरा काममृण्वे वध्वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra cyavānājjujuruṣo vavrimatkaṃ na muñcathaḥ | yuvā yadī kṛthaḥ punarā kāmamṛṇve vadhvaḥ ||

translations.english: You stripped off (his aged form) like a cuirass ffrom the decrepit Cyavāna, so that, when you had rendered him again a youth, he attracted the desires of women.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्ति हि वामिह स्तोता स्मसि वां संदृशि श्रिये । नू श्रुतं म आ गतमवोभिर्वाजिनीवसू ॥
mantras.transliteration: asti hi vāmiha stotā smasi vāṃ saṃdṛśi śriye | nū śrutaṃ ma ā gatamavobhirvājinīvasū ||

translations.english: A glorifier of you both is here; may we be (retained) in your sight for the sake of prosperity; hear today (my invocation); come hither with your protections, you who are affluent in food.

mantras.sanskrit: को वामद्य पुरूणामा वव्ने मर्त्यानाम् । को विप्रो विप्रवाहसा को यज्ञैर्वाजिनीवसू ॥
mantras.transliteration: ko vāmadya purūṇāmā vavne martyānām | ko vipro vipravāhasā ko yajñairvājinīvasū ||

translations.english: Who among many mortals has this day (best) propitiated you? what wise man (has best propitiated you) who are reverenced by the wise? what (worshipper has best propitiated you) by sacrifice, you who are affluent in food?

mantras.sanskrit: आ वां रथो रथानां येष्ठो यात्वश्विना । पुरू चिदस्मयुस्तिर आङ्गूषो मर्त्येष्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāṃ ratho rathānāṃ yeṣṭho yātvaśvinā | purū cidasmayustira āṅgūṣo martyeṣvā ||

translations.english: May your car, Aśvins, the swiftest of the cars (of the gods), come hither well-disposed towards us, the discomfiter of numerous (foes), glorified among men.

mantras.sanskrit: शमू षु वां मधूयुवास्माकमस्तु चर्कृतिः । अर्वाचीना विचेतसा विभिः श्येनेव दीयतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śamū ṣu vāṃ madhūyuvāsmākamastu carkṛtiḥ | arvācīnā vicetasā vibhiḥ śyeneva dīyatam ||

translations.english: May our repeated adoration of you two, who are desirous of the libation, be productive of felicity; descending to our presence, and exceeding in wisdom, travel with rapid (steeds), swift as two falcons.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्विना यद्ध कर्हि चिच्छुश्रूयातमिमं हवम् । वस्वीरू षु वां भुजः पृञ्चन्ति सु वां पृचः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvinā yaddha karhi cicchuśrūyātamimaṃ havam | vasvīrū ṣu vāṃ bhujaḥ pṛñcanti su vāṃ pṛcaḥ ||

translations.english: Aśvins, wherever you may be, hear this invocation; the excellent sacrificial offerings, longing for your proximity, reach you.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रति प्रियतमं रथं वृषणं वसुवाहनम् । स्तोता वामश्विनावृषिः स्तोमेन प्रति भूषति माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: prati priyatamaṃ rathaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vasuvāhanam | stotā vāmaśvināvṛṣiḥ stomena prati bhūṣati mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||

translations.english: The ṛṣi, your worshipper, Aśvins, graces your beloved chariot, the showerer (of benefits), the vehicle of wealth, with praises; masters of mystic lore, hear my invocation.

mantras.sanskrit: अत्यायातमश्विना तिरो विश्वा अहं सना । दस्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी सुषुम्ना सिन्धुवाहसा माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: atyāyātamaśvinā tiro viśvā ahaṃ sanā | dasrā hiraṇyavartanī suṣumnā sindhuvāhasā mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||

translations.english: Passing by (other worshippers), come, Aśvins, hither, so that I may ever overcome all (adversaries); Dasras, riding in a golden chariot distributors of wealth, propellers of rivers, masters of mystic lore, hear my invocation.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो रत्नानि बिभ्रतावश्विना गच्छतं युवम् । रुद्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी जुषाणा वाजिनीवसू माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no ratnāni bibhratāvaśvinā gacchataṃ yuvam | rudrā hiraṇyavartanī juṣāṇā vājinīvasū mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||

translations.english: Come, Aśvins, bring for us precious treasures; Rudras, riding in a golden chariot, propitiated (by sacrifice), affluent with food, masters of mystic lore, hear my invocatioṇ

mantras.sanskrit: सुष्टुभो वां वृषण्वसू रथे वाणीच्याहिता । उत वां ककुहो मृगः पृक्षः कृणोति वापुषो माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: suṣṭubho vāṃ vṛṣaṇvasū rathe vāṇīcyāhitā | uta vāṃ kakuho mṛgaḥ pṛkṣaḥ kṛṇoti vāpuṣo mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||

translations.english: Showerer of wealth, the praise of your worshipper is addressed to your chariot; (to it), as well as to you, does this distinguished, devoted, embodied (adorer) offer sacrificial food; masters of mystic lore, hear my invocation.

mantras.sanskrit: बोधिन्मनसा रथ्येषिरा हवनश्रुता । विभिश्च्यवानमश्विना नि याथो अद्वयाविनं माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: bodhinmanasā rathyeṣirā havanaśrutā | vibhiścyavānamaśvinā ni yātho advayāvinaṃ mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||

translations.english: With mind attentive (to praise), riding in cars, swift-moving, listening to invocations, you hastened with your steeds to the single-purposed cyavana; masters of mystic lore, hear my invocation.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वां नरा मनोयुजोऽश्वासः प्रुषितप्सवः । वयो वहन्तु पीतये सह सुम्नेभिरश्विना माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāṃ narā manoyujo'śvāsaḥ pruṣitapsavaḥ | vayo vahantu pītaye saha sumnebhiraśvinā mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||

translations.english: Aśvins, leaders (of rites), may your horses, harnessed at will, of wondrous beauty, and of rapid course, bring you hither with good gifts to drink (of the proffered beverage); masters of mystic lore,hear my invocation.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्विनावेह गच्छतं नासत्या मा वि वेनतम् । तिरश्चिदर्यया परि वर्तिर्यातमदाभ्या माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvināveha gacchataṃ nāsatyā mā vi venatam | tiraścidaryayā pari vartiryātamadābhyā mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||

translations.english: Aśvins, come hither; Nāsatyas, be not unpropitious; invincible lords, come from hidden (regions) to our sacrificial hall; maste of mystic lore, hear my invocation.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मिन्यज्ञे अदाभ्या जरितारं शुभस्पती । अवस्युमश्विना युवं गृणन्तमुप भूषथो माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asminyajñe adābhyā jaritāraṃ śubhaspatī | avasyumaśvinā yuvaṃ gṛṇantamupa bhūṣatho mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||

translations.english: Invincible Aśvins, lords of water, favour Avasyu, glorifying you at this sacrifice; masters of mystic lore, hear my invocation.

mantras.sanskrit: अभूदुषा रुशत्पशुराग्निरधाय्यृत्वियः । अयोजि वां वृषण्वसू रथो दस्रावमर्त्यो माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhūduṣā ruśatpaśurāgniradhāyyṛtviyaḥ | ayoji vāṃ vṛṣaṇvasū ratho dasrāvamartyo mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||

translations.english: The dawn has come; the Agni of the season, blazing with the oblation has been plural ced (upon the altar); showerers of wealth, subduers of foes, your immortal chariot has been harnessed; masters of mystic lore, hear my invocation.

mantras.sanskrit: आ भात्यग्निरुषसामनीकमुद्विप्राणां देवया वाचो अस्थुः । अर्वाञ्चा नूनं रथ्येह यातं पीपिवांसमश्विना घर्ममच्छ ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā bhātyagniruṣasāmanīkamudviprāṇāṃ devayā vāco asthuḥ | arvāñcā nūnaṃ rathyeha yātaṃ pīpivāṃsamaśvinā gharmamaccha ||

translations.english: Agni light sup the face of the dawns; the devout praisers of the pious have risen up; therefore, Aśvins, lords of the chariot, descending, come hither today to the splendid sacrifice, perfect (in all its parts).

mantras.sanskrit: न संस्कृतं प्र मिमीतो गमिष्ठान्ति नूनमश्विनोपस्तुतेह । दिवाभिपित्वेऽवसागमिष्ठा प्रत्यवर्तिं दाशुषे शम्भविष्ठा ॥
mantras.transliteration: na saṃskṛtaṃ pra mimīto gamiṣṭhānti nūnamaśvinopastuteha | divābhipitve'vasāgamiṣṭhā pratyavartiṃ dāśuṣe śambhaviṣṭhā ||

translations.english: Harm not, Aśvins, the perfected (rite), but coming now most quickly, be glorified on this occasion; be present at the opening of the ay, with proection against destitution, and be prompt to bestow happiness upon the donor (of the offering).

mantras.sanskrit: उता यातं संगवे प्रातरह्नो मध्यंदिन उदिता सूर्यस्य । दिवा नक्तमवसा शंतमेन नेदानीं पीतिरश्विना ततान ॥
mantras.transliteration: utā yātaṃ saṃgave prātarahno madhyaṃdina uditā sūryasya | divā naktamavasā śaṃtamena nedānīṃ pītiraśvinā tatāna ||

translations.english: Whether you come at the (milking time) of the cattle, at the dawn of day, at noon, when the sun is high, or by day or by night, (come) with felicitious protection; the drinking of the Soma has not now extended beyond the Aśvins. (whether you come: the day is divisible into two, three, five or fifteen parts; here the five-fold distinction is alluded to: uditā sūryasya = the afternoon, atyanta pravṛddha samayaḥ aparāhṇa ityarthaḥ; the drinking of the soma...Aśvins: nedānīm pītir aśvinā tatāna: legend-- the other gods refused to admit the participation of the Aśvins in the Soma libation at these hours, but on the present occasion they are not passed over; idānim api itaradevānām pānam na tanotyaśvinau vihāya, but now the drinking of the other gods does not extend, having omitted the two Aśvins]

mantras.sanskrit: इदं हि वां प्रदिवि स्थानमोक इमे गृहा अश्विनेदं दुरोणम् । आ नो दिवो बृहतः पर्वतादाद्भ्यो यातमिषमूर्जं वहन्ता ॥
mantras.transliteration: idaṃ hi vāṃ pradivi sthānamoka ime gṛhā aśvinedaṃ duroṇam | ā no divo bṛhataḥ parvatādādbhyo yātamiṣamūrjaṃ vahantā ||

translations.english: This station, Aśvins, is your ancient abode; these are your mansions, this your dwelling; come from the vast firmament, (verspread) by clouds (filled) with water, bringing strength.

mantras.sanskrit: समश्विनोरवसा नूतनेन मयोभुवा सुप्रणीती गमेम । आ नो रयिं वहतमोत वीराना विश्वान्यमृता सौभगानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: samaśvinoravasā nūtanena mayobhuvā supraṇītī gamema | ā no rayiṃ vahatamota vīrānā viśvānyamṛtā saubhagāni ||

translations.english: May we be united with the Aśvins by their special protection, which is the source of happiness and guide to good; bestow upon us, immortals, wealth and posterity; and all good things.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रातर्यावाणा प्रथमा यजध्वं पुरा गृध्रादररुषः पिबातः । प्रातर्हि यज्ञमश्विना दधाते प्र शंसन्ति कवयः पूर्वभाजः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prātaryāvāṇā prathamā yajadhvaṃ purā gṛdhrādararuṣaḥ pibātaḥ | prātarhi yajñamaśvinā dadhāte pra śaṃsanti kavayaḥ pūrvabhājaḥ ||

translations.english: Worship the two who come first (of the gods) at dawn; let them drink before the greedy withholders (of the offering); for the Aśvins verily claim the morning sacrifice; the ardent sages praised them (at dawn).

mantras.sanskrit: प्रातर्यजध्वमश्विना हिनोत न सायमस्ति देवया अजुष्टम् । उतान्यो अस्मद्यजते वि चावः पूर्वःपूर्वो यजमानो वनीयान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: prātaryajadhvamaśvinā hinota na sāyamasti devayā ajuṣṭam | utānyo asmadyajate vi cāvaḥ pūrvaḥpūrvo yajamāno vanīyān ||

translations.english: WOrship the Aśvins at early dawn; offer their oblations; the evening is not for the gods; it is unacceptable to them; and whether it be any other than ourselves who worship them or propitiates them, the worshipper who is foremost (in his devotion) is the most approved of.

mantras.sanskrit: हिरण्यत्वङ्मधुवर्णो घृतस्नुः पृक्षो वहन्ना रथो वर्तते वाम् । मनोजवा अश्विना वातरंहा येनातियाथो दुरितानि विश्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: hiraṇyatvaṅmadhuvarṇo ghṛtasnuḥ pṛkṣo vahannā ratho vartate vām | manojavā aśvinā vātaraṃhā yenātiyātho duritāni viśvā ||

translations.english: Your car, Aśvins, approaches, coated with gold, honey-tinted, water-shedding, laden with ambrosia, as quick as thought, as rapid as the wind, wherewith you pass over all obstacles.

mantras.sanskrit: यो भूयिष्ठं नासत्याभ्यां विवेष चनिष्ठं पित्वो ररते विभागे । स तोकमस्य पीपरच्छमीभिरनूर्ध्वभासः सदमित्तुतुर्यात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo bhūyiṣṭhaṃ nāsatyābhyāṃ viveṣa caniṣṭhaṃ pitvo rarate vibhāge | sa tokamasya pīparacchamībhiranūrdhvabhāsaḥ sadamittuturyāt ||

translations.english: He who, in the appointment (of the offerings), presents to the Nāsatyas the most ample (share) of (the sacrificial) food, who gives (them) the largest portion of the viands, secures, by his acts, the welfare of his son, and ever has the advantage of those who light no sacred fires.

mantras.sanskrit: समश्विनोरवसा नूतनेन मयोभुवा सुप्रणीती गमेम । आ नो रयिं वहतमोत वीराना विश्वान्यमृता सौभगानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: samaśvinoravasā nūtanena mayobhuvā supraṇītī gamema | ā no rayiṃ vahatamota vīrānā viśvānyamṛtā saubhagāni ||

translations.english: May we be united with the Aśvins, by their special protection, which is the source of happiness, the guide to good; bestow upon us, immortals, wealth and all good things.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्विनावेह गच्छतं नासत्या मा वि वेनतम् । हंसाविव पततमा सुताँ उप ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvināveha gacchataṃ nāsatyā mā vi venatam | haṃsāviva patatamā sutā~ upa ||

translations.english: Aśvins, come hither; Nāsatyas, be not ill-disposed; alight like two swans upon the effused libations.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्विना हरिणाविव गौराविवानु यवसम् । हंसाविव पततमा सुताँ उप ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvinā hariṇāviva gaurāvivānu yavasam | haṃsāviva patatamā sutā~ upa ||

translations.english: Like two deer, Aśvins, like two wild cattle on (fresh) pasture; like two swans alight upon the effused libation.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्विना वाजिनीवसू जुषेथां यज्ञमिष्टये । हंसाविव पततमा सुताँ उप ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvinā vājinīvasū juṣethāṃ yajñamiṣṭaye | haṃsāviva patatamā sutā~ upa ||

translations.english: Aśvins, affluent in food, be propitiated at your plural asure by the sacrifice; alight like two swans uon the effused libation.

mantras.sanskrit: अत्रिर्यद्वामवरोहन्नृबीसमजोहवीन्नाधमानेव योषा । श्येनस्य चिज्जवसा नूतनेनागच्छतमश्विना शंतमेन ॥
mantras.transliteration: atriryadvāmavarohannṛbīsamajohavīnnādhamāneva yoṣā | śyenasya cijjavasā nūtanenāgacchatamaśvinā śaṃtamena ||

translations.english: Inasmuch as Atri, escaping by your aid from the fire of chaff, conciliates you, like a wife soliciting the affection of a husband, therefore come with (your) propitious cars; with the new-born rapidity of the falcon.

mantras.sanskrit: वि जिहीष्व वनस्पते योनिः सूष्यन्त्या इव । श्रुतं मे अश्विना हवं सप्तवध्रिं च मुञ्चतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi jihīṣva vanaspate yoniḥ sūṣyantyā iva | śrutaṃ me aśvinā havaṃ saptavadhriṃ ca muñcatam ||

translations.english: Open, Vanaspati, like the womb of parturient feminine le; hear, Aśvins, my invocation; set Saptavadhri free.

mantras.sanskrit: भीताय नाधमानाय ऋषये सप्तवध्रये । मायाभिरश्विना युवं वृक्षं सं च वि चाचथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhītāya nādhamānāya ṛṣaye saptavadhraye | māyābhiraśvinā yuvaṃ vṛkṣaṃ saṃ ca vi cācathaḥ ||

translations.english: Aśvins, by your devices sunder the wicker-work for (the liberation of the) terrified, imploring Ṛṣi, Saptavadhri.

mantras.sanskrit: यथा वातः पुष्करिणीं समिङ्गयति सर्वतः । एवा ते गर्भ एजतु निरैतु दशमास्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathā vātaḥ puṣkariṇīṃ samiṅgayati sarvataḥ | evā te garbha ejatu niraitu daśamāsyaḥ ||

translations.english: As the wind ruffles the lake on every side, so may your womb be stimulated, and the conception of the months come forth.

mantras.sanskrit: यथा वातो यथा वनं यथा समुद्र एजति । एवा त्वं दशमास्य सहावेहि जरायुणा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathā vāto yathā vanaṃ yathā samudra ejati | evā tvaṃ daśamāsya sahāvehi jarāyuṇā ||

translations.english: As the wind, as the wood, as the ocean are agitated, so do you, gestation of ten months, invested with the uterine membranes, descend.

mantras.sanskrit: दश मासाञ्छशयानः कुमारो अधि मातरि । निरैतु जीवो अक्षतो जीवो जीवन्त्या अधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: daśa māsāñchaśayānaḥ kumāro adhi mātari | niraitu jīvo akṣato jīvo jīvantyā adhi ||

translations.english: May the boy who has reposed for ten months in the bosom of his mother come forth, alive, unharmed, living, from a living (parent).

mantras.sanskrit: महे नो अद्य बोधयोषो राये दिवित्मती । यथा चिन्नो अबोधयः सत्यश्रवसि वाय्ये सुजाते अश्वसूनृते ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahe no adya bodhayoṣo rāye divitmatī | yathā cinno abodhayaḥ satyaśravasi vāyye sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||

translations.english: Radiant Uṣas, wake up today for (the acquisition of) ample riches, in like manner as you have awakened us (of old); bright-born, and praised sincerely for (the gift of) horses, show favour to satyaśravas, the son of Vayya.

mantras.sanskrit: या सुनीथे शौचद्रथे व्यौच्छो दुहितर्दिवः । सा व्युच्छ सहीयसि सत्यश्रवसि वाय्ये सुजाते अश्वसूनृते ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā sunīthe śaucadrathe vyauccho duhitardivaḥ | sā vyuccha sahīyasi satyaśravasi vāyye sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||

translations.english: Daughter of heaven, who have dawned upon Sunitha, the son of Śucadratha, bright-born, and praised sincerely for (the gift of) horses, dawn upon the powerful son of Vayya, Satyaśravas.

mantras.sanskrit: सा नो अद्याभरद्वसुर्व्युच्छा दुहितर्दिवः । यो व्यौच्छः सहीयसि सत्यश्रवसि वाय्ये सुजाते अश्वसूनृते ॥
mantras.transliteration: sā no adyābharadvasurvyucchā duhitardivaḥ | yo vyaucchaḥ sahīyasi satyaśravasi vāyye sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||

translations.english: Daughter of heaven, who are the bringer of opulence, dawn upon us today, as, bright-born, and praised for (the gift of) horses, you have dawned upon the powerful Satyaśravas, the son of Vayya.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि ये त्वा विभावरि स्तोमैर्गृणन्ति वह्नयः । मघैर्मघोनि सुश्रियो दामन्वन्तः सुरातयः सुजाते अश्वसूनृते ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi ye tvā vibhāvari stomairgṛṇanti vahnayaḥ | maghairmaghoni suśriyo dāmanvantaḥ surātayaḥ sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||

translations.english: The offerers of oblations who eulogize you, lustrous Uṣas, with sacred hymns, become prosperous with affluence, (through your favour), bestower of wealth, bright-born goddess, (who are) sincrely praised for (the gift of) horses.

mantras.sanskrit: यच्चिद्धि ते गणा इमे छदयन्ति मघत्तये । परि चिद्वष्टयो दधुर्ददतो राधो अह्रयं सुजाते अश्वसूनृते ॥
mantras.transliteration: yacciddhi te gaṇā ime chadayanti maghattaye | pari cidvaṣṭayo dadhurdadato rādho ahrayaṃ sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||

translations.english: These, your assembled (worshippers), who stand before you to distribute wealth, entertain towards us kindly intentions, offering unlimited riches; bright-born goddess, (who are) sincerely praised for (the gift of) horses.

mantras.sanskrit: ऐषु धा वीरवद्यश उषो मघोनि सूरिषु । ये नो राधांस्यह्रया मघवानो अरासत सुजाते अश्वसूनृते ॥
mantras.transliteration: aiṣu dhā vīravadyaśa uṣo maghoni sūriṣu | ye no rādhāṃsyahrayā maghavāno arāsata sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||

translations.english: Affluent Uṣas, bestow upon these (yor) devout adorers food and posterity, so that, being opulent, they may, without stint, bestow riches upon us; bright-born goddess who are sincerely praised for (the gift of) horses.

mantras.sanskrit: तेभ्यो द्युम्नं बृहद्यश उषो मघोन्या वह । ये नो राधांस्यश्व्या गव्या भजन्त सूरयः सुजाते अश्वसूनृते ॥
mantras.transliteration: tebhyo dyumnaṃ bṛhadyaśa uṣo maghonyā vaha | ye no rādhāṃsyaśvyā gavyā bhajanta sūrayaḥ sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||

translations.english: Affluent Uṣas, bring wealth and abundant food to those who, liberal givers, bestow upon us riches with horses and cattle; bright-born goddess (who are) sincerely prised for (the gift of) horses.

mantras.sanskrit: उत नो गोमतीरिष आ वहा दुहितर्दिवः । साकं सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः शुक्रैः शोचद्भिरर्चिभिः सुजाते अश्वसूनृते ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta no gomatīriṣa ā vahā duhitardivaḥ | sākaṃ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ śukraiḥ śocadbhirarcibhiḥ sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||

translations.english: Daughter of heaven, bring to us food and cattle together with the pure rays of the sun, and the radiant flames (of the kindled fires); bright-born goddess, (who are) sincerely praised for (the gift of) horses.

mantras.sanskrit: व्युच्छा दुहितर्दिवो मा चिरं तनुथा अपः । नेत्त्वा स्तेनं यथा रिपुं तपाति सूरो अर्चिषा सुजाते अश्वसूनृते ॥
mantras.transliteration: vyucchā duhitardivo mā ciraṃ tanuthā apaḥ | nettvā stenaṃ yathā ripuṃ tapāti sūro arciṣā sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||

translations.english: Daughter of heaven, Dawn! delay not our (sacred) rite; let not the sun scorch you with his ray, as (a prince punishes) a thief, or (subdues) an enemy; bright-born goddess,(who are), sincerely praised for (the gift of) horses.

mantras.sanskrit: एतावद्वेदुषस्त्वं भूयो वा दातुमर्हसि । या स्तोतृभ्यो विभावर्युच्छन्ती न प्रमीयसे सुजाते अश्वसूनृते ॥
mantras.transliteration: etāvadveduṣastvaṃ bhūyo vā dātumarhasi | yā stotṛbhyo vibhāvaryucchantī na pramīyase sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||

translations.english: You, Uṣas, are able to give (us) whatever, indeed, (has been solicited), and much (that has not been asked for); for, radiant (divinity), who are dawning upon your adorers, you are never cruel (to them);bright-born goddess (who are) sincerely praised for (the gift of) horses.

mantras.sanskrit: द्युतद्यामानं बृहतीमृतेन ऋतावरीमरुणप्सुं विभातीम् । देवीमुषसं स्वरावहन्तीं प्रति विप्रासो मतिभिर्जरन्ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: dyutadyāmānaṃ bṛhatīmṛtena ṛtāvarīmaruṇapsuṃ vibhātīm | devīmuṣasaṃ svarāvahantīṃ prati viprāso matibhirjarante ||

translations.english: The wise priests celebrate with hymns the divine, bright-chariot, expanded Dawn; worshipped with holy worship, purple-tinted, radiant, leading on the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: एषा जनं दर्शता बोधयन्ती सुगान्पथः कृण्वती यात्यग्रे । बृहद्रथा बृहती विश्वमिन्वोषा ज्योतिर्यच्छत्यग्रे अह्नाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣā janaṃ darśatā bodhayantī sugānpathaḥ kṛṇvatī yātyagre | bṛhadrathā bṛhatī viśvaminvoṣā jyotiryacchatyagre ahnām ||

translations.english: The lovely Dawn, arousing man, goes before (the sun) preparing practicable paths, riding in a spacious chariot; vast, expanding everywhere, she diffuses light at the commencement of the days.

mantras.sanskrit: एषा गोभिररुणेभिर्युजानास्रेधन्ती रयिमप्रायु चक्रे । पथो रदन्ती सुविताय देवी पुरुष्टुता विश्ववारा वि भाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣā gobhiraruṇebhiryujānāsredhantī rayimaprāyu cakre | patho radantī suvitāya devī puruṣṭutā viśvavārā vi bhāti ||

translations.english: Harnessing the purple oxen to her car, unwearied she renders riches perpetual; a goddess, praised of many, and cherished by all, she shines, manifesting the paths that lead to good.

mantras.sanskrit: एषा व्येनी भवति द्विबर्हा आविष्कृण्वाना तन्वं पुरस्तात् । ऋतस्य पन्थामन्वेति साधु प्रजानतीव न दिशो मिनाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣā vyenī bhavati dvibarhā āviṣkṛṇvānā tanvaṃ purastāt | ṛtasya panthāmanveti sādhu prajānatīva na diśo mināti ||

translations.english: Lucidly white is she, occupying the two (regions, the upper and middle firmament), and manifesting her person n from the east; she traverses the path of the sun as if knowing (his course), and harms not the quarters of the horizon.

mantras.sanskrit: एषा शुभ्रा न तन्वो विदानोर्ध्वेव स्नाती दृशये नो अस्थात् । अप द्वेषो बाधमाना तमांस्युषा दिवो दुहिता ज्योतिषागात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣā śubhrā na tanvo vidānordhveva snātī dṛśaye no asthāt | apa dveṣo bādhamānā tamāṃsyuṣā divo duhitā jyotiṣāgāt ||

translations.english: exhibiting her person n like a well-attired feminine le, she stands before our eyes, (gracefully) inclining like (a woman who has been) bathing; dispersing the hostile glooms, Uṣas, the daughter of heaven, comes with radiance.

mantras.sanskrit: एषा प्रतीची दुहिता दिवो नॄन्योषेव भद्रा नि रिणीते अप्सः । व्यूर्ण्वती दाशुषे वार्याणि पुनर्ज्योतिर्युवतिः पूर्वथाकः ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣā pratīcī duhitā divo nṝnyoṣeva bhadrā ni riṇīte apsaḥ | vyūrṇvatī dāśuṣe vāryāṇi punarjyotiryuvatiḥ pūrvathākaḥ ||

translations.english: Uṣas, the daughter of heaven, tending to the west puts forth her beauty like a (well-dressed) woman, bestowing precious treasures upon the offerer of adoration; she, ever youthful, brings back the light as (she has done) of old.

mantras.sanskrit: युञ्जते मन उत युञ्जते धियो विप्रा विप्रस्य बृहतो विपश्चितः । वि होत्रा दधे वयुनाविदेक इन्मही देवस्य सवितुः परिष्टुतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuñjate mana uta yuñjate dhiyo viprā viprasya bṛhato vipaścitaḥ | vi hotrā dadhe vayunāvideka inmahī devasya savituḥ pariṣṭutiḥ ||

translations.english: The wise apply their minds; they perform sacred rites for the propitiation of the intelligent, great, adorable Savitā; he alone, knowing their functions, directs the priests; verily, great is the praise of the divine Savitā.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वा रूपाणि प्रति मुञ्चते कविः प्रासावीद्भद्रं द्विपदे चतुष्पदे । वि नाकमख्यत्सविता वरेण्योऽनु प्रयाणमुषसो वि राजति ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvā rūpāṇi prati muñcate kaviḥ prāsāvīdbhadraṃ dvipade catuṣpade | vi nākamakhyatsavitā vareṇyo'nu prayāṇamuṣaso vi rājati ||

translations.english: The wise Savitā comprehends all forms (in himself); he has engendered what is good for biped and quadruped; the adorable Savitā has illumed the heaven, and shines in sequence to the passage of the Dawn.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य प्रयाणमन्वन्य इद्ययुर्देवा देवस्य महिमानमोजसा । यः पार्थिवानि विममे स एतशो रजांसि देवः सविता महित्वना ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya prayāṇamanvanya idyayurdevā devasya mahimānamojasā | yaḥ pārthivāni vimame sa etaśo rajāṃsi devaḥ savitā mahitvanā ||

translations.english: After the passage of which divine (being) the other deities proceed to (obtain) majesty with power; he who by his greatness has measured out the terrestrial regions the divine Savitā, (is) resplendent.

mantras.sanskrit: उत यासि सवितस्त्रीणि रोचनोत सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः समुच्यसि । उत रात्रीमुभयतः परीयस उत मित्रो भवसि देव धर्मभिः ॥
