mantras.transliteration: uta yāsi savitastrīṇi rocanota sūryasya raśmibhiḥ samucyasi | uta rātrīmubhayataḥ parīyasa uta mitro bhavasi deva dharmabhiḥ ||

translations.english: eithe ryou traverse, Savitā, the three regions, or combine with the rays of Sūrya; or you pass between the night on either hand; or you, divine Savitā are Mitra, through your (benevolent) functions.

mantras.sanskrit: उतेशिषे प्रसवस्य त्वमेक इदुत पूषा भवसि देव यामभिः । उतेदं विश्वं भुवनं वि राजसि श्यावाश्वस्ते सवित स्तोममानशे ॥
mantras.transliteration: uteśiṣe prasavasya tvameka iduta pūṣā bhavasi deva yāmabhiḥ | utedaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ vi rājasi śyāvāśvaste savita stomamānaśe ||

translations.english: You alone rule over (the actions of) living beings; you are Pūṣan, divine (Savitā), by the movements; you are soverign over the whole world; Śyāvāśva offers praise, Savitā, to you.

mantras.sanskrit: तत्सवितुर्वृणीमहे वयं देवस्य भोजनम् । श्रेष्ठं सर्वधातमं तुरं भगस्य धीमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tatsaviturvṛṇīmahe vayaṃ devasya bhojanam | śreṣṭhaṃ sarvadhātamaṃ turaṃ bhagasya dhīmahi ||

translations.english: We solicit of the divine Savitā enjoyable (wealth) may we receive from Bhaga that which is excellent, all sustaining, destructive of foes.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य हि स्वयशस्तरं सवितुः कच्चन प्रियम् । न मिनन्ति स्वराज्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya hi svayaśastaraṃ savituḥ kaccana priyam | na minanti svarājyam ||

translations.english: Nothing impairs the sovereignty of this Savitā, which is most especially renowned and beloved.

mantras.sanskrit: स हि रत्नानि दाशुषे सुवाति सविता भगः । तं भागं चित्रमीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa hi ratnāni dāśuṣe suvāti savitā bhagaḥ | taṃ bhāgaṃ citramīmahe ||

translations.english: That Savitā who is Bhaga, bestows precious treasure on the donor of the offering; we solicit (of him) a valuable portion.

mantras.sanskrit: अद्या नो देव सवितः प्रजावत्सावीः सौभगम् । परा दुष्ष्वप्न्यं सुव ॥
mantras.transliteration: adyā no deva savitaḥ prajāvatsāvīḥ saubhagam | parā duṣṣvapnyaṃ suva ||

translations.english: Grant us today, divine Savitā affluence with progeny, and drive away evil dreams.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वानि देव सवितर्दुरितानि परा सुव । यद्भद्रं तन्न आ सुव ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvāni deva savitarduritāni parā suva | yadbhadraṃ tanna ā suva ||

translations.english: Remove from us, divine Savitā, all misfortunes; bestow upon us that which is good,

mantras.sanskrit: अनागसो अदितये देवस्य सवितुः सवे । विश्वा वामानि धीमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: anāgaso aditaye devasya savituḥ save | viśvā vāmāni dhīmahi ||

translations.english: Let us be void of offence towards Aditi, according to the will of the divine Savitā; may we be possessed of all-desired (riches).

mantras.sanskrit: आ विश्वदेवं सत्पतिं सूक्तैरद्या वृणीमहे । सत्यसवं सवितारम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā viśvadevaṃ satpatiṃ sūktairadyā vṛṇīmahe | satyasavaṃ savitāram ||

translations.english: We glorify today with hymns Savitā, the protector of the good, the observer of truth (identical with) all the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: य इमे उभे अहनी पुर एत्यप्रयुच्छन् । स्वाधीर्देवः सविता ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya ime ubhe ahanī pura etyaprayucchan | svādhīrdevaḥ savitā ||

translations.english: The divine object of meditation, Savitā, who ever vigilant, precedes both night and day.

mantras.sanskrit: य इमा विश्वा जातान्याश्रावयति श्लोकेन । प्र च सुवाति सविता ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya imā viśvā jātānyāśrāvayati ślokena | pra ca suvāti savitā ||

translations.english: Savitā, who proclaims his glory to all these living beings, and gives them life.

mantras.sanskrit: अच्छा वद तवसं गीर्भिराभिः स्तुहि पर्जन्यं नमसा विवास । कनिक्रदद्वृषभो जीरदानू रेतो दधात्योषधीषु गर्भम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: acchā vada tavasaṃ gīrbhirābhiḥ stuhi parjanyaṃ namasā vivāsa | kanikradadvṛṣabho jīradānū reto dadhātyoṣadhīṣu garbham ||

translations.english: I address the mighty Parjanya who is present; praise him with these hymns; worship him with reverence, him who is the thunderer, the showerer, the bountiful, who impregnates the plural nts with rain.

mantras.sanskrit: वि वृक्षान्हन्त्युत हन्ति रक्षसो विश्वं बिभाय भुवनं महावधात् । उतानागा ईषते वृष्ण्यावतो यत्पर्जन्यः स्तनयन्हन्ति दुष्कृतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi vṛkṣānhantyuta hanti rakṣaso viśvaṃ bibhāya bhuvanaṃ mahāvadhāt | utānāgā īṣate vṛṣṇyāvato yatparjanyaḥ stanayanhanti duṣkṛtaḥ ||

translations.english: He strikes down the trees, he destroys the rākṣasas, he terrifies the whole world by his mighty weapon; even the innocent man flies from the sender of rain, when Parjanya, thundering, slays the wicked.

mantras.sanskrit: रथीव कशयाश्वाँ अभिक्षिपन्नाविर्दूतान्कृणुते वर्ष्याँ अह । दूरात्सिंहस्य स्तनथा उदीरते यत्पर्जन्यः कृणुते वर्ष्यं नभः ॥
mantras.transliteration: rathīva kaśayāśvā~ abhikṣipannāvirdūtānkṛṇute varṣyā~ aha | dūrātsiṃhasya stanathā udīrate yatparjanyaḥ kṛṇute varṣyaṃ nabhaḥ ||

translations.english: As a charioteer, urging his horses with his whip, brings into view the messenger (of war), so Parjanya, (driving the clouds before him), makes manifest the messengers of the rain; the roaring of the lion-(like cloud) proclaims from afar that Parjanya overspreads the sky with rainy clouds.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वाता वान्ति पतयन्ति विद्युत उदोषधीर्जिहते पिन्वते स्वः । इरा विश्वस्मै भुवनाय जायते यत्पर्जन्यः पृथिवीं रेतसावति ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vātā vānti patayanti vidyuta udoṣadhīrjihate pinvate svaḥ | irā viśvasmai bhuvanāya jāyate yatparjanyaḥ pṛthivīṃ retasāvati ||

translations.english: The winds blow strong, the lightnings flash, the plural nts spring up, the firmament dissolves; earth becomes (fit) for all creatures when Parjanya fertilizes the soil with showers.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य व्रते पृथिवी नन्नमीति यस्य व्रते शफवज्जर्भुरीति । यस्य व्रत ओषधीर्विश्वरूपाः स नः पर्जन्य महि शर्म यच्छ ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya vrate pṛthivī nannamīti yasya vrate śaphavajjarbhurīti | yasya vrata oṣadhīrviśvarūpāḥ sa naḥ parjanya mahi śarma yaccha ||

translations.english: Do you, Parjanya, through whose function the earth is bowed down; through whose function hoofed cattle thrive; through whose function plural nts assume all kinds of forms, grant us great felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवो नो वृष्टिं मरुतो ररीध्वं प्र पिन्वत वृष्णो अश्वस्य धाराः । अर्वाङेतेन स्तनयित्नुनेह्यपो निषिञ्चन्नसुरः पिता नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: divo no vṛṣṭiṃ maruto rarīdhvaṃ pra pinvata vṛṣṇo aśvasya dhārāḥ | arvāṅetena stanayitnunehyapo niṣiñcannasuraḥ pitā naḥ ||

translations.english: Send down for us, Maruts, the rain from heaven; drops of the rainy charger descend; come down Parjanya, sprinkling water by this thundering (cloud); you who are the sender of rain, our protector.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि क्रन्द स्तनय गर्भमा धा उदन्वता परि दीया रथेन । दृतिं सु कर्ष विषितं न्यञ्चं समा भवन्तूद्वतो निपादाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi kranda stanaya garbhamā dhā udanvatā pari dīyā rathena | dṛtiṃ su karṣa viṣitaṃ nyañcaṃ samā bhavantūdvato nipādāḥ ||

translations.english: Cry aloud over (the earth); thunder; impregnate the plural nts; traverse (the sky) with your water-laden chariot, draw open the tight-fastened, downward-turned water bag, and may the high and low plural ces be made level.

mantras.sanskrit: महान्तं कोशमुदचा नि षिञ्च स्यन्दन्तां कुल्या विषिताः पुरस्तात् । घृतेन द्यावापृथिवी व्युन्धि सुप्रपाणं भवत्वघ्न्याभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahāntaṃ kośamudacā ni ṣiñca syandantāṃ kulyā viṣitāḥ purastāt | ghṛtena dyāvāpṛthivī vyundhi suprapāṇaṃ bhavatvaghnyābhyaḥ ||

translations.english: Raise on high the mighty sheath (of rain), pour down (its contents); let the rivers flow unimpeded to the east; saturate with water both heaven and earth, and let there be abundant beverage for the kine.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्पर्जन्य कनिक्रदत्स्तनयन्हंसि दुष्कृतः । प्रतीदं विश्वं मोदते यत्किं च पृथिव्यामधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatparjanya kanikradatstanayanhaṃsi duṣkṛtaḥ | pratīdaṃ viśvaṃ modate yatkiṃ ca pṛthivyāmadhi ||

translations.english: When, Parjanya, sounding loud and thundering, you destroy the wicked (clouds), this whole (world) rejoices, and all that is upon the earth.

mantras.sanskrit: अवर्षीर्वर्षमुदु षू गृभायाकर्धन्वान्यत्येतवा उ । अजीजन ओषधीर्भोजनाय कमुत प्रजाभ्योऽविदो मनीषाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: avarṣīrvarṣamudu ṣū gṛbhāyākardhanvānyatyetavā u | ajījana oṣadhīrbhojanāya kamuta prajābhyo'vido manīṣām ||

translations.english: You have rained; now check well the rain; you have made the deserts capable of being crossed; you have given birth to plural ns for (man's) enjoyment; verily you have obtained laudation from the people.

mantras.sanskrit: बळित्था पर्वतानां खिद्रं बिभर्षि पृथिवि । प्र या भूमिं प्रवत्वति मह्ना जिनोषि महिनि ॥
mantras.transliteration: baḷitthā parvatānāṃ khidraṃ bibharṣi pṛthivi | pra yā bhūmiṃ pravatvati mahnā jinoṣi mahini ||

translations.english: Verily you sustain here, Pṛthivi, the fracture of the mountains; mighty and most excellent, you are she who delight the earth by your greatness.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तोमासस्त्वा विचारिणि प्रति ष्टोभन्त्यक्तुभिः । प्र या वाजं न हेषन्तं पेरुमस्यस्यर्जुनि ॥
mantras.transliteration: stomāsastvā vicāriṇi prati ṣṭobhantyaktubhiḥ | pra yā vājaṃ na heṣantaṃ perumasyasyarjuni ||

translations.english: Wanderer in various ways your worshippers hymn you with (sacred) songs; you who, bright-hued, tosses the swollen (cloud) like a neighing horse.

mantras.sanskrit: दृळ्हा चिद्या वनस्पतीन्क्ष्मया दर्धर्ष्योजसा । यत्ते अभ्रस्य विद्युतो दिवो वर्षन्ति वृष्टयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dṛḷhā cidyā vanaspatīnkṣmayā dardharṣyojasā | yatte abhrasya vidyuto divo varṣanti vṛṣṭayaḥ ||

translations.english: You who, with solid earth, sustain by your strength the forest lords, when the showers of your cloud fall from the shining sky.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सम्राजे बृहदर्चा गभीरं ब्रह्म प्रियं वरुणाय श्रुताय । वि यो जघान शमितेव चर्मोपस्तिरे पृथिवीं सूर्याय ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra samrāje bṛhadarcā gabhīraṃ brahma priyaṃ varuṇāya śrutāya | vi yo jaghāna śamiteva carmopastire pṛthivīṃ sūryāya ||

translations.english: Offer a solemn, profound, and acceptable prayer to the imperial and renowned Varuṇa, who has spread the firmament as a bed for the sun, as the immolator (spreads) the skin of the victim.

mantras.sanskrit: वनेषु व्यन्तरिक्षं ततान वाजमर्वत्सु पय उस्रियासु । हृत्सु क्रतुं वरुणो अप्स्वग्निं दिवि सूर्यमदधात्सोममद्रौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: vaneṣu vyantarikṣaṃ tatāna vājamarvatsu paya usriyāsu | hṛtsu kratuṃ varuṇo apsvagniṃ divi sūryamadadhātsomamadrau ||

translations.english: He has extended the firmament over the tops of the trees, has given strength to horses, milk to cows, determination to the heart; he has plural ced fire in the waters, the sun in heaven, the Soma in the mountains.

mantras.sanskrit: नीचीनबारं वरुणः कवन्धं प्र ससर्ज रोदसी अन्तरिक्षम् । तेन विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजा यवं न वृष्टिर्व्युनत्ति भूम ॥
mantras.transliteration: nīcīnabāraṃ varuṇaḥ kavandhaṃ pra sasarja rodasī antarikṣam | tena viśvasya bhuvanasya rājā yavaṃ na vṛṣṭirvyunatti bhūma ||

translations.english: Varuṇa has set free the (water of the) downward opening cloud for the (benefit of the) heaven, the earth, and the firmament, thence is the monarch of all the world, watering the soil as the rain bedews the barley.

mantras.sanskrit: उनत्ति भूमिं पृथिवीमुत द्यां यदा दुग्धं वरुणो वष्ट्यादित् । समभ्रेण वसत पर्वतासस्तविषीयन्तः श्रथयन्त वीराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: unatti bhūmiṃ pṛthivīmuta dyāṃ yadā dugdhaṃ varuṇo vaṣṭyādit | samabhreṇa vasata parvatāsastaviṣīyantaḥ śrathayanta vīrāḥ ||

translations.english: Varuṇa waters earth, mid-air, and heaven, when he plural ases (to send forth) the milk (of the cloud); thereupon the mountains cloth (their summits) withthe rain-cloud, and the hero, (Maruts), exulting in their strength, compel (the clouds) to relax.

mantras.sanskrit: इमामू ष्वासुरस्य श्रुतस्य महीं मायां वरुणस्य प्र वोचम् । मानेनेव तस्थिवाँ अन्तरिक्षे वि यो ममे पृथिवीं सूर्येण ॥
mantras.transliteration: imāmū ṣvāsurasya śrutasya mahīṃ māyāṃ varuṇasya pra vocam | māneneva tasthivā~ antarikṣe vi yo mame pṛthivīṃ sūryeṇa ||

translations.english: I proclaim this great device of the renowned Varuṇa, the destroyer of the Asuras, who, abiding in the mid-heaven, has meted the firmament by the sun, as if by a measure.

mantras.sanskrit: इमामू नु कवितमस्य मायां महीं देवस्य नकिरा दधर्ष । एकं यदुद्ना न पृणन्त्येनीरासिञ्चन्तीरवनयः समुद्रम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: imāmū nu kavitamasya māyāṃ mahīṃ devasya nakirā dadharṣa | ekaṃ yadudnā na pṛṇantyenīrāsiñcantīravanayaḥ samudram ||

translations.english: No one has counteracted the device of the most sagacious divinity, whereby the lucid water-shedding rivers do not fill the ocean with water.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्यम्यं वरुण मित्र्यं वा सखायं वा सदमिद्भ्रातरं वा । वेशं वा नित्यं वरुणारणं वा यत्सीमागश्चकृमा शिश्रथस्तत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: aryamyaṃ varuṇa mitryaṃ vā sakhāyaṃ vā sadamidbhrātaraṃ vā | veśaṃ vā nityaṃ varuṇāraṇaṃ vā yatsīmāgaścakṛmā śiśrathastat ||

translations.english: If, Varuṇa, we have ever committed an offence against a benefactor, a friend, a companion, a brother, a near neighbour, or, Varuṇa, a dumb man, remove it from us.

mantras.sanskrit: कितवासो यद्रिरिपुर्न दीवि यद्वा घा सत्यमुत यन्न विद्म । सर्वा ता वि ष्य शिथिरेव देवाधा ते स्याम वरुण प्रियासः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kitavāso yadriripurna dīvi yadvā ghā satyamuta yanna vidma | sarvā tā vi ṣya śithireva devādhā te syāma varuṇa priyāsaḥ ||

translations.english: If, like gamesters, who cheat at plural y, (we commit offences) knowingly, or (those) of which we know not, do you divine Varuṇa, extricate us from them all, as if from loosened (bonds), so that we may be dear, Varuṇa, to you.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी यमवथ उभा वाजेषु मर्त्यम् । दृळ्हा चित्स प्र भेदति द्युम्ना वाणीरिव त्रितः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāgnī yamavatha ubhā vājeṣu martyam | dṛḷhā citsa pra bhedati dyumnā vāṇīriva tritaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra and Agni, the mortal whom you both protect scatters the substantial treasures (of his enemies), as Trita (fonfutes) the words (of his opponents).

mantras.sanskrit: या पृतनासु दुष्टरा या वाजेषु श्रवाय्या । या पञ्च चर्षणीरभीन्द्राग्नी ता हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā pṛtanāsu duṣṭarā yā vājeṣu śravāyyā | yā pañca carṣaṇīrabhīndrāgnī tā havāmahe ||

translations.english: We invoke the two, Indra and Agni, who are irresistible in conflicts, who are renowned in battles, who protect the five (classes of) men.

mantras.sanskrit: तयोरिदमवच्छवस्तिग्मा दिद्युन्मघोनोः । प्रति द्रुणा गभस्त्योर्गवां वृत्रघ्न एषते ॥
mantras.transliteration: tayoridamavacchavastigmā didyunmaghonoḥ | prati druṇā gabhastyorgavāṃ vṛtraghna eṣate ||

translations.english: Overpowering is the might of these two; the bright (lightning) is shining in the hands of Maghavan, as they go toether in one chariot for the (recovery of the) cows and the destruction of Vṛtra.

mantras.sanskrit: ता वामेषे रथानामिन्द्राग्नी हवामहे । पती तुरस्य राधसो विद्वांसा गिर्वणस्तमा ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā vāmeṣe rathānāmindrāgnī havāmahe | patī turasya rādhaso vidvāṃsā girvaṇastamā ||

translations.english: We invoke you both, Indra and Agni, for (sending) your chariots to the combat, lords of moveable wealth, all-knowing, most deserving of praise.

mantras.sanskrit: ता वृधन्तावनु द्यून्मर्ताय देवावदभा । अर्हन्ता चित्पुरो दधेंऽशेव देवावर्वते ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā vṛdhantāvanu dyūnmartāya devāvadabhā | arhantā citpuro dadheṃ'śeva devāvarvate ||

translations.english: I adore you, irresistible deities for (the sake of obtaining) horses; you who are increasing day by day like mortals, who are worthy of worship, like two Ādityas.

mantras.sanskrit: एवेन्द्राग्निभ्यामहावि हव्यं शूष्यं घृतं न पूतमद्रिभिः । ता सूरिषु श्रवो बृहद्रयिं गृणत्सु दिधृतमिषं गृणत्सु दिधृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: evendrāgnibhyāmahāvi havyaṃ śūṣyaṃ ghṛtaṃ na pūtamadribhiḥ | tā sūriṣu śravo bṛhadrayiṃ gṛṇatsu didhṛtamiṣaṃ gṛṇatsu didhṛtam ||

translations.english: The invigorating oblation has been offered, like the Soma-juice expressed by the sounding stones; do you bestow food uponthe pious; great riches upon those who praise you; bestow food also upon those who praise you.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वो महे मतयो यन्तु विष्णवे मरुत्वते गिरिजा एवयामरुत् । प्र शर्धाय प्रयज्यवे सुखादये तवसे भन्ददिष्टये धुनिव्रताय शवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vo mahe matayo yantu viṣṇave marutvate girijā evayāmarut | pra śardhāya prayajyave sukhādaye tavase bhandadiṣṭaye dhunivratāya śavase ||

translations.english: May the voice-born praises of Evayāmarut reach you, Viṣṇu, attended by the Maruts; (may they reach) the strong, the adorable, the brilliantly-adorned, the vigorous, praise-loving, cloud-scattering, quick-moving company of the Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ये जाता महिना ये च नु स्वयं प्र विद्मना ब्रुवत एवयामरुत् । क्रत्वा तद्वो मरुतो नाधृषे शवो दाना मह्ना तदेषामधृष्टासो नाद्रयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra ye jātā mahinā ye ca nu svayaṃ pra vidmanā bruvata evayāmarut | kratvā tadvo maruto nādhṛṣe śavo dānā mahnā tadeṣāmadhṛṣṭāso nādrayaḥ ||

translations.english: Evayāmarut glorifies those who are manifested with the great (Indra), who appear spontaneously and speedily with the knowledge (that the sacrifice is prepared); your strength in action, Maruts, is not to be resisted, (though qualified) by (your) infinite liberality; you are immoveable as mountains.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ये दिवो बृहतः शृण्विरे गिरा सुशुक्वानः सुभ्व एवयामरुत् । न येषामिरी सधस्थ ईष्ट आँ अग्नयो न स्वविद्युतः प्र स्यन्द्रासो धुनीनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra ye divo bṛhataḥ śṛṇvire girā suśukvānaḥ subhva evayāmarut | na yeṣāmirī sadhastha īṣṭa ā~ agnayo na svavidyutaḥ pra syandrāso dhunīnām ||

translations.english: Evayāmarut, glorifies with praise those who, (coming) brilliant and happy from the vast heaven, hear (his invocation); in whose dwelling there is no one able to disturb them, and who, like self-radiant fires, are the impellers of the rivers.

mantras.sanskrit: स चक्रमे महतो निरुरुक्रमः समानस्मात्सदस एवयामरुत् । यदायुक्त त्मना स्वादधि ष्णुभिर्विष्पर्धसो विमहसो जिगाति शेवृधो नृभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa cakrame mahato nirurukramaḥ samānasmātsadasa evayāmarut | yadāyukta tmanā svādadhi ṣṇubhirviṣpardhaso vimahaso jigāti śevṛdho nṛbhiḥ ||

translations.english: That wide-spreading troop (of Maruts) has issued from a spacious common dwelling-plural ce, (where) evayāmarut (awaits them) when their car has been spontaneously harnessed with its rapid horses; and, emulous, vigorous, and conferring happiness, they sally forth.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वनो न वोऽमवान्रेजयद्वृषा त्वेषो ययिस्तविष एवयामरुत् । येना सहन्त ऋञ्जत स्वरोचिषः स्थारश्मानो हिरण्ययाः स्वायुधास इष्मिणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: svano na vo'mavānrejayadvṛṣā tveṣo yayistaviṣa evayāmarut | yenā sahanta ṛñjata svarociṣaḥ sthāraśmāno hiraṇyayāḥ svāyudhāsa iṣmiṇaḥ ||

translations.english: Let not the sound (of your approach, Maruts), which is mighty, the announcer of rain,t he shedder of light, diffusive, loud, alarm Evayāmarut; that sound wherewith, overcoming (your foes), you who are self-irradiating, lasting-rayed, ornamented with golden oranaments, self-weaponed, bestowing food, accomplish your functions.

mantras.sanskrit: अपारो वो महिमा वृद्धशवसस्त्वेषं शवोऽवत्वेवयामरुत् । स्थातारो हि प्रसितौ संदृशि स्थन ते न उरुष्यता निदः शुशुक्वांसो नाग्नयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: apāro vo mahimā vṛddhaśavasastveṣaṃ śavo'vatvevayāmarut | sthātāro hi prasitau saṃdṛśi sthana te na uruṣyatā nidaḥ śuśukvāṃso nāgnayaḥ ||

translations.english: Possessor of vast strength, may your unbounded greatness, your brilliant vigour, protect Evayāmarut; for you are the regulators for overseeing (what is fit for) the limits of the sacrifice; preserve us from those who revile us, you, who are like blazing fires.

mantras.sanskrit: ते रुद्रासः सुमखा अग्नयो यथा तुविद्युम्ना अवन्त्वेवयामरुत् । दीर्घं पृथु पप्रथे सद्म पार्थिवं येषामज्मेष्वा महः शर्धांस्यद्भुतैनसाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: te rudrāsaḥ sumakhā agnayo yathā tuvidyumnā avantvevayāmarut | dīrghaṃ pṛthu paprathe sadma pārthivaṃ yeṣāmajmeṣvā mahaḥ śardhāṃsyadbhutainasām ||

translations.english: May those Rudras, the objects of worship, like resplendent fires, protect Evayāmarut; they, whose ethereal dwelling, extended and wide, has been made illustrious (by them), and of whom, exempt from blame, the mighty energies (are manifested) in their courses.

mantras.sanskrit: अद्वेषो नो मरुतो गातुमेतन श्रोता हवं जरितुरेवयामरुत् । विष्णोर्महः समन्यवो युयोतन स्मद्रथ्यो न दंसनाप द्वेषांसि सनुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adveṣo no maruto gātumetana śrotā havaṃ jariturevayāmarut | viṣṇormahaḥ samanyavo yuyotana smadrathyo na daṃsanāpa dveṣāṃsi sanutaḥ ||

translations.english: Maruts, devoid of enmity, come to our proffered praise, hear the invocation of your adorer, Evayāmarut; do you, who are associated in the worship of Viṣṇu drive away, as warriors (scatter their enemies), our secret foes.

mantras.sanskrit: गन्ता नो यज्ञं यज्ञियाः सुशमि श्रोता हवमरक्ष एवयामरुत् । ज्येष्ठासो न पर्वतासो व्योमनि यूयं तस्य प्रचेतसः स्यात दुर्धर्तवो निदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: gantā no yajñaṃ yajñiyāḥ suśami śrotā havamarakṣa evayāmarut | jyeṣṭhāso na parvatāso vyomani yūyaṃ tasya pracetasaḥ syāta durdhartavo nidaḥ ||

translations.english: Adorable Maruts come to our sacrifice, so that it may be prosperous; hear, undeterred by rākṣasas, the invocation of Evayāmarut; abiding like lofty mountains in mid-heaven, do you, who are profoundly wise, be ever intolerant of the reviler.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं ह्यग्ने प्रथमो मनोतास्या धियो अभवो दस्म होता । त्वं सीं वृषन्नकृणोर्दुष्टरीतु सहो विश्वस्मै सहसे सहध्यै ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ hyagne prathamo manotāsyā dhiyo abhavo dasma hotā | tvaṃ sīṃ vṛṣannakṛṇorduṣṭarītu saho viśvasmai sahase sahadhyai ||

translations.english: You Agni, are the first of the gods; a deity to whom their minds are devoted; plural asing of aspect, you are the invoker of the deities at this rite; showerer (of benefits), bestow upon us unsurpassable strength, where with to sustain all (hostile) prowess.

mantras.sanskrit: अधा होता न्यसीदो यजीयानिळस्पद इषयन्नीड्यः सन् । तं त्वा नरः प्रथमं देवयन्तो महो राये चितयन्तो अनु ग्मन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhā hotā nyasīdo yajīyāniḷaspada iṣayannīḍyaḥ san | taṃ tvā naraḥ prathamaṃ devayanto maho rāye citayanto anu gman ||

translations.english: Offerer of the oblation, frequent celebrator of sacrifice, now sit down on the foot-m ark of Iḷā, accepting the (sacrirficial) food, and being glorified; devout men, expectant of great riches, have recourse to you as to the first (of the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: वृतेव यन्तं बहुभिर्वसव्यैस्त्वे रयिं जागृवांसो अनु ग्मन् । रुशन्तमग्निं दर्शतं बृहन्तं वपावन्तं विश्वहा दीदिवांसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛteva yantaṃ bahubhirvasavyaistve rayiṃ jāgṛvāṃso anu gman | ruśantamagniṃ darśataṃ bṛhantaṃ vapāvantaṃ viśvahā dīdivāṃsam ||

translations.english: Those who are assiduous in (worshipping) you for riches follow you, going with many Vasus by the path (of the firmament); you, the radiant Agni, of goodly aspect, mighty, fed with burnt-offerings, and blazing every day.

mantras.sanskrit: पदं देवस्य नमसा व्यन्तः श्रवस्यवः श्रव आपन्नमृक्तम् । नामानि चिद्दधिरे यज्ञियानि भद्रायां ते रणयन्त संदृष्टौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: padaṃ devasya namasā vyantaḥ śravasyavaḥ śrava āpannamṛktam | nāmāni ciddadhire yajñiyāni bhadrāyāṃ te raṇayanta saṃdṛṣṭau ||

translations.english: Men desirous of food obtain abundance unopposed when repairing to the station of the divinity with oblations; and when delighting, Agni, in your auspicious presence, they repeat those your names which are to be uttered at sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वां वर्धन्ति क्षितयः पृथिव्यां त्वां राय उभयासो जनानाम् । त्वं त्राता तरणे चेत्यो भूः पिता माता सदमिन्मानुषाणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāṃ vardhanti kṣitayaḥ pṛthivyāṃ tvāṃ rāya ubhayāso janānām | tvaṃ trātā taraṇe cetyo bhūḥ pitā mātā sadaminmānuṣāṇām ||

translations.english: Men exalt you upon earth; they exalt you for both kinds of affluence, (cattle and treasure, which you bestow upon) men; you who extricate (us from evil) are to be known as our preserver, as the unfailing father and mother of mankind.

mantras.sanskrit: सपर्येण्यः स प्रियो विक्ष्वग्निर्होता मन्द्रो नि षसादा यजीयान् । तं त्वा वयं दम आ दीदिवांसमुप ज्ञुबाधो नमसा सदेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: saparyeṇyaḥ sa priyo vikṣvagnirhotā mandro ni ṣasādā yajīyān | taṃ tvā vayaṃ dama ā dīdivāṃsamupa jñubādho namasā sadema ||

translations.english: Agni, who is adorable, affectionate, the offerer of oblations among men, the giver of delight, the celebrator of worship, has sat down (upon the altar); let us approach you, kindled in our dwellings, on bended knees, with praise.

mantras.sanskrit: तं त्वा वयं सुध्यो नव्यमग्ने सुम्नायव ईमहे देवयन्तः । त्वं विशो अनयो दीद्यानो दिवो अग्ने बृहता रोचनेन ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ tvā vayaṃ sudhyo navyamagne sumnāyava īmahe devayantaḥ | tvaṃ viśo anayo dīdyāno divo agne bṛhatā rocanena ||

translations.english: Intelligent, hoping for happiness, and devout, we glorify you, adorable Agni; do you, shining with exceeding lustre, lead men to heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: विशां कविं विश्पतिं शश्वतीनां नितोशनं वृषभं चर्षणीनाम् । प्रेतीषणिमिषयन्तं पावकं राजन्तमग्निं यजतं रयीणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśāṃ kaviṃ viśpatiṃ śaśvatīnāṃ nitośanaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ carṣaṇīnām | pretīṣaṇimiṣayantaṃ pāvakaṃ rājantamagniṃ yajataṃ rayīṇām ||

translations.english: (We glorify) the lord of men of ever-existing men; the wise, the destroyer (of foes) the showerer (of benefits) on mankind, the moving, the bestower of food, the purifier, the resplendent, Agni, who is worshipped for (the sake of) riches.

mantras.sanskrit: सो अग्न ईजे शशमे च मर्तो यस्त आनट् समिधा हव्यदातिम् । य आहुतिं परि वेदा नमोभिर्विश्वेत्स वामा दधते त्वोतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: so agna īje śaśame ca marto yasta ānaṭ samidhā havyadātim | ya āhutiṃ pari vedā namobhirviśvetsa vāmā dadhate tvotaḥ ||

translations.english: The man, Agni, who worships you, who praises you, who offers oblations to you with kindled fuel, who presents burnt-offerings to you with prostrations, he verily, protected by you, obtains all desired wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मा उ ते महि महे विधेम नमोभिरग्ने समिधोत हव्यैः । वेदी सूनो सहसो गीर्भिरुक्थैरा ते भद्रायां सुमतौ यतेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmā u te mahi mahe vidhema namobhiragne samidhota havyaiḥ | vedī sūno sahaso gīrbhirukthairā te bhadrāyāṃ sumatau yatema ||

translations.english: To you, mighty Agni, we offer exceeding adoration with prostrations, with fuel, with oblations; (we glorify you) on the altar, son of strength, with hymns and with prayers; may we be successful in our efforts (to gain) you auspicious favour.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यस्ततन्थ रोदसी वि भासा श्रवोभिश्च श्रवस्यस्तरुत्रः । बृहद्भिर्वाजैः स्थविरेभिरस्मे रेवद्भिरग्ने वितरं वि भाहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yastatantha rodasī vi bhāsā śravobhiśca śravasyastarutraḥ | bṛhadbhirvājaiḥ sthavirebhirasme revadbhiragne vitaraṃ vi bhāhi ||

translations.english: Do you, Agni, who have spread heaven and earth with light, who are the preserver (of man), and (who are) to be glorified with praises, shine brightly upon us with abundant food, and with substantial riches.

mantras.sanskrit: नृवद्वसो सदमिद्धेह्यस्मे भूरि तोकाय तनयाय पश्वः । पूर्वीरिषो बृहतीरारेअघा अस्मे भद्रा सौश्रवसानि सन्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: nṛvadvaso sadamiddhehyasme bhūri tokāya tanayāya paśvaḥ | pūrvīriṣo bṛhatīrāreaghā asme bhadrā sauśravasāni santu ||

translations.english: Possessor of wealth, bestow upon us at all times opulence conjoined with dependants, and (grant) abundance of cattle to our sons and grandsons; may therefore be to us abundant food, satisfying our wishes, and free from blame; and may there be auspicious and reputable (means of subsistence).

mantras.sanskrit: पुरूण्यग्ने पुरुधा त्वाया वसूनि राजन्वसुता ते अश्याम् । पुरूणि हि त्वे पुरुवार सन्त्यग्ने वसु विधते राजनि त्वे ॥
mantras.transliteration: purūṇyagne purudhā tvāyā vasūni rājanvasutā te aśyām | purūṇi hi tve puruvāra santyagne vasu vidhate rājani tve ||

translations.english: Royal Agni, may I obtain from you your many and various treasures whereby to be enriched; for, Agni, who are the desired of multitudes, infinite are the riches (aggregated) in you, fit, monarch, for your worshipper.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं हि क्षैतवद्यशोऽग्ने मित्रो न पत्यसे । त्वं विचर्षणे श्रवो वसो पुष्टिं न पुष्यसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ hi kṣaitavadyaśo'gne mitro na patyase | tvaṃ vicarṣaṇe śravo vaso puṣṭiṃ na puṣyasi ||

translations.english: You alight, Agni, like Mitra, upon the oblation offered with the dry fuel; therefore, beholder of all, possessor of riches, you cherish us with food and nourishment.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वां हि ष्मा चर्षणयो यज्ञेभिर्गीर्भिरीळते । त्वां वाजी यात्यवृको रजस्तूर्विश्वचर्षणिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāṃ hi ṣmā carṣaṇayo yajñebhirgīrbhirīḷate | tvāṃ vājī yātyavṛko rajastūrviśvacarṣaṇiḥ ||

translations.english: Men verily worship you with sacrifice and with praises; the inoffensive sun, the sender of rain, the beholder of the universe, proceeds to you.

mantras.sanskrit: सजोषस्त्वा दिवो नरो यज्ञस्य केतुमिन्धते । यद्ध स्य मानुषो जनः सुम्नायुर्जुह्वे अध्वरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: sajoṣastvā divo naro yajñasya ketumindhate | yaddha sya mānuṣo janaḥ sumnāyurjuhve adhvare ||

translations.english: The offerers of praise, sympathizing in satisfaction, kindle you the banner of the sacrifice, when man, the descendant of Manu, desiring happiness, invokes you to the rite.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋधद्यस्ते सुदानवे धिया मर्तः शशमते । ऊती ष बृहतो दिवो द्विषो अंहो न तरति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛdhadyaste sudānave dhiyā martaḥ śaśamate | ūtī ṣa bṛhato divo dviṣo aṃho na tarati ||

translations.english: May the mortal prosper who propitiates you (his) benefactor, by holy rites; through the protection of you who are resplendent, he overcomes those who hate him, as if they were mortal sins.

mantras.sanskrit: समिधा यस्त आहुतिं निशितिं मर्त्यो नशत् । वयावन्तं स पुष्यति क्षयमग्ने शतायुषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: samidhā yasta āhutiṃ niśitiṃ martyo naśat | vayāvantaṃ sa puṣyati kṣayamagne śatāyuṣam ||

translations.english: The mortal who feeds your consecrated burnt offering with fuel enjoys, Agni, a dwelling peopled with descendants, and a life of a hundred years.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वेषस्ते धूम ऋण्वति दिवि षञ्छुक्र आततः । सूरो न हि द्युता त्वं कृपा पावक रोचसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tveṣaste dhūma ṛṇvati divi ṣañchukra ātataḥ | sūro na hi dyutā tvaṃ kṛpā pāvaka rocase ||

translations.english: The pure smoke of you the resplendent spreads through the firmament, matures (in clouds), and you, the purifier, shine with radiance like the sun, when propitiated by praise.

mantras.sanskrit: अधा हि विक्ष्वीड्योऽसि प्रियो नो अतिथिः । रण्वः पुरीव जूर्यः सूनुर्न त्रययाय्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhā hi vikṣvīḍyo'si priyo no atithiḥ | raṇvaḥ purīva jūryaḥ sūnurna trayayāyyaḥ ||

translations.english: You are now to be praised among the people, for you are our well beloved guest, venerated like an elder in the city, and to be cherished like a son.

mantras.sanskrit: क्रत्वा हि द्रोणे अज्यसेऽग्ने वाजी न कृत्व्यः । परिज्मेव स्वधा गयोऽत्यो न ह्वार्यः शिशुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kratvā hi droṇe ajyase'gne vājī na kṛtvyaḥ | parijmeva svadhā gayo'tyo na hvāryaḥ śiśuḥ ||

translations.english: You are manifested in the timber, Agni, by the act of attrition; you are the bearer (of the oblation) as a horse (is of his rider); you are like the circumsambient wind; you are food and dwelling; you are like a (newborn) babe, and variable (in movement) as a horse.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं त्या चिदच्युताग्ने पशुर्न यवसे । धामा ह यत्ते अजर वना वृश्चन्ति शिक्वसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ tyā cidacyutāgne paśurna yavase | dhāmā ha yatte ajara vanā vṛścanti śikvasaḥ ||

translations.english: You consume Agni, the unfallen (trees) as an animal (feeds) upon pasture, when, undecaying deity, the flames of you who are resplendent shear the forests.

mantras.sanskrit: वेषि ह्यध्वरीयतामग्ने होता दमे विशाम् । समृधो विश्पते कृणु जुषस्व हव्यमङ्गिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: veṣi hyadhvarīyatāmagne hotā dame viśām | samṛdho viśpate kṛṇu juṣasva havyamaṅgiraḥ ||

translations.english: You enter as the ministrant priest into the habitations of men who wish to perform sacrifice; render them prosperous, benefactor of mankind; be propitiated, aṅgiras, by the oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: अच्छा नो मित्रमहो देव देवानग्ने वोचः सुमतिं रोदस्योः । वीहि स्वस्तिं सुक्षितिं दिवो नॄन्द्विषो अंहांसि दुरिता तरेम ता तरेम तवावसा तरेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: acchā no mitramaho deva devānagne vocaḥ sumatiṃ rodasyoḥ | vīhi svastiṃ sukṣitiṃ divo nṝndviṣo aṃhāṃsi duritā tarema tā tarema tavāvasā tarema ||

translations.english: Divine Agni, reverenced as a friend, who are abiding in heaven and earth, communicate our praise to the gods; conduct the offerer of adoration to domestic felicity; and may we overcome our adversaries, our iniquities, our difficulties; may we overcome those (sins of a prior existence); may we overcome them by your protection.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने स क्षेषदृतपा ऋतेजा उरु ज्योतिर्नशते देवयुष्टे । यं त्वं मित्रेण वरुणः सजोषा देव पासि त्यजसा मर्तमंहः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne sa kṣeṣadṛtapā ṛtejā uru jyotirnaśate devayuṣṭe | yaṃ tvaṃ mitreṇa varuṇaḥ sajoṣā deva pāsi tyajasā martamaṃhaḥ ||

translations.english: The offerer of sacrifice, born for religious rites, who lives devoted, Agni, to you, obtains abundant light, and is a man whom you, sympathizing in satisfaction with Mitra and Varuṇa, protect by your shield from iniquity.

mantras.sanskrit: ईजे यज्ञेभिः शशमे शमीभिॠधद्वारायाग्नये ददाश । एवा चन तं यशसामजुष्टिर्नांहो मर्तं नशते न प्रदृप्तिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: īje yajñebhiḥ śaśame śamībhiṝdhadvārāyāgnaye dadāśa | evā cana taṃ yaśasāmajuṣṭirnāṃho martaṃ naśate na pradṛptiḥ ||

translations.english: He who has presented (oblations) to Agni, the possessor of desired (wealth), sacrifices with (all) sacrifices, and is sanctified by (all) holy acts; him, the wand of excellent (posterity) does not afflict, nor does sin or pride affect a mortal.

mantras.sanskrit: सूरो न यस्य दृशतिररेपा भीमा यदेति शुचतस्त आ धीः । हेषस्वतः शुरुधो नायमक्तोः कुत्रा चिद्रण्वो वसतिर्वनेजाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sūro na yasya dṛśatirarepā bhīmā yadeti śucatasta ā dhīḥ | heṣasvataḥ śurudho nāyamaktoḥ kutrā cidraṇvo vasatirvanejāḥ ||

translations.english: When the fearful flames of you, whose appearance is (as) faultless as (that of) the sun, spread on every side as (if they were) the lowing heifers of the night, then this Agni, the asylum of all, genitive rated in the woods, is everywhere beautiful.

mantras.sanskrit: तिग्मं चिदेम महि वर्पो अस्य भसदश्वो न यमसान आसा । विजेहमानः परशुर्न जिह्वां द्रविर्न द्रावयति दारु धक्षत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tigmaṃ cidema mahi varpo asya bhasadaśvo na yamasāna āsā | vijehamānaḥ paraśurna jihvāṃ dravirna drāvayati dāru dhakṣat ||

translations.english: Sharp is his path, and his vast body shines like a horse champing fodder with his mouth, darting forth his tongue like a hatchet, and burning timber to ashes, like a goldsmith who fuses (metal).

mantras.sanskrit: स इदस्तेव प्रति धादसिष्यञ्छिशीत तेजोऽयसो न धाराम् । चित्रध्रजतिररतिर्यो अक्तोर्वेर्न द्रुषद्वा रघुपत्मजंहाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa idasteva prati dhādasiṣyañchiśīta tejo'yaso na dhārām | citradhrajatiraratiryo aktorverna druṣadvā raghupatmajaṃhāḥ ||

translations.english: He casts (afar his flames) as an archer (his arrows), and sharpens when about to dart his radiance, as (a warrior whets) the edge of his metal (weapons), he who, variously moving, passes through the night, like the light-falling foot of a bird perched upon a tree.

mantras.sanskrit: स ईं रेभो न प्रति वस्त उस्राः शोचिषा रारपीति मित्रमहाः । नक्तं य ईमरुषो यो दिवा नॄनमर्त्यो अरुषो यो दिवा नॄन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa īṃ rebho na prati vasta usrāḥ śociṣā rārapīti mitramahāḥ | naktaṃ ya īmaruṣo yo divā nṝnamartyo aruṣo yo divā nṝn ||

translations.english: Like the adorable sun, he clothes himself with brilliant (rays); diffusing friendly light, he crackles with (his fame); (he it is) who is luminous by night, and who lights men (to their work) by day; who is immortal and radiant; who lights men by day.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवो न यस्य विधतो नवीनोद्वृषा रुक्ष ओषधीषु नूनोत् । घृणा न यो ध्रजसा पत्मना यन्ना रोदसी वसुना दं सुपत्नी ॥
mantras.transliteration: divo na yasya vidhato navīnodvṛṣā rukṣa oṣadhīṣu nūnot | ghṛṇā na yo dhrajasā patmanā yannā rodasī vasunā daṃ supatnī ||

translations.english: Of whom a sound is heard when scattering his rays like (that) of the sun; the brilliant showerer (of benefits) clamours among the (burning) plural nts; he who, moving not with a shifting, variable motion, but, humbling (our foes), fills the well-wedded earth and heaven with wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: धायोभिर्वा यो युज्येभिरर्कैर्विद्युन्न दविद्योत्स्वेभिः शुष्मैः । शर्धो वा यो मरुतां ततक्ष ऋभुर्न त्वेषो रभसानो अद्यौत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhāyobhirvā yo yujyebhirarkairvidyunna davidyotsvebhiḥ śuṣmaiḥ | śardho vā yo marutāṃ tatakṣa ṛbhurna tveṣo rabhasāno adyaut ||

translations.english: He who (goes) with sacred (rays), as if with self-harnessed, well-governed (steeds), who shines like lightning with his own scorching (flames), who impairs the vigour of the Maruts, he glows radiant and rapid as the wide-shining sun.

mantras.sanskrit: यथा होतर्मनुषो देवताता यज्ञेभिः सूनो सहसो यजासि । एवा नो अद्य समना समानानुशन्नग्न उशतो यक्षि देवान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathā hotarmanuṣo devatātā yajñebhiḥ sūno sahaso yajāsi | evā no adya samanā samānānuśannagna uśato yakṣi devān ||

translations.english: Son of strength, invoker (of the gods), in like manner as at the worship of the gods by Manu, you did offer worship with sacrifice; so now, Agni, with willing mind, worship for us the assenting deities, regarding them as your equals.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो विभावा चक्षणिर्न वस्तोरग्निर्वन्दारु वेद्यश्चनो धात् । विश्वायुर्यो अमृतो मर्त्येषूषर्भुद्भूदतिथिर्जातवेदाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no vibhāvā cakṣaṇirna vastoragnirvandāru vedyaścano dhāt | viśvāyuryo amṛto martyeṣūṣarbhudbhūdatithirjātavedāḥ ||

translations.english: May that Agni, who, like the illuminator of the day, is resplendent and cognizable (by all), gran us commendable food; he who is the life of all, immortal, who knows all that exists, who is our guest, waking among men at dawn.

mantras.sanskrit: द्यावो न यस्य पनयन्त्यभ्वं भासांसि वस्ते सूर्यो न शुक्रः । वि य इनोत्यजरः पावकोऽश्नस्य चिच्छिश्नथत्पूर्व्याणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: dyāvo na yasya panayantyabhvaṃ bhāsāṃsi vaste sūryo na śukraḥ | vi ya inotyajaraḥ pāvako'śnasya cicchiśnathatpūrvyāṇi ||

translations.english: Whose great deeds his worshipers now celebrate, who is clothed with light, radiant as the sun, exempt from decay, the purifier, he illumes (all things), and destroys the ancient cities of the dispersed (evil beings).

mantras.sanskrit: वद्मा हि सूनो अस्यद्मसद्वा चक्रे अग्निर्जनुषाज्मान्नम् । स त्वं न ऊर्जसन ऊर्जं धा राजेव जेरवृके क्षेष्यन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vadmā hi sūno asyadmasadvā cakre agnirjanuṣājmānnam | sa tvaṃ na ūrjasana ūrjaṃ dhā rājeva jeravṛke kṣeṣyantaḥ ||

translations.english: Sons of strength, you are to be praised; Agni, sitting upon the (sacrificial) viands, has given (to his worshippers), from their birth, habitation and food giver of strength, bestow strength upon us; triumph like a prize, so that you may abide in our unassailed (dwelling).

mantras.sanskrit: नितिक्ति यो वारणमन्नमत्ति वायुर्न राष्ट्र्यत्येत्यक्तून् । तुर्याम यस्त आदिशामरातीरत्यो न ह्रुतः पततः परिह्रुत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nitikti yo vāraṇamannamatti vāyurna rāṣṭryatyetyaktūn | turyāma yasta ādiśāmarātīratyo na hrutaḥ patataḥ parihrut ||

translations.english: He who whets his (gloom) dispersing (radiance), who eats the (offered) oblation, a soverign like vāyu, overcomes the nights; may we prevail (over him) who is not a donor of the oblations that are due; (Agni), to you, and do you, (swift) as a horse be the destroyer of the foes assailing (us).

mantras.sanskrit: आ सूर्यो न भानुमद्भिरर्कैरग्ने ततन्थ रोदसी वि भासा । चित्रो नयत्परि तमांस्यक्तः शोचिषा पत्मन्नौशिजो न दीयन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā sūryo na bhānumadbhirarkairagne tatantha rodasī vi bhāsā | citro nayatpari tamāṃsyaktaḥ śociṣā patmannauśijo na dīyan ||

translations.english: You over spread, Agni, heaven and earth with radiance, like the sun with his lustrous rays; the wonderful Agni disperses the glooms like the adored (sun) moving on his path, imbued with light.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वां हि मन्द्रतममर्कशोकैर्ववृमहे महि नः श्रोष्यग्ने । इन्द्रं न त्वा शवसा देवता वायुं पृणन्ति राधसा नृतमाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāṃ hi mandratamamarkaśokairvavṛmahe mahi naḥ śroṣyagne | indraṃ na tvā śavasā devatā vāyuṃ pṛṇanti rādhasā nṛtamāḥ ||

translations.english: We celebrate you, who are most adorable, with sacred praises; hear, Agni, our laudation; the leaders (of rites) earnestly honour you with offerings, you, who are divine like Indra, and like vāyu in strength.

mantras.sanskrit: नू नो अग्नेऽवृकेभिः स्वस्ति वेषि रायः पथिभिः पर्ष्यंहः । ता सूरिभ्यो गृणते रासि सुम्नं मदेम शतहिमाः सुवीराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū no agne'vṛkebhiḥ svasti veṣi rāyaḥ pathibhiḥ parṣyaṃhaḥ | tā sūribhyo gṛṇate rāsi sumnaṃ madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ ||

translations.english: Quickly conduct us, Agni, by unmolested paths, to riches and prosperity; (convey us) beyond sin; those delights which you give to your adorers (extend) to him who (now) glorifies you, and may we, living for a hundred winters, and blessed with excellent posterity, be happy.

mantras.sanskrit: हुवे वः सूनुं सहसो युवानमद्रोघवाचं मतिभिर्यविष्ठम् । य इन्वति द्रविणानि प्रचेता विश्ववाराणि पुरुवारो अध्रुक् ॥
mantras.transliteration: huve vaḥ sūnuṃ sahaso yuvānamadroghavācaṃ matibhiryaviṣṭham | ya invati draviṇāni pracetā viśvavārāṇi puruvāro adhruk ||

translations.english: I invoke you, Agni, the son of strength, the youthful, the irreproachable, the very young; you who are wise, the sought of many, the merciful, who bestows treasures acceptable to all.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वे वसूनि पुर्वणीक होतर्दोषा वस्तोरेरिरे यज्ञियासः । क्षामेव विश्वा भुवनानि यस्मिन्त्सं सौभगानि दधिरे पावके ॥
mantras.transliteration: tve vasūni purvaṇīka hotardoṣā vastorerire yajñiyāsaḥ | kṣāmeva viśvā bhuvanāni yasmintsaṃ saubhagāni dadhire pāvake ||

translations.english: Bright blazing Agni, invoker of the gods, to you the adorable deities have appropriated, by night and day, the riches (on the oblation); they have deposited in the purifer (Agni) all good things (agnau vāmam vasu sam nyadadhata: Taittirīya Saṃhitā 1.5.1.1), as they have plural ced all beings upon earth.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं विक्षु प्रदिवः सीद आसु क्रत्वा रथीरभवो वार्याणाम् । अत इनोषि विधते चिकित्वो व्यानुषग्जातवेदो वसूनि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ vikṣu pradivaḥ sīda āsu kratvā rathīrabhavo vāryāṇām | ata inoṣi vidhate cikitvo vyānuṣagjātavedo vasūni ||

translations.english: You, abide from of old in these people, and by your deeds have been (to them) the conveyer of good things; thence, sage jātavedas, you bestow continually wealth upon the sacrificer.

mantras.sanskrit: यो नः सनुत्यो अभिदासदग्ने यो अन्तरो मित्रमहो वनुष्यात् । तमजरेभिर्वृषभिस्तव स्वैस्तपा तपिष्ठ तपसा तपस्वान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo naḥ sanutyo abhidāsadagne yo antaro mitramaho vanuṣyāt | tamajarebhirvṛṣabhistava svaistapā tapiṣṭha tapasā tapasvān ||

translations.english: Do you, protector of (your) friends, who are most resplendent, blazing with radiance, consume with your own imperishable flames him who injures us abiding in secret, or when near to us design us harm.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्ते यज्ञेन समिधा य उक्थैरर्केभिः सूनो सहसो ददाशत् । स मर्त्येष्वमृत प्रचेता राया द्युम्नेन श्रवसा वि भाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaste yajñena samidhā ya ukthairarkebhiḥ sūno sahaso dadāśat | sa martyeṣvamṛta pracetā rāyā dyumnena śravasā vi bhāti ||

translations.english: He who propitiates you, son of strenght, with sacrifice, with fuel, with prayers, with praises, shines immortal amongst men, eminent in wisdom and possessed of splendid opulence and (abundant) food.

mantras.sanskrit: स तत्कृधीषितस्तूयमग्ने स्पृधो बाधस्व सहसा सहस्वान् । यच्छस्यसे द्युभिरक्तो वचोभिस्तज्जुषस्व जरितुर्घोषि मन्म ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa tatkṛdhīṣitastūyamagne spṛdho bādhasva sahasā sahasvān | yacchasyase dyubhirakto vacobhistajjuṣasva jariturghoṣi manma ||

translations.english: Accomplish quickly, Agni, that for which you are solicited; endowed with strength, oppose by strength our adversaries; be plural ased, you are anointed with radiance, by loud vociferation of your worshipper, by whom you are adored with hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्याम तं काममग्ने तवोती अश्याम रयिं रयिवः सुवीरम् । अश्याम वाजमभि वाजयन्तोऽश्याम द्युम्नमजराजरं ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśyāma taṃ kāmamagne tavotī aśyāma rayiṃ rayivaḥ suvīram | aśyāma vājamabhi vājayanto'śyāma dyumnamajarājaraṃ te ||

translations.english: May we obtain through your protection, Agni, that which we desire; giver of riches, may we obtain of your riches and descendants; desiring food, may we obtain food; may we obtain, imperishable Agni, imperishable fame (through you).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र नव्यसा सहसः सूनुमच्छा यज्ञेन गातुमव इच्छमानः । वृश्चद्वनं कृष्णयामं रुशन्तं वीती होतारं दिव्यं जिगाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra navyasā sahasaḥ sūnumacchā yajñena gātumava icchamānaḥ | vṛścadvanaṃ kṛṣṇayāmaṃ ruśantaṃ vītī hotāraṃ divyaṃ jigāti ||

translations.english: He who is desirous of food has recourse with a new sacrifice, approachable son of strength (Agni), to you the consumer of forests, the dark-pathed, the bright shining, the ministrant (to the gods) of (sacrificial) food, the divine.

mantras.sanskrit: स श्वितानस्तन्यतू रोचनस्था अजरेभिर्नानदद्भिर्यविष्ठः । यः पावकः पुरुतमः पुरूणि पृथून्यग्निरनुयाति भर्वन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa śvitānastanyatū rocanasthā ajarebhirnānadadbhiryaviṣṭhaḥ | yaḥ pāvakaḥ purutamaḥ purūṇi pṛthūnyagniranuyāti bharvan ||

translations.english: (You who are) white-hued, vociferous, abiding in the firmament, (associated) with the imperishable, resounding (winds), the youngest (of the gods), Agni, who, purifying and most vast, proceeds, feeding upon numerous and substantial (forests).

mantras.sanskrit: वि ते विष्वग्वातजूतासो अग्ने भामासः शुचे शुचयश्चरन्ति । तुविम्रक्षासो दिव्या नवग्वा वना वनन्ति धृषता रुजन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi te viṣvagvātajūtāso agne bhāmāsaḥ śuce śucayaścaranti | tuvimrakṣāso divyā navagvā vanā vananti dhṛṣatā rujantaḥ ||

translations.english: Pure Agni, your bright flames, fanned by the wind, spread wide in every diection, consuming abundant (fuel); divine, fresh-rising, they plural y upon the woods, enveloping them in lustre.

mantras.sanskrit: ये ते शुक्रासः शुचयः शुचिष्मः क्षां वपन्ति विषितासो अश्वाः । अध भ्रमस्त उर्विया वि भाति यातयमानो अधि सानु पृश्नेः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye te śukrāsaḥ śucayaḥ śuciṣmaḥ kṣāṃ vapanti viṣitāso aśvāḥ | adha bhramasta urviyā vi bhāti yātayamāno adhi sānu pṛśneḥ ||

translations.english: Resplendent Agni, your bright rays, horses let loose (from the rein), shear the earth; your (band of flame), mounting above the high-lands of the many-tinted (earth), blazes fiercely.

mantras.sanskrit: अध जिह्वा पापतीति प्र वृष्णो गोषुयुधो नाशनिः सृजाना । शूरस्येव प्रसितिः क्षातिरग्नेर्दुर्वर्तुर्भीमो दयते वनानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha jihvā pāpatīti pra vṛṣṇo goṣuyudho nāśaniḥ sṛjānā | śūrasyeva prasitiḥ kṣātiragnerdurvarturbhīmo dayate vanāni ||

translations.english: The flame of the showerer (Agni), repeatedly descends like the hurled thunderbolt of the rescuer of the cattle; like the prowess of a hero is the destroying (energy) of Agni; irresistible and fearful, he consumes the forests.

mantras.sanskrit: आ भानुना पार्थिवानि ज्रयांसि महस्तोदस्य धृषता ततन्थ । स बाधस्वाप भया सहोभिः स्पृधो वनुष्यन्वनुषो नि जूर्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā bhānunā pārthivāni jrayāṃsi mahastodasya dhṛṣatā tatantha | sa bādhasvāpa bhayā sahobhiḥ spṛdho vanuṣyanvanuṣo ni jūrva ||

translations.english: You overspread the accessible plural ces of the earth with light by the energy of you powerful, exciting (influence); do you disperse all perils, and, baffing (our) adversaries by your mighty (powers), destroy (our) foes.

mantras.sanskrit: स चित्र चित्रं चितयन्तमस्मे चित्रक्षत्र चित्रतमं वयोधाम् । चन्द्रं रयिं पुरुवीरं बृहन्तं चन्द्र चन्द्राभिर्गृणते युवस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa citra citraṃ citayantamasme citrakṣatra citratamaṃ vayodhām | candraṃ rayiṃ puruvīraṃ bṛhantaṃ candra candrābhirgṛṇate yuvasva ||

translations.english: Wonderful Agni, of wonderful strength, bestower of delight, grant to us, and to him who praises you with gratifying (praises), wonderful, most wonderful riches, conferring fame, supplying food, comprehending male descendants,d electable and infinite.

mantras.sanskrit: मूर्धानं दिवो अरतिं पृथिव्या वैश्वानरमृत आ जातमग्निम् । कविं सम्राजमतिथिं जनानामासन्ना पात्रं जनयन्त देवाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mūrdhānaṃ divo aratiṃ pṛthivyā vaiśvānaramṛta ā jātamagnim | kaviṃ samrājamatithiṃ janānāmāsannā pātraṃ janayanta devāḥ ||

translations.english: The gods have genitive rated vaśvānara Agni, as the brow of heaven, the unceasing pervader of earth, born for (the celebration of) sacrifice, wise, imperial, the guest of men, in whose mouth (is) the vessel (that conveys the oblation to the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: नाभिं यज्ञानां सदनं रयीणां महामाहावमभि सं नवन्त । वैश्वानरं रथ्यमध्वराणां यज्ञस्य केतुं जनयन्त देवाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nābhiṃ yajñānāṃ sadanaṃ rayīṇāṃ mahāmāhāvamabhi saṃ navanta | vaiśvānaraṃ rathyamadhvarāṇāṃ yajñasya ketuṃ janayanta devāḥ ||

translations.english: (The worshippers) glorify together, (Agni), the bond of sacrifices, the abode of riches, the great receptacle of burnt-offerings; the gods genitive rate vaśvānara, the conveyer of oblations, the emblem of sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वद्विप्रो जायते वाज्यग्ने त्वद्वीरासो अभिमातिषाहः । वैश्वानर त्वमस्मासु धेहि वसूनि राजन्त्स्पृहयाय्याणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvadvipro jāyate vājyagne tvadvīrāso abhimātiṣāhaḥ | vaiśvānara tvamasmāsu dhehi vasūni rājantspṛhayāyyāṇi ||

translations.english: The offerer of (sacrificial) food becomes wise, Agni, from you heroes become the vanquishers of foes; therefore, do you, royal vaiśvānara, bestow upon us enviable riches.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वां विश्वे अमृत जायमानं शिशुं न देवा अभि सं नवन्ते । तव क्रतुभिरमृतत्वमायन्वैश्वानर यत्पित्रोरदीदेः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāṃ viśve amṛta jāyamānaṃ śiśuṃ na devā abhi saṃ navante | tava kratubhiramṛtatvamāyanvaiśvānara yatpitroradīdeḥ ||

translations.english: All the worshippers together praise you, immortal, Agni, when born like an infant; when you shine vaiśvānara, between the parental (heaven and earth) they obtain immortality through your (sacred) rites.

mantras.sanskrit: वैश्वानर तव तानि व्रतानि महान्यग्ने नकिरा दधर्ष । यज्जायमानः पित्रोरुपस्थेऽविन्दः केतुं वयुनेष्वह्नाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vaiśvānara tava tāni vratāni mahānyagne nakirā dadharṣa | yajjāyamānaḥ pitrorupasthe'vindaḥ ketuṃ vayuneṣvahnām ||

translations.english: Agni, vaiśvānara, these your mighty deeds no one can resist; when born on the lap of your parents, you have stationed the banner of the days on the paths of the firmament.

mantras.sanskrit: वैश्वानरस्य विमितानि चक्षसा सानूनि दिवो अमृतस्य केतुना । तस्येदु विश्वा भुवनाधि मूर्धनि वया इव रुरुहुः सप्त विस्रुहः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vaiśvānarasya vimitāni cakṣasā sānūni divo amṛtasya ketunā | tasyedu viśvā bhuvanādhi mūrdhani vayā iva ruruhuḥ sapta visruhaḥ ||

translations.english: The summits of the firmament are measured by the light of vaiśvānara, the manifester of ambrosial (rain); all the regions are overspread (by the vapour) on his brow, and the seven gliding (streams) spring from thence like branches.

mantras.sanskrit: वि यो रजांस्यमिमीत सुक्रतुर्वैश्वानरो वि दिवो रोचना कविः । परि यो विश्वा भुवनानि पप्रथेऽदब्धो गोपा अमृतस्य रक्षिता ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi yo rajāṃsyamimīta sukraturvaiśvānaro vi divo rocanā kaviḥ | pari yo viśvā bhuvanāni paprathe'dabdho gopā amṛtasya rakṣitā ||

translations.english: Vaiśvānara, the performer of sacred acts, is he who made the regions; foreseeing (he has made) the luminaries of heaven, and has spread throughout all worlds; the irresistibel guardian (of all), the protector of ambrosial (rain).

mantras.sanskrit: पृक्षस्य वृष्णो अरुषस्य नू सहः प्र नु वोचं विदथा जातवेदसः । वैश्वानराय मतिर्नव्यसी शुचिः सोम इव पवते चारुरग्नये ॥
mantras.transliteration: pṛkṣasya vṛṣṇo aruṣasya nū sahaḥ pra nu vocaṃ vidathā jātavedasaḥ | vaiśvānarāya matirnavyasī śuciḥ soma iva pavate cāruragnaye ||

translations.english: I commemorate promptly at the holy ceremony the might of the all-pervading jātavaedasa, the showerer, the radiant; new, pure, and graceful praise issues (from me) like the soma juice (from the filter), to Agni vaiśvānara.

mantras.sanskrit: स जायमानः परमे व्योमनि व्रतान्यग्निर्व्रतपा अरक्षत । व्यन्तरिक्षममिमीत सुक्रतुर्वैश्वानरो महिना नाकमस्पृशत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa jāyamānaḥ parame vyomani vratānyagnirvratapā arakṣata | vyantarikṣamamimīta sukraturvaiśvānaro mahinā nākamaspṛśat ||

translations.english: That Agni who, as soon as born in the highest heaven, the protector of sacred rites, protects the pious acts (of men), he has made he manifold firmament; vaiśvānara, the performer of good deeds, has attained heaven by his greatness.

mantras.sanskrit: व्यस्तभ्नाद्रोदसी मित्रो अद्भुतोऽन्तर्वावदकृणोज्ज्योतिषा तमः । वि चर्मणीव धिषणे अवर्तयद्वैश्वानरो विश्वमधत्त वृष्ण्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vyastabhnādrodasī mitro adbhuto'ntarvāvadakṛṇojjyotiṣā tamaḥ | vi carmaṇīva dhiṣaṇe avartayadvaiśvānaro viśvamadhatta vṛṣṇyam ||

translations.english: The friend (of all), the wonderful (agni), has upheld heaven and earth; he has hidden darkness within light; he has spread out the two sustaining (worlds, heaven and earth), like two skins; vaiśvānara comprehends all (creaive) energy.

mantras.sanskrit: अपामुपस्थे महिषा अगृभ्णत विशो राजानमुप तस्थुॠग्मियम् । आ दूतो अग्निमभरद्विवस्वतो वैश्वानरं मातरिश्वा परावतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: apāmupasthe mahiṣā agṛbhṇata viśo rājānamupa tasthuṝgmiyam | ā dūto agnimabharadvivasvato vaiśvānaraṃ mātariśvā parāvataḥ ||

translations.english: The mighty maruts have seized upon him on the lap of the waters (in firmament), and men have acknowledged him as their adorable sovereign; mātariśvan, the messenger of the gods, has brought Agni vaiśvānara (hither) from the distant (sphere of the) sun.

mantras.sanskrit: युगेयुगे विदथ्यं गृणद्भ्योऽग्ने रयिं यशसं धेहि नव्यसीम् । पव्येव राजन्नघशंसमजर नीचा नि वृश्च वनिनं न तेजसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yugeyuge vidathyaṃ gṛṇadbhyo'gne rayiṃ yaśasaṃ dhehi navyasīm | pavyeva rājannaghaśaṃsamajara nīcā ni vṛśca vaninaṃ na tejasā ||

translations.english: To those, Agni, who repeat new (praises) to you, the object of their worship from age to age, grant riches and famous (posterity); strike don, undecaying, sovereign, the sinner with your blaze like the thunderbolt, as if he were a tree.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्माकमग्ने मघवत्सु धारयानामि क्षत्रमजरं सुवीर्यम् । वयं जयेम शतिनं सहस्रिणं वैश्वानर वाजमग्ने तवोतिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmākamagne maghavatsu dhārayānāmi kṣatramajaraṃ suvīryam | vayaṃ jayema śatinaṃ sahasriṇaṃ vaiśvānara vājamagne tavotibhiḥ ||

translations.english: Grant, Agni, to us who are affluent in (offerings), wealth that cannot be taken away, that is exempt from decay, and that comprehends excellent male descendants may we obtain, Agni vaiśvānara, hundreds and thousands of viands through your protection.

mantras.sanskrit: अदब्धेभिस्तव गोपाभिरिष्टेऽस्माकं पाहि त्रिषधस्थ सूरीन् । रक्षा च नो ददुषां शर्धो अग्ने वैश्वानर प्र च तारीः स्तवानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adabdhebhistava gopābhiriṣṭe'smākaṃ pāhi triṣadhastha sūrīn | rakṣā ca no daduṣāṃ śardho agne vaiśvānara pra ca tārīḥ stavānaḥ ||

translations.english: Adored Agni, present in the three worlds, protect your worshippers with your irresistible protections, preserve the strength of us who offer (oblations); glorified (by us), Agni vaiśvānara, transport us (beyond evil).

mantras.sanskrit: अहश्च कृष्णमहरर्जुनं च वि वर्तेते रजसी वेद्याभिः । वैश्वानरो जायमानो न राजावातिरज्ज्योतिषाग्निस्तमांसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaśca kṛṣṇamahararjunaṃ ca vi vartete rajasī vedyābhiḥ | vaiśvānaro jāyamāno na rājāvātirajjyotiṣāgnistamāṃsi ||

translations.english: The dark day and the light day revolve alternate, affecting (the world) by their recognizable (properties); Agni vaiśvānara, manifested like a prince, dispels darkness by his lustre.

mantras.sanskrit: नाहं तन्तुं न वि जानाम्योतुं न यं वयन्ति समरेऽतमानाः । कस्य स्वित्पुत्र इह वक्त्वानि परो वदात्यवरेण पित्रा ॥
mantras.transliteration: nāhaṃ tantuṃ na vi jānāmyotuṃ na yaṃ vayanti samare'tamānāḥ | kasya svitputra iha vaktvāni paro vadātyavareṇa pitrā ||

translations.english: I understand not the threads (of the warp), nor the threads of the woof, nor that (cloth) which those who are assiduous in united exertion weave; of what (man) may the son declare the words that are to be spoken in the next world, (instrumental ucted) by a father abiding below.

mantras.sanskrit: स इत्तन्तुं स वि जानात्योतुं स वक्त्वान्यृतुथा वदाति । य ईं चिकेतदमृतस्य गोपा अवश्चरन्परो अन्येन पश्यन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa ittantuṃ sa vi jānātyotuṃ sa vaktvānyṛtuthā vadāti | ya īṃ ciketadamṛtasya gopā avaścaranparo anyena paśyan ||

translations.english: He verily knows the threads of the warp and or the woof, he speaks in due season what is to be said, who comprehends all this (universe); who is the protector of ambrosial water, sojourning both above and below, and contemplating (the world) under a different (manifestation).

mantras.sanskrit: अयं होता प्रथमः पश्यतेममिदं ज्योतिरमृतं मर्त्येषु । अयं स जज्ञे ध्रुव आ निषत्तोऽमर्त्यस्तन्वा वर्धमानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ hotā prathamaḥ paśyatemamidaṃ jyotiramṛtaṃ martyeṣu | ayaṃ sa jajñe dhruva ā niṣatto'martyastanvā vardhamānaḥ ||

translations.english: This vaiśvānara is the first offerer of burnt offerings; behold him; this is the light immortal among mortals; he has been born in a bodily shape, immoveable, all-pervading, immortal, ever increasing.

mantras.sanskrit: ध्रुवं ज्योतिर्निहितं दृशये कं मनो जविष्ठं पतयत्स्वन्तः । विश्वे देवाः समनसः सकेता एकं क्रतुमभि वि यन्ति साधु ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhruvaṃ jyotirnihitaṃ dṛśaye kaṃ mano javiṣṭhaṃ patayatsvantaḥ | viśve devāḥ samanasaḥ saketā ekaṃ kratumabhi vi yanti sādhu ||

translations.english: A steady light, swifter than thought, stationed among moving beings to show (the way) to happiness all the gods being of one mind, and of like wisdom, proceed respectfully to the presence of the one (chief) agent (vaiśvānara).

mantras.sanskrit: वि मे कर्णा पतयतो वि चक्षुर्वीदं ज्योतिर्हृदय आहितं यत् । वि मे मनश्चरति दूरआधीः किं स्विद्वक्ष्यामि किमु नू मनिष्ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi me karṇā patayato vi cakṣurvīdaṃ jyotirhṛdaya āhitaṃ yat | vi me manaścarati dūraādhīḥ kiṃ svidvakṣyāmi kimu nū maniṣye ||

translations.english: My ears are turned (to hear him), my eyes (to behold him); this light that is plural ced in the heart (seeks to know him); my mind, the receptable of distant (objects) hastens (towards him); what shall I declare him? How shall I comprehend him?

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वे देवा अनमस्यन्भियानास्त्वामग्ने तमसि तस्थिवांसम् । वैश्वानरोऽवतूतये नोऽमर्त्योऽवतूतये नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśve devā anamasyanbhiyānāstvāmagne tamasi tasthivāṃsam | vaiśvānaro'vatūtaye no'martyo'vatūtaye naḥ ||

translations.english: All the gods, alarmed, venerate you, Agni, abiding in darkness; may vaiśvānara preserve us with his protection; may the immortal Agni preserve us with his protection.

mantras.sanskrit: पुरो वो मन्द्रं दिव्यं सुवृक्तिं प्रयति यज्ञे अग्निमध्वरे दधिध्वम् । पुर उक्थेभिः स हि नो विभावा स्वध्वरा करति जातवेदाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: puro vo mandraṃ divyaṃ suvṛktiṃ prayati yajñe agnimadhvare dadhidhvam | pura ukthebhiḥ sa hi no vibhāvā svadhvarā karati jātavedāḥ ||

translations.english: plural ce before you at the progressive, uninterrupted sacrifice, the divine, adorable, perfect Agni, with prayers; for he, the resplendent jātavedas, makes us prosperous in sacred rites.

mantras.sanskrit: तमु द्युमः पुर्वणीक होतरग्ने अग्निभिर्मनुष इधानः । स्तोमं यमस्मै ममतेव शूषं घृतं न शुचि मतयः पवन्ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamu dyumaḥ purvaṇīka hotaragne agnibhirmanuṣa idhānaḥ | stomaṃ yamasmai mamateva śūṣaṃ ghṛtaṃ na śuci matayaḥ pavante ||

translations.english: Brilliant, may-rayed Agni, invoker of the gods, kindled with many fires, (hear) this (praise) of men; which delightful praise, pure as the clarified butter (that has been filtered), his worshippers offer unto him as mamatā (formerly offered it).

mantras.sanskrit: पीपाय स श्रवसा मर्त्येषु यो अग्नये ददाश विप्र उक्थैः । चित्राभिस्तमूतिभिश्चित्रशोचिर्व्रजस्य साता गोमतो दधाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: pīpāya sa śravasā martyeṣu yo agnaye dadāśa vipra ukthaiḥ | citrābhistamūtibhiścitraśocirvrajasya sātā gomato dadhāti ||

translations.english: He thrives in abundance among men, who, pious, presents to Agni (oblations) with prayers; the wonderfully radian Agni plural ces him with marvellous protection in the enjoyment of pasturage full of herds of cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यः पप्रौ जायमान उर्वी दूरेदृशा भासा कृष्णाध्वा । अध बहु चित्तम ऊर्म्यायास्तिरः शोचिषा ददृशे पावकः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yaḥ paprau jāyamāna urvī dūredṛśā bhāsā kṛṣṇādhvā | adha bahu cittama ūrmyāyāstiraḥ śociṣā dadṛśe pāvakaḥ ||

translations.english: The dark-pathed, as soon as genitive rated, filled with his afar-seen light the two spacious (worlds); he, the purifer, is now beheld dispersing with his radiance the thick glooms of night.

mantras.sanskrit: नू नश्चित्रं पुरुवाजाभिरूती अग्ने रयिं मघवद्भ्यश्च धेहि । ये राधसा श्रवसा चात्यन्यान्त्सुवीर्येभिश्चाभि सन्ति जनान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū naścitraṃ puruvājābhirūtī agne rayiṃ maghavadbhyaśca dhehi | ye rādhasā śravasā cātyanyāntsuvīryebhiścābhi santi janān ||

translations.english: Bestow quickly, Agni, upon us who are affluent (in oblations), wondrous wealth), with abundant viands and protections, such as enrich other men with wealth with food, and with male descendants.

mantras.sanskrit: इमं यज्ञं चनो धा अग्न उशन्यं त आसानो जुहुते हविष्मान् । भरद्वाजेषु दधिषे सुवृक्तिमवीर्वाजस्य गध्यस्य सातौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: imaṃ yajñaṃ cano dhā agna uśanyaṃ ta āsāno juhute haviṣmān | bharadvājeṣu dadhiṣe suvṛktimavīrvājasya gadhyasya sātau ||

translations.english: Agni desirous (of the offering), accept this sacrifice, this food which the presenter (of the oblation), sitting down (before you), offers unto you; accept the blameless (praises) of the bhāradvāja (race), and favour them that they may obtain many sorts of food.

mantras.sanskrit: वि द्वेषांसीनुहि वर्धयेळां मदेम शतहिमाः सुवीराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi dveṣāṃsīnuhi vardhayeḷāṃ madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ ||

translations.english: Scatter (our enemies); augment our abundance; and may we, blessed with virtuous male descendants, enjoy happiness for a hundred winters.

mantras.sanskrit: यजस्व होतरिषितो यजीयानग्ने बाधो मरुतां न प्रयुक्ति । आ नो मित्रावरुणा नासत्या द्यावा होत्राय पृथिवी ववृत्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajasva hotariṣito yajīyānagne bādho marutāṃ na prayukti | ā no mitrāvaruṇā nāsatyā dyāvā hotrāya pṛthivī vavṛtyāḥ ||

translations.english: {Text is missing}

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं होता मन्द्रतमो नो अध्रुगन्तर्देवो विदथा मर्त्येषु । पावकया जुह्वा वह्निरासाग्ने यजस्व तन्वं तव स्वाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ hotā mandratamo no adhrugantardevo vidathā martyeṣu | pāvakayā juhvā vahnirāsāgne yajasva tanvaṃ tava svām ||

translations.english: {Text is missing}

mantras.sanskrit: धन्या चिद्धि त्वे धिषणा वष्टि प्र देवाञ्जन्म गृणते यजध्यै । वेपिष्ठो अङ्गिरसां यद्ध विप्रो मधु च्छन्दो भनति रेभ इष्टौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhanyā ciddhi tve dhiṣaṇā vaṣṭi pra devāñjanma gṛṇate yajadhyai | vepiṣṭho aṅgirasāṃ yaddha vipro madhu cchando bhanati rebha iṣṭau ||

translations.english: {Text is missing}

mantras.sanskrit: अदिद्युतत्स्वपाको विभावाग्ने यजस्व रोदसी उरूची । आयुं न यं नमसा रातहव्या अञ्जन्ति सुप्रयसं पञ्च जनाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adidyutatsvapāko vibhāvāgne yajasva rodasī urūcī | āyuṃ na yaṃ namasā rātahavyā añjanti suprayasaṃ pañca janāḥ ||

translations.english: {Text is missing}

mantras.sanskrit: वृञ्जे ह यन्नमसा बर्हिरग्नावयामि स्रुग्घृतवती सुवृक्तिः । अम्यक्षि सद्म सदने पृथिव्या अश्रायि यज्ञः सूर्ये न चक्षुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛñje ha yannamasā barhiragnāvayāmi srugghṛtavatī suvṛktiḥ | amyakṣi sadma sadane pṛthivyā aśrāyi yajñaḥ sūrye na cakṣuḥ ||

translations.english: {Text is missing}

mantras.sanskrit: दशस्या नः पुर्वणीक होतर्देवेभिरग्ने अग्निभिरिधानः । रायः सूनो सहसो वावसाना अति स्रसेम वृजनं नांहः ॥
mantras.transliteration: daśasyā naḥ purvaṇīka hotardevebhiragne agnibhiridhānaḥ | rāyaḥ sūno sahaso vāvasānā ati srasema vṛjanaṃ nāṃhaḥ ||

translations.english: {Text is missing}

mantras.sanskrit: मध्ये होता दुरोणे बर्हिषो राळग्निस्तोदस्य रोदसी यजध्यै । अयं स सूनुः सहस ऋतावा दूरात्सूर्यो न शोचिषा ततान ॥
mantras.transliteration: madhye hotā duroṇe barhiṣo rāḷagnistodasya rodasī yajadhyai | ayaṃ sa sūnuḥ sahasa ṛtāvā dūrātsūryo na śociṣā tatāna ||

translations.english: Agni, the invoker of the gods, the lord of sacrifice, abides in the dwelling of the instrumental tutor of the rite, to offer sacrifice to heaven and earth; he, the son of strength, the observer of truth, has overspread (the world) from afar, like the sun, with light.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यस्मिन्त्वे स्वपाके यजत्र यक्षद्राजन्त्सर्वतातेव नु द्यौः । त्रिषधस्थस्ततरुषो न जंहो हव्या मघानि मानुषा यजध्यै ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yasmintve svapāke yajatra yakṣadrājantsarvatāteva nu dyauḥ | triṣadhasthastataruṣo na jaṃho havyā maghāni mānuṣā yajadhyai ||

translations.english: Adorable and resplendent Agni, to whom, mature in wisdom, the worshipper offers oblations at every sacred rite, do you, who are present in the three (worlds), move with the speed of the traverser (of the sky, the sun), to convey the valuable oblations of men (to the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: तेजिष्ठा यस्यारतिर्वनेराट् तोदो अध्वन्न वृधसानो अद्यौत् । अद्रोघो न द्रविता चेतति त्मन्नमर्त्योऽवर्त्र ओषधीषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: tejiṣṭhā yasyāratirvanerāṭ todo adhvanna vṛdhasāno adyaut | adrogho na dravitā cetati tmannamartyo'vartra oṣadhīṣu ||

translations.english: He, whose pure and spreading flame blazes in the forest, shines with increasing intensity, like the sun on his (celestial) path; rushing like the innoxious (wind) among the plural nts, immortal, unimpeded, he lights up (all things) by his own (lustre).

mantras.sanskrit: सास्माकेभिरेतरी न शूषैरग्निः ष्टवे दम आ जातवेदाः । द्र्वन्नो वन्वन्क्रत्वा नार्वोस्रः पितेव जारयायि यज्ञैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sāsmākebhiretarī na śūṣairagniḥ ṣṭave dama ā jātavedāḥ | drvanno vanvankratvā nārvosraḥ piteva jārayāyi yajñaiḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, who knows all that exists, is propitiated in our dwelling by our praises, like those gratifying (commendations which proceed) from one soliciting (a favour); feeder upon trees, consumer of forests, impetuous in act as the bull, the (progenitor of calves), he is glorified by the celebration of sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: अध स्मास्य पनयन्ति भासो वृथा यत्तक्षदनुयाति पृथ्वीम् । सद्यो यः स्यन्द्रो विषितो धवीयानृणो न तायुरति धन्वा राट् ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha smāsya panayanti bhāso vṛthā yattakṣadanuyāti pṛthvīm | sadyo yaḥ syandro viṣito dhavīyānṛṇo na tāyurati dhanvā rāṭ ||

translations.english: They glorify his flames in this world; when, easily thinning the woods, they spread over the earth; he, who glides along unarrested, and rapid in movement as a fast flying thief, shines over the desert.

mantras.sanskrit: स त्वं नो अर्वन्निदाया विश्वेभिरग्ने अग्निभिरिधानः । वेषि रायो वि यासि दुच्छुना मदेम शतहिमाः सुवीराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa tvaṃ no arvannidāyā viśvebhiragne agnibhiridhānaḥ | veṣi rāyo vi yāsi ducchunā madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ ||

translations.english: Quick-moving Agni, kindled with all (your) fires, (guard) us from reproach; you bestow rices, you scattered adversaries; may we, blessed with excellent male descendants, enjoy happiness for a hundred winters.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वद्विश्वा सुभग सौभगान्यग्ने वि यन्ति वनिनो न वयाः । श्रुष्टी रयिर्वाजो वृत्रतूर्ये दिवो वृष्टिरीड्यो रीतिरपाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvadviśvā subhaga saubhagānyagne vi yanti vanino na vayāḥ | śruṣṭī rayirvājo vṛtratūrye divo vṛṣṭirīḍyo rītirapām ||

translations.english: Auspicious Agni, all good things proceed from you like branches (from the trunk) of a tree, renowned rices, vigour for the destruction of foes, the rain of heaven; you are to be glorified the sender of the waters.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं भगो न आ हि रत्नमिषे परिज्मेव क्षयसि दस्मवर्चाः । अग्ने मित्रो न बृहत ऋतस्यासि क्षत्ता वामस्य देव भूरेः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ bhago na ā hi ratnamiṣe parijmeva kṣayasi dasmavarcāḥ | agne mitro na bṛhata ṛtasyāsi kṣattā vāmasya deva bhūreḥ ||

translations.english: Do you, who are adorable, bestow upon us precious wealth; beautiful with radiance, you pass (around) like the circumambient (wind); you, divine Agni, are like mitra, the giver of abundant water and ample wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: स सत्पतिः शवसा हन्ति वृत्रमग्ने विप्रो वि पणेर्भर्ति वाजम् । यं त्वं प्रचेत ऋतजात राया सजोषा नप्त्रापां हिनोषि ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa satpatiḥ śavasā hanti vṛtramagne vipro vi paṇerbharti vājam | yaṃ tvaṃ praceta ṛtajāta rāyā sajoṣā naptrāpāṃ hinoṣi ||

translations.english: That man, the protector of the virtuous, destroys, Agni, his enemy by his strength, and baffles, intelligent, the might of (the asura) paṇi, whom you, the wise, the parent of the sacrifice, consentient with the grandson of the waters, encourage (in the hope of) riches.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्ते सूनो सहसो गीर्भिरुक्थैर्यज्ञैर्मर्तो निशितिं वेद्यानट् । विश्वं स देव प्रति वारमग्ने धत्ते धान्यं पत्यते वसव्यैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaste sūno sahaso gīrbhirukthairyajñairmarto niśitiṃ vedyānaṭ | viśvaṃ sa deva prati vāramagne dhatte dhānyaṃ patyate vasavyaiḥ ||

translations.english: The mortal who by praise, by prayers, by sacrifices, attracts, son of strength, your heightened (radiance) to the altar, enjoys all-sufficiency and corn, and abounds in wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: ता नृभ्य आ सौश्रवसा सुवीराग्ने सूनो सहसः पुष्यसे धाः । कृणोषि यच्छवसा भूरि पश्वो वयो वृकायारये जसुरये ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā nṛbhya ā sauśravasā suvīrāgne sūno sahasaḥ puṣyase dhāḥ | kṛṇoṣi yacchavasā bhūri paśvo vayo vṛkāyāraye jasuraye ||

translations.english: Grant, son of strength, to men (who praise you), those abundant viands and excellent descendants, (that may contribute) to their prosperity; grant also that copious sustenance from cattle, which by your strength you take away from a churlish and malignant adversary.

mantras.sanskrit: वद्मा सूनो सहसो नो विहाया अग्ने तोकं तनयं वाजि नो दाः । विश्वाभिर्गीर्भिरभि पूर्तिमश्यां मदेम शतहिमाः सुवीराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vadmā sūno sahaso no vihāyā agne tokaṃ tanayaṃ vāji no dāḥ | viśvābhirgīrbhirabhi pūrtimaśyāṃ madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, son of strength, do you who are mighty be our councillor; give us sons and grandsons, together with food; may I, by all my praises, obtain the fulfilment of my desires; may we, blessed with excellent male descendants, enjoy happiness for a hundred winters.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ना यो मर्त्यो दुवो धियं जुजोष धीतिभिः । भसन्नु ष प्र पूर्व्य इषं वुरीतावसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnā yo martyo duvo dhiyaṃ jujoṣa dhītibhiḥ | bhasannu ṣa pra pūrvya iṣaṃ vurītāvase ||

translations.english: May the mortal who propitiates Agni by devotion and worship, together with praises, quickly become distinguished as first (among men), and acquire ample food for the support (of his children).

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निरिद्धि प्रचेता अग्निर्वेधस्तम ऋषिः । अग्निं होतारमीळते यज्ञेषु मनुषो विशः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniriddhi pracetā agnirvedhastama ṛṣiḥ | agniṃ hotāramīḷate yajñeṣu manuṣo viśaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni verily is most wise; he is the chief performer of religious rites, a holy sage; the progeny of men glorify Agni as the invoker of the gods at sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: नाना ह्यग्नेऽवसे स्पर्धन्ते रायो अर्यः । तूर्वन्तो दस्युमायवो व्रतैः सीक्षन्तो अव्रतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nānā hyagne'vase spardhante rāyo aryaḥ | tūrvanto dasyumāyavo vrataiḥ sīkṣanto avratam ||

translations.english: The manifold treasures of the enemy (detached from them) are emulous, Agni, for the preservation (of your worshippers); men who worship you, triumphing over the spoiler, seek to shame him who celebrates no sacred rite by (their) observances.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निरप्सामृतीषहं वीरं ददाति सत्पतिम् । यस्य त्रसन्ति शवसः संचक्षि शत्रवो भिया ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirapsāmṛtīṣahaṃ vīraṃ dadāti satpatim | yasya trasanti śavasaḥ saṃcakṣi śatravo bhiyā ||

translations.english: Agni bestows (upon his worshippers) a male descendant, (the performer of good) works, the subduer of foes, the protector of the virtuous, at whose appearance his enemies tremble through fear of his prowess.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निर्हि विद्मना निदो देवो मर्तमुरुष्यति । सहावा यस्यावृतो रयिर्वाजेष्ववृतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirhi vidmanā nido devo martamuruṣyati | sahāvā yasyāvṛto rayirvājeṣvavṛtaḥ ||

translations.english: The mighty and divine Agni, endowed with knowledge, protects the mortal from reproach whose rich (offerings) are unobstructed (by evil spirits), and unshared by other (offerers) at sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: अच्छा नो मित्रमहो देव देवानग्ने वोचः सुमतिं रोदस्योः । वीहि स्वस्तिं सुक्षितिं दिवो नॄन्द्विषो अंहांसि दुरिता तरेम ता तरेम तवावसा तरेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: acchā no mitramaho deva devānagne vocaḥ sumatiṃ rodasyoḥ | vīhi svastiṃ sukṣitiṃ divo nṝndviṣo aṃhāṃsi duritā tarema tā tarema tavāvasā tarema ||

translations.english: Divine Agni, revered as a friend, who, abiding in heaven and earth, communicates our praise to the gods, conduct the offerer of adoration to domestic felicity, and may we overcome our adversaries, our iniquities, our difficulties; may we overcome them by your protection.

mantras.sanskrit: इममू षु वो अतिथिमुषर्बुधं विश्वासां विशां पतिमृञ्जसे गिरा । वेतीद्दिवो जनुषा कच्चिदा शुचिर्ज्योक्चिदत्ति गर्भो यदच्युतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: imamū ṣu vo atithimuṣarbudhaṃ viśvāsāṃ viśāṃ patimṛñjase girā | vetīddivo januṣā kaccidā śucirjyokcidatti garbho yadacyutam ||

translations.english: Propitiate by praises this guest who wakes at dawn, the cherisher of all people, who on every occasion descends, pure of origin, from heaven, and, present as the embryo (in the wood of attrition), consumes immediately the offered (oblation).

mantras.sanskrit: मित्रं न यं सुधितं भृगवो दधुर्वनस्पतावीड्यमूर्ध्वशोचिषम् । स त्वं सुप्रीतो वीतहव्ये अद्भुत प्रशस्तिभिर्महयसे दिवेदिवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: mitraṃ na yaṃ sudhitaṃ bhṛgavo dadhurvanaspatāvīḍyamūrdhvaśociṣam | sa tvaṃ suprīto vītahavye adbhuta praśastibhirmahayase divedive ||

translations.english: Wonderful Agni, whom, adorable and upward flaming, the bhṛgus regard as a friend, deposited in the wood of (attrition), be plural ased with vītahavya, since you are glorified by (his) praise everyday.

mantras.sanskrit: स त्वं दक्षस्यावृको वृधो भूरर्यः परस्यान्तरस्य तरुषः । रायः सूनो सहसो मर्त्येष्वा छर्दिर्यच्छ वीतहव्याय सप्रथो भरद्वाजाय सप्रथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa tvaṃ dakṣasyāvṛko vṛdho bhūraryaḥ parasyāntarasya taruṣaḥ | rāyaḥ sūno sahaso martyeṣvā chardiryaccha vītahavyāya sapratho bharadvājāya saprathaḥ ||

translations.english: Do you, who are unresisted, become the benefactor of him who is skilled (in sacred rites), his defender against a near of distant enemy; son of strength, who are ever renowned, grant wealth and a dwelling to vītahavya, the offerer of the oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: द्युतानं वो अतिथिं स्वर्णरमग्निं होतारं मनुषः स्वध्वरम् । विप्रं न द्युक्षवचसं सुवृक्तिभिर्हव्यवाहमरतिं देवमृञ्जसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: dyutānaṃ vo atithiṃ svarṇaramagniṃ hotāraṃ manuṣaḥ svadhvaram | vipraṃ na dyukṣavacasaṃ suvṛktibhirhavyavāhamaratiṃ devamṛñjase ||

translations.english: Propitiate with pious praises the radiant Agni, your guest, the guide to heaven, the invoker of the gods( at the sacrifice) of manu, the celebrator of holy rites, the speaker of brilliant words like a learned sage, the bearer of oblations (to the gods), the lord, the divine.

mantras.sanskrit: पावकया यश्चितयन्त्या कृपा क्षामन्रुरुच उषसो न भानुना । तूर्वन्न यामन्नेतशस्य नू रण आ यो घृणे न ततृषाणो अजरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pāvakayā yaścitayantyā kṛpā kṣāmanruruca uṣaso na bhānunā | tūrvanna yāmannetaśasya nū raṇa ā yo ghṛṇe na tatṛṣāṇo ajaraḥ ||

translations.english: (Propitiate him) who shines upon the earth with purifying and enlightening lustre, as the dawns with ligt; him, who like (a warrior) discomfiting (his foes) quickly blazed forth in the contest in defence of etaśa; him, who is satiated (with food), exempt from decay.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निमग्निं वः समिधा दुवस्यत प्रियम्प्रियं वो अतिथिं गृणीषणि । उप वो गीर्भिरमृतं विवासत देवो देवेषु वनते हि वार्यं देवो देवेषु वनते हि नो दुवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnimagniṃ vaḥ samidhā duvasyata priyampriyaṃ vo atithiṃ gṛṇīṣaṇi | upa vo gīrbhiramṛtaṃ vivāsata devo deveṣu vanate hi vāryaṃ devo deveṣu vanate hi no duvaḥ ||

translations.english: Worship repeatedly the adorable Agni with fuel (him) who is ever your dear friend, your guest; approach the immortal Agni with praises, for he, a god among gods, accepts our homage.

mantras.sanskrit: समिद्धमग्निं समिधा गिरा गृणे शुचिं पावकं पुरो अध्वरे ध्रुवम् । विप्रं होतारं पुरुवारमद्रुहं कविं सुम्नैरीमहे जातवेदसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: samiddhamagniṃ samidhā girā gṛṇe śuciṃ pāvakaṃ puro adhvare dhruvam | vipraṃ hotāraṃ puruvāramadruhaṃ kaviṃ sumnairīmahe jātavedasam ||

translations.english: I glorify with praise the kindled Agni, pure purifying, permanent, (plural ced) before (us) at the sacrifice; let us celebrate with plural asant (hymns) the wise Agni, the invoker of the gods, the adored of many, the benevolent, the far-seeing, him who knows all that exists.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वां दूतमग्ने अमृतं युगेयुगे हव्यवाहं दधिरे पायुमीड्यम् । देवासश्च मर्तासश्च जागृविं विभुं विश्पतिं नमसा नि षेदिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāṃ dūtamagne amṛtaṃ yugeyuge havyavāhaṃ dadhire pāyumīḍyam | devāsaśca martāsaśca jāgṛviṃ vibhuṃ viśpatiṃ namasā ni ṣedire ||

translations.english: You, Agni, have gods and men in every age retained as their messenger, immortal bearer of oblations, beneficent, adorable; they have plural ced him with reverence (upon the altar), vigilant, pervading, the protector of mankind.

mantras.sanskrit: विभूषन्नग्न उभयाँ अनु व्रता दूतो देवानां रजसी समीयसे । यत्ते धीतिं सुमतिमावृणीमहेऽध स्मा नस्त्रिवरूथः शिवो भव ॥
mantras.transliteration: vibhūṣannagna ubhayā~ anu vratā dūto devānāṃ rajasī samīyase | yatte dhītiṃ sumatimāvṛṇīmahe'dha smā nastrivarūthaḥ śivo bhava ||

translations.english: Showing grace, Agni, to both (gods and men), and at each sacred rite the messenger of the gods, you traverse earth and heaven; inasmuch as we offer you worship and praise, therefore do you, who are the guardian of the three (regions), be auspicious to us.
