mantras.sanskrit: तं सुप्रतीकं सुदृशं स्वञ्चमविद्वांसो विदुष्टरं सपेम । स यक्षद्विश्वा वयुनानि विद्वान्प्र हव्यमग्निरमृतेषु वोचत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ supratīkaṃ sudṛśaṃ svañcamavidvāṃso viduṣṭaraṃ sapema | sa yakṣadviśvā vayunāni vidvānpra havyamagniramṛteṣu vocat ||

translations.english: We of little wisdom adore the most wise Agni, the well-formed, the well-looking the graceful-moving; may Agni, who knows all things that are to be known offer the sacrifice; may he announce the oblation to the immortals.

mantras.sanskrit: तमग्ने पास्युत तं पिपर्षि यस्त आनट् कवये शूर धीतिम् । यज्ञस्य वा निशितिं वोदितिं वा तमित्पृणक्षि शवसोत राया ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamagne pāsyuta taṃ piparṣi yasta ānaṭ kavaye śūra dhītim | yajñasya vā niśitiṃ voditiṃ vā tamitpṛṇakṣi śavasota rāyā ||

translations.english: You cherish, you protect, Agni, that may who offers worship, hero, to you, the far-seeing; you reward with strength and with riches him (who undertakes) the instrumental tution, (who effects) the accomplishments of the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने वनुष्यतो नि पाहि त्वमु नः सहसावन्नवद्यात् । सं त्वा ध्वस्मन्वदभ्येतु पाथः सं रयिः स्पृहयाय्यः सहस्री ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne vanuṣyato ni pāhi tvamu naḥ sahasāvannavadyāt | saṃ tvā dhvasmanvadabhyetu pāthaḥ saṃ rayiḥ spṛhayāyyaḥ sahasrī ||

translations.english: Protect us, Agni, from the malignant, preserve us, mighty one, from wickedness; may the offering come to you free from defects; may desirable riches, by your sands, (reach us).

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निर्होता गृहपतिः स राजा विश्वा वेद जनिमा जातवेदाः । देवानामुत यो मर्त्यानां यजिष्ठः स प्र यजतामृतावा ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirhotā gṛhapatiḥ sa rājā viśvā veda janimā jātavedāḥ | devānāmuta yo martyānāṃ yajiṣṭhaḥ sa pra yajatāmṛtāvā ||

translations.english: Agni, is the invoker of the gods, the lord of the house, the ruler, who knows all that is, knows all existing beings; he is the mos assiduous worshipper among gods or men; let him who is observant of truth offer worship.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने यदद्य विशो अध्वरस्य होतः पावकशोचे वेष्ट्वं हि यज्वा । ऋता यजासि महिना वि यद्भूर्हव्या वह यविष्ठ या ते अद्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne yadadya viśo adhvarasya hotaḥ pāvakaśoce veṣṭvaṃ hi yajvā | ṛtā yajāsi mahinā vi yadbhūrhavyā vaha yaviṣṭha yā te adya ||

translations.english: Agni, minister of the sacrifice, bright wiht purifying lustre, approve of that (worship) which is this day celebrated by the instrumental tutor of the rite; you verily are the sacrificer, therefore address the worship (to the gods); and since by your greatness you are all-pervading, therefore, youngest (of the gods), accept the oblations which are today (presented) to you.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि प्रयांसि सुधितानि हि ख्यो नि त्वा दधीत रोदसी यजध्यै । अवा नो मघवन्वाजसातावग्ने विश्वानि दुरिता तरेम ता तरेम तवावसा तरेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi prayāṃsi sudhitāni hi khyo ni tvā dadhīta rodasī yajadhyai | avā no maghavanvājasātāvagne viśvāni duritā tarema tā tarema tavāvasā tarema ||

translations.english: Look, Agni, upon the (sacrificial) viands duly deposited (upon the altar); heaven and earth detain you to sacrifice (to the gods); opulent Agni, protect us in battle, whereby we may pass safe over all evils; may we pass over those of a prior existence; may we pass over them by your protection.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने विश्वेभिः स्वनीक देवैरूर्णावन्तं प्रथमः सीद योनिम् । कुलायिनं घृतवन्तं सवित्रे यज्ञं नय यजमानाय साधु ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne viśvebhiḥ svanīka devairūrṇāvantaṃ prathamaḥ sīda yonim | kulāyinaṃ ghṛtavantaṃ savitre yajñaṃ naya yajamānāya sādhu ||

translations.english: Bright-rayed Agni, sit down first with all the gods, upon the altar lined with wool, a nest (of perfumes) and suffused with ghee, and rightly convey (to the deities) the sacrifice of the instrumental tutor of the rite, of the presenter of the oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: इममु त्यमथर्ववदग्निं मन्थन्ति वेधसः । यमङ्कूयन्तमानयन्नमूरं श्याव्याभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imamu tyamatharvavadagniṃ manthanti vedhasaḥ | yamaṅkūyantamānayannamūraṃ śyāvyābhyaḥ ||

translations.english: The priests churn you, Agni, as was done by atharvan, and bring him from the glooms of night wandering deviously, but not bewildered.

mantras.sanskrit: जनिष्वा देववीतये सर्वताता स्वस्तये । आ देवान्वक्ष्यमृताँ ऋतावृधो यज्ञं देवेषु पिस्पृशः ॥
mantras.transliteration: janiṣvā devavītaye sarvatātā svastaye | ā devānvakṣyamṛtā~ ṛtāvṛdho yajñaṃ deveṣu pispṛśaḥ ||

translations.english: Be born, Agni, at the sacrifice, for the welfare of the offerer (of oblation) to the gods; bring hither the immortal deities, the augmenters of the (sacred) rite present our sacrifice to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: वयमु त्वा गृहपते जनानामग्ने अकर्म समिधा बृहन्तम् । अस्थूरि नो गार्हपत्यानि सन्तु तिग्मेन नस्तेजसा सं शिशाधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayamu tvā gṛhapate janānāmagne akarma samidhā bṛhantam | asthūri no gārhapatyāni santu tigmena nastejasā saṃ śiśādhi ||

translations.english: Lord of the house, Agni, we, among men, promote your increase by soma or fuel; may our domestic fires be supplied with all that is essential; enliven us with brilliant radiance.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने यज्ञानां होता विश्वेषां हितः । देवेभिर्मानुषे जने ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne yajñānāṃ hotā viśveṣāṃ hitaḥ | devebhirmānuṣe jane ||

translations.english: You, Agni, have been appointed by the gods, the ministrant fo men, the descendants of manu, at all sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो मन्द्राभिरध्वरे जिह्वाभिर्यजा महः । आ देवान्वक्षि यक्षि च ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no mandrābhiradhvare jihvābhiryajā mahaḥ | ā devānvakṣi yakṣi ca ||

translations.english: Therefore do you at our sacrifice offer oblations to the great deities with exhilarating flames; bring hither the gods; offer them worship.

mantras.sanskrit: वेत्था हि वेधो अध्वनः पथश्च देवाञ्जसा । अग्ने यज्ञेषु सुक्रतो ॥
mantras.transliteration: vetthā hi vedho adhvanaḥ pathaśca devāñjasā | agne yajñeṣu sukrato ||

translations.english: Agni, doere of great deeds, creator, you know (how to travel over) with speed (great) roads and (little) paths at sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामीळे अध द्विता भरतो वाजिभिः शुनम् । ईजे यज्ञेषु यज्ञियम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmīḷe adha dvitā bharato vājibhiḥ śunam | īje yajñeṣu yajñiyam ||

translations.english: Bharata, with the presenters of the oblation, has joyfully praised you in your (two-fold capacity), and has worshipped you, the adorable, with sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमिमा वार्या पुरु दिवोदासाय सुन्वते । भरद्वाजाय दाशुषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamimā vāryā puru divodāsāya sunvate | bharadvājāya dāśuṣe ||

translations.english: As you have conferred these many blessings upon Divodāsa when presenting libations, (so now grant them) to the (actual) offerer, Bharadvāja.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं दूतो अमर्त्य आ वहा दैव्यं जनम् । शृण्वन्विप्रस्य सुष्टुतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ dūto amartya ā vahā daivyaṃ janam | śṛṇvanviprasya suṣṭutim ||

translations.english: Hearing the adoration of the sage, do you, who are the immortal messenger, bring hither the celestial people.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने स्वाध्यो मर्तासो देववीतये । यज्ञेषु देवमीळते ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmagne svādhyo martāso devavītaye | yajñeṣu devamīḷate ||

translations.english: Pious mortals invoke you, divine Agni, at sacrifices, to convey their (sacrificial) food to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: तव प्र यक्षि संदृशमुत क्रतुं सुदानवः । विश्वे जुषन्त कामिनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava pra yakṣi saṃdṛśamuta kratuṃ sudānavaḥ | viśve juṣanta kāminaḥ ||

translations.english: I glorify your splendour and the acts of you the liberal giver all who, (through your favour) enjoy their desires, glorify you.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं होता मनुर्हितो वह्निरासा विदुष्टरः । अग्ने यक्षि दिवो विशः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ hotā manurhito vahnirāsā viduṣṭaraḥ | agne yakṣi divo viśaḥ ||

translations.english: You have been appointed by manu, the invoker of the gods, the most wise bearer of oblations (to them) by your mouth; worship, Agni, the people of heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्न आ याहि वीतये गृणानो हव्यदातये । नि होता सत्सि बर्हिषि ॥
mantras.transliteration: agna ā yāhi vītaye gṛṇāno havyadātaye | ni hotā satsi barhiṣi ||

translations.english: Come, Agni, to the (sacrificial) fod; being lauded, (come) to convey the oblation (to the gods); sit down as the ministrant priest upon the sacred grass.

mantras.sanskrit: तं त्वा समिद्भिरङ्गिरो घृतेन वर्धयामसि । बृहच्छोचा यविष्ठ्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ tvā samidbhiraṅgiro ghṛtena vardhayāmasi | bṛhacchocā yaviṣṭhya ||

translations.english: We augment you, Aṅgiras, with fuel and with butter; blaze fiercely, youngest (of the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: स नः पृथु श्रवाय्यमच्छा देव विवाससि । बृहदग्ने सुवीर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa naḥ pṛthu śravāyyamacchā deva vivāsasi | bṛhadagne suvīryam ||

translations.english: Divine Agni, bestow upon us (wealth), excellent, great and (comprehending) worthy male descendants.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने पुष्करादध्यथर्वा निरमन्थत । मूर्ध्नो विश्वस्य वाघतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmagne puṣkarādadhyatharvā niramanthata | mūrdhno viśvasya vāghataḥ ||

translations.english: The sage, Atharvan, extracted you from upon the lotus-leaf, the head, the support of the universe.

mantras.sanskrit: तमु त्वा दध्यङ्ङृषिः पुत्र ईधे अथर्वणः । वृत्रहणं पुरंदरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamu tvā dadhyaṅṅṛṣiḥ putra īdhe atharvaṇaḥ | vṛtrahaṇaṃ puraṃdaram ||

translations.english: The ṛṣi, Dadhyañc, the son of Atharvan, kindled the slayer of Vṛtra, the destroyer of the cities of Asuras.

mantras.sanskrit: तमु त्वा पाथ्यो वृषा समीधे दस्युहन्तमम् । धनंजयं रणेरणे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamu tvā pāthyo vṛṣā samīdhe dasyuhantamam | dhanaṃjayaṃ raṇeraṇe ||

translations.english: (The ṛṣi) Pāthya, the showerer, kindled you the destroyer of the Dasyu, the winner of spoil in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: एह्यू षु ब्रवाणि तेऽग्न इत्थेतरा गिरः । एभिर्वर्धास इन्दुभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ehyū ṣu bravāṇi te'gna itthetarā giraḥ | ebhirvardhāsa indubhiḥ ||

translations.english: Come, Agni, that I may address to you other praises in this manner; augment with these libations.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्र क्व च ते मनो दक्षं दधस उत्तरम् । तत्रा सदः कृणवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatra kva ca te mano dakṣaṃ dadhasa uttaram | tatrā sadaḥ kṛṇavase ||

translations.english: Wheresoever, and upon whatsoever your mind is directed, you bestow uncommon vigour, and there you make your abode.

mantras.sanskrit: नहि ते पूर्तमक्षिपद्भुवन्नेमानां वसो । अथा दुवो वनवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahi te pūrtamakṣipadbhuvannemānāṃ vaso | athā duvo vanavase ||

translations.english: Let not your full (blaze) be distressing to the eye, giver of dwellings to your humble votaries, and therefore accept our worship.

mantras.sanskrit: आग्निरगामि भारतो वृत्रहा पुरुचेतनः । दिवोदासस्य सत्पतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: āgniragāmi bhārato vṛtrahā purucetanaḥ | divodāsasya satpatiḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, the bearer, (of oblations), the destroyer of the enemies of Divopāsa, the cognizant of many, the protector of the good, has been brought hither (by our praises).

mantras.sanskrit: स हि विश्वाति पार्थिवा रयिं दाशन्महित्वना । वन्वन्नवातो अस्तृतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa hi viśvāti pārthivā rayiṃ dāśanmahitvanā | vanvannavāto astṛtaḥ ||

translations.english: Surpassing all earthly things, may he bestow upon us riches, destroying his enemies by his greatness, unresisted, unassailed.

mantras.sanskrit: स प्रत्नवन्नवीयसाग्ने द्युम्नेन संयता । बृहत्ततन्थ भानुना ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa pratnavannavīyasāgne dyumnena saṃyatā | bṛhattatantha bhānunā ||

translations.english: You, have overspread, Agni, this vast (firmament) with radiant concentrated lustre, recent like that of old.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वः सखायो अग्नये स्तोमं यज्ञं च धृष्णुया । अर्च गाय च वेधसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vaḥ sakhāyo agnaye stomaṃ yajñaṃ ca dhṛṣṇuyā | arca gāya ca vedhase ||

translations.english: Sing praise and offer sacrifice, my friends, to the foe-discomfiting, the creator, Agni.

mantras.sanskrit: स हि यो मानुषा युगा सीदद्धोता कविक्रतुः । दूतश्च हव्यवाहनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa hi yo mānuṣā yugā sīdaddhotā kavikratuḥ | dūtaśca havyavāhanaḥ ||

translations.english: May that Agni indeed sit down (at our sacrifice), who in every age of man has been the invoker of the gods, doer of wise deeds, the messenger of the gods, the bearer of oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: ता राजाना शुचिव्रतादित्यान्मारुतं गणम् । वसो यक्षीह रोदसी ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā rājānā śucivratādityānmārutaṃ gaṇam | vaso yakṣīha rodasī ||

translations.english: Giver of dwellings, worship on this occasion, the two regal divinities, Mitra and Varuṇa, whose acts are holy, the Ādityas, the company of the Maruts, and heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: वस्वी ते अग्ने संदृष्टिरिषयते मर्त्याय । ऊर्जो नपादमृतस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: vasvī te agne saṃdṛṣṭiriṣayate martyāya | ūrjo napādamṛtasya ||

translations.english: Son of strength, Agni, the glorious radiance of you who are immortal, bestows food upon (your) mortal worshipper.

mantras.sanskrit: क्रत्वा दा अस्तु श्रेष्ठोऽद्य त्वा वन्वन्त्सुरेक्णाः । मर्त आनाश सुवृक्तिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kratvā dā astu śreṣṭho'dya tvā vanvantsurekṇāḥ | marta ānāśa suvṛktim ||

translations.english: May the donor (of the oblation), propitiating you by his acts today, be exalted, and (rendered) very opulent; may (such) mortal be diligent in (your) praise.

mantras.sanskrit: ते ते अग्ने त्वोता इषयन्तो विश्वमायुः । तरन्तो अर्यो अरातीर्वन्वन्तो अर्यो अरातीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te te agne tvotā iṣayanto viśvamāyuḥ | taranto aryo arātīrvanvanto aryo arātīḥ ||

translations.english: Those, Agni, who are protected by you, wishing for the whole (term of) life (obtain it), overcoming hostile assailants, destroying hostile assailants.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निस्तिग्मेन शोचिषा यासद्विश्वं न्यत्रिणम् । अग्निर्नो वनते रयिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnistigmena śociṣā yāsadviśvaṃ nyatriṇam | agnirno vanate rayim ||

translations.english: May Agni, with his sharp flame, demolish the devourer (of the oblation); may Agni grant us riches.

mantras.sanskrit: सुवीरं रयिमा भर जातवेदो विचर्षणे । जहि रक्षांसि सुक्रतो ॥
mantras.transliteration: suvīraṃ rayimā bhara jātavedo vicarṣaṇe | jahi rakṣāṃsi sukrato ||

translations.english: Jātavedas, all-beholdeer, bring us wealth with good posterity; doer of good deeds, destroy the rākṣasas.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं नः पाह्यंहसो जातवेदो अघायतः । रक्षा णो ब्रह्मणस्कवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ naḥ pāhyaṃhaso jātavedo aghāyataḥ | rakṣā ṇo brahmaṇaskave ||

translations.english: Preserve us, Jātavedas, from sin; enunciator of prayer, protect us from the malevolent.

mantras.sanskrit: यो नो अग्ने दुरेव आ मर्तो वधाय दाशति । तस्मान्नः पाह्यंहसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo no agne dureva ā marto vadhāya dāśati | tasmānnaḥ pāhyaṃhasaḥ ||

translations.english: The malevolent mortal who threatens us with murderous weapon; defend us from him, and also from sin.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं तं देव जिह्वया परि बाधस्व दुष्कृतम् । मर्तो यो नो जिघांसति ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ taṃ deva jihvayā pari bādhasva duṣkṛtam | marto yo no jighāṃsati ||

translations.english: Scatter, divine Agni, by your flame, that evil-doer, the man who seeks to kill us.

mantras.sanskrit: भरद्वाजाय सप्रथः शर्म यच्छ सहन्त्य । अग्ने वरेण्यं वसु ॥
mantras.transliteration: bharadvājāya saprathaḥ śarma yaccha sahantya | agne vareṇyaṃ vasu ||

translations.english: Subduer of foes, grant to Bharadvāja infinite happiness and desirable wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निर्वृत्राणि जङ्घनद्द्रविणस्युर्विपन्यया । समिद्धः शुक्र आहुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirvṛtrāṇi jaṅghanaddraviṇasyurvipanyayā | samiddhaḥ śukra āhutaḥ ||

translations.english: May Agni, propitiated by praise, desirous of (sacrificial) affluence, kindled, bright, and fed with burnt-offerings, destroy all adversaries.

mantras.sanskrit: गर्भे मातुः पितुष्पिता विदिद्युतानो अक्षरे । सीदन्नृतस्य योनिमा ॥
mantras.transliteration: garbhe mātuḥ pituṣpitā vididyutāno akṣare | sīdannṛtasya yonimā ||

translations.english: Radiant in the embryo of the maternal (earth), on the imperishable (altar); the cherisher of the paternal (heaven), sitting on the seat of sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: ब्रह्म प्रजावदा भर जातवेदो विचर्षणे । अग्ने यद्दीदयद्दिवि ॥
mantras.transliteration: brahma prajāvadā bhara jātavedo vicarṣaṇe | agne yaddīdayaddivi ||

translations.english: Bring to us, Jātavedas, all-beholder, food with progeny; such (food) as is brilliant in heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: उप त्वा रण्वसंदृशं प्रयस्वन्तः सहस्कृत । अग्ने ससृज्महे गिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa tvā raṇvasaṃdṛśaṃ prayasvantaḥ sahaskṛta | agne sasṛjmahe giraḥ ||

translations.english: Strength-begotten Agni, we, offering (sacrificial) food, address praises to you who are of plural asing aspect.

mantras.sanskrit: उप च्छायामिव घृणेरगन्म शर्म ते वयम् । अग्ने हिरण्यसंदृशः ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa cchāyāmiva ghṛṇeraganma śarma te vayam | agne hiraṇyasaṃdṛśaḥ ||

translations.english: We have recourse, Agni, to the shelter of you, the lustrous, the golden-feathered, as to the shade (of a tree).

mantras.sanskrit: य उग्र इव शर्यहा तिग्मशृङ्गो न वंसगः । अग्ने पुरो रुरोजिथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya ugra iva śaryahā tigmaśṛṅgo na vaṃsagaḥ | agne puro rurojitha ||

translations.english: You, Agni, who are like a fierce archer, or like a sharp-horned bull, have destroyed the cities (of the asuras).

mantras.sanskrit: आ यं हस्ते न खादिनं शिशुं जातं न बिभ्रति । विशामग्निं स्वध्वरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yaṃ haste na khādinaṃ śiśuṃ jātaṃ na bibhrati | viśāmagniṃ svadhvaram ||

translations.english: (Worship) that Agni whom (the priests) bear in their hands like a new-born babe; the devourer (of the oblation), the (conveyer of the) holy sacrifices of men.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र देवं देववीतये भरता वसुवित्तमम् । आ स्वे योनौ नि षीदतु ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra devaṃ devavītaye bharatā vasuvittamam | ā sve yonau ni ṣīdatu ||

translations.english: Conduct the divine (Agni), the bestower of infinite wealth, to (receive charge of) the food of the gods; let him sit down on his appropriate seat.

mantras.sanskrit: आ जातं जातवेदसि प्रियं शिशीतातिथिम् । स्योन आ गृहपतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā jātaṃ jātavedasi priyaṃ śiśītātithim | syona ā gṛhapatim ||

translations.english: (Welcome him) as soon as born, like a beloved guest, and plural ce the lord of the mansion upon the sacred (altar) whence wisdom is derived.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने युक्ष्वा हि ये तवाश्वासो देव साधवः । अरं वहन्ति मन्यवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne yukṣvā hi ye tavāśvāso deva sādhavaḥ | araṃ vahanti manyave ||

translations.english: Harness, divine Agni, your well-trained horses, who bear you quickly to the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: अच्छा नो याह्या वहाभि प्रयांसि वीतये । आ देवान्त्सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: acchā no yāhyā vahābhi prayāṃsi vītaye | ā devāntsomapītaye ||

translations.english: Come, Agni, to our presence, bring hither the gods to partake of the (sacrificial) viands, to drink the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: उदग्ने भारत द्युमदजस्रेण दविद्युतत् । शोचा वि भाह्यजर ॥
mantras.transliteration: udagne bhārata dyumadajasreṇa davidyutat | śocā vi bhāhyajara ||

translations.english: Blaze up, Agni, bearer of oblations; shine, undecaying Agni, radiant with undecaying lustre.

mantras.sanskrit: वीती यो देवं मर्तो दुवस्येदग्निमीळीताध्वरे हविष्मान् । होतारं सत्ययजं रोदस्योरुत्तानहस्तो नमसा विवासेत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vītī yo devaṃ marto duvasyedagnimīḷītādhvare haviṣmān | hotāraṃ satyayajaṃ rodasyoruttānahasto namasā vivāset ||

translations.english: Whatever mortal, offering oblations, worships a deity with (sacrificial) food, let him at the ceremony also worship Agni, the invoker of heaven and earth, the sacrificer with truth; let him adore (Agni) with uplifted hands.

mantras.sanskrit: आ ते अग्न ऋचा हविर्हृदा तष्टं भरामसि । ते ते भवन्तूक्षण ऋषभासो वशा उत ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā te agna ṛcā havirhṛdā taṣṭaṃ bharāmasi | te te bhavantūkṣaṇa ṛṣabhāso vaśā uta ||

translations.english: We offer to you, Agni, the oblation sanctified by the heart, and (identified) with the sacred verse may the vigorous bulls and the cows be (as such an oblation) to you.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निं देवासो अग्रियमिन्धते वृत्रहन्तमम् । येना वसून्याभृता तृळ्हा रक्षांसि वाजिना ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniṃ devāso agriyamindhate vṛtrahantamam | yenā vasūnyābhṛtā tṛḷhā rakṣāṃsi vājinā ||

translations.english: The gods kindle Agni as the chief (of them); as the especial desroyer of Vṛtra; by whom the treasures (of the asuras) are carried off; by whom the rākṣasas are destroyed.

mantras.sanskrit: पिबा सोममभि यमुग्र तर्द ऊर्वं गव्यं महि गृणान इन्द्र । वि यो धृष्णो वधिषो वज्रहस्त विश्वा वृत्रममित्रिया शवोभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pibā somamabhi yamugra tarda ūrvaṃ gavyaṃ mahi gṛṇāna indra | vi yo dhṛṣṇo vadhiṣo vajrahasta viśvā vṛtramamitriyā śavobhiḥ ||

translations.english: Fierce Indra, glorified by us, drink of the Soma, (animated) by which you have discovered the vast herd of cattle (stolen by Paṇis), and, overcomer of enemies, wielder of the thunderbolt, you have slain, by your strength all opposing foes.

mantras.sanskrit: स ईं पाहि य ऋजीषी तरुत्रो यः शिप्रवान्वृषभो यो मतीनाम् । यो गोत्रभिद्वज्रभृद्यो हरिष्ठाः स इन्द्र चित्राँ अभि तृन्धि वाजान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa īṃ pāhi ya ṛjīṣī tarutro yaḥ śipravānvṛṣabho yo matīnām | yo gotrabhidvajrabhṛdyo hariṣṭhāḥ sa indra citrā~ abhi tṛndhi vājān ||

translations.english: Drink it, Indra, you who enjoy the flavourless Soma; you who are the preserver, the handsome-chinned, the showerer (of benefits) on those who praise you; who are the breaker of mountains, the wielder of the thunderbolt, the curber of steeds, do you bestow upon us various food.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा पाहि प्रत्नथा मन्दतु त्वा श्रुधि ब्रह्म वावृधस्वोत गीर्भिः । आविः सूर्यं कृणुहि पीपिहीषो जहि शत्रूँरभि गा इन्द्र तृन्धि ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā pāhi pratnathā mandatu tvā śrudhi brahma vāvṛdhasvota gīrbhiḥ | āviḥ sūryaṃ kṛṇuhi pīpihīṣo jahi śatrū~rabhi gā indra tṛndhi ||

translations.english: Drink it as of old, and may it exhilarate ou; hear our prayer, and be exalted by our praises; make the sun visible, nourish us with food, destroy our enemies, rescue the cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: ते त्वा मदा बृहदिन्द्र स्वधाव इमे पीता उक्षयन्त द्युमन्तम् । महामनूनं तवसं विभूतिं मत्सरासो जर्हृषन्त प्रसाहम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: te tvā madā bṛhadindra svadhāva ime pītā ukṣayanta dyumantam | mahāmanūnaṃ tavasaṃ vibhūtiṃ matsarāso jarhṛṣanta prasāham ||

translations.english: Abounding in food, Indra, let these exhilarating draughts copiously bedew you, the resplendent; let the inebriating juices delight you who are mighty, deficient in no (excellence), powerful, manifold, the overcomer of foes.

mantras.sanskrit: येभिः सूर्यमुषसं मन्दसानोऽवासयोऽप दृळ्हानि दर्द्रत् । महामद्रिं परि गा इन्द्र सन्तं नुत्था अच्युतं सदसस्परि स्वात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yebhiḥ sūryamuṣasaṃ mandasāno'vāsayo'pa dṛḷhāni dardrat | mahāmadriṃ pari gā indra santaṃ nutthā acyutaṃ sadasaspari svāt ||

translations.english: By which (juices) being exhilarated you have appointed the sun and the dawn (to their offices), driving away the solid (glooms); you have penetrated, Indra, the mountain, unmoved from its own seat, concealing the cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: तव क्रत्वा तव तद्दंसनाभिरामासु पक्वं शच्या नि दीधः । और्णोर्दुर उस्रियाभ्यो वि दृळ्होदूर्वाद्गा असृजो अङ्गिरस्वान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava kratvā tava taddaṃsanābhirāmāsu pakvaṃ śacyā ni dīdhaḥ | aurṇordura usriyābhyo vi dṛḷhodūrvādgā asṛjo aṅgirasvān ||

translations.english: By your wisdom, by your deeds, through your power, you have developed the mature (milk) in the immature (udders), you have opened the strong doors for the cattle (to come forth); associated with Aṅgirasas, you have liberated the cows from their fold.

mantras.sanskrit: पप्राथ क्षां महि दंसो व्युर्वीमुप द्यामृष्वो बृहदिन्द्र स्तभायः । अधारयो रोदसी देवपुत्रे प्रत्ने मातरा यह्वी ऋतस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: paprātha kṣāṃ mahi daṃso vyurvīmupa dyāmṛṣvo bṛhadindra stabhāyaḥ | adhārayo rodasī devaputre pratne mātarā yahvī ṛtasya ||

translations.english: You have filled the wide earth, Indra. With (the power of) your deeds; you, the mighty one, have propped up the vast heaven; you have sustained the heaven and earth, whose children are the gods, (and who are) the old and mighty parents of sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: अध त्वा विश्वे पुर इन्द्र देवा एकं तवसं दधिरे भराय । अदेवो यदभ्यौहिष्ट देवान्त्स्वर्षाता वृणत इन्द्रमत्र ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha tvā viśve pura indra devā ekaṃ tavasaṃ dadhire bharāya | adevo yadabhyauhiṣṭa devāntsvarṣātā vṛṇata indramatra ||

translations.english: All the gods then plural ced you, Indra, as their mighty chief in front for battle; when the impious (asuras) assailed the deities; the Maruts supported Indra in the conflict.

mantras.sanskrit: अध द्यौश्चित्ते अप सा नु वज्राद्द्वितानमद्भियसा स्वस्य मन्योः । अहिं यदिन्द्रो अभ्योहसानं नि चिद्विश्वायुः शयथे जघान ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha dyauścitte apa sā nu vajrāddvitānamadbhiyasā svasya manyoḥ | ahiṃ yadindro abhyohasānaṃ ni cidviśvāyuḥ śayathe jaghāna ||

translations.english: The heaven bowed down in the two-fold dread of your thunderbolt, and your individual wrath, when Indra, the giver of food, struck to the sleep (of death) the assailing Ahi.

mantras.sanskrit: अध त्वष्टा ते मह उग्र वज्रं सहस्रभृष्टिं ववृतच्छताश्रिम् । निकाममरमणसं येन नवन्तमहिं सं पिणगृजीषिन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha tvaṣṭā te maha ugra vajraṃ sahasrabhṛṣṭiṃ vavṛtacchatāśrim | nikāmamaramaṇasaṃ yena navantamahiṃ saṃ piṇagṛjīṣin ||

translations.english: Fierce Indra, Tvaṣṭā constructed for you, the mighty one, the thousand-edged, the hundred-angled thunderbolt, wherewith you have crushed the ambitious audacious, loud-shouting Ahi.

mantras.sanskrit: वर्धान्यं विश्वे मरुतः सजोषाः पचच्छतं महिषाँ इन्द्र तुभ्यम् । पूषा विष्णुस्त्रीणि सरांसि धावन्वृत्रहणं मदिरमंशुमस्मै ॥
mantras.transliteration: vardhānyaṃ viśve marutaḥ sajoṣāḥ pacacchataṃ mahiṣā~ indra tubhyam | pūṣā viṣṇustrīṇi sarāṃsi dhāvanvṛtrahaṇaṃ madiramaṃśumasmai ||

translations.english: For you, Indra, whom all the Maruts, alike plural ased, exalt, may Pūṣan and Viṣṇu dress for you a hundred buffaloes, and to him may the three streams flow with the inebriating, foe-destroying Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: आ क्षोदो महि वृतं नदीनां परिष्ठितमसृज ऊर्मिमपाम् । तासामनु प्रवत इन्द्र पन्थां प्रार्दयो नीचीरपसः समुद्रम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā kṣodo mahi vṛtaṃ nadīnāṃ pariṣṭhitamasṛja ūrmimapām | tāsāmanu pravata indra panthāṃ prārdayo nīcīrapasaḥ samudram ||

translations.english: You have set free the greatly obstructed and arrested water of the rivers, the flux of the waters; you have directed them, Indra, upon their downward paths; you have sent them rapidly down to the ocean.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा ता विश्वा चकृवांसमिन्द्रं महामुग्रमजुर्यं सहोदाम् । सुवीरं त्वा स्वायुधं सुवज्रमा ब्रह्म नव्यमवसे ववृत्यात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā tā viśvā cakṛvāṃsamindraṃ mahāmugramajuryaṃ sahodām | suvīraṃ tvā svāyudhaṃ suvajramā brahma navyamavase vavṛtyāt ||

translations.english: May our new prayer bring to our protection you, Indra, who are the maker of all these (things that exist); who are mighty, fierce, undecaying, the giver of strength, having excellent descendants, the Maruts, well-armed, the bearer of the thunderbolt.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो वाजाय श्रवस इषे च राये धेहि द्युमत इन्द्र विप्रान् । भरद्वाजे नृवत इन्द्र सूरीन्दिवि च स्मैधि पार्ये न इन्द्र ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no vājāya śravasa iṣe ca rāye dhehi dyumata indra viprān | bharadvāje nṛvata indra sūrīndivi ca smaidhi pārye na indra ||

translations.english: Do you, resplendent Indra, uphold us who are devout, for (the obtaining of) food, of sustenance, of nourishment, of wealth; bestow upon Bharadvāja pious posterity, with numerous attendants; be with us, Indra, every future day.

mantras.sanskrit: अया वाजं देवहितं सनेम मदेम शतहिमाः सुवीराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayā vājaṃ devahitaṃ sanema madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ ||

translations.english: May we, by this (praise), obtain food granted by the deity; may we, blessed with excellent male descendants, be happy for a hundred winters.

mantras.sanskrit: तमु ष्टुहि यो अभिभूत्योजा वन्वन्नवातः पुरुहूत इन्द्रः । अषाळ्हमुग्रं सहमानमाभिर्गीर्भिर्वर्ध वृषभं चर्षणीनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamu ṣṭuhi yo abhibhūtyojā vanvannavātaḥ puruhūta indraḥ | aṣāḷhamugraṃ sahamānamābhirgīrbhirvardha vṛṣabhaṃ carṣaṇīnām ||

translations.english: Praise him who is Indra, the invoker of many, endowed with overpowering vigour, the destroyer (of foes), unharmed by them; exalt with these praises the irresistible, fierce, victorious Indra, the showerer (of benefits) upon mankind.

mantras.sanskrit: स युध्मः सत्वा खजकृत्समद्वा तुविम्रक्षो नदनुमाँ ऋजीषी । बृहद्रेणुश्च्यवनो मानुषीणामेकः कृष्टीनामभवत्सहावा ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa yudhmaḥ satvā khajakṛtsamadvā tuvimrakṣo nadanumā~ ṛjīṣī | bṛhadreṇuścyavano mānuṣīṇāmekaḥ kṛṣṭīnāmabhavatsahāvā ||

translations.english: He is ever the combatant, the donor, the engaged in battle, the sympathizer (with the sacrificer), the benefactor of many, the loud-sounding, the partaker of the stale libation, the stirrer up of dust (in strife), the chief protector of men the descendants of Manu, the endowed with strength.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं ह नु त्यददमायो दस्यूँरेकः कृष्टीरवनोरार्याय । अस्ति स्विन्नु वीर्यं तत्त इन्द्र न स्विदस्ति तदृतुथा वि वोचः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ ha nu tyadadamāyo dasyū~rekaḥ kṛṣṭīravanorāryāya | asti svinnu vīryaṃ tatta indra na svidasti tadṛtuthā vi vocaḥ ||

translations.english: You are he who has quickly humbled the Dasyus; you are the chief one who has given posterity to the Arya;but, Indra, is not verily your power such? If it be not, then in due season confess.

mantras.sanskrit: सदिद्धि ते तुविजातस्य मन्ये सहः सहिष्ठ तुरतस्तुरस्य । उग्रमुग्रस्य तवसस्तवीयोऽरध्रस्य रध्रतुरो बभूव ॥
mantras.transliteration: sadiddhi te tuvijātasya manye sahaḥ sahiṣṭha turatasturasya | ugramugrasya tavasastavīyo'radhrasya radhraturo babhūva ||

translations.english: Yet, most mighty one, I believe that powre is verily always in you, who are manifest at many rites, and are the enemy of (our) enemies; (the power) that is fierce in the fierce one, most mighty in the mighty one, most unassailable in the subduer (of foes).

mantras.sanskrit: तन्नः प्रत्नं सख्यमस्तु युष्मे इत्था वदद्भिर्वलमङ्गिरोभिः । हन्नच्युतच्युद्दस्मेषयन्तमृणोः पुरो वि दुरो अस्य विश्वाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tannaḥ pratnaṃ sakhyamastu yuṣme itthā vadadbhirvalamaṅgirobhiḥ | hannacyutacyuddasmeṣayantamṛṇoḥ puro vi duro asya viśvāḥ ||

translations.english: May that our ancient friendship with you ever endure; as when, along with the Aṅgirasas, celebrating your praises, you, beautiful Indra, caster down of the immoveable (roks), did verily slay Bala, hurling (his darts against you), and force open his cities, and all his gates.

mantras.sanskrit: स हि धीभिर्हव्यो अस्त्युग्र ईशानकृन्महति वृत्रतूर्ये । स तोकसाता तनये स वज्री वितन्तसाय्यो अभवत्समत्सु ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa hi dhībhirhavyo astyugra īśānakṛnmahati vṛtratūrye | sa tokasātā tanaye sa vajrī vitantasāyyo abhavatsamatsu ||

translations.english: Fierce Indra, maker of rules you are he who is to be invoked with praise in a great conflict; you are he (who is to be invoked) for sons and grandsons, he, the wielder of the thunderbolt, who is to be especially glorified in battles.

mantras.sanskrit: स मज्मना जनिम मानुषाणाममर्त्येन नाम्नाति प्र सर्स्रे । स द्युम्नेन स शवसोत राया स वीर्येण नृतमः समोकाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa majmanā janima mānuṣāṇāmamartyena nāmnāti pra sarsre | sa dyumnena sa śavasota rāyā sa vīryeṇa nṛtamaḥ samokāḥ ||

translations.english: With immortal, foe-humiliating might he has promoted the (multiplied) birth of mankind; he, the chief of leaders, dwells in the same dwelling with fame, with strength, with riches, with heroism.

mantras.sanskrit: स यो न मुहे न मिथू जनो भूत्सुमन्तुनामा चुमुरिं धुनिं च । वृणक्पिप्रुं शम्बरं शुष्णमिन्द्रः पुरां च्यौत्नाय शयथाय नू चित् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa yo na muhe na mithū jano bhūtsumantunāmā cumuriṃ dhuniṃ ca | vṛṇakpipruṃ śambaraṃ śuṣṇamindraḥ purāṃ cyautnāya śayathāya nū cit ||

translations.english: He who is never perplexed, who is no engenderer of that which is in vain, whose name is renowned, who promptly (exerts himself) for the overturning of the cities (of the asuras), and for the destruction (of his foes); you, (Indra), have indeed slain Cumuri, Dhuni, Pipru, Śambara, and Śuṣṇa.

mantras.sanskrit: उदावता त्वक्षसा पन्यसा च वृत्रहत्याय रथमिन्द्र तिष्ठ । धिष्व वज्रं हस्त आ दक्षिणत्राभि प्र मन्द पुरुदत्र मायाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: udāvatā tvakṣasā panyasā ca vṛtrahatyāya rathamindra tiṣṭha | dhiṣva vajraṃ hasta ā dakṣiṇatrābhi pra manda purudatra māyāḥ ||

translations.english: (Endowed) with upward-rising, foe-thinning, and glorified (vigour), ascend your car for the destruction of Vṛtra; take the thunderbolt in your right hand, giver of wealth, baffle the devices (of the asuras).

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निर्न शुष्कं वनमिन्द्र हेती रक्षो नि धक्ष्यशनिर्न भीमा । गम्भीरय ऋष्वया यो रुरोजाध्वानयद्दुरिता दम्भयच्च ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirna śuṣkaṃ vanamindra hetī rakṣo ni dhakṣyaśanirna bhīmā | gambhīraya ṛṣvayā yo rurojādhvānayadduritā dambhayacca ||

translations.english: In like manner as Agni consumes the dry forest, so, Indra, your weapon (destroys your enemies); as (formidable as you) fearful shaft, consume the rākṣasas; you who have shouted aloud (in the combat) and demolished all evil things.

mantras.sanskrit: आ सहस्रं पथिभिरिन्द्र राया तुविद्युम्न तुविवाजेभिरर्वाक् । याहि सूनो सहसो यस्य नू चिददेव ईशे पुरुहूत योतोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā sahasraṃ pathibhirindra rāyā tuvidyumna tuvivājebhirarvāk | yāhi sūno sahaso yasya nū cidadeva īśe puruhūta yotoḥ ||

translations.english: Opulent, Indra, son of strength, the invoker of many, whose union (with energy) the impious is unable to disjoint, come down to us with thousands of riches by very powerful conveyances.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र तुविद्युम्नस्य स्थविरस्य घृष्वेर्दिवो ररप्शे महिमा पृथिव्याः । नास्य शत्रुर्न प्रतिमानमस्ति न प्रतिष्ठिः पुरुमायस्य सह्योः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra tuvidyumnasya sthavirasya ghṛṣverdivo rarapśe mahimā pṛthivyāḥ | nāsya śatrurna pratimānamasti na pratiṣṭhiḥ purumāyasya sahyoḥ ||

translations.english: The vastness of the affluent, ancient (Indra), the demolisher (of foes), exceeds that of the heaven and the earth; there is no antagonist, no counterpart, no recipient of him abounding in wisdom, victorious (in war).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र तत्ते अद्या करणं कृतं भूत्कुत्सं यदायुमतिथिग्वमस्मै । पुरू सहस्रा नि शिशा अभि क्षामुत्तूर्वयाणं धृषता निनेथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra tatte adyā karaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ bhūtkutsaṃ yadāyumatithigvamasmai | purū sahasrā ni śiśā abhi kṣāmuttūrvayāṇaṃ dhṛṣatā ninetha ||

translations.english: That exploit is celebrated in the present day (which you have) achieved for Kutsa, for Āyu, for Atithigvave; to him you have given many thousands (of riches), and you have quickly elevated Turvayāṇa over the earth by your power.

mantras.sanskrit: अनु त्वाहिघ्ने अध देव देवा मदन्विश्वे कवितमं कवीनाम् । करो यत्र वरिवो बाधिताय दिवे जनाय तन्वे गृणानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: anu tvāhighne adha deva devā madanviśve kavitamaṃ kavīnām | karo yatra varivo bādhitāya dive janāya tanve gṛṇānaḥ ||

translations.english: Divine Indra, all the gods have glorified you, the wisest of the wise, for the destruction of Ahi; when propitiated, you have given wealth to the distressed worshipper, and to his posterity.

mantras.sanskrit: अनु द्यावापृथिवी तत्त ओजोऽमर्त्या जिहत इन्द्र देवाः । कृष्वा कृत्नो अकृतं यत्ते अस्त्युक्थं नवीयो जनयस्व यज्ञैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: anu dyāvāpṛthivī tatta ojo'martyā jihata indra devāḥ | kṛṣvā kṛtno akṛtaṃ yatte astyukthaṃ navīyo janayasva yajñaiḥ ||

translations.english: The heaven and earth, and the immortal gods, acknowledge your might; doer of many deeds, do that which is yet undone by you, give birth to a new hymn at (your) sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: महाँ इन्द्रो नृवदा चर्षणिप्रा उत द्विबर्हा अमिनः सहोभिः । अस्मद्र्यग्वावृधे वीर्यायोरुः पृथुः सुकृतः कर्तृभिर्भूत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahā~ indro nṛvadā carṣaṇiprā uta dvibarhā aminaḥ sahobhiḥ | asmadryagvāvṛdhe vīryāyoruḥ pṛthuḥ sukṛtaḥ kartṛbhirbhūt ||

translations.english: May the great Indra, who is as a monarch the fulfiller (of the desires) of men, come hither; may he who is mighty over the two (realms of space), uninjurable by (hostile) offers, increase (in capacity) for heroism in our presence; may he who is great (in body), eminent (in qualities), be honoured by the performers (of pious acts).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रमेव धिषणा सातये धाद्बृहन्तमृष्वमजरं युवानम् । अषाळ्हेन शवसा शूशुवांसं सद्यश्चिद्यो वावृधे असामि ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrameva dhiṣaṇā sātaye dhādbṛhantamṛṣvamajaraṃ yuvānam | aṣāḷhena śavasā śūśuvāṃsaṃ sadyaścidyo vāvṛdhe asāmi ||

translations.english: Our praise encourages Indra o munificence, the vast, quick-moving, undecaying, ever-youthful Indra, mighty with unsurpassable strength, who rapidly grows to greatness.

mantras.sanskrit: पृथू करस्ना बहुला गभस्ती अस्मद्र्यक्सं मिमीहि श्रवांसि । यूथेव पश्वः पशुपा दमूना अस्माँ इन्द्राभ्या ववृत्स्वाजौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: pṛthū karasnā bahulā gabhastī asmadryaksaṃ mimīhi śravāṃsi | yūtheva paśvaḥ paśupā damūnā asmā~ indrābhyā vavṛtsvājau ||

translations.english: Extend towards us your long, active, and bountiful hands, (to bring us) food; be abot us, lowly-minded Indra, in battle, as a herdsman (tends) the herds of cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: तं व इन्द्रं चतिनमस्य शाकैरिह नूनं वाजयन्तो हुवेम । यथा चित्पूर्वे जरितार आसुरनेद्या अनवद्या अरिष्टाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ va indraṃ catinamasya śākairiha nūnaṃ vājayanto huvema | yathā citpūrve jaritāra āsuranedyā anavadyā ariṣṭāḥ ||

translations.english: Desiring sustenance, we invoke you, the renowned Indra, on this occasion, the destroyer (of enemies), together with his powerful allies (the Maruts); as his ancient adorers have been, (may we be), exempt from blame, irreproachable, unharmed.

mantras.sanskrit: धृतव्रतो धनदाः सोमवृद्धः स हि वामस्य वसुनः पुरुक्षुः । सं जग्मिरे पथ्या रायो अस्मिन्त्समुद्रे न सिन्धवो यादमानाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhṛtavrato dhanadāḥ somavṛddhaḥ sa hi vāmasya vasunaḥ purukṣuḥ | saṃ jagmire pathyā rāyo asmintsamudre na sindhavo yādamānāḥ ||

translations.english: In him who is observant of pious rites, who is a giver of wealth, who is exalted by the Soma, the (lord) of desirable riches, the distributor of food, (in him) the treasures fit (for his worshippers) congregate like rivers flowing into ocean.

mantras.sanskrit: शविष्ठं न आ भर शूर शव ओजिष्ठमोजो अभिभूत उग्रम् । विश्वा द्युम्ना वृष्ण्या मानुषाणामस्मभ्यं दा हरिवो मादयध्यै ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaviṣṭhaṃ na ā bhara śūra śava ojiṣṭhamojo abhibhūta ugram | viśvā dyumnā vṛṣṇyā mānuṣāṇāmasmabhyaṃ dā harivo mādayadhyai ||

translations.english: Bestow upon us, hero Indra, most vigorous vigour; subduer (of enemies, bestow upon us) most energetic and fierce energy; grant, lord of steeds, all the bright and invigorating (treasures) fit for men, to make us happy.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्ते मदः पृतनाषाळमृध्र इन्द्र तं न आ भर शूशुवांसम् । येन तोकस्य तनयस्य सातौ मंसीमहि जिगीवांसस्त्वोताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaste madaḥ pṛtanāṣāḷamṛdhra indra taṃ na ā bhara śūśuvāṃsam | yena tokasya tanayasya sātau maṃsīmahi jigīvāṃsastvotāḥ ||

translations.english: Impart to us, Indra, that your invigorating exultatio which overcomes enemies, and is irresistible, where by, protected by you, triumphant we may glorify you for the sake of (obtaining) sons and grandsons.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो भर वृषणं शुष्ममिन्द्र धनस्पृतं शूशुवांसं सुदक्षम् । येन वंसाम पृतनासु शत्रून्तवोतिभिरुत जामीँरजामीन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no bhara vṛṣaṇaṃ śuṣmamindra dhanaspṛtaṃ śūśuvāṃsaṃ sudakṣam | yena vaṃsāma pṛtanāsu śatrūntavotibhiruta jāmī~rajāmīn ||

translations.english: Bestow upon us, Indra, vigorous strenght, the realizer of wealth, great and propitious, wherewith, thorugh your protection, we may destroy our enemies in battles, whether they be kinsmen or strangers.

mantras.sanskrit: आ ते शुष्मो वृषभ एतु पश्चादोत्तरादधरादा पुरस्तात् । आ विश्वतो अभि समेत्वर्वाङिन्द्र द्युम्नं स्वर्वद्धेह्यस्मे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā te śuṣmo vṛṣabha etu paścādottarādadharādā purastāt | ā viśvato abhi sametvarvāṅindra dyumnaṃ svarvaddhehyasme ||

translations.english: May your invigorating srength come from the west, from the north, from the south, from the east; may it come to us from every quarter; grant us riches combined with felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: नृवत्त इन्द्र नृतमाभिरूती वंसीमहि वामं श्रोमतेभिः । ईक्षे हि वस्व उभयस्य राजन्धा रत्नं महि स्थूरं बृहन्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nṛvatta indra nṛtamābhirūtī vaṃsīmahi vāmaṃ śromatebhiḥ | īkṣe hi vasva ubhayasya rājandhā ratnaṃ mahi sthūraṃ bṛhantam ||

translations.english: We enjoy, Indra, through your guiding protection, desirable affluence along with descendants and reputation; grant us, sovereign, who rule over (earthly and heavenly) riches, vast, desirable and infinite treasures.

mantras.sanskrit: मरुत्वन्तं वृषभं वावृधानमकवारिं दिव्यं शासमिन्द्रम् । विश्वासाहमवसे नूतनायोग्रं सहोदामिह तं हुवेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: marutvantaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ vāvṛdhānamakavāriṃ divyaṃ śāsamindram | viśvāsāhamavase nūtanāyograṃ sahodāmiha taṃ huvema ||

translations.english: We invoke on this occasion for his present protection, that Indra who is attended by the Maruts; who is the showerer (of benefits); augmenting (in prowess); the unreviled of foes, radiant, ruling, all-subduing, fierce, the giver of strength.

mantras.sanskrit: जनं वज्रिन्महि चिन्मन्यमानमेभ्यो नृभ्यो रन्धया येष्वस्मि । अधा हि त्वा पृथिव्यां शूरसातौ हवामहे तनये गोष्वप्सु ॥
mantras.transliteration: janaṃ vajrinmahi cinmanyamānamebhyo nṛbhyo randhayā yeṣvasmi | adhā hi tvā pṛthivyāṃ śūrasātau havāmahe tanaye goṣvapsu ||

translations.english: Wielder of the thunderbolt, humble that man who looks upon himself as the greatest among those men of whom I am; we invoke you now to (ascend) upon the earth at the time of battle, and for (the sake of obtaining) sond and grandsons.

mantras.sanskrit: वयं त एभिः पुरुहूत सख्यैः शत्रोःशत्रोरुत्तर इत्स्याम । घ्नन्तो वृत्राण्युभयानि शूर राया मदेम बृहता त्वोताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayaṃ ta ebhiḥ puruhūta sakhyaiḥ śatroḥśatroruttara itsyāma | ghnanto vṛtrāṇyubhayāni śūra rāyā madema bṛhatā tvotāḥ ||

translations.english: Invoked of many, may we, through these your friendly (praises), ever be superior to successive foes, destroying, oḥ hero, both (classes of) enemies, (kindred or unallied); and may we, protected by you, be happy with abundant riches.

mantras.sanskrit: द्यौर्न य इन्द्राभि भूमार्यस्तस्थौ रयिः शवसा पृत्सु जनान् । तं नः सहस्रभरमुर्वरासां दद्धि सूनो सहसो वृत्रतुरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dyaurna ya indrābhi bhūmāryastasthau rayiḥ śavasā pṛtsu janān | taṃ naḥ sahasrabharamurvarāsāṃ daddhi sūno sahaso vṛtraturam ||

translations.english: Indra, son of strength, grant us (a son), the possessor of thousands, the owner of cultivated lands, the usbduer of foes, the riches that may overcome men in battles by strength, as the radiant (sun) overspreads the earth by his rays.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवो न तुभ्यमन्विन्द्र सत्रासुर्यं देवेभिर्धायि विश्वम् । अहिं यद्वृत्रमपो वव्रिवांसं हन्नृजीषिन्विष्णुना सचानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: divo na tubhyamanvindra satrāsuryaṃ devebhirdhāyi viśvam | ahiṃ yadvṛtramapo vavrivāṃsaṃ hannṛjīṣinviṣṇunā sacānaḥ ||

translations.english: To you, Indra, as to the sun, all strength has verily been given by the gods; so that, drinker of the stale Soma, associated with Viṣṇu, you mightiest slay the hostile Ahi obstructing the waters.

mantras.sanskrit: तूर्वन्नोजीयान्तवसस्तवीयान्कृतब्रह्मेन्द्रो वृद्धमहाः । राजाभवन्मधुनः सोम्यस्य विश्वासां यत्पुरां दर्त्नुमावत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tūrvannojīyāntavasastavīyānkṛtabrahmendro vṛddhamahāḥ | rājābhavanmadhunaḥ somyasya viśvāsāṃ yatpurāṃ dartnumāvat ||

translations.english: When Indra, the destroyer, the most mighty, the strongest of the strong, the giver of food, the possessor of vast splendour, received (the thunderbolt), the shatterer of all the cities (of the asuras), he became the lord of the sweet Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: शतैरपद्रन्पणय इन्द्रात्र दशोणये कवयेऽर्कसातौ । वधैः शुष्णस्याशुषस्य मायाः पित्वो नारिरेचीत्किं चन प्र ॥
mantras.transliteration: śatairapadranpaṇaya indrātra daśoṇaye kavaye'rkasātau | vadhaiḥ śuṣṇasyāśuṣasya māyāḥ pitvo nārirecītkiṃ cana pra ||

translations.english: The Paṇis, Indra, fled, with hundres (of asuras), from the sage, your worshipper (and ally) in battle; neither did e, (Indra), suffer the deceptions of the powerful Śuṣṇa to prevail over his weapons, nor did he (leave him) any of his sustenance.

mantras.sanskrit: महो द्रुहो अप विश्वायु धायि वज्रस्य यत्पतने पादि शुष्णः । उरु ष सरथं सारथये करिन्द्रः कुत्साय सूर्यस्य सातौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: maho druho apa viśvāyu dhāyi vajrasya yatpatane pādi śuṣṇaḥ | uru ṣa sarathaṃ sārathaye karindraḥ kutsāya sūryasya sātau ||

translations.english: When Śuṣṇa passed away upon the falling of the thunderbolt, then the universal strength of the great oppressor was annihilated, and Indra enlarged their common car for (the use of) his charioteer Kutsa, for (the sake of) the worship of the sn.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र श्येनो न मदिरमंशुमस्मै शिरो दासस्य नमुचेर्मथायन् । प्रावन्नमीं साप्यं ससन्तं पृणग्राया समिषा सं स्वस्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra śyeno na madiramaṃśumasmai śiro dāsasya namucermathāyan | prāvannamīṃ sāpyaṃ sasantaṃ pṛṇagrāyā samiṣā saṃ svasti ||

translations.english: And the hawk bore to Indra the exhilarating Soma, when, bruising the head of the oppressor Namuci, and protecting the slumbering Nami, the son of Sapya, he provided, for the weeell-being (of the sage), riches and food.

mantras.sanskrit: वि पिप्रोरहिमायस्य दृळ्हाः पुरो वज्रिञ्छवसा न दर्दः । सुदामन्तद्रेक्णो अप्रमृष्यमृजिश्वने दात्रं दाशुषे दाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi piprorahimāyasya dṛḷhāḥ puro vajriñchavasā na dardaḥ | sudāmantadrekṇo apramṛṣyamṛjiśvane dātraṃ dāśuṣe dāḥ ||

translations.english: You have scatered by force, wielder of the thunderbolt, the strong cities of the deadly-deluding Pipru; you have given, bountiful Indra, uninjurable wealh to rijiṣvat, the donor of sacrificial gifts.

mantras.sanskrit: स वेतसुं दशमायं दशोणिं तूतुजिमिन्द्रः स्वभिष्टिसुम्नः । आ तुग्रं शश्वदिभं द्योतनाय मातुर्न सीमुप सृजा इयध्यै ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa vetasuṃ daśamāyaṃ daśoṇiṃ tūtujimindraḥ svabhiṣṭisumnaḥ | ā tugraṃ śaśvadibhaṃ dyotanāya māturna sīmupa sṛjā iyadhyai ||

translations.english: Indra, the granter of wished-for felicity, compelled the many-fraudulent Etaśa and Dasoṇi, Tūtuji, Tugra and Ibha, always to come submissively to (the rājā) Dyotana, as a son (comes before a mother).

mantras.sanskrit: स ईं स्पृधो वनते अप्रतीतो बिभ्रद्वज्रं वृत्रहणं गभस्तौ । तिष्ठद्धरी अध्यस्तेव गर्ते वचोयुजा वहत इन्द्रमृष्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa īṃ spṛdho vanate apratīto bibhradvajraṃ vṛtrahaṇaṃ gabhastau | tiṣṭhaddharī adhyasteva garte vacoyujā vahata indramṛṣvam ||

translations.english: Bearing in his hand the foe-destroyig thunderbolt, Indra, unresisted, demolishing those his adversaries; he mounts his two-horse (car), as a warrior (ascends) his chariot; harnessed at a word, his steeds, convey the migty Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: सनेम तेऽवसा नव्य इन्द्र प्र पूरवः स्तवन्त एना यज्ञैः । सप्त यत्पुरः शर्म शारदीर्दर्द्धन्दासीः पुरुकुत्साय शिक्षन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sanema te'vasā navya indra pra pūravaḥ stavanta enā yajñaiḥ | sapta yatpuraḥ śarma śāradīrdarddhandāsīḥ purukutsāya śikṣan ||

translations.english: (Favoured) by your proection, Indra, we solicit new (wealth); by this adoration men glorify you at sacrifices, for that you have shattered with your bolt the seven cities of Śarat, killing the opponents (of sacred rites), killing the opponents (of sacred rites), and giving (their spoils) to Purukutsa.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं वृध इन्द्र पूर्व्यो भूर्वरिवस्यन्नुशने काव्याय । परा नववास्त्वमनुदेयं महे पित्रे ददाथ स्वं नपातम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ vṛdha indra pūrvyo bhūrvarivasyannuśane kāvyāya | parā navavāstvamanudeyaṃ mahe pitre dadātha svaṃ napātam ||

translations.english: Desirous of opulence, you, Indra, have been an ancient benefactor of Uśanas, the son of Kavi; having slain Navavāstva, you have given back his own grandson, who was (fit) to be restored o the grandfather.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं धुनिरिन्द्र धुनिमतीॠणोरपः सीरा न स्रवन्तीः । प्र यत्समुद्रमति शूर पर्षि पारया तुर्वशं यदुं स्वस्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ dhunirindra dhunimatīṝṇorapaḥ sīrā na sravantīḥ | pra yatsamudramati śūra parṣi pārayā turvaśaṃ yaduṃ svasti ||

translations.english: You, Indra, who make (your enemies) tremble, have caused the waters, detained by Dhuni, to flow like rushing rivers; so, hero, when, having crossed the ocean, you have reached the shore, you have brought over in safety Turvaśa and Yadu.

mantras.sanskrit: तव ह त्यदिन्द्र विश्वमाजौ सस्तो धुनीचुमुरी या ह सिष्वप् । दीदयदित्तुभ्यं सोमेभिः सुन्वन्दभीतिरिध्मभृतिः पक्थ्यर्कैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava ha tyadindra viśvamājau sasto dhunīcumurī yā ha siṣvap | dīdayadittubhyaṃ somebhiḥ sunvandabhītiridhmabhṛtiḥ pakthyarkaiḥ ||

translations.english: All this, Indra, has been your work in war; you have put to sleep, (in depth), the slumbering Dhunī and Cumurī; and thereupon Dabhīti, pouring the libation, preparing the oblation, and supplying the fuel, has glorified you with Soma offerings.

mantras.sanskrit: इमा उ त्वा पुरुतमस्य कारोर्हव्यं वीर हव्या हवन्ते । धियो रथेष्ठामजरं नवीयो रयिर्विभूतिरीयते वचस्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: imā u tvā purutamasya kārorhavyaṃ vīra havyā havante | dhiyo ratheṣṭhāmajaraṃ navīyo rayirvibhūtirīyate vacasyā ||

translations.english: These earnest adorations of the much-desiring worshipper glorify you, hero, Indra, who are adorable; mounted on your car, undecaying, ever new, and to whom the wealth (of sacrifice), the most excellent opulence, proceeds.

mantras.sanskrit: तमु स्तुष इन्द्रं यो विदानो गिर्वाहसं गीर्भिर्यज्ञवृद्धम् । यस्य दिवमति मह्ना पृथिव्याः पुरुमायस्य रिरिचे महित्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamu stuṣa indraṃ yo vidāno girvāhasaṃ gīrbhiryajñavṛddham | yasya divamati mahnā pṛthivyāḥ purumāyasya ririce mahitvam ||

translations.english: I glorifyi that Indra who is propitiated by praises, exalted by sacrifices, who knows all things; the magnitude of whom, the possessor of various wisdom, exceeds in vastness (that of) heaven and earth.

mantras.sanskrit: स इत्तमोऽवयुनं ततन्वत्सूर्येण वयुनवच्चकार । कदा ते मर्ता अमृतस्य धामेयक्षन्तो न मिनन्ति स्वधावः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa ittamo'vayunaṃ tatanvatsūryeṇa vayunavaccakāra | kadā te martā amṛtasya dhāmeyakṣanto na minanti svadhāvaḥ ||

translations.english: He who made the indistinct, wide-spreading darkness distinct with the sun; whenever, possessor of strength, mortals are seeking to adore the dwelling of you who are an immortal, they harm not (any living being).

mantras.sanskrit: यस्ता चकार स कुह स्विदिन्द्रः कमा जनं चरति कासु विक्षु । कस्ते यज्ञो मनसे शं वराय को अर्क इन्द्र कतमः स होता ॥
mantras.transliteration: yastā cakāra sa kuha svidindraḥ kamā janaṃ carati kāsu vikṣu | kaste yajño manase śaṃ varāya ko arka indra katamaḥ sa hotā ||

translations.english: What is he, the Indra who has done these deeds? What region does he frequent? Amog what people (does he abide)? What worship, Indra, gives satisfaction to your mind? What praise is able to gratify you? Which of your invokers (is most acceptable to you)?

mantras.sanskrit: इदा हि ते वेविषतः पुराजाः प्रत्नास आसुः पुरुकृत्सखायः । ये मध्यमास उत नूतनास उतावमस्य पुरुहूत बोधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: idā hi te veviṣataḥ purājāḥ pratnāsa āsuḥ purukṛtsakhāyaḥ | ye madhyamāsa uta nūtanāsa utāvamasya puruhūta bodhi ||

translations.english: Doer of many deeds, these adders, born in former times, engaged in sacred rites, have been, as they are now, your friends; so have those of mediaeval and those of recent (date); therefore, invoked of many, take notice of your (present) humble (adorer).

mantras.sanskrit: तं पृच्छन्तोऽवरासः पराणि प्रत्ना त इन्द्र श्रुत्यानु येमुः । अर्चामसि वीर ब्रह्मवाहो यादेव विद्म तात्त्वा महान्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ pṛcchanto'varāsaḥ parāṇi pratnā ta indra śrutyānu yemuḥ | arcāmasi vīra brahmavāho yādeva vidma tāttvā mahāntam ||

translations.english: Humble (worshippers), adoring him, commemorate, Indra, your excellent, ancient, and glorious (deeds); so, hero, who are attracted by prayer, we praise you who are mighty, for those great actions with which we are acquained.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि त्वा पाजो रक्षसो वि तस्थे महि जज्ञानमभि तत्सु तिष्ठ । तव प्रत्नेन युज्येन सख्या वज्रेण धृष्णो अप ता नुदस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi tvā pājo rakṣaso vi tasthe mahi jajñānamabhi tatsu tiṣṭha | tava pratnena yujyena sakhyā vajreṇa dhṛṣṇo apa tā nudasva ||

translations.english: The strength of the rākṣasas is concentrated against you; bear up well against that mighty manifested (effort); scatter them, valiant (Indra), with your old associate, your friend, the thunderbolt.

mantras.sanskrit: स तु श्रुधीन्द्र नूतनस्य ब्रह्मण्यतो वीर कारुधायः । त्वं ह्यापिः प्रदिवि पितॄणां शश्वद्बभूथ सुहव एष्टौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa tu śrudhīndra nūtanasya brahmaṇyato vīra kārudhāyaḥ | tvaṃ hyāpiḥ pradivi pitṝṇāṃ śaśvadbabhūtha suhava eṣṭau ||

translations.english: Supporter of (your) worshippers, hero, Indra, listen (to the praises) of your present adorer, for you have always attended to invocations at sacrifices in ancient times, as the kinsman of our forefather.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रोतये वरुणं मित्रमिन्द्रं मरुतः कृष्वावसे नो अद्य । प्र पूषणं विष्णुमग्निं पुरंधिं सवितारमोषधीः पर्वताँश्च ॥
mantras.transliteration: protaye varuṇaṃ mitramindraṃ marutaḥ kṛṣvāvase no adya | pra pūṣaṇaṃ viṣṇumagniṃ puraṃdhiṃ savitāramoṣadhīḥ parvatā~śca ||

translations.english: Propitiate today, for our protection and preservation, Varuṇa, Mitra, Indra and the Maruts, Pūṣan, Viṣṇu, Agni, of many rites, Savitā, the herbs, the mountains.

mantras.sanskrit: इम उ त्वा पुरुशाक प्रयज्यो जरितारो अभ्यर्चन्त्यर्कैः । श्रुधी हवमा हुवतो हुवानो न त्वावाँ अन्यो अमृत त्वदस्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ima u tvā puruśāka prayajyo jaritāro abhyarcantyarkaiḥ | śrudhī havamā huvato huvāno na tvāvā~ anyo amṛta tvadasti ||

translations.english: Indra, of great power, and to be devoutly worshipped, these your adorers glorify you with hymns; do you, who are invoked, hear the invocation of (him) invoking you, for there is no other divinity than you, immortal (Indra), such as you are.

mantras.sanskrit: नू म आ वाचमुप याहि विद्वान्विश्वेभिः सूनो सहसो यजत्रैः । ये अग्निजिह्वा ऋतसाप आसुर्ये मनुं चक्रुरुपरं दसाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū ma ā vācamupa yāhi vidvānviśvebhiḥ sūno sahaso yajatraiḥ | ye agnijihvā ṛtasāpa āsurye manuṃ cakruruparaṃ dasāya ||

translations.english: Come quickly, son of strength, you who know (all things), upon my prayer; together with all the adorable (divinities); they who, with the tongue of Agni, are partakers of the sacrifice, who rendered Manu (victorious) over his adversaries.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो बोधि पुरएता सुगेषूत दुर्गेषु पथिकृद्विदानः । ये अश्रमास उरवो वहिष्ठास्तेभिर्न इन्द्राभि वक्षि वाजम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no bodhi puraetā sugeṣūta durgeṣu pathikṛdvidānaḥ | ye aśramāsa uravo vahiṣṭhāstebhirna indrābhi vakṣi vājam ||

translations.english: Constructor of paths, who are cognizant (of all things), be our preceder, whether in easy or difficult (ways); bring to us food, Indra, with those your (steeds), who are unwearied, large, and bearers of great burdens.

mantras.sanskrit: य एक इद्धव्यश्चर्षणीनामिन्द्रं तं गीर्भिरभ्यर्च आभिः । यः पत्यते वृषभो वृष्ण्यावान्त्सत्यः सत्वा पुरुमायः सहस्वान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya eka iddhavyaścarṣaṇīnāmindraṃ taṃ gīrbhirabhyarca ābhiḥ | yaḥ patyate vṛṣabho vṛṣṇyāvāntsatyaḥ satvā purumāyaḥ sahasvān ||

translations.english: I glorify with these praises, Indra, who alone is to be invoked by man; who comes (to his worshippers) the showerer (of benefits), the vigorous, the observer of truth, the subduer of foes, the possessor of manifold knowledge, the mighty.

mantras.sanskrit: तमु नः पूर्वे पितरो नवग्वाः सप्त विप्रासो अभि वाजयन्तः । नक्षद्दाभं ततुरिं पर्वतेष्ठामद्रोघवाचं मतिभिः शविष्ठम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamu naḥ pūrve pitaro navagvāḥ sapta viprāso abhi vājayantaḥ | nakṣaddābhaṃ taturiṃ parvateṣṭhāmadroghavācaṃ matibhiḥ śaviṣṭham ||

translations.english: To him the seven sages, our ancient progenitors, performing the nine days' rite, were offerers of (sacrificial) food, celebrating with hymns the very strong (Indra), the humiliator of foes, the traverser of the heavens, he dweller in the clouds, whose commands are not to be disobeyed.

mantras.sanskrit: तमीमह इन्द्रमस्य रायः पुरुवीरस्य नृवतः पुरुक्षोः । यो अस्कृधोयुरजरः स्वर्वान्तमा भर हरिवो मादयध्यै ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamīmaha indramasya rāyaḥ puruvīrasya nṛvataḥ purukṣoḥ | yo askṛdhoyurajaraḥ svarvāntamā bhara harivo mādayadhyai ||

translations.english: We solicit that Indra for wealth, comprehending numerous descendants, followers and much cattle, and which is undisturbed, imperishable, and the source of felicity, such riches, lord of steeds, bestow upon us to make us happy.

mantras.sanskrit: तन्नो वि वोचो यदि ते पुरा चिज्जरितार आनशुः सुम्नमिन्द्र । कस्ते भागः किं वयो दुध्र खिद्वः पुरुहूत पुरूवसोऽसुरघ्नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tanno vi voco yadi te purā cijjaritāra ānaśuḥ sumnamindra | kaste bhāgaḥ kiṃ vayo dudhra khidvaḥ puruhūta purūvaso'suraghnaḥ ||

translations.english: If, Indra, your worshippers have formerly obtained felicity, confer that also upon us; irresistible Indra, subduer of foes, invoked of many, abounding in wealth, what is the portion, what the offering (due) to you who are the slayer of the asuras?

mantras.sanskrit: तं पृच्छन्ती वज्रहस्तं रथेष्ठामिन्द्रं वेपी वक्वरी यस्य नू गीः । तुविग्राभं तुविकूर्मिं रभोदां गातुमिषे नक्षते तुम्रमच्छ ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ pṛcchantī vajrahastaṃ ratheṣṭhāmindraṃ vepī vakvarī yasya nū gīḥ | tuvigrābhaṃ tuvikūrmiṃ rabhodāṃ gātumiṣe nakṣate tumramaccha ||

translations.english: He whose ceremonial and eulogistic hymn is commemorating Indra, the holder of the thunderbolt, seated in his car, the accepter of many, the doer of many great deeds, the bestower of strength, proceeds promptly to acquire happiness, and encounters (with confidence) the malevolent.

mantras.sanskrit: अया ह त्यं मायया वावृधानं मनोजुवा स्वतवः पर्वतेन । अच्युता चिद्वीळिता स्वोजो रुजो वि दृळ्हा धृषता विरप्शिन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayā ha tyaṃ māyayā vāvṛdhānaṃ manojuvā svatavaḥ parvatena | acyutā cidvīḷitā svojo rujo vi dṛḷhā dhṛṣatā virapśin ||

translations.english: Self-invigorated Indra, you have crushed by your knotted (thunderbolt), quick as thought, that Vṛtra, growing in strength by this cunning; very radiant and mighty (Indra), you have demolished by (your) irresistible (shaft) the unyielding, compact, and strong (cities of the asuras).

mantras.sanskrit: तं वो धिया नव्यस्या शविष्ठं प्रत्नं प्रत्नवत्परितंसयध्यै । स नो वक्षदनिमानः सुवह्मेन्द्रो विश्वान्यति दुर्गहाणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ vo dhiyā navyasyā śaviṣṭhaṃ pratnaṃ pratnavatparitaṃsayadhyai | sa no vakṣadanimānaḥ suvahmendro viśvānyati durgahāṇi ||

translations.english: (I have undertaken) to spread around with a new hymn, as i was done of old, (the glory of) you, the ancient and most mighty (Indra); may that Indra, who is illimitable, and is a sure conveyance, bear us over all difficulties.

mantras.sanskrit: आ जनाय द्रुह्वणे पार्थिवानि दिव्यानि दीपयोऽन्तरिक्षा । तपा वृषन्विश्वतः शोचिषा तान्ब्रह्मद्विषे शोचय क्षामपश्च ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā janāya druhvaṇe pārthivāni divyāni dīpayo'ntarikṣā | tapā vṛṣanviśvataḥ śociṣā tānbrahmadviṣe śocaya kṣāmapaśca ||

translations.english: Make hot the regions of earth, of heaven, of mid air, for the oppressive race (of the rākṣasas); showerer (of benefits), consume them everywhere with your radiance, make the heaven and the firmament (too) hot for the impious.

mantras.sanskrit: भुवो जनस्य दिव्यस्य राजा पार्थिवस्य जगतस्त्वेषसंदृक् । धिष्व वज्रं दक्षिण इन्द्र हस्ते विश्वा अजुर्य दयसे वि मायाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhuvo janasya divyasya rājā pārthivasya jagatastveṣasaṃdṛk | dhiṣva vajraṃ dakṣiṇa indra haste viśvā ajurya dayase vi māyāḥ ||

translations.english: Bright-flaming Indra, you are the king of the people of heaven, and of the moving races of earth; grasp in your right hand the thunderbolt, wherewith, Indra, who are beyond all praise, you baffle all the devices (of the asuras).

mantras.sanskrit: आ संयतमिन्द्र णः स्वस्तिं शत्रुतूर्याय बृहतीममृध्राम् । यया दासान्यार्याणि वृत्रा करो वज्रिन्त्सुतुका नाहुषाणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā saṃyatamindra ṇaḥ svastiṃ śatrutūryāya bṛhatīmamṛdhrām | yayā dāsānyāryāṇi vṛtrā karo vajrintsutukā nāhuṣāṇi ||

translations.english: Brin to us, Indra, concentrated, vast and unassailable prosperity beyond the reach of enemies, and by which, wielder of the thunderbolt, you have rendered human enemies, whether Dāsas or Āryas, easy to be overcome.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो नियुद्भिः पुरुहूत वेधो विश्ववाराभिरा गहि प्रयज्यो । न या अदेवो वरते न देव आभिर्याहि तूयमा मद्र्यद्रिक् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no niyudbhiḥ puruhūta vedho viśvavārābhirā gahi prayajyo | na yā adevo varate na deva ābhiryāhi tūyamā madryadrik ||

translations.english: Invoked of many, creator, object of sacrifices, come to us with your all-admired steeds, whom neither asura nor deity arrests; come with them quickly to our presence.

mantras.sanskrit: सुत इत्त्वं निमिश्ल इन्द्र सोमे स्तोमे ब्रह्मणि शस्यमान उक्थे । यद्वा युक्ताभ्यां मघवन्हरिभ्यां बिभ्रद्वज्रं बाह्वोरिन्द्र यासि ॥
mantras.transliteration: suta ittvaṃ nimiśla indra some stome brahmaṇi śasyamāna ukthe | yadvā yuktābhyāṃ maghavanharibhyāṃ bibhradvajraṃ bāhvorindra yāsi ||

translations.english: Indra, when the Soma is being effused, the sacred hymn chanted, the prayer recited, be you prepared (to harness your horses), or, Maghavan, with your horses ready harnessed, come (hither), bearing the thunderbolt in your hand.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्वा दिवि पार्ये सुष्विमिन्द्र वृत्रहत्येऽवसि शूरसातौ । यद्वा दक्षस्य बिभ्युषो अबिभ्यदरन्धयः शर्धत इन्द्र दस्यून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadvā divi pārye suṣvimindra vṛtrahatye'vasi śūrasātau | yadvā dakṣasya bibhyuṣo abibhyadarandhayaḥ śardhata indra dasyūn ||

translations.english: Or as, although engaged in heaven in the hero-animating conflict with foes, you protect the offerer of the libation, and humblest, undaunted Indra, the Dasyus, the disturbers of the pious and terrified worshipper, (so do you come when the soma is effused.

mantras.sanskrit: पाता सुतमिन्द्रो अस्तु सोमं प्रणेनीरुग्रो जरितारमूती । कर्ता वीराय सुष्वय उ लोकं दाता वसु स्तुवते कीरये चित् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pātā sutamindro astu somaṃ praṇenīrugro jaritāramūtī | kartā vīrāya suṣvaya u lokaṃ dātā vasu stuvate kīraye cit ||

translations.english: May Indra be the drinker of the effused soma, he who is the fierce conductor of the worshipper to security; may he be the donor of the world to the presenter of the libation, the giver of wealth to the man who adores him.

mantras.sanskrit: गन्तेयान्ति सवना हरिभ्यां बभ्रिर्वज्रं पपिः सोमं ददिर्गाः । कर्ता वीरं नर्यं सर्ववीरं श्रोता हवं गृणतः स्तोमवाहाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ganteyānti savanā haribhyāṃ babhrirvajraṃ papiḥ somaṃ dadirgāḥ | kartā vīraṃ naryaṃ sarvavīraṃ śrotā havaṃ gṛṇataḥ stomavāhāḥ ||

translations.english: May Indra, with his steeds, come o us as many (daily) rites (as may be celebrated), bearing the thundeerbolt, drinking the soma, bestowing cattle, granting manly and multiplied posterity, hearing the invocation of his adorer, and being the accenter of (our) praises.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मै वयं यद्वावान तद्विविष्म इन्द्राय यो नः प्रदिवो अपस्कः । सुते सोमे स्तुमसि शंसदुक्थेन्द्राय ब्रह्म वर्धनं यथासत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmai vayaṃ yadvāvāna tadviviṣma indrāya yo naḥ pradivo apaskaḥ | sute some stumasi śaṃsadukthendrāya brahma vardhanaṃ yathāsat ||

translations.english: To that Indra, who of old has rendered us good offices, we address (the praise) that he is plural ased by; we celebrate him when the soma is effused, repeating the prayer that the (sacrificial) food (offered) to Indra may be for his augmentation.

mantras.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणि हि चकृषे वर्धनानि तावत्त इन्द्र मतिभिर्विविष्मः । सुते सोमे सुतपाः शंतमानि राण्ड्या क्रियास्म वक्षणानि यज्ञैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: brahmāṇi hi cakṛṣe vardhanāni tāvatta indra matibhirviviṣmaḥ | sute some sutapāḥ śaṃtamāni rāṇḍyā kriyāsma vakṣaṇāni yajñaiḥ ||

translations.english: Since, Indra, you have made the (sacred) prayers (the means of) your augmentation, we address such to you, along with our praises; may we offer gratifying and acceptable eulogies to the drinker of the effused libation, with (our) sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो बोधि पुरोळाशं रराणः पिबा तु सोमं गोऋजीकमिन्द्र । एदं बर्हिर्यजमानस्य सीदोरुं कृधि त्वायत उ लोकम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no bodhi puroḷāśaṃ rarāṇaḥ pibā tu somaṃ goṛjīkamindra | edaṃ barhiryajamānasya sīdoruṃ kṛdhi tvāyata u lokam ||

translations.english: Accept, Indra, who are condescending, our cakes and butter; drink the soma mixed with curds; sit down upon this sacred grass (strewn by) the worshipper; grant ample possessions to him who depends on you.

mantras.sanskrit: स मन्दस्वा ह्यनु जोषमुग्र प्र त्वा यज्ञास इमे अश्नुवन्तु । प्रेमे हवासः पुरुहूतमस्मे आ त्वेयं धीरवस इन्द्र यम्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa mandasvā hyanu joṣamugra pra tvā yajñāsa ime aśnuvantu | preme havāsaḥ puruhūtamasme ā tveyaṃ dhīravasa indra yamyāḥ ||

translations.english: Rejoice, fierce Indra, according to your plural asure; let these libations reach you; invoked of many, may these our invocations ascend to you; may this praise influence you for our protection.

mantras.sanskrit: तं वः सखायः सं यथा सुतेषु सोमेभिरीं पृणता भोजमिन्द्रम् । कुवित्तस्मा असति नो भराय न सुष्विमिन्द्रोऽवसे मृधाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ vaḥ sakhāyaḥ saṃ yathā suteṣu somebhirīṃ pṛṇatā bhojamindram | kuvittasmā asati no bharāya na suṣvimindro'vase mṛdhāti ||

translations.english: Friends, when the libations are effused, do you satisfy that liberal Indra with the soma; let there be plural nty for him, that (he may provide) for our nourishmen; Indra never neglects the care of him who presents copious oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: एवेदिन्द्रः सुते अस्तावि सोमे भरद्वाजेषु क्षयदिन्मघोनः । असद्यथा जरित्र उत सूरिरिन्द्रो रायो विश्ववारस्य दाता ॥
mantras.transliteration: evedindraḥ sute astāvi some bharadvājeṣu kṣayadinmaghonaḥ | asadyathā jaritra uta sūririndro rāyo viśvavārasya dātā ||

translations.english: Thus has Indra, the lord of the opulent, been glorified by the Bhaāradvājas, upon the libation being effused, that he may be th director of his eulogist (to virtue), that Indra may be the giver of all desirable riches.

mantras.sanskrit: वृषा मद इन्द्रे श्लोक उक्था सचा सोमेषु सुतपा ऋजीषी । अर्चत्र्यो मघवा नृभ्य उक्थैर्द्युक्षो राजा गिरामक्षितोतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣā mada indre śloka ukthā sacā someṣu sutapā ṛjīṣī | arcatryo maghavā nṛbhya ukthairdyukṣo rājā girāmakṣitotiḥ ||

translations.english: At the rites at which soma (is offered) the exhilaration (produced) in Indra is a shower (of benefits to the offerer); so is the chanted hymn with the (recited) prayer, therefore the drinker of the soma, the partaker of the stale soma, Maghavan, is to be propitiated by men with praises; dweller in heaven, he is the lord of sacred songs, unwearied in the protection (of his votaries).

mantras.sanskrit: ततुरिर्वीरो नर्यो विचेताः श्रोता हवं गृणत उर्व्यूतिः । वसुः शंसो नरां कारुधाया वाजी स्तुतो विदथे दाति वाजम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taturirvīro naryo vicetāḥ śrotā havaṃ gṛṇata urvyūtiḥ | vasuḥ śaṃso narāṃ kārudhāyā vājī stuto vidathe dāti vājam ||

translations.english: The surpasser (of foes), a hero, the friend of man, the discriminator, the hearer of the invocation, the great protector of his adorers, the giver of dwelings, the ruler of men, the cherisher of his worshippers, the bestower of food, grants us, when glorified at the sacrifice, (abundant) sustenance.

mantras.sanskrit: अक्षो न चक्र्योः शूर बृहन्प्र ते मह्ना रिरिचे रोदस्योः । वृक्षस्य नु ते पुरुहूत वया व्यूतयो रुरुहुरिन्द्र पूर्वीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: akṣo na cakryoḥ śūra bṛhanpra te mahnā ririce rodasyoḥ | vṛkṣasya nu te puruhūta vayā vyūtayo ruruhurindra pūrvīḥ ||

translations.english: Mighty hero, by your magnitude, (the exten) of heaven and earth is exceeded, as the axle by the (circumerfence of the) wheels; invoked of many, your numerous benefits, Indra, spread out like the branches of a tree.

mantras.sanskrit: शचीवतस्ते पुरुशाक शाका गवामिव स्रुतयः संचरणीः । वत्सानां न तन्तयस्त इन्द्र दामन्वन्तो अदामानः सुदामन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śacīvataste puruśāka śākā gavāmiva srutayaḥ saṃcaraṇīḥ | vatsānāṃ na tantayasta indra dāmanvanto adāmānaḥ sudāman ||

translations.english: Accomplisher of many acts, the energies of you who are (ever) active (congregate from all directions), like the converging tracks of cattle; they are the bonds (of foes), themselves unfettered, munificent Indra, like the tethers of (many) calves.

mantras.sanskrit: अन्यदद्य कर्वरमन्यदु श्वोऽसच्च सन्मुहुराचक्रिरिन्द्रः । मित्रो नो अत्र वरुणश्च पूषार्यो वशस्य पर्येतास्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: anyadadya karvaramanyadu śvo'sacca sanmuhurācakririndraḥ | mitro no atra varuṇaśca pūṣāryo vaśasya paryetāsti ||

translations.english: Indra achieves one act today, another tomorrow, evil and good repeatedly; may he, and Mitra, Varuṇa, Pūṣan, Arya, be on this occasion promoters of the desired result.

mantras.sanskrit: वि त्वदापो न पर्वतस्य पृष्ठादुक्थेभिरिन्द्रानयन्त यज्ञैः । तं त्वाभिः सुष्टुतिभिर्वाजयन्त आजिं न जग्मुर्गिर्वाहो अश्वाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi tvadāpo na parvatasya pṛṣṭhādukthebhirindrānayanta yajñaiḥ | taṃ tvābhiḥ suṣṭutibhirvājayanta ājiṃ na jagmurgirvāho aśvāḥ ||

translations.english: By praises and by sacrifices, Indra, (men) bring down (what they desire) from you, as the waters (descend) from the top of the mountain; desirous of food, they approach you, who are accessible to praise, with these their eulogies, as (eagerly as) coursers rush to battle.

mantras.sanskrit: न यं जरन्ति शरदो न मासा न द्याव इन्द्रमवकर्शयन्ति । वृद्धस्य चिद्वर्धतामस्य तनूः स्तोमेभिरुक्थैश्च शस्यमाना ॥
mantras.transliteration: na yaṃ jaranti śarado na māsā na dyāva indramavakarśayanti | vṛddhasya cidvardhatāmasya tanūḥ stomebhirukthaiśca śasyamānā ||

translations.english: May the person n of that vast Indra, celebrated by praises and prayers, ever increase; Indra, whom neither years nor months make old, nor days enfeeble.

mantras.sanskrit: न वीळवे नमते न स्थिराय न शर्धते दस्युजूताय स्तवान् । अज्रा इन्द्रस्य गिरयश्चिदृष्वा गम्भीरे चिद्भवति गाधमस्मै ॥
mantras.transliteration: na vīḷave namate na sthirāya na śardhate dasyujūtāya stavān | ajrā indrasya girayaścidṛṣvā gambhīre cidbhavati gādhamasmai ||

translations.english: Glorified by us, he bows not down to the robust, nor to the resolute, nor to the person vering (worshipper) who is instrumental gated by the (irreligious) Dasyus; the lofty mountains are easy of access o Indra; to him there is a bottom in the (lowest) deep.

mantras.sanskrit: गम्भीरेण न उरुणामत्रिन्प्रेषो यन्धि सुतपावन्वाजान् । स्था ऊ षु ऊर्ध्व ऊती अरिषण्यन्नक्तोर्व्युष्टौ परितक्म्यायाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: gambhīreṇa na uruṇāmatrinpreṣo yandhi sutapāvanvājān | sthā ū ṣu ūrdhva ūtī ariṣaṇyannaktorvyuṣṭau paritakmyāyām ||

translations.english: Powerful Indra, drinker of the soma, (actuated) by a profound and comprehensive (purpose), grant us food and strength; be ever diligent, benevolent Indra, for our protection by day and by night.

mantras.sanskrit: सचस्व नायमवसे अभीक इतो वा तमिन्द्र पाहि रिषः । अमा चैनमरण्ये पाहि रिषो मदेम शतहिमाः सुवीराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sacasva nāyamavase abhīka ito vā tamindra pāhi riṣaḥ | amā cainamaraṇye pāhi riṣo madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ ||

translations.english: Accompany, Indra, the leader in battle for his protection; defend him against a near (or distant) foe; protect him from an enemy, whether in (his) house or in a forest, and may we, blessed with excellent male descendants, be happy for a hundred winters.

mantras.sanskrit: या त ऊतिरवमा या परमा या मध्यमेन्द्र शुष्मिन्नस्ति । ताभिरू षु वृत्रहत्येऽवीर्न एभिश्च वाजैर्महान्न उग्र ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā ta ūtiravamā yā paramā yā madhyamendra śuṣminnasti | tābhirū ṣu vṛtrahatye'vīrna ebhiśca vājairmahānna ugra ||

translations.english: Powerful Indra, with these (your protections), whether the protection be little, great or middlin, defend us for the destruction of our foes; supply us, fierce Indra, who are mighty, with those viands (that are needed).

mantras.sanskrit: आभिः स्पृधो मिथतीररिषण्यन्नमित्रस्य व्यथया मन्युमिन्द्र । आभिर्विश्वा अभियुजो विषूचीरार्याय विशोऽव तारीर्दासीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ābhiḥ spṛdho mithatīrariṣaṇyannamitrasya vyathayā manyumindra | ābhirviśvā abhiyujo viṣūcīrāryāya viśo'va tārīrdāsīḥ ||

translations.english: (Induced) by these (praises), protecting our assailing host, baffle, Indra, the wrath of the enemy; (induced) by them, overthrow, on the part of the Ārya, all the servile people everywhere abiding.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र जामय उत येऽजामयोऽर्वाचीनासो वनुषो युयुज्रे । त्वमेषां विथुरा शवांसि जहि वृष्ण्यानि कृणुही पराचः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra jāmaya uta ye'jāmayo'rvācīnāso vanuṣo yuyujre | tvameṣāṃ vithurā śavāṃsi jahi vṛṣṇyāni kṛṇuhī parācaḥ ||

translations.english: Annihilate, Indra, the strength of those who, whether kinsmen or unrelated, present themselves before us, exerting themselves as adversaries; enfeeble their prowess, put them to fight.

mantras.sanskrit: शूरो वा शूरं वनते शरीरैस्तनूरुचा तरुषि यत्कृण्वैते । तोके वा गोषु तनये यदप्सु वि क्रन्दसी उर्वरासु ब्रवैते ॥
mantras.transliteration: śūro vā śūraṃ vanate śarīraistanūrucā taruṣi yatkṛṇvaite | toke vā goṣu tanaye yadapsu vi krandasī urvarāsu bravaite ||

translations.english: The hero, (favoured by you), assuredly slays the (hostile) hero by his bodily prowess, when, both excelling in person nal strength, they strive together in conflict, or when, clamorous, they dispute for (the sake of) sons, of grandson, of cattle, of water, of land.

mantras.sanskrit: नहि त्वा शूरो न तुरो न धृष्णुर्न त्वा योधो मन्यमानो युयोध । इन्द्र नकिष्ट्वा प्रत्यस्त्येषां विश्वा जातान्यभ्यसि तानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahi tvā śūro na turo na dhṛṣṇurna tvā yodho manyamāno yuyodha | indra nakiṣṭvā pratyastyeṣāṃ viśvā jātānyabhyasi tāni ||

translations.english: But you (no one) resists, neither the hero, nor the fleet runner, nor the resolute, nor the combatant confiding (in his valour); neither of these, Indra, is a match for you; you are superior to all these person ns.

mantras.sanskrit: स पत्यत उभयोर्नृम्णमयोर्यदी वेधसः समिथे हवन्ते । वृत्रे वा महो नृवति क्षये वा व्यचस्वन्ता यदि वितन्तसैते ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa patyata ubhayornṛmṇamayoryadī vedhasaḥ samithe havante | vṛtre vā maho nṛvati kṣaye vā vyacasvantā yadi vitantasaite ||

translations.english: Of both these (disputants), that one acquires wealth whose priests invoke (Indra) at the sacrifice, whether the conten emulous for (the overthrow of) a powerful enemy, or for a dwelling peopled with dependants.

mantras.sanskrit: अध स्मा ते चर्षणयो यदेजानिन्द्र त्रातोत भवा वरूता । अस्माकासो ये नृतमासो अर्य इन्द्र सूरयो दधिरे पुरो नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha smā te carṣaṇayo yadejānindra trātota bhavā varūtā | asmākāso ye nṛtamāso arya indra sūrayo dadhire puro naḥ ||

translations.english: Therefore, Indra, when your people tremble (with fear), protect them; be to them a defender; may those who are our chief leaders be enjoyers (of your favour), as well as those (your) worshippers who have plural ced us foremost (to perform the sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: अनु ते दायि मह इन्द्रियाय सत्रा ते विश्वमनु वृत्रहत्ये । अनु क्षत्रमनु सहो यजत्रेन्द्र देवेभिरनु ते नृषह्ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: anu te dāyi maha indriyāya satrā te viśvamanu vṛtrahatye | anu kṣatramanu saho yajatrendra devebhiranu te nṛṣahye ||

translations.english: All (power) has been successively conceded verily to you, Indra, who are mighty, for the destruction of the foe; suitable vigour, suitable strength in battle (has been given) to you, adorable Indra, by the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा नः स्पृधः समजा समत्स्विन्द्र रारन्धि मिथतीरदेवीः । विद्याम वस्तोरवसा गृणन्तो भरद्वाजा उत त इन्द्र नूनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā naḥ spṛdhaḥ samajā samatsvindra rārandhi mithatīradevīḥ | vidyāma vastoravasā gṛṇanto bharadvājā uta ta indra nūnam ||

translations.english: So (glorified by us), Indra, animate us (to overcome) our enemies in battle; overthrow our pious, malevolent (foes), and may we, Bhāradvājas, praising you, assuredly possess habitations, with (abundant) food.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रुधी न इन्द्र ह्वयामसि त्वा महो वाजस्य सातौ वावृषाणाः । सं यद्विशोऽयन्त शूरसाता उग्रं नोऽवः पार्ये अहन्दाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śrudhī na indra hvayāmasi tvā maho vājasya sātau vāvṛṣāṇāḥ | saṃ yadviśo'yanta śūrasātā ugraṃ no'vaḥ pārye ahandāḥ ||

translations.english: Hear us, Indra, when, offering libations, we call  upon you for obtaining abundant food; grant us decided protection when on a future day men are assembling for battle.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वां वाजी हवते वाजिनेयो महो वाजस्य गध्यस्य सातौ । त्वां वृत्रेष्विन्द्र सत्पतिं तरुत्रं त्वां चष्टे मुष्टिहा गोषु युध्यन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāṃ vājī havate vājineyo maho vājasya gadhyasya sātau | tvāṃ vṛtreṣvindra satpatiṃ tarutraṃ tvāṃ caṣṭe muṣṭihā goṣu yudhyan ||

translations.english: The son of Vājini, (Bharadvāja), offering (sacrificial) viands, invokes you for (the sake of) acquiring obtainable and abundant food; (he invokes) you, Indra, the preserver of the good, the defender (from the wicked), when enemies (assail him); he depends upon you when, lifting up his fist, he is fighting for (his) cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं कविं चोदयोऽर्कसातौ त्वं कुत्साय शुष्णं दाशुषे वर्क् । त्वं शिरो अमर्मणः पराहन्नतिथिग्वाय शंस्यं करिष्यन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ kaviṃ codayo'rkasātau tvaṃ kutsāya śuṣṇaṃ dāśuṣe vark | tvaṃ śiro amarmaṇaḥ parāhannatithigvāya śaṃsyaṃ kariṣyan ||

translations.english: You have animated the sage with (the hope of) obtaining food; you have cut to pieces Śuṣṇa for Kutsa, the donor of the oblation; you have struck off the head (of Śambara), imagining himself invulnerable, intending to give plural asure to Atithigvan.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं रथं प्र भरो योधमृष्वमावो युध्यन्तं वृषभं दशद्युम् । त्वं तुग्रं वेतसवे सचाहन्त्वं तुजिं गृणन्तमिन्द्र तूतोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ rathaṃ pra bharo yodhamṛṣvamāvo yudhyantaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ daśadyum | tvaṃ tugraṃ vetasave sacāhantvaṃ tujiṃ gṛṇantamindra tūtoḥ ||

translations.english: You have brought to Vṛṣabha a great war-chariot; you have protected him warring for ten days; you have slain Tugra along with Vetasa; you have exalted Tuji glorifying you.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं तदुक्थमिन्द्र बर्हणा कः प्र यच्छता सहस्रा शूर दर्षि । अव गिरेर्दासं शम्बरं हन्प्रावो दिवोदासं चित्राभिरूती ॥
