mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ tadukthamindra barhaṇā kaḥ pra yacchatā sahasrā śūra darṣi | ava girerdāsaṃ śambaraṃ hanprāvo divodāsaṃ citrābhirūtī ||

translations.english: Indra, who are the subduer (of foes), you have achieved a glorious (deed), inasmuch as you have scatered, hero, the hundreds and thousands (of the host of Śambara), have slain the slave Śambara (when issuing) from the mountain, and have protected Divodāsa with marvellous protections.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं श्रद्धाभिर्मन्दसानः सोमैर्दभीतये चुमुरिमिन्द्र सिष्वप् । त्वं रजिं पिठीनसे दशस्यन्षष्टिं सहस्रा शच्या सचाहन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ śraddhābhirmandasānaḥ somairdabhītaye cumurimindra siṣvap | tvaṃ rajiṃ piṭhīnase daśasyanṣaṣṭiṃ sahasrā śacyā sacāhan ||

translations.english: Delighted by libations offered wiḥ faith, you have consigned Cumuri to the sleeop (of death) on behalf of Dabhīti, and bestowing (the maiden) Raji upon Piṭhīnas, you have, by your contrivance, destroyed sixty thousand (warriors) at once.

mantras.sanskrit: अहं चन तत्सूरिभिरानश्यां तव ज्याय इन्द्र सुम्नमोजः । त्वया यत्स्तवन्ते सधवीर वीरास्त्रिवरूथेन नहुषा शविष्ठ ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ cana tatsūribhirānaśyāṃ tava jyāya indra sumnamojaḥ | tvayā yatstavante sadhavīra vīrāstrivarūthena nahuṣā śaviṣṭha ||

translations.english: May I, with my fellow-worshippers, obtain that your most excellent felicity and vigour, which, most mighty Indra, associate of heroes, the pious celebrate (as bestowed) by you, who are the humiliator (of foes), the protector of the three (worlds).

mantras.sanskrit: वयं ते अस्यामिन्द्र द्युम्नहूतौ सखायः स्याम महिन प्रेष्ठाः । प्रातर्दनिः क्षत्रश्रीरस्तु श्रेष्ठो घने वृत्राणां सनये धनानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayaṃ te asyāmindra dyumnahūtau sakhāyaḥ syāma mahina preṣṭhāḥ | prātardaniḥ kṣatraśrīrastu śreṣṭho ghane vṛtrāṇāṃ sanaye dhanānām ||

translations.english: May we, adorable Indra, your friends, at this your worship, offered for (the acquisiiton of) wealth, be held most dear to you; may Kṣatraśrī, the son of Pratardana, (my patron), by most illustrious through the destruction of foes, and the attainment of riches.

mantras.sanskrit: किमस्य मदे किम्वस्य पीताविन्द्रः किमस्य सख्ये चकार । रणा वा ये निषदि किं ते अस्य पुरा विविद्रे किमु नूतनासः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kimasya made kimvasya pītāvindraḥ kimasya sakhye cakāra | raṇā vā ye niṣadi kiṃ te asya purā vividre kimu nūtanāsaḥ ||

translations.english: What has Indra done in the exhilaration of this (Soma)? What has he done on quaffing this (libation)? What has he done in friendship for this (Soma)? What have former, what have recent adorers obtained from you in the chamber of this (libation)?

mantras.sanskrit: सदस्य मदे सद्वस्य पीताविन्द्रः सदस्य सख्ये चकार । रणा वा ये निषदि सत्ते अस्य पुरा विविद्रे सदु नूतनासः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sadasya made sadvasya pītāvindraḥ sadasya sakhye cakāra | raṇā vā ye niṣadi satte asya purā vividre sadu nūtanāsaḥ ||

translations.english: Verily, in the exhilaration of this (Soma) Indra has done a good deed; on quaffing the libation (he has done) a good deed; (he has done) a good deed in friendship for this Soma; former as well as recent adorers have obtained good of you in the chamber (of the libation).

mantras.sanskrit: नहि नु ते महिमनः समस्य न मघवन्मघवत्त्वस्य विद्म । न राधसोराधसो नूतनस्येन्द्र नकिर्ददृश इन्द्रियं ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahi nu te mahimanaḥ samasya na maghavanmaghavattvasya vidma | na rādhasorādhaso nūtanasyendra nakirdadṛśa indriyaṃ te ||

translations.english: We acknowledge no one, Maghavan, of greatness equal to yours, nor one of like affluence, nor one of equally glorifiable riches, none has (such as) your power been ever seen (in any other).

mantras.sanskrit: एतत्त्यत्त इन्द्रियमचेति येनावधीर्वरशिखस्य शेषः । वज्रस्य यत्ते निहतस्य शुष्मात्स्वनाच्चिदिन्द्र परमो ददार ॥
mantras.transliteration: etattyatta indriyamaceti yenāvadhīrvaraśikhasya śeṣaḥ | vajrasya yatte nihatasya śuṣmātsvanāccidindra paramo dadāra ||

translations.english: Such as your power (is) it has been comprehended (by us) as that wherewith you have slain the race of Varaśikha, when the boldest (of them) was demolished by the noise of your thunderbolt hurled with (all your) force.

mantras.sanskrit: वधीदिन्द्रो वरशिखस्य शेषोऽभ्यावर्तिने चायमानाय शिक्षन् । वृचीवतो यद्धरियूपीयायां हन्पूर्वे अर्धे भियसापरो दर्त् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vadhīdindro varaśikhasya śeṣo'bhyāvartine cāyamānāya śikṣan | vṛcīvato yaddhariyūpīyāyāṃ hanpūrve ardhe bhiyasāparo dart ||

translations.english: Favouring Abhyāvartin, the son of Cāyamāna, Indra destroyed the varaśikha (people), killng the descendants of Vṛcīvat, (who were stationed) on the Hariyūpīya, on the eastern part, while the western (troop) was scattered through fear.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिंशच्छतं वर्मिण इन्द्र साकं यव्यावत्यां पुरुहूत श्रवस्या । वृचीवन्तः शरवे पत्यमानाः पात्रा भिन्दाना न्यर्थान्यायन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: triṃśacchataṃ varmiṇa indra sākaṃ yavyāvatyāṃ puruhūta śravasyā | vṛcīvantaḥ śarave patyamānāḥ pātrā bhindānā nyarthānyāyan ||

translations.english: Indra, the invoked of many, thirty hundred mailed warriors (were collected) together on the Yavyāvatī, to acquire glory, but the Vṛcīvats advancing in a hostile manner, and breaking the sacrificial vessels, went to (their own) annihilation.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य गावावरुषा सूयवस्यू अन्तरू षु चरतो रेरिहाणा । स सृञ्जयाय तुर्वशं परादाद्वृचीवतो दैववाताय शिक्षन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya gāvāvaruṣā sūyavasyū antarū ṣu carato rerihāṇā | sa sṛñjayāya turvaśaṃ parādādvṛcīvato daivavātāya śikṣan ||

translations.english: He whose bright prancing horses, delighted with choice fodder, proceed between (heaven and earth), gave up Turvaśa to Sṛñjaya, subjecting the Vṛcīvats to the descendant of Devavāta (Abhyāvartin).

mantras.sanskrit: द्वयाँ अग्ने रथिनो विंशतिं गा वधूमतो मघवा मह्यं सम्राट् । अभ्यावर्ती चायमानो ददाति दूणाशेयं दक्षिणा पार्थवानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dvayā~ agne rathino viṃśatiṃ gā vadhūmato maghavā mahyaṃ samrāṭ | abhyāvartī cāyamāno dadāti dūṇāśeyaṃ dakṣiṇā pārthavānām ||

translations.english: The opulent supreme sovereign Abhyāvartin, the son of Cāyamāna, presents, Agni, to me two damsels riding in cars, and twenty cows; this donation of the descendant of Pṛthu cannot be desroyed.

mantras.sanskrit: आ गावो अग्मन्नुत भद्रमक्रन्त्सीदन्तु गोष्ठे रणयन्त्वस्मे । प्रजावतीः पुरुरूपा इह स्युरिन्द्राय पूर्वीरुषसो दुहानाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā gāvo agmannuta bhadramakrantsīdantu goṣṭhe raṇayantvasme | prajāvatīḥ pururūpā iha syurindrāya pūrvīruṣaso duhānāḥ ||

translations.english: May the cows come and bring good fortune; let them lie down in (our) stalls and be plural ased with us; may the many-coloured kine here be parboiled milk for Indra on many dawns.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रो यज्वने पृणते च शिक्षत्युपेद्ददाति न स्वं मुषायति । भूयोभूयो रयिमिदस्य वर्धयन्नभिन्ने खिल्ये नि दधाति देवयुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indro yajvane pṛṇate ca śikṣatyupeddadāti na svaṃ muṣāyati | bhūyobhūyo rayimidasya vardhayannabhinne khilye ni dadhāti devayum ||

translations.english: Indra grants the desires of the man who offers to him sacrifice and praise; he ever bestows upon him wealth, and deprives him not of that which is his own; again and again increasing his riches, he plural ces the devout man in an inaccessible fortress.

mantras.sanskrit: न ता नशन्ति न दभाति तस्करो नासामामित्रो व्यथिरा दधर्षति । देवाँश्च याभिर्यजते ददाति च ज्योगित्ताभिः सचते गोपतिः सह ॥
mantras.transliteration: na tā naśanti na dabhāti taskaro nāsāmāmitro vyathirā dadharṣati | devā~śca yābhiryajate dadāti ca jyogittābhiḥ sacate gopatiḥ saha ||

translations.english: Let not the cows be lost; let no thief carry them away; let no hostile weapon fall upon them; may the master of the cattle be long possessed of hose with which he sacrifices, and which he presents to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: न ता अर्वा रेणुककाटो अश्नुते न संस्कृतत्रमुप यन्ति ता अभि । उरुगायमभयं तस्य ता अनु गावो मर्तस्य वि चरन्ति यज्वनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: na tā arvā reṇukakāṭo aśnute na saṃskṛtatramupa yanti tā abhi | urugāyamabhayaṃ tasya tā anu gāvo martasya vi caranti yajvanaḥ ||

translations.english: Let not the dust-spurning (war) horse reach them nor let them fall in the way of sacrificial consecration let the cattle of the man who offers sacrifice wander about at large and without fear.

mantras.sanskrit: गावो भगो गाव इन्द्रो मे अच्छान्गावः सोमस्य प्रथमस्य भक्षः । इमा या गावः स जनास इन्द्र इच्छामीद्धृदा मनसा चिदिन्द्रम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: gāvo bhago gāva indro me acchāngāvaḥ somasya prathamasya bhakṣaḥ | imā yā gāvaḥ sa janāsa indra icchāmīddhṛdā manasā cidindram ||

translations.english: May the cows be (for our) affluence; may Indra grant me cattle; may the cows yield the food of the first libation; these cows, oḥ men, are the Indra, the Indra whom I desire with heart and mins.

mantras.sanskrit: यूयं गावो मेदयथा कृशं चिदश्रीरं चित्कृणुथा सुप्रतीकम् । भद्रं गृहं कृणुथ भद्रवाचो बृहद्वो वय उच्यते सभासु ॥
mantras.transliteration: yūyaṃ gāvo medayathā kṛśaṃ cidaśrīraṃ citkṛṇuthā supratīkam | bhadraṃ gṛhaṃ kṛṇutha bhadravāco bṛhadvo vaya ucyate sabhāsu ||

translations.english: Do you, cows, give us nourisment; render the emaciated, the unlovely body the reverse; do you, whose lowing is auspicious, make my dwelling prosperous; great is the abundance that is attributed to you in religious assemblies.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रजावतीः सूयवसं रिशन्तीः शुद्धा अपः सुप्रपाणे पिबन्तीः । मा वः स्तेन ईशत माघशंसः परि वो हेती रुद्रस्य वृज्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prajāvatīḥ sūyavasaṃ riśantīḥ śuddhā apaḥ suprapāṇe pibantīḥ | mā vaḥ stena īśata māghaśaṃsaḥ pari vo hetī rudrasya vṛjyāḥ ||

translations.english: May you, cows, have many calves grazing upon good pasture, drinking pure water at accessible ponds; may no thief be your master; no beast of prey (assail you), and may the (fatal) weapon of Rudra avoid you.

mantras.sanskrit: उपेदमुपपर्चनमासु गोषूप पृच्यताम् । उप ऋषभस्य रेतस्युपेन्द्र तव वीर्ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: upedamupaparcanamāsu goṣūpa pṛcyatām | upa ṛṣabhasya retasyupendra tava vīrye ||

translations.english: Let the nourishment of the cows be solicited, let the vigour of the bull (be requested), Indra, for your invigoration.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रं वो नरः सख्याय सेपुर्महो यन्तः सुमतये चकानाः । महो हि दाता वज्रहस्तो अस्ति महामु रण्वमवसे यजध्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraṃ vo naraḥ sakhyāya sepurmaho yantaḥ sumataye cakānāḥ | maho hi dātā vajrahasto asti mahāmu raṇvamavase yajadhvam ||

translations.english: Your priests, (oḥ worshippers), proppitiate Indra for his friendship, offering great (praise), and desirous of his favour; for the wielder of the thunderbolt is the giver of vast (wealth); worship him, therefore, who is mighty and benevolent, (to obtain) his protection.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यस्मिन्हस्ते नर्या मिमिक्षुरा रथे हिरण्यये रथेष्ठाः । आ रश्मयो गभस्त्योः स्थूरयोराध्वन्नश्वासो वृषणो युजानाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yasminhaste naryā mimikṣurā rathe hiraṇyaye ratheṣṭhāḥ | ā raśmayo gabhastyoḥ sthūrayorādhvannaśvāso vṛṣaṇo yujānāḥ ||

translations.english: In whose hand (riches) good for man are accusative ulated, the chariot-mounted in a golden car; in whose arms the rays of light (are collected); whose vigorous horses, yoked (to his car, convey him) on the road (of the firmament).

mantras.sanskrit: श्रिये ते पादा दुव आ मिमिक्षुर्धृष्णुर्वज्री शवसा दक्षिणावान् । वसानो अत्कं सुरभिं दृशे कं स्वर्ण नृतविषिरो बभूथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: śriye te pādā duva ā mimikṣurdhṛṣṇurvajrī śavasā dakṣiṇāvān | vasāno atkaṃ surabhiṃ dṛśe kaṃ svarṇa nṛtaviṣiro babhūtha ||

translations.english: They offer adoration at your feet to acquire prosperity, for you are the overthrower of enemies by (your) strength, the wielder of the thunderbolt, the bestower of donations; leader (of rites), you are like the rolling sun, wearing in the sight (of all) a graceful and ever moving form.

mantras.sanskrit: स सोम आमिश्लतमः सुतो भूद्यस्मिन्पक्तिः पच्यते सन्ति धानाः । इन्द्रं नरः स्तुवन्तो ब्रह्मकारा उक्था शंसन्तो देववाततमाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa soma āmiślatamaḥ suto bhūdyasminpaktiḥ pacyate santi dhānāḥ | indraṃ naraḥ stuvanto brahmakārā ukthā śaṃsanto devavātatamāḥ ||

translations.english: That libation is most perfectly mixed when, upon its being effused, the cakes are baked, and the barley is fried, and the priests, glorifying Indra, offering the (sacrificial) food, and reciting holy prayers, are approaching most nigh to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: न ते अन्तः शवसो धाय्यस्य वि तु बाबधे रोदसी महित्वा । आ ता सूरिः पृणति तूतुजानो यूथेवाप्सु समीजमान ऊती ॥
mantras.transliteration: na te antaḥ śavaso dhāyyasya vi tu bābadhe rodasī mahitvā | ā tā sūriḥ pṛṇati tūtujāno yūthevāpsu samījamāna ūtī ||

translations.english: No limit of your strength has been assigned; heaven and earth are intimidated by its greatness; the pious worshipper, hastening (to sacrifice), and earnestly performing worship, gratifies you with the offering, as (the cow-keeper satisfies) the herds with water.

mantras.sanskrit: एवेदिन्द्रः सुहव ऋष्वो अस्तूती अनूती हिरिशिप्रः सत्वा । एवा हि जातो असमात्योजाः पुरू च वृत्रा हनति नि दस्यून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: evedindraḥ suhava ṛṣvo astūtī anūtī hiriśipraḥ satvā | evā hi jāto asamātyojāḥ purū ca vṛtrā hanati ni dasyūn ||

translations.english: Thus may the mighty Indra be successfully invoked; he, the azure-chinned, the giver of wealth, whether by coming or not coming (to the sacrifice); and may he who is of unequalled strength destroy, as soon as manifested, many opposing (evil spirits) and (hostile) Dasyus.

mantras.sanskrit: भूय इद्वावृधे वीर्यायँ एको अजुर्यो दयते वसूनि । प्र रिरिचे दिव इन्द्रः पृथिव्या अर्धमिदस्य प्रति रोदसी उभे ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhūya idvāvṛdhe vīryāya~ eko ajuryo dayate vasūni | pra ririce diva indraḥ pṛthivyā ardhamidasya prati rodasī ubhe ||

translations.english: Again has Indra increased (in strength) for (the display of) heroism; he, the chief (of all), the undecayable, bestows riches (on his votaries); Indra surpasses heaven and earth; a mere portion of him is equal to both earth and heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: अधा मन्ये बृहदसुर्यमस्य यानि दाधार नकिरा मिनाति । दिवेदिवे सूर्यो दर्शतो भूद्वि सद्मान्युर्विया सुक्रतुर्धात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhā manye bṛhadasuryamasya yāni dādhāra nakirā mināti | divedive sūryo darśato bhūdvi sadmānyurviyā sukraturdhāt ||

translations.english: I now glorify his vast and asura-destroying (vigour); those exploits that he has determined (to achieve) no one can resist; (by him) the sun was made daily visible; and he, the doer of great deeds, spread out the spacious regions (of the universe).

mantras.sanskrit: अद्या चिन्नू चित्तदपो नदीनां यदाभ्यो अरदो गातुमिन्द्र । नि पर्वता अद्मसदो न सेदुस्त्वया दृळ्हानि सुक्रतो रजांसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: adyā cinnū cittadapo nadīnāṃ yadābhyo arado gātumindra | ni parvatā admasado na sedustvayā dṛḷhāni sukrato rajāṃsi ||

translations.english: At present, verily as of old, that act, (the liberation) of the rivers, is effective; whereby you have directed them on their course; the mountains have settled (at your command) like (men) seated at their meals; doer of great deeds, by you have the worlds been rendered stationary.

mantras.sanskrit: सत्यमित्तन्न त्वावाँ अन्यो अस्तीन्द्र देवो न मर्त्यो ज्यायान् । अहन्नहिं परिशयानमर्णोऽवासृजो अपो अच्छा समुद्रम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: satyamittanna tvāvā~ anyo astīndra devo na martyo jyāyān | ahannahiṃ pariśayānamarṇo'vāsṛjo apo acchā samudram ||

translations.english: Verily it is the truth, Indra, that there is no other such as you, no god nor mortal is (your) superior; you have slain Ahi obstructing the waters, you have set them free (to flow) to the ocean.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमपो वि दुरो विषूचीरिन्द्र दृळ्हमरुजः पर्वतस्य । राजाभवो जगतश्चर्षणीनां साकं सूर्यं जनयन्द्यामुषासम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamapo vi duro viṣūcīrindra dṛḷhamarujaḥ parvatasya | rājābhavo jagataścarṣaṇīnāṃ sākaṃ sūryaṃ janayandyāmuṣāsam ||

translations.english: You have set the obstructed waters free o flow in all directions; you have fractured the solid (barrier) of the cloud; you are lord over the people of the world, making manifest together the sun, the sky, and the dawn.

mantras.sanskrit: अभूरेको रयिपते रयीणामा हस्तयोरधिथा इन्द्र कृष्टीः । वि तोके अप्सु तनये च सूरेऽवोचन्त चर्षणयो विवाचः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhūreko rayipate rayīṇāmā hastayoradhithā indra kṛṣṭīḥ | vi toke apsu tanaye ca sūre'vocanta carṣaṇayo vivācaḥ ||

translations.english: You, lord of riches, are the chief (soverign) over riches; you hold men in your two hands, and men glorify you with various praises for (the sake of obtaining) sons, and valiant grandsons, and rain.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वद्भियेन्द्र पार्थिवानि विश्वाच्युता चिच्च्यावयन्ते रजांसि । द्यावाक्षामा पर्वतासो वनानि विश्वं दृळ्हं भयते अज्मन्ना ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvadbhiyendra pārthivāni viśvācyutā ciccyāvayante rajāṃsi | dyāvākṣāmā parvatāso vanāni viśvaṃ dṛḷhaṃ bhayate ajmannā te ||

translations.english: Through fear of you, Indra, all the regions of the firmamet cause the unfallen (rain) to descend; the heavens, the earth, the mountains, the forests, all the solid (universe) is alarmed at your approach.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं कुत्सेनाभि शुष्णमिन्द्राशुषं युध्य कुयवं गविष्टौ । दश प्रपित्वे अध सूर्यस्य मुषायश्चक्रमविवे रपांसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ kutsenābhi śuṣṇamindrāśuṣaṃ yudhya kuyavaṃ gaviṣṭau | daśa prapitve adha sūryasya muṣāyaścakramavive rapāṃsi ||

translations.english: You, Indra, with Kutsa, have warred against the inexhaustible Śuṣṇa; you have overthrown Kuyava in battle; in conflict you have carried off the wheel (of the chariot) of the sun; you have driven away the malignant (spirits).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं शतान्यव शम्बरस्य पुरो जघन्थाप्रतीनि दस्योः । अशिक्षो यत्र शच्या शचीवो दिवोदासाय सुन्वते सुतक्रे भरद्वाजाय गृणते वसूनि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ śatānyava śambarasya puro jaghanthāpratīni dasyoḥ | aśikṣo yatra śacyā śacīvo divodāsāya sunvate sutakre bharadvājāya gṛṇate vasūni ||

translations.english: You have destroyed the hundred impregnable cities of the Dasyu, Śambara, when sagacious Indra, you, who are brought by the libation, have bestowed in your liberality riches upon Divodāsa presenting to you libations, and upon Bharadvāja hymning your praise.

mantras.sanskrit: स सत्यसत्वन्महते रणाय रथमा तिष्ठ तुविनृम्ण भीमम् । याहि प्रपथिन्नवसोप मद्रिक्प्र च श्रुत श्रावय चर्षणिभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa satyasatvanmahate raṇāya rathamā tiṣṭha tuvinṛmṇa bhīmam | yāhi prapathinnavasopa madrikpra ca śruta śrāvaya carṣaṇibhyaḥ ||

translations.english: Leader of true heroes, possessor of infinite wealth, mount your formidable car for the arduous conflict; come to me, pursuer of a forward path, for my protection; do you who are renowned, proclaim (our renown) among men.

mantras.sanskrit: अपूर्व्या पुरुतमान्यस्मै महे वीराय तवसे तुराय । विरप्शिने वज्रिणे शंतमानि वचांस्यासा स्थविराय तक्षम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: apūrvyā purutamānyasmai mahe vīrāya tavase turāya | virapśine vajriṇe śaṃtamāni vacāṃsyāsā sthavirāya takṣam ||

translations.english: I have fabricated with my mouth unprecedented, comprehensive, and gratifying praises to that mighty, heroic, powerful, rapid, adorable, and ancient wielder of the thunderbolt.

mantras.sanskrit: स मातरा सूर्येणा कवीनामवासयद्रुजदद्रिं गृणानः । स्वाधीभिॠक्वभिर्वावशान उदुस्रियाणामसृजन्निदानम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa mātarā sūryeṇā kavīnāmavāsayadrujadadriṃ gṛṇānaḥ | svādhībhiṝkvabhirvāvaśāna udusriyāṇāmasṛjannidānam ||

translations.english: He has obtained the parent (worlds, heaven and earth), with the sun, for the sake of the sages, (he aṅgirasas), and, glorified (by them), he has shattered the mountain; repeatedly wished for by his adorers intently meditating (upon him), he has cast off the fetters of the kine.

mantras.sanskrit: स वह्निभिॠक्वभिर्गोषु शश्वन्मितज्ञुभिः पुरुकृत्वा जिगाय । पुरः पुरोहा सखिभिः सखीयन्दृळ्हा रुरोज कविभिः कविः सन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa vahnibhiṝkvabhirgoṣu śaśvanmitajñubhiḥ purukṛtvā jigāya | puraḥ purohā sakhibhiḥ sakhīyandṛḷhā ruroja kavibhiḥ kaviḥ san ||

translations.english: He, the achiever of many deeds, together with his worshippers ever offering oblations upon bended knees, has overcome (the asuras) for (the rescue of) the cows; friendly with his friends (the aṅgirasas), far-seeing with the faqr-seeing, the destroyer of cities has demolished the strong cities (of the asuras).

mantras.sanskrit: स नीव्याभिर्जरितारमच्छा महो वाजेभिर्महद्भिश्च शुष्मैः । पुरुवीराभिर्वृषभ क्षितीनामा गिर्वणः सुविताय प्र याहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa nīvyābhirjaritāramacchā maho vājebhirmahadbhiśca śuṣmaiḥ | puruvīrābhirvṛṣabha kṣitīnāmā girvaṇaḥ suvitāya pra yāhi ||

translations.english: Showerer (of benefits), propitiated by the praise, come to him who glorifies you to make him happy among men with abundant food, with exceeding strength, and with young (mares) with numerous colts.

mantras.sanskrit: स सर्गेण शवसा तक्तो अत्यैरप इन्द्रो दक्षिणतस्तुराषाट् । इत्था सृजाना अनपावृदर्थं दिवेदिवे विविषुरप्रमृष्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa sargeṇa śavasā takto atyairapa indro dakṣiṇatasturāṣāṭ | itthā sṛjānā anapāvṛdarthaṃ divedive viviṣurapramṛṣyam ||

translations.english: Endowed with natural force possessed of (swift) horses, Indra, the overcomer of the adversaries, (sets free) the waters at the southern (declination); thus liberated the waters expand daily to the insatiable goal whence there is no returning.

mantras.sanskrit: य ओजिष्ठ इन्द्र तं सु नो दा मदो वृषन्त्स्वभिष्टिर्दास्वान् । सौवश्व्यं यो वनवत्स्वश्वो वृत्रा समत्सु सासहदमित्रान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya ojiṣṭha indra taṃ su no dā mado vṛṣantsvabhiṣṭirdāsvān | sauvaśvyaṃ yo vanavatsvaśvo vṛtrā samatsu sāsahadamitrān ||

translations.english: Showerer (of benefits), Indra, grant us a son who shall be most vigorous, a delighter (of you by praise), a pious sacrificer, a liberal giver, who, mounted on a good steed, shall overthrow numerous good steeds, and conquer opposing enemies in combat.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वां हीन्द्रावसे विवाचो हवन्ते चर्षणयः शूरसातौ । त्वं विप्रेभिर्वि पणीँरशायस्त्वोत इत्सनिता वाजमर्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāṃ hīndrāvase vivāco havante carṣaṇayaḥ śūrasātau | tvaṃ viprebhirvi paṇī~raśāyastvota itsanitā vājamarvā ||

translations.english: Men of various speech invoke you, Indra, for their defence in war; you, with the sages (the aṅgirasas), have slain the Paṇis; protected by you, the liberal (worshipper) obtains food.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं ताँ इन्द्रोभयाँ अमित्रान्दासा वृत्राण्यार्या च शूर । वधीर्वनेव सुधितेभिरत्कैरा पृत्सु दर्षि नृणां नृतम ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ tā~ indrobhayā~ amitrāndāsā vṛtrāṇyāryā ca śūra | vadhīrvaneva sudhitebhiratkairā pṛtsu darṣi nṛṇāṃ nṛtama ||

translations.english: You, hero, Indra, destroyed both (classes of) enemies, (both) Dāsa and Ārya, adversaries; chief leader of leaders, you cut your foes in pieces in battles with well-plural ed weapons, as (wood-cutters fell) the forests.

mantras.sanskrit: स त्वं न इन्द्राकवाभिरूती सखा विश्वायुरविता वृधे भूः । स्वर्षाता यद्ध्वयामसि त्वा युध्यन्तो नेमधिता पृत्सु शूर ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa tvaṃ na indrākavābhirūtī sakhā viśvāyuravitā vṛdhe bhūḥ | svarṣātā yaddhvayāmasi tvā yudhyanto nemadhitā pṛtsu śūra ||

translations.english: Do you, Indra, who are all-pervading, be a friend, and a protector with irreproachable protections for our prosperity; when warring in number-thinning conflicts, we invoke you for the acquisition of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: नूनं न इन्द्रापराय च स्या भवा मृळीक उत नो अभिष्टौ । इत्था गृणन्तो महिनस्य शर्मन्दिवि ष्याम पार्ये गोषतमाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nūnaṃ na indrāparāya ca syā bhavā mṛḷīka uta no abhiṣṭau | itthā gṛṇanto mahinasya śarmandivi ṣyāma pārye goṣatamāḥ ||

translations.english: Do you, Indra, now and at (all) other times be verily ours; be the bestower of happiness according to our condition; and in this maner, worshipping at dawn, and glorifying you, may we abide in the brilliant and unbounded felicity of you who are mighty.

mantras.sanskrit: सं च त्वे जग्मुर्गिर इन्द्र पूर्वीर्वि च त्वद्यन्ति विभ्वो मनीषाः । पुरा नूनं च स्तुतय ऋषीणां पस्पृध्र इन्द्रे अध्युक्थार्का ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ ca tve jagmurgira indra pūrvīrvi ca tvadyanti vibhvo manīṣāḥ | purā nūnaṃ ca stutaya ṛṣīṇāṃ paspṛdhra indre adhyukthārkā ||

translations.english: Many praises, Indra, are concentrated in you; from you abundant comemndations diversely proceed; to you, formerly and at presen, the praises of the sages, their prayers and hymns, vie (in glorifying) Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: पुरुहूतो यः पुरुगूर्त ऋभ्वाँ एकः पुरुप्रशस्तो अस्ति यज्ञैः । रथो न महे शवसे युजानोऽस्माभिरिन्द्रो अनुमाद्यो भूत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: puruhūto yaḥ purugūrta ṛbhvā~ ekaḥ purupraśasto asti yajñaiḥ | ratho na mahe śavase yujāno'smābhirindro anumādyo bhūt ||

translations.english: May that Indra ever be propitiated, by us who is the invoked of many, mighty and chief, especially honoured by sacrifices, and to whom, as to a conveyance, we are attached for (the attainment of) great strength.

mantras.sanskrit: न यं हिंसन्ति धीतयो न वाणीरिन्द्रं नक्षन्तीदभि वर्धयन्तीः । यदि स्तोतारः शतं यत्सहस्रं गृणन्ति गिर्वणसं शं तदस्मै ॥
mantras.transliteration: na yaṃ hiṃsanti dhītayo na vāṇīrindraṃ nakṣantīdabhi vardhayantīḥ | yadi stotāraḥ śataṃ yatsahasraṃ gṛṇanti girvaṇasaṃ śaṃ tadasmai ||

translations.english: All praises contributing to his exaltation proceed to Indra, whom no acts, no words can harm, since hundreds and thousands of adorers glorify him who is entitled to praise, and so afford him gratification.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मा एतद्दिव्यर्चेव मासा मिमिक्ष इन्द्रे न्ययामि सोमः । जनं न धन्वन्नभि सं यदापः सत्रा वावृधुर्हवनानि यज्ञैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmā etaddivyarceva māsā mimikṣa indre nyayāmi somaḥ | janaṃ na dhanvannabhi saṃ yadāpaḥ satrā vāvṛdhurhavanāni yajñaiḥ ||

translations.english: The mixed Soma has been prepared for Indra, (to be offered) on the day (of the sacrifice), with reverence-like adoration, when praises, together with offerings, yield him increase, as when water (revives) a man in a desert waste.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मा एतन्मह्याङ्गूषमस्मा इन्द्राय स्तोत्रं मतिभिरवाचि । असद्यथा महति वृत्रतूर्य इन्द्रो विश्वायुरविता वृधश्च ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmā etanmahyāṅgūṣamasmā indrāya stotraṃ matibhiravāci | asadyathā mahati vṛtratūrya indro viśvāyuravitā vṛdhaśca ||

translations.english: To this Indra has this earnest eulogy been addressed by the devout, in order that the all-pervading Indra may be our defender and exalter in the great conflict with (our) foes.

mantras.sanskrit: कदा भुवन्रथक्षयाणि ब्रह्म कदा स्तोत्रे सहस्रपोष्यं दाः । कदा स्तोमं वासयोऽस्य राया कदा धियः करसि वाजरत्नाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kadā bhuvanrathakṣayāṇi brahma kadā stotre sahasrapoṣyaṃ dāḥ | kadā stomaṃ vāsayo'sya rāyā kadā dhiyaḥ karasi vājaratnāḥ ||

translations.english: When may our prayers (be with you) in your chariot? When will you grant to your adorer the (means of) maintaining thousands? When will you recompense my adoration with riches? When will you render sacred rites productive of food?

mantras.sanskrit: कर्हि स्वित्तदिन्द्र यन्नृभिर्नॄन्वीरैर्वीरान्नीळयासे जयाजीन् । त्रिधातु गा अधि जयासि गोष्विन्द्र द्युम्नं स्वर्वद्धेह्यस्मे ॥
mantras.transliteration: karhi svittadindra yannṛbhirnṝnvīrairvīrānnīḷayāse jayājīn | tridhātu gā adhi jayāsi goṣvindra dyumnaṃ svarvaddhehyasme ||

translations.english: When, Indra, will you bring together leaders with leaders, heroes with heroes, and give us victory in battles? When will you conquer from the enemy the threefold-food-supplying cattle? (When will you grant) us, Indra, diffusive wealth?

mantras.sanskrit: कर्हि स्वित्तदिन्द्र यज्जरित्रे विश्वप्सु ब्रह्म कृणवः शविष्ठ । कदा धियो न नियुतो युवासे कदा गोमघा हवनानि गच्छाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: karhi svittadindra yajjaritre viśvapsu brahma kṛṇavaḥ śaviṣṭha | kadā dhiyo na niyuto yuvāse kadā gomaghā havanāni gacchāḥ ||

translations.english: When, most vigorous Indra, will you grant your worshipper that food which is all-sufficing? When will you combine (in yourself) worship and praises? When will you render oblations productive of cattle?

mantras.sanskrit: स गोमघा जरित्रे अश्वश्चन्द्रा वाजश्रवसो अधि धेहि पृक्षः । पीपिहीषः सुदुघामिन्द्र धेनुं भरद्वाजेषु सुरुचो रुरुच्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa gomaghā jaritre aśvaścandrā vājaśravaso adhi dhehi pṛkṣaḥ | pīpihīṣaḥ sudughāmindra dhenuṃ bharadvājeṣu suruco rurucyāḥ ||

translations.english: Grant, Indra, to your adorer (abundant) food, productive of cattle, plural asant with horses, and renowned for vigour; multiply nourishment, and (cherish) the kine easily milked, and render them so that they may be resplendent.

mantras.sanskrit: तमा नूनं वृजनमन्यथा चिच्छूरो यच्छक्र वि दुरो गृणीषे । मा निररं शुक्रदुघस्य धेनोराङ्गिरसान्ब्रह्मणा विप्र जिन्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamā nūnaṃ vṛjanamanyathā cicchūro yacchakra vi duro gṛṇīṣe | mā niraraṃ śukradughasya dhenorāṅgirasānbrahmaṇā vipra jinva ||

translations.english: Direct him who is actually our adversary into a different (course); mighty Indra, who are a hero, the destroyer (of enemies), therefore are you glorified; never may I desist from the praise of the giver of pure (gifts); satisfy, sage Indra, the aṅgirasas with food.

mantras.sanskrit: सत्रा मदासस्तव विश्वजन्याः सत्रा रायोऽध ये पार्थिवासः । सत्रा वाजानामभवो विभक्ता यद्देवेषु धारयथा असुर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: satrā madāsastava viśvajanyāḥ satrā rāyo'dha ye pārthivāsaḥ | satrā vājānāmabhavo vibhaktā yaddeveṣu dhārayathā asuryam ||

translations.english: Truly are your exhilarations beneficial to all men; truly are the riches which exist on earth (beneficial to all men); truly are you the distributor of food; wherefore you maintain vigour among the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: अनु प्र येजे जन ओजो अस्य सत्रा दधिरे अनु वीर्याय । स्यूमगृभे दुधयेऽर्वते च क्रतुं वृञ्जन्त्यपि वृत्रहत्ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: anu pra yeje jana ojo asya satrā dadhire anu vīryāya | syūmagṛbhe dudhaye'rvate ca kratuṃ vṛñjantyapi vṛtrahatye ||

translations.english: The worshipper praises especially the strength of that Indra, verily they rely upon him for heroic deeds; they offer sacrifices to him as the seizer of an uninterrupted series of foes, their assailant, their subduer, and also for the destruction of Vṛtra.

mantras.sanskrit: तं सध्रीचीरूतयो वृष्ण्यानि पौंस्यानि नियुतः सश्चुरिन्द्रम् । समुद्रं न सिन्धव उक्थशुष्मा उरुव्यचसं गिर आ विशन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ sadhrīcīrūtayo vṛṣṇyāni pauṃsyāni niyutaḥ saścurindram | samudraṃ na sindhava ukthaśuṣmā uruvyacasaṃ gira ā viśanti ||

translations.english: The associated Maruts, heroic energies, virile strength, and the Niyut steeds, attend upon Indra, and praises powerful in sacred song centre in him as rivers flow into the ocean.

mantras.sanskrit: स रायस्खामुप सृजा गृणानः पुरुश्चन्द्रस्य त्वमिन्द्र वस्वः । पतिर्बभूथासमो जनानामेको विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजा ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa rāyaskhāmupa sṛjā gṛṇānaḥ puruścandrasya tvamindra vasvaḥ | patirbabhūthāsamo janānāmeko viśvasya bhuvanasya rājā ||

translations.english: Glorified by us, Indra, let flow the stream of much delighting, home-conferring affluence, for you are the unequalled lord of men, the sole sovereign of all the world.

mantras.sanskrit: स तु श्रुधि श्रुत्या यो दुवोयुर्द्यौर्न भूमाभि रायो अर्यः । असो यथा नः शवसा चकानो युगेयुगे वयसा चेकितानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa tu śrudhi śrutyā yo duvoyurdyaurna bhūmābhi rāyo aryaḥ | aso yathā naḥ śavasā cakāno yugeyuge vayasā cekitānaḥ ||

translations.english: Hear, Indra, (the praises) that may be heard (by you), you, who are gratified by our adoration, and, like the sun, (prevail) over the ample riches of the enemy; endowed with strength, being glorified in every age, rendered comprehensible by (sacrificial) food, be to us no other (than as such as you have been).

mantras.sanskrit: अर्वाग्रथं विश्ववारं त उग्रेन्द्र युक्तासो हरयो वहन्तु । कीरिश्चिद्धि त्वा हवते स्वर्वानृधीमहि सधमादस्ते अद्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: arvāgrathaṃ viśvavāraṃ ta ugrendra yuktāso harayo vahantu | kīriściddhi tvā havate svarvānṛdhīmahi sadhamādaste adya ||

translations.english: Fierce Indra, let your harnessed steeds bring down your all-desired chariot; your devoted adorer verily invokes you; may we today, partaking of your exhilaration, increase today (in prosperity).

mantras.sanskrit: प्रो द्रोणे हरयः कर्माग्मन्पुनानास ऋज्यन्तो अभूवन् । इन्द्रो नो अस्य पूर्व्यः पपीयाद्द्युक्षो मदस्य सोम्यस्य राजा ॥
mantras.transliteration: pro droṇe harayaḥ karmāgmanpunānāsa ṛjyanto abhūvan | indro no asya pūrvyaḥ papīyāddyukṣo madasya somyasya rājā ||

translations.english: The green Soma flows at our sacrifice, and purified, proceed direct into the pitcher; may the ancient illustrious Indra, the soverign of the exhilarating Soma libation, drink of this our offering.

mantras.sanskrit: आसस्राणासः शवसानमच्छेन्द्रं सुचक्रे रथ्यासो अश्वाः । अभि श्रव ऋज्यन्तो वहेयुर्नू चिन्नु वायोरमृतं वि दस्येत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: āsasrāṇāsaḥ śavasānamacchendraṃ sucakre rathyāso aśvāḥ | abhi śrava ṛjyanto vaheyurnū cinnu vāyoramṛtaṃ vi dasyet ||

translations.english: May the everwhere-going, straight-proceeding, chariot-bearing seeds, bring the mighty Indra uin his strong-wheeled car to our rite; let not the ambrosial Soma waste in the wind.

mantras.sanskrit: वरिष्ठो अस्य दक्षिणामियर्तीन्द्रो मघोनां तुविकूर्मितमः । यया वज्रिवः परियास्यंहो मघा च धृष्णो दयसे वि सूरीन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: variṣṭho asya dakṣiṇāmiyartīndro maghonāṃ tuvikūrmitamaḥ | yayā vajrivaḥ pariyāsyaṃho maghā ca dhṛṣṇo dayase vi sūrīn ||

translations.english: The very strong Indra, the performer of many great deeds, instrumental gates the donation of this (instrumental tutor of the ceremony) among the opulent, whereby, wielder of the thunderbolt, you remove sin, and, firm of purpose, bestow riches upon the worshippers.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रो वाजस्य स्थविरस्य दातेन्द्रो गीर्भिर्वर्धतां वृद्धमहाः । इन्द्रो वृत्रं हनिष्ठो अस्तु सत्वा ता सूरिः पृणति तूतुजानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indro vājasya sthavirasya dātendro gīrbhirvardhatāṃ vṛddhamahāḥ | indro vṛtraṃ haniṣṭho astu satvā tā sūriḥ pṛṇati tūtujānaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra is the donor of substantial food; may the very illustrious Indra increase (in glory) through our praises; may Indra, the destroyer (of enemies), be the especial slayer of Vṛtra; may he, the animator the quick-mover, grant us those (riches which we desire).

mantras.sanskrit: अपादित उदु नश्चित्रतमो महीं भर्षद्द्युमतीमिन्द्रहूतिम् । पन्यसीं धीतिं दैव्यस्य यामञ्जनस्य रातिं वनते सुदानुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: apādita udu naścitratamo mahīṃ bharṣaddyumatīmindrahūtim | panyasīṃ dhītiṃ daivyasya yāmañjanasya rātiṃ vanate sudānuḥ ||

translations.english: May the most marvellous Indra drink from this (our cup); may he acknowledge our earnest and brilliant invocation; may the munificent (Indra) accept the offering and the praiseworthy adoration at the sacrifice of the devout worshipper.

mantras.sanskrit: दूराच्चिदा वसतो अस्य कर्णा घोषादिन्द्रस्य तन्यति ब्रुवाणः । एयमेनं देवहूतिर्ववृत्यान्मद्र्यगिन्द्रमियमृच्यमाना ॥
mantras.transliteration: dūrāccidā vasato asya karṇā ghoṣādindrasya tanyati bruvāṇaḥ | eyamenaṃ devahūtirvavṛtyānmadryagindramiyamṛcyamānā ||

translations.english: Reciting (his praise, the worshipper) calls aloud, that by the sound he may reach the ears of Indra, although abiding afar off; may this invocation of the deity, inducing, him (to come), bring Indra to my presence.

mantras.sanskrit: तं वो धिया परमया पुराजामजरमिन्द्रमभ्यनूष्यर्कैः । ब्रह्मा च गिरो दधिरे समस्मिन्महाँश्च स्तोमो अधि वर्धदिन्द्रे ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ vo dhiyā paramayā purājāmajaramindramabhyanūṣyarkaiḥ | brahmā ca giro dadhire samasminmahā~śca stomo adhi vardhadindre ||

translations.english: I glorify you wiht hymns and with pious worship, the ancient undecaying Indra, for in him are oblations and praises concentrated, and great adoration is enhanced (when addressed to him).

mantras.sanskrit: वर्धाद्यं यज्ञ उत सोम इन्द्रं वर्धाद्ब्रह्म गिर उक्था च मन्म । वर्धाहैनमुषसो यामन्नक्तोर्वर्धान्मासाः शरदो द्याव इन्द्रम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vardhādyaṃ yajña uta soma indraṃ vardhādbrahma gira ukthā ca manma | vardhāhainamuṣaso yāmannaktorvardhānmāsāḥ śarado dyāva indram ||

translations.english: Indra, whom the sacrifice, whom the libation exalts, whom the oblation, the praises, the prayers, the adoration exalt, whom the course of day and night exalts, whom months, and years, and days exalt.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा जज्ञानं सहसे असामि वावृधानं राधसे च श्रुताय । महामुग्रमवसे विप्र नूनमा विवासेम वृत्रतूर्येषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā jajñānaṃ sahase asāmi vāvṛdhānaṃ rādhase ca śrutāya | mahāmugramavase vipra nūnamā vivāsema vṛtratūryeṣu ||

translations.english: So, wise Indra, may we today propitiate you who are manifested, to overcome (our foes), you who are greatly augmenting, mighty and free, for (the sake of) wealth, fame, and protection, and for the destruction of (our) enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: मन्द्रस्य कवेर्दिव्यस्य वह्नेर्विप्रमन्मनो वचनस्य मध्वः । अपा नस्तस्य सचनस्य देवेषो युवस्व गृणते गोअग्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mandrasya kaverdivyasya vahnervipramanmano vacanasya madhvaḥ | apā nastasya sacanasya deveṣo yuvasva gṛṇate goagrāḥ ||

translations.english: Drink, Indra, of that our sweet, exhilarating, inspiring, celestial, fruit-yielding Soma, commended by the wise, and entitled to praise and preparation; bestow upon him who glorifies you, divine (Indra), food, the chiefest of which is cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: अयमुशानः पर्यद्रिमुस्रा ऋतधीतिभिॠतयुग्युजानः । रुजदरुग्णं वि वलस्य सानुं पणीँर्वचोभिरभि योधदिन्द्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayamuśānaḥ paryadrimusrā ṛtadhītibhiṝtayugyujānaḥ | rujadarugṇaṃ vi valasya sānuṃ paṇī~rvacobhirabhi yodhadindraḥ ||

translations.english: Determined (to recover) the cattle hidden in the mountain, associated with the animated by (their) veracious (praise), this (Indra) fractured the infrangible rock of Bala, and overwhelmed the Paṇis with reproaches.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं द्योतयदद्युतो व्यक्तून्दोषा वस्तोः शरद इन्दुरिन्द्र । इमं केतुमदधुर्नू चिदह्नां शुचिजन्मन उषसश्चकार ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ dyotayadadyuto vyaktūndoṣā vastoḥ śarada indurindra | imaṃ ketumadadhurnū cidahnāṃ śucijanmana uṣasaścakāra ||

translations.english: This Soma, Indra, (quaffed by you), has lighted up the unlustrous nights, and days and nights, and years; (the gods) of old have established it as the ensign of days, and it he made the dawns genitive rated in light.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं रोचयदरुचो रुचानोऽयं वासयद्व्यृतेन पूर्वीः । अयमीयत ऋतयुग्भिरश्वैः स्वर्विदा नाभिना चर्षणिप्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ rocayadaruco rucāno'yaṃ vāsayadvyṛtena pūrvīḥ | ayamīyata ṛtayugbhiraśvaiḥ svarvidā nābhinā carṣaṇiprāḥ ||

translations.english: This radiant (Indra) has illumined the non-radiant (worlds); he has pervaded many dawns with true lustre the benefactor of men moves in (a chariot) drawn by horses, harnessed by praise, laden with riches.

mantras.sanskrit: नू गृणानो गृणते प्रत्न राजन्निषः पिन्व वसुदेयाय पूर्वीः । अप ओषधीरविषा वनानि गा अर्वतो नॄनृचसे रिरीहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū gṛṇāno gṛṇate pratna rājanniṣaḥ pinva vasudeyāya pūrvīḥ | apa oṣadhīraviṣā vanāni gā arvato nṝnṛcase rirīhi ||

translations.english: Sovereign of old, do you, when glorified, bestow upon him who praises you, and to whom affluence is due abundant food; grant to the worshipper water, plural nts, inoxious woods, cattle, horses and men.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र पिब तुभ्यं सुतो मदायाव स्य हरी वि मुचा सखाया । उत प्र गाय गण आ निषद्याथा यज्ञाय गृणते वयो धाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra piba tubhyaṃ suto madāyāva sya harī vi mucā sakhāyā | uta pra gāya gaṇa ā niṣadyāthā yajñāya gṛṇate vayo dhāḥ ||

translations.english: Drink, Indra, (the Soma) that is effused for your exhilaration; stop your friendly steeds; let them loose; sitting in our society, respond to our hymns; give food to him who lauds and worships you.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य पिब यस्य जज्ञान इन्द्र मदाय क्रत्वे अपिबो विरप्शिन् । तमु ते गावो नर आपो अद्रिरिन्दुं समह्यन्पीतये समस्मै ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya piba yasya jajñāna indra madāya kratve apibo virapśin | tamu te gāvo nara āpo adririnduṃ samahyanpītaye samasmai ||

translations.english: Drink, Indra, of this (libation), of which you, mighty one, have drunk as soon as born, for excitement to (great) deeds; that Soma which the kine, the priests, the waters, the stones, combine to prepare for your drinking.

mantras.sanskrit: समिद्धे अग्नौ सुत इन्द्र सोम आ त्वा वहन्तु हरयो वहिष्ठाः । त्वायता मनसा जोहवीमीन्द्रा याहि सुविताय महे नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samiddhe agnau suta indra soma ā tvā vahantu harayo vahiṣṭhāḥ | tvāyatā manasā johavīmīndrā yāhi suvitāya mahe naḥ ||

translations.english: The fire is kindled; the Soma, Indra, is effused let your vigorous horses bring you hither; I invoke yo, Indra, with a mind wholly devoted to you; come for our great prosperity.

mantras.sanskrit: आ याहि शश्वदुशता ययाथेन्द्र महा मनसा सोमपेयम् । उप ब्रह्माणि शृणव इमा नोऽथा ते यज्ञस्तन्वे वयो धात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yāhi śaśvaduśatā yayāthendra mahā manasā somapeyam | upa brahmāṇi śṛṇava imā no'thā te yajñastanve vayo dhāt ||

translations.english: You have ever gone (to similar rites); come now with a great mind disposed to drink the Soma; hear these our praises; may the worshipper present to you (sacrificial) food for (the nourishment of) your person n.

mantras.sanskrit: यदिन्द्र दिवि पार्ये यदृधग्यद्वा स्वे सदने यत्र वासि । अतो नो यज्ञमवसे नियुत्वान्त्सजोषाः पाहि गिर्वणो मरुद्भिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadindra divi pārye yadṛdhagyadvā sve sadane yatra vāsi | ato no yajñamavase niyutvāntsajoṣāḥ pāhi girvaṇo marudbhiḥ ||

translations.english: Whether, Indra, you abide in the distant heaven, in any other plural ce, or in your own abode, or whersoever (you may be), from thence do you, who are propitiated by praise, putting to your steeds, protect, together with the Maruts, well plural ased, our sacrifice, for our preservation.

mantras.sanskrit: अहेळमान उप याहि यज्ञं तुभ्यं पवन्त इन्दवः सुतासः । गावो न वज्रिन्त्स्वमोको अच्छेन्द्रा गहि प्रथमो यज्ञियानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: aheḷamāna upa yāhi yajñaṃ tubhyaṃ pavanta indavaḥ sutāsaḥ | gāvo na vajrintsvamoko acchendrā gahi prathamo yajñiyānām ||

translations.english: Unirascible (Indra), come to the sacrifice; the effused Soma is purified for you; they flow, thunderer, (into the pitchers), as cows go to their stalls; come, Indra, the first of those who are to be worshipped.

mantras.sanskrit: या ते काकुत्सुकृता या वरिष्ठा यया शश्वत्पिबसि मध्व ऊर्मिम् । तया पाहि प्र ते अध्वर्युरस्थात्सं ते वज्रो वर्ततामिन्द्र गव्युः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā te kākutsukṛtā yā variṣṭhā yayā śaśvatpibasi madhva ūrmim | tayā pāhi pra te adhvaryurasthātsaṃ te vajro vartatāmindra gavyuḥ ||

translations.english: Drink, Indra, with that well-formed and expanded tongue wherewith you ever quaff the sweet (Soma); before you stands the ministrant priest; let your bolt, Indra,  designed (to recover) the cattle, be hurled (against your foes).

mantras.sanskrit: एष द्रप्सो वृषभो विश्वरूप इन्द्राय वृष्णे समकारि सोमः । एतं पिब हरिवः स्थातरुग्र यस्येशिषे प्रदिवि यस्ते अन्नम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa drapso vṛṣabho viśvarūpa indrāya vṛṣṇe samakāri somaḥ | etaṃ piba harivaḥ sthātarugra yasyeśiṣe pradivi yaste annam ||

translations.english: This dropping, omniform Soma, the showerer (of benefits), has been duly prepared for Indra, the showerer (of rain); lord of steeds, ruler over all, mighty (Indra), drink this over which you have of old pressed, which is your food.

mantras.sanskrit: सुतः सोमो असुतादिन्द्र वस्यानयं श्रेयाञ्चिकितुषे रणाय । एतं तितिर्व उप याहि यज्ञं तेन विश्वास्तविषीरा पृणस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: sutaḥ somo asutādindra vasyānayaṃ śreyāñcikituṣe raṇāya | etaṃ titirva upa yāhi yajñaṃ tena viśvāstaviṣīrā pṛṇasva ||

translations.english: Soma when pressed excels the unpressed Soma, better, for one who knows, to give him pleasure. Come to this sacrifice of ours, O Victor replenish all thy powers with this libation.

mantras.sanskrit: ह्वयामसि त्वेन्द्र याह्यर्वाङरं ते सोमस्तन्वे भवाति । शतक्रतो मादयस्वा सुतेषु प्रास्माँ अव पृतनासु प्र विक्षु ॥
mantras.transliteration: hvayāmasi tvendra yāhyarvāṅaraṃ te somastanve bhavāti | śatakrato mādayasvā suteṣu prāsmā~ ava pṛtanāsu pra vikṣu ||

translations.english: We invoke you, Indra, come down; may the Soma be sufficient for (the satisfaction of) your person n; exult Śatakratu with the libations, defend us in combats, and against the people.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रत्यस्मै पिपीषते विश्वानि विदुषे भर । अरंगमाय जग्मयेऽपश्चाद्दघ्वने नरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pratyasmai pipīṣate viśvāni viduṣe bhara | araṃgamāya jagmaye'paścāddaghvane nare ||

translations.english: Offer, (priests), the libation to him who is desirous to drink; who knows all things; whose movements are all-sufficient; who goes readily (to sacrifices); the leader (of holy rites), following no one.

mantras.sanskrit: एमेनं प्रत्येतन सोमेभिः सोमपातमम् । अमत्रेभिॠजीषिणमिन्द्रं सुतेभिरिन्दुभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: emenaṃ pratyetana somebhiḥ somapātamam | amatrebhiṝjīṣiṇamindraṃ sutebhirindubhiḥ ||

translations.english: Proceed to the presence of that deep quaffer of the Soma, with the Soma; to the vigorous Indra with vessels (filed) with the efused libations.

mantras.sanskrit: यदी सुतेभिरिन्दुभिः सोमेभिः प्रतिभूषथ । वेदा विश्वस्य मेधिरो धृषत्तंतमिदेषते ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadī sutebhirindubhiḥ somebhiḥ pratibhūṣatha | vedā viśvasya medhiro dhṛṣattaṃtamideṣate ||

translations.english: When, with the effused and flowing Soma, you come into his presence, the sagacious (Indra) knows your wish, and the suppresser (of enemies) assuredly grants it, whateve it may be.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्माअस्मा इदन्धसोऽध्वर्यो प्र भरा सुतम् । कुवित्समस्य जेन्यस्य शर्धतोऽभिशस्तेरवस्परत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmāasmā idandhaso'dhvaryo pra bharā sutam | kuvitsamasya jenyasya śardhato'bhiśasteravasparat ||

translations.english: Offer, priest, to him, and him (only) this libation of (sacrificial) food, and may he ever defend us against the malignity of every superable adversary.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य त्यच्छम्बरं मदे दिवोदासाय रन्धयः । अयं स सोम इन्द्र ते सुतः पिब ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya tyacchambaraṃ made divodāsāya randhayaḥ | ayaṃ sa soma indra te sutaḥ piba ||

translations.english: This Soma, in the exhilaration of which it is known that you have subdued Śambara for (the sake of) Divodāsa, is poured out, Indra, for you; drink.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य तीव्रसुतं मदं मध्यमन्तं च रक्षसे । अयं स सोम इन्द्र ते सुतः पिब ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya tīvrasutaṃ madaṃ madhyamantaṃ ca rakṣase | ayaṃ sa soma indra te sutaḥ piba ||

translations.english: This Soma, the exhilarating draught of which, when fresh effused (at dawn), or at noon, or at the last (or evening worship), you cherish, is poured out, Indra, for you; drink.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य गा अन्तरश्मनो मदे दृळ्हा अवासृजः । अयं स सोम इन्द्र ते सुतः पिब ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya gā antaraśmano made dṛḷhā avāsṛjaḥ | ayaṃ sa soma indra te sutaḥ piba ||

translations.english: This Soma, in the exhilaration of which you have liberated the cattle, firm (fastened) within the rock, is poured out, Indra, for you; drink.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य मन्दानो अन्धसो माघोनं दधिषे शवः । अयं स सोम इन्द्र ते सुतः पिब ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya mandāno andhaso māghonaṃ dadhiṣe śavaḥ | ayaṃ sa soma indra te sutaḥ piba ||

translations.english: This Soma, exhilarated (by drinking) of which (sacrificial) food you possessed the might of Maghavan, is poured out, Indra, for you; drink.

mantras.sanskrit: यो रयिवो रयिंतमो यो द्युम्नैर्द्युम्नवत्तमः । सोमः सुतः स इन्द्र तेऽस्ति स्वधापते मदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo rayivo rayiṃtamo yo dyumnairdyumnavattamaḥ | somaḥ sutaḥ sa indra te'sti svadhāpate madaḥ ||

translations.english: Opulent Indra, the Soma that abounds with riches, and is most resplendent with glories, is poured out; it is your exhilaration, Indra, lord of the offering.

mantras.sanskrit: यः शग्मस्तुविशग्म ते रायो दामा मतीनाम् । सोमः सुतः स इन्द्र तेऽस्ति स्वधापते मदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ śagmastuviśagma te rāyo dāmā matīnām | somaḥ sutaḥ sa indra te'sti svadhāpate madaḥ ||

translations.english: The Soma, possessor of felicity, which gives you delight, and which is the bestower of riches on your votaries, is poured out; it is your exhilaration, Indra, lord of the offering.

mantras.sanskrit: येन वृद्धो न शवसा तुरो न स्वाभिरूतिभिः । सोमः सुतः स इन्द्र तेऽस्ति स्वधापते मदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yena vṛddho na śavasā turo na svābhirūtibhiḥ | somaḥ sutaḥ sa indra te'sti svadhāpate madaḥ ||

translations.english: The Soma, whereby you are augmented in strength, and, together with your defenders, (the Maruts), are victorious (over your foes), is poured out; it is your exhilaration, Indra, lord of the offering.

mantras.sanskrit: त्यमु वो अप्रहणं गृणीषे शवसस्पतिम् । इन्द्रं विश्वासाहं नरं मंहिष्ठं विश्वचर्षणिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tyamu vo aprahaṇaṃ gṛṇīṣe śavasaspatim | indraṃ viśvāsāhaṃ naraṃ maṃhiṣṭhaṃ viśvacarṣaṇim ||

translations.english: (Worshippers), for you I glorify that Indra who disappointed not (his adorers); the lord of strength, the all-subduing, the leader (of rites), the most beautiful, the beholder of the universe.

mantras.sanskrit: यं वर्धयन्तीद्गिरः पतिं तुरस्य राधसः । तमिन्न्वस्य रोदसी देवी शुष्मं सपर्यतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ vardhayantīdgiraḥ patiṃ turasya rādhasaḥ | taminnvasya rodasī devī śuṣmaṃ saparyataḥ ||

translations.english: The divine heaven and earth adore that vigour of his, which our hymns augment, the appropriator of the riches of the foe.

mantras.sanskrit: तद्व उक्थस्य बर्हणेन्द्रायोपस्तृणीषणि । विपो न यस्योतयो वि यद्रोहन्ति सक्षितः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadva ukthasya barhaṇendrāyopastṛṇīṣaṇi | vipo na yasyotayo vi yadrohanti sakṣitaḥ ||

translations.english: (Worshippers), the efficacy of your eulogy is to be manifested to that Indra, whose protections, like (those) of a sensible man, are displayed as abiding along with him.

mantras.sanskrit: अविदद्दक्षं मित्रो नवीयान्पपानो देवेभ्यो वस्यो अचैत् । ससवान्त्स्तौलाभिर्धौतरीभिरुरुष्या पायुरभवत्सखिभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: avidaddakṣaṃ mitro navīyānpapāno devebhyo vasyo acait | sasavāntstaulābhirdhautarībhiruruṣyā pāyurabhavatsakhibhyaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, appreciates him who is skilled (in holy rites); a recent friend, quaffing (the libation), he heaps excellent (wealth) upon the devout; partaking of (the sacrificial) food, (and brought) by his robust agitators (of the earth, his steeds), he, through his benevolence, is a protector to his friends.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतस्य पथि वेधा अपायि श्रिये मनांसि देवासो अक्रन् । दधानो नाम महो वचोभिर्वपुर्दृशये वेन्यो व्यावः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtasya pathi vedhā apāyi śriye manāṃsi devāso akran | dadhāno nāma maho vacobhirvapurdṛśaye venyo vyāvaḥ ||

translations.english: The Soma, creator (of all), on the path of sacrifice, has been drunk; the worshippers have presented it to gratify the mind (of Indra); may he, the humiliator (of his foes), possessing a vast body, propitiated by our praises, become manifest to our view.

mantras.sanskrit: द्युमत्तमं दक्षं धेह्यस्मे सेधा जनानां पूर्वीररातीः । वर्षीयो वयः कृणुहि शचीभिर्धनस्य सातावस्माँ अविड्ढि ॥
mantras.transliteration: dyumattamaṃ dakṣaṃ dhehyasme sedhā janānāṃ pūrvīrarātīḥ | varṣīyo vayaḥ kṛṇuhi śacībhirdhanasya sātāvasmā~ aviḍḍhi ||

translations.english: Bestow upon us most brilliant vigour; oppose the numerous enemies of your worshippers; gran us, for our pious acts, abundant food; secure us in the enjoyment of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र तुभ्यमिन्मघवन्नभूम वयं दात्रे हरिवो मा वि वेनः । नकिरापिर्ददृशे मर्त्यत्रा किमङ्ग रध्रचोदनं त्वाहुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra tubhyaminmaghavannabhūma vayaṃ dātre harivo mā vi venaḥ | nakirāpirdadṛśe martyatrā kimaṅga radhracodanaṃ tvāhuḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, possessor of affluence, we have recourse to you, the bountiful, lord of steeds, be not unfavourable to us; no other kinsman is beheld (by us) among men; who else have they called yo the bestower of wealth?

mantras.sanskrit: मा जस्वने वृषभ नो ररीथा मा ते रेवतः सख्ये रिषाम । पूर्वीष्ट इन्द्र निष्षिधो जनेषु जह्यसुष्वीन्प्र वृहापृणतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā jasvane vṛṣabha no rarīthā mā te revataḥ sakhye riṣāma | pūrvīṣṭa indra niṣṣidho janeṣu jahyasuṣvīnpra vṛhāpṛṇataḥ ||

translations.english: Give us not up, showerer (of benefits), to the obstructor (of our rites); relying upon the friendship of you, lord of riches, may we be unharmed; many are the hindrances (opposed) to you among men; slay those who make no libations, root out those who present no offerings.

mantras.sanskrit: उदभ्राणीव स्तनयन्नियर्तीन्द्रो राधांस्यश्व्यानि गव्या । त्वमसि प्रदिवः कारुधाया मा त्वादामान आ दभन्मघोनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: udabhrāṇīva stanayanniyartīndro rādhāṃsyaśvyāni gavyā | tvamasi pradivaḥ kārudhāyā mā tvādāmāna ā dabhanmaghonaḥ ||

translations.english: As Indra, when thundering rases the clouds, so he (heaps upon his worshippers) riches of horses and cattle; yo, Indra, are he ancient upholder of the sacrificer; let not the opulent wrong you, not presenting (oblations).

mantras.sanskrit: अध्वर्यो वीर प्र महे सुतानामिन्द्राय भर स ह्यस्य राजा । यः पूर्व्याभिरुत नूतनाभिर्गीर्भिर्वावृधे गृणतामृषीणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhvaryo vīra pra mahe sutānāmindrāya bhara sa hyasya rājā | yaḥ pūrvyābhiruta nūtanābhirgīrbhirvāvṛdhe gṛṇatāmṛṣīṇām ||

translations.english: Ministrant priests offer libations to the mighty Indra, for he is their king, he who has been exalted by the ancient and recent hymns of adoring sages.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य मदे पुरु वर्पांसि विद्वानिन्द्रो वृत्राण्यप्रती जघान । तमु प्र होषि मधुमन्तमस्मै सोमं वीराय शिप्रिणे पिबध्यै ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya made puru varpāṃsi vidvānindro vṛtrāṇyapratī jaghāna | tamu pra hoṣi madhumantamasmai somaṃ vīrāya śipriṇe pibadhyai ||

translations.english: In the exhilaration of this Soma, the wise Indra, irresistible, has destroyed numerous opposing enemies; offer the sweet-flavoured beverage to that hero, the handsome-chinned, to drink.

mantras.sanskrit: पाता सुतमिन्द्रो अस्तु सोमं हन्ता वृत्रं वज्रेण मन्दसानः । गन्ता यज्ञं परावतश्चिदच्छा वसुर्धीनामविता कारुधायाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pātā sutamindro astu somaṃ hantā vṛtraṃ vajreṇa mandasānaḥ | gantā yajñaṃ parāvataścidacchā vasurdhīnāmavitā kārudhāyāḥ ||

translations.english: May Indra be the drinker of this effused Soma, and, exhilarated by it, become the destroyer of Vṛtra by the thunderbolt; may he come, although from afar, to our sacrifice, (he who is) the giver of dwellings, the upholder of the celebrator (of religious).

mantras.sanskrit: इदं त्यत्पात्रमिन्द्रपानमिन्द्रस्य प्रियममृतमपायि । मत्सद्यथा सौमनसाय देवं व्यस्मद्द्वेषो युयवद्व्यंहः ॥
mantras.transliteration: idaṃ tyatpātramindrapānamindrasya priyamamṛtamapāyi | matsadyathā saumanasāya devaṃ vyasmaddveṣo yuyavadvyaṃhaḥ ||

translations.english: May this ambrosia, the appropriate beverage of Indra, of which is fond, be quaffed (by him), so that it may inspire the divinity with favourable feelings (towards us), and that he may remove from us our adversaries, and (all) iniquity.

mantras.sanskrit: एना मन्दानो जहि शूर शत्रूञ्जामिमजामिं मघवन्नमित्रान् । अभिषेणाँ अभ्यादेदिशानान्पराच इन्द्र प्र मृणा जही च ॥
mantras.transliteration: enā mandāno jahi śūra śatrūñjāmimajāmiṃ maghavannamitrān | abhiṣeṇā~ abhyādediśānānparāca indra pra mṛṇā jahī ca ||

translations.english: Exhilarated by it, valiant Maghavan, slay our unfriendly adversaries, whether kinsman or unrelated (to us); put to flight, Indra, hostile armies menacing us (with their weapons), and slay them.

mantras.sanskrit: आसु ष्मा णो मघवन्निन्द्र पृत्स्वस्मभ्यं महि वरिवः सुगं कः । अपां तोकस्य तनयस्य जेष इन्द्र सूरीन्कृणुहि स्मा नो अर्धम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: āsu ṣmā ṇo maghavannindra pṛtsvasmabhyaṃ mahi varivaḥ sugaṃ kaḥ | apāṃ tokasya tanayasya jeṣa indra sūrīnkṛṇuhi smā no ardham ||

translations.english: Affluent Indra, facilitate to us (the acquisition of) vast riches in these our battles; (enable us) to gain the victory; make us prosperous with rain, and with sons and grandsons.

mantras.sanskrit: आ त्वा हरयो वृषणो युजाना वृषरथासो वृषरश्मयोऽत्याः । अस्मत्राञ्चो वृषणो वज्रवाहो वृष्णे मदाय सुयुजो वहन्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tvā harayo vṛṣaṇo yujānā vṛṣarathāso vṛṣaraśmayo'tyāḥ | asmatrāñco vṛṣaṇo vajravāho vṛṣṇe madāya suyujo vahantu ||

translations.english: Let your vigorous steeds, harnessed of their own will, drawing your wish-bestowing chariot, guided by shower-yielding reins, quick-moving, hastening towards us, youthful, thunder-bearing, well-yoked, bring you to the hountiful, exhilarating (libation).

mantras.sanskrit: आ ते वृषन्वृषणो द्रोणमस्थुर्घृतप्रुषो नोर्मयो मदन्तः । इन्द्र प्र तुभ्यं वृषभिः सुतानां वृष्णे भरन्ति वृषभाय सोमम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā te vṛṣanvṛṣaṇo droṇamasthurghṛtapruṣo normayo madantaḥ | indra pra tubhyaṃ vṛṣabhiḥ sutānāṃ vṛṣṇe bharanti vṛṣabhāya somam ||

translations.english: Showerer (of benefits), your vigorous water-shedding steeds, like the waves (of the sea), exulting, are harnessed to your car; for they, (the priests), offer to you, the showerer (of benefits), ever youthful, the libation of the Soma expressed by the stones.

mantras.sanskrit: वृषासि दिवो वृषभः पृथिव्या वृषा सिन्धूनां वृषभः स्तियानाम् । वृष्णे त इन्दुर्वृषभ पीपाय स्वादू रसो मधुपेयो वराय ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣāsi divo vṛṣabhaḥ pṛthivyā vṛṣā sindhūnāṃ vṛṣabhaḥ stiyānām | vṛṣṇe ta indurvṛṣabha pīpāya svādū raso madhupeyo varāya ||

translations.english: You, Indra, are the showerer of heaven, the bearer of earth, the feeder of the rivers, the supplier of the aggregated (waters); for you, showerer (of benefits), who are the most excellent shedder of rain, the sweet Soma, the honey-flavoured, is ready to be quaffed.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं देवः सहसा जायमान इन्द्रेण युजा पणिमस्तभायत् । अयं स्वस्य पितुरायुधानीन्दुरमुष्णादशिवस्य मायाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ devaḥ sahasā jāyamāna indreṇa yujā paṇimastabhāyat | ayaṃ svasya piturāyudhānīnduramuṣṇādaśivasya māyāḥ ||

translations.english: This divine Soma, with Indra for its ally, crushed, as soon as genitive rated, Paṇi by force; this Soma baffled the devices and the weapons of the malignant secreter of (the stolen) wealth, (the cattle).

mantras.sanskrit: अयमकृणोदुषसः सुपत्नीरयं सूर्ये अदधाज्ज्योतिरन्तः । अयं त्रिधातु दिवि रोचनेषु त्रितेषु विन्ददमृतं निगूळ्हम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayamakṛṇoduṣasaḥ supatnīrayaṃ sūrye adadhājjyotirantaḥ | ayaṃ tridhātu divi rocaneṣu triteṣu vindadamṛtaṃ nigūḷham ||

translations.english: This Soma made the dawns happily wedded to the sun; this Soma plural ced the light within the solar orb; this (Soma) has found the threefold ambrosia hidden in heaven in the three bright regions.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं द्यावापृथिवी वि ष्कभायदयं रथमयुनक्सप्तरश्मिम् । अयं गोषु शच्या पक्वमन्तः सोमो दाधार दशयन्त्रमुत्सम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī vi ṣkabhāyadayaṃ rathamayunaksaptaraśmim | ayaṃ goṣu śacyā pakvamantaḥ somo dādhāra daśayantramutsam ||

translations.english: This (Soma) has been fixed heaven and earth; this has harnessed the seven-rayed chariot (of the sun); this Soma has developed of its own will the mature deeply-organized secretion in the kind.

mantras.sanskrit: य आनयत्परावतः सुनीती तुर्वशं यदुम् । इन्द्रः स नो युवा सखा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya ānayatparāvataḥ sunītī turvaśaṃ yadum | indraḥ sa no yuvā sakhā ||

translations.english: May that youthful Indra, who, by good guidance, brought Turvaśa and Yadu from afar, (be) our friend.

mantras.sanskrit: अविप्रे चिद्वयो दधदनाशुना चिदर्वता । इन्द्रो जेता हितं धनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: avipre cidvayo dadhadanāśunā cidarvatā | indro jetā hitaṃ dhanam ||

translations.english: Indra gives sustenance, even to the undevout he is the conqueror of wealh accusative ulated (by enemies) though (going against) them with a slow-paced steed.

mantras.sanskrit: महीरस्य प्रणीतयः पूर्वीरुत प्रशस्तयः । नास्य क्षीयन्त ऊतयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahīrasya praṇītayaḥ pūrvīruta praśastayaḥ | nāsya kṣīyanta ūtayaḥ ||

translations.english: Vast are his designs, manifold are his praises, his protections are never withdrawn.

mantras.sanskrit: सखायो ब्रह्मवाहसेऽर्चत प्र च गायत । स हि नः प्रमतिर्मही ॥
mantras.transliteration: sakhāyo brahmavāhase'rcata pra ca gāyata | sa hi naḥ pramatirmahī ||

translations.english: Offer worship and praises, friends, to him who is to be attracted by prayers; for he verily is our great intelligence.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमेकस्य वृत्रहन्नविता द्वयोरसि । उतेदृशे यथा वयम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamekasya vṛtrahannavitā dvayorasi | utedṛśe yathā vayam ||

translations.english: Slayer of Vṛtra, you are the protector of one (adorer), or of two, and of such as we are.

mantras.sanskrit: नयसीद्वति द्विषः कृणोष्युक्थशंसिनः । नृभिः सुवीर उच्यसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: nayasīdvati dviṣaḥ kṛṇoṣyukthaśaṃsinaḥ | nṛbhiḥ suvīra ucyase ||

translations.english: You remove (far from us) those who hate us; you prosper hose who repeat your praise; bestower of excellent male descendants, you are glorified by man

mantras.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणं ब्रह्मवाहसं गीर्भिः सखायमृग्मियम् । गां न दोहसे हुवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: brahmāṇaṃ brahmavāhasaṃ gīrbhiḥ sakhāyamṛgmiyam | gāṃ na dohase huve ||

translations.english: I invoke with hymns Indra, our friends, who is Brahma, who is attracted by prayer and entitled to adoration, to milk him as a cow.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य विश्वानि हस्तयोरूचुर्वसूनि नि द्विता । वीरस्य पृतनाषहः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya viśvāni hastayorūcurvasūni ni dvitā | vīrasya pṛtanāṣahaḥ ||

translations.english: In the hands of whom, the eroic subduer of hostile armies, (the sages) have declared, are all the treasures in both (heaven and earth).

mantras.sanskrit: वि दृळ्हानि चिदद्रिवो जनानां शचीपते । वृह माया अनानत ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi dṛḷhāni cidadrivo janānāṃ śacīpate | vṛha māyā anānata ||

translations.english: Wielder of the thunderbolt, lord of Śaci, demolish the strong (cities) of men; (battle), unbending (Indra) their devices.

mantras.sanskrit: तमु त्वा सत्य सोमपा इन्द्र वाजानां पते । अहूमहि श्रवस्यवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamu tvā satya somapā indra vājānāṃ pate | ahūmahi śravasyavaḥ ||

translations.english: Veracious Indra, drinker of the Soma, provider of sustenance, we, desirous of food, invoke such as you are.

mantras.sanskrit: तमु त्वा यः पुरासिथ यो वा नूनं हिते धने । हव्यः स श्रुधी हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamu tvā yaḥ purāsitha yo vā nūnaṃ hite dhane | havyaḥ sa śrudhī havam ||

translations.english: (We invoke) you, such as you are, you who have been invocable of old, and who are now to be invoked for the wealth held (by the foe); hear our invocation.

mantras.sanskrit: धीभिरर्वद्भिरर्वतो वाजाँ इन्द्र श्रवाय्यान् । त्वया जेष्म हितं धनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhībhirarvadbhirarvato vājā~ indra śravāyyān | tvayā jeṣma hitaṃ dhanam ||

translations.english: (Favoured) by you, Indra, (who are propitiated), by our hymns, (we ovecome) with our steeds the steeds (of the enemy), and we conquer abundant food, and the wealth held (by the foes).

mantras.sanskrit: अभूरु वीर गिर्वणो महाँ इन्द्र धने हिते । भरे वितन्तसाय्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhūru vīra girvaṇo mahā~ indra dhane hite | bhare vitantasāyyaḥ ||

translations.english: Heroic and adorable Indra, verily you are mighty in battle, and victor of the wealth held (by the enemy).

mantras.sanskrit: या त ऊतिरमित्रहन्मक्षूजवस्तमासति । तया नो हिनुही रथम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā ta ūtiramitrahanmakṣūjavastamāsati | tayā no hinuhī ratham ||

translations.english: Destroyer of enemies with that your velocity, which is of exceeding swiftness, impel our chariots (against the foe).

mantras.sanskrit: स रथेन रथीतमोऽस्माकेनाभियुग्वना । जेषि जिष्णो हितं धनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa rathena rathītamo'smākenābhiyugvanā | jeṣi jiṣṇo hitaṃ dhanam ||

translations.english: Victorious Indra, who are the chief off charioteers, conquer the wealth that is held (by the enemy) with our assailing car.

mantras.sanskrit: य एक इत्तमु ष्टुहि कृष्टीनां विचर्षणिः । पतिर्जज्ञे वृषक्रतुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya eka ittamu ṣṭuhi kṛṣṭīnāṃ vicarṣaṇiḥ | patirjajñe vṛṣakratuḥ ||

translations.english: Praise that Indra who alone has been born the supervisor (of all), the lord of men, the giver of rain.

mantras.sanskrit: यो गृणतामिदासिथापिरूती शिवः सखा । स त्वं न इन्द्र मृळय ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo gṛṇatāmidāsithāpirūtī śivaḥ sakhā | sa tvaṃ na indra mṛḷaya ||

translations.english: Indra, who has ever been the friend of those who praise you, and the insurer of their happiness by your protection, grant us felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: धिष्व वज्रं गभस्त्यो रक्षोहत्याय वज्रिवः । सासहीष्ठा अभि स्पृधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhiṣva vajraṃ gabhastyo rakṣohatyāya vajrivaḥ | sāsahīṣṭhā abhi spṛdhaḥ ||

translations.english: Wielder of the thunderbolt, take the bolt in your hands for the destruction of rākṣasas, and uttely overthrow those who defy you.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रत्नं रयीणां युजं सखायं कीरिचोदनम् । ब्रह्मवाहस्तमं हुवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pratnaṃ rayīṇāṃ yujaṃ sakhāyaṃ kīricodanam | brahmavāhastamaṃ huve ||

translations.english: I invoke the ancient Indra, the giver of iches, (our) friend, the encourager of his adorers, who is to be propitiated by prayer.

mantras.sanskrit: स हि विश्वानि पार्थिवाँ एको वसूनि पत्यते । गिर्वणस्तमो अध्रिगुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa hi viśvāni pārthivā~ eko vasūni patyate | girvaṇastamo adhriguḥ ||

translations.english: He alone rules over all terrestrial riches, he who is entitled to especial praise, he who is irresistible.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो नियुद्भिरा पृण कामं वाजेभिरश्विभिः । गोमद्भिर्गोपते धृषत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no niyudbhirā pṛṇa kāmaṃ vājebhiraśvibhiḥ | gomadbhirgopate dhṛṣat ||

translations.english: Lord of cattle, (coming) with your mares, saisfy our desires completely with (abundant) food, with horses, and with kine.

mantras.sanskrit: तद्वो गाय सुते सचा पुरुहूताय सत्वने । शं यद्गवे न शाकिने ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadvo gāya sute sacā puruhūtāya satvane | śaṃ yadgave na śākine ||

translations.english: Sing praises, when your libation is poured out, to him who is the invoked of many, the subduer (of foes), giving him gratification, like (fresh pasture) to cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: न घा वसुर्नि यमते दानं वाजस्य गोमतः । यत्सीमुप श्रवद्गिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: na ghā vasurni yamate dānaṃ vājasya gomataḥ | yatsīmupa śravadgiraḥ ||

translations.english: The giver of dwellings verily withholds not the gift of food conjoined with cattle, when he hears our praises.

mantras.sanskrit: कुवित्सस्य प्र हि व्रजं गोमन्तं दस्युहा गमत् । शचीभिरप नो वरत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kuvitsasya pra hi vrajaṃ gomantaṃ dasyuhā gamat | śacībhirapa no varat ||

translations.english: Then the desroyer of the Dasyus, proceeds to the cattl-crowded folds of Kuvitsa, and by his acts opens them for us.

mantras.sanskrit: इमा उ त्वा शतक्रतोऽभि प्र णोनुवुर्गिरः । इन्द्र वत्सं न मातरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imā u tvā śatakrato'bhi pra ṇonuvurgiraḥ | indra vatsaṃ na mātaraḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, performer of many exploits, these our praises repeatedly recur to you as parent (cows) to their young.

mantras.sanskrit: दूणाशं सख्यं तव गौरसि वीर गव्यते । अश्वो अश्वायते भव ॥
mantras.transliteration: dūṇāśaṃ sakhyaṃ tava gaurasi vīra gavyate | aśvo aśvāyate bhava ||

translations.english: Your friendship, Indra, is not easily lost; you, hero are (the giver of) cattle to him who desires cattle (of) horses him who desires horses.

mantras.sanskrit: स मन्दस्वा ह्यन्धसो राधसे तन्वा महे । न स्तोतारं निदे करः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa mandasvā hyandhaso rādhase tanvā mahe | na stotāraṃ nide karaḥ ||

translations.english: Delight your person n with the libation (offered) for the sake of treasure; subject not your worshipper to his reviler.

mantras.sanskrit: इमा उ त्वा सुतेसुते नक्षन्ते गिर्वणो गिरः । वत्सं गावो न धेनवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imā u tvā sutesute nakṣante girvaṇo giraḥ | vatsaṃ gāvo na dhenavaḥ ||

translations.english: These our praises tend, as the libationsa are repeatedly poured out, eagerly to you who are gratified by praise, as the milch kine (hasten) to their calves.

mantras.sanskrit: पुरूतमं पुरूणां स्तोतॄणां विवाचि । वाजेभिर्वाजयताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: purūtamaṃ purūṇāṃ stotṝṇāṃ vivāci | vājebhirvājayatām ||

translations.english: May the praises of many worshippers offered at the sacrifice, (accompanied) by (sacrificial) viands, invigorate you, destroyer of multitudes.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्माकमिन्द्र भूतु ते स्तोमो वाहिष्ठो अन्तमः । अस्मान्राये महे हिनु ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmākamindra bhūtu te stomo vāhiṣṭho antamaḥ | asmānrāye mahe hinu ||

translations.english: May our most elevating praise be near, Indra, to you, and urge us to (the acquisition of) great riches.

mantras.sanskrit: अधि बृबुः पणीनां वर्षिष्ठे मूर्धन्नस्थात् । उरुः कक्षो न गाङ्ग्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhi bṛbuḥ paṇīnāṃ varṣiṣṭhe mūrdhannasthāt | uruḥ kakṣo na gāṅgyaḥ ||

translations.english: Bṛbu presided over the high plural ces of the Paṇis, like the elevated bank of the Ganges.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य वायोरिव द्रवद्भद्रा रातिः सहस्रिणी । सद्यो दानाय मंहते ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya vāyoriva dravadbhadrā rātiḥ sahasriṇī | sadyo dānāya maṃhate ||

translations.english: Of whom, prompt as the wind, the liberal donation of thousands (of cattle) has been quickly given to (me) soliciting a gift.

mantras.sanskrit: तत्सु नो विश्वे अर्य आ सदा गृणन्ति कारवः । बृबुं सहस्रदातमं सूरिं सहस्रसातमम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tatsu no viśve arya ā sadā gṛṇanti kāravaḥ | bṛbuṃ sahasradātamaṃ sūriṃ sahasrasātamam ||

translations.english: Whom, therefore, we all, who are the profferers and bestowers of praise ever commend, as the pious Bṛbu, the donor of thousands (of cattle), the receiver of thousands (of laudations).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामिद्धि हवामहे साता वाजस्य कारवः । त्वां वृत्रेष्विन्द्र सत्पतिं नरस्त्वां काष्ठास्वर्वतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmiddhi havāmahe sātā vājasya kāravaḥ | tvāṃ vṛtreṣvindra satpatiṃ narastvāṃ kāṣṭhāsvarvataḥ ||

translations.english: We worshippers invoke you for the acquisition of food; you, Indra, the protector of the good, (do) men (invoke for aid) against enemies, and in plural ces where horses (encounter).

mantras.sanskrit: स त्वं नश्चित्र वज्रहस्त धृष्णुया महः स्तवानो अद्रिवः । गामश्वं रथ्यमिन्द्र सं किर सत्रा वाजं न जिग्युषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa tvaṃ naścitra vajrahasta dhṛṣṇuyā mahaḥ stavāno adrivaḥ | gāmaśvaṃ rathyamindra saṃ kira satrā vājaṃ na jigyuṣe ||

translations.english: Wonderful wielder of the thunderbolt, Indra, the lord of clouds, mighty in resolution, being glorified by us, grant us cattle, and horses fit for chariots, as (you grant) abundant food to him who is victorious (in battle).

mantras.sanskrit: यः सत्राहा विचर्षणिरिन्द्रं तं हूमहे वयम् । सहस्रमुष्क तुविनृम्ण सत्पते भवा समत्सु नो वृधे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ satrāhā vicarṣaṇirindraṃ taṃ hūmahe vayam | sahasramuṣka tuvinṛmṇa satpate bhavā samatsu no vṛdhe ||

translations.english: We invoke that Indra who is the desroyer of mighty foes, the supervisor (of all things); do you, the many organed, the protector of the good, the distributor of wealth, be unto us (the insurer of) success in combats.

mantras.sanskrit: बाधसे जनान्वृषभेव मन्युना घृषौ मीळ्ह ऋचीषम । अस्माकं बोध्यविता महाधने तनूष्वप्सु सूर्ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: bādhase janānvṛṣabheva manyunā ghṛṣau mīḷha ṛcīṣama | asmākaṃ bodhyavitā mahādhane tanūṣvapsu sūrye ||

translations.english: Such, Indra, as you are represented in holy texts, assail (our) adversaries with fierceness like (that of) a bull in close conflict; regard yourself as our defender in war, (that we may long enjoy) posterity, water, and the sight of the) sun.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र ज्येष्ठं न आ भरँ ओजिष्ठं पपुरि श्रवः । येनेमे चित्र वज्रहस्त रोदसी ओभे सुशिप्र प्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra jyeṣṭhaṃ na ā bhara~ ojiṣṭhaṃ papuri śravaḥ | yeneme citra vajrahasta rodasī obhe suśipra prāḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, bring to us most excellent, most invigorating and nutritious food, wherewith, wonderful wielder of the thunderbolt, the handsome-chinned, you sustain both heaven and earth.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामुग्रमवसे चर्षणीसहं राजन्देवेषु हूमहे । विश्वा सु नो विथुरा पिब्दना वसोऽमित्रान्त्सुषहान्कृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmugramavase carṣaṇīsahaṃ rājandeveṣu hūmahe | viśvā su no vithurā pibdanā vaso'mitrāntsuṣahānkṛdhi ||

translations.english: We invoke for protection you, royal Indra, who are mighty among the gods, tthe subduer of men; granter of dwellings, repel all evil spirits, and render our enemies easy of discomfiture.

mantras.sanskrit: यदिन्द्र नाहुषीष्वाँ ओजो नृम्णं च कृष्टिषु । यद्वा पञ्च क्षितीनां द्युम्नमा भर सत्रा विश्वानि पौंस्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadindra nāhuṣīṣvā~ ojo nṛmṇaṃ ca kṛṣṭiṣu | yadvā pañca kṣitīnāṃ dyumnamā bhara satrā viśvāni pauṃsyā ||

translations.english: Whatever strength and opulence (exist) among human beings, whatever be the sustenance of the five classes of men, bring Indra to us, as well (as) all great manly energies.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्वा तृक्षौ मघवन्द्रुह्यावा जने यत्पूरौ कच्च वृष्ण्यम् । अस्मभ्यं तद्रिरीहि सं नृषाह्येऽमित्रान्पृत्सु तुर्वणे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadvā tṛkṣau maghavandruhyāvā jane yatpūrau kacca vṛṣṇyam | asmabhyaṃ tadrirīhi saṃ nṛṣāhye'mitrānpṛtsu turvaṇe ||

translations.english: Whatever vigour, Maghavan, (existed) in Tṛkṣu, in Druhyu, in Puru, bestow fully upon us in conflicts with foes, so that we may destroy our enemies in war.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र त्रिधातु शरणं त्रिवरूथं स्वस्तिमत् । छर्दिर्यच्छ मघवद्भ्यश्च मह्यं च यावया दिद्युमेभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra tridhātu śaraṇaṃ trivarūthaṃ svastimat | chardiryaccha maghavadbhyaśca mahyaṃ ca yāvayā didyumebhyaḥ ||

translations.english: Give, Indra, to the affluent, and to me also, a sheltering and prosperous dwelling combining three elements, and defending in three ways and keep from them the blazing (weapon of our foes).

mantras.sanskrit: ये गव्यता मनसा शत्रुमादभुरभिप्रघ्नन्ति धृष्णुया । अध स्मा नो मघवन्निन्द्र गिर्वणस्तनूपा अन्तमो भव ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye gavyatā manasā śatrumādabhurabhipraghnanti dhṛṣṇuyā | adha smā no maghavannindra girvaṇastanūpā antamo bhava ||

translations.english: Affluent Indra, propitiated by praise, be nigh o us, as the defender of our person ns (against those) who assail (us as) enemies, with a mind bent upon carrying off (our) cattle, or who assault us with arrogance.

mantras.sanskrit: अध स्मा नो वृधे भवेन्द्र नायमवा युधि । यदन्तरिक्षे पतयन्ति पर्णिनो दिद्यवस्तिग्ममूर्धानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha smā no vṛdhe bhavendra nāyamavā yudhi | yadantarikṣe patayanti parṇino didyavastigmamūrdhānaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, be (favourable) at present to our success; protect our leader in battle when the feathered, sharp-pointed, shining shafts fall from the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्र शूरासस्तन्वो वितन्वते प्रिया शर्म पितॄणाम् । अध स्मा यच्छ तन्वे तने च छर्दिरचित्तं यावय द्वेषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatra śūrāsastanvo vitanvate priyā śarma pitṝṇām | adha smā yaccha tanve tane ca chardiracittaṃ yāvaya dveṣaḥ ||

translations.english: When heroes rest their person ns (until abandoning) the plural asant abodes of their progenitors; grant us, for ourselves and our posterity, an unsuspected defence, and scatter our enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: यदिन्द्र सर्गे अर्वतश्चोदयासे महाधने । असमने अध्वनि वृजिने पथि श्येनाँ इव श्रवस्यतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadindra sarge arvataścodayāse mahādhane | asamane adhvani vṛjine pathi śyenā~ iva śravasyataḥ ||

translations.english: (At the time) when, in the effort (made) in an arduous conflict, you urge our horses over an uneven road, like falcons darting upon their food through the difficult path (of the firmament).

mantras.sanskrit: सिन्धूँरिव प्रवण आशुया यतो यदि क्लोशमनु ष्वणि । आ ये वयो न वर्वृतत्यामिषि गृभीता बाह्वोर्गवि ॥
mantras.transliteration: sindhū~riva pravaṇa āśuyā yato yadi klośamanu ṣvaṇi | ā ye vayo na varvṛtatyāmiṣi gṛbhītā bāhvorgavi ||

translations.english: Rushing rapidly like rivers in their downward course and although neighing loudly through trro, they yet, tight-girthed, return repeatedly (to the conflict) for cattle, like birds darting on their prey.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वादुष्किलायं मधुमाँ उतायं तीव्रः किलायं रसवाँ उतायम् । उतो न्वस्य पपिवांसमिन्द्रं न कश्चन सहत आहवेषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: svāduṣkilāyaṃ madhumā~ utāyaṃ tīvraḥ kilāyaṃ rasavā~ utāyam | uto nvasya papivāṃsamindraṃ na kaścana sahata āhaveṣu ||

translations.english: Savoury indeed is this (Soma); sweet is it, sharp, and full of flavour; no one is able to encounter Indra in battles after he has been quaffing this (Soma).

mantras.sanskrit: अयं स्वादुरिह मदिष्ठ आस यस्येन्द्रो वृत्रहत्ये ममाद । पुरूणि यश्च्यौत्ना शम्बरस्य वि नवतिं नव च देह्यो हन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ svāduriha madiṣṭha āsa yasyendro vṛtrahatye mamāda | purūṇi yaścyautnā śambarasya vi navatiṃ nava ca dehyo han ||

translations.english: The savoury Soma, drunk on this occasion, has been most exhilarating; by drinking of it Indra has been elevated to the slaying of Vṛtra, and it has destroyed the numerous hosts of Śambara and the ninetynine cities.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं मे पीत उदियर्ति वाचमयं मनीषामुशतीमजीगः । अयं षळुर्वीरमिमीत धीरो न याभ्यो भुवनं कच्चनारे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ me pīta udiyarti vācamayaṃ manīṣāmuśatīmajīgaḥ | ayaṃ ṣaḷurvīramimīta dhīro na yābhyo bhuvanaṃ kaccanāre ||

translations.english: This Soma inspires my speech; this develops the desired intelligence; this sagacious (Soma) has created the six vast conditions, from which no creature is distinct.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं स यो वरिमाणं पृथिव्या वर्ष्माणं दिवो अकृणोदयं सः । अयं पीयूषं तिसृषु प्रवत्सु सोमो दाधारोर्वन्तरिक्षम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ sa yo varimāṇaṃ pṛthivyā varṣmāṇaṃ divo akṛṇodayaṃ saḥ | ayaṃ pīyūṣaṃ tisṛṣu pravatsu somo dādhārorvantarikṣam ||

translations.english: This it is which formed the expanse of the earth, the compactness of the heaven; this Soma has deposited the ambrosia in its three principal (receptacles), and has upheld the spacious firmament.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं विदच्चित्रदृशीकमर्णः शुक्रसद्मनामुषसामनीके । अयं महान्महता स्कम्भनेनोद्द्यामस्तभ्नाद्वृषभो मरुत्वान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ vidaccitradṛśīkamarṇaḥ śukrasadmanāmuṣasāmanīke | ayaṃ mahānmahatā skambhanenoddyāmastabhnādvṛṣabho marutvān ||

translations.english: This makes known the wonderfully beautiful and inspiring (solar) radiance) at the appearance of the dawns, whose dwelling is the firmament; this mighty (Soma) has sustained the heaven with a powerful support, th sender of rain, the leader of the winds.

mantras.sanskrit: धृषत्पिब कलशे सोममिन्द्र वृत्रहा शूर समरे वसूनाम् । माध्यंदिने सवन आ वृषस्व रयिस्थानो रयिमस्मासु धेहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhṛṣatpiba kalaśe somamindra vṛtrahā śūra samare vasūnām | mādhyaṃdine savana ā vṛṣasva rayisthāno rayimasmāsu dhehi ||

translations.english: Hero, Indra, who are the slayer of foes in contests for (the acquisition of) treasures, drink boldly from the pitcher; drink copiously at the noonday rite; receptacle of rices, bestow riches upon us.
