mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र प्र णः पुरएतेव पश्य प्र नो नय प्रतरं वस्यो अच्छ । भवा सुपारो अतिपारयो नो भवा सुनीतिरुत वामनीतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra pra ṇaḥ puraeteva paśya pra no naya prataraṃ vasyo accha | bhavā supāro atipārayo no bhavā sunītiruta vāmanītiḥ ||

translations.english: Like one who goes before us, Indra, (on the road), look out, bring before us infinite wealth; be our conductor beyond the bounds (of want), convey us safely over (peril); be our careful guide, our gude to desirable (affluence).

mantras.sanskrit: उरुं नो लोकमनु नेषि विद्वान्त्स्वर्वज्ज्योतिरभयं स्वस्ति । ऋष्वा त इन्द्र स्थविरस्य बाहू उप स्थेयाम शरणा बृहन्ता ॥
mantras.transliteration: uruṃ no lokamanu neṣi vidvāntsvarvajjyotirabhayaṃ svasti | ṛṣvā ta indra sthavirasya bāhū upa stheyāma śaraṇā bṛhantā ||

translations.english: Do you, Indra, who are wise, conduct us to the spacious world (of heaven), to a blessed state of happiness, light, and safety; may we recline in the graceful, protecting, and mighty arms of you the ancient one.

mantras.sanskrit: वरिष्ठे न इन्द्र वन्धुरे धा वहिष्ठयोः शतावन्नश्वयोरा । इषमा वक्षीषां वर्षिष्ठां मा नस्तारीन्मघवन्रायो अर्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: variṣṭhe na indra vandhure dhā vahiṣṭhayoḥ śatāvannaśvayorā | iṣamā vakṣīṣāṃ varṣiṣṭhāṃ mā nastārīnmaghavanrāyo aryaḥ ||

translations.english: plural ce us, possessor of riches, in your ample chariot, (behind) your powerful horses; bring to us from among all viands the most excellent food; let not, Maghavan, any opulent man surpass us in wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र मृळ मह्यं जीवातुमिच्छ चोदय धियमयसो न धाराम् । यत्किं चाहं त्वायुरिदं वदामि तज्जुषस्व कृधि मा देववन्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra mṛḷa mahyaṃ jīvātumiccha codaya dhiyamayaso na dhārām | yatkiṃ cāhaṃ tvāyuridaṃ vadāmi tajjuṣasva kṛdhi mā devavantam ||

translations.english: Make me happy, Indra; be plural ased to prolong my life; shapen my intellect like the edge of a metal sword; whatsoever, desirous (of propitiating) you, I may utter, be plural ased by it; render me the object of divine protection.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रातारमिन्द्रमवितारमिन्द्रं हवेहवे सुहवं शूरमिन्द्रम् । ह्वयामि शक्रं पुरुहूतमिन्द्रं स्वस्ति नो मघवा धात्विन्द्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: trātāramindramavitāramindraṃ havehave suhavaṃ śūramindram | hvayāmi śakraṃ puruhūtamindraṃ svasti no maghavā dhātvindraḥ ||

translations.english: I invoke, at repeated sacrifice, Indra, the preserver, the protector, the hero, who is easily propitiated, Indra, the powerful, the invoked of many; may Indra, the lord of affluence, bestow upon us prosperity.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रः सुत्रामा स्ववाँ अवोभिः सुमृळीको भवतु विश्ववेदाः । बाधतां द्वेषो अभयं कृणोतु सुवीर्यस्य पतयः स्याम ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraḥ sutrāmā svavā~ avobhiḥ sumṛḷīko bhavatu viśvavedāḥ | bādhatāṃ dveṣo abhayaṃ kṛṇotu suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma ||

translations.english: May the protecting, opulent Indra be the bestower of felicity by his protections; may he, who is all-knower of felicity by his protections; may he, who is all-knowing, foil our adversaries; may he keep us out of danger, and may we be the possessors of excellent posterity.

mantras.sanskrit: तस्य वयं सुमतौ यज्ञियस्यापि भद्रे सौमनसे स्याम । स सुत्रामा स्ववाँ इन्द्रो अस्मे आराच्चिद्द्वेषः सनुतर्युयोतु ॥
mantras.transliteration: tasya vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyasyāpi bhadre saumanase syāma | sa sutrāmā svavā~ indro asme ārācciddveṣaḥ sanutaryuyotu ||

translations.english: May we continue in the favour of that adorable (deity) even in his auspicious good-will; may that protecting and opulent Indra drive far from us, into extinction, all those who hate us.

mantras.sanskrit: अव त्वे इन्द्र प्रवतो नोर्मिर्गिरो ब्रह्माणि नियुतो धवन्ते । उरू न राधः सवना पुरूण्यपो गा वज्रिन्युवसे समिन्दून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ava tve indra pravato normirgiro brahmāṇi niyuto dhavante | urū na rādhaḥ savanā purūṇyapo gā vajrinyuvase samindūn ||

translations.english: To you the praises and prayers of the worshipper hasten like a torrent down a declivity; and you thunderer, aggregate the immense wealth (of sacrificial offerings), copious libations, and milk, and the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: क ईं स्तवत्कः पृणात्को यजाते यदुग्रमिन्मघवा विश्वहावेत् । पादाविव प्रहरन्नन्यमन्यं कृणोति पूर्वमपरं शचीभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ka īṃ stavatkaḥ pṛṇātko yajāte yadugraminmaghavā viśvahāvet | pādāviva praharannanyamanyaṃ kṛṇoti pūrvamaparaṃ śacībhiḥ ||

translations.english: Who may (adequately) praise him? Who may satisfy him? Who offer worthy adoration? Since Maghava is daily conscious of his own terrible (power); by his acts he makes first one and then the other precede and follow, as (a man) throws out his feet (alternately in walking).

mantras.sanskrit: शृण्वे वीर उग्रमुग्रं दमायन्नन्यमन्यमतिनेनीयमानः । एधमानद्विळुभयस्य राजा चोष्कूयते विश इन्द्रो मनुष्यान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śṛṇve vīra ugramugraṃ damāyannanyamanyamatinenīyamānaḥ | edhamānadviḷubhayasya rājā coṣkūyate viśa indro manuṣyān ||

translations.english: The hero Indra is renowned; humiliating every formidable (foe), and repeatedly changing the plural ce of one (worshipper) with that of another; Indra, the enemy of the arrogant, the soverign of both (heaven and earth), calls again and again (to encourage) the men who are his worshippers.

mantras.sanskrit: परा पूर्वेषां सख्या वृणक्ति वितर्तुराणो अपरेभिरेति । अनानुभूतीरवधून्वानः पूर्वीरिन्द्रः शरदस्तर्तरीति ॥
mantras.transliteration: parā pūrveṣāṃ sakhyā vṛṇakti vitarturāṇo aparebhireti | anānubhūtīravadhūnvānaḥ pūrvīrindraḥ śaradastartarīti ||

translations.english: Indra rejects the friendship of those who are formost (in pious acts), and, depositing them, associates with (their) inferiors; or (again) shaking off those who neglect his worship, Indra abides many years with those who serve him.

mantras.sanskrit: रूपंरूपं प्रतिरूपो बभूव तदस्य रूपं प्रतिचक्षणाय । इन्द्रो मायाभिः पुरुरूप ईयते युक्ता ह्यस्य हरयः शता दश ॥
mantras.transliteration: rūpaṃrūpaṃ pratirūpo babhūva tadasya rūpaṃ praticakṣaṇāya | indro māyābhiḥ pururūpa īyate yuktā hyasya harayaḥ śatā daśa ||

translations.english: Indra, the prototype, has assumed various forms, and such is his form as that which (he adopts) for his manifestation; Indra, multiform by his illusion, proceeds (to his many worshippers), for the horses, yoked to his car are a thousand.

mantras.sanskrit: युजानो हरिता रथे भूरि त्वष्टेह राजति । को विश्वाहा द्विषतः पक्ष आसत उतासीनेषु सूरिषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: yujāno haritā rathe bhūri tvaṣṭeha rājati | ko viśvāhā dviṣataḥ pakṣa āsata utāsīneṣu sūriṣu ||

translations.english: Yoking his horses to his car, Tvaṣṭā shines in many plural ces here in the three worlds; who (else), sojourning daily among his present worshippers, is their proector against adversaries?

mantras.sanskrit: अगव्यूति क्षेत्रमागन्म देवा उर्वी सती भूमिरंहूरणाभूत् । बृहस्पते प्र चिकित्सा गविष्टावित्था सते जरित्र इन्द्र पन्थाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agavyūti kṣetramāganma devā urvī satī bhūmiraṃhūraṇābhūt | bṛhaspate pra cikitsā gaviṣṭāvitthā sate jaritra indra panthām ||

translations.english: We have wandered, gods, into a desert where there is no track of cattle; the vast extant earth has become the protectress of murderers; direct us, Bṛhaspati, in our search for cattle; show the path, Indra, to your votary being astray.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवेदिवे सदृशीरन्यमर्धं कृष्णा असेधदप सद्मनो जाः । अहन्दासा वृषभो वस्नयन्तोदव्रजे वर्चिनं शम्बरं च ॥
mantras.transliteration: divedive sadṛśīranyamardhaṃ kṛṣṇā asedhadapa sadmano jāḥ | ahandāsā vṛṣabho vasnayantodavraje varcinaṃ śambaraṃ ca ||

translations.english: Indra, becoming manifest from his abode (in the firmament), dissipates, day by day, the resembling glooms, (so that he may distinguish) the other portion, (or the day); and the showerer has slain the two wealth-seeking slaves, Varcin and Śambara, in (the country of) Udavraja.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रस्तोक इन्नु राधसस्त इन्द्र दश कोशयीर्दश वाजिनोऽदात् । दिवोदासादतिथिग्वस्य राधः शाम्बरं वसु प्रत्यग्रभीष्म ॥
mantras.transliteration: prastoka innu rādhasasta indra daśa kośayīrdaśa vājino'dāt | divodāsādatithigvasya rādhaḥ śāmbaraṃ vasu pratyagrabhīṣma ||

translations.english: Prastoka has given to your worshipper, Indra, ten purses of gold, and ten horses, and we have accepted this treasure from Divodāsa, the spoil won by Atithigva from Śambara.

mantras.sanskrit: दशाश्वान्दश कोशान्दश वस्त्राधिभोजना । दशो हिरण्यपिण्डान्दिवोदासादसानिषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: daśāśvāndaśa kośāndaśa vastrādhibhojanā | daśo hiraṇyapiṇḍāndivodāsādasāniṣam ||

translations.english: I have received ten horses, ten purses, clothes, and ample food and ten lumps of gold from Divodāsa.

mantras.sanskrit: दश रथान्प्रष्टिमतः शतं गा अथर्वभ्यः । अश्वथः पायवेऽदात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: daśa rathānpraṣṭimataḥ śataṃ gā atharvabhyaḥ | aśvathaḥ pāyave'dāt ||

translations.english: Aśvattha has given to Pāyu ten chariots with their horses, and a hundred cows to the priests.

mantras.sanskrit: महि राधो विश्वजन्यं दधानान्भरद्वाजान्त्सार्ञ्जयो अभ्ययष्ट ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahi rādho viśvajanyaṃ dadhānānbharadvājāntsārñjayo abhyayaṣṭa ||

translations.english: The son of Sṛñjaya has reverenced the Bharadvājas who have accepted such great wealth for the good of all men.

mantras.sanskrit: वनस्पते वीड्वङ्गो हि भूया अस्मत्सखा प्रतरणः सुवीरः । गोभिः संनद्धो असि वीळयस्वास्थाता ते जयतु जेत्वानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: vanaspate vīḍvaṅgo hi bhūyā asmatsakhā prataraṇaḥ suvīraḥ | gobhiḥ saṃnaddho asi vīḷayasvāsthātā te jayatu jetvāni ||

translations.english: (Chariot made of the) forest lord, be strong of fabric; be our friend; be our protector, and be manned by warriors; you are wrapped with cow-hides; keep us steady; and may he who rides in you be victorious over conquered (foes).

mantras.sanskrit: दिवस्पृथिव्याः पर्योज उद्भृतं वनस्पतिभ्यः पर्याभृतं सहः । अपामोज्मानं परि गोभिरावृतमिन्द्रस्य वज्रं हविषा रथं यज ॥
mantras.transliteration: divaspṛthivyāḥ paryoja udbhṛtaṃ vanaspatibhyaḥ paryābhṛtaṃ sahaḥ | apāmojmānaṃ pari gobhirāvṛtamindrasya vajraṃ haviṣā rathaṃ yaja ||

translations.english: Worship with oblations the chariot constructed of the substance of heaven and earth, the extracted essence of the forest lords; the velocity of the waters; the encompassed with the cow-hide; the thunderbolt (of Indra).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य वज्रो मरुतामनीकं मित्रस्य गर्भो वरुणस्य नाभिः । सेमां नो हव्यदातिं जुषाणो देव रथ प्रति हव्या गृभाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrasya vajro marutāmanīkaṃ mitrasya garbho varuṇasya nābhiḥ | semāṃ no havyadātiṃ juṣāṇo deva ratha prati havyā gṛbhāya ||

translations.english: Do you, divine chariot, who are the thunderbolt of Indra, the precursor of the Maruts, the embryo of Mitra, the navel of Varuṇa, propitiated by this our sacrifice, accept the oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: उप श्वासय पृथिवीमुत द्यां पुरुत्रा ते मनुतां विष्ठितं जगत् । स दुन्दुभे सजूरिन्द्रेण देवैर्दूराद्दवीयो अप सेध शत्रून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa śvāsaya pṛthivīmuta dyāṃ purutrā te manutāṃ viṣṭhitaṃ jagat | sa dundubhe sajūrindreṇa devairdūrāddavīyo apa sedha śatrūn ||

translations.english: War-drum, fill with your sound both heaven and earth; and let all things, fixed or moveable, be aware of it; do you, who are associated with Indra and the gods, drive away our foes to the remotest distance.

mantras.sanskrit: आ क्रन्दय बलमोजो न आ धा निः ष्टनिहि दुरिता बाधमानः । अप प्रोथ दुन्दुभे दुच्छुना इत इन्द्रस्य मुष्टिरसि वीळयस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā krandaya balamojo na ā dhā niḥ ṣṭanihi duritā bādhamānaḥ | apa protha dundubhe ducchunā ita indrasya muṣṭirasi vīḷayasva ||

translations.english: Sound loud against the (hostile) host; animate our prowess; thunder aloud, terrifying the evil-minded; rapid, drum, those whose delight is to harm us; you are the fist of Indra; inspire us with fierceness.

mantras.sanskrit: आमूरज प्रत्यावर्तयेमाः केतुमद्दुन्दुभिर्वावदीति । समश्वपर्णाश्चरन्ति नो नरोऽस्माकमिन्द्र रथिनो जयन्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: āmūraja pratyāvartayemāḥ ketumaddundubhirvāvadīti | samaśvaparṇāścaranti no naro'smākamindra rathino jayantu ||

translations.english: Recover these our cattle, Indra; bring them back; the drum sounds repeatedly as a signal; our leaders, mounted on their steeds, assemble; may our warriors, riding in their cars, Indra, be victorious.

mantras.sanskrit: यज्ञायज्ञा वो अग्नये गिरागिरा च दक्षसे । प्रप्र वयममृतं जातवेदसं प्रियं मित्रं न शंसिषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajñāyajñā vo agnaye girāgirā ca dakṣase | prapra vayamamṛtaṃ jātavedasaṃ priyaṃ mitraṃ na śaṃsiṣam ||

translations.english: At every sacrifice (honour) the mighty Agni with your reiterated praise, while we glorify him, the immortal, who knows all things, our dear friend.

mantras.sanskrit: ऊर्जो नपातं स हिनायमस्मयुर्दाशेम हव्यदातये । भुवद्वाजेष्वविता भुवद्वृध उत त्राता तनूनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūrjo napātaṃ sa hināyamasmayurdāśema havyadātaye | bhuvadvājeṣvavitā bhuvadvṛdha uta trātā tanūnām ||

translations.english: The son of strength, for he verily is propitious to us, to whom let us offer oblations as to the conveyer of them (to the gods); may he be our defender in battles; may he be our benefactor and the grandsire of our offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: वृषा ह्यग्ने अजरो महान्विभास्यर्चिषा । अजस्रेण शोचिषा शोशुचच्छुचे सुदीतिभिः सु दीदिहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣā hyagne ajaro mahānvibhāsyarciṣā | ajasreṇa śociṣā śośucacchuce sudītibhiḥ su dīdihi ||

translations.english: Agni, who are the showerer (of benefits), mighty, and exempt from decay, you shine with (great) splendour; you are resplendent, brilliant (Agni), with unfading lustre; shine forth with glorious rays.

mantras.sanskrit: महो देवान्यजसि यक्ष्यानुषक्तव क्रत्वोत दंसना । अर्वाचः सीं कृणुह्यग्नेऽवसे रास्व वाजोत वंस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: maho devānyajasi yakṣyānuṣaktava kratvota daṃsanā | arvācaḥ sīṃ kṛṇuhyagne'vase rāsva vājota vaṃsva ||

translations.english: You sacrifice to the mighty gods; sacrifice (for us) continually, for (sacrifice is perfected) by your wisdom and your acts; bring them down, Agni, for our salvation; present (to them) the sacrificial food, partake of it yourself.

mantras.sanskrit: यमापो अद्रयो वना गर्भमृतस्य पिप्रति । सहसा यो मथितो जायते नृभिः पृथिव्या अधि सानवि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yamāpo adrayo vanā garbhamṛtasya piprati | sahasā yo mathito jāyate nṛbhiḥ pṛthivyā adhi sānavi ||

translations.english: (You are he) whom the waters, the mountains, the woods, nourish as the embryo of sacrifice; who, churned with strength by the performers (of the rite), are genitive rated in the highest plural ce of the earth.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यः पप्रौ भानुना रोदसी उभे धूमेन धावते दिवि । तिरस्तमो ददृश ऊर्म्यास्वा श्यावास्वरुषो वृषा श्यावा अरुषो वृषा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yaḥ paprau bhānunā rodasī ubhe dhūmena dhāvate divi | tirastamo dadṛśa ūrmyāsvā śyāvāsvaruṣo vṛṣā śyāvā aruṣo vṛṣā ||

translations.english: He who fills both heaven and earth with light, who mounts with smoke into the sky, this radiant showerer (of benefits) is beheld in the dark nights dispersing the gloom; this radiant showerer (of benefits) presides over the dark nights.

mantras.sanskrit: बृहद्भिरग्ने अर्चिभिः शुक्रेण देव शोचिषा । भरद्वाजे समिधानो यविष्ठ्य रेवन्नः शुक्र दीदिहि द्युमत्पावक दीदिहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhadbhiragne arcibhiḥ śukreṇa deva śociṣā | bharadvāje samidhāno yaviṣṭhya revannaḥ śukra dīdihi dyumatpāvaka dīdihi ||

translations.english: Divine, resplendent Agni, youngest (of the gods), when kindled by Bharadvāja, shines with many flames, with pure lustre, (conferring) riches upon us; shine, resplendent purifier.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वासां गृहपतिर्विशामसि त्वमग्ने मानुषीणाम् । शतं पूर्भिर्यविष्ठ पाह्यंहसः समेद्धारं शतं हिमाः स्तोतृभ्यो ये च ददति ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvāsāṃ gṛhapatirviśāmasi tvamagne mānuṣīṇām | śataṃ pūrbhiryaviṣṭha pāhyaṃhasaḥ sameddhāraṃ śataṃ himāḥ stotṛbhyo ye ca dadati ||

translations.english: You, Agni, are the lord of the dwelling, and of all men the descendants of Manu; protect me, youngest (of the gods), when kindling you, with a hundred defences against iniquity; (grant me) a hundred winters, (as well as to those) who bestow gifts upon your worshippers.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं नश्चित्र ऊत्या वसो राधांसि चोदय । अस्य रायस्त्वमग्ने रथीरसि विदा गाधं तुचे तु नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ naścitra ūtyā vaso rādhāṃsi codaya | asya rāyastvamagne rathīrasi vidā gādhaṃ tuce tu naḥ ||

translations.english: Wonderful (Agni), giver of dwellings, encourage us by (your) protection, and (the gift of) riches, for you are he conveyer, Agni, of this wealth; quickly bestow permanence upon our progeny.

mantras.sanskrit: पर्षि तोकं तनयं पर्तृभिष्ट्वमदब्धैरप्रयुत्वभिः । अग्ने हेळांसि दैव्या युयोधि नोऽदेवानि ह्वरांसि च ॥
mantras.transliteration: parṣi tokaṃ tanayaṃ partṛbhiṣṭvamadabdhairaprayutvabhiḥ | agne heḷāṃsi daivyā yuyodhi no'devāni hvarāṃsi ca ||

translations.english: You protect with uninjurable, irremovable defences (our) sons and grandsons; remove far from us celestial wrath and human malevolence.

mantras.sanskrit: आ सखायः सबर्दुघां धेनुमजध्वमुप नव्यसा वचः । सृजध्वमनपस्फुराम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā sakhāyaḥ sabardughāṃ dhenumajadhvamupa navyasā vacaḥ | sṛjadhvamanapasphurām ||

translations.english: Approach, friends the milk-yielding cow with a new song, and let her loose unharmed.

mantras.sanskrit: या शर्धाय मारुताय स्वभानवे श्रवोऽमृत्यु धुक्षत । या मृळीके मरुतां तुराणां या सुम्नैरेवयावरी ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā śardhāya mārutāya svabhānave śravo'mṛtyu dhukṣata | yā mṛḷīke marutāṃ turāṇāṃ yā sumnairevayāvarī ||

translations.english: She who yields immortal food to the powerful, self-irradiating band of the Maruts, who (is anxious) for the gratiication of the self-moving Maruts, who traverse the sky with (the passing waters0, shedding delight.

mantras.sanskrit: भरद्वाजायाव धुक्षत द्विता । धेनुं च विश्वदोहसमिषं च विश्वभोजसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: bharadvājāyāva dhukṣata dvitā | dhenuṃ ca viśvadohasamiṣaṃ ca viśvabhojasam ||

translations.english: Milk for Bharadvāja the twofold (blessing), the cow that gives milk to the universe, food that is sufficient for all.

mantras.sanskrit: तं व इन्द्रं न सुक्रतुं वरुणमिव मायिनम् । अर्यमणं न मन्द्रं सृप्रभोजसं विष्णुं न स्तुष आदिशे ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ va indraṃ na sukratuṃ varuṇamiva māyinam | aryamaṇaṃ na mandraṃ sṛprabhojasaṃ viṣṇuṃ na stuṣa ādiśe ||

translations.english: I praise you, the (company of Maruts), for the distribution of wealth; (the company that), like Indra, is the achiever of great deeds; sagacious like Varuṇa; adorable as Aryaman and munificent as Viṣṇu.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वेषं शर्धो न मारुतं तुविष्वण्यनर्वाणं पूषणं सं यथा शता । सं सहस्रा कारिषच्चर्षणिभ्य आँ आविर्गूळ्हा वसू करत्सुवेदा नो वसू करत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tveṣaṃ śardho na mārutaṃ tuviṣvaṇyanarvāṇaṃ pūṣaṇaṃ saṃ yathā śatā | saṃ sahasrā kāriṣaccarṣaṇibhya ā~ āvirgūḷhā vasū karatsuvedā no vasū karat ||

translations.english: I now (glorify) the brilliant vigour of the company of the Maruts, loud-sounding, irresistible, cherishing, whereby hundreds and thousands (of treasures) are bestowed collectively upon men; may that (company) make hidden wealth manifes; may it render the wealth easily accessible to us.

mantras.sanskrit: आ मा पूषन्नुप द्रव शंसिषं नु ते अपिकर्ण आघृणे । अघा अर्यो अरातयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā mā pūṣannupa drava śaṃsiṣaṃ nu te apikarṇa āghṛṇe | aghā aryo arātayaḥ ||

translations.english: Hasten, Pūṣan, to me; (repel), bright deity, (all) deadly assailing foes; close at your side I repeat your praise.

mantras.sanskrit: मा काकम्बीरमुद्वृहो वनस्पतिमशस्तीर्वि हि नीनशः । मोत सूरो अह एवा चन ग्रीवा आदधते वेः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā kākambīramudvṛho vanaspatimaśastīrvi hi nīnaśaḥ | mota sūro aha evā cana grīvā ādadhate veḥ ||

translations.english: Uproot not, Pūṣan, the forest lord with its progeny of crows; utterly destroy those who are my revilers; let not the adversary ensnare me, as (fowlers) set snares for birds.

mantras.sanskrit: दृतेरिव तेऽवृकमस्तु सख्यम् । अच्छिद्रस्य दधन्वतः सुपूर्णस्य दधन्वतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dṛteriva te'vṛkamastu sakhyam | acchidrasya dadhanvataḥ supūrṇasya dadhanvataḥ ||

translations.english: May your friendship be unbroken, like (the surface) of a skin without a flaw, containing curds.

mantras.sanskrit: परो हि मर्त्यैरसि समो देवैरुत श्रिया । अभि ख्यः पूषन्पृतनासु नस्त्वमवा नूनं यथा पुरा ॥
mantras.transliteration: paro hi martyairasi samo devairuta śriyā | abhi khyaḥ pūṣanpṛtanāsu nastvamavā nūnaṃ yathā purā ||

translations.english: Supreme are you above mortals; equal in glory are you to the gods; therefore, Pūṣan, regard us (favourably) in battles; defend us at present as (you have defended) those of old.

mantras.sanskrit: वामी वामस्य धूतयः प्रणीतिरस्तु सूनृता । देवस्य वा मरुतो मर्त्यस्य वेजानस्य प्रयज्यवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāmī vāmasya dhūtayaḥ praṇītirastu sūnṛtā | devasya vā maruto martyasya vejānasya prayajyavaḥ ||

translations.english: Maruts, agitators, especially to be adored, may your kind and true speech be our conductress; that plural asant (speech which is the guide) to desirable (wealth) for both gods and sacrificing mortals.

mantras.sanskrit: सद्यश्चिद्यस्य चर्कृतिः परि द्यां देवो नैति सूर्यः । त्वेषं शवो दधिरे नाम यज्ञियं मरुतो वृत्रहं शवो ज्येष्ठं वृत्रहं शवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sadyaścidyasya carkṛtiḥ pari dyāṃ devo naiti sūryaḥ | tveṣaṃ śavo dadhire nāma yajñiyaṃ maruto vṛtrahaṃ śavo jyeṣṭhaṃ vṛtrahaṃ śavaḥ ||

translations.english: Whose functions spread quickly round the heavens, like (the light of) the divine sun, since the maruts possess brillian, foe-humiliating, and adorable foe-destroying strength, most excellent foe-destroying strength.

mantras.sanskrit: सकृद्ध द्यौरजायत सकृद्भूमिरजायत । पृश्न्या दुग्धं सकृत्पयस्तदन्यो नानु जायते ॥
mantras.transliteration: sakṛddha dyaurajāyata sakṛdbhūmirajāyata | pṛśnyā dugdhaṃ sakṛtpayastadanyo nānu jāyate ||

translations.english: Once, indeed, was the heaven genitive rated; once was the earth born; once was the milk of Pṛśni (pṛśnayai vai payaso maruto jātāḥ: Taittirīya Saṃhitā 2.2.11.4) drawn other than that was not similarly genitive rated.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तुषे जनं सुव्रतं नव्यसीभिर्गीर्भिर्मित्रावरुणा सुम्नयन्ता । त आ गमन्तु त इह श्रुवन्तु सुक्षत्रासो वरुणो मित्रो अग्निः ॥
mantras.transliteration: stuṣe janaṃ suvrataṃ navyasībhirgīrbhirmitrāvaruṇā sumnayantā | ta ā gamantu ta iha śruvantu sukṣatrāso varuṇo mitro agniḥ ||

translations.english: I commend with new hymns the man observant of his duty, and the beneficent Mitra and Varuṇa; may they, the mighty ones, Varuṇa, Mitra, and Agni, come to our rite, and listen (to our praises).

mantras.sanskrit: विशोविश ईड्यमध्वरेष्वदृप्तक्रतुमरतिं युवत्योः । दिवः शिशुं सहसः सूनुमग्निं यज्ञस्य केतुमरुषं यजध्यै ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśoviśa īḍyamadhvareṣvadṛptakratumaratiṃ yuvatyoḥ | divaḥ śiśuṃ sahasaḥ sūnumagniṃ yajñasya ketumaruṣaṃ yajadhyai ||

translations.english: (I incite the worshipper) to offer worship to Agni, who is to be adored at the sacrifices of every ma; whose acts are free from arrogance; the lord of the two youthful (brides, heaven and earth); the child of heaven, the son of strength, the briliant symbol of sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: अरुषस्य दुहितरा विरूपे स्तृभिरन्या पिपिशे सूरो अन्या । मिथस्तुरा विचरन्ती पावके मन्म श्रुतं नक्षत ऋच्यमाने ॥
mantras.transliteration: aruṣasya duhitarā virūpe stṛbhiranyā pipiśe sūro anyā | mithasturā vicarantī pāvake manma śrutaṃ nakṣata ṛcyamāne ||

translations.english: May the two daughters of the radiant (sun) of various form, of whom one glitters with stars, the other (is bright) with the sun, mutually opposed, proceeding diversely, purifying (all things), and entitled to our laudation, be plural ased by the praise they hear (from us).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वायुमच्छा बृहती मनीषा बृहद्रयिं विश्ववारं रथप्राम् । द्युतद्यामा नियुतः पत्यमानः कविः कविमियक्षसि प्रयज्यो ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vāyumacchā bṛhatī manīṣā bṛhadrayiṃ viśvavāraṃ rathaprām | dyutadyāmā niyutaḥ patyamānaḥ kaviḥ kavimiyakṣasi prayajyo ||

translations.english: May our earnest praise proceed to the presence of Vāyu, the possessor of vast riches, the desired of all, the filler of his chariot (with wealth for his worshippers); most adorable (Vāyu), who are riding in a radiant car, and driving your Niyut (steeds), do you, who are far-seeing, show favour to the sage, (your adorer).

mantras.sanskrit: स मे वपुश्छदयदश्विनोर्यो रथो विरुक्मान्मनसा युजानः । येन नरा नासत्येषयध्यै वर्तिर्याथस्तनयाय त्मने च ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa me vapuśchadayadaśvinoryo ratho virukmānmanasā yujānaḥ | yena narā nāsatyeṣayadhyai vartiryāthastanayāya tmane ca ||

translations.english: May that splendid car of the Aśvins, which is harnessed at a thought, clothe my form (with radiance); that (car) with which, Nāsatyās, leaders of (rites), you go to the dwelling (of the worshipper) to fulfil his desires for his posterity and himself.

mantras.sanskrit: पर्जन्यवाता वृषभा पृथिव्याः पुरीषाणि जिन्वतमप्यानि । सत्यश्रुतः कवयो यस्य गीर्भिर्जगतः स्थातर्जगदा कृणुध्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: parjanyavātā vṛṣabhā pṛthivyāḥ purīṣāṇi jinvatamapyāni | satyaśrutaḥ kavayo yasya gīrbhirjagataḥ sthātarjagadā kṛṇudhvam ||

translations.english: Parjanya and Vāta, showerers of rain, and from te firmament available waters; sage Maruts, hearers of the truth, establishers of the world, multiply the moveable (wealth of him) by whose praises (you are propitiated).

mantras.sanskrit: पावीरवी कन्या चित्रायुः सरस्वती वीरपत्नी धियं धात् । ग्नाभिरच्छिद्रं शरणं सजोषा दुराधर्षं गृणते शर्म यंसत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pāvīravī kanyā citrāyuḥ sarasvatī vīrapatnī dhiyaṃ dhāt | gnābhiracchidraṃ śaraṇaṃ sajoṣā durādharṣaṃ gṛṇate śarma yaṃsat ||

translations.english: May the purifying, amiable, graceful Sarasvatī, the bride of the hero, favour our pious rite; may she, together with the wives of the gods, well plural ased, bestow upon him who praises her a habitation free from defects and impenetrable (to wind and rain), and (grant him) felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: पथस्पथः परिपतिं वचस्या कामेन कृतो अभ्यानळर्कम् । स नो रासच्छुरुधश्चन्द्राग्रा धियंधियं सीषधाति प्र पूषा ॥
mantras.transliteration: pathaspathaḥ paripatiṃ vacasyā kāmena kṛto abhyānaḷarkam | sa no rāsacchurudhaścandrāgrā dhiyaṃdhiyaṃ sīṣadhāti pra pūṣā ||

translations.english: May (the worshipper), influenced by the hope (of reward), approach with praise the adorable (Pūṣan), protector of all path; may he bestow upon us cows with golden horns; may Pūṣan bring to perfection our every rite.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रथमभाजं यशसं वयोधां सुपाणिं देवं सुगभस्तिमृभ्वम् । होता यक्षद्यजतं पस्त्यानामग्निस्त्वष्टारं सुहवं विभावा ॥
mantras.transliteration: prathamabhājaṃ yaśasaṃ vayodhāṃ supāṇiṃ devaṃ sugabhastimṛbhvam | hotā yakṣadyajataṃ pastyānāmagnistvaṣṭāraṃ suhavaṃ vibhāvā ||

translations.english: May the illustrious Agni, the invoker of the gods, worship (with this oblation), Tvaṣṭā, the first divider (of forms), the renowned, the giver of food, the well-handed, the vast, the adored of householders, the readily invoked.

mantras.sanskrit: भुवनस्य पितरं गीर्भिराभी रुद्रं दिवा वर्धया रुद्रमक्तौ । बृहन्तमृष्वमजरं सुषुम्नमृधग्घुवेम कविनेषितासः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhuvanasya pitaraṃ gīrbhirābhī rudraṃ divā vardhayā rudramaktau | bṛhantamṛṣvamajaraṃ suṣumnamṛdhagghuvema kavineṣitāsaḥ ||

translations.english: Exalt Rudra, the parent of the world, with these hmns by day; (exalt) Rudra (with them) by night; animated by the far-seeing, we invoke him, mighty, of plural asing aspect, undecaying, endowed with felicity, (the source of) prosperity.

mantras.sanskrit: आ युवानः कवयो यज्ञियासो मरुतो गन्त गृणतो वरस्याम् । अचित्रं चिद्धि जिन्वथा वृधन्त इत्था नक्षन्तो नरो अङ्गिरस्वत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yuvānaḥ kavayo yajñiyāso maruto ganta gṛṇato varasyām | acitraṃ ciddhi jinvathā vṛdhanta itthā nakṣanto naro aṅgirasvat ||

translations.english: Ever youthful wise, and adorable Maruts, come to the praise of your adorer; thus augmenting, leaders (of rites), and spreading (through the firmament), like rays (of light), refresh the scanty woods (with rain).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वीराय प्र तवसे तुरायाजा यूथेव पशुरक्षिरस्तम् । स पिस्पृशति तन्वि श्रुतस्य स्तृभिर्न नाकं वचनस्य विपः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vīrāya pra tavase turāyājā yūtheva paśurakṣirastam | sa pispṛśati tanvi śrutasya stṛbhirna nākaṃ vacanasya vipaḥ ||

translations.english: Offer adoration to the valiant, powerful, swift-movig (company of the Maruts), as the herdsman (drives his) herd to their stall; may that (company) appropriate to its own body the praises of the pious worshipper, as the firmament (is studded) with stars.

mantras.sanskrit: यो रजांसि विममे पार्थिवानि त्रिश्चिद्विष्णुर्मनवे बाधिताय । तस्य ते शर्मन्नुपदद्यमाने राया मदेम तन्वा तना च ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo rajāṃsi vimame pārthivāni triścidviṣṇurmanave bādhitāya | tasya te śarmannupadadyamāne rāyā madema tanvā tanā ca ||

translations.english: May we be happy in a home, in riches, in person nn, in children, bestowd upon us by you, Viṣṇu, who with three (steps) made the terrestrial reions for Manu when harassed (by the asuras).

mantras.sanskrit: तन्नोऽहिर्बुध्न्यो अद्भिरर्कैस्तत्पर्वतस्तत्सविता चनो धात् । तदोषधीभिरभि रातिषाचो भगः पुरंधिर्जिन्वतु प्र राये ॥
mantras.transliteration: tanno'hirbudhnyo adbhirarkaistatparvatastatsavitā cano dhāt | tadoṣadhībhirabhi rātiṣāco bhagaḥ puraṃdhirjinvatu pra rāye ||

translations.english: May Ahirbudhnya (propitiated) by (our) hymns, and Parvata and Savitā give us food with water; may the bountiful (gods supply us), addition, with vegetable (grains); and may the all-wise Bhaga be propitious (to us) for (the acquisition of) riches.

mantras.sanskrit: नु नो रयिं रथ्यं चर्षणिप्रां पुरुवीरं मह ऋतस्य गोपाम् । क्षयं दाताजरं येन जनान्त्स्पृधो अदेवीरभि च क्रमाम विश आदेवीरभ्यश्नवाम ॥
mantras.transliteration: nu no rayiṃ rathyaṃ carṣaṇiprāṃ puruvīraṃ maha ṛtasya gopām | kṣayaṃ dātājaraṃ yena janāntspṛdho adevīrabhi ca kramāma viśa ādevīrabhyaśnavāma ||

translations.english: Grant us, (universal gods), riches, comprehending chariots, numerous dependants, many male offspring, (wealth) the giver of efficiency to the solemn rite, and a dwelling free from decay, wherewith we may overcome malevolent men and unrighteous (spirits), and afford support to those people who are devoted to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: हुवे वो देवीमदितिं नमोभिर्मृळीकाय वरुणं मित्रमग्निम् । अभिक्षदामर्यमणं सुशेवं त्रातॄन्देवान्त्सवितारं भगं च ॥
mantras.transliteration: huve vo devīmaditiṃ namobhirmṛḷīkāya varuṇaṃ mitramagnim | abhikṣadāmaryamaṇaṃ suśevaṃ trātṝndevāntsavitāraṃ bhagaṃ ca ||

translations.english: I invoke with adorations, for the sake of felicity, the divine Aditi ad Varuṇa, Mitra and Agni, Aryaman, the overthrower of foes, worthy of devotion, Savitā and Bhaga, and (all) protecting divinities.

mantras.sanskrit: सुज्योतिषः सूर्य दक्षपितॄननागास्त्वे सुमहो वीहि देवान् । द्विजन्मानो य ऋतसापः सत्याः स्वर्वन्तो यजता अग्निजिह्वाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sujyotiṣaḥ sūrya dakṣapitṝnanāgāstve sumaho vīhi devān | dvijanmāno ya ṛtasāpaḥ satyāḥ svarvanto yajatā agnijihvāḥ ||

translations.english: Radiant Sūrya, render the luminous deiies, who have Dakṣa for their progenitor, void of offence towards us; they who are twice born, desirous of sacrifice, observant of truth, possessors of wealth, deserving of worship, whose tongue is Agni.

mantras.sanskrit: उत द्यावापृथिवी क्षत्रमुरु बृहद्रोदसी शरणं सुषुम्ने । महस्करथो वरिवो यथा नोऽस्मे क्षयाय धिषणे अनेहः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta dyāvāpṛthivī kṣatramuru bṛhadrodasī śaraṇaṃ suṣumne | mahaskaratho varivo yathā no'sme kṣayāya dhiṣaṇe anehaḥ ||

translations.english: Or bestow, Heaven and Earth, vast strength; give us, Earth and Heaven, a spacious habitation for our comfort; so arrange, that infinite wealth may be ours, remove, beneficent deities, iniquity from our abode.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो रुद्रस्य सूनवो नमन्तामद्या हूतासो वसवोऽधृष्टाः । यदीमर्भे महति वा हितासो बाधे मरुतो अह्वाम देवान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no rudrasya sūnavo namantāmadyā hūtāso vasavo'dhṛṣṭāḥ | yadīmarbhe mahati vā hitāso bādhe maruto ahvāma devān ||

translations.english: May the sons of Rudra, givers of dwellings, the unsubdued, invoked on this occasion, stoop down to us, inasmuch as we call upon the divine Maruts that they may be our helpers in difficulty, great or small.

mantras.sanskrit: मिम्यक्ष येषु रोदसी नु देवी सिषक्ति पूषा अभ्यर्धयज्वा । श्रुत्वा हवं मरुतो यद्ध याथ भूमा रेजन्ते अध्वनि प्रविक्ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: mimyakṣa yeṣu rodasī nu devī siṣakti pūṣā abhyardhayajvā | śrutvā havaṃ maruto yaddha yātha bhūmā rejante adhvani pravikte ||

translations.english: With whom the divine Heaven and Earth are associated; whom Pūṣan, the rewarder (of his worshippers) with prosperity, honours; when, Maruts, having heard our invocation, you come hither, then on your several paths all beings tremble.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि त्यं वीरं गिर्वणसमर्चेन्द्रं ब्रह्मणा जरितर्नवेन । श्रवदिद्धवमुप च स्तवानो रासद्वाजाँ उप महो गृणानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi tyaṃ vīraṃ girvaṇasamarcendraṃ brahmaṇā jaritarnavena | śravadiddhavamupa ca stavāno rāsadvājā~ upa maho gṛṇānaḥ ||

translations.english: Praise, worshipper, with a new hymn, that hero, Indra, who is deserving of praise; may he, so glorified hear our invocation; may he, so lauded, bestow upon us abundant food.

mantras.sanskrit: ओमानमापो मानुषीरमृक्तं धात तोकाय तनयाय शं योः । यूयं हि ष्ठा भिषजो मातृतमा विश्वस्य स्थातुर्जगतो जनित्रीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: omānamāpo mānuṣīramṛktaṃ dhāta tokāya tanayāya śaṃ yoḥ | yūyaṃ hi ṣṭhā bhiṣajo mātṛtamā viśvasya sthāturjagato janitrīḥ ||

translations.english: Waters, friendly to mankind, grant uninterrupted (life) preserving (food) for (the perpetuation of our) sons and grandsons; grant us security and the removal (of all evil), for you are more than maternal physicians; you are the parents of the stationary and moveable universe.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो देवः सविता त्रायमाणो हिरण्यपाणिर्यजतो जगम्यात् । यो दत्रवाँ उषसो न प्रतीकं व्यूर्णुते दाशुषे वार्याणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no devaḥ savitā trāyamāṇo hiraṇyapāṇiryajato jagamyāt | yo datravā~ uṣaso na pratīkaṃ vyūrṇute dāśuṣe vāryāṇi ||

translations.english: May the adorable, golden-handed Savitā, the preserver, come to us; he, the munificent, who, like the opening of the dawn, displays desirable (riches) to the offerer of the oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्वं सूनो सहसो नो अद्या देवाँ अस्मिन्नध्वरे ववृत्याः । स्यामहं ते सदमिद्रातौ तव स्यामग्नेऽवसा सुवीरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tvaṃ sūno sahaso no adyā devā~ asminnadhvare vavṛtyāḥ | syāmahaṃ te sadamidrātau tava syāmagne'vasā suvīraḥ ||

translations.english: And do you, son of strength, bring back today the deities to this our sacrifice; may  I be ever in (the enoyment of) your bounty; may I, through your protection, Agni, be blessed with excellent male descendants.

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्या मे हवमा जग्म्यातं नासत्या धीभिर्युवमङ्ग विप्रा । अत्रिं न महस्तमसोऽमुमुक्तं तूर्वतं नरा दुरितादभीके ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tyā me havamā jagmyātaṃ nāsatyā dhībhiryuvamaṅga viprā | atriṃ na mahastamaso'mumuktaṃ tūrvataṃ narā duritādabhīke ||

translations.english: Wise Nāsatyās come quickly to my invocation (united) with holy acts; (extricate us) from thick darkness, as you did extricate Atri; protect us, leaders (of rites) from danger in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: ते नो रायो द्युमतो वाजवतो दातारो भूत नृवतः पुरुक्षोः । दशस्यन्तो दिव्याः पार्थिवासो गोजाता अप्या मृळता च देवाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te no rāyo dyumato vājavato dātāro bhūta nṛvataḥ purukṣoḥ | daśasyanto divyāḥ pārthivāso gojātā apyā mṛḷatā ca devāḥ ||

translations.english: Be unto us, gods, donors of splendid, invigorating riches, comprising male descendants, and celebrated by many; celestial Ādityas, terrestrial Vasus, offspring of Pṛśni, children of the waters, granting our desires, make us happy.

mantras.sanskrit: ते नो रुद्रः सरस्वती सजोषा मीळ्हुष्मन्तो विष्णुर्मृळन्तु वायुः । ऋभुक्षा वाजो दैव्यो विधाता पर्जन्यावाता पिप्यतामिषं नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te no rudraḥ sarasvatī sajoṣā mīḷhuṣmanto viṣṇurmṛḷantu vāyuḥ | ṛbhukṣā vājo daivyo vidhātā parjanyāvātā pipyatāmiṣaṃ naḥ ||

translations.english: May Rudra and Sarasvatī, alike well plural ased and Viṣṇu and Vāyu, make us happy, sending rain; and Ribhukṣin, and Vāja, and the divine Vidhātā; and may Parjanya and Vāta grant us abundant food.

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्य देवः सविता भगो नोऽपां नपादवतु दानु पप्रिः । त्वष्टा देवेभिर्जनिभिः सजोषा द्यौर्देवेभिः पृथिवी समुद्रैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta sya devaḥ savitā bhago no'pāṃ napādavatu dānu papriḥ | tvaṣṭā devebhirjanibhiḥ sajoṣā dyaurdevebhiḥ pṛthivī samudraiḥ ||

translations.english: And may the divine Savitā and Bhaga, and the grandson of the waters, (Agni), the prodigal of gifts, preserve us; and may Tvaṣṭā with the gods, and Earth with the seas, (preserve us).

mantras.sanskrit: उत नोऽहिर्बुध्न्यः शृणोत्वज एकपात्पृथिवी समुद्रः । विश्वे देवा ऋतावृधो हुवानाः स्तुता मन्त्राः कविशस्ता अवन्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta no'hirbudhnyaḥ śṛṇotvaja ekapātpṛthivī samudraḥ | viśve devā ṛtāvṛdho huvānāḥ stutā mantrāḥ kaviśastā avantu ||

translations.english: May Ahirbudhnya, Aja-ekapād, and Earth and Ocean, hear us; may the universal gods, who are exalted by sacrifice, they who are invoked and praised (by us), to whom mystical prayers are addressed, and who have been glorified by (ancient) sages, preserve us.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा नपातो मम तस्य धीभिर्भरद्वाजा अभ्यर्चन्त्यर्कैः । ग्ना हुतासो वसवोऽधृष्टा विश्वे स्तुतासो भूता यजत्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā napāto mama tasya dhībhirbharadvājā abhyarcantyarkaiḥ | gnā hutāso vasavo'dhṛṣṭā viśve stutāso bhūtā yajatrāḥ ||

translations.english: Thus do my sons, of the race of Bharadvāja, worship the gods with sacred rites and holy hymns; and so, adorable (deities), may you, who are worshipped and glorified, the givers of dwellings, the invincible, universal gods, ever be adored, (together with your) wives.

mantras.sanskrit: उदु त्यच्चक्षुर्महि मित्रयोराँ एति प्रियं वरुणयोरदब्धम् । ऋतस्य शुचि दर्शतमनीकं रुक्मो न दिव उदिता व्यद्यौत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: udu tyaccakṣurmahi mitrayorā~ eti priyaṃ varuṇayoradabdham | ṛtasya śuci darśatamanīkaṃ rukmo na diva uditā vyadyaut ||

translations.english: The expansive, illuminating, unobstructive, pure, and beautiful radiance of the sun, grateful to Mitra and Varuṇa, having risen, shines like the ornament of the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: वेद यस्त्रीणि विदथान्येषां देवानां जन्म सनुतरा च विप्रः । ऋजु मर्तेषु वृजिना च पश्यन्नभि चष्टे सूरो अर्य एवान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: veda yastrīṇi vidathānyeṣāṃ devānāṃ janma sanutarā ca vipraḥ | ṛju marteṣu vṛjinā ca paśyannabhi caṣṭe sūro arya evān ||

translations.english: He who knows the three cognizable (worlds); the sage (who knows) the mysterious birth of the divinities (abiding in them); he who is beholding the good and evil acts of mortals, he, the sun, the lord, makes manifest their intentions.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तुष उ वो मह ऋतस्य गोपानदितिं मित्रं वरुणं सुजातान् । अर्यमणं भगमदब्धधीतीनच्छा वोचे सधन्यः पावकान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: stuṣa u vo maha ṛtasya gopānaditiṃ mitraṃ varuṇaṃ sujātān | aryamaṇaṃ bhagamadabdhadhītīnacchā voce sadhanyaḥ pāvakān ||

translations.english: I praise you, protectors of the solemn sacrifice, the well-born Aditi, Mitra and Varuṇa and Aryaman and Bhaga; I celebrate the gods whose acts are unimpeded, the bestowers of wealth, the dispensers of purity.

mantras.sanskrit: रिशादसः सत्पतीँरदब्धान्महो राज्ञः सुवसनस्य दातॄन् । यूनः सुक्षत्रान्क्षयतो दिवो नॄनादित्यान्याम्यदितिं दुवोयु ॥
mantras.transliteration: riśādasaḥ satpatī~radabdhānmaho rājñaḥ suvasanasya dātṝn | yūnaḥ sukṣatrānkṣayato divo nṝnādityānyāmyaditiṃ duvoyu ||

translations.english: The scatterers of the malevolent, the defenders of the virtuous, the irresistible, the mighty lords, the donors of good dwellings, ever young, very powerful, omnipresent, leader of heaven, the sons of Āditya; I have recourse to Aditi, who is gratified by mine adoration.

mantras.sanskrit: द्यौष्पितः पृथिवि मातरध्रुगग्ने भ्रातर्वसवो मृळता नः । विश्व आदित्या अदिते सजोषा अस्मभ्यं शर्म बहुलं वि यन्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: dyauṣpitaḥ pṛthivi mātaradhrugagne bhrātarvasavo mṛḷatā naḥ | viśva ādityā adite sajoṣā asmabhyaṃ śarma bahulaṃ vi yanta ||

translations.english: Father Heaven, innocent mother Earth, brother Agni, and you, Vasus, grant us happiness; all you sons of Aditi, and you Aditi, alike well-plural ased, bestow upon us ample felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नो वृकाय वृक्ये समस्मा अघायते रीरधता यजत्राः । यूयं हि ष्ठा रथ्यो नस्तनूनां यूयं दक्षस्य वचसो बभूव ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā no vṛkāya vṛkye samasmā aghāyate rīradhatā yajatrāḥ | yūyaṃ hi ṣṭhā rathyo nastanūnāṃ yūyaṃ dakṣasya vacaso babhūva ||

translations.english: Subject us not, adorable (deities), to the robber or his wife; not to any one designing us harm; for you are the regulators of our person ns, of our strength, of our speech.

mantras.sanskrit: मा व एनो अन्यकृतं भुजेम मा तत्कर्म वसवो यच्चयध्वे । विश्वस्य हि क्षयथ विश्वदेवाः स्वयं रिपुस्तन्वं रीरिषीष्ट ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā va eno anyakṛtaṃ bhujema mā tatkarma vasavo yaccayadhve | viśvasya hi kṣayatha viśvadevāḥ svayaṃ ripustanvaṃ rīriṣīṣṭa ||

translations.english: Let us not suffer for the sin committed by another; let us not do that which, Vasus, you prohibit; you rule universal gods, over the universe; (so provide that) mine enemy may inflict injury on his own person n.

mantras.sanskrit: नम इदुग्रं नम आ विवासे नमो दाधार पृथिवीमुत द्याम् । नमो देवेभ्यो नम ईश एषां कृतं चिदेनो नमसा विवासे ॥
mantras.transliteration: nama idugraṃ nama ā vivāse namo dādhāra pṛthivīmuta dyām | namo devebhyo nama īśa eṣāṃ kṛtaṃ cideno namasā vivāse ||

translations.english: Reverence be to the potent (company of universal gods); I offer (them) reverence; reverence sustains both earth and heaven; revernce be to the gods; reverence is sovereign over them; I expiate by reverence whatever sin may have been committed.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतस्य वो रथ्यः पूतदक्षानृतस्य पस्त्यसदो अदब्धान् । ताँ आ नमोभिरुरुचक्षसो नॄन्विश्वान्व आ नमे महो यजत्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtasya vo rathyaḥ pūtadakṣānṛtasya pastyasado adabdhān | tā~ ā namobhirurucakṣaso nṝnviśvānva ā name maho yajatrāḥ ||

translations.english: Adorable (deities), I venerate with reverential salutations all you who are mighty, the mighty, the regulators of your sacrifice, of pure vigour, dwellers in the chamber of worship, unsubdued, far-seeing, leaders (of rites).

mantras.sanskrit: ते हि श्रेष्ठवर्चसस्त उ नस्तिरो विश्वानि दुरिता नयन्ति । सुक्षत्रासो वरुणो मित्रो अग्निॠतधीतयो वक्मराजसत्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te hi śreṣṭhavarcasasta u nastiro viśvāni duritā nayanti | sukṣatrāso varuṇo mitro agniṝtadhītayo vakmarājasatyāḥ ||

translations.english: May they, exceeding in splendour, so guide us, that all iniquities may disappear, they, the very powerful Varuṇa, Mitra, Agni, practisers of truth, and faithful to those who are prominent in (their) praise.

mantras.sanskrit: ते न इन्द्रः पृथिवी क्षाम वर्धन्पूषा भगो अदितिः पञ्च जनाः । सुशर्माणः स्ववसः सुनीथा भवन्तु नः सुत्रात्रासः सुगोपाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te na indraḥ pṛthivī kṣāma vardhanpūṣā bhago aditiḥ pañca janāḥ | suśarmāṇaḥ svavasaḥ sunīthā bhavantu naḥ sutrātrāsaḥ sugopāḥ ||

translations.english: May they, Indra, Earth, Pūṣan, Bhaga, Aditi and the five orders of beings, give increase to our habitations; may they be to us granters of happiness, bestowers of food, guides to good, our gracious defenders and preservers.

mantras.sanskrit: नू सद्मानं दिव्यं नंशि देवा भारद्वाजः सुमतिं याति होता । आसानेभिर्यजमानो मियेधैर्देवानां जन्म वसूयुर्ववन्द ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū sadmānaṃ divyaṃ naṃśi devā bhāradvājaḥ sumatiṃ yāti hotā | āsānebhiryajamāno miyedhairdevānāṃ janma vasūyurvavanda ||

translations.english: May the preseenter of the oblation, Bharadvāja, quickly obtain, gods, a celestial abode, as he solicits your good-will; the instrumental tutor of the ceremony, together with pious associates, desirous of riches, glorifies the assembly of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: अप त्यं वृजिनं रिपुं स्तेनमग्ने दुराध्यम् । दविष्ठमस्य सत्पते कृधी सुगम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: apa tyaṃ vṛjinaṃ ripuṃ stenamagne durādhyam | daviṣṭhamasya satpate kṛdhī sugam ||

translations.english: Drive away, Agni, to a distance the wicked, felonious, malignant enemy; grant us felicity, protector of the virtuous.

mantras.sanskrit: ग्रावाणः सोम नो हि कं सखित्वनाय वावशुः । जही न्यत्रिणं पणिं वृको हि षः ॥
mantras.transliteration: grāvāṇaḥ soma no hi kaṃ sakhitvanāya vāvaśuḥ | jahī nyatriṇaṃ paṇiṃ vṛko hi ṣaḥ ||

translations.english: These our grinding stones are anxious, Soma, for your friendship; destroy the voracious Paṇi, for verily he is a wolf.

mantras.sanskrit: यूयं हि ष्ठा सुदानव इन्द्रज्येष्ठा अभिद्यवः । कर्ता नो अध्वन्ना सुगं गोपा अमा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yūyaṃ hi ṣṭhā sudānava indrajyeṣṭhā abhidyavaḥ | kartā no adhvannā sugaṃ gopā amā ||

translations.english: You are munificent and illustrious, gods, with Indra for your chief, be with us, protectors, on the road, and grant us happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: अपि पन्थामगन्महि स्वस्तिगामनेहसम् । येन विश्वाः परि द्विषो वृणक्ति विन्दते वसु ॥
mantras.transliteration: api panthāmaganmahi svastigāmanehasam | yena viśvāḥ pari dviṣo vṛṇakti vindate vasu ||

translations.english: We have travelled along the road prosperously traversed and free from evil, and by which (a man) avoids adversaries and acquires wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: न तद्दिवा न पृथिव्यानु मन्ये न यज्ञेन नोत शमीभिराभिः । उब्जन्तु तं सुभ्वः पर्वतासो नि हीयतामतियाजस्य यष्टा ॥
mantras.transliteration: na taddivā na pṛthivyānu manye na yajñena nota śamībhirābhiḥ | ubjantu taṃ subhvaḥ parvatāso ni hīyatāmatiyājasya yaṣṭā ||

translations.english: I do not regard it as worthy (of the gods) of heaven, or (those) of earth, as (fit to be compared) with the sacrifice (I offer) or with these (our) sacred rites; let, then, the mighty mountains overhelm him; let the employer of Atiyāja be ever degraded.

mantras.sanskrit: अति वा यो मरुतो मन्यते नो ब्रह्म वा यः क्रियमाणं निनित्सात् । तपूंषि तस्मै वृजिनानि सन्तु ब्रह्मद्विषमभि तं शोचतु द्यौः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ati vā yo maruto manyate no brahma vā yaḥ kriyamāṇaṃ ninitsāt | tapūṃṣi tasmai vṛjināni santu brahmadviṣamabhi taṃ śocatu dyauḥ ||

translations.english: Maruts, may the energies of that man be enfeebled; may heaven consume that impious adversary who thinks himself superior to us, and who pretends to deprecate the worship that we offer.

mantras.sanskrit: किमङ्ग त्वा ब्रह्मणः सोम गोपां किमङ्ग त्वाहुरभिशस्तिपां नः । किमङ्ग नः पश्यसि निद्यमानान्ब्रह्मद्विषे तपुषिं हेतिमस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: kimaṅga tvā brahmaṇaḥ soma gopāṃ kimaṅga tvāhurabhiśastipāṃ naḥ | kimaṅga naḥ paśyasi nidyamānānbrahmadviṣe tapuṣiṃ hetimasya ||

translations.english: Why have they called you, Soma, the protector of pious prayer? Why (have they called you) our defender against calumny? Why do you behold us subjected to reproach? Cast your destroying weapon upon the adversary of the brahman.

mantras.sanskrit: अवन्तु मामुषसो जायमाना अवन्तु मा सिन्धवः पिन्वमानाः । अवन्तु मा पर्वतासो ध्रुवासोऽवन्तु मा पितरो देवहूतौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: avantu māmuṣaso jāyamānā avantu mā sindhavaḥ pinvamānāḥ | avantu mā parvatāso dhruvāso'vantu mā pitaro devahūtau ||

translations.english: May the opening dawns preserve me; may the swelling rivers preserve me; may the firm-set mountains preserve me; may the progenitors (present) at the invocation of the gods preserve me.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वदानीं सुमनसः स्याम पश्येम नु सूर्यमुच्चरन्तम् । तथा करद्वसुपतिर्वसूनां देवाँ ओहानोऽवसागमिष्ठः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvadānīṃ sumanasaḥ syāma paśyema nu sūryamuccarantam | tathā karadvasupatirvasūnāṃ devā~ ohāno'vasāgamiṣṭhaḥ ||

translations.english: May we at all seasons be possessed of sound minds; may we ever behold the rising sun; such may the affluent lord of riches, (Agni), render us, ever most ready to come (at our invocation), charged with our oblation to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रो नेदिष्ठमवसागमिष्ठः सरस्वती सिन्धुभिः पिन्वमाना । पर्जन्यो न ओषधीभिर्मयोभुरग्निः सुशंसः सुहवः पितेव ॥
mantras.transliteration: indro nediṣṭhamavasāgamiṣṭhaḥ sarasvatī sindhubhiḥ pinvamānā | parjanyo na oṣadhībhirmayobhuragniḥ suśaṃsaḥ suhavaḥ piteva ||

translations.english: May Indra be most prompt to come nigh for our protection, and Sarasvatī dwelling with (tributary) rivers; may Parjanya, with the plural nts, be a giver of happiness; and may Agni, worthily praised and earnestly invoked, (be to us) like a father.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वे देवास आ गत शृणुता म इमं हवम् । एदं बर्हिर्नि षीदत ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśve devāsa ā gata śṛṇutā ma imaṃ havam | edaṃ barhirni ṣīdata ||

translations.english: Come, universal gods, hear this my invocationl; sit down upon this sacred grass.

mantras.sanskrit: यो वो देवा घृतस्नुना हव्येन प्रतिभूषति । तं विश्व उप गच्छथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo vo devā ghṛtasnunā havyena pratibhūṣati | taṃ viśva upa gacchatha ||

translations.english: Come, gods, to him who honours you with the butter drippling oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: उप नः सूनवो गिरः शृण्वन्त्वमृतस्य ये । सुमृळीका भवन्तु नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa naḥ sūnavo giraḥ śṛṇvantvamṛtasya ye | sumṛḷīkā bhavantu naḥ ||

translations.english: May the sons of the immortal hear our praises, and be to us the givers of felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वे देवा ऋतावृध ऋतुभिर्हवनश्रुतः । जुषन्तां युज्यं पयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśve devā ṛtāvṛdha ṛtubhirhavanaśrutaḥ | juṣantāṃ yujyaṃ payaḥ ||

translations.english: Universal gods, augmenters of sacrifice, listening to praises (uttered) at due seasons, accept your appropriate milk-offering.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तोत्रमिन्द्रो मरुद्गणस्त्वष्टृमान्मित्रो अर्यमा । इमा हव्या जुषन्त नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: stotramindro marudgaṇastvaṣṭṛmānmitro aryamā | imā havyā juṣanta naḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, with the company of the Maruts, Mitra, with Tvaṣṭā and Aryaman, accept our praise and these our oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: इमं नो अग्ने अध्वरं होतर्वयुनशो यज । चिकित्वान्दैव्यं जनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: imaṃ no agne adhvaraṃ hotarvayunaśo yaja | cikitvāndaivyaṃ janam ||

translations.english: Agni, invoker of the gods, cognizant (which of) the divine assembly (is he honoured), offer this our sacrifice according to the proper order.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वे देवाः शृणुतेमं हवं मे ये अन्तरिक्षे य उप द्यवि ष्ठ । ये अग्निजिह्वा उत वा यजत्रा आसद्यास्मिन्बर्हिषि मादयध्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśve devāḥ śṛṇutemaṃ havaṃ me ye antarikṣe ya upa dyavi ṣṭha | ye agnijihvā uta vā yajatrā āsadyāsminbarhiṣi mādayadhvam ||

translations.english: Universal gods, hear this my invocation, whether you be in the firmament or in the heaven; you who (receive oblations) by the tongue of Agni, or are to be (otherwise) worshipped; seated on this sacred grass, be exhilarated (by the Soma).

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वे देवा मम शृण्वन्तु यज्ञिया उभे रोदसी अपां नपाच्च मन्म । मा वो वचांसि परिचक्ष्याणि वोचं सुम्नेष्विद्वो अन्तमा मदेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśve devā mama śṛṇvantu yajñiyā ubhe rodasī apāṃ napācca manma | mā vo vacāṃsi paricakṣyāṇi vocaṃ sumneṣvidvo antamā madema ||

translations.english: May the adorable, universal deities, and both heaven and earth, and the grandson, of the waters, hear my praise; let me not utter words to be disregarded, but let us, (brought) most nigh unto you, rejoice in the happiness (you bestow).

mantras.sanskrit: ये के च ज्मा महिनो अहिमाया दिवो जज्ञिरे अपां सधस्थे । ते अस्मभ्यमिषये विश्वमायुः क्षप उस्रा वरिवस्यन्तु देवाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye ke ca jmā mahino ahimāyā divo jajñire apāṃ sadhasthe | te asmabhyamiṣaye viśvamāyuḥ kṣapa usrā varivasyantu devāḥ ||

translations.english: May those mighty deities, having power to destroy, whether they have been manifested upon earth or in heaven, or in the abode of the waters, bestow upon us and our posterity abundant sustenance both by night and day.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्नीपर्जन्याववतं धियं मेऽस्मिन्हवे सुहवा सुष्टुतिं नः । इळामन्यो जनयद्गर्भमन्यः प्रजावतीरिष आ धत्तमस्मे ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnīparjanyāvavataṃ dhiyaṃ me'sminhave suhavā suṣṭutiṃ naḥ | iḷāmanyo janayadgarbhamanyaḥ prajāvatīriṣa ā dhattamasme ||

translations.english: Agni and Parjanya, prosper my pious acts; (accept), you who are reverently invoked, our praise at this sacrifice; one of you genitive rates food, the other posterity; grant us, therefore, food productive of descendants.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तीर्णे बर्हिषि समिधाने अग्नौ सूक्तेन महा नमसा विवासे । अस्मिन्नो अद्य विदथे यजत्रा विश्वे देवा हविषि मादयध्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: stīrṇe barhiṣi samidhāne agnau sūktena mahā namasā vivāse | asminno adya vidathe yajatrā viśve devā haviṣi mādayadhvam ||

translations.english: When the sacred grass is strewn, when the fire is kindled, and when I worship (you) with a hymn, and with profound veneration, then, adorable universal gods, rejoice in the oblation (offered) today at this our sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: वयमु त्वा पथस्पते रथं न वाजसातये । धिये पूषन्नयुज्महि ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayamu tvā pathaspate rathaṃ na vājasātaye | dhiye pūṣannayujmahi ||

translations.english: Pūṣan, lord of paths, we attach you to us like a chariot, for (the sake of) bringing food, and of (accomplishing our) solemnity.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि नो नर्यं वसु वीरं प्रयतदक्षिणम् । वामं गृहपतिं नय ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi no naryaṃ vasu vīraṃ prayatadakṣiṇam | vāmaṃ gṛhapatiṃ naya ||

translations.english: Conduct us to a gracious householder, friendly to men, liberal in (bestowing) wealth, the giver of pious donations.

mantras.sanskrit: अदित्सन्तं चिदाघृणे पूषन्दानाय चोदय । पणेश्चिद्वि म्रदा मनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aditsantaṃ cidāghṛṇe pūṣandānāya codaya | paṇeścidvi mradā manaḥ ||

translations.english: Resplendent Pūṣan, instrumental gate the niggard to liberality, soften the heart of the miser.

mantras.sanskrit: वि पथो वाजसातये चिनुहि वि मृधो जहि । साधन्तामुग्र नो धियः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi patho vājasātaye cinuhi vi mṛdho jahi | sādhantāmugra no dhiyaḥ ||

translations.english: Pierce Pūṣan, select (fit) roads for the passage of provisions; drive away all obstructors, (thieves, or the like), so that our holy rites may be accomplished.

mantras.sanskrit: परि तृन्धि पणीनामारया हृदया कवे । अथेमस्मभ्यं रन्धय ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari tṛndhi paṇīnāmārayā hṛdayā kave | athemasmabhyaṃ randhaya ||

translations.english: Pierce with a goad the hearts of the avaricious, wise Pūṣan, and so render them complacent towards us.

mantras.sanskrit: वि पूषन्नारया तुद पणेरिच्छ हृदि प्रियम् । अथेमस्मभ्यं रन्धय ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi pūṣannārayā tuda paṇericcha hṛdi priyam | athemasmabhyaṃ randhaya ||

translations.english: Pierce with a goad, Pūṣan, the heart of the avaricious; genitive rate genitive rosity in his heart, and so render him complacent towards us.

mantras.sanskrit: आ रिख किकिरा कृणु पणीनां हृदया कवे । अथेमस्मभ्यं रन्धय ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā rikha kikirā kṛṇu paṇīnāṃ hṛdayā kave | athemasmabhyaṃ randhaya ||

translations.english: Abrade, wise Pūṣan, the hearts of the avaricious; relax (their hardness), and so render them complacent towards us.

mantras.sanskrit: यां पूषन्ब्रह्मचोदनीमारां बिभर्ष्याघृणे । तया समस्य हृदयमा रिख किकिरा कृणु ॥
mantras.transliteration: yāṃ pūṣanbrahmacodanīmārāṃ bibharṣyāghṛṇe | tayā samasya hṛdayamā rikha kikirā kṛṇu ||

translations.english: Resplendent Pūṣan, with that food-propelling goad which you bear, abrade the heart of every miser, and render it relaxed.

mantras.sanskrit: या ते अष्ट्रा गोपशाघृणे पशुसाधनी । तस्यास्ते सुम्नमीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā te aṣṭrā gopaśāghṛṇe paśusādhanī | tasyāste sumnamīmahe ||

translations.english: Resplendent Pūṣan, we ask of you the service of that your weapon, which is the guide of cows, the director of cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: उत नो गोषणिं धियमश्वसां वाजसामुत । नृवत्कृणुहि वीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta no goṣaṇiṃ dhiyamaśvasāṃ vājasāmuta | nṛvatkṛṇuhi vītaye ||

translations.english: Make our pious worship productive of cows, of horses, of food, of dependants, for our enjoyment.

mantras.sanskrit: सं पूषन्विदुषा नय यो अञ्जसानुशासति । य एवेदमिति ब्रवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ pūṣanviduṣā naya yo añjasānuśāsati | ya evedamiti bravat ||

translations.english: Bring us, Pūṣan, into communication with a wise man who may rightly direct us, who may even say, this is so.

mantras.sanskrit: समु पूष्णा गमेमहि यो गृहाँ अभिशासति । इम एवेति च ब्रवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: samu pūṣṇā gamemahi yo gṛhā~ abhiśāsati | ima eveti ca bravat ||

translations.english: May we, by the favour of Pūṣan, come in communication with (the man) who may direct us to the houses (where our goods are secreted), and may say, verily these are they.

mantras.sanskrit: पूष्णश्चक्रं न रिष्यति न कोशोऽव पद्यते । नो अस्य व्यथते पविः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pūṣṇaścakraṃ na riṣyati na kośo'va padyate | no asya vyathate paviḥ ||

translations.english: The discus of Pūṣan does not destroy; its sheath is not discarded, its edge harms not us.

mantras.sanskrit: यो अस्मै हविषाविधन्न तं पूषापि मृष्यते । प्रथमो विन्दते वसु ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo asmai haviṣāvidhanna taṃ pūṣāpi mṛṣyate | prathamo vindate vasu ||

translations.english: Pūṣan inflicts not the least injury on the man who propitiates him by oblations; he is the first who acquires wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: पूषा गा अन्वेतु नः पूषा रक्षत्वर्वतः । पूषा वाजं सनोतु नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pūṣā gā anvetu naḥ pūṣā rakṣatvarvataḥ | pūṣā vājaṃ sanotu naḥ ||

translations.english: May Pūṣan come to (guard) our cattle, ma Pūṣan protect our horses; may Pūṣan give us food.

mantras.sanskrit: पूषन्ननु प्र गा इहि यजमानस्य सुन्वतः । अस्माकं स्तुवतामुत ॥
mantras.transliteration: pūṣannanu pra gā ihi yajamānasya sunvataḥ | asmākaṃ stuvatāmuta ||

translations.english: Come, Pūṣan, to (guard) the cattle of the instrumental tutor of the rite presenting libations, and also of us repeating (your) praises.

mantras.sanskrit: माकिर्नेशन्माकीं रिषन्माकीं सं शारि केवटे । अथारिष्टाभिरा गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: mākirneśanmākīṃ riṣanmākīṃ saṃ śāri kevaṭe | athāriṣṭābhirā gahi ||

translations.english: Let not, Pūṣan, our cattle perish; let them not be injured; let them not be hurt by falling into a well; come, therefore, along with them unharmed.

mantras.sanskrit: शृण्वन्तं पूषणं वयमिर्यमनष्टवेदसम् । ईशानं राय ईमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: śṛṇvantaṃ pūṣaṇaṃ vayamiryamanaṣṭavedasam | īśānaṃ rāya īmahe ||

translations.english: We solicit Pūṣan, who hears (our eulogies); who is the averter (of poverty); the preserver of that which is not lost, the ruler (over all).

mantras.sanskrit: पूषन्तव व्रते वयं न रिष्येम कदा चन । स्तोतारस्त इह स्मसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: pūṣantava vrate vayaṃ na riṣyema kadā cana | stotārasta iha smasi ||

translations.english: May we never suffer detriment when engaged, Pūṣan, in your worship; we are at this time your adorers.

mantras.sanskrit: परि पूषा परस्ताद्धस्तं दधातु दक्षिणम् । पुनर्नो नष्टमाजतु ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari pūṣā parastāddhastaṃ dadhātu dakṣiṇam | punarno naṣṭamājatu ||

translations.english: May Pūṣan put forth his right hand (to restrain our cattle) from going astray; may we bring again to us that which has been lost.

mantras.sanskrit: एहि वां विमुचो नपादाघृणे सं सचावहै । रथीॠतस्य नो भव ॥
mantras.transliteration: ehi vāṃ vimuco napādāghṛṇe saṃ sacāvahai | rathīṝtasya no bhava ||

translations.english: Come illusrious grandson of Prajāpati to (me your) worshipper); let us two be associated; become the conveyer of our sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: रथीतमं कपर्दिनमीशानं राधसो महः । रायः सखायमीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: rathītamaṃ kapardinamīśānaṃ rādhaso mahaḥ | rāyaḥ sakhāyamīmahe ||

translations.english: We solicit riches of our friend, (Pūṣan), the chief of charioteers, the wearer of a braid (of hair), the lord of infinite wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: रायो धारास्याघृणे वसो राशिरजाश्व । धीवतोधीवतः सखा ॥
mantras.transliteration: rāyo dhārāsyāghṛṇe vaso rāśirajāśva | dhīvatodhīvataḥ sakhā ||

translations.english: Illustrious Pūṣan, you are a torrent of riches; you, who have a goat for your steed, are a heap of wealth; the friend of every worshipper.

mantras.sanskrit: पूषणं न्वजाश्वमुप स्तोषाम वाजिनम् । स्वसुर्यो जार उच्यते ॥
mantras.transliteration: pūṣaṇaṃ nvajāśvamupa stoṣāma vājinam | svasuryo jāra ucyate ||

translations.english: We glorify Pūṣan, the rider of the goat, the giver of food, him who is called the gallant of his sister.

mantras.sanskrit: मातुर्दिधिषुमब्रवं स्वसुर्जारः शृणोतु नः । भ्रातेन्द्रस्य सखा मम ॥
mantras.transliteration: māturdidhiṣumabravaṃ svasurjāraḥ śṛṇotu naḥ | bhrātendrasya sakhā mama ||

translations.english: I glorify Pūṣan, the husband of his mother; may the gallant of his sister hear us; may the brother of Indra be our friend.

mantras.sanskrit: आजासः पूषणं रथे निशृम्भास्ते जनश्रियम् । देवं वहन्तु बिभ्रतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ājāsaḥ pūṣaṇaṃ rathe niśṛmbhāste janaśriyam | devaṃ vahantu bibhrataḥ ||

translations.english: May the harnessed goats, drawing the deity in his car, bring hither Pūṣan, the benefactor of man.

mantras.sanskrit: य एनमादिदेशति करम्भादिति पूषणम् । न तेन देव आदिशे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya enamādideśati karambhāditi pūṣaṇam | na tena deva ādiśe ||

translations.english: No (other) deity is indicated by him who declares the offering of mixed meal and butter to be intended for Pūṣan.

mantras.sanskrit: उत घा स रथीतमः सख्या सत्पतिर्युजा । इन्द्रो वृत्राणि जिघ्नते ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta ghā sa rathītamaḥ sakhyā satpatiryujā | indro vṛtrāṇi jighnate ||

translations.english: He, the chief of charioteers, the protector of the virtuous, Indra, destroys his foes, with his friend Pūṣan for his ally.

mantras.sanskrit: उतादः परुषे गवि सूरश्चक्रं हिरण्ययम् । न्यैरयद्रथीतमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: utādaḥ paruṣe gavi sūraścakraṃ hiraṇyayam | nyairayadrathītamaḥ ||

translations.english: He, the impeller, the chief of charioteers, (Pūṣan) ever urges on that golden wheel (of his car) for the radiant sun.

mantras.sanskrit: यदद्य त्वा पुरुष्टुत ब्रवाम दस्र मन्तुमः । तत्सु नो मन्म साधय ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadadya tvā puruṣṭuta bravāma dasra mantumaḥ | tatsu no manma sādhaya ||

translations.english: Since, intelligent Pūṣan, of godly aspect, the praised of many, we celebrate you today, therefore grant us the desired wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: इमं च नो गवेषणं सातये सीषधो गणम् । आरात्पूषन्नसि श्रुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imaṃ ca no gaveṣaṇaṃ sātaye sīṣadho gaṇam | ārātpūṣannasi śrutaḥ ||

translations.english: Gratify this our assembly, desirous of cattle, by their acquisition; you, Pūṣan, are renowned afar.

mantras.sanskrit: आ ते स्वस्तिमीमह आरेअघामुपावसुम् । अद्या च सर्वतातये श्वश्च सर्वतातये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā te svastimīmaha āreaghāmupāvasum | adyā ca sarvatātaye śvaśca sarvatātaye ||

translations.english: We deserve of your well-being, remote from evil, approximate to wealth, both for the sake of genitive ral sacrifice today, for the sake of genitive ral sacrifice tomorrow.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रा नु पूषणा वयं सख्याय स्वस्तये । हुवेम वाजसातये ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrā nu pūṣaṇā vayaṃ sakhyāya svastaye | huvema vājasātaye ||

translations.english: We invoke you, Indra and Pūṣan, for your friendship, for our well-being, and for the obtaining of food.

mantras.sanskrit: सोममन्य उपासदत्पातवे चम्वोः सुतम् । करम्भमन्य इच्छति ॥
mantras.transliteration: somamanya upāsadatpātave camvoḥ sutam | karambhamanya icchati ||

translations.english: One (of you) approaches to drink the Soma poured out into ladles, the other desires the buttered meal.

mantras.sanskrit: अजा अन्यस्य वह्नयो हरी अन्यस्य सम्भृता । ताभ्यां वृत्राणि जिघ्नते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ajā anyasya vahnayo harī anyasya sambhṛtā | tābhyāṃ vṛtrāṇi jighnate ||

translations.english: Goats are the bearers of the one, two well-fed horses of the other, and with them he destroys his foes.

mantras.sanskrit: यदिन्द्रो अनयद्रितो महीरपो वृषन्तमः । तत्र पूषाभवत्सचा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadindro anayadrito mahīrapo vṛṣantamaḥ | tatra pūṣābhavatsacā ||

translations.english: When the showerer Indra sends down the falling and mighty waters, there is Pūṣan along with him.

mantras.sanskrit: तां पूष्णः सुमतिं वयं वृक्षस्य प्र वयामिव । इन्द्रस्य चा रभामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tāṃ pūṣṇaḥ sumatiṃ vayaṃ vṛkṣasya pra vayāmiva | indrasya cā rabhāmahe ||

translations.english: We depend upon the good-will of Pūṣan, and of Indra, as (we cling) to the branches of a tree.

mantras.sanskrit: उत्पूषणं युवामहेऽभीशूँरिव सारथिः । मह्या इन्द्रं स्वस्तये ॥
mantras.transliteration: utpūṣaṇaṃ yuvāmahe'bhīśū~riva sārathiḥ | mahyā indraṃ svastaye ||

translations.english: We draw to us, for our great welfare, Pūṣan and Indra, as a charioteer (pulls tight) his reins.

mantras.sanskrit: शुक्रं ते अन्यद्यजतं ते अन्यद्विषुरूपे अहनी द्यौरिवासि । विश्वा हि माया अवसि स्वधावो भद्रा ते पूषन्निह रातिरस्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: śukraṃ te anyadyajataṃ te anyadviṣurūpe ahanī dyaurivāsi | viśvā hi māyā avasi svadhāvo bhadrā te pūṣanniha rātirastu ||

translations.english: One of your forms, (Pūṣan), is luminous, one is venerable; so that the day is variously complexioned; for you are like the sun; verily, bestower of food, you protect all intelligence; may your auspicious liberality be manifested on this occasion.

mantras.sanskrit: अजाश्वः पशुपा वाजपस्त्यो धियंजिन्वो भुवने विश्वे अर्पितः । अष्ट्रां पूषा शिथिरामुद्वरीवृजत्संचक्षाणो भुवना देव ईयते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ajāśvaḥ paśupā vājapastyo dhiyaṃjinvo bhuvane viśve arpitaḥ | aṣṭrāṃ pūṣā śithirāmudvarīvṛjatsaṃcakṣāṇo bhuvanā deva īyate ||

translations.english: The rider of the goat, the protector of animals, in whose dwelling good is abundant, the propitiated by sacred rites, who has been plural ced over the whole (world), the divine Pūṣan, brandishing his loosened goad, proceeds (in the sky), contemplating all beings.

mantras.sanskrit: यास्ते पूषन्नावो अन्तः समुद्रे हिरण्ययीरन्तरिक्षे चरन्ति । ताभिर्यासि दूत्यां सूर्यस्य कामेन कृत श्रव इच्छमानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yāste pūṣannāvo antaḥ samudre hiraṇyayīrantarikṣe caranti | tābhiryāsi dūtyāṃ sūryasya kāmena kṛta śrava icchamānaḥ ||

translations.english: With thos your golden vessels, which navigate within the ocean-firmament, you discharge the office of messenger of the sun; desirous of the sacrificial food, you are propitiated by (that which is) willingly offered.

mantras.sanskrit: पूषा सुबन्धुर्दिव आ पृथिव्या इळस्पतिर्मघवा दस्मवर्चाः । यं देवासो अददुः सूर्यायै कामेन कृतं तवसं स्वञ्चम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pūṣā subandhurdiva ā pṛthivyā iḷaspatirmaghavā dasmavarcāḥ | yaṃ devāso adaduḥ sūryāyai kāmena kṛtaṃ tavasaṃ svañcam ||

translations.english: Pūṣan is the kind kinsman of heaven and earth, the lord of food, the possessor of opulence, of goodly form; whom the gods gave to Sūrya, vigorous, well-moving, propitiated by (that which is) willingly offered.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र नु वोचा सुतेषु वां वीर्या यानि चक्रथुः । हतासो वां पितरो देवशत्रव इन्द्राग्नी जीवथो युवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra nu vocā suteṣu vāṃ vīryā yāni cakrathuḥ | hatāso vāṃ pitaro devaśatrava indrāgnī jīvatho yuvam ||

translations.english: When the libation is effused I celebrate, Indra and Agni, your heroic exploits; the Pitaras, the enemies of the gods, have been slain by you, and you survive.

mantras.sanskrit: बळित्था महिमा वामिन्द्राग्नी पनिष्ठ आ । समानो वां जनिता भ्रातरा युवं यमाविहेहमातरा ॥
mantras.transliteration: baḷitthā mahimā vāmindrāgnī paniṣṭha ā | samāno vāṃ janitā bhrātarā yuvaṃ yamāvihehamātarā ||

translations.english: Your greatness, Indra and Agni, is after this fashion, and is most deserving of praise; the same is your progenitor; twin brethren are you, having a mother everywhere present.

mantras.sanskrit: ओकिवांसा सुते सचाँ अश्वा सप्ती इवादने । इन्द्रा न्वग्नी अवसेह वज्रिणा वयं देवा हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: okivāṃsā sute sacā~ aśvā saptī ivādane | indrā nvagnī avaseha vajriṇā vayaṃ devā havāmahe ||

translations.english: You approach together, when the libation is effused, like two fleet coursers to their forage; we invoke today Indra and Agni, deities armed with the thunderbolt, to this ceremony for our preservation.

mantras.sanskrit: य इन्द्राग्नी सुतेषु वां स्तवत्तेष्वृतावृधा । जोषवाकं वदतः पज्रहोषिणा न देवा भसथश्चन ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya indrāgnī suteṣu vāṃ stavatteṣvṛtāvṛdhā | joṣavākaṃ vadataḥ pajrahoṣiṇā na devā bhasathaścana ||

translations.english: Divine Indra and Agni, augmenters of sacrifice by whom the acclamation (of praise) is received, you partake not of the (Soma) of him who, when the libation is effused, praises you (improperly), uttering unacceptable eulogies.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी को अस्य वां देवौ मर्तश्चिकेतति । विषूचो अश्वान्युयुजान ईयत एकः समान आ रथे ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāgnī ko asya vāṃ devau martaściketati | viṣūco aśvānyuyujāna īyata ekaḥ samāna ā rathe ||

translations.english: What mortal, divine Indra and Agni, is a judge of that (your act), when one of you, harnessing his diversely-going horses, proceeds in the common car.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी अपादियं पूर्वागात्पद्वतीभ्यः । हित्वी शिरो जिह्वया वावदच्चरत्त्रिंशत्पदा न्यक्रमीत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāgnī apādiyaṃ pūrvāgātpadvatībhyaḥ | hitvī śiro jihvayā vāvadaccarattriṃśatpadā nyakramīt ||

translations.english: This footless (dawn), Indra and Agni, comes before the footed sleepers, animating the head (of living beings with consciousness), causing them to utter loud sounds with their tongues, and passing onwards she traverses thirty steps.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी आ हि तन्वते नरो धन्वानि बाह्वोः । मा नो अस्मिन्महाधने परा वर्क्तं गविष्टिषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāgnī ā hi tanvate naro dhanvāni bāhvoḥ | mā no asminmahādhane parā varktaṃ gaviṣṭiṣu ||

translations.english: Indra and Agni, men verily stretch their bows with their arms, but do not you desert us contending for cattle in the great combat.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी तपन्ति माघा अर्यो अरातयः । अप द्वेषांस्या कृतं युयुतं सूर्यादधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāgnī tapanti māghā aryo arātayaḥ | apa dveṣāṃsyā kṛtaṃ yuyutaṃ sūryādadhi ||

translations.english: Indra and Agni, murderous, aggressive enemies harasss us; drive away mine adversaries; separate them from (sight of) the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी युवोरपि वसु दिव्यानि पार्थिवा । आ न इह प्र यच्छतं रयिं विश्वायुपोषसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāgnī yuvorapi vasu divyāni pārthivā | ā na iha pra yacchataṃ rayiṃ viśvāyupoṣasam ||

translations.english: Indra and Agni, yours are both celestial and terrestrial treasures; bestow upon us, on this occasion, life-sustaining riches.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी उक्थवाहसा स्तोमेभिर्हवनश्रुता । विश्वाभिर्गीर्भिरा गतमस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāgnī ukthavāhasā stomebhirhavanaśrutā | viśvābhirgīrbhirā gatamasya somasya pītaye ||

translations.english: Indra and Agni, who are to be attracted by hymns; you, who hear our invocation (accompanied) by praise and by all adorations, come hither to drink of this Soma libation.

mantras.sanskrit: श्नथद्वृत्रमुत सनोति वाजमिन्द्रा यो अग्नी सहुरी सपर्यात् । इरज्यन्ता वसव्यस्य भूरेः सहस्तमा सहसा वाजयन्ता ॥
mantras.transliteration: śnathadvṛtramuta sanoti vājamindrā yo agnī sahurī saparyāt | irajyantā vasavyasya bhūreḥ sahastamā sahasā vājayantā ||

translations.english: He ovecomes his enemy, and acquires food, who worships the victorious Indra and Agni, the lords of infinite opulence, most powerful in strength, desirous of (sacrificial) food.

mantras.sanskrit: ता योधिष्टमभि गा इन्द्र नूनमपः स्वरुषसो अग्न ऊळ्हाः । दिशः स्वरुषस इन्द्र चित्रा अपो गा अग्ने युवसे नियुत्वान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā yodhiṣṭamabhi gā indra nūnamapaḥ svaruṣaso agna ūḷhāḥ | diśaḥ svaruṣasa indra citrā apo gā agne yuvase niyutvān ||

translations.english: Indra and Agni, verily you have combated for (the recovery of) the cows, the waters, the sun, the dawns that had been carried away (by the asuras); you reunite, Indra (with the world), the quarters of the horizon, the sun, the wonderful waters, the dawns, the cattle and so do you, Agni, who have the Niyut steeds.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वृत्रहणा वृत्रहभिः शुष्मैरिन्द्र यातं नमोभिरग्ने अर्वाक् । युवं राधोभिरकवेभिरिन्द्राग्ने अस्मे भवतमुत्तमेभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vṛtrahaṇā vṛtrahabhiḥ śuṣmairindra yātaṃ namobhiragne arvāk | yuvaṃ rādhobhirakavebhirindrāgne asme bhavatamuttamebhiḥ ||

translations.english: Slayers of Vṛtra, Indra and Agni, come down with foe-subduing energies, (to be invigorated) by (our) offerings; be manifest to us, Indra and Agni, with unblameable and most excellent riches.

mantras.sanskrit: ता हुवे ययोरिदं पप्ने विश्वं पुरा कृतम् । इन्द्राग्नी न मर्धतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā huve yayoridaṃ papne viśvaṃ purā kṛtam | indrāgnī na mardhataḥ ||

translations.english: I invoke those two, the whole of whose deeds of old have been celebrated; Indra and Agni harm us not.

mantras.sanskrit: उग्रा विघनिना मृध इन्द्राग्नी हवामहे । ता नो मृळात ईदृशे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ugrā vighaninā mṛdha indrāgnī havāmahe | tā no mṛḷāta īdṛśe ||

translations.english: We invoke the fierce Indra and Agni, the slayers of enemies; may they give us success in similar warfare.

mantras.sanskrit: हतो वृत्राण्यार्या हतो दासानि सत्पती । हतो विश्वा अप द्विषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: hato vṛtrāṇyāryā hato dāsāni satpatī | hato viśvā apa dviṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Counteract all oppressions (committed) by the pious; counteract all oppressions (committed) by the impious; protectors of the virtuous, destroy all those who hate us.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी युवामिमेऽभि स्तोमा अनूषत । पिबतं शम्भुवा सुतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāgnī yuvāmime'bhi stomā anūṣata | pibataṃ śambhuvā sutam ||

translations.english: Indra and Agni, these hymns glorify you both; drink, bestowers of happiness, the libation.

mantras.sanskrit: या वां सन्ति पुरुस्पृहो नियुतो दाशुषे नरा । इन्द्राग्नी ताभिरा गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā vāṃ santi puruspṛho niyuto dāśuṣe narā | indrāgnī tābhirā gatam ||

translations.english: Indra and Agni, leaders (of rites), whose Niyut steeds are desired by many, come with them to the donor (of the libation).

mantras.sanskrit: ताभिरा गच्छतं नरोपेदं सवनं सुतम् । इन्द्राग्नी सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: tābhirā gacchataṃ naropedaṃ savanaṃ sutam | indrāgnī somapītaye ||

translations.english: Come with them, leaders (of rites),

mantras.sanskrit: तमीळिष्व यो अर्चिषा वना विश्वा परिष्वजत् । कृष्णा कृणोति जिह्वया ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamīḷiṣva yo arciṣā vanā viśvā pariṣvajat | kṛṣṇā kṛṇoti jihvayā ||

translations.english: Glorify that Agni who envelopes all the forest with flame, who blackens them with (his) tongue.

mantras.sanskrit: य इद्ध आविवासति सुम्नमिन्द्रस्य मर्त्यः । द्युम्नाय सुतरा अपः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya iddha āvivāsati sumnamindrasya martyaḥ | dyumnāya sutarā apaḥ ||

translations.english: The mortal who presents the gratifying (oblation) to Indra in the kindled (fire), to him (Indra grants) acceptable waters for his sustenance.

mantras.sanskrit: ता नो वाजवतीरिष आशून्पिपृतमर्वतः । इन्द्रमग्निं च वोळ्हवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā no vājavatīriṣa āśūnpipṛtamarvataḥ | indramagniṃ ca voḷhave ||

translations.english: May those two grant us strengthening food, and swift horses to convey (our offerings).

mantras.sanskrit: उभा वामिन्द्राग्नी आहुवध्या उभा राधसः सह मादयध्यै । उभा दाताराविषां रयीणामुभा वाजस्य सातये हुवे वाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ubhā vāmindrāgnī āhuvadhyā ubhā rādhasaḥ saha mādayadhyai | ubhā dātārāviṣāṃ rayīṇāmubhā vājasya sātaye huve vām ||

translations.english: I invoke you both, Indra and Agni, to be present at the sacrifice; and both together to be exhilarated by the (sacrificial) food; for you are both donors of food and riches, and therefore I invoke you both for the obtaining of sustenance.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो गव्येभिरश्व्यैर्वसव्यैरुप गच्छतम् । सखायौ देवौ सख्याय शम्भुवेन्द्राग्नी ता हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no gavyebhiraśvyairvasavyairupa gacchatam | sakhāyau devau sakhyāya śambhuvendrāgnī tā havāmahe ||

translations.english: Come to us with herds of cattle, with troops of horses, with ample treasures, divine friends, Indra and Agni; givers of happiness, we invoke you as such for your friendship.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी शृणुतं हवं यजमानस्य सुन्वतः । वीतं हव्यान्या गतं पिबतं सोम्यं मधु ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāgnī śṛṇutaṃ havaṃ yajamānasya sunvataḥ | vītaṃ havyānyā gataṃ pibataṃ somyaṃ madhu ||

translations.english: Hear, Indra and Agni, the instrumental tutor of the rite as he offers the libation; partake of the offering; come, quaff the sweet Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: इयमददाद्रभसमृणच्युतं दिवोदासं वध्र्यश्वाय दाशुषे । या शश्वन्तमाचखादावसं पणिं ता ते दात्राणि तविषा सरस्वति ॥
mantras.transliteration: iyamadadādrabhasamṛṇacyutaṃ divodāsaṃ vadhryaśvāya dāśuṣe | yā śaśvantamācakhādāvasaṃ paṇiṃ tā te dātrāṇi taviṣā sarasvati ||

translations.english: She gave to the donor of the oblations, Vadhryaśva, a son Divodāsa endowed with speed, and acquitting the debt (due to gods and progenitors), she who destroyed the churlis niggard, (thinking) only of himself, such are your bounties, Sarasvatī.

mantras.sanskrit: इयं शुष्मेभिर्बिसखा इवारुजत्सानु गिरीणां तविषेभिरूर्मिभिः । पारावतघ्नीमवसे सुवृक्तिभिः सरस्वतीमा विवासेम धीतिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: iyaṃ śuṣmebhirbisakhā ivārujatsānu girīṇāṃ taviṣebhirūrmibhiḥ | pārāvataghnīmavase suvṛktibhiḥ sarasvatīmā vivāsema dhītibhiḥ ||

translations.english: With impetuous and mighty waves she breaks down the precipices of the mountains, like a digger for the lotus fibres; we adore for our protection, the praises and with sacred rites, Sarasvatī the underminer of both her banks.

mantras.sanskrit: सरस्वति देवनिदो नि बर्हय प्रजां विश्वस्य बृसयस्य मायिनः । उत क्षितिभ्योऽवनीरविन्दो विषमेभ्यो अस्रवो वाजिनीवति ॥
mantras.transliteration: sarasvati devanido ni barhaya prajāṃ viśvasya bṛsayasya māyinaḥ | uta kṣitibhyo'vanīravindo viṣamebhyo asravo vājinīvati ||

translations.english: Destroy, Sarasvatī, the revilers of the gods, the offspring of the universal deluder, Bṛsaya; giver of sustenance, you have acquired for men the lands (seized by the asuras), and have showered water upon them.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र णो देवी सरस्वती वाजेभिर्वाजिनीवती । धीनामवित्र्यवतु ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra ṇo devī sarasvatī vājebhirvājinīvatī | dhīnāmavitryavatu ||

translations.english: May the divine Sarasvatī, the acceptress of (sacrificial) food, the protectress o her worshippers, sustain us with (abundant) viands.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्त्वा देवि सरस्वत्युपब्रूते धने हिते । इन्द्रं न वृत्रतूर्ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: yastvā devi sarasvatyupabrūte dhane hite | indraṃ na vṛtratūrye ||

translations.english: Divine Sarasvatī, protect him engaged in conflict for the sake of wealth, who glorifies you like Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं देवि सरस्वत्यवा वाजेषु वाजिनि । रदा पूषेव नः सनिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ devi sarasvatyavā vājeṣu vājini | radā pūṣeva naḥ sanim ||

translations.english: Divine Sarasvatī, abounding in food, protect us in combat, and, like Pūṣan, give us gifts.

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्या नः सरस्वती घोरा हिरण्यवर्तनिः । वृत्रघ्नी वष्टि सुष्टुतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta syā naḥ sarasvatī ghorā hiraṇyavartaniḥ | vṛtraghnī vaṣṭi suṣṭutim ||
