translations.english: May the fierce Sarasvatī, riding in a golden chariot, the destructress of enemies, be plural ased by our earnest laudation.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्या अनन्तो अह्रुतस्त्वेषश्चरिष्णुरर्णवः । अमश्चरति रोरुवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasyā ananto ahrutastveṣaścariṣṇurarṇavaḥ | amaścarati roruvat ||

translations.english: May she whose might, infinite, undeviating, splendid, progressive, water-shedding, proceeds loud-sounding.

mantras.sanskrit: सा नो विश्वा अति द्विषः स्वसॄरन्या ऋतावरी । अतन्नहेव सूर्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sā no viśvā ati dviṣaḥ svasṝranyā ṛtāvarī | atannaheva sūryaḥ ||

translations.english: Overcome all our adversaries, and bring to us her other water-laden sisters, as the ever-rolling sun (leads on) the days.

mantras.sanskrit: उत नः प्रिया प्रियासु सप्तस्वसा सुजुष्टा । सरस्वती स्तोम्या भूत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta naḥ priyā priyāsu saptasvasā sujuṣṭā | sarasvatī stomyā bhūt ||

translations.english: May Sarasvatī, who has seven sisters, who is dearest among those dear to us, and is fully propitiated, be ever adorable.

mantras.sanskrit: आपप्रुषी पार्थिवान्युरु रजो अन्तरिक्षम् । सरस्वती निदस्पातु ॥
mantras.transliteration: āpapruṣī pārthivānyuru rajo antarikṣam | sarasvatī nidaspātu ||

translations.english: May Sarasvatī, filing (with radiance) the expanse of earth and heaven, defend us from the reviled.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिषधस्था सप्तधातुः पञ्च जाता वर्धयन्ती । वाजेवाजे हव्या भूत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: triṣadhasthā saptadhātuḥ pañca jātā vardhayantī | vājevāje havyā bhūt ||

translations.english: Abiding in the three worlds, comprising seven elements, cherishing the five races (of beings), she is ever to be invoked in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र या महिम्ना महिनासु चेकिते द्युम्नेभिरन्या अपसामपस्तमा । रथ इव बृहती विभ्वने कृतोपस्तुत्या चिकितुषा सरस्वती ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra yā mahimnā mahināsu cekite dyumnebhiranyā apasāmapastamā | ratha iva bṛhatī vibhvane kṛtopastutyā cikituṣā sarasvatī ||

translations.english: She who is disinguished among them as eminent in greatness and in her glories; she who is the most impetuous of all other streams; she who as been created vast in capacity as a chariot, she, Sarasvatī, is to be glorified by the discree (worshippers)

mantras.sanskrit: सरस्वत्यभि नो नेषि वस्यो माप स्फरीः पयसा मा न आ धक् । जुषस्व नः सख्या वेश्या च मा त्वत्क्षेत्राण्यरणानि गन्म ॥
mantras.transliteration: sarasvatyabhi no neṣi vasyo māpa spharīḥ payasā mā na ā dhak | juṣasva naḥ sakhyā veśyā ca mā tvatkṣetrāṇyaraṇāni ganma ||

translations.english: Guide us, Sarasvatī, to precious wealth; reduce us no to insignificance; overwhelm us not with (excess of) water; be plural ased by our friendly (services) and access to our habitations, and let us not repair to plural ces unacceptable to you.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तुषे नरा दिवो अस्य प्रसन्ताश्विना हुवे जरमाणो अर्कैः । या सद्य उस्रा व्युषि ज्मो अन्तान्युयूषतः पर्युरू वरांसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: stuṣe narā divo asya prasantāśvinā huve jaramāṇo arkaiḥ | yā sadya usrā vyuṣi jmo antānyuyūṣataḥ paryurū varāṃsi ||

translations.english: I praise the two leaders of heaven, the presiders over this world; I invoke the Aśvins, glorifying them with sacred hymns, them, who are ever the discomfiture (of foes), who at dawn scatter the investing glooms to the ends of the earth.

mantras.sanskrit: ता यज्ञमा शुचिभिश्चक्रमाणा रथस्य भानुं रुरुचू रजोभिः । पुरू वरांस्यमिता मिमानापो धन्वान्यति याथो अज्रान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā yajñamā śucibhiścakramāṇā rathasya bhānuṃ rurucū rajobhiḥ | purū varāṃsyamitā mimānāpo dhanvānyati yātho ajrān ||

translations.english: Coming to the sacrifice with their bright splendours, they light up the lustre of (their) car; emitting vast and infinite radiance; they drive their horses over deserts (refreshing them) with water.

mantras.sanskrit: ता ह त्यद्वर्तिर्यदरध्रमुग्रेत्था धिय ऊहथुः शश्वदश्वैः । मनोजवेभिरिषिरैः शयध्यै परि व्यथिर्दाशुषो मर्त्यस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā ha tyadvartiryadaradhramugretthā dhiya ūhathuḥ śaśvadaśvaiḥ | manojavebhiriṣiraiḥ śayadhyai pari vyathirdāśuṣo martyasya ||

translations.english: Fierce Aśvins, from thhat humble mansion to which (you have repaired), you have ever borne with your desirable horses, as swift as thought, the pious worshippers in some manner (to heaven); let the injurer of the liberal man (be consigned by you) to (final) repose.

mantras.sanskrit: ता नव्यसो जरमाणस्य मन्मोप भूषतो युयुजानसप्ती । शुभं पृक्षमिषमूर्जं वहन्ता होता यक्षत्प्रत्नो अध्रुग्युवाना ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā navyaso jaramāṇasya manmopa bhūṣato yuyujānasaptī | śubhaṃ pṛkṣamiṣamūrjaṃ vahantā hotā yakṣatpratno adhrugyuvānā ||

translations.english: Harnessing their horses, bringing excellent food, nourishment, and strength, they approach (to receive) the adoration of their recent worshipper; and may the benevolent ancient invoker of the gods (Agni) sacrifice to the ever youthful (deities).

mantras.sanskrit: ता वल्गू दस्रा पुरुशाकतमा प्रत्ना नव्यसा वचसा विवासे । या शंसते स्तुवते शम्भविष्ठा बभूवतुर्गृणते चित्रराती ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā valgū dasrā puruśākatamā pratnā navyasā vacasā vivāse | yā śaṃsate stuvate śambhaviṣṭhā babhūvaturgṛṇate citrarātī ||

translations.english: I worship with a new hymn those two quick-moving good-looking ancient (Aśvins), the achievers of many exploits, who are the givers of great felicity to him who prays to (them), or praises (them); the bestowers of wondrous gifts on him who adores (them).

mantras.sanskrit: ता भुज्युं विभिरद्भ्यः समुद्रात्तुग्रस्य सूनुमूहथू रजोभिः । अरेणुभिर्योजनेभिर्भुजन्ता पतत्रिभिरर्णसो निरुपस्थात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā bhujyuṃ vibhiradbhyaḥ samudrāttugrasya sūnumūhathū rajobhiḥ | areṇubhiryojanebhirbhujantā patatribhirarṇaso nirupasthāt ||

translations.english: They bore up from te waters, from the ocean, by the winged horses attached to their car, (passing) by roads unsoiled by dust, Bhujyu, the son of Tugra; they (bore them) from out of the lap of the water.

mantras.sanskrit: वि जयुषा रथ्या यातमद्रिं श्रुतं हवं वृषणा वध्रिमत्याः । दशस्यन्ता शयवे पिप्यथुर्गामिति च्यवाना सुमतिं भुरण्यू ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi jayuṣā rathyā yātamadriṃ śrutaṃ havaṃ vṛṣaṇā vadhrimatyāḥ | daśasyantā śayave pipyathurgāmiti cyavānā sumatiṃ bhuraṇyū ||

translations.english: Riders in your car, you have penetrated the mountain by your triumphant chariot; showerers (of benefits) you heard the invocation of Vadhrimatī; you have nourished, bountiful givers, the cow of Śayu-- and in this manner displaying benevolence are you everywhere present.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्रोदसी प्रदिवो अस्ति भूमा हेळो देवानामुत मर्त्यत्रा । तदादित्या वसवो रुद्रियासो रक्षोयुजे तपुरघं दधात ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadrodasī pradivo asti bhūmā heḷo devānāmuta martyatrā | tadādityā vasavo rudriyāso rakṣoyuje tapuraghaṃ dadhāta ||

translations.english: Heaven and Earth, Ādiyas, Vasus, Maruts, rende that dread ange of the gods which (has) of old (been directed) against mortals, destructive and fatal to him who is associated with the rākṣasas.

mantras.sanskrit: य ईं राजानावृतुथा विदधद्रजसो मित्रो वरुणश्चिकेतत् । गम्भीराय रक्षसे हेतिमस्य द्रोघाय चिद्वचस आनवाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya īṃ rājānāvṛtuthā vidadhadrajaso mitro varuṇaściketat | gambhīrāya rakṣase hetimasya droghāya cidvacasa ānavāya ||

translations.english: Mitra and Varuṇa recognize him who of all the world worships the royal (Aśvins) in due season; he hurls his weapon against the strong rākṣasa, against the malignant menaces of man.

mantras.sanskrit: अन्तरैश्चक्रैस्तनयाय वर्तिर्द्युमता यातं नृवता रथेन । सनुत्येन त्यजसा मर्त्यस्य वनुष्यतामपि शीर्षा ववृक्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: antaraiścakraistanayāya vartirdyumatā yātaṃ nṛvatā rathena | sanutyena tyajasā martyasya vanuṣyatāmapi śīrṣā vavṛktam ||

translations.english: Come with your shining and well-guided chariot, (fitted) with excellen wheels, to our dwelling, (to bestow upon us) male offspring; cut off with secret indignation the heads of those obstructing (the adoration) of the mortal (who worships you).

mantras.sanskrit: आ परमाभिरुत मध्यमाभिर्नियुद्भिर्यातमवमाभिरर्वाक् । दृळ्हस्य चिद्गोमतो वि व्रजस्य दुरो वर्तं गृणते चित्रराती ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā paramābhiruta madhyamābhirniyudbhiryātamavamābhirarvāk | dṛḷhasya cidgomato vi vrajasya duro vartaṃ gṛṇate citrarātī ||

translations.english: Come down, whether with the most excellent, or middling, or inferior Niyut steeds; set upon the doors of the fast-shut stall of the cattle; eb bountiful to him who praises you.

mantras.sanskrit: क्व त्या वल्गू पुरुहूताद्य दूतो न स्तोमोऽविदन्नमस्वान् । आ यो अर्वाङ्नासत्या ववर्त प्रेष्ठा ह्यसथो अस्य मन्मन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kva tyā valgū puruhūtādya dūto na stomo'vidannamasvān | ā yo arvāṅnāsatyā vavarta preṣṭhā hyasatho asya manman ||

translations.english: Where may our praise and oblations find today for a mesenger, those two splendid (Aśvins), the invoked of many, and bring the Nāsatyās to our presence? Be propitiated (Aśvins) by the adoration of this (your worshipper).

mantras.sanskrit: अरं मे गन्तं हवनायास्मै गृणाना यथा पिबाथो अन्धः । परि ह त्यद्वर्तिर्याथो रिषो न यत्परो नान्तरस्तुतुर्यात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: araṃ me gantaṃ havanāyāsmai gṛṇānā yathā pibātho andhaḥ | pari ha tyadvartiryātho riṣo na yatparo nāntarastuturyāt ||

translations.english: Praised, that you may drink the (sacrificial) Soma, you come promptly upon this my invocation; keep guard around the dwelling against (all) advdrsaries, so that neither one that abides at a distance nor a neighbour may do us harm.

mantras.sanskrit: अकारि वामन्धसो वरीमन्नस्तारि बर्हिः सुप्रायणतमम् । उत्तानहस्तो युवयुर्ववन्दा वां नक्षन्तो अद्रय आञ्जन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: akāri vāmandhaso varīmannastāri barhiḥ suprāyaṇatamam | uttānahasto yuvayurvavandā vāṃ nakṣanto adraya āñjan ||

translations.english: (What is essential) for the copious effusion of the (sacrificial) food has been done for you; the very delicate sacred grass has been strewn; the (priest with) uplifted hands desirous o your presence praises you; the stones express (the Soma), designing it for you.

mantras.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वो वामग्निरध्वरेष्वस्थात्प्र रातिरेति जूर्णिनी घृताची । प्र होता गूर्तमना उराणोऽयुक्त यो नासत्या हवीमन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūrdhvo vāmagniradhvareṣvasthātpra rātireti jūrṇinī ghṛtācī | pra hotā gūrtamanā urāṇo'yukta yo nāsatyā havīman ||

translations.english: Agni is above for you; he is present at (your) sacrifices; the oblation flows diffusive and redolent of ghī; diligent and zealous is the ministrant priest who is engaged, Nāsatyās, in your invocation.

mantras.sanskrit: अधि श्रिये दुहिता सूर्यस्य रथं तस्थौ पुरुभुजा शतोतिम् । प्र मायाभिर्मायिना भूतमत्र नरा नृतू जनिमन्यज्ञियानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhi śriye duhitā sūryasya rathaṃ tasthau purubhujā śatotim | pra māyābhirmāyinā bhūtamatra narā nṛtū janimanyajñiyānām ||

translations.english: Protectors of many, the daughter of Sūrya ascended your chariot the defence of hundreds, for refuge sagacious leaders and guides, you have excelled by your devices (all others) at this appearance of the adorable (deities).

mantras.sanskrit: युवं श्रीभिर्दर्शताभिराभिः शुभे पुष्टिमूहथुः सूर्यायाः । प्र वां वयो वपुषेऽनु पप्तन्नक्षद्वाणी सुष्टुता धिष्ण्या वाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ śrībhirdarśatābhirābhiḥ śubhe puṣṭimūhathuḥ sūryāyāḥ | pra vāṃ vayo vapuṣe'nu paptannakṣadvāṇī suṣṭutā dhiṣṇyā vām ||

translations.english: You have provided with these beautiful splendours, gratification for the enjoyment of Sūrya, your horses have descended for feliciy, deserving of praise, the laudation (of the sages) has reached you glorified.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वां वयोऽश्वासो वहिष्ठा अभि प्रयो नासत्या वहन्तु । प्र वां रथो मनोजवा असर्जीषः पृक्ष इषिधो अनु पूर्वीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāṃ vayo'śvāso vahiṣṭhā abhi prayo nāsatyā vahantu | pra vāṃ ratho manojavā asarjīṣaḥ pṛkṣa iṣidho anu pūrvīḥ ||

translations.english: May your rapid burden-bearing steeds bring you Nāsatyās to the (sacrificial) food; your chariot swift as thought has dispensed substantial, desirable, abundant food.

mantras.sanskrit: पुरु हि वां पुरुभुजा देष्णं धेनुं न इषं पिन्वतमसक्राम् । स्तुतश्च वां माध्वी सुष्टुतिश्च रसाश्च ये वामनु रातिमग्मन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: puru hi vāṃ purubhujā deṣṇaṃ dhenuṃ na iṣaṃ pinvatamasakrām | stutaśca vāṃ mādhvī suṣṭutiśca rasāśca ye vāmanu rātimagman ||

translations.english: Protectors of many, vast (wealth) is to be distributed by you; give us then nutritious and invariable food. Givers of delight, there are to you, adorers, and fit praise, and libations, which are prepared to acknowledge your liberality.

mantras.sanskrit: उत म ऋज्रे पुरयस्य रघ्वी सुमीळ्हे शतं पेरुके च पक्वा । शाण्डो दाद्धिरणिनः स्मद्दिष्टीन्दश वशासो अभिषाच ऋष्वान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta ma ṛjre purayasya raghvī sumīḷhe śataṃ peruke ca pakvā | śāṇḍo dāddhiraṇinaḥ smaddiṣṭīndaśa vaśāso abhiṣāca ṛṣvān ||

translations.english: May the two straight-going, light-moving, (mares) of Puraya be mine; may the hundred cows belonging to Sumīḷha, may the dressed viands prepared by Peruka be for me; may Ṣaṇḍa bestow upon me ten handsome golden chariots, and obedient, valian, and well-favoured (dependants).

mantras.sanskrit: सं वां शता नासत्या सहस्राश्वानां पुरुपन्था गिरे दात् । भरद्वाजाय वीर नू गिरे दाद्धता रक्षांसि पुरुदंससा स्युः ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ vāṃ śatā nāsatyā sahasrāśvānāṃ purupanthā gire dāt | bharadvājāya vīra nū gire dāddhatā rakṣāṃsi purudaṃsasā syuḥ ||

translations.english: May Purupanthā, Nāsatyās, grant to him who praises you, hundreds and thousands of horses; may he give them, heroes, to Bharadvāja; achievers of great deeds, may the rākṣasas be slain.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वां सुम्ने वरिमन्त्सूरिभिः ष्याम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāṃ sumne varimantsūribhiḥ ṣyām ||

translations.english: May I be associated with the pious in the abundant felicity bestowed by you.

mantras.sanskrit: उदु श्रिय उषसो रोचमाना अस्थुरपां नोर्मयो रुशन्तः । कृणोति विश्वा सुपथा सुगान्यभूदु वस्वी दक्षिणा मघोनी ॥
mantras.transliteration: udu śriya uṣaso rocamānā asthurapāṃ normayo ruśantaḥ | kṛṇoti viśvā supathā sugānyabhūdu vasvī dakṣiṇā maghonī ||

translations.english: The white and shining tints of the dawn have spread like the waves of the waters, for the beautifying (of the world); she renders all good roads easy to be traversed; she ho is replete with delight, excellence and health.

mantras.sanskrit: भद्रा ददृक्ष उर्विया वि भास्युत्ते शोचिर्भानवो द्यामपप्तन् । आविर्वक्षः कृणुषे शुम्भमानोषो देवि रोचमाना महोभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhadrā dadṛkṣa urviyā vi bhāsyutte śocirbhānavo dyāmapaptan | āvirvakṣaḥ kṛṇuṣe śumbhamānoṣo devi rocamānā mahobhiḥ ||

translations.english: Divine Uṣas, you are seen auspicious; you shine afar; your bright rays spread over the sky, lovely and radiant with great (splndours), you display your person n.

mantras.sanskrit: वहन्ति सीमरुणासो रुशन्तो गावः सुभगामुर्विया प्रथानाम् । अपेजते शूरो अस्तेव शत्रून्बाधते तमो अजिरो न वोळ्हा ॥
mantras.transliteration: vahanti sīmaruṇāso ruśanto gāvaḥ subhagāmurviyā prathānām | apejate śūro asteva śatrūnbādhate tamo ajiro na voḷhā ||

translations.english: Ruddy and resplendent kine bear the auspicious, expanding, illustrious dawn; like a warrior, who, casting his darts, or a swift charger scattering enemies, she drives away the glooms.

mantras.sanskrit: सुगोत ते सुपथा पर्वतेष्ववाते अपस्तरसि स्वभानो । सा न आ वह पृथुयामन्नृष्वे रयिं दिवो दुहितरिषयध्यै ॥
mantras.transliteration: sugota te supathā parvateṣvavāte apastarasi svabhāno | sā na ā vaha pṛthuyāmannṛṣve rayiṃ divo duhitariṣayadhyai ||

translations.english: Yours are good roads and easy to be traversed in mountains and inaccessible plural ces; you pass self-irradiating over the waters; bring to us, daughter of heaven, in your spacious and beautiful chariot, desirable riches.

mantras.sanskrit: सा वह योक्षभिरवातोषो वरं वहसि जोषमनु । त्वं दिवो दुहितर्या ह देवी पूर्वहूतौ मंहना दर्शता भूः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sā vaha yokṣabhiravātoṣo varaṃ vahasi joṣamanu | tvaṃ divo duhitaryā ha devī pūrvahūtau maṃhanā darśatā bhūḥ ||

translations.english: Do you Uṣas bring me opulence, for unoposed you bear with your oxen (wealth to your worshippers), according to your satisfaction; daughter of heaven, you who are divine, who are lovely, are to be worshipped at the first (daily) rite.

mantras.sanskrit: उत्ते वयश्चिद्वसतेरपप्तन्नरश्च ये पितुभाजो व्युष्टौ । अमा सते वहसि भूरि वाममुषो देवि दाशुषे मर्त्याय ॥
mantras.transliteration: utte vayaścidvasaterapaptannaraśca ye pitubhājo vyuṣṭau | amā sate vahasi bhūri vāmamuṣo devi dāśuṣe martyāya ||

translations.english: At your dawning, divine Uṣas, the birds spring up from their nests, and men who have to gain their sustenance (arise); you, divine Uṣas, bring ample wealth to the mortal who is nigh you, the offerer of the oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: एषा स्या नो दुहिता दिवोजाः क्षितीरुच्छन्ती मानुषीरजीगः । या भानुना रुशता राम्यास्वज्ञायि तिरस्तमसश्चिदक्तून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣā syā no duhitā divojāḥ kṣitīrucchantī mānuṣīrajīgaḥ | yā bhānunā ruśatā rāmyāsvajñāyi tirastamasaścidaktūn ||

translations.english: This heaven-born daughter (of the sky), driving away the darkness for us, makes visible human beings; she who with bright lustre is perceived dissipating the glooms, and (extinguishing) the plural nets (shining) in the nights.

mantras.sanskrit: वि तद्ययुररुणयुग्भिरश्वैश्चित्रं भान्त्युषसश्चन्द्ररथाः । अग्रं यज्ञस्य बृहतो नयन्तीर्वि ता बाधन्ते तम ऊर्म्यायाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi tadyayuraruṇayugbhiraśvaiścitraṃ bhāntyuṣasaścandrarathāḥ | agraṃ yajñasya bṛhato nayantīrvi tā bādhante tama ūrmyāyāḥ ||

translations.english: The DWns in beautiful chariots drawn by purple steeds in pairs, shine gloriously as hey proceed (along the heaven); bringing on the commencement of the great (morning) sacrifice, they disperse the darkness of the night.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रवो वाजमिषमूर्जं वहन्तीर्नि दाशुष उषसो मर्त्याय । मघोनीर्वीरवत्पत्यमाना अवो धात विधते रत्नमद्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: śravo vājamiṣamūrjaṃ vahantīrni dāśuṣa uṣaso martyāya | maghonīrvīravatpatyamānā avo dhāta vidhate ratnamadya ||

translations.english: Dawns, bringing fame, and food, sustenance, and strength to the mortal, the donor (of the oblation), abonding in wealth, and proceeding (through the sky), bestow upon the worshiper today food, with male descendants and riches.

mantras.sanskrit: इदा हि वो विधते रत्नमस्तीदा वीराय दाशुष उषासः । इदा विप्राय जरते यदुक्था नि ष्म मावते वहथा पुरा चित् ॥
mantras.transliteration: idā hi vo vidhate ratnamastīdā vīrāya dāśuṣa uṣāsaḥ | idā viprāya jarate yadukthā ni ṣma māvate vahathā purā cit ||

translations.english: Verily, Dawns, there is at present wealth to give to your worshiper, to the man offering (oblations) to the sage repeating your praise; if the praises (are accepted), then bring to him who is like me such wealth as has been formerly bestowed (upon myself).

mantras.sanskrit: इदा हि त उषो अद्रिसानो गोत्रा गवामङ्गिरसो गृणन्ति । व्यर्केण बिभिदुर्ब्रह्मणा च सत्या नृणामभवद्देवहूतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: idā hi ta uṣo adrisāno gotrā gavāmaṅgiraso gṛṇanti | vyarkeṇa bibhidurbrahmaṇā ca satyā nṛṇāmabhavaddevahūtiḥ ||

translations.english: Verily, Dawns, there is at presen wealh to give to your worshipper, to the man offering (oblations) to the sage repeating your praise; if the praises (are accepted), then bring to him who is like me such wealth as has been formerly bestowed (upon myself).

mantras.sanskrit: उच्छा दिवो दुहितः प्रत्नवन्नो भरद्वाजवद्विधते मघोनि । सुवीरं रयिं गृणते रिरीह्युरुगायमधि धेहि श्रवो नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ucchā divo duhitaḥ pratnavanno bharadvājavadvidhate maghoni | suvīraṃ rayiṃ gṛṇate rirīhyurugāyamadhi dhehi śravo naḥ ||

translations.english: Verily, Uṣas, the Aṅgirasas through your (favour) recover the herd of cattle from the summit of the mountain; by adoration and by prayer they have divided (the rock); unfailing was the praise of the gods uttered by the oleaders (of rites).

mantras.sanskrit: वपुर्नु तच्चिकितुषे चिदस्तु समानं नाम धेनु पत्यमानम् । मर्तेष्वन्यद्दोहसे पीपाय सकृच्छुक्रं दुदुहे पृश्निरूधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vapurnu taccikituṣe cidastu samānaṃ nāma dhenu patyamānam | marteṣvanyaddohase pīpāya sakṛcchukraṃ duduhe pṛśnirūdhaḥ ||

translations.english: May the like-formed, benevolent, all-pervading, all humiliating troop (of the Maruts) be promptly with the prudent man; the troop that ever cherishes all that among mortals is designed to yield (them) advantage; and (at whose wil) Pṛśni gives milk from (her) bright udder once (in the year).

mantras.sanskrit: ये अग्नयो न शोशुचन्निधाना द्विर्यत्त्रिर्मरुतो वावृधन्त । अरेणवो हिरण्ययास एषां साकं नृम्णैः पौंस्येभिश्च भूवन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye agnayo na śośucannidhānā dviryattrirmaruto vāvṛdhanta | areṇavo hiraṇyayāsa eṣāṃ sākaṃ nṛmṇaiḥ pauṃsyebhiśca bhūvan ||

translations.english: Unsoiled by dust the golden chariots of those Maruts, who are shining like kindled fires, enlarging themselves (at will) twofold and threefold, and (charged) with riches and virile energies, are manifest.

mantras.sanskrit: रुद्रस्य ये मीळ्हुषः सन्ति पुत्रा याँश्चो नु दाधृविर्भरध्यै । विदे हि माता महो मही षा सेत्पृश्निः सुभ्वे गर्भमाधात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: rudrasya ye mīḷhuṣaḥ santi putrā yā~śco nu dādhṛvirbharadhyai | vide hi mātā maho mahī ṣā setpṛśniḥ subhve garbhamādhāt ||

translations.english: They (who are) the sons of the showerer Rudra, whom the nursing (firmamen is able) to sustain, and of whom, the mighty ones, it is known that the great Pṛśni has received the germ for the benefit (of man).

mantras.sanskrit: न य ईषन्ते जनुषोऽया न्वन्तः सन्तोऽवद्यानि पुनानाः । निर्यद्दुह्रे शुचयोऽनु जोषमनु श्रिया तन्वमुक्षमाणाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: na ya īṣante januṣo'yā nvantaḥ santo'vadyāni punānāḥ | niryadduhre śucayo'nu joṣamanu śriyā tanvamukṣamāṇāḥ ||

translations.english: They who approach not to men any conveyance, being already in their hearts, purifying their defects; when brilliant they supply their milk (the rain) for the gratification (of their worshippers); they are watering the earth (manifesting their collective); from with splendour.

mantras.sanskrit: मक्षू न येषु दोहसे चिदया आ नाम धृष्णु मारुतं दधानाः । न ये स्तौना अयासो मह्ना नू चित्सुदानुरव यासदुग्रान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: makṣū na yeṣu dohase cidayā ā nāma dhṛṣṇu mārutaṃ dadhānāḥ | na ye staunā ayāso mahnā nū citsudānurava yāsadugrān ||

translations.english: Approaching nigh to whom, and repeating the mighty name of the Maruts, (the worshipper is able) quickly to obtain (his wishes); the liberal donor pacifies the angry Maruts, who are otherwise in their might the resistless plural nderers (of their wealth).

mantras.sanskrit: त इदुग्राः शवसा धृष्णुषेणा उभे युजन्त रोदसी सुमेके । अध स्मैषु रोदसी स्वशोचिरामवत्सु तस्थौ न रोकः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ta idugrāḥ śavasā dhṛṣṇuṣeṇā ubhe yujanta rodasī sumeke | adha smaiṣu rodasī svaśocirāmavatsu tasthau na rokaḥ ||

translations.english: THose fierce and powerfully arrayed (Maruts) unite by their strength the two beautiful (regions) heaven and earth; in them, the self-radiant, heaven and earth abide; the obstruction (of light) dwells not in those mighty ones.

mantras.sanskrit: अनेनो वो मरुतो यामो अस्त्वनश्वश्चिद्यमजत्यरथीः । अनवसो अनभीशू रजस्तूर्वि रोदसी पथ्या याति साधन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: aneno vo maruto yāmo astvanaśvaścidyamajatyarathīḥ | anavaso anabhīśū rajastūrvi rodasī pathyā yāti sādhan ||

translations.english: May your chariot, Maruts, be devoid of wickedness; that which (the worshipper) impels, and which without driver, without horses, without provender, without traces, scattering water and accomplishing (desires), traverses heaven and earth and the paths (of the firmament).

mantras.sanskrit: नास्य वर्ता न तरुता न्वस्ति मरुतो यमवथ वाजसातौ । तोके वा गोषु तनये यमप्सु स व्रजं दर्ता पार्ये अध द्योः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nāsya vartā na tarutā nvasti maruto yamavatha vājasātau | toke vā goṣu tanaye yamapsu sa vrajaṃ dartā pārye adha dyoḥ ||

translations.english: There is no propeller, no obstructer, of him, whom, Maruts, you protect in battle; he whom (you prosper) with sons, grandsons, cattle, and water, is in war the despoiler of the herds of his ardent (foes).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र चित्रमर्कं गृणते तुराय मारुताय स्वतवसे भरध्वम् । ये सहांसि सहसा सहन्ते रेजते अग्ने पृथिवी मखेभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra citramarkaṃ gṛṇate turāya mārutāya svatavase bharadhvam | ye sahāṃsi sahasā sahante rejate agne pṛthivī makhebhyaḥ ||

translations.english: Offer to the loud-sounding, quick-moving, self-invigorating company of the Maruts, excellent (sacrificial) food; (to them) who overcome strength by strength; the earth trembles, Agni, at the adorable (Maruts).

mantras.sanskrit: त्विषीमन्तो अध्वरस्येव दिद्युत्तृषुच्यवसो जुह्वो नाग्नेः । अर्चत्रयो धुनयो न वीरा भ्राजज्जन्मानो मरुतो अधृष्टाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tviṣīmanto adhvarasyeva didyuttṛṣucyavaso juhvo nāgneḥ | arcatrayo dhunayo na vīrā bhrājajjanmāno maruto adhṛṣṭāḥ ||

translations.english: The Maruts are resplendent as if iluminators of the sacrifice, (bright) as he flames of Agni; entitled are they to donation, and like heroes making (adversaries) tremble; brilliant are they from birth, and invincible.

mantras.sanskrit: तं वृधन्तं मारुतं भ्राजदृष्टिं रुद्रस्य सूनुं हवसा विवासे । दिवः शर्धाय शुचयो मनीषा गिरयो नाप उग्रा अस्पृध्रन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ vṛdhantaṃ mārutaṃ bhrājadṛṣṭiṃ rudrasya sūnuṃ havasā vivāse | divaḥ śardhāya śucayo manīṣā girayo nāpa ugrā aspṛdhran ||

translations.english: I worship with oblations that exalted company of the Maruts, the progeny of Rudra, armed with shining lances; the pure and earnest praises of the devout (adorer) are emulous in the invigoration (of the Maruts), as the clouds (vie in the emission of the rain).

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वेषां वः सतां ज्येष्ठतमा गीर्भिर्मित्रावरुणा वावृधध्यै । सं या रश्मेव यमतुर्यमिष्ठा द्वा जनाँ असमा बाहुभिः स्वैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśveṣāṃ vaḥ satāṃ jyeṣṭhatamā gīrbhirmitrāvaruṇā vāvṛdhadhyai | saṃ yā raśmeva yamaturyamiṣṭhā dvā janā~ asamā bāhubhiḥ svaiḥ ||

translations.english: (I proceed) by my praises to exalt you, Mira and Varuṇa, the eldest of all existing things; you two, though not the same, are the irmest resrainers with your arms, and hold men back (from eil) as they check (horses) with reins.

mantras.sanskrit: इयं मद्वां प्र स्तृणीते मनीषोप प्रिया नमसा बर्हिरच्छ । यन्तं नो मित्रावरुणावधृष्टं छर्दिर्यद्वां वरूथ्यं सुदानू ॥
mantras.transliteration: iyaṃ madvāṃ pra stṛṇīte manīṣopa priyā namasā barhiraccha | yantaṃ no mitrāvaruṇāvadhṛṣṭaṃ chardiryadvāṃ varūthyaṃ sudānū ||

translations.english: This my praise is addressed to you both, and proceeds to you beloved (deities) together with the oblation; the sacred grass is spread before you; grant us, Mitra and Varuṇa an unassailable dwelling, that through your favour, munificent divinities, may be a (secure) shelter.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यातं मित्रावरुणा सुशस्त्युप प्रिया नमसा हूयमाना । सं यावप्नःस्थो अपसेव जनाञ्छ्रुधीयतश्चिद्यतथो महित्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yātaṃ mitrāvaruṇā suśastyupa priyā namasā hūyamānā | saṃ yāvapnaḥstho apaseva janāñchrudhīyataścidyatatho mahitvā ||

translations.english: Come, Mitra and Varuṇa, beloved by all, and invoked with reveence to the propitious ite, you who by your bounty support men labouring for sustenance as a work man (maintains himself) by work.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्वा न या वाजिना पूतबन्धू ऋता यद्गर्भमदितिर्भरध्यै । प्र या महि महान्ता जायमाना घोरा मर्ताय रिपवे नि दीधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvā na yā vājinā pūtabandhū ṛtā yadgarbhamaditirbharadhyai | pra yā mahi mahāntā jāyamānā ghorā martāya ripave ni dīdhaḥ ||

translations.english: Who (are) strong as horses, accepters or pious praise, observers of truth, whom Aditi conceived; whom, mighty of the mighty at your birth and formidable to mortal foes, she bore.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वे यद्वां मंहना मन्दमानाः क्षत्रं देवासो अदधुः सजोषाः । परि यद्भूथो रोदसी चिदुर्वी सन्ति स्पशो अदब्धासो अमूराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśve yadvāṃ maṃhanā mandamānāḥ kṣatraṃ devāso adadhuḥ sajoṣāḥ | pari yadbhūtho rodasī cidurvī santi spaśo adabdhāso amūrāḥ ||

translations.english: Inasmuch as all the gods equally plural ased and rejoicing in your greatness conferred strength upon you, and since you are pre-eminen over the wide heaven and earth, your courses are unobstructed, unimpeded.

mantras.sanskrit: ता हि क्षत्रं धारयेथे अनु द्यून्दृंहेथे सानुमुपमादिव द्योः । दृळ्हो नक्षत्र उत विश्वदेवो भूमिमातान्द्यां धासिनायोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā hi kṣatraṃ dhārayethe anu dyūndṛṃhethe sānumupamādiva dyoḥ | dṛḷho nakṣatra uta viśvadevo bhūmimātāndyāṃ dhāsināyoḥ ||

translations.english: You manifest vigour daily, you strengthen the summit of the sky as if with a pillar; the solid firmamen and the universal deity (the sun) replenish earth and heaven with the food of man.

mantras.sanskrit: ता विग्रं धैथे जठरं पृणध्या आ यत्सद्म सभृतयः पृणन्ति । न मृष्यन्ते युवतयोऽवाता वि यत्पयो विश्वजिन्वा भरन्ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā vigraṃ dhaithe jaṭharaṃ pṛṇadhyā ā yatsadma sabhṛtayaḥ pṛṇanti | na mṛṣyante yuvatayo'vātā vi yatpayo viśvajinvā bharante ||

translations.english: You two support the sage (worshipper), filling his belly when he and his dependants fill the sacrificial chamber; when sustainers of all, the rain (is sent down by you), and the young (rivers) are not obstructed, but, undried, diffuse (fertility) around.

mantras.sanskrit: ता जिह्वया सदमेदं सुमेधा आ यद्वां सत्यो अरतिॠते भूत् । तद्वां महित्वं घृतान्नावस्तु युवं दाशुषे वि चयिष्टमंहः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā jihvayā sadamedaṃ sumedhā ā yadvāṃ satyo aratiṝte bhūt | tadvāṃ mahitvaṃ ghṛtānnāvastu yuvaṃ dāśuṣe vi cayiṣṭamaṃhaḥ ||

translations.english: The wise man always (solicits) you his prayers for this (supply of water), when approaching you sincer in sacrifice; may your magnanimity be such that you, the feeders upon ghī, may exterminate sin in the donor (of the oblation);

mantras.sanskrit: प्र यद्वां मित्रावरुणा स्पूर्धन्प्रिया धाम युवधिता मिनन्ति । न ये देवास ओहसा न मर्ता अयज्ञसाचो अप्यो न पुत्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra yadvāṃ mitrāvaruṇā spūrdhanpriyā dhāma yuvadhitā minanti | na ye devāsa ohasā na martā ayajñasāco apyo na putrāḥ ||

translations.english: (Exterminate also), Mitra and Varuṇa those who emulously contending, disturb the rites that are agreeable and beneficial to you both; those divinities, those mortals, who are not diligent in adoration, those who performing works perform not sacrifices, those who do not propitiate you.

mantras.sanskrit: वि यद्वाचं कीस्तासो भरन्ते शंसन्ति के चिन्निविदो मनानाः । आद्वां ब्रवाम सत्यान्युक्था नकिर्देवेभिर्यतथो महित्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi yadvācaṃ kīstāso bharante śaṃsanti ke cinnivido manānāḥ | ādvāṃ bravāma satyānyukthā nakirdevebhiryatatho mahitvā ||

translations.english: When the intelligent (priests) offer praise, then some of them, glorifying (Agni and other deities), recite the Nivid hymns; such being the case, we address to you sincere adoration, for in consequence of your greatness you do not associate with (other) divinities.

mantras.sanskrit: अवोरित्था वां छर्दिषो अभिष्टौ युवोर्मित्रावरुणावस्कृधोयु । अनु यद्गावः स्फुरानृजिप्यं धृष्णुं यद्रणे वृषणं युनजन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: avoritthā vāṃ chardiṣo abhiṣṭau yuvormitrāvaruṇāvaskṛdhoyu | anu yadgāvaḥ sphurānṛjipyaṃ dhṛṣṇuṃ yadraṇe vṛṣaṇaṃ yunajan ||

translations.english: Upon your approach, Mitra and Varuṇa, protectors of the dwelling, your (bounty) is unlimited; when (your) praises are uttered, and the sacrificers add in the ceremony the Soma that inspires straightforwardness and resoluion, and is the showerer (of benefits).

mantras.sanskrit: श्रुष्टी वां यज्ञ उद्यतः सजोषा मनुष्वद्वृक्तबर्हिषो यजध्यै । आ य इन्द्रावरुणाविषे अद्य महे सुम्नाय मह आववर्तत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śruṣṭī vāṃ yajña udyataḥ sajoṣā manuṣvadvṛktabarhiṣo yajadhyai | ā ya indrāvaruṇāviṣe adya mahe sumnāya maha āvavartat ||

translations.english: Mighty Indra and Varuṇa, promptly has the Soma returned, engaged conscientiously (with the priests) to offer sacrifice to you to obtain food for him by whom, like Manu, the sacred grass has been clipped; he who (invited you hither) today for exceeding happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: ता हि श्रेष्ठा देवताता तुजा शूराणां शविष्ठा ता हि भूतम् । मघोनां मंहिष्ठा तुविशुष्म ऋतेन वृत्रतुरा सर्वसेना ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā hi śreṣṭhā devatātā tujā śūrāṇāṃ śaviṣṭhā tā hi bhūtam | maghonāṃ maṃhiṣṭhā tuviśuṣma ṛtena vṛtraturā sarvasenā ||

translations.english: You two are the principal (divinities) at the worship of the gods; the distributors of wealth; the most vigorous of heroes; the most liberal among the opulent; possessed of vast strength; destroyers of foes by truth; entire hosts (of yourselves).

mantras.sanskrit: ता गृणीहि नमस्येभिः शूषैः सुम्नेभिरिन्द्रावरुणा चकाना । वज्रेणान्यः शवसा हन्ति वृत्रं सिषक्त्यन्यो वृजनेषु विप्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā gṛṇīhi namasyebhiḥ śūṣaiḥ sumnebhirindrāvaruṇā cakānā | vajreṇānyaḥ śavasā hanti vṛtraṃ siṣaktyanyo vṛjaneṣu vipraḥ ||

translations.english: Praise Mitra and Varuṇa, renowned or all glorious energies and enjoyment; one of whom slays Vṛtra with the thunderbolt, the other, intelligent by his might, comes to the aid (of the pious when) in difficulties.

mantras.sanskrit: ग्नाश्च यन्नरश्च वावृधन्त विश्वे देवासो नरां स्वगूर्ताः । प्रैभ्य इन्द्रावरुणा महित्वा द्यौश्च पृथिवि भूतमुर्वी ॥
mantras.transliteration: gnāśca yannaraśca vāvṛdhanta viśve devāso narāṃ svagūrtāḥ | praibhya indrāvaruṇā mahitvā dyauśca pṛthivi bhūtamurvī ||

translations.english: When among mankind, both males and feminine les, and when all the gods spontaneously striving glorify you, Indra and Varuṇa, you become pre-eminent in greatness over them, as do you, wide heaven and earth (surpass them also).

mantras.sanskrit: स इत्सुदानुः स्ववाँ ऋतावेन्द्रा यो वां वरुण दाशति त्मन् । इषा स द्विषस्तरेद्दास्वान्वंसद्रयिं रयिवतश्च जनान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa itsudānuḥ svavā~ ṛtāvendrā yo vāṃ varuṇa dāśati tman | iṣā sa dviṣastareddāsvānvaṃsadrayiṃ rayivataśca janān ||

translations.english: He who spontaneously presents you, Indra and Varuṇa (oblations), is liberal, wealthy and upright; he has to prosper with the food of his adversary, and possess riches, and opulent descendants.

mantras.sanskrit: यं युवं दाश्वध्वराय देवा रयिं धत्थो वसुमन्तं पुरुक्षुम् । अस्मे स इन्द्रावरुणावपि ष्यात्प्र यो भनक्ति वनुषामशस्तीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ yuvaṃ dāśvadhvarāya devā rayiṃ dhattho vasumantaṃ purukṣum | asme sa indrāvaruṇāvapi ṣyātpra yo bhanakti vanuṣāmaśastīḥ ||

translations.english: May that opulence comprising treasure and abundant food, which you besow, deities, upon the donor (of the oblation), that, Indra and Varuṇa, which baffles the calumnies of the malevolent, be ours.

mantras.sanskrit: उत नः सुत्रात्रो देवगोपाः सूरिभ्य इन्द्रावरुणा रयिः ष्यात् । येषां शुष्मः पृतनासु साह्वान्प्र सद्यो द्युम्ना तिरते ततुरिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta naḥ sutrātro devagopāḥ sūribhya indrāvaruṇā rayiḥ ṣyāt | yeṣāṃ śuṣmaḥ pṛtanāsu sāhvānpra sadyo dyumnā tirate taturiḥ ||

translations.english: May that opulence, Indra and Varuṇa, which is a sure defence, and of which the gods are the guardians, be ours, celebrating our praise, whose destroying prowess in battles victorious (over foes) speedily obscures (their) fame.

mantras.sanskrit: नू न इन्द्रावरुणा गृणाना पृङ्क्तं रयिं सौश्रवसाय देवा । इत्था गृणन्तो महिनस्य शर्धोऽपो न नावा दुरिता तरेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū na indrāvaruṇā gṛṇānā pṛṅktaṃ rayiṃ sauśravasāya devā | itthā gṛṇanto mahinasya śardho'po na nāvā duritā tarema ||

translations.english: Divine and glorified Indra and Varuṇa, quickly bestow upon us wealth for our felicity; and thus eulogising he strength of you two, mighty (deities), may we pass over all difficulties as (we cross) the waters with a boat.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सम्राजे बृहते मन्म नु प्रियमर्च देवाय वरुणाय सप्रथः । अयं य उर्वी महिना महिव्रतः क्रत्वा विभात्यजरो न शोचिषा ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra samrāje bṛhate manma nu priyamarca devāya varuṇāya saprathaḥ | ayaṃ ya urvī mahinā mahivrataḥ kratvā vibhātyajaro na śociṣā ||

translations.english: Repeat acceptable and all-comprehensive praise to the imperial mighty divine Varuṇa, he who, endowed with greatness, with wisdom, and with splendour, illumines the spacious (heaven and earth).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रावरुणा सुतपाविमं सुतं सोमं पिबतं मद्यं धृतव्रता । युवो रथो अध्वरं देववीतये प्रति स्वसरमुप याति पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāvaruṇā sutapāvimaṃ sutaṃ somaṃ pibataṃ madyaṃ dhṛtavratā | yuvo ratho adhvaraṃ devavītaye prati svasaramupa yāti pītaye ||

translations.english: Indra and Varuṇa, observant of holy duties, drinkers of the Soma, drink this exhilarating effused libation; your chariot approaches along the road to the sacrifice, (that you may partake) of the food of the gods and drink (the Soma).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रावरुणा मधुमत्तमस्य वृष्णः सोमस्य वृषणा वृषेथाम् । इदं वामन्धः परिषिक्तमस्मे आसद्यास्मिन्बर्हिषि मादयेथाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāvaruṇā madhumattamasya vṛṣṇaḥ somasya vṛṣaṇā vṛṣethām | idaṃ vāmandhaḥ pariṣiktamasme āsadyāsminbarhiṣi mādayethām ||

translations.english: Drink, Indra and Varuṇa, showerers (of benefits), of the most sweet Soma, the shedder (of blessings); this your Soma, is poured forth by us; sitting on the sacred grass, be exhilarated (by the draught).

mantras.sanskrit: सं वां कर्मणा समिषा हिनोमीन्द्राविष्णू अपसस्पारे अस्य । जुषेथां यज्ञं द्रविणं च धत्तमरिष्टैर्नः पथिभिः पारयन्ता ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ vāṃ karmaṇā samiṣā hinomīndrāviṣṇū apasaspāre asya | juṣethāṃ yajñaṃ draviṇaṃ ca dhattamariṣṭairnaḥ pathibhiḥ pārayantā ||

translations.english: I earnestly propitiate you, Indra and Viṣṇu, by worship and (sacrificial) food; upon the completion of the ite, accept the sacrifice, and grant us wealth, conducting us by safe path.

mantras.sanskrit: या विश्वासां जनितारा मतीनामिन्द्राविष्णू कलशा सोमधाना । प्र वां गिरः शस्यमाना अवन्तु प्र स्तोमासो गीयमानासो अर्कैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā viśvāsāṃ janitārā matīnāmindrāviṣṇū kalaśā somadhānā | pra vāṃ giraḥ śasyamānā avantu pra stomāso gīyamānāso arkaiḥ ||

translations.english: May the prayers that are prepared to you reach you, Indra and Viṣṇu; may the praises that are chanted reach you; you are the genitive rators of all praisses, pitchers recipient of the Soma libation.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राविष्णू मदपती मदानामा सोमं यातं द्रविणो दधाना । सं वामञ्जन्त्वक्तुभिर्मतीनां सं स्तोमासः शस्यमानास उक्थैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāviṣṇū madapatī madānāmā somaṃ yātaṃ draviṇo dadhānā | saṃ vāmañjantvaktubhirmatīnāṃ saṃ stomāsaḥ śasyamānāsa ukthaiḥ ||

translations.english: Indra and Viṣṇu, lords of the exhilaration, of the exhilarating Soma, come to (drink) the Soma, bringing (with you) wealth; may the encomiums of the praises repeated along with the prayers anoint you completely with radiance.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वामश्वासो अभिमातिषाह इन्द्राविष्णू सधमादो वहन्तु । जुषेथां विश्वा हवना मतीनामुप ब्रह्माणि शृणुतं गिरो मे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāmaśvāso abhimātiṣāha indrāviṣṇū sadhamādo vahantu | juṣethāṃ viśvā havanā matīnāmupa brahmāṇi śṛṇutaṃ giro me ||

translations.english: May your equaly-spirited steeds, Indra and Viṣṇu, the triumphant over enemies, bear you hither, be plural ased with all the invocations of your worshippers; hear my prayers and praises.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राविष्णू तत्पनयाय्यं वां सोमस्य मद उरु चक्रमाथे । अकृणुतमन्तरिक्षं वरीयोऽप्रथतं जीवसे नो रजांसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāviṣṇū tatpanayāyyaṃ vāṃ somasya mada uru cakramāthe | akṛṇutamantarikṣaṃ varīyo'prathataṃ jīvase no rajāṃsi ||

translations.english: Indra and Viṣṇu, that (exploit) is to be glorified, by which, in the exhilaration of the Soma, you have strode over the wide (space); you have traversed the wide firmament; you have declared the worlds (fit) for our existence.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राविष्णू हविषा वावृधानाग्राद्वाना नमसा रातहव्या । घृतासुती द्रविणं धत्तमस्मे समुद्रः स्थः कलशः सोमधानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāviṣṇū haviṣā vāvṛdhānāgrādvānā namasā rātahavyā | ghṛtāsutī draviṇaṃ dhattamasme samudraḥ sthaḥ kalaśaḥ somadhānaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra and Viṣṇu, feeders upon clarified butter, drinkers of he fermented Soma, thriving upon oblations, accepting them offered with reverence, bestow upon us wealth; for you are an ocean, a pitcher, the receptacle of the libation.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राविष्णू पिबतं मध्वो अस्य सोमस्य दस्रा जठरं पृणेथाम् । आ वामन्धांसि मदिराण्यग्मन्नुप ब्रह्माणि शृणुतं हवं मे ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāviṣṇū pibataṃ madhvo asya somasya dasrā jaṭharaṃ pṛṇethām | ā vāmandhāṃsi madirāṇyagmannupa brahmāṇi śṛṇutaṃ havaṃ me ||

translations.english: Indra and Viṣṇu, agreeable of aspect, drink of this sweet Soma; fill with it your bellies; may the inebriating Soma reach you; hear my prayers, my invocation.

mantras.sanskrit: उभा जिग्यथुर्न परा जयेथे न परा जिग्ये कतरश्चनैनोः । इन्द्रश्च विष्णो यदपस्पृधेथां त्रेधा सहस्रं वि तदैरयेथाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ubhā jigyathurna parā jayethe na parā jigye kataraścanainoḥ | indraśca viṣṇo yadapaspṛdhethāṃ tredhā sahasraṃ vi tadairayethām ||

translations.english: You have both (ever) been victorious; never have been conquered; neither of you two has been vanquished; with whomsoever you have contended you have thrice conquered thousands.

mantras.sanskrit: घृतवती भुवनानामभिश्रियोर्वी पृथ्वी मधुदुघे सुपेशसा । द्यावापृथिवी वरुणस्य धर्मणा विष्कभिते अजरे भूरिरेतसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ghṛtavatī bhuvanānāmabhiśriyorvī pṛthvī madhudughe supeśasā | dyāvāpṛthivī varuṇasya dharmaṇā viṣkabhite ajare bhūriretasā ||

translations.english: Radiant Heaven and Earth, the asylum of created beings, you are spacious, manifold, water-yielding, lovely, separately fixed by the functions of Varuṇa, undecaying, many-germed.

mantras.sanskrit: असश्चन्ती भूरिधारे पयस्वती घृतं दुहाते सुकृते शुचिव्रते । राजन्ती अस्य भुवनस्य रोदसी अस्मे रेतः सिञ्चतं यन्मनुर्हितम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asaścantī bhūridhāre payasvatī ghṛtaṃ duhāte sukṛte śucivrate | rājantī asya bhuvanasya rodasī asme retaḥ siñcataṃ yanmanurhitam ||

translations.english: Uncollapsing, many-showering, water retaining, yielding moisture, beneficent, pure in act; do you two, Heaven and Earth, rulers over created beings, grant us vigour, that may be favourable to (the increase of) mankind.

mantras.sanskrit: यो वामृजवे क्रमणाय रोदसी मर्तो ददाश धिषणे स साधति । प्र प्रजाभिर्जायते धर्मणस्परि युवोः सिक्ता विषुरूपाणि सव्रता ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo vāmṛjave kramaṇāya rodasī marto dadāśa dhiṣaṇe sa sādhati | pra prajābhirjāyate dharmaṇaspari yuvoḥ siktā viṣurūpāṇi savratā ||

translations.english: Firm-set Heaven and Earth, the mortal who has offered (oblations) for your straight-forward course, accomplishes (his objects), he prospers with progeny, and invigorated by your operation, many beings of various forms, but similar functions, are engendeed.

mantras.sanskrit: घृतेन द्यावापृथिवी अभीवृते घृतश्रिया घृतपृचा घृतावृधा । उर्वी पृथ्वी होतृवूर्ये पुरोहिते ते इद्विप्रा ईळते सुम्नमिष्टये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ghṛtena dyāvāpṛthivī abhīvṛte ghṛtaśriyā ghṛtapṛcā ghṛtāvṛdhā | urvī pṛthvī hotṛvūrye purohite te idviprā īḷate sumnamiṣṭaye ||

translations.english: You are surrounded, Heaven and Earth, by water; you are the asylum of water; imbued with water; the augmenters of water; vast and manifold; you are first propitiated in the sacrifice; the pious pray to you for happiness, that the sacrifice (may be celebrated).

mantras.sanskrit: मधु नो द्यावापृथिवी मिमिक्षतां मधुश्चुता मधुदुघे मधुव्रते । दधाने यज्ञं द्रविणं च देवता महि श्रवो वाजमस्मे सुवीर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: madhu no dyāvāpṛthivī mimikṣatāṃ madhuścutā madhudughe madhuvrate | dadhāne yajñaṃ draviṇaṃ ca devatā mahi śravo vājamasme suvīryam ||

translations.english: May Heaven and Earth, the effusers of water, the milkers of water, dischargers of the functions of water, divinities, the promoters of sacrifice, the bestowers of wealth, of renown, of food, of male posterity, combine together.

mantras.sanskrit: ऊर्जं नो द्यौश्च पृथिवी च पिन्वतां पिता माता विश्वविदा सुदंससा । संरराणे रोदसी विश्वशम्भुवा सनिं वाजं रयिमस्मे समिन्वताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūrjaṃ no dyauśca pṛthivī ca pinvatāṃ pitā mātā viśvavidā sudaṃsasā | saṃrarāṇe rodasī viśvaśambhuvā saniṃ vājaṃ rayimasme saminvatām ||

translations.english: May father Heaven, may mother Earth, who are all-knowing, and doers of good deeds, grant us sustenance; may Heaven and Earth, mutually co-operating and promoting the happiness of all, bestow upon us posterity, food, and riches.

mantras.sanskrit: उदु ष्य देवः सविता हिरण्यया बाहू अयंस्त सवनाय सुक्रतुः । घृतेन पाणी अभि प्रुष्णुते मखो युवा सुदक्षो रजसो विधर्मणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: udu ṣya devaḥ savitā hiraṇyayā bāhū ayaṃsta savanāya sukratuḥ | ghṛtena pāṇī abhi pruṣṇute makho yuvā sudakṣo rajaso vidharmaṇi ||

translations.english: The divine and benevolent Savitā puts forth his golden arms for (making) donations; the adorable, youthful, sagacious (deity), stretches out his hands, filled with water, in the various services of the world.

mantras.sanskrit: देवस्य वयं सवितुः सवीमनि श्रेष्ठे स्याम वसुनश्च दावने । यो विश्वस्य द्विपदो यश्चतुष्पदो निवेशने प्रसवे चासि भूमनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: devasya vayaṃ savituḥ savīmani śreṣṭhe syāma vasunaśca dāvane | yo viśvasya dvipado yaścatuṣpado niveśane prasave cāsi bhūmanaḥ ||

translations.english: May we be among the progeny of the divine Savitā, and (have power) to offer him most excellent donations; for you are he who (are absolute) in the procreation and perpetuation of many (living beings), bipeds and quadrupeds.

mantras.sanskrit: अदब्धेभिः सवितः पायुभिष्ट्वं शिवेभिरद्य परि पाहि नो गयम् । हिरण्यजिह्वः सुविताय नव्यसे रक्षा माकिर्नो अघशंस ईशत ॥
mantras.transliteration: adabdhebhiḥ savitaḥ pāyubhiṣṭvaṃ śivebhiradya pari pāhi no gayam | hiraṇyajihvaḥ suvitāya navyase rakṣā mākirno aghaśaṃsa īśata ||

translations.english: Do you, Savitā, posper today our dwelling with uninjurable protections, confirming happiness; do you, who are golden-tongued, (be vigilant) for our present prosperity; protect us; let not any calumniator have power (to harm) us.

mantras.sanskrit: उदु ष्य देवः सविता दमूना हिरण्यपाणिः प्रतिदोषमस्थात् । अयोहनुर्यजतो मन्द्रजिह्व आ दाशुषे सुवति भूरि वामम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: udu ṣya devaḥ savitā damūnā hiraṇyapāṇiḥ pratidoṣamasthāt | ayohanuryajato mandrajihva ā dāśuṣe suvati bhūri vāmam ||

translations.english: May the divine, munificent, golden-handed, golden-jawed, adorable, sweet-spoken Savitā, rise regularly at the close of night; when he besows abundant and desirable (food) upon the donor of the oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: उदू अयाँ उपवक्तेव बाहू हिरण्यया सविता सुप्रतीका । दिवो रोहांस्यरुहत्पृथिव्या अरीरमत्पतयत्कच्चिदभ्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: udū ayā~ upavakteva bāhū hiraṇyayā savitā supratīkā | divo rohāṃsyaruhatpṛthivyā arīramatpatayatkaccidabhvam ||

translations.english: May Savitā put forth like an orator his golden well-formed arms; (he who), from the ends of the earth, ascends to the summit of the sky, and, moving along, delights every thing that is.

mantras.sanskrit: वाममद्य सवितर्वाममु श्वो दिवेदिवे वाममस्मभ्यं सावीः । वामस्य हि क्षयस्य देव भूरेरया धिया वामभाजः स्याम ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāmamadya savitarvāmamu śvo divedive vāmamasmabhyaṃ sāvīḥ | vāmasya hi kṣayasya deva bhūrerayā dhiyā vāmabhājaḥ syāma ||

translations.english: Beget for us, Savitā, wealth today, wealth tomorrow, wealth day by day; you are the giver of ample wealth, of a (spacious) mansion; may we, by this praise, become partakers of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रासोमा महि तद्वां महित्वं युवं महानि प्रथमानि चक्रथुः । युवं सूर्यं विविदथुर्युवं स्वर्विश्वा तमांस्यहतं निदश्च ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāsomā mahi tadvāṃ mahitvaṃ yuvaṃ mahāni prathamāni cakrathuḥ | yuvaṃ sūryaṃ vividathuryuvaṃ svarviśvā tamāṃsyahataṃ nidaśca ||

translations.english: Great, Indra and Soma, is that your greatness, for you have made great and principal (beings); you have made known (to men) Sūrya and the waters; you have dissipated the glooms and (desroyed) the revilers.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रासोमा वासयथ उषासमुत्सूर्यं नयथो ज्योतिषा सह । उप द्यां स्कम्भथुः स्कम्भनेनाप्रथतं पृथिवीं मातरं वि ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāsomā vāsayatha uṣāsamutsūryaṃ nayatho jyotiṣā saha | upa dyāṃ skambhathuḥ skambhanenāprathataṃ pṛthivīṃ mātaraṃ vi ||

translations.english: Indra and Soma, you have led on the dawns; you have upraised the sun with his splendour, you have propped up the sky with he supporting pillar (of the firmament); you have spread out the earth, the mother (of all).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रासोमावहिमपः परिष्ठां हथो वृत्रमनु वां द्यौरमन्यत । प्रार्णांस्यैरयतं नदीनामा समुद्राणि पप्रथुः पुरूणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāsomāvahimapaḥ pariṣṭhāṃ hatho vṛtramanu vāṃ dyauramanyata | prārṇāṃsyairayataṃ nadīnāmā samudrāṇi paprathuḥ purūṇi ||

translations.english: Indra and Soma, you slew Ahi and Vṛtra; the obstructer of the water; for which the heaven venerates you both; you have urged on the waters of the rivers until they have replenished numerous oceans.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रासोमा पक्वमामास्वन्तर्नि गवामिद्दधथुर्वक्षणासु । जगृभथुरनपिनद्धमासु रुशच्चित्रासु जगतीष्वन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāsomā pakvamāmāsvantarni gavāmiddadhathurvakṣaṇāsu | jagṛbhathuranapinaddhamāsu ruśaccitrāsu jagatīṣvantaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra and Soma, you have deposited the mature (milk) in the immature udders of the kine; you have retained the white (secretion), although not shut up within those may-coloured cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रासोमा युवमङ्ग तरुत्रमपत्यसाचं श्रुत्यं रराथे । युवं शुष्मं नर्यं चर्षणिभ्यः सं विव्यथुः पृतनाषाहमुग्रा ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāsomā yuvamaṅga tarutramapatyasācaṃ śrutyaṃ rarāthe | yuvaṃ śuṣmaṃ naryaṃ carṣaṇibhyaḥ saṃ vivyathuḥ pṛtanāṣāhamugrā ||

translations.english: Indra and Soma, do you promptly bestow upon us preservative, renowned (riches), accompanied by offspring; for you, fierce (divinities), have disseminated among men, strength, useful to man, victorious over hostile acts.

mantras.sanskrit: यो अद्रिभित्प्रथमजा ऋतावा बृहस्पतिराङ्गिरसो हविष्मान् । द्विबर्हज्मा प्राघर्मसत्पिता न आ रोदसी वृषभो रोरवीति ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo adribhitprathamajā ṛtāvā bṛhaspatirāṅgiraso haviṣmān | dvibarhajmā prāgharmasatpitā na ā rodasī vṛṣabho roravīti ||

translations.english: Bṛhaspati, who is the breaker of the mountain, the first-born (of Prajāpati), the observer of truth, the descendant of Aṅgirasa, the partaker of the oblation, the traverser of two worlds, abiding in the region of light, is to us a father; he, the showerer, hunders and in heaven and earth.

mantras.sanskrit: जनाय चिद्य ईवत उ लोकं बृहस्पतिर्देवहूतौ चकार । घ्नन्वृत्राणि वि पुरो दर्दरीति जयञ्छत्रूँरमित्रान्पृत्सु साहन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: janāya cidya īvata u lokaṃ bṛhaspatirdevahūtau cakāra | ghnanvṛtrāṇi vi puro dardarīti jayañchatrū~ramitrānpṛtsu sāhan ||

translations.english: Bṛhaspati, who has appointed a region for the man who attends diligently at divine worship, destroying impediments, conquering foes, overcoming enemies, demolished various cities (of the asuras).

mantras.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिः समजयद्वसूनि महो व्रजान्गोमतो देव एषः । अपः सिषासन्त्स्वरप्रतीतो बृहस्पतिर्हन्त्यमित्रमर्कैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhaspatiḥ samajayadvasūni maho vrajāngomato deva eṣaḥ | apaḥ siṣāsantsvarapratīto bṛhaspatirhantyamitramarkaiḥ ||

translations.english: This Bṛhaspati has conquered the treasures (of the enemy), and the spacious pastures with the cattle; purposing to appropriate he waters (of the firmament), he destroys with sacred prayers the adversary of heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: सोमारुद्रा धारयेथामसुर्यं प्र वामिष्टयोऽरमश्नुवन्तु । दमेदमे सप्त रत्ना दधाना शं नो भूतं द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: somārudrā dhārayethāmasuryaṃ pra vāmiṣṭayo'ramaśnuvantu | damedame sapta ratnā dadhānā śaṃ no bhūtaṃ dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade ||

translations.english: Soma and Rudra, confirm (in us the strength) of asuras may sacrifices in every dwelling adequately reach you; do you, possessors of the seven precious things, besow happiness upon us; happiness upon our bipeds and quadrupeds.

mantras.sanskrit: सोमारुद्रा वि वृहतं विषूचीममीवा या नो गयमाविवेश । आरे बाधेथां निॠतिं पराचैरस्मे भद्रा सौश्रवसानि सन्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: somārudrā vi vṛhataṃ viṣūcīmamīvā yā no gayamāviveśa | āre bādhethāṃ niṝtiṃ parācairasme bhadrā sauśravasāni santu ||

translations.english: Soma and Rudra, expel the widespread sickness that has entered into our dwellings; keep off Nirṛti, so that she may be far away, and may prosperous means of sustenance be ours.

mantras.sanskrit: सोमारुद्रा युवमेतान्यस्मे विश्वा तनूषु भेषजानि धत्तम् । अव स्यतं मुञ्चतं यन्नो अस्ति तनूषु बद्धं कृतमेनो अस्मत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: somārudrā yuvametānyasme viśvā tanūṣu bheṣajāni dhattam | ava syataṃ muñcataṃ yanno asti tanūṣu baddhaṃ kṛtameno asmat ||

translations.english: Soma and Rudra, grant all these medicamens for (the ailments of) our bodies; detach, set free, the perpetrated iniquity that has been bound up in our person ns.

mantras.sanskrit: तिग्मायुधौ तिग्महेती सुशेवौ सोमारुद्राविह सु मृळतं नः । प्र नो मुञ्चतं वरुणस्य पाशाद्गोपायतं नः सुमनस्यमाना ॥
mantras.transliteration: tigmāyudhau tigmahetī suśevau somārudrāviha su mṛḷataṃ naḥ | pra no muñcataṃ varuṇasya pāśādgopāyataṃ naḥ sumanasyamānā ||

translations.english: Sharp-weaponed, sharp-arrowed,  profoundly-honoured Soma and Rudra, grant us happiness in this world; propitiated by our praise, preserve us; liberate us from the bonds of Varuṇa.

mantras.sanskrit: जीमूतस्येव भवति प्रतीकं यद्वर्मी याति समदामुपस्थे । अनाविद्धया तन्वा जय त्वं स त्वा वर्मणो महिमा पिपर्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: jīmūtasyeva bhavati pratīkaṃ yadvarmī yāti samadāmupasthe | anāviddhayā tanvā jaya tvaṃ sa tvā varmaṇo mahimā pipartu ||

translations.english: When the mailed warrior advances in the front of battles, his form is like that of a cloud; with his body unwounded do you conquer; may the strength of the armous defend us.

mantras.sanskrit: धन्वना गा धन्वनाजिं जयेम धन्वना तीव्राः समदो जयेम । धनुः शत्रोरपकामं कृणोति धन्वना सर्वाः प्रदिशो जयेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhanvanā gā dhanvanājiṃ jayema dhanvanā tīvrāḥ samado jayema | dhanuḥ śatrorapakāmaṃ kṛṇoti dhanvanā sarvāḥ pradiśo jayema ||

translations.english: May we conquer the cattle (of the enemies) with the bow; with the bow may we be victorious in battle may we overcome our fierce-exulting (enemies) with the bow; may the bow disappoint the hope of the foe; may we subdue with the bow all (hostile) countries.

mantras.sanskrit: वक्ष्यन्तीवेदा गनीगन्ति कर्णं प्रियं सखायं परिषस्वजाना । योषेव शिङ्क्ते वितताधि धन्वञ्ज्या इयं समने पारयन्ती ॥
mantras.transliteration: vakṣyantīvedā ganīganti karṇaṃ priyaṃ sakhāyaṃ pariṣasvajānā | yoṣeva śiṅkte vitatādhi dhanvañjyā iyaṃ samane pārayantī ||

translations.english: This bowstring, drawn tight upon the bow, and making way in battle, repeatedly approaches the ear (of the warrior), as if embracing its friend (the arrow), and proposing to say something agreeable, as a woman whispers (to her husband).

mantras.sanskrit: ते आचरन्ती समनेव योषा मातेव पुत्रं बिभृतामुपस्थे । अप शत्रून्विध्यतां संविदाने आर्त्नी इमे विष्फुरन्ती अमित्रान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: te ācarantī samaneva yoṣā māteva putraṃ bibhṛtāmupasthe | apa śatrūnvidhyatāṃ saṃvidāne ārtnī ime viṣphurantī amitrān ||

translations.english: May the two extremities of the bow, acting in concert, like a wife sympathizing (with her husband), uphold (the warrior), as a mother nurses her child upon her lap; and may they, moving concurrently, and harassing the foe, scatter his enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: बह्वीनां पिता बहुरस्य पुत्रश्चिश्चा कृणोति समनावगत्य । इषुधिः सङ्काः पृतनाश्च सर्वाः पृष्ठे निनद्धो जयति प्रसूतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bahvīnāṃ pitā bahurasya putraściścā kṛṇoti samanāvagatya | iṣudhiḥ saṅkāḥ pṛtanāśca sarvāḥ pṛṣṭhe ninaddho jayati prasūtaḥ ||

translations.english: The quiver, the parent of many, of whom many are the sons, clangs as it enters into the battle; slung at the back (of the warrior), prolific (of its shafts), it overcomes all shouting hosts.

mantras.sanskrit: रथे तिष्ठन्नयति वाजिनः पुरो यत्रयत्र कामयते सुषारथिः । अभीशूनां महिमानं पनायत मनः पश्चादनु यच्छन्ति रश्मयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: rathe tiṣṭhannayati vājinaḥ puro yatrayatra kāmayate suṣārathiḥ | abhīśūnāṃ mahimānaṃ panāyata manaḥ paścādanu yacchanti raśmayaḥ ||

translations.english: The skilful charioteer, standing in the car, derives his horses before him whatsoever he will; praise the efficacy of the reins, for the reins from the back (of the car compel the steeds) to follow the intention (of the driver).

mantras.sanskrit: तीव्रान्घोषान्कृण्वते वृषपाणयोऽश्वा रथेभिः सह वाजयन्तः । अवक्रामन्तः प्रपदैरमित्रान्क्षिणन्ति शत्रूँरनपव्ययन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tīvrānghoṣānkṛṇvate vṛṣapāṇayo'śvā rathebhiḥ saha vājayantaḥ | avakrāmantaḥ prapadairamitrānkṣiṇanti śatrū~ranapavyayantaḥ ||

translations.english: The horses raising the dust with their hoofs, rushing on with the chariots, utter loud neighings, retreating not (from the charge), but trampling with their fore feet upon the enemies, they destroy them.

mantras.sanskrit: रथवाहनं हविरस्य नाम यत्रायुधं निहितमस्य वर्म । तत्रा रथमुप शग्मं सदेम विश्वाहा वयं सुमनस्यमानाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: rathavāhanaṃ havirasya nāma yatrāyudhaṃ nihitamasya varma | tatrā rathamupa śagmaṃ sadema viśvāhā vayaṃ sumanasyamānāḥ ||

translations.english: The spoil borne off in his car, in which his weapons and armour are deposited, is the appropriate oblation of the warrior; therefore let us, exulting, daily do honour to the joy-bestowing car.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वादुषंसदः पितरो वयोधाः कृच्छ्रेश्रितः शक्तीवन्तो गभीराः । चित्रसेना इषुबला अमृध्राः सतोवीरा उरवो व्रातसाहाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: svāduṣaṃsadaḥ pitaro vayodhāḥ kṛcchreśritaḥ śaktīvanto gabhīrāḥ | citrasenā iṣubalā amṛdhrāḥ satovīrā uravo vrātasāhāḥ ||

translations.english: The guards (of chariot), revelling in the savoury (spoil), distributors of food, protecors in calamity, armed with spears, resolute, beautifully arranged, strong in arrows, invincible, of heroic valour, robust, and conquerors of numerous hosts.

mantras.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणासः पितरः सोम्यासः शिवे नो द्यावापृथिवी अनेहसा । पूषा नः पातु दुरितादृतावृधो रक्षा माकिर्नो अघशंस ईशत ॥
mantras.transliteration: brāhmaṇāsaḥ pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ śive no dyāvāpṛthivī anehasā | pūṣā naḥ pātu duritādṛtāvṛdho rakṣā mākirno aghaśaṃsa īśata ||

translations.english: May the brāhmaṇas, the progenitors presenters of the Soma, the observers of truth, protect us; may the faultless heaven and earth be propitious to us; may Pūṣan preserve us from misfortune, let no calumniator prevail over us.

mantras.sanskrit: सुपर्णं वस्ते मृगो अस्या दन्तो गोभिः संनद्धा पतति प्रसूता । यत्रा नरः सं च वि च द्रवन्ति तत्रास्मभ्यमिषवः शर्म यंसन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: suparṇaṃ vaste mṛgo asyā danto gobhiḥ saṃnaddhā patati prasūtā | yatrā naraḥ saṃ ca vi ca dravanti tatrāsmabhyamiṣavaḥ śarma yaṃsan ||

translations.english: The arrow puts on a (feathery) wing; the (horn of the) deer is its point; it is bound with the sinews of the cow; it alights where directed; whenever men assemble or disperse, there may the shafts fall for an advantage.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋजीते परि वृङ्धि नोऽश्मा भवतु नस्तनूः । सोमो अधि ब्रवीतु नोऽदितिः शर्म यच्छतु ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛjīte pari vṛṅdhi no'śmā bhavatu nastanūḥ | somo adhi bravītu no'ditiḥ śarma yacchatu ||

translations.english: Straight-flying (arrow), defend us; may our bodies be stone; may Soma speak to us encouragement; may Aditi grant us success.

mantras.sanskrit: आ जङ्घन्ति सान्वेषां जघनाँ उप जिघ्नते । अश्वाजनि प्रचेतसोऽश्वान्त्समत्सु चोदय ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā jaṅghanti sānveṣāṃ jaghanā~ upa jighnate | aśvājani pracetaso'śvāntsamatsu codaya ||

translations.english: Whip, with which the skilful (charioteers) last their thighs and scourge their flanks, urge the horses in battles.

mantras.sanskrit: अहिरिव भोगैः पर्येति बाहुं ज्याया हेतिं परिबाधमानः । हस्तघ्नो विश्वा वयुनानि विद्वान्पुमान्पुमांसं परि पातु विश्वतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahiriva bhogaiḥ paryeti bāhuṃ jyāyā hetiṃ paribādhamānaḥ | hastaghno viśvā vayunāni vidvānpumānpumāṃsaṃ pari pātu viśvataḥ ||

translations.english: The ward of the fore-arm protecting it from the abrasion of the bow-string, surrounds the arm like a snake with its convulutions; may the brave man, experienced in the arts of war, defend a combatant on every side.

mantras.sanskrit: आलाक्ता या रुरुशीर्ष्ण्यथो यस्या अयो मुखम् । इदं पर्जन्यरेतस इष्वै देव्यै बृहन्नमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ālāktā yā ruruśīrṣṇyatho yasyā ayo mukham | idaṃ parjanyaretasa iṣvai devyai bṛhannamaḥ ||

translations.english: This praise (be offered) to the large celestial arrow, the growth of Parjanya, whose point is anointed with venom, whose blade is iron.

mantras.sanskrit: अवसृष्टा परा पत शरव्ये ब्रह्मसंशिते । गच्छामित्रान्प्र पद्यस्व मामीषां कं चनोच्छिषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: avasṛṣṭā parā pata śaravye brahmasaṃśite | gacchāmitrānpra padyasva māmīṣāṃ kaṃ canocchiṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Arrow, wheted by charms, fly when discharged; go light among the adversaries, spare not one of the enemy.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्र बाणाः सम्पतन्ति कुमारा विशिखा इव । तत्रा नो ब्रह्मणस्पतिरदितिः शर्म यच्छतु विश्वाहा शर्म यच्छतु ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatra bāṇāḥ sampatanti kumārā viśikhā iva | tatrā no brahmaṇaspatiraditiḥ śarma yacchatu viśvāhā śarma yacchatu ||

translations.english: Where arrows alight like shaven-headed boys may brahmaṇaspati, may Aditi, grant us happiness every day.

mantras.sanskrit: मर्माणि ते वर्मणा छादयामि सोमस्त्वा राजामृतेनानु वस्ताम् । उरोर्वरीयो वरुणस्ते कृणोतु जयन्तं त्वानु देवा मदन्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: marmāṇi te varmaṇā chādayāmi somastvā rājāmṛtenānu vastām | urorvarīyo varuṇaste kṛṇotu jayantaṃ tvānu devā madantu ||

translations.english: I cover your vital parts with armour; may the royal Soma invest you with ambrosia; may Varuṇa amplify your ample felicity; may the gods rejoice (at beholding you) triumphant.

mantras.sanskrit: यो नः स्वो अरणो यश्च निष्ट्यो जिघांसति । देवास्तं सर्वे धूर्वन्तु ब्रह्म वर्म ममान्तरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo naḥ svo araṇo yaśca niṣṭyo jighāṃsati | devāstaṃ sarve dhūrvantu brahma varma mamāntaram ||

translations.english: Whoever, whether an unfriendly relative or a stranger, desires to kill us, may all the gods destroy him; prayer is my best armour

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निं नरो दीधितिभिररण्योर्हस्तच्युती जनयन्त प्रशस्तम् । दूरेदृशं गृहपतिमथर्युम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniṃ naro dīdhitibhiraraṇyorhastacyutī janayanta praśastam | dūredṛśaṃ gṛhapatimatharyum ||

translations.english: Men genitive rate the excellent, far-gleaming maser of the mansion, the accessible Agni, present in the twosticks by attrition with their fingers.

mantras.sanskrit: तमग्निमस्ते वसवो न्यृण्वन्त्सुप्रतिचक्षमवसे कुतश्चित् । दक्षाय्यो यो दम आस नित्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamagnimaste vasavo nyṛṇvantsupraticakṣamavase kutaścit | dakṣāyyo yo dama āsa nityaḥ ||

translations.english: The dwellers have plural ced in the mansion, for its constant protection, that visible Agni, who has beenfrom ever, who is to be honoured in every house.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रेद्धो अग्ने दीदिहि पुरो नोऽजस्रया सूर्म्या यविष्ठ । त्वां शश्वन्त उप यन्ति वाजाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: preddho agne dīdihi puro no'jasrayā sūrmyā yaviṣṭha | tvāṃ śaśvanta upa yanti vājāḥ ||

translations.english: Well-kindled, youthful Agni, shine before us with undecaying radiance; to you abundant sacrificialviands proceed.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ते अग्नयोऽग्निभ्यो वरं निः सुवीरासः शोशुचन्त द्युमन्तः । यत्रा नरः समासते सुजाताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra te agnayo'gnibhyo varaṃ niḥ suvīrāsaḥ śośucanta dyumantaḥ | yatrā naraḥ samāsate sujātāḥ ||

translations.english: Those radiant fires, at which the well-bon sacrificers assemble, shine more brightly, and are morebountiful bestower of progeny (and other blessings), than the fires (of common life).

mantras.sanskrit: दा नो अग्ने धिया रयिं सुवीरं स्वपत्यं सहस्य प्रशस्तम् । न यं यावा तरति यातुमावान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dā no agne dhiyā rayiṃ suvīraṃ svapatyaṃ sahasya praśastam | na yaṃ yāvā tarati yātumāvān ||

translations.english: Vigorous Agni, grant to us, (in requital) of our praises, excellent riches, worthy male offspring, anddescendants; (wealth), which an enemy attemptin to assail, may not despoil.

mantras.sanskrit: उप यमेति युवतिः सुदक्षं दोषा वस्तोर्हविष्मती घृताची । उप स्वैनमरमतिर्वसूयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa yameti yuvatiḥ sudakṣaṃ doṣā vastorhaviṣmatī ghṛtācī | upa svainamaramatirvasūyuḥ ||

translations.english: Whom vigorous, the young damsel (the ladle) charged with the oblation, presenting the melted butter,day and night approaches; him, his own lustre approaches, favourable to (the bestowal of) wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वा अग्नेऽप दहारातीर्येभिस्तपोभिरदहो जरूथम् । प्र निस्वरं चातयस्वामीवाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvā agne'pa dahārātīryebhistapobhiradaho jarūtham | pra nisvaraṃ cātayasvāmīvām ||

translations.english: Consume, Agni, all enemies; with the same flames with which you have consumed Jarūtha, drive awayfebrile disease.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यस्ते अग्न इधते अनीकं वसिष्ठ शुक्र दीदिवः पावक । उतो न एभिः स्तवथैरिह स्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yaste agna idhate anīkaṃ vasiṣṭha śukra dīdivaḥ pāvaka | uto na ebhiḥ stavathairiha syāḥ ||

translations.english: Eminent, pure, radiating purifier, Agni, be present (at the sacrifice) of him who lights up your blaze, andat ours, (who address you) with these praises.

mantras.sanskrit: वि ये ते अग्ने भेजिरे अनीकं मर्ता नरः पित्र्यासः पुरुत्रा । उतो न एभिः सुमना इह स्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi ye te agne bhejire anīkaṃ martā naraḥ pitryāsaḥ purutrā | uto na ebhiḥ sumanā iha syāḥ ||

translations.english: Patriarchal mortals, leaders or rites have shared, Agni, your radiance in many plural ces; (propitiated) bythese our (praises, as by theirs), be present at this sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: इमे नरो वृत्रहत्येषु शूरा विश्वा अदेवीरभि सन्तु मायाः । ये मे धियं पनयन्त प्रशस्ताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ime naro vṛtrahatyeṣu śūrā viśvā adevīrabhi santu māyāḥ | ye me dhiyaṃ panayanta praśastām ||

translations.english: May those men who commend this my sacred rite, heroes, in battles with foes, overcome all impiousdevices.

mantras.sanskrit: मा शूने अग्ने नि षदाम नृणां माशेषसोऽवीरता परि त्वा । प्रजावतीषु दुर्यासु दुर्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā śūne agne ni ṣadāma nṛṇāṃ māśeṣaso'vīratā pari tvā | prajāvatīṣu duryāsu durya ||

translations.english: Let us not sit down, Agni, in an empty dwelling, (nor in those) of (other) men; let us not be withoutsuccessors; or, being without male posterity, let us, friend of dwellings, (by) worshipping you, (come to abide) inhouses filled with progeny.

mantras.sanskrit: यमश्वी नित्यमुपयाति यज्ञं प्रजावन्तं स्वपत्यं क्षयं नः । स्वजन्मना शेषसा वावृधानम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yamaśvī nityamupayāti yajñaṃ prajāvantaṃ svapatyaṃ kṣayaṃ naḥ | svajanmanā śeṣasā vāvṛdhānam ||

translations.english: To whatsoever sacrifice the lord of horses regularly repairs, render, (Agni), our dwelling blessed withprogeny, with excellent posterity, prospering with lineal successors.

mantras.sanskrit: पाहि नो अग्ने रक्षसो अजुष्टात्पाहि धूर्तेरररुषो अघायोः । त्वा युजा पृतनायूँरभि ष्याम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pāhi no agne rakṣaso ajuṣṭātpāhi dhūrterararuṣo aghāyoḥ | tvā yujā pṛtanāyū~rabhi ṣyām ||

translations.english: Protect us, Agni, from the odious rākṣasas; protect us from the malignant, the illiberal, the iniquitous;may I, with you for my ally, triumph over the hostile.

mantras.sanskrit: सेदग्निरग्नीँरत्यस्त्वन्यान्यत्र वाजी तनयो वीळुपाणिः । सहस्रपाथा अक्षरा समेति ॥
mantras.transliteration: sedagniragnī~ratyastvanyānyatra vājī tanayo vīḷupāṇiḥ | sahasrapāthā akṣarā sameti ||

translations.english: May that fire (kindled by me) surpass all other fires, at which a vigorous son, firm-handed, possessing athousand means (of living), co-operates in imperishable (praise).

mantras.sanskrit: सेदग्निर्यो वनुष्यतो निपाति समेद्धारमंहस उरुष्यात् । सुजातासः परि चरन्ति वीराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sedagniryo vanuṣyato nipāti sameddhāramaṃhasa uruṣyāt | sujātāsaḥ pari caranti vīrāḥ ||

translations.english: Verily is he Agni, who defends from the malevolent and from heinous sin (the worshipper) kindling (thefire); he (it is) whom the well-born worshippers adore.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं सो अग्निराहुतः पुरुत्रा यमीशानः समिदिन्धे हविष्मान् । परि यमेत्यध्वरेषु होता ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ so agnirāhutaḥ purutrā yamīśānaḥ samidindhe haviṣmān | pari yametyadhvareṣu hotā ||

translations.english: This is the Agni invoked in many plural ces; whom the prince, presenting oblations to, kindles, whom theministrant priest circumambulates at sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वे अग्न आहवनानि भूरीशानास आ जुहुयाम नित्या । उभा कृण्वन्तो वहतू मियेधे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tve agna āhavanāni bhūrīśānāsa ā juhuyāma nityā | ubhā kṛṇvanto vahatū miyedhe ||

translations.english: To you, Agni, may we, who are of exalted rank, offer many perpetual oblations, (employing) means,(prayer and praise), attracting you to the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: इमो अग्ने वीततमानि हव्याजस्रो वक्षि देवतातिमच्छ । प्रति न ईं सुरभीणि व्यन्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: imo agne vītatamāni havyājasro vakṣi devatātimaccha | prati na īṃ surabhīṇi vyantu ||

translations.english: Do you, who are imperishable, bear these most acceptable oblations to the presence of the assembly ofthe gods; and may our fragran (offering) gratify them severally.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नो अग्नेऽवीरते परा दा दुर्वाससेऽमतये मा नो अस्यै । मा नः क्षुधे मा रक्षस ऋतावो मा नो दमे मा वन आ जुहूर्थाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā no agne'vīrate parā dā durvāsase'mataye mā no asyai | mā naḥ kṣudhe mā rakṣasa ṛtāvo mā no dame mā vana ā juhūrthāḥ ||

translations.english: Relinquish us not, Agni, to the want of male offspring; nor to deficient clothing; nor to such desruction;leave us not to hunger, not to the rākṣasas; expose us not, observer of truth, to evil, whether in the house or inthe forest.

mantras.sanskrit: नू मे ब्रह्माण्यग्न उच्छशाधि त्वं देव मघवद्भ्यः सुषूदः । रातौ स्यामोभयास आ ते यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū me brahmāṇyagna ucchaśādhi tvaṃ deva maghavadbhyaḥ suṣūdaḥ | rātau syāmobhayāsa ā te yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Bestow upon me, Agni, quickly, abundant wholesome food; send sustenance, divine Agni, to those whoare opulent in oblations; may we, both (priests and employer), be comprehended in your munificence; do youever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने सुहवो रण्वसंदृक्सुदीती सूनो सहसो दिदीहि । मा त्वे सचा तनये नित्य आ धङ्मा वीरो अस्मन्नर्यो वि दासीत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne suhavo raṇvasaṃdṛksudītī sūno sahaso didīhi | mā tve sacā tanaye nitya ā dhaṅmā vīro asmannaryo vi dāsīt ||

translations.english: Shine wiḥ bright lustre, Agni, son of strength, you who are earnestly invoked, and of plural asant aspect;consume not the begotten son with whom you are associated; let not our male offspring, beneficial to man,perish.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नो अग्ने दुर्भृतये सचैषु देवेद्धेष्वग्निषु प्र वोचः । मा ते अस्मान्दुर्मतयो भृमाच्चिद्देवस्य सूनो सहसो नशन्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā no agne durbhṛtaye sacaiṣu deveddheṣvagniṣu pra vocaḥ | mā te asmāndurmatayo bhṛmācciddevasya sūno sahaso naśanta ||

translations.english: Command not the fires kindled by the priests with which you are united to work as evil; let not thedispleasure, even in error, of you, the son of strength, who are divine, fall upon us.

mantras.sanskrit: स मर्तो अग्ने स्वनीक रेवानमर्त्ये य आजुहोति हव्यम् । स देवता वसुवनिं दधाति यं सूरिरर्थी पृच्छमान एति ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa marto agne svanīka revānamartye ya ājuhoti havyam | sa devatā vasuvaniṃ dadhāti yaṃ sūrirarthī pṛcchamāna eti ||

translations.english: Radiant Agni, the mortal who offers oblations to the immortal becomes affluent; that deity (Agni) favoursthe presenter of (sacrificial) wealth, to whom the devout solicitant inquiring applies.

mantras.sanskrit: महो नो अग्ने सुवितस्य विद्वान्रयिं सूरिभ्य आ वहा बृहन्तम् । येन वयं सहसावन्मदेमाविक्षितास आयुषा सुवीराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: maho no agne suvitasya vidvānrayiṃ sūribhya ā vahā bṛhantam | yena vayaṃ sahasāvanmademāvikṣitāsa āyuṣā suvīrāḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, who are cognizant of our solemn and auspicious (worship), bring to the worshippers abundantriches, whereby, mighty Agni, we, blessed with uncontracted life, and excellent male desendants, may be happy.

mantras.sanskrit: नू मे ब्रह्माण्यग्न उच्छशाधि त्वं देव मघवद्भ्यः सुषूदः । रातौ स्यामोभयास आ ते यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū me brahmāṇyagna ucchaśādhi tvaṃ deva maghavadbhyaḥ suṣūdaḥ | rātau syāmobhayāsa ā te yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Bestow upon me, Agni, quickly, abundant wholesome food; send sustenance, divine Agni, to those whoare opulent in oblaions; may we, both (priests and employer), be comprehended in your munificence; do you evercherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: जुषस्व नः समिधमग्ने अद्य शोचा बृहद्यजतं धूममृण्वन् । उप स्पृश दिव्यं सानु स्तूपैः सं रश्मिभिस्ततनः सूर्यस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: juṣasva naḥ samidhamagne adya śocā bṛhadyajataṃ dhūmamṛṇvan | upa spṛśa divyaṃ sānu stūpaiḥ saṃ raśmibhistatanaḥ sūryasya ||

translations.english: Be gratified, Agni, by the (sacred fire) kindled by us today, emitting abundant adorable smoke; touchwith your scorching flames the celestial summit; combine with the rays of the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: नराशंसस्य महिमानमेषामुप स्तोषाम यजतस्य यज्ञैः । ये सुक्रतवः शुचयो धियंधाः स्वदन्ति देवा उभयानि हव्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: narāśaṃsasya mahimānameṣāmupa stoṣāma yajatasya yajñaiḥ | ye sukratavaḥ śucayo dhiyaṃdhāḥ svadanti devā ubhayāni havyā ||

translations.english: We celebrate with sacrifices the greatness of the adorable Narāśaṃsa among those who aredivinities, the performers of good works, the bright-shining, the upholders of rites, who partake of both kinds ofoblations.

mantras.sanskrit: ईळेन्यं वो असुरं सुदक्षमन्तर्दूतं रोदसी सत्यवाचम् । मनुष्वदग्निं मनुना समिद्धं समध्वराय सदमिन्महेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: īḷenyaṃ vo asuraṃ sudakṣamantardūtaṃ rodasī satyavācam | manuṣvadagniṃ manunā samiddhaṃ samadhvarāya sadaminmahema ||

translations.english: Let us ever worship the Agni who is to be adored by us; the mighty, the dextrous, the messengerpassing between heaven and earth, the speaker of truth, kindled (of old) by Manu, as now by men, that (he maycome) to the solemnity.

mantras.sanskrit: सपर्यवो भरमाणा अभिज्ञु प्र वृञ्जते नमसा बर्हिरग्नौ । आजुह्वाना घृतपृष्ठं पृषद्वदध्वर्यवो हविषा मर्जयध्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: saparyavo bharamāṇā abhijñu pra vṛñjate namasā barhiragnau | ājuhvānā ghṛtapṛṣṭhaṃ pṛṣadvadadhvaryavo haviṣā marjayadhvam ||

translations.english: The worshippers bearing the sacred grass offer it with reverence, upon their knees, to Agni; worshiphim, priests, with oblations, invoking him to (sit down) on the spotted (grass), smeared with clarified butter.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वाध्यो वि दुरो देवयन्तोऽशिश्रयू रथयुर्देवताता । पूर्वी शिशुं न मातरा रिहाणे समग्रुवो न समनेष्वञ्जन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: svādhyo vi duro devayanto'śiśrayū rathayurdevatātā | pūrvī śiśuṃ na mātarā rihāṇe samagruvo na samaneṣvañjan ||

translations.english: The devout performers of holy rites, desirous of chariots, have had recourse to the doors (of thesacrificial chamber); (the ladles), plural ced to the east, are plural ing the fire with ghee at sacrifices, as the mothercows lick the calf, or as rivers (water the fields).

mantras.sanskrit: उत योषणे दिव्ये मही न उषासानक्ता सुदुघेव धेनुः । बर्हिषदा पुरुहूते मघोनी आ यज्ञिये सुविताय श्रयेताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta yoṣaṇe divye mahī na uṣāsānaktā sudugheva dhenuḥ | barhiṣadā puruhūte maghonī ā yajñiye suvitāya śrayetām ||

translations.english: May the two youthful feminine les, the divine and mighty day and night, the invoked of many, the possessedof wealth, seated on the sacred grass, enitled to adoration, be with us like an easily-milked cow for our welfare.

mantras.sanskrit: विप्रा यज्ञेषु मानुषेषु कारू मन्ये वां जातवेदसा यजध्यै । ऊर्ध्वं नो अध्वरं कृतं हवेषु ता देवेषु वनथो वार्याणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: viprā yajñeṣu mānuṣeṣu kārū manye vāṃ jātavedasā yajadhyai | ūrdhvaṃ no adhvaraṃ kṛtaṃ haveṣu tā deveṣu vanatho vāryāṇi ||

translations.english: I am minded to adore you two sages, the ministrants at sacrifices of men, from celebrated, convey ouroffspring aloft, and acquire (for our use) the precious (treasures preserved) among the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: आ भारती भारतीभिः सजोषा इळा देवैर्मनुष्येभिरग्निः । सरस्वती सारस्वतेभिरर्वाक्तिस्रो देवीर्बर्हिरेदं सदन्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā bhāratī bhāratībhiḥ sajoṣā iḷā devairmanuṣyebhiragniḥ | sarasvatī sārasvatebhirarvāktisro devīrbarhiredaṃ sadantu ||

translations.english: May Bharati, associated with the Bharatis; Iḷā with gods and men; and Agni and Sarasvatī with theSārasvatas; may the three goddesses sit down before us upon this sacred grass.

mantras.sanskrit: तन्नस्तुरीपमध पोषयित्नु देव त्वष्टर्वि रराणः स्यस्व । यतो वीरः कर्मण्यः सुदक्षो युक्तग्रावा जायते देवकामः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tannasturīpamadha poṣayitnu deva tvaṣṭarvi rarāṇaḥ syasva | yato vīraḥ karmaṇyaḥ sudakṣo yuktagrāvā jāyate devakāmaḥ ||

translations.english: Divine Tvaṣṭā, being well-plural ased, give issue to our procreative vigour, whence (a son) manly,devout, vigorous, wielder of the Soma-bruising stone, and reverencing the gods, may be born.

mantras.sanskrit: वनस्पतेऽव सृजोप देवानग्निर्हविः शमिता सूदयाति । सेदु होता सत्यतरो यजाति यथा देवानां जनिमानि वेद ॥
mantras.transliteration: vanaspate'va sṛjopa devānagnirhaviḥ śamitā sūdayāti | sedu hotā satyataro yajāti yathā devānāṃ janimāni veda ||

translations.english: Vanaspati, bring the gods night; may Agni, the immolator, prepare the victim; let him who is truthofficiate as the ministering priest, for verily he knows the birth of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: आ याह्यग्ने समिधानो अर्वाङिन्द्रेण देवैः सरथं तुरेभिः । बर्हिर्न आस्तामदितिः सुपुत्रा स्वाहा देवा अमृता मादयन्ताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yāhyagne samidhāno arvāṅindreṇa devaiḥ sarathaṃ turebhiḥ | barhirna āstāmaditiḥ suputrā svāhā devā amṛtā mādayantām ||

translations.english: Agni, kindled (into flame), come to our presence in the same chariot with Indra, and with the swiftmoving gods; may Aditi, the mother of excellent sons, sit down on the sacred grass, and may the immortal godsbe satisfied with the reverentially-offered oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निं वो देवमग्निभिः सजोषा यजिष्ठं दूतमध्वरे कृणुध्वम् । यो मर्त्येषु निध्रुविॠतावा तपुर्मूर्धा घृतान्नः पावकः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniṃ vo devamagnibhiḥ sajoṣā yajiṣṭhaṃ dūtamadhvare kṛṇudhvam | yo martyeṣu nidhruviṝtāvā tapurmūrdhā ghṛtānnaḥ pāvakaḥ ||

translations.english: Appoint (gods) the most adorable, divine Agni, consentient with (all other) fires, your messenger at thesacrifice; him who is permanently present among men, the observer of truth, who is crowned with flame, thepurifier, whose food is butter.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रोथदश्वो न यवसेऽविष्यन्यदा महः संवरणाद्व्यस्थात् । आदस्य वातो अनु वाति शोचिरध स्म ते व्रजनं कृष्णमस्ति ॥
