mantras.transliteration: prothadaśvo na yavase'viṣyanyadā mahaḥ saṃvaraṇādvyasthāt | ādasya vāto anu vāti śociradha sma te vrajanaṃ kṛṣṇamasti ||

translations.english: When, like a neighing steed about to feed upon the forage, (Agni) springs up from the vast-enclosing(forest) then the wind fans his flame; and black, (Agni), is your course.

mantras.sanskrit: उद्यस्य ते नवजातस्य वृष्णोऽग्ने चरन्त्यजरा इधानाः । अच्छा द्यामरुषो धूम एति सं दूतो अग्न ईयसे हि देवान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: udyasya te navajātasya vṛṣṇo'gne carantyajarā idhānāḥ | acchā dyāmaruṣo dhūma eti saṃ dūto agna īyase hi devān ||

translations.english: The kindled undecaying flames of you, the newly born, the showerer, rise up; the luminous smokespreads along the sky; and you, Agni, proceed as their messenger to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: वि यस्य ते पृथिव्यां पाजो अश्रेत्तृषु यदन्ना समवृक्त जम्भैः । सेनेव सृष्टा प्रसितिष्ट एति यवं न दस्म जुह्वा विवेक्षि ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi yasya te pṛthivyāṃ pājo aśrettṛṣu yadannā samavṛkta jambhaiḥ | seneva sṛṣṭā prasitiṣṭa eti yavaṃ na dasma juhvā vivekṣi ||

translations.english: The light of whom quickly spreads over the earth when with his teeth (of flame) he devours his food;your blaze rushes along like a charging host, when Agni, of goodly aspect, you spread with your flame (amongthe trees) as if (they were) barley.

mantras.sanskrit: तमिद्दोषा तमुषसि यविष्ठमग्निमत्यं न मर्जयन्त नरः । निशिशाना अतिथिमस्य योनौ दीदाय शोचिराहुतस्य वृष्णः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamiddoṣā tamuṣasi yaviṣṭhamagnimatyaṃ na marjayanta naraḥ | niśiśānā atithimasya yonau dīdāya śocirāhutasya vṛṣṇaḥ ||

translations.english: Men cherish that youthful Agni at evening and at dawn, as (they tend) a horse; lighting him as a guestin his proper station; the radiance of the showerer (of benefits), to whom the oblation is offered, shines brightly.

mantras.sanskrit: सुसंदृक्ते स्वनीक प्रतीकं वि यद्रुक्मो न रोचस उपाके । दिवो न ते तन्यतुरेति शुष्मश्चित्रो न सूरः प्रति चक्षि भानुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: susaṃdṛkte svanīka pratīkaṃ vi yadrukmo na rocasa upāke | divo na te tanyatureti śuṣmaścitro na sūraḥ prati cakṣi bhānum ||

translations.english: Resplendent Agni, when you shine nigh at hand like gold, your appearance is beautiful; your mightissues like the thunderbolt from the firmament, and like the wonderful sun, you display your lustre.

mantras.sanskrit: यथा वः स्वाहाग्नये दाशेम परीळाभिर्घृतवद्भिश्च हव्यैः । तेभिर्नो अग्ने अमितैर्महोभिः शतं पूर्भिरायसीभिर्नि पाहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathā vaḥ svāhāgnaye dāśema parīḷābhirghṛtavadbhiśca havyaiḥ | tebhirno agne amitairmahobhiḥ śataṃ pūrbhirāyasībhirni pāhi ||

translations.english: When we present to you, Agni, the sacred offerings with oblations mixed with butter and milk, thenprotect us with those vast unbounded, innumerable golden cities and metals.

mantras.sanskrit: या वा ते सन्ति दाशुषे अधृष्टा गिरो वा याभिर्नृवतीरुरुष्याः । ताभिर्नः सूनो सहसो नि पाहि स्मत्सूरीञ्जरितॄञ्जातवेदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā vā te santi dāśuṣe adhṛṣṭā giro vā yābhirnṛvatīruruṣyāḥ | tābhirnaḥ sūno sahaso ni pāhi smatsūrīñjaritṝñjātavedaḥ ||

translations.english: Son of strength, Jātavedas, with those unobstructed (splendours) which belong to you, a munificentdonor, and with those praises wherewiḥ you protect people with their posterity, do you protect us yourworshippers and praisers.

mantras.sanskrit: निर्यत्पूतेव स्वधितिः शुचिर्गात्स्वया कृपा तन्वा रोचमानः । आ यो मात्रोरुशेन्यो जनिष्ट देवयज्याय सुक्रतुः पावकः ॥
mantras.transliteration: niryatpūteva svadhitiḥ śucirgātsvayā kṛpā tanvā rocamānaḥ | ā yo mātroruśenyo janiṣṭa devayajyāya sukratuḥ pāvakaḥ ||

translations.english: When the bright Agni, radiant with his own diffusive lustre, issues (from the touchwood) like asharpened axe; and he who is desirable, the doer of great deeds, the purifier, is born of his two parents; (heappears) for the worship of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: एता नो अग्ने सौभगा दिदीह्यपि क्रतुं सुचेतसं वतेम । विश्वा स्तोतृभ्यो गृणते च सन्तु यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: etā no agne saubhagā didīhyapi kratuṃ sucetasaṃ vatema | viśvā stotṛbhyo gṛṇate ca santu yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Illumine for us, Agni, these auspicious (riches); may we possess (a son) intelligent, the celebrator ofsacred rites; may all (good things) be your praisers, and to him who eulogizes (you); and do you ever cherish uswith blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वः शुक्राय भानवे भरध्वं हव्यं मतिं चाग्नये सुपूतम् । यो दैव्यानि मानुषा जनूंष्यन्तर्विश्वानि विद्मना जिगाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vaḥ śukrāya bhānave bharadhvaṃ havyaṃ matiṃ cāgnaye supūtam | yo daivyāni mānuṣā janūṃṣyantarviśvāni vidmanā jigāti ||

translations.english: Offer your sacred oblation, and praise the bright and radiant Agni, who passes with wisdom between alldivine and human beings.

mantras.sanskrit: स गृत्सो अग्निस्तरुणश्चिदस्तु यतो यविष्ठो अजनिष्ट मातुः । सं यो वना युवते शुचिदन्भूरि चिदन्ना समिदत्ति सद्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa gṛtso agnistaruṇaścidastu yato yaviṣṭho ajaniṣṭa mātuḥ | saṃ yo vanā yuvate śucidanbhūri cidannā samidatti sadyaḥ ||

translations.english: May the sagacious Agni be our conductor from the time that he is orn, most youthful, of his mother; hewho, bright-toothed, attacks the forest, and quickly devours his abundant food.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य देवस्य संसद्यनीके यं मर्तासः श्येतं जगृभ्रे । नि यो गृभं पौरुषेयीमुवोच दुरोकमग्निरायवे शुशोच ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya devasya saṃsadyanīke yaṃ martāsaḥ śyetaṃ jagṛbhre | ni yo gṛbhaṃ pauruṣeyīmuvoca durokamagnirāyave śuśoca ||

translations.english: Whom mortals apprehend as white (shining) in the principal station of that divinity; he who assents tomanly adoration, and blazes for the good of man, and the discomfiture (of his foes).

mantras.sanskrit: अयं कविरकविषु प्रचेता मर्तेष्वग्निरमृतो नि धायि । स मा नो अत्र जुहुरः सहस्वः सदा त्वे सुमनसः स्याम ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ kavirakaviṣu pracetā marteṣvagniramṛto ni dhāyi | sa mā no atra juhuraḥ sahasvaḥ sadā tve sumanasaḥ syāma ||

translations.english: This far-seeing, sagacious, immortal Agni, has been stationed among short-sighted mortals; harm usnot, vigorous Agni, in this world, that we may ever be devoted to you.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यो योनिं देवकृतं ससाद क्रत्वा ह्यग्निरमृताँ अतारीत् । तमोषधीश्च वनिनश्च गर्भं भूमिश्च विश्वधायसं बिभर्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yo yoniṃ devakṛtaṃ sasāda kratvā hyagniramṛtā~ atārīt | tamoṣadhīśca vaninaśca garbhaṃ bhūmiśca viśvadhāyasaṃ bibharti ||

translations.english: The herbs, and the trees, and the earth, contain as a germ that all- supporting Agni, who occupies aplace provided by the gods, that by his functions he may convey (the offerings) to the immortals.

mantras.sanskrit: ईशे ह्यग्निरमृतस्य भूरेरीशे रायः सुवीर्यस्य दातोः । मा त्वा वयं सहसावन्नवीरा माप्सवः परि षदाम मादुवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: īśe hyagniramṛtasya bhūrerīśe rāyaḥ suvīryasya dātoḥ | mā tvā vayaṃ sahasāvannavīrā māpsavaḥ pari ṣadāma māduvaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni has power to grant abundant food; he has power to grant riches with male posterity; vigorous Agni,let us not sit down before you devoid of sons, of beauty, of devotion.

mantras.sanskrit: परिषद्यं ह्यरणस्य रेक्णो नित्यस्य रायः पतयः स्याम । न शेषो अग्ने अन्यजातमस्त्यचेतानस्य मा पथो वि दुक्षः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pariṣadyaṃ hyaraṇasya rekṇo nityasya rāyaḥ patayaḥ syāma | na śeṣo agne anyajātamastyacetānasya mā patho vi dukṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Wealth is competent to the acquittance of debt; may we be masters of permanent riches; that is notoffspring which is begotten by another; alter not the paths (of the genitive ration) of a blockhead.

mantras.sanskrit: नहि ग्रभायारणः सुशेवोऽन्योदर्यो मनसा मन्तवा उ । अधा चिदोकः पुनरित्स एत्या नो वाज्यभीषाळेतु नव्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahi grabhāyāraṇaḥ suśevo'nyodaryo manasā mantavā u | adhā cidokaḥ punaritsa etyā no vājyabhīṣāḷetu navyaḥ ||

translations.english: One not acquitting debts, although worthy of regard, yet begotten of another, is not to be contemplatedeven in the mind (as fit) for acceptance; for verily he returns to his own house; therefore let there come to us (ason) new- born, possessed of food, victorious over foes.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने वनुष्यतो नि पाहि त्वमु नः सहसावन्नवद्यात् । सं त्वा ध्वस्मन्वदभ्येतु पाथः सं रयिः स्पृहयाय्यः सहस्री ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne vanuṣyato ni pāhi tvamu naḥ sahasāvannavadyāt | saṃ tvā dhvasmanvadabhyetu pāthaḥ saṃ rayiḥ spṛhayāyyaḥ sahasrī ||

translations.english: Do you, Agni, defend us against, the malignant; do you, who are endowed with strengt, (preserve us)from sin; may the (sacrificial) food come to you free from defect; may the riches that we desire come to us bythousands.

mantras.sanskrit: एता नो अग्ने सौभगा दिदीह्यपि क्रतुं सुचेतसं वतेम । विश्वा स्तोतृभ्यो गृणते च सन्तु यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: etā no agne saubhagā didīhyapi kratuṃ sucetasaṃ vatema | viśvā stotṛbhyo gṛṇate ca santu yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Illumine for us, Agni, these auspicious (riches); may we possess (a son) intelligent, the celebrator ofsacred rites; may all (good things) be to your praisers and to him who eulogizes (you); and do you ever cherishus with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: प्राग्नये तवसे भरध्वं गिरं दिवो अरतये पृथिव्याः । यो विश्वेषाममृतानामुपस्थे वैश्वानरो वावृधे जागृवद्भिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prāgnaye tavase bharadhvaṃ giraṃ divo arataye pṛthivyāḥ | yo viśveṣāmamṛtānāmupasthe vaiśvānaro vāvṛdhe jāgṛvadbhiḥ ||

translations.english: Offer praise to the strong Agni, traversing without hindrance heaven and earth; he who (as)Vaiśvānara prospers at the sacrifices of all the immortals, being associated with the awaking divinities.

mantras.sanskrit: पृष्टो दिवि धाय्यग्निः पृथिव्यां नेता सिन्धूनां वृषभः स्तियानाम् । स मानुषीरभि विशो वि भाति वैश्वानरो वावृधानो वरेण ॥
mantras.transliteration: pṛṣṭo divi dhāyyagniḥ pṛthivyāṃ netā sindhūnāṃ vṛṣabhaḥ stiyānām | sa mānuṣīrabhi viśo vi bhāti vaiśvānaro vāvṛdhāno vareṇa ||

translations.english: Agni, the leader of the rivers, the showerer of the waters, the radiant, has been stationed in thefirmament and upon earth; Viśvānara augmenting with the most excellent (oblation) shines upon human beings.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वद्भिया विश आयन्नसिक्नीरसमना जहतीर्भोजनानि । वैश्वानर पूरवे शोशुचानः पुरो यदग्ने दरयन्नदीदेः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvadbhiyā viśa āyannasiknīrasamanā jahatīrbhojanāni | vaiśvānara pūrave śośucānaḥ puro yadagne darayannadīdeḥ ||

translations.english: Through fear of you, Vaiśvānara, the dark-complexioned races, although of many minds, arrived,abandoning their possessions, when, Agni, shining upon Puru, you have blazed, consuming the cities of his foe.

mantras.sanskrit: तव त्रिधातु पृथिवी उत द्यौर्वैश्वानर व्रतमग्ने सचन्त । त्वं भासा रोदसी आ ततन्थाजस्रेण शोचिषा शोशुचानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava tridhātu pṛthivī uta dyaurvaiśvānara vratamagne sacanta | tvaṃ bhāsā rodasī ā tatanthājasreṇa śociṣā śośucānaḥ ||

translations.english: Vaiśvānara Agni, the firmament, the earth, the heaven, combine in your worship; shining withundecaying splendour, you overspread heaven and earth with light.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने हरितो वावशाना गिरः सचन्ते धुनयो घृताचीः । पतिं कृष्टीनां रथ्यं रयीणां वैश्वानरमुषसां केतुमह्नाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmagne harito vāvaśānā giraḥ sacante dhunayo ghṛtācīḥ | patiṃ kṛṣṭīnāṃ rathyaṃ rayīṇāṃ vaiśvānaramuṣasāṃ ketumahnām ||

translations.english: The horses (of Indra), full of ardour, worship you, Agni; the praises (of men), dispersers (of iniquity),accompanied by oblations, (honour you), the lord of men, the conveyer of riches, the Vaiśvānara of dawns, themanifester of days.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वे असुर्यं वसवो न्यृण्वन्क्रतुं हि ते मित्रमहो जुषन्त । त्वं दस्यूँरोकसो अग्न आज उरु ज्योतिर्जनयन्नार्याय ॥
mantras.transliteration: tve asuryaṃ vasavo nyṛṇvankratuṃ hi te mitramaho juṣanta | tvaṃ dasyū~rokaso agna āja uru jyotirjanayannāryāya ||

translations.english: Reverencer of friends, Agni, th Vasus have concentrated vigour in you; they have been propitiated byyour acts; genitive rating vast splendour for the Arya, do you, Agni, expel the Dasyus from the dwelling.

mantras.sanskrit: स जायमानः परमे व्योमन्वायुर्न पाथः परि पासि सद्यः । त्वं भुवना जनयन्नभि क्रन्नपत्याय जातवेदो दशस्यन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa jāyamānaḥ parame vyomanvāyurna pāthaḥ pari pāsi sadyaḥ | tvaṃ bhuvanā janayannabhi krannapatyāya jātavedo daśasyan ||

translations.english: Born in the highest heaven, you ever drink (Soma) like Vāyu; genitive rating the waters, you thunder,granting (his wishes) to your offspring, the worshipper.

mantras.sanskrit: तामग्ने अस्मे इषमेरयस्व वैश्वानर द्युमतीं जातवेदः । यया राधः पिन्वसि विश्ववार पृथु श्रवो दाशुषे मर्त्याय ॥
mantras.transliteration: tāmagne asme iṣamerayasva vaiśvānara dyumatīṃ jātavedaḥ | yayā rādhaḥ pinvasi viśvavāra pṛthu śravo dāśuṣe martyāya ||

translations.english: Send to us, Agni, (who are) Vaiśvānara Jātavedas, that brilliant sustenance whereby you conferwealth, and (grant), all-desired Agni, abundant food to the mortal, the donor (of the oblation).

mantras.sanskrit: तं नो अग्ने मघवद्भ्यः पुरुक्षुं रयिं नि वाजं श्रुत्यं युवस्व । वैश्वानर महि नः शर्म यच्छ रुद्रेभिरग्ने वसुभिः सजोषाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ no agne maghavadbhyaḥ purukṣuṃ rayiṃ ni vājaṃ śrutyaṃ yuvasva | vaiśvānara mahi naḥ śarma yaccha rudrebhiragne vasubhiḥ sajoṣāḥ ||

translations.english: Bestow upon us who are affluent (in offerings), Agni, ample riches and renowned strength; associatedwith the Rudras, with the Vasus, grant us, Agni Vaiśvānara, infinite happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सम्राजो असुरस्य प्रशस्तिं पुंसः कृष्टीनामनुमाद्यस्य । इन्द्रस्येव प्र तवसस्कृतानि वन्दे दारुं वन्दमानो विवक्मि ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra samrājo asurasya praśastiṃ puṃsaḥ kṛṣṭīnāmanumādyasya | indrasyeva pra tavasaskṛtāni vande dāruṃ vandamāno vivakmi ||

translations.english: I salute the demolisher (of cities), glorifying the excellence of the powerful male, the universal sovereignwho is the reverenced of all men; I proclaim his exploits (which are) like those of the mighty Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: कविं केतुं धासिं भानुमद्रेर्हिन्वन्ति शं राज्यं रोदस्योः । पुरंदरस्य गीर्भिरा विवासेऽग्नेर्व्रतानि पूर्व्या महानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: kaviṃ ketuṃ dhāsiṃ bhānumadrerhinvanti śaṃ rājyaṃ rodasyoḥ | puraṃdarasya gīrbhirā vivāse'gnervratāni pūrvyā mahāni ||

translations.english: They propitiate the wise, the manifesting, the sustaining,t he enlightener of the pious, the giver ofhappiness, the sovereign of heaven and earth; I glorify the ancient and mighty works of Agni, the demolisher ofcities.

mantras.sanskrit: न्यक्रतून्ग्रथिनो मृध्रवाचः पणीँरश्रद्धाँ अवृधाँ अयज्ञान् । प्रप्र तान्दस्यूँरग्निर्विवाय पूर्वश्चकारापराँ अयज्यून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nyakratūngrathino mṛdhravācaḥ paṇī~raśraddhā~ avṛdhā~ ayajñān | prapra tāndasyū~ragnirvivāya pūrvaścakārāparā~ ayajyūn ||

translations.english: May Agni utterly confound those Dasyus who perform no (sacred) rites, who are babblers defective inspeech, niggards, unbelievers; not honouring (Agni), offering no sacrifice; Agni preceding, has degrated thosewho instrumental tute no sacred ceremonies.

mantras.sanskrit: यो अपाचीने तमसि मदन्तीः प्राचीश्चकार नृतमः शचीभिः । तमीशानं वस्वो अग्निं गृणीषेऽनानतं दमयन्तं पृतन्यून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo apācīne tamasi madantīḥ prācīścakāra nṛtamaḥ śacībhiḥ | tamīśānaṃ vasvo agniṃ gṛṇīṣe'nānataṃ damayantaṃ pṛtanyūn ||

translations.english: The chief of leaders has, by the benefits (bestowed upon them), guided those praising (him) throughthe accusative ulated gloom (of night); I glorify that Agni, the unbending lord of wealth, the tamer of adversarieṣ

mantras.sanskrit: यो देह्यो अनमयद्वधस्नैर्यो अर्यपत्नीरुषसश्चकार । स निरुध्या नहुषो यह्वो अग्निर्विशश्चक्रे बलिहृतः सहोभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo dehyo anamayadvadhasnairyo aryapatnīruṣasaścakāra | sa nirudhyā nahuṣo yahvo agnirviśaścakre balihṛtaḥ sahobhiḥ ||

translations.english: The mighty Agni, who by his fatal (weapons) has baffled the devices (of the asuras), who has createdthe lawns, the birds of the sun, having coerced the people by his strength, has made them the tributaries ofNahuṣa.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य शर्मन्नुप विश्वे जनास एवैस्तस्थुः सुमतिं भिक्षमाणाः । वैश्वानरो वरमा रोदस्योराग्निः ससाद पित्रोरुपस्थम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya śarmannupa viśve janāsa evaistasthuḥ sumatiṃ bhikṣamāṇāḥ | vaiśvānaro varamā rodasyorāgniḥ sasāda pitrorupastham ||

translations.english: Agni Vaiśvānara, whom all men approach with pious offerings, soliciting his favour for the sake of(obtaining felicity), has come to the excellent station (intermediate) between his parents, heaven and earth.

mantras.sanskrit: आ देवो ददे बुध्न्या वसूनि वैश्वानर उदिता सूर्यस्य । आ समुद्रादवरादा परस्मादाग्निर्ददे दिव आ पृथिव्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā devo dade budhnyā vasūni vaiśvānara uditā sūryasya | ā samudrādavarādā parasmādāgnirdade diva ā pṛthivyāḥ ||

translations.english: The divine Agni Vaiśvānara has removed from the firmament the investing (glooms) at the rising of thesun; he has removed them from the lower firmament of the earth, from the upper firmament of heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वो देवं चित्सहसानमग्निमश्वं न वाजिनं हिषे नमोभिः । भवा नो दूतो अध्वरस्य विद्वान्त्मना देवेषु विविदे मितद्रुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vo devaṃ citsahasānamagnimaśvaṃ na vājinaṃ hiṣe namobhiḥ | bhavā no dūto adhvarasya vidvāntmanā deveṣu vivide mitadruḥ ||

translations.english: I propitiate with oblations the divine, vigorous Agni, rapid as a horse; do you, knowing (our desires), beour messenger of the sacrifice; he, the consumer of forests, is known spontaneously among the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: आ याह्यग्ने पथ्या अनु स्वा मन्द्रो देवानां सख्यं जुषाणः । आ सानु शुष्मैर्नदयन्पृथिव्या जम्भेभिर्विश्वमुशधग्वनानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yāhyagne pathyā anu svā mandro devānāṃ sakhyaṃ juṣāṇaḥ | ā sānu śuṣmairnadayanpṛthivyā jambhebhirviśvamuśadhagvanāni ||

translations.english: Come, Agni, rejoicing by thine own paths, gratified by the friendship of the gods; roarind with witheringflames above the high plural ces of the earth; threatening to consume all the forests.

mantras.sanskrit: प्राचीनो यज्ञः सुधितं हि बर्हिः प्रीणीते अग्निरीळितो न होता । आ मातरा विश्ववारे हुवानो यतो यविष्ठ जज्ञिषे सुशेवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prācīno yajñaḥ sudhitaṃ hi barhiḥ prīṇīte agnirīḷito na hotā | ā mātarā viśvavāre huvāno yato yaviṣṭha jajñiṣe suśevaḥ ||

translations.english: The sacrifice is presen; the sacred grass is strewn; Agni lauded is satisfied, and is the ministrant priestinvoking the all-desired parents of whom you, honoured Agni, the youngest (of the gods), are born.

mantras.sanskrit: सद्यो अध्वरे रथिरं जनन्त मानुषासो विचेतसो य एषाम् । विशामधायि विश्पतिर्दुरोणेऽग्निर्मन्द्रो मधुवचा ऋतावा ॥
mantras.transliteration: sadyo adhvare rathiraṃ jananta mānuṣāso vicetaso ya eṣām | viśāmadhāyi viśpatirduroṇe'gnirmandro madhuvacā ṛtāvā ||

translations.english: Judicious men promptly genitive rate at the sacred rite the directing (Agni), who (may convey) their(oblations); Agni, the lord of men, the giver of delight, the swee-spoken, the celebrator of sacrifices, has beenestablished in the dwelling of the people.

mantras.sanskrit: असादि वृतो वह्निराजगन्वानग्निर्ब्रह्मा नृषदने विधर्ता । द्यौश्च यं पृथिवी वावृधाते आ यं होता यजति विश्ववारम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asādi vṛto vahnirājaganvānagnirbrahmā nṛṣadane vidhartā | dyauśca yaṃ pṛthivī vāvṛdhāte ā yaṃ hotā yajati viśvavāram ||

translations.english: Invester (with the priestly office), the bearer (of the oblation), Agni, the directing priest, the sustainer (ofall), is seated in the house of man, he whom heaven and earth extol, and whom, the desired of all, the ministrantpriests worship.

mantras.sanskrit: एते द्युम्नेभिर्विश्वमातिरन्त मन्त्रं ये वारं नर्या अतक्षन् । प्र ये विशस्तिरन्त श्रोषमाणा आ ये मे अस्य दीधयन्नृतस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: ete dyumnebhirviśvamātiranta mantraṃ ye vāraṃ naryā atakṣan | pra ye viśastiranta śroṣamāṇā ā ye me asya dīdhayannṛtasya ||

translations.english: These men nourish the universe with viands who offer (to Agni) fitting commendation; those people alsowho eagerly listen (to his laudation) augment (the plural nty of the world), as do these my (associates), who areglorifiers of this truthful (duty).

mantras.sanskrit: नू त्वामग्न ईमहे वसिष्ठा ईशानं सूनो सहसो वसूनाम् । इषं स्तोतृभ्यो मघवद्भ्य आनड्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū tvāmagna īmahe vasiṣṭhā īśānaṃ sūno sahaso vasūnām | iṣaṃ stotṛbhyo maghavadbhya ānaḍyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: We Vasiṣṭhas implore you, Agni, son of strength, the lord of treasures, that you will quickly bestowfood upon thine adorers who are affluent (in oblations), and do you ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्धे राजा समर्यो नमोभिर्यस्य प्रतीकमाहुतं घृतेन । नरो हव्येभिरीळते सबाध आग्निरग्र उषसामशोचि ॥
mantras.transliteration: indhe rājā samaryo namobhiryasya pratīkamāhutaṃ ghṛtena | naro havyebhirīḷate sabādha āgniragra uṣasāmaśoci ||

translations.english: The royal (Agni), the mater (of the sacrifice), is kindled with praises, he whose person n is invoked with(offerings of) butter, whom men associated worship with oblations, Agni, who is lighted before the dawn.

mantras.sanskrit: अयमु ष्य सुमहाँ अवेदि होता मन्द्रो मनुषो यह्वो अग्निः । वि भा अकः ससृजानः पृथिव्यां कृष्णपविरोषधीभिर्ववक्षे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayamu ṣya sumahā~ avedi hotā mandro manuṣo yahvo agniḥ | vi bhā akaḥ sasṛjānaḥ pṛthivyāṃ kṛṣṇapaviroṣadhībhirvavakṣe ||

translations.english: This great Agni has been known among men as invoker (of the gods), the giver of deligh, the mighty; hehas spread (in the firmament), he, the darkpathed at large upon the earth, is nourished by the plural nts.

mantras.sanskrit: कया नो अग्ने वि वसः सुवृक्तिं कामु स्वधामृणवः शस्यमानः । कदा भवेम पतयः सुदत्र रायो वन्तारो दुष्टरस्य साधोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kayā no agne vi vasaḥ suvṛktiṃ kāmu svadhāmṛṇavaḥ śasyamānaḥ | kadā bhavema patayaḥ sudatra rāyo vantāro duṣṭarasya sādhoḥ ||

translations.english: By what oblation, Agni, do you clothe our praise? What offering do you, when glorified, accept? When,giver of good, may we be the possessors and enjoyers of perfect and unmolested riches?

mantras.sanskrit: प्रप्रायमग्निर्भरतस्य शृण्वे वि यत्सूर्यो न रोचते बृहद्भाः । अभि यः पूरुं पृतनासु तस्थौ द्युतानो दैव्यो अतिथिः शुशोच ॥
mantras.transliteration: praprāyamagnirbharatasya śṛṇve vi yatsūryo na rocate bṛhadbhāḥ | abhi yaḥ pūruṃ pṛtanāsu tasthau dyutāno daivyo atithiḥ śuśoca ||

translations.english: This Agni is greatly celebrated by the instrumental tutor of the rite when he shines resplendent as the sun; hewho overcame Puru in battle, and shone glorious as the guest of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: असन्नित्त्वे आहवनानि भूरि भुवो विश्वेभिः सुमना अनीकैः । स्तुतश्चिदग्ने शृण्विषे गृणानः स्वयं वर्धस्व तन्वं सुजात ॥
mantras.transliteration: asannittve āhavanāni bhūri bhuvo viśvebhiḥ sumanā anīkaiḥ | stutaścidagne śṛṇviṣe gṛṇānaḥ svayaṃ vardhasva tanvaṃ sujāta ||

translations.english: In you, Agni, are many offerings; do you with all your flames be propitious; favourably hear (the praises)of the worshipper; and do you of auspicious manifestation being glorified, spontaneously magnify (your) person n.

mantras.sanskrit: इदं वचः शतसाः संसहस्रमुदग्नये जनिषीष्ट द्विबर्हाः । शं यत्स्तोतृभ्य आपये भवाति द्युमदमीवचातनं रक्षोहा ॥
mantras.transliteration: idaṃ vacaḥ śatasāḥ saṃsahasramudagnaye janiṣīṣṭa dvibarhāḥ | śaṃ yatstotṛbhya āpaye bhavāti dyumadamīvacātanaṃ rakṣohā ||

translations.english: Vasi.ṣṭha illustrious in both heaven and earth, rich with a hundred and a thousand (head of cattle), hasaddressed this hymn to Agni, that such fame- conferring disease-removing, fiend-destroying (laudation) may be(the means of) happiness to the eulogists and their kindred.

mantras.sanskrit: नू त्वामग्न ईमहे वसिष्ठा ईशानं सूनो सहसो वसूनाम् । इषं स्तोतृभ्यो मघवद्भ्य आनड्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū tvāmagna īmahe vasiṣṭhā īśānaṃ sūno sahaso vasūnām | iṣaṃ stotṛbhyo maghavadbhya ānaḍyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: We Vasiṣṭhas implore you, Agni, son of strength, the lord of treasures, that you will quickly bestowfood upon thine adorers, who are affluent (in oblations), and do you ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: अबोधि जार उषसामुपस्थाद्धोता मन्द्रः कवितमः पावकः । दधाति केतुमुभयस्य जन्तोर्हव्या देवेषु द्रविणं सुकृत्सु ॥
mantras.transliteration: abodhi jāra uṣasāmupasthāddhotā mandraḥ kavitamaḥ pāvakaḥ | dadhāti ketumubhayasya jantorhavyā deveṣu draviṇaṃ sukṛtsu ||

translations.english: The waster away (of living creatures), the invoker (of the gods), the giver of delight, the wisest of thewise, the purifier, (Agni), has been manifested from the lap of the dawn; he gives consciousness to both classesof beings (men and animals), oblations to the gods, and wealth to the pious.

mantras.sanskrit: स सुक्रतुर्यो वि दुरः पणीनां पुनानो अर्कं पुरुभोजसं नः । होता मन्द्रो विशां दमूनास्तिरस्तमो ददृशे राम्याणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa sukraturyo vi duraḥ paṇīnāṃ punāno arkaṃ purubhojasaṃ naḥ | hotā mandro viśāṃ damūnāstirastamo dadṛśe rāmyāṇām ||

translations.english: He, the doer of great deeds, who forced open the doors of the Paṇis, recovered for us the sacredfood-bestowing (herd of kine), he who is the invoker of the gods, the giver of delight to the lowly-minded, is seenof all people dissipating the gloom of the nights.

mantras.sanskrit: अमूरः कविरदितिर्विवस्वान्त्सुसंसन्मित्रो अतिथिः शिवो नः । चित्रभानुरुषसां भात्यग्रेऽपां गर्भः प्रस्व आ विवेश ॥
mantras.transliteration: amūraḥ kaviraditirvivasvāntsusaṃsanmitro atithiḥ śivo naḥ | citrabhānuruṣasāṃ bhātyagre'pāṃ garbhaḥ prasva ā viveśa ||

translations.english: Unperplexed, far-seeing elevated, resplendent, right-directing, a friend, a guest, the bestower ofprosperity upon us, the wonderfully radiant he shines before the dawns, the embryo of the waters, he hasentered into the nascent plural nts.

mantras.sanskrit: ईळेन्यो वो मनुषो युगेषु समनगा अशुचज्जातवेदाः । सुसंदृशा भानुना यो विभाति प्रति गावः समिधानं बुधन्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: īḷenyo vo manuṣo yugeṣu samanagā aśucajjātavedāḥ | susaṃdṛśā bhānunā yo vibhāti prati gāvaḥ samidhānaṃ budhanta ||

translations.english: You, Agni, are to be glorified in (all) the ages of men; you, Jātavedas, who are illustrious whenengaged in battle; our praises wake up the kindling (Agni), him who shines with conspicuous splendour.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने याहि दूत्यं मा रिषण्यो देवाँ अच्छा ब्रह्मकृता गणेन । सरस्वतीं मरुतो अश्विनापो यक्षि देवान्रत्नधेयाय विश्वान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne yāhi dūtyaṃ mā riṣaṇyo devā~ acchā brahmakṛtā gaṇena | sarasvatīṃ maruto aśvināpo yakṣi devānratnadheyāya viśvān ||

translations.english: Repair, Agni, to the presence of the gods in your office of messenger, (sent) by the assembly engagedin prayer; neglect us not; offer worship to Sarasvati, the Maruts, the Aśvins, the waters, the universal gods, thatthey may bestow treasures (upon us).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने समिधानो वसिष्ठो जरूथं हन्यक्षि राये पुरंधिम् । पुरुणीथा जातवेदो जरस्व यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmagne samidhāno vasiṣṭho jarūthaṃ hanyakṣi rāye puraṃdhim | puruṇīthā jātavedo jarasva yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Vasiṣṭha is kindling you, Agni; destroy the malignant; worship the object of many rites, (the company ofthe gods), on behalf of the wealthy (instrumental tutor of the sacrifice), praise (the gods), Jātavedas, with manifoldpraises, and do you ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: उषो न जारः पृथु पाजो अश्रेद्दविद्युतद्दीद्यच्छोशुचानः । वृषा हरिः शुचिरा भाति भासा धियो हिन्वान उशतीरजीगः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uṣo na jāraḥ pṛthu pājo aśreddavidyutaddīdyacchośucānaḥ | vṛṣā hariḥ śucirā bhāti bhāsā dhiyo hinvāna uśatīrajīgaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, like the lover of the dawn (the sun), radiant, bright, resplendent, displays extensive lustre, theshowerer (of benefits), the receiver (of oblations), he shines with splendour, encouraging holy rites; he arouses(mankind), desiring (his presence).

mantras.sanskrit: स्वर्ण वस्तोरुषसामरोचि यज्ञं तन्वाना उशिजो न मन्म । अग्निर्जन्मानि देव आ वि विद्वान्द्रवद्दूतो देवयावा वनिष्ठः ॥
mantras.transliteration: svarṇa vastoruṣasāmaroci yajñaṃ tanvānā uśijo na manma | agnirjanmāni deva ā vi vidvāndravaddūto devayāvā vaniṣṭhaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, preceding the dawn, is radiant by day as the sun, and the priests celebrating the sacrifice repeathis praise; the divine, munificent Agni, the messenger (of the gods), cognizant of their birth, repairing to thedeities, hastens in various directions.

mantras.sanskrit: अच्छा गिरो मतयो देवयन्तीरग्निं यन्ति द्रविणं भिक्षमाणाः । सुसंदृशं सुप्रतीकं स्वञ्चं हव्यवाहमरतिं मानुषाणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: acchā giro matayo devayantīragniṃ yanti draviṇaṃ bhikṣamāṇāḥ | susaṃdṛśaṃ supratīkaṃ svañcaṃ havyavāhamaratiṃ mānuṣāṇām ||

translations.english: Devout praises and hymns, soliciting riches, proceed to Agni, who is of plural asant aspect, agreeableform, of graceful movement, the bearer of oblations, the ruler of men.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रं नो अग्ने वसुभिः सजोषा रुद्रं रुद्रेभिरा वहा बृहन्तम् । आदित्येभिरदितिं विश्वजन्यां बृहस्पतिमृक्वभिर्विश्ववारम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraṃ no agne vasubhiḥ sajoṣā rudraṃ rudrebhirā vahā bṛhantam | ādityebhiraditiṃ viśvajanyāṃ bṛhaspatimṛkvabhirviśvavāram ||

translations.english: Consentient with the Vasus, Agni, bring hither Indra, with the Rudras, the benevolent Aditi, with theĀdityas and Bṛhaspati, the desired of all, with the adorable (Aṅgirasas).

mantras.sanskrit: मन्द्रं होतारमुशिजो यविष्ठमग्निं विश ईळते अध्वरेषु । स हि क्षपावाँ अभवद्रयीणामतन्द्रो दूतो यजथाय देवान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mandraṃ hotāramuśijo yaviṣṭhamagniṃ viśa īḷate adhvareṣu | sa hi kṣapāvā~ abhavadrayīṇāmatandro dūto yajathāya devān ||

translations.english: Men desiring him celebrate at sacrifices the youthful Agni, the giver of delight, the invoker of the gods;he, the ruler of the night, has been the diligent envoy of the opulent (instrumental tutors of sacrifices) for the worship ofthe gods.

mantras.sanskrit: महाँ अस्यध्वरस्य प्रकेतो न ऋते त्वदमृता मादयन्ते । आ विश्वेभिः सरथं याहि देवैर्न्यग्ने होता प्रथमः सदेह ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahā~ asyadhvarasya praketo na ṛte tvadamṛtā mādayante | ā viśvebhiḥ sarathaṃ yāhi devairnyagne hotā prathamaḥ sadeha ||

translations.english: Great are you, Agni, the manifester of the solemnity without you the immortals do not rejoice; come inthe same chariot with all the gods; sit down here the chief, the ministrant priest.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामीळते अजिरं दूत्याय हविष्मन्तः सदमिन्मानुषासः । यस्य देवैरासदो बर्हिरग्नेऽहान्यस्मै सुदिना भवन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmīḷate ajiraṃ dūtyāya haviṣmantaḥ sadaminmānuṣāsaḥ | yasya devairāsado barhiragne'hānyasmai sudinā bhavanti ||

translations.english: Men offering oblations, ever solicit you the quick-going (to undertake) the office of their messenger, forto him, on whose sacred grass you sit with the gods, the days are prosperous.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिश्चिदक्तोः प्र चिकितुर्वसूनि त्वे अन्तर्दाशुषे मर्त्याय । मनुष्वदग्न इह यक्षि देवान्भवा नो दूतो अभिशस्तिपावा ॥
mantras.transliteration: triścidaktoḥ pra cikiturvasūni tve antardāśuṣe martyāya | manuṣvadagna iha yakṣi devānbhavā no dūto abhiśastipāvā ||

translations.english: In you, Agni, thrice in the day, (the priests) make manifest the treasures (of the oblation) for (the benefitof the) mortal donor; worship the gods on this occasion, Agni, as (you did) for Manu; be our messenger, ourprotector against malignity.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निरीशे बृहतो अध्वरस्याग्निर्विश्वस्य हविषः कृतस्य । क्रतुं ह्यस्य वसवो जुषन्ताथा देवा दधिरे हव्यवाहम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirīśe bṛhato adhvarasyāgnirviśvasya haviṣaḥ kṛtasya | kratuṃ hyasya vasavo juṣantāthā devā dadhire havyavāham ||

translations.english: Agni presides over the solemn rite, over every consecrated oblation; the Vasus approved of his acts;the gods have made him the bearer of the offering.

mantras.sanskrit: आग्ने वह हविरद्याय देवानिन्द्रज्येष्ठास इह मादयन्ताम् । इमं यज्ञं दिवि देवेषु धेहि यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: āgne vaha haviradyāya devānindrajyeṣṭhāsa iha mādayantām | imaṃ yajñaṃ divi deveṣu dhehi yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, bring the gods to eat of the oblation; may they, of whom Indra is the chief, be delighted on thisoccasion; convey this sacrifice to the deities in heaven, and do you ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: अगन्म महा नमसा यविष्ठं यो दीदाय समिद्धः स्वे दुरोणे । चित्रभानुं रोदसी अन्तरुर्वी स्वाहुतं विश्वतः प्रत्यञ्चम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: aganma mahā namasā yaviṣṭhaṃ yo dīdāya samiddhaḥ sve duroṇe | citrabhānuṃ rodasī antarurvī svāhutaṃ viśvataḥ pratyañcam ||

translations.english: Let us approach with profound reverence the youngest (of the gods), who shines when kindled in hisown abode; who is blazing wonderfully between heaven and earth, and, piously invoked, is coming from everyquarter.

mantras.sanskrit: स मह्ना विश्वा दुरितानि साह्वानग्निः ष्टवे दम आ जातवेदाः । स नो रक्षिषद्दुरितादवद्यादस्मान्गृणत उत नो मघोनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa mahnā viśvā duritāni sāhvānagniḥ ṣṭave dama ā jātavedāḥ | sa no rakṣiṣadduritādavadyādasmāngṛṇata uta no maghonaḥ ||

translations.english: May that Agni who by his greatness is the overcomer of all evils, who is praised as Jātavedas in the(sacrificial) chamber, protect us, glorifying him, and affluent (in oblations), from all sin and reproach.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं वरुण उत मित्रो अग्ने त्वां वर्धन्ति मतिभिर्वसिष्ठाः । त्वे वसु सुषणनानि सन्तु यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ varuṇa uta mitro agne tvāṃ vardhanti matibhirvasiṣṭhāḥ | tve vasu suṣaṇanāni santu yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: You are Varuṇa, you are Mitra, Agni; the Vasiṣṭhas augment you with praises; may liberally distributedriches be (extant) in you, and do you ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: प्राग्नये विश्वशुचे धियंधेऽसुरघ्ने मन्म धीतिं भरध्वम् । भरे हविर्न बर्हिषि प्रीणानो वैश्वानराय यतये मतीनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: prāgnaye viśvaśuce dhiyaṃdhe'suraghne manma dhītiṃ bharadhvam | bhare havirna barhiṣi prīṇāno vaiśvānarāya yataye matīnām ||

translations.english: Offer praise and worshp to Agni, the enlightener of all, the accepter of pious rites, the destroyer of theAsuras; propitiating him, I now present the oblation on the sacred grass to Vaiśvānara, the granter of riches.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने शोचिषा शोशुचान आ रोदसी अपृणा जायमानः । त्वं देवाँ अभिशस्तेरमुञ्चो वैश्वानर जातवेदो महित्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne śociṣā śośucāna ā rodasī apṛṇā jāyamānaḥ | tvaṃ devā~ abhiśasteramuñco vaiśvānara jātavedo mahitvā ||

translations.english: You, Agni, radiant with lustre, fill the heaven and earth (with light) as soon as born; you, Vaiśvānara,from whom wealth proceeds, has by your might liberated the gods from malevolent (foes).

mantras.sanskrit: जातो यदग्ने भुवना व्यख्यः पशून्न गोपा इर्यः परिज्मा । वैश्वानर ब्रह्मणे विन्द गातुं यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: jāto yadagne bhuvanā vyakhyaḥ paśūnna gopā iryaḥ parijmā | vaiśvānara brahmaṇe vinda gātuṃ yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: When you are born, Agni, the lord, the circumambient, you watch over all creatures as a herdsman overhis cattle; be willing, Vaiśvānara, to requite our praise, and do you cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: समिधा जातवेदसे देवाय देवहूतिभिः । हविर्भिः शुक्रशोचिषे नमस्विनो वयं दाशेमाग्नये ॥
mantras.transliteration: samidhā jātavedase devāya devahūtibhiḥ | havirbhiḥ śukraśociṣe namasvino vayaṃ dāśemāgnaye ||

translations.english: Let us, laden with oblations, offer worship with fuel and invocations of the gods to the divineJātavedas, to the purely lustrous Agni.

mantras.sanskrit: वयं ते अग्ने समिधा विधेम वयं दाशेम सुष्टुती यजत्र । वयं घृतेनाध्वरस्य होतर्वयं देव हविषा भद्रशोचे ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayaṃ te agne samidhā vidhema vayaṃ dāśema suṣṭutī yajatra | vayaṃ ghṛtenādhvarasya hotarvayaṃ deva haviṣā bhadraśoce ||

translations.english: May we perform your rites, Agni, with fuel; may we offer you, adorable Agni, pious praises; may we(gratify you), ministrant of the sacrifice, with clarified butter; divine Agni, of auspicious lustre, may we (worshipyou) with oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो देवेभिरुप देवहूतिमग्ने याहि वषट्कृतिं जुषाणः । तुभ्यं देवाय दाशतः स्याम यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no devebhirupa devahūtimagne yāhi vaṣaṭkṛtiṃ juṣāṇaḥ | tubhyaṃ devāya dāśataḥ syāma yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Come to our sacrifice, Agni, with the gods, propitiated by the sanctified oblations; may we be theofferers (of worship) to you who are divine, and do you ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: उपसद्याय मीळ्हुष आस्ये जुहुता हविः । यो नो नेदिष्ठमाप्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: upasadyāya mīḷhuṣa āsye juhutā haviḥ | yo no nediṣṭhamāpyam ||

translations.english: Offer the oblation to the present Agni, the showerer (of benefits); pour into the mouth of him who(bears) to us the nearest relationship.

mantras.sanskrit: यः पञ्च चर्षणीरभि निषसाद दमेदमे । कविर्गृहपतिर्युवा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ pañca carṣaṇīrabhi niṣasāda damedame | kavirgṛhapatiryuvā ||

translations.english: Who, juvenile, wise, the lord of the dwelling, abides with the five classes of men in every dwelling.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो वेदो अमात्यमग्नी रक्षतु विश्वतः । उतास्मान्पात्वंहसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no vedo amātyamagnī rakṣatu viśvataḥ | utāsmānpātvaṃhasaḥ ||

translations.english: May he defend for us the wealth that has been acquired, and preserve us from iniquity.

mantras.sanskrit: नवं नु स्तोममग्नये दिवः श्येनाय जीजनम् । वस्वः कुविद्वनाति नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: navaṃ nu stomamagnaye divaḥ śyenāya jījanam | vasvaḥ kuvidvanāti naḥ ||

translations.english: May Agni, to whom as to a (swift) hawk in heaven, I address this new hymn, bestow upon us amplewealth.

mantras.sanskrit: स्पार्हा यस्य श्रियो दृशे रयिर्वीरवतो यथा । अग्रे यज्ञस्य शोचतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: spārhā yasya śriyo dṛśe rayirvīravato yathā | agre yajñasya śocataḥ ||

translations.english: Of whom, blazing in the front of the sacrifice, the enviable honours are to be seen, like the riches of aman having male offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: सेमां वेतु वषट्कृतिमग्निर्जुषत नो गिरः । यजिष्ठो हव्यवाहनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: semāṃ vetu vaṣaṭkṛtimagnirjuṣata no giraḥ | yajiṣṭho havyavāhanaḥ ||

translations.english: May that most adorable Agni, the bearer of oblations, accept our offering, gratified by our praises.

mantras.sanskrit: नि त्वा नक्ष्य विश्पते द्युमन्तं देव धीमहि । सुवीरमग्न आहुत ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni tvā nakṣya viśpate dyumantaṃ deva dhīmahi | suvīramagna āhuta ||

translations.english: Divine Agni, the approachable; the lord of men, the invoked of all, we set you down (upon the altar), theresplendent, the righteously glorified.

mantras.sanskrit: क्षप उस्रश्च दीदिहि स्वग्नयस्त्वया वयम् । सुवीरस्त्वमस्मयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kṣapa usraśca dīdihi svagnayastvayā vayam | suvīrastvamasmayuḥ ||

translations.english: Blaze, Agni, night and day, that by you we may be possessed of sacred fires; may you, friendly to us,be righteously praised.

mantras.sanskrit: उप त्वा सातये नरो विप्रासो यन्ति धीतिभिः । उपाक्षरा सहस्रिणी ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa tvā sātaye naro viprāso yanti dhītibhiḥ | upākṣarā sahasriṇī ||

translations.english: Wise men approach with sacred rites for the acquisition of riches; perpetual, infinite (praise isaddressed to you);

mantras.sanskrit: अग्नी रक्षांसि सेधति शुक्रशोचिरमर्त्यः । शुचिः पावक ईड्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnī rakṣāṃsi sedhati śukraśociramartyaḥ | śuciḥ pāvaka īḍyaḥ ||

translations.english: May the bright, radiant, immortal, pure, purifying, adorable Agni, keep off the rākṣasas].

mantras.sanskrit: स नो राधांस्या भरेशानः सहसो यहो । भगश्च दातु वार्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no rādhāṃsyā bhareśānaḥ sahaso yaho | bhagaśca dātu vāryam ||

translations.english: Son of strength, who are the lord (of all), bestow riches upon us; and may Bhaga give us wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने वीरवद्यशो देवश्च सविता भगः । दितिश्च दाति वार्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne vīravadyaśo devaśca savitā bhagaḥ | ditiśca dāti vāryam ||

translations.english: Do you, Agni, give us food along with male issue, and may the divine Savitā, Bhaga and Diti, give uswealth.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने रक्षा णो अंहसः प्रति ष्म देव रीषतः । तपिष्ठैरजरो दह ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne rakṣā ṇo aṃhasaḥ prati ṣma deva rīṣataḥ | tapiṣṭhairajaro daha ||

translations.english: Preserve us, Agni, from sin; divine (Agni), who are exempt from decay, consume (our) foes with (your)hottest flames.

mantras.sanskrit: अधा मही न आयस्यनाधृष्टो नृपीतये । पूर्भवा शतभुजिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhā mahī na āyasyanādhṛṣṭo nṛpītaye | pūrbhavā śatabhujiḥ ||

translations.english: Do you, who are irresistibel, be to us, for the protection of our posterity, like the vast spacious,metal-walled cities (of the rākṣasas).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं नः पाह्यंहसो दोषावस्तरघायतः । दिवा नक्तमदाभ्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ naḥ pāhyaṃhaso doṣāvastaraghāyataḥ | divā naktamadābhya ||

translations.english: Uninjurable Agni, dispeller of darkness, preserve us night and day from sin, and from the malevolent.

mantras.sanskrit: एना वो अग्निं नमसोर्जो नपातमा हुवे । प्रियं चेतिष्ठमरतिं स्वध्वरं विश्वस्य दूतममृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: enā vo agniṃ namasorjo napātamā huve | priyaṃ cetiṣṭhamaratiṃ svadhvaraṃ viśvasya dūtamamṛtam ||

translations.english: I invoke for you with this hymn, Agni, the son of strength, the kind, the most knowing, the unobstructed;the fit object of sacred rites, the messenger of all the immortals.

mantras.sanskrit: स योजते अरुषा विश्वभोजसा स दुद्रवत्स्वाहुतः । सुब्रह्मा यज्ञः सुशमी वसूनां देवं राधो जनानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa yojate aruṣā viśvabhojasā sa dudravatsvāhutaḥ | subrahmā yajñaḥ suśamī vasūnāṃ devaṃ rādho janānām ||

translations.english: May he harness his brilliant protecting (steeds to his car), when earnestly invoked; may he hasten (tobring the gods); may the sacrificial wealth of the worshippers (proceed to) that deity who is the giver of abundantfood, the adorable, the doer of great deeds.

mantras.sanskrit: उदस्य शोचिरस्थादाजुह्वानस्य मीळ्हुषः । उद्धूमासो अरुषासो दिविस्पृशः समग्निमिन्धते नरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: udasya śocirasthādājuhvānasya mīḷhuṣaḥ | uddhūmāso aruṣāso divispṛśaḥ samagnimindhate naraḥ ||

translations.english: The radiance of that showerer (of benefits), repeatedly invoked, rises up, as does the fiery sky-lambentsmoke when men kindle Agni.

mantras.sanskrit: तं त्वा दूतं कृण्महे यशस्तमं देवाँ आ वीतये वह । विश्वा सूनो सहसो मर्तभोजना रास्व तद्यत्त्वेमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ tvā dūtaṃ kṛṇmahe yaśastamaṃ devā~ ā vītaye vaha | viśvā sūno sahaso martabhojanā rāsva tadyattvemahe ||

translations.english: We constitute you our most renowned messenger; bring the gods to partake (of the oblations); bestowupon us, son of strength, all human blessings; whatsoever we solicit of you.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने गृहपतिस्त्वं होता नो अध्वरे । त्वं पोता विश्ववार प्रचेता यक्षि वेषि च वार्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne gṛhapatistvaṃ hotā no adhvare | tvaṃ potā viśvavāra pracetā yakṣi veṣi ca vāryam ||

translations.english: All-desired Agni, you are the lord of the mansion; you are the invoker of the gods; you are the assistantpriest; do you, who are wise, present (the oblation to the gods), and partake (of it yourself).

mantras.sanskrit: कृधि रत्नं यजमानाय सुक्रतो त्वं हि रत्नधा असि । आ न ऋते शिशीहि विश्वमृत्विजं सुशंसो यश्च दक्षते ॥
mantras.transliteration: kṛdhi ratnaṃ yajamānāya sukrato tvaṃ hi ratnadhā asi | ā na ṛte śiśīhi viśvamṛtvijaṃ suśaṃso yaśca dakṣate ||

translations.english: Doer of good deeds, bestow treasure upon the instrumental tutor of the solemnity, for you are the bestower oftreasure; inspire all the priests at our sacrifice; (prosper him) who, offering worthy praise, is prosperouṣ

mantras.sanskrit: त्वे अग्ने स्वाहुत प्रियासः सन्तु सूरयः । यन्तारो ये मघवानो जनानामूर्वान्दयन्त गोनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tve agne svāhuta priyāsaḥ santu sūrayaḥ | yantāro ye maghavāno janānāmūrvāndayanta gonām ||

translations.english: Agni, piously invoked, may those devout worshippers be dear to you, who are liberal, opulent, and thebestowers upon man of herds of cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: येषामिळा घृतहस्ता दुरोण आँ अपि प्राता निषीदति । ताँस्त्रायस्व सहस्य द्रुहो निदो यच्छा नः शर्म दीर्घश्रुत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yeṣāmiḷā ghṛtahastā duroṇa ā~ api prātā niṣīdati | tā~strāyasva sahasya druho nido yacchā naḥ śarma dīrghaśrut ||

translations.english: Strength-bestowing Agni, protect from the oppressor and the revilers those in whose dwelling Iḷā,butter-handed, sits down satisfied, and grant to us felicity long renowned; Iḷā, butter-handed: iḷā ghṛtahastā= annarūpa havirlakṣaṇā devī, a goddess, the impersonation of food, that is, of sacrificial food, or theoblation person nified].

mantras.sanskrit: स मन्द्रया च जिह्वया वह्निरासा विदुष्टरः । अग्ने रयिं मघवद्भ्यो न आ वह हव्यदातिं च सूदय ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa mandrayā ca jihvayā vahnirāsā viduṣṭaraḥ | agne rayiṃ maghavadbhyo na ā vaha havyadātiṃ ca sūdaya ||

translations.english: The most wise Agni is the bearer (of oblations), as the mouth of the gods with his graceful tongue (offlame); bring riches, Agni, to the affluent (in sacrifices); encourage the donor of the oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: ये राधांसि ददत्यश्व्या मघा कामेन श्रवसो महः । ताँ अंहसः पिपृहि पर्तृभिष्ट्वं शतं पूर्भिर्यविष्ठ्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye rādhāṃsi dadatyaśvyā maghā kāmena śravaso mahaḥ | tā~ aṃhasaḥ pipṛhi partṛbhiṣṭvaṃ śataṃ pūrbhiryaviṣṭhya ||

translations.english: Youngest (of the gods), protect with your protections from iniquity, (and reward) with numerous citiesthose who, through the desire of extended fame, bestow riches, comprehending horses and treasure.

mantras.sanskrit: देवो वो द्रविणोदाः पूर्णां विवष्ट्यासिचम् । उद्वा सिञ्चध्वमुप वा पृणध्वमादिद्वो देव ओहते ॥
mantras.transliteration: devo vo draviṇodāḥ pūrṇāṃ vivaṣṭyāsicam | udvā siñcadhvamupa vā pṛṇadhvamādidvo deva ohate ||

translations.english: The divine Agni, the giver of wealth, desires the ladle filled full. Pour out (the contents), and replenish(the vessel), and then the deity bears (your oblations to the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: तं होतारमध्वरस्य प्रचेतसं वह्निं देवा अकृण्वत । दधाति रत्नं विधते सुवीर्यमग्निर्जनाय दाशुषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ hotāramadhvarasya pracetasaṃ vahniṃ devā akṛṇvata | dadhāti ratnaṃ vidhate suvīryamagnirjanāya dāśuṣe ||

translations.english: The gods have made the wise (Agni) the ministrant priest, and bearer of the sacrifice. Agni giives to theman who performs the prescribed rite and presents (the offering), wealth, with virtuous male posterity.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने भव सुषमिधा समिद्ध उत बर्हिरुर्विया वि स्तृणीताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne bhava suṣamidhā samiddha uta barhirurviyā vi stṛṇītām ||

translations.english: Be kindled, Agni, with suitable fuel; let the (priest) strew the plural ntiful sacred grass.

mantras.sanskrit: उत द्वार उशतीर्वि श्रयन्तामुत देवाँ उशत आ वहेह ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta dvāra uśatīrvi śrayantāmuta devā~ uśata ā vaheha ||

translations.english: Let the willing doors and the chamber of sacrifice be thrown open; bring hither the willing gods.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने वीहि हविषा यक्षि देवान्त्स्वध्वरा कृणुहि जातवेदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne vīhi haviṣā yakṣi devāntsvadhvarā kṛṇuhi jātavedaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni Jātavedas, repair to the gods, worship them with the oblation, render them plural ased by thesacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वध्वरा करति जातवेदा यक्षद्देवाँ अमृतान्पिप्रयच्च ॥
mantras.transliteration: svadhvarā karati jātavedā yakṣaddevā~ amṛtānpiprayacca ||

translations.english: May Jātavedas render the immortal gods, plural ased by the sacrifice; let him sacrifice (to them), andgratify them (with praise).

mantras.sanskrit: वंस्व विश्वा वार्याणि प्रचेतः सत्या भवन्त्वाशिषो नो अद्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: vaṃsva viśvā vāryāṇi pracetaḥ satyā bhavantvāśiṣo no adya ||

translations.english: Bestow upon us, sage, Agni, all desirable (riches); may the blessings (vouchsafed) to us this day besacrificed.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामु ते दधिरे हव्यवाहं देवासो अग्न ऊर्ज आ नपातम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmu te dadhire havyavāhaṃ devāso agna ūrja ā napātam ||

translations.english: The gods have made you, Agni, who are the son of strength, the bearer of the oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: ते ते देवाय दाशतः स्याम महो नो रत्ना वि दध इयानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te te devāya dāśataḥ syāma maho no ratnā vi dadha iyānaḥ ||

translations.english: May we be the presenters (of offerings) to you who are divine; and you, the mighty one, being solicited,bestow upon us treasures.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वे ह यत्पितरश्चिन्न इन्द्र विश्वा वामा जरितारो असन्वन् । त्वे गावः सुदुघास्त्वे ह्यश्वास्त्वं वसु देवयते वनिष्ठः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tve ha yatpitaraścinna indra viśvā vāmā jaritāro asanvan | tve gāvaḥ sudughāstve hyaśvāstvaṃ vasu devayate vaniṣṭhaḥ ||

translations.english: Our forefathers, Indra, glorifying you, have obtained all desirable (riches); in your gift are cows easy tobe milked, and horses, and you are the liberal donor of wealth to the devout.

mantras.sanskrit: राजेव हि जनिभिः क्षेष्येवाव द्युभिरभि विदुष्कविः सन् । पिशा गिरो मघवन्गोभिरश्वैस्त्वायतः शिशीहि राये अस्मान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: rājeva hi janibhiḥ kṣeṣyevāva dyubhirabhi viduṣkaviḥ san | piśā giro maghavangobhiraśvaistvāyataḥ śiśīhi rāye asmān ||

translations.english: You dwell with your glories like a rājā with his wives; Maghavan, who are wise and experienced,(reward our) praises with the precious metals, with cows, with horses; conduct us who are dependent on yourriches.

mantras.sanskrit: इमा उ त्वा पस्पृधानासो अत्र मन्द्रा गिरो देवयन्तीरुप स्थुः । अर्वाची ते पथ्या राय एतु स्याम ते सुमताविन्द्र शर्मन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: imā u tvā paspṛdhānāso atra mandrā giro devayantīrupa sthuḥ | arvācī te pathyā rāya etu syāma te sumatāvindra śarman ||

translations.english: These gratifying and pious hymns, emulous (in earnestness), are addressed on this occasion to you,may the path of your riches lead downwards; may we, Indra, (diligent) in your praise, enjoy felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: धेनुं न त्वा सूयवसे दुदुक्षन्नुप ब्रह्माणि ससृजे वसिष्ठः । त्वामिन्मे गोपतिं विश्व आहा न इन्द्रः सुमतिं गन्त्वच्छ ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhenuṃ na tvā sūyavase dudukṣannupa brahmāṇi sasṛje vasiṣṭhaḥ | tvāminme gopatiṃ viśva āhā na indraḥ sumatiṃ gantvaccha ||

translations.english: Desirous of milking you like a milch cow at pasture, Vasiṣṭha has let loose his prayers to you; everyone of my people proclaims you the lord of cattle; may Indra be present at our praises.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्णांसि चित्पप्रथाना सुदास इन्द्रो गाधान्यकृणोत्सुपारा । शर्धन्तं शिम्युमुचथस्य नव्यः शापं सिन्धूनामकृणोदशस्तीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: arṇāṃsi citpaprathānā sudāsa indro gādhānyakṛṇotsupārā | śardhantaṃ śimyumucathasya navyaḥ śāpaṃ sindhūnāmakṛṇodaśastīḥ ||

translations.english: The adorable Indra made the well-known deep waters (of the Paruṣṇi) fordable for Sudāsa, andconverted the vehement awakening imprecation of the sacrificer into the calumnation of the rivers.

mantras.sanskrit: पुरोळा इत्तुर्वशो यक्षुरासीद्राये मत्स्यासो निशिता अपीव । श्रुष्टिं चक्रुर्भृगवो द्रुह्यवश्च सखा सखायमतरद्विषूचोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: puroḷā itturvaśo yakṣurāsīdrāye matsyāso niśitā apīva | śruṣṭiṃ cakrurbhṛgavo druhyavaśca sakhā sakhāyamataradviṣūcoḥ ||

translations.english: Turvaśa, who was presiding (at solemn rites), diligent in sacrifice, (went to Sudāsa) for wealth; but likefishes restricted (to the element of water), the Bhrigus and Druhyus quickly assailed them; of these twoeverywhere going the friend (of Sudāsa, Indra) rescued his friend.

mantras.sanskrit: आ पक्थासो भलानसो भनन्तालिनासो विषाणिनः शिवासः । आ योऽनयत्सधमा आर्यस्य गव्या तृत्सुभ्यो अजगन्युधा नॄन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā pakthāso bhalānaso bhanantālināso viṣāṇinaḥ śivāsaḥ | ā yo'nayatsadhamā āryasya gavyā tṛtsubhyo ajaganyudhā nṝn ||

translations.english: Those who dress the oblation, those who pronounce auspicious words, those who abstain frompenance, those who bear horns (in their hands), those who bestow happiness (on the world by sacrifice), glorifythat Indra, who recovered the cattle of the Arya from the plural nderers, who slew the enemies in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: दुराध्यो अदितिं स्रेवयन्तोऽचेतसो वि जगृभ्रे परुष्णीम् । मह्नाविव्यक्पृथिवीं पत्यमानः पशुष्कविरशयच्चायमानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: durādhyo aditiṃ srevayanto'cetaso vi jagṛbhre paruṣṇīm | mahnāvivyakpṛthivīṃ patyamānaḥ paśuṣkaviraśayaccāyamānaḥ ||

translations.english: The evil-disposed and stupid (enemies of Sudāsa), crossing the humble Paruṣṇi river, have brokendown its banks; but he by his greatness pervades the earth, and Kavi, the son of Cāyamana, like a fallingvictim, sleeps (in death).

mantras.sanskrit: ईयुरर्थं न न्यर्थं परुष्णीमाशुश्चनेदभिपित्वं जगाम । सुदास इन्द्रः सुतुकाँ अमित्रानरन्धयन्मानुषे वध्रिवाचः ॥
mantras.transliteration: īyurarthaṃ na nyarthaṃ paruṣṇīmāśuścanedabhipitvaṃ jagāma | sudāsa indraḥ sutukā~ amitrānarandhayanmānuṣe vadhrivācaḥ ||

translations.english: The waters followed their regular course to the Paruṣṇi, nor (wandered) beyond it; the quick courser(of the king) came to the accessible plural ces, and Indra made the idly-talking enemies, with their numerousprogeny, subject among men (to Sudāsa).

mantras.sanskrit: ईयुर्गावो न यवसादगोपा यथाकृतमभि मित्रं चितासः । पृश्निगावः पृश्निनिप्रेषितासः श्रुष्टिं चक्रुर्नियुतो रन्तयश्च ॥
mantras.transliteration: īyurgāvo na yavasādagopā yathākṛtamabhi mitraṃ citāsaḥ | pṛśnigāvaḥ pṛśninipreṣitāsaḥ śruṣṭiṃ cakrurniyuto rantayaśca ||

translations.english: They who ride on particoloured cattle, (the Maruts), despatched by Pṛṣṇi and recalling theengagement made by them with their friend (Indra), came like cattle from the pasturage, when left without aherdsman; the exulting Niyut steeds brought them quickly (against the foe).

mantras.sanskrit: एकं च यो विंशतिं च श्रवस्या वैकर्णयोर्जनान्राजा न्यस्तः । दस्मो न सद्मन्नि शिशाति बर्हिः शूरः सर्गमकृणोदिन्द्र एषाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ekaṃ ca yo viṃśatiṃ ca śravasyā vaikarṇayorjanānrājā nyastaḥ | dasmo na sadmanni śiśāti barhiḥ śūraḥ sargamakṛṇodindra eṣām ||

translations.english: The hero Indra created the Maruts (for the assistance of the rājā), who, ambitious of fame, slewone-and-twenty of the men on the two banks (of the Paruṣṇi), as a well-looking priest lops the sacred grass inthe chamber of sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: अध श्रुतं कवषं वृद्धमप्स्वनु द्रुह्युं नि वृणग्वज्रबाहुः । वृणाना अत्र सख्याय सख्यं त्वायन्तो ये अमदन्ननु त्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha śrutaṃ kavaṣaṃ vṛddhamapsvanu druhyuṃ ni vṛṇagvajrabāhuḥ | vṛṇānā atra sakhyāya sakhyaṃ tvāyanto ye amadannanu tvā ||

translations.english: You, the bearer of the thunderbolt, did drown Śruta, Kavaṣa, Vṛddha and afterwards Druhyu, in thewaters; for they, Indra, who are devoted to you, and glorify you, preferring your friendship, enjoy it.

mantras.sanskrit: वि सद्यो विश्वा दृंहितान्येषामिन्द्रः पुरः सहसा सप्त दर्दः । व्यानवस्य तृत्सवे गयं भाग्जेष्म पूरुं विदथे मृध्रवाचम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi sadyo viśvā dṛṃhitānyeṣāmindraḥ puraḥ sahasā sapta dardaḥ | vyānavasya tṛtsave gayaṃ bhāgjeṣma pūruṃ vidathe mṛdhravācam ||

translations.english: Indra, in his might, quickly demolished all their strongholds, and their seven (kinds of) cities; he hasgiven the dwelling of the son of Anu to Tṛtsu; may we, (by propitiating Indra), conquer in battle the ill-speakingman.

mantras.sanskrit: नि गव्यवोऽनवो द्रुह्यवश्च षष्टिः शता सुषुपुः षट् सहस्रा । षष्टिर्वीरासो अधि षड्दुवोयु विश्वेदिन्द्रस्य वीर्या कृतानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni gavyavo'navo druhyavaśca ṣaṣṭiḥ śatā suṣupuḥ ṣaṭ sahasrā | ṣaṣṭirvīrāso adhi ṣaḍduvoyu viśvedindrasya vīryā kṛtāni ||

translations.english: The warriors of the Anus and Druhyus, intending (to carry off the) cattle, (hostile) to the pious(Sudāsa) perished to the number of sixty-six thousand six hundred and sixty; such are all the glorious acts ofIndra.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रेणैते तृत्सवो वेविषाणा आपो न सृष्टा अधवन्त नीचीः । दुर्मित्रासः प्रकलविन्मिमाना जहुर्विश्वानि भोजना सुदासे ॥
mantras.transliteration: indreṇaite tṛtsavo veviṣāṇā āpo na sṛṣṭā adhavanta nīcīḥ | durmitrāsaḥ prakalavinmimānā jahurviśvāni bhojanā sudāse ||

translations.english: These hostile, Tṛtsus, ignorantly contending with Indra, fled routed as rapidly as rivers on a downwardcourse, and being discomfited, abandoned all their possessions to Sudāsa.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्धं वीरस्य शृतपामनिन्द्रं परा शर्धन्तं नुनुदे अभि क्षाम् । इन्द्रो मन्युं मन्युम्यो मिमाय भेजे पथो वर्तनिं पत्यमानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ardhaṃ vīrasya śṛtapāmanindraṃ parā śardhantaṃ nunude abhi kṣām | indro manyuṃ manyumyo mimāya bheje patho vartaniṃ patyamānaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra has scattered over the earth the hostile rival of the hero (Sudāsa), the senior of Indra, theappropriator of the oblation; Indra has baffled the wrath of the wratfhful enemy, and the (foe) advancing on theway (against Sudāsa) has taken the path of flight.

mantras.sanskrit: आध्रेण चित्तद्वेकं चकार सिंह्यं चित्पेत्वेना जघान । अव स्रक्तीर्वेश्यावृश्चदिन्द्रः प्रायच्छद्विश्वा भोजना सुदासे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ādhreṇa cittadvekaṃ cakāra siṃhyaṃ citpetvenā jaghāna | ava sraktīrveśyāvṛścadindraḥ prāyacchadviśvā bhojanā sudāse ||

translations.english: Indra, has effected a valuable (donation) by a pauper; he has slain an old lion by a goat; he has cut theangles of the sacrificial post with a needle; he has given all the spoils (of the enemy) to Sudāsa.

mantras.sanskrit: शश्वन्तो हि शत्रवो रारधुष्टे भेदस्य चिच्छर्धतो विन्द रन्धिम् । मर्ताँ एनः स्तुवतो यः कृणोति तिग्मं तस्मिन्नि जहि वज्रमिन्द्र ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaśvanto hi śatravo rāradhuṣṭe bhedasya cicchardhato vinda randhim | martā~ enaḥ stuvato yaḥ kṛṇoti tigmaṃ tasminni jahi vajramindra ||

translations.english: Your numerous enemies, Indra, have been reduced to subjection, effect at some time or other thesubjugation of the turbulent Bheda, who holds men praising you as guilty of wickedness; hurl, Indra, your sharpthuderbolt against him.

mantras.sanskrit: आवदिन्द्रं यमुना तृत्सवश्च प्रात्र भेदं सर्वताता मुषायत् । अजासश्च शिग्रवो यक्षवश्च बलिं शीर्षाणि जभ्रुरश्व्यानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: āvadindraṃ yamunā tṛtsavaśca prātra bhedaṃ sarvatātā muṣāyat | ajāsaśca śigravo yakṣavaśca baliṃ śīrṣāṇi jabhruraśvyāni ||

translations.english: The dwellers on the Yamuna and the Tṛtsus glorified Indra when he killed Bheda in battle; the Ajas, theŚigrus, the Yakṣas, offered him as a sacrifice the heads of the horses (killed in the combat).

mantras.sanskrit: न त इन्द्र सुमतयो न रायः संचक्षे पूर्वा उषसो न नूत्नाः । देवकं चिन्मान्यमानं जघन्थाव त्मना बृहतः शम्बरं भेत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: na ta indra sumatayo na rāyaḥ saṃcakṣe pūrvā uṣaso na nūtnāḥ | devakaṃ cinmānyamānaṃ jaghanthāva tmanā bṛhataḥ śambaraṃ bhet ||

translations.english: Your favours, Indra, and your bounties, whether old or new, cannot be counted like the (recurring)dawn; you have slain Devaka, the son of Mānyamāna, and of thine own will, has cast down Śambara from thevast (mountain).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ये गृहादममदुस्त्वाया पराशरः शतयातुर्वसिष्ठः । न ते भोजस्य सख्यं मृषन्ताधा सूरिभ्यः सुदिना व्युच्छान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra ye gṛhādamamadustvāyā parāśaraḥ śatayāturvasiṣṭhaḥ | na te bhojasya sakhyaṃ mṛṣantādhā sūribhyaḥ sudinā vyucchān ||

translations.english: Parāśara, the destroyer of hundreds (of rākṣasas), and Vasiṣṭha they who, devoted to you, haveglorified you in every dwelling, neglect not the friendship of you (their) benefactor; therefore prosperous daysdawn upon the pious.

mantras.sanskrit: द्वे नप्तुर्देववतः शते गोर्द्वा रथा वधूमन्ता सुदासः । अर्हन्नग्ने पैजवनस्य दानं होतेव सद्म पर्येमि रेभन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dve napturdevavataḥ śate gordvā rathā vadhūmantā sudāsaḥ | arhannagne paijavanasya dānaṃ hoteva sadma paryemi rebhan ||

translations.english: Praising the liberality of Sudāsa, the grandson of Devavat, the son of Paijavana, the donor of twohundred cows, and of two chariots with two wives, I, worthy (of the gift), circumambulate you, Agni, like theministrant priest in the chamber (of sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: चत्वारो मा पैजवनस्य दानाः स्मद्दिष्टयः कृशनिनो निरेके । ऋज्रासो मा पृथिविष्ठाः सुदासस्तोकं तोकाय श्रवसे वहन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: catvāro mā paijavanasya dānāḥ smaddiṣṭayaḥ kṛśanino nireke | ṛjrāso mā pṛthiviṣṭhāḥ sudāsastokaṃ tokāya śravase vahanti ||

translations.english: Four (horses), having golden trappings, going steadily on a difficult road, celebrated on the earth, theexcellent and acceptable gifts (made) to me by Sudāsa, the son of Paijavana, bear me as a son (to obtain) foodand progeny.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य श्रवो रोदसी अन्तरुर्वी शीर्ष्णेशीर्ष्णे विबभाजा विभक्ता । सप्तेदिन्द्रं न स्रवतो गृणन्ति नि युध्यामधिमशिशादभीके ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya śravo rodasī antarurvī śīrṣṇeśīrṣṇe vibabhājā vibhaktā | saptedindraṃ na sravato gṛṇanti ni yudhyāmadhimaśiśādabhīke ||

translations.english: The seven worlds praise (Sudāsa) as if he were Indra; him whose fame (spreads) through thespacious heaven and earth; who, munificent, has distributed (wealth) on every eminent person n, and (for him) theflowing (rivers) have destroyed Yudhyamadhi in war.

mantras.sanskrit: इमं नरो मरुतः सश्चतानु दिवोदासं न पितरं सुदासः । अविष्टना पैजवनस्य केतं दूणाशं क्षत्रमजरं दुवोयु ॥
mantras.transliteration: imaṃ naro marutaḥ saścatānu divodāsaṃ na pitaraṃ sudāsaḥ | aviṣṭanā paijavanasya ketaṃ dūṇāśaṃ kṣatramajaraṃ duvoyu ||

translations.english: Maruts, leaders (of rites), attend upon this (prince) as you did upon Divodāsa, the father of Sudāsa;favour the prayers of the devout son of Pijavana, and may his strength be unimpaired, undecaying].

mantras.sanskrit: यस्तिग्मशृङ्गो वृषभो न भीम एकः कृष्टीश्च्यावयति प्र विश्वाः । यः शश्वतो अदाशुषो गयस्य प्रयन्तासि सुष्वितराय वेदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yastigmaśṛṅgo vṛṣabho na bhīma ekaḥ kṛṣṭīścyāvayati pra viśvāḥ | yaḥ śaśvato adāśuṣo gayasya prayantāsi suṣvitarāya vedaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, who is formidable as a sharp-horned bull, singly expels all men (from their stations); you who arethe despoiler of the ample wealth of him who makes no offerings are the giver of riches to the presenter offrequent oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं ह त्यदिन्द्र कुत्समावः शुश्रूषमाणस्तन्वा समर्ये । दासं यच्छुष्णं कुयवं न्यस्मा अरन्धय आर्जुनेयाय शिक्षन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ ha tyadindra kutsamāvaḥ śuśrūṣamāṇastanvā samarye | dāsaṃ yacchuṣṇaṃ kuyavaṃ nyasmā arandhaya ārjuneyāya śikṣan ||

translations.english: Aiding him with your person n, Indra, you had defended Kutsa in combat when you had subjugatedDāsa, Śuṣṇa and Kuyava, giving (their spoil) to that son of Arjuni.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं धृष्णो धृषता वीतहव्यं प्रावो विश्वाभिरूतिभिः सुदासम् । प्र पौरुकुत्सिं त्रसदस्युमावः क्षेत्रसाता वृत्रहत्येषु पूरुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ dhṛṣṇo dhṛṣatā vītahavyaṃ prāvo viśvābhirūtibhiḥ sudāsam | pra paurukutsiṃ trasadasyumāvaḥ kṣetrasātā vṛtrahatyeṣu pūrum ||

translations.english: Undaunted (Indra), you had protected with all your protections Sudāsa, the offerer of oblations; youhave protected in battles with enemies for the possession of the earth Trasadasyu, the son of Purukutsa, andPuru.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं नृभिर्नृमणो देववीतौ भूरीणि वृत्रा हर्यश्व हंसि । त्वं नि दस्युं चुमुरिं धुनिं चास्वापयो दभीतये सुहन्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ nṛbhirnṛmaṇo devavītau bhūrīṇi vṛtrā haryaśva haṃsi | tvaṃ ni dasyuṃ cumuriṃ dhuniṃ cāsvāpayo dabhītaye suhantu ||

translations.english: You, the lord of horses, who are honoured by men, have destroyed, along with the Maruts, numerousenemies at the sacrifice of the gods; you have put to sleep with the thunderbolt the Dasyus, Chumuri, and Dhuni,on behalf of Dabhīti.

mantras.sanskrit: तव च्यौत्नानि वज्रहस्त तानि नव यत्पुरो नवतिं च सद्यः । निवेशने शततमाविवेषीरहञ्च वृत्रं नमुचिमुताहन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava cyautnāni vajrahasta tāni nava yatpuro navatiṃ ca sadyaḥ | niveśane śatatamāviveṣīrahañca vṛtraṃ namucimutāhan ||

translations.english: Such, wielder of the thunderbolt, are your mighty powers, that when you had quickly destroyed ninetyand nine cities, you have occupied the hundredth as a plural ce of abode; you have slain Vṛtra, you have also slainNamuci.

mantras.sanskrit: सना ता त इन्द्र भोजनानि रातहव्याय दाशुषे सुदासे । वृष्णे ते हरी वृषणा युनज्मि व्यन्तु ब्रह्माणि पुरुशाक वाजम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sanā tā ta indra bhojanāni rātahavyāya dāśuṣe sudāse | vṛṣṇe te harī vṛṣaṇā yunajmi vyantu brahmāṇi puruśāka vājam ||

translations.english: Your favours, Indra, to Sudāsa, the donor (of offerings), the presenter of oblations, are infinite;showerer (of benefits), I yoke for you (your vigorous) steeds; may our prayers reach you who are mighty, towhom many rites are addressed.

mantras.sanskrit: मा ते अस्यां सहसावन्परिष्टावघाय भूम हरिवः परादै । त्रायस्व नोऽवृकेभिर्वरूथैस्तव प्रियासः सूरिषु स्याम ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā te asyāṃ sahasāvanpariṣṭāvaghāya bhūma harivaḥ parādai | trāyasva no'vṛkebhirvarūthaistava priyāsaḥ sūriṣu syāma ||

translations.english: Powerful Indra, lord of horses, let us not be exposed at this ceremony, addressed to you, to themurderous despoiler; protect us with impregnable defences; may we be held dear among your worshippers.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रियास इत्ते मघवन्नभिष्टौ नरो मदेम शरणे सखायः । नि तुर्वशं नि याद्वं शिशीह्यतिथिग्वाय शंस्यं करिष्यन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: priyāsa itte maghavannabhiṣṭau naro madema śaraṇe sakhāyaḥ | ni turvaśaṃ ni yādvaṃ śiśīhyatithigvāya śaṃsyaṃ kariṣyan ||

translations.english: May we, Maghavan, leaders in your adoration, regarded as dear friends, be happy in our homes; aboutto bestow felicity upon Atithigvan, humiliate Turvaśa; (humiliate) the son of Yadu.

mantras.sanskrit: सद्यश्चिन्नु ते मघवन्नभिष्टौ नरः शंसन्त्युक्थशास उक्था । ये ते हवेभिर्वि पणीँरदाशन्नस्मान्वृणीष्व युज्याय तस्मै ॥
mantras.transliteration: sadyaścinnu te maghavannabhiṣṭau naraḥ śaṃsantyukthaśāsa ukthā | ye te havebhirvi paṇī~radāśannasmānvṛṇīṣva yujyāya tasmai ||

translations.english: The leader (of rites), reciters of prayers, offer, Maghavan, prayers devoutly for your adoration; they bytheir praises have appropriated the wealth of the niggards; select us (as the objects) of your friendship.

mantras.sanskrit: एते स्तोमा नरां नृतम तुभ्यमस्मद्र्यञ्चो ददतो मघानि । तेषामिन्द्र वृत्रहत्ये शिवो भूः सखा च शूरोऽविता च नृणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ete stomā narāṃ nṛtama tubhyamasmadryañco dadato maghāni | teṣāmindra vṛtrahatye śivo bhūḥ sakhā ca śūro'vitā ca nṛṇām ||

translations.english: Chief leader (of rites), these praises of man addressed to you revert to us, who are the offerers of(sacrificial) riches; do you be propitious to such men, (Indra), in conflicts with enemies; be their friend, their hero,and protector.

mantras.sanskrit: नू इन्द्र शूर स्तवमान ऊती ब्रह्मजूतस्तन्वा वावृधस्व । उप नो वाजान्मिमीह्युप स्तीन्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū indra śūra stavamāna ūtī brahmajūtastanvā vāvṛdhasva | upa no vājānmimīhyupa stīnyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Hero, Indra, glorified on the present occasion, and propitiated by praise, be amplified in your person n forour protection; bestow upon us food and habitations; and do you ever cherish us wiht blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: उग्रो जज्ञे वीर्याय स्वधावाञ्चक्रिरपो नर्यो यत्करिष्यन् । जग्मिर्युवा नृषदनमवोभिस्त्राता न इन्द्र एनसो महश्चित् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ugro jajñe vīryāya svadhāvāñcakrirapo naryo yatkariṣyan | jagmiryuvā nṛṣadanamavobhistrātā na indra enaso mahaścit ||

translations.english: The fierce and powerful (Indra) has been born for heroic (deeds); friendly to man, he is theaccomplisher of whatever act he undertakes to perform; ever youthful, he invests the (sacrificial) hall withdefences (against interruption); be our preserver, Indra, from heinous sin.

mantras.sanskrit: हन्ता वृत्रमिन्द्रः शूशुवानः प्रावीन्नु वीरो जरितारमूती । कर्ता सुदासे अह वा उ लोकं दाता वसु मुहुरा दाशुषे भूत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: hantā vṛtramindraḥ śūśuvānaḥ prāvīnnu vīro jaritāramūtī | kartā sudāse aha vā u lokaṃ dātā vasu muhurā dāśuṣe bhūt ||

translations.english: Indra, dilating in bulk, is the slayer of Vṛtra; the hero defends his worshipper promptly with hisprotection, whether he be the giver of dominion to Sudāsa, or the donor repeatedly of wealth to the offerer (ofoblations).

mantras.sanskrit: युध्मो अनर्वा खजकृत्समद्वा शूरः सत्राषाड्जनुषेमषाळ्हः । व्यास इन्द्रः पृतनाः स्वोजा अधा विश्वं शत्रूयन्तं जघान ॥
mantras.transliteration: yudhmo anarvā khajakṛtsamadvā śūraḥ satrāṣāḍjanuṣemaṣāḷhaḥ | vyāsa indraḥ pṛtanāḥ svojā adhā viśvaṃ śatrūyantaṃ jaghāna ||

translations.english: A warrior who turns not back in battle, a combatant, one engaged in tumults, a hero, victorious over(his) foes from birth, invincible, of great vigour, this Indra scatters (hostile) hosts and slays all (his) adversaries.

mantras.sanskrit: उभे चिदिन्द्र रोदसी महित्वा पप्राथ तविषीभिस्तुविष्मः । नि वज्रमिन्द्रो हरिवान्मिमिक्षन्त्समन्धसा मदेषु वा उवोच ॥
mantras.transliteration: ubhe cidindra rodasī mahitvā paprātha taviṣībhistuviṣmaḥ | ni vajramindro harivānmimikṣantsamandhasā madeṣu vā uvoca ||

translations.english: Opulent Indra, you have filled both heaven and earth with your magnitutde, your energies; Indra, thelord of horses, brandishing the thunderbolt, is gratified at sacrifices by the (sacrificial) food.

mantras.sanskrit: वृषा जजान वृषणं रणाय तमु चिन्नारी नर्यं ससूव । प्र यः सेनानीरध नृभ्यो अस्तीनः सत्वा गवेषणः स धृष्णुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣā jajāna vṛṣaṇaṃ raṇāya tamu cinnārī naryaṃ sasūva | pra yaḥ senānīradha nṛbhyo astīnaḥ satvā gaveṣaṇaḥ sa dhṛṣṇuḥ ||

translations.english: (His) progenitor begot Indra, the showerer (of benefits) for (the purpose of) war; his mother brought himforth the benefactor of man; the leader of armies who is chief over men, he is the lord, the conqueror, therecoverer of the kine, the subduer of foes.

mantras.sanskrit: नू चित्स भ्रेषते जनो न रेषन्मनो यो अस्य घोरमाविवासात् । यज्ञैर्य इन्द्रे दधते दुवांसि क्षयत्स राय ऋतपा ऋतेजाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū citsa bhreṣate jano na reṣanmano yo asya ghoramāvivāsāt | yajñairya indre dadhate duvāṃsi kṣayatsa rāya ṛtapā ṛtejāḥ ||

translations.english: He who devotes his mind to the terrible Indra never falls (from his condition), nor will he perish; theprotector of sacred rites, the progeny of sacrifice, bestows riches on him who offers to Indra praises and prayerswith sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: यदिन्द्र पूर्वो अपराय शिक्षन्नयज्ज्यायान्कनीयसो देष्णम् । अमृत इत्पर्यासीत दूरमा चित्र चित्र्यं भरा रयिं नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadindra pūrvo aparāya śikṣannayajjyāyānkanīyaso deṣṇam | amṛta itparyāsīta dūramā citra citryaṃ bharā rayiṃ naḥ ||

translations.english: That (wealth) Indra, which the prior has given to the posterior; which the elder may accept from theyounger; with which (the son) yet living dwells far away (separated from his father), confer, wonderful Indra, suchprecious riches upon us.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्त इन्द्र प्रियो जनो ददाशदसन्निरेके अद्रिवः सखा ते । वयं ते अस्यां सुमतौ चनिष्ठाः स्याम वरूथे अघ्नतो नृपीतौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasta indra priyo jano dadāśadasannireke adrivaḥ sakhā te | vayaṃ te asyāṃ sumatau caniṣṭhāḥ syāma varūthe aghnato nṛpītau ||

translations.english: May the man who is dear to you, Indra, present (oblations); may he be your friend, wielder of thethunderbolt, he (assiduous) in donations; may we be abounding in food through this favour of you who aredevoid of cruelty, (may we be in the enjoyment of) a dwelling giving shelter to men.

mantras.sanskrit: एष स्तोमो अचिक्रदद्वृषा त उत स्तामुर्मघवन्नक्रपिष्ट । रायस्कामो जरितारं त आगन्त्वमङ्ग शक्र वस्व आ शको नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa stomo acikradadvṛṣā ta uta stāmurmaghavannakrapiṣṭa | rāyaskāmo jaritāraṃ ta āgantvamaṅga śakra vasva ā śako naḥ ||

translations.english: For you, Maghavan, this showering Soma (libation) cries aloud; to you the worshipper has recitedpraises; the desire of riches has fallen upon thine adorer, do you, therefore, Śakra, bestow quickly upon uswealth.

mantras.sanskrit: स न इन्द्र त्वयताया इषे धास्त्मना च ये मघवानो जुनन्ति । वस्वी षु ते जरित्रे अस्तु शक्तिर्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa na indra tvayatāyā iṣe dhāstmanā ca ye maghavāno junanti | vasvī ṣu te jaritre astu śaktiryūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Enable us, Indra, (to partake of) food granted by you, as well as those who, opulent (in sacrificialpresentations), spontaneously offer (you oblations); may there be power in thine adorer (to repeat) manylaudations; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: असावि देवं गोऋजीकमन्धो न्यस्मिन्निन्द्रो जनुषेमुवोच । बोधामसि त्वा हर्यश्व यज्ञैर्बोधा नः स्तोममन्धसो मदेषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: asāvi devaṃ goṛjīkamandho nyasminnindro januṣemuvoca | bodhāmasi tvā haryaśva yajñairbodhā naḥ stomamandhaso madeṣu ||

translations.english: Bright sacrificial food mixed with curds and milk has been poured out; Indra delights in it from his birth;lord of bay horses, we wake you up with sacrifices, acknowledge our praises in the exhilaration of the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र यन्ति यज्ञं विपयन्ति बर्हिः सोममादो विदथे दुध्रवाचः । न्यु भ्रियन्ते यशसो गृभादा दूरौपब्दो वृषणो नृषाचः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra yanti yajñaṃ vipayanti barhiḥ somamādo vidathe dudhravācaḥ | nyu bhriyante yaśaso gṛbhādā dūraupabdo vṛṣaṇo nṛṣācaḥ ||

translations.english: They repair to the sacrifice, they strew the sacred grass; the (grinding) stones at the ceremony are ofdifficulty suppressed noise; famous priests, whose voices are heard far off, bring the stones from the interior ofthe dwelling.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमिन्द्र स्रवितवा अपस्कः परिष्ठिता अहिना शूर पूर्वीः । त्वद्वावक्रे रथ्यो न धेना रेजन्ते विश्वा कृत्रिमाणि भीषा ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamindra sravitavā apaskaḥ pariṣṭhitā ahinā śūra pūrvīḥ | tvadvāvakre rathyo na dhenā rejante viśvā kṛtrimāṇi bhīṣā ||

translations.english: You, hero, have enabled the many waters arrested by Ahi to flow; by you the rivers rushed forth likecharioteers; all created worlds trembled through fear of you.

mantras.sanskrit: भीमो विवेषायुधेभिरेषामपांसि विश्वा नर्याणि विद्वान् । इन्द्रः पुरो जर्हृषाणो वि दूधोद्वि वज्रहस्तो महिना जघान ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhīmo viveṣāyudhebhireṣāmapāṃsi viśvā naryāṇi vidvān | indraḥ puro jarhṛṣāṇo vi dūdhodvi vajrahasto mahinā jaghāna ||

translations.english: The formidable (Indra), knowing all actions beneficial to man, intimidated those (asuras) by hisweapons; Indra, exuling shook their cities; armed with his thunderbolt he slew them in his might.

mantras.sanskrit: न यातव इन्द्र जूजुवुर्नो न वन्दना शविष्ठ वेद्याभिः । स शर्धदर्यो विषुणस्य जन्तोर्मा शिश्नदेवा अपि गुॠतं नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: na yātava indra jūjuvurno na vandanā śaviṣṭha vedyābhiḥ | sa śardhadaryo viṣuṇasya jantormā śiśnadevā api guṝtaṃ naḥ ||

translations.english: Let not th rākṣasas, Indra, do us harm; let not the evil spirits do harm to our progeny, most powerful(Indra); let the sovereign lord, (Indra), exert himself (in the restraint) of disorderly beings, so that the unchastemay not disturb our rite.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि क्रत्वेन्द्र भूरध ज्मन्न ते विव्यङ्महिमानं रजांसि । स्वेना हि वृत्रं शवसा जघन्थ न शत्रुरन्तं विविदद्युधा ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi kratvendra bhūradha jmanna te vivyaṅmahimānaṃ rajāṃsi | svenā hi vṛtraṃ śavasā jaghantha na śatrurantaṃ vividadyudhā te ||

translations.english: You, Indra, by your function, preside over the beings (of earth); all the regions (of the world) do notsurpass your magnitude; by thine own strength you have slain Vṛtra; no enemy has effected your destruction inbattle.

mantras.sanskrit: देवाश्चित्ते असुर्याय पूर्वेऽनु क्षत्राय ममिरे सहांसि । इन्द्रो मघानि दयते विषह्येन्द्रं वाजस्य जोहुवन्त सातौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: devāścitte asuryāya pūrve'nu kṣatrāya mamire sahāṃsi | indro maghāni dayate viṣahyendraṃ vājasya johuvanta sātau ||

translations.english: The older deities have confessed your vigour superior to their destructive strength, Indra havingsubdued his foes, gives the rich spoils (to his worshippers); they invoke Indra to obtain food.

mantras.sanskrit: कीरिश्चिद्धि त्वामवसे जुहावेशानमिन्द्र सौभगस्य भूरेः । अवो बभूथ शतमूते अस्मे अभिक्षत्तुस्त्वावतो वरूता ॥
mantras.transliteration: kīriściddhi tvāmavase juhāveśānamindra saubhagasya bhūreḥ | avo babhūtha śatamūte asme abhikṣattustvāvato varūtā ||

translations.english: The worshipper has invoked you the sovereign Indra, for protection; protector of many, you have beento us the guardian of great fortune; be our defender against every overpowering (assailant).

mantras.sanskrit: सखायस्त इन्द्र विश्वह स्याम नमोवृधासो महिना तरुत्र । वन्वन्तु स्मा तेऽवसा समीकेऽभीतिमर्यो वनुषां शवांसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: sakhāyasta indra viśvaha syāma namovṛdhāso mahinā tarutra | vanvantu smā te'vasā samīke'bhītimaryo vanuṣāṃ śavāṃsi ||

translations.english: May we, daily increasing in reverence, be (regarded), Indra, (as) your friends; through the protection ofyou, surpasser in greatness, may (your worshippers) repulse the attack of the foe in battle, the strength of themalevolent.

mantras.sanskrit: स न इन्द्र त्वयताया इषे धास्त्मना च ये मघवानो जुनन्ति । वस्वी षु ते जरित्रे अस्तु शक्तिर्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa na indra tvayatāyā iṣe dhāstmanā ca ye maghavāno junanti | vasvī ṣu te jaritre astu śaktiryūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Enable us, Indra, (to partake of) food granted by you, as well as those who, opulent (in sacrificialpresentations), spontaneously offer the (oblations); may there be ability in thine adorer (to repeat) my laudations;and do you ever cherish us wiḥ blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: पिबा सोममिन्द्र मन्दतु त्वा यं ते सुषाव हर्यश्वाद्रिः । सोतुर्बाहुभ्यां सुयतो नार्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: pibā somamindra mandatu tvā yaṃ te suṣāva haryaśvādriḥ | soturbāhubhyāṃ suyato nārvā ||

translations.english: Drink, Indra, the Soma; may it exhilarate you, that which the stone tightly held like a horse (by thereins), by the arms of the grinder, has expressed, lord of bay horses for you.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्ते मदो युज्यश्चारुरस्ति येन वृत्राणि हर्यश्व हंसि । स त्वामिन्द्र प्रभूवसो ममत्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaste mado yujyaścārurasti yena vṛtrāṇi haryaśva haṃsi | sa tvāmindra prabhūvaso mamattu ||

translations.english: May the exhilarating Soma which is fit for and suitable to you, by which, lord of bay horses, you slayVṛtra, exhilarate you, Indra, abounding in riches.

mantras.sanskrit: बोधा सु मे मघवन्वाचमेमां यां ते वसिष्ठो अर्चति प्रशस्तिम् । इमा ब्रह्म सधमादे जुषस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: bodhā su me maghavanvācamemāṃ yāṃ te vasiṣṭho arcati praśastim | imā brahma sadhamāde juṣasva ||
