translations.english: Understand thoroughly, Maghavan, this my speech, this praise of you, which Vasiṣṭha recites; bepleased by these prayers at the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रुधी हवं विपिपानस्याद्रेर्बोधा विप्रस्यार्चतो मनीषाम् । कृष्वा दुवांस्यन्तमा सचेमा ॥
mantras.transliteration: śrudhī havaṃ vipipānasyādrerbodhā viprasyārcato manīṣām | kṛṣvā duvāṃsyantamā sacemā ||

translations.english: Hear the invocation of the (grinding) stone, (of me) repeatedly drinking (the Soma), comprehend thehymn of the adoring sage, and, friendly (with us), take to your near consideration these adorations.

mantras.sanskrit: न ते गिरो अपि मृष्ये तुरस्य न सुष्टुतिमसुर्यस्य विद्वान् । सदा ते नाम स्वयशो विवक्मि ॥
mantras.transliteration: na te giro api mṛṣye turasya na suṣṭutimasuryasya vidvān | sadā te nāma svayaśo vivakmi ||

translations.english: Knowing of your strength, I refrain not from the praise nor from the glorification of you, the destroyer (offoes), but ever proclaim your especial care.

mantras.sanskrit: भूरि हि ते सवना मानुषेषु भूरि मनीषी हवते त्वामित् । मारे अस्मन्मघवञ्ज्योक्कः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhūri hi te savanā mānuṣeṣu bhūri manīṣī havate tvāmit | māre asmanmaghavañjyokkaḥ ||

translations.english: Many are the sacrifices offered, Maghavan, to you among mankind; constantly does worshipper indeedinvoke you; therefore be not far nor be a long time from us.

mantras.sanskrit: तुभ्येदिमा सवना शूर विश्वा तुभ्यं ब्रह्माणि वर्धना कृणोमि । त्वं नृभिर्हव्यो विश्वधासि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tubhyedimā savanā śūra viśvā tubhyaṃ brahmāṇi vardhanā kṛṇomi | tvaṃ nṛbhirhavyo viśvadhāsi ||

translations.english: To you, hero, I indeed offer these sacrifices, to you I address these elevating praises; you are to be inall ways invoked by the leaders (of rites).

mantras.sanskrit: नू चिन्नु ते मन्यमानस्य दस्मोदश्नुवन्ति महिमानमुग्र । न वीर्यमिन्द्र ते न राधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū cinnu te manyamānasya dasmodaśnuvanti mahimānamugra | na vīryamindra te na rādhaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, of goodly aspect, none attain the greatness of you who are to be honoured, nor, fierce Indra, yourheroism, nor your wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: ये च पूर्व ऋषयो ये च नूत्ना इन्द्र ब्रह्माणि जनयन्त विप्राः । अस्मे ते सन्तु सख्या शिवानि यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye ca pūrva ṛṣayo ye ca nūtnā indra brahmāṇi janayanta viprāḥ | asme te santu sakhyā śivāni yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: May your auspicious regards, Indra, be directed towards us, as they have been to those pious sages,ancient or recent, who have originated (your) praises, and do you ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: उदु ब्रह्माण्यैरत श्रवस्येन्द्रं समर्ये महया वसिष्ठ । आ यो विश्वानि शवसा ततानोपश्रोता म ईवतो वचांसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: udu brahmāṇyairata śravasyendraṃ samarye mahayā vasiṣṭha | ā yo viśvāni śavasā tatānopaśrotā ma īvato vacāṃsi ||

translations.english: (The sages) have offered prayers to (Indra) for food, worship Indra, Vasiṣṭha at the sacrifice; may thatIndra who has spread out all (the regions) by his might, be the hearer of my words when approaching him.

mantras.sanskrit: अयामि घोष इन्द्र देवजामिरिरज्यन्त यच्छुरुधो विवाचि । नहि स्वमायुश्चिकिते जनेषु तानीदंहांस्यति पर्ष्यस्मान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayāmi ghoṣa indra devajāmirirajyanta yacchurudho vivāci | nahi svamāyuścikite janeṣu tānīdaṃhāṃsyati parṣyasmān ||

translations.english: When, Indra, the plural nts grow up, the sound (of praise) acceptable to the gods, (uttered) by theworshipper, has been raised; by no one among men, is his own life understood; convey us beyond all those sins(by which life is shortened).

mantras.sanskrit: युजे रथं गवेषणं हरिभ्यामुप ब्रह्माणि जुजुषाणमस्थुः । वि बाधिष्ट स्य रोदसी महित्वेन्द्रो वृत्राण्यप्रती जघन्वान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuje rathaṃ gaveṣaṇaṃ haribhyāmupa brahmāṇi jujuṣāṇamasthuḥ | vi bādhiṣṭa sya rodasī mahitvendro vṛtrāṇyapratī jaghanvān ||

translations.english: I harness (by praises) the kine-bestowing chariot (of Indra) with his horses; (my) prayers have reachedhim who is plural ased (by devotion); he has surpassed in magnitude heaven and earth, slaying the unresistingenemies.

mantras.sanskrit: आपश्चित्पिप्युः स्तर्यो न गावो नक्षन्नृतं जरितारस्त इन्द्र । याहि वायुर्न नियुतो नो अच्छा त्वं हि धीभिर्दयसे वि वाजान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: āpaścitpipyuḥ staryo na gāvo nakṣannṛtaṃ jaritārasta indra | yāhi vāyurna niyuto no acchā tvaṃ hi dhībhirdayase vi vājān ||

translations.english: May the waters increase like young; may your worshippers, Indra, possess water (in abundance); comelike the wind with the Niyut steeds, for you, (propitiated) by holy rites, verily bestow upon us food.

mantras.sanskrit: ते त्वा मदा इन्द्र मादयन्तु शुष्मिणं तुविराधसं जरित्रे । एको देवत्रा दयसे हि मर्तानस्मिञ्छूर सवने मादयस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: te tvā madā indra mādayantu śuṣmiṇaṃ tuvirādhasaṃ jaritre | eko devatrā dayase hi martānasmiñchūra savane mādayasva ||

translations.english: May these inebriating draughts exhilarate you, Indra; bestow upon the praiser (a son vigorous andwealthy); for you alone among the gods are compassionate to mortals; be exhilarated here at this sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: एवेदिन्द्रं वृषणं वज्रबाहुं वसिष्ठासो अभ्यर्चन्त्यर्कैः । स नः स्तुतो वीरवद्धातु गोमद्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: evedindraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vajrabāhuṃ vasiṣṭhāso abhyarcantyarkaiḥ | sa naḥ stuto vīravaddhātu gomadyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: In this manner the Vasiṣṭhas glorify with hymns Indra, the showerer, the bearer of the thunderbolt; mayhe so glorified grant us wealth, comprising male posterity and cattle; and do you ever cherish us with blessingṣ

mantras.sanskrit: योनिष्ट इन्द्र सदने अकारि तमा नृभिः पुरुहूत प्र याहि । असो यथा नोऽविता वृधे च ददो वसूनि ममदश्च सोमैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yoniṣṭa indra sadane akāri tamā nṛbhiḥ puruhūta pra yāhi | aso yathā no'vitā vṛdhe ca dado vasūni mamadaśca somaiḥ ||

translations.english: A plural ce has been prepared for you in the sacrificial chamber; proceed to it, invoked of many, along withthe leaders (of rites the Maruts), inasmuch as you are our protector, (promote our) prosperity; grant us riches; beexhilarated by the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: गृभीतं ते मन इन्द्र द्विबर्हाः सुतः सोमः परिषिक्ता मधूनि । विसृष्टधेना भरते सुवृक्तिरियमिन्द्रं जोहुवती मनीषा ॥
mantras.transliteration: gṛbhītaṃ te mana indra dvibarhāḥ sutaḥ somaḥ pariṣiktā madhūni | visṛṣṭadhenā bharate suvṛktiriyamindraṃ johuvatī manīṣā ||

translations.english: Your purpose, Indra, is apprehended, you who are mighty in the two (worlds); the Soma is effused; thesweet juices are poured (into the vessels); this perfect praise uttered with loosened tongue propitiates Indra withrepeated invocations.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो दिव आ पृथिव्या ऋजीषिन्निदं बर्हिः सोमपेयाय याहि । वहन्तु त्वा हरयो मद्र्यञ्चमाङ्गूषमच्छा तवसं मदाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no diva ā pṛthivyā ṛjīṣinnidaṃ barhiḥ somapeyāya yāhi | vahantu tvā harayo madryañcamāṅgūṣamacchā tavasaṃ madāya ||

translations.english: Come, Rijishin, from the sky, or from the firmament, to this sacred gras, to drink the Soma; let yourhorses bear you who are vigorous to my presence to (receive my) praise and for (thine) exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो विश्वाभिरूतिभिः सजोषा ब्रह्म जुषाणो हर्यश्व याहि । वरीवृजत्स्थविरेभिः सुशिप्रास्मे दधद्वृषणं शुष्ममिन्द्र ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no viśvābhirūtibhiḥ sajoṣā brahma juṣāṇo haryaśva yāhi | varīvṛjatsthavirebhiḥ suśiprāsme dadhadvṛṣaṇaṃ śuṣmamindra ||

translations.english: Lord of bay steeds, propitiated by our praise, come to us with all your protections, sharing insatisfaction, handsome-chinned, with the ancient (Maruts), overthrowing repeatedly (your) foes, and granting usa strong and vigorous (son).

mantras.sanskrit: एष स्तोमो मह उग्राय वाहे धुरीवात्यो न वाजयन्नधायि । इन्द्र त्वायमर्क ईट्टे वसूनां दिवीव द्यामधि नः श्रोमतं धाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa stomo maha ugrāya vāhe dhurīvātyo na vājayannadhāyi | indra tvāyamarka īṭṭe vasūnāṃ divīva dyāmadhi naḥ śromataṃ dhāḥ ||

translations.english: This invogorating praise, like a horse attached, to car, has been addressed to you who are mighty andfierce, the up-bearer (of the world); this thine adorer desires of you, Indra, riches; do you grant us sustenancenotorious as the sky in heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा न इन्द्र वार्यस्य पूर्धि प्र ते महीं सुमतिं वेविदाम । इषं पिन्व मघवद्भ्यः सुवीरां यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā na indra vāryasya pūrdhi pra te mahīṃ sumatiṃ vevidāma | iṣaṃ pinva maghavadbhyaḥ suvīrāṃ yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: In this manner, Indra, satisfy us (with the gift) of desirable (wealth); may we repeatedly experience yougreat giver; bestow upon us who are opulent (in offerings) food with male descendants; do you ever cherish uswith blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: आ ते मह इन्द्रोत्युग्र समन्यवो यत्समरन्त सेनाः । पताति दिद्युन्नर्यस्य बाह्वोर्मा ते मनो विष्वद्र्यग्वि चारीत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā te maha indrotyugra samanyavo yatsamaranta senāḥ | patāti didyunnaryasya bāhvormā te mano viṣvadryagvi cārīt ||

translations.english: Fierce Indra, when animated by like fierce armies, encounter them; let the bright (weapon) wielded bythe arms of you who are mighty and the friend of man descend for our protection; let not your all-pervading mindwander (away from us).

mantras.sanskrit: नि दुर्ग इन्द्र श्नथिह्यमित्राँ अभि ये नो मर्तासो अमन्ति । आरे तं शंसं कृणुहि निनित्सोरा नो भर सम्भरणं वसूनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni durga indra śnathihyamitrā~ abhi ye no martāso amanti | āre taṃ śaṃsaṃ kṛṇuhi ninitsorā no bhara sambharaṇaṃ vasūnām ||

translations.english: Destroy, Indra, our adversaries in battle, those men who overpower us; remove far from us the calumnyof the reviler; bring to us abundance of treasures.

mantras.sanskrit: शतं ते शिप्रिन्नूतयः सुदासे सहस्रं शंसा उत रातिरस्तु । जहि वधर्वनुषो मर्त्यस्यास्मे द्युम्नमधि रत्नं च धेहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: śataṃ te śiprinnūtayaḥ sudāse sahasraṃ śaṃsā uta rātirastu | jahi vadharvanuṣo martyasyāsme dyumnamadhi ratnaṃ ca dhehi ||

translations.english: May hundreds of your protections, handsome-chinned, be (secured) to the liberal donor (of oblations);may thousands of blessing be bestowed (upon me) as well as wealth; cast the fatal weapon on the mischievousmortal; grant us food and wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वावतो हीन्द्र क्रत्वे अस्मि त्वावतोऽवितुः शूर रातौ । विश्वेदहानि तविषीव उग्रँ ओकः कृणुष्व हरिवो न मर्धीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāvato hīndra kratve asmi tvāvato'vituḥ śūra rātau | viśvedahāni taviṣīva ugra~ okaḥ kṛṇuṣva harivo na mardhīḥ ||

translations.english: I am (in dependence), Indra, upon the acts of such as you are, upon the liberality of a protector, hero,such as you; vigorous and fierce Indra, give us a dwelling for all our days; lord of bay steeds, do us no harm.

mantras.sanskrit: कुत्सा एते हर्यश्वाय शूषमिन्द्रे सहो देवजूतमियानाः । सत्रा कृधि सुहना शूर वृत्रा वयं तरुत्राः सनुयाम वाजम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kutsā ete haryaśvāya śūṣamindre saho devajūtamiyānāḥ | satrā kṛdhi suhanā śūra vṛtrā vayaṃ tarutrāḥ sanuyāma vājam ||

translations.english: These (Vasiṣṭhas) are offering grateful (adoration) to the lord of bay steeds, soliciting the strengthassigned by the gods to Indra; make our enemies, Indra, easy to be overcome, and may we, safe from peril,enjoy abundance.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा न इन्द्र वार्यस्य पूर्धि प्र ते महीं सुमतिं वेविदाम । इषं पिन्व मघवद्भ्यः सुवीरां यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā na indra vāryasya pūrdhi pra te mahīṃ sumatiṃ vevidāma | iṣaṃ pinva maghavadbhyaḥ suvīrāṃ yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: In this manner, Indra, satisfy us with the gift of desirable (wealth); may we repeatedly experience yourgreat favour; bestow upon us who are opulent in offerings food with male descendants; do you ever cherish uswith blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: न सोम इन्द्रमसुतो ममाद नाब्रह्माणो मघवानं सुतासः । तस्मा उक्थं जनये यज्जुजोषन्नृवन्नवीयः शृणवद्यथा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: na soma indramasuto mamāda nābrahmāṇo maghavānaṃ sutāsaḥ | tasmā ukthaṃ janaye yajjujoṣannṛvannavīyaḥ śṛṇavadyathā naḥ ||

translations.english: The Soma uneffused delights not Indra; the effused juices plural ase not Maghavan, unaccompanied byprayer; therefore, I offer to him praise that he may be plural ased with; that, like a prince, he may listen to a novel(strain).

mantras.sanskrit: उक्थौक्थे सोम इन्द्रं ममाद नीथेनीथे मघवानं सुतासः । यदीं सबाधः पितरं न पुत्राः समानदक्षा अवसे हवन्ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ukthaukthe soma indraṃ mamāda nīthenīthe maghavānaṃ sutāsaḥ | yadīṃ sabādhaḥ pitaraṃ na putrāḥ samānadakṣā avase havante ||

translations.english: The Soma effused with reiterated prayer delights Indra; the effused juices, (offered) with repeatedpraise, (exhilarate) Maghavan; therefore, (the priests), combining together and making like exertion, invoke Indrafor protection, as sons (apply) to a father.

mantras.sanskrit: चकार ता कृणवन्नूनमन्या यानि ब्रुवन्ति वेधसः सुतेषु । जनीरिव पतिरेकः समानो नि मामृजे पुर इन्द्रः सु सर्वाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: cakāra tā kṛṇavannūnamanyā yāni bruvanti vedhasaḥ suteṣu | janīriva patirekaḥ samāno ni māmṛje pura indraḥ su sarvāḥ ||

translations.english: Such exploits as his worshippers, when the Soma is effused, proclaim that he has achieved, let himnow perform; may Indra, equal (to the task) and unaided, possess all the riches (of the asuras) as a husband hiswives.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा तमाहुरुत शृण्व इन्द्र एको विभक्ता तरणिर्मघानाम् । मिथस्तुर ऊतयो यस्य पूर्वीरस्मे भद्राणि सश्चत प्रियाणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā tamāhuruta śṛṇva indra eko vibhaktā taraṇirmaghānām | mithastura ūtayo yasya pūrvīrasme bhadrāṇi saścata priyāṇi ||

translations.english: Such have they proclaimed him; Indra is still celebrated as the distributor of riches, the transporter(beyond calamity), of whom many and emulous are the protections; may acceptable benefits attend us.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा वसिष्ठ इन्द्रमूतये नॄन्कृष्टीनां वृषभं सुते गृणाति । सहस्रिण उप नो माहि वाजान्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā vasiṣṭha indramūtaye nṝnkṛṣṭīnāṃ vṛṣabhaṃ sute gṛṇāti | sahasriṇa upa no māhi vājānyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Thus does Vasiṣṭha glorify Indra, the showerer (of benefits) upon the worshippers for the preservationof mankind; bestow upon us, (Indra), thousands of viands; do you ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रं नरो नेमधिता हवन्ते यत्पार्या युनजते धियस्ताः । शूरो नृषाता शवसश्चकान आ गोमति व्रजे भजा त्वं नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraṃ naro nemadhitā havante yatpāryā yunajate dhiyastāḥ | śūro nṛṣātā śavasaścakāna ā gomati vraje bhajā tvaṃ naḥ ||

translations.english: Men invoke Indra in battle when those actions which lead to victory are performed; do you who arehero, the benefactor of man, the desirer of prowess, plural ce us in possession of pastures abounding with cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: य इन्द्र शुष्मो मघवन्ते अस्ति शिक्षा सखिभ्यः पुरुहूत नृभ्यः । त्वं हि दृळ्हा मघवन्विचेता अपा वृधि परिवृतं न राधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya indra śuṣmo maghavante asti śikṣā sakhibhyaḥ puruhūta nṛbhyaḥ | tvaṃ hi dṛḷhā maghavanvicetā apā vṛdhi parivṛtaṃ na rādhaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, who are the invoked of many, give to those men who are your friends that strength which,Maghavan, is thine; you, Maghavan (has forced open) the firm (shut, gates of cities); discover, discrimiantor (oftruth), the treasure now concealed.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रो राजा जगतश्चर्षणीनामधि क्षमि विषुरूपं यदस्ति । ततो ददाति दाशुषे वसूनि चोदद्राध उपस्तुतश्चिदर्वाक् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indro rājā jagataścarṣaṇīnāmadhi kṣami viṣurūpaṃ yadasti | tato dadāti dāśuṣe vasūni codadrādha upastutaścidarvāk ||

translations.english: Indra is lord of the earth and of men; (his is) the various wealth that exists upon the earth; thence hegives riches to the donor (of oblations); may he, glorified by us, bestow upon us wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: नू चिन्न इन्द्रो मघवा सहूती दानो वाजं नि यमते न ऊती । अनूना यस्य दक्षिणा पीपाय वामं नृभ्यो अभिवीता सखिभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū cinna indro maghavā sahūtī dāno vājaṃ ni yamate na ūtī | anūnā yasya dakṣiṇā pīpāya vāmaṃ nṛbhyo abhivītā sakhibhyaḥ ||

translations.english: May the affluent and liberal, Indra, upon being invoked together (with the Maruts), quickly bestow foodfor our reservation, he whose unlimited, experienced liberality yields desirable (wealth) to those men (who arehis) friends.

mantras.sanskrit: नू इन्द्र राये वरिवस्कृधी न आ ते मनो ववृत्याम मघाय । गोमदश्वावद्रथवद्व्यन्तो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū indra rāye varivaskṛdhī na ā te mano vavṛtyāma maghāya | gomadaśvāvadrathavadvyanto yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, grant quickly wealh for our enricment; may we attract your favour by our adoration; granting us(riches), comprising cattle and horses and chariots; do you ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा ण इन्द्रोप याहि विद्वानर्वाञ्चस्ते हरयः सन्तु युक्ताः । विश्वे चिद्धि त्वा विहवन्त मर्ता अस्माकमिच्छृणुहि विश्वमिन्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: brahmā ṇa indropa yāhi vidvānarvāñcaste harayaḥ santu yuktāḥ | viśve ciddhi tvā vihavanta martā asmākamicchṛṇuhi viśvaminva ||

translations.english: Indra, who are wise, come to our adoration; let your horses harnessed be before us; gratified of all(men), all mortals severally invoke you; hear, therefore, our (invocation).

mantras.sanskrit: हवं त इन्द्र महिमा व्यानड्ब्रह्म यत्पासि शवसिन्नृषीणाम् । आ यद्वज्रं दधिषे हस्त उग्र घोरः सन्क्रत्वा जनिष्ठा अषाळ्हः ॥
mantras.transliteration: havaṃ ta indra mahimā vyānaḍbrahma yatpāsi śavasinnṛṣīṇām | ā yadvajraṃ dadhiṣe hasta ugra ghoraḥ sankratvā janiṣṭhā aṣāḷhaḥ ||

translations.english: Endowed with strength, since you grant the prayers of the Ṛṣis, let your greatness, Indra, extend tothine invoker; and as, fierce deity, you hold the thunderbolt in your hand, then formidable by your exploits youhave become invincible.

mantras.sanskrit: तव प्रणीतीन्द्र जोहुवानान्त्सं यन्नॄन्न रोदसी निनेथ । महे क्षत्राय शवसे हि जज्ञेऽतूतुजिं चित्तूतुजिरशिश्नत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava praṇītīndra johuvānāntsaṃ yannṝnna rodasī ninetha | mahe kṣatrāya śavase hi jajñe'tūtujiṃ cittūtujiraśiśnat ||

translations.english: Since, Indra, by your guidance, you have conducted men, your zealous worshippers, over heaven andearth, you are born to (bestow) great wealth and strength, whence the presenter of offerings overcomes him whooffers them not.

mantras.sanskrit: एभिर्न इन्द्राहभिर्दशस्य दुर्मित्रासो हि क्षितयः पवन्ते । प्रति यच्चष्टे अनृतमनेना अव द्विता वरुणो मायी नः सात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ebhirna indrāhabhirdaśasya durmitrāso hi kṣitayaḥ pavante | prati yaccaṣṭe anṛtamanenā ava dvitā varuṇo māyī naḥ sāt ||

translations.english: Grant us, Indra, with these days, (wealth), for unfriendly men approach; may the untruth which the wiseand sinless Varuṇa observes in us, (through your favour, Indra), doubly disappear.

mantras.sanskrit: वोचेमेदिन्द्रं मघवानमेनं महो रायो राधसो यद्ददन्नः । यो अर्चतो ब्रह्मकृतिमविष्ठो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vocemedindraṃ maghavānamenaṃ maho rāyo rādhaso yaddadannaḥ | yo arcato brahmakṛtimaviṣṭho yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Let us glorify that opulent Indra, that he may give us great and valuable riches, he who is the chiefprotector of the pious rites of the worshipper; do you ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं सोम इन्द्र तुभ्यं सुन्व आ तु प्र याहि हरिवस्तदोकाः । पिबा त्वस्य सुषुतस्य चारोर्ददो मघानि मघवन्नियानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ soma indra tubhyaṃ sunva ā tu pra yāhi harivastadokāḥ | pibā tvasya suṣutasya cārordado maghāni maghavanniyānaḥ ||

translations.english: This Soma is poured out, Indra, for you; come, lord of bay steeds, to that dwelling (where it isprepared), drink of the plural ntifully-effused and grateful (libation), give us, Maghavan, when solicited for them,riches.

mantras.sanskrit: ब्रह्मन्वीर ब्रह्मकृतिं जुषाणोऽर्वाचीनो हरिभिर्याहि तूयम् । अस्मिन्नू षु सवने मादयस्वोप ब्रह्माणि शृणव इमा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: brahmanvīra brahmakṛtiṃ juṣāṇo'rvācīno haribhiryāhi tūyam | asminnū ṣu savane mādayasvopa brahmāṇi śṛṇava imā naḥ ||

translations.english: Magnified hero, Indra, approving of the sacred rite, come to us speedily with your steeds; be exhilaratedat this sacrifice; hear these our prayers.

mantras.sanskrit: का ते अस्त्यरंकृतिः सूक्तैः कदा नूनं ते मघवन्दाशेम । विश्वा मतीरा ततने त्वायाधा म इन्द्र शृणवो हवेमा ॥
mantras.transliteration: kā te astyaraṃkṛtiḥ sūktaiḥ kadā nūnaṃ te maghavandāśema | viśvā matīrā tatane tvāyādhā ma indra śṛṇavo havemā ||

translations.english: What satisfaction is there to you from our hymns? When, Maghavan, may we indeed present to you(oblations)? I expatiate in all praises addressed to you; hear, Indra, these my invocations.

mantras.sanskrit: उतो घा ते पुरुष्या इदासन्येषां पूर्वेषामशृणोॠषीणाम् । अधाहं त्वा मघवञ्जोहवीमि त्वं न इन्द्रासि प्रमतिः पितेव ॥
mantras.transliteration: uto ghā te puruṣyā idāsanyeṣāṃ pūrveṣāmaśṛṇoṝṣīṇām | adhāhaṃ tvā maghavañjohavīmi tvaṃ na indrāsi pramatiḥ piteva ||

translations.english: Friendly to man were those ancien Ṛṣis whose praise you have listened to; therefore, I repeatedlyinvoke you, Maghavan; you, Indra, are well affected towards us as a parent.

mantras.sanskrit: वोचेमेदिन्द्रं मघवानमेनं महो रायो राधसो यद्ददन्नः । यो अर्चतो ब्रह्मकृतिमविष्ठो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vocemedindraṃ maghavānamenaṃ maho rāyo rādhaso yaddadannaḥ | yo arcato brahmakṛtimaviṣṭho yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Let us glorify that opulent Indra, that he may give us vast and valuable riches, he who is the chiefprotector of the religious rites of the worshippers; do you ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो देव शवसा याहि शुष्मिन्भवा वृध इन्द्र रायो अस्य । महे नृम्णाय नृपते सुवज्र महि क्षत्राय पौंस्याय शूर ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no deva śavasā yāhi śuṣminbhavā vṛdha indra rāyo asya | mahe nṛmṇāya nṛpate suvajra mahi kṣatrāya pauṃsyāya śūra ||

translations.english: Divine and powerful (Indra), come to us with your strength; be the augmenter of our riches; be to us,king of men, wielder of the thunderbolt, for (a source of) vigour, of great prowess, hero, of manhood.

mantras.sanskrit: हवन्त उ त्वा हव्यं विवाचि तनूषु शूराः सूर्यस्य सातौ । त्वं विश्वेषु सेन्यो जनेषु त्वं वृत्राणि रन्धया सुहन्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: havanta u tvā havyaṃ vivāci tanūṣu śūrāḥ sūryasya sātau | tvaṃ viśveṣu senyo janeṣu tvaṃ vṛtrāṇi randhayā suhantu ||

translations.english: Warriors invoke you, worthy to be invoked, in the variously clamorous (strife), for (the safety of their)person ns, and for the (long) enjoyment of the sun; you are a fit leader over all men; humble our enemies by thefatal (bolt).

mantras.sanskrit: अहा यदिन्द्र सुदिना व्युच्छान्दधो यत्केतुमुपमं समत्सु । न्यग्निः सीददसुरो न होता हुवानो अत्र सुभगाय देवान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahā yadindra sudinā vyucchāndadho yatketumupamaṃ samatsu | nyagniḥ sīdadasuro na hotā huvāno atra subhagāya devān ||

translations.english: When, Indra, fortunate days arise, when you advance your emblem in battles, the strong Agni, theinvoker of the gods, summoning the gods hither for our benefit, sits down on the sacred grass.

mantras.sanskrit: वयं ते त इन्द्र ये च देव स्तवन्त शूर ददतो मघानि । यच्छा सूरिभ्य उपमं वरूथं स्वाभुवो जरणामश्नवन्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayaṃ te ta indra ye ca deva stavanta śūra dadato maghāni | yacchā sūribhya upamaṃ varūthaṃ svābhuvo jaraṇāmaśnavanta ||

translations.english: We, divine Indra, who are yours, are they, hero, who are praising you and offering rich libations; grantto (your) pious (worshippers) an excellent abode; and may they, prosperous, attain old age.

mantras.sanskrit: वोचेमेदिन्द्रं मघवानमेनं महो रायो राधसो यद्ददन्नः । यो अर्चतो ब्रह्मकृतिमविष्ठो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vocemedindraṃ maghavānamenaṃ maho rāyo rādhaso yaddadannaḥ | yo arcato brahmakṛtimaviṣṭho yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Let us glorify the opulent Indra, that he may give us vast and valuable riches; he who is the chiefprotector of the religious rites of the worshippers; do you ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र व इन्द्राय मादनं हर्यश्वाय गायत । सखायः सोमपाव्ने ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra va indrāya mādanaṃ haryaśvāya gāyata | sakhāyaḥ somapāvne ||

translations.english: Sing, friends, an exhilarating hymn to Indra, the lord of bay steeds, the drinker of the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: शंसेदुक्थं सुदानव उत द्युक्षं यथा नरः । चकृमा सत्यराधसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaṃsedukthaṃ sudānava uta dyukṣaṃ yathā naraḥ | cakṛmā satyarādhase ||

translations.english: Repeat to the liberal Indra such brilliant praise as other (men repeat); let us offer it to him who is affluentin truth.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं न इन्द्र वाजयुस्त्वं गव्युः शतक्रतो । त्वं हिरण्ययुर्वसो ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ na indra vājayustvaṃ gavyuḥ śatakrato | tvaṃ hiraṇyayurvaso ||

translations.english: Do you, Indra, be willing to give us food; be willing, Śatakratu, to give us cattle; be willing, donor ofdwelling, to us gold.

mantras.sanskrit: वयमिन्द्र त्वायवोऽभि प्र णोनुमो वृषन् । विद्धी त्वस्य नो वसो ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayamindra tvāyavo'bhi pra ṇonumo vṛṣan | viddhī tvasya no vaso ||

translations.english: Devoted to you, showerer (of benefits), we glorify you; be cognizant, giver of dwellings, of this ourpraise.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नो निदे च वक्तवेऽर्यो रन्धीरराव्णे । त्वे अपि क्रतुर्मम ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā no nide ca vaktave'ryo randhīrarāvṇe | tve api kraturmama ||

translations.english: Indra, who are lord, subject us not to the reviler, to the abuser, to the withholder of offerings; may myworship verily (find favour) with you.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं वर्मासि सप्रथः पुरोयोधश्च वृत्रहन् । त्वया प्रति ब्रुवे युजा ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ varmāsi saprathaḥ puroyodhaśca vṛtrahan | tvayā prati bruve yujā ||

translations.english: Slayer of enemies, you, Indra, are our armour, vast and our preceder in battle; with you for my ally I defy(the foe).

mantras.sanskrit: महाँ उतासि यस्य तेऽनु स्वधावरी सहः । मम्नाते इन्द्र रोदसी ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahā~ utāsi yasya te'nu svadhāvarī sahaḥ | mamnāte indra rodasī ||

translations.english: You verily are great; and heaven and earth abounding with food, respect, Indra, your strength.

mantras.sanskrit: तं त्वा मरुत्वती परि भुवद्वाणी सयावरी । नक्षमाणा सह द्युभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ tvā marutvatī pari bhuvadvāṇī sayāvarī | nakṣamāṇā saha dyubhiḥ ||

translations.english: May the praises of your adorers, accompanying you (wherever you go), such as you are, and spreadingaround with radiance, reach you.

mantras.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वासस्त्वान्विन्दवो भुवन्दस्ममुप द्यवि । सं ते नमन्त कृष्टयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūrdhvāsastvānvindavo bhuvandasmamupa dyavi | saṃ te namanta kṛṣṭayaḥ ||

translations.english: The ascending libations proceed, Indra, to you, abiding in heaven, of goodly aspect; men bow inreverence before you.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वो महे महिवृधे भरध्वं प्रचेतसे प्र सुमतिं कृणुध्वम् । विशः पूर्वीः प्र चरा चर्षणिप्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vo mahe mahivṛdhe bharadhvaṃ pracetase pra sumatiṃ kṛṇudhvam | viśaḥ pūrvīḥ pra carā carṣaṇiprāḥ ||

translations.english: Bring (libations) to the great (Indra), the giver of great (wealth); offer praise to the wise Indra; fulfiller (ofthe desires) of men, come to the people offering many (oblations).

mantras.sanskrit: उरुव्यचसे महिने सुवृक्तिमिन्द्राय ब्रह्म जनयन्त विप्राः । तस्य व्रतानि न मिनन्ति धीराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uruvyacase mahine suvṛktimindrāya brahma janayanta viprāḥ | tasya vratāni na minanti dhīrāḥ ||

translations.english: The sages engender sacred praise and (sacrificial) food for the wide- pervading, mighty Indra; theprudent impede not his functions.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रं वाणीरनुत्तमन्युमेव सत्रा राजानं दधिरे सहध्यै । हर्यश्वाय बर्हया समापीन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraṃ vāṇīranuttamanyumeva satrā rājānaṃ dadhire sahadhyai | haryaśvāya barhayā samāpīn ||

translations.english: Praises truly enable the universal monarch, Indra, whose wrath is irresistible, to overcome (his foes);urge your kinsmen, (worthippers, to glorify) the lord of bay steeds.

mantras.sanskrit: मो षु त्वा वाघतश्चनारे अस्मन्नि रीरमन् । आरात्ताच्चित्सधमादं न आ गहीह वा सन्नुप श्रुधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: mo ṣu tvā vāghataścanāre asmanni rīraman | ārāttāccitsadhamādaṃ na ā gahīha vā sannupa śrudhi ||

translations.english: Let not, Indra, (other) worshippers detain you far from us; come from whatever distance to ourassembly; present at this ceremony, hear our (prayers).

mantras.sanskrit: इमे हि ते ब्रह्मकृतः सुते सचा मधौ न मक्ष आसते । इन्द्रे कामं जरितारो वसूयवो रथे न पादमा दधुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ime hi te brahmakṛtaḥ sute sacā madhau na makṣa āsate | indre kāmaṃ jaritāro vasūyavo rathe na pādamā dadhuḥ ||

translations.english: When the libation is effused for you, these offerers of sacrifice swarm like flies around honey; the piouspraisers, desiring riches, fix their hope upon Indra, like a foot upon a chariot.

mantras.sanskrit: रायस्कामो वज्रहस्तं सुदक्षिणं पुत्रो न पितरं हुवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: rāyaskāmo vajrahastaṃ sudakṣiṇaṃ putro na pitaraṃ huve ||

translations.english: Desirous of riches, I call upon the benevolent wielder of the thunderbolt, as a son upon a father.

mantras.sanskrit: इम इन्द्राय सुन्विरे सोमासो दध्याशिरः । ताँ आ मदाय वज्रहस्त पीतये हरिभ्यां याह्योक आ ॥
mantras.transliteration: ima indrāya sunvire somāso dadhyāśiraḥ | tā~ ā madāya vajrahasta pītaye haribhyāṃ yāhyoka ā ||

translations.english: These Soma, mixed with curds, are poured out to Indra; come, wielder of the thunderbolt, with yourhorses of our dwelling, to drink there for (your) exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रवच्छ्रुत्कर्ण ईयते वसूनां नू चिन्नो मर्धिषद्गिरः । सद्यश्चिद्यः सहस्राणि शता ददन्नकिर्दित्सन्तमा मिनत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śravacchrutkarṇa īyate vasūnāṃ nū cinno mardhiṣadgiraḥ | sadyaścidyaḥ sahasrāṇi śatā dadannakirditsantamā minat ||

translations.english: May Indra, whose ear is ready to hear, listen to the suppliant for riches, and never disappoint ourprayers; he who is the giver of hundreds and thousands; may no one ever hinder him when willing to give.

mantras.sanskrit: स वीरो अप्रतिष्कुत इन्द्रेण शूशुवे नृभिः । यस्ते गभीरा सवनानि वृत्रहन्त्सुनोत्या च धावति ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa vīro apratiṣkuta indreṇa śūśuve nṛbhiḥ | yaste gabhīrā savanāni vṛtrahantsunotyā ca dhāvati ||

translations.english: Slayer of Vṛtra, the hero who offers sacrifices to you, who eagerly approaches you (with praises), he,(protected) by Indra, is unresisted (by anyone), and is honoured by men.

mantras.sanskrit: भवा वरूथं मघवन्मघोनां यत्समजासि शर्धतः । वि त्वाहतस्य वेदनं भजेमह्या दूणाशो भरा गयम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhavā varūthaṃ maghavanmaghonāṃ yatsamajāsi śardhataḥ | vi tvāhatasya vedanaṃ bhajemahyā dūṇāśo bharā gayam ||

translations.english: Be a defence, Maghavan, to the wealthy (offerers in oblations), for you are the discomfiter of (our)adversaries; may we divide the spoil of the enemy slain by you, who are indestructible, bring it to our dwelling.

mantras.sanskrit: सुनोता सोमपाव्ने सोममिन्द्राय वज्रिणे । पचता पक्तीरवसे कृणुध्वमित्पृणन्नित्पृणते मयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sunotā somapāvne somamindrāya vajriṇe | pacatā paktīravase kṛṇudhvamitpṛṇannitpṛṇate mayaḥ ||

translations.english: Pour out the libation to Indra, the thunderer, the drinker of the Soma; prepare the baked (cakes) tosatisfy him; do (what is agreeable to him), for he bestows happiness on (the worshipper) who plural ases them.

mantras.sanskrit: मा स्रेधत सोमिनो दक्षता महे कृणुध्वं राय आतुजे । तरणिरिज्जयति क्षेति पुष्यति न देवासः कवत्नवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā sredhata somino dakṣatā mahe kṛṇudhvaṃ rāya ātuje | taraṇirijjayati kṣeti puṣyati na devāsaḥ kavatnave ||

translations.english: Offerers of the libation, do not hesitate; be active; sacrifice to the mighty benefactor for the sake ofriches; the assiduous worshipper conquers (his enemies), dwells in a habitation, and prospers; the gods favournot the imperfect rite.

mantras.sanskrit: नकिः सुदासो रथं पर्यास न रीरमत् । इन्द्रो यस्याविता यस्य मरुतो गमत्स गोमति व्रजे ॥
mantras.transliteration: nakiḥ sudāso rathaṃ paryāsa na rīramat | indro yasyāvitā yasya maruto gamatsa gomati vraje ||

translations.english: No one overturns, no one arrests the chariot of the liberal sacrificer; he, of whom Indra is the protector,of whom the Maruts (are the defenders), will walk in pastures filled with cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: गमद्वाजं वाजयन्निन्द्र मर्त्यो यस्य त्वमविता भुवः । अस्माकं बोध्यविता रथानामस्माकं शूर नृणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: gamadvājaṃ vājayannindra martyo yasya tvamavitā bhuvaḥ | asmākaṃ bodhyavitā rathānāmasmākaṃ śūra nṛṇām ||

translations.english: Let the man of whom you, Indra, are the protector, invigorating (you with praise), enjoy (abundant) food;be the preserver, hero, of our chariots, (the preserver) of our people.

mantras.sanskrit: उदिन्न्वस्य रिच्यतेंऽशो धनं न जिग्युषः । य इन्द्रो हरिवान्न दभन्ति तं रिपो दक्षं दधाति सोमिनि ॥
mantras.transliteration: udinnvasya ricyateṃ'śo dhanaṃ na jigyuṣaḥ | ya indro harivānna dabhanti taṃ ripo dakṣaṃ dadhāti somini ||

translations.english: Verily (Indra's) share (of the Soma) exceeds (that of other deities) like the wealth of the victorious;enemies overcome not him, who is the lord of bay steeds, who gives strength to the offerer of the libation.

mantras.sanskrit: मन्त्रमखर्वं सुधितं सुपेशसं दधात यज्ञियेष्वा । पूर्वीश्चन प्रसितयस्तरन्ति तं य इन्द्रे कर्मणा भुवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mantramakharvaṃ sudhitaṃ supeśasaṃ dadhāta yajñiyeṣvā | pūrvīścana prasitayastaranti taṃ ya indre karmaṇā bhuvat ||

translations.english: Address (to Indra), among the gods, the ample, well-uttered, and graceful prayer; many bonds entanglenot him who, by his devotion, abides in Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: कस्तमिन्द्र त्वावसुमा मर्त्यो दधर्षति । श्रद्धा इत्ते मघवन्पार्ये दिवि वाजी वाजं सिषासति ॥
mantras.transliteration: kastamindra tvāvasumā martyo dadharṣati | śraddhā itte maghavanpārye divi vājī vājaṃ siṣāsati ||

translations.english: What mortal, Indra, injures him who has you for his support? He who offers you (sacrificial) food,Maghavan, with faith, he obtains food on the day of the libation.

mantras.sanskrit: मघोनः स्म वृत्रहत्येषु चोदय ये ददति प्रिया वसु । तव प्रणीती हर्यश्व सूरिभिर्विश्वा तरेम दुरिता ॥
mantras.transliteration: maghonaḥ sma vṛtrahatyeṣu codaya ye dadati priyā vasu | tava praṇītī haryaśva sūribhirviśvā tarema duritā ||

translations.english: Animate (those men) for the destruction of their foes, who offer treasures which are dear to you, theabounder in wealth; may we, lord of bay steeds, along with (your) worshippers, pass over all difficulties by yourguidance.

mantras.sanskrit: तवेदिन्द्रावमं वसु त्वं पुष्यसि मध्यमम् । सत्रा विश्वस्य परमस्य राजसि नकिष्ट्वा गोषु वृण्वते ॥
mantras.transliteration: tavedindrāvamaṃ vasu tvaṃ puṣyasi madhyamam | satrā viśvasya paramasya rājasi nakiṣṭvā goṣu vṛṇvate ||

translations.english: Yours, Indra, is the vast valuable wealth; you cherish the middling; you rule over all that which is themost precious; no one opposes you in (the recovering of the) cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं विश्वस्य धनदा असि श्रुतो य ईं भवन्त्याजयः । तवायं विश्वः पुरुहूत पार्थिवोऽवस्युर्नाम भिक्षते ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ viśvasya dhanadā asi śruto ya īṃ bhavantyājayaḥ | tavāyaṃ viśvaḥ puruhūta pārthivo'vasyurnāma bhikṣate ||

translations.english: You are celebrated as the giver of wealth to all even where battles occur; all the people of theearth--desirous of protection, solicit you, the invoked of many.

mantras.sanskrit: यदिन्द्र यावतस्त्वमेतावदहमीशीय । स्तोतारमिद्दिधिषेय रदावसो न पापत्वाय रासीय ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadindra yāvatastvametāvadahamīśīya | stotāramiddidhiṣeya radāvaso na pāpatvāya rāsīya ||

translations.english: If I were lord of as much (affluence) as you are, Indra, then might I support (your) worshippers,dispenser of wealth, and not squander it upon wickedness.

mantras.sanskrit: शिक्षेयमिन्महयते दिवेदिवे राय आ कुहचिद्विदे । नहि त्वदन्यन्मघवन्न आप्यं वस्यो अस्ति पिता चन ॥
mantras.transliteration: śikṣeyaminmahayate divedive rāya ā kuhacidvide | nahi tvadanyanmaghavanna āpyaṃ vasyo asti pitā cana ||

translations.english: May I daily distribute wealth to the venerable wherever abiding; no other, Maghavan, than you is to besought by us; (no other is to us) a most excellent protector.

mantras.sanskrit: तरणिरित्सिषासति वाजं पुरंध्या युजा । आ व इन्द्रं पुरुहूतं नमे गिरा नेमिं तष्टेव सुद्र्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taraṇiritsiṣāsati vājaṃ puraṃdhyā yujā | ā va indraṃ puruhūtaṃ name girā nemiṃ taṣṭeva sudrvam ||

translations.english: The prompt offers (of praise), with solemn rites combined, acquires food; I bend down with adoration toyou, Indra, the invoker of many, as a carpenter bends the wooden circumference of the wheel.

mantras.sanskrit: न दुःष्टुती मर्त्यो विन्दते वसु न स्रेधन्तं रयिर्नशत् । सुशक्तिरिन्मघवन्तुभ्यं मावते देष्णं यत्पार्ये दिवि ॥
mantras.transliteration: na duḥṣṭutī martyo vindate vasu na sredhantaṃ rayirnaśat | suśaktirinmaghavantubhyaṃ māvate deṣṇaṃ yatpārye divi ||

translations.english: A man acquires not wealth by unbecoming praise; affluence devolves not upon one obstructing(sacrifice) in you, Maghavan, is the power whereby bounty (may be shown) to such as I am on the day of libation.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि त्वा शूर नोनुमोऽदुग्धा इव धेनवः । ईशानमस्य जगतः स्वर्दृशमीशानमिन्द्र तस्थुषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi tvā śūra nonumo'dugdhā iva dhenavaḥ | īśānamasya jagataḥ svardṛśamīśānamindra tasthuṣaḥ ||

translations.english: We glorify you, hero, (Indra), the lord of all movable and stationary things, the beholder of the universe,with ladles filled (with Soma, like (the udders of) unmilked kine.

mantras.sanskrit: न त्वावाँ अन्यो दिव्यो न पार्थिवो न जातो न जनिष्यते । अश्वायन्तो मघवन्निन्द्र वाजिनो गव्यन्तस्त्वा हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: na tvāvā~ anyo divyo na pārthivo na jāto na janiṣyate | aśvāyanto maghavannindra vājino gavyantastvā havāmahe ||

translations.english: No other such as you are, celestial or terrestrial, has been or will be born; desirous of horses, of food,of cattle affluent Indra, we invoke you.

mantras.sanskrit: अभी षतस्तदा भरेन्द्र ज्यायः कनीयसः । पुरूवसुर्हि मघवन्त्सनादसि भरेभरे च हव्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhī ṣatastadā bharendra jyāyaḥ kanīyasaḥ | purūvasurhi maghavantsanādasi bharebhare ca havyaḥ ||

translations.english: Elder Indra, bring that (wealth to me), being the junior, for, Maghavan, you have from the beginningbeen possessed of infinite treasure, and are to be adored at repeated sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: परा णुदस्व मघवन्नमित्रान्त्सुवेदा नो वसू कृधि । अस्माकं बोध्यविता महाधने भवा वृधः सखीनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: parā ṇudasva maghavannamitrāntsuvedā no vasū kṛdhi | asmākaṃ bodhyavitā mahādhane bhavā vṛdhaḥ sakhīnām ||

translations.english: Drive away, Maghavan, our enemies; render riches easy of acquisition; be our preserver in war; be theaugmenter of (the prosperity) of (your) friends.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र क्रतुं न आ भर पिता पुत्रेभ्यो यथा । शिक्षा णो अस्मिन्पुरुहूत यामनि जीवा ज्योतिरशीमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra kratuṃ na ā bhara pitā putrebhyo yathā | śikṣā ṇo asminpuruhūta yāmani jīvā jyotiraśīmahi ||

translations.english: Bring to us, Indra, wisdom, as a father (gives knowledge) to his sons; bestow wealth upon us on thisoccasion, you the invoked of many, so that we, living at the solemnity may (long) enjoy the light (of existence).

mantras.sanskrit: मा नो अज्ञाता वृजना दुराध्यो माशिवासो अव क्रमुः । त्वया वयं प्रवतः शश्वतीरपोऽति शूर तरामसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā no ajñātā vṛjanā durādhyo māśivāso ava kramuḥ | tvayā vayaṃ pravataḥ śaśvatīrapo'ti śūra tarāmasi ||

translations.english: Let no unknown, wicked, malevolent, malignant (enemies) overpower us; may we, protected by you,cross over many waters.

mantras.sanskrit: श्वित्यञ्चो मा दक्षिणतस्कपर्दा धियंजिन्वासो अभि हि प्रमन्दुः । उत्तिष्ठन्वोचे परि बर्हिषो नॄन्न मे दूरादवितवे वसिष्ठाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śvityañco mā dakṣiṇataskapardā dhiyaṃjinvāso abhi hi pramanduḥ | uttiṣṭhanvoce pari barhiṣo nṝnna me dūrādavitave vasiṣṭhāḥ ||

translations.english: The white-complexioned accomplishers of holy ceremonies, wearing the lock of hair on the right side,have afforded me delight, when, rising up I call the leaders (of rites) to the sacred grass; the Vasiṣṭhas, (mysons) should never be far from me.

mantras.sanskrit: दूरादिन्द्रमनयन्ना सुतेन तिरो वैशन्तमति पान्तमुग्रम् । पाशद्युम्नस्य वायतस्य सोमात्सुतादिन्द्रोऽवृणीता वसिष्ठान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dūrādindramanayannā sutena tiro vaiśantamati pāntamugram | pāśadyumnasya vāyatasya somātsutādindro'vṛṇītā vasiṣṭhān ||

translations.english: Disgracing (Pāśadyumna), they brought from afar the fierce Indra, when drinking the ladle of Soma athis sacrifice, to (receive) the libation (of Sudāsa); Indra hastened from the effused Soma of Pāśadumna, theson of Vāyata, to the Vasiṣṭhas.

mantras.sanskrit: एवेन्नु कं सिन्धुमेभिस्ततारेवेन्नु कं भेदमेभिर्जघान । एवेन्नु कं दाशराज्ञे सुदासं प्रावदिन्द्रो ब्रह्मणा वो वसिष्ठाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: evennu kaṃ sindhumebhistatārevennu kaṃ bhedamebhirjaghāna | evennu kaṃ dāśarājñe sudāsaṃ prāvadindro brahmaṇā vo vasiṣṭhāḥ ||

translations.english: In the same manner was he, (Sudāsa) enabled by them easily to cross the Sindhu river; in the samemanner, through them he easily slew his foe; so in like manner, Vasiṣṭhas, through your prayers, did Indradefend Sudāsa in the war with the ten kings.

mantras.sanskrit: जुष्टी नरो ब्रह्मणा वः पितॄणामक्षमव्ययं न किला रिषाथ । यच्छक्वरीषु बृहता रवेणेन्द्रे शुष्ममदधाता वसिष्ठाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: juṣṭī naro brahmaṇā vaḥ pitṝṇāmakṣamavyayaṃ na kilā riṣātha | yacchakvarīṣu bṛhatā raveṇendre śuṣmamadadhātā vasiṣṭhāḥ ||

translations.english: By your prayers, leaders (of rites), is effected the gratificcation of your progenitors; I have set in motionthe axle (of the chariot); be no you intert, for by your sacred metres, Vasiṣṭhas, (chanted) with a loud voice, yousustain vigour in Inda.

mantras.sanskrit: उद्द्यामिवेत्तृष्णजो नाथितासोऽदीधयुर्दाशराज्ञे वृतासः । वसिष्ठस्य स्तुवत इन्द्रो अश्रोदुरुं तृत्सुभ्यो अकृणोदु लोकम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uddyāmivettṛṣṇajo nāthitāso'dīdhayurdāśarājñe vṛtāsaḥ | vasiṣṭhasya stuvata indro aśroduruṃ tṛtsubhyo akṛṇodu lokam ||

translations.english: Suffering from thirst, soliciting (rain), supported (by the Tṛtsus) in the war with the ten rājās, (theVasiṣṭhas) made Indra radiant as the sun; Indra heard (the praises) of Vasiṣṭha glorifying him, and bestowed aspacious region on the Tṛtsus.

mantras.sanskrit: दण्डा इवेद्गोअजनास आसन्परिच्छिन्ना भरता अर्भकासः । अभवच्च पुरएता वसिष्ठ आदित्तृत्सूनां विशो अप्रथन्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: daṇḍā ivedgoajanāsa āsanparicchinnā bharatā arbhakāsaḥ | abhavacca puraetā vasiṣṭha ādittṛtsūnāṃ viśo aprathanta ||

translations.english: The Bharatas, inferior (to their foes), were shorn (of their possessions), like he staves for driving cattle,(stripped of their leaves and branches); but Vasiṣṭha became their family priest, and the people of the Tṛtsusprospered.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रयः कृण्वन्ति भुवनेषु रेतस्तिस्रः प्रजा आर्या ज्योतिरग्राः । त्रयो घर्मास उषसं सचन्ते सर्वाँ इत्ताँ अनु विदुर्वसिष्ठाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: trayaḥ kṛṇvanti bhuvaneṣu retastisraḥ prajā āryā jyotiragrāḥ | trayo gharmāsa uṣasaṃ sacante sarvā~ ittā~ anu vidurvasiṣṭhāḥ ||

translations.english: Three shed moisture upon the regions, three are their glorious progeny, of which the chief is night;three communicators of warmth accompany the dawn; verily the Vasiṣṭhas understand all these.

mantras.sanskrit: सूर्यस्येव वक्षथो ज्योतिरेषां समुद्रस्येव महिमा गभीरः । वातस्येव प्रजवो नान्येन स्तोमो वसिष्ठा अन्वेतवे वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sūryasyeva vakṣatho jyotireṣāṃ samudrasyeva mahimā gabhīraḥ | vātasyeva prajavo nānyena stomo vasiṣṭhā anvetave vaḥ ||

translations.english: The glory of these Vasi.ṣṭhas is like the splendour of the sun; their greatness as profound as (thedepth of) the ocean; your praise, Vasiṣṭhas, has the velocity of the wind; by no other can it be surpassed.

mantras.sanskrit: त इन्निण्यं हृदयस्य प्रकेतैः सहस्रवल्शमभि सं चरन्ति । यमेन ततं परिधिं वयन्तोऽप्सरस उप सेदुर्वसिष्ठाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ta inniṇyaṃ hṛdayasya praketaiḥ sahasravalśamabhi saṃ caranti | yamena tataṃ paridhiṃ vayanto'psarasa upa sedurvasiṣṭhāḥ ||

translations.english: By the wisdom seated in the heart the Vasiṣṭhas traverse the hidden thousand branched world, andthe Apsarasas sit down wearing the vesture spread out by Yama.

mantras.sanskrit: विद्युतो ज्योतिः परि संजिहानं मित्रावरुणा यदपश्यतां त्वा । तत्ते जन्मोतैकं वसिष्ठागस्त्यो यत्त्वा विश आजभार ॥
mantras.transliteration: vidyuto jyotiḥ pari saṃjihānaṃ mitrāvaruṇā yadapaśyatāṃ tvā | tatte janmotaikaṃ vasiṣṭhāgastyo yattvā viśa ājabhāra ||

translations.english: When Mitra and Varuṇa beheld you, Vasiṣṭha, quitting the lustre of the lightning (for a different form),then one of your births (took plural ce), inasmuch as Agastya bore you from your (former) abode.

mantras.sanskrit: उतासि मैत्रावरुणो वसिष्ठोर्वश्या ब्रह्मन्मनसोऽधि जातः । द्रप्सं स्कन्नं ब्रह्मणा दैव्येन विश्वे देवाः पुष्करे त्वाददन्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: utāsi maitrāvaruṇo vasiṣṭhorvaśyā brahmanmanaso'dhi jātaḥ | drapsaṃ skannaṃ brahmaṇā daivyena viśve devāḥ puṣkare tvādadanta ||

translations.english: Verily, Vasiṣṭha you are the son of Mitra and Varuṇa, born, Brahmā, of the will of Urvaśī, after theseminal effusion; all the gods have sustained you, (endowed) with celestial and Vedic vigour in the lake.

mantras.sanskrit: स प्रकेत उभयस्य प्रविद्वान्त्सहस्रदान उत वा सदानः । यमेन ततं परिधिं वयिष्यन्नप्सरसः परि जज्ञे वसिष्ठः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa praketa ubhayasya pravidvāntsahasradāna uta vā sadānaḥ | yamena tataṃ paridhiṃ vayiṣyannapsarasaḥ pari jajñe vasiṣṭhaḥ ||

translations.english: He, the sage, cognizant of both worlds, was the donor of thousands; he was verily donation; wearingthe vesture spread spread by Yama, Vasiṣṭha was born of the Apsaras.

mantras.sanskrit: सत्रे ह जाताविषिता नमोभिः कुम्भे रेतः सिषिचतुः समानम् । ततो ह मान उदियाय मध्यात्ततो जातमृषिमाहुर्वसिष्ठम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: satre ha jātāviṣitā namobhiḥ kumbhe retaḥ siṣicatuḥ samānam | tato ha māna udiyāya madhyāttato jātamṛṣimāhurvasiṣṭham ||

translations.english: Consecrated for the sacrifice, propitiated by praises, they, Mitra and Varuṇa, poured a commoneffusion into the water-jar, from the midst of which Māna arose, and from which also, they say, Vasiṣṭha wasborn.

mantras.sanskrit: उक्थभृतं सामभृतं बिभर्ति ग्रावाणं बिभ्रत्प्र वदात्यग्रे । उपैनमाध्वं सुमनस्यमाना आ वो गच्छाति प्रतृदो वसिष्ठः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ukthabhṛtaṃ sāmabhṛtaṃ bibharti grāvāṇaṃ bibhratpra vadātyagre | upainamādhvaṃ sumanasyamānā ā vo gacchāti pratṛdo vasiṣṭhaḥ ||

translations.english: Pratṛts, Agastya comes to you; welcome him with devoted minds, and he in the foremost station directsthe reciter of the prayer, the chanter of the hymn, the grinder of the stone, and repeats (what is to be repeated).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र शुक्रैतु देवी मनीषा अस्मत्सुतष्टो रथो न वाजी ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra śukraitu devī manīṣā asmatsutaṣṭo ratho na vājī ||

translations.english: May pure and divine praise proceed from us (to the gods) like a swift well-constructed chariot.

mantras.sanskrit: विदुः पृथिव्या दिवो जनित्रं शृण्वन्त्यापो अध क्षरन्तीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viduḥ pṛthivyā divo janitraṃ śṛṇvantyāpo adha kṣarantīḥ ||

translations.english: The flowing waters having known the origin of earth and heaven; may they now hear (our praises).

mantras.sanskrit: आपश्चिदस्मै पिन्वन्त पृथ्वीर्वृत्रेषु शूरा मंसन्त उग्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: āpaścidasmai pinvanta pṛthvīrvṛtreṣu śūrā maṃsanta ugrāḥ ||

translations.english: The vast waters offer nourishment to Indra; fierce warriors (combating) with foes, glorify him.

mantras.sanskrit: आ धूर्ष्वस्मै दधाताश्वानिन्द्रो न वज्री हिरण्यबाहुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā dhūrṣvasmai dadhātāśvānindro na vajrī hiraṇyabāhuḥ ||

translations.english: Yoke for him the horses of his chariot, the Indra is the wielder of the thunderbolt, the golden-armed.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि प्र स्थाताहेव यज्ञं यातेव पत्मन्त्मना हिनोत ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi pra sthātāheva yajñaṃ yāteva patmantmanā hinota ||

translations.english: Proceed to the sacrifice like one who goes along the road; proceed of your own accord.

mantras.sanskrit: त्मना समत्सु हिनोत यज्ञं दधात केतुं जनाय वीरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tmanā samatsu hinota yajñaṃ dadhāta ketuṃ janāya vīram ||

translations.english: Go of your own accord to battle; celebrate the significant and expiatory sacrifice for (the good of)mankind.

mantras.sanskrit: उदस्य शुष्माद्भानुर्नार्त बिभर्ति भारं पृथिवी न भूम ॥
mantras.transliteration: udasya śuṣmādbhānurnārta bibharti bhāraṃ pṛthivī na bhūma ||

translations.english: From the force of this (sacrifice) the sun rises; it sustains the burden (of the world) as (earth) supportsmany (beings).

mantras.sanskrit: ह्वयामि देवाँ अयातुरग्ने साधन्नृतेन धियं दधामि ॥
mantras.transliteration: hvayāmi devā~ ayāturagne sādhannṛtena dhiyaṃ dadhāmi ||

translations.english: I invoke the gods, Agni, propitiating them by an inoffensive rite, I celebrate a pious act.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि वो देवीं धियं दधिध्वं प्र वो देवत्रा वाचं कृणुध्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi vo devīṃ dhiyaṃ dadhidhvaṃ pra vo devatrā vācaṃ kṛṇudhvam ||

translations.english: Offer (worshippers) your heavenly worship; earnestly address your praises to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: आ चष्ट आसां पाथो नदीनां वरुण उग्रः सहस्रचक्षाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā caṣṭa āsāṃ pātho nadīnāṃ varuṇa ugraḥ sahasracakṣāḥ ||

translations.english: The fierce Varuṇa, the thousand-eyed, contemplates the water of these rivers.

mantras.sanskrit: राजा राष्ट्रानां पेशो नदीनामनुत्तमस्मै क्षत्रं विश्वायु ॥
mantras.transliteration: rājā rāṣṭrānāṃ peśo nadīnāmanuttamasmai kṣatraṃ viśvāyu ||

translations.english: He is the king of kings; the beauty of the rivers his all-pervading strength is irresistible.

mantras.sanskrit: अविष्टो अस्मान्विश्वासु विक्ष्वद्युं कृणोत शंसं निनित्सोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aviṣṭo asmānviśvāsu vikṣvadyuṃ kṛṇota śaṃsaṃ ninitsoḥ ||

translations.english: Protect us, gods, among all people; render extinct the calumny of the malevolent.

mantras.sanskrit: व्येतु दिद्युद्द्विषामशेवा युयोत विष्वग्रपस्तनूनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vyetu didyuddviṣāmaśevā yuyota viṣvagrapastanūnām ||

translations.english: May the blazing (weapons) of foes pass by innocuous; separate, (gods), universally (from us) the sin ofour bodies.

mantras.sanskrit: अवीन्नो अग्निर्हव्यान्नमोभिः प्रेष्ठो अस्मा अधायि स्तोमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: avīnno agnirhavyānnamobhiḥ preṣṭho asmā adhāyi stomaḥ ||

translations.english: May Agni, the feeder on oblations, propitiated by our homage, protect us; to him has our praise beenaddressed.

mantras.sanskrit: सजूर्देवेभिरपां नपातं सखायं कृध्वं शिवो नो अस्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: sajūrdevebhirapāṃ napātaṃ sakhāyaṃ kṛdhvaṃ śivo no astu ||

translations.english: Glorify along with the gods our friend, the grandson of the waters; may he be propitious to us.

mantras.sanskrit: अब्जामुक्थैरहिं गृणीषे बुध्ने नदीनां रजस्सु षीदन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abjāmukthairahiṃ gṛṇīṣe budhne nadīnāṃ rajassu ṣīdan ||

translations.english: I glorify with hymns the disperser of the clouds in the firmament; the water-born, sitting among thewaters of the rivers.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नोऽहिर्बुध्न्यो रिषे धान्मा यज्ञो अस्य स्रिधदृतायोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā no'hirbudhnyo riṣe dhānmā yajño asya sridhadṛtāyoḥ ||

translations.english: Let not Ahirbudhnya be disposed to work us harm; let not the sacrifice of the worshipper bedisregarded.

mantras.sanskrit: उत न एषु नृषु श्रवो धुः प्र राये यन्तु शर्धन्तो अर्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta na eṣu nṛṣu śravo dhuḥ pra rāye yantu śardhanto aryaḥ ||

translations.english: May (the gods) bestow food upon our people; let foes contending for our riches perish.

mantras.sanskrit: तपन्ति शत्रुं स्वर्ण भूमा महासेनासो अमेभिरेषाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tapanti śatruṃ svarṇa bhūmā mahāsenāso amebhireṣām ||

translations.english: Leaders of great armies, by the power of these (divinities), consume their foes, as he sun (scorches)the regions.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यन्नः पत्नीर्गमन्त्यच्छा त्वष्टा सुपाणिर्दधातु वीरान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yannaḥ patnīrgamantyacchā tvaṣṭā supāṇirdadhātu vīrān ||

translations.english: When the wives (of the gods) come before us, may the dextrous Tvaṣṭā grant us male progeny.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रति नः स्तोमं त्वष्टा जुषेत स्यादस्मे अरमतिर्वसूयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prati naḥ stomaṃ tvaṣṭā juṣeta syādasme aramatirvasūyuḥ ||

translations.english: May Tvaṣṭā be propitiated by this our praise; may he who is of comprehensive understanding beinclined to give us wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: ता नो रासन्रातिषाचो वसून्या रोदसी वरुणानी शृणोतु । वरूत्रीभिः सुशरणो नो अस्तु त्वष्टा सुदत्रो वि दधातु रायः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā no rāsanrātiṣāco vasūnyā rodasī varuṇānī śṛṇotu | varūtrībhiḥ suśaraṇo no astu tvaṣṭā sudatro vi dadhātu rāyaḥ ||

translations.english: May they who are the givers of gifts bestow upon us the treasure (we desire); may Rodasī andVaruṇānī hear (our supplications); may the genitive rous Tvaṣṭā together with these (our) protectresses, be oursure refuge; may they give us riches.

mantras.sanskrit: तन्नो रायः पर्वतास्तन्न आपस्तद्रातिषाच ओषधीरुत द्यौः । वनस्पतिभिः पृथिवी सजोषा उभे रोदसी परि पासतो नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tanno rāyaḥ parvatāstanna āpastadrātiṣāca oṣadhīruta dyauḥ | vanaspatibhiḥ pṛthivī sajoṣā ubhe rodasī pari pāsato naḥ ||

translations.english: May the mountains, the waters, the liberal (wives of the gods), the plural nts, also the heaven and theearth, consentient with the forest lords and both the heaven and earth, preserve for us those (coveted) riches.

mantras.sanskrit: अनु तदुर्वी रोदसी जिहातामनु द्युक्षो वरुण इन्द्रसखा । अनु विश्वे मरुतो ये सहासो रायः स्याम धरुणं धियध्यै ॥
mantras.transliteration: anu tadurvī rodasī jihātāmanu dyukṣo varuṇa indrasakhā | anu viśve maruto ye sahāso rāyaḥ syāma dharuṇaṃ dhiyadhyai ||

translations.english: Let the vast heaven and earth consent, let the brilliant Varuṇa, of whom Indra is the friend consent; letall the victorious Maruts consent that we may be a recepacle for the retention of riches.

mantras.sanskrit: तन्न इन्द्रो वरुणो मित्रो अग्निराप ओषधीर्वनिनो जुषन्त । शर्मन्त्स्याम मरुतामुपस्थे यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tanna indro varuṇo mitro agnirāpa oṣadhīrvanino juṣanta | śarmantsyāma marutāmupasthe yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: May Indra, Varuṇa, Mitra, Agni, the waters, the herbs, the trees, be plural ased by our (praise); may we,(reclining) on the lap of the Maruts, enjoy felicity; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: शं न इन्द्राग्नी भवतामवोभिः शं न इन्द्रावरुणा रातहव्या । शमिन्द्रासोमा सुविताय शं योः शं न इन्द्रापूषणा वाजसातौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaṃ na indrāgnī bhavatāmavobhiḥ śaṃ na indrāvaruṇā rātahavyā | śamindrāsomā suvitāya śaṃ yoḥ śaṃ na indrāpūṣaṇā vājasātau ||

translations.english: May Indra and Agni be (with us) with their protections for our hapiness; may Indra and Varuṇa, to whomoblations are offered, (be with us) for our happiness; may Indra and Soma be (with us) for our happiness, ourprosperity, our good; may Indra and Pūṣan be (with us) in battle for our triumph.

mantras.sanskrit: शं नो भगः शमु नः शंसो अस्तु शं नः पुरंधिः शमु सन्तु रायः । शं नः सत्यस्य सुयमस्य शंसः शं नो अर्यमा पुरुजातो अस्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaṃ no bhagaḥ śamu naḥ śaṃso astu śaṃ naḥ puraṃdhiḥ śamu santu rāyaḥ | śaṃ naḥ satyasya suyamasya śaṃsaḥ śaṃ no aryamā purujāto astu ||

translations.english: May Bhaga (promote) our happiness; may Śaṃsa be our happiness; may Purandhi be (with us for) ourhappiness; may riches be (a source of) happiness; may the benediction of the true and virtuous yield ushappiness; may the variously-manifested Aryaman be (with us) for our felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: शं नो धाता शमु धर्ता नो अस्तु शं न उरूची भवतु स्वधाभिः । शं रोदसी बृहती शं नो अद्रिः शं नो देवानां सुहवानि सन्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaṃ no dhātā śamu dhartā no astu śaṃ na urūcī bhavatu svadhābhiḥ | śaṃ rodasī bṛhatī śaṃ no adriḥ śaṃ no devānāṃ suhavāni santu ||

translations.english: May the creator be to us for happiness; may the discriminator (between virtue and vice, Varuṇa) be(with us) for our happiness; may the wide earth (contribute) with sustenance to our happiness; may the vastheaven and earth be (to us for) happiness; may the mountains (yield) us happiness; may our pious invocations ofthe gods secure us happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: शं नो अग्निर्ज्योतिरनीको अस्तु शं नो मित्रावरुणावश्विना शम् । शं नः सुकृतां सुकृतानि सन्तु शं न इषिरो अभि वातु वातः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaṃ no agnirjyotiranīko astu śaṃ no mitrāvaruṇāvaśvinā śam | śaṃ naḥ sukṛtāṃ sukṛtāni santu śaṃ na iṣiro abhi vātu vātaḥ ||

translations.english: May Agni, whose countenance is light, be (with us) for our happiness; may Mitra and Varuṇa, may theAśvins be (present) for our felicity; may the virtuous be (promotive of) our happiness; may the restless wind blowfor our happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: शं नो द्यावापृथिवी पूर्वहूतौ शमन्तरिक्षं दृशये नो अस्तु । शं न ओषधीर्वनिनो भवन्तु शं नो रजसस्पतिरस्तु जिष्णुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaṃ no dyāvāpṛthivī pūrvahūtau śamantarikṣaṃ dṛśaye no astu | śaṃ na oṣadhīrvanino bhavantu śaṃ no rajasaspatirastu jiṣṇuḥ ||

translations.english: May heaven and earth, the first invoked, (promote) our happiness; may the firmament be happiness toour view; may the herbs, the trees, (yield) us happiness; may the victorious lord of the world, (Indra), be(favourable to) our felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: शं न इन्द्रो वसुभिर्देवो अस्तु शमादित्येभिर्वरुणः सुशंसः । शं नो रुद्रो रुद्रेभिर्जलाषः शं नस्त्वष्टा ग्नाभिरिह शृणोतु ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaṃ na indro vasubhirdevo astu śamādityebhirvaruṇaḥ suśaṃsaḥ | śaṃ no rudro rudrebhirjalāṣaḥ śaṃ nastvaṣṭā gnābhiriha śṛṇotu ||

translations.english: May the divine (Indra), with the Vasus, grant us happiness; may the justly-praised Varuṇa, with theĀdityas, be (friendly to) our happiness; may the grief-assuaging Rudra, with the Rudras, be (for) our happiness;may Tvaṣṭā, with the wives of the gods, be (with us) for our happiness, and hear us at this solemnity.

mantras.sanskrit: शं नः सोमो भवतु ब्रह्म शं नः शं नो ग्रावाणः शमु सन्तु यज्ञाः । शं नः स्वरूणां मितयो भवन्तु शं नः प्रस्वः शम्वस्तु वेदिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaṃ naḥ somo bhavatu brahma śaṃ naḥ śaṃ no grāvāṇaḥ śamu santu yajñāḥ | śaṃ naḥ svarūṇāṃ mitayo bhavantu śaṃ naḥ prasvaḥ śamvastu vediḥ ||

translations.english: May the Soma be (offered for) our happiness; may the prayer be (uttered for) our happiness; may thestones (grind the Soma), the sacrifice be (solemnized for) our happiness; may the measured lengths of thesacrificial posts be (conducive to) our felicity; may the sacred grass be (strewn) for our happiness; may the altarbe (raised for) our happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: शं नः सूर्य उरुचक्षा उदेतु शं नश्चतस्रः प्रदिशो भवन्तु । शं नः पर्वता ध्रुवयो भवन्तु शं नः सिन्धवः शमु सन्त्वापः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaṃ naḥ sūrya urucakṣā udetu śaṃ naścatasraḥ pradiśo bhavantu | śaṃ naḥ parvatā dhruvayo bhavantu śaṃ naḥ sindhavaḥ śamu santvāpaḥ ||

translations.english: May the wide-seeing sun rise (for) our happines; may the four quarters of the horizon (exist for) ourfelicity; may the firm-set mountains be (for) our happiness; may the rivers, may the waters, be (diffused) for ourhappiness.

mantras.sanskrit: शं नो अदितिर्भवतु व्रतेभिः शं नो भवन्तु मरुतः स्वर्काः । शं नो विष्णुः शमु पूषा नो अस्तु शं नो भवित्रं शम्वस्तु वायुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaṃ no aditirbhavatu vratebhiḥ śaṃ no bhavantu marutaḥ svarkāḥ | śaṃ no viṣṇuḥ śamu pūṣā no astu śaṃ no bhavitraṃ śamvastu vāyuḥ ||

translations.english: May Aditi, with holy observances, be (for) our happiness; may the glorified Maruts be (friendly to) ourfelicity; may Viṣṇu, may Pūṣan, be (promoters of) our happiness; may the firmament be propitious to us; mayVāyu (blow for) our happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: शं नो देवः सविता त्रायमाणः शं नो भवन्तूषसो विभातीः । शं नः पर्जन्यो भवतु प्रजाभ्यः शं नः क्षेत्रस्य पतिरस्तु शम्भुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaṃ no devaḥ savitā trāyamāṇaḥ śaṃ no bhavantūṣaso vibhātīḥ | śaṃ naḥ parjanyo bhavatu prajābhyaḥ śaṃ naḥ kṣetrasya patirastu śambhuḥ ||

translations.english: May the divine preserving Savitā be (radiant for) our happiness; may the opening dawns (break for)our happiness; may Parjanya be (the granter of happiness) to our posterity; may Śambhu, the lord of strength,be (the conferrer of) happiness upon us.

mantras.sanskrit: शं नो देवा विश्वदेवा भवन्तु शं सरस्वती सह धीभिरस्तु । शमभिषाचः शमु रातिषाचः शं नो दिव्याः पार्थिवाः शं नो अप्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaṃ no devā viśvadevā bhavantu śaṃ sarasvatī saha dhībhirastu | śamabhiṣācaḥ śamu rātiṣācaḥ śaṃ no divyāḥ pārthivāḥ śaṃ no apyāḥ ||

translations.english: May the divine universal gods be (favourable) to our felicity; may Sarasvatī, with holy rites, behappiness; may those who assist at sacrifices, those who are liberal of gifts. Be (conducive to) our happiness;may celestial, terrestrial and aquatic things be (subservient to) our happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: शं नः सत्यस्य पतयो भवन्तु शं नो अर्वन्तः शमु सन्तु गावः । शं न ऋभवः सुकृतः सुहस्ताः शं नो भवन्तु पितरो हवेषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaṃ naḥ satyasya patayo bhavantu śaṃ no arvantaḥ śamu santu gāvaḥ | śaṃ na ṛbhavaḥ sukṛtaḥ suhastāḥ śaṃ no bhavantu pitaro haveṣu ||

translations.english: May the lords of truth be (propitious to) our happiness; may horses, may cattle, (contribute to) ourhappiness; may the virtuous, the dexterous Ṛbhus, be to us (for) felicity; may the progenitors be (promoters of)our happiness at the seasons of worship.

mantras.sanskrit: शं नो अज एकपाद्देवो अस्तु शं नोऽहिर्बुध्न्यः शं समुद्रः । शं नो अपां नपात्पेरुरस्तु शं नः पृश्निर्भवतु देवगोपा ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaṃ no aja ekapāddevo astu śaṃ no'hirbudhnyaḥ śaṃ samudraḥ | śaṃ no apāṃ napātperurastu śaṃ naḥ pṛśnirbhavatu devagopā ||

translations.english: May the divine Aja-Ekapād be (favourable to) our happiness; may Ahirbudhnya, may the firmament, be(promotive of) our happiness; may the grandson of the waters, the protector, be (the securer of) our felicity; mayPṛśni, of whom the gods are the guardians, be to us (a granter of) happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: आदित्या रुद्रा वसवो जुषन्तेदं ब्रह्म क्रियमाणं नवीयः । शृण्वन्तु नो दिव्याः पार्थिवासो गोजाता उत ये यज्ञियासः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ādityā rudrā vasavo juṣantedaṃ brahma kriyamāṇaṃ navīyaḥ | śṛṇvantu no divyāḥ pārthivāso gojātā uta ye yajñiyāsaḥ ||

translations.english: May the Ādiyas, the Rudras, the Vasus, be gratified by this new and now repeated praise; maycelestial and terrestrial (beings), the progeny of the cow, (Pṛśni), and those who were entitled to worship, hearour (invocations).

mantras.sanskrit: ये देवानां यज्ञिया यज्ञियानां मनोर्यजत्रा अमृता ऋतज्ञाः । ते नो रासन्तामुरुगायमद्य यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye devānāṃ yajñiyā yajñiyānāṃ manoryajatrā amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ | te no rāsantāmurugāyamadya yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: May those who are the most adorable divinities, those who were the adored of Manu, those who areimmortal, the observers of truth, bestow upon us this day (a son), of wide-spread renown; and do you evercherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ब्रह्मैतु सदनादृतस्य वि रश्मिभिः ससृजे सूर्यो गाः । वि सानुना पृथिवी सस्र उर्वी पृथु प्रतीकमध्येधे अग्निः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra brahmaitu sadanādṛtasya vi raśmibhiḥ sasṛje sūryo gāḥ | vi sānunā pṛthivī sasra urvī pṛthu pratīkamadhyedhe agniḥ ||

translations.english: Let the prayer proceed from the nail of the sacrifice, for Sūrya with his rays lets loose the waters; thespacious earth spreads (studded) with mountains, and Agni blazes on the extensive plural inṣ

mantras.sanskrit: इमां वां मित्रावरुणा सुवृक्तिमिषं न कृण्वे असुरा नवीयः । इनो वामन्यः पदवीरदब्धो जनं च मित्रो यतति ब्रुवाणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imāṃ vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā suvṛktimiṣaṃ na kṛṇve asurā navīyaḥ | ino vāmanyaḥ padavīradabdho janaṃ ca mitro yatati bruvāṇaḥ ||

translations.english: Powerful Mitra and Varuṇa, to you I offer this new praise as if it were (sacrificial) food; one of you,(Varuṇa). The invincible lord, is the guide to the path (of virtue) Mitra when praised animates men to exertioṇ

mantras.sanskrit: आ वातस्य ध्रजतो रन्त इत्या अपीपयन्त धेनवो न सूदाः । महो दिवः सदने जायमानोऽचिक्रदद्वृषभः सस्मिन्नूधन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vātasya dhrajato ranta ityā apīpayanta dhenavo na sūdāḥ | maho divaḥ sadane jāyamāno'cikradadvṛṣabhaḥ sasminnūdhan ||

translations.english: The movements of the restless wind sport around; the milk-yielding kine are in good condition; theshowerer genitive rated in the dwelling of the mighty sun has cried aloud in that his plural ce of abiding, (the firmament).

mantras.sanskrit: गिरा य एता युनजद्धरी त इन्द्र प्रिया सुरथा शूर धायू । प्र यो मन्युं रिरिक्षतो मिनात्या सुक्रतुमर्यमणं ववृत्याम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: girā ya etā yunajaddharī ta indra priyā surathā śūra dhāyū | pra yo manyuṃ ririkṣato minātyā sukratumaryamaṇaṃ vavṛtyām ||

translations.english: Hero, Indra, (come to the sacrifice of the man) who, by his adoration, has harnessed (to your car) theseyour favourite, graceful and vigorous horses; may I bring hither Aryaman, the doer of good deeds, who baffles thewrath of the malevolent.

mantras.sanskrit: यजन्ते अस्य सख्यं वयश्च नमस्विनः स्व ऋतस्य धामन् । वि पृक्षो बाबधे नृभिः स्तवान इदं नमो रुद्राय प्रेष्ठम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajante asya sakhyaṃ vayaśca namasvinaḥ sva ṛtasya dhāman | vi pṛkṣo bābadhe nṛbhiḥ stavāna idaṃ namo rudrāya preṣṭham ||

translations.english: Let the offerers of adoration, engaging (in pious acts), worship (Rudra) in their own hall of sacrifice,(solicitous) of his friendship; praised by the leaders (of rites), he lavishes food (upon them); this most acceptableadoration is addressed to Rudra.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यत्साकं यशसो वावशानाः सरस्वती सप्तथी सिन्धुमाता । याः सुष्वयन्त सुदुघाः सुधारा अभि स्वेन पयसा पीप्यानाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yatsākaṃ yaśaso vāvaśānāḥ sarasvatī saptathī sindhumātā | yāḥ suṣvayanta sudughāḥ sudhārā abhi svena payasā pīpyānāḥ ||

translations.english: May the seventh (stream), Sarasvatī, the mother of the Sindhu and those rivers that flow copious andfertilizing, bestowing abundance of food, and nourishing (the people) by their waters come at once together.

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्ये नो मरुतो मन्दसाना धियं तोकं च वाजिनोऽवन्तु । मा नः परि ख्यदक्षरा चरन्त्यवीवृधन्युज्यं ते रयिं नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tye no maruto mandasānā dhiyaṃ tokaṃ ca vājino'vantu | mā naḥ pari khyadakṣarā carantyavīvṛdhanyujyaṃ te rayiṃ naḥ ||

translations.english: May these joyous and swift-going Maruts protect our sacrifice and our offspring; let not the imperishablegoddess of speech, deserting us, speak (kindly) to our (adversaries); and may both (she and the Marut)associated augment our riches.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वो महीमरमतिं कृणुध्वं प्र पूषणं विदथ्यं न वीरम् । भगं धियोऽवितारं नो अस्याः सातौ वाजं रातिषाचं पुरंधिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vo mahīmaramatiṃ kṛṇudhvaṃ pra pūṣaṇaṃ vidathyaṃ na vīram | bhagaṃ dhiyo'vitāraṃ no asyāḥ sātau vājaṃ rātiṣācaṃ puraṃdhim ||

translations.english: Invoke, (worshippers), the unresisting earth, and the adorable hero, Pūṣan; (invoke) Bhaga, theprotector of this our sacrifice, and Vāja, the sustainer of old, the liberal of gifts to our solemnity.

mantras.sanskrit: अच्छायं वो मरुतः श्लोक एत्वच्छा विष्णुं निषिक्तपामवोभिः । उत प्रजायै गृणते वयो धुर्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: acchāyaṃ vo marutaḥ śloka etvacchā viṣṇuṃ niṣiktapāmavobhiḥ | uta prajāyai gṛṇate vayo dhuryūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: May this praise come, Maruts, before you; (may it come) before Viṣṇu, the guardian of the embryo,with his protecting faculties; may they both bestow upon (me), their adorer, progeny and food; and do you evercherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वो वाहिष्ठो वहतु स्तवध्यै रथो वाजा ऋभुक्षणो अमृक्तः । अभि त्रिपृष्ठैः सवनेषु सोमैर्मदे सुशिप्रा महभिः पृणध्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vo vāhiṣṭho vahatu stavadhyai ratho vājā ṛbhukṣaṇo amṛktaḥ | abhi tripṛṣṭhaiḥ savaneṣu somairmade suśiprā mahabhiḥ pṛṇadhvam ||

translations.english: Vājas, possessors of energy, let your capacious, commendable, and unobstructed chariot bring you(hither); be satiated, handsome-chinned, with the copious triply-combined libation (poured out) for yourexhilaration at our sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: यूयं ह रत्नं मघवत्सु धत्थ स्वर्दृश ऋभुक्षणो अमृक्तम् । सं यज्ञेषु स्वधावन्तः पिबध्वं वि नो राधांसि मतिभिर्दयध्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yūyaṃ ha ratnaṃ maghavatsu dhattha svardṛśa ṛbhukṣaṇo amṛktam | saṃ yajñeṣu svadhāvantaḥ pibadhvaṃ vi no rādhāṃsi matibhirdayadhvam ||

translations.english: For you, Ṛbhukṣins, beholders of heaven, preserve unmolested the precious (treasure) for us who areaffluent (in sacrificial offerings); do you who are possessed of strengh, drink fully at (our) solemnities, and with(favourable) minds bestow upon us riches.

mantras.sanskrit: उवोचिथ हि मघवन्देष्णं महो अर्भस्य वसुनो विभागे । उभा ते पूर्णा वसुना गभस्ती न सूनृता नि यमते वसव्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: uvocitha hi maghavandeṣṇaṃ maho arbhasya vasuno vibhāge | ubhā te pūrṇā vasunā gabhastī na sūnṛtā ni yamate vasavyā ||

translations.english: You, Maghavan, have determined what is to be given in the apportionment of much or of little wealth,for both your hands are full of treasure, and your sincere (promises) of riches do not restrain them.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमिन्द्र स्वयशा ऋभुक्षा वाजो न साधुरस्तमेष्यृक्वा । वयं नु ते दाश्वांसः स्याम ब्रह्म कृण्वन्तो हरिवो वसिष्ठाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamindra svayaśā ṛbhukṣā vājo na sādhurastameṣyṛkvā | vayaṃ nu te dāśvāṃsaḥ syāma brahma kṛṇvanto harivo vasiṣṭhāḥ ||

translations.english: Do you, Indra, who are Ṛbhukṣin, and of especial renown, who, like food, are the fulfiller (of wants),come to the dwelling of the worshipper; lord of bay horses, may we, Vasiṣṭhas, be today the donors (of theofferings) to yo, the celebrators of your praise.

mantras.sanskrit: सनितासि प्रवतो दाशुषे चिद्याभिर्विवेषो हर्यश्व धीभिः । ववन्मा नु ते युज्याभिरूती कदा न इन्द्र राय आ दशस्येः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sanitāsi pravato dāśuṣe cidyābhirviveṣo haryaśva dhībhiḥ | vavanmā nu te yujyābhirūtī kadā na indra rāya ā daśasyeḥ ||

translations.english: Lord of bay horses, you are the giver of descending (wealth) to the donor (of the oblation), by whosesacred rites you are magnified; when may you bestow upon us riches; when may we be secure by yourappropriate protections.

mantras.sanskrit: वासयसीव वेधसस्त्वं नः कदा न इन्द्र वचसो बुबोधः । अस्तं तात्या धिया रयिं सुवीरं पृक्षो नो अर्वा न्युहीत वाजी ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāsayasīva vedhasastvaṃ naḥ kadā na indra vacaso bubodhaḥ | astaṃ tātyā dhiyā rayiṃ suvīraṃ pṛkṣo no arvā nyuhīta vājī ||

translations.english: When, Indra, will you appreciate our praise; at present you establish us (your) adorers in our dwelling;let your swift horse, (influenced) by our protracted solemnity, convey to our abode riches, male offspring, andfood.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि यं देवी निॠतिश्चिदीशे नक्षन्त इन्द्रं शरदः सुपृक्षः । उप त्रिबन्धुर्जरदष्टिमेत्यस्ववेशं यं कृणवन्त मर्ताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi yaṃ devī niṝtiścidīśe nakṣanta indraṃ śaradaḥ supṛkṣaḥ | upa tribandhurjaradaṣṭimetyasvaveśaṃ yaṃ kṛṇavanta martāḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, the upholder of the three regions, whom the divine Nirṛti acknowledges as ruler, whom abundantyears pass over, whom mortals detain from his own abode, approaches to (recruit) his decaying strength.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो राधांसि सवित स्तवध्या आ रायो यन्तु पर्वतस्य रातौ । सदा नो दिव्यः पायुः सिषक्तु यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no rādhāṃsi savita stavadhyā ā rāyo yantu parvatasya rātau | sadā no divyaḥ pāyuḥ siṣaktu yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: May riches worthy of laudation come, Savitā, to us; riches that are in the bestow of Parvata; may theheavenly protector (of all) preserve us; and, do you (Universal gods), ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: उदु ष्य देवः सविता ययाम हिरण्ययीममतिं यामशिश्रेत् । नूनं भगो हव्यो मानुषेभिर्वि यो रत्ना पुरूवसुर्दधाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: udu ṣya devaḥ savitā yayāma hiraṇyayīmamatiṃ yāmaśiśret | nūnaṃ bhago havyo mānuṣebhirvi yo ratnā purūvasurdadhāti ||

translations.english: The divine Savitā has diffused the golden radiance on high, of which he is the asylum; verily Bhaga isto be absorbed by men who, abounding in wealth, distributes treasures (among them).

mantras.sanskrit: उदु तिष्ठ सवितः श्रुध्यस्य हिरण्यपाणे प्रभृतावृतस्य । व्युर्वीं पृथ्वीममतिं सृजान आ नृभ्यो मर्तभोजनं सुवानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: udu tiṣṭha savitaḥ śrudhyasya hiraṇyapāṇe prabhṛtāvṛtasya | vyurvīṃ pṛthvīmamatiṃ sṛjāna ā nṛbhyo martabhojanaṃ suvānaḥ ||

translations.english: Rise up Savitā; hear (our solicitations) upon the celebration of this ceremony, (you who are) diffusinglight over the spacious earth, and bestowing human enjoyment upon men.

mantras.sanskrit: अपि ष्टुतः सविता देवो अस्तु यमा चिद्विश्वे वसवो गृणन्ति । स नः स्तोमान्नमस्यश्चनो धाद्विश्वेभिः पातु पायुभिर्नि सूरीन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: api ṣṭutaḥ savitā devo astu yamā cidviśve vasavo gṛṇanti | sa naḥ stomānnamasyaścano dhādviśvebhiḥ pātu pāyubhirni sūrīn ||

translations.english: Glorified be the divine Savitā, whom all the gods praise; may that adorable (diviniy) require our praises(with) food; may he always protect the devout with all his protections.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि यं देव्यदितिर्गृणाति सवं देवस्य सवितुर्जुषाणा । अभि सम्राजो वरुणो गृणन्त्यभि मित्रासो अर्यमा सजोषाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi yaṃ devyaditirgṛṇāti savaṃ devasya saviturjuṣāṇā | abhi samrājo varuṇo gṛṇantyabhi mitrāso aryamā sajoṣāḥ ||

translations.english: Whom the divine Aditi, delighting at the birth of the divine Savitṛ, glorifies, whom the supremesoverigns, Varuṇa, Mitra, Āryaman, (and other gods) adore.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि ये मिथो वनुषः सपन्ते रातिं दिवो रातिषाचः पृथिव्याः । अहिर्बुध्न्य उत नः शृणोतु वरूत्र्येकधेनुभिर्नि पातु ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi ye mitho vanuṣaḥ sapante rātiṃ divo rātiṣācaḥ pṛthivyāḥ | ahirbudhnya uta naḥ śṛṇotu varūtryekadhenubhirni pātu ||

translations.english: Whom those solicitous for wealth those enjoying (it), mutually worship, the benefactor of heaven andearth; may Ahirbudhnya hear us; may the protectress (the goddess of speech), cherish us with excellen cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: अनु तन्नो जास्पतिर्मंसीष्ट रत्नं देवस्य सवितुरियानः । भगमुग्रोऽवसे जोहवीति भगमनुग्रो अध याति रत्नम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: anu tanno jāspatirmaṃsīṣṭa ratnaṃ devasya savituriyānaḥ | bhagamugro'vase johavīti bhagamanugro adha yāti ratnam ||

translations.english: May the protector of progeny, when solicited, consent to bestow upon us the precious (wealth of thedivine Savitā; the ardent (adorer) invokes repeatedly Bhaga for protection; the less ardent solicits Bhaga forwealth.

mantras.sanskrit: शं नो भवन्तु वाजिनो हवेषु देवताता मितद्रवः स्वर्काः । जम्भयन्तोऽहिं वृकं रक्षांसि सनेम्यस्मद्युयवन्नमीवाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaṃ no bhavantu vājino haveṣu devatātā mitadravaḥ svarkāḥ | jambhayanto'hiṃ vṛkaṃ rakṣāṃsi sanemyasmadyuyavannamīvāḥ ||

translations.english: May the Vājins, with slackened speed, bringing excellent food, be (disposed) for our happiness, uponour invocations at the worship of the gods; destroying the murderer, the robber, the rākṣasas, and keepingfrom us ancient maladies.

mantras.sanskrit: वाजेवाजेऽवत वाजिनो नो धनेषु विप्रा अमृता ऋतज्ञाः । अस्य मध्वः पिबत मादयध्वं तृप्ता यात पथिभिर्देवयानैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vājevāje'vata vājino no dhaneṣu viprā amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ | asya madhvaḥ pibata mādayadhvaṃ tṛptā yāta pathibhirdevayānaiḥ ||

translations.english: Wise, immortal Vājins, observers of truth, defend us in every conflict, and for the sake of wealth; drinkof this sweet (Soma), be exhilarated (thereby) and satisfied; proceed by the paths traversed by the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वो अग्निः सुमतिं वस्वो अश्रेत्प्रतीची जूर्णिर्देवतातिमेति । भेजाते अद्री रथ्येव पन्थामृतं होता न इषितो यजाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūrdhvo agniḥ sumatiṃ vasvo aśretpratīcī jūrṇirdevatātimeti | bhejāte adrī rathyeva panthāmṛtaṃ hotā na iṣito yajāti ||

translations.english: Let Agni, risen on high, accept the praise of the worshipper; she who makes (all creatures) old, lookingto the west, goes to the sacrifice; the pious pair, like two riders in a chariot, follow the path (of the ceremony); letthe Hotā, as enjoined, celebrate the rite.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वावृजे सुप्रया बर्हिरेषामा विश्पतीव बीरिट इयाते । विशामक्तोरुषसः पूर्वहूतौ वायुः पूषा स्वस्तये नियुत्वान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vāvṛje suprayā barhireṣāmā viśpatīva bīriṭa iyāte | viśāmaktoruṣasaḥ pūrvahūtau vāyuḥ pūṣā svastaye niyutvān ||

translations.english: The food-bestowing sacred grass of these (the worshippers) is strewn; may the two lords of people,Vāyu with the Niyut steeds, and Pūṣan, invoked before the dawn upon the close of the night, appear now inthe firmament for the welfare of mankind.

mantras.sanskrit: ज्मया अत्र वसवो रन्त देवा उरावन्तरिक्षे मर्जयन्त शुभ्राः । अर्वाक्पथ उरुज्रयः कृणुध्वं श्रोता दूतस्य जग्मुषो नो अस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: jmayā atra vasavo ranta devā urāvantarikṣe marjayanta śubhrāḥ | arvākpatha urujrayaḥ kṛṇudhvaṃ śrotā dūtasya jagmuṣo no asya ||

translations.english: May the divine Vasus sport on this occasion upon the earth; the brilliant (Maruts) in the expansivefirmament are being worshipped; swift-moving deities, direct your paths towards us; hear (the words) of this ourmessenger, (Agni), approaching you.

mantras.sanskrit: ते हि यज्ञेषु यज्ञियास ऊमाः सधस्थं विश्वे अभि सन्ति देवाः । ताँ अध्वर उशतो यक्ष्यग्ने श्रुष्टी भगं नासत्या पुरंधिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: te hi yajñeṣu yajñiyāsa ūmāḥ sadhasthaṃ viśve abhi santi devāḥ | tā~ adhvara uśato yakṣyagne śruṣṭī bhagaṃ nāsatyā puraṃdhim ||

translations.english: These universal adorable guardian deities occupy a common station at sacrifices; worship, Agni, thosedivinities, deservers (of oblations) at the ceremony, the swift Bhaga, the Nāsatyās and Purandhi.

mantras.sanskrit: आग्ने गिरो दिव आ पृथिव्या मित्रं वह वरुणमिन्द्रमग्निम् । आर्यमणमदितिं विष्णुमेषां सरस्वती मरुतो मादयन्ताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: āgne giro diva ā pṛthivyā mitraṃ vaha varuṇamindramagnim | āryamaṇamaditiṃ viṣṇumeṣāṃ sarasvatī maruto mādayantām ||

translations.english: Bring Agni, whether from heaven or earth, the adorable deities Mitra, Varuṇa, Indra and Agni,Āryaman, Aditi and Viṣṇu (for the good) of these (worshippers); and may Sarasvatī and the Maruts bedelighted (by our offerings).
