mantras.sanskrit: ररे हव्यं मतिभिर्यज्ञियानां नक्षत्कामं मर्त्यानामसिन्वन् । धाता रयिमविदस्यं सदासां सक्षीमहि युज्येभिर्नु देवैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: rare havyaṃ matibhiryajñiyānāṃ nakṣatkāmaṃ martyānāmasinvan | dhātā rayimavidasyaṃ sadāsāṃ sakṣīmahi yujyebhirnu devaiḥ ||

translations.english: The oblation is offered together with praises to the adorable deities; may (Agni), unaverse to the desireof mortals, be present; bestow (upon us gods), unwasting, all-benefiting riches; and may we today be associatedwith the assembled deities.

mantras.sanskrit: नू रोदसी अभिष्टुते वसिष्ठैॠतावानो वरुणो मित्रो अग्निः । यच्छन्तु चन्द्रा उपमं नो अर्कं यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū rodasī abhiṣṭute vasiṣṭhaiṝtāvāno varuṇo mitro agniḥ | yacchantu candrā upamaṃ no arkaṃ yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Heaven and earth are now glorified by the Vasiṣṭhas, as are Varuṇa, the objec of worship, and Mitraand Agni; may they, the conferrers of joy, bestow upon us excellent food; and do you (all) ever cherish us withblessings.

mantras.sanskrit: ओ श्रुष्टिर्विदथ्या समेतु प्रति स्तोमं दधीमहि तुराणाम् । यदद्य देवः सविता सुवाति स्यामास्य रत्निनो विभागे ॥
mantras.transliteration: o śruṣṭirvidathyā sametu prati stomaṃ dadhīmahi turāṇām | yadadya devaḥ savitā suvāti syāmāsya ratnino vibhāge ||

translations.english: May the satisfaction derived from pious rites come to us as we contemplate the glorification of the swiftmoving (divinities); may we be included in the apportionment by that wealth-bestowing deity (of the riches) whichthe divine Savitā goday distributes.

mantras.sanskrit: मित्रस्तन्नो वरुणो रोदसी च द्युभक्तमिन्द्रो अर्यमा ददातु । दिदेष्टु देव्यदिती रेक्णो वायुश्च यन्नियुवैते भगश्च ॥
mantras.transliteration: mitrastanno varuṇo rodasī ca dyubhaktamindro aryamā dadātu | dideṣṭu devyaditī rekṇo vāyuśca yanniyuvaite bhagaśca ||

translations.english: May Mitra and Varuṇa, heaven and earth, Indra and Āryaman, give us that (wealth) which is meritedby brilliant (laudations); may the divine Aditi be disposed to give us riches, which Vāyu and Bhaga may preserveever in our keeping.

mantras.sanskrit: सेदुग्रो अस्तु मरुतः स शुष्मी यं मर्त्यं पृषदश्वा अवाथ । उतेमग्निः सरस्वती जुनन्ति न तस्य रायः पर्येतास्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: sedugro astu marutaḥ sa śuṣmī yaṃ martyaṃ pṛṣadaśvā avātha | utemagniḥ sarasvatī junanti na tasya rāyaḥ paryetāsti ||

translations.english: Maruts, whose steeds are the spotted deer, may the mortal whom you protect the resolute, be strong,for him Agni and Sarasvatī also defend, and there be no despoiler of his riches.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं हि नेता वरुण ऋतस्य मित्रो राजानो अर्यमापो धुः । सुहवा देव्यदितिरनर्वा ते नो अंहो अति पर्षन्नरिष्टान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ hi netā varuṇa ṛtasya mitro rājāno aryamāpo dhuḥ | suhavā devyaditiranarvā te no aṃho ati parṣannariṣṭān ||

translations.english: This Varuṇa, the leader of the rite, and the royal Mitra and Āryaman, uphold my acts, and the divineunopposed Aditi, earnestly invoked; may they convey us safe beyond evil.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य देवस्य मीळ्हुषो वया विष्णोरेषस्य प्रभृथे हविर्भिः । विदे हि रुद्रो रुद्रियं महित्वं यासिष्टं वर्तिरश्विनाविरावत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya devasya mīḷhuṣo vayā viṣṇoreṣasya prabhṛthe havirbhiḥ | vide hi rudro rudriyaṃ mahitvaṃ yāsiṣṭaṃ vartiraśvināvirāvat ||

translations.english: I propitiate with oblations the ramifications of that divine attainable Viṣṇu, the showerer of benefits;Rudra, bestow upon us the magnificence of his nature; the Aśvins have come to our dwelling abond with(sacrificial) food.

mantras.sanskrit: मात्र पूषन्नाघृण इरस्यो वरूत्री यद्रातिषाचश्च रासन् । मयोभुवो नो अर्वन्तो नि पान्तु वृष्टिं परिज्मा वातो ददातु ॥
mantras.transliteration: mātra pūṣannāghṛṇa irasyo varūtrī yadrātiṣācaśca rāsan | mayobhuvo no arvanto ni pāntu vṛṣṭiṃ parijmā vāto dadātu ||

translations.english: Resplendent Pūṣan, oppose not (hindrance) on this occasion; may the protectress, (Sarasvatī) andthe liberal (wives of the gods), grant us wealth; may the ever-moving deities, the sources of happiness, protectus; may the circumambient Vāta send us rain.

mantras.sanskrit: नू रोदसी अभिष्टुते वसिष्ठैॠतावानो वरुणो मित्रो अग्निः । यच्छन्तु चन्द्रा उपमं नो अर्कं यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū rodasī abhiṣṭute vasiṣṭhaiṝtāvāno varuṇo mitro agniḥ | yacchantu candrā upamaṃ no arkaṃ yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Heaven and earth are now glorified by the Vasiṣṭhas, as are Varuṇa the object of worship, and Mitraand Agni; may they, the conferrers of joy, bestow upon us excellent food; and do you (all) ever cherish us withblessings.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रातरग्निं प्रातरिन्द्रं हवामहे प्रातर्मित्रावरुणा प्रातरश्विना । प्रातर्भगं पूषणं ब्रह्मणस्पतिं प्रातः सोममुत रुद्रं हुवेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: prātaragniṃ prātarindraṃ havāmahe prātarmitrāvaruṇā prātaraśvinā | prātarbhagaṃ pūṣaṇaṃ brahmaṇaspatiṃ prātaḥ somamuta rudraṃ huvema ||

translations.english: We invoke at dawn Agni; at dawn Indra; at dawn Mitra and Varuṇa; at dawn the Aśvins; at dawnBhaga, Pūṣan, Brahmaṇaspati; at dawn Soma and Rudra.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रातर्जितं भगमुग्रं हुवेम वयं पुत्रमदितेर्यो विधर्ता । आध्रश्चिद्यं मन्यमानस्तुरश्चिद्राजा चिद्यं भगं भक्षीत्याह ॥
mantras.transliteration: prātarjitaṃ bhagamugraṃ huvema vayaṃ putramaditeryo vidhartā | ādhraścidyaṃ manyamānasturaścidrājā cidyaṃ bhagaṃ bhakṣītyāha ||

translations.english: We invoke at dawn fierce Bhaga, the son of Aditi, who is the sustainer (of the world), to whom the poorman praising him applies, saying, give (me wealth), to whom the opulent prince (addresses the same prayer).

mantras.sanskrit: भग प्रणेतर्भग सत्यराधो भगेमां धियमुदवा ददन्नः । भग प्र णो जनय गोभिरश्वैर्भग प्र नृभिर्नृवन्तः स्याम ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhaga praṇetarbhaga satyarādho bhagemāṃ dhiyamudavā dadannaḥ | bhaga pra ṇo janaya gobhiraśvairbhaga pra nṛbhirnṛvantaḥ syāma ||

translations.english: Bhaga, chief leader of rites, Bhaga, faithful granting (our wishes), fructify ceremony, enrich us withcattle and horses; may we Bhaga, be eminent with male descendants and followers.

mantras.sanskrit: उतेदानीं भगवन्तः स्यामोत प्रपित्व उत मध्ये अह्नाम् । उतोदिता मघवन्त्सूर्यस्य वयं देवानां सुमतौ स्याम ॥
mantras.transliteration: utedānīṃ bhagavantaḥ syāmota prapitva uta madhye ahnām | utoditā maghavantsūryasya vayaṃ devānāṃ sumatau syāma ||

translations.english: May we now have Bhaga (for our lord), whether in the forenoon or mid- day, or at sun-rise; may we,Maghavan, enjoy the favour of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: भग एव भगवाँ अस्तु देवास्तेन वयं भगवन्तः स्याम । तं त्वा भग सर्व इज्जोहवीति स नो भग पुरएता भवेह ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhaga eva bhagavā~ astu devāstena vayaṃ bhagavantaḥ syāma | taṃ tvā bhaga sarva ijjohavīti sa no bhaga puraetā bhaveha ||

translations.english: May Bhaga, gods, be the possessor of opulence, and, through him, may we be possessed of wealth,every one verily repeatedly invokes you, Bhaga; do you, Bhaga, be our preceder at this solemnity.

mantras.sanskrit: समध्वरायोषसो नमन्त दधिक्रावेव शुचये पदाय । अर्वाचीनं वसुविदं भगं नो रथमिवाश्वा वाजिन आ वहन्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: samadhvarāyoṣaso namanta dadhikrāveva śucaye padāya | arvācīnaṃ vasuvidaṃ bhagaṃ no rathamivāśvā vājina ā vahantu ||

translations.english: May the dawn come to our sacrifice as a horse to a suitable station; as rapid steeds convey a chariot,so may the dawns bring to us Bhaga, down- descending, charged with riches.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्वावतीर्गोमतीर्न उषासो वीरवतीः सदमुच्छन्तु भद्राः । घृतं दुहाना विश्वतः प्रपीता यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvāvatīrgomatīrna uṣāso vīravatīḥ sadamucchantu bhadrāḥ | ghṛtaṃ duhānā viśvataḥ prapītā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: {Text is missing}

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ब्रह्माणो अङ्गिरसो नक्षन्त प्र क्रन्दनुर्नभन्यस्य वेतु । प्र धेनव उदप्रुतो नवन्त युज्यातामद्री अध्वरस्य पेशः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra brahmāṇo aṅgiraso nakṣanta pra krandanurnabhanyasya vetu | pra dhenava udapruto navanta yujyātāmadrī adhvarasya peśaḥ ||

translations.english: May the brāhmaṇas, the Aṅgirasas, be everywhere present; may Krandanu be conscious of (our)adoration; may the rivers glide along, distributing water; may the pious couple (the yajamāna and his wife),conjointly appreciate the beauty of the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: सुगस्ते अग्ने सनवित्तो अध्वा युक्ष्वा सुते हरितो रोहितश्च । ये वा सद्मन्नरुषा वीरवाहो हुवे देवानां जनिमानि सत्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sugaste agne sanavitto adhvā yukṣvā sute harito rohitaśca | ye vā sadmannaruṣā vīravāho huve devānāṃ janimāni sattaḥ ||

translations.english: plural asant, Agni, by your long-familiar path, invoke the libation; the bay, the ruddy horses, who, brilliantshining, are the conveyers of (you), the hero, to the hall of sacrifice, where seated, I invoke the companies of thegods.

mantras.sanskrit: समु वो यज्ञं महयन्नमोभिः प्र होता मन्द्रो रिरिच उपाके । यजस्व सु पुर्वणीक देवाना यज्ञियामरमतिं ववृत्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samu vo yajñaṃ mahayannamobhiḥ pra hotā mandro ririca upāke | yajasva su purvaṇīka devānā yajñiyāmaramatiṃ vavṛtyāḥ ||

translations.english: The (worshippers) offer you, (gods), this sacrifice, with prostrations; the ministrant priest, who is nearus repeating pious praise, excels (all others); worship well the gods; resplendent (Agni), make the venerableearth revolve.

mantras.sanskrit: यदा वीरस्य रेवतो दुरोणे स्योनशीरतिथिराचिकेतत् । सुप्रीतो अग्निः सुधितो दम आ स विशे दाति वार्यमियत्यै ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadā vīrasya revato duroṇe syonaśīratithirāciketat | suprīto agniḥ sudhito dama ā sa viśe dāti vāryamiyatyai ||

translations.english: When Agni, reposing at his ease in the dwelling of the liberal worshipper, is welcomed as a guest, thussuitable plural ced in the hall of sacrifice, he gives well-plural ased, desirable (wealth) to the people who approach him.

mantras.sanskrit: इमं नो अग्ने अध्वरं जुषस्व मरुत्स्विन्द्रे यशसं कृधी नः । आ नक्ता बर्हिः सदतामुषासोशन्ता मित्रावरुणा यजेह ॥
mantras.transliteration: imaṃ no agne adhvaraṃ juṣasva marutsvindre yaśasaṃ kṛdhī naḥ | ā naktā barhiḥ sadatāmuṣāsośantā mitrāvaruṇā yajeha ||

translations.english: Be gratified, Agni, by this our sacrifice; render our (worship) renowned among Indra and the Maruts; letthe days and nights sit down on the sacred grass; worship (Agni), at this rite, Mitra and Varuṇa, desiring (theoblation).

mantras.sanskrit: एवाग्निं सहस्यं वसिष्ठो रायस्कामो विश्वप्स्न्यस्य स्तौत् । इषं रयिं पप्रथद्वाजमस्मे यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: evāgniṃ sahasyaṃ vasiṣṭho rāyaskāmo viśvapsnyasya staut | iṣaṃ rayiṃ paprathadvājamasme yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Thus has Vasiṣṭha wishing for riches, glorified the vigorous Agni for the sake of every sort of wealth;may he bestow upon us food, rices, strength; and do you, (gods), ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वो यज्ञेषु देवयन्तो अर्चन्द्यावा नमोभिः पृथिवी इषध्यै । येषां ब्रह्माण्यसमानि विप्रा विष्वग्वियन्ति वनिनो न शाखाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vo yajñeṣu devayanto arcandyāvā namobhiḥ pṛthivī iṣadhyai | yeṣāṃ brahmāṇyasamāni viprā viṣvagviyanti vanino na śākhāḥ ||

translations.english: Devout worshippers seek to attain you, gods, by praises at sacrifices; they (worship) the heaven andearth, they of whom the divesified adorations spread everywhere like th ebranches of trees.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र यज्ञ एतु हेत्वो न सप्तिरुद्यच्छध्वं समनसो घृताचीः । स्तृणीत बर्हिरध्वराय साधूर्ध्वा शोचींषि देवयून्यस्थुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra yajña etu hetvo na saptirudyacchadhvaṃ samanaso ghṛtācīḥ | stṛṇīta barhiradhvarāya sādhūrdhvā śocīṃṣi devayūnyasthuḥ ||

translations.english: Let the sacrifice proceed like a swift course (tot he gods); elevate, (priests), with one occurred, yourladles, charged with butter; spread for the solemnity the sacred grass;le the flames (of the burnt-offering) to thegods ascend on high.

mantras.sanskrit: आ पुत्रासो न मातरं विभृत्राः सानौ देवासो बर्हिषः सदन्तु । आ विश्वाची विदथ्यामनक्त्वग्ने मा नो देवताता मृधस्कः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā putrāso na mātaraṃ vibhṛtrāḥ sānau devāso barhiṣaḥ sadantu | ā viśvācī vidathyāmanaktvagne mā no devatātā mṛdhaskaḥ ||

translations.english: Let the gods sit down on the summit of the sacred grass, like children nursed on the (lap of the) mother;let the full ladle, Agni, pour (the oblaion) on the sacrificial flame; give us not up to your adversaries in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: ते सीषपन्त जोषमा यजत्रा ऋतस्य धाराः सुदुघा दुहानाः । ज्येष्ठं वो अद्य मह आ वसूनामा गन्तन समनसो यति ष्ठ ॥
mantras.transliteration: te sīṣapanta joṣamā yajatrā ṛtasya dhārāḥ sudughā duhānāḥ | jyeṣṭhaṃ vo adya maha ā vasūnāmā gantana samanaso yati ṣṭha ||

translations.english: May the adorable deities, who are the bestowers of water, the shedders of showers, be fully propitiated(by our praises); may the most precious and commendable of your treasure (be ours) today; and do you with oneaccord come hither.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा नो अग्ने विक्ष्वा दशस्य त्वया वयं सहसावन्नास्क्राः । राया युजा सधमादो अरिष्टा यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā no agne vikṣvā daśasya tvayā vayaṃ sahasāvannāskrāḥ | rāyā yujā sadhamādo ariṣṭā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Be glorified Agni; grant us (wealth) among the people; may we, vigorous Agni, ever be undeserted byyou, but always be rejoicing and unmolested in the possession of riches; and do you, (gods), ever cherish uswith blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: दधिक्रां वः प्रथममश्विनोषसमग्निं समिद्धं भगमूतये हुवे । इन्द्रं विष्णुं पूषणं ब्रह्मणस्पतिमादित्यान्द्यावापृथिवी अपः स्वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dadhikrāṃ vaḥ prathamamaśvinoṣasamagniṃ samiddhaṃ bhagamūtaye huve | indraṃ viṣṇuṃ pūṣaṇaṃ brahmaṇaspatimādityāndyāvāpṛthivī apaḥ svaḥ ||

translations.english: For your preservation, (worshippers), I invoke, first, Dadhikrā, then the Aśvins, the Dawn, the kindledAgni, Bhaga, Indra, Viṣṇu, Pūṣan, Brahmaṇaspati, the Ādityas, heaven and earth, the waters, the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: दधिक्रामु नमसा बोधयन्त उदीराणा यज्ञमुपप्रयन्तः । इळां देवीं बर्हिषि सादयन्तोऽश्विना विप्रा सुहवा हुवेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: dadhikrāmu namasā bodhayanta udīrāṇā yajñamupaprayantaḥ | iḷāṃ devīṃ barhiṣi sādayanto'śvinā viprā suhavā huvema ||

translations.english: Arousing and animating Dadhikrā, proceeding diligently with the sacrifice; seating the divine Iḷā onthe sacred grass, let us invoke the intelligent and worthily-invoked Aśvins.

mantras.sanskrit: दधिक्रावाणं बुबुधानो अग्निमुप ब्रुव उषसं सूर्यं गाम् । ब्रध्नं माँश्चतोर्वरुणस्य बभ्रुं ते विश्वास्मद्दुरिता यावयन्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: dadhikrāvāṇaṃ bubudhāno agnimupa bruva uṣasaṃ sūryaṃ gām | bradhnaṃ mā~ścatorvaruṇasya babhruṃ te viśvāsmadduritā yāvayantu ||

translations.english: Propitiating Dadhikrāvan, I glorify Agni, Uṣas, the sun, the earth, the great brown horse of Varuṇa,who is mindful of his adorers; may they put far away from us iniquities.

mantras.sanskrit: दधिक्रावा प्रथमो वाज्यर्वाग्रे रथानां भवति प्रजानन् । संविदान उषसा सूर्येणादित्येभिर्वसुभिरङ्गिरोभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dadhikrāvā prathamo vājyarvāgre rathānāṃ bhavati prajānan | saṃvidāna uṣasā sūryeṇādityebhirvasubhiraṅgirobhiḥ ||

translations.english: Dadhikrāvan, the swift steed, the first (of horses), knowing (his office), is in the front of the chariots (ofthe gods), consentient with Uṣas, with Sūrya, wiḥ the Ādityas, with the Vasus, with the Aṅgirasas.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो दधिक्राः पथ्यामनक्त्वृतस्य पन्थामन्वेतवा उ । शृणोतु नो दैव्यं शर्धो अग्निः शृण्वन्तु विश्वे महिषा अमूराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no dadhikrāḥ pathyāmanaktvṛtasya panthāmanvetavā u | śṛṇotu no daivyaṃ śardho agniḥ śṛṇvantu viśve mahiṣā amūrāḥ ||

translations.english: May Dadhikrā sprinkle our path (with water), that we may follow the road of sacrifice; may Agni, thestrength of the gods, here our (invocation); may the mighty, unperplexed, universal deities hear it.

mantras.sanskrit: आ देवो यातु सविता सुरत्नोऽन्तरिक्षप्रा वहमानो अश्वैः । हस्ते दधानो नर्या पुरूणि निवेशयञ्च प्रसुवञ्च भूम ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā devo yātu savitā suratno'ntarikṣaprā vahamāno aśvaiḥ | haste dadhāno naryā purūṇi niveśayañca prasuvañca bhūma ||

translations.english: Borne by his steeds, may the divine Savitā, who is possessed of precious treasure, and filling thefirmament (with radiance), come hither, holding in his hands many things good for man, and (both) tranquilizingand animating living beings.

mantras.sanskrit: उदस्य बाहू शिथिरा बृहन्ता हिरण्यया दिवो अन्ताँ अनष्टाम् । नूनं सो अस्य महिमा पनिष्ट सूरश्चिदस्मा अनु दादपस्याम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: udasya bāhū śithirā bṛhantā hiraṇyayā divo antā~ anaṣṭām | nūnaṃ so asya mahimā paniṣṭa sūraścidasmā anu dādapasyām ||

translations.english: May the outspread, vast, and golden arms of Savitā extend to the ends of the sky; verily his greatnessis glorified (by us); may the sun impart energy unto him.

mantras.sanskrit: स घा नो देवः सविता सहावा साविषद्वसुपतिर्वसूनि । विश्रयमाणो अमतिमुरूचीं मर्तभोजनमध रासते नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa ghā no devaḥ savitā sahāvā sāviṣadvasupatirvasūni | viśrayamāṇo amatimurūcīṃ martabhojanamadha rāsate naḥ ||

translations.english: May the divine Savitā, who is endowed with energy, the lord of treasure, bestow treasures upon usconcentrating infinite lustre; may he bestow upon us wealh, the source of the enjoyment of mortals.

mantras.sanskrit: इमा गिरः सवितारं सुजिह्वं पूर्णगभस्तिमीळते सुपाणिम् । चित्रं वयो बृहदस्मे दधातु यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imā giraḥ savitāraṃ sujihvaṃ pūrṇagabhastimīḷate supāṇim | citraṃ vayo bṛhadasme dadhātu yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: These praises glorify the eloquent-tongued, dextrous-handed, whose hands are full (of wealth); may hebestow upon us manifold and abundant food; and do you, (gods), ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: इमा रुद्राय स्थिरधन्वने गिरः क्षिप्रेषवे देवाय स्वधाव्ने । अषाळ्हाय सहमानाय वेधसे तिग्मायुधाय भरता शृणोतु नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imā rudrāya sthiradhanvane giraḥ kṣipreṣave devāya svadhāvne | aṣāḷhāya sahamānāya vedhase tigmāyudhāya bharatā śṛṇotu naḥ ||

translations.english: Offer these praises to the divine Rudra, armed with the strong bow and fast-flying arrows, the bestowerof food, the invincible, the conqueror, the creator, the wielder of sharp weapons; may he hear our (praises).

mantras.sanskrit: स हि क्षयेण क्षम्यस्य जन्मनः साम्राज्येन दिव्यस्य चेतति । अवन्नवन्तीरुप नो दुरश्चरानमीवो रुद्र जासु नो भव ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa hi kṣayeṇa kṣamyasya janmanaḥ sāmrājyena divyasya cetati | avannavantīrupa no duraścarānamīvo rudra jāsu no bhava ||

translations.english: He is known by his rule over those of terrestrial birth, by his sovereignty over those of celestial (origin);protecting our progeny, Rudra, propitiating you (by praise), come to our dwellings, and be to them a guardianagainst disease.

mantras.sanskrit: या ते दिद्युदवसृष्टा दिवस्परि क्ष्मया चरति परि सा वृणक्तु नः । सहस्रं ते स्वपिवात भेषजा मा नस्तोकेषु तनयेषु रीरिषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā te didyudavasṛṣṭā divaspari kṣmayā carati pari sā vṛṇaktu naḥ | sahasraṃ te svapivāta bheṣajā mā nastokeṣu tanayeṣu rīriṣaḥ ||

translations.english: May your blazing (weapon), which, discharged from heaven, traverses the earth, avoid us; thine,appeaser of the wind, are a thousand medicaments; inflict not evil upon our sons and grandsons.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नो वधी रुद्र मा परा दा मा ते भूम प्रसितौ हीळितस्य । आ नो भज बर्हिषि जीवशंसे यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā no vadhī rudra mā parā dā mā te bhūma prasitau hīḷitasya | ā no bhaja barhiṣi jīvaśaṃse yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Harm us not, Rudra; abandon us not; let us not fall under the bondage of you when displeased; makeus partakers of the life-promotion sacrifice; and do you, (gods), ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: आपो यं वः प्रथमं देवयन्त इन्द्रपानमूर्मिमकृण्वतेळः । तं वो वयं शुचिमरिप्रमद्य घृतप्रुषं मधुमन्तं वनेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: āpo yaṃ vaḥ prathamaṃ devayanta indrapānamūrmimakṛṇvateḷaḥ | taṃ vo vayaṃ śucimaripramadya ghṛtapruṣaṃ madhumantaṃ vanema ||

translations.english: We solicit from you, Waters, today, that pure, faultless, rain- shedding, sweet essence of the earth,which devout have first consecrated as the Soma for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: तमूर्मिमापो मधुमत्तमं वोऽपां नपादवत्वाशुहेमा । यस्मिन्निन्द्रो वसुभिर्मादयाते तमश्याम देवयन्तो वो अद्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamūrmimāpo madhumattamaṃ vo'pāṃ napādavatvāśuhemā | yasminnindro vasubhirmādayāte tamaśyāma devayanto vo adya ||

translations.english: May the swift-moving grandson of the Waters protect, Waters, your most sweet essence, wherewiḥ mayIndra and the Vasus be delighted; and may we, devoted to the gods, partake (of it).

mantras.sanskrit: शतपवित्राः स्वधया मदन्तीर्देवीर्देवानामपि यन्ति पाथः । ता इन्द्रस्य न मिनन्ति व्रतानि सिन्धुभ्यो हव्यं घृतवज्जुहोत ॥
mantras.transliteration: śatapavitrāḥ svadhayā madantīrdevīrdevānāmapi yanti pāthaḥ | tā indrasya na minanti vratāni sindhubhyo havyaṃ ghṛtavajjuhota ||

translations.english: The divine Waters, the purifiers of many, gratifying men with food, pursue the paths of the gods; theyimpede not the sacred rites of Indra; offer, (priests), the butter-charged oblation to the rivers.

mantras.sanskrit: याः सूर्यो रश्मिभिराततान याभ्य इन्द्रो अरदद्गातुमूर्मिम् । ते सिन्धवो वरिवो धातना नो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yāḥ sūryo raśmibhirātatāna yābhya indro aradadgātumūrmim | te sindhavo varivo dhātanā no yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Waters, whom the sun has evaporized by his rays, for whom Indra has opened a path by which toissue, bestow upon us wealth; and do you (also) ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋभुक्षणो वाजा मादयध्वमस्मे नरो मघवानः सुतस्य । आ वोऽर्वाचः क्रतवो न यातां विभ्वो रथं नर्यं वर्तयन्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛbhukṣaṇo vājā mādayadhvamasme naro maghavānaḥ sutasya | ā vo'rvācaḥ kratavo na yātāṃ vibhvo rathaṃ naryaṃ vartayantu ||

translations.english: Ṛbhu, (Vibhu), and Vāja, leaders of rites, possessors of opulence, be exhilarated by our effused(libation); may your active and powerful (horses) bring to our presence your chariot, beneficial to mankiṇḍ

mantras.sanskrit: ऋभुॠभुभिरभि वः स्याम विभ्वो विभुभिः शवसा शवांसि । वाजो अस्माँ अवतु वाजसाताविन्द्रेण युजा तरुषेम वृत्रम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛbhuṝbhubhirabhi vaḥ syāma vibhvo vibhubhiḥ śavasā śavāṃsi | vājo asmā~ avatu vājasātāvindreṇa yujā taruṣema vṛtram ||

translations.english: Mighty with the Ṛbhus, opulent with the Vibhus, may we overcome by strength, the strength (of ourfoes); may Vāja defend us in battle; with Indra, our ally, may we destroy the enemy.

mantras.sanskrit: ते चिद्धि पूर्वीरभि सन्ति शासा विश्वाँ अर्य उपरताति वन्वन् । इन्द्रो विभ्वाँ ऋभुक्षा वाजो अर्यः शत्रोर्मिथत्या कृणवन्वि नृम्णम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: te ciddhi pūrvīrabhi santi śāsā viśvā~ arya uparatāti vanvan | indro vibhvā~ ṛbhukṣā vājo aryaḥ śatrormithatyā kṛṇavanvi nṛmṇam ||

translations.english: They verily, (Indra and Ṛbhus), overcome multitudes by their prowess; they overcome all enemies inthe missile conflict; may Indra, Vibhvan, Ṛbhukṣin and Vāja, the subduers of foes, annihilate by their wrath thestrength of the enemy.

mantras.sanskrit: नू देवासो वरिवः कर्तना नो भूत नो विश्वेऽवसे सजोषाः । समस्मे इषं वसवो ददीरन्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū devāso varivaḥ kartanā no bhūta no viśve'vase sajoṣāḥ | samasme iṣaṃ vasavo dadīranyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Grant us, deities, this day opulence; may you all, may you all, well- plural ased alike, be (ready) for ourprotection; may the exalted (Ṛbhus) bestow upon us food; and do you (all) ever cherish us with blessingṣ

mantras.sanskrit: समुद्रज्येष्ठाः सलिलस्य मध्यात्पुनाना यन्त्यनिविशमानाः । इन्द्रो या वज्री वृषभो रराद ता आपो देवीरिह मामवन्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: samudrajyeṣṭhāḥ salilasya madhyātpunānā yantyaniviśamānāḥ | indro yā vajrī vṛṣabho rarāda tā āpo devīriha māmavantu ||

translations.english: The waters, with their ocen-chief, proceed from the midst of the firmament, purifying (all things), flowingunceasingly; may the divine waters, whom the thunder-bearing Indra, the showerer, sent forth, protect me here(on earth).

mantras.sanskrit: या आपो दिव्या उत वा स्रवन्ति खनित्रिमा उत वा याः स्वयंजाः । समुद्रार्था याः शुचयः पावकास्ता आपो देवीरिह मामवन्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā āpo divyā uta vā sravanti khanitrimā uta vā yāḥ svayaṃjāḥ | samudrārthā yāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakāstā āpo devīriha māmavantu ||

translations.english: May the waters that are in the sky, or those that flow (on the earth), those (whose channels) have beendug, or those that have sprung up spontaneously, and those that seek the ocean. All pure and purifying, maythose divine waters protect me here (on earth).

mantras.sanskrit: यासां राजा वरुणो याति मध्ये सत्यानृते अवपश्यञ्जनानाम् । मधुश्चुतः शुचयो याः पावकास्ता आपो देवीरिह मामवन्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: yāsāṃ rājā varuṇo yāti madhye satyānṛte avapaśyañjanānām | madhuścutaḥ śucayo yāḥ pāvakāstā āpo devīriha māmavantu ||

translations.english: Those whose sovereign, Varuṇa, passes in the middle sphere, discriminating the truth and falsehod ofmankind; those shedding sweet showers, pure and purifying; may those divine waters protect me here (on earth).

mantras.sanskrit: यासु राजा वरुणो यासु सोमो विश्वे देवा यासूर्जं मदन्ति । वैश्वानरो यास्वग्निः प्रविष्टस्ता आपो देवीरिह मामवन्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: yāsu rājā varuṇo yāsu somo viśve devā yāsūrjaṃ madanti | vaiśvānaro yāsvagniḥ praviṣṭastā āpo devīriha māmavantu ||

translations.english: May they in which their king, Varuṇa, in which Soma, abides, in which the gods delight (to receive) thesacrificial food, into which Agni Vaiśvānara entered, may those diine waters protect me here (on earth).

mantras.sanskrit: आ मां मित्रावरुणेह रक्षतं कुलाययद्विश्वयन्मा न आ गन् । अजकावं दुर्दृशीकं तिरो दधे मा मां पद्येन रपसा विदत्त्सरुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā māṃ mitrāvaruṇeha rakṣataṃ kulāyayadviśvayanmā na ā gan | ajakāvaṃ durdṛśīkaṃ tiro dadhe mā māṃ padyena rapasā vidattsaruḥ ||

translations.english: Mitra and Varuṇa, protect me here (in this world) let not the insidious and spreading (poison) reach me;may the equally malignant and undiscernible (venom) disappear; let not the tortuous (snake) recognize me by thesound of my footsteps.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्विजामन्परुषि वन्दनं भुवदष्ठीवन्तौ परि कुल्फौ च देहत् । अग्निष्टच्छोचन्नप बाधतामितो मा मां पद्येन रपसा विदत्त्सरुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadvijāmanparuṣi vandanaṃ bhuvadaṣṭhīvantau pari kulphau ca dehat | agniṣṭacchocannapa bādhatāmito mā māṃ padyena rapasā vidattsaruḥ ||

translations.english: May the brilliant Agni counteract that poison which is genitive rated in the manifold knots (of trees) and thelike, or which is smeared upon the knees of ankles; let not the tortuous snake recognize me by the sound of myfootsteps.

mantras.sanskrit: यच्छल्मलौ भवति यन्नदीषु यदोषधीभ्यः परि जायते विषम् । विश्वे देवा निरितस्तत्सुवन्तु मा मां पद्येन रपसा विदत्त्सरुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yacchalmalau bhavati yannadīṣu yadoṣadhībhyaḥ pari jāyate viṣam | viśve devā niritastatsuvantu mā māṃ padyena rapasā vidattsaruḥ ||

translations.english: The poison that is in the Śalmalī tree, in the rivers, or which is genitive rated from plural nts, may theuniversal gods remove from hence; let not the tortuous (snake) recognize me by the sound of my footsteps.

mantras.sanskrit: याः प्रवतो निवत उद्वत उदन्वतीरनुदकाश्च याः । ता अस्मभ्यं पयसा पिन्वमानाः शिवा देवीरशिपदा भवन्तु सर्वा नद्यो अशिमिदा भवन्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: yāḥ pravato nivata udvata udanvatīranudakāśca yāḥ | tā asmabhyaṃ payasā pinvamānāḥ śivā devīraśipadā bhavantu sarvā nadyo aśimidā bhavantu ||

translations.english: May the divine rivers, whether flowing down declivities, in hollow plural ces, or upwards, whether filled withwater or dry, nourishing all with their water, be auspicious to us communicating not disease; may all the rivers beunproductive of harm.

mantras.sanskrit: आदित्यानामवसा नूतनेन सक्षीमहि शर्मणा शंतमेन । अनागास्त्वे अदितित्वे तुरास इमं यज्ञं दधतु श्रोषमाणाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ādityānāmavasā nūtanena sakṣīmahi śarmaṇā śaṃtamena | anāgāstve adititve turāsa imaṃ yajñaṃ dadhatu śroṣamāṇāḥ ||

translations.english: May we, through the protection of the Ādityas, be in the enjoyment of a new and comfortable dwelling;may the swift-moving Ādityas, listening to our praises, preserve this their worshipper in sinlessness andindependence.

mantras.sanskrit: आदित्यासो अदितिर्मादयन्तां मित्रो अर्यमा वरुणो रजिष्ठाः । अस्माकं सन्तु भुवनस्य गोपाः पिबन्तु सोममवसे नो अद्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: ādityāso aditirmādayantāṃ mitro aryamā varuṇo rajiṣṭhāḥ | asmākaṃ santu bhuvanasya gopāḥ pibantu somamavase no adya ||

translations.english: May the Ādityas and Aditi, and the upright Mitra, Āryaman, and Varuṇa, be exhilarated (by thelibation); may the guardians of the world be ours also; may they drink the Soma today for our preservation.

mantras.sanskrit: आदित्या विश्वे मरुतश्च विश्वे देवाश्च विश्व ऋभवश्च विश्वे । इन्द्रो अग्निरश्विना तुष्टुवाना यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ādityā viśve marutaśca viśve devāśca viśva ṛbhavaśca viśve | indro agniraśvinā tuṣṭuvānā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: All the Ādityas, all the Maruts, all the gods, all the Ṛbhus, Indra, Agni, and the Aśvins, (have been)glorified (by us), do you all ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: आदित्यासो अदितयः स्याम पूर्देवत्रा वसवो मर्त्यत्रा । सनेम मित्रावरुणा सनन्तो भवेम द्यावापृथिवी भवन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ādityāso aditayaḥ syāma pūrdevatrā vasavo martyatrā | sanema mitrāvaruṇā sananto bhavema dyāvāpṛthivī bhavantaḥ ||

translations.english: Ādityas, may we be independent; Vasus, (dwelling) among the gods, may your protection (extend) tomortals; offering (oblations to you), Mitra and Varuṇa, may we partake (of your bounty); may we, heaven andearth exist (through your favour).

mantras.sanskrit: मित्रस्तन्नो वरुणो मामहन्त शर्म तोकाय तनयाय गोपाः । मा वो भुजेमान्यजातमेनो मा तत्कर्म वसवो यच्चयध्वे ॥
mantras.transliteration: mitrastanno varuṇo māmahanta śarma tokāya tanayāya gopāḥ | mā vo bhujemānyajātameno mā tatkarma vasavo yaccayadhve ||

translations.english: May Mitra and Varuṇa bestow upon us felicity; (may they), the guardians (of all men, bestow felicity)upon our sons and grandsons; let us not suffer (gods), for offences committed by another; let us not, Vasus, doany act by which you may be offended.

mantras.sanskrit: तुरण्यवोऽङ्गिरसो नक्षन्त रत्नं देवस्य सवितुरियानाः । पिता च तन्नो महान्यजत्रो विश्वे देवाः समनसो जुषन्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: turaṇyavo'ṅgiraso nakṣanta ratnaṃ devasya savituriyānāḥ | pitā ca tanno mahānyajatro viśve devāḥ samanaso juṣanta ||

translations.english: The Aṅgirasas, prompt (in worship), soliciting him obtain preious (wealth) from Savitā; may the mightyadorable parent, and the universal god alike favourable minded, approve (of the donation).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र द्यावा यज्ञैः पृथिवी नमोभिः सबाध ईळे बृहती यजत्रे । ते चिद्धि पूर्वे कवयो गृणन्तः पुरो मही दधिरे देवपुत्रे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra dyāvā yajñaiḥ pṛthivī namobhiḥ sabādha īḷe bṛhatī yajatre | te ciddhi pūrve kavayo gṛṇantaḥ puro mahī dadhire devaputre ||

translations.english: Attended by a concourse (of priests) I worship the adorable and mighty Heaven and Earth withsacrifices and praises, those wo great ones of whom the gods are the sons, whom ancient sages glorifying haveformerly detained.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र पूर्वजे पितरा नव्यसीभिर्गीर्भिः कृणुध्वं सदने ऋतस्य । आ नो द्यावापृथिवी दैव्येन जनेन यातं महि वां वरूथम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra pūrvaje pitarā navyasībhirgīrbhiḥ kṛṇudhvaṃ sadane ṛtasya | ā no dyāvāpṛthivī daivyena janena yātaṃ mahi vāṃ varūtham ||

translations.english: plural ce before (us) in the hall of sacrifice, with new songs, the ancient parents (of all beings); come to us,Heaven and Earth, with the celestial people, for vast is your protecting (wealth).

mantras.sanskrit: उतो हि वां रत्नधेयानि सन्ति पुरूणि द्यावापृथिवी सुदासे । अस्मे धत्तं यदसदस्कृधोयु यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uto hi vāṃ ratnadheyāni santi purūṇi dyāvāpṛthivī sudāse | asme dhattaṃ yadasadaskṛdhoyu yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Many, Heavan and Earth, are the treasures fit to be given to the pious donor (of the oblation); give to usthat wealth which is unlimited; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: वास्तोष्पते प्रति जानीह्यस्मान्त्स्वावेशो अनमीवो भवा नः । यत्त्वेमहे प्रति तन्नो जुषस्व शं नो भव द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāstoṣpate prati jānīhyasmāntsvāveśo anamīvo bhavā naḥ | yattvemahe prati tanno juṣasva śaṃ no bhava dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade ||

translations.english: Protector of the dwelling, recognize us; be to us an excellent abode the non-inflicter of disease;whatever we ask of you, be plural ased to grant; be the bestower of happiness on our bipeds and quadrupedṣ

mantras.sanskrit: वास्तोष्पते प्रतरणो न एधि गयस्फानो गोभिरश्वेभिरिन्दो । अजरासस्ते सख्ये स्याम पितेव पुत्रान्प्रति नो जुषस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāstoṣpate prataraṇo na edhi gayasphāno gobhiraśvebhirindo | ajarāsaste sakhye syāma piteva putrānprati no juṣasva ||

translations.english: Protector of the dwelling, be our preserver and the augmenter of our wealth; possessed of catle andhorses, Indra, may we, through your friendship, be exempt from decay; be favourable to us, like a father to hissons.

mantras.sanskrit: वास्तोष्पते शग्मया संसदा ते सक्षीमहि रण्वया गातुमत्या । पाहि क्षेम उत योगे वरं नो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāstoṣpate śagmayā saṃsadā te sakṣīmahi raṇvayā gātumatyā | pāhi kṣema uta yoge varaṃ no yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Protector of the dwelling, may we be possessed of a comfortable, delightful, opulent abode, bestowedby you; protect our wealth, whether in possession or expectaion; and do you, (gods), ever cherish us withblessings.

mantras.sanskrit: अमीवहा वास्तोष्पते विश्वा रूपाण्याविशन् । सखा सुशेव एधि नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: amīvahā vāstoṣpate viśvā rūpāṇyāviśan | sakhā suśeva edhi naḥ ||

translations.english: Protector of the dwelling, remover of disease, assuming all (kinds of) forms, be to us a friend, thegranter of happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: यदर्जुन सारमेय दतः पिशङ्ग यच्छसे । वीव भ्राजन्त ऋष्टय उप स्रक्वेषु बप्सतो नि षु स्वप ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadarjuna sārameya dataḥ piśaṅga yacchase | vīva bhrājanta ṛṣṭaya upa srakveṣu bapsato ni ṣu svapa ||

translations.english: White offspring of Saramā, with tawny limbs, althogh barking you display your teeth against me,bristling like lances in your gums, nevertheless, to quietly to sleep.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तेनं राय सारमेय तस्करं वा पुनःसर । स्तोतॄनिन्द्रस्य रायसि किमस्मान्दुच्छुनायसे नि षु स्वप ॥
mantras.transliteration: stenaṃ rāya sārameya taskaraṃ vā punaḥsara | stotṝnindrasya rāyasi kimasmānducchunāyase ni ṣu svapa ||

translations.english: Offspring of Saramā, returning (to the charge), attack the pilferer or the thief; why do you assail theworshippers of Indra? Why do you intimidate us? Go quietly to sleep.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं सूकरस्य दर्दृहि तव दर्दर्तु सूकरः । स्तोतॄनिन्द्रस्य रायसि किमस्मान्दुच्छुनायसे नि षु स्वप ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ sūkarasya dardṛhi tava dardartu sūkaraḥ | stotṝnindrasya rāyasi kimasmānducchunāyase ni ṣu svapa ||

translations.english: Do you rend the hog; let the hog rend you; why do you assail the worshippers of Indra? Why do youintimidate us? Go quietly to sleep.

mantras.sanskrit: सस्तु माता सस्तु पिता सस्तु श्वा सस्तु विश्पतिः । ससन्तु सर्वे ज्ञातयः सस्त्वयमभितो जनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sastu mātā sastu pitā sastu śvā sastu viśpatiḥ | sasantu sarve jñātayaḥ sastvayamabhito janaḥ ||

translations.english: Let the mother sleep let the father sleep, let the dog sleep, let the son-in-law sleep, let all the kindredsleep, let the people (who are stationed) around sleep.

mantras.sanskrit: य आस्ते यश्च चरति यश्च पश्यति नो जनः । तेषां सं हन्मो अक्षाणि यथेदं हर्म्यं तथा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya āste yaśca carati yaśca paśyati no janaḥ | teṣāṃ saṃ hanmo akṣāṇi yathedaṃ harmyaṃ tathā ||

translations.english: The man who sits, or he who walks, or he who sees us, of these we shut up the eyes, so that they maybe as unconscious as the mansion.

mantras.sanskrit: सहस्रशृङ्गो वृषभो यः समुद्रादुदाचरत् । तेना सहस्येना वयं नि जनान्त्स्वापयामसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: sahasraśṛṅgo vṛṣabho yaḥ samudrādudācarat | tenā sahasyenā vayaṃ ni janāntsvāpayāmasi ||

translations.english: We put men to sleep through the irresisible might or the bull with a thousand horns, who rises out of theocean.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रोष्ठेशया वह्येशया नारीर्यास्तल्पशीवरीः । स्त्रियो याः पुण्यगन्धास्ताः सर्वाः स्वापयामसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: proṣṭheśayā vahyeśayā nārīryāstalpaśīvarīḥ | striyo yāḥ puṇyagandhāstāḥ sarvāḥ svāpayāmasi ||

translations.english: We put to sleep all those women are lying in the courtyard in litter on the bed, the wom who aredecorated with holiday perfumes.

mantras.sanskrit: क ईं व्यक्ता नरः सनीळा रुद्रस्य मर्या अध स्वश्वाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ka īṃ vyaktā naraḥ sanīḷā rudrasya maryā adha svaśvāḥ ||

translations.english: Who are these resplendent chiefs, the dwellers in one abode, the sons of Rudra, friends of man, atpresent well-mounted?

mantras.sanskrit: नकिर्ह्येषां जनूंषि वेद ते अङ्ग विद्रे मिथो जनित्रम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nakirhyeṣāṃ janūṃṣi veda te aṅga vidre mitho janitram ||

translations.english: No one indeed knows their origin, they alone respectively know their birth.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि स्वपूभिर्मिथो वपन्त वातस्वनसः श्येना अस्पृध्रन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi svapūbhirmitho vapanta vātasvanasaḥ śyenā aspṛdhran ||

translations.english: They go together by their own pure paths; roaring like the wind, and fleet as falcons, they mutually rivaleach other.

mantras.sanskrit: एतानि धीरो निण्या चिकेत पृश्निर्यदूधो मही जभार ॥
mantras.transliteration: etāni dhīro niṇyā ciketa pṛśniryadūdho mahī jabhāra ||

translations.english: The sage may know those white-complexioned beings (the Maruts), whom the vast Pṛṣṇi born at herudder.

mantras.sanskrit: सा विट् सुवीरा मरुद्भिरस्तु सनात्सहन्ती पुष्यन्ती नृम्णम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sā viṭ suvīrā marudbhirastu sanātsahantī puṣyantī nṛmṇam ||

translations.english: May the people, through (the favours of) the Maruts, always victorious, possessed of male posterity,and in the enjoyment of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: यामं येष्ठाः शुभा शोभिष्ठाः श्रिया सम्मिश्ला ओजोभिरुग्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yāmaṃ yeṣṭhāḥ śubhā śobhiṣṭhāḥ śriyā sammiślā ojobhirugrāḥ ||

translations.english: The Maruts rapidly repair to the plural ce (of their destination), richly decorated with ornaments, investedwith beauty, terrible by their strength.

mantras.sanskrit: उग्रं व ओजः स्थिरा शवांस्यधा मरुद्भिर्गणस्तुविष्मान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ugraṃ va ojaḥ sthirā śavāṃsyadhā marudbhirgaṇastuviṣmān ||

translations.english: Terrible be your strength, steadfast your energies, prosperous be the company of the Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: शुभ्रो वः शुष्मः क्रुध्मी मनांसि धुनिर्मुनिरिव शर्धस्य धृष्णोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śubhro vaḥ śuṣmaḥ krudhmī manāṃsi dhunirmuniriva śardhasya dhṛṣṇoḥ ||

translations.english: Glorious is your vigour, unrelenting are your minds; (the exertion) of your irresistible force, the agitator(of the trees), is like (the manifold tone of the prayers of) a muni.

mantras.sanskrit: सनेम्यस्मद्युयोत दिद्युं मा वो दुर्मतिरिह प्रणङ्नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sanemyasmadyuyota didyuṃ mā vo durmatiriha praṇaṅnaḥ ||

translations.english: Withhold from us your ancient blazing (weapon) let not your displeasure light upon us at this sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रिया वो नाम हुवे तुराणामा यत्तृपन्मरुतो वावशानाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: priyā vo nāma huve turāṇāmā yattṛpanmaruto vāvaśānāḥ ||

translations.english: I invoke your beloved names, Maruts, destroyers (of foes), that they who are desirous of the offeringmay be satisfied.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वायुधास इष्मिणः सुनिष्का उत स्वयं तन्वः शुम्भमानाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: svāyudhāsa iṣmiṇaḥ suniṣkā uta svayaṃ tanvaḥ śumbhamānāḥ ||

translations.english: Bearers are (the Maruts) of bright weapons, rapid are they in motion, wearers of brilliant ornaments,and self-radiators of their person ns.

mantras.sanskrit: शुची वो हव्या मरुतः शुचीनां शुचिं हिनोम्यध्वरं शुचिभ्यः । ऋतेन सत्यमृतसाप आयञ्छुचिजन्मानः शुचयः पावकाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śucī vo havyā marutaḥ śucīnāṃ śuciṃ hinomyadhvaraṃ śucibhyaḥ | ṛtena satyamṛtasāpa āyañchucijanmānaḥ śucayaḥ pāvakāḥ ||

translations.english: Pure oblations be offered, Maruts, to you who are pure; the shedders of water proceed by truth to truth,pure, purifying, of pure birth.

mantras.sanskrit: अंसेष्वा मरुतः खादयो वो वक्षस्सु रुक्मा उपशिश्रियाणाः । वि विद्युतो न वृष्टिभी रुचाना अनु स्वधामायुधैर्यच्छमानाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aṃseṣvā marutaḥ khādayo vo vakṣassu rukmā upaśiśriyāṇāḥ | vi vidyuto na vṛṣṭibhī rucānā anu svadhāmāyudhairyacchamānāḥ ||

translations.english: Bright ornaments, Maruts, are on your shoulders, shining (necklaces) are pendant on your breasts,glittering with rain, like lightnings, you are distributing the waters with your weapons.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र बुध्न्या व ईरते महांसि प्र नामानि प्रयज्यवस्तिरध्वम् । सहस्रियं दम्यं भागमेतं गृहमेधीयं मरुतो जुषध्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra budhnyā va īrate mahāṃsi pra nāmāni prayajyavastiradhvam | sahasriyaṃ damyaṃ bhāgametaṃ gṛhamedhīyaṃ maruto juṣadhvam ||

translations.english: Your celestial splendours, Maruts, spread wide; objects of worship, you send down (the waters) thatbeat down (the dust); accept Maruts, this your portion of the domestic worship of the household multiplied athousand-fold.

mantras.sanskrit: यदि स्तुतस्य मरुतो अधीथेत्था विप्रस्य वाजिनो हवीमन् । मक्षू रायः सुवीर्यस्य दात नू चिद्यमन्य आदभदरावा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadi stutasya maruto adhīthetthā viprasya vājino havīman | makṣū rāyaḥ suvīryasya dāta nū cidyamanya ādabhadarāvā ||

translations.english: If, Maruts, you justly appreciate the praise of the devout offerer of (sacrificial) food, conjoined withoblations, then promptly bestow (upon us) riches, comprehending excellent male posterity, such as no unfriendlyman can take away.

mantras.sanskrit: अत्यासो न ये मरुतः स्वञ्चो यक्षदृशो न शुभयन्त मर्याः । ते हर्म्येष्ठाः शिशवो न शुभ्रा वत्सासो न प्रक्रीळिनः पयोधाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: atyāso na ye marutaḥ svañco yakṣadṛśo na śubhayanta maryāḥ | te harmyeṣṭhāḥ śiśavo na śubhrā vatsāso na prakrīḷinaḥ payodhāḥ ||

translations.english: The swift-moving Maruts are like rapid horses, shining like men gazing at a festival innocent as childrenin the (paternal) mansion, frolicsome as calves, they are the dispensers of water.

mantras.sanskrit: दशस्यन्तो नो मरुतो मृळन्तु वरिवस्यन्तो रोदसी सुमेके । आरे गोहा नृहा वधो वो अस्तु सुम्नेभिरस्मे वसवो नमध्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: daśasyanto no maruto mṛḷantu varivasyanto rodasī sumeke | āre gohā nṛhā vadho vo astu sumnebhirasme vasavo namadhvam ||

translations.english: May the munificent Maruts, filling the beautiful heaven and earth with their glory, make us happy; yourfatal weapon, the render of clouds, the destroyer of men, be far from us; bend down to us, Vasus, with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वो होता जोहवीति सत्तः सत्राचीं रातिं मरुतो गृणानः । य ईवतो वृषणो अस्ति गोपाः सो अद्वयावी हवते व उक्थैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vo hotā johavīti sattaḥ satrācīṃ rātiṃ maruto gṛṇānaḥ | ya īvato vṛṣaṇo asti gopāḥ so advayāvī havate va ukthaiḥ ||

translations.english: Praising your universal liberality, Maruts, the ministrant priest repeatedly worships you, seated (in thesacrificial chamber); he, showerers (of benefits), who is the guardian of the zealous (worshipper), he (the priest),who is void of insincerity, glorifies you with hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: इमे तुरं मरुतो रामयन्तीमे सहः सहस आ नमन्ति । इमे शंसं वनुष्यतो नि पान्ति गुरु द्वेषो अररुषे दधन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ime turaṃ maruto rāmayantīme sahaḥ sahasa ā namanti | ime śaṃsaṃ vanuṣyato ni pānti guru dveṣo araruṣe dadhanti ||

translations.english: These, Maruts, give plural asure to the zealous (worshipper); these humble the strength of the strong man;they entertain severe displeasure towards the withholder of offerings.

mantras.sanskrit: इमे रध्रं चिन्मरुतो जुनन्ति भृमिं चिद्यथा वसवो जुषन्त । अप बाधध्वं वृषणस्तमांसि धत्त विश्वं तनयं तोकमस्मे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ime radhraṃ cinmaruto junanti bhṛmiṃ cidyathā vasavo juṣanta | apa bādhadhvaṃ vṛṣaṇastamāṃsi dhatta viśvaṃ tanayaṃ tokamasme ||

translations.english: These, Maruts, encourage the prosperous man; they encourage the (poor) wanderer; they, as Vasus,are plural ased (with you); showerers (of benefits), dissipate the darkness; grant us many sons and grandsons.

mantras.sanskrit: मा वो दात्रान्मरुतो निरराम मा पश्चाद्दघ्म रथ्यो विभागे । आ नः स्पार्हे भजतना वसव्ये यदीं सुजातं वृषणो वो अस्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā vo dātrānmaruto nirarāma mā paścāddaghma rathyo vibhāge | ā naḥ spārhe bhajatanā vasavye yadīṃ sujātaṃ vṛṣaṇo vo asti ||

translations.english: Never, Maruts, may we be excluded from your bounty; let us not, lords of chariots, be last in itsapportionment; make us sharers in that desirable opulence which, showerers (of benefit), is born of you.

mantras.sanskrit: सं यद्धनन्त मन्युभिर्जनासः शूरा यह्वीष्वोषधीषु विक्षु । अध स्मा नो मरुतो रुद्रियासस्त्रातारो भूत पृतनास्वर्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ yaddhananta manyubhirjanāsaḥ śūrā yahvīṣvoṣadhīṣu vikṣu | adha smā no maruto rudriyāsastrātāro bhūta pṛtanāsvaryaḥ ||

translations.english: When heroic men, filled with wrath, assemble for (the sake of conquering) many plural nts and people;then, Maruts, sons of Rudra, be our defenders in battles against our enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: भूरि चक्र मरुतः पित्र्याण्युक्थानि या वः शस्यन्ते पुरा चित् । मरुद्भिरुग्रः पृतनासु साळ्हा मरुद्भिरित्सनिता वाजमर्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhūri cakra marutaḥ pitryāṇyukthāni yā vaḥ śasyante purā cit | marudbhirugraḥ pṛtanāsu sāḷhā marudbhiritsanitā vājamarvā ||

translations.english: You have bestowed, Maruts, many (benefits) on our forefathers, which praiseworthy (benefits) havebeen celebrated in former times; by the (favour of the) Maruts the fierce (warrior) is victorious in combats; by the(favour of the) Maruts the worshipper ever obtains food.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मे वीरो मरुतः शुष्म्यस्तु जनानां यो असुरो विधर्ता । अपो येन सुक्षितये तरेमाध स्वमोको अभि वः स्याम ॥
mantras.transliteration: asme vīro marutaḥ śuṣmyastu janānāṃ yo asuro vidhartā | apo yena sukṣitaye taremādha svamoko abhi vaḥ syāma ||

translations.english: May our male progeny, Maruts, be vigorous, one who is intelligent, the scatterer of (hostile) men, bywhom we may cross the water (of enmity) to a secure dwelling; may we, your (servants), dwell in our own abode.

mantras.sanskrit: तन्न इन्द्रो वरुणो मित्रो अग्निराप ओषधीर्वनिनो जुषन्त । शर्मन्त्स्याम मरुतामुपस्थे यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tanna indro varuṇo mitro agnirāpa oṣadhīrvanino juṣanta | śarmantsyāma marutāmupasthe yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: May Indra, Varuṇa, Mitra, Agni, the waters, the plural nts, the trees, be plural ased with us; may we recline inhappiness upon the lap of the Maruts; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: मध्वो वो नाम मारुतं यजत्राः प्र यज्ञेषु शवसा मदन्ति । ये रेजयन्ति रोदसी चिदुर्वी पिन्वन्त्युत्सं यदयासुरुग्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: madhvo vo nāma mārutaṃ yajatrāḥ pra yajñeṣu śavasā madanti | ye rejayanti rodasī cidurvī pinvantyutsaṃ yadayāsurugrāḥ ||

translations.english: Adorable (Maruts), the worshippers vigorously celebrate at sacrifices your appellation of company ofthe Maruts, they who cause the spacious heaven and earth to tremble, the clouds to rain, the move everywhereterrible.

mantras.sanskrit: निचेतारो हि मरुतो गृणन्तं प्रणेतारो यजमानस्य मन्म । अस्माकमद्य विदथेषु बर्हिरा वीतये सदत पिप्रियाणाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nicetāro hi maruto gṛṇantaṃ praṇetāro yajamānasya manma | asmākamadya vidatheṣu barhirā vītaye sadata pipriyāṇāḥ ||

translations.english: The Maruts verily are the benefactors of him who praises them, the gratifiers of the wishes of theinstitutor of the solemnity; do you, being plural ased, sit down today upon the grass at our ceremony, to partake (ofthe sacrificial food).

mantras.sanskrit: नैतावदन्ये मरुतो यथेमे भ्राजन्ते रुक्मैरायुधैस्तनूभिः । आ रोदसी विश्वपिशः पिशानाः समानमञ्ज्यञ्जते शुभे कम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: naitāvadanye maruto yatheme bhrājante rukmairāyudhaistanūbhiḥ | ā rodasī viśvapiśaḥ piśānāḥ samānamañjyañjate śubhe kam ||

translations.english: No other (deities give) such (good things) as the Maruts, as they shine with brilliant (ornaments),weapons and person ns; illumining heaven and earth, wide-radiating, they heighten their common lustre for (our)good.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋधक्सा वो मरुतो दिद्युदस्तु यद्व आगः पुरुषता कराम । मा वस्तस्यामपि भूमा यजत्रा अस्मे वो अस्तु सुमतिश्चनिष्ठा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛdhaksā vo maruto didyudastu yadva āgaḥ puruṣatā karāma | mā vastasyāmapi bhūmā yajatrā asme vo astu sumatiścaniṣṭhā ||

translations.english: May that blazing (weapon) of your, Maruts, be far from us, although, through human infirmities, we offeryou offence; let us not, adorable Maruts, be exposed to your (shaft); may your favour the source of abundance,ever be shown to us.

mantras.sanskrit: कृते चिदत्र मरुतो रणन्तानवद्यासः शुचयः पावकाः । प्र णोऽवत सुमतिभिर्यजत्राः प्र वाजेभिस्तिरत पुष्यसे नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kṛte cidatra maruto raṇantānavadyāsaḥ śucayaḥ pāvakāḥ | pra ṇo'vata sumatibhiryajatrāḥ pra vājebhistirata puṣyase naḥ ||

translations.english: May the Maruts, who are irreproachable, pure, and purifying, delight in this our ceremony; protect us,adorable Maruts, with favourable thoughts; be ever anxious to sustain us with food.

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्तुतासो मरुतो व्यन्तु विश्वेभिर्नामभिर्नरो हवींषि । ददात नो अमृतस्य प्रजायै जिगृत रायः सूनृता मघानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta stutāso maruto vyantu viśvebhirnāmabhirnaro havīṃṣi | dadāta no amṛtasya prajāyai jigṛta rāyaḥ sūnṛtā maghāni ||

translations.english: May the glorified Maruts partake of the oblations, they who, accompanied by the bending waters, arethe leaders of rites; bestow water, Maruts, upon our progeny, return suitable opulence for (the donation ofsacrificial) riches.

mantras.sanskrit: आ स्तुतासो मरुतो विश्व ऊती अच्छा सूरीन्त्सर्वताता जिगात । ये नस्त्मना शतिनो वर्धयन्ति यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā stutāso maruto viśva ūtī acchā sūrīntsarvatātā jigāta | ye nastmanā śatino vardhayanti yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Glorified Maruts, do you all come at the time of sacrifice to the presence of the worshippers along withyour protections, for you are they who, of your own will, multiply our hundreds; do you ever cherish us withblessings.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र साकमुक्षे अर्चता गणाय यो दैव्यस्य धाम्नस्तुविष्मान् । उत क्षोदन्ति रोदसी महित्वा नक्षन्ते नाकं निॠतेरवंशात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra sākamukṣe arcatā gaṇāya yo daivyasya dhāmnastuviṣmān | uta kṣodanti rodasī mahitvā nakṣante nākaṃ niṝteravaṃśāt ||

translations.english: Offer worship to the company (of the Maruts), the associated dispensers of moisture, which is powerfulover the celestial region; the Maruts, by their greatness, oppress both heaven and earth; they spread from theearth and the firmament to heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: जनूश्चिद्वो मरुतस्त्वेष्येण भीमासस्तुविमन्यवोऽयासः । प्र ये महोभिरोजसोत सन्ति विश्वो वो यामन्भयते स्वर्दृक् ॥
mantras.transliteration: janūścidvo marutastveṣyeṇa bhīmāsastuvimanyavo'yāsaḥ | pra ye mahobhirojasota santi viśvo vo yāmanbhayate svardṛk ||

translations.english: Formidable, high-spirited, quick-moving Maruts, your birth is from the illustrious Rudra; every gazer onthe sun is alarmed with the course of you who are pre-eminent in lustre and strength.

mantras.sanskrit: बृहद्वयो मघवद्भ्यो दधात जुजोषन्निन्मरुतः सुष्टुतिं नः । गतो नाध्वा वि तिराति जन्तुं प्र णः स्पार्हाभिरूतिभिस्तिरेत ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhadvayo maghavadbhyo dadhāta jujoṣanninmarutaḥ suṣṭutiṃ naḥ | gato nādhvā vi tirāti jantuṃ pra ṇaḥ spārhābhirūtibhistireta ||

translations.english: Grant, Maruts, to us who are affluent (in sacrificial offering) abundant food; accept complacently ourearnest praise; the path you follow is not hurtful to living beings; may it increase our (prosperity) by (your)desirable protections.

mantras.sanskrit: युष्मोतो विप्रो मरुतः शतस्वी युष्मोतो अर्वा सहुरिः सहस्री । युष्मोतः सम्राळुत हन्ति वृत्रं प्र तद्वो अस्तु धूतयो देष्णम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuṣmoto vipro marutaḥ śatasvī yuṣmoto arvā sahuriḥ sahasrī | yuṣmotaḥ samrāḷuta hanti vṛtraṃ pra tadvo astu dhūtayo deṣṇam ||

translations.english: The pious man protected, Maruts, by you, is the possessor of hundreds; the assailant, overcomer (ofhis foes), protected by you, is the possessor of thousands; protected by you, the emperor slays his enemy; maythe wealth that is given, agitators, by you ever be abundant.

mantras.sanskrit: ताँ आ रुद्रस्य मीळ्हुषो विवासे कुविन्नंसन्ते मरुतः पुनर्नः । यत्सस्वर्ता जिहीळिरे यदाविरव तदेन ईमहे तुराणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā~ ā rudrasya mīḷhuṣo vivāse kuvinnaṃsante marutaḥ punarnaḥ | yatsasvartā jihīḷire yadāvirava tadena īmahe turāṇām ||

translations.english: I adore those sons of the showerer, Rudra; may the Maruts, repeatedly invoked, again come to us; maywe expiate (by praise) whatever we have committed secretly or openly against the swift-moving Maruts, by whichthey are displeased.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सा वाचि सुष्टुतिर्मघोनामिदं सूक्तं मरुतो जुषन्त । आराच्चिद्द्वेषो वृषणो युयोत यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra sā vāci suṣṭutirmaghonāmidaṃ sūktaṃ maruto juṣanta | ārācciddveṣo vṛṣaṇo yuyota yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: The pious praise of the opulent Maruts has been recited; may the Maruts be gratified by this hymn;remove far from us, showerers (of benefits), those who hate us; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: यं त्रायध्व इदमिदं देवासो यं च नयथ । तस्मा अग्ने वरुण मित्रार्यमन्मरुतः शर्म यच्छत ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ trāyadhva idamidaṃ devāso yaṃ ca nayatha | tasmā agne varuṇa mitrāryamanmarutaḥ śarma yacchata ||

translations.english: Agni, Varuṇa, Mitra, Maruts, grant happiness, gods, to him whom you preserve from (the perils of) this(world), whom you guide here (to the paths of virtue).

mantras.sanskrit: युष्माकं देवा अवसाहनि प्रिय ईजानस्तरति द्विषः । प्र स क्षयं तिरते वि महीरिषो यो वो वराय दाशति ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuṣmākaṃ devā avasāhani priya ījānastarati dviṣaḥ | pra sa kṣayaṃ tirate vi mahīriṣo yo vo varāya dāśati ||

translations.english: Through your protection, gods, the man who worships on an auspicious day overcomes hisadversaries; he who offers abundant (sacrificial) food to you to detain you (at his rite) enlarges his habitation.

mantras.sanskrit: नहि वश्चरमं चन वसिष्ठः परिमंसते । अस्माकमद्य मरुतः सुते सचा विश्वे पिबत कामिनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahi vaścaramaṃ cana vasiṣṭhaḥ parimaṃsate | asmākamadya marutaḥ sute sacā viśve pibata kāminaḥ ||

translations.english: Vasiṣṭha overlooks not the very lowest among you; Maruts, who are desirous (of the libation), do youall drink together today of our effused Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: नहि व ऊतिः पृतनासु मर्धति यस्मा अराध्वं नरः । अभि व आवर्त्सुमतिर्नवीयसी तूयं यात पिपीषवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahi va ūtiḥ pṛtanāsu mardhati yasmā arādhvaṃ naraḥ | abhi va āvartsumatirnavīyasī tūyaṃ yāta pipīṣavaḥ ||

translations.english: Your protection, leaders (of rites), yields no detriment to him whom you defend in battles; may yourlatest favour return to us; come quickly, eager to drink the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: ओ षु घृष्विराधसो यातनान्धांसि पीतये । इमा वो हव्या मरुतो ररे हि कं मो ष्वन्यत्र गन्तन ॥
mantras.transliteration: o ṣu ghṛṣvirādhaso yātanāndhāṃsi pītaye | imā vo havyā maruto rare hi kaṃ mo ṣvanyatra gantana ||

translations.english: Do you whose riches are connected together come to partake of the (sacrificial) viands, for Maruts, Ioffer to you these oblations, therefore go not away to any other (sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: आ च नो बर्हिः सदताविता च नः स्पार्हाणि दातवे वसु । अस्रेधन्तो मरुतः सोम्ये मधौ स्वाहेह मादयाध्वै ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā ca no barhiḥ sadatāvitā ca naḥ spārhāṇi dātave vasu | asredhanto marutaḥ somye madhau svāheha mādayādhvai ||

translations.english: Sit down on our sacred grass; come to bestow upon us desirable riches; doing no harm, Maruts delightin the sweet Soma libation presented at this season.

mantras.sanskrit: सस्वश्चिद्धि तन्वः शुम्भमाना आ हंसासो नीलपृष्ठा अपप्तन् । विश्वं शर्धो अभितो मा नि षेद नरो न रण्वाः सवने मदन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sasvaściddhi tanvaḥ śumbhamānā ā haṃsāso nīlapṛṣṭhā apaptan | viśvaṃ śardho abhito mā ni ṣeda naro na raṇvāḥ savane madantaḥ ||

translations.english: May the Maruts yet unrevealed, decorating their person ns, descend like black-backed swans; let theentire company gather round me like happy men rejoicing together at a solemn rite.

mantras.sanskrit: यो नो मरुतो अभि दुर्हृणायुस्तिरश्चित्तानि वसवो जिघांसति । द्रुहः पाशान्प्रति स मुचीष्ट तपिष्ठेन हन्मना हन्तना तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo no maruto abhi durhṛṇāyustiraścittāni vasavo jighāṃsati | druhaḥ pāśānprati sa mucīṣṭa tapiṣṭhena hanmanā hantanā tam ||

translations.english: The man, Maruts, who wounds our feelings, he who, rebuked by all, yet seeks, Vasus, to kill us, hewoudl bind us in the wounds of (Varuṇa), the avenger (of iniquity), such a man do you destroy with a consumingfatal weapon.

mantras.sanskrit: सांतपना इदं हविर्मरुतस्तज्जुजुष्टन । युष्माकोती रिशादसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sāṃtapanā idaṃ havirmarutastajjujuṣṭana | yuṣmākotī riśādasaḥ ||

translations.english: Maruts, desroyers of foes, this oblaion is designed for you; do you, who are the devourers of enemies,(coming) with your protections, graciously accept it.

mantras.sanskrit: गृहमेधास आ गत मरुतो माप भूतन । युष्माकोती सुदानवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: gṛhamedhāsa ā gata maruto māpa bhūtana | yuṣmākotī sudānavaḥ ||

translations.english: Objects of domestic worship, munificent Maruts, come with your protections; go not away.

mantras.sanskrit: इहेह वः स्वतवसः कवयः सूर्यत्वचः । यज्ञं मरुत आ वृणे ॥
mantras.transliteration: iheha vaḥ svatavasaḥ kavayaḥ sūryatvacaḥ | yajñaṃ maruta ā vṛṇe ||

translations.english: Maruts, of independent strength, who are far-seeing, glorious as the sun, come hither, come hither, Iinvoke you to the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम् । उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्मृत्योर्मुक्षीय मामृतात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tryambakaṃ yajāmahe sugandhiṃ puṣṭivardhanam | urvārukamiva bandhanānmṛtyormukṣīya māmṛtāt ||

translations.english: We worship Tryambaka, whose fame is fragrant, the augmenter of increase; may I be liberated fromdeath, and, like the urvāruka from its stalk, but not to immortality; let us worship Trayambaka, whose fame isfragrant, the augmenter of increase; may I be liberated from death like the urvāruka from its stalk, but not untoimmortality.

mantras.sanskrit: यदद्य सूर्य ब्रवोऽनागा उद्यन्मित्राय वरुणाय सत्यम् । वयं देवत्रादिते स्याम तव प्रियासो अर्यमन्गृणन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadadya sūrya bravo'nāgā udyanmitrāya varuṇāya satyam | vayaṃ devatrādite syāma tava priyāso aryamangṛṇantaḥ ||

translations.english: Sūrya, when rising today, declare the truḥ to Mitra and Varuṇa, that we are void of sin; may we, Aditi,be (approved of) among the gods; praising you, Aryaman, may we be dear to you.

mantras.sanskrit: एष स्य मित्रावरुणा नृचक्षा उभे उदेति सूर्यो अभि ज्मन् । विश्वस्य स्थातुर्जगतश्च गोपा ऋजु मर्तेषु वृजिना च पश्यन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa sya mitrāvaruṇā nṛcakṣā ubhe udeti sūryo abhi jman | viśvasya sthāturjagataśca gopā ṛju marteṣu vṛjinā ca paśyan ||

translations.english: This Sūrya, the beholder of man, rises, Mitra and Varuṇa, upon both (heaven and earth), moving (inthe sky); he who is the preserver of all that is stationary or moveable, witnessing the upright acts or the sins ofmortals.

mantras.sanskrit: अयुक्त सप्त हरितः सधस्थाद्या ईं वहन्ति सूर्यं घृताचीः । धामानि मित्रावरुणा युवाकुः सं यो यूथेव जनिमानि चष्टे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayukta sapta haritaḥ sadhasthādyā īṃ vahanti sūryaṃ ghṛtācīḥ | dhāmāni mitrāvaruṇā yuvākuḥ saṃ yo yūtheva janimāni caṣṭe ||

translations.english: He has harnessed his seven bay steeds, Mitra and Varuṇa, (to come) from your commondwelling-plural ce, (the firmament); the horses that, shedding water, convey that Sūrya who, friendly to you both,(contemplates all) regions, and looks carefully upon living creatures as (a herdsman) upon the herd.

mantras.sanskrit: उद्वां पृक्षासो मधुमन्तो अस्थुरा सूर्यो अरुहच्छुक्रमर्णः । यस्मा आदित्या अध्वनो रदन्ति मित्रो अर्यमा वरुणः सजोषाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: udvāṃ pṛkṣāso madhumanto asthurā sūryo aruhacchukramarṇaḥ | yasmā ādityā adhvano radanti mitro aryamā varuṇaḥ sajoṣāḥ ||

translations.english: For yo, (Mitra and Varuṇa), the sweet-flavoured viands have been prepared; the sun has ascended theshining firmament, for whom the Ādityas and the consentient Mitra, Varuṇa, Aryaman make ready paths.

mantras.sanskrit: इमे चेतारो अनृतस्य भूरेर्मित्रो अर्यमा वरुणो हि सन्ति । इम ऋतस्य वावृधुर्दुरोणे शग्मासः पुत्रा अदितेरदब्धाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ime cetāro anṛtasya bhūrermitro aryamā varuṇo hi santi | ima ṛtasya vāvṛdhurduroṇe śagmāsaḥ putrā aditeradabdhāḥ ||

translations.english: These (deities), Mitra, Aryaman, Varuṇa, are the detecters of much untruth; these unconquered sons ofAditi, dispensers of happiness, are magnified in the hall of sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: इमे मित्रो वरुणो दूळभासोऽचेतसं चिच्चितयन्ति दक्षैः । अपि क्रतुं सुचेतसं वतन्तस्तिरश्चिदंहः सुपथा नयन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ime mitro varuṇo dūḷabhāso'cetasaṃ ciccitayanti dakṣaiḥ | api kratuṃ sucetasaṃ vatantastiraścidaṃhaḥ supathā nayanti ||

translations.english: These, the unsubdued Mitra, Varuṇa and Aryaman, animate with energies the unconscious (sleepers);repairing tot he intelligent performer (of pious acts), they lead (him), by safe pahs (to heaven), removing alliniquity.

mantras.sanskrit: इमे दिवो अनिमिषा पृथिव्याश्चिकित्वांसो अचेतसं नयन्ति । प्रव्राजे चिन्नद्यो गाधमस्ति पारं नो अस्य विष्पितस्य पर्षन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ime divo animiṣā pṛthivyāścikitvāṃso acetasaṃ nayanti | pravrāje cinnadyo gādhamasti pāraṃ no asya viṣpitasya parṣan ||

translations.english: (Beholding) with unclosing eyes, and cognizant (of the things) of heaven and earth, they conduct theignorant man (to duty); in the lowes depth of the river, (through them), there is a bottom; may they lead us to theopposite shore of the vast expanse.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्गोपावददितिः शर्म भद्रं मित्रो यच्छन्ति वरुणः सुदासे । तस्मिन्ना तोकं तनयं दधाना मा कर्म देवहेळनं तुरासः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadgopāvadaditiḥ śarma bhadraṃ mitro yacchanti varuṇaḥ sudāse | tasminnā tokaṃ tanayaṃ dadhānā mā karma devaheḷanaṃ turāsaḥ ||

translations.english: Including our sons and grandsons in that preserving and auspicious felicity which Aditi, Mitra andVaruṇa confer upon the liberal donor (of the oblation), may we never, acting precipitately, incur the displeasureof the deities.

mantras.sanskrit: अव वेदिं होत्राभिर्यजेत रिपः काश्चिद्वरुणध्रुतः सः । परि द्वेषोभिरर्यमा वृणक्तूरुं सुदासे वृषणा उ लोकम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ava vediṃ hotrābhiryajeta ripaḥ kāścidvaruṇadhrutaḥ saḥ | pari dveṣobhiraryamā vṛṇaktūruṃ sudāse vṛṣaṇā u lokam ||

translations.english: Let my adversary desecrate the altar by (ill-expressed) praises; repelled by Varuṇa, may he (undergo)various sufferings; may Aryaman defend us from those who hate us; confer, showerers (of benefits), a vastregion upon the liberal donor (of oblations).

mantras.sanskrit: सस्वश्चिद्धि समृतिस्त्वेष्येषामपीच्येन सहसा सहन्ते । युष्मद्भिया वृषणो रेजमाना दक्षस्य चिन्महिना मृळता नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sasvaściddhi samṛtistveṣyeṣāmapīcyena sahasā sahante | yuṣmadbhiyā vṛṣaṇo rejamānā dakṣasya cinmahinā mṛḷatā naḥ ||

translations.english: The association of these (three deities) is of mysterious lustre; by their secret strength they overcome(all enemies); showerers (of benefits), through fear (of you our opponents) are trembling; have mercy upon us inthe mightiness of your strength.

mantras.sanskrit: यो ब्रह्मणे सुमतिमायजाते वाजस्य सातौ परमस्य रायः । सीक्षन्त मन्युं मघवानो अर्य उरु क्षयाय चक्रिरे सुधातु ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo brahmaṇe sumatimāyajāte vājasya sātau paramasya rāyaḥ | sīkṣanta manyuṃ maghavāno arya uru kṣayāya cakrire sudhātu ||

translations.english: These munificent (deities) conjointly accept the praise of the worshipper, and bestow a spaciousmansion for a dwelling upon him who, for the sake of food and excellent riches, devotes his mind to yourglorification.

mantras.sanskrit: इयं देव पुरोहितिर्युवभ्यां यज्ञेषु मित्रावरुणावकारि । विश्वानि दुर्गा पिपृतं तिरो नो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: iyaṃ deva purohitiryuvabhyāṃ yajñeṣu mitrāvaruṇāvakāri | viśvāni durgā pipṛtaṃ tiro no yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Excellent Mitra and Varuṇa, to you this adoration at sacrifices is addressed; remove from us alldifficulties, and ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: उद्वां चक्षुर्वरुण सुप्रतीकं देवयोरेति सूर्यस्ततन्वान् । अभि यो विश्वा भुवनानि चष्टे स मन्युं मर्त्येष्वा चिकेत ॥
mantras.transliteration: udvāṃ cakṣurvaruṇa supratīkaṃ devayoreti sūryastatanvān | abhi yo viśvā bhuvanāni caṣṭe sa manyuṃ martyeṣvā ciketa ||

translations.english: Spreading arond the beautiful light, Mitra and Varuṇa, of you two divinities, Sūrya rises; he whobeholds all existing beings apprehends the acts of mortals.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वां स मित्रावरुणावृतावा विप्रो मन्मानि दीर्घश्रुदियर्ति । यस्य ब्रह्माणि सुक्रतू अवाथ आ यत्क्रत्वा न शरदः पृणैथे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vāṃ sa mitrāvaruṇāvṛtāvā vipro manmāni dīrghaśrudiyarti | yasya brahmāṇi sukratū avātha ā yatkratvā na śaradaḥ pṛṇaithe ||

translations.english: The sage, the solemnizer of sacrifice, the ancient hearer (of holy prayer), earnestly repeats, Mitra andVaruṇa, your praises; he whose prayers, doers of good deeds, you favour, whose acts (of worship) yourecompense not for years.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रोरोर्मित्रावरुणा पृथिव्याः प्र दिव ऋष्वाद्बृहतः सुदानू । स्पशो दधाथे ओषधीषु विक्ष्वृधग्यतो अनिमिषं रक्षमाणा ॥
mantras.transliteration: prorormitrāvaruṇā pṛthivyāḥ pra diva ṛṣvādbṛhataḥ sudānū | spaśo dadhāthe oṣadhīṣu vikṣvṛdhagyato animiṣaṃ rakṣamāṇā ||

translations.english: You are vaster, Mitra and Varuṇa, than the ample earth, vaster, bounteous donors, than the gloriousand expansive heaven; you maintain beauty in plural nts and in people, diligent observers of truth, and vigilantlyprotecting (us).

mantras.sanskrit: शंसा मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धाम शुष्मो रोदसी बद्बधे महित्वा । अयन्मासा अयज्वनामवीराः प्र यज्ञमन्मा वृजनं तिराते ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaṃsā mitrasya varuṇasya dhāma śuṣmo rodasī badbadhe mahitvā | ayanmāsā ayajvanāmavīrāḥ pra yajñamanmā vṛjanaṃ tirāte ||

translations.english: Praise the splendour of Mitra and Varuṇa, whose strength, by its might, keeps heaven and earthasunder; may the days of those who differ not worship pass without male descendants; amy he who delights insacrifice increase in prosperity.

mantras.sanskrit: अमूरा विश्वा वृषणाविमा वां न यासु चित्रं ददृशे न यक्षम् । द्रुहः सचन्ते अनृता जनानां न वां निण्यान्यचिते अभूवन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: amūrā viśvā vṛṣaṇāvimā vāṃ na yāsu citraṃ dadṛśe na yakṣam | druhaḥ sacante anṛtā janānāṃ na vāṃ niṇyānyacite abhūvan ||

translations.english: Unperplexed, all-pervading showerers (of benefits), these (praises) are for you, in which nothingsurprising, no adoration (worthy of you) is beheld; the insincere commendations of men serve as offences;eulogies of you, althogh offered in secret, are not unappreciated.

mantras.sanskrit: समु वां यज्ञं महयं नमोभिर्हुवे वां मित्रावरुणा सबाधः । प्र वां मन्मान्यृचसे नवानि कृतानि ब्रह्म जुजुषन्निमानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: samu vāṃ yajñaṃ mahayaṃ namobhirhuve vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā sabādhaḥ | pra vāṃ manmānyṛcase navāni kṛtāni brahma jujuṣannimāni ||

translations.english: I offer sacrifice to you two with praises, I invoke you, Mitra and Varuṇa, when in trouble; may thepresent hymns be capable of gratifying you; may these (my) prayers be acceptable to you both.

mantras.sanskrit: इयं देव पुरोहितिर्युवभ्यां यज्ञेषु मित्रावरुणावकारि । विश्वानि दुर्गा पिपृतं तिरो नो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: iyaṃ deva purohitiryuvabhyāṃ yajñeṣu mitrāvaruṇāvakāri | viśvāni durgā pipṛtaṃ tiro no yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: To you, divine Mitra and Varuṇa, to you this adoration at sacrifices is addressed; remove from us alldifficulties, and ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: उत्सूर्यो बृहदर्चींष्यश्रेत्पुरु विश्वा जनिम मानुषाणाम् । समो दिवा ददृशे रोचमानः क्रत्वा कृतः सुकृतः कर्तृभिर्भूत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: utsūryo bṛhadarcīṃṣyaśretpuru viśvā janima mānuṣāṇām | samo divā dadṛśe rocamānaḥ kratvā kṛtaḥ sukṛtaḥ kartṛbhirbhūt ||

translations.english: Sūrya spreads his vast and numerous rays over all the crowds of men; shining bright by day, he isbeheld (by all) the same, the creator, the created, he is glorified by his worshippers.

mantras.sanskrit: स सूर्य प्रति पुरो न उद्गा एभिः स्तोमेभिरेतशेभिरेवैः । प्र नो मित्राय वरुणाय वोचोऽनागसो अर्यम्णे अग्नये च ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa sūrya prati puro na udgā ebhiḥ stomebhiretaśebhirevaiḥ | pra no mitrāya varuṇāya voco'nāgaso aryamṇe agnaye ca ||

translations.english: Rise up before us, Sūrya, with your glorious white horses; declare us free from sin to Mitra, Varuṇa,Aryaman, and Agni.

mantras.sanskrit: वि नः सहस्रं शुरुधो रदन्त्वृतावानो वरुणो मित्रो अग्निः । यच्छन्तु चन्द्रा उपमं नो अर्कमा नः कामं पूपुरन्तु स्तवानाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi naḥ sahasraṃ śurudho radantvṛtāvāno varuṇo mitro agniḥ | yacchantu candrā upamaṃ no arkamā naḥ kāmaṃ pūpurantu stavānāḥ ||

translations.english: May Varuṇa, Mitra and Agni, the alleviators of pain, the observers of truth, bestow upon us thousands(of riches); may they, the givers of delight, grant us excellent (food); glorified by us, many they fulfil our desires.

mantras.sanskrit: द्यावाभूमी अदिते त्रासीथां नो ये वां जज्ञुः सुजनिमान ऋष्वे । मा हेळे भूम वरुणस्य वायोर्मा मित्रस्य प्रियतमस्य नृणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dyāvābhūmī adite trāsīthāṃ no ye vāṃ jajñuḥ sujanimāna ṛṣve | mā heḷe bhūma varuṇasya vāyormā mitrasya priyatamasya nṛṇām ||

translations.english: Indivisible and mighty heaven and earth protect us who, of fortunate birth, have knowledge of you both;let us not incur the displeasure of Varuṇa, or of Vāyu, or of Mitra, the best beloved of men.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र बाहवा सिसृतं जीवसे न आ नो गव्यूतिमुक्षतं घृतेन । आ नो जने श्रवयतं युवाना श्रुतं मे मित्रावरुणा हवेमा ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra bāhavā sisṛtaṃ jīvase na ā no gavyūtimukṣataṃ ghṛtena | ā no jane śravayataṃ yuvānā śrutaṃ me mitrāvaruṇā havemā ||

translations.english: Stretch forth your arms for the prolongation of our existence, bedew with water the pastures of ourcattle, render us honoured among men; ever youthful Mitra and Varuṇa, hear these my invocations.

mantras.sanskrit: नू मित्रो वरुणो अर्यमा नस्त्मने तोकाय वरिवो दधन्तु । सुगा नो विश्वा सुपथानि सन्तु यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū mitro varuṇo aryamā nastmane tokāya varivo dadhantu | sugā no viśvā supathāni santu yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: May Mitra, Varuṇa, Aryaman grant affluence to us and to our posterity; may all paths be easy of accessunto us; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: उद्वेति सुभगो विश्वचक्षाः साधारणः सूर्यो मानुषाणाम् । चक्षुर्मित्रस्य वरुणस्य देवश्चर्मेव यः समविव्यक्तमांसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: udveti subhago viśvacakṣāḥ sādhāraṇaḥ sūryo mānuṣāṇām | cakṣurmitrasya varuṇasya devaścarmeva yaḥ samavivyaktamāṃsi ||

translations.english: The auspicious Sūrya rises, the eye of all, the common (parent) of men; the divine eye of Mitra andVaruṇa, who breaks through the glooms as through (investing) skin.

mantras.sanskrit: उद्वेति प्रसवीता जनानां महान्केतुरर्णवः सूर्यस्य । समानं चक्रं पर्याविवृत्सन्यदेतशो वहति धूर्षु युक्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: udveti prasavītā janānāṃ mahānketurarṇavaḥ sūryasya | samānaṃ cakraṃ paryāvivṛtsanyadetaśo vahati dhūrṣu yuktaḥ ||

translations.english: The animator of men arises, the great rain-shedding banner of Sūrya rolling on the universal wheel,which the white steeds yoked to his car drag along.

mantras.sanskrit: विभ्राजमान उषसामुपस्थाद्रेभैरुदेत्यनुमद्यमानः । एष मे देवः सविता चच्छन्द यः समानं न प्रमिनाति धाम ॥
mantras.transliteration: vibhrājamāna uṣasāmupasthādrebhairudetyanumadyamānaḥ | eṣa me devaḥ savitā cacchanda yaḥ samānaṃ na pramināti dhāma ||

translations.english: Delighted by the praises (of his worshippers), the radiant sun rises from the lap of the dawns; thatdivine sun gratifies my desires, who limits not the lustre that is common (to all).

mantras.sanskrit: दिवो रुक्म उरुचक्षा उदेति दूरेअर्थस्तरणिर्भ्राजमानः । नूनं जनाः सूर्येण प्रसूता अयन्नर्थानि कृणवन्नपांसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: divo rukma urucakṣā udeti dūrearthastaraṇirbhrājamānaḥ | nūnaṃ janāḥ sūryeṇa prasūtā ayannarthāni kṛṇavannapāṃsi ||

translations.english: The bright and glorious sun rises from the firmament far-going, traversing (the heavens), diffusing light;verily all beings animated by Sūrya proceed and execute their assigned labours.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्रा चक्रुरमृता गातुमस्मै श्येनो न दीयन्नन्वेति पाथः । प्रति वां सूर उदिते विधेम नमोभिर्मित्रावरुणोत हव्यैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatrā cakruramṛtā gātumasmai śyeno na dīyannanveti pāthaḥ | prati vāṃ sūra udite vidhema namobhirmitrāvaruṇota havyaiḥ ||

translations.english: He travels the path which the immortals have prepared for his course, darting along like a hawk; weworship you, Mitra and Varuṇa, when the sun has risen, with praises and oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: नू मित्रो वरुणो अर्यमा नस्त्मने तोकाय वरिवो दधन्तु । सुगा नो विश्वा सुपथानि सन्तु यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū mitro varuṇo aryamā nastmane tokāya varivo dadhantu | sugā no viśvā supathāni santu yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: May Mitra, Varuṇa and Aryaman grant affluence to us and to our posterity; may all paths be easy ofaccess to us, and do you ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवि क्षयन्ता रजसः पृथिव्यां प्र वां घृतस्य निर्णिजो ददीरन् । हव्यं नो मित्रो अर्यमा सुजातो राजा सुक्षत्रो वरुणो जुषन्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: divi kṣayantā rajasaḥ pṛthivyāṃ pra vāṃ ghṛtasya nirṇijo dadīran | havyaṃ no mitro aryamā sujāto rājā sukṣatro varuṇo juṣanta ||

translations.english: Ruling over the water that are in heaven and earth, impelled by you, (the clouds) assume the form ofrain may the auspiciously manifested Mitra, the royal Aryaman, the powerul Varuṇa, accept our oblatioṇ

mantras.sanskrit: आ राजाना मह ऋतस्य गोपा सिन्धुपती क्षत्रिया यातमर्वाक् । इळां नो मित्रावरुणोत वृष्टिमव दिव इन्वतं जीरदानू ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā rājānā maha ṛtasya gopā sindhupatī kṣatriyā yātamarvāk | iḷāṃ no mitrāvaruṇota vṛṣṭimava diva invataṃ jīradānū ||

translations.english: Sovereigns, mighty preservers of water, powerful lords of rivers, come to our presence; send down tous munificent Mitra and Varuṇa, from the firmament, sustenance and rain.

mantras.sanskrit: मित्रस्तन्नो वरुणो देवो अर्यः प्र साधिष्ठेभिः पथिभिर्नयन्तु । ब्रवद्यथा न आदरिः सुदास इषा मदेम सह देवगोपाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mitrastanno varuṇo devo aryaḥ pra sādhiṣṭhebhiḥ pathibhirnayantu | bravadyathā na ādariḥ sudāsa iṣā madema saha devagopāḥ ||

translations.english: May Mitra, Varuṇa, the divine Aryaman, conduct us by the most practicable paths, then, (when wedesire their guidance), accordingly as Aryaman promises to the liberal donor (of oblations), may we, enjoying theprotection of the gods, rejoice in abundance, together with posterity.

mantras.sanskrit: यो वां गर्तं मनसा तक्षदेतमूर्ध्वां धीतिं कृणवद्धारयच्च । उक्षेथां मित्रावरुणा घृतेन ता राजाना सुक्षितीस्तर्पयेथाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo vāṃ gartaṃ manasā takṣadetamūrdhvāṃ dhītiṃ kṛṇavaddhārayacca | ukṣethāṃ mitrāvaruṇā ghṛtena tā rājānā sukṣitīstarpayethām ||

translations.english: Mitra and Varuṇa, bedew with water him who fabricates your chariot in his mind, offering high praise,the people well affected towards him.

mantras.sanskrit: एष स्तोमो वरुण मित्र तुभ्यं सोमः शुक्रो न वायवेऽयामि । अविष्टं धियो जिगृतं पुरंधीर्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa stomo varuṇa mitra tubhyaṃ somaḥ śukro na vāyave'yāmi | aviṣṭaṃ dhiyo jigṛtaṃ puraṃdhīryūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Varuṇa and Mitra, this praise, pure as the Soma libation, has been offered to you, and also, Aryaman,(to you); protect our rites; be awake to our praises; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रति वां सूर उदिते सूक्तैर्मित्रं हुवे वरुणं पूतदक्षम् । ययोरसुर्यमक्षितं ज्येष्ठं विश्वस्य यामन्नाचिता जिगत्नु ॥
mantras.transliteration: prati vāṃ sūra udite sūktairmitraṃ huve varuṇaṃ pūtadakṣam | yayorasuryamakṣitaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ viśvasya yāmannācitā jigatnu ||

translations.english: When the sun has risen, I invoke Mitra and you, Varuṇa, of pure vigour, whose imperishable andsuperior might is triumphant in the crowded conflict over all enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: ता हि देवानामसुरा तावर्या ता नः क्षितीः करतमूर्जयन्तीः । अश्याम मित्रावरुणा वयं वां द्यावा च यत्र पीपयन्नहा च ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā hi devānāmasurā tāvaryā tā naḥ kṣitīḥ karatamūrjayantīḥ | aśyāma mitrāvaruṇā vayaṃ vāṃ dyāvā ca yatra pīpayannahā ca ||

translations.english: They verily are mighty among the gods; they are rulers; they bestow upon us a numerous posterity;may we obtain from you, Mitra and Varuṇa, whether on earth or in heaven, and whereever the (passing) daysmay preserve us.

mantras.sanskrit: ता भूरिपाशावनृतस्य सेतू दुरत्येतू रिपवे मर्त्याय । ऋतस्य मित्रावरुणा पथा वामपो न नावा दुरिता तरेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā bhūripāśāvanṛtasya setū duratyetū ripave martyāya | ṛtasya mitrāvaruṇā pathā vāmapo na nāvā duritā tarema ||

translations.english: Holders are you of many fetters, barriers against the irreligious, invincible by hostile mortals; may wecross over all the danger, Mitra and Varuṇa, by the path of sacrifice, to you, as (we cross over) water by a boat.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो मित्रावरुणा हव्यजुष्टिं घृतैर्गव्यूतिमुक्षतमिळाभिः । प्रति वामत्र वरमा जनाय पृणीतमुद्नो दिव्यस्य चारोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no mitrāvaruṇā havyajuṣṭiṃ ghṛtairgavyūtimukṣatamiḷābhiḥ | prati vāmatra varamā janāya pṛṇītamudno divyasya cāroḥ ||

translations.english: Come, Mitra and Varuṇa, to our offered oblation sprinkle our plural ce of sacrifice with water and withviands (who) in this world (may present to you such) excellent (donations) that you may (thereby be induced to)gratify mankind with celestial and beautiful water.

mantras.sanskrit: एष स्तोमो वरुण मित्र तुभ्यं सोमः शुक्रो न वायवेऽयामि । अविष्टं धियो जिगृतं पुरंधीर्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
