mantras.transliteration: eṣa stomo varuṇa mitra tubhyaṃ somaḥ śukro na vāyave'yāmi | aviṣṭaṃ dhiyo jigṛtaṃ puraṃdhīryūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Varuṇa and Mitra, this praise, pure as the Soma libation, has been offered to you, and also, Aryaman(to you); protect our rites; be awake to our praises; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र मित्रयोर्वरुणयोः स्तोमो न एतु शूष्यः । नमस्वान्तुविजातयोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra mitrayorvaruṇayoḥ stomo na etu śūṣyaḥ | namasvāntuvijātayoḥ ||

translations.english: May this our propitiatory praise, accompanied by oblations, proceed to you, Mitra and Varuṇa, ofreiterated manifestations.

mantras.sanskrit: या धारयन्त देवाः सुदक्षा दक्षपितरा । असुर्याय प्रमहसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā dhārayanta devāḥ sudakṣā dakṣapitarā | asuryāya pramahasā ||

translations.english: You whom the gods uphold for their invigoration, both mighty, masters of strength and of diffusiveradiance.

mantras.sanskrit: ता नः स्तिपा तनूपा वरुण जरितॄणाम् । मित्र साधयतं धियः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā naḥ stipā tanūpā varuṇa jaritṝṇām | mitra sādhayataṃ dhiyaḥ ||

translations.english: Protectors of our dwellings, protectors of our person ns, Mitra and Varuṇa, perfect the rites of youradorers.

mantras.sanskrit: यदद्य सूर उदितेऽनागा मित्रो अर्यमा । सुवाति सविता भगः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadadya sūra udite'nāgā mitro aryamā | suvāti savitā bhagaḥ ||

translations.english: May Mitra, the destroyer of sin, Aryaman, Savitā, Bhaga, bestow (upon us), today at sun-rise what (wepray for).

mantras.sanskrit: सुप्रावीरस्तु स क्षयः प्र नु यामन्त्सुदानवः । ये नो अंहोऽतिपिप्रति ॥
mantras.transliteration: suprāvīrastu sa kṣayaḥ pra nu yāmantsudānavaḥ | ye no aṃho'tipiprati ||

translations.english: May this our dwelling be well protected, liberal deities, on your departure, you who purify us from sin.

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्वराजो अदितिरदब्धस्य व्रतस्य ये । महो राजान ईशते ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta svarājo aditiradabdhasya vratasya ye | maho rājāna īśate ||

translations.english: And who are sovereign over all, and, with Aditi, preside over this unobstructed and great ceremony.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रति वां सूर उदिते मित्रं गृणीषे वरुणम् । अर्यमणं रिशादसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: prati vāṃ sūra udite mitraṃ gṛṇīṣe varuṇam | aryamaṇaṃ riśādasam ||

translations.english: I glorify you, Mitra and Varuṇa, and Aryaman, the consumer of enemies when the sun has risen.

mantras.sanskrit: राया हिरण्यया मतिरियमवृकाय शवसे । इयं विप्रा मेधसातये ॥
mantras.transliteration: rāyā hiraṇyayā matiriyamavṛkāya śavase | iyaṃ viprā medhasātaye ||

translations.english: May this praise (be effective) for unimpeached strength, alone with golden treasure; may it (beeffective), sages, for the fulfilment of (the objects of) the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: ते स्याम देव वरुण ते मित्र सूरिभिः सह । इषं स्वश्च धीमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: te syāma deva varuṇa te mitra sūribhiḥ saha | iṣaṃ svaśca dhīmahi ||

translations.english: May we be thine, divine Varuṇa; may we, along with pious worshippers, be, Mitra, thine; may we obtainfood and water.

mantras.sanskrit: बहवः सूरचक्षसोऽग्निजिह्वा ऋतावृधः । त्रीणि ये येमुर्विदथानि धीतिभिर्विश्वानि परिभूतिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bahavaḥ sūracakṣaso'gnijihvā ṛtāvṛdhaḥ | trīṇi ye yemurvidathāni dhītibhirviśvāni paribhūtibhiḥ ||

translations.english: Manifold radiant as the sun, Agni-tongued augmenters of sacrifice, you who have limited the threeuniversal sacrifices with comprehensive rites.

mantras.sanskrit: वि ये दधुः शरदं मासमादहर्यज्ञमक्तुं चादृचम् । अनाप्यं वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा क्षत्रं राजान आशत ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi ye dadhuḥ śaradaṃ māsamādaharyajñamaktuṃ cādṛcam | anāpyaṃ varuṇo mitro aryamā kṣatraṃ rājāna āśata ||

translations.english: Who have established the year, and then the month and the day, the sacrifice, the night, and the holytext, they, the royal deities, Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman, enjoy unrivalled might.

mantras.sanskrit: तद्वो अद्य मनामहे सूक्तैः सूर उदिते । यदोहते वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा यूयमृतस्य रथ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadvo adya manāmahe sūktaiḥ sūra udite | yadohate varuṇo mitro aryamā yūyamṛtasya rathyaḥ ||

translations.english: Therefore today at sunrise we solicit you with hymns for (wealth), which Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman,bearers of water, you convey.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतावान ऋतजाता ऋतावृधो घोरासो अनृतद्विषः । तेषां वः सुम्ने सुच्छर्दिष्टमे नरः स्याम ये च सूरयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtāvāna ṛtajātā ṛtāvṛdho ghorāso anṛtadviṣaḥ | teṣāṃ vaḥ sumne succhardiṣṭame naraḥ syāma ye ca sūrayaḥ ||

translations.english: Accepters of rites, genitive rated for rites, augmenters of rites, fierce enemies of the neglecter of rites, maywe, as well as those men who are your adorers, be in (the enjoyment of) the highest felicity, all confirmed by you.

mantras.sanskrit: उदु त्यद्दर्शतं वपुर्दिव एति प्रतिह्वरे । यदीमाशुर्वहति देव एतशो विश्वस्मै चक्षसे अरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: udu tyaddarśataṃ vapurdiva eti pratihvare | yadīmāśurvahati deva etaśo viśvasmai cakṣase aram ||

translations.english: That beautiful orb (of the sun) rises on the near margin of the sky as the swift, divine, white-coloured(steed) bears it along for the beholding of all men.

mantras.sanskrit: शीर्ष्णःशीर्ष्णो जगतस्तस्थुषस्पतिं समया विश्वमा रजः । सप्त स्वसारः सुविताय सूर्यं वहन्ति हरितो रथे ॥
mantras.transliteration: śīrṣṇaḥśīrṣṇo jagatastasthuṣaspatiṃ samayā viśvamā rajaḥ | sapta svasāraḥ suvitāya sūryaṃ vahanti harito rathe ||

translations.english: The seven gliding steeds convey the sun, the lord of every individual moving or stationary thing,traversing the whole world in his chariot for the good (of all).

mantras.sanskrit: तच्चक्षुर्देवहितं शुक्रमुच्चरत् । पश्येम शरदः शतं जीवेम शरदः शतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taccakṣurdevahitaṃ śukramuccarat | paśyema śaradaḥ śataṃ jīvema śaradaḥ śatam ||

translations.english: That pure eye (of the universe), beneficial of the gods, rises; may we behold it for a hundred years; maywe live a hundred years.

mantras.sanskrit: काव्येभिरदाभ्या यातं वरुण द्युमत् । मित्रश्च सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: kāvyebhiradābhyā yātaṃ varuṇa dyumat | mitraśca somapītaye ||

translations.english: Unconquerable, resplendent Varuṇa and Mitra, (induced) by our praises, come to drink the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवो धामभिर्वरुण मित्रश्चा यातमद्रुहा । पिबतं सोममातुजी ॥
mantras.transliteration: divo dhāmabhirvaruṇa mitraścā yātamadruhā | pibataṃ somamātujī ||

translations.english: genitive le Mitra and Varuṇa, destroyers of foes, come from heaven with your glories, and drink the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यातं मित्रावरुणा जुषाणावाहुतिं नरा । पातं सोममृतावृधा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yātaṃ mitrāvaruṇā juṣāṇāvāhutiṃ narā | pātaṃ somamṛtāvṛdhā ||

translations.english: Come, Mitra and Varuṇa, leaders of rites, propitiated by the oblation, and drink the Soma, augmentersof the sacred rite.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रति वां रथं नृपती जरध्यै हविष्मता मनसा यज्ञियेन । यो वां दूतो न धिष्ण्यावजीगरच्छा सूनुर्न पितरा विवक्मि ॥
mantras.transliteration: prati vāṃ rathaṃ nṛpatī jaradhyai haviṣmatā manasā yajñiyena | yo vāṃ dūto na dhiṣṇyāvajīgaracchā sūnurna pitarā vivakmi ||

translations.english: Lords of men, (I approach) to adore your chariot with devout praise and oblation, I address it as if itwere a messenger to awaken you, adorable deities, as a son (addresses) his parents.

mantras.sanskrit: अशोच्यग्निः समिधानो अस्मे उपो अदृश्रन्तमसश्चिदन्ताः । अचेति केतुरुषसः पुरस्ताच्छ्रिये दिवो दुहितुर्जायमानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśocyagniḥ samidhāno asme upo adṛśrantamasaścidantāḥ | aceti keturuṣasaḥ purastācchriye divo duhiturjāyamānaḥ ||

translations.english: Kindled by us, Agni blazes, the extremities of the darkness are seen near at hand, the banner (of thesun) is perceived rising with the glory on the east of the dawn, the daughter of heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि वां नूनमश्विना सुहोता स्तोमैः सिषक्ति नासत्या विवक्वान् । पूर्वीभिर्यातं पथ्याभिरर्वाक्स्वर्विदा वसुमता रथेन ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi vāṃ nūnamaśvinā suhotā stomaiḥ siṣakti nāsatyā vivakvān | pūrvībhiryātaṃ pathyābhirarvāksvarvidā vasumatā rathena ||

translations.english: Verily, Aśvins, the pious priest repeating (your praises) glorifies you, Nāsatyās with hymns; cometherefore by formerly-trodden paths to our presence with your chariot, familiar with heaven, laden with treasure.

mantras.sanskrit: अवोर्वां नूनमश्विना युवाकुर्हुवे यद्वां सुते माध्वी वसूयुः । आ वां वहन्तु स्थविरासो अश्वाः पिबाथो अस्मे सुषुता मधूनि ॥
mantras.transliteration: avorvāṃ nūnamaśvinā yuvākurhuve yadvāṃ sute mādhvī vasūyuḥ | ā vāṃ vahantu sthavirāso aśvāḥ pibātho asme suṣutā madhūni ||

translations.english: Relying on you, Aśvins, as protectors, desirous of wealth, Mādhvis, I invoke you when the Soma iseffused; may your stout horses bring you (hither); drink the sweet Soma poured out by us.

mantras.sanskrit: प्राचीमु देवाश्विना धियं मेऽमृध्रां सातये कृतं वसूयुम् । विश्वा अविष्टं वाज आ पुरंधीस्ता नः शक्तं शचीपती शचीभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prācīmu devāśvinā dhiyaṃ me'mṛdhrāṃ sātaye kṛtaṃ vasūyum | viśvā aviṣṭaṃ vāja ā puraṃdhīstā naḥ śaktaṃ śacīpatī śacībhiḥ ||

translations.english: Divine Aśvins, render my sincere and undisturbed adoration, offered for the sake of riches, (efficacious)for their acquisition; preserve all my caculties in (the time of) battle; protectors of pious acts (influenced) by ouracts, bestow upon us (wealth).

mantras.sanskrit: अविष्टं धीष्वश्विना न आसु प्रजावद्रेतो अह्रयं नो अस्तु । आ वां तोके तनये तूतुजानाः सुरत्नासो देववीतिं गमेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: aviṣṭaṃ dhīṣvaśvinā na āsu prajāvadreto ahrayaṃ no astu | ā vāṃ toke tanaye tūtujānāḥ suratnāso devavītiṃ gamema ||

translations.english: Protect us, Aśvins, in these pious acts, may our procreative power fail not; but (through your favour)possessing sons and grandsons, distributing desired riches and enjoying ample wealth, may we accomplish theworship of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: एष स्य वां पूर्वगत्वेव सख्ये निधिर्हितो माध्वी रातो अस्मे । अहेळता मनसा यातमर्वागश्नन्ता हव्यं मानुषीषु विक्षु ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa sya vāṃ pūrvagatveva sakhye nidhirhito mādhvī rāto asme | aheḷatā manasā yātamarvāgaśnantā havyaṃ mānuṣīṣu vikṣu ||

translations.english: This treasure given by us has been plural ced, Mādhvis, before you, like (an envoy) who has come to thepresence (of a prince) for (acquiring his) friendship; come to our presence with benevolent thoughts, acceptingthe oblations offered among human beings.

mantras.sanskrit: एकस्मिन्योगे भुरणा समाने परि वां सप्त स्रवतो रथो गात् । न वायन्ति सुभ्वो देवयुक्ता ये वां धूर्षु तरणयो वहन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ekasminyoge bhuraṇā samāne pari vāṃ sapta sravato ratho gāt | na vāyanti subhvo devayuktā ye vāṃ dhūrṣu taraṇayo vahanti ||

translations.english: Nourishers of all, the chariot of you two, who are associated in a common purpose, traverses the sevenflowing (streams); the excellent horses harnessed by the gods, who bear you rapidly, careering in the car, arenever wearied.

mantras.sanskrit: असश्चता मघवद्भ्यो हि भूतं ये राया मघदेयं जुनन्ति । प्र ये बन्धुं सूनृताभिस्तिरन्ते गव्या पृञ्चन्तो अश्व्या मघानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: asaścatā maghavadbhyo hi bhūtaṃ ye rāyā maghadeyaṃ junanti | pra ye bandhuṃ sūnṛtābhistirante gavyā pṛñcanto aśvyā maghāni ||

translations.english: Be propitious to those who are affluent (in oblations), who offer the wealth that is to be offered for thesake of riches; they who encourage a kinsman with kind commendations, distributing wealth of cattle and ofhorses.

mantras.sanskrit: नू मे हवमा शृणुतं युवाना यासिष्टं वर्तिरश्विनाविरावत् । धत्तं रत्नानि जरतं च सूरीन्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū me havamā śṛṇutaṃ yuvānā yāsiṣṭaṃ vartiraśvināvirāvat | dhattaṃ ratnāni jarataṃ ca sūrīnyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Ever youthful Aśvins, hear today my invocation; come Aśvins, to the dwelling where the oblation isprepared; grant wealth (to the offerer); elevate the worshipper and to you ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: आ शुभ्रा यातमश्विना स्वश्वा गिरो दस्रा जुजुषाणा युवाकोः । हव्यानि च प्रतिभृता वीतं नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā śubhrā yātamaśvinā svaśvā giro dasrā jujuṣāṇā yuvākoḥ | havyāni ca pratibhṛtā vītaṃ naḥ ||

translations.english: Illustrious Aśvins, lords of handsome horses, come hither, propitiated; Dasrasā, by the praises of youradorer, and partake of our consecrated oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वामन्धांसि मद्यान्यस्थुररं गन्तं हविषो वीतये मे । तिरो अर्यो हवनानि श्रुतं नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vāmandhāṃsi madyānyasthuraraṃ gantaṃ haviṣo vītaye me | tiro aryo havanāni śrutaṃ naḥ ||

translations.english: The exhilarating viands have been prepared for you; come quickly to partake of my oblation;disregarding the invocations of an adversary, listen to ours.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वां रथो मनोजवा इयर्ति तिरो रजांस्यश्विना शतोतिः । अस्मभ्यं सूर्यावसू इयानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vāṃ ratho manojavā iyarti tiro rajāṃsyaśvinā śatotiḥ | asmabhyaṃ sūryāvasū iyānaḥ ||

translations.english: Your chariot, Aśvins, in which you ride with Sūrya, hastens towards us at our solicitations, traversingthe regions as swift as thought, and laden with a hundred blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं ह यद्वां देवया उ अद्रिरूर्ध्वो विवक्ति सोमसुद्युवभ्याम् । आ वल्गू विप्रो ववृतीत हव्यैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ ha yadvāṃ devayā u adrirūrdhvo vivakti somasudyuvabhyām | ā valgū vipro vavṛtīta havyaiḥ ||

translations.english: When the stone, seeking to propitiate you two divinities, is raised aloft, and loudly sounds, expressingfor you the Soma, then the pious worshipper brings you back, beautiful divinities, by his oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: चित्रं ह यद्वां भोजनं न्वस्ति न्यत्रये महिष्वन्तं युयोतम् । यो वामोमानं दधते प्रियः सन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: citraṃ ha yadvāṃ bhojanaṃ nvasti nyatraye mahiṣvantaṃ yuyotam | yo vāmomānaṃ dadhate priyaḥ san ||

translations.english: Wonderful, verily, is the wealth that is yours; you have liberated from the cave Atri, who is dear to you,and enjoys your protection.

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्यद्वां जुरते अश्विना भूच्च्यवानाय प्रतीत्यं हविर्दे । अधि यद्वर्प इतऊति धत्थः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tyadvāṃ jurate aśvinā bhūccyavānāya pratītyaṃ havirde | adhi yadvarpa itaūti dhatthaḥ ||

translations.english: Such was your benevolence, Aśvins, to Cyavana, praising and offering oblations, that you in requitalrescued his body from departure.

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्यं भुज्युमश्विना सखायो मध्ये जहुर्दुरेवासः समुद्रे । निरीं पर्षदरावा यो युवाकुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tyaṃ bhujyumaśvinā sakhāyo madhye jahurdurevāsaḥ samudre | nirīṃ parṣadarāvā yo yuvākuḥ ||

translations.english: When faithless friends had abandoned Bhujyu in the midst of the ocean, you brought him to shore,devoted to and relying upon you.

mantras.sanskrit: वृकाय चिज्जसमानाय शक्तमुत श्रुतं शयवे हूयमाना । यावघ्न्यामपिन्वतमपो न स्तर्यं चिच्छक्त्यश्विना शचीभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛkāya cijjasamānāya śaktamuta śrutaṃ śayave hūyamānā | yāvaghnyāmapinvatamapo na staryaṃ cicchaktyaśvinā śacībhiḥ ||

translations.english: You have granted (his desires) to Vṛka, exhausted by his devotions; when called upon you havelistened to Śayu; you are they who have filled the barren cow (with milk) as (a river) with water; you have(endowed her) with strength, Aśvins, by your deeds.

mantras.sanskrit: एष स्य कारुर्जरते सूक्तैरग्रे बुधान उषसां सुमन्मा । इषा तं वर्धदघ्न्या पयोभिर्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa sya kārurjarate sūktairagre budhāna uṣasāṃ sumanmā | iṣā taṃ vardhadaghnyā payobhiryūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: This your devoted worshipper, wwaking before the dawn, praises with hymns; nourish him with food,and let the cow (nourish him) with her milk; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वां रथो रोदसी बद्बधानो हिरण्ययो वृषभिर्यात्वश्वैः । घृतवर्तनिः पविभी रुचान इषां वोळ्हा नृपतिर्वाजिनीवान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāṃ ratho rodasī badbadhāno hiraṇyayo vṛṣabhiryātvaśvaiḥ | ghṛtavartaniḥ pavibhī rucāna iṣāṃ voḷhā nṛpatirvājinīvān ||

translations.english: May your golden chariot, drawn by your vigorous horses, blocking up heaven and earth, come to us,following the track of the waters, radiant with (glowing) wheels, laden with viands, the protector of men, thereceptacle of food.

mantras.sanskrit: स पप्रथानो अभि पञ्च भूमा त्रिवन्धुरो मनसा यातु युक्तः । विशो येन गच्छथो देवयन्तीः कुत्रा चिद्याममश्विना दधाना ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa paprathāno abhi pañca bhūmā trivandhuro manasā yātu yuktaḥ | viśo yena gacchatho devayantīḥ kutrā cidyāmamaśvinā dadhānā ||

translations.english: Renowned among the five orders of beings, furnished with three benches, harnessed at will, may itcome hither; that (vehicle) wherewith you repair to devout mortals, whatsoever, Aśvins, directing your course.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वश्वा यशसा यातमर्वाग्दस्रा निधिं मधुमन्तं पिबाथः । वि वां रथो वध्वा यादमानोऽन्तान्दिवो बाधते वर्तनिभ्याम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: svaśvā yaśasā yātamarvāgdasrā nidhiṃ madhumantaṃ pibāthaḥ | vi vāṃ ratho vadhvā yādamāno'ntāndivo bādhate vartanibhyām ||

translations.english: Well-horsed and celebrated, come, Aśvins, to our presence; drink, Dasras, the sweet plural dge; yourchariot, conveying you, with your spouse, furrows with its two wheels the extremities of the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: युवोः श्रियं परि योषावृणीत सूरो दुहिता परितक्म्यायाम् । यद्देवयन्तमवथः शचीभिः परि घ्रंसमोमना वां वयो गात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvoḥ śriyaṃ pari yoṣāvṛṇīta sūro duhitā paritakmyāyām | yaddevayantamavathaḥ śacībhiḥ pari ghraṃsamomanā vāṃ vayo gāt ||

translations.english: The daughter of Sūrya made choice of your chariot at the approach of night; you defend the devoutworshipper by your deeds, when the resplendent (sacrificial) food proceeds to you to secure your protection.

mantras.sanskrit: यो ह स्य वां रथिरा वस्त उस्रा रथो युजानः परियाति वर्तिः । तेन नः शं योरुषसो व्युष्टौ न्यश्विना वहतं यज्ञे अस्मिन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo ha sya vāṃ rathirā vasta usrā ratho yujānaḥ pariyāti vartiḥ | tena naḥ śaṃ yoruṣaso vyuṣṭau nyaśvinā vahataṃ yajñe asmin ||

translations.english: Riders in the chariot, Aśvin, come for our participation and welfare to this our sacrifice, at the dawn ofday, with that chariot which is clothed in radiance, and which, when harnessed, traverses its (appointed) road.

mantras.sanskrit: नरा गौरेव विद्युतं तृषाणास्माकमद्य सवनोप यातम् । पुरुत्रा हि वां मतिभिर्हवन्ते मा वामन्ये नि यमन्देवयन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: narā gaureva vidyutaṃ tṛṣāṇāsmākamadya savanopa yātam | purutrā hi vāṃ matibhirhavante mā vāmanye ni yamandevayantaḥ ||

translations.english: Leaders of rites, like (thirsty) cattle, thirsting for the radiant (Soma), hasten today to our sacrifice; inmany ceremonies do the pious propitiate you with praises; let not other devout worshippers detain you.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं भुज्युमवविद्धं समुद्र उदूहथुरर्णसो अस्रिधानैः । पतत्रिभिरश्रमैरव्यथिभिर्दंसनाभिरश्विना पारयन्ता ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ bhujyumavaviddhaṃ samudra udūhathurarṇaso asridhānaiḥ | patatribhiraśramairavyathibhirdaṃsanābhiraśvinā pārayantā ||

translations.english: You bore up Bhujyu, Aśvins, from the waters, when cast into the sea, bearing him to shore by yourexertions with your undecaying, unwearied, unharassed horses.

mantras.sanskrit: नू मे हवमा शृणुतं युवाना यासिष्टं वर्तिरश्विनाविरावत् । धत्तं रत्नानि जरतं च सूरीन्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū me havamā śṛṇutaṃ yuvānā yāsiṣṭaṃ vartiraśvināvirāvat | dhattaṃ ratnāni jarataṃ ca sūrīnyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Ever youthful Aśvins, hear today this my invocation; come, Aśvins, to the dwelling where the oblation isprepared, grant wealth (to the offerer), elevate the worshipper, and do you ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: आ विश्ववाराश्विना गतं नः प्र तत्स्थानमवाचि वां पृथिव्याम् । अश्वो न वाजी शुनपृष्ठो अस्थादा यत्सेदथुर्ध्रुवसे न योनिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā viśvavārāśvinā gataṃ naḥ pra tatsthānamavāci vāṃ pṛthivyām | aśvo na vājī śunapṛṣṭho asthādā yatsedathurdhruvase na yonim ||

translations.english: All-adored Aśvins, come to our (sacrifice), to that plural ce on earth which has been designated yours,which, like a swift, broad-backed horse, awaits you, and on which you are seated as firmly as in a dwelling.

mantras.sanskrit: सिषक्ति सा वां सुमतिश्चनिष्ठातापि घर्मो मनुषो दुरोणे । यो वां समुद्रान्त्सरितः पिपर्त्येतग्वा चिन्न सुयुजा युजानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: siṣakti sā vāṃ sumatiścaniṣṭhātāpi gharmo manuṣo duroṇe | yo vāṃ samudrāntsaritaḥ pipartyetagvā cinna suyujā yujānaḥ ||

translations.english: This excellent praise, redolent of food, propitiates you; the ewer has been heated in the dwelling of theworshipper, which, reaching you, fills the ocean and the rivers (through the rain it obtains), associating you (inthe rite), like two well-matched horses in a chariot.

mantras.sanskrit: यानि स्थानान्यश्विना दधाथे दिवो यह्वीष्वोषधीषु विक्षु । नि पर्वतस्य मूर्धनि सदन्तेषं जनाय दाशुषे वहन्ता ॥
mantras.transliteration: yāni sthānānyaśvinā dadhāthe divo yahvīṣvoṣadhīṣu vikṣu | ni parvatasya mūrdhani sadanteṣaṃ janāya dāśuṣe vahantā ||

translations.english: To whatever plural ces you may descend, Aśvins, from heaven, whether amidst the spreading plural nts, oramong men, or sitting on the summit of the clouds, be the bearers of food to the man, the donor (of the oblation).

mantras.sanskrit: चनिष्टं देवा ओषधीष्वप्सु यद्योग्या अश्नवैथे ऋषीणाम् । पुरूणि रत्ना दधतौ न्यस्मे अनु पूर्वाणि चख्यथुर्युगानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: caniṣṭaṃ devā oṣadhīṣvapsu yadyogyā aśnavaithe ṛṣīṇām | purūṇi ratnā dadhatau nyasme anu pūrvāṇi cakhyathuryugāni ||

translations.english: Inasmuch, divine Aśvins, as you accept that which is most acceptable in the plural nts and in the waters,and those (things) which are most suitable to you, (the offerings) of the Ṛṣis, therefore, bestowing upon usample riches, (favour us) as you have favoured, bestowing former couples.

mantras.sanskrit: शुश्रुवांसा चिदश्विना पुरूण्यभि ब्रह्माणि चक्षाथे ऋषीणाम् । प्रति प्र यातं वरमा जनायास्मे वामस्तु सुमतिश्चनिष्ठा ॥
mantras.transliteration: śuśruvāṃsā cidaśvinā purūṇyabhi brahmāṇi cakṣāthe ṛṣīṇām | prati pra yātaṃ varamā janāyāsme vāmastu sumatiścaniṣṭhā ||

translations.english: Aśvins, hearing the many prayers of the Ṛṣis, you look (favourably) upon (us); come to the sacrifice ofthis man, and may your desired favour be (shown) him.

mantras.sanskrit: यो वां यज्ञो नासत्या हविष्मान्कृतब्रह्मा समर्यो भवाति । उप प्र यातं वरमा वसिष्ठमिमा ब्रह्माण्यृच्यन्ते युवभ्याम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo vāṃ yajño nāsatyā haviṣmānkṛtabrahmā samaryo bhavāti | upa pra yātaṃ varamā vasiṣṭhamimā brahmāṇyṛcyante yuvabhyām ||

translations.english: Come, Nāsatyās, to the excellent Vasiṣṭha, the worshiper who, accompanied by the priests, ispresent, offering oblations and repeating praises; these prayers are recited to (bring) you (hither).

mantras.sanskrit: इयं मनीषा इयमश्विना गीरिमां सुवृक्तिं वृषणा जुषेथाम् । इमा ब्रह्माणि युवयून्यग्मन्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: iyaṃ manīṣā iyamaśvinā gīrimāṃ suvṛktiṃ vṛṣaṇā juṣethām | imā brahmāṇi yuvayūnyagmanyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: This adoration, Aśvins, this praise (is for you) be gratified, showerers (of benefits), by this laudationmay these eulogies, addressed to you, reach you; and do you ever cherish us with blessing.

mantras.sanskrit: अप स्वसुरुषसो नग्जिहीते रिणक्ति कृष्णीररुषाय पन्थाम् । अश्वामघा गोमघा वां हुवेम दिवा नक्तं शरुमस्मद्युयोतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: apa svasuruṣaso nagjihīte riṇakti kṛṣṇīraruṣāya panthām | aśvāmaghā gomaghā vāṃ huvema divā naktaṃ śarumasmadyuyotam ||

translations.english: Night retires before the dawn, the sister (of the Aśvins); the dark night leaves the path clear for theradiant (sun); upon you, who are affluent in horses, affluenet in cattle, we call day and night; keep away from usthe malevolent.

mantras.sanskrit: उपायातं दाशुषे मर्त्याय रथेन वाममश्विना वहन्ता । युयुतमस्मदनिराममीवां दिवा नक्तं माध्वी त्रासीथां नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: upāyātaṃ dāśuṣe martyāya rathena vāmamaśvinā vahantā | yuyutamasmadanirāmamīvāṃ divā naktaṃ mādhvī trāsīthāṃ naḥ ||

translations.english: Come to the mortal, the donor (of oblations) bringing desired wealth in your chariot; keep afar from usfamine and sickness; day and night, Mādhvis, protect us.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वां रथमवमस्यां व्युष्टौ सुम्नायवो वृषणो वर्तयन्तु । स्यूमगभस्तिमृतयुग्भिरश्वैराश्विना वसुमन्तं वहेथाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāṃ rathamavamasyāṃ vyuṣṭau sumnāyavo vṛṣaṇo vartayantu | syūmagabhastimṛtayugbhiraśvairāśvinā vasumantaṃ vahethām ||

translations.english: May your docile and vigorous (horses) bring hither your chariot at the approaching dawn; conducthither, Aśvins, your radiating, wealth-laden chariot, with your rain-bestowing steeds.

mantras.sanskrit: यो वां रथो नृपती अस्ति वोळ्हा त्रिवन्धुरो वसुमाँ उस्रयामा । आ न एना नासत्योप यातमभि यद्वां विश्वप्स्न्यो जिगाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo vāṃ ratho nṛpatī asti voḷhā trivandhuro vasumā~ usrayāmā | ā na enā nāsatyopa yātamabhi yadvāṃ viśvapsnyo jigāti ||

translations.english: With that chariot, lords of men, which is your vehicle, which has three benches, is laden with wealth,and is the precursor of day, come Nāsatyās, to us; with that chariot which traverses (the sky) as yourall-pervading form.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं च्यवानं जरसोऽमुमुक्तं नि पेदव ऊहथुराशुमश्वम् । निरंहसस्तमसः स्पर्तमत्रिं नि जाहुषं शिथिरे धातमन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ cyavānaṃ jaraso'mumuktaṃ ni pedava ūhathurāśumaśvam | niraṃhasastamasaḥ spartamatriṃ ni jāhuṣaṃ śithire dhātamantaḥ ||

translations.english: You exempted Cyavana from decay; you mounted Pedu upon a swift charger; you extricated Atri fromtorture and darkness; you replaced Jāhuṣa in his rebellious kingdom.

mantras.sanskrit: इयं मनीषा इयमश्विना गीरिमां सुवृक्तिं वृषणा जुषेथाम् । इमा ब्रह्माणि युवयून्यग्मन्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: iyaṃ manīṣā iyamaśvinā gīrimāṃ suvṛktiṃ vṛṣaṇā juṣethām | imā brahmāṇi yuvayūnyagmanyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: This adoration, Aśvins, this praise (is for you), be gratified, showerer (of benefits), by this laudation;may these eulogies, addressed to you, reach you; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: आ गोमता नासत्या रथेनाश्वावता पुरुश्चन्द्रेण यातम् । अभि वां विश्वा नियुतः सचन्ते स्पार्हया श्रिया तन्वा शुभाना ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā gomatā nāsatyā rathenāśvāvatā puruścandreṇa yātam | abhi vāṃ viśvā niyutaḥ sacante spārhayā śriyā tanvā śubhānā ||

translations.english: Come, Nāsatyās, with your cattle-giving, horse-bestowing, wealth- yielding chariot; all praises gatherround you, who are resplendent with admirable beauty of a person n.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो देवेभिरुप यातमर्वाक्सजोषसा नासत्या रथेन । युवोर्हि नः सख्या पित्र्याणि समानो बन्धुरुत तस्य वित्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no devebhirupa yātamarvāksajoṣasā nāsatyā rathena | yuvorhi naḥ sakhyā pitryāṇi samāno bandhuruta tasya vittam ||

translations.english: Sharing in satisfaction with the gods, come to our presence, Nāsatyās, with your chariot, for thefriendship (that prevails) between you and us is from our forefathers; a common ancestor (is ours); acknowledgehis affinity.

mantras.sanskrit: उदु स्तोमासो अश्विनोरबुध्रञ्जामि ब्रह्माण्युषसश्च देवीः । आविवासन्रोदसी धिष्ण्येमे अच्छा विप्रो नासत्या विवक्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: udu stomāso aśvinorabudhrañjāmi brahmāṇyuṣasaśca devīḥ | āvivāsanrodasī dhiṣṇyeme acchā vipro nāsatyā vivakti ||

translations.english: Praises wakn up the Aśvins, kindred adorations (arouse them) and the celestial dawns; the sage,addressing these laudations to the adorable heaven and earth glorifies the Nāsatyās in their presence.

mantras.sanskrit: वि चेदुच्छन्त्यश्विना उषासः प्र वां ब्रह्माणि कारवो भरन्ते । ऊर्ध्वं भानुं सविता देवो अश्रेद्बृहदग्नयः समिधा जरन्ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi ceducchantyaśvinā uṣāsaḥ pra vāṃ brahmāṇi kāravo bharante | ūrdhvaṃ bhānuṃ savitā devo aśredbṛhadagnayaḥ samidhā jarante ||

translations.english: When the dawns arise, your worshippers, Aśvins, profer you praises; the divine Savitā casts hissplendours on high; the fires, with their (kindled) fuel, greatly glorify you.

mantras.sanskrit: आ पश्चातान्नासत्या पुरस्तादाश्विना यातमधरादुदक्तात् । आ विश्वतः पाञ्चजन्येन राया यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā paścātānnāsatyā purastādāśvinā yātamadharādudaktāt | ā viśvataḥ pāñcajanyena rāyā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Come, Nāsatyās, from the west, from the east; (come), Aśvins, from the south, from the north, comefrom every quarter with riches beneficial for the five classes of men; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: अतारिष्म तमसस्पारमस्य प्रति स्तोमं देवयन्तो दधानाः । पुरुदंसा पुरुतमा पुराजामर्त्या हवते अश्विना गीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: atāriṣma tamasaspāramasya prati stomaṃ devayanto dadhānāḥ | purudaṃsā purutamā purājāmartyā havate aśvinā gīḥ ||

translations.english: Devoted to the gods, and hymning their praise, we have crossed to the opposite shore of this (state of)darkness; the worshipper invokes the Aśvins, the doers of many deeds, the most mighty, the first born, theimmortal.

mantras.sanskrit: न्यु प्रियो मनुषः सादि होता नासत्या यो यजते वन्दते च । अश्नीतं मध्वो अश्विना उपाक आ वां वोचे विदथेषु प्रयस्वान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nyu priyo manuṣaḥ sādi hotā nāsatyā yo yajate vandate ca | aśnītaṃ madhvo aśvinā upāka ā vāṃ voce vidatheṣu prayasvān ||

translations.english: The man who is dear to you, Nāsatyās, the invoker of the gods, has taken his seat, he who offersworship and repeats praise; be near, Aśvins, and partake of the libation; supplied with food, I address you atsacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: अहेम यज्ञं पथामुराणा इमां सुवृक्तिं वृषणा जुषेथाम् । श्रुष्टीवेव प्रेषितो वामबोधि प्रति स्तोमैर्जरमाणो वसिष्ठः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahema yajñaṃ pathāmurāṇā imāṃ suvṛktiṃ vṛṣaṇā juṣethām | śruṣṭīveva preṣito vāmabodhi prati stomairjaramāṇo vasiṣṭhaḥ ||

translations.english: Praising (the gods), we preparers the sacrifice for their coming; showerers (of benefits), be propitiatedby this pious laudation; despatched like a swift messenger, Vasiṣṭha arouses you, glorifying you with hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: उप त्या वह्नी गमतो विशं नो रक्षोहणा सम्भृता वीळुपाणी । समन्धांस्यग्मत मत्सराणि मा नो मर्धिष्टमा गतं शिवेन ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa tyā vahnī gamato viśaṃ no rakṣohaṇā sambhṛtā vīḷupāṇī | samandhāṃsyagmata matsarāṇi mā no mardhiṣṭamā gataṃ śivena ||

translations.english: May those two, the bearers (of oblations), approach our people, destroyers of rākṣasas,well-nourished, strong-handed; accept our exhilarating (sacrificial) viands; injure us not, but come with goodfortune.

mantras.sanskrit: आ पश्चातान्नासत्या पुरस्तादाश्विना यातमधरादुदक्तात् । आ विश्वतः पाञ्चजन्येन राया यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā paścātānnāsatyā purastādāśvinā yātamadharādudaktāt | ā viśvataḥ pāñcajanyena rāyā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Come, Nāsatyās, from the west, from the east; come, Aśvins, from the south, from the north, comefrom every quarter with riches beneficial for the five classes of men; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: इमा उ वां दिविष्टय उस्रा हवन्ते अश्विना । अयं वामह्वेऽवसे शचीवसू विशंविशं हि गच्छथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imā u vāṃ diviṣṭaya usrā havante aśvinā | ayaṃ vāmahve'vase śacīvasū viśaṃviśaṃ hi gacchathaḥ ||

translations.english: These pious praises glorify you, radiant Aśvins; I call upon you, who are rich, in acts of preservation,for you reach out to every individual.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं चित्रं ददथुर्भोजनं नरा चोदेथां सूनृतावते । अर्वाग्रथं समनसा नि यच्छतं पिबतं सोम्यं मधु ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ citraṃ dadathurbhojanaṃ narā codethāṃ sūnṛtāvate | arvāgrathaṃ samanasā ni yacchataṃ pibataṃ somyaṃ madhu ||

translations.english: You are possessed, leaders (of rites), of marvellous wealth; bestow upon him who sincerely praisesyou; alike favourable-minded, direct your chariot to our presence; drink the sweet Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यातमुप भूषतं मध्वः पिबतमश्विना । दुग्धं पयो वृषणा जेन्यावसू मा नो मर्धिष्टमा गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yātamupa bhūṣataṃ madhvaḥ pibatamaśvinā | dugdhaṃ payo vṛṣaṇā jenyāvasū mā no mardhiṣṭamā gatam ||

translations.english: Come, Aśvins, tarry near us, drink of the sweet libation; showerers (of benefits), by whom riches arewon, milk the rain (from the firmament); harm us not; come hither.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्वासो ये वामुप दाशुषो गृहं युवां दीयन्ति बिभ्रतः । मक्षूयुभिर्नरा हयेभिरश्विना देवा यातमस्मयू ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvāso ye vāmupa dāśuṣo gṛhaṃ yuvāṃ dīyanti bibhrataḥ | makṣūyubhirnarā hayebhiraśvinā devā yātamasmayū ||

translations.english: Yours are the horses that, conveying you, bring you to the dwelling to the donor (of the oblation); divineleader (of rites), favourable inclined towards us, come with your rapid steed

mantras.sanskrit: अधा ह यन्तो अश्विना पृक्षः सचन्त सूरयः । ता यंसतो मघवद्भ्यो ध्रुवं यशश्छर्दिरस्मभ्यं नासत्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhā ha yanto aśvinā pṛkṣaḥ sacanta sūrayaḥ | tā yaṃsato maghavadbhyo dhruvaṃ yaśaśchardirasmabhyaṃ nāsatyā ||

translations.english: The pious worshippers now approaching you unite to offer (you sacrificial) food; do you two,Nāsatyās, grant to us who are affluent (in offerings) enduring fame and dwelling.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ये ययुरवृकासो रथा इव नृपातारो जनानाम् । उत स्वेन शवसा शूशुवुर्नर उत क्षियन्ति सुक्षितिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra ye yayuravṛkāso rathā iva nṛpātāro janānām | uta svena śavasā śūśuvurnara uta kṣiyanti sukṣitim ||

translations.english: Those worshippers, the benefactors of men, doing injury to none who go to you, like chariots (to thefarm), either prosper by their own strength, or inhabit an excellent abode.

mantras.sanskrit: व्युषा आवो दिविजा ऋतेनाविष्कृण्वाना महिमानमागात् । अप द्रुहस्तम आवरजुष्टमङ्गिरस्तमा पथ्या अजीगः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vyuṣā āvo divijā ṛtenāviṣkṛṇvānā mahimānamāgāt | apa druhastama āvarajuṣṭamaṅgirastamā pathyā ajīgaḥ ||

translations.english: The Dawn, the daughter of heaven, has risen; she comes, manifesting her magnificence in light; shescatters our foes as well as the odious darkness, and re-illuminates the paths thaat are to be trodden (by livingbeings).

mantras.sanskrit: महे नो अद्य सुविताय बोध्युषो महे सौभगाय प्र यन्धि । चित्रं रयिं यशसं धेह्यस्मे देवि मर्तेषु मानुषि श्रवस्युम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahe no adya suvitāya bodhyuṣo mahe saubhagāya pra yandhi | citraṃ rayiṃ yaśasaṃ dhehyasme devi marteṣu mānuṣi śravasyum ||

translations.english: Be unto us today the cause of great felicity; bestow, Uṣas, (what is promotive) of great prosperity; giveus wonderful riches and reputation; grant, divine benefactrss of men, to mortals flourishing male posterity.

mantras.sanskrit: एते त्ये भानवो दर्शतायाश्चित्रा उषसो अमृतास आगुः । जनयन्तो दैव्यानि व्रतान्यापृणन्तो अन्तरिक्षा व्यस्थुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ete tye bhānavo darśatāyāścitrā uṣaso amṛtāsa āguḥ | janayanto daivyāni vratānyāpṛṇanto antarikṣā vyasthuḥ ||

translations.english: These wonderful, immortal rays of the beautifu Dawn appear, giving birth to the pious rites of divineworship, and filling the firmament, they spread around.

mantras.sanskrit: एषा स्या युजाना पराकात्पञ्च क्षितीः परि सद्यो जिगाति । अभिपश्यन्ती वयुना जनानां दिवो दुहिता भुवनस्य पत्नी ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣā syā yujānā parākātpañca kṣitīḥ pari sadyo jigāti | abhipaśyantī vayunā janānāṃ divo duhitā bhuvanasya patnī ||

translations.english: Exerting herself, she approaches rapidly from afar (to give light) to the five classes of men, witnessingthe thoughts of men, the daughter of heaven, the benefactress of living beings.

mantras.sanskrit: वाजिनीवती सूर्यस्य योषा चित्रामघा राय ईशे वसूनाम् । ऋषिष्टुता जरयन्ती मघोन्युषा उच्छति वह्निभिर्गृणाना ॥
mantras.transliteration: vājinīvatī sūryasya yoṣā citrāmaghā rāya īśe vasūnām | ṛṣiṣṭutā jarayantī maghonyuṣā ucchati vahnibhirgṛṇānā ||

translations.english: The bride Sūrya, the distributress (of food), the possessor of wonderful wealth, she rules overtreasures (of every kind) of riches; hymned by the ṛṣis, the waster away of life, the mistress of opulence, sherises glorified by the offerers (of oblations).

mantras.sanskrit: प्रति द्युतानामरुषासो अश्वाश्चित्रा अदृश्रन्नुषसं वहन्तः । याति शुभ्रा विश्वपिशा रथेन दधाति रत्नं विधते जनाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: prati dyutānāmaruṣāso aśvāścitrā adṛśrannuṣasaṃ vahantaḥ | yāti śubhrā viśvapiśā rathena dadhāti ratnaṃ vidhate janāya ||

translations.english: The bright and wondrous steeds, conveying the resplendent Uṣas, are visible; she advances, radiantin her every-way-moving chariot; she bestows wealth upon the man who practises sacred rites.

mantras.sanskrit: सत्या सत्येभिर्महती महद्भिर्देवी देवेभिर्यजता यजत्रैः । रुजद्दृळ्हानि दददुस्रियाणां प्रति गाव उषसं वावशन्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: satyā satyebhirmahatī mahadbhirdevī devebhiryajatā yajatraiḥ | rujaddṛḷhāni dadadusriyāṇāṃ prati gāva uṣasaṃ vāvaśanta ||

translations.english: True with the truthful, great with the great, divine with the deities, adorable with adorable, she dispersesthe solid (glooms), she displays (the pastures) of the cattle; all creatures, the cattle especially, are longing for theDawn.

mantras.sanskrit: नू नो गोमद्वीरवद्धेहि रत्नमुषो अश्वावत्पुरुभोजो अस्मे । मा नो बर्हिः पुरुषता निदे कर्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū no gomadvīravaddhehi ratnamuṣo aśvāvatpurubhojo asme | mā no barhiḥ puruṣatā nide karyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Bestow upon us, Uṣas, wealth, comprising cattle horses, abundant food, and male offspring; let not oursacrifice incur reproach among men; and do you (gods), ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: उदु ज्योतिरमृतं विश्वजन्यं विश्वानरः सविता देवो अश्रेत् । क्रत्वा देवानामजनिष्ट चक्षुराविरकर्भुवनं विश्वमुषाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: udu jyotiramṛtaṃ viśvajanyaṃ viśvānaraḥ savitā devo aśret | kratvā devānāmajaniṣṭa cakṣurāvirakarbhuvanaṃ viśvamuṣāḥ ||

translations.english: The divine Savitā, the leader of all, sends upwards the immortal, all- benefiting light; the eye of thegods has been manifested for (the celebration of) religious rites; the Dawn has made all creatures visible.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र मे पन्था देवयाना अदृश्रन्नमर्धन्तो वसुभिरिष्कृतासः । अभूदु केतुरुषसः पुरस्तात्प्रतीच्यागादधि हर्म्येभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra me panthā devayānā adṛśrannamardhanto vasubhiriṣkṛtāsaḥ | abhūdu keturuṣasaḥ purastātpratīcyāgādadhi harmyebhyaḥ ||

translations.english: The paths that lead to the gods are beheld by me, innocuous and glorious with light; the banner ofUṣas is displayed in the east, she comes to the west, rising above high plural ces.

mantras.sanskrit: तानीदहानि बहुलान्यासन्या प्राचीनमुदिता सूर्यस्य । यतः परि जार इवाचरन्त्युषो ददृक्षे न पुनर्यतीव ॥
mantras.transliteration: tānīdahāni bahulānyāsanyā prācīnamuditā sūryasya | yataḥ pari jāra ivācarantyuṣo dadṛkṣe na punaryatīva ||

translations.english: Many are the days that have dawned before the rising of the sun, on which you, Uṣas, have beenbeheld like a wife going to an inconstant husband, and not like one deserting him.

mantras.sanskrit: त इद्देवानां सधमाद आसन्नृतावानः कवयः पूर्व्यासः । गूळ्हं ज्योतिः पितरो अन्वविन्दन्त्सत्यमन्त्रा अजनयन्नुषासम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ta iddevānāṃ sadhamāda āsannṛtāvānaḥ kavayaḥ pūrvyāsaḥ | gūḷhaṃ jyotiḥ pitaro anvavindantsatyamantrā ajanayannuṣāsam ||

translations.english: Those ancient sages, our ancestors, observant of truth, rejoicing together with the gods, discovered thehidden ligh, and, reciters of sincere prayers, they genitive rated the Dawn.

mantras.sanskrit: समान ऊर्वे अधि संगतासः सं जानते न यतन्ते मिथस्ते । ते देवानां न मिनन्ति व्रतान्यमर्धन्तो वसुभिर्यादमानाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samāna ūrve adhi saṃgatāsaḥ saṃ jānate na yatante mithaste | te devānāṃ na minanti vratānyamardhanto vasubhiryādamānāḥ ||

translations.english: When the common herd (of cattle had been stolen) then, associating, they concurred, nor mutuallycontended; they obstructed not the sacrifices of the gods, but, unoffending, proceeded with the light (they hadrecovered).

mantras.sanskrit: प्रति त्वा स्तोमैरीळते वसिष्ठा उषर्बुधः सुभगे तुष्टुवांसः । गवां नेत्री वाजपत्नी न उच्छोषः सुजाते प्रथमा जरस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: prati tvā stomairīḷate vasiṣṭhā uṣarbudhaḥ subhage tuṣṭuvāṃsaḥ | gavāṃ netrī vājapatnī na ucchoṣaḥ sujāte prathamā jarasva ||

translations.english: Auspicious Uṣas, the Vasiṣṭhas, waking at dawn; and praising you, glorify you, glorify you with hymns;Uṣas, who are the conductress of the cattle (to pasture), the bestower of food, dawn upon us; shine, well-bornUṣas, the first (of the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: एषा नेत्री राधसः सूनृतानामुषा उच्छन्ती रिभ्यते वसिष्ठैः । दीर्घश्रुतं रयिमस्मे दधाना यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣā netrī rādhasaḥ sūnṛtānāmuṣā ucchantī ribhyate vasiṣṭhaiḥ | dīrghaśrutaṃ rayimasme dadhānā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Uṣas, the object of the sincere praises of the worshipper, is glorified when dawning, by the Vasiṣṭhasbestowing upon us far-famed riches; do you (gods), ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: उपो रुरुचे युवतिर्न योषा विश्वं जीवं प्रसुवन्ती चरायै । अभूदग्निः समिधे मानुषाणामकर्ज्योतिर्बाधमाना तमांसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: upo ruruce yuvatirna yoṣā viśvaṃ jīvaṃ prasuvantī carāyai | abhūdagniḥ samidhe mānuṣāṇāmakarjyotirbādhamānā tamāṃsi ||

translations.english: Uṣas shines radiant in the proximity (of the sun), like a youthful wife (in the presence of her husband),animating all existence to activity; Agni is to be kindled for the good of men; the light disperses the obstructingdarkness.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वं प्रतीची सप्रथा उदस्थाद्रुशद्वासो बिभ्रती शुक्रमश्वैत् । हिरण्यवर्णा सुदृशीकसंदृग्गवां माता नेत्र्यह्नामरोचि ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvaṃ pratīcī saprathā udasthādruśadvāso bibhratī śukramaśvait | hiraṇyavarṇā sudṛśīkasaṃdṛggavāṃ mātā netryahnāmaroci ||

translations.english: Advancing towards all, and spreading widely, the Dawn has risen; clothed in pure and brilliant vesture,she expands; of golden colour and of lovely radiance, she shines the parent of sounds, the leader of days.

mantras.sanskrit: देवानां चक्षुः सुभगा वहन्ती श्वेतं नयन्ती सुदृशीकमश्वम् । उषा अदर्शि रश्मिभिर्व्यक्ता चित्रामघा विश्वमनु प्रभूता ॥
mantras.transliteration: devānāṃ cakṣuḥ subhagā vahantī śvetaṃ nayantī sudṛśīkamaśvam | uṣā adarśi raśmibhirvyaktā citrāmaghā viśvamanu prabhūtā ||

translations.english: The auspicious Uṣas, bearing the eye of the gods (the light), leading her white and beautiful courser(the sun), is belied, manifested by her rays, disributress of wonderful wealth, mighty over all.

mantras.sanskrit: अन्तिवामा दूरे अमित्रमुच्छोर्वीं गव्यूतिमभयं कृधी नः । यावय द्वेष आ भरा वसूनि चोदय राधो गृणते मघोनि ॥
mantras.transliteration: antivāmā dūre amitramucchorvīṃ gavyūtimabhayaṃ kṛdhī naḥ | yāvaya dveṣa ā bharā vasūni codaya rādho gṛṇate maghoni ||

translations.english: Dawn, Uṣas, who are the bearer to us of desirable (wealth), and keep our adversary from us; renderthe wide earth free from peril; drive away those who hate us; bring to us treasures; bestow, opulent goddesswealth upon him who praises you.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मे श्रेष्ठेभिर्भानुभिर्वि भाह्युषो देवि प्रतिरन्ती न आयुः । इषं च नो दधती विश्ववारे गोमदश्वावद्रथवच्च राधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asme śreṣṭhebhirbhānubhirvi bhāhyuṣo devi pratirantī na āyuḥ | iṣaṃ ca no dadhatī viśvavāre gomadaśvāvadrathavacca rādhaḥ ||

translations.english: Divine Uṣas, illumine us with your brightest rays, prolonging our existence, bestowing upon us food,(and granting us), you who are adored by all, affluence, comprising cattle, horses, and chariots.

mantras.sanskrit: यां त्वा दिवो दुहितर्वर्धयन्त्युषः सुजाते मतिभिर्वसिष्ठाः । सास्मासु धा रयिमृष्वं बृहन्तं यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yāṃ tvā divo duhitarvardhayantyuṣaḥ sujāte matibhirvasiṣṭhāḥ | sāsmāsu dhā rayimṛṣvaṃ bṛhantaṃ yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Well-manifested Uṣas, daughter of heaven, do you, whom the Vasiṣṭhas magnify with praises, bestowupon us brillian and infinite wealth; and do you, (gods), ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रति केतवः प्रथमा अदृश्रन्नूर्ध्वा अस्या अञ्जयो वि श्रयन्ते । उषो अर्वाचा बृहता रथेन ज्योतिष्मता वाममस्मभ्यं वक्षि ॥
mantras.transliteration: prati ketavaḥ prathamā adṛśrannūrdhvā asyā añjayo vi śrayante | uṣo arvācā bṛhatā rathena jyotiṣmatā vāmamasmabhyaṃ vakṣi ||

translations.english: The first signs of the Dawn are visible, her rays are spreading not high; you bring us, Uṣas, desirable(riches) in your vast, descending and resplendent chariot.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रति षीमग्निर्जरते समिद्धः प्रति विप्रासो मतिभिर्गृणन्तः । उषा याति ज्योतिषा बाधमाना विश्वा तमांसि दुरिताप देवी ॥
mantras.transliteration: prati ṣīmagnirjarate samiddhaḥ prati viprāso matibhirgṛṇantaḥ | uṣā yāti jyotiṣā bādhamānā viśvā tamāṃsi duritāpa devī ||

translations.english: The kindled fire increases everywhere, (and) the priests, glorifying (the dawn) with hymns; the divineUṣas comes, driving away all the evil glooms by her lustre.

mantras.sanskrit: एता उ त्याः प्रत्यदृश्रन्पुरस्ताज्ज्योतिर्यच्छन्तीरुषसो विभातीः । अजीजनन्त्सूर्यं यज्ञमग्निमपाचीनं तमो अगादजुष्टम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: etā u tyāḥ pratyadṛśranpurastājjyotiryacchantīruṣaso vibhātīḥ | ajījanantsūryaṃ yajñamagnimapācīnaṃ tamo agādajuṣṭam ||

translations.english: These luminous (beams of the) dawn are beheld in the east diffusing light; (the dawn) enger sacrifice,fire; the odious glooms, descending, disappear.

mantras.sanskrit: अचेति दिवो दुहिता मघोनी विश्वे पश्यन्त्युषसं विभातीम् । आस्थाद्रथं स्वधया युज्यमानमा यमश्वासः सुयुजो वहन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: aceti divo duhitā maghonī viśve paśyantyuṣasaṃ vibhātīm | āsthādrathaṃ svadhayā yujyamānamā yamaśvāsaḥ suyujo vahanti ||

translations.english: The affluent daughter of heaven is perceived; all creatures behold the luminous dawn; she ascends herchariot laden with sustenance, which her easily- yoked horses draw.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रति त्वाद्य सुमनसो बुधन्तास्माकासो मघवानो वयं च । तिल्विलायध्वमुषसो विभातीर्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prati tvādya sumanaso budhantāsmākāso maghavāno vayaṃ ca | tilvilāyadhvamuṣaso vibhātīryūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Affluent (in sacrificial offerings), actuated by one mind, we and ours awaken you, (Uṣas), today;luminous dawns, soften (the earth) with unctuous (dews) and do you, (gods) ever cherish us with blessingṣ

mantras.sanskrit: व्युषा आवः पथ्या जनानां पञ्च क्षितीर्मानुषीर्बोधयन्ती । सुसंदृग्भिरुक्षभिर्भानुमश्रेद्वि सूर्यो रोदसी चक्षसावः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vyuṣā āvaḥ pathyā janānāṃ pañca kṣitīrmānuṣīrbodhayantī | susaṃdṛgbhirukṣabhirbhānumaśredvi sūryo rodasī cakṣasāvaḥ ||

translations.english: Uṣas has dawned upon the paths of men, awaking the five classes of human beings; she has shedlight with her lustrous oxen; the sun makes heaven and earth manifest with radiance.

mantras.sanskrit: व्यञ्जते दिवो अन्तेष्वक्तून्विशो न युक्ता उषसो यतन्ते । सं ते गावस्तम आ वर्तयन्ति ज्योतिर्यच्छन्ति सवितेव बाहू ॥
mantras.transliteration: vyañjate divo anteṣvaktūnviśo na yuktā uṣaso yatante | saṃ te gāvastama ā vartayanti jyotiryacchanti saviteva bāhū ||

translations.english: The dawns send their rays to the ends of the sky. They advance like people arrayed like people (inmartial order); your rays, Uṣas, annihilate the darkness; they diffuse light as Savitā (spreads out) his arms.

mantras.sanskrit: अभूदुषा इन्द्रतमा मघोन्यजीजनत्सुविताय श्रवांसि । वि दिवो देवी दुहिता दधात्यङ्गिरस्तमा सुकृते वसूनि ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhūduṣā indratamā maghonyajījanatsuvitāya śravāṃsi | vi divo devī duhitā dadhātyaṅgirastamā sukṛte vasūni ||

translations.english: The supreme sovereign, the opulent uṣas, has risen; she has engendered food for our welfare; thedivine daughter of heaven, most prompt in movement, bestows treasures upon the pious worshipper.

mantras.sanskrit: तावदुषो राधो अस्मभ्यं रास्व यावत्स्तोतृभ्यो अरदो गृणाना । यां त्वा जज्ञुर्वृषभस्या रवेण वि दृळ्हस्य दुरो अद्रेरौर्णोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tāvaduṣo rādho asmabhyaṃ rāsva yāvatstotṛbhyo arado gṛṇānā | yāṃ tvā jajñurvṛṣabhasyā raveṇa vi dṛḷhasya duro adreraurṇoḥ ||

translations.english: Grant us as much wealth as you have bestowed upon thine adorers when (formerly) praised by them;you whom (your worshippers) welcomed with clamour, (loud as the bellowing) of a bull, when you had set openthe doors of the mountains (where the stolen cattle were confined).

mantras.sanskrit: देवंदेवं राधसे चोदयन्त्यस्मद्र्यक्सूनृता ईरयन्ती । व्युच्छन्ती नः सनये धियो धा यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: devaṃdevaṃ rādhase codayantyasmadryaksūnṛtā īrayantī | vyucchantī naḥ sanaye dhiyo dhā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Inspiring every individual devout (worshipper) with a desire for wealth, addressing to us the words oftruth, diffusing the light of morning, bestow upon us understanding (fit) for the acquisition of riches; and do you,(gods), ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रति स्तोमेभिरुषसं वसिष्ठा गीर्भिर्विप्रासः प्रथमा अबुध्रन् । विवर्तयन्तीं रजसी समन्ते आविष्कृण्वतीं भुवनानि विश्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: prati stomebhiruṣasaṃ vasiṣṭhā gīrbhirviprāsaḥ prathamā abudhran | vivartayantīṃ rajasī samante āviṣkṛṇvatīṃ bhuvanāni viśvā ||

translations.english: The pious Vasiṣṭhas, first (of all worshippers) awaken with prayers and praises (each succeeding)dawn spreading over the like-bounded earth and heaven making all the regions manifest.

mantras.sanskrit: एषा स्या नव्यमायुर्दधाना गूढ्वी तमो ज्योतिषोषा अबोधि । अग्र एति युवतिरह्रयाणा प्राचिकितत्सूर्यं यज्ञमग्निम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣā syā navyamāyurdadhānā gūḍhvī tamo jyotiṣoṣā abodhi | agra eti yuvatirahrayāṇā prācikitatsūryaṃ yajñamagnim ||

translations.english: Bestowing new existence, dispersing the thick darkness by her radiance, the Dawn is awakened andlike an immodest dame, she comes before (the sun), and makes manifest Sūrya, sacrifice and Agni.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्वावतीर्गोमतीर्न उषासो वीरवतीः सदमुच्छन्तु भद्राः । घृतं दुहाना विश्वतः प्रपीता यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvāvatīrgomatīrna uṣāso vīravatīḥ sadamucchantu bhadrāḥ | ghṛtaṃ duhānā viśvataḥ prapītā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: May the auspicious dawns ever break upon us redolen of horses, of cattle, of male posterity, sheddingmoisture, yielding everywhere abundance; and do you, (gods), ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रत्यु अदर्श्यायत्युच्छन्ती दुहिता दिवः । अपो महि व्ययति चक्षसे तमो ज्योतिष्कृणोति सूनरी ॥
mantras.transliteration: pratyu adarśyāyatyucchantī duhitā divaḥ | apo mahi vyayati cakṣase tamo jyotiṣkṛṇoti sūnarī ||

translations.english: The daughter of heaven is everywhere beheld advancing and shedding light; she drives away the deepdarkness that objects may meet the eye; the kind guide of man, she diffuses light.

mantras.sanskrit: उदुस्रियाः सृजते सूर्यः सचाँ उद्यन्नक्षत्रमर्चिवत् । तवेदुषो व्युषि सूर्यस्य च सं भक्तेन गमेमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: udusriyāḥ sṛjate sūryaḥ sacā~ udyannakṣatramarcivat | taveduṣo vyuṣi sūryasya ca saṃ bhaktena gamemahi ||

translations.english: At the same time the sun sends forth his rays, and, rising, renders the plural nets luminous; so, Uṣas,upon your manifestation, and that of Sūrya, may we become possessed of sustenance.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रति त्वा दुहितर्दिव उषो जीरा अभुत्स्महि । या वहसि पुरु स्पार्हं वनन्वति रत्नं न दाशुषे मयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prati tvā duhitardiva uṣo jīrā abhutsmahi | yā vahasi puru spārhaṃ vananvati ratnaṃ na dāśuṣe mayaḥ ||

translations.english: May we, prompt adorers, awaken you, Uṣas, daughter of heaven, bountiful divinity, who bring ampleand desirable (wealth) and happiness, like riches, to the donor (of the oblation).

mantras.sanskrit: उच्छन्ती या कृणोषि मंहना महि प्रख्यै देवि स्वर्दृशे । तस्यास्ते रत्नभाज ईमहे वयं स्याम मातुर्न सूनवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ucchantī yā kṛṇoṣi maṃhanā mahi prakhyai devi svardṛśe | tasyāste ratnabhāja īmahe vayaṃ syāma māturna sūnavaḥ ||

translations.english: Mighty goddess, who, scattering darkness, are endowed with power to arouse the world and make itvisible, we pray that we may be dear to you, the distributress of wealth, as sons are to a mother.

mantras.sanskrit: तच्चित्रं राध आ भरोषो यद्दीर्घश्रुत्तमम् । यत्ते दिवो दुहितर्मर्तभोजनं तद्रास्व भुनजामहै ॥
mantras.transliteration: taccitraṃ rādha ā bharoṣo yaddīrghaśruttamam | yatte divo duhitarmartabhojanaṃ tadrāsva bhunajāmahai ||

translations.english: Bring Uṣas, such wondrous wealth as may be long renowned; bestow, daughter of heaven, thatsustenance which is fit for mortals, such as we may enjoy.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रवः सूरिभ्यो अमृतं वसुत्वनं वाजाँ अस्मभ्यं गोमतः । चोदयित्री मघोनः सूनृतावत्युषा उच्छदप स्रिधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śravaḥ sūribhyo amṛtaṃ vasutvanaṃ vājā~ asmabhyaṃ gomataḥ | codayitrī maghonaḥ sūnṛtāvatyuṣā ucchadapa sridhaḥ ||

translations.english: Grant to the pious immortal fame, conjoined with affluence; grant to us food and cattle; and may Uṣas,the encourager of the wealthy (sacrificer) the speaker of truth, drive away our foes.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रावरुणा युवमध्वराय नो विशे जनाय महि शर्म यच्छतम् । दीर्घप्रयज्युमति यो वनुष्यति वयं जयेम पृतनासु दूढ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāvaruṇā yuvamadhvarāya no viśe janāya mahi śarma yacchatam | dīrghaprayajyumati yo vanuṣyati vayaṃ jayema pṛtanāsu dūḍhyaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra and Varuṇa, bestow upon this man, our employer, a spacious chamber for (the celebration of) thesacrifice; and may we subdue in conflicts such evil-minded person ns as may seek to injure him who has been longengaged (in your adoration).

mantras.sanskrit: सम्राळन्यः स्वराळन्य उच्यते वां महान्ताविन्द्रावरुणा महावसू । विश्वे देवासः परमे व्योमनि सं वामोजो वृषणा सं बलं दधुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samrāḷanyaḥ svarāḷanya ucyate vāṃ mahāntāvindrāvaruṇā mahāvasū | viśve devāsaḥ parame vyomani saṃ vāmojo vṛṣaṇā saṃ balaṃ dadhuḥ ||

translations.english: One of you it titled supreme monarch, so is the other; mighty and most opulent are you, Indra and all thegods in the highest heaven, showerers (of benefits), have combined your united strength, (your) maid vigouṛ

mantras.sanskrit: अन्वपां खान्यतृन्तमोजसा सूर्यमैरयतं दिवि प्रभुम् । इन्द्रावरुणा मदे अस्य मायिनोऽपिन्वतमपितः पिन्वतं धियः ॥
mantras.transliteration: anvapāṃ khānyatṛntamojasā sūryamairayataṃ divi prabhum | indrāvaruṇā made asya māyino'pinvatamapitaḥ pinvataṃ dhiyaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra and Varuṇa, you have forced open by your strength the barriers of the waters; you haveestablished Sūrya as the lord in heaven; in the exhilaration of the inspiring (Soma) you have replenished the dry(beds of the rivers); do you also fulfil the objects of our sacred rite.

mantras.sanskrit: युवामिद्युत्सु पृतनासु वह्नयो युवां क्षेमस्य प्रसवे मितज्ञवः । ईशाना वस्व उभयस्य कारव इन्द्रावरुणा सुहवा हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvāmidyutsu pṛtanāsu vahnayo yuvāṃ kṣemasya prasave mitajñavaḥ | īśānā vasva ubhayasya kārava indrāvaruṇā suhavā havāmahe ||

translations.english: The bearers (of offerings) invoke you, Indra and Varuṇa, in wars, in battles; on banded knees (theAṅgirasas invoke you) for the begetting of prosperity; and we, your worshippers, invoke you, who are entitled torespectful homage, the lords of both celestial and terrestrial treasures.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रावरुणा यदिमानि चक्रथुर्विश्वा जातानि भुवनस्य मज्मना । क्षेमेण मित्रो वरुणं दुवस्यति मरुद्भिरुग्रः शुभमन्य ईयते ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāvaruṇā yadimāni cakrathurviśvā jātāni bhuvanasya majmanā | kṣemeṇa mitro varuṇaṃ duvasyati marudbhirugraḥ śubhamanya īyate ||

translations.english: Indra and Varuṇa, inasmuch as you have created by your might all these beings of the world, thereforeMitra worships Varuṇa for prosperity, while the other, the fierce Indra, associated with the Maruts, acquiresglory.

mantras.sanskrit: महे शुल्काय वरुणस्य नु त्विष ओजो मिमाते ध्रुवमस्य यत्स्वम् । अजामिमन्यः श्नथयन्तमातिरद्दभ्रेभिरन्यः प्र वृणोति भूयसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahe śulkāya varuṇasya nu tviṣa ojo mimāte dhruvamasya yatsvam | ajāmimanyaḥ śnathayantamātiraddabhrebhiranyaḥ pra vṛṇoti bhūyasaḥ ||

translations.english: In honour of (Indra and Varuṇa) the sacrificer and his wife for (the obtaining of) great wealth, confer (bytheir praises) that strength which is peculiar to each of them, and ever-enduring; one of them, (Varuṇa), destroysthe unfriendly man neglecting (his worship); the other, (Indra), with scanty (means), discomfits numerous(enemies).

mantras.sanskrit: न तमंहो न दुरितानि मर्त्यमिन्द्रावरुणा न तपः कुतश्चन । यस्य देवा गच्छथो वीथो अध्वरं न तं मर्तस्य नशते परिह्वृतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: na tamaṃho na duritāni martyamindrāvaruṇā na tapaḥ kutaścana | yasya devā gacchatho vītho adhvaraṃ na taṃ martasya naśate parihvṛtiḥ ||

translations.english: Sin contaminates not, difficulties assail not, nor distress at any time afflicts the mortal, Indra andVaruṇa, to whose sacrifices you, deities, go, and of which you approve; such a man ruin never destroyṣ

mantras.sanskrit: अर्वाङ्नरा दैव्येनावसा गतं शृणुतं हवं यदि मे जुजोषथः । युवोर्हि सख्यमुत वा यदाप्यं मार्डीकमिन्द्रावरुणा नि यच्छतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: arvāṅnarā daivyenāvasā gataṃ śṛṇutaṃ havaṃ yadi me jujoṣathaḥ | yuvorhi sakhyamuta vā yadāpyaṃ mārḍīkamindrāvaruṇā ni yacchatam ||

translations.english: Leaders of rites, come to our presence with divine protection; if you have any regard for me, hear myinvocation; verily your friendship, your affinity, is the source of happiness; grant them, Indra and Varuṇa (untous).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्माकमिन्द्रावरुणा भरेभरे पुरोयोधा भवतं कृष्ट्योजसा । यद्वां हवन्त उभये अध स्पृधि नरस्तोकस्य तनयस्य सातिषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmākamindrāvaruṇā bharebhare puroyodhā bhavataṃ kṛṣṭyojasā | yadvāṃ havanta ubhaye adha spṛdhi narastokasya tanayasya sātiṣu ||

translations.english: Indra and Varuṇa, of irresistible strength, be our preceders in every encounter, for both (past andpresent) worshippers invoke you to defend them iin war, or for the acquisition of sons and grandsons.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मे इन्द्रो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा द्युम्नं यच्छन्तु महि शर्म सप्रथः । अवध्रं ज्योतिरदितेॠतावृधो देवस्य श्लोकं सवितुर्मनामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: asme indro varuṇo mitro aryamā dyumnaṃ yacchantu mahi śarma saprathaḥ | avadhraṃ jyotiraditeṝtāvṛdho devasya ślokaṃ saviturmanāmahe ||

translations.english: May Indra, Varuṇa, Mitra and Aryaman grant us wealth and a large and spacious habitation; may thelustre of Aditi, the augmentress of sacrifice, be innoxious to us; we recite the praise of the divine Savitā.

mantras.sanskrit: युवां नरा पश्यमानास आप्यं प्राचा गव्यन्तः पृथुपर्शवो ययुः । दासा च वृत्रा हतमार्याणि च सुदासमिन्द्रावरुणावसावतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvāṃ narā paśyamānāsa āpyaṃ prācā gavyantaḥ pṛthuparśavo yayuḥ | dāsā ca vṛtrā hatamāryāṇi ca sudāsamindrāvaruṇāvasāvatam ||

translations.english: Indra and Varuṇa, leaders (of rites), contemplating your affinity, and desirous of cattle, the worshippers,armed with large sickles, have proceeded to the east (to cut the sacred grass); destroy, Indra and Varuṇa, yourenemies, whether Dāsās or Āryās and defend Sudāsa with yor protection.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्रा नरः समयन्ते कृतध्वजो यस्मिन्नाजा भवति किं चन प्रियम् । यत्रा भयन्ते भुवना स्वर्दृशस्तत्रा न इन्द्रावरुणाधि वोचतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatrā naraḥ samayante kṛtadhvajo yasminnājā bhavati kiṃ cana priyam | yatrā bhayante bhuvanā svardṛśastatrā na indrāvaruṇādhi vocatam ||

translations.english: Where men assemble with uplifted banners, in whatever conflict, there is something unfavourable;where living beings, looking to heaven, are in fear, there, Indra and Varuṇa, speak tous (encouragement).

mantras.sanskrit: सं भूम्या अन्ता ध्वसिरा अदृक्षतेन्द्रावरुणा दिवि घोष आरुहत् । अस्थुर्जनानामुप मामरातयोऽर्वागवसा हवनश्रुता गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ bhūmyā antā dhvasirā adṛkṣatendrāvaruṇā divi ghoṣa āruhat | asthurjanānāmupa māmarātayo'rvāgavasā havanaśrutā gatam ||

translations.english: The ends of the earth are beheld laid waste; the clamour has ascended, Indra and Varuṇa, to heaven;the adversaries of my people approach me; having heard my invocation, come for my defence.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रावरुणा वधनाभिरप्रति भेदं वन्वन्ता प्र सुदासमावतम् । ब्रह्माण्येषां शृणुतं हवीमनि सत्या तृत्सूनामभवत्पुरोहितिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāvaruṇā vadhanābhiraprati bhedaṃ vanvantā pra sudāsamāvatam | brahmāṇyeṣāṃ śṛṇutaṃ havīmani satyā tṛtsūnāmabhavatpurohitiḥ ||

translations.english: Indra and Varuṇa, you protected Sudāsa, overwhelming the yet unassailed Bheda with your fatalweapons; here the prayers of threse Tṛtsus in time of battle, so that my ministration may have borne them fruit.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रावरुणावभ्या तपन्ति माघान्यर्यो वनुषामरातयः । युवं हि वस्व उभयस्य राजथोऽध स्मा नोऽवतं पार्ये दिवि ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāvaruṇāvabhyā tapanti māghānyaryo vanuṣāmarātayaḥ | yuvaṃ hi vasva ubhayasya rājatho'dha smā no'vataṃ pārye divi ||

translations.english: Indra and Varuṇa, the murderous (weapons) of my enemy distressme; foes among the malignant(assail me); you two are sovereigns over both (celestial and terrestrial) wealth; protect us therefore, onthe day ofbattle.

mantras.sanskrit: युवां हवन्त उभयास आजिष्विन्द्रं च वस्वो वरुणं च सातये । यत्र राजभिर्दशभिर्निबाधितं प्र सुदासमावतं तृत्सुभिः सह ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvāṃ havanta ubhayāsa ājiṣvindraṃ ca vasvo varuṇaṃ ca sātaye | yatra rājabhirdaśabhirnibādhitaṃ pra sudāsamāvataṃ tṛtsubhiḥ saha ||

translations.english: Both (Sudāsa and the Tṛtsus) call upon you two (Indra and Varuṇa), in combats for the acquisition ofwealth, when you defend Sudāsa, together with Tṛtsus, when attacked bythe ten rājās.

mantras.sanskrit: दश राजानः समिता अयज्यवः सुदासमिन्द्रावरुणा न युयुधुः । सत्या नृणामद्मसदामुपस्तुतिर्देवा एषामभवन्देवहूतिषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: daśa rājānaḥ samitā ayajyavaḥ sudāsamindrāvaruṇā na yuyudhuḥ | satyā nṛṇāmadmasadāmupastutirdevā eṣāmabhavandevahūtiṣu ||

translations.english: The ten confederated irreligious rājās did not prevail, Indra and Varuṇa, against Sudāsa; the praiseof the leaders (of rites), the offerers of sacrificial food, was fruitful; the gods were present at their sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: दाशराज्ञे परियत्ताय विश्वतः सुदास इन्द्रावरुणावशिक्षतम् । श्वित्यञ्चो यत्र नमसा कपर्दिनो धिया धीवन्तो असपन्त तृत्सवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dāśarājñe pariyattāya viśvataḥ sudāsa indrāvaruṇāvaśikṣatam | śvityañco yatra namasā kapardino dhiyā dhīvanto asapanta tṛtsavaḥ ||

translations.english: You gave vigour, Indra and Varuṇa, to Sudāsa when surrounded on all sides by the ten rājās (inthe country) where the pious Tṛtsus, walking in whiteness, and wearing braided hair, worshipped with oblationsand praise.

mantras.sanskrit: वृत्राण्यन्यः समिथेषु जिघ्नते व्रतान्यन्यो अभि रक्षते सदा । हवामहे वां वृषणा सुवृक्तिभिरस्मे इन्द्रावरुणा शर्म यच्छतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛtrāṇyanyaḥ samitheṣu jighnate vratānyanyo abhi rakṣate sadā | havāmahe vāṃ vṛṣaṇā suvṛktibhirasme indrāvaruṇā śarma yacchatam ||

translations.english: One of you destroys enemies inbattle, the other ever protects religious observances; we invoke you,showerers (of benefits), with praises; bestow upon us, Indra and Varuṇa, felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मे इन्द्रो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा द्युम्नं यच्छन्तु महि शर्म सप्रथः । अवध्रं ज्योतिरदितेॠतावृधो देवस्य श्लोकं सवितुर्मनामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: asme indro varuṇo mitro aryamā dyumnaṃ yacchantu mahi śarma saprathaḥ | avadhraṃ jyotiraditeṝtāvṛdho devasya ślokaṃ saviturmanāmahe ||

translations.english: May Indra, Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman grant us wealth and a large and spacious mansion; may the lustreof Aditi, the augmentress (of sacrifice), be innoxious to us; we recite the praise of the divine Savitā.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वां राजानावध्वरे ववृत्यां हव्येभिरिन्द्रावरुणा नमोभिः । प्र वां घृताची बाह्वोर्दधाना परि त्मना विषुरूपा जिगाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāṃ rājānāvadhvare vavṛtyāṃ havyebhirindrāvaruṇā namobhiḥ | pra vāṃ ghṛtācī bāhvordadhānā pari tmanā viṣurūpā jigāti ||

translations.english: Royal Indra and Varuṇa, I invite you to the sacrifice with oblations and with praise; the butter-dropping(ladle), held in our hands, offers spontaneously (the oblation) to you who are of many forms.

mantras.sanskrit: युवो राष्ट्रं बृहदिन्वति द्यौर्यौ सेतृभिररज्जुभिः सिनीथः । परि नो हेळो वरुणस्य वृज्या उरुं न इन्द्रः कृणवदु लोकम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvo rāṣṭraṃ bṛhadinvati dyauryau setṛbhirarajjubhiḥ sinīthaḥ | pari no heḷo varuṇasya vṛjyā uruṃ na indraḥ kṛṇavadu lokam ||

translations.english: Your vast kingdom of heaven gratifies (the world with rain), you who bind (the sinner) with bonds notmade of rope; may the wrath of Varuṇa pass away from us; may Indra prepare for us a spacious region.

mantras.sanskrit: कृतं नो यज्ञं विदथेषु चारुं कृतं ब्रह्माणि सूरिषु प्रशस्ता । उपो रयिर्देवजूतो न एतु प्र णः स्पार्हाभिरूतिभिस्तिरेतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kṛtaṃ no yajñaṃ vidatheṣu cāruṃ kṛtaṃ brahmāṇi sūriṣu praśastā | upo rayirdevajūto na etu pra ṇaḥ spārhābhirūtibhistiretam ||

translations.english: Render the sacrifices offered inour dwelling fruitful, the prayers uttered by the worshippers successful;may riches come to us sent by the gods; do you two give us increase by you desirable protections.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मे इन्द्रावरुणा विश्ववारं रयिं धत्तं वसुमन्तं पुरुक्षुम् । प्र य आदित्यो अनृता मिनात्यमिता शूरो दयते वसूनि ॥
mantras.transliteration: asme indrāvaruṇā viśvavāraṃ rayiṃ dhattaṃ vasumantaṃ purukṣum | pra ya ādityo anṛtā minātyamitā śūro dayate vasūni ||

translations.english: Bestow upon us, Indra and Varuṇa, riches desirable to all, together with a dwelling and abundant food,for the hero, Āditya, who punishes beings devoid of truth, gives (to the devout) unbounded treasures.

mantras.sanskrit: इयमिन्द्रं वरुणमष्ट मे गीः प्रावत्तोके तनये तूतुजाना । सुरत्नासो देववीतिं गमेम यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: iyamindraṃ varuṇamaṣṭa me gīḥ prāvattoke tanaye tūtujānā | suratnāso devavītiṃ gamema yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: May this my praise reach Indra and Varuṇa, and, earnestly offered (by me), preserve sons andgrandsons; let us, possessed of affluence, present (their) food to the gods; and do you, (duties), ever cherish uswith blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: पुनीषे वामरक्षसं मनीषां सोममिन्द्राय वरुणाय जुह्वत् । घृतप्रतीकामुषसं न देवीं ता नो यामन्नुरुष्यतामभीके ॥
mantras.transliteration: punīṣe vāmarakṣasaṃ manīṣāṃ somamindrāya varuṇāya juhvat | ghṛtapratīkāmuṣasaṃ na devīṃ tā no yāmannuruṣyatāmabhīke ||

translations.english: I offer to you both adoration, uninterrupted by rākṣasas, presenting the Soma to Indra and to Varuṇa,-- (adoration), of which the members are radiant as the celestial dawn; may these two protect us at the time ofgoing to battle.

mantras.sanskrit: स्पर्धन्ते वा उ देवहूये अत्र येषु ध्वजेषु दिद्यवः पतन्ति । युवं ताँ इन्द्रावरुणावमित्रान्हतं पराचः शर्वा विषूचः ॥
mantras.transliteration: spardhante vā u devahūye atra yeṣu dhvajeṣu didyavaḥ patanti | yuvaṃ tā~ indrāvaruṇāvamitrānhataṃ parācaḥ śarvā viṣūcaḥ ||

translations.english: In the conflict where (combatants) strive against us, in those (contests) in which bright (weapons) fallupon the banners, do you two, Indra and Varuṇa, slay with your shaft those enemies who have been routed, andare scattered in various directions.

mantras.sanskrit: आपश्चिद्धि स्वयशसः सदस्सु देवीरिन्द्रं वरुणं देवता धुः । कृष्टीरन्यो धारयति प्रविक्ता वृत्राण्यन्यो अप्रतीनि हन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: āpaściddhi svayaśasaḥ sadassu devīrindraṃ varuṇaṃ devatā dhuḥ | kṛṣṭīranyo dhārayati praviktā vṛtrāṇyanyo apratīni hanti ||

translations.english: The divine Soma, flowing like water, self-renowned, (offered) at religious assemblies, supoort Indra andVaruṇa; of whom one regulates mankind, distinguished (as good or bad), and the other slays unresisted foeṣ

mantras.sanskrit: स सुक्रतुॠतचिदस्तु होता य आदित्य शवसा वां नमस्वान् । आववर्तदवसे वां हविष्मानसदित्स सुविताय प्रयस्वान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa sukratuṝtacidastu hotā ya āditya śavasā vāṃ namasvān | āvavartadavase vāṃ haviṣmānasaditsa suvitāya prayasvān ||

translations.english: May the devout worshipper derive benefit from sacrifice when offering adoration to you both, sons ofAditi (involved) with strength; he who, liberal of oblations invites you for your satisfaction, may he, possessingabundance, be in the enjoyment of happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: इयमिन्द्रं वरुणमष्ट मे गीः प्रावत्तोके तनये तूतुजाना । सुरत्नासो देववीतिं गमेम यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: iyamindraṃ varuṇamaṣṭa me gīḥ prāvattoke tanaye tūtujānā | suratnāso devavītiṃ gamema yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: May this my praise reach Indra and Varuṇa; and earnestly offered (by me), preserve sons andgrandsons; let us, possessed of affluence, present (their) food to the gods; and do you, (deities), ever cherish uswith blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: धीरा त्वस्य महिना जनूंषि वि यस्तस्तम्भ रोदसी चिदुर्वी । प्र नाकमृष्वं नुनुदे बृहन्तं द्विता नक्षत्रं पप्रथच्च भूम ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhīrā tvasya mahinā janūṃṣi vi yastastambha rodasī cidurvī | pra nākamṛṣvaṃ nunude bṛhantaṃ dvitā nakṣatraṃ paprathacca bhūma ||

translations.english: Permanent in greatness are the births of that Varuṇa who propped up the vast heaven and earth, whoappointed to (their) two-fold (task) the glorious sun and beautiful constellations, who spread out the earth.

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्वया तन्वा सं वदे तत्कदा न्वन्तर्वरुणे भुवानि । किं मे हव्यमहृणानो जुषेत कदा मृळीकं सुमना अभि ख्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta svayā tanvā saṃ vade tatkadā nvantarvaruṇe bhuvāni | kiṃ me havyamahṛṇāno juṣeta kadā mṛḷīkaṃ sumanā abhi khyam ||

translations.english: When may I in my person n converse with the deity? When may I (be admitted) to the heart of Varuṇa?By what means may he, without displeasure, accept my oblation? When may I, rejoicing in mind, behold thatgiver of felicity?

mantras.sanskrit: पृच्छे तदेनो वरुण दिदृक्षूपो एमि चिकितुषो विपृच्छम् । समानमिन्मे कवयश्चिदाहुरयं ह तुभ्यं वरुणो हृणीते ॥
mantras.transliteration: pṛcche tadeno varuṇa didṛkṣūpo emi cikituṣo vipṛccham | samānaminme kavayaścidāhurayaṃ ha tubhyaṃ varuṇo hṛṇīte ||

translations.english: Desirous of beholding you, Varuṇa, I inquire what is my offence; I have gone to make inquiry of thewise; the sages verily have said the same thing to me: -- this Varuṇa is displeased with you.

mantras.sanskrit: किमाग आस वरुण ज्येष्ठं यत्स्तोतारं जिघांससि सखायम् । प्र तन्मे वोचो दूळभ स्वधावोऽव त्वानेना नमसा तुर इयाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kimāga āsa varuṇa jyeṣṭhaṃ yatstotāraṃ jighāṃsasi sakhāyam | pra tanme voco dūḷabha svadhāvo'va tvānenā namasā tura iyām ||

translations.english: What has that great wickedness been, Varuṇa, that you should seek to destroy the worshiper, yourfriend? Insuperable, resplendent Varuṇa, declare it to me, so that, freed from sin, I may quick approach you withveneration.

mantras.sanskrit: अव द्रुग्धानि पित्र्या सृजा नोऽव या वयं चकृमा तनूभिः । अव राजन्पशुतृपं न तायुं सृजा वत्सं न दाम्नो वसिष्ठम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ava drugdhāni pitryā sṛjā no'va yā vayaṃ cakṛmā tanūbhiḥ | ava rājanpaśutṛpaṃ na tāyuṃ sṛjā vatsaṃ na dāmno vasiṣṭham ||

translations.english: Relax (the bonds) imosed by all the ill deeds of our fore-fathers, and those incurred (by the sins) whichwe have committed in our person ns; liberate, royal Varuṇa, like a calf from its tether, Vasiṣṭha like a thiefnourishing the animal (he has stolen).

mantras.sanskrit: न स स्वो दक्षो वरुण ध्रुतिः सा सुरा मन्युर्विभीदको अचित्तिः । अस्ति ज्यायान्कनीयस उपारे स्वप्नश्चनेदनृतस्य प्रयोता ॥
mantras.transliteration: na sa svo dakṣo varuṇa dhrutiḥ sā surā manyurvibhīdako acittiḥ | asti jyāyānkanīyasa upāre svapnaścanedanṛtasya prayotā ||

translations.english: It is not our own choice, Varuṇa, not our condition, (that is the cause of our sinning); it is that which isintoxication, wrath, gambling, ignorance; there is a senior in the proximity of the junior; even a dream is aprovocation to sin.

mantras.sanskrit: अरं दासो न मीळ्हुषे कराण्यहं देवाय भूर्णयेऽनागाः । अचेतयदचितो देवो अर्यो गृत्सं राये कवितरो जुनाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: araṃ dāso na mīḷhuṣe karāṇyahaṃ devāya bhūrṇaye'nāgāḥ | acetayadacito devo aryo gṛtsaṃ rāye kavitaro junāti ||

translations.english: Liberated from sin, I may perform diligent service, like a slave, to the divine showerer (of benefits), thesustainer of the world; may he, the divine lord, give intelligence to us who are devoid of understanding; may hewho is most wise, guide the worshipper to wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं सु तुभ्यं वरुण स्वधावो हृदि स्तोम उपश्रितश्चिदस्तु । शं नः क्षेमे शमु योगे नो अस्तु यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ su tubhyaṃ varuṇa svadhāvo hṛdi stoma upaśritaścidastu | śaṃ naḥ kṣeme śamu yoge no astu yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: May this laudation, food-conferring Varuṇa, be taken to your heart; may success be ours in retainingwhat we have, and in acquiring more; and do you, (deities), ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: रदत्पथो वरुणः सूर्याय प्रार्णांसि समुद्रिया नदीनाम् । सर्गो न सृष्टो अर्वतीॠतायञ्चकार महीरवनीरहभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: radatpatho varuṇaḥ sūryāya prārṇāṃsi samudriyā nadīnām | sargo na sṛṣṭo arvatīṝtāyañcakāra mahīravanīrahabhyaḥ ||

translations.english: Varuṇa prepared a path for the sun; he set free the waters of the rivers genitive rated in the firmament;hastening (to his task), as a horse let loose rushes to (a flock of) mares, he divided the great nights from thedays.

mantras.sanskrit: आत्मा ते वातो रज आ नवीनोत्पशुर्न भूर्णिर्यवसे ससवान् । अन्तर्मही बृहती रोदसीमे विश्वा ते धाम वरुण प्रियाणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ātmā te vāto raja ā navīnotpaśurna bhūrṇiryavase sasavān | antarmahī bṛhatī rodasīme viśvā te dhāma varuṇa priyāṇi ||

translations.english: Your spirit is the wind; he sends abroad the waters; he, the cherisher of the world, is the feeder on(ssacrificial) food, like an animal upon fodder; all your glories, Varuṇa, manifested between the vast andspacious heaven and earth, give delight (to all).

mantras.sanskrit: परि स्पशो वरुणस्य स्मदिष्टा उभे पश्यन्ति रोदसी सुमेके । ऋतावानः कवयो यज्ञधीराः प्रचेतसो य इषयन्त मन्म ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari spaśo varuṇasya smadiṣṭā ubhe paśyanti rodasī sumeke | ṛtāvānaḥ kavayo yajñadhīrāḥ pracetaso ya iṣayanta manma ||

translations.english: The excellent spies of Varuṇa behold the beautiful heaven and earth, as well as those (men) who, thecelebrators of rites, constant in sacrifice, wise and intelligent address (to him their) praise.

mantras.sanskrit: उवाच मे वरुणो मेधिराय त्रिः सप्त नामाघ्न्या बिभर्ति । विद्वान्पदस्य गुह्या न वोचद्युगाय विप्र उपराय शिक्षन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uvāca me varuṇo medhirāya triḥ sapta nāmāghnyā bibharti | vidvānpadasya guhyā na vocadyugāya vipra uparāya śikṣan ||

translations.english: Varuṇa thus spoke to me, possessed of understanding; the cow (speech) has thrice sevenappellations; the wise and intelligent Varuṇa, giving instrumental uction to me, his worthy disciple, had declared themysteries of the plural ce (of Brahma).

mantras.sanskrit: तिस्रो द्यावो निहिता अन्तरस्मिन्तिस्रो भूमीरुपराः षड्विधानाः । गृत्सो राजा वरुणश्चक्र एतं दिवि प्रेङ्खं हिरण्ययं शुभे कम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tisro dyāvo nihitā antarasmintisro bhūmīruparāḥ ṣaḍvidhānāḥ | gṛtso rājā varuṇaścakra etaṃ divi preṅkhaṃ hiraṇyayaṃ śubhe kam ||

translations.english: In him are deposited the three heavens, the three earths with their six seasons are shown in him; themost adorable, royal Varuṇa has made this golden sun undulating in the sky, he has made it to diffuse light.

mantras.sanskrit: अव सिन्धुं वरुणो द्यौरिव स्थाद्द्रप्सो न श्वेतो मृगस्तुविष्मान् । गम्भीरशंसो रजसो विमानः सुपारक्षत्रः सतो अस्य राजा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ava sindhuṃ varuṇo dyauriva sthāddrapso na śveto mṛgastuviṣmān | gambhīraśaṃso rajaso vimānaḥ supārakṣatraḥ sato asya rājā ||

translations.english: (Radiant) as the sun, Varuṇa plural ced the ocean (in its bed) white as a drop (of water), vigorous as anantelope, objects of profound praise, distributor of water, the powerful transporter beyond sin, the ruler of thisexisting (world).

mantras.sanskrit: यो मृळयाति चक्रुषे चिदागो वयं स्याम वरुणे अनागाः । अनु व्रतान्यदितेॠधन्तो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo mṛḷayāti cakruṣe cidāgo vayaṃ syāma varuṇe anāgāḥ | anu vratānyaditeṝdhanto yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: May we be free from sin against that Varuṇa, who has compassion upon him who commits offence, wewho are duly observing the rites of the son Aditi; and do you, (gods), ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र शुन्ध्युवं वरुणाय प्रेष्ठां मतिं वसिष्ठ मीळ्हुषे भरस्व । य ईमर्वाञ्चं करते यजत्रं सहस्रामघं वृषणं बृहन्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra śundhyuvaṃ varuṇāya preṣṭhāṃ matiṃ vasiṣṭha mīḷhuṣe bharasva | ya īmarvāñcaṃ karate yajatraṃ sahasrāmaghaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ bṛhantam ||

translations.english: Offer pure and acceptable praise, Vasiṣṭha to the showerer, Varuṇa, he who makes the adorable(sun), the donor of thousands, the showerer (of benefits), the vast, manifest before (us).

mantras.sanskrit: अधा न्वस्य संदृशं जगन्वानग्नेरनीकं वरुणस्य मंसि । स्वर्यदश्मन्नधिपा उ अन्धोऽभि मा वपुर्दृशये निनीयात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhā nvasya saṃdṛśaṃ jaganvānagneranīkaṃ varuṇasya maṃsi | svaryadaśmannadhipā u andho'bhi mā vapurdṛśaye ninīyāt ||

translations.english: Hastening into his sight, may I (worthily) glorify the aggregated radiance of Varuṇa, when he is theimbiber of the exhilarating beverage (expressed) by the stones; may he render my person n of goodly aspect.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यद्रुहाव वरुणश्च नावं प्र यत्समुद्रमीरयाव मध्यम् । अधि यदपां स्नुभिश्चराव प्र प्रेङ्ख ईङ्खयावहै शुभे कम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yadruhāva varuṇaśca nāvaṃ pra yatsamudramīrayāva madhyam | adhi yadapāṃ snubhiścarāva pra preṅkha īṅkhayāvahai śubhe kam ||

translations.english: When (I, Vasiṣṭha) and Varuṇa ascend the ship together when we send it forth into the midst of theocean, when we proceed over the waters with swift (sailing vessels), then may we both undulate happily in theprosperous swing.

mantras.sanskrit: वसिष्ठं ह वरुणो नाव्याधादृषिं चकार स्वपा महोभिः । स्तोतारं विप्रः सुदिनत्वे अह्नां यान्नु द्यावस्ततनन्यादुषासः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vasiṣṭhaṃ ha varuṇo nāvyādhādṛṣiṃ cakāra svapā mahobhiḥ | stotāraṃ vipraḥ sudinatve ahnāṃ yānnu dyāvastatananyāduṣāsaḥ ||

translations.english: So Varuṇa plural ced Vasiṣṭha in the ship, and by his mighty protection made the ṛṣi a doer of goodworks; the wise Varuṇa plural ced his worshipper in a fortunate day of days, he extended the passing days, thepassing nights.

mantras.sanskrit: क्व त्यानि नौ सख्या बभूवुः सचावहे यदवृकं पुरा चित् । बृहन्तं मानं वरुण स्वधावः सहस्रद्वारं जगमा गृहं ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: kva tyāni nau sakhyā babhūvuḥ sacāvahe yadavṛkaṃ purā cit | bṛhantaṃ mānaṃ varuṇa svadhāvaḥ sahasradvāraṃ jagamā gṛhaṃ te ||
