translations.english: What has become of those our ancient friendships? Let us preserve them unimpaired as of old;food-bestowing Varuṇa, may I go to your vast comprehensive thousand-doored dwelling.

mantras.sanskrit: य आपिर्नित्यो वरुण प्रियः सन्त्वामागांसि कृणवत्सखा ते । मा त एनस्वन्तो यक्षिन्भुजेम यन्धि ष्मा विप्रः स्तुवते वरूथम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya āpirnityo varuṇa priyaḥ santvāmāgāṃsi kṛṇavatsakhā te | mā ta enasvanto yakṣinbhujema yandhi ṣmā vipraḥ stuvate varūtham ||

translations.english: May he your unvarying kin, who was ever dear, though committing offences against you, still be yourfriend; adorable Varuṇa, offending you, let us not enjoy (happiness); but do you, who are wise, bestow on yourworshipper a secure abode.

mantras.sanskrit: ध्रुवासु त्वासु क्षितिषु क्षियन्तो व्यस्मत्पाशं वरुणो मुमोचत् । अवो वन्वाना अदितेरुपस्थाद्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhruvāsu tvāsu kṣitiṣu kṣiyanto vyasmatpāśaṃ varuṇo mumocat | avo vanvānā aditerupasthādyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: While dwelling in these durable worlds, may Varuṇa loose our bonds; may we be enjoyers of theprotection (which has been given by him) from the lap of Aditi, and do you (gods) ever cherish us with blessingṣ

mantras.sanskrit: मो षु वरुण मृन्मयं गृहं राजन्नहं गमम् । मृळा सुक्षत्र मृळय ॥
mantras.transliteration: mo ṣu varuṇa mṛnmayaṃ gṛhaṃ rājannahaṃ gamam | mṛḷā sukṣatra mṛḷaya ||

translations.english: May I never go, royal Varuṇa, to a house made of clay; grant me happiness, possessor of wealth, grantme happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: यदेमि प्रस्फुरन्निव दृतिर्न ध्मातो अद्रिवः । मृळा सुक्षत्र मृळय ॥
mantras.transliteration: yademi prasphuranniva dṛtirna dhmāto adrivaḥ | mṛḷā sukṣatra mṛḷaya ||

translations.english: When, Varuṇa, I am throbbing as if (with awe) like an inflated skin, grant me happiness, possessor ofwealth, grant me happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: क्रत्वः समह दीनता प्रतीपं जगमा शुचे । मृळा सुक्षत्र मृळय ॥
mantras.transliteration: kratvaḥ samaha dīnatā pratīpaṃ jagamā śuce | mṛḷā sukṣatra mṛḷaya ||

translations.english: Opulent and pure (Varuṇa), if through infirmity I have done what is contrary (to the law), yet grant mehappiness, possessor of wealth, grant me happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: अपां मध्ये तस्थिवांसं तृष्णाविदज्जरितारम् । मृळा सुक्षत्र मृळय ॥
mantras.transliteration: apāṃ madhye tasthivāṃsaṃ tṛṣṇāvidajjaritāram | mṛḷā sukṣatra mṛḷaya ||

translations.english: Thirst distresses (me) your worshipper in the midst of the waters; grant me happiness, possessor ofwealth, grant me happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्किं चेदं वरुण दैव्ये जनेऽभिद्रोहं मनुष्याश्चरामसि । अचित्ती यत्तव धर्मा युयोपिम मा नस्तस्मादेनसो देव रीरिषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatkiṃ cedaṃ varuṇa daivye jane'bhidrohaṃ manuṣyāścarāmasi | acittī yattava dharmā yuyopima mā nastasmādenaso deva rīriṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Whatever the offence which we men commit Varuṇa against divine beings, whatever law of yours wemay through ignorance violate, do not you, divine Varuṇa, punish us on account of that iniquity.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वीरया शुचयो दद्रिरे वामध्वर्युभिर्मधुमन्तः सुतासः । वह वायो नियुतो याह्यच्छा पिबा सुतस्यान्धसो मदाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vīrayā śucayo dadrire vāmadhvaryubhirmadhumantaḥ sutāsaḥ | vaha vāyo niyuto yāhyacchā pibā sutasyāndhaso madāya ||

translations.english: The sweet and pure Soma is offered to you, the hero Vāyu, by the priests; therefore, harness yourNiyut steeds, come hither and drink of effused Soma for your exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: ईशानाय प्रहुतिं यस्त आनट् छुचिं सोमं शुचिपास्तुभ्यं वायो । कृणोषि तं मर्त्येषु प्रशस्तं जातोजातो जायते वाज्यस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: īśānāya prahutiṃ yasta ānaṭ chuciṃ somaṃ śucipāstubhyaṃ vāyo | kṛṇoṣi taṃ martyeṣu praśastaṃ jātojāto jāyate vājyasya ||

translations.english: Drinker of the Soma, Vāyu, you elevate him who among mortals offers to you who are the lord anexcellent oblation, the pure Soma; repeatedly born, he is born for the acquisition of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: राये नु यं जज्ञतू रोदसीमे राये देवी धिषणा धाति देवम् । अध वायुं नियुतः सश्चत स्वा उत श्वेतं वसुधितिं निरेके ॥
mantras.transliteration: rāye nu yaṃ jajñatū rodasīme rāye devī dhiṣaṇā dhāti devam | adha vāyuṃ niyutaḥ saścata svā uta śvetaṃ vasudhitiṃ nireke ||

translations.english: His own Niyut steeds bear to the plural ce of poverty the white- complexioned dispenser of wealth, Vāyu,whom heaven and earth bore for the sake of riches, whom the divine language of praise sustains as a deity forthe sake of riches.

mantras.sanskrit: उच्छन्नुषसः सुदिना अरिप्रा उरु ज्योतिर्विविदुर्दीध्यानाः । गव्यं चिदूर्वमुशिजो वि वव्रुस्तेषामनु प्रदिवः सस्रुरापः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ucchannuṣasaḥ sudinā ariprā uru jyotirvividurdīdhyānāḥ | gavyaṃ cidūrvamuśijo vi vavrusteṣāmanu pradivaḥ sasrurāpaḥ ||

translations.english: The blameless dawns (ushering) bright days have broken, and, shining radiantly, (the Aṅgirasas) haveobtained the vast light (the sun); desirous (to recover it) they have obtained their wealth of cattle and the ancientwaters have subsequently issued for their good.

mantras.sanskrit: ते सत्येन मनसा दीध्यानाः स्वेन युक्तासः क्रतुना वहन्ति । इन्द्रवायू वीरवाहं रथं वामीशानयोरभि पृक्षः सचन्ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: te satyena manasā dīdhyānāḥ svena yuktāsaḥ kratunā vahanti | indravāyū vīravāhaṃ rathaṃ vāmīśānayorabhi pṛkṣaḥ sacante ||

translations.english: Those (worshippers) illustrious by sincere adoration, assiduous in the discharge of their own duties,bring to you, Indra and Vāyu, a hero-bearing chariot, and present to you, two soverigns, (sacrificial) fooḍ

mantras.sanskrit: ईशानासो ये दधते स्वर्णो गोभिरश्वेभिर्वसुभिर्हिरण्यैः । इन्द्रवायू सूरयो विश्वमायुरर्वद्भिर्वीरैः पृतनासु सह्युः ॥
mantras.transliteration: īśānāso ye dadhate svarṇo gobhiraśvebhirvasubhirhiraṇyaiḥ | indravāyū sūrayo viśvamāyurarvadbhirvīraiḥ pṛtanāsu sahyuḥ ||

translations.english: May those munificent princes who confer upon us prosperity by gifts of cattle, horses, treasure, gold,overcome, Indra and Vāyu, the entire existence (of their enemies) in contests with horses and with heroeṣ

mantras.sanskrit: अर्वन्तो न श्रवसो भिक्षमाणा इन्द्रवायू सुष्टुतिभिर्वसिष्ठाः । वाजयन्तः स्ववसे हुवेम यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: arvanto na śravaso bhikṣamāṇā indravāyū suṣṭutibhirvasiṣṭhāḥ | vājayantaḥ svavase huvema yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: We, Vasiṣṭha, (bearing oblation) like horses (bearing burdens), soliciting food, desiring strength,invoke with praises Indra and Vāyu for (our) sure defence; do you ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: कुविदङ्ग नमसा ये वृधासः पुरा देवा अनवद्यास आसन् । ते वायवे मनवे बाधितायावासयन्नुषसं सूर्येण ॥
mantras.transliteration: kuvidaṅga namasā ye vṛdhāsaḥ purā devā anavadyāsa āsan | te vāyave manave bādhitāyāvāsayannuṣasaṃ sūryeṇa ||

translations.english: Those venerable worshippers, who by prompted and frequently (adoring Vāyu) with reverence wereformerly free from reproach, have now illumined Uṣas and the sun for sacrificing to Vāyu and (the preservationof) embarrassed mankind.

mantras.sanskrit: उशन्ता दूता न दभाय गोपा मासश्च पाथः शरदश्च पूर्वीः । इन्द्रवायू सुष्टुतिर्वामियाना मार्डीकमीट्टे सुवितं च नव्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uśantā dūtā na dabhāya gopā māsaśca pāthaḥ śaradaśca pūrvīḥ | indravāyū suṣṭutirvāmiyānā mārḍīkamīṭṭe suvitaṃ ca navyam ||

translations.english: Desiring (adoration), proceeding (in the sky), preservers of mankind, be not disposed, Indra and Vāyu,to do us harm; protect us through many months and years; our sincere praise, addressed to you both, solicitshappiness and excellent wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: पीवोअन्नाँ रयिवृधः सुमेधाः श्वेतः सिषक्ति नियुतामभिश्रीः । ते वायवे समनसो वि तस्थुर्विश्वेन्नरः स्वपत्यानि चक्रुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pīvoannā~ rayivṛdhaḥ sumedhāḥ śvetaḥ siṣakti niyutāmabhiśrīḥ | te vāyave samanaso vi tasthurviśvennaraḥ svapatyāni cakruḥ ||

translations.english: The white-complexioned Vāyu, intelligent, glorious with the Niyut steeds, favours those men who arewell fed, abounding in riches, for they with one mind stand everywhere, ready to (worship) him, and leaders ofrites, they perform all the ceremonies, that are productive of excellent offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: यावत्तरस्तन्वो यावदोजो यावन्नरश्चक्षसा दीध्यानाः । शुचिं सोमं शुचिपा पातमस्मे इन्द्रवायू सदतं बर्हिरेदम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yāvattarastanvo yāvadojo yāvannaraścakṣasā dīdhyānāḥ | śuciṃ somaṃ śucipā pātamasme indravāyū sadataṃ barhiredam ||

translations.english: As much as is your rapidity of body, as much as is your vigour, as much as the leaders (of rites) areilluminated by wisdom, (to such extent), drinkers of the pure (Soma) Indra and Varuṇa., drink this our pure Soma,and sit down upon this sacred grass.

mantras.sanskrit: नियुवाना नियुतः स्पार्हवीरा इन्द्रवायू सरथं यातमर्वाक् । इदं हि वां प्रभृतं मध्वो अग्रमध प्रीणाना वि मुमुक्तमस्मे ॥
mantras.transliteration: niyuvānā niyutaḥ spārhavīrā indravāyū sarathaṃ yātamarvāk | idaṃ hi vāṃ prabhṛtaṃ madhvo agramadha prīṇānā vi mumuktamasme ||

translations.english: Harnessing the Niyuts, whom the devout (worshippers) desire, to your common car, come, Indra andVāyu, hither; this the first (cup) of the sweet Soma is prepared for you; and then, delighted (by the draught),liberate us (from sin).

mantras.sanskrit: या वां शतं नियुतो याः सहस्रमिन्द्रवायू विश्ववाराः सचन्ते । आभिर्यातं सुविदत्राभिरर्वाक्पातं नरा प्रतिभृतस्य मध्वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā vāṃ śataṃ niyuto yāḥ sahasramindravāyū viśvavārāḥ sacante | ābhiryātaṃ suvidatrābhirarvākpātaṃ narā pratibhṛtasya madhvaḥ ||

translations.english: Come to our presence, Indra and Vāyu, with those munificent Niyut steeds, who, the desired of all,wait upon you both by hundreds and thousands; drink, leaders (of rites), of the sweet Soma plural ced near (thealtar).

mantras.sanskrit: अर्वन्तो न श्रवसो भिक्षमाणा इन्द्रवायू सुष्टुतिभिर्वसिष्ठाः । वाजयन्तः स्ववसे हुवेम यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: arvanto na śravaso bhikṣamāṇā indravāyū suṣṭutibhirvasiṣṭhāḥ | vājayantaḥ svavase huvema yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: We, Vasiṣṭhas (bearing oblations) like horses (bearing burdens), soliciting food, desiring strength,invoke with praises Indra and Vāyu for our sure defence; do you ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वायो भूष शुचिपा उप नः सहस्रं ते नियुतो विश्ववार । उपो ते अन्धो मद्यमयामि यस्य देव दधिषे पूर्वपेयम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāyo bhūṣa śucipā upa naḥ sahasraṃ te niyuto viśvavāra | upo te andho madyamayāmi yasya deva dadhiṣe pūrvapeyam ||

translations.english: Drinker of the pure (Soma), Vāyu, come to us as your Niyut are thousands; oḥ, you who are desired ofall, I offer you, the exhilarating (sacrificial) food, of which you, deity, have the prior drinking.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सोता जीरो अध्वरेष्वस्थात्सोममिन्द्राय वायवे पिबध्यै । प्र यद्वां मध्वो अग्रियं भरन्त्यध्वर्यवो देवयन्तः शचीभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra sotā jīro adhvareṣvasthātsomamindrāya vāyave pibadhyai | pra yadvāṃ madhvo agriyaṃ bharantyadhvaryavo devayantaḥ śacībhiḥ ||

translations.english: The prompt effuser of the libation offers the Soma to Indra and to Vāyu to drink at the sacrifices, atwhich devout priests, according to their functions, bring to you two the first (portion) of the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र याभिर्यासि दाश्वांसमच्छा नियुद्भिर्वायविष्टये दुरोणे । नि नो रयिं सुभोजसं युवस्व नि वीरं गव्यमश्व्यं च राधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra yābhiryāsi dāśvāṃsamacchā niyudbhirvāyaviṣṭaye duroṇe | ni no rayiṃ subhojasaṃ yuvasva ni vīraṃ gavyamaśvyaṃ ca rādhaḥ ||

translations.english: With those Niyut steeds, with which you go, Vāyu, to the donor (of the libation), waiting in this hall tooffer sacrifice, (come to us), and bestow upon us enjoyable riches, bestow male progeny, and wealth,comprehending cattle, and horses.

mantras.sanskrit: ये वायव इन्द्रमादनास आदेवासो नितोशनासो अर्यः । घ्नन्तो वृत्राणि सूरिभिः ष्याम सासह्वांसो युधा नृभिरमित्रान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye vāyava indramādanāsa ādevāso nitośanāso aryaḥ | ghnanto vṛtrāṇi sūribhiḥ ṣyāma sāsahvāṃso yudhā nṛbhiramitrān ||

translations.english: Overcoming our enemies in war by our warriors, may we be the slayers of foes, through the pious(worshippers) who are the exhilarators of Indra and Vāyu, the reciters of divine hymns, the destroyers of theadversary.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो नियुद्भिः शतिनीभिरध्वरं सहस्रिणीभिरुप याहि यज्ञम् । वायो अस्मिन्त्सवने मादयस्व यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no niyudbhiḥ śatinībhiradhvaraṃ sahasriṇībhirupa yāhi yajñam | vāyo asmintsavane mādayasva yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Come Vāyu, to our imperishable sacrifice, with hundreds and thousands of Niyut steeds, and beexhilarated at this ceremony; do you (gods) ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: शुचिं नु स्तोमं नवजातमद्येन्द्राग्नी वृत्रहणा जुषेथाम् । उभा हि वां सुहवा जोहवीमि ता वाजं सद्य उशते धेष्ठा ॥
mantras.transliteration: śuciṃ nu stomaṃ navajātamadyendrāgnī vṛtrahaṇā juṣethām | ubhā hi vāṃ suhavā johavīmi tā vājaṃ sadya uśate dheṣṭhā ||

translations.english: Slayers of enemies, Indra and Agni, be plural ased today by this pious and newly recited praise; repeatedlydo we invoke you both, who are worthy of invocation; you are the chief bestowers of food promptly upon him whosolicits (it of you).

mantras.sanskrit: ता सानसी शवसाना हि भूतं साकंवृधा शवसा शूशुवांसा । क्षयन्तौ रायो यवसस्य भूरेः पृङ्क्तं वाजस्य स्थविरस्य घृष्वेः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā sānasī śavasānā hi bhūtaṃ sākaṃvṛdhā śavasā śūśuvāṃsā | kṣayantau rāyo yavasasya bhūreḥ pṛṅktaṃ vājasya sthavirasya ghṛṣveḥ ||

translations.english: You two are desired of all, the demolishers of (hostile) strength, augmenting together, increasing invigour, lords of the wealth of corn; do you grant us substantial invigorating food.

mantras.sanskrit: उपो ह यद्विदथं वाजिनो गुर्धीभिर्विप्राः प्रमतिमिच्छमानाः । अर्वन्तो न काष्ठां नक्षमाणा इन्द्राग्नी जोहुवतो नरस्ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: upo ha yadvidathaṃ vājino gurdhībhirviprāḥ pramatimicchamānāḥ | arvanto na kāṣṭhāṃ nakṣamāṇā indrāgnī johuvato naraste ||

translations.english: Those sage offerers of oblations, who, desiring your favour, celebrate the sacrifice with holy rites,hasten to worship you, like horse to battle, repeatedly invoking Indra and Agni.

mantras.sanskrit: गीर्भिर्विप्रः प्रमतिमिच्छमान ईट्टे रयिं यशसं पूर्वभाजम् । इन्द्राग्नी वृत्रहणा सुवज्रा प्र नो नव्येभिस्तिरतं देष्णैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: gīrbhirvipraḥ pramatimicchamāna īṭṭe rayiṃ yaśasaṃ pūrvabhājam | indrāgnī vṛtrahaṇā suvajrā pra no navyebhistirataṃ deṣṇaiḥ ||

translations.english: The pious sage, desiring your favour, glorifies you with praises for the sake of formerly enjoyed riches,accompanied by celebrity; Indra and Agni, slayers of Vṛtra, bearers of the thunderbolt, exalt us with preciousdonations.

mantras.sanskrit: सं यन्मही मिथती स्पर्धमाने तनूरुचा शूरसाता यतैते । अदेवयुं विदथे देवयुभिः सत्रा हतं सोमसुता जनेन ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ yanmahī mithatī spardhamāne tanūrucā śūrasātā yataite | adevayuṃ vidathe devayubhiḥ satrā hataṃ somasutā janena ||

translations.english: As two large, mutually defiant (armies), emulous in corporal vigour, may contend in war, so do youdestroy, by the devout, those who are not devoted to the gods in sacrifice, and, by the man who presentslibations, (him who does not offer).

mantras.sanskrit: इमामु षु सोमसुतिमुप न एन्द्राग्नी सौमनसाय यातम् । नू चिद्धि परिमम्नाथे अस्माना वां शश्वद्भिर्ववृतीय वाजैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imāmu ṣu somasutimupa na endrāgnī saumanasāya yātam | nū ciddhi parimamnāthe asmānā vāṃ śaśvadbhirvavṛtīya vājaiḥ ||

translations.english: Come with gracious minds, Indra and Agni, to this our Soma libation; you are never regardless of us,therefore, I propitiate you with constant (sacrificial) viands.

mantras.sanskrit: सो अग्न एना नमसा समिद्धोऽच्छा मित्रं वरुणमिन्द्रं वोचेः । यत्सीमागश्चकृमा तत्सु मृळ तदर्यमादितिः शिश्रथन्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: so agna enā namasā samiddho'cchā mitraṃ varuṇamindraṃ voceḥ | yatsīmāgaścakṛmā tatsu mṛḷa tadaryamāditiḥ śiśrathantu ||

translations.english: Kindled, Agni, by this adoration, do you recommend us to Mitra, Varuṇa, and Indra; whatever sin wemay have committed, do you expiate, and may Aryaman, Aditi (and Mitra) remove it (from us).

mantras.sanskrit: एता अग्न आशुषाणास इष्टीर्युवोः सचाभ्यश्याम वाजान् । मेन्द्रो नो विष्णुर्मरुतः परि ख्यन्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: etā agna āśuṣāṇāsa iṣṭīryuvoḥ sacābhyaśyāma vājān | mendro no viṣṇurmarutaḥ pari khyanyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Diligently celebrating these rites, may we, Agni, (and Indra), at once arrive at your food; let not Indra,Viṣ.u, the Maruts, abandon us; and do you (gods) ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: इयं वामस्य मन्मन इन्द्राग्नी पूर्व्यस्तुतिः । अभ्राद्वृष्टिरिवाजनि ॥
mantras.transliteration: iyaṃ vāmasya manmana indrāgnī pūrvyastutiḥ | abhrādvṛṣṭirivājani ||

translations.english: This chief praise, Indra and Agni, proceeds (copiously) from me your worshipper, like rain from a cloud.

mantras.sanskrit: शृणुतं जरितुर्हवमिन्द्राग्नी वनतं गिरः । ईशाना पिप्यतं धियः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śṛṇutaṃ jariturhavamindrāgnī vanataṃ giraḥ | īśānā pipyataṃ dhiyaḥ ||

translations.english: Hear, Indra and Agni, the invocation of the worshipper; accept his adoration. Recompense, lords, hispious acts.

mantras.sanskrit: मा पापत्वाय नो नरेन्द्राग्नी माभिशस्तये । मा नो रीरधतं निदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā pāpatvāya no narendrāgnī mābhiśastaye | mā no rīradhataṃ nide ||

translations.english: Leaders of (rites), Indra and Agni, subject us not to wickedness, nor to calumny, nor to the reviler.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रे अग्ना नमो बृहत्सुवृक्तिमेरयामहे । धिया धेना अवस्यवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indre agnā namo bṛhatsuvṛktimerayāmahe | dhiyā dhenā avasyavaḥ ||

translations.english: Desiring protection, we offer copious oblations and praise to Indra and Agni, and prayers with holy rites.

mantras.sanskrit: ता हि शश्वन्त ईळत इत्था विप्रास ऊतये । सबाधो वाजसातये ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā hi śaśvanta īḷata itthā viprāsa ūtaye | sabādho vājasātaye ||

translations.english: Many are the sages who propitiate (Indra and Agni) in this manner for (their) protection, mutuallystriving for the acquisition of food.

mantras.sanskrit: ता वां गीर्भिर्विपन्यवः प्रयस्वन्तो हवामहे । मेधसाता सनिष्यवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā vāṃ gīrbhirvipanyavaḥ prayasvanto havāmahe | medhasātā saniṣyavaḥ ||

translations.english: Eager to offer praise, bearing (sacrificial) food, desirous of wealth, we invoke you, Indra and Agni, withpraises, in the celebration of holy acts.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी अवसा गतमस्मभ्यं चर्षणीसहा । मा नो दुःशंस ईशत ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāgnī avasā gatamasmabhyaṃ carṣaṇīsahā | mā no duḥśaṃsa īśata ||

translations.english: Overcomers of (hostile) men, Indra and Agni, come wiḥ food (to be bestowed) upon us; let not themalevolent have power over us.

mantras.sanskrit: मा कस्य नो अररुषो धूर्तिः प्रणङ्मर्त्यस्य । इन्द्राग्नी शर्म यच्छतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā kasya no araruṣo dhūrtiḥ praṇaṅmartyasya | indrāgnī śarma yacchatam ||

translations.english: Let not the malice of any hostile mortal reach us; gran us, Indra and Agni, felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: गोमद्धिरण्यवद्वसु यद्वामश्वावदीमहे । इन्द्राग्नी तद्वनेमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: gomaddhiraṇyavadvasu yadvāmaśvāvadīmahe | indrāgnī tadvanemahi ||

translations.english: We solicit you both for wealth, comprising cattle, gold and horses; may we obtain it for you, Indra andAgni.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्सोम आ सुते नर इन्द्राग्नी अजोहवुः । सप्तीवन्ता सपर्यवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatsoma ā sute nara indrāgnī ajohavuḥ | saptīvantā saparyavaḥ ||

translations.english: When adoring leaders (of rites), invoke you two, lords of horses, on the Soma being offered, (comehither).

mantras.sanskrit: उक्थेभिर्वृत्रहन्तमा या मन्दाना चिदा गिरा । आङ्गूषैराविवासतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ukthebhirvṛtrahantamā yā mandānā cidā girā | āṅgūṣairāvivāsataḥ ||

translations.english: Utter destroyers of Vṛtra, exhilarated (by the Soma), you who are worshipped with prayers and hymnsand songs, (come hither).

mantras.sanskrit: ताविद्दुःशंसं मर्त्यं दुर्विद्वांसं रक्षस्विनम् । आभोगं हन्मना हतमुदधिं हन्मना हतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tāvidduḥśaṃsaṃ martyaṃ durvidvāṃsaṃ rakṣasvinam | ābhogaṃ hanmanā hatamudadhiṃ hanmanā hatam ||

translations.english: Destroy with your fatal (weapons) the mortal who is malignant, ignorant, strong, rapacious; destroy himlike a water jar, with your weapons.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र क्षोदसा धायसा सस्र एषा सरस्वती धरुणमायसी पूः । प्रबाबधाना रथ्येव याति विश्वा अपो महिना सिन्धुरन्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra kṣodasā dhāyasā sasra eṣā sarasvatī dharuṇamāyasī pūḥ | prabābadhānā rathyeva yāti viśvā apo mahinā sindhuranyāḥ ||

translations.english: This Sarasvatī, firm as a city made of metal, flows rapidly with all sustaining water, sweeping away inits might all other waters, as a charioteer (clears the road).

mantras.sanskrit: एकाचेतत्सरस्वती नदीनां शुचिर्यती गिरिभ्य आ समुद्रात् । रायश्चेतन्ती भुवनस्य भूरेर्घृतं पयो दुदुहे नाहुषाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: ekācetatsarasvatī nadīnāṃ śuciryatī giribhya ā samudrāt | rāyaścetantī bhuvanasya bhūrerghṛtaṃ payo duduhe nāhuṣāya ||

translations.english: Sarasvatī, chief and pure of rivers, flowing from the mountains to the ocean, understood the request ofNahuṣa, and distributing riches among the many existing beings, milked for him butter and water.

mantras.sanskrit: स वावृधे नर्यो योषणासु वृषा शिशुर्वृषभो यज्ञियासु । स वाजिनं मघवद्भ्यो दधाति वि सातये तन्वं मामृजीत ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa vāvṛdhe naryo yoṣaṇāsu vṛṣā śiśurvṛṣabho yajñiyāsu | sa vājinaṃ maghavadbhyo dadhāti vi sātaye tanvaṃ māmṛjīta ||

translations.english: The showerer Sarasvat, the friend of man, a showerer (of benefits), even while yet a child, continuallyincreases among his adorable wives (the rains); he bestows upon the affluent (worshippers) a vigorous son; hepurifies their person ns (to fit them) for the reception (of his bounties).

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्या नः सरस्वती जुषाणोप श्रवत्सुभगा यज्णे अस्मिन् । मितज्ञुभिर्नमस्यैरियाना राया युजा चिदुत्तरा सखिभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta syā naḥ sarasvatī juṣāṇopa śravatsubhagā yajṇe asmin | mitajñubhirnamasyairiyānā rāyā yujā ciduttarā sakhibhyaḥ ||

translations.english: May the auspicious and gracious Sarasvatī hear (our praises) at this sacrifice, approached as she iswith reverence and with bended knees, and most liberal to her friends with the riches she possesses.

mantras.sanskrit: इमा जुह्वाना युष्मदा नमोभिः प्रति स्तोमं सरस्वति जुषस्व । तव शर्मन्प्रियतमे दधाना उप स्थेयाम शरणं न वृक्षम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: imā juhvānā yuṣmadā namobhiḥ prati stomaṃ sarasvati juṣasva | tava śarmanpriyatame dadhānā upa stheyāma śaraṇaṃ na vṛkṣam ||

translations.english: Presenting to you, Sarasvatī, these oblations with reverence (may we receive from you affluence); begratified by our praise and may we, being retained in your dearest felicity, ever recline upon you, as on asheltering tree.

mantras.sanskrit: अयमु ते सरस्वति वसिष्ठो द्वारावृतस्य सुभगे व्यावः । वर्ध शुभ्रे स्तुवते रासि वाजान्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayamu te sarasvati vasiṣṭho dvārāvṛtasya subhage vyāvaḥ | vardha śubhre stuvate rāsi vājānyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Auspicious Sarasvatī, for you Vasiṣṭha has set open the two doors (the east and west) of sacrifice;white-complexioned (goddess), be magnified; bestow food on him who glorifies you; and do you (gods) evercherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: बृहदु गायिषे वचोऽसुर्या नदीनाम् । सरस्वतीमिन्महया सुवृक्तिभिः स्तोमैर्वसिष्ठ रोदसी ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhadu gāyiṣe vaco'suryā nadīnām | sarasvatīminmahayā suvṛktibhiḥ stomairvasiṣṭha rodasī ||

translations.english: You chant, Vasiṣṭha a powerful hymn to her who is the most mighty of rivers; worship, Vasiṣṭha withwell-selected praises, Sarasvatī, who is both in heaven and earth.

mantras.sanskrit: उभे यत्ते महिना शुभ्रे अन्धसी अधिक्षियन्ति पूरवः । सा नो बोध्यवित्री मरुत्सखा चोद राधो मघोनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ubhe yatte mahinā śubhre andhasī adhikṣiyanti pūravaḥ | sā no bodhyavitrī marutsakhā coda rādho maghonām ||

translations.english: Beautiful Sarasvatī, inasmuch as by your might men obtain both kinds of food, do you, our protectress,regard us; do you, the friend of the Maruts, bestow riches upon those who are affluent (in oblations).

mantras.sanskrit: भद्रमिद्भद्रा कृणवत्सरस्वत्यकवारी चेतति वाजिनीवती । गृणाना जमदग्निवत्स्तुवाना च वसिष्ठवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhadramidbhadrā kṛṇavatsarasvatyakavārī cetati vājinīvatī | gṛṇānā jamadagnivatstuvānā ca vasiṣṭhavat ||

translations.english: May the auspicious Sarasvatī bestow auspicious fortune upon us; may the faultless-movingfood-conferring (goddess) think of us; glorified (as you have been) by Jamadagnī, (be now) glorified byVasiṣṭha.

mantras.sanskrit: जनीयन्तो न्वग्रवः पुत्रीयन्तः सुदानवः । सरस्वन्तं हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: janīyanto nvagravaḥ putrīyantaḥ sudānavaḥ | sarasvantaṃ havāmahe ||

translations.english: Desiring wives, desiring sons, liberal of donations, approaching him, now worship Sarasvat.

mantras.sanskrit: ये ते सरस्व ऊर्मयो मधुमन्तो घृतश्चुतः । तेभिर्नोऽविता भव ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye te sarasva ūrmayo madhumanto ghṛtaścutaḥ | tebhirno'vitā bhava ||

translations.english: With those your waves Sarasvat, which are sweet-tasted, the distributors of water, be our protector.

mantras.sanskrit: पीपिवांसं सरस्वतः स्तनं यो विश्वदर्शतः । भक्षीमहि प्रजामिषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pīpivāṃsaṃ sarasvataḥ stanaṃ yo viśvadarśataḥ | bhakṣīmahi prajāmiṣam ||

translations.english: May we recline upon the protuberant breast of Sarasvati. Which is visible to all; that we may possessprogeny and food.

mantras.sanskrit: यज्ञे दिवो नृषदने पृथिव्या नरो यत्र देवयवो मदन्ति । इन्द्राय यत्र सवनानि सुन्वे गमन्मदाय प्रथमं वयश्च ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajñe divo nṛṣadane pṛthivyā naro yatra devayavo madanti | indrāya yatra savanāni sunve gamanmadāya prathamaṃ vayaśca ||

translations.english: At the sacrifice in the dwellings of man upon earth, where the devout leaders of (rites) rejoice, wherethe libations to Indra are poured out, there may he descend before (other gods) from heaven for his exhilaration;(may his) swift (horses approach).

mantras.sanskrit: आ दैव्या वृणीमहेऽवांसि बृहस्पतिर्नो मह आ सखायः । यथा भवेम मीळ्हुषे अनागा यो नो दाता परावतः पितेव ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā daivyā vṛṇīmahe'vāṃsi bṛhaspatirno maha ā sakhāyaḥ | yathā bhavema mīḷhuṣe anāgā yo no dātā parāvataḥ piteva ||

translations.english: Let us solicit, friends divine protections, for Bṛhaspati accepts our (oblations); so may we be withoutoffence towards that showerer (of benefits) whois our benefactor from afar, as a father (of a son).

mantras.sanskrit: तमु ज्येष्ठं नमसा हविर्भिः सुशेवं ब्रह्मणस्पतिं गृणीषे । इन्द्रं श्लोको महि दैव्यः सिषक्तु यो ब्रह्मणो देवकृतस्य राजा ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamu jyeṣṭhaṃ namasā havirbhiḥ suśevaṃ brahmaṇaspatiṃ gṛṇīṣe | indraṃ śloko mahi daivyaḥ siṣaktu yo brahmaṇo devakṛtasya rājā ||

translations.english: I glorify with homage and with oblations that most excellent and beneficent Brahmaṇaspati; may mypraise worthy of the deity, attain to the mighty Indra, who is the lord of the prayers offered by the devout.

mantras.sanskrit: स आ नो योनिं सदतु प्रेष्ठो बृहस्पतिर्विश्ववारो यो अस्ति । कामो रायः सुवीर्यस्य तं दात्पर्षन्नो अति सश्चतो अरिष्टान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa ā no yoniṃ sadatu preṣṭho bṛhaspatirviśvavāro yo asti | kāmo rāyaḥ suvīryasya taṃ dātparṣanno ati saścato ariṣṭān ||

translations.english: May that best beloved Bṛhaspati, who is the desired of all sit down in our hall of sacrifice; may hegratify our desire of riches and of male posterity. Transporting us (at present) embarrassed uninjured beyond(the assaults of enemies).

mantras.sanskrit: तमा नो अर्कममृताय जुष्टमिमे धासुरमृतासः पुराजाः । शुचिक्रन्दं यजतं पस्त्यानां बृहस्पतिमनर्वाणं हुवेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamā no arkamamṛtāya juṣṭamime dhāsuramṛtāsaḥ purājāḥ | śucikrandaṃ yajataṃ pastyānāṃ bṛhaspatimanarvāṇaṃ huvema ||

translations.english: May the first-born immortals (by his command) bestow upon us the food that is necessary for existence;let us invoke the unresisted Bṛhaspati, to whom pure praises are addressed, he adored of householder.

mantras.sanskrit: तं शग्मासो अरुषासो अश्वा बृहस्पतिं सहवाहो वहन्ति । सहश्चिद्यस्य नीलवत्सधस्थं नभो न रूपमरुषं वसानाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ śagmāso aruṣāso aśvā bṛhaspatiṃ sahavāho vahanti | sahaścidyasya nīlavatsadhasthaṃ nabho na rūpamaruṣaṃ vasānāḥ ||

translations.english: May his powerful brilliant horses, wearing a lustrous form like (that of) the sun, acting together, bring(hither) that Bṛhaspai, in whom strength abides like that of a substantial mansion.

mantras.sanskrit: स हि शुचिः शतपत्रः स शुन्ध्युर्हिरण्यवाशीरिषिरः स्वर्षाः । बृहस्पतिः स स्वावेश ऋष्वः पुरू सखिभ्य आसुतिं करिष्ठः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa hi śuciḥ śatapatraḥ sa śundhyurhiraṇyavāśīriṣiraḥ svarṣāḥ | bṛhaspatiḥ sa svāveśa ṛṣvaḥ purū sakhibhya āsutiṃ kariṣṭhaḥ ||

translations.english: He verily is pure, borne by numerous conveyances, he is the purifier armed with golden weapons, theobject of desire, the enjoyer of heaven; he, Bṛhaspati is well domiciled, of goodly aspect, a most bountiful giverof ample food to his friend.

mantras.sanskrit: देवी देवस्य रोदसी जनित्री बृहस्पतिं वावृधतुर्महित्वा । दक्षाय्याय दक्षता सखायः करद्ब्रह्मणे सुतरा सुगाधा ॥
mantras.transliteration: devī devasya rodasī janitrī bṛhaspatiṃ vāvṛdhaturmahitvā | dakṣāyyāya dakṣatā sakhāyaḥ karadbrahmaṇe sutarā sugādhā ||

translations.english: The divine heaven and earth, the genitive ratrices of the deity have by their might, given growth toBṛhaspati; magnify, friends, the magnifiable, and may he render (the waters) easy to be crossed and forded for(the attainment of) food.

mantras.sanskrit: इयं वां ब्रह्मणस्पते सुवृक्तिर्ब्रह्मेन्द्राय वज्रिणे अकारि । अविष्टं धियो जिगृतं पुरंधीर्जजस्तमर्यो वनुषामरातीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: iyaṃ vāṃ brahmaṇaspate suvṛktirbrahmendrāya vajriṇe akāri | aviṣṭaṃ dhiyo jigṛtaṃ puraṃdhīrjajastamaryo vanuṣāmarātīḥ ||

translations.english: This praise has been offered as prayer to you both, Brahmaṇaspati and Indra, the wielder of thethunderbolt; protect our ceremonies; hear our manifold praise; annihilate the assailing adversaries of yourworshippers.

mantras.sanskrit: बृहस्पते युवमिन्द्रश्च वस्वो दिव्यस्येशाथे उत पार्थिवस्य । धत्तं रयिं स्तुवते कीरये चिद्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhaspate yuvamindraśca vasvo divyasyeśāthe uta pārthivasya | dhattaṃ rayiṃ stuvate kīraye cidyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: You two, Bṛhaspati and Indra are lords of both celestial and terrestrial treasure; grant riches to theworshipper who praises you; and do you (gods) ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: अध्वर्यवोऽरुणं दुग्धमंशुं जुहोतन वृषभाय क्षितीनाम् । गौराद्वेदीयाँ अवपानमिन्द्रो विश्वाहेद्याति सुतसोममिच्छन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhvaryavo'ruṇaṃ dugdhamaṃśuṃ juhotana vṛṣabhāya kṣitīnām | gaurādvedīyā~ avapānamindro viśvāhedyāti sutasomamicchan ||

translations.english: Offer, priests, the shining effused Soma o him who is eminent (among) men; knowing better than theGaura where his distant drinking-plural ce (is to be found). Indra comes daily seeking for the offerer of the libatioṇ

mantras.sanskrit: यद्दधिषे प्रदिवि चार्वन्नं दिवेदिवे पीतिमिदस्य वक्षि । उत हृदोत मनसा जुषाण उशन्निन्द्र प्रस्थितान्पाहि सोमान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaddadhiṣe pradivi cārvannaṃ divedive pītimidasya vakṣi | uta hṛdota manasā juṣāṇa uśannindra prasthitānpāhi somān ||

translations.english: The plural asant Soma that you, Indra, have quaffed in former days, you still desire to drink of daily;gratified in heart and mind, and wishing (our good), drink, Indra the Soma, that is plural ced before (you).

mantras.sanskrit: जज्ञानः सोमं सहसे पपाथ प्र ते माता महिमानमुवाच । एन्द्र पप्राथोर्वन्तरिक्षं युधा देवेभ्यो वरिवश्चकर्थ ॥
mantras.transliteration: jajñānaḥ somaṃ sahase papātha pra te mātā mahimānamuvāca | endra paprāthorvantarikṣaṃ yudhā devebhyo varivaścakartha ||

translations.english: As soon as born, Indra you have drunk the Soma for your invigoration; your mother (Aditi) proclaimedyour greatness; hence you have filled the vast firmament. Indra, you have gained in battle treasure for the godṣ

mantras.sanskrit: यद्योधया महतो मन्यमानान्त्साक्षाम तान्बाहुभिः शाशदानान् । यद्वा नृभिर्वृत इन्द्राभियुध्यास्तं त्वयाजिं सौश्रवसं जयेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadyodhayā mahato manyamānāntsākṣāma tānbāhubhiḥ śāśadānān | yadvā nṛbhirvṛta indrābhiyudhyāstaṃ tvayājiṃ sauśravasaṃ jayema ||

translations.english: When you enable us to encounter mighty and arrogant (enemies), we are competent to overcome themalignant by our (unarmed) hands alone; and when you, Indra, surrounded by your attendants (Maruts), fightagainst them, we shall triumph, aided by you (in) that glorious war.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रेन्द्रस्य वोचं प्रथमा कृतानि प्र नूतना मघवा या चकार । यदेददेवीरसहिष्ट माया अथाभवत्केवलः सोमो अस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: prendrasya vocaṃ prathamā kṛtāni pra nūtanā maghavā yā cakāra | yadedadevīrasahiṣṭa māyā athābhavatkevalaḥ somo asya ||

translations.english: I proclaim the ancient exploits of Indra the recent deeds that Maghavan has achieved; when indeed hehad overcome the undivine illusion, thenceforth the Soma became his exclusive.

mantras.sanskrit: तवेदं विश्वमभितः पशव्यं यत्पश्यसि चक्षसा सूर्यस्य । गवामसि गोपतिरेक इन्द्र भक्षीमहि ते प्रयतस्य वस्वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tavedaṃ viśvamabhitaḥ paśavyaṃ yatpaśyasi cakṣasā sūryasya | gavāmasi gopatireka indra bhakṣīmahi te prayatasya vasvaḥ ||

translations.english: Thine is all this animal world around you, which you illumine with the light of the sun; you, Indra, are theone lord of cattle, thence may we possess wealh bestowed by you.

mantras.sanskrit: बृहस्पते युवमिन्द्रश्च वस्वो दिव्यस्येशाथे उत पार्थिवस्य । धत्तं रयिं स्तुवते कीरये चिद्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhaspate yuvamindraśca vasvo divyasyeśāthe uta pārthivasya | dhattaṃ rayiṃ stuvate kīraye cidyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: You two Bṛhaspati and Indra are lords of both celestial and terrestrial treasure; grant riches to theworshipper who praises you; and do you (gods) ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: परो मात्रया तन्वा वृधान न ते महित्वमन्वश्नुवन्ति । उभे ते विद्म रजसी पृथिव्या विष्णो देव त्वं परमस्य वित्से ॥
mantras.transliteration: paro mātrayā tanvā vṛdhāna na te mahitvamanvaśnuvanti | ubhe te vidma rajasī pṛthivyā viṣṇo deva tvaṃ paramasya vitse ||

translations.english: Expanding with a body beyond all measure, Viṣṇu men comprehend not your magnitude; we knowthese your two worlds (computing) from the earth, but you, divine Viṣṇu, are cognisant of the highest.

mantras.sanskrit: न ते विष्णो जायमानो न जातो देव महिम्नः परमन्तमाप । उदस्तभ्ना नाकमृष्वं बृहन्तं दाधर्थ प्राचीं ककुभं पृथिव्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: na te viṣṇo jāyamāno na jāto deva mahimnaḥ paramantamāpa | udastabhnā nākamṛṣvaṃ bṛhantaṃ dādhartha prācīṃ kakubhaṃ pṛthivyāḥ ||

translations.english: No being that is or that has been born, divine Viṣṇu, has attained the utmost limit of your magnitude bywhich you have upheld the vast and beautiful heaven, and sustained the eastern horizon of the earth.

mantras.sanskrit: इरावती धेनुमती हि भूतं सूयवसिनी मनुषे दशस्या । व्यस्तभ्ना रोदसी विष्णवेते दाधर्थ पृथिवीमभितो मयूखैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: irāvatī dhenumatī hi bhūtaṃ sūyavasinī manuṣe daśasyā | vyastabhnā rodasī viṣṇavete dādhartha pṛthivīmabhito mayūkhaiḥ ||

translations.english: Heaven and earth, abounding with food, abounding with cattle, yielding abundant fodder, you aredisposed to be liberal to the man (who praises you); you, Viṣṇu, have upheld these two heaven and earth, andhave secured the earth around with mountains.

mantras.sanskrit: उरुं यज्ञाय चक्रथुरु लोकं जनयन्ता सूर्यमुषासमग्निम् । दासस्य चिद्वृषशिप्रस्य माया जघ्नथुर्नरा पृतनाज्येषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: uruṃ yajñāya cakrathuru lokaṃ janayantā sūryamuṣāsamagnim | dāsasya cidvṛṣaśiprasya māyā jaghnathurnarā pṛtanājyeṣu ||

translations.english: You two, Indra and Viṣṇu, have made the spacious world for the sake of sacrifice, genitive rating the sun,the dawn, Agni; you leaders (of rites) have baffled the devices of the slave Vṛsaśipra in the conflict of hosts.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राविष्णू दृंहिताः शम्बरस्य नव पुरो नवतिं च श्नथिष्टम् । शतं वर्चिनः सहस्रं च साकं हथो अप्रत्यसुरस्य वीरान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāviṣṇū dṛṃhitāḥ śambarasya nava puro navatiṃ ca śnathiṣṭam | śataṃ varcinaḥ sahasraṃ ca sākaṃ hatho apratyasurasya vīrān ||

translations.english: Indra and Viṣṇu, you have demolished the ninety-nine strong cities of Śambara; you have slain atonce, without resistance, the hundred thousand heroes of the Asura Varcin.

mantras.sanskrit: इयं मनीषा बृहती बृहन्तोरुक्रमा तवसा वर्धयन्ती । ररे वां स्तोमं विदथेषु विष्णो पिन्वतमिषो वृजनेष्विन्द्र ॥
mantras.transliteration: iyaṃ manīṣā bṛhatī bṛhantorukramā tavasā vardhayantī | rare vāṃ stomaṃ vidatheṣu viṣṇo pinvatamiṣo vṛjaneṣvindra ||

translations.english: The ample laudation is magnifying you two, who are mighty, wide- striding, endowed with strength; toyou two, Viṣṇu and Indra, I offer praise at sacrifices; grant us food (won) in battles.

mantras.sanskrit: वषट् ते विष्णवास आ कृणोमि तन्मे जुषस्व शिपिविष्ट हव्यम् । वर्धन्तु त्वा सुष्टुतयो गिरो मे यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vaṣaṭ te viṣṇavāsa ā kṛṇomi tanme juṣasva śipiviṣṭa havyam | vardhantu tvā suṣṭutayo giro me yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: I offer, Viṣṇu, the oblation plural ced before you with the exclamation Vaṣa: be plural ased, Śipiviṣṭa, withmy offering; may my laudatory hymns magnify you; and do you (gods) ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: नू मर्तो दयते सनिष्यन्यो विष्णव उरुगायाय दाशत् । प्र यः सत्राचा मनसा यजात एतावन्तं नर्यमाविवासात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū marto dayate saniṣyanyo viṣṇava urugāyāya dāśat | pra yaḥ satrācā manasā yajāta etāvantaṃ naryamāvivāsāt ||

translations.english: The mortal desirous of wealth quickly obtains it who presents (offerings) to the widely-renownedViṣṇu, who worships him with entirely devoted mind, who adores so great a benefactor of mankind.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं विष्णो सुमतिं विश्वजन्यामप्रयुतामेवयावो मतिं दाः । पर्चो यथा नः सुवितस्य भूरेरश्वावतः पुरुश्चन्द्रस्य रायः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ viṣṇo sumatiṃ viśvajanyāmaprayutāmevayāvo matiṃ dāḥ | parco yathā naḥ suvitasya bhūreraśvāvataḥ puruścandrasya rāyaḥ ||

translations.english: Viṣṇu, granter of desires, show to us that favourable disposition which is benevolent to all, unmixed(with exception), so that there may be to us the attainment of easily-acquire, ample, steed-comprising,all-delighting riches.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिर्देवः पृथिवीमेष एतां वि चक्रमे शतर्चसं महित्वा । प्र विष्णुरस्तु तवसस्तवीयान्त्वेषं ह्यस्य स्थविरस्य नाम ॥
mantras.transliteration: trirdevaḥ pṛthivīmeṣa etāṃ vi cakrame śatarcasaṃ mahitvā | pra viṣṇurastu tavasastavīyāntveṣaṃ hyasya sthavirasya nāma ||

translations.english: This deity, by his great power, traversed with three (steps) the many- lustrous earth; may Viṣṇu, themost powerful of the powerful rule over us, for illustrious is the name of the mighty one.

mantras.sanskrit: वि चक्रमे पृथिवीमेष एतां क्षेत्राय विष्णुर्मनुषे दशस्यन् । ध्रुवासो अस्य कीरयो जनास उरुक्षितिं सुजनिमा चकार ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi cakrame pṛthivīmeṣa etāṃ kṣetrāya viṣṇurmanuṣe daśasyan | dhruvāso asya kīrayo janāsa urukṣitiṃ sujanimā cakāra ||

translations.english: This Viṣṇu traversed the earth for a dwelling which he was desirous of giving to his eulogist; firm arethe people who are his praisers; he who is the engenderer of good has made a spacious dwelling (for hisworshippers).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र तत्ते अद्य शिपिविष्ट नामार्यः शंसामि वयुनानि विद्वान् । तं त्वा गृणामि तवसमतव्यान्क्षयन्तमस्य रजसः पराके ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra tatte adya śipiviṣṭa nāmāryaḥ śaṃsāmi vayunāni vidvān | taṃ tvā gṛṇāmi tavasamatavyānkṣayantamasya rajasaḥ parāke ||

translations.english: Resplendent Viṣṇu, I, the master of the offering, knowing the objects that are to be known, glorifytoday your name; I who am feeble, praise you who are powerful, dwelling in a remote region of this worlḍ

mantras.sanskrit: किमित्ते विष्णो परिचक्ष्यं भूत्प्र यद्ववक्षे शिपिविष्टो अस्मि । मा वर्पो अस्मदप गूह एतद्यदन्यरूपः समिथे बभूथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: kimitte viṣṇo paricakṣyaṃ bhūtpra yadvavakṣe śipiviṣṭo asmi | mā varpo asmadapa gūha etadyadanyarūpaḥ samithe babhūtha ||

translations.english: What is to be proclaimed, Viṣṇu, of you, when you save. I am Śipiviṣṭa? Conceal not from us yourreal form, although you have engaged under a different form in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: वषट् ते विष्णवास आ कृणोमि तन्मे जुषस्व शिपिविष्ट हव्यम् । वर्धन्तु त्वा सुष्टुतयो गिरो मे यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vaṣaṭ te viṣṇavāsa ā kṛṇomi tanme juṣasva śipiviṣṭa havyam | vardhantu tvā suṣṭutayo giro me yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: I offer, Viṣṇu, the oblation plural ced before you with the exclamation Vaṣaṭ; be plural ased, Śipiviṣṭa, withmy offering; may my laudatory hymns magnify you and do you (gods) ever cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: तिस्रो वाचः प्र वद ज्योतिरग्रा या एतद्दुह्रे मधुदोघमूधः । स वत्सं कृण्वन्गर्भमोषधीनां सद्यो जातो वृषभो रोरवीति ॥
mantras.transliteration: tisro vācaḥ pra vada jyotiragrā yā etadduhre madhudoghamūdhaḥ | sa vatsaṃ kṛṇvangarbhamoṣadhīnāṃ sadyo jāto vṛṣabho roravīti ||

translations.english: Recite the three sacred texts, preceded by light, which milk the water- yielding udder; for he, theshowerer, (thereby) becoming quickly manifest, loudly roars, engendering the (lightning) infant, the embryo of theplants.

mantras.sanskrit: यो वर्धन ओषधीनां यो अपां यो विश्वस्य जगतो देव ईशे । स त्रिधातु शरणं शर्म यंसत्त्रिवर्तु ज्योतिः स्वभिष्ट्यस्मे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo vardhana oṣadhīnāṃ yo apāṃ yo viśvasya jagato deva īśe | sa tridhātu śaraṇaṃ śarma yaṃsattrivartu jyotiḥ svabhiṣṭyasme ||

translations.english: May he who is the augmenter of plural nts, the increase of the waters, who rules divine over the wholeearth, bestow upon us a three-storied dwelling and felicity; may he grant us the desired light (of the sun) at thethree (bright) seasons.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तरीरु त्वद्भवति सूत उ त्वद्यथावशं तन्वं चक्र एषः । पितुः पयः प्रति गृभ्णाति माता तेन पिता वर्धते तेन पुत्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: starīru tvadbhavati sūta u tvadyathāvaśaṃ tanvaṃ cakra eṣaḥ | pituḥ payaḥ prati gṛbhṇāti mātā tena pitā vardhate tena putraḥ ||

translations.english: One form of Parjanya is like a barren cow the other produces offspring, he takes whichever form hepleases; the mother receives the milk from the father thence the father, thence the son is nourished.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्मिन्विश्वानि भुवनानि तस्थुस्तिस्रो द्यावस्त्रेधा सस्रुरापः । त्रयः कोशास उपसेचनासो मध्वः श्चोतन्त्यभितो विरप्शम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasminviśvāni bhuvanāni tasthustisro dyāvastredhā sasrurāpaḥ | trayaḥ kośāsa upasecanāso madhvaḥ ścotantyabhito virapśam ||

translations.english: In whom all beings exist; the three worlds abide; from whom the waters flow in three directions (east,west, and south); the three water-shedding masses of clouds (east, west, and north) pour the waters round themighty (Parjanya).

mantras.sanskrit: इदं वचः पर्जन्याय स्वराजे हृदो अस्त्वन्तरं तज्जुजोषत् । मयोभुवो वृष्टयः सन्त्वस्मे सुपिप्पला ओषधीर्देवगोपाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: idaṃ vacaḥ parjanyāya svarāje hṛdo astvantaraṃ tajjujoṣat | mayobhuvo vṛṣṭayaḥ santvasme supippalā oṣadhīrdevagopāḥ ||

translations.english: This praise is addressed to the self-irradiating Parjanya; may it be plural ced in his heart; may he begratified by it; may the joy-diffusing rains be ours; may the plural nts cherished by the deiy be fruitful.

mantras.sanskrit: स रेतोधा वृषभः शश्वतीनां तस्मिन्नात्मा जगतस्तस्थुषश्च । तन्म ऋतं पातु शतशारदाय यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa retodhā vṛṣabhaḥ śaśvatīnāṃ tasminnātmā jagatastasthuṣaśca | tanma ṛtaṃ pātu śataśāradāya yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: May he, the bull, be the impregnator of the perpetual plural ns, for in him is the vitality of both the fixed andmoveable (world); may the rain sent by him preserve me for a hundred years; and do you (gods) ever cherish uswith blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: पर्जन्याय प्र गायत दिवस्पुत्राय मीळ्हुषे । स नो यवसमिच्छतु ॥
mantras.transliteration: parjanyāya pra gāyata divasputrāya mīḷhuṣe | sa no yavasamicchatu ||

translations.english: Sing aloud to the son of heaven, Parjanya, the sender of rain; may he be plural ased (to grant) us food.

mantras.sanskrit: यो गर्भमोषधीनां गवां कृणोत्यर्वताम् । पर्जन्यः पुरुषीणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo garbhamoṣadhīnāṃ gavāṃ kṛṇotyarvatām | parjanyaḥ puruṣīṇām ||

translations.english: He who is the cause of impregnation of plural nts, of cows, of mares, of women.

mantras.sanskrit: तस्मा इदास्ये हविर्जुहोता मधुमत्तमम् । इळां नः संयतं करत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tasmā idāsye havirjuhotā madhumattamam | iḷāṃ naḥ saṃyataṃ karat ||

translations.english: Offer verily to him by the mouth (of the gods, Agni), the most savoury oblation, so that he may yield usfood unfailingly.

mantras.sanskrit: संवत्सरं शशयाना ब्राह्मणा व्रतचारिणः । वाचं पर्जन्यजिन्वितां प्र मण्डूका अवादिषुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃvatsaraṃ śaśayānā brāhmaṇā vratacāriṇaḥ | vācaṃ parjanyajinvitāṃ pra maṇḍūkā avādiṣuḥ ||

translations.english: The frogs, like Brāhmaṇas, observant of their vows, practising penance throughout the year, utteraloud praises agreeable to Parjanya.

mantras.sanskrit: दिव्या आपो अभि यदेनमायन्दृतिं न शुष्कं सरसी शयानम् । गवामह न मायुर्वत्सिनीनां मण्डूकानां वग्नुरत्रा समेति ॥
mantras.transliteration: divyā āpo abhi yadenamāyandṛtiṃ na śuṣkaṃ sarasī śayānam | gavāmaha na māyurvatsinīnāṃ maṇḍūkānāṃ vagnuratrā sameti ||

translations.english: When the waters of the sky fall upon (the troop of frogs) sleeping in the (exhausted) lake like a drywater-skin; then rises together the croaking of the frogs, like the bellowing of cows when joined by their calves.

mantras.sanskrit: यदीमेनाँ उशतो अभ्यवर्षीत्तृष्यावतः प्रावृष्यागतायाम् । अख्खलीकृत्या पितरं न पुत्रो अन्यो अन्यमुप वदन्तमेति ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadīmenā~ uśato abhyavarṣīttṛṣyāvataḥ prāvṛṣyāgatāyām | akhkhalīkṛtyā pitaraṃ na putro anyo anyamupa vadantameti ||

translations.english: When the rainy season has arrived, and (Parjanya) has sent the rain upon them, thirsty and longing (forits coming), then one frog meets another croaking (his congratulations) as a child (calls to) its father withinarticulate ejaculations.

mantras.sanskrit: अन्यो अन्यमनु गृभ्णात्येनोरपां प्रसर्गे यदमन्दिषाताम् । मण्डूको यदभिवृष्टः कनिष्कन्पृश्निः सम्पृङ्क्ते हरितेन वाचम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: anyo anyamanu gṛbhṇātyenorapāṃ prasarge yadamandiṣātām | maṇḍūko yadabhivṛṣṭaḥ kaniṣkanpṛśniḥ sampṛṅkte haritena vācam ||

translations.english: One of these two congratulates the other as they are both delighting in the forthcoming of rain; thespeckled frog, leaping up repeatedly when moistened (by the shower), joins greetings with the green one.

mantras.sanskrit: यदेषामन्यो अन्यस्य वाचं शाक्तस्येव वदति शिक्षमाणः । सर्वं तदेषां समृधेव पर्व यत्सुवाचो वदथनाध्यप्सु ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadeṣāmanyo anyasya vācaṃ śāktasyeva vadati śikṣamāṇaḥ | sarvaṃ tadeṣāṃ samṛdheva parva yatsuvāco vadathanādhyapsu ||

translations.english: When one of you imitates the croaking of another as a learner (imitates) his teacher, when, loud crying,you converse (leaping) upon the waters, then the enire body is as it were developed.

mantras.sanskrit: गोमायुरेको अजमायुरेकः पृश्निरेको हरित एक एषाम् । समानं नाम बिभ्रतो विरूपाः पुरुत्रा वाचं पिपिशुर्वदन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: gomāyureko ajamāyurekaḥ pṛśnireko harita eka eṣām | samānaṃ nāma bibhrato virūpāḥ purutrā vācaṃ pipiśurvadantaḥ ||

translations.english: One frog has the bellowing of a cow, another the bleating of a goat; one of them is speckled, one isgreen; designated by a common appellation, they are of various colours and croaking, show themselves innumerous plural ces.

mantras.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणासो अतिरात्रे न सोमे सरो न पूर्णमभितो वदन्तः । संवत्सरस्य तदहः परि ष्ठ यन्मण्डूकाः प्रावृषीणं बभूव ॥
mantras.transliteration: brāhmaṇāso atirātre na some saro na pūrṇamabhito vadantaḥ | saṃvatsarasya tadahaḥ pari ṣṭha yanmaṇḍūkāḥ prāvṛṣīṇaṃ babhūva ||

translations.english: Like Brāhmaṇas at the Soma libation, at the Atirātra sacrifice, you are now croaking around thereplenished lake (throughout the night), for on that day of the year you frogs are everywhere about, when it is theday of the serving of the rains.

mantras.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणासः सोमिनो वाचमक्रत ब्रह्म कृण्वन्तः परिवत्सरीणम् । अध्वर्यवो घर्मिणः सिष्विदाना आविर्भवन्ति गुह्या न के चित् ॥
mantras.transliteration: brāhmaṇāsaḥ somino vācamakrata brahma kṛṇvantaḥ parivatsarīṇam | adhvaryavo gharmiṇaḥ siṣvidānā āvirbhavanti guhyā na ke cit ||

translations.english: They utter a loud cry, like brāhmaṇas when bearing the Soma libation, and reciting the perennialprayer; like ministrant priests with the gharma offering, they hid (in the hot weather) person iring (in their holes), butnow some of them appear.

mantras.sanskrit: देवहितिं जुगुपुर्द्वादशस्य ऋतुं नरो न प्र मिनन्त्येते । संवत्सरे प्रावृष्यागतायां तप्ता घर्मा अश्नुवते विसर्गम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: devahitiṃ jugupurdvādaśasya ṛtuṃ naro na pra minantyete | saṃvatsare prāvṛṣyāgatāyāṃ taptā gharmā aśnuvate visargam ||

translations.english: These leaders of rites observe the instrumental tutes of the gods and disregard not the (appropriate) season ofthe twelve month; as the year revolves, and the rains return then, scorched and heated, they obtain freedom(from their hiding- plural ces).

mantras.sanskrit: गोमायुरदादजमायुरदात्पृश्निरदाद्धरितो नो वसूनि । गवां मण्डूका ददतः शतानि सहस्रसावे प्र तिरन्त आयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: gomāyuradādajamāyuradātpṛśniradāddharito no vasūni | gavāṃ maṇḍūkā dadataḥ śatāni sahasrasāve pra tiranta āyuḥ ||

translations.english: May the cow-toned, the goat-toned, the speckled, the green (frog, severally) grant us riches! May thefrogs in the fertilizing (season of the rain), bestowing upon us hundreds of cows, prolong (our) lives!

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रासोमा तपतं रक्ष उब्जतं न्यर्पयतं वृषणा तमोवृधः । परा शृणीतमचितो न्योषतं हतं नुदेथां नि शिशीतमत्रिणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāsomā tapataṃ rakṣa ubjataṃ nyarpayataṃ vṛṣaṇā tamovṛdhaḥ | parā śṛṇītamacito nyoṣataṃ hataṃ nudethāṃ ni śiśītamatriṇaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra and Soma, afflict, destroy the rākṣasas; showerers (of benefits) cast down those who delight indarkness; put to flight the stupid (spirits); consume, slay, drive away, utterly extermiante the cannibals.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रासोमा समघशंसमभ्यघं तपुर्ययस्तु चरुरग्निवाँ इव । ब्रह्मद्विषे क्रव्यादे घोरचक्षसे द्वेषो धत्तमनवायं किमीदिने ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāsomā samaghaśaṃsamabhyaghaṃ tapuryayastu caruragnivā~ iva | brahmadviṣe kravyāde ghoracakṣase dveṣo dhattamanavāyaṃ kimīdine ||

translations.english: Indra and Soma, fall upon the destructive (rākṣasa) and the performer of unprofitable acts, so that,consumed (by your wrath), he may perish like the offering cast into the fire; retain implacable hatred to the haterof brāhmaṇas, the cannibal, the hideous, the vile (rākṣasa).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रासोमा दुष्कृतो वव्रे अन्तरनारम्भणे तमसि प्र विध्यतम् । यथा नातः पुनरेकश्चनोदयत्तद्वामस्तु सहसे मन्युमच्छवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāsomā duṣkṛto vavre antaranārambhaṇe tamasi pra vidhyatam | yathā nātaḥ punarekaścanodayattadvāmastu sahase manyumacchavaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra and Soma, chastise the malignant (rākṣasas), having plural nged them in surrounding andinextricable darkness, so that not one of them may again issue from it; so may your wrathful might be triumphantover them.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रासोमा वर्तयतं दिवो वधं सं पृथिव्या अघशंसाय तर्हणम् । उत्तक्षतं स्वर्यं पर्वतेभ्यो येन रक्षो वावृधानं निजूर्वथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāsomā vartayataṃ divo vadhaṃ saṃ pṛthivyā aghaśaṃsāya tarhaṇam | uttakṣataṃ svaryaṃ parvatebhyo yena rakṣo vāvṛdhānaṃ nijūrvathaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra and Soma, disperse from heaven your fatal (weapon), the extirpator from earth of the malignant(rākṣasas) put forth from the clouds the consuming, (thunderbolt), wherewith you slay the increasing rākṣasarace.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रासोमा वर्तयतं दिवस्पर्यग्नितप्तेभिर्युवमश्महन्मभिः । तपुर्वधेभिरजरेभिरत्रिणो नि पर्शाने विध्यतं यन्तु निस्वरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāsomā vartayataṃ divasparyagnitaptebhiryuvamaśmahanmabhiḥ | tapurvadhebhirajarebhiratriṇo ni parśāne vidhyataṃ yantu nisvaram ||

translations.english: Indra and Soma, scatter around (your weapons) from the sky, pierce their sides with fiery searchingadamantine (weapons), so that they depart without a sound.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रासोमा परि वां भूतु विश्वत इयं मतिः कक्ष्याश्वेव वाजिना । यां वां होत्रां परिहिनोमि मेधयेमा ब्रह्माणि नृपतीव जिन्वतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāsomā pari vāṃ bhūtu viśvata iyaṃ matiḥ kakṣyāśveva vājinā | yāṃ vāṃ hotrāṃ parihinomi medhayemā brahmāṇi nṛpatīva jinvatam ||

translations.english: May the praise invest you, Indra and Soma, who are mighty, on every side, as a girth (encompasses) ahorse, that praise which I offer to you both with pure devotion; do you, like two kings, accept this my homage.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रति स्मरेथां तुजयद्भिरेवैर्हतं द्रुहो रक्षसो भङ्गुरावतः । इन्द्रासोमा दुष्कृते मा सुगं भूद्यो नः कदा चिदभिदासति द्रुहा ॥
mantras.transliteration: prati smarethāṃ tujayadbhirevairhataṃ druho rakṣaso bhaṅgurāvataḥ | indrāsomā duṣkṛte mā sugaṃ bhūdyo naḥ kadā cidabhidāsati druhā ||

translations.english: Come with rapid steeds, slay the oppressive mischievous rākṣasas; let there be no happiness, Indraand Soma, to the malignant, who harasses us with his oppression.

mantras.sanskrit: यो मा पाकेन मनसा चरन्तमभिचष्टे अनृतेभिर्वचोभिः । आप इव काशिना संगृभीता असन्नस्त्वासत इन्द्र वक्ता ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo mā pākena manasā carantamabhicaṣṭe anṛtebhirvacobhiḥ | āpa iva kāśinā saṃgṛbhītā asannastvāsata indra vaktā ||

translations.english: May he who with false calumnies maligns me behaving with a pure heart, may such a speaker offalsehood Indra, cease to be, like water held in the hand.

mantras.sanskrit: ये पाकशंसं विहरन्त एवैर्ये वा भद्रं दूषयन्ति स्वधाभिः । अहये वा तान्प्रददातु सोम आ वा दधातु निॠतेरुपस्थे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye pākaśaṃsaṃ viharanta evairye vā bhadraṃ dūṣayanti svadhābhiḥ | ahaye vā tānpradadātu soma ā vā dadhātu niṝterupasthe ||

translations.english: May Soma give to the serpent, or toss upon the lap of Nirṛti, those who with designing (accusative ations)person cute me, a speaker of sincerely, and those who by spiteful (calumnies) vilify all that is good in me.

mantras.sanskrit: यो नो रसं दिप्सति पित्वो अग्ने यो अश्वानां यो गवां यस्तनूनाम् । रिपुः स्तेनः स्तेयकृद्दभ्रमेतु नि ष हीयतां तन्वा तना च ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo no rasaṃ dipsati pitvo agne yo aśvānāṃ yo gavāṃ yastanūnām | ripuḥ stenaḥ steyakṛddabhrametu ni ṣa hīyatāṃ tanvā tanā ca ||

translations.english: May he, Agni, who strives to destroy the essence of our food, of our horse, of our cattle, of our bodies--the adversary, the thief, the robber-- go to destruction, and be deprived both of person n and of progeny.

mantras.sanskrit: परः सो अस्तु तन्वा तना च तिस्रः पृथिवीरधो अस्तु विश्वाः । प्रति शुष्यतु यशो अस्य देवा यो नो दिवा दिप्सति यश्च नक्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: paraḥ so astu tanvā tanā ca tisraḥ pṛthivīradho astu viśvāḥ | prati śuṣyatu yaśo asya devā yo no divā dipsati yaśca naktam ||

translations.english: May he be deprived of bodily (existence) and of posterity; may he be cast down below all the threeworlds; may his reputation, Gods, be blighted who seeks our destruction by day or by night.

mantras.sanskrit: सुविज्ञानं चिकितुषे जनाय सच्चासच्च वचसी पस्पृधाते । तयोर्यत्सत्यं यतरदृजीयस्तदित्सोमोऽवति हन्त्यासत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: suvijñānaṃ cikituṣe janāya saccāsacca vacasī paspṛdhāte | tayoryatsatyaṃ yataradṛjīyastaditsomo'vati hantyāsat ||

translations.english: To the understanding man there is perfect discrimination, the words of truth and falsehood are mutuallyat variance; of these two, Soma verily cherishes that which is true and right; he destroys the false.

mantras.sanskrit: न वा उ सोमो वृजिनं हिनोति न क्षत्रियं मिथुया धारयन्तम् । हन्ति रक्षो हन्त्यासद्वदन्तमुभाविन्द्रस्य प्रसितौ शयाते ॥
mantras.transliteration: na vā u somo vṛjinaṃ hinoti na kṣatriyaṃ mithuyā dhārayantam | hanti rakṣo hantyāsadvadantamubhāvindrasya prasitau śayāte ||

translations.english: Soma instrumental gates not the wicked; he instrumental gates not the strong man dealing in falsehood; he destroys therākṣasa, he destroys the speaker of untruth; and both remain in the bondage of Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: यदि वाहमनृतदेव आस मोघं वा देवाँ अप्यूहे अग्ने । किमस्मभ्यं जातवेदो हृणीषे द्रोघवाचस्ते निॠथं सचन्ताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadi vāhamanṛtadeva āsa moghaṃ vā devā~ apyūhe agne | kimasmabhyaṃ jātavedo hṛṇīṣe droghavācaste niṝthaṃ sacantām ||

translations.english: If I am one following false gods, if I approach the gods in vain, then Agni (punishes me). If (we be notsuch, then) why, Jātavedas, are you angry with us? Let the utterers of falsehood incur your chastisement.

mantras.sanskrit: अद्या मुरीय यदि यातुधानो अस्मि यदि वायुस्ततप पूरुषस्य । अधा स वीरैर्दशभिर्वि यूया यो मा मोघं यातुधानेत्याह ॥
mantras.transliteration: adyā murīya yadi yātudhāno asmi yadi vāyustatapa pūruṣasya | adhā sa vīrairdaśabhirvi yūyā yo mā moghaṃ yātudhānetyāha ||

translations.english: May I this day die if I am a spirit of ill, or if I have ever injured the life of any ma; may you be deprived(rākṣasa) of your ten sons, who have falsely called me by such an appellation.

mantras.sanskrit: यो मायातुं यातुधानेत्याह यो वा रक्षाः शुचिरस्मीत्याह । इन्द्रस्तं हन्तु महता वधेन विश्वस्य जन्तोरधमस्पदीष्ट ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo māyātuṃ yātudhānetyāha yo vā rakṣāḥ śucirasmītyāha | indrastaṃ hantu mahatā vadhena viśvasya jantoradhamaspadīṣṭa ||

translations.english: May Indra slay with his mighty weapon him who calls me the Yātudhāna, which I am not, therākṣasa, who says (of himself), I am pure; may he, the vilest of all beings, perish.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र या जिगाति खर्गलेव नक्तमप द्रुहा तन्वं गूहमाना । वव्राँ अनन्ताँ अव सा पदीष्ट ग्रावाणो घ्नन्तु रक्षस उपब्दैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra yā jigāti khargaleva naktamapa druhā tanvaṃ gūhamānā | vavrā~ anantā~ ava sā padīṣṭa grāvāṇo ghnantu rakṣasa upabdaiḥ ||

translations.english: May the cruel feminine le fiend who, throwing off the concealment of her person n, wanders about at night likean owl, fall headlong down into the unbounded caverns; may the sones that grind the Soma destroy therākṣasas by their noise.

mantras.sanskrit: वि तिष्ठध्वं मरुतो विक्ष्विच्छत गृभायत रक्षसः सं पिनष्टन । वयो ये भूत्वी पतयन्ति नक्तभिर्ये वा रिपो दधिरे देवे अध्वरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi tiṣṭhadhvaṃ maruto vikṣvicchata gṛbhāyata rakṣasaḥ saṃ pinaṣṭana | vayo ye bhūtvī patayanti naktabhirye vā ripo dadhire deve adhvare ||

translations.english: Stay, Maruts, among the people, desirous (of protecting them); seize the rākṣasas, grind them intopieces; whether you fly about like birds at night, or whether they have offered obstruction to the sacred sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वर्तय दिवो अश्मानमिन्द्र सोमशितं मघवन्त्सं शिशाधि । प्राक्तादपाक्तादधरादुदक्तादभि जहि रक्षसः पर्वतेन ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vartaya divo aśmānamindra somaśitaṃ maghavantsaṃ śiśādhi | prāktādapāktādadharādudaktādabhi jahi rakṣasaḥ parvatena ||

translations.english: Hurl, Indra, your thunderbolt from heaven; sanctify, Maghavan, (the worshipper) sharpened by theSoma; slay with the thunderbolt the rākṣasas, on the eas, on the west, on the south, on the north.

mantras.sanskrit: एत उ त्ये पतयन्ति श्वयातव इन्द्रं दिप्सन्ति दिप्सवोऽदाभ्यम् । शिशीते शक्रः पिशुनेभ्यो वधं नूनं सृजदशनिं यातुमद्भ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: eta u tye patayanti śvayātava indraṃ dipsanti dipsavo'dābhyam | śiśīte śakraḥ piśunebhyo vadhaṃ nūnaṃ sṛjadaśaniṃ yātumadbhyaḥ ||

translations.english: They advance, accompanied by dogs; desirous to destroy him, they assail the indomitable Indra;Śakra whets his thunderbolt for the miscreants; quickly let him hurl the bolt upon the fiends.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रो यातूनामभवत्पराशरो हविर्मथीनामभ्याविवासताम् । अभीदु शक्रः परशुर्यथा वनं पात्रेव भिन्दन्त्सत एति रक्षसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indro yātūnāmabhavatparāśaro havirmathīnāmabhyāvivāsatām | abhīdu śakraḥ paraśuryathā vanaṃ pātreva bhindantsata eti rakṣasaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra has ever been the discomfiter of the evil spirits coming to obstruct (the rites of) the offerers ofoblations; Śakra advances, crushing the present rākṣasas, as a hatchet cuts down (the trees of) a forest, as (amallet smashes) the earthen vessels.

mantras.sanskrit: उलूकयातुं शुशुलूकयातुं जहि श्वयातुमुत कोकयातुम् । सुपर्णयातुमुत गृध्रयातुं दृषदेव प्र मृण रक्ष इन्द्र ॥
mantras.transliteration: ulūkayātuṃ śuśulūkayātuṃ jahi śvayātumuta kokayātum | suparṇayātumuta gṛdhrayātuṃ dṛṣadeva pra mṛṇa rakṣa indra ||

translations.english: Destroy the evil spirit, whether in the form of an owl, or of an owlet, of a dog, or of a duck, of a hawk orof a vulture; slay the rākṣasas, Indra, (with the thunderbolt) as with a stone.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नो रक्षो अभि नड्यातुमावतामपोच्छतु मिथुना या किमीदिना । पृथिवी नः पार्थिवात्पात्वंहसोऽन्तरिक्षं दिव्यात्पात्वस्मान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā no rakṣo abhi naḍyātumāvatāmapocchatu mithunā yā kimīdinā | pṛthivī naḥ pārthivātpātvaṃhaso'ntarikṣaṃ divyātpātvasmān ||

translations.english: Let not the rākṣasas do us harm; let the dawn drive away the pairs of evil spirits exclaiming, "Whatnote is this"; may the earth protect us from terrestrial, the firmament protect us from celestial, wickednesṣ

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र जहि पुमांसं यातुधानमुत स्त्रियं मायया शाशदानाम् । विग्रीवासो मूरदेवा ऋदन्तु मा ते दृशन्त्सूर्यमुच्चरन्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra jahi pumāṃsaṃ yātudhānamuta striyaṃ māyayā śāśadānām | vigrīvāso mūradevā ṛdantu mā te dṛśantsūryamuccarantam ||

translations.english: Slay, Indra, the Yātudhāna, whether in the form of a man, or of a woman doing mischief by herdeceptions; may those who sport in murder perish dissipated; let them not behold the rising sun.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रति चक्ष्व वि चक्ष्वेन्द्रश्च सोम जागृतम् । रक्षोभ्यो वधमस्यतमशनिं यातुमद्भ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prati cakṣva vi cakṣvendraśca soma jāgṛtam | rakṣobhyo vadhamasyatamaśaniṃ yātumadbhyaḥ ||

translations.english: Soma, do you and Indra severally watch (the rākṣasas), be vary, be vigilant; hurl the thunderbolt atthe malignant rākṣasas.

mantras.sanskrit: मा चिदन्यद्वि शंसत सखायो मा रिषण्यत । इन्द्रमित्स्तोता वृषणं सचा सुते मुहुरुक्था च शंसत ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā cidanyadvi śaṃsata sakhāyo mā riṣaṇyata | indramitstotā vṛṣaṇaṃ sacā sute muhurukthā ca śaṃsata ||

translations.english: Repeat, friends, no other praise, be not hurtful (to yourselves); praise together Indra, the showerer (ofbenefits) when the Soma is effused; repeately utter praise (to him).

mantras.sanskrit: अवक्रक्षिणं वृषभं यथाजुरं गां न चर्षणीसहम् । विद्वेषणं संवननोभयंकरं मंहिष्ठमुभयाविनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: avakrakṣiṇaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ yathājuraṃ gāṃ na carṣaṇīsaham | vidveṣaṇaṃ saṃvananobhayaṃkaraṃ maṃhiṣṭhamubhayāvinam ||

translations.english: A bull rushing (upon his foes), undecaying, like an ox, the overcomer of (hostile) men, the hater (ofadversaries), the venerable, the displayer of both (enmity and favour), the munificent, the distributor of both(celestial and terrestrial riches).

mantras.sanskrit: यच्चिद्धि त्वा जना इमे नाना हवन्त ऊतये । अस्माकं ब्रह्मेदमिन्द्र भूतु तेऽहा विश्वा च वर्धनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yacciddhi tvā janā ime nānā havanta ūtaye | asmākaṃ brahmedamindra bhūtu te'hā viśvā ca vardhanam ||

translations.english: Although these people worship you, Indra, in many ways to (secure) your protection, (yet) may this ourprayer be throughout all days your magnification.

mantras.sanskrit: वि तर्तूर्यन्ते मघवन्विपश्चितोऽर्यो विपो जनानाम् । उप क्रमस्व पुरुरूपमा भर वाजं नेदिष्ठमूतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi tartūryante maghavanvipaścito'ryo vipo janānām | upa kramasva pururūpamā bhara vājaṃ nediṣṭhamūtaye ||

translations.english: The sages (your worshippers), Maghavan, the overcomers (of foes), the terrifiers of (hostile) people,pass over various (calamities by your aid); come near and bring manysorts of food, and available for ourpreservation.

mantras.sanskrit: महे चन त्वामद्रिवः परा शुल्काय देयाम् । न सहस्राय नायुताय वज्रिवो न शताय शतामघ ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahe cana tvāmadrivaḥ parā śulkāya deyām | na sahasrāya nāyutāya vajrivo na śatāya śatāmagha ||

translations.english: Wielder of the thunderbolt, I would not sell you for a large price, not for a thousand, nor for tenthousand, nor, opulent bearer of the thunderbolt, for a hundred.

mantras.sanskrit: वस्याँ इन्द्रासि मे पितुरुत भ्रातुरभुञ्जतः । माता च मे छदयथः समा वसो वसुत्वनाय राधसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: vasyā~ indrāsi me pituruta bhrāturabhuñjataḥ | mātā ca me chadayathaḥ samā vaso vasutvanāya rādhase ||

translations.english: You are more precious, Indra, than my father, or than my brother, who is not affectionate; you, giver ofdwellings, are equal to my mother, for you both render me distinguished on account of celebrity and riches.

mantras.sanskrit: क्वेयथ क्वेदसि पुरुत्रा चिद्धि ते मनः । अलर्षि युध्म खजकृत्पुरंदर प्र गायत्रा अगासिषुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kveyatha kvedasi purutrā ciddhi te manaḥ | alarṣi yudhma khajakṛtpuraṃdara pra gāyatrā agāsiṣuḥ ||

translations.english: Where have you gone? Where, indeed, are you now? Verily your mind (wanders) among many(worshippers); martial, valorous Purandara, come here; the chanters are singing (your praise).

mantras.sanskrit: प्रास्मै गायत्रमर्चत वावातुर्यः पुरंदरः । याभिः काण्वस्योप बर्हिरासदं यासद्वज्री भिनत्पुरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prāsmai gāyatramarcata vāvāturyaḥ puraṃdaraḥ | yābhiḥ kāṇvasyopa barhirāsadaṃ yāsadvajrī bhinatpuraḥ ||

translations.english: Raise the sacred chant to him who is the destroyer of the cities (of the foes) of his worshipper,(induced) by which may the thunderer come to sit down at the sacrifice of the sons of Kaṇva, and destroy thecities (of their enemies).

mantras.sanskrit: ये ते सन्ति दशग्विनः शतिनो ये सहस्रिणः । अश्वासो ये ते वृषणो रघुद्रुवस्तेभिर्नस्तूयमा गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye te santi daśagvinaḥ śatino ye sahasriṇaḥ | aśvāso ye te vṛṣaṇo raghudruvastebhirnastūyamā gahi ||

translations.english: Come quickly with those your horses which are vigorous and fleet, and which are traversers of tens, orhundreds, or thousands (of leagues).

mantras.sanskrit: आ त्वद्य सबर्दुघां हुवे गायत्रवेपसम् । इन्द्रं धेनुं सुदुघामन्यामिषमुरुधारामरंकृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tvadya sabardughāṃ huve gāyatravepasam | indraṃ dhenuṃ sudughāmanyāmiṣamurudhārāmaraṃkṛtam ||

translations.english: I invoke today the all-sufficient Indra, as the milch cow yielding abundant milk, of excellent motion, andeasy to be milked; or, as another (form), the vast-dropping, desirable (rain).

mantras.sanskrit: यत्तुदत्सूर एतशं वङ्कू वातस्य पर्णिना । वहत्कुत्समार्जुनेयं शतक्रतुः त्सरद्गन्धर्वमस्तृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yattudatsūra etaśaṃ vaṅkū vātasya parṇinā | vahatkutsamārjuneyaṃ śatakratuḥ tsaradgandharvamastṛtam ||

translations.english: When Sūrya harassed Etaśa, Śatakratu conveyed (to his aid) Kutsa, the son of Arjuni, with his twoprancing horses (swift) as the wind, and stealthily approached the irresistible Gandharva.

mantras.sanskrit: य ऋते चिदभिश्रिषः पुरा जत्रुभ्य आतृदः । संधाता संधिं मघवा पुरूवसुरिष्कर्ता विह्रुतं पुनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya ṛte cidabhiśriṣaḥ purā jatrubhya ātṛdaḥ | saṃdhātā saṃdhiṃ maghavā purūvasuriṣkartā vihrutaṃ punaḥ ||

translations.english: He who without healing materials before the flow of blood from the necks was the effecter of there-union, the opulent Maghavan, again makes whole the dissevered (parts).

mantras.sanskrit: मा भूम निष्ट्या इवेन्द्र त्वदरणा इव । वनानि न प्रजहितान्यद्रिवो दुरोषासो अमन्महि ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā bhūma niṣṭyā ivendra tvadaraṇā iva | vanāni na prajahitānyadrivo duroṣāso amanmahi ||

translations.english: May we never be like the abject, Indra, through your favour, nor suffer affliction; may we never be likebranchless trees; for, thunderer, unconsumable (by foes) we glorify you.

mantras.sanskrit: अमन्महीदनाशवोऽनुग्रासश्च वृत्रहन् । सकृत्सु ते महता शूर राधसा अनु स्तोमं मुदीमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: amanmahīdanāśavo'nugrāsaśca vṛtrahan | sakṛtsu te mahatā śūra rādhasā anu stomaṃ mudīmahi ||

translations.english: Neither rash nor irate, we verily glorify you, slayer of Vṛtra, may we propitiate you, hero, for once (atleast) by our praise with great (sacrificial) wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: यदि स्तोमं मम श्रवदस्माकमिन्द्रमिन्दवः । तिरः पवित्रं ससृवांस आशवो मन्दन्तु तुग्र्यावृधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadi stomaṃ mama śravadasmākamindramindavaḥ | tiraḥ pavitraṃ sasṛvāṃsa āśavo mandantu tugryāvṛdhaḥ ||

translations.english: If he hear our praise, then may our libations, flowing through the filter, dropping quickly, and diluted withconsecrated water, exhilarate Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: आ त्वद्य सधस्तुतिं वावातुः सख्युरा गहि । उपस्तुतिर्मघोनां प्र त्वावत्वधा ते वश्मि सुष्टुतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tvadya sadhastutiṃ vāvātuḥ sakhyurā gahi | upastutirmaghonāṃ pra tvāvatvadhā te vaśmi suṣṭutim ||

translations.english: Come quickly to-day to the collected laudation of your devoted friend; may the subsidiary praise ofwealthy (worshippers) reach you, but now I wish (to offer) your complete eulogy.

mantras.sanskrit: सोता हि सोममद्रिभिरेमेनमप्सु धावत । गव्या वस्त्रेव वासयन्त इन्नरो निर्धुक्षन्वक्षणाभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sotā hi somamadribhiremenamapsu dhāvata | gavyā vastreva vāsayanta innaro nirdhukṣanvakṣaṇābhyaḥ ||

translations.english: Extract the Soma with the bruising stones, wash it with the consecrated waters; (for by so doing) theleaders (of the rain, the Maruts) clothing (the sky with clouds) as with vesture of the hide of the cow, milk, forth(the water) for the rivers.

mantras.sanskrit: अध ज्मो अध वा दिवो बृहतो रोचनादधि । अया वर्धस्व तन्वा गिरा ममा जाता सुक्रतो पृण ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha jmo adha vā divo bṛhato rocanādadhi | ayā vardhasva tanvā girā mamā jātā sukrato pṛṇa ||

translations.english: Whether come from the earth or the firmament, or the vast luminous (heaven), be magnified by this maydiffusive praise; satisfy, Śatakratu, (my) people.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राय सु मदिन्तमं सोमं सोता वरेण्यम् । शक्र एणं पीपयद्विश्वया धिया हिन्वानं न वाजयुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāya su madintamaṃ somaṃ sotā vareṇyam | śakra eṇaṃ pīpayadviśvayā dhiyā hinvānaṃ na vājayum ||

translations.english: Pour out to Indra the most exhilarating, the most excellent Soma, for Śakra cherishes him who isdesirous of food, propitiating him by every pious act.

mantras.sanskrit: मा त्वा सोमस्य गल्दया सदा याचन्नहं गिरा । भूर्णिं मृगं न सवनेषु चुक्रुधं क ईशानं न याचिषत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā tvā somasya galdayā sadā yācannahaṃ girā | bhūrṇiṃ mṛgaṃ na savaneṣu cukrudhaṃ ka īśānaṃ na yāciṣat ||

translations.english: May I never, when importuning you in sacrifices with the effusion of the Soma and with praise, exciteyou like a ferocious lion to wrath; who (is there in the world) that does not solicit his lorḍ

mantras.sanskrit: मदेनेषितं मदमुग्रमुग्रेण शवसा । विश्वेषां तरुतारं मदच्युतं मदे हि ष्मा ददाति नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: madeneṣitaṃ madamugramugreṇa śavasā | viśveṣāṃ tarutāraṃ madacyutaṃ made hi ṣmā dadāti naḥ ||

translations.english: (May Indra drink) with invogorated strength, the strong exhilarating (Soma) offered with animating(laudation); for in his delight he gives us (a son) the overcomer of all (foes), the humbler of their pride.

mantras.sanskrit: शेवारे वार्या पुरु देवो मर्ताय दाशुषे । स सुन्वते च स्तुवते च रासते विश्वगूर्तो अरिष्टुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śevāre vāryā puru devo martāya dāśuṣe | sa sunvate ca stuvate ca rāsate viśvagūrto ariṣṭutaḥ ||

translations.english: The divine (Indra), the accomplisher of all aims, the glorified by his foes, gives vast treasures to themortal who presents offerings at the sacrifice, to him who pours out the libation, who hymns his praise.

mantras.sanskrit: एन्द्र याहि मत्स्व चित्रेण देव राधसा । सरो न प्रास्युदरं सपीतिभिरा सोमेभिरुरु स्फिरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: endra yāhi matsva citreṇa deva rādhasā | saro na prāsyudaraṃ sapītibhirā somebhiruru sphiram ||

translations.english: Come here, Indra, be exhilarated by the wonderful (libatory) affluence and with your fellow-troopers (theMaruts) fill with the Soma your vast belly, capacious as a lake,

mantras.sanskrit: आ त्वा सहस्रमा शतं युक्ता रथे हिरण्यये । ब्रह्मयुजो हरय इन्द्र केशिनो वहन्तु सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tvā sahasramā śataṃ yuktā rathe hiraṇyaye | brahmayujo haraya indra keśino vahantu somapītaye ||

translations.english: May your thousand, your hundred steeds, Indra yoke to your golden chariot, harnessed by prayer, withflowing manes, bring you to drink the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: आ त्वा रथे हिरण्यये हरी मयूरशेप्या । शितिपृष्ठा वहतां मध्वो अन्धसो विवक्षणस्य पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tvā rathe hiraṇyaye harī mayūraśepyā | śitipṛṣṭhā vahatāṃ madhvo andhaso vivakṣaṇasya pītaye ||

translations.english: May your two peacock-tailed, white-backed horses, yoked to your golden chariot, bring you to drink ofthe sweet praiseworthy libation.

mantras.sanskrit: पिबा त्वस्य गिर्वणः सुतस्य पूर्वपा इव । परिष्कृतस्य रसिन इयमासुतिश्चारुर्मदाय पत्यते ॥
mantras.transliteration: pibā tvasya girvaṇaḥ sutasya pūrvapā iva | pariṣkṛtasya rasina iyamāsutiścārurmadāya patyate ||

translations.english: Drink you, who are worthy to be glorified, of this consecrated and juicy libation, like the first drinker(vāyu); this excellent effusion issues for your exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: य एको अस्ति दंसना महाँ उग्रो अभि व्रतैः । गमत्स शिप्री न स योषदा गमद्धवं न परि वर्जति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya eko asti daṃsanā mahā~ ugro abhi vrataiḥ | gamatsa śiprī na sa yoṣadā gamaddhavaṃ na pari varjati ||

translations.english: May he who alone overcomes (enemies) through (the power of) religious observances, who by piousacts is rendered mighty and fierce, who is handsome- chinned, approach; may he never be remote; may he cometo our invocation; may he never abandon us.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं पुरं चरिष्ण्वं वधैः शुष्णस्य सं पिणक् । त्वं भा अनु चरो अध द्विता यदिन्द्र हव्यो भुवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ puraṃ cariṣṇvaṃ vadhaiḥ śuṣṇasya saṃ piṇak | tvaṃ bhā anu caro adha dvitā yadindra havyo bhuvaḥ ||

translations.english: You have broken to pieces the moveable city of Śuṣṇa with your weapons; you who are light havefollowed him; wherefore, Indra, you are in two ways to be worshipped.

mantras.sanskrit: मम त्वा सूर उदिते मम मध्यंदिने दिवः । मम प्रपित्वे अपिशर्वरे वसवा स्तोमासो अवृत्सत ॥
mantras.transliteration: mama tvā sūra udite mama madhyaṃdine divaḥ | mama prapitve apiśarvare vasavā stomāso avṛtsata ||

translations.english: May my prayers when the sun has risen, those also at noon, those also when evening arrives, bringyou back, giver of riches (to my sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: स्तुहि स्तुहीदेते घा ते मंहिष्ठासो मघोनाम् । निन्दिताश्वः प्रपथी परमज्या मघस्य मेध्यातिथे ॥
mantras.transliteration: stuhi stuhīdete ghā te maṃhiṣṭhāso maghonām | ninditāśvaḥ prapathī paramajyā maghasya medhyātithe ||

translations.english: Praise (me), praise (me), Medhyātithi, for among the wealthy we are the most liberal donors of wealthto you; (praise me as one) who outstrips a horse in speed, follows the right path, and bears the best arms.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यदश्वान्वनन्वतः श्रद्धयाहं रथे रुहम् । उत वामस्य वसुनश्चिकेतति यो अस्ति याद्वः पशुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yadaśvānvananvataḥ śraddhayāhaṃ rathe ruham | uta vāmasya vasunaściketati yo asti yādvaḥ paśuḥ ||

translations.english: When with faith I harness the docile horses in the car, (praise me), for the descendant of Yādu,possessed of cattle, know how to distribute desirable riches.

mantras.sanskrit: य ऋज्रा मह्यं मामहे सह त्वचा हिरण्यया । एष विश्वान्यभ्यस्तु सौभगासङ्गस्य स्वनद्रथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya ṛjrā mahyaṃ māmahe saha tvacā hiraṇyayā | eṣa viśvānyabhyastu saubhagāsaṅgasya svanadrathaḥ ||

translations.english: (Praise me, saying), "He who has presented riches to me with a golden purse; may this rattling chariotof Asaṅga carry off all the treasures (of my enemy)".

mantras.sanskrit: अध प्लायोगिरति दासदन्यानासङ्गो अग्ने दशभिः सहस्रैः । अधोक्षणो दश मह्यं रुशन्तो नळा इव सरसो निरतिष्ठन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha plāyogirati dāsadanyānāsaṅgo agne daśabhiḥ sahasraiḥ | adhokṣaṇo daśa mahyaṃ ruśanto naḷā iva saraso niratiṣṭhan ||

translations.english: (So praise me, saying), "Asaṅga, the son of plural _yoga, has given more than others, Agni, by tens ofthousands; ten times the (number of) vigorous and brilliant oxen (given by him) to me, issue forth like the reeds ofa lake.

mantras.sanskrit: अन्वस्य स्थूरं ददृशे पुरस्तादनस्थ ऊरुरवरम्बमाणः । शश्वती नार्यभिचक्ष्याह सुभद्रमर्य भोजनं बिभर्षि ॥
mantras.transliteration: anvasya sthūraṃ dadṛśe purastādanastha ūruravarambamāṇaḥ | śaśvatī nāryabhicakṣyāha subhadramarya bhojanaṃ bibharṣi ||

translations.english: Śaśvatī, perceiving that the sings of manhood were restored, exclaims, "Joy, husband, you arecapable of enjoyment".

mantras.sanskrit: इदं वसो सुतमन्धः पिबा सुपूर्णमुदरम् । अनाभयिन्ररिमा ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: idaṃ vaso sutamandhaḥ pibā supūrṇamudaram | anābhayinrarimā te ||

translations.english: Give of dwellings (Indra), drink this effused libation till your belly is full, we offer it, undaunted (Indra), toyou.

mantras.sanskrit: नृभिर्धूतः सुतो अश्नैरव्यो वारैः परिपूतः । अश्वो न निक्तो नदीषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: nṛbhirdhūtaḥ suto aśnairavyo vāraiḥ paripūtaḥ | aśvo na nikto nadīṣu ||

translations.english: Washed by the priests, effused by the stones, purified by the woollen filter, like a horse cleansed in astream.

mantras.sanskrit: तं ते यवं यथा गोभिः स्वादुमकर्म श्रीणन्तः । इन्द्र त्वास्मिन्त्सधमादे ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ te yavaṃ yathā gobhiḥ svādumakarma śrīṇantaḥ | indra tvāsmintsadhamāde ||

translations.english: We have made it sweet for you as the barley-cake mixing it with milk, and therefore, Indra, (I invoke)you to this social rite.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र इत्सोमपा एक इन्द्रः सुतपा विश्वायुः । अन्तर्देवान्मर्त्याँश्च ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra itsomapā eka indraḥ sutapā viśvāyuḥ | antardevānmartyā~śca ||

translations.english: Indra verily is the chief drinker of the Soma among gods and men, the drinker of the effused libation, theaccepter of all kinds of offerings.

mantras.sanskrit: न यं शुक्रो न दुराशीर्न तृप्रा उरुव्यचसम् । अपस्पृण्वते सुहार्दम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: na yaṃ śukro na durāśīrna tṛprā uruvyacasam | apaspṛṇvate suhārdam ||
