translations.english: (We praise him) a universal kind-hearted (friend), whom the pure Soma, the mixture (of it) made withdifficulty, or other satisfying (offerings) do not displease.

mantras.sanskrit: गोभिर्यदीमन्ये अस्मन्मृगं न व्रा मृगयन्ते । अभित्सरन्ति धेनुभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: gobhiryadīmanye asmanmṛgaṃ na vrā mṛgayante | abhitsaranti dhenubhiḥ ||

translations.english: Whom others pursue with offerings of milk and curds as hunters chase a deer (with nets and snares),and harass with (inappropriate) praises.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रय इन्द्रस्य सोमाः सुतासः सन्तु देवस्य । स्वे क्षये सुतपाव्नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: traya indrasya somāḥ sutāsaḥ santu devasya | sve kṣaye sutapāvnaḥ ||

translations.english: May the three libations be effused for the divine Indra in his won dwelling, (for he is) the drinker of theeffused Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रयः कोशासः श्चोतन्ति तिस्रश्चम्वः सुपूर्णाः । समाने अधि भार्मन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: trayaḥ kośāsaḥ ścotanti tisraścamvaḥ supūrṇāḥ | samāne adhi bhārman ||

translations.english: Three purifying vessels drop (the Soma), three ladles are well filled (for the libation), the whole isfurnished for the common sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: शुचिरसि पुरुनिष्ठाः क्षीरैर्मध्यत आशीर्तः । दध्ना मन्दिष्ठः शूरस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: śucirasi puruniṣṭhāḥ kṣīrairmadhyata āśīrtaḥ | dadhnā mandiṣṭhaḥ śūrasya ||

translations.english: You (Soma) are pure, distributed in many vessels, mixed at the mid-day sacrifice with milk, and (at thethird sacrifice) with curds, the most exhilarating (Soma) of the hero (Indra).

mantras.sanskrit: इमे त इन्द्र सोमास्तीव्रा अस्मे सुतासः । शुक्रा आशिरं याचन्ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ime ta indra somāstīvrā asme sutāsaḥ | śukrā āśiraṃ yācante ||

translations.english: These dsharp and pure Soma libations effused by us for you solicit you for admixture.

mantras.sanskrit: ताँ आशिरं पुरोळाशमिन्द्रेमं सोमं श्रीणीहि । रेवन्तं हि त्वा शृणोमि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā~ āśiraṃ puroḷāśamindremaṃ somaṃ śrīṇīhi | revantaṃ hi tvā śṛṇomi ||

translations.english: Mix, Indra, the milk and Soma, (add) the cake to this libation. I hear that you are possessed of riches.

mantras.sanskrit: हृत्सु पीतासो युध्यन्ते दुर्मदासो न सुरायाम् । ऊधर्न नग्ना जरन्ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: hṛtsu pītāso yudhyante durmadāso na surāyām | ūdharna nagnā jarante ||

translations.english: The potations (of Soma) contend in your interior (for your exhilaration) like the inebriation caused bywine; your worshippers praise you (filled full of Soma) like the udder (of a cow with milk).

mantras.sanskrit: रेवाँ इद्रेवतः स्तोता स्यात्त्वावतो मघोनः । प्रेदु हरिवः श्रुतस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: revā~ idrevataḥ stotā syāttvāvato maghonaḥ | predu harivaḥ śrutasya ||

translations.english: May the eulogist of you, who are opulent, be opulent; may he even, lord of steeds, surpass one who iswealthy and renowned, like you.

mantras.sanskrit: उक्थं चन शस्यमानमगोररिरा चिकेत । न गायत्रं गीयमानम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ukthaṃ cana śasyamānamagorarirā ciketa | na gāyatraṃ gīyamānam ||

translations.english: (Indra), the enemy of the unbeliever, apprehends whatever prayer is being repeated, whatever chant isbeing chanted.

mantras.sanskrit: मा न इन्द्र पीयत्नवे मा शर्धते परा दाः । शिक्षा शचीवः शचीभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā na indra pīyatnave mā śardhate parā dāḥ | śikṣā śacīvaḥ śacībhiḥ ||

translations.english: Consign us not, Indra, to the slayer, not to an overpowering foe; doer of great deeds, enable us by youracts (to conquer).

mantras.sanskrit: वयमु त्वा तदिदर्था इन्द्र त्वायन्तः सखायः । कण्वा उक्थेभिर्जरन्ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayamu tvā tadidarthā indra tvāyantaḥ sakhāyaḥ | kaṇvā ukthebhirjarante ||

translations.english: Friends devoted, Indra, to you we, the descendants of Kaṇva, having your praise for our object, glorifyyou with prayers.

mantras.sanskrit: न घेमन्यदा पपन वज्रिन्नपसो नविष्टौ । तवेदु स्तोमं चिकेत ॥
mantras.transliteration: na ghemanyadā papana vajrinnapaso naviṣṭau | tavedu stomaṃ ciketa ||

translations.english: (Engaged), thunderer, in your recent (worship) I utter no other praise than that of you, the doer of greatdeeds, I repeat only your glorification.

mantras.sanskrit: इच्छन्ति देवाः सुन्वन्तं न स्वप्नाय स्पृहयन्ति । यन्ति प्रमादमतन्द्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: icchanti devāḥ sunvantaṃ na svapnāya spṛhayanti | yanti pramādamatandrāḥ ||

translations.english: The gods love the man who offers libations, they desire not to (let him) sleep, thence they, unslothful,obtain the inebriating Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: ओ षु प्र याहि वाजेभिर्मा हृणीथा अभ्यस्मान् । महाँ इव युवजानिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: o ṣu pra yāhi vājebhirmā hṛṇīthā abhyasmān | mahā~ iva yuvajāniḥ ||

translations.english: Come to us quickly with excellent viands, be not bashful, like the ardent husband of a new bride.

mantras.sanskrit: मो ष्वद्य दुर्हणावान्त्सायं करदारे अस्मत् । अश्रीर इव जामाता ॥
mantras.transliteration: mo ṣvadya durhaṇāvāntsāyaṃ karadāre asmat | aśrīra iva jāmātā ||

translations.english: Let insuperable, delay (coming to us) today until the evening, like an unlucky son-in-law.

mantras.sanskrit: विद्मा ह्यस्य वीरस्य भूरिदावरीं सुमतिम् । त्रिषु जातस्य मनांसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: vidmā hyasya vīrasya bhūridāvarīṃ sumatim | triṣu jātasya manāṃsi ||

translations.english: We know the munificent genitive rosity of the hero (Indra); of the purposes of him who is manifest in thethree worlds (we are aware).

mantras.sanskrit: आ तू षिञ्च कण्वमन्तं न घा विद्म शवसानात् । यशस्तरं शतमूतेः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tū ṣiñca kaṇvamantaṃ na ghā vidma śavasānāt | yaśastaraṃ śatamūteḥ ||

translations.english: Pour out the libation to him who is associated with the Kaṇva (family); we know not any one morecelebrated than the very powerful bestower of numerous protections.

mantras.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठेन सोतरिन्द्राय सोमं वीराय शक्राय । भरा पिबन्नर्याय ॥
mantras.transliteration: jyeṣṭhena sotarindrāya somaṃ vīrāya śakrāya | bharā pibannaryāya ||

translations.english: Offer, worshipper, the libation in the first plural ce to the hero, the powerful Indra, the benefactor of man;may he drink (of it).

mantras.sanskrit: यो वेदिष्ठो अव्यथिष्वश्वावन्तं जरितृभ्यः । वाजं स्तोतृभ्यो गोमन्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo vediṣṭho avyathiṣvaśvāvantaṃ jaritṛbhyaḥ | vājaṃ stotṛbhyo gomantam ||

translations.english: He who most recognisant of (the merit) of those who give him no annoyance, bestows upon his adorersand praisers food with horses and cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: पन्यम्पन्यमित्सोतार आ धावत मद्याय । सोमं वीराय शूराय ॥
mantras.transliteration: panyampanyamitsotāra ā dhāvata madyāya | somaṃ vīrāya śūrāya ||

translations.english: Hasten, offerers of the libation, (to present) the glorious Soma to the valiant, the hero (Indra), for (his)exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: पाता वृत्रहा सुतमा घा गमन्नारे अस्मत् । नि यमते शतमूतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pātā vṛtrahā sutamā ghā gamannāre asmat | ni yamate śatamūtiḥ ||

translations.english: May the drinker of the Soma libation, the slayer of Vṛtra, approach, let him not be far from us; let thegranter of many protections keep in check (our enemies).

mantras.sanskrit: एह हरी ब्रह्मयुजा शग्मा वक्षतः सखायम् । गीर्भिः श्रुतं गिर्वणसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eha harī brahmayujā śagmā vakṣataḥ sakhāyam | gīrbhiḥ śrutaṃ girvaṇasam ||

translations.english: May the delightful steeds who are harnessed by prayer bring hither (our) friends (Indra), magnified bypraises, deserving of laudation.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वादवः सोमा आ याहि श्रीताः सोमा आ याहि । शिप्रिन्नृषीवः शचीवो नायमच्छा सधमादम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: svādavaḥ somā ā yāhi śrītāḥ somā ā yāhi | śiprinnṛṣīvaḥ śacīvo nāyamacchā sadhamādam ||

translations.english: Handsome-chinned (Indra), the honoured of sages, the doer of great deeds, come, for well-flavoured isSoma; come, for the libations are ready mixed; his (your worshipper) now (invites you) to be present at this socialexhilarating rite.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तुतश्च यास्त्वा वर्धन्ति महे राधसे नृम्णाय । इन्द्र कारिणं वृधन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: stutaśca yāstvā vardhanti mahe rādhase nṛmṇāya | indra kāriṇaṃ vṛdhantaḥ ||

translations.english: They who praising you magnify you, Indra, the instrumental tutor of rites, and those (hymns which glorify) youhave (for their object) great riches and strength.

mantras.sanskrit: गिरश्च यास्ते गिर्वाह उक्था च तुभ्यं तानि । सत्रा दधिरे शवांसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: giraśca yāste girvāha ukthā ca tubhyaṃ tāni | satrā dadhire śavāṃsi ||

translations.english: Upborne by hymns, those your praises and those prayers which are addressed to you, all combined,sustain your energies.

mantras.sanskrit: एवेदेष तुविकूर्मिर्वाजाँ एको वज्रहस्तः । सनादमृक्तो दयते ॥
mantras.transliteration: evedeṣa tuvikūrmirvājā~ eko vajrahastaḥ | sanādamṛkto dayate ||

translations.english: Verily this accomplisher of many acts, the chief (among the gods), the wielder of the thunderbolt, hewho has ever been unconquered, gives food (to his votaries).

mantras.sanskrit: हन्ता वृत्रं दक्षिणेनेन्द्रः पुरू पुरुहूतः । महान्महीभिः शचीभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: hantā vṛtraṃ dakṣiṇenendraḥ purū puruhūtaḥ | mahānmahībhiḥ śacībhiḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, the slayer of Vṛtra with his right hand, the invoked of many in many (plural ces), the mighty by mighydeeds.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्मिन्विश्वाश्चर्षणय उत च्यौत्ना ज्रयांसि च । अनु घेन्मन्दी मघोनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasminviśvāścarṣaṇaya uta cyautnā jrayāṃsi ca | anu ghenmandī maghonaḥ ||

translations.english: He upon whom all men depend, (in whom) overwhelming energies (abide), he verily is the delighter ofthe opulent (worshipper).

mantras.sanskrit: एष एतानि चकारेन्द्रो विश्वा योऽति शृण्वे । वाजदावा मघोनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa etāni cakārendro viśvā yo'ti śṛṇve | vājadāvā maghonām ||

translations.english: This Indra has made all these (beings), who is thence exceedingly renowned; he is he donor of food toopulent worshippers.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रभर्ता रथं गव्यन्तमपाकाच्चिद्यमवति । इनो वसु स हि वोळ्हा ॥
mantras.transliteration: prabhartā rathaṃ gavyantamapākāccidyamavati | ino vasu sa hi voḷhā ||

translations.english: He, whom, adoring, and desirous of cattle, the protector (Indra) defends against an ignorant (foe),becomes a prince, the possessor of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: सनिता विप्रो अर्वद्भिर्हन्ता वृत्रं नृभिः शूरः । सत्योऽविता विधन्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sanitā vipro arvadbhirhantā vṛtraṃ nṛbhiḥ śūraḥ | satyo'vitā vidhantam ||

translations.english: Liberal, wise, (borne by his won) steeds, a hero, the slayer of Vṛtra, (aided) by the Maruts, truthful, heis the protector of the performer of holy rites.

mantras.sanskrit: यजध्वैनं प्रियमेधा इन्द्रं सत्राचा मनसा । यो भूत्सोमैः सत्यमद्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajadhvainaṃ priyamedhā indraṃ satrācā manasā | yo bhūtsomaiḥ satyamadvā ||

translations.english: Worship, Priyamedha, with mind intent upon him, that Indra, who is truthful when exhilarated by theSoma potations.

mantras.sanskrit: गाथश्रवसं सत्पतिं श्रवस्कामं पुरुत्मानम् । कण्वासो गात वाजिनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: gāthaśravasaṃ satpatiṃ śravaskāmaṃ purutmānam | kaṇvāso gāta vājinam ||

translations.english: Sing, Kaṇvas, the mighty (Indra), of widely-sung renown, the protector of the good, the desirous of(sacrificial) food, present in many plural ces.

mantras.sanskrit: य ऋते चिद्गास्पदेभ्यो दात्सखा नृभ्यः शचीवान् । ये अस्मिन्काममश्रियन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya ṛte cidgāspadebhyo dātsakhā nṛbhyaḥ śacīvān | ye asminkāmamaśriyan ||

translations.english: He who, a friend (to his worshippers), the doer of great deeds, tracing the catttle by their foot-marks,being without (other means of detection), restored them to those leaders (of rites) who willingly put their trust inhim.

mantras.sanskrit: इत्था धीवन्तमद्रिवः काण्वं मेध्यातिथिम् । मेषो भूतोऽभि यन्नयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: itthā dhīvantamadrivaḥ kāṇvaṃ medhyātithim | meṣo bhūto'bhi yannayaḥ ||

translations.english: You, thunderer, approaching in the form of a ram, have come to Medhyātithi, one of the race ofKaṇva, thus propitiating you.

mantras.sanskrit: शिक्षा विभिन्दो अस्मै चत्वार्ययुता ददत् । अष्टा परः सहस्रा ॥
mantras.transliteration: śikṣā vibhindo asmai catvāryayutā dadat | aṣṭā paraḥ sahasrā ||

translations.english: Liberal Vibhindu, you have given to me four times ten thousand, and afterwards eight thousand.

mantras.sanskrit: उत सु त्ये पयोवृधा माकी रणस्य नप्त्या । जनित्वनाय मामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta su tye payovṛdhā mākī raṇasya naptyā | janitvanāya māmahe ||

translations.english: I glorify those two (heaven and earth), the augmenters of water, the originators (of beings), thebenefactors of the worshipper, on account of their genitive ration (of the wealth so given to me).

mantras.sanskrit: पिबा सुतस्य रसिनो मत्स्वा न इन्द्र गोमतः । आपिर्नो बोधि सधमाद्यो वृधेऽस्माँ अवन्तु ते धियः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pibā sutasya rasino matsvā na indra gomataḥ | āpirno bodhi sadhamādyo vṛdhe'smā~ avantu te dhiyaḥ ||

translations.english: Drink, Indra, of our sapid libation, mixed with milk, and be satisfied; regard thyself as our kinsman, to beexhilarated along with us for our welfare; may your (good) intentions protect us.

mantras.sanskrit: भूयाम ते सुमतौ वाजिनो वयं मा नः स्तरभिमातये । अस्माञ्चित्राभिरवतादभिष्टिभिरा नः सुम्नेषु यामय ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhūyāma te sumatau vājino vayaṃ mā naḥ starabhimātaye | asmāñcitrābhiravatādabhiṣṭibhirā naḥ sumneṣu yāmaya ||

translations.english: May we be offerers of oblations (to enjoy) your favour; harm us not for the sake of the enemy; protectus with your wondrous solicited (protections), maintain us ever in felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: इमा उ त्वा पुरूवसो गिरो वर्धन्तु या मम । पावकवर्णाः शुचयो विपश्चितोऽभि स्तोमैरनूषत ॥
mantras.transliteration: imā u tvā purūvaso giro vardhantu yā mama | pāvakavarṇāḥ śucayo vipaścito'bhi stomairanūṣata ||

translations.english: (Indra), abounding in wealth, may these my praises magnify you; the brilliant pure sages glorify you withhymns.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं सहस्रमृषिभिः सहस्कृतः समुद्र इव पप्रथे । सत्यः सो अस्य महिमा गृणे शवो यज्ञेषु विप्रराज्ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ sahasramṛṣibhiḥ sahaskṛtaḥ samudra iva paprathe | satyaḥ so asya mahimā gṛṇe śavo yajñeṣu viprarājye ||

translations.english: Invigorated by (the praises of) a thousand ṛṣis, this (Indra) is as vast as the ocean; the true mightinessand strength of him are glorified at sacrifices, and in the realm of the devout.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रमिद्देवतातय इन्द्रं प्रयत्यध्वरे । इन्द्रं समीके वनिनो हवामह इन्द्रं धनस्य सातये ॥
mantras.transliteration: indramiddevatātaya indraṃ prayatyadhvare | indraṃ samīke vanino havāmaha indraṃ dhanasya sātaye ||

translations.english: We invoke Indra for the worship of the gods, and when the sacrifice is proceeding; adoring him, we callupon Indra as the close of the rite; we invoke him for the acquisition of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रो मह्ना रोदसी पप्रथच्छव इन्द्रः सूर्यमरोचयत् । इन्द्रे ह विश्वा भुवनानि येमिर इन्द्रे सुवानास इन्दवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indro mahnā rodasī paprathacchava indraḥ sūryamarocayat | indre ha viśvā bhuvanāni yemira indre suvānāsa indavaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, by the might of his strength, has spread out the heaven and earth; Indra has lighted up the sun;in Indra are all beings aggregated; the distilling drops of the Soma flow to Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि त्वा पूर्वपीतय इन्द्र स्तोमेभिरायवः । समीचीनास ऋभवः समस्वरन्रुद्रा गृणन्त पूर्व्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi tvā pūrvapītaya indra stomebhirāyavaḥ | samīcīnāsa ṛbhavaḥ samasvaranrudrā gṛṇanta pūrvyam ||

translations.english: Men glorify you, Indra, with hymns that you may drink the first (of the gods); the associated Ṛbhusunite in your praise, the Rudras glorify the ancient (Indra).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्येदिन्द्रो वावृधे वृष्ण्यं शवो मदे सुतस्य विष्णवि । अद्या तमस्य महिमानमायवोऽनु ष्टुवन्ति पूर्वथा ॥
mantras.transliteration: asyedindro vāvṛdhe vṛṣṇyaṃ śavo made sutasya viṣṇavi | adyā tamasya mahimānamāyavo'nu ṣṭuvanti pūrvathā ||

translations.english: Indra augments the energy and the strength of this (his worshipper), when he exhilaration of the Somais diffused through his body; men celebrate in due order his might today as they did of old.

mantras.sanskrit: तत्त्वा यामि सुवीर्यं तद्ब्रह्म पूर्वचित्तये । येना यतिभ्यो भृगवे धने हिते येन प्रस्कण्वमाविथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: tattvā yāmi suvīryaṃ tadbrahma pūrvacittaye | yenā yatibhyo bhṛgave dhane hite yena praskaṇvamāvitha ||

translations.english: I solicit you, Indra, for such vigour and for such food as may be hoped for in priority (to others),wherewith you have granted to Bhṛgu the wealth taken from those who had desired from sacrifices, wherewithyou have protected prakṣaṇva.

mantras.sanskrit: येना समुद्रमसृजो महीरपस्तदिन्द्र वृष्णि ते शवः । सद्यः सो अस्य महिमा न संनशे यं क्षोणीरनुचक्रदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yenā samudramasṛjo mahīrapastadindra vṛṣṇi te śavaḥ | sadyaḥ so asya mahimā na saṃnaśe yaṃ kṣoṇīranucakrade ||

translations.english: Wherewith you have sent the great waters tot he ocean; such as is your wish-fulfilling strength; thatmight of Indra is not easily to be resisted which the earth obeys.

mantras.sanskrit: शग्धी न इन्द्र यत्त्वा रयिं यामि सुवीर्यम् । शग्धि वाजाय प्रथमं सिषासते शग्धि स्तोमाय पूर्व्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: śagdhī na indra yattvā rayiṃ yāmi suvīryam | śagdhi vājāya prathamaṃ siṣāsate śagdhi stomāya pūrvya ||

translations.english: Grant us, Indra, the wealth accompanied by vigour, which I solicit from you; give (wealth) first of all tohim desirous of gratifying you, presenting (sacrificial) food; give (wealth), you who are of old, to him who glorifiesyou.

mantras.sanskrit: शग्धी नो अस्य यद्ध पौरमाविथ धिय इन्द्र सिषासतः । शग्धि यथा रुशमं श्यावकं कृपमिन्द्र प्रावः स्वर्णरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śagdhī no asya yaddha pauramāvitha dhiya indra siṣāsataḥ | śagdhi yathā ruśamaṃ śyāvakaṃ kṛpamindra prāvaḥ svarṇaram ||

translations.english: Give to this our (worshipper) engaged in celebrating your sacred rites, Indra, (the wealth) whereby youhave protected the son of Puru, grant to the man (aspiring) to heaven (the wealth wherewith) you havepreserved, O Indra, Ruśama, Śyāvaka and Kṛpa.

mantras.sanskrit: कन्नव्यो अतसीनां तुरो गृणीत मर्त्यः । नही न्वस्य महिमानमिन्द्रियं स्वर्गृणन्त आनशुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kannavyo atasīnāṃ turo gṛṇīta martyaḥ | nahī nvasya mahimānamindriyaṃ svargṛṇanta ānaśuḥ ||

translations.english: What living mortal, the prompter of ever-rising (praises), may now glorify Indra? No one of thoseheretofore praising him have attained the greatness of the properties of Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: कदु स्तुवन्त ऋतयन्त देवत ऋषिः को विप्र ओहते । कदा हवं मघवन्निन्द्र सुन्वतः कदु स्तुवत आ गमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kadu stuvanta ṛtayanta devata ṛṣiḥ ko vipra ohate | kadā havaṃ maghavannindra sunvataḥ kadu stuvata ā gamaḥ ||

translations.english: Who, praising you as the deity, (ever) hoped to sacrifice to you? What saint, what sage conveys (hispraises to yo?) When, opulent Indra, have you come to the invocation of one pouring out libations, of onerepeating (your) praise?

mantras.sanskrit: उदु त्ये मधुमत्तमा गिरः स्तोमास ईरते । सत्राजितो धनसा अक्षितोतयो वाजयन्तो रथा इव ॥
mantras.transliteration: udu tye madhumattamā giraḥ stomāsa īrate | satrājito dhanasā akṣitotayo vājayanto rathā iva ||

translations.english: These most sweet songs, these hymns of praise ascent (to you), like triumphant chariots laden withwealth, charged with unfailing protections, intended to procure food.

mantras.sanskrit: कण्वा इव भृगवः सूर्या इव विश्वमिद्धीतमानशुः । इन्द्रं स्तोमेभिर्महयन्त आयवः प्रियमेधासो अस्वरन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kaṇvā iva bhṛgavaḥ sūryā iva viśvamiddhītamānaśuḥ | indraṃ stomebhirmahayanta āyavaḥ priyamedhāso asvaran ||

translations.english: The Bhṛgus, like the Kaṇvas, have verily attained to the all- pervading (Indra), on whom they havemeditated, as the sun (pervades the unverse by his rays); men of the Priyamedha race, worshipping Indra withpraises glorify him.

mantras.sanskrit: युक्ष्वा हि वृत्रहन्तम हरी इन्द्र परावतः । अर्वाचीनो मघवन्त्सोमपीतय उग्र ऋष्वेभिरा गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yukṣvā hi vṛtrahantama harī indra parāvataḥ | arvācīno maghavantsomapītaya ugra ṛṣvebhirā gahi ||

translations.english: Utter destroyer of Vṛtra, harness your horses come down to us, fierce Maghavan, with your attendantsfrom afar to drink the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: इमे हि ते कारवो वावशुर्धिया विप्रासो मेधसातये । स त्वं नो मघवन्निन्द्र गिर्वणो वेनो न शृणुधी हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ime hi te kāravo vāvaśurdhiyā viprāso medhasātaye | sa tvaṃ no maghavannindra girvaṇo veno na śṛṇudhī havam ||

translations.english: These wise celebrators (of holy rites) repeatedly propitiate you with pious praise for the acceptance ofthe sacrifice; do you, opulent Indra, who are entitled to praise, hear our invocation like one who listens to what hedesires.

mantras.sanskrit: निरिन्द्र बृहतीभ्यो वृत्रं धनुभ्यो अस्फुरः । निरर्बुदस्य मृगयस्य मायिनो निः पर्वतस्य गा आजः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nirindra bṛhatībhyo vṛtraṃ dhanubhyo asphuraḥ | nirarbudasya mṛgayasya māyino niḥ parvatasya gā ājaḥ ||

translations.english: You have extirpated Vṛtra with your mighty weapons; you have been the destroyer of the deceptiveArbuda and Ṃgaya; you have extricated the cattle from the mountain.

mantras.sanskrit: निरग्नयो रुरुचुर्निरु सूर्यो निः सोम इन्द्रियो रसः । निरन्तरिक्षादधमो महामहिं कृषे तदिन्द्र पौंस्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: niragnayo rurucurniru sūryo niḥ soma indriyo rasaḥ | nirantarikṣādadhamo mahāmahiṃ kṛṣe tadindra pauṃsyam ||

translations.english: When you had expelled the mighty Ahi from the firmament, then the fires blazed out, the sun shoneforth, the ambrosial Soma destined for Indra flowed out, and you, Indra, did manifest your manhood.

mantras.sanskrit: यं मे दुरिन्द्रो मरुतः पाकस्थामा कौरयाणः । विश्वेषां त्मना शोभिष्ठमुपेव दिवि धावमानम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ me durindro marutaḥ pākasthāmā kaurayāṇaḥ | viśveṣāṃ tmanā śobhiṣṭhamupeva divi dhāvamānam ||

translations.english: Such wealth as Indra and the Maruts have bestowed upon me, such has Pākasthāman, the son ofKurayāṇa, bestowed, of itself the most magnificent of all, like the quick-moving (sun) in the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: रोहितं मे पाकस्थामा सुधुरं कक्ष्यप्राम् । अदाद्रायो विबोधनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: rohitaṃ me pākasthāmā sudhuraṃ kakṣyaprām | adādrāyo vibodhanam ||

translations.english: Pākasthāman has given me a tawny robust beast of burden, the means of acquiring riches.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्मा अन्ये दश प्रति धुरं वहन्ति वह्नयः । अस्तं वयो न तुग्र्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasmā anye daśa prati dhuraṃ vahanti vahnayaḥ | astaṃ vayo na tugryam ||

translations.english: Whose burden ten other bearers (of loads) (would be required) to convey, such as were the steeds thatbore Bhujyu home.

mantras.sanskrit: आत्मा पितुस्तनूर्वास ओजोदा अभ्यञ्जनम् । तुरीयमिद्रोहितस्य पाकस्थामानं भोजं दातारमब्रवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ātmā pitustanūrvāsa ojodā abhyañjanam | turīyamidrohitasya pākasthāmānaṃ bhojaṃ dātāramabravam ||

translations.english: His father's own son, the giver of dwellings, the sustainer of strength like (invigorating) unguents, Icelebrate Pākasthāman, the destroyer (of foes), the despoiler (of enemies), the donor of the tawny (horse).

mantras.sanskrit: यदिन्द्र प्रागपागुदङ्न्यग्वा हूयसे नृभिः । सिमा पुरू नृषूतो अस्यानवेऽसि प्रशर्ध तुर्वशे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadindra prāgapāgudaṅnyagvā hūyase nṛbhiḥ | simā purū nṛṣūto asyānave'si praśardha turvaśe ||

translations.english: Inasmuch, Indra, as you are invoked by the people in the east, in the west, in the north, in the south, so,excellent Indra, have you been incited by men on behalf of the son of Anu; so, overcomer of foes, (have you beencalled upon) on behalf of Turvaśa.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्वा रुमे रुशमे श्यावके कृप इन्द्र मादयसे सचा । कण्वासस्त्वा ब्रह्मभिः स्तोमवाहस इन्द्रा यच्छन्त्या गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadvā rume ruśame śyāvake kṛpa indra mādayase sacā | kaṇvāsastvā brahmabhiḥ stomavāhasa indrā yacchantyā gahi ||

translations.english: Inasmuch, Indra, as you have been exhilarated in the society of Ruma, Ruśama, Śyāvaka and Kṛpa,so the Kaṇvas, bearers of oblations, attract you with their praises, (therefore) come here.

mantras.sanskrit: यथा गौरो अपा कृतं तृष्यन्नेत्यवेरिणम् । आपित्वे नः प्रपित्वे तूयमा गहि कण्वेषु सु सचा पिब ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathā gauro apā kṛtaṃ tṛṣyannetyaveriṇam | āpitve naḥ prapitve tūyamā gahi kaṇveṣu su sacā piba ||

translations.english: As the thirsty Gaura hastens to the pool filled with water in the desert, so, (Indra), our affinity beingacknowledged, come quickly, and drink freely with the Kaṇvas.

mantras.sanskrit: मन्दन्तु त्वा मघवन्निन्द्रेन्दवो राधोदेयाय सुन्वते । आमुष्या सोममपिबश्चमू सुतं ज्येष्ठं तद्दधिषे सहः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mandantu tvā maghavannindrendavo rādhodeyāya sunvate | āmuṣyā somamapibaścamū sutaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ taddadhiṣe sahaḥ ||

translations.english: Opulent Indra, may the Soma drops exhilate you, that you may bestow wealth on the donor of thelibation; for taking it by stealth (when given), you have drunk the Soma poured out into the ladle, and havethence sustained pre- eminent strength.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र चक्रे सहसा सहो बभञ्ज मन्युमोजसा । विश्वे त इन्द्र पृतनायवो यहो नि वृक्षा इव येमिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra cakre sahasā saho babhañja manyumojasā | viśve ta indra pṛtanāyavo yaho ni vṛkṣā iva yemire ||

translations.english: By his strength he has overpowered the strength (of his foes), he has crushed thei wrath by hisprowess; all hostile armies have been arrested like trees (immoveable through fear), mighty Indra, by you.

mantras.sanskrit: सहस्रेणेव सचते यवीयुधा यस्त आनळुपस्तुतिम् । पुत्रं प्रावर्गं कृणुते सुवीर्ये दाश्नोति नमौक्तिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sahasreṇeva sacate yavīyudhā yasta ānaḷupastutim | putraṃ prāvargaṃ kṛṇute suvīrye dāśnoti namauktibhiḥ ||

translations.english: He who has made his praise attain to you associates himself with a thousand gallant combatants; hewho offers oblations with reverence begets a valiant son, the scatterer (of enemies).

mantras.sanskrit: मा भेम मा श्रमिष्मोग्रस्य सख्ये तव । महत्ते वृष्णो अभिचक्ष्यं कृतं पश्येम तुर्वशं यदुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā bhema mā śramiṣmograsya sakhye tava | mahatte vṛṣṇo abhicakṣyaṃ kṛtaṃ paśyema turvaśaṃ yadum ||

translations.english: (Secure) in the friendship of you who are terrible, let us not fear, let us not be harassed; great andglorious, showerer (of benefits), are your deeds, as we may behold them in the case of Turvaśa, of Yadu.

mantras.sanskrit: सव्यामनु स्फिग्यं वावसे वृषा न दानो अस्य रोषति । मध्वा सम्पृक्ताः सारघेण धेनवस्तूयमेहि द्रवा पिब ॥
mantras.transliteration: savyāmanu sphigyaṃ vāvase vṛṣā na dāno asya roṣati | madhvā sampṛktāḥ sāragheṇa dhenavastūyamehi dravā piba ||

translations.english: The showerer (of benefits) with his left hip covers (the world), no tearer (of it) angers him; the delightful(Soma juices) are mixed with the sweet honey of the bee; come quickly hither, hasten, drink.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्वी रथी सुरूप इद्गोमाँ इदिन्द्र ते सखा । श्वात्रभाजा वयसा सचते सदा चन्द्रो याति सभामुप ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvī rathī surūpa idgomā~ idindra te sakhā | śvātrabhājā vayasā sacate sadā candro yāti sabhāmupa ||

translations.english: He who is your friend, Indra, is verily possessed of horses, of cars, of cattle, and is of goodly form; he isever supplied with food-comprising riches, and delighting all, he enters an assembly.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋश्यो न तृष्यन्नवपानमा गहि पिबा सोमं वशाँ अनु । निमेघमानो मघवन्दिवेदिव ओजिष्ठं दधिषे सहः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛśyo na tṛṣyannavapānamā gahi pibā somaṃ vaśā~ anu | nimeghamāno maghavandivediva ojiṣṭhaṃ dadhiṣe sahaḥ ||

translations.english: Come like a thirsty deer to the watering plural ce, drink at will of the Soma, whence, daily driving down theclouds, you sustain, Maghavan, most vigorous strength.

mantras.sanskrit: अध्वर्यो द्रावया त्वं सोममिन्द्रः पिपासति । उप नूनं युयुजे वृषणा हरी आ च जगाम वृत्रहा ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhvaryo drāvayā tvaṃ somamindraḥ pipāsati | upa nūnaṃ yuyuje vṛṣaṇā harī ā ca jagāma vṛtrahā ||

translations.english: Quickly, priest, pour forth the Soma, for Indra is thirsty; verily he has harnessed his vigorous steeds, theslayer of Vṛtra has arrived.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वयं चित्स मन्यते दाशुरिर्जनो यत्रा सोमस्य तृम्पसि । इदं ते अन्नं युज्यं समुक्षितं तस्येहि प्र द्रवा पिब ॥
mantras.transliteration: svayaṃ citsa manyate dāśurirjano yatrā somasya tṛmpasi | idaṃ te annaṃ yujyaṃ samukṣitaṃ tasyehi pra dravā piba ||

translations.english: The man who is the donor (of the oblation), he with (the gift of whose) libation you are satisfied,possesses of himself understanding; this your appropriate food is ready; come, hasten, drink of it.

mantras.sanskrit: रथेष्ठायाध्वर्यवः सोममिन्द्राय सोतन । अधि ब्रध्नस्याद्रयो वि चक्षते सुन्वन्तो दाश्वध्वरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ratheṣṭhāyādhvaryavaḥ somamindrāya sotana | adhi bradhnasyādrayo vi cakṣate sunvanto dāśvadhvaram ||

translations.english: Pour our, priests, the Soma libation to Indra in his chariot; the stones, plural ced upon their bases, arebeheld effusing the Soma for the sacrifice of the offerer.

mantras.sanskrit: उप ब्रध्नं वावाता वृषणा हरी इन्द्रमपसु वक्षतः । अर्वाञ्चं त्वा सप्तयोऽध्वरश्रियो वहन्तु सवनेदुप ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa bradhnaṃ vāvātā vṛṣaṇā harī indramapasu vakṣataḥ | arvāñcaṃ tvā saptayo'dhvaraśriyo vahantu savanedupa ||

translations.english: May his vigorous horses, repeatedly traversing the firmament, bring Indra to our rites; may your steeds,glorious through sacrifice, bring you indeed to the (daily) ceremonials.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र पूषणं वृणीमहे युज्याय पुरूवसुम् । स शक्र शिक्ष पुरुहूत नो धिया तुजे राये विमोचन ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra pūṣaṇaṃ vṛṇīmahe yujyāya purūvasum | sa śakra śikṣa puruhūta no dhiyā tuje rāye vimocana ||

translations.english: We have recourse to the opulent Pūṣan for his alliance; do you, Śakra, the adored of many, theliberator (from iniquity), enable us to acquire by our intelligence, wealth and victory.

mantras.sanskrit: सं नः शिशीहि भुरिजोरिव क्षुरं रास्व रायो विमोचन । त्वे तन्नः सुवेदमुस्रियं वसु यं त्वं हिनोषि मर्त्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ naḥ śiśīhi bhurijoriva kṣuraṃ rāsva rāyo vimocana | tve tannaḥ suvedamusriyaṃ vasu yaṃ tvaṃ hinoṣi martyam ||

translations.english: Sharpen us like a razor in the hands (of a barber); grant us riches, liberator (from iniquity), the wealth ofcattle easily obtained by us from you, such wealth as you bestow upon the (pious) mortal.

mantras.sanskrit: वेमि त्वा पूषन्नृञ्जसे वेमि स्तोतव आघृणे । न तस्य वेम्यरणं हि तद्वसो स्तुषे पज्राय साम्ने ॥
mantras.transliteration: vemi tvā pūṣannṛñjase vemi stotava āghṛṇe | na tasya vemyaraṇaṃ hi tadvaso stuṣe pajrāya sāmne ||

translations.english: I desire, Pūṣan, to propitiate you; I desire, illustrious deity, to glorify you; I desire not (to offer)ungracious praise to any other; (grant riches), bestower of wealth, to him who praises, eulogizes, and glorifiesyou.

mantras.sanskrit: परा गावो यवसं कच्चिदाघृणे नित्यं रेक्णो अमर्त्य । अस्माकं पूषन्नविता शिवो भव मंहिष्ठो वाजसातये ॥
mantras.transliteration: parā gāvo yavasaṃ kaccidāghṛṇe nityaṃ rekṇo amartya | asmākaṃ pūṣannavitā śivo bhava maṃhiṣṭho vājasātaye ||

translations.english: Illustrious (Pūṣan), my cattle go forth occasionally to pasture, may that wealth (of herds), immortaldeity, be permanent; being my protector, Pūṣan, be the granter of felicity, be most bountiful in bestowing food.

mantras.sanskrit: स्थूरं राधः शताश्वं कुरुङ्गस्य दिविष्टिषु । राज्ञस्त्वेषस्य सुभगस्य रातिषु तुर्वशेष्वमन्महि ॥
mantras.transliteration: sthūraṃ rādhaḥ śatāśvaṃ kuruṅgasya diviṣṭiṣu | rājñastveṣasya subhagasya rātiṣu turvaśeṣvamanmahi ||

translations.english: We acknowledge the substantial wealth (of the gift) of a hundred horses, the donation made to usamong men at the holy solemnities of the illustrious and auspicious Rājā Kuruṅga.

mantras.sanskrit: धीभिः सातानि काण्वस्य वाजिनः प्रियमेधैरभिद्युभिः । षष्टिं सहस्रानु निर्मजामजे निर्यूथानि गवामृषिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhībhiḥ sātāni kāṇvasya vājinaḥ priyamedhairabhidyubhiḥ | ṣaṣṭiṃ sahasrānu nirmajāmaje niryūthāni gavāmṛṣiḥ ||

translations.english: I, the Ṛṣi (Devātithi), have received subsequently the complete donation; the sixty thousand herds ofpure cattle merited by the devotions of the pious son of Kaṇva, and by the illustrious Priyamedhas.

mantras.sanskrit: वृक्षाश्चिन्मे अभिपित्वे अरारणुः । गां भजन्त मेहनाश्वं भजन्त मेहना ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛkṣāścinme abhipitve arāraṇuḥ | gāṃ bhajanta mehanāśvaṃ bhajanta mehanā ||

translations.english: Upon the acceptance of this donation to me, the very trees have exclaimed; (see these ṛṣis) haveacquired excellent cows excellent horses.

mantras.sanskrit: दूरादिहेव यत्सत्यरुणप्सुरशिश्वितत् । वि भानुं विश्वधातनत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dūrādiheva yatsatyaruṇapsuraśiśvitat | vi bhānuṃ viśvadhātanat ||

translations.english: When the shining dawn, advancing hither from afar, whitens (all things), she spreads the light on allsides.

mantras.sanskrit: नृवद्दस्रा मनोयुजा रथेन पृथुपाजसा । सचेथे अश्विनोषसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nṛvaddasrā manoyujā rathena pṛthupājasā | sacethe aśvinoṣasam ||

translations.english: And you, Aśvins, of goodly aspect, accompany the dawn like leader with your mighty chariot harnessedat a thought.

mantras.sanskrit: युवाभ्यां वाजिनीवसू प्रति स्तोमा अदृक्षत । वाचं दूतो यथोहिषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvābhyāṃ vājinīvasū prati stomā adṛkṣata | vācaṃ dūto yathohiṣe ||

translations.english: By you, affluent in sacrifices, may our praises be severally accepted; I bear the words (of theworshipper) like a messenger (to you).

mantras.sanskrit: पुरुप्रिया ण ऊतये पुरुमन्द्रा पुरूवसू । स्तुषे कण्वासो अश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: purupriyā ṇa ūtaye purumandrā purūvasū | stuṣe kaṇvāso aśvinā ||

translations.english: We, Kaṇvas, praise for our protection the many-loved, the many- delighting Aśvins, abounding inwealth.

mantras.sanskrit: मंहिष्ठा वाजसातमेषयन्ता शुभस्पती । गन्तारा दाशुषो गृहम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: maṃhiṣṭhā vājasātameṣayantā śubhaspatī | gantārā dāśuṣo gṛham ||

translations.english: Most adorable bestowwers of strength, distributors of food, lords of opulence, repairers to the dwellingof the donor (of the oblation).

mantras.sanskrit: ता सुदेवाय दाशुषे सुमेधामवितारिणीम् । घृतैर्गव्यूतिमुक्षतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā sudevāya dāśuṣe sumedhāmavitāriṇīm | ghṛtairgavyūtimukṣatam ||

translations.english: Sprinkle well with water the pure unfailing pasturage (of his cattle) for the devout donor (of theoblation).

mantras.sanskrit: आ नः स्तोममुप द्रवत्तूयं श्येनेभिराशुभिः । यातमश्वेभिरश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā naḥ stomamupa dravattūyaṃ śyenebhirāśubhiḥ | yātamaśvebhiraśvinā ||

translations.english: Come, Aśvins, to our adoration, hastening quickly with your rapid falcon-like horses.

mantras.sanskrit: येभिस्तिस्रः परावतो दिवो विश्वानि रोचना । त्रीँरक्तून्परिदीयथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yebhistisraḥ parāvato divo viśvāni rocanā | trī~raktūnparidīyathaḥ ||

translations.english: With which in three days and three nights you traverse from afar all the brilliant (constellations).

mantras.sanskrit: उत नो गोमतीरिष उत सातीरहर्विदा । वि पथः सातये सितम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta no gomatīriṣa uta sātīraharvidā | vi pathaḥ sātaye sitam ||

translations.english: Bringers of the day, (bestow) upon us food with cattle, or donations of wealth, and close the path(against aggression) upon our gains.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो गोमन्तमश्विना सुवीरं सुरथं रयिम् । वोळ्हमश्वावतीरिषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no gomantamaśvinā suvīraṃ surathaṃ rayim | voḷhamaśvāvatīriṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Bring to us, Aśvins, riches comprising cattle, male offspring, chariots, horses, food.

mantras.sanskrit: वावृधाना शुभस्पती दस्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी । पिबतं सोम्यं मधु ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāvṛdhānā śubhaspatī dasrā hiraṇyavartanī | pibataṃ somyaṃ madhu ||

translations.english: Magnificent lords of good fortune, handsome Aśvins, riding in a golden chariot, drink the sweet Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मभ्यं वाजिनीवसू मघवद्भ्यश्च सप्रथः । छर्दिर्यन्तमदाभ्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmabhyaṃ vājinīvasū maghavadbhyaśca saprathaḥ | chardiryantamadābhyam ||

translations.english: Affluent i sacrifices, grant to us who are opulent (in oblations) a spacious unassailable dwelling.

mantras.sanskrit: नि षु ब्रह्म जनानां याविष्टं तूयमा गतम् । मो ष्वन्याँ उपारतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni ṣu brahma janānāṃ yāviṣṭaṃ tūyamā gatam | mo ṣvanyā~ upāratam ||

translations.english: Do you ever carefully protect the Brahman among men, come quickly; tarry not with other(worshippers).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य पिबतमश्विना युवं मदस्य चारुणः । मध्वो रातस्य धिष्ण्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya pibatamaśvinā yuvaṃ madasya cāruṇaḥ | madhvo rātasya dhiṣṇyā ||

translations.english: Adorable Aśvins, drink of this exhilarating, delightful, sweet Soma, presented by us.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मे आ वहतं रयिं शतवन्तं सहस्रिणम् । पुरुक्षुं विश्वधायसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asme ā vahataṃ rayiṃ śatavantaṃ sahasriṇam | purukṣuṃ viśvadhāyasam ||

translations.english: Bring unto us riches by hundreds and by thousands, desired by many, sustaining all.

mantras.sanskrit: पुरुत्रा चिद्धि वां नरा विह्वयन्ते मनीषिणः । वाघद्भिरश्विना गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: purutrā ciddhi vāṃ narā vihvayante manīṣiṇaḥ | vāghadbhiraśvinā gatam ||

translations.english: Leaders (of rites), wise men worship you in many plural ces; come to us with your steeds.

mantras.sanskrit: जनासो वृक्तबर्हिषो हविष्मन्तो अरंकृतः । युवां हवन्ते अश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: janāso vṛktabarhiṣo haviṣmanto araṃkṛtaḥ | yuvāṃ havante aśvinā ||

translations.english: Men bearing the clipped sacred grass, presenting oblations, and completely fulfilling (their functions),worship you, Aśvin.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्माकमद्य वामयं स्तोमो वाहिष्ठो अन्तमः । युवाभ्यां भूत्वश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmākamadya vāmayaṃ stomo vāhiṣṭho antamaḥ | yuvābhyāṃ bhūtvaśvinā ||

translations.english: May this our praise today be conveyed successfully to you, Aśvins, and be most near to you.

mantras.sanskrit: यो ह वां मधुनो दृतिराहितो रथचर्षणे । ततः पिबतमश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo ha vāṃ madhuno dṛtirāhito rathacarṣaṇe | tataḥ pibatamaśvinā ||

translations.english: Drink, Aśvins, from the skin (filled) with the sweet (Soma) which is suspended in view of your car.

mantras.sanskrit: तेन नो वाजिनीवसू पश्वे तोकाय शं गवे । वहतं पीवरीरिषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tena no vājinīvasū paśve tokāya śaṃ gave | vahataṃ pīvarīriṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Affluent in oblations, bring to us with that (chariot) abundant food, so that there may be prosperity inhorses, progeny, and cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: उत नो दिव्या इष उत सिन्धूँरहर्विदा । अप द्वारेव वर्षथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta no divyā iṣa uta sindhū~raharvidā | apa dvāreva varṣathaḥ ||

translations.english: Bringers of the day, you rain upon us by the (open) door (of the clouds) the waters of heaven, or (withthem fill) the rivers.

mantras.sanskrit: कदा वां तौग्र्यो विधत्समुद्रे जहितो नरा । यद्वां रथो विभिष्पतात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kadā vāṃ taugryo vidhatsamudre jahito narā | yadvāṃ ratho vibhiṣpatāt ||

translations.english: When did the son of Tugra, thrown into the ocean, glorify you, leaders (of rites)? then when yourchariot and horses descended.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं कण्वाय नासत्या ऋपिरिप्ताय हर्म्ये । शश्वदूतीर्दशस्यथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ kaṇvāya nāsatyā ṛpiriptāya harmye | śaśvadūtīrdaśasyathaḥ ||

translations.english: to Kaṇva when blinded (by the Asuras) in his dwelling, you rendered, Na-satyās, effectual aiḍ

mantras.sanskrit: ताभिरा यातमूतिभिर्नव्यसीभिः सुशस्तिभिः । यद्वां वृषण्वसू हुवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tābhirā yātamūtibhirnavyasībhiḥ suśastibhiḥ | yadvāṃ vṛṣaṇvasū huve ||

translations.english: Rich in showers, come with your newest and most excellent protections when I call upon you.

mantras.sanskrit: यथा चित्कण्वमावतं प्रियमेधमुपस्तुतम् । अत्रिं शिञ्जारमश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathā citkaṇvamāvataṃ priyamedhamupastutam | atriṃ śiñjāramaśvinā ||

translations.english: In like manner as you protected Kaṇva, Priyamedha, Upastuta, and the praise-repeating Atri.

mantras.sanskrit: यथोत कृत्व्ये धनेंऽशुं गोष्वगस्त्यम् । यथा वाजेषु सोभरिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathota kṛtvye dhaneṃ'śuṃ goṣvagastyam | yathā vājeṣu sobharim ||

translations.english: And in like manner as (you protected) Anshu when wealth was to be bestowed, and Agastya when hiscattle (were to be recovered), and Sobhari when food (was to be supplied to him).

mantras.sanskrit: एतावद्वां वृषण्वसू अतो वा भूयो अश्विना । गृणन्तः सुम्नमीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: etāvadvāṃ vṛṣaṇvasū ato vā bhūyo aśvinā | gṛṇantaḥ sumnamīmahe ||

translations.english: So pariasing you, Aśvins, rich in showers, we solicit of you happiness as great or greater than that(which they obtained).

mantras.sanskrit: रथं हिरण्यवन्धुरं हिरण्याभीशुमश्विना । आ हि स्थाथो दिविस्पृशम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: rathaṃ hiraṇyavandhuraṃ hiraṇyābhīśumaśvinā | ā hi sthātho divispṛśam ||

translations.english: Ascend, Aśvins, your sky-touching chariot with a golden seat and golden reins.

mantras.sanskrit: हिरण्ययी वां रभिरीषा अक्षो हिरण्ययः । उभा चक्रा हिरण्यया ॥
mantras.transliteration: hiraṇyayī vāṃ rabhirīṣā akṣo hiraṇyayaḥ | ubhā cakrā hiraṇyayā ||

translations.english: Golden is its supporting shaft, golden the axle, golden both the wheels.

mantras.sanskrit: तेन नो वाजिनीवसू परावतश्चिदा गतम् । उपेमां सुष्टुतिं मम ॥
mantras.transliteration: tena no vājinīvasū parāvataścidā gatam | upemāṃ suṣṭutiṃ mama ||

translations.english: Come to us, affluent in sacrifices, from afar, come to this mine adoration.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वहेथे पराकात्पूर्वीरश्नन्तावश्विना । इषो दासीरमर्त्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vahethe parākātpūrvīraśnantāvaśvinā | iṣo dāsīramartyā ||

translations.english: Immortal Aśvins, destroyers of the cities of the Dāsas, you bring to us food from afar.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो द्युम्नैरा श्रवोभिरा राया यातमश्विना । पुरुश्चन्द्रा नासत्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no dyumnairā śravobhirā rāyā yātamaśvinā | puruścandrā nāsatyā ||

translations.english: Come to us, Aśvins, with food, with fame, with riches, Nāsatyās, delighters of many.

mantras.sanskrit: एह वां प्रुषितप्सवो वयो वहन्तु पर्णिनः । अच्छा स्वध्वरं जनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eha vāṃ pruṣitapsavo vayo vahantu parṇinaḥ | acchā svadhvaraṃ janam ||

translations.english: Let your sleek, winged, rapid (horses) bring you to the presence of the man offering holy sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: रथं वामनुगायसं य इषा वर्तते सह । न चक्रमभि बाधते ॥
mantras.transliteration: rathaṃ vāmanugāyasaṃ ya iṣā vartate saha | na cakramabhi bādhate ||

translations.english: No hostile force arrests that car of yours which is hymned (by the devout), and which is laden with food.

mantras.sanskrit: हिरण्ययेन रथेन द्रवत्पाणिभिरश्वैः । धीजवना नासत्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: hiraṇyayena rathena dravatpāṇibhiraśvaiḥ | dhījavanā nāsatyā ||

translations.english: Rapid as thought, Nāsatyās, (come) with your golden chariot drawn by quick-footed steeds.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं मृगं जागृवांसं स्वदथो वा वृषण्वसू । ता नः पृङ्क्तमिषा रयिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ mṛgaṃ jāgṛvāṃsaṃ svadatho vā vṛṣaṇvasū | tā naḥ pṛṅktamiṣā rayim ||

translations.english: Affluent in showers, taste the wakeful desirable Soma; combine for us riches with food.

mantras.sanskrit: ता मे अश्विना सनीनां विद्यातं नवानाम् । यथा चिच्चैद्यः कशुः शतमुष्ट्रानां ददत्सहस्रा दश गोनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā me aśvinā sanīnāṃ vidyātaṃ navānām | yathā ciccaidyaḥ kaśuḥ śatamuṣṭrānāṃ dadatsahasrā daśa gonām ||

translations.english: Become appraised, Aśvins, of my recent gifts, how that Kaśu, the son of Cedi, has presented me with ahundred camels and ten thousand cows.

mantras.sanskrit: यो मे हिरण्यसंदृशो दश राज्ञो अमंहत । अधस्पदा इच्चैद्यस्य कृष्टयश्चर्मम्ना अभितो जनाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo me hiraṇyasaṃdṛśo daśa rājño amaṃhata | adhaspadā iccaidyasya kṛṣṭayaścarmamnā abhito janāḥ ||

translations.english: The son of Cedi, who has given me for servants ten Rājās, bright as gold, for all men are beneath hisfeet; all those around him wear cuirasses of leather.

mantras.sanskrit: माकिरेना पथा गाद्येनेमे यन्ति चेदयः । अन्यो नेत्सूरिरोहते भूरिदावत्तरो जनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mākirenā pathā gādyeneme yanti cedayaḥ | anyo netsūrirohate bhūridāvattaro janaḥ ||

translations.english: No one proceeds by that path which the Cedis follow, no other proud man as a more liberal benefactorconfers (favour on those who praise him).

mantras.sanskrit: महाँ इन्द्रो य ओजसा पर्जन्यो वृष्टिमाँ इव । स्तोमैर्वत्सस्य वावृधे ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahā~ indro ya ojasā parjanyo vṛṣṭimā~ iva | stomairvatsasya vāvṛdhe ||

translations.english: Indra, who is great in might like Parjanya the disributor of rain, is magnified by the praises o Vatsa.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रजामृतस्य पिप्रतः प्र यद्भरन्त वह्नयः । विप्रा ऋतस्य वाहसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: prajāmṛtasya piprataḥ pra yadbharanta vahnayaḥ | viprā ṛtasya vāhasā ||

translations.english: When his steeds filling (the heavens) bear onwards the progeny of the sacrifice, then the pious(magnify him) with the hymns of the rite.

mantras.sanskrit: कण्वा इन्द्रं यदक्रत स्तोमैर्यज्ञस्य साधनम् । जामि ब्रुवत आयुधम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kaṇvā indraṃ yadakrata stomairyajñasya sādhanam | jāmi bruvata āyudham ||

translations.english: When the Kaṇvas by their praises have made Indra the accomplisher of the sacrifice, they declare allweapons needless.

mantras.sanskrit: समस्य मन्यवे विशो विश्वा नमन्त कृष्टयः । समुद्रायेव सिन्धवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samasya manyave viśo viśvā namanta kṛṣṭayaḥ | samudrāyeva sindhavaḥ ||

translations.english: All people, (all) men bow down before his anger, as rivers (decline) towards the sea.

mantras.sanskrit: ओजस्तदस्य तित्विष उभे यत्समवर्तयत् । इन्द्रश्चर्मेव रोदसी ॥
mantras.transliteration: ojastadasya titviṣa ubhe yatsamavartayat | indraścarmeva rodasī ||

translations.english: His might is manifest, for Indra folds and unfolds both heaven and earth, as (one spreads or rolls up) askin.

mantras.sanskrit: वि चिद्वृत्रस्य दोधतो वज्रेण शतपर्वणा । शिरो बिभेद वृष्णिना ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi cidvṛtrasya dodhato vajreṇa śataparvaṇā | śiro bibheda vṛṣṇinā ||

translations.english: He has cloven with the powerful hundred-edged thunderbolt the head of the turbulent Vṛtra.

mantras.sanskrit: इमा अभि प्र णोनुमो विपामग्रेषु धीतयः । अग्नेः शोचिर्न दिद्युतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imā abhi pra ṇonumo vipāmagreṣu dhītayaḥ | agneḥ śocirna didyutaḥ ||

translations.english: In front of one worshipper we repeatedly utter our praises, radiant as the flame of fire.

mantras.sanskrit: गुहा सतीरुप त्मना प्र यच्छोचन्त धीतयः । कण्वा ऋतस्य धारया ॥
mantras.transliteration: guhā satīrupa tmanā pra yacchocanta dhītayaḥ | kaṇvā ṛtasya dhārayā ||

translations.english: The praises that are offered in secret shine brightly when approaching (Indra) of their own will; theKaṇvas (combine them) with the stream of the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र तमिन्द्र नशीमहि रयिं गोमन्तमश्विनम् । प्र ब्रह्म पूर्वचित्तये ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra tamindra naśīmahi rayiṃ gomantamaśvinam | pra brahma pūrvacittaye ||

translations.english: May we obtain, Indra, that wealth which comprises cattle, horses, and food, before it be known toothers.

mantras.sanskrit: अहमिद्धि पितुष्परि मेधामृतस्य जग्रभ । अहं सूर्य इवाजनि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahamiddhi pituṣpari medhāmṛtasya jagrabha | ahaṃ sūrya ivājani ||

translations.english: I have verily acquired the favour of the true protector (Indra); I have become (bright) as the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: अहं प्रत्नेन मन्मना गिरः शुम्भामि कण्ववत् । येनेन्द्रः शुष्ममिद्दधे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ pratnena manmanā giraḥ śumbhāmi kaṇvavat | yenendraḥ śuṣmamiddadhe ||

translations.english: I grace my words with ancient praise, like Kaṇva; whereby Indra assuredly enjoys vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: ये त्वामिन्द्र न तुष्टुवुॠषयो ये च तुष्टुवुः । ममेद्वर्धस्व सुष्टुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye tvāmindra na tuṣṭuvuṝṣayo ye ca tuṣṭuvuḥ | mamedvardhasva suṣṭutaḥ ||

translations.english: Amid those who do not praise you, Indra, amid the Ṛṣis who do praise you, by my praise beingglorified, do you increase.

mantras.sanskrit: यदस्य मन्युरध्वनीद्वि वृत्रं पर्वशो रुजन् । अपः समुद्रमैरयत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadasya manyuradhvanīdvi vṛtraṃ parvaśo rujan | apaḥ samudramairayat ||

translations.english: When his wrath thundered, dividing Vṛtra joint by joint, then he drove the waters to the ocean.

mantras.sanskrit: नि शुष्ण इन्द्र धर्णसिं वज्रं जघन्थ दस्यवि । वृषा ह्युग्र शृण्विषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni śuṣṇa indra dharṇasiṃ vajraṃ jaghantha dasyavi | vṛṣā hyugra śṛṇviṣe ||

translations.english: You have hurled your wielded thunderbolt upon the impious Śuṣṇa; you are renowned, fierce Indra,as the showerer (of benefits).

mantras.sanskrit: न द्याव इन्द्रमोजसा नान्तरिक्षाणि वज्रिणम् । न विव्यचन्त भूमयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: na dyāva indramojasā nāntarikṣāṇi vajriṇam | na vivyacanta bhūmayaḥ ||

translations.english: Neither the heavens, nor the realms of the firmament, nor the regions of the earth, equal the thundererIndra in strength.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्त इन्द्र महीरपः स्तभूयमान आशयत् । नि तं पद्यासु शिश्नथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasta indra mahīrapaḥ stabhūyamāna āśayat | ni taṃ padyāsu śiśnathaḥ ||

translations.english: You, Indra, have cast into the rushing streams him who lay obstructing your copious waters.

mantras.sanskrit: य इमे रोदसी मही समीची समजग्रभीत् । तमोभिरिन्द्र तं गुहः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya ime rodasī mahī samīcī samajagrabhīt | tamobhirindra taṃ guhaḥ ||

translations.english: You have enveloped with darkness, Indra, him who had seized upon these spacious aggregated(realms of) heaven and earth.

mantras.sanskrit: य इन्द्र यतयस्त्वा भृगवो ये च तुष्टुवुः । ममेदुग्र श्रुधी हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya indra yatayastvā bhṛgavo ye ca tuṣṭuvuḥ | mamedugra śrudhī havam ||

translations.english: Amid those pious sages, amid those Bhṛgus, who have glorified you, hear also, fierce Indra, myinvocation.

mantras.sanskrit: इमास्त इन्द्र पृश्नयो घृतं दुहत आशिरम् । एनामृतस्य पिप्युषीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imāsta indra pṛśnayo ghṛtaṃ duhata āśiram | enāmṛtasya pipyuṣīḥ ||

translations.english: These, your spotted cows, the nourishers of the sacrifice, yields, Indra, their butter, and this mixture (ofmilk and curds).

mantras.sanskrit: या इन्द्र प्रस्वस्त्वासा गर्भमचक्रिरन् । परि धर्मेव सूर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā indra prasvastvāsā garbhamacakriran | pari dharmeva sūryam ||

translations.english: These prolific cattle became pregnant, having taken into their mouths, Indra, (the products of yourvigour) like the all-sustaining sun.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामिच्छवसस्पते कण्वा उक्थेन वावृधुः । त्वां सुतास इन्दवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmicchavasaspate kaṇvā ukthena vāvṛdhuḥ | tvāṃ sutāsa indavaḥ ||

translations.english: Lord of strength, the Kaṇvas verily invigorate you by praise; the effused Soma (invigorates) you.

mantras.sanskrit: तवेदिन्द्र प्रणीतिषूत प्रशस्तिरद्रिवः । यज्ञो वितन्तसाय्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tavedindra praṇītiṣūta praśastiradrivaḥ | yajño vitantasāyyaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, excellent praise (is addressed to you) on account of your goodguidance, as is a most extended sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: आ न इन्द्र महीमिषं पुरं न दर्षि गोमतीम् । उत प्रजां सुवीर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā na indra mahīmiṣaṃ puraṃ na darṣi gomatīm | uta prajāṃ suvīryam ||

translations.english: Be willing to grant us abundant food with cattle; (to grant us) protection, progeny, and vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्यदाश्वश्व्यं यदिन्द्र नाहुषीष्वा । अग्रे विक्षु प्रदीदयत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tyadāśvaśvyaṃ yadindra nāhuṣīṣvā | agre vikṣu pradīdayat ||

translations.english: May that herd of swift horses, which formerly shone among the people of nahuṣa, (be granted), Indra,to us.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि व्रजं न तत्निषे सूर उपाकचक्षसम् । यदिन्द्र मृळयासि नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi vrajaṃ na tatniṣe sūra upākacakṣasam | yadindra mṛḷayāsi naḥ ||

translations.english: Sage Indra, you spread (the cattle) over the adjacent pastures when you are favourably inclined towardus.

mantras.sanskrit: यदङ्ग तविषीयस इन्द्र प्रराजसि क्षितीः । महाँ अपार ओजसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadaṅga taviṣīyasa indra prarājasi kṣitīḥ | mahā~ apāra ojasā ||

translations.english: When you put forth your might, you reign, Indra, over mankind; surpassing are you, and unlimited instrumental ength.

mantras.sanskrit: तं त्वा हविष्मतीर्विश उप ब्रुवत ऊतये । उरुज्रयसमिन्दुभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ tvā haviṣmatīrviśa upa bruvata ūtaye | urujrayasamindubhiḥ ||

translations.english: The people offering oblations call upon you, the pervader of space, with libations for protection.

mantras.sanskrit: उपह्वरे गिरीणां संगथे च नदीनाम् । धिया विप्रो अजायत ॥
mantras.transliteration: upahvare girīṇāṃ saṃgathe ca nadīnām | dhiyā vipro ajāyata ||

translations.english: The wise (Indra) has been engendered by holy rites on the skirts of the mountains, at the confluence ofrivers.

mantras.sanskrit: अतः समुद्रमुद्वतश्चिकित्वाँ अव पश्यति । यतो विपान एजति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ataḥ samudramudvataścikitvā~ ava paśyati | yato vipāna ejati ||

translations.english: From the lofty region in which pervading he abides, Indra the intelligent looks down upon the offeredlibation.

mantras.sanskrit: आदित्प्रत्नस्य रेतसो ज्योतिष्पश्यन्ति वासरम् । परो यदिध्यते दिवा ॥
mantras.transliteration: āditpratnasya retaso jyotiṣpaśyanti vāsaram | paro yadidhyate divā ||

translations.english: Then (men) behold the daily light of the ancient shedder of water, when he shines above the heaveṇ

mantras.sanskrit: कण्वास इन्द्र ते मतिं विश्वे वर्धन्ति पौंस्यम् । उतो शविष्ठ वृष्ण्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kaṇvāsa indra te matiṃ viśve vardhanti pauṃsyam | uto śaviṣṭha vṛṣṇyam ||

translations.english: All the Kaṇvas, Indra, magnify your wisdom, your manhood, and, most mighty one, your strength.

mantras.sanskrit: इमां म इन्द्र सुष्टुतिं जुषस्व प्र सु मामव । उत प्र वर्धया मतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: imāṃ ma indra suṣṭutiṃ juṣasva pra su māmava | uta pra vardhayā matim ||

translations.english: Be propitiated, Indra, by this my praise; carefully protect me, and give increase to my understanding.

mantras.sanskrit: उत ब्रह्मण्या वयं तुभ्यं प्रवृद्ध वज्रिवः । विप्रा अतक्ष्म जीवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta brahmaṇyā vayaṃ tubhyaṃ pravṛddha vajrivaḥ | viprā atakṣma jīvase ||

translations.english: Wielder of the thunderbolt, magnified (by our praises), we your worshippers have offered to you theseprayers for our existence.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि कण्वा अनूषतापो न प्रवता यतीः । इन्द्रं वनन्वती मतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi kaṇvā anūṣatāpo na pravatā yatīḥ | indraṃ vananvatī matiḥ ||

translations.english: The Kaṇvas glorify Indra; like waters rushing down a declivity, praise spontaneously seeks Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रमुक्थानि वावृधुः समुद्रमिव सिन्धवः । अनुत्तमन्युमजरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indramukthāni vāvṛdhuḥ samudramiva sindhavaḥ | anuttamanyumajaram ||

translations.english: Holy praises magnify Indra, the imperishable, the implacable, as rivers (swell) the ocean.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो याहि परावतो हरिभ्यां हर्यताभ्याम् । इममिन्द्र सुतं पिब ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no yāhi parāvato haribhyāṃ haryatābhyām | imamindra sutaṃ piba ||

translations.english: Come to us from afar with your beloved horses; drink, Indra, this libation.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामिद्वृत्रहन्तम जनासो वृक्तबर्हिषः । हवन्ते वाजसातये ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmidvṛtrahantama janāso vṛktabarhiṣaḥ | havante vājasātaye ||

translations.english: Destroyer of Vṛtra, men strewing the clipped sacred grass invoke you for the obtaining of food.

mantras.sanskrit: अनु त्वा रोदसी उभे चक्रं न वर्त्येतशम् । अनु सुवानास इन्दवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: anu tvā rodasī ubhe cakraṃ na vartyetaśam | anu suvānāsa indavaḥ ||

translations.english: Both heaven and earth follow you as the wheels (of a car follow) the horse; the streams of the Somapoured forth (by the priests) follow (you).

mantras.sanskrit: मन्दस्वा सु स्वर्णर उतेन्द्र शर्यणावति । मत्स्वा विवस्वतो मती ॥
mantras.transliteration: mandasvā su svarṇara utendra śaryaṇāvati | matsvā vivasvato matī ||

translations.english: Rejoice, Indra, at the heaven-guiding sacrifice as Śaryaṇāvat; be exhilarated by the praise of theworshipper.

mantras.sanskrit: वावृधान उप द्यवि वृषा वज्र्यरोरवीत् । वृत्रहा सोमपातमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāvṛdhāna upa dyavi vṛṣā vajryaroravīt | vṛtrahā somapātamaḥ ||

translations.english: The vast wielder of the thunderbolt, the slayer of Vṛtra, the deep quaffer of the Soma, the showerer,roars near at hand in the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋषिर्हि पूर्वजा अस्येक ईशान ओजसा । इन्द्र चोष्कूयसे वसु ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛṣirhi pūrvajā asyeka īśāna ojasā | indra coṣkūyase vasu ||

translations.english: You are a Ṛṣi, the first-born (of the gods), the chief, the ruler (over all) by your strength; you giverepeatedly, Indra, wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्माकं त्वा सुताँ उप वीतपृष्ठा अभि प्रयः । शतं वहन्तु हरयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmākaṃ tvā sutā~ upa vītapṛṣṭhā abhi prayaḥ | śataṃ vahantu harayaḥ ||

translations.english: May your hundred sleek-backed horses bring you to our libations, to our (sacrificial) food.

mantras.sanskrit: इमां सु पूर्व्यां धियं मधोर्घृतस्य पिप्युषीम् । कण्वा उक्थेन वावृधुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imāṃ su pūrvyāṃ dhiyaṃ madhorghṛtasya pipyuṣīm | kaṇvā ukthena vāvṛdhuḥ ||

translations.english: The Kaṇvas augment by praise this ancient rite intended (to obtain) an abundance of sweet water.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रमिद्विमहीनां मेधे वृणीत मर्त्यः । इन्द्रं सनिष्युरूतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: indramidvimahīnāṃ medhe vṛṇīta martyaḥ | indraṃ saniṣyurūtaye ||

translations.english: The mortal (adorer) selects at the sacrifice Indra from among the mighty (gods); he who is desirous ofwealth (worships) Indra for protection.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्वाञ्चं त्वा पुरुष्टुत प्रियमेधस्तुता हरी । सोमपेयाय वक्षतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: arvāñcaṃ tvā puruṣṭuta priyamedhastutā harī | somapeyāya vakṣataḥ ||

translations.english: May your horses, praised by the pious priests, bring you, who are the praised of many, down to drinkthe Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: शतमहं तिरिन्दिरे सहस्रं पर्शावा ददे । राधांसि याद्वानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śatamahaṃ tirindire sahasraṃ parśāvā dade | rādhāṃsi yādvānām ||

translations.english: I have accepted from Tirindira, the son of Paraśu, hundreds and thousands of the treasures of meṇ

mantras.sanskrit: त्रीणि शतान्यर्वतां सहस्रा दश गोनाम् । ददुष्पज्राय साम्ने ॥
mantras.transliteration: trīṇi śatānyarvatāṃ sahasrā daśa gonām | daduṣpajrāya sāmne ||

translations.english: (These princes) have given to the chanter Pajra three hundred horses, ten thousand cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: उदानट् ककुहो दिवमुष्ट्राञ्चतुर्युजो ददत् । श्रवसा याद्वं जनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: udānaṭ kakuho divamuṣṭrāñcaturyujo dadat | śravasā yādvaṃ janam ||

translations.english: The exalted (prince) has been raised by fame to heaven, for he has given camels laden with four (loadsof gold), and Yādva people (as slaves).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र यद्वस्त्रिष्टुभमिषं मरुतो विप्रो अक्षरत् । वि पर्वतेषु राजथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra yadvastriṣṭubhamiṣaṃ maruto vipro akṣarat | vi parvateṣu rājatha ||

translations.english: When the pious worshipper offers you, Maruts, food at the three diurnal rites, then you havesovereignty over the mountains.

mantras.sanskrit: यदङ्ग तविषीयवो यामं शुभ्रा अचिध्वम् । नि पर्वता अहासत ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadaṅga taviṣīyavo yāmaṃ śubhrā acidhvam | ni parvatā ahāsata ||

translations.english: When, glorious and powerful (Maruts), you fit out your chariot, the mountains depart (from their plural ces).

mantras.sanskrit: उदीरयन्त वायुभिर्वाश्रासः पृश्निमातरः । धुक्षन्त पिप्युषीमिषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: udīrayanta vāyubhirvāśrāsaḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ | dhukṣanta pipyuṣīmiṣam ||

translations.english: The loud-sounding sons of Pṛśni drive with their breezes (the clouds), they milk forth nutritioussustenance.

mantras.sanskrit: वपन्ति मरुतो मिहं प्र वेपयन्ति पर्वतान् । यद्यामं यान्ति वायुभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vapanti maruto mihaṃ pra vepayanti parvatān | yadyāmaṃ yānti vāyubhiḥ ||

translations.english: The Maruts scatter the rain, they shake the mountains, when they mount their chariot, with the winds.

mantras.sanskrit: नि यद्यामाय वो गिरिर्नि सिन्धवो विधर्मणे । महे शुष्माय येमिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni yadyāmāya vo girirni sindhavo vidharmaṇe | mahe śuṣmāya yemire ||

translations.english: The mountains are curbed, the rivers are restrained at your coming, for the upholding of your greatstrength.

mantras.sanskrit: युष्माँ उ नक्तमूतये युष्मान्दिवा हवामहे । युष्मान्प्रयत्यध्वरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuṣmā~ u naktamūtaye yuṣmāndivā havāmahe | yuṣmānprayatyadhvare ||

translations.english: We invoke you for protection by night, (we invoke) you by day, (we invoke) you when the sacrifice is inprogress.

mantras.sanskrit: उदु त्ये अरुणप्सवश्चित्रा यामेभिरीरते । वाश्रा अधि ष्णुना दिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: udu tye aruṇapsavaścitrā yāmebhirīrate | vāśrā adhi ṣṇunā divaḥ ||

translations.english: Truly these purple-hued, wonderful, clamorous Maruts proceed with their chariots in the height aove thesky.

mantras.sanskrit: सृजन्ति रश्मिमोजसा पन्थां सूर्याय यातवे । ते भानुभिर्वि तस्थिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: sṛjanti raśmimojasā panthāṃ sūryāya yātave | te bhānubhirvi tasthire ||

translations.english: They, who by their might open a radiant path for the sun to travel, they pervade (the world) with lustre.

mantras.sanskrit: इमां मे मरुतो गिरमिमं स्तोममृभुक्षणः । इमं मे वनता हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: imāṃ me maruto giramimaṃ stomamṛbhukṣaṇaḥ | imaṃ me vanatā havam ||

translations.english: Accept, Maruts, this my praise, (accept), mighty ones, this my adoration, (accept) this my invocation.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रीणि सरांसि पृश्नयो दुदुह्रे वज्रिणे मधु । उत्सं कवन्धमुद्रिणम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: trīṇi sarāṃsi pṛśnayo duduhre vajriṇe madhu | utsaṃ kavandhamudriṇam ||

translations.english: The kine have filled for the thunderer three lakes of the sweet (Soma) from the dripping water-bearingcloud.

mantras.sanskrit: मरुतो यद्ध वो दिवः सुम्नायन्तो हवामहे । आ तू न उप गन्तन ॥
mantras.transliteration: maruto yaddha vo divaḥ sumnāyanto havāmahe | ā tū na upa gantana ||

translations.english: When, Maruts, desirous of felicity, we invoke you from heaven, come unto us quickly.

mantras.sanskrit: यूयं हि ष्ठा सुदानवो रुद्रा ऋभुक्षणो दमे । उत प्रचेतसो मदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yūyaṃ hi ṣṭhā sudānavo rudrā ṛbhukṣaṇo dame | uta pracetaso made ||

translations.english: Munificent, mighty Rudras, you in the sacrificial hall are wise (even) in the exhilaration (of the Soma).

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो रयिं मदच्युतं पुरुक्षुं विश्वधायसम् । इयर्ता मरुतो दिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no rayiṃ madacyutaṃ purukṣuṃ viśvadhāyasam | iyartā maruto divaḥ ||

translations.english: Send us, Maruts, from heaven exhilarating, many lauded, all-sustaining riches.

mantras.sanskrit: अधीव यद्गिरीणां यामं शुभ्रा अचिध्वम् । सुवानैर्मन्दध्व इन्दुभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhīva yadgirīṇāṃ yāmaṃ śubhrā acidhvam | suvānairmandadhva indubhiḥ ||

translations.english: When, bright (Maruts), you harness your car over the mountains, then you exhilarate (yourselves) withthe effusing Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: एतावतश्चिदेषां सुम्नं भिक्षेत मर्त्यः । अदाभ्यस्य मन्मभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: etāvataścideṣāṃ sumnaṃ bhikṣeta martyaḥ | adābhyasya manmabhiḥ ||

translations.english: A man should solicit happiness of them with praises of such an unconquerable (company).

mantras.sanskrit: ये द्रप्सा इव रोदसी धमन्त्यनु वृष्टिभिः । उत्सं दुहन्तो अक्षितम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye drapsā iva rodasī dhamantyanu vṛṣṭibhiḥ | utsaṃ duhanto akṣitam ||

translations.english: They who, like dropping showers, inflate heaven and earth with rain, milking the inexhaustible cloud.

mantras.sanskrit: उदु स्वानेभिरीरत उद्रथैरुदु वायुभिः । उत्स्तोमैः पृश्निमातरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: udu svānebhirīrata udrathairudu vāyubhiḥ | utstomaiḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ ||

translations.english: The sons of Pṛśni rise up with shouts, with chariots, with winds, with praises.

mantras.sanskrit: येनाव तुर्वशं यदुं येन कण्वं धनस्पृतम् । राये सु तस्य धीमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yenāva turvaśaṃ yaduṃ yena kaṇvaṃ dhanaspṛtam | rāye su tasya dhīmahi ||

translations.english: We meditate on that (genitive rosity) whereby for (the sake of granting them) riches you have protectedTurvaśa and Yadu and the wealth-desiring Kaṇva.

mantras.sanskrit: इमा उ वः सुदानवो घृतं न पिप्युषीरिषः । वर्धान्काण्वस्य मन्मभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imā u vaḥ sudānavo ghṛtaṃ na pipyuṣīriṣaḥ | vardhānkāṇvasya manmabhiḥ ||

translations.english: Munificent (Maruts), may these (sacrificial) viands, nutritious as butter, together with the praises of thedescendant of Kaṇva, afford you augmentation.

mantras.sanskrit: क्व नूनं सुदानवो मदथा वृक्तबर्हिषः । ब्रह्मा को वः सपर्यति ॥
mantras.transliteration: kva nūnaṃ sudānavo madathā vṛktabarhiṣaḥ | brahmā ko vaḥ saparyati ||

translations.english: Munificent (Maruts), for whom the sacred grass has been trimmed, where now are you beingexhilarated? What pious worshipper detains you as he) adores you?

mantras.sanskrit: नहि ष्म यद्ध वः पुरा स्तोमेभिर्वृक्तबर्हिषः । शर्धाँ ऋतस्य जिन्वथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahi ṣma yaddha vaḥ purā stomebhirvṛktabarhiṣaḥ | śardhā~ ṛtasya jinvatha ||

translations.english: (Maruts), for whom the sacred grass is trimmed, it cannot be (that you submit to be detained), for youhave derived strength from the sacrifice, formerly (accompanied) by our praises.

mantras.sanskrit: समु त्ये महतीरपः सं क्षोणी समु सूर्यम् । सं वज्रं पर्वशो दधुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samu tye mahatīrapaḥ saṃ kṣoṇī samu sūryam | saṃ vajraṃ parvaśo dadhuḥ ||

translations.english: They have concentrated the abundant waters, they have held together the heaven and earth, they havesustained the sun, they have divided (Vṛtra) joint by joint with the thunderbolt.

mantras.sanskrit: वि वृत्रं पर्वशो ययुर्वि पर्वताँ अराजिनः । चक्राणा वृष्णि पौंस्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi vṛtraṃ parvaśo yayurvi parvatā~ arājinaḥ | cakrāṇā vṛṣṇi pauṃsyam ||

translations.english: Independent of a ruler, they have divided Vṛtra joint by joint; they have shattered the mountains,manifesting manly vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: अनु त्रितस्य युध्यतः शुष्ममावन्नुत क्रतुम् । अन्विन्द्रं वृत्रतूर्ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: anu tritasya yudhyataḥ śuṣmamāvannuta kratum | anvindraṃ vṛtratūrye ||

translations.english: They have come to the aid of the warring Trita, invigorating his strength, and (animating) his acts; theyhave come to the aid of Indra, for the destruction of Vṛtra.

mantras.sanskrit: विद्युद्धस्ता अभिद्यवः शिप्राः शीर्षन्हिरण्ययीः । शुभ्रा व्यञ्जत श्रिये ॥
mantras.transliteration: vidyuddhastā abhidyavaḥ śiprāḥ śīrṣanhiraṇyayīḥ | śubhrā vyañjata śriye ||

translations.english: The birlliant (Maruts), bearing the lightning in their hands, radiant above all, gloriously display theirgolden helmets on their heads.

mantras.sanskrit: उशना यत्परावत उक्ष्णो रन्ध्रमयातन । द्यौर्न चक्रदद्भिया ॥
mantras.transliteration: uśanā yatparāvata ukṣṇo randhramayātana | dyaurna cakradadbhiyā ||

translations.english: Glorified, (Maruts), by Uśanas, when you approach from afar to the opening of the rainy (firmament),then (the dwellers on earth), like those in heaven, are clamorous through fear.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो मखस्य दावनेऽश्वैर्हिरण्यपाणिभिः । देवास उप गन्तन ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no makhasya dāvane'śvairhiraṇyapāṇibhiḥ | devāsa upa gantana ||

translations.english: Come, gods, to (show your) liberality at our sacrifice with your golden-footed steeds.

mantras.sanskrit: यदेषां पृषती रथे प्रष्टिर्वहति रोहितः । यान्ति शुभ्रा रिणन्नपः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadeṣāṃ pṛṣatī rathe praṣṭirvahati rohitaḥ | yānti śubhrā riṇannapaḥ ||

translations.english: When the spotted antelope or the swift tawny deer conveys them in their chariot, then the brilliant(Maruts) depart, and the rains have gone.

mantras.sanskrit: सुषोमे शर्यणावत्यार्जीके पस्त्यावति । ययुर्निचक्रया नरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: suṣome śaryaṇāvatyārjīke pastyāvati | yayurnicakrayā naraḥ ||

translations.english: The leaders of rites have proceeded with downward chariot-wheels to the Ṛjīka (Ārjīka) country,where lies the Śaryaṇāvat, abounding in dwellings, and where Soma is plural ntiful.

mantras.sanskrit: कदा गच्छाथ मरुत इत्था विप्रं हवमानम् । मार्डीकेभिर्नाधमानम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kadā gacchātha maruta itthā vipraṃ havamānam | mārḍīkebhirnādhamānam ||

translations.english: When, maruts, will you go with joy-bestowing riches to the sage thus adoring you, and soliciting (you forwealth)?

mantras.sanskrit: कद्ध नूनं कधप्रियो यदिन्द्रमजहातन । को वः सखित्व ओहते ॥
mantras.transliteration: kaddha nūnaṃ kadhapriyo yadindramajahātana | ko vaḥ sakhitva ohate ||

translations.english: When was it, Maruts, who are gratified by praise, that you really deserted Indra? Who is there thatenjoys your friendship?

mantras.sanskrit: सहो षु णो वज्रहस्तैः कण्वासो अग्निं मरुद्भिः । स्तुषे हिरण्यवाशीभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: saho ṣu ṇo vajrahastaiḥ kaṇvāso agniṃ marudbhiḥ | stuṣe hiraṇyavāśībhiḥ ||

translations.english: Do you of our race of Kaṇva praise Agni together with the Maruts, bearing the thunderbolt in theirhands, and armed with golden lances.

mantras.sanskrit: ओ षु वृष्णः प्रयज्यूना नव्यसे सुविताय । ववृत्यां चित्रवाजान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: o ṣu vṛṣṇaḥ prayajyūnā navyase suvitāya | vavṛtyāṃ citravājān ||

translations.english: I bring to my presence, for the sake of most excellent prosperity, the showerers (of desires), theadorable (Maruts), the possessors of wonderful strength.

mantras.sanskrit: गिरयश्चिन्नि जिहते पर्शानासो मन्यमानाः । पर्वताश्चिन्नि येमिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: girayaścinni jihate parśānāso manyamānāḥ | parvatāścinni yemire ||

translations.english: The hills, oppressed and agitated by them, move (from their plural ces), the mountains are restraineḍ

mantras.sanskrit: आक्ष्णयावानो वहन्त्यन्तरिक्षेण पततः । धातारः स्तुवते वयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ākṣṇayāvāno vahantyantarikṣeṇa patataḥ | dhātāraḥ stuvate vayaḥ ||

translations.english: (Their horses), quickly traversing (space), bear them travelling through the firmament, giving food to theworshipper.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निर्हि जानि पूर्व्यश्छन्दो न सूरो अर्चिषा । ते भानुभिर्वि तस्थिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirhi jāni pūrvyaśchando na sūro arciṣā | te bhānubhirvi tasthire ||

translations.english: Agni was born the first among the gods, like the brilliant sun in splendour; then they (the Maruts) stoodround in their radiance.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो विश्वाभिरूतिभिरश्विना गच्छतं युवम् । दस्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी पिबतं सोम्यं मधु ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no viśvābhirūtibhiraśvinā gacchataṃ yuvam | dasrā hiraṇyavartanī pibataṃ somyaṃ madhu ||

translations.english: Come to us, Aśvins, with all your protections; Dasras, riders in a golden chariot, drink the sweet Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नूनं यातमश्विना रथेन सूर्यत्वचा । भुजी हिरण्यपेशसा कवी गम्भीरचेतसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā nūnaṃ yātamaśvinā rathena sūryatvacā | bhujī hiraṇyapeśasā kavī gambhīracetasā ||

translations.english: Aśvin, partakers of sacrificial food, decorated with golden ornaments, wise, and endowed with profoundintellects, come verily in your chariot, invested with solar radiance.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यातं नहुषस्पर्यान्तरिक्षात्सुवृक्तिभिः । पिबाथो अश्विना मधु कण्वानां सवने सुतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yātaṃ nahuṣasparyāntarikṣātsuvṛktibhiḥ | pibātho aśvinā madhu kaṇvānāṃ savane sutam ||

translations.english: Come from (the world of) man, come from the firmament, (attracted) by our pious praises, drink, Aśvins,the sweet Soma offered at the sacriice of the Kaṇvas.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो यातं दिवस्पर्यान्तरिक्षादधप्रिया । पुत्रः कण्वस्य वामिह सुषाव सोम्यं मधु ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no yātaṃ divasparyāntarikṣādadhapriyā | putraḥ kaṇvasya vāmiha suṣāva somyaṃ madhu ||

translations.english: Come to us from above the heaven, you who love the (world) below, (come) from the firmament; the sonof Kaṇva has been poured forth for you the sweet Soma libation.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो यातमुपश्रुत्यश्विना सोमपीतये । स्वाहा स्तोमस्य वर्धना प्र कवी धीतिभिर्नरा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no yātamupaśrutyaśvinā somapītaye | svāhā stomasya vardhanā pra kavī dhītibhirnarā ||

translations.english: Come, Aśvins, to drink the Soma at our sacrifice, you who are praised (by him) and honoured by hispious acts, benefactors of the worshipper, sages and leaders of rites.

mantras.sanskrit: यच्चिद्धि वां पुर ऋषयो जुहूरेऽवसे नरा । आ यातमश्विना गतमुपेमां सुष्टुतिं मम ॥
mantras.transliteration: yacciddhi vāṃ pura ṛṣayo juhūre'vase narā | ā yātamaśvinā gatamupemāṃ suṣṭutiṃ mama ||

translations.english: Leaders of rites, when the Ṛṣis formerly invoked you for protection, you came; so now, Aśvins, comeat my devout praises.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवश्चिद्रोचनादध्या नो गन्तं स्वर्विदा । धीभिर्वत्सप्रचेतसा स्तोमेभिर्हवनश्रुता ॥
mantras.transliteration: divaścidrocanādadhyā no gantaṃ svarvidā | dhībhirvatsapracetasā stomebhirhavanaśrutā ||

translations.english: Familiar with heaven, come to us from the sky, or from above the bright (firmament); favourably inclidedto the worshipper, (come), induced by his pious acts; hearers of invocations (come, induced) by our praiseṣ

mantras.sanskrit: किमन्ये पर्यासतेऽस्मत्स्तोमेभिरश्विना । पुत्रः कण्वस्य वामृषिर्गीर्भिर्वत्सो अवीवृधत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kimanye paryāsate'smatstomebhiraśvinā | putraḥ kaṇvasya vāmṛṣirgīrbhirvatso avīvṛdhat ||

translations.english: What others than ourselves adore the Aśvins with praises? The Ṛṣi Vatsa, the son of Kaṇva, hasmagnified you with hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वां विप्र इहावसेऽह्वत्स्तोमेभिरश्विना । अरिप्रा वृत्रहन्तमा ता नो भूतं मयोभुवा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāṃ vipra ihāvase'hvatstomebhiraśvinā | ariprā vṛtrahantamā tā no bhūtaṃ mayobhuvā ||

translations.english: The wise adorer invokes you hither with praise, Aśvins, for protection; sinless, utter destroyers ofenemies, be to us the sources of felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यद्वां योषणा रथमतिष्ठद्वाजिनीवसू । विश्वान्यश्विना युवं प्र धीतान्यगच्छतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yadvāṃ yoṣaṇā rathamatiṣṭhadvājinīvasū | viśvānyaśvinā yuvaṃ pra dhītānyagacchatam ||

translations.english: Affluent in sacrifices, when the maiden (sūrya) mounted your chariot, then, Aśvins, you obtained allyour desires.

mantras.sanskrit: अतः सहस्रनिर्णिजा रथेना यातमश्विना । वत्सो वां मधुमद्वचोऽशंसीत्काव्यः कविः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ataḥ sahasranirṇijā rathenā yātamaśvinā | vatso vāṃ madhumadvaco'śaṃsītkāvyaḥ kaviḥ ||

translations.english: From wheresoever (you may be) come, Aśvins, with your thousandfold diversified chariot; the sageVatsa, the son of Kavi, has addressed you with sweet worlds.

mantras.sanskrit: पुरुमन्द्रा पुरूवसू मनोतरा रयीणाम् । स्तोमं मे अश्विनाविममभि वह्नी अनूषाताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: purumandrā purūvasū manotarā rayīṇām | stomaṃ me aśvināvimamabhi vahnī anūṣātām ||

translations.english: Delighters of many, abonding in wealth, bestowers of riches, Aśvins, sustainers of all, approve of thismy adoration.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो विश्वान्यश्विना धत्तं राधांस्यह्रया । कृतं न ऋत्वियावतो मा नो रीरधतं निदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no viśvānyaśvinā dhattaṃ rādhāṃsyahrayā | kṛtaṃ na ṛtviyāvato mā no rīradhataṃ nide ||

translations.english: Grant us, Aśvins, all riches that may not bring us shame, make us the begetters of progeny in dueseason, subject us not to reproach.

mantras.sanskrit: यन्नासत्या परावति यद्वा स्थो अध्यम्बरे । अतः सहस्रनिर्णिजा रथेना यातमश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: yannāsatyā parāvati yadvā stho adhyambare | ataḥ sahasranirṇijā rathenā yātamaśvinā ||

translations.english: Whether, Nāsatyās, you be far off, or whether you be near, come from there wiḥ your thousandolddiversified chariot.

mantras.sanskrit: यो वां नासत्यावृषिर्गीर्भिर्वत्सो अवीवृधत् । तस्मै सहस्रनिर्णिजमिषं धत्तं घृतश्चुतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo vāṃ nāsatyāvṛṣirgīrbhirvatso avīvṛdhat | tasmai sahasranirṇijamiṣaṃ dhattaṃ ghṛtaścutam ||

translations.english: Give, Nāsatyās, food of many kinds dripping with butter to him, the ṛṣi Vatsa, who has magnifiedyou both with hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रास्मा ऊर्जं घृतश्चुतमश्विना यच्छतं युवम् । यो वां सुम्नाय तुष्टवद्वसूयाद्दानुनस्पती ॥
mantras.transliteration: prāsmā ūrjaṃ ghṛtaścutamaśvinā yacchataṃ yuvam | yo vāṃ sumnāya tuṣṭavadvasūyāddānunaspatī ||

translations.english: Give, Aśvins, invigorating food, dripping with butter, to him who praises you, the lords of liberality, toobtain happiness; who desires affluence.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो गन्तं रिशादसेमं स्तोमं पुरुभुजा । कृतं नः सुश्रियो नरेमा दातमभिष्टये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no gantaṃ riśādasemaṃ stomaṃ purubhujā | kṛtaṃ naḥ suśriyo naremā dātamabhiṣṭaye ||

translations.english: Confounders of the malignant, partakers of many (oblations), come to this our adoration; render usprosperous leaders (of rites); give these (good things of earth) to our desires.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वां विश्वाभिरूतिभिः प्रियमेधा अहूषत । राजन्तावध्वराणामश्विना यामहूतिषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāṃ viśvābhirūtibhiḥ priyamedhā ahūṣata | rājantāvadhvarāṇāmaśvinā yāmahūtiṣu ||

translations.english: The Priyamedhas at the sacrifices to the gods invoke you, Aśvins, who rule over religious rites,together with your protections.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो गन्तं मयोभुवाश्विना शम्भुवा युवम् । यो वां विपन्यू धीतिभिर्गीर्भिर्वत्सो अवीवृधत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no gantaṃ mayobhuvāśvinā śambhuvā yuvam | yo vāṃ vipanyū dhītibhirgīrbhirvatso avīvṛdhat ||

translations.english: Come to us, Aśvins, sources of happiness, sources of health; (come), adorable (Aśvins), to that Vatsa,who has magnified you with sacrifices and with praises.

mantras.sanskrit: याभिः कण्वं मेधातिथिं याभिर्वशं दशव्रजम् । याभिर्गोशर्यमावतं ताभिर्नोऽवतं नरा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yābhiḥ kaṇvaṃ medhātithiṃ yābhirvaśaṃ daśavrajam | yābhirgośaryamāvataṃ tābhirno'vataṃ narā ||

translations.english: Leaders (of rites), protect us with those protections with which you have protected Kaṇva andMedhātithi, Viśa and Daśavraja, with which you have protected Gośarya.

mantras.sanskrit: याभिर्नरा त्रसदस्युमावतं कृत्व्ये धने । ताभिः ष्वस्माँ अश्विना प्रावतं वाजसातये ॥
mantras.transliteration: yābhirnarā trasadasyumāvataṃ kṛtvye dhane | tābhiḥ ṣvasmā~ aśvinā prāvataṃ vājasātaye ||

translations.english: (And) with which, leaders (of rites), you protected Trasadasyu when wealth was to be acquired; do youwith the same graciously protec tus, Aśvins, for the acquisition of food.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वां स्तोमाः सुवृक्तयो गिरो वर्धन्त्वश्विना । पुरुत्रा वृत्रहन्तमा ता नो भूतं पुरुस्पृहा ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vāṃ stomāḥ suvṛktayo giro vardhantvaśvinā | purutrā vṛtrahantamā tā no bhūtaṃ puruspṛhā ||

translations.english: May (perfect) hymns and holy praises magnify you, Aśvins; protectors of many, exerminators of foes,greatly are you desired of us.
