mantras.sanskrit: त्रीणि पदान्यश्विनोराविः सान्ति गुहा परः । कवी ऋतस्य पत्मभिरर्वाग्जीवेभ्यस्परि ॥
mantras.transliteration: trīṇi padānyaśvinorāviḥ sānti guhā paraḥ | kavī ṛtasya patmabhirarvāgjīvebhyaspari ||

translations.english: The three wheels (of the chariot) of he Aśvins, which were invisible, have become manifest; do youtwo, who are cognizant of the past, (come) by the paths of truth to the presence of living beings.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नूनमश्विना युवं वत्सस्य गन्तमवसे । प्रास्मै यच्छतमवृकं पृथु च्छर्दिर्युयुतं या अरातयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā nūnamaśvinā yuvaṃ vatsasya gantamavase | prāsmai yacchatamavṛkaṃ pṛthu cchardiryuyutaṃ yā arātayaḥ ||

translations.english: Come, Aśvins, without fail, for the protection of the worshipper; confer upon him a secure and spaciousdwelling; drive away those who make no offerings.

mantras.sanskrit: यदन्तरिक्षे यद्दिवि यत्पञ्च मानुषाँ अनु । नृम्णं तद्धत्तमश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadantarikṣe yaddivi yatpañca mānuṣā~ anu | nṛmṇaṃ taddhattamaśvinā ||

translations.english: Whatever wealth may be in the firmament, in heaven, or among the five (classes) of men, bestow,Aśvins, (upon us).

mantras.sanskrit: ये वां दंसांस्यश्विना विप्रासः परिमामृशुः । एवेत्काण्वस्य बोधतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye vāṃ daṃsāṃsyaśvinā viprāsaḥ parimāmṛśuḥ | evetkāṇvasya bodhatam ||

translations.english: Recognize, Aśvins, (the devotions0 of the son of Kaṇva, as (you have recognized) those former sageswho have repeatedly addresswed pious works to you.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं वां घर्मो अश्विना स्तोमेन परि षिच्यते । अयं सोमो मधुमान्वाजिनीवसू येन वृत्रं चिकेतथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ vāṃ gharmo aśvinā stomena pari ṣicyate | ayaṃ somo madhumānvājinīvasū yena vṛtraṃ ciketathaḥ ||

translations.english: This oblation is poured out, Aśvin, to you with praise; this sweet- savoured Soma is offered to you, whoare alluent with food, (animated) by which you meditate (the destruction) of the foe.

mantras.sanskrit: यदप्सु यद्वनस्पतौ यदोषधीषु पुरुदंससा कृतम् । तेन माविष्टमश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadapsu yadvanaspatau yadoṣadhīṣu purudaṃsasā kṛtam | tena māviṣṭamaśvinā ||

translations.english: Doers of many deeds, Aśvins preserve me with that (healing virtue) deposited (by you) in the waters, inthe trees, in the herbs.

mantras.sanskrit: यन्नासत्या भुरण्यथो यद्वा देव भिषज्यथः । अयं वां वत्सो मतिभिर्न विन्धते हविष्मन्तं हि गच्छथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yannāsatyā bhuraṇyatho yadvā deva bhiṣajyathaḥ | ayaṃ vāṃ vatso matibhirna vindhate haviṣmantaṃ hi gacchathaḥ ||

translations.english: Although, Nāsatyās, you cherish (all beings), though, divinities, you heal (all disease),, yet this youradorer does not obtain you by praises (only), you go to him who offers you oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नूनमश्विनोॠषिः स्तोमं चिकेत वामया । आ सोमं मधुमत्तमं घर्मं सिञ्चादथर्वणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā nūnamaśvinoṝṣiḥ stomaṃ ciketa vāmayā | ā somaṃ madhumattamaṃ gharmaṃ siñcādatharvaṇi ||

translations.english: When verily you arrive, Aśvins, the ṛṣi understands with excellent (comprehension) the praise (to beaddressed to you); he will sprinkle the sweet- flavoured Soma and the gharma (oblation) on Atharvan fire.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नूनं रघुवर्तनिं रथं तिष्ठाथो अश्विना । आ वां स्तोमा इमे मम नभो न चुच्यवीरत ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā nūnaṃ raghuvartaniṃ rathaṃ tiṣṭhātho aśvinā | ā vāṃ stomā ime mama nabho na cucyavīrata ||

translations.english: Abscond at once, Aśvins, your light-moving chariot; may these praises bring you down radiant as thesun.

mantras.sanskrit: यदद्य वां नासत्योक्थैराचुच्युवीमहि । यद्वा वाणीभिरश्विनेवेत्काण्वस्य बोधतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadadya vāṃ nāsatyokthairācucyuvīmahi | yadvā vāṇībhiraśvinevetkāṇvasya bodhatam ||

translations.english: Acknowledge Nāsatyās, that we may bring you down today by the prayers and he praises of the sonof Kaṇva.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्वां कक्षीवाँ उत यद्व्यश्व ऋषिर्यद्वां दीर्घतमा जुहाव । पृथी यद्वां वैन्यः सादनेष्वेवेदतो अश्विना चेतयेथाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadvāṃ kakṣīvā~ uta yadvyaśva ṛṣiryadvāṃ dīrghatamā juhāva | pṛthī yadvāṃ vainyaḥ sādaneṣvevedato aśvinā cetayethām ||

translations.english: Consider (my praises) in the same maner as (you have considered) when Kakṣīvat praied yo, whenthe ṛṣi Vyaśva, when Dīrghatamas, or Pṛthin, the son of Vena, glorified you in the chambers of sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: यातं छर्दिष्पा उत नः परस्पा भूतं जगत्पा उत नस्तनूपा । वर्तिस्तोकाय तनयाय यातम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yātaṃ chardiṣpā uta naḥ paraspā bhūtaṃ jagatpā uta nastanūpā | vartistokāya tanayāya yātam ||

translations.english: Come (to us as) guardians of our dwelling, become our defenders, be protectors of our dependants,cherishers of our person ns; come to the dwelling for (the good of) our sons and grandsons.

mantras.sanskrit: यदिन्द्रेण सरथं याथो अश्विना यद्वा वायुना भवथः समोकसा । यदादित्येभिॠभुभिः सजोषसा यद्वा विष्णोर्विक्रमणेषु तिष्ठथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadindreṇa sarathaṃ yātho aśvinā yadvā vāyunā bhavathaḥ samokasā | yadādityebhiṝbhubhiḥ sajoṣasā yadvā viṣṇorvikramaṇeṣu tiṣṭhathaḥ ||

translations.english: Although, Aśvins you should be riding in the same chariot with Indra, although you should be domiciledwith Vāyu, although you should be enjoying gratification along with the Ādityas and Ṛbhus, although you beproceeding on the tracks of Viṣṇu, (nevertheless come here).

mantras.sanskrit: यदद्याश्विनावहं हुवेय वाजसातये । यत्पृत्सु तुर्वणे सहस्तच्छ्रेष्ठमश्विनोरवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadadyāśvināvahaṃ huveya vājasātaye | yatpṛtsu turvaṇe sahastacchreṣṭhamaśvinoravaḥ ||

translations.english: Inasmuch as I invoke you, Aśvins, today for success in war (therefore grant it), for the triumphantprotection of the Aśvins is the most excellent for the destruction (of enemies) in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नूनं यातमश्विनेमा हव्यानि वां हिता । इमे सोमासो अधि तुर्वशे यदाविमे कण्वेषु वामथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā nūnaṃ yātamaśvinemā havyāni vāṃ hitā | ime somāso adhi turvaśe yadāvime kaṇveṣu vāmatha ||

translations.english: Come, Aśvins, these libations are prepared for you; those libations which were presented you byTurvaśa and Yadu, they are now offered to you by Kaṇvas.

mantras.sanskrit: यन्नासत्या पराके अर्वाके अस्ति भेषजम् । तेन नूनं विमदाय प्रचेतसा छर्दिर्वत्साय यच्छतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yannāsatyā parāke arvāke asti bheṣajam | tena nūnaṃ vimadāya pracetasā chardirvatsāya yacchatam ||

translations.english: The healing drug, Nāsatyās, that is afar off or near, wherewith (you wen) to (his) dwelling for thesake of Vimada, do you who are of surpassing wisdom now grant to Vatsa.

mantras.sanskrit: अभुत्स्यु प्र देव्या साकं वाचाहमश्विनोः । व्यावर्देव्या मतिं वि रातिं मर्त्येभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhutsyu pra devyā sākaṃ vācāhamaśvinoḥ | vyāvardevyā matiṃ vi rātiṃ martyebhyaḥ ||

translations.english: I awake with the pious praise of the Aśvins; scatter, goddess, (the darkness) at my eulogy; bestowwealth upon (us) mortals.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र बोधयोषो अश्विना प्र देवि सूनृते महि । प्र यज्ञहोतरानुषक्प्र मदाय श्रवो बृहत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra bodhayoṣo aśvinā pra devi sūnṛte mahi | pra yajñahotarānuṣakpra madāya śravo bṛhat ||

translations.english: Uṣas, truht-speaking mighty goddess, awake the Aśvins; invoker of the adorable (deities, arouse them)successively; the copious sacrificial food (is prepared) for their exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: यदुषो यासि भानुना सं सूर्येण रोचसे । आ हायमश्विनो रथो वर्तिर्याति नृपाय्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaduṣo yāsi bhānunā saṃ sūryeṇa rocase | ā hāyamaśvino ratho vartiryāti nṛpāyyam ||

translations.english: When, Uṣas, you move with radiance, you shine equally with the sun; and this chariot of the Aśvinsproceeds to the hall of sacrifice frequented by the leaders (of the rite).

mantras.sanskrit: यदापीतासो अंशवो गावो न दुह्र ऊधभिः । यद्वा वाणीरनूषत प्र देवयन्तो अश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadāpītāso aṃśavo gāvo na duhra ūdhabhiḥ | yadvā vāṇīranūṣata pra devayanto aśvinā ||

translations.english: When the yellow Soma stalks milk forth as cows from their udders, when the devout (priests) repeat thewords of praise, then, O Aśvins, preserve us.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र द्युम्नाय प्र शवसे प्र नृषाह्याय शर्मणे । प्र दक्षाय प्रचेतसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra dyumnāya pra śavase pra nṛṣāhyāya śarmaṇe | pra dakṣāya pracetasā ||

translations.english: Endowed with great wisdom, preserve us for fame, for strength, for victory, for happiness, forprosperity.

mantras.sanskrit: यन्नूनं धीभिरश्विना पितुर्योना निषीदथः । यद्वा सुम्नेभिरुक्थ्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: yannūnaṃ dhībhiraśvinā pituryonā niṣīdathaḥ | yadvā sumnebhirukthyā ||

translations.english: Although, Aśvins, you be seated in the region of the paternal (heaven engaged in) holy rites, or,glorified by us, (abide there) with plural asures, (yet come here).

mantras.sanskrit: यत्स्थो दीर्घप्रसद्मनि यद्वादो रोचने दिवः । यद्वा समुद्रे अध्याकृते गृहेऽत आ यातमश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatstho dīrghaprasadmani yadvādo rocane divaḥ | yadvā samudre adhyākṛte gṛhe'ta ā yātamaśvinā ||

translations.english: Whether, Aśvins, you are at present where the spacious halls of sacrifice (abound), whether you are inyonder bright sphere of heaven, or whether you are in a dwelling constructed above the firmament, come here.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्वा यज्ञं मनवे सम्मिमिक्षथुरेवेत्काण्वस्य बोधतम् । बृहस्पतिं विश्वान्देवाँ अहं हुव इन्द्राविष्णू अश्विनावाशुहेषसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadvā yajñaṃ manave sammimikṣathurevetkāṇvasya bodhatam | bṛhaspatiṃ viśvāndevā~ ahaṃ huva indrāviṣṇū aśvināvāśuheṣasā ||

translations.english: In like manner, as you have prepared, Aśvins, the sacrifice for Manu, consent (to prepare it) for the sonof Kaṇva; for I invoke Bṛhaspati, the universal gods, Indra and Viṣṇu, and the Aśvins, with rapid steeds.

mantras.sanskrit: त्या न्वश्विना हुवे सुदंससा गृभे कृता । ययोरस्ति प्र णः सख्यं देवेष्वध्याप्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tyā nvaśvinā huve sudaṃsasā gṛbhe kṛtā | yayorasti pra ṇaḥ sakhyaṃ deveṣvadhyāpyam ||

translations.english: I invoke those Aśvins, who are famed for great deeds, induced (to come here) for acceptance (of ouroblations), of whom among the gods the friendship is especially to be obtained.

mantras.sanskrit: ययोरधि प्र यज्ञा असूरे सन्ति सूरयः । ता यज्ञस्याध्वरस्य प्रचेतसा स्वधाभिर्या पिबतः सोम्यं मधु ॥
mantras.transliteration: yayoradhi pra yajñā asūre santi sūrayaḥ | tā yajñasyādhvarasya pracetasā svadhābhiryā pibataḥ somyaṃ madhu ||

translations.english: Upon whom (all) sacrifices are dependent, of whom there are worshippers in a plural ce where is noworship, those two familiar with undecaying sacrifices (I invoke) with praises, that you may drink the sweet Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: यदद्याश्विनावपाग्यत्प्राक्स्थो वाजिनीवसू । यद्द्रुह्यव्यनवि तुर्वशे यदौ हुवे वामथ मा गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadadyāśvināvapāgyatprākstho vājinīvasū | yaddruhyavyanavi turvaśe yadau huve vāmatha mā gatam ||

translations.english: Whether, Aśvins, you abide today in the west, whether opulent in food, you abide in the east, whetheryou sojourn with Druhyu, Anu, Turvaśu or Yadu, I invoke you, therefore, come to me.

mantras.sanskrit: यदन्तरिक्षे पतथः पुरुभुजा यद्वेमे रोदसी अनु । यद्वा स्वधाभिरधितिष्ठथो रथमत आ यातमश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadantarikṣe patathaḥ purubhujā yadveme rodasī anu | yadvā svadhābhiradhitiṣṭhatho rathamata ā yātamaśvinā ||

translations.english: Protectors of many, whether you traverse the firmament, or pass along earth and heaven, whether youascend your chariot with (all) your splendours, come from there, Aśvins, here.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने व्रतपा असि देव आ मर्त्येष्वा । त्वं यज्ञेष्वीड्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne vratapā asi deva ā martyeṣvā | tvaṃ yajñeṣvīḍyaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, who are a god among mortals, (and among gods), you are the guardian of religious obligations;you are to be hymned at sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमसि प्रशस्यो विदथेषु सहन्त्य । अग्ने रथीरध्वराणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamasi praśasyo vidatheṣu sahantya | agne rathīradhvarāṇām ||

translations.english: Victor (over enemies), you are to be hymned at solemn rites; you, Agni, are the charioteer of sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: स त्वमस्मदप द्विषो युयोधि जातवेदः । अदेवीरग्ने अरातीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa tvamasmadapa dviṣo yuyodhi jātavedaḥ | adevīragne arātīḥ ||

translations.english: Do you, Jātavedas, drive away from us those who hate us; (drive away), Agni, the impious hostilehosts.

mantras.sanskrit: अन्ति चित्सन्तमह यज्ञं मर्तस्य रिपोः । नोप वेषि जातवेदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: anti citsantamaha yajñaṃ martasya ripoḥ | nopa veṣi jātavedaḥ ||

translations.english: You desire not, Jātavedas, the sacrifice of the man who is our adversary, although plural ced before you.

mantras.sanskrit: मर्ता अमर्त्यस्य ते भूरि नाम मनामहे । विप्रासो जातवेदसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: martā amartyasya te bhūri nāma manāmahe | viprāso jātavedasaḥ ||

translations.english: Prudent mortals, we offer abundant homage to you, who are immortal and all-knowing.

mantras.sanskrit: विप्रं विप्रासोऽवसे देवं मर्तास ऊतये । अग्निं गीर्भिर्हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: vipraṃ viprāso'vase devaṃ martāsa ūtaye | agniṃ gīrbhirhavāmahe ||

translations.english: Prudent mortals, we invoke the sage deity Agni with hymns to propitiate him for our protection.

mantras.sanskrit: आ ते वत्सो मनो यमत्परमाच्चित्सधस्थात् । अग्ने त्वांकामया गिरा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā te vatso mano yamatparamāccitsadhasthāt | agne tvāṃkāmayā girā ||

translations.english: Vatsa, by the praise that seeks to propitiate you, Agni, would draw your thought from the supremeassembly (of the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: पुरुत्रा हि सदृङ्ङसि विशो विश्वा अनु प्रभुः । समत्सु त्वा हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: purutrā hi sadṛṅṅasi viśo viśvā anu prabhuḥ | samatsu tvā havāmahe ||

translations.english: You look upon many plural ces, you are lord over all people; we call upon you in battles.

mantras.sanskrit: समत्स्वग्निमवसे वाजयन्तो हवामहे । वाजेषु चित्रराधसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: samatsvagnimavase vājayanto havāmahe | vājeṣu citrarādhasam ||

translations.english: Desiring strength, we call upon Agni for protection in battles; upon him who is the granter of wonderfulriches (won) in conflicts.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रत्नो हि कमीड्यो अध्वरेषु सनाच्च होता नव्यश्च सत्सि । स्वां चाग्ने तन्वं पिप्रयस्वास्मभ्यं च सौभगमा यजस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: pratno hi kamīḍyo adhvareṣu sanācca hotā navyaśca satsi | svāṃ cāgne tanvaṃ piprayasvāsmabhyaṃ ca saubhagamā yajasva ||

translations.english: You, the ancient, are to be hymned at sacrifices; from eternity the invoker of the gods, you sit (at thesolemnity) entitled to laudation; cherish, Agni, yor own person n, and grant us prosperity.

mantras.sanskrit: य इन्द्र सोमपातमो मदः शविष्ठ चेतति । येना हंसि न्यत्रिणं तमीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya indra somapātamo madaḥ śaviṣṭha cetati | yenā haṃsi nyatriṇaṃ tamīmahe ||

translations.english: We solicit, most powerful Indra, who are the deep quaffer of the Soma, that exhilaration whichcontemplates (heroic deeds), whereby you slay the devourer (of men).

mantras.sanskrit: येना दशग्वमध्रिगुं वेपयन्तं स्वर्णरम् । येना समुद्रमाविथा तमीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yenā daśagvamadhriguṃ vepayantaṃ svarṇaram | yenā samudramāvithā tamīmahe ||

translations.english: We solicit that (exhilaration) whereby you have defended Adhrigu, the accomplisher of the ten (monthśrite), and the trembling leader of heaven, (the sun), and the ocean.

mantras.sanskrit: येन सिन्धुं महीरपो रथाँ इव प्रचोदयः । पन्थामृतस्य यातवे तमीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yena sindhuṃ mahīrapo rathā~ iva pracodayaḥ | panthāmṛtasya yātave tamīmahe ||

translations.english: We solicit that (exhilaration) whereby you urge on the mighty waters to the sea, in like manner as(charioteers drive) their cars (to the goal), and (whereby) to travel the paths of sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: इमं स्तोममभिष्टये घृतं न पूतमद्रिवः । येना नु सद्य ओजसा ववक्षिथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: imaṃ stomamabhiṣṭaye ghṛtaṃ na pūtamadrivaḥ | yenā nu sadya ojasā vavakṣitha ||

translations.english: Accepts, thunderer, their praise (offered) for the attainment of our desires, like consecrated butter;(induced) by which, you, promptly bear us by your might (to our objects).

mantras.sanskrit: इमं जुषस्व गिर्वणः समुद्र इव पिन्वते । इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिर्ववक्षिथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: imaṃ juṣasva girvaṇaḥ samudra iva pinvate | indra viśvābhirūtibhirvavakṣitha ||

translations.english: Be plural ased, you who are gratified by praise, with this our eulogy swelling like the oceans, (induced bywhich), Indra, you ber us with all your proections (to our objects).

mantras.sanskrit: यो नो देवः परावतः सखित्वनाय मामहे । दिवो न वृष्टिं प्रथयन्ववक्षिथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo no devaḥ parāvataḥ sakhitvanāya māmahe | divo na vṛṣṭiṃ prathayanvavakṣitha ||

translations.english: (I glorify Indra) the deity, who, coming from afar, has given us, through friendship, (riches); heaping(them upon us) like rain from heaven, you have borne us (to our objects).

mantras.sanskrit: ववक्षुरस्य केतवो उत वज्रो गभस्त्योः । यत्सूर्यो न रोदसी अवर्धयत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vavakṣurasya ketavo uta vajro gabhastyoḥ | yatsūryo na rodasī avardhayat ||

translations.english: The banners of Indra, the thunderbolt (he bears) in his hands, have brought (us benefits), when, likethe sun, he has expanded heaven and earth.

mantras.sanskrit: यदि प्रवृद्ध सत्पते सहस्रं महिषाँ अघः । आदित्त इन्द्रियं महि प्र वावृधे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadi pravṛddha satpate sahasraṃ mahiṣā~ aghaḥ | āditta indriyaṃ mahi pra vāvṛdhe ||

translations.english: Great Indra, protector of the good, when you have slain thousands of mighty (foes), then your vast andspecial energy has been augmented.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रः सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिर्न्यर्शसानमोषति । अग्निर्वनेव सासहिः प्र वावृधे ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraḥ sūryasya raśmibhirnyarśasānamoṣati | agnirvaneva sāsahiḥ pra vāvṛdhe ||

translations.english: Indra, with the rays of the sun, utterly consumes his adversary; like fire (burning) the forests, hespreads victorious.

mantras.sanskrit: इयं त ऋत्वियावती धीतिरेति नवीयसी । सपर्यन्ती पुरुप्रिया मिमीत इत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: iyaṃ ta ṛtviyāvatī dhītireti navīyasī | saparyantī purupriyā mimīta it ||

translations.english: This new praise, suited to the season, approaches, (Indra), to you; offering adoration and greatlydelighting (you), it verily proclaims the measure (of your merits).

mantras.sanskrit: गर्भो यज्ञस्य देवयुः क्रतुं पुनीत आनुषक् । स्तोमैरिन्द्रस्य वावृधे मिमीत इत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: garbho yajñasya devayuḥ kratuṃ punīta ānuṣak | stomairindrasya vāvṛdhe mimīta it ||

translations.english: The devout praiser of the adorable (Indra) purifies in due succession the offering (of the Soma); withsacred hymns he magnifies (the might) of Indra; he verily proclaims the measure (of hismerits).

mantras.sanskrit: सनिर्मित्रस्य पप्रथ इन्द्रः सोमस्य पीतये । प्राची वाशीव सुन्वते मिमीत इत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sanirmitrasya papratha indraḥ somasya pītaye | prācī vāśīva sunvate mimīta it ||

translations.english: Indra, the benefactor of his friend (the worshipper), has enlarged himself to drik the Soma, in likemanner as the pious praise dilates and proclaims the measure (of his merits).

mantras.sanskrit: यं विप्रा उक्थवाहसोऽभिप्रमन्दुरायवः । घृतं न पिप्य आसन्यृतस्य यत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ viprā ukthavāhaso'bhipramandurāyavaḥ | ghṛtaṃ na pipya āsanyṛtasya yat ||

translations.english: I pour the oblation of the sacrifice, like clarified butter, into the mouth (of that Indra), whom wise men,addressing with prayers, delight.

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्वराजे अदितिः स्तोममिन्द्राय जीजनत् । पुरुप्रशस्तमूतय ऋतस्य यत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta svarāje aditiḥ stomamindrāya jījanat | purupraśastamūtaya ṛtasya yat ||

translations.english: The excellent praise which Aditi brought forth for the imperial Indra, for our protection, is that which was(the product) of the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि वह्नय ऊतयेऽनूषत प्रशस्तये । न देव विव्रता हरी ऋतस्य यत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi vahnaya ūtaye'nūṣata praśastaye | na deva vivratā harī ṛtasya yat ||

translations.english: The bearers of the oblation glorify (Indra) for his excellent protection; now, divinity, let yourmany-actioned horses (bear you to the offering) of the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्सोममिन्द्र विष्णवि यद्वा घ त्रित आप्त्ये । यद्वा मरुत्सु मन्दसे समिन्दुभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatsomamindra viṣṇavi yadvā gha trita āptye | yadvā marutsu mandase samindubhiḥ ||

translations.english: Inasmuch as you are exhilarated by the Soma shared with Viṣṇu, or when (offered) by Trita, the son ofthe waters, or along with the Maruts, so now (be gratified) by (our) libation.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्वा शक्र परावति समुद्रे अधि मन्दसे । अस्माकमित्सुते रणा समिन्दुभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadvā śakra parāvati samudre adhi mandase | asmākamitsute raṇā samindubhiḥ ||

translations.english: Inasmuch, Śakra, as you are exhilarated (by the Soma) on the far- distant ocean, so be you gratifiednow, when the Soma is effused by our libations.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्वासि सुन्वतो वृधो यजमानस्य सत्पते । उक्थे वा यस्य रण्यसि समिन्दुभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadvāsi sunvato vṛdho yajamānasya satpate | ukthe vā yasya raṇyasi samindubhiḥ ||

translations.english: Inasmuch, protector of the virtuous, as you are the benefactor of the worshipper offering you libations,or by whose prayers you are propitiated, so now (be gratified) by our libations.

mantras.sanskrit: देवंदेवं वोऽवस इन्द्रमिन्द्रं गृणीषणि । अधा यज्ञाय तुर्वणे व्यानशुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: devaṃdevaṃ vo'vasa indramindraṃ gṛṇīṣaṇi | adhā yajñāya turvaṇe vyānaśuḥ ||

translations.english: I glorify the divine Indra wherever worshipped for your protection; (my praises) have reached him for theprompt (fulfilment) of the (objects of the) sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: यज्ञेभिर्यज्ञवाहसं सोमेभिः सोमपातमम् । होत्राभिरिन्द्रं वावृधुर्व्यानशुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajñebhiryajñavāhasaṃ somebhiḥ somapātamam | hotrābhirindraṃ vāvṛdhurvyānaśuḥ ||

translations.english: (His worshippers) have magnified with many sacrifices him to whom the sacrifice is offered, and withmany libations the eager quaffer of the Soma; (they have magnified) Indra with hymns, (their praises) haveattained him.

mantras.sanskrit: महीरस्य प्रणीतयः पूर्वीरुत प्रशस्तयः । विश्वा वसूनि दाशुषे व्यानशुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahīrasya praṇītayaḥ pūrvīruta praśastayaḥ | viśvā vasūni dāśuṣe vyānaśuḥ ||

translations.english: Infinite are his bounties, many are his glories; ample treasures have reached the donor (of oblations).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रं वृत्राय हन्तवे देवासो दधिरे पुरः । इन्द्रं वाणीरनूषता समोजसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraṃ vṛtrāya hantave devāso dadhire puraḥ | indraṃ vāṇīranūṣatā samojase ||

translations.english: The gods have plural ced Indra (foremost) for the destruction of Vṛtra; their praise has been addressed tohim to enhance his vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: महान्तं महिना वयं स्तोमेभिर्हवनश्रुतम् । अर्कैरभि प्र णोनुमः समोजसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahāntaṃ mahinā vayaṃ stomebhirhavanaśrutam | arkairabhi pra ṇonumaḥ samojase ||

translations.english: We repeatedly glorify with praises and adorations him who is great with greatness, who hears ourinvocations, (to enhance) his vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: न यं विविक्तो रोदसी नान्तरिक्षाणि वज्रिणम् । अमादिदस्य तित्विषे समोजसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: na yaṃ vivikto rodasī nāntarikṣāṇi vajriṇam | amādidasya titviṣe samojasaḥ ||

translations.english: The thunderer, from whom neither the heaven and earth nor the firmament are separated; from thestrength of whom, the mighty one, (the world) derives lustre.

mantras.sanskrit: यदिन्द्र पृतनाज्ये देवास्त्वा दधिरे पुरः । आदित्ते हर्यता हरी ववक्षतुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadindra pṛtanājye devāstvā dadhire puraḥ | āditte haryatā harī vavakṣatuḥ ||

translations.english: When, Indra, the gods plural ced you foremost in the battle, then your beloved horses bore you.

mantras.sanskrit: यदा वृत्रं नदीवृतं शवसा वज्रिन्नवधीः । आदित्ते हर्यता हरी ववक्षतुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadā vṛtraṃ nadīvṛtaṃ śavasā vajrinnavadhīḥ | āditte haryatā harī vavakṣatuḥ ||

translations.english: When, thunderer, by your strength you did slay Vṛtra, the obstructer of the waters, then your belovedhorses bore you.

mantras.sanskrit: यदा ते विष्णुरोजसा त्रीणि पदा विचक्रमे । आदित्ते हर्यता हरी ववक्षतुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadā te viṣṇurojasā trīṇi padā vicakrame | āditte haryatā harī vavakṣatuḥ ||

translations.english: When your (younger brother) Viṣṇu by (his) strength stepped his three paces, then verily your belovedhorses bore you.

mantras.sanskrit: यदा ते हर्यता हरी वावृधाते दिवेदिवे । आदित्ते विश्वा भुवनानि येमिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadā te haryatā harī vāvṛdhāte divedive | āditte viśvā bhuvanāni yemire ||

translations.english: When your beloved horses had augmented day by day, then all existent beings were subject unto you.

mantras.sanskrit: यदा ते मारुतीर्विशस्तुभ्यमिन्द्र नियेमिरे । आदित्ते विश्वा भुवनानि येमिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadā te mārutīrviśastubhyamindra niyemire | āditte viśvā bhuvanāni yemire ||

translations.english: When, Indra, your people, the Maruts, were regulated by you, then all existent beings were subject untoyou.

mantras.sanskrit: यदा सूर्यममुं दिवि शुक्रं ज्योतिरधारयः । आदित्ते विश्वा भुवनानि येमिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadā sūryamamuṃ divi śukraṃ jyotiradhārayaḥ | āditte viśvā bhuvanāni yemire ||

translations.english: Whenyou had plural ced yonder pure light, the sun, in the sky, then all existing beings were subject untoyou.

mantras.sanskrit: इमां त इन्द्र सुष्टुतिं विप्र इयर्ति धीतिभिः । जामिं पदेव पिप्रतीं प्राध्वरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: imāṃ ta indra suṣṭutiṃ vipra iyarti dhītibhiḥ | jāmiṃ padeva pipratīṃ prādhvare ||

translations.english: The wise (worshipper), Indra, offers you this gratifying sincere praise along with pious rites at thesacrifice, as (a man plural ces) a kinsman in (a prominent) position.

mantras.sanskrit: यदस्य धामनि प्रिये समीचीनासो अस्वरन् । नाभा यज्ञस्य दोहना प्राध्वरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadasya dhāmani priye samīcīnāso asvaran | nābhā yajñasya dohanā prādhvare ||

translations.english: When the congregated (worshippers) praise him aloud in a plural ce that plural ases (him) on the navel (of theearth), in the spot where the libation is effused at the sacrifice, (then).

mantras.sanskrit: सुवीर्यं स्वश्व्यं सुगव्यमिन्द्र दद्धि नः । होतेव पूर्वचित्तये प्राध्वरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: suvīryaṃ svaśvyaṃ sugavyamindra daddhi naḥ | hoteva pūrvacittaye prādhvare ||

translations.english: Bestow upon us, Indra, (wealth), comprising worthy male ofspring, excellent horses, and good cattle;like the ministrant priest (I worship you) at the sacrifice, (to secure) your prior consideration.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रः सुतेषु सोमेषु क्रतुं पुनीत उक्थ्यम् । विदे वृधस्य दक्षसो महान्हि षः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraḥ suteṣu someṣu kratuṃ punīta ukthyam | vide vṛdhasya dakṣaso mahānhi ṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, when the Soma juices are effused, sanctifies the offerer and the praiser for the attainment ofincrease giving strength, for he is mighty.

mantras.sanskrit: स प्रथमे व्योमनि देवानां सदने वृधः । सुपारः सुश्रवस्तमः समप्सुजित् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa prathame vyomani devānāṃ sadane vṛdhaḥ | supāraḥ suśravastamaḥ samapsujit ||

translations.english: Abiding in the highest heaven, in the dwelling of the gods, he is the giver of increase, the accomplisher(of works), the possessor of great renown, the conqueror of (the obstructer of) the rains.

mantras.sanskrit: तमह्वे वाजसातय इन्द्रं भराय शुष्मिणम् । भवा नः सुम्ने अन्तमः सखा वृधे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamahve vājasātaya indraṃ bharāya śuṣmiṇam | bhavā naḥ sumne antamaḥ sakhā vṛdhe ||

translations.english: I invoke the powerful Indra for (aid in) the food-bestowing combat; be near unto us for our happiness;be a friend for our increase.

mantras.sanskrit: इयं त इन्द्र गिर्वणो रातिः क्षरति सुन्वतः । मन्दानो अस्य बर्हिषो वि राजसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: iyaṃ ta indra girvaṇo rātiḥ kṣarati sunvataḥ | mandāno asya barhiṣo vi rājasi ||

translations.english: This gift of the offerer of the libation flows to you, Indra, who are gratified by praise, exhilarated bywhich you reign over the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: नूनं तदिन्द्र दद्धि नो यत्त्वा सुन्वन्त ईमहे । रयिं नश्चित्रमा भरा स्वर्विदम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nūnaṃ tadindra daddhi no yattvā sunvanta īmahe | rayiṃ naścitramā bharā svarvidam ||

translations.english: Bestow upon us, Indra, that which, when pouring out the libation, we solicit of you; grant us thewondrous wealth that is the means of obtaining heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तोता यत्ते विचर्षणिरतिप्रशर्धयद्गिरः । वया इवानु रोहते जुषन्त यत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: stotā yatte vicarṣaṇiratipraśardhayadgiraḥ | vayā ivānu rohate juṣanta yat ||

translations.english: When your discriminating eulogist has addressed to you overpowering praises, then, if they areacceptable to you, they expand like the branches (of a tree).

mantras.sanskrit: प्रत्नवज्जनया गिरः शृणुधी जरितुर्हवम् । मदेमदे ववक्षिथा सुकृत्वने ॥
mantras.transliteration: pratnavajjanayā giraḥ śṛṇudhī jariturhavam | mademade vavakṣithā sukṛtvane ||

translations.english: genitive rate your eulogies as of old; hear the invocation of the adorer; you bear in your reiteratedexultation (blessings) to the liberal donor (of the oblation).

mantras.sanskrit: क्रीळन्त्यस्य सूनृता आपो न प्रवता यतीः । अया धिया य उच्यते पतिर्दिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: krīḷantyasya sūnṛtā āpo na pravatā yatīḥ | ayā dhiyā ya ucyate patirdivaḥ ||

translations.english: The kind and true words of him who in this hymn is called the lord of heaven sport like waters flowingby a downward (channel).

mantras.sanskrit: उतो पतिर्य उच्यते कृष्टीनामेक इद्वशी । नमोवृधैरवस्युभिः सुते रण ॥
mantras.transliteration: uto patirya ucyate kṛṣṭīnāmeka idvaśī | namovṛdhairavasyubhiḥ sute raṇa ||

translations.english: Or he, who is called the one absolute lord of men-- praise him, when the libation is effused, withmagnifying songs, imploring his protection.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तुहि श्रुतं विपश्चितं हरी यस्य प्रसक्षिणा । गन्तारा दाशुषो गृहं नमस्विनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: stuhi śrutaṃ vipaścitaṃ harī yasya prasakṣiṇā | gantārā dāśuṣo gṛhaṃ namasvinaḥ ||

translations.english: Praise the renowned, the sapient (Indra), whose victorious horses proceed to the dwelling of the devoutdonor (of the libation).

mantras.sanskrit: तूतुजानो महेमतेऽश्वेभिः प्रुषितप्सुभिः । आ याहि यज्ञमाशुभिः शमिद्धि ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: tūtujāno mahemate'śvebhiḥ pruṣitapsubhiḥ | ā yāhi yajñamāśubhiḥ śamiddhi te ||

translations.english: Munificently minded, do you, who are quick of movement, come with shining and swift steeds to thesacrifice, for verily there is gratification to you thereby.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र शविष्ठ सत्पते रयिं गृणत्सु धारय । श्रवः सूरिभ्यो अमृतं वसुत्वनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra śaviṣṭha satpate rayiṃ gṛṇatsu dhāraya | śravaḥ sūribhyo amṛtaṃ vasutvanam ||

translations.english: Most powerful Indra, protector of the virtuous, secure us who praise you in the possession of riches,(grant) to the pious imperishable all-pervading sustenance.

mantras.sanskrit: हवे त्वा सूर उदिते हवे मध्यंदिने दिवः । जुषाण इन्द्र सप्तिभिर्न आ गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: have tvā sūra udite have madhyaṃdine divaḥ | juṣāṇa indra saptibhirna ā gahi ||

translations.english: I invoke you when the sun is risen; I invoke (you) at mid-day; being propitited, come to us, Indra, withyour gliding steeds.

mantras.sanskrit: आ तू गहि प्र तु द्रव मत्स्वा सुतस्य गोमतः । तन्तुं तनुष्व पूर्व्यं यथा विदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tū gahi pra tu drava matsvā sutasya gomataḥ | tantuṃ tanuṣva pūrvyaṃ yathā vide ||

translations.english: Come quickly; hasten, be exhilarated by the libation mixed with milk; extend the ancient sacrifice, sothat I may obtain (its reward).

mantras.sanskrit: यच्छक्रासि परावति यदर्वावति वृत्रहन् । यद्वा समुद्रे अन्धसोऽवितेदसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yacchakrāsi parāvati yadarvāvati vṛtrahan | yadvā samudre andhaso'vitedasi ||

translations.english: Whether, Śakra, you be far off, or, slayer of Vṛtra, near at hand, or whether you be in the firmament,you are the guardian of the (sacrificial) food.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रं वर्धन्तु नो गिर इन्द्रं सुतास इन्दवः । इन्द्रे हविष्मतीर्विशो अराणिषुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraṃ vardhantu no gira indraṃ sutāsa indavaḥ | indre haviṣmatīrviśo arāṇiṣuḥ ||

translations.english: May our praises magnify Indra! May our effused libations gratify Indra! May the people bearingoblations excite plural asure in Indra!

mantras.sanskrit: तमिद्विप्रा अवस्यवः प्रवत्वतीभिरूतिभिः । इन्द्रं क्षोणीरवर्धयन्वया इव ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamidviprā avasyavaḥ pravatvatībhirūtibhiḥ | indraṃ kṣoṇīravardhayanvayā iva ||

translations.english: The pious, desiring his protection, magnify him by ample and plural asure- yielding (libations); the earth,(and other worlds, spread out) like the branches of a tree, magnify Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिकद्रुकेषु चेतनं देवासो यज्ञमत्नत । तमिद्वर्धन्तु नो गिरः सदावृधम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: trikadrukeṣu cetanaṃ devāso yajñamatnata | tamidvardhantu no giraḥ sadāvṛdham ||

translations.english: The gods propitiate the superintending adorable (Indra) at the Trikadruka rites. May our praisesmagnify him who is ever the magnifier (of his worshippers).

mantras.sanskrit: स्तोता यत्ते अनुव्रत उक्थान्यृतुथा दधे । शुचिः पावक उच्यते सो अद्भुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: stotā yatte anuvrata ukthānyṛtuthā dadhe | śuciḥ pāvaka ucyate so adbhutaḥ ||

translations.english: Your worshipper is observant of his duty, inasmuch as he offers prayers indue season; for you are hewho is called pure, purifying, wonderful.

mantras.sanskrit: तदिद्रुद्रस्य चेतति यह्वं प्रत्नेषु धामसु । मनो यत्रा वि तद्दधुर्विचेतसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadidrudrasya cetati yahvaṃ pratneṣu dhāmasu | mano yatrā vi taddadhurvicetasaḥ ||

translations.english: The progeny of Rudra (the Maruts) is known in ancient plural ces, and to them the intelligent worshippersoffer adoration.

mantras.sanskrit: यदि मे सख्यमावर इमस्य पाह्यन्धसः । येन विश्वा अति द्विषो अतारिम ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadi me sakhyamāvara imasya pāhyandhasaḥ | yena viśvā ati dviṣo atārima ||

translations.english: If, (Indra), you choose my friendship, partake of this (sacrificial) food, by which we may pass beyond(the reach of) all adversaries.

mantras.sanskrit: कदा त इन्द्र गिर्वणः स्तोता भवाति शंतमः । कदा नो गव्ये अश्व्ये वसौ दधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kadā ta indra girvaṇaḥ stotā bhavāti śaṃtamaḥ | kadā no gavye aśvye vasau dadhaḥ ||

translations.english: When, Indra, who delight in praise, may your worshipper be entirely happy? When will you establish usin (the affluence of) cattle, of horses, of dwellings?

mantras.sanskrit: उत ते सुष्टुता हरी वृषणा वहतो रथम् । अजुर्यस्य मदिन्तमं यमीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta te suṣṭutā harī vṛṣaṇā vahato ratham | ajuryasya madintamaṃ yamīmahe ||

translations.english: Or, when will your renowned and vigorous horses bring the chariot of you, who are exempt from decay,that exhilarating (wealth) which we solicit?

mantras.sanskrit: तमीमहे पुरुष्टुतं यह्वं प्रत्नाभिरूतिभिः । नि बर्हिषि प्रिये सददध द्विता ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamīmahe puruṣṭutaṃ yahvaṃ pratnābhirūtibhiḥ | ni barhiṣi priye sadadadha dvitā ||

translations.english: We solicit with ancient and gratifying (offerings) him who is mighty and the invoked of many; may he sitdown on the plural asant sacred grass, and accept the two-fold (offering of cakes and Soma).

mantras.sanskrit: वर्धस्वा सु पुरुष्टुत ऋषिष्टुताभिरूतिभिः । धुक्षस्व पिप्युषीमिषमवा च नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vardhasvā su puruṣṭuta ṛṣiṣṭutābhirūtibhiḥ | dhukṣasva pipyuṣīmiṣamavā ca naḥ ||

translations.english: Praised of many, prosper (us) with the protections hymned by the ṛṣis, send down upon us nutritiousfood.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र त्वमवितेदसीत्था स्तुवतो अद्रिवः । ऋतादियर्मि ते धियं मनोयुजम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra tvamavitedasītthā stuvato adrivaḥ | ṛtādiyarmi te dhiyaṃ manoyujam ||

translations.english: Thunderbolt-bearing Indra, you are the protector of him who thus eulogises you; I seek through sacrificefor your favour, which is to be gained by praise.

mantras.sanskrit: इह त्या सधमाद्या युजानः सोमपीतये । हरी इन्द्र प्रतद्वसू अभि स्वर ॥
mantras.transliteration: iha tyā sadhamādyā yujānaḥ somapītaye | harī indra pratadvasū abhi svara ||

translations.english: Harnessing your horses, Indra, laden with treasure and sharing your exhilaratio, come here to drink ofthe Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि स्वरन्तु ये तव रुद्रासः सक्षत श्रियम् । उतो मरुत्वतीर्विशो अभि प्रयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi svarantu ye tava rudrāsaḥ sakṣata śriyam | uto marutvatīrviśo abhi prayaḥ ||

translations.english: May the sons of Rudra, who are your followers, approach and partake of the glory (of the sacrifice); andmay (other celestial) people associated with the Maruts (partake of the sacrificial) food.

mantras.sanskrit: इमा अस्य प्रतूर्तयः पदं जुषन्त यद्दिवि । नाभा यज्ञस्य सं दधुर्यथा विदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: imā asya pratūrtayaḥ padaṃ juṣanta yaddivi | nābhā yajñasya saṃ dadhuryathā vide ||

translations.english: May those who (are his attndants), victorious (over enemies), be satisfied with the station (which theyoccupy) in heaven, and may they be assembled at the navel of the sacrifice, that I may therefrom acquire(wealth).

mantras.sanskrit: अयं दीर्घाय चक्षसे प्राचि प्रयत्यध्वरे । मिमीते यज्ञमानुषग्विचक्ष्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ dīrghāya cakṣase prāci prayatyadhvare | mimīte yajñamānuṣagvicakṣya ||

translations.english: When the ceremony is being prepared in the hall of sacrifice, this (Indra), having inspected the rite,regulates (the performance) in due succession for a distant object.

mantras.sanskrit: वृषायमिन्द्र ते रथ उतो ते वृषणा हरी । वृषा त्वं शतक्रतो वृषा हवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣāyamindra te ratha uto te vṛṣaṇā harī | vṛṣā tvaṃ śatakrato vṛṣā havaḥ ||

translations.english: Your chariot, Indra, is a showerer (of benefits), showerers (of benefits) are your horses; you alsoŚatakratu, are the showerer (of benefits) the invocation (addressed to you) is the showerer (of benefits).

mantras.sanskrit: वृषा ग्रावा वृषा मदो वृषा सोमो अयं सुतः । वृषा यज्ञो यमिन्वसि वृषा हवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣā grāvā vṛṣā mado vṛṣā somo ayaṃ sutaḥ | vṛṣā yajño yaminvasi vṛṣā havaḥ ||

translations.english: The stone (that bruises the Soma) is the showerer (of benefits), so is your exhilaration and this Somathat is effused; the sacrifice that you accept is the showerer (of benefits),such also is your invocation.

mantras.sanskrit: वृषा त्वा वृषणं हुवे वज्रिञ्चित्राभिरूतिभिः । वावन्थ हि प्रतिष्टुतिं वृषा हवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣā tvā vṛṣaṇaṃ huve vajriñcitrābhirūtibhiḥ | vāvantha hi pratiṣṭutiṃ vṛṣā havaḥ ||

translations.english: The showerer (of the oblation) I invoke with manifold and gratifying (praises) you, O thunderer, theshowerer (of benefits); inasmuch as you acknowledge the eulogy addressed to you, your invocation is theshowerer (of benefits).

mantras.sanskrit: यदिन्द्राहं यथा त्वमीशीय वस्व एक इत् । स्तोता मे गोषखा स्यात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadindrāhaṃ yathā tvamīśīya vasva eka it | stotā me goṣakhā syāt ||

translations.english: If, Indra, I were, as you are, sole, lord over wealth, then should my eulogist be possessed of cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: शिक्षेयमस्मै दित्सेयं शचीपते मनीषिणे । यदहं गोपतिः स्याम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śikṣeyamasmai ditseyaṃ śacīpate manīṣiṇe | yadahaṃ gopatiḥ syām ||

translations.english: Lord of might, I would give to that intelligent worshipper that which I should wish to give, if I were thepossessor of cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: धेनुष्ट इन्द्र सूनृता यजमानाय सुन्वते । गामश्वं पिप्युषी दुहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhenuṣṭa indra sūnṛtā yajamānāya sunvate | gāmaśvaṃ pipyuṣī duhe ||

translations.english: Your praise, Indra, is a cow to the worshipper offering the libations, it milks him in abundance cattle andhorses.

mantras.sanskrit: न ते वर्तास्ति राधस इन्द्र देवो न मर्त्यः । यद्दित्ससि स्तुतो मघम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: na te vartāsti rādhasa indra devo na martyaḥ | yadditsasi stuto magham ||

translations.english: Neither god nor man, Indra, is the obstructor of your affluence, (of) the wealth which you, when praised,design to bestow.

mantras.sanskrit: यज्ञ इन्द्रमवर्धयद्यद्भूमिं व्यवर्तयत् । चक्राण ओपशं दिवि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajña indramavardhayadyadbhūmiṃ vyavartayat | cakrāṇa opaśaṃ divi ||

translations.english: Sacrifice has magnified Indra, so that he has supported the earth (with rain), making (the cloud)quiescent in the firmament.

mantras.sanskrit: वावृधानस्य ते वयं विश्वा धनानि जिग्युषः । ऊतिमिन्द्रा वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāvṛdhānasya te vayaṃ viśvā dhanāni jigyuṣaḥ | ūtimindrā vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: We solicit, Indra, the protection of you, who are ever being magnified, the conqueror of all the riches (ofthe enemy).

mantras.sanskrit: व्यन्तरिक्षमतिरन्मदे सोमस्य रोचना । इन्द्रो यदभिनद्वलम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vyantarikṣamatiranmade somasya rocanā | indro yadabhinadvalam ||

translations.english: In the exhilaration of the Soma, Indra has traversed the radiant firmament that he might pierce (theasura) Vala.

mantras.sanskrit: उद्गा आजदङ्गिरोभ्य आविष्कृण्वन्गुहा सतीः । अर्वाञ्चं नुनुदे वलम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: udgā ājadaṅgirobhya āviṣkṛṇvanguhā satīḥ | arvāñcaṃ nunude valam ||

translations.english: He liberated the cows for the aṅgirasas, making manifest those that have been hidden in the cave,hurling Vala headlong down.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रेण रोचना दिवो दृळ्हानि दृंहितानि च । स्थिराणि न पराणुदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: indreṇa rocanā divo dṛḷhāni dṛṃhitāni ca | sthirāṇi na parāṇude ||

translations.english: By Indra the constellations were made stable and firm and stationary, so that they could not be movedby any.

mantras.sanskrit: अपामूर्मिर्मदन्निव स्तोम इन्द्राजिरायते । वि ते मदा अराजिषुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: apāmūrmirmadanniva stoma indrājirāyate | vi te madā arājiṣuḥ ||

translations.english: Your praise, Indra, mounts aloft like the exulting wave of the waters, your exhilarations have beenmanifested.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं हि स्तोमवर्धन इन्द्रास्युक्थवर्धनः । स्तोतॄणामुत भद्रकृत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ hi stomavardhana indrāsyukthavardhanaḥ | stotṝṇāmuta bhadrakṛt ||

translations.english: You, Indra, are to be magnified by praise, you are to be magnified by prayer; you are the benefactor ofthose who praise you.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रमित्केशिना हरी सोमपेयाय वक्षतः । उप यज्ञं सुराधसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indramitkeśinā harī somapeyāya vakṣataḥ | upa yajñaṃ surādhasam ||

translations.english: Let the long-maned horses bring the wealth-bestowing Indra to the sacrifice to drink the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: अपां फेनेन नमुचेः शिर इन्द्रोदवर्तयः । विश्वा यदजयः स्पृधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: apāṃ phenena namuceḥ śira indrodavartayaḥ | viśvā yadajayaḥ spṛdhaḥ ||

translations.english: You have struck off, Indra, the head of Namuci with the foam of the waters, when you had subdued allyour enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: मायाभिरुत्सिसृप्सत इन्द्र द्यामारुरुक्षतः । अव दस्यूँरधूनुथाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: māyābhirutsisṛpsata indra dyāmārurukṣataḥ | ava dasyū~radhūnuthāḥ ||

translations.english: You have hurled down, Indra, the Dasyus, gliding upwards by their devices and ascending to heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: असुन्वामिन्द्र संसदं विषूचीं व्यनाशयः । सोमपा उत्तरो भवन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asunvāmindra saṃsadaṃ viṣūcīṃ vyanāśayaḥ | somapā uttaro bhavan ||

translations.english: You, Indra, the most excellent drinker of the Soma, destroy the adverse assembly that offers nolibations.

mantras.sanskrit: तम्वभि प्र गायत पुरुहूतं पुरुष्टुतम् । इन्द्रं गीर्भिस्तविषमा विवासत ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamvabhi pra gāyata puruhūtaṃ puruṣṭutam | indraṃ gīrbhistaviṣamā vivāsata ||

translations.english: Glorify him the invoked of many, the praised of many; adore the powerful Indra with hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य द्विबर्हसो बृहत्सहो दाधार रोदसी । गिरीँरज्राँ अपः स्वर्वृषत्वना ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya dvibarhaso bṛhatsaho dādhāra rodasī | girī~rajrā~ apaḥ svarvṛṣatvanā ||

translations.english: The vast strength of whom, powerful in both (regions), has sustained the heaven and earth, and by itsvigour (upheld) the swift clouds and flowing waters.

mantras.sanskrit: स राजसि पुरुष्टुतँ एको वृत्राणि जिघ्नसे । इन्द्र जैत्रा श्रवस्या च यन्तवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa rājasi puruṣṭuta~ eko vṛtrāṇi jighnase | indra jaitrā śravasyā ca yantave ||

translations.english: You, the praised of many, reign; you, single, have slain many enemies, in order to acquire the spoils ofvictory and abundant food.

mantras.sanskrit: तं ते मदं गृणीमसि वृषणं पृत्सु सासहिम् । उ लोककृत्नुमद्रिवो हरिश्रियम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ te madaṃ gṛṇīmasi vṛṣaṇaṃ pṛtsu sāsahim | u lokakṛtnumadrivo hariśriyam ||

translations.english: We celebrate, thunderer, your exhilaration, the showerer (of benefits), the overcomer (of foes) in battle,the maker of the world, the glorious with your steeds.

mantras.sanskrit: येन ज्योतींष्यायवे मनवे च विवेदिथ । मन्दानो अस्य बर्हिषो वि राजसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yena jyotīṃṣyāyave manave ca viveditha | mandāno asya barhiṣo vi rājasi ||

translations.english: Whereby you have made the plural nets manifest to Ayu and to Manu, and rule rejoicing over this sacredrite.

mantras.sanskrit: तदद्या चित्त उक्थिनोऽनु ष्टुवन्ति पूर्वथा । वृषपत्नीरपो जया दिवेदिवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadadyā citta ukthino'nu ṣṭuvanti pūrvathā | vṛṣapatnīrapo jayā divedive ||

translations.english: The reciters of prayer celebrate that your (exhilaration) now as of old; do you daily hold in subjectionthe waters, the wives of the showerer.

mantras.sanskrit: तव त्यदिन्द्रियं बृहत्तव शुष्ममुत क्रतुम् । वज्रं शिशाति धिषणा वरेण्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava tyadindriyaṃ bṛhattava śuṣmamuta kratum | vajraṃ śiśāti dhiṣaṇā vareṇyam ||

translations.english: Praise sharpens your great energy, your strength, your acts, and your majestic thunderbolt.

mantras.sanskrit: तव द्यौरिन्द्र पौंस्यं पृथिवी वर्धति श्रवः । त्वामापः पर्वतासश्च हिन्विरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava dyaurindra pauṃsyaṃ pṛthivī vardhati śravaḥ | tvāmāpaḥ parvatāsaśca hinvire ||

translations.english: The heaven invigorates your manhood, Indra, the earth (spreads) your renown; the waters, themountains propitiate you.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वां विष्णुर्बृहन्क्षयो मित्रो गृणाति वरुणः । त्वां शर्धो मदत्यनु मारुतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāṃ viṣṇurbṛhankṣayo mitro gṛṇāti varuṇaḥ | tvāṃ śardho madatyanu mārutam ||

translations.english: Viṣṇu, the mighty giver of dwellings, praises you, and Mitra and Varuṇa; the company of the Marutsimitates you in exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं वृषा जनानां मंहिष्ठ इन्द्र जज्ञिषे । सत्रा विश्वा स्वपत्यानि दधिषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ vṛṣā janānāṃ maṃhiṣṭha indra jajñiṣe | satrā viśvā svapatyāni dadhiṣe ||

translations.english: You, Indra, who are the showerer, have been born the most bountiful of beings; you associate with youall good offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: सत्रा त्वं पुरुष्टुतँ एको वृत्राणि तोशसे । नान्य इन्द्रात्करणं भूय इन्वति ॥
mantras.transliteration: satrā tvaṃ puruṣṭuta~ eko vṛtrāṇi tośase | nānya indrātkaraṇaṃ bhūya invati ||

translations.english: (Indra), the praised of many, you alone destroy many mighty foes; no other Indra achieves such greatexploits.

mantras.sanskrit: यदिन्द्र मन्मशस्त्वा नाना हवन्त ऊतये । अस्माकेभिर्नृभिरत्रा स्वर्जय ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadindra manmaśastvā nānā havanta ūtaye | asmākebhirnṛbhiratrā svarjaya ||

translations.english: When (in the combat), Indra, they invoke you in many ways with praise for protection, then do you (soinvoked) by our leaders overcome all (our enemies).

mantras.sanskrit: अरं क्षयाय नो महे विश्वा रूपाण्याविशन् । इन्द्रं जैत्राय हर्षया शचीपतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: araṃ kṣayāya no mahe viśvā rūpāṇyāviśan | indraṃ jaitrāya harṣayā śacīpatim ||

translations.english: All the forms (of Indra) have sufficiently entered into our own spacious abode; gratify Indra the lord ofŚacī, (that he may give us) the spoil of victory.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सम्राजं चर्षणीनामिन्द्रं स्तोता नव्यं गीर्भिः । नरं नृषाहं मंहिष्ठम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra samrājaṃ carṣaṇīnāmindraṃ stotā navyaṃ gīrbhiḥ | naraṃ nṛṣāhaṃ maṃhiṣṭham ||

translations.english: Glorify with hymns the adorable Indra, the supreme king of men, the leader (of rites), the overcomer ofenemies, the most munificent.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्मिन्नुक्थानि रण्यन्ति विश्वानि च श्रवस्या । अपामवो न समुद्रे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasminnukthāni raṇyanti viśvāni ca śravasyā | apāmavo na samudre ||

translations.english: In whom all praises, all kinds of sustenance concentrate, like the aggregation of the waters in theocean.

mantras.sanskrit: तं सुष्टुत्या विवासे ज्येष्ठराजं भरे कृत्नुम् । महो वाजिनं सनिभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ suṣṭutyā vivāse jyeṣṭharājaṃ bhare kṛtnum | maho vājinaṃ sanibhyaḥ ||

translations.english: I worship Indra with pious praises, glorious among the best (of beings), the achiever of great deeds inwar mighty for the acquisition (of wealth).

mantras.sanskrit: यस्यानूना गभीरा मदा उरवस्तरुत्राः । हर्षुमन्तः शूरसातौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasyānūnā gabhīrā madā uravastarutrāḥ | harṣumantaḥ śūrasātau ||

translations.english: Whose unbounded and profound exhilarations are many, protective, and animating in waṛ

mantras.sanskrit: तमिद्धनेषु हितेष्वधिवाकाय हवन्ते । येषामिन्द्रस्ते जयन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamiddhaneṣu hiteṣvadhivākāya havante | yeṣāmindraste jayanti ||

translations.english: (His worshippers) invoke him to take part (in spoiling) the trasures deposited (with the foe); theyconquer, of whom Indra is (the partisan).

mantras.sanskrit: तमिच्च्यौत्नैरार्यन्ति तं कृतेभिश्चर्षणयः । एष इन्द्रो वरिवस्कृत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamiccyautnairāryanti taṃ kṛtebhiścarṣaṇayaḥ | eṣa indro varivaskṛt ||

translations.english: They honour him with animating (hymns), men (honour) him with sacred rites, for Indra is the giver ofwealth.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रो ब्रह्मेन्द्र ऋषिरिन्द्रः पुरू पुरुहूतः । महान्महीभिः शचीभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indro brahmendra ṛṣirindraḥ purū puruhūtaḥ | mahānmahībhiḥ śacībhiḥ ||

translations.english: Indra is Brahmā, Indra is the ṛṣi; Indra is the much-invoked of many, mighty with mighty deeds.

mantras.sanskrit: स स्तोम्यः स हव्यः सत्यः सत्वा तुविकूर्मिः । एकश्चित्सन्नभिभूतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa stomyaḥ sa havyaḥ satyaḥ satvā tuvikūrmiḥ | ekaścitsannabhibhūtiḥ ||

translations.english: He is to be praised, he is to be invoked, he is true, powerful the doer of many deeds; he, being single,is the overcomer (of his foes).

mantras.sanskrit: तमर्केभिस्तं सामभिस्तं गायत्रैश्चर्षणयः । इन्द्रं वर्धन्ति क्षितयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamarkebhistaṃ sāmabhistaṃ gāyatraiścarṣaṇayaḥ | indraṃ vardhanti kṣitayaḥ ||

translations.english: Men who are cognizant (of sacred texts) magnify Indra with pious precepts, with sacred songs, and withprayers.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रणेतारं वस्यो अच्छा कर्तारं ज्योतिः समत्सु । सासह्वांसं युधामित्रान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: praṇetāraṃ vasyo acchā kartāraṃ jyotiḥ samatsu | sāsahvāṃsaṃ yudhāmitrān ||

translations.english: Him (they magnify) who brings before them the spoil, who gives lustre in combats, who overcomesenemies in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: स नः पप्रिः पारयाति स्वस्ति नावा पुरुहूतः । इन्द्रो विश्वा अति द्विषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa naḥ papriḥ pārayāti svasti nāvā puruhūtaḥ | indro viśvā ati dviṣaḥ ||

translations.english: May Indra, the fulfiller (of desires), the invoked of many, bear us beyond (the reach of) all our enemies,to welfare, as if by a ship (across the sea).

mantras.sanskrit: स त्वं न इन्द्र वाजेभिर्दशस्या च गातुया च । अच्छा च नः सुम्नं नेषि ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa tvaṃ na indra vājebhirdaśasyā ca gātuyā ca | acchā ca naḥ sumnaṃ neṣi ||

translations.english: Do you, Indra, (endow) us with vigour, bestow upon us (wealth, enable us) to go (by the right way), leadus to felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: आ याहि सुषुमा हि त इन्द्र सोमं पिबा इमम् । एदं बर्हिः सदो मम ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yāhi suṣumā hi ta indra somaṃ pibā imam | edaṃ barhiḥ sado mama ||

translations.english: Come, we express, Indra, for you, the Soma; drink it; sit down upon this my sacred grass.

mantras.sanskrit: आ त्वा ब्रह्मयुजा हरी वहतामिन्द्र केशिना । उप ब्रह्माणि नः शृणु ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tvā brahmayujā harī vahatāmindra keśinā | upa brahmāṇi naḥ śṛṇu ||

translations.english: Let your long-maned horses, Indra, that are yoked by prayers, bring you here, anddo you hear ourprayers.

mantras.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणस्त्वा वयं युजा सोमपामिन्द्र सोमिनः । सुतावन्तो हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: brahmāṇastvā vayaṃ yujā somapāmindra sominaḥ | sutāvanto havāmahe ||

translations.english: We brāhmaṇas, offerers of Soma, bearing the effused Soma, invoke with suitable (prayers), you thedrinker of the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो याहि सुतावतोऽस्माकं सुष्टुतीरुप । पिबा सु शिप्रिन्नन्धसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no yāhi sutāvato'smākaṃ suṣṭutīrupa | pibā su śiprinnandhasaḥ ||

translations.english: Come to us offering the libation, accept our earnest praises; drink, handsome-jawed, of the (sacrificial)beverage.

mantras.sanskrit: आ ते सिञ्चामि कुक्ष्योरनु गात्रा वि धावतु । गृभाय जिह्वया मधु ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā te siñcāmi kukṣyoranu gātrā vi dhāvatu | gṛbhāya jihvayā madhu ||

translations.english: I fill your belly (with the libation); let is spread throughout the limbs; take the honied Soma with yourtongue.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वादुष्टे अस्तु संसुदे मधुमान्तन्वे तव । सोमः शमस्तु ते हृदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: svāduṣṭe astu saṃsude madhumāntanve tava | somaḥ śamastu te hṛde ||

translations.english: May the sweet-flavoured Soma be grateful to you, who are munificent; (may it be grateful) to your bodymay it be exhilarating to your heart.

mantras.sanskrit: अयमु त्वा विचर्षणे जनीरिवाभि संवृतः । प्र सोम इन्द्र सर्पतु ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayamu tvā vicarṣaṇe janīrivābhi saṃvṛtaḥ | pra soma indra sarpatu ||

translations.english: May this Soma, invested (with milk), approach you, observant Indra, like a bride (clad in white apparel).

mantras.sanskrit: तुविग्रीवो वपोदरः सुबाहुरन्धसो मदे । इन्द्रो वृत्राणि जिघ्नते ॥
mantras.transliteration: tuvigrīvo vapodaraḥ subāhurandhaso made | indro vṛtrāṇi jighnate ||

translations.english: Long-necked, large-bellied, strong-armed Indra, in the exhilaration of the (sacrificial) food, destroys hisenemies.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र प्रेहि पुरस्त्वं विश्वस्येशान ओजसा । वृत्राणि वृत्रहञ्जहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra prehi purastvaṃ viśvasyeśāna ojasā | vṛtrāṇi vṛtrahañjahi ||

translations.english: Indra, who by your strength are the lord over all, come to us, slayer of Vṛtra, subdue our foes.

mantras.sanskrit: दीर्घस्ते अस्त्वङ्कुशो येना वसु प्रयच्छसि । यजमानाय सुन्वते ॥
mantras.transliteration: dīrghaste astvaṅkuśo yenā vasu prayacchasi | yajamānāya sunvate ||

translations.english: Long be your goad, wherewith you bestow wealth upon the sacrificer offering libations.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं त इन्द्र सोमो निपूतो अधि बर्हिषि । एहीमस्य द्रवा पिब ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ ta indra somo nipūto adhi barhiṣi | ehīmasya dravā piba ||

translations.english: This Soma, purified (by filtering) through the sacred grass is for you, Indra, come to it, hasten, drink.

mantras.sanskrit: शाचिगो शाचिपूजनायं रणाय ते सुतः । आखण्डल प्र हूयसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: śācigo śācipūjanāyaṃ raṇāya te sutaḥ | ākhaṇḍala pra hūyase ||

translations.english: Renowned for radiance, renowned for adoration, this libation is for your gratification; destroyer of foes,you are earnestly invoked.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्ते शृङ्गवृषो नपात्प्रणपात्कुण्डपाय्यः । न्यस्मिन्दध्र आ मनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaste śṛṅgavṛṣo napātpraṇapātkuṇḍapāyyaḥ | nyasmindadhra ā manaḥ ||

translations.english: (Indra), who was the offspring of Śṛṅgavṛṣa, of whom the kuṇḍapāyya rite was the protector, (thesages) have fixed (of old) their minds upon this ceremony.

mantras.sanskrit: वास्तोष्पते ध्रुवा स्थूणांसत्रं सोम्यानाम् । द्रप्सो भेत्ता पुरां शश्वतीनामिन्द्रो मुनीनां सखा ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāstoṣpate dhruvā sthūṇāṃsatraṃ somyānām | drapso bhettā purāṃ śaśvatīnāmindro munīnāṃ sakhā ||

translations.english: Lord of dwellings, may the (roof) pillar be strong; may there be vigour of body for the offerers of libation;may Indra, the drinker (of the Soma), the destroyer of the numerous cities (of the asuras), ever be the friend ofthe Munis.

mantras.sanskrit: पृदाकुसानुर्यजतो गवेषण एकः सन्नभि भूयसः । भूर्णिमश्वं नयत्तुजा पुरो गृभेन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: pṛdākusānuryajato gaveṣaṇa ekaḥ sannabhi bhūyasaḥ | bhūrṇimaśvaṃ nayattujā puro gṛbhendraṃ somasya pītaye ||

translations.english: With head uplifted like a serpent, adorable, the recoverer of the cattle, Indra single, is superior tomultitudes; (the worshipper) brings Indra to drink the Soma by a rapid seizure, like a loaded horse (by a halter).

mantras.sanskrit: इदं ह नूनमेषां सुम्नं भिक्षेत मर्त्यः । आदित्यानामपूर्व्यं सवीमनि ॥
mantras.transliteration: idaṃ ha nūnameṣāṃ sumnaṃ bhikṣeta martyaḥ | ādityānāmapūrvyaṃ savīmani ||

translations.english: Let a mortal now earnestly solicit at the worship of these Ādityas unprecedented riches.

mantras.sanskrit: अनर्वाणो ह्येषां पन्था आदित्यानाम् । अदब्धाः सन्ति पायवः सुगेवृधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: anarvāṇo hyeṣāṃ panthā ādityānām | adabdhāḥ santi pāyavaḥ sugevṛdhaḥ ||

translations.english: The paths of these Ādityas are unobstructed and unopposed; may they yield us security and augmentour happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: तत्सु नः सविता भगो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । शर्म यच्छन्तु सप्रथो यदीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tatsu naḥ savitā bhago varuṇo mitro aryamā | śarma yacchantu sapratho yadīmahe ||

translations.english: May Savitā, Bhaga, Varuṇa, Mitra, and Aryaman bestow upon us that ample felicity which we solicit.

mantras.sanskrit: देवेभिर्देव्यदितेऽरिष्टभर्मन्ना गहि । स्मत्सूरिभिः पुरुप्रिये सुशर्मभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: devebhirdevyadite'riṣṭabharmannā gahi | smatsūribhiḥ purupriye suśarmabhiḥ ||

translations.english: Divine Aditi, bringer of safety, beloved of many, com propitiously with the wise and happy divinitieṣ

mantras.sanskrit: ते हि पुत्रासो अदितेर्विदुर्द्वेषांसि योतवे । अंहोश्चिदुरुचक्रयोऽनेहसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te hi putrāso aditervidurdveṣāṃsi yotave | aṃhościdurucakrayo'nehasaḥ ||

translations.english: These sons of Aditi know how to drive away (our) enmies; and, doers of great deeds and donors ofsecurity, (they know how to extricate us) from sin.

mantras.sanskrit: अदितिर्नो दिवा पशुमदितिर्नक्तमद्वयाः । अदितिः पात्वंहसः सदावृधा ॥
mantras.transliteration: aditirno divā paśumaditirnaktamadvayāḥ | aditiḥ pātvaṃhasaḥ sadāvṛdhā ||

translations.english: May Aditi protect our cattle by day, ad, free from duplicity (guard them) by night; may Aditi, by herconstant favour, preserve us from sin.

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्या नो दिवा मतिरदितिरूत्या गमत् । सा शंताति मयस्करदप स्रिधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta syā no divā matiraditirūtyā gamat | sā śaṃtāti mayaskaradapa sridhaḥ ||

translations.english: May the monitress Aditi come to us, for our prosecution by day; may she grant us tranquil felicity, andlive away, (our) enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्या दैव्या भिषजा शं नः करतो अश्विना । युयुयातामितो रपो अप स्रिधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tyā daivyā bhiṣajā śaṃ naḥ karato aśvinā | yuyuyātāmito rapo apa sridhaḥ ||

translations.english: May the two divine physicians, the Aśvins, grant us health; may they drive away from hence iniquity;(may they drive) away our foes.

mantras.sanskrit: शमग्निरग्निभिः करच्छं नस्तपतु सूर्यः । शं वातो वात्वरपा अप स्रिधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śamagniragnibhiḥ karacchaṃ nastapatu sūryaḥ | śaṃ vāto vātvarapā apa sridhaḥ ||

translations.english: May the two divine physicians, the Aśvins, grant us health; may they drive away from hence iniquity;(may they drive) away our foes.

mantras.sanskrit: अपामीवामप स्रिधमप सेधत दुर्मतिम् । आदित्यासो युयोतना नो अंहसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: apāmīvāmapa sridhamapa sedhata durmatim | ādityāso yuyotanā no aṃhasaḥ ||

translations.english: Ādityas, remove (from us) disease, enemies, malignity; keep us afar from sin.

mantras.sanskrit: युयोता शरुमस्मदाँ आदित्यास उतामतिम् । ऋधग्द्वेषः कृणुत विश्ववेदसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuyotā śarumasmadā~ ādityāsa utāmatim | ṛdhagdveṣaḥ kṛṇuta viśvavedasaḥ ||

translations.english: Keep afar from us, Ādityas, malignity, ill-will; do you who are all- wise keep afar those who hate us.

mantras.sanskrit: तत्सु नः शर्म यच्छतादित्या यन्मुमोचति । एनस्वन्तं चिदेनसः सुदानवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tatsu naḥ śarma yacchatādityā yanmumocati | enasvantaṃ cidenasaḥ sudānavaḥ ||

translations.english: Grant freely to us, genitive rous Ādityas, that happiness which liberates even the offending (worshipper)from sin.

mantras.sanskrit: यो नः कश्चिद्रिरिक्षति रक्षस्त्वेन मर्त्यः । स्वैः ष एवै रिरिषीष्ट युर्जनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo naḥ kaścidririkṣati rakṣastvena martyaḥ | svaiḥ ṣa evai ririṣīṣṭa yurjanaḥ ||

translations.english: May that man who, from his diabolical nature seeks to do us evil-- may he, injuring himself by his owndevices, incu that evil.

mantras.sanskrit: समित्तमघमश्नवद्दुःशंसं मर्त्यं रिपुम् । यो अस्मत्रा दुर्हणावाँ उप द्वयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samittamaghamaśnavadduḥśaṃsaṃ martyaṃ ripum | yo asmatrā durhaṇāvā~ upa dvayuḥ ||

translations.english: May iniquity pervade hat calumniating and hostile mortal who wishes to do us harm, and is treacheroustowards us.

mantras.sanskrit: पाकत्रा स्थन देवा हृत्सु जानीथ मर्त्यम् । उप द्वयुं चाद्वयुं च वसवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pākatrā sthana devā hṛtsu jānītha martyam | upa dvayuṃ cādvayuṃ ca vasavaḥ ||

translations.english: Deities, you are (propitious) to sincere (worshippers), you know, Vasus, the hearts of men, anddistinguish between the single and double-minded.

mantras.sanskrit: आ शर्म पर्वतानामोतापां वृणीमहे । द्यावाक्षामारे अस्मद्रपस्कृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā śarma parvatānāmotāpāṃ vṛṇīmahe | dyāvākṣāmāre asmadrapaskṛtam ||

translations.english: We solicit the happiness of the mountains and of the waters; heaven and earth, remove sin far from us.

mantras.sanskrit: ते नो भद्रेण शर्मणा युष्माकं नावा वसवः । अति विश्वानि दुरिता पिपर्तन ॥
mantras.transliteration: te no bhadreṇa śarmaṇā yuṣmākaṃ nāvā vasavaḥ | ati viśvāni duritā pipartana ||

translations.english: Convey us, Vasus, in your vessel, with auspicious felicity, beyond all calamities.

mantras.sanskrit: तुचे तनाय तत्सु नो द्राघीय आयुर्जीवसे । आदित्यासः सुमहसः कृणोतन ॥
mantras.transliteration: tuce tanāya tatsu no drāghīya āyurjīvase | ādityāsaḥ sumahasaḥ kṛṇotana ||

translations.english: Radiant Ādityas grant to our sons and grandsons to enjoy long life.

mantras.sanskrit: यज्ञो हीळो वो अन्तर आदित्या अस्ति मृळत । युष्मे इद्वो अपि ष्मसि सजात्ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajño hīḷo vo antara ādityā asti mṛḷata | yuṣme idvo api ṣmasi sajātye ||

translations.english: The duly-presented sacrifice is ready for you, Ādityas; grant us, therefore, happiness; may we everabide in near relationship with you.

mantras.sanskrit: बृहद्वरूथं मरुतां देवं त्रातारमश्विना । मित्रमीमहे वरुणं स्वस्तये ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhadvarūthaṃ marutāṃ devaṃ trātāramaśvinā | mitramīmahe varuṇaṃ svastaye ||

translations.english: We solicit of the divine protector of he Maruts, of the Aśvisn, of Mitra and of Varuṇa, a spaciousdwelling for our welfare.

mantras.sanskrit: अनेहो मित्रार्यमन्नृवद्वरुण शंस्यम् । त्रिवरूथं मरुतो यन्त नश्छर्दिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aneho mitrāryamannṛvadvaruṇa śaṃsyam | trivarūthaṃ maruto yanta naśchardiḥ ||

translations.english: Mitra, Aryaman, Varuṇa and Maruts, grant us a secure, excellent and well-peopled dwelling, athree-fold shelter.

mantras.sanskrit: ये चिद्धि मृत्युबन्धव आदित्या मनवः स्मसि । प्र सू न आयुर्जीवसे तिरेतन ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye ciddhi mṛtyubandhava ādityā manavaḥ smasi | pra sū na āyurjīvase tiretana ||

translations.english: Since, Ādityas, we mortals are of kin to death, do you benevolently (exert yourselves to) prolong ourlives.

mantras.sanskrit: तं गूर्धया स्वर्णरं देवासो देवमरतिं दधन्विरे । देवत्रा हव्यमोहिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ gūrdhayā svarṇaraṃ devāso devamaratiṃ dadhanvire | devatrā havyamohire ||

translations.english: Glorify (Agni), the leader of all (sacred rites); the priests approach the divine lord, (and through him)convey the oblation to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: विभूतरातिं विप्र चित्रशोचिषमग्निमीळिष्व यन्तुरम् । अस्य मेधस्य सोम्यस्य सोभरे प्रेमध्वराय पूर्व्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vibhūtarātiṃ vipra citraśociṣamagnimīḷiṣva yanturam | asya medhasya somyasya sobhare premadhvarāya pūrvyam ||

translations.english: Praise, pious Sobhari, at the sacrifice this ancient Agni, who is the giver of opulence, the wonderfullyluminous, the regulator of this rite, at which the Soma is presented.

mantras.sanskrit: यजिष्ठं त्वा ववृमहे देवं देवत्रा होतारममर्त्यम् । अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajiṣṭhaṃ tvā vavṛmahe devaṃ devatrā hotāramamartyam | asya yajñasya sukratum ||

translations.english: We adore you, the most adorable deity, the invoker of the gods, the immortal, the perfecter of thissacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: ऊर्जो नपातं सुभगं सुदीदितिमग्निं श्रेष्ठशोचिषम् । स नो मित्रस्य वरुणस्य सो अपामा सुम्नं यक्षते दिवि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūrjo napātaṃ subhagaṃ sudīditimagniṃ śreṣṭhaśociṣam | sa no mitrasya varuṇasya so apāmā sumnaṃ yakṣate divi ||

translations.english: Agni, the great grandson of (sacrificial) food, the possessor of opulence, the illuminator, the shedder ofexcellent light; may he obtain for us by sacrifice the happiness in heaven (that is the gift) of Mitra, of Varuṇa, ofthe waters.

mantras.sanskrit: यः समिधा य आहुती यो वेदेन ददाश मर्तो अग्नये । यो नमसा स्वध्वरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ samidhā ya āhutī yo vedena dadāśa marto agnaye | yo namasā svadhvaraḥ ||

translations.english: The man who has presented (worship) to Agni with fuel, with burnt offerings, with the Veda, with(sacrificial) food, and is diligent in pious rites.

mantras.sanskrit: तस्येदर्वन्तो रंहयन्त आशवस्तस्य द्युम्नितमं यशः । न तमंहो देवकृतं कुतश्चन न मर्त्यकृतं नशत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tasyedarvanto raṃhayanta āśavastasya dyumnitamaṃ yaśaḥ | na tamaṃho devakṛtaṃ kutaścana na martyakṛtaṃ naśat ||

translations.english: Of him assuredly the rapid horses rush (on the foe); his is most brilliant glory; him no evil, whether thework of gods or of men, ever assails.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वग्नयो वो अग्निभिः स्याम सूनो सहस ऊर्जां पते । सुवीरस्त्वमस्मयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: svagnayo vo agnibhiḥ syāma sūno sahasa ūrjāṃ pate | suvīrastvamasmayuḥ ||

translations.english: Son of strength, lord of (sacrificial) food, may we be favoured with your various fires; do you, (Agni),endowed with energy, be well-disposed towards us!

mantras.sanskrit: प्रशंसमानो अतिथिर्न मित्रियोऽग्नी रथो न वेद्यः । त्वे क्षेमासो अपि सन्ति साधवस्त्वं राजा रयीणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: praśaṃsamāno atithirna mitriyo'gnī ratho na vedyaḥ | tve kṣemāso api santi sādhavastvaṃ rājā rayīṇām ||

translations.english: Agni, when honoured like a guest, is gracious to his praisers; he is to be recognized as a chariot(bringing the fruit of the worship); in you verily the virtuous are confiding; you are the rājā of riches.

mantras.sanskrit: सो अद्धा दाश्वध्वरोऽग्ने मर्तः सुभग स प्रशंस्यः । स धीभिरस्तु सनिता ॥
mantras.transliteration: so addhā dāśvadhvaro'gne martaḥ subhaga sa praśaṃsyaḥ | sa dhībhirastu sanitā ||

translations.english: Agni, may he who is the offerer of sacrifice obtain his reward; he, auspicious Agni, is worthy ofcommendation; may he by his pious rites become the giver of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य त्वमूर्ध्वो अध्वराय तिष्ठसि क्षयद्वीरः स साधते । सो अर्वद्भिः सनिता स विपन्युभिः स शूरैः सनिता कृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya tvamūrdhvo adhvarāya tiṣṭhasi kṣayadvīraḥ sa sādhate | so arvadbhiḥ sanitā sa vipanyubhiḥ sa śūraiḥ sanitā kṛtam ||

translations.english: He whose sacrifice you preside, prospers, having his dwelling filled with male offspring; he is theeffecter of his purposes through his horses, through his wise (counsellors), his valiant adherents.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्याग्निर्वपुर्गृहे स्तोमं चनो दधीत विश्ववार्यः । हव्या वा वेविषद्विषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasyāgnirvapurgṛhe stomaṃ cano dadhīta viśvavāryaḥ | havyā vā veviṣadviṣaḥ ||

translations.english: (So is he) in whose dwelling the all-desired and embodied Agni receives praise and food, and conveysoblations to the all-pervading deities.

mantras.sanskrit: विप्रस्य वा स्तुवतः सहसो यहो मक्षूतमस्य रातिषु । अवोदेवमुपरिमर्त्यं कृधि वसो विविदुषो वचः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viprasya vā stuvataḥ sahaso yaho makṣūtamasya rātiṣu | avodevamuparimartyaṃ kṛdhi vaso vividuṣo vacaḥ ||

translations.english: Son of strength, giver of dwellings, plural ce the prayer of he devout intelligent worshipper, who is mostprompt in offerings, below the gods and above mortals.

mantras.sanskrit: यो अग्निं हव्यदातिभिर्नमोभिर्वा सुदक्षमाविवासति । गिरा वाजिरशोचिषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo agniṃ havyadātibhirnamobhirvā sudakṣamāvivāsati | girā vājiraśociṣam ||

translations.english: He who propitiated the powerful and quick radiating Agni with offerings of oblations, with reverentialadorations and with praise, (is prosperous).

mantras.sanskrit: समिधा यो निशिती दाशददितिं धामभिरस्य मर्त्यः । विश्वेत्स धीभिः सुभगो जनाँ अति द्युम्नैरुद्न इव तारिषत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: samidhā yo niśitī dāśadaditiṃ dhāmabhirasya martyaḥ | viśvetsa dhībhiḥ subhago janā~ ati dyumnairudna iva tāriṣat ||

translations.english: The mortal who propitiates Aditi with his (Agni's) many forms by blazing fuel, prospering through hispious rites, shall surpass all men in renown as (if he had crossed over) the waters.

mantras.sanskrit: तदग्ने द्युम्नमा भर यत्सासहत्सदने कं चिदत्रिणम् । मन्युं जनस्य दूढ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadagne dyumnamā bhara yatsāsahatsadane kaṃ cidatriṇam | manyuṃ janasya dūḍhyaḥ ||

translations.english: Bestow upon us, Agni, that power which may overcome any cannibal (entering) into our abode, thewrath of any malignant (being).

mantras.sanskrit: येन चष्टे वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा येन नासत्या भगः । वयं तत्ते शवसा गातुवित्तमा इन्द्रत्वोता विधेमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yena caṣṭe varuṇo mitro aryamā yena nāsatyā bhagaḥ | vayaṃ tatte śavasā gātuvittamā indratvotā vidhemahi ||

translations.english: Protected by Indra, well-knowing the path that through your power, (Agni), we should follow, we adorethat (radiance) of you, by which Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman, the Nāsatyās, and Bhaga shine.

mantras.sanskrit: ते घेदग्ने स्वाध्यो ये त्वा विप्र निदधिरे नृचक्षसम् । विप्रासो देव सुक्रतुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: te ghedagne svādhyo ye tvā vipra nidadhire nṛcakṣasam | viprāso deva sukratum ||

translations.english: Those verily, Agni, are of approved piety who as your worshippers, sagacious deity, have establishedyou as the contemplator of men, the perfomer of good works.

mantras.sanskrit: त इद्वेदिं सुभग त आहुतिं ते सोतुं चक्रिरे दिवि । त इद्वाजेभिर्जिग्युर्महद्धनं ये त्वे कामं न्येरिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ta idvediṃ subhaga ta āhutiṃ te sotuṃ cakrire divi | ta idvājebhirjigyurmahaddhanaṃ ye tve kāmaṃ nyerire ||

translations.english: Auspicious (Agni), they have set up the altar, have presented oblations, have expressed the libation ona (fortunate) day; they have won by their efforts infinite wealth who have plural ced their affection upon you.

mantras.sanskrit: भद्रो नो अग्निराहुतो भद्रा रातिः सुभग भद्रो अध्वरः । भद्रा उत प्रशस्तयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhadro no agnirāhuto bhadrā rātiḥ subhaga bhadro adhvaraḥ | bhadrā uta praśastayaḥ ||

translations.english: May Agni, to whom burnt-offerings have been made, be propitious to us; auspicious (Agni), may yourgifts be blessings, may the sacrifice (we offer) be beneficial, may our praises yield us happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: भद्रं मनः कृणुष्व वृत्रतूर्ये येना समत्सु सासहः । अव स्थिरा तनुहि भूरि शर्धतां वनेमा ते अभिष्टिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhadraṃ manaḥ kṛṇuṣva vṛtratūrye yenā samatsu sāsahaḥ | ava sthirā tanuhi bhūri śardhatāṃ vanemā te abhiṣṭibhiḥ ||

translations.english: Give us that resolute mind in conflict by which you conquer in combats; humble the many firm (resolves)of our foes; may we propitiate you by our sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: ईळे गिरा मनुर्हितं यं देवा दूतमरतिं न्येरिरे । यजिष्ठं हव्यवाहनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: īḷe girā manurhitaṃ yaṃ devā dūtamaratiṃ nyerire | yajiṣṭhaṃ havyavāhanam ||

translations.english: I worship Agni, who has been established by Manu with praise, whom the gods have appointed theirroyal messenger, who is the most adorable, the bearer of oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: तिग्मजम्भाय तरुणाय राजते प्रयो गायस्यग्नये । यः पिंशते सूनृताभिः सुवीर्यमग्निर्घृतेभिराहुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tigmajambhāya taruṇāya rājate prayo gāyasyagnaye | yaḥ piṃśate sūnṛtābhiḥ suvīryamagnirghṛtebhirāhutaḥ ||

translations.english: Offer (sacriicial) food to that bright-shining, every-youthful, royal Agni, who, (when gratified) by sincerepraises, and worshipped with oblations, bestows excellent male offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: यदी घृतेभिराहुतो वाशीमग्निर्भरत उच्चाव च । असुर इव निर्णिजम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadī ghṛtebhirāhuto vāśīmagnirbharata uccāva ca | asura iva nirṇijam ||

translations.english: When Agni, worshipped with oblations, sends his voice upwards and downwards, as the sun disperseshis rays, (we praise him).

mantras.sanskrit: यो हव्यान्यैरयता मनुर्हितो देव आसा सुगन्धिना । विवासते वार्याणि स्वध्वरो होता देवो अमर्त्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo havyānyairayatā manurhito deva āsā sugandhinā | vivāsate vāryāṇi svadhvaro hotā devo amartyaḥ ||

translations.english: The divine (Agni), established by Manu, the offerer of the sacrifice, the invoker (of the gods), the divine,the immortal, who conveys the oblations in his fragrant mouth, bestows (upon his adorers) desirable (riches).

mantras.sanskrit: यदग्ने मर्त्यस्त्वं स्यामहं मित्रमहो अमर्त्यः । सहसः सूनवाहुत ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadagne martyastvaṃ syāmahaṃ mitramaho amartyaḥ | sahasaḥ sūnavāhuta ||

translations.english: Agni, son of strength, shining with friendly radiance, and worshipped with oblations, may I, who,although mortal, am as you are, become immortal.

mantras.sanskrit: न त्वा रासीयाभिशस्तये वसो न पापत्वाय सन्त्य । न मे स्तोतामतीवा न दुर्हितः स्यादग्ने न पापया ॥
mantras.transliteration: na tvā rāsīyābhiśastaye vaso na pāpatvāya santya | na me stotāmatīvā na durhitaḥ syādagne na pāpayā ||

translations.english: May I not be accusative ed, Vasu, of calumniating you, nor, gracious (Agni), of sinfulness (against you); letnot (the priest) the reciter of my praises be dull of intellect or ill-disposed; (may he not err), Agni, throughwickedness.

mantras.sanskrit: पितुर्न पुत्रः सुभृतो दुरोण आ देवाँ एतु प्र णो हविः ॥
mantras.transliteration: piturna putraḥ subhṛto duroṇa ā devā~ etu pra ṇo haviḥ ||

translations.english: Cherished by us as a son by a father, let him (Agni) in our dwelling convey promptly our oblation to thegods.

mantras.sanskrit: तवाहमग्न ऊतिभिर्नेदिष्ठाभिः सचेय जोषमा वसो । सदा देवस्य मर्त्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tavāhamagna ūtibhirnediṣṭhābhiḥ saceya joṣamā vaso | sadā devasya martyaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, granter of dwellings, may I, who am mortal, ever enjoy plural asure through your proximateprotections.

mantras.sanskrit: तव क्रत्वा सनेयं तव रातिभिरग्ने तव प्रशस्तिभिः । त्वामिदाहुः प्रमतिं वसो ममाग्ने हर्षस्व दातवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava kratvā saneyaṃ tava rātibhiragne tava praśastibhiḥ | tvāmidāhuḥ pramatiṃ vaso mamāgne harṣasva dātave ||

translations.english: May I propitiate you, Agni, by worshipping you, by the gifts presented to you, by your praises; verily,Vasu, they have called you the benevolent- minded; delight, Agni, to give me wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सो अग्ने तवोतिभिः सुवीराभिस्तिरते वाजभर्मभिः । यस्य त्वं सख्यमावरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra so agne tavotibhiḥ suvīrābhistirate vājabharmabhiḥ | yasya tvaṃ sakhyamāvaraḥ ||

translations.english: He, Agni, whose friendship you accept, prospers through your favours, granting male progeny andample food.

mantras.sanskrit: तव द्रप्सो नीलवान्वाश ऋत्विय इन्धानः सिष्णवा ददे । त्वं महीनामुषसामसि प्रियः क्षपो वस्तुषु राजसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava drapso nīlavānvāśa ṛtviya indhānaḥ siṣṇavā dade | tvaṃ mahīnāmuṣasāmasi priyaḥ kṣapo vastuṣu rājasi ||

translations.english: Sprinkled, (Agni, with the libation), the dripping (Soma), car-borne, agreeable, offered in due season,resplendent, have been presented to you; you are the beloved of the mighty dawns; you reign over the things ofnight.

mantras.sanskrit: तमागन्म सोभरयः सहस्रमुष्कं स्वभिष्टिमवसे । सम्राजं त्रासदस्यवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamāganma sobharayaḥ sahasramuṣkaṃ svabhiṣṭimavase | samrājaṃ trāsadasyavam ||

translations.english: We, the Sobharis, have come to the thousand-rayed, the sincerely- worshipped, the universalsovereign, the ally of Trasadasyu, for his protection.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य ते अग्ने अन्ये अग्नय उपक्षितो वया इव । विपो न द्युम्ना नि युवे जनानां तव क्षत्राणि वर्धयन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya te agne anye agnaya upakṣito vayā iva | vipo na dyumnā ni yuve janānāṃ tava kṣatrāṇi vardhayan ||

translations.english: Agni, on whom your other fires are dependent, like branches (on the stem of the tree), may I amongmen, magnifying your powers, become possessed, like (other) votaries, of (abundant) food.

mantras.sanskrit: यमादित्यासो अद्रुहः पारं नयथ मर्त्यम् । मघोनां विश्वेषां सुदानवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yamādityāso adruhaḥ pāraṃ nayatha martyam | maghonāṃ viśveṣāṃ sudānavaḥ ||

translations.english: Benevolent and genitive rous Ādityas, amid all the offerers of oblations, the man whom you conduct to thelimit (of his undertakings obtains his reward).

mantras.sanskrit: यूयं राजानः कं चिच्चर्षणीसहः क्षयन्तं मानुषाँ अनु । वयं ते वो वरुण मित्रार्यमन्त्स्यामेदृतस्य रथ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yūyaṃ rājānaḥ kaṃ ciccarṣaṇīsahaḥ kṣayantaṃ mānuṣā~ anu | vayaṃ te vo varuṇa mitrāryamantsyāmedṛtasya rathyaḥ ||

translations.english: Royal (Ādityas), overcomers of (hostile) men, (you subdue) any one harassing those (who areengaged in sacred rites) and may we, Varuṇa, Mitra, and Aryaman, be the conveyers of the sacrifice(addressed) to you.

mantras.sanskrit: अदान्मे पौरुकुत्स्यः पञ्चाशतं त्रसदस्युर्वधूनाम् । मंहिष्ठो अर्यः सत्पतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adānme paurukutsyaḥ pañcāśataṃ trasadasyurvadhūnām | maṃhiṣṭho aryaḥ satpatiḥ ||

translations.english: The magnificent lord, the protector of the virtuous, Trasadasyu, the son of Purukutsa, has given me fivehundred brides.

mantras.sanskrit: उत मे प्रयियोर्वयियोः सुवास्त्वा अधि तुग्वनि । तिसॄणां सप्ततीनां श्यावः प्रणेता भुवद्वसुर्दियानां पतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta me prayiyorvayiyoḥ suvāstvā adhi tugvani | tisṝṇāṃ saptatīnāṃ śyāvaḥ praṇetā bhuvadvasurdiyānāṃ patiḥ ||

translations.english: The affluent Śyāva, the lord of kine, has given to me upon the banks of Suvastu a present of seventythree (cows).
