mantras.sanskrit: आ गन्ता मा रिषण्यत प्रस्थावानो माप स्थाता समन्यवः । स्थिरा चिन्नमयिष्णवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā gantā mā riṣaṇyata prasthāvāno māpa sthātā samanyavaḥ | sthirā cinnamayiṣṇavaḥ ||

translations.english: Far-travellig (winds), alike wrathful, come here, harm us not; benders of the solid (mountains), withdrawnot from us.

mantras.sanskrit: वीळुपविभिर्मरुत ऋभुक्षण आ रुद्रासः सुदीतिभिः । इषा नो अद्या गता पुरुस्पृहो यज्ञमा सोभरीयवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vīḷupavibhirmaruta ṛbhukṣaṇa ā rudrāsaḥ sudītibhiḥ | iṣā no adyā gatā puruspṛho yajñamā sobharīyavaḥ ||

translations.english: Mighty sons of Rudra, Maruts, come with brilliant, strong-wheeled (chariots); desired of many,well-disposed to Sobhari, come today to our sacrifice with (abundant) food.

mantras.sanskrit: विद्मा हि रुद्रियाणां शुष्ममुग्रं मरुतां शिमीवताम् । विष्णोरेषस्य मीळ्हुषाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vidmā hi rudriyāṇāṃ śuṣmamugraṃ marutāṃ śimīvatām | viṣṇoreṣasya mīḷhuṣām ||

translations.english: We know the great strength of the active sons of Rudra, the Maruts, the shedders of the diffusive raiṇ

mantras.sanskrit: वि द्वीपानि पापतन्तिष्ठद्दुच्छुनोभे युजन्त रोदसी । प्र धन्वान्यैरत शुभ्रखादयो यदेजथ स्वभानवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi dvīpāni pāpatantiṣṭhadducchunobhe yujanta rodasī | pra dhanvānyairata śubhrakhādayo yadejatha svabhānavaḥ ||

translations.english: They fall upon the island; the firm-set (trees) are with difficulty sustained; they agitate both heaven andearth; they urge on the waters; bright- weaponed, far-shining, whatever (you approach) you cause to tremble.

mantras.sanskrit: अच्युता चिद्वो अज्मन्ना नानदति पर्वतासो वनस्पतिः । भूमिर्यामेषु रेजते ॥
mantras.transliteration: acyutā cidvo ajmannā nānadati parvatāso vanaspatiḥ | bhūmiryāmeṣu rejate ||

translations.english: At your coming the unprecipitated mountains and trees resound; the earth shakes at your passage.

mantras.sanskrit: अमाय वो मरुतो यातवे द्यौर्जिहीत उत्तरा बृहत् । यत्रा नरो देदिशते तनूष्वा त्वक्षांसि बाह्वोजसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: amāya vo maruto yātave dyaurjihīta uttarā bṛhat | yatrā naro dediśate tanūṣvā tvakṣāṃsi bāhvojasaḥ ||

translations.english: (Alarmed) at your violence, Maruts, the heaven seeks to rise higher, abandoning the firmament, where(you) the strong-armed leaders (of rites) display the ornaments of (your) person ns.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वधामनु श्रियं नरो महि त्वेषा अमवन्तो वृषप्सवः । वहन्ते अह्रुतप्सवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: svadhāmanu śriyaṃ naro mahi tveṣā amavanto vṛṣapsavaḥ | vahante ahrutapsavaḥ ||

translations.english: The radiant, strong, rain-shedding, undisguised leaders of rites display their great glory when acceptingthe (sacrificial) food.

mantras.sanskrit: गोभिर्वाणो अज्यते सोभरीणां रथे कोशे हिरण्यये । गोबन्धवः सुजातास इषे भुजे महान्तो नः स्परसे नु ॥
mantras.transliteration: gobhirvāṇo ajyate sobharīṇāṃ rathe kośe hiraṇyaye | gobandhavaḥ sujātāsa iṣe bhuje mahānto naḥ sparase nu ||

translations.english: The voice (of the Maruts) blends with the songs of the Sobharis in the receptacle of their goldenchariot; may the mighty well-born Maruts, the offspring of the (bridled) cow, (be gracious) to us regard of food,enjoyment, and kindness.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रति वो वृषदञ्जयो वृष्णे शर्धाय मारुताय भरध्वम् । हव्या वृषप्रयाव्णे ॥
mantras.transliteration: prati vo vṛṣadañjayo vṛṣṇe śardhāya mārutāya bharadhvam | havyā vṛṣaprayāvṇe ||

translations.english: Sprinklers of the libation, present the offerings to the rain-bestowing swift-passing company of theMaruts.

mantras.sanskrit: वृषणश्वेन मरुतो वृषप्सुना रथेन वृषनाभिना । आ श्येनासो न पक्षिणो वृथा नरो हव्या नो वीतये गत ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣaṇaśvena maruto vṛṣapsunā rathena vṛṣanābhinā | ā śyenāso na pakṣiṇo vṛthā naro havyā no vītaye gata ||

translations.english: Maruts, leaders (of rites), come like swift-flying birds in your rain- shedding, strong-horsed chariot,whose wheels bestow showers, to partake of our oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: समानमञ्ज्येषां वि भ्राजन्ते रुक्मासो अधि बाहुषु । दविद्युतत्यृष्टयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samānamañjyeṣāṃ vi bhrājante rukmāso adhi bāhuṣu | davidyutatyṛṣṭayaḥ ||

translations.english: Their decoration is the same; gold (necklaces) shine (on their breasts), lances gleam upon theirshoulders.

mantras.sanskrit: त उग्रासो वृषण उग्रबाहवो नकिष्टनूषु येतिरे । स्थिरा धन्वान्यायुधा रथेषु वोऽनीकेष्वधि श्रियः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ta ugrāso vṛṣaṇa ugrabāhavo nakiṣṭanūṣu yetire | sthirā dhanvānyāyudhā ratheṣu vo'nīkeṣvadhi śriyaḥ ||

translations.english: Fierce, vigorous, strong-armed, they need not exert (the energy of their) person ns; bows and arrows areready in your chariots; the glory (of conquest) over (hostile) armies is yours.

mantras.sanskrit: येषामर्णो न सप्रथो नाम त्वेषं शश्वतामेकमिद्भुजे । वयो न पित्र्यं सहः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yeṣāmarṇo na sapratho nāma tveṣaṃ śaśvatāmekamidbhuje | vayo na pitryaṃ sahaḥ ||

translations.english: One illustrious name is given to them all, as widely diffused as water for the gratification (of theirworshippers), like invigoraing paternal food.

mantras.sanskrit: तान्वन्दस्व मरुतस्ताँ उप स्तुहि तेषां हि धुनीनाम् । अराणां न चरमस्तदेषां दाना मह्ना तदेषाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tānvandasva marutastā~ upa stuhi teṣāṃ hi dhunīnām | arāṇāṃ na caramastadeṣāṃ dānā mahnā tadeṣām ||

translations.english: Praise them, praise the Maruts, for we are (dependen) upon those agitators (of all things) as a menial isupon his lords; therefore are their donations (characterized) by munificence; such are their (gifts).

mantras.sanskrit: सुभगः स व ऊतिष्वास पूर्वासु मरुतो व्युष्टिषु । यो वा नूनमुतासति ॥
mantras.transliteration: subhagaḥ sa va ūtiṣvāsa pūrvāsu maruto vyuṣṭiṣu | yo vā nūnamutāsati ||

translations.english: Fortunate was he, Maruts, who, in former days, was secure in your protections, as is he who nowenjoys them.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य वा यूयं प्रति वाजिनो नर आ हव्या वीतये गथ । अभि ष द्युम्नैरुत वाजसातिभिः सुम्ना वो धूतयो नशत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya vā yūyaṃ prati vājino nara ā havyā vītaye gatha | abhi ṣa dyumnairuta vājasātibhiḥ sumnā vo dhūtayo naśat ||

translations.english: The sacrificer, to partake of whose oblations you approach, leaders of rites, enjoys, agitators of allthings, the felicity you bestow, together with abundant viands, and the gift of strength.

mantras.sanskrit: यथा रुद्रस्य सूनवो दिवो वशन्त्यसुरस्य वेधसः । युवानस्तथेदसत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathā rudrasya sūnavo divo vaśantyasurasya vedhasaḥ | yuvānastathedasat ||

translations.english: May this (our praise) take effect, so that the ever-youthful sons of Rudra, creators of the cloud,(coming) from heaven, may be plural ased with us.

mantras.sanskrit: ये चार्हन्ति मरुतः सुदानवः स्मन्मीळ्हुषश्चरन्ति ये । अतश्चिदा न उप वस्यसा हृदा युवान आ ववृध्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye cārhanti marutaḥ sudānavaḥ smanmīḷhuṣaścaranti ye | ataścidā na upa vasyasā hṛdā yuvāna ā vavṛdhvam ||

translations.english: Youthful (Maruts), approaching us with benevolent hearts, grant prosperity to those liberal men whoworship you, who zealously propitiate you, the showerers of rain, with oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: यून ऊ षु नविष्ठया वृष्णः पावकाँ अभि सोभरे गिरा । गाय गा इव चर्कृषत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yūna ū ṣu naviṣṭhayā vṛṣṇaḥ pāvakā~ abhi sobhare girā | gāya gā iva carkṛṣat ||

translations.english: Praise, Sobhari, (and attract here) by a new song the youthful purifying showerers, as (a plural ughman)repeatedly drags his oxen.

mantras.sanskrit: साहा ये सन्ति मुष्टिहेव हव्यो विश्वासु पृत्सु होतृषु । वृष्णश्चन्द्रान्न सुश्रवस्तमान्गिरा वन्दस्व मरुतो अह ॥
mantras.transliteration: sāhā ye santi muṣṭiheva havyo viśvāsu pṛtsu hotṛṣu | vṛṣṇaścandrānna suśravastamāngirā vandasva maruto aha ||

translations.english: Propitiate wiḥ praise he Maruts, the senders of rain, the givers of plural asure, the liberal bestowers offood; who are ever victorious in combats, and like a boxer who has been challenged over his challengerṣ

mantras.sanskrit: गावश्चिद्घा समन्यवः सजात्येन मरुतः सबन्धवः । रिहते ककुभो मिथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: gāvaścidghā samanyavaḥ sajātyena marutaḥ sabandhavaḥ | rihate kakubho mithaḥ ||

translations.english: Maruts, who are of like wrath, offspring of the maternal cow (Pṛśni), related by a common origin, theyseverally spread through the quarters of the horizon.

mantras.sanskrit: मर्तश्चिद्वो नृतवो रुक्मवक्षस उप भ्रातृत्वमायति । अधि नो गात मरुतः सदा हि व आपित्वमस्ति निध्रुवि ॥
mantras.transliteration: martaścidvo nṛtavo rukmavakṣasa upa bhrātṛtvamāyati | adhi no gāta marutaḥ sadā hi va āpitvamasti nidhruvi ||

translations.english: Maruts, dancing (through the air), decorated with golden breast-plural tes, the mortal (who worships you)attains your brotherhood; speak favourably to us, for your affinity is ever (made known) at the regulated(sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: मरुतो मारुतस्य न आ भेषजस्य वहता सुदानवः । यूयं सखायः सप्तयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: maruto mārutasya na ā bheṣajasya vahatā sudānavaḥ | yūyaṃ sakhāyaḥ saptayaḥ ||

translations.english: genitive rous fiends, Maruts, swift gliding (through the air), bring to us (the boon) of the medicaments thatbelong to your company.

mantras.sanskrit: याभिः सिन्धुमवथ याभिस्तूर्वथ याभिर्दशस्यथा क्रिविम् । मयो नो भूतोतिभिर्मयोभुवः शिवाभिरसचद्विषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yābhiḥ sindhumavatha yābhistūrvatha yābhirdaśasyathā krivim | mayo no bhūtotibhirmayobhuvaḥ śivābhirasacadviṣaḥ ||

translations.english: With those auspicious protectionw with which you have guarded the ocean, with which you havedesroyed (your enemies), with which you provided the well (for Gotama), do you who are he sources ofhappiness, the unconquerable by your adversaries, bestow happiness upon uṣ]The unconquerable:asasacadviṣa = śatrurahitaḥ, destitute of enemies].

mantras.sanskrit: यत्सिन्धौ यदसिक्न्यां यत्समुद्रेषु मरुतः सुबर्हिषः । यत्पर्वतेषु भेषजम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatsindhau yadasiknyāṃ yatsamudreṣu marutaḥ subarhiṣaḥ | yatparvateṣu bheṣajam ||

translations.english: Whatever medicament there may be in the Sindhu, the Asikni, in the oceans, in the mountains, Maruts,who are gratified by sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वं पश्यन्तो बिभृथा तनूष्वा तेना नो अधि वोचत । क्षमा रपो मरुत आतुरस्य न इष्कर्ता विह्रुतं पुनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvaṃ paśyanto bibhṛthā tanūṣvā tenā no adhi vocata | kṣamā rapo maruta āturasya na iṣkartā vihrutaṃ punaḥ ||

translations.english: Do you, beholding every sort, collect them for (the good of) our bodies, ad instrumental uct us in their (uses); letthe cure of sickness (be the portion), Maruts, of him among us who for his wickedness is sick; re-establish hisenfeebled (frame).

mantras.sanskrit: वयमु त्वामपूर्व्य स्थूरं न कच्चिद्भरन्तोऽवस्यवः । वाजे चित्रं हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayamu tvāmapūrvya sthūraṃ na kaccidbharanto'vasyavaḥ | vāje citraṃ havāmahe ||

translations.english: Unpreceded Indra, cherishing you (with sacrificial food), desirous of your protection, we invoke you whoare manifold in battle, as (men call upon) some stout (person n for help).

mantras.sanskrit: उप त्वा कर्मन्नूतये स नो युवोग्रश्चक्राम यो धृषत् । त्वामिद्ध्यवितारं ववृमहे सखाय इन्द्र सानसिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa tvā karmannūtaye sa no yuvograścakrāma yo dhṛṣat | tvāmiddhyavitāraṃ vavṛmahe sakhāya indra sānasim ||

translations.english: We have recourse, Indra, to you for protection at sacred rites; may he who is ever young, fierce,resolute, come to us! We, your friends, Indra, rely upon you as our protector and benefactor.

mantras.sanskrit: आ याहीम इन्दवोऽश्वपते गोपत उर्वरापते । सोमं सोमपते पिब ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yāhīma indavo'śvapate gopata urvarāpate | somaṃ somapate piba ||

translations.english: Lord of horses, of cattle, of corn-land, these libations (are for you); come, lord of the Soma, drink theeffused Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: वयं हि त्वा बन्धुमन्तमबन्धवो विप्रास इन्द्र येमिम । या ते धामानि वृषभ तेभिरा गहि विश्वेभिः सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayaṃ hi tvā bandhumantamabandhavo viprāsa indra yemima | yā te dhāmāni vṛṣabha tebhirā gahi viśvebhiḥ somapītaye ||

translations.english: Intelligent, but destitute of kin, let us connect ourselves, Indra, with you, who abound with kinsmen;come, showerer (of benefits), with all your glories, to drink the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: सीदन्तस्ते वयो यथा गोश्रीते मधौ मदिरे विवक्षणे । अभि त्वामिन्द्र नोनुमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sīdantaste vayo yathā gośrīte madhau madire vivakṣaṇe | abhi tvāmindra nonumaḥ ||

translations.english: Gathering like (a flock of) birds round your exhilarating heaven- bestowing Soma mixed with curds, werepeatedly glorify you, Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: अच्छा च त्वैना नमसा वदामसि किं मुहुश्चिद्वि दीधयः । सन्ति कामासो हरिवो ददिष्ट्वं स्मो वयं सन्ति नो धियः ॥
mantras.transliteration: acchā ca tvainā namasā vadāmasi kiṃ muhuścidvi dīdhayaḥ | santi kāmāso harivo dadiṣṭvaṃ smo vayaṃ santi no dhiyaḥ ||

translations.english: We salute you with this adoration; why do you so often mediate (upon our requests)? Master of baysteeds, let our desires be granted. You are their bestower, we are your (suppliants) and our sacred rites are(addressed to you).

mantras.sanskrit: नूत्ना इदिन्द्र ते वयमूती अभूम नहि नू ते अद्रिवः । विद्मा पुरा परीणसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nūtnā idindra te vayamūtī abhūma nahi nū te adrivaḥ | vidmā purā parīṇasaḥ ||

translations.english: We verily are the most recent (objects) of your protection, Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, we have notknown of old one greater than you.

mantras.sanskrit: विद्मा सखित्वमुत शूर भोज्यमा ते ता वज्रिन्नीमहे । उतो समस्मिन्ना शिशीहि नो वसो वाजे सुशिप्र गोमति ॥
mantras.transliteration: vidmā sakhitvamuta śūra bhojyamā te tā vajrinnīmahe | uto samasminnā śiśīhi no vaso vāje suśipra gomati ||

translations.english: We acknowledge, hero, your friendship, (the wealth) to be enjoyed through you, and solicit both,thunderer, of you; giver of dwellings, Indra of the handsome jaws, sustain us in all abundance and in (store of)cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: यो न इदमिदं पुरा प्र वस्य आनिनाय तमु वः स्तुषे । सखाय इन्द्रमूतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo na idamidaṃ purā pra vasya ānināya tamu vaḥ stuṣe | sakhāya indramūtaye ||

translations.english: I glorify friends, for your protection, that Indra who has brought to us of old this or that excellent(wealth).

mantras.sanskrit: हर्यश्वं सत्पतिं चर्षणीसहं स हि ष्मा यो अमन्दत । आ तु नः स वयति गव्यमश्व्यं स्तोतृभ्यो मघवा शतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: haryaśvaṃ satpatiṃ carṣaṇīsahaṃ sa hi ṣmā yo amandata | ā tu naḥ sa vayati gavyamaśvyaṃ stotṛbhyo maghavā śatam ||

translations.english: That man glorifies Indra, the lord of bay steeds, the protector of the good, the overcomer of enemies,who rejoices (in the fulfilment of his wishes); may Maghavan bestow upon us, his worshippers, hundreds of cattleand horses.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वया ह स्विद्युजा वयं प्रति श्वसन्तं वृषभ ब्रुवीमहि । संस्थे जनस्य गोमतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvayā ha svidyujā vayaṃ prati śvasantaṃ vṛṣabha bruvīmahi | saṃsthe janasya gomataḥ ||

translations.english: With you, showerer (of benefits), for our ally, we bid defiance to one assailing us in a contest (onbehalf) of a man possessing herds of cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: जयेम कारे पुरुहूत कारिणोऽभि तिष्ठेम दूढ्यः । नृभिर्वृत्रं हन्याम शूशुयाम चावेरिन्द्र प्र णो धियः ॥
mantras.transliteration: jayema kāre puruhūta kāriṇo'bhi tiṣṭhema dūḍhyaḥ | nṛbhirvṛtraṃ hanyāma śūśuyāma cāverindra pra ṇo dhiyaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, invoked of many, may we conquer in battle those contending against us; may we resist themalignant; may we, aided by the leaders (of rites, the Maruts), slay Vṛtra; may we be prosperous, and do youprotect our pious works.

mantras.sanskrit: अभ्रातृव्यो अना त्वमनापिरिन्द्र जनुषा सनादसि । युधेदापित्वमिच्छसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhrātṛvyo anā tvamanāpirindra januṣā sanādasi | yudhedāpitvamicchase ||

translations.english: You, Indra, are by your birth brotherless; from ever are you without a kinsman; the kindred you desire is(that of him) who engages in war.

mantras.sanskrit: नकी रेवन्तं सख्याय विन्दसे पीयन्ति ते सुराश्वः । यदा कृणोषि नदनुं समूहस्यादित्पितेव हूयसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: nakī revantaṃ sakhyāya vindase pīyanti te surāśvaḥ | yadā kṛṇoṣi nadanuṃ samūhasyāditpiteva hūyase ||

translations.english: You acknowledge no friendship for the wealthy man (who makes no offerings); those who are puffed upwith wine offered you; when you instrumental tute (the sacrifice), you expelled niggardliness, and you are invoked as aprotector.

mantras.sanskrit: मा ते अमाजुरो यथा मूरास इन्द्र सख्ये त्वावतः । नि षदाम सचा सुते ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā te amājuro yathā mūrāsa indra sakhye tvāvataḥ | ni ṣadāma sacā sute ||

translations.english: Let us not, like fools, Indra, be regardless of the friendship of such as you are; let us assemble togetherwhen the libation is effused.

mantras.sanskrit: मा ते गोदत्र निरराम राधस इन्द्र मा ते गृहामहि । दृळ्हा चिदर्यः प्र मृशाभ्या भर न ते दामान आदभे ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā te godatra nirarāma rādhasa indra mā te gṛhāmahi | dṛḷhā cidaryaḥ pra mṛśābhyā bhara na te dāmāna ādabhe ||

translations.english: Let us never, Indra, giver of cattle, cease (to benefit) from your wealth; let us not accept it (from anotherthan) you; do you, who are the lord, connfirm to us permanent (riches), bestow them upon us; your benefactionscannoe be arrested.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रो वा घेदियन्मघं सरस्वती वा सुभगा ददिर्वसु । त्वं वा चित्र दाशुषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: indro vā ghediyanmaghaṃ sarasvatī vā subhagā dadirvasu | tvaṃ vā citra dāśuṣe ||

translations.english: Is it Indra who has given to the donor (of the oblation) so much affluence? Is it the auspiciousSarasvatī (who has given) the treasure? Or, Citra, is it you?

mantras.sanskrit: चित्र इद्राजा राजका इदन्यके यके सरस्वतीमनु । पर्जन्य इव ततनद्धि वृष्ट्या सहस्रमयुता ददत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: citra idrājā rājakā idanyake yake sarasvatīmanu | parjanya iva tatanaddhi vṛṣṭyā sahasramayutā dadat ||

translations.english: Verily the Rājā Citra, giving his thousands and tens of thousands, has overspread (with his bounty)those other petty princes, who rules along the Sarasvatī, as Parjanya (overspeads the earth) with rain.

mantras.sanskrit: ओ त्यमह्व आ रथमद्या दंसिष्ठमूतये । यमश्विना सुहवा रुद्रवर्तनी आ सूर्यायै तस्थथुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: o tyamahva ā rathamadyā daṃsiṣṭhamūtaye | yamaśvinā suhavā rudravartanī ā sūryāyai tasthathuḥ ||

translations.english: I invoke to-day for our protection that splendid chariot, which, adorable Aśvins, advancing on the pathto battle, you ascended (to go to the wwedding) of Sūrya.

mantras.sanskrit: पूर्वायुषं सुहवं पुरुस्पृहं भुज्युं वाजेषु पूर्व्यम् । सचनावन्तं सुमतिभिः सोभरे विद्वेषसमनेहसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pūrvāyuṣaṃ suhavaṃ puruspṛhaṃ bhujyuṃ vājeṣu pūrvyam | sacanāvantaṃ sumatibhiḥ sobhare vidveṣasamanehasam ||

translations.english: Celebrate, Sobhari, with praises (that chariot), the benefactor of former (encomiasts), the worthilyinvoked, the desired of many, the preserver, the foremost in battles, the relied upon by all, the scatterer ofenemies, the exempt from ill.

mantras.sanskrit: इह त्या पुरुभूतमा देवा नमोभिरश्विना । अर्वाचीना स्ववसे करामहे गन्तारा दाशुषो गृहम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: iha tyā purubhūtamā devā namobhiraśvinā | arvācīnā svavase karāmahe gantārā dāśuṣo gṛham ||

translations.english: We incite by our adorations on this occasion the two divine Aśvins, the overcomers of foes, that theymay come down for our protection and proceed to the dwelling of the donor (of the offering).

mantras.sanskrit: युवो रथस्य परि चक्रमीयत ईर्मान्यद्वामिषण्यति । अस्माँ अच्छा सुमतिर्वां शुभस्पती आ धेनुरिव धावतु ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvo rathasya pari cakramīyata īrmānyadvāmiṣaṇyati | asmā~ acchā sumatirvāṃ śubhaspatī ā dhenuriva dhāvatu ||

translations.english: One of the wheels of your car moves in every direction; the other, impellers of actions, remains withyou; may your favour, lords of rain, hasten towards us as a cow (to her calf)!

mantras.sanskrit: रथो यो वां त्रिवन्धुरो हिरण्याभीशुरश्विना । परि द्यावापृथिवी भूषति श्रुतस्तेन नासत्या गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ratho yo vāṃ trivandhuro hiraṇyābhīśuraśvinā | pari dyāvāpṛthivī bhūṣati śrutastena nāsatyā gatam ||

translations.english: Your celebrated chariot, Aśvins, that is three-banked, and caparisoned with gold, graces heaven andearth; come with it, Nāsatyās.

mantras.sanskrit: दशस्यन्ता मनवे पूर्व्यं दिवि यवं वृकेण कर्षथः । ता वामद्य सुमतिभिः शुभस्पती अश्विना प्र स्तुवीमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: daśasyantā manave pūrvyaṃ divi yavaṃ vṛkeṇa karṣathaḥ | tā vāmadya sumatibhiḥ śubhaspatī aśvinā pra stuvīmahi ||

translations.english: Bestowing upon Manu the ancient (rain) from the firmament, you enabled him to cultivate (the soil) withthe plural ugh (and reap) the barley; now therefore, Aśvins, lords of rain, we glorify you both with praises.

mantras.sanskrit: उप नो वाजिनीवसू यातमृतस्य पथिभिः । येभिस्तृक्षिं वृषणा त्रासदस्यवं महे क्षत्राय जिन्वथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa no vājinīvasū yātamṛtasya pathibhiḥ | yebhistṛkṣiṃ vṛṣaṇā trāsadasyavaṃ mahe kṣatrāya jinvathaḥ ||

translations.english: Rich in food, Aśvins, come to us by the paths of sacrifice, those by which showerers (of benefits), youwent to gratify Tṛkṣi, the son of Trasadasyu, with vast wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं वामद्रिभिः सुतः सोमो नरा वृषण्वसू । आ यातं सोमपीतये पिबतं दाशुषो गृहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ vāmadribhiḥ sutaḥ somo narā vṛṣaṇvasū | ā yātaṃ somapītaye pibataṃ dāśuṣo gṛhe ||

translations.english: Leaders (of rites), affluent in rain, this Soma has been expressed by the (grinding) stones for you; cometo drink the Soma, drink it in the dwelling of the donor.

mantras.sanskrit: आ हि रुहतमश्विना रथे कोशे हिरण्यये वृषण्वसू । युञ्जाथां पीवरीरिषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā hi ruhatamaśvinā rathe kośe hiraṇyaye vṛṣaṇvasū | yuñjāthāṃ pīvarīriṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Aśvins, who are rich in rain, ascend your golden chariot, a storehouse (of weapons); bring to usfattening food.

mantras.sanskrit: याभिः पक्थमवथो याभिरध्रिगुं याभिर्बभ्रुं विजोषसम् । ताभिर्नो मक्षू तूयमश्विना गतं भिषज्यतं यदातुरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yābhiḥ pakthamavatho yābhiradhriguṃ yābhirbabhruṃ vijoṣasam | tābhirno makṣū tūyamaśvinā gataṃ bhiṣajyataṃ yadāturam ||

translations.english: With those protections with which you have defended Paktha, Adhrigu, and Babhru, when propitiatingyou, come to us, Aśvins, quickly; administer medicine to the sick.

mantras.sanskrit: यदध्रिगावो अध्रिगू इदा चिदह्नो अश्विना हवामहे । वयं गीर्भिर्विपन्यवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadadhrigāvo adhrigū idā cidahno aśvinā havāmahe | vayaṃ gīrbhirvipanyavaḥ ||

translations.english: At the tiem when hurrying, devout, we invoke you both speedily going to battle, at the dawn of day, withour hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: ताभिरा यातं वृषणोप मे हवं विश्वप्सुं विश्ववार्यम् । इषा मंहिष्ठा पुरुभूतमा नरा याभिः क्रिविं वावृधुस्ताभिरा गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tābhirā yātaṃ vṛṣaṇopa me havaṃ viśvapsuṃ viśvavāryam | iṣā maṃhiṣṭhā purubhūtamā narā yābhiḥ kriviṃ vāvṛdhustābhirā gatam ||

translations.english: Then, showerers, come to my manifold all-propitiating invocation with those (protections), with which,leaders (of rites), you, who are gratified (by oblations), munificent (in gifts), and the overcomers of numerous(foes), gave augmentation to the well; with such (protections) come here.

mantras.sanskrit: ताविदा चिदहानां तावश्विना वन्दमान उप ब्रुवे । ता उ नमोभिरीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tāvidā cidahānāṃ tāvaśvinā vandamāna upa bruve | tā u namobhirīmahe ||

translations.english: I address the Aśvins, glorifying them at break of day; we solicit them with oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: ताविद्दोषा ता उषसि शुभस्पती ता यामन्रुद्रवर्तनी । मा नो मर्ताय रिपवे वाजिनीवसू परो रुद्रावति ख्यतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tāviddoṣā tā uṣasi śubhaspatī tā yāmanrudravartanī | mā no martāya ripave vājinīvasū paro rudrāvati khyatam ||

translations.english: We adore those lords of water, leaders on the road of battle, in the evening, at dawn, and at mid-day;therefore, Rudras who are rich in food, give us not up hereafter to a mortal adversary; rudravartanī : yuddherodanaśilamārgau stūyamānamārgau vā].

mantras.sanskrit: आ सुग्म्याय सुग्म्यं प्राता रथेनाश्विना वा सक्षणी । हुवे पितेव सोभरी ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā sugmyāya sugmyaṃ prātā rathenāśvinā vā sakṣaṇī | huve piteva sobharī ||

translations.english: Adorable Aśvins, bring in your chariot at early dawn happiness to me, soliciting happiness; I, Sobhari,invoke you as (did my) father.

mantras.sanskrit: मनोजवसा वृषणा मदच्युता मक्षुंगमाभिरूतिभिः । आरात्ताच्चिद्भूतमस्मे अवसे पूर्वीभिः पुरुभोजसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: manojavasā vṛṣaṇā madacyutā makṣuṃgamābhirūtibhiḥ | ārāttāccidbhūtamasme avase pūrvībhiḥ purubhojasā ||

translations.english: (Aśvins), who are swift as thought, the showerers (of benefits), prostrators of the arrogant, the givers ofenjoyment to many, be ever near unto us, for our security, with many and prompt protections.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो अश्वावदश्विना वर्तिर्यासिष्टं मधुपातमा नरा । गोमद्दस्रा हिरण्यवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no aśvāvadaśvinā vartiryāsiṣṭaṃ madhupātamā narā | gomaddasrā hiraṇyavat ||

translations.english: Aśvins, of goodly aspect, leaders (of rites), deep drinkers of the Soma, come to our dwelling aboundingwith horses, with cattle, with gold.

mantras.sanskrit: सुप्रावर्गं सुवीर्यं सुष्ठु वार्यमनाधृष्टं रक्षस्विना । अस्मिन्ना वामायाने वाजिनीवसू विश्वा वामानि धीमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: suprāvargaṃ suvīryaṃ suṣṭhu vāryamanādhṛṣṭaṃ rakṣasvinā | asminnā vāmāyāne vājinīvasū viśvā vāmāni dhīmahi ||

translations.english: May we obtain from you (wealth) spontaneously bestowed, comprising excellent strength, such as isdesired by all, and unassailable by a powerful (foe); may we obtain from you who are rich in food, upon youcoming here, all good things.

mantras.sanskrit: ईळिष्वा हि प्रतीव्यं यजस्व जातवेदसम् । चरिष्णुधूममगृभीतशोचिषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: īḷiṣvā hi pratīvyaṃ yajasva jātavedasam | cariṣṇudhūmamagṛbhītaśociṣam ||

translations.english: Adore him who resists (our foes), worship Jātavedas the diffuser of smoke, of unobstructed radiance.

mantras.sanskrit: दामानं विश्वचर्षणेऽग्निं विश्वमनो गिरा । उत स्तुषे विष्पर्धसो रथानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dāmānaṃ viśvacarṣaṇe'gniṃ viśvamano girā | uta stuṣe viṣpardhaso rathānām ||

translations.english: Commend with praise, all-beholding Viśvamanas, that Agni, who is the giver of chariots to theunenvious (worshipper).

mantras.sanskrit: येषामाबाध ऋग्मिय इषः पृक्षश्च निग्रभे । उपविदा वह्निर्विन्दते वसु ॥
mantras.transliteration: yeṣāmābādha ṛgmiya iṣaḥ pṛkṣaśca nigrabhe | upavidā vahnirvindate vasu ||

translations.english: The repeller (of foes), the glorified by hyms, arrests the food and drink, and the bearer of oblationstakes away the wealth (of those) of whom he foreknows (the neglect of sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: उदस्य शोचिरस्थाद्दीदियुषो व्यजरम् । तपुर्जम्भस्य सुद्युतो गणश्रियः ॥
mantras.transliteration: udasya śocirasthāddīdiyuṣo vyajaram | tapurjambhasya sudyuto gaṇaśriyaḥ ||

translations.english: The imperishable lustre rises of that Agni, who is radiant, bright with blazing teech, resplendent, andglorious amid troops (of worshippers).

mantras.sanskrit: उदु तिष्ठ स्वध्वर स्तवानो देव्या कृपा । अभिख्या भासा बृहता शुशुक्वनिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: udu tiṣṭha svadhvara stavāno devyā kṛpā | abhikhyā bhāsā bṛhatā śuśukvaniḥ ||

translations.english: Rise up with celestial splendour, you who are radiant with great and present lustre, who are worthilyworshipped and glorified.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने याहि सुशस्तिभिर्हव्या जुह्वान आनुषक् । यथा दूतो बभूथ हव्यवाहनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne yāhi suśastibhirhavyā juhvāna ānuṣak | yathā dūto babhūtha havyavāhanaḥ ||

translations.english: Proceed, Agni, with pious praises, offering in due order the oblations (to the gods), for you are theirmessenger, the bearer of oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निं वः पूर्व्यं हुवे होतारं चर्षणीनाम् । तमया वाचा गृणे तमु वः स्तुषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniṃ vaḥ pūrvyaṃ huve hotāraṃ carṣaṇīnām | tamayā vācā gṛṇe tamu vaḥ stuṣe ||

translations.english: I invoke for you, (worshippers), Agni, the ancient ministrant priest of man, I praise him with this hymn, Iglorify him for you.

mantras.sanskrit: यज्ञेभिरद्भुतक्रतुं यं कृपा सूदयन्त इत् । मित्रं न जने सुधितमृतावनि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajñebhiradbhutakratuṃ yaṃ kṛpā sūdayanta it | mitraṃ na jane sudhitamṛtāvani ||

translations.english: (Worship him who is) of wondrous works, who, gladdened (by offerings), is present like a friend, whom(the priests) by their sacrifices, according to their power, render propitious to the worshipper.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतावानमृतायवो यज्ञस्य साधनं गिरा । उपो एनं जुजुषुर्नमसस्पदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtāvānamṛtāyavo yajñasya sādhanaṃ girā | upo enaṃ jujuṣurnamasaspade ||

translations.english: Pious worshippers, at the plural ce of offerings adore with praise him who is gratified by worship, thecompleter of the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: अच्छा नो अङ्गिरस्तमं यज्ञासो यन्तु संयतः । होता यो अस्ति विक्ष्वा यशस्तमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: acchā no aṅgirastamaṃ yajñāso yantu saṃyataḥ | hotā yo asti vikṣvā yaśastamaḥ ||

translations.english: Let our sacrificers, prepared (with their implements), present themselves before the chief of theAṅgirasas, who is the most renowned offerer of oblations among men.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने तव त्ये अजरेन्धानासो बृहद्भाः । अश्वा इव वृषणस्तविषीयवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne tava tye ajarendhānāso bṛhadbhāḥ | aśvā iva vṛṣaṇastaviṣīyavaḥ ||

translations.english: These your vast blazing flames, undecaying Agni, are most powerful, vigorous as horses.

mantras.sanskrit: स त्वं न ऊर्जां पते रयिं रास्व सुवीर्यम् । प्राव नस्तोके तनये समत्स्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa tvaṃ na ūrjāṃ pate rayiṃ rāsva suvīryam | prāva nastoke tanaye samatsvā ||

translations.english: Do you, who are the lord of food, give us riches, with male offspring; defend us, with our sons andgrandsons.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्वा उ विश्पतिः शितः सुप्रीतो मनुषो विशि । विश्वेदग्निः प्रति रक्षांसि सेधति ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadvā u viśpatiḥ śitaḥ suprīto manuṣo viśi | viśvedagniḥ prati rakṣāṃsi sedhati ||

translations.english: When Agni, the lord of man, sharpened (by sacrifice), and, well plural ased, is present in the abode of aman, he verily defends it against all evil spirits.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रुष्ट्यग्ने नवस्य मे स्तोमस्य वीर विश्पते । नि मायिनस्तपुषा रक्षसो दह ॥
mantras.transliteration: śruṣṭyagne navasya me stomasya vīra viśpate | ni māyinastapuṣā rakṣaso daha ||

translations.english: Hero, Agni, lord of men, hearing this my present praise, consume the guileful rākṣasas by yourflames.

mantras.sanskrit: न तस्य मायया चन रिपुरीशीत मर्त्यः । यो अग्नये ददाश हव्यदातिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: na tasya māyayā cana ripurīśīta martyaḥ | yo agnaye dadāśa havyadātibhiḥ ||

translations.english: No hostile mortal shall have power by fraud over him who by the (sacred) offerers of the oblationpresents (offerings) to Agni.

mantras.sanskrit: व्यश्वस्त्वा वसुविदमुक्षण्युरप्रीणादृषिः । महो राये तमु त्वा समिधीमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: vyaśvastvā vasuvidamukṣaṇyuraprīṇādṛṣiḥ | maho rāye tamu tvā samidhīmahi ||

translations.english: The ṛṣi Vyaśva, desirous (of propitiating) the showerer (of rain), has gratified you, the bestower ofwealth; so we too kindle you for (the acquisition of) ample riches.

mantras.sanskrit: उशना काव्यस्त्वा नि होतारमसादयत् । आयजिं त्वा मनवे जातवेदसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uśanā kāvyastvā ni hotāramasādayat | āyajiṃ tvā manave jātavedasam ||

translations.english: Uśanā, the son of Kavi, has established you, Jātavedas, as the ministrant priest, you as the offererof sacrifice, for Manu.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वे हि त्वा सजोषसो देवासो दूतमक्रत । श्रुष्टी देव प्रथमो यज्ञियो भुवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśve hi tvā sajoṣaso devāso dūtamakrata | śruṣṭī deva prathamo yajñiyo bhuvaḥ ||

translations.english: All the consentient gods have made you their messenger, may you, divine Agni, who are the first (of thedeities), quickly become the object of their worship.

mantras.sanskrit: इमं घा वीरो अमृतं दूतं कृण्वीत मर्त्यः । पावकं कृष्णवर्तनिं विहायसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: imaṃ ghā vīro amṛtaṃ dūtaṃ kṛṇvīta martyaḥ | pāvakaṃ kṛṣṇavartaniṃ vihāyasam ||

translations.english: The pious mortal has appointed this immortal, purifying, dark-moving, mighty (Agni), his messenger.

mantras.sanskrit: तं हुवेम यतस्रुचः सुभासं शुक्रशोचिषम् । विशामग्निमजरं प्रत्नमीड्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ huvema yatasrucaḥ subhāsaṃ śukraśociṣam | viśāmagnimajaraṃ pratnamīḍyam ||

translations.english: Let us with uplifted ladles invoke him, the brilliant, bright-shining, undecaying, ancient Agni, who is to beadored by men.

mantras.sanskrit: यो अस्मै हव्यदातिभिराहुतिं मर्तोऽविधत् । भूरि पोषं स धत्ते वीरवद्यशः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo asmai havyadātibhirāhutiṃ marto'vidhat | bhūri poṣaṃ sa dhatte vīravadyaśaḥ ||

translations.english: The man who by the (holy) presenters of oblations makes offerings to him, receives (from Agni) amplenourishment, with male progeny, and fame.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रथमं जातवेदसमग्निं यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यम् । प्रति स्रुगेति नमसा हविष्मती ॥
mantras.transliteration: prathamaṃ jātavedasamagniṃ yajñeṣu pūrvyam | prati srugeti namasā haviṣmatī ||

translations.english: The ladle charged with the oblation proceeds with reverence at sacrifices to the ancient Agni, the first(of the gods), the cognizant of all that exists.

mantras.sanskrit: आभिर्विधेमाग्नये ज्येष्ठाभिर्व्यश्ववत् । मंहिष्ठाभिर्मतिभिः शुक्रशोचिषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ābhirvidhemāgnaye jyeṣṭhābhirvyaśvavat | maṃhiṣṭhābhirmatibhiḥ śukraśociṣe ||

translations.english: Let us, like Vyaśva, glorify the brilliant Agni with these excellent and most pious praises.

mantras.sanskrit: नूनमर्च विहायसे स्तोमेभिः स्थूरयूपवत् । ऋषे वैयश्व दम्यायाग्नये ॥
mantras.transliteration: nūnamarca vihāyase stomebhiḥ sthūrayūpavat | ṛṣe vaiyaśva damyāyāgnaye ||

translations.english: Ṛṣi, son of Vyaśva, adore the far-spreading domestic Agni, with praises, like Sthūrayūpa.

mantras.sanskrit: अतिथिं मानुषाणां सूनुं वनस्पतीनाम् । विप्रा अग्निमवसे प्रत्नमीळते ॥
mantras.transliteration: atithiṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ sūnuṃ vanaspatīnām | viprā agnimavase pratnamīḷate ||

translations.english: Pious men glorify the ancient Agni, the guest of men, the son of the trees, for protection.

mantras.sanskrit: महो विश्वाँ अभि षतोऽभि हव्यानि मानुषा । अग्ने नि षत्सि नमसाधि बर्हिषि ॥
mantras.transliteration: maho viśvā~ abhi ṣato'bhi havyāni mānuṣā | agne ni ṣatsi namasādhi barhiṣi ||

translations.english: Sit down, Agni, on the sacred grass, in the presence of all those worshippers diligent (in pious works,induced) by their veneration (to accept) the oblations of men.

mantras.sanskrit: वंस्वा नो वार्या पुरु वंस्व रायः पुरुस्पृहः । सुवीर्यस्य प्रजावतो यशस्वतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vaṃsvā no vāryā puru vaṃsva rāyaḥ puruspṛhaḥ | suvīryasya prajāvato yaśasvataḥ ||

translations.english: Grant us (Agni) many desirable (things), grant us riches, envied by many, (comprehending) vigour,offspring, fame.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं वरो सुषाम्णेऽग्ने जनाय चोदय । सदा वसो रातिं यविष्ठ शश्वते ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ varo suṣāmṇe'gne janāya codaya | sadā vaso rātiṃ yaviṣṭha śaśvate ||

translations.english: Agni, (who are) the desired of all, the humbler (of foes), the youngest (of the gods), ever bestow richesupon the tranquil and constant man.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं हि सुप्रतूरसि त्वं नो गोमतीरिषः । महो रायः सातिमग्ने अपा वृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ hi supratūrasi tvaṃ no gomatīriṣaḥ | maho rāyaḥ sātimagne apā vṛdhi ||

translations.english: You verily are a liberal benefactor; bestow upon us, Agni, food, with cattle, and the gift of abundantriches.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने त्वं यशा अस्या मित्रावरुणा वह । ऋतावाना सम्राजा पूतदक्षसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne tvaṃ yaśā asyā mitrāvaruṇā vaha | ṛtāvānā samrājā pūtadakṣasā ||

translations.english: You, Agni, are renowned, bring hither the truthful, the purely vigorous, the resplendent deities Mitra andVaruṇa.

mantras.sanskrit: सखाय आ शिषामहि ब्रह्मेन्द्राय वज्रिणे । स्तुष ऊ षु वो नृतमाय धृष्णवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: sakhāya ā śiṣāmahi brahmendrāya vajriṇe | stuṣa ū ṣu vo nṛtamāya dhṛṣṇave ||

translations.english: Let us earnestly, friends, address our prayer to Indra, the wielder of the thunderbolt, for you I praise thechief leader (in battles), the resolute (opposer of foes).

mantras.sanskrit: शवसा ह्यसि श्रुतो वृत्रहत्येन वृत्रहा । मघैर्मघोनो अति शूर दाशसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: śavasā hyasi śruto vṛtrahatyena vṛtrahā | maghairmaghono ati śūra dāśasi ||

translations.english: You are renowned for strength; from the slaying of Vṛtra, you are (famed as) Vṛtrahan; you surpass,hero, the opulent in the donation of your riches.

mantras.sanskrit: स नः स्तवान आ भर रयिं चित्रश्रवस्तमम् । निरेके चिद्यो हरिवो वसुर्ददिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa naḥ stavāna ā bhara rayiṃ citraśravastamam | nireke cidyo harivo vasurdadiḥ ||

translations.english: Praised by us, bestow upon us riches of wonderful variety; you, the lord of steeds, who, at the issue (ofyour weapons) put your enemies to flight, are the donor (of treasures).

mantras.sanskrit: आ निरेकमुत प्रियमिन्द्र दर्षि जनानाम् । धृषता धृष्णो स्तवमान आ भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā nirekamuta priyamindra darṣi janānām | dhṛṣatā dhṛṣṇo stavamāna ā bhara ||

translations.english: Burst open to your worshippers, Indra, the highly prized wealth; glorified by us, do you who areendowed with resolution, bring (us wealth) with a resolute (mind).

mantras.sanskrit: न ते सव्यं न दक्षिणं हस्तं वरन्त आमुरः । न परिबाधो हरिवो गविष्टिषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: na te savyaṃ na dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ varanta āmuraḥ | na paribādho harivo gaviṣṭiṣu ||

translations.english: Lord of steeds, in the recovery of the cattle the opponents resist not your left hand nor your right, yourenemies (resist you) not.

mantras.sanskrit: आ त्वा गोभिरिव व्रजं गीर्भिॠणोम्यद्रिवः । आ स्मा कामं जरितुरा मनः पृण ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tvā gobhiriva vrajaṃ gīrbhiṝṇomyadrivaḥ | ā smā kāmaṃ jariturā manaḥ pṛṇa ||

translations.english: I approach you, thunderer, with praises, as (a cowherd goes) with cattle to the pasture; gratify thedesire, satisfy the mind of your adorer.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वानि विश्वमनसो धिया नो वृत्रहन्तम । उग्र प्रणेतरधि षू वसो गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvāni viśvamanaso dhiyā no vṛtrahantama | ugra praṇetaradhi ṣū vaso gahi ||

translations.english: Fierce destroyer of Vṛtra, bringer (of wealth to your worshippers), subduer of enemies, preside over all(the offerings) of us, Visvamanasa, with a (favourable) mind.

mantras.sanskrit: वयं ते अस्य वृत्रहन्विद्याम शूर नव्यसः । वसोः स्पार्हस्य पुरुहूत राधसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayaṃ te asya vṛtrahanvidyāma śūra navyasaḥ | vasoḥ spārhasya puruhūta rādhasaḥ ||

translations.english: May we, hero, slayer of Vṛtra, invoked of many become possessed of this your new, desirable, andhappiness producing wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र यथा ह्यस्ति तेऽपरीतं नृतो शवः । अमृक्ता रातिः पुरुहूत दाशुषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra yathā hyasti te'parītaṃ nṛto śavaḥ | amṛktā rātiḥ puruhūta dāśuṣe ||

translations.english: As, Indra, inspirer (of men), your strength is irresistible, (so) invoked of many, your munificence to thedonor (of oblations) cannot be marred.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वृषस्व महामह महे नृतम राधसे । दृळ्हश्चिद्दृह्य मघवन्मघत्तये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vṛṣasva mahāmaha mahe nṛtama rādhase | dṛḷhaściddṛhya maghavanmaghattaye ||

translations.english: Most adorable, chief leader (of men), invigorate (yourself with the Soma) for (the conquest of) greatwealth; consume, Maghavan, the strong (cities of the asuras) for the rich spoil.

mantras.sanskrit: नू अन्यत्रा चिदद्रिवस्त्वन्नो जग्मुराशसः । मघवञ्छग्धि तव तन्न ऊतिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū anyatrā cidadrivastvanno jagmurāśasaḥ | maghavañchagdhi tava tanna ūtibhiḥ ||

translations.english: Wielder of the thunderbolt, our solicitations have been formerly addressed to other gods, than you; giveus, Maghavan, of your (spoil and guard it) for us with (your) protections.

mantras.sanskrit: नह्यङ्ग नृतो त्वदन्यं विन्दामि राधसे । राये द्युम्नाय शवसे च गिर्वणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahyaṅga nṛto tvadanyaṃ vindāmi rādhase | rāye dyumnāya śavase ca girvaṇaḥ ||

translations.english: Verily, impeller (of men), who are to be worshipped by praise, I apply to no other than you forsustenance, riches, reputation, and strength.

mantras.sanskrit: एन्दुमिन्द्राय सिञ्चत पिबाति सोम्यं मधु । प्र राधसा चोदयाते महित्वना ॥
mantras.transliteration: endumindrāya siñcata pibāti somyaṃ madhu | pra rādhasā codayāte mahitvanā ||

translations.english: Effuse the Soma for Indra, let him quaff the Soma; he by his might rewards (the donor) with wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: उपो हरीणां पतिं दक्षं पृञ्चन्तमब्रवम् । नूनं श्रुधि स्तुवतो अश्व्यस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: upo harīṇāṃ patiṃ dakṣaṃ pṛñcantamabravam | nūnaṃ śrudhi stuvato aśvyasya ||

translations.english: Let me address the lord of steeds, who associates his strength (with the Maruts); now hear the words ofthe son of Vyaśva praising you.

mantras.sanskrit: नह्यङ्ग पुरा चन जज्ञे वीरतरस्त्वत् । नकी राया नैवथा न भन्दना ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahyaṅga purā cana jajñe vīratarastvat | nakī rāyā naivathā na bhandanā ||

translations.english: No one, Indra, has ever been born more mighty than you, no one (surpassing you) in riches; no one(more powerful) in protection; no one (more entitled) to praise.

mantras.sanskrit: एदु मध्वो मदिन्तरं सिञ्च वाध्वर्यो अन्धसः । एवा हि वीरः स्तवते सदावृधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: edu madhvo madintaraṃ siñca vādhvaryo andhasaḥ | evā hi vīraḥ stavate sadāvṛdhaḥ ||

translations.english: Pour out, priest, the most exhilarating (draught) of the sweet (sacrificial) Soma, for he, the ever-mightyhero, alone is praised.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र स्थातर्हरीणां नकिष्टे पूर्व्यस्तुतिम् । उदानंश शवसा न भन्दना ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra sthātarharīṇāṃ nakiṣṭe pūrvyastutim | udānaṃśa śavasā na bhandanā ||

translations.english: Indra, ruler of horses, no one surpasses your ancient praise, either for force or for fame.

mantras.sanskrit: तं वो वाजानां पतिमहूमहि श्रवस्यवः । अप्रायुभिर्यज्ञेभिर्वावृधेन्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ vo vājānāṃ patimahūmahi śravasyavaḥ | aprāyubhiryajñebhirvāvṛdhenyam ||

translations.english: Desirous of food, we invoke your lord of viands, who is to be magnified by sacrifices (offered) byattentive (worshipers).

mantras.sanskrit: एतो न्विन्द्रं स्तवाम सखायः स्तोम्यं नरम् । कृष्टीर्यो विश्वा अभ्यस्त्येक इत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eto nvindraṃ stavāma sakhāyaḥ stomyaṃ naram | kṛṣṭīryo viśvā abhyastyeka it ||

translations.english: Come, freinds, let us glorify Indra, the leader, who is entitled to praise, who, single, overcomes allhostile hosts.

mantras.sanskrit: अगोरुधाय गविषे द्युक्षाय दस्म्यं वचः । घृतात्स्वादीयो मधुनश्च वोचत ॥
mantras.transliteration: agorudhāya gaviṣe dyukṣāya dasmyaṃ vacaḥ | ghṛtātsvādīyo madhunaśca vocata ||

translations.english: Recite agreeable words, sweeter than clarified butter, or than Soma, to the illustrious (Indra), who isgratified by eulogy, who rejects not praise.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्यामितानि वीर्या न राधः पर्येतवे । ज्योतिर्न विश्वमभ्यस्ति दक्षिणा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasyāmitāni vīryā na rādhaḥ paryetave | jyotirna viśvamabhyasti dakṣiṇā ||

translations.english: Whose energies are unbounded, whose wealth cannot be carried away, whose bounty extends like thefirmament over all.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तुहीन्द्रं व्यश्ववदनूर्मिं वाजिनं यमम् । अर्यो गयं मंहमानं वि दाशुषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: stuhīndraṃ vyaśvavadanūrmiṃ vājinaṃ yamam | aryo gayaṃ maṃhamānaṃ vi dāśuṣe ||

translations.english: Glorify Indra, the unassailable, the powerful, the regulator (of man), as was done by Vyaśva, he, thelord, gives a spacious dwelling to the donor (of the oblation).

mantras.sanskrit: एवा नूनमुप स्तुहि वैयश्व दशमं नवम् । सुविद्वांसं चर्कृत्यं चरणीनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā nūnamupa stuhi vaiyaśva daśamaṃ navam | suvidvāṃsaṃ carkṛtyaṃ caraṇīnām ||

translations.english: Praise verily at present, son of Vyaśva, praise (Indra), who is the tenth of the pervading (vitalprinciples), the adorable, the all-wise to be honoured repeatedly (by sacred rites).

mantras.sanskrit: वेत्था हि निॠतीनां वज्रहस्त परिवृजम् । अहरहः शुन्ध्युः परिपदामिव ॥
mantras.transliteration: vetthā hi niṝtīnāṃ vajrahasta parivṛjam | aharahaḥ śundhyuḥ paripadāmiva ||

translations.english: You are cognizant, wielder of the thunderbolt, of the departure of evil beings, as the purifying sun dayby day (is of that) of the birds flying in all directions (from their roost).

mantras.sanskrit: तदिन्द्राव आ भर येना दंसिष्ठ कृत्वने । द्विता कुत्साय शिश्नथो नि चोदय ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadindrāva ā bhara yenā daṃsiṣṭha kṛtvane | dvitā kutsāya śiśnatho ni codaya ||

translations.english: Indra, of goodly aspect, bring to the offerer (of the oblation) that (protection) wherewith to defend himyou have twice slain (the goe) for Kutsa; show the same (care of us).

mantras.sanskrit: तमु त्वा नूनमीमहे नव्यं दंसिष्ठ सन्यसे । स त्वं नो विश्वा अभिमातीः सक्षणिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamu tvā nūnamīmahe navyaṃ daṃsiṣṭha sanyase | sa tvaṃ no viśvā abhimātīḥ sakṣaṇiḥ ||

translations.english: (Indra) of goodly aspect, we implore you who are entitled to praise, for (our) preservation; for you arethe overcomer of all our adversaries.

mantras.sanskrit: य ऋक्षादंहसो मुचद्यो वार्यात्सप्त सिन्धुषु । वधर्दासस्य तुविनृम्ण नीनमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya ṛkṣādaṃhaso mucadyo vāryātsapta sindhuṣu | vadhardāsasya tuvinṛmṇa nīnamaḥ ||

translations.english: (He it is) who rescues men from the wickedness of evil beings, who enriches (the dwellers) on theseven rivers; now hurl, you who abound in wealth, your weapon at the Dāsa.

mantras.sanskrit: यथा वरो सुषाम्णे सनिभ्य आवहो रयिम् । व्यश्वेभ्यः सुभगे वाजिनीवति ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathā varo suṣāmṇe sanibhya āvaho rayim | vyaśvebhyaḥ subhage vājinīvati ||

translations.english: As you, Varu, have distributed vast wealth to those who have solicited (riches) on behalf of Susāman,(so do you now distribute) to the descendants of Vyaśva; (and so too you), auspicious food-bestowing (Uṣas).

mantras.sanskrit: आ नार्यस्य दक्षिणा व्यश्वाँ एतु सोमिनः । स्थूरं च राधः शतवत्सहस्रवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā nāryasya dakṣiṇā vyaśvā~ etu sominaḥ | sthūraṃ ca rādhaḥ śatavatsahasravat ||

translations.english: May the gifts of a humane (price), when offering the Soma libation, extend to the Vyaśvas, yes, andsubstantial wealthy by hundreds and thousands.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्त्वा पृच्छादीजानः कुहया कुहयाकृते । एषो अपश्रितो वलो गोमतीमव तिष्ठति ॥
mantras.transliteration: yattvā pṛcchādījānaḥ kuhayā kuhayākṛte | eṣo apaśrito valo gomatīmava tiṣṭhati ||

translations.english: If any ask of you, (Uṣas), when anywhere present, where the sacrificer (Varu dwells), (reply) thepowerful (prince), the refuge of all, abides on (the banks of) the Gomatī river.

mantras.sanskrit: ता वां विश्वस्य गोपा देवा देवेषु यज्ञिया । ऋतावाना यजसे पूतदक्षसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā vāṃ viśvasya gopā devā deveṣu yajñiyā | ṛtāvānā yajase pūtadakṣasā ||

translations.english: You two are the protectors of the universe, divine and to be adored among the gods; therefore,(Viśvamanas), you sacrifice to the pair who are observant of truth and endowed with real power.

mantras.sanskrit: मित्रा तना न रथ्या वरुणो यश्च सुक्रतुः । सनात्सुजाता तनया धृतव्रता ॥
mantras.transliteration: mitrā tanā na rathyā varuṇo yaśca sukratuḥ | sanātsujātā tanayā dhṛtavratā ||

translations.english: Mitra and Varuṇa, doers of good deeds, (diffusers of) riches, who are the charioteers (of men),well-born of old, the sons, (of Aditi), observant of vows, (you are worshipped by me).

mantras.sanskrit: ता माता विश्ववेदसासुर्याय प्रमहसा । मही जजानादितिॠतावरी ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā mātā viśvavedasāsuryāya pramahasā | mahī jajānāditiṝtāvarī ||

translations.english: The great and truthful Aditi, the mother (of the gods), gave birth to those two who are possessed of allaffluence, and shining with great splendour, for the (destruction of the) asuras.

mantras.sanskrit: महान्ता मित्रावरुणा सम्राजा देवावसुरा । ऋतावानावृतमा घोषतो बृहत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahāntā mitrāvaruṇā samrājā devāvasurā | ṛtāvānāvṛtamā ghoṣato bṛhat ||

translations.english: The great Mitra and Varuṇa, the two sovereign and powerful deities, the observers of truth, illumine oursolemn rite.

mantras.sanskrit: नपाता शवसो महः सूनू दक्षस्य सुक्रतू । सृप्रदानू इषो वास्त्वधि क्षितः ॥
mantras.transliteration: napātā śavaso mahaḥ sūnū dakṣasya sukratū | sṛpradānū iṣo vāstvadhi kṣitaḥ ||

translations.english: Grandson sof mighty strength, son sof energy, doers of good deeds, liberal benefactors, they presideover the habitation of food.

mantras.sanskrit: सं या दानूनि येमथुर्दिव्याः पार्थिवीरिषः । नभस्वतीरा वां चरन्तु वृष्टयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ yā dānūni yemathurdivyāḥ pārthivīriṣaḥ | nabhasvatīrā vāṃ carantu vṛṣṭayaḥ ||

translations.english: Bestow (upon us) good gifts, viands, whether of heaven or earth; may the water-shedding rains attendupon you.

mantras.sanskrit: अधि या बृहतो दिवोऽभि यूथेव पश्यतः । ऋतावाना सम्राजा नमसे हिता ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhi yā bṛhato divo'bhi yūtheva paśyataḥ | ṛtāvānā samrājā namase hitā ||

translations.english: (These are they) who look upon the great deities as (a bull contemplates) the herd, sovereignsobservant of truth and propitious to adoration.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतावाना नि षेदतुः साम्राज्याय सुक्रतू । धृतव्रता क्षत्रिया क्षत्रमाशतुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtāvānā ni ṣedatuḥ sāmrājyāya sukratū | dhṛtavratā kṣatriyā kṣatramāśatuḥ ||

translations.english: Observers of truth, doers of good deeds, they sit down for the office of sovereignty; observant ofobligations, endowed with strength, they acquire vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: अक्ष्णश्चिद्गातुवित्तरानुल्बणेन चक्षसा । नि चिन्मिषन्ता निचिरा नि चिक्यतुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: akṣṇaścidgātuvittarānulbaṇena cakṣasā | ni cinmiṣantā nicirā ni cikyatuḥ ||

translations.english: Through knowers of the path, even before the eye (can see), causing (alll beings) to open their eyelids,existing from of old, and shining with a mild radiance, verily they have been worshipped.

mantras.sanskrit: उत नो देव्यदितिरुरुष्यतां नासत्या । उरुष्यन्तु मरुतो वृद्धशवसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta no devyaditiruruṣyatāṃ nāsatyā | uruṣyantu maruto vṛddhaśavasaḥ ||

translations.english: May the divine Aditi, may the Nāsatyās also protect us; may the rapid Maruts defend us.

mantras.sanskrit: ते नो नावमुरुष्यत दिवा नक्तं सुदानवः । अरिष्यन्तो नि पायुभिः सचेमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: te no nāvamuruṣyata divā naktaṃ sudānavaḥ | ariṣyanto ni pāyubhiḥ sacemahi ||

translations.english: Munificent and irresistible (Maruts), guard our vessel by day and night, so that we may be securethrough your protection.

mantras.sanskrit: अघ्नते विष्णवे वयमरिष्यन्तः सुदानवे । श्रुधि स्वयावन्त्सिन्धो पूर्वचित्तये ॥
mantras.transliteration: aghnate viṣṇave vayamariṣyantaḥ sudānave | śrudhi svayāvantsindho pūrvacittaye ||

translations.english: We, injured (through his protection, offer praise) to the liberal Viṣṇu, who harms not (his adorers); doyou who goes by thyself alone (to combat), and cause wealth to flow (to the worshipper), hear (our prayer) inbehalf of him who has commenced the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: तद्वार्यं वृणीमहे वरिष्ठं गोपयत्यम् । मित्रो यत्पान्ति वरुणो यदर्यमा ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadvāryaṃ vṛṇīmahe variṣṭhaṃ gopayatyam | mitro yatpānti varuṇo yadaryamā ||

translations.english: We solicit that ample, all-desired, all-guarding (wealth) which Mitra, Varuṇa and Aryaman hold undertheir protection.

mantras.sanskrit: उत नः सिन्धुरपां तन्मरुतस्तदश्विना । इन्द्रो विष्णुर्मीढ्वांसः सजोषसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta naḥ sindhurapāṃ tanmarutastadaśvinā | indro viṣṇurmīḍhvāṃsaḥ sajoṣasaḥ ||

translations.english: Yes, may he who causes the waters to flow (Parjanya), the Maruts, the Aśvins, Indra, Viṣṇu, may all(these deities) together, the showerers (of benefits, protect) that wealth for us.

mantras.sanskrit: ते हि ष्मा वनुषो नरोऽभिमातिं कयस्य चित् । तिग्मं न क्षोदः प्रतिघ्नन्ति भूर्णयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te hi ṣmā vanuṣo naro'bhimātiṃ kayasya cit | tigmaṃ na kṣodaḥ pratighnanti bhūrṇayaḥ ||

translations.english: Those desirable leaders (of men), rapid in movement, break down the haughtiness of any (foe)whatever, as an impetuous current (sweeps away all obstacles).

mantras.sanskrit: अयमेक इत्था पुरूरु चष्टे वि विश्पतिः । तस्य व्रतान्यनु वश्चरामसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayameka itthā purūru caṣṭe vi viśpatiḥ | tasya vratānyanu vaścarāmasi ||

translations.english: This one, the lord of man (Mitra), contemplates many vast things; we follow his rites for you.

mantras.sanskrit: अनु पूर्वाण्योक्या साम्राज्यस्य सश्चिम । मित्रस्य व्रता वरुणस्य दीर्घश्रुत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: anu pūrvāṇyokyā sāmrājyasya saścima | mitrasya vratā varuṇasya dīrghaśrut ||

translations.english: We observe the ancient rites of the imperial Varuṇa and the renowned Mitra, (rites) that are good for(our) dwelling.

mantras.sanskrit: परि यो रश्मिना दिवोऽन्तान्ममे पृथिव्याः । उभे आ पप्रौ रोदसी महित्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari yo raśminā divo'ntānmame pṛthivyāḥ | ubhe ā paprau rodasī mahitvā ||

translations.english: (Mitra is he) who has measured with his rays the limits of both heaven and earth; who has filled bothheaven and earth with his greatness.

mantras.sanskrit: उदु ष्य शरणे दिवो ज्योतिरयंस्त सूर्यः । अग्निर्न शुक्रः समिधान आहुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: udu ṣya śaraṇe divo jyotirayaṃsta sūryaḥ | agnirna śukraḥ samidhāna āhutaḥ ||

translations.english: He, Sūrya, has uplifted his radiance in the region of the heaven; kindled and invoked withburnt-offerings, he is bright, like Agni.

mantras.sanskrit: वचो दीर्घप्रसद्मनीशे वाजस्य गोमतः । ईशे हि पित्वोऽविषस्य दावने ॥
mantras.transliteration: vaco dīrghaprasadmanīśe vājasya gomataḥ | īśe hi pitvo'viṣasya dāvane ||

translations.english: Raise your voice in the spacious hall of sacrifice (to him) who is lord over food derived from cattle, whois able to grant nutritious sustenance.

mantras.sanskrit: तत्सूर्यं रोदसी उभे दोषा वस्तोरुप ब्रुवे । भोजेष्वस्माँ अभ्युच्चरा सदा ॥
mantras.transliteration: tatsūryaṃ rodasī ubhe doṣā vastorupa bruve | bhojeṣvasmā~ abhyuccarā sadā ||

translations.english: I glorify by night and day that sun (Mitra and Varuṇa) and both the heaven and earth; do you (Varuṇa)ever bring us to the presence of the bountiful.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋज्रमुक्षण्यायने रजतं हरयाणे । रथं युक्तमसनाम सुषामणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛjramukṣaṇyāyane rajataṃ harayāṇe | rathaṃ yuktamasanāma suṣāmaṇi ||

translations.english: We have received from the son of Suṣāman, the descendant of Ukṣan, the overcomer (of foes), awell-going chariot of silver, yoked (with a pair of horses).

mantras.sanskrit: ता मे अश्व्यानां हरीणां नितोशना । उतो नु कृत्व्यानां नृवाहसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā me aśvyānāṃ harīṇāṃ nitośanā | uto nu kṛtvyānāṃ nṛvāhasā ||

translations.english: Among bay horses these two are pre-eminently the destroyers (of foes), and of those eager in combat;the two strong bearers of men.

mantras.sanskrit: स्मदभीशू कशावन्ता विप्रा नविष्ठया मती । महो वाजिनावर्वन्ता सचासनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: smadabhīśū kaśāvantā viprā naviṣṭhayā matī | maho vājināvarvantā sacāsanam ||

translations.english: Through this new praise (of Mitra and Varuṇa) I have obtained at the same moment of the mightyprince, two fast-going sagacious steeds, with whip and reins.

mantras.sanskrit: युवोरु षू रथं हुवे सधस्तुत्याय सूरिषु । अतूर्तदक्षा वृषणा वृषण्वसू ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvoru ṣū rathaṃ huve sadhastutyāya sūriṣu | atūrtadakṣā vṛṣaṇā vṛṣaṇvasū ||

translations.english: (Aśvins) of irresistible strength, affluent showerers (of benefits), I invoke your chariot amid the pious,who are assembled to celebrate your presence.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं वरो सुषाम्णे महे तने नासत्या । अवोभिर्याथो वृषणा वृषण्वसू ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ varo suṣāmṇe mahe tane nāsatyā | avobhiryātho vṛṣaṇā vṛṣaṇvasū ||

translations.english: (Say), Varu (thus), Nāsatyās, senders of rain, affluent showerers (of benefits), as you came toSuṣāman with your protections to (grant him) great riches, (so come to me).

mantras.sanskrit: ता वामद्य हवामहे हव्येभिर्वाजिनीवसू । पूर्वीरिष इषयन्तावति क्षपः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā vāmadya havāmahe havyebhirvājinīvasū | pūrvīriṣa iṣayantāvati kṣapaḥ ||

translations.english: Affluent in nourishment, we invoke you, who are desirous of (sacrificial) food, on this occasion at dawnwith oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वां वाहिष्ठो अश्विना रथो यातु श्रुतो नरा । उप स्तोमान्तुरस्य दर्शथः श्रिये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāṃ vāhiṣṭho aśvinā ratho yātu śruto narā | upa stomānturasya darśathaḥ śriye ||

translations.english: Leaders (of rites), let your renowned all-conveying chariot come to us, and (do you) recognize thepraisers of the zealous (worshipper) for his prosperity.

mantras.sanskrit: जुहुराणा चिदश्विना मन्येथां वृषण्वसू । युवं हि रुद्रा पर्षथो अति द्विषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: juhurāṇā cidaśvinā manyethāṃ vṛṣaṇvasū | yuvaṃ hi rudrā parṣatho ati dviṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Aśvins, affluent showerers (of benefits), detect the guileful, verily, Rudras, vex your adversaries.

mantras.sanskrit: दस्रा हि विश्वमानुषङ्मक्षूभिः परिदीयथः । धियंजिन्वा मधुवर्णा शुभस्पती ॥
mantras.transliteration: dasrā hi viśvamānuṣaṅmakṣūbhiḥ paridīyathaḥ | dhiyaṃjinvā madhuvarṇā śubhaspatī ||

translations.english: Dasras, who are gratified by sacred rites, of fascinating complexion, lords of rain, pass with your fleet(horses) completely round our entier (sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: उप नो यातमश्विना राया विश्वपुषा सह । मघवाना सुवीरावनपच्युता ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa no yātamaśvinā rāyā viśvapuṣā saha | maghavānā suvīrāvanapacyutā ||

translations.english: Come to us, Aśvins, with all-supporting riches, for you are opulent, heroic, overthrown of none.

mantras.sanskrit: आ मे अस्य प्रतीव्यमिन्द्रनासत्या गतम् । देवा देवेभिरद्य सचनस्तमा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā me asya pratīvyamindranāsatyā gatam | devā devebhiradya sacanastamā ||

translations.english: Indra and Nāsatyās, who are most accessible, come to this my sacrifice; come, gods, today with(other) divinities.

mantras.sanskrit: वयं हि वां हवामह उक्षण्यन्तो व्यश्ववत् । सुमतिभिरुप विप्राविहा गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayaṃ hi vāṃ havāmaha ukṣaṇyanto vyaśvavat | sumatibhirupa viprāvihā gatam ||

translations.english: Desirous of you who are bestowers of wealth, we invoke you, as did (your father) Vyaśva; come,sagacious Aśvins, here with favourable intentions.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्विना स्वृषे स्तुहि कुवित्ते श्रवतो हवम् । नेदीयसः कूळयातः पणीँरुत ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvinā svṛṣe stuhi kuvitte śravato havam | nedīyasaḥ kūḷayātaḥ paṇī~ruta ||

translations.english: Praise the Aśvins devoutly, Ṛṣi, that they may repeatedly hear your invocation, and destroy thenearest (approaching enemies) and the Paṇis.

mantras.sanskrit: वैयश्वस्य श्रुतं नरोतो मे अस्य वेदथः । सजोषसा वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ॥
mantras.transliteration: vaiyaśvasya śrutaṃ naroto me asya vedathaḥ | sajoṣasā varuṇo mitro aryamā ||

translations.english: Hear, leaders (of rites), (the invocation) of me the son of Vyaśva, and understand its (purport), and mayVaruṇa, Mitra ans Aryaman concurrently (grant me wealth).

mantras.sanskrit: युवादत्तस्य धिष्ण्या युवानीतस्य सूरिभिः । अहरहर्वृषण मह्यं शिक्षतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvādattasya dhiṣṇyā yuvānītasya sūribhiḥ | aharaharvṛṣaṇa mahyaṃ śikṣatam ||

translations.english: Adorable showerers (of benefits), bestow daily upon me (some) of that (wealth) which is given by you,which is brought by you for the worshippers.

mantras.sanskrit: यो वां यज्ञेभिरावृतोऽधिवस्त्रा वधूरिव । सपर्यन्ता शुभे चक्राते अश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo vāṃ yajñebhirāvṛto'dhivastrā vadhūriva | saparyantā śubhe cakrāte aśvinā ||

translations.english: The man who is enveloped in sacrifices (offered) to you, like a woman with additional raiment,rewarding him, Aśvins, you plural ce him in prosperity.

mantras.sanskrit: यो वामुरुव्यचस्तमं चिकेतति नृपाय्यम् । वर्तिरश्विना परि यातमस्मयू ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo vāmuruvyacastamaṃ ciketati nṛpāyyam | vartiraśvinā pari yātamasmayū ||

translations.english: Favourably disposed towards me, come, Aśvins, to the dwelling of him who knows (how to prepare foryou) the most copiously effused (libation) to be drunk by the leaders (of rites).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मभ्यं सु वृषण्वसू यातं वर्तिर्नृपाय्यम् । विषुद्रुहेव यज्ञमूहथुर्गिरा ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmabhyaṃ su vṛṣaṇvasū yātaṃ vartirnṛpāyyam | viṣudruheva yajñamūhathurgirā ||

translations.english: Affluent showerers (of benefits), come to our dwelling for (the libation) to be drunk by the leaders (ofrites), for you bring the sacrifice to completion by praise, as the fatal shaft (slays the deer).

mantras.sanskrit: वाहिष्ठो वां हवानां स्तोमो दूतो हुवन्नरा । युवाभ्यां भूत्वश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāhiṣṭho vāṃ havānāṃ stomo dūto huvannarā | yuvābhyāṃ bhūtvaśvinā ||

translations.english: Aśvins, leaders (of rites), among (all) invocations may my most earnest praise invoke you as amessenger may it be (acceptable) to you.

mantras.sanskrit: यददो दिवो अर्णव इषो वा मदथो गृहे । श्रुतमिन्मे अमर्त्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadado divo arṇava iṣo vā madatho gṛhe | śrutaminme amartyā ||

translations.english: Whether, immortal (Aśvins), you rejoice in the water of the firmament, or in the dwelling of theworshipper hear this my (invocation).

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्या श्वेतयावरी वाहिष्ठा वां नदीनाम् । सिन्धुर्हिरण्यवर्तनिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta syā śvetayāvarī vāhiṣṭhā vāṃ nadīnām | sindhurhiraṇyavartaniḥ ||

translations.english: Verily this Śvetayāvarī, the golden-pathed river, is of all rivers the especial bearer of your (praises).

mantras.sanskrit: स्मदेतया सुकीर्त्याश्विना श्वेतया धिया । वहेथे शुभ्रयावाना ॥
mantras.transliteration: smadetayā sukīrtyāśvinā śvetayā dhiyā | vahethe śubhrayāvānā ||

translations.english: Aśvins, following a brilliant course, you acquire celebrity by the white river worthily praising you theenricher (of the peole on its banks).

mantras.sanskrit: युक्ष्वा हि त्वं रथासहा युवस्व पोष्या वसो । आन्नो वायो मधु पिबास्माकं सवना गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yukṣvā hi tvaṃ rathāsahā yuvasva poṣyā vaso | ānno vāyo madhu pibāsmākaṃ savanā gahi ||

translations.english: Yoke your chariot-drawing horses, Vāyu; bring them, Vasu, encouraged (to the sacrifice); then drinkour Soma, come to our daily libations.

mantras.sanskrit: तव वायवृतस्पते त्वष्टुर्जामातरद्भुत । अवांस्या वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava vāyavṛtaspate tvaṣṭurjāmātaradbhuta | avāṃsyā vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: We solicit your protection, Vāyu, lord of sacrifice wonderful son-in- law of Tvaṣṭā.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वष्टुर्जामातरं वयमीशानं राय ईमहे । सुतावन्तो वायुं द्युम्ना जनासः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṣṭurjāmātaraṃ vayamīśānaṃ rāya īmahe | sutāvanto vāyuṃ dyumnā janāsaḥ ||

translations.english: We, the offerers of Soma, solicit riches from the sovereign, the son- in-law of Tvaṣṭā; (may webecome) wealthy.

mantras.sanskrit: वायो याहि शिवा दिवो वहस्वा सु स्वश्व्यम् । वहस्व महः पृथुपक्षसा रथे ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāyo yāhi śivā divo vahasvā su svaśvyam | vahasva mahaḥ pṛthupakṣasā rathe ||

translations.english: Establish, Vāyu, happiness in heaven; bear quickly your well-horsed (chariot); do you, who are mighty,yoke the broad-flanked (horses) to the car.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वां हि सुप्सरस्तमं नृषदनेषु हूमहे । ग्रावाणं नाश्वपृष्ठं मंहना ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāṃ hi supsarastamaṃ nṛṣadaneṣu hūmahe | grāvāṇaṃ nāśvapṛṣṭhaṃ maṃhanā ||

translations.english: We invoke you who are of graceful form, extending through your magnitude your limbs in all directions,to our religious rites, like the stone (for bruising the Soma).

mantras.sanskrit: स त्वं नो देव मनसा वायो मन्दानो अग्रियः । कृधि वाजाँ अपो धियः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa tvaṃ no deva manasā vāyo mandāno agriyaḥ | kṛdhi vājā~ apo dhiyaḥ ||

translations.english: Divine Vāyu, foremost (of the gods), exulting in your won mind, cause our rites to be productive of foodand water.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निरुक्थे पुरोहितो ग्रावाणो बर्हिरध्वरे । ऋचा यामि मरुतो ब्रह्मणस्पतिं देवाँ अवो वरेण्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirukthe purohito grāvāṇo barhiradhvare | ṛcā yāmi maruto brahmaṇaspatiṃ devā~ avo vareṇyam ||

translations.english: Agni is the Purohita at the sacrifice; the stones, the sacred grass (are prepared) for the ceremony. Iinvoke with the holy verse the Maruts, Brahmaṇaspati, and all the gods, for their desirable protection.

mantras.sanskrit: आ पशुं गासि पृथिवीं वनस्पतीनुषासा नक्तमोषधीः । विश्वे च नो वसवो विश्ववेदसो धीनां भूत प्रावितारः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā paśuṃ gāsi pṛthivīṃ vanaspatīnuṣāsā naktamoṣadhīḥ | viśve ca no vasavo viśvavedaso dhīnāṃ bhūta prāvitāraḥ ||

translations.english: You come (Agni) to the victim, to the dwelling (of the worshipper), to the touchwood, to the Soma, atdawn and at night; universal deities, givers of wealth, knowing all things, be the defenders of our pious actṣ

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सू न एत्वध्वरोऽग्ना देवेषु पूर्व्यः । आदित्येषु प्र वरुणे धृतव्रते मरुत्सु विश्वभानुषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra sū na etvadhvaro'gnā deveṣu pūrvyaḥ | ādityeṣu pra varuṇe dhṛtavrate marutsu viśvabhānuṣu ||

translations.english: Let the ancient sacrifice proceed first to Agni, then to the gods, -- to the Ādityas, to Varuṇa, observantof obligations, to the all-resplendent Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वे हि ष्मा मनवे विश्ववेदसो भुवन्वृधे रिशादसः । अरिष्टेभिः पायुभिर्विश्ववेदसो यन्ता नोऽवृकं छर्दिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśve hi ṣmā manave viśvavedaso bhuvanvṛdhe riśādasaḥ | ariṣṭebhiḥ pāyubhirviśvavedaso yantā no'vṛkaṃ chardiḥ ||

translations.english: May the universal deities, possessors of all opulence, destroyers of foes, be (near) to Manu for hisprosperity; do you, who know all things, secure to us an abode safe from robbers through unassailableprotections.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो अद्य समनसो गन्ता विश्वे सजोषसः । ऋचा गिरा मरुतो देव्यदिते सदने पस्त्ये महि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no adya samanaso gantā viśve sajoṣasaḥ | ṛcā girā maruto devyadite sadane pastye mahi ||

translations.english: Universal deities, united together and of one mind, come this day to us, (attracted) by the sacred praiseaddressed to you; and do you, Maruts, and the mighty goddess Aditi, (come) to the dwelling, (our) abode.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि प्रिया मरुतो या वो अश्व्या हव्या मित्र प्रयाथन । आ बर्हिरिन्द्रो वरुणस्तुरा नर आदित्यासः सदन्तु नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi priyā maruto yā vo aśvyā havyā mitra prayāthana | ā barhirindro varuṇasturā nara ādityāsaḥ sadantu naḥ ||

translations.english: Direct, Maruts, your beloved horses (to our rite); Mitra, (come to our) oblations; and may Indra, andVaruṇa, and the swift leaders, the Ādityas, sit down on our sacred grass.

mantras.sanskrit: वयं वो वृक्तबर्हिषो हितप्रयस आनुषक् । सुतसोमासो वरुण हवामहे मनुष्वदिद्धाग्नयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayaṃ vo vṛktabarhiṣo hitaprayasa ānuṣak | sutasomāso varuṇa havāmahe manuṣvadiddhāgnayaḥ ||

translations.english: Bearing the clipped sacred grass, offering in due order the (sacrificial) food, presenting the effusedSoma, and having the fires kindled, we invoke you, Varuṇa, (and the rest), as did Manus.

mantras.sanskrit: आ प्र यात मरुतो विष्णो अश्विना पूषन्माकीनया धिया । इन्द्र आ यातु प्रथमः सनिष्युभिर्वृषा यो वृत्रहा गृणे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā pra yāta maruto viṣṇo aśvinā pūṣanmākīnayā dhiyā | indra ā yātu prathamaḥ saniṣyubhirvṛṣā yo vṛtrahā gṛṇe ||

translations.english: Maruts, Viṣṇu, Aśvins, Pūṣan, come here (induced) by my praise; may Indra, the first (of the gods),also come, the showerer (of benefits), he who is praised by (his) worshippers as the slayer of Vṛtra.

mantras.sanskrit: वि नो देवासो अद्रुहोऽच्छिद्रं शर्म यच्छत । न यद्दूराद्वसवो नू चिदन्तितो वरूथमादधर्षति ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi no devāso adruho'cchidraṃ śarma yacchata | na yaddūrādvasavo nū cidantito varūthamādadharṣati ||

translations.english: Unoppressive deities, bestow upon us a mansion without defect, so that, subduers (of foes), no onemay injure our defences, whether from afar or near.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्ति हि वः सजात्यं रिशादसो देवासो अस्त्याप्यम् । प्र णः पूर्वस्मै सुविताय वोचत मक्षू सुम्नाय नव्यसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: asti hi vaḥ sajātyaṃ riśādaso devāso astyāpyam | pra ṇaḥ pūrvasmai suvitāya vocata makṣū sumnāya navyase ||

translations.english: There is identity of race among you, deities, destroyers of foes; there is kindred (with me yourworshipper); therefore, utter at once the command for our former prosperity and for new happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: इदा हि व उपस्तुतिमिदा वामस्य भक्तये । उप वो विश्ववेदसो नमस्युराँ असृक्ष्यन्यामिव ॥
mantras.transliteration: idā hi va upastutimidā vāmasya bhaktaye | upa vo viśvavedaso namasyurā~ asṛkṣyanyāmiva ||

translations.english: Deities, possessed of all wealth, I, desirous of offering worship, address to you verily unprecedentedpraise, for the sake of obtaining desired affluence.

mantras.sanskrit: उदु ष्य वः सविता सुप्रणीतयोऽस्थादूर्ध्वो वरेण्यः । नि द्विपादश्चतुष्पादो अर्थिनोऽविश्रन्पतयिष्णवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: udu ṣya vaḥ savitā supraṇītayo'sthādūrdhvo vareṇyaḥ | ni dvipādaścatuṣpādo arthino'viśranpatayiṣṇavaḥ ||

translations.english: Devoutly praised (Maruts), when the adorable Savitā has risen above you, then bipeds andquadrupeds, and the flying birds, seeking (their objects), enter (upon their functions).

mantras.sanskrit: देवंदेवं वोऽवसे देवंदेवमभिष्टये । देवंदेवं हुवेम वाजसातये गृणन्तो देव्या धिया ॥
mantras.transliteration: devaṃdevaṃ vo'vase devaṃdevamabhiṣṭaye | devaṃdevaṃ huvema vājasātaye gṛṇanto devyā dhiyā ||

translations.english: We would invoke each deity among you (gods) for protection, each deity for the attainment of ourdesires, each deity for the acquisition of food, glorifying you with divine praise.

mantras.sanskrit: देवासो हि ष्मा मनवे समन्यवो विश्वे साकं सरातयः । ते नो अद्य ते अपरं तुचे तु नो भवन्तु वरिवोविदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: devāso hi ṣmā manave samanyavo viśve sākaṃ sarātayaḥ | te no adya te aparaṃ tuce tu no bhavantu varivovidaḥ ||

translations.english: May the universal gods with one consent be together the givers (of riches) to Manu; may they, bothtoday and hereafter, be the bestowers of wealth upon us and upon our posterity.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वः शंसाम्यद्रुहः संस्थ उपस्तुतीनाम् । न तं धूर्तिर्वरुण मित्र मर्त्यं यो वो धामभ्योऽविधत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vaḥ śaṃsāmyadruhaḥ saṃstha upastutīnām | na taṃ dhūrtirvaruṇa mitra martyaṃ yo vo dhāmabhyo'vidhat ||

translations.english: I glorify you, inoxious deities, in the plural ce of praises; no harm befalls the man who, Mitra and Varuṇa,offers (oblations) to your glories.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र स क्षयं तिरते वि महीरिषो यो वो वराय दाशति । प्र प्रजाभिर्जायते धर्मणस्पर्यरिष्टः सर्व एधते ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra sa kṣayaṃ tirate vi mahīriṣo yo vo varāya dāśati | pra prajābhirjāyate dharmaṇasparyariṣṭaḥ sarva edhate ||

translations.english: He enlarges his dweling, he has abundant food who offers you (oblations) to obtain a blessing; throughhis pious acts he is born on every side in his children; all prosper (through your favour) unharmed (by enemies).

mantras.sanskrit: ऋते स विन्दते युधः सुगेभिर्यात्यध्वनः । अर्यमा मित्रो वरुणः सरातयो यं त्रायन्ते सजोषसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛte sa vindate yudhaḥ sugebhiryātyadhvanaḥ | aryamā mitro varuṇaḥ sarātayo yaṃ trāyante sajoṣasaḥ ||

translations.english: He gains (wealth) without war, he travels along the roads with quick (horses), whom Aryaman, Mitraand Varuṇa, alike munificent, and acting in concert, protect.

mantras.sanskrit: अज्रे चिदस्मै कृणुथा न्यञ्चनं दुर्गे चिदा सुसरणम् । एषा चिदस्मादशनिः परो नु सास्रेधन्ती वि नश्यतु ॥
mantras.transliteration: ajre cidasmai kṛṇuthā nyañcanaṃ durge cidā susaraṇam | eṣā cidasmādaśaniḥ paro nu sāsredhantī vi naśyatu ||

translations.english: You enable him (Manu) to proceed by an unobstructed road; you grant him easy access to difficultpasses; may the weapon (of the foe) be far from him, and, inflicting no injury, perish.

mantras.sanskrit: यदद्य सूर्य उद्यति प्रियक्षत्रा ऋतं दध । यन्निम्रुचि प्रबुधि विश्ववेदसो यद्वा मध्यंदिने दिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadadya sūrya udyati priyakṣatrā ṛtaṃ dadha | yannimruci prabudhi viśvavedaso yadvā madhyaṃdine divaḥ ||

translations.english: Divinities of benevolent vigour, since you preside over the rite today, at the rising of the sun, since,possessors of all wealth, (you are present) at his setting, or at his waking, or at the meridian of the day.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्वाभिपित्वे असुरा ऋतं यते छर्दिर्येम वि दाशुषे । वयं तद्वो वसवो विश्ववेदस उप स्थेयाम मध्य आ ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadvābhipitve asurā ṛtaṃ yate chardiryema vi dāśuṣe | vayaṃ tadvo vasavo viśvavedasa upa stheyāma madhya ā ||

translations.english: Or since all-wise deities, you accept the sacrifice, bestowing on the zealous donor (of the oblation) aswelling (such as we may worship in) then, possessors of all wealth, distributors of riches, may we worshp you inthe midst (of that dwelling).

mantras.sanskrit: यदद्य सूर उदिते यन्मध्यंदिन आतुचि । वामं धत्थ मनवे विश्ववेदसो जुह्वानाय प्रचेतसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadadya sūra udite yanmadhyaṃdina ātuci | vāmaṃ dhattha manave viśvavedaso juhvānāya pracetase ||

translations.english: (Gods), who are possessed of all wealth, bestow the desired (opulence) upon the intelligent Manu,offering oblations to you at sunrise, mid-day and sunset.

mantras.sanskrit: वयं तद्वः सम्राज आ वृणीमहे पुत्रो न बहुपाय्यम् । अश्याम तदादित्या जुह्वतो हविर्येन वस्योऽनशामहै ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayaṃ tadvaḥ samrāja ā vṛṇīmahe putro na bahupāyyam | aśyāma tadādityā juhvato haviryena vasyo'naśāmahai ||

translations.english: We solicit of you, resplendent deities, as a son (of a father), that which is to be enjoyed by many;offering oblations, may we obtain that (wealth), Ādityas, by which we may possess abundance.

mantras.sanskrit: ये त्रिंशति त्रयस्परो देवासो बर्हिरासदन् । विदन्नह द्वितासनन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye triṃśati trayasparo devāso barhirāsadan | vidannaha dvitāsanan ||

translations.english: May the three-and-thirty divinities sit down upon the sacred grass; may they accept (our offerings), andbestow upon us both (sorts of wealth).

mantras.sanskrit: वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा स्मद्रातिषाचो अग्नयः । पत्नीवन्तो वषट्कृताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: varuṇo mitro aryamā smadrātiṣāco agnayaḥ | patnīvanto vaṣaṭkṛtāḥ ||

translations.english: May Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman and the Agnis, with their wives, honouring the donors (of the oblation),and addressed with the sacrificial exclamation.

mantras.sanskrit: ते नो गोपा अपाच्यास्त उदक्त इत्था न्यक् । पुरस्तात्सर्वया विशा ॥
mantras.transliteration: te no gopā apācyāsta udakta itthā nyak | purastātsarvayā viśā ||

translations.english: Be our protectors, whether coming with all their attendants from the west, from the north, from thesouth, from the east.

mantras.sanskrit: यथा वशन्ति देवास्तथेदसत्तदेषां नकिरा मिनत् । अरावा चन मर्त्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathā vaśanti devāstathedasattadeṣāṃ nakirā minat | arāvā cana martyaḥ ||

translations.english: Whatever the gods desire, that assuredly comes to pass; no one can resist their (will), no mortalwithholds (their) offerings.

mantras.sanskrit: सप्तानां सप्त ऋष्टयः सप्त द्युम्नान्येषाम् । सप्तो अधि श्रियो धिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: saptānāṃ sapta ṛṣṭayaḥ sapta dyumnānyeṣām | sapto adhi śriyo dhire ||

translations.english: Seven are he lances of the seven (troops of the Maruts), seven are their ornaments, they wear sevensurpassing glories.

mantras.sanskrit: बभ्रुरेको विषुणः सूनरो युवाञ्ज्यङ्क्ते हिरण्ययम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: babhrureko viṣuṇaḥ sūnaro yuvāñjyaṅkte hiraṇyayam ||

translations.english: One (Soma) brown of hue, all-pervading, leader of the nights, ever young, decorates (himself) withgolden ornament.

mantras.sanskrit: योनिमेक आ ससाद द्योतनोऽन्तर्देवेषु मेधिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yonimeka ā sasāda dyotano'ntardeveṣu medhiraḥ ||

translations.english: One (Agni) intelligent, resplended among the gods, is seated in his plural ce (the altar).

mantras.sanskrit: वाशीमेको बिभर्ति हस्त आयसीमन्तर्देवेषु निध्रुविः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāśīmeko bibharti hasta āyasīmantardeveṣu nidhruviḥ ||

translations.english: One (Tvaṣṭā) immoveably stationed among the gods, holds his metal axe in his hand.

mantras.sanskrit: वज्रमेको बिभर्ति हस्त आहितं तेन वृत्राणि जिघ्नते ॥
mantras.transliteration: vajrameko bibharti hasta āhitaṃ tena vṛtrāṇi jighnate ||

translations.english: One (Indra) holds his thunderbol wielded in his hand, by which he slays the Vṛtras.

mantras.sanskrit: तिग्ममेको बिभर्ति हस्त आयुधं शुचिरुग्रो जलाषभेषजः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tigmameko bibharti hasta āyudhaṃ śucirugro jalāṣabheṣajaḥ ||

translations.english: One (Rudra) brilliant and fierce, (yet) the distributor of healing medicines, holds his sharp weapon in hishand.

mantras.sanskrit: पथ एकः पीपाय तस्करो यथाँ एष वेद निधीनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: patha ekaḥ pīpāya taskaro yathā~ eṣa veda nidhīnām ||

translations.english: One (Pūṣan) watches the roads like a robber, and is cognizant of hidden treasures.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रीण्येक उरुगायो वि चक्रमे यत्र देवासो मदन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: trīṇyeka urugāyo vi cakrame yatra devāso madanti ||

translations.english: One (Viṣṇu) wide-stepping, has traversed the three worlds where the gods rejoice.

mantras.sanskrit: विभिर्द्वा चरत एकया सह प्र प्रवासेव वसतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vibhirdvā carata ekayā saha pra pravāseva vasataḥ ||

translations.english: Two (the Aśvins), travel with swift (horses) along with one (bride Sūrya), like travellers to foreigncountries.

mantras.sanskrit: सदो द्वा चक्राते उपमा दिवि सम्राजा सर्पिरासुती ॥
mantras.transliteration: sado dvā cakrāte upamā divi samrājā sarpirāsutī ||

translations.english: Two of like beauty and of royal rank (Mitra and Varuṇa), worshipped with oblations of clarified butter,have taken their seat in heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्चन्त एके महि साम मन्वत तेन सूर्यमरोचयन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: arcanta eke mahi sāma manvata tena sūryamarocayan ||

translations.english: Some (the Atris) when worshipping, call to mind the great Sāman, wherewith they light up the suṇ

mantras.sanskrit: नहि वो अस्त्यर्भको देवासो न कुमारकः । विश्वे सतोमहान्त इत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahi vo astyarbhako devāso na kumārakaḥ | viśve satomahānta it ||

translations.english: There is no one among you, gods, who is an infant or a youth; you verily are all of mature existence.

mantras.sanskrit: इति स्तुतासो असथा रिशादसो ये स्थ त्रयश्च त्रिंशच्च । मनोर्देवा यज्ञियासः ॥
mantras.transliteration: iti stutāso asathā riśādaso ye stha trayaśca triṃśacca | manordevā yajñiyāsaḥ ||

translations.english: Destroyers of foes, gods, adored by Manu, who are three-and-thirty, and are thus hymned.

mantras.sanskrit: ते नस्त्राध्वं तेऽवत त उ नो अधि वोचत । मा नः पथः पित्र्यान्मानवादधि दूरं नैष्ट परावतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te nastrādhvaṃ te'vata ta u no adhi vocata | mā naḥ pathaḥ pitryānmānavādadhi dūraṃ naiṣṭa parāvataḥ ||
