translations.english: Do you preserve us, do you protect us, do you direct us (to our good); lead us not afar from the paternalpaths of Manu, nor from those still more distant.

mantras.sanskrit: ये देवास इह स्थन विश्वे वैश्वानरा उत । अस्मभ्यं शर्म सप्रथो गवेऽश्वाय यच्छत ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye devāsa iha sthana viśve vaiśvānarā uta | asmabhyaṃ śarma sapratho gave'śvāya yacchata ||

translations.english: Gods, who are here present, all to whom this full sacrifice is offered, bestow upon us, upon our cattleand horses, happiness far renowned.

mantras.sanskrit: यो यजाति यजात इत्सुनवच्च पचाति च । ब्रह्मेदिन्द्रस्य चाकनत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo yajāti yajāta itsunavacca pacāti ca | brahmedindrasya cākanat ||

translations.english: He who offers oblations (to the gods, again) offers them; he pours forth libations and presents (thesacred cake), he delights in reiterating the praise verily of Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: पुरोळाशं यो अस्मै सोमं ररत आशिरम् । पादित्तं शक्रो अंहसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: puroḷāśaṃ yo asmai somaṃ rarata āśiram | pādittaṃ śakro aṃhasaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra protects from sin that man who offers him cakes and presents Soma mixed with milk.

mantras.sanskrit: तस्य द्युमाँ असद्रथो देवजूतः स शूशुवत् । विश्वा वन्वन्नमित्रिया ॥
mantras.transliteration: tasya dyumā~ asadratho devajūtaḥ sa śūśuvat | viśvā vanvannamitriyā ||

translations.english: A brilliant chariot comes to him, sent by the gods, with which, baffling all hostilities, he prospers.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य प्रजावती गृहेऽसश्चन्ती दिवेदिवे । इळा धेनुमती दुहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya prajāvatī gṛhe'saścantī divedive | iḷā dhenumatī duhe ||

translations.english: In his house perpetual abundance, accompanied by progeny, (is present), and kine are milked day byday.

mantras.sanskrit: या दम्पती समनसा सुनुत आ च धावतः । देवासो नित्ययाशिरा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā dampatī samanasā sunuta ā ca dhāvataḥ | devāso nityayāśirā ||

translations.english: Gods, may the husband and wife, who with one mind offer libations and purify them, and (propitiateyou) with the Soma ever mixed with milk.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रति प्राशव्याँ इतः सम्यञ्चा बर्हिराशाते । न ता वाजेषु वायतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prati prāśavyā~ itaḥ samyañcā barhirāśāte | na tā vājeṣu vāyataḥ ||

translations.english: Constantly associated, may they acquire appropriate (sacrificial) viands; may they be able to offersacrifice; may the never be wanting in food (given by the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: न देवानामपि ह्नुतः सुमतिं न जुगुक्षतः । श्रवो बृहद्विवासतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: na devānāmapi hnutaḥ sumatiṃ na jugukṣataḥ | śravo bṛhadvivāsataḥ ||

translations.english: They retract not (their promises) to the gods, they withhold not your praise, but offer abundant(sacrificial) food.

mantras.sanskrit: पुत्रिणा ता कुमारिणा विश्वमायुर्व्यश्नुतः । उभा हिरण्यपेशसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: putriṇā tā kumāriṇā viśvamāyurvyaśnutaḥ | ubhā hiraṇyapeśasā ||

translations.english: Blessed with youthful and adolescent offsprin, and both having their person ns richly ornamented, theypass (happily) their whole life.

mantras.sanskrit: वीतिहोत्रा कृतद्वसू दशस्यन्तामृताय कम् । समूधो रोमशं हतो देवेषु कृणुतो दुवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vītihotrā kṛtadvasū daśasyantāmṛtāya kam | samūdho romaśaṃ hato deveṣu kṛṇuto duvaḥ ||

translations.english: Offering acceptable sacrifices, obtaining the wealth they solicit, presenting gratifying (oblations to thegods), for the sake of immortality enjoying person nal union, they (wife and husband) worship the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: आ शर्म पर्वतानां वृणीमहे नदीनाम् । आ विष्णोः सचाभुवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā śarma parvatānāṃ vṛṇīmahe nadīnām | ā viṣṇoḥ sacābhuvaḥ ||

translations.english: We solicit the happiness (afforded) by the mountains, the rivers, and Viṣṇu, associated (with thegods).

mantras.sanskrit: ऐतु पूषा रयिर्भगः स्वस्ति सर्वधातमः । उरुरध्वा स्वस्तये ॥
mantras.transliteration: aitu pūṣā rayirbhagaḥ svasti sarvadhātamaḥ | ururadhvā svastaye ||

translations.english: May the adorable Pūṣan, the possessor of opulence, the most benevolent patron to all, comeauspiciously; may a wide path (be open) for our prosperity.

mantras.sanskrit: अरमतिरनर्वणो विश्वो देवस्य मनसा । आदित्यानामनेह इत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: aramatiranarvaṇo viśvo devasya manasā | ādityānāmaneha it ||

translations.english: All men with (devout) minds are the unwearied (praisers) of the irresistible deity (Pūṣan), verily the(most) sinless of the Ādityas.

mantras.sanskrit: यथा नो मित्रो अर्यमा वरुणः सन्ति गोपाः । सुगा ऋतस्य पन्थाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathā no mitro aryamā varuṇaḥ santi gopāḥ | sugā ṛtasya panthāḥ ||

translations.english: Since Mitra, Aryaman and Varuṇa are our protectors, may the paths of the sacrifice be easily traversed(by them).

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निं वः पूर्व्यं गिरा देवमीळे वसूनाम् । सपर्यन्तः पुरुप्रियं मित्रं न क्षेत्रसाधसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniṃ vaḥ pūrvyaṃ girā devamīḷe vasūnām | saparyantaḥ purupriyaṃ mitraṃ na kṣetrasādhasam ||

translations.english: I worship the divine Agni, the preceder of you, (gods), with praise, (for the sake) of riches; theworshippers (cherish him), the bountiful perfector of the sacrifice, like a friend.

mantras.sanskrit: मक्षू देववतो रथः शूरो वा पृत्सु कासु चित् । देवानां य इन्मनो यजमान इयक्षत्यभीदयज्वनो भुवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: makṣū devavato rathaḥ śūro vā pṛtsu kāsu cit | devānāṃ ya inmano yajamāna iyakṣatyabhīdayajvano bhuvat ||

translations.english: The chariot of the devout worshipper quickly (prevails), as the hero (prevails) in all combats whatever;the celebrator of the sacrifice, who desires to propitiate the mind of the gods, overcomes those who are nosacrificers.

mantras.sanskrit: न यजमान रिष्यसि न सुन्वान न देवयो । देवानां य इन्मनो यजमान इयक्षत्यभीदयज्वनो भुवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: na yajamāna riṣyasi na sunvāna na devayo | devānāṃ ya inmano yajamāna iyakṣatyabhīdayajvano bhuvat ||

translations.english: Devoted to the gods, pouring out to them libations, you, worshipper, shall not perish; the celebrator ofthe sacrifice, who desires to propitiate the mind of the gods, overcomes those who are no sacrificers.

mantras.sanskrit: नकिष्टं कर्मणा नशन्न प्र योषन्न योषति । देवानां य इन्मनो यजमान इयक्षत्यभीदयज्वनो भुवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nakiṣṭaṃ karmaṇā naśanna pra yoṣanna yoṣati | devānāṃ ya inmano yajamāna iyakṣatyabhīdayajvano bhuvat ||

translations.english: No one obstructs him by his acts, he is never driven (from his station), he is never separated (from hisfamily); the celebrator of the sacrifice, who desires to propitiate the mind of the gods, overcomes those who areno sacrificers.

mantras.sanskrit: असदत्र सुवीर्यमुत त्यदाश्वश्व्यम् । देवानां य इन्मनो यजमान इयक्षत्यभीदयज्वनो भुवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asadatra suvīryamuta tyadāśvaśvyam | devānāṃ ya inmano yajamāna iyakṣatyabhīdayajvano bhuvat ||

translations.english: To him in this life is a valiant progeny, to him are swift herds of horses; the celebrator of the sacrifice,who desires to propitiate the mind of the gods, overcomes those who are no sacrificers.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र कृतान्यृजीषिणः कण्वा इन्द्रस्य गाथया । मदे सोमस्य वोचत ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra kṛtānyṛjīṣiṇaḥ kaṇvā indrasya gāthayā | made somasya vocata ||

translations.english: Celebrate with songs the great deeds of Indra, the drinker of the stale Soma, when in his exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: यः सृबिन्दमनर्शनिं पिप्रुं दासमहीशुवम् । वधीदुग्रो रिणन्नपः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ sṛbindamanarśaniṃ pipruṃ dāsamahīśuvam | vadhīdugro riṇannapaḥ ||

translations.english: The fierce (deity) who, liberating the waters, has slain Sṛbinda, Anarśani, Pipru, Dāsa and Ahiśuva.

mantras.sanskrit: न्यर्बुदस्य विष्टपं वर्ष्माणं बृहतस्तिर । कृषे तदिन्द्र पौंस्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nyarbudasya viṣṭapaṃ varṣmāṇaṃ bṛhatastira | kṛṣe tadindra pauṃsyam ||

translations.english: Pierce the rain-holding domain of the vast Arbuda; achieve, Indra, this manly exploit.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रति श्रुताय वो धृषत्तूर्णाशं न गिरेरधि । हुवे सुशिप्रमूतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: prati śrutāya vo dhṛṣattūrṇāśaṃ na gireradhi | huve suśipramūtaye ||

translations.english: I invoke the victorious handsome-jawed Indra for your protection, and to hear (your praises), as (atraveller invokes) the water from the cloud.

mantras.sanskrit: स गोरश्वस्य वि व्रजं मन्दानः सोम्येभ्यः । पुरं न शूर दर्षसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa goraśvasya vi vrajaṃ mandānaḥ somyebhyaḥ | puraṃ na śūra darṣasi ||

translations.english: Exhilarated by the Soma draughts, you, hero, throw open the pastures of the cattle and horses like a(hostile) city.

mantras.sanskrit: यदि मे रारणः सुत उक्थे वा दधसे चनः । आरादुप स्वधा गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadi me rāraṇaḥ suta ukthe vā dadhase canaḥ | ārādupa svadhā gahi ||

translations.english: If you are propitiated by my libation and praise, and bestow food (upon me), come with viands from afar.

mantras.sanskrit: वयं घा ते अपि ष्मसि स्तोतार इन्द्र गिर्वणः । त्वं नो जिन्व सोमपाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayaṃ ghā te api ṣmasi stotāra indra girvaṇaḥ | tvaṃ no jinva somapāḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, who are plural ased by praise, we are your adorers; do you, therefore, who are the drinker of theSoma, be genitive rous unto us.

mantras.sanskrit: उत नः पितुमा भर संरराणो अविक्षितम् । मघवन्भूरि ते वसु ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta naḥ pitumā bhara saṃrarāṇo avikṣitam | maghavanbhūri te vasu ||

translations.english: Gratified by us, bring us undiminished food, Maghavan, for vast is your wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: उत नो गोमतस्कृधि हिरण्यवतो अश्विनः । इळाभिः सं रभेमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta no gomataskṛdhi hiraṇyavato aśvinaḥ | iḷābhiḥ saṃ rabhemahi ||

translations.english: Make us (Indra) possessed of cattle, of gold, and of horses; may we prosper with abundant viands.

mantras.sanskrit: बृबदुक्थं हवामहे सृप्रकरस्नमूतये । साधु कृण्वन्तमवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛbadukthaṃ havāmahe sṛprakarasnamūtaye | sādhu kṛṇvantamavase ||

translations.english: We invoke Indra, who is greatly to be praised, whose arm is stretched out for the protection (of theworld), acting nobly for our defence.

mantras.sanskrit: यः संस्थे चिच्छतक्रतुरादीं कृणोति वृत्रहा । जरितृभ्यः पुरूवसुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ saṃsthe cicchatakraturādīṃ kṛṇoti vṛtrahā | jaritṛbhyaḥ purūvasuḥ ||

translations.english: The slayer of Vṛtra, the accomplisher of a hundred exploits in war, achieves them that he may be thegiver of much wealth to his worshippers.

mantras.sanskrit: स नः शक्रश्चिदा शकद्दानवाँ अन्तराभरः । इन्द्रो विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa naḥ śakraścidā śakaddānavā~ antarābharaḥ | indro viśvābhirūtibhiḥ ||

translations.english: May Śakra give us strength, may the liberal Indra with all protections be the supplier of our deficiencieṣ

mantras.sanskrit: यो रायोऽवनिर्महान्त्सुपारः सुन्वतः सखा । तमिन्द्रमभि गायत ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo rāyo'vanirmahāntsupāraḥ sunvataḥ sakhā | tamindramabhi gāyata ||

translations.english: Glorify that Indra who is the preserver of riches, the mighty, the conveyor beyond (calamity), the friendof the offerer of the libation.

mantras.sanskrit: आयन्तारं महि स्थिरं पृतनासु श्रवोजितम् । भूरेरीशानमोजसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: āyantāraṃ mahi sthiraṃ pṛtanāsu śravojitam | bhūrerīśānamojasā ||

translations.english: Him who comes near, the mighty, the firm in battles, the acquirer of fame, the lord of vast riches throughhis prowess.

mantras.sanskrit: नकिरस्य शचीनां नियन्ता सूनृतानाम् । नकिर्वक्ता न दादिति ॥
mantras.transliteration: nakirasya śacīnāṃ niyantā sūnṛtānām | nakirvaktā na dāditi ||

translations.english: No one puts a limit to his glorious deeds, no one asserts that he is not genitive rous.

mantras.sanskrit: न नूनं ब्रह्मणामृणं प्राशूनामस्ति सुन्वताम् । न सोमो अप्रता पपे ॥
mantras.transliteration: na nūnaṃ brahmaṇāmṛṇaṃ prāśūnāmasti sunvatām | na somo apratā pape ||

translations.english: Verily no debt is due (to the gods) by those Soma-partaking brāhmaṇas offering libations; the Soma isnot drunk without the expenditure of boundless (wealth).

mantras.sanskrit: पन्य इदुप गायत पन्य उक्थानि शंसत । ब्रह्मा कृणोत पन्य इत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: panya idupa gāyata panya ukthāni śaṃsata | brahmā kṛṇota panya it ||

translations.english: Sing praises to the adorable (Indra), repeat prayers to the adorable (Indra), address hymns to theadorable (Indra).

mantras.sanskrit: पन्य आ दर्दिरच्छता सहस्रा वाज्यवृतः । इन्द्रो यो यज्वनो वृधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: panya ā dardiracchatā sahasrā vājyavṛtaḥ | indro yo yajvano vṛdhaḥ ||

translations.english: The powerful Indra, the discomfiter of hundreds and thousands, unchecked (by foes), is adorable; hewho is the benefactor of the sacrificer.

mantras.sanskrit: वि षू चर स्वधा अनु कृष्टीनामन्वाहुवः । इन्द्र पिब सुतानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi ṣū cara svadhā anu kṛṣṭīnāmanvāhuvaḥ | indra piba sutānām ||

translations.english: Indra, who are to be invoked of man, come to their offered viands, drink of (their) libations.

mantras.sanskrit: पिब स्वधैनवानामुत यस्तुग्र्ये सचा । उतायमिन्द्र यस्तव ॥
mantras.transliteration: piba svadhainavānāmuta yastugrye sacā | utāyamindra yastava ||

translations.english: Drink of the (Soma) purchased by the cow, that (Soma) which is mixed with water, that by which, Indra,is especially yours.

mantras.sanskrit: अतीहि मन्युषाविणं सुषुवांसमुपारणे । इमं रातं सुतं पिब ॥
mantras.transliteration: atīhi manyuṣāviṇaṃ suṣuvāṃsamupāraṇe | imaṃ rātaṃ sutaṃ piba ||

translations.english: Indra, pass by the man who offers the libation in anger, him who pours it out upon a spot disapprovedof; drink this presented Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: इहि तिस्रः परावत इहि पञ्च जनाँ अति । धेना इन्द्रावचाकशत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ihi tisraḥ parāvata ihi pañca janā~ ati | dhenā indrāvacākaśat ||

translations.english: Indra, who has beheld our praises, proceed in three directions from a distance, pass beyond the fiveorders of beings.

mantras.sanskrit: सूर्यो रश्मिं यथा सृजा त्वा यच्छन्तु मे गिरः । निम्नमापो न सध्र्यक् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sūryo raśmiṃ yathā sṛjā tvā yacchantu me giraḥ | nimnamāpo na sadhryak ||

translations.english: As the sun disperses his rays, do you disperse (wealth upon me); may my praises rapidly draw you, aswaters (reach) the low ground.

mantras.sanskrit: अध्वर्यवा तु हि षिञ्च सोमं वीराय शिप्रिणे । भरा सुतस्य पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhvaryavā tu hi ṣiñca somaṃ vīrāya śipriṇe | bharā sutasya pītaye ||

translations.english: Adhvaryu, quickly pour forth the Soma to the hero Indra with the goodly jaws; bring the Soma for hisdrinking.

mantras.sanskrit: य उद्नः फलिगं भिनन्न्यक्सिन्धूँरवासृजत् । यो गोषु पक्वं धारयत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya udnaḥ phaligaṃ bhinannyaksindhū~ravāsṛjat | yo goṣu pakvaṃ dhārayat ||

translations.english: Who clove the cloud for (the issue of) the rain, who sent down the waters, who plural ced the mature (milk)in the cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: अहन्वृत्रमृचीषम और्णवाभमहीशुवम् । हिमेनाविध्यदर्बुदम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahanvṛtramṛcīṣama aurṇavābhamahīśuvam | himenāvidhyadarbudam ||

translations.english: The brilliant Indra slew Vṛtra, Aurṇavābha, Ahiśava; he smote Arbuda with frost.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र व उग्राय निष्टुरेऽषाळ्हाय प्रसक्षिणे । देवत्तं ब्रह्म गायत ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra va ugrāya niṣṭure'ṣāḷhāya prasakṣiṇe | devattaṃ brahma gāyata ||

translations.english: Sing aloud (priests) to the fierce, victorious (Indra) the overpowerer, the subduer (of foes), the praiseinspired by the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: यो विश्वान्यभि व्रता सोमस्य मदे अन्धसः । इन्द्रो देवेषु चेतति ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo viśvānyabhi vratā somasya made andhasaḥ | indro deveṣu cetati ||

translations.english: Indra, who, in the exhilaration of the quaffed Soma, makes known among the gods all pious rites.

mantras.sanskrit: इह त्या सधमाद्या हरी हिरण्यकेश्या । वोळ्हामभि प्रयो हितम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: iha tyā sadhamādyā harī hiraṇyakeśyā | voḷhāmabhi prayo hitam ||

translations.english: May those two golden-maned steeds, together exulting, bring him here to the salutary (sacrificial) food.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्वाञ्चं त्वा पुरुष्टुत प्रियमेधस्तुता हरी । सोमपेयाय वक्षतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: arvāñcaṃ tvā puruṣṭuta priyamedhastutā harī | somapeyāya vakṣataḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, the glorified of many, let your horses, praised by Priyamedha, bring you down to drink the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: वयं घ त्वा सुतावन्त आपो न वृक्तबर्हिषः । पवित्रस्य प्रस्रवणेषु वृत्रहन्परि स्तोतार आसते ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayaṃ gha tvā sutāvanta āpo na vṛktabarhiṣaḥ | pavitrasya prasravaṇeṣu vṛtrahanpari stotāra āsate ||

translations.english: We are pouring forth to you Soma like water; the praisers, strewing the clipped sacred grass, worshipyou, slayer of Vṛtra, in the streams (falling) from the filter.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वरन्ति त्वा सुते नरो वसो निरेक उक्थिनः । कदा सुतं तृषाण ओक आ गम इन्द्र स्वब्दीव वंसगः ॥
mantras.transliteration: svaranti tvā sute naro vaso nireka ukthinaḥ | kadā sutaṃ tṛṣāṇa oka ā gama indra svabdīva vaṃsagaḥ ||

translations.english: The leaders (of rites), repeating praises, shout to you, Vasu, when the libation issues forth; when, Indra,bellowing like a bull, do you come to the dwelling thirsting fo the Soma?

mantras.sanskrit: कण्वेभिर्धृष्णवा धृषद्वाजं दर्षि सहस्रिणम् । पिशङ्गरूपं मघवन्विचर्षणे मक्षू गोमन्तमीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: kaṇvebhirdhṛṣṇavā dhṛṣadvājaṃ darṣi sahasriṇam | piśaṅgarūpaṃ maghavanvicarṣaṇe makṣū gomantamīmahe ||

translations.english: Resolute (Indra), bestow abundantly upon the descendants of Kaṇva thousands of viands; wiseMaghavan, we earnestly solicit you for (wealth) of gold and cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: पाहि गायान्धसो मद इन्द्राय मेध्यातिथे । यः सम्मिश्लो हर्योर्यः सुते सचा वज्री रथो हिरण्ययः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pāhi gāyāndhaso mada indrāya medhyātithe | yaḥ sammiślo haryoryaḥ sute sacā vajrī ratho hiraṇyayaḥ ||

translations.english: Drink, Medhyātithi, and in the exhilaration of the draught sing to Indra, to him who has harnessed hishorses, who, when the Soma is poured out, is present, the wielder of the thunderbolt, whose chariot is of golḍ

mantras.sanskrit: यः सुषव्यः सुदक्षिण इनो यः सुक्रतुर्गृणे । य आकरः सहस्रा यः शतामघ इन्द्रो यः पूर्भिदारितः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ suṣavyaḥ sudakṣiṇa ino yaḥ sukraturgṛṇe | ya ākaraḥ sahasrā yaḥ śatāmagha indro yaḥ pūrbhidāritaḥ ||

translations.english: He who is well-handled, both left and right, who is the lord, who is wise, he performer of numerousgreat acts, the giver of vast wealth, Indra, who is the demolisher of cities, who is gratified by praise, is glorified(by us).

mantras.sanskrit: यो धृषितो योऽवृतो यो अस्ति श्मश्रुषु श्रितः । विभूतद्युम्नश्च्यवनः पुरुष्टुतः क्रत्वा गौरिव शाकिनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo dhṛṣito yo'vṛto yo asti śmaśruṣu śritaḥ | vibhūtadyumnaścyavanaḥ puruṣṭutaḥ kratvā gauriva śākinaḥ ||

translations.english: He who is the subduer (of foes), the unresisted, practised in combats, possessed of vast wealth, thedemander of the libation, the praised of many, who by his acts (of bounty) is like a cow to the competent(worshipper).

mantras.sanskrit: क ईं वेद सुते सचा पिबन्तं कद्वयो दधे । अयं यः पुरो विभिनत्त्योजसा मन्दानः शिप्र्यन्धसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ka īṃ veda sute sacā pibantaṃ kadvayo dadhe | ayaṃ yaḥ puro vibhinattyojasā mandānaḥ śipryandhasaḥ ||

translations.english: Who knows him drinking with (the priests) when the Soma is effused? What food has he partaken of?He, the handsome-jawed, who, exhilarated by the (sacrificial) Soma, destroys cities by his might.

mantras.sanskrit: दाना मृगो न वारणः पुरुत्रा चरथं दधे । नकिष्ट्वा नि यमदा सुते गमो महाँश्चरस्योजसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: dānā mṛgo na vāraṇaḥ purutrā carathaṃ dadhe | nakiṣṭvā ni yamadā sute gamo mahā~ścarasyojasā ||

translations.english: As a wild elephant emitting the dews of passion, he manifests his exhilaration in many plural ces; no onechecks you, (Indra), come to the libation; you are mighty, and goes (everywhere) through your strength.

mantras.sanskrit: य उग्रः सन्ननिष्टृतः स्थिरो रणाय संस्कृतः । यदि स्तोतुर्मघवा शृणवद्धवं नेन्द्रो योषत्या गमत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya ugraḥ sannaniṣṭṛtaḥ sthiro raṇāya saṃskṛtaḥ | yadi stoturmaghavā śṛṇavaddhavaṃ nendro yoṣatyā gamat ||

translations.english: He who is fierce, unmoved (by foes) and firm, ready equipped for battle-- if Maghavan hears theinvocation of his adorer, he will not go apart (from us) but come here.

mantras.sanskrit: सत्यमित्था वृषेदसि वृषजूतिर्नोऽवृतः । वृषा ह्युग्र शृण्विषे परावति वृषो अर्वावति श्रुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: satyamitthā vṛṣedasi vṛṣajūtirno'vṛtaḥ | vṛṣā hyugra śṛṇviṣe parāvati vṛṣo arvāvati śrutaḥ ||

translations.english: Verily (Indra), in this manner you are the showerer (of benefits), brought by vigorous (steeds) to us,unresisted (by foes); fierce (Indra), you are celebrated as a showerer (of benefits) when afar; you are celebratedas a showerer (of benefits) when near.

mantras.sanskrit: वृषणस्ते अभीशवो वृषा कशा हिरण्ययी । वृषा रथो मघवन्वृषणा हरी वृषा त्वं शतक्रतो ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣaṇaste abhīśavo vṛṣā kaśā hiraṇyayī | vṛṣā ratho maghavanvṛṣaṇā harī vṛṣā tvaṃ śatakrato ||

translations.english: Showerers (of benefits) are your reins, such also is your golden whip, your chariot, Maghavan, is ashowerer (of benefits), so are your two horses; and you, too, Śatakratu, are the showerer (of benefits).

mantras.sanskrit: वृषा सोता सुनोतु ते वृषन्नृजीपिन्ना भर । वृषा दधन्वे वृषणं नदीष्वा तुभ्यं स्थातर्हरीणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣā sotā sunotu te vṛṣannṛjīpinnā bhara | vṛṣā dadhanve vṛṣaṇaṃ nadīṣvā tubhyaṃ sthātarharīṇām ||

translations.english: Showerer (of benefits), may the offerer of the libation to you effuse the Soma as a showerer;straight-going (Indra), bring (us wealth); arrester of your horses, the showerer (of the oblation) has prepared thebountiful Soma to be mixed with the waters for you.

mantras.sanskrit: एन्द्र याहि पीतये मधु शविष्ठ सोम्यम् । नायमच्छा मघवा शृणवद्गिरो ब्रह्मोक्था च सुक्रतुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: endra yāhi pītaye madhu śaviṣṭha somyam | nāyamacchā maghavā śṛṇavadgiro brahmokthā ca sukratuḥ ||

translations.english: Come, most powerful Indra, to drink of the Soma ambrosia, (for without coming) this Maghavan, theachiever of many exploits, hears not our praises, our chants, our hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: वहन्तु त्वा रथेष्ठामा हरयो रथयुजः । तिरश्चिदर्यं सवनानि वृत्रहन्नन्येषां या शतक्रतो ॥
mantras.transliteration: vahantu tvā ratheṣṭhāmā harayo rathayujaḥ | tiraścidaryaṃ savanāni vṛtrahannanyeṣāṃ yā śatakrato ||

translations.english: Śatakratu, slayer of Vṛtra, let your horses, yoked to your car, bring you, the lord, riding in your chariot,(to our sacrifices), avoiding those sacrifices (offered) by others.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्माकमद्यान्तमं स्तोमं धिष्व महामह । अस्माकं ते सवना सन्तु शंतमा मदाय द्युक्ष सोमपाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmākamadyāntamaṃ stomaṃ dhiṣva mahāmaha | asmākaṃ te savanā santu śaṃtamā madāya dyukṣa somapāḥ ||

translations.english: Greatest of the great, brilliant drinker of the Soma, accept today this our present praise; may oursacrifices be most sucessful in exciting your exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: नहि षस्तव नो मम शास्त्रे अन्यस्य रण्यति । यो अस्मान्वीर आनयत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahi ṣastava no mama śāstre anyasya raṇyati | yo asmānvīra ānayat ||

translations.english: The hero (Indra) who has (ever) guided us delights not in your punishment, nor in mine; nor in that ofany other.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रश्चिद्घा तदब्रवीत्स्त्रिया अशास्यं मनः । उतो अह क्रतुं रघुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraścidghā tadabravītstriyā aśāsyaṃ manaḥ | uto aha kratuṃ raghum ||

translations.english: Verily Indra said that the mind of a woman is not to be controlled, he declared also that her intellect wassmall.

mantras.sanskrit: सप्ती चिद्घा मदच्युता मिथुना वहतो रथम् । एवेद्धूर्वृष्ण उत्तरा ॥
mantras.transliteration: saptī cidghā madacyutā mithunā vahato ratham | eveddhūrvṛṣṇa uttarā ||

translations.english: The two horses of Indra, hastening to the exhilaration (of the Soma), draw his chariot; the pole of theshowerer rests upon them.

mantras.sanskrit: अधः पश्यस्व मोपरि संतरां पादकौ हर । मा ते कशप्लकौ दृशन्त्स्त्री हि ब्रह्मा बभूविथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhaḥ paśyasva mopari saṃtarāṃ pādakau hara | mā te kaśaplakau dṛśantstrī hi brahmā babhūvitha ||

translations.english: Cast your eyes (son of plural yoga) downwards, not upwards; keep your feet close together; let not (men)behold your ankles, for from having been a brahmā you have become a feminine le.

mantras.sanskrit: एन्द्र याहि हरिभिरुप कण्वस्य सुष्टुतिम् । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
mantras.transliteration: endra yāhi haribhirupa kaṇvasya suṣṭutim | divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||

translations.english: Come, Indra, with your horses to receive the praise of Kaṇva; do you, ruling yonder heaven, O radiantwith oblations, return here.

mantras.sanskrit: आ त्वा ग्रावा वदन्निह सोमी घोषेण यच्छतु । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tvā grāvā vadanniha somī ghoṣeṇa yacchatu | divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||

translations.english: May the grinding stone, yielding the Soma as it utters a sound, bring you here with the noise; do you,ruling yonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.

mantras.sanskrit: अत्रा वि नेमिरेषामुरां न धूनुते वृकः । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
mantras.transliteration: atrā vi nemireṣāmurāṃ na dhūnute vṛkaḥ | divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||

translations.english: The circumference of these (stones) shakes (the Soma) at this (rite), as a wolf (terrifies) a sheep doyou, ruling yonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.

mantras.sanskrit: आ त्वा कण्वा इहावसे हवन्ते वाजसातये । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tvā kaṇvā ihāvase havante vājasātaye | divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||

translations.english: The Kaṇvas invoke you here for protection and for food; do you, ruling yonder heaven, O radiant withoblations, return here.

mantras.sanskrit: दधामि ते सुतानां वृष्णे न पूर्वपाय्यम् । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
mantras.transliteration: dadhāmi te sutānāṃ vṛṣṇe na pūrvapāyyam | divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||

translations.english: I make offering to you of the libations as the first drink is presented to the showerer; do you, rulingyonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.

mantras.sanskrit: स्मत्पुरंधिर्न आ गहि विश्वतोधीर्न ऊतये । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
mantras.transliteration: smatpuraṃdhirna ā gahi viśvatodhīrna ūtaye | divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||

translations.english: (Indra) master of the family of heaven, come to us; do you, ruling yonder heaven, O radiant withoblations, return here.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो याहि महेमते सहस्रोते शतामघ । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no yāhi mahemate sahasrote śatāmagha | divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||

translations.english: Sagacious (Indra) bestower of numerous protections, granter of infinite wealth, come uno us; do you,ruling yonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.

mantras.sanskrit: आ त्वा होता मनुर्हितो देवत्रा वक्षदीड्यः । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tvā hotā manurhito devatrā vakṣadīḍyaḥ | divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||

translations.english: May (Agni) the invoker, adorable among the gods, the benefactor of man, bring you here; do you, rulingyonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.

mantras.sanskrit: आ त्वा मदच्युता हरी श्येनं पक्षेव वक्षतः । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tvā madacyutā harī śyenaṃ pakṣeva vakṣataḥ | divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||

translations.english: Let your two steeds, humiliators of the pride (of foes), bring you as (his) two wings (bear along) thefalcon; do you, ruling yonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.

mantras.sanskrit: आ याह्यर्य आ परि स्वाहा सोमस्य पीतये । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yāhyarya ā pari svāhā somasya pītaye | divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||

translations.english: Come, lord, from whatever direction, to drink the Soma offered with svāhā; do you, ruling yonderheaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो याह्युपश्रुत्युक्थेषु रणया इह । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no yāhyupaśrutyuktheṣu raṇayā iha | divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||

translations.english: Come to listen to our praises, when they are being recited-- bestow upon us delight; do you, rulingyonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.

mantras.sanskrit: सरूपैरा सु नो गहि सम्भृतैः सम्भृताश्वः । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
mantras.transliteration: sarūpairā su no gahi sambhṛtaiḥ sambhṛtāśvaḥ | divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||

translations.english: Indra, who are possessed of cherished steeds, come to us with (your) well-fed and like-shaped horses;do you, ruling yonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.

mantras.sanskrit: आ याहि पर्वतेभ्यः समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपः । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yāhi parvatebhyaḥ samudrasyādhi viṣṭapaḥ | divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||

translations.english: Come from the mountains, from above the region of the firmament; do you, ruling yonder heaven, Oradiant with oblations, return here.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो गव्यान्यश्व्या सहस्रा शूर दर्दृहि । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no gavyānyaśvyā sahasrā śūra dardṛhi | divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||

translations.english: Bestow upon us, hero, thousands of herds of cattle and horses; do you, ruling yonder heaven, Oradiant with oblations, return here.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नः सहस्रशो भरायुतानि शतानि च । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā naḥ sahasraśo bharāyutāni śatāni ca | divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||

translations.english: Bring to us, by thousands, tens of thousands, and hundres (of good things); do you, ruling yonderheaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यदिन्द्रश्च दद्वहे सहस्रं वसुरोचिषः । ओजिष्ठमश्व्यं पशुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yadindraśca dadvahe sahasraṃ vasurociṣaḥ | ojiṣṭhamaśvyaṃ paśum ||

translations.english: We, the thousand Vasurociṣas, and Indra (our leader), when we obtain vigorous herds of horseṣ..

mantras.sanskrit: य ऋज्रा वातरंहसोऽरुषासो रघुष्यदः । भ्राजन्ते सूर्या इव ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya ṛjrā vātaraṃhaso'ruṣāso raghuṣyadaḥ | bhrājante sūryā iva ||

translations.english: Such as are straight-going, fleet as the wind, bright-coloured, light- footed, and shine like the suṇ..

mantras.sanskrit: पारावतस्य रातिषु द्रवच्चक्रेष्वाशुषु । तिष्ठं वनस्य मध्य आ ॥
mantras.transliteration: pārāvatasya rātiṣu dravaccakreṣvāśuṣu | tiṣṭhaṃ vanasya madhya ā ||

translations.english: Then (having received) the horses, attached to the rolling-wheeled chariot, given from afar, we departto the middle of the forest.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निनेन्द्रेण वरुणेन विष्णुनादित्यै रुद्रैर्वसुभिः सचाभुवा । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं पिबतमश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: agninendreṇa varuṇena viṣṇunādityai rudrairvasubhiḥ sacābhuvā | sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somaṃ pibatamaśvinā ||

translations.english: Associated with Agni, with Indra, with Varuṇa, with Viṣṇu, with the Ādityas, the Rudras, and theVasus, and united with the dawn and with Sūrya, drink, Aśvins, the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वाभिर्धीभिर्भुवनेन वाजिना दिवा पृथिव्याद्रिभिः सचाभुवा । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं पिबतमश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvābhirdhībhirbhuvanena vājinā divā pṛthivyādribhiḥ sacābhuvā | sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somaṃ pibatamaśvinā ||

translations.english: Powerful (Aśvins), associated with all intelligences, with all beings, with heaven, with earth, with themountains, united with the dawn and with the Sūrya, drink, Aśvins, the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वैर्देवैस्त्रिभिरेकादशैरिहाद्भिर्मरुद्भिर्भृगुभिः सचाभुवा । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं पिबतमश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvairdevaistribhirekādaśairihādbhirmarudbhirbhṛgubhiḥ sacābhuvā | sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somaṃ pibatamaśvinā ||

translations.english: Associated with all the thrice-eleven deities at this ceremony, with the waters, with the Maruts, with theBhṛgus, united with the dawn and with Sūrya, drink, Aśvins, the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: जुषेथां यज्ञं बोधतं हवस्य मे विश्वेह देवौ सवनाव गच्छतम् । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चेषं नो वोळ्हमश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: juṣethāṃ yajñaṃ bodhataṃ havasya me viśveha devau savanāva gacchatam | sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ceṣaṃ no voḷhamaśvinā ||

translations.english: Be gratified by the sacrifice; hear my invocation; recognize, deities, all the offerings in this ceremony;united with the dawn and with Sūrya, bring us Aśvins, food.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तोमं जुषेथां युवशेव कन्यनां विश्वेह देवौ सवनाव गच्छतम् । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चेषं नो वोळ्हमश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: stomaṃ juṣethāṃ yuvaśeva kanyanāṃ viśveha devau savanāva gacchatam | sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ceṣaṃ no voḷhamaśvinā ||

translations.english: Be gratified by our praise as youths are delighted (by the voices) of maidens; recognize, deities, all theofferings in this ceremony; united with the dawn adn with Sūrya, bring us, Aśvins, food.

mantras.sanskrit: गिरो जुषेथामध्वरं जुषेथां विश्वेह देवौ सवनाव गच्छतम् । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चेषं नो वोळ्हमश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: giro juṣethāmadhvaraṃ juṣethāṃ viśveha devau savanāva gacchatam | sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ceṣaṃ no voḷhamaśvinā ||

translations.english: Be gratified, deities, by our praises, be gratified by the sacrifice, recognize, deities, all the offerings inthis ceremony; united with the dawn and with Sūrya, bring us, Aśvins, food.

mantras.sanskrit: हारिद्रवेव पतथो वनेदुप सोमं सुतं महिषेवाव गच्छथः । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च त्रिर्वर्तिर्यातमश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: hāridraveva patatho vanedupa somaṃ sutaṃ mahiṣevāva gacchathaḥ | sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca trirvartiryātamaśvinā ||

translations.english: You alight upon the effused Soma as the Hāridravā plural nges unto the water; you fall upon it like twobuffaloes (plural nging into a pool); united with the dawn and with Sūrya, come, Aśvins, by the triple path.

mantras.sanskrit: हंसाविव पतथो अध्वगाविव सोमं सुतं महिषेवाव गच्छथः । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च त्रिर्वर्तिर्यातमश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: haṃsāviva patatho adhvagāviva somaṃ sutaṃ mahiṣevāva gacchathaḥ | sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca trirvartiryātamaśvinā ||

translations.english: As two geese, as two travellers, as two buffaloes (hasten to water), you alight, Aśvins, upon the effusedSoma; united with the dawn and with Sūrya, come, Aśvins, by the triple path.

mantras.sanskrit: श्येनाविव पतथो हव्यदातये सोमं सुतं महिषेवाव गच्छथः । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च त्रिर्वर्तिर्यातमश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: śyenāviva patatho havyadātaye somaṃ sutaṃ mahiṣevāva gacchathaḥ | sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca trirvartiryātamaśvinā ||

translations.english: You hasten like two falcons to the offerer of the libation, you alight upon the effused Soma as twobuffaloes (hasten to water), united with the dawn and with Sūrya, come, Aśvins, by the triple path.

mantras.sanskrit: पिबतं च तृप्णुतं चा च गच्छतं प्रजां च धत्तं द्रविणं च धत्तम् । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चोर्जं नो धत्तमश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: pibataṃ ca tṛpṇutaṃ cā ca gacchataṃ prajāṃ ca dhattaṃ draviṇaṃ ca dhattam | sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa corjaṃ no dhattamaśvinā ||

translations.english: Drink, Aśvins, the Soma, and satiate yourselves; come here; give us progeny; give us wealth; unitedwith the dawn and with Sūrya, give us, Aśvins, strength.

mantras.sanskrit: जयतं च प्र स्तुतं च प्र चावतं प्रजां च धत्तं द्रविणं च धत्तम् । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चोर्जं नो धत्तमश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: jayataṃ ca pra stutaṃ ca pra cāvataṃ prajāṃ ca dhattaṃ draviṇaṃ ca dhattam | sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa corjaṃ no dhattamaśvinā ||

translations.english: Conquer (Aśvins), your foes; protect and praise (your worshipper), grant progeny, give wealth, andunited with the dawn and with Sūrya, give us, Aśvins, strength.

mantras.sanskrit: हतं च शत्रून्यततं च मित्रिणः प्रजां च धत्तं द्रविणं च धत्तम् । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चोर्जं नो धत्तमश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: hataṃ ca śatrūnyatataṃ ca mitriṇaḥ prajāṃ ca dhattaṃ draviṇaṃ ca dhattam | sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa corjaṃ no dhattamaśvinā ||

translations.english: Destroy your foes, repair to your friends, grant progeny, give wealth, and, united with the dawn and withSūrya, give us, Aśvins, strength.

mantras.sanskrit: मित्रावरुणवन्ता उत धर्मवन्ता मरुत्वन्ता जरितुर्गच्छथो हवम् । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चादित्यैर्यातमश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: mitrāvaruṇavantā uta dharmavantā marutvantā jariturgacchatho havam | sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa cādityairyātamaśvinā ||

translations.english: Associated with Mitra and Varuṇa, with Dharma, with the Maruts, repair to the invocation of the adorer;repair (to him), Aśvins, united with the dawn, with Sūrya and with the Ādityas.

mantras.sanskrit: अङ्गिरस्वन्ता उत विष्णुवन्ता मरुत्वन्ता जरितुर्गच्छथो हवम् । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चादित्यैर्यातमश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: aṅgirasvantā uta viṣṇuvantā marutvantā jariturgacchatho havam | sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa cādityairyātamaśvinā ||

translations.english: Associated with the Aṅgirasas, with Viṣṇu, with the Maruts, repair to the invocation of the adorer;repair (to him), Aśvins, united with the dawn, with Sūrya, and with the Ādityas.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋभुमन्ता वृषणा वाजवन्ता मरुत्वन्ता जरितुर्गच्छथो हवम् । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चादित्यैर्यातमश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛbhumantā vṛṣaṇā vājavantā marutvantā jariturgacchatho havam | sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa cādityairyātamaśvinā ||

translations.english: Associated with the Ṛbhus, and with the maruts, repair, showerers (of benefits), dispensers of food, tothe invocation of the adorer; repair (to him), Aśvins, united with the dawn, with Sūrya, and with the Ādityas.

mantras.sanskrit: ब्रह्म जिन्वतमुत जिन्वतं धियो हतं रक्षांसि सेधतममीवाः । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं सुन्वतो अश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: brahma jinvatamuta jinvataṃ dhiyo hataṃ rakṣāṃsi sedhatamamīvāḥ | sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somaṃ sunvato aśvinā ||

translations.english: Be propitious to prayer, be propitious to sacred rites, slay the rākṣasas, remedy diseases united withthe dawn and with Sūrya, (drink), Aśvins, the Soma of the offerer.

mantras.sanskrit: क्षत्रं जिन्वतमुत जिन्वतं नॄन्हतं रक्षांसि सेधतममीवाः । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं सुन्वतो अश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: kṣatraṃ jinvatamuta jinvataṃ nṝnhataṃ rakṣāṃsi sedhatamamīvāḥ | sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somaṃ sunvato aśvinā ||

translations.english: Be propitious to the strong, be propitious to men, slay the rākṣasas, remedy diseases, united with thedawn and with Sūrya, (drink), Aśvins, the Soma of the offerer.

mantras.sanskrit: धेनूर्जिन्वतमुत जिन्वतं विशो हतं रक्षांसि सेधतममीवाः । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं सुन्वतो अश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhenūrjinvatamuta jinvataṃ viśo hataṃ rakṣāṃsi sedhatamamīvāḥ | sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somaṃ sunvato aśvinā ||

translations.english: Be propitious to the kine, be propitious to the people, slay the rākṣasas, remedy diseases, united withthe dawn and with Sūrya, (drink), Aśvins, the Soma of the offerer.

mantras.sanskrit: अत्रेरिव शृणुतं पूर्व्यस्तुतिं श्यावाश्वस्य सुन्वतो मदच्युता । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चाश्विना तिरोअह्न्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: atreriva śṛṇutaṃ pūrvyastutiṃ śyāvāśvasya sunvato madacyutā | sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa cāśvinā tiroahnyam ||

translations.english: Humblers of the pride (of your enemies), hear the earnest praise of Śyāvāśva offering libations as(you did) that of Atri, and, united with the dawn and with Sūrya, (drink), Aśvins, (the Soma) prepared theprevious day.

mantras.sanskrit: सर्गाँ इव सृजतं सुष्टुतीरुप श्यावाश्वस्य सुन्वतो मदच्युता । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चाश्विना तिरोअह्न्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sargā~ iva sṛjataṃ suṣṭutīrupa śyāvāśvasya sunvato madacyutā | sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa cāśvinā tiroahnyam ||

translations.english: Humblers of the pride (of your enemies), accept the earnest praises of Śyāvāśva offering youlibations as if you were accepting oblations; and, united with the dawn and with Sūrya, (drink), Aśvins, (theSoma) prepared the previous day.

mantras.sanskrit: रश्मीँरिव यच्छतमध्वराँ उप श्यावाश्वस्य सुन्वतो मदच्युता । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चाश्विना तिरोअह्न्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: raśmī~riva yacchatamadhvarā~ upa śyāvāśvasya sunvato madacyutā | sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa cāśvinā tiroahnyam ||

translations.english: Humblers of the pride (of your enemies), seize the sacrifices of Śyāvāśva offering libations as youseize your reins; and united with the dawn and with Sūrya, (drink), Aśvins,(the Soma) prepared the previousday.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्वाग्रथं नि यच्छतं पिबतं सोम्यं मधु । आ यातमश्विना गतमवस्युर्वामहं हुवे धत्तं रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: arvāgrathaṃ ni yacchataṃ pibataṃ somyaṃ madhu | ā yātamaśvinā gatamavasyurvāmahaṃ huve dhattaṃ ratnāni dāśuṣe ||

translations.english: Direct your chariot downwards, drink the Soma nectar; come, Aśvins, come (here); desirous of yourprotection, I invoke you; give precious riches to the donor of the offering.

mantras.sanskrit: नमोवाके प्रस्थिते अध्वरे नरा विवक्षणस्य पीतये । आ यातमश्विना गतमवस्युर्वामहं हुवे धत्तं रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: namovāke prasthite adhvare narā vivakṣaṇasya pītaye | ā yātamaśvinā gatamavasyurvāmahaṃ huve dhattaṃ ratnāni dāśuṣe ||

translations.english: Come, leaders of rites, when the sacrifice, at which your adoration is cited, is commenced, to drink ofthe Soma offered by me; come, Aśvins, come (here), desirous of protection, I invoke you; give precious riches tothe donor of the offering.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वाहाकृतस्य तृम्पतं सुतस्य देवावन्धसः । आ यातमश्विना गतमवस्युर्वामहं हुवे धत्तं रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: svāhākṛtasya tṛmpataṃ sutasya devāvandhasaḥ | ā yātamaśvinā gatamavasyurvāmahaṃ huve dhattaṃ ratnāni dāśuṣe ||

translations.english: Divine (Aśvins), partake to satiety of the sacrificial Soma, consecrated with the exclamation svāhā;come, Aśvins, come (here); desirous of protection, I invoke you; give precious riches to the donor of the offering.

mantras.sanskrit: अवितासि सुन्वतो वृक्तबर्हिषः पिबा सोमं मदाय कं शतक्रतो । यं ते भागमधारयन्विश्वाः सेहानः पृतना उरु ज्रयः समप्सुजिन्मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र सत्पते ॥
mantras.transliteration: avitāsi sunvato vṛktabarhiṣaḥ pibā somaṃ madāya kaṃ śatakrato | yaṃ te bhāgamadhārayanviśvāḥ sehānaḥ pṛtanā uru jrayaḥ samapsujinmarutvā~ indra satpate ||

translations.english: You are the protector of the effuser of the libation, of the strewer of he clipped sacred grass; drinkjoyfully, Śatakratu, the Soma for your exhilaration-- that portion which (the gods) assigned you, Indra, lord of thevirtuous, who are the victor over all (hostile) hosts, the conqueror of many, the subduer of the waters, the leaderof the Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: प्राव स्तोतारं मघवन्नव त्वां पिबा सोमं मदाय कं शतक्रतो । यं ते भागमधारयन्विश्वाः सेहानः पृतना उरु ज्रयः समप्सुजिन्मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र सत्पते ॥
mantras.transliteration: prāva stotāraṃ maghavannava tvāṃ pibā somaṃ madāya kaṃ śatakrato | yaṃ te bhāgamadhārayanviśvāḥ sehānaḥ pṛtanā uru jrayaḥ samapsujinmarutvā~ indra satpate ||

translations.english: Protect the worshippers, Maghavan, protect thyself; drink joyfully, Śatakratu, the Soma for yourexhilaration-- that portion which (the gods) assigned you, Indra, lord of the virtuous, who are the victor over all(hostile) hosts, the conqueror of many, the subduer of the waters, the leader of the Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: ऊर्जा देवाँ अवस्योजसा त्वां पिबा सोमं मदाय कं शतक्रतो । यं ते भागमधारयन्विश्वाः सेहानः पृतना उरु ज्रयः समप्सुजिन्मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र सत्पते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūrjā devā~ avasyojasā tvāṃ pibā somaṃ madāya kaṃ śatakrato | yaṃ te bhāgamadhārayanviśvāḥ sehānaḥ pṛtanā uru jrayaḥ samapsujinmarutvā~ indra satpate ||

translations.english: You, Maghavan, protect the gods with (sacrificial) food, and yourself by your might; drink joyfully,Śatakratu, the Soma for your exhilaration-- that portion which (the gods) assigned you, Indra, lord of the virtuous,who are the victor over all (hostile) hosts, the conqueror of many, the subduer of the waters, the leader of theMaruts.

mantras.sanskrit: जनिता दिवो जनिता पृथिव्याः पिबा सोमं मदाय कं शतक्रतो । यं ते भागमधारयन्विश्वाः सेहानः पृतना उरु ज्रयः समप्सुजिन्मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र सत्पते ॥
mantras.transliteration: janitā divo janitā pṛthivyāḥ pibā somaṃ madāya kaṃ śatakrato | yaṃ te bhāgamadhārayanviśvāḥ sehānaḥ pṛtanā uru jrayaḥ samapsujinmarutvā~ indra satpate ||

translations.english: You, are the genitive rator of heaven, the genitive rator of earth; drink joyfully, Śatakratu, the Soma for yourexhilaration-- that portion which (the gods) assigned you, Indra, lord of the virtuous, who are the victor over all(hostile) hosts, the conqueror of many, the subduer of the waters, the leader of the Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: जनिताश्वानां जनिता गवामसि पिबा सोमं मदाय कं शतक्रतो । यं ते भागमधारयन्विश्वाः सेहानः पृतना उरु ज्रयः समप्सुजिन्मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र सत्पते ॥
mantras.transliteration: janitāśvānāṃ janitā gavāmasi pibā somaṃ madāya kaṃ śatakrato | yaṃ te bhāgamadhārayanviśvāḥ sehānaḥ pṛtanā uru jrayaḥ samapsujinmarutvā~ indra satpate ||

translations.english: You are the genitive rator of horses, the genitive rator of cattle; drink joyfully, Śatakratu, the Soma for yourexhilaration-- that portion which (the gods) assigned you, Indra, lord of the virtuous, who are the victor over all(hostile) hosts, the conqueror of many, the subduer of the waters, the leader of the Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: अत्रीणां स्तोममद्रिवो महस्कृधि पिबा सोमं मदाय कं शतक्रतो । यं ते भागमधारयन्विश्वाः सेहानः पृतना उरु ज्रयः समप्सुजिन्मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र सत्पते ॥
mantras.transliteration: atrīṇāṃ stomamadrivo mahaskṛdhi pibā somaṃ madāya kaṃ śatakrato | yaṃ te bhāgamadhārayanviśvāḥ sehānaḥ pṛtanā uru jrayaḥ samapsujinmarutvā~ indra satpate ||

translations.english: Wielder of the thunderbolt, reverence the praise of the Atris; drink joyfully, Śatakratu, the Soma for yourexhilaration-- that portion which (the gods) assigned you, Indra, lord of the virtuous, who are the victor over all(hostile) hosts, the conqueror of many, the subduer of the waters, the leader of the Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: श्यावाश्वस्य सुन्वतस्तथा शृणु यथाशृणोरत्रेः कर्माणि कृण्वतः । प्र त्रसदस्युमाविथ त्वमेक इन्नृषाह्य इन्द्र ब्रह्माणि वर्धयन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śyāvāśvasya sunvatastathā śṛṇu yathāśṛṇoratreḥ karmāṇi kṛṇvataḥ | pra trasadasyumāvitha tvameka innṛṣāhya indra brahmāṇi vardhayan ||

translations.english: Hear (the praises) of Śyāvāśva offering the libations, as you have heard (those) of Atri engaged inholy rites; you alone, Indra, have defended Trasadasyu in battle, animating his prayers.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रेदं ब्रह्म वृत्रतूर्येष्वाविथ प्र सुन्वतः शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः । माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: predaṃ brahma vṛtratūryeṣvāvitha pra sunvataḥ śacīpata indra viśvābhirūtibhiḥ | mādhyaṃdinasya savanasya vṛtrahannanedya pibā somasya vajrivaḥ ||

translations.english: You protect, Indra, lord of rites, with all protections in combats with enemies, this sacrifice of him whooffers you the libations; slayer of Vṛtra, irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt drink of the Soma at themid-day solemnity.

mantras.sanskrit: सेहान उग्र पृतना अभि द्रुहः शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः । माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sehāna ugra pṛtanā abhi druhaḥ śacīpata indra viśvābhirūtibhiḥ | mādhyaṃdinasya savanasya vṛtrahannanedya pibā somasya vajrivaḥ ||

translations.english: Fierce Indra, defeater of hostile armies, lord of rites, (you protect) with all your protections; slayer ofVṛtra, irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt, drink of the Soma at the mid-day solemnity.

mantras.sanskrit: एकराळस्य भुवनस्य राजसि शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः । माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ekarāḷasya bhuvanasya rājasi śacīpata indra viśvābhirūtibhiḥ | mādhyaṃdinasya savanasya vṛtrahannanedya pibā somasya vajrivaḥ ||

translations.english: You shine the sole sovereign of this world, Indra, lord of rites, with all your protections; slayer of Vṛtra,irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt, drink of the Soma at the mid-day solemnity.

mantras.sanskrit: सस्थावाना यवयसि त्वमेक इच्छचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः । माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sasthāvānā yavayasi tvameka icchacīpata indra viśvābhirūtibhiḥ | mādhyaṃdinasya savanasya vṛtrahannanedya pibā somasya vajrivaḥ ||

translations.english: You alone, Indra, lord of rites, separate the combined worlds (heaven and earth) with all yourprotections; slayer of Vṛtra, irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt, drink of the Soma at the mid-daysolemnity.

mantras.sanskrit: क्षेमस्य च प्रयुजश्च त्वमीशिषे शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः । माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kṣemasya ca prayujaśca tvamīśiṣe śacīpata indra viśvābhirūtibhiḥ | mādhyaṃdinasya savanasya vṛtrahannanedya pibā somasya vajrivaḥ ||

translations.english: You, lord of rites, are sovereign over our prosperity and gains, with all your protections; slayer of Vṛtra,irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt, drink of the Soma at the mid-day solemnity.

mantras.sanskrit: क्षत्राय त्वमवसि न त्वमाविथ शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः । माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kṣatrāya tvamavasi na tvamāvitha śacīpata indra viśvābhirūtibhiḥ | mādhyaṃdinasya savanasya vṛtrahannanedya pibā somasya vajrivaḥ ||

translations.english: You are for the strength (of the world), you protect with all your protections, but you need no defender,Indra, lord of rites; slayer of Vṛtra, irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt, drink of the Soma at the mid- daysolemnity.

mantras.sanskrit: श्यावाश्वस्य रेभतस्तथा शृणु यथाशृणोरत्रेः कर्माणि कृण्वतः । प्र त्रसदस्युमाविथ त्वमेक इन्नृषाह्य इन्द्र क्षत्राणि वर्धयन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śyāvāśvasya rebhatastathā śṛṇu yathāśṛṇoratreḥ karmāṇi kṛṇvataḥ | pra trasadasyumāvitha tvameka innṛṣāhya indra kṣatrāṇi vardhayan ||

translations.english: Hear the praises of Śyāvāśva eulogizing you, as you have heard those of Atri engaged in piousrites; you alone have protected Trasadasyu in battle, augmenting his vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: यज्ञस्य हि स्थ ऋत्विजा सस्नी वाजेषु कर्मसु । इन्द्राग्नी तस्य बोधतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajñasya hi stha ṛtvijā sasnī vājeṣu karmasu | indrāgnī tasya bodhatam ||

translations.english: Indra and Agni, you are the pure ministrants, (encouragers) in offerings and sacred rites-- hear (thepraise) of this (your worshipper).

mantras.sanskrit: तोशासा रथयावाना वृत्रहणापराजिता । इन्द्राग्नी तस्य बोधतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tośāsā rathayāvānā vṛtrahaṇāparājitā | indrāgnī tasya bodhatam ||

translations.english: Destroyers (of foes), riding in one chariot, slayers of Vṛtra, invincible; hear, Indra and Agni, (the praise)of this (your worshipper).

mantras.sanskrit: इदं वां मदिरं मध्वधुक्षन्नद्रिभिर्नरः । इन्द्राग्नी तस्य बोधतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: idaṃ vāṃ madiraṃ madhvadhukṣannadribhirnaraḥ | indrāgnī tasya bodhatam ||

translations.english: The leaders of rites have effused by the stones this sweet exhilarating (Soma) for you; hear, Indra andAgni, (the praise) of this (your worshipper).

mantras.sanskrit: जुषेथां यज्ञमिष्टये सुतं सोमं सधस्तुती । इन्द्राग्नी आ गतं नरा ॥
mantras.transliteration: juṣethāṃ yajñamiṣṭaye sutaṃ somaṃ sadhastutī | indrāgnī ā gataṃ narā ||

translations.english: Associate in praie, accept the sacrifice; leaders of rites, Indra and Agni, come hither to the Somaeffused for this solemnity.

mantras.sanskrit: इमा जुषेथां सवना येभिर्हव्यान्यूहथुः । इन्द्राग्नी आ गतं नरा ॥
mantras.transliteration: imā juṣethāṃ savanā yebhirhavyānyūhathuḥ | indrāgnī ā gataṃ narā ||

translations.english: Accept these sacrifices whereby you have borne away the oblations; leaders of rites, Indra and Agni,come hither.

mantras.sanskrit: इमां गायत्रवर्तनिं जुषेथां सुष्टुतिं मम । इन्द्राग्नी आ गतं नरा ॥
mantras.transliteration: imāṃ gāyatravartaniṃ juṣethāṃ suṣṭutiṃ mama | indrāgnī ā gataṃ narā ||

translations.english: Accept this my earnest praise, following the path of the gāyatrī; leaders of rites, Indra and Agni, comehere.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रातर्यावभिरा गतं देवेभिर्जेन्यावसू । इन्द्राग्नी सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: prātaryāvabhirā gataṃ devebhirjenyāvasū | indrāgnī somapītaye ||

translations.english: Rich with the spoils of victory, come, Indra and Agni, to drink of the Soma, with the deities astir in themorning.

mantras.sanskrit: श्यावाश्वस्य सुन्वतोऽत्रीणां शृणुतं हवम् । इन्द्राग्नी सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: śyāvāśvasya sunvato'trīṇāṃ śṛṇutaṃ havam | indrāgnī somapītaye ||

translations.english: Hear the invocation, Indra and Agni, of Śyāvāśva pouring out the effused Soma, (and) the Atris, todrink of the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा वामह्व ऊतये यथाहुवन्त मेधिराः । इन्द्राग्नी सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā vāmahva ūtaye yathāhuvanta medhirāḥ | indrāgnī somapītaye ||

translations.english: I invoke you both, Indra and Agni, as the sages have invoked you, for your protection (and) to drink ofthe Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: आहं सरस्वतीवतोरिन्द्राग्न्योरवो वृणे । याभ्यां गायत्रमृच्यते ॥
mantras.transliteration: āhaṃ sarasvatīvatorindrāgnyoravo vṛṇe | yābhyāṃ gāyatramṛcyate ||

translations.english: I solicit the protection of Indra and Agni, associated with Sarasvatī, to whom this Gāyatrī hymn isaddressed.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निमस्तोष्यृग्मियमग्निमीळा यजध्यै । अग्निर्देवाँ अनक्तु न उभे हि विदथे कविरन्तश्चरति दूत्यं नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnimastoṣyṛgmiyamagnimīḷā yajadhyai | agnirdevā~ anaktu na ubhe hi vidathe kavirantaścarati dūtyaṃ nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: I glorify the adorable Agni, (I invite) Agni with praise to the sacrifice, may Agni brighten the gods with theoblations at our sacrifice; the sage Agni traverses both (worlds discharging his function) as messenger of thegods; may all our adversaries perish.

mantras.sanskrit: न्यग्ने नव्यसा वचस्तनूषु शंसमेषाम् । न्यराती रराव्णां विश्वा अर्यो अरातीरितो युच्छन्त्वामुरो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: nyagne navyasā vacastanūṣu śaṃsameṣām | nyarātī rarāvṇāṃ viśvā aryo arātīrito yucchantvāmuro nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: (Propitiated), Agni, by our new praise baffle the hostile attempts of these against our person ns, consumethe enemies of those who are liberal (at sacred rites); may all our foolish assailants depart from here, may all ouradversaries perish.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने मन्मानि तुभ्यं कं घृतं न जुह्व आसनि । स देवेषु प्र चिकिद्धि त्वं ह्यसि पूर्व्यः शिवो दूतो विवस्वतो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne manmāni tubhyaṃ kaṃ ghṛtaṃ na juhva āsani | sa deveṣu pra cikiddhi tvaṃ hyasi pūrvyaḥ śivo dūto vivasvato nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: I pour into your mouth, Agni, praises as others (fill it) with delicious butter; do you amidst the godsacknowledge (them), for you are ancient, the giver of happiness, the messenger of Vivaśvat; may all ouradversaries perish.

mantras.sanskrit: तत्तदग्निर्वयो दधे यथायथा कृपण्यति । ऊर्जाहुतिर्वसूनां शं च योश्च मयो दधे विश्वस्यै देवहूत्यै नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tattadagnirvayo dadhe yathāyathā kṛpaṇyati | ūrjāhutirvasūnāṃ śaṃ ca yośca mayo dadhe viśvasyai devahūtyai nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: Agni grants whatever food is solicited; invoked with offerings, he bestows on the worshippershappiness springing from tranquility and the enjoyment (of objects of sense); he is requisite for all invocation ofthe gods; may all our adversaries perish.

mantras.sanskrit: स चिकेत सहीयसाग्निश्चित्रेण कर्मणा । स होता शश्वतीनां दक्षिणाभिरभीवृत इनोति च प्रतीव्यं नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa ciketa sahīyasāgniścitreṇa karmaṇā | sa hotā śaśvatīnāṃ dakṣiṇābhirabhīvṛta inoti ca pratīvyaṃ nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: Agni is known by his most powerful and manifold deeds; he is the invoker of the eternals; surroundedby victims, he proceeds against the foe; may all our adversaries perish.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निर्जाता देवानामग्निर्वेद मर्तानामपीच्यम् । अग्निः स द्रविणोदा अग्निर्द्वारा व्यूर्णुते स्वाहुतो नवीयसा नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirjātā devānāmagnirveda martānāmapīcyam | agniḥ sa draviṇodā agnirdvārā vyūrṇute svāhuto navīyasā nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: Agni knows the birth of the gods; Agni knows the secrets of mankind; Agni is the giver of riches; Agni,duly worshipped with a new (oblation), sets open the doors (of opulence); may all our adversaries perish.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निर्देवेषु संवसुः स विक्षु यज्ञियास्वा । स मुदा काव्या पुरु विश्वं भूमेव पुष्यति देवो देवेषु यज्ञियो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirdeveṣu saṃvasuḥ sa vikṣu yajñiyāsvā | sa mudā kāvyā puru viśvaṃ bhūmeva puṣyati devo deveṣu yajñiyo nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: Agni has his abode among the gods, he (dwells) among pious people; he cherishes with plural asure manypious acts, as the earth all (beings); a god adorable among the gods; may all our adversaries perish.

mantras.sanskrit: यो अग्निः सप्तमानुषः श्रितो विश्वेषु सिन्धुषु । तमागन्म त्रिपस्त्यं मन्धातुर्दस्युहन्तममग्निं यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यं नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo agniḥ saptamānuṣaḥ śrito viśveṣu sindhuṣu | tamāganma tripastyaṃ mandhāturdasyuhantamamagniṃ yajñeṣu pūrvyaṃ nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: Let us approach that Agni who is ministered to by seven priess; who takes refuge in all rivers, who hasa triple dwelling plural ce, the slayer of the Dasyu for Mandhātā, who is foremost in sacrifices; may all ouradversaries perish.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निस्त्रीणि त्रिधातून्या क्षेति विदथा कविः । स त्रीँरेकादशाँ इह यक्षच्च पिप्रयच्च नो विप्रो दूतः परिष्कृतो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnistrīṇi tridhātūnyā kṣeti vidathā kaviḥ | sa trī~rekādaśā~ iha yakṣacca piprayacca no vipro dūtaḥ pariṣkṛto nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: Agni, the sage, inhabits the three elementary regions; may he, intelligent, and richly decorated, themessenger (of the gods), here perform worship to the thrice eleven deities, and satisfy all our desires; may all ouradversaries perish.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं नो अग्न आयुषु त्वं देवेषु पूर्व्य वस्व एक इरज्यसि । त्वामापः परिस्रुतः परि यन्ति स्वसेतवो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ no agna āyuṣu tvaṃ deveṣu pūrvya vasva eka irajyasi | tvāmāpaḥ parisrutaḥ pari yanti svasetavo nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: You, ancient Agni, among men and gods, are alone to us the lord of wealth; the flowing waters confinedwithin their own banks flow around you;may all our adversaries perish.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी युवं सु नः सहन्ता दासथो रयिम् । येन दृळ्हा समत्स्वा वीळु चित्साहिषीमह्यग्निर्वनेव वात इन्नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāgnī yuvaṃ su naḥ sahantā dāsatho rayim | yena dṛḷhā samatsvā vīḷu citsāhiṣīmahyagnirvaneva vāta innabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: Victorious Indra and Agni, bestow upon us riches whereby we may destroy our powerful enemies incombats as fire fanned by the wind consumes the forests; may all our adversaries perish.

mantras.sanskrit: नहि वां वव्रयामहेऽथेन्द्रमिद्यजामहे शविष्ठं नृणां नरम् । स नः कदा चिदर्वता गमदा वाजसातये गमदा मेधसातये नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahi vāṃ vavrayāmahe'thendramidyajāmahe śaviṣṭhaṃ nṛṇāṃ naram | sa naḥ kadā cidarvatā gamadā vājasātaye gamadā medhasātaye nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: Do we not invoke you both? We worship especially Indra, who is the strongest leader of men; he comesoccasionally with his horses to bestow upon us food; he comes to partake of the sacrifice; may all ouradversaries perish.

mantras.sanskrit: ता हि मध्यं भराणामिन्द्राग्नी अधिक्षितः । ता उ कवित्वना कवी पृच्छ्यमाना सखीयते सं धीतमश्नुतं नरा नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā hi madhyaṃ bharāṇāmindrāgnī adhikṣitaḥ | tā u kavitvanā kavī pṛcchyamānā sakhīyate saṃ dhītamaśnutaṃ narā nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: They two, Indra and Agni, are present in the midst of battles; do you two, leaders of rites, who are reallysages, when solicited (by the wise), accept the offering (from him) who seeks your friendship; may all ouradversaries perish.

mantras.sanskrit: अभ्यर्च नभाकवदिन्द्राग्नी यजसा गिरा । ययोर्विश्वमिदं जगदियं द्यौः पृथिवी मह्युपस्थे बिभृतो वसु नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhyarca nabhākavadindrāgnī yajasā girā | yayorviśvamidaṃ jagadiyaṃ dyauḥ pṛthivī mahyupasthe bibhṛto vasu nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: Worship, like Nabhāka, Indra and Agni with sacrifice and praise, of whom is this universe, upon whoselap this heaven and the spacious earth deposit their treasure; may all our adversaries perish.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ब्रह्माणि नभाकवदिन्द्राग्निभ्यामिरज्यत । या सप्तबुध्नमर्णवं जिह्मबारमपोर्णुत इन्द्र ईशान ओजसा नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra brahmāṇi nabhākavadindrāgnibhyāmirajyata | yā saptabudhnamarṇavaṃ jihmabāramaporṇuta indra īśāna ojasā nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: Address like Nabhāka your praises to Indra and Agni, who overspread (with their lustre) theseven-rooted ocean whose gates are hidden, and of whom Indra by his might is the lord; may all our adversariesperish.

mantras.sanskrit: अपि वृश्च पुराणवद्व्रततेरिव गुष्पितमोजो दासस्य दम्भय । वयं तदस्य सम्भृतं वस्विन्द्रेण वि भजेमहि नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: api vṛśca purāṇavadvratateriva guṣpitamojo dāsasya dambhaya | vayaṃ tadasya sambhṛtaṃ vasvindreṇa vi bhajemahi nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: Cut off (the foe), Indra, as and old (pruner) the protruding (branch) of a creeper, humble the strength ofthe Dāsa; may we divide his accusative ulated treasure (despoiled) by Indra; may all our adversaries perish.

mantras.sanskrit: यदिन्द्राग्नी जना इमे विह्वयन्ते तना गिरा । अस्माकेभिर्नृभिर्वयं सासह्याम पृतन्यतो वनुयाम वनुष्यतो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadindrāgnī janā ime vihvayante tanā girā | asmākebhirnṛbhirvayaṃ sāsahyāma pṛtanyato vanuyāma vanuṣyato nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: Inasmuch as these people honour Indra and Agni with gifts and with praises, so may we, defying hosts,overcome (our foes) with our warriors; let us praise those seeking praise; may all our adversaries perish.

mantras.sanskrit: या नु श्वेताववो दिव उच्चरात उप द्युभिः । इन्द्राग्न्योरनु व्रतमुहाना यन्ति सिन्धवो यान्त्सीं बन्धादमुञ्चतां नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā nu śvetāvavo diva uccarāta upa dyubhiḥ | indrāgnyoranu vratamuhānā yanti sindhavo yāntsīṃ bandhādamuñcatāṃ nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: Offering oblations, (the worshippers) approach to the worship of Indra and Agni, who are of a whitecomplexion, and rise from below with bright rays to heaven; they verily have liberated the waters from bondage;may all our adversaries perish.

mantras.sanskrit: पूर्वीष्ट इन्द्रोपमातयः पूर्वीरुत प्रशस्तयः सूनो हिन्वस्य हरिवः । वस्वो वीरस्यापृचो या नु साधन्त नो धियो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pūrvīṣṭa indropamātayaḥ pūrvīruta praśastayaḥ sūno hinvasya harivaḥ | vasvo vīrasyāpṛco yā nu sādhanta no dhiyo nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, instrumental gator (of acts), may the numerous merits, the many excellences ofyou, who are the bestower of affluence and of male offspring, perfect our understandings; may all ouradversaries perish.

mantras.sanskrit: तं शिशीता सुवृक्तिभिस्त्वेषं सत्वानमृग्मियम् । उतो नु चिद्य ओजसा शुष्णस्याण्डानि भेदति जेषत्स्वर्वतीरपो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ śiśītā suvṛktibhistveṣaṃ satvānamṛgmiyam | uto nu cidya ojasā śuṣṇasyāṇḍāni bhedati jeṣatsvarvatīrapo nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: Animate with praises that brilliant adorable Indra, the distributor (of riches), who by hismight breaks theeggs of Śuṣṇa; may he conquer the celestial waters; may all our enemies perish.

mantras.sanskrit: तं शिशीता स्वध्वरं सत्यं सत्वानमृत्वियम् । उतो नु चिद्य ओहत आण्डा शुष्णस्य भेदत्यजैः स्वर्वतीरपो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ śiśītā svadhvaraṃ satyaṃ satvānamṛtviyam | uto nu cidya ohata āṇḍā śuṣṇasya bhedatyajaiḥ svarvatīrapo nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: Animate that Indra to whom sacrifice is due-- sincere, bountiful, adorable; him who frequents sacrifices,who breaks the eggs of Śuṣṇa; you have conquered the celestial waters; may all our enemies perish.

mantras.sanskrit: एवेन्द्राग्निभ्यां पितृवन्नवीयो मन्धातृवदङ्गिरस्वदवाचि । त्रिधातुना शर्मणा पातमस्मान्वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: evendrāgnibhyāṃ pitṛvannavīyo mandhātṛvadaṅgirasvadavāci | tridhātunā śarmaṇā pātamasmānvayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||

translations.english: Thus has a new hymn been addressed to Indra and Agni, as was done by my father, by Mandhātā,by Aṅgirasa; cherish us with a triply defended dwelling; may we be the lords of riches.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मा ऊ षु प्रभूतये वरुणाय मरुद्भ्योऽर्चा विदुष्टरेभ्यः । यो धीता मानुषाणां पश्वो गा इव रक्षति नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmā ū ṣu prabhūtaye varuṇāya marudbhyo'rcā viduṣṭarebhyaḥ | yo dhītā mānuṣāṇāṃ paśvo gā iva rakṣati nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: Offer praise to that opulent Varuṇa, and to the most sage Maruts; (Varuṇa) who protects men by hisacts, as (the herdsman guards) the cattle; may all our adversaries perish.

mantras.sanskrit: तमू षु समना गिरा पितॄणां च मन्मभिः । नाभाकस्य प्रशस्तिभिर्यः सिन्धूनामुपोदये सप्तस्वसा स मध्यमो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamū ṣu samanā girā pitṝṇāṃ ca manmabhiḥ | nābhākasya praśastibhiryaḥ sindhūnāmupodaye saptasvasā sa madhyamo nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: (I praise) with a like praise, with the praises of (my) progenitors, with the eulogies of Nabhāka, thatVaruṇa who rises up in the vicinity of the rivers, and in the midst (of them) has seven sisters; may all ouradversaries perish.

mantras.sanskrit: स क्षपः परि षस्वजे न्युस्रो मायया दधे स विश्वं परि दर्शतः । तस्य वेनीरनु व्रतमुषस्तिस्रो अवर्धयन्नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa kṣapaḥ pari ṣasvaje nyusro māyayā dadhe sa viśvaṃ pari darśataḥ | tasya venīranu vratamuṣastisro avardhayannabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: He embraces the nights; of goodly aspect, and quick of movement, he encompasses the universe byhis acts; all who are desirous (of his favour) diligently offer him worship at the three diurnal rites; may all ouradversaries perish.

mantras.sanskrit: यः ककुभो निधारयः पृथिव्यामधि दर्शतः । स माता पूर्व्यं पदं तद्वरुणस्य सप्त्यं स हि गोपा इवेर्यो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ kakubho nidhārayaḥ pṛthivyāmadhi darśataḥ | sa mātā pūrvyaṃ padaṃ tadvaruṇasya saptyaṃ sa hi gopā iveryo nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: He, who visible above the earth sustains the points of the horizon, is the measurer (of the universe);that is the ancient abode of Varuṇa, to which we have access; he is our lord, like the keeper of cattle; may all ouradversaries perish.

mantras.sanskrit: यो धर्ता भुवनानां य उस्राणामपीच्या वेद नामानि गुह्या । स कविः काव्या पुरु रूपं द्यौरिव पुष्यति नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo dhartā bhuvanānāṃ ya usrāṇāmapīcyā veda nāmāni guhyā | sa kaviḥ kāvyā puru rūpaṃ dyauriva puṣyati nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: He who is the sustainer of the worlds, who knows the hidden and secret names of the (solar) rays, he isthe sage who cherishes the acts of sages, as the heaven cherishes numerous forms; may all our adversariesperish.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्मिन्विश्वानि काव्या चक्रे नाभिरिव श्रिता । त्रितं जूती सपर्यत व्रजे गावो न संयुजे युजे अश्वाँ अयुक्षत नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasminviśvāni kāvyā cakre nābhiriva śritā | tritaṃ jūtī saparyata vraje gāvo na saṃyuje yuje aśvā~ ayukṣata nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: In whom all pious acts are concentrated, like the nave in the (centre of the) wheel, worship him quicklywho abides in the three worlds; as men assemble the cattle in their pasture, so do (our foes) collect their horses(to assail us); may all our adversaries perish.

mantras.sanskrit: य आस्वत्क आशये विश्वा जातान्येषाम् । परि धामानि मर्मृशद्वरुणस्य पुरो गये विश्वे देवा अनु व्रतं नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya āsvatka āśaye viśvā jātānyeṣām | pari dhāmāni marmṛśadvaruṇasya puro gaye viśve devā anu vrataṃ nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: He who, passing amid those (regions of the firmament), given refuge to all their races, and all thedeities precede the chariot of Varuṇa, when manifesting his glories to perform his worship; may all ouradversaries perish.

mantras.sanskrit: स समुद्रो अपीच्यस्तुरो द्यामिव रोहति नि यदासु यजुर्दधे । स माया अर्चिना पदास्तृणान्नाकमारुहन्नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa samudro apīcyasturo dyāmiva rohati ni yadāsu yajurdadhe | sa māyā arcinā padāstṛṇānnākamāruhannabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: He is the hidden ocean; swift he mounts (the heaven) as (the sun) the sky; when he has plural ced thesacrifice in those (regions of the firmament), he demolishes with his brilliant radiance the devices (of the asuras);he ascends to heaven; may all our adversaries perish.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य श्वेता विचक्षणा तिस्रो भूमीरधिक्षितः । त्रिरुत्तराणि पप्रतुर्वरुणस्य ध्रुवं सदः स सप्तानामिरज्यति नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya śvetā vicakṣaṇā tisro bhūmīradhikṣitaḥ | triruttarāṇi papraturvaruṇasya dhruvaṃ sadaḥ sa saptānāmirajyati nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: Of whom, present in the three worlds, the brilliant rays pervade the three realms beyond, the eternaldwelling of Varuṇa, he is lord of the seven (rivers); may all our adversaries perish.

mantras.sanskrit: यः श्वेताँ अधिनिर्णिजश्चक्रे कृष्णाँ अनु व्रता । स धाम पूर्व्यं ममे यः स्कम्भेन वि रोदसी अजो न द्यामधारयन्नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ śvetā~ adhinirṇijaścakre kṛṣṇā~ anu vratā | sa dhāma pūrvyaṃ mame yaḥ skambhena vi rodasī ajo na dyāmadhārayannabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: He who in his successive functions emits his bright rays or turns them dark, first made his residence (inthe firmament), and as the unborn sun the sky, supports with the pillar (of the firmament) both heaven and earth;may all our adversaries perish.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्तभ्नाद्द्यामसुरो विश्ववेदा अमिमीत वरिमाणं पृथिव्याः । आसीदद्विश्वा भुवनानि सम्राड्विश्वेत्तानि वरुणस्य व्रतानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: astabhnāddyāmasuro viśvavedā amimīta varimāṇaṃ pṛthivyāḥ | āsīdadviśvā bhuvanāni samrāḍviśvettāni varuṇasya vratāni ||

translations.english: The possessor of all wealth, the powerful Varuṇa, has fixed the heaven; he has meted the measure ofthe earth; he presides as supreme monarch over all worlds; these all are the functions of Varuṇa

mantras.sanskrit: एवा वन्दस्व वरुणं बृहन्तं नमस्या धीरममृतस्य गोपाम् । स नः शर्म त्रिवरूथं वि यंसत्पातं नो द्यावापृथिवी उपस्थे ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā vandasva varuṇaṃ bṛhantaṃ namasyā dhīramamṛtasya gopām | sa naḥ śarma trivarūthaṃ vi yaṃsatpātaṃ no dyāvāpṛthivī upasthe ||

translations.english: Glorify then the mighty Varuṇa; reverence the wise guardian of the ambrosia; may he bestow upon usa thrice sheltering habitation; may heaven and earth preserve us abiding in their proximity.

mantras.sanskrit: इमां धियं शिक्षमाणस्य देव क्रतुं दक्षं वरुण सं शिशाधि । ययाति विश्वा दुरिता तरेम सुतर्माणमधि नावं रुहेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: imāṃ dhiyaṃ śikṣamāṇasya deva kratuṃ dakṣaṃ varuṇa saṃ śiśādhi | yayāti viśvā duritā tarema sutarmāṇamadhi nāvaṃ ruhema ||

translations.english: Divine Varuṇa, animate the sacred acts of me engaging in this your worship; may we ascend thesafe-bearing vessel by which we may cross all difficulties.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वां ग्रावाणो अश्विना धीभिर्विप्रा अचुच्यवुः । नासत्या सोमपीतये नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāṃ grāvāṇo aśvinā dhībhirviprā acucyavuḥ | nāsatyā somapītaye nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: The sacred stones, Aśvins, the pious worshipers, Nāsatyās, have fallen upon their sacred functions,(to induce you) to drink the Soma; may all our enemies perish.

mantras.sanskrit: यथा वामत्रिरश्विना गीर्भिर्विप्रो अजोहवीत् । नासत्या सोमपीतये नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathā vāmatriraśvinā gīrbhirvipro ajohavīt | nāsatyā somapītaye nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: In like manner as the pious Atri, Aśvins, invoked you with hymns, so (I invoke you), Nāsatyās, todrink the Soma; may all our enemies perish.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा वामह्व ऊतये यथाहुवन्त मेधिराः । नासत्या सोमपीतये नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā vāmahva ūtaye yathāhuvanta medhirāḥ | nāsatyā somapītaye nabhantāmanyake same ||

translations.english: In like manner as the wise invoke you for protection, so do I invoke you, Nāsatyās, to drink the Soma;may all our enemies perish.

mantras.sanskrit: इमे विप्रस्य वेधसोऽग्नेरस्तृतयज्वनः । गिरः स्तोमास ईरते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ime viprasya vedhaso'gnerastṛtayajvanaḥ | giraḥ stomāsa īrate ||

translations.english: These repeaters of laudations recite the praises of the wise creative Agni, the uninterrupted sacrificeṛ

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मै ते प्रतिहर्यते जातवेदो विचर्षणे । अग्ने जनामि सुष्टुतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmai te pratiharyate jātavedo vicarṣaṇe | agne janāmi suṣṭutim ||

translations.english: Agni, Jātavedas, to you, the liberal offerer (of the oblation), the all-beholding, I repeat earnest praise.

mantras.sanskrit: आरोका इव घेदह तिग्मा अग्ने तव त्विषः । दद्भिर्वनानि बप्सति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ārokā iva ghedaha tigmā agne tava tviṣaḥ | dadbhirvanāni bapsati ||

translations.english: Your fierce flames, Agni, consume the forest, as wild animals destroy (the plural nts) with their teeth.

mantras.sanskrit: हरयो धूमकेतवो वातजूता उप द्यवि । यतन्ते वृथगग्नयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: harayo dhūmaketavo vātajūtā upa dyavi | yatante vṛthagagnayaḥ ||

translations.english: The consuming smoke-bannered fires, borne by the wind, spread diversely in the firmament.

mantras.sanskrit: एते त्ये वृथगग्नय इद्धासः समदृक्षत । उषसामिव केतवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ete tye vṛthagagnaya iddhāsaḥ samadṛkṣata | uṣasāmiva ketavaḥ ||

translations.english: These fires separately kindled are beheld like the tokens of the dawn.

mantras.sanskrit: कृष्णा रजांसि पत्सुतः प्रयाणे जातवेदसः । अग्निर्यद्रोधति क्षमि ॥
mantras.transliteration: kṛṣṇā rajāṃsi patsutaḥ prayāṇe jātavedasaḥ | agniryadrodhati kṣami ||

translations.english: Black dust is raised by the feet of Jātavedas when he moves, when Agni spreads on the earth.

mantras.sanskrit: धासिं कृण्वान ओषधीर्बप्सदग्निर्न वायति । पुनर्यन्तरुणीरपि ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhāsiṃ kṛṇvāna oṣadhīrbapsadagnirna vāyati | punaryantaruṇīrapi ||

translations.english: Making the plural nts his food, Agni devouring them is never satiated, but falls again upon the young(shrubs).

mantras.sanskrit: जिह्वाभिरह नन्नमदर्चिषा जञ्जणाभवन् । अग्निर्वनेषु रोचते ॥
mantras.transliteration: jihvābhiraha nannamadarciṣā jañjaṇābhavan | agnirvaneṣu rocate ||

translations.english: Bowing down (the trees) with his tongues (of flame), and blazing with splendour, Agni shines in theforests.

mantras.sanskrit: अप्स्वग्ने सधिष्टव सौषधीरनु रुध्यसे । गर्भे सञ्जायसे पुनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: apsvagne sadhiṣṭava sauṣadhīranu rudhyase | garbhe sañjāyase punaḥ ||

translations.english: Your station, Agni, is in the waters; you cling to the plural nts, and becoming their embryo, are born again.

mantras.sanskrit: उदग्ने तव तद्घृतादर्ची रोचत आहुतम् । निंसानं जुह्वो मुखे ॥
mantras.transliteration: udagne tava tadghṛtādarcī rocata āhutam | niṃsānaṃ juhvo mukhe ||

translations.english: Your lustre, Agni, lambent in the mouth of the ladle, shines when offered from (the oblation of) butter.

mantras.sanskrit: उक्षान्नाय वशान्नाय सोमपृष्ठाय वेधसे । स्तोमैर्विधेमाग्नये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ukṣānnāya vaśānnāya somapṛṣṭhāya vedhase | stomairvidhemāgnaye ||

translations.english: Let us adore with hymns Agni, the granter (of desires), the eater of the ox, the eater of the marrow, onwhose back the libation is poured.

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्वा नमसा वयं होतर्वरेण्यक्रतो । अग्ने समिद्भिरीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tvā namasā vayaṃ hotarvareṇyakrato | agne samidbhirīmahe ||

translations.english: We solicit you, Agni, invoker of the gods, performer of sacred rites, with oblations and with fueḷ

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्वा भृगुवच्छुचे मनुष्वदग्न आहुत । अङ्गिरस्वद्धवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tvā bhṛguvacchuce manuṣvadagna āhuta | aṅgirasvaddhavāmahe ||

translations.english: Holy Agni, to whom oblations are offered, we worship you in like manner (as you have beenworshipped) by Bhṛgu, by Manus, by Aṅgirasa.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं ह्यग्ने अग्निना विप्रो विप्रेण सन्त्सता । सखा सख्या समिध्यसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ hyagne agninā vipro vipreṇa santsatā | sakhā sakhyā samidhyase ||

translations.english: You, Agni, are kindled by Agni; a sage by a sage, saint by a saint, a friend by a friend.

mantras.sanskrit: स त्वं विप्राय दाशुषे रयिं देहि सहस्रिणम् । अग्ने वीरवतीमिषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa tvaṃ viprāya dāśuṣe rayiṃ dehi sahasriṇam | agne vīravatīmiṣam ||

translations.english: Do you, Agni, bestow upon the pious donor (of the oblation) infinite riches and food with male progeny.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने भ्रातः सहस्कृत रोहिदश्व शुचिव्रत । इमं स्तोमं जुषस्व मे ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne bhrātaḥ sahaskṛta rohidaśva śucivrata | imaṃ stomaṃ juṣasva me ||

translations.english: Agni, (our) brother, who are elicited by strength, who have red horses, and are (the performer) of purerites, be propitiated by this my praise.

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्वाग्ने मम स्तुतो वाश्राय प्रतिहर्यते । गोष्ठं गाव इवाशत ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tvāgne mama stuto vāśrāya pratiharyate | goṣṭhaṃ gāva ivāśata ||

translations.english: My praises hasten to you, Agni, as cows enter their stalls (to give milk) to the thirsting calves.

mantras.sanskrit: तुभ्यं ता अङ्गिरस्तम विश्वाः सुक्षितयः पृथक् । अग्ने कामाय येमिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tubhyaṃ tā aṅgirastama viśvāḥ sukṣitayaḥ pṛthak | agne kāmāya yemire ||

translations.english: To you, Agni, who are the chief of the Aṅgirasas, all people have severally recourse for the attainemntof their desires.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निं धीभिर्मनीषिणो मेधिरासो विपश्चितः । अद्मसद्याय हिन्विरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniṃ dhībhirmanīṣiṇo medhirāso vipaścitaḥ | admasadyāya hinvire ||

translations.english: The wise, the intelligent, the sagacious, propitiate Agni with sacrifices for the attainment of food.

mantras.sanskrit: तं त्वामज्मेषु वाजिनं तन्वाना अग्ने अध्वरम् । वह्निं होतारमीळते ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ tvāmajmeṣu vājinaṃ tanvānā agne adhvaram | vahniṃ hotāramīḷate ||

translations.english: Preparing the sacrifice in their mansions, (the worshippers) adore you, Agni, the powerful, the bearer(of the oblation), the invoker of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: पुरुत्रा हि सदृङ्ङसि विशो विश्वा अनु प्रभुः । समत्सु त्वा हवामहे ॥
