mantras.transliteration: purutrā hi sadṛṅṅasi viśo viśvā anu prabhuḥ | samatsu tvā havāmahe ||

translations.english: You are the lord, you behold all people alike in many plural ces; we therefore invoke you in battles.

mantras.sanskrit: तमीळिष्व य आहुतोऽग्निर्विभ्राजते घृतैः । इमं नः शृणवद्धवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamīḷiṣva ya āhuto'gnirvibhrājate ghṛtaiḥ | imaṃ naḥ śṛṇavaddhavam ||

translations.english: Adore that Agni who shines brightly when fed with offerings of butter, who hears this our invocation.

mantras.sanskrit: तं त्वा वयं हवामहे शृण्वन्तं जातवेदसम् । अग्ने घ्नन्तमप द्विषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ tvā vayaṃ havāmahe śṛṇvantaṃ jātavedasam | agne ghnantamapa dviṣaḥ ||

translations.english: We invoke you, Agni, who are Jātavedas, listening (to our praises), exterminating our foes.

mantras.sanskrit: विशां राजानमद्भुतमध्यक्षं धर्मणामिमम् । अग्निमीळे स उ श्रवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśāṃ rājānamadbhutamadhyakṣaṃ dharmaṇāmimam | agnimīḷe sa u śravat ||

translations.english: I praise this Agni, the sovereign of men, the wonderful, the superintendent of holy acts; may he hearme.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निं विश्वायुवेपसं मर्यं न वाजिनं हितम् । सप्तिं न वाजयामसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniṃ viśvāyuvepasaṃ maryaṃ na vājinaṃ hitam | saptiṃ na vājayāmasi ||

translations.english: We invigorate like a horse that (Agni) whose might is everywhere present; who is noble, strong, andbenevolent.

mantras.sanskrit: घ्नन्मृध्राण्यप द्विषो दहन्रक्षांसि विश्वहा । अग्ने तिग्मेन दीदिहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ghnanmṛdhrāṇyapa dviṣo dahanrakṣāṃsi viśvahā | agne tigmena dīdihi ||

translations.english: Slaying the malignant (driving away) our enemies everywhere consuming the rākṣasas, do you, Agniblaze forth with bright (radiance).

mantras.sanskrit: यं त्वा जनास इन्धते मनुष्वदङ्गिरस्तम । अग्ने स बोधि मे वचः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ tvā janāsa indhate manuṣvadaṅgirastama | agne sa bodhi me vacaḥ ||

translations.english: Chief of the Aṅgirasas, whose men kindle as did Manus; Agni, hear my words.

mantras.sanskrit: यदग्ने दिविजा अस्यप्सुजा वा सहस्कृत । तं त्वा गीर्भिर्हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadagne divijā asyapsujā vā sahaskṛta | taṃ tvā gīrbhirhavāmahe ||

translations.english: We worship with praises you, Agni, who are born in heaven or in the waters, elicited by strength.

mantras.sanskrit: तुभ्यं घेत्ते जना इमे विश्वाः सुक्षितयः पृथक् । धासिं हिन्वन्त्यत्तवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tubhyaṃ ghette janā ime viśvāḥ sukṣitayaḥ pṛthak | dhāsiṃ hinvantyattave ||

translations.english: All these people, the inhabitants (of the earth), offer severally to you (sacrificial) food for your eatingand enjoyment.

mantras.sanskrit: ते घेदग्ने स्वाध्योऽहा विश्वा नृचक्षसः । तरन्तः स्याम दुर्गहा ॥
mantras.transliteration: te ghedagne svādhyo'hā viśvā nṛcakṣasaḥ | tarantaḥ syāma durgahā ||

translations.english: Agni, through you, may we, skilled in sacrifices and beholding men all our days, pass through (all)difficulties.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निं मन्द्रं पुरुप्रियं शीरं पावकशोचिषम् । हृद्भिर्मन्द्रेभिरीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniṃ mandraṃ purupriyaṃ śīraṃ pāvakaśociṣam | hṛdbhirmandrebhirīmahe ||

translations.english: We invoke with cheerful and delightful (hymns) the gladdening Agni, dear to many, who abides in thesacrifice with purifying brilliance.

mantras.sanskrit: स त्वमग्ने विभावसुः सृजन्त्सूर्यो न रश्मिभिः । शर्धन्तमांसि जिघ्नसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa tvamagne vibhāvasuḥ sṛjantsūryo na raśmibhiḥ | śardhantamāṃsi jighnase ||

translations.english: Shining forth, Agni, like the rising sun, displaying your strength by your beams, you destroy thedarkness.

mantras.sanskrit: तत्ते सहस्व ईमहे दात्रं यन्नोपदस्यति । त्वदग्ने वार्यं वसु ॥
mantras.transliteration: tatte sahasva īmahe dātraṃ yannopadasyati | tvadagne vāryaṃ vasu ||

translations.english: We solicit from you, strong Agni, that desirable wealth which is in your gift and which decays not.

mantras.sanskrit: समिधाग्निं दुवस्यत घृतैर्बोधयतातिथिम् । आस्मिन्हव्या जुहोतन ॥
mantras.transliteration: samidhāgniṃ duvasyata ghṛtairbodhayatātithim | āsminhavyā juhotana ||

translations.english: Honour Agni with fuel, awaken him, the guest, with (libations of) butter; offer the oblations in him.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने स्तोमं जुषस्व मे वर्धस्वानेन मन्मना । प्रति सूक्तानि हर्य नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne stomaṃ juṣasva me vardhasvānena manmanā | prati sūktāni harya naḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, accept my praise, be invigorated by this prayer; be favourable to our hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निं दूतं पुरो दधे हव्यवाहमुप ब्रुवे । देवाँ आ सादयादिह ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniṃ dūtaṃ puro dadhe havyavāhamupa bruve | devā~ ā sādayādiha ||

translations.english: I set Agni in the front as the messenger, I adore him as the bearer of the oblations; may he cause thegods to sit down here.

mantras.sanskrit: उत्ते बृहन्तो अर्चयः समिधानस्य दीदिवः । अग्ने शुक्रास ईरते ॥
mantras.transliteration: utte bṛhanto arcayaḥ samidhānasya dīdivaḥ | agne śukrāsa īrate ||

translations.english: Brilliant Agni, as you are kindled, your great flames start blazing up.

mantras.sanskrit: उप त्वा जुह्वो मम घृताचीर्यन्तु हर्यत । अग्ने हव्या जुषस्व नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa tvā juhvo mama ghṛtācīryantu haryata | agne havyā juṣasva naḥ ||

translations.english: Let my ladles, filled with butter, come near you, O propitious one; Agni, receive our oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: मन्द्रं होतारमृत्विजं चित्रभानुं विभावसुम् । अग्निमीळे स उ श्रवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mandraṃ hotāramṛtvijaṃ citrabhānuṃ vibhāvasum | agnimīḷe sa u śravat ||

translations.english: I worship Agni, the exhilarating invoker (of the gods), the priest, him who shines forth with various lustre,and is rich in brilliance, may he give car.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रत्नं होतारमीड्यं जुष्टमग्निं कविक्रतुम् । अध्वराणामभिश्रियम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pratnaṃ hotāramīḍyaṃ juṣṭamagniṃ kavikratum | adhvarāṇāmabhiśriyam ||

translations.english: (I worship) the beloved Agni, the ancient adorable invoker (of the gods), the wise, the frequenter ofsacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: जुषाणो अङ्गिरस्तमेमा हव्यान्यानुषक् । अग्ने यज्ञं नय ऋतुथा ॥
mantras.transliteration: juṣāṇo aṅgirastamemā havyānyānuṣak | agne yajñaṃ naya ṛtuthā ||

translations.english: Agni, best of the Aṅgirasas, do you, continually accepting these our oblations, conduct the sacrifice atthe due seasons.

mantras.sanskrit: समिधान उ सन्त्य शुक्रशोच इहा वह । चिकित्वान्दैव्यं जनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: samidhāna u santya śukraśoca ihā vaha | cikitvāndaivyaṃ janam ||

translations.english: Brilliant-flames giver of food, do you, the knower, when kindled, bring the host of the gods here.

mantras.sanskrit: विप्रं होतारमद्रुहं धूमकेतुं विभावसुम् । यज्ञानां केतुमीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: vipraṃ hotāramadruhaṃ dhūmaketuṃ vibhāvasum | yajñānāṃ ketumīmahe ||

translations.english: We solicit the wise invoker (of the gods), the beneficent, the smoke- bannered, the resplendent, thebanner of the sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने नि पाहि नस्त्वं प्रति ष्म देव रीषतः । भिन्धि द्वेषः सहस्कृत ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne ni pāhi nastvaṃ prati ṣma deva rīṣataḥ | bhindhi dveṣaḥ sahaskṛta ||

translations.english: Divine Agni, produced by strength, do you protect us from the injurer, tear asunder our enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निः प्रत्नेन मन्मना शुम्भानस्तन्वं स्वाम् । कविर्विप्रेण वावृधे ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniḥ pratnena manmanā śumbhānastanvaṃ svām | kavirvipreṇa vāvṛdhe ||

translations.english: The wise Agni, beautifying his body with the ancient hymn, has grown in might through the intelligenthymner.

mantras.sanskrit: ऊर्जो नपातमा हुवेऽग्निं पावकशोचिषम् । अस्मिन्यज्ञे स्वध्वरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūrjo napātamā huve'gniṃ pāvakaśociṣam | asminyajñe svadhvare ||

translations.english: I invoke Agni of purifying lustre, the son of (sacrificial) food, in this inviolable sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो मित्रमहस्त्वमग्ने शुक्रेण शोचिषा । देवैरा सत्सि बर्हिषि ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no mitramahastvamagne śukreṇa śociṣā | devairā satsi barhiṣi ||

translations.english: O Agni, adorable to your friends, sit down with the gods on our sacred grass with your resplendentradiance.

mantras.sanskrit: यो अग्निं तन्वो दमे देवं मर्तः सपर्यति । तस्मा इद्दीदयद्वसु ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo agniṃ tanvo dame devaṃ martaḥ saparyati | tasmā iddīdayadvasu ||

translations.english: Whatsoever mortal worships the divine Agni in his house (for the attainment) of wealth, to him he givesriches.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निर्मूर्धा दिवः ककुत्पतिः पृथिव्या अयम् । अपां रेतांसि जिन्वति ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirmūrdhā divaḥ kakutpatiḥ pṛthivyā ayam | apāṃ retāṃsi jinvati ||

translations.english: Agni, the head (of the gods), the summit of heaven-- he the lord of the earth-- gladdens the seed of thewaters.

mantras.sanskrit: उदग्ने शुचयस्तव शुक्रा भ्राजन्त ईरते । तव ज्योतींष्यर्चयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: udagne śucayastava śukrā bhrājanta īrate | tava jyotīṃṣyarcayaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, your pure, bright, shining flames send forth your splendours.

mantras.sanskrit: ईशिषे वार्यस्य हि दात्रस्याग्ने स्वर्पतिः । स्तोता स्यां तव शर्मणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: īśiṣe vāryasya hi dātrasyāgne svarpatiḥ | stotā syāṃ tava śarmaṇi ||

translations.english: Agni, lord of heaven, you preside over (all) that is to be desired or given; may I be your eulogist forhappiness.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने मनीषिणस्त्वां हिन्वन्ति चित्तिभिः । त्वां वर्धन्तु नो गिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmagne manīṣiṇastvāṃ hinvanti cittibhiḥ | tvāṃ vardhantu no giraḥ ||

translations.english: You, Agni, the wise (praise), you they rejoice with (pious) rites; may our praises invigorate you.

mantras.sanskrit: अदब्धस्य स्वधावतो दूतस्य रेभतः सदा । अग्नेः सख्यं वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: adabdhasya svadhāvato dūtasya rebhataḥ sadā | agneḥ sakhyaṃ vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: We ever choose the friendship of Agni, the unharmed, the strong, the messenger, the praiser (of thegods).

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निः शुचिव्रततमः शुचिर्विप्रः शुचिः कविः । शुची रोचत आहुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniḥ śucivratatamaḥ śucirvipraḥ śuciḥ kaviḥ | śucī rocata āhutaḥ ||

translations.english: The pure Agni shines forth when worshipped the purest offerer, the pure priest, the pure sage.

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्वा धीतयो मम गिरो वर्धन्तु विश्वहा । अग्ने सख्यस्य बोधि नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tvā dhītayo mama giro vardhantu viśvahā | agne sakhyasya bodhi naḥ ||

translations.english: May my rites also and my praises ever invigorate you Agni, take thought of our friendship.

mantras.sanskrit: यदग्ने स्यामहं त्वं त्वं वा घा स्या अहम् । स्युष्टे सत्या इहाशिषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadagne syāmahaṃ tvaṃ tvaṃ vā ghā syā aham | syuṣṭe satyā ihāśiṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, if I were you or you were I, your wishes here should come true.

mantras.sanskrit: वसुर्वसुपतिर्हि कमस्यग्ने विभावसुः । स्याम ते सुमतावपि ॥
mantras.transliteration: vasurvasupatirhi kamasyagne vibhāvasuḥ | syāma te sumatāvapi ||

translations.english: Agni, you are rich in splendour, the lord of wealth, and the giver of dwellings; may we too abide in yourfavour.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने धृतव्रताय ते समुद्रायेव सिन्धवः । गिरो वाश्रास ईरते ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne dhṛtavratāya te samudrāyeva sindhavaḥ | giro vāśrāsa īrate ||

translations.english: Agni, my loud praises proceed to you, observant of pious rites, as rivers to the sea.

mantras.sanskrit: युवानं विश्पतिं कविं विश्वादं पुरुवेपसम् । अग्निं शुम्भामि मन्मभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvānaṃ viśpatiṃ kaviṃ viśvādaṃ puruvepasam | agniṃ śumbhāmi manmabhiḥ ||

translations.english: I glorify with hymns the ever-young Agni, the lord of men, the wise, the all-devouring, the performer ofmany acts.

mantras.sanskrit: यज्ञानां रथ्ये वयं तिग्मजम्भाय वीळवे । स्तोमैरिषेमाग्नये ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajñānāṃ rathye vayaṃ tigmajambhāya vīḷave | stomairiṣemāgnaye ||

translations.english: Let us seek with our hymns Agni, the conductor of the sacrifices, the mighty, the sharp-jawed.

mantras.sanskrit: अयमग्ने त्वे अपि जरिता भूतु सन्त्य । तस्मै पावक मृळय ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayamagne tve api jaritā bhūtu santya | tasmai pāvaka mṛḷaya ||

translations.english: May this (my family) also be your worshippers, adorable Agni; O purifier, give them happinesṣ

mantras.sanskrit: धीरो ह्यस्यद्मसद्विप्रो न जागृविः सदा । अग्ने दीदयसि द्यवि ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhīro hyasyadmasadvipro na jāgṛviḥ sadā | agne dīdayasi dyavi ||

translations.english: You verily are wise, seated at the oblation, wakeful as the seer (for the welfare of living beings); Agni,you ever shine in the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: पुराग्ने दुरितेभ्यः पुरा मृध्रेभ्यः कवे । प्र ण आयुर्वसो तिर ॥
mantras.transliteration: purāgne duritebhyaḥ purā mṛdhrebhyaḥ kave | pra ṇa āyurvaso tira ||

translations.english: Wise Agni, giver of dwellings, extend our lives,before sins or assailants (destroy us).

mantras.sanskrit: आ घा ये अग्निमिन्धते स्तृणन्ति बर्हिरानुषक् । येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā ghā ye agnimindhate stṛṇanti barhirānuṣak | yeṣāmindro yuvā sakhā ||

translations.english: Those (sages) who kindle Agni, those of whom the ever-young Indra is the friend, continually spreadthe sacred grass.

mantras.sanskrit: बृहन्निदिध्म एषां भूरि शस्तं पृथुः स्वरुः । येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhannididhma eṣāṃ bhūri śastaṃ pṛthuḥ svaruḥ | yeṣāmindro yuvā sakhā ||

translations.english: Ample is their fuel, many their hymns, broad their sacred shaving-- whose friend is the ever-youngIndra.

mantras.sanskrit: अयुद्ध इद्युधा वृतं शूर आजति सत्वभिः । येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayuddha idyudhā vṛtaṃ śūra ājati satvabhiḥ | yeṣāmindro yuvā sakhā ||

translations.english: Though before powerless to combat, the hero by his might now subdues one surrounded by allies, (ifhelped by those) of whom the ever-young Indra is the friend.

mantras.sanskrit: आ बुन्दं वृत्रहा ददे जातः पृच्छद्वि मातरम् । क उग्राः के ह शृण्विरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā bundaṃ vṛtrahā dade jātaḥ pṛcchadvi mātaram | ka ugrāḥ ke ha śṛṇvire ||

translations.english: The slayer of Vṛtra, as soon as he was born, seized his arrow, and asked his mother, "who are theterrible, who are renowned?"

mantras.sanskrit: प्रति त्वा शवसी वदद्गिरावप्सो न योधिषत् । यस्ते शत्रुत्वमाचके ॥
mantras.transliteration: prati tvā śavasī vadadgirāvapso na yodhiṣat | yaste śatrutvamācake ||

translations.english: Your strong mother answered you, "he who wishes your enmity fights as the elephant in the mountain".

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्वं मघवञ्छृणु यस्ते वष्टि ववक्षि तत् । यद्वीळयासि वीळु तत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tvaṃ maghavañchṛṇu yaste vaṣṭi vavakṣi tat | yadvīḷayāsi vīḷu tat ||

translations.english: O Maghavan, do you hear (our praise); whosoever desires of you, you bear to him his request, whatyou fix is sure.

mantras.sanskrit: यदाजिं यात्याजिकृदिन्द्रः स्वश्वयुरुप । रथीतमो रथीनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadājiṃ yātyājikṛdindraḥ svaśvayurupa | rathītamo rathīnām ||

translations.english: When Indra, the warrior, goes to battle, desirous of gallant steeds, he is the foremost of the lords ofchariots.

mantras.sanskrit: वि षु विश्वा अभियुजो वज्रिन्विष्वग्यथा वृह । भवा नः सुश्रवस्तमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi ṣu viśvā abhiyujo vajrinviṣvagyathā vṛha | bhavā naḥ suśravastamaḥ ||

translations.english: Thunderer, smite all your enemies that you may be scattered-- be to us a most abundant benefactor.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्माकं सु रथं पुर इन्द्रः कृणोतु सातये । न यं धूर्वन्ति धूर्तयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmākaṃ su rathaṃ pura indraḥ kṛṇotu sātaye | na yaṃ dhūrvanti dhūrtayaḥ ||

translations.english: May Indra, whom no foes can harm, send before us a beautiful chariot for the acquisition (of ourdesires).

mantras.sanskrit: वृज्याम ते परि द्विषोऽरं ते शक्र दावने । गमेमेदिन्द्र गोमतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛjyāma te pari dviṣo'raṃ te śakra dāvane | gamemedindra gomataḥ ||

translations.english: Surround Indra, may we escape your enemies; may we come to you abundantly for your gifts, rich incattle.

mantras.sanskrit: शनैश्चिद्यन्तो अद्रिवोऽश्वावन्तः शतग्विनः । विवक्षणा अनेहसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śanaiścidyanto adrivo'śvāvantaḥ śatagvinaḥ | vivakṣaṇā anehasaḥ ||

translations.english: (May we come), thunderer, slowly approaching you-- may we be rich in horses, possessed of abundanttreasure, ready to offer, and unharmed (by calamity).

mantras.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वा हि ते दिवेदिवे सहस्रा सूनृता शता । जरितृभ्यो विमंहते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūrdhvā hi te divedive sahasrā sūnṛtā śatā | jaritṛbhyo vimaṃhate ||

translations.english: (The sacrificer) gives to your praisers day by day hundreds and thousands of excellent and auspiciousgifts.

mantras.sanskrit: विद्मा हि त्वा धनंजयमिन्द्र दृळ्हा चिदारुजम् । आदारिणं यथा गयम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vidmā hi tvā dhanaṃjayamindra dṛḷhā cidārujam | ādāriṇaṃ yathā gayam ||

translations.english: We know you, Indra, as the conqueror of wealth, the breaker of firm obstacles, the opener, and(guarding from harm) as a house.

mantras.sanskrit: ककुहं चित्त्वा कवे मन्दन्तु धृष्णविन्दवः । आ त्वा पणिं यदीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: kakuhaṃ cittvā kave mandantu dhṛṣṇavindavaḥ | ā tvā paṇiṃ yadīmahe ||

translations.english: Wise (Indra) overcomer of enemies, when we solicit you the barterer, may the drops of the Somaexhilarate you the exalted one.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्ते रेवाँ अदाशुरिः प्रममर्ष मघत्तये । तस्य नो वेद आ भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaste revā~ adāśuriḥ pramamarṣa maghattaye | tasya no veda ā bhara ||

translations.english: Grant to us the possessions of that rich man who, through his niggardliness, reviles you as to yourbestowal of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: इम उ त्वा वि चक्षते सखाय इन्द्र सोमिनः । पुष्टावन्तो यथा पशुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ima u tvā vi cakṣate sakhāya indra sominaḥ | puṣṭāvanto yathā paśum ||

translations.english: These friends, effusing the Soma, look on you, Indra, as men with their fodder ready (look) on theircattle.

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्वाबधिरं वयं श्रुत्कर्णं सन्तमूतये । दूरादिह हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tvābadhiraṃ vayaṃ śrutkarṇaṃ santamūtaye | dūrādiha havāmahe ||

translations.english: We invoke you here from afar for our protection, who are never deaf, and whose ears are always opento hear.

mantras.sanskrit: यच्छुश्रूया इमं हवं दुर्मर्षं चक्रिया उत । भवेरापिर्नो अन्तमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yacchuśrūyā imaṃ havaṃ durmarṣaṃ cakriyā uta | bhaverāpirno antamaḥ ||

translations.english: If you hear this our prayer, then display your invincible power and be our nearest kinsman.

mantras.sanskrit: यच्चिद्धि ते अपि व्यथिर्जगन्वांसो अमन्महि । गोदा इदिन्द्र बोधि नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yacciddhi te api vyathirjaganvāṃso amanmahi | godā idindra bodhi naḥ ||

translations.english: Whenever, repairing to you in our distress, we offer our praises, attend to us, Indra, as a giver of cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: आ त्वा रम्भं न जिव्रयो ररभ्मा शवसस्पते । उश्मसि त्वा सधस्थ आ ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tvā rambhaṃ na jivrayo rarabhmā śavasaspate | uśmasi tvā sadhastha ā ||

translations.english: Lord of might, we lean on you as the aged on a staff; we long for you in the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तोत्रमिन्द्राय गायत पुरुनृम्णाय सत्वने । नकिर्यं वृण्वते युधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: stotramindrāya gāyata purunṛmṇāya satvane | nakiryaṃ vṛṇvate yudhi ||

translations.english: Sing the praise to Indra, who is rich in wealth and bountiful, whom none can slay in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि त्वा वृषभा सुते सुतं सृजामि पीतये । तृम्पा व्यश्नुही मदम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi tvā vṛṣabhā sute sutaṃ sṛjāmi pītaye | tṛmpā vyaśnuhī madam ||

translations.english: When the Soma is effused, I pour the libation to you, showerer (of blessings), for your drinking; satiateyourself, enjoy the exhilarating draught.

mantras.sanskrit: मा त्वा मूरा अविष्यवो मोपहस्वान आ दभन् । माकीं ब्रह्मद्विषो वनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā tvā mūrā aviṣyavo mopahasvāna ā dabhan | mākīṃ brahmadviṣo vanaḥ ||

translations.english: Let not fools, seeking protection, nor mockers trouble you; favour not the enemies of the brāhmaṇaṣ

mantras.sanskrit: इह त्वा गोपरीणसा महे मन्दन्तु राधसे । सरो गौरो यथा पिब ॥
mantras.transliteration: iha tvā goparīṇasā mahe mandantu rādhase | saro gauro yathā piba ||

translations.english: Let (the worships) gladden you here with the Soma mixed with milk, for the attainment of great wealth;drink it as the buffalo a lake.

mantras.sanskrit: या वृत्रहा परावति सना नवा च चुच्युवे । ता संसत्सु प्र वोचत ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā vṛtrahā parāvati sanā navā ca cucyuve | tā saṃsatsu pra vocata ||

translations.english: Proclaim in our assemblies those perpetual and ever new riches which the slayer of Vṛtra sends fromafar.

mantras.sanskrit: अपिबत्कद्रुवः सुतमिन्द्रः सहस्रबाह्वे । अत्रादेदिष्ट पौंस्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: apibatkadruvaḥ sutamindraḥ sahasrabāhve | atrādediṣṭa pauṃsyam ||

translations.english: Indra drank the Soma offering of Kadru, (he smote the enemies) of the thousand-armed; there did hismight shine forth.

mantras.sanskrit: सत्यं तत्तुर्वशे यदौ विदानो अह्नवाय्यम् । व्यानट् तुर्वणे शमि ॥
mantras.transliteration: satyaṃ tatturvaśe yadau vidāno ahnavāyyam | vyānaṭ turvaṇe śami ||

translations.english: Well-knowing those (sacrificial) deeds of Turvaśa and Yadu, he overcame Anhavāyya in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: तरणिं वो जनानां त्रदं वाजस्य गोमतः । समानमु प्र शंसिषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taraṇiṃ vo janānāṃ tradaṃ vājasya gomataḥ | samānamu pra śaṃsiṣam ||

translations.english: I praise our common (Indra), the deliverer of your families, the slayer (of your enemies, the bestower) ofriches in cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋभुक्षणं न वर्तव उक्थेषु तुग्र्यावृधम् । इन्द्रं सोमे सचा सुते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛbhukṣaṇaṃ na vartava uktheṣu tugryāvṛdham | indraṃ some sacā sute ||

translations.english: (I praise) in hymns the mighty Indra, the augmenter of waters, for the attainment of wealth, when theSoma is effused with (song).

mantras.sanskrit: यः कृन्तदिद्वि योन्यं त्रिशोकाय गिरिं पृथुम् । गोभ्यो गातुं निरेतवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ kṛntadidvi yonyaṃ triśokāya giriṃ pṛthum | gobhyo gātuṃ niretave ||

translations.english: (Indra), who clove for Triśoka the broad womb-like cloud, (and made) a path for the cows to issueforth?

mantras.sanskrit: यद्दधिषे मनस्यसि मन्दानः प्रेदियक्षसि । मा तत्करिन्द्र मृळय ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaddadhiṣe manasyasi mandānaḥ prediyakṣasi | mā tatkarindra mṛḷaya ||

translations.english: Whatever you undertake in your exhilaration, whatever you purpose in your mind or are thinking tobestow-- O Indra, do it not, but bless us.

mantras.sanskrit: दभ्रं चिद्धि त्वावतः कृतं शृण्वे अधि क्षमि । जिगात्विन्द्र ते मनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dabhraṃ ciddhi tvāvataḥ kṛtaṃ śṛṇve adhi kṣami | jigātvindra te manaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, the least deeds of one like you are renowned in the earth; may your care visit me.

mantras.sanskrit: तवेदु ताः सुकीर्तयोऽसन्नुत प्रशस्तयः । यदिन्द्र मृळयासि नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tavedu tāḥ sukīrtayo'sannuta praśastayaḥ | yadindra mṛḷayāsi naḥ ||

translations.english: Yours be those ascriptions of praise, your those hymns, through which, Indra, you bless us.

mantras.sanskrit: मा न एकस्मिन्नागसि मा द्वयोरुत त्रिषु । वधीर्मा शूर भूरिषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā na ekasminnāgasi mā dvayoruta triṣu | vadhīrmā śūra bhūriṣu ||

translations.english: Slay us not for one sin, not for two, not for three; O hero, slay us not for many.

mantras.sanskrit: बिभया हि त्वावत उग्रादभिप्रभङ्गिणः । दस्मादहमृतीषहः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bibhayā hi tvāvata ugrādabhiprabhaṅgiṇaḥ | dasmādahamṛtīṣahaḥ ||

translations.english: I am afraid of one like you, terrible, the smiter of enemies, the destroyer, who endures hostie attacks.

mantras.sanskrit: मा सख्युः शूनमा विदे मा पुत्रस्य प्रभूवसो । आवृत्वद्भूतु ते मनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā sakhyuḥ śūnamā vide mā putrasya prabhūvaso | āvṛtvadbhūtu te manaḥ ||

translations.english: Wealthy (Indra), may I never have to tell you of the destitutuion of my friend or my son; may your mindbe favourable towards me.

mantras.sanskrit: को नु मर्या अमिथितः सखा सखायमब्रवीत् । जहा को अस्मदीषते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ko nu maryā amithitaḥ sakhā sakhāyamabravīt | jahā ko asmadīṣate ||

translations.english: "Who, O mortals", said (Indra), "unprovoked, has ever, as a friend, slain his friend? Who fleeth fromme?"

mantras.sanskrit: एवारे वृषभा सुतेऽसिन्वन्भूर्यावयः । श्वघ्नीव निवता चरन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: evāre vṛṣabhā sute'sinvanbhūryāvayaḥ | śvaghnīva nivatā caran ||

translations.english: Showerer (of benefits), when the ready Soma was effused, you did devour much, without stint, rushingdown like a gameste.

mantras.sanskrit: आ त एता वचोयुजा हरी गृभ्णे सुमद्रथा । यदीं ब्रह्मभ्य इद्ददः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā ta etā vacoyujā harī gṛbhṇe sumadrathā | yadīṃ brahmabhya iddadaḥ ||

translations.english: I draw here your two steeds, harnessed to a beauiful chariot and yoked by hymns, since you givewealth to the brāhmaṇas.

mantras.sanskrit: भिन्धि विश्वा अप द्विषः परि बाधो जही मृधः । वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhindhi viśvā apa dviṣaḥ pari bādho jahī mṛdhaḥ | vasu spārhaṃ tadā bhara ||

translations.english: Cleave asunder all the hostile hosts, frustrate their destructive attacks, and bestow on us their desirablewealth.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्वीळाविन्द्र यत्स्थिरे यत्पर्शाने पराभृतम् । वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadvīḷāvindra yatsthire yatparśāne parābhṛtam | vasu spārhaṃ tadā bhara ||

translations.english: Bestow on us, Indra, that desirable wealth, which is deosited in strongholds, in fastnesses, and inplaces which can stand an attack.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य ते विश्वमानुषो भूरेर्दत्तस्य वेदति । वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya te viśvamānuṣo bhūrerdattasya vedati | vasu spārhaṃ tadā bhara ||

translations.english: Bestow on us, Indra, that desirable wealth which all men recognize as given abundantly by you.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वावतः पुरूवसो वयमिन्द्र प्रणेतः । स्मसि स्थातर्हरीणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāvataḥ purūvaso vayamindra praṇetaḥ | smasi sthātarharīṇām ||

translations.english: O wealthy Indra, the leader (of rites), we belong to one like you, ruler of horses.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वां हि सत्यमद्रिवो विद्म दातारमिषाम् । विद्म दातारं रयीणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāṃ hi satyamadrivo vidma dātāramiṣām | vidma dātāraṃ rayīṇām ||

translations.english: You, thunderer, we verily know to be giver of food, you we know to be the give of riches.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यस्य ते महिमानं शतमूते शतक्रतो । गीर्भिर्गृणन्ति कारवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yasya te mahimānaṃ śatamūte śatakrato | gīrbhirgṛṇanti kāravaḥ ||

translations.english: O Śatakratu, wielding a hundred protections, whose greatness the worshippers praise with theirhymns.

mantras.sanskrit: सुनीथो घा स मर्त्यो यं मरुतो यमर्यमा । मित्रः पान्त्यद्रुहः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sunītho ghā sa martyo yaṃ maruto yamaryamā | mitraḥ pāntyadruhaḥ ||

translations.english: Fortunate in sacrifice is that mortal whom the guileless Maruts, whom Aryaman and Mitra, protect.

mantras.sanskrit: दधानो गोमदश्ववत्सुवीर्यमादित्यजूत एधते । सदा राया पुरुस्पृहा ॥
mantras.transliteration: dadhāno gomadaśvavatsuvīryamādityajūta edhate | sadā rāyā puruspṛhā ||

translations.english: He who is directed by Āditya ever increases, possessing abundance of kine and horses and vigorouschildren; he increases in wealth longed for by many.

mantras.sanskrit: तमिन्द्रं दानमीमहे शवसानमभीर्वम् । ईशानं राय ईमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamindraṃ dānamīmahe śavasānamabhīrvam | īśānaṃ rāya īmahe ||

translations.english: We solicit a gift from this Indra, the displayer of might, the fearless; we solicit wealth from the lord.

mantras.sanskrit: तस्मिन्हि सन्त्यूतयो विश्वा अभीरवः सचा । तमा वहन्तु सप्तयः पुरूवसुं मदाय हरयः सुतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tasminhi santyūtayo viśvā abhīravaḥ sacā | tamā vahantu saptayaḥ purūvasuṃ madāya harayaḥ sutam ||

translations.english: In him abide united all secure protections; lord of vast wealth, may his gliding steeds bear him to theexpressed Soma for his exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्ते मदो वरेण्यो य इन्द्र वृत्रहन्तमः । य आददिः स्वर्नृभिर्यः पृतनासु दुष्टरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaste mado vareṇyo ya indra vṛtrahantamaḥ | ya ādadiḥ svarnṛbhiryaḥ pṛtanāsu duṣṭaraḥ ||

translations.english: That exhilaration of your, Indra, which is pre-eminent, which utterly desroys your enemies, which winswealth from men, and is invincible in battles.

mantras.sanskrit: यो दुष्टरो विश्ववार श्रवाय्यो वाजेष्वस्ति तरुता । स नः शविष्ठ सवना वसो गहि गमेम गोमति व्रजे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo duṣṭaro viśvavāra śravāyyo vājeṣvasti tarutā | sa naḥ śaviṣṭha savanā vaso gahi gamema gomati vraje ||

translations.english: Which is invincibel in contests -- O you desired by all-- well-worthy of praise and the deliverer (fromenemies); come to our oblations, most mighty one, giver of dwellings; may we obtain a stall full of kine.

mantras.sanskrit: गव्यो षु णो यथा पुराश्वयोत रथया । वरिवस्य महामह ॥
mantras.transliteration: gavyo ṣu ṇo yathā purāśvayota rathayā | varivasya mahāmaha ||

translations.english: Lord of wealth, visit us as of old, go give us cows, horses and chariots.

mantras.sanskrit: नहि ते शूर राधसोऽन्तं विन्दामि सत्रा । दशस्या नो मघवन्नू चिदद्रिवो धियो वाजेभिराविथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahi te śūra rādhaso'ntaṃ vindāmi satrā | daśasyā no maghavannū cidadrivo dhiyo vājebhirāvitha ||

translations.english: Verily, hero, I find no limit to your wealth; O Maghavan, the thunderer, bestow (your gifts) quickly uponus, and bless our offerings with (abundant) food.

mantras.sanskrit: य ऋष्वः श्रावयत्सखा विश्वेत्स वेद जनिमा पुरुष्टुतः । तं विश्वे मानुषा युगेन्द्रं हवन्ते तविषं यतस्रुचः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya ṛṣvaḥ śrāvayatsakhā viśvetsa veda janimā puruṣṭutaḥ | taṃ viśve mānuṣā yugendraṃ havante taviṣaṃ yatasrucaḥ ||

translations.english: The graceful Indra, whose friends extol him, knows, praised of many, all births; him, the mighty, all meninvoke at all times, seizing the ladles (for oblation).

mantras.sanskrit: स नो वाजेष्वविता पुरूवसुः पुरस्थाता मघवा वृत्रहा भुवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no vājeṣvavitā purūvasuḥ purasthātā maghavā vṛtrahā bhuvat ||

translations.english: May Maghavan, the wealthy, the slayer of Vṛtra, stand before us as our defender in battles.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि वो वीरमन्धसो मदेषु गाय गिरा महा विचेतसम् । इन्द्रं नाम श्रुत्यं शाकिनं वचो यथा ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi vo vīramandhaso madeṣu gāya girā mahā vicetasam | indraṃ nāma śrutyaṃ śākinaṃ vaco yathā ||

translations.english: At the time of the exhilaration of the Soma, sing, according to your hymns, with a loud voice, you wisehero Indra, the humbler of enemies, the strong, the ever-worthy to be praised.

mantras.sanskrit: ददी रेक्णस्तन्वे ददिर्वसु ददिर्वाजेषु पुरुहूत वाजिनम् । नूनमथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: dadī rekṇastanve dadirvasu dadirvājeṣu puruhūta vājinam | nūnamatha ||

translations.english: (Indra), invoked by many, speedily give me wealth; give riches, give abundance of food in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वेषामिरज्यन्तं वसूनां सासह्वांसं चिदस्य वर्पसः । कृपयतो नूनमत्यथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśveṣāmirajyantaṃ vasūnāṃ sāsahvāṃsaṃ cidasya varpasaḥ | kṛpayato nūnamatyatha ||

translations.english: (We praise you), the lord of all riches, the subduer of this obstructor waging (attacks), -- speedily giveus abundant (wealth).

mantras.sanskrit: महः सु वो अरमिषे स्तवामहे मीळ्हुषे अरंगमाय जग्मये । यज्ञेभिर्गीर्भिर्विश्वमनुषां मरुतामियक्षसि गाये त्वा नमसा गिरा ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahaḥ su vo aramiṣe stavāmahe mīḷhuṣe araṃgamāya jagmaye | yajñebhirgīrbhirviśvamanuṣāṃ marutāmiyakṣasi gāye tvā namasā girā ||

translations.english: I desire the coming of you, the mighty one, we give praise with oblations and ymns to the showerer whohastens readily (to the sacrifice), associated with the Maruts, you are worshipped of all men; I glorify you withadoration and praise.

mantras.sanskrit: ये पातयन्ते अज्मभिर्गिरीणां स्नुभिरेषाम् । यज्ञं महिष्वणीनां सुम्नं तुविष्वणीनां प्राध्वरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye pātayante ajmabhirgirīṇāṃ snubhireṣām | yajñaṃ mahiṣvaṇīnāṃ sumnaṃ tuviṣvaṇīnāṃ prādhvare ||

translations.english: (We present) the oblation to those loud-sounding (Maruts) who rush along with the streaming trains ofthe clouds; may we obtain in the sacrifice the happiness which those deep-roarers bestow.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रभङ्गं दुर्मतीनामिन्द्र शविष्ठा भर । रयिमस्मभ्यं युज्यं चोदयन्मते ज्येष्ठं चोदयन्मते ॥
mantras.transliteration: prabhaṅgaṃ durmatīnāmindra śaviṣṭhā bhara | rayimasmabhyaṃ yujyaṃ codayanmate jyeṣṭhaṃ codayanmate ||

translations.english: (We worship) the crusher of the malevolent, most powerful Indra, bring to us suitable wealth, Oinspirer-- (bring) most excellent( wealth), O inspirer.

mantras.sanskrit: सनितः सुसनितरुग्र चित्र चेतिष्ठ सूनृत । प्रासहा सम्राट् सहुरिं सहन्तं भुज्युं वाजेषु पूर्व्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sanitaḥ susanitarugra citra cetiṣṭha sūnṛta | prāsahā samrāṭ sahuriṃ sahantaṃ bhujyuṃ vājeṣu pūrvyam ||

translations.english: O bountiful, mos bountiful, mighty, wondeful, best giver of knowledge and supremely truthful, by yourprowess, universal ruler, (bring to us) in conflicts ample wealth, overpowering those who attack us, and causingenjoyment.

mantras.sanskrit: आ स एतु य ईवदाँ अदेवः पूर्तमाददे । यथा चिद्वशो अश्व्यः पृथुश्रवसि कानीतेऽस्या व्युष्याददे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā sa etu ya īvadā~ adevaḥ pūrtamādade | yathā cidvaśo aśvyaḥ pṛthuśravasi kānīte'syā vyuṣyādade ||

translations.english: Let him draw near, who, though not a god, would receive this complete living gift-- since Vaśa, the sonof Aśva, receives it at the dawn of this (morning) at the hands of Pṛthuśravas, the son of Kānīta.

mantras.sanskrit: षष्टिं सहस्राश्व्यस्यायुतासनमुष्ट्रानां विंशतिं शता । दश श्यावीनां शता दश त्र्यरुषीणां दश गवां सहस्रा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṣaṣṭiṃ sahasrāśvyasyāyutāsanamuṣṭrānāṃ viṃśatiṃ śatā | daśa śyāvīnāṃ śatā daśa tryaruṣīṇāṃ daśa gavāṃ sahasrā ||

translations.english: I have received sixty thousand horses, and ens of housands-- a score of hundreds of camels-- athousand brown mares-- and ten times ten thousand cows with three red patches.

mantras.sanskrit: दश श्यावा ऋधद्रयो वीतवारास आशवः । मथ्रा नेमिं नि वावृतुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: daśa śyāvā ṛdhadrayo vītavārāsa āśavaḥ | mathrā nemiṃ ni vāvṛtuḥ ||

translations.english: Ten brown horses bear along the wheel (of my chariot), of mature vigour, of complete power, andtrampling down obstacles.

mantras.sanskrit: दानासः पृथुश्रवसः कानीतस्य सुराधसः । रथं हिरण्ययं ददन्मंहिष्ठः सूरिरभूद्वर्षिष्ठमकृत श्रवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dānāsaḥ pṛthuśravasaḥ kānītasya surādhasaḥ | rathaṃ hiraṇyayaṃ dadanmaṃhiṣṭhaḥ sūrirabhūdvarṣiṣṭhamakṛta śravaḥ ||

translations.english: These arehtje gifts of the wealthy Pṛthuśravas, the son of Kānīta; he, bestowing a golden chariot,has proved himself most liberal and wise, he has won most abundant fame.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो वायो महे तने याहि मखाय पाजसे । वयं हि ते चकृमा भूरि दावने सद्यश्चिन्महि दावने ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no vāyo mahe tane yāhi makhāya pājase | vayaṃ hi te cakṛmā bhūri dāvane sadyaścinmahi dāvane ||

translations.english: Come to us, Vāyu, to bestow great wealth and glorious strength; we have offered (libations) to you thegiver of abundant (wealth), we have offered immediately to you the giver of great (gifts).

mantras.sanskrit: यो अश्वेभिर्वहते वस्त उस्रास्त्रिः सप्त सप्ततीनाम् । एभिः सोमेभिः सोमसुद्भिः सोमपा दानाय शुक्रपूतपाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo aśvebhirvahate vasta usrāstriḥ sapta saptatīnām | ebhiḥ somebhiḥ somasudbhiḥ somapā dānāya śukrapūtapāḥ ||

translations.english: He who is borne on horses and surrounds himself with thrice seven times seventy cows-- he comes toyou with these Soma-libations and Soma-priests, to offer to you, drinker of the Soma, drinker of the bright pureSoma.

mantras.sanskrit: यो म इमं चिदु त्मनामन्दच्चित्रं दावने । अरट्वे अक्षे नहुषे सुकृत्वनि सुकृत्तराय सुक्रतुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo ma imaṃ cidu tmanāmandaccitraṃ dāvane | araṭve akṣe nahuṣe sukṛtvani sukṛttarāya sukratuḥ ||

translations.english: He who of his own will has been plural ased to give me this honoured gift, he, performer of good works,(has determined) on a pre-eminently good action, amid Aratva, Nahuṣa and Sukṛtvan.

mantras.sanskrit: उचथ्ये वपुषि यः स्वराळुत वायो घृतस्नाः । अश्वेषितं रजेषितं शुनेषितं प्राज्म तदिदं नु तत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ucathye vapuṣi yaḥ svarāḷuta vāyo ghṛtasnāḥ | aśveṣitaṃ rajeṣitaṃ śuneṣitaṃ prājma tadidaṃ nu tat ||

translations.english: He who is self-resplendent in his glorious body, who is bright, O Vāyu, like ghī, has given me thisfood, brought by horses, brought by camels, brought by dogs.

mantras.sanskrit: अध प्रियमिषिराय षष्टिं सहस्रासनम् । अश्वानामिन्न वृष्णाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha priyamiṣirāya ṣaṣṭiṃ sahasrāsanam | aśvānāminna vṛṣṇām ||

translations.english: I have now received (a gift) dear to the beneficent king, sixty thousand bulls vigorous like horses.

mantras.sanskrit: गावो न यूथमुप यन्ति वध्रय उप मा यन्ति वध्रयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: gāvo na yūthamupa yanti vadhraya upa mā yanti vadhrayaḥ ||

translations.english: As the cows to the herd, so repair the oxen; so the oxen repair to me.

mantras.sanskrit: अध यच्चारथे गणे शतमुष्ट्राँ अचिक्रदत् । अध श्वित्नेषु विंशतिं शता ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha yaccārathe gaṇe śatamuṣṭrā~ acikradat | adha śvitneṣu viṃśatiṃ śatā ||

translations.english: Since, when the herd were wandering (to the wood), he called a hundred camels (to give them to me),and two thousand from among the white herds (of cows).

mantras.sanskrit: शतं दासे बल्बूथे विप्रस्तरुक्ष आ ददे । ते ते वायविमे जना मदन्तीन्द्रगोपा मदन्ति देवगोपाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śataṃ dāse balbūthe viprastarukṣa ā dade | te te vāyavime janā madantīndragopā madanti devagopāḥ ||

translations.english: I, the sage, accep the hundred from the slave Balbūtha, the cowherd; we here are your, O Vāyu-those who have Indra and the gods for protectors rejoice (through your favour).

mantras.sanskrit: अध स्या योषणा मही प्रतीची वशमश्व्यम् । अधिरुक्मा वि नीयते ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha syā yoṣaṇā mahī pratīcī vaśamaśvyam | adhirukmā vi nīyate ||

translations.english: This tall maiden, adorned with gold, is led towards me, Vaśa, the son of Aśva.

mantras.sanskrit: महि वो महतामवो वरुण मित्र दाशुषे । यमादित्या अभि द्रुहो रक्षथा नेमघं नशदनेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahi vo mahatāmavo varuṇa mitra dāśuṣe | yamādityā abhi druho rakṣathā nemaghaṃ naśadanehaso va ūtayaḥ sutayo va ūtayaḥ ||

translations.english: Mitra and Varuṇa, you are great, and great is your protection to the offerer; no evil, Ādityas, harmshim whom you guard from the injurer; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.

mantras.sanskrit: विदा देवा अघानामादित्यासो अपाकृतिम् । पक्षा वयो यथोपरि व्यस्मे शर्म यच्छतानेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vidā devā aghānāmādityāso apākṛtim | pakṣā vayo yathopari vyasme śarma yacchatānehaso va ūtayaḥ sutayo va ūtayaḥ ||

translations.english: Divine Ādityas, you know the averting of evils; as birds (spread) their wings over (their) young, grantus happiness; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.

mantras.sanskrit: व्यस्मे अधि शर्म तत्पक्षा वयो न यन्तन । विश्वानि विश्ववेदसो वरूथ्या मनामहेऽनेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vyasme adhi śarma tatpakṣā vayo na yantana | viśvāni viśvavedaso varūthyā manāmahe'nehaso va ūtayaḥ sutayo va ūtayaḥ ||

translations.english: Grant us that happiness of yours, as birds (spread) their wings; O you possessed of all wealth, wesolicit all riches suitable for our dwelling; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्मा अरासत क्षयं जीवातुं च प्रचेतसः । मनोर्विश्वस्य घेदिम आदित्या राय ईशतेऽनेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasmā arāsata kṣayaṃ jīvātuṃ ca pracetasaḥ | manorviśvasya ghedima ādityā rāya īśate'nehaso va ūtayaḥ sutayo va ūtayaḥ ||

translations.english: To whomsoever these wise Ādityas gran a dwelling and the means of life, (for him) they master thewealth of every man; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.

mantras.sanskrit: परि णो वृणजन्नघा दुर्गाणि रथ्यो यथा । स्यामेदिन्द्रस्य शर्मण्यादित्यानामुतावस्यनेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari ṇo vṛṇajannaghā durgāṇi rathyo yathā | syāmedindrasya śarmaṇyādityānāmutāvasyanehaso va ūtayaḥ sutayo va ūtayaḥ ||

translations.english: May our sins avoid us as charioteers inaccessible plural ce; may we abide in Indra's happiness and in theprotection of the Ādiyas; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.

mantras.sanskrit: परिह्वृतेदना जनो युष्मादत्तस्य वायति । देवा अदभ्रमाश वो यमादित्या अहेतनानेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: parihvṛtedanā jano yuṣmādattasya vāyati | devā adabhramāśa vo yamādityā ahetanānehaso va ūtayaḥ sutayo va ūtayaḥ ||

translations.english: Only by painful means does a living man obtain the wealth which you bestow; but he whom you, divineĀdityas, visit, wins great (riches); your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.

mantras.sanskrit: न तं तिग्मं चन त्यजो न द्रासदभि तं गुरु । यस्मा उ शर्म सप्रथ आदित्यासो अराध्वमनेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: na taṃ tigmaṃ cana tyajo na drāsadabhi taṃ guru | yasmā u śarma sapratha ādityāso arādhvamanehaso va ūtayaḥ sutayo va ūtayaḥ ||

translations.english: Him fierce wrath touches not, nor heavy (calamity), to whom, Ādityas, you have given greathappiness; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.

mantras.sanskrit: युष्मे देवा अपि ष्मसि युध्यन्त इव वर्मसु । यूयं महो न एनसो यूयमर्भादुरुष्यतानेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuṣme devā api ṣmasi yudhyanta iva varmasu | yūyaṃ maho na enaso yūyamarbhāduruṣyatānehaso va ūtayaḥ sutayo va ūtayaḥ ||

translations.english: Deities, may we abide in you as warriors in their armour; do you defend us from great evil, do youdefend us from litt;e your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.

mantras.sanskrit: अदितिर्न उरुष्यत्वदितिः शर्म यच्छतु । माता मित्रस्य रेवतोऽर्यम्णो वरुणस्य चानेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aditirna uruṣyatvaditiḥ śarma yacchatu | mātā mitrasya revato'ryamṇo varuṇasya cānehaso va ūtayaḥ sutayo va ūtayaḥ ||

translations.english: May Aditi defend us, may Aditi grant us happiness, the mother of the wealthy Mitra, Aryama andVaruṇa; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्देवाः शर्म शरणं यद्भद्रं यदनातुरम् । त्रिधातु यद्वरूथ्यं तदस्मासु वि यन्तनानेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaddevāḥ śarma śaraṇaṃ yadbhadraṃ yadanāturam | tridhātu yadvarūthyaṃ tadasmāsu vi yantanānehaso va ūtayaḥ sutayo va ūtayaḥ ||

translations.english: Grant to us, deities, that happiness which is a refuge, auspicious, and free from sickness, which isthreefold and fit for a (secure) shelter; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.

mantras.sanskrit: आदित्या अव हि ख्यताधि कूलादिव स्पशः । सुतीर्थमर्वतो यथानु नो नेषथा सुगमनेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ādityā ava hi khyatādhi kūlādiva spaśaḥ | sutīrthamarvato yathānu no neṣathā sugamanehaso va ūtayaḥ sutayo va ūtayaḥ ||

translations.english: Ādityas, look down upon us as those who look from the shore; as (men lead) their horses to a secureGhāṭa, so conduct us along a good path; your aids are void of harm, your aids are void of harm, your aids aretrue aids.

mantras.sanskrit: नेह भद्रं रक्षस्विने नावयै नोपया उत । गवे च भद्रं धेनवे वीराय च श्रवस्यतेऽनेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: neha bhadraṃ rakṣasvine nāvayai nopayā uta | gave ca bhadraṃ dhenave vīrāya ca śravasyate'nehaso va ūtayaḥ sutayo va ūtayaḥ ||

translations.english: Let there not be prosperit here to our powerul (foe), nor to him who threaten or assails us; but let therebe prosperity to our cattle, our kine, and our male offspring desirous of food; your aids are void of harm, your aidsare true aids.

mantras.sanskrit: यदाविर्यदपीच्यं देवासो अस्ति दुष्कृतम् । त्रिते तद्विश्वमाप्त्य आरे अस्मद्दधातनानेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadāviryadapīcyaṃ devāso asti duṣkṛtam | trite tadviśvamāptya āre asmaddadhātanānehaso va ūtayaḥ sutayo va ūtayaḥ ||

translations.english: Deities, whatever evil is manifest, whatever is concealed, (let it be not found) in Trita Āptya, keep it farfrom us; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.

mantras.sanskrit: यच्च गोषु दुष्ष्वप्न्यं यच्चास्मे दुहितर्दिवः । त्रिताय तद्विभावर्याप्त्याय परा वहानेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yacca goṣu duṣṣvapnyaṃ yaccāsme duhitardivaḥ | tritāya tadvibhāvaryāptyāya parā vahānehaso va ūtayaḥ sutayo va ūtayaḥ ||

translations.english: Daughter of heaven, (Uṣas), whatever ill-omened dream threatens our cattle, keep it, O brilliant one,far from Trita Āptya; y our aids are void of harm, your aids, are true aids.

mantras.sanskrit: निष्कं वा घा कृणवते स्रजं वा दुहितर्दिवः । त्रिते दुष्ष्वप्न्यं सर्वमाप्त्ये परि दद्मस्यनेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: niṣkaṃ vā ghā kṛṇavate srajaṃ vā duhitardivaḥ | trite duṣṣvapnyaṃ sarvamāptye pari dadmasyanehaso va ūtayaḥ sutayo va ūtayaḥ ||

translations.english: Daughter of heaven, whatever ill-omened dream threatens Trita Āptya, we transfer it to the worker ofgold ornaments or to the maker of garlands; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.

mantras.sanskrit: तदन्नाय तदपसे तं भागमुपसेदुषे । त्रिताय च द्विताय चोषो दुष्ष्वप्न्यं वहानेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadannāya tadapase taṃ bhāgamupaseduṣe | tritāya ca dvitāya coṣo duṣṣvapnyaṃ vahānehaso va ūtayaḥ sutayo va ūtayaḥ ||

translations.english: Uṣas, bear (elsewhere) the ill-omened dream for Trita and Dvita, who eat and do (in dreams) that(which is eaten and done amiss when awake) and who obtain that (inauspicious) portion; your aids are void ofharm, your aids are true aids.

mantras.sanskrit: यथा कलां यथा शफं यथ ऋणं संनयामसि । एवा दुष्ष्वप्न्यं सर्वमाप्त्ये सं नयामस्यनेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathā kalāṃ yathā śaphaṃ yatha ṛṇaṃ saṃnayāmasi | evā duṣṣvapnyaṃ sarvamāptye saṃ nayāmasyanehaso va ūtayaḥ sutayo va ūtayaḥ ||

translations.english: As (in the sacrifice) we put severally together the proper parts and the hoofs, and as we discharge adebt, so we transfer all the ill-omened dream that rests on Āptya; your aids are void of harm, your aids are trueaids.

mantras.sanskrit: अजैष्माद्यासनाम चाभूमानागसो वयम् । उषो यस्माद्दुष्ष्वप्न्यादभैष्माप तदुच्छत्वनेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ajaiṣmādyāsanāma cābhūmānāgaso vayam | uṣo yasmādduṣṣvapnyādabhaiṣmāpa taducchatvanehaso va ūtayaḥ sutayo va ūtayaḥ ||

translations.english: May we be today victorious, and obtain (happiness); may we be free from evil; Uṣas, may that ill dreamdepart, of which we were afraid; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वादोरभक्षि वयसः सुमेधाः स्वाध्यो वरिवोवित्तरस्य । विश्वे यं देवा उत मर्त्यासो मधु ब्रुवन्तो अभि संचरन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: svādorabhakṣi vayasaḥ sumedhāḥ svādhyo varivovittarasya | viśve yaṃ devā uta martyāso madhu bruvanto abhi saṃcaranti ||

translations.english: May I, the wise and devout, enjoy the delicious, abundantly honoured Soma food, which all gods andmortals, pronouncing sweet, seek to obtain.

mantras.sanskrit: अन्तश्च प्रागा अदितिर्भवास्यवयाता हरसो दैव्यस्य । इन्दविन्द्रस्य सख्यं जुषाणः श्रौष्टीव धुरमनु राय ऋध्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: antaśca prāgā aditirbhavāsyavayātā haraso daivyasya | indavindrasya sakhyaṃ juṣāṇaḥ śrauṣṭīva dhuramanu rāya ṛdhyāḥ ||

translations.english: You enter within, and unimpaired, you avert the anger of the gods; Soma, enjoying the friendship ofIndra, may you bring us to wealth as a swift (horse) its burden.

mantras.sanskrit: अपाम सोमममृता अभूमागन्म ज्योतिरविदाम देवान् । किं नूनमस्मान्कृणवदरातिः किमु धूर्तिरमृत मर्त्यस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: apāma somamamṛtā abhūmāganma jyotiravidāma devān | kiṃ nūnamasmānkṛṇavadarātiḥ kimu dhūrtiramṛta martyasya ||

translations.english: We drink the Soma, may we become immortal; we have attained the light of (heaven), we have knownthe gods; what now could the enemy do to us, or what, O immortal, should the aggriever do to the mortal?

mantras.sanskrit: शं नो भव हृद आ पीत इन्दो पितेव सोम सूनवे सुशेवः । सखेव सख्य उरुशंस धीरः प्र ण आयुर्जीवसे सोम तारीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaṃ no bhava hṛda ā pīta indo piteva soma sūnave suśevaḥ | sakheva sakhya uruśaṃsa dhīraḥ pra ṇa āyurjīvase soma tārīḥ ||

translations.english: O soma, drunk by us, be bliss to our hearts, as a father is indulgent to a son or a friend to a friend; OSoma, worthy of wide praise, do you, wise one, extend our years that we may live.

mantras.sanskrit: इमे मा पीता यशस उरुष्यवो रथं न गावः समनाह पर्वसु । ते मा रक्षन्तु विस्रसश्चरित्रादुत मा स्रामाद्यवयन्त्विन्दवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ime mā pītā yaśasa uruṣyavo rathaṃ na gāvaḥ samanāha parvasu | te mā rakṣantu visrasaścaritrāduta mā srāmādyavayantvindavaḥ ||

translations.english: May these glory-conferring protecting Soma-streams knit together my joints as cows draw together achariot falling in pieces; may they keep us from a loosely-knit worship; may they deliver me from sickness.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निं न मा मथितं सं दिदीपः प्र चक्षय कृणुहि वस्यसो नः । अथा हि ते मद आ सोम मन्ये रेवाँ इव प्र चरा पुष्टिमच्छ ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniṃ na mā mathitaṃ saṃ didīpaḥ pra cakṣaya kṛṇuhi vasyaso naḥ | athā hi te mada ā soma manye revā~ iva pra carā puṣṭimaccha ||

translations.english: Soma, kindle me like the fire ignited by attrition, brighten (our eyes) and make us rich; I praise you nowfor exhilaration; come now, full of wealth, to nourish us.

mantras.sanskrit: इषिरेण ते मनसा सुतस्य भक्षीमहि पित्र्यस्येव रायः । सोम राजन्प्र ण आयूंषि तारीरहानीव सूर्यो वासराणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: iṣireṇa te manasā sutasya bhakṣīmahi pitryasyeva rāyaḥ | soma rājanpra ṇa āyūṃṣi tārīrahānīva sūryo vāsarāṇi ||

translations.english: May we partake of you, effused, with a longing mind as (men enjoy) paternal wealth; King Soma,prolong our lives, as the sun the world-establishing day.

mantras.sanskrit: सोम राजन्मृळया नः स्वस्ति तव स्मसि व्रत्यास्तस्य विद्धि । अलर्ति दक्ष उत मन्युरिन्दो मा नो अर्यो अनुकामं परा दाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: soma rājanmṛḷayā naḥ svasti tava smasi vratyāstasya viddhi | alarti dakṣa uta manyurindo mā no aryo anukāmaṃ parā dāḥ ||

translations.english: King Soma, bless us for our welfare; we worshippers are yours, do you recognize it; the enemy goesstrong and fierce, O Soma; give us not over to him as he desires.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं हि नस्तन्वः सोम गोपा गात्रेगात्रे निषसत्था नृचक्षाः । यत्ते वयं प्रमिनाम व्रतानि स नो मृळ सुषखा देव वस्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ hi nastanvaḥ soma gopā gātregātre niṣasatthā nṛcakṣāḥ | yatte vayaṃ pramināma vratāni sa no mṛḷa suṣakhā deva vasyaḥ ||

translations.english: O Soma, you are the guardian of our bodies, you dwell in each limb as the beholder of man; though weimpair your rites, yet, divine one, bless us, you who are possessed of most excellent food and good friends.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋदूदरेण सख्या सचेय यो मा न रिष्येद्धर्यश्व पीतः । अयं यः सोमो न्यधाय्यस्मे तस्मा इन्द्रं प्रतिरमेम्यायुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛdūdareṇa sakhyā saceya yo mā na riṣyeddharyaśva pītaḥ | ayaṃ yaḥ somo nyadhāyyasme tasmā indraṃ pratiramemyāyuḥ ||

translations.english: May I obtain a wholesome friend who, when quaffed, will not harm me, O lord of bay horses; I ask ofIndra a long permanence for this Soma which has been plural ced within us.

mantras.sanskrit: अप त्या अस्थुरनिरा अमीवा निरत्रसन्तमिषीचीरभैषुः । आ सोमो अस्माँ अरुहद्विहाया अगन्म यत्र प्रतिरन्त आयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: apa tyā asthuranirā amīvā niratrasantamiṣīcīrabhaiṣuḥ | ā somo asmā~ aruhadvihāyā aganma yatra pratiranta āyuḥ ||

translations.english: May those irremovable sicknesses depart; let those strong (pains) which have made us tremble, beafraid; the mighty Soma has climbed into us, we have attained that (draught) by which men prolong life.

mantras.sanskrit: यो न इन्दुः पितरो हृत्सु पीतोऽमर्त्यो मर्त्याँ आविवेश । तस्मै सोमाय हविषा विधेम मृळीके अस्य सुमतौ स्याम ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo na induḥ pitaro hṛtsu pīto'martyo martyā~ āviveśa | tasmai somāya haviṣā vidhema mṛḷīke asya sumatau syāma ||

translations.english: That Soma which, drunk into our hearts, has entered, immortal, into us mortals-- to him, fathers, let usdo worship with oblations; may we abide in his bliss and favour.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं सोम पितृभिः संविदानोऽनु द्यावापृथिवी आ ततन्थ । तस्मै त इन्दो हविषा विधेम वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ soma pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidāno'nu dyāvāpṛthivī ā tatantha | tasmai ta indo haviṣā vidhema vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||

translations.english: Soma, you in conjunction with the fathers do stretch our successively heaven and earth-- to you let usdo worship with oblations, may we be lords of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रातारो देवा अधि वोचता नो मा नो निद्रा ईशत मोत जल्पिः । वयं सोमस्य विश्वह प्रियासः सुवीरासो विदथमा वदेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: trātāro devā adhi vocatā no mā no nidrā īśata mota jalpiḥ | vayaṃ somasya viśvaha priyāsaḥ suvīrāso vidathamā vadema ||

translations.english: Guardian gods, speak favourably to us; let no dreams nor the censurer overpower us; may we be everdear to Soma; possessed of brave offspring, may we utter our hymn.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं नः सोम विश्वतो वयोधास्त्वं स्वर्विदा विशा नृचक्षाः । त्वं न इन्द ऊतिभिः सजोषाः पाहि पश्चातादुत वा पुरस्तात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ naḥ soma viśvato vayodhāstvaṃ svarvidā viśā nṛcakṣāḥ | tvaṃ na inda ūtibhiḥ sajoṣāḥ pāhi paścātāduta vā purastāt ||

translations.english: You, Soma, give us food from every side; you are the bestower of heaven; enter us, beholder of men; OSoma, rejoicing with your protecting powers, guard us from behind and before.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि प्र वः सुराधसमिन्द्रमर्च यथा विदे । यो जरितृभ्यो मघवा पुरूवसुः सहस्रेणेव शिक्षति ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi pra vaḥ surādhasamindramarca yathā vide | yo jaritṛbhyo maghavā purūvasuḥ sahasreṇeva śikṣati ||

translations.english: I would praise to you the bounteous Indra as is fit, the wealth- abounding Maghavan, who loves to helpwith thousandfold treasure those who praise him.

mantras.sanskrit: शतानीकेव प्र जिगाति धृष्णुया हन्ति वृत्राणि दाशुषे । गिरेरिव प्र रसा अस्य पिन्विरे दत्राणि पुरुभोजसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śatānīkeva pra jigāti dhṛṣṇuyā hanti vṛtrāṇi dāśuṣe | gireriva pra rasā asya pinvire datrāṇi purubhojasaḥ ||

translations.english: He rushes on boldly like a weapon with a hundred edges, he smites the enemies of his worshipper; thegifts of him who feeds many, swell like the streams of a mountain.

mantras.sanskrit: आ त्वा सुतास इन्दवो मदा य इन्द्र गिर्वणः । आपो न वज्रिन्नन्वोक्यं सरः पृणन्ति शूर राधसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tvā sutāsa indavo madā ya indra girvaṇaḥ | āpo na vajrinnanvokyaṃ saraḥ pṛṇanti śūra rādhase ||

translations.english: The expressed exhilarate Soma, O Indra, lover of hymns, fills you for bounty, O hero, O thunderer, asthe waters flow to their accusative tomed lake.

mantras.sanskrit: अनेहसं प्रतरणं विवक्षणं मध्वः स्वादिष्ठमीं पिब । आ यथा मन्दसानः किरासि नः प्र क्षुद्रेव त्मना धृषत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: anehasaṃ prataraṇaṃ vivakṣaṇaṃ madhvaḥ svādiṣṭhamīṃ piba | ā yathā mandasānaḥ kirāsi naḥ pra kṣudreva tmanā dhṛṣat ||

translations.english: Drink the incomparable, helpful, swelling Soma, the sweet of the Soma, that in your exultation you maypour out treasure for us, just as the mill-stone pours out meal.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नः स्तोममुप द्रवद्धियानो अश्वो न सोतृभिः । यं ते स्वधावन्त्स्वदयन्ति धेनव इन्द्र कण्वेषु रातयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā naḥ stomamupa dravaddhiyāno aśvo na sotṛbhiḥ | yaṃ te svadhāvantsvadayanti dhenava indra kaṇveṣu rātayaḥ ||

translations.english: Come quickly to our praise--urged on by the Soma-pressers like a horse- - which the kine make sweet,for you, O Indra, of independent mighty; there are gifts (for you) among the Kaṇva's.

mantras.sanskrit: उग्रं न वीरं नमसोप सेदिम विभूतिमक्षितावसुम् । उद्रीव वज्रिन्नवतो न सिञ्चते क्षरन्तीन्द्र धीतयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ugraṃ na vīraṃ namasopa sedima vibhūtimakṣitāvasum | udrīva vajrinnavato na siñcate kṣarantīndra dhītayaḥ ||

translations.english: We have approached you with homage like a mighty hero, the pre-eminent one, of imperishable wealth;O Indra, thunderer, our prayers flow forth as an abundant fountain pours out its streams.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्ध नूनं यद्वा यज्ञे यद्वा पृथिव्यामधि । अतो नो यज्ञमाशुभिर्महेमत उग्र उग्रेभिरा गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaddha nūnaṃ yadvā yajñe yadvā pṛthivyāmadhi | ato no yajñamāśubhirmahemata ugra ugrebhirā gahi ||

translations.english: Whether you are now present at a sacrifice, or whether you are abroad on the earth, come from thencewith your swift steeds to our sacrifice, O you of lofty counsel, come, strong one, with the strong (steeds).

mantras.sanskrit: अजिरासो हरयो ये त आशवो वाता इव प्रसक्षिणः । येभिरपत्यं मनुषः परीयसे येभिर्विश्वं स्वर्दृशे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ajirāso harayo ye ta āśavo vātā iva prasakṣiṇaḥ | yebhirapatyaṃ manuṣaḥ parīyase yebhirviśvaṃ svardṛśe ||

translations.english: Agile and swift are your steeds, overpowering like the winds; with which you encircle the race of Manus,with which he whole heaven becomes visible.

mantras.sanskrit: एतावतस्त ईमह इन्द्र सुम्नस्य गोमतः । यथा प्रावो मघवन्मेध्यातिथिं यथा नीपातिथिं धने ॥
mantras.transliteration: etāvatasta īmaha indra sumnasya gomataḥ | yathā prāvo maghavanmedhyātithiṃ yathā nīpātithiṃ dhane ||

translations.english: O Indra, we long for such a bounty of yours, rich in kine; (help us), Maghavan, as you did helpMedhyātithi with wealth, as you did help Nīpātithi.

mantras.sanskrit: यथा कण्वे मघवन्त्रसदस्यवि यथा पक्थे दशव्रजे । यथा गोशर्ये असनोॠजिश्वनीन्द्र गोमद्धिरण्यवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathā kaṇve maghavantrasadasyavi yathā pakthe daśavraje | yathā gośarye asanoṝjiśvanīndra gomaddhiraṇyavat ||

translations.english: As you, Mahavan, did give abundant kine and gold to Kaṇva and Trasadasyu, to Paktha andDaśavraja; as you did give them to Gośarya and Ṛjiśvan.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सु श्रुतं सुराधसमर्चा शक्रमभिष्टये । यः सुन्वते स्तुवते काम्यं वसु सहस्रेणेव मंहते ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra su śrutaṃ surādhasamarcā śakramabhiṣṭaye | yaḥ sunvate stuvate kāmyaṃ vasu sahasreṇeva maṃhate ||

translations.english: I would praise the far-famed, the bounteous Śakra, for the sake of his protection, who gives desirablewealth by thousands to the presser of the Soma and the offerer of hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: शतानीका हेतयो अस्य दुष्टरा इन्द्रस्य समिषो महीः । गिरिर्न भुज्मा मघवत्सु पिन्वते यदीं सुता अमन्दिषुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śatānīkā hetayo asya duṣṭarā indrasya samiṣo mahīḥ | girirna bhujmā maghavatsu pinvate yadīṃ sutā amandiṣuḥ ||

translations.english: Invincible are his hundred-edged weapons, he mighty arrows of Indra; he pours forth blessings on hisliberal worshippers like a mountain rich in springs, when the effused Soma has exhilarated him.

mantras.sanskrit: यदीं सुतास इन्दवोऽभि प्रियममन्दिषुः । आपो न धायि सवनं म आ वसो दुघा इवोप दाशुषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadīṃ sutāsa indavo'bhi priyamamandiṣuḥ | āpo na dhāyi savanaṃ ma ā vaso dughā ivopa dāśuṣe ||

translations.english: When the effused Soma-drops have exhilarated the beloved one, my oblation is offered abundantly likethe waters, O gracious Indra-- it is like the kine to the worshipper.

mantras.sanskrit: अनेहसं वो हवमानमूतये मध्वः क्षरन्ति धीतयः । आ त्वा वसो हवमानास इन्दव उप स्तोत्रेषु दधिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: anehasaṃ vo havamānamūtaye madhvaḥ kṣaranti dhītayaḥ | ā tvā vaso havamānāsa indava upa stotreṣu dadhire ||

translations.english: The prayers which consecrate the Soma flow forth to the incomparable one who calls you for hisfavour, the Soma-drops which invoke you, O gracious one, have set you in the midst of the hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नः सोमे स्वध्वर इयानो अत्यो न तोशते । यं ते स्वदावन्त्स्वदन्ति गूर्तयः पौरे छन्दयसे हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā naḥ some svadhvara iyāno atyo na tośate | yaṃ te svadāvantsvadanti gūrtayaḥ paure chandayase havam ||

translations.english: He rushes hurrying like a horse to the Soma offered in our festival, which the hymns make sweet toyou, O you that love sweet viands, you approve the summons to the satisfying Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वीरमुग्रं विविचिं धनस्पृतं विभूतिं राधसो महः । उद्रीव वज्रिन्नवतो वसुत्वना सदा पीपेथ दाशुषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vīramugraṃ viviciṃ dhanaspṛtaṃ vibhūtiṃ rādhaso mahaḥ | udrīva vajrinnavato vasutvanā sadā pīpetha dāśuṣe ||

translations.english: Praise the mighty hero, wide-grasping, spoil-harrying, who has control over vast treasure; you, Othunderer ever pour forth wealth to the worshipper like an abundan fountain.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्ध नूनं परावति यद्वा पृथिव्यां दिवि । युजान इन्द्र हरिभिर्महेमत ऋष्व ऋष्वेभिरा गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaddha nūnaṃ parāvati yadvā pṛthivyāṃ divi | yujāna indra haribhirmahemata ṛṣva ṛṣvebhirā gahi ||

translations.english: Whether you are in the far distance or in the earth or in heaven, O Indra, god of lofty counsel, yoke yoursteeds, come here, lofty one, with the lofty.

mantras.sanskrit: रथिरासो हरयो ये ते अस्रिध ओजो वातस्य पिप्रति । येभिर्नि दस्युं मनुषो निघोषयो येभिः स्वः परीयसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: rathirāso harayo ye te asridha ojo vātasya piprati | yebhirni dasyuṃ manuṣo nighoṣayo yebhiḥ svaḥ parīyase ||

translations.english: Your harmless steeds which draw your chariot, which surpass the strength of the wind, with which yousilence the enemy of man and with which you go round the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: एतावतस्ते वसो विद्याम शूर नव्यसः । यथा प्राव एतशं कृत्व्ये धने यथा वशं दशव्रजे ॥
mantras.transliteration: etāvataste vaso vidyāma śūra navyasaḥ | yathā prāva etaśaṃ kṛtvye dhane yathā vaśaṃ daśavraje ||

translations.english: May we once more know you as such, O gracious hero, as when you did aid Etaśa in the decisivebattle, or Vaśa against Daśavraja.

mantras.sanskrit: यथा कण्वे मघवन्मेधे अध्वरे दीर्घनीथे दमूनसि । यथा गोशर्ये असिषासो अद्रिवो मयि गोत्रं हरिश्रियम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathā kaṇve maghavanmedhe adhvare dīrghanīthe damūnasi | yathā gośarye asiṣāso adrivo mayi gotraṃ hariśriyam ||

translations.english: As you were willing to give, O Maghavan, to Kaṇva in the sacrificial feast, or to Dīrghanītha thefriend of the house, as you were willing to give, O slinger, to Gośarya, so give to me a herd of kine shining likegold.

mantras.sanskrit: यथा मनौ सांवरणौ सोममिन्द्रापिबः सुतम् । नीपातिथौ मघवन्मेध्यातिथौ पुष्टिगौ श्रुष्टिगौ सचा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathā manau sāṃvaraṇau somamindrāpibaḥ sutam | nīpātithau maghavanmedhyātithau puṣṭigau śruṣṭigau sacā ||

translations.english: As you did drink, O Indra, the effused Soma beside Manu, the descendant of Saṃvaraṇa, byNīpātithi and Medhyātithi, by Puṣṭigu and Śruṣṭigu, O Maghavan (so do you drink it here).

mantras.sanskrit: पार्षद्वाणः प्रस्कण्वं समसादयच्छयानं जिव्रिमुद्धितम् । सहस्राण्यसिषासद्गवामृषिस्त्वोतो दस्यवे वृकः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pārṣadvāṇaḥ praskaṇvaṃ samasādayacchayānaṃ jivrimuddhitam | sahasrāṇyasiṣāsadgavāmṛṣistvoto dasyave vṛkaḥ ||

translations.english: The descendant of Pṛṣadvana entertained the aged Praskaṇva who lay rejected (by his kindred);aided by you the seer Dasyave-vṛka desired to obtain thousands of cows.

mantras.sanskrit: य उक्थेभिर्न विन्धते चिकिद्य ऋषिचोदनः । इन्द्रं तमच्छा वद नव्यस्या मत्यरिष्यन्तं न भोजसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya ukthebhirna vindhate cikidya ṛṣicodanaḥ | indraṃ tamacchā vada navyasyā matyariṣyantaṃ na bhojase ||

translations.english: Sing that Indra with the new hymn who has no lack of praises, who is wise and the inspirer of seers,who is as it were eager to enjoy.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्मा अर्कं सप्तशीर्षाणमानृचुस्त्रिधातुमुत्तमे पदे । स त्विमा विश्वा भुवनानि चिक्रददादिज्जनिष्ट पौंस्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasmā arkaṃ saptaśīrṣāṇamānṛcustridhātumuttame pade | sa tvimā viśvā bhuvanāni cikradadādijjaniṣṭa pauṃsyam ||

translations.english: He to whom they sang the seven-headed hymn with its three parts in the highest region, he has madeall these worlds tremble, and has thus brought forth his power.

mantras.sanskrit: यो नो दाता वसूनामिन्द्रं तं हूमहे वयम् । विद्मा ह्यस्य सुमतिं नवीयसीं गमेम गोमति व्रजे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo no dātā vasūnāmindraṃ taṃ hūmahe vayam | vidmā hyasya sumatiṃ navīyasīṃ gamema gomati vraje ||

translations.english: We invoke that Indra who gives us wealth; for we know his new favour; may we obtain a stall rich incows.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्मै त्वं वसो दानाय शिक्षसि स रायस्पोषमश्नुते । तं त्वा वयं मघवन्निन्द्र गिर्वणः सुतावन्तो हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasmai tvaṃ vaso dānāya śikṣasi sa rāyaspoṣamaśnute | taṃ tvā vayaṃ maghavannindra girvaṇaḥ sutāvanto havāmahe ||

translations.english: He whom you help, O gracious one, to give, obtains abundance of wealth; bringing the Soma we invokeyou, Indra, Maghavan, you that love hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: कदा चन स्तरीरसि नेन्द्र सश्चसि दाशुषे । उपोपेन्नु मघवन्भूय इन्नु ते दानं देवस्य पृच्यते ॥
mantras.transliteration: kadā cana starīrasi nendra saścasi dāśuṣe | upopennu maghavanbhūya innu te dānaṃ devasya pṛcyate ||

translations.english: Never are you niggardly, Indra, and give not to the worshipper; but your godlike gifts, O Maghavan, arepoured forth more and more.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र यो ननक्षे अभ्योजसा क्रिविं वधैः शुष्णं निघोषयन् । यदेदस्तम्भीत्प्रथयन्नमूं दिवमादिज्जनिष्ट पार्थिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra yo nanakṣe abhyojasā kriviṃ vadhaiḥ śuṣṇaṃ nighoṣayan | yadedastambhītprathayannamūṃ divamādijjaniṣṭa pārthivaḥ ||

translations.english: He who overpowered Krivi by his might and silences Suṣṇa with his weapons, when he spread abroadyonder sky and propped it up, then first the dweller on earth was born.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्यायं विश्व आर्यो दासः शेवधिपा अरिः । तिरश्चिदर्ये रुशमे परीरवि तुभ्येत्सो अज्यते रयिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasyāyaṃ viśva āryo dāsaḥ śevadhipā ariḥ | tiraścidarye ruśame parīravi tubhyetso ajyate rayiḥ ||

translations.english: That wealth, which every Ārya here covets and every miserly Dāsa, is sent direct to yo, the piousRuśama Paviru.

mantras.sanskrit: तुरण्यवो मधुमन्तं घृतश्चुतं विप्रासो अर्कमानृचुः । अस्मे रयिः पप्रथे वृष्ण्यं शवोऽस्मे सुवानास इन्दवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: turaṇyavo madhumantaṃ ghṛtaścutaṃ viprāso arkamānṛcuḥ | asme rayiḥ paprathe vṛṣṇyaṃ śavo'sme suvānāsa indavaḥ ||

translations.english: The zealous seers have sung a hymn, sweet with Soma and dropping ghī; wealth and manly strengthhav espread themselves among us, and so too the expressed Soma drops.

mantras.sanskrit: यथा मनौ विवस्वति सोमं शक्रापिबः सुतम् । यथा त्रिते छन्द इन्द्र जुजोषस्यायौ मादयसे सचा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathā manau vivasvati somaṃ śakrāpibaḥ sutam | yathā trite chanda indra jujoṣasyāyau mādayase sacā ||

translations.english: As you, Śakra, did drink the effused Soma from Manu Vivasvat, as you did accept the hymn from Trita,so do you gladden yourself with Āyu.

mantras.sanskrit: पृषध्रे मेध्ये मातरिश्वनीन्द्र सुवाने अमन्दथाः । यथा सोमं दशशिप्रे दशोण्ये स्यूमरश्मावृजूनसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: pṛṣadhre medhye mātariśvanīndra suvāne amandathāḥ | yathā somaṃ daśaśipre daśoṇye syūmaraśmāvṛjūnasi ||

translations.english: You did enjoy, Indra, the effused drink with Pṛṣadhra, Medhya and Mātariśvan, just as you did drinkthe Soma with Daśaśipra, Daśoṇya, Syumaraśmi, and Ṛjunas.

mantras.sanskrit: य उक्था केवला दधे यः सोमं धृषितापिबत् । यस्मै विष्णुस्त्रीणि पदा विचक्रम उप मित्रस्य धर्मभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya ukthā kevalā dadhe yaḥ somaṃ dhṛṣitāpibat | yasmai viṣṇustrīṇi padā vicakrama upa mitrasya dharmabhiḥ ||

translations.english: (It is Indra) who has appropriated the hymns for himself, who has bravely drunk the Soma, for whomViṣṇu strode the three steps according to the ordinances of Mitra.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य त्वमिन्द्र स्तोमेषु चाकनो वाजे वाजिञ्छतक्रतो । तं त्वा वयं सुदुघामिव गोदुहो जुहूमसि श्रवस्यवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya tvamindra stomeṣu cākano vāje vājiñchatakrato | taṃ tvā vayaṃ sudughāmiva goduho juhūmasi śravasyavaḥ ||

translations.english: O Śatakratu, you who are bountiful to him whose praises and oblations you delight in, we, desiringwealth, invoke you, as the milkers call a cow which bears abundant milk.

mantras.sanskrit: यो नो दाता स नः पिता महाँ उग्र ईशानकृत् । अयामन्नुग्रो मघवा पुरूवसुर्गोरश्वस्य प्र दातु नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo no dātā sa naḥ pitā mahā~ ugra īśānakṛt | ayāmannugro maghavā purūvasurgoraśvasya pra dātu naḥ ||

translations.english: He who gives to us is our father, the mighty, the strong, he who acts as the sovereign, may he, thestrong rich Maghavan, give us kine and horses, even without our asking for it.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्मै त्वं वसो दानाय मंहसे स रायस्पोषमिन्वति । वसूयवो वसुपतिं शतक्रतुं स्तोमैरिन्द्रं हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasmai tvaṃ vaso dānāya maṃhase sa rāyaspoṣaminvati | vasūyavo vasupatiṃ śatakratuṃ stomairindraṃ havāmahe ||

translations.english: He to whom you give a present that he may obtain abundance of wealth; we, desiring wealth, invokewith our praises Indra Śatakratu, the lord of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: कदा चन प्र युच्छस्युभे नि पासि जन्मनी । तुरीयादित्य हवनं त इन्द्रियमा तस्थावमृतं दिवि ॥
mantras.transliteration: kadā cana pra yucchasyubhe ni pāsi janmanī | turīyāditya havanaṃ ta indriyamā tasthāvamṛtaṃ divi ||

translations.english: Never are you heedless, you guard both races, (gods and men); O fourth Āditya, to you belongs theIndra invocation, the ambrosia has risen to heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्मै त्वं मघवन्निन्द्र गिर्वणः शिक्षो शिक्षसि दाशुषे । अस्माकं गिर उत सुष्टुतिं वसो कण्ववच्छृणुधी हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasmai tvaṃ maghavannindra girvaṇaḥ śikṣo śikṣasi dāśuṣe | asmākaṃ gira uta suṣṭutiṃ vaso kaṇvavacchṛṇudhī havam ||

translations.english: (As you hear) the worshipper who you favour, O Indra, Maghavan, liberal one, you that love hymns, so,gracious one, hear our hymns and our invocation of praise, like Kaṇva's.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्तावि मन्म पूर्व्यं ब्रह्मेन्द्राय वोचत । पूर्वीॠतस्य बृहतीरनूषत स्तोतुर्मेधा असृक्षत ॥
mantras.transliteration: astāvi manma pūrvyaṃ brahmendrāya vocata | pūrvīṝtasya bṛhatīranūṣata stoturmedhā asṛkṣata ||

translations.english: The old hymn has been sun, you have uttered the prayer to Indra; they have shouted many bṛhatīverses of the rite, many hymns of the worshipper have they poured forth.

mantras.sanskrit: समिन्द्रो रायो बृहतीरधूनुत सं क्षोणी समु सूर्यम् । सं शुक्रासः शुचयः सं गवाशिरः सोमा इन्द्रममन्दिषुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samindro rāyo bṛhatīradhūnuta saṃ kṣoṇī samu sūryam | saṃ śukrāsaḥ śucayaḥ saṃ gavāśiraḥ somā indramamandiṣuḥ ||

translations.english: Indra has heaped together vast stores of wealth, the two worlds and the sun; the bright pureSoma-drink mixed with milk, has exhilarated Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: उपमं त्वा मघोनां ज्येष्ठं च वृषभाणाम् । पूर्भित्तमं मघवन्निन्द्र गोविदमीशानं राय ईमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: upamaṃ tvā maghonāṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ ca vṛṣabhāṇām | pūrbhittamaṃ maghavannindra govidamīśānaṃ rāya īmahe ||

translations.english: We come to you, O Maghavan Indra, the highest of Maghavans, the strong of bulls, the mightiestbreakere of forts, the provider of kine, the lord of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: य आयुं कुत्समतिथिग्वमर्दयो वावृधानो दिवेदिवे । तं त्वा वयं हर्यश्वं शतक्रतुं वाजयन्तो हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya āyuṃ kutsamatithigvamardayo vāvṛdhāno divedive | taṃ tvā vayaṃ haryaśvaṃ śatakratuṃ vājayanto havāmahe ||

translations.english: You who, waxing in might day by day, did destroy Āyu, Kutsa, and Atithigva, we invoke you,Śatakratu, with your bay horses, rousing you by our offerings.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो विश्वेषां रसं मध्वः सिञ्चन्त्वद्रयः । ये परावति सुन्विरे जनेष्वा ये अर्वावतीन्दवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no viśveṣāṃ rasaṃ madhvaḥ siñcantvadrayaḥ | ye parāvati sunvire janeṣvā ye arvāvatīndavaḥ ||

translations.english: Let the stones our forth the Soma for us all, the Soma-drops which have been pressed by men afar ornear.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वा द्वेषांसि जहि चाव चा कृधि विश्वे सन्वन्त्वा वसु । शीष्टेषु चित्ते मदिरासो अंशवो यत्रा सोमस्य तृम्पसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvā dveṣāṃsi jahi cāva cā kṛdhi viśve sanvantvā vasu | śīṣṭeṣu citte madirāso aṃśavo yatrā somasya tṛmpasi ||

translations.english: Smite all our enemies and drive them away, may we all obtain their wealth; even amont the Śīṣṭasare you exhilarating Soma-stalks, where you fill yourself with the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र नेदीय एदिहि मितमेधाभिरूतिभिः । आ शंतम शंतमाभिरभिष्टिभिरा स्वापे स्वापिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra nedīya edihi mitamedhābhirūtibhiḥ | ā śaṃtama śaṃtamābhirabhiṣṭibhirā svāpe svāpibhiḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, come very near with your firmly-wise protections; come, O most healthful, with your mos healthfulaid, come, good kinsma, with your good kinsmen.

mantras.sanskrit: आजितुरं सत्पतिं विश्वचर्षणिं कृधि प्रजास्वाभगम् । प्र सू तिरा शचीभिर्ये त उक्थिनः क्रतुं पुनत आनुषक् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ājituraṃ satpatiṃ viśvacarṣaṇiṃ kṛdhi prajāsvābhagam | pra sū tirā śacībhirye ta ukthinaḥ kratuṃ punata ānuṣak ||

translations.english: Make rich in children that chief of all me, who is victorious in battle and a strong protector; properthoroughly with your powers your singers who cintinually purify their minds.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्ते साधिष्ठोऽवसे ते स्याम भरेषु ते । वयं होत्राभिरुत देवहूतिभिः ससवांसो मनामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaste sādhiṣṭho'vase te syāma bhareṣu te | vayaṃ hotrābhiruta devahūtibhiḥ sasavāṃso manāmahe ||

translations.english: May we be in battle as one who is the sure to gain your protection; we worship you with invocationsand prayers wen we obtain our desire.

mantras.sanskrit: अहं हि ते हरिवो ब्रह्म वाजयुराजिं यामि सदोतिभिः । त्वामिदेव तममे समश्वयुर्गव्युरग्रे मथीनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ hi te harivo brahma vājayurājiṃ yāmi sadotibhiḥ | tvāmideva tamame samaśvayurgavyuragre mathīnām ||

translations.english: With your help, O lord of bay steeds, I always go into prayer and into battle, seeking spoil; it is youwhom I insist upon, when I go, longing for horses and kine, at the head of plural nders.

mantras.sanskrit: एतत्त इन्द्र वीर्यं गीर्भिर्गृणन्ति कारवः । ते स्तोभन्त ऊर्जमावन्घृतश्चुतं पौरासो नक्षन्धीतिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: etatta indra vīryaṃ gīrbhirgṛṇanti kāravaḥ | te stobhanta ūrjamāvanghṛtaścutaṃ paurāso nakṣandhītibhiḥ ||

translations.english: The singers with their hymns, O Indra, this might of yours; singing loudly, they have brought you sacredviands dropping with Soma; the offerers have drawn near with their prayers.

mantras.sanskrit: नक्षन्त इन्द्रमवसे सुकृत्यया येषां सुतेषु मन्दसे । यथा संवर्ते अमदो यथा कृश एवास्मे इन्द्र मत्स्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: nakṣanta indramavase sukṛtyayā yeṣāṃ suteṣu mandase | yathā saṃvarte amado yathā kṛśa evāsme indra matsva ||

translations.english: They have drawn near Indra with holy rites for his protection, they in whose libations you rejoice; as youdid rejoice in Samvara and Kṛśa, so now, Indra, do you rejoice in us.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो विश्वे सजोषसो देवासो गन्तनोप नः । वसवो रुद्रा अवसे न आ गमञ्छृण्वन्तु मरुतो हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no viśve sajoṣaso devāso gantanopa naḥ | vasavo rudrā avase na ā gamañchṛṇvantu maruto havam ||

translations.english: You gods, come all with one accord to us; let the Vasus and Rudras come for our protection, let theMaruts hear our call.

mantras.sanskrit: पूषा विष्णुर्हवनं मे सरस्वत्यवन्तु सप्त सिन्धवः । आपो वातः पर्वतासो वनस्पतिः शृणोतु पृथिवी हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pūṣā viṣṇurhavanaṃ me sarasvatyavantu sapta sindhavaḥ | āpo vātaḥ parvatāso vanaspatiḥ śṛṇotu pṛthivī havam ||

translations.english: May Pūṣan, Viṣṇu, Sarsvatī, and the seven rivers, favour my call; may the waters, the wind, themountains, the trees, the earth, hear my call.

mantras.sanskrit: यदिन्द्र राधो अस्ति ते माघोनं मघवत्तम । तेन नो बोधि सधमाद्यो वृधे भगो दानाय वृत्रहन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadindra rādho asti te māghonaṃ maghavattama | tena no bodhi sadhamādyo vṛdhe bhago dānāya vṛtrahan ||

translations.english: With yours own special gift, O Indra, best of Maghavans, be you our boon-companion for good, ourliberal benefactor, O slayer of Vṛtra.

mantras.sanskrit: आजिपते नृपते त्वमिद्धि नो वाज आ वक्षि सुक्रतो । वीती होत्राभिरुत देववीतिभिः ससवांसो वि शृण्विरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ājipate nṛpate tvamiddhi no vāja ā vakṣi sukrato | vītī hotrābhiruta devavītibhiḥ sasavāṃso vi śṛṇvire ||

translations.english: O lord of battle, lord of men, mighty in action, do you guide us in the conflict; far-famed are those whoobtain their desires by sacrificial feasts, by invocations, and by entertaining the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: सन्ति ह्यर्य आशिष इन्द्र आयुर्जनानाम् । अस्मान्नक्षस्व मघवन्नुपावसे धुक्षस्व पिप्युषीमिषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: santi hyarya āśiṣa indra āyurjanānām | asmānnakṣasva maghavannupāvase dhukṣasva pipyuṣīmiṣam ||

translations.english: Our prayers abide in the true one, in Indra is the life of men; draw near to us, Maghavan, for ourprotection; milk for the streaming drink.

mantras.sanskrit: वयं त इन्द्र स्तोमेभिर्विधेम त्वमस्माकं शतक्रतो । महि स्थूरं शशयं राधो अह्रयं प्रस्कण्वाय नि तोशय ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayaṃ ta indra stomebhirvidhema tvamasmākaṃ śatakrato | mahi sthūraṃ śaśayaṃ rādho ahrayaṃ praskaṇvāya ni tośaya ||

translations.english: O Indra, we would worship you with hymns; O Śatakratu, you are ours; pour down upon Praśkaṇvagreat, solid, inexhaustible, exuberant abundance.

mantras.sanskrit: भूरीदिन्द्रस्य वीर्यं व्यख्यमभ्यायति । राधस्ते दस्यवे वृक ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhūrīdindrasya vīryaṃ vyakhyamabhyāyati | rādhaste dasyave vṛka ||

translations.english: Great indeed is Indra's might; I have beheld it; your gift approaches, O Dasyaave vṛka

mantras.sanskrit: शतं श्वेतास उक्षणो दिवि तारो न रोचन्ते । मह्ना दिवं न तस्तभुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śataṃ śvetāsa ukṣaṇo divi tāro na rocante | mahnā divaṃ na tastabhuḥ ||

translations.english: A hundred white oxen shine like stars in the heaven, by their size they have almost held up theheavens.

mantras.sanskrit: शतं वेणूञ्छतं शुनः शतं चर्माणि म्लातानि । शतं मे बल्बजस्तुका अरुषीणां चतुःशतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śataṃ veṇūñchataṃ śunaḥ śataṃ carmāṇi mlātāni | śataṃ me balbajastukā aruṣīṇāṃ catuḥśatam ||

translations.english: A hundred bamboos, a hundred dogs, a hundred dressed hides, a hundred bunches of balbaja grass,and four hundred red mares are mine.

mantras.sanskrit: सुदेवाः स्थ काण्वायना वयोवयो विचरन्तः । अश्वासो न चङ्क्रमत ॥
mantras.transliteration: sudevāḥ stha kāṇvāyanā vayovayo vicarantaḥ | aśvāso na caṅkramata ||

translations.english: May youu have the gods propitious to you, O descendants of Kaṇva, living through youth on youth;step out vigorously like steed.

mantras.sanskrit: आदित्साप्तस्य चर्किरन्नानूनस्य महि श्रवः । श्यावीरतिध्वसन्पथश्चक्षुषा चन संनशे ॥
mantras.transliteration: āditsāptasya carkirannānūnasya mahi śravaḥ | śyāvīratidhvasanpathaścakṣuṣā cana saṃnaśe ||
