translations.english: Let them praise the seven-yoked team, great is the strength of that which is not yet full-grown; thedark-brown mares have rushed along the paths so that no eye can follow them.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रति ते दस्यवे वृक राधो अदर्श्यह्रयम् । द्यौर्न प्रथिना शवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prati te dasyave vṛka rādho adarśyahrayam | dyaurna prathinā śavaḥ ||

translations.english: Your inexhaustible gift has appeared, O Dasyave vṛka, its fullness is in extent like the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: दश मह्यं पौतक्रतः सहस्रा दस्यवे वृकः । नित्याद्रायो अमंहत ॥
mantras.transliteration: daśa mahyaṃ pautakrataḥ sahasrā dasyave vṛkaḥ | nityādrāyo amaṃhata ||

translations.english: Dasyave-vṛka, the son of Putakrata, has given to me ten thousand from his own store.

mantras.sanskrit: शतं मे गर्दभानां शतमूर्णावतीनाम् । शतं दासाँ अति स्रजः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śataṃ me gardabhānāṃ śatamūrṇāvatīnām | śataṃ dāsā~ ati srajaḥ ||

translations.english: A hundred asses a hundred woolly sheep, a hundred slaves, beside garlands.

mantras.sanskrit: तत्रो अपि प्राणीयत पूतक्रतायै व्यक्ता । अश्वानामिन्न यूथ्याम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tatro api prāṇīyata pūtakratāyai vyaktā | aśvānāminna yūthyām ||

translations.english: There too has been brought for Putakrata a well-adorned mare, which is not one of the common horsesof the herd.

mantras.sanskrit: अचेत्यग्निश्चिकितुर्हव्यवाट् स सुमद्रथः । अग्निः शुक्रेण शोचिषा बृहत्सूरो अरोचत दिवि सूर्यो अरोचत ॥
mantras.transliteration: acetyagniścikiturhavyavāṭ sa sumadrathaḥ | agniḥ śukreṇa śociṣā bṛhatsūro arocata divi sūryo arocata ||

translations.english: The shining Agni has appeared, the bearer of the oblation, with his chariot; Agni has gleamed forthbrilliantly with his bright flame as Sura, he has gleamed forth in heaven as Sūrya.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं देवा क्रतुना पूर्व्येण युक्ता रथेन तविषं यजत्रा । आगच्छतं नासत्या शचीभिरिदं तृतीयं सवनं पिबाथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ devā kratunā pūrvyeṇa yuktā rathena taviṣaṃ yajatrā | āgacchataṃ nāsatyā śacībhiridaṃ tṛtīyaṃ savanaṃ pibāthaḥ ||

translations.english: You have come quickly, you two gods, with your car, endowed with ancient might, O sacred Aśvins,truthful ones, with your powers, drink this third libation.

mantras.sanskrit: युवां देवास्त्रय एकादशासः सत्याः सत्यस्य ददृशे पुरस्तात् । अस्माकं यज्ञं सवनं जुषाणा पातं सोममश्विना दीद्यग्नी ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvāṃ devāstraya ekādaśāsaḥ satyāḥ satyasya dadṛśe purastāt | asmākaṃ yajñaṃ savanaṃ juṣāṇā pātaṃ somamaśvinā dīdyagnī ||

translations.english: The three-and-thirty truthful gods saw you before the truthful one; O Aśvins, gleaming with fire, drinkthe Soma, enjoying our offering, our libation.

mantras.sanskrit: पनाय्यं तदश्विना कृतं वां वृषभो दिवो रजसः पृथिव्याः । सहस्रं शंसा उत ये गविष्टौ सर्वाँ इत्ताँ उप याता पिबध्यै ॥
mantras.transliteration: panāyyaṃ tadaśvinā kṛtaṃ vāṃ vṛṣabho divo rajasaḥ pṛthivyāḥ | sahasraṃ śaṃsā uta ye gaviṣṭau sarvā~ ittā~ upa yātā pibadhyai ||

translations.english: That work of yours, O Aśvins, is worthy of wonder, the bull of the heavens, the firmament and the earth;and your thousand blessings in battle, for all these come here to drink.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं वां भागो निहितो यजत्रेमा गिरो नासत्योप यातम् । पिबतं सोमं मधुमन्तमस्मे प्र दाश्वांसमवतं शचीभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ vāṃ bhāgo nihito yajatremā giro nāsatyopa yātam | pibataṃ somaṃ madhumantamasme pra dāśvāṃsamavataṃ śacībhiḥ ||

translations.english: O sacred ones, this your portion has been plural ced for you, O truthful ones, come to these your praises;drink among us the sweet Soma, succour your worshipper with your powers.

mantras.sanskrit: यमृत्विजो बहुधा कल्पयन्तः सचेतसो यज्ञमिमं वहन्ति । यो अनूचानो ब्राह्मणो युक्त आसीत्का स्वित्तत्र यजमानस्य संवित् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yamṛtvijo bahudhā kalpayantaḥ sacetaso yajñamimaṃ vahanti | yo anūcāno brāhmaṇo yukta āsītkā svittatra yajamānasya saṃvit ||

translations.english: He whom the wise priests bring, when they arrange the offering in many ways, who was employed as alearned brāhmaṇa, what is the offerer's knowledge regarding him?

mantras.sanskrit: एक एवाग्निर्बहुधा समिद्ध एकः सूर्यो विश्वमनु प्रभूतः । एकैवोषाः सर्वमिदं वि भात्येकं वा इदं वि बभूव सर्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eka evāgnirbahudhā samiddha ekaḥ sūryo viśvamanu prabhūtaḥ | ekaivoṣāḥ sarvamidaṃ vi bhātyekaṃ vā idaṃ vi babhūva sarvam ||

translations.english: Agni is one, though kindled in various ways; one is the Sun, pre- eminent over all; one Dawn illuminesthis all; one is that which has become this all.

mantras.sanskrit: ज्योतिष्मन्तं केतुमन्तं त्रिचक्रं सुखं रथं सुषदं भूरिवारम् । चित्रामघा यस्य योगेऽधिजज्ञे तं वां हुवे अति रिक्तं पिबध्यै ॥
mantras.transliteration: jyotiṣmantaṃ ketumantaṃ tricakraṃ sukhaṃ rathaṃ suṣadaṃ bhūrivāram | citrāmaghā yasya yoge'dhijajñe taṃ vāṃ huve ati riktaṃ pibadhyai ||

translations.english: The brilliant chariot, diffusing splendour, rolling lightly on its three wheels, offering an easy seat, and fullof many gifts, at whose yoking the Dawn was born, rich in marvellous treasures, I invoke that your chariot (OAśvins), come you here to drink.

mantras.sanskrit: इमानि वां भागधेयानि सिस्रत इन्द्रावरुणा प्र महे सुतेषु वाम् । यज्ञेयज्ञे ह सवना भुरण्यथो यत्सुन्वते यजमानाय शिक्षथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imāni vāṃ bhāgadheyāni sisrata indrāvaruṇā pra mahe suteṣu vām | yajñeyajñe ha savanā bhuraṇyatho yatsunvate yajamānāya śikṣathaḥ ||

translations.english: These your offered portions stream forth, O Indra and Varuṇa, to your honour in the oblations; at everysacrifice you hasten to the oblations, when you help the offerer who presses out the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: निष्षिध्वरीरोषधीराप आस्तामिन्द्रावरुणा महिमानमाशत । या सिस्रतू रजसः पारे अध्वनो ययोः शत्रुर्नकिरादेव ओहते ॥
mantras.transliteration: niṣṣidhvarīroṣadhīrāpa āstāmindrāvaruṇā mahimānamāśata | yā sisratū rajasaḥ pāre adhvano yayoḥ śatrurnakirādeva ohate ||

translations.english: The plural nts and the waters were efficacious, they have attained their power, O indra and Varuṇa, youwho have gone beyond the path of the firmament, no godless man is worth being called your enemy.

mantras.sanskrit: सत्यं तदिन्द्रावरुणा कृशस्य वां मध्व ऊर्मिं दुहते सप्त वाणीः । ताभिर्दाश्वांसमवतं शुभस्पती यो वामदब्धो अभि पाति चित्तिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: satyaṃ tadindrāvaruṇā kṛśasya vāṃ madhva ūrmiṃ duhate sapta vāṇīḥ | tābhirdāśvāṃsamavataṃ śubhaspatī yo vāmadabdho abhi pāti cittibhiḥ ||

translations.english: True, O Indra and Varuṇa, is that saying of Kṛsa's, 'the seven sacred voices distil a stream of honey',for their sake help the worshipper, O you lords of splendour, who reverence you devoutly in his thoughts.

mantras.sanskrit: घृतप्रुषः सौम्या जीरदानवः सप्त स्वसारः सदन ऋतस्य । या ह वामिन्द्रावरुणा घृतश्चुतस्ताभिर्धत्तं यजमानाय शिक्षतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ghṛtapruṣaḥ saumyā jīradānavaḥ sapta svasāraḥ sadana ṛtasya | yā ha vāmindrāvaruṇā ghṛtaścutastābhirdhattaṃ yajamānāya śikṣatam ||

translations.english: The seven sister-streams of the Soma, in the hot the offering, pour forth ghī-dripping streams of yours,O Indra Varuṇa, provide for and help the offerer.

mantras.sanskrit: अवोचाम महते सौभगाय सत्यं त्वेषाभ्यां महिमानमिन्द्रियम् । अस्मान्त्स्विन्द्रावरुणा घृतश्चुतस्त्रिभिः साप्तेभिरवतं शुभस्पती ॥
mantras.transliteration: avocāma mahate saubhagāya satyaṃ tveṣābhyāṃ mahimānamindriyam | asmāntsvindrāvaruṇā ghṛtaścutastribhiḥ sāptebhiravataṃ śubhaspatī ||

translations.english: To our great happiness we hae declared to these two brilliant ones the true might of Indra; O indra andVaruṇa, lords of splendour, help us, the offerers of ghī, with the company of thrice seven.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रावरुणा यदृषिभ्यो मनीषां वाचो मतिं श्रुतमदत्तमग्रे । यानि स्थानान्यसृजन्त धीरा यज्ञं तन्वानास्तपसाभ्यपश्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāvaruṇā yadṛṣibhyo manīṣāṃ vāco matiṃ śrutamadattamagre | yāni sthānānyasṛjanta dhīrā yajñaṃ tanvānāstapasābhyapaśyam ||

translations.english: O Indra and Varuṇa, I have seen what you formerly gave to the seers, wisdom, power of song, andfame, and the plural ces which the wise have prepared for themselves, as they spread the web of the sacrifice withholy austerities.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रावरुणा सौमनसमदृप्तं रायस्पोषं यजमानेषु धत्तम् । प्रजां पुष्टिं भूतिमस्मासु धत्तं दीर्घायुत्वाय प्र तिरतं न आयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāvaruṇā saumanasamadṛptaṃ rāyaspoṣaṃ yajamāneṣu dhattam | prajāṃ puṣṭiṃ bhūtimasmāsu dhattaṃ dīrghāyutvāya pra tirataṃ na āyuḥ ||

translations.english: O Indra and Varuṇa, give to the offerers cheerfulness without levity, and abundance of wealth; give tous offspring, food, prosperity; prolong our lives to length of days.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्न आ याह्यग्निभिर्होतारं त्वा वृणीमहे । आ त्वामनक्तु प्रयता हविष्मती यजिष्ठं बर्हिरासदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: agna ā yāhyagnibhirhotāraṃ tvā vṛṇīmahe | ā tvāmanaktu prayatā haviṣmatī yajiṣṭhaṃ barhirāsade ||

translations.english: Agni, come here with the fires, we choose you as our invoking priest; let the presented offering anointyou, the chief sacrificer, to sit down on the sacred grass.

mantras.sanskrit: अच्छा हि त्वा सहसः सूनो अङ्गिरः स्रुचश्चरन्त्यध्वरे । ऊर्जो नपातं घृतकेशमीमहेऽग्निं यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: acchā hi tvā sahasaḥ sūno aṅgiraḥ srucaścarantyadhvare | ūrjo napātaṃ ghṛtakeśamīmahe'gniṃ yajñeṣu pūrvyam ||

translations.english: Aṅgirasa, son of strength, the ladles go to find you in the sacrifice; we praise the ancient Agni in ourofferings, the grandson of food, butter-haired.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने कविर्वेधा असि होता पावक यक्ष्यः । मन्द्रो यजिष्ठो अध्वरेष्वीड्यो विप्रेभिः शुक्र मन्मभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne kavirvedhā asi hotā pāvaka yakṣyaḥ | mandro yajiṣṭho adhvareṣvīḍyo viprebhiḥ śukra manmabhiḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, you, wise, are the creator (of consequences); O purifier, you are the involving priest, worthy ofworship; bright one, you are to be praised in our sacrifices by the priests with hymns, yourself the chief ministrantworthy to be rejoiced in.

mantras.sanskrit: अद्रोघमा वहोशतो यविष्ठ्य देवाँ अजस्र वीतये । अभि प्रयांसि सुधिता वसो गहि मन्दस्व धीतिभिर्हितः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adroghamā vahośato yaviṣṭhya devā~ ajasra vītaye | abhi prayāṃsi sudhitā vaso gahi mandasva dhītibhirhitaḥ ||

translations.english: Most youthful, eternal one, bring the longing gods to me guileless, to eat (the oblation); giver ofdwellings, approach the well-plural ced food; rejoice, being set in your plural ce with praises.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमित्सप्रथा अस्यग्ने त्रातॠतस्कविः । त्वां विप्रासः समिधान दीदिव आ विवासन्ति वेधसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamitsaprathā asyagne trātaṝtaskaviḥ | tvāṃ viprāsaḥ samidhāna dīdiva ā vivāsanti vedhasaḥ ||

translations.english: Deliverer Agni, you, the truthful and the seer, are widely spread; O kindled blazing one, the wisepraisers wait on you.

mantras.sanskrit: शोचा शोचिष्ठ दीदिहि विशे मयो रास्व स्तोत्रे महाँ असि । देवानां शर्मन्मम सन्तु सूरयः शत्रूषाहः स्वग्नयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śocā śociṣṭha dīdihi viśe mayo rāsva stotre mahā~ asi | devānāṃ śarmanmama santu sūrayaḥ śatrūṣāhaḥ svagnayaḥ ||

translations.english: Most resplendent (Agni), shine forth and illuminate (us); give happiness to your people, to yourworshipper, for you are great; may my priests abide in the bliss of the gods, subduing their enemies, possessingbright fires.

mantras.sanskrit: यथा चिद्वृद्धमतसमग्ने संजूर्वसि क्षमि । एवा दह मित्रमहो यो अस्मध्रुग्दुर्मन्मा कश्च वेनति ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathā cidvṛddhamatasamagne saṃjūrvasi kṣami | evā daha mitramaho yo asmadhrugdurmanmā kaśca venati ||

translations.english: As, Agni, you consume old timber on the earth, so, cherisher of friends, do you burn our injurer,whosoever evil-minded wishes (our ill).

mantras.sanskrit: मा नो मर्ताय रिपवे रक्षस्विने माघशंसाय रीरधः । अस्रेधद्भिस्तरणिभिर्यविष्ठ्य शिवेभिः पाहि पायुभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā no martāya ripave rakṣasvine māghaśaṃsāya rīradhaḥ | asredhadbhistaraṇibhiryaviṣṭhya śivebhiḥ pāhi pāyubhiḥ ||

translations.english: Subject us not to a strong mortal enemy, nor to the malevolent; O most youthful, guard us with yourunharming delivering auspicious protections.

mantras.sanskrit: पाहि नो अग्न एकया पाह्युत द्वितीयया । पाहि गीर्भिस्तिसृभिरूर्जां पते पाहि चतसृभिर्वसो ॥
mantras.transliteration: pāhi no agna ekayā pāhyuta dvitīyayā | pāhi gīrbhistisṛbhirūrjāṃ pate pāhi catasṛbhirvaso ||

translations.english: Agni, protect us by one (rich), or protect us by a second; lord of strength, protect us by three sons;protect us, giver of dwellings, by four.

mantras.sanskrit: पाहि विश्वस्माद्रक्षसो अराव्णः प्र स्म वाजेषु नोऽव । त्वामिद्धि नेदिष्ठं देवतातय आपिं नक्षामहे वृधे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pāhi viśvasmādrakṣaso arāvṇaḥ pra sma vājeṣu no'va | tvāmiddhi nediṣṭhaṃ devatātaya āpiṃ nakṣāmahe vṛdhe ||

translations.english: Protect us from every impious rākṣasa, shield us in battles; we approach you, our nearest neighbour,our kinsman, for sacrifice and for increase.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो अग्ने वयोवृधं रयिं पावक शंस्यम् । रास्वा च न उपमाते पुरुस्पृहं सुनीती स्वयशस्तरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no agne vayovṛdhaṃ rayiṃ pāvaka śaṃsyam | rāsvā ca na upamāte puruspṛhaṃ sunītī svayaśastaram ||

translations.english: Purifying Agni, bestow upon us food-augmenting excellent wealth; and (bring) us, O meter-out of good,by auspicious guidance, (a treasure) desired by many and bringing its own fame.

mantras.sanskrit: येन वंसाम पृतनासु शर्धतस्तरन्तो अर्य आदिशः । स त्वं नो वर्ध प्रयसा शचीवसो जिन्वा धियो वसुविदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yena vaṃsāma pṛtanāsu śardhatastaranto arya ādiśaḥ | sa tvaṃ no vardha prayasā śacīvaso jinvā dhiyo vasuvidaḥ ||

translations.english: By which we may escape and destroy in battles our impetuous weapon- aiming enemies; O you who bywisdom establish our rites, bless us with food, prosper our wealth-obtaining offerings.

mantras.sanskrit: शिशानो वृषभो यथाग्निः शृङ्गे दविध्वत् । तिग्मा अस्य हनवो न प्रतिधृषे सुजम्भः सहसो यहुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śiśāno vṛṣabho yathāgniḥ śṛṅge davidhvat | tigmā asya hanavo na pratidhṛṣe sujambhaḥ sahaso yahuḥ ||

translations.english: Agni tosses his horns, sharpening them as a bull; his sharp jaws are not to be resisted; he is mightytoothed, this son of strength.

mantras.sanskrit: नहि ते अग्ने वृषभ प्रतिधृषे जम्भासो यद्वितिष्ठसे । स त्वं नो होतः सुहुतं हविष्कृधि वंस्वा नो वार्या पुरु ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahi te agne vṛṣabha pratidhṛṣe jambhāso yadvitiṣṭhase | sa tvaṃ no hotaḥ suhutaṃ haviṣkṛdhi vaṃsvā no vāryā puru ||

translations.english: Since you spread out on all sides, your teeth, bull Agni, are not to be resisted; O offerer, do you makeour oblation rightly presented; give us many precious (gifts).

mantras.sanskrit: शेषे वनेषु मात्रोः सं त्वा मर्तास इन्धते । अतन्द्रो हव्या वहसि हविष्कृत आदिद्देवेषु राजसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: śeṣe vaneṣu mātroḥ saṃ tvā martāsa indhate | atandro havyā vahasi haviṣkṛta ādiddeveṣu rājasi ||

translations.english: You sleep within your mothers in the woods, mortals kindle you; unwearied you bear the offerings of thesacrificer, then you shine among the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: सप्त होतारस्तमिदीळते त्वाग्ने सुत्यजमह्रयम् । भिनत्स्यद्रिं तपसा वि शोचिषा प्राग्ने तिष्ठ जनाँ अति ॥
mantras.transliteration: sapta hotārastamidīḷate tvāgne sutyajamahrayam | bhinatsyadriṃ tapasā vi śociṣā prāgne tiṣṭha janā~ ati ||

translations.english: The seven priests praise you, Agni, giver of good things and unfailing; you cleave the cloud with yourfierce splendour; go forth, having overcome our enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निमग्निं वो अध्रिगुं हुवेम वृक्तबर्हिषः । अग्निं हितप्रयसः शश्वतीष्वा होतारं चर्षणीनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnimagniṃ vo adhriguṃ huvema vṛktabarhiṣaḥ | agniṃ hitaprayasaḥ śaśvatīṣvā hotāraṃ carṣaṇīnām ||

translations.english: Now that we have cut the sacred grass, let us invoke for you Agni, Agni the irresistible; having plural cedthe oblations, let us invoke Agni, abiding in many (plural ces), the offerer of sacrifices for men.

mantras.sanskrit: केतेन शर्मन्त्सचते सुषामण्यग्ने तुभ्यं चिकित्वना । इषण्यया नः पुरुरूपमा भर वाजं नेदिष्ठमूतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ketena śarmantsacate suṣāmaṇyagne tubhyaṃ cikitvanā | iṣaṇyayā naḥ pururūpamā bhara vājaṃ nediṣṭhamūtaye ||

translations.english: (The sacrificer) worships you by praises, Agni, with the experienced (priests) in the rite celebrated withbeautiful Sāman hymns;bring us of your own accord for our protection food of various kinds which may bealways in our reach.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने जरितर्विश्पतिस्तेपानो देव रक्षसः । अप्रोषिवान्गृहपतिर्महाँ असि दिवस्पायुर्दुरोणयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne jaritarviśpatistepāno deva rakṣasaḥ | aproṣivāngṛhapatirmahā~ asi divaspāyurduroṇayuḥ ||

translations.english: Divine Agni, worthy of praise, you are the guardian of men, the consumer of the rākṣasas; you aregreat, you the never-absent guardian of the (worshipper's) house, the protector of heaven, ever present in thedwelling.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नो रक्ष आ वेशीदाघृणीवसो मा यातुर्यातुमावताम् । परोगव्यूत्यनिरामप क्षुधमग्ने सेध रक्षस्विनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā no rakṣa ā veśīdāghṛṇīvaso mā yāturyātumāvatām | parogavyūtyanirāmapa kṣudhamagne sedha rakṣasvinaḥ ||

translations.english: O you brilliant wealth, let not the rākṣasa enter us, nor the torment of the evil spirits; Agni, drive awayfurther than a gavyūti from us poverty, hunger and the strong demons.

mantras.sanskrit: उभयं शृणवच्च न इन्द्रो अर्वागिदं वचः । सत्राच्या मघवा सोमपीतये धिया शविष्ठ आ गमत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ubhayaṃ śṛṇavacca na indro arvāgidaṃ vacaḥ | satrācyā maghavā somapītaye dhiyā śaviṣṭha ā gamat ||

translations.english: May Indra listen to both these our hymns; may the mightiest Maghavan come to us, (plural ased) with ourdevoted offering, to drink the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: तं हि स्वराजं वृषभं तमोजसे धिषणे निष्टतक्षतुः । उतोपमानां प्रथमो नि षीदसि सोमकामं हि ते मनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ hi svarājaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tamojase dhiṣaṇe niṣṭatakṣatuḥ | utopamānāṃ prathamo ni ṣīdasi somakāmaṃ hi te manaḥ ||

translations.english: Him, self-resplendent, have heaven and earth formed as the showerer, him (they have formed) forstrength; therefore, you sit down first of your peers; your mind loved the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वृषस्व पुरूवसो सुतस्येन्द्रान्धसः । विद्मा हि त्वा हरिवः पृत्सु सासहिमधृष्टं चिद्दधृष्वणिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vṛṣasva purūvaso sutasyendrāndhasaḥ | vidmā hi tvā harivaḥ pṛtsu sāsahimadhṛṣṭaṃ ciddadhṛṣvaṇim ||

translations.english: Indra, possessor of much wealth, pour the effused Soma within you; possessor of (bright) coursers, weknow you, the overpowerer in battles, the unconquerable, the conqueror.

mantras.sanskrit: अप्रामिसत्य मघवन्तथेदसदिन्द्र क्रत्वा यथा वशः । सनेम वाजं तव शिप्रिन्नवसा मक्षू चिद्यन्तो अद्रिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aprāmisatya maghavantathedasadindra kratvā yathā vaśaḥ | sanema vājaṃ tava śiprinnavasā makṣū cidyanto adrivaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, Maghavan of unbroken truth, it ever comes to pass as you in your knowledge may desire, by yourprotection, O handsome-jawed, may we obtain food, speedily, O thunderer, subduing our enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: शग्ध्यू षु शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः । भगं न हि त्वा यशसं वसुविदमनु शूर चरामसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: śagdhyū ṣu śacīpata indra viśvābhirūtibhiḥ | bhagaṃ na hi tvā yaśasaṃ vasuvidamanu śūra carāmasi ||

translations.english: Indr, lord of rites, give us (our desire) with all your helping powers; hero, we worship you as happiness,the glorious, the obtainer of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: पौरो अश्वस्य पुरुकृद्गवामस्युत्सो देव हिरण्ययः । नकिर्हि दानं परिमर्धिषत्त्वे यद्यद्यामि तदा भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: pauro aśvasya purukṛdgavāmasyutso deva hiraṇyayaḥ | nakirhi dānaṃ parimardhiṣattve yadyadyāmi tadā bhara ||

translations.english: You are the increaser of horses, the multiplier of cows; you, deity, with your golden body; none canharm the gifts laid up for me in you; bring me whatever I ask.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं ह्येहि चेरवे विदा भगं वसुत्तये । उद्वावृषस्व मघवन्गविष्टय उदिन्द्राश्वमिष्टये ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ hyehi cerave vidā bhagaṃ vasuttaye | udvāvṛṣasva maghavangaviṣṭaya udindrāśvamiṣṭaye ||

translations.english: You are (bounteous), come, may you obtain wealth to distribute to the worshipper; shower your bounty,Maghavan, on me desiring cows, shower it, Indra, on me desiring horses.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं पुरू सहस्राणि शतानि च यूथा दानाय मंहसे । आ पुरंदरं चकृम विप्रवचस इन्द्रं गायन्तोऽवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ purū sahasrāṇi śatāni ca yūthā dānāya maṃhase | ā puraṃdaraṃ cakṛma vipravacasa indraṃ gāyanto'vase ||

translations.english: You grant many hundreds and thousands of herds as a gift (to the offerer), uttering long praises, we,hymning Indra, the destroyer of cities, bring him before us for our protection.

mantras.sanskrit: अविप्रो वा यदविधद्विप्रो वेन्द्र ते वचः । स प्र ममन्दत्त्वाया शतक्रतो प्राचामन्यो अहंसन ॥
mantras.transliteration: avipro vā yadavidhadvipro vendra te vacaḥ | sa pra mamandattvāyā śatakrato prācāmanyo ahaṃsana ||

translations.english: Indra, whether it be the unskilled or the skilled who celebrate your praise, each rejoices in his desire foryou, O Śatakratu, whose wrath presses ever forwards, who meet the foe, proclaiming, "It is I".

mantras.sanskrit: उग्रबाहुर्म्रक्षकृत्वा पुरंदरो यदि मे शृणवद्धवम् । वसूयवो वसुपतिं शतक्रतुं स्तोमैरिन्द्रं हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ugrabāhurmrakṣakṛtvā puraṃdaro yadi me śṛṇavaddhavam | vasūyavo vasupatiṃ śatakratuṃ stomairindraṃ havāmahe ||

translations.english: If the strong-armed slayer of enemies, the destroyer of cities, will but hear my invocation, we, desiringwealth, will with our praises call one Indra Śatakratu, the lord of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: न पापासो मनामहे नारायासो न जळ्हवः । यदिन्न्विन्द्रं वृषणं सचा सुते सखायं कृणवामहै ॥
mantras.transliteration: na pāpāso manāmahe nārāyāso na jaḷhavaḥ | yadinnvindraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ sacā sute sakhāyaṃ kṛṇavāmahai ||

translations.english: We are not evil who worship him, nor too poor to offer gifts, nor destitute of sacred fires-- sinceassembled together, when the Soma is effused, we make Indra, the showerer, our friend.

mantras.sanskrit: उग्रं युयुज्म पृतनासु सासहिमृणकातिमदाभ्यम् । वेदा भृमं चित्सनिता रथीतमो वाजिनं यमिदू नशत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ugraṃ yuyujma pṛtanāsu sāsahimṛṇakātimadābhyam | vedā bhṛmaṃ citsanitā rathītamo vājinaṃ yamidū naśat ||

translations.english: We join (to our rite) the mighty Indra, the subduer of enemies in battles, the inviolate, him to whompraise is due as a debt; he, the best of charioteers, knows (among steeds) the strong racer, and (among men)he, the bounteous (knows) the offerer whom he is to reach.

mantras.sanskrit: यत इन्द्र भयामहे ततो नो अभयं कृधि । मघवञ्छग्धि तव तन्न ऊतिभिर्वि द्विषो वि मृधो जहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yata indra bhayāmahe tato no abhayaṃ kṛdhi | maghavañchagdhi tava tanna ūtibhirvi dviṣo vi mṛdho jahi ||

translations.english: Indra, give us security from him of whom we are afraid, Maghavan, be strong for us with yourprotections; destroy our enemies, destroy those who harm us.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं हि राधस्पते राधसो महः क्षयस्यासि विधतः । तं त्वा वयं मघवन्निन्द्र गिर्वणः सुतावन्तो हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ hi rādhaspate rādhaso mahaḥ kṣayasyāsi vidhataḥ | taṃ tvā vayaṃ maghavannindra girvaṇaḥ sutāvanto havāmahe ||

translations.english: Lord of wealth, you are (the bestower) of great wealth and a dwelling plural ce upon your worshipper; assuch, we invoke you, bearing the Soma, O Maghavan, Indra, who are to be honoured with hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रः स्पळुत वृत्रहा परस्पा नो वरेण्यः । स नो रक्षिषच्चरमं स मध्यमं स पश्चात्पातु नः पुरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraḥ spaḷuta vṛtrahā paraspā no vareṇyaḥ | sa no rakṣiṣaccaramaṃ sa madhyamaṃ sa paścātpātu naḥ puraḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, the all-knower, the slayer of Vṛtra, the protector, is to be chosen by us; may he guard our (son),our last (son), our middle (son), may he protect us from behind and before.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं नः पश्चादधरादुत्तरात्पुर इन्द्र नि पाहि विश्वतः । आरे अस्मत्कृणुहि दैव्यं भयमारे हेतीरदेवीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ naḥ paścādadharāduttarātpura indra ni pāhi viśvataḥ | āre asmatkṛṇuhi daivyaṃ bhayamāre hetīradevīḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, protect us from the west, from the south, from the north, from the east, protect us from every side;keep far from us supernatural alarm, keep afar the weapons of the demons.

mantras.sanskrit: अद्याद्या श्वःश्व इन्द्र त्रास्व परे च नः । विश्वा च नो जरितॄन्त्सत्पते अहा दिवा नक्तं च रक्षिषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adyādyā śvaḥśva indra trāsva pare ca naḥ | viśvā ca no jaritṝntsatpate ahā divā naktaṃ ca rakṣiṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Save us, Indra, every today, every tomorrow, and every succeeding day; lord of the good, protect us,your praisers, in all days, by day and night.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रभङ्गी शूरो मघवा तुवीमघः सम्मिश्लो विर्याय कम् । उभा ते बाहू वृषणा शतक्रतो नि या वज्रं मिमिक्षतुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prabhaṅgī śūro maghavā tuvīmaghaḥ sammiślo viryāya kam | ubhā te bāhū vṛṣaṇā śatakrato ni yā vajraṃ mimikṣatuḥ ||

translations.english: Maghavan is the shatterer, the hero, great in wealth, and the conductor to victory (over our enemies),Śatakratu, both your arms, which grasp the thunderbolt, are the showerers (of blessings).

mantras.sanskrit: प्रो अस्मा उपस्तुतिं भरता यज्जुजोषति । उक्थैरिन्द्रस्य माहिनं वयो वर्धन्ति सोमिनो भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pro asmā upastutiṃ bharatā yajjujoṣati | ukthairindrasya māhinaṃ vayo vardhanti somino bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||

translations.english: Present the offering of praise to Indra, since he enjoys it; (the priests) augment the ample food of theSoma-loving Indra with their recited hymns, Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.

mantras.sanskrit: अयुजो असमो नृभिरेकः कृष्टीरयास्यः । पूर्वीरति प्र वावृधे विश्वा जातान्योजसा भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayujo asamo nṛbhirekaḥ kṛṣṭīrayāsyaḥ | pūrvīrati pra vāvṛdhe viśvā jātānyojasā bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||

translations.english: Without a fellow and unlike the other gods, he alone, unconquerable, surpasses the men of formertimes, he surpasses in might all beings; Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.

mantras.sanskrit: अहितेन चिदर्वता जीरदानुः सिषासति । प्रवाच्यमिन्द्र तत्तव वीर्याणि करिष्यतो भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahitena cidarvatā jīradānuḥ siṣāsati | pravācyamindra tattava vīryāṇi kariṣyato bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||

translations.english: He, the swift giver, wishes to bestow blessings (upon us) with his unurged courser, your greatness,Indra, as you are about to display your powers, should be proclaimed, Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.

mantras.sanskrit: आ याहि कृणवाम त इन्द्र ब्रह्माणि वर्धना । येभिः शविष्ठ चाकनो भद्रमिह श्रवस्यते भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yāhi kṛṇavāma ta indra brahmāṇi vardhanā | yebhiḥ śaviṣṭha cākano bhadramiha śravasyate bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, come here; let us perform for you our sacred rites augmenting your vigour; by which (rites), mostmightyone, you desire to bless him who wishes for food; Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.

mantras.sanskrit: धृषतश्चिद्धृषन्मनः कृणोषीन्द्र यत्त्वम् । तीव्रैः सोमैः सपर्यतो नमोभिः प्रतिभूषतो भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhṛṣataściddhṛṣanmanaḥ kṛṇoṣīndra yattvam | tīvraiḥ somaiḥ saparyato namobhiḥ pratibhūṣato bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||

translations.english: You have made your mind, Indra, more resolute than the resolute, since you (wish to give the desires)of him who worships you with the intoxicating Soma and adorns you with adorations; Indra's gifts are worthy ofpraise.

mantras.sanskrit: अव चष्ट ऋचीषमोऽवताँ इव मानुषः । जुष्ट्वी दक्षस्य सोमिनः सखायं कृणुते युजं भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ava caṣṭa ṛcīṣamo'vatā~ iva mānuṣaḥ | juṣṭvī dakṣasya sominaḥ sakhāyaṃ kṛṇute yujaṃ bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, who is well-deserving of the hymn, looks down (with favour) upon us as a (thirsty) man (looksdown) on wells; and being well-plural ased he makes the energetic Soma-offerer his friend; Indra's gifts are worthyof praise.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वे त इन्द्र वीर्यं देवा अनु क्रतुं ददुः । भुवो विश्वस्य गोपतिः पुरुष्टुत भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśve ta indra vīryaṃ devā anu kratuṃ daduḥ | bhuvo viśvasya gopatiḥ puruṣṭuta bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, by the example of your power and knowledge the gods attain the same; O hymned by many, youare herdsman of the universe; Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.

mantras.sanskrit: गृणे तदिन्द्र ते शव उपमं देवतातये । यद्धंसि वृत्रमोजसा शचीपते भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: gṛṇe tadindra te śava upamaṃ devatātaye | yaddhaṃsi vṛtramojasā śacīpate bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, I laud that might of yours which isnear at hand to the worshipper-- (I laud you) that you slay Vṛtra,O lord of rites, by your strength; Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.

mantras.sanskrit: समनेव वपुष्यतः कृणवन्मानुषा युगा । विदे तदिन्द्रश्चेतनमध श्रुतो भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samaneva vapuṣyataḥ kṛṇavanmānuṣā yugā | vide tadindraścetanamadha śruto bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||

translations.english: As a woman who shows no partiality wins her lovers to her, so Indra confers periods of time onmankind;it is Indra who has performed that knowledge- giving achievement, therefore he is renowned; Indra's gifts areworthy of praise.

mantras.sanskrit: उज्जातमिन्द्र ते शव उत्त्वामुत्तव क्रतुम् । भूरिगो भूरि वावृधुर्मघवन्तव शर्मणि भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ujjātamindra te śava uttvāmuttava kratum | bhūrigo bhūri vāvṛdhurmaghavantava śarmaṇi bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||

translations.english: Maghavan, rich in cattle, (those who abide) in your happiness have greatly augmented your might whenit was born, (they have greatly augmented) you, Indra and your knwoeldge; Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.

mantras.sanskrit: अहं च त्वं च वृत्रहन्त्सं युज्याव सनिभ्य आ । अरातीवा चिदद्रिवोऽनु नौ शूर मंसते भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ ca tvaṃ ca vṛtrahantsaṃ yujyāva sanibhya ā | arātīvā cidadrivo'nu nau śūra maṃsate bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||

translations.english: May I and you, slayer of Vṛtra, be close to you united until wealth is obtained; hero, wielding thethunderbolt, even the niggard concedes (that our union gives wealth); Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.

mantras.sanskrit: सत्यमिद्वा उ तं वयमिन्द्रं स्तवाम नानृतम् । महाँ असुन्वतो वधो भूरि ज्योतींषि सुन्वतो भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: satyamidvā u taṃ vayamindraṃ stavāma nānṛtam | mahā~ asunvato vadho bhūri jyotīṃṣi sunvato bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||

translations.english: Let us praise that Indra with truth, not with untruth, great is the destruction of him who offers not but tohim who offers abundant Soma-oblations, Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.

mantras.sanskrit: स पूर्व्यो महानां वेनः क्रतुभिरानजे । यस्य द्वारा मनुष्पिता देवेषु धिय आनजे ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa pūrvyo mahānāṃ venaḥ kratubhirānaje | yasya dvārā manuṣpitā deveṣu dhiya ānaje ||

translations.english: He, (Indra), the chief of those to be honoured, desirous of our offerings, approaches; he, the doors ofwhose favour, the sacred rites, Manu, the (universal) father, attained among the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवो मानं नोत्सदन्त्सोमपृष्ठासो अद्रयः । उक्था ब्रह्म च शंस्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: divo mānaṃ notsadantsomapṛṣṭhāso adrayaḥ | ukthā brahma ca śaṃsyā ||

translations.english: May the stones which press out the Soma never forsake Indra, maker of heaven, nor the praises andhymns which are to be uttered.

mantras.sanskrit: स विद्वाँ अङ्गिरोभ्य इन्द्रो गा अवृणोदप । स्तुषे तदस्य पौंस्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa vidvā~ aṅgirobhya indro gā avṛṇodapa | stuṣe tadasya pauṃsyam ||

translations.english: He, the wise Indra, discovered the cows to the Aṅgirasas; I glorify that his might.

mantras.sanskrit: स प्रत्नथा कविवृध इन्द्रो वाकस्य वक्षणिः । शिवो अर्कस्य होमन्यस्मत्रा गन्त्ववसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa pratnathā kavivṛdha indro vākasya vakṣaṇiḥ | śivo arkasya homanyasmatrā gantvavase ||

translations.english: As in former times, so now too is Indra the blesser of the worshipper and the bearer of him who praiseshim; may he come among us auspicious for our protection at the oblation of the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: आदू नु ते अनु क्रतुं स्वाहा वरस्य यज्यवः । श्वात्रमर्का अनूषतेन्द्र गोत्रस्य दावने ॥
mantras.transliteration: ādū nu te anu kratuṃ svāhā varasya yajyavaḥ | śvātramarkā anūṣatendra gotrasya dāvane ||

translations.english: Forthwith, Indra, as they offer to Agni the lord of Svāhā, the singers successively praise your deeds,for your attainment of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रे विश्वानि वीर्या कृतानि कर्त्वानि च । यमर्का अध्वरं विदुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indre viśvāni vīryā kṛtāni kartvāni ca | yamarkā adhvaraṃ viduḥ ||

translations.english: In that Indra, whom the singers know as the unharming, all past and future powers abide.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्पाञ्चजन्यया विशेन्द्रे घोषा असृक्षत । अस्तृणाद्बर्हणा विपोऽर्यो मानस्य स क्षयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatpāñcajanyayā viśendre ghoṣā asṛkṣata | astṛṇādbarhaṇā vipo'ryo mānasya sa kṣayaḥ ||

translations.english: When praises are addressed to Indra by the men of the five classes, he destroys their enemies by hismight; he, the lord, is the abode of the worshipper's homage.

mantras.sanskrit: इयमु ते अनुष्टुतिश्चकृषे तानि पौंस्या । प्रावश्चक्रस्य वर्तनिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: iyamu te anuṣṭutiścakṛṣe tāni pauṃsyā | prāvaścakrasya vartanim ||

translations.english: This praise is yours, for you have achieved those exploits; you have guarded the road of ourchariot-wheel (to the sacrificial rite).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य वृष्णो व्योदन उरु क्रमिष्ट जीवसे । यवं न पश्व आ ददे ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya vṛṣṇo vyodana uru kramiṣṭa jīvase | yavaṃ na paśva ā dade ||

translations.english: When the various sustenance, given by Indra, the showerer, is obtained, all men step over with widestrides for (dear) life; they receive it as cattle and barley.

mantras.sanskrit: तद्दधाना अवस्यवो युष्माभिर्दक्षपितरः । स्याम मरुत्वतो वृधे ॥
mantras.transliteration: taddadhānā avasyavo yuṣmābhirdakṣapitaraḥ | syāma marutvato vṛdhe ||

translations.english: Presenting our praise, and desiring protection, may we with you (O priests) be lords of food, to offersacrifice to (Indra) attended by the Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: बळृत्वियाय धाम्न ऋक्वभिः शूर नोनुमः । जेषामेन्द्र त्वया युजा ॥
mantras.transliteration: baḷṛtviyāya dhāmna ṛkvabhiḥ śūra nonumaḥ | jeṣāmendra tvayā yujā ||

translations.english: Hero, by our hymns we offer praise to you, who appear at the time of sacrifice, and wear auspicioussplendour; with you as our ally may we conquer (our enemies).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मे रुद्रा मेहना पर्वतासो वृत्रहत्ये भरहूतौ सजोषाः । यः शंसते स्तुवते धायि पज्र इन्द्रज्येष्ठा अस्माँ अवन्तु देवाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asme rudrā mehanā parvatāso vṛtrahatye bharahūtau sajoṣāḥ | yaḥ śaṃsate stuvate dhāyi pajra indrajyeṣṭhā asmā~ avantu devāḥ ||

translations.english: The Rudras, the showering clouds, and (Indra) who rejoices with us in the battle-challenge which bringsVṛtra's destruction, and who comes in his might to the reciter and singer of his praises-- may these gods, withIndra at their head, protect us.

mantras.sanskrit: उत्त्वा मन्दन्तु स्तोमाः कृणुष्व राधो अद्रिवः । अव ब्रह्मद्विषो जहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: uttvā mandantu stomāḥ kṛṇuṣva rādho adrivaḥ | ava brahmadviṣo jahi ||

translations.english: May our praises exhilarate you, thunderer, make food for us, destroy the haters of the brāhmaṇas.

mantras.sanskrit: पदा पणीँरराधसो नि बाधस्व महाँ असि । नहि त्वा कश्चन प्रति ॥
mantras.transliteration: padā paṇī~rarādhaso ni bādhasva mahā~ asi | nahi tvā kaścana prati ||

translations.english: Crush with your foot the paṇis who offer no oblations; you are mighty; there is none else like unto you.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमीशिषे सुतानामिन्द्र त्वमसुतानाम् । त्वं राजा जनानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamīśiṣe sutānāmindra tvamasutānām | tvaṃ rājā janānām ||

translations.english: You, Indra, are the lord of the Soma effused or not effused, you are the king of all men.

mantras.sanskrit: एहि प्रेहि क्षयो दिव्याघोषञ्चर्षणीनाम् । ओभे पृणासि रोदसी ॥
mantras.transliteration: ehi prehi kṣayo divyāghoṣañcarṣaṇīnām | obhe pṛṇāsi rodasī ||

translations.english: Come, here, come forth from heaven to our dwelling, shouting for the sake of men; you fill both heavenand earth.

mantras.sanskrit: त्यं चित्पर्वतं गिरिं शतवन्तं सहस्रिणम् । वि स्तोतृभ्यो रुरोजिथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: tyaṃ citparvataṃ giriṃ śatavantaṃ sahasriṇam | vi stotṛbhyo rurojitha ||

translations.english: Do you burst, for your worshippers, the gnarled cloud with its hundreds and thousands of showers

mantras.sanskrit: वयमु त्वा दिवा सुते वयं नक्तं हवामहे । अस्माकं काममा पृण ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayamu tvā divā sute vayaṃ naktaṃ havāmahe | asmākaṃ kāmamā pṛṇa ||

translations.english: We invoke you when the Soma is effused by day, we invoke you by night; fulfil our desire.

mantras.sanskrit: क्व स्य वृषभो युवा तुविग्रीवो अनानतः । ब्रह्मा कस्तं सपर्यति ॥
mantras.transliteration: kva sya vṛṣabho yuvā tuvigrīvo anānataḥ | brahmā kastaṃ saparyati ||

translations.english: Where is that ever-youthful showerer, strong-necked and bowing to none? What hymner worships you?

mantras.sanskrit: कस्य स्वित्सवनं वृषा जुजुष्वाँ अव गच्छति । इन्द्रं क उ स्विदा चके ॥
mantras.transliteration: kasya svitsavanaṃ vṛṣā jujuṣvā~ ava gacchati | indraṃ ka u svidā cake ||

translations.english: To whose offering does the showerer come down plural ased? Who can praise Indra?

mantras.sanskrit: कं ते दाना असक्षत वृत्रहन्कं सुवीर्या । उक्थे क उ स्विदन्तमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kaṃ te dānā asakṣata vṛtrahankaṃ suvīryā | ukthe ka u svidantamaḥ ||

translations.english: In what character, O slayer of Vṛtra, do the sacrificial offerings honour you, or the brave praises in thehymn? Who is nearest (in time of battle)?

mantras.sanskrit: अयं ते मानुषे जने सोमः पूरुषु सूयते । तस्येहि प्र द्रवा पिब ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ te mānuṣe jane somaḥ pūruṣu sūyate | tasyehi pra dravā piba ||

translations.english: For you is this Soma effused among men by me of mortal race; draw near, hasten, drink it.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं ते शर्यणावति सुषोमायामधि प्रियः । आर्जीकीये मदिन्तमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ te śaryaṇāvati suṣomāyāmadhi priyaḥ | ārjīkīye madintamaḥ ||

translations.english: This is your beloved most exhilarating Soma which grows in the Śaryaṇāvat lake by the Suṣomāriver in the Ārjikīya country.

mantras.sanskrit: तमद्य राधसे महे चारुं मदाय घृष्वये । एहीमिन्द्र द्रवा पिब ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamadya rādhase mahe cāruṃ madāya ghṛṣvaye | ehīmindra dravā piba ||

translations.english: Come today, Indra, hasten, drink this grateful Soma for our great wealth, and for your own foe-crushingexultation.

mantras.sanskrit: यदिन्द्र प्रागपागुदङ्न्यग्वा हूयसे नृभिः । आ याहि तूयमाशुभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadindra prāgapāgudaṅnyagvā hūyase nṛbhiḥ | ā yāhi tūyamāśubhiḥ ||

translations.english: Whether you are invoked by us, the leaders of rites, from the east, the west, the norh, or the south,come here quickly with your rapid steeds.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्वा प्रस्रवणे दिवो मादयासे स्वर्णरे । यद्वा समुद्रे अन्धसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadvā prasravaṇe divo mādayāse svarṇare | yadvā samudre andhasaḥ ||

translations.english: Whether you rejoice in the ambrosia-fountain of heaven, or in some other heavenward-leading sacrifice(on earth), or in the ocean-like firmament of the waters.

mantras.sanskrit: आ त्वा गीर्भिर्महामुरुं हुवे गामिव भोजसे । इन्द्र सोमस्य पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tvā gīrbhirmahāmuruṃ huve gāmiva bhojase | indra somasya pītaye ||

translations.english: Indra, by my praises I invoke you, great and strong one, to drink the Soma as a bull to eat (his fodder).

mantras.sanskrit: आ त इन्द्र महिमानं हरयो देव ते महः । रथे वहन्तु बिभ्रतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā ta indra mahimānaṃ harayo deva te mahaḥ | rathe vahantu bibhrataḥ ||

translations.english: Let your steeds, Indra, bearing you in your chariot, bring hither yourmight, (may they bring here) yoursplendour, O divine one.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र गृणीष उ स्तुषे महाँ उग्र ईशानकृत् । एहि नः सुतं पिब ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra gṛṇīṣa u stuṣe mahā~ ugra īśānakṛt | ehi naḥ sutaṃ piba ||

translations.english: Indra, you are invoked, you are praised, the great, the strong, the wilder of sovereignty; come here anddrink our libation.

mantras.sanskrit: सुतावन्तस्त्वा वयं प्रयस्वन्तो हवामहे । इदं नो बर्हिरासदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: sutāvantastvā vayaṃ prayasvanto havāmahe | idaṃ no barhirāsade ||

translations.english: Bearing the effused Soma and the sacrificial food, we invoke you, Indra, to sit on our sacred grass.

mantras.sanskrit: यच्चिद्धि शश्वतामसीन्द्र साधारणस्त्वम् । तं त्वा वयं हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yacciddhi śaśvatāmasīndra sādhāraṇastvam | taṃ tvā vayaṃ havāmahe ||

translations.english: Because you are common to many worshippers, therefore, Indra, we invoke you.

mantras.sanskrit: इदं ते सोम्यं मध्वधुक्षन्नद्रिभिर्नरः । जुषाण इन्द्र तत्पिब ॥
mantras.transliteration: idaṃ te somyaṃ madhvadhukṣannadribhirnaraḥ | juṣāṇa indra tatpiba ||

translations.english: The priests have milked for you with their stones this nectar of the Soma; drink it, Indra, well plural ased.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वाँ अर्यो विपश्चितोऽति ख्यस्तूयमा गहि । अस्मे धेहि श्रवो बृहत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvā~ aryo vipaścito'ti khyastūyamā gahi | asme dhehi śravo bṛhat ||

translations.english: Do you, the lord, pass by all other worshippers and come quickly to us, and bestow on us abundantfood.

mantras.sanskrit: दाता मे पृषतीनां राजा हिरण्यवीनाम् । मा देवा मघवा रिषत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dātā me pṛṣatīnāṃ rājā hiraṇyavīnām | mā devā maghavā riṣat ||

translations.english: May (Indra) the king give me cows adorned with gold; O gods, let not Maghavan be harmed.

mantras.sanskrit: सहस्रे पृषतीनामधि श्चन्द्रं बृहत्पृथु । शुक्रं हिरण्यमा ददे ॥
mantras.transliteration: sahasre pṛṣatīnāmadhi ścandraṃ bṛhatpṛthu | śukraṃ hiraṇyamā dade ||

translations.english: Upon a thousand cows I obtain gold, abundant, delightful, wide-spread, and pure.

mantras.sanskrit: नपातो दुर्गहस्य मे सहस्रेण सुराधसः । श्रवो देवेष्वक्रत ॥
mantras.transliteration: napāto durgahasya me sahasreṇa surādhasaḥ | śravo deveṣvakrata ||

translations.english: plural nged as I am in sorrow, my children, by the favour of the gods, obtain food, and are blessed withabundance in a thousand cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: तरोभिर्वो विदद्वसुमिन्द्रं सबाध ऊतये । बृहद्गायन्तः सुतसोमे अध्वरे हुवे भरं न कारिणम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tarobhirvo vidadvasumindraṃ sabādha ūtaye | bṛhadgāyantaḥ sutasome adhvare huve bharaṃ na kāriṇam ||

translations.english: Thronging together, (worship) for your protection Indra full of might and the revealer of wealth; (worshiphim), chanting the Bṛhat-sāman at his sacrifice where the Soma is effused, I invoke him as (men invoke) abeneficent master of a household.

mantras.sanskrit: न यं दुध्रा वरन्ते न स्थिरा मुरो मदे सुशिप्रमन्धसः । य आदृत्या शशमानाय सुन्वते दाता जरित्र उक्थ्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: na yaṃ dudhrā varante na sthirā muro made suśipramandhasaḥ | ya ādṛtyā śaśamānāya sunvate dātā jaritra ukthyam ||

translations.english: He, the handsome-jawed, whom, inthe intoxication of the Soma, the fierce (demons) withstand not, north firm gods, nor mortal (men)-- who confers glorious wealth on him who reverently praises him, offers the Somaand sings hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: यः शक्रो मृक्षो अश्व्यो यो वा कीजो हिरण्ययः । स ऊर्वस्य रेजयत्यपावृतिमिन्द्रो गव्यस्य वृत्रहा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ śakro mṛkṣo aśvyo yo vā kījo hiraṇyayaḥ | sa ūrvasya rejayatyapāvṛtimindro gavyasya vṛtrahā ||

translations.english: He Śakra, who is the purifier (of his worshippers), and well-skilled in horses, who is wonderful andgolden-bodied-- he, Indra, the slayer of Vṛtra, shakes the hiding-plural ce of the numerous herd of kine.

mantras.sanskrit: निखातं चिद्यः पुरुसम्भृतं वसूदिद्वपति दाशुषे । वज्री सुशिप्रो हर्यश्व इत्करदिन्द्रः क्रत्वा यथा वशत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nikhātaṃ cidyaḥ purusambhṛtaṃ vasūdidvapati dāśuṣe | vajrī suśipro haryaśva itkaradindraḥ kratvā yathā vaśat ||

translations.english: He who verily pours forth to the offerer the buried wealth accusative ulated by many, he, Indra, thethunderer, handsome-jawed, borne on bay steeds, does as he plural ases, (when propitiated) with sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्वावन्थ पुरुष्टुत पुरा चिच्छूर नृणाम् । वयं तत्त इन्द्र सं भरामसि यज्ञमुक्थं तुरं वचः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadvāvantha puruṣṭuta purā cicchūra nṛṇām | vayaṃ tatta indra saṃ bharāmasi yajñamukthaṃ turaṃ vacaḥ ||

translations.english: Hero, praised of many, what of old time you did desire from your votaries, that, Indra, we hasten to bringto you-- oblation and recited praise.

mantras.sanskrit: सचा सोमेषु पुरुहूत वज्रिवो मदाय द्युक्ष सोमपाः । त्वमिद्धि ब्रह्मकृते काम्यं वसु देष्ठः सुन्वते भुवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sacā someṣu puruhūta vajrivo madāya dyukṣa somapāḥ | tvamiddhi brahmakṛte kāmyaṃ vasu deṣṭhaḥ sunvate bhuvaḥ ||

translations.english: Bearer of the thunderbolt, invoked of many, radiant, drinker of the Soma, be present at our libations foryour exhilaration; for you are an abundant giver of desirable wealth to him who utters your praises and effusesthe Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: वयमेनमिदा ह्योऽपीपेमेह वज्रिणम् । तस्मा उ अद्य समना सुतं भरा नूनं भूषत श्रुते ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayamenamidā hyo'pīpemeha vajriṇam | tasmā u adya samanā sutaṃ bharā nūnaṃ bhūṣata śrute ||

translations.english: Today and yesterday we have here refreshed him, the thunderer; bring to him today our libation effusedfor (success in) battle; let him now hasten here on hearing our praise.

mantras.sanskrit: वृकश्चिदस्य वारण उरामथिरा वयुनेषु भूषति । सेमं नः स्तोमं जुजुषाण आ गहीन्द्र प्र चित्रया धिया ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛkaścidasya vāraṇa urāmathirā vayuneṣu bhūṣati | semaṃ naḥ stomaṃ jujuṣāṇa ā gahīndra pra citrayā dhiyā ||

translations.english: The obstructing robber, the destroyer of travelling enemies, is obedient to him in hiw ways; hasten,Indra, (drawn) by our gorgeous rite, welcoming this our hymn.

mantras.sanskrit: कदू न्वस्याकृतमिन्द्रस्यास्ति पौंस्यम् । केनो नु कं श्रोमतेन न शुश्रुवे जनुषः परि वृत्रहा ॥
mantras.transliteration: kadū nvasyākṛtamindrasyāsti pauṃsyam | keno nu kaṃ śromatena na śuśruve januṣaḥ pari vṛtrahā ||

translations.english: What act of might is there, unperformed by Indra? Who has not heard of his famous (heroism)? He, theslayer of Vṛtra, (is renowned) from his birth.

mantras.sanskrit: कदू महीरधृष्टा अस्य तविषीः कदु वृत्रघ्नो अस्तृतम् । इन्द्रो विश्वान्बेकनाटाँ अहर्दृश उत क्रत्वा पणीँरभि ॥
mantras.transliteration: kadū mahīradhṛṣṭā asya taviṣīḥ kadu vṛtraghno astṛtam | indro viśvānbekanāṭā~ ahardṛśa uta kratvā paṇī~rabhi ||

translations.english: When were his mighty forces ever languid? When was aught undestroyed before the slayer of Vṛtra?Indra by his energy overpowers all the huckstering usurers who see only this world's days.

mantras.sanskrit: वयं घा ते अपूर्व्येन्द्र ब्रह्माणि वृत्रहन् । पुरूतमासः पुरुहूत वज्रिवो भृतिं न प्र भरामसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayaṃ ghā te apūrvyendra brahmāṇi vṛtrahan | purūtamāsaḥ puruhūta vajrivo bhṛtiṃ na pra bharāmasi ||

translations.english: Indra, slayer of Vṛra, invoked of many, we, your many worshippers, offer new hymns to you, thunderer,as your wages.

mantras.sanskrit: पूर्वीश्चिद्धि त्वे तुविकूर्मिन्नाशसो हवन्त इन्द्रोतयः । तिरश्चिदर्यः सवना वसो गहि शविष्ठ श्रुधि मे हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pūrvīściddhi tve tuvikūrminnāśaso havanta indrotayaḥ | tiraścidaryaḥ savanā vaso gahi śaviṣṭha śrudhi me havam ||

translations.english: Indra, doer of many great deeds, (other worshippers) invoke the manifold hopes and protections whichabide in you; but rejecting the enemy's oblations, come to us bestower of dwellings; O mightiest, hear my appeal.

mantras.sanskrit: वयं घा ते त्वे इद्विन्द्र विप्रा अपि ष्मसि । नहि त्वदन्यः पुरुहूत कश्चन मघवन्नस्ति मर्डिता ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayaṃ ghā te tve idvindra viprā api ṣmasi | nahi tvadanyaḥ puruhūta kaścana maghavannasti marḍitā ||

translations.english: Indra, we are your, therefore we, your worshippers, depend on you; other than you, Maghavan, invokedof many, there is no giver of happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं नो अस्या अमतेरुत क्षुधोऽभिशस्तेरव स्पृधि । त्वं न ऊती तव चित्रया धिया शिक्षा शचिष्ठ गातुवित् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ no asyā amateruta kṣudho'bhiśasterava spṛdhi | tvaṃ na ūtī tava citrayā dhiyā śikṣā śaciṣṭha gātuvit ||

translations.english: Deliver from us this poverty, hunger and calumny; give us (our desire) by your protection and wondrousworking; O mightiest, you know the right way.

mantras.sanskrit: सोम इद्वः सुतो अस्तु कलयो मा बिभीतन । अपेदेष ध्वस्मायति स्वयं घैषो अपायति ॥
mantras.transliteration: soma idvaḥ suto astu kalayo mā bibhītana | apedeṣa dhvasmāyati svayaṃ ghaiṣo apāyati ||

translations.english: Let your effused Soma be only (for Indra); O sons of Kali, fear not; that malignant (spirit) departs, of hisown accord he departs.

mantras.sanskrit: त्यान्नु क्षत्रियाँ अव आदित्यान्याचिषामहे । सुमृळीकाँ अभिष्टये ॥
mantras.transliteration: tyānnu kṣatriyā~ ava ādityānyāciṣāmahe | sumṛḷīkā~ abhiṣṭaye ||

translations.english: We solicit for protection those kṣatriyas, the Ādityas who bless (their votaries) abundantly to theattainment of their desires.

mantras.sanskrit: मित्रो नो अत्यंहतिं वरुणः पर्षदर्यमा । आदित्यासो यथा विदुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mitro no atyaṃhatiṃ varuṇaḥ parṣadaryamā | ādityāso yathā viduḥ ||

translations.english: May the Ādityas, Mitra, Varuṇa, and Aryaman, bear us across our distress, as they know it well.

mantras.sanskrit: तेषां हि चित्रमुक्थ्यं वरूथमस्ति दाशुषे । आदित्यानामरंकृते ॥
mantras.transliteration: teṣāṃ hi citramukthyaṃ varūthamasti dāśuṣe | ādityānāmaraṃkṛte ||

translations.english: To those Ādityas belongs wonderful wealth, worthy of all praise, (laid up) for the offerer of oblationsand the sacrificer.

mantras.sanskrit: महि वो महतामवो वरुण मित्रार्यमन् । अवांस्या वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahi vo mahatāmavo varuṇa mitrāryaman | avāṃsyā vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: You are great, Varuṇa, Mitra and Aryaman, and great is your protection; your protections we implore.

mantras.sanskrit: जीवान्नो अभि धेतनादित्यासः पुरा हथात् । कद्ध स्थ हवनश्रुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: jīvānno abhi dhetanādityāsaḥ purā hathāt | kaddha stha havanaśrutaḥ ||

translations.english: Ādityas, hasten to us before our death, while we are yet alive; where are you, hearers of prayer?

mantras.sanskrit: यद्वः श्रान्ताय सुन्वते वरूथमस्ति यच्छर्दिः । तेना नो अधि वोचत ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadvaḥ śrāntāya sunvate varūthamasti yacchardiḥ | tenā no adhi vocata ||

translations.english: Whatever wealh, whatever dwelling is yours (to give) to the wearied offerer of libations-- with thesespeak to us a kindly answer.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्ति देवा अंहोरुर्वस्ति रत्नमनागसः । आदित्या अद्भुतैनसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asti devā aṃhorurvasti ratnamanāgasaḥ | ādityā adbhutainasaḥ ||

translations.english: Great, O deities, is (the guild) of the sinner, but to the sinless is happiness; Ādityas, you are void ofsin.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नः सेतुः सिषेदयं महे वृणक्तु नस्परि । इन्द्र इद्धि श्रुतो वशी ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā naḥ setuḥ siṣedayaṃ mahe vṛṇaktu naspari | indra iddhi śruto vaśī ||

translations.english: Let not the snare bind us; may Indra, the renowned, the subduer of all, deliver us for a glorious act.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नो मृचा रिपूणां वृजिनानामविष्यवः । देवा अभि प्र मृक्षत ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā no mṛcā ripūṇāṃ vṛjinānāmaviṣyavaḥ | devā abhi pra mṛkṣata ||

translations.english: O deities, ready to protect, move us not with the destructive net of our wicked enemieṣ

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्वामदिते मह्यहं देव्युप ब्रुवे । सुमृळीकामभिष्टये ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tvāmadite mahyahaṃ devyupa bruve | sumṛḷīkāmabhiṣṭaye ||

translations.english: I address you, who give abundant delight, the great goddess, Aditi, for the attainment of my desire.

mantras.sanskrit: पर्षि दीने गभीर आँ उग्रपुत्रे जिघांसतः । माकिस्तोकस्य नो रिषत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: parṣi dīne gabhīra ā~ ugraputre jighāṃsataḥ | mākistokasya no riṣat ||

translations.english: You protect on every side; let not (the net) of the destroyer hurt our children, in this shallow water full ofmighhty offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: अनेहो न उरुव्रज उरूचि वि प्रसर्तवे । कृधि तोकाय जीवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: aneho na uruvraja urūci vi prasartave | kṛdhi tokāya jīvase ||

translations.english: Wide-traversing, far-reaching goddess, put forth your power to come to us, innocent ones, that ourchildren may live.

mantras.sanskrit: ये मूर्धानः क्षितीनामदब्धासः स्वयशसः । व्रता रक्षन्ते अद्रुहः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye mūrdhānaḥ kṣitīnāmadabdhāsaḥ svayaśasaḥ | vratā rakṣante adruhaḥ ||

translations.english: You who are the heads of men, unharming, and of self-sustained glory, who, benevolent ones, protectour rites.

mantras.sanskrit: ते न आस्नो वृकाणामादित्यासो मुमोचत । स्तेनं बद्धमिवादिते ॥
mantras.transliteration: te na āsno vṛkāṇāmādityāso mumocata | stenaṃ baddhamivādite ||

translations.english: Ādityas, deliver us from the jaws of the destroyers like a bound thief; O Aditi, (deliver us).

mantras.sanskrit: अपो षु ण इयं शरुरादित्या अप दुर्मतिः । अस्मदेत्वजघ्नुषी ॥
mantras.transliteration: apo ṣu ṇa iyaṃ śarurādityā apa durmatiḥ | asmadetvajaghnuṣī ||

translations.english: Ādityas, let this net, let the malevolent design turn away from us innocuous.

mantras.sanskrit: शश्वद्धि वः सुदानव आदित्या ऊतिभिर्वयम् । पुरा नूनं बुभुज्महे ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaśvaddhi vaḥ sudānava ādityā ūtibhirvayam | purā nūnaṃ bubhujmahe ||

translations.english: Bounteous Ādityas, by your protections we have continually possessed enjoyments from of old.

mantras.sanskrit: शश्वन्तं हि प्रचेतसः प्रतियन्तं चिदेनसः । देवाः कृणुथ जीवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaśvantaṃ hi pracetasaḥ pratiyantaṃ cidenasaḥ | devāḥ kṛṇutha jīvase ||

translations.english: Wise deities, keep away from us, that we may live, the many doers of sin who come against us.

mantras.sanskrit: तत्सु नो नव्यं सन्यस आदित्या यन्मुमोचति । बन्धाद्बद्धमिवादिते ॥
mantras.transliteration: tatsu no navyaṃ sanyasa ādityā yanmumocati | bandhādbaddhamivādite ||

translations.english: Ādityas and Aditi, let that which releases us as a prisoner from his bond, be ever the object of ourpraise and worship.

mantras.sanskrit: नास्माकमस्ति तत्तर आदित्यासो अतिष्कदे । यूयमस्मभ्यं मृळत ॥
mantras.transliteration: nāsmākamasti tattara ādityāso atiṣkade | yūyamasmabhyaṃ mṛḷata ||

translations.english: Not to us is there strength enough to burst from this (net); O Ādityas, do you grant us your favour.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नो हेतिर्विवस्वत आदित्याः कृत्रिमा शरुः । पुरा नु जरसो वधीत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā no hetirvivasvata ādityāḥ kṛtrimā śaruḥ | purā nu jaraso vadhīt ||

translations.english: Let not this weapon of Vivasvat, this net made with hands, Ādityas, destroy us before old age.

mantras.sanskrit: वि षु द्वेषो व्यंहतिमादित्यासो वि संहितम् । विष्वग्वि वृहता रपः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi ṣu dveṣo vyaṃhatimādityāso vi saṃhitam | viṣvagvi vṛhatā rapaḥ ||

translations.english: Ādityas, utterly destroy our enemies, destroy wickedness, destroy the closely drawn net, destroy evileverywhere.

mantras.sanskrit: आ त्वा रथं यथोतये सुम्नाय वर्तयामसि । तुविकूर्मिमृतीषहमिन्द्र शविष्ठ सत्पते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tvā rathaṃ yathotaye sumnāya vartayāmasi | tuvikūrmimṛtīṣahamindra śaviṣṭha satpate ||

translations.english: Most powerful Indra, protector of the good, we brin you here, rich in achievement and subduer ofenemies, as a car for our protection and weal.

mantras.sanskrit: तुविशुष्म तुविक्रतो शचीवो विश्वया मते । आ पप्राथ महित्वना ॥
mantras.transliteration: tuviśuṣma tuvikrato śacīvo viśvayā mate | ā paprātha mahitvanā ||

translations.english: Great in power, rich in deeds, might one, adorable, you have filled (all things) with your universalmajesy.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य ते महिना महः परि ज्मायन्तमीयतुः । हस्ता वज्रं हिरण्ययम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya te mahinā mahaḥ pari jmāyantamīyatuḥ | hastā vajraṃ hiraṇyayam ||

translations.english: You mighty one, whose hands in your might grasp the all-pervading golden thunderbolt.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वानरस्य वस्पतिमनानतस्य शवसः । एवैश्च चर्षणीनामूती हुवे रथानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvānarasya vaspatimanānatasya śavasaḥ | evaiśca carṣaṇīnāmūtī huve rathānām ||

translations.english: I invoke (Indra) the lord of that might which subdues all enemies and bow to none-- (I invoke him)followed by your onsets as his soldiers and (surrounded) by the protection of your chariots (O Maruts).

mantras.sanskrit: अभिष्टये सदावृधं स्वर्मीळ्हेषु यं नरः । नाना हवन्त ऊतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhiṣṭaye sadāvṛdhaṃ svarmīḷheṣu yaṃ naraḥ | nānā havanta ūtaye ||

translations.english: (I invoke him) to come to our help, whose might ever waxes more and more-- to whom men appeal foraid in various ways in battles.

mantras.sanskrit: परोमात्रमृचीषममिन्द्रमुग्रं सुराधसम् । ईशानं चिद्वसूनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: paromātramṛcīṣamamindramugraṃ surādhasam | īśānaṃ cidvasūnām ||

translations.english: (I invoke) Indra, the unlimited, worthy of praise, the mighty, possessing excellent wealth, the lord oftreasures (for his votaries).

mantras.sanskrit: तंतमिद्राधसे मह इन्द्रं चोदामि पीतये । यः पूर्व्यामनुष्टुतिमीशे कृष्टीनां नृतुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃtamidrādhase maha indraṃ codāmi pītaye | yaḥ pūrvyāmanuṣṭutimīśe kṛṣṭīnāṃ nṛtuḥ ||

translations.english: To him, to him, Indra, do I direct my praise, that he may quaff the Soma to my great gain-- to him, thebringer of success, who rules over the praises of the offerers at the opening of the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: न यस्य ते शवसान सख्यमानंश मर्त्यः । नकिः शवांसि ते नशत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: na yasya te śavasāna sakhyamānaṃśa martyaḥ | nakiḥ śavāṃsi te naśat ||

translations.english: You mighty one, whose friendship no mortal reaches, whose might no one attains.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वोतासस्त्वा युजाप्सु सूर्ये महद्धनम् । जयेम पृत्सु वज्रिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvotāsastvā yujāpsu sūrye mahaddhanam | jayema pṛtsu vajrivaḥ ||

translations.english: Protected by you, O thunderer, with you as our ally, may we win great wealth in battles, that we maybathe in the water and behold he sun.

mantras.sanskrit: तं त्वा यज्ञेभिरीमहे तं गीर्भिर्गिर्वणस्तम । इन्द्र यथा चिदाविथ वाजेषु पुरुमाय्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ tvā yajñebhirīmahe taṃ gīrbhirgirvaṇastama | indra yathā cidāvitha vājeṣu purumāyyam ||

translations.english: We address you with sacrificial gifts, (we address you) with songs, O Indra most worthy of song, as youhave protected me, the offerer of many praises, in battles.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य ते स्वादु सख्यं स्वाद्वी प्रणीतिरद्रिवः । यज्ञो वितन्तसाय्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya te svādu sakhyaṃ svādvī praṇītiradrivaḥ | yajño vitantasāyyaḥ ||

translations.english: You, the thunderer, whose friendship is sweet, sweet too is your liberality, and your sacrificepre-eminently to be performed.

mantras.sanskrit: उरु णस्तन्वे तन उरु क्षयाय नस्कृधि । उरु णो यन्धि जीवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: uru ṇastanve tana uru kṣayāya naskṛdhi | uru ṇo yandhi jīvase ||

translations.english: Give ample (wealth) to our own selves, give ample (wealth) to our children, give ample (wealth) to ourdwelling, gran us (our desire) that we may live.

mantras.sanskrit: उरुं नृभ्य उरुं गव उरुं रथाय पन्थाम् । देववीतिं मनामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: uruṃ nṛbhya uruṃ gava uruṃ rathāya panthām | devavītiṃ manāmahe ||

translations.english: We solicit a spacious (road) for our servants, a spacious (road) for our cattle, a spacious road for ourchariot, and (an abundant) sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: उप मा षड्द्वाद्वा नरः सोमस्य हर्ष्या । तिष्ठन्ति स्वादुरातयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa mā ṣaḍdvādvā naraḥ somasya harṣyā | tiṣṭhanti svādurātayaḥ ||

translations.english: Six princes come to me in pairs, bearing plural asant gifts, in the exhilaration of the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋज्राविन्द्रोत आ ददे हरी ऋक्षस्य सूनवि । आश्वमेधस्य रोहिता ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛjrāvindrota ā dade harī ṛkṣasya sūnavi | āśvamedhasya rohitā ||

translations.english: I receive two straight-going steeds from Indrota, two from the son of Ṛkṣa, two from the son ofAśvamedha.

mantras.sanskrit: सुरथाँ आतिथिग्वे स्वभीशूँरार्क्षे । आश्वमेधे सुपेशसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: surathā~ ātithigve svabhīśū~rārkṣe | āśvamedhe supeśasaḥ ||

translations.english: (I receive) two steeds with excellent chariots from the son of Atithigva, two with excellent reins from theson of Ṛkṣa, two with excellent ornaments from the son of Aśvamedha.

mantras.sanskrit: षळश्वाँ आतिथिग्व इन्द्रोते वधूमतः । सचा पूतक्रतौ सनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṣaḷaśvā~ ātithigva indrote vadhūmataḥ | sacā pūtakratau sanam ||

translations.english: I have received together (with my other gifts) six horses with their mares from te pious Indrota, the sonof Atithigva.

mantras.sanskrit: ऐषु चेतद्वृषण्वत्यन्तॠज्रेष्वरुषी । स्वभीशुः कशावती ॥
mantras.transliteration: aiṣu cetadvṛṣaṇvatyantaṝjreṣvaruṣī | svabhīśuḥ kaśāvatī ||

translations.english: Among these straight-going steeds is numbered a mature mare with excellent reins and whip.

mantras.sanskrit: न युष्मे वाजबन्धवो निनित्सुश्चन मर्त्यः । अवद्यमधि दीधरत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: na yuṣme vājabandhavo ninitsuścana martyaḥ | avadyamadhi dīdharat ||

translations.english: O princes, givers of food, even the lover of calumny has thrown no censure on you.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रप्र वस्त्रिष्टुभमिषं मन्दद्वीरायेन्दवे । धिया वो मेधसातये पुरंध्या विवासति ॥
mantras.transliteration: prapra vastriṣṭubhamiṣaṃ mandadvīrāyendave | dhiyā vo medhasātaye puraṃdhyā vivāsati ||

translations.english: Present your sacrificial food with a three-fold song of praise to Indu, gladdener of heroes; he will blessyou in your religious rites to the accompaniment of your sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: नदं व ओदतीनां नदं योयुवतीनाम् । पतिं वो अघ्न्यानां धेनूनामिषुध्यसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: nadaṃ va odatīnāṃ nadaṃ yoyuvatīnām | patiṃ vo aghnyānāṃ dhenūnāmiṣudhyasi ||

translations.english: (Invoke) for yourselves the author of the dawns, (I invoke) for you the roarer of the rivers; (I invoke) foryou the lord of the inviolable ones; (O sacrificer), you desire kine.

mantras.sanskrit: ता अस्य सूददोहसः सोमं श्रीणन्ति पृश्नयः । जन्मन्देवानां विशस्त्रिष्वा रोचने दिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā asya sūdadohasaḥ somaṃ śrīṇanti pṛśnayaḥ | janmandevānāṃ viśastriṣvā rocane divaḥ ||

translations.english: These white kine, giving milk wells, mix the Soma for him at the three oblations, rising (in consequece tothe brilliant home of the sun, the birthplace of the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: अभि प्र गोपतिं गिरेन्द्रमर्च यथा विदे । सूनुं सत्यस्य सत्पतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi pra gopatiṃ girendramarca yathā vide | sūnuṃ satyasya satpatim ||

translations.english: Worship with your praise, as he himself knows-- that lord of kine, Indra, the son of Satya, the protectorof the good.

mantras.sanskrit: आ हरयः ससृज्रिरेऽरुषीरधि बर्हिषि । यत्राभि संनवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā harayaḥ sasṛjrire'ruṣīradhi barhiṣi | yatrābhi saṃnavāmahe ||

translations.english: Let the brilliant bay (horses) drop him down on the cut grass, where we will hymn his praise.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राय गाव आशिरं दुदुह्रे वज्रिणे मधु । यत्सीमुपह्वरे विदत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāya gāva āśiraṃ duduhre vajriṇe madhu | yatsīmupahvare vidat ||

translations.english: The cows have milked the intoxicating draught for Indra, the thunderer, when he finds it near him.

mantras.sanskrit: उद्यद्ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपं गृहमिन्द्रश्च गन्वहि । मध्वः पीत्वा सचेवहि त्रिः सप्त सख्युः पदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: udyadbradhnasya viṣṭapaṃ gṛhamindraśca ganvahi | madhvaḥ pītvā sacevahi triḥ sapta sakhyuḥ pade ||

translations.english: When Indra, and I ascend to our home, the world of the sun, then, having drunk the sweet (Soma), letus be united in the twenty-first sphere of the (universal) friend.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्चत प्रार्चत प्रियमेधासो अर्चत । अर्चन्तु पुत्रका उत पुरं न धृष्ण्वर्चत ॥
mantras.transliteration: arcata prārcata priyamedhāso arcata | arcantu putrakā uta puraṃ na dhṛṣṇvarcata ||

translations.english: Worship Indra, worship him pre-eminently, worship him, you of the family of Priyamedha; let your sonsalso worship him; worship him as a strong city.

mantras.sanskrit: अव स्वराति गर्गरो गोधा परि सनिष्वणत् । पिङ्गा परि चनिष्कददिन्द्राय ब्रह्मोद्यतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ava svarāti gargaro godhā pari saniṣvaṇat | piṅgā pari caniṣkadadindrāya brahmodyatam ||

translations.english: The drum utters its sound, the leathern guard twangs, the tawny bowstring leaps to and fro; let thehymn be raised to Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यत्पतन्त्येन्यः सुदुघा अनपस्फुरः । अपस्फुरं गृभायत सोममिन्द्राय पातवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yatpatantyenyaḥ sudughā anapasphuraḥ | apasphuraṃ gṛbhāyata somamindrāya pātave ||

translations.english: When the bright fertilizing rivers flow with diminished waters, then take the overflowing Soma for Indrato drink.

mantras.sanskrit: अपादिन्द्रो अपादग्निर्विश्वे देवा अमत्सत । वरुण इदिह क्षयत्तमापो अभ्यनूषत वत्सं संशिश्वरीरिव ॥
mantras.transliteration: apādindro apādagnirviśve devā amatsata | varuṇa idiha kṣayattamāpo abhyanūṣata vatsaṃ saṃśiśvarīriva ||

translations.english: Indra drank (the Soma), Agni drank it, the Viśve Devās were gladdened; let Varuṇa fix his dwellinghere, the waters have praised him as cows (low) meeting their calves.

mantras.sanskrit: सुदेवो असि वरुण यस्य ते सप्त सिन्धवः । अनुक्षरन्ति काकुदं सूर्म्यं सुषिरामिव ॥
mantras.transliteration: sudevo asi varuṇa yasya te sapta sindhavaḥ | anukṣaranti kākudaṃ sūrmyaṃ suṣirāmiva ||

translations.english: You are a glorious god, Varuṇa, across whose palate the seven rivers keep pouring as a fair-flowing(stream) into an abyss.

mantras.sanskrit: यो व्यतीँरफाणयत्सुयुक्ताँ उप दाशुषे । तक्वो नेता तदिद्वपुरुपमा यो अमुच्यत ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo vyatī~raphāṇayatsuyuktā~ upa dāśuṣe | takvo netā tadidvapurupamā yo amucyata ||

translations.english: He ho directs towards the worshiper his well-yoked prancing steeds-- he, (Indra), the swift bearer ofblessing, (produces) rain-- he, who being comparable only to himself is delivered (from all his enemies).

mantras.sanskrit: अतीदु शक्र ओहत इन्द्रो विश्वा अति द्विषः । भिनत्कनीन ओदनं पच्यमानं परो गिरा ॥
mantras.transliteration: atīdu śakra ohata indro viśvā ati dviṣaḥ | bhinatkanīna odanaṃ pacyamānaṃ paro girā ||

translations.english: Śakra verily overpowers, Indra overpowers all his enemies; he, worthy of love, abiding beyond, cleavesthe cloud smitten by his thunder-voice.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्भको न कुमारकोऽधि तिष्ठन्नवं रथम् । स पक्षन्महिषं मृगं पित्रे मात्रे विभुक्रतुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: arbhako na kumārako'dhi tiṣṭhannavaṃ ratham | sa pakṣanmahiṣaṃ mṛgaṃ pitre mātre vibhukratum ||

translations.english: (Indra), like a young boy, has mounted his splendid chariot; he makes ready for his father and motherthe great deer-like many-functioned cloud.

mantras.sanskrit: आ तू सुशिप्र दम्पते रथं तिष्ठा हिरण्ययम् । अध द्युक्षं सचेवहि सहस्रपादमरुषं स्वस्तिगामनेहसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tū suśipra dampate rathaṃ tiṣṭhā hiraṇyayam | adha dyukṣaṃ sacevahi sahasrapādamaruṣaṃ svastigāmanehasam ||

translations.english: Handsome-jawed (Indra), householder, mount your golden chariot; then let us meet mounted togetheron that bright thousand-footed brilliant auspiciously moving sinless (car).

mantras.sanskrit: तं घेमित्था नमस्विन उप स्वराजमासते । अर्थं चिदस्य सुधितं यदेतव आवर्तयन्ति दावने ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ ghemitthā namasvina upa svarājamāsate | arthaṃ cidasya sudhitaṃ yadetava āvartayanti dāvane ||

translations.english: (The priests), presenting praise, thus worship that self-resplendent (Indra); they obtain his well-storedwealth, when (his horsesk) bring him on his way for the offering.

mantras.sanskrit: अनु प्रत्नस्यौकसः प्रियमेधास एषाम् । पूर्वामनु प्रयतिं वृक्तबर्हिषो हितप्रयस आशत ॥
mantras.transliteration: anu pratnasyaukasaḥ priyamedhāsa eṣām | pūrvāmanu prayatiṃ vṛktabarhiṣo hitaprayasa āśata ||

translations.english: The Priyamedhas have reached the ancient dwelling plural ce of these deities, having strewn the sacredgrass and plural ced their oblations after the manner of a pre-eminent offering.

mantras.sanskrit: यो राजा चर्षणीनां याता रथेभिरध्रिगुः । विश्वासां तरुता पृतनानां ज्येष्ठो यो वृत्रहा गृणे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo rājā carṣaṇīnāṃ yātā rathebhiradhriguḥ | viśvāsāṃ tarutā pṛtanānāṃ jyeṣṭho yo vṛtrahā gṛṇe ||

translations.english: I praise that Indra who is the lord of men, who proceeds irresistible in his chariots, the breaker-throughof all armies, the pre-eminent one, the slayer of Vṛtra.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रं तं शुम्भ पुरुहन्मन्नवसे यस्य द्विता विधर्तरि । हस्ताय वज्रः प्रति धायि दर्शतो महो दिवे न सूर्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraṃ taṃ śumbha puruhanmannavase yasya dvitā vidhartari | hastāya vajraḥ prati dhāyi darśato maho dive na sūryaḥ ||

translations.english: Puruhanman, honour that Indra for your protection, for in your upholder there is a two-fold might; heholds in his hand (to smite his enemies) the glorious thunderbolt great as the sun in heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: नकिष्टं कर्मणा नशद्यश्चकार सदावृधम् । इन्द्रं न यज्ञैर्विश्वगूर्तमृभ्वसमधृष्टं धृष्ण्वोजसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nakiṣṭaṃ karmaṇā naśadyaścakāra sadāvṛdham | indraṃ na yajñairviśvagūrtamṛbhvasamadhṛṣṭaṃ dhṛṣṇvojasam ||

translations.english: None can touch him by his deeds, who has made Indra his friend by sacrifices-- (Indra) ever givingfresh strength, to be hymned by all, great, unconquered, of ever-daring might.

mantras.sanskrit: अषाळ्हमुग्रं पृतनासु सासहिं यस्मिन्महीरुरुज्रयः । सं धेनवो जायमाने अनोनवुर्द्यावः क्षामो अनोनवुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aṣāḷhamugraṃ pṛtanāsu sāsahiṃ yasminmahīrurujrayaḥ | saṃ dhenavo jāyamāne anonavurdyāvaḥ kṣāmo anonavuḥ ||

translations.english: (I laud) him who is not to be withstood, the mighty, the conqueror in hostile hosts; whom, when he wasborn, the strong rushing cows welcomed and the heavens and the earths praised.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्द्याव इन्द्र ते शतं शतं भूमीरुत स्युः । न त्वा वज्रिन्त्सहस्रं सूर्या अनु न जातमष्ट रोदसी ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaddyāva indra te śataṃ śataṃ bhūmīruta syuḥ | na tvā vajrintsahasraṃ sūryā anu na jātamaṣṭa rodasī ||

translations.english: Indra, were there a hundred heavens to compare with you, or were there a hundred earths-- Othunderer, not even a thousand suns woudl reveal you-- yes, no created thing would fill you, nor heaven andearth.

mantras.sanskrit: आ पप्राथ महिना वृष्ण्या वृषन्विश्वा शविष्ठ शवसा । अस्माँ अव मघवन्गोमति व्रजे वज्रिञ्चित्राभिरूतिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā paprātha mahinā vṛṣṇyā vṛṣanviśvā śaviṣṭha śavasā | asmā~ ava maghavangomati vraje vajriñcitrābhirūtibhiḥ ||

translations.english: Mightiest showerer (of blessings), you have filled all (our hosts) with your vast bountiful power; OMaghavan, thunderer, guard us with your manifold protections, (when we march) against the well-stockedcowpen of our enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: न सीमदेव आपदिषं दीर्घायो मर्त्यः । एतग्वा चिद्य एतशा युयोजते हरी इन्द्रो युयोजते ॥
mantras.transliteration: na sīmadeva āpadiṣaṃ dīrghāyo martyaḥ | etagvā cidya etaśā yuyojate harī indro yuyojate ||

translations.english: O long-lived Indra, the mortal who has not you as his deity obtains no food; (he who praises not) thatsteed-borne Indra, who yokes to his car the two variegated, who yokes the two bay steeds.

mantras.sanskrit: तं वो महो महाय्यमिन्द्रं दानाय सक्षणिम् । यो गाधेषु य आरणेषु हव्यो वाजेष्वस्ति हव्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ vo maho mahāyyamindraṃ dānāya sakṣaṇim | yo gādheṣu ya āraṇeṣu havyo vājeṣvasti havyaḥ ||

translations.english: Great (priests), worship that Indra who is propitiated by gifts; who is to be invoked in the shallows andin the depths, and who is to be invoked in battles.

mantras.sanskrit: उदू षु णो वसो महे मृशस्व शूर राधसे । उदू षु मह्यै मघवन्मघत्तय उदिन्द्र श्रवसे महे ॥
mantras.transliteration: udū ṣu ṇo vaso mahe mṛśasva śūra rādhase | udū ṣu mahyai maghavanmaghattaya udindra śravase mahe ||

translations.english: O hero, giver of dwellings, raise up to enjoy abundant food; raise us up, Maghavan, for abundantwealth; raise us up, Indra, for abundant fame.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं न इन्द्र ऋतयुस्त्वानिदो नि तृम्पसि । मध्ये वसिष्व तुविनृम्णोर्वोर्नि दासं शिश्नथो हथैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ na indra ṛtayustvānido ni tṛmpasi | madhye vasiṣva tuvinṛmṇorvorni dāsaṃ śiśnatho hathaiḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, who delights in offerings, you satisfy us abundantly with (the possession of him) who despisesyou; O you possessed of vast wealth, shelter us between your thighs; you smite down the Dāsa with yourblows.

mantras.sanskrit: अन्यव्रतममानुषमयज्वानमदेवयुम् । अव स्वः सखा दुधुवीत पर्वतः सुघ्नाय दस्युं पर्वतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: anyavratamamānuṣamayajvānamadevayum | ava svaḥ sakhā dudhuvīta parvataḥ sughnāya dasyuṃ parvataḥ ||

translations.english: May your friend, Parvata, hurl down from heaven him who follows other rites, the enemy of men, himwho offers no sacrifice and who worships not the gods; may Parvata hurl the Dasyu down to the storm smiter(death).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं न इन्द्रासां हस्ते शविष्ठ दावने । धानानां न सं गृभायास्मयुर्द्विः सं गृभायास्मयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ na indrāsāṃ haste śaviṣṭha dāvane | dhānānāṃ na saṃ gṛbhāyāsmayurdviḥ saṃ gṛbhāyāsmayuḥ ||

translations.english: Most powerful Indra, in your favour towards us, take these cows in your hand, as fried grain, to give tous; yes, take them twice in your favour towards us.

mantras.sanskrit: सखायः क्रतुमिच्छत कथा राधाम शरस्य । उपस्तुतिं भोजः सूरिर्यो अह्रयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sakhāyaḥ kratumicchata kathā rādhāma śarasya | upastutiṃ bhojaḥ sūriryo ahrayaḥ ||

translations.english: Associated priests, give good heed to the sacrifice, for how can we (worthily) perform the praise of(Indra) the destroyer, who is the recompenser of enemies, the sender of reward, the unvanquished?

mantras.sanskrit: भूरिभिः समह ऋषिभिर्बर्हिष्मद्भिः स्तविष्यसे । यदित्थमेकमेकमिच्छर वत्सान्पराददः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhūribhiḥ samaha ṛṣibhirbarhiṣmadbhiḥ staviṣyase | yaditthamekamekamicchara vatsānparādadaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, the common object of our worship, you are praised by many sacrificing Ṛṣis; for it is you,destroyer of foes, who thus give calves in succession to your worshippers.

mantras.sanskrit: कर्णगृह्या मघवा शौरदेव्यो वत्सं नस्त्रिभ्य आनयत् । अजां सूरिर्न धातवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: karṇagṛhyā maghavā śauradevyo vatsaṃ nastribhya ānayat | ajāṃ sūrirna dhātave ||

translations.english: May Maghavan, taking them by the ears, lead the cows with their calves from our three (destructiveenemies), as the owner leads a goat to drink.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं नो अग्ने महोभिः पाहि विश्वस्या अरातेः । उत द्विषो मर्त्यस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ no agne mahobhiḥ pāhi viśvasyā arāteḥ | uta dviṣo martyasya ||

translations.english: Agni, do you protect us by great wealh from every niggard and mortal foe.

mantras.sanskrit: नहि मन्युः पौरुषेय ईशे हि वः प्रियजात । त्वमिदसि क्षपावान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahi manyuḥ pauruṣeya īśe hi vaḥ priyajāta | tvamidasi kṣapāvān ||

translations.english: O you who was born loved, no human anger can hrm you-- you only are the lord of night.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो विश्वेभिर्देवेभिरूर्जो नपाद्भद्रशोचे । रयिं देहि विश्ववारम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no viśvebhirdevebhirūrjo napādbhadraśoce | rayiṃ dehi viśvavāram ||

translations.english: Son of strength, auspicious in brilliance, associated with all the gods, give us all desirable wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: न तमग्ने अरातयो मर्तं युवन्त रायः । यं त्रायसे दाश्वांसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: na tamagne arātayo martaṃ yuvanta rāyaḥ | yaṃ trāyase dāśvāṃsam ||

translations.english: That sacrificing mortal whom you, Agni, protect the niggardly cannot separate from wealht.

mantras.sanskrit: यं त्वं विप्र मेधसातावग्ने हिनोषि धनाय । स तवोती गोषु गन्ता ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ tvaṃ vipra medhasātāvagne hinoṣi dhanāya | sa tavotī goṣu gantā ||

translations.english: Wise (Agni), he whom in his performance of the sacrifice you incite to attain wealth, by your protectionwalks (lord) among crowds of cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं रयिं पुरुवीरमग्ने दाशुषे मर्ताय । प्र णो नय वस्यो अच्छ ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ rayiṃ puruvīramagne dāśuṣe martāya | pra ṇo naya vasyo accha ||

translations.english: You, Agni give to the offerer wealth comprehending many male descendants; conduct us to affluence.

mantras.sanskrit: उरुष्या णो मा परा दा अघायते जातवेदः । दुराध्ये मर्ताय ॥
mantras.transliteration: uruṣyā ṇo mā parā dā aghāyate jātavedaḥ | durādhye martāya ||

translations.english: Defend us, Jātavedas; deliver us not over to the malevolent, to the man whose thoughts are evil.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने माकिष्टे देवस्य रातिमदेवो युयोत । त्वमीशिषे वसूनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne mākiṣṭe devasya rātimadevo yuyota | tvamīśiṣe vasūnām ||

translations.english: Agni, let not the godless take away the wealth which you, the divine, have given, for you are the lord oftreasures.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो वस्व उप मास्यूर्जो नपान्माहिनस्य । सखे वसो जरितृभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no vasva upa māsyūrjo napānmāhinasya | sakhe vaso jaritṛbhyaḥ ||

translations.english: Son of strength, the friend, the giver of dwellings, you get our abundant treasure to us your praisers.

mantras.sanskrit: अच्छा नः शीरशोचिषं गिरो यन्तु दर्शतम् । अच्छा यज्ञासो नमसा पुरूवसुं पुरुप्रशस्तमूतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: acchā naḥ śīraśociṣaṃ giro yantu darśatam | acchā yajñāso namasā purūvasuṃ purupraśastamūtaye ||

translations.english: Let our voices come near the beautiful (Agni) him who bears devouring flames; let our sacrifices withour oblations come near him, for our protection, who is rich in wealth and rich in praise.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निं सूनुं सहसो जातवेदसं दानाय वार्याणाम् । द्विता यो भूदमृतो मर्त्येष्वा होता मन्द्रतमो विशि ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniṃ sūnuṃ sahaso jātavedasaṃ dānāya vāryāṇām | dvitā yo bhūdamṛto martyeṣvā hotā mandratamo viśi ||

translations.english: (Let them come near) Agni, Jātavedas, son of strength, for the giving of all desirable good things, whois doubly immortal as (perpetually burning) among priests, among the sacrificers.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निं वो देवयज्ययाग्निं प्रयत्यध्वरे । अग्निं धीषु प्रथममग्निमर्वत्यग्निं क्षैत्राय साधसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniṃ vo devayajyayāgniṃ prayatyadhvare | agniṃ dhīṣu prathamamagnimarvatyagniṃ kṣaitrāya sādhase ||

translations.english: I praise Agni, (O sacrificers), for the inauguration of your divine offering; (I praise him) when thesacrifice is proceeding; (I praise) Agni first of the gods, at our rites; (I praise) Agni when the enemy approaches; (Ipraise) Agni for the attainment of land.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निरिषां सख्ये ददातु न ईशे यो वार्याणाम् । अग्निं तोके तनये शश्वदीमहे वसुं सन्तं तनूपाम् ॥
