mantras.transliteration: agniriṣāṃ sakhye dadātu na īśe yo vāryāṇām | agniṃ toke tanaye śaśvadīmahe vasuṃ santaṃ tanūpām ||

translations.english: May Agni in his friendship give us food for he is the lord of all desirable things; we solicit abundance forour sons and grandsons from Agni, who is the giver of dwellings and the protector of our bodies.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निमीळिष्वावसे गाथाभिः शीरशोचिषम् । अग्निं राये पुरुमीळ्ह श्रुतं नरोऽग्निं सुदीतये छर्दिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnimīḷiṣvāvase gāthābhiḥ śīraśociṣam | agniṃ rāye purumīḷha śrutaṃ naro'gniṃ sudītaye chardiḥ ||

translations.english: Land with your hymns for our protection, Agni, whose splendour lie outspread; laud Agni for wealth, OPurumīḷha, for other offerers are lauding that far famed one on their own behalf; solicit of Agni a house for (me)Sudīti.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निं द्वेषो योतवै नो गृणीमस्यग्निं शं योश्च दातवे । विश्वासु विक्ष्ववितेव हव्यो भुवद्वस्तुॠषूणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniṃ dveṣo yotavai no gṛṇīmasyagniṃ śaṃ yośca dātave | viśvāsu vikṣvaviteva havyo bhuvadvastuṝṣūṇām ||

translations.english: We praise Agni that he may keep off our enemies; we praise Agni that he may give us joy and security;he may be worshipped as the giver of dwellings to the ṛṣis; he who is as it were the protector of all men.

mantras.sanskrit: हविष्कृणुध्वमा गमदध्वर्युर्वनते पुनः । विद्वाँ अस्य प्रशासनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: haviṣkṛṇudhvamā gamadadhvaryurvanate punaḥ | vidvā~ asya praśāsanam ||

translations.english: ()Priests), present the oblation, for (Agni) has come; the Adhvaryu again offers (the sacrifice),well-skilled in its offering.

mantras.sanskrit: नि तिग्ममभ्यंशुं सीदद्धोता मनावधि । जुषाणो अस्य सख्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni tigmamabhyaṃśuṃ sīdaddhotā manāvadhi | juṣāṇo asya sakhyam ||

translations.english: The Hotā sits down by (Agni's) hot flame, rejoicing in his friendship towards the offerer.

mantras.sanskrit: अन्तरिच्छन्ति तं जने रुद्रं परो मनीषया । गृभ्णन्ति जिह्वया ससम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: antaricchanti taṃ jane rudraṃ paro manīṣayā | gṛbhṇanti jihvayā sasam ||

translations.english: For the sake of the offerer, they seek by their skill to plural ce Rudra in the fore-front; they seize, as hesleeps, with their tongues.

mantras.sanskrit: जाम्यतीतपे धनुर्वयोधा अरुहद्वनम् । दृषदं जिह्वयावधीत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: jāmyatītape dhanurvayodhā aruhadvanam | dṛṣadaṃ jihvayāvadhīt ||

translations.english: (Agni), the giver of food, scorches the vast bow (Of the sky); he mounts the water; he smites the cloudwith his tongue.

mantras.sanskrit: चरन्वत्सो रुशन्निह निदातारं न विन्दते । वेति स्तोतव अम्ब्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: caranvatso ruśanniha nidātāraṃ na vindate | veti stotava ambyam ||

translations.english: Roaming like a calf and bright-shining, he finds here no hinderer; he seeks a chanter to praise hiṃ

mantras.sanskrit: उतो न्वस्य यन्महदश्वावद्योजनं बृहद् । दामा रथस्य ददृशे ॥
mantras.transliteration: uto nvasya yanmahadaśvāvadyojanaṃ bṛhad | dāmā rathasya dadṛśe ||

translations.english: As soon as the great stout harness of his horses is seen (in the sky), the traces of his chariot.

mantras.sanskrit: दुहन्ति सप्तैकामुप द्वा पञ्च सृजतः । तीर्थे सिन्धोरधि स्वरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: duhanti saptaikāmupa dvā pañca sṛjataḥ | tīrthe sindhoradhi svare ||

translations.english: Seven milk one (cow), the two direct the five, on the resounding shore of the river.

mantras.sanskrit: आ दशभिर्विवस्वत इन्द्रः कोशमचुच्यवीत् । खेदया त्रिवृता दिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā daśabhirvivasvata indraḥ kośamacucyavīt | khedayā trivṛtā divaḥ ||

translations.english: Invoked by the ten (fingers) of the worshipper, Indra has caused the cloud to fall from heaven by histhree-fold ray.

mantras.sanskrit: परि त्रिधातुरध्वरं जूर्णिरेति नवीयसी । मध्वा होतारो अञ्जते ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari tridhāturadhvaraṃ jūrṇireti navīyasī | madhvā hotāro añjate ||

translations.english: The three-hued fresh impetuous (blaze) goes swiftly round the sacrifice, the priests anoint it with butteṛ

mantras.sanskrit: सिञ्चन्ति नमसावतमुच्चाचक्रं परिज्मानम् । नीचीनबारमक्षितम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: siñcanti namasāvatamuccācakraṃ parijmānam | nīcīnabāramakṣitam ||

translations.english: They pour out with reverence the inexhaustible cauldron, as it goes round circular above and with anopening below:

mantras.sanskrit: अभ्यारमिदद्रयो निषिक्तं पुष्करे मधु । अवतस्य विसर्जने ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhyāramidadrayo niṣiktaṃ puṣkare madhu | avatasya visarjane ||

translations.english: The reverent priests drawing near pour the superfluous butter into the large (spoon), where hey set thecauldron down.

mantras.sanskrit: गाव उपावतावतं मही यज्ञस्य रप्सुदा । उभा कर्णा हिरण्यया ॥
mantras.transliteration: gāva upāvatāvataṃ mahī yajñasya rapsudā | ubhā karṇā hiraṇyayā ||

translations.english: Draw near, you cows, to the cauldron; (the two kinds of milk) in the sacrifice are plural ntiful and fruitgiving; both ears (of the vessel) are golden.

mantras.sanskrit: आ सुते सिञ्चत श्रियं रोदस्योरभिश्रियम् । रसा दधीत वृषभम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā sute siñcata śriyaṃ rodasyorabhiśriyam | rasā dadhīta vṛṣabham ||

translations.english: Drop into the milked (stream) the admixture, which reaches, (as it boils), heaven and earth; set the bullin the liquor.

mantras.sanskrit: ते जानत स्वमोक्यं सं वत्सासो न मातृभिः । मिथो नसन्त जामिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te jānata svamokyaṃ saṃ vatsāso na mātṛbhiḥ | mitho nasanta jāmibhiḥ ||

translations.english: They know their own abode; as calves with their mothers, so they severally assemble with their kiṇ

mantras.sanskrit: उप स्रक्वेषु बप्सतः कृण्वते धरुणं दिवि । इन्द्रे अग्ना नमः स्वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa srakveṣu bapsataḥ kṛṇvate dharuṇaṃ divi | indre agnā namaḥ svaḥ ||

translations.english: (The priests) minister in the sky the supporting (milk) to (Agni) who devours with his jaws; they ministerall the food to Indra and Agni.

mantras.sanskrit: अधुक्षत्पिप्युषीमिषमूर्जं सप्तपदीमरिः । सूर्यस्य सप्त रश्मिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhukṣatpipyuṣīmiṣamūrjaṃ saptapadīmariḥ | sūryasya sapta raśmibhiḥ ||

translations.english: The wind by means of the sun's seven rays milks the nourishing food and drink from the seven-steppedone.

mantras.sanskrit: सोमस्य मित्रावरुणोदिता सूर आ ददे । तदातुरस्य भेषजम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: somasya mitrāvaruṇoditā sūra ā dade | tadāturasya bheṣajam ||

translations.english: Mitra and Varuṇa, I take the Soma when the sun is risen; it is medicine to the sick.

mantras.sanskrit: उतो न्वस्य यत्पदं हर्यतस्य निधान्यम् । परि द्यां जिह्वयातनत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uto nvasya yatpadaṃ haryatasya nidhānyam | pari dyāṃ jihvayātanat ||

translations.english: Agni-- standing in the plural ce which I, the eager offerer, choose as the spot for presenting the oblations--fills the sky on every side with his blaze.

mantras.sanskrit: उदीराथामृतायते युञ्जाथामश्विना रथम् । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: udīrāthāmṛtāyate yuñjāthāmaśvinā ratham | anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||

translations.english: Rise, Aśvins, on my behalf, as I prepare to sacrifice; yoke your ear; let your protection abide near me.

mantras.sanskrit: निमिषश्चिज्जवीयसा रथेना यातमश्विना । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nimiṣaścijjavīyasā rathenā yātamaśvinā | anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||

translations.english: Come, Aśvins, in your chariot which moves quicker than the twinkling of an eye; let your protectionabide near me.

mantras.sanskrit: उप स्तृणीतमत्रये हिमेन घर्ममश्विना । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa stṛṇītamatraye himena gharmamaśvinā | anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||

translations.english: Aśvins, you covered the hot (fire) with cold (water) for Atri; let your protection abide near me.

mantras.sanskrit: कुह स्थः कुह जग्मथुः कुह श्येनेव पेतथुः । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kuha sthaḥ kuha jagmathuḥ kuha śyeneva petathuḥ | anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||

translations.english: Where are you? Whither are you gone? Wither have you flown like hawks? Let your protection abidenear me.

mantras.sanskrit: यदद्य कर्हि कर्हि चिच्छुश्रूयातमिमं हवम् । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadadya karhi karhi cicchuśrūyātamimaṃ havam | anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||

translations.english: If today, at some time, in some plural ce, you would but hear my invocation-- let your protection abide nearme.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्विना यामहूतमा नेदिष्ठं याम्याप्यम् । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvinā yāmahūtamā nediṣṭhaṃ yāmyāpyam | anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||

translations.english: The Aśvins are earnestly to be invoked in emergency; I enter into close friendshipwith them; let yourprotection abide near me.

mantras.sanskrit: अवन्तमत्रये गृहं कृणुतं युवमश्विना । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: avantamatraye gṛhaṃ kṛṇutaṃ yuvamaśvinā | anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||

translations.english: Aśvins, you made a sheltering house for Atri; let your protection abide near me.

mantras.sanskrit: वरेथे अग्निमातपो वदते वल्ग्वत्रये । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: varethe agnimātapo vadate valgvatraye | anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||

translations.english: You stayed the fire from its fierceness for Atri, while he praied you acceptably; let your protection abidenear me.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सप्तवध्रिराशसा धारामग्नेरशायत । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra saptavadhrirāśasā dhārāmagneraśāyata | anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||

translations.english: Through his praise of you Saptavadhri set the fire's flame-point (to his basket); let your protection abidenear me.

mantras.sanskrit: इहा गतं वृषण्वसू शृणुतं म इमं हवम् । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ihā gataṃ vṛṣaṇvasū śṛṇutaṃ ma imaṃ havam | anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||

translations.english: Come hither, lords of abundan wealth, hear this my invocation; let your protection abide near me.

mantras.sanskrit: किमिदं वां पुराणवज्जरतोरिव शस्यते । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kimidaṃ vāṃ purāṇavajjaratoriva śasyate | anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||

translations.english: Why is this (repeated invocation) addressed to you as if you were decrepit like old men? Let yourprotection abide near me.

mantras.sanskrit: समानं वां सजात्यं समानो बन्धुरश्विना । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samānaṃ vāṃ sajātyaṃ samāno bandhuraśvinā | anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||

translations.english: Aśvins, your relationship is common and you have a common kinsman; let your protection abide nearme.

mantras.sanskrit: यो वां रजांस्यश्विना रथो वियाति रोदसी । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo vāṃ rajāṃsyaśvinā ratho viyāti rodasī | anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||

translations.english: Your chariot, Aśvins, moves swifty through the worlds, through heaven and earth; let your protectionabide near me.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो गव्येभिरश्व्यैः सहस्रैरुप गच्छतम् । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no gavyebhiraśvyaiḥ sahasrairupa gacchatam | anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||

translations.english: Come to us with thousands of herds of cattle and horses; let your protection abide near me.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नो गव्येभिरश्व्यैः सहस्रेभिरति ख्यतम् । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā no gavyebhiraśvyaiḥ sahasrebhirati khyatam | anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||

translations.english: Pass us not by with your thousands of herds of cattle and horses; let your protection abide near uṣ

mantras.sanskrit: अरुणप्सुरुषा अभूदकर्ज्योतिॠतावरी । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aruṇapsuruṣā abhūdakarjyotiṝtāvarī | anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||

translations.english: The purple-tinted Dawn has appeared, the mistress of the sacrifice spreads her light; le tyour protectionabide near me.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्विना सु विचाकशद्वृक्षं परशुमाँ इव । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvinā su vicākaśadvṛkṣaṃ paraśumā~ iva | anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||

translations.english: Aśvins, the splendidly-brilliant (sun cleaves the darkness) as the woodman with his axe a tree; let yourprotection abide near me.

mantras.sanskrit: पुरं न धृष्णवा रुज कृष्णया बाधितो विशा । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: puraṃ na dhṛṣṇavā ruja kṛṣṇayā bādhito viśā | anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||

translations.english: O bold Saptavadhri, distressed by the entangling and detaining (basket), break through it as through acity; let your protection (Aśvins) abide near me.

mantras.sanskrit: विशोविशो वो अतिथिं वाजयन्तः पुरुप्रियम् । अग्निं वो दुर्यं वचः स्तुषे शूषस्य मन्मभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśoviśo vo atithiṃ vājayantaḥ purupriyam | agniṃ vo duryaṃ vacaḥ stuṣe śūṣasya manmabhiḥ ||

translations.english: Food-desiring (priests, worship) Agni, who is the guest of all mankind, beloved of many; I address tohim in your behalf a domestic homage with hymns, for the attainment of happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: यं जनासो हविष्मन्तो मित्रं न सर्पिरासुतिम् । प्रशंसन्ति प्रशस्तिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ janāso haviṣmanto mitraṃ na sarpirāsutim | praśaṃsanti praśastibhiḥ ||

translations.english: (That Agni), to whom clarified butter is offered, whom man, bearing oblations, worship with praises as afriend.

mantras.sanskrit: पन्यांसं जातवेदसं यो देवतात्युद्यता । हव्यान्यैरयद्दिवि ॥
mantras.transliteration: panyāṃsaṃ jātavedasaṃ yo devatātyudyatā | havyānyairayaddivi ||

translations.english: Jātavedaqs, the earnest praiser of his worshipper, who sends to heaven the oblations presented inthe sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: आगन्म वृत्रहन्तमं ज्येष्ठमग्निमानवम् । यस्य श्रुतर्वा बृहन्नार्क्षो अनीक एधते ॥
mantras.transliteration: āganma vṛtrahantamaṃ jyeṣṭhamagnimānavam | yasya śrutarvā bṛhannārkṣo anīka edhate ||

translations.english: We have come to that most excellent Agni, mightiest destroyer of the wicked, the benefactor of men, inwhose army (O rays) Śruvavān, the mighty son of Ṛkṣa, waxes great.

mantras.sanskrit: अमृतं जातवेदसं तिरस्तमांसि दर्शतम् । घृताहवनमीड्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: amṛtaṃ jātavedasaṃ tirastamāṃsi darśatam | ghṛtāhavanamīḍyam ||

translations.english: (We have come) to the immortal Jātavedas, who shows light across the darkness, well worthy ofpraise, and receiving the offering of ghī.

mantras.sanskrit: सबाधो यं जना इमेऽग्निं हव्येभिरीळते । जुह्वानासो यतस्रुचः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sabādho yaṃ janā ime'gniṃ havyebhirīḷate | juhvānāso yatasrucaḥ ||

translations.english: That Agni, whom these crowding worshippers honour with oblations, offering to him with up-lifted ladles.

mantras.sanskrit: इयं ते नव्यसी मतिरग्ने अधाय्यस्मदा । मन्द्र सुजात सुक्रतोऽमूर दस्मातिथे ॥
mantras.transliteration: iyaṃ te navyasī matiragne adhāyyasmadā | mandra sujāta sukrato'mūra dasmātithe ||

translations.english: This new hymn has been made by us for you, O joyful, well-born Agni, glorious in deeds, unbewildered,beautiful, the guest (of man).

mantras.sanskrit: सा ते अग्ने शंतमा चनिष्ठा भवतु प्रिया । तया वर्धस्व सुष्टुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sā te agne śaṃtamā caniṣṭhā bhavatu priyā | tayā vardhasva suṣṭutaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, may it be dear to you, most plural asant and most agreeable-- well praised by it, to you wax greaṭ

mantras.sanskrit: सा द्युम्नैर्द्युम्निनी बृहदुपोप श्रवसि श्रवः । दधीत वृत्रतूर्ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: sā dyumnairdyumninī bṛhadupopa śravasi śravaḥ | dadhīta vṛtratūrye ||

translations.english: May this (hymn) the rich source of wealth, heap abundance on our abundance (with stores won fromour enemies) in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्वमिद्गां रथप्रां त्वेषमिन्द्रं न सत्पतिम् । यस्य श्रवांसि तूर्वथ पन्यम्पन्यं च कृष्टयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvamidgāṃ rathaprāṃ tveṣamindraṃ na satpatim | yasya śravāṃsi tūrvatha panyampanyaṃ ca kṛṣṭayaḥ ||

translations.english: (Worship), you men, the bright (Agni), who goes like a horse and fills our chariots (with spoil), whoprotects the good like Indra, and by whose might you ravage the stores (of your enemies) and all their wonderful(wealth).

mantras.sanskrit: यं त्वा गोपवनो गिरा चनिष्ठदग्ने अङ्गिरः । स पावक श्रुधी हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ tvā gopavano girā caniṣṭhadagne aṅgiraḥ | sa pāvaka śrudhī havam ||

translations.english: Agni, Aṅirasa, whom Gopavana by his praise has made the especial giver of food-- O purifier, hear thisprayer.

mantras.sanskrit: यं त्वा जनास ईळते सबाधो वाजसातये । स बोधि वृत्रतूर्ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ tvā janāsa īḷate sabādho vājasātaye | sa bodhi vṛtratūrye ||

translations.english: O you whom the crowding worshippers praise for the obtainment of food, attend to them for thedestruction of their enemiess.

mantras.sanskrit: अहं हुवान आर्क्षे श्रुतर्वणि मदच्युति । शर्धांसीव स्तुकाविनां मृक्षा शीर्षा चतुर्णाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ huvāna ārkṣe śrutarvaṇi madacyuti | śardhāṃsīva stukāvināṃ mṛkṣā śīrṣā caturṇām ||

translations.english: Summoned before Śrutarvān, the son of Ṛkṣa, the humbler of the pride of his enemies, (I stroke) withmy hand the heads of the four horses (which he has given me), as (men stroke) the long wool of rams.

mantras.sanskrit: मां चत्वार आशवः शविष्ठस्य द्रवित्नवः । सुरथासो अभि प्रयो वक्षन्वयो न तुग्र्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: māṃ catvāra āśavaḥ śaviṣṭhasya dravitnavaḥ | surathāso abhi prayo vakṣanvayo na tugryam ||

translations.english: Four swift horses of that most mighty king, yoked to a splendid car, bear me forth to seize thesubstance (of my enemies), as the ships bore home the son of Tugra.

mantras.sanskrit: सत्यमित्त्वा महेनदि परुष्ण्यव देदिशम् । नेमापो अश्वदातरः शविष्ठादस्ति मर्त्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: satyamittvā mahenadi paruṣṇyava dediśam | nemāpo aśvadātaraḥ śaviṣṭhādasti martyaḥ ||

translations.english: Verily I address you, O great river Paruṣṇi, O waters, there is no mortal who gives horses moreliberally than this most mighty (monarch).

mantras.sanskrit: युक्ष्वा हि देवहूतमाँ अश्वाँ अग्ने रथीरिव । नि होता पूर्व्यः सदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yukṣvā hi devahūtamā~ aśvā~ agne rathīriva | ni hotā pūrvyaḥ sadaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, like a charioteer yoke your god-invoking steeds; eat thyself first, the invoker.

mantras.sanskrit: उत नो देव देवाँ अच्छा वोचो विदुष्टरः । श्रद्विश्वा वार्या कृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta no deva devā~ acchā voco viduṣṭaraḥ | śradviśvā vāryā kṛdhi ||

translations.english: Divine (Agni), proclaim us to the gods as profoundly killed; assure to us all desirable things.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं ह यद्यविष्ठ्य सहसः सूनवाहुत । ऋतावा यज्ञियो भुवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ ha yadyaviṣṭhya sahasaḥ sūnavāhuta | ṛtāvā yajñiyo bhuvaḥ ||

translations.english: Since you are truthful and worthy of sacrifice, O most youthful, son of strength and everywherehonoured with offerings.

mantras.sanskrit: अयमग्निः सहस्रिणो वाजस्य शतिनस्पतिः । मूर्धा कवी रयीणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayamagniḥ sahasriṇo vājasya śatinaspatiḥ | mūrdhā kavī rayīṇām ||

translations.english: This Agni is the lord of hundredfold and thousandfold food; he is the head, the seer, (the lord) of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: तं नेमिमृभवो यथा नमस्व सहूतिभिः । नेदीयो यज्ञमङ्गिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ nemimṛbhavo yathā namasva sahūtibhiḥ | nedīyo yajñamaṅgiraḥ ||

translations.english: O Aṅgirasa, with the deities associated in the invocation draw this offering near you as the Ṛbhus(bend) the circumference of a wheel.

mantras.sanskrit: तस्मै नूनमभिद्यवे वाचा विरूप नित्यया । वृष्णे चोदस्व सुष्टुतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tasmai nūnamabhidyave vācā virūpa nityayā | vṛṣṇe codasva suṣṭutim ||

translations.english: Virūpa, with constant voice address your praise to this well-plural ased showerer (of blessings).

mantras.sanskrit: कमु ष्विदस्य सेनयाग्नेरपाकचक्षसः । पणिं गोषु स्तरामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: kamu ṣvidasya senayāgnerapākacakṣasaḥ | paṇiṃ goṣu starāmahe ||

translations.english: What strong enemy shall we overthrow, to win kine, by the help of the host of this Agni of unmeasuredradiance?

mantras.sanskrit: मा नो देवानां विशः प्रस्नातीरिवोस्राः । कृशं न हासुरघ्न्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā no devānāṃ viśaḥ prasnātīrivosrāḥ | kṛśaṃ na hāsuraghnyāḥ ||

translations.english: May he not (forasake) us, the liegemen of the gods, as the milk- streaming cows (forsake not); the kineabandon not a little (calf).

mantras.sanskrit: मा नः समस्य दूढ्यः परिद्वेषसो अंहतिः । ऊर्मिर्न नावमा वधीत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā naḥ samasya dūḍhyaḥ paridveṣaso aṃhatiḥ | ūrmirna nāvamā vadhīt ||

translations.english: Let not the onset of any evil-minded adversary harm us as the wave (overwhelms) a ship.

mantras.sanskrit: नमस्ते अग्न ओजसे गृणन्ति देव कृष्टयः । अमैरमित्रमर्दय ॥
mantras.transliteration: namaste agna ojase gṛṇanti deva kṛṣṭayaḥ | amairamitramardaya ||

translations.english: Divine Agni, men utter your praises for the attainment of strength; by strength destroy the enemy.

mantras.sanskrit: कुवित्सु नो गविष्टयेऽग्ने संवेषिषो रयिम् । उरुकृदुरु णस्कृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: kuvitsu no gaviṣṭaye'gne saṃveṣiṣo rayim | urukṛduru ṇaskṛdhi ||

translations.english: Agni, send us abundance of wealth to satisfy our desires; giver of free space, grant us abundant rooṃ

mantras.sanskrit: मा नो अस्मिन्महाधने परा वर्ग्भारभृद्यथा । संवर्गं सं रयिं जय ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā no asminmahādhane parā vargbhārabhṛdyathā | saṃvargaṃ saṃ rayiṃ jaya ||

translations.english: Leave us not in this conflict as a bearer his burden win for us the plural ndered wealth of our foes.

mantras.sanskrit: अन्यमस्मद्भिया इयमग्ने सिषक्तु दुच्छुना । वर्धा नो अमवच्छवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: anyamasmadbhiyā iyamagne siṣaktu ducchunā | vardhā no amavacchavaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, may your plural gues pursue some other to terrify him; increase our vigorous strength in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्याजुषन्नमस्विनः शमीमदुर्मखस्य वा । तं घेदग्निर्वृधावति ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasyājuṣannamasvinaḥ śamīmadurmakhasya vā | taṃ ghedagnirvṛdhāvati ||

translations.english: Agni especially protects (in battle) that praiser or zealous sacrificer whose offerings he has attendeḍ

mantras.sanskrit: परस्या अधि संवतोऽवराँ अभ्या तर । यत्राहमस्मि ताँ अव ॥
mantras.transliteration: parasyā adhi saṃvato'varā~ abhyā tara | yatrāhamasmi tā~ ava ||

translations.english: Deliver us wholly from the hostile army, shield those among whom I am (lord).

mantras.sanskrit: विद्मा हि ते पुरा वयमग्ने पितुर्यथावसः । अधा ते सुम्नमीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: vidmā hi te purā vayamagne pituryathāvasaḥ | adhā te sumnamīmahe ||

translations.english: We know your protection, Agni, as of a father in former times, therefore we (again) desire of you thathappiness.

mantras.sanskrit: इमं नु मायिनं हुव इन्द्रमीशानमोजसा । मरुत्वन्तं न वृञ्जसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: imaṃ nu māyinaṃ huva indramīśānamojasā | marutvantaṃ na vṛñjase ||

translations.english: I invoke now for the destruction of my enemies the wise Indra attended by the Maruts, ruling all by hispower.

mantras.sanskrit: अयमिन्द्रो मरुत्सखा वि वृत्रस्याभिनच्छिरः । वज्रेण शतपर्वणा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayamindro marutsakhā vi vṛtrasyābhinacchiraḥ | vajreṇa śataparvaṇā ||

translations.english: Indra, attended by the Maruts, has cleft the head of Vṛtra with his hundred-jointed thunderbolt.

mantras.sanskrit: वावृधानो मरुत्सखेन्द्रो वि वृत्रमैरयत् । सृजन्त्समुद्रिया अपः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāvṛdhāno marutsakhendro vi vṛtramairayat | sṛjantsamudriyā apaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra increasing in might, attended by the Maruts, has torn Vṛtra asunder, letting loose the waters ofthe firmament.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं ह येन वा इदं स्वर्मरुत्वता जितम् । इन्द्रेण सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ ha yena vā idaṃ svarmarutvatā jitam | indreṇa somapītaye ||

translations.english: This is that Indra, by whom assisted by the Maruts, yonder heaven was conquered, to quaff the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: मरुत्वन्तमृजीषिणमोजस्वन्तं विरप्शिनम् । इन्द्रं गीर्भिर्हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: marutvantamṛjīṣiṇamojasvantaṃ virapśinam | indraṃ gīrbhirhavāmahe ||

translations.english: We invoke with our praises the mighty Indra, accompanied by the Maruts, the vigorous accepter of theresidue of the Soma oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रं प्रत्नेन मन्मना मरुत्वन्तं हवामहे । अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraṃ pratnena manmanā marutvantaṃ havāmahe | asya somasya pītaye ||

translations.english: With an ancient hymn we invoke Indra with the Maruts, to drink tis Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र मीढ्वः पिबा सोमं शतक्रतो । अस्मिन्यज्ञे पुरुष्टुत ॥
mantras.transliteration: marutvā~ indra mīḍhvaḥ pibā somaṃ śatakrato | asminyajñe puruṣṭuta ||

translations.english: Indra, Śatakratu, showerer (of blessings), drink the Soma at this offering, accompanied by the Maruts,O invoked of many.

mantras.sanskrit: तुभ्येदिन्द्र मरुत्वते सुताः सोमासो अद्रिवः । हृदा हूयन्त उक्थिनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tubhyedindra marutvate sutāḥ somāso adrivaḥ | hṛdā hūyanta ukthinaḥ ||

translations.english: Thunderer Indra, to you with the Maruts are these Soma-libations effused-- they are offered to you infaith, with recited hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: पिबेदिन्द्र मरुत्सखा सुतं सोमं दिविष्टिषु । वज्रं शिशान ओजसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: pibedindra marutsakhā sutaṃ somaṃ diviṣṭiṣu | vajraṃ śiśāna ojasā ||

translations.english: Drink, Indra, with your friends the Maruts, this Soma effused on the recurring sacred days, and sharpenyour thunderbolt with (renewed) vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: उत्तिष्ठन्नोजसा सह पीत्वी शिप्रे अवेपयः । सोममिन्द्र चमू सुतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uttiṣṭhannojasā saha pītvī śipre avepayaḥ | somamindra camū sutam ||

translations.english: Rising up in your strength, Indra, you did shake your jaws, when you had quaffed the Soma pressedbetween the two boards.

mantras.sanskrit: अनु त्वा रोदसी उभे क्रक्षमाणमकृपेताम् । इन्द्र यद्दस्युहाभवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: anu tvā rodasī ubhe krakṣamāṇamakṛpetām | indra yaddasyuhābhavaḥ ||

translations.english: Let heaven and earth follow you, Indra, as you smile, when you beat down the Dasyu.

mantras.sanskrit: वाचमष्टापदीमहं नवस्रक्तिमृतस्पृशम् । इन्द्रात्परि तन्वं ममे ॥
mantras.transliteration: vācamaṣṭāpadīmahaṃ navasraktimṛtaspṛśam | indrātpari tanvaṃ mame ||

translations.english: I make this sacrificial hymn, reaching to the eight points (of the sky) and rising to a ninth (the sun in thezenith), though it is less than (the dimensions of) Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: जज्ञानो नु शतक्रतुर्वि पृच्छदिति मातरम् । क उग्राः के ह शृण्विरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: jajñāno nu śatakraturvi pṛcchaditi mātaram | ka ugrāḥ ke ha śṛṇvire ||

translations.english: As soon as he was born Śatakratu asked his mother, who are the mgihty, who are renowned?

mantras.sanskrit: आदीं शवस्यब्रवीदौर्णवाभमहीशुवम् । ते पुत्र सन्तु निष्टुरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ādīṃ śavasyabravīdaurṇavābhamahīśuvam | te putra santu niṣṭuraḥ ||

translations.english: His strong mother answered, -- Aurṇavābha and Ahiṣuva, be these, my son the foes who you shallovercome.

mantras.sanskrit: समित्तान्वृत्रहाखिदत्खे अराँ इव खेदया । प्रवृद्धो दस्युहाभवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: samittānvṛtrahākhidatkhe arā~ iva khedayā | pravṛddho dasyuhābhavat ||

translations.english: The slayer of Vṛtra dragged them along as spokes (are tied fast) with a rope in the nave of a chariotwheel; he swelled in vigour, the slayer of enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: एकया प्रतिधापिबत्साकं सरांसि त्रिंशतम् । इन्द्रः सोमस्य काणुका ॥
mantras.transliteration: ekayā pratidhāpibatsākaṃ sarāṃsi triṃśatam | indraḥ somasya kāṇukā ||

translations.english: At one draught Indra drank at once thirty lakes filled wiḥ Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि गन्धर्वमतृणदबुध्नेषु रजस्स्वा । इन्द्रो ब्रह्मभ्य इद्वृधे ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi gandharvamatṛṇadabudhneṣu rajassvā | indro brahmabhya idvṛdhe ||

translations.english: In the realms (of the sky) where the foot finds no resting-plural ce, Indra shattered the cloud to bringincrease to the brāhmaṇas.

mantras.sanskrit: निराविध्यद्गिरिभ्य आ धारयत्पक्वमोदनम् । इन्द्रो बुन्दं स्वाततम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nirāvidhyadgiribhya ā dhārayatpakvamodanam | indro bundaṃ svātatam ||

translations.english: Indra smote (rain) from the clouds with his far-stretched arrow, he secured boiled rice (for men).

mantras.sanskrit: शतब्रध्न इषुस्तव सहस्रपर्ण एक इत् । यमिन्द्र चकृषे युजम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śatabradhna iṣustava sahasraparṇa eka it | yamindra cakṛṣe yujam ||

translations.english: That single shaft of yours, Indra, which you make your ally, is hundred-pointed, thousand-feathered.

mantras.sanskrit: तेन स्तोतृभ्य आ भर नृभ्यो नारिभ्यो अत्तवे । सद्यो जात ऋभुष्ठिर ॥
mantras.transliteration: tena stotṛbhya ā bhara nṛbhyo nāribhyo attave | sadyo jāta ṛbhuṣṭhira ||

translations.english: Forthwith increased (by our offerings), do you, mighty and firm, by that (weapon) brin (wealth) forsustenance to us your praisers, our children, and our wives.

mantras.sanskrit: एता च्यौत्नानि ते कृता वर्षिष्ठानि परीणसा । हृदा वीड्वधारयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: etā cyautnāni te kṛtā varṣiṣṭhāni parīṇasā | hṛdā vīḍvadhārayaḥ ||

translations.english: These gigantic far-reaching efforts were put forth by you; you did fix them firm in your thought.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वेत्ता विष्णुराभरदुरुक्रमस्त्वेषितः । शतं महिषान्क्षीरपाकमोदनं वराहमिन्द्र एमुषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvettā viṣṇurābharadurukramastveṣitaḥ | śataṃ mahiṣānkṣīrapākamodanaṃ varāhamindra emuṣam ||

translations.english: The wide-traversing Sun, despatched by you, brings (to the world) all these (waters which you create);he brings hundreds of cattle and rice boiled in milk; it is Indra who slays the water-stealing boar.

mantras.sanskrit: तुविक्षं ते सुकृतं सूमयं धनुः साधुर्बुन्दो हिरण्ययः । उभा ते बाहू रण्या सुसंस्कृत ऋदूपे चिदृदूवृधा ॥
mantras.transliteration: tuvikṣaṃ te sukṛtaṃ sūmayaṃ dhanuḥ sādhurbundo hiraṇyayaḥ | ubhā te bāhū raṇyā susaṃskṛta ṛdūpe cidṛdūvṛdhā ||

translations.english: Far-darting is your well-made auspicious bow, unfailing is your golden arrow; your two warlike arms areready equipped, destructively overthrowing, destructively piercing.

mantras.sanskrit: पुरोळाशं नो अन्धस इन्द्र सहस्रमा भर । शता च शूर गोनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: puroḷāśaṃ no andhasa indra sahasramā bhara | śatā ca śūra gonām ||

translations.english: (Accepting) our offering of sacrificial viands, O hero Indra, bring us thousands and hundreds of cows.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो भर व्यञ्जनं गामश्वमभ्यञ्जनम् । सचा मना हिरण्यया ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no bhara vyañjanaṃ gāmaśvamabhyañjanam | sacā manā hiraṇyayā ||

translations.english: Bring us condiments, cows, horses, and oil, (bring us) with them precious golden (vessels).

mantras.sanskrit: उत नः कर्णशोभना पुरूणि धृष्णवा भर । त्वं हि शृण्विषे वसो ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta naḥ karṇaśobhanā purūṇi dhṛṣṇavā bhara | tvaṃ hi śṛṇviṣe vaso ||

translations.english: O resolute one, bring us many ear-ornaments; giver of dwellings, you are renowned.

mantras.sanskrit: नकीं वृधीक इन्द्र ते न सुषा न सुदा उत । नान्यस्त्वच्छूर वाघतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nakīṃ vṛdhīka indra te na suṣā na sudā uta | nānyastvacchūra vāghataḥ ||

translations.english: There is no prosperer other than you, no divider of the spoil, no giver of boons; O hero, there is no(leader) of the sacrificer other than you.

mantras.sanskrit: नकीमिन्द्रो निकर्तवे न शक्रः परिशक्तवे । विश्वं शृणोति पश्यति ॥
mantras.transliteration: nakīmindro nikartave na śakraḥ pariśaktave | viśvaṃ śṛṇoti paśyati ||

translations.english: Indra cannot be brought low, he cannot be over-powered-- he hears, he sees all.

mantras.sanskrit: स मन्युं मर्त्यानामदब्धो नि चिकीषते । पुरा निदश्चिकीषते ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa manyuṃ martyānāmadabdho ni cikīṣate | purā nidaścikīṣate ||

translations.english: Unharmed he brings low the wrath of mortals; ere any one can reproach him, he brings him low.

mantras.sanskrit: क्रत्व इत्पूर्णमुदरं तुरस्यास्ति विधतः । वृत्रघ्नः सोमपाव्नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kratva itpūrṇamudaraṃ turasyāsti vidhataḥ | vṛtraghnaḥ somapāvnaḥ ||

translations.english: The belly of the Soma-drinker, the eager slayer of Vṛtra, is filled by the sacrificer's offering.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वे वसूनि संगता विश्वा च सोम सौभगा । सुदात्वपरिह्वृता ॥
mantras.transliteration: tve vasūni saṃgatā viśvā ca soma saubhagā | sudātvaparihvṛtā ||

translations.english: In you, O drinker of the Soma, are treasures stored, and all precious things and unblemished giftṣ

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामिद्यवयुर्मम कामो गव्युर्हिरण्ययुः । त्वामश्वयुरेषते ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmidyavayurmama kāmo gavyurhiraṇyayuḥ | tvāmaśvayureṣate ||

translations.english: To you my desire astens, seeking barley, cows and gold-- to you it hastens seeking horses.

mantras.sanskrit: तवेदिन्द्राहमाशसा हस्ते दात्रं चना ददे । दिनस्य वा मघवन्त्सम्भृतस्य वा पूर्धि यवस्य काशिना ॥
mantras.transliteration: tavedindrāhamāśasā haste dātraṃ canā dade | dinasya vā maghavantsambhṛtasya vā pūrdhi yavasya kāśinā ||

translations.english: I take my sickle also in hand, Indra, with a prayer to you; fill it, Maghavan, with a handful of barleyalready cut or piled.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं कृत्नुरगृभीतो विश्वजिदुद्भिदित्सोमः । ऋषिर्विप्रः काव्येन ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ kṛtnuragṛbhīto viśvajidudbhiditsomaḥ | ṛṣirvipraḥ kāvyena ||

translations.english: This all-creating Soma, obstructed by none, the conqueror of all, the producer of fruit, the seer, thewise, (is to be praised) with a hymn.

mantras.sanskrit: अभ्यूर्णोति यन्नग्नं भिषक्ति विश्वं यत्तुरम् । प्रेमन्धः ख्यन्निः श्रोणो भूत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhyūrṇoti yannagnaṃ bhiṣakti viśvaṃ yatturam | premandhaḥ khyanniḥ śroṇo bhūt ||

translations.english: He covers what is naked, he heals all that is sick, the blind sees, the lame walks.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं सोम तनूकृद्भ्यो द्वेषोभ्योऽन्यकृतेभ्यः । उरु यन्तासि वरूथम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ soma tanūkṛdbhyo dveṣobhyo'nyakṛtebhyaḥ | uru yantāsi varūtham ||

translations.english: Soma, you offer us a wide shelter from the wasting enmities wrought by our foes.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं चित्ती तव दक्षैर्दिव आ पृथिव्या ऋजीषिन् । यावीरघस्य चिद्द्वेषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ cittī tava dakṣairdiva ā pṛthivyā ṛjīṣin | yāvīraghasya ciddveṣaḥ ||

translations.english: O Ṛjīṣin, by you wisdom and might drive away the enmity of our oppressor from the heaven andearth.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्थिनो यन्ति चेदर्थं गच्छानिद्ददुषो रातिम् । ववृज्युस्तृष्यतः कामम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: arthino yanti cedarthaṃ gacchāniddaduṣo rātim | vavṛjyustṛṣyataḥ kāmam ||

translations.english: The petitioners seek for wealth, they attend the bounty of the liberal; (by you) men pour out the desireof the thirsty.

mantras.sanskrit: विदद्यत्पूर्व्यं नष्टमुदीमृतायुमीरयत् । प्रेमायुस्तारीदतीर्णम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vidadyatpūrvyaṃ naṣṭamudīmṛtāyumīrayat | premāyustārīdatīrṇam ||

translations.english: (Soma) urges him on when the sacrificer obtains (by offerings) him old lost wealth, he lengthen out hisunending life.

mantras.sanskrit: सुशेवो नो मृळयाकुरदृप्तक्रतुरवातः । भवा नः सोम शं हृदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: suśevo no mṛḷayākuradṛptakraturavātaḥ | bhavā naḥ soma śaṃ hṛde ||

translations.english: Most gracious and conferring joy, void of pride in your acts, and never failing, dwell, Soma, auspiciouslyin our hearts.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नः सोम सं वीविजो मा वि बीभिषथा राजन् । मा नो हार्दि त्विषा वधीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā naḥ soma saṃ vīvijo mā vi bībhiṣathā rājan | mā no hārdi tviṣā vadhīḥ ||

translations.english: O Soma, cause us not to tremble, frighten us not, O king; smite not our hearts with your brightness.

mantras.sanskrit: अव यत्स्वे सधस्थे देवानां दुर्मतीरीक्षे । राजन्नप द्विषः सेध मीढ्वो अप स्रिधः सेध ॥
mantras.transliteration: ava yatsve sadhasthe devānāṃ durmatīrīkṣe | rājannapa dviṣaḥ sedha mīḍhvo apa sridhaḥ sedha ||

translations.english: When in my house I watch against the enemies of the gods, then, O kind, drive away those who hateus-- O showerer of blessings, drive away those who would harm us.

mantras.sanskrit: नह्यन्यं बळाकरं मर्डितारं शतक्रतो । त्वं न इन्द्र मृळय ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahyanyaṃ baḷākaraṃ marḍitāraṃ śatakrato | tvaṃ na indra mṛḷaya ||

translations.english: Other than you, Śatakratu, I know no bestower of happiness; Indra, do you make us happy.

mantras.sanskrit: यो नः शश्वत्पुराविथामृध्रो वाजसातये । स त्वं न इन्द्र मृळय ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo naḥ śaśvatpurāvithāmṛdhro vājasātaye | sa tvaṃ na indra mṛḷaya ||

translations.english: O you, the invulnerable, who have always in former times protected us for the battle, do you, Indra,make us happy.

mantras.sanskrit: किमङ्ग रध्रचोदनः सुन्वानस्यावितेदसि । कुवित्स्विन्द्र णः शकः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kimaṅga radhracodanaḥ sunvānasyāvitedasi | kuvitsvindra ṇaḥ śakaḥ ||

translations.english: Director of the worshipper, you are the guardian of the offerer; help us mightily.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र प्र णो रथमव पश्चाच्चित्सन्तमद्रिवः । पुरस्तादेनं मे कृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra pra ṇo rathamava paścāccitsantamadrivaḥ | purastādenaṃ me kṛdhi ||

translations.english: Indra, protect our chariot; though now left behind, set it in the front, O thunderer.

mantras.sanskrit: हन्तो नु किमाससे प्रथमं नो रथं कृधि । उपमं वाजयु श्रवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: hanto nu kimāsase prathamaṃ no rathaṃ kṛdhi | upamaṃ vājayu śravaḥ ||

translations.english: Up, why sit you still? Make our chariot the first; our food-seeking offering is near you.

mantras.sanskrit: अवा नो वाजयुं रथं सुकरं ते किमित्परि । अस्मान्त्सु जिग्युषस्कृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: avā no vājayuṃ rathaṃ sukaraṃ te kimitpari | asmāntsu jigyuṣaskṛdhi ||

translations.english: Protect our food-seeking chariot, everything is easy for you to do; make us completely victorious.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र दृह्यस्व पूरसि भद्रा त एति निष्कृतम् । इयं धीॠत्वियावती ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra dṛhyasva pūrasi bhadrā ta eti niṣkṛtam | iyaṃ dhīṝtviyāvatī ||

translations.english: Indra, be firm (in battle), you are (strong as) a city; to you, the repeller (of enemies), comes thisauspicious sacrifice, offered in due season.

mantras.sanskrit: मा सीमवद्य आ भागुर्वी काष्ठा हितं धनम् । अपावृक्ता अरत्नयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā sīmavadya ā bhāgurvī kāṣṭhā hitaṃ dhanam | apāvṛktā aratnayaḥ ||

translations.english: Let not reproach reach us; far off is the goal; there is the wealth stored; may our enemies be excluded.

mantras.sanskrit: तुरीयं नाम यज्ञियं यदा करस्तदुश्मसि । आदित्पतिर्न ओहसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: turīyaṃ nāma yajñiyaṃ yadā karastaduśmasi | āditpatirna ohase ||

translations.english: When you assume your sacrificial fourth name, we long for it; then you forthwith carry us as a protectoṛ

mantras.sanskrit: अवीवृधद्वो अमृता अमन्दीदेकद्यूर्देवा उत याश्च देवीः । तस्मा उ राधः कृणुत प्रशस्तं प्रातर्मक्षू धियावसुर्जगम्यात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: avīvṛdhadvo amṛtā amandīdekadyūrdevā uta yāśca devīḥ | tasmā u rādhaḥ kṛṇuta praśastaṃ prātarmakṣū dhiyāvasurjagamyāt ||

translations.english: O immortal gods and all you goddesses, Ekadyū has honoured you (with his praise) and rejoiced you(with his Soma-offering); make his substance abundant; and may (Indra), who rewards pious acts wtiḥ wealth,come speedily in the morning.

mantras.sanskrit: आ तू न इन्द्र क्षुमन्तं चित्रं ग्राभं सं गृभाय । महाहस्ती दक्षिणेन ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tū na indra kṣumantaṃ citraṃ grābhaṃ saṃ gṛbhāya | mahāhastī dakṣiṇena ||

translations.english: Indra, lord of the mighty hand, do you seize for us with your right hand marvellous praise-exciting(riches), worthy to be seized.

mantras.sanskrit: विद्मा हि त्वा तुविकूर्मिं तुविदेष्णं तुवीमघम् । तुविमात्रमवोभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vidmā hi tvā tuvikūrmiṃ tuvideṣṇaṃ tuvīmagham | tuvimātramavobhiḥ ||

translations.english: We know you the achiever of many great deeds, the bestower of many gifts, the lord of much wealth,vast in size, and full of protection (for your worshippeers).

mantras.sanskrit: नहि त्वा शूर देवा न मर्तासो दित्सन्तम् । भीमं न गां वारयन्ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahi tvā śūra devā na martāso ditsantam | bhīmaṃ na gāṃ vārayante ||

translations.english: Hero, when you desire to give, neither gods nor men can stay you, as (they cannot stay) a terrible bull.

mantras.sanskrit: एतो न्विन्द्रं स्तवामेशानं वस्वः स्वराजम् । न राधसा मर्धिषन्नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: eto nvindraṃ stavāmeśānaṃ vasvaḥ svarājam | na rādhasā mardhiṣannaḥ ||

translations.english: Hasten here, let us glorify Indra the lord of wealth, the self- resplendent, let none vex, us by his wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र स्तोषदुप गासिषच्छ्रवत्साम गीयमानम् । अभि राधसा जुगुरत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra stoṣadupa gāsiṣacchravatsāma gīyamānam | abhi rādhasā jugurat ||

translations.english: May (Indra) sing the prelude, may he sing the accompaniment, may he listen to our hymn as it ischanted; may he, endowed with wealth, accept us favourably.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो भर दक्षिणेनाभि सव्येन प्र मृश । इन्द्र मा नो वसोर्निर्भाक् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no bhara dakṣiṇenābhi savyena pra mṛśa | indra mā no vasornirbhāk ||

translations.english: Bring us (gifts) with your right hand, and with your left bestow them on us; exclude us not, Indra, fromwealth.

mantras.sanskrit: उप क्रमस्वा भर धृषता धृष्णो जनानाम् । अदाशूष्टरस्य वेदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa kramasvā bhara dhṛṣatā dhṛṣṇo janānām | adāśūṣṭarasya vedaḥ ||

translations.english: Come here, and bring us, daring one, with your resolute (mind), the wealth of him who is pre-eminentlya niggard among men.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र य उ नु ते अस्ति वाजो विप्रेभिः सनित्वः । अस्माभिः सु तं सनुहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra ya u nu te asti vājo viprebhiḥ sanitvaḥ | asmābhiḥ su taṃ sanuhi ||

translations.english: O Indra, give us abundantly that wealth is yours, and which is to be obtained by the wise (worshippers).

mantras.sanskrit: सद्योजुवस्ते वाजा अस्मभ्यं विश्वश्चन्द्राः । वशैश्च मक्षू जरन्ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: sadyojuvaste vājā asmabhyaṃ viśvaścandrāḥ | vaśaiśca makṣū jarante ||

translations.english: May your all-rejoicing riches speedily come to us; full of desires, men immediately offer their praises.

mantras.sanskrit: आ प्र द्रव परावतोऽर्वावतश्च वृत्रहन् । मध्वः प्रति प्रभर्मणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā pra drava parāvato'rvāvataśca vṛtrahan | madhvaḥ prati prabharmaṇi ||

translations.english: Hasten, slayer of Vṛtra, from afar or from near to the exhilarating (Soma-libations) in the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: तीव्राः सोमास आ गहि सुतासो मादयिष्णवः । पिबा दधृग्यथोचिषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tīvrāḥ somāsa ā gahi sutāso mādayiṣṇavaḥ | pibā dadhṛgyathociṣe ||

translations.english: Come here, the strong intoxicating Soma is effused; drink, since you are boldly devoted to it.

mantras.sanskrit: इषा मन्दस्वादु तेऽरं वराय मन्यवे । भुवत्त इन्द्र शं हृदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: iṣā mandasvādu te'raṃ varāya manyave | bhuvatta indra śaṃ hṛde ||

translations.english: Rejoice yourself with this food-- may it forthwith avail to (quench) your foe-restraining anger, may itproduce happiness, Indra, in your heart.

mantras.sanskrit: आ त्वशत्रवा गहि न्युक्थानि च हूयसे । उपमे रोचने दिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tvaśatravā gahi nyukthāni ca hūyase | upame rocane divaḥ ||

translations.english: O you who have no enemies, come here; you are summoned from the resplendent heaven to the hymnsat this our rite near at hand in this world illumined (by the sacred rites).

mantras.sanskrit: तुभ्यायमद्रिभिः सुतो गोभिः श्रीतो मदाय कम् । प्र सोम इन्द्र हूयते ॥
mantras.transliteration: tubhyāyamadribhiḥ suto gobhiḥ śrīto madāya kam | pra soma indra hūyate ||

translations.english: Indra, this Soma, effused for you by the stones and mixed with milk, is offered auspiciously (in the fire)for your exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र श्रुधि सु मे हवमस्मे सुतस्य गोमतः । वि पीतिं तृप्तिमश्नुहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra śrudhi su me havamasme sutasya gomataḥ | vi pītiṃ tṛptimaśnuhi ||

translations.english: Indra, hear with favour my call; be present at the drinking of this our libation mixed with milk and besatisfied.

mantras.sanskrit: य इन्द्र चमसेष्वा सोमश्चमूषु ते सुतः । पिबेदस्य त्वमीशिषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya indra camaseṣvā somaścamūṣu te sutaḥ | pibedasya tvamīśiṣe ||

translations.english: Whatever Soma has been poured into the cups and the bowls for you, drink it, Indra-- you are thesovereign.

mantras.sanskrit: यो अप्सु चन्द्रमा इव सोमश्चमूषु ददृशे । पिबेदस्य त्वमीशिषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo apsu candramā iva somaścamūṣu dadṛśe | pibedasya tvamīśiṣe ||

translations.english: Whatever Soma is seen in the vessels like the moon (reflected) in the waters, drink it-- you are thesovereign.

mantras.sanskrit: यं ते श्येनः पदाभरत्तिरो रजांस्यस्पृतम् । पिबेदस्य त्वमीशिषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ te śyenaḥ padābharattiro rajāṃsyaspṛtam | pibedasya tvamīśiṣe ||

translations.english: Whatever Soma the hawk bore for you with its feet, having won it, till then inviolate, from the (guardiansof the) upper worlds, drink it-- you are the sovereign.

mantras.sanskrit: देवानामिदवो महत्तदा वृणीमहे वयम् । वृष्णामस्मभ्यमूतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: devānāmidavo mahattadā vṛṇīmahe vayam | vṛṣṇāmasmabhyamūtaye ||

translations.english: We solicit that might protection of the desire-raining deities in our own behalf, for our own help.

mantras.sanskrit: ते नः सन्तु युजः सदा वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । वृधासश्च प्रचेतसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te naḥ santu yujaḥ sadā varuṇo mitro aryamā | vṛdhāsaśca pracetasaḥ ||

translations.english: May those (deities) Varuṇa, Mitra and Aryaman, be ever our allies and supremeley wise helpers.

mantras.sanskrit: अति नो विष्पिता पुरु नौभिरपो न पर्षथ । यूयमृतस्य रथ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ati no viṣpitā puru naubhirapo na parṣatha | yūyamṛtasya rathyaḥ ||

translations.english: Charioteers of the sacrifice, do you conduct us through the many wide- spread (forces of our enemies)as in ships across the waters.

mantras.sanskrit: वामं नो अस्त्वर्यमन्वामं वरुण शंस्यम् । वामं ह्यावृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāmaṃ no astvaryamanvāmaṃ varuṇa śaṃsyam | vāmaṃ hyāvṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: Be wealth ours, Aryaman-- wealth worthy to be praised, Varuṇa; it is wealth which we ask.

mantras.sanskrit: वामस्य हि प्रचेतस ईशानाशो रिशादसः । नेमादित्या अघस्य यत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāmasya hi pracetasa īśānāśo riśādasaḥ | nemādityā aghasya yat ||

translations.english: Mighty in wisdom, repellers of enemies, you are the lords of wealth; be not mine the wealth, Ādityas,which belongs to sin.

mantras.sanskrit: वयमिद्वः सुदानवः क्षियन्तो यान्तो अध्वन्ना । देवा वृधाय हूमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayamidvaḥ sudānavaḥ kṣiyanto yānto adhvannā | devā vṛdhāya hūmahe ||

translations.english: Bounteous deities, whether we dwell at home or go abroad on the road, we invoke you only to benourished by our oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: अधि न इन्द्रैषां विष्णो सजात्यानाम् । इता मरुतो अश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhi na indraiṣāṃ viṣṇo sajātyānām | itā maruto aśvinā ||

translations.english: Come to us, Indra, Viṣṇu, Maruts, and Ādityas, from the midst of these your brethren.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र भ्रातृत्वं सुदानवोऽध द्विता समान्या । मातुर्गर्भे भरामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra bhrātṛtvaṃ sudānavo'dha dvitā samānyā | māturgarbhe bharāmahe ||

translations.english: Bounteous (deities), we forthwith proclaim aloud that brotherhood of yours in mother's womb, (first) incommon union, then as born in diverse manner.

mantras.sanskrit: यूयं हि ष्ठा सुदानव इन्द्रज्येष्ठा अभिद्यवः । अधा चिद्व उत ब्रुवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yūyaṃ hi ṣṭhā sudānava indrajyeṣṭhā abhidyavaḥ | adhā cidva uta bruve ||

translations.english: Bounteous (deities) with Indra as your chief, be present here in your radiance; again and again I praiseyou.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रेष्ठं वो अतिथिं स्तुषे मित्रमिव प्रियम् । अग्निं रथं न वेद्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: preṣṭhaṃ vo atithiṃ stuṣe mitramiva priyam | agniṃ rathaṃ na vedyam ||

translations.english: I praise Agni your most beloved guest, dear as a friend, who brings wealth as a chariot.

mantras.sanskrit: कविमिव प्रचेतसं यं देवासो अध द्विता । नि मर्त्येष्वादधुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kavimiva pracetasaṃ yaṃ devāso adha dvitā | ni martyeṣvādadhuḥ ||

translations.english: Whom he gods have set like a wise seer in a two-fold function among mortals.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं यविष्ठ दाशुषो नॄँ: पाहि शृणुधी गिरः । रक्षा तोकमुत त्मना ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ yaviṣṭha dāśuṣo nṝ~: pāhi śṛṇudhī giraḥ | rakṣā tokamuta tmanā ||

translations.english: Ever-youthful (Agni), protect your offerers, hear our praises, and thyself guard our offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: कया ते अग्ने अङ्गिर ऊर्जो नपादुपस्तुतिम् । वराय देव मन्यवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: kayā te agne aṅgira ūrjo napādupastutim | varāya deva manyave ||

translations.english: Divine Agni Aṅgirasa, son of food, with what voice (shall I utter) my praise to you, most excellentscorner of enemies?

mantras.sanskrit: दाशेम कस्य मनसा यज्ञस्य सहसो यहो । कदु वोच इदं नमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dāśema kasya manasā yajñasya sahaso yaho | kadu voca idaṃ namaḥ ||

translations.english: Son of strength, what worshipper's (offerings) shall we present to you with devoted mind, and whenshall I utter to you this praise?

mantras.sanskrit: अधा त्वं हि नस्करो विश्वा अस्मभ्यं सुक्षितीः । वाजद्रविणसो गिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhā tvaṃ hi naskaro viśvā asmabhyaṃ sukṣitīḥ | vājadraviṇaso giraḥ ||

translations.english: Cause all our praises to bring to us excellent dwellings and abundance of wealth in food.

mantras.sanskrit: कस्य नूनं परीणसो धियो जिन्वसि दम्पते । गोषाता यस्य ते गिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kasya nūnaṃ parīṇaso dhiyo jinvasi dampate | goṣātā yasya te giraḥ ||

translations.english: Whose many offerings do you gladden, Agni, you who are the lord of the house, and whose praisesbring wealth of kine?

mantras.sanskrit: तं मर्जयन्त सुक्रतुं पुरोयावानमाजिषु । स्वेषु क्षयेषु वाजिनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ marjayanta sukratuṃ puroyāvānamājiṣu | sveṣu kṣayeṣu vājinam ||

translations.english: They keep him bright in their houses, (Agni) famed for glorious deeds, the mighty one who pressesforward in battles.

mantras.sanskrit: क्षेति क्षेमेभिः साधुभिर्नकिर्यं घ्नन्ति हन्ति यः । अग्ने सुवीर एधते ॥
mantras.transliteration: kṣeti kṣemebhiḥ sādhubhirnakiryaṃ ghnanti hanti yaḥ | agne suvīra edhate ||

translations.english: He who dwells at home with all-efficient protections, whom none can harm, but who himself harms (hisenemies)-- he, Agni, (your worshipper), waxes strong with heroic offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: आ मे हवं नासत्याश्विना गच्छतं युवम् । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā me havaṃ nāsatyāśvinā gacchataṃ yuvam | madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||

translations.english: Nāsatyās, Aśvins, come you to my invocation that you may drink the exhilarating Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: इमं मे स्तोममश्विनेमं मे शृणुतं हवम् । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: imaṃ me stomamaśvinemaṃ me śṛṇutaṃ havam | madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||

translations.english: Aśvins, hear this my hymn, this my invocation that you may drink the exhilarating Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं वां कृष्णो अश्विना हवते वाजिनीवसू । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ vāṃ kṛṣṇo aśvinā havate vājinīvasū | madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||

translations.english: Kṛṣṇa invokes you, Aśvins rich in sacrifices, that you may drink the exhilarating Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: शृणुतं जरितुर्हवं कृष्णस्य स्तुवतो नरा । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: śṛṇutaṃ jariturhavaṃ kṛṣṇasya stuvato narā | madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||

translations.english: Leaders (of all), hear the invocation of Kṛṣṇa, the hymner, who praises you-- that you may drink theexhilarating Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: छर्दिर्यन्तमदाभ्यं विप्राय स्तुवते नरा । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: chardiryantamadābhyaṃ viprāya stuvate narā | madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||

translations.english: Leaders, give to the sage who praises you an unassailable dwelling that you may drink the exhilaratingSoma.

mantras.sanskrit: गच्छतं दाशुषो गृहमित्था स्तुवतो अश्विना । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: gacchataṃ dāśuṣo gṛhamitthā stuvato aśvinā | madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||

translations.english: Aśvins, come to the house of the offerer who thus praises you, that you may drink the exhilaratingSoma.

mantras.sanskrit: युञ्जाथां रासभं रथे वीड्वङ्गे वृषण्वसू । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuñjāthāṃ rāsabhaṃ rathe vīḍvaṅge vṛṣaṇvasū | madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||

translations.english: You who possess showering wealth, yoke the ass to your firmly built chariot, that you may drink theexhilarating Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिवन्धुरेण त्रिवृता रथेना यातमश्विना । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: trivandhureṇa trivṛtā rathenā yātamaśvinā | madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||

translations.english: Aśvins, come here with your three-seated triangular car, that you may drink the exhilarating Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: नू मे गिरो नासत्याश्विना प्रावतं युवम् । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū me giro nāsatyāśvinā prāvataṃ yuvam | madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||

translations.english: Nāsatyās, Aśvins, hasten quickly to my praises, that you may drink the exhilarating Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: उभा हि दस्रा भिषजा मयोभुवोभा दक्षस्य वचसो बभूवथुः । ता वां विश्वको हवते तनूकृथे मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ubhā hi dasrā bhiṣajā mayobhuvobhā dakṣasya vacaso babhūvathuḥ | tā vāṃ viśvako havate tanūkṛthe mā no vi yauṣṭaṃ sakhyā mumocatam ||

translations.english: Dasras, physicians, sources of happiness, you both were (the objects) of Dakṣa's praise; Viśvaka nowinvokes you for the sake of his son; sever not our friendships, but fling loose (your reins and gallop here).

mantras.sanskrit: कथा नूनं वां विमना उप स्तवद्युवं धियं ददथुर्वस्यैष्टये । ता वां विश्वको हवते तनूकृथे मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kathā nūnaṃ vāṃ vimanā upa stavadyuvaṃ dhiyaṃ dadathurvasyaiṣṭaye | tā vāṃ viśvako havate tanūkṛthe mā no vi yauṣṭaṃ sakhyā mumocatam ||

translations.english: How Vimanas once praised you, and you gave him understanding for the attainment of excellent wealth!Viśvaka now invokes you for the sake of his son; sever not our friendships, but fling loose (your reins and gallophere).

mantras.sanskrit: युवं हि ष्मा पुरुभुजेममेधतुं विष्णाप्वे ददथुर्वस्यैष्टये । ता वां विश्वको हवते तनूकृथे मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ hi ṣmā purubhujemamedhatuṃ viṣṇāpve dadathurvasyaiṣṭaye | tā vāṃ viśvako havate tanūkṛthe mā no vi yauṣṭaṃ sakhyā mumocatam ||

translations.english: Gladdeners of many, you have given to Viśṇāpu this prosperity for the attainment of excellent wealth!Viśvaka now invokes you for the sake of his son; sever not our friendships, but fling loose (your reins and gallophere).

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्यं वीरं धनसामृजीषिणं दूरे चित्सन्तमवसे हवामहे । यस्य स्वादिष्ठा सुमतिः पितुर्यथा मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tyaṃ vīraṃ dhanasāmṛjīṣiṇaṃ dūre citsantamavase havāmahe | yasya svādiṣṭhā sumatiḥ pituryathā mā no vi yauṣṭaṃ sakhyā mumocatam ||

translations.english: We summon that hero to our protection, (the enjoyer) of wealth, the possessor of the Soma, who nowdwells afar off and whose hymn is most plural asing (to the gods) like his father's, sever not our friendships, but flingloose (your reins and gallop here).

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतेन देवः सविता शमायत ऋतस्य शृङ्गमुर्विया वि पप्रथे । ऋतं सासाह महि चित्पृतन्यतो मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtena devaḥ savitā śamāyata ṛtasya śṛṅgamurviyā vi paprathe | ṛtaṃ sāsāha mahi citpṛtanyato mā no vi yauṣṭaṃ sakhyā mumocatam ||

translations.english: The sun-god by truth extinguishes his beams (in the evening); he spreads abroad (in the morning) thehorn of truth; truth verily overcomes the might of the eager assailant; therefore sever not our friendships, but flingloose (your reins and gallop here).

mantras.sanskrit: द्युम्नी वां स्तोमो अश्विना क्रिविर्न सेक आ गतम् । मध्वः सुतस्य स दिवि प्रियो नरा पातं गौराविवेरिणे ॥
mantras.transliteration: dyumnī vāṃ stomo aśvinā krivirna seka ā gatam | madhvaḥ sutasya sa divi priyo narā pātaṃ gaurāviveriṇe ||

translations.english: Aśvins, your praise is filled with plural nty as a well (with water) in time of rain; hasten here; it is especiallydear to the Soma when it is effused in the brilliant (offering); drink, leaders (of rites), as two Gauras (drink), at apool.

mantras.sanskrit: पिबतं घर्मं मधुमन्तमश्विना बर्हिः सीदतं नरा । ता मन्दसाना मनुषो दुरोण आ नि पातं वेदसा वयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pibataṃ gharmaṃ madhumantamaśvinā barhiḥ sīdataṃ narā | tā mandasānā manuṣo duroṇa ā ni pātaṃ vedasā vayaḥ ||

translations.english: Drink, Aśvins, the exhilarating (Soma) as it drops (into the vessels)- - seat yourselves, leaders, on thesacrificial grass; rejoicing in the house of the worshipper, drink the sacred Soma with the oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वां विश्वाभिरूतिभिः प्रियमेधा अहूषत । ता वर्तिर्यातमुप वृक्तबर्हिषो जुष्टं यज्ञं दिविष्टिषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāṃ viśvābhirūtibhiḥ priyamedhā ahūṣata | tā vartiryātamupa vṛktabarhiṣo juṣṭaṃ yajñaṃ diviṣṭiṣu ||

translations.english: The worshippers have invoked you with all protections; come in the early mornings to the dwelling ofhim who has clipped the sacred grass, to the offering loved (by all the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: पिबतं सोमं मधुमन्तमश्विना बर्हिः सीदतं सुमत् । ता वावृधाना उप सुष्टुतिं दिवो गन्तं गौराविवेरिणम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pibataṃ somaṃ madhumantamaśvinā barhiḥ sīdataṃ sumat | tā vāvṛdhānā upa suṣṭutiṃ divo gantaṃ gaurāviveriṇam ||

translations.english: Aśvins, drink the exhilarating Soma, sit down in your radiance on the sacrificial grass; waxing strong(through the libation), come from heaven to our praises as two Gadras to a pool.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नूनं यातमश्विनाश्वेभिः प्रुषितप्सुभिः । दस्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी शुभस्पती पातं सोममृतावृधा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā nūnaṃ yātamaśvināśvebhiḥ pruṣitapsubhiḥ | dasrā hiraṇyavartanī śubhaspatī pātaṃ somamṛtāvṛdhā ||

translations.english: Come, Aśvins, with your glossy steeds, Dasras, riding in golden chariots, lords of good fortune,upholders of truth, drink the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: वयं हि वां हवामहे विपन्यवो विप्रासो वाजसातये । ता वल्गू दस्रा पुरुदंससा धियाश्विना श्रुष्ट्या गतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayaṃ hi vāṃ havāmahe vipanyavo viprāso vājasātaye | tā valgū dasrā purudaṃsasā dhiyāśvinā śruṣṭyā gatam ||

translations.english: We, your wise praisers, invoke you to the enjoyment of the sacrificial viands; come quickly, Dasras, atthe sound of our praise, Aśvins, graceful in your movements, abounding in mighty deeds.

mantras.sanskrit: तं वो दस्ममृतीषहं वसोर्मन्दानमन्धसः । अभि वत्सं न स्वसरेषु धेनव इन्द्रं गीर्भिर्नवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ vo dasmamṛtīṣahaṃ vasormandānamandhasaḥ | abhi vatsaṃ na svasareṣu dhenava indraṃ gīrbhirnavāmahe ||

translations.english: We offer praise with our hymns, as cows (low) to their calf in the stalls, to that handsome Indra of yours,(O priests), the overcomer of enemies, who rejoices in the excellent Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: द्युक्षं सुदानुं तविषीभिरावृतं गिरिं न पुरुभोजसम् । क्षुमन्तं वाजं शतिनं सहस्रिणं मक्षू गोमन्तमीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: dyukṣaṃ sudānuṃ taviṣībhirāvṛtaṃ giriṃ na purubhojasam | kṣumantaṃ vājaṃ śatinaṃ sahasriṇaṃ makṣū gomantamīmahe ||

translations.english: We solicit the radiant bounteous (Indra), surrounded by powers as a mountain (by clouds), thesupporter of many-- (we solicit him) speedily for renowned food, rich in cattle, and multiplied a hundred and athousand-fold.

mantras.sanskrit: न त्वा बृहन्तो अद्रयो वरन्त इन्द्र वीळवः । यद्दित्ससि स्तुवते मावते वसु नकिष्टदा मिनाति ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: na tvā bṛhanto adrayo varanta indra vīḷavaḥ | yadditsasi stuvate māvate vasu nakiṣṭadā mināti te ||

translations.english: The vast firm mountains cannot stop you, Indra, whatever wealth you would give to a worshipper suchas I none can hinder you therein.

mantras.sanskrit: योद्धासि क्रत्वा शवसोत दंसना विश्वा जाताभि मज्मना । आ त्वायमर्क ऊतये ववर्तति यं गोतमा अजीजनन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yoddhāsi kratvā śavasota daṃsanā viśvā jātābhi majmanā | ā tvāyamarka ūtaye vavartati yaṃ gotamā ajījanan ||

translations.english: By your exploits and might you are a warrior you overpower all beings by your deeds and prowess, thishymn which the Gotamas have made, causes you to turn here for their protection.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र हि रिरिक्ष ओजसा दिवो अन्तेभ्यस्परि । न त्वा विव्याच रज इन्द्र पार्थिवमनु स्वधां ववक्षिथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra hi ririkṣa ojasā divo antebhyaspari | na tvā vivyāca raja indra pārthivamanu svadhāṃ vavakṣitha ||

translations.english: Indra, by your might you extend beyond the limits of heaven, the region of the earth cannot contain you;design to bring us food.

mantras.sanskrit: नकिः परिष्टिर्मघवन्मघस्य ते यद्दाशुषे दशस्यसि । अस्माकं बोध्युचथस्य चोदिता मंहिष्ठो वाजसातये ॥
mantras.transliteration: nakiḥ pariṣṭirmaghavanmaghasya te yaddāśuṣe daśasyasi | asmākaṃ bodhyucathasya coditā maṃhiṣṭho vājasātaye ||

translations.english: None can hinder your bounty, Maghavan, when you give wealth to your votary, most liberal sender (ofwealth), listen to our praise for the attainment of food.

mantras.sanskrit: बृहदिन्द्राय गायत मरुतो वृत्रहन्तमम् । येन ज्योतिरजनयन्नृतावृधो देवं देवाय जागृवि ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhadindrāya gāyata maruto vṛtrahantamam | yena jyotirajanayannṛtāvṛdho devaṃ devāya jāgṛvi ||

translations.english: Priests sing to Indra the most sin-destroying Bṛhat-sāman, by which the upholders of truth producedthe divine all-waking luminary for the god.

mantras.sanskrit: अपाधमदभिशस्तीरशस्तिहाथेन्द्रो द्युम्न्याभवत् । देवास्त इन्द्र सख्याय येमिरे बृहद्भानो मरुद्गण ॥
mantras.transliteration: apādhamadabhiśastīraśastihāthendro dyumnyābhavat | devāsta indra sakhyāya yemire bṛhadbhāno marudgaṇa ||

translations.english: Indra, the destroyer of those who offer not praise, has driven away the malevolent and has becomeglorious; I indra of mighty splendour, lord of the troops of Maruts, the gods press you for your friendship.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र व इन्द्राय बृहते मरुतो ब्रह्मार्चत । वृत्रं हनति वृत्रहा शतक्रतुर्वज्रेण शतपर्वणा ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra va indrāya bṛhate maruto brahmārcata | vṛtraṃ hanati vṛtrahā śatakraturvajreṇa śataparvaṇā ||

translations.english: Priests, utter forth the hymn to your great Indra; let Śatakratu, the slayer of Vṛtra, smite Vṛtra with hishundred-edged thunderbolt.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि प्र भर धृषता धृषन्मनः श्रवश्चित्ते असद्बृहत् । अर्षन्त्वापो जवसा वि मातरो हनो वृत्रं जया स्वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi pra bhara dhṛṣatā dhṛṣanmanaḥ śravaścitte asadbṛhat | arṣantvāpo javasā vi mātaro hano vṛtraṃ jayā svaḥ ||

translations.english: Daring-souled (Indra), there is abundance of food with you-- boldly bring it to us; let our mothers (thewaters) impetuously spread over the earth; smite Vṛtra, and conquer all.

mantras.sanskrit: यज्जायथा अपूर्व्य मघवन्वृत्रहत्याय । तत्पृथिवीमप्रथयस्तदस्तभ्ना उत द्याम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajjāyathā apūrvya maghavanvṛtrahatyāya | tatpṛthivīmaprathayastadastabhnā uta dyām ||

translations.english: Maghavan, who had none before you, when you were born for the slaying of Vṛtra, then you did spreadabroad the earth, then you did prop up the heavens.

mantras.sanskrit: तत्ते यज्ञो अजायत तदर्क उत हस्कृतिः । तद्विश्वमभिभूरसि यज्जातं यच्च जन्त्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tatte yajño ajāyata tadarka uta haskṛtiḥ | tadviśvamabhibhūrasi yajjātaṃ yacca jantvam ||

translations.english: Then was the sacrifice produced for you, then too the joyous hymn; then did you surpass all, whateverhas been or will be born.

mantras.sanskrit: आमासु पक्वमैरय आ सूर्यं रोहयो दिवि । घर्मं न सामन्तपता सुवृक्तिभिर्जुष्टं गिर्वणसे बृहत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: āmāsu pakvamairaya ā sūryaṃ rohayo divi | gharmaṃ na sāmantapatā suvṛktibhirjuṣṭaṃ girvaṇase bṛhat ||

translations.english: In the immature (cows) you produced the mature (milk), you caused the sun to arise in heaven,(priests), excite (Indra) with your praises as men heat the gharma with sāman hymns. (sing) the acceptableBṛhat sāman to him who is to be honoure dby song.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो विश्वासु हव्य इन्द्रः समत्सु भूषतु । उप ब्रह्माणि सवनानि वृत्रहा परमज्या ऋचीषमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no viśvāsu havya indraḥ samatsu bhūṣatu | upa brahmāṇi savanāni vṛtrahā paramajyā ṛcīṣamaḥ ||

translations.english: May Indra, who is to be invoked in all battles regard our hykns and our libationsl he the slayer of Vṛtra,who crushes the mightiest (foes), who is worthy of his praise.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं दाता प्रथमो राधसामस्यसि सत्य ईशानकृत् । तुविद्युम्नस्य युज्या वृणीमहे पुत्रस्य शवसो महः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ dātā prathamo rādhasāmasyasi satya īśānakṛt | tuvidyumnasya yujyā vṛṇīmahe putrasya śavaso mahaḥ ||

translations.english: You are the chief giver of wealth, you are truthful and make your worshippers rulers; we solicit(blessings) worthy of you, lord of vast riches, mighty son of strength.

mantras.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा त इन्द्र गिर्वणः क्रियन्ते अनतिद्भुता । इमा जुषस्व हर्यश्व योजनेन्द्र या ते अमन्महि ॥
mantras.transliteration: brahmā ta indra girvaṇaḥ kriyante anatidbhutā | imā juṣasva haryaśva yojanendra yā te amanmahi ||

translations.english: Indra, who are the object of hymns, unexaggerated praises are offered by us; lord of bay steeds, acceptthese fitting hymns, which we have meditated for you.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं हि सत्यो मघवन्ननानतो वृत्रा भूरि न्यृञ्जसे । स त्वं शविष्ठ वज्रहस्त दाशुषेऽर्वाञ्चं रयिमा कृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ hi satyo maghavannanānato vṛtrā bhūri nyṛñjase | sa tvaṃ śaviṣṭha vajrahasta dāśuṣe'rvāñcaṃ rayimā kṛdhi ||

translations.english: You are truthful, Maghavan, unhumbled yourself, you humble many enemies; most mighty thunderer,cause wealth to meet your worshipper.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमिन्द्र यशा अस्यृजीषी शवसस्पते । त्वं वृत्राणि हंस्यप्रतीन्येक इदनुत्ता चर्षणीधृता ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamindra yaśā asyṛjīṣī śavasaspate | tvaṃ vṛtrāṇi haṃsyapratīnyeka idanuttā carṣaṇīdhṛtā ||

translations.english: You, Indra, lord of strength, are the glorious possessor of the offered Soma, alone with (yourthunderbolt), that protector of men, you smite the enemies that none else could oppose or drive away.

mantras.sanskrit: तमु त्वा नूनमसुर प्रचेतसं राधो भागमिवेमहे । महीव कृत्तिः शरणा त इन्द्र प्र ते सुम्ना नो अश्नवन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamu tvā nūnamasura pracetasaṃ rādho bhāgamivemahe | mahīva kṛttiḥ śaraṇā ta indra pra te sumnā no aśnavan ||

translations.english: Living one, who possess supreme knowledge, we verily ask you for wealth as though it were aninheritance your abode (in heaven), Indra, is vast like your glory; may your blessings fill us.

mantras.sanskrit: कन्या वारवायती सोममपि स्रुताविदत् । अस्तं भरन्त्यब्रवीदिन्द्राय सुनवै त्वा शक्राय सुनवै त्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: kanyā vāravāyatī somamapi srutāvidat | astaṃ bharantyabravīdindrāya sunavai tvā śakrāya sunavai tvā ||

translations.english: A young woman going to the water found Soma in the path; as she carried it home she said, I will pressyou for Indra, I will you for Śakra.

mantras.sanskrit: असौ य एषि वीरको गृहंगृहं विचाकशद् । इमं जम्भसुतं पिब धानावन्तं करम्भिणमपूपवन्तमुक्थिनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asau ya eṣi vīrako gṛhaṃgṛhaṃ vicākaśad | imaṃ jambhasutaṃ piba dhānāvantaṃ karambhiṇamapūpavantamukthinam ||

translations.english: You who go from house to house a hero bright in your splendour, drink this Soma pressed by my teethtogether with fried grains of barley, the karambha, cakes and hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: आ चन त्वा चिकित्सामोऽधि चन त्वा नेमसि । शनैरिव शनकैरिवेन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā cana tvā cikitsāmo'dhi cana tvā nemasi | śanairiva śanakairivendrāyendo pari srava ||

translations.english: We wish to know you, but here we know you not, O Soma, flow forth for Indra first slowly, then quickly.

mantras.sanskrit: कुविच्छकत्कुवित्करत्कुविन्नो वस्यसस्करत् । कुवित्पतिद्विषो यतीरिन्द्रेण संगमामहै ॥
mantras.transliteration: kuvicchakatkuvitkaratkuvinno vasyasaskarat | kuvitpatidviṣo yatīrindreṇa saṃgamāmahai ||

translations.english: May (Indra) repeatedly make us powerful, may he do abundantly for us, may he repeatedly make usvery rich; often hated by our husband and forced to leave hi, may we be united to Indra.]

mantras.sanskrit: इमानि त्रीणि विष्टपा तानीन्द्र वि रोहय । शिरस्ततस्योर्वरामादिदं म उपोदरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: imāni trīṇi viṣṭapā tānīndra vi rohaya | śirastatasyorvarāmādidaṃ ma upodare ||

translations.english: These hree plural ces-- do you cause them all to grow-- my father's (bald) head, his (barren) field, and mybody.

mantras.sanskrit: असौ च या न उर्वरादिमां तन्वं मम । अथो ततस्य यच्छिरः सर्वा ता रोमशा कृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: asau ca yā na urvarādimāṃ tanvaṃ mama | atho tatasya yacchiraḥ sarvā tā romaśā kṛdhi ||

translations.english: This field which is our (father's), and this my body and he head of my father-- do you make all thesebear a crop.

mantras.sanskrit: खे रथस्य खेऽनसः खे युगस्य शतक्रतो । अपालामिन्द्र त्रिष्पूत्व्यकृणोः सूर्यत्वचम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: khe rathasya khe'nasaḥ khe yugasya śatakrato | apālāmindra triṣpūtvyakṛṇoḥ sūryatvacam ||

translations.english: Thice, Śatakratu, did you purify Apālā, in the hole of the chariot, in the hole of the cart, and in thehole of the yoke, and you did make here with a skin splendent like the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: पान्तमा वो अन्धस इन्द्रमभि प्र गायत । विश्वासाहं शतक्रतुं मंहिष्ठं चर्षणीनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pāntamā vo andhasa indramabhi pra gāyata | viśvāsāhaṃ śatakratuṃ maṃhiṣṭhaṃ carṣaṇīnām ||

translations.english: Sing priests, that Indra, who drinks your offered Soma-- the foe- subduing Śatakratu, most liberal ofmen.

mantras.sanskrit: पुरुहूतं पुरुष्टुतं गाथान्यं सनश्रुतम् । इन्द्र इति ब्रवीतन ॥
mantras.transliteration: puruhūtaṃ puruṣṭutaṃ gāthānyaṃ sanaśrutam | indra iti bravītana ||

translations.english: Proclaim that deity as Indra, who is invoked by many, who is praised by many, who is worthy of songsand renowned as eternal.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र इन्नो महानां दाता वाजानां नृतुः । महाँ अभिज्ञ्वा यमत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra inno mahānāṃ dātā vājānāṃ nṛtuḥ | mahā~ abhijñvā yamat ||

translations.english: May Indra who causes all to rejoice, be the giver of plural ntiful food to us; may be, the mighty, bring us(riches) up to our knees.

mantras.sanskrit: अपादु शिप्र्यन्धसः सुदक्षस्य प्रहोषिणः । इन्दोरिन्द्रो यवाशिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: apādu śipryandhasaḥ sudakṣasya prahoṣiṇaḥ | indorindro yavāśiraḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, the handsome-jawed, has drunk of th dropping Soma cooked with barley, (the offering) ofSudakṣa assiduous in sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: तम्वभि प्रार्चतेन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये । तदिद्ध्यस्य वर्धनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamvabhi prārcatendraṃ somasya pītaye | tadiddhyasya vardhanam ||

translations.english: Loudly praise that Indra that he may drink the Soma-- it is this which gives him strength.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य पीत्वा मदानां देवो देवस्यौजसा । विश्वाभि भुवना भुवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya pītvā madānāṃ devo devasyaujasā | viśvābhi bhuvanā bhuvat ||

translations.english: The god, having quaffed its exhilarations, by the strength of the divine (Soma) has conquered allworlds.

mantras.sanskrit: त्यमु वः सत्रासाहं विश्वासु गीर्ष्वायतम् । आ च्यावयस्यूतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: tyamu vaḥ satrāsāhaṃ viśvāsu gīrṣvāyatam | ā cyāvayasyūtaye ||

translations.english: Bring here for our protection Indra the conqueror of many, who pervades all your praises.

mantras.sanskrit: युध्मं सन्तमनर्वाणं सोमपामनपच्युतम् । नरमवार्यक्रतुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yudhmaṃ santamanarvāṇaṃ somapāmanapacyutam | naramavāryakratum ||

translations.english: The warrior, whom none oppose and none can harm, the quaffer of the Soma, the leader whose deedscannot be hindered.

mantras.sanskrit: शिक्षा ण इन्द्र राय आ पुरु विद्वाँ ऋचीषम । अवा नः पार्ये धने ॥
mantras.transliteration: śikṣā ṇa indra rāya ā puru vidvā~ ṛcīṣama | avā naḥ pārye dhane ||

translations.english: O you worthy of our praise, you who know all things, repeatedly give us riches, protect us by the wealthour enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: अतश्चिदिन्द्र ण उपा याहि शतवाजया । इषा सहस्रवाजया ॥
mantras.transliteration: ataścidindra ṇa upā yāhi śatavājayā | iṣā sahasravājayā ||

translations.english: Come to us, Indra, from there with food of a hundred-fold strength, of a thousand-fold strength.

mantras.sanskrit: अयाम धीवतो धियोऽर्वद्भिः शक्र गोदरे । जयेम पृत्सु वज्रिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayāma dhīvato dhiyo'rvadbhiḥ śakra godare | jayema pṛtsu vajrivaḥ ||

translations.english: Śakra, let us go, proved in deeds, to deeds; thunderer, cleaver of mountains, let us conquer in battlesby your steeds.

mantras.sanskrit: वयमु त्वा शतक्रतो गावो न यवसेष्वा । उक्थेषु रणयामसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayamu tvā śatakrato gāvo na yavaseṣvā | uktheṣu raṇayāmasi ||

translations.english: We refresh you, Śatakratu, with our praises, as (the herdsman) the cattle with (different kinds of)paasture.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वा हि मर्त्यत्वनानुकामा शतक्रतो । अगन्म वज्रिन्नाशसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvā hi martyatvanānukāmā śatakrato | aganma vajrinnāśasaḥ ||

translations.english: All mortal natures, Śatakratu, are moved by desire; we feel wishes, O thunderer.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वे सु पुत्र शवसोऽवृत्रन्कामकातयः । न त्वामिन्द्राति रिच्यते ॥
mantras.transliteration: tve su putra śavaso'vṛtrankāmakātayaḥ | na tvāmindrāti ricyate ||

translations.english: O son of strength, men, uttering their desires, abide happily in you, none, Indra, surpasses you.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो वृषन्त्सनिष्ठया सं घोरया द्रवित्न्वा । धियाविड्ढि पुरंध्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no vṛṣantsaniṣṭhayā saṃ ghorayā dravitnvā | dhiyāviḍḍhi puraṃdhyā ||

translations.english: Showerer (of blessings), protect us by your action, which is most bounteous yet awful, foe-terrifying yetmany-cherishing.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्ते नूनं शतक्रतविन्द्र द्युम्नितमो मदः । तेन नूनं मदे मदेः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaste nūnaṃ śatakratavindra dyumnitamo madaḥ | tena nūnaṃ made madeḥ ||

translations.english: Rejoice us, Indra, Śatakratu, as you rejoice in that most glorious exhilaration of the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्ते चित्रश्रवस्तमो य इन्द्र वृत्रहन्तमः । य ओजोदातमो मदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaste citraśravastamo ya indra vṛtrahantamaḥ | ya ojodātamo madaḥ ||

translations.english: The Soma of yours, Indra, which is most widely renowned, most destrucive of your enemies, and mostrenovating to your strength.

mantras.sanskrit: विद्मा हि यस्ते अद्रिवस्त्वादत्तः सत्य सोमपाः । विश्वासु दस्म कृष्टिषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: vidmā hi yaste adrivastvādattaḥ satya somapāḥ | viśvāsu dasma kṛṣṭiṣu ||

translations.english: Thunderer, smiter of enemies, truthful drinker of the Soma, we know (the wealth) which is given by youto all your votaries.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राय मद्वने सुतं परि ष्टोभन्तु नो गिरः । अर्कमर्चन्तु कारवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāya madvane sutaṃ pari ṣṭobhantu no giraḥ | arkamarcantu kāravaḥ ||

translations.english: Let our voices praise on every side the (Soma) effused to the exhilarated Indra; let the priests dohonour to the (Soma) honoured of all.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्मिन्विश्वा अधि श्रियो रणन्ति सप्त संसदः । इन्द्रं सुते हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasminviśvā adhi śriyo raṇanti sapta saṃsadaḥ | indraṃ sute havāmahe ||

translations.english: We invoke, now that the Soma is effused, that Indra in whom all graces are at their height, and in whomthe seven associated priests rejoice.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिकद्रुकेषु चेतनं देवासो यज्ञमत्नत । तमिद्वर्धन्तु नो गिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: trikadrukeṣu cetanaṃ devāso yajñamatnata | tamidvardhantu no giraḥ ||

translations.english: The gods extended the heaven-revealing sacrifice in the Trikadruka days-- may our praise prosper iṭ

mantras.sanskrit: आ त्वा विशन्त्विन्दवः समुद्रमिव सिन्धवः । न त्वामिन्द्राति रिच्यते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tvā viśantvindavaḥ samudramiva sindhavaḥ | na tvāmindrāti ricyate ||

translations.english: Let the Soma-drops enter you as the rivers the sea: none, Indra surpasses you.

mantras.sanskrit: विव्यक्थ महिना वृषन्भक्षं सोमस्य जागृवे । य इन्द्र जठरेषु ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: vivyaktha mahinā vṛṣanbhakṣaṃ somasya jāgṛve | ya indra jaṭhareṣu te ||

translations.english: Indra, showerer (of blessings), wakeful one, you have attained by your might the drinking of the Somawhich enters your belly.

mantras.sanskrit: अरं त इन्द्र कुक्षये सोमो भवतु वृत्रहन् । अरं धामभ्य इन्दवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: araṃ ta indra kukṣaye somo bhavatu vṛtrahan | araṃ dhāmabhya indavaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, slayer of Vṛtra,may the Soma be enough for your belly, may the drops be enough for your(various) bodies.

mantras.sanskrit: अरमश्वाय गायति श्रुतकक्षो अरं गवे । अरमिन्द्रस्य धाम्ने ॥
mantras.transliteration: aramaśvāya gāyati śrutakakṣo araṃ gave | aramindrasya dhāmne ||

translations.english: Ṣrutakakṣa sings enough for a horse, enough for a cow, enough for a house of Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: अरं हि ष्म सुतेषु णः सोमेष्विन्द्र भूषसि । अरं ते शक्र दावने ॥
mantras.transliteration: araṃ hi ṣma suteṣu ṇaḥ someṣvindra bhūṣasi | araṃ te śakra dāvane ||

translations.english: When our Soma-libations are effused, you are abundantly able (to drink them)-- may they be enough foryou, the bounteous.

mantras.sanskrit: पराकात्ताच्चिदद्रिवस्त्वां नक्षन्त नो गिरः । अरं गमाम ते वयम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: parākāttāccidadrivastvāṃ nakṣanta no giraḥ | araṃ gamāma te vayam ||

translations.english: May our praises reach you, thunderer, even from afar; may we obtain your (wealth) abundantly.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा ह्यसि वीरयुरेवा शूर उत स्थिरः । एवा ते राध्यं मनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā hyasi vīrayurevā śūra uta sthiraḥ | evā te rādhyaṃ manaḥ ||

translations.english: You verily love to smite the mighty, you are a hero and firm (in battle), yourmind is to be propitiated (bypraise).

mantras.sanskrit: एवा रातिस्तुवीमघ विश्वेभिर्धायि धातृभिः । अधा चिदिन्द्र मे सचा ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā rātistuvīmagha viśvebhirdhāyi dhātṛbhiḥ | adhā cidindra me sacā ||

translations.english: Lord of great wealth, your bounty is possessed by all your worshippers; therefore, Indra, be also myally.

mantras.sanskrit: मो षु ब्रह्मेव तन्द्रयुर्भुवो वाजानां पते । मत्स्वा सुतस्य गोमतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mo ṣu brahmeva tandrayurbhuvo vājānāṃ pate | matsvā sutasya gomataḥ ||

translations.english: Be not like a lazy brāhmaṇa, O lord of food; rejoice thyself by drinking the effused Soma mixed withmilk.

mantras.sanskrit: मा न इन्द्राभ्यादिशः सूरो अक्तुष्वा यमन् । त्वा युजा वनेम तत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā na indrābhyādiśaḥ sūro aktuṣvā yaman | tvā yujā vanema tat ||

translations.english: Indra,let not the threatening prowling (demons) obstruct us at night, let us smite them with you as ourhelper.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वयेदिन्द्र युजा वयं प्रति ब्रुवीमहि स्पृधः । त्वमस्माकं तव स्मसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvayedindra yujā vayaṃ prati bruvīmahi spṛdhaḥ | tvamasmākaṃ tava smasi ||

translations.english: With you, Indra, as our helper, let us answer our enemies; you are ours, we are yours.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामिद्धि त्वायवोऽनुनोनुवतश्चरान् । सखाय इन्द्र कारवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmiddhi tvāyavo'nunonuvataścarān | sakhāya indra kāravaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, may your friends, the chanters, worship you, devoted to your service and again and againreciting your praise.

mantras.sanskrit: उद्घेदभि श्रुतामघं वृषभं नर्यापसम् । अस्तारमेषि सूर्य ॥
