mantras.transliteration: udghedabhi śrutāmaghaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ naryāpasam | astārameṣi sūrya ||

translations.english: You rise, O sun, on (the sacrifice of Indra) the showerer (of blessings), the bountiful giver, famed for hiswealth, the benefactor of men.

mantras.sanskrit: नव यो नवतिं पुरो बिभेद बाह्वोजसा । अहिं च वृत्रहावधीत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nava yo navatiṃ puro bibheda bāhvojasā | ahiṃ ca vṛtrahāvadhīt ||

translations.english: Who cleft the ninety-nine cities by the strength of his arm, and, slayeer of Vṛtra, smote Ahi.

mantras.sanskrit: स न इन्द्रः शिवः सखाश्वावद्गोमद्यवमत् । उरुधारेव दोहते ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa na indraḥ śivaḥ sakhāśvāvadgomadyavamat | urudhāreva dohate ||

translations.english: May Indra, our auspicious friend, milk for us, like a richly-streaming (cow), wealth of horses, kine andbarley.

mantras.sanskrit: यदद्य कच्च वृत्रहन्नुदगा अभि सूर्य । सर्वं तदिन्द्र ते वशे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadadya kacca vṛtrahannudagā abhi sūrya | sarvaṃ tadindra te vaśe ||

translations.english: Whatsoever, O Sun, slayr of Vṛtra, you have risen upon today-- it is all, Indra, under your power.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्वा प्रवृद्ध सत्पते न मरा इति मन्यसे । उतो तत्सत्यमित्तव ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadvā pravṛddha satpate na marā iti manyase | uto tatsatyamittava ||

translations.english: When, swelling in your might, lord of the good, you think, 'I shall not die', that thought of yours is indeedtrue.

mantras.sanskrit: ये सोमासः परावति ये अर्वावति सुन्विरे । सर्वाँस्ताँ इन्द्र गच्छसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye somāsaḥ parāvati ye arvāvati sunvire | sarvā~stā~ indra gacchasi ||

translations.english: You go at once, Indra, to all those Soma-libations which are effused afar or effused near.

mantras.sanskrit: तमिन्द्रं वाजयामसि महे वृत्राय हन्तवे । स वृषा वृषभो भुवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamindraṃ vājayāmasi mahe vṛtrāya hantave | sa vṛṣā vṛṣabho bhuvat ||

translations.english: We invigorate that (great) Indra for the slaying of mighty Vṛtra, may he be a bounteous showerer (ofwealth).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रः स दामने कृत ओजिष्ठः स मदे हितः । द्युम्नी श्लोकी स सोम्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraḥ sa dāmane kṛta ojiṣṭhaḥ sa made hitaḥ | dyumnī ślokī sa somyaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra was created for giving; he, the most mighty was set over the exhilarating Soma; he, the gloriousone the lord of praise, is worthy of the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: गिरा वज्रो न सम्भृतः सबलो अनपच्युतः । ववक्ष ऋष्वो अस्तृतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: girā vajro na sambhṛtaḥ sabalo anapacyutaḥ | vavakṣa ṛṣvo astṛtaḥ ||

translations.english: The mighty (Indra), unassailed by his foes, hastens to confer wealth on his worshippers-- renderedkeen by their praises as a weapon, full of strength and invincible.

mantras.sanskrit: दुर्गे चिन्नः सुगं कृधि गृणान इन्द्र गिर्वणः । त्वं च मघवन्वशः ॥
mantras.transliteration: durge cinnaḥ sugaṃ kṛdhi gṛṇāna indra girvaṇaḥ | tvaṃ ca maghavanvaśaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, worthy of our praise, do you, hymned by us, make our path plural in even in the midst of difficulties,(hear us), Maghavan, if you love us.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य ते नू चिदादिशं न मिनन्ति स्वराज्यम् । न देवो नाध्रिगुर्जनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya te nū cidādiśaṃ na minanti svarājyam | na devo nādhrigurjanaḥ ||

translations.english: You whose command and rightful empire neither god nor irresistible hero can harm.

mantras.sanskrit: अधा ते अप्रतिष्कुतं देवी शुष्मं सपर्यतः । उभे सुशिप्र रोदसी ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhā te apratiṣkutaṃ devī śuṣmaṃ saparyataḥ | ubhe suśipra rodasī ||

translations.english: Yes, deity of the handsome jaw, the two goddesses, heaven and earth, both worship your resistlessconsuming might.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमेतदधारयः कृष्णासु रोहिणीषु च । परुष्णीषु रुशत्पयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvametadadhārayaḥ kṛṣṇāsu rohiṇīṣu ca | paruṣṇīṣu ruśatpayaḥ ||

translations.english: It is you that keep this bright milk in the black, red, and spotted cows.

mantras.sanskrit: वि यदहेरध त्विषो विश्वे देवासो अक्रमुः । विदन्मृगस्य ताँ अमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi yadaheradha tviṣo viśve devāso akramuḥ | vidanmṛgasya tā~ amaḥ ||

translations.english: When all the gods fled in various directions from the splendour of the demon Ahi, and when fear of thedeer seized them.

mantras.sanskrit: आदु मे निवरो भुवद्वृत्रहादिष्ट पौंस्यम् । अजातशत्रुरस्तृतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ādu me nivaro bhuvadvṛtrahādiṣṭa pauṃsyam | ajātaśatrurastṛtaḥ ||

translations.english: Then was my Indra the repeller; then did the smiter of Vṛtra put forth his might, he who has no existentenemies, the invincible.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रुतं वो वृत्रहन्तमं प्र शर्धं चर्षणीनाम् । आ शुषे राधसे महे ॥
mantras.transliteration: śrutaṃ vo vṛtrahantamaṃ pra śardhaṃ carṣaṇīnām | ā śuṣe rādhase mahe ||

translations.english: (Priests), I bring to you men, for great wealth, that renowned and mighty one who utterly destroyedVṛtra.

mantras.sanskrit: अया धिया च गव्यया पुरुणामन्पुरुष्टुत । यत्सोमेसोम आभवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayā dhiyā ca gavyayā puruṇāmanpuruṣṭuta | yatsomesoma ābhavaḥ ||

translations.english: O you bearing many names and praised by many, when you are present at our various Soma-libations,may we be endowed with a kine-desiring mind.

mantras.sanskrit: बोधिन्मना इदस्तु नो वृत्रहा भूर्यासुतिः । शृणोतु शक्र आशिषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: bodhinmanā idastu no vṛtrahā bhūryāsutiḥ | śṛṇotu śakra āśiṣam ||

translations.english: May the slayer of Vṛtra, to whom many libations are offered, know our desires-- may Śakra hear ourpraises.

mantras.sanskrit: कया त्वं न ऊत्याभि प्र मन्दसे वृषन् । कया स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: kayā tvaṃ na ūtyābhi pra mandase vṛṣan | kayā stotṛbhya ā bhara ||

translations.english: Showerer (of blessings), with what coming of yours do you gladden us, with what coming bring you(wealth) to your worshippers?

mantras.sanskrit: कस्य वृषा सुते सचा नियुत्वान्वृषभो रणत् । वृत्रहा सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: kasya vṛṣā sute sacā niyutvānvṛṣabho raṇat | vṛtrahā somapītaye ||

translations.english: At whose hymn-accompanied libations does the showerer, the lord of the Niyuts, the slayer of Vṛtra,rejoice to drink the Soma?

mantras.sanskrit: अभी षु णस्त्वं रयिं मन्दसानः सहस्रिणम् । प्रयन्ता बोधि दाशुषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhī ṣu ṇastvaṃ rayiṃ mandasānaḥ sahasriṇam | prayantā bodhi dāśuṣe ||

translations.english: Rejoicing (in our oblations), bring us wealth a thousandfold; remember that you are the giver to yourvotary.

mantras.sanskrit: पत्नीवन्तः सुता इम उशन्तो यन्ति वीतये । अपां जग्मिर्निचुम्पुणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: patnīvantaḥ sutā ima uśanto yanti vītaye | apāṃ jagmirnicumpuṇaḥ ||

translations.english: These Soma-libations with their wives proceed (to Indra) longing to be drunk; the stale Soma, plural asingto the taste, goes to the waters.

mantras.sanskrit: इष्टा होत्रा असृक्षतेन्द्रं वृधासो अध्वरे । अच्छावभृथमोजसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: iṣṭā hotrā asṛkṣatendraṃ vṛdhāso adhvare | acchāvabhṛthamojasā ||

translations.english: The sacrificing priests, invigorating (Indra) by their offerings at the sacrifice, have by their mightdismissed him to the avabhṛtha.

mantras.sanskrit: इह त्या सधमाद्या हरी हिरण्यकेश्या । वोळ्हामभि प्रयो हितम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: iha tyā sadhamādyā harī hiraṇyakeśyā | voḷhāmabhi prayo hitam ||

translations.english: May those two golden-maned steeds together exulting bring him to our wholesome offering.

mantras.sanskrit: तुभ्यं सोमाः सुता इमे स्तीर्णं बर्हिर्विभावसो । स्तोतृभ्य इन्द्रमा वह ॥
mantras.transliteration: tubhyaṃ somāḥ sutā ime stīrṇaṃ barhirvibhāvaso | stotṛbhya indramā vaha ||

translations.english: Resplendent (Agni), these Soma-libations are effused for you, the clipped grass is spread; bring Indrahere for his worshippers.

mantras.sanskrit: आ ते दक्षं वि रोचना दधद्रत्ना वि दाशुषे । स्तोतृभ्य इन्द्रमर्चत ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā te dakṣaṃ vi rocanā dadhadratnā vi dāśuṣe | stotṛbhya indramarcata ||

translations.english: May he give strength and his brilliant heaven and precious things to you his worshipper, and to hispraising priests; worship Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: आ ते दधामीन्द्रियमुक्था विश्वा शतक्रतो । स्तोतृभ्य इन्द्र मृळय ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā te dadhāmīndriyamukthā viśvā śatakrato | stotṛbhya indra mṛḷaya ||

translations.english: I prepare, Śatakratu, your strong (Soma) and all your praises; be gracious, Indra, to your hymners.

mantras.sanskrit: भद्रम्भद्रं न आ भरेषमूर्जं शतक्रतो । यदिन्द्र मृळयासि नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhadrambhadraṃ na ā bhareṣamūrjaṃ śatakrato | yadindra mṛḷayāsi naḥ ||

translations.english: Bring us what is most auspicious, Śatakratu, (bring us) food and strength, if you have favour to us,Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो विश्वान्या भर सुवितानि शतक्रतो । यदिन्द्र मृळयासि नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no viśvānyā bhara suvitāni śatakrato | yadindra mṛḷayāsi naḥ ||

translations.english: Bring us all blessings, Śatakratu, if you have favour to us, Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामिद्वृत्रहन्तम सुतावन्तो हवामहे । यदिन्द्र मृळयासि नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmidvṛtrahantama sutāvanto havāmahe | yadindra mṛḷayāsi naḥ ||

translations.english: Bearing the effused libation, we invoke you, mightiest slayer of Vṛtra, if you have favour to us, Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: उप नो हरिभिः सुतं याहि मदानां पते । उप नो हरिभिः सुतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa no haribhiḥ sutaṃ yāhi madānāṃ pate | upa no haribhiḥ sutam ||

translations.english: Come with your steeds to our effused libation, lord of the Soma-- come with your steds to our effusedlibation.

mantras.sanskrit: द्विता यो वृत्रहन्तमो विद इन्द्रः शतक्रतुः । उप नो हरिभिः सुतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dvitā yo vṛtrahantamo vida indraḥ śatakratuḥ | upa no haribhiḥ sutam ||

translations.english: Indra, Śatakratu, mightiest slayer of Vṛtra, you whose power is known in a two-fold way, come withyour steeds to our effused libation.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं हि वृत्रहन्नेषां पाता सोमानामसि । उप नो हरिभिः सुतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ hi vṛtrahanneṣāṃ pātā somānāmasi | upa no haribhiḥ sutam ||

translations.english: Slayer of Vṛtra, you are the drinker of these Soma juices, come with your steeds to our effused libation.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र इषे ददातु न ऋभुक्षणमृभुं रयिम् । वाजी ददातु वाजिनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra iṣe dadātu na ṛbhukṣaṇamṛbhuṃ rayim | vājī dadātu vājinam ||

translations.english: May Indra bring to us the bounteous Ṛbhu Ṛbhukṣaṇa to partake of our sacrificial viands; may he,the mighty, bring the mighty (Vāja).

mantras.sanskrit: गौर्धयति मरुतां श्रवस्युर्माता मघोनाम् । युक्ता वह्नी रथानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: gaurdhayati marutāṃ śravasyurmātā maghonām | yuktā vahnī rathānām ||

translations.english: The cow (Pṛs;ni), the food-desiring mother of the wealthy Maruts, drinks (the Soma)-- she is worthy ofall honour, who yokes (the mares) to their chariots.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्या देवा उपस्थे व्रता विश्वे धारयन्ते । सूर्यामासा दृशे कम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasyā devā upasthe vratā viśve dhārayante | sūryāmāsā dṛśe kam ||

translations.english: She, in whose presence all the gods observe their functions, and the sun and moon move in peace toenlighten the world.

mantras.sanskrit: तत्सु नो विश्वे अर्य आ सदा गृणन्ति कारवः । मरुतः सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: tatsu no viśve arya ā sadā gṛṇanti kāravaḥ | marutaḥ somapītaye ||

translations.english: Therefore all our priests in their worship always sing the Maruts that they may drink the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्ति सोमो अयं सुतः पिबन्त्यस्य मरुतः । उत स्वराजो अश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: asti somo ayaṃ sutaḥ pibantyasya marutaḥ | uta svarājo aśvinā ||

translations.english: This Soma is effused (by us); the self-resplendent Maruts drink of it, and the Aśvins.

mantras.sanskrit: पिबन्ति मित्रो अर्यमा तना पूतस्य वरुणः । त्रिषधस्थस्य जावतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pibanti mitro aryamā tanā pūtasya varuṇaḥ | triṣadhasthasya jāvataḥ ||

translations.english: Mitra, Aryaman and Varuṇa drink (the Soma), purified by the straining cloth, abiding in three plural ces,and granting posterity.

mantras.sanskrit: उतो न्वस्य जोषमाँ इन्द्रः सुतस्य गोमतः । प्रातर्होतेव मत्सति ॥
mantras.transliteration: uto nvasya joṣamā~ indraḥ sutasya gomataḥ | prātarhoteva matsati ||

translations.english: Indra also is eager in the morning to drink this effused (Soma) mixed with milk, as a priest (to praise thegods).

mantras.sanskrit: कदत्विषन्त सूरयस्तिर आप इव स्रिधः । अर्षन्ति पूतदक्षसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kadatviṣanta sūrayastira āpa iva sridhaḥ | arṣanti pūtadakṣasaḥ ||

translations.english: When do the sages flash like waters across (to sky)? When do the Maruts, pure in vigour, destroyers ofenemies, come to our offering?

mantras.sanskrit: कद्वो अद्य महानां देवानामवो वृणे । त्मना च दस्मवर्चसाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kadvo adya mahānāṃ devānāmavo vṛṇe | tmanā ca dasmavarcasām ||

translations.english: O shall I today possess your protection, mighty deities, beautiful bright in yourselves (thoughunadorned)?

mantras.sanskrit: आ ये विश्वा पार्थिवानि पप्रथन्रोचना दिवः । मरुतः सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā ye viśvā pārthivāni paprathanrocanā divaḥ | marutaḥ somapītaye ||

translations.english: (We invoke) those maruts to drink our Soma, who have spread our all the things of earth and theluminaries of heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: त्यान्नु पूतदक्षसो दिवो वो मरुतो हुवे । अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: tyānnu pūtadakṣaso divo vo maruto huve | asya somasya pītaye ||

translations.english: O Maruts, I invoke you, resplendent, of pure vigour, to drink this Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: त्यान्नु ये वि रोदसी तस्तभुर्मरुतो हुवे । अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: tyānnu ye vi rodasī tastabhurmaruto huve | asya somasya pītaye ||

translations.english: I invoke those Maruts to drink this Soma, who have established heaven and earth.

mantras.sanskrit: त्यं नु मारुतं गणं गिरिष्ठां वृषणं हुवे । अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: tyaṃ nu mārutaṃ gaṇaṃ giriṣṭhāṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ huve | asya somasya pītaye ||

translations.english: I invoke that band of the Maruts, abiding in the clouds, the showerers, to drink this Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: आ त्वा गिरो रथीरिवास्थुः सुतेषु गिर्वणः । अभि त्वा समनूषतेन्द्र वत्सं न मातरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tvā giro rathīrivāsthuḥ suteṣu girvaṇaḥ | abhi tvā samanūṣatendra vatsaṃ na mātaraḥ ||

translations.english: O Indra, worthy of praise when the Soma is effused our songs hasten to you as charioteer, they lowtowards you as cows towards their calves.

mantras.sanskrit: आ त्वा शुक्रा अचुच्यवुः सुतास इन्द्र गिर्वणः । पिबा त्वस्यान्धस इन्द्र विश्वासु ते हितम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tvā śukrā acucyavuḥ sutāsa indra girvaṇaḥ | pibā tvasyāndhasa indra viśvāsu te hitam ||

translations.english: Indra worthy of praise, let the bright Soma-libations come to you; drink your portion of the Soma; Indra,in all plural ces it is fit for you.

mantras.sanskrit: पिबा सोमं मदाय कमिन्द्र श्येनाभृतं सुतम् । त्वं हि शश्वतीनां पती राजा विशामसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: pibā somaṃ madāya kamindra śyenābhṛtaṃ sutam | tvaṃ hi śaśvatīnāṃ patī rājā viśāmasi ||

translations.english: Drink to your fill, Indra, the effused Soma brought, by the hawk, you are the lord of all the divine hosts,you are the self-resplendent.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रुधी हवं तिरश्च्या इन्द्र यस्त्वा सपर्यति । सुवीर्यस्य गोमतो रायस्पूर्धि महाँ असि ॥
mantras.transliteration: śrudhī havaṃ tiraścyā indra yastvā saparyati | suvīryasya gomato rāyaspūrdhi mahā~ asi ||

translations.english: Hear, Indra, the prayer of Tiraści who worships you, and satisfy him with wealth bringing gallantoffspring and cattle-- for you are mighty.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र यस्ते नवीयसीं गिरं मन्द्रामजीजनत् । चिकित्विन्मनसं धियं प्रत्नामृतस्य पिप्युषीम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra yaste navīyasīṃ giraṃ mandrāmajījanat | cikitvinmanasaṃ dhiyaṃ pratnāmṛtasya pipyuṣīm ||

translations.english: To him who has made for you this newest joy-giving hymn, do you, Indra, (extend) your ancient truthfulprovidence to which all hearts are known.

mantras.sanskrit: तमु ष्टवाम यं गिर इन्द्रमुक्थानि वावृधुः । पुरूण्यस्य पौंस्या सिषासन्तो वनामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamu ṣṭavāma yaṃ gira indramukthāni vāvṛdhuḥ | purūṇyasya pauṃsyā siṣāsanto vanāmahe ||

translations.english: Let us praise that Indra whom our chants and hymns have magnified; we worship him, desirous tohonour his many deeds of might.

mantras.sanskrit: एतो न्विन्द्रं स्तवाम शुद्धं शुद्धेन साम्ना । शुद्धैरुक्थैर्वावृध्वांसं शुद्ध आशीर्वान्ममत्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: eto nvindraṃ stavāma śuddhaṃ śuddhena sāmnā | śuddhairukthairvāvṛdhvāṃsaṃ śuddha āśīrvānmamattu ||

translations.english: Come let us praise the purified Indra with a pure Sāman and with pure recited hymns; let the pure(Soma) mixed with milk gladden him waxing strong.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र शुद्धो न आ गहि शुद्धः शुद्धाभिरूतिभिः । शुद्धो रयिं नि धारय शुद्धो ममद्धि सोम्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra śuddho na ā gahi śuddhaḥ śuddhābhirūtibhiḥ | śuddho rayiṃ ni dhāraya śuddho mamaddhi somyaḥ ||

translations.english: Come to us, Indra, purified; purified with your pure protecting hosts; purified establish wealth in us;purified and now worthy of the Soma, rejoice.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र शुद्धो हि नो रयिं शुद्धो रत्नानि दाशुषे । शुद्धो वृत्राणि जिघ्नसे शुद्धो वाजं सिषाससि ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra śuddho hi no rayiṃ śuddho ratnāni dāśuṣe | śuddho vṛtrāṇi jighnase śuddho vājaṃ siṣāsasi ||

translations.english: Purified, Indra, give us wealth; purified give to your worshipper precious things; purified you smite yourenemies; purified you desire to give us food.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मा उषास आतिरन्त याममिन्द्राय नक्तमूर्म्याः सुवाचः । अस्मा आपो मातरः सप्त तस्थुर्नृभ्यस्तराय सिन्धवः सुपाराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmā uṣāsa ātiranta yāmamindrāya naktamūrmyāḥ suvācaḥ | asmā āpo mātaraḥ sapta tasthurnṛbhyastarāya sindhavaḥ supārāḥ ||

translations.english: For him the dawns prolonged their rising; for Indra the nights uttered auspicious voices by night; for himthe waters, the mothers, the seven rivers, stood, offering an easy passage for men to cross over.

mantras.sanskrit: अतिविद्धा विथुरेणा चिदस्त्रा त्रिः सप्त सानु संहिता गिरीणाम् । न तद्देवो न मर्त्यस्तुतुर्याद्यानि प्रवृद्धो वृषभश्चकार ॥
mantras.transliteration: atividdhā vithureṇā cidastrā triḥ sapta sānu saṃhitā girīṇām | na taddevo na martyastuturyādyāni pravṛddho vṛṣabhaścakāra ||

translations.english: By him the thrower, unaided, were pierced asunder the thrice seven table-lands of the mountainheaped together; neither god nor mortal could do what he, the showerer, in his full-grown strength has done.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य वज्र आयसो निमिश्ल इन्द्रस्य बाह्वोर्भूयिष्ठमोजः । शीर्षन्निन्द्रस्य क्रतवो निरेक आसन्नेषन्त श्रुत्या उपाके ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrasya vajra āyaso nimiśla indrasya bāhvorbhūyiṣṭhamojaḥ | śīrṣannindrasya kratavo nireka āsanneṣanta śrutyā upāke ||

translations.english: Indra's iron thunderbolt is grasped firmly in his hand, enormous strength resides in his arms; when hegoes forth (to battle), there is ample employment for his head and his mouth, and (his followers) rush near him tohear his commands.

mantras.sanskrit: मन्ये त्वा यज्ञियं यज्ञियानां मन्ये त्वा च्यवनमच्युतानाम् । मन्ये त्वा सत्वनामिन्द्र केतुं मन्ये त्वा वृषभं चर्षणीनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: manye tvā yajñiyaṃ yajñiyānāṃ manye tvā cyavanamacyutānām | manye tvā satvanāmindra ketuṃ manye tvā vṛṣabhaṃ carṣaṇīnām ||

translations.english: I think you the most worthy among those worthy of sacrifice; I think you the overthrower of theimperishable (mountains); I think you, Indra, the banner of warriors; I think you the showerer (of blessings) tomen.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यद्वज्रं बाह्वोरिन्द्र धत्से मदच्युतमहये हन्तवा उ । प्र पर्वता अनवन्त प्र गावः प्र ब्रह्माणो अभिनक्षन्त इन्द्रम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yadvajraṃ bāhvorindra dhatse madacyutamahaye hantavā u | pra parvatā anavanta pra gāvaḥ pra brahmāṇo abhinakṣanta indram ||

translations.english: When, Indra, you grasp in your arms your pride humbling thunderbolt to smite Ahi, when the mountainclouds loudly roar and the cows loudly bellow, then the brāhmaṇas offer their worship to Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: तमु ष्टवाम य इमा जजान विश्वा जातान्यवराण्यस्मात् । इन्द्रेण मित्रं दिधिषेम गीर्भिरुपो नमोभिर्वृषभं विशेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamu ṣṭavāma ya imā jajāna viśvā jātānyavarāṇyasmāt | indreṇa mitraṃ didhiṣema gīrbhirupo namobhirvṛṣabhaṃ viśema ||

translations.english: Let us praise that Indra who produced all the things, to him all beings are subsequent; may we maintainfriendship with Indra by our hymns, let us bring the showerer (of blessings) near us by our praises.

mantras.sanskrit: वृत्रस्य त्वा श्वसथादीषमाणा विश्वे देवा अजहुर्ये सखायः । मरुद्भिरिन्द्र सख्यं ते अस्त्वथेमा विश्वाः पृतना जयासि ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛtrasya tvā śvasathādīṣamāṇā viśve devā ajahurye sakhāyaḥ | marudbhirindra sakhyaṃ te astvathemā viśvāḥ pṛtanā jayāsi ||

translations.english: All the gods who were your friends forsook you, flying away at the snorting of Vṛtra; O Indra, let therebe friendship to you with the Maruts; then do you conquer all these hostile armies.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिः षष्टिस्त्वा मरुतो वावृधाना उस्रा इव राशयो यज्ञियासः । उप त्वेमः कृधि नो भागधेयं शुष्मं त एना हविषा विधेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: triḥ ṣaṣṭistvā maruto vāvṛdhānā usrā iva rāśayo yajñiyāsaḥ | upa tvemaḥ kṛdhi no bhāgadheyaṃ śuṣmaṃ ta enā haviṣā vidhema ||

translations.english: These sixty-three Maruts were worthy of sacrifice nourishing your vigour like cows gathered together;we come to you, do you grant us our portion; so will we produce strength in you by this offering.

mantras.sanskrit: तिग्ममायुधं मरुतामनीकं कस्त इन्द्र प्रति वज्रं दधर्ष । अनायुधासो असुरा अदेवाश्चक्रेण ताँ अप वप ऋजीषिन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tigmamāyudhaṃ marutāmanīkaṃ kasta indra prati vajraṃ dadharṣa | anāyudhāso asurā adevāścakreṇa tā~ apa vapa ṛjīṣin ||

translations.english: Your sharp bow, the host of Maruts, and your thunderbolt who, Indra, has ever withstood? The asurasare weaponless and abandoned by the gods, drive them away by your discus, O Ṛjīṣin.

mantras.sanskrit: मह उग्राय तवसे सुवृक्तिं प्रेरय शिवतमाय पश्वः । गिर्वाहसे गिर इन्द्राय पूर्वीर्धेहि तन्वे कुविदङ्ग वेदत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: maha ugrāya tavase suvṛktiṃ preraya śivatamāya paśvaḥ | girvāhase gira indrāya pūrvīrdhehi tanve kuvidaṅga vedat ||

translations.english: Send forth an excellent hymn to great (Indra), the strong, might and most fortunate, (that he mayprosper) my cattle; utter many praises to Indra who is borne by praise, may he speedily give much wealth to me.

mantras.sanskrit: उक्थवाहसे विभ्वे मनीषां द्रुणा न पारमीरया नदीनाम् । नि स्पृश धिया तन्वि श्रुतस्य जुष्टतरस्य कुविदङ्ग वेदत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ukthavāhase vibhve manīṣāṃ druṇā na pāramīrayā nadīnām | ni spṛśa dhiyā tanvi śrutasya juṣṭatarasya kuvidaṅga vedat ||

translations.english: Send forth your praise to mighty Indra who is borne by hymns, as (a sailor sends a traveller) in a shipacross the rivers; bring to me by your rites that wealth which belongs to him renowned and beneficent; may hespeedily give much wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: तद्विविड्ढि यत्त इन्द्रो जुजोषत्स्तुहि सुष्टुतिं नमसा विवास । उप भूष जरितर्मा रुवण्यः श्रावया वाचं कुविदङ्ग वेदत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadviviḍḍhi yatta indro jujoṣatstuhi suṣṭutiṃ namasā vivāsa | upa bhūṣa jaritarmā ruvaṇyaḥ śrāvayā vācaṃ kuvidaṅga vedat ||

translations.english: Perform those rites of yours that Indra may accept them; praise him to whom praise belongs, worshiphim with your service; O priest, adorn thyself, grieve not (for poverty); let Indra hear your praise, may he speedilygive much wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: अव द्रप्सो अंशुमतीमतिष्ठदियानः कृष्णो दशभिः सहस्रैः । आवत्तमिन्द्रः शच्या धमन्तमप स्नेहितीर्नृमणा अधत्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: ava drapso aṃśumatīmatiṣṭhadiyānaḥ kṛṣṇo daśabhiḥ sahasraiḥ | āvattamindraḥ śacyā dhamantamapa snehitīrnṛmaṇā adhatta ||

translations.english: The swift-moving Kṛṣṇa with ten thousand (demons) stood on the Aṃśumatī; by his might Indracaught him snorting (in the water); he, benevolent to man, smote his malicious (bands).

mantras.sanskrit: द्रप्समपश्यं विषुणे चरन्तमुपह्वरे नद्यो अंशुमत्याः । नभो न कृष्णमवतस्थिवांसमिष्यामि वो वृषणो युध्यताजौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: drapsamapaśyaṃ viṣuṇe carantamupahvare nadyo aṃśumatyāḥ | nabho na kṛṣṇamavatasthivāṃsamiṣyāmi vo vṛṣaṇo yudhyatājau ||

translations.english: "I have seen the swift-moving (demon) lurking in an inaccessible plural ce, in the depths of the riverAṃśumatī, (I have seen) Kṛṣṇa standing there as (the sun) in a cloud; I appeal to you, showerers; conquerhim in battle".

mantras.sanskrit: अध द्रप्सो अंशुमत्या उपस्थेऽधारयत्तन्वं तित्विषाणः । विशो अदेवीरभ्याचरन्तीर्बृहस्पतिना युजेन्द्रः ससाहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha drapso aṃśumatyā upasthe'dhārayattanvaṃ titviṣāṇaḥ | viśo adevīrabhyācarantīrbṛhaspatinā yujendraḥ sasāhe ||

translations.english: Then the swift-moving one, shining forth assumed his own body by the Aṃśumatī, and Indra withBṛhaspati as his ally smote the godless hosts as they drew near.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं ह त्यत्सप्तभ्यो जायमानोऽशत्रुभ्यो अभवः शत्रुरिन्द्र । गूळ्हे द्यावापृथिवी अन्वविन्दो विभुमद्भ्यो भुवनेभ्यो रणं धाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ ha tyatsaptabhyo jāyamāno'śatrubhyo abhavaḥ śatrurindra | gūḷhe dyāvāpṛthivī anvavindo vibhumadbhyo bhuvanebhyo raṇaṃ dhāḥ ||

translations.english: As soon as you were born, Indra, you were an enemy to those seven who had no enemy; yourecovered the heavens and earth when concealed (in darkness); you cause joy to the mighty worlds.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं ह त्यदप्रतिमानमोजो वज्रेण वज्रिन्धृषितो जघन्थ । त्वं शुष्णस्यावातिरो वधत्रैस्त्वं गा इन्द्र शच्येदविन्दः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ ha tyadapratimānamojo vajreṇa vajrindhṛṣito jaghantha | tvaṃ śuṣṇasyāvātiro vadhatraistvaṃ gā indra śacyedavindaḥ ||

translations.english: Thunderer, you, the resolute one, did smite that unrivalled might with your bolt; you destroyed Śuṣṇawith your weapons, you recovered the cows, Indra, by your wisdom.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं ह त्यद्वृषभ चर्षणीनां घनो वृत्राणां तविषो बभूथ । त्वं सिन्धूँरसृजस्तस्तभानान्त्वमपो अजयो दासपत्नीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ ha tyadvṛṣabha carṣaṇīnāṃ ghano vṛtrāṇāṃ taviṣo babhūtha | tvaṃ sindhū~rasṛjastastabhānāntvamapo ajayo dāsapatnīḥ ||

translations.english: You, showerer, were the mighty destroyer of the hindrances of your worshippers; you did set free theobstructed rivers, you did win the waters which the Dāsas had mastered.

mantras.sanskrit: स सुक्रतू रणिता यः सुतेष्वनुत्तमन्युर्यो अहेव रेवान् । य एक इन्नर्यपांसि कर्ता स वृत्रहा प्रतीदन्यमाहुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa sukratū raṇitā yaḥ suteṣvanuttamanyuryo aheva revān | ya eka innaryapāṃsi kartā sa vṛtrahā pratīdanyamāhuḥ ||

translations.english: He who noble in his exploits rejoices in the Soma-libations, he whose wrath cannot be repelled and whois wealthy as the days, he who alone performs the rites for his worshipper-- he, the slayer of Vṛtra, men say, is amatch for all others.

mantras.sanskrit: स वृत्रहेन्द्रश्चर्षणीधृत्तं सुष्टुत्या हव्यं हुवेम । स प्राविता मघवा नोऽधिवक्ता स वाजस्य श्रवस्यस्य दाता ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa vṛtrahendraścarṣaṇīdhṛttaṃ suṣṭutyā havyaṃ huvema | sa prāvitā maghavā no'dhivaktā sa vājasya śravasyasya dātā ||

translations.english: Indra is the slayer of Vṛtra, the cherisher of men; let us invoke him worthy of invocation, with anexcellent hymn; he is Maghavan, our protector, our encourager, he is the bestower of food that brings fame.

mantras.sanskrit: स वृत्रहेन्द्र ऋभुक्षाः सद्यो जज्ञानो हव्यो बभूव । कृण्वन्नपांसि नर्या पुरूणि सोमो न पीतो हव्यः सखिभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa vṛtrahendra ṛbhukṣāḥ sadyo jajñāno havyo babhūva | kṛṇvannapāṃsi naryā purūṇi somo na pīto havyaḥ sakhibhyaḥ ||

translations.english: As soon as he was born, he, Indra, the slayer of Vṛtra, the chief of the Ṛbhus, was worthy to beinvoked; he, performing many sacred acts for men, is worthy to be invoked for his friends like the quaffed Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: या इन्द्र भुज आभरः स्वर्वाँ असुरेभ्यः । स्तोतारमिन्मघवन्नस्य वर्धय ये च त्वे वृक्तबर्हिषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā indra bhuja ābharaḥ svarvā~ asurebhyaḥ | stotāraminmaghavannasya vardhaya ye ca tve vṛktabarhiṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, lord of heaven, with those good things which you have carried off from the asuras do youprosper, O Maghavan, your praiser and those who have spread for you the clipped grass.

mantras.sanskrit: यमिन्द्र दधिषे त्वमश्वं गां भागमव्ययम् । यजमाने सुन्वति दक्षिणावति तस्मिन्तं धेहि मा पणौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: yamindra dadhiṣe tvamaśvaṃ gāṃ bhāgamavyayam | yajamāne sunvati dakṣiṇāvati tasmintaṃ dhehi mā paṇau ||

translations.english: Those horses, those cows, that imperishable wealth which you have seized (from your enemies)--bestow them on the sacrificer who offers the Soma and is liberal to the priests-- not on the niggard.

mantras.sanskrit: य इन्द्र सस्त्यव्रतोऽनुष्वापमदेवयुः । स्वैः ष एवैर्मुमुरत्पोष्यं रयिं सनुतर्धेहि तं ततः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya indra sastyavrato'nuṣvāpamadevayuḥ | svaiḥ ṣa evairmumuratpoṣyaṃ rayiṃ sanutardhehi taṃ tataḥ ||

translations.english: Let him, Indra, who sleeps away careless of the gods and offering no sacrifices-- let him lose hisprecious wealth by his own evil courses, and then do you stow him away in some hidden plural ce.

mantras.sanskrit: यच्छक्रासि परावति यदर्वावति वृत्रहन् । अतस्त्वा गीर्भिर्द्युगदिन्द्र केशिभिः सुतावाँ आ विवासति ॥
mantras.transliteration: yacchakrāsi parāvati yadarvāvati vṛtrahan | atastvā gīrbhirdyugadindra keśibhiḥ sutāvā~ ā vivāsati ||

translations.english: Whether, Śakra, you are in the far-distant region, or whether, slayer of Vṛtra, you are in the lower-- thesacrificeer longs to being you, Indra, from thence by his hymns as by heaven-going steeds.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्वासि रोचने दिवः समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपि । यत्पार्थिवे सदने वृत्रहन्तम यदन्तरिक्ष आ गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadvāsi rocane divaḥ samudrasyādhi viṣṭapi | yatpārthive sadane vṛtrahantama yadantarikṣa ā gahi ||

translations.english: Or whether you are in the brightness of heaven, or whether in some region in the midst of the sea, orwhether, mightiest slayer of Vṛtra, in some abode in the earth, or whether in the firmament, -- come to us.

mantras.sanskrit: स नः सोमेषु सोमपाः सुतेषु शवसस्पते । मादयस्व राधसा सूनृतावतेन्द्र राया परीणसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa naḥ someṣu somapāḥ suteṣu śavasaspate | mādayasva rādhasā sūnṛtāvatendra rāyā parīṇasā ||

translations.english: Indra, drinker of the Soma, lord of strength, now that our Soma- libations have been effused, do yougladden us with wholesome food and ample wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: मा न इन्द्र परा वृणग्भवा नः सधमाद्यः । त्वं न ऊती त्वमिन्न आप्यं मा न इन्द्र परा वृणक् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā na indra parā vṛṇagbhavā naḥ sadhamādyaḥ | tvaṃ na ūtī tvaminna āpyaṃ mā na indra parā vṛṇak ||

translations.english: Leave us not, Indra, but share our joy; you are our protection, you are our kindred; Indra, leave us not.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मे इन्द्र सचा सुते नि षदा पीतये मधु । कृधी जरित्रे मघवन्नवो महदस्मे इन्द्र सचा सुते ॥
mantras.transliteration: asme indra sacā sute ni ṣadā pītaye madhu | kṛdhī jaritre maghavannavo mahadasme indra sacā sute ||

translations.english: Sit with us, Indra, at the oblation to drink the Soma; Maghavan, perform a mighty protection for yourworshipper, (seated) with us at the oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: न त्वा देवास आशत न मर्त्यासो अद्रिवः । विश्वा जातानि शवसाभिभूरसि न त्वा देवास आशत ॥
mantras.transliteration: na tvā devāsa āśata na martyāso adrivaḥ | viśvā jātāni śavasābhibhūrasi na tvā devāsa āśata ||

translations.english: Thunderer, neither gods nor mortals equal you by their acts; you surpass all beings by your might, thegods equal you not.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वाः पृतना अभिभूतरं नरं सजूस्ततक्षुरिन्द्रं जजनुश्च राजसे । क्रत्वा वरिष्ठं वर आमुरिमुतोग्रमोजिष्ठं तवसं तरस्विनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvāḥ pṛtanā abhibhūtaraṃ naraṃ sajūstatakṣurindraṃ jajanuśca rājase | kratvā variṣṭhaṃ vara āmurimutogramojiṣṭhaṃ tavasaṃ tarasvinam ||

translations.english: The assembled (priests) have roused Indra, the leader, the conqueror in all battles; they have createdhim (by their hymns) to shine-- him the mightiest in his acts, the smiter of enemies for spoil, the terrible, the mostpowerful, the stalwart, the furious.

mantras.sanskrit: समीं रेभासो अस्वरन्निन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये । स्वर्पतिं यदीं वृधे धृतव्रतो ह्योजसा समूतिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samīṃ rebhāso asvarannindraṃ somasya pītaye | svarpatiṃ yadīṃ vṛdhe dhṛtavrato hyojasā samūtibhiḥ ||

translations.english: The Rebhas have together praised Indra that he may drink the Soma; when (they praise) the lord ofheaven that he may wax strong (by the oblations), then he, observant of pious rites, is united to his strength andhis protecting guards.

mantras.sanskrit: नेमिं नमन्ति चक्षसा मेषं विप्रा अभिस्वरा । सुदीतयो वो अद्रुहोऽपि कर्णे तरस्विनः समृक्वभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nemiṃ namanti cakṣasā meṣaṃ viprā abhisvarā | sudītayo vo adruho'pi karṇe tarasvinaḥ samṛkvabhiḥ ||

translations.english: At the first sight (the Rebhas) bow to him who is the circumferene of the wheel, the priests (worship)with their praise (Indra) the ram; radiant and unharming, do you also, full of earnestness, sing in his ear with yourhymns.

mantras.sanskrit: तमिन्द्रं जोहवीमि मघवानमुग्रं सत्रा दधानमप्रतिष्कुतं शवांसि । मंहिष्ठो गीर्भिरा च यज्ञियो ववर्तद्राये नो विश्वा सुपथा कृणोतु वज्री ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamindraṃ johavīmi maghavānamugraṃ satrā dadhānamapratiṣkutaṃ śavāṃsi | maṃhiṣṭho gīrbhirā ca yajñiyo vavartadrāye no viśvā supathā kṛṇotu vajrī ||

translations.english: Again and again I invoke the strong Indra, Maghavan, who alone really possesses might, the irresistible;may he draw near through our songs, most bounteous and worthy of sacrifice; may he, the thunderer, make allthings prosperous for our wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं पुर इन्द्र चिकिदेना व्योजसा शविष्ठ शक्र नाशयध्यै । त्वद्विश्वानि भुवनानि वज्रिन्द्यावा रेजेते पृथिवी च भीषा ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ pura indra cikidenā vyojasā śaviṣṭha śakra nāśayadhyai | tvadviśvāni bhuvanāni vajrindyāvā rejete pṛthivī ca bhīṣā ||

translations.english: Indra, mightiest Śakra, you know how to destroy those cities (of Śambara) by your strength at you allworlds tremble, thunderer-- heaven and earth (tremble) with fear.

mantras.sanskrit: तन्म ऋतमिन्द्र शूर चित्र पात्वपो न वज्रिन्दुरिताति पर्षि भूरि । कदा न इन्द्र राय आ दशस्येर्विश्वप्स्न्यस्य स्पृहयाय्यस्य राजन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tanma ṛtamindra śūra citra pātvapo na vajrinduritāti parṣi bhūri | kadā na indra rāya ā daśasyerviśvapsnyasya spṛhayāyyasya rājan ||

translations.english: Indra, hero assuming many forms, may that truthfulness of you protect me; bear us, thunderer, over ourmany sins as over waters; when, radiant Indra, will you give us some wealth, desirable to all, manifold in itskinds?

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राय साम गायत विप्राय बृहते बृहत् । धर्मकृते विपश्चिते पनस्यवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāya sāma gāyata viprāya bṛhate bṛhat | dharmakṛte vipaścite panasyave ||

translations.english: Sing a Sāman to Indra, a Bṛhat to the mighty sage, to the performer, of religious rites, the all-knowingone who longs for praise.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमिन्द्राभिभूरसि त्वं सूर्यमरोचयः । विश्वकर्मा विश्वदेवो महाँ असि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamindrābhibhūrasi tvaṃ sūryamarocayaḥ | viśvakarmā viśvadevo mahā~ asi ||

translations.english: You are the conqueror, Indra; you have lighted in the sun; you are the maker of all, the lord of all thegods, the mighty.

mantras.sanskrit: विभ्राजञ्ज्योतिषा स्वरगच्छो रोचनं दिवः । देवास्त इन्द्र सख्याय येमिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: vibhrājañjyotiṣā svaragaccho rocanaṃ divaḥ | devāsta indra sakhyāya yemire ||

translations.english: You have pervaded the light of the sky, illumining heaven by your splendour; the gods, Indra,submissively solicit your friendship.

mantras.sanskrit: एन्द्र नो गधि प्रियः सत्राजिदगोह्यः । गिरिर्न विश्वतस्पृथुः पतिर्दिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: endra no gadhi priyaḥ satrājidagohyaḥ | girirna viśvataspṛthuḥ patirdivaḥ ||

translations.english: Come to us, Indra, beloved one, triumphant, and whom, none can conceal- - lord of heaven, vast on allsides as a mountain.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि हि सत्य सोमपा उभे बभूथ रोदसी । इन्द्रासि सुन्वतो वृधः पतिर्दिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi hi satya somapā ubhe babhūtha rodasī | indrāsi sunvato vṛdhaḥ patirdivaḥ ||

translations.english: Truthful drinker of the Soma, you surpass heaven and earth; O Indra, you are the fosterer of him whoprepares the libation, you are the lord of heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं हि शश्वतीनामिन्द्र दर्ता पुरामसि । हन्ता दस्योर्मनोर्वृधः पतिर्दिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ hi śaśvatīnāmindra dartā purāmasi | hantā dasyormanorvṛdhaḥ patirdivaḥ ||

translations.english: You, Indra, are the stormer of many hostile cities, the slayer of the Dasyu, the fosterer of man, the lordof heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: अधा हीन्द्र गिर्वण उप त्वा कामान्महः ससृज्महे । उदेव यन्त उदभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhā hīndra girvaṇa upa tvā kāmānmahaḥ sasṛjmahe | udeva yanta udabhiḥ ||

translations.english: Indra worthy of hymns, we send our earnest praises to you as men going by water (splash their friends)with handfuls.

mantras.sanskrit: वार्ण त्वा यव्याभिर्वर्धन्ति शूर ब्रह्माणि । वावृध्वांसं चिदद्रिवो दिवेदिवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: vārṇa tvā yavyābhirvardhanti śūra brahmāṇi | vāvṛdhvāṃsaṃ cidadrivo divedive ||

translations.english: As the lake (swells) with the rivers, so our praises, O hero, O thunderer, augment you as you growmore and more day by day.

mantras.sanskrit: युञ्जन्ति हरी इषिरस्य गाथयोरौ रथ उरुयुगे । इन्द्रवाहा वचोयुजा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuñjanti harī iṣirasya gāthayorau ratha uruyuge | indravāhā vacoyujā ||

translations.english: (The priests) by their hymn yoke in the swift deity's yoked at a word.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं न इन्द्रा भरँ ओजो नृम्णं शतक्रतो विचर्षणे । आ वीरं पृतनाषहम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ na indrā bhara~ ojo nṛmṇaṃ śatakrato vicarṣaṇe | ā vīraṃ pṛtanāṣaham ||

translations.english: Indra, all-beholding Maghavan, bring us strength and wealth; (we solicit you) the host-overpoweringchampion.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं हि नः पिता वसो त्वं माता शतक्रतो बभूविथ । अधा ते सुम्नमीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ hi naḥ pitā vaso tvaṃ mātā śatakrato babhūvitha | adhā te sumnamīmahe ||

translations.english: You have been our father, O giver of dwellings, you our mother O Śatakratu; we pray for thathappiness which is yours.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वां शुष्मिन्पुरुहूत वाजयन्तमुप ब्रुवे शतक्रतो । स नो रास्व सुवीर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāṃ śuṣminpuruhūta vājayantamupa bruve śatakrato | sa no rāsva suvīryam ||

translations.english: Mighty Śatakratu, invoked by many, I praise you desirous of offerings; do you give us wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामिदा ह्यो नरोऽपीप्यन्वज्रिन्भूर्णयः । स इन्द्र स्तोमवाहसामिह श्रुध्युप स्वसरमा गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmidā hyo naro'pīpyanvajrinbhūrṇayaḥ | sa indra stomavāhasāmiha śrudhyupa svasaramā gahi ||

translations.english: Thunderer, your worshippers, ready with their oblations, have today and yesterday made you drink (theSoma); listen, Indra, here to us who offer you praise and come you to our dwelling.

mantras.sanskrit: मत्स्वा सुशिप्र हरिवस्तदीमहे त्वे आ भूषन्ति वेधसः । तव श्रवांस्युपमान्युक्थ्या सुतेष्विन्द्र गिर्वणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: matsvā suśipra harivastadīmahe tve ā bhūṣanti vedhasaḥ | tava śravāṃsyupamānyukthyā suteṣvindra girvaṇaḥ ||

translations.english: Handsome-jawed lord of steeds, rejoice (in the libation); we pray to you, your votaries come to youIndra, worthy of praise, may your food be a pattern and excellent.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रायन्त इव सूर्यं विश्वेदिन्द्रस्य भक्षत । वसूनि जाते जनमान ओजसा प्रति भागं न दीधिम ॥
mantras.transliteration: śrāyanta iva sūryaṃ viśvedindrasya bhakṣata | vasūni jāte janamāna ojasā prati bhāgaṃ na dīdhima ||

translations.english: As the gathering (rays) proceed to the son, so (the Maruts proceed) to Indra, and by their power divideall his treasures among those who have been or will be born; may we meditate on our share.

mantras.sanskrit: अनर्शरातिं वसुदामुप स्तुहि भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः । सो अस्य कामं विधतो न रोषति मनो दानाय चोदयन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: anarśarātiṃ vasudāmupa stuhi bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ | so asya kāmaṃ vidhato na roṣati mano dānāya codayan ||

translations.english: Praise him the bestower of wealth, whose gifts are never evil; Indra's gifts are fortunate; he directs hismind to the gift and mars not the desire of his worshipper.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमिन्द्र प्रतूर्तिष्वभि विश्वा असि स्पृधः । अशस्तिहा जनिता विश्वतूरसि त्वं तूर्य तरुष्यतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamindra pratūrtiṣvabhi viśvā asi spṛdhaḥ | aśastihā janitā viśvatūrasi tvaṃ tūrya taruṣyataḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, you conquer in battles all opposing hosts; O opposer who beat down those who would opposeyou are the smiter of the wicked, the bringer (of evil to your enemies), and the destroyer of all.

mantras.sanskrit: अनु ते शुष्मं तुरयन्तमीयतुः क्षोणी शिशुं न मातरा । विश्वास्ते स्पृधः श्नथयन्त मन्यवे वृत्रं यदिन्द्र तूर्वसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: anu te śuṣmaṃ turayantamīyatuḥ kṣoṇī śiśuṃ na mātarā | viśvāste spṛdhaḥ śnathayanta manyave vṛtraṃ yadindra tūrvasi ||

translations.english: Heaven and earth follow your destructive energy as mothers their child; since you smite Vṛtra, all thehostile hosts, Indra, faint at your wrath.

mantras.sanskrit: इत ऊती वो अजरं प्रहेतारमप्रहितम् । आशुं जेतारं हेतारं रथीतममतूर्तं तुग्र्यावृधम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ita ūtī vo ajaraṃ prahetāramaprahitam | āśuṃ jetāraṃ hetāraṃ rathītamamatūrtaṃ tugryāvṛdham ||

translations.english: (Worshippers), summon here for protecting him who never grows old, the repeller (of enemies), himselfnever expelled, the swift conqueror, the driver, the best of charioteers, unharmed of any, the augmenter of water.

mantras.sanskrit: इष्कर्तारमनिष्कृतं सहस्कृतं शतमूतिं शतक्रतुम् । समानमिन्द्रमवसे हवामहे वसवानं वसूजुवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: iṣkartāramaniṣkṛtaṃ sahaskṛtaṃ śatamūtiṃ śatakratum | samānamindramavase havāmahe vasavānaṃ vasūjuvam ||

translations.english: We solicit for our protection Indra, the consecrator of others but himself consecrated by none, producedby strength, possessing a hundred-fold protection, possessing hundred-fold knowledge, a common deity tomany, hiding treasures in his store-house and sending wealth (to his votaries).

mantras.sanskrit: अयं त एमि तन्वा पुरस्ताद्विश्वे देवा अभि मा यन्ति पश्चात् । यदा मह्यं दीधरो भागमिन्द्रादिन्मया कृणवो वीर्याणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ ta emi tanvā purastādviśve devā abhi mā yanti paścāt | yadā mahyaṃ dīdharo bhāgamindrādinmayā kṛṇavo vīryāṇi ||

translations.english: I here go before you with my son, the Viśve devās follow after me; if, Indra, you keep wealth for me,then put forth your strength on my side.

mantras.sanskrit: दधामि ते मधुनो भक्षमग्रे हितस्ते भागः सुतो अस्तु सोमः । असश्च त्वं दक्षिणतः सखा मेऽधा वृत्राणि जङ्घनाव भूरि ॥
mantras.transliteration: dadhāmi te madhuno bhakṣamagre hitaste bhāgaḥ suto astu somaḥ | asaśca tvaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ sakhā me'dhā vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanāva bhūri ||

translations.english: I offer the exhilarating Soma first toyou, let the effused enjoyable Soma be plural ced within you; be you afriend on my right hand, then will we two smite our many enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सु स्तोमं भरत वाजयन्त इन्द्राय सत्यं यदि सत्यमस्ति । नेन्द्रो अस्तीति नेम उ त्व आह क ईं ददर्श कमभि ष्टवाम ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra su stomaṃ bharata vājayanta indrāya satyaṃ yadi satyamasti | nendro astīti nema u tva āha ka īṃ dadarśa kamabhi ṣṭavāma ||

translations.english: Offer fervently, may war-loving companions, true praise to Indra, if he truly exists; Nema says, "verilythere is no Indra", who has ever seen him? Whom shall we praise?

mantras.sanskrit: अयमस्मि जरितः पश्य मेह विश्वा जातान्यभ्यस्मि मह्ना । ऋतस्य मा प्रदिशो वर्धयन्त्यादर्दिरो भुवना दर्दरीमि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayamasmi jaritaḥ paśya meha viśvā jātānyabhyasmi mahnā | ṛtasya mā pradiśo vardhayantyādardiro bhuvanā dardarīmi ||

translations.english: (Indra speaks): "here I am, worshipper, behold me here; I overpower all beings by my might; the offerersof sacrifice magnify me by their praises; I, the shatterer, shatter the worlds".

mantras.sanskrit: आ यन्मा वेना अरुहन्नृतस्यँ एकमासीनं हर्यतस्य पृष्ठे । मनश्चिन्मे हृद आ प्रत्यवोचदचिक्रदञ्छिशुमन्तः सखायः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yanmā venā aruhannṛtasya~ ekamāsīnaṃ haryatasya pṛṣṭhe | manaścinme hṛda ā pratyavocadacikradañchiśumantaḥ sakhāyaḥ ||

translations.english: "When the lovers of sacrifice ascended to me sitting alone on the back of my well-loved (formament),then my mind verily proclaimed to my heart, ' my friends with their children are crying to me' ".

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वेत्ता ते सवनेषु प्रवाच्या या चकर्थ मघवन्निन्द्र सुन्वते । पारावतं यत्पुरुसम्भृतं वस्वपावृणोः शरभाय ऋषिबन्धवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvettā te savaneṣu pravācyā yā cakartha maghavannindra sunvate | pārāvataṃ yatpurusambhṛtaṃ vasvapāvṛṇoḥ śarabhāya ṛṣibandhave ||

translations.english: Verily all those deeds of yours, Maghavan, are to be proclaimed, which you have achieved for him whooffers libations in the sacrifice; that wealth of Pārāvat, collected by many; you have opened to Śarabha, thekinsman of the Ṛṣi.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र नूनं धावता पृथङ्नेह यो वो अवावरीत् । नि षीं वृत्रस्य मर्मणि वज्रमिन्द्रो अपीपतत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra nūnaṃ dhāvatā pṛthaṅneha yo vo avāvarīt | ni ṣīṃ vṛtrasya marmaṇi vajramindro apīpatat ||

translations.english: Haste now severally forward; he is not here who stopped your way-- has not Indra let fall histhunderbolt in the very vitals of that enemy?

mantras.sanskrit: मनोजवा अयमान आयसीमतरत्पुरम् । दिवं सुपर्णो गत्वाय सोमं वज्रिण आभरत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: manojavā ayamāna āyasīmataratpuram | divaṃ suparṇo gatvāya somaṃ vajriṇa ābharat ||

translations.english: Suparṇa, rushing swift as thought, passed through the metal city; then having gone to heaven hebrought the Soma to the thunderer.

mantras.sanskrit: समुद्रे अन्तः शयत उद्ना वज्रो अभीवृतः । भरन्त्यस्मै संयतः पुरःप्रस्रवणा बलिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: samudre antaḥ śayata udnā vajro abhīvṛtaḥ | bharantyasmai saṃyataḥ puraḥprasravaṇā balim ||

translations.english: The thunderbolt lies in the midst of the sea, covered with the waters; (the foes) flying in front of thebattle bring offerings of submission to it.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्वाग्वदन्त्यविचेतनानि राष्ट्री देवानां निषसाद मन्द्रा । चतस्र ऊर्जं दुदुहे पयांसि क्व स्विदस्याः परमं जगाम ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadvāgvadantyavicetanāni rāṣṭrī devānāṃ niṣasāda mandrā | catasra ūrjaṃ duduhe payāṃsi kva svidasyāḥ paramaṃ jagāma ||

translations.english: When Vāk, the queen, the gladdener of the gods, sits down (in the sacrifice) uttering things not to beunderstood, she milks water and food for the four quarters (of the earth); whither now is her best portion gone?

mantras.sanskrit: देवीं वाचमजनयन्त देवास्तां विश्वरूपाः पशवो वदन्ति । सा नो मन्द्रेषमूर्जं दुहाना धेनुर्वागस्मानुप सुष्टुतैतु ॥
mantras.transliteration: devīṃ vācamajanayanta devāstāṃ viśvarūpāḥ paśavo vadanti | sā no mandreṣamūrjaṃ duhānā dhenurvāgasmānupa suṣṭutaitu ||

translations.english: The gods produced the goddess Vāk; her do animals of every kind utter; may she, Vāk, theall-gladdening cow, yielding meat and drink, come to us, worthily praised.

mantras.sanskrit: सखे विष्णो वितरं वि क्रमस्व द्यौर्देहि लोकं वज्राय विष्कभे । हनाव वृत्रं रिणचाव सिन्धूनिन्द्रस्य यन्तु प्रसवे विसृष्टाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sakhe viṣṇo vitaraṃ vi kramasva dyaurdehi lokaṃ vajrāya viṣkabhe | hanāva vṛtraṃ riṇacāva sindhūnindrasya yantu prasave visṛṣṭāḥ ||

translations.english: O Viṣṇu my friends, stride forth lustily; O heaven, give room to contain the thunderbolt; let us smiteVṛtra, let us open the rivers; let them flow, set free, at the command of Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋधगित्था स मर्त्यः शशमे देवतातये । यो नूनं मित्रावरुणावभिष्टय आचक्रे हव्यदातये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛdhagitthā sa martyaḥ śaśame devatātaye | yo nūnaṃ mitrāvaruṇāvabhiṣṭaya ācakre havyadātaye ||

translations.english: That man verily consecrates the oblation for the sacrifice, who brings quickly Mitra and Varuṇa to theofferer for the attainment of his desires.

mantras.sanskrit: वर्षिष्ठक्षत्रा उरुचक्षसा नरा राजाना दीर्घश्रुत्तमा । ता बाहुता न दंसना रथर्यतः साकं सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: varṣiṣṭhakṣatrā urucakṣasā narā rājānā dīrghaśruttamā | tā bāhutā na daṃsanā ratharyataḥ sākaṃ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ ||

translations.english: Those two leaders of rites, great in mite, far-seeing, resplendent, and most far-hearing, perform theirdeeds like two arms, by the help of the rays of the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र यो वां मित्रावरुणाजिरो दूतो अद्रवत् । अयःशीर्षा मदेरघुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra yo vāṃ mitrāvaruṇājiro dūto adravat | ayaḥśīrṣā maderaghuḥ ||

translations.english: Mitra and Varuṇa, he who hastens to appear before you, becomes the messenger of the gods; hewears a metal helment, he exults in his wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: न यः सम्पृच्छे न पुनर्हवीतवे न संवादाय रमते । तस्मान्नो अद्य समृतेरुरुष्यतं बाहुभ्यां न उरुष्यतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: na yaḥ sampṛcche na punarhavītave na saṃvādāya ramate | tasmānno adya samṛteruruṣyataṃ bāhubhyāṃ na uruṣyatam ||

translations.english: He who has no plural asure in questioning, nor in repeated calling nor in dialogue-- defend us today fromhim and from his encounter, defend us from his arms.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र मित्राय प्रार्यम्णे सचथ्यमृतावसो । वरूथ्यं वरुणे छन्द्यं वचः स्तोत्रं राजसु गायत ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra mitrāya prāryamṇe sacathyamṛtāvaso | varūthyaṃ varuṇe chandyaṃ vacaḥ stotraṃ rājasu gāyata ||

translations.english: O you rich in offerings, sing to Mitra, sing to Aryaman, a reverential hymn produced in the sacrificialchamber; sing a propitiating address to Varuṇa; sing a hymn of praise to the kings.

mantras.sanskrit: ते हिन्विरे अरुणं जेन्यं वस्वेकं पुत्रं तिसॄणाम् । ते धामान्यमृता मर्त्यानामदब्धा अभि चक्षते ॥
mantras.transliteration: te hinvire aruṇaṃ jenyaṃ vasvekaṃ putraṃ tisṝṇām | te dhāmānyamṛtā martyānāmadabdhā abhi cakṣate ||

translations.english: It was these who sent the red victory-giving Vasu, the one son of the three (worlds); they, the invincible,the immortal, overlook the abodes of men.

mantras.sanskrit: आ मे वचांस्युद्यता द्युमत्तमानि कर्त्वा । उभा यातं नासत्या सजोषसा प्रति हव्यानि वीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā me vacāṃsyudyatā dyumattamāni kartvā | ubhā yātaṃ nāsatyā sajoṣasā prati havyāni vītaye ||

translations.english: O associated Nāsatyās, come both of you to my uplifted glorious praises and my rites, come topartake of my offering.

mantras.sanskrit: रातिं यद्वामरक्षसं हवामहे युवाभ्यां वाजिनीवसू । प्राचीं होत्रां प्रतिरन्तावितं नरा गृणाना जमदग्निना ॥
mantras.transliteration: rātiṃ yadvāmarakṣasaṃ havāmahe yuvābhyāṃ vājinīvasū | prācīṃ hotrāṃ pratirantāvitaṃ narā gṛṇānā jamadagninā ||

translations.english: Deities rich in food, when we solicit your bounty, that (wealth) which demons cannot thwart-- then,helping our praise directed to the east, come, leaders of rites, worshipped by Jamadagni.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो यज्ञं दिविस्पृशं वायो याहि सुमन्मभिः । अन्तः पवित्र उपरि श्रीणानोऽयं शुक्रो अयामि ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no yajñaṃ divispṛśaṃ vāyo yāhi sumanmabhiḥ | antaḥ pavitra upari śrīṇāno'yaṃ śukro ayāmi te ||

translations.english: Come, Vāyu, to our heaven-reaching sacrifice with its beautiful hymns of praise, this bright Soma hasbeen kept for you, poured out upon the middle of the straining cloth.

mantras.sanskrit: वेत्यध्वर्युः पथिभी रजिष्ठैः प्रति हव्यानि वीतये । अधा नियुत्व उभयस्य नः पिब शुचिं सोमं गवाशिरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vetyadhvaryuḥ pathibhī rajiṣṭhaiḥ prati havyāni vītaye | adhā niyutva ubhayasya naḥ piba śuciṃ somaṃ gavāśiram ||

translations.english: The ministrant priest comes by the straighter paths, he brings the oblations for your enjoyment; thenlord of the Niyut steeds, drink of both kinds, the Soma pure and that mixed with milk.

mantras.sanskrit: बण्महाँ असि सूर्य बळादित्य महाँ असि । महस्ते सतो महिमा पनस्यतेऽद्धा देव महाँ असि ॥
mantras.transliteration: baṇmahā~ asi sūrya baḷāditya mahā~ asi | mahaste sato mahimā panasyate'ddhā deva mahā~ asi ||

translations.english: Verily you are great, O Sun; verily, Āditya, you are great; the greatness of you, the greatone,ispraised; verily you are great, O god.

mantras.sanskrit: बट् सूर्य श्रवसा महाँ असि सत्रा देव महाँ असि । मह्ना देवानामसुर्यः पुरोहितो विभु ज्योतिरदाभ्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: baṭ sūrya śravasā mahā~ asi satrā deva mahā~ asi | mahnā devānāmasuryaḥ purohito vibhu jyotiradābhyam ||

translations.english: Verily, O sun, you are great in fame; O god, you are indeed mighty among the gods in might; you arethe slayer of the asuras, and the preceptor (of the gods); your glory is widespread and to be marred by none.

mantras.sanskrit: इयं या नीच्यर्किणी रूपा रोहिण्या कृता । चित्रेव प्रत्यदर्श्यायत्यन्तर्दशसु बाहुषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: iyaṃ yā nīcyarkiṇī rūpā rohiṇyā kṛtā | citreva pratyadarśyāyatyantardaśasu bāhuṣu ||

translations.english: She who was created beautiful and bright, bending downwards and receiving all praise, has been seenwithin (the world), like a bridled cow, advancing to the ten regions (spread out) like arms.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रजा ह तिस्रो अत्यायमीयुर्न्यन्या अर्कमभितो विविश्रे । बृहद्ध तस्थौ भुवनेष्वन्तः पवमानो हरित आ विवेश ॥
mantras.transliteration: prajā ha tisro atyāyamīyurnyanyā arkamabhito viviśre | bṛhaddha tasthau bhuvaneṣvantaḥ pavamāno harita ā viveśa ||

translations.english: Three kinds of creatures went to destruction; the others came before Agni; the mighty one (the Sun)stood within the worlds; (Vāyu), the purifier, entered the quarters of the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: माता रुद्राणां दुहिता वसूनां स्वसादित्यानाममृतस्य नाभिः । प्र नु वोचं चिकितुषे जनाय मा गामनागामदितिं वधिष्ट ॥
mantras.transliteration: mātā rudrāṇāṃ duhitā vasūnāṃ svasādityānāmamṛtasya nābhiḥ | pra nu vocaṃ cikituṣe janāya mā gāmanāgāmaditiṃ vadhiṣṭa ||

translations.english: (She who is) the mother of the Rudras, the daughter of the Vasus, the sister of the Ādityas, the homeof ambrosia-- I have spoken to men of understqanding-- kill not her, the sinless inviolate cow.

mantras.sanskrit: वचोविदं वाचमुदीरयन्तीं विश्वाभिर्धीभिरुपतिष्ठमानाम् । देवीं देवेभ्यः पर्येयुषीं गामा मावृक्त मर्त्यो दभ्रचेताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vacovidaṃ vācamudīrayantīṃ viśvābhirdhībhirupatiṣṭhamānām | devīṃ devebhyaḥ paryeyuṣīṃ gāmā māvṛkta martyo dabhracetāḥ ||

translations.english: The divine cow, who herself utters, speech and gives speech to others, who comes attended by everykind of utterance, who helps me for my worship of the gods-- it is only the fool who abandons her.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने बृहद्वयो दधासि देव दाशुषे । कविर्गृहपतिर्युवा ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagne bṛhadvayo dadhāsi deva dāśuṣe | kavirgṛhapatiryuvā ||

translations.english: Divine Agni, the ever young, the wise, the protector of the household, it is you who give abundant foodto the worshipper.

mantras.sanskrit: स न ईळानया सह देवाँ अग्ने दुवस्युवा । चिकिद्विभानवा वह ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa na īḷānayā saha devā~ agne duvasyuvā | cikidvibhānavā vaha ||

translations.english: Resplendent one, do you, the all-knower, bring the gods here with this our reverential hymn of praise.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वया ह स्विद्युजा वयं चोदिष्ठेन यविष्ठ्य । अभि ष्मो वाजसातये ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvayā ha svidyujā vayaṃ codiṣṭhena yaviṣṭhya | abhi ṣmo vājasātaye ||

translations.english: O ever youthful one, with you as our ally, the sender of wealth, we overcome (our enemies) fo rtheattainemnt of food.

mantras.sanskrit: और्वभृगुवच्छुचिमप्नवानवदा हुवे । अग्निं समुद्रवाससम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: aurvabhṛguvacchucimapnavānavadā huve | agniṃ samudravāsasam ||

translations.english: Like Aurva Bhṛgu and like Apanvān, I invoke the pure Agni, dwelling in the midst of the sea.

mantras.sanskrit: हुवे वातस्वनं कविं पर्जन्यक्रन्द्यं सहः । अग्निं समुद्रवाससम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: huve vātasvanaṃ kaviṃ parjanyakrandyaṃ sahaḥ | agniṃ samudravāsasam ||

translations.english: I invoke Agni, dwelling in the midst of the sea, the wise one, roaring like the wind, might, with a voicelike Parjanya's.

mantras.sanskrit: आ सवं सवितुर्यथा भगस्येव भुजिं हुवे । अग्निं समुद्रवाससम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā savaṃ savituryathā bhagasyeva bhujiṃ huve | agniṃ samudravāsasam ||

translations.english: I invoke Agni dwelling in th emidst of the sea, like the energy of Savitā, like the enjoyments granted byBhaga.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निं वो वृधन्तमध्वराणां पुरूतमम् । अच्छा नप्त्रे सहस्वते ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniṃ vo vṛdhantamadhvarāṇāṃ purūtamam | acchā naptre sahasvate ||

translations.english: (Draw) near to Agni the strong, the mightiest, him who expands (with his flames), the grandson of theinvincible ones.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं यथा न आभुवत्त्वष्टा रूपेव तक्ष्या । अस्य क्रत्वा यशस्वतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ yathā na ābhuvattvaṣṭā rūpeva takṣyā | asya kratvā yaśasvataḥ ||

translations.english: (Draw near) that he may deal with us as a carpenter (TVaṣṭā) deals with the timber he has to cut;may we become renowned by his skill.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं विश्वा अभि श्रियोऽग्निर्देवेषु पत्यते । आ वाजैरुप नो गमत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ viśvā abhi śriyo'gnirdeveṣu patyate | ā vājairupa no gamat ||

translations.english: Among the gods Agni has to do with all the successes (of men); may he come to us with abundance offood.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वेषामिह स्तुहि होतॄणां यशस्तमम् । अग्निं यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśveṣāmiha stuhi hotṝṇāṃ yaśastamam | agniṃ yajñeṣu pūrvyam ||

translations.english: Praise at our rite Agni, the most glorious of all ministrant priests, the foremost in the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: शीरं पावकशोचिषं ज्येष्ठो यो दमेष्वा । दीदाय दीर्घश्रुत्तमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śīraṃ pāvakaśociṣaṃ jyeṣṭho yo dameṣvā | dīdāya dīrghaśruttamaḥ ||

translations.english: (Praise him) the dweller in the sacrifice, of purifying radiance, who shines, the chief of the gods andomniscient, in the house (of the sacrificers).

mantras.sanskrit: तमर्वन्तं न सानसिं गृणीहि विप्र शुष्मिणम् । मित्रं न यातयज्जनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamarvantaṃ na sānasiṃ gṛṇīhi vipra śuṣmiṇam | mitraṃ na yātayajjanam ||

translations.english: O priest, glorify him, who is welcome and strong as a horse, and who like a friend conquers all foes.

mantras.sanskrit: उप त्वा जामयो गिरो देदिशतीर्हविष्कृतः । वायोरनीके अस्थिरन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa tvā jāmayo giro dediśatīrhaviṣkṛtaḥ | vāyoranīke asthiran ||

translations.english: The sister praises of the worshipper rise to you, proclaiming your glories; they stand kindling you in thepresence of Vāyu.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य त्रिधात्ववृतं बर्हिस्तस्थावसंदिनम् । आपश्चिन्नि दधा पदम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya tridhātvavṛtaṃ barhistasthāvasaṃdinam | āpaścinni dadhā padam ||

translations.english: The waters find their plural ce in him, for whom the triple-jointed grass is spread unlimited and untied (inthe sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: पदं देवस्य मीळ्हुषोऽनाधृष्टाभिरूतिभिः । भद्रा सूर्य इवोपदृक् ॥
mantras.transliteration: padaṃ devasya mīḷhuṣo'nādhṛṣṭābhirūtibhiḥ | bhadrā sūrya ivopadṛk ||

translations.english: Auspicious is the plural ce of the god who pours forth all desires with his inviolable protections; auspiciousis his appearance like the Sun's.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने घृतस्य धीतिभिस्तेपानो देव शोचिषा । आ देवान्वक्षि यक्षि च ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne ghṛtasya dhītibhistepāno deva śociṣā | ā devānvakṣi yakṣi ca ||

translations.english: Divine Agni, blazing with radiance, through our oblations of ghī, bear (our sacrifice) to the gods andoffer it.

mantras.sanskrit: तं त्वाजनन्त मातरः कविं देवासो अङ्गिरः । हव्यवाहममर्त्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ tvājananta mātaraḥ kaviṃ devāso aṅgiraḥ | havyavāhamamartyam ||

translations.english: The gods, as mothers, have borne you Aṅgirasa, the seer, the immortal, the bearer of the oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रचेतसं त्वा कवेऽग्ने दूतं वरेण्यम् । हव्यवाहं नि षेदिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pracetasaṃ tvā kave'gne dūtaṃ vareṇyam | havyavāhaṃ ni ṣedire ||

translations.english: The gods seat you in your plural ce, O wise Agni, the seer, the messenger, the most excellent the bearerof the oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: नहि मे अस्त्यघ्न्या न स्वधितिर्वनन्वति । अथैतादृग्भरामि ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahi me astyaghnyā na svadhitirvananvati | athaitādṛgbharāmi te ||

translations.english: No cow is mine, and no axe is at hand to cleave wood, but yet I bring both these to you.

mantras.sanskrit: यदग्ने कानि कानि चिदा ते दारूणि दध्मसि । ता जुषस्व यविष्ठ्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadagne kāni kāni cidā te dārūṇi dadhmasi | tā juṣasva yaviṣṭhya ||

translations.english: Most youthful (Agni), when we offer any kinds of timber trees to burn, you accept them all.

mantras.sanskrit: यदत्त्युपजिह्विका यद्वम्रो अतिसर्पति । सर्वं तदस्तु ते घृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadattyupajihvikā yadvamro atisarpati | sarvaṃ tadastu te ghṛtam ||

translations.english: Whatever timber the ant has gnawed, whatever the emmet has infested-- may it all be welcome to youas ghī.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निमिन्धानो मनसा धियं सचेत मर्त्यः । अग्निमीधे विवस्वभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnimindhāno manasā dhiyaṃ saceta martyaḥ | agnimīdhe vivasvabhiḥ ||

translations.english: Let a man, when he kindles Agni, perform the ceremony with a (devout) mind; he kindles him with thepriests.

mantras.sanskrit: अदर्शि गातुवित्तमो यस्मिन्व्रतान्यादधुः । उपो षु जातमार्यस्य वर्धनमग्निं नक्षन्त नो गिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adarśi gātuvittamo yasminvratānyādadhuḥ | upo ṣu jātamāryasya vardhanamagniṃ nakṣanta no giraḥ ||

translations.english: He, in whom they offer the sacrifices, has appeared-- he who knows all ways; our praises rise to Agni,auspiciously born, the helpeer of the Ārya.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र दैवोदासो अग्निर्देवाँ अच्छा न मज्मना । अनु मातरं पृथिवीं वि वावृते तस्थौ नाकस्य सानवि ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra daivodāso agnirdevā~ acchā na majmanā | anu mātaraṃ pṛthivīṃ vi vāvṛte tasthau nākasya sānavi ||

translations.english: Agni, when invoked by Divodāsa, ran along the mother Earth as with might, towards the gods; he tookhis plural ce in the height of heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्माद्रेजन्त कृष्टयश्चर्कृत्यानि कृण्वतः । सहस्रसां मेधसाताविव त्मनाग्निं धीभिः सपर्यत ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasmādrejanta kṛṣṭayaścarkṛtyāni kṛṇvataḥ | sahasrasāṃ medhasātāviva tmanāgniṃ dhībhiḥ saparyata ||

translations.english: Since men tremble before those who perform the sacred sacrifices, therefore, do you devoutly worshipin the solemn rite Agni the bestower of thousands of kine.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र यं राये निनीषसि मर्तो यस्ते वसो दाशत् । स वीरं धत्ते अग्न उक्थशंसिनं त्मना सहस्रपोषिणम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra yaṃ rāye ninīṣasi marto yaste vaso dāśat | sa vīraṃ dhatte agna ukthaśaṃsinaṃ tmanā sahasrapoṣiṇam ||

translations.english: Agni, bestower of dwellings, that mortal whom you wish to lead to wealth, and who gives offerings toyou possess of himself a strong son, a reciter of hymns and a lord of great wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: स दृळ्हे चिदभि तृणत्ति वाजमर्वता स धत्ते अक्षिति श्रवः । त्वे देवत्रा सदा पुरूवसो विश्वा वामानि धीमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa dṛḷhe cidabhi tṛṇatti vājamarvatā sa dhatte akṣiti śravaḥ | tve devatrā sadā purūvaso viśvā vāmāni dhīmahi ||

translations.english: Lord of vast wealth, he (your worshipper) spoils with his steed food laid up even in strongholds, hepossesses imperishable wealth; in you divine we ever possess all desirable treasures.

mantras.sanskrit: यो विश्वा दयते वसु होता मन्द्रो जनानाम् । मधोर्न पात्रा प्रथमान्यस्मै प्र स्तोमा यन्त्यग्नये ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo viśvā dayate vasu hotā mandro janānām | madhorna pātrā prathamānyasmai pra stomā yantyagnaye ||

translations.english: To him the invoker of the gods, who ever rejoicing distributes all wealth to men-- to Agni proceed ourpraises like the principal cups of the exhilarating Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्वं न गीर्भी रथ्यं सुदानवो मर्मृज्यन्ते देवयवः । उभे तोके तनये दस्म विश्पते पर्षि राधो मघोनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvaṃ na gīrbhī rathyaṃ sudānavo marmṛjyante devayavaḥ | ubhe toke tanaye dasma viśpate parṣi rādho maghonām ||

translations.english: The liberal worshippers with their hymns honour you harnessed to the car like a horse; graceful lord ofmen, grant wealth to us rich in children and grandchildren.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र मंहिष्ठाय गायत ऋताव्ने बृहते शुक्रशोचिषे । उपस्तुतासो अग्नये ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra maṃhiṣṭhāya gāyata ṛtāvne bṛhate śukraśociṣe | upastutāso agnaye ||

translations.english: Singers of hymns, sing aloud to the mighty Agni, most bounteous, observant of truth an dradiant withbrightness.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वंसते मघवा वीरवद्यशः समिद्धो द्युम्न्याहुतः । कुविन्नो अस्य सुमतिर्नवीयस्यच्छा वाजेभिरागमत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vaṃsate maghavā vīravadyaśaḥ samiddho dyumnyāhutaḥ | kuvinno asya sumatirnavīyasyacchā vājebhirāgamat ||

translations.english: The wealthy and glorious (Agni), when invoked and kindled, pours forth on his votaries abundance offood with children; may his ever fresh favour continually come to us with all kinds of food.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रेष्ठमु प्रियाणां स्तुह्यासावातिथिम् । अग्निं रथानां यमम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: preṣṭhamu priyāṇāṃ stuhyāsāvātithim | agniṃ rathānāṃ yamam ||

translations.english: Praise, singer of hymns, the guest, Agni, the dearest of the dear, the driver of chariots.

mantras.sanskrit: उदिता यो निदिता वेदिता वस्वा यज्ञियो ववर्तति । दुष्टरा यस्य प्रवणे नोर्मयो धिया वाजं सिषासतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uditā yo niditā veditā vasvā yajñiyo vavartati | duṣṭarā yasya pravaṇe normayo dhiyā vājaṃ siṣāsataḥ ||

translations.english: (Praise him) the knower, worthy of the sacrifice, who brings to us treasures which have come up (fromthe depths) and are far-renowned-- whose (flames), as he hastend to wage the battle by means of our sacred riteand hard to be passed through as waves rushing down a declivity.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नो हृणीतामतिथिर्वसुरग्निः पुरुप्रशस्त एषः । यः सुहोता स्वध्वरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā no hṛṇītāmatithirvasuragniḥ purupraśasta eṣaḥ | yaḥ suhotā svadhvaraḥ ||

translations.english: May none hinder Agni from coming to us, our guest, the giver of dwellings, praised by many-- (Agni)who is the excellent invoker of the gods, who offers an excellent sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: मो ते रिषन्ये अच्छोक्तिभिर्वसोऽग्ने केभिश्चिदेवैः । कीरिश्चिद्धि त्वामीट्टे दूत्याय रातहव्यः स्वध्वरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mo te riṣanye acchoktibhirvaso'gne kebhiścidevaiḥ | kīriściddhi tvāmīṭṭe dūtyāya rātahavyaḥ svadhvaraḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, giver of dwellings, let not those come to harm, who approach you in whatever manner with hymnsof praise; the worshipper who offers his libation and duly performs the rite praises you that you may be thebearer of the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: आग्ने याहि मरुत्सखा रुद्रेभिः सोमपीतये । सोभर्या उप सुष्टुतिं मादयस्व स्वर्णरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: āgne yāhi marutsakhā rudrebhiḥ somapītaye | sobharyā upa suṣṭutiṃ mādayasva svarṇare ||

translations.english: Agni, who have the Maruts as your friends, come with the Rudras to drinkt he Soma; come to thepraises of Sobhari; delight yourself at our solemn rite.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वादिष्ठया मदिष्ठया पवस्व सोम धारया । इन्द्राय पातवे सुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: svādiṣṭhayā madiṣṭhayā pavasva soma dhārayā | indrāya pātave sutaḥ ||

translations.english: Flow, Soma, in a most sweet and exhilarating stream, effused for Indra to drink.

mantras.sanskrit: रक्षोहा विश्वचर्षणिरभि योनिमयोहतम् । द्रुणा सधस्थमासदत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: rakṣohā viśvacarṣaṇirabhi yonimayohatam | druṇā sadhasthamāsadat ||

translations.english: The all-beholding destroyer of rākṣasas has stepped upon his gold-smitten birthplace, united with the wooden cask.

mantras.sanskrit: वरिवोधातमो भव मंहिष्ठो वृत्रहन्तमः । पर्षि राधो मघोनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: varivodhātamo bhava maṃhiṣṭho vṛtrahantamaḥ | parṣi rādho maghonām ||

translations.english: Be the lavish giver of wealth, most bounteous, the destroyer of enemies; bestow on us the riches of the affluent.

mantras.sanskrit: अभ्यर्ष महानां देवानां वीतिमन्धसा । अभि वाजमुत श्रवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhyarṣa mahānāṃ devānāṃ vītimandhasā | abhi vājamuta śravaḥ ||

translations.english: Come with food to the sacrifice of the mighty gods, and bring to us strength and sustenance.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामच्छा चरामसि तदिदर्थं दिवेदिवे । इन्दो त्वे न आशसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmacchā carāmasi tadidarthaṃ divedive | indo tve na āśasaḥ ||

translations.english: To you we come, O dropping (Soma); for you only is this our worship day by day, our prayers are to you, none other.

mantras.sanskrit: पुनाति ते परिस्रुतं सोमं सूर्यस्य दुहिता । वारेण शश्वता तना ॥
mantras.transliteration: punāti te parisrutaṃ somaṃ sūryasya duhitā | vāreṇa śaśvatā tanā ||

translations.english: The daughter of the Sun purifies your gushing streams through the eternal outstretched hair.

mantras.sanskrit: तमीमण्वीः समर्य आ गृभ्णन्ति योषणो दश । स्वसारः पार्ये दिवि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamīmaṇvīḥ samarya ā gṛbhṇanti yoṣaṇo daśa | svasāraḥ pārye divi ||

translations.english: The ten sister-fingers seize you in the sacrifice, on the final day (of the oblation).

mantras.sanskrit: तमीं हिन्वन्त्यग्रुवो धमन्ति बाकुरं दृतिम् । त्रिधातु वारणं मधु ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamīṃ hinvantyagruvo dhamanti bākuraṃ dṛtim | tridhātu vāraṇaṃ madhu ||

translations.english: The fingers press the Soma, they squeeze it glittering like a water-skin; its juice becomes threefold, enemy-averting.

mantras.sanskrit: अभीममघ्न्या उत श्रीणन्ति धेनवः शिशुम् । सोममिन्द्राय पातवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhīmamaghnyā uta śrīṇanti dhenavaḥ śiśum | somamindrāya pātave ||

translations.english: The inviolable kine mingle this fresh Soma with their milk for Indra to drink.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्येदिन्द्रो मदेष्वा विश्वा वृत्राणि जिघ्नते । शूरो मघा च मंहते ॥
mantras.transliteration: asyedindro madeṣvā viśvā vṛtrāṇi jighnate | śūro maghā ca maṃhate ||

translations.english: In the exhilaration of this draught the hero Indra smites all his enemies and bestows wealth (on his worshippers).

mantras.sanskrit: पवस्व देववीरति पवित्रं सोम रंह्या । इन्द्रमिन्दो वृषा विश ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavasva devavīrati pavitraṃ soma raṃhyā | indramindo vṛṣā viśa ||

translations.english: Flow on, Soma, seeking the gods, hastening on in your purifying course; enter Indra, O Indu, the showerer.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वच्यस्व महि प्सरो वृषेन्दो द्युम्नवत्तमः । आ योनिं धर्णसिः सदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vacyasva mahi psaro vṛṣendo dyumnavattamaḥ | ā yoniṃ dharṇasiḥ sadaḥ ||

translations.english: O Indu, do you, the mighty showerer (of blessings) most glorious upholder, send us food, and sit down in yours own plural ce.

mantras.sanskrit: अधुक्षत प्रियं मधु धारा सुतस्य वेधसः । अपो वसिष्ट सुक्रतुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhukṣata priyaṃ madhu dhārā sutasya vedhasaḥ | apo vasiṣṭa sukratuḥ ||

translations.english: The stream of effused creative Soma milks out the joy-giving ambrosia; the accomplisher of holy rites veils itself in the waters.

mantras.sanskrit: महान्तं त्वा महीरन्वापो अर्षन्ति सिन्धवः । यद्गोभिर्वासयिष्यसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahāntaṃ tvā mahīranvāpo arṣanti sindhavaḥ | yadgobhirvāsayiṣyase ||

translations.english: (Som), when you will veil yourself in the milk, the mighty streaming waters flow to you, the mighty one.

mantras.sanskrit: समुद्रो अप्सु मामृजे विष्टम्भो धरुणो दिवः । सोमः पवित्रे अस्मयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samudro apsu māmṛje viṣṭambho dharuṇo divaḥ | somaḥ pavitre asmayuḥ ||

translations.english: The juice-distilling Soma, the sustainer, the supporter of heaven, is purified in the water-- favouring us, (it is poured) into the straining cloth.

mantras.sanskrit: अचिक्रदद्वृषा हरिर्महान्मित्रो न दर्शतः । सं सूर्येण रोचते ॥
mantras.transliteration: acikradadvṛṣā harirmahānmitro na darśataḥ | saṃ sūryeṇa rocate ||

translations.english: The mighty golden-hued showerer of blessings utters a sound as it drops, beautiful as a friend; it shines (in the heavens) with the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: गिरस्त इन्द ओजसा मर्मृज्यन्ते अपस्युवः । याभिर्मदाय शुम्भसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: girasta inda ojasā marmṛjyante apasyuvaḥ | yābhirmadāya śumbhase ||

translations.english: O Indu, by the power the busy voices are hallowed which adorn you as you drop for our exhilaratioṇ

mantras.sanskrit: तं त्वा मदाय घृष्वय उ लोककृत्नुमीमहे । तव प्रशस्तयो महीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ tvā madāya ghṛṣvaya u lokakṛtnumīmahe | tava praśastayo mahīḥ ||

translations.english: We ask you for exhilaration, you the giver of the highest world to your foe-crushing worshipper-- great are your praises.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मभ्यमिन्दविन्द्रयुर्मध्वः पवस्व धारया । पर्जन्यो वृष्टिमाँ इव ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmabhyamindavindrayurmadhvaḥ pavasva dhārayā | parjanyo vṛṣṭimā~ iva ||

translations.english: Indu, do you, longing for Indra, stream upon us with a shower of ambrosia, like a raining cloud.

mantras.sanskrit: गोषा इन्दो नृषा अस्यश्वसा वाजसा उत । आत्मा यज्ञस्य पूर्व्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: goṣā indo nṛṣā asyaśvasā vājasā uta | ātmā yajñasya pūrvyaḥ ||

translations.english: Indu, you are the giver of kine, of children, of horses, and of food; you are the primeval soul of the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: एष देवो अमर्त्यः पर्णवीरिव दीयति । अभि द्रोणान्यासदम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa devo amartyaḥ parṇavīriva dīyati | abhi droṇānyāsadam ||

translations.english: This divine immortal (Soma) hastens as a bird to settle on the sacrificial vessels.

mantras.sanskrit: एष देवो विपा कृतोऽति ह्वरांसि धावति । पवमानो अदाभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa devo vipā kṛto'ti hvarāṃsi dhāvati | pavamāno adābhyaḥ ||

translations.english: This divine (Soma), expressed by the fingers, and dropping inviolable, rushes against the enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: एष देवो विपन्युभिः पवमान ऋतायुभिः । हरिर्वाजाय मृज्यते ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa devo vipanyubhiḥ pavamāna ṛtāyubhiḥ | harirvājāya mṛjyate ||

translations.english: This divine (Soma), as it drops, is adorned (with hymns) by the sacrifice-desiring priests as a horse for battle.

mantras.sanskrit: एष विश्वानि वार्या शूरो यन्निव सत्वभिः । पवमानः सिषासति ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa viśvāni vāryā śūro yanniva satvabhiḥ | pavamānaḥ siṣāsati ||

translations.english: This strong one, as it drops, seems to encompass all desirable things with its power and seeks to bestow them upon us.

mantras.sanskrit: एष देवो रथर्यति पवमानो दशस्यति । आविष्कृणोति वग्वनुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa devo ratharyati pavamāno daśasyati | āviṣkṛṇoti vagvanum ||

translations.english: This divine (Soma), as it drops, prepares its chariot (to come to us); it flings us our boons, it utters a sound.

mantras.sanskrit: एष विप्रैरभिष्टुतोऽपो देवो वि गाहते । दधद्रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa viprairabhiṣṭuto'po devo vi gāhate | dadhadratnāni dāśuṣe ||

translations.english: This divine (Soma), praised by the priests and giving wealth to the worshipper, plural nges into the waters.

mantras.sanskrit: एष दिवं वि धावति तिरो रजांसि धारया । पवमानः कनिक्रदत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa divaṃ vi dhāvati tiro rajāṃsi dhārayā | pavamānaḥ kanikradat ||

translations.english: Making a sound as it drops in a continued stream it rushes across the worlds into heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: एष दिवं व्यासरत्तिरो रजांस्यस्पृतः । पवमानः स्वध्वरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa divaṃ vyāsarattiro rajāṃsyaspṛtaḥ | pavamānaḥ svadhvaraḥ ||

translations.english: As it drops, completing the sacrifice, it passes across the worlds in inviolable to heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: एष प्रत्नेन जन्मना देवो देवेभ्यः सुतः । हरिः पवित्रे अर्षति ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa pratnena janmanā devo devebhyaḥ sutaḥ | hariḥ pavitre arṣati ||

translations.english: Divine and expressed for the gods by an ancient birth, the golden-hued (Soma) flows in the straining cloth.

mantras.sanskrit: एष उ स्य पुरुव्रतो जज्ञानो जनयन्निषः । धारया पवते सुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa u sya puruvrato jajñāno janayanniṣaḥ | dhārayā pavate sutaḥ ||

translations.english: Produced at our rite and producing abundant food the Soma, efficacious in sacrifices, flows effused in a stream.

mantras.sanskrit: सना च सोम जेषि च पवमान महि श्रवः । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: sanā ca soma jeṣi ca pavamāna mahi śravaḥ | athā no vasyasaskṛdhi ||

translations.english: Pure-dropping (Soma), bounteous food, welcome (the gods at our rite) and overcome (the demons); and make us happy.

mantras.sanskrit: सना ज्योतिः सना स्वर्विश्वा च सोम सौभगा । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: sanā jyotiḥ sanā svarviśvā ca soma saubhagā | athā no vasyasaskṛdhi ||

translations.english: Soma, give us brightness, give us heaven, give us all good things; and make us happy.

mantras.sanskrit: सना दक्षमुत क्रतुमप सोम मृधो जहि । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: sanā dakṣamuta kratumapa soma mṛdho jahi | athā no vasyasaskṛdhi ||

translations.english: Soma, give us strength, give us wisdom, drive away our enemies; and make us happy.

mantras.sanskrit: पवीतारः पुनीतन सोममिन्द्राय पातवे । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavītāraḥ punītana somamindrāya pātave | athā no vasyasaskṛdhi ||

translations.english: Priests, press out the Soma for Indra to drink; (O Soma), make us happy.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं सूर्ये न आ भज तव क्रत्वा तवोतिभिः । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ sūrye na ā bhaja tava kratvā tavotibhiḥ | athā no vasyasaskṛdhi ||

translations.english: Do you, (O Soma), by your power and your protections bring us to the sun, and make us happy.

mantras.sanskrit: तव क्रत्वा तवोतिभिर्ज्योक्पश्येम सूर्यम् । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava kratvā tavotibhirjyokpaśyema sūryam | athā no vasyasaskṛdhi ||

translations.english: The pure-flowing (Soma) longs for the fair-formed wide-reaching mighty Night and Dawn not yet visible.

mantras.sanskrit: अभ्यर्ष स्वायुध सोम द्विबर्हसं रयिम् । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhyarṣa svāyudha soma dvibarhasaṃ rayim | athā no vasyasaskṛdhi ||

translations.english: Bright-weaponed Soma, shower upon us wealth abundant for both worlds; and make us happy.

mantras.sanskrit: अभ्यर्षानपच्युतो रयिं समत्सु सासहिः । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhyarṣānapacyuto rayiṃ samatsu sāsahiḥ | athā no vasyasaskṛdhi ||

translations.english: O you who are unvanquished in battle, smitter of enemies, shower wealth upon us, and make us happy.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वां यज्ञैरवीवृधन्पवमान विधर्मणि । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāṃ yajñairavīvṛdhanpavamāna vidharmaṇi | athā no vasyasaskṛdhi ||

translations.english: Pure-dropping (Soma), they glorify you with the holy rites for their own upholding make us happy.

mantras.sanskrit: रयिं नश्चित्रमश्विनमिन्दो विश्वायुमा भर । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: rayiṃ naścitramaśvinamindo viśvāyumā bhara | athā no vasyasaskṛdhi ||

translations.english: Indu, bring to us varied wealth, abundant in horses and all-reaching, and make us happy.
