mantras.sanskrit: समिद्धो विश्वतस्पतिः पवमानो वि राजति । प्रीणन्वृषा कनिक्रदत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: samiddho viśvataspatiḥ pavamāno vi rājati | prīṇanvṛṣā kanikradat ||

translations.english: The pure-flowing (Soma) shines forth in its brightness, the universal lord, the showerer of blessings, the rejoicer, uttering a loud sound.

mantras.sanskrit: तनूनपात्पवमानः शृङ्गे शिशानो अर्षति । अन्तरिक्षेण रारजत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tanūnapātpavamānaḥ śṛṅge śiśāno arṣati | antarikṣeṇa rārajat ||

translations.english: The pure-flowing Tanūnapāt, rushes sharpening its splendour on the height and hastens through the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: ईळेन्यः पवमानो रयिर्वि राजति द्युमान् । मधोर्धाराभिरोजसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: īḷenyaḥ pavamāno rayirvi rājati dyumān | madhordhārābhirojasā ||

translations.english: The pure-flowing bright (Soma), the bounteous giver, worthy of all praise, shines forth in its might with the streams of water.

mantras.sanskrit: बर्हिः प्राचीनमोजसा पवमानः स्तृणन्हरिः । देवेषु देव ईयते ॥
mantras.transliteration: barhiḥ prācīnamojasā pavamānaḥ stṛṇanhariḥ | deveṣu deva īyate ||

translations.english: The bright golden-hued pure-flowing one rushes in its might, strewing the sacred grass in the sacrifice with its points towards the cast.

mantras.sanskrit: उदातैर्जिहते बृहद्द्वारो देवीर्हिरण्ययीः । पवमानेन सुष्टुताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: udātairjihate bṛhaddvāro devīrhiraṇyayīḥ | pavamānena suṣṭutāḥ ||

translations.english: The bright golden doors, praised by the priests together with the Soma, rise up from the vast horizon.

mantras.sanskrit: सुशिल्पे बृहती मही पवमानो वृषण्यति । नक्तोषासा न दर्शते ॥
mantras.transliteration: suśilpe bṛhatī mahī pavamāno vṛṣaṇyati | naktoṣāsā na darśate ||

translations.english: The pure-flowing (Soma) longs for the fair-formed wide-reaching mighty Night and Dawn not yet visible.

mantras.sanskrit: उभा देवा नृचक्षसा होतारा दैव्या हुवे । पवमान इन्द्रो वृषा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ubhā devā nṛcakṣasā hotārā daivyā huve | pavamāna indro vṛṣā ||

translations.english: I  invoke the two divine priests, the two deities who behold men-- the pure-flowing (Soma) is radiant and the showerer (of benefits).

mantras.sanskrit: भारती पवमानस्य सरस्वतीळा मही । इमं नो यज्ञमा गमन्तिस्रो देवीः सुपेशसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhāratī pavamānasya sarasvatīḷā mahī | imaṃ no yajñamā gamantisro devīḥ supeśasaḥ ||

translations.english: May the three beautiful goddesses, Bhāratī, Sarasvatī, and mighty Iḷā, come to this our offering of the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वष्टारमग्रजां गोपां पुरोयावानमा हुवे । इन्दुरिन्द्रो वृषा हरिः पवमानः प्रजापतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṣṭāramagrajāṃ gopāṃ puroyāvānamā huve | indurindro vṛṣā hariḥ pavamānaḥ prajāpatiḥ ||

translations.english: I invoke Tvaṣṭā, the first-born, the protector, the leader; the golden-coloured pure-flowing Indu is Indra, the showerer, the lord of all creatures.

mantras.sanskrit: वनस्पतिं पवमान मध्वा समङ्ग्धि धारया । सहस्रवल्शं हरितं भ्राजमानं हिरण्ययम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vanaspatiṃ pavamāna madhvā samaṅgdhi dhārayā | sahasravalśaṃ haritaṃ bhrājamānaṃ hiraṇyayam ||

translations.english: Pure Soma, consecrate with your streaming ambrosia the green bright golden-hued Vanaspati with its thousand branches.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वे देवाः स्वाहाकृतिं पवमानस्या गत । वायुर्बृहस्पतिः सूर्योऽग्निरिन्द्रः सजोषसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśve devāḥ svāhākṛtiṃ pavamānasyā gata | vāyurbṛhaspatiḥ sūryo'gnirindraḥ sajoṣasaḥ ||

translations.english: O all ye gods, come together to the consecration of the Soma-- Vāyu, Bṛhaspati, Sūrya, Agni and Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: मन्द्रया सोम धारया वृषा पवस्व देवयुः । अव्यो वारेष्वस्मयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mandrayā soma dhārayā vṛṣā pavasva devayuḥ | avyo vāreṣvasmayuḥ ||

translations.english: Soma, who is the showerer (of benefits), devoted to the gods, favourable to us, flow with your exhilarating stream into the woollen sieve.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि त्यं मद्यं मदमिन्दविन्द्र इति क्षर । अभि वाजिनो अर्वतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi tyaṃ madyaṃ madamindavindra iti kṣara | abhi vājino arvataḥ ||

translations.english: Indu,do you, as sovereign, effuse that exhilarating juice, and pour forth vigorous steeds.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि त्यं पूर्व्यं मदं सुवानो अर्ष पवित्र आ । अभि वाजमुत श्रवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi tyaṃ pūrvyaṃ madaṃ suvāno arṣa pavitra ā | abhi vājamuta śravaḥ ||

translations.english: Rain out through the filter, while pressed that ancient exhilarating fluid, and pour us forth strength and food.

mantras.sanskrit: अनु द्रप्सास इन्दव आपो न प्रवतासरन् । पुनाना इन्द्रमाशत ॥
mantras.transliteration: anu drapsāsa indava āpo na pravatāsaran | punānā indramāśata ||

translations.english: The quickly-falling drops, as they filter, follow Indra and reach him, like waters rushing down a declivity.

mantras.sanskrit: यमत्यमिव वाजिनं मृजन्ति योषणो दश । वने क्रीळन्तमत्यविम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yamatyamiva vājinaṃ mṛjanti yoṣaṇo daśa | vane krīḷantamatyavim ||

translations.english: That which sporting in the wood and spurting beyond the sieve, the ten sisters press, as (men rub down) a strong horse.

mantras.sanskrit: तं गोभिर्वृषणं रसं मदाय देववीतये । सुतं भराय सं सृज ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ gobhirvṛṣaṇaṃ rasaṃ madāya devavītaye | sutaṃ bharāya saṃ sṛja ||

translations.english: That desire-showring liquor, effused for the drink of the gods and for our exhilaration, mix with milk for prowess in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: देवो देवाय धारयेन्द्राय पवते सुतः । पयो यदस्य पीपयत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: devo devāya dhārayendrāya pavate sutaḥ | payo yadasya pīpayat ||

translations.english: The divine Soma, when effused, flows to the divine Indra in a stream, since its milk flattens him.

mantras.sanskrit: आत्मा यज्ञस्य रंह्या सुष्वाणः पवते सुतः । प्रत्नं नि पाति काव्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ātmā yajñasya raṃhyā suṣvāṇaḥ pavate sutaḥ | pratnaṃ ni pāti kāvyam ||

translations.english: The soul of the sacrifice, the effused Soma, flows; with speed bringing blessings, and maintains his ancient seer-hood.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा पुनान इन्द्रयुर्मदं मदिष्ठ वीतये । गुहा चिद्दधिषे गिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā punāna indrayurmadaṃ madiṣṭha vītaye | guhā ciddadhiṣe giraḥ ||

translations.english: Most exciting (Soma), devoted to Indra, as you pour forth the exhilarating juice for his drinking, you emit sounds in the secret (hall of sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: असृग्रमिन्दवः पथा धर्मन्नृतस्य सुश्रियः । विदाना अस्य योजनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asṛgramindavaḥ pathā dharmannṛtasya suśriyaḥ | vidānā asya yojanam ||

translations.english: The excellent streams (of the Soma), feeling a union with Indra, flow forth in the ceremony by the path of sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र धारा मध्वो अग्रियो महीरपो वि गाहते । हविर्हविष्षु वन्द्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra dhārā madhvo agriyo mahīrapo vi gāhate | havirhaviṣṣu vandyaḥ ||

translations.english: That which is to be praised as the oblation among oblations is immersed in the great (holy) waters, the stream of honey, the pre-eminent.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र युजो वाचो अग्रियो वृषाव चक्रदद्वने । सद्माभि सत्यो अध्वरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra yujo vāco agriyo vṛṣāva cakradadvane | sadmābhi satyo adhvaraḥ ||

translations.english: The pre-eminent (Soma), the showerer of benefits, the truthful, the indestructible, utters continuous sounds in the water, towards the sacrificial hall.

mantras.sanskrit: परि यत्काव्या कविर्नृम्णा वसानो अर्षति । स्वर्वाजी सिषासति ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari yatkāvyā kavirnṛmṇā vasāno arṣati | svarvājī siṣāsati ||

translations.english: When the seer (Soma), wearing ample treasures, goes round the praises (of his worshippers), then the mighty (Indra) in heaven is eager to repair to the oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: पवमानो अभि स्पृधो विशो राजेव सीदति । यदीमृण्वन्ति वेधसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamāno abhi spṛdho viśo rājeva sīdati | yadīmṛṇvanti vedhasaḥ ||

translations.english: When the priests excite it, the flowing Soma like a king destroys opposing (demons and) men.

mantras.sanskrit: अव्यो वारे परि प्रियो हरिर्वनेषु सीदति । रेभो वनुष्यते मती ॥
mantras.transliteration: avyo vāre pari priyo harirvaneṣu sīdati | rebho vanuṣyate matī ||

translations.english: The green-tinted (Soma), dear to the gods, commingled with the water, sits down upon the woollen sieve, uttering a sound it is greeted by praise.

mantras.sanskrit: स वायुमिन्द्रमश्विना साकं मदेन गच्छति । रणा यो अस्य धर्मभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa vāyumindramaśvinā sākaṃ madena gacchati | raṇā yo asya dharmabhiḥ ||

translations.english: He who is assiduous in the functions of (providing and preparing) the Soma, goes with exhilaration to Vāyu, Indra and the Aśvins.

mantras.sanskrit: आ मित्रावरुणा भगं मध्वः पवन्त ऊर्मयः । विदाना अस्य शक्मभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā mitrāvaruṇā bhagaṃ madhvaḥ pavanta ūrmayaḥ | vidānā asya śakmabhiḥ ||

translations.english: The streams of the sweet Soma flow to Mitra and Varuṇa and to Bhaga; the worshippers knowing its (virtues are rewarded) with happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मभ्यं रोदसी रयिं मध्वो वाजस्य सातये । श्रवो वसूनि सं जितम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmabhyaṃ rodasī rayiṃ madhvo vājasya sātaye | śravo vasūni saṃ jitam ||

translations.english: Heaven and earth, for the acquisition of this exhilarating Soma food, win for us wealth, food and treasures.

mantras.sanskrit: एते सोमा अभि प्रियमिन्द्रस्य काममक्षरन् । वर्धन्तो अस्य वीर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ete somā abhi priyamindrasya kāmamakṣaran | vardhanto asya vīryam ||

translations.english: These Soma juices distil the dear desire of Indra, increasing his vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: पुनानासश्चमूषदो गच्छन्तो वायुमश्विना । ते नो धान्तु सुवीर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: punānāsaścamūṣado gacchanto vāyumaśvinā | te no dhāntu suvīryam ||

translations.english: Pure-flowing, filling the ladles, and proceeding to Vāyu and the Aśvins, may they sustain our energy.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य सोम राधसे पुनानो हार्दि चोदय । ऋतस्य योनिमासदम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrasya soma rādhase punāno hārdi codaya | ṛtasya yonimāsadam ||

translations.english: Soma, pure-flowing, desired for the gratification of Indra, do you impel him to sit in the plural ce of sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: मृजन्ति त्वा दश क्षिपो हिन्वन्ति सप्त धीतयः । अनु विप्रा अमादिषुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mṛjanti tvā daśa kṣipo hinvanti sapta dhītayaḥ | anu viprā amādiṣuḥ ||

translations.english: The ten fingers strain you, the seven priests caress you, the worshippers gladden you.

mantras.sanskrit: देवेभ्यस्त्वा मदाय कं सृजानमति मेष्यः । सं गोभिर्वासयामसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: devebhyastvā madāya kaṃ sṛjānamati meṣyaḥ | saṃ gobhirvāsayāmasi ||

translations.english: As you stream on the water and the woollen sieve, we wrap you up with milk for the exhilaration of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: पुनानः कलशेष्वा वस्त्राण्यरुषो हरिः । परि गव्यान्यव्यत ॥
mantras.transliteration: punānaḥ kalaśeṣvā vastrāṇyaruṣo hariḥ | pari gavyānyavyata ||

translations.english: Purified in the pitchers, radiant and green-tinted, the Soma puts on the raiment derived from the cow.

mantras.sanskrit: मघोन आ पवस्व नो जहि विश्वा अप द्विषः । इन्दो सखायमा विश ॥
mantras.transliteration: maghona ā pavasva no jahi viśvā apa dviṣaḥ | indo sakhāyamā viśa ||

translations.english: Flow to us, your wealthy (worshippers); destoy all our enemies; Indu, enter your friend.

mantras.sanskrit: वृष्टिं दिवः परि स्रव द्युम्नं पृथिव्या अधि । सहो नः सोम पृत्सु धाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣṭiṃ divaḥ pari srava dyumnaṃ pṛthivyā adhi | saho naḥ soma pṛtsu dhāḥ ||

translations.english: Pour down rain from heaven, and abundance upon the earth; uphold our strength, Soma, in battles.

mantras.sanskrit: नृचक्षसं त्वा वयमिन्द्रपीतं स्वर्विदम् । भक्षीमहि प्रजामिषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nṛcakṣasaṃ tvā vayamindrapītaṃ svarvidam | bhakṣīmahi prajāmiṣam ||

translations.english: (Adoring) you, the contemplator of men, the beverage of Indra and the knower of all things, may we be blessed with progeny and food.

mantras.sanskrit: परि प्रिया दिवः कविर्वयांसि नप्त्योर्हितः । सुवानो याति कविक्रतुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari priyā divaḥ kavirvayāṃsi naptyorhitaḥ | suvāno yāti kavikratuḥ ||

translations.english: The seer (Soma) having wise designs, when plural ced between the two boards and effused, proceeds to the stones which are most dear to heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रप्र क्षयाय पन्यसे जनाय जुष्टो अद्रुहे । वीत्यर्ष चनिष्ठया ॥
mantras.transliteration: prapra kṣayāya panyase janāya juṣṭo adruhe | vītyarṣa caniṣṭhayā ||

translations.english: Go forth in a most abundant stream, ample for his sustenance, to the guileless man, your own, who praises you

mantras.sanskrit: स सूनुर्मातरा शुचिर्जातो जाते अरोचयत् । महान्मही ऋतावृधा ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa sūnurmātarā śucirjāto jāte arocayat | mahānmahī ṛtāvṛdhā ||

translations.english: That mighty and pure son, when born, illumines his mighty parents (heaven and earth), the progenitors (of all things), the augmenters of the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: स सप्त धीतिभिर्हितो नद्यो अजिन्वदद्रुहः । या एकमक्षि वावृधुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa sapta dhītibhirhito nadyo ajinvadadruhaḥ | yā ekamakṣi vāvṛdhuḥ ||

translations.english: Effused by the fingers, (Soma) gladdens the seven guileless rivers, who have magnified him one and undecaying.

mantras.sanskrit: ता अभि सन्तमस्तृतं महे युवानमा दधुः । इन्दुमिन्द्र तव व्रते ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā abhi santamastṛtaṃ mahe yuvānamā dadhuḥ | indumindra tava vrate ||

translations.english: Indra, at your worship, they (the fingers) have provided the present, indestructible, and ever-youthful Indu, for your solemn service.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि वह्निरमर्त्यः सप्त पश्यति वावहिः । क्रिविर्देवीरतर्पयत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi vahniramartyaḥ sapta paśyati vāvahiḥ | krivirdevīratarpayat ||

translations.english: The immortal bearer (of the oblation), the conveyer (of content to the gods), beholds the seven rivers, full as a well, he has satisfied the divine streams.

mantras.sanskrit: अवा कल्पेषु नः पुमस्तमांसि सोम योध्या । तानि पुनान जङ्घनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: avā kalpeṣu naḥ pumastamāṃsi soma yodhyā | tāni punāna jaṅghanaḥ ||

translations.english: Protect us, manly Soma, in the days of sacrifice purifier, destroy those powers of darkness against which we must contend.

mantras.sanskrit: नू नव्यसे नवीयसे सूक्ताय साधया पथः । प्रत्नवद्रोचया रुचः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū navyase navīyase sūktāya sādhayā pathaḥ | pratnavadrocayā rucaḥ ||

translations.english: Quickly speed on the road for our new praiseworthy hymn; as of old, display your radiance.

mantras.sanskrit: पवमान महि श्रवो गामश्वं रासि वीरवत् । सना मेधां सना स्वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamāna mahi śravo gāmaśvaṃ rāsi vīravat | sanā medhāṃ sanā svaḥ ||

translations.english: Purifier (Soma), you grant us abundant food with male off-spring, and cattle and horses; give us understanding, give us all (we desire).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र स्वानासो रथा इवार्वन्तो न श्रवस्यवः । सोमासो राये अक्रमुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra svānāso rathā ivārvanto na śravasyavaḥ | somāso rāye akramuḥ ||

translations.english: Longing for food the Soma juices, uttering a sound like chariots or like horses, have come for the sake of riches.

mantras.sanskrit: हिन्वानासो रथा इव दधन्विरे गभस्त्योः । भरासः कारिणामिव ॥
mantras.transliteration: hinvānāso rathā iva dadhanvire gabhastyoḥ | bharāsaḥ kāriṇāmiva ||

translations.english: Coming like chariots (to the sacrifice), they are upheld in the arms (of the priests) as burdens (in the arms) of labourers.

mantras.sanskrit: राजानो न प्रशस्तिभिः सोमासो गोभिरञ्जते । यज्ञो न सप्त धातृभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: rājāno na praśastibhiḥ somāso gobhirañjate | yajño na sapta dhātṛbhiḥ ||

translations.english: The libations are anointed with milk as kings with praises, and (tended) as a sacrifice by seven priests.

mantras.sanskrit: परि सुवानास इन्दवो मदाय बर्हणा गिरा । सुता अर्षन्ति धारया ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari suvānāsa indavo madāya barhaṇā girā | sutā arṣanti dhārayā ||

translations.english: The Soma juices, when poured forth, are effused with loud praise, and proceed in a stream to excite exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: आपानासो विवस्वतो जनन्त उषसो भगम् । सूरा अण्वं वि तन्वते ॥
mantras.transliteration: āpānāso vivasvato jananta uṣaso bhagam | sūrā aṇvaṃ vi tanvate ||

translations.english: The beverages of Vivasvat and producing the glory of the dawn, the issuing juices spread their sound.

mantras.sanskrit: अप द्वारा मतीनां प्रत्ना ऋण्वन्ति कारवः । वृष्णो हरस आयवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: apa dvārā matīnāṃ pratnā ṛṇvanti kāravaḥ | vṛṣṇo harasa āyavaḥ ||

translations.english: The old makers of hymns, men the offerers of the Soma, throw open the doors (of the sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: समीचीनास आसते होतारः सप्तजामयः । पदमेकस्य पिप्रतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samīcīnāsa āsate hotāraḥ saptajāmayaḥ | padamekasya piprataḥ ||

translations.english: The seven associated ministers like so many kinsmen filling the receptacle of the single (Soma), sit down (at the sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: नाभा नाभिं न आ ददे चक्षुश्चित्सूर्ये सचा । कवेरपत्यमा दुहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: nābhā nābhiṃ na ā dade cakṣuścitsūrye sacā | kaverapatyamā duhe ||

translations.english: I take into my navel the navel of the sacrifice, my becomes associated with the sun, I fill the offspring of the sage.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि प्रिया दिवस्पदमध्वर्युभिर्गुहा हितम् । सूरः पश्यति चक्षसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi priyā divaspadamadhvaryubhirguhā hitam | sūraḥ paśyati cakṣasā ||

translations.english: The powerful (Indra) looks with the eye of his own resplendent self on the acceptable plural ce of the Soma, fixed by the priests in the heart.

mantras.sanskrit: उपास्मै गायता नरः पवमानायेन्दवे । अभि देवाँ इयक्षते ॥
mantras.transliteration: upāsmai gāyatā naraḥ pavamānāyendave | abhi devā~ iyakṣate ||

translations.english: Sing, leaders of rites, to this pure-flowing, Indu, who is desirous of offering worship to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि ते मधुना पयोऽथर्वाणो अशिश्रयुः । देवं देवाय देवयु ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi te madhunā payo'tharvāṇo aśiśrayuḥ | devaṃ devāya devayu ||

translations.english: The Atharvāṇa have mixed with sweet milk for the deity (Indra) your divine and god-devoted (juice).

mantras.sanskrit: स नः पवस्व शं गवे शं जनाय शमर्वते । शं राजन्नोषधीभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa naḥ pavasva śaṃ gave śaṃ janāya śamarvate | śaṃ rājannoṣadhībhyaḥ ||

translations.english: Radiant (Soma), do you pour prosperity upon our cattle, upon our people, upon our horses, and upon our plural nts.

mantras.sanskrit: बभ्रवे नु स्वतवसेऽरुणाय दिविस्पृशे । सोमाय गाथमर्चत ॥
mantras.transliteration: babhrave nu svatavase'ruṇāya divispṛśe | somāya gāthamarcata ||

translations.english: Recite praises to the brown-coloured self-vigorous (at times) red heaven-touching Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: हस्तच्युतेभिरद्रिभिः सुतं सोमं पुनीतन । मधावा धावता मधु ॥
mantras.transliteration: hastacyutebhiradribhiḥ sutaṃ somaṃ punītana | madhāvā dhāvatā madhu ||

translations.english: Purify the Soma which has been effused by the stones whirled by the hands; mix the sweet (milk) in the inebriating juice.

mantras.sanskrit: नमसेदुप सीदत दध्नेदभि श्रीणीतन । इन्दुमिन्द्रे दधातन ॥
mantras.transliteration: namasedupa sīdata dadhnedabhi śrīṇītana | indumindre dadhātana ||

translations.english: Approach with reverence, mix (the libation) with the curds, offer the Soma to Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: अमित्रहा विचर्षणिः पवस्व सोम शं गवे । देवेभ्यो अनुकामकृत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: amitrahā vicarṣaṇiḥ pavasva soma śaṃ gave | devebhyo anukāmakṛt ||

translations.english: Soma, slayer of our enemies, the wise one, the fulfiller of the desires of the gods, do you shed prosperity on our cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राय सोम पातवे मदाय परि षिच्यसे । मनश्चिन्मनसस्पतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāya soma pātave madāya pari ṣicyase | manaścinmanasaspatiḥ ||

translations.english: Soma, who are cognizant of the mind, lord of the mind, you are poured forth for Indra to drink for his exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: पवमान सुवीर्यं रयिं सोम रिरीहि नः । इन्दविन्द्रेण नो युजा ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamāna suvīryaṃ rayiṃ soma rirīhi naḥ | indavindreṇa no yujā ||

translations.english: Pure-dropping Soma, grant us wealth with excellent male offspring, grant it to us, Indu, with Indra as our ally.

mantras.sanskrit: सोमा असृग्रमिन्दवः सुता ऋतस्य सादने । इन्द्राय मधुमत्तमाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: somā asṛgramindavaḥ sutā ṛtasya sādane | indrāya madhumattamāḥ ||

translations.english: The most sweet-flavoured Soma libations are poured forth to Indra in the hall of sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि विप्रा अनूषत गावो वत्सं न मातरः । इन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi viprā anūṣata gāvo vatsaṃ na mātaraḥ | indraṃ somasya pītaye ||

translations.english: The wise (priests) call upon Indra to drink the Soma as the mother low to their calves.

mantras.sanskrit: मदच्युत्क्षेति सादने सिन्धोरूर्मा विपश्चित् । सोमो गौरी अधि श्रितः ॥
mantras.transliteration: madacyutkṣeti sādane sindhorūrmā vipaścit | somo gaurī adhi śritaḥ ||

translations.english: The wise soma, the bestower of exhilaration, dwells in the hall of (sacrifice), mixed with the waves of the river to a chant in the middle tone.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवो नाभा विचक्षणोऽव्यो वारे महीयते । सोमो यः सुक्रतुः कविः ॥
mantras.transliteration: divo nābhā vicakṣaṇo'vyo vāre mahīyate | somo yaḥ sukratuḥ kaviḥ ||

translations.english: Soma, the observant, who is the wise seer, is worshipped in the navel of the sky, the woollen filter.

mantras.sanskrit: यः सोमः कलशेष्वाँ अन्तः पवित्र आहितः । तमिन्दुः परि षस्वजे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ somaḥ kalaśeṣvā~ antaḥ pavitra āhitaḥ | taminduḥ pari ṣasvaje ||

translations.english: Indu has embraced that Soma which is collected in the sewers and has been passed through the filter.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वाचमिन्दुरिष्यति समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपि । जिन्वन्कोशं मधुश्चुतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vācaminduriṣyati samudrasyādhi viṣṭapi | jinvankośaṃ madhuścutam ||

translations.english: Indu emits a sound, abiding in the firmament of the sky, and delighting the nectar-shedding cloud.

mantras.sanskrit: नित्यस्तोत्रो वनस्पतिर्धीनामन्तः सबर्दुघः । हिन्वानो मानुषा युगा ॥
mantras.transliteration: nityastotro vanaspatirdhīnāmantaḥ sabardughaḥ | hinvāno mānuṣā yugā ||

translations.english: Soma, whose praise is eternal, the lord of forests, the shedder of nectar, and rejoicing the genitive rations of men, (is present) in the midst of our sacred rites.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि प्रिया दिवस्पदा सोमो हिन्वानो अर्षति । विप्रस्य धारया कविः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi priyā divaspadā somo hinvāno arṣati | viprasya dhārayā kaviḥ ||

translations.english: The sage Soma, urged from heaven, flows in a stream to the beloved abodes of his devout (worshipper).

mantras.sanskrit: आ पवमान धारय रयिं सहस्रवर्चसम् । अस्मे इन्दो स्वाभुवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā pavamāna dhāraya rayiṃ sahasravarcasam | asme indo svābhuvam ||

translations.english: Purifying Indu, bestow upon us wealth of a thousand radiances, excelent in its nature.

mantras.sanskrit: सोमः पुनानो अर्षति सहस्रधारो अत्यविः । वायोरिन्द्रस्य निष्कृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: somaḥ punāno arṣati sahasradhāro atyaviḥ | vāyorindrasya niṣkṛtam ||

translations.english: The purifying Soma, flowing in a thousand streams and passing through the woollen filter, proceeds to the prepared vessel for Vāyu and Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: पवमानमवस्यवो विप्रमभि प्र गायत । सुष्वाणं देववीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamānamavasyavo vipramabhi pra gāyata | suṣvāṇaṃ devavītaye ||

translations.english: Sing aloud, you who are desirous of (divine) protection to he purifying wise Soma, effused for the beverage of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: पवन्ते वाजसातये सोमाः सहस्रपाजसः । गृणाना देववीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavante vājasātaye somāḥ sahasrapājasaḥ | gṛṇānā devavītaye ||

translations.english: The Soma juices flow for the attainment of food, giving abundance of strength and hymned (to become) the beverage of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: उत नो वाजसातये पवस्व बृहतीरिषः । द्युमदिन्दो सुवीर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta no vājasātaye pavasva bṛhatīriṣaḥ | dyumadindo suvīryam ||

translations.english: You, Indu, for our attainment of food pour forth abundant streams, and splendid and excellent vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: ते नः सहस्रिणं रयिं पवन्तामा सुवीर्यम् । सुवाना देवास इन्दवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te naḥ sahasriṇaṃ rayiṃ pavantāmā suvīryam | suvānā devāsa indavaḥ ||

translations.english: May those divine libations, when effused, bring to us thousandfold wealth and excellent vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: अत्या हियाना न हेतृभिरसृग्रं वाजसातये । वि वारमव्यमाशवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: atyā hiyānā na hetṛbhirasṛgraṃ vājasātaye | vi vāramavyamāśavaḥ ||

translations.english: Like horses urged to battle by their drivers, the swift-flowing juices have (flown) through the woollen fleece.

mantras.sanskrit: वाश्रा अर्षन्तीन्दवोऽभि वत्सं न धेनवः । दधन्विरे गभस्त्योः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāśrā arṣantīndavo'bhi vatsaṃ na dhenavaḥ | dadhanvire gabhastyoḥ ||

translations.english: Making a loud noise, the libations flow (to the vessel) like cows lowing to their calves; they are held in the arms (of the priests).

mantras.sanskrit: जुष्ट इन्द्राय मत्सरः पवमान कनिक्रदत् । विश्वा अप द्विषो जहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: juṣṭa indrāya matsaraḥ pavamāna kanikradat | viśvā apa dviṣo jahi ||

translations.english: Acceptable and giving delight to Indra, pure (Soma), do you, as you utter a sound, destroy all our enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: अपघ्नन्तो अराव्णः पवमानाः स्वर्दृशः । योनावृतस्य सीदत ॥
mantras.transliteration: apaghnanto arāvṇaḥ pavamānāḥ svardṛśaḥ | yonāvṛtasya sīdata ||

translations.english: Pure (libations), beholding all things and destroying those who worship not, sit down in the plural ce of sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: परि प्रासिष्यदत्कविः सिन्धोरूर्मावधि श्रितः । कारं बिभ्रत्पुरुस्पृहम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari prāsiṣyadatkaviḥ sindhorūrmāvadhi śritaḥ | kāraṃ bibhratpuruspṛham ||

translations.english: The wise (Soma) flows widely round, be taking itself to the waves of the river, and uttering a sound desired by many.

mantras.sanskrit: गिरा यदी सबन्धवः पञ्च व्राता अपस्यवः । परिष्कृण्वन्ति धर्णसिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: girā yadī sabandhavaḥ pañca vrātā apasyavaḥ | pariṣkṛṇvanti dharṇasim ||

translations.english: When the five kindred sacrificing races, desirous of accomplishing pious rites, honour the sustaining (Soma) with their praise.

mantras.sanskrit: आदस्य शुष्मिणो रसे विश्वे देवा अमत्सत । यदी गोभिर्वसायते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ādasya śuṣmiṇo rase viśve devā amatsata | yadī gobhirvasāyate ||

translations.english: Then all the gods rejoice in the juice of this powerful (libation), when it is enveloped with milk and curds.

mantras.sanskrit: निरिणानो वि धावति जहच्छर्याणि तान्वा । अत्रा सं जिघ्नते युजा ॥
mantras.transliteration: niriṇāno vi dhāvati jahaccharyāṇi tānvā | atrā saṃ jighnate yujā ||

translations.english: Descending from the filters (into the vessel), and passing through the cloth's interstices, it becomes united in this (sacrifice) with its friend (Indra).

mantras.sanskrit: नप्तीभिर्यो विवस्वतः शुभ्रो न मामृजे युवा । गाः कृण्वानो न निर्णिजम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: naptībhiryo vivasvataḥ śubhro na māmṛje yuvā | gāḥ kṛṇvāno na nirṇijam ||

translations.english: He who is rubbed down by the grandchildren of the sacrificer like a handsome young (horse), and renders his form like the produce of the kine.

mantras.sanskrit: अति श्रिती तिरश्चता गव्या जिगात्यण्व्या । वग्नुमियर्ति यं विदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ati śritī tiraścatā gavyā jigātyaṇvyā | vagnumiyarti yaṃ vide ||

translations.english: Expressed by the finger, he proceeds obliquely to the produce of the cow to mix with it; it utters a sound which (the worshipper) recognizes.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि क्षिपः समग्मत मर्जयन्तीरिषस्पतिम् । पृष्ठा गृभ्णत वाजिनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi kṣipaḥ samagmata marjayantīriṣaspatim | pṛṣṭhā gṛbhṇata vājinaḥ ||

translations.english: The fingers combine expressing the lord of food (i.e., Soma), and they grasp the back of the vigorous (Soma).

mantras.sanskrit: परि दिव्यानि मर्मृशद्विश्वानि सोम पार्थिवा । वसूनि याह्यस्मयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari divyāni marmṛśadviśvāni soma pārthivā | vasūni yāhyasmayuḥ ||

translations.english: Soma, who hols all the treasures of heaven and earth, come favourably disposed to us.

mantras.sanskrit: एष धिया यात्यण्व्या शूरो रथेभिराशुभिः । गच्छन्निन्द्रस्य निष्कृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa dhiyā yātyaṇvyā śūro rathebhirāśubhiḥ | gacchannindrasya niṣkṛtam ||

translations.english: This heroic Soma expressed by the fingers proceeds by the sacrifice, hastening with swift chariots to Indra's above.

mantras.sanskrit: एष पुरू धियायते बृहते देवतातये । यत्रामृतास आसते ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa purū dhiyāyate bṛhate devatātaye | yatrāmṛtāsa āsate ||

translations.english: This Soma engages in many holy rites for the great sacrifice where the immortals sit.

mantras.sanskrit: एष हितो वि नीयतेऽन्तः शुभ्रावता पथा । यदी तुञ्जन्ति भूर्णयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa hito vi nīyate'ntaḥ śubhrāvatā pathā | yadī tuñjanti bhūrṇayaḥ ||

translations.english: plural ced (in the cart) he is brought by a brilliant path when the offerers of the libation present him.

mantras.sanskrit: एष शृङ्गाणि दोधुवच्छिशीते यूथ्यो वृषा । नृम्णा दधान ओजसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa śṛṅgāṇi dodhuvacchiśīte yūthyo vṛṣā | nṛmṇā dadhāna ojasā ||

translations.english: He tosses his horns as a bull, the lord of the herd, sharpens his, bearing treasures (for us) by his might.

mantras.sanskrit: एष रुक्मिभिरीयते वाजी शुभ्रेभिरंशुभिः । पतिः सिन्धूनां भवन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa rukmibhirīyate vājī śubhrebhiraṃśubhiḥ | patiḥ sindhūnāṃ bhavan ||

translations.english: He proceeds along impetuous with goldenbrilliant rays, the lord of streams.

mantras.sanskrit: एष वसूनि पिब्दना परुषा ययिवाँ अति । अव शादेषु गच्छति ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa vasūni pibdanā paruṣā yayivā~ ati | ava śādeṣu gacchati ||

translations.english: Overpowering at the juncture of time the discomfited concealers (the rākṣasas), he descends upon those doomed to destruction.

mantras.sanskrit: एतं मृजन्ति मर्ज्यमुप द्रोणेष्वायवः । प्रचक्राणं महीरिषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: etaṃ mṛjanti marjyamupa droṇeṣvāyavaḥ | pracakrāṇaṃ mahīriṣaḥ ||

translations.english: The priests express into the vessels this juice which is to be purified, the bestower of abundant food.

mantras.sanskrit: एतमु त्यं दश क्षिपो मृजन्ति सप्त धीतयः । स्वायुधं मदिन्तमम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: etamu tyaṃ daśa kṣipo mṛjanti sapta dhītayaḥ | svāyudhaṃ madintamam ||

translations.english: The ten fingers, the seven priests, express this (juice), well-weaponed, and yielding great exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ते सोतार ओण्यो रसं मदाय घृष्वये । सर्गो न तक्त्येतशः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra te sotāra oṇyo rasaṃ madāya ghṛṣvaye | sargo na taktyetaśaḥ ||

translations.english: They who express you, the juice of heaven and earth do it for the foe-destroying exhilaration (of Indra); your flow rushes as a swift horse.

mantras.sanskrit: क्रत्वा दक्षस्य रथ्यमपो वसानमन्धसा । गोषामण्वेषु सश्चिम ॥
mantras.transliteration: kratvā dakṣasya rathyamapo vasānamandhasā | goṣāmaṇveṣu saścima ||

translations.english: In pious rite by our fingers we mix with the milk (the Soma), the bringer of strength, the sender of kine, who envelopes the water.

mantras.sanskrit: अनप्तमप्सु दुष्टरं सोमं पवित्र आ सृज । पुनीहीन्द्राय पातवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: anaptamapsu duṣṭaraṃ somaṃ pavitra ā sṛja | punīhīndrāya pātave ||

translations.english: Cast into the filter the unassailable invincible (Soma), abiding in the waters (of the firmament) purify it for the drinking of Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र पुनानस्य चेतसा सोमः पवित्रे अर्षति । क्रत्वा सधस्थमासदत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra punānasya cetasā somaḥ pavitre arṣati | kratvā sadhasthamāsadat ||

translations.english: The Soma of him who is purified by worship flows upon the filter and settles in the plural ce common with the ceremony.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र त्वा नमोभिरिन्दव इन्द्र सोमा असृक्षत । महे भराय कारिणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra tvā namobhirindava indra somā asṛkṣata | mahe bharāya kāriṇaḥ ||

translations.english: The Soma juices flow to you, Indra, with praises, giving you vigour for the great conflict.

mantras.sanskrit: पुनानो रूपे अव्यये विश्वा अर्षन्नभि श्रियः । शूरो न गोषु तिष्ठति ॥
mantras.transliteration: punāno rūpe avyaye viśvā arṣannabhi śriyaḥ | śūro na goṣu tiṣṭhati ||

translations.english: Purified in his woollen robe, and attaining all honours he stands as a hero amidst the kine.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवो न सानु पिप्युषी धारा सुतस्य वेधसः । वृथा पवित्रे अर्षति ॥
mantras.transliteration: divo na sānu pipyuṣī dhārā sutasya vedhasaḥ | vṛthā pavitre arṣati ||

translations.english: As the lofty rain from heaven, the nutritious strream of the invogorating Soma falls easily upon the straining cloth.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं सोम विपश्चितं तना पुनान आयुषु । अव्यो वारं वि धावसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ soma vipaścitaṃ tanā punāna āyuṣu | avyo vāraṃ vi dhāvasi ||

translations.english: You, Soma, (process) the worshipper among men, and purified by the cloth you wander through the woollen filter.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र निम्नेनेव सिन्धवो घ्नन्तो वृत्राणि भूर्णयः । सोमा असृग्रमाशवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra nimneneva sindhavo ghnanto vṛtrāṇi bhūrṇayaḥ | somā asṛgramāśavaḥ ||

translations.english: Like rivers falling down a steep plural ce, so that rapid foe-destroying pervading Soma-streams hurry (to the pitcher).

mantras.sanskrit: अभि सुवानास इन्दवो वृष्टयः पृथिवीमिव । इन्द्रं सोमासो अक्षरन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi suvānāsa indavo vṛṣṭayaḥ pṛthivīmiva | indraṃ somāso akṣaran ||

translations.english: The Soma-drops, as they are expressed, flow to Indra like the rains falling upon the earth.

mantras.sanskrit: अत्यूर्मिर्मत्सरो मदः सोमः पवित्रे अर्षति । विघ्नन्रक्षांसि देवयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: atyūrmirmatsaro madaḥ somaḥ pavitre arṣati | vighnanrakṣāṃsi devayuḥ ||

translations.english: Soma, with swelling waves, exhilarating, inebriating, flows to the straining-cloth, destroying the rākṣasas, and devoted to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: आ कलशेषु धावति पवित्रे परि षिच्यते । उक्थैर्यज्ञेषु वर्धते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā kalaśeṣu dhāvati pavitre pari ṣicyate | ukthairyajñeṣu vardhate ||

translations.english: It flows to the pitchers, it is poured out upon the straining-cloth, it is magnified at sacrifices by praises.

mantras.sanskrit: अति त्री सोम रोचना रोहन्न भ्राजसे दिवम् । इष्णन्त्सूर्यं न चोदयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ati trī soma rocanā rohanna bhrājase divam | iṣṇantsūryaṃ na codayaḥ ||

translations.english: Soma, mounting beyond the three worlds, you illumine heaven, and moving, you urge on the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि विप्रा अनूषत मूर्धन्यज्ञस्य कारवः । दधानाश्चक्षसि प्रियम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi viprā anūṣata mūrdhanyajñasya kāravaḥ | dadhānāścakṣasi priyam ||

translations.english: The sage performers (of pious rites) glorify (the Soma) at the head of the sacrifice, entertaining affection for him the all-beholding.

mantras.sanskrit: तमु त्वा वाजिनं नरो धीभिर्विप्रा अवस्यवः । मृजन्ति देवतातये ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamu tvā vājinaṃ naro dhībhirviprā avasyavaḥ | mṛjanti devatātaye ||

translations.english: Sages, leaders of rites, desirous of sustenance, purify you who are the giver of food, with pious rites for the offering.

mantras.sanskrit: मधोर्धारामनु क्षर तीव्रः सधस्थमासदः । चारुॠताय पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: madhordhārāmanu kṣara tīvraḥ sadhasthamāsadaḥ | cāruṝtāya pītaye ||

translations.english: Pour forth the stream of the sweet beverage; sit down, sharp-flavoured in the receptacle, alert for drinking at the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: परि सुवानो गिरिष्ठाः पवित्रे सोमो अक्षाः । मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari suvāno giriṣṭhāḥ pavitre somo akṣāḥ | madeṣu sarvadhā asi ||

translations.english: Effused while pressed between the stones, the Soma flows upon the straining cloth; you are the giver of all things to those who praise you.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं विप्रस्त्वं कविर्मधु प्र जातमन्धसः । मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ viprastvaṃ kavirmadhu pra jātamandhasaḥ | madeṣu sarvadhā asi ||

translations.english: You are wise, you are a seer; you bestow the sweet (beverage) produced from the Soma; you are the giver of all things to those who praise you.

mantras.sanskrit: तव विश्वे सजोषसो देवासः पीतिमाशत । मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava viśve sajoṣaso devāsaḥ pītimāśata | madeṣu sarvadhā asi ||

translations.english: All the gods together plural ased enjoy your drinking; you are the giver of all things to those who praise you.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यो विश्वानि वार्या वसूनि हस्तयोर्दधे । मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yo viśvāni vāryā vasūni hastayordadhe | madeṣu sarvadhā asi ||

translations.english: (You are he) who plural ces in the hands (of the worshipper) all desirable riches, you are the giver of all things to those who praise you.

mantras.sanskrit: य इमे रोदसी मही सं मातरेव दोहते । मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya ime rodasī mahī saṃ mātareva dohate | madeṣu sarvadhā asi ||

translations.english: (You are he) who milks this great heaven and earth like two mothers; you are the giver of all things to those who praise you.

mantras.sanskrit: परि यो रोदसी उभे सद्यो वाजेभिरर्षति । मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari yo rodasī ubhe sadyo vājebhirarṣati | madeṣu sarvadhā asi ||

translations.english: (You are he) who at once supplies both heaven and earth with viands; you are the giver of all things to those who praise you.

mantras.sanskrit: स शुष्मी कलशेष्वा पुनानो अचिक्रदत् । मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa śuṣmī kalaśeṣvā punāno acikradat | madeṣu sarvadhā asi ||

translations.english: This vigorous Soma, while being purified, murmurs in the pitchers; you are the giver of all things to those who praise you.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्सोम चित्रमुक्थ्यं दिव्यं पार्थिवं वसु । तन्नः पुनान आ भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatsoma citramukthyaṃ divyaṃ pārthivaṃ vasu | tannaḥ punāna ā bhara ||

translations.english: Whatever wonderful glorious wealth there be in heaven or in earth, do you, Soma, being purified, bring it to us.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं हि स्थः स्वर्पती इन्द्रश्च सोम गोपती । ईशाना पिप्यतं धियः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ hi sthaḥ svarpatī indraśca soma gopatī | īśānā pipyataṃ dhiyaḥ ||

translations.english: You, Soma and Indra, are the lords of all the lords of cattle, do you, the rulers, prosper our rites.

mantras.sanskrit: वृषा पुनान आयुषु स्तनयन्नधि बर्हिषि । हरिः सन्योनिमासदत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣā punāna āyuṣu stanayannadhi barhiṣi | hariḥ sanyonimāsadat ||

translations.english: The showerer (of benefits) being purified among men (lies) murmuring upon the sacred grass, green-tinted he sits down in his proper plural ce.

mantras.sanskrit: अवावशन्त धीतयो वृषभस्याधि रेतसि । सूनोर्वत्सस्य मातरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: avāvaśanta dhītayo vṛṣabhasyādhi retasi | sūnorvatsasya mātaraḥ ||

translations.english: The mothers of the male calf, which are sucked by him, long to cherish the bull with their strength.

mantras.sanskrit: कुविद्वृषण्यन्तीभ्यः पुनानो गर्भमादधत् । याः शुक्रं दुहते पयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kuvidvṛṣaṇyantībhyaḥ punāno garbhamādadhat | yāḥ śukraṃ duhate payaḥ ||

translations.english: The purified Soma has implanted many a germ in those (waters) desirous of conception, which yield bright milk.

mantras.sanskrit: उप शिक्षापतस्थुषो भियसमा धेहि शत्रुषु । पवमान विदा रयिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa śikṣāpatasthuṣo bhiyasamā dhehi śatruṣu | pavamāna vidā rayim ||

translations.english: Bring near to us those who stand aloof, strike terror into our fores; pure-flowing one, you do transfer to us their riches.

mantras.sanskrit: नि शत्रोः सोम वृष्ण्यं नि शुष्मं नि वयस्तिर । दूरे वा सतो अन्ति वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni śatroḥ soma vṛṣṇyaṃ ni śuṣmaṃ ni vayastira | dūre vā sato anti vā ||

translations.english: Destroy, Soma, the vigour, the energy, the subsistence of our enemy, whether he be far off or nigh.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र कविर्देववीतयेऽव्यो वारेभिरर्षति । साह्वान्विश्वा अभि स्पृधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra kavirdevavītaye'vyo vārebhirarṣati | sāhvānviśvā abhi spṛdhaḥ ||

translations.english: The seer passes through the woollen fleece for the beverage of the gods, triumphing over all adversaries.

mantras.sanskrit: स हि ष्मा जरितृभ्य आ वाजं गोमन्तमिन्वति । पवमानः सहस्रिणम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa hi ṣmā jaritṛbhya ā vājaṃ gomantaminvati | pavamānaḥ sahasriṇam ||

translations.english: Verily he, the pure-flowing, bestows upon his praisers thousands of victuals with cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: परि विश्वानि चेतसा मृशसे पवसे मती । स नः सोम श्रवो विदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari viśvāni cetasā mṛśase pavase matī | sa naḥ soma śravo vidaḥ ||

translations.english: By the favour you give to us all kinds of wealth, you flow at our praise; grant us, O Soma, food.

mantras.sanskrit: अभ्यर्ष बृहद्यशो मघवद्भ्यो ध्रुवं रयिम् । इषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhyarṣa bṛhadyaśo maghavadbhyo dhruvaṃ rayim | iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||

translations.english: Bestow upon us great renown, grant durable riches to those who profuse in their libations, bring food to your praisers.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं राजेव सुव्रतो गिरः सोमा विवेशिथ । पुनानो वह्ने अद्भुत ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ rājeva suvrato giraḥ somā viveśitha | punāno vahne adbhuta ||

translations.english: Purified one, doer of good deeds, you, Soma, enter our praises like a king, O wonderful bearer (of our offerings).

mantras.sanskrit: स वह्निरप्सु दुष्टरो मृज्यमानो गभस्त्योः । सोमश्चमूषु सीदति ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa vahnirapsu duṣṭaro mṛjyamāno gabhastyoḥ | somaścamūṣu sīdati ||

translations.english: Soma, the bearer (of oblations), abiding in the waters of the firmament, difficult to be surpassed, being cleansed by our hands reposes in the vessels.

mantras.sanskrit: क्रीळुर्मखो न मंहयुः पवित्रं सोम गच्छसि । दधत्स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: krīḷurmakho na maṃhayuḥ pavitraṃ soma gacchasi | dadhatstotre suvīryam ||

translations.english: Soma, you proceed to the straining-cloth, sportive and genitive rous, like a gift, giving excellent vigour to him who praises you.

mantras.sanskrit: एते धावन्तीन्दवः सोमा इन्द्राय घृष्वयः । मत्सरासः स्वर्विदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ete dhāvantīndavaḥ somā indrāya ghṛṣvayaḥ | matsarāsaḥ svarvidaḥ ||

translations.english: These flowing Soma-juices, foe-destroying, exhilarating, heaven-conferring, have gone to Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रवृण्वन्तो अभियुजः सुष्वये वरिवोविदः । स्वयं स्तोत्रे वयस्कृतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pravṛṇvanto abhiyujaḥ suṣvaye varivovidaḥ | svayaṃ stotre vayaskṛtaḥ ||

translations.english: Showing favour, assailing foes, giving wealth to him who rightly effuses them, and bestowing food spontaneously on their praiser.

mantras.sanskrit: वृथा क्रीळन्त इन्दवः सधस्थमभ्येकमित् । सिन्धोरूर्मा व्यक्षरन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛthā krīḷanta indavaḥ sadhasthamabhyekamit | sindhorūrmā vyakṣaran ||

translations.english: The effused juices come sporting lightly to the common receptacle, they drop into the wave of the river.

mantras.sanskrit: एते विश्वानि वार्या पवमानास आशत । हिता न सप्तयो रथे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ete viśvāni vāryā pavamānāsa āśata | hitā na saptayo rathe ||

translations.english: Like horses harnessed to a car these pure juices bring (to us) all desirable blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: आस्मिन्पिशङ्गमिन्दवो दधाता वेनमादिशे । यो अस्मभ्यमरावा ॥
mantras.transliteration: āsminpiśaṅgamindavo dadhātā venamādiśe | yo asmabhyamarāvā ||

translations.english: Effused Soma-juices, at our indication, bestow manifold blessings on this (instrumental tutor of the sacrifice), who (at present) has given us nothing.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋभुर्न रथ्यं नवं दधाता केतमादिशे । शुक्राः पवध्वमर्णसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛbhurna rathyaṃ navaṃ dadhātā ketamādiśe | śukrāḥ pavadhvamarṇasā ||

translations.english: As a great man sets before him a commendable charioteer, so do you grant knowledge to our lord, and flow glistening with water.

mantras.sanskrit: एत उ त्ये अवीवशन्काष्ठां वाजिनो अक्रत । सतः प्रासाविषुर्मतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eta u tye avīvaśankāṣṭhāṃ vājino akrata | sataḥ prāsāviṣurmatim ||

translations.english: These effused juices have desired (the sacrifice); powerful they have made for themselves an abiding-plural ce; they have animated the intellect of the pious instrumental tutor of the rite.

mantras.sanskrit: एते सोमास आशवो रथा इव प्र वाजिनः । सर्गाः सृष्टा अहेषत ॥
mantras.transliteration: ete somāsa āśavo rathā iva pra vājinaḥ | sargāḥ sṛṣṭā aheṣata ||

translations.english: These Soma-jices, when let out, neigh as they leap swiftly forth like chariots or rapid steeds let loose.

mantras.sanskrit: एते वाता इवोरवः पर्जन्यस्येव वृष्टयः । अग्नेरिव भ्रमा वृथा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ete vātā ivoravaḥ parjanyasyeva vṛṣṭayaḥ | agneriva bhramā vṛthā ||

translations.english: Like strong winds, like the rains of Parjanya, like the swift-whiring (flames) of fire.

mantras.sanskrit: एते पूता विपश्चितः सोमासो दध्याशिरः । विपा व्यानशुर्धियः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ete pūtā vipaścitaḥ somāso dadhyāśiraḥ | vipā vyānaśurdhiyaḥ ||

translations.english: These pure Soma-juices, sagacious, mixed with curds, easily pervade our cermonies with their intelligence.

mantras.sanskrit: एते मृष्टा अमर्त्याः ससृवांसो न शश्रमुः । इयक्षन्तः पथो रजः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ete mṛṣṭā amartyāḥ sasṛvāṃso na śaśramuḥ | iyakṣantaḥ patho rajaḥ ||

translations.english: Purified, immortal, issuing from the vessels, eager to traverse their (assigned) paths and the universe, they are never wearied.

mantras.sanskrit: एते पृष्ठानि रोदसोर्विप्रयन्तो व्यानशुः । उतेदमुत्तमं रजः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ete pṛṣṭhāni rodasorviprayanto vyānaśuḥ | utedamuttamaṃ rajaḥ ||

translations.english: Spreading in various directions, they pervade the surface of earth and sky, you and this highest heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: तन्तुं तन्वानमुत्तममनु प्रवत आशत । उतेदमुत्तमाय्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tantuṃ tanvānamuttamamanu pravata āśata | utedamuttamāyyam ||

translations.english: Descending rivers follow this excellent (Soma) as it spreads out the sacrifice; this rits is glorified thereby.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं सोम पणिभ्य आ वसु गव्यानि धारयः । ततं तन्तुमचिक्रदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ soma paṇibhya ā vasu gavyāni dhārayaḥ | tataṃ tantumacikradaḥ ||

translations.english: You, Soma, hold the wealth of kine which you have won from the Paṇis, you have called aloud at the outspread sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: सोमा असृग्रमाशवो मधोर्मदस्य धारया । अभि विश्वानि काव्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: somā asṛgramāśavo madhormadasya dhārayā | abhi viśvāni kāvyā ||

translations.english: The swift-flowing Soma-juices have issued in a stream of the sweet exhilarating (beverage), at (the recital of) all the praise (of the sages).

mantras.sanskrit: अनु प्रत्नास आयवः पदं नवीयो अक्रमुः । रुचे जनन्त सूर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: anu pratnāsa āyavaḥ padaṃ navīyo akramuḥ | ruce jananta sūryam ||

translations.english: Ancient swift-going (horses), they (the juices) have traversed anew field-- they have a genitive rated a sun to give light.

mantras.sanskrit: आ पवमान नो भरार्यो अदाशुषो गयम् । कृधि प्रजावतीरिषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā pavamāna no bharāryo adāśuṣo gayam | kṛdhi prajāvatīriṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Bring to us, purifier, the house of our enemy who presents no libations-- bestow upon us progeny-abounding food.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि सोमास आयवः पवन्ते मद्यं मदम् । अभि कोशं मधुश्चुतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi somāsa āyavaḥ pavante madyaṃ madam | abhi kośaṃ madhuścutam ||

translations.english: The swift-flowing Soma-juices diffuse exhilarating wine-- they flow to the honey-shedding receptacle.

mantras.sanskrit: सोमो अर्षति धर्णसिर्दधान इन्द्रियं रसम् । सुवीरो अभिशस्तिपाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: somo arṣati dharṇasirdadhāna indriyaṃ rasam | suvīro abhiśastipāḥ ||

translations.english: The Soma flows, the sustainer (of the world), bearing a sense-invigorating essence-- heroic-- a protector against calumny.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राय सोम पवसे देवेभ्यः सधमाद्यः । इन्दो वाजं सिषाससि ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāya soma pavase devebhyaḥ sadhamādyaḥ | indo vājaṃ siṣāsasi ||

translations.english: Soma, who are worthy of the sacrifice, you flow to Indra and to the gods; you, Indu, vouchsafe to give us food.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य पीत्वा मदानामिन्द्रो वृत्राण्यप्रति । जघान जघनच्च नु ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya pītvā madānāmindro vṛtrāṇyaprati | jaghāna jaghanacca nu ||

translations.english: Having drunk of this chief of exhilarating draughts, Indra irresistible has slain his foes, and may he ever slay them.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सोमासो अधन्विषुः पवमानास इन्दवः । श्रीणाना अप्सु मृञ्जत ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra somāso adhanviṣuḥ pavamānāsa indavaḥ | śrīṇānā apsu mṛñjata ||

translations.english: The purified effused Soma-juices have flowed forth-- mixing (with curds and milk) they are cleansed in the waters.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि गावो अधन्विषुरापो न प्रवता यतीः । पुनाना इन्द्रमाशत ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi gāvo adhanviṣurāpo na pravatā yatīḥ | punānā indramāśata ||

translations.english: The flowing juices rush (to the filter), like waters flowing down a declivity; purified they gratify Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र पवमान धन्वसि सोमेन्द्राय पातवे । नृभिर्यतो वि नीयसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra pavamāna dhanvasi somendrāya pātave | nṛbhiryato vi nīyase ||

translations.english: Purifier, Soma, you proceed to Indra for his drinking-- thence are you brought by the priests.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं सोम नृमादनः पवस्व चर्षणीसहे । सस्निर्यो अनुमाद्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ soma nṛmādanaḥ pavasva carṣaṇīsahe | sasniryo anumādyaḥ ||

translations.english: You, Soma, who are the exhilarator of men, flow to (Indra), the conqueror of enemies, you who are pure and to be worshipped.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्दो यदद्रिभिः सुतः पवित्रं परिधावसि । अरमिन्द्रस्य धाम्ने ॥
mantras.transliteration: indo yadadribhiḥ sutaḥ pavitraṃ paridhāvasi | aramindrasya dhāmne ||

translations.english: When, Indu, effused by the stones, you have flowed to the filtering-cloth, you are an ample portion for Indra's belly.

mantras.sanskrit: पवस्व वृत्रहन्तमोक्थेभिरनुमाद्यः । शुचिः पावको अद्भुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavasva vṛtrahantamokthebhiranumādyaḥ | śuciḥ pāvako adbhutaḥ ||

translations.english: Utter destroyer of enemies, flow forth, to be propitiated by praises, pure, purifying, wonderful.

mantras.sanskrit: शुचिः पावक उच्यते सोमः सुतस्य मध्वः । देवावीरघशंसहा ॥
mantras.transliteration: śuciḥ pāvaka ucyate somaḥ sutasya madhvaḥ | devāvīraghaśaṃsahā ||

translations.english: Soma, (the yielder) of the exhilarating effusion, is called the pure, the purifier, the gratifier of the gods, the slayer of the wicked.

mantras.sanskrit: पवस्व दक्षसाधनो देवेभ्यः पीतये हरे । मरुद्भ्यो वायवे मदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavasva dakṣasādhano devebhyaḥ pītaye hare | marudbhyo vāyave madaḥ ||

translations.english: Green-tinted (Soma), do you who are the bestower of strength, the exhilarating, flow as a beverage for the gods, for the Maruts and for Vāyu.

mantras.sanskrit: पवमान धिया हितोऽभि योनिं कनिक्रदत् । धर्मणा वायुमा विश ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamāna dhiyā hito'bhi yoniṃ kanikradat | dharmaṇā vāyumā viśa ||

translations.english: Purifying (Soma), plural ced suitably by the sacred rite, (enter) uttering a cry the (appointed) plural ce, enter by the sacred function into Vāyu.

mantras.sanskrit: सं देवैः शोभते वृषा कविर्योनावधि प्रियः । वृत्रहा देववीतमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ devaiḥ śobhate vṛṣā kaviryonāvadhi priyaḥ | vṛtrahā devavītamaḥ ||

translations.english: This Soma, the showerer (of benefits), the seer, the beloved, the destroyer of foes,t he most devout, shines in its appointed plural ce along with the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वा रूपाण्याविशन्पुनानो याति हर्यतः । यत्रामृतास आसते ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvā rūpāṇyāviśanpunāno yāti haryataḥ | yatrāmṛtāsa āsate ||

translations.english: Pervading all forms, the pure, the desirable goes to the plural ce where the immortals abide.

mantras.sanskrit: अरुषो जनयन्गिरः सोमः पवत आयुषक् । इन्द्रं गच्छन्कविक्रतुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aruṣo janayangiraḥ somaḥ pavata āyuṣak | indraṃ gacchankavikratuḥ ||

translations.english: Endowed with wisdom of the past, the brilliant Soma, genitive rating sounds, flows forth continually proceeding to Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: आ पवस्व मदिन्तम पवित्रं धारया कवे । अर्कस्य योनिमासदम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā pavasva madintama pavitraṃ dhārayā kave | arkasya yonimāsadam ||

translations.english: Most exhilarating and sage (Soma), flow through the filter in a stream, to attain the station of the adorable Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: तममृक्षन्त वाजिनमुपस्थे अदितेरधि । विप्रासो अण्व्या धिया ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamamṛkṣanta vājinamupasthe aditeradhi | viprāso aṇvyā dhiyā ||

translations.english: The priests have cleansed that Soma (swift as) horse, on the lap of Aditi with fingers and with hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: तं गावो अभ्यनूषत सहस्रधारमक्षितम् । इन्दुं धर्तारमा दिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ gāvo abhyanūṣata sahasradhāramakṣitam | induṃ dhartāramā divaḥ ||

translations.english: The chants celebrate that Indu flowing in a thousand streams, inexhaustible, the supporter of heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: तं वेधां मेधयाह्यन्पवमानमधि द्यवि । धर्णसिं भूरिधायसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ vedhāṃ medhayāhyanpavamānamadhi dyavi | dharṇasiṃ bhūridhāyasam ||

translations.english: They have elevated to heaven by their praise that creative purifying (Soma), the sustainer, the maker of many.

mantras.sanskrit: तमह्यन्भुरिजोर्धिया संवसानं विवस्वतः । पतिं वाचो अदाभ्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamahyanbhurijordhiyā saṃvasānaṃ vivasvataḥ | patiṃ vāco adābhyam ||

translations.english: The worshippers have elevated by the fingers of their arms that unconquerable lord of praise abiding (in the vessels).

mantras.sanskrit: तं सानावधि जामयो हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । हर्यतं भूरिचक्षसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ sānāvadhi jāmayo hariṃ hinvantyadribhiḥ | haryataṃ bhūricakṣasam ||

translations.english: The sister-fingers in a raised plural ce press out by the grinding stones that green-tinted (Soma), desirable and far-beholding.

mantras.sanskrit: तं त्वा हिन्वन्ति वेधसः पवमान गिरावृधम् । इन्दविन्द्राय मत्सरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ tvā hinvanti vedhasaḥ pavamāna girāvṛdham | indavindrāya matsaram ||

translations.english: The worshippers offer you to Indra, purifier, Indu, filled with praise and bestowing exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: एष कविरभिष्टुतः पवित्रे अधि तोशते । पुनानो घ्नन्नप स्रिधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa kavirabhiṣṭutaḥ pavitre adhi tośate | punāno ghnannapa sridhaḥ ||

translations.english: This seer, the purifying (Soma), lauded by us, passes through the filter, driving away foes.

mantras.sanskrit: एष इन्द्राय वायवे स्वर्जित्परि षिच्यते । पवित्रे दक्षसाधनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa indrāya vāyave svarjitpari ṣicyate | pavitre dakṣasādhanaḥ ||

translations.english: This invigorating heaven-conquering Soma is poured upon the filter for Indra and Vāyu.

mantras.sanskrit: एष नृभिर्वि नीयते दिवो मूर्धा वृषा सुतः । सोमो वनेषु विश्ववित् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa nṛbhirvi nīyate divo mūrdhā vṛṣā sutaḥ | somo vaneṣu viśvavit ||

translations.english: This Soma, the showerer (of benefits), the summit of heaven, the all-knowing, being expressed is brought by the priests into the wooden vessels.

mantras.sanskrit: एष गव्युरचिक्रदत्पवमानो हिरण्ययुः । इन्दुः सत्राजिदस्तृतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa gavyuracikradatpavamāno hiraṇyayuḥ | induḥ satrājidastṛtaḥ ||

translations.english: This Indu resounds as it drops, yearning to give us cattle and gold, the conqueror of foes, the irresistible.

mantras.sanskrit: एष सूर्येण हासते पवमानो अधि द्यवि । पवित्रे मत्सरो मदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa sūryeṇa hāsate pavamāno adhi dyavi | pavitre matsaro madaḥ ||

translations.english: This pure-flowing exhilarating Soma is abandoned by the sun in the filter, the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: एष शुष्म्यसिष्यददन्तरिक्षे वृषा हरिः । पुनान इन्दुरिन्द्रमा ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa śuṣmyasiṣyadadantarikṣe vṛṣā hariḥ | punāna indurindramā ||

translations.english: This powerful and purifying showerer (of benefits), the green-tinted Indu, flows through the firmament to Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: एष वाजी हितो नृभिर्विश्वविन्मनसस्पतिः । अव्यो वारं वि धावति ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa vājī hito nṛbhirviśvavinmanasaspatiḥ | avyo vāraṃ vi dhāvati ||

translations.english: This swift-flowing (Soma) plural ced (in the vessels) by the priests, all-knowing, the lord of praise, has to the woollen (filter).

mantras.sanskrit: एष पवित्रे अक्षरत्सोमो देवेभ्यः सुतः । विश्वा धामान्याविशन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa pavitre akṣaratsomo devebhyaḥ sutaḥ | viśvā dhāmānyāviśan ||

translations.english: This (Soma), effused for the gods, flows into the filter, penetrating all the (divine) forms.

mantras.sanskrit: एष देवः शुभायतेऽधि योनावमर्त्यः । वृत्रहा देववीतमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa devaḥ śubhāyate'dhi yonāvamartyaḥ | vṛtrahā devavītamaḥ ||

translations.english: This divine immortal (Soma) is brilliant in his own plural ce, the slayer of enemies, the most devoted to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: एष वृषा कनिक्रदद्दशभिर्जामिभिर्यतः । अभि द्रोणानि धावति ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa vṛṣā kanikradaddaśabhirjāmibhiryataḥ | abhi droṇāni dhāvati ||

translations.english: This showerer (of desire), expressed by the ten fingers, has uttered a sound ot the pitchers.

mantras.sanskrit: एष सूर्यमरोचयत्पवमानो विचर्षणिः । विश्वा धामानि विश्ववित् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa sūryamarocayatpavamāno vicarṣaṇiḥ | viśvā dhāmāni viśvavit ||

translations.english: This purified, all-contemplating, all-knowing (Soma) gives radiance to the sun and all the spheres (of light).

mantras.sanskrit: एष शुष्म्यदाभ्यः सोमः पुनानो अर्षति । देवावीरघशंसहा ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa śuṣmyadābhyaḥ somaḥ punāno arṣati | devāvīraghaśaṃsahā ||

translations.english: This powerful invincible purifying Soma proceeds the protector of the gods, the destroyer of the wicked.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रास्य धारा अक्षरन्वृष्णः सुतस्यौजसा । देवाँ अनु प्रभूषतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prāsya dhārā akṣaranvṛṣṇaḥ sutasyaujasā | devā~ anu prabhūṣataḥ ||

translations.english: The streams of this effused (Soma), the showerer (of benefits), flow forth, as it seeks to surpass the gods in strength.

mantras.sanskrit: सप्तिं मृजन्ति वेधसो गृणन्तः कारवो गिरा । ज्योतिर्जज्ञानमुक्थ्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: saptiṃ mṛjanti vedhaso gṛṇantaḥ kāravo girā | jyotirjajñānamukthyam ||

translations.english: The pious performers (of holy rites), the utterers of praise, purify by their laudation the radiant courser (the Soma) as soon as genitive rated and meriting to be hymned.

mantras.sanskrit: सुषहा सोम तानि ते पुनानाय प्रभूवसो । वर्धा समुद्रमुक्थ्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: suṣahā soma tāni te punānāya prabhūvaso | vardhā samudramukthyam ||

translations.english: Soma, distributor of abundant wealth, those radiances of yours when you are purified are over-powering; fill therefore the praiseworthy ocean-like (pitcher).

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वा वसूनि संजयन्पवस्व सोम धारया । इनु द्वेषांसि सध्र्यक् ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvā vasūni saṃjayanpavasva soma dhārayā | inu dveṣāṃsi sadhryak ||

translations.english: Flow, Soma, in a full stream, conquering for us all treasures-- drive our enemies away together.

mantras.sanskrit: रक्षा सु नो अररुषः स्वनात्समस्य कस्य चित् । निदो यत्र मुमुच्महे ॥
mantras.transliteration: rakṣā su no araruṣaḥ svanātsamasya kasya cit | nido yatra mumucmahe ||

translations.english: Preserve us from the reproach of every one who makes offerings, who utters a blame-- that we may be free.

mantras.sanskrit: एन्दो पार्थिवं रयिं दिव्यं पवस्व धारया । द्युमन्तं शुष्ममा भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: endo pārthivaṃ rayiṃ divyaṃ pavasva dhārayā | dyumantaṃ śuṣmamā bhara ||

translations.english: Indu, pour to us in a stream terrestrial and celestial riches, bring brilliant vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र धारा अस्य शुष्मिणो वृथा पवित्रे अक्षरन् । पुनानो वाचमिष्यति ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra dhārā asya śuṣmiṇo vṛthā pavitre akṣaran | punāno vācamiṣyati ||

translations.english: The streams of this strong Soma flow without effort into the filter; purified, he excites praise.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्दुर्हियानः सोतृभिर्मृज्यमानः कनिक्रदत् । इयर्ति वग्नुमिन्द्रियम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indurhiyānaḥ sotṛbhirmṛjyamānaḥ kanikradat | iyarti vagnumindriyam ||

translations.english: This Indu, urged by the priests, and purified with a sound in the filter, utters loud voice (in the oblation).

mantras.sanskrit: आ नः शुष्मं नृषाह्यं वीरवन्तं पुरुस्पृहम् । पवस्व सोम धारया ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā naḥ śuṣmaṃ nṛṣāhyaṃ vīravantaṃ puruspṛham | pavasva soma dhārayā ||

translations.english: Pour upon us in a stream, Soma, foe-subduing strength, associated with male offspring and desired by many.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सोमो अति धारया पवमानो असिष्यदत् । अभि द्रोणान्यासदम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra somo ati dhārayā pavamāno asiṣyadat | abhi droṇānyāsadam ||

translations.english: This purified Soma flows out in a stream to take its plural ce in the pitchers.

mantras.sanskrit: अप्सु त्वा मधुमत्तमं हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । इन्दविन्द्राय पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: apsu tvā madhumattamaṃ hariṃ hinvantyadribhiḥ | indavindrāya pītaye ||

translations.english: Indu, they press you forth by the stories, most sweet-flavoured and green-tinted, into the waters for Indra to drink.

mantras.sanskrit: सुनोता मधुमत्तमं सोममिन्द्राय वज्रिणे । चारुं शर्धाय मत्सरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sunotā madhumattamaṃ somamindrāya vajriṇe | cāruṃ śardhāya matsaram ||

translations.english: (Priests) express the most sweet-flavoured beautiful exhilarating Soma for Indra the thunderer, and for our invigoration.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सोमासः स्वाध्यः पवमानासो अक्रमुः । रयिं कृण्वन्ति चेतनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra somāsaḥ svādhyaḥ pavamānāso akramuḥ | rayiṃ kṛṇvanti cetanam ||

translations.english: The benevolent juices being purified flow forth, they confer intellectual wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवस्पृथिव्या अधि भवेन्दो द्युम्नवर्धनः । भवा वाजानां पतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: divaspṛthivyā adhi bhavendo dyumnavardhanaḥ | bhavā vājānāṃ patiḥ ||

translations.english: Indu, be (to us) the augmenter of the riches of heaven and earth, be the lord of food.

mantras.sanskrit: तुभ्यं वाता अभिप्रियस्तुभ्यमर्षन्ति सिन्धवः । सोम वर्धन्ति ते महः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tubhyaṃ vātā abhipriyastubhyamarṣanti sindhavaḥ | soma vardhanti te mahaḥ ||

translations.english: For you, Soma, the winds are gracious, for you the rivers flow, they magnify your greatness.

mantras.sanskrit: आ प्यायस्व समेतु ते विश्वतः सोम वृष्ण्यम् । भवा वाजस्य संगथे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā pyāyasva sametu te viśvataḥ soma vṛṣṇyam | bhavā vājasya saṃgathe ||

translations.english: Be well nourished, Soma; may vigour come to you from all sides, be (the giver) of strength in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: तुभ्यं गावो घृतं पयो बभ्रो दुदुह्रे अक्षितम् । वर्षिष्ठे अधि सानवि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tubhyaṃ gāvo ghṛtaṃ payo babhro duduhre akṣitam | varṣiṣṭhe adhi sānavi ||

translations.english: Tawny-tinted (Soma), the cows yield butter and milk inexhaustible for you (set) on the highest summit.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वायुधस्य ते सतो भुवनस्य पते वयम् । इन्दो सखित्वमुश्मसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: svāyudhasya te sato bhuvanasya pate vayam | indo sakhitvamuśmasi ||

translations.english: Indu, lord of beings, we desire the friendship of you, the well-armed.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सोमासो मदच्युतः श्रवसे नो मघोनः । सुता विदथे अक्रमुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra somāso madacyutaḥ śravase no maghonaḥ | sutā vidathe akramuḥ ||

translations.english: The Soma juices, diffusing exhilaration, rush forth effused at the sacrifice for the sustenance of us abounding in oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: आदीं त्रितस्य योषणो हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ādīṃ tritasya yoṣaṇo hariṃ hinvantyadribhiḥ | indumindrāya pītaye ||

translations.english: And the fingers of Trita express this green-tinted Soma with the stones for Indra's drinking.

mantras.sanskrit: आदीं हंसो यथा गणं विश्वस्यावीवशन्मतिम् । अत्यो न गोभिरज्यते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ādīṃ haṃso yathā gaṇaṃ viśvasyāvīvaśanmatim | atyo na gobhirajyate ||

translations.english: And like a swan entering its own flock, the Soma excites the praise of all, like a horse, it is bathed with milk.

mantras.sanskrit: उभे सोमावचाकशन्मृगो न तक्तो अर्षसि । सीदन्नृतस्य योनिमा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ubhe somāvacākaśanmṛgo na takto arṣasi | sīdannṛtasya yonimā ||

translations.english: Beholding both worlds, Soma, you hurry, swift as a deer, taking your seat on the plural ce of sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि गावो अनूषत योषा जारमिव प्रियम् । अगन्नाजिं यथा हितम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi gāvo anūṣata yoṣā jāramiva priyam | agannājiṃ yathā hitam ||

translations.english: Praises commend you (Soma) as a woman praises a dear lover; (you hasten to the vessel) as a hero hastens to the welcome contest.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मे धेहि द्युमद्यशो मघवद्भ्यश्च मह्यं च । सनिं मेधामुत श्रवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asme dhehi dyumadyaśo maghavadbhyaśca mahyaṃ ca | saniṃ medhāmuta śravaḥ ||

translations.english: Give to us who are affluent (in oblations), and also to me, brilliant fame, wealth, intelligence, and glory.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सोमासो विपश्चितोऽपां न यन्त्यूर्मयः । वनानि महिषा इव ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra somāso vipaścito'pāṃ na yantyūrmayaḥ | vanāni mahiṣā iva ||

translations.english: The intelligent Soma juices rush along like waves of water, like buffaloes to the forests.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि द्रोणानि बभ्रवः शुक्रा ऋतस्य धारया । वाजं गोमन्तमक्षरन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi droṇāni babhravaḥ śukrā ṛtasya dhārayā | vājaṃ gomantamakṣaran ||

translations.english: The tawny-coloured bright juices hasten to the pitchers with a stream of ambrosia, they pour forth sustenance accompanied with cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: सुता इन्द्राय वायवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः । सोमा अर्षन्ति विष्णवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: sutā indrāya vāyave varuṇāya marudbhyaḥ | somā arṣanti viṣṇave ||

translations.english: The libations effused proceed to Indra, to Vāyu, to Varuṇa, to the Maruts, to Viṣṇu

mantras.sanskrit: तिस्रो वाच उदीरते गावो मिमन्ति धेनवः । हरिरेति कनिक्रदत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tisro vāca udīrate gāvo mimanti dhenavaḥ | harireti kanikradat ||

translations.english: The priests utter the three sacred texts, the kine low (on being milked),, the green-tinted Soma goes sounding (to the vessels).

mantras.sanskrit: अभि ब्रह्मीरनूषत यह्वीॠतस्य मातरः । मर्मृज्यन्ते दिवः शिशुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi brahmīranūṣata yahvīṝtasya mātaraḥ | marmṛjyante divaḥ śiśum ||

translations.english: The many sacred hymns, the mothers of the sacrifice, give praise, they purify (the Soma), the infant of heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: रायः समुद्राँश्चतुरोऽस्मभ्यं सोम विश्वतः । आ पवस्व सहस्रिणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: rāyaḥ samudrā~ścaturo'smabhyaṃ soma viśvataḥ | ā pavasva sahasriṇaḥ ||

translations.english: From every side, Soma, pour upon us four oceans of riches, grant us thousands (of desires).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सुवानो धारया तनेन्दुर्हिन्वानो अर्षति । रुजद्दृळ्हा व्योजसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra suvāno dhārayā tanendurhinvāno arṣati | rujaddṛḷhā vyojasā ||

translations.english: Indu, when effused and expressed (by the priests) flows in a stream to the filter, breaking down strong plural ces by its strength.

mantras.sanskrit: सुत इन्द्राय वायवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः । सोमो अर्षति विष्णवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: suta indrāya vāyave varuṇāya marudbhyaḥ | somo arṣati viṣṇave ||

translations.english: The Soma effused proceeds to Indra, to Vāyu, to Varuṇa, to Maruts, to Viṣṇu.

mantras.sanskrit: वृषाणं वृषभिर्यतं सुन्वन्ति सोममद्रिभिः । दुहन्ति शक्मना पयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣāṇaṃ vṛṣabhiryataṃ sunvanti somamadribhiḥ | duhanti śakmanā payaḥ ||

translations.english: They press the crushed Soma as it pours forth its juice between the effusing stones, they milk out its juice by their acts.

mantras.sanskrit: भुवत्त्रितस्य मर्ज्यो भुवदिन्द्राय मत्सरः । सं रूपैरज्यते हरिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhuvattritasya marjyo bhuvadindrāya matsaraḥ | saṃ rūpairajyate hariḥ ||

translations.english: The exhilarating Soma is to be cleansed (for the sacrifice) of Trita, and for the drinking of Indra; the green-tinted (juice) is mixed with the ingredients.

mantras.sanskrit: अभीमृतस्य विष्टपं दुहते पृश्निमातरः । चारु प्रियतमं हविः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhīmṛtasya viṣṭapaṃ duhate pṛśnimātaraḥ | cāru priyatamaṃ haviḥ ||

translations.english: The son fof Pṛśni milk this Soma at the plural ce of sacrifice, the most beautiful and grateful oblation (to the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: समेनमह्रुता इमा गिरो अर्षन्ति सस्रुतः । धेनूर्वाश्रो अवीवशत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: samenamahrutā imā giro arṣanti sasrutaḥ | dhenūrvāśro avīvaśat ||

translations.english: Our sincere smooth-flowing praises approach him, and he, uttering a sound, welcomes the kine.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नः पवस्व धारया पवमान रयिं पृथुम् । यया ज्योतिर्विदासि नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā naḥ pavasva dhārayā pavamāna rayiṃ pṛthum | yayā jyotirvidāsi naḥ ||

translations.english: Pour upon us, purifier, ample riches with that stream wherewith you bestow upon us light.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्दो समुद्रमीङ्खय पवस्व विश्वमेजय । रायो धर्ता न ओजसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: indo samudramīṅkhaya pavasva viśvamejaya | rāyo dhartā na ojasā ||

translations.english: Indu, impeller of the waters, confounder of all (our foes), flow forth by your power as the supporter of wealth to us.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वया वीरेण वीरवोऽभि ष्याम पृतन्यतः । क्षरा णो अभि वार्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvayā vīreṇa vīravo'bhi ṣyāma pṛtanyataḥ | kṣarā ṇo abhi vāryam ||

translations.english: With you, heroic (Soma), as our hero, may we overcome our enemies, pour upon the desirable (riches).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वाजमिन्दुरिष्यति सिषासन्वाजसा ऋषिः । व्रता विदान आयुधा ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vājaminduriṣyati siṣāsanvājasā ṛṣiḥ | vratā vidāna āyudhā ||

translations.english: Indu, the bestower of food, the seer sends food to the worshipper, showing his favour, acquainted with sacred rites and arms.

mantras.sanskrit: तं गीर्भिर्वाचमीङ्खयं पुनानं वासयामसि । सोमं जनस्य गोपतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ gīrbhirvācamīṅkhayaṃ punānaṃ vāsayāmasi | somaṃ janasya gopatim ||

translations.english: We clothe with praise that Soma who is the inspirer of praise, the purified, the shepherd of men.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वो यस्य व्रते जनो दाधार धर्मणस्पतेः । पुनानस्य प्रभूवसोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvo yasya vrate jano dādhāra dharmaṇaspateḥ | punānasya prabhūvasoḥ ||

translations.english: On the worship of whom all men fix their thoughts-- the lord of pious acts, the purified, the possessor of abundant wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: असर्जि रथ्यो यथा पवित्रे चम्वोः सुतः । कार्ष्मन्वाजी न्यक्रमीत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asarji rathyo yathā pavitre camvoḥ sutaḥ | kārṣmanvājī nyakramīt ||

translations.english: Pressed between the boards, (the Soma) has been let loose, like a chariot-horse, upon the straining-cloth-- the courser steps out on the field.

mantras.sanskrit: स वह्निः सोम जागृविः पवस्व देववीरति । अभि कोशं मधुश्चुतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa vahniḥ soma jāgṛviḥ pavasva devavīrati | abhi kośaṃ madhuścutam ||

translations.english: Soma, bearer (of oblation), vigilant, devoted to the gods, flow past the honey-dropping filter (into the vessel).

mantras.sanskrit: स नो ज्योतींषि पूर्व्य पवमान वि रोचय । क्रत्वे दक्षाय नो हिनु ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no jyotīṃṣi pūrvya pavamāna vi rocaya | kratve dakṣāya no hinu ||

translations.english: Ancient purifier, illume for us the luminaries (of heaven), animate us for strength-bestowing sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: शुम्भमान ऋतायुभिर्मृज्यमानो गभस्त्योः । पवते वारे अव्यये ॥
mantras.transliteration: śumbhamāna ṛtāyubhirmṛjyamāno gabhastyoḥ | pavate vāre avyaye ||

translations.english: Beautified by the ministers of the rite, expressed by their hands, (the Soma) flows through the woollen filter.

mantras.sanskrit: स विश्वा दाशुषे वसु सोमो दिव्यानि पार्थिवा । पवतामान्तरिक्ष्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa viśvā dāśuṣe vasu somo divyāni pārthivā | pavatāmāntarikṣyā ||

translations.english: May that Soma bestow upon the donor (of the libation) all treasures, whether of heaven or earth or the firmament.

mantras.sanskrit: आ दिवस्पृष्ठमश्वयुर्गव्ययुः सोम रोहसि । वीरयुः शवसस्पते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā divaspṛṣṭhamaśvayurgavyayuḥ soma rohasi | vīrayuḥ śavasaspate ||

translations.english: Soma, lord of food, you ascend to the summit of the sky, desirous of horses, kine, and male progeny.

mantras.sanskrit: स सुतः पीतये वृषा सोमः पवित्रे अर्षति । विघ्नन्रक्षांसि देवयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa sutaḥ pītaye vṛṣā somaḥ pavitre arṣati | vighnanrakṣāṃsi devayuḥ ||

translations.english: Soma, the showerer (of benefits), when effused for the drinking (of the gods), rushes to the filter, destroying the rākṣas, devoted to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: स पवित्रे विचक्षणो हरिरर्षति धर्णसिः । अभि योनिं कनिक्रदत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa pavitre vicakṣaṇo harirarṣati dharṇasiḥ | abhi yoniṃ kanikradat ||

translations.english: The all-beholding Soma, green-tinted, all-sustaining rush to the filter (and thence) crying aloud to the pitcher.

mantras.sanskrit: स वाजी रोचना दिवः पवमानो वि धावति । रक्षोहा वारमव्ययम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa vājī rocanā divaḥ pavamāno vi dhāvati | rakṣohā vāramavyayam ||

translations.english: (Fleet as) a horse, the pure Soma, the illume of heaven, hastens, the destroyer of rākṣasas, past the woollen fleece.

mantras.sanskrit: स त्रितस्याधि सानवि पवमानो अरोचयत् । जामिभिः सूर्यं सह ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa tritasyādhi sānavi pavamāno arocayat | jāmibhiḥ sūryaṃ saha ||

translations.english: The pure Soma upon the high plural ce (of the sacrifice) of Trita, attended by its kindred rays, has lighted up the Sun.

mantras.sanskrit: स वृत्रहा वृषा सुतो वरिवोविददाभ्यः । सोमो वाजमिवासरत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa vṛtrahā vṛṣā suto varivovidadābhyaḥ | somo vājamivāsarat ||

translations.english: The slayer of Vṛtra, the showerer of benefits, the giver of wealth, the invincible, the effused Soma proceeds (to the pitcher) as (a horse) to battle.

mantras.sanskrit: स देवः कविनेषितोऽभि द्रोणानि धावति । इन्दुरिन्द्राय मंहना ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa devaḥ kavineṣito'bhi droṇāni dhāvati | indurindrāya maṃhanā ||

translations.english: The divine Soma, when effused by the priest, hastens in his might to the pitchers for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: एष उ स्य वृषा रथोऽव्यो वारेभिरर्षति । गच्छन्वाजं सहस्रिणम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa u sya vṛṣā ratho'vyo vārebhirarṣati | gacchanvājaṃ sahasriṇam ||

translations.english: This Soma, the showerer of benefits, the chariot, dashes through the woollen fleece, bearing (to the worshipper) thousandfold food.

mantras.sanskrit: एतं त्रितस्य योषणो हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: etaṃ tritasya yoṣaṇo hariṃ hinvantyadribhiḥ | indumindrāya pītaye ||

translations.english: The fingers of Trita effuse by the stones this green-tinted juice for Indra's drinking.

mantras.sanskrit: एतं त्यं हरितो दश मर्मृज्यन्ते अपस्युवः । याभिर्मदाय शुम्भते ॥
mantras.transliteration: etaṃ tyaṃ harito daśa marmṛjyante apasyuvaḥ | yābhirmadāya śumbhate ||

translations.english: The ten fingers, eager in the work, express that (Soma), and by them it is purified for the exhilaration (of Indra).

mantras.sanskrit: एष स्य मानुषीष्वा श्येनो न विक्षु सीदति । गच्छञ्जारो न योषितम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa sya mānuṣīṣvā śyeno na vikṣu sīdati | gacchañjāro na yoṣitam ||

translations.english: That Soma sits down among human beings like a falcon, hastening as a gallant to his mistress.

mantras.sanskrit: एष स्य मद्यो रसोऽव चष्टे दिवः शिशुः । य इन्दुर्वारमाविशत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa sya madyo raso'va caṣṭe divaḥ śiśuḥ | ya indurvāramāviśat ||

translations.english: That exhilarating juice beholds all, Indu, the child of heaven, that percolates through the fleece.

mantras.sanskrit: एष स्य पीतये सुतो हरिरर्षति धर्णसिः । क्रन्दन्योनिमभि प्रियम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa sya pītaye suto harirarṣati dharṇasiḥ | krandanyonimabhi priyam ||

translations.english: That green-tinted, all-sustaining (Soma), when effused for the drinking (of the gods), rushes crying aloud to its beloved plural ce.

mantras.sanskrit: आशुरर्ष बृहन्मते परि प्रियेण धाम्ना । यत्र देवा इति ब्रवन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: āśurarṣa bṛhanmate pari priyeṇa dhāmnā | yatra devā iti bravan ||

translations.english: Great-minded Soma, go swift with your body that is most dear (to the gods), saying, 'Where are the gods?'

mantras.sanskrit: परिष्कृण्वन्ननिष्कृतं जनाय यातयन्निषः । वृष्टिं दिवः परि स्रव ॥
mantras.transliteration: pariṣkṛṇvannaniṣkṛtaṃ janāya yātayanniṣaḥ | vṛṣṭiṃ divaḥ pari srava ||

translations.english: Sanctifying the unconsecrated (worshipper) bringing food for the offerer, pour down rain from heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: सुत एति पवित्र आ त्विषिं दधान ओजसा । विचक्षाणो विरोचयन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: suta eti pavitra ā tviṣiṃ dadhāna ojasā | vicakṣāṇo virocayan ||

translations.english: (The Soma) when effused enters the filter with force, giving forth light, beholding and illuminating (all things).

mantras.sanskrit: अयं स यो दिवस्परि रघुयामा पवित्र आ । सिन्धोरूर्मा व्यक्षरत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ sa yo divaspari raghuyāmā pavitra ā | sindhorūrmā vyakṣarat ||

translations.english: This (Soma), who light of movement (mounts) toheaven, through the filter in a stream of water.

mantras.sanskrit: आविवासन्परावतो अथो अर्वावतः सुतः । इन्द्राय सिच्यते मधु ॥
mantras.transliteration: āvivāsanparāvato atho arvāvataḥ sutaḥ | indrāya sicyate madhu ||

translations.english: The effused (Soma) honouring (the gods) whether he is far off or nigh, is poured out (as) madhu for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: समीचीना अनूषत हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । योनावृतस्य सीदत ॥
mantras.transliteration: samīcīnā anūṣata hariṃ hinvantyadribhiḥ | yonāvṛtasya sīdata ||

translations.english: The united (worshippers) praise (him), they squeeze (him) forth green-tinted with the stones; sit down (O gods) at the plural ce of sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: पुनानो अक्रमीदभि विश्वा मृधो विचर्षणिः । शुम्भन्ति विप्रं धीतिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: punāno akramīdabhi viśvā mṛdho vicarṣaṇiḥ | śumbhanti vipraṃ dhītibhiḥ ||

translations.english: The pure all-seeing (Soma) has overcome all enemies; (the worshippers) grace the sage (Soma) with their praises.

mantras.sanskrit: आ योनिमरुणो रुहद्गमदिन्द्रं वृषा सुतः । ध्रुवे सदसि सीदति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yonimaruṇo ruhadgamadindraṃ vṛṣā sutaḥ | dhruve sadasi sīdati ||

translations.english: The tawny-hued showerer (of benefits) when effused ascends to his plural ce; he goes to Indra; he dwells in the fixed abode (of heaven).

mantras.sanskrit: नू नो रयिं महामिन्दोऽस्मभ्यं सोम विश्वतः । आ पवस्व सहस्रिणम् ॥
