mantras.transliteration: nū no rayiṃ mahāmindo'smabhyaṃ soma viśvataḥ | ā pavasva sahasriṇam ||

translations.english: O Indu, O Soma, quickly pour upon us from all quarters vast and infinite riches.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वा सोम पवमान द्युम्नानीन्दवा भर । विदाः सहस्रिणीरिषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvā soma pavamāna dyumnānīndavā bhara | vidāḥ sahasriṇīriṣaḥ ||

translations.english: O purified Soma, O Indu, bring all sorts of wealth bestow unlimited food.

mantras.sanskrit: स नः पुनान आ भर रयिं स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम् । जरितुर्वर्धया गिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa naḥ punāna ā bhara rayiṃ stotre suvīryam | jariturvardhayā giraḥ ||

translations.english: O Soma, being purified, bring us your worshippers wealth with male offspring, recompense the praises of him who glorifies you.

mantras.sanskrit: पुनान इन्दवा भर सोम द्विबर्हसं रयिम् । वृषन्निन्दो न उक्थ्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: punāna indavā bhara soma dvibarhasaṃ rayim | vṛṣannindo na ukthyam ||

translations.english: Indu, Soma, being purified, bring us wealth from both worlds; Indu, showerer (of benefits), (bring us) glorious (wealth).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ये गावो न भूर्णयस्त्वेषा अयासो अक्रमुः । घ्नन्तः कृष्णामप त्वचम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra ye gāvo na bhūrṇayastveṣā ayāso akramuḥ | ghnantaḥ kṛṣṇāmapa tvacam ||

translations.english: (Praise the Soma-juices) which descend like streams of water, swift, brilliant, rapid driving off the black skinned (rākṣasa).

mantras.sanskrit: सुवितस्य मनामहेऽति सेतुं दुराव्यम् । साह्वांसो दस्युमव्रतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: suvitasya manāmahe'ti setuṃ durāvyam | sāhvāṃso dasyumavratam ||

translations.english: We praise the auspicious Soma's imprisonment (of the rākṣasas) and hostile (intent against them), while we triumph over the enemy who performs no riteṣ

mantras.sanskrit: शृण्वे वृष्टेरिव स्वनः पवमानस्य शुष्मिणः । चरन्ति विद्युतो दिवि ॥
mantras.transliteration: śṛṇve vṛṣṭeriva svanaḥ pavamānasya śuṣmiṇaḥ | caranti vidyuto divi ||

translations.english: The sound of the purified, powerful Soma is heard like that of rain; (his) lightning moves in the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: आ पवस्व महीमिषं गोमदिन्दो हिरण्यवत् । अश्वावद्वाजवत्सुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā pavasva mahīmiṣaṃ gomadindo hiraṇyavat | aśvāvadvājavatsutaḥ ||

translations.english: When effused, Indu, pour forth much food with cows, gold, horses, and strength.

mantras.sanskrit: स पवस्व विचर्षण आ मही रोदसी पृण । उषाः सूर्यो न रश्मिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa pavasva vicarṣaṇa ā mahī rodasī pṛṇa | uṣāḥ sūryo na raśmibhiḥ ||

translations.english: Flow, all-seeing (Soma), fill the vast heaven and earth as the sun (fills) the days with his beams.

mantras.sanskrit: परि णः शर्मयन्त्या धारया सोम विश्वतः । सरा रसेव विष्टपम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari ṇaḥ śarmayantyā dhārayā soma viśvataḥ | sarā raseva viṣṭapam ||

translations.english: Flow round us, Soma, on all sides in a bliss-bestowing stream, like a river down a steep plural ce.

mantras.sanskrit: जनयन्रोचना दिवो जनयन्नप्सु सूर्यम् । वसानो गा अपो हरिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: janayanrocanā divo janayannapsu sūryam | vasāno gā apo hariḥ ||

translations.english: The green-tinted (Soma) genitive rating the luminaries of heaven, genitive rating the sun in the firmament, clothing himself with the descending water.

mantras.sanskrit: एष प्रत्नेन मन्मना देवो देवेभ्यस्परि । धारया पवते सुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa pratnena manmanā devo devebhyaspari | dhārayā pavate sutaḥ ||

translations.english: He with ancient praise when effused flows in a stream, a god for the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: वावृधानाय तूर्वये पवन्ते वाजसातये । सोमाः सहस्रपाजसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāvṛdhānāya tūrvaye pavante vājasātaye | somāḥ sahasrapājasaḥ ||

translations.english: The Soma juices of unbounded vigour flow for the increasing, rapid acquisition of food.

mantras.sanskrit: दुहानः प्रत्नमित्पयः पवित्रे परि षिच्यते । क्रन्दन्देवाँ अजीजनत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: duhānaḥ pratnamitpayaḥ pavitre pari ṣicyate | krandandevā~ ajījanat ||

translations.english: Milking forth the ancient fluid, the Soma is poured into the filter and crying out genitive rates the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि विश्वानि वार्याभि देवाँ ऋतावृधः । सोमः पुनानो अर्षति ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi viśvāni vāryābhi devā~ ṛtāvṛdhaḥ | somaḥ punāno arṣati ||

translations.english: Soma, being purified hastens towards all desirable (wealth), towards the gods who favour the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: गोमन्नः सोम वीरवदश्वावद्वाजवत्सुतः । पवस्व बृहतीरिषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: gomannaḥ soma vīravadaśvāvadvājavatsutaḥ | pavasva bṛhatīriṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Soma, being effused pour down to us (wealth) consisting of kine, male offspring, horses, and strength, and abundant food.

mantras.sanskrit: यो अत्य इव मृज्यते गोभिर्मदाय हर्यतः । तं गीर्भिर्वासयामसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo atya iva mṛjyate gobhirmadāya haryataḥ | taṃ gīrbhirvāsayāmasi ||

translations.english: We invest with praises that Soma who, beloved, is cleansed like a horse with milk for the exhilaration (of the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: तं नो विश्वा अवस्युवो गिरः शुम्भन्ति पूर्वथा । इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ no viśvā avasyuvo giraḥ śumbhanti pūrvathā | indumindrāya pītaye ||

translations.english: This Indu all our praises desiring protection, beautify (new) as of old for Indra to drink.

mantras.sanskrit: पुनानो याति हर्यतः सोमो गीर्भिः परिष्कृतः । विप्रस्य मेध्यातिथेः ॥
mantras.transliteration: punāno yāti haryataḥ somo gīrbhiḥ pariṣkṛtaḥ | viprasya medhyātitheḥ ||

translations.english: Pure flows the beloved Soma, beautified by the praises of the sage Medhyātithi.

mantras.sanskrit: पवमान विदा रयिमस्मभ्यं सोम सुश्रियम् । इन्दो सहस्रवर्चसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamāna vidā rayimasmabhyaṃ soma suśriyam | indo sahasravarcasam ||

translations.english: Purified Soma, grant us auspicious wealth, with infinite splendour, O Indu.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्दुरत्यो न वाजसृत्कनिक्रन्ति पवित्र आ । यदक्षारति देवयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: induratyo na vājasṛtkanikranti pavitra ā | yadakṣārati devayuḥ ||

translations.english: Rushing into battle, sounds in the rough, beloved of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: पवस्व वाजसातये विप्रस्य गृणतो वृधे । सोम रास्व सुवीर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavasva vājasātaye viprasya gṛṇato vṛdhe | soma rāsva suvīryam ||

translations.english: Flow for the acquisition of food, for the prosperity of the sage who praise you; O Soma, grant (me) excellent male offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ण इन्दो महे तन ऊर्मिं न बिभ्रदर्षसि । अभि देवाँ अयास्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra ṇa indo mahe tana ūrmiṃ na bibhradarṣasi | abhi devā~ ayāsyaḥ ||

translations.english: Indu, you advance to give us abundant wealth; Ayāsya bearing your waves (go) towards the gods (to sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: मती जुष्टो धिया हितः सोमो हिन्वे परावति । विप्रस्य धारया कविः ॥
mantras.transliteration: matī juṣṭo dhiyā hitaḥ somo hinve parāvati | viprasya dhārayā kaviḥ ||

translations.english: The sage Soma gratified by the praise of the pious (worshipper) prepared for the sacrifice is sent in a stream at a distance (from the filter).

mantras.sanskrit: अयं देवेषु जागृविः सुत एति पवित्र आ । सोमो याति विचर्षणिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ deveṣu jāgṛviḥ suta eti pavitra ā | somo yāti vicarṣaṇiḥ ||

translations.english: This vigilant Soma effused for the gods, approaches, all-beholding he goes to the filter.

mantras.sanskrit: स नः पवस्व वाजयुश्चक्राणश्चारुमध्वरम् । बर्हिष्माँ आ विवासति ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa naḥ pavasva vājayuścakrāṇaścārumadhvaram | barhiṣmā~ ā vivāsati ||

translations.english: Flow for us food-desiring, making (our) sacrifice auspicious; (O Soma, whom) the priest with the sacred grass adores.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो भगाय वायवे विप्रवीरः सदावृधः । सोमो देवेष्वा यमत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no bhagāya vāyave vipravīraḥ sadāvṛdhaḥ | somo deveṣvā yamat ||

translations.english: May Soma who is pressed forth by the seers for Bhaga and Vāyu, ever prosper in, grant us (wealth plural ced) among the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो अद्य वसुत्तये क्रतुविद्गातुवित्तमः । वाजं जेषि श्रवो बृहत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no adya vasuttaye kratuvidgātuvittamaḥ | vājaṃ jeṣi śravo bṛhat ||

translations.english: Receiver of sacrifices, knower of (pious), give us this day abundant food and strength for the acquisition of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: स पवस्व मदाय कं नृचक्षा देववीतये । इन्दविन्द्राय पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa pavasva madāya kaṃ nṛcakṣā devavītaye | indavindrāya pītaye ||

translations.english: Indu, do you the beholder of men flow plural asantly for the banquet of the gods, for Indra's drinking and exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो अर्षाभि दूत्यं त्वमिन्द्राय तोशसे । देवान्त्सखिभ्य आ वरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no arṣābhi dūtyaṃ tvamindrāya tośase | devāntsakhibhya ā varam ||

translations.english: Approach the office of the messenger for us; you who are drunk for Indra, (pour) on the gods wealth for (us their) friends.

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्वामरुणं वयं गोभिरञ्ज्मो मदाय कम् । वि नो राये दुरो वृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tvāmaruṇaṃ vayaṃ gobhirañjmo madāya kam | vi no rāye duro vṛdhi ||

translations.english: And we adorn you, the purple-tinted with milk and curd for the purpose of exhilaration open the doors for our riches.

mantras.sanskrit: अत्यू पवित्रमक्रमीद्वाजी धुरं न यामनि । इन्दुर्देवेषु पत्यते ॥
mantras.transliteration: atyū pavitramakramīdvājī dhuraṃ na yāmani | indurdeveṣu patyate ||

translations.english: Indu passes the filter as a horse in going passes the shaft (of the chariot); he proceeds to the midst of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: समी सखायो अस्वरन्वने क्रीळन्तमत्यविम् । इन्दुं नावा अनूषत ॥
mantras.transliteration: samī sakhāyo asvaranvane krīḷantamatyavim | induṃ nāvā anūṣata ||

translations.english: His friends praise Indu sporting in the water and passing through the fleece; their hymns glorify him.

mantras.sanskrit: तया पवस्व धारया यया पीतो विचक्षसे । इन्दो स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tayā pavasva dhārayā yayā pīto vicakṣase | indo stotre suvīryam ||

translations.english: Flow Indu, with that stream wherewith when drunk you bestow much vigour on your discerning worshipper.

mantras.sanskrit: असृग्रन्देववीतयेऽत्यासः कृत्व्या इव । क्षरन्तः पर्वतावृधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asṛgrandevavītaye'tyāsaḥ kṛtvyā iva | kṣarantaḥ parvatāvṛdhaḥ ||

translations.english: Begotten by the stones the flowing (Soma-juices) are effused for the banquet of the gods' active horses.

mantras.sanskrit: परिष्कृतास इन्दवो योषेव पित्र्यावती । वायुं सोमा असृक्षत ॥
mantras.transliteration: pariṣkṛtāsa indavo yoṣeva pitryāvatī | vāyuṃ somā asṛkṣata ||

translations.english: The Soma-juices pressed (at the sacrifice), adorned like a bride who has a father, flow to Vāyu.

mantras.sanskrit: एते सोमास इन्दवः प्रयस्वन्तश्चमू सुताः । इन्द्रं वर्धन्ति कर्मभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ete somāsa indavaḥ prayasvantaścamū sutāḥ | indraṃ vardhanti karmabhiḥ ||

translations.english: These brilliang Soma-juices, bestowing plural asant food, expressed into the vessel, gratify Indra with the ceremonies.

mantras.sanskrit: आ धावता सुहस्त्यः शुक्रा गृभ्णीत मन्थिना । गोभिः श्रीणीत मत्सरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā dhāvatā suhastyaḥ śukrā gṛbhṇīta manthinā | gobhiḥ śrīṇīta matsaram ||

translations.english: Dexterous (priests) have (to me), taken with the ladle the pure (Soma), mix the exhilarating (Soma) with milk and curds.

mantras.sanskrit: स पवस्व धनंजय प्रयन्ता राधसो महः । अस्मभ्यं सोम गातुवित् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa pavasva dhanaṃjaya prayantā rādhaso mahaḥ | asmabhyaṃ soma gātuvit ||

translations.english: Soma, conqueror of wealth, who know the way (to fulfil my desires), flow forth the bestower of vast wealth upon us.

mantras.sanskrit: एतं मृजन्ति मर्ज्यं पवमानं दश क्षिपः । इन्द्राय मत्सरं मदम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: etaṃ mṛjanti marjyaṃ pavamānaṃ daśa kṣipaḥ | indrāya matsaraṃ madam ||

translations.english: The ten fingers purify this purifiable pure-flowing exhilarating juice for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: अया सोमः सुकृत्यया महश्चिदभ्यवर्धत । मन्दान उद्वृषायते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayā somaḥ sukṛtyayā mahaścidabhyavardhata | mandāna udvṛṣāyate ||

translations.english: By this sacred solemnity the Soma is magnified before the mighty (gods); exulting he moves like a bull.

mantras.sanskrit: कृतानीदस्य कर्त्वा चेतन्ते दस्युतर्हणा । ऋणा च धृष्णुश्चयते ॥
mantras.transliteration: kṛtānīdasya kartvā cetante dasyutarhaṇā | ṛṇā ca dhṛṣṇuścayate ||

translations.english: They publish his exploits, his acts of Dasyu-crushing; resolute he acquite the debts (of the worshipper).

mantras.sanskrit: आत्सोम इन्द्रियो रसो वज्रः सहस्रसा भुवत् । उक्थं यदस्य जायते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ātsoma indriyo raso vajraḥ sahasrasā bhuvat | ukthaṃ yadasya jāyate ||

translations.english: When the praise of Indra is recited, then the juice dear to him, vigorous as a thunderbolt, give us unlimited wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वयं कविर्विधर्तरि विप्राय रत्नमिच्छति । यदी मर्मृज्यते धियः ॥
mantras.transliteration: svayaṃ kavirvidhartari viprāya ratnamicchati | yadī marmṛjyate dhiyaḥ ||

translations.english: When the sage Soma is cleansed by the fingers, he of his own accord desires wealth for the pious worshipper in (Indra), the granter of wishes.

mantras.sanskrit: सिषासतू रयीणां वाजेष्वर्वतामिव । भरेषु जिग्युषामसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: siṣāsatū rayīṇāṃ vājeṣvarvatāmiva | bhareṣu jigyuṣāmasi ||

translations.english: You desire to give wealth to those who conquer in combat as (men offer fodder) to horses in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: तं त्वा नृम्णानि बिभ्रतं सधस्थेषु महो दिवः । चारुं सुकृत्ययेमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ tvā nṛmṇāni bibhrataṃ sadhastheṣu maho divaḥ | cāruṃ sukṛtyayemahe ||

translations.english: By sacred rites we solicit (wealth) of you, auspicious, bearing wealth, abiding in the regions of the vast heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: संवृक्तधृष्णुमुक्थ्यं महामहिव्रतं मदम् । शतं पुरो रुरुक्षणिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃvṛktadhṛṣṇumukthyaṃ mahāmahivrataṃ madam | śataṃ puro rurukṣaṇim ||

translations.english: The overthrower of the resolute (foe), the praiseworthy, to whom many solemn observances are addressed, the exhilarator, the destroyer of a hundred cities (of the asuras).

mantras.sanskrit: अतस्त्वा रयिमभि राजानं सुक्रतो दिवः । सुपर्णो अव्यथिर्भरत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: atastvā rayimabhi rājānaṃ sukrato divaḥ | suparṇo avyathirbharat ||

translations.english: O (Soma), doer of good deeds, the unwearied hawk brought you, king over riches, from this heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वस्मा इत्स्वर्दृशे साधारणं रजस्तुरम् । गोपामृतस्य विर्भरत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvasmā itsvardṛśe sādhāraṇaṃ rajasturam | gopāmṛtasya virbharat ||

translations.english: The bird brought you, the showerer of water, the protector of the sacrifice, the common property of every god.

mantras.sanskrit: अधा हिन्वान इन्द्रियं ज्यायो महित्वमानशे । अभिष्टिकृद्विचर्षणिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhā hinvāna indriyaṃ jyāyo mahitvamānaśe | abhiṣṭikṛdvicarṣaṇiḥ ||

translations.english: The contemplator of all, the granter of desires, putting forth his energy obtains superior greatness.

mantras.sanskrit: पवस्व वृष्टिमा सु नोऽपामूर्मिं दिवस्परि । अयक्ष्मा बृहतीरिषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavasva vṛṣṭimā su no'pāmūrmiṃ divaspari | ayakṣmā bṛhatīriṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Pour down upon us a shower from heaven, a stream of waters, wholesome and abundant food.

mantras.sanskrit: तया पवस्व धारया यया गाव इहागमन् । जन्यास उप नो गृहम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tayā pavasva dhārayā yayā gāva ihāgaman | janyāsa upa no gṛham ||

translations.english: Flow in such a stream that the cattle belonging to the (enemy's) nation may come here to our dwelling.

mantras.sanskrit: घृतं पवस्व धारया यज्ञेषु देववीतमः । अस्मभ्यं वृष्टिमा पव ॥
mantras.transliteration: ghṛtaṃ pavasva dhārayā yajñeṣu devavītamaḥ | asmabhyaṃ vṛṣṭimā pava ||

translations.english: You who are most dear to the gods at sacrifice, shower down water in a stream, pour your rain upon us.

mantras.sanskrit: स न ऊर्जे व्यव्ययं पवित्रं धाव धारया । देवासः शृणवन्हि कम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa na ūrje vyavyayaṃ pavitraṃ dhāva dhārayā | devāsaḥ śṛṇavanhi kam ||

translations.english: Do you for our sustenance hasten to the woollen filter with your stream; let the gods hear your sound.

mantras.sanskrit: पवमानो असिष्यदद्रक्षांस्यपजङ्घनत् । प्रत्नवद्रोचयन्रुचः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamāno asiṣyadadrakṣāṃsyapajaṅghanat | pratnavadrocayanrucaḥ ||

translations.english: The purifier (the Soma) flows forth destroying the rākṣasas, flashing out brilliance as of old.

mantras.sanskrit: उत्ते शुष्मास ईरते सिन्धोरूर्मेरिव स्वनः । वाणस्य चोदया पविम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: utte śuṣmāsa īrate sindhorūrmeriva svanaḥ | vāṇasya codayā pavim ||

translations.english: Forth flow your mystery (streams), like the roar (issuing) from the ocean wave; emit your sound like that of a (rushing) arrow.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रसवे त उदीरते तिस्रो वाचो मखस्युवः । यदव्य एषि सानवि ॥
mantras.transliteration: prasave ta udīrate tisro vāco makhasyuvaḥ | yadavya eṣi sānavi ||

translations.english: At your birth the three voices of the worshipper are uttered when you go to the summit of the fleece.

mantras.sanskrit: अव्यो वारे परि प्रियं हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । पवमानं मधुश्चुतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: avyo vāre pari priyaṃ hariṃ hinvantyadribhiḥ | pavamānaṃ madhuścutam ||

translations.english: (The priests) effuse with the stones into the fleece the beloved green-tinted purifying honey-dropping (Soma).

mantras.sanskrit: आ पवस्व मदिन्तम पवित्रं धारया कवे । अर्कस्य योनिमासदम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā pavasva madintama pavitraṃ dhārayā kave | arkasya yonimāsadam ||

translations.english: Most exhilarating sage (Soma), flow in a stream to the filter to sit on Indra'slap.

mantras.sanskrit: स पवस्व मदिन्तम गोभिरञ्जानो अक्तुभिः । इन्दविन्द्राय पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa pavasva madintama gobhirañjāno aktubhiḥ | indavindrāya pītaye ||

translations.english: Most exhilarating Indu, being anointed with the unguents of milk and curds flow forth for Indra's drinking.

mantras.sanskrit: अध्वर्यो अद्रिभिः सुतं सोमं पवित्र आ सृज । पुनीहीन्द्राय पातवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhvaryo adribhiḥ sutaṃ somaṃ pavitra ā sṛja | punīhīndrāya pātave ||

translations.english: Adhvaryu, pour upon the filter the Soma that has been expressed with the stones, purify it for Indra's drinking.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवः पीयूषमुत्तमं सोममिन्द्राय वज्रिणे । सुनोता मधुमत्तमम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: divaḥ pīyūṣamuttamaṃ somamindrāya vajriṇe | sunotā madhumattamam ||

translations.english: (Adhvaryus), effuse the most sweet-flavoured Soma, the best ambrosia of heaven for Indra, the wielder of the thunderbolt.

mantras.sanskrit: तव त्य इन्दो अन्धसो देवा मधोर्व्यश्नते । पवमानस्य मरुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava tya indo andhaso devā madhorvyaśnate | pavamānasya marutaḥ ||

translations.english: Indu, the gods and the Maruts partake your sweet purifying beverage.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं हि सोम वर्धयन्त्सुतो मदाय भूर्णये । वृषन्त्स्तोतारमूतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ hi soma vardhayantsuto madāya bhūrṇaye | vṛṣantstotāramūtaye ||

translations.english: For you, Soma, being effused, approach the worshipper for speedy exhilaration and protection.

mantras.sanskrit: अभ्यर्ष विचक्षण पवित्रं धारया सुतः । अभि वाजमुत श्रवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhyarṣa vicakṣaṇa pavitraṃ dhārayā sutaḥ | abhi vājamuta śravaḥ ||

translations.english: Hasten, sagacious (Soma), when you are effused, to the filter in a stream; bestow upon us food and fame.

mantras.sanskrit: परि द्युक्षः सनद्रयिर्भरद्वाजं नो अन्धसा । सुवानो अर्ष पवित्र आ ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari dyukṣaḥ sanadrayirbharadvājaṃ no andhasā | suvāno arṣa pavitra ā ||

translations.english: May the glittering (Soma), the acquirer of wealth; bestow upon us strength together with food; hasten when effused to the filter.

mantras.sanskrit: तव प्रत्नेभिरध्वभिरव्यो वारे परि प्रियः । सहस्रधारो यात्तना ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava pratnebhiradhvabhiravyo vāre pari priyaḥ | sahasradhāro yāttanā ||

translations.english: Your juice dear (to the gods), flowing in a thousand streams, proceeds by ancient paths to the fleecy filter.

mantras.sanskrit: चरुर्न यस्तमीङ्खयेन्दो न दानमीङ्खय । वधैर्वधस्नवीङ्खय ॥
mantras.transliteration: carurna yastamīṅkhayendo na dānamīṅkhaya | vadhairvadhasnavīṅkhaya ||

translations.english: (Soma), send (us) him who is like a pot; Indu, send us now wealth; swift-flowing (Soma), send it with blows (of stones).

mantras.sanskrit: नि शुष्ममिन्दवेषां पुरुहूत जनानाम् । यो अस्माँ आदिदेशति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni śuṣmamindaveṣāṃ puruhūta janānām | yo asmā~ ādideśati ||

translations.english: Indu, the invoked of many, overthrow the strength of those people who challenge us.

mantras.sanskrit: शतं न इन्द ऊतिभिः सहस्रं वा शुचीनाम् । पवस्व मंहयद्रयिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śataṃ na inda ūtibhiḥ sahasraṃ vā śucīnām | pavasva maṃhayadrayiḥ ||

translations.english: Indu, do you who are the distributor of riches, pour forth for our protection a hundred or a thousand of your pure (streams).

mantras.sanskrit: उत्ते शुष्मासो अस्थू रक्षो भिन्दन्तो अद्रिवः । नुदस्व याः परिस्पृधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: utte śuṣmāso asthū rakṣo bhindanto adrivaḥ | nudasva yāḥ parispṛdhaḥ ||

translations.english: (Soma) armed with the stones, your powerful streams rise up scattering the rākṣasas; drive away those who are our adversaries.

mantras.sanskrit: अया निजघ्निरोजसा रथसंगे धने हिते । स्तवा अबिभ्युषा हृदा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayā nijaghnirojasā rathasaṃge dhane hite | stavā abibhyuṣā hṛdā ||

translations.english: (You are) by this strength the discomfited (of foes), I praise you with a fearless heart for the sake of (our) line of chariots ranged (against the foe) and for the sake of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य व्रतानि नाधृषे पवमानस्य दूढ्या । रुज यस्त्वा पृतन्यति ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya vratāni nādhṛṣe pavamānasya dūḍhyā | ruja yastvā pṛtanyati ||

translations.english: The prowess of you (Soma) as you are poured forth is irresistible against the malignant (rākṣasas); destroy him who defies you to battle.

mantras.sanskrit: तं हिन्वन्ति मदच्युतं हरिं नदीषु वाजिनम् । इन्दुमिन्द्राय मत्सरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ hinvanti madacyutaṃ hariṃ nadīṣu vājinam | indumindrāya matsaram ||

translations.english: (The priests) plural nge Indu, honey-dropping, green-tinted, vigorous, exhilarating, into the waters for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य प्रत्नामनु द्युतं शुक्रं दुदुह्रे अह्रयः । पयः सहस्रसामृषिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya pratnāmanu dyutaṃ śukraṃ duduhre ahrayaḥ | payaḥ sahasrasāmṛṣim ||

translations.english: Towards Soma's ancient body the seers milk the flashing fluid, the sage who grants a thousand boons.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं सूर्य इवोपदृगयं सरांसि धावति । सप्त प्रवत आ दिवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ sūrya ivopadṛgayaṃ sarāṃsi dhāvati | sapta pravata ā divam ||

translations.english: He like the sun is the supervisor (of all acts); he hastens to the lakes, he unites with the seven down-descending rivers from heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं विश्वानि तिष्ठति पुनानो भुवनोपरि । सोमो देवो न सूर्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ viśvāni tiṣṭhati punāno bhuvanopari | somo devo na sūryaḥ ||

translations.english: The purified Soma, like the divine sun, abides above all regions.

mantras.sanskrit: परि णो देववीतये वाजाँ अर्षसि गोमतः । पुनान इन्दविन्द्रयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari ṇo devavītaye vājā~ arṣasi gomataḥ | punāna indavindrayuḥ ||

translations.english: Purified Indu, who are devoted to Indra, pour down for our sacrifice, food with milk and curds.

mantras.sanskrit: यवंयवं नो अन्धसा पुष्टम्पुष्टं परि स्रव । सोम विश्वा च सौभगा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yavaṃyavaṃ no andhasā puṣṭampuṣṭaṃ pari srava | soma viśvā ca saubhagā ||

translations.english: Soma, pour forth (in a stream of) food, abundant soft-collected (juice), and all good things.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्दो यथा तव स्तवो यथा ते जातमन्धसः । नि बर्हिषि प्रिये सदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indo yathā tava stavo yathā te jātamandhasaḥ | ni barhiṣi priye sadaḥ ||

translations.english: Indu, since the praise of you as food, since your birth (has appeared), sit down upon the grass that plural ases (you).

mantras.sanskrit: उत नो गोविदश्ववित्पवस्व सोमान्धसा । मक्षूतमेभिरहभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta no govidaśvavitpavasva somāndhasā | makṣūtamebhirahabhiḥ ||

translations.english: And Soma, do you who are the giver of cattle, the giver of horses, flow to us in (a stream of) food as the days quickly pass.

mantras.sanskrit: यो जिनाति न जीयते हन्ति शत्रुमभीत्य । स पवस्व सहस्रजित् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo jināti na jīyate hanti śatrumabhītya | sa pavasva sahasrajit ||

translations.english: Flow forth, O conqueror of thousands, who conquers and is not conquered, and attacking slays his foe.

mantras.sanskrit: परि सोम ऋतं बृहदाशुः पवित्रे अर्षति । विघ्नन्रक्षांसि देवयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari soma ṛtaṃ bṛhadāśuḥ pavitre arṣati | vighnanrakṣāṃsi devayuḥ ||

translations.english: The swift Soma devoted to the gods destroying the rākṣasas in the filter, bestows abundant food (on us).

mantras.sanskrit: यत्सोमो वाजमर्षति शतं धारा अपस्युवः । इन्द्रस्य सख्यमाविशन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatsomo vājamarṣati śataṃ dhārā apasyuvaḥ | indrasya sakhyamāviśan ||

translations.english: When the hundred rite-loving streams (of the Soma) obtain the friendship of Indra, then the Soma brings us food.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि त्वा योषणो दश जारं न कन्यानूषत । मृज्यसे सोम सातये ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi tvā yoṣaṇo daśa jāraṃ na kanyānūṣata | mṛjyase soma sātaye ||

translations.english: The ten fingers commend you, Soma, as a maiden her lover, you are cleansed in order to bestow (wealth on us).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमिन्द्राय विष्णवे स्वादुरिन्दो परि स्रव । नॄन्त्स्तोतॄन्पाह्यंहसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamindrāya viṣṇave svādurindo pari srava | nṝntstotṝnpāhyaṃhasaḥ ||

translations.english: Do you, Indu, who are sweet-flavoured flow for Indra and Viṣṇu preserve the worshippers, your praisers, from sin.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ते धारा असश्चतो दिवो न यन्ति वृष्टयः । अच्छा वाजं सहस्रिणम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra te dhārā asaścato divo na yanti vṛṣṭayaḥ | acchā vājaṃ sahasriṇam ||

translations.english: Your unconnected streams advance towards infinite food (for us) like the showers from heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि प्रियाणि काव्या विश्वा चक्षाणो अर्षति । हरिस्तुञ्जान आयुधा ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi priyāṇi kāvyā viśvā cakṣāṇo arṣati | haristuñjāna āyudhā ||

translations.english: The green-tinted Soma contemplating all the holy acts that are plural asing to the gods rushes (to the sacrifice) brandishing his weapons (against the rākṣasas).

mantras.sanskrit: स मर्मृजान आयुभिरिभो राजेव सुव्रतः । श्येनो न वंसु षीदति ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa marmṛjāna āyubhiribho rājeva suvrataḥ | śyeno na vaṃsu ṣīdati ||

translations.english: He, the object of pious observances, cleansed by the priests, fearless as a king, sits on the waters like a hawk.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो विश्वा दिवो वसूतो पृथिव्या अधि । पुनान इन्दवा भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no viśvā divo vasūto pṛthivyā adhi | punāna indavā bhara ||

translations.english: Indu, when you are purified, bring us all the treasures that are in heaven and upon earth.

mantras.sanskrit: तरत्स मन्दी धावति धारा सुतस्यान्धसः । तरत्स मन्दी धावति ॥
mantras.transliteration: taratsa mandī dhāvati dhārā sutasyāndhasaḥ | taratsa mandī dhāvati ||

translations.english: He the delighted (of the gods) flows rescuing (his worshippers from sin); the stream of the effused beverage (flows); he the delighted (of the gods) flows rescuing (his worshippers from sin).

mantras.sanskrit: उस्रा वेद वसूनां मर्तस्य देव्यवसः । तरत्स मन्दी धावति ॥
mantras.transliteration: usrā veda vasūnāṃ martasya devyavasaḥ | taratsa mandī dhāvati ||

translations.english: The brilliant (stream), the bestower of riches, knows how to protect the worshipper; he the delighted (of the gods) flows rescuing (his worshippers from sin).

mantras.sanskrit: ध्वस्रयोः पुरुषन्त्योरा सहस्राणि दद्महे । तरत्स मन्दी धावति ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhvasrayoḥ puruṣantyorā sahasrāṇi dadmahe | taratsa mandī dhāvati ||

translations.english: We have received thousands from Dhvasra and Puruṣanti; he the delighted (of the gods) flows rescuing (his worshippers from sin).

mantras.sanskrit: आ ययोस्त्रिंशतं तना सहस्राणि च दद्महे । तरत्स मन्दी धावति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yayostriṃśataṃ tanā sahasrāṇi ca dadmahe | taratsa mandī dhāvati ||

translations.english: We have received from those two three hundred thousand garments; he the delighted (of the gods) flows rescuing (his worshippers from sin).

mantras.sanskrit: पवस्व गोजिदश्वजिद्विश्वजित्सोम रण्यजित् । प्रजावद्रत्नमा भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavasva gojidaśvajidviśvajitsoma raṇyajit | prajāvadratnamā bhara ||

translations.english: Flow, Soma, conqueror of cattle, of horses, of all things, of desirable wealth; bring us riches with male offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: पवस्वाद्भ्यो अदाभ्यः पवस्वौषधीभ्यः । पवस्व धिषणाभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavasvādbhyo adābhyaḥ pavasvauṣadhībhyaḥ | pavasva dhiṣaṇābhyaḥ ||

translations.english: Flow with waters and with filaments, flow with herbs, flow with the stones.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं सोम पवमानो विश्वानि दुरिता तर । कविः सीद नि बर्हिषि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ soma pavamāno viśvāni duritā tara | kaviḥ sīda ni barhiṣi ||

translations.english: Soma, do you who are the purifier, the sage, overcome all hindrances; sit down on the sacred grass.

mantras.sanskrit: पवमान स्वर्विदो जायमानोऽभवो महान् । इन्दो विश्वाँ अभीदसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamāna svarvido jāyamāno'bhavo mahān | indo viśvā~ abhīdasi ||

translations.english: O purifying Soma, grant all boons; as soon as you are born you are great; Indu, you overcome all (foes).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र गायत्रेण गायत पवमानं विचर्षणिम् । इन्दुं सहस्रचक्षसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra gāyatreṇa gāyata pavamānaṃ vicarṣaṇim | induṃ sahasracakṣasam ||

translations.english: Hymn with a gāyatrī hymn, Indu the purifier, the all-beholding, the thousand-eyed.

mantras.sanskrit: तं त्वा सहस्रचक्षसमथो सहस्रभर्णसम् । अति वारमपाविषुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ tvā sahasracakṣasamatho sahasrabharṇasam | ati vāramapāviṣuḥ ||

translations.english: You, the thousand-eyed, and the supporter of thousands, they make to flow through the filter.

mantras.sanskrit: अति वारान्पवमानो असिष्यदत्कलशाँ अभि धावति । इन्द्रस्य हार्द्याविशन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ati vārānpavamāno asiṣyadatkalaśā~ abhi dhāvati | indrasya hārdyāviśan ||

translations.english: The purifier trickles through the hairs of the filter; he hastens to the pitchers, entering Indra's heart.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य सोम राधसे शं पवस्व विचर्षणे । प्रजावद्रेत आ भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrasya soma rādhase śaṃ pavasva vicarṣaṇe | prajāvadreta ā bhara ||

translations.english: All-beholding Soma, flow plural asantly for Indra's gratification; bring (us) food with male offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: अया वीती परि स्रव यस्त इन्दो मदेष्वा । अवाहन्नवतीर्नव ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayā vītī pari srava yasta indo madeṣvā | avāhannavatīrnava ||

translations.english: Flow, Indu, for (Indra's) food with that (juice) of yours which in battles overthrow ninety and nine (cities of the foe).

mantras.sanskrit: पुरः सद्य इत्थाधिये दिवोदासाय शम्बरम् । अध त्यं तुर्वशं यदुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: puraḥ sadya itthādhiye divodāsāya śambaram | adha tyaṃ turvaśaṃ yadum ||

translations.english: (Which overturned) the cities in a moment, and for the sake of the devout Divodāsa (subdued) Śambara, and then that Turvaśa and Yadu.

mantras.sanskrit: परि णो अश्वमश्वविद्गोमदिन्दो हिरण्यवत् । क्षरा सहस्रिणीरिषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari ṇo aśvamaśvavidgomadindo hiraṇyavat | kṣarā sahasriṇīriṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Indu, conqueror of horses, shower forth horses with cattle and gold and unbounded food.

mantras.sanskrit: पवमानस्य ते वयं पवित्रमभ्युन्दतः । सखित्वमा वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamānasya te vayaṃ pavitramabhyundataḥ | sakhitvamā vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: We solicit your friendship as you drop flowing over the filter.

mantras.sanskrit: ये ते पवित्रमूर्मयोऽभिक्षरन्ति धारया । तेभिर्नः सोम मृळय ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye te pavitramūrmayo'bhikṣaranti dhārayā | tebhirnaḥ soma mṛḷaya ||

translations.english: Delight us, Soma, with those your undulations what flow over the filter in a stream.

mantras.sanskrit: स नः पुनान आ भर रयिं वीरवतीमिषम् । ईशानः सोम विश्वतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa naḥ punāna ā bhara rayiṃ vīravatīmiṣam | īśānaḥ soma viśvataḥ ||

translations.english: Soma, who are lord over all, the purifier, bring us riches and food with male offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: एतमु त्यं दश क्षिपो मृजन्ति सिन्धुमातरम् । समादित्येभिरख्यत ॥
mantras.transliteration: etamu tyaṃ daśa kṣipo mṛjanti sindhumātaram | samādityebhirakhyata ||

translations.english: The ten fingers cleanse this Soma, whose parents are the rivers; he is associated with the Ādityas.

mantras.sanskrit: समिन्द्रेणोत वायुना सुत एति पवित्र आ । सं सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samindreṇota vāyunā suta eti pavitra ā | saṃ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ ||

translations.english: When effused he proceeds to the filter, with Indra and Vāyu, and with the sun's rays.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो भगाय वायवे पूष्णे पवस्व मधुमान् । चारुर्मित्रे वरुणे च ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no bhagāya vāyave pūṣṇe pavasva madhumān | cārurmitre varuṇe ca ||

translations.english: Do you who are sweet-flavoured and beautiful flow (at) our (sacrifice) for Bhaga, Vāyu, Pūṣaṇ, Mitra and Varuṇa

mantras.sanskrit: उच्चा ते जातमन्धसो दिवि षद्भूम्या ददे । उग्रं शर्म महि श्रवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uccā te jātamandhaso divi ṣadbhūmyā dade | ugraṃ śarma mahi śravaḥ ||

translations.english: The birth of your juice is on high; the earth has received (your) intense happiness and abundant food, though (these) exist (naturally) in heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: एना विश्वान्यर्य आ द्युम्नानि मानुषाणाम् । सिषासन्तो वनामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: enā viśvānyarya ā dyumnāni mānuṣāṇām | siṣāsanto vanāmahe ||

translations.english: By this (Soma) obtaining and desiring to enjoy all the good things that belong to men we enjoy (them).

mantras.sanskrit: स न इन्द्राय यज्यवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः । वरिवोवित्परि स्रव ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa na indrāya yajyave varuṇāya marudbhyaḥ | varivovitpari srava ||

translations.english: O you who are the possessor of wealth flow for us, for the adorable Indra, for Varuṇa and the Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: उपो षु जातमप्तुरं गोभिर्भङ्गं परिष्कृतम् । इन्दुं देवा अयासिषुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: upo ṣu jātamapturaṃ gobhirbhaṅgaṃ pariṣkṛtam | induṃ devā ayāsiṣuḥ ||

translations.english: The gods approach Indu, (who is) completely genitive rated, sent forth by the waters, the demolisher (of foes), adorned with milk and curds.

mantras.sanskrit: तमिद्वर्धन्तु नो गिरो वत्सं संशिश्वरीरिव । य इन्द्रस्य हृदंसनिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamidvardhantu no giro vatsaṃ saṃśiśvarīriva | ya indrasya hṛdaṃsaniḥ ||

translations.english: May our praises foster him who wins the heart of Indra, as cows who have young ones (foster) their calf.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्षा णः सोम शं गवे धुक्षस्व पिप्युषीमिषम् । वर्धा समुद्रमुक्थ्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: arṣā ṇaḥ soma śaṃ gave dhukṣasva pipyuṣīmiṣam | vardhā samudramukthyam ||

translations.english: Soma, pour prosperity upon our cattle, milk forth (for us) nutritious food; augment the laudable water.

mantras.sanskrit: पवमानो अजीजनद्दिवश्चित्रं न तन्यतुम् । ज्योतिर्वैश्वानरं बृहत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamāno ajījanaddivaścitraṃ na tanyatum | jyotirvaiśvānaraṃ bṛhat ||

translations.english: The pure (Soma) has genitive rated in heaven the great Vaiśvānara light like the wonderful thunder.

mantras.sanskrit: पवमानस्य ते रसो मदो राजन्नदुच्छुनः । वि वारमव्यमर्षति ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamānasya te raso mado rājannaducchunaḥ | vi vāramavyamarṣati ||

translations.english: Bright shining Soma, the juice of you, when your flow enters the woollen filter, exhilarating free from evil.

mantras.sanskrit: पवमान रसस्तव दक्षो वि राजति द्युमान् । ज्योतिर्विश्वं स्वर्दृशे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamāna rasastava dakṣo vi rājati dyumān | jyotirviśvaṃ svardṛśe ||

translations.english: Purified Soma, your juice as it increases shines bright; it (makes) a pervading universal light to be seen.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्ते मदो वरेण्यस्तेना पवस्वान्धसा । देवावीरघशंसहा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaste mado vareṇyastenā pavasvāndhasā | devāvīraghaśaṃsahā ||

translations.english: Flow forth with that juice of yours which is exhilarating, the best gratifying the gods, the slayer of rākṣasas.

mantras.sanskrit: जघ्निर्वृत्रममित्रियं सस्निर्वाजं दिवेदिवे । गोषा उ अश्वसा असि ॥
mantras.transliteration: jaghnirvṛtramamitriyaṃ sasnirvājaṃ divedive | goṣā u aśvasā asi ||

translations.english: You are the slayer of the hostile Vṛtra, the enjoyed of battle day by day, the giver of kine and the giver of horses.

mantras.sanskrit: सम्मिश्लो अरुषो भव सूपस्थाभिर्न धेनुभिः । सीदञ्छ्येनो न योनिमा ॥
mantras.transliteration: sammiślo aruṣo bhava sūpasthābhirna dhenubhiḥ | sīdañchyeno na yonimā ||

translations.english: Be now resplendent, mixed with the supporting (products of the) kine, alighting like a falcon on your plural ce.

mantras.sanskrit: स पवस्व य आविथेन्द्रं वृत्राय हन्तवे । वव्रिवांसं महीरपः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa pavasva ya āvithendraṃ vṛtrāya hantave | vavrivāṃsaṃ mahīrapaḥ ||

translations.english: Flow you who did help Indra to slay Vṛtra, who obstructed the great waters.

mantras.sanskrit: सुवीरासो वयं धना जयेम सोम मीढ्वः । पुनानो वर्ध नो गिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: suvīrāso vayaṃ dhanā jayema soma mīḍhvaḥ | punāno vardha no giraḥ ||

translations.english: May we, possessed of excellent male offspring, conquer the wealth (of our enemies), O Soma, the sprinkler; being purified, accept our praises.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वोतासस्तवावसा स्याम वन्वन्त आमुरः । सोम व्रतेषु जागृहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvotāsastavāvasā syāma vanvanta āmuraḥ | soma vrateṣu jāgṛhi ||

translations.english: Protected by you, through your protection may we be victorious, slaying (our enemies); be vigilant Soma, at our sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: अपघ्नन्पवते मृधोऽप सोमो अराव्णः । गच्छन्निन्द्रस्य निष्कृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: apaghnanpavate mṛdho'pa somo arāvṇaḥ | gacchannindrasya niṣkṛtam ||

translations.english: The Soma flows, slaying the malignant, slaying the withholders (of wealth), proceeding to Indra's consecrated (station).

mantras.sanskrit: महो नो राय आ भर पवमान जही मृधः । रास्वेन्दो वीरवद्यशः ॥
mantras.transliteration: maho no rāya ā bhara pavamāna jahī mṛdhaḥ | rāsvendo vīravadyaśaḥ ||

translations.english: Bring us, purifier, much wealth; conquer our foes; grant us, Indu, fame and male offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: न त्वा शतं चन ह्रुतो राधो दित्सन्तमा मिनन् । यत्पुनानो मखस्यसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: na tvā śataṃ cana hruto rādho ditsantamā minan | yatpunāno makhasyase ||

translations.english: A hundred foes harm you not, purposing to give wealth when being purified you are benevolently inclined.

mantras.sanskrit: पवस्वेन्दो वृषा सुतः कृधी नो यशसो जने । विश्वा अप द्विषो जहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavasvendo vṛṣā sutaḥ kṛdhī no yaśaso jane | viśvā apa dviṣo jahi ||

translations.english: You, Indu, when effused, the showerer (of benefits) make us celebrated among men; slay all our enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य ते सख्ये वयं तवेन्दो द्युम्न उत्तमे । सासह्याम पृतन्यतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya te sakhye vayaṃ tavendo dyumna uttame | sāsahyāma pṛtanyataḥ ||

translations.english: (Enjoying) the friendship of you here and you excellent food, Indu, may we overcome our assailants.

mantras.sanskrit: या ते भीमान्यायुधा तिग्मानि सन्ति धूर्वणे । रक्षा समस्य नो निदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā te bhīmānyāyudhā tigmāni santi dhūrvaṇe | rakṣā samasya no nidaḥ ||

translations.english: With your weapons which are formidable and sharp for slaying (the foe), defend us from the scorn (of our enemies).

mantras.sanskrit: एते असृग्रमिन्दवस्तिरः पवित्रमाशवः । विश्वान्यभि सौभगा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ete asṛgramindavastiraḥ pavitramāśavaḥ | viśvānyabhi saubhagā ||

translations.english: These rapid Soma juices have directed through the filter (to obtain) all good things.

mantras.sanskrit: विघ्नन्तो दुरिता पुरु सुगा तोकाय वाजिनः । तना कृण्वन्तो अर्वते ॥
mantras.transliteration: vighnanto duritā puru sugā tokāya vājinaḥ | tanā kṛṇvanto arvate ||

translations.english: Powerful, repelling evils, bestowing happiness and riches upon our sons and horses.

mantras.sanskrit: कृण्वन्तो वरिवो गवेऽभ्यर्षन्ति सुष्टुतिम् । इळामस्मभ्यं संयतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kṛṇvanto varivo gave'bhyarṣanti suṣṭutim | iḷāmasmabhyaṃ saṃyatam ||

translations.english: They advance towards our fair praise, granting to (us and) our cattle sustaining wealth and food.

mantras.sanskrit: असाव्यंशुर्मदायाप्सु दक्षो गिरिष्ठाः । श्येनो न योनिमासदत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asāvyaṃśurmadāyāpsu dakṣo giriṣṭhāḥ | śyeno na yonimāsadat ||

translations.english: The mountain-born Soma flows for exhilaration, mighty in the (vasatīvarī) waters; he alights like a falcon on his own plural ce.

mantras.sanskrit: शुभ्रमन्धो देववातमप्सु धूतो नृभिः सुतः । स्वदन्ति गावः पयोभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śubhramandho devavātamapsu dhūto nṛbhiḥ sutaḥ | svadanti gāvaḥ payobhiḥ ||

translations.english: The cattle sweeten with their milk the beautiful food that is asked for by the gods; the Soma when effused by the priests is cleansed in the water.

mantras.sanskrit: आदीमश्वं न हेतारोऽशूशुभन्नमृताय । मध्वो रसं सधमादे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ādīmaśvaṃ na hetāro'śūśubhannamṛtāya | madhvo rasaṃ sadhamāde ||

translations.english: Then the ministering priests in the assembly beautify the dice of exhilarating (Soma) like a horse, for the sake of immortality.

mantras.sanskrit: यास्ते धारा मधुश्चुतोऽसृग्रमिन्द ऊतये । ताभिः पवित्रमासदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yāste dhārā madhuścuto'sṛgraminda ūtaye | tābhiḥ pavitramāsadaḥ ||

translations.english: Sit down, Indu, on the filter with those streams the shedders of sweet (juice), which are let fall for our protection.

mantras.sanskrit: सो अर्षेन्द्राय पीतये तिरो रोमाण्यव्यया । सीदन्योना वनेष्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: so arṣendrāya pītaye tiro romāṇyavyayā | sīdanyonā vaneṣvā ||

translations.english: Passing obliquely through the sheep's hairs, hasten for Indra's drinking, sitting in your plural ce in the wooden vessels.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमिन्दो परि स्रव स्वादिष्ठो अङ्गिरोभ्यः । वरिवोविद्घृतं पयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamindo pari srava svādiṣṭho aṅgirobhyaḥ | varivovidghṛtaṃ payaḥ ||

translations.english: Indu, who are most sweet-flavoured, the bestower of riches, drop for the Aṅgirasas butter and milk.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं विचर्षणिर्हितः पवमानः स चेतति । हिन्वान आप्यं बृहत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ vicarṣaṇirhitaḥ pavamānaḥ sa cetati | hinvāna āpyaṃ bṛhat ||

translations.english: This all-seeing Pavamāna Soma deposited (in the vessels), sending forth abundant (food), the product of the waters, is known (by all).

mantras.sanskrit: एष वृषा वृषव्रतः पवमानो अशस्तिहा । करद्वसूनि दाशुषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa vṛṣā vṛṣavrataḥ pavamāno aśastihā | karadvasūni dāśuṣe ||

translations.english: This Pavamāna Soma, the sprinkler (of benefits), engaged in sprinkling, the destroyer of rākṣasas, bestows riches upon the donor (of the oblation).

mantras.sanskrit: आ पवस्व सहस्रिणं रयिं गोमन्तमश्विनम् । पुरुश्चन्द्रं पुरुस्पृहम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā pavasva sahasriṇaṃ rayiṃ gomantamaśvinam | puruścandraṃ puruspṛham ||

translations.english: Pour forth thousand-fold wealth, together with cattle and horses, delighting many, desired by many.

mantras.sanskrit: एष स्य परि षिच्यते मर्मृज्यमान आयुभिः । उरुगायः कविक्रतुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa sya pari ṣicyate marmṛjyamāna āyubhiḥ | urugāyaḥ kavikratuḥ ||

translations.english: This (Soma) the many-hymned, having wise designs being cleansed by the priests, is sprinkled forth.

mantras.sanskrit: सहस्रोतिः शतामघो विमानो रजसः कविः । इन्द्राय पवते मदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sahasrotiḥ śatāmagho vimāno rajasaḥ kaviḥ | indrāya pavate madaḥ ||

translations.english: Offering thousand-fold protection, having hundred-fold wealth, the meawsurer of the world, the sage, the exhilarating (Soma) flows for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: गिरा जात इह स्तुत इन्दुरिन्द्राय धीयते । विर्योना वसताविव ॥
mantras.transliteration: girā jāta iha stuta indurindrāya dhīyate | viryonā vasatāviva ||

translations.english: genitive rated and praised by song, Indu at this sacrifice is deposited in his plural ce for Indra, like a bird on its nest.

mantras.sanskrit: पवमानः सुतो नृभिः सोमो वाजमिवासरत् । चमूषु शक्मनासदम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamānaḥ suto nṛbhiḥ somo vājamivāsarat | camūṣu śakmanāsadam ||

translations.english: The pure Soma effused by the priests rushes forth as if to battle, to alight vigorously upon the ladles.

mantras.sanskrit: तं त्रिपृष्ठे त्रिवन्धुरे रथे युञ्जन्ति यातवे । ऋषीणां सप्त धीतिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ tripṛṣṭhe trivandhure rathe yuñjanti yātave | ṛṣīṇāṃ sapta dhītibhiḥ ||

translations.english: They attach him by seven ceremonies to the three-backed three-benched chariot of the ṛṣis to go to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: तं सोतारो धनस्पृतमाशुं वाजाय यातवे । हरिं हिनोत वाजिनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ sotāro dhanaspṛtamāśuṃ vājāya yātave | hariṃ hinota vājinam ||

translations.english: Effused of the Soma, urge forward that wealth bestowing rapid vigorous steed to go to the battle.

mantras.sanskrit: आविशन्कलशं सुतो विश्वा अर्षन्नभि श्रियः । शूरो न गोषु तिष्ठति ॥
mantras.transliteration: āviśankalaśaṃ suto viśvā arṣannabhi śriyaḥ | śūro na goṣu tiṣṭhati ||

translations.english: Entering when effused into the pitcher bringing us all success like a hero, he stands among the cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: आ त इन्दो मदाय कं पयो दुहन्त्यायवः । देवा देवेभ्यो मधु ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā ta indo madāya kaṃ payo duhantyāyavaḥ | devā devebhyo madhu ||

translations.english: The devout priests milk forth your sweet juice Indu, for the gods for the purpose of exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नः सोमं पवित्र आ सृजता मधुमत्तमम् । देवेभ्यो देवश्रुत्तमम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā naḥ somaṃ pavitra ā sṛjatā madhumattamam | devebhyo devaśruttamam ||

translations.english: Pour upon the filter for us for the sake of the gods the most sweet-flavoured Soma, most audible to the godṣ

mantras.sanskrit: एते सोमा असृक्षत गृणानाः श्रवसे महे । मदिन्तमस्य धारया ॥
mantras.transliteration: ete somā asṛkṣata gṛṇānāḥ śravase mahe | madintamasya dhārayā ||

translations.english: These lauded Soma juices are let flow for the sake of abundant food in a stream for the most exhilarating (juice).

mantras.sanskrit: अभि गव्यानि वीतये नृम्णा पुनानो अर्षसि । सनद्वाजः परि स्रव ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi gavyāni vītaye nṛmṇā punāno arṣasi | sanadvājaḥ pari srava ||

translations.english: Being purified you have the treasures of the kine to enjoy (them); flow forth you who grants food.

mantras.sanskrit: उत नो गोमतीरिषो विश्वा अर्ष परिष्टुभः । गृणानो जमदग्निना ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta no gomatīriṣo viśvā arṣa pariṣṭubhaḥ | gṛṇāno jamadagninā ||

translations.english: And have for us towards all widely renowned food with cattle, being hymned by Jamadagni.

mantras.sanskrit: पवस्व वाचो अग्रियः सोम चित्राभिरूतिभिः । अभि विश्वानि काव्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavasva vāco agriyaḥ soma citrābhirūtibhiḥ | abhi viśvāni kāvyā ||

translations.english: Soma, who are most excellent, flow with your marvellous protection towards our praises, towards all hymns (of praise).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं समुद्रिया अपोऽग्रियो वाच ईरयन् । पवस्व विश्वमेजय ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ samudriyā apo'griyo vāca īrayan | pavasva viśvamejaya ||

translations.english: Agitator of all, do you who are the most excellent raising your voice, pour forth the waters of the firmament.

mantras.sanskrit: तुभ्येमा भुवना कवे महिम्ने सोम तस्थिरे । तुभ्यमर्षन्ति सिन्धवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tubhyemā bhuvanā kave mahimne soma tasthire | tubhyamarṣanti sindhavaḥ ||

translations.english: O sage (Soma) in your might do these worlds stand; to you the rivers hasten.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ते दिवो न वृष्टयो धारा यन्त्यसश्चतः । अभि शुक्रामुपस्तिरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra te divo na vṛṣṭayo dhārā yantyasaścataḥ | abhi śukrāmupastiram ||

translations.english: Your unconnected streams descend like the rian from heaven upon the white outspread (fleece).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रायेन्दुं पुनीतनोग्रं दक्षाय साधनम् । ईशानं वीतिराधसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāyenduṃ punītanograṃ dakṣāya sādhanam | īśānaṃ vītirādhasam ||

translations.english: Purify for Indra the fierce Indu, the means of strength, the lord (of wealth), the giver of riches.

mantras.sanskrit: पवमान ऋतः कविः सोमः पवित्रमासदत् । दधत्स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamāna ṛtaḥ kaviḥ somaḥ pavitramāsadat | dadhatstotre suvīryam ||

translations.english: The truthful seer, Pavamaāna Soma, sits down upon the filter, giving great energy to the worshipper.

mantras.sanskrit: आ पवस्व सहस्रिणं रयिं सोम सुवीर्यम् । अस्मे श्रवांसि धारय ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā pavasva sahasriṇaṃ rayiṃ soma suvīryam | asme śravāṃsi dhāraya ||

translations.english: Pour (upon us), Soma, thousand-fold wealth, with excellent male progeny, secure to us ample food.

mantras.sanskrit: इषमूर्जं च पिन्वस इन्द्राय मत्सरिन्तमः । चमूष्वा नि षीदसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: iṣamūrjaṃ ca pinvasa indrāya matsarintamaḥ | camūṣvā ni ṣīdasi ||

translations.english: You who are most exhilarating effuse food and drink for Indra; you sit on the ladles.

mantras.sanskrit: सुत इन्द्राय विष्णवे सोमः कलशे अक्षरत् । मधुमाँ अस्तु वायवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: suta indrāya viṣṇave somaḥ kalaśe akṣarat | madhumā~ astu vāyave ||

translations.english: Soma effused for Indra and Viṣṇu and Vāyu drops into the pitcher; may he be sweet-flavoured.

mantras.sanskrit: एते असृग्रमाशवोऽति ह्वरांसि बभ्रवः । सोमा ऋतस्य धारया ॥
mantras.transliteration: ete asṛgramāśavo'ti hvarāṃsi babhravaḥ | somā ṛtasya dhārayā ||

translations.english: These swift-flowing tawny-coloured Soma juices, with a stream of water are let loose upon the rākṣasas.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रं वर्धन्तो अप्तुरः कृण्वन्तो विश्वमार्यम् । अपघ्नन्तो अराव्णः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraṃ vardhanto apturaḥ kṛṇvanto viśvamāryam | apaghnanto arāvṇaḥ ||

translations.english: Augmenting Indra, urging the waters, making all our acts prosperous, destroying the withholders (of oblations).

mantras.sanskrit: सुता अनु स्वमा रजोऽभ्यर्षन्ति बभ्रवः । इन्द्रं गच्छन्त इन्दवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sutā anu svamā rajo'bhyarṣanti babhravaḥ | indraṃ gacchanta indavaḥ ||

translations.english: The effused tawny-coloured Soma-juices going to Indra have to their own plural ce.

mantras.sanskrit: अया पवस्व धारया यया सूर्यमरोचयः । हिन्वानो मानुषीरपः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayā pavasva dhārayā yayā sūryamarocayaḥ | hinvāno mānuṣīrapaḥ ||

translations.english: Flow with that stream with which you, Soma, light up the sun, urging on the waters beneficial to man.

mantras.sanskrit: अयुक्त सूर एतशं पवमानो मनावधि । अन्तरिक्षेण यातवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayukta sūra etaśaṃ pavamāno manāvadhi | antarikṣeṇa yātave ||

translations.english: The purified (Soma) harnesses the horse of the sun to travel through the firmament to man.

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्या हरितो दश सूरो अयुक्त यातवे । इन्दुरिन्द्र इति ब्रुवन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tyā harito daśa sūro ayukta yātave | indurindra iti bruvan ||

translations.english: And Indu exclaiming 'Indra!' harnesses the (horse of the) sun to go towards these ten regions.

mantras.sanskrit: परीतो वायवे सुतं गिर इन्द्राय मत्सरम् । अव्यो वारेषु सिञ्चत ॥
mantras.transliteration: parīto vāyave sutaṃ gira indrāya matsaram | avyo vāreṣu siñcata ||

translations.english: Sprinkle worshipper, upon the woollen fleece the exhilarating (Soma) that has been effused in all directions for Vāyu and for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: पवमान विदा रयिमस्मभ्यं सोम दुष्टरम् । यो दूणाशो वनुष्यता ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamāna vidā rayimasmabhyaṃ soma duṣṭaram | yo dūṇāśo vanuṣyatā ||

translations.english: Purified Soma, grant us wealth unassailable (by our foes), and which cannot be destroyed by the enemy.

mantras.sanskrit: अभ्यर्ष सहस्रिणं रयिं गोमन्तमश्विनम् । अभि वाजमुत श्रवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhyarṣa sahasriṇaṃ rayiṃ gomantamaśvinam | abhi vājamuta śravaḥ ||

translations.english: Bring to us thousandfold wealth with cattle and horses; bring vigour and food.

mantras.sanskrit: सोमो देवो न सूर्योऽद्रिभिः पवते सुतः । दधानः कलशे रसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: somo devo na sūryo'dribhiḥ pavate sutaḥ | dadhānaḥ kalaśe rasam ||

translations.english: Soma, like the radiant sun, when effused flows forth, depositing its juice in the pitcher.

mantras.sanskrit: एते धामान्यार्या शुक्रा ऋतस्य धारया । वाजं गोमन्तमक्षरन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ete dhāmānyāryā śukrā ṛtasya dhārayā | vājaṃ gomantamakṣaran ||

translations.english: These brilliang Soma-juices (flowing) towards the dwellings of respectable (worshippers), effuse food and cattle in a stream of water.

mantras.sanskrit: सुता इन्द्राय वज्रिणे सोमासो दध्याशिरः । पवित्रमत्यक्षरन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sutā indrāya vajriṇe somāso dadhyāśiraḥ | pavitramatyakṣaran ||

translations.english: The Soma-juices mixed with curds effused for Indra, the wielder of the thunderbolt, flow through the filter.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सोम मधुमत्तमो राये अर्ष पवित्र आ । मदो यो देववीतमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra soma madhumattamo rāye arṣa pavitra ā | mado yo devavītamaḥ ||

translations.english: Soma, pour into the filter to bring us wealth (your juice), which is most sweet-flavoured, exhilarating and most desired by the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: तमी मृजन्त्यायवो हरिं नदीषु वाजिनम् । इन्दुमिन्द्राय मत्सरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamī mṛjantyāyavo hariṃ nadīṣu vājinam | indumindrāya matsaram ||

translations.english: The priests cleanse in the (vasatīvarī) waters the green-tinted powerful exhilarating Indu for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: आ पवस्व हिरण्यवदश्वावत्सोम वीरवत् । वाजं गोमन्तमा भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā pavasva hiraṇyavadaśvāvatsoma vīravat | vājaṃ gomantamā bhara ||

translations.english: Soma, pour forth wealth of gold, horses and male offspring; bring us food and cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: परि वाजे न वाजयुमव्यो वारेषु सिञ्चत । इन्द्राय मधुमत्तमम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari vāje na vājayumavyo vāreṣu siñcata | indrāya madhumattamam ||

translations.english: Sprinkle upon the woollen fleece for Indra the most sweet (Soma), desiring battle as if in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: कविं मृजन्ति मर्ज्यं धीभिर्विप्रा अवस्यवः । वृषा कनिक्रदर्षति ॥
mantras.transliteration: kaviṃ mṛjanti marjyaṃ dhībhirviprā avasyavaḥ | vṛṣā kanikradarṣati ||

translations.english: The (worshippers) desiring protection, cleanse with their fingers the purifiable (Soma) the sage; with a noise the sprinkler (of benefits) flows forth.

mantras.sanskrit: वृषणं धीभिरप्तुरं सोममृतस्य धारया । मती विप्राः समस्वरन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣaṇaṃ dhībhirapturaṃ somamṛtasya dhārayā | matī viprāḥ samasvaran ||

translations.english: The wise (priests) in a stream of water send forth with their fingers, and with praise the sprinkler (of benefits), the shedder of water.

mantras.sanskrit: पवस्व देवायुषगिन्द्रं गच्छतु ते मदः । वायुमा रोह धर्मणा ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavasva devāyuṣagindraṃ gacchatu te madaḥ | vāyumā roha dharmaṇā ||

translations.english: Flow, (Soma), let your exhilarating juice proceed in continuous order to Indra, rise with your supporting (juice to Vāyu).

mantras.sanskrit: पवमान नि तोशसे रयिं सोम श्रवाय्यम् । प्रियः समुद्रमा विश ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamāna ni tośase rayiṃ soma śravāyyam | priyaḥ samudramā viśa ||

translations.english: Purified Soma, you squeeze forth the celebrated riches (of the enemy); do you who are beloved enter the ocean.

mantras.sanskrit: अपघ्नन्पवसे मृधः क्रतुवित्सोम मत्सरः । नुदस्वादेवयुं जनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: apaghnanpavase mṛdhaḥ kratuvitsoma matsaraḥ | nudasvādevayuṃ janam ||

translations.english: Soma, you who are exhilarating flow defeating the enemies, bestowing knowledge (on us); drive off the people who love not the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: पवमाना असृक्षत सोमाः शुक्रास इन्दवः । अभि विश्वानि काव्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamānā asṛkṣata somāḥ śukrāsa indavaḥ | abhi viśvāni kāvyā ||

translations.english: The brilliant purified Soma-juices are let fall amidst all praises.

mantras.sanskrit: पवमानास आशवः शुभ्रा असृग्रमिन्दवः । घ्नन्तो विश्वा अप द्विषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamānāsa āśavaḥ śubhrā asṛgramindavaḥ | ghnanto viśvā apa dviṣaḥ ||

translations.english: The purified Soma-juices flow swift and bright destroying all enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: पवमाना दिवस्पर्यन्तरिक्षादसृक्षत । पृथिव्या अधि सानवि ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamānā divasparyantarikṣādasṛkṣata | pṛthivyā adhi sānavi ||

translations.english: The purified (juices) are poured forth from heaven and from the firmament upon the summit of the ground.

mantras.sanskrit: पुनानः सोम धारयेन्दो विश्वा अप स्रिधः । जहि रक्षांसि सुक्रतो ॥
mantras.transliteration: punānaḥ soma dhārayendo viśvā apa sridhaḥ | jahi rakṣāṃsi sukrato ||

translations.english: Brilliant Soma, do you, purified in a stream, achieving great acts, destroy all foes and the rākṣasas.

mantras.sanskrit: अपघ्नन्त्सोम रक्षसोऽभ्यर्ष कनिक्रदत् । द्युमन्तं शुष्ममुत्तमम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: apaghnantsoma rakṣaso'bhyarṣa kanikradat | dyumantaṃ śuṣmamuttamam ||

translations.english: Destroying the rākṣasas, pour forth, Soma, with a noise, brilliant and excellent vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मे वसूनि धारय सोम दिव्यानि पार्थिवा । इन्दो विश्वानि वार्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: asme vasūni dhāraya soma divyāni pārthivā | indo viśvāni vāryā ||

translations.english: Bestow upon us, Soma, celestial and terrestrial treasures; (bestow), Indu, all desirable things.

mantras.sanskrit: वृषा सोम द्युमाँ असि वृषा देव वृषव्रतः । वृषा धर्माणि दधिषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣā soma dyumā~ asi vṛṣā deva vṛṣavrataḥ | vṛṣā dharmāṇi dadhiṣe ||

translations.english: You, Soma, are the bright sprinkler; you shining (Soma) are the sprinkler whose occupation is sprinkling; you, the sprinkler, sustain the rites (of men and gods).

mantras.sanskrit: वृष्णस्ते वृष्ण्यं शवो वृषा वनं वृषा मदः । सत्यं वृषन्वृषेदसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣṇaste vṛṣṇyaṃ śavo vṛṣā vanaṃ vṛṣā madaḥ | satyaṃ vṛṣanvṛṣedasi ||

translations.english: O sprinkler, the strengh of you the sprinkler consists in sprinkling, your worship consists in sprinkling,  your juice consists in sprinkling; you truly are always the sprinkler.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्वो न चक्रदो वृषा सं गा इन्दो समर्वतः । वि नो राये दुरो वृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvo na cakrado vṛṣā saṃ gā indo samarvataḥ | vi no rāye duro vṛdhi ||

translations.english: Indu, the sprinkler, you nigh like a horse; you give us cattle, you give us horses; open the doors for our wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: असृक्षत प्र वाजिनो गव्या सोमासो अश्वया । शुक्रासो वीरयाशवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asṛkṣata pra vājino gavyā somāso aśvayā | śukrāso vīrayāśavaḥ ||

translations.english: The powerful, brilliant, rapid Soma-juices are effused in the hope of obtaining cattle, horses, and male offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: शुम्भमाना ऋतायुभिर्मृज्यमाना गभस्त्योः । पवन्ते वारे अव्यये ॥
mantras.transliteration: śumbhamānā ṛtāyubhirmṛjyamānā gabhastyoḥ | pavante vāre avyaye ||

translations.english: The (Soma-juices) beautified by those desirous of sacrifice, cleansed by their hands, flow through the woollen fleece.

mantras.sanskrit: ते विश्वा दाशुषे वसु सोमा दिव्यानि पार्थिवा । पवन्तामान्तरिक्ष्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: te viśvā dāśuṣe vasu somā divyāni pārthivā | pavantāmāntarikṣyā ||

translations.english: May those Soma-juices pour forth for the offerer (of libations) all the treasures of heaven and earth and of the firmament.

mantras.sanskrit: पवमानस्य विश्ववित्प्र ते सर्गा असृक्षत । सूर्यस्येव न रश्मयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamānasya viśvavitpra te sargā asṛkṣata | sūryasyeva na raśmayaḥ ||

translations.english: All-beholding Soma, your streams as you are being purified are sent forth like the rays of the sun at present.

mantras.sanskrit: केतुं कृण्वन्दिवस्परि विश्वा रूपाभ्यर्षसि । समुद्रः सोम पिन्वसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ketuṃ kṛṇvandivaspari viśvā rūpābhyarṣasi | samudraḥ soma pinvase ||

translations.english: Soma, you who are the ocean, bestowing knowledge, have from heaven to all our various forms, and bestow (variouskinds of wealth on us).

mantras.sanskrit: हिन्वानो वाचमिष्यसि पवमान विधर्मणि । अक्रान्देवो न सूर्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: hinvāno vācamiṣyasi pavamāna vidharmaṇi | akrāndevo na sūryaḥ ||

translations.english: Purified Soma, when sent forth you utter a cry (when your juice) like the sun god passed through the supporting (filter).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्दुः पविष्ट चेतनः प्रियः कवीनां मती । सृजदश्वं रथीरिव ॥
mantras.transliteration: induḥ paviṣṭa cetanaḥ priyaḥ kavīnāṃ matī | sṛjadaśvaṃ rathīriva ||

translations.english: Indu the enlightener, beloved (of the gods), flows forth at the praise of the sages; he lets loose (his wave) as a charioteer his horse.

mantras.sanskrit: ऊर्मिर्यस्ते पवित्र आ देवावीः पर्यक्षरत् । सीदन्नृतस्य योनिमा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūrmiryaste pavitra ā devāvīḥ paryakṣarat | sīdannṛtasya yonimā ||

translations.english: Your wave which, devoted to the gods flows to the filter, alighting upon the plural ce of sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो अर्ष पवित्र आ मदो यो देववीतमः । इन्दविन्द्राय पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no arṣa pavitra ā mado yo devavītamaḥ | indavindrāya pītaye ||

translations.english: Indu, who are exhilarating and most devoted to the gods, hasten to the filter for Indra to drink.

mantras.sanskrit: इषे पवस्व धारया मृज्यमानो मनीषिभिः । इन्दो रुचाभि गा इहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: iṣe pavasva dhārayā mṛjyamāno manīṣibhiḥ | indo rucābhi gā ihi ||

translations.english: Cleansed by the priests, Indu, flow in a stream for (our) food; approach the cattle with food.

mantras.sanskrit: पुनानो वरिवस्कृध्यूर्जं जनाय गिर्वणः । हरे सृजान आशिरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: punāno varivaskṛdhyūrjaṃ janāya girvaṇaḥ | hare sṛjāna āśiram ||

translations.english: Green-tinted (Soma) lauded by hymns,being dropped into the curds and milk and being purified, bestow wealth and food upon the worshipper.

mantras.sanskrit: पुनानो देववीतय इन्द्रस्य याहि निष्कृतम् । द्युतानो वाजिभिर्यतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: punāno devavītaya indrasya yāhi niṣkṛtam | dyutāno vājibhiryataḥ ||

translations.english: Purified for the banquet of the gods, go to Indra's station radiant, collected together by the vigorous (worshippers).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र हिन्वानास इन्दवोऽच्छा समुद्रमाशवः । धिया जूता असृक्षत ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra hinvānāsa indavo'cchā samudramāśavaḥ | dhiyā jūtā asṛkṣata ||

translations.english: The rapid Soma-juices being sent towards the firmament, are poured forth expressed by the fingers.

mantras.sanskrit: मर्मृजानास आयवो वृथा समुद्रमिन्दवः । अग्मन्नृतस्य योनिमा ॥
mantras.transliteration: marmṛjānāsa āyavo vṛthā samudramindavaḥ | agmannṛtasya yonimā ||

translations.english: The swift Soma-juices being cleansed (go to) the firmament without an effort; they go to the abode of the water.

mantras.sanskrit: परि णो याह्यस्मयुर्विश्वा वसून्योजसा । पाहि नः शर्म वीरवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari ṇo yāhyasmayurviśvā vasūnyojasā | pāhi naḥ śarma vīravat ||

translations.english: Soma, who are devoted to us, guard all our treasures with your might; protect our home and offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: मिमाति वह्निरेतशः पदं युजान ऋक्वभिः । प्र यत्समुद्र आहितः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mimāti vahniretaśaḥ padaṃ yujāna ṛkvabhiḥ | pra yatsamudra āhitaḥ ||

translations.english: The horse of burden neighs, yoked to the sacrifice by the priests, when plural ced in the ocean.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यद्योनिं हिरण्ययमाशुॠतस्य सीदति । जहात्यप्रचेतसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yadyoniṃ hiraṇyayamāśuṝtasya sīdati | jahātyapracetasaḥ ||

translations.english: When the swift (Soma) takes his plural ce on the golden seat of sacrifice, he abandons (the sacrifice) of the foolish man.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि वेना अनूषतेयक्षन्ति प्रचेतसः । मज्जन्त्यविचेतसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi venā anūṣateyakṣanti pracetasaḥ | majjantyavicetasaḥ ||

translations.english: Devoted (worshippers) glorify Soma; the well-disposed desire to sacrifice; the perverse-minded sink (into hell).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रायेन्दो मरुत्वते पवस्व मधुमत्तमः । ऋतस्य योनिमासदम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāyendo marutvate pavasva madhumattamaḥ | ṛtasya yonimāsadam ||

translations.english: Flow, Indu, for Indra associated with the Maruts, you who are most sweet-flavoured, and take your seat on the plural ce of the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: तं त्वा विप्रा वचोविदः परि ष्कृण्वन्ति वेधसः । सं त्वा मृजन्त्यायवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ tvā viprā vacovidaḥ pari ṣkṛṇvanti vedhasaḥ | saṃ tvā mṛjantyāyavaḥ ||

translations.english: The wise who are the performers of pious acts, who are acquainted with holy texts, adorn you; men purify you.

mantras.sanskrit: रसं ते मित्रो अर्यमा पिबन्ति वरुणः कवे । पवमानस्य मरुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: rasaṃ te mitro aryamā pibanti varuṇaḥ kave | pavamānasya marutaḥ ||

translations.english: Mitra, Aryaman, Varuṇa and the Maruts drink, sage (Soma), your juice as you drop.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं सोम विपश्चितं पुनानो वाचमिष्यसि । इन्दो सहस्रभर्णसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ soma vipaścitaṃ punāno vācamiṣyasi | indo sahasrabharṇasam ||

translations.english: Brilliant Soma, when purified you utter a sapient speech, feeding thousands.

mantras.sanskrit: उतो सहस्रभर्णसं वाचं सोम मखस्युवम् । पुनान इन्दवा भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: uto sahasrabharṇasaṃ vācaṃ soma makhasyuvam | punāna indavā bhara ||

translations.english: Brilliant Soma, when purified bring (us) a voice, feeding thousands and desiring wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: पुनान इन्दवेषां पुरुहूत जनानाम् । प्रियः समुद्रमा विश ॥
mantras.transliteration: punāna indaveṣāṃ puruhūta janānām | priyaḥ samudramā viśa ||

translations.english: Indu, invoked by many, do you, being purified and being loved by these your worshippers, enter the ocean.

mantras.sanskrit: दविद्युतत्या रुचा परिष्टोभन्त्या कृपा । सोमाः शुक्रा गवाशिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: davidyutatyā rucā pariṣṭobhantyā kṛpā | somāḥ śukrā gavāśiraḥ ||

translations.english: The bright Soma-juices with their shining radiance and resounding stream are mixed with the milk and the curds.

mantras.sanskrit: हिन्वानो हेतृभिर्यत आ वाजं वाज्यक्रमीत् । सीदन्तो वनुषो यथा ॥
mantras.transliteration: hinvāno hetṛbhiryata ā vājaṃ vājyakramīt | sīdanto vanuṣo yathā ||

translations.english: The powerful Soma urged by the urging (worshippers) goes collected to the battle like warriors entering (the battle-field).

mantras.sanskrit: ऋधक्सोम स्वस्तये संजग्मानो दिवः कविः । पवस्व सूर्यो दृशे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛdhaksoma svastaye saṃjagmāno divaḥ kaviḥ | pavasva sūryo dṛśe ||

translations.english: Soma, who are a sage mighty and prospering approaching flow from heaven for our prosperity and view.

mantras.sanskrit: हिन्वन्ति सूरमुस्रयः स्वसारो जामयस्पतिम् । महामिन्दुं महीयुवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: hinvanti sūramusrayaḥ svasāro jāmayaspatim | mahāminduṃ mahīyuvaḥ ||

translations.english: The kindred fingers diligently operating, eager to squeeze you forth, send out the invigorating the lord (of all), the mighty Indu.

mantras.sanskrit: पवमान रुचारुचा देवो देवेभ्यस्परि । विश्वा वसून्या विश ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamāna rucārucā devo devebhyaspari | viśvā vasūnyā viśa ||

translations.english: Filtered Soma, who with reiterated radiance shine in the presence of the gods, obtain all boons (for us).

mantras.sanskrit: आ पवमान सुष्टुतिं वृष्टिं देवेभ्यो दुवः । इषे पवस्व संयतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā pavamāna suṣṭutiṃ vṛṣṭiṃ devebhyo duvaḥ | iṣe pavasva saṃyatam ||

translations.english: Pour, purified (Soma), a well-praised shower for the worship of the gods; (pour) a continual shower for our food.

mantras.sanskrit: वृषा ह्यसि भानुना द्युमन्तं त्वा हवामहे । पवमान स्वाध्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣā hyasi bhānunā dyumantaṃ tvā havāmahe | pavamāna svādhyaḥ ||

translations.english: We who perform good works praise you, purified Soma, brilliant with radiance, for you are the showerer (of benefits).

mantras.sanskrit: आ पवस्व सुवीर्यं मन्दमानः स्वायुध । इहो ष्विन्दवा गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā pavasva suvīryaṃ mandamānaḥ svāyudha | iho ṣvindavā gahi ||

translations.english: Well-armed (Soma) who does exhilarate (the gods) pour forth for us male offspring; come, Indu, favourably to our sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: यदद्भिः परिषिच्यसे मृज्यमानो गभस्त्योः । द्रुणा सधस्थमश्नुषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadadbhiḥ pariṣicyase mṛjyamāno gabhastyoḥ | druṇā sadhasthamaśnuṣe ||

translations.english: When cleansed by the hands you are sprinkled with the water, (taken up) with the wooden vessel you attain your abode.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सोमाय व्यश्ववत्पवमानाय गायत । महे सहस्रचक्षसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra somāya vyaśvavatpavamānāya gāyata | mahe sahasracakṣase ||

translations.english: Sing, as Vyaśva did, to the filtered Soma the great, the all-beholding.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य वर्णं मधुश्चुतं हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya varṇaṃ madhuścutaṃ hariṃ hinvantyadribhiḥ | indumindrāya pītaye ||

translations.english: (That Soma) whose juice they squeeze out with the stones, foe-repelling, honey-dropping, green-tinted, for Indra to drink.

mantras.sanskrit: तस्य ते वाजिनो वयं विश्वा धनानि जिग्युषः । सखित्वमा वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tasya te vājino vayaṃ viśvā dhanāni jigyuṣaḥ | sakhitvamā vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: We, who have heaped up oblations, solicit his friendship, (the friendship) of you who have won all the riches (of the foe).

mantras.sanskrit: वृषा पवस्व धारया मरुत्वते च मत्सरः । विश्वा दधान ओजसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣā pavasva dhārayā marutvate ca matsaraḥ | viśvā dadhāna ojasā ||

translations.english: Flow in a stream, you who are the showerer (of benefits); and (be) exhilarating to the lord of the Maruts granting us all (wealth) by your power.

mantras.sanskrit: तं त्वा धर्तारमोण्योः पवमान स्वर्दृशम् । हिन्वे वाजेषु वाजिनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ tvā dhartāramoṇyoḥ pavamāna svardṛśam | hinve vājeṣu vājinam ||

translations.english: You, the supporter of heaven and earth, O purified (Soma), the beholder of heaven, the powerful one, I send forth to battle.

mantras.sanskrit: अया चित्तो विपानया हरिः पवस्व धारया । युजं वाजेषु चोदय ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayā citto vipānayā hariḥ pavasva dhārayā | yujaṃ vājeṣu codaya ||

translations.english: Expressed by these flexible fingers (of mine), do you who are green-tinted flow forth in a stream; excite (Indra) our ally to battle.

mantras.sanskrit: आ न इन्दो महीमिषं पवस्व विश्वदर्शतः । अस्मभ्यं सोम गातुवित् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā na indo mahīmiṣaṃ pavasva viśvadarśataḥ | asmabhyaṃ soma gātuvit ||

translations.english: Swift-flowing Soma, who are the illuminator of the universe, pour down upon us abundant food, (and be) to us the revealer to the path (to heaven).

mantras.sanskrit: आ कलशा अनूषतेन्दो धाराभिरोजसा । एन्द्रस्य पीतये विश ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā kalaśā anūṣatendo dhārābhirojasā | endrasya pītaye viśa ||

translations.english: Indu, they praise the vessels together with your streams (who are endowed) with strength; enter for Indra's drinking.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य ते मद्यं रसं तीव्रं दुहन्त्यद्रिभिः । स पवस्वाभिमातिहा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya te madyaṃ rasaṃ tīvraṃ duhantyadribhiḥ | sa pavasvābhimātihā ||

translations.english: Do you whose, sharp exhilarating juice the priests express with the stones, flow the destroyer of the evil-minded.

mantras.sanskrit: राजा मेधाभिरीयते पवमानो मनावधि । अन्तरिक्षेण यातवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: rājā medhābhirīyate pavamāno manāvadhi | antarikṣeṇa yātave ||

translations.english: The king (Soma) purified at the sacrifice is urged by the priests to pass through the firmament.

mantras.sanskrit: आ न इन्दो शतग्विनं गवां पोषं स्वश्व्यम् । वहा भगत्तिमूतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā na indo śatagvinaṃ gavāṃ poṣaṃ svaśvyam | vahā bhagattimūtaye ||

translations.english: Bring to us, Indu, for our protection increase of kine with hundreds, of cattle and a gift of fortune with beautiful horses.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नः सोम सहो जुवो रूपं न वर्चसे भर । सुष्वाणो देववीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā naḥ soma saho juvo rūpaṃ na varcase bhara | suṣvāṇo devavītaye ||

translations.english: (Be) expressed for the banquet of the gods;bestow on us, Soma, strength, speed and a form for brilliance.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्षा सोम द्युमत्तमोऽभि द्रोणानि रोरुवत् । सीदञ्छ्येनो न योनिमा ॥
mantras.transliteration: arṣā soma dyumattamo'bhi droṇāni roruvat | sīdañchyeno na yonimā ||

translations.english: Hasten, Soma, who are most radiant, with a roar to the wooden vessels; as a hawk flying to its nest.

mantras.sanskrit: अप्सा इन्द्राय वायवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः । सोमो अर्षति विष्णवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: apsā indrāya vāyave varuṇāya marudbhyaḥ | somo arṣati viṣṇave ||

translations.english: Soma, the enjoyer of the water, hasten (to vessels) for Indra, Vāyu, Varuṇa, the Marut, Viṣṇu.

mantras.sanskrit: इषं तोकाय नो दधदस्मभ्यं सोम विश्वतः । आ पवस्व सहस्रिणम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: iṣaṃ tokāya no dadhadasmabhyaṃ soma viśvataḥ | ā pavasva sahasriṇam ||

translations.english: Bestowing food upon our offspring, Soma, pour from all quarters thousand-fold (wealth).

mantras.sanskrit: ये सोमासः परावति ये अर्वावति सुन्विरे । ये वादः शर्यणावति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye somāsaḥ parāvati ye arvāvati sunvire | ye vādaḥ śaryaṇāvati ||

translations.english: May those Soma juices which are effused at a distance of nigh or on this Śaryaṇāvat (lake).

mantras.sanskrit: य आर्जीकेषु कृत्वसु ये मध्ये पस्त्यानाम् । ये वा जनेषु पञ्चसु ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya ārjīkeṣu kṛtvasu ye madhye pastyānām | ye vā janeṣu pañcasu ||

translations.english: Or among the Ṛjikas, or the Kṛtvas, or in the neighbourhood of the rivers Sarasvatī, or in the five castes.

mantras.sanskrit: ते नो वृष्टिं दिवस्परि पवन्तामा सुवीर्यम् । सुवाना देवास इन्दवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te no vṛṣṭiṃ divaspari pavantāmā suvīryam | suvānā devāsa indavaḥ ||

translations.english: May those brilliant Soma-juices when expressed pour down upon us from heaven rain with male progeny.

mantras.sanskrit: पवते हर्यतो हरिर्गृणानो जमदग्निना । हिन्वानो गोरधि त्वचि ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavate haryato harirgṛṇāno jamadagninā | hinvāno goradhi tvaci ||

translations.english: The delightful green-tinted Soma, praised by Jamadagni, urged on the cow-hide flows (to the vessels).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र शुक्रासो वयोजुवो हिन्वानासो न सप्तयः । श्रीणाना अप्सु मृञ्जत ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra śukrāso vayojuvo hinvānāso na saptayaḥ | śrīṇānā apsu mṛñjata ||

translations.english: The bright Soma-juices, the dispensers of food, being mixed with the curds and milk, are cleansed in the waters like horses urged (by the charioteers).

mantras.sanskrit: तं त्वा सुतेष्वाभुवो हिन्विरे देवतातये । स पवस्वानया रुचा ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ tvā suteṣvābhuvo hinvire devatātaye | sa pavasvānayā rucā ||

translations.english: The priests who are present send you forth at the rites at which you are effused for the whole of the gods; do you flow with this splendour.

mantras.sanskrit: आ ते दक्षं मयोभुवं वह्निमद्या वृणीमहे । पान्तमा पुरुस्पृहम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā te dakṣaṃ mayobhuvaṃ vahnimadyā vṛṇīmahe | pāntamā puruspṛham ||

translations.english: We have recourse today to your strength, the source of happiness, the bearer (of good things), the defender (against foes), the desired of many.

mantras.sanskrit: आ मन्द्रमा वरेण्यमा विप्रमा मनीषिणम् । पान्तमा पुरुस्पृहम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā mandramā vareṇyamā vipramā manīṣiṇam | pāntamā puruspṛham ||

translations.english: The exhilarating, the desirable, the wise, the intelligent, the defender (of all), the desired of many.

mantras.sanskrit: आ रयिमा सुचेतुनमा सुक्रतो तनूष्वा । पान्तमा पुरुस्पृहम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā rayimā sucetunamā sukrato tanūṣvā | pāntamā puruspṛham ||

translations.english: (We have recourse) to your wealth and intelligence for our posterity, O you to whom fair sacrifices are offered, and to you the defender (of all), the desired of many.

mantras.sanskrit: पवस्व विश्वचर्षणेऽभि विश्वानि काव्या । सखा सखिभ्य ईड्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavasva viśvacarṣaṇe'bhi viśvāni kāvyā | sakhā sakhibhya īḍyaḥ ||

translations.english: All-seeing (Soma), who are the adorable friend (of the worshippers), flow for (us your) friends towards all (our) hymns of praise.

mantras.sanskrit: ताभ्यां विश्वस्य राजसि ये पवमान धामनी । प्रतीची सोम तस्थतुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tābhyāṃ viśvasya rājasi ye pavamāna dhāmanī | pratīcī soma tasthatuḥ ||

translations.english: You, purified Soma, rule the universe by those two halves (of the lunar month) which stand facing you.

mantras.sanskrit: परि धामानि यानि ते त्वं सोमासि विश्वतः । पवमान ऋतुभिः कवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari dhāmāni yāni te tvaṃ somāsi viśvataḥ | pavamāna ṛtubhiḥ kave ||

translations.english: Since your splendour abounds, you purified sage, Soma, are everywhere (associated) with the seasons.

mantras.sanskrit: पवस्व जनयन्निषोऽभि विश्वानि वार्या । सखा सखिभ्य ऊतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavasva janayanniṣo'bhi viśvāni vāryā | sakhā sakhibhya ūtaye ||

translations.english: Soma, who are a friend, do you for the sake of all our desirable (praises) approach genitive rating food for (us your) friends for our support.

mantras.sanskrit: तव शुक्रासो अर्चयो दिवस्पृष्ठे वि तन्वते । पवित्रं सोम धामभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava śukrāso arcayo divaspṛṣṭhe vi tanvate | pavitraṃ soma dhāmabhiḥ ||

translations.english: Soma, the shining rays of you who are accompanied by brilliance, spread the purifying (water) over the surface of heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: तवेमे सप्त सिन्धवः प्रशिषं सोम सिस्रते । तुभ्यं धावन्ति धेनवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taveme sapta sindhavaḥ praśiṣaṃ soma sisrate | tubhyaṃ dhāvanti dhenavaḥ ||

translations.english: These your seven rivers flow, Soma, at your command; the kine hasten to you.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सोम याहि धारया सुत इन्द्राय मत्सरः । दधानो अक्षिति श्रवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra soma yāhi dhārayā suta indrāya matsaraḥ | dadhāno akṣiti śravaḥ ||

translations.english: Proceed, Soma, in a stream when effused, giving exhilaration to Indra, bestowing (upon us) inexhaustible food.

mantras.sanskrit: समु त्वा धीभिरस्वरन्हिन्वतीः सप्त जामयः । विप्रमाजा विवस्वतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samu tvā dhībhirasvaranhinvatīḥ sapta jāmayaḥ | vipramājā vivasvataḥ ||

translations.english: The seven kindred (priests) uttering (praises) and worshipping (the gods with oblations) invoked you the sage at the sacrifice with hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: मृजन्ति त्वा समग्रुवोऽव्ये जीरावधि ष्वणि । रेभो यदज्यसे वने ॥
mantras.transliteration: mṛjanti tvā samagruvo'vye jīrāvadhi ṣvaṇi | rebho yadajyase vane ||

translations.english: The fingers cleanse you in the quickly made loud-sounding (woollen) filter, when with a noise you are sprinkled with the water.
