mantras.sanskrit: पवमानस्य ते कवे वाजिन्त्सर्गा असृक्षत । अर्वन्तो न श्रवस्यवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamānasya te kave vājintsargā asṛkṣata | arvanto na śravasyavaḥ ||

translations.english: Sage Soma, possessor of food, your food-desiring streams when you are filtered are let loose like horses.

mantras.sanskrit: अच्छा कोशं मधुश्चुतमसृग्रं वारे अव्यये । अवावशन्त धीतयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: acchā kośaṃ madhuścutamasṛgraṃ vāre avyaye | avāvaśanta dhītayaḥ ||

translations.english: They are let loose in the woollen filter (to go) towards the honey-dropping vessel; our fingers have desired them.

mantras.sanskrit: अच्छा समुद्रमिन्दवोऽस्तं गावो न धेनवः । अग्मन्नृतस्य योनिमा ॥
mantras.transliteration: acchā samudramindavo'staṃ gāvo na dhenavaḥ | agmannṛtasya yonimā ||

translations.english: The Soma-juices go to the ocean, as kine to their stall; they go the plural ce of sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ण इन्दो महे रण आपो अर्षन्ति सिन्धवः । यद्गोभिर्वासयिष्यसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra ṇa indo mahe raṇa āpo arṣanti sindhavaḥ | yadgobhirvāsayiṣyase ||

translations.english: Indu, the flowing waters hasten to our great sacrifices when you are mixed with the curds and milk.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य ते सख्ये वयमियक्षन्तस्त्वोतयः । इन्दो सखित्वमुश्मसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya te sakhye vayamiyakṣantastvotayaḥ | indo sakhitvamuśmasi ||

translations.english: Indu, we abiding in your friendship, desiring to sacrifice, depending on your protection, desire your friendship.

mantras.sanskrit: आ पवस्व गविष्टये महे सोम नृचक्षसे । एन्द्रस्य जठरे विश ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā pavasva gaviṣṭaye mahe soma nṛcakṣase | endrasya jaṭhare viśa ||

translations.english: Flow, Soma, for the mighty cattle-seeker, the beholder of men, enter Indra's belly.

mantras.sanskrit: महाँ असि सोम ज्येष्ठ उग्राणामिन्द ओजिष्ठः । युध्वा सञ्छश्वज्जिगेथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahā~ asi soma jyeṣṭha ugrāṇāminda ojiṣṭhaḥ | yudhvā sañchaśvajjigetha ||

translations.english: Soma, you are great, most worthy to be praised; Indu, (you are) the most vigorous of the mighty; engaged in battle you ever triumph.

mantras.sanskrit: य उग्रेभ्यश्चिदोजीयाञ्छूरेभ्यश्चिच्छूरतरः । भूरिदाभ्यश्चिन्मंहीयान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya ugrebhyaścidojīyāñchūrebhyaścicchūrataraḥ | bhūridābhyaścinmaṃhīyān ||

translations.english: (You) who (are) mightier than the mighty, braver than the brave, more genitive rous than the genitive rous.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं सोम सूर एषस्तोकस्य साता तनूनाम् । वृणीमहे सख्याय वृणीमहे युज्याय ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ soma sūra eṣastokasya sātā tanūnām | vṛṇīmahe sakhyāya vṛṇīmahe yujyāya ||

translations.english: You, Soma, who are a hero (bestow) upon (us) food, (be) the giver of sons (to us); we choose you for your friendship, (we choose you) for your alliance.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्न आयूंषि पवस आ सुवोर्जमिषं च नः । आरे बाधस्व दुच्छुनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agna āyūṃṣi pavasa ā suvorjamiṣaṃ ca naḥ | āre bādhasva ducchunām ||

translations.english: Agni, you support our lives, send us nutriment and food, drive far off the rākṣasas.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निॠषिः पवमानः पाञ्चजन्यः पुरोहितः । तमीमहे महागयम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniṝṣiḥ pavamānaḥ pāñcajanyaḥ purohitaḥ | tamīmahe mahāgayam ||

translations.english: Agni, the all-beholding, who is in the form of the Pavamāna, the benefactor of the five orders, the preceder at sacrifice; him we solicit, who is hymned by the great.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने पवस्व स्वपा अस्मे वर्चः सुवीर्यम् । दधद्रयिं मयि पोषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne pavasva svapā asme varcaḥ suvīryam | dadhadrayiṃ mayi poṣam ||

translations.english: Agni, who are the doer of good, pour upon us brightness and fair-offspring; may he make me wealth and plural nty.

mantras.sanskrit: पवमानो अति स्रिधोऽभ्यर्षति सुष्टुतिम् । सूरो न विश्वदर्शतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamāno ati sridho'bhyarṣati suṣṭutim | sūro na viśvadarśataḥ ||

translations.english: The purified (Soma) hastens past the adversaries towards the fair praise of the worshippers, visible to all like the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: स मर्मृजान आयुभिः प्रयस्वान्प्रयसे हितः । इन्दुरत्यो विचक्षणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa marmṛjāna āyubhiḥ prayasvānprayase hitaḥ | induratyo vicakṣaṇaḥ ||

translations.english: Repeatedly purified by the priests, Indu, abounding with food, plural ced for food, the beholder of all continually goes (to the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: पवमान ऋतं बृहच्छुक्रं ज्योतिरजीजनत् । कृष्णा तमांसि जङ्घनत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamāna ṛtaṃ bṛhacchukraṃ jyotirajījanat | kṛṣṇā tamāṃsi jaṅghanat ||

translations.english: The purified (Soma) genitive rated the veracious all-pervading bright-shining light, destroying the black darkness.

mantras.sanskrit: पवमानस्य जङ्घ्नतो हरेश्चन्द्रा असृक्षत । जीरा अजिरशोचिषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamānasya jaṅghnato hareścandrā asṛkṣata | jīrā ajiraśociṣaḥ ||

translations.english: The gladsome swift-moving streams of the purified, green-tinted, unfadingly radiant (Soma), the destroyer (of darkness), have been let forth.

mantras.sanskrit: पवमानो रथीतमः शुभ्रेभिः शुभ्रशस्तमः । हरिश्चन्द्रो मरुद्गणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamāno rathītamaḥ śubhrebhiḥ śubhraśastamaḥ | hariścandro marudgaṇaḥ ||

translations.english: The purified (Soma) possessing many chariots, most radiant with beauteous splendours, having green-tinted streams, attended by the Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: पवमानो व्यश्नवद्रश्मिभिर्वाजसातमः । दधत्स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamāno vyaśnavadraśmibhirvājasātamaḥ | dadhatstotre suvīryam ||

translations.english: May the purified Soma, the most liberal dispenser of food, pervade (the world) with his rays, granting excellent male offspring to the worshipper.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सुवान इन्दुरक्षाः पवित्रमत्यव्ययम् । पुनान इन्दुरिन्द्रमा ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra suvāna indurakṣāḥ pavitramatyavyayam | punāna indurindramā ||

translations.english: Indu when effused drops through the fleecy filter (into the vessel); being filtered Indu (enters) into Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: एष सोमो अधि त्वचि गवां क्रीळत्यद्रिभिः । इन्द्रं मदाय जोहुवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa somo adhi tvaci gavāṃ krīḷatyadribhiḥ | indraṃ madāya johuvat ||

translations.english: This Soma sports with the stones upon the cowhide, calling Indra for exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य ते द्युम्नवत्पयः पवमानाभृतं दिवः । तेन नो मृळ जीवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya te dyumnavatpayaḥ pavamānābhṛtaṃ divaḥ | tena no mṛḷa jīvase ||

translations.english: Purified (Soma),bless us with long life by means of that your nutritious milk which has been brought from heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं सोमासि धारयुर्मन्द्र ओजिष्ठो अध्वरे । पवस्व मंहयद्रयिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ somāsi dhārayurmandra ojiṣṭho adhvare | pavasva maṃhayadrayiḥ ||

translations.english: You, Soma, who are most exhilarating, most powerful, are disposed to shed your stream at our sacrifice; flow then you who are the giver or riches.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं सुतो नृमादनो दधन्वान्मत्सरिन्तमः । इन्द्राय सूरिरन्धसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ suto nṛmādano dadhanvānmatsarintamaḥ | indrāya sūrirandhasā ||

translations.english: You who are the exhilarator o fthe priests, bestowing (wealth upon them) and intelligent, do you when effused together with food be the especial cause of exhilaration to Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं सुष्वाणो अद्रिभिरभ्यर्ष कनिक्रदत् । द्युमन्तं शुष्ममुत्तमम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ suṣvāṇo adribhirabhyarṣa kanikradat | dyumantaṃ śuṣmamuttamam ||

translations.english: Do you when effused by the stones proceed resounding (to the vessel); (grant) bright excellent strength.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्दुर्हिन्वानो अर्षति तिरो वाराण्यव्यया । हरिर्वाजमचिक्रदत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indurhinvāno arṣati tiro vārāṇyavyayā | harirvājamacikradat ||

translations.english: Indu effused (by the stones) passes through the woollen filter; green-tinted he roars forth food.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्दो व्यव्यमर्षसि वि श्रवांसि वि सौभगा । वि वाजान्त्सोम गोमतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indo vyavyamarṣasi vi śravāṃsi vi saubhagā | vi vājāntsoma gomataḥ ||

translations.english: Indu, you have flowed through the fleece, you grant us food and wealth; (therefore grant us), Soma, strength of flocks.

mantras.sanskrit: आ न इन्दो शतग्विनं रयिं गोमन्तमश्विनम् । भरा सोम सहस्रिणम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā na indo śatagvinaṃ rayiṃ gomantamaśvinam | bharā soma sahasriṇam ||

translations.english: Indu, Soma, bring us thousand-fold wealth, consisting of hundreds of cows, having excellent cows and horses.

mantras.sanskrit: पवमानास इन्दवस्तिरः पवित्रमाशवः । इन्द्रं यामेभिराशत ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamānāsa indavastiraḥ pavitramāśavaḥ | indraṃ yāmebhirāśata ||

translations.english: The purified swift-flowing Soma-juices passing hrough the filter reach Indra by their own paths.

mantras.sanskrit: ककुहः सोम्यो रस इन्दुरिन्द्राय पूर्व्यः । आयुः पवत आयवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: kakuhaḥ somyo rasa indurindrāya pūrvyaḥ | āyuḥ pavata āyave ||

translations.english: The excellent juice of the Soma dropping (into the vessels) poured forth by men of old, the goer (to Indra), is filtered for Indra the goer.

mantras.sanskrit: हिन्वन्ति सूरमुस्रयः पवमानं मधुश्चुतम् । अभि गिरा समस्वरन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: hinvanti sūramusrayaḥ pavamānaṃ madhuścutam | abhi girā samasvaran ||

translations.english: The fingers express the purified honey-dropping heroic Soma; (the worshippers) hail him with praise.

mantras.sanskrit: अविता नो अजाश्वः पूषा यामनियामनि । आ भक्षत्कन्यासु नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: avitā no ajāśvaḥ pūṣā yāmaniyāmani | ā bhakṣatkanyāsu naḥ ||

translations.english: May the goat-borne Pūṣan in all his paths be our protector; may he bestow maidens on us.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं सोमः कपर्दिने घृतं न पवते मधु । आ भक्षत्कन्यासु नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ somaḥ kapardine ghṛtaṃ na pavate madhu | ā bhakṣatkanyāsu naḥ ||

translations.english: This Soma flows to Pūṣan, who wears a beautiful tiara like exhilarating ghī; may he bestow maidens on us.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं त आघृणे सुतो घृतं न पवते शुचि । आ भक्षत्कन्यासु नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ ta āghṛṇe suto ghṛtaṃ na pavate śuci | ā bhakṣatkanyāsu naḥ ||

translations.english: This Soma poured for you, shining (Pūṣan) flows like pure ghī; may he bestow maidens on us.

mantras.sanskrit: वाचो जन्तुः कवीनां पवस्व सोम धारया । देवेषु रत्नधा असि ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāco jantuḥ kavīnāṃ pavasva soma dhārayā | deveṣu ratnadhā asi ||

translations.english: Soma, genitive rator of the praises of the wise, flow in a stream; you are the dispenser of treasure among the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: आ कलशेषु धावति श्येनो वर्म वि गाहते । अभि द्रोणा कनिक्रदत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā kalaśeṣu dhāvati śyeno varma vi gāhate | abhi droṇā kanikradat ||

translations.english: He has flowed to the vessels as a falcon enters its nest and enters the wooden (vessels) with a cry.

mantras.sanskrit: परि प्र सोम ते रसोऽसर्जि कलशे सुतः । श्येनो न तक्तो अर्षति ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari pra soma te raso'sarji kalaśe sutaḥ | śyeno na takto arṣati ||

translations.english: Your juice, Soma, spreads around when effused into the vessel as a swift falcon rushes along.

mantras.sanskrit: पवस्व सोम मन्दयन्निन्द्राय मधुमत्तमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavasva soma mandayannindrāya madhumattamaḥ ||

translations.english: Flow, Soma, who are most sweet-flavoured, giving exhilaration to Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: असृग्रन्देववीतये वाजयन्तो रथा इव ॥
mantras.transliteration: asṛgrandevavītaye vājayanto rathā iva ||

translations.english: (The Soma-juices) are let loose for the banquet of the gods like chariots desiring the wealth (of the enemy).

mantras.sanskrit: ते सुतासो मदिन्तमाः शुक्रा वायुमसृक्षत ॥
mantras.transliteration: te sutāso madintamāḥ śukrā vāyumasṛkṣata ||

translations.english: These effused (Soma-juices), brilliant and extremely exhilarating, are let forth for Vāyu.

mantras.sanskrit: ग्राव्णा तुन्नो अभिष्टुतः पवित्रं सोम गच्छसि । दधत्स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: grāvṇā tunno abhiṣṭutaḥ pavitraṃ soma gacchasi | dadhatstotre suvīryam ||

translations.english: Bruised with the stones and effused (by the worshippers), you, Soma; enter the filter, bestowing upon your praiser (wealth), accompanied with excellent male offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: एष तुन्नो अभिष्टुतः पवित्रमति गाहते । रक्षोहा वारमव्ययम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa tunno abhiṣṭutaḥ pavitramati gāhate | rakṣohā vāramavyayam ||

translations.english: This (Soma), bruised (with the stones), and praised by (all), the slayer of rākṣasas, plural nge through the woollen filter (into the vessel).

mantras.sanskrit: यदन्ति यच्च दूरके भयं विन्दति मामिह । पवमान वि तज्जहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadanti yacca dūrake bhayaṃ vindati māmiha | pavamāna vi tajjahi ||

translations.english: Whatever fear seizes me, near, afar off, or here, purified (Soma) dispel that (fear).

mantras.sanskrit: पवमानः सो अद्य नः पवित्रेण विचर्षणिः । यः पोता स पुनातु नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamānaḥ so adya naḥ pavitreṇa vicarṣaṇiḥ | yaḥ potā sa punātu naḥ ||

translations.english: May that purified Soma, the beholder of all, who is the purifier, purify us now by his purifying (might).

mantras.sanskrit: यत्ते पवित्रमर्चिष्यग्ने विततमन्तरा । ब्रह्म तेन पुनीहि नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatte pavitramarciṣyagne vitatamantarā | brahma tena punīhi naḥ ||

translations.english: Purify, Agni, our divine (body) with your purifying (light), which is diffused in the midst of the light.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्ते पवित्रमर्चिवदग्ने तेन पुनीहि नः । ब्रह्मसवैः पुनीहि नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatte pavitramarcivadagne tena punīhi naḥ | brahmasavaiḥ punīhi naḥ ||

translations.english: Purify us, Agni, with your purifying (light) which possesses the light; purify us with the effusion of the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: उभाभ्यां देव सवितः पवित्रेण सवेन च । मां पुनीहि विश्वतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ubhābhyāṃ deva savitaḥ pavitreṇa savena ca | māṃ punīhi viśvataḥ ||

translations.english: Shining (Soma), urger of all things, purify me by both, by your purifying (light) and by the effusion (of the Soma); purify me in every way

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिभिष्ट्वं देव सवितर्वर्षिष्ठैः सोम धामभिः । अग्ने दक्षैः पुनीहि नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tribhiṣṭvaṃ deva savitarvarṣiṣṭhaiḥ soma dhāmabhiḥ | agne dakṣaiḥ punīhi naḥ ||

translations.english: Purify us, shining Agni Pavamāna, urger of all things, with your three most mighty powerful forms.

mantras.sanskrit: पुनन्तु मां देवजनाः पुनन्तु वसवो धिया । विश्वे देवाः पुनीत मा जातवेदः पुनीहि मा ॥
mantras.transliteration: punantu māṃ devajanāḥ punantu vasavo dhiyā | viśve devāḥ punīta mā jātavedaḥ punīhi mā ||

translations.english: May the worshippers purify me, may the Vasus purify (me) by their acts; purify me, all you gods, (Agni) the intelligent purify me.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र प्यायस्व प्र स्यन्दस्व सोम विश्वेभिरंशुभिः । देवेभ्य उत्तमं हविः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra pyāyasva pra syandasva soma viśvebhiraṃśubhiḥ | devebhya uttamaṃ haviḥ ||

translations.english: Soma, nourish (us), pour forth for the gods with all your juices the most excellent oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: उप प्रियं पनिप्नतं युवानमाहुतीवृधम् । अगन्म बिभ्रतो नमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa priyaṃ panipnataṃ yuvānamāhutīvṛdham | aganma bibhrato namaḥ ||

translations.english: Let us approach bearing the beloved loud-sounding youthful oblation fostered by our offerings.

mantras.sanskrit: अलाय्यस्य परशुर्ननाश तमा पवस्व देव सोम । आखुं चिदेव देव सोम ॥
mantras.transliteration: alāyyasya paraśurnanāśa tamā pavasva deva soma | ākhuṃ cideva deva soma ||

translations.english: May the battle-axe of the foe destroy the foe; alone flow tous, bright Soma; (slay) the villain only, bright Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: यः पावमानीरध्येत्यृषिभिः सम्भृतं रसम् । सर्वं स पूतमश्नाति स्वदितं मातरिश्वना ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ pāvamānīradhyetyṛṣibhiḥ sambhṛtaṃ rasam | sarvaṃ sa pūtamaśnāti svaditaṃ mātariśvanā ||

translations.english: He who reads the hymns to Pavamāna, the essence (of the Veda) collected by the ṛṣis, enjoys all (his food) purified, sweetened by Mātariśvan.

mantras.sanskrit: पावमानीर्यो अध्येत्यृषिभिः सम्भृतं रसम् । तस्मै सरस्वती दुहे क्षीरं सर्पिर्मधूदकम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pāvamānīryo adhyetyṛṣibhiḥ sambhṛtaṃ rasam | tasmai sarasvatī duhe kṣīraṃ sarpirmadhūdakam ||

translations.english: For him who reads the hymns to Pavamāna, the essence (of the Veda) collected by the ṛṣis, Sarasvatī milks milk, ghee and exhilarating Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र देवमच्छा मधुमन्त इन्दवोऽसिष्यदन्त गाव आ न धेनवः । बर्हिषदो वचनावन्त ऊधभिः परिस्रुतमुस्रिया निर्णिजं धिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra devamacchā madhumanta indavo'siṣyadanta gāva ā na dhenavaḥ | barhiṣado vacanāvanta ūdhabhiḥ parisrutamusriyā nirṇijaṃ dhire ||

translations.english: The exhilarating Soma-juices flow towards the shining (Indra), as kine (have to their calves); the lowing kine sitting on the barhis grass hold in their udders the pure (juice) welling up.

mantras.sanskrit: स रोरुवदभि पूर्वा अचिक्रददुपारुहः श्रथयन्त्स्वादते हरिः । तिरः पवित्रं परियन्नुरु ज्रयो नि शर्याणि दधते देव आ वरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa roruvadabhi pūrvā acikradadupāruhaḥ śrathayantsvādate hariḥ | tiraḥ pavitraṃ pariyannuru jrayo ni śaryāṇi dadhate deva ā varam ||

translations.english: He with a noise re-echoes the principal (praises), separating the growing herbs, the green-tinted (Soma) sweetens them; passing through the filter, (he exerts) great speed, he annihilates the rākṣasas, the shining (Soma) bestows wealth (upon the worshippers).

mantras.sanskrit: वि यो ममे यम्या संयती मदः साकंवृधा पयसा पिन्वदक्षिता । मही अपारे रजसी विवेविददभिव्रजन्नक्षितं पाज आ ददे ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi yo mame yamyā saṃyatī madaḥ sākaṃvṛdhā payasā pinvadakṣitā | mahī apāre rajasī vivevidadabhivrajannakṣitaṃ pāja ā dade ||

translations.english: The exhilarating (Soma) who constructed the twin united (heaven and earth) does by means of his juice maintain them growing together, imperishable; he has distinguished these two great unbounded worlds, wandering everywhere, he has assumed imperishable strength.

mantras.sanskrit: स मातरा विचरन्वाजयन्नपः प्र मेधिरः स्वधया पिन्वते पदम् । अंशुर्यवेन पिपिशे यतो नृभिः सं जामिभिर्नसते रक्षते शिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa mātarā vicaranvājayannapaḥ pra medhiraḥ svadhayā pinvate padam | aṃśuryavena pipiśe yato nṛbhiḥ saṃ jāmibhirnasate rakṣate śiraḥ ||

translations.english: The wise (Soma) wandering through the two worlds, sending forth the waters, flattens his station with food; the Soma-juice collected by the priests is mixed with the barley; it is united by the fingers; it protects the head.

mantras.sanskrit: सं दक्षेण मनसा जायते कविॠतस्य गर्भो निहितो यमा परः । यूना ह सन्ता प्रथमं वि जज्ञतुर्गुहा हितं जनिम नेममुद्यतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ dakṣeṇa manasā jāyate kaviṝtasya garbho nihito yamā paraḥ | yūnā ha santā prathamaṃ vi jajñaturguhā hitaṃ janima nemamudyatam ||

translations.english: The sage (Soma) is born with developed mind; having his plural ce in the womb of the water, he is deposited (by the gods) by rule from far off; even when young these two were distinct; the birth (of one half) was plural ced in secret, the (other) half was visible.

mantras.sanskrit: मन्द्रस्य रूपं विविदुर्मनीषिणः श्येनो यदन्धो अभरत्परावतः । तं मर्जयन्त सुवृधं नदीष्वाँ उशन्तमंशुं परियन्तमृग्मियम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mandrasya rūpaṃ vividurmanīṣiṇaḥ śyeno yadandho abharatparāvataḥ | taṃ marjayanta suvṛdhaṃ nadīṣvā~ uśantamaṃśuṃ pariyantamṛgmiyam ||

translations.english: The wise (worshippers) know the form of the exhilarating Soma-juice, the food that the falcon brought from afar; they cleanse in the waters the fostering (Soma) delighting (the gods), flowing around, and deserving laudation.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वां मृजन्ति दश योषणः सुतं सोम ऋषिभिर्मतिभिर्धीतिभिर्हितम् । अव्यो वारेभिरुत देवहूतिभिर्नृभिर्यतो वाजमा दर्षि सातये ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāṃ mṛjanti daśa yoṣaṇaḥ sutaṃ soma ṛṣibhirmatibhirdhītibhirhitam | avyo vārebhiruta devahūtibhirnṛbhiryato vājamā darṣi sātaye ||

translations.english: The ten fingers cleanse you, Soma, when effused and plural ced in the vessels by the ṛṣis, with praises, religious rites and woollen filters; and collected by the priests with oblations to the gods you bestow food (upon the worshippers) for a gift.

mantras.sanskrit: परिप्रयन्तं वय्यं सुषंसदं सोमं मनीषा अभ्यनूषत स्तुभः । यो धारया मधुमाँ ऊर्मिणा दिव इयर्ति वाचं रयिषाळमर्त्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pariprayantaṃ vayyaṃ suṣaṃsadaṃ somaṃ manīṣā abhyanūṣata stubhaḥ | yo dhārayā madhumā~ ūrmiṇā diva iyarti vācaṃ rayiṣāḷamartyaḥ ||

translations.english: Intelligent praises celebrate the wide-flowing (god) delighting Soma who sits in good company, who exhilarating (falls) in a stream with his water from the sky (and) wealth-conquering, immortal, sends out his voice.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं दिव इयर्ति विश्वमा रजः सोमः पुनानः कलशेषु सीदति । अद्भिर्गोभिर्मृज्यते अद्रिभिः सुतः पुनान इन्दुर्वरिवो विदत्प्रियम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ diva iyarti viśvamā rajaḥ somaḥ punānaḥ kalaśeṣu sīdati | adbhirgobhirmṛjyate adribhiḥ sutaḥ punāna indurvarivo vidatpriyam ||

translations.english: This Soma sends from heaven all water; bring filtered he settles in the vessels; effused with the stones, he is cleansed with water and milk; the filtered Indu bestow delightful wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा नः सोम परिषिच्यमानो वयो दधच्चित्रतमं पवस्व । अद्वेषे द्यावापृथिवी हुवेम देवा धत्त रयिमस्मे सुवीरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā naḥ soma pariṣicyamāno vayo dadhaccitratamaṃ pavasva | adveṣe dyāvāpṛthivī huvema devā dhatta rayimasme suvīram ||

translations.english: Soma offering (wealth) as soon as you are sprinkled (with the water and milk), pour various kinds of food (upon us); let us invoke the friendly heaven and earth; do you, O gods, grant us wealth with excellent male offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: इषुर्न धन्वन्प्रति धीयते मतिर्वत्सो न मातुरुप सर्ज्यूधनि । उरुधारेव दुहे अग्र आयत्यस्य व्रतेष्वपि सोम इष्यते ॥
mantras.transliteration: iṣurna dhanvanprati dhīyate matirvatso na māturupa sarjyūdhani | urudhāreva duhe agra āyatyasya vrateṣvapi soma iṣyate ||

translations.english: (Our) praise is attached (to Indra) as an arrow to the bow; (the Soma-juice) is let loose to (Indra) the fosterer as a calf to the udder to its mother; (Indra sheds blessings) as a cow having a copious stream of milk yields it when coming into the presence (of the calf); in Indra's sacrifices the Soma is stimulated.

mantras.sanskrit: उपो मतिः पृच्यते सिच्यते मधु मन्द्राजनी चोदते अन्तरासनि । पवमानः संतनिः प्रघ्नतामिव मधुमान्द्रप्सः परि वारमर्षति ॥
mantras.transliteration: upo matiḥ pṛcyate sicyate madhu mandrājanī codate antarāsani | pavamānaḥ saṃtaniḥ praghnatāmiva madhumāndrapsaḥ pari vāramarṣati ||

translations.english: The praise is united (to Indra); the excellent (Soma) is sprinkled; (the Soma stream) emitting plural asant juice is driven into (Indra's) mouth; the filtered diffused exhilarating swift-flowing (Soma) hastens to the fleece like the arrow of the combatants.

mantras.sanskrit: अव्ये वधूयुः पवते परि त्वचि श्रथ्नीते नप्तीरदितेॠतं यते । हरिरक्रान्यजतः संयतो मदो नृम्णा शिशानो महिषो न शोभते ॥
mantras.transliteration: avye vadhūyuḥ pavate pari tvaci śrathnīte naptīraditeṝtaṃ yate | harirakrānyajataḥ saṃyato mado nṛmṇā śiśāno mahiṣo na śobhate ||

translations.english: (Soma) seeking his spouse is filtered in the sheep-skin; he separates his grand-daughter on the earth for the sacrificer; green-tinted, adorable, collected (in the ladles), exhilarating, he overcomes (his foes); sharpening his vigour he shines like one of might.

mantras.sanskrit: उक्षा मिमाति प्रति यन्ति धेनवो देवस्य देवीरुप यन्ति निष्कृतम् । अत्यक्रमीदर्जुनं वारमव्ययमत्कं न निक्तं परि सोमो अव्यत ॥
mantras.transliteration: ukṣā mimāti prati yanti dhenavo devasya devīrupa yanti niṣkṛtam | atyakramīdarjunaṃ vāramavyayamatkaṃ na niktaṃ pari somo avyata ||

translations.english: The bull lows, the cows flow around him; the divine (praises) gather round the station of the radiant (Soma); Soma passes through the white sheep-skin; he clothes himself with it as it were a burnished armouṛ

mantras.sanskrit: अमृक्तेन रुशता वाससा हरिरमर्त्यो निर्णिजानः परि व्यत । दिवस्पृष्ठं बर्हणा निर्णिजे कृतोपस्तरणं चम्वोर्नभस्मयम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: amṛktena ruśatā vāsasā hariramartyo nirṇijānaḥ pari vyata | divaspṛṣṭhaṃ barhaṇā nirṇije kṛtopastaraṇaṃ camvornabhasmayam ||

translations.english: The immortal green-tinted Soma when purified is arranged in an uncleaned shining vestment; he ahs created (Āditya) who stands on the back of the sky for the destruction (of sin) and purification, (and has created) Āditya's brilliance, the cover of the two worlds.

mantras.sanskrit: सूर्यस्येव रश्मयो द्रावयित्नवो मत्सरासः प्रसुपः साकमीरते । तन्तुं ततं परि सर्गास आशवो नेन्द्रादृते पवते धाम किं चन ॥
mantras.transliteration: sūryasyeva raśmayo drāvayitnavo matsarāsaḥ prasupaḥ sākamīrate | tantuṃ tataṃ pari sargāsa āśavo nendrādṛte pavate dhāma kiṃ cana ||

translations.english: The rushing exhilarating foe-slaying Soma-juices when let loose flow together round the extended cloth like the sun's rays; they flow to no other person n except Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: सिन्धोरिव प्रवणे निम्न आशवो वृषच्युता मदासो गातुमाशत । शं नो निवेशे द्विपदे चतुष्पदेऽस्मे वाजाः सोम तिष्ठन्तु कृष्टयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sindhoriva pravaṇe nimna āśavo vṛṣacyutā madāso gātumāśata | śaṃ no niveśe dvipade catuṣpade'sme vājāḥ soma tiṣṭhantu kṛṣṭayaḥ ||

translations.english: The exhilarating (Soma-juices) poured forth by the sprinklers effect their way to Indra as in a waterfall of a river the percvading (waters find their way) to dry ground; bless on our return our two-footed and four-footed things; may food and offspring ever abide with us.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नः पवस्व वसुमद्धिरण्यवदश्वावद्गोमद्यवमत्सुवीर्यम् । यूयं हि सोम पितरो मम स्थन दिवो मूर्धानः प्रस्थिता वयस्कृतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā naḥ pavasva vasumaddhiraṇyavadaśvāvadgomadyavamatsuvīryam | yūyaṃ hi soma pitaro mama sthana divo mūrdhānaḥ prasthitā vayaskṛtaḥ ||

translations.english: Pour upon us (wealth) comprising treasure, gold, horses, cattle, barley, and excellent male offspring; you, Soma are my progenitors, the chiefs of heaven, plural ced (for sacrificial), the offerers of oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: एते सोमाः पवमानास इन्द्रं रथा इव प्र ययुः सातिमच्छ । सुताः पवित्रमति यन्त्यव्यं हित्वी वव्रिं हरितो वृष्टिमच्छ ॥
mantras.transliteration: ete somāḥ pavamānāsa indraṃ rathā iva pra yayuḥ sātimaccha | sutāḥ pavitramati yantyavyaṃ hitvī vavriṃ harito vṛṣṭimaccha ||

translations.english: These filtered Soma-juices advance to Indra worthy of honour, as (Indra's) chariots advance to battle; expressed (with the stones) they pass through the woollen filter, casting off infirmity the horses go towards the rain.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्दविन्द्राय बृहते पवस्व सुमृळीको अनवद्यो रिशादाः । भरा चन्द्राणि गृणते वसूनि देवैर्द्यावापृथिवी प्रावतं नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indavindrāya bṛhate pavasva sumṛḷīko anavadyo riśādāḥ | bharā candrāṇi gṛṇate vasūni devairdyāvāpṛthivī prāvataṃ naḥ ||

translations.english: Indu, who do make (men) very happy, the blameless one, the destroyer of foes, flow for mighty Indra; bring to (me) your worshipper gratifying riches; heaven and earth, protect us with auspicious (riches).

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिरस्मै सप्त धेनवो दुदुह्रे सत्यामाशिरं पूर्व्ये व्योमनि । चत्वार्यन्या भुवनानि निर्णिजे चारूणि चक्रे यदृतैरवर्धत ॥
mantras.transliteration: trirasmai sapta dhenavo duduhre satyāmāśiraṃ pūrvye vyomani | catvāryanyā bhuvanāni nirṇije cārūṇi cakre yadṛtairavardhata ||

translations.english: For him in the ancient sacrifice thrice seven kine milk forth the right mixture; he makes four other beautiful waters for purification when he is nourished with the sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: स भिक्षमाणो अमृतस्य चारुण उभे द्यावा काव्येना वि शश्रथे । तेजिष्ठा अपो मंहना परि व्यत यदी देवस्य श्रवसा सदो विदुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa bhikṣamāṇo amṛtasya cāruṇa ubhe dyāvā kāvyenā vi śaśrathe | tejiṣṭhā apo maṃhanā pari vyata yadī devasya śravasā sado viduḥ ||

translations.english: He being solicited for auspicious ambrosia opens both heaven and earth by his intelligence, he covers the lustrious waters with his greatness, when (the priests) with the oblation recognize the station of the radiant (Soma).

mantras.sanskrit: ते अस्य सन्तु केतवोऽमृत्यवोऽदाभ्यासो जनुषी उभे अनु । येभिर्नृम्णा च देव्या च पुनत आदिद्राजानं मनना अगृभ्णत ॥
mantras.transliteration: te asya santu ketavo'mṛtyavo'dābhyāso januṣī ubhe anu | yebhirnṛmṇā ca devyā ca punata ādidrājānaṃ mananā agṛbhṇata ||

translations.english: May those his immortal, inviolable rays protect both classes of beings, wherewith he stimulates human (strength) and divine (food); thereupon praises reach the royal (Soma).

mantras.sanskrit: स मृज्यमानो दशभिः सुकर्मभिः प्र मध्यमासु मातृषु प्रमे सचा । व्रतानि पानो अमृतस्य चारुण उभे नृचक्षा अनु पश्यते विशौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa mṛjyamāno daśabhiḥ sukarmabhiḥ pra madhyamāsu mātṛṣu prame sacā | vratāni pāno amṛtasya cāruṇa ubhe nṛcakṣā anu paśyate viśau ||

translations.english: Cleansed by the ten well-working (fingers), the companion (of the waters) stands among the midmost mothers to measure (the worlds); the beholder of men protecting sacred rites (for the sake) of auspicious ambrosia looks after both races.

mantras.sanskrit: स मर्मृजान इन्द्रियाय धायस ओभे अन्ता रोदसी हर्षते हितः । वृषा शुष्मेण बाधते वि दुर्मतीरादेदिशानः शर्यहेव शुरुधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa marmṛjāna indriyāya dhāyasa obhe antā rodasī harṣate hitaḥ | vṛṣā śuṣmeṇa bādhate vi durmatīrādediśānaḥ śaryaheva śurudhaḥ ||

translations.english: Being filtered for Indra's world-supporting strength, stationed in the midst of both worlds he goes (everywhere); the showerer destroys the evil-minded by his vigour, challenging the asuras like an archer.

mantras.sanskrit: स मातरा न ददृशान उस्रियो नानददेति मरुतामिव स्वनः । जानन्नृतं प्रथमं यत्स्वर्णरं प्रशस्तये कमवृणीत सुक्रतुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa mātarā na dadṛśāna usriyo nānadadeti marutāmiva svanaḥ | jānannṛtaṃ prathamaṃ yatsvarṇaraṃ praśastaye kamavṛṇīta sukratuḥ ||

translations.english: He repeatedly beholding his parents (heaven and earth) proceeds with a loud noise, like cows (looking at their calves and lowing), and with a roar (like the troop) of Maruts; knowing that water to be the best which is good for all men, the intelligent (pavamāna) chose man to be the offerer of his praise.

mantras.sanskrit: रुवति भीमो वृषभस्तविष्यया शृङ्गे शिशानो हरिणी विचक्षणः । आ योनिं सोमः सुकृतं नि षीदति गव्ययी त्वग्भवति निर्णिगव्ययी ॥
mantras.transliteration: ruvati bhīmo vṛṣabhastaviṣyayā śṛṅge śiśāno hariṇī vicakṣaṇaḥ | ā yoniṃ somaḥ sukṛtaṃ ni ṣīdati gavyayī tvagbhavati nirṇigavyayī ||

translations.english: The formidable showerer, the contemplator of all through desire for strength roars, sharpening his green-tinted horns; the Soma settles on his well-prepared station; the cowhide is his cleanser and the sheep-skin (too).

mantras.sanskrit: शुचिः पुनानस्तन्वमरेपसमव्ये हरिर्न्यधाविष्ट सानवि । जुष्टो मित्राय वरुणाय वायवे त्रिधातु मधु क्रियते सुकर्मभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śuciḥ punānastanvamarepasamavye harirnyadhāviṣṭa sānavi | juṣṭo mitrāya varuṇāya vāyave tridhātu madhu kriyate sukarmabhiḥ ||

translations.english: Brilliant cleansing his sinless body, the green-tinted (Soma) is plural ced on the high-plural ced fleece; sufficient for Mitra, Varuṇa, and Vāyu the exhilarating (Soma) mixed with the three ingredients is prepared by the performers of good rites.

mantras.sanskrit: पवस्व सोम देववीतये वृषेन्द्रस्य हार्दि सोमधानमा विश । पुरा नो बाधाद्दुरिताति पारय क्षेत्रविद्धि दिश आहा विपृच्छते ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavasva soma devavītaye vṛṣendrasya hārdi somadhānamā viśa | purā no bādhādduritāti pāraya kṣetraviddhi diśa āhā vipṛcchate ||

translations.english: Flow Soma, the showerer, for the banquet for the gods; enter the Soma-vessel dear to Indra; bring us safe past the hostile (rākṣasas) before the oppress us; for he who knows the country tells the direction to him who asks (the way).

mantras.sanskrit: हितो न सप्तिरभि वाजमर्षेन्द्रस्येन्दो जठरमा पवस्व । नावा न सिन्धुमति पर्षि विद्वाञ्छूरो न युध्यन्नव नो निदः स्पः ॥
mantras.transliteration: hito na saptirabhi vājamarṣendrasyendo jaṭharamā pavasva | nāvā na sindhumati parṣi vidvāñchūro na yudhyannava no nidaḥ spaḥ ||

translations.english: Hasten (to the vessel) as a horse when urged (hastens) to the battle; flow Indu into Indra's belly; all knowing (Soma) bear us (safe) across, as (boatmen bear people) across a river in a boat; fighting like a hero, defend us from the reviling (of the foe).

mantras.sanskrit: आ दक्षिणा सृज्यते शुष्म्यासदं वेति द्रुहो रक्षसः पाति जागृविः । हरिरोपशं कृणुते नभस्पय उपस्तिरे चम्वोर्ब्रह्म निर्णिजे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā dakṣiṇā sṛjyate śuṣmyāsadaṃ veti druho rakṣasaḥ pāti jāgṛviḥ | hariropaśaṃ kṛṇute nabhaspaya upastire camvorbrahma nirṇije ||

translations.english: The donation is given; the vigorous (Soma) enters his resting-plural ce, and, vigilant, guards (his worshippers) against the malignant rākṣasas; the green-tinted (Soma) produces the all-sustaining water of the sun; (he plural ces) the mighty sun to cover the two worlds, to purify (created things).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र कृष्टिहेव शूष एति रोरुवदसुर्यं वर्णं नि रिणीते अस्य तम् । जहाति वव्रिं पितुरेति निष्कृतमुपप्रुतं कृणुते निर्णिजं तना ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra kṛṣṭiheva śūṣa eti roruvadasuryaṃ varṇaṃ ni riṇīte asya tam | jahāti vavriṃ pitureti niṣkṛtamupaprutaṃ kṛṇute nirṇijaṃ tanā ||

translations.english: The powerful (Soma) advances with a roar like a slayer of men; he puts forth that asura-slaying tint of his; he abandons bodily infirmity; the food goes to the prepared (altar); he assumes a form advancing to the outstretched (filter).

mantras.sanskrit: अद्रिभिः सुतः पवते गभस्त्योर्वृषायते नभसा वेपते मती । स मोदते नसते साधते गिरा नेनिक्ते अप्सु यजते परीमणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: adribhiḥ sutaḥ pavate gabhastyorvṛṣāyate nabhasā vepate matī | sa modate nasate sādhate girā nenikte apsu yajate parīmaṇi ||

translations.english: Expressed with the stones by the hands (the Soma) flows; he moves like a bull; (worshipped) with praise he wanders through the firmament; he rejoices, he is embraced; (praised) with a hymn he fulfills (the desire of the worshippers), he is cleansed in the waters, he is honoured at the (god) protected (sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: परि द्युक्षं सहसः पर्वतावृधं मध्वः सिञ्चन्ति हर्म्यस्य सक्षणिम् । आ यस्मिन्गावः सुहुताद ऊधनि मूर्धञ्छ्रीणन्त्यग्रियं वरीमभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari dyukṣaṃ sahasaḥ parvatāvṛdhaṃ madhvaḥ siñcanti harmyasya sakṣaṇim | ā yasmingāvaḥ suhutāda ūdhani mūrdhañchrīṇantyagriyaṃ varīmabhiḥ ||

translations.english: The powerful exhilarating Soma-juices besprinkle Indra who dwells in heaven, the augmenter of the clouds, the destroyer of the dwelling (of the foe); in whom on account of his greatness, the cows, the eaters of the oblations, mix the best (of their milk contained) in the uplifted udder.

mantras.sanskrit: समी रथं न भुरिजोरहेषत दश स्वसारो अदितेरुपस्थ आ । जिगादुप ज्रयति गोरपीच्यं पदं यदस्य मतुथा अजीजनन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: samī rathaṃ na bhurijoraheṣata daśa svasāro aditerupastha ā | jigādupa jrayati gorapīcyaṃ padaṃ yadasya matuthā ajījanan ||

translations.english: The ten fingers of the arms urge him near to the ground (of the sacrificial altar) like a chariot; he goes (to the vessels), he approaches the concealed (milk) of the cow when the praisers produce his resting plural ce.

mantras.sanskrit: श्येनो न योनिं सदनं धिया कृतं हिरण्ययमासदं देव एषति । ए रिणन्ति बर्हिषि प्रियं गिराश्वो न देवाँ अप्येति यज्ञियः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śyeno na yoniṃ sadanaṃ dhiyā kṛtaṃ hiraṇyayamāsadaṃ deva eṣati | e riṇanti barhiṣi priyaṃ girāśvo na devā~ apyeti yajñiyaḥ ||

translations.english: The shining (Soma) approaches the golden seat the station constructed by his holy rites, as a falcon (approaches) his nest; (the worshippers) send the well-beloved by their praise to the sacred grass; the adorable Soma proceeds to the gods like a horse.

mantras.sanskrit: परा व्यक्तो अरुषो दिवः कविर्वृषा त्रिपृष्ठो अनविष्ट गा अभि । सहस्रणीतिर्यतिः परायती रेभो न पूर्वीरुषसो वि राजति ॥
mantras.transliteration: parā vyakto aruṣo divaḥ kavirvṛṣā tripṛṣṭho anaviṣṭa gā abhi | sahasraṇītiryatiḥ parāyatī rebho na pūrvīruṣaso vi rājati ||

translations.english: Radiant, wise, flowing in separate streams, (the Soma descends) from the firmament; the shower offered at the three libations responds to the praises (of the worshippers); led in a thousand directions, coming and going, he shines at many a sunrise like one who sings praises (to the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वेषं रूपं कृणुते वर्णो अस्य स यत्राशयत्समृता सेधति स्रिधः । अप्सा याति स्वधया दैव्यं जनं सं सुष्टुती नसते सं गोअग्रया ॥
mantras.transliteration: tveṣaṃ rūpaṃ kṛṇute varṇo asya sa yatrāśayatsamṛtā sedhati sridhaḥ | apsā yāti svadhayā daivyaṃ janaṃ saṃ suṣṭutī nasate saṃ goagrayā ||

translations.english: His ray creates a shining form; at whatever battle it is present, it beats down the adversaries; the giver of water goes with the oblation to the divine people, (it meets) with good praise; (Soma) is joined by (a hymn) demanding kine as the chief boon.

mantras.sanskrit: उक्षेव यूथा परियन्नरावीदधि त्विषीरधित सूर्यस्य । दिव्यः सुपर्णोऽव चक्षत क्षां सोमः परि क्रतुना पश्यते जाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ukṣeva yūthā pariyannarāvīdadhi tviṣīradhita sūryasya | divyaḥ suparṇo'va cakṣata kṣāṃ somaḥ pari kratunā paśyate jāḥ ||

translations.english: Like a bull approaching the herbs (Soma) roars (as he approaches the praises); he appropriates the lustre of the sun; celestial, flying gracefully he looks down upon the earth; by his wisdom Soma contemplates mankind.

mantras.sanskrit: हरिं मृजन्त्यरुषो न युज्यते सं धेनुभिः कलशे सोमो अज्यते । उद्वाचमीरयति हिन्वते मती पुरुष्टुतस्य कति चित्परिप्रियः ॥
mantras.transliteration: hariṃ mṛjantyaruṣo na yujyate saṃ dhenubhiḥ kalaśe somo ajyate | udvācamīrayati hinvate matī puruṣṭutasya kati citparipriyaḥ ||

translations.english: They cleanse the green-tinted (Soma); he is harnessed like a swift horse; the Soma is combined in the pitcher with the products of the kine. He utters a sound, (the worshippers) send forth praise; how many (boons) abundantly delightint the utterer of many praises (does Soma bestow).

mantras.sanskrit: साकं वदन्ति बहवो मनीषिण इन्द्रस्य सोमं जठरे यदादुहुः । यदी मृजन्ति सुगभस्तयो नरः सनीळाभिर्दशभिः काम्यं मधु ॥
mantras.transliteration: sākaṃ vadanti bahavo manīṣiṇa indrasya somaṃ jaṭhare yadāduhuḥ | yadī mṛjanti sugabhastayo naraḥ sanīḷābhirdaśabhiḥ kāmyaṃ madhu ||

translations.english: Many wise men utter praise together, when they have milked the Soma into Indra's belly, when fair-armed men cleanse the delightful exhilarating juice with their ten united (fingers).

mantras.sanskrit: अरममाणो अत्येति गा अभि सूर्यस्य प्रियं दुहितुस्तिरो रवम् । अन्वस्मै जोषमभरद्विनंगृसः सं द्वयीभिः स्वसृभिः क्षेति जामिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aramamāṇo atyeti gā abhi sūryasya priyaṃ duhitustiro ravam | anvasmai joṣamabharadvinaṃgṛsaḥ saṃ dvayībhiḥ svasṛbhiḥ kṣeti jāmibhiḥ ||

translations.english: Unceasing, the Soma goes to mix with the products of the kine, he utters a cry dear to the daughter of the sun. The praiser brings delight to him; he is united to the two kindred sisters (the hands).

mantras.sanskrit: नृधूतो अद्रिषुतो बर्हिषि प्रियः पतिर्गवां प्रदिव इन्दुॠत्वियः । पुरंधिवान्मनुषो यज्ञसाधनः शुचिर्धिया पवते सोम इन्द्र ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: nṛdhūto adriṣuto barhiṣi priyaḥ patirgavāṃ pradiva induṝtviyaḥ | puraṃdhivānmanuṣo yajñasādhanaḥ śucirdhiyā pavate soma indra te ||

translations.english: Shaken by the men, expressed by the stones, the delight (of the gods), the lord of cattle, ancient, distilling (in the vessels) born in due season, (the Soma is plural ced) on the sacrd grass; intelligent, the material of the sacrifice of man, pure, the Soma flows for you, Indra,of his own accord.

mantras.sanskrit: नृबाहुभ्यां चोदितो धारया सुतोऽनुष्वधं पवते सोम इन्द्र ते । आप्राः क्रतून्त्समजैरध्वरे मतीर्वेर्न द्रुषच्चम्वोरासदद्धरिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nṛbāhubhyāṃ codito dhārayā suto'nuṣvadhaṃ pavate soma indra te | āprāḥ kratūntsamajairadhvare matīrverna druṣaccamvorāsadaddhariḥ ||

translations.english: Urged by the arms of men, poured forth in a stream the Soma flows for you, Indra, for strength; you accomplish the rites, you overcome enemies at the sacrifice; the green-tinted Soma rests upon the cups like a bird perching on a tree.

mantras.sanskrit: अंशुं दुहन्ति स्तनयन्तमक्षितं कविं कवयोऽपसो मनीषिणः । समी गावो मतयो यन्ति संयत ऋतस्य योना सदने पुनर्भुवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aṃśuṃ duhanti stanayantamakṣitaṃ kaviṃ kavayo'paso manīṣiṇaḥ | samī gāvo matayo yanti saṃyata ṛtasya yonā sadane punarbhuvaḥ ||

translations.english: The seers, the experienced performers of holy acts, milk forth the seer, the loud-sounding undecaying Soma; the regenerated cattle and the praises combined repair to him at the plural ce of birth of the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: नाभा पृथिव्या धरुणो महो दिवोऽपामूर्मौ सिन्धुष्वन्तरुक्षितः । इन्द्रस्य वज्रो वृषभो विभूवसुः सोमो हृदे पवते चारु मत्सरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nābhā pṛthivyā dharuṇo maho divo'pāmūrmau sindhuṣvantarukṣitaḥ | indrasya vajro vṛṣabho vibhūvasuḥ somo hṛde pavate cāru matsaraḥ ||

translations.english: The supporter of the vast heaven, (plural ced) upon the navel of the earth, moistened among the rivers in the wave of the waters, the thunderbolt of Indra, the showerer (of benefits), the possessor of wealth, Soma auspiciously exhilarating distils into (Indra's) heart.

mantras.sanskrit: स तू पवस्व परि पार्थिवं रजः स्तोत्रे शिक्षन्नाधून्वते च सुक्रतो । मा नो निर्भाग्वसुनः सादनस्पृशो रयिं पिशङ्गं बहुलं वसीमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa tū pavasva pari pārthivaṃ rajaḥ stotre śikṣannādhūnvate ca sukrato | mā no nirbhāgvasunaḥ sādanaspṛśo rayiṃ piśaṅgaṃ bahulaṃ vasīmahi ||

translations.english: Performer of good deeds, flow quickly round the terrestrial region, giving (riches) to the worshipper and the shaker (of the libation); do not deprive us of the wealth that enriches our dwellings; may we be invested with abundant wealth of diverse kinds.

mantras.sanskrit: आ तू न इन्दो शतदात्वश्व्यं सहस्रदातु पशुमद्धिरण्यवत् । उप मास्व बृहती रेवतीरिषोऽधि स्तोत्रस्य पवमान नो गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tū na indo śatadātvaśvyaṃ sahasradātu paśumaddhiraṇyavat | upa māsva bṛhatī revatīriṣo'dhi stotrasya pavamāna no gahi ||

translations.english: On Indu, bring us quickly (wealth) with a hundred gifts, with horses, with a thousand gifts, with cattle and with gold; measure unto us abundant riches and food; come, purified one, to (hear) our praise.

mantras.sanskrit: स्रक्वे द्रप्सस्य धमतः समस्वरन्नृतस्य योना समरन्त नाभयः । त्रीन्त्स मूर्ध्नो असुरश्चक्र आरभे सत्यस्य नावः सुकृतमपीपरन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: srakve drapsasya dhamataḥ samasvarannṛtasya yonā samaranta nābhayaḥ | trīntsa mūrdhno asuraścakra ārabhe satyasya nāvaḥ sukṛtamapīparan ||

translations.english: (The streams) of the dripping effused (Soma) sound together on the jaw (of the sacrifice), the Soma-juices flow together to the plural ce of sacrifice. The powerful (Soma) has made the three exalted worlds for the use (of men and gods); the ships of the truthful (Soma) satisfy the pious worshipper.

mantras.sanskrit: सम्यक्सम्यञ्चो महिषा अहेषत सिन्धोरूर्मावधि वेना अवीविपन् । मधोर्धाराभिर्जनयन्तो अर्कमित्प्रियामिन्द्रस्य तन्वमवीवृधन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: samyaksamyañco mahiṣā aheṣata sindhorūrmāvadhi venā avīvipan | madhordhārābhirjanayanto arkamitpriyāmindrasya tanvamavīvṛdhan ||

translations.english: The mighty (priests) assembled together send forth (the Soma) together; desirous (of heaven) they drive it to the wave of the river; genitive rating praise they nourish the previous body of Indra with the streams of the exhilarating Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: पवित्रवन्तः परि वाचमासते पितैषां प्रत्नो अभि रक्षति व्रतम् । महः समुद्रं वरुणस्तिरो दधे धीरा इच्छेकुर्धरुणेष्वारभम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavitravantaḥ pari vācamāsate pitaiṣāṃ pratno abhi rakṣati vratam | mahaḥ samudraṃ varuṇastiro dadhe dhīrā icchekurdharuṇeṣvārabham ||

translations.english: (The rays of the Soma) having the means of purification sit round the voice (of the firmament), their ancient father protects their (light-giving) work; Soma the all-developer has overspread the mighty firmament (with them); the skilful (priests) are able to conduct (the Soma) to the all-sustaining (waters).

mantras.sanskrit: सहस्रधारेऽव ते समस्वरन्दिवो नाके मधुजिह्वा असश्चतः । अस्य स्पशो न नि मिषन्ति भूर्णयः पदेपदे पाशिनः सन्ति सेतवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sahasradhāre'va te samasvarandivo nāke madhujihvā asaścataḥ | asya spaśo na ni miṣanti bhūrṇayaḥ padepade pāśinaḥ santi setavaḥ ||

translations.english: (The Soma rays) in the firmament of a thousand streams (unite with the earth) below; in the summit of heaven, sweet-tongued, in separate drops, his rays, swiftly moving, never shut their eyes; fixed each in his plural ce, they are the molesters (of sinners).

mantras.sanskrit: पितुर्मातुरध्या ये समस्वरन्नृचा शोचन्तः संदहन्तो अव्रतान् । इन्द्रद्विष्टामप धमन्ति मायया त्वचमसिक्नीं भूमनो दिवस्परि ॥
mantras.transliteration: piturmāturadhyā ye samasvarannṛcā śocantaḥ saṃdahanto avratān | indradviṣṭāmapa dhamanti māyayā tvacamasiknīṃ bhūmano divaspari ||

translations.english: (The rays) which were manifested in heaven and earth, illumined by the hymn (of praise), consuming the impious (sacrificers), drive away by their wisdom from earth and heaven the black-skinned (rākṣasas) hated by Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रत्नान्मानादध्या ये समस्वरञ्छ्लोकयन्त्रासो रभसस्य मन्तवः । अपानक्षासो बधिरा अहासत ऋतस्य पन्थां न तरन्ति दुष्कृतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pratnānmānādadhyā ye samasvarañchlokayantrāso rabhasasya mantavaḥ | apānakṣāso badhirā ahāsata ṛtasya panthāṃ na taranti duṣkṛtaḥ ||

translations.english: (The rays) which regulating praise and purposing rapidity of action, were manifested from the ancient firmament, them the blind and deaf avoid; the wicked traverse not the path of truth.

mantras.sanskrit: सहस्रधारे वितते पवित्र आ वाचं पुनन्ति कवयो मनीषिणः । रुद्रास एषामिषिरासो अद्रुहः स्पशः स्वञ्चः सुदृशो नृचक्षसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sahasradhāre vitate pavitra ā vācaṃ punanti kavayo manīṣiṇaḥ | rudrāsa eṣāmiṣirāso adruhaḥ spaśaḥ svañcaḥ sudṛśo nṛcakṣasaḥ ||

translations.english: The intelligent sages extol the voice (of the firmament) in the purifying extended (Soma) with its thousand streams; the Rudras are their servants, swift-moving, inviolable, revered, of goodly aspect, the beholders of men.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतस्य गोपा न दभाय सुक्रतुस्त्री ष पवित्रा हृद्यन्तरा दधे । विद्वान्त्स विश्वा भुवनाभि पश्यत्यवाजुष्टान्विध्यति कर्ते अव्रतान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtasya gopā na dabhāya sukratustrī ṣa pavitrā hṛdyantarā dadhe | vidvāntsa viśvā bhuvanābhi paśyatyavājuṣṭānvidhyati karte avratān ||

translations.english: (Soma) the protector of the sacrifice, the doer of good deeds cannot be resisted; he plural ces in his heart the three purifiers; he the all-wise looks over all worlds; he censures those who are hostile in action, who sacrifice not.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतस्य तन्तुर्विततः पवित्र आ जिह्वाया अग्रे वरुणस्य मायया । धीराश्चित्तत्समिनक्षन्त आशतात्रा कर्तमव पदात्यप्रभुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtasya tanturvitataḥ pavitra ā jihvāyā agre varuṇasya māyayā | dhīrāścittatsaminakṣanta āśatātrā kartamava padātyaprabhuḥ ||

translations.english: The threads of the sacrifice spread over the filter extends by its act to the tip of Varuṇa's tongue; the wise approaching reached it;but he who is incompetent for the rite sinks (to hell) even in this world.

mantras.sanskrit: शिशुर्न जातोऽव चक्रदद्वने स्वर्यद्वाज्यरुषः सिषासति । दिवो रेतसा सचते पयोवृधा तमीमहे सुमती शर्म सप्रथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śiśurna jāto'va cakradadvane svaryadvājyaruṣaḥ siṣāsati | divo retasā sacate payovṛdhā tamīmahe sumatī śarma saprathaḥ ||

translations.english: Born in the water (the Soma) cries out like a child, when powerful and brilliant he wishes to enjoy heaven; he comes from the sky tomix with the water that nourish the kine; we ask him by our praises for an opulent dwelling.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवो यः स्कम्भो धरुणः स्वातत आपूर्णो अंशुः पर्येति विश्वतः । सेमे मही रोदसी यक्षदावृता समीचीने दाधार समिषः कविः ॥
mantras.transliteration: divo yaḥ skambho dharuṇaḥ svātata āpūrṇo aṃśuḥ paryeti viśvataḥ | seme mahī rodasī yakṣadāvṛtā samīcīne dādhāra samiṣaḥ kaviḥ ||

translations.english: The supporter of heaven, the prop (of the earth), the Soma-juice who, widely spreading, filling (the vessels), flows in all directions-- may he unite the two great worlds by his own strength; he has upheld them combined; (may he) the sage (bestow) food upon (his worshippers).

mantras.sanskrit: महि प्सरः सुकृतं सोम्यं मधूर्वी गव्यूतिरदितेॠतं यते । ईशे यो वृष्टेरित उस्रियो वृषापां नेता य इतऊतिॠग्मियः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahi psaraḥ sukṛtaṃ somyaṃ madhūrvī gavyūtiraditeṝtaṃ yate | īśe yo vṛṣṭerita usriyo vṛṣāpāṃ netā ya itaūtiṝgmiyaḥ ||

translations.english: (There is) abundant food well-prepared made of Soma and sweet for (Indra) who comes to the sacrifice; the way to earth is broad; (for Indra) who is the lord of the rain (that falls) here, the possessor of cattle, the showerer of water, the leader (of the sacrifice), whose road is hither, who is deserving of praise.

mantras.sanskrit: आत्मन्वन्नभो दुह्यते घृतं पय ऋतस्य नाभिरमृतं वि जायते । समीचीनाः सुदानवः प्रीणन्ति तं नरो हितमव मेहन्ति पेरवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ātmanvannabho duhyate ghṛtaṃ paya ṛtasya nābhiramṛtaṃ vi jāyate | samīcīnāḥ sudānavaḥ prīṇanti taṃ naro hitamava mehanti peravaḥ ||

translations.english: Full of sap the butter and milk is milked from heaven, the bond of the sacrifice, the water is genitive rated; the assembled liberal givers delight him; (the Soma-juices) the leaders, the protectors shower down the accusative ulated (water).

mantras.sanskrit: अरावीदंशुः सचमान ऊर्मिणा देवाव्यं मनुषे पिन्वति त्वचम् । दधाति गर्भमदितेरुपस्थ आ येन तोकं च तनयं च धामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: arāvīdaṃśuḥ sacamāna ūrmiṇā devāvyaṃ manuṣe pinvati tvacam | dadhāti garbhamaditerupastha ā yena tokaṃ ca tanayaṃ ca dhāmahe ||

translations.english: Combining with the wave the Soma utters a cry; he sprinkles his god-protecting body for the worshipper; he plural ces the germ upon the lap of the earth, whereby we acquire sons and grandsons.

mantras.sanskrit: सहस्रधारेऽव ता असश्चतस्तृतीये सन्तु रजसि प्रजावतीः । चतस्रो नाभो निहिता अवो दिवो हविर्भरन्त्यमृतं घृतश्चुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sahasradhāre'va tā asaścatastṛtīye santu rajasi prajāvatīḥ | catasro nābho nihitā avo divo havirbharantyamṛtaṃ ghṛtaścutaḥ ||

translations.english: May those (juices) which are in the third world, the world of many streams, unconnected, bestowing progeny, descend; the four digits (of the Soma) sent down from heaven bearing water bring the oblation and the nectar.

mantras.sanskrit: श्वेतं रूपं कृणुते यत्सिषासति सोमो मीढ्वाँ असुरो वेद भूमनः । धिया शमी सचते सेमभि प्रवद्दिवस्कवन्धमव दर्षदुद्रिणम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śvetaṃ rūpaṃ kṛṇute yatsiṣāsati somo mīḍhvā~ asuro veda bhūmanaḥ | dhiyā śamī sacate semabhi pravaddivaskavandhamava darṣadudriṇam ||

translations.english: When the Soma seeks to gain (heaven) he assumes a white colour; showering (benefits), powerful he knows (how to bestow) abundant wealth (upon the worshippers). He by his wisdom is associated with excellent rites; he bursts asunder the rain cloud from heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: अध श्वेतं कलशं गोभिरक्तं कार्ष्मन्ना वाज्यक्रमीत्ससवान् । आ हिन्विरे मनसा देवयन्तः कक्षीवते शतहिमाय गोनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha śvetaṃ kalaśaṃ gobhiraktaṃ kārṣmannā vājyakramītsasavān | ā hinvire manasā devayantaḥ kakṣīvate śatahimāya gonām ||

translations.english: Thus the Soma successfully reaches the white water besprinkled pitcher like a horse (reaching) the goal; the devout (priests) stimulate him with their praise; (he bestows) cattle upon Kakṣīvat who has seen a hundred winters.

mantras.sanskrit: अद्भिः सोम पपृचानस्य ते रसोऽव्यो वारं वि पवमान धावति । स मृज्यमानः कविभिर्मदिन्तम स्वदस्वेन्द्राय पवमान पीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: adbhiḥ soma papṛcānasya te raso'vyo vāraṃ vi pavamāna dhāvati | sa mṛjyamānaḥ kavibhirmadintama svadasvendrāya pavamāna pītaye ||

translations.english: Purified Soma, when you are diluted with the water your juice passes through the woollen fleece; cleansed by the sages, O exhilarating purified (Soma), be sweet-flavoured for Indra to drink.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि प्रियाणि पवते चनोहितो नामानि यह्वो अधि येषु वर्धते । आ सूर्यस्य बृहतो बृहन्नधि रथं विष्वञ्चमरुहद्विचक्षणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi priyāṇi pavate canohito nāmāni yahvo adhi yeṣu vardhate | ā sūryasya bṛhato bṛhannadhi rathaṃ viṣvañcamaruhadvicakṣaṇaḥ ||

translations.english: (The Soma) fit for good flows towards the delightful waters in which the mighty (Soma) is fostered; the beholder of all, the great (Soma) mounts themighty sun's chariot which go everywhere.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतस्य जिह्वा पवते मधु प्रियं वक्ता पतिर्धियो अस्या अदाभ्यः । दधाति पुत्रः पित्रोरपीच्यं नाम तृतीयमधि रोचने दिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtasya jihvā pavate madhu priyaṃ vaktā patirdhiyo asyā adābhyaḥ | dadhāti putraḥ pitrorapīcyaṃ nāma tṛtīyamadhi rocane divaḥ ||

translations.english: The tongue of the sacrifice (Soma) distils the delightful exhilarating (juice), speaking, lord of this rite, unassailable; the son (the sacrificer) assumes a third name unknown to his parents in the briliance of heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: अव द्युतानः कलशाँ अचिक्रदन्नृभिर्येमानः कोश आ हिरण्यये । अभीमृतस्य दोहना अनूषताधि त्रिपृष्ठ उषसो वि राजति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ava dyutānaḥ kalaśā~ acikradannṛbhiryemānaḥ kośa ā hiraṇyaye | abhīmṛtasya dohanā anūṣatādhi tripṛṣṭha uṣaso vi rājati ||

translations.english: Shining, he cries aloud (descending) into the vessels, pressed by the priests into the golden receptacle; the milk of the sacrifice glorify him; the supporter of the three sacrifices shines (most) on the days of sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: अद्रिभिः सुतो मतिभिश्चनोहितः प्ररोचयन्रोदसी मातरा शुचिः । रोमाण्यव्या समया वि धावति मधोर्धारा पिन्वमाना दिवेदिवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: adribhiḥ suto matibhiścanohitaḥ prarocayanrodasī mātarā śuciḥ | romāṇyavyā samayā vi dhāvati madhordhārā pinvamānā divedive ||

translations.english: Effused by the stones and by the praises, fit for food, illuminating heaven and earth the parents (of the universe), pure, (the Soma), flows between the sheep's hairs, diluted (with the water) the stream of the exhilarating beverage (is purified) day by day.

mantras.sanskrit: परि सोम प्र धन्वा स्वस्तये नृभिः पुनानो अभि वासयाशिरम् । ये ते मदा आहनसो विहायसस्तेभिरिन्द्रं चोदय दातवे मघम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari soma pra dhanvā svastaye nṛbhiḥ punāno abhi vāsayāśiram | ye te madā āhanaso vihāyasastebhirindraṃ codaya dātave magham ||

translations.english: Soma, flow forth for our welfare; purified by the priests cloth yourself in the (milky) mixture; with the exhilarating loud-sounding mighty juices which you have, inspire Indra to bestow affluence upon us.

mantras.sanskrit: धर्ता दिवः पवते कृत्व्यो रसो दक्षो देवानामनुमाद्यो नृभिः । हरिः सृजानो अत्यो न सत्वभिर्वृथा पाजांसि कृणुते नदीष्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhartā divaḥ pavate kṛtvyo raso dakṣo devānāmanumādyo nṛbhiḥ | hariḥ sṛjāno atyo na satvabhirvṛthā pājāṃsi kṛṇute nadīṣvā ||

translations.english: (Soma) the sustainer (of all) flows from the firmament, the purifiable juice, the invigorator of the gods, worthy tobe praised by the priests; green-tinted like a horse let loose by the charioteers he easily restores his vigour in the waters.

mantras.sanskrit: शूरो न धत्त आयुधा गभस्त्योः स्वः सिषासन्रथिरो गविष्टिषु । इन्द्रस्य शुष्ममीरयन्नपस्युभिरिन्दुर्हिन्वानो अज्यते मनीषिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śūro na dhatta āyudhā gabhastyoḥ svaḥ siṣāsanrathiro gaviṣṭiṣu | indrasya śuṣmamīrayannapasyubhirindurhinvāno ajyate manīṣibhiḥ ||

translations.english: Like a hero he carries weapons in his hands, desirous of enjoying felicity, mounting his chariot in quest of the cattle (of the worshipper), animating the strength of Indra, Indu, urged by the wise performers of pious acts, is anointed (with the milk and curds).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य सोम पवमान ऊर्मिणा तविष्यमाणो जठरेष्वा विश । प्र णः पिन्व विद्युदभ्रेव रोदसी धिया न वाजाँ उप मासि शश्वतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrasya soma pavamāna ūrmiṇā taviṣyamāṇo jaṭhareṣvā viśa | pra ṇaḥ pinva vidyudabhreva rodasī dhiyā na vājā~ upa māsi śaśvataḥ ||

translations.english: Soma who are purified, who desire strength enter Indra's belly in a mighty stream; milk heaven and earth for us as lightning (milks) the clouds; now with the rite meter (unto us) abundant food.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वस्य राजा पवते स्वर्दृश ऋतस्य धीतिमृषिषाळवीवशत् । यः सूर्यस्यासिरेण मृज्यते पिता मतीनामसमष्टकाव्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvasya rājā pavate svardṛśa ṛtasya dhītimṛṣiṣāḷavīvaśat | yaḥ sūryasyāsireṇa mṛjyate pitā matīnāmasamaṣṭakāvyaḥ ||

translations.english: (Soma) the soverign of the universe flows forth; surpassing the ṛṣis he desire the worship of the all-seeing truthful (Indra); he who is cleansed by the ray of he sun, the father of praise, the unequalled sage.

mantras.sanskrit: वृषेव यूथा परि कोशमर्षस्यपामुपस्थे वृषभः कनिक्रदत् । स इन्द्राय पवसे मत्सरिन्तमो यथा जेषाम समिथे त्वोतयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣeva yūthā pari kośamarṣasyapāmupasthe vṛṣabhaḥ kanikradat | sa indrāya pavase matsarintamo yathā jeṣāma samithe tvotayaḥ ||

translations.english: As a bull (entering) the herd you rush to the receptacle, on the top of the waters, showering (benefits) crying aloud; you flow for Indra, most exhilarating so that we may be victorious in battle protected by you.

mantras.sanskrit: एष प्र कोशे मधुमाँ अचिक्रददिन्द्रस्य वज्रो वपुषो वपुष्टरः । अभीमृतस्य सुदुघा घृतश्चुतो वाश्रा अर्षन्ति पयसेव धेनवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa pra kośe madhumā~ acikradadindrasya vajro vapuṣo vapuṣṭaraḥ | abhīmṛtasya sudughā ghṛtaścuto vāśrā arṣanti payaseva dhenavaḥ ||

translations.english: The sweet-flavoured beverage sounds in the pitcher, the thunderbolt of Indra, more beautiful than the beautiful; (the stream) of this veracious (Soma) approach yielding much milk, dropping water, lowing like kine (laden) with milk.

mantras.sanskrit: स पूर्व्यः पवते यं दिवस्परि श्येनो मथायदिषितस्तिरो रजः । स मध्व आ युवते वेविजान इत्कृशानोरस्तुर्मनसाह बिभ्युषा ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa pūrvyaḥ pavate yaṃ divaspari śyeno mathāyadiṣitastiro rajaḥ | sa madhva ā yuvate vevijāna itkṛśānorasturmanasāha bibhyuṣā ||

translations.english: The ancient (Soma) flows, which the hawk, despatched (for the purpose), brought down from heaven passing through the (third) world; he detaches the sweet-flavoured (Soma) flying downwards, with mind full of fear of the archer Kṛśānu.

mantras.sanskrit: ते नः पूर्वास उपरास इन्दवो महे वाजाय धन्वन्तु गोमते । ईक्षेण्यासो अह्यो न चारवो ब्रह्मब्रह्म ये जुजुषुर्हविर्हविः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te naḥ pūrvāsa uparāsa indavo mahe vājāya dhanvantu gomate | īkṣeṇyāso ahyo na cāravo brahmabrahma ye jujuṣurhavirhaviḥ ||

translations.english: May the former and the latter Soma-juices flow to give us abundant food and milk, plural asing to look upon like beautiful well-adorned (women), which (juices) perform every prayer and every oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं नो विद्वान्वनवद्वनुष्यत इन्दुः सत्राचा मनसा पुरुष्टुतः । इनस्य यः सदने गर्भमादधे गवामुरुब्जमभ्यर्षति व्रजम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ no vidvānvanavadvanuṣyata induḥ satrācā manasā puruṣṭutaḥ | inasya yaḥ sadane garbhamādadhe gavāmurubjamabhyarṣati vrajam ||

translations.english: May this Indu, praised of many, knowing those who desire to slay us, slay them with united mind; who being in the dwelling of the lord (Agni) deposits a germ (in the herds) and hastens to (our) milk-giving herd of cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: चक्रिर्दिवः पवते कृत्व्यो रसो महाँ अदब्धो वरुणो हुरुग्यते । असावि मित्रो वृजनेषु यज्ञियोऽत्यो न यूथे वृषयुः कनिक्रदत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: cakrirdivaḥ pavate kṛtvyo raso mahā~ adabdho varuṇo hurugyate | asāvi mitro vṛjaneṣu yajñiyo'tyo na yūthe vṛṣayuḥ kanikradat ||

translations.english: The maker of all, clever in work, the juice, mighty unassailable Varuṇa flows from heaven for the sake of him who go hither and thither; the friend of the adorable (Soma) is effused in affliction uttering a sound like an ardent horse amidst a herd (of mares). [

mantras.sanskrit: प्र राजा वाचं जनयन्नसिष्यददपो वसानो अभि गा इयक्षति । गृभ्णाति रिप्रमविरस्य तान्वा शुद्धो देवानामुप याति निष्कृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra rājā vācaṃ janayannasiṣyadadapo vasāno abhi gā iyakṣati | gṛbhṇāti ripramavirasya tānvā śuddho devānāmupa yāti niṣkṛtam ||

translations.english: This royal (Soma) producing a sound flows forth; clothing himself with the water he advances towards the praises (of the worshipper); the sheep with its fleece lays hold of the impure form; purified he approaches the station of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राय सोम परि षिच्यसे नृभिर्नृचक्षा ऊर्मिः कविरज्यसे वने । पूर्वीर्हि ते स्रुतयः सन्ति यातवे सहस्रमश्वा हरयश्चमूषदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāya soma pari ṣicyase nṛbhirnṛcakṣā ūrmiḥ kavirajyase vane | pūrvīrhi te srutayaḥ santi yātave sahasramaśvā harayaścamūṣadaḥ ||

translations.english: You are effused by the priests, Soma, for Indra; you the observer of men, stimulated, intelligent, are immersed in the water; many are the paths for you to follow, infinite are the spreading green-tinted streams alighting on the cups.

mantras.sanskrit: समुद्रिया अप्सरसो मनीषिणमासीना अन्तरभि सोममक्षरन् । ता ईं हिन्वन्ति हर्म्यस्य सक्षणिं याचन्ते सुम्नं पवमानमक्षितम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: samudriyā apsaraso manīṣiṇamāsīnā antarabhi somamakṣaran | tā īṃ hinvanti harmyasya sakṣaṇiṃ yācante sumnaṃ pavamānamakṣitam ||

translations.english: The nymphs of the firmament seated in the midst flow towards the sagacious Soma; they cherish him the sprinkler of the hall of sacrifice; (the worshippers) solicit  Pavamāna (the undecaying) for a boon.

mantras.sanskrit: गोजिन्नः सोमो रथजिद्धिरण्यजित्स्वर्जिदब्जित्पवते सहस्रजित् । यं देवासश्चक्रिरे पीतये मदं स्वादिष्ठं द्रप्समरुणं मयोभुवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: gojinnaḥ somo rathajiddhiraṇyajitsvarjidabjitpavate sahasrajit | yaṃ devāsaścakrire pītaye madaṃ svādiṣṭhaṃ drapsamaruṇaṃ mayobhuvam ||

translations.english: Soma flows for us, the conqueror of cattle, of chariots, of gold, of heaven, of water, of thousandfold (wealth), whom the gods have made for (their) drinking, exhilarating, most sweet-flavoured, dropping, purple, causing happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: एतानि सोम पवमानो अस्मयुः सत्यानि कृण्वन्द्रविणान्यर्षसि । जहि शत्रुमन्तिके दूरके च य उर्वीं गव्यूतिमभयं च नस्कृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: etāni soma pavamāno asmayuḥ satyāni kṛṇvandraviṇānyarṣasi | jahi śatrumantike dūrake ca ya urvīṃ gavyūtimabhayaṃ ca naskṛdhi ||

translations.english: Bestowing all these true riches, loving us you flow, Soma, purified; destroy our enemy whether he be far or nigh; grant us a free road and freedom from danger.

mantras.sanskrit: अचोदसो नो धन्वन्त्विन्दवः प्र सुवानासो बृहद्दिवेषु हरयः । वि च नशन्न इषो अरातयोऽर्यो नशन्त सनिषन्त नो धियः ॥
mantras.transliteration: acodaso no dhanvantvindavaḥ pra suvānāso bṛhaddiveṣu harayaḥ | vi ca naśanna iṣo arātayo'ryo naśanta saniṣanta no dhiyaḥ ||

translations.english: May the spontaneous Soma-juices flow to us at the brilliant (sacrifices), green-tinted, effused; may they be destroyed who are the withholders of food from us; may (our) foes be destroyed; may (the gods) enjoy our pious acts.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र णो धन्वन्त्विन्दवो मदच्युतो धना वा येभिरर्वतो जुनीमसि । तिरो मर्तस्य कस्य चित्परिह्वृतिं वयं धनानि विश्वधा भरेमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra ṇo dhanvantvindavo madacyuto dhanā vā yebhirarvato junīmasi | tiro martasya kasya citparihvṛtiṃ vayaṃ dhanāni viśvadhā bharemahi ||

translations.english: May they flow to us, may they bring us riches-- the honey-dropping Soma-juices by whose aid we encounter the powerful (enemy); may we overcoming the opposition of every man always bear off his wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्वस्या अरात्या अरिर्हि ष उतान्यस्या अरात्या वृको हि षः । धन्वन्न तृष्णा समरीत ताँ अभि सोम जहि पवमान दुराध्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta svasyā arātyā arirhi ṣa utānyasyā arātyā vṛko hi ṣaḥ | dhanvanna tṛṣṇā samarīta tā~ abhi soma jahi pavamāna durādhyaḥ ||

translations.english: For the (Soma) verily is the foe of his own enemy and the destroyer of the enemy of another; as thirst overcomes one in a desert, so purified Soma, who are irresistible, slay (both) those (adversaries).

mantras.sanskrit: दिवि ते नाभा परमो य आददे पृथिव्यास्ते रुरुहुः सानवि क्षिपः । अद्रयस्त्वा बप्सति गोरधि त्वच्यप्सु त्वा हस्तैर्दुदुहुर्मनीषिणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: divi te nābhā paramo ya ādade pṛthivyāste ruruhuḥ sānavi kṣipaḥ | adrayastvā bapsati goradhi tvacyapsu tvā hastairduduhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ||

translations.english: Your best juice (dwells) in the navel of heaven, that which receives (the oblation); your (members) grow up thrown upon the summit of the earth; the stones devour you upon the cowhide; the wise (priests) milk you into the water with their hands.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा त इन्दो सुभ्वं सुपेशसं रसं तुञ्जन्ति प्रथमा अभिश्रियः । निदंनिदं पवमान नि तारिष आविस्ते शुष्मो भवतु प्रियो मदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā ta indo subhvaṃ supeśasaṃ rasaṃ tuñjanti prathamā abhiśriyaḥ | nidaṃnidaṃ pavamāna ni tāriṣa āviste śuṣmo bhavatu priyo madaḥ ||

translations.english: Thus, Indu, the chief (priests) making the mixture send forth your well-lodged, well-formed juice (rasa); purified Soma, destroy (our) reviler; let your potent, delightful, exhilarating (juice) appoear.

mantras.sanskrit: सोमस्य धारा पवते नृचक्षस ऋतेन देवान्हवते दिवस्परि । बृहस्पते रवथेना वि दिद्युते समुद्रासो न सवनानि विव्यचुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: somasya dhārā pavate nṛcakṣasa ṛtena devānhavate divaspari | bṛhaspate ravathenā vi didyute samudrāso na savanāni vivyacuḥ ||

translations.english: The stream of the Soma, the contemplator of man, flows forth; it invites by the sacrifice the gods (who dwell) above the sky; it shines forth at the voice of the sacrificer; the libations cover (the earth) like rivers.

mantras.sanskrit: यं त्वा वाजिन्नघ्न्या अभ्यनूषतायोहतं योनिमा रोहसि द्युमान् । मघोनामायुः प्रतिरन्महि श्रव इन्द्राय सोम पवसे वृषा मदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ tvā vājinnaghnyā abhyanūṣatāyohataṃ yonimā rohasi dyumān | maghonāmāyuḥ pratiranmahi śrava indrāya soma pavase vṛṣā madaḥ ||

translations.english: Giver of food, whom the kine praise, you mount, bright-shining, your station fashioned by golden-hands; you, Soma, the health of the worshippers, increasing (their) abundant food flow for Indra, the showerer (of benefits), the giver of exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: एन्द्रस्य कुक्षा पवते मदिन्तम ऊर्जं वसानः श्रवसे सुमङ्गलः । प्रत्यङ्स विश्वा भुवनाभि पप्रथे क्रीळन्हरिरत्यः स्यन्दते वृषा ॥
mantras.transliteration: endrasya kukṣā pavate madintama ūrjaṃ vasānaḥ śravase sumaṅgalaḥ | pratyaṅsa viśvā bhuvanābhi paprathe krīḷanhariratyaḥ syandate vṛṣā ||

translations.english: The (Soma) flows to Indra's belly for (his) food, giving extreme exhilaration, clothed with vigour, giving good fortune he spreads forth towards all beings; sporting (on the altar), green-tinted, swift-moving, the showerer of benefits, he flows forth.

mantras.sanskrit: तं त्वा देवेभ्यो मधुमत्तमं नरः सहस्रधारं दुहते दश क्षिपः । नृभिः सोम प्रच्युतो ग्रावभिः सुतो विश्वान्देवाँ आ पवस्वा सहस्रजित् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ tvā devebhyo madhumattamaṃ naraḥ sahasradhāraṃ duhate daśa kṣipaḥ | nṛbhiḥ soma pracyuto grāvabhiḥ suto viśvāndevā~ ā pavasvā sahasrajit ||

translations.english: The priests, the ten fingers, milk you forth for the gods, most sweet-flavoured, flowing in a thousand streams; effused by the men, expressed with the stone, do you, Soma, the winner of thousand-fold wealth, flow to all the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: तं त्वा हस्तिनो मधुमन्तमद्रिभिर्दुहन्त्यप्सु वृषभं दश क्षिपः । इन्द्रं सोम मादयन्दैव्यं जनं सिन्धोरिवोर्मिः पवमानो अर्षसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ tvā hastino madhumantamadribhirduhantyapsu vṛṣabhaṃ daśa kṣipaḥ | indraṃ soma mādayandaivyaṃ janaṃ sindhorivormiḥ pavamāno arṣasi ||

translations.english: The ten fingers of the skillful (one) milk you forth with the stones into the water most sweet-flavoured, the showerer (of benefits); Soma, exhilarating Indra (and) the celestial people, you rush forth, when filtered, like the wave of a river.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सोमस्य पवमानस्योर्मय इन्द्रस्य यन्ति जठरं सुपेशसः । दध्ना यदीमुन्नीता यशसा गवां दानाय शूरमुदमन्दिषुः सुताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra somasya pavamānasyormaya indrasya yanti jaṭharaṃ supeśasaḥ | dadhnā yadīmunnītā yaśasā gavāṃ dānāya śūramudamandiṣuḥ sutāḥ ||

translations.english: The graceful waves of the purified Soma flow into Indra's belly when being effused and drawn forth (together) with the potent curds of the kine, they excite the hero to bestow (gifts to the worshippers).

mantras.sanskrit: अच्छा हि सोमः कलशाँ असिष्यददत्यो न वोळ्हा रघुवर्तनिर्वृषा । अथा देवानामुभयस्य जन्मनो विद्वाँ अश्नोत्यमुत इतश्च यत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: acchā hi somaḥ kalaśā~ asiṣyadadatyo na voḷhā raghuvartanirvṛṣā | athā devānāmubhayasya janmano vidvā~ aśnotyamuta itaśca yat ||

translations.english: The flows towards the pitchers, like a darught horse, lightly moving, the showerer; and knowing both races of gods-- those who come to (the sacrifice) from the other world and those who (come) from this world.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नः सोम पवमानः किरा वस्विन्दो भव मघवा राधसो महः । शिक्षा वयोधो वसवे सु चेतुना मा नो गयमारे अस्मत्परा सिचः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā naḥ soma pavamānaḥ kirā vasvindo bhava maghavā rādhaso mahaḥ | śikṣā vayodho vasave su cetunā mā no gayamāre asmatparā sicaḥ ||

translations.english: Soma, when purified, strew upon us wealth; Indu, who are possessed of affluence, be (the donor) of ample riches; dispenser of food, grant to Vasu prosperity through (your) intelligence, scatter not our riches far from us.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नः पूषा पवमानः सुरातयो मित्रो गच्छन्तु वरुणः सजोषसः । बृहस्पतिर्मरुतो वायुरश्विना त्वष्टा सविता सुयमा सरस्वती ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā naḥ pūṣā pavamānaḥ surātayo mitro gacchantu varuṇaḥ sajoṣasaḥ | bṛhaspatirmaruto vāyuraśvinā tvaṣṭā savitā suyamā sarasvatī ||

translations.english: May the genitive rous (gods) meet together to us-- Pūṣan, Pavamāna, Mitra, Varuṇa, Bṛhaspati, the Maruts, Vāyu, the Aśvins, Tvaṣṭā, savitā, and beautiful Sarasvatī. [

mantras.sanskrit: उभे द्यावापृथिवी विश्वमिन्वे अर्यमा देवो अदितिर्विधाता । भगो नृशंस उर्वन्तरिक्षं विश्वे देवाः पवमानं जुषन्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: ubhe dyāvāpṛthivī viśvaminve aryamā devo aditirvidhātā | bhago nṛśaṃsa urvantarikṣaṃ viśve devāḥ pavamānaṃ juṣanta ||

translations.english: The all-pervading couple heaven and earth, the divine Aryaman, Aditi, Vidhātā, Bhaga deserving the praise of men, the spacious firmament, all the gods honour the purified (Soma).

mantras.sanskrit: असावि सोमो अरुषो वृषा हरी राजेव दस्मो अभि गा अचिक्रदत् । पुनानो वारं पर्येत्यव्ययं श्येनो न योनिं घृतवन्तमासदम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asāvi somo aruṣo vṛṣā harī rājeva dasmo abhi gā acikradat | punāno vāraṃ paryetyavyayaṃ śyeno na yoniṃ ghṛtavantamāsadam ||

translations.english: The Soma has been effused radiant, the showerer, green-inted; magnificent as a king, he cries aloud when approaching the waters; purified, he passes through the sheep's fleece, to alight on the water-moistened seat like a hawk (on its nest).

mantras.sanskrit: कविर्वेधस्या पर्येषि माहिनमत्यो न मृष्टो अभि वाजमर्षसि । अपसेधन्दुरिता सोम मृळय घृतं वसानः परि यासि निर्णिजम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kavirvedhasyā paryeṣi māhinamatyo na mṛṣṭo abhi vājamarṣasi | apasedhanduritā soma mṛḷaya ghṛtaṃ vasānaḥ pari yāsi nirṇijam ||

translations.english: You, who are wise, pass through the adorable (filter) with a desire to perform the sacrifice; being cleansed you rush like a horse to the cattle. Driving away misfortunes be gracious (to us), Soma; clothed in water you proceed to the cleansing (vessel).

mantras.sanskrit: पर्जन्यः पिता महिषस्य पर्णिनो नाभा पृथिव्या गिरिषु क्षयं दधे । स्वसार आपो अभि गा उतासरन्त्सं ग्रावभिर्नसते वीते अध्वरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: parjanyaḥ pitā mahiṣasya parṇino nābhā pṛthivyā giriṣu kṣayaṃ dadhe | svasāra āpo abhi gā utāsarantsaṃ grāvabhirnasate vīte adhvare ||

translations.english: The mighty winged (Soma) whose father is Parjanya has plural ced his dwelling on the navel of the earth among the mountains; the sisters, the waters flow to (the produce of) the kine; he meets with the stones at the beloved sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: जायेव पत्यावधि शेव मंहसे पज्राया गर्भ शृणुहि ब्रवीमि ते । अन्तर्वाणीषु प्र चरा सु जीवसेऽनिन्द्यो वृजने सोम जागृहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: jāyeva patyāvadhi śeva maṃhase pajrāyā garbha śṛṇuhi bravīmi te | antarvāṇīṣu pra carā su jīvase'nindyo vṛjane soma jāgṛhi ||

translations.english: As a wife to her husband, so you (afford) delight to your worshipper; (Soma), offspring of Pajra, listen (to the praises) I address to you; in the midst of our adorations advance to grant us life; Soma, who are irreproachable, be vigilant against (our) foe.

mantras.sanskrit: यथा पूर्वेभ्यः शतसा अमृध्रः सहस्रसाः पर्यया वाजमिन्दो । एवा पवस्व सुविताय नव्यसे तव व्रतमन्वापः सचन्ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathā pūrvebhyaḥ śatasā amṛdhraḥ sahasrasāḥ paryayā vājamindo | evā pavasva suvitāya navyase tava vratamanvāpaḥ sacante ||

translations.english: As you, Indu, did attain strength for the ancient (ṛṣis), giving them hundred-fold (wealth), invulnerable, giving them thousand-fold (wealth); so now flow for (our) modern prosperity; the waters wait upon your functions.

mantras.sanskrit: पवित्रं ते विततं ब्रह्मणस्पते प्रभुर्गात्राणि पर्येषि विश्वतः । अतप्ततनूर्न तदामो अश्नुते शृतास इद्वहन्तस्तत्समाशत ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavitraṃ te vitataṃ brahmaṇaspate prabhurgātrāṇi paryeṣi viśvataḥ | ataptatanūrna tadāmo aśnute śṛtāsa idvahantastatsamāśata ||

translations.english: Lord or prayer, your filter is stretched out; you who are the sovereign, enter its members from all sides; the raw (liquid) whose mass is not heated attains not this (filter); it is the boiled (liquids) bearing (the sacrifice) which attain it.

mantras.sanskrit: तपोष्पवित्रं विततं दिवस्पदे शोचन्तो अस्य तन्तवो व्यस्थिरन् । अवन्त्यस्य पवीतारमाशवो दिवस्पृष्ठमधि तिष्ठन्ति चेतसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: tapoṣpavitraṃ vitataṃ divaspade śocanto asya tantavo vyasthiran | avantyasya pavītāramāśavo divaspṛṣṭhamadhi tiṣṭhanti cetasā ||

translations.english: The filter of the foe-scorching (Soma) is spread on the summit of heaven; his shining filaments are separated, his swift-flowing (juices) protect the purifier (the worshipper), they dwell upon the summit of the sky in their wish (to approach the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: अरूरुचदुषसः पृश्निरग्रिय उक्षा बिभर्ति भुवनानि वाजयुः । मायाविनो ममिरे अस्य मायया नृचक्षसः पितरो गर्भमा दधुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: arūrucaduṣasaḥ pṛśniragriya ukṣā bibharti bhuvanāni vājayuḥ | māyāvino mamire asya māyayā nṛcakṣasaḥ pitaro garbhamā dadhuḥ ||

translations.english: The chief sun of the dawn (the Soma) shines forth; sprinkler (of water), he nourishes the worlds, wishing (to have them) food; by his intelligence the intelligent build, the pitṛs, the beholders of men, support the germ (of vegetation).

mantras.sanskrit: गन्धर्व इत्था पदमस्य रक्षति पाति देवानां जनिमान्यद्भुतः । गृभ्णाति रिपुं निधया निधापतिः सुकृत्तमा मधुनो भक्षमाशत ॥
mantras.transliteration: gandharva itthā padamasya rakṣati pāti devānāṃ janimānyadbhutaḥ | gṛbhṇāti ripuṃ nidhayā nidhāpatiḥ sukṛttamā madhuno bhakṣamāśata ||

translations.english: The gandharva verily protects this station; the marvellous (Soma) preserves the races of the gods; the lord of cattle seizes (our enemy) with a snare, the doers of good attain the drinking of the sweet-juiced (Soma).

mantras.sanskrit: हविर्हविष्मो महि सद्म दैव्यं नभो वसानः परि यास्यध्वरम् । राजा पवित्ररथो वाजमारुहः सहस्रभृष्टिर्जयसि श्रवो बृहत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: havirhaviṣmo mahi sadma daivyaṃ nabho vasānaḥ pari yāsyadhvaram | rājā pavitraratho vājamāruhaḥ sahasrabhṛṣṭirjayasi śravo bṛhat ||

translations.english: Possessed of water, you go clothed in the liquid water, to the great celestial abode to (take) the sacrifice; as king you ascend to the battle, mounted to your filter-chariot; armed with a thousand weapons you win (us) abundant food.

mantras.sanskrit: पवस्व देवमादनो विचर्षणिरप्सा इन्द्राय वरुणाय वायवे । कृधी नो अद्य वरिवः स्वस्तिमदुरुक्षितौ गृणीहि दैव्यं जनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavasva devamādano vicarṣaṇirapsā indrāya varuṇāya vāyave | kṛdhī no adya varivaḥ svastimadurukṣitau gṛṇīhi daivyaṃ janam ||

translations.english: Flow, the exhilarator of the gods, the far-seeing, the giver of water; for Indra, Varuṇa and Vāyu; grant us this day wealth and health; call the celestial people on the spacious ground (of the sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: आ यस्तस्थौ भुवनान्यमर्त्यो विश्वानि सोमः परि तान्यर्षति । कृण्वन्त्संचृतं विचृतमभिष्टय इन्दुः सिषक्त्युषसं न सूर्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yastasthau bhuvanānyamartyo viśvāni somaḥ pari tānyarṣati | kṛṇvantsaṃcṛtaṃ vicṛtamabhiṣṭaya induḥ siṣaktyuṣasaṃ na sūryaḥ ||

translations.english: The immortal Soma who is stationed upon the worlds, goes round about them all; Indu,binding and unloosing accompanies (the sacrifice) for its protection, as the sun the dawn.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यो गोभिः सृज्यत ओषधीष्वा देवानां सुम्न इषयन्नुपावसुः । आ विद्युता पवते धारया सुत इन्द्रं सोमो मादयन्दैव्यं जनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yo gobhiḥ sṛjyata oṣadhīṣvā devānāṃ sumna iṣayannupāvasuḥ | ā vidyutā pavate dhārayā suta indraṃ somo mādayandaivyaṃ janam ||

translations.english: The Soma who is created by the (sun's) rays, (and whom they plural ce) in the herbs for the gratification of the gods, desiring to go (to the gods), taking wealth from (the foe), flows when effused in a brilliant stream, exhilarating Indra (and) the people of heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: एष स्य सोमः पवते सहस्रजिद्धिन्वानो वाचमिषिरामुषर्बुधम् । इन्दुः समुद्रमुदियर्ति वायुभिरेन्द्रस्य हार्दि कलशेषु सीदति ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa sya somaḥ pavate sahasrajiddhinvāno vācamiṣirāmuṣarbudham | induḥ samudramudiyarti vāyubhirendrasya hārdi kalaśeṣu sīdati ||

translations.english: This is the Soma, the conqueror of thousands, who flows stimulating the rapid voice (of the priests), awakened at dawn; Indu sends forth his ocean and sinks into the pitchers into Indra's heart.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि त्यं गावः पयसा पयोवृधं सोमं श्रीणन्ति मतिभिः स्वर्विदम् । धनंजयः पवते कृत्व्यो रसो विप्रः कविः काव्येना स्वर्चनाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi tyaṃ gāvaḥ payasā payovṛdhaṃ somaṃ śrīṇanti matibhiḥ svarvidam | dhanaṃjayaḥ pavate kṛtvyo raso vipraḥ kaviḥ kāvyenā svarcanāḥ ||

translations.english: The kine dilute with their milk that milk augmenting Soma who bestows all things by means of praises; (the Soma) the winner of (our foes') wealth flows purified by the rite, apt for the rite, wise, experienced, the (giver of) all food.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राय सोम सुषुतः परि स्रवापामीवा भवतु रक्षसा सह । मा ते रसस्य मत्सत द्वयाविनो द्रविणस्वन्त इह सन्त्विन्दवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāya soma suṣutaḥ pari sravāpāmīvā bhavatu rakṣasā saha | mā te rasasya matsata dvayāvino draviṇasvanta iha santvindavaḥ ||
