translations.english: Flow forth, Soma, well-effused for Indra; may disease and the rākṣasas be (kept) far off; let not the double-dealers be exhilarated by your juices; may the Soma-juices be full of wealth at this (sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मान्त्समर्ये पवमान चोदय दक्षो देवानामसि हि प्रियो मदः । जहि शत्रूँरभ्या भन्दनायतः पिबेन्द्र सोममव नो मृधो जहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmāntsamarye pavamāna codaya dakṣo devānāmasi hi priyo madaḥ | jahi śatrū~rabhyā bhandanāyataḥ pibendra somamava no mṛdho jahi ||

translations.english: Purified (Soma), animate us in battle; for you are powerful, dear to the gods, the exhilarator. Slay our foes, approach (us) who desire (to propitiate you by) praises; Indra, drink the Soma, destroy our adversaries.

mantras.sanskrit: अदब्ध इन्दो पवसे मदिन्तम आत्मेन्द्रस्य भवसि धासिरुत्तमः । अभि स्वरन्ति बहवो मनीषिणो राजानमस्य भुवनस्य निंसते ॥
mantras.transliteration: adabdha indo pavase madintama ātmendrasya bhavasi dhāsiruttamaḥ | abhi svaranti bahavo manīṣiṇo rājānamasya bhuvanasya niṃsate ||

translations.english: You flow, Indu, the inviolable, the most exhilarating; you are yourself the best support for Indra; may sages approach and glorify you the ruler of this world.

mantras.sanskrit: सहस्रणीथः शतधारो अद्भुत इन्द्रायेन्दुः पवते काम्यं मधु । जयन्क्षेत्रमभ्यर्षा जयन्नप उरुं नो गातुं कृणु सोम मीढ्वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sahasraṇīthaḥ śatadhāro adbhuta indrāyenduḥ pavate kāmyaṃ madhu | jayankṣetramabhyarṣā jayannapa uruṃ no gātuṃ kṛṇu soma mīḍhvaḥ ||

translations.english: The guide of thousands, flowing in a hundred streams, marvellous, Indu flows forth for Indra, (his) beloved beverage; approach (the filter) winning (us) land, winning water, O Soma, sprinkler, make our path broad.

mantras.sanskrit: कनिक्रदत्कलशे गोभिरज्यसे व्यव्ययं समया वारमर्षसि । मर्मृज्यमानो अत्यो न सानसिरिन्द्रस्य सोम जठरे समक्षरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kanikradatkalaśe gobhirajyase vyavyayaṃ samayā vāramarṣasi | marmṛjyamāno atyo na sānasirindrasya soma jaṭhare samakṣaraḥ ||

translations.english: Crying aloud you are blended in the pitcher with curds and milk, you pass through the woollen fleece in the midst; being cleansed like a horse, distributing (gifts), you flow, Soma, into Indra's belly.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वादुः पवस्व दिव्याय जन्मने स्वादुरिन्द्राय सुहवीतुनाम्ने । स्वादुर्मित्राय वरुणाय वायवे बृहस्पतये मधुमाँ अदाभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: svāduḥ pavasva divyāya janmane svādurindrāya suhavītunāmne | svādurmitrāya varuṇāya vāyave bṛhaspataye madhumā~ adābhyaḥ ||

translations.english: Flow sweet for the celestial people, flow sweet for Indra, whose name is worthily invoked; sweet for Mitra, Varuṇa, Vāyu, Bṛhaspati, you who are the sweet-flavoured, inviolable.

mantras.sanskrit: अत्यं मृजन्ति कलशे दश क्षिपः प्र विप्राणां मतयो वाच ईरते । पवमाना अभ्यर्षन्ति सुष्टुतिमेन्द्रं विशन्ति मदिरास इन्दवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: atyaṃ mṛjanti kalaśe daśa kṣipaḥ pra viprāṇāṃ matayo vāca īrate | pavamānā abhyarṣanti suṣṭutimendraṃ viśanti madirāsa indavaḥ ||

translations.english: The ten fingers clean the horse in the pitcher; among the vipras the worshippers send forth praises; the filtered (juices) hasten to the fair praise, the exhilarating Soma juices enter Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: पवमानो अभ्यर्षा सुवीर्यमुर्वीं गव्यूतिं महि शर्म सप्रथः । माकिर्नो अस्य परिषूतिरीशतेन्दो जयेम त्वया धनंधनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamāno abhyarṣā suvīryamurvīṃ gavyūtiṃ mahi śarma saprathaḥ | mākirno asya pariṣūtirīśatendo jayema tvayā dhanaṃdhanam ||

translations.english: (Soma), when filtered, bring us male progeny, extensive pastures, a large and spacious mansion; let no hinderer of this (rite) be lord over us; Indu, through you may we win all wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: अधि द्यामस्थाद्वृषभो विचक्षणोऽरूरुचद्वि दिवो रोचना कविः । राजा पवित्रमत्येति रोरुवद्दिवः पीयूषं दुहते नृचक्षसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhi dyāmasthādvṛṣabho vicakṣaṇo'rūrucadvi divo rocanā kaviḥ | rājā pavitramatyeti roruvaddivaḥ pīyūṣaṃ duhate nṛcakṣasaḥ ||

translations.english: The showerer, the beholder, has taken his station upon heaven, the seer has illumined the luminaries of heaven; the king passes through the filter with a shout, (the Soma juices) the beholders of men milk forth the ambrosia of heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवो नाके मधुजिह्वा असश्चतो वेना दुहन्त्युक्षणं गिरिष्ठाम् । अप्सु द्रप्सं वावृधानं समुद्र आ सिन्धोरूर्मा मधुमन्तं पवित्र आ ॥
mantras.transliteration: divo nāke madhujihvā asaścato venā duhantyukṣaṇaṃ giriṣṭhām | apsu drapsaṃ vāvṛdhānaṃ samudra ā sindhorūrmā madhumantaṃ pavitra ā ||

translations.english: In the heaven of the bright (ssacrifice) the sweet-voiced Venas severally milk forth the sprinkler, the mountain-haunting (Soma); (they sprinkle him) nourished in the waters, juicy, in the ocean (-like pitcher), in the wave of the river; (they sprinkle him) sweet-flavoured, in the filter.

mantras.sanskrit: नाके सुपर्णमुपपप्तिवांसं गिरो वेनानामकृपन्त पूर्वीः । शिशुं रिहन्ति मतयः पनिप्नतं हिरण्ययं शकुनं क्षामणि स्थाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nāke suparṇamupapaptivāṃsaṃ giro venānāmakṛpanta pūrvīḥ | śiśuṃ rihanti matayaḥ panipnataṃ hiraṇyayaṃ śakunaṃ kṣāmaṇi sthām ||

translations.english: The many voices of the Venas praise (the Soma who dwells) in heaven, well-winged, falling (to earth); praises soothe the crying infant, the golden bird, reposing on the earth.

mantras.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वो गन्धर्वो अधि नाके अस्थाद्विश्वा रूपा प्रतिचक्षाणो अस्य । भानुः शुक्रेण शोचिषा व्यद्यौत्प्रारूरुचद्रोदसी मातरा शुचिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūrdhvo gandharvo adhi nāke asthādviśvā rūpā praticakṣāṇo asya | bhānuḥ śukreṇa śociṣā vyadyautprārūrucadrodasī mātarā śuciḥ ||

translations.english: The elevated gandharva abides above the sun contemplating all its forms; the sun shines with white light, radiant he illumines the creative heaven and earth.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र त आशवः पवमान धीजवो मदा अर्षन्ति रघुजा इव त्मना । दिव्याः सुपर्णा मधुमन्त इन्दवो मदिन्तमासः परि कोशमासते ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra ta āśavaḥ pavamāna dhījavo madā arṣanti raghujā iva tmanā | divyāḥ suparṇā madhumanta indavo madintamāsaḥ pari kośamāsate ||

translations.english: Your (juices), purified (Soma), all-pervading, quick as thought, go of themselves like the offspring of swift (mares); the celestial well-winged sweet-flavoured juices, great exciters of exhilaration, alight upon the receptacle.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ते मदासो मदिरास आशवोऽसृक्षत रथ्यासो यथा पृथक् । धेनुर्न वत्सं पयसाभि वज्रिणमिन्द्रमिन्दवो मधुमन्त ऊर्मयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra te madāso madirāsa āśavo'sṛkṣata rathyāso yathā pṛthak | dhenurna vatsaṃ payasābhi vajriṇamindramindavo madhumanta ūrmayaḥ ||

translations.english: Your exhilarating, all-pervading juices are let loose separately like chariot-horses; the sweet-flavoured (Soma) waves (go) to Indra the wilder of the thunderbolt as a cow with her milk to the calf.

mantras.sanskrit: अत्यो न हियानो अभि वाजमर्ष स्वर्वित्कोशं दिवो अद्रिमातरम् । वृषा पवित्रे अधि सानो अव्यये सोमः पुनान इन्द्रियाय धायसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: atyo na hiyāno abhi vājamarṣa svarvitkośaṃ divo adrimātaram | vṛṣā pavitre adhi sāno avyaye somaḥ punāna indriyāya dhāyase ||

translations.english: Like a horse urged on to battle, do you who are all-knowing rush from heaven to the receptacle whose mother is the cloud; Soma the showerer (of benefits) is being purified at the top upon the woollen filter for Indra's strength which supports (the world).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र त आश्विनीः पवमान धीजुवो दिव्या असृग्रन्पयसा धरीमणि । प्रान्तॠषयः स्थाविरीरसृक्षत ये त्वा मृजन्त्यृषिषाण वेधसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra ta āśvinīḥ pavamāna dhījuvo divyā asṛgranpayasā dharīmaṇi | prāntaṝṣayaḥ sthāvirīrasṛkṣata ye tvā mṛjantyṛṣiṣāṇa vedhasaḥ ||

translations.english: Purified (Soma), your celestial steed-like (streams) as quick as thought are poured along with the milk into the receptacle; the ṛṣis, the ordainers (of sacrifice), who cleanse you, O ṛṣi-enjoyed (Soma), pour your continuous (streams) into the midst (of the vessel).

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वा धामानि विश्वचक्ष ऋभ्वसः प्रभोस्ते सतः परि यन्ति केतवः । व्यानशिः पवसे सोम धर्मभिः पतिर्विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvā dhāmāni viśvacakṣa ṛbhvasaḥ prabhoste sataḥ pari yanti ketavaḥ | vyānaśiḥ pavase soma dharmabhiḥ patirviśvasya bhuvanasya rājasi ||

translations.english: All-seeing (Soma), the mighty rays of you, who are the lord, encompass all the sphere; pervading (all things) you flow, Soma, through your functions; you rule lord of the whole world.

mantras.sanskrit: उभयतः पवमानस्य रश्मयो ध्रुवस्य सतः परि यन्ति केतवः । यदी पवित्रे अधि मृज्यते हरिः सत्ता नि योना कलशेषु सीदति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ubhayataḥ pavamānasya raśmayo dhruvasya sataḥ pari yanti ketavaḥ | yadī pavitre adhi mṛjyate hariḥ sattā ni yonā kalaśeṣu sīdati ||

translations.english: The rays, the tokens of the extant, steady, purified Soma, circulate from both worlds; when the green-tinted juice is cleansed upon the filter, reposing it alights upon its station, the pitchers.

mantras.sanskrit: यज्ञस्य केतुः पवते स्वध्वरः सोमो देवानामुप याति निष्कृतम् । सहस्रधारः परि कोशमर्षति वृषा पवित्रमत्येति रोरुवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajñasya ketuḥ pavate svadhvaraḥ somo devānāmupa yāti niṣkṛtam | sahasradhāraḥ pari kośamarṣati vṛṣā pavitramatyeti roruvat ||

translations.english: Soma, the signal of sacrifice, the object of pious worship, flows filtered; it approaches the abode of the gods; the thousand-streamed rushes to the receptacle, the showerer passes roaring through the filter.

mantras.sanskrit: राजा समुद्रं नद्यो वि गाहतेऽपामूर्मिं सचते सिन्धुषु श्रितः । अध्यस्थात्सानु पवमानो अव्ययं नाभा पृथिव्या धरुणो महो दिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: rājā samudraṃ nadyo vi gāhate'pāmūrmiṃ sacate sindhuṣu śritaḥ | adhyasthātsānu pavamāno avyayaṃ nābhā pṛthivyā dharuṇo maho divaḥ ||

translations.english: The royal (Soma) plural nges into the firmament, (and) the rivers (thereof), mixed with the streams, he associates with the wave of the waters; being filtered he stands upon the uplifted woollen (filter) on the navel of the earth, the upholder of the vast heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवो न सानु स्तनयन्नचिक्रदद्द्यौश्च यस्य पृथिवी च धर्मभिः । इन्द्रस्य सख्यं पवते विवेविदत्सोमः पुनानः कलशेषु सीदति ॥
mantras.transliteration: divo na sānu stanayannacikradaddyauśca yasya pṛthivī ca dharmabhiḥ | indrasya sakhyaṃ pavate vivevidatsomaḥ punānaḥ kalaśeṣu sīdati ||

translations.english: Thundering like the summit of the sky (the Soma) roars, by whose support both heaven and earth, (are upheld); the Soma flows acquiring Indra's friendship, purified he alights upon the pitchers.

mantras.sanskrit: ज्योतिर्यज्ञस्य पवते मधु प्रियं पिता देवानां जनिता विभूवसुः । दधाति रत्नं स्वधयोरपीच्यं मदिन्तमो मत्सर इन्द्रियो रसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: jyotiryajñasya pavate madhu priyaṃ pitā devānāṃ janitā vibhūvasuḥ | dadhāti ratnaṃ svadhayorapīcyaṃ madintamo matsara indriyo rasaḥ ||

translations.english: The light of the sacrifice, he distils sweet (juice) delightful (to the gods), the parent of the gods, the genitive rator (of all), possessed of ample wealth; he supports the hidden wealth of heaven and earth, the most exhilarating, the exciting (Soma), the nourisher of (Indra), the juice.

mantras.sanskrit: अभिक्रन्दन्कलशं वाज्यर्षति पतिर्दिवः शतधारो विचक्षणः । हरिर्मित्रस्य सदनेषु सीदति मर्मृजानोऽविभिः सिन्धुभिर्वृषा ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhikrandankalaśaṃ vājyarṣati patirdivaḥ śatadhāro vicakṣaṇaḥ | harirmitrasya sadaneṣu sīdati marmṛjāno'vibhiḥ sindhubhirvṛṣā ||

translations.english: The rapid (Soma), thelord of heaven, the thousand-streamed, the beholder (of all), rushes crying aloud to the pitcher, the green-tinted one alights upon Mitra's dwelling plural ce, cleansed by the sheep's hairs and the waters, the shower.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्रे सिन्धूनां पवमानो अर्षत्यग्रे वाचो अग्रियो गोषु गच्छति । अग्रे वाजस्य भजते महाधनं स्वायुधः सोतृभिः पूयते वृषा ॥
mantras.transliteration: agre sindhūnāṃ pavamāno arṣatyagre vāco agriyo goṣu gacchati | agre vājasya bhajate mahādhanaṃ svāyudhaḥ sotṛbhiḥ pūyate vṛṣā ||

translations.english: In the front of the waters rushes the filtered (Soma), foremost (he rushes) in the front of the voice, he goes among the rays; in the front he engages in battle (to win) food; well-armed, the showerer (of benefits), he is purified by the offerers of the oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं मतवाञ्छकुनो यथा हितोऽव्ये ससार पवमान ऊर्मिणा । तव क्रत्वा रोदसी अन्तरा कवे शुचिर्धिया पवते सोम इन्द्र ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ matavāñchakuno yathā hito'vye sasāra pavamāna ūrmiṇā | tava kratvā rodasī antarā kave śucirdhiyā pavate soma indra te ||

translations.english: This (Soma) possessed of agreeable (praise) filtered, and sent forth, (quick) as a bird goes with a stream (of juice) through the fleece; by your sustaining act, by your intelligence, sage Indra, the pure Soma flows purified through both heaven and earth.

mantras.sanskrit: द्रापिं वसानो यजतो दिविस्पृशमन्तरिक्षप्रा भुवनेष्वर्पितः । स्वर्जज्ञानो नभसाभ्यक्रमीत्प्रत्नमस्य पितरमा विवासति ॥
mantras.transliteration: drāpiṃ vasāno yajato divispṛśamantarikṣaprā bhuvaneṣvarpitaḥ | svarjajñāno nabhasābhyakramītpratnamasya pitaramā vivāsati ||

translations.english: Wearing a coat of mail reaching to heaven, the adorable Soma, who fills the firmament (with rain), plural ced in the waters, genitive rating heaven,passes with the water, (and) worships its ancient parent (Indra).

mantras.sanskrit: सो अस्य विशे महि शर्म यच्छति यो अस्य धाम प्रथमं व्यानशे । पदं यदस्य परमे व्योमन्यतो विश्वा अभि सं याति संयतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: so asya viśe mahi śarma yacchati yo asya dhāma prathamaṃ vyānaśe | padaṃ yadasya parame vyomanyato viśvā abhi saṃ yāti saṃyataḥ ||

translations.english: (Soma), who first reached Indra's glorious body, gives great happiness to the entrance of Indra (that Soma), whose station is in the highest heaven, and through whom (Indra) triumphs in all contests.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रो अयासीदिन्दुरिन्द्रस्य निष्कृतं सखा सख्युर्न प्र मिनाति संगिरम् । मर्य इव युवतिभिः समर्षति सोमः कलशे शतयाम्ना पथा ॥
mantras.transliteration: pro ayāsīdindurindrasya niṣkṛtaṃ sakhā sakhyurna pra mināti saṃgiram | marya iva yuvatibhiḥ samarṣati somaḥ kalaśe śatayāmnā pathā ||

translations.english: Indu goes to Indra's abode, the friend leaves not the stomach of his friend; as a young man meets maidens, so the Soma (meets) the pitcher by a hundred pathṣ

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वो धियो मन्द्रयुवो विपन्युवः पनस्युवः संवसनेष्वक्रमुः । सोमं मनीषा अभ्यनूषत स्तुभोऽभि धेनवः पयसेमशिश्रयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vo dhiyo mandrayuvo vipanyuvaḥ panasyuvaḥ saṃvasaneṣvakramuḥ | somaṃ manīṣā abhyanūṣata stubho'bhi dhenavaḥ payasemaśiśrayuḥ ||

translations.english: Your thoughtful worshippers (Soma), desiring an exhilarating sound, purposing praise, advance into the halls of sacrifice; the praisers the lords of intellect praise Soma, the kine approach him with their milk.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नः सोम संयतं पिप्युषीमिषमिन्दो पवस्व पवमानो अस्रिधम् । या नो दोहते त्रिरहन्नसश्चुषी क्षुमद्वाजवन्मधुमत्सुवीर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā naḥ soma saṃyataṃ pipyuṣīmiṣamindo pavasva pavamāno asridham | yā no dohate trirahannasaścuṣī kṣumadvājavanmadhumatsuvīryam ||

translations.english: Radiant Soma, when filtered, pour upon us accusative ulated unwasting nutritious food, which is milked for us three times a day, without hindrance, giving forth a sound, yielding strength and delight and fair male offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: वृषा मतीनां पवते विचक्षणः सोमो अह्नः प्रतरीतोषसो दिवः । क्राणा सिन्धूनां कलशाँ अवीवशदिन्द्रस्य हार्द्याविशन्मनीषिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣā matīnāṃ pavate vicakṣaṇaḥ somo ahnaḥ pratarītoṣaso divaḥ | krāṇā sindhūnāṃ kalaśā~ avīvaśadindrasya hārdyāviśanmanīṣibhiḥ ||

translations.english: The all-obsergant Soma, the showerer (of the desires) of his eulogists, the increase of the day, the dawn, the sun; maker of rivers he desires to enter the pitchers, penetrating to Indra's heart, (praised) by the wise.

mantras.sanskrit: मनीषिभिः पवते पूर्व्यः कविर्नृभिर्यतः परि कोशाँ अचिक्रदत् । त्रितस्य नाम जनयन्मधु क्षरदिन्द्रस्य वायोः सख्याय कर्तवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: manīṣibhiḥ pavate pūrvyaḥ kavirnṛbhiryataḥ pari kośā~ acikradat | tritasya nāma janayanmadhu kṣaradindrasya vāyoḥ sakhyāya kartave ||

translations.english: The ancient sage (Soma) is purified by the wise, guided by the priests he roars into the receptacles; genitive rating the water of the threefold (Indra), he distils sweet juice to gain Indra's and Vāyu's friendship.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं पुनान उषसो वि रोचयदयं सिन्धुभ्यो अभवदु लोककृत् । अयं त्रिः सप्त दुदुहान आशिरं सोमो हृदे पवते चारु मत्सरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ punāna uṣaso vi rocayadayaṃ sindhubhyo abhavadu lokakṛt | ayaṃ triḥ sapta duduhāna āśiraṃ somo hṛde pavate cāru matsaraḥ ||

translations.english: (It is) he (who), when purified, illumines the dawn; he the maker of the world is (prosperous) for the rivers; this Soma, having milked the thrice seven (cows) of their curds and milk, exhilarating, flows plural asantly to (go to) the heart.

mantras.sanskrit: पवस्व सोम दिव्येषु धामसु सृजान इन्दो कलशे पवित्र आ । सीदन्निन्द्रस्य जठरे कनिक्रदन्नृभिर्यतः सूर्यमारोहयो दिवि ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavasva soma divyeṣu dhāmasu sṛjāna indo kalaśe pavitra ā | sīdannindrasya jaṭhare kanikradannṛbhiryataḥ sūryamārohayo divi ||

translations.english: Flow, Soma, to the heavenly abodes; let forth, O Indu, (proceed) to the pitcher, to the filter; alighting upon Indra's belly with a noise, guided by the priests, make the sun ascend the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: अद्रिभिः सुतः पवसे पवित्र आँ इन्दविन्द्रस्य जठरेष्वाविशन् । त्वं नृचक्षा अभवो विचक्षण सोम गोत्रमङ्गिरोभ्योऽवृणोरप ॥
mantras.transliteration: adribhiḥ sutaḥ pavase pavitra ā~ indavindrasya jaṭhareṣvāviśan | tvaṃ nṛcakṣā abhavo vicakṣaṇa soma gotramaṅgirobhyo'vṛṇorapa ||

translations.english: Effused with the stones, you flow, Indu, into the filter entering the belly of Indra; Soma, the contemplator, you do look upon man (with affection); you did open the cloud for the aṅgirasas.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वां सोम पवमानं स्वाध्योऽनु विप्रासो अमदन्नवस्यवः । त्वां सुपर्ण आभरद्दिवस्परीन्दो विश्वाभिर्मतिभिः परिष्कृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāṃ soma pavamānaṃ svādhyo'nu viprāso amadannavasyavaḥ | tvāṃ suparṇa ābharaddivasparīndo viśvābhirmatibhiḥ pariṣkṛtam ||

translations.english: The pious worshippers desirous of preservation have glorified you, Soma, when being purified; the hawk brought you from heaven, Indu, adorned with all praises.

mantras.sanskrit: अव्ये पुनानं परि वार ऊर्मिणा हरिं नवन्ते अभि सप्त धेनवः । अपामुपस्थे अध्यायवः कविमृतस्य योना महिषा अहेषत ॥
mantras.transliteration: avye punānaṃ pari vāra ūrmiṇā hariṃ navante abhi sapta dhenavaḥ | apāmupasthe adhyāyavaḥ kavimṛtasya yonā mahiṣā aheṣata ||

translations.english: The seven kine approach the green-tinted (Soma) who flows purified in a stream through the woollen fleece, mighty men urge (you) the sage on the lap of the waters to the plural ce of sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्दुः पुनानो अति गाहते मृधो विश्वानि कृण्वन्त्सुपथानि यज्यवे । गाः कृण्वानो निर्णिजं हर्यतः कविरत्यो न क्रीळन्परि वारमर्षति ॥
mantras.transliteration: induḥ punāno ati gāhate mṛdho viśvāni kṛṇvantsupathāni yajyave | gāḥ kṛṇvāno nirṇijaṃ haryataḥ kaviratyo na krīḷanpari vāramarṣati ||

translations.english: Indu, purified, plural nges through his foes making all things easy of access to the worshipper; making his body liquid, lovable and wise, he rishes through the filter sporting like a horse.

mantras.sanskrit: असश्चतः शतधारा अभिश्रियो हरिं नवन्तेऽव ता उदन्युवः । क्षिपो मृजन्ति परि गोभिरावृतं तृतीये पृष्ठे अधि रोचने दिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asaścataḥ śatadhārā abhiśriyo hariṃ navante'va tā udanyuvaḥ | kṣipo mṛjanti pari gobhirāvṛtaṃ tṛtīye pṛṣṭhe adhi rocane divaḥ ||

translations.english: Separate, hundred-streamed, commingling (with the Soma), water-desiring, (the sun's rays) approach the green-tinted (Soma); the fingers cleanse him pervaded by rays, in the third sphere illumined by the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: तवेमाः प्रजा दिव्यस्य रेतसस्त्वं विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजसि । अथेदं विश्वं पवमान ते वशे त्वमिन्दो प्रथमो धामधा असि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tavemāḥ prajā divyasya retasastvaṃ viśvasya bhuvanasya rājasi | athedaṃ viśvaṃ pavamāna te vaśe tvamindo prathamo dhāmadhā asi ||

translations.english: All these are the offspring of your celestial effluence; you are the ruler of the whole world; so, purified (Soma) this universe is in subjection to you; you, Indu, are the foremost, the supporter of the house.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं समुद्रो असि विश्ववित्कवे तवेमाः पञ्च प्रदिशो विधर्मणि । त्वं द्यां च पृथिवीं चाति जभ्रिषे तव ज्योतींषि पवमान सूर्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ samudro asi viśvavitkave tavemāḥ pañca pradiśo vidharmaṇi | tvaṃ dyāṃ ca pṛthivīṃ cāti jabhriṣe tava jyotīṃṣi pavamāna sūryaḥ ||

translations.english: You, O sage, are the ocean, you are omniscient; these five regions (rest) on your support; you sustain both heaven and earth; the sun, O Pavamāna (nourishes) your luminaries.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं पवित्रे रजसो विधर्मणि देवेभ्यः सोम पवमान पूयसे । त्वामुशिजः प्रथमा अगृभ्णत तुभ्येमा विश्वा भुवनानि येमिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ pavitre rajaso vidharmaṇi devebhyaḥ soma pavamāna pūyase | tvāmuśijaḥ prathamā agṛbhṇata tubhyemā viśvā bhuvanāni yemire ||

translations.english: Purified Soma, you are purified for the gods in the filter the supporter of the worlds; the chief (priests) desiring (you) lay hold (of you), all these worlds offer themselves to you.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र रेभ एत्यति वारमव्ययं वृषा वनेष्वव चक्रदद्धरिः । सं धीतयो वावशाना अनूषत शिशुं रिहन्ति मतयः पनिप्नतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra rebha etyati vāramavyayaṃ vṛṣā vaneṣvava cakradaddhariḥ | saṃ dhītayo vāvaśānā anūṣata śiśuṃ rihanti matayaḥ panipnatam ||

translations.english: The sounding (Soma) passes through the woollen fleece; the green-tinted showerer cries in the waters; the worshippers desiring (the Soma) praise him together, the laudations soothe the infant as he cries.

mantras.sanskrit: स सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः परि व्यत तन्तुं तन्वानस्त्रिवृतं यथा विदे । नयन्नृतस्य प्रशिषो नवीयसीः पतिर्जनीनामुप याति निष्कृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa sūryasya raśmibhiḥ pari vyata tantuṃ tanvānastrivṛtaṃ yathā vide | nayannṛtasya praśiṣo navīyasīḥ patirjanīnāmupa yāti niṣkṛtam ||

translations.english: He invests himself with the rays of the sun stretching out the triple thread in the way he knows; guiding the recent adorations of the truthful (worshipper), the protection of women passes to the consecrated (vessel).

mantras.sanskrit: राजा सिन्धूनां पवते पतिर्दिव ऋतस्य याति पथिभिः कनिक्रदत् । सहस्रधारः परि षिच्यते हरिः पुनानो वाचं जनयन्नुपावसुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: rājā sindhūnāṃ pavate patirdiva ṛtasya yāti pathibhiḥ kanikradat | sahasradhāraḥ pari ṣicyate hariḥ punāno vācaṃ janayannupāvasuḥ ||

translations.english: The sovereign of rivers flows pure, the lord of heaven goes with a shout by the paths of the sacrifice; the thousand-streamed green-tinted (Soma) is poured out, uttering a sound while being filtered, the bringer of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: पवमान मह्यर्णो वि धावसि सूरो न चित्रो अव्ययानि पव्यया । गभस्तिपूतो नृभिरद्रिभिः सुतो महे वाजाय धन्याय धन्वसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamāna mahyarṇo vi dhāvasi sūro na citro avyayāni pavyayā | gabhastipūto nṛbhiradribhiḥ suto mahe vājāya dhanyāya dhanvasi ||

translations.english: Purified (Soma), you pour forth abundant juice; like the wonderful sun (you approach) the fleecy filters; purified by the hands of the priests, expressed with the stones you flow for a mighty wealth-yielding conflict.

mantras.sanskrit: इषमूर्जं पवमानाभ्यर्षसि श्येनो न वंसु कलशेषु सीदसि । इन्द्राय मद्वा मद्यो मदः सुतो दिवो विष्टम्भ उपमो विचक्षणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: iṣamūrjaṃ pavamānābhyarṣasi śyeno na vaṃsu kalaśeṣu sīdasi | indrāya madvā madyo madaḥ suto divo viṣṭambha upamo vicakṣaṇaḥ ||

translations.english: You rush, Pavamāna, to (bring) food and strength; you alight on the pitchers like a falcon on its nest; (you) the exhilarating effused juice giving exhilaration to Indra, resembling the support of heaven, beholding (all things).

mantras.sanskrit: सप्त स्वसारो अभि मातरः शिशुं नवं जज्ञानं जेन्यं विपश्चितम् । अपां गन्धर्वं दिव्यं नृचक्षसं सोमं विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: sapta svasāro abhi mātaraḥ śiśuṃ navaṃ jajñānaṃ jenyaṃ vipaścitam | apāṃ gandharvaṃ divyaṃ nṛcakṣasaṃ somaṃ viśvasya bhuvanasya rājase ||

translations.english: The seven sister mothers approach the new-born, victorious sagacious infant, Soma, abiding amidst the waters, supporter of water, divine the contemplator of men to make him the ruler of the whole world.

mantras.sanskrit: ईशान इमा भुवनानि वीयसे युजान इन्दो हरितः सुपर्ण्यः । तास्ते क्षरन्तु मधुमद्घृतं पयस्तव व्रते सोम तिष्ठन्तु कृष्टयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: īśāna imā bhuvanāni vīyase yujāna indo haritaḥ suparṇyaḥ | tāste kṣarantu madhumadghṛtaṃ payastava vrate soma tiṣṭhantu kṛṣṭayaḥ ||

translations.english: Indu, who are the lord, you go (through) threse worlds, harnessing (to the car) your swift-moving steeds; let them dispense the sweet-flavoured shining liquor, may all men be present Soma, at your worship.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं नृचक्षा असि सोम विश्वतः पवमान वृषभ ता वि धावसि । स नः पवस्व वसुमद्धिरण्यवद्वयं स्याम भुवनेषु जीवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ nṛcakṣā asi soma viśvataḥ pavamāna vṛṣabha tā vi dhāvasi | sa naḥ pavasva vasumaddhiraṇyavadvayaṃ syāma bhuvaneṣu jīvase ||

translations.english: You, Soma, are everywhere, the contemplator of men; you, Pavamāna, the showerer, hasten to these (waters); do you pour forth upon us (wealth), comprising various treasures and gold; may we be (able) to live in the worlds.

mantras.sanskrit: गोवित्पवस्व वसुविद्धिरण्यविद्रेतोधा इन्दो भुवनेष्वर्पितः । त्वं सुवीरो असि सोम विश्ववित्तं त्वा विप्रा उप गिरेम आसते ॥
mantras.transliteration: govitpavasva vasuviddhiraṇyavidretodhā indo bhuvaneṣvarpitaḥ | tvaṃ suvīro asi soma viśvavittaṃ tvā viprā upa girema āsate ||

translations.english: Flow, Indu, who are the winner of cattle, wealth, and gold, the fructifier, plural ced upon the waters; you, Soma, are a hero, omniscient; you these sages approach with praise.

mantras.sanskrit: उन्मध्व ऊर्मिर्वनना अतिष्ठिपदपो वसानो महिषो वि गाहते । राजा पवित्ररथो वाजमारुहत्सहस्रभृष्टिर्जयति श्रवो बृहत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: unmadhva ūrmirvananā atiṣṭhipadapo vasāno mahiṣo vi gāhate | rājā pavitraratho vājamāruhatsahasrabhṛṣṭirjayati śravo bṛhat ||

translations.english: The wave of the swee-flavoured (Soma) exfites voices (of praise); clothed in water the mighty one plural nges (into the pitcher); the king whose chariot is the filter mounts for the conflict, and, armed with a thousand weapons, wins ample sustenance (for us).

mantras.sanskrit: स भन्दना उदियर्ति प्रजावतीर्विश्वायुर्विश्वाः सुभरा अहर्दिवि । ब्रह्म प्रजावद्रयिमश्वपस्त्यं पीत इन्दविन्द्रमस्मभ्यं याचतात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa bhandanā udiyarti prajāvatīrviśvāyurviśvāḥ subharā ahardivi | brahma prajāvadrayimaśvapastyaṃ pīta indavindramasmabhyaṃ yācatāt ||

translations.english: The all-pervading (Soma) exfites both day and night all praises easily borne, productive of prosperity; Indu, when drunk, solicit Indra (to give) us food productive of progeny and riches filling our homes.

mantras.sanskrit: सो अग्रे अह्नां हरिर्हर्यतो मदः प्र चेतसा चेतयते अनु द्युभिः । द्वा जना यातयन्नन्तरीयते नरा च शंसं दैव्यं च धर्तरि ॥
mantras.transliteration: so agre ahnāṃ harirharyato madaḥ pra cetasā cetayate anu dyubhiḥ | dvā janā yātayannantarīyate narā ca śaṃsaṃ daivyaṃ ca dhartari ||

translations.english: At the beginning of the day the green-tinted delightful exhilarating (Soma) is recognized by the intelligence (of the praisers) and by their praises; approaching the two men he passes in the midst (of heaven and earth, bestowing) upon the upholder (of the rite) both human and divine (riches).

mantras.sanskrit: अञ्जते व्यञ्जते समञ्जते क्रतुं रिहन्ति मधुनाभ्यञ्जते । सिन्धोरुच्छ्वासे पतयन्तमुक्षणं हिरण्यपावाः पशुमासु गृभ्णते ॥
mantras.transliteration: añjate vyañjate samañjate kratuṃ rihanti madhunābhyañjate | sindhorucchvāse patayantamukṣaṇaṃ hiraṇyapāvāḥ paśumāsu gṛbhṇate ||

translations.english: (The priests) smear and grease and anoint (the Soma with milk); (the gods) taste the invigorating (juice); they smear it over with sweet (milk). Purifying it with gold, they plural nge it into those (waters) the sprinkler, the beholder, falling into the seething torrent.

mantras.sanskrit: विपश्चिते पवमानाय गायत मही न धारात्यन्धो अर्षति । अहिर्न जूर्णामति सर्पति त्वचमत्यो न क्रीळन्नसरद्वृषा हरिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vipaścite pavamānāya gāyata mahī na dhārātyandho arṣati | ahirna jūrṇāmati sarpati tvacamatyo na krīḷannasaradvṛṣā hariḥ ||

translations.english: Sing (you priests) to the intelligent Pavamāna; like a mighty shower he sends forth food; like a snake he glides out of his old skin, sporting like a horse he hastens forth, the showerer, green-tinted.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्रेगो राजाप्यस्तविष्यते विमानो अह्नां भुवनेष्वर्पितः । हरिर्घृतस्नुः सुदृशीको अर्णवो ज्योतीरथः पवते राय ओक्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agrego rājāpyastaviṣyate vimāno ahnāṃ bhuvaneṣvarpitaḥ | harirghṛtasnuḥ sudṛśīko arṇavo jyotīrathaḥ pavate rāya okyaḥ ||

translations.english: (Soma) going foremost, radiant, sanctified by water, plural ced in the firmament as the measure of days is glorified; green-tinted, shedding water, of goodly aspect, the source of moisture, borne in a chariot of light he flows giving wealth, friendly to the house.

mantras.sanskrit: असर्जि स्कम्भो दिव उद्यतो मदः परि त्रिधातुर्भुवनान्यर्षति । अंशुं रिहन्ति मतयः पनिप्नतं गिरा यदि निर्णिजमृग्मिणो ययुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asarji skambho diva udyato madaḥ pari tridhāturbhuvanānyarṣati | aṃśuṃ rihanti matayaḥ panipnataṃ girā yadi nirṇijamṛgmiṇo yayuḥ ||

translations.english: The supporter of heaven the prepared exhilarating (Soma) is let loose, the triple (beverage) rushes to the waters; the worshippers taste the sounding Soma juice, when the reciters of holy texts approach the embodied (beverage) with praise.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ते धारा अत्यण्वानि मेष्यः पुनानस्य संयतो यन्ति रंहयः । यद्गोभिरिन्दो चम्वोः समज्यस आ सुवानः सोम कलशेषु सीदसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra te dhārā atyaṇvāni meṣyaḥ punānasya saṃyato yanti raṃhayaḥ | yadgobhirindo camvoḥ samajyasa ā suvānaḥ soma kalaśeṣu sīdasi ||

translations.english: The rapid streams of you when you are purified,being collected together pass through the interstices of the fleece; when you are mixed with water in the ladles, you, Soma, on being effused alight on the pitchers.

mantras.sanskrit: पवस्व सोम क्रतुविन्न उक्थ्योऽव्यो वारे परि धाव मधु प्रियम् । जहि विश्वान्रक्षस इन्दो अत्रिणो बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavasva soma kratuvinna ukthyo'vyo vāre pari dhāva madhu priyam | jahi viśvānrakṣasa indo atriṇo bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

translations.english: Flow for us, Soma, cognizant of (our) worship and deserving praise; pour (your) beloved sweet-flavoured (juice) upon the woollen fleece; slay, Indu, all the voracious rākṣasas; blessed with excellent male offspring may we offer ample (praises) at the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र तु द्रव परि कोशं नि षीद नृभिः पुनानो अभि वाजमर्ष । अश्वं न त्वा वाजिनं मर्जयन्तोऽच्छा बर्ही रशनाभिर्नयन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra tu drava pari kośaṃ ni ṣīda nṛbhiḥ punāno abhi vājamarṣa | aśvaṃ na tvā vājinaṃ marjayanto'cchā barhī raśanābhirnayanti ||

translations.english: Flow fast (Soma), sit down on the receptacle, purified by the priests hasten (showing) food (to the sacrificer); cleansing you like a strong horse, they guide you with (their fingers for) reins to the sacred grass.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वायुधः पवते देव इन्दुरशस्तिहा वृजनं रक्षमाणः । पिता देवानां जनिता सुदक्षो विष्टम्भो दिवो धरुणः पृथिव्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: svāyudhaḥ pavate deva induraśastihā vṛjanaṃ rakṣamāṇaḥ | pitā devānāṃ janitā sudakṣo viṣṭambho divo dharuṇaḥ pṛthivyāḥ ||

translations.english: The divine, Indu well-armed flows forth, the destroyer of rākṣasas, averting calamity, the protector of the gods, the progenitor, the powerful one, the prop of heaven, the support of the earth.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋषिर्विप्रः पुरएता जनानामृभुर्धीर उशना काव्येन । स चिद्विवेद निहितं यदासामपीच्यं गुह्यं नाम गोनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛṣirvipraḥ puraetā janānāmṛbhurdhīra uśanā kāvyena | sa cidviveda nihitaṃ yadāsāmapīcyaṃ guhyaṃ nāma gonām ||

translations.english: The ṛṣi, the sage, the foremost of men, the far-shining intelligent Uṣanas-- he verily by his poetic gift discovered the secret milk of those cows which was hidden and concealed.

mantras.sanskrit: एष स्य ते मधुमाँ इन्द्र सोमो वृषा वृष्णे परि पवित्रे अक्षाः । सहस्रसाः शतसा भूरिदावा शश्वत्तमं बर्हिरा वाज्यस्थात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa sya te madhumā~ indra somo vṛṣā vṛṣṇe pari pavitre akṣāḥ | sahasrasāḥ śatasā bhūridāvā śaśvattamaṃ barhirā vājyasthāt ||

translations.english: For you, Indra, the showerer, this sweet-flavoured Soma the showerer has been poured into the filter; the giver of thousand-fold wealth, the giver of hundred-fold wealth, the giver of abundant wealth, the powerful is present at the eternal sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: एते सोमा अभि गव्या सहस्रा महे वाजायामृताय श्रवांसि । पवित्रेभिः पवमाना असृग्रञ्छ्रवस्यवो न पृतनाजो अत्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ete somā abhi gavyā sahasrā mahe vājāyāmṛtāya śravāṃsi | pavitrebhiḥ pavamānā asṛgrañchravasyavo na pṛtanājo atyāḥ ||

translations.english: These Soma-juices, (going towards) the thousand viands produced by the kine, purified, by the filters, are let loose for ample food and ambrosia, desiring food like horses victorious over a host.

mantras.sanskrit: परि हि ष्मा पुरुहूतो जनानां विश्वासरद्भोजना पूयमानः । अथा भर श्येनभृत प्रयांसि रयिं तुञ्जानो अभि वाजमर्ष ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari hi ṣmā puruhūto janānāṃ viśvāsaradbhojanā pūyamānaḥ | athā bhara śyenabhṛta prayāṃsi rayiṃ tuñjāno abhi vājamarṣa ||

translations.english: Invoked by many, the Soma, undergoing purification, pours forth all food (for the sake of men); falcon-borne, bring us food, conveying wealth send forth your juice.

mantras.sanskrit: एष सुवानः परि सोमः पवित्रे सर्गो न सृष्टो अदधावदर्वा । तिग्मे शिशानो महिषो न शृङ्गे गा गव्यन्नभि शूरो न सत्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa suvānaḥ pari somaḥ pavitre sargo na sṛṣṭo adadhāvadarvā | tigme śiśāno mahiṣo na śṛṅge gā gavyannabhi śūro na satvā ||

translations.english: When effused, this quick-flowing Soma hastens to the filter like a steed let loose; while alighting he moves like a buffalo sharpening his pointed horns, like a warrior on a foray for cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: एषा ययौ परमादन्तरद्रेः कूचित्सतीरूर्वे गा विवेद । दिवो न विद्युत्स्तनयन्त्यभ्रैः सोमस्य ते पवत इन्द्र धारा ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣā yayau paramādantaradreḥ kūcitsatīrūrve gā viveda | divo na vidyutstanayantyabhraiḥ somasya te pavata indra dhārā ||

translations.english: This Soma stream has come from on high and has detected the cattle which were in a stall (hidden) somewhere within the mountain; the stream of the Soma flows for you, Indra, thundering like lightning emitted by the clouds from heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्म राशिं परि यासि गोनामिन्द्रेण सोम सरथं पुनानः । पूर्वीरिषो बृहतीर्जीरदानो शिक्षा शचीवस्तव ता उपष्टुत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta sma rāśiṃ pari yāsi gonāmindreṇa soma sarathaṃ punānaḥ | pūrvīriṣo bṛhatīrjīradāno śikṣā śacīvastava tā upaṣṭut ||

translations.english: And being purified, Soma, you pursue the herd of (stolen) cattle in the same chariot with Indra; O you who give quickly, give (us) when invoked plural ntiful and abundant viands, for they are your (property) O you who abound in food.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं सोम इन्द्र तुभ्यं सुन्वे तुभ्यं पवते त्वमस्य पाहि । त्वं ह यं चकृषे त्वं ववृष इन्दुं मदाय युज्याय सोमम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ soma indra tubhyaṃ sunve tubhyaṃ pavate tvamasya pāhi | tvaṃ ha yaṃ cakṛṣe tvaṃ vavṛṣa induṃ madāya yujyāya somam ||

translations.english: This Soma is expressed for you, Indra; for you is filtered; do you drink of it; it is the Indu Soma which you have made, which you have chosen for your exhilaration, your companion.

mantras.sanskrit: स ईं रथो न भुरिषाळयोजि महः पुरूणि सातये वसूनि । आदीं विश्वा नहुष्याणि जाता स्वर्षाता वन ऊर्ध्वा नवन्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa īṃ ratho na bhuriṣāḷayoji mahaḥ purūṇi sātaye vasūni | ādīṃ viśvā nahuṣyāṇi jātā svarṣātā vana ūrdhvā navanta ||

translations.english: It has been harnessed like a great wagon that bears heavy burdens in order to bring us many treasures; after this may all the races of men expecting our (attack) go to the desirable battle.

mantras.sanskrit: वायुर्न यो नियुत्वाँ इष्टयामा नासत्येव हव आ शम्भविष्ठः । विश्ववारो द्रविणोदा इव त्मन्पूषेव धीजवनोऽसि सोम ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāyurna yo niyutvā~ iṣṭayāmā nāsatyeva hava ā śambhaviṣṭhaḥ | viśvavāro draviṇodā iva tmanpūṣeva dhījavano'si soma ||

translations.english: You, Soma, who like Vāyu with his Niyut steeds go where you list, who like the Nāsatyās on hearing the invocation do grant abundant felicity, you are of yourself desired by all like the giver of wealth, you are like Pūṣan, swift as thought.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रो न यो महा कर्माणि चक्रिर्हन्ता वृत्राणामसि सोम पूर्भित् । पैद्वो न हि त्वमहिनाम्नां हन्ता विश्वस्यासि सोम दस्योः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indro na yo mahā karmāṇi cakrirhantā vṛtrāṇāmasi soma pūrbhit | paidvo na hi tvamahināmnāṃ hantā viśvasyāsi soma dasyoḥ ||

translations.english: You, Soma, who like Indra perform mighty acts, are the slayer of the Vṛtras, the destroyer of those who are called serpents; you are the slayer of every Dasyu.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निर्न यो वन आ सृज्यमानो वृथा पाजांसि कृणुते नदीषु । जनो न युध्वा महत उपब्दिरियर्ति सोमः पवमान ऊर्मिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirna yo vana ā sṛjyamāno vṛthā pājāṃsi kṛṇute nadīṣu | jano na yudhvā mahata upabdiriyarti somaḥ pavamāna ūrmim ||

translations.english: Soma who, like Agni let loose in a forest, easily manifests his might in the waters like a man who fights shouting against his mighty (foe)-- so Soma when purified urges on his wave.

mantras.sanskrit: एते सोमा अति वाराण्यव्या दिव्या न कोशासो अभ्रवर्षाः । वृथा समुद्रं सिन्धवो न नीचीः सुतासो अभि कलशाँ असृग्रन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ete somā ati vārāṇyavyā divyā na kośāso abhravarṣāḥ | vṛthā samudraṃ sindhavo na nīcīḥ sutāso abhi kalaśā~ asṛgran ||

translations.english: These Soma-juices pass through the woollen fleece, like the rains of heaven showered by the clouds; the effused juices flow promptly to the pitchers as rivers running downwards (flow) into the ocean.

mantras.sanskrit: शुष्मी शर्धो न मारुतं पवस्वानभिशस्ता दिव्या यथा विट् । आपो न मक्षू सुमतिर्भवा नः सहस्राप्साः पृतनाषाण्न यज्ञः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śuṣmī śardho na mārutaṃ pavasvānabhiśastā divyā yathā viṭ | āpo na makṣū sumatirbhavā naḥ sahasrāpsāḥ pṛtanāṣāṇna yajñaḥ ||

translations.english: Flow strong as the army of the Maruts, like the divine blameless folk; like waters become quickly favourable to us; (you are) of a thousand shapes, adorable like (Indra) the victor in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: राज्ञो नु ते वरुणस्य व्रतानि बृहद्गभीरं तव सोम धाम । शुचिष्ट्वमसि प्रियो न मित्रो दक्षाय्यो अर्यमेवासि सोम ॥
mantras.transliteration: rājño nu te varuṇasya vratāni bṛhadgabhīraṃ tava soma dhāma | śuciṣṭvamasi priyo na mitro dakṣāyyo aryamevāsi soma ||

translations.english: Your acts are (like) those of the royal Varuṇa, vast and profound, Soma, is your abode; you are pure as the beloved Mitra, munificent are you, Soma, as Aryaman.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रो स्य वह्निः पथ्याभिरस्यान्दिवो न वृष्टिः पवमानो अक्षाः । सहस्रधारो असदन्न्यस्मे मातुरुपस्थे वन आ च सोमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pro sya vahniḥ pathyābhirasyāndivo na vṛṣṭiḥ pavamāno akṣāḥ | sahasradhāro asadannyasme māturupasthe vana ā ca somaḥ ||

translations.english: This horse of burden moves forth by the (sacrificial) paths; when purified you flow like the rain from heaven; the thousand-streamed Soma sits down among us on his mother's lap in the water.

mantras.sanskrit: राजा सिन्धूनामवसिष्ट वास ऋतस्य नावमारुहद्रजिष्ठाम् । अप्सु द्रप्सो वावृधे श्येनजूतो दुह ईं पिता दुह ईं पितुर्जाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: rājā sindhūnāmavasiṣṭa vāsa ṛtasya nāvamāruhadrajiṣṭhām | apsu drapso vāvṛdhe śyenajūto duha īṃ pitā duha īṃ piturjām ||

translations.english: The sovereign Soma has put on the vestment of the waters, he has ascended the most straight-going ship of sacrifice; the dripping juice brought by the falcon has increased in the water; the father milks him-- milks him the son of the father.

mantras.sanskrit: सिंहं नसन्त मध्वो अयासं हरिमरुषं दिवो अस्य पतिम् । शूरो युत्सु प्रथमः पृच्छते गा अस्य चक्षसा परि पात्युक्षा ॥
mantras.transliteration: siṃhaṃ nasanta madhvo ayāsaṃ harimaruṣaṃ divo asya patim | śūro yutsu prathamaḥ pṛcchate gā asya cakṣasā pari pātyukṣā ||

translations.english: (The worshippers) reach the lion-like (Soma) the dispenser of water, green-tinted, red, the protector of this heaven; a hero in battles, first (among the gods) he seeks the (stolen) cows; by his might the sprinkler (Indra) protects (the universe).

mantras.sanskrit: मधुपृष्ठं घोरमयासमश्वं रथे युञ्जन्त्युरुचक्र ऋष्वम् । स्वसार ईं जामयो मर्जयन्ति सनाभयो वाजिनमूर्जयन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: madhupṛṣṭhaṃ ghoramayāsamaśvaṃ rathe yuñjantyurucakra ṛṣvam | svasāra īṃ jāmayo marjayanti sanābhayo vājinamūrjayanti ||

translations.english: (The priests) attach to the broad-wheeled car the glossy-backed terrible active graceful horse; the sister fingers cleanse him; the kinsfolk invigorate the mighty (Soma).

mantras.sanskrit: चतस्र ईं घृतदुहः सचन्ते समाने अन्तर्धरुणे निषत्ताः । ता ईमर्षन्ति नमसा पुनानास्ता ईं विश्वतः परि षन्ति पूर्वीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: catasra īṃ ghṛtaduhaḥ sacante samāne antardharuṇe niṣattāḥ | tā īmarṣanti namasā punānāstā īṃ viśvataḥ pari ṣanti pūrvīḥ ||

translations.english: The four yielders of butter wait upon him, stationed in a common asylum; being purified they approach him with food, they surround him in numbers on every side.

mantras.sanskrit: विष्टम्भो दिवो धरुणः पृथिव्या विश्वा उत क्षितयो हस्ते अस्य । असत्त उत्सो गृणते नियुत्वान्मध्वो अंशुः पवत इन्द्रियाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: viṣṭambho divo dharuṇaḥ pṛthivyā viśvā uta kṣitayo haste asya | asatta utso gṛṇate niyutvānmadhvo aṃśuḥ pavata indriyāya ||

translations.english: The prop of heaven, the support of earth-- all beings (are) in his hands; may (Soma) the fountain (of desires) be possessed of horses for you (his) adorer; the filament of the sweet-flavoured (Soma) is purified for (the sake of winning) strength.

mantras.sanskrit: वन्वन्नवातो अभि देववीतिमिन्द्राय सोम वृत्रहा पवस्व । शग्धि महः पुरुश्चन्द्रस्य रायः सुवीर्यस्य पतयः स्याम ॥
mantras.transliteration: vanvannavāto abhi devavītimindrāya soma vṛtrahā pavasva | śagdhi mahaḥ puruścandrasya rāyaḥ suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma ||

translations.english: Conquering (and) unconquered approach the banquet of the gods; Soma, who are the slayer of Vṛtra, flow for Indra; grant us abundant and splendid riches, may we be masters of excellent male offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र हिन्वानो जनिता रोदस्यो रथो न वाजं सनिष्यन्नयासीत् । इन्द्रं गच्छन्नायुधा संशिशानो विश्वा वसु हस्तयोरादधानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra hinvāno janitā rodasyo ratho na vājaṃ saniṣyannayāsīt | indraṃ gacchannāyudhā saṃśiśāno viśvā vasu hastayorādadhānaḥ ||

translations.english: Urged (by the priests) the genitive rator of heaven and earth advances like a chariot, wishing to distribute food; going to Indra, sharpening his weapons, holding all treasures in his hands.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि त्रिपृष्ठं वृषणं वयोधामाङ्गूषाणामवावशन्त वाणीः । वना वसानो वरुणो न सिन्धून्वि रत्नधा दयते वार्याणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi tripṛṣṭhaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vayodhāmāṅgūṣāṇāmavāvaśanta vāṇīḥ | vanā vasāno varuṇo na sindhūnvi ratnadhā dayate vāryāṇi ||

translations.english: The voices of the worshippers resound about him the triple-backed, the showerer (of benefits), the giver of food; arrayed in water as Varuṇa (is arrayed) in the rivers, the giver of precious wealth he bestows desirable riches.

mantras.sanskrit: शूरग्रामः सर्ववीरः सहावाञ्जेता पवस्व सनिता धनानि । तिग्मायुधः क्षिप्रधन्वा समत्स्वषाळ्हः साह्वान्पृतनासु शत्रून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śūragrāmaḥ sarvavīraḥ sahāvāñjetā pavasva sanitā dhanāni | tigmāyudhaḥ kṣipradhanvā samatsvaṣāḷhaḥ sāhvānpṛtanāsu śatrūn ||

translations.english: Flow you who have a host of warriors, who have all the heroes, full of strength, victorious, the giver of riches, sharp-weaponed, rapid bowman, irresistible in battle, overthrowing the enemy (arrayed) in (hostile) armies.

mantras.sanskrit: उरुगव्यूतिरभयानि कृण्वन्त्समीचीने आ पवस्वा पुरंधी । अपः सिषासन्नुषसः स्वर्गाः सं चिक्रदो महो अस्मभ्यं वाजान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: urugavyūtirabhayāni kṛṇvantsamīcīne ā pavasvā puraṃdhī | apaḥ siṣāsannuṣasaḥ svargāḥ saṃ cikrado maho asmabhyaṃ vājān ||

translations.english: Flow you whose paths are broad, giving security (to the worshipper), uniting heaven and earth, wishing to enjoy the waters of dawn, the sun and (his) rays you cry aloud, ( to bestow upon) us ample food.

mantras.sanskrit: मत्सि सोम वरुणं मत्सि मित्रं मत्सीन्द्रमिन्दो पवमान विष्णुम् । मत्सि शर्धो मारुतं मत्सि देवान्मत्सि महामिन्द्रमिन्दो मदाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: matsi soma varuṇaṃ matsi mitraṃ matsīndramindo pavamāna viṣṇum | matsi śardho mārutaṃ matsi devānmatsi mahāmindramindo madāya ||

translations.english: Soma, exhilarate Varuṇa, exhilarate Mitra; O Soma Pavamāna, exhilarate Indra and Viṣṇu, exhilarate the company of the Maruts, exhilarate the gods, exhilarate the mighty Indra, O Indu, for his exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा राजेव क्रतुमाँ अमेन विश्वा घनिघ्नद्दुरिता पवस्व । इन्दो सूक्ताय वचसे वयो धा यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā rājeva kratumā~ amena viśvā ghanighnadduritā pavasva | indo sūktāya vacase vayo dhā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: Thus (glorified), to you (Soma) like a king, performing your functions, flow on destroying all evils by your might; Indu, give food (in answer) to (our) well-recited praise; do you (O gods) cherish us ever with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: असर्जि वक्वा रथ्ये यथाजौ धिया मनोता प्रथमो मनीषी । दश स्वसारो अधि सानो अव्येऽजन्ति वह्निं सदनान्यच्छ ॥
mantras.transliteration: asarji vakvā rathye yathājau dhiyā manotā prathamo manīṣī | daśa svasāro adhi sāno avye'janti vahniṃ sadanānyaccha ||

translations.english: (Soma) on whom the minds of the gods are fixed, chief (of the gods), recipient of praise, is let loose with a shout by ceremony as (a horse is let loose by the finger) in a battle of chariots; the ten sister (fingers) drive the bearer (of the oblation) on the elevated plural ce to the halls (of sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: वीती जनस्य दिव्यस्य कव्यैरधि सुवानो नहुष्येभिरिन्दुः । प्र यो नृभिरमृतो मर्त्येभिर्मर्मृजानोऽविभिर्गोभिरद्भिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vītī janasya divyasya kavyairadhi suvāno nahuṣyebhirinduḥ | pra yo nṛbhiramṛto martyebhirmarmṛjāno'vibhirgobhiradbhiḥ ||

translations.english: The Soma juice effused by pious mortals (comes) down (to the sacrifice) for the food of the celestial people; which immortal (beverage) is purified by mortal (priests) with the filter, the curds and milk and the waters.

mantras.sanskrit: वृषा वृष्णे रोरुवदंशुरस्मै पवमानो रुशदीर्ते पयो गोः । सहस्रमृक्वा पथिभिर्वचोविदध्वस्मभिः सूरो अण्वं वि याति ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣā vṛṣṇe roruvadaṃśurasmai pavamāno ruśadīrte payo goḥ | sahasramṛkvā pathibhirvacovidadhvasmabhiḥ sūro aṇvaṃ vi yāti ||

translations.english: The Soma juice the showerer (of benefits) roaring to the showerer (Indra) goes when being purified to (mix with) the glistening milk of the cow; greeted with laudation, cognizant of sacred praise, the hero passes through the filter by a thousand imperishable paths.

mantras.sanskrit: रुजा दृळ्हा चिद्रक्षसः सदांसि पुनान इन्द ऊर्णुहि वि वाजान् । वृश्चोपरिष्टात्तुजता वधेन ये अन्ति दूरादुपनायमेषाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: rujā dṛḷhā cidrakṣasaḥ sadāṃsi punāna inda ūrṇuhi vi vājān | vṛścopariṣṭāttujatā vadhena ye anti dūrādupanāyameṣām ||

translations.english: Demolish the strong dwellings of the rākṣasa; Indu, when purified put on his strength; cut to pieces with your destructive weapon (the rākṣasas) who come from above, from nigh, or from afar and their leader.

mantras.sanskrit: स प्रत्नवन्नव्यसे विश्ववार सूक्ताय पथः कृणुहि प्राचः । ये दुःषहासो वनुषा बृहन्तस्ताँस्ते अश्याम पुरुकृत्पुरुक्षो ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa pratnavannavyase viśvavāra sūktāya pathaḥ kṛṇuhi prācaḥ | ye duḥṣahāso vanuṣā bṛhantastā~ste aśyāma purukṛtpurukṣo ||

translations.english: Adorable (Soma), do you as of old grant the ancient paths to your new worshipper; doer of many acts, utterer of many sounds, may we obtain those (portions) of you which are difficult to defeat, inflicting injury (on foes) and mighty.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा पुनानो अपः स्वर्गा अस्मभ्यं तोका तनयानि भूरि । शं नः क्षेत्रमुरु ज्योतींषि सोम ज्योङ्नः सूर्यं दृशये रिरीहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā punāno apaḥ svargā asmabhyaṃ tokā tanayāni bhūri | śaṃ naḥ kṣetramuru jyotīṃṣi soma jyoṅnaḥ sūryaṃ dṛśaye rirīhi ||

translations.english: Thus, being purified, bestow upon us the firmament and heaven and earth and many sons and grandsons;make our land prosper, diffuse the luminaries widely (in the firmament) and grant us long life to see the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: परि सुवानो हरिरंशुः पवित्रे रथो न सर्जि सनये हियानः । आपच्छ्लोकमिन्द्रियं पूयमानः प्रति देवाँ अजुषत प्रयोभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari suvāno hariraṃśuḥ pavitre ratho na sarji sanaye hiyānaḥ | āpacchlokamindriyaṃ pūyamānaḥ prati devā~ ajuṣata prayobhiḥ ||

translations.english: The green-tinted Soma effused and sent forth (by the priests) is let loose, like a chariot upon the filter, for the acquisition (of riches); being filtered he acquires (Indra's) praise, he gratifies the gods with conciliatory (oblations).

mantras.sanskrit: अच्छा नृचक्षा असरत्पवित्रे नाम दधानः कविरस्य योनौ । सीदन्होतेव सदने चमूषूपेमग्मन्नृषयः सप्त विप्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: acchā nṛcakṣā asaratpavitre nāma dadhānaḥ kavirasya yonau | sīdanhoteva sadane camūṣūpemagmannṛṣayaḥ sapta viprāḥ ||

translations.english: The sage, the observer of men, retaining the water proceeds to his plural ce on the filter; like a ministrant priest sitting at the sacrifice (the Soma flows) into the cups; the seven wise ṛṣis approach him with praise.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सुमेधा गातुविद्विश्वदेवः सोमः पुनानः सद एति नित्यम् । भुवद्विश्वेषु काव्येषु रन्तानु जनान्यतते पञ्च धीरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra sumedhā gātuvidviśvadevaḥ somaḥ punānaḥ sada eti nityam | bhuvadviśveṣu kāvyeṣu rantānu janānyatate pañca dhīraḥ ||

translations.english: Soma, the intelligent, the knower of the right path, accompanied by all the gods, undergoing purification goes to his constant abode; he is one who delights in all sacred praises; the sage endeavours to approach the five classes of beings.

mantras.sanskrit: तव त्ये सोम पवमान निण्ये विश्वे देवास्त्रय एकादशासः । दश स्वधाभिरधि सानो अव्ये मृजन्ति त्वा नद्यः सप्त यह्वीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava tye soma pavamāna niṇye viśve devāstraya ekādaśāsaḥ | daśa svadhābhiradhi sāno avye mṛjanti tvā nadyaḥ sapta yahvīḥ ||

translations.english: O Soma Pavamāna, you are the thrice eleven universal gods abiding in the secret (heaven); the ten (fingers) cleanse you with the waters upon the elevated fleece, the seven great rivers (cleanse you).

mantras.sanskrit: तन्नु सत्यं पवमानस्यास्तु यत्र विश्वे कारवः संनसन्त । ज्योतिर्यदह्ने अकृणोदु लोकं प्रावन्मनुं दस्यवे करभीकम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tannu satyaṃ pavamānasyāstu yatra viśve kāravaḥ saṃnasanta | jyotiryadahne akṛṇodu lokaṃ prāvanmanuṃ dasyave karabhīkam ||

translations.english: May thatplace of the truthful Pavamāna be quickly ours, when all the worshippers assemble (to praise him) the light (of the Soma) which gave manifestation to the day protected Manu-- Soma made it triumphant over the Dasyu.

mantras.sanskrit: परि सद्मेव पशुमान्ति होता राजा न सत्यः समितीरियानः । सोमः पुनानः कलशाँ अयासीत्सीदन्मृगो न महिषो वनेषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari sadmeva paśumānti hotā rājā na satyaḥ samitīriyānaḥ | somaḥ punānaḥ kalaśā~ ayāsītsīdanmṛgo na mahiṣo vaneṣu ||

translations.english: As theministrant priest proceeds to the hall where the victim is stationed, as a just king marches to battle, the Soma undergoing purification enters the pitcheers like the wild buffalo in the waters.

mantras.sanskrit: साकमुक्षो मर्जयन्त स्वसारो दश धीरस्य धीतयो धनुत्रीः । हरिः पर्यद्रवज्जाः सूर्यस्य द्रोणं ननक्षे अत्यो न वाजी ॥
mantras.transliteration: sākamukṣo marjayanta svasāro daśa dhīrasya dhītayo dhanutrīḥ | hariḥ paryadravajjāḥ sūryasya droṇaṃ nanakṣe atyo na vājī ||

translations.english: The sister (fingers) sprinkling together cleanse (the Soma), the ten fingers (are) the efffuse of the sagacious (Soma); the green-tinted one flows round the wives of the sun, he hastens like a swift horse to the pitcher.

mantras.sanskrit: सं मातृभिर्न शिशुर्वावशानो वृषा दधन्वे पुरुवारो अद्भिः । मर्यो न योषामभि निष्कृतं यन्त्सं गच्छते कलश उस्रियाभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ mātṛbhirna śiśurvāvaśāno vṛṣā dadhanve puruvāro adbhiḥ | maryo na yoṣāmabhi niṣkṛtaṃ yantsaṃ gacchate kalaśa usriyābhiḥ ||

translations.english: Longing (for the deities) the showerer (of benefits) the desired of many (the Soma) is sustained by the (consecrated) waters as the infant by its mother; going to his station like a bridegroom to his bride, hecombines in the pitcher with the curds and milk.

mantras.sanskrit: उत प्र पिप्य ऊधरघ्न्याया इन्दुर्धाराभिः सचते सुमेधाः । मूर्धानं गावः पयसा चमूष्वभि श्रीणन्ति वसुभिर्न निक्तैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta pra pipya ūdharaghnyāyā indurdhārābhiḥ sacate sumedhāḥ | mūrdhānaṃ gāvaḥ payasā camūṣvabhi śrīṇanti vasubhirna niktaiḥ ||

translations.english: And he nourishes the cow's udder; the intelligent Indu is associated with his stream; the cows clothe the elevated Soma in the ladles with their milk as with newly washed robes.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो देवेभिः पवमान रदेन्दो रयिमश्विनं वावशानः । रथिरायतामुशती पुरंधिरस्मद्र्यगा दावने वसूनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no devebhiḥ pavamāna radendo rayimaśvinaṃ vāvaśānaḥ | rathirāyatāmuśatī puraṃdhirasmadryagā dāvane vasūnām ||

translations.english: Indu Pavamāna, do you with the gods, who do long for (our good) bestow upon us riches comprising horses; may your capacious mind longing for those who possess chariots (come) towards us to bestow treasures (upon us).

mantras.sanskrit: नू नो रयिमुप मास्व नृवन्तं पुनानो वाताप्यं विश्वश्चन्द्रम् । प्र वन्दितुरिन्दो तार्यायुः प्रातर्मक्षू धियावसुर्जगम्यात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū no rayimupa māsva nṛvantaṃ punāno vātāpyaṃ viśvaścandram | pra vanditurindo tāryāyuḥ prātarmakṣū dhiyāvasurjagamyāt ||

translations.english: Soma, when you are purified, measure out to us riches and dependents and all-gratifying water. Indu, may the life of your praiser be prolonged; may (Soma) who acquires wealth by his intelligence come quickly at dawn.

mantras.sanskrit: अधि यदस्मिन्वाजिनीव शुभः स्पर्धन्ते धियः सूर्ये न विशः । अपो वृणानः पवते कवीयन्व्रजं न पशुवर्धनाय मन्म ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhi yadasminvājinīva śubhaḥ spardhante dhiyaḥ sūrye na viśaḥ | apo vṛṇānaḥ pavate kavīyanvrajaṃ na paśuvardhanāya manma ||

translations.english: When the fingers vie with each other in this (Soma), as the trappings on a horse or the rays in the sun, clothed in the waters he flows desiring his worshippers like (a cowherd going to) a plural asant cow-stall for the nourishment of his cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: द्विता व्यूर्ण्वन्नमृतस्य धाम स्वर्विदे भुवनानि प्रथन्त । धियः पिन्वानाः स्वसरे न गाव ऋतायन्तीरभि वावश्र इन्दुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dvitā vyūrṇvannamṛtasya dhāma svarvide bhuvanāni prathanta | dhiyaḥ pinvānāḥ svasare na gāva ṛtāyantīrabhi vāvaśra indum ||

translations.english: Openingout the abode of the ambrosia on both sides (he passes between); for him, the omniscient, the worlds expand. Gratifying laudations eager for the sacrifice, call upon Indu, like kine (lowing) towards their stall.

mantras.sanskrit: परि यत्कविः काव्या भरते शूरो न रथो भुवनानि विश्वा । देवेषु यशो मर्ताय भूषन्दक्षाय रायः पुरुभूषु नव्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari yatkaviḥ kāvyā bharate śūro na ratho bhuvanāni viśvā | deveṣu yaśo martāya bhūṣandakṣāya rāyaḥ purubhūṣu navyaḥ ||

translations.english: When the sage Soma goes round the praises (of the wise) like a hostile chariot (going round) all the regions (of the battle-field), then desirous of bestowing upon mortals the wealth that abides with the gods, he (is) tobe glorified in the many plural ces of sacrifice for the preservation of the riches he has given.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रिये जातः श्रिय आ निरियाय श्रियं वयो जरितृभ्यो दधाति । श्रियं वसाना अमृतत्वमायन्भवन्ति सत्या समिथा मितद्रौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: śriye jātaḥ śriya ā niriyāya śriyaṃ vayo jaritṛbhyo dadhāti | śriyaṃ vasānā amṛtatvamāyanbhavanti satyā samithā mitadrau ||

translations.english: He (is) genitive rated for prosperity, for prosperity he issues forth, he gives prosperity (and) sustenance to those who praise him; clothing themselves in (his) prosperity, they obtain immortality; their conflicts are successful through the aid of (the Soma) who moves with measured tread.

mantras.sanskrit: इषमूर्जमभ्यर्षाश्वं गामुरु ज्योतिः कृणुहि मत्सि देवान् । विश्वानि हि सुषहा तानि तुभ्यं पवमान बाधसे सोम शत्रून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: iṣamūrjamabhyarṣāśvaṃ gāmuru jyotiḥ kṛṇuhi matsi devān | viśvāni hi suṣahā tāni tubhyaṃ pavamāna bādhase soma śatrūn ||

translations.english: Bring us food and drink, horses, cattle and ample light, exhilarate the gods; for all (the rākṣasas) are easily subdued by you; Soma Pavamāna, destroy (all) foes.

mantras.sanskrit: कनिक्रन्ति हरिरा सृज्यमानः सीदन्वनस्य जठरे पुनानः । नृभिर्यतः कृणुते निर्णिजं गा अतो मतीर्जनयत स्वधाभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kanikranti harirā sṛjyamānaḥ sīdanvanasya jaṭhare punānaḥ | nṛbhiryataḥ kṛṇute nirṇijaṃ gā ato matīrjanayata svadhābhiḥ ||

translations.english: The green-tinted Soma cries aloud when let loose, sitting when filtered in the belly of the pitcher; collected by the priests, he assumes his shape, (putting on) the products of the kine, therefore raise praises (to him) with oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: हरिः सृजानः पथ्यामृतस्येयर्ति वाचमरितेव नावम् । देवो देवानां गुह्यानि नामाविष्कृणोति बर्हिषि प्रवाचे ॥
mantras.transliteration: hariḥ sṛjānaḥ pathyāmṛtasyeyarti vācamariteva nāvam | devo devānāṃ guhyāni nāmāviṣkṛṇoti barhiṣi pravāce ||

translations.english: The green-tinted Soma being let loose propels the voice that indicates the path of truth as the boatman (propels his) boat; the bright Soma reveals to his worshipper on the sacred grass the secret names of the god. [

mantras.sanskrit: अपामिवेदूर्मयस्तर्तुराणाः प्र मनीषा ईरते सोममच्छ । नमस्यन्तीरुप च यन्ति सं चा च विशन्त्युशतीरुशन्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: apāmivedūrmayastarturāṇāḥ pra manīṣā īrate somamaccha | namasyantīrupa ca yanti saṃ cā ca viśantyuśatīruśantam ||

translations.english: The priests hurrying like the waves of the waters dispatch praises towards Soma; adoring him they approach and come up together, longing for him who longs for them they enter him.

mantras.sanskrit: तं मर्मृजानं महिषं न सानावंशुं दुहन्त्युक्षणं गिरिष्ठाम् । तं वावशानं मतयः सचन्ते त्रितो बिभर्ति वरुणं समुद्रे ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ marmṛjānaṃ mahiṣaṃ na sānāvaṃśuṃ duhantyukṣaṇaṃ giriṣṭhām | taṃ vāvaśānaṃ matayaḥ sacante trito bibharti varuṇaṃ samudre ||

translations.english: (The priests) milk forth the Soma cleansed (dwelling) on a high plural ce like a buffalo, the sprinkler, plural ces between the grinding-stones; praises attend upon the longing Soma; (Indra) who dwells in three abodes supports him, the defeater of enemies, in the firmament.

mantras.sanskrit: इष्यन्वाचमुपवक्तेव होतुः पुनान इन्दो वि ष्या मनीषाम् । इन्द्रश्च यत्क्षयथः सौभगाय सुवीर्यस्य पतयः स्याम ॥
mantras.transliteration: iṣyanvācamupavakteva hotuḥ punāna indo vi ṣyā manīṣām | indraśca yatkṣayathaḥ saubhagāya suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma ||

translations.english: Indu, being purified, stimulating the praise (of the worshippers) like the answer of the hotā set free the understanding; when (you) and Indra are present together (at the sacrifice) may we be prosperous, may we become the possessors of excellent male progeny.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सेनानीः शूरो अग्रे रथानां गव्यन्नेति हर्षते अस्य सेना । भद्रान्कृण्वन्निन्द्रहवान्त्सखिभ्य आ सोमो वस्त्रा रभसानि दत्ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra senānīḥ śūro agre rathānāṃ gavyanneti harṣate asya senā | bhadrānkṛṇvannindrahavāntsakhibhya ā somo vastrā rabhasāni datte ||

translations.english: The leader of the host, a hero, advances in front of the chariots intent on seizing the cattle (of the enemy); his army exults; making their oblations to Indra prosperous for the friendly (worshippers), Soma assumes the hastily made robes (of curds and milk).

mantras.sanskrit: समस्य हरिं हरयो मृजन्त्यश्वहयैरनिशितं नमोभिः । आ तिष्ठति रथमिन्द्रस्य सखा विद्वाँ एना सुमतिं यात्यच्छ ॥
mantras.transliteration: samasya hariṃ harayo mṛjantyaśvahayairaniśitaṃ namobhiḥ | ā tiṣṭhati rathamindrasya sakhā vidvā~ enā sumatiṃ yātyaccha ||

translations.english: The priests express his green-tinted (juice); he mounts the chariot unyoked by the horse-driving salutations; the wise Soma the friend of Indra goes to meet the worshipper.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो देव देवताते पवस्व महे सोम प्सरस इन्द्रपानः । कृण्वन्नपो वर्षयन्द्यामुतेमामुरोरा नो वरिवस्या पुनानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no deva devatāte pavasva mahe soma psarasa indrapānaḥ | kṛṇvannapo varṣayandyāmutemāmurorā no varivasyā punānaḥ ||

translations.english: Divine Soma, who are the beverage of Indra, flow at our sacrifice for (his) abundant food; sending water, causing rain to fall upon heaven and upon this earth, (come) from the wide (firmament, and) being purified bestow upon us wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: अजीतयेऽहतये पवस्व स्वस्तये सर्वतातये बृहते । तदुशन्ति विश्व इमे सखायस्तदहं वश्मि पवमान सोम ॥
mantras.transliteration: ajītaye'hataye pavasva svastaye sarvatātaye bṛhate | taduśanti viśva ime sakhāyastadahaṃ vaśmi pavamāna soma ||

translations.english: Flow for our immunity from defeat and slaughter, flow for our welfare, for the great sacrifice for all the gods; all these my friends desire this; this I desire, O Soma Pavamāna.

mantras.sanskrit: सोमः पवते जनिता मतीनां जनिता दिवो जनिता पृथिव्याः । जनिताग्नेर्जनिता सूर्यस्य जनितेन्द्रस्य जनितोत विष्णोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: somaḥ pavate janitā matīnāṃ janitā divo janitā pṛthivyāḥ | janitāgnerjanitā sūryasya janitendrasya janitota viṣṇoḥ ||

translations.english: The Soma flows, the genitive rator of praises, the genitive rator of heaven, the genitive rator of the earth, the genitive rator of Agni, the genitive rator of the sun, the genitive rator of Indra, and the genitive rator of Viṣṇu.

mantras.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा देवानां पदवीः कवीनामृषिर्विप्राणां महिषो मृगाणाम् । श्येनो गृध्राणां स्वधितिर्वनानां सोमः पवित्रमत्येति रेभन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: brahmā devānāṃ padavīḥ kavīnāmṛṣirviprāṇāṃ mahiṣo mṛgāṇām | śyeno gṛdhrāṇāṃ svadhitirvanānāṃ somaḥ pavitramatyeti rebhan ||

translations.english: The Brahmā of the gods, the guide of the sages, the ṛṣi of the pious, the buffalo of wild animals, the falcon of the vultures, the hatchet of deadly weapons, the Soma passes through the filter with a roar.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रावीविपद्वाच ऊर्मिं न सिन्धुर्गिरः सोमः पवमानो मनीषाः । अन्तः पश्यन्वृजनेमावराण्या तिष्ठति वृषभो गोषु जानन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: prāvīvipadvāca ūrmiṃ na sindhurgiraḥ somaḥ pavamāno manīṣāḥ | antaḥ paśyanvṛjanemāvarāṇyā tiṣṭhati vṛṣabho goṣu jānan ||

translations.english: The purified Soma excites gratifying praises as a river (excites) the wave of sound; the showerer (of benefits) beholding the hidden (treasure) presides over these irresistible powers, knowing about the cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: स मत्सरः पृत्सु वन्वन्नवातः सहस्ररेता अभि वाजमर्ष । इन्द्रायेन्दो पवमानो मनीष्यंशोरूर्मिमीरय गा इषण्यन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa matsaraḥ pṛtsu vanvannavātaḥ sahasraretā abhi vājamarṣa | indrāyendo pavamāno manīṣyaṃśorūrmimīraya gā iṣaṇyan ||

translations.english: (Soma) who are the exhilarator, harming (the foe) in battles, (yourself) unharmed, who have a thousand streams, rush against the strength (of the enemy), Indu, who are being purified, the sage, uttering cries, urge on for Indra the wave of juice.

mantras.sanskrit: परि प्रियः कलशे देववात इन्द्राय सोमो रण्यो मदाय । सहस्रधारः शतवाज इन्दुर्वाजी न सप्तिः समना जिगाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari priyaḥ kalaśe devavāta indrāya somo raṇyo madāya | sahasradhāraḥ śatavāja indurvājī na saptiḥ samanā jigāti ||

translations.english: The plural asing delightful Soma approached by gods (proceeds) to the pitcher to exhilarate Indra; Indu the thousand-streamed and vigorous proceeds like a strong horse to battle.

mantras.sanskrit: स पूर्व्यो वसुविज्जायमानो मृजानो अप्सु दुदुहानो अद्रौ । अभिशस्तिपा भुवनस्य राजा विदद्गातुं ब्रह्मणे पूयमानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa pūrvyo vasuvijjāyamāno mṛjāno apsu duduhāno adrau | abhiśastipā bhuvanasya rājā vidadgātuṃ brahmaṇe pūyamānaḥ ||

translations.english: The ancient (Soma) the finder of treasure as soon as genitive rated, cleansed in the waters milked on the stone, the defender against enemies, the sovereign of the world, purified for the sacrifice, shows (the worshipper) the right way.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वया हि नः पितरः सोम पूर्वे कर्माणि चक्रुः पवमान धीराः । वन्वन्नवातः परिधीँरपोर्णु वीरेभिरश्वैर्मघवा भवा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvayā hi naḥ pitaraḥ soma pūrve karmāṇi cakruḥ pavamāna dhīrāḥ | vanvannavātaḥ paridhī~raporṇu vīrebhiraśvairmaghavā bhavā naḥ ||

translations.english: Soma Pavamāna, by you our ancient and wise progenitors performed their religious rites; harming the foes (yourself) unharmed slay the rākṣasas and be liberal in enriching us with male offspring and horses.

mantras.sanskrit: यथापवथा मनवे वयोधा अमित्रहा वरिवोविद्धविष्मान् । एवा पवस्व द्रविणं दधान इन्द्रे सं तिष्ठ जनयायुधानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathāpavathā manave vayodhā amitrahā varivoviddhaviṣmān | evā pavasva draviṇaṃ dadhāna indre saṃ tiṣṭha janayāyudhāni ||

translations.english: As you did flow to Manu possessing food, slaying enemies, acquiring wealth, having oblations, so now flow bringing us riches; abide you in Indra; make manifest (your) weapons.

mantras.sanskrit: पवस्व सोम मधुमाँ ऋतावापो वसानो अधि सानो अव्ये । अव द्रोणानि घृतवान्ति सीद मदिन्तमो मत्सर इन्द्रपानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavasva soma madhumā~ ṛtāvāpo vasāno adhi sāno avye | ava droṇāni ghṛtavānti sīda madintamo matsara indrapānaḥ ||

translations.english: Soma who have exhilarating juice, who are connected with the sacrifice, clothed with water flow upon the elevated fleece; alight upon the water-holding pitchers, you who are most exhilarating, intoxicating, the especial beverage of Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: वृष्टिं दिवः शतधारः पवस्व सहस्रसा वाजयुर्देववीतौ । सं सिन्धुभिः कलशे वावशानः समुस्रियाभिः प्रतिरन्न आयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣṭiṃ divaḥ śatadhāraḥ pavasva sahasrasā vājayurdevavītau | saṃ sindhubhiḥ kalaśe vāvaśānaḥ samusriyābhiḥ pratiranna āyuḥ ||

translations.english: (Soma), who flows in a hundred streams, pour rain from the firmament, you who are the giver of hundredfold (wealth), the bestower of food at the banquet of the gods; desirous of (the mixture) combine with the waters in the pitchers and with the curds and milk, prolonging our life.

mantras.sanskrit: एष स्य सोमो मतिभिः पुनानोऽत्यो न वाजी तरतीदरातीः । पयो न दुग्धमदितेरिषिरमुर्विव गातुः सुयमो न वोळ्हा ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa sya somo matibhiḥ punāno'tyo na vājī taratīdarātīḥ | payo na dugdhamaditeriṣiramurviva gātuḥ suyamo na voḷhā ||

translations.english: This Soma (is) purified with praises, like a strong horse he overthrows (his) foes; (he is purified) like the strong milk milked from the cow, (flocked to by all) like a broad road, (and guided by the praisers) like a well-trained horse of burden.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वायुधः सोतृभिः पूयमानोऽभ्यर्ष गुह्यं चारु नाम । अभि वाजं सप्तिरिव श्रवस्याभि वायुमभि गा देव सोम ॥
mantras.transliteration: svāyudhaḥ sotṛbhiḥ pūyamāno'bhyarṣa guhyaṃ cāru nāma | abhi vājaṃ saptiriva śravasyābhi vāyumabhi gā deva soma ||

translations.english: Well-armed, purified by those who express you, send your concealed desirable form (into the pitchers); like a horse bring us food in our desire for food; divine Soma, bring us life, bring us cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: शिशुं जज्ञानं हर्यतं मृजन्ति शुम्भन्ति वह्निं मरुतो गणेन । कविर्गीर्भिः काव्येना कविः सन्त्सोमः पवित्रमत्येति रेभन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śiśuṃ jajñānaṃ haryataṃ mṛjanti śumbhanti vahniṃ maruto gaṇena | kavirgīrbhiḥ kāvyenā kaviḥ santsomaḥ pavitramatyeti rebhan ||

translations.english: They cleanse the charming infant (Soma) at his birth; the Maruts decorate the bearer (of boons) with their troop; bring wise with songs, wise with wisdom, Soma passes clamorous through the filter.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋषिमना य ऋषिकृत्स्वर्षाः सहस्रणीथः पदवीः कवीनाम् । तृतीयं धाम महिषः सिषासन्त्सोमो विराजमनु राजति ष्टुप् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛṣimanā ya ṛṣikṛtsvarṣāḥ sahasraṇīthaḥ padavīḥ kavīnām | tṛtīyaṃ dhāma mahiṣaḥ siṣāsantsomo virājamanu rājati ṣṭup ||

translations.english: Thinking as a ṛṣi, acting as a ṛṣi, gaining heaven, praised by thousands, the guide of the wise, the mighty Soma desiring to attain the third region (heaven), being praised adds lustre to the illustrious (Indra).

mantras.sanskrit: चमूषच्छ्येनः शकुनो विभृत्वा गोविन्दुर्द्रप्स आयुधानि बिभ्रत् । अपामूर्मिं सचमानः समुद्रं तुरीयं धाम महिषो विवक्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: camūṣacchyenaḥ śakuno vibhṛtvā govindurdrapsa āyudhāni bibhrat | apāmūrmiṃ sacamānaḥ samudraṃ turīyaṃ dhāma mahiṣo vivakti ||

translations.english: Seated on the ladles, praiseworthy, competent, supporting, acquiring cattle, flowing, bearing arms, attending upon the firmament, the sender of the waters, the mighty (Soma) attends the fourth sphere.

mantras.sanskrit: मर्यो न शुभ्रस्तन्वं मृजानोऽत्यो न सृत्वा सनये धनानाम् । वृषेव यूथा परि कोशमर्षन्कनिक्रदच्चम्वोरा विवेश ॥
mantras.transliteration: maryo na śubhrastanvaṃ mṛjāno'tyo na sṛtvā sanaye dhanānām | vṛṣeva yūthā pari kośamarṣankanikradaccamvorā viveśa ||

translations.english: Cleaning his person n like a richly-decorated man, flowing to acquire riches like a rapid (horse), rushing to the receptacle like a bull to the herd, (Soma) crying repeatedly enters the plural nks.

mantras.sanskrit: पवस्वेन्दो पवमानो महोभिः कनिक्रदत्परि वाराण्यर्ष । क्रीळञ्चम्वोरा विश पूयमान इन्द्रं ते रसो मदिरो ममत्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavasvendo pavamāno mahobhiḥ kanikradatpari vārāṇyarṣa | krīḷañcamvorā viśa pūyamāna indraṃ te raso madiro mamattu ||

translations.english: Flow, Indu, purified by the venerable (priests), rush through the filter crying repeatedly, sporting enter the plural nks purified, let your exhilarating beverage exhilarate Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रास्य धारा बृहतीरसृग्रन्नक्तो गोभिः कलशाँ आ विवेश । साम कृण्वन्त्सामन्यो विपश्चित्क्रन्दन्नेत्यभि सख्युर्न जामिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: prāsya dhārā bṛhatīrasṛgrannakto gobhiḥ kalaśā~ ā viveśa | sāma kṛṇvantsāmanyo vipaścitkrandannetyabhi sakhyurna jāmim ||

translations.english: His copious streams flow forth; blended with the milk and curds he enters the pitchers; uttering chants the skilful chanter (Soma) hasten invoking (the gods) towards (the cups) like (a libertine) to the wife of a friend.

mantras.sanskrit: अपघ्नन्नेषि पवमान शत्रून्प्रियां न जारो अभिगीत इन्दुः । सीदन्वनेषु शकुनो न पत्वा सोमः पुनानः कलशेषु सत्ता ॥
mantras.transliteration: apaghnanneṣi pavamāna śatrūnpriyāṃ na jāro abhigīta induḥ | sīdanvaneṣu śakuno na patvā somaḥ punānaḥ kalaśeṣu sattā ||

translations.english: O Pavamāna, eulogized (by the worshippers), distilling (into the receptacles), destroying the enemies, you go like a gallant to his mistress; falling like a bird alighting on the trees the Soma when purified alights upon the pitchers.

mantras.sanskrit: आ ते रुचः पवमानस्य सोम योषेव यन्ति सुदुघाः सुधाराः । हरिरानीतः पुरुवारो अप्स्वचिक्रदत्कलशे देवयूनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā te rucaḥ pavamānasya soma yoṣeva yanti sudughāḥ sudhārāḥ | harirānītaḥ puruvāro apsvacikradatkalaśe devayūnām ||

translations.english: The lustres, Soma, of you when being purified, approach with abundant milk with copious streams like a woman (giving milk to her child); the green-tinted Soma, the desired of many, has been brought to the waters and cries repeatedly in the pitcher of the god-loving (worshippers).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य प्रेषा हेमना पूयमानो देवो देवेभिः समपृक्त रसम् । सुतः पवित्रं पर्येति रेभन्मितेव सद्म पशुमान्ति होता ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya preṣā hemanā pūyamāno devo devebhiḥ samapṛkta rasam | sutaḥ pavitraṃ paryeti rebhanmiteva sadma paśumānti hotā ||

translations.english: The shining Somabeing purified by the golden hand that urges it forth, brings its juice into contact with the gods; when effused it proceeds with a roar to the filter like the ministrant priest to the halls prepared (for sacrifice) containing victims.

mantras.sanskrit: भद्रा वस्त्रा समन्या वसानो महान्कविर्निवचनानि शंसन् । आ वच्यस्व चम्वोः पूयमानो विचक्षणो जागृविर्देववीतौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhadrā vastrā samanyā vasāno mahānkavirnivacanāni śaṃsan | ā vacyasva camvoḥ pūyamāno vicakṣaṇo jāgṛvirdevavītau ||

translations.english: The great wise Soma, clothed in his auspicious war-vestments, the inspirer of praises-- enter into the vessle when purified, you who are sagacious and vigilant at the banquet of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: समु प्रियो मृज्यते सानो अव्ये यशस्तरो यशसां क्षैतो अस्मे । अभि स्वर धन्वा पूयमानो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samu priyo mṛjyate sāno avye yaśastaro yaśasāṃ kṣaito asme | abhi svara dhanvā pūyamāno yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: (Soma), the most famous of the famous, the earht-born, the conciliator, is cleansed for us in the elevated fleece; sound aloud in the firmament when purified; do you ever protect us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र गायताभ्यर्चाम देवान्त्सोमं हिनोत महते धनाय । स्वादुः पवाते अति वारमव्यमा सीदाति कलशं देवयुर्नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra gāyatābhyarcāma devāntsomaṃ hinota mahate dhanāya | svāduḥ pavāte ati vāramavyamā sīdāti kalaśaṃ devayurnaḥ ||

translations.english: Sing (to the Soma), let us praise the gods; send forth the Soma for (the acquisition of) great wealth. He passes sweet-flavoured pure through the fleecy filter; our (Soma) devoted to the gods alights on the pitcher.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्दुर्देवानामुप सख्यमायन्त्सहस्रधारः पवते मदाय । नृभिः स्तवानो अनु धाम पूर्वमगन्निन्द्रं महते सौभगाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: indurdevānāmupa sakhyamāyantsahasradhāraḥ pavate madāya | nṛbhiḥ stavāno anu dhāma pūrvamagannindraṃ mahate saubhagāya ||

translations.english: Indu coming to obtain the friendship of the god; flows in a thousand streams for (their) exhilaration, glorified by the priests (he proceeds) to his ancient station, he proceeds to Indra for the sake of great prosperity (to the worshippers).

mantras.sanskrit: स्तोत्रे राये हरिरर्षा पुनान इन्द्रं मदो गच्छतु ते भराय । देवैर्याहि सरथं राधो अच्छा यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: stotre rāye harirarṣā punāna indraṃ mado gacchatu te bharāya | devairyāhi sarathaṃ rādho acchā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: (Soma), when our praise is offered, flow green-tinted and purified, to (bring us) riches, may your exhilarating beverage animate Indra to battle. Go in the same car with the gods to (procure us) wealth; do you ever protect us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र काव्यमुशनेव ब्रुवाणो देवो देवानां जनिमा विवक्ति । महिव्रतः शुचिबन्धुः पावकः पदा वराहो अभ्येति रेभन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra kāvyamuśaneva bruvāṇo devo devānāṃ janimā vivakti | mahivrataḥ śucibandhuḥ pāvakaḥ padā varāho abhyeti rebhan ||

translations.english: Reciting sacred praise like Uṣanas the praiser (Vṛṣagaṇa) proclaims the births of the gods; assiduous in pious observances, of brilliant radiance, purifying (from sin), he approaches the filter making a noise (as) a wild boar (makes a noise) with its foot.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र हंसासस्तृपलं मन्युमच्छामादस्तं वृषगणा अयासुः । आङ्गूष्यं पवमानं सखायो दुर्मर्षं साकं प्र वदन्ति वाणम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra haṃsāsastṛpalaṃ manyumacchāmādastaṃ vṛṣagaṇā ayāsuḥ | āṅgūṣyaṃ pavamānaṃ sakhāyo durmarṣaṃ sākaṃ pra vadanti vāṇam ||

translations.english: The Vṛṣagaṇas (walking like) swans, (alarmed) at the strength (of the foe), having repaired to the house of sacrifice, to the swift-shooting foe-despising (Soma), the friends sound the flut to the praiseworthy irresistble Pavamāna.

mantras.sanskrit: स रंहत उरुगायस्य जूतिं वृथा क्रीळन्तं मिमते न गावः । परीणसं कृणुते तिग्मशृङ्गो दिवा हरिर्ददृशे नक्तमृज्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa raṃhata urugāyasya jūtiṃ vṛthā krīḷantaṃ mimate na gāvaḥ | parīṇasaṃ kṛṇute tigmaśṛṅgo divā harirdadṛśe naktamṛjraḥ ||

translations.english: He moves rapidly (following) the path of (him) the much-praised, (other) goers cannot overtake him (though he is) moving easily; sharp-horned he displays manifold (radiance); the Soma appears green-tinted by day, and clearly visible at night.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्दुर्वाजी पवते गोन्योघा इन्द्रे सोमः सह इन्वन्मदाय । हन्ति रक्षो बाधते पर्यरातीर्वरिवः कृण्वन्वृजनस्य राजा ॥
mantras.transliteration: indurvājī pavate gonyoghā indre somaḥ saha invanmadāya | hanti rakṣo bādhate paryarātīrvarivaḥ kṛṇvanvṛjanasya rājā ||

translations.english: The powerful, flowing Soma having quantities o fjuice flowing down, streams forth infusing strength into Indra for his exhilaration; conferring wealth the king of strength slays the rākṣasas and harasses the enemy.

mantras.sanskrit: अध धारया मध्वा पृचानस्तिरो रोम पवते अद्रिदुग्धः । इन्दुरिन्द्रस्य सख्यं जुषाणो देवो देवस्य मत्सरो मदाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha dhārayā madhvā pṛcānastiro roma pavate adridugdhaḥ | indurindrasya sakhyaṃ juṣāṇo devo devasya matsaro madāya ||

translations.english: Milked forth by the stones the Soma flows through the (sheep's) hair coming into contact (with the gods) with its sweet-flavoured stream; the divine exhilarating Indu desiring the friendship of Indra flows for the exhilaration of the deity.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि प्रियाणि पवते पुनानो देवो देवान्त्स्वेन रसेन पृञ्चन् । इन्दुर्धर्माण्यृतुथा वसानो दश क्षिपो अव्यत सानो अव्ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi priyāṇi pavate punāno devo devāntsvena rasena pṛñcan | indurdharmāṇyṛtuthā vasāno daśa kṣipo avyata sāno avye ||

translations.english: Clothed in plural asant radiance suited to the season, the sportive Indu flows purified, reaching the gods with its juice; the ten fingers guide it to the elevated fleece.

mantras.sanskrit: वृषा शोणो अभिकनिक्रदद्गा नदयन्नेति पृथिवीमुत द्याम् । इन्द्रस्येव वग्नुरा शृण्व आजौ प्रचेतयन्नर्षति वाचमेमाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣā śoṇo abhikanikradadgā nadayanneti pṛthivīmuta dyām | indrasyeva vagnurā śṛṇva ājau pracetayannarṣati vācamemām ||

translations.english: (Calling out for the praises like) a red bull bellowing after the kine; the Soma goes with a roar through heaven and earth; (his voice) is heard as the voice of Indra, manifesting (himself) he raises this voice.

mantras.sanskrit: रसाय्यः पयसा पिन्वमान ईरयन्नेषि मधुमन्तमंशुम् । पवमानः संतनिमेषि कृण्वन्निन्द्राय सोम परिषिच्यमानः ॥
