mantras.transliteration: rasāyyaḥ payasā pinvamāna īrayanneṣi madhumantamaṃśum | pavamānaḥ saṃtanimeṣi kṛṇvannindrāya soma pariṣicyamānaḥ ||

translations.english: plural asant to the taste, dripping with milk, you flow pouring forth the sweet-flavoured juice. Soma, when purified and sprinkled, you flow for Indra in a continuous stream.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा पवस्व मदिरो मदायोदग्राभस्य नमयन्वधस्नैः । परि वर्णं भरमाणो रुशन्तं गव्युर्नो अर्ष परि सोम सिक्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā pavasva madiro madāyodagrābhasya namayanvadhasnaiḥ | pari varṇaṃ bharamāṇo ruśantaṃ gavyurno arṣa pari soma siktaḥ ||

translations.english: Thus flow, the exhilarator, for Indra's exhilaration bowing down the rain-holder with (your) weapons, assuming brilliant colour, desirous of our cattle, flow, Soma, sprinkled (into the filter).

mantras.sanskrit: जुष्ट्वी न इन्दो सुपथा सुगान्युरौ पवस्व वरिवांसि कृण्वन् । घनेव विष्वग्दुरितानि विघ्नन्नधि ष्णुना धन्व सानो अव्ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: juṣṭvī na indo supathā sugānyurau pavasva varivāṃsi kṛṇvan | ghaneva viṣvagduritāni vighnannadhi ṣṇunā dhanva sāno avye ||

translations.english: Gratified (with our praises), Indu, flow into the large (vessel), granting us riches coming by holy paths and easily acquired; beating down the rākṣasas on every side as with a club, flow in a stream upon the elevated fleece.

mantras.sanskrit: वृष्टिं नो अर्ष दिव्यां जिगत्नुमिळावतीं शंगयीं जीरदानुम् । स्तुकेव वीता धन्वा विचिन्वन्बन्धूँरिमाँ अवराँ इन्दो वायून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣṭiṃ no arṣa divyāṃ jigatnumiḷāvatīṃ śaṃgayīṃ jīradānum | stukeva vītā dhanvā vicinvanbandhū~rimā~ avarā~ indo vāyūn ||

translations.english: Sending us rain from heaven, quick-falling, food-giving, giving health to our home, promptly munificent; flow, Indu, seeking these lower winds your kinsmen as (one seeking his) beloved infants.

mantras.sanskrit: ग्रन्थिं न वि ष्य ग्रथितं पुनान ऋजुं च गातुं वृजिनं च सोम । अत्यो न क्रदो हरिरा सृजानो मर्यो देव धन्व पस्त्यावान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: granthiṃ na vi ṣya grathitaṃ punāna ṛjuṃ ca gātuṃ vṛjinaṃ ca soma | atyo na krado harirā sṛjāno maryo deva dhanva pastyāvān ||

translations.english: (Soma), when filtered loose (me) bound (by sin) as (one loose) a knot; (grant me) a straight path and strength. You, green-tinted, neigh like a horse (when you are) let loose; proceed divine (Soma) who are friendly to man, and have a dwelling.

mantras.sanskrit: जुष्टो मदाय देवतात इन्दो परि ष्णुना धन्व सानो अव्ये । सहस्रधारः सुरभिरदब्धः परि स्रव वाजसातौ नृषह्ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: juṣṭo madāya devatāta indo pari ṣṇunā dhanva sāno avye | sahasradhāraḥ surabhiradabdhaḥ pari srava vājasātau nṛṣahye ||

translations.english: Indu, who are adequate for exhilaration flow in a stream to the elevated fleece at the sacrifice; thousand- streaming, fragrant, irresistible, flow for the acquisition of food in the combat.

mantras.sanskrit: अरश्मानो येऽरथा अयुक्ता अत्यासो न ससृजानास आजौ । एते शुक्रासो धन्वन्ति सोमा देवासस्ताँ उप याता पिबध्यै ॥
mantras.transliteration: araśmāno ye'rathā ayuktā atyāso na sasṛjānāsa ājau | ete śukrāso dhanvanti somā devāsastā~ upa yātā pibadhyai ||

translations.english: These brilliant Soma juices flow like horses let loose inbattle without reins, without chariots, unharnessed; approach them, you gods, to drink.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा न इन्दो अभि देववीतिं परि स्रव नभो अर्णश्चमूषु । सोमो अस्मभ्यं काम्यं बृहन्तं रयिं ददातु वीरवन्तमुग्रम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā na indo abhi devavītiṃ pari srava nabho arṇaścamūṣu | somo asmabhyaṃ kāmyaṃ bṛhantaṃ rayiṃ dadātu vīravantamugram ||

translations.english: So, Indu, at our sacrifice pour the water from the firmament into the vessels; may Soma bestow upon us desirable riches in abundance with male offspring and strength.

mantras.sanskrit: तक्षद्यदी मनसो वेनतो वाग्ज्येष्ठस्य वा धर्मणि क्षोरनीके । आदीमायन्वरमा वावशाना जुष्टं पतिं कलशे गाव इन्दुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: takṣadyadī manaso venato vāgjyeṣṭhasya vā dharmaṇi kṣoranīke | ādīmāyanvaramā vāvaśānā juṣṭaṃ patiṃ kalaśe gāva indum ||

translations.english: When the praise of the zealous worshipper sanctiies him as that of a noisy (crowd) in front (praises) a distinguished (prince) for the support (he affords); then the cows come to the excellent exhilarating Indu, the lord (of all, abiding) in the pitcher, eager to gratify him (with their milk).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र दानुदो दिव्यो दानुपिन्व ऋतमृताय पवते सुमेधाः । धर्मा भुवद्वृजन्यस्य राजा प्र रश्मिभिर्दशभिर्भारि भूम ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra dānudo divyo dānupinva ṛtamṛtāya pavate sumedhāḥ | dharmā bhuvadvṛjanyasya rājā pra raśmibhirdaśabhirbhāri bhūma ||

translations.english: The divine benefactor of givers, poured (boons) on givers, the intelligent (Soma) distils his true beverage for true (Indra); the radiant (Soma) is the upholder of strength, he is entirely restrained by the ten fingers.

mantras.sanskrit: पवित्रेभिः पवमानो नृचक्षा राजा देवानामुत मर्त्यानाम् । द्विता भुवद्रयिपती रयीणामृतं भरत्सुभृतं चार्विन्दुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavitrebhiḥ pavamāno nṛcakṣā rājā devānāmuta martyānām | dvitā bhuvadrayipatī rayīṇāmṛtaṃ bharatsubhṛtaṃ cārvinduḥ ||

translations.english: Purified by the filters the observers of man, the sovereign of both gods and mortals, the lord of abundant wealth (Soma), is twofold; Indu bears the auspicious collected water.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्वाँ इव श्रवसे सातिमच्छेन्द्रस्य वायोरभि वीतिमर्ष । स नः सहस्रा बृहतीरिषो दा भवा सोम द्रविणोवित्पुनानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: arvā~ iva śravase sātimacchendrasya vāyorabhi vītimarṣa | sa naḥ sahasrā bṛhatīriṣo dā bhavā soma draviṇovitpunānaḥ ||

translations.english: Hasten (Soma) to give food to Indra and Vāyu like a horse, for (the sake of giving us) food, to acquire wealth; give us abundant thousand-fold food; Soma, when filtered become the dispenser of riches.

mantras.sanskrit: देवाव्यो नः परिषिच्यमानाः क्षयं सुवीरं धन्वन्तु सोमाः । आयज्यवः सुमतिं विश्ववारा होतारो न दिवियजो मन्द्रतमाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: devāvyo naḥ pariṣicyamānāḥ kṣayaṃ suvīraṃ dhanvantu somāḥ | āyajyavaḥ sumatiṃ viśvavārā hotāro na diviyajo mandratamāḥ ||

translations.english: May the Soma juices which are gratifying to the gods when poured around (into the vessels) bring us a dwelling and male offspring-- (the juice) endeavouring to gain the favour (of the gods), desired by all offering (to the gods) in heaven like the ministrant priests, most exhilarating.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा देव देवताते पवस्व महे सोम प्सरसे देवपानः । महश्चिद्धि ष्मसि हिताः समर्ये कृधि सुष्ठाने रोदसी पुनानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā deva devatāte pavasva mahe soma psarase devapānaḥ | mahaściddhi ṣmasi hitāḥ samarye kṛdhi suṣṭhāne rodasī punānaḥ ||

translations.english: Divine Soma, who are the beverage of the gods, flow at the sacrifice for (their) abundant food; urged on (by you) may we overcome even mighty (foes) in battle; purified do you render heaven and earth happy abodes (for us).

mantras.sanskrit: अश्वो नो क्रदो वृषभिर्युजानः सिंहो न भीमो मनसो जवीयान् । अर्वाचीनैः पथिभिर्ये रजिष्ठा आ पवस्व सौमनसं न इन्दो ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvo no krado vṛṣabhiryujānaḥ siṃho na bhīmo manaso javīyān | arvācīnaiḥ pathibhirye rajiṣṭhā ā pavasva saumanasaṃ na indo ||

translations.english: Yoked by the priests, you neigh like a horse, (you are) terrible as a lion, swifter than thought; Indu, pour happiness upon us by those which are the most direct of the paths leading hitherward.

mantras.sanskrit: शतं धारा देवजाता असृग्रन्त्सहस्रमेनाः कवयो मृजन्ति । इन्दो सनित्रं दिव आ पवस्व पुरएतासि महतो धनस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: śataṃ dhārā devajātā asṛgrantsahasramenāḥ kavayo mṛjanti | indo sanitraṃ diva ā pavasva puraetāsi mahato dhanasya ||

translations.english: Your hundred streams manifested for the gods are loose; the sages cleanse those thousand (streams); pour wealth upon us, Indu, from heaven; you are the precursor of abundant riches.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवो न सर्गा अससृग्रमह्नां राजा न मित्रं प्र मिनाति धीरः । पितुर्न पुत्रः क्रतुभिर्यतान आ पवस्व विशे अस्या अजीतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: divo na sargā asasṛgramahnāṃ rājā na mitraṃ pra mināti dhīraḥ | piturna putraḥ kratubhiryatāna ā pavasva viśe asyā ajītim ||

translations.english: As the rays of the days of the sun are let loose (so are the streams of the Soma); a prudent king does not abandon his friend; as a son preserving in pious acts (wins) his father's (safety), do you pour upon this people immunity from defeat.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ते धारा मधुमतीरसृग्रन्वारान्यत्पूतो अत्येष्यव्यान् । पवमान पवसे धाम गोनां जज्ञानः सूर्यमपिन्वो अर्कैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra te dhārā madhumatīrasṛgranvārānyatpūto atyeṣyavyān | pavamāna pavase dhāma gonāṃ jajñānaḥ sūryamapinvo arkaiḥ ||

translations.english: Your exhilarating streams are let loose when you pass purified through the woollen fleece; Pavamāna you flow to the supporting (milk) of the kine, as soon as genitive rated you fill the sun with your radiance.

mantras.sanskrit: कनिक्रददनु पन्थामृतस्य शुक्रो वि भास्यमृतस्य धाम । स इन्द्राय पवसे मत्सरवान्हिन्वानो वाचं मतिभिः कवीनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kanikradadanu panthāmṛtasya śukro vi bhāsyamṛtasya dhāma | sa indrāya pavase matsaravānhinvāno vācaṃ matibhiḥ kavīnām ||

translations.english: (The Soma) cries repeatedly upon the path of the sacrifice; you shine (being) the abode of immortality; possessing exhilaration you flow for Indra, sending forth your voice with the praises of the sages.

mantras.sanskrit: दिव्यः सुपर्णोऽव चक्षि सोम पिन्वन्धाराः कर्मणा देववीतौ । एन्दो विश कलशं सोमधानं क्रन्दन्निहि सूर्यस्योप रश्मिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: divyaḥ suparṇo'va cakṣi soma pinvandhārāḥ karmaṇā devavītau | endo viśa kalaśaṃ somadhānaṃ krandannihi sūryasyopa raśmim ||

translations.english: Soma, who are celestial, well-winged, you look down from heaven, pouring forth your streams by the pious rite at the sacrifice; Indu, enter into the pitcher the receptacle of the Soma; crying aloud approach the sun's rays.

mantras.sanskrit: तिस्रो वाच ईरयति प्र वह्निॠतस्य धीतिं ब्रह्मणो मनीषाम् । गावो यन्ति गोपतिं पृच्छमानाः सोमं यन्ति मतयो वावशानाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tisro vāca īrayati pra vahniṝtasya dhītiṃ brahmaṇo manīṣām | gāvo yanti gopatiṃ pṛcchamānāḥ somaṃ yanti matayo vāvaśānāḥ ||

translations.english: The bearer (of the oblation) utters the three praises, the thought of Brahma that sustains the sacrifice; the kine come to the cowherd asking (to be milked), the praisers proceed to the Soma with eagerness.

mantras.sanskrit: सोमं गावो धेनवो वावशानाः सोमं विप्रा मतिभिः पृच्छमानाः । सोमः सुतः पूयते अज्यमानः सोमे अर्कास्त्रिष्टुभः सं नवन्ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: somaṃ gāvo dhenavo vāvaśānāḥ somaṃ viprā matibhiḥ pṛcchamānāḥ | somaḥ sutaḥ pūyate ajyamānaḥ some arkāstriṣṭubhaḥ saṃ navante ||

translations.english: The kine (are) longing for the Soma; wise men (are) inquiring for him with praises; Soma being effused is purified blended (with milk), our adorations in the triṣṭubh metre are united in the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा नः सोम परिषिच्यमान आ पवस्व पूयमानः स्वस्ति । इन्द्रमा विश बृहता रवेण वर्धया वाचं जनया पुरंधिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā naḥ soma pariṣicyamāna ā pavasva pūyamānaḥ svasti | indramā viśa bṛhatā raveṇa vardhayā vācaṃ janayā puraṃdhim ||

translations.english: Thus poured around (into the vessels), Soma, do you when purified flow for our welfare, enter with a great noise into Indra, foster our praise, genitive rate abundant knowledge in us.

mantras.sanskrit: आ जागृविर्विप्र ऋता मतीनां सोमः पुनानो असदच्चमूषु । सपन्ति यं मिथुनासो निकामा अध्वर्यवो रथिरासः सुहस्ताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā jāgṛvirvipra ṛtā matīnāṃ somaḥ punāno asadaccamūṣu | sapanti yaṃ mithunāso nikāmā adhvaryavo rathirāsaḥ suhastāḥ ||

translations.english: The vigilant Soma, the knower of true praises, being purified, has sat down in the vessels-- (the Soma) whom the adhvaryus touch, combined, emulous, leaders of the sacrifice, auspicious-handed.

mantras.sanskrit: स पुनान उप सूरे न धातोभे अप्रा रोदसी वि ष आवः । प्रिया चिद्यस्य प्रियसास ऊती स तू धनं कारिणे न प्र यंसत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa punāna upa sūre na dhātobhe aprā rodasī vi ṣa āvaḥ | priyā cidyasya priyasāsa ūtī sa tū dhanaṃ kāriṇe na pra yaṃsat ||

translations.english: The purified (Soma) approaches (Indra) as the year (approaches) the sun, he fills both heaven and earth (with his radiance), he opens (the darkness with his light); may he, the beloved (Soma), whose beloved (streams) are for (our) preservation, bestow upon us wealth like (wages given) to a labourer.

mantras.sanskrit: स वर्धिता वर्धनः पूयमानः सोमो मीढ्वाँ अभि नो ज्योतिषावीत् । येना नः पूर्वे पितरः पदज्ञाः स्वर्विदो अभि गा अद्रिमुष्णन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa vardhitā vardhanaḥ pūyamānaḥ somo mīḍhvā~ abhi no jyotiṣāvīt | yenā naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ padajñāḥ svarvido abhi gā adrimuṣṇan ||

translations.english: May Soma the augmenter (of the gods), self-augmenting, being purified, the showerer (of benefits), protect us by his radiance; through whom our forefathers, tracing the footmarks, cognizant of all things, stole the cattle from the rock.

mantras.sanskrit: अक्रान्त्समुद्रः प्रथमे विधर्मञ्जनयन्प्रजा भुवनस्य राजा । वृषा पवित्रे अधि सानो अव्ये बृहत्सोमो वावृधे सुवान इन्दुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: akrāntsamudraḥ prathame vidharmañjanayanprajā bhuvanasya rājā | vṛṣā pavitre adhi sāno avye bṛhatsomo vāvṛdhe suvāna induḥ ||

translations.english: The ocean, the royal (Soma), genitive rating progeny in the outstretched (firmament, the) supporter of the water traverses the universe; the showerer (of benefits), the brilliant Soma when effused increases abundantly in the elevated woollen filter.

mantras.sanskrit: महत्तत्सोमो महिषश्चकारापां यद्गर्भोऽवृणीत देवान् । अदधादिन्द्रे पवमान ओजोऽजनयत्सूर्ये ज्योतिरिन्दुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahattatsomo mahiṣaścakārāpāṃ yadgarbho'vṛṇīta devān | adadhādindre pavamāna ojo'janayatsūrye jyotirinduḥ ||

translations.english: The mighty Soma has achieved this mighty (work) that, being the germ of the waters, he has nourished the gods; purified he has given strength to Indra; Indu has genitive rated the light in the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: मत्सि वायुमिष्टये राधसे च मत्सि मित्रावरुणा पूयमानः । मत्सि शर्धो मारुतं मत्सि देवान्मत्सि द्यावापृथिवी देव सोम ॥
mantras.transliteration: matsi vāyumiṣṭaye rādhase ca matsi mitrāvaruṇā pūyamānaḥ | matsi śardho mārutaṃ matsi devānmatsi dyāvāpṛthivī deva soma ||

translations.english: Exhilarate Vāyu for (our) food and wealth, exhilarate Mitra and Varuṇa as soon as you are filtered; exhilarate the company of the Maruts, exhilarate the gods, exhilarate heaven and earth, divine Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋजुः पवस्व वृजिनस्य हन्तापामीवां बाधमानो मृधश्च । अभिश्रीणन्पयः पयसाभि गोनामिन्द्रस्य त्वं तव वयं सखायः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛjuḥ pavasva vṛjinasya hantāpāmīvāṃ bādhamāno mṛdhaśca | abhiśrīṇanpayaḥ payasābhi gonāmindrasya tvaṃ tava vayaṃ sakhāyaḥ ||

translations.english: Flow you who are straight going, the slayer of the crooked-goer, driving away disease and enemies; mixing your juice with thejuice of the kine (you go to the cups); (you are) Indra's (friend), we (are) your friends.

mantras.sanskrit: मध्वः सूदं पवस्व वस्व उत्सं वीरं च न आ पवस्वा भगं च । स्वदस्वेन्द्राय पवमान इन्दो रयिं च न आ पवस्वा समुद्रात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: madhvaḥ sūdaṃ pavasva vasva utsaṃ vīraṃ ca na ā pavasvā bhagaṃ ca | svadasvendrāya pavamāna indo rayiṃ ca na ā pavasvā samudrāt ||

translations.english: Pour forth a fountain of wealth distilling sweet juice, pour upon us male offspring and riches; flow sweet for Indra, O Indu, when purified; and pour riches upon us from the firmament.

mantras.sanskrit: सोमः सुतो धारयात्यो न हित्वा सिन्धुर्न निम्नमभि वाज्यक्षाः । आ योनिं वन्यमसदत्पुनानः समिन्दुर्गोभिरसरत्समद्भिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: somaḥ suto dhārayātyo na hitvā sindhurna nimnamabhi vājyakṣāḥ | ā yoniṃ vanyamasadatpunānaḥ samindurgobhirasaratsamadbhiḥ ||

translations.english: The Soma effused in a stream, going like a horse flows powerful like a river down a descent; purified he alights on the wooden abode; Indu mixes with the milk and curds, (mixes) with the water.

mantras.sanskrit: एष स्य ते पवत इन्द्र सोमश्चमूषु धीर उशते तवस्वान् । स्वर्चक्षा रथिरः सत्यशुष्मः कामो न यो देवयतामसर्जि ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa sya te pavata indra somaścamūṣu dhīra uśate tavasvān | svarcakṣā rathiraḥ satyaśuṣmaḥ kāmo na yo devayatāmasarji ||

translations.english: The following sagacious Soma flows into the cups, Indra, for you, who long (for him)--all-seeing, car-borne, of adequate vigour, who has been sent forth like the wish of the god-desiring (worshippers).

mantras.sanskrit: एष प्रत्नेन वयसा पुनानस्तिरो वर्पांसि दुहितुर्दधानः । वसानः शर्म त्रिवरूथमप्सु होतेव याति समनेषु रेभन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa pratnena vayasā punānastiro varpāṃsi duhiturdadhānaḥ | vasānaḥ śarma trivarūthamapsu hoteva yāti samaneṣu rebhan ||

translations.english: Flowing with (his) ancient food, enveloping the forms of the earth, covering the house of sacrifice which has a threefold protection, (plural ced) in the waters he advances calling aloud at the oblations like a ministrant priest.

mantras.sanskrit: नू नस्त्वं रथिरो देव सोम परि स्रव चम्वोः पूयमानः । अप्सु स्वादिष्ठो मधुमाँ ऋतावा देवो न यः सविता सत्यमन्मा ॥
mantras.transliteration: nū nastvaṃ rathiro deva soma pari srava camvoḥ pūyamānaḥ | apsu svādiṣṭho madhumā~ ṛtāvā devo na yaḥ savitā satyamanmā ||

translations.english: Divine Soma, who are car-borne, being filtered (at) our (sacrifice), flow quickly into the cups; most sweet-flavoured in the waters, full of delight, offered at the sacrifice, stimulator of all, who like a god are the object of true praise.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि वायुं वीत्यर्षा गृणानोऽभि मित्रावरुणा पूयमानः । अभी नरं धीजवनं रथेष्ठामभीन्द्रं वृषणं वज्रबाहुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi vāyuṃ vītyarṣā gṛṇāno'bhi mitrāvaruṇā pūyamānaḥ | abhī naraṃ dhījavanaṃ ratheṣṭhāmabhīndraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vajrabāhum ||

translations.english: Being eulogized, hasten to Vāyu, for (him to) drink; being purified, hasten to Mitra and Varuṇa; (hasten) to the leader, who is quick as thought, mounted on a car, to Indra, the showerer, the wielder of the thunderbolt.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि वस्त्रा सुवसनान्यर्षाभि धेनूः सुदुघाः पूयमानः । अभि चन्द्रा भर्तवे नो हिरण्याभ्यश्वान्रथिनो देव सोम ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi vastrā suvasanānyarṣābhi dhenūḥ sudughāḥ pūyamānaḥ | abhi candrā bhartave no hiraṇyābhyaśvānrathino deva soma ||

translations.english: Bring us handsome garments, bring us, when you are purified, cows easily milked; bring for our maintenance gratifying gold; divine Soma, bring us horses fit for chariots.

mantras.sanskrit: अभी नो अर्ष दिव्या वसून्यभि विश्वा पार्थिवा पूयमानः । अभि येन द्रविणमश्नवामाभ्यार्षेयं जमदग्निवन्नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhī no arṣa divyā vasūnyabhi viśvā pārthivā pūyamānaḥ | abhi yena draviṇamaśnavāmābhyārṣeyaṃ jamadagnivannaḥ ||

translations.english: Bring us celestial treasures, bring us all erthly (treasures)  when you are purified; bring us (the ability) whereby we may acquire riches, make our sacred prayer (sweet) as Jamadagni.

mantras.sanskrit: अया पवा पवस्वैना वसूनि माँश्चत्व इन्दो सरसि प्र धन्व । ब्रध्नश्चिदत्र वातो न जूतः पुरुमेधश्चित्तकवे नरं दात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayā pavā pavasvainā vasūni mā~ścatva indo sarasi pra dhanva | bradhnaścidatra vāto na jūtaḥ purumedhaścittakave naraṃ dāt ||

translations.english: With this filtered stream pour on us those treasures; do you, Indu, advance to the brown water; at this rite may the sun, rapid as the wind, may (Indra) the object of many sacrifices grant a son to me approaching (the Soma).

mantras.sanskrit: उत न एना पवया पवस्वाधि श्रुते श्रवाय्यस्य तीर्थे । षष्टिं सहस्रा नैगुतो वसूनि वृक्षं न पक्वं धूनवद्रणाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta na enā pavayā pavasvādhi śrute śravāyyasya tīrthe | ṣaṣṭiṃ sahasrā naiguto vasūni vṛkṣaṃ na pakvaṃ dhūnavadraṇāya ||

translations.english: And flow with this filtered stream at the renowned station ofyou who are worthy of renown; (the Soma) the destroyer of enemies has shaken down (for us) sixty thousand treasures for victory as (one shakes) a tree whose fruit is ripe.

mantras.sanskrit: महीमे अस्य वृषनाम शूषे माँश्चत्वे वा पृशने वा वधत्रे । अस्वापयन्निगुतः स्नेहयच्चापामित्राँ अपाचितो अचेतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahīme asya vṛṣanāma śūṣe mā~ścatve vā pṛśane vā vadhatre | asvāpayannigutaḥ snehayaccāpāmitrā~ apācito acetaḥ ||

translations.english: These two great acts, the raining (of arrows) and the humiliation (of foes), are the givers of happiness; they are deadly either in a fight on horseback or in a hand to hand fight; he has put the foes to sleep and driven them away; doyou (Soma) drive away the enemies and unbelievers.

mantras.sanskrit: सं त्री पवित्रा विततान्येष्यन्वेकं धावसि पूयमानः । असि भगो असि दात्रस्य दातासि मघवा मघवद्भ्य इन्दो ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ trī pavitrā vitatānyeṣyanvekaṃ dhāvasi pūyamānaḥ | asi bhago asi dātrasya dātāsi maghavā maghavadbhya indo ||

translations.english: You reach the three outstretched filters, you hasten to the one (filter) being purified; you are Bhaga, you are the donor of gifts, you Indu are more affluent than the affluent.

mantras.sanskrit: एष विश्ववित्पवते मनीषी सोमो विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजा । द्रप्साँ ईरयन्विदथेष्विन्दुर्वि वारमव्यं समयाति याति ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa viśvavitpavate manīṣī somo viśvasya bhuvanasya rājā | drapsā~ īrayanvidatheṣvindurvi vāramavyaṃ samayāti yāti ||

translations.english: This all-knowing sage Soma, the sovereign of the whole world, flows forth; distilling his drops at the sacrifices, Indu passes through the sheep's hair on both sides.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्दुं रिहन्ति महिषा अदब्धाः पदे रेभन्ति कवयो न गृध्राः । हिन्वन्ति धीरा दशभिः क्षिपाभिः समञ्जते रूपमपां रसेन ॥
mantras.transliteration: induṃ rihanti mahiṣā adabdhāḥ pade rebhanti kavayo na gṛdhrāḥ | hinvanti dhīrā daśabhiḥ kṣipābhiḥ samañjate rūpamapāṃ rasena ||

translations.english: The adorable, unassailable (deities) sip the Soma juice, they hail it at its station like worshippers greedy (of wealth); the skilful priests send forth the Soma with their ten fingers, they anoint its body with the fluid of the waters.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वया वयं पवमानेन सोम भरे कृतं वि चिनुयाम शश्वत् । तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvayā vayaṃ pavamānena soma bhare kṛtaṃ vi cinuyāma śaśvat | tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

translations.english: May we ever, Soma, with you who are purified, (as our ally) win much wealth in battle; so may Mitra, Varuṇa, Aditi, Sindhu, heaven and earth enrich us.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि नो वाजसातमं रयिमर्ष पुरुस्पृहम् । इन्दो सहस्रभर्णसं तुविद्युम्नं विभ्वासहम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi no vājasātamaṃ rayimarṣa puruspṛham | indo sahasrabharṇasaṃ tuvidyumnaṃ vibhvāsaham ||

translations.english: Bring us, Indu, strength-bestowing riches, desired bymany, supporting many, far-celebrated and overcoming mighty (foes).

mantras.sanskrit: परि ष्य सुवानो अव्ययं रथे न वर्माव्यत । इन्दुरभि द्रुणा हितो हियानो धाराभिरक्षाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari ṣya suvāno avyayaṃ rathe na varmāvyata | indurabhi druṇā hito hiyāno dhārābhirakṣāḥ ||

translations.english: When effused the Soma juice flows to the woollen (filter) as (a warrior) in a chariot is covered in mail; fitted into the wooden (cask), hurrying forth, it flows in streams.

mantras.sanskrit: परि ष्य सुवानो अक्षा इन्दुरव्ये मदच्युतः । धारा य ऊर्ध्वो अध्वरे भ्राजा नैति गव्ययुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari ṣya suvāno akṣā induravye madacyutaḥ | dhārā ya ūrdhvo adhvare bhrājā naiti gavyayuḥ ||

translations.english: The Soma juice being effused flows through the fleece diffusing exhilaration; who, being exalted goes to the sacrifice in a stream desiring the milk and curds as (he goes to the firmament) with radiance.

mantras.sanskrit: स हि त्वं देव शश्वते वसु मर्ताय दाशुषे । इन्दो सहस्रिणं रयिं शतात्मानं विवाससि ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa hi tvaṃ deva śaśvate vasu martāya dāśuṣe | indo sahasriṇaṃ rayiṃ śatātmānaṃ vivāsasi ||

translations.english: For you, divine Indu, grant riches to every man who offers libations, thousand-fold and hundred-fold treasure.

mantras.sanskrit: वयं ते अस्य वृत्रहन्वसो वस्वः पुरुस्पृहः । नि नेदिष्ठतमा इषः स्याम सुम्नस्याध्रिगो ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayaṃ te asya vṛtrahanvaso vasvaḥ puruspṛhaḥ | ni nediṣṭhatamā iṣaḥ syāma sumnasyādhrigo ||

translations.english: Slayer of enemies, may we by your (people); Vasu, (may we be) extremely near your much-coveted wealth; irresistible (Soma), may we be near happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: द्विर्यं पञ्च स्वयशसं स्वसारो अद्रिसंहतम् । प्रियमिन्द्रस्य काम्यं प्रस्नापयन्त्यूर्मिणम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dviryaṃ pañca svayaśasaṃ svasāro adrisaṃhatam | priyamindrasya kāmyaṃ prasnāpayantyūrmiṇam ||

translations.english: Whom, celebrated, expressed by the stones, dear to Indra, beloved (by all) moving in streams, the twice fiver sister (fingers) bathe (in the sacred waters).

mantras.sanskrit: परि त्यं हर्यतं हरिं बभ्रुं पुनन्ति वारेण । यो देवान्विश्वाँ इत्परि मदेन सह गच्छति ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari tyaṃ haryataṃ hariṃ babhruṃ punanti vāreṇa | yo devānviśvā~ itpari madena saha gacchati ||

translations.english: Him, coveted (by all), green-tinted, brown, they purify with the filter; who goes to all the gods with (his) exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य वो ह्यवसा पान्तो दक्षसाधनम् । यः सूरिषु श्रवो बृहद्दधे स्वर्ण हर्यतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya vo hyavasā pānto dakṣasādhanam | yaḥ sūriṣu śravo bṛhaddadhe svarṇa haryataḥ ||

translations.english: For you by his protection have drunk the strengthening (juice of that Soma) who, beloved (by all) like the sun, has bestowed abundant food upon his worshippers.

mantras.sanskrit: स वां यज्ञेषु मानवी इन्दुर्जनिष्ट रोदसी । देवो देवी गिरिष्ठा अस्रेधन्तं तुविष्वणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa vāṃ yajñeṣu mānavī indurjaniṣṭa rodasī | devo devī giriṣṭhā asredhantaṃ tuviṣvaṇi ||

translations.english: Divine heaven and earth the progeny of Manu, the Soma juice is genitive rated at your sacrifices, radiant, abiding in the grinding stones; (the priests) bruise him at the loud-sounding ceremony.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राय सोम पातवे वृत्रघ्ने परि षिच्यसे । नरे च दक्षिणावते देवाय सदनासदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāya soma pātave vṛtraghne pari ṣicyase | nare ca dakṣiṇāvate devāya sadanāsade ||

translations.english: You are poured forth, Soma, for Indra, the slayer of Vṛtra, to drink; and for the munificent worshipper who sits in the halls of sacrifice (to give oblations) to god.

mantras.sanskrit: ते प्रत्नासो व्युष्टिषु सोमाः पवित्रे अक्षरन् । अपप्रोथन्तः सनुतर्हुरश्चितः प्रातस्ताँ अप्रचेतसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te pratnāso vyuṣṭiṣu somāḥ pavitre akṣaran | apaprothantaḥ sanutarhuraścitaḥ prātastā~ apracetasaḥ ||

translations.english: Those ancient Soma juices flow into the filter at the dawn, driving away in the early morning the concealed and ignorant thieves.

mantras.sanskrit: तं सखायः पुरोरुचं यूयं वयं च सूरयः । अश्याम वाजगन्ध्यं सनेम वाजपस्त्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ sakhāyaḥ purorucaṃ yūyaṃ vayaṃ ca sūrayaḥ | aśyāma vājagandhyaṃ sanema vājapastyam ||

translations.english: May you and we, intelligent friends, eat the bright Soma fragrant and invigorating, may we obtain food and dwellings.

mantras.sanskrit: आ हर्यताय धृष्णवे धनुस्तन्वन्ति पौंस्यम् । शुक्रां वयन्त्यसुराय निर्णिजं विपामग्रे महीयुवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā haryatāya dhṛṣṇave dhanustanvanti pauṃsyam | śukrāṃ vayantyasurāya nirṇijaṃ vipāmagre mahīyuvaḥ ||

translations.english: They stretch the bow of manhood for the beloved courageous (Soma); (the priests) wishing to worship spread out the white filter for the mighty (Soma) in the presence of the sage (deities).

mantras.sanskrit: अध क्षपा परिष्कृतो वाजाँ अभि प्र गाहते । यदी विवस्वतो धियो हरिं हिन्वन्ति यातवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha kṣapā pariṣkṛto vājā~ abhi pra gāhate | yadī vivasvato dhiyo hariṃ hinvanti yātave ||

translations.english: Consecrated at the end of the night (the Soma) plural nges into the viands, when the fingers of the worshipper press out the green-tinted (juice) to go (to the vessels).

mantras.sanskrit: तमस्य मर्जयामसि मदो य इन्द्रपातमः । यं गाव आसभिर्दधुः पुरा नूनं च सूरयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamasya marjayāmasi mado ya indrapātamaḥ | yaṃ gāva āsabhirdadhuḥ purā nūnaṃ ca sūrayaḥ ||

translations.english: We purify the juice that Soma which is exhilarating and fit for Indra's drinking; which the approaching worshippers both now and of old take up in their mluths.

mantras.sanskrit: तं गाथया पुराण्या पुनानमभ्यनूषत । उतो कृपन्त धीतयो देवानां नाम बिभ्रतीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ gāthayā purāṇyā punānamabhyanūṣata | uto kṛpanta dhītayo devānāṃ nāma bibhratīḥ ||

translations.english: They celebrate the purified Soma juice with an ancient hymn of praise, and the fingers exercising their pressure are able (to prepare the oblation) for the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: तमुक्षमाणमव्यये वारे पुनन्ति धर्णसिम् । दूतं न पूर्वचित्तय आ शासते मनीषिणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamukṣamāṇamavyaye vāre punanti dharṇasim | dūtaṃ na pūrvacittaya ā śāsate manīṣiṇaḥ ||

translations.english: Him sprinkled (with water) the supporter (of all things) they purify in the woollen filter; the wise (worshippers) instrumental uct him as a messenger to proclaim (their prayers) beforehand (to the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: स पुनानो मदिन्तमः सोमश्चमूषु सीदति । पशौ न रेत आदधत्पतिर्वचस्यते धियः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa punāno madintamaḥ somaścamūṣu sīdati | paśau na reta ādadhatpatirvacasyate dhiyaḥ ||

translations.english: The most exhilarating Soma, being purified, alights on the vessels; putting his seed (in the vessels) as in a heifer, the protector of the rite is worshipped.

mantras.sanskrit: स मृज्यते सुकर्मभिर्देवो देवेभ्यः सुतः । विदे यदासु संददिर्महीरपो वि गाहते ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa mṛjyate sukarmabhirdevo devebhyaḥ sutaḥ | vide yadāsu saṃdadirmahīrapo vi gāhate ||

translations.english: Effused for the gods, the god Soma is cleansed by the skilful (priests); when he is recognized among these (people) as the giver (of riches), he plural nges into the mighty waters.

mantras.sanskrit: सुत इन्दो पवित्र आ नृभिर्यतो वि नीयसे । इन्द्राय मत्सरिन्तमश्चमूष्वा नि षीदसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: suta indo pavitra ā nṛbhiryato vi nīyase | indrāya matsarintamaścamūṣvā ni ṣīdasi ||

translations.english: When effused, Indu, and collected by the priests, you are guided to the filter; you alight on the cups for Indra, exciting exceeding exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: अभी नवन्ते अद्रुहः प्रियमिन्द्रस्य काम्यम् । वत्सं न पूर्व आयुनि जातं रिहन्ति मातरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhī navante adruhaḥ priyamindrasya kāmyam | vatsaṃ na pūrva āyuni jātaṃ rihanti mātaraḥ ||

translations.english: The innocent waters repair to Soma dear to Indra and beloved (of all), as the material kine lick the new-born calf at the beginning of its life.

mantras.sanskrit: पुनान इन्दवा भर सोम द्विबर्हसं रयिम् । त्वं वसूनि पुष्यसि विश्वानि दाशुषो गृहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: punāna indavā bhara soma dvibarhasaṃ rayim | tvaṃ vasūni puṣyasi viśvāni dāśuṣo gṛhe ||

translations.english: Indu, Soma, when purified bring us the riches of both worlds; you foster all treasures in the house of the donor (of the libation).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं धियं मनोयुजं सृजा वृष्टिं न तन्यतुः । त्वं वसूनि पार्थिवा दिव्या च सोम पुष्यसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ dhiyaṃ manoyujaṃ sṛjā vṛṣṭiṃ na tanyatuḥ | tvaṃ vasūni pārthivā divyā ca soma puṣyasi ||

translations.english: Let loose your stream which is as rapid as thought; as the cloud (let loose) the rain; you Soma foster terrestrial and celestial treasures.

mantras.sanskrit: परि ते जिग्युषो यथा धारा सुतस्य धावति । रंहमाणा व्यव्ययं वारं वाजीव सानसिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari te jigyuṣo yathā dhārā sutasya dhāvati | raṃhamāṇā vyavyayaṃ vāraṃ vājīva sānasiḥ ||

translations.english: Your stream when you are effused, swift-flowing bountiful, rushes through the sheep's hair like the horse of a victorious (hero).

mantras.sanskrit: क्रत्वे दक्षाय नः कवे पवस्व सोम धारया । इन्द्राय पातवे सुतो मित्राय वरुणाय च ॥
mantras.transliteration: kratve dakṣāya naḥ kave pavasva soma dhārayā | indrāya pātave suto mitrāya varuṇāya ca ||

translations.english: Sage Soma flow in a stream for our enlightenment and invigoration, poured forth for Indra, Mitra and Varuṇa to drink.

mantras.sanskrit: पवस्व वाजसातमः पवित्रे धारया सुतः । इन्द्राय सोम विष्णवे देवेभ्यो मधुमत्तमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavasva vājasātamaḥ pavitre dhārayā sutaḥ | indrāya soma viṣṇave devebhyo madhumattamaḥ ||

translations.english: Flow, Soma, who are the giver of food in a stream, when effused, to the filter; (flow) Soma who are most sweet for Indra, for Viṣṇu, for the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वां रिहन्ति मातरो हरिं पवित्रे अद्रुहः । वत्सं जातं न धेनवः पवमान विधर्मणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāṃ rihanti mātaro hariṃ pavitre adruhaḥ | vatsaṃ jātaṃ na dhenavaḥ pavamāna vidharmaṇi ||

translations.english: The innocent maternal (waters) caress you, the green-tinted, upon the filter, O Pavamāna, at the sacrifice, as kine caress their new-born calf.

mantras.sanskrit: पवमान महि श्रवश्चित्रेभिर्यासि रश्मिभिः । शर्धन्तमांसि जिघ्नसे विश्वानि दाशुषो गृहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamāna mahi śravaścitrebhiryāsi raśmibhiḥ | śardhantamāṃsi jighnase viśvāni dāśuṣo gṛhe ||

translations.english: Pavamāna, you traverse the vast firmament with various rays, hastening on you dispel all rākṣasas at the house of the donor (of the libation).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं द्यां च महिव्रत पृथिवीं चाति जभ्रिषे । प्रति द्रापिममुञ्चथाः पवमान महित्वना ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ dyāṃ ca mahivrata pṛthivīṃ cāti jabhriṣe | prati drāpimamuñcathāḥ pavamāna mahitvanā ||

translations.english: Observer of manifold rites, you support both heaven and earth; O Pavamāna, (who are endowed) with greatness, you put on your coat of mail.

mantras.sanskrit: पुरोजिती वो अन्धसः सुताय मादयित्नवे । अप श्वानं श्नथिष्टन सखायो दीर्घजिह्व्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: purojitī vo andhasaḥ sutāya mādayitnave | apa śvānaṃ śnathiṣṭana sakhāyo dīrghajihvyam ||

translations.english: For (the drinking of) the effused exhilarating (juice) of the Soma who has plural ced victory before you, do you friends destroy the long-tongued dog.

mantras.sanskrit: यो धारया पावकया परिप्रस्यन्दते सुतः । इन्दुरश्वो न कृत्व्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo dhārayā pāvakayā pariprasyandate sutaḥ | induraśvo na kṛtvyaḥ ||

translations.english: The Indu good for sacred rites which when effused flows forth in a purifying stream, (swift) as a horse.

mantras.sanskrit: तं दुरोषमभी नरः सोमं विश्वाच्या धिया । यज्ञं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ duroṣamabhī naraḥ somaṃ viśvācyā dhiyā | yajñaṃ hinvantyadribhiḥ ||

translations.english: Him, the Soma unassailable, adorable, the priests, with all comprehending intelligence, express with the stones.

mantras.sanskrit: सुतासो मधुमत्तमाः सोमा इन्द्राय मन्दिनः । पवित्रवन्तो अक्षरन्देवान्गच्छन्तु वो मदाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sutāso madhumattamāḥ somā indrāya mandinaḥ | pavitravanto akṣarandevāngacchantu vo madāḥ ||

translations.english: The sweet-flavoured exhilarating Soma juices effused (and) filtered flow for Indra; do you, exhilarating (juices) proceed to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्दुरिन्द्राय पवत इति देवासो अब्रुवन् । वाचस्पतिर्मखस्यते विश्वस्येशान ओजसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: indurindrāya pavata iti devāso abruvan | vācaspatirmakhasyate viśvasyeśāna ojasā ||

translations.english: The devout (worshippers) say 'Indu flows forth for Indra'; the lord of speech (Soma) soverign of all by his might desires (our) worship.

mantras.sanskrit: सहस्रधारः पवते समुद्रो वाचमीङ्खयः । सोमः पती रयीणां सखेन्द्रस्य दिवेदिवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: sahasradhāraḥ pavate samudro vācamīṅkhayaḥ | somaḥ patī rayīṇāṃ sakhendrasya divedive ||

translations.english: The thousand-streamed ocean, Soma the stimulator of praise, the lord of riches, the friend of Indra flows day by day.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं पूषा रयिर्भगः सोमः पुनानो अर्षति । पतिर्विश्वस्य भूमनो व्यख्यद्रोदसी उभे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ pūṣā rayirbhagaḥ somaḥ punāno arṣati | patirviśvasya bhūmano vyakhyadrodasī ubhe ||

translations.english: This Soma being purified hastens (to the pitcher) fostering, wealth-giving, to be enjoyed (by all); the lord of all beings, he has illuminated both heaven and earth.

mantras.sanskrit: समु प्रिया अनूषत गावो मदाय घृष्वयः । सोमासः कृण्वते पथः पवमानास इन्दवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samu priyā anūṣata gāvo madāya ghṛṣvayaḥ | somāsaḥ kṛṇvate pathaḥ pavamānāsa indavaḥ ||

translations.english: The affectionate emulous cows celebrate (Soma) for his exhilaration; the brilliant filtered (Soma) juices make paths (for themselves to flow).

mantras.sanskrit: य ओजिष्ठस्तमा भर पवमान श्रवाय्यम् । यः पञ्च चर्षणीरभि रयिं येन वनामहै ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya ojiṣṭhastamā bhara pavamāna śravāyyam | yaḥ pañca carṣaṇīrabhi rayiṃ yena vanāmahai ||

translations.english: Bring to us, filtered (Soma), that celebrated (beverage) which is most potent, which (waits) upon the fiver orders of beings and by which we may obtain riches.

mantras.sanskrit: सोमाः पवन्त इन्दवोऽस्मभ्यं गातुवित्तमाः । मित्राः सुवाना अरेपसः स्वाध्यः स्वर्विदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: somāḥ pavanta indavo'smabhyaṃ gātuvittamāḥ | mitrāḥ suvānā arepasaḥ svādhyaḥ svarvidaḥ ||

translations.english: The brilliant Soma juices flow for us knowing the right path, friendly (to the gods), effused sinless, contemplative, all-knowing.

mantras.sanskrit: सुष्वाणासो व्यद्रिभिश्चिताना गोरधि त्वचि । इषमस्मभ्यमभितः समस्वरन्वसुविदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: suṣvāṇāso vyadribhiścitānā goradhi tvaci | iṣamasmabhyamabhitaḥ samasvaranvasuvidaḥ ||

translations.english: Effused by the stones, recognized upon the cowhide acquirers of wealth they bestow food upon us from all sides.

mantras.sanskrit: एते पूता विपश्चितः सोमासो दध्याशिरः । सूर्यासो न दर्शतासो जिगत्नवो ध्रुवा घृते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ete pūtā vipaścitaḥ somāso dadhyāśiraḥ | sūryāso na darśatāso jigatnavo dhruvā ghṛte ||

translations.english: These filtered Soma juices, intelligent, mixed with curds, swift-moving, firm in the water (are) brilliant as suns.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सुन्वानस्यान्धसो मर्तो न वृत तद्वचः । अप श्वानमराधसं हता मखं न भृगवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra sunvānasyāndhaso marto na vṛta tadvacaḥ | apa śvānamarādhasaṃ hatā makhaṃ na bhṛgavaḥ ||

translations.english: Let no mortal hear the sound of the effused Soma; drive off the dog that sacrifices not as the Bhṛgus drove off Makha.

mantras.sanskrit: आ जामिरत्के अव्यत भुजे न पुत्र ओण्योः । सरज्जारो न योषणां वरो न योनिमासदम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā jāmiratke avyata bhuje na putra oṇyoḥ | sarajjāro na yoṣaṇāṃ varo na yonimāsadam ||

translations.english: (Soma) the kinsman (of the gods) is enveloped in the investing filter like a child in the arms of its protecting parents; he hastens like a gallant to a mistress, like a bridegroom (to the bride) to sit upon his station (the pitcher).

mantras.sanskrit: स वीरो दक्षसाधनो वि यस्तस्तम्भ रोदसी । हरिः पवित्रे अव्यत वेधा न योनिमासदम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa vīro dakṣasādhano vi yastastambha rodasī | hariḥ pavitre avyata vedhā na yonimāsadam ||

translations.english: The green-tinted (Soma), the implement of strength, the hero, who has upheld heaven and earth, is enveloped in the filter like the sacrificer (in his house) to sit upon his station.

mantras.sanskrit: अव्यो वारेभिः पवते सोमो गव्ये अधि त्वचि । कनिक्रदद्वृषा हरिरिन्द्रस्याभ्येति निष्कृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: avyo vārebhiḥ pavate somo gavye adhi tvaci | kanikradadvṛṣā haririndrasyābhyeti niṣkṛtam ||

translations.english: The Soma flows purified by the sheep's hairs; crying aloud upon the cowhide for the showerer (of benefits), green-tinted he goes to Indra's prepared station.

mantras.sanskrit: क्राणा शिशुर्महीनां हिन्वन्नृतस्य दीधितिम् । विश्वा परि प्रिया भुवदध द्विता ॥
mantras.transliteration: krāṇā śiśurmahīnāṃ hinvannṛtasya dīdhitim | viśvā pari priyā bhuvadadha dvitā ||

translations.english: Performing (sacred rites) the child of the great (waters) sending forth the lustre of the sacrifice (Soma) produces all acceptable (oblations) and (abides) in the two worlds.

mantras.sanskrit: उप त्रितस्य पाष्योरभक्त यद्गुहा पदम् । यज्ञस्य सप्त धामभिरध प्रियम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa tritasya pāṣyorabhakta yadguhā padam | yajñasya sapta dhāmabhiradha priyam ||

translations.english: When the Soma has been taken the secret station of the grinding stones (at the sacrifice) of Trita, then with the seven supports of the sacrifice (the priests praise) the conciliating (Soma).

mantras.sanskrit: त्रीणि त्रितस्य धारया पृष्ठेष्वेरया रयिम् । मिमीते अस्य योजना वि सुक्रतुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: trīṇi tritasya dhārayā pṛṣṭheṣverayā rayim | mimīte asya yojanā vi sukratuḥ ||

translations.english: (Support, Soma) with your stream Trita's three (oblations); cause the giver of riches (Indra) to come to the sacred songs. The intelligent (praiser) of this (Indra) measures out hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: जज्ञानं सप्त मातरो वेधामशासत श्रिये । अयं ध्रुवो रयीणां चिकेत यत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: jajñānaṃ sapta mātaro vedhāmaśāsata śriye | ayaṃ dhruvo rayīṇāṃ ciketa yat ||

translations.english: The seven mothers instrumental uct the (Soma) the instrumental tutor (of the sacrifice) when born for the prosperity (of the worshippers) to that this firm Soma is cognizant of riches. [

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य व्रते सजोषसो विश्वे देवासो अद्रुहः । स्पार्हा भवन्ति रन्तयो जुषन्त यत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya vrate sajoṣaso viśve devāso adruhaḥ | spārhā bhavanti rantayo juṣanta yat ||

translations.english: The universal gods, devoid of malice, assembled together at his rite, are to be envied if being delighted they take plural asure (in the Soma).

mantras.sanskrit: यमी गर्भमृतावृधो दृशे चारुमजीजनन् । कविं मंहिष्ठमध्वरे पुरुस्पृहम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yamī garbhamṛtāvṛdho dṛśe cārumajījanan | kaviṃ maṃhiṣṭhamadhvare puruspṛham ||

translations.english: The germ which the augmenters of the rite brought forth at the sacrifice lovely to look upon intelligent, most adorable, desired by many.

mantras.sanskrit: समीचीने अभि त्मना यह्वी ऋतस्य मातरा । तन्वाना यज्ञमानुषग्यदञ्जते ॥
mantras.transliteration: samīcīne abhi tmanā yahvī ṛtasya mātarā | tanvānā yajñamānuṣagyadañjate ||

translations.english: He of his own will approaches the great united parents of the sacrifice (heaven and earth) when (the priests) conducting the ceremony anoint him in due order with the sacred waters.

mantras.sanskrit: क्रत्वा शुक्रेभिरक्षभिॠणोरप व्रजं दिवः । हिन्वन्नृतस्य दीधितिं प्राध्वरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: kratvā śukrebhirakṣabhiṝṇorapa vrajaṃ divaḥ | hinvannṛtasya dīdhitiṃ prādhvare ||

translations.english: Soma, by your act drive away with your brilliant organs the darkness from the sky, effusing into the sacrifice (your juice) the lustre of the rite.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र पुनानाय वेधसे सोमाय वच उद्यतम् । भृतिं न भरा मतिभिर्जुजोषते ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra punānāya vedhase somāya vaca udyatam | bhṛtiṃ na bharā matibhirjujoṣate ||

translations.english: Raise a loud voice to Soma the instrumental tutor (of the rite), purified, gratified by praises, as (men pay) wages (to a labourer).

mantras.sanskrit: परि वाराण्यव्यया गोभिरञ्जानो अर्षति । त्री षधस्था पुनानः कृणुते हरिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari vārāṇyavyayā gobhirañjāno arṣati | trī ṣadhasthā punānaḥ kṛṇute hariḥ ||

translations.english: Blending with the curds and milk the Soma rushes through the woollen fleece; the green-tinted Soma being purified takes up three stations.

mantras.sanskrit: परि कोशं मधुश्चुतमव्यये वारे अर्षति । अभि वाणीॠषीणां सप्त नूषत ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari kośaṃ madhuścutamavyaye vāre arṣati | abhi vāṇīṝṣīṇāṃ sapta nūṣata ||

translations.english: The Soma sends forth (its juice) through the woollen fleece to the honey-dripping receptacle; the seven metres of the ṛṣis praise (it).

mantras.sanskrit: परि णेता मतीनां विश्वदेवो अदाभ्यः । सोमः पुनानश्चम्वोर्विशद्धरिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari ṇetā matīnāṃ viśvadevo adābhyaḥ | somaḥ punānaścamvorviśaddhariḥ ||

translations.english: Soma, the leader of praises, in whom all the gods are comprehended, unassailable, green-tinted when filtered, enters the cups.

mantras.sanskrit: परि दैवीरनु स्वधा इन्द्रेण याहि सरथम् । पुनानो वाघद्वाघद्भिरमर्त्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari daivīranu svadhā indreṇa yāhi saratham | punāno vāghadvāghadbhiramartyaḥ ||

translations.english: Proceed in the same chariot with Indra to the celestial hosts, a priest purified by priests, immortal.

mantras.sanskrit: परि सप्तिर्न वाजयुर्देवो देवेभ्यः सुतः । व्यानशिः पवमानो वि धावति ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari saptirna vājayurdevo devebhyaḥ sutaḥ | vyānaśiḥ pavamāno vi dhāvati ||

translations.english: Like a charger eager for the combat the divine (Soma) effused for the gods hastens when purified spreading widely into the vessels.

mantras.sanskrit: सखाय आ नि षीदत पुनानाय प्र गायत । शिशुं न यज्ञैः परि भूषत श्रिये ॥
mantras.transliteration: sakhāya ā ni ṣīdata punānāya pra gāyata | śiśuṃ na yajñaiḥ pari bhūṣata śriye ||

translations.english: Sit down, friends, sing to the filtered Soma, decorate him with offerings to beautify him as (parents decorate) a child.

mantras.sanskrit: समी वत्सं न मातृभिः सृजता गयसाधनम् । देवाव्यं मदमभि द्विशवसम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: samī vatsaṃ na mātṛbhiḥ sṛjatā gayasādhanam | devāvyaṃ madamabhi dviśavasam ||

translations.english: Associate him the support of the mansion with the maternal (waters) as the calf (with the mother) the protector of the gods, the exhilarator, endowed with twofold strength.

mantras.sanskrit: पुनाता दक्षसाधनं यथा शर्धाय वीतये । यथा मित्राय वरुणाय शंतमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: punātā dakṣasādhanaṃ yathā śardhāya vītaye | yathā mitrāya varuṇāya śaṃtamaḥ ||

translations.english: Purify the bestower of strength so that he may make for invigoration for the banquet (of the gods) and may grant much happiness to Mitra and Varuṇa.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मभ्यं त्वा वसुविदमभि वाणीरनूषत । गोभिष्टे वर्णमभि वासयामसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmabhyaṃ tvā vasuvidamabhi vāṇīranūṣata | gobhiṣṭe varṇamabhi vāsayāmasi ||

translations.english: For us do the hymns glorify you the giver of wealth; we clothe your form with the (products of the) kine.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो मदानां पत इन्दो देवप्सरा असि । सखेव सख्ये गातुवित्तमो भव ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no madānāṃ pata indo devapsarā asi | sakheva sakhye gātuvittamo bhava ||

translations.english: Lord of our exhilaration, Indu, you are of brilliant form; be our true guide as a friend is to a friend.

mantras.sanskrit: सनेमि कृध्यस्मदा रक्षसं कं चिदत्रिणम् । अपादेवं द्वयुमंहो युयोधि नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sanemi kṛdhyasmadā rakṣasaṃ kaṃ cidatriṇam | apādevaṃ dvayumaṃho yuyodhi naḥ ||

translations.english: Show us (your) ancient (friendship); (drive off) the voracious rākṣasa, the impious, the double dealer-- drive away our sin.

mantras.sanskrit: तं वः सखायो मदाय पुनानमभि गायत । शिशुं न यज्ञैः स्वदयन्त गूर्तिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ vaḥ sakhāyo madāya punānamabhi gāyata | śiśuṃ na yajñaiḥ svadayanta gūrtibhiḥ ||

translations.english: Hymn, friends, the Soma purified for the exhilaration (of the gods), gratify him with oblations and praises as (men gratify) a child (with ornaments).

mantras.sanskrit: सं वत्स इव मातृभिरिन्दुर्हिन्वानो अज्यते । देवावीर्मदो मतिभिः परिष्कृतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ vatsa iva mātṛbhirindurhinvāno ajyate | devāvīrmado matibhiḥ pariṣkṛtaḥ ||

translations.english: Indu being set forth is sprinkled (with the waters) as a calf (is nourished) by its mother-- the protector of the deities, the exhilarator, graced by praises.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं दक्षाय साधनोऽयं शर्धाय वीतये । अयं देवेभ्यो मधुमत्तमः सुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ dakṣāya sādhano'yaṃ śardhāya vītaye | ayaṃ devebhyo madhumattamaḥ sutaḥ ||

translations.english: This (Soma) is an instrumental ument for invigoration; he (is useful) for speed (and) for the banquet of your gods; he is effused most sweet-flavoured for the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: गोमन्न इन्दो अश्ववत्सुतः सुदक्ष धन्व । शुचिं ते वर्णमधि गोषु दीधरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: gomanna indo aśvavatsutaḥ sudakṣa dhanva | śuciṃ te varṇamadhi goṣu dīdharam ||

translations.english: Powerful Indu who are effused, pour upon us (wealth) comprising cattle and horses; I mix the pure juice with the curds and milk.

mantras.sanskrit: स नो हरीणां पत इन्दो देवप्सरस्तमः । सखेव सख्ये नर्यो रुचे भव ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa no harīṇāṃ pata indo devapsarastamaḥ | sakheva sakhye naryo ruce bhava ||

translations.english: Lord of our bay-coloured (cattle), Indu, who have a most brilliant form, do you who are kind to the priests be for a light to us as a friend (gives light) to a friend.

mantras.sanskrit: सनेमि त्वमस्मदाँ अदेवं कं चिदत्रिणम् । साह्वाँ इन्दो परि बाधो अप द्वयुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sanemi tvamasmadā~ adevaṃ kaṃ cidatriṇam | sāhvā~ indo pari bādho apa dvayum ||

translations.english: Do you (show) us your ancient (friendship), drive away the impious voracious (rākṣasa); Indu who are victorious overcome those who oppress us, (drive) off the double-dealing (rākṣas).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रमच्छ सुता इमे वृषणं यन्तु हरयः । श्रुष्टी जातास इन्दवः स्वर्विदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indramaccha sutā ime vṛṣaṇaṃ yantu harayaḥ | śruṣṭī jātāsa indavaḥ svarvidaḥ ||

translations.english: May these effused green-tinted Soma juices quickly genitive rated, all-knowing, proceed to Indra the showerer (of benefits).

mantras.sanskrit: अयं भराय सानसिरिन्द्राय पवते सुतः । सोमो जैत्रस्य चेतति यथा विदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ bharāya sānasirindrāya pavate sutaḥ | somo jaitrasya cetati yathā vide ||

translations.english: This effused Soma adorable for battle, is filtered for Indra; Soma thinks of the victorious (Indra) as he is known (in the world).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्येदिन्द्रो मदेष्वा ग्राभं गृभ्णीत सानसिम् । वज्रं च वृषणं भरत्समप्सुजित् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asyedindro madeṣvā grābhaṃ gṛbhṇīta sānasim | vajraṃ ca vṛṣaṇaṃ bharatsamapsujit ||

translations.english: In the Soma's exhilaration may Indra seize hold of wealth to be enjoyed (by all) and conquering Vṛtra in the waters may he wield the thunderbolt the showerer (of blessings).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र धन्वा सोम जागृविरिन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव । द्युमन्तं शुष्ममा भरा स्वर्विदम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra dhanvā soma jāgṛvirindrāyendo pari srava | dyumantaṃ śuṣmamā bharā svarvidam ||

translations.english: Flow Soma who are vigilant; Indu spread around for Indra; bring brilliant overpowering all-obtaining (strength).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राय वृषणं मदं पवस्व विश्वदर्शतः । सहस्रयामा पथिकृद्विचक्षणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāya vṛṣaṇaṃ madaṃ pavasva viśvadarśataḥ | sahasrayāmā pathikṛdvicakṣaṇaḥ ||

translations.english: Pour forth for Indra the exhilarating (juice) showering (benefits), you who are very beautiful, who have many paths, the finder of the (right) path, the observer (of all).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मभ्यं गातुवित्तमो देवेभ्यो मधुमत्तमः । सहस्रं याहि पथिभिः कनिक्रदत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmabhyaṃ gātuvittamo devebhyo madhumattamaḥ | sahasraṃ yāhi pathibhiḥ kanikradat ||

translations.english: You who are the best finder of paths for us, the sweet beverage for the gods, come by a thousand paths crying aloud.

mantras.sanskrit: पवस्व देववीतय इन्दो धाराभिरोजसा । आ कलशं मधुमान्त्सोम नः सदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavasva devavītaya indo dhārābhirojasā | ā kalaśaṃ madhumāntsoma naḥ sadaḥ ||

translations.english: Flow, Indu, in your strength with your streams for the banquet of the gods; sit down, Soma, who are sweet-flavoured, in our pitcher.

mantras.sanskrit: तव द्रप्सा उदप्रुत इन्द्रं मदाय वावृधुः । त्वां देवासो अमृताय कं पपुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava drapsā udapruta indraṃ madāya vāvṛdhuḥ | tvāṃ devāso amṛtāya kaṃ papuḥ ||

translations.english: Your drops, goint to the water, have exalted Indra to exhilaration; the gods have quaffed you, the delighter, for immortality.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नः सुतास इन्दवः पुनाना धावता रयिम् । वृष्टिद्यावो रीत्यापः स्वर्विदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā naḥ sutāsa indavaḥ punānā dhāvatā rayim | vṛṣṭidyāvo rītyāpaḥ svarvidaḥ ||

translations.english: Bring us wealth, bright Soma juices effused, filtered, filling the sky with rain, shedding water (upon the earth) acquiring all things.

mantras.sanskrit: सोमः पुनान ऊर्मिणाव्यो वारं वि धावति । अग्रे वाचः पवमानः कनिक्रदत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: somaḥ punāna ūrmiṇāvyo vāraṃ vi dhāvati | agre vācaḥ pavamānaḥ kanikradat ||

translations.english: Some being filtered flows in a stream through the woollen fleece, crying aloud when filtered in advance of the voice (of praise).

mantras.sanskrit: धीभिर्हिन्वन्ति वाजिनं वने क्रीळन्तमत्यविम् । अभि त्रिपृष्ठं मतयः समस्वरन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhībhirhinvanti vājinaṃ vane krīḷantamatyavim | abhi tripṛṣṭhaṃ matayaḥ samasvaran ||

translations.english: They send forth with their fingers the powerful Soma sporting in the water, passing through the fleece; praises celebrate him abiding in the three receptacles.

mantras.sanskrit: असर्जि कलशाँ अभि मीळ्हे सप्तिर्न वाजयुः । पुनानो वाचं जनयन्नसिष्यदत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asarji kalaśā~ abhi mīḷhe saptirna vājayuḥ | punāno vācaṃ janayannasiṣyadat ||

translations.english: Desiring (to give the worshipper) food he has been let loose into the pitchers like a charger in battle; being filtered, raising a cry he flows (into the vessels).

mantras.sanskrit: पवते हर्यतो हरिरति ह्वरांसि रंह्या । अभ्यर्षन्त्स्तोतृभ्यो वीरवद्यशः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavate haryato harirati hvarāṃsi raṃhyā | abhyarṣantstotṛbhyo vīravadyaśaḥ ||

translations.english: The delightful green-tinted (juice) flows with rapidity into the crooked (pitchers); bringing the worshippers, food and male offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: अया पवस्व देवयुर्मधोर्धारा असृक्षत । रेभन्पवित्रं पर्येषि विश्वतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayā pavasva devayurmadhordhārā asṛkṣata | rebhanpavitraṃ paryeṣi viśvataḥ ||

translations.english: Devoted to the gods flow with that (stream); (your) streams of exhilarating beverage are let loose; with a roar you pass through the filter in all directions.

mantras.sanskrit: परीतो षिञ्चता सुतं सोमो य उत्तमं हविः । दधन्वाँ यो नर्यो अप्स्वन्तरा सुषाव सोममद्रिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: parīto ṣiñcatā sutaṃ somo ya uttamaṃ haviḥ | dadhanvā~ yo naryo apsvantarā suṣāva somamadribhiḥ ||

translations.english: Sprinkle from hence the effused Soma-juice which is the best oblation (to the gods), and which, good for man, is going into the midst of the firmament; (the priest) has expressed the Soma with the stones.

mantras.sanskrit: नूनं पुनानोऽविभिः परि स्रवादब्धः सुरभिन्तरः । सुते चित्त्वाप्सु मदामो अन्धसा श्रीणन्तो गोभिरुत्तरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nūnaṃ punāno'vibhiḥ pari sravādabdhaḥ surabhintaraḥ | sute cittvāpsu madāmo andhasā śrīṇanto gobhiruttaram ||

translations.english: (Soma) who are unassailable, who are most fragrant, flow around now being purified by the fleece; being effused we praise you eminent in the waters mixing you with food and the (products of the) kind.

mantras.sanskrit: परि सुवानश्चक्षसे देवमादनः क्रतुरिन्दुर्विचक्षणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari suvānaścakṣase devamādanaḥ kraturindurvicakṣaṇaḥ ||

translations.english: Being effused the Indu flows so as to be seen (of all)-- the exhilarator of the gods, the agent (in holy acts), the observer of all.

mantras.sanskrit: पुनानः सोम धारयापो वसानो अर्षसि । आ रत्नधा योनिमृतस्य सीदस्युत्सो देव हिरण्ययः ॥
mantras.transliteration: punānaḥ soma dhārayāpo vasāno arṣasi | ā ratnadhā yonimṛtasya sīdasyutso deva hiraṇyayaḥ ||

translations.english: Undergoing purification you flow Soma in a stream clothed in the (consecrated) waters; the giver of wealth you sit on the plural ce of sacrifice, divine (Soma), who flow forth, who are the origin of gold.

mantras.sanskrit: दुहान ऊधर्दिव्यं मधु प्रियं प्रत्नं सधस्थमासदत् । आपृच्छ्यं धरुणं वाज्यर्षति नृभिर्धूतो विचक्षणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: duhāna ūdhardivyaṃ madhu priyaṃ pratnaṃ sadhasthamāsadat | āpṛcchyaṃ dharuṇaṃ vājyarṣati nṛbhirdhūto vicakṣaṇaḥ ||

translations.english: Milking the exhilarating agreeable celestial udder (the Soma) sits down on its ancient plural ce of aggregation (the firmament); food-giving, cleansed by the priests, observant it flows to the commendable worshipper.

mantras.sanskrit: पुनानः सोम जागृविरव्यो वारे परि प्रियः । त्वं विप्रो अभवोऽङ्गिरस्तमो मध्वा यज्ञं मिमिक्ष नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: punānaḥ soma jāgṛviravyo vāre pari priyaḥ | tvaṃ vipro abhavo'ṅgirastamo madhvā yajñaṃ mimikṣa naḥ ||

translations.english: Soma, who are purified, vigilant, agreeable (you flow) through the woollen fleece; you are intelligent, the chief of the Aṅgirasas, sprinkle our oblation with your exhilarating juice.

mantras.sanskrit: सोमो मीढ्वान्पवते गातुवित्तम ऋषिर्विप्रो विचक्षणः । त्वं कविरभवो देववीतम आ सूर्यं रोहयो दिवि ॥
mantras.transliteration: somo mīḍhvānpavate gātuvittama ṛṣirvipro vicakṣaṇaḥ | tvaṃ kavirabhavo devavītama ā sūryaṃ rohayo divi ||

translations.english: Soma flows forth the showerer of benefits, the best of path-finders, a ṛṣi, a sage, all-discriminating; you are a seer, most devoted to the gods; you have made the sun to mount the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: सोम उ षुवाणः सोतृभिरधि ष्णुभिरवीनाम् । अश्वयेव हरिता याति धारया मन्द्रया याति धारया ॥
mantras.transliteration: soma u ṣuvāṇaḥ sotṛbhiradhi ṣṇubhiravīnām | aśvayeva haritā yāti dhārayā mandrayā yāti dhārayā ||

translations.english: Effused by the effusers Soma is poured out upon the elevated fleeces; and proceeds with its green-tinted stream, as on a mare, proceeds with its exhilarating streams.

mantras.sanskrit: अनूपे गोमान्गोभिरक्षाः सोमो दुग्धाभिरक्षाः । समुद्रं न संवरणान्यग्मन्मन्दी मदाय तोशते ॥
mantras.transliteration: anūpe gomāngobhirakṣāḥ somo dugdhābhirakṣāḥ | samudraṃ na saṃvaraṇānyagmanmandī madāya tośate ||

translations.english: Soma combined with the produce of the kine flows with the kine into the pitcher, he flows with the milked kine; his enjoyable juices go (to the pitcher as waters) to the ocean, the exhilarating (Soma) is expressed for the exhilaration (of the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: आ सोम सुवानो अद्रिभिस्तिरो वाराण्यव्यया । जनो न पुरि चम्वोर्विशद्धरिः सदो वनेषु दधिषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā soma suvāno adribhistiro vārāṇyavyayā | jano na puri camvorviśaddhariḥ sado vaneṣu dadhiṣe ||

translations.english: Expressed by the stones, Soma, (passing) through the sheep's hairs, green-tinted, entering the cups as a man (enters) a city, you take your seat in the wooden (vessels).

mantras.sanskrit: स मामृजे तिरो अण्वानि मेष्यो मीळ्हे सप्तिर्न वाजयुः । अनुमाद्यः पवमानो मनीषिभिः सोमो विप्रेभिॠक्वभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa māmṛje tiro aṇvāni meṣyo mīḷhe saptirna vājayuḥ | anumādyaḥ pavamāno manīṣibhiḥ somo viprebhiṝkvabhiḥ ||

translations.english: Desirous of (bestowing) food, passing through the interstices of the fleece the Soma is adorned like a horse in the battle; the Pavamāna, to be rejoiced in (by all, praised) by the intelligent, the sages, the reciters of sacred songs.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सोम देववीतये सिन्धुर्न पिप्ये अर्णसा । अंशोः पयसा मदिरो न जागृविरच्छा कोशं मधुश्चुतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra soma devavītaye sindhurna pipye arṇasā | aṃśoḥ payasā madiro na jāgṛviracchā kośaṃ madhuścutam ||

translations.english: You are fed with water, Soma, like a river, for the banquet of the gods; with the juice of your filament you go to the honey-dropping receptacle, exhilarating, vigilant.

mantras.sanskrit: आ हर्यतो अर्जुने अत्के अव्यत प्रियः सूनुर्न मर्ज्यः । तमीं हिन्वन्त्यपसो यथा रथं नदीष्वा गभस्त्योः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā haryato arjune atke avyata priyaḥ sūnurna marjyaḥ | tamīṃ hinvantyapaso yathā rathaṃ nadīṣvā gabhastyoḥ ||

translations.english: Agreeable affectionate like a son about to be decorated, the Soma is clad in a shining robe; they send him with thei rarms into the streams as active (warriors and their) chariot into (battle).

mantras.sanskrit: अभि सोमास आयवः पवन्ते मद्यं मदम् । समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपि मनीषिणो मत्सरासः स्वर्विदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi somāsa āyavaḥ pavante madyaṃ madam | samudrasyādhi viṣṭapi manīṣiṇo matsarāsaḥ svarvidaḥ ||

translations.english: The swift Soma send forth their inebriating juice upon the uplifted (filter) of the firmament, intelligent, exhilarating, all-acquiring.

mantras.sanskrit: तरत्समुद्रं पवमान ऊर्मिणा राजा देव ऋतं बृहत् । अर्षन्मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धर्मणा प्र हिन्वान ऋतं बृहत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taratsamudraṃ pavamāna ūrmiṇā rājā deva ṛtaṃ bṛhat | arṣanmitrasya varuṇasya dharmaṇā pra hinvāna ṛtaṃ bṛhat ||

translations.english: The divine royal (Soma) vast and true, undergoing purification traverses the firmament in a stream; vast and true, being sent forth he flows for the support of Mitra and Varuṇa

mantras.sanskrit: नृभिर्येमानो हर्यतो विचक्षणो राजा देवः समुद्रियः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nṛbhiryemāno haryato vicakṣaṇo rājā devaḥ samudriyaḥ ||

translations.english: Regulated by the priests, the divine royal Soma, agreeable, intelligent, abiding in the firmament.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राय पवते मदः सोमो मरुत्वते सुतः । सहस्रधारो अत्यव्यमर्षति तमी मृजन्त्यायवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāya pavate madaḥ somo marutvate sutaḥ | sahasradhāro atyavyamarṣati tamī mṛjantyāyavaḥ ||

translations.english: Exhilarating, flows, when effused, for Indra attended by the Maruts; thousand-streamed he passes through the fleece; men cleanse him.

mantras.sanskrit: पुनानश्चमू जनयन्मतिं कविः सोमो देवेषु रण्यति । अपो वसानः परि गोभिरुत्तरः सीदन्वनेष्वव्यत ॥
mantras.transliteration: punānaścamū janayanmatiṃ kaviḥ somo deveṣu raṇyati | apo vasānaḥ pari gobhiruttaraḥ sīdanvaneṣvavyata ||

translations.english: Purified in the cups, exciting laudation, the sage Soma rejoices among the gods; clothed with the waters sitting in the wooden bowls, he is surrounded with the curds and milk.

mantras.sanskrit: तवाहं सोम रारण सख्य इन्दो दिवेदिवे । पुरूणि बभ्रो नि चरन्ति मामव परिधीँरति ताँ इहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tavāhaṃ soma rāraṇa sakhya indo divedive | purūṇi babhro ni caranti māmava paridhī~rati tā~ ihi ||

translations.english: In your friendship, Indu Soma, I have rejoiced day by day; many (rākṣasas) assail me, tawny-coloured (Soma); overcome these who surround me.

mantras.sanskrit: उताहं नक्तमुत सोम ते दिवा सख्याय बभ्र ऊधनि । घृणा तपन्तमति सूर्यं परः शकुना इव पप्तिम ॥
mantras.transliteration: utāhaṃ naktamuta soma te divā sakhyāya babhra ūdhani | ghṛṇā tapantamati sūryaṃ paraḥ śakunā iva paptima ||

translations.english: I (delight) in your presence, tawny-coloured Soma, both day and night, for the sake of your friendship may we soar like birds far beyond the sun blazing with your light.

mantras.sanskrit: मृज्यमानः सुहस्त्य समुद्रे वाचमिन्वसि । रयिं पिशङ्गं बहुलं पुरुस्पृहं पवमानाभ्यर्षसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: mṛjyamānaḥ suhastya samudre vācaminvasi | rayiṃ piśaṅgaṃ bahulaṃ puruspṛhaṃ pavamānābhyarṣasi ||

translations.english: Fair-fingered (Soma) being cleansed you utter a sound in the pitcher; you bring, Pavamāna, ample golden-hued much-coveted wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: मृजानो वारे पवमानो अव्यये वृषाव चक्रदो वने । देवानां सोम पवमान निष्कृतं गोभिरञ्जानो अर्षसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: mṛjāno vāre pavamāno avyaye vṛṣāva cakrado vane | devānāṃ soma pavamāna niṣkṛtaṃ gobhirañjāno arṣasi ||

translations.english: The showerer of benefits, cleansed and filtered in the woollen fleece, you cried aloud in the water; Soma Pavamāna, mixed with the curds and milk, you go to the prepared (station) of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: पवस्व वाजसातयेऽभि विश्वानि काव्या । त्वं समुद्रं प्रथमो वि धारयो देवेभ्यः सोम मत्सरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavasva vājasātaye'bhi viśvāni kāvyā | tvaṃ samudraṃ prathamo vi dhārayo devebhyaḥ soma matsaraḥ ||

translations.english: Flow, Soma, to all praises to procure food (for us); you, the exhilarator of the gods, are the chief supporter of the firmament.

mantras.sanskrit: स तू पवस्व परि पार्थिवं रजो दिव्या च सोम धर्मभिः । त्वां विप्रासो मतिभिर्विचक्षण शुभ्रं हिन्वन्ति धीतिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa tū pavasva pari pārthivaṃ rajo divyā ca soma dharmabhiḥ | tvāṃ viprāso matibhirvicakṣaṇa śubhraṃ hinvanti dhītibhiḥ ||

translations.english: Flow quickly, Soma, with your supports, to the terrestrial and celestial worlds; the sages express you radiant, O observer of all, with praises and with their fingers.

mantras.sanskrit: पवमाना असृक्षत पवित्रमति धारया । मरुत्वन्तो मत्सरा इन्द्रिया हया मेधामभि प्रयांसि च ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavamānā asṛkṣata pavitramati dhārayā | marutvanto matsarā indriyā hayā medhāmabhi prayāṃsi ca ||

translations.english: Your purified juices are let flow through the filter in a stream accompanied by the Maruts, exhilarating plural asing Indra, swift-moving, bringing praise and food.

mantras.sanskrit: अपो वसानः परि कोशमर्षतीन्दुर्हियानः सोतृभिः । जनयञ्ज्योतिर्मन्दना अवीवशद्गाः कृण्वानो न निर्णिजम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: apo vasānaḥ pari kośamarṣatīndurhiyānaḥ sotṛbhiḥ | janayañjyotirmandanā avīvaśadgāḥ kṛṇvāno na nirṇijam ||

translations.english: Indu clothed with waters effused by the worshippers rushes to the receptacle, genitive rating light, identifying its form with the (products of the) kine, he covets now (our) praises.

mantras.sanskrit: पवस्व मधुमत्तम इन्द्राय सोम क्रतुवित्तमो मदः । महि द्युक्षतमो मदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavasva madhumattama indrāya soma kratuvittamo madaḥ | mahi dyukṣatamo madaḥ ||

translations.english: Soma,who are most sweet-flavoured, most intelligent, the exhilarator, flow for Indra, the great, the most brilliant,the exhilarator.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य ते पीत्वा वृषभो वृषायतेऽस्य पीता स्वर्विदः । स सुप्रकेतो अभ्यक्रमीदिषोऽच्छा वाजं नैतशः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya te pītvā vṛṣabho vṛṣāyate'sya pītā svarvidaḥ | sa supraketo abhyakramīdiṣo'cchā vājaṃ naitaśaḥ ||

translations.english: By drinking whom the showerer Indra is invigorated, by drinking you who are the beholder of everything, the intelligent (Indra) reaches the viands (of the enemy) as a horse (reaches) the battle.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं ह्यङ्ग दैव्या पवमान जनिमानि द्युमत्तमः । अमृतत्वाय घोषयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ hyaṅga daivyā pavamāna janimāni dyumattamaḥ | amṛtatvāya ghoṣayaḥ ||

translations.english: For you, Pavamāna, who aremost brilliant quickly shout to the races of the gods for (the sake of their) immortality.

mantras.sanskrit: येना नवग्वो दध्यङ्ङपोर्णुते येन विप्रास आपिरे । देवानां सुम्ने अमृतस्य चारुणो येन श्रवांस्यानशुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yenā navagvo dadhyaṅṅaporṇute yena viprāsa āpire | devānāṃ sumne amṛtasya cāruṇo yena śravāṃsyānaśuḥ ||

translations.english: (You) through whom Dadhyañc tthe offerer of the nine days' rites opened (the cave), through whom the ṛṣis recovered (the stolen cows), through whom under the protection of the gods the worshippers obtained the sustenance of the delicious (ambrosial water).

mantras.sanskrit: एष स्य धारया सुतोऽव्यो वारेभिः पवते मदिन्तमः । क्रीळन्नूर्मिरपामिव ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa sya dhārayā suto'vyo vārebhiḥ pavate madintamaḥ | krīḷannūrmirapāmiva ||

translations.english: This (Soma) when effused flows most exhilarating through the woollen fleece, sporting like a wave of water.

mantras.sanskrit: य उस्रिया अप्या अन्तरश्मनो निर्गा अकृन्तदोजसा । अभि व्रजं तत्निषे गव्यमश्व्यं वर्मीव धृष्णवा रुज ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya usriyā apyā antaraśmano nirgā akṛntadojasā | abhi vrajaṃ tatniṣe gavyamaśvyaṃ varmīva dhṛṣṇavā ruja ||

translations.english: You who by your might extricated from the rock the quick-moving kine abiding in the waters, you have spread out a pasturage for cattle and horses; like a mailed (warrior) slay (the asuras), brave (Soma).

mantras.sanskrit: आ सोता परि षिञ्चताश्वं न स्तोममप्तुरं रजस्तुरम् । वनक्रक्षमुदप्रुतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā sotā pari ṣiñcatāśvaṃ na stomamapturaṃ rajasturam | vanakrakṣamudaprutam ||

translations.english: Pour forth (the Soma), sprinkle it round like a horse, adorable, dispenser of rain, dispenser of light, showerer of fluid, swimming in water.

mantras.sanskrit: सहस्रधारं वृषभं पयोवृधं प्रियं देवाय जन्मने । ऋतेन य ऋतजातो विवावृधे राजा देव ऋतं बृहत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sahasradhāraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ payovṛdhaṃ priyaṃ devāya janmane | ṛtena ya ṛtajāto vivāvṛdhe rājā deva ṛtaṃ bṛhat ||

translations.english: Thousand-streamed, showererof benefits, augmenter of water, affectionate; (pour it forth) for the race of the gods which water-born is fostered by the water, the king, the god, the true, the great.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि द्युम्नं बृहद्यश इषस्पते दिदीहि देव देवयुः । वि कोशं मध्यमं युव ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi dyumnaṃ bṛhadyaśa iṣaspate didīhi deva devayuḥ | vi kośaṃ madhyamaṃ yuva ||

translations.english: Divine (Soma) lord of viands, who are devoted to the gods, bestow upon us brilliant and abundant food; separate the mid-aerial receptacle.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वच्यस्व सुदक्ष चम्वोः सुतो विशां वह्निर्न विश्पतिः । वृष्टिं दिवः पवस्व रीतिमपां जिन्वा गविष्टये धियः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vacyasva sudakṣa camvoḥ suto viśāṃ vahnirna viśpatiḥ | vṛṣṭiṃ divaḥ pavasva rītimapāṃ jinvā gaviṣṭaye dhiyaḥ ||

translations.english: Come, powerful (Soma) effused into the cups, like a prince the sustainer of the people; pour the course of the waters, the rain fromheaven; accomplish the rites for the worshipper who seeks cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: एतमु त्यं मदच्युतं सहस्रधारं वृषभं दिवो दुहुः । विश्वा वसूनि बिभ्रतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: etamu tyaṃ madacyutaṃ sahasradhāraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ divo duhuḥ | viśvā vasūni bibhratam ||

translations.english: Him have they milked from heaven, the shedder of exhilarating juice, the thousand-streamed, the showerer (of benefits), bearing all treasures.

mantras.sanskrit: वृषा वि जज्ञे जनयन्नमर्त्यः प्रतपञ्ज्योतिषा तमः । स सुष्टुतः कविभिर्निर्णिजं दधे त्रिधात्वस्य दंससा ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣā vi jajñe janayannamartyaḥ pratapañjyotiṣā tamaḥ | sa suṣṭutaḥ kavibhirnirṇijaṃ dadhe tridhātvasya daṃsasā ||

translations.english: The showerer (of benefits) is manifested begetting (light) immortal, destroying the darkness with (his) radiance; glorified by the wise he has assumed his shining robe; the triple (oblation is supported) by his act.

mantras.sanskrit: स सुन्वे यो वसूनां यो रायामानेता य इळानाम् । सोमो यः सुक्षितीनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa sunve yo vasūnāṃ yo rāyāmānetā ya iḷānām | somo yaḥ sukṣitīnām ||

translations.english: The Soma has been effused who is the bringer of treasures, the bringer of riches, the bringer of food, the bringer of fair homes.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य न इन्द्रः पिबाद्यस्य मरुतो यस्य वार्यमणा भगः । आ येन मित्रावरुणा करामह एन्द्रमवसे महे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya na indraḥ pibādyasya maruto yasya vāryamaṇā bhagaḥ | ā yena mitrāvaruṇā karāmaha endramavase mahe ||

translations.english: Our (Soma) which Indra drinks, which the Maruts drink and Bhaga with Aryaman; through which we propitiate Mitra and Varuṇa and Indra, to obtain his powerful protection.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राय सोम पातवे नृभिर्यतः स्वायुधो मदिन्तमः । पवस्व मधुमत्तमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāya soma pātave nṛbhiryataḥ svāyudho madintamaḥ | pavasva madhumattamaḥ ||

translations.english: Soma, collected by the priests, well-armed, most exhilarating, most sweet-flavoured, flow for Indra to drink.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य हार्दि सोमधानमा विश समुद्रमिव सिन्धवः । जुष्टो मित्राय वरुणाय वायवे दिवो विष्टम्भ उत्तमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrasya hārdi somadhānamā viśa samudramiva sindhavaḥ | juṣṭo mitrāya varuṇāya vāyave divo viṣṭambha uttamaḥ ||

translations.english: Soma, enter the Somadhāna, Indra's heart, as the rivers (enter) the sea agreeable to Mitra, Varuṇa and Vāyu, the chief stay of heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: परि प्र धन्वेन्द्राय सोम स्वादुर्मित्राय पूष्णे भगाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari pra dhanvendrāya soma svādurmitrāya pūṣṇe bhagāya ||

translations.english: Flow, Soma who are sweet-flavoured, for Indra, Mitra, Pūṣan, and Bhaga.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्ते सोम सुतस्य पेयाः क्रत्वे दक्षाय विश्वे च देवाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraste soma sutasya peyāḥ kratve dakṣāya viśve ca devāḥ ||

translations.english: Soma, let Indra and all the gods drink of you when effused for intelligence and strength.

mantras.sanskrit: एवामृताय महे क्षयाय स शुक्रो अर्ष दिव्यः पीयूषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: evāmṛtāya mahe kṣayāya sa śukro arṣa divyaḥ pīyūṣaḥ ||

translations.english: So do you who are pure, divine, the beverage of all the gods, flow for immortality and a spacious abode.

mantras.sanskrit: पवस्व सोम महान्त्समुद्रः पिता देवानां विश्वाभि धाम ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavasva soma mahāntsamudraḥ pitā devānāṃ viśvābhi dhāma ||

translations.english: Flow, Soma, who are mighty, the shedder of juice the parent of the gods, towards all bodies.

mantras.sanskrit: शुक्रः पवस्व देवेभ्यः सोम दिवे पृथिव्यै शं च प्रजायै ॥
mantras.transliteration: śukraḥ pavasva devebhyaḥ soma dive pṛthivyai śaṃ ca prajāyai ||

translations.english: Soma, who are brilliant, flow for the gods and (give) joy to heaven and earth and all creatures.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवो धर्तासि शुक्रः पीयूषः सत्ये विधर्मन्वाजी पवस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: divo dhartāsi śukraḥ pīyūṣaḥ satye vidharmanvājī pavasva ||

translations.english: You are the upholder of heaven, radiant and good to drink; flow you who are strong, at the truthful sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: पवस्व सोम द्युम्नी सुधारो महामवीनामनु पूर्व्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavasva soma dyumnī sudhāro mahāmavīnāmanu pūrvyaḥ ||

translations.english: Do you, Soma, who are possessed of food, who have a copious stream, flow through the great sheep's hairs in due succession.

mantras.sanskrit: नृभिर्येमानो जज्ञानः पूतः क्षरद्विश्वानि मन्द्रः स्वर्वित् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nṛbhiryemāno jajñānaḥ pūtaḥ kṣaradviśvāni mandraḥ svarvit ||

translations.english: May, the Soma regulated by the priests, engendered, purified, exhilarating, all-knowing bring us all (riches).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्दुः पुनानः प्रजामुराणः करद्विश्वानि द्रविणानि नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: induḥ punānaḥ prajāmurāṇaḥ karadviśvāni draviṇāni naḥ ||

translations.english: May Indu, purified, extolling (the gods) bestow on us progeny and all kinds of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: पवस्व सोम क्रत्वे दक्षायाश्वो न निक्तो वाजी धनाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: pavasva soma kratve dakṣāyāśvo na nikto vājī dhanāya ||

translations.english: Flow, Soma, for intelligence, for strength, for wealth, strong and cleansed like a horse.

mantras.sanskrit: तं ते सोतारो रसं मदाय पुनन्ति सोमं महे द्युम्नाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ te sotāro rasaṃ madāya punanti somaṃ mahe dyumnāya ||

translations.english: (The priests) who press you purify your juice for exhilaration; (they purify) the Soma for abundant food.

mantras.sanskrit: शिशुं जज्ञानं हरिं मृजन्ति पवित्रे सोमं देवेभ्य इन्दुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śiśuṃ jajñānaṃ hariṃ mṛjanti pavitre somaṃ devebhya indum ||

translations.english: They cleanse the new-born infant, the green-tinted shining Soma, on the filter for the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्दुः पविष्ट चारुर्मदायापामुपस्थे कविर्भगाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: induḥ paviṣṭa cārurmadāyāpāmupasthe kavirbhagāya ||

translations.english: The auspicious sage Indu flows upon the lap of the waters for exhilaration and for wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: बिभर्ति चार्विन्द्रस्य नाम येन विश्वानि वृत्रा जघान ॥
mantras.transliteration: bibharti cārvindrasya nāma yena viśvāni vṛtrā jaghāna ||

translations.english: The auspicious (Soma) sustains Indra's body, by which he has slain all rākṣasas.

mantras.sanskrit: पिबन्त्यस्य विश्वे देवासो गोभिः श्रीतस्य नृभिः सुतस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: pibantyasya viśve devāso gobhiḥ śrītasya nṛbhiḥ sutasya ||

translations.english: The universal gods drink of it, effused by the priests, mixed with milk and curds.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सुवानो अक्षाः सहस्रधारस्तिरः पवित्रं वि वारमव्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra suvāno akṣāḥ sahasradhārastiraḥ pavitraṃ vi vāramavyam ||

translations.english: Being effused the Soma in a thousand streams flows through the sheep's-hair filter.

mantras.sanskrit: स वाज्यक्षाः सहस्ररेता अद्भिर्मृजानो गोभिः श्रीणानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa vājyakṣāḥ sahasraretā adbhirmṛjāno gobhiḥ śrīṇānaḥ ||

translations.english: The vigorous Soma flows in a thousand streams cleansed by the waters and mixing with the curds and milk.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सोम याहीन्द्रस्य कुक्षा नृभिर्येमानो अद्रिभिः सुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra soma yāhīndrasya kukṣā nṛbhiryemāno adribhiḥ sutaḥ ||

translations.english: Guided by the priests and effused with the stones go, Soma, to Indra's belly.

mantras.sanskrit: असर्जि वाजी तिरः पवित्रमिन्द्राय सोमः सहस्रधारः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asarji vājī tiraḥ pavitramindrāya somaḥ sahasradhāraḥ ||

translations.english: The vigorous thousand-streamed Soma has been sent through, the filter for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: अञ्जन्त्येनं मध्वो रसेनेन्द्राय वृष्ण इन्दुं मदाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: añjantyenaṃ madhvo rasenendrāya vṛṣṇa induṃ madāya ||

translations.english: They mix the Soma with the liquid of the sweet (milk) for Indra, the showerer (of benefits) for his exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: देवेभ्यस्त्वा वृथा पाजसेऽपो वसानं हरिं मृजन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: devebhyastvā vṛthā pājase'po vasānaṃ hariṃ mṛjanti ||

translations.english: They cleanse you readily, clothed with water, green-tinted, for the invigoration of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्दुरिन्द्राय तोशते नि तोशते श्रीणन्नुग्रो रिणन्नपः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indurindrāya tośate ni tośate śrīṇannugro riṇannapaḥ ||

translations.english: Indu is effused for Indra's, is effused downward-- fierce, mixing (with the milk), flowing (into) the water.

mantras.sanskrit: पर्यू षु प्र धन्व वाजसातये परि वृत्राणि सक्षणिः । द्विषस्तरध्या ऋणया न ईयसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: paryū ṣu pra dhanva vājasātaye pari vṛtrāṇi sakṣaṇiḥ | dviṣastaradhyā ṛṇayā na īyase ||

translations.english: Hasten, Soma, to bring us sustenance; gifted with endurance (attack our) foes; the acquitter of our debts, you approach to disperse our enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: अनु हि त्वा सुतं सोम मदामसि महे समर्यराज्ये । वाजाँ अभि पवमान प्र गाहसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: anu hi tvā sutaṃ soma madāmasi mahe samaryarājye | vājā~ abhi pavamāna pra gāhase ||

translations.english: In turn we glorify you, Soma, when effused; you attack the (hostile) forces, O Pavamāna, to (defend) your great sovereignty over men.

mantras.sanskrit: अजीजनो हि पवमान सूर्यं विधारे शक्मना पयः । गोजीरया रंहमाणः पुरंध्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: ajījano hi pavamāna sūryaṃ vidhāre śakmanā payaḥ | gojīrayā raṃhamāṇaḥ puraṃdhyā ||

translations.english: Pavamāna, by your might you ahve genitive rated the sun in (the firmament), the support of the water, hastening on with abundant wisdom that procures cattle (for your worshippers).

mantras.sanskrit: अजीजनो अमृत मर्त्येष्वाँ ऋतस्य धर्मन्नमृतस्य चारुणः । सदासरो वाजमच्छा सनिष्यदत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ajījano amṛta martyeṣvā~ ṛtasya dharmannamṛtasya cāruṇaḥ | sadāsaro vājamacchā saniṣyadat ||

translations.english: Immortal Soma, you have genitive rated (the sun) among mortals in (the firmament), the suppor tof the truthful auspicious ambrosia; streaming forth you goe to battle continually.

mantras.sanskrit: अभ्यभि हि श्रवसा ततर्दिथोत्सं न कं चिज्जनपानमक्षितम् । शर्याभिर्न भरमाणो गभस्त्योः ॥
