mantras.transliteration: abhyabhi hi śravasā tatardithotsaṃ na kaṃ cijjanapānamakṣitam | śaryābhirna bharamāṇo gabhastyoḥ ||

translations.english: You have burst open (the filter) with (your) food as (one bursts open) an inexhaustible fountain giving drink to the nation, like one taking up (water) with the fingers of his two hands.

mantras.sanskrit: आदीं के चित्पश्यमानास आप्यं वसुरुचो दिव्या अभ्यनूषत । वारं न देवः सविता व्यूर्णुते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ādīṃ ke citpaśyamānāsa āpyaṃ vasuruco divyā abhyanūṣata | vāraṃ na devaḥ savitā vyūrṇute ||

translations.english: Beholding him certain celestial Vasurucas praise him as a kinsman before the shining Savitā drives away the obstructing (darkness).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वे सोम प्रथमा वृक्तबर्हिषो महे वाजाय श्रवसे धियं दधुः । स त्वं नो वीर वीर्याय चोदय ॥
mantras.transliteration: tve soma prathamā vṛktabarhiṣo mahe vājāya śravase dhiyaṃ dadhuḥ | sa tvaṃ no vīra vīryāya codaya ||

translations.english: The chief (of men) having cut the sacred grass have fixed their minds, Soma, on you for abundant strength and food; do you, O hero, excite us to heroism.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवः पीयूषं पूर्व्यं यदुक्थ्यं महो गाहाद्दिव आ निरधुक्षत । इन्द्रमभि जायमानं समस्वरन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: divaḥ pīyūṣaṃ pūrvyaṃ yadukthyaṃ maho gāhāddiva ā niradhukṣata | indramabhi jāyamānaṃ samasvaran ||

translations.english: They have milked from heaven from the mighty deep the ancient Soma, the beverage (of the gods) of heaven, which is worthy of praise; they have praised it when genitive rated for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: अध यदिमे पवमान रोदसी इमा च विश्वा भुवनाभि मज्मना । यूथे न निष्ठा वृषभो वि तिष्ठसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha yadime pavamāna rodasī imā ca viśvā bhuvanābhi majmanā | yūthe na niṣṭhā vṛṣabho vi tiṣṭhase ||

translations.english: Since, Pavamāna, you by your might are chief over these two worlds and all these living beings, as a bull is ruler in a herd of kine.

mantras.sanskrit: सोमः पुनानो अव्यये वारे शिशुर्न क्रीळन्पवमानो अक्षाः । सहस्रधारः शतवाज इन्दुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: somaḥ punāno avyaye vāre śiśurna krīḷanpavamāno akṣāḥ | sahasradhāraḥ śatavāja induḥ ||

translations.english: Pavamāna Soma sporting like a child drops filtered through the woollen fleece, thousand-streamed, having the might of a hundred, radiant.

mantras.sanskrit: एष पुनानो मधुमाँ ऋतावेन्द्रायेन्दुः पवते स्वादुरूर्मिः । वाजसनिर्वरिवोविद्वयोधाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: eṣa punāno madhumā~ ṛtāvendrāyenduḥ pavate svādurūrmiḥ | vājasanirvarivovidvayodhāḥ ||

translations.english: This Soma juice undergoing purification, sweet-flavoured, holy, dropping; flows for Indra a sweet stream, bestowing food, dispensing wealth and life.

mantras.sanskrit: स पवस्व सहमानः पृतन्यून्त्सेधन्रक्षांस्यप दुर्गहाणि । स्वायुधः सासह्वान्त्सोम शत्रून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa pavasva sahamānaḥ pṛtanyūntsedhanrakṣāṃsyapa durgahāṇi | svāyudhaḥ sāsahvāntsoma śatrūn ||

translations.english: Flow, Soma, overcoming (our) enemies, driving away the rākṣasas who are difficult to approach, well-armed, triumphing over foes.

mantras.sanskrit: अया रुचा हरिण्या पुनानो विश्वा द्वेषांसि तरति स्वयुग्वभिः सूरो न स्वयुग्वभिः । धारा सुतस्य रोचते पुनानो अरुषो हरिः । विश्वा यद्रूपा परियात्यृक्वभिः सप्तास्येभिॠक्वभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayā rucā hariṇyā punāno viśvā dveṣāṃsi tarati svayugvabhiḥ sūro na svayugvabhiḥ | dhārā sutasya rocate punāno aruṣo hariḥ | viśvā yadrūpā pariyātyṛkvabhiḥ saptāsyebhiṝkvabhiḥ ||

translations.english: With this bright green-tinted stream Soma being filtered overcomes all enemies with the (juices) yoked to it, as the sun (overcomes the darkness) with the (rays) yoked to it; the stream of the effused (Soma) shines, the filtered green-tinted (Soma) is resplendent, which pervade all constellations, with the ṛkvans, with the seven-mouthed ṛkvans.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं त्यत्पणीनां विदो वसु सं मातृभिर्मर्जयसि स्व आ दम ऋतस्य धीतिभिर्दमे । परावतो न साम तद्यत्रा रणन्ति धीतयः । त्रिधातुभिररुषीभिर्वयो दधे रोचमानो वयो दधे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ tyatpaṇīnāṃ vido vasu saṃ mātṛbhirmarjayasi sva ā dama ṛtasya dhītibhirdame | parāvato na sāma tadyatrā raṇanti dhītayaḥ | tridhātubhiraruṣībhirvayo dadhe rocamāno vayo dadhe ||

translations.english: You did discover the wealth of the Paṇis, and are washed in your own house at the sacrifice by the mothers, the supporters of the sacrifice; as the hymn (is heard) from afar, so it (is heard by all, the hymn) in which the supporters (of the rite) rejoice; the shining (Soma) with its brilliant (waters), the supporters of the three (worlds), gives food, gives food (to the worshippers).

mantras.sanskrit: पूर्वामनु प्रदिशं याति चेकितत्सं रश्मिभिर्यतते दर्शतो रथो दैव्यो दर्शतो रथः । अग्मन्नुक्थानि पौंस्येन्द्रं जैत्राय हर्षयन् । वज्रश्च यद्भवथो अनपच्युता समत्स्वनपच्युता ॥
mantras.transliteration: pūrvāmanu pradiśaṃ yāti cekitatsaṃ raśmibhiryatate darśato ratho daivyo darśato rathaḥ | agmannukthāni pauṃsyendraṃ jaitrāya harṣayan | vajraśca yadbhavatho anapacyutā samatsvanapacyutā ||

translations.english: The intelligent Soma proceeds to the eastern quarter; (your) beautiful chariot, (your) celestial beautiful chariot meets the sun's rays; the manly praises advance to Indra and stimulate him to victory; (his) thunderbolt too (advances to him); so that you are invincible, invincible in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: नानानं वा उ नो धियो वि व्रतानि जनानाम् । तक्षा रिष्टं रुतं भिषग्ब्रह्मा सुन्वन्तमिच्छतीन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
mantras.transliteration: nānānaṃ vā u no dhiyo vi vratāni janānām | takṣā riṣṭaṃ rutaṃ bhiṣagbrahmā sunvantamicchatīndrāyendo pari srava ||

translations.english: Various are our acts, (various) are the occupations of men; the carpenter desires timber, the physician disease, the brāhmaṇa a worshipper who effuses Soma; flow, Indu for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: जरतीभिरोषधीभिः पर्णेभिः शकुनानाम् । कार्मारो अश्मभिर्द्युभिर्हिरण्यवन्तमिच्छतीन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
mantras.transliteration: jaratībhiroṣadhībhiḥ parṇebhiḥ śakunānām | kārmāro aśmabhirdyubhirhiraṇyavantamicchatīndrāyendo pari srava ||

translations.english: With dried plural nts (are arrows made), with the feathers of birds (and) with glistening stones; the smith seeks a man who has gold; flow, Indu, for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: कारुरहं ततो भिषगुपलप्रक्षिणी नना । नानाधियो वसूयवोऽनु गा इव तस्थिमेन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
mantras.transliteration: kārurahaṃ tato bhiṣagupalaprakṣiṇī nanā | nānādhiyo vasūyavo'nu gā iva tasthimendrāyendo pari srava ||

translations.english: I am the singer; papa is the physician, mamma throws the corn upon the grinding stones; having various occupations, desiring riches we remain (in the world) like cattle (in the stall); flow, Indu, for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्वो वोळ्हा सुखं रथं हसनामुपमन्त्रिणः । शेपो रोमण्वन्तौ भेदौ वारिन्मण्डूक इच्छतीन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvo voḷhā sukhaṃ rathaṃ hasanāmupamantriṇaḥ | śepo romaṇvantau bhedau vārinmaṇḍūka icchatīndrāyendo pari srava ||

translations.english: The draught horse (desire) a cart easy (to draw); those who invite guests (desire) merriment; the frog desires water; flow, Indu, for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: शर्यणावति सोममिन्द्रः पिबतु वृत्रहा । बलं दधान आत्मनि करिष्यन्वीर्यं महदिन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaryaṇāvati somamindraḥ pibatu vṛtrahā | balaṃ dadhāna ātmani kariṣyanvīryaṃ mahadindrāyendo pari srava ||

translations.english: Let Indra, the slayer of Vṛtra, quaff the Soma on the Śaryaṇāvat, infusing strength into himself, about to show great prowess; flow, Indu, for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: आ पवस्व दिशां पत आर्जीकात्सोम मीढ्वः । ऋतवाकेन सत्येन श्रद्धया तपसा सुत इन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā pavasva diśāṃ pata ārjīkātsoma mīḍhvaḥ | ṛtavākena satyena śraddhayā tapasā suta indrāyendo pari srava ||

translations.english: Soma, lord of the four regions, sprinkler (of benefits) flow from Ārjikā effused by a truth-speaking truthful (man) with faith and devotion; flow, Indu, for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: पर्जन्यवृद्धं महिषं तं सूर्यस्य दुहिताभरत् । तं गन्धर्वाः प्रत्यगृभ्णन्तं सोमे रसमादधुरिन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
mantras.transliteration: parjanyavṛddhaṃ mahiṣaṃ taṃ sūryasya duhitābharat | taṃ gandharvāḥ pratyagṛbhṇantaṃ some rasamādadhurindrāyendo pari srava ||

translations.english: The daughter of Sūrya brought the vast Soma large as a rain-cloud; the gandharva seized upon it and plural ced the juice in the Soma; flow, Indu, for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतं वदन्नृतद्युम्न सत्यं वदन्त्सत्यकर्मन् । श्रद्धां वदन्त्सोम राजन्धात्रा सोम परिष्कृत इन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtaṃ vadannṛtadyumna satyaṃ vadantsatyakarman | śraddhāṃ vadantsoma rājandhātrā soma pariṣkṛta indrāyendo pari srava ||

translations.english: Soma, the utterer of truth, radiant with truth, truth-speaking, truthful in act, speaking faith; lord (of worshippers), you are decorated by the upholder (of the rite); flow, Indu for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: सत्यमुग्रस्य बृहतः सं स्रवन्ति संस्रवाः । सं यन्ति रसिनो रसाः पुनानो ब्रह्मणा हर इन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
mantras.transliteration: satyamugrasya bṛhataḥ saṃ sravanti saṃsravāḥ | saṃ yanti rasino rasāḥ punāno brahmaṇā hara indrāyendo pari srava ||

translations.english: The united streams of you who are vast and truly formidable flow united; the juices of you the juicy one meet together; green-tinted (Soma), purified by holy prayer, Indu, flow for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्र ब्रह्मा पवमान छन्दस्यां वाचं वदन् । ग्राव्णा सोमे महीयते सोमेनानन्दं जनयन्निन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatra brahmā pavamāna chandasyāṃ vācaṃ vadan | grāvṇā some mahīyate somenānandaṃ janayannindrāyendo pari srava ||

translations.english: Wherever the Brahman, O purified (Soma), reciting the holy rhythmical text, engendering the delight (of the gods) by the Soma (expressed) with the grinding-stone, is reverenced, flow, Indu, for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्र ज्योतिरजस्रं यस्मिँल्लोके स्वर्हितम् । तस्मिन्मां धेहि पवमानामृते लोके अक्षित इन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatra jyotirajasraṃ yasmi~lloke svarhitam | tasminmāṃ dhehi pavamānāmṛte loke akṣita indrāyendo pari srava ||

translations.english: Where light is perpetual, in the world in which the sun is plural ced, in that immortal imperishable world plural ce me, Pavamāna; flow, Indu, for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्र राजा वैवस्वतो यत्रावरोधनं दिवः । यत्रामूर्यह्वतीरापस्तत्र माममृतं कृधीन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatra rājā vaivasvato yatrāvarodhanaṃ divaḥ | yatrāmūryahvatīrāpastatra māmamṛtaṃ kṛdhīndrāyendo pari srava ||

translations.english: Where Vivasvat's son is king, where the inner chamber of the sun (is), where these great waters (are), there make me immortal; flow, Indu, for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्रानुकामं चरणं त्रिनाके त्रिदिवे दिवः । लोका यत्र ज्योतिष्मन्तस्तत्र माममृतं कृधीन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatrānukāmaṃ caraṇaṃ trināke tridive divaḥ | lokā yatra jyotiṣmantastatra māmamṛtaṃ kṛdhīndrāyendo pari srava ||

translations.english: Where in the third heaven, in the third sphere, the sun wanders at will, where the regions are filled with light, there make me immortal; flow, Indu, for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्र कामा निकामाश्च यत्र ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपम् । स्वधा च यत्र तृप्तिश्च तत्र माममृतं कृधीन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatra kāmā nikāmāśca yatra bradhnasya viṣṭapam | svadhā ca yatra tṛptiśca tatra māmamṛtaṃ kṛdhīndrāyendo pari srava ||

translations.english: Where wishes and desires (are), where the region of the sun (is), where food and delight (are) found, there make me immortal; flow, Indu, for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्रानन्दाश्च मोदाश्च मुदः प्रमुद आसते । कामस्य यत्राप्ताः कामास्तत्र माममृतं कृधीन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatrānandāśca modāśca mudaḥ pramuda āsate | kāmasya yatrāptāḥ kāmāstatra māmamṛtaṃ kṛdhīndrāyendo pari srava ||

translations.english: Where there is happiness, plural asure, joy and enjoyment, where the wishes of the wishers are obtained, there make me immortal; flow, Indu, for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: य इन्दोः पवमानस्यानु धामान्यक्रमीत् । तमाहुः सुप्रजा इति यस्ते सोमाविधन्मन इन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya indoḥ pavamānasyānu dhāmānyakramīt | tamāhuḥ suprajā iti yaste somāvidhanmana indrāyendo pari srava ||

translations.english: (The brāhmaṇa) who attends to the stations of the filtered Soma-juice-- him men call rich in children, who applies his mind to you, Soma; flow, Indu for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋषे मन्त्रकृतां स्तोमैः कश्यपोद्वर्धयन्गिरः । सोमं नमस्य राजानं यो जज्ञे वीरुधां पतिरिन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛṣe mantrakṛtāṃ stomaiḥ kaśyapodvardhayangiraḥ | somaṃ namasya rājānaṃ yo jajñe vīrudhāṃ patirindrāyendo pari srava ||

translations.english: Ṛṣi Kaśyapa, raising your voice with the praises of the hymn-makers, adore the royal Soma who is born the lord of the growing (vīrūdhām); flow, Indu, for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: सप्त दिशो नानासूर्याः सप्त होतार ऋत्विजः । देवा आदित्या ये सप्त तेभिः सोमाभि रक्ष न इन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
mantras.transliteration: sapta diśo nānāsūryāḥ sapta hotāra ṛtvijaḥ | devā ādityā ye sapta tebhiḥ somābhi rakṣa na indrāyendo pari srava ||

translations.english: Seven (are) the quarters of the world with different suns, seven (are) the ministrant priests, seven are the divine Ādityas-- with these, Soma, protect us; flow, Indu, for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्ते राजञ्छृतं हविस्तेन सोमाभि रक्ष नः । अरातीवा मा नस्तारीन्मो च नः किं चनाममदिन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatte rājañchṛtaṃ havistena somābhi rakṣa naḥ | arātīvā mā nastārīnmo ca naḥ kiṃ canāmamadindrāyendo pari srava ||

translations.english: Protect us, royal Soma, with the oblation which has been cooked for you; let no enemy assail us, or harm anything of ours; flow, Indu, for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्रे बृहन्नुषसामूर्ध्वो अस्थान्निर्जगन्वान्तमसो ज्योतिषागात् । अग्निर्भानुना रुशता स्वङ्ग आ जातो विश्वा सद्मान्यप्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agre bṛhannuṣasāmūrdhvo asthānnirjaganvāntamaso jyotiṣāgāt | agnirbhānunā ruśatā svaṅga ā jāto viśvā sadmānyaprāḥ ||

translations.english: The great fire from beginning of dawn has sprung aloft, and coming forth from the darkness has comewith radiance. Agni, the bright-bodied, as soon as born, fills all dwellings with shining light.

mantras.sanskrit: स जातो गर्भो असि रोदस्योरग्ने चारुर्विभृत ओषधीषु । चित्रः शिशुः परि तमांस्यक्तून्प्र मातृभ्यो अधि कनिक्रदद्गाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa jāto garbho asi rodasyoragne cārurvibhṛta oṣadhīṣu | citraḥ śiśuḥ pari tamāṃsyaktūnpra mātṛbhyo adhi kanikradadgāḥ ||

translations.english: When born, you, O Agni, are the embryo of heaven and earth, beautiful, borne about in the plural nts;variegated, infantine, you disperse the noctural glooms; you issue roaring loudly from the maternal (sources).

mantras.sanskrit: विष्णुरित्था परममस्य विद्वाञ्जातो बृहन्नभि पाति तृतीयम् । आसा यदस्य पयो अक्रत स्वं सचेतसो अभ्यर्चन्त्यत्र ॥
mantras.transliteration: viṣṇuritthā paramamasya vidvāñjāto bṛhannabhi pāti tṛtīyam | āsā yadasya payo akrata svaṃ sacetaso abhyarcantyatra ||

translations.english: May he, who as soon as manifested is vast and wise, and thus (universally) pervading, defend (me),his third (manifestation); and when (the worshippers) ask with their mouths for his own water, animated by onepurpose, they praise him in this world.

mantras.sanskrit: अत उ त्वा पितुभृतो जनित्रीरन्नावृधं प्रति चरन्त्यन्नैः । ता ईं प्रत्येषि पुनरन्यरूपा असि त्वं विक्षु मानुषीषु होता ॥
mantras.transliteration: ata u tvā pitubhṛto janitrīrannāvṛdhaṃ prati carantyannaiḥ | tā īṃ pratyeṣi punaranyarūpā asi tvaṃ vikṣu mānuṣīṣu hotā ||

translations.english: Therefore, the genitive trices (of all things, the herbs), the cherishers (of all) with food, wait on you whoare the augmenter of food, with (sacrificial) viands; you visit them again, when they have assumed other forms,you among human beings the invoker (of the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: होतारं चित्ररथमध्वरस्य यज्ञस्ययज्ञस्य केतुं रुशन्तम् । प्रत्यर्धिं देवस्यदेवस्य मह्ना श्रिया त्वग्निमतिथिं जनानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: hotāraṃ citrarathamadhvarasya yajñasyayajñasya ketuṃ ruśantam | pratyardhiṃ devasyadevasya mahnā śriyā tvagnimatithiṃ janānām ||

translations.english: (We worship) Agni for prosperity, you, who are the invoker of the gods, the many-colouredconveyance of the saacrifice, the brilliant banner of every offering, the surpasser of every other deity in might, theguest of men.

mantras.sanskrit: स तु वस्त्राण्यध पेशनानि वसानो अग्निर्नाभा पृथिव्याः । अरुषो जातः पद इळायाः पुरोहितो राजन्यक्षीह देवान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa tu vastrāṇyadha peśanāni vasāno agnirnābhā pṛthivyāḥ | aruṣo jātaḥ pada iḷāyāḥ purohito rājanyakṣīha devān ||

translations.english: Arrayed in splendid garments, that Agni (abides) on the navel of the earth; do you, royal (Agni), whoare radiant, born on the foot-mark of Iḷā, offer worship here as Purohita to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: आ हि द्यावापृथिवी अग्न उभे सदा पुत्रो न मातरा ततन्थ । प्र याह्यच्छोशतो यविष्ठाथा वह सहस्येह देवान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā hi dyāvāpṛthivī agna ubhe sadā putro na mātarā tatantha | pra yāhyacchośato yaviṣṭhāthā vaha sahasyeha devān ||

translations.english: You have, ever sustained, Agni, both heaven and earth, as a son (supports) his parents; come,youngest (of the gods), to the presence of those desiring (you); son of strength, bring here the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: पिप्रीहि देवाँ उशतो यविष्ठ विद्वाँ ऋतूँॠतुपते यजेह । ये दैव्या ऋत्विजस्तेभिरग्ने त्वं होतॄणामस्यायजिष्ठः ॥
mantras.transliteration: piprīhi devā~ uśato yaviṣṭha vidvā~ ṛtū~ṝtupate yajeha | ye daivyā ṛtvijastebhiragne tvaṃ hotṝṇāmasyāyajiṣṭhaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, youngest (of the deities), propitiate the desiring gods; lord of seasons, cognizant of seasons,here offer worship; worship with those who are the priests of the celestials; among the ministrant priests you arethe best offerer.

mantras.sanskrit: वेषि होत्रमुत पोत्रं जनानां मन्धातासि द्रविणोदा ऋतावा । स्वाहा वयं कृणवामा हवींषि देवो देवान्यजत्वग्निरर्हन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: veṣi hotramuta potraṃ janānāṃ mandhātāsi draviṇodā ṛtāvā | svāhā vayaṃ kṛṇavāmā havīṃṣi devo devānyajatvagnirarhan ||

translations.english: Whether, Agni, you prefer the office of hotā or potā among men, you are wise, the giver of wealth,the observer of truth, let us offer the oblations with the (sacred) svāhā, and may the most excellent and divineAgni present them to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: आ देवानामपि पन्थामगन्म यच्छक्नवाम तदनु प्रवोळ्हुम् । अग्निर्विद्वान्त्स यजात्सेदु होता सो अध्वरान्त्स ऋतून्कल्पयाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā devānāmapi panthāmaganma yacchaknavāma tadanu pravoḷhum | agnirvidvāntsa yajātsedu hotā so adhvarāntsa ṛtūnkalpayāti ||

translations.english: May we pursue the path that leads to the gods to convey that (worship) which we may be able (tooffer). May that wise Agni minister, for he verily is the ministrant priest, and let him prescribe the ceremonies andthe seasons.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्वो वयं प्रमिनाम व्रतानि विदुषां देवा अविदुष्टरासः । अग्निष्टद्विश्वमा पृणाति विद्वान्येभिर्देवाँ ऋतुभिः कल्पयाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadvo vayaṃ pramināma vratāni viduṣāṃ devā aviduṣṭarāsaḥ | agniṣṭadviśvamā pṛṇāti vidvānyebhirdevā~ ṛtubhiḥ kalpayāti ||

translations.english: O gods, when we who are most ignorant neglect the offices addressed to you who are wise, may thewise Agni complete the whole by (appointing) those seasons by which he regulates the worship of the godṣ

mantras.sanskrit: यत्पाकत्रा मनसा दीनदक्षा न यज्ञस्य मन्वते मर्त्यासः । अग्निष्टद्धोता क्रतुविद्विजानन्यजिष्ठो देवाँ ऋतुशो यजाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatpākatrā manasā dīnadakṣā na yajñasya manvate martyāsaḥ | agniṣṭaddhotā kratuvidvijānanyajiṣṭho devā~ ṛtuśo yajāti ||

translations.english: Since men of feeble energies, with mind yet immature, are unacquainted with (the ritual of) thesacrifice, may Agni, the invoker (of the gods), the skilled in rites, well-knowing (what is to be done), the bestofferer, offer worship according to the fit season to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वेषां ह्यध्वराणामनीकं चित्रं केतुं जनिता त्वा जजान । स आ यजस्व नृवतीरनु क्षा स्पार्हा इषः क्षुमतीर्विश्वजन्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśveṣāṃ hyadhvarāṇāmanīkaṃ citraṃ ketuṃ janitā tvā jajāna | sa ā yajasva nṛvatīranu kṣā spārhā iṣaḥ kṣumatīrviśvajanyāḥ ||

translations.english: The progenitor has engendered you the chief of all sacrifices, variegated, illuminating (all); do youoffer (to the gods) the desirable all- sustaining praise-accompanied viands growing upon man-occupied earth.

mantras.sanskrit: यं त्वा द्यावापृथिवी यं त्वापस्त्वष्टा यं त्वा सुजनिमा जजान । पन्थामनु प्रविद्वान्पितृयाणं द्युमदग्ने समिधानो वि भाहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ tvā dyāvāpṛthivī yaṃ tvāpastvaṣṭā yaṃ tvā sujanimā jajāna | panthāmanu pravidvānpitṛyāṇaṃ dyumadagne samidhāno vi bhāhi ||

translations.english: Do you, Agni, whom the earth and heaven, whom the waters, whom Tvaṣṭā, the glorious creator,engendered, who are cognizant of the path, the road of the Pitṛs, shine brilliantly, being kindled.

mantras.sanskrit: इनो राजन्नरतिः समिद्धो रौद्रो दक्षाय सुषुमाँ अदर्शि । चिकिद्वि भाति भासा बृहतासिक्नीमेति रुशतीमपाजन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ino rājannaratiḥ samiddho raudro dakṣāya suṣumā~ adarśi | cikidvi bhāti bhāsā bṛhatāsiknīmeti ruśatīmapājan ||

translations.english: Royal Agni, (you are) the lord (of all). He who is the conveyer of the oblation, the radiant, theformidable, the recipient of the Soma, is manifested for the benefaction (of the worshipper); all-knowing, heshines forth with great lustre; he proceeds, scattering the glimmering darkness.

mantras.sanskrit: कृष्णां यदेनीमभि वर्पसा भूज्जनयन्योषां बृहतः पितुर्जाम् । ऊर्ध्वं भानुं सूर्यस्य स्तभायन्दिवो वसुभिररतिर्वि भाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: kṛṣṇāṃ yadenīmabhi varpasā bhūjjanayanyoṣāṃ bṛhataḥ piturjām | ūrdhvaṃ bhānuṃ sūryasya stabhāyandivo vasubhiraratirvi bhāti ||

translations.english: When he has overcome the dark departing (night) by his radiance, then, begetting the damsel, thedaughter of the great father, he shines in his course with the treasures of heaven, establishing above the light ofthe sun.

mantras.sanskrit: भद्रो भद्रया सचमान आगात्स्वसारं जारो अभ्येति पश्चात् । सुप्रकेतैर्द्युभिरग्निर्वितिष्ठन्रुशद्भिर्वर्णैरभि राममस्थात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhadro bhadrayā sacamāna āgātsvasāraṃ jāro abhyeti paścāt | supraketairdyubhiragnirvitiṣṭhanruśadbhirvarṇairabhi rāmamasthāt ||

translations.english: He has come auspicious, waited on by the auspicious (light); he afterwards approaches his sister(dawn) like a gallant; Agni, spreading everywhere, with omniscient rays overpowers the dark (night) the brilliantbeams.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य यामासो बृहतो न वग्नूनिन्धाना अग्नेः सख्युः शिवस्य । ईड्यस्य वृष्णो बृहतः स्वासो भामासो यामन्नक्तवश्चिकित्रे ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya yāmāso bṛhato na vagnūnindhānā agneḥ sakhyuḥ śivasya | īḍyasya vṛṣṇo bṛhataḥ svāso bhāmāso yāmannaktavaścikitre ||

translations.english: The blazing flames of that mighty Agni do not (deter) his adorers; the fierce flames of the friendlyauspicious adorable (Agni), the showerer of (benefits), the vast, the strong-mouthed, are visible in the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वना न यस्य भामासः पवन्ते रोचमानस्य बृहतः सुदिवः । ज्येष्ठेभिर्यस्तेजिष्ठैः क्रीळुमद्भिर्वर्षिष्ठेभिर्भानुभिर्नक्षति द्याम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: svanā na yasya bhāmāsaḥ pavante rocamānasya bṛhataḥ sudivaḥ | jyeṣṭhebhiryastejiṣṭhaiḥ krīḷumadbhirvarṣiṣṭhebhirbhānubhirnakṣati dyām ||

translations.english: The flames of whom, radiant, vast, bright-shining, go roaring like the winds; who covers the sky withmost excellent, most lustrous, most sportive and most mighty rays.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य शुष्मासो ददृशानपवेर्जेहमानस्य स्वनयन्नियुद्भिः । प्रत्नेभिर्यो रुशद्भिर्देवतमो वि रेभद्भिररतिर्भाति विभ्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya śuṣmāso dadṛśānapaverjehamānasya svanayanniyudbhiḥ | pratnebhiryo ruśadbhirdevatamo vi rebhadbhiraratirbhāti vibhvā ||

translations.english: Of him, bright-blazing and hastening (towards the gods), the fierce- burning flames roar with the horses(of Maruts); who shines mighty in his course, most divine, with ancient, brilliant, and loud-sounding (flames).

mantras.sanskrit: स आ वक्षि महि न आ च सत्सि दिवस्पृथिव्योररतिर्युवत्योः । अग्निः सुतुकः सुतुकेभिरश्वै रभस्वद्भी रभस्वाँ एह गम्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa ā vakṣi mahi na ā ca satsi divaspṛthivyoraratiryuvatyoḥ | agniḥ sutukaḥ sutukebhiraśvai rabhasvadbhī rabhasvā~ eha gamyāḥ ||

translations.english: Do you, great Agni, bring the gods to our (sacrifice); do you, the messenger of the young heaven andearth, sit down (at our sacrifice). Agni, who are easily found, who are rapid in movement, do you come with yourdocile and rapid steeds (to our rite).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ते यक्षि प्र त इयर्मि मन्म भुवो यथा वन्द्यो नो हवेषु । धन्वन्निव प्रपा असि त्वमग्न इयक्षवे पूरवे प्रत्न राजन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra te yakṣi pra ta iyarmi manma bhuvo yathā vandyo no haveṣu | dhanvanniva prapā asi tvamagna iyakṣave pūrave pratna rājan ||

translations.english: To you, Agni, I present the oblation; you repeat praise; that you, who are deserving of laudation maybe present at our invocations; ancient sovereign Agni, you are like a well of water in a desert, to the mandesirous of offering sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: यं त्वा जनासो अभि संचरन्ति गाव उष्णमिव व्रजं यविष्ठ । दूतो देवानामसि मर्त्यानामन्तर्महाँश्चरसि रोचनेन ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ tvā janāso abhi saṃcaranti gāva uṣṇamiva vrajaṃ yaviṣṭha | dūto devānāmasi martyānāmantarmahā~ścarasi rocanena ||

translations.english: Men have recourse to you, Agni, youngest (of the gods), as cattle hasten to the warm stall. You arethe messenger of the gods and of mortals; mighty, you proceed by the firmament between (heaven and earth). sustains you. You come, eager from above the firmament, by a downward path, and when released (after theoblation is offered), you desire to go back like cattle (to their stall).

mantras.sanskrit: शिशुं न त्वा जेन्यं वर्धयन्ती माता बिभर्ति सचनस्यमाना । धनोरधि प्रवता यासि हर्यञ्जिगीषसे पशुरिवावसृष्टः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śiśuṃ na tvā jenyaṃ vardhayantī mātā bibharti sacanasyamānā | dhanoradhi pravatā yāsi haryañjigīṣase paśurivāvasṛṣṭaḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: मूरा अमूर न वयं चिकित्वो महित्वमग्ने त्वमङ्ग वित्से । शये वव्रिश्चरति जिह्वयादन्रेरिह्यते युवतिं विश्पतिः सन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mūrā amūra na vayaṃ cikitvo mahitvamagne tvamaṅga vitse | śaye vavriścarati jihvayādanrerihyate yuvatiṃ viśpatiḥ san ||

translations.english: We, who are perplexed, know not, O unperplexed, intelligent one, your greatness; but you, Agni, verilyknow it. Wearing a form he reposes; he moves about devouring (the offering) with his tongue (of flame); beinglord of men, he licks up the mixed oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: कूचिज्जायते सनयासु नव्यो वने तस्थौ पलितो धूमकेतुः । अस्नातापो वृषभो न प्र वेति सचेतसो यं प्रणयन्त मर्ताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kūcijjāyate sanayāsu navyo vane tasthau palito dhūmaketuḥ | asnātāpo vṛṣabho na pra veti sacetaso yaṃ praṇayanta martāḥ ||

translations.english: Where is the new (Agni) born? He is present in the old (plural nt) and in the wood, grey-haired,smoke-bannered; though not needing ablution, he hastens to the water like a (thirsty) bull, he whom men withone consent propitiate.

mantras.sanskrit: तनूत्यजेव तस्करा वनर्गू रशनाभिर्दशभिरभ्यधीताम् । इयं ते अग्ने नव्यसी मनीषा युक्ष्वा रथं न शुचयद्भिरङ्गैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tanūtyajeva taskarā vanargū raśanābhirdaśabhirabhyadhītām | iyaṃ te agne navyasī manīṣā yukṣvā rathaṃ na śucayadbhiraṅgaiḥ ||

translations.english: As two daring robbers lurking in a forest seize (upon a traveller) with ten cords, (so the two handsseize upon the touchwood, with the ten fingers). This new praise, Agni, is addressed to you; attach thyself (to mysacrifice) with your radiant members; as (they harness horses) to a car.

mantras.sanskrit: ब्रह्म च ते जातवेदो नमश्चेयं च गीः सदमिद्वर्धनी भूत् । रक्षा णो अग्ने तनयानि तोका रक्षोत नस्तन्वो अप्रयुच्छन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: brahma ca te jātavedo namaśceyaṃ ca gīḥ sadamidvardhanī bhūt | rakṣā ṇo agne tanayāni tokā rakṣota nastanvo aprayucchan ||

translations.english: May this oblation, Jātavedas, this reverence, this praise, ever magnify you. Protect, Agni, our sons,our grandsons, and diligently defend our person ns.

mantras.sanskrit: एकः समुद्रो धरुणो रयीणामस्मद्धृदो भूरिजन्मा वि चष्टे । सिषक्त्यूधर्निण्योरुपस्थ उत्सस्य मध्ये निहितं पदं वेः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ekaḥ samudro dharuṇo rayīṇāmasmaddhṛdo bhūrijanmā vi caṣṭe | siṣaktyūdharniṇyorupastha utsasya madhye nihitaṃ padaṃ veḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, the sole capacious ocean of riches who is of many births beholds our hearts; he waits on thecloud in the neighbourhood of the hidden (firmament); go, Agni, to the appointed plural ce in the midst of the waterṣ

mantras.sanskrit: समानं नीळं वृषणो वसानाः सं जग्मिरे महिषा अर्वतीभिः । ऋतस्य पदं कवयो नि पान्ति गुहा नामानि दधिरे पराणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: samānaṃ nīḷaṃ vṛṣaṇo vasānāḥ saṃ jagmire mahiṣā arvatībhiḥ | ṛtasya padaṃ kavayo ni pānti guhā nāmāni dadhire parāṇi ||

translations.english: Great (worshippers), showerers (of oblations) enveloping with their hymns the common dark (fire),have associated (him) with his horses (to come to the sacrifice). Sages preserve (by oblations) the plural ce of thewater and support the divine rains in the vault (of heaven).

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतायिनी मायिनी सं दधाते मित्वा शिशुं जज्ञतुर्वर्धयन्ती । विश्वस्य नाभिं चरतो ध्रुवस्य कवेश्चित्तन्तुं मनसा वियन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtāyinī māyinī saṃ dadhāte mitvā śiśuṃ jajñaturvardhayantī | viśvasya nābhiṃ carato dhruvasya kaveścittantuṃ manasā viyantaḥ ||

translations.english: The two observers of truth, the two possessors of wisdom, (heaven and earth) sustain (this Agni);measuring the time, they have brought forth and reared a son; and (men), pondering in their minds on that navelof the universe, movable and immovable, the thread of the sage (Agni, are blessed with happiness).

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतस्य हि वर्तनयः सुजातमिषो वाजाय प्रदिवः सचन्ते । अधीवासं रोदसी वावसाने घृतैरन्नैर्वावृधाते मधूनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtasya hi vartanayaḥ sujātamiṣo vājāya pradivaḥ sacante | adhīvāsaṃ rodasī vāvasāne ghṛtairannairvāvṛdhāte madhūnām ||

translations.english: The ancient celebrators of the rite desiring (boons) wait on (Agni), rightly born, for the sake of food;the all-comprising heaven and earth cherish him, who abodes above the heavens, with the sacrificial butter andfood (produced) from the water.

mantras.sanskrit: सप्त स्वसॄररुषीर्वावशानो विद्वान्मध्व उज्जभारा दृशे कम् । अन्तर्येमे अन्तरिक्षे पुराजा इच्छन्वव्रिमविदत्पूषणस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: sapta svasṝraruṣīrvāvaśāno vidvānmadhva ujjabhārā dṛśe kam | antaryeme antarikṣe purājā icchanvavrimavidatpūṣaṇasya ||

translations.english: The wise Agni glorified (by his worshippers) has from the sacrifice raised aloft, for the readymanifestation of (all things), the seven radiant sister (flames); which when formerly engendered he restrained inthe firmament, until desirous of (adorers) he bestowed form upon the region of the earth.

mantras.sanskrit: सप्त मर्यादाः कवयस्ततक्षुस्तासामेकामिदभ्यंहुरो गात् । आयोर्ह स्कम्भ उपमस्य नीळे पथां विसर्गे धरुणेषु तस्थौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: sapta maryādāḥ kavayastatakṣustāsāmekāmidabhyaṃhuro gāt | āyorha skambha upamasya nīḷe pathāṃ visarge dharuṇeṣu tasthau ||

translations.english: The ise have established seven rules of conduct; he is a sinner who deviates from any one of theṃAgni is the obstructor of (that) man, he abides in the dwelling of his neighbour, in the region of the scattering ofthe rays, and in the recipient (waters).

mantras.sanskrit: असच्च सच्च परमे व्योमन्दक्षस्य जन्मन्नदितेरुपस्थे । अग्निर्ह नः प्रथमजा ऋतस्य पूर्व आयुनि वृषभश्च धेनुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asacca sacca parame vyomandakṣasya janmannaditerupasthe | agnirha naḥ prathamajā ṛtasya pūrva āyuni vṛṣabhaśca dhenuḥ ||

translations.english: Non-existent, and existent (is Agni) in the supreme heaven, in the birth-plural ce of Dakṣa, and in thepresence of Aditi; Agni is elder born to us (who enjoy the fruit) of the sacrifice; in the olden time he was the bulland the cow.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं स यस्य शर्मन्नवोभिरग्नेरेधते जरिताभिष्टौ । ज्येष्ठेभिर्यो भानुभिॠषूणां पर्येति परिवीतो विभावा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ sa yasya śarmannavobhiragneredhate jaritābhiṣṭau | jyeṣṭhebhiryo bhānubhiṝṣūṇāṃ paryeti parivīto vibhāvā ||

translations.english: This is that Agni by whose protections the worshipper (diligent) in sacrifice prospers in his dwelling;who is radiant, travels everywhere invested with the excellent splendours of his rays.

mantras.sanskrit: यो भानुभिर्विभावा विभात्यग्निर्देवेभिॠतावाजस्रः । आ यो विवाय सख्या सखिभ्योऽपरिह्वृतो अत्यो न सप्तिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo bhānubhirvibhāvā vibhātyagnirdevebhiṝtāvājasraḥ | ā yo vivāya sakhyā sakhibhyo'parihvṛto atyo na saptiḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, the observer of truth, the eternal who shines resplendent with celestial splendours, who comesuntiring like a swift horse, (bringing) friendly gifts to his friends.

mantras.sanskrit: ईशे यो विश्वस्या देववीतेरीशे विश्वायुरुषसो व्युष्टौ । आ यस्मिन्मना हवींष्यग्नावरिष्टरथः स्कभ्नाति शूषैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: īśe yo viśvasyā devavīterīśe viśvāyuruṣaso vyuṣṭau | ā yasminmanā havīṃṣyagnāvariṣṭarathaḥ skabhnāti śūṣaiḥ ||

translations.english: Who rules over every oblation to the gods, who all pervading rules at the opening of the dawn, and inwhom (the sacrificer), whose sacrifice is undisturbed by his foes, throws his choice oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: शूषेभिर्वृधो जुषाणो अर्कैर्देवाँ अच्छा रघुपत्वा जिगाति । मन्द्रो होता स जुह्वा यजिष्ठः सम्मिश्लो अग्निरा जिघर्ति देवान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śūṣebhirvṛdho juṣāṇo arkairdevā~ acchā raghupatvā jigāti | mandro hotā sa juhvā yajiṣṭhaḥ sammiślo agnirā jigharti devān ||

translations.english: Magnified by our oblations, propitiated by our praises, swift-moving, he proceeds to the presence ofthe gods; the adorable invoker of the deities, most entitled to worship, associated (with the gods). Agni presentsto them (the oblation) with the sacrificial ladle.

mantras.sanskrit: तमुस्रामिन्द्रं न रेजमानमग्निं गीर्भिर्नमोभिरा कृणुध्वम् । आ यं विप्रासो मतिभिर्गृणन्ति जातवेदसं जुह्वं सहानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamusrāmindraṃ na rejamānamagniṃ gīrbhirnamobhirā kṛṇudhvam | ā yaṃ viprāso matibhirgṛṇanti jātavedasaṃ juhvaṃ sahānām ||

translations.english: Bring before us with praises, and with adorations, the brilliant Agni, the bestower of enjoyments, as ifhe were Indra, him, whom wise worshippers praise with hymns as Jātavedas, the sacrificer of the victoriousGods.

mantras.sanskrit: सं यस्मिन्विश्वा वसूनि जग्मुर्वाजे नाश्वाः सप्तीवन्त एवैः । अस्मे ऊतीरिन्द्रवाततमा अर्वाचीना अग्न आ कृणुष्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ yasminviśvā vasūni jagmurvāje nāśvāḥ saptīvanta evaiḥ | asme ūtīrindravātatamā arvācīnā agna ā kṛṇuṣva ||

translations.english: O Agni, in whom all treasures are brought together as fleet horses are brought together in battle;bestow upon us protections even more effective than those of Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: अधा ह्यग्ने मह्ना निषद्या सद्यो जज्ञानो हव्यो बभूथ । तं ते देवासो अनु केतमायन्नधावर्धन्त प्रथमास ऊमाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhā hyagne mahnā niṣadyā sadyo jajñāno havyo babhūtha | taṃ te devāso anu ketamāyannadhāvardhanta prathamāsa ūmāḥ ||

translations.english: Since you, Agni, born in your glory and having sat down (on the altar), are immediately entitled to theoblation; therefore, the holy (priests) come to that your ensign and the mos worthy (worshippers) prosperprotected (by you).

mantras.sanskrit: स्वस्ति नो दिवो अग्ने पृथिव्या विश्वायुर्धेहि यजथाय देव । सचेमहि तव दस्म प्रकेतैरुरुष्या ण उरुभिर्देव शंसैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: svasti no divo agne pṛthivyā viśvāyurdhehi yajathāya deva | sacemahi tava dasma praketairuruṣyā ṇa urubhirdeva śaṃsaiḥ ||

translations.english: Divine Agni, bestow upon us from earth and heaven prosperity and abundant food, that we may beable to offer sacrifices. May we be associated, beautiful (Agni), with your indications (of favour); protect us, divineAgni, on account of our many hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: इमा अग्ने मतयस्तुभ्यं जाता गोभिरश्वैरभि गृणन्ति राधः । यदा ते मर्तो अनु भोगमानड्वसो दधानो मतिभिः सुजात ॥
mantras.transliteration: imā agne matayastubhyaṃ jātā gobhiraśvairabhi gṛṇanti rādhaḥ | yadā te marto anu bhogamānaḍvaso dadhāno matibhiḥ sujāta ||

translations.english: These hymns, addressed, Agni, to you, praise you for wealth, together with cattle and horses; when amortal obtains the means of enjoyment from the, (then), opulent and well-born Agni, you, who are the granter ofbenefits, (are celebrated) by our praises.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निं मन्ये पितरमग्निमापिमग्निं भ्रातरं सदमित्सखायम् । अग्नेरनीकं बृहतः सपर्यं दिवि शुक्रं यजतं सूर्यस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniṃ manye pitaramagnimāpimagniṃ bhrātaraṃ sadamitsakhāyam | agneranīkaṃ bṛhataḥ saparyaṃ divi śukraṃ yajataṃ sūryasya ||

translations.english: I regard Agni as a father, as a kinsman, as a brother, as a constant friend. I reverence the face of themighty Agni, radiant in heaven, adorable as the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: सिध्रा अग्ने धियो अस्मे सनुत्रीर्यं त्रायसे दम आ नित्यहोता । ऋतावा स रोहिदश्वः पुरुक्षुर्द्युभिरस्मा अहभिर्वाममस्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: sidhrā agne dhiyo asme sanutrīryaṃ trāyase dama ā nityahotā | ṛtāvā sa rohidaśvaḥ purukṣurdyubhirasmā ahabhirvāmamastu ||

translations.english: Agni, our earnest praises have been composed for you. May he whom you, the perpetual invoker ofthe gods, protect in the sacrificial chamber, be rich in sacrifices, the master of red steeds, the possessor ofabundant food; may the desirable (oblation) be granted him on shining days.

mantras.sanskrit: द्युभिर्हितं मित्रमिव प्रयोगं प्रत्नमृत्विजमध्वरस्य जारम् । बाहुभ्यामग्निमायवोऽजनन्त विक्षु होतारं न्यसादयन्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: dyubhirhitaṃ mitramiva prayogaṃ pratnamṛtvijamadhvarasya jāram | bāhubhyāmagnimāyavo'jananta vikṣu hotāraṃ nyasādayanta ||

translations.english: Men have genitive rated with their arms Agni, who is decorated with rays of light, selected as a friend, theancient priest, the accomplisher of the sacrifice, and they have appointed him among people, the invoker of thegods.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वयं यजस्व दिवि देव देवान्किं ते पाकः कृणवदप्रचेताः । यथायज ऋतुभिर्देव देवानेवा यजस्व तन्वं सुजात ॥
mantras.transliteration: svayaṃ yajasva divi deva devānkiṃ te pākaḥ kṛṇavadapracetāḥ | yathāyaja ṛtubhirdeva devānevā yajasva tanvaṃ sujāta ||

translations.english: Offer sacrifice thyself, divine (Agni), to the gods in heaven; what can one who is ignorant and ofimmature understanding effect for you? As in due seasons, divine (Agni), you have sacrificed to the gods, so doyou, well- engendered (Agni), sacrifice to your won person n.

mantras.sanskrit: भवा नो अग्नेऽवितोत गोपा भवा वयस्कृदुत नो वयोधाः । रास्वा च नः सुमहो हव्यदातिं त्रास्वोत नस्तन्वो अप्रयुच्छन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhavā no agne'vitota gopā bhavā vayaskṛduta no vayodhāḥ | rāsvā ca naḥ sumaho havyadātiṃ trāsvota nastanvo aprayucchan ||

translations.english: Be our protector, Agni, (in obvious peril); be our preserver (in unseen danger), be the provider andgiver of sustenance; bestow upon us, nightly Agni, the donation of oblations, and ever attentive, protect ourpersons.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र केतुना बृहता यात्यग्निरा रोदसी वृषभो रोरवीति । दिवश्चिदन्ताँ उपमाँ उदानळपामुपस्थे महिषो ववर्ध ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra ketunā bṛhatā yātyagnirā rodasī vṛṣabho roravīti | divaścidantā~ upamā~ udānaḷapāmupasthe mahiṣo vavardha ||

translations.english: Agni traverses heaven and earth with a vast banner; he roars (like) a bull; he spreads aloft over theremote and proximate (regions) of the sky; mighty, he increases in the lap of the water.

mantras.sanskrit: मुमोद गर्भो वृषभः ककुद्मानस्रेमा वत्सः शिमीवाँ अरावीत् । स देवतात्युद्यतानि कृण्वन्त्स्वेषु क्षयेषु प्रथमो जिगाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: mumoda garbho vṛṣabhaḥ kakudmānasremā vatsaḥ śimīvā~ arāvīt | sa devatātyudyatāni kṛṇvantsveṣu kṣayeṣu prathamo jigāti ||

translations.english: THe embryo (of heaven and earth), the showerer (of benefits), the glorious, rejoices; the excellentchild (of morn and eve), the celebrator of holy rites calls aloud; assiduous in exertions at the worship of the gods,he moves chief in his own abodes.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यो मूर्धानं पित्रोररब्ध न्यध्वरे दधिरे सूरो अर्णः । अस्य पत्मन्नरुषीरश्वबुध्ना ऋतस्य योनौ तन्वो जुषन्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yo mūrdhānaṃ pitrorarabdha nyadhvare dadhire sūro arṇaḥ | asya patmannaruṣīraśvabudhnā ṛtasya yonau tanvo juṣanta ||

translations.english: They have plural ced in the sacrifice the radiance of the powerful Agni, who seizes hold of the forehead ofhis parents, gratifying his cherished, radiant, and expanding limbs, in their course, in their chamber of sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: उषौषो हि वसो अग्रमेषि त्वं यमयोरभवो विभावा । ऋताय सप्त दधिषे पदानि जनयन्मित्रं तन्वे स्वायै ॥
mantras.transliteration: uṣauṣo hi vaso agrameṣi tvaṃ yamayorabhavo vibhāvā | ṛtāya sapta dadhiṣe padāni janayanmitraṃ tanve svāyai ||

translations.english: Opulent Agni, you precede dawn after dawn. You are the illuminator of the twin (day and night);engendering Mitra from your own person n, you retain seven plural ces for sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: भुवश्चक्षुर्मह ऋतस्य गोपा भुवो वरुणो यदृताय वेषि । भुवो अपां नपाज्जातवेदो भुवो दूतो यस्य हव्यं जुजोषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhuvaścakṣurmaha ṛtasya gopā bhuvo varuṇo yadṛtāya veṣi | bhuvo apāṃ napājjātavedo bhuvo dūto yasya havyaṃ jujoṣaḥ ||

translations.english: You are the eye, the protector of the great sacrifice; when you proceed to the rite, you are Varuṇa;you are the grandson of the waters, Jātavedas; you are the messenger (of him) whose oblation you enjoy.

mantras.sanskrit: भुवो यज्ञस्य रजसश्च नेता यत्रा नियुद्भिः सचसे शिवाभिः । दिवि मूर्धानं दधिषे स्वर्षां जिह्वामग्ने चकृषे हव्यवाहम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhuvo yajñasya rajasaśca netā yatrā niyudbhiḥ sacase śivābhiḥ | divi mūrdhānaṃ dadhiṣe svarṣāṃ jihvāmagne cakṛṣe havyavāham ||

translations.english: You are the leader of the sacrifice and sacrificial water to the plural ce in which you are associated withthe auspicious steeds of the wind; you sustain the all-enjoying (sun) as chief in heaven; you, Agni, make yourtongue the bearer of the oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य त्रितः क्रतुना वव्रे अन्तरिच्छन्धीतिं पितुरेवैः परस्य । सचस्यमानः पित्रोरुपस्थे जामि ब्रुवाण आयुधानि वेति ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya tritaḥ kratunā vavre antaricchandhītiṃ piturevaiḥ parasya | sacasyamānaḥ pitrorupasthe jāmi bruvāṇa āyudhāni veti ||

translations.english: Trita by (his own), desiring a share (of the sacrifice), for the sake of taking part in the exploit of thesupreme protector (of the world), chose (Indra as his friend); attended (by the priests) in the proximity of theparental heaven and earth, and reciting appropriate praise, he takes up his weapons.

mantras.sanskrit: स पित्र्याण्यायुधानि विद्वानिन्द्रेषित आप्त्यो अभ्ययुध्यत् । त्रिशीर्षाणं सप्तरश्मिं जघन्वान्त्वाष्ट्रस्य चिन्निः ससृजे त्रितो गाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa pitryāṇyāyudhāni vidvānindreṣita āptyo abhyayudhyat | triśīrṣāṇaṃ saptaraśmiṃ jaghanvāntvāṣṭrasya cinniḥ sasṛje trito gāḥ ||

translations.english: He, the son of the waters, incited by Indra, skilled in his paternal weapons, fought against (the enemy),and slew the seven-rayed, three-headed (asura); then Trita set free the cows of the son of Tvaṣṭā.

mantras.sanskrit: भूरीदिन्द्र उदिनक्षन्तमोजोऽवाभिनत्सत्पतिर्मन्यमानम् । त्वाष्ट्रस्य चिद्विश्वरूपस्य गोनामाचक्राणस्त्रीणि शीर्षा परा वर्क् ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhūrīdindra udinakṣantamojo'vābhinatsatpatirmanyamānam | tvāṣṭrasya cidviśvarūpasya gonāmācakrāṇastrīṇi śīrṣā parā vark ||

translations.english: Indra, the protector of the virtuous, crushed the arrogant (foe), attaining vast strenth; shouting, he cutoff the three heads of the multiform son of Tvaṣṭā (the lord) of cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: आपो हि ष्ठा मयोभुवस्ता न ऊर्जे दधातन । महे रणाय चक्षसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuvastā na ūrje dadhātana | mahe raṇāya cakṣase ||

translations.english: Since, waters, you are the sources of happiness, grant to us to enjoy abundance, and great anddelightful perception.

mantras.sanskrit: यो वः शिवतमो रसस्तस्य भाजयतेह नः । उशतीरिव मातरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo vaḥ śivatamo rasastasya bhājayateha naḥ | uśatīriva mātaraḥ ||

translations.english: Give us to partake in this world of your most auspicious Soma, like affectionate mothers.

mantras.sanskrit: तस्मा अरं गमाम वो यस्य क्षयाय जिन्वथ । आपो जनयथा च नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tasmā araṃ gamāma vo yasya kṣayāya jinvatha | āpo janayathā ca naḥ ||

translations.english: Let us quickly have recourse to you, for that your (faculty) of removing (sin) by which you gladden us;waters, bestow upon us progeny.

mantras.sanskrit: शं नो देवीरभिष्टय आपो भवन्तु पीतये । शं योरभि स्रवन्तु नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaṃ no devīrabhiṣṭaya āpo bhavantu pītaye | śaṃ yorabhi sravantu naḥ ||

translations.english: May the divine water be propitious to our worship, (may they be good) for our drinking; may they flowround us, and be our health and safety.

mantras.sanskrit: ईशाना वार्याणां क्षयन्तीश्चर्षणीनाम् । अपो याचामि भेषजम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: īśānā vāryāṇāṃ kṣayantīścarṣaṇīnām | apo yācāmi bheṣajam ||

translations.english: Waters, sovereigns of precious (treasures), granters of habitations to men, I solicit of you medicine (formy infirmities).

mantras.sanskrit: अप्सु मे सोमो अब्रवीदन्तर्विश्वानि भेषजा । अग्निं च विश्वशम्भुवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: apsu me somo abravīdantarviśvāni bheṣajā | agniṃ ca viśvaśambhuvam ||

translations.english: Soma has declared to me; all medicaments, as well as Agni, the benefactor of the universe, are in thewaters.

mantras.sanskrit: आपः पृणीत भेषजं वरूथं तन्वे मम । ज्योक्च सूर्यं दृशे ॥
mantras.transliteration: āpaḥ pṛṇīta bheṣajaṃ varūthaṃ tanve mama | jyokca sūryaṃ dṛśe ||

translations.english: Waters, bring to perfection, all disease-dispelling medicaments for the good of my body, that I maybehold the Sun.

mantras.sanskrit: इदमापः प्र वहत यत्किं च दुरितं मयि । यद्वाहमभिदुद्रोह यद्वा शेप उतानृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: idamāpaḥ pra vahata yatkiṃ ca duritaṃ mayi | yadvāhamabhidudroha yadvā śepa utānṛtam ||

translations.english: Waters, take away whatever sin has been (found) in me, whether I have (knowingly) done wrong, orhave pronounced imprecations (against holy men), or have spoken untruth.

mantras.sanskrit: आपो अद्यान्वचारिषं रसेन समगस्महि । पयस्वानग्न आ गहि तं मा सं सृज वर्चसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: āpo adyānvacāriṣaṃ rasena samagasmahi | payasvānagna ā gahi taṃ mā saṃ sṛja varcasā ||

translations.english: I have this day entered into the waters; we have mingled with their essence. Agni, abiding in thewaters approach, and fill me (thus bathed) with vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: ओ चित्सखायं सख्या ववृत्यां तिरः पुरू चिदर्णवं जगन्वान् । पितुर्नपातमा दधीत वेधा अधि क्षमि प्रतरं दीध्यानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: o citsakhāyaṃ sakhyā vavṛtyāṃ tiraḥ purū cidarṇavaṃ jaganvān | piturnapātamā dadhīta vedhā adhi kṣami prataraṃ dīdhyānaḥ ||

translations.english: (Yami speaks). I invite my friend to friendship, having come over the vast and desert ocean; mayVedhas, after reflecting, plural ce in the earth the offsprig (of you) the father, edowed with excellent qualities.

mantras.sanskrit: न ते सखा सख्यं वष्ट्येतत्सलक्ष्मा यद्विषुरूपा भवाति । महस्पुत्रासो असुरस्य वीरा दिवो धर्तार उर्विया परि ख्यन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: na te sakhā sakhyaṃ vaṣṭyetatsalakṣmā yadviṣurūpā bhavāti | mahasputrāso asurasya vīrā divo dhartāra urviyā pari khyan ||

translations.english: (Yama speaks). Your friend desires not this friendship, for although of one origin, she is of differentform; the hero sons of the great asura (are) the upholders of heaven, enjoying vast renown.

mantras.sanskrit: उशन्ति घा ते अमृतास एतदेकस्य चित्त्यजसं मर्त्यस्य । नि ते मनो मनसि धाय्यस्मे जन्युः पतिस्तन्वमा विविश्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uśanti ghā te amṛtāsa etadekasya cittyajasaṃ martyasya | ni te mano manasi dhāyyasme janyuḥ patistanvamā viviśyāḥ ||

translations.english: (Yami speaks). The immortals take plural asure in (a union) like this which is forbidden to every mortal; letyour mind then concur with mine, and as the progenitor (of all) was the husband (of his daughter), do you enjoymy person n.

mantras.sanskrit: न यत्पुरा चकृमा कद्ध नूनमृता वदन्तो अनृतं रपेम । गन्धर्वो अप्स्वप्या च योषा सा नो नाभिः परमं जामि तन्नौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: na yatpurā cakṛmā kaddha nūnamṛtā vadanto anṛtaṃ rapema | gandharvo apsvapyā ca yoṣā sā no nābhiḥ paramaṃ jāmi tannau ||

translations.english: (Yama speak). We have not done what was done formerly; for how can we who speak truth, utter nowthat which is untrue? Gandharva (the sun) was in the watery (firmament), and the water was his bride. She is ourcommon hence our near affinity.

mantras.sanskrit: गर्भे नु नौ जनिता दम्पती कर्देवस्त्वष्टा सविता विश्वरूपः । नकिरस्य प्र मिनन्ति व्रतानि वेद नावस्य पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
mantras.transliteration: garbhe nu nau janitā dampatī kardevastvaṣṭā savitā viśvarūpaḥ | nakirasya pra minanti vratāni veda nāvasya pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

translations.english: (Yami speaks). The divine omniform genitive rator Tvaṣṭā, the progenitor, made us two husband andwife, even in the womb: none frustrate his undertaking; earth and heaven are conscious of this our (union).

mantras.sanskrit: को अस्य वेद प्रथमस्याह्नः क ईं ददर्श क इह प्र वोचत् । बृहन्मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धाम कदु ब्रव आहनो वीच्या नॄन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ko asya veda prathamasyāhnaḥ ka īṃ dadarśa ka iha pra vocat | bṛhanmitrasya varuṇasya dhāma kadu brava āhano vīcyā nṝn ||

translations.english: (Yama speaks). Who knows anything of this (his) first day (of existence)? Who has beheld it? Whohas here revealed it? The dwelling of Mitra and of Varuṇa is vast. What say you, who punishes men with hell?

mantras.sanskrit: यमस्य मा यम्यं काम आगन्त्समाने योनौ सहशेय्याय । जायेव पत्ये तन्वं रिरिच्यां वि चिद्वृहेव रथ्येव चक्रा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yamasya mā yamyaṃ kāma āgantsamāne yonau sahaśeyyāya | jāyeva patye tanvaṃ riricyāṃ vi cidvṛheva rathyeva cakrā ||

translations.english: (Yami speaks). The desire of Yama has approached me Yamī, to lie with him in the same bed; I willabandon my person n as a wife to her husband; let us exert ourselves in union like the two wheels of a wagon.

mantras.sanskrit: न तिष्ठन्ति न नि मिषन्त्येते देवानां स्पश इह ये चरन्ति । अन्येन मदाहनो याहि तूयं तेन वि वृह रथ्येव चक्रा ॥
mantras.transliteration: na tiṣṭhanti na ni miṣantyete devānāṃ spaśa iha ye caranti | anyena madāhano yāhi tūyaṃ tena vi vṛha rathyeva cakrā ||

translations.english: (Yama speaks). The spies of the gods, which wander upon earth, never stop, never close their eyeṣAssociate quickly, destructress, with some other than with me, and exert yourselves in union, like the two wheelsof a wagon.

mantras.sanskrit: रात्रीभिरस्मा अहभिर्दशस्येत्सूर्यस्य चक्षुर्मुहुरुन्मिमीयात् । दिवा पृथिव्या मिथुना सबन्धू यमीर्यमस्य बिभृयादजामि ॥
mantras.transliteration: rātrībhirasmā ahabhirdaśasyetsūryasya cakṣurmuhurunmimīyāt | divā pṛthivyā mithunā sabandhū yamīryamasya bibhṛyādajāmi ||

translations.english: (Yami speaks). To him (Yam) let every worshipper sacrifice both day and night, on him let the eye ofthe Sun repeatedly rise; (for him may) the kindred pair (day and night unite) with heaven and earth. Yama willadhere to the non- affinity of Yama.

mantras.sanskrit: आ घा ता गच्छानुत्तरा युगानि यत्र जामयः कृणवन्नजामि । उप बर्बृहि वृषभाय बाहुमन्यमिच्छस्व सुभगे पतिं मत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā ghā tā gacchānuttarā yugāni yatra jāmayaḥ kṛṇavannajāmi | upa barbṛhi vṛṣabhāya bāhumanyamicchasva subhage patiṃ mat ||

translations.english: (Yama speaks). The subsequent ages will come, when sisters will choose one who is not a brother (asa husband); therefore, auspicious one, choose another husband than me, and make your arm a pillow for yourmate.

mantras.sanskrit: किं भ्रातासद्यदनाथं भवाति किमु स्वसा यन्निॠतिर्निगच्छात् । काममूता बह्वेतद्रपामि तन्वा मे तन्वं सं पिपृग्धि ॥
mantras.transliteration: kiṃ bhrātāsadyadanāthaṃ bhavāti kimu svasā yanniṝtirnigacchāt | kāmamūtā bahvetadrapāmi tanvā me tanvaṃ saṃ pipṛgdhi ||

translations.english: (Yami speaks). Is he a brother whose sister has no lord? Is she a sister (whose brother) misfortuneapproaches? Overcome by desire, I strongly urge this one request; unite your person n with mine.

mantras.sanskrit: न वा उ ते तन्वा तन्वं सं पपृच्यां पापमाहुर्यः स्वसारं निगच्छात् । अन्येन मत्प्रमुदः कल्पयस्व न ते भ्राता सुभगे वष्ट्येतत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: na vā u te tanvā tanvaṃ saṃ papṛcyāṃ pāpamāhuryaḥ svasāraṃ nigacchāt | anyena matpramudaḥ kalpayasva na te bhrātā subhage vaṣṭyetat ||

translations.english: (Yama speaks). I will not unite my person n with yours; they call him who approaches a sister, a sinneṛEnjoy plural asure with some other than me; your brother, auspicious one, has no such desire.

mantras.sanskrit: बतो बतासि यम नैव ते मनो हृदयं चाविदाम । अन्या किल त्वां कक्ष्येव युक्तं परि ष्वजाते लिबुजेव वृक्षम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: bato batāsi yama naiva te mano hṛdayaṃ cāvidāma | anyā kila tvāṃ kakṣyeva yuktaṃ pari ṣvajāte libujeva vṛkṣam ||

translations.english: (Yami speaks). Alas, Yama, you are feeble; we understand not your mind or your heart. Some otherfemale embraces you as a girth a horse, or as a creeper a tree.

mantras.sanskrit: अन्यमू षु त्वं यम्यन्य उ त्वां परि ष्वजाते लिबुजेव वृक्षम् । तस्य वा त्वं मन इच्छा स वा तवाधा कृणुष्व संविदं सुभद्राम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: anyamū ṣu tvaṃ yamyanya u tvāṃ pari ṣvajāte libujeva vṛkṣam | tasya vā tvaṃ mana icchā sa vā tavādhā kṛṇuṣva saṃvidaṃ subhadrām ||

translations.english: (Yama speaks). Do you, Yamī, embrace another; and let another embrace you as a creeper a tree;seek his affection, let him seek you; and make a happy union.

mantras.sanskrit: वृषा वृष्णे दुदुहे दोहसा दिवः पयांसि यह्वो अदितेरदाभ्यः । विश्वं स वेद वरुणो यथा धिया स यज्ञियो यजतु यज्ञियाँ ऋतून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣā vṛṣṇe duduhe dohasā divaḥ payāṃsi yahvo aditeradābhyaḥ | viśvaṃ sa veda varuṇo yathā dhiyā sa yajñiyo yajatu yajñiyā~ ṛtūn ||

translations.english: The great, the unconquerable (Agni), the showerer, milks openly with a (great) milking the streams (ofprosperity) from heaven for the unwearying sacrificer; like Varuṇa, he knows everything by his understanding;may he who is skilled in sacrifice observe the sacrificial seasona.

mantras.sanskrit: रपद्गन्धर्वीरप्या च योषणा नदस्य नादे परि पातु मे मनः । इष्टस्य मध्ये अदितिर्नि धातु नो भ्राता नो ज्येष्ठः प्रथमो वि वोचति ॥
mantras.transliteration: rapadgandharvīrapyā ca yoṣaṇā nadasya nāde pari pātu me manaḥ | iṣṭasya madhye aditirni dhātu no bhrātā no jyeṣṭhaḥ prathamo vi vocati ||

translations.english: The Gandharvī and the water-consecrated feminine nine oblation praise Agni; may he be favourable tothe thought of me, raising my voice in his praise; may Agni plural ce us in the midst of the sacrifice; the chief (of theworshipers), our elder brother, repeats his various laudations.

mantras.sanskrit: सो चिन्नु भद्रा क्षुमती यशस्वत्युषा उवास मनवे स्वर्वती । यदीमुशन्तमुशतामनु क्रतुमग्निं होतारं विदथाय जीजनन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: so cinnu bhadrā kṣumatī yaśasvatyuṣā uvāsa manave svarvatī | yadīmuśantamuśatāmanu kratumagniṃ hotāraṃ vidathāya jījanan ||

translations.english: The very auspicious, resounding, famous Dawn, ascends bringing the sun to man; when for thesacrifice after the worship they give birth to that Agni, the desirer, the invoker of the desiring (gods).

mantras.sanskrit: अध त्यं द्रप्सं विभ्वं विचक्षणं विराभरदिषितः श्येनो अध्वरे । यदी विशो वृणते दस्ममार्या अग्निं होतारमध धीरजायत ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha tyaṃ drapsaṃ vibhvaṃ vicakṣaṇaṃ virābharadiṣitaḥ śyeno adhvare | yadī viśo vṛṇate dasmamāryā agniṃ hotāramadha dhīrajāyata ||

translations.english: The hawk sent (by Agni) to the sacrifice has brought the dripping copious all-seeing (Soma) libatioṇWhen the Arya people choose the victorious Agni as the ministrant priest, then the sacred rite is celebrateḍ

mantras.sanskrit: सदासि रण्वो यवसेव पुष्यते होत्राभिरग्ने मनुषः स्वध्वरः । विप्रस्य वा यच्छशमान उक्थ्यं वाजं ससवाँ उपयासि भूरिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sadāsi raṇvo yavaseva puṣyate hotrābhiragne manuṣaḥ svadhvaraḥ | viprasya vā yacchaśamāna ukthyaṃ vājaṃ sasavā~ upayāsi bhūribhiḥ ||

translations.english: You, Agni, are ever plural asing (to your worshippers), as pasture satisfies (the herds); bewell-worshipped with man's sacrifices; if commending the praise of the wise, and partaking of the (sacrificial)food, you come with many (divinities of the rite).

mantras.sanskrit: उदीरय पितरा जार आ भगमियक्षति हर्यतो हृत्त इष्यति । विवक्ति वह्निः स्वपस्यते मखस्तविष्यते असुरो वेपते मती ॥
mantras.transliteration: udīraya pitarā jāra ā bhagamiyakṣati haryato hṛtta iṣyati | vivakti vahniḥ svapasyate makhastaviṣyate asuro vepate matī ||

translations.english: Wake up the parents, as the Sun his splendour; (the worshipper) desires to offer worship to (thedeities) who are plural ased by it; with all his heart he wishes (to do so); he desires to repeat (your praise); thebearer (of the oblation) is anxious to effect the good work; the sacrifice longs for augmentation, the prudent(sacrificer) trembles in his thoughts.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्ते अग्ने सुमतिं मर्तो अक्षत्सहसः सूनो अति स प्र शृण्वे । इषं दधानो वहमानो अश्वैरा स द्युमाँ अमवान्भूषति द्यून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaste agne sumatiṃ marto akṣatsahasaḥ sūno ati sa pra śṛṇve | iṣaṃ dadhāno vahamāno aśvairā sa dyumā~ amavānbhūṣati dyūn ||

translations.english: Agni, son of strength, the mortal who obtains your favour is widely celebrated; possessing abundantfood, and being conveyed by horses, illustrious and vigorous he graces the days of his existence.

mantras.sanskrit: यदग्न एषा समितिर्भवाति देवी देवेषु यजता यजत्र । रत्ना च यद्विभजासि स्वधावो भागं नो अत्र वसुमन्तं वीतात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadagna eṣā samitirbhavāti devī deveṣu yajatā yajatra | ratnā ca yadvibhajāsi svadhāvo bhāgaṃ no atra vasumantaṃ vītāt ||

translations.english: When, adorable Agni, this united praise is resplendent among the adorable gods, and when you,bearer of the oblatio, apportion the precious (treasures), then allot to us a valuable share. bring to us the heaven and earth, the daughters of the divine (Prajāpati), let none of the gods be absent, and doyou yourself be present.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रुधी नो अग्ने सदने सधस्थे युक्ष्वा रथममृतस्य द्रवित्नुम् । आ नो वह रोदसी देवपुत्रे माकिर्देवानामप भूरिह स्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śrudhī no agne sadane sadhasthe yukṣvā rathamamṛtasya dravitnum | ā no vaha rodasī devaputre mākirdevānāmapa bhūriha syāḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: द्यावा ह क्षामा प्रथमे ऋतेनाभिश्रावे भवतः सत्यवाचा । देवो यन्मर्तान्यजथाय कृण्वन्त्सीदद्धोता प्रत्यङ्स्वमसुं यन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dyāvā ha kṣāmā prathame ṛtenābhiśrāve bhavataḥ satyavācā | devo yanmartānyajathāya kṛṇvantsīdaddhotā pratyaṅsvamasuṃ yan ||

translations.english: Heaven and earth, declarers of truth, principal (of things), be present at the invocation, associatedwith the rite, when the divine (Agni), exciting mortals to sacrifice, sits down in their presence as the invoker (ofthe gods) putting forth his flame.

mantras.sanskrit: देवो देवान्परिभूॠतेन वहा नो हव्यं प्रथमश्चिकित्वान् । धूमकेतुः समिधा भाऋजीको मन्द्रो होता नित्यो वाचा यजीयान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: devo devānparibhūṝtena vahā no havyaṃ prathamaścikitvān | dhūmaketuḥ samidhā bhāṛjīko mandro hotā nityo vācā yajīyān ||

translations.english: Do you, bright (Agni), surrounding the gods, carry our oblation with due rites; you, who are the chief(of the deities), the wise, the smoke-bannered, fuel-kindled, straight-flaming, adorable, the invoker, the constantsacrificer with prayer.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वावृग्देवस्यामृतं यदी गोरतो जातासो धारयन्त उर्वी । विश्वे देवा अनु तत्ते यजुर्गुर्दुहे यदेनी दिव्यं घृतं वाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: svāvṛgdevasyāmṛtaṃ yadī gorato jātāso dhārayanta urvī | viśve devā anu tatte yajurgurduhe yadenī divyaṃ ghṛtaṃ vāḥ ||

translations.english: When the self-aggregated ambrosia of the divine Agni is genitive rated fromhis radiance, then theproducts from it sustain both heaven and earth, all the worshippers glorify this your oblation, the celestial nutriouswater which your white lustre milks forth.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्चामि वां वर्धायापो घृतस्नू द्यावाभूमी शृणुतं रोदसी मे । अहा यद्द्यावोऽसुनीतिमयन्मध्वा नो अत्र पितरा शिशीताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: arcāmi vāṃ vardhāyāpo ghṛtasnū dyāvābhūmī śṛṇutaṃ rodasī me | ahā yaddyāvo'sunītimayanmadhvā no atra pitarā śiśītām ||

translations.english: I worship you, waters that pour forth ghī, and you, heaven and earth, for your increase; hear me, youworlds; when worshippers at the daily or nightly rite proceed to their pious purpose, then may the parents (of all)sanctify us with ambrosia.

mantras.sanskrit: किं स्विन्नो राजा जगृहे कदस्याति व्रतं चकृमा को वि वेद । मित्रश्चिद्धि ष्मा जुहुराणो देवाञ्छ्लोको न यातामपि वाजो अस्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: kiṃ svinno rājā jagṛhe kadasyāti vrataṃ cakṛmā ko vi veda | mitraściddhi ṣmā juhurāṇo devāñchloko na yātāmapi vājo asti ||

translations.english: But will the royal Agni accept our oblation? Have we duly performed our vows to him? Who decides?As a friend affectionately invited, so let our praise now proceed to the gods; together with the sacrificial food thatis left over.

mantras.sanskrit: दुर्मन्त्वत्रामृतस्य नाम सलक्ष्मा यद्विषुरूपा भवाति । यमस्य यो मनवते सुमन्त्वग्ने तमृष्व पाह्यप्रयुच्छन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: durmantvatrāmṛtasya nāma salakṣmā yadviṣurūpā bhavāti | yamasya yo manavate sumantvagne tamṛṣva pāhyaprayucchan ||

translations.english: Hard to understand is the nature of the immortal, for although of one origin, she is of a different form;cherish him diligently, great Agni, who understands Yama's nature easy to be understood.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्मिन्देवा विदथे मादयन्ते विवस्वतः सदने धारयन्ते । सूर्ये ज्योतिरदधुर्मास्यक्तून्परि द्योतनिं चरतो अजस्रा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasmindevā vidathe mādayante vivasvataḥ sadane dhārayante | sūrye jyotiradadhurmāsyaktūnpari dyotaniṃ carato ajasrā ||

translations.english: In him the gods find plural asure at the sacrifice; they seat themselves on the altar of the sacrificer. Theyplaced light in the sun; beams in the moon; and these untiring shed their light around.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्मिन्देवा मन्मनि संचरन्त्यपीच्ये न वयमस्य विद्म । मित्रो नो अत्रादितिरनागान्त्सविता देवो वरुणाय वोचत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasmindevā manmani saṃcarantyapīcye na vayamasya vidma | mitro no atrāditiranāgāntsavitā devo varuṇāya vocat ||

translations.english: When he, the all-illumining, is there, the gods assemble; but when he is concealed, we know not (hisabode); so at this sacrifice, let Mitra and Aditi and Savitā proclaim us to Varuṇa as free from sin.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रुधी नो अग्ने सदने सधस्थे युक्ष्वा रथममृतस्य द्रवित्नुम् । आ नो वह रोदसी देवपुत्रे माकिर्देवानामप भूरिह स्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śrudhī no agne sadane sadhasthe yukṣvā rathamamṛtasya dravitnum | ā no vaha rodasī devaputre mākirdevānāmapa bhūriha syāḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: युजे वां ब्रह्म पूर्व्यं नमोभिर्वि श्लोक एतु पथ्येव सूरेः । शृण्वन्तु विश्वे अमृतस्य पुत्रा आ ये धामानि दिव्यानि तस्थुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuje vāṃ brahma pūrvyaṃ namobhirvi śloka etu pathyeva sūreḥ | śṛṇvantu viśve amṛtasya putrā ā ye dhāmāni divyāni tasthuḥ ||

translations.english: I load you two with sacred offerings, repeating an ancient prayer; may the sound (of your approach)reach (the gods) like the path of the worshipper, may all the sons of the immortal (Prajāpati) who inhabit thecelestial regions hear (the sound).

mantras.sanskrit: यमे इव यतमाने यदैतं प्र वां भरन्मानुषा देवयन्तः । आ सीदतं स्वमु लोकं विदाने स्वासस्थे भवतमिन्दवे नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yame iva yatamāne yadaitaṃ pra vāṃ bharanmānuṣā devayantaḥ | ā sīdataṃ svamu lokaṃ vidāne svāsasthe bhavatamindave naḥ ||

translations.english: When you two came, like twins, busily engaged, then devout worshipper brought you forward;knowing your plural ce there abide and be fair storehouses for our Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: पञ्च पदानि रुपो अन्वरोहं चतुष्पदीमन्वेमि व्रतेन । अक्षरेण प्रति मिम एतामृतस्य नाभावधि सं पुनामि ॥
mantras.transliteration: pañca padāni rupo anvarohaṃ catuṣpadīmanvemi vratena | akṣareṇa prati mima etāmṛtasya nābhāvadhi saṃ punāmi ||

translations.english: I make the five stages of the sacrifice ascend; I take four steps by pious observances; with the sacredsyllable, I perfect this (adoration); I purify (the Soma) on the navel of the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: देवेभ्यः कमवृणीत मृत्युं प्रजायै कममृतं नावृणीत । बृहस्पतिं यज्ञमकृण्वत ऋषिं प्रियां यमस्तन्वं प्रारिरेचीत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: devebhyaḥ kamavṛṇīta mṛtyuṃ prajāyai kamamṛtaṃ nāvṛṇīta | bṛhaspatiṃ yajñamakṛṇvata ṛṣiṃ priyāṃ yamastanvaṃ prārirecīt ||

translations.english: Whom has he selected as the slayer of the gods? Whom has he not selected as non-slayer of theabove mentioned are necessarily present while the business of the bringing of the oblation is in progress, yamadoes not send any of hie men as the destroyer. Another translation: What death did he choose for the gods, whatimmortality did he not choose for men? i.e., Yama ordained that gods should not die, and that men should receiveimmortality; Yama preserves our loved bodies: prārirecit = takes away (from death), mṛtyoḥ saka- śātpariharati; 'ric' is here used in the sense of taking away; the meaning is: he does not take our life away as aconsequence of a fault arising from a defect in our worship].

mantras.sanskrit: सप्त क्षरन्ति शिशवे मरुत्वते पित्रे पुत्रासो अप्यवीवतन्नृतम् । उभे इदस्योभयस्य राजत उभे यतेते उभयस्य पुष्यतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sapta kṣaranti śiśave marutvate pitre putrāso apyavīvatannṛtam | ubhe idasyobhayasya rājata ubhe yatete ubhayasya puṣyataḥ ||

translations.english: The seven (metres) offer laudation to the glorious, the adorable parent, (the Soma), his sons (thepriests) utter his true (praise); you both are lords of both (men and gods), you both exert yourselves and are thenourishers of both (men and gods).

mantras.sanskrit: परेयिवांसं प्रवतो महीरनु बहुभ्यः पन्थामनुपस्पशानम् । वैवस्वतं संगमनं जनानां यमं राजानं हविषा दुवस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: pareyivāṃsaṃ pravato mahīranu bahubhyaḥ panthāmanupaspaśānam | vaivasvataṃ saṃgamanaṃ janānāṃ yamaṃ rājānaṃ haviṣā duvasya ||

translations.english: Worship with oblations from Yama, king (of the Pitṛs), son of Vivasvat, the aggregation of mankind,who conducts those who are virtuous over the earth, and opens to many the path (of heaven).

mantras.sanskrit: यमो नो गातुं प्रथमो विवेद नैषा गव्यूतिरपभर्तवा उ । यत्रा नः पूर्वे पितरः परेयुरेना जज्ञानाः पथ्या अनु स्वाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yamo no gātuṃ prathamo viveda naiṣā gavyūtirapabhartavā u | yatrā naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ pareyurenā jajñānāḥ pathyā anu svāḥ ||

translations.english: Yama, the chief (of all), knows our well-being; this pasture no one can take from us; by the road bywhich our forefathers have gone, all who are born (proceed) along the paths they have made for themselveṣ

mantras.sanskrit: मातली कव्यैर्यमो अङ्गिरोभिर्बृहस्पतिॠक्वभिर्वावृधानः । याँश्च देवा वावृधुर्ये च देवान्त्स्वाहान्ये स्वधयान्ये मदन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: mātalī kavyairyamo aṅgirobhirbṛhaspatiṝkvabhirvāvṛdhānaḥ | yā~śca devā vāvṛdhurye ca devāntsvāhānye svadhayānye madanti ||

translations.english: Mātalin prospers with the Kavyas; Yama with the Aṅgirasas; Bṛhaspati with the Ṛkvans; they whomthe gods augment, and they who augment the gods, these rejoice in Svāhā, those in the Svadhā.

mantras.sanskrit: इमं यम प्रस्तरमा हि सीदाङ्गिरोभिः पितृभिः संविदानः । आ त्वा मन्त्राः कविशस्ता वहन्त्वेना राजन्हविषा मादयस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: imaṃ yama prastaramā hi sīdāṅgirobhiḥ pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidānaḥ | ā tvā mantrāḥ kaviśastā vahantvenā rājanhaviṣā mādayasva ||

translations.english: Yama, who are associated with the Aṅgirasa Pitṛs, sit down at this sacrifice; may the prayers recitedby the priests bring you here; be exhilarated, Sovereign, (Yam), by this oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: अङ्गिरोभिरा गहि यज्ञियेभिर्यम वैरूपैरिह मादयस्व । विवस्वन्तं हुवे यः पिता तेऽस्मिन्यज्ञे बर्हिष्या निषद्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: aṅgirobhirā gahi yajñiyebhiryama vairūpairiha mādayasva | vivasvantaṃ huve yaḥ pitā te'sminyajñe barhiṣyā niṣadya ||

translations.english: Come here, Yama, with the venerable multiform Aṅgirasas, and be exhilarated; I summon Vivasvat,who is your father, to this sacrifice; be seated on the sacred grass (delight the sacrificer).

mantras.sanskrit: अङ्गिरसो नः पितरो नवग्वा अथर्वाणो भृगवः सोम्यासः । तेषां वयं सुमतौ यज्ञियानामपि भद्रे सौमनसे स्याम ॥
mantras.transliteration: aṅgiraso naḥ pitaro navagvā atharvāṇo bhṛgavaḥ somyāsaḥ | teṣāṃ vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyānāmapi bhadre saumanase syāma ||

translations.english: The Aṅgirasas, the Atharvas, the Bhṛgus, who are entitled to the Soma, are our recent progenitors;may we ever have a plural ce in the favour of these venerable (pitrṣ); may we be ever held in their auspiciousregard.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रेहि प्रेहि पथिभिः पूर्व्येभिर्यत्रा नः पूर्वे पितरः परेयुः । उभा राजाना स्वधया मदन्ता यमं पश्यासि वरुणं च देवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: prehi prehi pathibhiḥ pūrvyebhiryatrā naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ pareyuḥ | ubhā rājānā svadhayā madantā yamaṃ paśyāsi varuṇaṃ ca devam ||

translations.english: Depart, depart, by the former paths by which our forefathers have departed; there shall you behold thetwo monarchs Yama and the divine Varuṇa rejoicing in the Svadhā.

mantras.sanskrit: सं गच्छस्व पितृभिः सं यमेनेष्टापूर्तेन परमे व्योमन् । हित्वायावद्यं पुनरस्तमेहि सं गच्छस्व तन्वा सुवर्चाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ gacchasva pitṛbhiḥ saṃ yameneṣṭāpūrtena parame vyoman | hitvāyāvadyaṃ punarastamehi saṃ gacchasva tanvā suvarcāḥ ||

translations.english: Be united with the Pitṛs, with Yama, and with the fulfilment of your wishes in the highest heaven;discarding iniquity, return to your abode, and unite yourself to a luminous body.

mantras.sanskrit: अपेत वीत वि च सर्पतातोऽस्मा एतं पितरो लोकमक्रन् । अहोभिरद्भिरक्तुभिर्व्यक्तं यमो ददात्यवसानमस्मै ॥
mantras.transliteration: apeta vīta vi ca sarpatāto'smā etaṃ pitaro lokamakran | ahobhiradbhiraktubhirvyaktaṃ yamo dadātyavasānamasmai ||

translations.english: Depart from hence, begone, go far off, (evil spirits); the Pitṛs have assigned this plural ce to him, yamahas given him a plural ce of cremation consecrated by days, streams and nights. To him-- (the departedworshipper].

mantras.sanskrit: अति द्रव सारमेयौ श्वानौ चतुरक्षौ शबलौ साधुना पथा । अथा पितॄन्त्सुविदत्राँ उपेहि यमेन ये सधमादं मदन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ati drava sārameyau śvānau caturakṣau śabalau sādhunā pathā | athā pitṝntsuvidatrā~ upehi yamena ye sadhamādaṃ madanti ||

translations.english: Pass by a secure path beyond the two spotted four-eyed dogs, the progeny of Saramā, and join thewise Pitṛs who rejoice joyfully with Yama.

mantras.sanskrit: यौ ते श्वानौ यम रक्षितारौ चतुरक्षौ पथिरक्षी नृचक्षसौ । ताभ्यामेनं परि देहि राजन्त्स्वस्ति चास्मा अनमीवं च धेहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yau te śvānau yama rakṣitārau caturakṣau pathirakṣī nṛcakṣasau | tābhyāmenaṃ pari dehi rājantsvasti cāsmā anamīvaṃ ca dhehi ||

translations.english: Entrust him, O king, to your two dogs, which are your protectors, Yama, the four-eyed guardians of theroad, renowned by men, and grant him prosperity and health.

mantras.sanskrit: उरूणसावसुतृपा उदुम्बलौ यमस्य दूतौ चरतो जनाँ अनु । तावस्मभ्यं दृशये सूर्याय पुनर्दातामसुमद्येह भद्रम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: urūṇasāvasutṛpā udumbalau yamasya dūtau carato janā~ anu | tāvasmabhyaṃ dṛśaye sūryāya punardātāmasumadyeha bhadram ||

translations.english: The messengers of Yama, broad-nosed, and of exceeding strength, and satiating themselves with thelife (of mortals), hunt mankind; may they allow us this day a prosperous existence here, that we may look uponthe sun.

mantras.sanskrit: यमाय सोमं सुनुत यमाय जुहुता हविः । यमं ह यज्ञो गच्छत्यग्निदूतो अरंकृतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yamāya somaṃ sunuta yamāya juhutā haviḥ | yamaṃ ha yajño gacchatyagnidūto araṃkṛtaḥ ||

translations.english: Pour out the Soma for Yama; to Yama offer the oblation, the decorated sacrifice of which Agni is themessenger proceeds to Yama.

mantras.sanskrit: यमाय घृतवद्धविर्जुहोत प्र च तिष्ठत । स नो देवेष्वा यमद्दीर्घमायुः प्र जीवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yamāya ghṛtavaddhavirjuhota pra ca tiṣṭhata | sa no deveṣvā yamaddīrghamāyuḥ pra jīvase ||

translations.english: Offer the oblation of clarified butter to Yama, and stand near (to the altar); it is he who among the godsgives us a long life to live.

mantras.sanskrit: यमाय मधुमत्तमं राज्ञे हव्यं जुहोतन । इदं नम ऋषिभ्यः पूर्वजेभ्यः पूर्वेभ्यः पथिकृद्भ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yamāya madhumattamaṃ rājñe havyaṃ juhotana | idaṃ nama ṛṣibhyaḥ pūrvajebhyaḥ pūrvebhyaḥ pathikṛdbhyaḥ ||

translations.english: Offer to the royal Yama this most sweet oblation; (let) this our adoration (be addressed) to the ancientsages, the first followers of (virtuous) paths.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिकद्रुकेभिः पतति षळुर्वीरेकमिद्बृहत् । त्रिष्टुब्गायत्री छन्दांसि सर्वा ता यम आहिता ॥
mantras.transliteration: trikadrukebhiḥ patati ṣaḷurvīrekamidbṛhat | triṣṭubgāyatrī chandāṃsi sarvā tā yama āhitā ||

translations.english: (Yama) acquires the three trikadruka saacrifices; the six earths, the one great (moving world); thetriṣṭubh, gāyatrī, all the sacred metres converge in Yama.

mantras.sanskrit: उदीरतामवर उत्परास उन्मध्यमाः पितरः सोम्यासः । असुं य ईयुरवृका ऋतज्ञास्ते नोऽवन्तु पितरो हवेषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: udīratāmavara utparāsa unmadhyamāḥ pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ | asuṃ ya īyuravṛkā ṛtajñāste no'vantu pitaro haveṣu ||

translations.english: Let the lower, the upper, the intermediate Pitṛs, rise up, accepting the Soma libation; may thoseprogenitors who, unlike wolves, acknowledging our offerings, have come to preserve our lives, protect us uponour invocations.

mantras.sanskrit: इदं पितृभ्यो नमो अस्त्वद्य ये पूर्वासो य उपरास ईयुः । ये पार्थिवे रजस्या निषत्ता ये वा नूनं सुवृजनासु विक्षु ॥
mantras.transliteration: idaṃ pitṛbhyo namo astvadya ye pūrvāso ya uparāsa īyuḥ | ye pārthive rajasyā niṣattā ye vā nūnaṃ suvṛjanāsu vikṣu ||

translations.english: Let this our adoration be today addressed to those Pitṛs our predecessors, to those our successors,who have departed (to the world of the manes); to those who are seated in the terrestrial sphere, to those whoare present among opulent people.

mantras.sanskrit: आहं पितॄन्त्सुविदत्राँ अवित्सि नपातं च विक्रमणं च विष्णोः । बर्हिषदो ये स्वधया सुतस्य भजन्त पित्वस्त इहागमिष्ठाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: āhaṃ pitṝntsuvidatrā~ avitsi napātaṃ ca vikramaṇaṃ ca viṣṇoḥ | barhiṣado ye svadhayā sutasya bhajanta pitvasta ihāgamiṣṭhāḥ ||

translations.english: I have brought to my presence the Pitṛs who are well cognizant (of my worship), the infallibility, andfood of the effused (Soma) with the sacrificial cake.

mantras.sanskrit: बर्हिषदः पितर ऊत्यर्वागिमा वो हव्या चकृमा जुषध्वम् । त आ गतावसा शंतमेनाथा नः शं योररपो दधात ॥
mantras.transliteration: barhiṣadaḥ pitara ūtyarvāgimā vo havyā cakṛmā juṣadhvam | ta ā gatāvasā śaṃtamenāthā naḥ śaṃ yorarapo dadhāta ||

translations.english: Pitṛs, Barhiṣads, protect (us who are) in your presence; we have made these oblations for you,accept them; come with your most felicitous protection, and bestow upon us health and happiness; and pardonfrom sin.

mantras.sanskrit: उपहूताः पितरः सोम्यासो बर्हिष्येषु निधिषु प्रियेषु । त आ गमन्तु त इह श्रुवन्त्वधि ब्रुवन्तु तेऽवन्त्वस्मान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: upahūtāḥ pitaraḥ somyāso barhiṣyeṣu nidhiṣu priyeṣu | ta ā gamantu ta iha śruvantvadhi bruvantu te'vantvasmān ||

translations.english: May the Pitṛs who are entitled to the Soma come, when invoked by us, to the agreeable treasuresconnected with the sacred grass; let them here listen (to our praises), let them speak (their approbation in reply);let them protect us.

mantras.sanskrit: आच्या जानु दक्षिणतो निषद्येमं यज्ञमभि गृणीत विश्वे । मा हिंसिष्ट पितरः केन चिन्नो यद्व आगः पुरुषता कराम ॥
mantras.transliteration: ācyā jānu dakṣiṇato niṣadyemaṃ yajñamabhi gṛṇīta viśve | mā hiṃsiṣṭa pitaraḥ kena cinno yadva āgaḥ puruṣatā karāma ||

translations.english: Having sat down on the right side withbended knee, do you all accept this sacrifice. Harm us notPitṛs, for any offence which through human (infirmity) we may have committed towards you.

mantras.sanskrit: आसीनासो अरुणीनामुपस्थे रयिं धत्त दाशुषे मर्त्याय । पुत्रेभ्यः पितरस्तस्य वस्वः प्र यच्छत त इहोर्जं दधात ॥
mantras.transliteration: āsīnāso aruṇīnāmupasthe rayiṃ dhatta dāśuṣe martyāya | putrebhyaḥ pitarastasya vasvaḥ pra yacchata ta ihorjaṃ dadhāta ||

translations.english: Seated in the proximity of the radiant (flames of the altar), bestow riches on the mortal donor (of theoblation); give wealth, Pitṛs, to his sons; do you who are present grant us vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: ये नः पूर्वे पितरः सोम्यासोऽनूहिरे सोमपीथं वसिष्ठाः । तेभिर्यमः संरराणो हवींष्युशन्नुशद्भिः प्रतिकाममत्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ somyāso'nūhire somapīthaṃ vasiṣṭhāḥ | tebhiryamaḥ saṃrarāṇo havīṃṣyuśannuśadbhiḥ pratikāmamattu ||

translations.english: May Yama, being propitiated, desirous (of the offering), partake at plural asure of the oblations along withthose our ancient progenitors of the Saumyas, the possessors of great wealth, who also desire it, and whoconveyed the Soma (to the gods and to the Pitṛs) in order.

mantras.sanskrit: ये तातृषुर्देवत्रा जेहमाना होत्राविदः स्तोमतष्टासो अर्कैः । आग्ने याहि सुविदत्रेभिरर्वाङ्सत्यैः कव्यैः पितृभिर्घर्मसद्भिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye tātṛṣurdevatrā jehamānā hotrāvidaḥ stomataṣṭāso arkaiḥ | āgne yāhi suvidatrebhirarvāṅsatyaiḥ kavyaiḥ pitṛbhirgharmasadbhiḥ ||

translations.english: Come, Agni, to our presence with the Pitṛs, who are possessed of knowledge, who having attained aseat among the gods, thirst (for the Soma), skilled in sacrifices, reciters of praises with hymns, truth-speaking,seers, frequenters of sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: ये सत्यासो हविरदो हविष्पा इन्द्रेण देवैः सरथं दधानाः । आग्ने याहि सहस्रं देववन्दैः परैः पूर्वैः पितृभिर्घर्मसद्भिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye satyāso havirado haviṣpā indreṇa devaiḥ sarathaṃ dadhānāḥ | āgne yāhi sahasraṃ devavandaiḥ paraiḥ pūrvaiḥ pitṛbhirgharmasadbhiḥ ||

translations.english: Come, Agni, with thousands of Pitṛs, of both past and future (time), frequenters of sacrifices, eulogistsof the gods; those who are true, who feed on oblations, and drink oblations, possessing equality with Indra andthe gods.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निष्वात्ताः पितर एह गच्छत सदःसदः सदत सुप्रणीतयः । अत्ता हवींषि प्रयतानि बर्हिष्यथा रयिं सर्ववीरं दधातन ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniṣvāttāḥ pitara eha gacchata sadaḥsadaḥ sadata supraṇītayaḥ | attā havīṃṣi prayatāni barhiṣyathā rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ dadhātana ||

translations.english: Agniṣvātta Pitṛs, come to this solemnity; sit down, directors in the right way, in your appropriateplaces; eat the oblations spread on the grass, and grant us riches and male posterity.
