mantras.sanskrit: त्वमग्न ईळितो जातवेदोऽवाड्ढव्यानि सुरभीणि कृत्वी । प्रादाः पितृभ्यः स्वधया ते अक्षन्नद्धि त्वं देव प्रयता हवींषि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamagna īḷito jātavedo'vāḍḍhavyāni surabhīṇi kṛtvī | prādāḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svadhayā te akṣannaddhi tvaṃ deva prayatā havīṃṣi ||

translations.english: Agni Jātavedas, who are glorified (by us), having made our oblations fragrant, you have borne themoff, and have presented them to the Pitṛs; may they partake of them with the Svadhā; and do you also, divineAgni, feed upon the offered oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: ये चेह पितरो ये च नेह याँश्च विद्म याँ उ च न प्रविद्म । त्वं वेत्थ यति ते जातवेदः स्वधाभिर्यज्ञं सुकृतं जुषस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye ceha pitaro ye ca neha yā~śca vidma yā~ u ca na pravidma | tvaṃ vettha yati te jātavedaḥ svadhābhiryajñaṃ sukṛtaṃ juṣasva ||

translations.english: You know, Jātavedas, those Pitṛs, how many they may be, who are not in this world, those whom weknow, and those whom we do not fully know; enjoy this pious sacrifice offered together with svadhās.

mantras.sanskrit: ये अग्निदग्धा ये अनग्निदग्धा मध्ये दिवः स्वधया मादयन्ते । तेभिः स्वराळसुनीतिमेतां यथावशं तन्वं कल्पयस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye agnidagdhā ye anagnidagdhā madhye divaḥ svadhayā mādayante | tebhiḥ svarāḷasunītimetāṃ yathāvaśaṃ tanvaṃ kalpayasva ||

translations.english: May those who are agnidagdhas, and those who are not, be satisfied with svadhā in the midst ofheaven; and do you supreme lord, associated with them, construct at your plural asure that body that is endowedwith breath.

mantras.sanskrit: मैनमग्ने वि दहो माभि शोचो मास्य त्वचं चिक्षिपो मा शरीरम् । यदा शृतं कृणवो जातवेदोऽथेमेनं प्र हिणुतात्पितृभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mainamagne vi daho mābhi śoco māsya tvacaṃ cikṣipo mā śarīram | yadā śṛtaṃ kṛṇavo jātavedo'themenaṃ pra hiṇutātpitṛbhyaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, consume him not entirely; afflict him not; scatter not (here and there) his skin nor his body; whenJātavedas, you have rendered him mature, then send him to the Pitṛs.

mantras.sanskrit: शृतं यदा करसि जातवेदोऽथेमेनं परि दत्तात्पितृभ्यः । यदा गच्छात्यसुनीतिमेतामथा देवानां वशनीर्भवाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: śṛtaṃ yadā karasi jātavedo'themenaṃ pari dattātpitṛbhyaḥ | yadā gacchātyasunītimetāmathā devānāṃ vaśanīrbhavāti ||

translations.english: When you have rendered him mature, then give him up, Jātavedas, to the Pitṛs; when he proceedsto that world of spirits, then he becomes subject to the will of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: सूर्यं चक्षुर्गच्छतु वातमात्मा द्यां च गच्छ पृथिवीं च धर्मणा । अपो वा गच्छ यदि तत्र ते हितमोषधीषु प्रति तिष्ठा शरीरैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sūryaṃ cakṣurgacchatu vātamātmā dyāṃ ca gaccha pṛthivīṃ ca dharmaṇā | apo vā gaccha yadi tatra te hitamoṣadhīṣu prati tiṣṭhā śarīraiḥ ||

translations.english: Let the eye repair to the sun; the breath to the wind; go you to the heaven or to the earth, according toyour merit; or go to the waters it it suits you (to be) there, or abide with your members in the plural nts.

mantras.sanskrit: अजो भागस्तपसा तं तपस्व तं ते शोचिस्तपतु तं ते अर्चिः । यास्ते शिवास्तन्वो जातवेदस्ताभिर्वहैनं सुकृतामु लोकम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ajo bhāgastapasā taṃ tapasva taṃ te śocistapatu taṃ te arciḥ | yāste śivāstanvo jātavedastābhirvahainaṃ sukṛtāmu lokam ||

translations.english: The unborn portion; burn that, Agni, with your heat; let your flame, your splendour, consume it; withthose glorious members which you have given him, Jātavedas, bear him to the world (of the virtuous).

mantras.sanskrit: अव सृज पुनरग्ने पितृभ्यो यस्त आहुतश्चरति स्वधाभिः । आयुर्वसान उप वेतु शेषः सं गच्छतां तन्वा जातवेदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ava sṛja punaragne pitṛbhyo yasta āhutaścarati svadhābhiḥ | āyurvasāna upa vetu śeṣaḥ saṃ gacchatāṃ tanvā jātavedaḥ ||

translations.english: Dismiss again to the Pitṛs, Agni, him who offered on you, comes with the svadhās; putting on(celestial) life, let the remains (of bodily life) depart; let him, Jātavedas, be associated with a body.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्ते कृष्णः शकुन आतुतोद पिपीलः सर्प उत वा श्वापदः । अग्निष्टद्विश्वादगदं कृणोतु सोमश्च यो ब्राह्मणाँ आविवेश ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatte kṛṣṇaḥ śakuna ātutoda pipīlaḥ sarpa uta vā śvāpadaḥ | agniṣṭadviśvādagadaṃ kṛṇotu somaśca yo brāhmaṇā~ āviveśa ||

translations.english: Should the black crow, the ant, the snake, the wild beast, harm (a limb) of you, may Agni theall-devourer, and the Soma that has pervaded the brāhmaṇas, make it whole.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्नेर्वर्म परि गोभिर्व्ययस्व सं प्रोर्णुष्व पीवसा मेदसा च । नेत्त्वा धृष्णुर्हरसा जर्हृषाणो दधृग्विधक्ष्यन्पर्यङ्खयाते ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnervarma pari gobhirvyayasva saṃ prorṇuṣva pīvasā medasā ca | nettvā dhṛṣṇurharasā jarhṛṣāṇo dadhṛgvidhakṣyanparyaṅkhayāte ||

translations.english: Enclose the mail of Agni with the (hide of the) cow; cover it with the fat and marrow; then will not(Agni), bold, exulting in his fierce heat, proud, embrace you roundabout to consume you (to ashes).

mantras.sanskrit: इममग्ने चमसं मा वि जिह्वरः प्रियो देवानामुत सोम्यानाम् । एष यश्चमसो देवपानस्तस्मिन्देवा अमृता मादयन्ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: imamagne camasaṃ mā vi jihvaraḥ priyo devānāmuta somyānām | eṣa yaścamaso devapānastasmindevā amṛtā mādayante ||

translations.english: Agni, shake not this ladle, for it is dear to the gods and to the (Pitṛs) who are worthy of the Soma; thiswhich is the drinking ladle of the ogds, in this immortal gods delight.

mantras.sanskrit: क्रव्यादमग्निं प्र हिणोमि दूरं यमराज्ञो गच्छतु रिप्रवाहः । इहैवायमितरो जातवेदा देवेभ्यो हव्यं वहतु प्रजानन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kravyādamagniṃ pra hiṇomi dūraṃ yamarājño gacchatu ripravāhaḥ | ihaivāyamitaro jātavedā devebhyo havyaṃ vahatu prajānan ||

translations.english: I send the flesh-devouring Agni to a distance; let him bearing away sin repair to (the realm of) kingYama; but let this other Jātavedas who is known (by all) convey the oblation to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: यो अग्निः क्रव्यात्प्रविवेश वो गृहमिमं पश्यन्नितरं जातवेदसम् । तं हरामि पितृयज्ञाय देवं स घर्ममिन्वात्परमे सधस्थे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo agniḥ kravyātpraviveśa vo gṛhamimaṃ paśyannitaraṃ jātavedasam | taṃ harāmi pitṛyajñāya devaṃ sa gharmaminvātparame sadhasthe ||

translations.english: The flesh-devouring deity Agni, who has entered your dwelling, I turn him out, for the worship of thePitṛs, upon beholding this other (Agni) Jātavedas; let him celebrate the sacrifice (to the Pitṛs) in the mostexcellent assembly.

mantras.sanskrit: यो अग्निः क्रव्यवाहनः पितॄन्यक्षदृतावृधः । प्रेदु हव्यानि वोचति देवेभ्यश्च पितृभ्य आ ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo agniḥ kravyavāhanaḥ pitṝnyakṣadṛtāvṛdhaḥ | predu havyāni vocati devebhyaśca pitṛbhya ā ||

translations.english: Let Agni the bearer of the Kavya worship the Pitṛs, who are magnified by truth, let him declare whichare the offerings to the gods, which to the Pitṛs.

mantras.sanskrit: उशन्तस्त्वा नि धीमह्युशन्तः समिधीमहि । उशन्नुशत आ वह पितॄन्हविषे अत्तवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: uśantastvā ni dhīmahyuśantaḥ samidhīmahi | uśannuśata ā vaha pitṝnhaviṣe attave ||

translations.english: Longing we set you down; longing we kindle you; do you longing bring the longing Pitṛs to eat of the(sacrificial) viands.

mantras.sanskrit: यं त्वमग्ने समदहस्तमु निर्वापया पुनः । कियाम्ब्वत्र रोहतु पाकदूर्वा व्यल्कशा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ tvamagne samadahastamu nirvāpayā punaḥ | kiyāmbvatra rohatu pākadūrvā vyalkaśā ||

translations.english: Cool again, Agni, the spot which you have burned, there let the water- lily grow, and the ripe Durvawith its many stalks.

mantras.sanskrit: शीतिके शीतिकावति ह्लादिके ह्लादिकावति । मण्डूक्या सु सं गम इमं स्वग्निं हर्षय ॥
mantras.transliteration: śītike śītikāvati hlādike hlādikāvati | maṇḍūkyā su saṃ gama imaṃ svagniṃ harṣaya ||

translations.english: (Oh earth), cool and filled with cool (herbs), gladsome and filled with gladsome (trees), be throngedwith feminine le frogs and give joy to this Agni.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वष्टा दुहित्रे वहतुं कृणोतीतीदं विश्वं भुवनं समेति । यमस्य माता पर्युह्यमाना महो जाया विवस्वतो ननाश ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṣṭā duhitre vahatuṃ kṛṇotītīdaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ sameti | yamasya mātā paryuhyamānā maho jāyā vivasvato nanāśa ||

translations.english: Tvaṣṭā celebrates the marriage of his daughter; therefore, the whole world is assembled; but themother of Yama, the newly-married wife of the mighty Vivasvat, disappeared.

mantras.sanskrit: अपागूहन्नमृतां मर्त्येभ्यः कृत्वी सवर्णामददुर्विवस्वते । उताश्विनावभरद्यत्तदासीदजहादु द्वा मिथुना सरण्यूः ॥
mantras.transliteration: apāgūhannamṛtāṃ martyebhyaḥ kṛtvī savarṇāmadadurvivasvate | utāśvināvabharadyattadāsīdajahādu dvā mithunā saraṇyūḥ ||

translations.english: The gods concealing the immortal (Sarṇyū) for th esake of mortals and having formed her, gave herto Vivasvat. She bore the two Aśvins when this had happened and then Saraṇyū gave birth to two twins.

mantras.sanskrit: पूषा त्वेतश्च्यावयतु प्र विद्वाननष्टपशुर्भुवनस्य गोपाः । स त्वैतेभ्यः परि ददत्पितृभ्योऽग्निर्देवेभ्यः सुविदत्रियेभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pūṣā tvetaścyāvayatu pra vidvānanaṣṭapaśurbhuvanasya gopāḥ | sa tvaitebhyaḥ pari dadatpitṛbhyo'gnirdevebhyaḥ suvidatriyebhyaḥ ||

translations.english: May the discriminating Pūṣan, whose cattle are never lost, the protector of all beings, transfer youhence (to a better world); may he give you to these Pitṛs; may Agni (give) you to the beneficent gods.

mantras.sanskrit: आयुर्विश्वायुः परि पासति त्वा पूषा त्वा पातु प्रपथे पुरस्तात् । यत्रासते सुकृतो यत्र ते ययुस्तत्र त्वा देवः सविता दधातु ॥
mantras.transliteration: āyurviśvāyuḥ pari pāsati tvā pūṣā tvā pātu prapathe purastāt | yatrāsate sukṛto yatra te yayustatra tvā devaḥ savitā dadhātu ||

translations.english: May the all-pervading Vāyu protect you, may Pūṣan (preserve) you, (going) first on the excellentpath (to heaven); may the divine Savitā plural ce you, where the virtuous abide, whither they have gone.

mantras.sanskrit: पूषेमा आशा अनु वेद सर्वाः सो अस्माँ अभयतमेन नेषत् । स्वस्तिदा आघृणिः सर्ववीरोऽप्रयुच्छन्पुर एतु प्रजानन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pūṣemā āśā anu veda sarvāḥ so asmā~ abhayatamena neṣat | svastidā āghṛṇiḥ sarvavīro'prayucchanpura etu prajānan ||

translations.english: Pūṣan knows all these regions severally; met him conduct us by (the path) that is most free fromperil; let him precede us, who is the giver of prosperity, endowed with radiance, accompanied by all pious men,ever vigilant, and knowing our (deserts).

mantras.sanskrit: प्रपथे पथामजनिष्ट पूषा प्रपथे दिवः प्रपथे पृथिव्याः । उभे अभि प्रियतमे सधस्थे आ च परा च चरति प्रजानन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: prapathe pathāmajaniṣṭa pūṣā prapathe divaḥ prapathe pṛthivyāḥ | ubhe abhi priyatame sadhasthe ā ca parā ca carati prajānan ||

translations.english: Pūṣan has been born on the best path of paths, on the best path of heaven on the best path ofearth, he goes forward and backward over both (worlds), the assemblies longed for by all, discriminating (themerits of the dead).

mantras.sanskrit: सरस्वतीं देवयन्तो हवन्ते सरस्वतीमध्वरे तायमाने । सरस्वतीं सुकृतो अह्वयन्त सरस्वती दाशुषे वार्यं दात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sarasvatīṃ devayanto havante sarasvatīmadhvare tāyamāne | sarasvatīṃ sukṛto ahvayanta sarasvatī dāśuṣe vāryaṃ dāt ||

translations.english: The devout invoke Sarasvatī; they worship Sarasvatī at the strewn sacrifice; the virtuous call uponSarasvatī; may Sarasvatī bestow blessings upon the donor (of the oblation).

mantras.sanskrit: सरस्वति या सरथं ययाथ स्वधाभिर्देवि पितृभिर्मदन्ती । आसद्यास्मिन्बर्हिषि मादयस्वानमीवा इष आ धेह्यस्मे ॥
mantras.transliteration: sarasvati yā sarathaṃ yayātha svadhābhirdevi pitṛbhirmadantī | āsadyāsminbarhiṣi mādayasvānamīvā iṣa ā dhehyasme ||

translations.english: Divine Sarasvatī, who rides in the same chariot with the Pitṛs, and delighted (along with them) by the(sacrificial) viands, seated on the sacred grass gratified (by our offering, and grant us wholesome food. worshippers at this sacrifice a portion of food fit for thousands, and increase of riches.

mantras.sanskrit: सरस्वतीं यां पितरो हवन्ते दक्षिणा यज्ञमभिनक्षमाणाः । सहस्रार्घमिळो अत्र भागं रायस्पोषं यजमानेषु धेहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: sarasvatīṃ yāṃ pitaro havante dakṣiṇā yajñamabhinakṣamāṇāḥ | sahasrārghamiḷo atra bhāgaṃ rāyaspoṣaṃ yajamāneṣu dhehi ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: आपो अस्मान्मातरः शुन्धयन्तु घृतेन नो घृतप्वः पुनन्तु । विश्वं हि रिप्रं प्रवहन्ति देवीरुदिदाभ्यः शुचिरा पूत एमि ॥
mantras.transliteration: āpo asmānmātaraḥ śundhayantu ghṛtena no ghṛtapvaḥ punantu | viśvaṃ hi ripraṃ pravahanti devīrudidābhyaḥ śucirā pūta emi ||

translations.english: May the maternal waters, purify us; may the shedders of water purify us with the effusion; for thedivine (waters) bear away all sin; I come away from them purified (to heaven).

mantras.sanskrit: द्रप्सश्चस्कन्द प्रथमाँ अनु द्यूनिमं च योनिमनु यश्च पूर्वः । समानं योनिमनु संचरन्तं द्रप्सं जुहोम्यनु सप्त होत्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: drapsaścaskanda prathamā~ anu dyūnimaṃ ca yonimanu yaśca pūrvaḥ | samānaṃ yonimanu saṃcarantaṃ drapsaṃ juhomyanu sapta hotrāḥ ||

translations.english: The Soma has risen to the earthly and heavenly (worlds), both this visible world, and that which(existed) before (it); I offer that Soma flowing through the common region (of heaven and earth) after the sacrifice(offered by the) seven (officiating priests).

mantras.sanskrit: यस्ते द्रप्सः स्कन्दति यस्ते अंशुर्बाहुच्युतो धिषणाया उपस्थात् । अध्वर्योर्वा परि वा यः पवित्रात्तं ते जुहोमि मनसा वषट्कृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaste drapsaḥ skandati yaste aṃśurbāhucyuto dhiṣaṇāyā upasthāt | adhvaryorvā pari vā yaḥ pavitrāttaṃ te juhomi manasā vaṣaṭkṛtam ||

translations.english: Soma, which escapes (from the hide), your filaments which let fall from the hands (of the priestescape) from the vicinity of the plural nks (of the press), or (from the hand) of the Adhvaryu, or from the filter; I offer itall with my mind (to Agni) with the word vaṣat.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्ते द्रप्सः स्कन्नो यस्ते अंशुरवश्च यः परः स्रुचा । अयं देवो बृहस्पतिः सं तं सिञ्चतु राधसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaste drapsaḥ skanno yaste aṃśuravaśca yaḥ paraḥ srucā | ayaṃ devo bṛhaspatiḥ saṃ taṃ siñcatu rādhase ||

translations.english: Your juice and your filaments, (Soma), which escape, and which fall from the ladle on this side or onthat; may this divine Bṛhaspati sprinkle it for our enrichment.

mantras.sanskrit: पयस्वतीरोषधयः पयस्वन्मामकं वचः । अपां पयस्वदित्पयस्तेन मा सह शुन्धत ॥
mantras.transliteration: payasvatīroṣadhayaḥ payasvanmāmakaṃ vacaḥ | apāṃ payasvaditpayastena mā saha śundhata ||

translations.english: (Waters)! the plural nts flourish by means of water my prayer is effectual through water; the essence ofwater is vigorous through water; purify me with it.

mantras.sanskrit: परं मृत्यो अनु परेहि पन्थां यस्ते स्व इतरो देवयानात् । चक्षुष्मते शृण्वते ते ब्रवीमि मा नः प्रजां रीरिषो मोत वीरान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: paraṃ mṛtyo anu parehi panthāṃ yaste sva itaro devayānāt | cakṣuṣmate śṛṇvate te bravīmi mā naḥ prajāṃ rīriṣo mota vīrān ||

translations.english: Depart, Mṛtyu, by a different path; by that which is your own, and distinct from the path of the gods; Ispeak to you who have eyes, who have ears; do no harm to our offspring, nor to our male progeny.

mantras.sanskrit: मृत्योः पदं योपयन्तो यदैत द्राघीय आयुः प्रतरं दधानाः । आप्यायमानाः प्रजया धनेन शुद्धाः पूता भवत यज्ञियासः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mṛtyoḥ padaṃ yopayanto yadaita drāghīya āyuḥ prataraṃ dadhānāḥ | āpyāyamānāḥ prajayā dhanena śuddhāḥ pūtā bhavata yajñiyāsaḥ ||

translations.english: If, avoiding the path of death, you go (on the path of he gods), assuming a longer and better life, (myfriends), then may you, (O sacrificers), diligent in sacrifice, enriched with progeny and affluence, be cleansed andpure.

mantras.sanskrit: इमे जीवा वि मृतैराववृत्रन्नभूद्भद्रा देवहूतिर्नो अद्य । प्राञ्चो अगाम नृतये हसाय द्राघीय आयुः प्रतरं दधानाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ime jīvā vi mṛtairāvavṛtrannabhūdbhadrā devahūtirno adya | prāñco agāma nṛtaye hasāya drāghīya āyuḥ prataraṃ dadhānāḥ ||

translations.english: May those who are living remain separate from the dead; may our invocation of the gods today besuccessful; let us go forward to dancing and laughter, assuming a longer and better life.

mantras.sanskrit: इमं जीवेभ्यः परिधिं दधामि मैषां नु गादपरो अर्थमेतम् । शतं जीवन्तु शरदः पुरूचीरन्तर्मृत्युं दधतां पर्वतेन ॥
mantras.transliteration: imaṃ jīvebhyaḥ paridhiṃ dadhāmi maiṣāṃ nu gādaparo arthametam | śataṃ jīvantu śaradaḥ purūcīrantarmṛtyuṃ dadhatāṃ parvatena ||

translations.english: I erect this circle (of stones) for (the protection of) the living, that none other of them may approach thislimit; may they live a hundred years, occupied by many holy works, and keep death hidden by this mound.

mantras.sanskrit: यथाहान्यनुपूर्वं भवन्ति यथ ऋतव ऋतुभिर्यन्ति साधु । यथा न पूर्वमपरो जहात्येवा धातरायूंषि कल्पयैषाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathāhānyanupūrvaṃ bhavanti yatha ṛtava ṛtubhiryanti sādhu | yathā na pūrvamaparo jahātyevā dhātarāyūṃṣi kalpayaiṣām ||

translations.english: As days pass along in succession; as season are duly followed by seasons; as the successor doesnot abandon his predecessor, so, Dhātā, support the lives of these (my kinsmen).

mantras.sanskrit: आ रोहतायुर्जरसं वृणाना अनुपूर्वं यतमाना यति ष्ठ । इह त्वष्टा सुजनिमा सजोषा दीर्घमायुः करति जीवसे वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā rohatāyurjarasaṃ vṛṇānā anupūrvaṃ yatamānā yati ṣṭha | iha tvaṣṭā sujanimā sajoṣā dīrghamāyuḥ karati jīvase vaḥ ||

translations.english: (You kinsmen of the dead man), choosing old age, attain length of life, striving one after the other, howmany soever you may be; may Tvaṣṭā, the creator.

mantras.sanskrit: इमा नारीरविधवाः सुपत्नीराञ्जनेन सर्पिषा सं विशन्तु । अनश्रवोऽनमीवाः सुरत्ना आ रोहन्तु जनयो योनिमग्रे ॥
mantras.transliteration: imā nārīravidhavāḥ supatnīrāñjanena sarpiṣā saṃ viśantu | anaśravo'namīvāḥ suratnā ā rohantu janayo yonimagre ||

translations.english: Let these women who are not widows, who have good husbands, enter (anointed) with unguent andbutter. Let women without tears, without sorrow, and decorated with jewels, first proceed to the house.

mantras.sanskrit: उदीर्ष्व नार्यभि जीवलोकं गतासुमेतमुप शेष एहि । हस्तग्राभस्य दिधिषोस्तवेदं पत्युर्जनित्वमभि सं बभूथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: udīrṣva nāryabhi jīvalokaṃ gatāsumetamupa śeṣa ehi | hastagrābhasya didhiṣostavedaṃ patyurjanitvamabhi saṃ babhūtha ||

translations.english: Rise, woman, (and go) to the world of living beings; come, this man near whom you sleep is lifeless;you have enjoyed this state of being the wife of your husband, the suitor who took you by the band.

mantras.sanskrit: धनुर्हस्तादाददानो मृतस्यास्मे क्षत्राय वर्चसे बलाय । अत्रैव त्वमिह वयं सुवीरा विश्वाः स्पृधो अभिमातीर्जयेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhanurhastādādadāno mṛtasyāsme kṣatrāya varcase balāya | atraiva tvamiha vayaṃ suvīrā viśvāḥ spṛdho abhimātīrjayema ||

translations.english: Taking his bow from the hand of the dead man, for the sake of our vigour, energy and strength, (I say)you are there; may we (who are) here, blessed with male offspring, overcome all the enemies who assail us.

mantras.sanskrit: उप सर्प मातरं भूमिमेतामुरुव्यचसं पृथिवीं सुशेवाम् । ऊर्णम्रदा युवतिर्दक्षिणावत एषा त्वा पातु निॠतेरुपस्थात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa sarpa mātaraṃ bhūmimetāmuruvyacasaṃ pṛthivīṃ suśevām | ūrṇamradā yuvatirdakṣiṇāvata eṣā tvā pātu niṝterupasthāt ||

translations.english: Go to this your mother-earth, the wide-spread, delightful earth; this virgin (earth is) as soft as wool, tothe liberal (worshipper) may she protect you from the proximity of Nirṛti.

mantras.sanskrit: उच्छ्वञ्चस्व पृथिवि मा नि बाधथाः सूपायनास्मै भव सूपवञ्चना । माता पुत्रं यथा सिचाभ्येनं भूम ऊर्णुहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ucchvañcasva pṛthivi mā ni bādhathāḥ sūpāyanāsmai bhava sūpavañcanā | mātā putraṃ yathā sicābhyenaṃ bhūma ūrṇuhi ||

translations.english: Earth, rise up above him; oppress him not; be attentive to him (and) comfortable; cover him up, earth,as a mother covers her child with the skirt of her garment.

mantras.sanskrit: उच्छ्वञ्चमाना पृथिवी सु तिष्ठतु सहस्रं मित उप हि श्रयन्ताम् । ते गृहासो घृतश्चुतो भवन्तु विश्वाहास्मै शरणाः सन्त्वत्र ॥
mantras.transliteration: ucchvañcamānā pṛthivī su tiṣṭhatu sahasraṃ mita upa hi śrayantām | te gṛhāso ghṛtaścuto bhavantu viśvāhāsmai śaraṇāḥ santvatra ||

translations.english: Bring them back again, render them obedient; may Indra restor ethem; may Agni bring them near.

mantras.sanskrit: उत्ते स्तभ्नामि पृथिवीं त्वत्परीमं लोगं निदधन्मो अहं रिषम् । एतां स्थूणां पितरो धारयन्तु तेऽत्रा यमः सादना ते मिनोतु ॥
mantras.transliteration: utte stabhnāmi pṛthivīṃ tvatparīmaṃ logaṃ nidadhanmo ahaṃ riṣam | etāṃ sthūṇāṃ pitaro dhārayantu te'trā yamaḥ sādanā te minotu ||

translations.english: May they come back to me and be fostered under this (their) protector; do you Agni, keep them here;may whatever wealth (there is) remain here.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रतीचीने मामहनीष्वाः पर्णमिवा दधुः । प्रतीचीं जग्रभा वाचमश्वं रशनया यथा ॥
mantras.transliteration: pratīcīne māmahanīṣvāḥ parṇamivā dadhuḥ | pratīcīṃ jagrabhā vācamaśvaṃ raśanayā yathā ||

translations.english: I invoke the knowledge of the plural ce, of their going, of their coming, of their departure, of theirwandering, of their returning; (I invoke) him who is their keeper.

mantras.sanskrit: नि वर्तध्वं मानु गातास्मान्त्सिषक्त रेवतीः । अग्नीषोमा पुनर्वसू अस्मे धारयतं रयिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni vartadhvaṃ mānu gātāsmāntsiṣakta revatīḥ | agnīṣomā punarvasū asme dhārayataṃ rayim ||

translations.english: Come back; go not elsewhere; abounding in wealth, sprinkle us; Agni and Soma, you who clothe (yourworshippers) again, bestow upon us riches.

mantras.sanskrit: पुनरेना नि वर्तय पुनरेना न्या कुरु । इन्द्र एणा नि यच्छत्वग्निरेना उपाजतु ॥
mantras.transliteration: punarenā ni vartaya punarenā nyā kuru | indra eṇā ni yacchatvagnirenā upājatu ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: पुनरेता नि वर्तन्तामस्मिन्पुष्यन्तु गोपतौ । इहैवाग्ने नि धारयेह तिष्ठतु या रयिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: punaretā ni vartantāmasminpuṣyantu gopatau | ihaivāgne ni dhārayeha tiṣṭhatu yā rayiḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: यन्नियानं न्ययनं संज्ञानं यत्परायणम् । आवर्तनं निवर्तनं यो गोपा अपि तं हुवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yanniyānaṃ nyayanaṃ saṃjñānaṃ yatparāyaṇam | āvartanaṃ nivartanaṃ yo gopā api taṃ huve ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: य उदानड्व्ययनं य उदानट् परायणम् । आवर्तनं निवर्तनमपि गोपा नि वर्तताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya udānaḍvyayanaṃ ya udānaṭ parāyaṇam | āvartanaṃ nivartanamapi gopā ni vartatām ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: आ निवर्त नि वर्तय पुनर्न इन्द्र गा देहि । जीवाभिर्भुनजामहै ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā nivarta ni vartaya punarna indra gā dehi | jīvābhirbhunajāmahai ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: परि वो विश्वतो दध ऊर्जा घृतेन पयसा । ये देवाः के च यज्ञियास्ते रय्या सं सृजन्तु नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari vo viśvato dadha ūrjā ghṛtena payasā | ye devāḥ ke ca yajñiyāste rayyā saṃ sṛjantu naḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: आ निवर्तन वर्तय नि निवर्तन वर्तय । भूम्याश्चतस्रः प्रदिशस्ताभ्य एना नि वर्तय ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā nivartana vartaya ni nivartana vartaya | bhūmyāścatasraḥ pradiśastābhya enā ni vartaya ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: भद्रं नो अपि वातय मनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhadraṃ no api vātaya manaḥ ||

translations.english: (Agni), manifest towards us a favourable mind.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निमीळे भुजां यविष्ठं शासा मित्रं दुर्धरीतुम् । यस्य धर्मन्त्स्वरेनीः सपर्यन्ति मातुरूधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnimīḷe bhujāṃ yaviṣṭhaṃ śāsā mitraṃ durdharītum | yasya dharmantsvarenīḥ saparyanti māturūdhaḥ ||

translations.english: I glorify Agni, the youngest of the feeders (on oblations), friendly in counsel, difficult to resist, at whoserite the oblations seek heaven, as (calves) the udder of the mother cow.

mantras.sanskrit: यमासा कृपनीळं भासाकेतुं वर्धयन्ति । भ्राजते श्रेणिदन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yamāsā kṛpanīḷaṃ bhāsāketuṃ vardhayanti | bhrājate śreṇidan ||

translations.english: He whom (the worshippers) magnify with their mouth, the sustainer of pious works; whose banner isthe light, he shines, bestowing upon them all their desires.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्यो विशां गातुरेति प्र यदानड्दिवो अन्तान् । कविरभ्रं दीद्यानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aryo viśāṃ gātureti pra yadānaḍdivo antān | kavirabhraṃ dīdyānaḥ ||

translations.english: The refuge of the people, the mover, who, when he moves, penetrates to the ends of the sky; thesage illumining the firmament.

mantras.sanskrit: जुषद्धव्या मानुषस्योर्ध्वस्तस्थावृभ्वा यज्ञे । मिन्वन्त्सद्म पुर एति ॥
mantras.transliteration: juṣaddhavyā mānuṣasyordhvastasthāvṛbhvā yajñe | minvantsadma pura eti ||

translations.english: Accepting the oblations (offered) at the sacrifice of the worshipper, he blazes up, with a mighty flame;fixing his abode, he advances.

mantras.sanskrit: स हि क्षेमो हविर्यज्ञः श्रुष्टीदस्य गातुरेति । अग्निं देवा वाशीमन्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa hi kṣemo haviryajñaḥ śruṣṭīdasya gātureti | agniṃ devā vāśīmantam ||

translations.english: Agni is capable (of protecting all men), he is himself the oblation, and the sacrifice; rapidly indeed doeshis spirit move, the gods come to Agni, who bears the praises.

mantras.sanskrit: यज्ञासाहं दुव इषेऽग्निं पूर्वस्य शेवस्य । अद्रेः सूनुमायुमाहुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajñāsāhaṃ duva iṣe'gniṃ pūrvasya śevasya | adreḥ sūnumāyumāhuḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, who goes to (summon the gods), the bearer of the oblation, whom men call the sow of the stone;him I desire to worship (for the sake) of supreme felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: नरो ये के चास्मदा विश्वेत्ते वाम आ स्युः । अग्निं हविषा वर्धन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: naro ye ke cāsmadā viśvette vāma ā syuḥ | agniṃ haviṣā vardhantaḥ ||

translations.english: May all the men who belong to us be (gratified) in all that is desirable, augmenting Agni with oblationṣ

mantras.sanskrit: कृष्णः श्वेतोऽरुषो यामो अस्य ब्रध्न ऋज्र उत शोणो यशस्वान् । हिरण्यरूपं जनिता जजान ॥
mantras.transliteration: kṛṣṇaḥ śveto'ruṣo yāmo asya bradhna ṛjra uta śoṇo yaśasvān | hiraṇyarūpaṃ janitā jajāna ||

translations.english: His chariot is black, white, red, tawny, dark red, crimson, and glorious; the progenitor of all has givenhim a chariot of gold.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा ते अग्ने विमदो मनीषामूर्जो नपादमृतेभिः सजोषाः । गिर आ वक्षत्सुमतीरियान इषमूर्जं सुक्षितिं विश्वमाभाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā te agne vimado manīṣāmūrjo napādamṛtebhiḥ sajoṣāḥ | gira ā vakṣatsumatīriyāna iṣamūrjaṃ sukṣitiṃ viśvamābhāḥ ||

translations.english: Grandson of strength, Agni, who are gratified by the ambrosial (Viands), Vimada, (desirous of) wisdom,has recited your praises; do you, approaching with a kind intention, bestow upon us food, strength, and aprosperous abode.

mantras.sanskrit: आग्निं न स्ववृक्तिभिर्होतारं त्वा वृणीमहे । यज्ञाय स्तीर्णबर्हिषे वि वो मदे शीरं पावकशोचिषं विवक्षसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: āgniṃ na svavṛktibhirhotāraṃ tvā vṛṇīmahe | yajñāya stīrṇabarhiṣe vi vo made śīraṃ pāvakaśociṣaṃ vivakṣase ||

translations.english: We invoke you now, Agni, invoker (of the gods), with our voluntary (praises) for the sacrifice, at whichthe sacred grass is spread; you, who underlying (all things), who (diffuses) purifying radiance, (we invoke) foryour exhilaration; you are mighty.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामु ते स्वाभुवः शुम्भन्त्यश्वराधसः । वेति त्वामुपसेचनी वि वो मद ऋजीतिरग्न आहुतिर्विवक्षसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmu te svābhuvaḥ śumbhantyaśvarādhasaḥ | veti tvāmupasecanī vi vo mada ṛjītiragna āhutirvivakṣase ||

translations.english: Self-radiant, opulent in horses, they glorify you; the oblation poured out over (you) proceeds in astraight course, Agni, to you for your exhilaration; you are mighy.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वे धर्माण आसते जुहूभिः सिञ्चतीरिव । कृष्णा रूपाण्यर्जुना वि वो मदे विश्वा अधि श्रियो धिषे विवक्षसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tve dharmāṇa āsate juhūbhiḥ siñcatīriva | kṛṣṇā rūpāṇyarjunā vi vo made viśvā adhi śriyo dhiṣe vivakṣase ||

translations.english: The establishers (of the rite) worship you with their ladles (filled with the oblation), like (earth)sprinkling (showers); you sustain exceedingly black forms and white and all beauties for your exhilaration; youare mighty.

mantras.sanskrit: यमग्ने मन्यसे रयिं सहसावन्नमर्त्य । तमा नो वाजसातये वि वो मदे यज्ञेषु चित्रमा भरा विवक्षसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yamagne manyase rayiṃ sahasāvannamartya | tamā no vājasātaye vi vo made yajñeṣu citramā bharā vivakṣase ||

translations.english: Powerful and immortal Agni, bring to us, for our sustenance, the precious wealth which you think best;(bring it) for your exhilaration at the sacrifices; you are mighty.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निर्जातो अथर्वणा विदद्विश्वानि काव्या । भुवद्दूतो विवस्वतो वि वो मदे प्रियो यमस्य काम्यो विवक्षसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirjāto atharvaṇā vidadviśvāni kāvyā | bhuvaddūto vivasvato vi vo made priyo yamasya kāmyo vivakṣase ||

translations.english: Agni, genitive rated by Atharvan, is cognizant of all praises; he is the messenger of Vivasvat, the belovedfriend of Yama, for your exhilaration; you are mighty.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वां यज्ञेष्वीळतेऽग्ने प्रयत्यध्वरे । त्वं वसूनि काम्या वि वो मदे विश्वा दधासि दाशुषे विवक्षसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāṃ yajñeṣvīḷate'gne prayatyadhvare | tvaṃ vasūni kāmyā vi vo made viśvā dadhāsi dāśuṣe vivakṣase ||

translations.english: The men establish you, Agni, at sacrifices, the ministrant priest, graceful, whose face shines withbutter, radiant, most intelligent with your eyes, for your exhilaration; (hence) you are mighty.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वां यज्ञेष्वृत्विजं चारुमग्ने नि षेदिरे । घृतप्रतीकं मनुषो वि वो मदे शुक्रं चेतिष्ठमक्षभिर्विवक्षसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāṃ yajñeṣvṛtvijaṃ cārumagne ni ṣedire | ghṛtapratīkaṃ manuṣo vi vo made śukraṃ cetiṣṭhamakṣabhirvivakṣase ||

translations.english: Agni, you, the mighty one, are known far and wide by your radiant lustre; bellowing, you rush like abull, you impregnate the sister (plural nts) in your exhilaration; you are mighty.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने शुक्रेण शोचिषोरु प्रथयसे बृहत् । अभिक्रन्दन्वृषायसे वि वो मदे गर्भं दधासि जामिषु विवक्षसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne śukreṇa śociṣoru prathayase bṛhat | abhikrandanvṛṣāyase vi vo made garbhaṃ dadhāsi jāmiṣu vivakṣase ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: कुह श्रुत इन्द्रः कस्मिन्नद्य जने मित्रो न श्रूयते । ऋषीणां वा यः क्षये गुहा वा चर्कृषे गिरा ॥
mantras.transliteration: kuha śruta indraḥ kasminnadya jane mitro na śrūyate | ṛṣīṇāṃ vā yaḥ kṣaye guhā vā carkṛṣe girā ||

translations.english: In what plural ce today is Indra renowned? In what nation is he famed like Mitra? (Indra), who isworshipper; or in secret = or, in the forest].

mantras.sanskrit: इह श्रुत इन्द्रो अस्मे अद्य स्तवे वज्र्यृचीषमः । मित्रो न यो जनेष्वा यशश्चक्रे असाम्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: iha śruta indro asme adya stave vajryṛcīṣamaḥ | mitro na yo janeṣvā yaśaścakre asāmyā ||

translations.english: Here is Indra renowned; today he is praised by us, the wielder of the thunderbolt, the deserving ofpraise; he who, like Mitra, bestows upon men unequalled abundance.

mantras.sanskrit: महो यस्पतिः शवसो असाम्या महो नृम्णस्य तूतुजिः । भर्ता वज्रस्य धृष्णोः पिता पुत्रमिव प्रियम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: maho yaspatiḥ śavaso asāmyā maho nṛmṇasya tūtujiḥ | bhartā vajrasya dhṛṣṇoḥ pitā putramiva priyam ||

translations.english: (May Indra protect us) who is the lord of great strenght, of unequalled (power), the distributor of greatwealth, the cherisher of the dreadful thunderbolt as a father (cherishes) a dear son.

mantras.sanskrit: युजानो अश्वा वातस्य धुनी देवो देवस्य वज्रिवः । स्यन्ता पथा विरुक्मता सृजानः स्तोष्यध्वनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yujāno aśvā vātasya dhunī devo devasya vajrivaḥ | syantā pathā virukmatā sṛjānaḥ stoṣyadhvanaḥ ||

translations.english: Thunderer, you who are divine, yoking your horses which are swifter than the divine wind, and glidingalong the resplendent road, you, opening out the way (to battle), are glorified.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं त्या चिद्वातस्याश्वागा ऋज्रा त्मना वहध्यै । ययोर्देवो न मर्त्यो यन्ता नकिर्विदाय्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ tyā cidvātasyāśvāgā ṛjrā tmanā vahadhyai | yayordevo na martyo yantā nakirvidāyyaḥ ||

translations.english: You have come to these two horses (which have the speed) of the wind, straight-going, for them todraw you of themselves, whom no deity, no mortal is able to restrain; whose fleetness no one comprehends.

mantras.sanskrit: अध ग्मन्तोशना पृच्छते वां कदर्था न आ गृहम् । आ जग्मथुः पराकाद्दिवश्च ग्मश्च मर्त्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha gmantośanā pṛcchate vāṃ kadarthā na ā gṛham | ā jagmathuḥ parākāddivaśca gmaśca martyam ||

translations.english: Uśanas inquires of youu two as you pass, "(Why) have you come to (our dwelling) from a distance;from heaven and earth to a mortal?"

mantras.sanskrit: आ न इन्द्र पृक्षसेऽस्माकं ब्रह्मोद्यतम् । तत्त्वा याचामहेऽवः शुष्णं यद्धन्नमानुषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā na indra pṛkṣase'smākaṃ brahmodyatam | tattvā yācāmahe'vaḥ śuṣṇaṃ yaddhannamānuṣam ||

translations.english: Accept, Indra, the oblation upraised by us; we solicit of you that protection by which you did slay thenon-human Suṣṇa.

mantras.sanskrit: अकर्मा दस्युरभि नो अमन्तुरन्यव्रतो अमानुषः । त्वं तस्यामित्रहन्वधर्दासस्य दम्भय ॥
mantras.transliteration: akarmā dasyurabhi no amanturanyavrato amānuṣaḥ | tvaṃ tasyāmitrahanvadhardāsasya dambhaya ||

translations.english: The Dasyu practising no religious rites, not knowing as thoroughly, following other observances,obeying no human laws, baffle, destroyer of enemies, the weapon of that slave.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं न इन्द्र शूर शूरैरुत त्वोतासो बर्हणा । पुरुत्रा ते वि पूर्तयो नवन्त क्षोणयो यथा ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ na indra śūra śūrairuta tvotāso barhaṇā | purutrā te vi pūrtayo navanta kṣoṇayo yathā ||

translations.english: Hero, Indra, withh the hero (Maruts defend) us; that protected by you (we may be able) to overcome(our enemies); your blessings are diffused among many (praisers), as men (repair to their lord).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं तान्वृत्रहत्ये चोदयो नॄन्कार्पाणे शूर वज्रिवः । गुहा यदी कवीनां विशां नक्षत्रशवसाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ tānvṛtrahatye codayo nṝnkārpāṇe śūra vajrivaḥ | guhā yadī kavīnāṃ viśāṃ nakṣatraśavasām ||

translations.english: Hero, Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, you have animated those chiefs (the Maruts) to the slaughterof Vṛtra in battle, when (you hear) the mystical (praises) of the sages, the worshippers praising the might of theconstellations.

mantras.sanskrit: मक्षू ता त इन्द्र दानाप्नस आक्षाणे शूर वज्रिवः । यद्ध शुष्णस्य दम्भयो जातं विश्वं सयावभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: makṣū tā ta indra dānāpnasa ākṣāṇe śūra vajrivaḥ | yaddha śuṣṇasya dambhayo jātaṃ viśvaṃ sayāvabhiḥ ||

translations.english: Hero, Indra, (your worshippers glorify) those prompt exploits performed by you in battle, (by you whoare) ever bountiful, when with your associate (Maruts) you destroyed the whole race o Śuṣṇa.

mantras.sanskrit: माकुध्र्यगिन्द्र शूर वस्वीरस्मे भूवन्नभिष्टयः । वयंवयं त आसां सुम्ने स्याम वज्रिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mākudhryagindra śūra vasvīrasme bhūvannabhiṣṭayaḥ | vayaṃvayaṃ ta āsāṃ sumne syāma vajrivaḥ ||

translations.english: Hero, Indra, let not our manifold sacrifices be unavailing, but may we all, thunderer, (through) your(favour) continue in the fruiton of these (our desires).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मे ता त इन्द्र सन्तु सत्याहिंसन्तीरुपस्पृशः । विद्याम यासां भुजो धेनूनां न वज्रिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asme tā ta indra santu satyāhiṃsantīrupaspṛśaḥ | vidyāma yāsāṃ bhujo dhenūnāṃ na vajrivaḥ ||

translations.english: May these our (praises) reaching you, Indra, be successful, doing no detriment (to you), so that,thunderer, we may obtain the benefits derivable from them, as (a cowherd enjoys those) from the kine.

mantras.sanskrit: अहस्ता यदपदी वर्धत क्षाः शचीभिर्वेद्यानाम् । शुष्णं परि प्रदक्षिणिद्विश्वायवे नि शिश्नथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahastā yadapadī vardhata kṣāḥ śacībhirvedyānām | śuṣṇaṃ pari pradakṣiṇidviśvāyave ni śiśnathaḥ ||

translations.english: When the earth which has neither hands nor feet flourished throught the acts of (devotion paid to) theadorable (deities), then you did smite down Śuṣṇa, circumambulating it on the right, for the sake of Viśvāyu.

mantras.sanskrit: पिबापिबेदिन्द्र शूर सोमं मा रिषण्यो वसवान वसुः सन् । उत त्रायस्व गृणतो मघोनो महश्च रायो रेवतस्कृधी नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pibāpibedindra śūra somaṃ mā riṣaṇyo vasavāna vasuḥ san | uta trāyasva gṛṇato maghono mahaśca rāyo revataskṛdhī naḥ ||

translations.english: Drink, hero Indra, drink the Soma; being excellent, harm (us) not, possessor of opulence; preservethose who praise you, and are affluent (in offerings), and render us rich with great riches.

mantras.sanskrit: यजामह इन्द्रं वज्रदक्षिणं हरीणां रथ्यं विव्रतानाम् । प्र श्मश्रु दोधुवदूर्ध्वथा भूद्वि सेनाभिर्दयमानो वि राधसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajāmaha indraṃ vajradakṣiṇaṃ harīṇāṃ rathyaṃ vivratānām | pra śmaśru dodhuvadūrdhvathā bhūdvi senābhirdayamāno vi rādhasā ||

translations.english: We worship Indra, being in his right hand the thunderbolt, the driver of the bay horses which havemany functions; shaking his beard, he mounts on high, destroying (his enemies) by his armies he gives wealth (tohis worshippers).

mantras.sanskrit: हरी न्वस्य या वने विदे वस्विन्द्रो मघैर्मघवा वृत्रहा भुवत् । ऋभुर्वाज ऋभुक्षाः पत्यते शवोऽव क्ष्णौमि दासस्य नाम चित् ॥
mantras.transliteration: harī nvasya yā vane vide vasvindro maghairmaghavā vṛtrahā bhuvat | ṛbhurvāja ṛbhukṣāḥ patyate śavo'va kṣṇaumi dāsasya nāma cit ||

translations.english: With his two bay horses which bestow riches at the sacrifice, Indra, wealthy with wealth, is the slayerof Vṛtra; the brilliant, powerful, mighty Indra is the lord of strength; (through him) I cut off the head of the Dāsa.

mantras.sanskrit: यदा वज्रं हिरण्यमिदथा रथं हरी यमस्य वहतो वि सूरिभिः । आ तिष्ठति मघवा सनश्रुत इन्द्रो वाजस्य दीर्घश्रवसस्पतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadā vajraṃ hiraṇyamidathā rathaṃ harī yamasya vahato vi sūribhiḥ | ā tiṣṭhati maghavā sanaśruta indro vājasya dīrghaśravasaspatiḥ ||

translations.english: When he grasps his golden thunderbolt, then the opulent Indra ascends with his praisers, the chariotwhich his two bay horses draw, (Indra) the lord of long-celebrated and widely-renowned food.

mantras.sanskrit: सो चिन्नु वृष्टिर्यूथ्या स्वा सचाँ इन्द्रः श्मश्रूणि हरिताभि प्रुष्णुते । अव वेति सुक्षयं सुते मधूदिद्धूनोति वातो यथा वनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: so cinnu vṛṣṭiryūthyā svā sacā~ indraḥ śmaśrūṇi haritābhi pruṣṇute | ava veti sukṣayaṃ sute madhūdiddhūnoti vāto yathā vanam ||

translations.english: As the rain (bedews all), so, Indra, accompanied by his troops (of the Maruts), sprinkles their beards,with the green (Soma); he repairs to the plural asant chamber (of sacrifice); (the Soma) beign effused, the sweetSoma agitates (his frame), as the breeze (shakes) the forest.

mantras.sanskrit: यो वाचा विवाचो मृध्रवाचः पुरू सहस्राशिवा जघान । तत्तदिदस्य पौंस्यं गृणीमसि पितेव यस्तविषीं वावृधे शवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo vācā vivāco mṛdhravācaḥ purū sahasrāśivā jaghāna | tattadidasya pauṃsyaṃ gṛṇīmasi piteva yastaviṣīṃ vāvṛdhe śavaḥ ||

translations.english: We praise his manhood, who, having by his voice alone made the many- tongued speechless has slainmany thousand enemies, who supports the strength (of the world) as a father the strength (of his son).

mantras.sanskrit: स्तोमं त इन्द्र विमदा अजीजनन्नपूर्व्यं पुरुतमं सुदानवे । विद्मा ह्यस्य भोजनमिनस्य यदा पशुं न गोपाः करामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: stomaṃ ta indra vimadā ajījanannapūrvyaṃ purutamaṃ sudānave | vidmā hyasya bhojanaminasya yadā paśuṃ na gopāḥ karāmahe ||

translations.english: We Vimadas, have genitive rated this your unprecedented, and most varied praise, Indra, to obtain yourbounty; as we know what the opulence of that lord is, (therefore) we call it (before us), as a cowherd (calls) hiscattle. attachment, divine (Indra), to be like that of a sister (to a brother) so may the friendship between us and youprosper.

mantras.sanskrit: माकिर्न एना सख्या वि यौषुस्तव चेन्द्र विमदस्य च ऋषेः । विद्मा हि ते प्रमतिं देव जामिवदस्मे ते सन्तु सख्या शिवानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: mākirna enā sakhyā vi yauṣustava cendra vimadasya ca ṛṣeḥ | vidmā hi te pramatiṃ deva jāmivadasme te santu sakhyā śivāni ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र सोममिमं पिब मधुमन्तं चमू सुतम् । अस्मे रयिं नि धारय वि वो मदे सहस्रिणं पुरूवसो विवक्षसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra somamimaṃ piba madhumantaṃ camū sutam | asme rayiṃ ni dhāraya vi vo made sahasriṇaṃ purūvaso vivakṣase ||

translations.english: Drink, Indra, this most sweet Soma, expressed by the plural nks (of the Soma-press), then bestow uponus riches in your exhilaration; thousandfold (riches), lord of infinite wealth; you are mighty.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वां यज्ञेभिरुक्थैरुप हव्येभिरीमहे । शचीपते शचीनां वि वो मदे श्रेष्ठं नो धेहि वार्यं विवक्षसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāṃ yajñebhirukthairupa havyebhirīmahe | śacīpate śacīnāṃ vi vo made śreṣṭhaṃ no dhehi vāryaṃ vivakṣase ||

translations.english: We solicit you with sacrifices, with prayers, with oblations; lord of all pious acts, grant us in yourexhilaration, excellent and desirable (affluence); you are mighty.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्पतिर्वार्याणामसि रध्रस्य चोदिता । इन्द्र स्तोतॄणामविता वि वो मदे द्विषो नः पाह्यंहसो विवक्षसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaspatirvāryāṇāmasi radhrasya coditā | indra stotṝṇāmavitā vi vo made dviṣo naḥ pāhyaṃhaso vivakṣase ||

translations.english: Indra, who are the lord of desirable (riches), the encourager of the worshipper, the protector of theeulogists, defend us, in your exhilaration, from adversaries, (guard us) from sin, you are mighty.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं शक्रा मायाविना समीची निरमन्थतम् । विमदेन यदीळिता नासत्या निरमन्थतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ śakrā māyāvinā samīcī niramanthatam | vimadena yadīḷitā nāsatyā niramanthatam ||

translations.english: Powerful and sagacious (Aśvins) mutually associated, you have churned forth (the fire); when you,Nāsatyās, glorified by Vimada, have churned it forth.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वे देवा अकृपन्त समीच्योर्निष्पतन्त्योः । नासत्यावब्रुवन्देवाः पुनरा वहतादिति ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśve devā akṛpanta samīcyorniṣpatantyoḥ | nāsatyāvabruvandevāḥ punarā vahatāditi ||

translations.english: All the gods praised you as you were mutually associated, and caused (the sparks) to fly up; the godshave said to the two Nāsatyās, "let the fire again bear (us oblations)"].

mantras.sanskrit: मधुमन्मे परायणं मधुमत्पुनरायनम् । ता नो देवा देवतया युवं मधुमतस्कृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: madhumanme parāyaṇaṃ madhumatpunarāyanam | tā no devā devatayā yuvaṃ madhumataskṛtam ||

translations.english: May my going forth be plural asant, may my coming back be plural asant, you two divine Aśvins, render us,through your divine power, possessed of plural asure.

mantras.sanskrit: भद्रं नो अपि वातय मनो दक्षमुत क्रतुम् । अधा ते सख्ये अन्धसो वि वो मदे रणन्गावो न यवसे विवक्षसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhadraṃ no api vātaya mano dakṣamuta kratum | adhā te sakhye andhaso vi vo made raṇangāvo na yavase vivakṣase ||

translations.english: Sanctify (Soma) our mind, our heart, our intellect; and may (your worshippers) delight in yourfriendship, like cattle in fresh pasture, in your exhilaration (produced) by the (sacrificial) food; for you are mighty.

mantras.sanskrit: हृदिस्पृशस्त आसते विश्वेषु सोम धामसु । अधा कामा इमे मम वि वो मदे वि तिष्ठन्ते वसूयवो विवक्षसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: hṛdispṛśasta āsate viśveṣu soma dhāmasu | adhā kāmā ime mama vi vo made vi tiṣṭhante vasūyavo vivakṣase ||

translations.english: They who seek to touch your heart, Soma, worship you in all plural ces; and these desires for wealth risefrom my heart at your exhilaration; for you are mighty.

mantras.sanskrit: उत व्रतानि सोम ते प्राहं मिनामि पाक्या । अधा पितेव सूनवे वि वो मदे मृळा नो अभि चिद्वधाद्विवक्षसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta vratāni soma te prāhaṃ mināmi pākyā | adhā piteva sūnave vi vo made mṛḷā no abhi cidvadhādvivakṣase ||

translations.english: Verily, Soma, I practise all your observances with fullness; and as a father to his son, so do you inyour exhilaration make us happy; protect us from being killed (by our enemies); for you are mighty.

mantras.sanskrit: समु प्र यन्ति धीतयः सर्गासोऽवताँ इव । क्रतुं नः सोम जीवसे वि वो मदे धारया चमसाँ इव विवक्षसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: samu pra yanti dhītayaḥ sargāso'vatā~ iva | kratuṃ naḥ soma jīvase vi vo made dhārayā camasā~ iva vivakṣase ||

translations.english: Our praises converge (Soma) towards you, as herds towards a well; establish our pious acts, Soma,for us to live (long), as (the priest sets up) the cups for your exhilaration; for you are mighty.

mantras.sanskrit: तव त्ये सोम शक्तिभिर्निकामासो व्यृण्विरे । गृत्सस्य धीरास्तवसो वि वो मदे व्रजं गोमन्तमश्विनं विवक्षसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava tye soma śaktibhirnikāmāso vyṛṇvire | gṛtsasya dhīrāstavaso vi vo made vrajaṃ gomantamaśvinaṃ vivakṣase ||

translations.english: The intelligent (priests), whose desires are fixed (on the fruit of good works), with sacred rites showforth (the praises) of you, Soma, who are wise and powerful; do you, in your exhilaration, (grant us) pastures,abounding with cattle, and with horses; for you are mighty.

mantras.sanskrit: पशुं नः सोम रक्षसि पुरुत्रा विष्ठितं जगत् । समाकृणोषि जीवसे वि वो मदे विश्वा सम्पश्यन्भुवना विवक्षसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: paśuṃ naḥ soma rakṣasi purutrā viṣṭhitaṃ jagat | samākṛṇoṣi jīvase vi vo made viśvā sampaśyanbhuvanā vivakṣase ||

translations.english: You protect our cattle, Soma, and the variously occupied world, contemplating all existing beings; youprepare (the world) for them to live in for your exhilaration; for you are mighty.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं नः सोम विश्वतो गोपा अदाभ्यो भव । सेध राजन्नप स्रिधो वि वो मदे मा नो दुःशंस ईशता विवक्षसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ naḥ soma viśvato gopā adābhyo bhava | sedha rājannapa sridho vi vo made mā no duḥśaṃsa īśatā vivakṣase ||

translations.english: Be on all sides our preserver, Soma, you, who are unassailable; drive away, monarch, our adversariesin your exhilaration, and let no calumniator rule over us; for you are mighty.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं नः सोम सुक्रतुर्वयोधेयाय जागृहि । क्षेत्रवित्तरो मनुषो वि वो मदे द्रुहो नः पाह्यंहसो विवक्षसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ naḥ soma sukraturvayodheyāya jāgṛhi | kṣetravittaro manuṣo vi vo made druho naḥ pāhyaṃhaso vivakṣase ||

translations.english: Soma, author of good works, liberal granter of fields, be vigilant in supplying us with food; and in your

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं नो वृत्रहन्तमेन्द्रस्येन्दो शिवः सखा । यत्सीं हवन्ते समिथे वि वो मदे युध्यमानास्तोकसातौ विवक्षसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ no vṛtrahantamendrasyendo śivaḥ sakhā | yatsīṃ havante samithe vi vo made yudhyamānāstokasātau vivakṣase ||

translations.english: Utter destroyer of enemies, Soma, who are the auspicious friend of Indra, (protect us), when hostilewarriors everywhere call us to the combat that bestows offsprin; by your exhilration (preserve us); for you aremighty.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं घ स तुरो मद इन्द्रस्य वर्धत प्रियः । अयं कक्षीवतो महो वि वो मदे मतिं विप्रस्य वर्धयद्विवक्षसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ gha sa turo mada indrasya vardhata priyaḥ | ayaṃ kakṣīvato maho vi vo made matiṃ viprasya vardhayadvivakṣase ||

translations.english: Such is the Soma which, swiftly moving, exhilarating, acceptable to Indra, has given increase (to ourunderstanding); it has increased the intelligence of the great and pious Kakṣīvat in your exhilaration; for youare mighty.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं विप्राय दाशुषे वाजाँ इयर्ति गोमतः । अयं सप्तभ्य आ वरं वि वो मदे प्रान्धं श्रोणं च तारिषद्विवक्षसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ viprāya dāśuṣe vājā~ iyarti gomataḥ | ayaṃ saptabhya ā varaṃ vi vo made prāndhaṃ śroṇaṃ ca tāriṣadvivakṣase ||

translations.english: This Soma bestows, upon the pious donor of the libation, food with cattle; it gives wealth to the seven(priests) in the manifold exhilaration; it has restored (their faculties) to the blind, and the lame.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ह्यच्छा मनीषा स्पार्हा यन्ति नियुतः । प्र दस्रा नियुद्रथः पूषा अविष्टु माहिनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra hyacchā manīṣā spārhā yanti niyutaḥ | pra dasrā niyudrathaḥ pūṣā aviṣṭu māhinaḥ ||

translations.english: Since our appointed and acceptable prayers proceed to him, may the mighty Pūṣan, of plural asingaspect, whose care is ever harnessed, protect us.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य त्यन्महित्वं वाताप्यमयं जनः । विप्र आ वंसद्धीतिभिश्चिकेत सुष्टुतीनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya tyanmahitvaṃ vātāpyamayaṃ janaḥ | vipra ā vaṃsaddhītibhiściketa suṣṭutīnām ||

translations.english: (May e) whose greatness (manifested as) the matured rain, this pious man celebrates with piousrites-- may he be cognizant of such excellent praises.

mantras.sanskrit: स वेद सुष्टुतीनामिन्दुर्न पूषा वृषा । अभि प्सुरः प्रुषायति व्रजं न आ प्रुषायति ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa veda suṣṭutīnāmindurna pūṣā vṛṣā | abhi psuraḥ pruṣāyati vrajaṃ na ā pruṣāyati ||

translations.english: He, Pūṣan, is cognizant of such excellent praises; like Soma he is the showerer (of benefits); thegraceful deity rains down upon us, he rains upon our cow-pastures.

mantras.sanskrit: मंसीमहि त्वा वयमस्माकं देव पूषन् । मतीनां च साधनं विप्राणां चाधवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: maṃsīmahi tvā vayamasmākaṃ deva pūṣan | matīnāṃ ca sādhanaṃ viprāṇāṃ cādhavam ||

translations.english: We glorify you, divine Pūṣan, the accomplisher of our desires, who make the pious to quake.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रत्यर्धिर्यज्ञानामश्वहयो रथानाम् । ऋषिः स यो मनुर्हितो विप्रस्य यावयत्सखः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pratyardhiryajñānāmaśvahayo rathānām | ṛṣiḥ sa yo manurhito viprasya yāvayatsakhaḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: आधीषमाणायाः पतिः शुचायाश्च शुचस्य च । वासोवायोऽवीनामा वासांसि मर्मृजत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ādhīṣamāṇāyāḥ patiḥ śucāyāśca śucasya ca | vāsovāyo'vīnāmā vāsāṃsi marmṛjat ||

translations.english: Lord both of the pure desirable (she-goat), and of the pure (he-goat); weave3r of the cloth (of thewool) of the sheep; he has cleansed the vestments.

mantras.sanskrit: इनो वाजानां पतिरिनः पुष्टीनां सखा । प्र श्मश्रु हर्यतो दूधोद्वि वृथा यो अदाभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ino vājānāṃ patirinaḥ puṣṭīnāṃ sakhā | pra śmaśru haryato dūdhodvi vṛthā yo adābhyaḥ ||

translations.english: The ruler, the lord of viands, the soverign, the friend of the contentment (of all); he who isunassailable, genitive ly shakes his beard (when drinking the Soma of the sacrificer), desiring (his favour).

mantras.sanskrit: आ ते रथस्य पूषन्नजा धुरं ववृत्युः । विश्वस्यार्थिनः सखा सनोजा अनपच्युतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā te rathasya pūṣannajā dhuraṃ vavṛtyuḥ | viśvasyārthinaḥ sakhā sanojā anapacyutaḥ ||

translations.english: THe goats, Pūṣan, bear the burden of your car, who are the friend of every suppliant, born long ago,never-failing (in your duty).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्माकमूर्जा रथं पूषा अविष्टु माहिनः । भुवद्वाजानां वृध इमं नः शृणवद्धवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmākamūrjā rathaṃ pūṣā aviṣṭu māhinaḥ | bhuvadvājānāṃ vṛdha imaṃ naḥ śṛṇavaddhavam ||

translations.english: May the mighty Pūṣan protect our chariot by his might; may he be to us the augmenter of food; mayhe hear this our invocation.

mantras.sanskrit: असत्सु मे जरितः साभिवेगो यत्सुन्वते यजमानाय शिक्षम् । अनाशीर्दामहमस्मि प्रहन्ता सत्यध्वृतं वृजिनायन्तमाभुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asatsu me jaritaḥ sābhivego yatsunvate yajamānāya śikṣam | anāśīrdāmahamasmi prahantā satyadhvṛtaṃ vṛjināyantamābhum ||

translations.english: (Indra speaks). Such is my plural asant disposition, worshipper, that I help the instrumental tutor of the rite, whooffers libation; but I am the punisher of him who offers not libations, who disregards the truth, the perpetrator ofsin, the malignant.

mantras.sanskrit: यदीदहं युधये संनयान्यदेवयून्तन्वा शूशुजानान् । अमा ते तुम्रं वृषभं पचानि तीव्रं सुतं पञ्चदशं नि षिञ्चम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadīdahaṃ yudhaye saṃnayānyadevayūntanvā śūśujānān | amā te tumraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ pacāni tīvraṃ sutaṃ pañcadaśaṃ ni ṣiñcam ||

translations.english: If I encounter in combat the undevout, resplendent in their bodies, then will I cook a vigorous bull forthem, and will sprinkle (upon the fire) the exhilarating Soma the fifteen-fold (Soma).

mantras.sanskrit: नाहं तं वेद य इति ब्रवीत्यदेवयून्त्समरणे जघन्वान् । यदावाख्यत्समरणमृघावदादिद्ध मे वृषभा प्र ब्रुवन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: nāhaṃ taṃ veda ya iti bravītyadevayūntsamaraṇe jaghanvān | yadāvākhyatsamaraṇamṛghāvadādiddha me vṛṣabhā pra bruvanti ||

translations.english: I know not that man who says that he is the slayer in battle of those who do not reverence the gods;but when (I behold) the fierce war commenced, then (my enemies) proclaim my prowess.

mantras.sanskrit: यदज्ञातेषु वृजनेष्वासं विश्वे सतो मघवानो म आसन् । जिनामि वेत्क्षेम आ सन्तमाभुं प्र तं क्षिणां पर्वते पादगृह्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadajñāteṣu vṛjaneṣvāsaṃ viśve sato maghavāno ma āsan | jināmi vetkṣema ā santamābhuṃ pra taṃ kṣiṇāṃ parvate pādagṛhya ||

translations.english: When I enter upon unprecedented combats, then all those who are affluent in oblations approach meso engaged; I destroy the mighty and overpowering foe for the protection of the world, and, seizing him by thefeet, throw him down from the mountain.

mantras.sanskrit: न वा उ मां वृजने वारयन्ते न पर्वतासो यदहं मनस्ये । मम स्वनात्कृधुकर्णो भयात एवेदनु द्यून्किरणः समेजात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: na vā u māṃ vṛjane vārayante na parvatāso yadahaṃ manasye | mama svanātkṛdhukarṇo bhayāta evedanu dyūnkiraṇaḥ samejāt ||

translations.english: None resist me (engaged) in combat, not even the mountains when I am resolved; at my shout the dullof hearing is alarmed, and so too even the bright- rayed (sun) trembles day by day.

mantras.sanskrit: दर्शन्न्वत्र शृतपाँ अनिन्द्रान्बाहुक्षदः शरवे पत्यमानान् । घृषुं वा ये निनिदुः सखायमध्यू न्वेषु पवयो ववृत्युः ॥
mantras.transliteration: darśannvatra śṛtapā~ anindrānbāhukṣadaḥ śarave patyamānān | ghṛṣuṃ vā ye niniduḥ sakhāyamadhyū nveṣu pavayo vavṛtyuḥ ||

translations.english: Beholding here the drinkers of the libations who serve not Indra, who cut (the worshippers) to pieceswith their hands, assailing them to do them harm; my shafts quickly fall upon them, as well as on those who revile(your) powerful friend. all existence; the ancient Indra verily destroys (his foe), the other does not destroy (Indra). The united two(heaven and earth) surpass not him who extends beyond the confines of the universe.

mantras.sanskrit: अभूर्वौक्षीर्व्यु आयुरानड्दर्षन्नु पूर्वो अपरो नु दर्षत् । द्वे पवस्ते परि तं न भूतो यो अस्य पारे रजसो विवेष ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhūrvaukṣīrvyu āyurānaḍdarṣannu pūrvo aparo nu darṣat | dve pavaste pari taṃ na bhūto yo asya pāre rajaso viveṣa ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: गावो यवं प्रयुता अर्यो अक्षन्ता अपश्यं सहगोपाश्चरन्तीः । हवा इदर्यो अभितः समायन्कियदासु स्वपतिश्छन्दयाते ॥
mantras.transliteration: gāvo yavaṃ prayutā aryo akṣantā apaśyaṃ sahagopāścarantīḥ | havā idaryo abhitaḥ samāyankiyadāsu svapatiśchandayāte ||

translations.english: The assembled cattle feed upon the barley; I their master have beheld them grazing, tended by theherdsman; when called, they collect around their lord; when they approach, how much milk does he desire (totake)?

mantras.sanskrit: सं यद्वयं यवसादो जनानामहं यवाद उर्वज्रे अन्तः । अत्रा युक्तोऽवसातारमिच्छादथो अयुक्तं युनजद्ववन्वान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ yadvayaṃ yavasādo janānāmahaṃ yavāda urvajre antaḥ | atrā yukto'vasātāramicchādatho ayuktaṃ yunajadvavanvān ||

translations.english: When we, the grass-eaters of men, (are) together, I (am) among the barley-eaters in the wide field;here he who is yoked would like one to unloose him, and the assailant would yoke him who is unyoked.

mantras.sanskrit: अत्रेदु मे मंससे सत्यमुक्तं द्विपाच्च यच्चतुष्पात्संसृजानि । स्त्रीभिर्यो अत्र वृषणं पृतन्यादयुद्धो अस्य वि भजानि वेदः ॥
mantras.transliteration: atredu me maṃsase satyamuktaṃ dvipācca yaccatuṣpātsaṃsṛjāni | strībhiryo atra vṛṣaṇaṃ pṛtanyādayuddho asya vi bhajāni vedaḥ ||

translations.english: (Indra speaks). You know that what is said by me at this time is the truth, that I may create both bipedsand quadrupeds. I distribute without conflict (among my worshippers) the wealth (that I have taken from him), who(neglecting me), the showerer of desires), wishes to contend with women.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्यानक्षा दुहिता जात्वास कस्तां विद्वाँ अभि मन्याते अन्धाम् । कतरो मेनिं प्रति तं मुचाते य ईं वहाते य ईं वा वरेयात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasyānakṣā duhitā jātvāsa kastāṃ vidvā~ abhi manyāte andhām | kataro meniṃ prati taṃ mucāte ya īṃ vahāte ya īṃ vā vareyāt ||

translations.english: What (other god but me) whose eyeless daughter is ever present knows her and honours (her) theblind one; which of the two (deities) lets loose that bolt against (a foe)-- he who assails, (or) he who protects hiṃ

mantras.sanskrit: कियती योषा मर्यतो वधूयोः परिप्रीता पन्यसा वार्येण । भद्रा वधूर्भवति यत्सुपेशाः स्वयं सा मित्रं वनुते जने चित् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kiyatī yoṣā maryato vadhūyoḥ pariprītā panyasā vāryeṇa | bhadrā vadhūrbhavati yatsupeśāḥ svayaṃ sā mitraṃ vanute jane cit ||

translations.english: How many a woman has been gratified by the flattering praise of man's desire, when the bride isfortunate and beautiful, she of herself chooses her husband among men.

mantras.sanskrit: पत्तो जगार प्रत्यञ्चमत्ति शीर्ष्णा शिरः प्रति दधौ वरूथम् । आसीन ऊर्ध्वामुपसि क्षिणाति न्यङ्ङुत्तानामन्वेति भूमिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: patto jagāra pratyañcamatti śīrṣṇā śiraḥ prati dadhau varūtham | āsīna ūrdhvāmupasi kṣiṇāti nyaṅṅuttānāmanveti bhūmim ||

translations.english: He seizes (it) with his feet, he swallows it when it approaches him, he plural ces the head (of heaven) asa guard around his head; seated (above) he sends (his rays) upwards to the proximate heaven; he send themdownwards, on the outspread earth.

mantras.sanskrit: बृहन्नच्छायो अपलाशो अर्वा तस्थौ माता विषितो अत्ति गर्भः । अन्यस्या वत्सं रिहती मिमाय कया भुवा नि दधे धेनुरूधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhannacchāyo apalāśo arvā tasthau mātā viṣito atti garbhaḥ | anyasyā vatsaṃ rihatī mimāya kayā bhuvā ni dadhe dhenurūdhaḥ ||

translations.english: The great (sun), shadeless, undecaying, ever-moving, abides; the builder (of the world), who isliberated, the germ (of the three worlds), eats (the oblations), fondling the offspring of another (mother), heconstructs (the quarters of the world); with what design has the cow offered her udder?

mantras.sanskrit: सप्त वीरासो अधरादुदायन्नष्टोत्तरात्तात्समजग्मिरन्ते । नव पश्चातात्स्थिविमन्त आयन्दश प्राक्सानु वि तिरन्त्यश्नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sapta vīrāso adharādudāyannaṣṭottarāttātsamajagmirante | nava paścātātsthivimanta āyandaśa prāksānu vi tirantyaśnaḥ ||

translations.english: Seven sages sprang from the lower portion (of Indra as Prajāpati); eight were born from the upperportion; nine occupants of stations came from behind, and ten, genitive rated in the front, partaking of food,eight vālakhilyas; nine bhṛgus; ten aṅgirasas; or, seven Maruts on Indra's right, eight on his left, nine behindhim, and ten in front].

mantras.sanskrit: दशानामेकं कपिलं समानं तं हिन्वन्ति क्रतवे पार्याय । गर्भं माता सुधितं वक्षणास्ववेनन्तं तुषयन्ती बिभर्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: daśānāmekaṃ kapilaṃ samānaṃ taṃ hinvanti kratave pāryāya | garbhaṃ mātā sudhitaṃ vakṣaṇāsvavenantaṃ tuṣayantī bibharti ||

translations.english: (The other aṅgirasas) despatched one of the ten, Kapila, as equal (to the task) for the completion ofthe sacrifice; the gratified mother cherishes the embryo well-deposited in the waters, and not desirous of anabiding plural ce.

mantras.sanskrit: पीवानं मेषमपचन्त वीरा न्युप्ता अक्षा अनु दीव आसन् । द्वा धनुं बृहतीमप्स्वन्तः पवित्रवन्ता चरतः पुनन्ता ॥
mantras.transliteration: pīvānaṃ meṣamapacanta vīrā nyuptā akṣā anu dīva āsan | dvā dhanuṃ bṛhatīmapsvantaḥ pavitravantā carataḥ punantā ||

translations.english: The sages cooked a fat ram; they followed (prajāpati) in succession like dice thrown in gambling; two(of them), having the means of purification and becoming purified, proceed in the midst of the waters to (Prakṛti)the augmenter, to (Kapila) the implement of destruction.

mantras.sanskrit: वि क्रोशनासो विष्वञ्च आयन्पचाति नेमो नहि पक्षदर्धः । अयं मे देवः सविता तदाह द्र्वन्न इद्वनवत्सर्पिरन्नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi krośanāso viṣvañca āyanpacāti nemo nahi pakṣadardhaḥ | ayaṃ me devaḥ savitā tadāha drvanna idvanavatsarpirannaḥ ||

translations.english: They (the Aṅgirasas) go in all directions calling (upon Prajāpati), half of them cook (their oblations),the other half cook not; this divine Savitā has told me this-- (Agni), whose food is wood and ghī, serves(Prajāpati by means of oblations).

mantras.sanskrit: अपश्यं ग्रामं वहमानमारादचक्रया स्वधया वर्तमानम् । सिषक्त्यर्यः प्र युगा जनानां सद्यः शिश्ना प्रमिनानो नवीयान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: apaśyaṃ grāmaṃ vahamānamārādacakrayā svadhayā vartamānam | siṣaktyaryaḥ pra yugā janānāṃ sadyaḥ śiśnā pramināno navīyān ||

translations.english: I beheld the crowd coming from afar, moving of themselves without wheels; the lord of all, (Indra),regulates the seasons (worship of men), younger in vigour, destroying at once the herds of evil beings.

mantras.sanskrit: एतौ मे गावौ प्रमरस्य युक्तौ मो षु प्र सेधीर्मुहुरिन्ममन्धि । आपश्चिदस्य वि नशन्त्यर्थं सूरश्च मर्क उपरो बभूवान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: etau me gāvau pramarasya yuktau mo ṣu pra sedhīrmuhurinmamandhi | āpaścidasya vi naśantyarthaṃ sūraśca marka uparo babhūvān ||

translations.english: Turn not back, but repeatedly praise these two yoked (steeds) of me the destroyer, which advance (tothe foe and to the sacrifice); the waters fulfil Indra's purpose and (so does) the all-cleansing sun, being (swift as)a cloud.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं यो वज्रः पुरुधा विवृत्तोऽवः सूर्यस्य बृहतः पुरीषात् । श्रव इदेना परो अन्यदस्ति तदव्यथी जरिमाणस्तरन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ yo vajraḥ purudhā vivṛtto'vaḥ sūryasya bṛhataḥ purīṣāt | śrava idenā paro anyadasti tadavyathī jarimāṇastaranti ||

translations.english: This is the thunderbolt which repeatedly falls (on those who are) below the orb of the vast sun; theworshippers easily cause this water (in the sun's orb) above which is differnet form that (in the clouds) to passthrough (the firmament).

mantras.sanskrit: वृक्षेवृक्षे नियता मीमयद्गौस्ततो वयः प्र पतान्पूरुषादः । अथेदं विश्वं भुवनं भयात इन्द्राय सुन्वदृषये च शिक्षत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛkṣevṛkṣe niyatā mīmayadgaustato vayaḥ pra patānpūruṣādaḥ | athedaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ bhayāta indrāya sunvadṛṣaye ca śikṣat ||

translations.english: The bowstring fixed to each bow clangs loudly; then the man-destroying (shafts like) birds fall upon(the foes); and the whole of this world is alarmed, presentinglibations to Indra, and donations to the Ṛṣis.

mantras.sanskrit: देवानां माने प्रथमा अतिष्ठन्कृन्तत्रादेषामुपरा उदायन् । त्रयस्तपन्ति पृथिवीमनूपा द्वा बृबूकं वहतः पुरीषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: devānāṃ māne prathamā atiṣṭhankṛntatrādeṣāmuparā udāyan | trayastapanti pṛthivīmanūpā dvā bṛbūkaṃ vahataḥ purīṣam ||

translations.english: At the creation of the gods, the (clouds) stood first; from their division, the waters (of the rain) cameforth; the three divinities (Parjanya, Vāyu and Āditya). Sowing in succession, warm the earth; two of them(Vāyu and Āditya) convey all-delighting water (to the sun's sphere).

mantras.sanskrit: सा ते जीवातुरुत तस्य विद्धि मा स्मैतादृगप गूहः समर्ये । आविः स्वः कृणुते गूहते बुसं स पादुरस्य निर्णिजो न मुच्यते ॥
mantras.transliteration: sā te jīvāturuta tasya viddhi mā smaitādṛgapa gūhaḥ samarye | āviḥ svaḥ kṛṇute gūhate busaṃ sa pādurasya nirṇijo na mucyate ||

translations.english: That your (divine) nature identified with the (sun) is the cause of life; and know such (solar form) of his(to be worthy of adoration) at the sacrifice; conceal nothing; that motion of him the all-cleansing (sun) makesmanifest the universe; it absorbs the moisture; it is never discontinued.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वो ह्यन्यो अरिराजगाम ममेदह श्वशुरो ना जगाम । जक्षीयाद्धाना उत सोमं पपीयात्स्वाशितः पुनरस्तं जगायात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvo hyanyo arirājagāma mamedaha śvaśuro nā jagāma | jakṣīyāddhānā uta somaṃ papīyātsvāśitaḥ punarastaṃ jagāyāt ||

translations.english: (The wife of Vasukra speaks). Every other (divine) lord has come, but my father-in-law has notcome;may he eat the parched grain; and drink the Soma; when he is well-satisfied, may he return home.

mantras.sanskrit: स रोरुवद्वृषभस्तिग्मशृङ्गो वर्ष्मन्तस्थौ वरिमन्ना पृथिव्याः । विश्वेष्वेनं वृजनेषु पामि यो मे कुक्षी सुतसोमः पृणाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa roruvadvṛṣabhastigmaśṛṅgo varṣmantasthau varimannā pṛthivyāḥ | viśveṣvenaṃ vṛjaneṣu pāmi yo me kukṣī sutasomaḥ pṛṇāti ||

translations.english: (Indra speaks). (Indra) the showerer (of blessings), having not rays, abides roaring in the resoundingexpanse of the firmament; in all conflicts I defend him, (Vasukra), who, having effused the libation, fills my flanks.

mantras.sanskrit: अद्रिणा ते मन्दिन इन्द्र तूयान्त्सुन्वन्ति सोमान्पिबसि त्वमेषाम् । पचन्ति ते वृषभाँ अत्सि तेषां पृक्षेण यन्मघवन्हूयमानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adriṇā te mandina indra tūyāntsunvanti somānpibasi tvameṣām | pacanti te vṛṣabhā~ atsi teṣāṃ pṛkṣeṇa yanmaghavanhūyamānaḥ ||

translations.english: (Vasukra speaks). Your worshippers express with the stone fast flowing exhilarating Soma for you, youdrink them; they roast bulls for you, you eat them, when you are invoked, Maghavan, to the sacrificial food.

mantras.sanskrit: इदं सु मे जरितरा चिकिद्धि प्रतीपं शापं नद्यो वहन्ति । लोपाशः सिंहं प्रत्यञ्चमत्साः क्रोष्टा वराहं निरतक्त कक्षात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: idaṃ su me jaritarā cikiddhi pratīpaṃ śāpaṃ nadyo vahanti | lopāśaḥ siṃhaṃ pratyañcamatsāḥ kroṣṭā varāhaṃ niratakta kakṣāt ||

translations.english: Overcomer of foes, (Indra) be cognizant of this my (power, whereby) rivers bear their waterbackwards, and the eater of cut (grass) confronts the lion, the jackal drives the wild boar from his lair.

mantras.sanskrit: कथा त एतदहमा चिकेतं गृत्सस्य पाकस्तवसो मनीषाम् । त्वं नो विद्वाँ ऋतुथा वि वोचो यमर्धं ते मघवन्क्षेम्या धूः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kathā ta etadahamā ciketaṃ gṛtsasya pākastavaso manīṣām | tvaṃ no vidvā~ ṛtuthā vi voco yamardhaṃ te maghavankṣemyā dhūḥ ||

translations.english: How, Indra, should I yet immature (in understanding), be capable of comprehending this (your power,so as to render fitting) praise to those who are wise and powerful? Therefore, do you who are all-knowinginstruct us in fit season; the portion of your (praise) O Maghavan, which (we offer) is a burden easy to be bornṣ

mantras.sanskrit: एवा हि मां तवसं वर्धयन्ति दिवश्चिन्मे बृहत उत्तरा धूः । पुरू सहस्रा नि शिशामि साकमशत्रंम हि मा जनिता जजान ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā hi māṃ tavasaṃ vardhayanti divaścinme bṛhata uttarā dhūḥ | purū sahasrā ni śiśāmi sākamaśatraṃma hi mā janitā jajāna ||

translations.english: (Indra speaks). Since (your laudations) thus increase my strength, (let the praise of me) who ammighty, (rise) even higher than the heavens. I destroy at once many thousand (of foes), for the genitive rator (of all)has engendered me without an enemy.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा हि मां तवसं जज्ञुरुग्रं कर्मन्कर्मन्वृषणमिन्द्र देवाः । वधीं वृत्रं वज्रेण मन्दसानोऽप व्रजं महिना दाशुषे वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā hi māṃ tavasaṃ jajñurugraṃ karmankarmanvṛṣaṇamindra devāḥ | vadhīṃ vṛtraṃ vajreṇa mandasāno'pa vrajaṃ mahinā dāśuṣe vam ||

translations.english: Since, Indra, the gods have known me to be powerful, fierce in every act, the showerer (of oblations);exulting I have slain Vṛtra with your thunderbolt, and by my might have opened the clouds for the donor (ofoblations).

mantras.sanskrit: देवास आयन्परशूँरबिभ्रन्वना वृश्चन्तो अभि विड्भिरायन् । नि सुद्र्वं दधतो वक्षणासु यत्रा कृपीटमनु तद्दहन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: devāsa āyanparaśū~rabibhranvanā vṛścanto abhi viḍbhirāyan | ni sudrvaṃ dadhato vakṣaṇāsu yatrā kṛpīṭamanu taddahanti ||

translations.english: The gods came, they bare their axes, clearing the woods, they came with men in front of the waters;depositing (the tree) of good wood in the belly (of the river); where the underwood (is), they burnt it up.

mantras.sanskrit: शशः क्षुरं प्रत्यञ्चं जगाराद्रिं लोगेन व्यभेदमारात् । बृहन्तं चिदृहते रन्धयानि वयद्वत्सो वृषभं शूशुवानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaśaḥ kṣuraṃ pratyañcaṃ jagārādriṃ logena vyabhedamārāt | bṛhantaṃ cidṛhate randhayāni vayadvatso vṛṣabhaṃ śūśuvānaḥ ||

translations.english: (Vasukra speaks). The hare graps the assailing beast of prey; with a clod of clay I cleave the distant(mountain); I can compel the great to submit to the small; swelling (with courage) the calf attacks the bulḷ

mantras.sanskrit: सुपर्ण इत्था नखमा सिषायावरुद्धः परिपदं न सिंहः । निरुद्धश्चिन्महिषस्तर्ष्यावान्गोधा तस्मा अयथं कर्षदेतत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: suparṇa itthā nakhamā siṣāyāvaruddhaḥ paripadaṃ na siṃhaḥ | niruddhaścinmahiṣastarṣyāvāngodhā tasmā ayathaṃ karṣadetat ||

translations.english: The hawk has fastened her claw in heaven; a lion confined (in a cage) plural ces one foot over the otheṛAs a captive buffalo (is) thirsty, (so) Indra thirsted for the Soma, Ga-yatrī brought it to him easily (from heaven).

mantras.sanskrit: तेभ्यो गोधा अयथं कर्षदेतद्ये ब्रह्मणः प्रतिपीयन्त्यन्नैः । सिम उक्ष्णोऽवसृष्टाँ अदन्ति स्वयं बलानि तन्वः शृणानाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tebhyo godhā ayathaṃ karṣadetadye brahmaṇaḥ pratipīyantyannaiḥ | sima ukṣṇo'vasṛṣṭā~ adanti svayaṃ balāni tanvaḥ śṛṇānāḥ ||

translations.english: Gāyatrī drew it away without difficulty, for the good of those (gods) who, (satisfied) with the viandsof Indra, retaliate the injuries (of the enemies of the gods); they devour all the sprinkling (Soma libations) left (byIndra), spontaneously destroying the armies and bodies (of the enemy).

mantras.sanskrit: एते शमीभिः सुशमी अभूवन्ये हिन्विरे तन्वः सोम उक्थैः । नृवद्वदन्नुप नो माहि वाजान्दिवि श्रवो दधिषे नाम वीरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ete śamībhiḥ suśamī abhūvanye hinvire tanvaḥ soma ukthaiḥ | nṛvadvadannupa no māhi vājāndivi śravo dadhiṣe nāma vīraḥ ||

translations.english: They have been sanctified by holy rites, who have fostered their bodies with prayers, at the Soma(sacrifice); speaking like a man, grant us food, you possess in heaven name and fame as a hero.

mantras.sanskrit: वने न वा यो न्यधायि चाकञ्छुचिर्वां स्तोमो भुरणावजीगः । यस्येदिन्द्रः पुरुदिनेषु होता नृणां नर्यो नृतमः क्षपावान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vane na vā yo nyadhāyi cākañchucirvāṃ stomo bhuraṇāvajīgaḥ | yasyedindraḥ purudineṣu hotā nṛṇāṃ naryo nṛtamaḥ kṣapāvān ||

translations.english: As (the bird) who deposits its young (in its nest) in the tree (is) eagerly looking around, so you bearers(Aśvins) your pure praise (ever) keeps you awake; (that praise) of which Indra has for many days been theinvoker, (Indra) the friend of man, the manliest of men, (to whom the Soma) is offered at night.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ते अस्या उषसः प्रापरस्या नृतौ स्याम नृतमस्य नृणाम् । अनु त्रिशोकः शतमावहन्नॄन्कुत्सेन रथो यो असत्ससवान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra te asyā uṣasaḥ prāparasyā nṛtau syāma nṛtamasya nṛṇām | anu triśokaḥ śatamāvahannṝnkutsena ratho yo asatsasavān ||

translations.english: May we be prosperous at the coming of the present or of any future dawn, (through the adoration) ofyou, the chief leader of men; through your favour Triśoka obtained a hundred followers; the chariot which wascommon to him and you was acquired by Kutsa.

mantras.sanskrit: कस्ते मद इन्द्र रन्त्यो भूद्दुरो गिरो अभ्युग्रो वि धाव । कद्वाहो अर्वागुप मा मनीषा आ त्वा शक्यामुपमं राधो अन्नैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kaste mada indra rantyo bhūdduro giro abhyugro vi dhāva | kadvāho arvāgupa mā manīṣā ā tvā śakyāmupamaṃ rādho annaiḥ ||

translations.english: What sort of exhilaration, Indra, is agreeable to you? You who are powerful hasten to the doors (of thesacrificial chamber) to our praises; when will the Soma be present? (When will) intelligence (come) to me? When,having propitiated you, may I acquire wealth and food?

mantras.sanskrit: कदु द्युम्नमिन्द्र त्वावतो नॄन्कया धिया करसे कन्न आगन् । मित्रो न सत्य उरुगाय भृत्या अन्ने समस्य यदसन्मनीषाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kadu dyumnamindra tvāvato nṝnkayā dhiyā karase kanna āgan | mitro na satya urugāya bhṛtyā anne samasya yadasanmanīṣāḥ ||

translations.english: When, Indra, (having partaken of) our oblation, and by what sacred rite, will you render menresembling you? When will you bring them to us? You, who are widely renowned, are to us like a true friend,(attentive) for our support, when the minds of all were (anxious) for food.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रेरय सूरो अर्थं न पारं ये अस्य कामं जनिधा इव ग्मन् । गिरश्च ये ते तुविजात पूर्वीर्नर इन्द्र प्रतिशिक्षन्त्यन्नैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: preraya sūro arthaṃ na pāraṃ ye asya kāmaṃ janidhā iva gman | giraśca ye te tuvijāta pūrvīrnara indra pratiśikṣantyannaiḥ ||

translations.english: As the sun (brings) the ascetic, do you bring to the end (of existence) (your worshippers), who satisfyyour desire (fo the Soma), as husbands (the desire of their wives); and who (being) leaders of rites, multiformIndra, offer to you ancient praises with (sacrificial) viands.

mantras.sanskrit: मात्रे नु ते सुमिते इन्द्र पूर्वी द्यौर्मज्मना पृथिवी काव्येन । वराय ते घृतवन्तः सुतासः स्वाद्मन्भवन्तु पीतये मधूनि ॥
mantras.transliteration: mātre nu te sumite indra pūrvī dyaurmajmanā pṛthivī kāvyena | varāya te ghṛtavantaḥ sutāsaḥ svādmanbhavantu pītaye madhūni ||

translations.english: By your overwhelming energy, Indra, the vast heaven and earth, the measurers (of all), have beenquickly constructed; may the Soma-libations mixed with ghī be acceptable (to you) who are most excellent; (maythe oblations be) sweet for your drinking.

mantras.sanskrit: आ मध्वो अस्मा असिचन्नमत्रमिन्द्राय पूर्णं स हि सत्यराधाः । स वावृधे वरिमन्ना पृथिव्या अभि क्रत्वा नर्यः पौंस्यैश्च ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā madhvo asmā asicannamatramindrāya pūrṇaṃ sa hi satyarādhāḥ | sa vāvṛdhe varimannā pṛthivyā abhi kratvā naryaḥ pauṃsyaiśca ||

translations.english: (The worshippers) have poured out the vessel full of the sweet (Soma) (into the fire) for that Indra, forhe is true (to his promises) of wealth; Indra, the friend of man, (distinguished) by his actions, and his prowess, ismagnified throughout the expanse of the firmament.

mantras.sanskrit: व्यानळिन्द्रः पृतनाः स्वोजा आस्मै यतन्ते सख्याय पूर्वीः । आ स्मा रथं न पृतनासु तिष्ठ यं भद्रया सुमत्या चोदयासे ॥
mantras.transliteration: vyānaḷindraḥ pṛtanāḥ svojā āsmai yatante sakhyāya pūrvīḥ | ā smā rathaṃ na pṛtanāsu tiṣṭha yaṃ bhadrayā sumatyā codayāse ||

translations.english: The powerful Indra reaches the hosts (of the enemy), the mightiest (hosts) exert themselves to obtainhis friendship; ascend, Indra, that chariot which you direct with favourable intent (to our sacrifice), as a chariot(which you mount) against the armies (of the foe).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र देवत्रा ब्रह्मणे गातुरेत्वपो अच्छा मनसो न प्रयुक्ति । महीं मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धासिं पृथुज्रयसे रीरधा सुवृक्तिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra devatrā brahmaṇe gāturetvapo acchā manaso na prayukti | mahīṃ mitrasya varuṇasya dhāsiṃ pṛthujrayase rīradhā suvṛktim ||

translations.english: (Honoured) by adoration, let the advancing Soma approach the celestial waters like the celerity of themind; offer abundant (sacrificial) food, and perfect praise for the sake of Mitra and Varuṇa, and for (Indra) therapid mover.

mantras.sanskrit: अध्वर्यवो हविष्मन्तो हि भूताच्छाप इतोशतीरुशन्तः । अव याश्चष्टे अरुणः सुपर्णस्तमास्यध्वमूर्मिमद्या सुहस्ताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhvaryavo haviṣmanto hi bhūtācchāpa itośatīruśantaḥ | ava yāścaṣṭe aruṇaḥ suparṇastamāsyadhvamūrmimadyā suhastāḥ ||

translations.english: Priests, since you are charged with the libation, desiring (to present it), proceed to the waters desiring(to receive it), to those (waters) which the red hawk beholds descending (from the clouds); do you,dextrous-handed (priests), cast today that flood (of Soma) into (the consecrated water).

mantras.sanskrit: अध्वर्यवोऽप इता समुद्रमपां नपातं हविषा यजध्वम् । स वो दददूर्मिमद्या सुपूतं तस्मै सोमं मधुमन्तं सुनोत ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhvaryavo'pa itā samudramapāṃ napātaṃ haviṣā yajadhvam | sa vo dadadūrmimadyā supūtaṃ tasmai somaṃ madhumantaṃ sunota ||

translations.english: Go, priests, to the water, to the reservoir; worship the grandson of the waters with oblations; may hetoday give you the consecrated water, and do you pour forth to him the sweet-flavoured Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: यो अनिध्मो दीदयदप्स्वन्तर्यं विप्रास ईळते अध्वरेषु । अपां नपान्मधुमतीरपो दा याभिरिन्द्रो वावृधे वीर्याय ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo anidhmo dīdayadapsvantaryaṃ viprāsa īḷate adhvareṣu | apāṃ napānmadhumatīrapo dā yābhirindro vāvṛdhe vīryāya ||

translations.english: (He) who shines, without fuel, in the midst of the waters, he whom the pious worship at sacrifices,grandson of the waters, give us those sweet waters by which (mixed with the Soma), Indra is elevated toheroism.

mantras.sanskrit: याभिः सोमो मोदते हर्षते च कल्याणीभिर्युवतिभिर्न मर्यः । ता अध्वर्यो अपो अच्छा परेहि यदासिञ्चा ओषधीभिः पुनीतात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yābhiḥ somo modate harṣate ca kalyāṇībhiryuvatibhirna maryaḥ | tā adhvaryo apo acchā parehi yadāsiñcā oṣadhībhiḥ punītāt ||

translations.english: Those waters with which Soma sports and delights as a man (sports) with elegant young damsels; doyou, priest, approach to obtain them; when you sprinkle them (in libation), purify (them with the filter) along withthe plural nts.

mantras.sanskrit: एवेद्यूने युवतयो नमन्त यदीमुशन्नुशतीरेत्यच्छ । सं जानते मनसा सं चिकित्रेऽध्वर्यवो धिषणापश्च देवीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: evedyūne yuvatayo namanta yadīmuśannuśatīretyaccha | saṃ jānate manasā saṃ cikitre'dhvaryavo dhiṣaṇāpaśca devīḥ ||

translations.english: Verily as young damsels welcome a youth when desiring (them), he comes to them desiring (him), sothe priests and their praise and the divine waters agree in mind and contemplate (their mutual assistance).

mantras.sanskrit: यो वो वृताभ्यो अकृणोदु लोकं यो वो मह्या अभिशस्तेरमुञ्चत् । तस्मा इन्द्राय मधुमन्तमूर्मिं देवमादनं प्र हिणोतनापः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo vo vṛtābhyo akṛṇodu lokaṃ yo vo mahyā abhiśasteramuñcat | tasmā indrāya madhumantamūrmiṃ devamādanaṃ pra hiṇotanāpaḥ ||

translations.english: Present, waters, the sweet-flavoured god-exhilarating mixture to that Indra who has made an issue foryou when enveloped (by the clouds); who has liberated you from a great calamity.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रास्मै हिनोत मधुमन्तमूर्मिं गर्भो यो वः सिन्धवो मध्व उत्सः । घृतपृष्ठमीड्यमध्वरेष्वापो रेवतीः शृणुता हवं मे ॥
mantras.transliteration: prāsmai hinota madhumantamūrmiṃ garbho yo vaḥ sindhavo madhva utsaḥ | ghṛtapṛṣṭhamīḍyamadhvareṣvāpo revatīḥ śṛṇutā havaṃ me ||

translations.english: Send forth, rivers, the sweet-flavoured beverage to him who is your germ, a well of the sweet (Soma),the Soma which is mixed with butter adorable at sacrifices; hear, opulent waters my invocation.

mantras.sanskrit: तं सिन्धवो मत्सरमिन्द्रपानमूर्मिं प्र हेत य उभे इयर्ति । मदच्युतमौशानं नभोजां परि त्रितन्तुं विचरन्तमुत्सम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ sindhavo matsaramindrapānamūrmiṃ pra heta ya ubhe iyarti | madacyutamauśānaṃ nabhojāṃ pari tritantuṃ vicarantamutsam ||
