translations.english: Send, rivers, (to our sacrifice), that exhilarating wave the Soma of Indra, which sends us both (kinds offruit), exciting exhilaration, desirous (of mixing with the Soma). genitive rated in the firmament, spreading through thethree (worlds), flowing (amidst the vessels of sacrifices), a well (of satisfaction to the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: आवर्वृततीरध नु द्विधारा गोषुयुधो न नियवं चरन्तीः । ऋषे जनित्रीर्भुवनस्य पत्नीरपो वन्दस्व सवृधः सयोनीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: āvarvṛtatīradha nu dvidhārā goṣuyudho na niyavaṃ carantīḥ | ṛṣe janitrīrbhuvanasya patnīrapo vandasva savṛdhaḥ sayonīḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: हिनोता नो अध्वरं देवयज्या हिनोत ब्रह्म सनये धनानाम् । ऋतस्य योगे वि ष्यध्वमूधः श्रुष्टीवरीर्भूतनास्मभ्यमापः ॥
mantras.transliteration: hinotā no adhvaraṃ devayajyā hinota brahma sanaye dhanānām | ṛtasya yoge vi ṣyadhvamūdhaḥ śruṣṭīvarīrbhūtanāsmabhyamāpaḥ ||

translations.english: Direct our sacrifice to the worship of the gods; direct our adoration to the acquisition of wealth; openthe udder on the occasion of (this) rite; be to us, waters, the givers of felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: आपो रेवतीः क्षयथा हि वस्वः क्रतुं च भद्रं बिभृथामृतं च । रायश्च स्थ स्वपत्यस्य पत्नीः सरस्वती तद्गृणते वयो धात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: āpo revatīḥ kṣayathā hi vasvaḥ kratuṃ ca bhadraṃ bibhṛthāmṛtaṃ ca | rāyaśca stha svapatyasya patnīḥ sarasvatī tadgṛṇate vayo dhāt ||

translations.english: Opulent waters, you rule over riches; you support good fortune, pious rites, and immortality; you arethe protectresses of wealth and of offspring; may Sarasvatī bestow all this opulence on him who praises you.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रति यदापो अदृश्रमायतीर्घृतं पयांसि बिभ्रतीर्मधूनि । अध्वर्युभिर्मनसा संविदाना इन्द्राय सोमं सुषुतं भरन्तीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prati yadāpo adṛśramāyatīrghṛtaṃ payāṃsi bibhratīrmadhūni | adhvaryubhirmanasā saṃvidānā indrāya somaṃ suṣutaṃ bharantīḥ ||

translations.english: I behold you, waters, coming to (the sacrifice), conveying the butter, the water, the sweet (Soma);conversing mentally with the priests, and bringing the well-effused Soma for Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: एमा अग्मन्रेवतीर्जीवधन्या अध्वर्यवः सादयता सखायः । नि बर्हिषि धत्तन सोम्यासोऽपां नप्त्रा संविदानास एनाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: emā agmanrevatīrjīvadhanyā adhvaryavaḥ sādayatā sakhāyaḥ | ni barhiṣi dhattana somyāso'pāṃ naptrā saṃvidānāsa enāḥ ||

translations.english: These opulent and life-sustaining (waters) have come (to my sacrifice); friendly priests, make them sitdown; plural ce them on the sacred grass, you offerers of the Soma, conversing with the grandson of the waters.

mantras.sanskrit: आग्मन्नाप उशतीर्बर्हिरेदं न्यध्वरे असदन्देवयन्तीः । अध्वर्यवः सुनुतेन्द्राय सोममभूदु वः सुशका देवयज्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: āgmannāpa uśatīrbarhiredaṃ nyadhvare asadandevayantīḥ | adhvaryavaḥ sunutendrāya somamabhūdu vaḥ suśakā devayajyā ||

translations.english: The waters desiring (it) have come to this sacred grass, and wishing to satisfy the gods, have satdown at our sacrifice; express priests, the Soma for Indrra; for you the worship of the gods is easy.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो देवानामुप वेतु शंसो विश्वेभिस्तुरैरवसे यजत्रः । तेभिर्वयं सुषखायो भवेम तरन्तो विश्वा दुरिता स्याम ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no devānāmupa vetu śaṃso viśvebhisturairavase yajatraḥ | tebhirvayaṃ suṣakhāyo bhavema taranto viśvā duritā syāma ||

translations.english: May he, who is to be praised by us, his worshippers, and to be adored, (Indra), come with all his swift(Maruts), for our protection, may we be excellent friends with them; may we be freed from all sins.

mantras.sanskrit: परि चिन्मर्तो द्रविणं ममन्यादृतस्य पथा नमसा विवासेत् । उत स्वेन क्रतुना सं वदेत श्रेयांसं दक्षं मनसा जगृभ्यात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari cinmarto draviṇaṃ mamanyādṛtasya pathā namasā vivāset | uta svena kratunā saṃ vadeta śreyāṃsaṃ dakṣaṃ manasā jagṛbhyāt ||

translations.english: Let a mortal be ever desirous of affluence, (having acquired it), let him worship with oblations on thepath of the sacrifice; and let him with his own intellect meditate upon (the gods); let him grasp with his mind thebest and most mighty (of the universal deities).

mantras.sanskrit: अधायि धीतिरससृग्रमंशास्तीर्थे न दस्ममुप यन्त्यूमाः । अभ्यानश्म सुवितस्य शूषं नवेदसो अमृतानामभूम ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhāyi dhītirasasṛgramaṃśāstīrthe na dasmamupa yantyūmāḥ | abhyānaśma suvitasya śūṣaṃ navedaso amṛtānāmabhūma ||

translations.english: The sacrifice has been prepared; the invigorating portions (of thhe oblation) approach the beautiful(god) of excellent birth, as (the waters) at a holy spot (approach the gods); may we obtain the happiness ofheaven; may we have a real knowledge of the immortals.

mantras.sanskrit: नित्यश्चाकन्यात्स्वपतिर्दमूना यस्मा उ देवः सविता जजान । भगो वा गोभिरर्यमेमनज्यात्सो अस्मै चारुश्छदयदुत स्यात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nityaścākanyātsvapatirdamūnā yasmā u devaḥ savitā jajāna | bhago vā gobhiraryamemanajyātso asmai cāruśchadayaduta syāt ||

translations.english: May the eternal (Prajāpati), the lord of wealth, of genitive rous mind, be willing to bestow (benefits onhim) to whom the divine Savitā has given birth; may Bhaga (induced) by (our) praises, and the divine Aryamanunfold (future rewards); or may some (other) gracious (divinity) be inclined to favour this (instrumental tutor of the rite).

mantras.sanskrit: इयं सा भूया उषसामिव क्षा यद्ध क्षुमन्तः शवसा समायन् । अस्य स्तुतिं जरितुर्भिक्षमाणा आ नः शग्मास उप यन्तु वाजाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: iyaṃ sā bhūyā uṣasāmiva kṣā yaddha kṣumantaḥ śavasā samāyan | asya stutiṃ jariturbhikṣamāṇā ā naḥ śagmāsa upa yantu vājāḥ ||

translations.english: May this (our praise) be accessible like the earth at dawn, when the glorious (gods) assemble in theirmight; may the Vājas, the dispensers of happiness, come to us, soliciting the laudation of this (their) adorer.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्येदेषा सुमतिः पप्रथानाभवत्पूर्व्या भूमना गौः । अस्य सनीळा असुरस्य योनौ समान आ भरणे बिभ्रमाणाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asyedeṣā sumatiḥ paprathānābhavatpūrvyā bhūmanā gauḥ | asya sanīḷā asurasya yonau samāna ā bharaṇe bibhramāṇāḥ ||

translations.english: May this glorification, of this (assemly of the gods), ancient and frequent, approaching (the deities), bewidely diffused, (may the universal gods), collected together, bearing (future rewards, come) to the commonplace (of sacrifice) of this one who is mighty, which nourishes (them).

mantras.sanskrit: किं स्विद्वनं क उ स वृक्ष आस यतो द्यावापृथिवी निष्टतक्षुः । संतस्थाने अजरे इतऊती अहानि पूर्वीरुषसो जरन्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: kiṃ svidvanaṃ ka u sa vṛkṣa āsa yato dyāvāpṛthivī niṣṭatakṣuḥ | saṃtasthāne ajare itaūtī ahāni pūrvīruṣaso jaranta ||

translations.english: What is the forest, which is the tree, out of which (the gods) have fabricated heaven and earth,ever-stationary and undecaying, giving protection to the deities; through numerous days and dawns (men)praises (the gods for this).

mantras.sanskrit: नैतावदेना परो अन्यदस्त्युक्षा स द्यावापृथिवी बिभर्ति । त्वचं पवित्रं कृणुत स्वधावान्यदीं सूर्यं न हरितो वहन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: naitāvadenā paro anyadastyukṣā sa dyāvāpṛthivī bibharti | tvacaṃ pavitraṃ kṛṇuta svadhāvānyadīṃ sūryaṃ na harito vahanti ||

translations.english: Not such (is their power); there is another greater than they; the creator, he sustains heaven andearth; possessed of might, he makes a pure skin, before his horses bear it to the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तेगो न क्षामत्येति पृथ्वीं मिहं न वातो वि ह वाति भूम । मित्रो यत्र वरुणो अज्यमानोऽग्निर्वने न व्यसृष्ट शोकम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: stego na kṣāmatyeti pṛthvīṃ mihaṃ na vāto vi ha vāti bhūma | mitro yatra varuṇo ajyamāno'gnirvane na vyasṛṣṭa śokam ||

translations.english: The sun does not pass beyond the broad earth, the wind does not drive the rain from off the earth; (Iglorify Prajāpati) in whom Mitra and Varuṇa being manifested, disperse their radiance, as Agni (spreads hisflames) in a forest.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तरीर्यत्सूत सद्यो अज्यमाना व्यथिरव्यथीः कृणुत स्वगोपा । पुत्रो यत्पूर्वः पित्रोर्जनिष्ट शम्यां गौर्जगार यद्ध पृच्छान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: starīryatsūta sadyo ajyamānā vyathiravyathīḥ kṛṇuta svagopā | putro yatpūrvaḥ pitrorjaniṣṭa śamyāṃ gaurjagāra yaddha pṛcchān ||

translations.english: When a barren cow being suddenly impregnated bears (a calf), she the repeller of evils, free frompain, self-protected, produces (offspring); when (Agni), the ancient son, is genitive rated by his two parents, earthejects the Śamī which the priests are seeking.

mantras.sanskrit: उत कण्वं नृषदः पुत्रमाहुरुत श्यावो धनमादत्त वाजी । प्र कृष्णाय रुशदपिन्वतोधॠतमत्र नकिरस्मा अपीपेत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta kaṇvaṃ nṛṣadaḥ putramāhuruta śyāvo dhanamādatta vājī | pra kṛṣṇāya ruśadapinvatodhaṝtamatra nakirasmā apīpet ||

translations.english: (The expounders of the Vedas) spoke to Kaṇva, the son of Nṛṣad, and he the dark-tinted, havingfood, acquired wealth; (Agni) sprinkled (the milk of the brilliant udder for the dark (complexioned sage); no otherdivinity so favours the sacrifice for him].

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सु ग्मन्ता धियसानस्य सक्षणि वरेभिर्वराँ अभि षु प्रसीदतः । अस्माकमिन्द्र उभयं जुजोषति यत्सोम्यस्यान्धसो बुबोधति ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra su gmantā dhiyasānasya sakṣaṇi varebhirvarā~ abhi ṣu prasīdataḥ | asmākamindra ubhayaṃ jujoṣati yatsomyasyāndhaso bubodhati ||

translations.english: Indra sends his quick-going horses to the service of the (worshipper) expectant (of his arrival); may hecome to the excellent (adorations) of the (worshipper), propitiating him by suitable means; Indra is gratified byboth our (oblations and praises), when he recognizes (the taste) of the food presented by the offerer of theSoma.

mantras.sanskrit: वीन्द्र यासि दिव्यानि रोचना वि पार्थिवानि रजसा पुरुष्टुत । ये त्वा वहन्ति मुहुरध्वराँ उप ते सु वन्वन्तु वग्वनाँ अराधसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vīndra yāsi divyāni rocanā vi pārthivāni rajasā puruṣṭuta | ye tvā vahanti muhuradhvarā~ upa te su vanvantu vagvanā~ arādhasaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, who is praised by many, you pervade the luminaries of heaven and earth with your lustre; maythe horses that repeatedly bring you to our sacrifices, plural ased by our praise, bring affluence to us who are poor.

mantras.sanskrit: तदिन्मे छन्त्सद्वपुषो वपुष्टरं पुत्रो यज्जानं पित्रोरधीयति । जाया पतिं वहति वग्नुना सुमत्पुंस इद्भद्रो वहतुः परिष्कृतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadinme chantsadvapuṣo vapuṣṭaraṃ putro yajjānaṃ pitroradhīyati | jāyā patiṃ vahati vagnunā sumatpuṃsa idbhadro vahatuḥ pariṣkṛtaḥ ||

translations.english: May (Indra) desire for me this (act of sacrifice). The most beautiful of beautiful things, (as) when a sonproclaims his birth from his parents. The wife brings her husband (to her side) with genitive le words; the goodfortune of the husband is perfected only as marriage.

mantras.sanskrit: तदित्सधस्थमभि चारु दीधय गावो यच्छासन्वहतुं न धेनवः । माता यन्मन्तुर्यूथस्य पूर्व्याभि वाणस्य सप्तधातुरिज्जनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taditsadhasthamabhi cāru dīdhaya gāvo yacchāsanvahatuṃ na dhenavaḥ | mātā yanmanturyūthasya pūrvyābhi vāṇasya saptadhāturijjanaḥ ||

translations.english: Shine, Indra, upon this elegant chamber of sacrifice when our praises desire (your approach) as kine(desire) their stalls; since the praise of (me) the worshipper precedes (the adoration) of the company, and thisperson accompanied by the seven officiating priests is the offerer of praise.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वोऽच्छा रिरिचे देवयुष्पदमेको रुद्रेभिर्याति तुर्वणिः । जरा वा येष्वमृतेषु दावने परि व ऊमेभ्यः सिञ्चता मधु ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vo'cchā ririce devayuṣpadameko rudrebhiryāti turvaṇiḥ | jarā vā yeṣvamṛteṣu dāvane pari va ūmebhyaḥ siñcatā madhu ||

translations.english: The devout (priest) excels (going) towards your plural ce of worship; the quick-moving (Indra), the chief(of the priests), proceeds with the Rudras, (the Maruts); sprinkle the exhilarating (Soma with water) for theprotecting (deities), the immortals among whom praise is (able) to procure wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: निधीयमानमपगूळ्हमप्सु प्र मे देवानां व्रतपा उवाच । इन्द्रो विद्वाँ अनु हि त्वा चचक्ष तेनाहमग्ने अनुशिष्ट आगाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nidhīyamānamapagūḷhamapsu pra me devānāṃ vratapā uvāca | indro vidvā~ anu hi tvā cacakṣa tenāhamagne anuśiṣṭa āgām ||

translations.english: The guardian of the sacred rites of the gods, Indra, said to me, (Agni), who had been deposited in thewaters; the sagacious Indra, following you, Agni, has discovered you, therefore, admonished by him may I, Agni,proceed to heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: अक्षेत्रवित्क्षेत्रविदं ह्यप्राट् स प्रैति क्षेत्रविदानुशिष्टः । एतद्वै भद्रमनुशासनस्योत स्रुतिं विन्दत्यञ्जसीनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: akṣetravitkṣetravidaṃ hyaprāṭ sa praiti kṣetravidānuśiṣṭaḥ | etadvai bhadramanuśāsanasyota srutiṃ vindatyañjasīnām ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: अद्येदु प्राणीदममन्निमाहापीवृतो अधयन्मातुरूधः । एमेनमाप जरिमा युवानमहेळन्वसुः सुमना बभूव ॥
mantras.transliteration: adyedu prāṇīdamamannimāhāpīvṛto adhayanmāturūdhaḥ | emenamāpa jarimā yuvānamaheḷanvasuḥ sumanā babhūva ||

translations.english: Today (Agni) breathed; he purposed (to conduct) these days surrounded (by lustre), and drank thesap of his mother (earth); the praise of his (worshippers) reaches the over-youthful (Agni), and he has becomegentle, genitive rous, and well-disposed.

mantras.sanskrit: एतानि भद्रा कलश क्रियाम कुरुश्रवण ददतो मघानि । दान इद्वो मघवानः सो अस्त्वयं च सोमो हृदि यं बिभर्मि ॥
mantras.transliteration: etāni bhadrā kalaśa kriyāma kuruśravaṇa dadato maghāni | dāna idvo maghavānaḥ so astvayaṃ ca somo hṛdi yaṃ bibharmi ||

translations.english: (Indra), the possessor of the pitchers, the bearer of the praise of the Kurus, let us celebrate theseauspicious adorations of you, the giver of riches; may he, (Indra), be the donor (of affluence) to you who areopulent, (in pious offering), and (so may) this Soma which I cherish in my heart.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र मा युयुज्रे प्रयुजो जनानां वहामि स्म पूषणमन्तरेण । विश्वे देवासो अध मामरक्षन्दुःशासुरागादिति घोष आसीत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra mā yuyujre prayujo janānāṃ vahāmi sma pūṣaṇamantareṇa | viśve devāso adha māmarakṣanduḥśāsurāgāditi ghoṣa āsīt ||

translations.english: The (divinities, the) appointers of men, have appointed me to Kuruśravaṇa; I have borne Pūṣan onthe way; the universal gods are my protectors; the cry is: "duhśāsu comes"

mantras.sanskrit: सं मा तपन्त्यभितः सपत्नीरिव पर्शवः । नि बाधते अमतिर्नग्नता जसुर्वेर्न वेवीयते मतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ mā tapantyabhitaḥ sapatnīriva parśavaḥ | ni bādhate amatirnagnatā jasurverna vevīyate matiḥ ||

translations.english: My ribs pain me on both sides, like rival wives; disease, nakedness, hunger, afflict me; my mindflutters like a bird.

mantras.sanskrit: मूषो न शिश्ना व्यदन्ति माध्य स्तोतारं ते शतक्रतो । सकृत्सु नो मघवन्निन्द्र मृळयाधा पितेव नो भव ॥
mantras.transliteration: mūṣo na śiśnā vyadanti mādhya stotāraṃ te śatakrato | sakṛtsu no maghavannindra mṛḷayādhā piteva no bhava ||

translations.english: Afflictions consume me, your worshipper Śatakratu, as mice (eat) threads, for once, Indra, possessorof opulence, grant us felicity; be to us as a father.

mantras.sanskrit: कुरुश्रवणमावृणि राजानं त्रासदस्यवम् । मंहिष्ठं वाघतामृषिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kuruśravaṇamāvṛṇi rājānaṃ trāsadasyavam | maṃhiṣṭhaṃ vāghatāmṛṣiḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य मा हरितो रथे तिस्रो वहन्ति साधुया । स्तवै सहस्रदक्षिणे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya mā harito rathe tisro vahanti sādhuyā | stavai sahasradakṣiṇe ||

translations.english: Whose three horses bear me plural asantly in the chariot; I praise him at the ceremony in which hepresents thousands.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य प्रस्वादसो गिर उपमश्रवसः पितुः । क्षेत्रं न रण्वमूचुषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya prasvādaso gira upamaśravasaḥ pituḥ | kṣetraṃ na raṇvamūcuṣe ||

translations.english: Upamaśravas, the words of whose father were sweet, like a plural asant field given to a beggar.

mantras.sanskrit: अधि पुत्रोपमश्रवो नपान्मित्रातिथेरिहि । पितुष्टे अस्मि वन्दिता ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhi putropamaśravo napānmitrātitherihi | pituṣṭe asmi vanditā ||

translations.english: Come to me, my son, grandson of Mitrātithi; I am the eulogist of your father.

mantras.sanskrit: यदीशीयामृतानामुत वा मर्त्यानाम् । जीवेदिन्मघवा मम ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadīśīyāmṛtānāmuta vā martyānām | jīvedinmaghavā mama ||

translations.english: If I were lord oover immortals and mortals, then should my munificent (benefactor) live.

mantras.sanskrit: न देवानामति व्रतं शतात्मा चन जीवति । तथा युजा वि वावृते ॥
mantras.transliteration: na devānāmati vrataṃ śatātmā cana jīvati | tathā yujā vi vāvṛte ||

translations.english: No one lives hundred years passing the limit fixed by the gods; so he is separated from his friendṣ

mantras.sanskrit: प्रावेपा मा बृहतो मादयन्ति प्रवातेजा इरिणे वर्वृतानाः । सोमस्येव मौजवतस्य भक्षो विभीदको जागृविर्मह्यमच्छान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: prāvepā mā bṛhato mādayanti pravātejā iriṇe varvṛtānāḥ | somasyeva maujavatasya bhakṣo vibhīdako jāgṛvirmahyamacchān ||

translations.english: The large rattling dice exhilarate me as torrents borne on a precipice flowing in a desert; the excitingdice animate me as the taste of the Soma of Maujavat (delights the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: न मा मिमेथ न जिहीळ एषा शिवा सखिभ्य उत मह्यमासीत् । अक्षस्याहमेकपरस्य हेतोरनुव्रतामप जायामरोधम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: na mā mimetha na jihīḷa eṣā śivā sakhibhya uta mahyamāsīt | akṣasyāhamekaparasya hetoranuvratāmapa jāyāmarodham ||

translations.english: This (my wife) has not been angry (with me), nor was she overcome with sham; kind was she to meand to my friends; yet for the sake of one or other die, I have deserted this affectionate spouse.

mantras.sanskrit: द्वेष्टि श्वश्रूरप जाया रुणद्धि न नाथितो विन्दते मर्डितारम् । अश्वस्येव जरतो वस्न्यस्य नाहं विन्दामि कितवस्य भोगम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dveṣṭi śvaśrūrapa jāyā ruṇaddhi na nāthito vindate marḍitāram | aśvasyeva jarato vasnyasya nāhaṃ vindāmi kitavasya bhogam ||

translations.english: My mother-in-law reviles me, my wife opposes me; the beggar meets no compassionate (benefactor); Ido not realize the enjoyment of the gamester any more than that of a valuable horse grown old.

mantras.sanskrit: अन्ये जायां परि मृशन्त्यस्य यस्यागृधद्वेदने वाज्यक्षः । पिता माता भ्रातर एनमाहुर्न जानीमो नयता बद्धमेतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: anye jāyāṃ pari mṛśantyasya yasyāgṛdhadvedane vājyakṣaḥ | pitā mātā bhrātara enamāhurna jānīmo nayatā baddhametam ||

translations.english: Others touch the wife of him whose wealth the potent dice covet; his mother, father, brothers say, "weknow him not, take him away bound (where you will)".

mantras.sanskrit: यदादीध्ये न दविषाण्येभिः परायद्भ्योऽव हीये सखिभ्यः । न्युप्ताश्च बभ्रवो वाचमक्रतँ एमीदेषां निष्कृतं जारिणीव ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadādīdhye na daviṣāṇyebhiḥ parāyadbhyo'va hīye sakhibhyaḥ | nyuptāśca babhravo vācamakrata~ emīdeṣāṃ niṣkṛtaṃ jāriṇīva ||

translations.english: When I relect, (then I say), "I will plural y no more with them". I pay attention to my friends who desert(me); and the tawny dice rattle as they are thrown; I hasten to their accusative tomed plural ce as a harlot (to anassignation).

mantras.sanskrit: सभामेति कितवः पृच्छमानो जेष्यामीति तन्वा शूशुजानः । अक्षासो अस्य वि तिरन्ति कामं प्रतिदीव्ने दधत आ कृतानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: sabhāmeti kitavaḥ pṛcchamāno jeṣyāmīti tanvā śūśujānaḥ | akṣāso asya vi tiranti kāmaṃ pratidīvne dadhata ā kṛtāni ||

translations.english: The gamester goes to the gambling table, radiant in person n, and asking himself, "Shall I win?" Thedice increase his passion for plural y as he practises the arts of (gambling) with his adversary.

mantras.sanskrit: अक्षास इदङ्कुशिनो नितोदिनो निकृत्वानस्तपनास्तापयिष्णवः । कुमारदेष्णा जयतः पुनर्हणो मध्वा सम्पृक्ताः कितवस्य बर्हणा ॥
mantras.transliteration: akṣāsa idaṅkuśino nitodino nikṛtvānastapanāstāpayiṣṇavaḥ | kumāradeṣṇā jayataḥ punarhaṇo madhvā sampṛktāḥ kitavasya barhaṇā ||

translations.english: Dice verily are armed with hooks, with goads, pricking, paining and torturing (the gamester); to thewinning (plural yer) they are the givers of sons, they are tipped with honey; slaying him in return by taking away thegambler's (all).

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिपञ्चाशः क्रीळति व्रात एषां देव इव सविता सत्यधर्मा । उग्रस्य चिन्मन्यवे ना नमन्ते राजा चिदेभ्यो नम इत्कृणोति ॥
mantras.transliteration: tripañcāśaḥ krīḷati vrāta eṣāṃ deva iva savitā satyadharmā | ugrasya cinmanyave nā namante rājā cidebhyo nama itkṛṇoti ||

translations.english: The aggregate fifty-three of them are plural yed as the divine truth, observant Savitā, (travels); the dicebow not before the wrath of any, however violent; a king himself pays them homage.

mantras.sanskrit: नीचा वर्तन्त उपरि स्फुरन्त्यहस्तासो हस्तवन्तं सहन्ते । दिव्या अङ्गारा इरिणे न्युप्ताः शीताः सन्तो हृदयं निर्दहन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: nīcā vartanta upari sphurantyahastāso hastavantaṃ sahante | divyā aṅgārā iriṇe nyuptāḥ śītāḥ santo hṛdayaṃ nirdahanti ||

translations.english: Now they abide below; now they palpitate on high handless, they overpower him who has hands; castupon the dice-board like coals from the sky, even though cold they burn the heart.

mantras.sanskrit: जाया तप्यते कितवस्य हीना माता पुत्रस्य चरतः क्व स्वित् । ऋणावा बिभ्यद्धनमिच्छमानोऽन्येषामस्तमुप नक्तमेति ॥
mantras.transliteration: jāyā tapyate kitavasya hīnā mātā putrasya carataḥ kva svit | ṛṇāvā bibhyaddhanamicchamāno'nyeṣāmastamupa naktameti ||

translations.english: The deserted wife of the gamester is afflicted; the mother (grieves) for the son wandering wherever helikes; involved in debt, ever in fear, anxious for wealth, (the gambler) goes forth by night to the dwellings of others(to plural nder).

mantras.sanskrit: स्त्रियं दृष्ट्वाय कितवं ततापान्येषां जायां सुकृतं च योनिम् । पूर्वाह्णे अश्वान्युयुजे हि बभ्रून्त्सो अग्नेरन्ते वृषलः पपाद ॥
mantras.transliteration: striyaṃ dṛṣṭvāya kitavaṃ tatāpānyeṣāṃ jāyāṃ sukṛtaṃ ca yonim | pūrvāhṇe aśvānyuyuje hi babhrūntso agnerante vṛṣalaḥ papāda ||

translations.english: The gamester, having observed the happy wife and well-ordered home of others, suffers regret; yet inthe forenoon he puts to the tawny steeds, and at night the sinner lies down by the fire.

mantras.sanskrit: यो वः सेनानीर्महतो गणस्य राजा व्रातस्य प्रथमो बभूव । तस्मै कृणोमि न धना रुणध्मि दशाहं प्राचीस्तदृतं वदामि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo vaḥ senānīrmahato gaṇasya rājā vrātasya prathamo babhūva | tasmai kṛṇomi na dhanā ruṇadhmi daśāhaṃ prācīstadṛtaṃ vadāmi ||

translations.english: Dice, I offer salutation to him who has been the genitive ral of your great army, the chief lord of your host;I do not provide him with wealth; I raise my ten (fingers) to the east; that (which) I speak (is) the truth.

mantras.sanskrit: अक्षैर्मा दीव्यः कृषिमित्कृषस्व वित्ते रमस्व बहु मन्यमानः । तत्र गावः कितव तत्र जाया तन्मे वि चष्टे सवितायमर्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: akṣairmā dīvyaḥ kṛṣimitkṛṣasva vitte ramasva bahu manyamānaḥ | tatra gāvaḥ kitava tatra jāyā tanme vi caṣṭe savitāyamaryaḥ ||

translations.english: Giving serious attention (to my advie), plural y not with dice; pursue agriculture; delight in wealth (soacquired); there, gambler, are cows; there is a wife; so has this (visible) sovereign Savitā declared to me.

mantras.sanskrit: मित्रं कृणुध्वं खलु मृळता नो मा नो घोरेण चरताभि धृष्णु । नि वो नु मन्युर्विशतामरातिरन्यो बभ्रूणां प्रसितौ न्वस्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: mitraṃ kṛṇudhvaṃ khalu mṛḷatā no mā no ghoreṇa caratābhi dhṛṣṇu | ni vo nu manyurviśatāmarātiranyo babhrūṇāṃ prasitau nvastu ||

translations.english: Be friends with us (dice); bestow upon us happiness; approach us not in terrible wrath; let your angerlight upon our enemies; let our enemy fall under the bondage of the tawny (dice).

mantras.sanskrit: अबुध्रमु त्य इन्द्रवन्तो अग्नयो ज्योतिर्भरन्त उषसो व्युष्टिषु । मही द्यावापृथिवी चेततामपोऽद्या देवानामव आ वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: abudhramu tya indravanto agnayo jyotirbharanta uṣaso vyuṣṭiṣu | mahī dyāvāpṛthivī cetatāmapo'dyā devānāmava ā vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: The fires that are connected with Indra are awake, bringing light at the opening of the dawn; let thegreat heaven and earth be cognizant of that office; to-day we solicit the protection of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवस्पृथिव्योरव आ वृणीमहे मातॄन्त्सिन्धून्पर्वताञ्छर्यणावतः । अनागास्त्वं सूर्यमुषासमीमहे भद्रं सोमः सुवानो अद्या कृणोतु नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: divaspṛthivyorava ā vṛṇīmahe mātṝntsindhūnparvatāñcharyaṇāvataḥ | anāgāstvaṃ sūryamuṣāsamīmahe bhadraṃ somaḥ suvāno adyā kṛṇotu naḥ ||

translations.english: We solicit the protection of heaven and earth; (we solicit) the maternal rivers, the mountains with theirlakes, the sun and the dawn, for freedom from sin; may the Soma that is now effused secure to us today goodfortune.

mantras.sanskrit: द्यावा नो अद्य पृथिवी अनागसो मही त्रायेतां सुविताय मातरा । उषा उच्छन्त्यप बाधतामघं स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: dyāvā no adya pṛthivī anāgaso mahī trāyetāṃ suvitāya mātarā | uṣā ucchantyapa bādhatāmaghaṃ svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe ||

translations.english: May the vast maternal heaven and earth this day preserve us for our happiness, free from sin; may theopening dawn drive away our sin; we solicit the kindled fire for our welfare.

mantras.sanskrit: इयं न उस्रा प्रथमा सुदेव्यं रेवत्सनिभ्यो रेवती व्युच्छतु । आरे मन्युं दुर्विदत्रस्य धीमहि स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: iyaṃ na usrā prathamā sudevyaṃ revatsanibhyo revatī vyucchatu | āre manyuṃ durvidatrasya dhīmahi svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe ||

translations.english: May this first dawn, the possessor of wealth, open; bringing to us who are liberal (a season) fit for thegods, abounding with riches; we consider the anger of the malevolent (to be) remote; we solicit the kindled firefor our welfare.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र याः सिस्रते सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिर्ज्योतिर्भरन्तीरुषसो व्युष्टिषु । भद्रा नो अद्य श्रवसे व्युच्छत स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra yāḥ sisrate sūryasya raśmibhirjyotirbharantīruṣaso vyuṣṭiṣu | bhadrā no adya śravase vyucchata svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe ||

translations.english: Dawns, who are associated with the rays of the sun, bringing light at the opening (of the day), shineupon us today, propitious, for our subsistence; we solicit the kindled fire for our welfare.

mantras.sanskrit: अनमीवा उषस आ चरन्तु न उदग्नयो जिहतां ज्योतिषा बृहत् । आयुक्षातामश्विना तूतुजिं रथं स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: anamīvā uṣasa ā carantu na udagnayo jihatāṃ jyotiṣā bṛhat | āyukṣātāmaśvinā tūtujiṃ rathaṃ svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe ||

translations.english: May the salutary dawns hasten to us; may the fires blaze up with great lustre, and may the Aśvinsharness their quick-going chariot; we solicit the kindled fire for our welfare.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रेष्ठं नो अद्य सवितर्वरेण्यं भागमा सुव स हि रत्नधा असि । रायो जनित्रीं धिषणामुप ब्रुवे स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: śreṣṭhaṃ no adya savitarvareṇyaṃ bhāgamā suva sa hi ratnadhā asi | rāyo janitrīṃ dhiṣaṇāmupa bruve svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe ||

translations.english: Savitā, this day bestow upon us excellent and eligible portion, for you verily are the dispenser ofwealth; I recite the praise (of the gods) which is the progenitress of riches; we solicit the kindled fire for ourwelfare.

mantras.sanskrit: पिपर्तु मा तदृतस्य प्रवाचनं देवानां यन्मनुष्या अमन्महि । विश्वा इदुस्राः स्पळुदेति सूर्यः स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pipartu mā tadṛtasya pravācanaṃ devānāṃ yanmanuṣyā amanmahi | viśvā idusrāḥ spaḷudeti sūryaḥ svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe ||

translations.english: May that glorification of the gods which men repeat in connection with the rite preserve me; the sunrises visiting all the lustre of the dawn; we solicit the kindled fire for our welfare.

mantras.sanskrit: अद्वेषो अद्य बर्हिषः स्तरीमणि ग्राव्णां योगे मन्मनः साध ईमहे । आदित्यानां शर्मणि स्था भुरण्यसि स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: adveṣo adya barhiṣaḥ starīmaṇi grāvṇāṃ yoge manmanaḥ sādha īmahe | ādityānāṃ śarmaṇi sthā bhuraṇyasi svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe ||

translations.english: On strewing the sacred grass, and bringing the stones into contact (with the Soma), whereby ourwishes are accomplished, we solicit today the benevolent (Ādityas); abiding in the happiness of those Ādityas,you discharged, worshipper, your duties, we solicit the kindled fire for our welfare.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो बर्हिः सधमादे बृहद्दिवि देवाँ ईळे सादया सप्त होतॄन् । इन्द्रं मित्रं वरुणं सातये भगं स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no barhiḥ sadhamāde bṛhaddivi devā~ īḷe sādayā sapta hotṝn | indraṃ mitraṃ varuṇaṃ sātaye bhagaṃ svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe ||

translations.english: On this our sacred grass, spacious and bright where the gods delight together, do you (Agni) seat theseven ministrant priests, Indra, Mitra, Varuṇa, Bhaga, I praise the gods for their bounty; we solicit the kindled firefor our welfare.

mantras.sanskrit: त आदित्या आ गता सर्वतातये वृधे नो यज्ञमवता सजोषसः । बृहस्पतिं पूषणमश्विना भगं स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ta ādityā ā gatā sarvatātaye vṛdhe no yajñamavatā sajoṣasaḥ | bṛhaspatiṃ pūṣaṇamaśvinā bhagaṃ svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe ||

translations.english: Ādityas, come to our ceremony, being well-plural ased protect the sacrifice for our growth; we solicit forour welfare Bṛhaspati, Pūṣan, the Aśvins, Bhaga, and the kindled fire.

mantras.sanskrit: तन्नो देवा यच्छत सुप्रवाचनं छर्दिरादित्याः सुभरं नृपाय्यम् । पश्वे तोकाय तनयाय जीवसे स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tanno devā yacchata supravācanaṃ chardirādityāḥ subharaṃ nṛpāyyam | paśve tokāya tanayāya jīvase svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe ||

translations.english: Divine Aśvins, bestow upon us an excellent, spacious, man-protecting dwelling, for our cattle, oursons and our grandsons to exist; we solicit the kindled fire for our welfare.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वे अद्य मरुतो विश्व ऊती विश्वे भवन्त्वग्नयः समिद्धाः । विश्वे नो देवा अवसा गमन्तु विश्वमस्तु द्रविणं वाजो अस्मे ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśve adya maruto viśva ūtī viśve bhavantvagnayaḥ samiddhāḥ | viśve no devā avasā gamantu viśvamastu draviṇaṃ vājo asme ||

translations.english: This day, may all the Maruts, all the (deities), be for our protection; and may all the fires be kindleḍMay all the gods come for our preservation, and may all wealth and food be ours.

mantras.sanskrit: यं देवासोऽवथ वाजसातौ यं त्रायध्वे यं पिपृथात्यंहः । यो वो गोपीथे न भयस्य वेद ते स्याम देववीतये तुरासः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ devāso'vatha vājasātau yaṃ trāyadhve yaṃ pipṛthātyaṃhaḥ | yo vo gopīthe na bhayasya veda te syāma devavītaye turāsaḥ ||

translations.english: Gods, who are prompt (to grant our desires), may he, whom you guard in battle, whom you defend(from his enemies), whom having extricated from sin, you gratify (in all his wishes), who (secure) in yourprotection; knows not of fear, may we (who are all this) be assiduous in offering sacrifice to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: उषासानक्ता बृहती सुपेशसा द्यावाक्षामा वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । इन्द्रं हुवे मरुतः पर्वताँ अप आदित्यान्द्यावापृथिवी अपः स्वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uṣāsānaktā bṛhatī supeśasā dyāvākṣāmā varuṇo mitro aryamā | indraṃ huve marutaḥ parvatā~ apa ādityāndyāvāpṛthivī apaḥ svaḥ ||

translations.english: I invoke the vast and beautiful day and night, heaven and earth, Mitra and Varuṇa with Aryaman,Indra, the Maruts, the mountains, the waters, the Ādityas, heaven and earth, the waters (of the firmament), thewhole (host of the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: द्यौश्च नः पृथिवी च प्रचेतस ऋतावरी रक्षतामंहसो रिषः । मा दुर्विदत्रा निॠतिर्न ईशत तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: dyauśca naḥ pṛthivī ca pracetasa ṛtāvarī rakṣatāmaṃhaso riṣaḥ | mā durvidatrā niṝtirna īśata taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: May the intelligent and truthful heaven and earth defend us from sin, and from malignant; let not themalevolent Nirṛti have power over us; we solicit today this protection of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वस्मान्नो अदितिः पात्वंहसो माता मित्रस्य वरुणस्य रेवतः । स्वर्वज्ज्योतिरवृकं नशीमहि तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvasmānno aditiḥ pātvaṃhaso mātā mitrasya varuṇasya revataḥ | svarvajjyotiravṛkaṃ naśīmahi taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: May Aditi, the mother of the opulent Mitra and Varuṇa, preserve us from all sin, may we hasten tocelestial light, which is free from oppressors; we solicit today this protection of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: ग्रावा वदन्नप रक्षांसि सेधतु दुष्ष्वप्न्यं निॠतिं विश्वमत्रिणम् । आदित्यं शर्म मरुतामशीमहि तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: grāvā vadannapa rakṣāṃsi sedhatu duṣṣvapnyaṃ niṝtiṃ viśvamatriṇam | ādityaṃ śarma marutāmaśīmahi taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: May the sounding stone drive away rākṣasas, evil dreams, Nirṛti, and every spirit of ill; may weobtain the happiness of the Ādityas and the Maruts; we solicit today this protection of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: एन्द्रो बर्हिः सीदतु पिन्वतामिळा बृहस्पतिः सामभिॠक्वो अर्चतु । सुप्रकेतं जीवसे मन्म धीमहि तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: endro barhiḥ sīdatu pinvatāmiḷā bṛhaspatiḥ sāmabhiṝkvo arcatu | supraketaṃ jīvase manma dhīmahi taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: May Indra sit down upon the sacred grass; may Iḷā be propitious; may Bṛhaspati the singer hymnedwith Sāmans honour us; we offer an intelligent prayer for life; we solcit today this protection of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: दिविस्पृशं यज्ञमस्माकमश्विना जीराध्वरं कृणुतं सुम्नमिष्टये । प्राचीनरश्मिमाहुतं घृतेन तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: divispṛśaṃ yajñamasmākamaśvinā jīrādhvaraṃ kṛṇutaṃ sumnamiṣṭaye | prācīnaraśmimāhutaṃ ghṛtena taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: Aśvins, make our sacriice ascend to heaven free from injury, happy for the attainment of our desires;make the fire to which she is offered blaze up towards (the gods); we solicit today this protection of our gods.

mantras.sanskrit: उप ह्वये सुहवं मारुतं गणं पावकमृष्वं सख्याय शम्भुवम् । रायस्पोषं सौश्रवसाय धीमहि तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa hvaye suhavaṃ mārutaṃ gaṇaṃ pāvakamṛṣvaṃ sakhyāya śambhuvam | rāyaspoṣaṃ sauśravasāya dhīmahi taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: I invoke for their friendship, the deservedly invoked, purifying, beautiful troops of the Maruts, the giversof felicity, the dispensers of riches; we meditate upon them for the attainemtn of abundant food; we solicit todaythis protection of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: अपां पेरुं जीवधन्यं भरामहे देवाव्यं सुहवमध्वरश्रियम् । सुरश्मिं सोममिन्द्रियं यमीमहि तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: apāṃ peruṃ jīvadhanyaṃ bharāmahe devāvyaṃ suhavamadhvaraśriyam | suraśmiṃ somamindriyaṃ yamīmahi taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: We offer the Soma, the protector of the waters, affluent in life, the delighter of the gods, who iswell-praised, the glory of sacrifice, the brilliant-rayed, the vigour which we desire; we solicit today this protectionof the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: सनेम तत्सुसनिता सनित्वभिर्वयं जीवा जीवपुत्रा अनागसः । ब्रह्मद्विषो विष्वगेनो भरेरत तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: sanema tatsusanitā sanitvabhirvayaṃ jīvā jīvaputrā anāgasaḥ | brahmadviṣo viṣvageno bharerata taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: Living with living offspring, and free from fault, let us make offerings (to the gods), sharing with thosewho share with us; may those who hate the brāhmaṇas, carry off our iniquity in different directions; we solicittoday this protection of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: ये स्था मनोर्यज्ञियास्ते शृणोतन यद्वो देवा ईमहे तद्ददातन । जैत्रं क्रतुं रयिमद्वीरवद्यशस्तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye sthā manoryajñiyāste śṛṇotana yadvo devā īmahe taddadātana | jaitraṃ kratuṃ rayimadvīravadyaśastaddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: Gods, who are entitled to the worship of men, hear (our prayers), and grant us that which we request;(bestow upon us) the intelligence requisite for victory, and fame with wealth, and male progeny; we solicit todaythis protection of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: महदद्य महतामा वृणीमहेऽवो देवानां बृहतामनर्वणाम् । यथा वसु वीरजातं नशामहै तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahadadya mahatāmā vṛṇīmahe'vo devānāṃ bṛhatāmanarvaṇām | yathā vasu vīrajātaṃ naśāmahai taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: We impolore today the especial protection of the mighty, the great, the irresistible, gods, that we mayobtain riches, and male progeny; we solicit today this protection of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: महो अग्नेः समिधानस्य शर्मण्यनागा मित्रे वरुणे स्वस्तये । श्रेष्ठे स्याम सवितुः सवीमनि तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: maho agneḥ samidhānasya śarmaṇyanāgā mitre varuṇe svastaye | śreṣṭhe syāma savituḥ savīmani taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: May we free from sin be in the (enjoyment of the) happiness of the mighty kindled Agni; and in (thekeeping of) Mitra and Varuṇa for our welfare; may we be among the excellent progeny of Savitā; we solicittoday this protection of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: ये सवितुः सत्यसवस्य विश्वे मित्रस्य व्रते वरुणस्य देवाः । ते सौभगं वीरवद्गोमदप्नो दधातन द्रविणं चित्रमस्मे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye savituḥ satyasavasya viśve mitrasya vrate varuṇasya devāḥ | te saubhagaṃ vīravadgomadapno dadhātana draviṇaṃ citramasme ||

translations.english: Universal gods, who (take part) in the functions of Savitā, the parent of truth, of Mitra and Varuṇa,confer upon us auspicious and honourable wealth, comprising male progeny, and cattle, and (pious) acts.

mantras.sanskrit: सविता पश्चातात्सविता पुरस्तात्सवितोत्तरात्तात्सविताधरात्तात् । सविता नः सुवतु सर्वतातिं सविता नो रासतां दीर्घमायुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: savitā paścātātsavitā purastātsavitottarāttātsavitādharāttāt | savitā naḥ suvatu sarvatātiṃ savitā no rāsatāṃ dīrghamāyuḥ ||

translations.english: May Savitā on the west, Savitā on the east, Savitā on the north, Savitā on the south, may Savitāsend us all desired wealth, may Savitā bestow upon us long life.

mantras.sanskrit: नमो मित्रस्य वरुणस्य चक्षसे महो देवाय तदृतं सपर्यत । दूरेदृशे देवजाताय केतवे दिवस्पुत्राय सूर्याय शंसत ॥
mantras.transliteration: namo mitrasya varuṇasya cakṣase maho devāya tadṛtaṃ saparyata | dūredṛśe devajātāya ketave divasputrāya sūryāya śaṃsata ||

translations.english: (Having offered) adoration to Sūrya, the beholder of Mitra and Varuṇa, the mighty, the divine, thefar-seer, the god-born, the manifester (of all things), the son of heaven; celebrate the rite enjoined by him, andsing his praise.

mantras.sanskrit: सा मा सत्योक्तिः परि पातु विश्वतो द्यावा च यत्र ततनन्नहानि च । विश्वमन्यन्नि विशते यदेजति विश्वाहापो विश्वाहोदेति सूर्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sā mā satyoktiḥ pari pātu viśvato dyāvā ca yatra tatanannahāni ca | viśvamanyanni viśate yadejati viśvāhāpo viśvāhodeti sūryaḥ ||

translations.english: May that world of truth everywhere protect me, through which it is that the heaven and earth, and daysand nights, extend; all the rest of creation which trembles has rest (there); the waters daily (flow), the sun risesevery day.

mantras.sanskrit: न ते अदेवः प्रदिवो नि वासते यदेतशेभिः पतरै रथर्यसि । प्राचीनमन्यदनु वर्तते रज उदन्येन ज्योतिषा यासि सूर्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: na te adevaḥ pradivo ni vāsate yadetaśebhiḥ patarai ratharyasi | prācīnamanyadanu vartate raja udanyena jyotiṣā yāsi sūrya ||

translations.english: No ancient rākṣasa abides, Sūrya, near you when you desire to yoke to your chariot your rapidsteeds; one ancient radiance follows (you) while you rise with another.

mantras.sanskrit: येन सूर्य ज्योतिषा बाधसे तमो जगच्च विश्वमुदियर्षि भानुना । तेनास्मद्विश्वामनिरामनाहुतिमपामीवामप दुष्ष्वप्न्यं सुव ॥
mantras.transliteration: yena sūrya jyotiṣā bādhase tamo jagacca viśvamudiyarṣi bhānunā | tenāsmadviśvāmanirāmanāhutimapāmīvāmapa duṣṣvapnyaṃ suva ||

translations.english: With that light, Sūrya, with which you disperse the darkness, and with that radiance with which youquicken every moving thing, remove from us all famine, neglect of oblations, sickness and evil dreams.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वस्य हि प्रेषितो रक्षसि व्रतमहेळयन्नुच्चरसि स्वधा अनु । यदद्य त्वा सूर्योपब्रवामहै तं नो देवा अनु मंसीरत क्रतुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvasya hi preṣito rakṣasi vratamaheḷayannuccarasi svadhā anu | yadadya tvā sūryopabravāmahai taṃ no devā anu maṃsīrata kratum ||

translations.english: When invoked, you who are genitive le protect the rite of every (worshipper); you rise after the svadhāofferings; when today we call upon you, may the gods be propitious to our sacred acts.

mantras.sanskrit: तं नो द्यावापृथिवी तन्न आप इन्द्रः शृण्वन्तु मरुतो हवं वचः । मा शूने भूम सूर्यस्य संदृशि भद्रं जीवन्तो जरणामशीमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ no dyāvāpṛthivī tanna āpa indraḥ śṛṇvantu maruto havaṃ vacaḥ | mā śūne bhūma sūryasya saṃdṛśi bhadraṃ jīvanto jaraṇāmaśīmahi ||

translations.english: May heaven and earth, may the waters, may Indra, and the Maruts, hear this our invocation and thisour praise; may we not be in sorrow at the sight of the Sun; diving long, may we attain a prosperous old age.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वाहा त्वा सुमनसः सुचक्षसः प्रजावन्तो अनमीवा अनागसः । उद्यन्तं त्वा मित्रमहो दिवेदिवे ज्योग्जीवाः प्रति पश्येम सूर्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvāhā tvā sumanasaḥ sucakṣasaḥ prajāvanto anamīvā anāgasaḥ | udyantaṃ tvā mitramaho divedive jyogjīvāḥ prati paśyema sūrya ||

translations.english: May we, constantly happy in mind, sound of sight, blessed with posterity, exempt from sickness,devoid of sin, daily (worship you); may we, enjoying long life behold you, Sūrya, who are the cherisher of yourfriends rising day by day.

mantras.sanskrit: महि ज्योतिर्बिभ्रतं त्वा विचक्षण भास्वन्तं चक्षुषेचक्षुषे मयः । आरोहन्तं बृहतः पाजसस्परि वयं जीवाः प्रति पश्येम सूर्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahi jyotirbibhrataṃ tvā vicakṣaṇa bhāsvantaṃ cakṣuṣecakṣuṣe mayaḥ | ārohantaṃ bṛhataḥ pājasaspari vayaṃ jīvāḥ prati paśyema sūrya ||

translations.english: May we, enoying (long) life, day by day behold you, Sūrya, who glance over all things, invested withgreat lustre, radiant, giving joy to every eye, and rising above the vast and mighty (ocean).

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य ते विश्वा भुवनानि केतुना प्र चेरते नि च विशन्ते अक्तुभिः । अनागास्त्वेन हरिकेश सूर्याह्नाह्ना नो वस्यसावस्यसोदिहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya te viśvā bhuvanāni ketunā pra cerate ni ca viśante aktubhiḥ | anāgāstvena harikeśa sūryāhnāhnā no vasyasāvasyasodihi ||

translations.english: Golden-haired Sūrya, by whose guidance all beings move (by day), and repose by night, do youcome to us with freedom from sin, and more felicitous (life) every day.

mantras.sanskrit: शं नो भव चक्षसा शं नो अह्ना शं भानुना शं हिमा शं घृणेन । यथा शमध्वञ्छमसद्दुरोणे तत्सूर्य द्रविणं धेहि चित्रम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaṃ no bhava cakṣasā śaṃ no ahnā śaṃ bhānunā śaṃ himā śaṃ ghṛṇena | yathā śamadhvañchamasadduroṇe tatsūrya draviṇaṃ dhehi citram ||

translations.english: Be propitious to us with light; be propitious to us with sunshine; be propitious to us with warmth; bepropitious to us with frost; and grant us, Sūrya, various wealth, whereby we may prosper on the road and in thehouse.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्माकं देवा उभयाय जन्मने शर्म यच्छत द्विपदे चतुष्पदे । अदत्पिबदूर्जयमानमाशितं तदस्मे शं योररपो दधातन ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmākaṃ devā ubhayāya janmane śarma yacchata dvipade catuṣpade | adatpibadūrjayamānamāśitaṃ tadasme śaṃ yorarapo dadhātana ||

translations.english: Bestow, gods, felicity upon both (classes) of our living beings, bipeds and quadrupeds, so that,whether they be eating or drinking, they may be strong and healthy; so grant to us happiness, plural asure andfreedom from sin.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्वो देवाश्चकृम जिह्वया गुरु मनसो वा प्रयुती देवहेळनम् । अरावा यो नो अभि दुच्छुनायते तस्मिन्तदेनो वसवो नि धेतन ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadvo devāścakṛma jihvayā guru manaso vā prayutī devaheḷanam | arāvā yo no abhi ducchunāyate tasmintadeno vasavo ni dhetana ||

translations.english: Whatever sin, great and exciting the wrath of the gods, we have committed against you, O gods, bythe tongue, or the working of the mind, do you, Vasu, transfer that sin to him, who assailing terrifies us.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मिन्न इन्द्र पृत्सुतौ यशस्वति शिमीवति क्रन्दसि प्राव सातये । यत्र गोषाता धृषितेषु खादिषु विष्वक्पतन्ति दिद्यवो नृषाह्ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: asminna indra pṛtsutau yaśasvati śimīvati krandasi prāva sātaye | yatra goṣātā dhṛṣiteṣu khādiṣu viṣvakpatanti didyavo nṛṣāhye ||

translations.english: You shout, Indra, in this glorious and arduous conflict, and assist us to the acquisition (of spoil), in thisbattle where cows are won and men overpowered, wherein the weapons descend on every side upon the fierceand courageous combatants.

mantras.sanskrit: स नः क्षुमन्तं सदने व्यूर्णुहि गोअर्णसं रयिमिन्द्र श्रवाय्यम् । स्याम ते जयतः शक्र मेदिनो यथा वयमुश्मसि तद्वसो कृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa naḥ kṣumantaṃ sadane vyūrṇuhi goarṇasaṃ rayimindra śravāyyam | syāma te jayataḥ śakra medino yathā vayamuśmasi tadvaso kṛdhi ||

translations.english: Do you, Indra, heap up in our dwelling famous riches, comprising food and herds of cattle; may we,Śakra, be vigorous (through the favour) of you, the victorious; grant us, Vasu, that which we desire.

mantras.sanskrit: यो नो दास आर्यो वा पुरुष्टुतादेव इन्द्र युधये चिकेतति । अस्माभिष्टे सुषहाः सन्तु शत्रवस्त्वया वयं तान्वनुयाम संगमे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo no dāsa āryo vā puruṣṭutādeva indra yudhaye ciketati | asmābhiṣṭe suṣahāḥ santu śatravastvayā vayaṃ tānvanuyāma saṃgame ||

translations.english: Indra, the praised of many, may he who proposes to assail us, whether he be a dāsa, an ārya, or anenemy of the gods; through your aid may all (such) foes be easily overcome by us; through you may we destroythem in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: यो दभ्रेभिर्हव्यो यश्च भूरिभिर्यो अभीके वरिवोविन्नृषाह्ये । तं विखादे सस्निमद्य श्रुतं नरमर्वाञ्चमिन्द्रमवसे करामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo dabhrebhirhavyo yaśca bhūribhiryo abhīke varivovinnṛṣāhye | taṃ vikhāde sasnimadya śrutaṃ naramarvāñcamindramavase karāmahe ||

translations.english: Let us bring before us today for ur protection that Indra, the pure, the renowned, the leader of rites,who in the main-destroying, all-devouring conflict, is the winner of wealth; who is to be invoked by few and many.

mantras.sanskrit: स्ववृजं हि त्वामहमिन्द्र शुश्रवानानुदं वृषभ रध्रचोदनम् । प्र मुञ्चस्व परि कुत्सादिहा गहि किमु त्वावान्मुष्कयोर्बद्ध आसते ॥
mantras.transliteration: svavṛjaṃ hi tvāmahamindra śuśravānānudaṃ vṛṣabha radhracodanam | pra muñcasva pari kutsādihā gahi kimu tvāvānmuṣkayorbaddha āsate ||

translations.english: Indra, showerer of benefits, I have heard of you, the self-mutilator, the giver of unexpected strength,encouragin the prosperous; set yourself free from Kutsa, and come here; how should such a one as you remainso bound?

mantras.sanskrit: यो वां परिज्मा सुवृदश्विना रथो दोषामुषासो हव्यो हविष्मता । शश्वत्तमासस्तमु वामिदं वयं पितुर्न नाम सुहवं हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo vāṃ parijmā suvṛdaśvinā ratho doṣāmuṣāso havyo haviṣmatā | śaśvattamāsastamu vāmidaṃ vayaṃ piturna nāma suhavaṃ havāmahe ||

translations.english: We from very ancient times invoke, Aśvins, by a name as venerable as that of a father, this yourglorious chariot, which travels all around, which turns, well, and which is to be invoked morning and evening bythe worshipper.

mantras.sanskrit: चोदयतं सूनृताः पिन्वतं धिय उत्पुरंधीरीरयतं तदुश्मसि । यशसं भागं कृणुतं नो अश्विना सोमं न चारुं मघवत्सु नस्कृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: codayataṃ sūnṛtāḥ pinvataṃ dhiya utpuraṃdhīrīrayataṃ taduśmasi | yaśasaṃ bhāgaṃ kṛṇutaṃ no aśvinā somaṃ na cāruṃ maghavatsu naskṛtam ||

translations.english: Stimulate, Aśvins, our words of truth, perfect (our) sacred rites, and inspire (our) numerous facultires;this (is what) we wish; grant us a glorious portion (cf. wealth); put us like prosperous Soma among the affluent.

mantras.sanskrit: अमाजुरश्चिद्भवथो युवं भगोऽनाशोश्चिदवितारापमस्य चित् । अन्धस्य चिन्नासत्या कृशस्य चिद्युवामिदाहुर्भिषजा रुतस्य चित् ॥
mantras.transliteration: amājuraścidbhavatho yuvaṃ bhago'nāśościdavitārāpamasya cit | andhasya cinnāsatyā kṛśasya cidyuvāmidāhurbhiṣajā rutasya cit ||

translations.english: You, Nāsatyās, are the good fortune of a damsel growing old in (her father's) mansion; thepreservers of the famishing, the protectors of the object, of the blind, of the feeble, they call you the physicians ofthe sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं च्यवानं सनयं यथा रथं पुनर्युवानं चरथाय तक्षथुः । निष्टौग्र्यमूहथुरद्भ्यस्परि विश्वेत्ता वां सवनेषु प्रवाच्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ cyavānaṃ sanayaṃ yathā rathaṃ punaryuvānaṃ carathāya takṣathuḥ | niṣṭaugryamūhathuradbhyaspari viśvettā vāṃ savaneṣu pravācyā ||

translations.english: You made the aged Cyavana, when like a worn out chariot, again young and able to go; you bore theson of Tugra above the waters; all these your (exploits) are to be celebrated at our sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: पुराणा वां वीर्या प्र ब्रवा जनेऽथो हासथुर्भिषजा मयोभुवा । ता वां नु नव्याववसे करामहेऽयं नासत्या श्रदरिर्यथा दधत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: purāṇā vāṃ vīryā pra bravā jane'tho hāsathurbhiṣajā mayobhuvā | tā vāṃ nu navyāvavase karāmahe'yaṃ nāsatyā śradariryathā dadhat ||

translations.english: I proclaim, Aśvins, your ancient exploits among the people, for you were the physicians, the bestowersof felicity; we count you two worthy to be praised for (our) preservation; so that this worshipper Na-satyās, maybelieve (in you).

mantras.sanskrit: इयं वामह्वे शृणुतं मे अश्विना पुत्रायेव पितरा मह्यं शिक्षतम् । अनापिरज्ञा असजात्यामतिः पुरा तस्या अभिशस्तेरव स्पृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: iyaṃ vāmahve śṛṇutaṃ me aśvinā putrāyeva pitarā mahyaṃ śikṣatam | anāpirajñā asajātyāmatiḥ purā tasyā abhiśasterava spṛtam ||

translations.english: I here, (ghoṣā), invoke you. Here my (invocation), Aśvins, give me (wealth) as parents give to a son;before (it come) beyond the reach of (a course) that has no relatives, ungrateful, without kinsfolk, without belief,(pursues me); save me from that curse before (it reaches me).

mantras.sanskrit: युवं रथेन विमदाय शुन्ध्युवं न्यूहथुः पुरुमित्रस्य योषणाम् । युवं हवं वध्रिमत्या अगच्छतं युवं सुषुतिं चक्रथुः पुरंधये ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ rathena vimadāya śundhyuvaṃ nyūhathuḥ purumitrasya yoṣaṇām | yuvaṃ havaṃ vadhrimatyā agacchataṃ yuvaṃ suṣutiṃ cakrathuḥ puraṃdhaye ||

translations.english: You brought, Śundhyu, the daughter of Purumitra to (her husband) Vimada; you came atVadharimati's invocation, and gave excellent offsprin to her who was full of wisdom.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं विप्रस्य जरणामुपेयुषः पुनः कलेरकृणुतं युवद्वयः । युवं वन्दनमृश्यदादुदूपथुर्युवं सद्यो विश्पलामेतवे कृथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ viprasya jaraṇāmupeyuṣaḥ punaḥ kalerakṛṇutaṃ yuvadvayaḥ | yuvaṃ vandanamṛśyadādudūpathuryuvaṃ sadyo viśpalāmetave kṛthaḥ ||

translations.english: You made young again the life of the sage Kali, when approaching old age, you rescued Vandanafrom the well; you quickly enabled Viśapalā to walk.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं ह रेभं वृषणा गुहा हितमुदैरयतं ममृवांसमश्विना । युवमृबीसमुत तप्तमत्रय ओमन्वन्तं चक्रथुः सप्तवध्रये ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ ha rebhaṃ vṛṣaṇā guhā hitamudairayataṃ mamṛvāṃsamaśvinā | yuvamṛbīsamuta taptamatraya omanvantaṃ cakrathuḥ saptavadhraye ||

translations.english: Aśvins, shedders of rain, you extricated Rebha when he was plural ced in a cave and was dying; youmade the heated fire-pit cool for Atri; you gave (liberty) to Saptavadhri.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं श्वेतं पेदवेऽश्विनाश्वं नवभिर्वाजैर्नवती च वाजिनम् । चर्कृत्यं ददथुर्द्रावयत्सखं भगं न नृभ्यो हव्यं मयोभुवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ śvetaṃ pedave'śvināśvaṃ navabhirvājairnavatī ca vājinam | carkṛtyaṃ dadathurdrāvayatsakhaṃ bhagaṃ na nṛbhyo havyaṃ mayobhuvam ||

translations.english: You gave, Aśvins, to Pedu a strong white horse with nine-and-ninety (other) steeds, (a horse), active(in combat), putting to flight the friends (of the foe), worthy to be invoked, a source of deligght, like wealth to meṇ

mantras.sanskrit: न तं राजानावदिते कुतश्चन नांहो अश्नोति दुरितं नकिर्भयम् । यमश्विना सुहवा रुद्रवर्तनी पुरोरथं कृणुथः पत्न्या सह ॥
mantras.transliteration: na taṃ rājānāvadite kutaścana nāṃho aśnoti duritaṃ nakirbhayam | yamaśvinā suhavā rudravartanī purorathaṃ kṛṇuthaḥ patnyā saha ||

translations.english: Lofty soverigns, worthy of invocation, going on roads which are praised in hymns, Aśvins, the manwhom with his wife you plural ce in front of (your) car, encounters not from any quarter wickedness, difficulty, ordanger.

mantras.sanskrit: आ तेन यातं मनसो जवीयसा रथं यं वामृभवश्चक्रुरश्विना । यस्य योगे दुहिता जायते दिव उभे अहनी सुदिने विवस्वतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tena yātaṃ manaso javīyasā rathaṃ yaṃ vāmṛbhavaścakruraśvinā | yasya yoge duhitā jāyate diva ubhe ahanī sudine vivasvataḥ ||

translations.english: Come, Aśvins, with the chariot that is swifter than thought, which the Ribhus made for you; inconnection with which the daughter of heaven, (the dawn), is born and both the auspicious day and night fromVivasvat.

mantras.sanskrit: ता वर्तिर्यातं जयुषा वि पर्वतमपिन्वतं शयवे धेनुमश्विना । वृकस्य चिद्वर्तिकामन्तरास्याद्युवं शचीभिर्ग्रसिताममुञ्चतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā vartiryātaṃ jayuṣā vi parvatamapinvataṃ śayave dhenumaśvinā | vṛkasya cidvartikāmantarāsyādyuvaṃ śacībhirgrasitāmamuñcatam ||

translations.english: Do you two, Aśvins, climb the path to the mountain with your triumphant chariot; you have renovatedfor Śayu (barren) cow; you liberated by your acts the quail that had been seized from the jaws of the wolf.

mantras.sanskrit: एतं वां स्तोममश्विनावकर्मातक्षाम भृगवो न रथम् । न्यमृक्षाम योषणां न मर्ये नित्यं न सूनुं तनयं दधानाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: etaṃ vāṃ stomamaśvināvakarmātakṣāma bhṛgavo na ratham | nyamṛkṣāma yoṣaṇāṃ na marye nityaṃ na sūnuṃ tanayaṃ dadhānāḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: रथं यान्तं कुह को ह वां नरा प्रति द्युमन्तं सुविताय भूषति । प्रातर्यावाणं विभ्वं विशेविशे वस्तोर्वस्तोर्वहमानं धिया शमि ॥
mantras.transliteration: rathaṃ yāntaṃ kuha ko ha vāṃ narā prati dyumantaṃ suvitāya bhūṣati | prātaryāvāṇaṃ vibhvaṃ viśeviśe vastorvastorvahamānaṃ dhiyā śami ||

translations.english: What (worshipper), O leaderes of rites, and where (abiding) glorifies for his good, by his praise at therite, your radiant moving chariot, going (to the sacrifice) at dawn, all-pervading, and bearing (wealth) day afterday to one man after another?

mantras.sanskrit: कुह स्विद्दोषा कुह वस्तोरश्विना कुहाभिपित्वं करतः कुहोषतुः । को वां शयुत्रा विधवेव देवरं मर्यं न योषा कृणुते सधस्थ आ ॥
mantras.transliteration: kuha sviddoṣā kuha vastoraśvinā kuhābhipitvaṃ karataḥ kuhoṣatuḥ | ko vāṃ śayutrā vidhaveva devaraṃ maryaṃ na yoṣā kṛṇute sadhastha ā ||

translations.english: Where are you, Aśvins, by night? Where are you by day? Where do you sojourn? Where do youdwell? Who brings you into his presence in the same plural ce (of sacrifice) as on her couch a widow (brings) herhusband's brother, as a woman (brings) her husband (to her).

mantras.sanskrit: प्रातर्जरेथे जरणेव कापया वस्तोर्वस्तोर्यजता गच्छथो गृहम् । कस्य ध्वस्रा भवथः कस्य वा नरा राजपुत्रेव सवनाव गच्छथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prātarjarethe jaraṇeva kāpayā vastorvastoryajatā gacchatho gṛham | kasya dhvasrā bhavathaḥ kasya vā narā rājaputreva savanāva gacchathaḥ ||

translations.english: Leaders (of rites), you are glorified at dawn like two ancient (monarchs) by the voice (of the caller)entitled to worship, you go day by day to the dwelling (of the worshipper); of whose (faults) are you thedestroyer? To whose oblations do you go like princes?

mantras.sanskrit: युवां मृगेव वारणा मृगण्यवो दोषा वस्तोर्हविषा नि ह्वयामहे । युवं होत्रामृतुथा जुह्वते नरेषं जनाय वहथः शुभस्पती ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvāṃ mṛgeva vāraṇā mṛgaṇyavo doṣā vastorhaviṣā ni hvayāmahe | yuvaṃ hotrāmṛtuthā juhvate nareṣaṃ janāya vahathaḥ śubhaspatī ||

translations.english: Like perons hunting two wild elephants, we praise you, Aśvins, with oblations night and day; at all dueseasons, leaders (of rites), (the worshipper) offers you the oblation; do you, who are rulers of the shining (rain),bring food to mankind.

mantras.sanskrit: युवां ह घोषा पर्यश्विना यती राज्ञ ऊचे दुहिता पृच्छे वां नरा । भूतं मे अह्न उत भूतमक्तवेऽश्वावते रथिने शक्तमर्वते ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvāṃ ha ghoṣā paryaśvinā yatī rājña ūce duhitā pṛcche vāṃ narā | bhūtaṃ me ahna uta bhūtamaktave'śvāvate rathine śaktamarvate ||

translations.english: Attending upon you, Aśvins, leaders (of rites), I, Ghoṣā, the daughter of king (Kakṣīvat), speak toyou and request you; be (present at) my (sacrifice) by day, and be (present) by night, be able, (to grant favour) tothe son of my brother, who has horses and a chariot.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं कवी ष्ठः पर्यश्विना रथं विशो न कुत्सो जरितुर्नशायथः । युवोर्ह मक्षा पर्यश्विना मध्वासा भरत निष्कृतं न योषणा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ kavī ṣṭhaḥ paryaśvinā rathaṃ viśo na kutso jariturnaśāyathaḥ | yuvorha makṣā paryaśvinā madhvāsā bharata niṣkṛtaṃ na yoṣaṇā ||

translations.english: Sage Aśvins, stand by your chariot; make it approach (the sacrifice) of the worshipper, as Kutsa(made his chariot approach) men, the fly carries your honey, Aśvins, in its mouth as a woman carries purified(honey).

mantras.sanskrit: युवं ह भुज्युं युवमश्विना वशं युवं शिञ्जारमुशनामुपारथुः । युवो ररावा परि सख्यमासते युवोरहमवसा सुम्नमा चके ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ ha bhujyuṃ yuvamaśvinā vaśaṃ yuvaṃ śiñjāramuśanāmupārathuḥ | yuvo rarāvā pari sakhyamāsate yuvorahamavasā sumnamā cake ||

translations.english: You came, Aśvins, to the rescue of Bhujyu, you came to the rescue of Vaśa, you came to Śiñjārato (hear) his desirable (praise); the offerer of oblations besieges your friendship; and I desire happiness throughyour protection.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं ह कृशं युवमश्विना शयुं युवं विधन्तं विधवामुरुष्यथः । युवं सनिभ्यः स्तनयन्तमश्विनाप व्रजमूर्णुथः सप्तास्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ ha kṛśaṃ yuvamaśvinā śayuṃ yuvaṃ vidhantaṃ vidhavāmuruṣyathaḥ | yuvaṃ sanibhyaḥ stanayantamaśvināpa vrajamūrṇuthaḥ saptāsyam ||

translations.english: Verily, Aśvins, you protect the feeble man; you protected Śayu; you protect him who worshipsaccording to rule, and the widow, (Vadhrimati); you set open, O Aśvins, for the donors of oblations theseven-mouthed thundering cloud.

mantras.sanskrit: जनिष्ट योषा पतयत्कनीनको वि चारुहन्वीरुधो दंसना अनु । आस्मै रीयन्ते निवनेव सिन्धवोऽस्मा अह्ने भवति तत्पतित्वनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: janiṣṭa yoṣā patayatkanīnako vi cāruhanvīrudho daṃsanā anu | āsmai rīyante nivaneva sindhavo'smā ahne bhavati tatpatitvanam ||

translations.english: The bride, Aśvins, has been born, let the husband approach; may the plural nts spring up (for him) afterthe rain; for him may the streams flow as if from a declivity; may he invulnerable have the power of a husbandover her.

mantras.sanskrit: जीवं रुदन्ति वि मयन्ते अध्वरे दीर्घामनु प्रसितिं दीधियुर्नरः । वामं पितृभ्यो य इदं समेरिरे मयः पतिभ्यो जनयः परिष्वजे ॥
mantras.transliteration: jīvaṃ rudanti vi mayante adhvare dīrghāmanu prasitiṃ dīdhiyurnaraḥ | vāmaṃ pitṛbhyo ya idaṃ samerire mayaḥ patibhyo janayaḥ pariṣvaje ||

translations.english: The husbands who weep for the life (of their wives), make them sit down at the sacrifice, hold in a longembrace, (and) send the Pitṛs this desirable offspring, upon these husbands the wives (bestow) happiness inorder to be embraced.

mantras.sanskrit: न तस्य विद्म तदु षु प्र वोचत युवा ह यद्युवत्याः क्षेति योनिषु । प्रियोस्रियस्य वृषभस्य रेतिनो गृहं गमेमाश्विना तदुश्मसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: na tasya vidma tadu ṣu pra vocata yuvā ha yadyuvatyāḥ kṣeti yoniṣu | priyosriyasya vṛṣabhasya retino gṛhaṃ gamemāśvinā taduśmasi ||

translations.english: We do not know this (happiness) of his; do you, (Aśvins), clearly explain how it is that the young(husband) dwells in the bride's house; let us, Aśvins, go the dwelling of (my) dear youthful, vigorous, and manlyhusband; this is our desire.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वामगन्त्सुमतिर्वाजिनीवसू न्यश्विना हृत्सु कामा अयंसत । अभूतं गोपा मिथुना शुभस्पती प्रिया अर्यम्णो दुर्याँ अशीमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāmagantsumatirvājinīvasū nyaśvinā hṛtsu kāmā ayaṃsata | abhūtaṃ gopā mithunā śubhaspatī priyā aryamṇo duryā~ aśīmahi ||

translations.english: Aśvins, rich in food, lords of water, twin (associates), may your good will devolve (upon us), may thedesires (of our hearts) be attained; you have been my protectors; may we, (being) beloved, attain the habitationof a husband.

mantras.sanskrit: ता मन्दसाना मनुषो दुरोण आ धत्तं रयिं सहवीरं वचस्यवे । कृतं तीर्थं सुप्रपाणं शुभस्पती स्थाणुं पथेष्ठामप दुर्मतिं हतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā mandasānā manuṣo duroṇa ā dhattaṃ rayiṃ sahavīraṃ vacasyave | kṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ suprapāṇaṃ śubhaspatī sthāṇuṃ patheṣṭhāmapa durmatiṃ hatam ||

translations.english: Exulting, do you bestow riches, comprehending male progeny, in the house of my husband, on me,who desire to praise you; lords of waters, make the sacred ford good to drink; remove the tree that stands in theroad and the malevolent (enemy).

mantras.sanskrit: क्व स्विदद्य कतमास्वश्विना विक्षु दस्रा मादयेते शुभस्पती । क ईं नि येमे कतमस्य जग्मतुर्विप्रस्य वा यजमानस्य वा गृहम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kva svidadya katamāsvaśvinā vikṣu dasrā mādayete śubhaspatī | ka īṃ ni yeme katamasya jagmaturviprasya vā yajamānasya vā gṛham ||

translations.english: Aśvins of goodly aspect, lords of water, in what plural ce, among what people, do you today delight? Whonow detains you? To the house of what sage or of what sacrificer, have you gone?

mantras.sanskrit: समानमु त्यं पुरुहूतमुक्थ्यं रथं त्रिचक्रं सवना गनिग्मतम् । परिज्मानं विदथ्यं सुवृक्तिभिर्वयं व्युष्टा उषसो हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: samānamu tyaṃ puruhūtamukthyaṃ rathaṃ tricakraṃ savanā ganigmatam | parijmānaṃ vidathyaṃ suvṛktibhirvayaṃ vyuṣṭā uṣaso havāmahe ||

translations.english: At break of dawn, (Aśvins), we invoke with pious prayers your common chariot, praised of many,adorable three-wheeled, frequenting religious rites, traversing all space, suitable at sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रातर्युजं नासत्याधि तिष्ठथः प्रातर्यावाणं मधुवाहनं रथम् । विशो येन गच्छथो यज्वरीर्नरा कीरेश्चिद्यज्ञं होतृमन्तमश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: prātaryujaṃ nāsatyādhi tiṣṭhathaḥ prātaryāvāṇaṃ madhuvāhanaṃ ratham | viśo yena gacchatho yajvarīrnarā kīreścidyajñaṃ hotṛmantamaśvinā ||

translations.english: Ascend, Nāsatyās, your nectar-bearing chariot, which is harnessed at dawn, and set in motion atdawn, with which, leaders (of rites), you go to the people who are engaged in worship, to the priest-administeredsacrifice, Aśvins, of (your) adorer.

mantras.sanskrit: अध्वर्युं वा मधुपाणिं सुहस्त्यमग्निधं वा धृतदक्षं दमूनसम् । विप्रस्य वा यत्सवनानि गच्छथोऽत आ यातं मधुपेयमश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhvaryuṃ vā madhupāṇiṃ suhastyamagnidhaṃ vā dhṛtadakṣaṃ damūnasam | viprasya vā yatsavanāni gacchatho'ta ā yātaṃ madhupeyamaśvinā ||

translations.english: Come, Aśvins, to Suhastya, whether as the ministrant priest bearing the Soma in his hand, or as thecompetent lowly-minded feeder of the sacred fire; although you go to the sacrifices of (some other) sage, (yet)come, Aśvins, from them to the Soma (which I offer).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्तेव सु प्रतरं लायमस्यन्भूषन्निव प्र भरा स्तोममस्मै । वाचा विप्रास्तरत वाचमर्यो नि रामय जरितः सोम इन्द्रम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asteva su prataraṃ lāyamasyanbhūṣanniva pra bharā stomamasmai | vācā viprāstarata vācamaryo ni rāmaya jaritaḥ soma indram ||

translations.english: Direct your laudation to him, (Indra), like an archer aiming a larger arrow (to its mark), like a decorator(applying his ornaments); surpass by your praises, sages, the praises of your adversaries; delight Indraworshipper, by the (offering of the) Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: दोहेन गामुप शिक्षा सखायं प्र बोधय जरितर्जारमिन्द्रम् । कोशं न पूर्णं वसुना न्यृष्टमा च्यावय मघदेयाय शूरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dohena gāmupa śikṣā sakhāyaṃ pra bodhaya jaritarjāramindram | kośaṃ na pūrṇaṃ vasunā nyṛṣṭamā cyāvaya maghadeyāya śūram ||

translations.english: Control, worshipper, your friend (Indra), like a cow for your milking; awake, Indra, the author of decay;bring down for the distribution of wealth the hero who is pressed down with wealth like a vessel full (of water).

mantras.sanskrit: किमङ्ग त्वा मघवन्भोजमाहुः शिशीहि मा शिशयं त्वा शृणोमि । अप्नस्वती मम धीरस्तु शक्र वसुविदं भगमिन्द्रा भरा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kimaṅga tvā maghavanbhojamāhuḥ śiśīhi mā śiśayaṃ tvā śṛṇomi | apnasvatī mama dhīrastu śakra vasuvidaṃ bhagamindrā bharā naḥ ||

translations.english: Why, Maghavat, do (the wise) call you the nourisher (of worshippers)? Quicken me, (Indra), withwealth, (for) I hear that you are the quickener (of the worshipper); may my understanding, Śakra, be productiveof works; grant us, Indra, a destiny that brings wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वां जना ममसत्येष्विन्द्र संतस्थाना वि ह्वयन्ते समीके । अत्रा युजं कृणुते यो हविष्मान्नासुन्वता सख्यं वष्टि शूरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāṃ janā mamasatyeṣvindra saṃtasthānā vi hvayante samīke | atrā yujaṃ kṛṇute yo haviṣmānnāsunvatā sakhyaṃ vaṣṭi śūraḥ ||

translations.english: The people earnestly call upon you in battles, Indra, (they call upon you) when standing together inthe conflict; at this (call) Indra makes him his friend who offers oblations; the hero desires not friendship with himwho presents no libation.

mantras.sanskrit: धनं न स्यन्द्रं बहुलं यो अस्मै तीव्रान्त्सोमाँ आसुनोति प्रयस्वान् । तस्मै शत्रून्त्सुतुकान्प्रातरह्नो नि स्वष्ट्रान्युवति हन्ति वृत्रम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhanaṃ na syandraṃ bahulaṃ yo asmai tīvrāntsomā~ āsunoti prayasvān | tasmai śatrūntsutukānprātarahno ni svaṣṭrānyuvati hanti vṛtram ||

translations.english: The bearer of the oblation who offers to Indra the sharp Soma, like much moveable wealth (given tothe poor)-- for him in the fore part of the day Indra scatters his eager and well-armed (enemies), and defeats hisfoe.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्मिन्वयं दधिमा शंसमिन्द्रे यः शिश्राय मघवा काममस्मे । आराच्चित्सन्भयतामस्य शत्रुर्न्यस्मै द्युम्ना जन्या नमन्ताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasminvayaṃ dadhimā śaṃsamindre yaḥ śiśrāya maghavā kāmamasme | ārāccitsanbhayatāmasya śatrurnyasmai dyumnā janyā namantām ||

translations.english: May the enemy of that Indra on whom we have laid our praise, the lord of affluence, who has grantedus our desires, be in the fear of him even when far off; may the food belonging to the country of the foe bowdown before him (to enjoy).

mantras.sanskrit: आराच्छत्रुमप बाधस्व दूरमुग्रो यः शम्बः पुरुहूत तेन । अस्मे धेहि यवमद्गोमदिन्द्र कृधी धियं जरित्रे वाजरत्नाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ārācchatrumapa bādhasva dūramugro yaḥ śambaḥ puruhūta tena | asme dhehi yavamadgomadindra kṛdhī dhiyaṃ jaritre vājaratnām ||

translations.english: Invoked of many, (Indra) drive far away the enemy with that fierce thunderbolt of yours; grant to us,Indra, wealth of barley and cattle; render to the worshipper his sacrifice productive of plural asant food.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र यमन्तर्वृषसवासो अग्मन्तीव्राः सोमा बहुलान्तास इन्द्रम् । नाह दामानं मघवा नि यंसन्नि सुन्वते वहति भूरि वामम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra yamantarvṛṣasavāso agmantīvrāḥ somā bahulāntāsa indram | nāha dāmānaṃ maghavā ni yaṃsanni sunvate vahati bhūri vāmam ||

translations.english: The Indra into whom the sharp abundant Soma effused by (the priests), the showerers (of the Soma),have entered; he, Maghavat, deserts not the donor of the sacrifice, but bestows ample wealth upon him whopresents libations.

mantras.sanskrit: उत प्रहामतिदीव्या जयाति कृतं यच्छ्वघ्नी विचिनोति काले । यो देवकामो न धना रुणद्धि समित्तं राया सृजति स्वधावान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta prahāmatidīvyā jayāti kṛtaṃ yacchvaghnī vicinoti kāle | yo devakāmo na dhanā ruṇaddhi samittaṃ rāyā sṛjati svadhāvān ||

translations.english: Having driven away the assailant, he triumphs; at the time (of battle) he selects his antagonist as doesa gambler. The man who, desirous of gratifying the gods, withholds not his riches, him the powerful Indraassociates with wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: गोभिष्टरेमामतिं दुरेवां यवेन क्षुधं पुरुहूत विश्वाम् । वयं राजभिः प्रथमा धनान्यस्माकेन वृजनेना जयेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: gobhiṣṭaremāmatiṃ durevāṃ yavena kṣudhaṃ puruhūta viśvām | vayaṃ rājabhiḥ prathamā dhanānyasmākena vṛjanenā jayema ||

translations.english: Indra, invoked of many, may we escape all ignorance caused by poverty by means of our cattle; (maywe escape) all hunger by means of our barley; (may we acquire) the chief riches through the princes (of wealth);may we conquer by our valour.

mantras.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिर्नः परि पातु पश्चादुतोत्तरस्मादधरादघायोः । इन्द्रः पुरस्तादुत मध्यतो नः सखा सखिभ्यो वरिवः कृणोतु ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhaspatirnaḥ pari pātu paścādutottarasmādadharādaghāyoḥ | indraḥ purastāduta madhyato naḥ sakhā sakhibhyo varivaḥ kṛṇotu ||

translations.english: May Bṛhaspati defend us from a malignant (foe) coming from behind, from above, or from below; mayIndra defend us from foes in front and in the middle; may he, our friend, bestow wealth upon (us) his friends.

mantras.sanskrit: अच्छा म इन्द्रं मतयः स्वर्विदः सध्रीचीर्विश्वा उशतीरनूषत । परि ष्वजन्ते जनयो यथा पतिं मर्यं न शुन्ध्युं मघवानमूतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: acchā ma indraṃ matayaḥ svarvidaḥ sadhrīcīrviśvā uśatīranūṣata | pari ṣvajante janayo yathā patiṃ maryaṃ na śundhyuṃ maghavānamūtaye ||

translations.english: My praises, all-acquiring, concentrated and eager, glorify Indra; they embrace Maghavat as wives(embrace) a husband; as (women embrace) a man free from defect for the sake of protection.

mantras.sanskrit: न घा त्वद्रिगप वेति मे मनस्त्वे इत्कामं पुरुहूत शिश्रय । राजेव दस्म नि षदोऽधि बर्हिष्यस्मिन्त्सु सोमेऽवपानमस्तु ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: na ghā tvadrigapa veti me manastve itkāmaṃ puruhūta śiśraya | rājeva dasma ni ṣado'dhi barhiṣyasmintsu some'vapānamastu te ||

translations.english: Indra, of godly aspect, the invoked of many, my mind intent on you wanders not from your presence, Ifix my desire on you; take your seat like a prince upon this sacred grass, and may your drinking be of this Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: विषूवृदिन्द्रो अमतेरुत क्षुधः स इद्रायो मघवा वस्व ईशते । तस्येदिमे प्रवणे सप्त सिन्धवो वयो वर्धन्ति वृषभस्य शुष्मिणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viṣūvṛdindro amateruta kṣudhaḥ sa idrāyo maghavā vasva īśate | tasyedime pravaṇe sapta sindhavo vayo vardhanti vṛṣabhasya śuṣmiṇaḥ ||

translations.english: May Indra be the remover of thirst and hunger, for he, Maghavat, is lord over precious riches; theseseven rivers of the powerful showerer, (Indra), flowing down a declivity, augment food.

mantras.sanskrit: वयो न वृक्षं सुपलाशमासदन्त्सोमास इन्द्रं मन्दिनश्चमूषदः । प्रैषामनीकं शवसा दविद्युतद्विदत्स्वर्मनवे ज्योतिरार्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayo na vṛkṣaṃ supalāśamāsadantsomāsa indraṃ mandinaścamūṣadaḥ | praiṣāmanīkaṃ śavasā davidyutadvidatsvarmanave jyotirāryam ||

translations.english: As birds perch upon the leafy tree, so the exhilarating Soma fillling the ladles (go) to (Indra), thesummit of them shines through their speed, may Indra spontaneously bestow excellent light upon man.

mantras.sanskrit: कृतं न श्वघ्नी वि चिनोति देवने संवर्गं यन्मघवा सूर्यं जयत् । न तत्ते अन्यो अनु वीर्यं शकन्न पुराणो मघवन्नोत नूतनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kṛtaṃ na śvaghnī vi cinoti devane saṃvargaṃ yanmaghavā sūryaṃ jayat | na tatte anyo anu vīryaṃ śakanna purāṇo maghavannota nūtanaḥ ||

translations.english: As a gambler at plural y selects his adversary, so does Maghavat when he overcomes the rain-bestowingsun; no one, Maghavat, ancient or modern, is able to imitate this your vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: विशंविशं मघवा पर्यशायत जनानां धेना अवचाकशद्वृषा । यस्याह शक्रः सवनेषु रण्यति स तीव्रैः सोमैः सहते पृतन्यतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśaṃviśaṃ maghavā paryaśāyata janānāṃ dhenā avacākaśadvṛṣā | yasyāha śakraḥ savaneṣu raṇyati sa tīvraiḥ somaiḥ sahate pṛtanyataḥ ||

translations.english: Maghavat, the showerer (of benefits), encompasses all people; he contemplates the praises ofmankind; the man in whose sacrifice Śakra delights, overcomes (foes) wishing to fight by means of his pungentSoma-libations.

mantras.sanskrit: आपो न सिन्धुमभि यत्समक्षरन्त्सोमास इन्द्रं कुल्या इव ह्रदम् । वर्धन्ति विप्रा महो अस्य सादने यवं न वृष्टिर्दिव्येन दानुना ॥
mantras.transliteration: āpo na sindhumabhi yatsamakṣarantsomāsa indraṃ kulyā iva hradam | vardhanti viprā maho asya sādane yavaṃ na vṛṣṭirdivyena dānunā ||

translations.english: When the Soma flows towards Indra, as waters to the sea, as rivers to a lake, then the piousworshippers augment his greatness in the (sacrificial) abode, as the rain by its heavenly gift, (augments) thebarley.

mantras.sanskrit: वृषा न क्रुद्धः पतयद्रजस्स्वा यो अर्यपत्नीरकृणोदिमा अपः । स सुन्वते मघवा जीरदानवेऽविन्दज्ज्योतिर्मनवे हविष्मते ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣā na kruddhaḥ patayadrajassvā yo aryapatnīrakṛṇodimā apaḥ | sa sunvate maghavā jīradānave'vindajjyotirmanave haviṣmate ||

translations.english: As in the world an angry bull rushes (upon another), so does Indra, who directs (towards us) thewaters, the brides of the lord (of earth); when (the Soma) is effused, Maghavat bestows light upon the man, whogives promptly, who offers oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: उज्जायतां परशुर्ज्योतिषा सह भूया ऋतस्य सुदुघा पुराणवत् । वि रोचतामरुषो भानुना शुचिः स्वर्ण शुक्रं शुशुचीत सत्पतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ujjāyatāṃ paraśurjyotiṣā saha bhūyā ṛtasya sudughā purāṇavat | vi rocatāmaruṣo bhānunā śuciḥ svarṇa śukraṃ śuśucīta satpatiḥ ||

translations.english: Let the axe (of Indra) be put forth together with light; may the easily milked cow of truth be(manifested) as of old; may the pure and radiant Indra shine with splendour; may the lord of the virtuous shinebrightly like the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: गोभिष्टरेमामतिं दुरेवां यवेन क्षुधं पुरुहूत विश्वाम् । वयं राजभिः प्रथमा धनान्यस्माकेन वृजनेना जयेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: gobhiṣṭaremāmatiṃ durevāṃ yavena kṣudhaṃ puruhūta viśvām | vayaṃ rājabhiḥ prathamā dhanānyasmākena vṛjanenā jayema ||

translations.english: Indra, invoked of many, may we escape all ignorance caused by poverty by means of our cattle; (maywe escape) all hunger by means of our barley; (may we acquire) the chief riches through the princes (of wealth);may we conquer by our valour.

mantras.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिर्नः परि पातु पश्चादुतोत्तरस्मादधरादघायोः । इन्द्रः पुरस्तादुत मध्यतो नः सखा सखिभ्यो वरिवः कृणोतु ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhaspatirnaḥ pari pātu paścādutottarasmādadharādaghāyoḥ | indraḥ purastāduta madhyato naḥ sakhā sakhibhyo varivaḥ kṛṇotu ||

translations.english: May Bṛhaspati defend us from a malignant (foe) coming from behind, from above, or from below; mayIndra defend us from foes in front and in the middle; may he, our friend, bestow wealth upon (us) his friends.

mantras.sanskrit: आ यात्विन्द्रः स्वपतिर्मदाय यो धर्मणा तूतुजानस्तुविष्मान् । प्रत्वक्षाणो अति विश्वा सहांस्यपारेण महता वृष्ण्येन ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yātvindraḥ svapatirmadāya yo dharmaṇā tūtujānastuviṣmān | pratvakṣāṇo ati viśvā sahāṃsyapāreṇa mahatā vṛṣṇyena ||

translations.english: May Indra, the lord of wealth, come here with his chariot for his exhilaration; he who is rapid, strong,who, overcoming all the forces (of the enemy) by his great insuperable might, (passes) through them.

mantras.sanskrit: सुष्ठामा रथः सुयमा हरी ते मिम्यक्ष वज्रो नृपते गभस्तौ । शीभं राजन्त्सुपथा याह्यर्वाङ्वर्धाम ते पपुषो वृष्ण्यानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: suṣṭhāmā rathaḥ suyamā harī te mimyakṣa vajro nṛpate gabhastau | śībhaṃ rājantsupathā yāhyarvāṅvardhāma te papuṣo vṛṣṇyāni ||

translations.english: King of men, your chariot is well stationed; your horses are well trained; the thunderbolt is grasped inyour hands; come quickly towards us, lord of all, by a good path, we will augment your energies when you drinkthe Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: एन्द्रवाहो नृपतिं वज्रबाहुमुग्रमुग्रासस्तविषास एनम् । प्रत्वक्षसं वृषभं सत्यशुष्ममेमस्मत्रा सधमादो वहन्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: endravāho nṛpatiṃ vajrabāhumugramugrāsastaviṣāsa enam | pratvakṣasaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ satyaśuṣmamemasmatrā sadhamādo vahantu ||

translations.english: May the fierce, vigorous, exulting horses of Indra bring him here to us, the king of men, armed with thethunderbolt, fierce, the reducer of foes, the showerer (of benefits), whose strength is real.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा पतिं द्रोणसाचं सचेतसमूर्जः स्कम्भं धरुण आ वृषायसे । ओजः कृष्व सं गृभाय त्वे अप्यसो यथा केनिपानामिनो वृधे ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā patiṃ droṇasācaṃ sacetasamūrjaḥ skambhaṃ dharuṇa ā vṛṣāyase | ojaḥ kṛṣva saṃ gṛbhāya tve apyaso yathā kenipānāmino vṛdhe ||

translations.english: Verily, Indra, you pour into your capacious (stomach) the protecting (Soma), serving the woodentrough, intelligent, holding strength; bestow (upon us) vigour; take us into yourself, for you are the lord for theexaltation of the wise.

mantras.sanskrit: गमन्नस्मे वसून्या हि शंसिषं स्वाशिषं भरमा याहि सोमिनः । त्वमीशिषे सास्मिन्ना सत्सि बर्हिष्यनाधृष्या तव पात्राणि धर्मणा ॥
mantras.transliteration: gamannasme vasūnyā hi śaṃsiṣaṃ svāśiṣaṃ bharamā yāhi sominaḥ | tvamīśiṣe sāsminnā satsi barhiṣyanādhṛṣyā tava pātrāṇi dharmaṇā ||

translations.english: Let the wealth (to be given by you) come quickly to me, for verily I have glorified you; come to theblessed sacrifice of the offerer of the Soma; for you are the lord; sit down upon this sacred grass; these yourcups (of Soma) are not to be insulted by the act (of evil spirits).

mantras.sanskrit: पृथक्प्रायन्प्रथमा देवहूतयोऽकृण्वत श्रवस्यानि दुष्टरा । न ये शेकुर्यज्ञियां नावमारुहमीर्मैव ते न्यविशन्त केपयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pṛthakprāyanprathamā devahūtayo'kṛṇvata śravasyāni duṣṭarā | na ye śekuryajñiyāṃ nāvamāruhamīrmaiva te nyaviśanta kepayaḥ ||

translations.english: They go separately (to the worlds of the gods); first those who offer oblations to the gods haveattained reputation difficult to surpass; those who have not been able to ascend the ship of sacrifice, have gonedown (in the world), wretches (plural nged) in debt.

mantras.sanskrit: एवैवापागपरे सन्तु दूढ्योऽश्वा येषां दुर्युज आयुयुज्रे । इत्था ये प्रागुपरे सन्ति दावने पुरूणि यत्र वयुनानि भोजना ॥
mantras.transliteration: evaivāpāgapare santu dūḍhyo'śvā yeṣāṃ duryuja āyuyujre | itthā ye prāgupare santi dāvane purūṇi yatra vayunāni bhojanā ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: गिरीँरज्रान्रेजमानाँ अधारयद्द्यौः क्रन्ददन्तरिक्षाणि कोपयत् । समीचीने धिषणे वि ष्कभायति वृष्णः पीत्वा मद उक्थानि शंसति ॥
mantras.transliteration: girī~rajrānrejamānā~ adhārayaddyauḥ krandadantarikṣāṇi kopayat | samīcīne dhiṣaṇe vi ṣkabhāyati vṛṣṇaḥ pītvā mada ukthāni śaṃsati ||

translations.english: (Indra) has arrested the wandering tremulous clouds; the heaven cries out (in alarm); he agitates thefirmament; he fixes the combined heaven and earth; having drunk of the effused Soma, he repeats praises in hisexhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: इमं बिभर्मि सुकृतं ते अङ्कुशं येनारुजासि मघवञ्छफारुजः । अस्मिन्त्सु ते सवने अस्त्वोक्यं सुत इष्टौ मघवन्बोध्याभगः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imaṃ bibharmi sukṛtaṃ te aṅkuśaṃ yenārujāsi maghavañchaphārujaḥ | asmintsu te savane astvokyaṃ suta iṣṭau maghavanbodhyābhagaḥ ||
