translations.english: I bear this your well-made goad, (excited) by which, Maghavat, you urge on the slayers of powerfulfoes. Let your abode be at this my sacrifice. Accept, Maghavat, who are to be adored, (my praise) at the sacrificeat which (the Soma) is effused.

mantras.sanskrit: गोभिष्टरेमामतिं दुरेवां यवेन क्षुधं पुरुहूत विश्वाम् । वयं राजभिः प्रथमा धनान्यस्माकेन वृजनेना जयेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: gobhiṣṭaremāmatiṃ durevāṃ yavena kṣudhaṃ puruhūta viśvām | vayaṃ rājabhiḥ prathamā dhanānyasmākena vṛjanenā jayema ||

translations.english: Indra, invoked of many, may we escape all ignorance caused by poverty by means of our cattle; (maywe escape) all hunger by means of our barley; (may we acquire) the chief riches through the princes (of wealth);may we conquer by our valour.

mantras.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिर्नः परि पातु पश्चादुतोत्तरस्मादधरादघायोः । इन्द्रः पुरस्तादुत मध्यतो नः सखा सखिभ्यो वरिवः कृणोतु ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhaspatirnaḥ pari pātu paścādutottarasmādadharādaghāyoḥ | indraḥ purastāduta madhyato naḥ sakhā sakhibhyo varivaḥ kṛṇotu ||

translations.english: May Bṛhaspati defend us from a malignant (foe) coming from behind, from above, or from below; mayIndra defend us from foes in front and in the middle; may he, our friend, bestow wealth upon (us) his friends.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवस्परि प्रथमं जज्ञे अग्निरस्मद्द्वितीयं परि जातवेदाः । तृतीयमप्सु नृमणा अजस्रमिन्धान एनं जरते स्वाधीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: divaspari prathamaṃ jajñe agnirasmaddvitīyaṃ pari jātavedāḥ | tṛtīyamapsu nṛmaṇā ajasramindhāna enaṃ jarate svādhīḥ ||

translations.english: Agni was first born above the sky; as Ja-tavedas he was born the second time among us; the friend ofman, he was born the third time in the watters; the sage kindlin him eternally praises him.

mantras.sanskrit: विद्मा ते अग्ने त्रेधा त्रयाणि विद्मा ते धाम विभृता पुरुत्रा । विद्मा ते नाम परमं गुहा यद्विद्मा तमुत्सं यत आजगन्थ ॥
mantras.transliteration: vidmā te agne tredhā trayāṇi vidmā te dhāma vibhṛtā purutrā | vidmā te nāma paramaṃ guhā yadvidmā tamutsaṃ yata ājagantha ||

translations.english: We recognize your threefold station, Agni, and your three (forms); we recognize the many stationsoccupied by you; we know what your supreme secret appellation (is); we know the source, whence you haveproceeded.

mantras.sanskrit: समुद्रे त्वा नृमणा अप्स्वन्तर्नृचक्षा ईधे दिवो अग्न ऊधन् । तृतीये त्वा रजसि तस्थिवांसमपामुपस्थे महिषा अवर्धन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: samudre tvā nṛmaṇā apsvantarnṛcakṣā īdhe divo agna ūdhan | tṛtīye tvā rajasi tasthivāṃsamapāmupasthe mahiṣā avardhan ||

translations.english: He who is well disposed towards men illumines the Agni in the ocean (as submarine fire), in the midstof the waters; the beholder of men (illumines) you in the centre of the sky; the mighty (maruts) magnify youabiding in the third region (the firmament), on the lap of the waters.

mantras.sanskrit: अक्रन्ददग्निः स्तनयन्निव द्यौः क्षामा रेरिहद्वीरुधः समञ्जन् । सद्यो जज्ञानो वि हीमिद्धो अख्यदा रोदसी भानुना भात्यन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: akrandadagniḥ stanayanniva dyauḥ kṣāmā rerihadvīrudhaḥ samañjan | sadyo jajñāno vi hīmiddho akhyadā rodasī bhānunā bhātyantaḥ ||

translations.english: Agni cries aloud like the thundering heaven; he licks the earth burning the plural nts; as soon asgenerated, he contemplates this (conflagration); when kindled he blazes with his (own) radiance between heavenand earth.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रीणामुदारो धरुणो रयीणां मनीषाणां प्रार्पणः सोमगोपाः । वसुः सूनुः सहसो अप्सु राजा वि भात्यग्र उषसामिधानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śrīṇāmudāro dharuṇo rayīṇāṃ manīṣāṇāṃ prārpaṇaḥ somagopāḥ | vasuḥ sūnuḥ sahaso apsu rājā vi bhātyagra uṣasāmidhānaḥ ||

translations.english: Liberal, exciter of splendours, depositary of riches, granter of desires, preserver of the Soma, theinhabiter (of the world), the son of strength, (plural ced) in the waters, the king (Agni) blazes, kindled at thecommencement of dawn.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वस्य केतुर्भुवनस्य गर्भ आ रोदसी अपृणाज्जायमानः । वीळुं चिदद्रिमभिनत्परायञ्जना यदग्निमयजन्त पञ्च ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvasya keturbhuvanasya garbha ā rodasī apṛṇājjāyamānaḥ | vīḷuṃ cidadrimabhinatparāyañjanā yadagnimayajanta pañca ||

translations.english: The manifester of all, the germ of the world, Agni, as soon as born fills heaven and earth (with light);he fractures as he advances the solid cloud, for which the classes of men praise him.

mantras.sanskrit: उशिक्पावको अरतिः सुमेधा मर्तेष्वग्निरमृतो नि धायि । इयर्ति धूममरुषं भरिभ्रदुच्छुक्रेण शोचिषा द्यामिनक्षन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uśikpāvako aratiḥ sumedhā marteṣvagniramṛto ni dhāyi | iyarti dhūmamaruṣaṃ bharibhraducchukreṇa śociṣā dyāminakṣan ||

translations.english: Desiring (oblations), purifying, moving quickly, sagacious, immortal, Agni has been stationed amongmortals; he sends forth the smoke, and goes wearing a radiant (form), and percading the heaven with brilliantlustre.

mantras.sanskrit: दृशानो रुक्म उर्विया व्यद्यौद्दुर्मर्षमायुः श्रिये रुचानः । अग्निरमृतो अभवद्वयोभिर्यदेनं द्यौर्जनयत्सुरेताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dṛśāno rukma urviyā vyadyauddurmarṣamāyuḥ śriye rucānaḥ | agniramṛto abhavadvayobhiryadenaṃ dyaurjanayatsuretāḥ ||

translations.english: Conspicuous, glorious, Agni shines with great splendour, moving everywhere, and blazingunsurpassingly with glory; Agni became immortal through the food (of sacrifice) when the prolific heavenengendered him.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्ते अद्य कृणवद्भद्रशोचेऽपूपं देव घृतवन्तमग्ने । प्र तं नय प्रतरं वस्यो अच्छाभि सुम्नं देवभक्तं यविष्ठ ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaste adya kṛṇavadbhadraśoce'pūpaṃ deva ghṛtavantamagne | pra taṃ naya prataraṃ vasyo acchābhi sumnaṃ devabhaktaṃ yaviṣṭha ||

translations.english: Auspiciously radiant and divine Agni, youngest (of the gods), grant ample wealth to the eminent(worshipper), who presents to you today cakes dressed with butter, and confer happiness upon one devoted tothe gods.

mantras.sanskrit: आ तं भज सौश्रवसेष्वग्न उक्थौक्थ आ भज शस्यमाने । प्रियः सूर्ये प्रियो अग्ना भवात्युज्जातेन भिनददुज्जनित्वैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā taṃ bhaja sauśravaseṣvagna ukthauktha ā bhaja śasyamāne | priyaḥ sūrye priyo agnā bhavātyujjātena bhinadadujjanitvaiḥ ||

translations.english: Prosper the worshipper, Agni, when beautiful sacrificial viands (are being offered), when sacredpraises are being recited (by him). May he be dear to Sūrya, dear to Agni; may he by a son born, or sons to beborn, overcome (his foes).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने यजमाना अनु द्यून्विश्वा वसु दधिरे वार्याणि । त्वया सह द्रविणमिच्छमाना व्रजं गोमन्तमुशिजो वि वव्रुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmagne yajamānā anu dyūnviśvā vasu dadhire vāryāṇi | tvayā saha draviṇamicchamānā vrajaṃ gomantamuśijo vi vavruḥ ||

translations.english: To you, Agni, the worshippers offer daily all desirable treasures; (abiding) with you, desirous of wealth,the sages have set open the pasturage frequented by cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्ताव्यग्निर्नरां सुशेवो वैश्वानर ऋषिभिः सोमगोपाः । अद्वेषे द्यावापृथिवी हुवेम देवा धत्त रयिमस्मे सुवीरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: astāvyagnirnarāṃ suśevo vaiśvānara ṛṣibhiḥ somagopāḥ | adveṣe dyāvāpṛthivī huvema devā dhatta rayimasme suvīram ||

translations.english: Agni, who are very dear to men, Vaiśvānara, the guardian of the Soma, has been glorified by the

mantras.sanskrit: प्र होता जातो महान्नभोविन्नृषद्वा सीददपामुपस्थे । दधिर्यो धायि स ते वयांसि यन्ता वसूनि विधते तनूपाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra hotā jāto mahānnabhovinnṛṣadvā sīdadapāmupasthe | dadhiryo dhāyi sa te vayāṃsi yantā vasūni vidhate tanūpāḥ ||

translations.english: A mighty ministrant priest, one cognizant of heaven, though abiding with men, having been born, isseated on the lap of the waters; may he, the upholder (of sacrifice), who has been stationed (on the altar), be toyou when offering worship, the giver of food and riches, the protector of your person n.

mantras.sanskrit: इमं विधन्तो अपां सधस्थे पशुं न नष्टं पदैरनु ग्मन् । गुहा चतन्तमुशिजो नमोभिरिच्छन्तो धीरा भृगवोऽविन्दन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: imaṃ vidhanto apāṃ sadhasthe paśuṃ na naṣṭaṃ padairanu gman | guhā catantamuśijo namobhiricchanto dhīrā bhṛgavo'vindan ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: इमं त्रितो भूर्यविन्ददिच्छन्वैभूवसो मूर्धन्यघ्न्यायाः । स शेवृधो जात आ हर्म्येषु नाभिर्युवा भवति रोचनस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: imaṃ trito bhūryavindadicchanvaibhūvaso mūrdhanyaghnyāyāḥ | sa śevṛdho jāta ā harmyeṣu nābhiryuvā bhavati rocanasya ||

translations.english: Trita, the son of Vibhuvas, searching (for him), found mighty Agni on the head of the cow; he theaugmenter of happiness manifested in the dwellings (of the pious), the youthful (connecting) bond of theresplendent (Sun).

mantras.sanskrit: मन्द्रं होतारमुशिजो नमोभिः प्राञ्चं यज्ञं नेतारमध्वराणाम् । विशामकृण्वन्नरतिं पावकं हव्यवाहं दधतो मानुषेषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: mandraṃ hotāramuśijo namobhiḥ prāñcaṃ yajñaṃ netāramadhvarāṇām | viśāmakṛṇvannaratiṃ pāvakaṃ havyavāhaṃ dadhato mānuṣeṣu ||

translations.english: (The priests) desirous (to propitiate him), detaining him among men, have by their adoration made himlord over all people, him the exhilarator, the presenteer of burnt offerings, the migrator, the object of sacrifice, theleader of rites, the purifier, the bearer of oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र भूर्जयन्तं महां विपोधां मूरा अमूरं पुरां दर्माणम् । नयन्तो गर्भं वनां धियं धुर्हिरिश्मश्रुं नार्वाणं धनर्चम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra bhūrjayantaṃ mahāṃ vipodhāṃ mūrā amūraṃ purāṃ darmāṇam | nayanto garbhaṃ vanāṃ dhiyaṃ dhurhiriśmaśruṃ nārvāṇaṃ dhanarcam ||

translations.english: Be competent, (priest, to glorify) the victorious mighty Agni, the sustainer of the wise, (even) fools(adore) him, the exempt from folly, the demolisher of cities; conducting the embryo of touchwood, (Agni). Like agolden- haired, swift-moving (horse), loving praise and wealth, they bring him to the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: नि पस्त्यासु त्रितः स्तभूयन्परिवीतो योनौ सीददन्तः । अतः संगृभ्या विशां दमूना विधर्मणायन्त्रैरीयते नॄन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni pastyāsu tritaḥ stabhūyanparivīto yonau sīdadantaḥ | ataḥ saṃgṛbhyā viśāṃ damūnā vidharmaṇāyantrairīyate nṝn ||

translations.english: Occupying three (satations), consolidation (the dwelling of the worshipper), surrounded (by flames),he sits down upon the altar in the chambers (of sacrifice); from there, having accepted (the oblations) of thepeople, with intent to give (them to the gods), in various ways, he (Agni) goes to the gods holding (his foes) incheck.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्याजरासो दमामरित्रा अर्चद्धूमासो अग्नयः पावकाः । श्वितीचयः श्वात्रासो भुरण्यवो वनर्षदो वायवो न सोमाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asyājarāso damāmaritrā arcaddhūmāso agnayaḥ pāvakāḥ | śvitīcayaḥ śvātrāso bhuraṇyavo vanarṣado vāyavo na somāḥ ||

translations.english: The undecaying fires of the worshipper, the rescuers from the humiliated (spirits of ill), havingadorable smoke, purifying, becoming white, swift, bearing (the oblation), sitting in the wood, (are) like thefast-flowing Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र जिह्वया भरते वेपो अग्निः प्र वयुनानि चेतसा पृथिव्याः । तमायवः शुचयन्तं पावकं मन्द्रं होतारं दधिरे यजिष्ठम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra jihvayā bharate vepo agniḥ pra vayunāni cetasā pṛthivyāḥ | tamāyavaḥ śucayantaṃ pāvakaṃ mandraṃ hotāraṃ dadhire yajiṣṭham ||

translations.english: Agni, who bears off (the oblation) with his tongue (of flames), who bears off the hymns of praise with(favourable) mind (for the preservation) of the earth; him men appointed as the shining, purifying, exulting hotā,the most entitled to worship.

mantras.sanskrit: द्यावा यमग्निं पृथिवी जनिष्टामापस्त्वष्टा भृगवो यं सहोभिः । ईळेन्यं प्रथमं मातरिश्वा देवास्ततक्षुर्मनवे यजत्रम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dyāvā yamagniṃ pṛthivī janiṣṭāmāpastvaṣṭā bhṛgavo yaṃ sahobhiḥ | īḷenyaṃ prathamaṃ mātariśvā devāstatakṣurmanave yajatram ||

translations.english: Agni, whom heaven and earth engendered, (whom) the waters and Tvaṣṭā, and the Bṛghus by theirpowers (begot),; the adorable one, whom Mātariśvan first, and the gods fabricated as the object of worship ofManu.

mantras.sanskrit: यं त्वा देवा दधिरे हव्यवाहं पुरुस्पृहो मानुषासो यजत्रम् । स यामन्नग्ने स्तुवते वयो धाः प्र देवयन्यशसः सं हि पूर्वीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ tvā devā dadhire havyavāhaṃ puruspṛho mānuṣāso yajatram | sa yāmannagne stuvate vayo dhāḥ pra devayanyaśasaḥ saṃ hi pūrvīḥ ||

translations.english: You, whom the gods appointed as the bearer of oblations, whom men, desiring manifold blessings,regard as the object of worship; do you, Agni, bestow food upon him who praises you at the sacrifice; for thedevout worshipper verily obtains great renown.

mantras.sanskrit: जगृभ्मा ते दक्षिणमिन्द्र हस्तं वसूयवो वसुपते वसूनाम् । विद्मा हि त्वा गोपतिं शूर गोनामस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: jagṛbhmā te dakṣiṇamindra hastaṃ vasūyavo vasupate vasūnām | vidmā hi tvā gopatiṃ śūra gonāmasmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, lord of abundant wealth, we, desiring wealth, seize hold of your right hand; we know you, hero,lord of abundant cattle, give us various fertilizing riches.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वायुधं स्ववसं सुनीथं चतुःसमुद्रं धरुणं रयीणाम् । चर्कृत्यं शंस्यं भूरिवारमस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: svāyudhaṃ svavasaṃ sunīthaṃ catuḥsamudraṃ dharuṇaṃ rayīṇām | carkṛtyaṃ śaṃsyaṃ bhūrivāramasmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||

translations.english: (We know you to be) well armed, a sure protector, a safe guide, (renowned throughout) the fouroceans, the depositary of riches, deserving of repeated worship, adorable, the preventer of many (ills); grant usvarious fertilizing riches.

mantras.sanskrit: सुब्रह्माणं देववन्तं बृहन्तमुरुं गभीरं पृथुबुध्नमिन्द्र । श्रुतऋषिमुग्रमभिमातिषाहमस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: subrahmāṇaṃ devavantaṃ bṛhantamuruṃ gabhīraṃ pṛthubudhnamindra | śrutaṛṣimugramabhimātiṣāhamasmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||

translations.english: Grant us, Indra, various fertilizing riches, the fit object of prayer, honoured by the gods, large, vast,

mantras.sanskrit: सनद्वाजं विप्रवीरं तरुत्रं धनस्पृतं शूशुवांसं सुदक्षम् । दस्युहनं पूर्भिदमिन्द्र सत्यमस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sanadvājaṃ vipravīraṃ tarutraṃ dhanaspṛtaṃ śūśuvāṃsaṃ sudakṣam | dasyuhanaṃ pūrbhidamindra satyamasmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||

translations.english: Grant us, Indra, various fertilizing riches, dispensing food, comprising intelligent male offspring, theprotector, filling men with wealth, the granter of increase, the very powerful, the slayer of the Dasyus, thedestroyer of cities, the observer of truth.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्वावन्तं रथिनं वीरवन्तं सहस्रिणं शतिनं वाजमिन्द्र । भद्रव्रातं विप्रवीरं स्वर्षामस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvāvantaṃ rathinaṃ vīravantaṃ sahasriṇaṃ śatinaṃ vājamindra | bhadravrātaṃ vipravīraṃ svarṣāmasmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||

translations.english: Grant us, Indra, various fettilizing wealth, consisting of horses, of chariots, of valiant followers, ofthousands, of hundreds (of cattle), surrounded by beautiful attendants, endowed with sages and heroes, theenjoyer of all (benefits).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सप्तगुमृतधीतिं सुमेधां बृहस्पतिं मतिरच्छा जिगाति । य आङ्गिरसो नमसोपसद्योऽस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra saptagumṛtadhītiṃ sumedhāṃ bṛhaspatiṃ matiracchā jigāti | ya āṅgiraso namasopasadyo'smabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||

translations.english: The praise (addressed to the gods) comes to the presence of Saptagu, the observer of the truth, theintelligent, the lord of much (praise), who, being of the family of Aṅgirasa, has approached (the gods) withoblations; do you, (Indra) grant me various fertilizing riches.

mantras.sanskrit: वनीवानो मम दूतास इन्द्रं स्तोमाश्चरन्ति सुमतीरियानाः । हृदिस्पृशो मनसा वच्यमाना अस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vanīvāno mama dūtāsa indraṃ stomāścaranti sumatīriyānāḥ | hṛdispṛśo manasā vacyamānā asmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||

translations.english: My praises, (my) messengers soliciting ((audience), come to Indra, praying (his) favourable (thoughts),heart-touching, spoken from the soul; (therefore, Indra) grant me various fertilizing riches.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्त्वा यामि दद्धि तन्न इन्द्र बृहन्तं क्षयमसमं जनानाम् । अभि तद्द्यावापृथिवी गृणीतामस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yattvā yāmi daddhi tanna indra bṛhantaṃ kṣayamasamaṃ janānām | abhi taddyāvāpṛthivī gṛṇītāmasmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||

translations.english: Bestow, Indra, that which I solicit of you; a large mansion, not held in common with other men; andmay heaven and earth approve of it; grant us, (Indra), various fertilizing riches.

mantras.sanskrit: अहं भुवं वसुनः पूर्व्यस्पतिरहं धनानि सं जयामि शश्वतः । मां हवन्ते पितरं न जन्तवोऽहं दाशुषे वि भजामि भोजनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ bhuvaṃ vasunaḥ pūrvyaspatirahaṃ dhanāni saṃ jayāmi śaśvataḥ | māṃ havante pitaraṃ na jantavo'haṃ dāśuṣe vi bhajāmi bhojanam ||

translations.english: I am the principal lord of wealth; I conquer the treasure of many (adversaries); living beings call uponme as (sons call upon) a father; I bestow food on the donor of oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: अहमिन्द्रो रोधो वक्षो अथर्वणस्त्रिताय गा अजनयमहेरधि । अहं दस्युभ्यः परि नृम्णमा ददे गोत्रा शिक्षन्दधीचे मातरिश्वने ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahamindro rodho vakṣo atharvaṇastritāya gā ajanayamaheradhi | ahaṃ dasyubhyaḥ pari nṛmṇamā dade gotrā śikṣandadhīce mātariśvane ||

translations.english: I, Indra, amd the strtiker off of the head of the son of Atharvan, I genitive rated the waters from above thecloud for the sake of Trita. I carried off their wealth from the Dasyus; taming the clouds for Dadhyañc, the son ofMātariśvan.

mantras.sanskrit: मह्यं त्वष्टा वज्रमतक्षदायसं मयि देवासोऽवृजन्नपि क्रतुम् । ममानीकं सूर्यस्येव दुष्टरं मामार्यन्ति कृतेन कर्त्वेन च ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahyaṃ tvaṣṭā vajramatakṣadāyasaṃ mayi devāso'vṛjannapi kratum | mamānīkaṃ sūryasyeva duṣṭaraṃ māmāryanti kṛtena kartvena ca ||

translations.english: For me Tvaṣṭā fabricated the metal thunderbolt; in me the gods have concentrated pious acts; mylustre is insurmountable, like that of the Sun; men acknowledge me as lord in consequence of what I have done,and of what I shall do.

mantras.sanskrit: अहमेतं गव्ययमश्व्यं पशुं पुरीषिणं सायकेना हिरण्ययम् । पुरू सहस्रा नि शिशामि दाशुषे यन्मा सोमास उक्थिनो अमन्दिषुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahametaṃ gavyayamaśvyaṃ paśuṃ purīṣiṇaṃ sāyakenā hiraṇyayam | purū sahasrā ni śiśāmi dāśuṣe yanmā somāsa ukthino amandiṣuḥ ||

translations.english: (I conquered) by my shaft this (wealth) comprehending kine, horses, herds, water, and gold; I givemany thousands to the donor (of the oblation) when libations and praises have afforded me delight.

mantras.sanskrit: अहमिन्द्रो न परा जिग्य इद्धनं न मृत्यवेऽव तस्थे कदा चन । सोममिन्मा सुन्वन्तो याचता वसु न मे पूरवः सख्ये रिषाथन ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahamindro na parā jigya iddhanaṃ na mṛtyave'va tasthe kadā cana | somaminmā sunvanto yācatā vasu na me pūravaḥ sakhye riṣāthana ||

translations.english: I, Indra, am not surpassed in affluence; I never yield to death; pouring forth the Soma libation, ask ofme wealth; O men, forfeit not my friendship.

mantras.sanskrit: अहमेताञ्छाश्वसतो द्वाद्वेन्द्रं ये वज्रं युधयेऽकृण्वत । आह्वयमानाँ अव हन्मनाहनं दृळ्हा वदन्ननमस्युर्नमस्विनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahametāñchāśvasato dvādvendraṃ ye vajraṃ yudhaye'kṛṇvata | āhvayamānā~ ava hanmanāhanaṃ dṛḷhā vadannanamasyurnamasvinaḥ ||

translations.english: I destroy those powerful (enemies) two by two who defy the (wielder of the) thunderbolt, Indra, tobattle, I slew them challenging (me to fight) with (great) slaughter, the unbending (slaying) the bending, theuttering stern (menaces).

mantras.sanskrit: अभीदमेकमेको अस्मि निष्षाळभी द्वा किमु त्रयः करन्ति । खले न पर्षान्प्रति हन्मि भूरि किं मा निन्दन्ति शत्रवोऽनिन्द्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhīdamekameko asmi niṣṣāḷabhī dvā kimu trayaḥ karanti | khale na parṣānprati hanmi bhūri kiṃ mā nindanti śatravo'nindrāḥ ||

translations.english: Single, I overcome my single (adversary); (over-powering them) I overcome two foes; what can threeenemies who know not Indra revile me?

mantras.sanskrit: अहं गुङ्गुभ्यो अतिथिग्वमिष्करमिषं न वृत्रतुरं विक्षु धारयम् । यत्पर्णयघ्न उत वा करञ्जहे प्राहं महे वृत्रहत्ये अशुश्रवि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ guṅgubhyo atithigvamiṣkaramiṣaṃ na vṛtraturaṃ vikṣu dhārayam | yatparṇayaghna uta vā karañjahe prāhaṃ mahe vṛtrahatye aśuśravi ||

translations.english: I prepared Atithigva for (the protection of) the Guṅgus, I upheld him, the destroyer of enemies, assustenance among the people; when I gained renown in the great Vṛtra-battle, in which Parṇaya and Karañja= hospitable; guṅgus = name of a people; parṇaya and karañja = names of asuras].

mantras.sanskrit: प्र मे नमी साप्य इषे भुजे भूद्गवामेषे सख्या कृणुत द्विता । दिद्युं यदस्य समिथेषु मंहयमादिदेनं शंस्यमुक्थ्यं करम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra me namī sāpya iṣe bhuje bhūdgavāmeṣe sakhyā kṛṇuta dvitā | didyuṃ yadasya samitheṣu maṃhayamādidenaṃ śaṃsyamukthyaṃ karam ||

translations.english: My praiser, the refuge (of all), was food to enjoy; (him, men) use in two ways, to search for their cattle,and to be their freiend, when I bestow upon him a weapon in his battles, and make him worthy of celebrity andpraise.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र नेमस्मिन्ददृशे सोमो अन्तर्गोपा नेममाविरस्था कृणोति । स तिग्मशृङ्गं वृषभं युयुत्सन्द्रुहस्तस्थौ बहुले बद्धो अन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra nemasmindadṛśe somo antargopā nemamāvirasthā kṛṇoti | sa tigmaśṛṅgaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ yuyutsandruhastasthau bahule baddho antaḥ ||

translations.english: The Soma is seen in one of the two (combatants); the cowherd (Indra) manifests the other with histhunderbolt; the latter warring against the sharp- horned bull, remains in great (darkness) bound by the victoṛ

mantras.sanskrit: आदित्यानां वसूनां रुद्रियाणां देवो देवानां न मिनामि धाम । ते मा भद्राय शवसे ततक्षुरपराजितमस्तृतमषाळ्हम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ādityānāṃ vasūnāṃ rudriyāṇāṃ devo devānāṃ na mināmi dhāma | te mā bhadrāya śavase tatakṣuraparājitamastṛtamaṣāḷham ||

translations.english: The divine (Indra) abandons not the abode of the deities, the Ādityas, the Vasus, and the Rudriyas;may they fashion me for auspicious vigour, undefeated, unharmed, unconquered.

mantras.sanskrit: अहं दां गृणते पूर्व्यं वस्वहं ब्रह्म कृणवं मह्यं वर्धनम् । अहं भुवं यजमानस्य चोदितायज्वनः साक्षि विश्वस्मिन्भरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ dāṃ gṛṇate pūrvyaṃ vasvahaṃ brahma kṛṇavaṃ mahyaṃ vardhanam | ahaṃ bhuvaṃ yajamānasya coditāyajvanaḥ sākṣi viśvasminbhare ||

translations.english: I give excellent treasure to him who praises me, I render sacred prayer (a source) of greatness tomyself, I am the instrumental gator of the worshipper; I am the discomfiter in every battle of him who does not worship.

mantras.sanskrit: मां धुरिन्द्रं नाम देवता दिवश्च ग्मश्चापां च जन्तवः । अहं हरी वृषणा विव्रता रघू अहं वज्रं शवसे धृष्ण्वा ददे ॥
mantras.transliteration: māṃ dhurindraṃ nāma devatā divaśca gmaścāpāṃ ca jantavaḥ | ahaṃ harī vṛṣaṇā vivratā raghū ahaṃ vajraṃ śavase dhṛṣṇvā dade ||

translations.english: Those born in heaven, in earth, and in the firmament, support me, whose name is Indra among thedeities (by their offerings). I (harness to my car) two bay steeds vigorous, many-functioned, rapid; I wield for mystrength the fearful thunderbolt.

mantras.sanskrit: अहमत्कं कवये शिश्नथं हथैरहं कुत्समावमाभिरूतिभिः । अहं शुष्णस्य श्नथिता वधर्यमं न यो रर आर्यं नाम दस्यवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahamatkaṃ kavaye śiśnathaṃ hathairahaṃ kutsamāvamābhirūtibhiḥ | ahaṃ śuṣṇasya śnathitā vadharyamaṃ na yo rara āryaṃ nāma dasyave ||

translations.english: I smote Atka with many weapons for the defence of the sage; with those protections I preserved Kutsa;I am the slayer of Śuṣṇa; I grasped the thunderbolt I who have not given the water (nāma) of the Āryas to theDasyu.

mantras.sanskrit: अहं पितेव वेतसूँरभिष्टये तुग्रं कुत्साय स्मदिभं च रन्धयम् । अहं भुवं यजमानस्य राजनि प्र यद्भरे तुजये न प्रियाधृषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ piteva vetasū~rabhiṣṭaye tugraṃ kutsāya smadibhaṃ ca randhayam | ahaṃ bhuvaṃ yajamānasya rājani pra yadbhare tujaye na priyādhṛṣe ||

translations.english: Like a father (for a son), I brought under subjection to Kutsa, at his desire, the Vetasūs and Tugraand Smadibha I have been in plural ce of a sovereign to the worshipper when I bring (to him) as to a son acceptable(gifts) for assailing (his enemies).

mantras.sanskrit: अहं रन्धयं मृगयं श्रुतर्वणे यन्माजिहीत वयुना चनानुषक् । अहं वेशं नम्रमायवेऽकरमहं सव्याय पड्गृभिमरन्धयम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ randhayaṃ mṛgayaṃ śrutarvaṇe yanmājihīta vayunā canānuṣak | ahaṃ veśaṃ namramāyave'karamahaṃ savyāya paḍgṛbhimarandhayam ||

translations.english: I have brought Mṛgaya under subjection to Śrutarvan; when he came to me, (he was) earnestlyengaged in supplication. I humiliated Veśa for Āyu; I subjugated Padgṛbhi for Savya.

mantras.sanskrit: अहं स यो नववास्त्वं बृहद्रथं सं वृत्रेव दासं वृत्रहारुजम् । यद्वर्धयन्तं प्रथयन्तमानुषग्दूरे पारे रजसो रोचनाकरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ sa yo navavāstvaṃ bṛhadrathaṃ saṃ vṛtreva dāsaṃ vṛtrahārujam | yadvardhayantaṃ prathayantamānuṣagdūre pāre rajaso rocanākaram ||

translations.english: I, the slayer of Vṛtra, am he who crushed Navavāstva and Bṛhadratha, (who crushed) Dāsa like aVṛtra, when I drove to the distant shore of the shining world, (both) my augmenting and outstretched (foes) oneafter the other.

mantras.sanskrit: अहं सूर्यस्य परि याम्याशुभिः प्रैतशेभिर्वहमान ओजसा । यन्मा सावो मनुष आह निर्णिज ऋधक्कृषे दासं कृत्व्यं हथैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ sūryasya pari yāmyāśubhiḥ praitaśebhirvahamāna ojasā | yanmā sāvo manuṣa āha nirṇija ṛdhakkṛṣe dāsaṃ kṛtvyaṃ hathaiḥ ||

translations.english: Conveyed by the swift white horses of Sūrya, I hasten forth by my power; when the effused libation ofa man invokes me to the brilliant form of the sacrifice, I drive off with my weapons the destroyer who is to beslain.

mantras.sanskrit: अहं सप्तहा नहुषो नहुष्टरः प्राश्रावयं शवसा तुर्वशं यदुम् । अहं न्यन्यं सहसा सहस्करं नव व्राधतो नवतिं च वक्षयम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ saptahā nahuṣo nahuṣṭaraḥ prāśrāvayaṃ śavasā turvaśaṃ yadum | ahaṃ nyanyaṃ sahasā sahaskaraṃ nava vrādhato navatiṃ ca vakṣayam ||

translations.english: I am the slayer of seven (asuras); I am the especial bond of bonds; I have made Turvaśa and Yadufamous through prowess; I have strengthened another (worshipper) with strength; I have demolished ninety andnine powerful (foes).

mantras.sanskrit: अहं सप्त स्रवतो धारयं वृषा द्रवित्न्वः पृथिव्यां सीरा अधि । अहमर्णांसि वि तिरामि सुक्रतुर्युधा विदं मनवे गातुमिष्टये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ sapta sravato dhārayaṃ vṛṣā dravitnvaḥ pṛthivyāṃ sīrā adhi | ahamarṇāṃsi vi tirāmi sukraturyudhā vidaṃ manave gātumiṣṭaye ||

translations.english: The showerer (of rain), I supported the seven rivers flowing and meandering over the earth; doer ofgood deeds, I spread out the waters; I found by war a path for man to go in.

mantras.sanskrit: अहं तदासु धारयं यदासु न देवश्चन त्वष्टाधारयद्रुशत् । स्पार्हं गवामूधस्सु वक्षणास्वा मधोर्मधु श्वात्र्यं सोममाशिरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ tadāsu dhārayaṃ yadāsu na devaścana tvaṣṭādhārayadruśat | spārhaṃ gavāmūdhassu vakṣaṇāsvā madhormadhu śvātryaṃ somamāśiram ||

translations.english: I have kept up in them that which no deity, not even Tvaṣṭā, has maintained, bright, desirable,(contained) in the udders of the cows; in the rivers (I uphold) the water up to the (source of the) water, thedelightful Soma and the milk and curds.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा देवाँ इन्द्रो विव्ये नॄन्प्र च्यौत्नेन मघवा सत्यराधाः । विश्वेत्ता ते हरिवः शचीवोऽभि तुरासः स्वयशो गृणन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā devā~ indro vivye nṝnpra cyautnena maghavā satyarādhāḥ | viśvettā te harivaḥ śacīvo'bhi turāsaḥ svayaśo gṛṇanti ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वो महे मन्दमानायान्धसोऽर्चा विश्वानराय विश्वाभुवे । इन्द्रस्य यस्य सुमखं सहो महि श्रवो नृम्णं च रोदसी सपर्यतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vo mahe mandamānāyāndhaso'rcā viśvānarāya viśvābhuve | indrasya yasya sumakhaṃ saho mahi śravo nṛmṇaṃ ca rodasī saparyataḥ ||

translations.english: Worship him who is exhilarated by the sacrificiial food, the mighty Indra; the leader of all men, thecreator of all, whose venerable strength and abundant food and wealth, heaven and earth adore.

mantras.sanskrit: सो चिन्नु सख्या नर्य इनः स्तुतश्चर्कृत्य इन्द्रो मावते नरे । विश्वासु धूर्षु वाजकृत्येषु सत्पते वृत्रे वाप्स्वभि शूर मन्दसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: so cinnu sakhyā narya inaḥ stutaścarkṛtya indro māvate nare | viśvāsu dhūrṣu vājakṛtyeṣu satpate vṛtre vāpsvabhi śūra mandase ||

translations.english: That Indra, kind to man, the lord of all, who is praised by his friend, is to be repeatedly honoured bymen like me; you, hero, protector of the good, are glorified in the all-sustaining food-producing cloud-imprisonedwaters.

mantras.sanskrit: के ते नर इन्द्र ये त इषे ये ते सुम्नं सधन्यमियक्षान् । के ते वाजायासुर्याय हिन्विरे के अप्सु स्वासूर्वरासु पौंस्ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ke te nara indra ye ta iṣe ye te sumnaṃ sadhanyamiyakṣān | ke te vājāyāsuryāya hinvire ke apsu svāsūrvarāsu pauṃsye ||

translations.english: What men, Indra, are they who (are eminent in offering food to you, who are desirous of obtaining fromthe happiness and opulence, who send you (oblations) for the sake of strength (to fight) the asura, who (sentoblations) for the sake of obtaining spontaneously-flowing waters and cultivable lands, and manly vigour?

mantras.sanskrit: भुवस्त्वमिन्द्र ब्रह्मणा महान्भुवो विश्वेषु सवनेषु यज्ञियः । भुवो नॄँश्च्यौत्नो विश्वस्मिन्भरे ज्येष्ठश्च मन्त्रो विश्वचर्षणे ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhuvastvamindra brahmaṇā mahānbhuvo viśveṣu savaneṣu yajñiyaḥ | bhuvo nṝ~ścyautno viśvasminbhare jyeṣṭhaśca mantro viśvacarṣaṇe ||

translations.english: Indra, you have become mighty through our praise; you have have become adorable at all sacrifices,in every combat you are the caster down of the leaders (of hosts); beholder of all, you are the best, mostexcellent.

mantras.sanskrit: अवा नु कं ज्यायान्यज्ञवनसो महीं त ओमात्रां कृष्टयो विदुः । असो नु कमजरो वर्धाश्च विश्वेदेता सवना तूतुमा कृषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: avā nu kaṃ jyāyānyajñavanaso mahīṃ ta omātrāṃ kṛṣṭayo viduḥ | aso nu kamajaro vardhāśca viśvedetā savanā tūtumā kṛṣe ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: एता विश्वा सवना तूतुमा कृषे स्वयं सूनो सहसो यानि दधिषे । वराय ते पात्रं धर्मणे तना यज्ञो मन्त्रो ब्रह्मोद्यतं वचः ॥
mantras.transliteration: etā viśvā savanā tūtumā kṛṣe svayaṃ sūno sahaso yāni dadhiṣe | varāya te pātraṃ dharmaṇe tanā yajño mantro brahmodyataṃ vacaḥ ||

translations.english: You make swift all those sacrifices which, son of strength, you yourself support; may your protectionbe granted for the repulse (of enemies, may) wealth (be granted) for our support; the sacrifice, the hymn, thesacred text, the voice (is) raised (to you).

mantras.sanskrit: ये ते विप्र ब्रह्मकृतः सुते सचा वसूनां च वसुनश्च दावने । प्र ते सुम्नस्य मनसा पथा भुवन्मदे सुतस्य सोम्यस्यान्धसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye te vipra brahmakṛtaḥ sute sacā vasūnāṃ ca vasunaśca dāvane | pra te sumnasya manasā pathā bhuvanmade sutasya somyasyāndhasaḥ ||

translations.english: Sage Indra, the reciters of pious hymns to you who assembled together when (the Soma) is effused,(worship you) for the donation of riches and treasures; may they be competent (to acquire) you felicity by thepathway of the mind; when you are exhilarated with the effused Soma food.

mantras.sanskrit: महत्तदुल्बं स्थविरं तदासीद्येनाविष्टितः प्रविवेशिथापः । विश्वा अपश्यद्बहुधा ते अग्ने जातवेदस्तन्वो देव एकः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahattadulbaṃ sthaviraṃ tadāsīdyenāviṣṭitaḥ praviveśithāpaḥ | viśvā apaśyadbahudhā te agne jātavedastanvo deva ekaḥ ||

translations.english: (The gods speak). Great and very dense is the covering enveloped by which, Agni, you have enteredinto the waters. Agni Jātavedas, one deity has beheld all your manifold forms.

mantras.sanskrit: को मा ददर्श कतमः स देवो यो मे तन्वो बहुधा पर्यपश्यत् । क्वाह मित्रावरुणा क्षियन्त्यग्नेर्विश्वाः समिधो देवयानीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ko mā dadarśa katamaḥ sa devo yo me tanvo bahudhā paryapaśyat | kvāha mitrāvaruṇā kṣiyantyagnerviśvāḥ samidho devayānīḥ ||

translations.english: (Agni speaks). Who has beheld me? Which is it of the deities who has fully seen my manifold forms?Where Mitra and Varuṇa, do Agni's luminous vehicles of the gods abide?

mantras.sanskrit: ऐच्छाम त्वा बहुधा जातवेदः प्रविष्टमग्ने अप्स्वोषधीषु । तं त्वा यमो अचिकेच्चित्रभानो दशान्तरुष्यादतिरोचमानम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: aicchāma tvā bahudhā jātavedaḥ praviṣṭamagne apsvoṣadhīṣu | taṃ tvā yamo acikeccitrabhāno daśāntaruṣyādatirocamānam ||

translations.english: (The gods). We sought for you, Agni Jātavedas, who had entered in many ways into the waters, intothe plural nts; Yama recognized you, who have adorable rays, blazing from your ten hiding-plural ces.

mantras.sanskrit: होत्रादहं वरुण बिभ्यदायं नेदेव मा युनजन्नत्र देवाः । तस्य मे तन्वो बहुधा निविष्टा एतमर्थं न चिकेताहमग्निः ॥
mantras.transliteration: hotrādahaṃ varuṇa bibhyadāyaṃ nedeva mā yunajannatra devāḥ | tasya me tanvo bahudhā niviṣṭā etamarthaṃ na ciketāhamagniḥ ||

translations.english: (Agni). Divine Varuṇa, I have come hither, being afraid of hotā, lest the gods should again associateme with him; my forms have therefore entered (into the waters) in various plural ces. I, Agni, do not consent (toundertake) that office.

mantras.sanskrit: एहि मनुर्देवयुर्यज्ञकामोऽरंकृत्या तमसि क्षेष्यग्ने । सुगान्पथः कृणुहि देवयानान्वह हव्यानि सुमनस्यमानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ehi manurdevayuryajñakāmo'raṃkṛtyā tamasi kṣeṣyagne | sugānpathaḥ kṛṇuhi devayānānvaha havyāni sumanasyamānaḥ ||

translations.english: (The gods). Come, Agni, the devout Manu (is) desirous of offering sacrifice; adorning yourself, youabide in darkness; make straight the paths traversed by the gods, and with a benevolent mind convey ouroblations.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्नेः पूर्वे भ्रातरो अर्थमेतं रथीवाध्वानमन्वावरीवुः । तस्माद्भिया वरुण दूरमायं गौरो न क्षेप्नोरविजे ज्यायाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agneḥ pūrve bhrātaro arthametaṃ rathīvādhvānamanvāvarīvuḥ | tasmādbhiyā varuṇa dūramāyaṃ gauro na kṣepnoravije jyāyāḥ ||

translations.english: (Agni). The elder brothers of Agni performed that duty, as the driver of a chariot covers the roaḍ(They were slain), and therefore, Varuṇa, I fled afar through fear. I trembled as a wild ox (tembles) at thebowstring of the archer.

mantras.sanskrit: कुर्मस्त आयुरजरं यदग्ने यथा युक्तो जातवेदो न रिष्याः । अथा वहासि सुमनस्यमानो भागं देवेभ्यो हविषः सुजात ॥
mantras.transliteration: kurmasta āyurajaraṃ yadagne yathā yukto jātavedo na riṣyāḥ | athā vahāsi sumanasyamāno bhāgaṃ devebhyo haviṣaḥ sujāta ||

translations.english: (The gods). We grant you life, Agni, which (is) exempt from decay, so that thus endowed, Jātavedas,you will not die; so, becoming conciliated, well- born, Agni, bear their portion of the oblation to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रयाजान्मे अनुयाजाँश्च केवलानूर्जस्वन्तं हविषो दत्त भागम् । घृतं चापां पुरुषं चौषधीनामग्नेश्च दीर्घमायुरस्तु देवाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prayājānme anuyājā~śca kevalānūrjasvantaṃ haviṣo datta bhāgam | ghṛtaṃ cāpāṃ puruṣaṃ cauṣadhīnāmagneśca dīrghamāyurastu devāḥ ||

translations.english: (Agni). Only grant to me, deities, the concentrated portion of the oblation the Prayājas and Anuyājasexclusively; (give me) the butter (the essence) of the waters, and man (the essence) of the plural nts; and let the lifeof Agni be long.

mantras.sanskrit: तव प्रयाजा अनुयाजाश्च केवल ऊर्जस्वन्तो हविषः सन्तु भागाः । तवाग्ने यज्ञोऽयमस्तु सर्वस्तुभ्यं नमन्तां प्रदिशश्चतस्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava prayājā anuyājāśca kevala ūrjasvanto haviṣaḥ santu bhāgāḥ | tavāgne yajño'yamastu sarvastubhyaṃ namantāṃ pradiśaścatasraḥ ||

translations.english: (The gods). Yours, Agni, be the Prayājas and Anuyājas exclusively; yours be the concentrated portions of the oblations; let this sacrifice; Agni, be all yours, and let the four quarters of space bow down beforeyou.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वे देवाः शास्तन मा यथेह होता वृतो मनवै यन्निषद्य । प्र मे ब्रूत भागधेयं यथा वो येन पथा हव्यमा वो वहानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśve devāḥ śāstana mā yatheha hotā vṛto manavai yanniṣadya | pra me brūta bhāgadheyaṃ yathā vo yena pathā havyamā vo vahāni ||

translations.english: instrumental uct me, Viśvedevās, since I am appointed Hotā, how sitting here I ought to praise you; declareto me your portion; how you have acquired it, and by what path I may convey the oblation to you.

mantras.sanskrit: अहं होता न्यसीदं यजीयान्विश्वे देवा मरुतो मा जुनन्ति । अहरहरश्विनाध्वर्यवं वां ब्रह्मा समिद्भवति साहुतिर्वाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ hotā nyasīdaṃ yajīyānviśve devā maruto mā junanti | aharaharaśvinādhvaryavaṃ vāṃ brahmā samidbhavati sāhutirvām ||

translations.english: Best entitled to the sacrifice, I have sat down as the Hotā; all the divine Maruts urge me( to bear theoblation); the office of the Adhvaryu is to be discharged daily, Aśvins, by you; let the moon be the brahman, andlet it be also your oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं यो होता किरु स यमस्य कमप्यूहे यत्समञ्जन्ति देवाः । अहरहर्जायते मासिमास्यथा देवा दधिरे हव्यवाहम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ yo hotā kiru sa yamasya kamapyūhe yatsamañjanti devāḥ | aharaharjāyate māsimāsyathā devā dadhire havyavāham ||

translations.english: Who is this, who is the Hotā? (Afraid) of Yama, what offering does he bear that the gods accept?Agni is born day by day, and month by month, and so the gods have made for themselves a bearer of oblationṣ

mantras.sanskrit: मां देवा दधिरे हव्यवाहमपम्लुक्तं बहु कृच्छ्रा चरन्तम् । अग्निर्विद्वान्यज्ञं नः कल्पयाति पञ्चयामं त्रिवृतं सप्ततन्तुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: māṃ devā dadhire havyavāhamapamluktaṃ bahu kṛcchrā carantam | agnirvidvānyajñaṃ naḥ kalpayāti pañcayāmaṃ trivṛtaṃ saptatantum ||

translations.english: The gods have made me the bearer of oblations returning after departure, and passing many difficultplaces; (saying) this Agni is wise; he will accomplish the sacrifice for us, whether it be that of the five ways, thethree kinds, or the seven threads.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वो यक्ष्यमृतत्वं सुवीरं यथा वो देवा वरिवः कराणि । आ बाह्वोर्वज्रमिन्द्रस्य धेयामथेमा विश्वाः पृतना जयाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vo yakṣyamṛtatvaṃ suvīraṃ yathā vo devā varivaḥ karāṇi | ā bāhvorvajramindrasya dheyāmathemā viśvāḥ pṛtanā jayāti ||

translations.english: Gods, I solicit of you immortality and excellent male offspring, that I may offer you adoration. I causeIndra to take the thunderbolt in his hands, wherewith he may overcome all these hostile hosts.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रीणि शता त्री सहस्राण्यग्निं त्रिंशच्च देवा नव चासपर्यन् । औक्षन्घृतैरस्तृणन्बर्हिरस्मा आदिद्धोतारं न्यसादयन्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: trīṇi śatā trī sahasrāṇyagniṃ triṃśacca devā nava cāsaparyan | aukṣanghṛtairastṛṇanbarhirasmā ādiddhotāraṃ nyasādayanta ||

translations.english: Three thousand three hundred and thirty-and-nine deities worshipped Agni, they sprinkled (me) withbutter, they strewed the sacred grass, and then made the invoker of the gods sit down.

mantras.sanskrit: यमैच्छाम मनसा सोऽयमागाद्यज्ञस्य विद्वान्परुषश्चिकित्वान् । स नो यक्षद्देवताता यजीयान्नि हि षत्सदन्तरः पूर्वो अस्मत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yamaicchāma manasā so'yamāgādyajñasya vidvānparuṣaścikitvān | sa no yakṣaddevatātā yajīyānni hi ṣatsadantaraḥ pūrvo asmat ||

translations.english: (The gods). He whom we sought with (anxious) minds has arrived; he who understands the sacrificeand is acquainted with its different parts; may he who is most skilled in worship, sacrifice for us at the worship ofthe gods, being seated (at the altar), taking plural ce among (the priests), and preceding us.

mantras.sanskrit: अराधि होता निषदा यजीयानभि प्रयांसि सुधितानि हि ख्यत् । यजामहै यज्ञियान्हन्त देवाँ ईळामहा ईड्याँ आज्येन ॥
mantras.transliteration: arādhi hotā niṣadā yajīyānabhi prayāṃsi sudhitāni hi khyat | yajāmahai yajñiyānhanta devā~ īḷāmahā īḍyā~ ājyena ||

translations.english: The hotā, most skilled in worship, has been sanctified by his seat (at the altar); he contemplates thesacred offerings reverently plural ced (before him); let us speedily worship with ghī the gods to whom worship isdue; let us praise those who are entitled to praise.

mantras.sanskrit: साध्वीमकर्देववीतिं नो अद्य यज्ञस्य जिह्वामविदाम गुह्याम् । स आयुरागात्सुरभिर्वसानो भद्रामकर्देवहूतिं नो अद्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: sādhvīmakardevavītiṃ no adya yajñasya jihvāmavidāma guhyām | sa āyurāgātsurabhirvasāno bhadrāmakardevahūtiṃ no adya ||

translations.english: He has today made our banquet to the gods efficacious; we have obtained the mysterious tongue ofsacrifice; he has come, fragrant, clothed with life; he makes our oblation to the gods today auspicious.

mantras.sanskrit: तदद्य वाचः प्रथमं मसीय येनासुराँ अभि देवा असाम । ऊर्जाद उत यज्ञियासः पञ्च जना मम होत्रं जुषध्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadadya vācaḥ prathamaṃ masīya yenāsurā~ abhi devā asāma | ūrjāda uta yajñiyāsaḥ pañca janā mama hotraṃ juṣadhvam ||

translations.english: (Agni speaks). I communicate today the best advice by which we gods may overcome the asuras; doyou who are the eaters of sacrificial food, who are entitled to worship, and you five orders of men, be plural ased bymy (discharge of) the office of hotā.

mantras.sanskrit: पञ्च जना मम होत्रं जुषन्तां गोजाता उत ये यज्ञियासः । पृथिवी नः पार्थिवात्पात्वंहसोऽन्तरिक्षं दिव्यात्पात्वस्मान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pañca janā mama hotraṃ juṣantāṃ gojātā uta ye yajñiyāsaḥ | pṛthivī naḥ pārthivātpātvaṃhaso'ntarikṣaṃ divyātpātvasmān ||

translations.english: May the fiver orders of men, may those who were born for the sake of ghī, may those who areentitled to worship be plural ased by my (discharge of) the office of hotā; may earth preserve us from all earthly sin;may the firmament preserve us from heavenly (sin).

mantras.sanskrit: तन्तुं तन्वन्रजसो भानुमन्विहि ज्योतिष्मतः पथो रक्ष धिया कृतान् । अनुल्बणं वयत जोगुवामपो मनुर्भव जनया दैव्यं जनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tantuṃ tanvanrajaso bhānumanvihi jyotiṣmataḥ patho rakṣa dhiyā kṛtān | anulbaṇaṃ vayata joguvāmapo manurbhava janayā daivyaṃ janam ||

translations.english: (The gods) spreading out the sacrifice, follow the illuminator of the world (the sun); protect theluminous paths (of the gods) constructed by sacred acts; may Agni render the pious works of the worshipper freefrom defect; become Manu, genitive rate the people of heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: अक्षानहो नह्यतनोत सोम्या इष्कृणुध्वं रशना ओत पिंशत । अष्टावन्धुरं वहताभितो रथं येन देवासो अनयन्नभि प्रियम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: akṣānaho nahyatanota somyā iṣkṛṇudhvaṃ raśanā ota piṃśata | aṣṭāvandhuraṃ vahatābhito rathaṃ yena devāso anayannabhi priyam ||

translations.english: (The gods to one another). Drinkers of the Soma, bind (the horses) that are to be fastened to the pole;prepare the reins; caparison (the steeds); accompany everywhere (in your cars) the chariot which has eightseats with which the gods bring us acceptable (wealth).

mantras.sanskrit: अश्मन्वती रीयते सं रभध्वमुत्तिष्ठत प्र तरता सखायः । अत्रा जहाम ये असन्नशेवाः शिवान्वयमुत्तरेमाभि वाजान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśmanvatī rīyate saṃ rabhadhvamuttiṣṭhata pra taratā sakhāyaḥ | atrā jahāma ye asannaśevāḥ śivānvayamuttaremābhi vājān ||

translations.english: The aśmanvatī flows along; be alert; rise up, cross over, may friends; here let us leave those whoare unhappy, so that we may cross over to auspicious sacrificial viands.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वष्टा माया वेदपसामपस्तमो बिभ्रत्पात्रा देवपानानि शंतमा । शिशीते नूनं परशुं स्वायसं येन वृश्चादेतशो ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṣṭā māyā vedapasāmapastamo bibhratpātrā devapānāni śaṃtamā | śiśīte nūnaṃ paraśuṃ svāyasaṃ yena vṛścādetaśo brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||

translations.english: Tvaṣṭā knows the arts of fabricating (drinking vessels), the most skilful of artificers bearing thesacred drinking cups out of which the gods drink-- verily he sharpens his axe of good metal, wherewith thewhite- complexioned brahmaṇaspati cuts them.

mantras.sanskrit: सतो नूनं कवयः सं शिशीत वाशीभिर्याभिरमृताय तक्षथ । विद्वांसः पदा गुह्यानि कर्तन येन देवासो अमृतत्वमानशुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sato nūnaṃ kavayaḥ saṃ śiśīta vāśībhiryābhiramṛtāya takṣatha | vidvāṃsaḥ padā guhyāni kartana yena devāso amṛtatvamānaśuḥ ||

translations.english: Verily being sages, (Ṛbhus) sharpen the instrumental uments with which you fabricate the cups for the nectaṛDo you, who are wise, prepare the mysterious paths whereby tte gods have attained to immortality.

mantras.sanskrit: गर्भे योषामदधुर्वत्समासन्यपीच्येन मनसोत जिह्वया । स विश्वाहा सुमना योग्या अभि सिषासनिर्वनते कार इज्जितिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: garbhe yoṣāmadadhurvatsamāsanyapīcyena manasota jihvayā | sa viśvāhā sumanā yogyā abhi siṣāsanirvanate kāra ijjitim ||

translations.english: (The Maruts) plural ced a feminine le in the enveloping hide (of a dead cow), and a calf in the mouth (of adead cow), with mind and tongue, aiming (at deification); daily the genitive rous (fraternity of the Ṛbhus) offerssuitable praises (to the gods), granting victory over our foes.

mantras.sanskrit: तां सु ते कीर्तिं मघवन्महित्वा यत्त्वा भीते रोदसी अह्वयेताम् । प्रावो देवाँ आतिरो दासमोजः प्रजायै त्वस्यै यदशिक्ष इन्द्र ॥
mantras.transliteration: tāṃ su te kīrtiṃ maghavanmahitvā yattvā bhīte rodasī ahvayetām | prāvo devā~ ātiro dāsamojaḥ prajāyai tvasyai yadaśikṣa indra ||

translations.english: (I celebrate), Maghavat, the great glory (you have acquired) by your might; when heaven and earthalarmed called upon you, you did defend the gods, and destroy (their) adversary; (I celebrate your glory), Indra,in that you gave strength to one person n (the worshipper).

mantras.sanskrit: यदचरस्तन्वा वावृधानो बलानीन्द्र प्रब्रुवाणो जनेषु । मायेत्सा ते यानि युद्धान्याहुर्नाद्य शत्रुं ननु पुरा विवित्से ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadacarastanvā vāvṛdhāno balānīndra prabruvāṇo janeṣu | māyetsā te yāni yuddhānyāhurnādya śatruṃ nanu purā vivitse ||

translations.english: When you proceed, Indra, increasing in form, and proclaiming your prowess among mankind, false isthat your (wandering), false the combats which you have narrated; you (find) now no enemy (to attack), did youformerly find one? person n you have genitive rated at once both mother and father (or earth and heaven)?

mantras.sanskrit: क उ नु ते महिमनः समस्यास्मत्पूर्व ऋषयोऽन्तमापुः । यन्मातरं च पितरं च साकमजनयथास्तन्वः स्वायाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ka u nu te mahimanaḥ samasyāsmatpūrva ṛṣayo'ntamāpuḥ | yanmātaraṃ ca pitaraṃ ca sākamajanayathāstanvaḥ svāyāḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: चत्वारि ते असुर्याणि नामादाभ्यानि महिषस्य सन्ति । त्वमङ्ग तानि विश्वानि वित्से येभिः कर्माणि मघवञ्चकर्थ ॥
mantras.transliteration: catvāri te asuryāṇi nāmādābhyāni mahiṣasya santi | tvamaṅga tāni viśvāni vitse yebhiḥ karmāṇi maghavañcakartha ||

translations.english: Four are the asura-slaying uninjurable forms of you the mighty one: you know them all wherewith,Maghavat, you have achieved your exploits.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं विश्वा दधिषे केवलानि यान्याविर्या च गुहा वसूनि । काममिन्मे मघवन्मा वि तारीस्त्वमाज्ञाता त्वमिन्द्रासि दाता ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ viśvā dadhiṣe kevalāni yānyāviryā ca guhā vasūni | kāmaminme maghavanmā vi tārīstvamājñātā tvamindrāsi dātā ||

translations.english: You have in your keeping all treasures, which are yours exclusively, whether they be manifest orhidden; thwart not, therefore, Maghavat, my desire (for wealth); for you are cognizant (of my desire), you are thedonor.

mantras.sanskrit: यो अदधाज्ज्योतिषि ज्योतिरन्तर्यो असृजन्मधुना सं मधूनि । अध प्रियं शूषमिन्द्राय मन्म ब्रह्मकृतो बृहदुक्थादवाचि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo adadhājjyotiṣi jyotirantaryo asṛjanmadhunā saṃ madhūni | adha priyaṃ śūṣamindrāya manma brahmakṛto bṛhadukthādavāci ||

translations.english: To that Indra, who has deposited the light in luminous bodies, who has flavoured sweet things withsweetness, this acceptable invigorating praise has been recited by Bṛhaduktha, the author of the prayer.

mantras.sanskrit: दूरे तन्नाम गुह्यं पराचैर्यत्त्वा भीते अह्वयेतां वयोधै । उदस्तभ्नाः पृथिवीं द्यामभीके भ्रातुः पुत्रान्मघवन्तित्विषाणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dūre tannāma guhyaṃ parācairyattvā bhīte ahvayetāṃ vayodhai | udastabhnāḥ pṛthivīṃ dyāmabhīke bhrātuḥ putrānmaghavantitviṣāṇaḥ ||

translations.english: Your form held secret (by men) with averted faces, is far from here; when (heaven and earth) alarmed,called upon you for the sustenance (of the world), then you did fix in their proximity the heaven and earth,illumining, Maghavat, the sons, of (your) brother.

mantras.sanskrit: महत्तन्नाम गुह्यं पुरुस्पृग्येन भूतं जनयो येन भव्यम् । प्रत्नं जातं ज्योतिर्यदस्य प्रियं प्रियाः समविशन्त पञ्च ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahattannāma guhyaṃ puruspṛgyena bhūtaṃ janayo yena bhavyam | pratnaṃ jātaṃ jyotiryadasya priyaṃ priyāḥ samaviśanta pañca ||

translations.english: That mighty mysterious form, desired of many, wherewith you have engendered the past, and(engender) the future, the ancient manifested light, the beloved of Indra, into which the five (orders of beings)delighted enter.

mantras.sanskrit: आ रोदसी अपृणादोत मध्यं पञ्च देवाँ ऋतुशः सप्तसप्त । चतुस्त्रिंशता पुरुधा वि चष्टे सरूपेण ज्योतिषा विव्रतेन ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā rodasī apṛṇādota madhyaṃ pañca devā~ ṛtuśaḥ saptasapta | catustriṃśatā purudhā vi caṣṭe sarūpeṇa jyotiṣā vivratena ||

translations.english: He has filled heaven and earth (with his ethereal form) as well as the mid-heaven; he contemplates invarious aspects the five orders of beings, the classes of seven in their seasons, with the thirty-four (deities),(endowed) with light of like nature, and with various functions.

mantras.sanskrit: यदुष औच्छः प्रथमा विभानामजनयो येन पुष्टस्य पुष्टम् । यत्ते जामित्वमवरं परस्या महन्महत्या असुरत्वमेकम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaduṣa aucchaḥ prathamā vibhānāmajanayo yena puṣṭasya puṣṭam | yatte jāmitvamavaraṃ parasyā mahanmahatyā asuratvamekam ||

translations.english: Since you, Uṣas, did shine forth the first of luminaries, whereby you did beget the nourishment ofnourishment (the Sun); unequalled is the mighty greatness of you who are mighty, since your relationship isdownwards (towards us), though you are stationed on high.

mantras.sanskrit: विधुं दद्राणं समने बहूनां युवानं सन्तं पलितो जगार । देवस्य पश्य काव्यं महित्वाद्या ममार स ह्यः समान ॥
mantras.transliteration: vidhuṃ dadrāṇaṃ samane bahūnāṃ yuvānaṃ santaṃ palito jagāra | devasya paśya kāvyaṃ mahitvādyā mamāra sa hyaḥ samāna ||

translations.english: The grey-haired has swallowed the warlike (man) the scatterer of many foes, in battle being young;behold the power of the deity (endowed) with might; he dies today, he is alive tomorrow.

mantras.sanskrit: शाक्मना शाको अरुणः सुपर्ण आ यो महः शूरः सनादनीळः । यच्चिकेत सत्यमित्तन्न मोघं वसु स्पार्हमुत जेतोत दाता ॥
mantras.transliteration: śākmanā śāko aruṇaḥ suparṇa ā yo mahaḥ śūraḥ sanādanīḷaḥ | yacciketa satyamittanna moghaṃ vasu spārhamuta jetota dātā ||

translations.english: Vigorous with (innate) vigour, (comes) a purple-coloured bird, mighty, heroic, ancient, having no nest;that which he knows is truth, and is not vain; (he is) the conqueror and distributor of desirable wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: ऐभिर्ददे वृष्ण्या पौंस्यानि येभिरौक्षद्वृत्रहत्याय वज्री । ये कर्मणः क्रियमाणस्य मह्न ऋतेकर्ममुदजायन्त देवाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aibhirdade vṛṣṇyā pauṃsyāni yebhiraukṣadvṛtrahatyāya vajrī | ye karmaṇaḥ kriyamāṇasya mahna ṛtekarmamudajāyanta devāḥ ||

translations.english: Indra bestows fertilizing energies (accompanied by these Maruts in whose company the thunderersends down showers in order to destroy sin; the deities who were born for giving rain (to assist) in the actperformed be great Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: युजा कर्माणि जनयन्विश्वौजा अशस्तिहा विश्वमनास्तुराषाट् । पीत्वी सोमस्य दिव आ वृधानः शूरो निर्युधाधमद्दस्यून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yujā karmāṇi janayanviśvaujā aśastihā viśvamanāsturāṣāṭ | pītvī somasya diva ā vṛdhānaḥ śūro niryudhādhamaddasyūn ||

translations.english: Accomplishing his duty with their assistance, the all-powerful Indra, the destroyer of the wicked, theall-wise, the quick subduer of foes, descending from heaven, and quaffing the Soma, invogirated and a hero, hedemolishes the Dasyus with his thunderbolt.

mantras.sanskrit: इदं त एकं पर ऊ त एकं तृतीयेन ज्योतिषा सं विशस्व । संवेशने तन्वश्चारुरेधि प्रियो देवानां परमे जनित्रे ॥
mantras.transliteration: idaṃ ta ekaṃ para ū ta ekaṃ tṛtīyena jyotiṣā saṃ viśasva | saṃveśane tanvaścāruredhi priyo devānāṃ parame janitre ||

translations.english: This (light) is one (portion) of you, and this other is one (portion); with your third light enter into (outerradiance); on the entrance of the body into (the sun), the supreme birthplace of the gods, become lovely andbeloved.

mantras.sanskrit: तनूष्टे वाजिन्तन्वं नयन्ती वाममस्मभ्यं धातु शर्म तुभ्यम् । अह्रुतो महो धरुणाय देवान्दिवीव ज्योतिः स्वमा मिमीयाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tanūṣṭe vājintanvaṃ nayantī vāmamasmabhyaṃ dhātu śarma tubhyam | ahruto maho dharuṇāya devāndivīva jyotiḥ svamā mimīyāḥ ||

translations.english: May this body (the earth) conveying your body, Vājin, give precious wealth to us and happiness toyou; an ddo you, without stumbling, enter among the great gods for their support; and the light that is in heaven(the sun) and your own (light).

mantras.sanskrit: वाज्यसि वाजिनेना सुवेनीः सुवितः स्तोमं सुवितो दिवं गाः । सुवितो धर्म प्रथमानु सत्या सुवितो देवान्त्सुवितोऽनु पत्म ॥
mantras.transliteration: vājyasi vājinenā suvenīḥ suvitaḥ stomaṃ suvito divaṃ gāḥ | suvito dharma prathamānu satyā suvito devāntsuvito'nu patma ||

translations.english: You are, Vājin, (strong) through food; you (are) well-beloved; urged thereto follow (the object of your)praise; urged thereto proceed to heaven; urged thereto pursue the duties that are the most important and sure ofreward; urged thereto follow the gods; urged thereto follow (the light), descending (from heaven).

mantras.sanskrit: महिम्न एषां पितरश्चनेशिरे देवा देवेष्वदधुरपि क्रतुम् । समविव्यचुरुत यान्यत्विषुरैषां तनूषु नि विविशुः पुनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahimna eṣāṃ pitaraścaneśire devā deveṣvadadhurapi kratum | samavivyacuruta yānyatviṣuraiṣāṃ tanūṣu ni viviśuḥ punaḥ ||

translations.english: Our progenitors (the Aṅgirasas) were lords over the might of those (divinities), they having becomegods imposed their will upon the gods; they attained also (the radiances) which shone forth, and they againentered the bodies of those (gods).

mantras.sanskrit: सहोभिर्विश्वं परि चक्रमू रजः पूर्वा धामान्यमिता मिमानाः । तनूषु विश्वा भुवना नि येमिरे प्रासारयन्त पुरुध प्रजा अनु ॥
mantras.transliteration: sahobhirviśvaṃ pari cakramū rajaḥ pūrvā dhāmānyamitā mimānāḥ | tanūṣu viśvā bhuvanā ni yemire prāsārayanta purudha prajā anu ||

translations.english: By their powers they traversed the whole world, measuring the ancient divisions (till then)unmeasured; they restricted all existent beings to their proper forms; they distributed in many directions (light)among the people.

mantras.sanskrit: द्विधा सूनवोऽसुरं स्वर्विदमास्थापयन्त तृतीयेन कर्मणा । स्वां प्रजां पितरः पित्र्यं सह आवरेष्वदधुस्तन्तुमाततम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dvidhā sūnavo'suraṃ svarvidamāsthāpayanta tṛtīyena karmaṇā | svāṃ prajāṃ pitaraḥ pitryaṃ saha āvareṣvadadhustantumātatam ||

translations.english: The sons (of Āditya, the Aṅgirasas), established by the third act of duty, the mighty, all-wise (sun) inhis two-fold (condition of rising and setting); our progenitors (having begotten) their own progeny, deposited inthe best (of them) the paternal strength, (making) an extended line (of progeny).

mantras.sanskrit: नावा न क्षोदः प्रदिशः पृथिव्याः स्वस्तिभिरति दुर्गाणि विश्वा । स्वां प्रजां बृहदुक्थो महित्वावरेष्वदधादा परेषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: nāvā na kṣodaḥ pradiśaḥ pṛthivyāḥ svastibhirati durgāṇi viśvā | svāṃ prajāṃ bṛhaduktho mahitvāvareṣvadadhādā pareṣu ||

translations.english: As men pass over the water to the several quarters of the earth in a ship; (as they pass over) alldifficulties by the blessings (of fortune), Bṛhaduktha by his might has committed his own offspring to those onthis side, and to those on the other side.

mantras.sanskrit: मा प्र गाम पथो वयं मा यज्ञादिन्द्र सोमिनः । मान्त स्थुर्नो अरातयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā pra gāma patho vayaṃ mā yajñādindra sominaḥ | mānta sthurno arātayaḥ ||

translations.english: Let us not depart, Indra, from the path; let us not (depart) from the sacrifice of the offerer of thelibation; let not our adversaries remain (in our plural ce).

mantras.sanskrit: यो यज्ञस्य प्रसाधनस्तन्तुर्देवेष्वाततः । तमाहुतं नशीमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo yajñasya prasādhanastanturdeveṣvātataḥ | tamāhutaṃ naśīmahi ||

translations.english: May we obtain (the favour of) him to whom burnt offerings are presented, (Agni), who is the thread, theperfecter of sacrifice, drawn out (by the priests) to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: मनो न्वा हुवामहे नाराशंसेन सोमेन । पितॄणां च मन्मभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mano nvā huvāmahe nārāśaṃsena somena | pitṝṇāṃ ca manmabhiḥ ||

translations.english: We call upon the spirit (of Subandhu) with the Soma appropriated to the progenitors, with the praisesepithet of the Soma. Yajus. 3.53 reads stomena: praise is of to kinds, that of gods and men, the latter isnārāśamsaḥ, whence the epithet narāśaṃsa means, suited to man; that is, to deified men or pitṛs].

mantras.sanskrit: आ त एतु मनः पुनः क्रत्वे दक्षाय जीवसे । ज्योक्च सूर्यं दृशे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā ta etu manaḥ punaḥ kratve dakṣāya jīvase | jyokca sūryaṃ dṛśe ||

translations.english: May (your) spirit (Subandhu) come back again to perform pious acts; to exercise strength; to live; andlong to see the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: पुनर्नः पितरो मनो ददातु दैव्यो जनः । जीवं व्रातं सचेमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: punarnaḥ pitaro mano dadātu daivyo janaḥ | jīvaṃ vrātaṃ sacemahi ||

translations.english: May our progenitors, may the host of the gods, restore (your) spirit; may we obtain (for you) theaggregate of the functions of life.

mantras.sanskrit: वयं सोम व्रते तव मनस्तनूषु बिभ्रतः । प्रजावन्तः सचेमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayaṃ soma vrate tava manastanūṣu bibhrataḥ | prajāvantaḥ sacemahi ||

translations.english: Soma, fixing our minds, on your worship and its details, may we, blessed with progeny, obtain (theaggreagate of the functions of life)

mantras.sanskrit: यत्ते यमं वैवस्वतं मनो जगाम दूरकम् । तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatte yamaṃ vaivasvataṃ mano jagāma dūrakam | tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: यत्ते दिवं यत्पृथिवीं मनो जगाम दूरकम् । तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatte divaṃ yatpṛthivīṃ mano jagāma dūrakam | tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: यत्ते भूमिं चतुर्भृष्टिं मनो जगाम दूरकम् । तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatte bhūmiṃ caturbhṛṣṭiṃ mano jagāma dūrakam | tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: यत्ते चतस्रः प्रदिशो मनो जगाम दूरकम् । तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatte catasraḥ pradiśo mano jagāma dūrakam | tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: यत्ते समुद्रमर्णवं मनो जगाम दूरकम् । तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatte samudramarṇavaṃ mano jagāma dūrakam | tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: यत्ते मरीचीः प्रवतो मनो जगाम दूरकम् । तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatte marīcīḥ pravato mano jagāma dūrakam | tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: यत्ते अपो यदोषधीर्मनो जगाम दूरकम् । तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatte apo yadoṣadhīrmano jagāma dūrakam | tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: यत्ते सूर्यं यदुषसं मनो जगाम दूरकम् । तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatte sūryaṃ yaduṣasaṃ mano jagāma dūrakam | tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: यत्ते पर्वतान्बृहतो मनो जगाम दूरकम् । तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatte parvatānbṛhato mano jagāma dūrakam | tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: यत्ते विश्वमिदं जगन्मनो जगाम दूरकम् । तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatte viśvamidaṃ jaganmano jagāma dūrakam | tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: यत्ते पराः परावतो मनो जगाम दूरकम् । तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatte parāḥ parāvato mano jagāma dūrakam | tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: यत्ते भूतं च भव्यं च मनो जगाम दूरकम् । तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatte bhūtaṃ ca bhavyaṃ ca mano jagāma dūrakam | tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: प्र तार्यायुः प्रतरं नवीय स्थातारेव क्रतुमता रथस्य । अध च्यवान उत्तवीत्यर्थं परातरं सु निॠतिर्जिहीताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra tāryāyuḥ prataraṃ navīya sthātāreva kratumatā rathasya | adha cyavāna uttavītyarthaṃ parātaraṃ su niṝtirjihītām ||

translations.english: May the life of Subandhu be augmented so as to be more lasting and newer, as men conveyed in acar (are carried on) by a skilful (driver); he who falls from life, increases (his) desire to live; may Nirṛti depart faroff.

mantras.sanskrit: सामन्नु राये निधिमन्न्वन्नं करामहे सु पुरुध श्रवांसि । ता नो विश्वानि जरिता ममत्तु परातरं सु निॠतिर्जिहीताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sāmannu rāye nidhimannvannaṃ karāmahe su purudha śravāṃsi | tā no viśvāni jaritā mamattu parātaraṃ su niṝtirjihītām ||

translations.english: (When) the hymn (is being sung) let us offer (sacrificial) food, like a treasure (to Nirṛti) for the sake ofriches, and many kinds of sacrificial viands; may she, being praised, partake of all these our (offerings); mayNiṛrti depart far off.

mantras.sanskrit: अभी ष्वर्यः पौंस्यैर्भवेम द्यौर्न भूमिं गिरयो नाज्रान् । ता नो विश्वानि जरिता चिकेत परातरं सु निॠतिर्जिहीताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhī ṣvaryaḥ pauṃsyairbhavema dyaurna bhūmiṃ girayo nājrān | tā no viśvāni jaritā ciketa parātaraṃ su niṝtirjihītām ||

translations.english: May we, by our manly exertions, overcome our enemies, as the Sun the earth, as thunderbolts theclouds; she, being praised, knows all these our (exploits); may Nirṛti depart far off.

mantras.sanskrit: मो षु णः सोम मृत्यवे परा दाः पश्येम नु सूर्यमुच्चरन्तम् । द्युभिर्हितो जरिमा सू नो अस्तु परातरं सु निॠतिर्जिहीताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mo ṣu ṇaḥ soma mṛtyave parā dāḥ paśyema nu sūryamuccarantam | dyubhirhito jarimā sū no astu parātaraṃ su niṝtirjihītām ||

translations.english: Give us not up, Soma, to death; may we (long) behold the rising sun; may our old age brought on by(passing) days be happy; may Nirṛti depart far off.

mantras.sanskrit: असुनीते मनो अस्मासु धारय जीवातवे सु प्र तिरा न आयुः । रारन्धि नः सूर्यस्य संदृशि घृतेन त्वं तन्वं वर्धयस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: asunīte mano asmāsu dhāraya jīvātave su pra tirā na āyuḥ | rārandhi naḥ sūryasya saṃdṛśi ghṛtena tvaṃ tanvaṃ vardhayasva ||

translations.english: Asunīti, give us back the (departed) spirit; extend our life that we may live (long); establish us that wemay (long) behold the sun; do you cherish the body with the ghī (that we have offered).

mantras.sanskrit: असुनीते पुनरस्मासु चक्षुः पुनः प्राणमिह नो धेहि भोगम् । ज्योक्पश्येम सूर्यमुच्चरन्तमनुमते मृळया नः स्वस्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: asunīte punarasmāsu cakṣuḥ punaḥ prāṇamiha no dhehi bhogam | jyokpaśyema sūryamuccarantamanumate mṛḷayā naḥ svasti ||

translations.english: Restore to us, Asunīti, sight and breath, and enjoyment in this world; long may we behold the risingsun; make us happy, gracious (goddess), with prosperity.

mantras.sanskrit: पुनर्नो असुं पृथिवी ददातु पुनर्द्यौर्देवी पुनरन्तरिक्षम् । पुनर्नः सोमस्तन्वं ददातु पुनः पूषा पथ्यां या स्वस्तिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: punarno asuṃ pṛthivī dadātu punardyaurdevī punarantarikṣam | punarnaḥ somastanvaṃ dadātu punaḥ pūṣā pathyāṃ yā svastiḥ ||

translations.english: May earth restore the (departed) soul to us; may the divine heaven, may the firmament (restore it);may Soma restore body to us; may Pūṣan restore to us speech, which is prosperity.

mantras.sanskrit: शं रोदसी सुबन्धवे यह्वी ऋतस्य मातरा । भरतामप यद्रपो द्यौः पृथिवि क्षमा रपो मो षु ते किं चनाममत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaṃ rodasī subandhave yahvī ṛtasya mātarā | bharatāmapa yadrapo dyauḥ pṛthivi kṣamā rapo mo ṣu te kiṃ canāmamat ||

translations.english: May the great heaven and earth, the parents of sacrifice, (grant) happiness to Subandhu; heaven andearth, remove all iniquity; let heaven (take away) iniquity; may no ill ever approach you.

mantras.sanskrit: अव द्वके अव त्रिका दिवश्चरन्ति भेषजा । क्षमा चरिष्ण्वेककं भरतामप यद्रपो द्यौः पृथिवि क्षमा रपो मो षु ते किं चनाममत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ava dvake ava trikā divaścaranti bheṣajā | kṣamā cariṣṇvekakaṃ bharatāmapa yadrapo dyauḥ pṛthivi kṣamā rapo mo ṣu te kiṃ canāmamat ||

translations.english: Remedies come down from heaven by two and threes; one wanders singly in heaven; heaven andearth remove all iniquity; let heaven (take away) iniquity; may no ill ever approach you.

mantras.sanskrit: समिन्द्रेरय गामनड्वाहं य आवहदुशीनराण्या अनः । भरतामप यद्रपो द्यौः पृथिवि क्षमा रपो मो षु ते किं चनाममत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: samindreraya gāmanaḍvāhaṃ ya āvahaduśīnarāṇyā anaḥ | bharatāmapa yadrapo dyauḥ pṛthivi kṣamā rapo mo ṣu te kiṃ canāmamat ||

translations.english: Send, Indra, the active ox, who may bring the cart (laden with) the uśīnarāṇi grass; heaven andearth, remove all iniquity; let heaven (take away) iniquity; may no ill ever approach you.

mantras.sanskrit: आ जनं त्वेषसंदृशं माहीनानामुपस्तुतम् । अगन्म बिभ्रतो नमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā janaṃ tveṣasaṃdṛśaṃ māhīnānāmupastutam | aganma bibhrato namaḥ ||

translations.english: We have come to the person n of splendid appearance, the honoured of the mighty, bringing himreverential homage.

mantras.sanskrit: असमातिं नितोशनं त्वेषं निययिनं रथम् । भजेरथस्य सत्पतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asamātiṃ nitośanaṃ tveṣaṃ niyayinaṃ ratham | bhajerathasya satpatim ||

translations.english: To Asamāti, the destroyer (of foes), radiant, a quick-moving chariot, (for the bringing of benefits),(the descendant) of Bhajeratha, the protector of the good.

mantras.sanskrit: यो जनान्महिषाँ इवातितस्थौ पवीरवान् । उतापवीरवान्युधा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo janānmahiṣā~ ivātitasthau pavīravān | utāpavīravānyudhā ||

translations.english: Who, whether armed or unarmed with a sword, overcomes adversaries in fight, as (a lion destroys)buffaloes.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्येक्ष्वाकुरुप व्रते रेवान्मराय्येधते । दिवीव पञ्च कृष्टयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasyekṣvākurupa vrate revānmarāyyedhate | divīva pañca kṛṣṭayaḥ ||

translations.english: In the good government of whose (realm) the opunlent and victorious Ikṣvāku prospers (so that) thefive orders of men (are as happy) as if they were in heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र क्षत्रासमातिषु रथप्रोष्ठेषु धारय । दिवीव सूर्यं दृशे ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra kṣatrāsamātiṣu rathaproṣṭheṣu dhāraya | divīva sūryaṃ dṛśe ||

translations.english: Maintain, Indra, vigour in the Rathaproṣṭha Asamātis, as (you maintain) the sun in heaven for thesight (of all).

mantras.sanskrit: अगस्त्यस्य नद्भ्यः सप्ती युनक्षि रोहिता । पणीन्न्यक्रमीरभि विश्वान्राजन्नराधसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agastyasya nadbhyaḥ saptī yunakṣi rohitā | paṇīnnyakramīrabhi viśvānrājannarādhasaḥ ||

translations.english: Yoke the two red horses to your chariot, for the nephews of Agastya, and overcome, rājā, all theniggard withholders of oblations.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं मातायं पितायं जीवातुरागमत् । इदं तव प्रसर्पणं सुबन्धवेहि निरिहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ mātāyaṃ pitāyaṃ jīvāturāgamat | idaṃ tava prasarpaṇaṃ subandhavehi nirihi ||

translations.english: This (Agni) your mother, this your father, this the giver of life to you, has arrived; come back,Subandhu, to this your (body) that is capable of motion. Come forth.

mantras.sanskrit: यथा युगं वरत्रया नह्यन्ति धरुणाय कम् । एवा दाधार ते मनो जीवातवे न मृत्यवेऽथो अरिष्टतातये ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathā yugaṃ varatrayā nahyanti dharuṇāya kam | evā dādhāra te mano jīvātave na mṛtyave'tho ariṣṭatātaye ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: यथेयं पृथिवी मही दाधारेमान्वनस्पतीन् । एवा दाधार ते मनो जीवातवे न मृत्यवेऽथो अरिष्टतातये ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatheyaṃ pṛthivī mahī dādhāremānvanaspatīn | evā dādhāra te mano jīvātave na mṛtyave'tho ariṣṭatātaye ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: यमादहं वैवस्वतात्सुबन्धोर्मन आभरम् । जीवातवे न मृत्यवेऽथो अरिष्टतातये ॥
mantras.transliteration: yamādahaṃ vaivasvatātsubandhormana ābharam | jīvātave na mṛtyave'tho ariṣṭatātaye ||

translations.english: (Agni speaks). I bring the spirit of ASubandhu from Yama, the son of Vivasvat, for life, not for death,but for security.

mantras.sanskrit: न्यग्वातोऽव वाति न्यक्तपति सूर्यः । नीचीनमघ्न्या दुहे न्यग्भवतु ते रपः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nyagvāto'va vāti nyaktapati sūryaḥ | nīcīnamaghnyā duhe nyagbhavatu te rapaḥ ||

translations.english: The wind blows downwards, the sun burns downwards, the cow yields her milk downwards, so be(hand) has all medicaments; this has a blessed touch.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं मे हस्तो भगवानयं मे भगवत्तरः । अयं मे विश्वभेषजोऽयं शिवाभिमर्शनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ me hasto bhagavānayaṃ me bhagavattaraḥ | ayaṃ me viśvabheṣajo'yaṃ śivābhimarśanaḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: इदमित्था रौद्रं गूर्तवचा ब्रह्म क्रत्वा शच्यामन्तराजौ । क्राणा यदस्य पितरा मंहनेष्ठाः पर्षत्पक्थे अहन्ना सप्त होतॄन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: idamitthā raudraṃ gūrtavacā brahma kratvā śacyāmantarājau | krāṇā yadasya pitarā maṃhaneṣṭhāḥ parṣatpakthe ahannā sapta hotṝn ||

translations.english: The fierce-voiced (Nābhānediṣṭha repeated) through his intelligence this praise of Rudra, in themidst of the ceremony at the assembly (of the Aṅgirasas), which (praise) his parents, making (the partition) andhis brothers engaged in giving (the shares accomplished); he perfected the seven priests (therewith) on the dayon which the rite was to be matured.

mantras.sanskrit: स इद्दानाय दभ्याय वन्वञ्च्यवानः सूदैरमिमीत वेदिम् । तूर्वयाणो गूर्तवचस्तमः क्षोदो न रेत इतऊति सिञ्चत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa iddānāya dabhyāya vanvañcyavānaḥ sūdairamimīta vedim | tūrvayāṇo gūrtavacastamaḥ kṣodo na reta itaūti siñcat ||

translations.english: He (Rudra) bestowing on his worshippers the gift (of wealth) and the defeat (of their foes),castingdown (the rākṣasas) with his weapons, has constructed the altar; rapid in movement, most fierce in speech,and shedding the procreative fluid like water around.

mantras.sanskrit: मनो न येषु हवनेषु तिग्मं विपः शच्या वनुथो द्रवन्ता । आ यः शर्याभिस्तुविनृम्णो अस्याश्रीणीतादिशं गभस्तौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: mano na yeṣu havaneṣu tigmaṃ vipaḥ śacyā vanutho dravantā | ā yaḥ śaryābhistuvinṛmṇo asyāśrīṇītādiśaṃ gabhastau ||

translations.english: (I call you to these) oblations, to which hastening, (Aśvins), swift as thought at the invitation of theworshipper, you rejoice my (worshipper) who, affluent in the wealth of sacrifice, mixes (the oblation) with hisfingers in your presence, (holding) in his hand the sacrifice intended (for you).

mantras.sanskrit: कृष्णा यद्गोष्वरुणीषु सीदद्दिवो नपाताश्विना हुवे वाम् । वीतं मे यज्ञमा गतं मे अन्नं ववन्वांसा नेषमस्मृतध्रू ॥
mantras.transliteration: kṛṣṇā yadgoṣvaruṇīṣu sīdaddivo napātāśvinā huve vām | vītaṃ me yajñamā gataṃ me annaṃ vavanvāṃsā neṣamasmṛtadhrū ||

translations.english: When the dark night rettires before the purple oxen (of the chariot of the dawn), I invoke you,Aśvinschildren of heaven; be desirous of my sacrifice; come to my food and to my viands like (two horses) eatingtogether, oblivious of offence.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रथिष्ट यस्य वीरकर्ममिष्णदनुष्ठितं नु नर्यो अपौहत् । पुनस्तदा वृहति यत्कनाया दुहितुरा अनुभृतमनर्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: prathiṣṭa yasya vīrakarmamiṣṇadanuṣṭhitaṃ nu naryo apauhat | punastadā vṛhati yatkanāyā duhiturā anubhṛtamanarvā ||

translations.english: (Rudra), the benefactor of man, whose eager, virile energy was developed, drew it back whendisseminated (for the genitive ration of offfspring); again the irresistible (Rudra) concentrates (the energy) which wascommunicated to his maiden daughter.

mantras.sanskrit: मध्या यत्कर्त्वमभवदभीके कामं कृण्वाने पितरि युवत्याम् । मनानग्रेतो जहतुर्वियन्ता सानौ निषिक्तं सुकृतस्य योनौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: madhyā yatkartvamabhavadabhīke kāmaṃ kṛṇvāne pitari yuvatyām | manānagreto jahaturviyantā sānau niṣiktaṃ sukṛtasya yonau ||

translations.english: When the deed was done in mid-heaven in the proximity of the father working his will, and thedaughter coming together, they let the seed fall slightly; it was poured upon the high plural ce of sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: पिता यत्स्वां दुहितरमधिष्कन्क्ष्मया रेतः संजग्मानो नि षिञ्चत् । स्वाध्योऽजनयन्ब्रह्म देवा वास्तोष्पतिं व्रतपां निरतक्षन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pitā yatsvāṃ duhitaramadhiṣkankṣmayā retaḥ saṃjagmāno ni ṣiñcat | svādhyo'janayanbrahma devā vāstoṣpatiṃ vratapāṃ niratakṣan ||

translations.english: When the father united with the daughter, then associating with the earth, he sprinkled it with theeffusion; then the thoughtful gods begot Brahma; they fabricated the lord of the hearth (of sacrifice); the defenderof sacred rites.

mantras.sanskrit: स ईं वृषा न फेनमस्यदाजौ स्मदा परैदप दभ्रचेताः । सरत्पदा न दक्षिणा परावृङ्न ता नु मे पृशन्यो जगृभ्रे ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa īṃ vṛṣā na phenamasyadājau smadā paraidapa dabhracetāḥ | saratpadā na dakṣiṇā parāvṛṅna tā nu me pṛśanyo jagṛbhre ||

translations.english: He, like the showerer (Indra), cast foam around in the combat, and came away from us with a niggardmind; he advances not a step, relinquishing the donations; though skilled in rapine, he seizes not these my(cows).

mantras.sanskrit: मक्षू न वह्निः प्रजाया उपब्दिरग्निं न नग्न उप सीददूधः । सनितेध्मं सनितोत वाजं स धर्ता जज्ञे सहसा यवीयुत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: makṣū na vahniḥ prajāyā upabdiragniṃ na nagna upa sīdadūdhaḥ | sanitedhmaṃ sanitota vājaṃ sa dhartā jajñe sahasā yavīyut ||

translations.english: The fire, harming the people, does not approach quickly (by day); the naked (rākṣasas approach)not Agni by night; the giver of fuel, and the giver of food, he, the upholder (of the rite), is born, overcomingenemies by his might.

mantras.sanskrit: मक्षू कनायाः सख्यं नवग्वा ऋतं वदन्त ऋतयुक्तिमग्मन् । द्विबर्हसो य उप गोपमागुरदक्षिणासो अच्युता दुदुक्षन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: makṣū kanāyāḥ sakhyaṃ navagvā ṛtaṃ vadanta ṛtayuktimagman | dvibarhaso ya upa gopamāguradakṣiṇāso acyutā dudukṣan ||

translations.english: The Aṅgirasas, who were engaged in the nine months;' ceremonial, reciting the praise suited to therite, quickly attained the friendship of the maiden; those who seated in the two seats (heaven and earth) came totheir protector, as they had no donation, milked forth the inexhaustible (waters).

mantras.sanskrit: मक्षू कनायाः सख्यं नवीयो राधो न रेत ऋतमित्तुरण्यन् । शुचि यत्ते रेक्ण आयजन्त सबर्दुघायाः पय उस्रियायाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: makṣū kanāyāḥ sakhyaṃ navīyo rādho na reta ṛtamitturaṇyan | śuci yatte rekṇa āyajanta sabardughāyāḥ paya usriyāyāḥ ||

translations.english: Quickly (obtaining) the friendship of the maiden, they poured forth water like new wealth, when theyoffered to you (Indra) the pure riches, the milk of the cow, that yields ambrosia.

mantras.sanskrit: पश्वा यत्पश्चा वियुता बुधन्तेति ब्रवीति वक्तरी रराणः । वसोर्वसुत्वा कारवोऽनेहा विश्वं विवेष्टि द्रविणमुप क्षु ॥
mantras.transliteration: paśvā yatpaścā viyutā budhanteti bravīti vaktarī rarāṇaḥ | vasorvasutvā kāravo'nehā viśvaṃ viveṣṭi draviṇamupa kṣu ||

translations.english: "When (the worshippers) find (the stalls deserted) by the cattle" (then the performer of the rite)exclaims, "(Indra), plural asing to his adorer, the affluent lord of affluence, the compassionate, the sinless, quicklyrecovers all the wealth (that has been carried off)."

mantras.sanskrit: तदिन्न्वस्य परिषद्वानो अग्मन्पुरू सदन्तो नार्षदं बिभित्सन् । वि शुष्णस्य संग्रथितमनर्वा विदत्पुरुप्रजातस्य गुहा यत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadinnvasya pariṣadvāno agmanpurū sadanto nārṣadaṃ bibhitsan | vi śuṣṇasya saṃgrathitamanarvā vidatpuruprajātasya guhā yat ||

translations.english: Then the attendant (rays of light) quickly gathered round him, and (the asuras) dwelling in manyregions sought to destroy the son of Nṛṣad, but the irresistible (Indra) found the well-knit mail of Śuṣṇa, whoseoffspring was numerous, which was hidden in the cave.

mantras.sanskrit: भर्गो ह नामोत यस्य देवाः स्वर्ण ये त्रिषधस्थे निषेदुः । अग्निर्ह नामोत जातवेदाः श्रुधी नो होतॠतस्य होताध्रुक् ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhargo ha nāmota yasya devāḥ svarṇa ye triṣadhasthe niṣeduḥ | agnirha nāmota jātavedāḥ śrudhī no hotaṝtasya hotādhruk ||

translations.english: Whether Bharga is the name of that radiance, on the triple seat of which those who are gods areseated, as if in heaven, or whether it be Agni, or Jātavedas; invoker (of the gods), who are the ministrant priestof the sacrifice, hear our guileless invocation.

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्या मे रौद्रावर्चिमन्ता नासत्याविन्द्र गूर्तये यजध्यै । मनुष्वद्वृक्तबर्हिषे रराणा मन्दू हितप्रयसा विक्षु यज्यू ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tyā me raudrāvarcimantā nāsatyāvindra gūrtaye yajadhyai | manuṣvadvṛktabarhiṣe rarāṇā mandū hitaprayasā vikṣu yajyū ||

translations.english: And, Indra, let those two brilliant sons of Rudra, the Nāsatyās, (be present) at my praise andsacrifice; being propitious to (me seated) on the strewn grass, as (at the sacrifice of) Manu, cheerful, liberal ofwealth to the people, deserving of adoration.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं स्तुतो राजा वन्दि वेधा अपश्च विप्रस्तरति स्वसेतुः । स कक्षीवन्तं रेजयत्सो अग्निं नेमिं न चक्रमर्वतो रघुद्रु ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ stuto rājā vandi vedhā apaśca viprastarati svasetuḥ | sa kakṣīvantaṃ rejayatso agniṃ nemiṃ na cakramarvato raghudru ||

translations.english: This royal (Soma), this glorified creator, is praised (by all), and, like a sage, constituting his owncause-way, he traverses the firmament; he made Kakṣīvat tremble, he (made) Agni (shake) as horses (agitate)the light- whirling, revolving-wheel (of a chariot).

mantras.sanskrit: स द्विबन्धुर्वैतरणो यष्टा सबर्धुं धेनुमस्वं दुहध्यै । सं यन्मित्रावरुणा वृञ्ज उक्थैर्ज्येष्ठेभिरर्यमणं वरूथैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa dvibandhurvaitaraṇo yaṣṭā sabardhuṃ dhenumasvaṃ duhadhyai | saṃ yanmitrāvaruṇā vṛñja ukthairjyeṣṭhebhiraryamaṇaṃ varūthaiḥ ||

translations.english: The kinsman of the two (worlds, Agni), the conveyer (of all), the sacrificer, (made) theambrosia-yielding cow, which had not given birth, to yield milk (for Śayu), when he praises Mitra, Varuṇa andAryaman, with most excellent and choice hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: तद्बन्धुः सूरिर्दिवि ते धियंधा नाभानेदिष्ठो रपति प्र वेनन् । सा नो नाभिः परमास्य वा घाहं तत्पश्चा कतिथश्चिदास ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadbandhuḥ sūrirdivi te dhiyaṃdhā nābhānediṣṭho rapati pra venan | sā no nābhiḥ paramāsya vā ghāhaṃ tatpaścā katithaścidāsa ||
