translations.english: The kinsman of the earth, the utterer of praise (belonging) to you (who abides) in heaven,Nābhānediṣṭha, the supporter of the rite, desiring (the recompense), repeats (this praise); the (heaven) ourmost excellent bound (is the site) of the (sun), and I was after many (degrees) descended from hiṃ

mantras.sanskrit: इयं मे नाभिरिह मे सधस्थमिमे मे देवा अयमस्मि सर्वः । द्विजा अह प्रथमजा ऋतस्येदं धेनुरदुहज्जायमाना ॥
mantras.transliteration: iyaṃ me nābhiriha me sadhasthamime me devā ayamasmi sarvaḥ | dvijā aha prathamajā ṛtasyedaṃ dhenuraduhajjāyamānā ||

translations.english: This (aerial voice) is my bond of affinity; here, (in the solar orb) is my abiding-plural ce; these are myresplendent (rays); I am this all; I am the twice-born; the first-born of truth; the cow, as soon as born, milked forthidentical with Āditya; sā yā vāg asau sa ādityaḥ, that which is vāk is that Ādityaḥ: ŚatapathaBrāhmaṇa 10.5.1.4]. the forests, terminates (in the fire of sacrifice), who upward rising, like a line, adorable, quickly subdues (hisfoes). him, unchangeable, the augmenter of happiness, his mother has brought forth.

mantras.sanskrit: अधासु मन्द्रो अरतिर्विभावाव स्यति द्विवर्तनिर्वनेषाट् । ऊर्ध्वा यच्छ्रेणिर्न शिशुर्दन्मक्षू स्थिरं शेवृधं सूत माता ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhāsu mandro aratirvibhāvāva syati dvivartanirvaneṣāṭ | ūrdhvā yacchreṇirna śiśurdanmakṣū sthiraṃ śevṛdhaṃ sūta mātā ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: अधा गाव उपमातिं कनाया अनु श्वान्तस्य कस्य चित्परेयुः । श्रुधि त्वं सुद्रविणो नस्त्वं याळाश्वघ्नस्य वावृधे सूनृताभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhā gāva upamātiṃ kanāyā anu śvāntasya kasya citpareyuḥ | śrudhi tvaṃ sudraviṇo nastvaṃ yāḷāśvaghnasya vāvṛdhe sūnṛtābhiḥ ||

translations.english: The words of the desirable (praise), of a certain tranquil person n (Nābhānediṣṭha), attain theprototype (Indra). Do you, who are the giver of wealth (Agni), hear us; offer sacrifice, you are magnified by thesincere eulogies of Aśvaghna.

mantras.sanskrit: अध त्वमिन्द्र विद्ध्यस्मान्महो राये नृपते वज्रबाहुः । रक्षा च नो मघोनः पाहि सूरीननेहसस्ते हरिवो अभिष्टौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha tvamindra viddhyasmānmaho rāye nṛpate vajrabāhuḥ | rakṣā ca no maghonaḥ pāhi sūrīnanehasaste harivo abhiṣṭau ||

translations.english: Do you, Indra, king of men, who are the bearer of the thunderbolt, regard us now to (give us) greatriches, and protect us who are affluent in (oblations), who utter (your) praise; may we, lord of bay steeds, (be)free from blame on your approach.

mantras.sanskrit: अध यद्राजाना गविष्टौ सरत्सरण्युः कारवे जरण्युः । विप्रः प्रेष्ठः स ह्येषां बभूव परा च वक्षदुत पर्षदेनान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: adha yadrājānā gaviṣṭau saratsaraṇyuḥ kārave jaraṇyuḥ | vipraḥ preṣṭhaḥ sa hyeṣāṃ babhūva parā ca vakṣaduta parṣadenān ||

translations.english: Since, royal (Mitra and Varuṇa), the impetuous (Yama) now approaches in expectation of (the gift of)cattle, and desiring praise for the sacrificing (band of the Aṅgirasas); the sage (Nābhānediṣṭha) has beenheld most dear by them; may he accomplish (what has to be effected), and make them successful.

mantras.sanskrit: अधा न्वस्य जेन्यस्य पुष्टौ वृथा रेभन्त ईमहे तदू नु । सरण्युरस्य सूनुरश्वो विप्रश्चासि श्रवसश्च सातौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhā nvasya jenyasya puṣṭau vṛthā rebhanta īmahe tadū nu | saraṇyurasya sūnuraśvo vipraścāsi śravasaśca sātau ||

translations.english: And for the contentment of this victorious (Varuṇa), praising (him) without an effort, we solicit this (ofhim), (that) his progeny, a swift horse, (may be ours), and you, (Varuṇa), are wise, and (are occupied) inprocuring us food.

mantras.sanskrit: युवोर्यदि सख्यायास्मे शर्धाय स्तोमं जुजुषे नमस्वान् । विश्वत्र यस्मिन्ना गिरः समीचीः पूर्वीव गातुर्दाशत्सूनृतायै ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvoryadi sakhyāyāsme śardhāya stomaṃ jujuṣe namasvān | viśvatra yasminnā giraḥ samīcīḥ pūrvīva gāturdāśatsūnṛtāyai ||

translations.english: If the priest offers homage to you two (Mitra and Varuṇa) for the sake of your friendship and ourinvigoration, on (the formation of) which (friendship) the praises (of the Aṅgirasas go) everywhere in a commondirection; may he give (plural asure) to the utterer of praise like an ancient road.

mantras.sanskrit: स गृणानो अद्भिर्देववानिति सुबन्धुर्नमसा सूक्तैः । वर्धदुक्थैर्वचोभिरा हि नूनं व्यध्वैति पयस उस्रियायाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa gṛṇāno adbhirdevavāniti subandhurnamasā sūktaiḥ | vardhadukthairvacobhirā hi nūnaṃ vyadhvaiti payasa usriyāyāḥ ||

translations.english: Being praised with reverence and hymns thus, "the god-accompanied (Varuṇa) of good lineage,together with the waters"; may he be magnified; (attracted) by hymns and prayers (may he) now (approach); thepath of the milk of the cow is open (for his worship).

mantras.sanskrit: त ऊ षु णो महो यजत्रा भूत देवास ऊतये सजोषाः । ये वाजाँ अनयता वियन्तो ये स्था निचेतारो अमूराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ta ū ṣu ṇo maho yajatrā bhūta devāsa ūtaye sajoṣāḥ | ye vājā~ anayatā viyanto ye sthā nicetāro amūrāḥ ||

translations.english: Adorable divinities, be consentient for our great preservation, both you who, going in variousdirections, are the bringers of food, and you who, being no longer perplexed, are the discoverers (of the cattle).

mantras.sanskrit: ये यज्ञेन दक्षिणया समक्ता इन्द्रस्य सख्यममृतत्वमानश । तेभ्यो भद्रमङ्गिरसो वो अस्तु प्रति गृभ्णीत मानवं सुमेधसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye yajñena dakṣiṇayā samaktā indrasya sakhyamamṛtatvamānaśa | tebhyo bhadramaṅgiraso vo astu prati gṛbhṇīta mānavaṃ sumedhasaḥ ||

translations.english: You, who associated with sacrifice and pious donations, have acquired the friendship of Indra andimmortality; upon you, Aṅgirasas, may good fortune attend; welcome, sages, the son of Manu.

mantras.sanskrit: य उदाजन्पितरो गोमयं वस्वृतेनाभिन्दन्परिवत्सरे वलम् । दीर्घायुत्वमङ्गिरसो वो अस्तु प्रति गृभ्णीत मानवं सुमेधसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya udājanpitaro gomayaṃ vasvṛtenābhindanparivatsare valam | dīrghāyutvamaṅgiraso vo astu prati gṛbhṇīta mānavaṃ sumedhasaḥ ||

translations.english: May length of life be yours, Aṅgirasas, our progenitors, who drove forth the wealth of cattle, and bymeans of your sacrifice when the year was ended, demolished (the asura) Bala; welcome, sages, the son ofManu.

mantras.sanskrit: य ऋतेन सूर्यमारोहयन्दिव्यप्रथयन्पृथिवीं मातरं वि । सुप्रजास्त्वमङ्गिरसो वो अस्तु प्रति गृभ्णीत मानवं सुमेधसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya ṛtena sūryamārohayandivyaprathayanpṛthivīṃ mātaraṃ vi | suprajāstvamaṅgiraso vo astu prati gṛbhṇīta mānavaṃ sumedhasaḥ ||

translations.english: May the possession of posterity be yours, Aṅgirasas, who elevated by the (power) of sacrifice theSun in heaven, and made the maternal earth renowned; welcome, sages, the son of Manu.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं नाभा वदति वल्गु वो गृहे देवपुत्रा ऋषयस्तच्छृणोतन । सुब्रह्मण्यमङ्गिरसो वो अस्तु प्रति गृभ्णीत मानवं सुमेधसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ nābhā vadati valgu vo gṛhe devaputrā ṛṣayastacchṛṇotana | subrahmaṇyamaṅgiraso vo astu prati gṛbhṇīta mānavaṃ sumedhasaḥ ||

translations.english: Ṛṣis, sons of the gods, this (Nābhānediṣṭha) addresses to you in the house of (sacrifice) hisbenediction, hear it; may divine splendour, Aṅgirasas, be yours; welcome, sages, the son of Manu.

mantras.sanskrit: विरूपास इदृषयस्त इद्गम्भीरवेपसः । ते अङ्गिरसः सूनवस्ते अग्नेः परि जज्ञिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: virūpāsa idṛṣayasta idgambhīravepasaḥ | te aṅgirasaḥ sūnavaste agneḥ pari jajñire ||

translations.english: These Ṛṣis, however different in form, were verily of profound piety; they are the Aṅgirasas whohave been born as the sons of Agni.

mantras.sanskrit: ये अग्नेः परि जज्ञिरे विरूपासो दिवस्परि । नवग्वो नु दशग्वो अङ्गिरस्तमो सचा देवेषु मंहते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye agneḥ pari jajñire virūpāso divaspari | navagvo nu daśagvo aṅgirastamo sacā deveṣu maṃhate ||

translations.english: Among those who have sprung from Agni in many forms, (and spring) from heaven, the chiefAṅgirasa, the celebrator of the nine-month rite, the celebrator of the ten-month rite, accompanied by the godsbestows (upon me wealth).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रेण युजा निः सृजन्त वाघतो व्रजं गोमन्तमश्विनम् । सहस्रं मे ददतो अष्टकर्ण्यः श्रवो देवेष्वक्रत ॥
mantras.transliteration: indreṇa yujā niḥ sṛjanta vāghato vrajaṃ gomantamaśvinam | sahasraṃ me dadato aṣṭakarṇyaḥ śravo deveṣvakrata ||

translations.english: The acceptors of oblations, with Indra for their associate, have emptied pastures crowded with cows,and horses, giving me a thousand full-grown (cattle), they have gained renown among the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र नूनं जायतामयं मनुस्तोक्मेव रोहतु । यः सहस्रं शताश्वं सद्यो दानाय मंहते ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra nūnaṃ jāyatāmayaṃ manustokmeva rohatu | yaḥ sahasraṃ śatāśvaṃ sadyo dānāya maṃhate ||

translations.english: May this Manu (Sāvarṇi) quickly be born, may he increase like (well- watered) seed, who sends meat once a thousand and a hundred horses for a present.

mantras.sanskrit: न तमश्नोति कश्चन दिव इव सान्वारभम् । सावर्ण्यस्य दक्षिणा वि सिन्धुरिव पप्रथे ॥
mantras.transliteration: na tamaśnoti kaścana diva iva sānvārabham | sāvarṇyasya dakṣiṇā vi sindhuriva paprathe ||

translations.english: No one succeeds in reaching him; (elevated) like the summit of heaven, the liberality of Sāvarṇi hasbroadened out like a river.

mantras.sanskrit: उत दासा परिविषे स्मद्दिष्टी गोपरीणसा । यदुस्तुर्वश्च मामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta dāsā pariviṣe smaddiṣṭī goparīṇasā | yadusturvaśca māmahe ||

translations.english: Yadu and Indra speaking auspiciously, and possessed of numerous cattle, gave them like (appointed)servants, for the enjoyment (of Manu Sāvarṇi).

mantras.sanskrit: सहस्रदा ग्रामणीर्मा रिषन्मनुः सूर्येणास्य यतमानैतु दक्षिणा । सावर्णेर्देवाः प्र तिरन्त्वायुर्यस्मिन्नश्रान्ता असनाम वाजम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sahasradā grāmaṇīrmā riṣanmanuḥ sūryeṇāsya yatamānaitu dakṣiṇā | sāvarṇerdevāḥ pra tirantvāyuryasminnaśrāntā asanāma vājam ||

translations.english: May the donor of a thousand (cows), the head of the district, the Manu, never suffer wrong, may hisliberality go spreading (in glory) with the sun; may the gods prolong the life of Sāvarṇi (from whom) unwearied(in his service) we enjoy abundant food.

mantras.sanskrit: परावतो ये दिधिषन्त आप्यं मनुप्रीतासो जनिमा विवस्वतः । ययातेर्ये नहुष्यस्य बर्हिषि देवा आसते ते अधि ब्रुवन्तु नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: parāvato ye didhiṣanta āpyaṃ manuprītāso janimā vivasvataḥ | yayāterye nahuṣyasya barhiṣi devā āsate te adhi bruvantu naḥ ||

translations.english: May the gods who, (coming) from afar proclaim their affinity (with men), and beloved by men, (support)the genitive rations of (Manu, the son of) Vivasvat; may they who are seated on the sacred grass of Yayāti, the sonof Nahuṣa, speak favourably unto us.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वा हि वो नमस्यानि वन्द्या नामानि देवा उत यज्ञियानि वः । ये स्थ जाता अदितेरद्भ्यस्परि ये पृथिव्यास्ते म इह श्रुता हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvā hi vo namasyāni vandyā nāmāni devā uta yajñiyāni vaḥ | ye stha jātā aditeradbhyaspari ye pṛthivyāste ma iha śrutā havam ||

translations.english: All your appellations, gods, are to be revered and praised, and worshipped, and whether you aresprung from heaven, or from the firmament, or from earth, hear at this (solemnity) my invocation.

mantras.sanskrit: येभ्यो माता मधुमत्पिन्वते पयः पीयूषं द्यौरदितिरद्रिबर्हाः । उक्थशुष्मान्वृषभरान्त्स्वप्नसस्ताँ आदित्याँ अनु मदा स्वस्तये ॥
mantras.transliteration: yebhyo mātā madhumatpinvate payaḥ pīyūṣaṃ dyauraditiradribarhāḥ | ukthaśuṣmānvṛṣabharāntsvapnasastā~ ādityā~ anu madā svastaye ||

translations.english: To (these dieties) to whom the maternal (earth) yields the sweet- flavoured milk, and thecloud-invested, undepressed heaven (yields) ambrosia, to those Ādityas whose strength is sacred praise, whoare bringers of rain, the doers of good actions, offer for your welfare laudation.

mantras.sanskrit: नृचक्षसो अनिमिषन्तो अर्हणा बृहद्देवासो अमृतत्वमानशुः । ज्योतीरथा अहिमाया अनागसो दिवो वर्ष्माणं वसते स्वस्तये ॥
mantras.transliteration: nṛcakṣaso animiṣanto arhaṇā bṛhaddevāso amṛtatvamānaśuḥ | jyotīrathā ahimāyā anāgaso divo varṣmāṇaṃ vasate svastaye ||

translations.english: The gods, the never-slumbering beholders of mankind, and entitled (to their adoration), have obtainedgreat immortality; conveyed in chariots of light, possessed of unsurpassable wisdom, devoid of sin, they inhabitthe exalted station of heaven for the well-being (of the world).

mantras.sanskrit: सम्राजो ये सुवृधो यज्ञमाययुरपरिह्वृता दधिरे दिवि क्षयम् । ताँ आ विवास नमसा सुवृक्तिभिर्महो आदित्याँ अदितिं स्वस्तये ॥
mantras.transliteration: samrājo ye suvṛdho yajñamāyayuraparihvṛtā dadhire divi kṣayam | tā~ ā vivāsa namasā suvṛktibhirmaho ādityā~ aditiṃ svastaye ||

translations.english: The gods, who, kings over all, and most exalted, have come to the sacrifice, who, unassailable, abidein heaven; them, the mighty Ādityas, (the sage) worships with reverence, and with praises, and also Aditi for hiswell- being.

mantras.sanskrit: को वः स्तोमं राधति यं जुजोषथ विश्वे देवासो मनुषो यति ष्ठन । को वोऽध्वरं तुविजाता अरं करद्यो नः पर्षदत्यंहः स्वस्तये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ko vaḥ stomaṃ rādhati yaṃ jujoṣatha viśve devāso manuṣo yati ṣṭhana | ko vo'dhvaraṃ tuvijātā araṃ karadyo naḥ parṣadatyaṃhaḥ svastaye ||

translations.english: Who offers you the praise which you like, you wise universal deities, however many you may be?Deities from whom many are born, who can prepare for you such worship as may bear the safe beyond iniquityfor our well-being?

mantras.sanskrit: येभ्यो होत्रां प्रथमामायेजे मनुः समिद्धाग्निर्मनसा सप्त होतृभिः । त आदित्या अभयं शर्म यच्छत सुगा नः कर्त सुपथा स्वस्तये ॥
mantras.transliteration: yebhyo hotrāṃ prathamāmāyeje manuḥ samiddhāgnirmanasā sapta hotṛbhiḥ | ta ādityā abhayaṃ śarma yacchata sugā naḥ karta supathā svastaye ||

translations.english: Ādityas, to whom, Manu, having kindled the fire, offered the first sacrifice with (reverent) mind,(aided) by the seven ministrant priests, do you bestow upon us prosperity, free from peril; provide for us plural asantpaths easy to travel for our well-being.

mantras.sanskrit: य ईशिरे भुवनस्य प्रचेतसो विश्वस्य स्थातुर्जगतश्च मन्तवः । ते नः कृतादकृतादेनसस्पर्यद्या देवासः पिपृता स्वस्तये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya īśire bhuvanasya pracetaso viśvasya sthāturjagataśca mantavaḥ | te naḥ kṛtādakṛtādenasasparyadyā devāsaḥ pipṛtā svastaye ||

translations.english: May the wise and omniscient deities, who rule over the whole world both stationary and moveable,deliver us today from committed and uncommitted sin, for our well-being.

mantras.sanskrit: भरेष्विन्द्रं सुहवं हवामहेंऽहोमुचं सुकृतं दैव्यं जनम् । अग्निं मित्रं वरुणं सातये भगं द्यावापृथिवी मरुतः स्वस्तये ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhareṣvindraṃ suhavaṃ havāmaheṃ'homucaṃ sukṛtaṃ daivyaṃ janam | agniṃ mitraṃ varuṇaṃ sātaye bhagaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī marutaḥ svastaye ||

translations.english: We call in battles upon the well-invoked Indra, the liberator from sin, and upon the virtuous folk ofheaven, Agni, Mitra, Varuṇa, Bhaga, Heaven and Earth, the Maruts, for the acquisition (of food), for well-being.

mantras.sanskrit: सुत्रामाणं पृथिवीं द्यामनेहसं सुशर्माणमदितिं सुप्रणीतिम् । दैवीं नावं स्वरित्रामनागसमस्रवन्तीमा रुहेमा स्वस्तये ॥
mantras.transliteration: sutrāmāṇaṃ pṛthivīṃ dyāmanehasaṃ suśarmāṇamaditiṃ supraṇītim | daivīṃ nāvaṃ svaritrāmanāgasamasravantīmā ruhemā svastaye ||

translations.english: May we for our well-being ascend the well-oared, defectless, unyielding, divine vessel, thesafe-sheltering expansive heaven, exempt from evil, replete with happiness, exalted and right-directing.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वे यजत्रा अधि वोचतोतये त्रायध्वं नो दुरेवाया अभिह्रुतः । सत्यया वो देवहूत्या हुवेम शृण्वतो देवा अवसे स्वस्तये ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśve yajatrā adhi vocatotaye trāyadhvaṃ no durevāyā abhihrutaḥ | satyayā vo devahūtyā huvema śṛṇvato devā avase svastaye ||

translations.english: Adorable, universal gods, advocate our cause for our protection; preserve us from malignant adversity,may we with since invocation invoke you, gods, who listen (to our praise) for our protection, for our well-being.

mantras.sanskrit: अपामीवामप विश्वामनाहुतिमपारातिं दुर्विदत्रामघायतः । आरे देवा द्वेषो अस्मद्युयोतनोरु णः शर्म यच्छता स्वस्तये ॥
mantras.transliteration: apāmīvāmapa viśvāmanāhutimapārātiṃ durvidatrāmaghāyataḥ | āre devā dveṣo asmadyuyotanoru ṇaḥ śarma yacchatā svastaye ||

translations.english: (Remove far) from us disease, remove all neglect of oblations, remove illiberality, the malevolence ofthose who wish to do us harm; remove far from us, gods, those who hate us; grant us ample happiness for ourwell-being.

mantras.sanskrit: अरिष्टः स मर्तो विश्व एधते प्र प्रजाभिर्जायते धर्मणस्परि । यमादित्यासो नयथा सुनीतिभिरति विश्वानि दुरिता स्वस्तये ॥
mantras.transliteration: ariṣṭaḥ sa marto viśva edhate pra prajābhirjāyate dharmaṇaspari | yamādityāso nayathā sunītibhirati viśvāni duritā svastaye ||

translations.english: Unharmed prospers every mortal, after performing his duties, he flourishes with posterity, whom youĀdityas guide with good counsels safe over all misfortunes to well-being.

mantras.sanskrit: यं देवासोऽवथ वाजसातौ यं शूरसाता मरुतो हिते धने । प्रातर्यावाणं रथमिन्द्र सानसिमरिष्यन्तमा रुहेमा स्वस्तये ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ devāso'vatha vājasātau yaṃ śūrasātā maruto hite dhane | prātaryāvāṇaṃ rathamindra sānasimariṣyantamā ruhemā svastaye ||

translations.english: (The chariot) which, deities, you protect for the supply of food; that which, Maruts, (you protect) inbattle for the sake of the deposited spoil; may we mount, Indra, the early-moving desirable irresistible chariot forour well- being.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वस्ति नः पथ्यासु धन्वसु स्वस्त्यप्सु वृजने स्वर्वति । स्वस्ति नः पुत्रकृथेषु योनिषु स्वस्ति राये मरुतो दधातन ॥
mantras.transliteration: svasti naḥ pathyāsu dhanvasu svastyapsu vṛjane svarvati | svasti naḥ putrakṛtheṣu yoniṣu svasti rāye maruto dadhātana ||

translations.english: Maruts, secure to us well-being on roads, in deserts, well-being in waters, midst the might of assailinghosts; well-being in the son-bearing wombs (of our wives); well-being for (the acquisition of) riches.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वस्तिरिद्धि प्रपथे श्रेष्ठा रेक्णस्वत्यभि या वाममेति । सा नो अमा सो अरणे नि पातु स्वावेशा भवतु देवगोपा ॥
mantras.transliteration: svastiriddhi prapathe śreṣṭhā rekṇasvatyabhi yā vāmameti | sā no amā so araṇe ni pātu svāveśā bhavatu devagopā ||

translations.english: May (pṛthivī), who secures well-being to the excellent path, who, abounding with wealth, goes to thedesirable (plural ce of sacrifice), preserve our home, may she protect us on the path we have to travel; cherished bythe gods, may she be to us a plural asant abode.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा प्लतेः सूनुरवीवृधद्वो विश्व आदित्या अदिते मनीषी । ईशानासो नरो अमर्त्येनास्तावि जनो दिव्यो गयेन ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā plateḥ sūnuravīvṛdhadvo viśva ādityā adite manīṣī | īśānāso naro amartyenāstāvi jano divyo gayena ||

translations.english: Universal deities and Aditi, thus has the prudent son of plural ti magnified you; the celestial people, theimmortal (company of the gods) through whom (when praised) men become the lords (of wealth) have beengloried by Gaya.

mantras.sanskrit: कथा देवानां कतमस्य यामनि सुमन्तु नाम शृण्वतां मनामहे । को मृळाति कतमो नो मयस्करत्कतम ऊती अभ्या ववर्तति ॥
mantras.transliteration: kathā devānāṃ katamasya yāmani sumantu nāma śṛṇvatāṃ manāmahe | ko mṛḷāti katamo no mayaskaratkatama ūtī abhyā vavartati ||

translations.english: In what manner, and of which of the gods, who hear (our praises) at the sacrifice, may we enunciatethe venerable name? Who will show us compassion? Which of them will grant us happiness? Which of themcomes for our protection?

mantras.sanskrit: क्रतूयन्ति क्रतवो हृत्सु धीतयो वेनन्ति वेनाः पतयन्त्या दिशः । न मर्डिता विद्यते अन्य एभ्यो देवेषु मे अधि कामा अयंसत ॥
mantras.transliteration: kratūyanti kratavo hṛtsu dhītayo venanti venāḥ patayantyā diśaḥ | na marḍitā vidyate anya ebhyo deveṣu me adhi kāmā ayaṃsata ||

translations.english: The desires cherished in my heart strive to offer worship; (our) wishes long for (the gods) andexpressed (by us) go forth to (the gods); no other bestower of happiness exists except them; upon the gods aremy desire concentrated.

mantras.sanskrit: नरा वा शंसं पूषणमगोह्यमग्निं देवेद्धमभ्यर्चसे गिरा । सूर्यामासा चन्द्रमसा यमं दिवि त्रितं वातमुषसमक्तुमश्विना ॥
mantras.transliteration: narā vā śaṃsaṃ pūṣaṇamagohyamagniṃ deveddhamabhyarcase girā | sūryāmāsā candramasā yamaṃ divi tritaṃ vātamuṣasamaktumaśvinā ||

translations.english: Adore with praises Nārāśaṃsa and Pūṣan, and the unapproachable Agni kindled by the devoutAśvins.

mantras.sanskrit: कथा कविस्तुवीरवान्कया गिरा बृहस्पतिर्वावृधते सुवृक्तिभिः । अज एकपात्सुहवेभिॠक्वभिरहिः शृणोतु बुध्न्यो हवीमनि ॥
mantras.transliteration: kathā kavistuvīravānkayā girā bṛhaspatirvāvṛdhate suvṛktibhiḥ | aja ekapātsuhavebhiṝkvabhirahiḥ śṛṇotu budhnyo havīmani ||

translations.english: How is the sage(Agni) adored by multitudes, and by what praises? Bṛhaspati is magnified with sacredhymns; Aja, walking alone, is magnified with solemn invocations and prayers; may Ahirbudhnya hear us at theseason of invocation.

mantras.sanskrit: दक्षस्य वादिते जन्मनि व्रते राजाना मित्रावरुणा विवाससि । अतूर्तपन्थाः पुरुरथो अर्यमा सप्तहोता विषुरूपेषु जन्मसु ॥
mantras.transliteration: dakṣasya vādite janmani vrate rājānā mitrāvaruṇā vivāsasi | atūrtapanthāḥ pururatho aryamā saptahotā viṣurūpeṣu janmasu ||

translations.english: At the birth of Dakṣa, at his sacred rite, you, Aditi, worshipped the royal Mitra and Varuṇa at thesacred rite. Aryaman, whose course is not hurried, the giver of delight to many, having seven ministering (rays),(proceeds) in his multiform births.

mantras.sanskrit: ते नो अर्वन्तो हवनश्रुतो हवं विश्वे शृण्वन्तु वाजिनो मितद्रवः । सहस्रसा मेधसाताविव त्मना महो ये धनं समिथेषु जभ्रिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: te no arvanto havanaśruto havaṃ viśve śṛṇvantu vājino mitadravaḥ | sahasrasā medhasātāviva tmanā maho ye dhanaṃ samitheṣu jabhrire ||

translations.english: May those universal horses (of the deities), who listen to invocations, who are vigorous, swiftroadsters, hear our summons; they who spontaneously are the givers of thousands, as if at sacrifice; they whohave won great wealth in battles.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वो वायुं रथयुजं पुरंधिं स्तोमैः कृणुध्वं सख्याय पूषणम् । ते हि देवस्य सवितुः सवीमनि क्रतुं सचन्ते सचितः सचेतसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vo vāyuṃ rathayujaṃ puraṃdhiṃ stomaiḥ kṛṇudhvaṃ sakhyāya pūṣaṇam | te hi devasya savituḥ savīmani kratuṃ sacante sacitaḥ sacetasaḥ ||

translations.english: Importune, (worshippers), with praises, Vāyu, harnessing his chariot, and Purandhi and Pūṣan fortheir friendship, for these considerate and consentient deities, attend the sacrifice upon the birth of Savitā.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिः सप्त सस्रा नद्यो महीरपो वनस्पतीन्पर्वताँ अग्निमूतये । कृशानुमस्तॄन्तिष्यं सधस्थ आ रुद्रं रुद्रेषु रुद्रियं हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: triḥ sapta sasrā nadyo mahīrapo vanaspatīnparvatā~ agnimūtaye | kṛśānumastṝntiṣyaṃ sadhastha ā rudraṃ rudreṣu rudriyaṃ havāmahe ||

translations.english: We invoke for protection the thrice seven flowing rivers, (their) great waters, the trees, the mountains,Agni, Kṛśānu, the archers, and Tiṣya, to the assembly; (we invoke) Rudra, worthy of the praise of the Rudras,for the good of the praisers.

mantras.sanskrit: सरस्वती सरयुः सिन्धुरूर्मिभिर्महो महीरवसा यन्तु वक्षणीः । देवीरापो मातरः सूदयित्न्वो घृतवत्पयो मधुमन्नो अर्चत ॥
mantras.transliteration: sarasvatī sarayuḥ sindhurūrmibhirmaho mahīravasā yantu vakṣaṇīḥ | devīrāpo mātaraḥ sūdayitnvo ghṛtavatpayo madhumanno arcata ||

translations.english: May the very great rivers, Sarasvatī, Sarayu, Sindhu, come with their waves for (our) protection; maythe divine maternal animating waters grant us their water mixed with butter and honey.

mantras.sanskrit: उत माता बृहद्दिवा शृणोतु नस्त्वष्टा देवेभिर्जनिभिः पिता वचः । ऋभुक्षा वाजो रथस्पतिर्भगो रण्वः शंसः शशमानस्य पातु नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta mātā bṛhaddivā śṛṇotu nastvaṣṭā devebhirjanibhiḥ pitā vacaḥ | ṛbhukṣā vājo rathaspatirbhago raṇvaḥ śaṃsaḥ śaśamānasya pātu naḥ ||

translations.english: May the bright shining mother (of the gods) hear us; may father Tvaṣṭā, with the gods, and theirwives, (hear our) words; may Ṛbhukṣan, Vāja, Rathaspati, Bhaga, may the joyous adorable (company of theMaruts) protect us their praisers.

mantras.sanskrit: रण्वः संदृष्टौ पितुमाँ इव क्षयो भद्रा रुद्राणां मरुतामुपस्तुतिः । गोभिः ष्याम यशसो जनेष्वा सदा देवास इळया सचेमहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: raṇvaḥ saṃdṛṣṭau pitumā~ iva kṣayo bhadrā rudrāṇāṃ marutāmupastutiḥ | gobhiḥ ṣyāma yaśaso janeṣvā sadā devāsa iḷayā sacemahi ||

translations.english: plural asant of aspect (is troop of Maruts), like a house well stored with provisions; fortunate is the favourof the Maruts, the sons of Rudra; may we (thereby) be famed among men for cattle, and so, gods, ever approach(you) with sacrificial food.

mantras.sanskrit: यां मे धियं मरुत इन्द्र देवा अददात वरुण मित्र यूयम् । तां पीपयत पयसेव धेनुं कुविद्गिरो अधि रथे वहाथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: yāṃ me dhiyaṃ maruta indra devā adadāta varuṇa mitra yūyam | tāṃ pīpayata payaseva dhenuṃ kuvidgiro adhi rathe vahātha ||

translations.english: Maruts, Indra, gods, Varuṇa and Mitra, reward the worship, which you have given as (men fatten) the(newly-delivered) cow with milk, you have repeatedly put my praises on your car.

mantras.sanskrit: कुविदङ्ग प्रति यथा चिदस्य नः सजात्यस्य मरुतो बुबोधथ । नाभा यत्र प्रथमं संनसामहे तत्र जामित्वमदितिर्दधातु नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kuvidaṅga prati yathā cidasya naḥ sajātyasya maruto bubodhatha | nābhā yatra prathamaṃ saṃnasāmahe tatra jāmitvamaditirdadhātu naḥ ||

translations.english: Maruts, repeatedly acknowledge us, so that (you may make us the objects) of this relationship; andmay Aditi grant us affinity (with men) on the navel of the earth, where we first assemble (to offer oblations).

mantras.sanskrit: ते हि द्यावापृथिवी मातरा मही देवी देवाञ्जन्मना यज्ञिये इतः । उभे बिभृत उभयं भरीमभिः पुरू रेतांसि पितृभिश्च सिञ्चतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te hi dyāvāpṛthivī mātarā mahī devī devāñjanmanā yajñiye itaḥ | ubhe bibhṛta ubhayaṃ bharīmabhiḥ purū retāṃsi pitṛbhiśca siñcataḥ ||

translations.english: They, two, the maternal heaven and earth, mighty, divine, adorable, attain to the gods upon their birth;they both cherish the two (races, human and divine) (gods), they shed abundant moisture.

mantras.sanskrit: वि षा होत्रा विश्वमश्नोति वार्यं बृहस्पतिररमतिः पनीयसी । ग्रावा यत्र मधुषुदुच्यते बृहदवीवशन्त मतिभिर्मनीषिणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi ṣā hotrā viśvamaśnoti vāryaṃ bṛhaspatiraramatiḥ panīyasī | grāvā yatra madhuṣuducyate bṛhadavīvaśanta matibhirmanīṣiṇaḥ ||

translations.english: That voice of invocation, the protectress of the mighty, never ceasing, the panegyrist (of the gods),the pious, by their praises, make the god desirous (of the sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: एवा कविस्तुवीरवाँ ऋतज्ञा द्रविणस्युर्द्रविणसश्चकानः । उक्थेभिरत्र मतिभिश्च विप्रोऽपीपयद्गयो दिव्यानि जन्म ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā kavistuvīravā~ ṛtajñā draviṇasyurdraviṇasaścakānaḥ | ukthebhiratra matibhiśca vipro'pīpayadgayo divyāni janma ||

translations.english: The pious sage, Gaya, eloquent in laudation, conversant with sacred rites, wishing for wealth, eagerfor wealth, propitiates the celestial people with prayers and praises.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा प्लतेः सूनुरवीवृधद्वो विश्व आदित्या अदिते मनीषी । ईशानासो नरो अमर्त्येनास्तावि जनो दिव्यो गयेन ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā plateḥ sūnuravīvṛdhadvo viśva ādityā adite manīṣī | īśānāso naro amartyenāstāvi jano divyo gayena ||

translations.english: Universal deities and Aditi, thus has the prudent son of plural ti magnified you; the celestial people, theimmortal (company of the gods) through whom (when praised) men become the bonds (of wealth), have beenglorified by Gaya.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निरिन्द्रो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा वायुः पूषा सरस्वती सजोषसः । आदित्या विष्णुर्मरुतः स्वर्बृहत्सोमो रुद्रो अदितिर्ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirindro varuṇo mitro aryamā vāyuḥ pūṣā sarasvatī sajoṣasaḥ | ādityā viṣṇurmarutaḥ svarbṛhatsomo rudro aditirbrahmaṇaspatiḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, Inda, Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman, Vāyu, Pūṣan, Sarasvatī, the Ādityas, Viṣṇu, the Maruts,the mighty heaven, Soma, Rudra, Aditi, Brahmaṇaspati with one consent.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी वृत्रहत्येषु सत्पती मिथो हिन्वाना तन्वा समोकसा । अन्तरिक्षं मह्या पप्रुरोजसा सोमो घृतश्रीर्महिमानमीरयन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāgnī vṛtrahatyeṣu satpatī mitho hinvānā tanvā samokasā | antarikṣaṃ mahyā paprurojasā somo ghṛtaśrīrmahimānamīrayan ||

translations.english: Indra, and Agni, the lords of the virtuous, standing in the same plural ce, mutually invigorating each otherwith might in the Vṛtra-slaying battles, and the ghī-glorified Soma putting forth his greatness have filled the vastfirmament with their strength.

mantras.sanskrit: तेषां हि मह्ना महतामनर्वणां स्तोमाँ इयर्म्यृतज्ञा ऋतावृधाम् । ये अप्सवमर्णवं चित्रराधसस्ते नो रासन्तां महये सुमित्र्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: teṣāṃ hi mahnā mahatāmanarvaṇāṃ stomā~ iyarmyṛtajñā ṛtāvṛdhām | ye apsavamarṇavaṃ citrarādhasaste no rāsantāṃ mahaye sumitryāḥ ||

translations.english: Skilled in pious rites, I recite the praises of these (deities), mighty through (their own) might,unassailable, exalted by sacrifice; may those (gods) who possessed of various wealth, (rain down) the beautifulwater-cloud, acting in friendly wise, grant us (wealth) for our honour (among men).

mantras.sanskrit: स्वर्णरमन्तरिक्षाणि रोचना द्यावाभूमी पृथिवीं स्कम्भुरोजसा । पृक्षा इव महयन्तः सुरातयो देवाः स्तवन्ते मनुषाय सूरयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: svarṇaramantarikṣāṇi rocanā dyāvābhūmī pṛthivīṃ skambhurojasā | pṛkṣā iva mahayantaḥ surātayo devāḥ stavante manuṣāya sūrayaḥ ||

translations.english: They have sustained by their strength the leader of all (the sun), the luminaries of the firmament,heaven and earth, the outstretched (firmament), honouring (their worshippers) like those who give food (to thepoor), the genitive rous gods bestowing wealth on man are glorified (at this sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: मित्राय शिक्ष वरुणाय दाशुषे या सम्राजा मनसा न प्रयुच्छतः । ययोर्धाम धर्मणा रोचते बृहद्ययोरुभे रोदसी नाधसी वृतौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: mitrāya śikṣa varuṇāya dāśuṣe yā samrājā manasā na prayucchataḥ | yayordhāma dharmaṇā rocate bṛhadyayorubhe rodasī nādhasī vṛtau ||

translations.english: Worship the liberal Mitra and Varuṇa, the two royal deities who are never negligent in their thoughts,whose vast body is resplendent through their functions, upon whom the two solicitous worlds (heaven and earth)remain (dependent).

mantras.sanskrit: या गौर्वर्तनिं पर्येति निष्कृतं पयो दुहाना व्रतनीरवारतः । सा प्रब्रुवाणा वरुणाय दाशुषे देवेभ्यो दाशद्धविषा विवस्वते ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā gaurvartaniṃ paryeti niṣkṛtaṃ payo duhānā vratanīravārataḥ | sā prabruvāṇā varuṇāya dāśuṣe devebhyo dāśaddhaviṣā vivasvate ||

translations.english: May that cow, the leader of the rite, which yielding her milk proceeds uncalled to the consecratedplace (of sacrifice), may she, propitiated by me, yield her milk to (me), the offerer of oblations to liberal Varuṇaand the (other) gods.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवक्षसो अग्निजिह्वा ऋतावृध ऋतस्य योनिं विमृशन्त आसते । द्यां स्कभित्व्यप आ चक्रुरोजसा यज्ञं जनित्वी तन्वी नि मामृजुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: divakṣaso agnijihvā ṛtāvṛdha ṛtasya yoniṃ vimṛśanta āsate | dyāṃ skabhitvyapa ā cakrurojasā yajñaṃ janitvī tanvī ni māmṛjuḥ ||

translations.english: Pervading heaven (with their radiance), having Agni as their tongue, the augmenters of sacrifice,(these deities) sit contemplating the plural ce of sacrifice; sustaining heaven they have produced the waters by theirpower; having genitive rated sacrifice, they have decorated their person ns (with it).

mantras.sanskrit: परिक्षिता पितरा पूर्वजावरी ऋतस्य योना क्षयतः समोकसा । द्यावापृथिवी वरुणाय सव्रते घृतवत्पयो महिषाय पिन्वतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: parikṣitā pitarā pūrvajāvarī ṛtasya yonā kṣayataḥ samokasā | dyāvāpṛthivī varuṇāya savrate ghṛtavatpayo mahiṣāya pinvataḥ ||

translations.english: The encompassing parents (heaven and earth), born of old, having a common dwelling, sit down uponthe plural ce of sacrifice; engaged in a common observance they sprinkle upon the adorable Varuṇa water mixedwith butter.

mantras.sanskrit: पर्जन्यावाता वृषभा पुरीषिणेन्द्रवायू वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । देवाँ आदित्याँ अदितिं हवामहे ये पार्थिवासो दिव्यासो अप्सु ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: parjanyāvātā vṛṣabhā purīṣiṇendravāyū varuṇo mitro aryamā | devā~ ādityā~ aditiṃ havāmahe ye pārthivāso divyāso apsu ye ||

translations.english: The two showerers (of desires), Parjanya and Vāta, the two senders of water, Indra and Vāyu,Varuṇa,m Mitra, Aryaman; we invoke the divine Ādityas, Aditi, and the gods, who dwell on the earth, or inheaven, or in the waters.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वष्टारं वायुमृभवो य ओहते दैव्या होतारा उषसं स्वस्तये । बृहस्पतिं वृत्रखादं सुमेधसमिन्द्रियं सोमं धनसा उ ईमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṣṭāraṃ vāyumṛbhavo ya ohate daivyā hotārā uṣasaṃ svastaye | bṛhaspatiṃ vṛtrakhādaṃ sumedhasamindriyaṃ somaṃ dhanasā u īmahe ||

translations.english: Desirous of wealth, we solicit that Soma, the fried of Indra, who for your welfare, Ṛbhus, brings(hither) Tvaṣṭā,Vāyu, the two divine sacrificers (the Aśvins), Dawn, Bṛhaspati, and the wise slayer of Vṛtra.

mantras.sanskrit: ब्रह्म गामश्वं जनयन्त ओषधीर्वनस्पतीन्पृथिवीं पर्वताँ अपः । सूर्यं दिवि रोहयन्तः सुदानव आर्या व्रता विसृजन्तो अधि क्षमि ॥
mantras.transliteration: brahma gāmaśvaṃ janayanta oṣadhīrvanaspatīnpṛthivīṃ parvatā~ apaḥ | sūryaṃ divi rohayantaḥ sudānava āryā vratā visṛjanto adhi kṣami ||

translations.english: genitive rating food, cows, horses, plural nts, trees, the earth, mountains and waters, elevating the sun inheaven, munificent, promoting sacred observances upon the earth, (they abide everywhere).

mantras.sanskrit: भुज्युमंहसः पिपृथो निरश्विना श्यावं पुत्रं वध्रिमत्या अजिन्वतम् । कमद्युवं विमदायोहथुर्युवं विष्णाप्वं विश्वकायाव सृजथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhujyumaṃhasaḥ pipṛtho niraśvinā śyāvaṃ putraṃ vadhrimatyā ajinvatam | kamadyuvaṃ vimadāyohathuryuvaṃ viṣṇāpvaṃ viśvakāyāva sṛjathaḥ ||

translations.english: You, Aśvins, extricated Bhujyu from calamity, you gave to Vadhrimatī her son Śyāva; you gaveKamadyu (as a wife) to Vimada; you restored (the lost) Viṣṇāpu to Viśvaka.

mantras.sanskrit: पावीरवी तन्यतुरेकपादजो दिवो धर्ता सिन्धुरापः समुद्रियः । विश्वे देवासः शृणवन्वचांसि मे सरस्वती सह धीभिः पुरंध्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: pāvīravī tanyaturekapādajo divo dhartā sindhurāpaḥ samudriyaḥ | viśve devāsaḥ śṛṇavanvacāṃsi me sarasvatī saha dhībhiḥ puraṃdhyā ||

translations.english: May the armed and thundering (voice of mid-heaven), the upholder of heaven, Aja Ekapād, theocean, the waters of the firmament, the universal gods and Sarasvatī, accompanied by sacred rites, andabundant wisdom, hear my words.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वे देवाः सह धीभिः पुरंध्या मनोर्यजत्रा अमृता ऋतज्ञाः । रातिषाचो अभिषाचः स्वर्विदः स्वर्गिरो ब्रह्म सूक्तं जुषेरत ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśve devāḥ saha dhībhiḥ puraṃdhyā manoryajatrā amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ | rātiṣāco abhiṣācaḥ svarvidaḥ svargiro brahma sūktaṃ juṣerata ||

translations.english: May the universal gods, accompanied by sacred rites and abundant wisdom, adorable (at thesacrifice) of men, immortal, the knowers of truth, waiting on the oblation to be given, arriving together (at thesacrifice), omniscient, graciously accept all our praises and abundant food with well-sung hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: देवान्वसिष्ठो अमृतान्ववन्दे ये विश्वा भुवनाभि प्रतस्थुः । ते नो रासन्तामुरुगायमद्य यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: devānvasiṣṭho amṛtānvavande ye viśvā bhuvanābhi pratasthuḥ | te no rāsantāmurugāyamadya yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: (Descendant of) Vasiṣṭha, I have glorified the immortal gods who preside over all worlds; may theythis day bestow upon us widely-famed food; do you always cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: देवान्हुवे बृहच्छ्रवसः स्वस्तये ज्योतिष्कृतो अध्वरस्य प्रचेतसः । ये वावृधुः प्रतरं विश्ववेदस इन्द्रज्येष्ठासो अमृता ऋतावृधः ॥
mantras.transliteration: devānhuve bṛhacchravasaḥ svastaye jyotiṣkṛto adhvarasya pracetasaḥ | ye vāvṛdhuḥ prataraṃ viśvavedasa indrajyeṣṭhāso amṛtā ṛtāvṛdhaḥ ||

translations.english: I invoke for the success of the sacrifice the gods, who bestow abundant food, the diffusers of light, theextremely wise who flourish mightily, abounding in all riches, having Indra as their chief, immortal, augmented bysacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रप्रसूता वरुणप्रशिष्टा ये सूर्यस्य ज्योतिषो भागमानशुः । मरुद्गणे वृजने मन्म धीमहि माघोने यज्ञं जनयन्त सूरयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraprasūtā varuṇapraśiṣṭā ye sūryasya jyotiṣo bhāgamānaśuḥ | marudgaṇe vṛjane manma dhīmahi māghone yajñaṃ janayanta sūrayaḥ ||

translations.english: We offer praise to the company of the Maruts, the attendants upon Maghavan, who, encouraged byIndra, and instrumental ucted by Varuṇa, have acquired a portion of the light of the sun; the wise worshippers beget thesacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रो वसुभिः परि पातु नो गयमादित्यैर्नो अदितिः शर्म यच्छतु । रुद्रो रुद्रेभिर्देवो मृळयाति नस्त्वष्टा नो ग्नाभिः सुविताय जिन्वतु ॥
mantras.transliteration: indro vasubhiḥ pari pātu no gayamādityairno aditiḥ śarma yacchatu | rudro rudrebhirdevo mṛḷayāti nastvaṣṭā no gnābhiḥ suvitāya jinvatu ||

translations.english: May Indra with the Vasus guard our dwelling; may Aditi with the Ādityas grant us felicity; may thedivine Rudra with the Rudras make us happy;may Tvaṣṭā with the wives of the gods be favourable to us forour prosperity.

mantras.sanskrit: अदितिर्द्यावापृथिवी ऋतं महदिन्द्राविष्णू मरुतः स्वर्बृहत् । देवाँ आदित्याँ अवसे हवामहे वसून्रुद्रान्त्सवितारं सुदंससम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: aditirdyāvāpṛthivī ṛtaṃ mahadindrāviṣṇū marutaḥ svarbṛhat | devā~ ādityā~ avase havāmahe vasūnrudrāntsavitāraṃ sudaṃsasam ||

translations.english: Aditi, heaven and earth, the mighty Truth (Agni), Indra, Viṣṇu, the Maruts, the great sun-- (these) weinvoke for our protection, as well as the divine Ādityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, and Savitā, the accomplisher ofgood works.

mantras.sanskrit: सरस्वान्धीभिर्वरुणो धृतव्रतः पूषा विष्णुर्महिमा वायुरश्विना । ब्रह्मकृतो अमृता विश्ववेदसः शर्म नो यंसन्त्रिवरूथमंहसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sarasvāndhībhirvaruṇo dhṛtavrataḥ pūṣā viṣṇurmahimā vāyuraśvinā | brahmakṛto amṛtā viśvavedasaḥ śarma no yaṃsantrivarūthamaṃhasaḥ ||

translations.english: May Sarasvatī, (endowed) with intelligences, Varuṇa the observer of oblations, Pūṣan, Viṣṇu, themighty Vāyu, the Aśvins, (may these) the bestowers of food upon worshippers, immortal, the possessors of allwealth, grant us a habitation triply-guarded from evil.

mantras.sanskrit: वृषा यज्ञो वृषणः सन्तु यज्ञिया वृषणो देवा वृषणो हविष्कृतः । वृषणा द्यावापृथिवी ऋतावरी वृषा पर्जन्यो वृषणो वृषस्तुभः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣā yajño vṛṣaṇaḥ santu yajñiyā vṛṣaṇo devā vṛṣaṇo haviṣkṛtaḥ | vṛṣaṇā dyāvāpṛthivī ṛtāvarī vṛṣā parjanyo vṛṣaṇo vṛṣastubhaḥ ||

translations.english: May our sacrifice be the showerer (of benefits); may the gods who are worthy of sacrifice be theshowerers (of benefits); may the priest, may the presenters of the oblation, be the showerers (of benefits); mayheaven and earth receiving adoration be the showerers (of benefits); may Parjanya be the showerer (of rain);may those who praise (the gods) with showers be showerers.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्नीषोमा वृषणा वाजसातये पुरुप्रशस्ता वृषणा उप ब्रुवे । यावीजिरे वृषणो देवयज्यया ता नः शर्म त्रिवरूथं वि यंसतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnīṣomā vṛṣaṇā vājasātaye purupraśastā vṛṣaṇā upa bruve | yāvījire vṛṣaṇo devayajyayā tā naḥ śarma trivarūthaṃ vi yaṃsataḥ ||

translations.english: I glorify for the obtaining of food the two showerers (of benefits), Agni and Soma, the many-laudedshowerers (of benefits), may these two whom the priests have worshipped with divine worship bestow upon us atriply-guarded dwelling.

mantras.sanskrit: धृतव्रताः क्षत्रिया यज्ञनिष्कृतो बृहद्दिवा अध्वराणामभिश्रियः । अग्निहोतार ऋतसापो अद्रुहोऽपो असृजन्ननु वृत्रतूर्ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhṛtavratāḥ kṣatriyā yajñaniṣkṛto bṛhaddivā adhvarāṇāmabhiśriyaḥ | agnihotāra ṛtasāpo adruho'po asṛjannanu vṛtratūrye ||

translations.english: The (gods) observing obligations endowed with vigour, developers of sacrifice, possessed ofabundant brightness, the defenders of sacrifices, having Agni for their priest, enjoying truth, unassailable, setfree the waters at the combat with the Vṛtra.

mantras.sanskrit: द्यावापृथिवी जनयन्नभि व्रताप ओषधीर्वनिनानि यज्ञिया । अन्तरिक्षं स्वरा पप्रुरूतये वशं देवासस्तन्वी नि मामृजुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dyāvāpṛthivī janayannabhi vratāpa oṣadhīrvanināni yajñiyā | antarikṣaṃ svarā paprurūtaye vaśaṃ devāsastanvī ni māmṛjuḥ ||

translations.english: The gods engendered the heaven and earth with their respective functions, the waters, the plural nts, thesacred trees; they filled the whole firmament (with lustre) for its protection; they graced the desirable (sacrifice) intheir own person ns.

mantras.sanskrit: धर्तारो दिव ऋभवः सुहस्ता वातापर्जन्या महिषस्य तन्यतोः । आप ओषधीः प्र तिरन्तु नो गिरो भगो रातिर्वाजिनो यन्तु मे हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhartāro diva ṛbhavaḥ suhastā vātāparjanyā mahiṣasya tanyatoḥ | āpa oṣadhīḥ pra tirantu no giro bhago rātirvājino yantu me havam ||

translations.english: May the upholders of the sky, the radiant with truth, the well-armed deities, Vāta and Parjanya, (theutterers) of the mighty thunder, the waters, the plural nts, amplify our praises; may the liberal Bhaga and Vājinscome to my invocation.

mantras.sanskrit: समुद्रः सिन्धू रजो अन्तरिक्षमज एकपात्तनयित्नुरर्णवः । अहिर्बुध्न्यः शृणवद्वचांसि मे विश्वे देवास उत सूरयो मम ॥
mantras.transliteration: samudraḥ sindhū rajo antarikṣamaja ekapāttanayitnurarṇavaḥ | ahirbudhnyaḥ śṛṇavadvacāṃsi me viśve devāsa uta sūrayo mama ||

translations.english: May the flowing Sindhu, the atmosphere, the firmament, Aja Ekapād, the rain-bearing thunder-cloud,and Ahirbudhnya hear my words; may the wise universal gods (listen to) my (praises).

mantras.sanskrit: स्याम वो मनवो देववीतये प्राञ्चं नो यज्ञं प्र णयत साधुया । आदित्या रुद्रा वसवः सुदानव इमा ब्रह्म शस्यमानानि जिन्वत ॥
mantras.transliteration: syāma vo manavo devavītaye prāñcaṃ no yajñaṃ pra ṇayata sādhuyā | ādityā rudrā vasavaḥ sudānava imā brahma śasyamānāni jinvata ||

translations.english: May we men be (diligent in providing) for your food, (O gods); conduct our ancient sacrifice to asuccessful end, Ādityas, Rudras, and genitive rous Vasus, graciously accept these hymns which are being recited.

mantras.sanskrit: दैव्या होतारा प्रथमा पुरोहित ऋतस्य पन्थामन्वेमि साधुया । क्षेत्रस्य पतिं प्रतिवेशमीमहे विश्वान्देवाँ अमृताँ अप्रयुच्छतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: daivyā hotārā prathamā purohita ṛtasya panthāmanvemi sādhuyā | kṣetrasya patiṃ prativeśamīmahe viśvāndevā~ amṛtā~ aprayucchataḥ ||

translations.english: I follow the two chief priests the divine offerers of burnt sacrifices, (I follow) successfully the path ofsacrifice; we solicit (wealth of) the contiguous lord of the field, and the immortal and not unheeding universaldeities.

mantras.sanskrit: वसिष्ठासः पितृवद्वाचमक्रत देवाँ ईळाना ऋषिवत्स्वस्तये । प्रीता इव ज्ञातयः काममेत्यास्मे देवासोऽव धूनुता वसु ॥
mantras.transliteration: vasiṣṭhāsaḥ pitṛvadvācamakrata devā~ īḷānā ṛṣivatsvastaye | prītā iva jñātayaḥ kāmametyāsme devāso'va dhūnutā vasu ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: देवान्वसिष्ठो अमृतान्ववन्दे ये विश्वा भुवनाभि प्रतस्थुः । ते नो रासन्तामुरुगायमद्य यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: devānvasiṣṭho amṛtānvavande ye viśvā bhuvanābhi pratasthuḥ | te no rāsantāmurugāyamadya yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: (Descendant of) Vasiṣṭha, I have glorified the immortal gods who preside over all the worlds; maythey this day bestow upon us widely-famed food; do you always cherish us with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: इमां धियं सप्तशीर्ष्णीं पिता न ऋतप्रजातां बृहतीमविन्दत् । तुरीयं स्विज्जनयद्विश्वजन्योऽयास्य उक्थमिन्द्राय शंसन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: imāṃ dhiyaṃ saptaśīrṣṇīṃ pitā na ṛtaprajātāṃ bṛhatīmavindat | turīyaṃ svijjanayadviśvajanyo'yāsya ukthamindrāya śaṃsan ||

translations.english: This great seven-headed ceremony, born of truth our father (Aṅgirasa) discovered; Ayāsya, thefrined of all races, engendered the fourth (genitive ration), reciting a hymn to Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतं शंसन्त ऋजु दीध्याना दिवस्पुत्रासो असुरस्य वीराः । विप्रं पदमङ्गिरसो दधाना यज्ञस्य धाम प्रथमं मनन्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtaṃ śaṃsanta ṛju dīdhyānā divasputrāso asurasya vīrāḥ | vipraṃ padamaṅgiraso dadhānā yajñasya dhāma prathamaṃ mananta ||

translations.english: Reciting sincere praise, reflecting correctly, the Aṅgirasas, the pious sons of the brilliant and powerful(Agni), upholding the intelligent base, the supporter of the sacrifice, praise from the beginning.

mantras.sanskrit: हंसैरिव सखिभिर्वावदद्भिरश्मन्मयानि नहना व्यस्यन् । बृहस्पतिरभिकनिक्रदद्गा उत प्रास्तौदुच्च विद्वाँ अगायत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: haṃsairiva sakhibhirvāvadadbhiraśmanmayāni nahanā vyasyan | bṛhaspatirabhikanikradadgā uta prāstauducca vidvā~ agāyat ||

translations.english: With his friends (the Maruts) clamouring like geese, throwing open the (asuras') cattle-folds made ofstone, Bṛhaspati calling aloud (desires to carry off) the cows; knowing all things he praises (the gods) andchants (their laudation).

mantras.sanskrit: अवो द्वाभ्यां पर एकया गा गुहा तिष्ठन्तीरनृतस्य सेतौ । बृहस्पतिस्तमसि ज्योतिरिच्छन्नुदुस्रा आकर्वि हि तिस्र आवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: avo dvābhyāṃ para ekayā gā guhā tiṣṭhantīranṛtasya setau | bṛhaspatistamasi jyotiricchannudusrā ākarvi hi tisra āvaḥ ||

translations.english: Bṛhaspati purposing to bring light into the darkness drove out the cows standing in the cave in theplace of darkness below by two (ways), and those above by one (way); he opened the three (doors of the

mantras.sanskrit: विभिद्या पुरं शयथेमपाचीं निस्त्रीणि साकमुदधेरकृन्तत् । बृहस्पतिरुषसं सूर्यं गामर्कं विवेद स्तनयन्निव द्यौः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vibhidyā puraṃ śayathemapācīṃ nistrīṇi sākamudadherakṛntat | bṛhaspatiruṣasaṃ sūryaṃ gāmarkaṃ viveda stanayanniva dyauḥ ||

translations.english: Resting near it, demolishing the western city, Bṛhaspati wrested at once from Vala the three, thedawn, the sun, the cow; thundering like the heaven, he proclaimed the adorable (Sun).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रो वलं रक्षितारं दुघानां करेणेव वि चकर्ता रवेण । स्वेदाञ्जिभिराशिरमिच्छमानोऽरोदयत्पणिमा गा अमुष्णात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indro valaṃ rakṣitāraṃ dughānāṃ kareṇeva vi cakartā raveṇa | svedāñjibhirāśiramicchamāno'rodayatpaṇimā gā amuṣṇāt ||

translations.english: Indra with his voice as with an (armed) hand clove Vala the defender of hte kine; desirous of themixture (of milk and Soma) he with (the Maruts)k, who were shining with person iration, destroyed Paṇi andliberated the cows.

mantras.sanskrit: स ईं सत्येभिः सखिभिः शुचद्भिर्गोधायसं वि धनसैरदर्दः । ब्रह्मणस्पतिर्वृषभिर्वराहैर्घर्मस्वेदेभिर्द्रविणं व्यानट् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa īṃ satyebhiḥ sakhibhiḥ śucadbhirgodhāyasaṃ vi dhanasairadardaḥ | brahmaṇaspatirvṛṣabhirvarāhairgharmasvedebhirdraviṇaṃ vyānaṭ ||

translations.english: Together with his true brilliant wealth-winning friendly (Maruts) he destroyed the detainer of the cows;Brahmaṇaspati, with the showerers (of benefits), the conveyers of desirable (water), the frequenters of sacrifice,acquired wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: ते सत्येन मनसा गोपतिं गा इयानास इषणयन्त धीभिः । बृहस्पतिर्मिथोअवद्यपेभिरुदुस्रिया असृजत स्वयुग्भिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te satyena manasā gopatiṃ gā iyānāsa iṣaṇayanta dhībhiḥ | bṛhaspatirmithoavadyapebhirudusriyā asṛjata svayugbhiḥ ||

translations.english: They with truthful mind searching for the cows resolved by their exploits to make him the lord of cattle;Bṛhaspati with his self-yoked (allied) mutually defending each other from reproach, set free the kind.

mantras.sanskrit: तं वर्धयन्तो मतिभिः शिवाभिः सिंहमिव नानदतं सधस्थे । बृहस्पतिं वृषणं शूरसातौ भरेभरे अनु मदेम जिष्णुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ vardhayanto matibhiḥ śivābhiḥ siṃhamiva nānadataṃ sadhasthe | bṛhaspatiṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ śūrasātau bharebhare anu madema jiṣṇum ||

translations.english: Magnifying the victorious Bṛhaspati, the showerer (of benefits), roaring in mid-heaven like a lion, letus praise him in the conflicts where heroes win, with auspicious praises.

mantras.sanskrit: यदा वाजमसनद्विश्वरूपमा द्यामरुक्षदुत्तराणि सद्म । बृहस्पतिं वृषणं वर्धयन्तो नाना सन्तो बिभ्रतो ज्योतिरासा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadā vājamasanadviśvarūpamā dyāmarukṣaduttarāṇi sadma | bṛhaspatiṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vardhayanto nānā santo bibhrato jyotirāsā ||

translations.english: When he acquires food of various kinds, when he ascends the sky or the northern stations, (the godsare) extolling Bṛhaspati, the showerer (of benefits), with their mouth, being in various (quarters), bearing light.

mantras.sanskrit: सत्यामाशिषं कृणुता वयोधै कीरिं चिद्ध्यवथ स्वेभिरेवैः । पश्चा मृधो अप भवन्तु विश्वास्तद्रोदसी शृणुतं विश्वमिन्वे ॥
mantras.transliteration: satyāmāśiṣaṃ kṛṇutā vayodhai kīriṃ ciddhyavatha svebhirevaiḥ | paścā mṛdho apa bhavantu viśvāstadrodasī śṛṇutaṃ viśvaminve ||

translations.english: Make good our prayer for the bestowal of food; you protect through your movements even (me) yourprayer).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रो मह्ना महतो अर्णवस्य वि मूर्धानमभिनदर्बुदस्य । अहन्नहिमरिणात्सप्त सिन्धून्देवैर्द्यावापृथिवी प्रावतं नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indro mahnā mahato arṇavasya vi mūrdhānamabhinadarbudasya | ahannahimariṇātsapta sindhūndevairdyāvāpṛthivī prāvataṃ naḥ ||

translations.english: Indra by his might has cleft the brow of the vast watery cloud, he has slain Ahi; he has made the sevenrivers flow; do you, heaven and earth, along with the gods, protect us.

mantras.sanskrit: उदप्रुतो न वयो रक्षमाणा वावदतो अभ्रियस्येव घोषाः । गिरिभ्रजो नोर्मयो मदन्तो बृहस्पतिमभ्यर्का अनावन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: udapruto na vayo rakṣamāṇā vāvadato abhriyasyeva ghoṣāḥ | giribhrajo normayo madanto bṛhaspatimabhyarkā anāvan ||

translations.english: Like birds swimming in water when keeping watch, like the sound of the roaring thunder-cloud, likesounding torrents falling from the clouds, the worshippers glorify Bṛhaspati.

mantras.sanskrit: सं गोभिराङ्गिरसो नक्षमाणो भग इवेदर्यमणं निनाय । जने मित्रो न दम्पती अनक्ति बृहस्पते वाजयाशूँरिवाजौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ gobhirāṅgiraso nakṣamāṇo bhaga ivedaryamaṇaṃ nināya | jane mitro na dampatī anakti bṛhaspate vājayāśū~rivājau ||

translations.english: The son of Aṅgirasa pervading him with his brightness has, like Bhaga, brought Aryaman to the cows;as Mitra (unites his radiance) with the people, so has he united husband and wife; Bṛhaspati, send (yourwide-spread rays to your worshippers) as (a warrior sends his) horses to battle.

mantras.sanskrit: साध्वर्या अतिथिनीरिषिरा स्पार्हाः सुवर्णा अनवद्यरूपाः । बृहस्पतिः पर्वतेभ्यो वितूर्या निर्गा ऊपे यवमिव स्थिविभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sādhvaryā atithinīriṣirā spārhāḥ suvarṇā anavadyarūpāḥ | bṛhaspatiḥ parvatebhyo vitūryā nirgā ūpe yavamiva sthivibhyaḥ ||

translations.english: Bṛhaspati brings unto (the gods), after extricating them from the mountains, the cows that are theyielders of pure (milk), ever in motion, the objects of search and of desire, well-coloured and of unexceptionableform, (as men bring) barley from the granaries.

mantras.sanskrit: आप्रुषायन्मधुन ऋतस्य योनिमवक्षिपन्नर्क उल्कामिव द्योः । बृहस्पतिरुद्धरन्नश्मनो गा भूम्या उद्नेव वि त्वचं बिभेद ॥
mantras.transliteration: āpruṣāyanmadhuna ṛtasya yonimavakṣipannarka ulkāmiva dyoḥ | bṛhaspatiruddharannaśmano gā bhūmyā udneva vi tvacaṃ bibheda ||

translations.english: Saturating (the earth) with water, scattering the receptacle of rain, the adorable Bṛhaspati, raising upthe cattle from the rock as (he raises) a meteor from the sky, rent the skin of the earth (with the hoofs of thecattle) as (Parjanya rends it) with rain.

mantras.sanskrit: अप ज्योतिषा तमो अन्तरिक्षादुद्नः शीपालमिव वात आजत् । बृहस्पतिरनुमृश्या वलस्याभ्रमिव वात आ चक्र आ गाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: apa jyotiṣā tamo antarikṣādudnaḥ śīpālamiva vāta ājat | bṛhaspatiranumṛśyā valasyābhramiva vāta ā cakra ā gāḥ ||

translations.english: Bṛhaspati drove away the darkness from the firmament with light as the wind (blows) the Śīpālafrom the water; guessing (them to be there), he swept the Vala's cows together to himself as the wind (sweeps)the clouds.

mantras.sanskrit: यदा वलस्य पीयतो जसुं भेद्बृहस्पतिरग्नितपोभिरर्कैः । दद्भिर्न जिह्वा परिविष्टमाददाविर्निधीँरकृणोदुस्रियाणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadā valasya pīyato jasuṃ bhedbṛhaspatiragnitapobhirarkaiḥ | dadbhirna jihvā pariviṣṭamādadāvirnidhī~rakṛṇodusriyāṇām ||

translations.english: When Bṛhaspati demolished with rays burning like fire the weapon of the malignant Vala, he devouredhim (encompassed by his followers) as the tongue (consumes) that which is encompassed by the teeth; he mademanifest the hiding- plural ce of the kine.

mantras.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिरमत हि त्यदासां नाम स्वरीणां सदने गुहा यत् । आण्डेव भित्त्वा शकुनस्य गर्भमुदुस्रियाः पर्वतस्य त्मनाजत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhaspatiramata hi tyadāsāṃ nāma svarīṇāṃ sadane guhā yat | āṇḍeva bhittvā śakunasya garbhamudusriyāḥ parvatasya tmanājat ||

translations.english: When Bṛhaspati had discovered that name of the lowing kine in their plural ce in the cave, by his ownstrength he extricated the cattle from the rock as (breaking) the eggs of a bird (one extricates) the embryo.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्नापिनद्धं मधु पर्यपश्यन्मत्स्यं न दीन उदनि क्षियन्तम् । निष्टज्जभार चमसं न वृक्षाद्बृहस्पतिर्विरवेणा विकृत्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśnāpinaddhaṃ madhu paryapaśyanmatsyaṃ na dīna udani kṣiyantam | niṣṭajjabhāra camasaṃ na vṛkṣādbṛhaspatirviraveṇā vikṛtya ||

translations.english: Bṛhaspati looked round upon the cows shut up in the cave like fish in a dried up pool; he seized Valawith a shout, cutting him off like a bowl from a tree.

mantras.sanskrit: सोषामविन्दत्स स्वः सो अग्निं सो अर्केण वि बबाधे तमांसि । बृहस्पतिर्गोवपुषो वलस्य निर्मज्जानं न पर्वणो जभार ॥
mantras.transliteration: soṣāmavindatsa svaḥ so agniṃ so arkeṇa vi babādhe tamāṃsi | bṛhaspatirgovapuṣo valasya nirmajjānaṃ na parvaṇo jabhāra ||

translations.english: Bṛhaspati found the dawn, the sun, Agni; he dispersed the gloom with light; he seized (the cattle fromthe rock)) of Vala surrounded by the kine as (one extracts) marrow from a bone.

mantras.sanskrit: हिमेव पर्णा मुषिता वनानि बृहस्पतिनाकृपयद्वलो गाः । अनानुकृत्यमपुनश्चकार यात्सूर्यामासा मिथ उच्चरातः ॥
mantras.transliteration: himeva parṇā muṣitā vanāni bṛhaspatinākṛpayadvalo gāḥ | anānukṛtyamapunaścakāra yātsūryāmāsā mitha uccarātaḥ ||

translations.english: As the trees (bemoan) their leaves carried off by the winter, so Vala bemoaned his kine (carried off) byBṛhaspati; he did that which cannot be imitated, which cannot be repeated, whereby sun and moon mutually rise(day and night).

mantras.sanskrit: अभि श्यावं न कृशनेभिरश्वं नक्षत्रेभिः पितरो द्यामपिंशन् । रात्र्यां तमो अदधुर्ज्योतिरहन्बृहस्पतिर्भिनदद्रिं विदद्गाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi śyāvaṃ na kṛśanebhiraśvaṃ nakṣatrebhiḥ pitaro dyāmapiṃśan | rātryāṃ tamo adadhurjyotirahanbṛhaspatirbhinadadriṃ vidadgāḥ ||

translations.english: The protecting (deities) have decorated the heaven with constellations as (men decorate) a brownhorse with golden trappings; they established darkness in the night and light in the day; Bṛhaspati fractured therock and recovered the cows.

mantras.sanskrit: इदमकर्म नमो अभ्रियाय यः पूर्वीरन्वानोनवीति । बृहस्पतिः स हि गोभिः सो अश्वैः स वीरेभिः स नृभिर्नो वयो धात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: idamakarma namo abhriyāya yaḥ pūrvīranvānonavīti | bṛhaspatiḥ sa hi gobhiḥ so aśvaiḥ sa vīrebhiḥ sa nṛbhirno vayo dhāt ||

translations.english: We have offered this homage to Bṛhaspati, who lives in mid-heaven, who recites in order many(sacred stanzas); may he bestow upon us food, with cows, with horses, with son, with dependants.

mantras.sanskrit: भद्रा अग्नेर्वध्र्यश्वस्य संदृशो वामी प्रणीतिः सुरणा उपेतयः । यदीं सुमित्रा विशो अग्र इन्धते घृतेनाहुतो जरते दविद्युतत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhadrā agnervadhryaśvasya saṃdṛśo vāmī praṇītiḥ suraṇā upetayaḥ | yadīṃ sumitrā viśo agra indhate ghṛtenāhuto jarate davidyutat ||

translations.english: May Agni's regards be benevolent to Vadhryaśva; may his guidance be auspicious, his approaches(to the sacrifice) favourable; when the Sumitra people first kindled Agni, then fed with butter and brilliantly blazinghe is glorified.

mantras.sanskrit: घृतमग्नेर्वध्र्यश्वस्य वर्धनं घृतमन्नं घृतम्वस्य मेदनम् । घृतेनाहुत उर्विया वि पप्रथे सूर्य इव रोचते सर्पिरासुतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ghṛtamagnervadhryaśvasya vardhanaṃ ghṛtamannaṃ ghṛtamvasya medanam | ghṛtenāhuta urviyā vi paprathe sūrya iva rocate sarpirāsutiḥ ||

translations.english: May ghī be the augmenter of the Agni of Vadhryaśva; may ghī be his food; may ghī be hisnutriment; sacrified to with ghī he expands exceedingly; he shines like the sun, when the clarified butter ispoured out for him.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्ते मनुर्यदनीकं सुमित्रः समीधे अग्ने तदिदं नवीयः । स रेवच्छोच स गिरो जुषस्व स वाजं दर्षि स इह श्रवो धाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatte manuryadanīkaṃ sumitraḥ samīdhe agne tadidaṃ navīyaḥ | sa revacchoca sa giro juṣasva sa vājaṃ darṣi sa iha śravo dhāḥ ||

translations.english: May that your army of flame, Agni, which Manu, which Sumitra has kindled, be the newest; do youshine wealthily; do you graciously accept our praises; do you destroy the might (of our foes), do you grant usabundance.

mantras.sanskrit: यं त्वा पूर्वमीळितो वध्र्यश्वः समीधे अग्ने स इदं जुषस्व । स नः स्तिपा उत भवा तनूपा दात्रं रक्षस्व यदिदं ते अस्मे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ tvā pūrvamīḷito vadhryaśvaḥ samīdhe agne sa idaṃ juṣasva | sa naḥ stipā uta bhavā tanūpā dātraṃ rakṣasva yadidaṃ te asme ||

translations.english: Do you, Agni, whom Vadhryaśva propitiating you formerly kindled, accept this; be the proector of oursacrifices, be the protector of our bodies; preserve this wealth which has been given to us by you.

mantras.sanskrit: भवा द्युम्नी वाध्र्यश्वोत गोपा मा त्वा तारीदभिमातिर्जनानाम् । शूर इव धृष्णुश्च्यवनः सुमित्रः प्र नु वोचं वाध्र्यश्वस्य नाम ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhavā dyumnī vādhryaśvota gopā mā tvā tārīdabhimātirjanānām | śūra iva dhṛṣṇuścyavanaḥ sumitraḥ pra nu vocaṃ vādhryaśvasya nāma ||

translations.english: Kinsman of Vadhryaśva, be the possessor of food and our protector; let no one assail you, (for youare) the overcomer of men; like a resolute warrior (you are) the overthrower (of enemies); I, Sumitra, celebratethe names of the kinsmen of Vadhyaśva.

mantras.sanskrit: समज्र्या पर्वत्या वसूनि दासा वृत्राण्यार्या जिगेथ । शूर इव धृष्णुश्च्यवनो जनानां त्वमग्ने पृतनायूँरभि ष्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samajryā parvatyā vasūni dāsā vṛtrāṇyāryā jigetha | śūra iva dhṛṣṇuścyavano janānāṃ tvamagne pṛtanāyū~rabhi ṣyāḥ ||

translations.english: You have gained mountain-treasures beneficial to men, (you have defeated the hostilities) of strongmen, Dāsas and Vṛtras, like a resolute warrior, do you, Agni, the overthrower (of enemies), overcome thosewho are desirous of battle.

mantras.sanskrit: दीर्घतन्तुर्बृहदुक्षायमग्निः सहस्रस्तरीः शतनीथ ऋभ्वा । द्युमान्द्युमत्सु नृभिर्मृज्यमानः सुमित्रेषु दीदयो देवयत्सु ॥
mantras.transliteration: dīrghatanturbṛhadukṣāyamagniḥ sahasrastarīḥ śatanītha ṛbhvā | dyumāndyumatsu nṛbhirmṛjyamānaḥ sumitreṣu dīdayo devayatsu ||

translations.english: This Agni to whom a long series (of sacrifices has been addressed), who is bright with many rays,covering thousands (in the form of ghī), the leader of hundreds (of burnt offerings), the mighty one, brilliantamong the brilliant, (is) being glorified by the priests; shine (Agni) upon the devout Sumitras.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वे धेनुः सुदुघा जातवेदोऽसश्चतेव समना सबर्धुक् । त्वं नृभिर्दक्षिणावद्भिरग्ने सुमित्रेभिरिध्यसे देवयद्भिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tve dhenuḥ sudughā jātavedo'saścateva samanā sabardhuk | tvaṃ nṛbhirdakṣiṇāvadbhiragne sumitrebhiridhyase devayadbhiḥ ||

translations.english: In you, Jātavedas, is the cow easy to be milked, yielding ambrosia as it were inexhaustibly in battle,you are kindled, Agni, by the devout Sumitras who are entitled to the sacrificial donation.

mantras.sanskrit: देवाश्चित्ते अमृता जातवेदो महिमानं वाध्र्यश्व प्र वोचन् । यत्सम्पृच्छं मानुषीर्विश आयन्त्वं नृभिरजयस्त्वावृधेभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: devāścitte amṛtā jātavedo mahimānaṃ vādhryaśva pra vocan | yatsampṛcchaṃ mānuṣīrviśa āyantvaṃ nṛbhirajayastvāvṛdhebhiḥ ||

translations.english: The immortal gods have proclaimed your greatness. Jātavedas, Vadhryaśva (Agni); when humanbeings, came to inquire (who would slay the asuras), then you with (the gods), the leaders of all, fostered by youdid overcome (those who impeded the ceremony).

mantras.sanskrit: पितेव पुत्रमबिभरुपस्थे त्वामग्ने वध्र्यश्वः सपर्यन् । जुषाणो अस्य समिधं यविष्ठोत पूर्वाँ अवनोर्व्राधतश्चित् ॥
mantras.transliteration: piteva putramabibharupasthe tvāmagne vadhryaśvaḥ saparyan | juṣāṇo asya samidhaṃ yaviṣṭhota pūrvā~ avanorvrādhataścit ||

translations.english: Vadhryaśva, honouring you, Agni, plural ced you upon the altar as a father (plural ces) his son (upon hislap); plural ased with his fuel, youngest (of the gods), you did slay the ancient obstructers of the rite.

mantras.sanskrit: शश्वदग्निर्वध्र्यश्वस्य शत्रून्नृभिर्जिगाय सुतसोमवद्भिः । समनं चिददहश्चित्रभानोऽव व्राधन्तमभिनद्वृधश्चित् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaśvadagnirvadhryaśvasya śatrūnnṛbhirjigāya sutasomavadbhiḥ | samanaṃ cidadahaścitrabhāno'va vrādhantamabhinadvṛdhaścit ||

translations.english: Agni by means of the priests of Vadhryaśva pouring out libations always conquers his foes; you(Agni) shining with varied splendour, have consumed the battle; (your praiser) self-fostered has destroyed hispowerful (assailant).

mantras.sanskrit: अयमग्निर्वध्र्यश्वस्य वृत्रहा सनकात्प्रेद्धो नमसोपवाक्यः । स नो अजामीँरुत वा विजामीनभि तिष्ठ शर्धतो वाध्र्यश्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayamagnirvadhryaśvasya vṛtrahā sanakātpreddho namasopavākyaḥ | sa no ajāmī~ruta vā vijāmīnabhi tiṣṭha śardhato vādhryaśva ||

translations.english: From a long period has this Agni the slayer of foes been kindled (by the oblation) of Vadhryaśva; (heis) to be addressed with reverence; do you, (Agni, kindled in the) family of Vadhryaśva, overcome our enemies,both those who have no kinsmen and those who have many kinsmen.

mantras.sanskrit: इमां मे अग्ने समिधं जुषस्वेळस्पदे प्रति हर्या घृताचीम् । वर्ष्मन्पृथिव्याः सुदिनत्वे अह्नामूर्ध्वो भव सुक्रतो देवयज्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: imāṃ me agne samidhaṃ juṣasveḷaspade prati haryā ghṛtācīm | varṣmanpṛthivyāḥ sudinatve ahnāmūrdhvo bhava sukrato devayajyā ||

translations.english: Graciously accept, Agni, this my fuel (plural ced) on the plural ce of libation (the altar); delight in thebutter-laden (spoon); most wise, rise up upon the lofty plural ce of the earth for the propitiousness of the daysthrough the worship of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: आ देवानामग्रयावेह यातु नराशंसो विश्वरूपेभिरश्वैः । ऋतस्य पथा नमसा मियेधो देवेभ्यो देवतमः सुषूदत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā devānāmagrayāveha yātu narāśaṃso viśvarūpebhiraśvaiḥ | ṛtasya pathā namasā miyedho devebhyo devatamaḥ suṣūdat ||

translations.english: May Narāśaṃsa, the preceder of the gods, come here with his horses of various forms; deserving ofadoration, chief of the gods, may he effuse (oblations) to the gods by the path of the sacrifice with praise.

mantras.sanskrit: शश्वत्तममीळते दूत्याय हविष्मन्तो मनुष्यासो अग्निम् । वहिष्ठैरश्वैः सुवृता रथेना देवान्वक्षि नि षदेह होता ॥
mantras.transliteration: śaśvattamamīḷate dūtyāya haviṣmanto manuṣyāso agnim | vahiṣṭhairaśvaiḥ suvṛtā rathenā devānvakṣi ni ṣadeha hotā ||

translations.english: Men offering oblations adore the eternal Agni to (induce him to perform) the duty of messenger (to thegods); do you with your stalwart draught horses and your well-turning chariots bear (our offering) to the gods,and sit down here as the ministrant priest.

mantras.sanskrit: वि प्रथतां देवजुष्टं तिरश्चा दीर्घं द्राघ्मा सुरभि भूत्वस्मे । अहेळता मनसा देव बर्हिरिन्द्रज्येष्ठाँ उशतो यक्षि देवान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi prathatāṃ devajuṣṭaṃ tiraścā dīrghaṃ drāghmā surabhi bhūtvasme | aheḷatā manasā deva barhirindrajyeṣṭhā~ uśato yakṣi devān ||

translations.english: May our (sacred grass) acceptable to the gods, twining crookedly be stretched out, may it be long,lengthy, and fragrant; with mind free from wrath, divine Barhis, offer worship to the gods desiring (the sacrifice),of whom Indra is the chief.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवो वा सानु स्पृशता वरीयः पृथिव्या वा मात्रया वि श्रयध्वम् । उशतीर्द्वारो महिना महद्भिर्देवं रथं रथयुर्धारयध्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: divo vā sānu spṛśatā varīyaḥ pṛthivyā vā mātrayā vi śrayadhvam | uśatīrdvāro mahinā mahadbhirdevaṃ rathaṃ rathayurdhārayadhvam ||

translations.english: Be in contact, doors, with the lofty height of heaven, or expand according to the measure of the earth;desiring the gods, desiring a chariot, sustain without might the shining chariot (that is mounted) by the mightygods.

mantras.sanskrit: देवी दिवो दुहितरा सुशिल्पे उषासानक्ता सदतां नि योनौ । आ वां देवास उशती उशन्त उरौ सीदन्तु सुभगे उपस्थे ॥
mantras.transliteration: devī divo duhitarā suśilpe uṣāsānaktā sadatāṃ ni yonau | ā vāṃ devāsa uśatī uśanta urau sīdantu subhage upasthe ||

translations.english: Radiant daughters of heaven, Dawn and Night, sit down on the plural ce of sacrifice; O you, who aredesirous and possessed of affluence, may the gods desirous (of oblations) sit down on your spacious lap.

mantras.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वो ग्रावा बृहदग्निः समिद्धः प्रिया धामान्यदितेरुपस्थे । पुरोहितावृत्विजा यज्ञे अस्मिन्विदुष्टरा द्रविणमा यजेथाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūrdhvo grāvā bṛhadagniḥ samiddhaḥ priyā dhāmānyaditerupasthe | purohitāvṛtvijā yajñe asminviduṣṭarā draviṇamā yajethām ||

translations.english: (When) the grinding-stone is uplifted, the mighty Agni kindled, the acceptable vessels (ready) on thelap of earth; (then), most learned priests, who take the foremost plural ce, bestow wealth upon us at this sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: तिस्रो देवीर्बर्हिरिदं वरीय आ सीदत चकृमा वः स्योनम् । मनुष्वद्यज्ञं सुधिता हवींषीळा देवी घृतपदी जुषन्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: tisro devīrbarhiridaṃ varīya ā sīdata cakṛmā vaḥ syonam | manuṣvadyajñaṃ sudhitā havīṃṣīḷā devī ghṛtapadī juṣanta ||

translations.english: Sit down, you three goddesses, upon this broad barhis, we have spread it out for you; Iḷā, radiant(Sarasvatī) and bright-footed (bhāratī) accept our sacrifice and well-presented oblations as if they wereManu's.

mantras.sanskrit: देव त्वष्टर्यद्ध चारुत्वमानड्यदङ्गिरसामभवः सचाभूः । स देवानां पाथ उप प्र विद्वाँ उशन्यक्षि द्रविणोदः सुरत्नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: deva tvaṣṭaryaddha cārutvamānaḍyadaṅgirasāmabhavaḥ sacābhūḥ | sa devānāṃ pātha upa pra vidvā~ uśanyakṣi draviṇodaḥ suratnaḥ ||

translations.english: Divine Tvaṣṭā, since you have attained to beauty (through our oblations), and have become theassociate of the Aṅgirasas, do you, the bestower of wealth, possessed of precious treasure, and knowing (towhom each portion belongs), offer the food of the gods (to them).

mantras.sanskrit: वनस्पते रशनया नियूया देवानां पाथ उप वक्षि विद्वान् । स्वदाति देवः कृणवद्धवींष्यवतां द्यावापृथिवी हवं मे ॥
mantras.transliteration: vanaspate raśanayā niyūyā devānāṃ pātha upa vakṣi vidvān | svadāti devaḥ kṛṇavaddhavīṃṣyavatāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī havaṃ me ||

translations.english: Vanaspati, who are intelligent, having fastened it with a rope, convey the food of the gods; may thedivine (Vanaspati) taste it, may he take the oblations (to the gods); may heaven and earth protect my invocatioṇ

mantras.sanskrit: आग्ने वह वरुणमिष्टये न इन्द्रं दिवो मरुतो अन्तरिक्षात् । सीदन्तु बर्हिर्विश्व आ यजत्राः स्वाहा देवा अमृता मादयन्ताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: āgne vaha varuṇamiṣṭaye na indraṃ divo maruto antarikṣāt | sīdantu barhirviśva ā yajatrāḥ svāhā devā amṛtā mādayantām ||

translations.english: Bring, Agni, to our sacrifice Varuṇa and Indra from heaven, and the Maruts from the firmament, maythe adorable universal gods sit down on the sacred grass, and may the immortal deities rejoice in (the oblationpresented with) the svāhā.

mantras.sanskrit: बृहस्पते प्रथमं वाचो अग्रं यत्प्रैरत नामधेयं दधानाः । यदेषां श्रेष्ठं यदरिप्रमासीत्प्रेणा तदेषां निहितं गुहाविः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhaspate prathamaṃ vāco agraṃ yatprairata nāmadheyaṃ dadhānāḥ | yadeṣāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yadaripramāsītpreṇā tadeṣāṃ nihitaṃ guhāviḥ ||

translations.english: That, Bṛhaspati, is the best (part) of speech which those giving a name (to objects) first utter; thatwhich was the best of those (words) and free from defect, (Sarasvatī) reveals it though secretly imparted, bymeans of affection.

mantras.sanskrit: सक्तुमिव तितौना पुनन्तो यत्र धीरा मनसा वाचमक्रत । अत्रा सखायः सख्यानि जानते भद्रैषां लक्ष्मीर्निहिताधि वाचि ॥
mantras.transliteration: saktumiva titaunā punanto yatra dhīrā manasā vācamakrata | atrā sakhāyaḥ sakhyāni jānate bhadraiṣāṃ lakṣmīrnihitādhi vāci ||

translations.english: When the wise create Speech through wisdom winnowing (it) as (men winnow) barley with a sieve,then friends know friendship; good fortune is plural ced upon their word.

mantras.sanskrit: यज्ञेन वाचः पदवीयमायन्तामन्वविन्दन्नृषिषु प्रविष्टाम् । तामाभृत्या व्यदधुः पुरुत्रा तां सप्त रेभा अभि सं नवन्ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajñena vācaḥ padavīyamāyantāmanvavindannṛṣiṣu praviṣṭām | tāmābhṛtyā vyadadhuḥ purutrā tāṃ sapta rebhā abhi saṃ navante ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्वः पश्यन्न ददर्श वाचमुत त्वः शृण्वन्न शृणोत्येनाम् । उतो त्वस्मै तन्वं वि सस्रे जायेव पत्य उशती सुवासाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tvaḥ paśyanna dadarśa vācamuta tvaḥ śṛṇvanna śṛṇotyenām | uto tvasmai tanvaṃ vi sasre jāyeva patya uśatī suvāsāḥ ||

translations.english: One (man) indeed seeing Speech has not seen her; another (man) hearing her has not heard her; butto another she delivers her person n as a loving wife well-attired presents herself to her husband.

mantras.sanskrit: उत त्वं सख्ये स्थिरपीतमाहुर्नैनं हिन्वन्त्यपि वाजिनेषु । अधेन्वा चरति माययैष वाचं शुश्रुवाँ अफलामपुष्पाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta tvaṃ sakhye sthirapītamāhurnainaṃ hinvantyapi vājineṣu | adhenvā carati māyayaiṣa vācaṃ śuśruvā~ aphalāmapuṣpām ||

translations.english: They call one man firmly established in the friendship (of Speech), they do not exclude him from (thesociety of) the powerful (in knowledge); another wanders with an illusion that is barren, bearing Speech that iswithout fruit, without flowers.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्तित्याज सचिविदं सखायं न तस्य वाच्यपि भागो अस्ति । यदीं शृणोत्यलकं शृणोति नहि प्रवेद सुकृतस्य पन्थाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yastityāja sacividaṃ sakhāyaṃ na tasya vācyapi bhāgo asti | yadīṃ śṛṇotyalakaṃ śṛṇoti nahi praveda sukṛtasya panthām ||

translations.english: He who has abandoned the friend who knows the duty of a friend, in his speech there is not a particle(of sense); what he hears, he hears amiss; for he knows not the path of righteousness.

mantras.sanskrit: अक्षण्वन्तः कर्णवन्तः सखायो मनोजवेष्वसमा बभूवुः । आदघ्नास उपकक्षास उ त्वे ह्रदा इव स्नात्वा उ त्वे ददृश्रे ॥
mantras.transliteration: akṣaṇvantaḥ karṇavantaḥ sakhāyo manojaveṣvasamā babhūvuḥ | ādaghnāsa upakakṣāsa u tve hradā iva snātvā u tve dadṛśre ||

translations.english: Friends possessing eyes, possessing ears, were (yet) unequal in mental apprehension; some seemedlike pools reaching to the mouth, others reaching to the loins, others like pools in which one can bathe.

mantras.sanskrit: हृदा तष्टेषु मनसो जवेषु यद्ब्राह्मणाः संयजन्ते सखायः । अत्राह त्वं वि जहुर्वेद्याभिरोहब्रह्माणो वि चरन्त्यु त्वे ॥
mantras.transliteration: hṛdā taṣṭeṣu manaso javeṣu yadbrāhmaṇāḥ saṃyajante sakhāyaḥ | atrāha tvaṃ vi jahurvedyābhirohabrahmāṇo vi carantyu tve ||

translations.english: Although Brāhmaṇas who are friends concur in the mental apprehensions which are conceived bythe heart (of the wise), yet in this (assembly) they abandon one man (to ignorance of the sciences) that are to beknown, others again who are reckoned as Brāhmaṇas (wander at will in the meanings of the Veda).

mantras.sanskrit: इमे ये नार्वाङ्न परश्चरन्ति न ब्राह्मणासो न सुतेकरासः । त एते वाचमभिपद्य पापया सिरीस्तन्त्रं तन्वते अप्रजज्ञयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ime ye nārvāṅna paraścaranti na brāhmaṇāso na sutekarāsaḥ | ta ete vācamabhipadya pāpayā sirīstantraṃ tanvate aprajajñayaḥ ||

translations.english: Those who do not walk (with the Brāhmaṇas) in this lower world not (with the gods) in the upperworld-- they are neither Brāhmaṇas nor offerers of libations; they, devoid of wisdom, attaining Speech, havingsin producing (Speech), becoming plural ughmen pursue agriculture.

mantras.sanskrit: सर्वे नन्दन्ति यशसागतेन सभासाहेन सख्या सखायः । किल्बिषस्पृत्पितुषणिर्ह्येषामरं हितो भवति वाजिनाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: sarve nandanti yaśasāgatena sabhāsāhena sakhyā sakhāyaḥ | kilbiṣaspṛtpituṣaṇirhyeṣāmaraṃ hito bhavati vājināya ||

translations.english: All frinends rejoice when the friendly (libation), the support of the assembly (of the priests), has arrived(at the sacrifice); for (Soma), the remover of iniquity, the giver of sustenance, being plural ced (in the vessels), issufficient for their invigoration.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋचां त्वः पोषमास्ते पुपुष्वान्गायत्रं त्वो गायति शक्वरीषु । ब्रह्मा त्वो वदति जातविद्यां यज्ञस्य मात्रां वि मिमीत उ त्वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛcāṃ tvaḥ poṣamāste pupuṣvāngāyatraṃ tvo gāyati śakvarīṣu | brahmā tvo vadati jātavidyāṃ yajñasya mātrāṃ vi mimīta u tvaḥ ||

translations.english: One (the Hotā) is diligent in the repitition of the verses (of the Ṛk); another (the Udgātā) chantsthe Gāyatra (the Sāman) in the Śakvarī metre; another the Brahma declares the knowledge of what is to bedone; another (the Adhvaryu) measures the materials of the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: देवानां नु वयं जाना प्र वोचाम विपन्यया । उक्थेषु शस्यमानेषु यः पश्यादुत्तरे युगे ॥
mantras.transliteration: devānāṃ nu vayaṃ jānā pra vocāma vipanyayā | uktheṣu śasyamāneṣu yaḥ paśyāduttare yuge ||

translations.english: Let us proclaim with a clear voice the genitive rations of the gods (the divine company), who, when theirpraises are recited, look (favourably on the worshipper) in this latter age.

mantras.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणस्पतिरेता सं कर्मार इवाधमत् । देवानां पूर्व्ये युगेऽसतः सदजायत ॥
mantras.transliteration: brahmaṇaspatiretā saṃ karmāra ivādhamat | devānāṃ pūrvye yuge'sataḥ sadajāyata ||

translations.english: Brahmaṇaspati filled these (genitive rations of the gods) with breath as a blacksmith (his bellows); in thefirst age of the gods the existent was born of the non-existent.

mantras.sanskrit: देवानां युगे प्रथमेऽसतः सदजायत । तदाशा अन्वजायन्त तदुत्तानपदस्परि ॥
mantras.transliteration: devānāṃ yuge prathame'sataḥ sadajāyata | tadāśā anvajāyanta taduttānapadaspari ||

translations.english: In the firsst age of the gods the existent was born of the non- existent; after that the quarters (of thehorizon) were born, and after them the upward-growing (trees).

mantras.sanskrit: भूर्जज्ञ उत्तानपदो भुव आशा अजायन्त । अदितेर्दक्षो अजायत दक्षाद्वदितिः परि ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhūrjajña uttānapado bhuva āśā ajāyanta | aditerdakṣo ajāyata dakṣādvaditiḥ pari ||

translations.english: The earth was born from the upward-growing (tree), the quarters were born from the earth; Dakṣawas born from Aditi, and afterwards Aditi from Dakṣa.

mantras.sanskrit: अदितिर्ह्यजनिष्ट दक्ष या दुहिता तव । तां देवा अन्वजायन्त भद्रा अमृतबन्धवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aditirhyajaniṣṭa dakṣa yā duhitā tava | tāṃ devā anvajāyanta bhadrā amṛtabandhavaḥ ||

translations.english: Aditi, who was your daughter, Dakṣa, was born; after her the gods were born adorable, freed from thebonds of death.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्देवा अदः सलिले सुसंरब्धा अतिष्ठत । अत्रा वो नृत्यतामिव तीव्रो रेणुरपायत ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaddevā adaḥ salile susaṃrabdhā atiṣṭhata | atrā vo nṛtyatāmiva tīvro reṇurapāyata ||

translations.english: When, goeds, your abode in this pool well-arranged, then a pungent dust went forth from you as if youwere dancing.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्देवा यतयो यथा भुवनान्यपिन्वत । अत्रा समुद्र आ गूळ्हमा सूर्यमजभर्तन ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaddevā yatayo yathā bhuvanānyapinvata | atrā samudra ā gūḷhamā sūryamajabhartana ||

translations.english: When, gods, you filled the worlds (with your radiance) as clouds (fill the earth with rain), then youbrought forth the wun hidden in the ocean.

mantras.sanskrit: अष्टौ पुत्रासो अदितेर्ये जातास्तन्वस्परि । देवाँ उप प्रैत्सप्तभिः परा मार्ताण्डमास्यत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: aṣṭau putrāso aditerye jātāstanvaspari | devā~ upa praitsaptabhiḥ parā mārtāṇḍamāsyat ||

translations.english: Eight sons (there were) of Āditya who were born from her body; she approached the gods withseven, she sent forth Mārtāṇḍa on high (Taittirīya Āraṇyaka 1.13.3)

mantras.sanskrit: सप्तभिः पुत्रैरदितिरुप प्रैत्पूर्व्यं युगम् । प्रजायै मृत्यवे त्वत्पुनर्मार्ताण्डमाभरत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: saptabhiḥ putrairaditirupa praitpūrvyaṃ yugam | prajāyai mṛtyave tvatpunarmārtāṇḍamābharat ||

translations.english: With seven sons Aditi went to a former genitive ration, but she bore Mārtāṇḍa for the birth and death(of human beings).

mantras.sanskrit: जनिष्ठा उग्रः सहसे तुराय मन्द्र ओजिष्ठो बहुलाभिमानः । अवर्धन्निन्द्रं मरुतश्चिदत्र माता यद्वीरं दधनद्धनिष्ठा ॥
mantras.transliteration: janiṣṭhā ugraḥ sahase turāya mandra ojiṣṭho bahulābhimānaḥ | avardhannindraṃ marutaścidatra mātā yadvīraṃ dadhanaddhaniṣṭhā ||

translations.english: You have been born, (Indra), for strength, for slaying (enemies); powerful, adorable, most mighty,extremely proud; the Maruts animated Indra in the (Vṛtra-fight) when (his) sustaining mother sustained the hero.

mantras.sanskrit: द्रुहो निषत्ता पृशनी चिदेवैः पुरू शंसेन वावृधुष्ट इन्द्रम् । अभीवृतेव ता महापदेन ध्वान्तात्प्रपित्वादुदरन्त गर्भाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: druho niṣattā pṛśanī cidevaiḥ purū śaṃsena vāvṛdhuṣṭa indram | abhīvṛteva tā mahāpadena dhvāntātprapitvādudaranta garbhāḥ ||

translations.english: The material troop of (Indra) the injurer encamped around Indra, (accompanied) by the swift-moving(maruts); they animated him with abundant praise; like (cattle) penned up within a great stall, the embryonic(waters) issued from the (Vṛtra) who had arrived in the form of darkness.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋष्वा ते पादा प्र यज्जिगास्यवर्धन्वाजा उत ये चिदत्र । त्वमिन्द्र सालावृकान्त्सहस्रमासन्दधिषे अश्विना ववृत्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛṣvā te pādā pra yajjigāsyavardhanvājā uta ye cidatra | tvamindra sālāvṛkāntsahasramāsandadhiṣe aśvinā vavṛtyāḥ ||

translations.english: Vast, (Indra), are your feet; when you advance, the Vājas, and whatsoever (deities are) thereanimated you; you, Indra, hold a thousand jackals in yourmouth, may you bring back the Aśvins.

mantras.sanskrit: समना तूर्णिरुप यासि यज्ञमा नासत्या सख्याय वक्षि । वसाव्यामिन्द्र धारयः सहस्राश्विना शूर ददतुर्मघानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: samanā tūrṇirupa yāsi yajñamā nāsatyā sakhyāya vakṣi | vasāvyāmindra dhārayaḥ sahasrāśvinā śūra dadaturmaghāni ||

translations.english: Hastening in battle you approach the sacrifice; you bring the two Nāsatyās to friendship (with us);you, Indra, possess a heap of treasures, thousands (in numbers); the Aśvins, hero, gave us riches.

mantras.sanskrit: मन्दमान ऋतादधि प्रजायै सखिभिरिन्द्र इषिरेभिरर्थम् । आभिर्हि माया उप दस्युमागान्मिहः प्र तम्रा अवपत्तमांसि ॥
