mantras.transliteration: mandamāna ṛtādadhi prajāyai sakhibhirindra iṣirebhirartham | ābhirhi māyā upa dasyumāgānmihaḥ pra tamrā avapattamāṃsi ||

translations.english: Indra rejoicing at the sacrifice accompanied by hisswift-moving riends (the Maruts, gave) wealth to thepeople; he has come with them against the Dasyu to destroy his illusions; he has scattered the dark rain-cloudsand the gloom.

mantras.sanskrit: सनामाना चिद्ध्वसयो न्यस्मा अवाहन्निन्द्र उषसो यथानः । ऋष्वैरगच्छः सखिभिर्निकामैः साकं प्रतिष्ठा हृद्या जघन्थ ॥
mantras.transliteration: sanāmānā ciddhvasayo nyasmā avāhannindra uṣaso yathānaḥ | ṛṣvairagacchaḥ sakhibhirnikāmaiḥ sākaṃ pratiṣṭhā hṛdyā jaghantha ||

translations.english: You have expelled the two of the same name, you have destroyed the Vṛtra as (he destroyed) the cartof the dawn; you advance with the mighty friends (the Maruts), who were eager (to slay the Vṛtra); youdemolished his precious limbs.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं जघन्थ नमुचिं मखस्युं दासं कृण्वान ऋषये विमायम् । त्वं चकर्थ मनवे स्योनान्पथो देवत्राञ्जसेव यानान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ jaghantha namuciṃ makhasyuṃ dāsaṃ kṛṇvāna ṛṣaye vimāyam | tvaṃ cakartha manave syonānpatho devatrāñjaseva yānān ||

translations.english: You have slain the slave Namuci endeavouring (to disturb) the sacrifice, making his illusionspowerless against the Ṛṣi; you have made easy for Manu the paths to the gods, so as (to make) the waysstraight.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमेतानि पप्रिषे वि नामेशान इन्द्र दधिषे गभस्तौ । अनु त्वा देवाः शवसा मदन्त्युपरिबुध्नान्वनिनश्चकर्थ ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvametāni papriṣe vi nāmeśāna indra dadhiṣe gabhastau | anu tvā devāḥ śavasā madantyuparibudhnānvaninaścakartha ||

translations.english: You have filled these waters, you, Indra, who are the lord (of all) bear (the thunderbolt) in your hands;the gods glorify you (who are endowed) with strength; you have made the clouds with their roots upwards.

mantras.sanskrit: चक्रं यदस्याप्स्वा निषत्तमुतो तदस्मै मध्विच्चच्छद्यात् । पृथिव्यामतिषितं यदूधः पयो गोष्वदधा ओषधीषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: cakraṃ yadasyāpsvā niṣattamuto tadasmai madhviccacchadyāt | pṛthivyāmatiṣitaṃ yadūdhaḥ payo goṣvadadhā oṣadhīṣu ||

translations.english: When his thunderbolt rode everywhere in the firmament, it also subjugated the water to him; the waterwhich is let loose upon the earth puts milk into cows and herbs.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्वादियायेति यद्वदन्त्योजसो जातमुत मन्य एनम् । मन्योरियाय हर्म्येषु तस्थौ यतः प्रजज्ञ इन्द्रो अस्य वेद ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvādiyāyeti yadvadantyojaso jātamuta manya enam | manyoriyāya harmyeṣu tasthau yataḥ prajajña indro asya veda ||

translations.english: Although (some) say he came from the horse (the sun), I know that he is the offspring of strength; hecame from wrath, he stands in the homes (of his enemies); Indra knows whence he was born.

mantras.sanskrit: वयः सुपर्णा उप सेदुरिन्द्रं प्रियमेधा ऋषयो नाधमानाः । अप ध्वान्तमूर्णुहि पूर्धि चक्षुर्मुमुग्ध्यस्मान्निधयेव बद्धान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayaḥ suparṇā upa sedurindraṃ priyamedhā ṛṣayo nādhamānāḥ | apa dhvāntamūrṇuhi pūrdhi cakṣurmumugdhyasmānnidhayeva baddhān ||

translations.english: The swift-moving well-flying (rays of the sun), living sacrifices, discerning (the future), deservingknowledge, invested Indra, dissipate the darkness, fill out the light; release us like men bound with a net.

mantras.sanskrit: वसूनां वा चर्कृष इयक्षन्धिया वा यज्ञैर्वा रोदस्योः । अर्वन्तो वा ये रयिमन्तः सातौ वनुं वा ये सुश्रुणं सुश्रुतो धुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vasūnāṃ vā carkṛṣa iyakṣandhiyā vā yajñairvā rodasyoḥ | arvanto vā ye rayimantaḥ sātau vanuṃ vā ye suśruṇaṃ suśruto dhuḥ ||

translations.english: Indra desiring to bestow (wealth) is attracted by the inhabitants of heaven and earth (for theacquisition) of riches, either by pious acts or by sacrifices; (he is attracted) either by those swift-moving (person ns)who acquire wealth in battle or by those who being successful (inflict) successful injury.

mantras.sanskrit: हव एषामसुरो नक्षत द्यां श्रवस्यता मनसा निंसत क्षाम् । चक्षाणा यत्र सुविताय देवा द्यौर्न वारेभिः कृणवन्त स्वैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: hava eṣāmasuro nakṣata dyāṃ śravasyatā manasā niṃsata kṣām | cakṣāṇā yatra suvitāya devā dyaurna vārebhiḥ kṛṇavanta svaiḥ ||

translations.english: The animating invocation of these (Aṅgirasas) pervaded heaven; (the gods) with minds desirous offood kissed the earth; and there beholding (the lost cattle), the gods for their own benefit made (illumination) likethe sun by their glorious radiance.

mantras.sanskrit: इयमेषाममृतानां गीः सर्वताता ये कृपणन्त रत्नम् । धियं च यज्ञं च साधन्तस्ते नो धान्तु वसव्यमसामि ॥
mantras.transliteration: iyameṣāmamṛtānāṃ gīḥ sarvatātā ye kṛpaṇanta ratnam | dhiyaṃ ca yajñaṃ ca sādhantaste no dhāntu vasavyamasāmi ||

translations.english: This (is) the praise of these immortal (Gods), who bestow wealth at the sacrifice; perfecting our praiseand sacrifice, may they bestow upon us unequalled riches.

mantras.sanskrit: आ तत्त इन्द्रायवः पनन्ताभि य ऊर्वं गोमन्तं तितृत्सान् । सकृत्स्वं ये पुरुपुत्रां महीं सहस्रधारां बृहतीं दुदुक्षन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tatta indrāyavaḥ panantābhi ya ūrvaṃ gomantaṃ titṛtsān | sakṛtsvaṃ ye puruputrāṃ mahīṃ sahasradhārāṃ bṛhatīṃ dudukṣan ||

translations.english: Your men praised (you) then, Indra, (those) who wished to break into the vast (stall) full of cattle; whomilked the extensive once-genitive rating earth, mother of many children, the showerer of thousands (of blessings).

mantras.sanskrit: शचीव इन्द्रमवसे कृणुध्वमनानतं दमयन्तं पृतन्यून् । ऋभुक्षणं मघवानं सुवृक्तिं भर्ता यो वज्रं नर्यं पुरुक्षुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śacīva indramavase kṛṇudhvamanānataṃ damayantaṃ pṛtanyūn | ṛbhukṣaṇaṃ maghavānaṃ suvṛktiṃ bhartā yo vajraṃ naryaṃ purukṣuḥ ||

translations.english: Celebrators of holy rites, select for your protection Indra the unsubdued, the tamer of hostile hosts;mighty, opulent, much glorified, who, loud-shouting, is the bearer of the thunderbolt, which is friendly to man.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्वावान पुरुतमं पुराषाळा वृत्रहेन्द्रो नामान्यप्राः । अचेति प्रासहस्पतिस्तुविष्मान्यदीमुश्मसि कर्तवे करत्तत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadvāvāna purutamaṃ purāṣāḷā vṛtrahendro nāmānyaprāḥ | aceti prāsahaspatistuviṣmānyadīmuśmasi kartave karattat ||

translations.english: When Indra, the destroyer of cities, had slain the most mighty (Vṛtra), then he the Vṛtra-slayer filledthe waters; he was manifest (to all), the subduer of enemies, the lord of all, the most opulent; may he do thatwhich we desire to have done.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सु व आपो महिमानमुत्तमं कारुर्वोचाति सदने विवस्वतः । प्र सप्तसप्त त्रेधा हि चक्रमुः प्र सृत्वरीणामति सिन्धुरोजसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra su va āpo mahimānamuttamaṃ kārurvocāti sadane vivasvataḥ | pra saptasapta tredhā hi cakramuḥ pra sṛtvarīṇāmati sindhurojasā ||

translations.english: Waters, the worshipper addresses to you excellent praise in the dwelling of the instrumental tutor of the rite;they flowed by sevens through the three (worlds); but the Sindhu surpasses (all) the (other) streams in strength.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र तेऽरदद्वरुणो यातवे पथः सिन्धो यद्वाजाँ अभ्यद्रवस्त्वम् । भूम्या अधि प्रवता यासि सानुना यदेषामग्रं जगतामिरज्यसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra te'radadvaruṇo yātave pathaḥ sindho yadvājā~ abhyadravastvam | bhūmyā adhi pravatā yāsi sānunā yadeṣāmagraṃ jagatāmirajyasi ||

translations.english: For your course, Sindhu, Varuṇa tore open a path, since you hastened towards food; you go by alofty road down upon the earth, by which (road) you reign in the sight of all worlds.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवि स्वनो यतते भूम्योपर्यनन्तं शुष्ममुदियर्ति भानुना । अभ्रादिव प्र स्तनयन्ति वृष्टयः सिन्धुर्यदेति वृषभो न रोरुवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: divi svano yatate bhūmyoparyanantaṃ śuṣmamudiyarti bhānunā | abhrādiva pra stanayanti vṛṣṭayaḥ sindhuryadeti vṛṣabho na roruvat ||

translations.english: The sound goes forth in heaven above the earth; (Sindhu) with shining wave animates his endlessspeed; as rains issue thundering from the cloud, so Sindhu (thunders) when he advances roaring like a bull.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि त्वा सिन्धो शिशुमिन्न मातरो वाश्रा अर्षन्ति पयसेव धेनवः । राजेव युध्वा नयसि त्वमित्सिचौ यदासामग्रं प्रवतामिनक्षसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi tvā sindho śiśuminna mātaro vāśrā arṣanti payaseva dhenavaḥ | rājeva yudhvā nayasi tvamitsicau yadāsāmagraṃ pravatāminakṣasi ||

translations.english: Like mothers crying for their sons, (the other rivers) hasten towards you, Sindhu, like cows with theirmilk; you lead your two wings like a king going to battle when you march in the van of the streams that aredescending (with you).

mantras.sanskrit: इमं मे गङ्गे यमुने सरस्वति शुतुद्रि स्तोमं सचता परुष्ण्या । असिक्न्या मरुद्वृधे वितस्तयार्जीकीये शृणुह्या सुषोमया ॥
mantras.transliteration: imaṃ me gaṅge yamune sarasvati śutudri stomaṃ sacatā paruṣṇyā | asiknyā marudvṛdhe vitastayārjīkīye śṛṇuhyā suṣomayā ||

translations.english: Accept this my praise, Gaṅgā, Yamunā, Sarasvatī, Śutudri, Paruṣṇi, Marudvṛdha with Asiknī,and Vitazstā; listen, Ārjikīya with Suṣomā.

mantras.sanskrit: तृष्टामया प्रथमं यातवे सजूः सुसर्त्वा रसया श्वेत्या त्या । त्वं सिन्धो कुभया गोमतीं क्रुमुं मेहत्न्वा सरथं याभिरीयसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tṛṣṭāmayā prathamaṃ yātave sajūḥ susartvā rasayā śvetyā tyā | tvaṃ sindho kubhayā gomatīṃ krumuṃ mehatnvā sarathaṃ yābhirīyase ||

translations.english: You, Sindhu, in order to reach the swift-moving Gomatī, have united, yourself first with theTṛṣṭāmā; (now be united) with the Susartu, the Rasā, the Śveti, the Kubha, and the Mehatnu, inconjunction with which streams you do advance.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋजीत्येनी रुशती महित्वा परि ज्रयांसि भरते रजांसि । अदब्धा सिन्धुरपसामपस्तमाश्वा न चित्रा वपुषीव दर्शता ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛjītyenī ruśatī mahitvā pari jrayāṃsi bharate rajāṃsi | adabdhā sindhurapasāmapastamāśvā na citrā vapuṣīva darśatā ||

translations.english: Straight-flowing, white-coloured, bright-shining (Sindhu) bear along in its might the rapid waters; theinviolable Sindhu, the most efficacious of the efficacious, is speckled like a mare, beautiful as a handsomewoman.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वश्वा सिन्धुः सुरथा सुवासा हिरण्ययी सुकृता वाजिनीवती । ऊर्णावती युवतिः सीलमावत्युताधि वस्ते सुभगा मधुवृधम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: svaśvā sindhuḥ surathā suvāsā hiraṇyayī sukṛtā vājinīvatī | ūrṇāvatī yuvatiḥ sīlamāvatyutādhi vaste subhagā madhuvṛdham ||

translations.english: The Sindhu is rich in horses, rich in chariots, rich in clothes, rich in gold ornaments, well-made, rich infood, rich in wool, ever fresh, abounding Sīlamā plural nts, and the auspicious river wears honey-growing(flowers).

mantras.sanskrit: सुखं रथं युयुजे सिन्धुरश्विनं तेन वाजं सनिषदस्मिन्नाजौ । महान्ह्यस्य महिमा पनस्यतेऽदब्धस्य स्वयशसो विरप्शिनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sukhaṃ rathaṃ yuyuje sindhuraśvinaṃ tena vājaṃ saniṣadasminnājau | mahānhyasya mahimā panasyate'dabdhasya svayaśaso virapśinaḥ ||

translations.english: Sindhu has harnessed his easy-going, well-horsed, chariot, with it may he bring (us) food; the might ofthis inviolable, great, renowned (chariot) at this sacrifice is praised as mighty.

mantras.sanskrit: आ व ऋञ्जस ऊर्जां व्युष्टिष्विन्द्रं मरुतो रोदसी अनक्तन । उभे यथा नो अहनी सचाभुवा सदःसदो वरिवस्यात उद्भिदा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā va ṛñjasa ūrjāṃ vyuṣṭiṣvindraṃ maruto rodasī anaktana | ubhe yathā no ahanī sacābhuvā sadaḥsado varivasyāta udbhidā ||

translations.english: I propitiate you at the commencement of the food-possessing (dawns); you reveal Indra, the Maruts,heaven and earth; both heaven and earth being united attend on us in all the chambers of sacrifice; (may they fillus) with wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: तदु श्रेष्ठं सवनं सुनोतनात्यो न हस्तयतो अद्रिः सोतरि । विदद्ध्यर्यो अभिभूति पौंस्यं महो राये चित्तरुते यदर्वतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadu śreṣṭhaṃ savanaṃ sunotanātyo na hastayato adriḥ sotari | vidaddhyaryo abhibhūti pauṃsyaṃ maho rāye cittarute yadarvataḥ ||

translations.english: Pour forth this excellent libation; the stone grasped by the hand is like a horse when the grinder(effuses the Soma). The animating (worshipper) acquires virile strength overpowering (his foes) when (the stone)bestows horses for the sake of great wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: तदिद्ध्यस्य सवनं विवेरपो यथा पुरा मनवे गातुमश्रेत् । गोअर्णसि त्वाष्ट्रे अश्वनिर्णिजि प्रेमध्वरेष्वध्वराँ अशिश्रयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadiddhyasya savanaṃ viverapo yathā purā manave gātumaśret | goarṇasi tvāṣṭre aśvanirṇiji premadhvareṣvadhvarā~ aśiśrayuḥ ||

translations.english: May this (sacrificial) work of this grinding-stone the effusion of the Soma, spread as it went formerlyalong the path to Manu; when the son of Tvaṣṭā, hidden by the (stolen) cows, and assuming the form of ahorse, (was to be slain), the worshippers had recourse at the sacrifices to the inviolable (upper grinding-stones).

mantras.sanskrit: अप हत रक्षसो भङ्गुरावत स्कभायत निॠतिं सेधतामतिम् । आ नो रयिं सर्ववीरं सुनोतन देवाव्यं भरत श्लोकमद्रयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: apa hata rakṣaso bhaṅgurāvata skabhāyata niṝtiṃ sedhatāmatim | ā no rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ sunotana devāvyaṃ bharata ślokamadrayaḥ ||

translations.english: Drive away the disturbing rākṣasas; keep off Nirṛti; prohibit all malignity; effuse for us riches withmale progeny; bear, stones, the praise that delights the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवश्चिदा वोऽमवत्तरेभ्यो विभ्वना चिदाश्वपस्तरेभ्यः । वायोश्चिदा सोमरभस्तरेभ्योऽग्नेश्चिदर्च पितुकृत्तरेभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: divaścidā vo'mavattarebhyo vibhvanā cidāśvapastarebhyaḥ | vāyościdā somarabhastarebhyo'gneścidarca pitukṛttarebhyaḥ ||

translations.english: (The Adhvaryu) praises you who are stronger even than heaven, quicker in work that Vibhvan, morediffusive of the Soma than Vāyu, more bountiful of food than Agni.

mantras.sanskrit: भुरन्तु नो यशसः सोत्वन्धसो ग्रावाणो वाचा दिविता दिवित्मता । नरो यत्र दुहते काम्यं मध्वाघोषयन्तो अभितो मिथस्तुरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhurantu no yaśasaḥ sotvandhaso grāvāṇo vācā divitā divitmatā | naro yatra duhate kāmyaṃ madhvāghoṣayanto abhito mithasturaḥ ||

translations.english: May the renowned stones bring us the effused Soma, (may they establish us) with brilliant praise inthe brilliant (Soma-sacrifice), where the priests milk forth the desirable Soma, crying out all around, and racingeach other.

mantras.sanskrit: सुन्वन्ति सोमं रथिरासो अद्रयो निरस्य रसं गविषो दुहन्ति ते । दुहन्त्यूधरुपसेचनाय कं नरो हव्या न मर्जयन्त आसभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sunvanti somaṃ rathirāso adrayo nirasya rasaṃ gaviṣo duhanti te | duhantyūdharupasecanāya kaṃ naro havyā na marjayanta āsabhiḥ ||

translations.english: The swiftly-moving grinding-stones effuse the Soma, desiring praise, they milk forth Soma; they milkforth for the spinkling (of Agni); the leaders (of rites) purify the oblations with their mouths.

mantras.sanskrit: एते नरः स्वपसो अभूतन य इन्द्राय सुनुथ सोममद्रयः । वामंवामं वो दिव्याय धाम्ने वसुवसु वः पार्थिवाय सुन्वते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ete naraḥ svapaso abhūtana ya indrāya sunutha somamadrayaḥ | vāmaṃvāmaṃ vo divyāya dhāmne vasuvasu vaḥ pārthivāya sunvate ||

translations.english: You stones, leaders (of rites), youu are the doers of good works; you who express the Soma for Indra,(make) all desirable wealth for the glory of heaven; you (give) all treasures to the earthly effuser.

mantras.sanskrit: अभ्रप्रुषो न वाचा प्रुषा वसु हविष्मन्तो न यज्ञा विजानुषः । सुमारुतं न ब्रह्माणमर्हसे गणमस्तोष्येषां न शोभसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhrapruṣo na vācā pruṣā vasu haviṣmanto na yajñā vijānuṣaḥ | sumārutaṃ na brahmāṇamarhase gaṇamastoṣyeṣāṃ na śobhase ||

translations.english: (The Maruts), plural ased with our praise like water-drops sent down by clouds, shower wealth; they arethe genitive rators (of the world) like sacrifices abounding with oblations; I have not praised the mighty band ofMaruts (adequately) for their honour or of their glory.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रिये मर्यासो अञ्जीँरकृण्वत सुमारुतं न पूर्वीरति क्षपः । दिवस्पुत्रास एता न येतिर आदित्यासस्ते अक्रा न वावृधुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śriye maryāso añjī~rakṛṇvata sumārutaṃ na pūrvīrati kṣapaḥ | divasputrāsa etā na yetira ādityāsaste akrā na vāvṛdhuḥ ||

translations.english: The destructive (Maruts) made ornaments for their decoration many hostile hosts cannot overcomethe band of Maruts; the moving sons of heaven do not issue forth, the swift-going sons of Aditi do not increase (inglory).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ये दिवः पृथिव्या न बर्हणा त्मना रिरिच्रे अभ्रान्न सूर्यः । पाजस्वन्तो न वीराः पनस्यवो रिशादसो न मर्या अभिद्यवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra ye divaḥ pṛthivyā na barhaṇā tmanā riricre abhrānna sūryaḥ | pājasvanto na vīrāḥ panasyavo riśādaso na maryā abhidyavaḥ ||

translations.english: (The Maruts), who through the might of heaven and earth have emerged from their own person ns asthe sun emerges from the cloud, (are) desirous of praise like powerful heroes, and radiant like men whooverpower their enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: युष्माकं बुध्ने अपां न यामनि विथुर्यति न मही श्रथर्यति । विश्वप्सुर्यज्ञो अर्वागयं सु वः प्रयस्वन्तो न सत्राच आ गत ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuṣmākaṃ budhne apāṃ na yāmani vithuryati na mahī śratharyati | viśvapsuryajño arvāgayaṃ su vaḥ prayasvanto na satrāca ā gata ||

translations.english: In your collision, as in the transit of waters, the earth is not shaken, is not shattered; this manifoldsacrifice comes towards you; approach united as if laden with food.

mantras.sanskrit: यूयं धूर्षु प्रयुजो न रश्मिभिर्ज्योतिष्मन्तो न भासा व्युष्टिषु । श्येनासो न स्वयशसो रिशादसः प्रवासो न प्रसितासः परिप्रुषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yūyaṃ dhūrṣu prayujo na raśmibhirjyotiṣmanto na bhāsā vyuṣṭiṣu | śyenāso na svayaśaso riśādasaḥ pravāso na prasitāsaḥ paripruṣaḥ ||

translations.english: You (move along) like horses harnessed to the chariot-poles with reins; at break of day you (areendowed) with radiance like the luminaries (of heaven); you are like hawks, like the destroyers of foes, desirousof renown; you cover the ground like travellers, you move everywhere.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र यद्वहध्वे मरुतः पराकाद्यूयं महः संवरणस्य वस्वः । विदानासो वसवो राध्यस्याराच्चिद्द्वेषः सनुतर्युयोत ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra yadvahadhve marutaḥ parākādyūyaṃ mahaḥ saṃvaraṇasya vasvaḥ | vidānāso vasavo rādhyasyārācciddveṣaḥ sanutaryuyota ||

translations.english: When, Maruts, you come from a distance, then, Vasus, distributors of abundant, desirable, covetedwealth, do you scatter afar our concealed foes.

mantras.sanskrit: य उदृचि यज्ञे अध्वरेष्ठा मरुद्भ्यो न मानुषो ददाशत् । रेवत्स वयो दधते सुवीरं स देवानामपि गोपीथे अस्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya udṛci yajñe adhvareṣṭhā marudbhyo na mānuṣo dadāśat | revatsa vayo dadhate suvīraṃ sa devānāmapi gopīthe astu ||

translations.english: The worshipper who engaged in worship at the sacrifice, accompanied with praise, presentsdonations (to the priests) as if to the Maruts, he enjoys food with riches, and male progeny; may he be present atthe god's soma-drinking.

mantras.sanskrit: ते हि यज्ञेषु यज्ञियास ऊमा आदित्येन नाम्ना शम्भविष्ठाः । ते नोऽवन्तु रथतूर्मनीषां महश्च यामन्नध्वरे चकानाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te hi yajñeṣu yajñiyāsa ūmā ādityena nāmnā śambhaviṣṭhāḥ | te no'vantu rathatūrmanīṣāṃ mahaśca yāmannadhvare cakānāḥ ||

translations.english: May those protecting deities who are entitled to be worshipped at sacrifices, who under the name ofĀdityas are the bestowers of felicity, may they (the Maruts) accelerating their chariots, and desirous of theample (oblation), upon their arrival at the sacrificed protect our praise.

mantras.sanskrit: विप्रासो न मन्मभिः स्वाध्यो देवाव्यो न यज्ञैः स्वप्नसः । राजानो न चित्राः सुसंदृशः क्षितीनां न मर्या अरेपसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viprāso na manmabhiḥ svādhyo devāvyo na yajñaiḥ svapnasaḥ | rājāno na citrāḥ susaṃdṛśaḥ kṣitīnāṃ na maryā arepasaḥ ||

translations.english: They (the Maruts) are like Brāhmaṇas sanctified by pious praises, they are instrumental tutors of holy riteslike the propitiators of the gods by sacrifices; decked with various ornaments, and handsome like kings, devoid ofsin like men (who are the lords) of habitations.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निर्न ये भ्राजसा रुक्मवक्षसो वातासो न स्वयुजः सद्यऊतयः । प्रज्ञातारो न ज्येष्ठाः सुनीतयः सुशर्माणो न सोमा ऋतं यते ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirna ye bhrājasā rukmavakṣaso vātāso na svayujaḥ sadyaūtayaḥ | prajñātāro na jyeṣṭhāḥ sunītayaḥ suśarmāṇo na somā ṛtaṃ yate ||

translations.english: (You) who like Agni (are endowed) with splendour, who have golden ornaments upon your breasts,who like the winds (are) self-yoked, swift-moving, who like the extremely wise (are) venerable and able guides,and like the Soma the giver of delight, (do you com) to the (worshipper) going to the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: वातासो न ये धुनयो जिगत्नवोऽग्नीनां न जिह्वा विरोकिणः । वर्मण्वन्तो न योधाः शिमीवन्तः पितॄणां न शंसाः सुरातयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vātāso na ye dhunayo jigatnavo'gnīnāṃ na jihvā virokiṇaḥ | varmaṇvanto na yodhāḥ śimīvantaḥ pitṝṇāṃ na śaṃsāḥ surātayaḥ ||

translations.english: (The Maruts), who like the winds cause (the gods) to tremble and move swift; blazing like the flames offires, (who are) the achievers of heroic deeds like warriors clad in mail; munificent donors like the praises ofancestors.

mantras.sanskrit: रथानां न येऽराः सनाभयो जिगीवांसो न शूरा अभिद्यवः । वरेयवो न मर्या घृतप्रुषोऽभिस्वर्तारो अर्कं न सुष्टुभः ॥
mantras.transliteration: rathānāṃ na ye'rāḥ sanābhayo jigīvāṃso na śūrā abhidyavaḥ | vareyavo na maryā ghṛtapruṣo'bhisvartāro arkaṃ na suṣṭubhaḥ ||

translations.english: Who (are) united to a common centre like the spokes (of the wheels) of chariots, brilliant like victoriousheroes, sprinkling water like benevolent men, sweet-voiced like men who recite praise.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्वासो न ये ज्येष्ठास आशवो दिधिषवो न रथ्यः सुदानवः । आपो न निम्नैरुदभिर्जिगत्नवो विश्वरूपा अङ्गिरसो न सामभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvāso na ye jyeṣṭhāsa āśavo didhiṣavo na rathyaḥ sudānavaḥ | āpo na nimnairudabhirjigatnavo viśvarūpā aṅgiraso na sāmabhiḥ ||

translations.english: Who (are) most excellent and swift like horses, lords of cars and munificent like the possessors ofwealth, swiftly moving like rivers with water flowing from a height, (accompanied) everywhere with hymns like themultiform Aṅgirasas.

mantras.sanskrit: ग्रावाणो न सूरयः सिन्धुमातर आदर्दिरासो अद्रयो न विश्वहा । शिशूला न क्रीळयः सुमातरो महाग्रामो न यामन्नुत त्विषा ॥
mantras.transliteration: grāvāṇo na sūrayaḥ sindhumātara ādardirāso adrayo na viśvahā | śiśūlā na krīḷayaḥ sumātaro mahāgrāmo na yāmannuta tviṣā ||

translations.english: Having streams for mothers like the grinding-stones which send forth moisture; ever destroying(enemies) like destructive thunderbolts; having tender mothers like sportive infants; (endowed) with splendourlike a great crowd of men in a procession.

mantras.sanskrit: उषसां न केतवोऽध्वरश्रियः शुभंयवो नाञ्जिभिर्व्यश्वितन् । सिन्धवो न ययियो भ्राजदृष्टयः परावतो न योजनानि ममिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: uṣasāṃ na ketavo'dhvaraśriyaḥ śubhaṃyavo nāñjibhirvyaśvitan | sindhavo na yayiyo bhrājadṛṣṭayaḥ parāvato na yojanāni mamire ||

translations.english: Who, radiant in sacrifices like the rays of the dawn, shine with their ornaments like those expectant ofgood fortune, (who) swift-moving like rivers, having bright weapons, have traversed leagues like mares who havejourneyed from far, (may they come to our sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: सुभागान्नो देवाः कृणुता सुरत्नानस्मान्त्स्तोतॄन्मरुतो वावृधानाः । अधि स्तोत्रस्य सख्यस्य गात सनाद्धि वो रत्नधेयानि सन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: subhāgānno devāḥ kṛṇutā suratnānasmāntstotṝnmaruto vāvṛdhānāḥ | adhi stotrasya sakhyasya gāta sanāddhi vo ratnadheyāni santi ||

translations.english: Divine Maruts, magnified (by our praise), render us, your praisers, prosperous and opulent; come tothis friendly laudation, for your precious bounties have been long (bestowed upon us).

mantras.sanskrit: अपश्यमस्य महतो महित्वममर्त्यस्य मर्त्यासु विक्षु । नाना हनू विभृते सं भरेते असिन्वती बप्सती भूर्यत्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: apaśyamasya mahato mahitvamamartyasya martyāsu vikṣu | nānā hanū vibhṛte saṃ bharete asinvatī bapsatī bhūryattaḥ ||

translations.english: I have beheld the might of the adorable (Agni) immortal in (the hearts of) mortal beings; his two jaws,divided asunder, shut together; devouring without masticating consume much (fuel).

mantras.sanskrit: गुहा शिरो निहितमृधगक्षी असिन्वन्नत्ति जिह्वया वनानि । अत्राण्यस्मै पड्भिः सं भरन्त्युत्तानहस्ता नमसाधि विक्षु ॥
mantras.transliteration: guhā śiro nihitamṛdhagakṣī asinvannatti jihvayā vanāni | atrāṇyasmai paḍbhiḥ saṃ bharantyuttānahastā namasādhi vikṣu ||

translations.english: His head is deposited in a cavern; his eyes are wide apart; with his tongue he devours the woodwithout masticating; (the priests) approaching on food reverently offer him oblations among the people withuplifted hands.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र मातुः प्रतरं गुह्यमिच्छन्कुमारो न वीरुधः सर्पदुर्वीः । ससं न पक्वमविदच्छुचन्तं रिरिह्वांसं रिप उपस्थे अन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra mātuḥ prataraṃ guhyamicchankumāro na vīrudhaḥ sarpadurvīḥ | sasaṃ na pakvamavidacchucantaṃ ririhvāṃsaṃ ripa upasthe antaḥ ||

translations.english: Longing for the abundant creepers of the maternal (earth, longing for) their more excellent concealed(root), he creeps like a child; he has found the tree shining like ripe grain, upon the lap of tthe earth, tasting (theether).

mantras.sanskrit: तद्वामृतं रोदसी प्र ब्रवीमि जायमानो मातरा गर्भो अत्ति । नाहं देवस्य मर्त्यश्चिकेताग्निरङ्ग विचेताः स प्रचेताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadvāmṛtaṃ rodasī pra bravīmi jāyamāno mātarā garbho atti | nāhaṃ devasya martyaściketāgniraṅga vicetāḥ sa pracetāḥ ||

translations.english: This (that) I declare unto you, heaven and earth, (is) the truth; as soon as born, the embryo devoursthe parents; I who am a mortal know not (the condition) of the deity; Agni, (O Vaiśvānara), is discriminating, heis exceedingly wise.

mantras.sanskrit: यो अस्मा अन्नं तृष्वादधात्याज्यैर्घृतैर्जुहोति पुष्यति । तस्मै सहस्रमक्षभिर्वि चक्षेऽग्ने विश्वतः प्रत्यङ्ङसि त्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo asmā annaṃ tṛṣvādadhātyājyairghṛtairjuhoti puṣyati | tasmai sahasramakṣabhirvi cakṣe'gne viśvataḥ pratyaṅṅasi tvam ||

translations.english: He who quickly offers him food, makes oblations to him with dripping Soma, and delights him (withfood); (Agni) looks upon him with a thousand eyes; you, Agni, are everywhere present.

mantras.sanskrit: किं देवेषु त्यज एनश्चकर्थाग्ने पृच्छामि नु त्वामविद्वान् । अक्रीळन्क्रीळन्हरिरत्तवेऽदन्वि पर्वशश्चकर्त गामिवासिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kiṃ deveṣu tyaja enaścakarthāgne pṛcchāmi nu tvāmavidvān | akrīḷankrīḷanharirattave'danvi parvaśaścakarta gāmivāsiḥ ||

translations.english: What wrathful act, what sin have you committed among the gods? Ignorant I ask you, Agni, sporting(here) not sporting (there), golden-hued; eating what is to be eaten, you cut (your food) into pieces as the knife(cuts up) the cow.

mantras.sanskrit: विषूचो अश्वान्युयुजे वनेजा ऋजीतिभी रशनाभिर्गृभीतान् । चक्षदे मित्रो वसुभिः सुजातः समानृधे पर्वभिर्वावृधानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viṣūco aśvānyuyuje vanejā ṛjītibhī raśanābhirgṛbhītān | cakṣade mitro vasubhiḥ sujātaḥ samānṛdhe parvabhirvāvṛdhānaḥ ||

translations.english: Born in the woods, he has harnessed his steeds which move everywhere held in by straight-guidingreins; friendly and augmented by rays, he has distributed (wealth); he grows in strength nourished with logs ofwood.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निः सप्तिं वाजम्भरं ददात्यग्निर्वीरं श्रुत्यं कर्मनिष्ठाम् । अग्नी रोदसी वि चरत्समञ्जन्नग्निर्नारीं वीरकुक्षिं पुरंधिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniḥ saptiṃ vājambharaṃ dadātyagnirvīraṃ śrutyaṃ karmaniṣṭhām | agnī rodasī vi caratsamañjannagnirnārīṃ vīrakukṣiṃ puraṃdhim ||

translations.english: Agni gives (his worshipper) a food-acquiring steed, Agni gives (him) a valiant son, renowned,assiduous in pious works; Agni travels beautifying heaven and earth; Agni (makes) as woman the bearer of maleoff-spring (and) intelligent.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्नेरप्नसः समिदस्तु भद्राग्निर्मही रोदसी आ विवेश । अग्निरेकं चोदयत्समत्स्वग्निर्वृत्राणि दयते पुरूणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnerapnasaḥ samidastu bhadrāgnirmahī rodasī ā viveśa | agnirekaṃ codayatsamatsvagnirvṛtrāṇi dayate purūṇi ||

translations.english: May the fuel of the efficient Agni be auspicious; Agni has penetrated the vast heaven and earth; Agnianimates (the worshipper) alone in battles; Agni destroys numerous enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निर्ह त्यं जरतः कर्णमावाग्निरद्भ्यो निरदहज्जरूथम् । अग्निरत्रिं घर्म उरुष्यदन्तरग्निर्नृमेधं प्रजयासृजत्सम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirha tyaṃ jarataḥ karṇamāvāgniradbhyo niradahajjarūtham | agniratriṃ gharma uruṣyadantaragnirnṛmedhaṃ prajayāsṛjatsam ||

translations.english: Agni verily has protected Jaratkarṇa; he has consumed Jarūtha with his flames; Agni rescued Atri inthe hot fissure; Agni furnished Nṛmedha with progeny.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निर्दाद्द्रविणं वीरपेशा अग्निॠषिं यः सहस्रा सनोति । अग्निर्दिवि हव्यमा ततानाग्नेर्धामानि विभृता पुरुत्रा ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirdāddraviṇaṃ vīrapeśā agniṝṣiṃ yaḥ sahasrā sanoti | agnirdivi havyamā tatānāgnerdhāmāni vibhṛtā purutrā ||

translations.english: Agni sending forth flames bestows wealth; Agni (gives a son to) the Ṛṣi who acquires a thousandcows; Agni spreads the oblation through heaven, the forms of Agni are manifested in many plural ces.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निमुक्थैॠषयो वि ह्वयन्तेऽग्निं नरो यामनि बाधितासः । अग्निं वयो अन्तरिक्षे पतन्तोऽग्निः सहस्रा परि याति गोनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnimukthaiṝṣayo vi hvayante'gniṃ naro yāmani bādhitāsaḥ | agniṃ vayo antarikṣe patanto'gniḥ sahasrā pari yāti gonām ||

translations.english: The Ṛṣis variously invoke Agni with hymns; men when hard pressed in battle (invoke) Agni; the birdsflying in mid-heaven (invoke) Agni; Agni circumambulates thousands of cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निं विश ईळते मानुषीर्या अग्निं मनुषो नहुषो वि जाताः । अग्निर्गान्धर्वीं पथ्यामृतस्याग्नेर्गव्यूतिर्घृत आ निषत्ता ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniṃ viśa īḷate mānuṣīryā agniṃ manuṣo nahuṣo vi jātāḥ | agnirgāndharvīṃ pathyāmṛtasyāgnergavyūtirghṛta ā niṣattā ||

translations.english: The races who are of human birth praise (Agni, so do the men descended from king Nahuṣa; Agni,(hears) the voice which is fit for the path of sacrifice; Agni's path lies everywhere in ghī.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्नये ब्रह्म ऋभवस्ततक्षुरग्निं महामवोचामा सुवृक्तिम् । अग्ने प्राव जरितारं यविष्ठाग्ने महि द्रविणमा यजस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnaye brahma ṛbhavastatakṣuragniṃ mahāmavocāmā suvṛktim | agne prāva jaritāraṃ yaviṣṭhāgne mahi draviṇamā yajasva ||

translations.english: The Ṛbhus have fabricated praise for Agni; we have recited pious praise to the mighty Agni; Agni,youngest (of the gods), protect your worshipper; Agni, bestow (on him) abundant wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: य इमा विश्वा भुवनानि जुह्वदृषिर्होता न्यसीदत्पिता नः । स आशिषा द्रविणमिच्छमानः प्रथमच्छदवराँ आ विवेश ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya imā viśvā bhuvanāni juhvadṛṣirhotā nyasīdatpitā naḥ | sa āśiṣā draviṇamicchamānaḥ prathamacchadavarā~ ā viveśa ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: किं स्विदासीदधिष्ठानमारम्भणं कतमत्स्वित्कथासीत् । यतो भूमिं जनयन्विश्वकर्मा वि द्यामौर्णोन्महिना विश्वचक्षाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kiṃ svidāsīdadhiṣṭhānamārambhaṇaṃ katamatsvitkathāsīt | yato bhūmiṃ janayanviśvakarmā vi dyāmaurṇonmahinā viśvacakṣāḥ ||

translations.english: What was the station? What was the material? How was (it done)? So that the beholder of all,Viśvakarman (was) genitive rating and disclosed heaven by his might.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वतश्चक्षुरुत विश्वतोमुखो विश्वतोबाहुरुत विश्वतस्पात् । सं बाहुभ्यां धमति सं पतत्रैर्द्यावाभूमी जनयन्देव एकः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvataścakṣuruta viśvatomukho viśvatobāhuruta viśvataspāt | saṃ bāhubhyāṃ dhamati saṃ patatrairdyāvābhūmī janayandeva ekaḥ ||

translations.english: Having eyes everywhere, and having a face everywhere, having arms everywhere, and having feeteverywhere, he traverses (heaven) with his arms, (earth) with his swift-moving (feet), and exists a god withoutcompanion genitive rating heaven and earth.

mantras.sanskrit: किं स्विद्वनं क उ स वृक्ष आस यतो द्यावापृथिवी निष्टतक्षुः । मनीषिणो मनसा पृच्छतेदु तद्यदध्यतिष्ठद्भुवनानि धारयन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kiṃ svidvanaṃ ka u sa vṛkṣa āsa yato dyāvāpṛthivī niṣṭatakṣuḥ | manīṣiṇo manasā pṛcchatedu tadyadadhyatiṣṭhadbhuvanāni dhārayan ||

translations.english: Which was the forest, which the tree, from which they fabricated heaven and earth? Inquire, sages, inyour minds what (plural ce) he was stationed in when holding the worlds.

mantras.sanskrit: या ते धामानि परमाणि यावमा या मध्यमा विश्वकर्मन्नुतेमा । शिक्षा सखिभ्यो हविषि स्वधावः स्वयं यजस्व तन्वं वृधानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā te dhāmāni paramāṇi yāvamā yā madhyamā viśvakarmannutemā | śikṣā sakhibhyo haviṣi svadhāvaḥ svayaṃ yajasva tanvaṃ vṛdhānaḥ ||

translations.english: Grant to your friends, Viśvakarman, at the oblation, your best, your worst and your intermediate forms,and to these do you yourself, possessor of the oblation, becoming augmented in person n (by oblations), offerworship.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वकर्मन्हविषा वावृधानः स्वयं यजस्व पृथिवीमुत द्याम् । मुह्यन्त्वन्ये अभितो जनास इहास्माकं मघवा सूरिरस्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvakarmanhaviṣā vāvṛdhānaḥ svayaṃ yajasva pṛthivīmuta dyām | muhyantvanye abhito janāsa ihāsmākaṃ maghavā sūrirastu ||

translations.english: VIśvakarman, magnified by the oblation, do you of yourself worship earth and heaven; let other men(who offer no oblations) be everywhere confounded; may he, rich in oblations, be the granter of heaven at thisour (sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: वाचस्पतिं विश्वकर्माणमूतये मनोजुवं वाजे अद्या हुवेम । स नो विश्वानि हवनानि जोषद्विश्वशम्भूरवसे साधुकर्मा ॥
mantras.transliteration: vācaspatiṃ viśvakarmāṇamūtaye manojuvaṃ vāje adyā huvema | sa no viśvāni havanāni joṣadviśvaśambhūravase sādhukarmā ||

translations.english: Let us this day invoke for our protection the lord of speech, the creator of all, who is swift as thought;may he, the bestower of all happiness, the doer of good works, be propitiated by all our oblations, (so as) togrant us his protection.

mantras.sanskrit: चक्षुषः पिता मनसा हि धीरो घृतमेने अजनन्नन्नमाने । यदेदन्ता अददृहन्त पूर्व आदिद्द्यावापृथिवी अप्रथेताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: cakṣuṣaḥ pitā manasā hi dhīro ghṛtamene ajanannannamāne | yadedantā adadṛhanta pūrva ādiddyāvāpṛthivī aprathetām ||

translations.english: The maker of the senses, resolute in mind, engendered the water, (and then) these two (heaven andearth) floating (on the waters); when those ancient boundaries were fixed, then the heaven and earth wereexpanded.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वकर्मा विमना आद्विहाया धाता विधाता परमोत संदृक् । तेषामिष्टानि समिषा मदन्ति यत्रा सप्तऋषीन्पर एकमाहुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvakarmā vimanā ādvihāyā dhātā vidhātā paramota saṃdṛk | teṣāmiṣṭāni samiṣā madanti yatrā saptaṛṣīnpara ekamāhuḥ ||

translations.english: Viśvakarman, of comprehensive mind and manifold greatness, is all- pervading, the creator, thearranger and the supreme supervisor; him in whom the desires of their (senses) are satisfied with food, they callsecond line of the ṛca: him in whom they delight their forms (or plural ces) with water, him, those who are skille dinViśvakarman; Nirukta notes that at the universal sacrifice Viśvakarman Bhauvana offered up all beings and thenhimself].

mantras.sanskrit: यो नः पिता जनिता यो विधाता धामानि वेद भुवनानि विश्वा । यो देवानां नामधा एक एव तं सम्प्रश्नं भुवना यन्त्यन्या ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo naḥ pitā janitā yo vidhātā dhāmāni veda bhuvanāni viśvā | yo devānāṃ nāmadhā eka eva taṃ sampraśnaṃ bhuvanā yantyanyā ||

translations.english: He who is our preserver, our parent, the creator (of all), who knows our abodes (and knows) allbeings, who is the name-giver of the gods-- he is one; other beings come to him to inquire.

mantras.sanskrit: त आयजन्त द्रविणं समस्मा ऋषयः पूर्वे जरितारो न भूना । असूर्ते सूर्ते रजसि निषत्ते ये भूतानि समकृण्वन्निमानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ta āyajanta draviṇaṃ samasmā ṛṣayaḥ pūrve jaritāro na bhūnā | asūrte sūrte rajasi niṣatte ye bhūtāni samakṛṇvannimāni ||

translations.english: Those ancient Ṛṣis who adorned (with light) these beings in the animate and inanimate world, offerto him wealth (of sacrifice) as praisers with abundant (laudation).

mantras.sanskrit: परो दिवा पर एना पृथिव्या परो देवेभिरसुरैर्यदस्ति । कं स्विद्गर्भं प्रथमं दध्र आपो यत्र देवाः समपश्यन्त विश्वे ॥
mantras.transliteration: paro divā para enā pṛthivyā paro devebhirasurairyadasti | kaṃ svidgarbhaṃ prathamaṃ dadhra āpo yatra devāḥ samapaśyanta viśve ||

translations.english: What was that embryo which was beyond the heaven, beyond this earth, beyond the gods, beyondthe asuras, which the waters first retained, in which all the gods contemplated each other?

mantras.sanskrit: तमिद्गर्भं प्रथमं दध्र आपो यत्र देवाः समगच्छन्त विश्वे । अजस्य नाभावध्येकमर्पितं यस्मिन्विश्वानि भुवनानि तस्थुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamidgarbhaṃ prathamaṃ dadhra āpo yatra devāḥ samagacchanta viśve | ajasya nābhāvadhyekamarpitaṃ yasminviśvāni bhuvanāni tasthuḥ ||

translations.english: The waters verily first retained the embryo in which all the gods were aggregated, single deposited onthe navel of the unborn (creator), in which all beings abide.

mantras.sanskrit: न तं विदाथ य इमा जजानान्यद्युष्माकमन्तरं बभूव । नीहारेण प्रावृता जल्प्या चासुतृप उक्थशासश्चरन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: na taṃ vidātha ya imā jajānānyadyuṣmākamantaraṃ babhūva | nīhāreṇa prāvṛtā jalpyā cāsutṛpa ukthaśāsaścaranti ||

translations.english: You know not him who has genitive rated these (beings); (his life) is another, different from yours;wrapped in fog, and foolish speech (do they) wander (who are) gluttonous and engaged in devotion.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्ते मन्योऽविधद्वज्र सायक सह ओजः पुष्यति विश्वमानुषक् । साह्याम दासमार्यं त्वया युजा सहस्कृतेन सहसा सहस्वता ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaste manyo'vidhadvajra sāyaka saha ojaḥ puṣyati viśvamānuṣak | sāhyāma dāsamāryaṃ tvayā yujā sahaskṛtena sahasā sahasvatā ||

translations.english: He who worships you, Manyu, the thunderbolt, the destroyer (of enemies), enjoys all might andstrength, combined; may we oversome the Dāsa and the Ārya with you for our ally, invigorating, strong andvigorous.

mantras.sanskrit: मन्युरिन्द्रो मन्युरेवास देवो मन्युर्होता वरुणो जातवेदाः । मन्युं विश ईळते मानुषीर्याः पाहि नो मन्यो तपसा सजोषाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: manyurindro manyurevāsa devo manyurhotā varuṇo jātavedāḥ | manyuṃ viśa īḷate mānuṣīryāḥ pāhi no manyo tapasā sajoṣāḥ ||

translations.english: Manyu is Indra; Manyu verily was a god; Manyu is the sacrificing priest (Agni), the omniscient Varuṇa;the people who are of human descent, praise Manyu; protect us, Manyu, well plural ased along with Tapas.

mantras.sanskrit: अभीहि मन्यो तवसस्तवीयान्तपसा युजा वि जहि शत्रून् । अमित्रहा वृत्रहा दस्युहा च विश्वा वसून्या भरा त्वं नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhīhi manyo tavasastavīyāntapasā yujā vi jahi śatrūn | amitrahā vṛtrahā dasyuhā ca viśvā vasūnyā bharā tvaṃ naḥ ||

translations.english: Come to us Manyuu, who are the strongest of the strong; with Tapas as your ally overthrow ourenemies; do you who are the slayer of enemies, the slayer of adversaries, the slayer of foes, bring to us allriches.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं हि मन्यो अभिभूत्योजाः स्वयम्भूर्भामो अभिमातिषाहः । विश्वचर्षणिः सहुरिः सहावानस्मास्वोजः पृतनासु धेहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ hi manyo abhibhūtyojāḥ svayambhūrbhāmo abhimātiṣāhaḥ | viśvacarṣaṇiḥ sahuriḥ sahāvānasmāsvojaḥ pṛtanāsu dhehi ||

translations.english: Do you, Manyu, who are possessed of over-powering strength, self- existent, irate, the overcomer ofenemies, the beholder of all, enduring, vigorous, grant us strength in battles.

mantras.sanskrit: अभागः सन्नप परेतो अस्मि तव क्रत्वा तविषस्य प्रचेतः । तं त्वा मन्यो अक्रतुर्जिहीळाहं स्वा तनूर्बलदेयाय मेहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhāgaḥ sannapa pareto asmi tava kratvā taviṣasya pracetaḥ | taṃ tvā manyo akraturjihīḷāhaṃ svā tanūrbaladeyāya mehi ||

translations.english: Sage Manyu, taking no part in the worship of you, the powerful one, I have retreated (from before myfoes); worshipping not, I was angry with you; (yet) being (incorporated with) my body, approach me to give mestrength.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं ते अस्म्युप मेह्यर्वाङ्प्रतीचीनः सहुरे विश्वधायः । मन्यो वज्रिन्नभि मामा ववृत्स्व हनाव दस्यूँरुत बोध्यापेः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ te asmyupa mehyarvāṅpratīcīnaḥ sahure viśvadhāyaḥ | manyo vajrinnabhi māmā vavṛtsva hanāva dasyū~ruta bodhyāpeḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: अभि प्रेहि दक्षिणतो भवा मेऽधा वृत्राणि जङ्घनाव भूरि । जुहोमि ते धरुणं मध्वो अग्रमुभा उपांशु प्रथमा पिबाव ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi prehi dakṣiṇato bhavā me'dhā vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanāva bhūri | juhomi te dharuṇaṃ madhvo agramubhā upāṃśu prathamā pibāva ||

translations.english: Approach, be upon my right, let us slay a multitude of foes; I offer to you the best Soma, the sustainer;let us both drink it first in privacy.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वया मन्यो सरथमारुजन्तो हर्षमाणासो धृषिता मरुत्वः । तिग्मेषव आयुधा संशिशाना अभि प्र यन्तु नरो अग्निरूपाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvayā manyo sarathamārujanto harṣamāṇāso dhṛṣitā marutvaḥ | tigmeṣava āyudhā saṃśiśānā abhi pra yantu naro agnirūpāḥ ||

translations.english: May the leaders (of rites) wearing the form of Agni, (ascending) the same car with you, Manyu, whoare accompanied by the Maruts, proceed to combat, advancing, exulting, indignant, armed with sharp arrow,whetting their weapons.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निरिव मन्यो त्विषितः सहस्व सेनानीर्नः सहुरे हूत एधि । हत्वाय शत्रून्वि भजस्व वेद ओजो मिमानो वि मृधो नुदस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniriva manyo tviṣitaḥ sahasva senānīrnaḥ sahure hūta edhi | hatvāya śatrūnvi bhajasva veda ojo mimāno vi mṛdho nudasva ||

translations.english: Manyu, blazing like Agni, overthrow (our foes), come as our genitive ral, enduring (manyu) when invoked(by us) in battle; having slain the enemies divide (among us) the treasure; granting (us) strength, scatter (our)foes.

mantras.sanskrit: सहस्व मन्यो अभिमातिमस्मे रुजन्मृणन्प्रमृणन्प्रेहि शत्रून् । उग्रं ते पाजो नन्वा रुरुध्रे वशी वशं नयस एकज त्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sahasva manyo abhimātimasme rujanmṛṇanpramṛṇanprehi śatrūn | ugraṃ te pājo nanvā rurudhre vaśī vaśaṃ nayasa ekaja tvam ||

translations.english: Overthrow, Manyu, our assailant; advance against our foes, wounding, killing, annihilating them; (who)can resist your fierce might? O you who are without companion, subjecting them you lead them subject.

mantras.sanskrit: एको बहूनामसि मन्यवीळितो विशंविशं युधये सं शिशाधि । अकृत्तरुक्त्वया युजा वयं द्युमन्तं घोषं विजयाय कृण्महे ॥
mantras.transliteration: eko bahūnāmasi manyavīḷito viśaṃviśaṃ yudhaye saṃ śiśādhi | akṛttaruktvayā yujā vayaṃ dyumantaṃ ghoṣaṃ vijayāya kṛṇmahe ||

translations.english: You are praised, Manyu, as (the conqueror) alone of many; animate us to contend with all men; withyyou, O you of unshorn radiance, for our ally, we raise aloud shout for victory.

mantras.sanskrit: विजेषकृदिन्द्र इवानवब्रवोऽस्माकं मन्यो अधिपा भवेह । प्रियं ते नाम सहुरे गृणीमसि विद्मा तमुत्सं यत आबभूथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: vijeṣakṛdindra ivānavabravo'smākaṃ manyo adhipā bhaveha | priyaṃ te nāma sahure gṛṇīmasi vidmā tamutsaṃ yata ābabhūtha ||

translations.english: Manyu, the giver of victory like Indra, irreproachable, be you our protector at this (sacrifice); enduringone, we sing to you acceptable praise; we know this to be the source whence you have become (mighty).

mantras.sanskrit: आभूत्या सहजा वज्र सायक सहो बिभर्ष्यभिभूत उत्तरम् । क्रत्वा नो मन्यो सह मेद्येधि महाधनस्य पुरुहूत संसृजि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ābhūtyā sahajā vajra sāyaka saho bibharṣyabhibhūta uttaram | kratvā no manyo saha medyedhi mahādhanasya puruhūta saṃsṛji ||

translations.english: (Manyu), your destructive thunderbolt, the over-powerer (of foes), twin-born with victory, you possessexceeding strength; be favourable to us, Manyu, in deeds, you who are invoked by many in the shock of battle.

mantras.sanskrit: संसृष्टं धनमुभयं समाकृतमस्मभ्यं दत्तां वरुणश्च मन्युः । भियं दधाना हृदयेषु शत्रवः पराजितासो अप नि लयन्ताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃsṛṣṭaṃ dhanamubhayaṃ samākṛtamasmabhyaṃ dattāṃ varuṇaśca manyuḥ | bhiyaṃ dadhānā hṛdayeṣu śatravaḥ parājitāso apa ni layantām ||

translations.english: May Varuṇa and Manyu bestow upon us wealth of both kinds, undivided and completely our own, andmay our enemies, bearing fear within their hearts, be overcome and utterly destroyed.

mantras.sanskrit: सत्येनोत्तभिता भूमिः सूर्येणोत्तभिता द्यौः । ऋतेनादित्यास्तिष्ठन्ति दिवि सोमो अधि श्रितः ॥
mantras.transliteration: satyenottabhitā bhūmiḥ sūryeṇottabhitā dyauḥ | ṛtenādityāstiṣṭhanti divi somo adhi śritaḥ ||

translations.english: Earth is upheld by truth; heaven is upheld by the sun; the Ādityas are supported by sacrifice, Soma issupreme in heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: सोमेनादित्या बलिनः सोमेन पृथिवी मही । अथो नक्षत्राणामेषामुपस्थे सोम आहितः ॥
mantras.transliteration: somenādityā balinaḥ somena pṛthivī mahī | atho nakṣatrāṇāmeṣāmupasthe soma āhitaḥ ||

translations.english: By Soma the Ādityas are strong; by Soma the earth is great; Soma is stationed in the vicinity of theseNakṣatras.

mantras.sanskrit: सोमं मन्यते पपिवान्यत्सम्पिंषन्त्योषधिम् । सोमं यं ब्रह्माणो विदुर्न तस्याश्नाति कश्चन ॥
mantras.transliteration: somaṃ manyate papivānyatsampiṃṣantyoṣadhim | somaṃ yaṃ brahmāṇo vidurna tasyāśnāti kaścana ||

translations.english: He who has drunk thinks that the herb which men crush is the Soma; (but) that which theBrāhmaṇas know to be Soma,, of that no one partakes. {i.e., no one partakes of it unless he has sacrificed; ifthe Soma be taken as the moon, 'no one' will mean 'no one but the gods'].

mantras.sanskrit: आच्छद्विधानैर्गुपितो बार्हतैः सोम रक्षितः । ग्राव्णामिच्छृण्वन्तिष्ठसि न ते अश्नाति पार्थिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ācchadvidhānairgupito bārhataiḥ soma rakṣitaḥ | grāvṇāmicchṛṇvantiṣṭhasi na te aśnāti pārthivaḥ ||

translations.english: Concealed by means of coverings, protected by the Bārhats, O Soma, you abide listening to thegrinding-stones; no terrestrial being partakes of you.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्त्वा देव प्रपिबन्ति तत आ प्यायसे पुनः । वायुः सोमस्य रक्षिता समानां मास आकृतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yattvā deva prapibanti tata ā pyāyase punaḥ | vāyuḥ somasya rakṣitā samānāṃ māsa ākṛtiḥ ||

translations.english: When, O god, they quaff you, then do you renew yourself again; Vāyu is the guardian of Soma, themaker of years and months.

mantras.sanskrit: रैभ्यासीदनुदेयी नाराशंसी न्योचनी । सूर्याया भद्रमिद्वासो गाथयैति परिष्कृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: raibhyāsīdanudeyī nārāśaṃsī nyocanī | sūryāyā bhadramidvāso gāthayaiti pariṣkṛtam ||

translations.english: Raibhi was her companion; Nārāśaṃsī her slave; Sūrya's lovely dress was adorned by Gātha.

mantras.sanskrit: चित्तिरा उपबर्हणं चक्षुरा अभ्यञ्जनम् । द्यौर्भूमिः कोश आसीद्यदयात्सूर्या पतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: cittirā upabarhaṇaṃ cakṣurā abhyañjanam | dyaurbhūmiḥ kośa āsīdyadayātsūryā patim ||

translations.english: Citti (mind) was the pillow, the eye was the collyrium; heaven and earth were the box when Sūryawent to her husband.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तोमा आसन्प्रतिधयः कुरीरं छन्द ओपशः । सूर्याया अश्विना वराग्निरासीत्पुरोगवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: stomā āsanpratidhayaḥ kurīraṃ chanda opaśaḥ | sūryāyā aśvinā varāgnirāsītpurogavaḥ ||

translations.english: Hymns were the cross-bars (of the car); the Kurīra metre was the thong of the whip; the Aśvins wereSūrya's groomsmen; Agni was the leader of the procession.

mantras.sanskrit: सोमो वधूयुरभवदश्विनास्तामुभा वरा । सूर्यां यत्पत्ये शंसन्तीं मनसा सविताददात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: somo vadhūyurabhavadaśvināstāmubhā varā | sūryāṃ yatpatye śaṃsantīṃ manasā savitādadāt ||

translations.english: Soma was desirous of a bride; the two Aśvins were the two groomsmen when Savitā gave Sūrya,who was ripe for a husband, (to Soma endowed) with intelligence.

mantras.sanskrit: मनो अस्या अन आसीद्द्यौरासीदुत च्छदिः । शुक्रावनड्वाहावास्तां यदयात्सूर्या गृहम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mano asyā ana āsīddyaurāsīduta cchadiḥ | śukrāvanaḍvāhāvāstāṃ yadayātsūryā gṛham ||

translations.english: Mind was her chariot, and heaven was the covering, the two shining (orbs) were the oxen whenSūrya went to (her husband's) dwelling.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋक्सामाभ्यामभिहितौ गावौ ते सामनावितः । श्रोत्रं ते चक्रे आस्तां दिवि पन्थाश्चराचारः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛksāmābhyāmabhihitau gāvau te sāmanāvitaḥ | śrotraṃ te cakre āstāṃ divi panthāścarācāraḥ ||

translations.english: Those two oxen yoked by the Ṛk and the Sāman march equally; the two wheels were your ears; themoving path (was) in heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: शुची ते चक्रे यात्या व्यानो अक्ष आहतः । अनो मनस्मयं सूर्यारोहत्प्रयती पतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śucī te cakre yātyā vyāno akṣa āhataḥ | ano manasmayaṃ sūryārohatprayatī patim ||

translations.english: The two swift-moving wheels were your pure (cars). Vāyu was the fastened axle, Sūrya mountedthe chariot of the Mind, going to her lord.

mantras.sanskrit: सूर्याया वहतुः प्रागात्सविता यमवासृजत् । अघासु हन्यन्ते गावोऽर्जुन्योः पर्युह्यते ॥
mantras.transliteration: sūryāyā vahatuḥ prāgātsavitā yamavāsṛjat | aghāsu hanyante gāvo'rjunyoḥ paryuhyate ||

translations.english: Sūrya's bridal procession which Savitā despatched has advanced; the oxen are whipped along inthe Magha (constellations); she is borne (to her husband's house) in the Arjunī (constellations).

mantras.sanskrit: यदश्विना पृच्छमानावयातं त्रिचक्रेण वहतुं सूर्यायाः । विश्वे देवा अनु तद्वामजानन्पुत्रः पितराववृणीत पूषा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadaśvinā pṛcchamānāvayātaṃ tricakreṇa vahatuṃ sūryāyāḥ | viśve devā anu tadvāmajānanputraḥ pitarāvavṛṇīta pūṣā ||

translations.english: When, Aśvins, you came in your three-wheeled car soliciting the marriage of Sūrya, then all thegods, assented and Pūṣan (your) son chose (you as) his parents.

mantras.sanskrit: यदयातं शुभस्पती वरेयं सूर्यामुप । क्वैकं चक्रं वामासीत्क्व देष्ट्राय तस्थथुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadayātaṃ śubhaspatī vareyaṃ sūryāmupa | kvaikaṃ cakraṃ vāmāsītkva deṣṭrāya tasthathuḥ ||

translations.english: When, lords of water, you came to the giver-away (to get) Sūrya, where was the one wheel of yourcar, where did you stand to make the gift?

mantras.sanskrit: द्वे ते चक्रे सूर्ये ब्रह्माण ऋतुथा विदुः । अथैकं चक्रं यद्गुहा तदद्धातय इद्विदुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dve te cakre sūrye brahmāṇa ṛtuthā viduḥ | athaikaṃ cakraṃ yadguhā tadaddhātaya idviduḥ ||

translations.english: Sūrya, the Brāhmaṇas know your chariot wheels in their season; the single wheel that isconcealed, the sages know it also.

mantras.sanskrit: सूर्यायै देवेभ्यो मित्राय वरुणाय च । ये भूतस्य प्रचेतस इदं तेभ्योऽकरं नमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sūryāyai devebhyo mitrāya varuṇāya ca | ye bhūtasya pracetasa idaṃ tebhyo'karaṃ namaḥ ||

translations.english: I offer this adoration to Sūrya, to the gods, to Mitra and Varuṇa, (and to all those) who areconsiderate to created beings.

mantras.sanskrit: पूर्वापरं चरतो माययैतौ शिशू क्रीळन्तौ परि यातो अध्वरम् । विश्वान्यन्यो भुवनाभिचष्ट ऋतूँरन्यो विदधज्जायते पुनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pūrvāparaṃ carato māyayaitau śiśū krīḷantau pari yāto adhvaram | viśvānyanyo bhuvanābhicaṣṭa ṛtū~ranyo vidadhajjāyate punaḥ ||

translations.english: These two (the sun and moon) wandering in thought one after the other, youthful, sportive, approachthe sacrifice; one (of them) looks over all worlds, the other regulating the seasons is born repeatedly.

mantras.sanskrit: नवोनवो भवति जायमानोऽह्नां केतुरुषसामेत्यग्रम् । भागं देवेभ्यो वि दधात्यायन्प्र चन्द्रमास्तिरते दीर्घमायुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: navonavo bhavati jāyamāno'hnāṃ keturuṣasāmetyagram | bhāgaṃ devebhyo vi dadhātyāyanpra candramāstirate dīrghamāyuḥ ||

translations.english: New every day (the moon) is born; the manifester of days he goes on front of the Dawns; hedistributes their portion to the gods as he goes; the moon protracts a long existence.

mantras.sanskrit: सुकिंशुकं शल्मलिं विश्वरूपं हिरण्यवर्णं सुवृतं सुचक्रम् । आ रोह सूर्ये अमृतस्य लोकं स्योनं पत्ये वहतुं कृणुष्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: sukiṃśukaṃ śalmaliṃ viśvarūpaṃ hiraṇyavarṇaṃ suvṛtaṃ sucakram | ā roha sūrye amṛtasya lokaṃ syonaṃ patye vahatuṃ kṛṇuṣva ||

translations.english: Ascend, Sūrya, the chariot made of good kiṃśuka wood and of śalmali, multiform, decorated withgold, well-covered, well-wheeled, prepare the happy world of the immortals, your marriage procession to yourhusband.

mantras.sanskrit: उदीर्ष्वातः पतिवती ह्येषा विश्वावसुं नमसा गीर्भिरीळे । अन्यामिच्छ पितृषदं व्यक्तां स ते भागो जनुषा तस्य विद्धि ॥
mantras.transliteration: udīrṣvātaḥ pativatī hyeṣā viśvāvasuṃ namasā gīrbhirīḷe | anyāmiccha pitṛṣadaṃ vyaktāṃ sa te bhāgo januṣā tasya viddhi ||

translations.english: Rise up from hence, for this (damsel) has a husband; I worship Viśvāvasu with reverence and withhymns; seek for another maiden still dwelling in her father's house, decorated with ornaments; that is yourportion, know this (to your portion, take it) from your birth.

mantras.sanskrit: उदीर्ष्वातो विश्वावसो नमसेळा महे त्वा । अन्यामिच्छ प्रफर्व्यं सं जायां पत्या सृज ॥
mantras.transliteration: udīrṣvāto viśvāvaso namaseḷā mahe tvā | anyāmiccha prapharvyaṃ saṃ jāyāṃ patyā sṛja ||

translations.english: Rise up from here, Viśvāvasu, we worship you with reverence; seek another maiden, one with largehips; leave the bride with her husband.

mantras.sanskrit: अनृक्षरा ऋजवः सन्तु पन्था येभिः सखायो यन्ति नो वरेयम् । समर्यमा सं भगो नो निनीयात्सं जास्पत्यं सुयममस्तु देवाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: anṛkṣarā ṛjavaḥ santu panthā yebhiḥ sakhāyo yanti no vareyam | samaryamā saṃ bhago no ninīyātsaṃ jāspatyaṃ suyamamastu devāḥ ||

translations.english: Smooth and straight be the paths by which our friends repair to the bride's father; may Aryaman, mayBhaga conduct us, and may the union of the wife and husband be easily accomplished, O gods.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र त्वा मुञ्चामि वरुणस्य पाशाद्येन त्वाबध्नात्सविता सुशेवः । ऋतस्य योनौ सुकृतस्य लोकेऽरिष्टां त्वा सह पत्या दधामि ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra tvā muñcāmi varuṇasya pāśādyena tvābadhnātsavitā suśevaḥ | ṛtasya yonau sukṛtasya loke'riṣṭāṃ tvā saha patyā dadhāmi ||

translations.english: I set you free from the noose of Varuṇa, wherewith the adorable Savitā had bound you; in the plural ceof sacrifice in the world of good deeds I unite you, unharmed, with your husband.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रेतो मुञ्चामि नामुतः सुबद्धाममुतस्करम् । यथेयमिन्द्र मीढ्वः सुपुत्रा सुभगासति ॥
mantras.transliteration: preto muñcāmi nāmutaḥ subaddhāmamutaskaram | yatheyamindra mīḍhvaḥ suputrā subhagāsati ||

translations.english: I set you free from there, not from here; I plural ce you here firmly bound; grant, Indra, showerer, that this(damsel) may have excellent children, and be very fortunate.

mantras.sanskrit: पूषा त्वेतो नयतु हस्तगृह्याश्विना त्वा प्र वहतां रथेन । गृहान्गच्छ गृहपत्नी यथासो वशिनी त्वं विदथमा वदासि ॥
mantras.transliteration: pūṣā tveto nayatu hastagṛhyāśvinā tvā pra vahatāṃ rathena | gṛhāngaccha gṛhapatnī yathāso vaśinī tvaṃ vidathamā vadāsi ||

translations.english: May Pūṣan lead you hence, taking you by the hand; may the Aśvins convey you away in their car,go to the dwelling (of your husband) as you are the mistress of the house; you, submissive (to your husband),give orders to his household.

mantras.sanskrit: इह प्रियं प्रजया ते समृध्यतामस्मिन्गृहे गार्हपत्याय जागृहि । एना पत्या तन्वं सं सृजस्वाधा जिव्री विदथमा वदाथः ॥
mantras.transliteration: iha priyaṃ prajayā te samṛdhyatāmasmingṛhe gārhapatyāya jāgṛhi | enā patyā tanvaṃ saṃ sṛjasvādhā jivrī vidathamā vadāthaḥ ||

translations.english: In this your (husband's family) may affection increase with offspring, be watchful over the domestic firein this house; unite your person n with this your husband; and both growing old together govern your household.

mantras.sanskrit: नीललोहितं भवति कृत्यासक्तिर्व्यज्यते । एधन्ते अस्या ज्ञातयः पतिर्बन्धेषु बध्यते ॥
mantras.transliteration: nīlalohitaṃ bhavati kṛtyāsaktirvyajyate | edhante asyā jñātayaḥ patirbandheṣu badhyate ||

translations.english: Blue and red is (her form); devoted (to her) is left behind; her kinsmen prosper, the husband is boundin bonds.

mantras.sanskrit: परा देहि शामुल्यं ब्रह्मभ्यो वि भजा वसु । कृत्यैषा पद्वती भूत्व्या जाया विशते पतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: parā dehi śāmulyaṃ brahmabhyo vi bhajā vasu | kṛtyaiṣā padvatī bhūtvyā jāyā viśate patim ||

translations.english: Put away the garment soiled by the body; give wealth to the Brāhmaṇas; this Kṛtyā having becomeendowed with feet, enters the husband's heart as his wife.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्रीरा तनूर्भवति रुशती पापयामुया । पतिर्यद्वध्वो वाससा स्वमङ्गमभिधित्सते ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśrīrā tanūrbhavati ruśatī pāpayāmuyā | patiryadvadhvo vāsasā svamaṅgamabhidhitsate ||

translations.english: The (bridegroom's) body is lacking in beauty; shining with this wicked (Kṛtyā), when he wishes to clothe his own limbs with his wife's garments.

mantras.sanskrit: ये वध्वश्चन्द्रं वहतुं यक्ष्मा यन्ति जनादनु । पुनस्तान्यज्ञिया देवा नयन्तु यत आगताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye vadhvaścandraṃ vahatuṃ yakṣmā yanti janādanu | punastānyajñiyā devā nayantu yata āgatāḥ ||

translations.english: May the adorable gods drive back again to the plural ce whence they came the diseases which followfrom (other) people the wife's golden bridal procession.

mantras.sanskrit: मा विदन्परिपन्थिनो य आसीदन्ति दम्पती । सुगेभिर्दुर्गमतीतामप द्रान्त्वरातयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā vidanparipanthino ya āsīdanti dampatī | sugebhirdurgamatītāmapa drāntvarātayaḥ ||

translations.english: Let not the robbers who approach the husband and wife reach them; may they by easy roads pass thedifficulty; may enemies keep aloof.

mantras.sanskrit: सुमङ्गलीरियं वधूरिमां समेत पश्यत । सौभाग्यमस्यै दत्त्वायाथास्तं वि परेतन ॥
mantras.transliteration: sumaṅgalīriyaṃ vadhūrimāṃ sameta paśyata | saubhāgyamasyai dattvāyāthāstaṃ vi paretana ||

translations.english: Fortunate is this bride, approach, behold her; having given her your congratulations, depart to yourseveral homes.

mantras.sanskrit: तृष्टमेतत्कटुकमेतदपाष्ठवद्विषवन्नैतदत्तवे । सूर्यां यो ब्रह्मा विद्यात्स इद्वाधूयमर्हति ॥
mantras.transliteration: tṛṣṭametatkaṭukametadapāṣṭhavadviṣavannaitadattave | sūryāṃ yo brahmā vidyātsa idvādhūyamarhati ||

translations.english: This (garment) is inflaming, it is pungent; it is like stale Soma; it is like poison; it is not fit to eat; theBrāhmaṇa, who knows Sūrya, verily desires the bridal (garment).

mantras.sanskrit: आशसनं विशसनमथो अधिविकर्तनम् । सूर्यायाः पश्य रूपाणि तानि ब्रह्मा तु शुन्धति ॥
mantras.transliteration: āśasanaṃ viśasanamatho adhivikartanam | sūryāyāḥ paśya rūpāṇi tāni brahmā tu śundhati ||

translations.english: Behold the forms of Sūrya, the āśasana (bordercloth) the viśasana (headcloth), the adhivikartana(divided skirt); of these the Brāhmaṇa relieves her.

mantras.sanskrit: गृभ्णामि ते सौभगत्वाय हस्तं मया पत्या जरदष्टिर्यथासः । भगो अर्यमा सविता पुरंधिर्मह्यं त्वादुर्गार्हपत्याय देवाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: gṛbhṇāmi te saubhagatvāya hastaṃ mayā patyā jaradaṣṭiryathāsaḥ | bhago aryamā savitā puraṃdhirmahyaṃ tvādurgārhapatyāya devāḥ ||

translations.english: I take your hand for good fortune, that you may attain old age with me as your husband; the godsBhaga, Aryaman, Savitā, Purandhi have given you to me, that I may be the master of a household.

mantras.sanskrit: तां पूषञ्छिवतमामेरयस्व यस्यां बीजं मनुष्या वपन्ति । या न ऊरू उशती विश्रयाते यस्यामुशन्तः प्रहराम शेपम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tāṃ pūṣañchivatamāmerayasva yasyāṃ bījaṃ manuṣyā vapanti | yā na ūrū uśatī viśrayāte yasyāmuśantaḥ praharāma śepam ||

translations.english: Pūṣan, inspire her who is most auspicious, in whom men may now seed, who most affectionate maybe devoted to us, and in whom animated by desire we may beget progeny.

mantras.sanskrit: तुभ्यमग्रे पर्यवहन्त्सूर्यां वहतुना सह । पुनः पतिभ्यो जायां दा अग्ने प्रजया सह ॥
mantras.transliteration: tubhyamagre paryavahantsūryāṃ vahatunā saha | punaḥ patibhyo jāyāṃ dā agne prajayā saha ||

translations.english: (The Gandharvas) gave Sūrya to you, Agni, with her bridal ornaments; do you, Agni, give (us)husbands our wife back again with male offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: पुनः पत्नीमग्निरदादायुषा सह वर्चसा । दीर्घायुरस्या यः पतिर्जीवाति शरदः शतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: punaḥ patnīmagniradādāyuṣā saha varcasā | dīrghāyurasyā yaḥ patirjīvāti śaradaḥ śatam ||

translations.english: Agni gave the wife back again with life and splendour; may he who is her husband enjoying long lifelive a hundred years.

mantras.sanskrit: सोमः प्रथमो विविदे गन्धर्वो विविद उत्तरः । तृतीयो अग्निष्टे पतिस्तुरीयस्ते मनुष्यजाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: somaḥ prathamo vivide gandharvo vivida uttaraḥ | tṛtīyo agniṣṭe patisturīyaste manuṣyajāḥ ||

translations.english: Soma first obtained the bride; the Gandharva obtained her next. Agni was your third husband; yourfourth (husband) is born of man.

mantras.sanskrit: सोमो ददद्गन्धर्वाय गन्धर्वो दददग्नये । रयिं च पुत्राँश्चादादग्निर्मह्यमथो इमाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: somo dadadgandharvāya gandharvo dadadagnaye | rayiṃ ca putrā~ścādādagnirmahyamatho imām ||

translations.english: Soma gave her to the Gandharva; the Gandharva gave her to Agni; Agni has given her to me andwealth and sons.

mantras.sanskrit: इहैव स्तं मा वि यौष्टं विश्वमायुर्व्यश्नुतम् । क्रीळन्तौ पुत्रैर्नप्तृभिर्मोदमानौ स्वे गृहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ihaiva staṃ mā vi yauṣṭaṃ viśvamāyurvyaśnutam | krīḷantau putrairnaptṛbhirmodamānau sve gṛhe ||

translations.english: Abide here together; may you never be separated; live together all your lives, sporting with sons andgrandsons, happy in your own home.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नः प्रजां जनयतु प्रजापतिराजरसाय समनक्त्वर्यमा । अदुर्मङ्गलीः पतिलोकमा विश शं नो भव द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā naḥ prajāṃ janayatu prajāpatirājarasāya samanaktvaryamā | adurmaṅgalīḥ patilokamā viśa śaṃ no bhava dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade ||

translations.english: May Prajāpati grant us progeny, may Aryaman unite us together until old age; free from all evil omensenter your husband's abode, be the bringer of prosperity to our bipeds and quadrupeds.

mantras.sanskrit: अघोरचक्षुरपतिघ्न्येधि शिवा पशुभ्यः सुमनाः सुवर्चाः । वीरसूर्देवकामा स्योना शं नो भव द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: aghoracakṣurapatighnyedhi śivā paśubhyaḥ sumanāḥ suvarcāḥ | vīrasūrdevakāmā syonā śaṃ no bhava dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade ||

translations.english: (Look upon your husband) with no angry eye, be not hostile to your lord, be tender to animals, beamiable, be very glorious; be the mother of males, be devoted to the gods, be the bestower of happiness, be thebringer of prosperity to our bipeds and quadrupeds.

mantras.sanskrit: इमां त्वमिन्द्र मीढ्वः सुपुत्रां सुभगां कृणु । दशास्यां पुत्राना धेहि पतिमेकादशं कृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: imāṃ tvamindra mīḍhvaḥ suputrāṃ subhagāṃ kṛṇu | daśāsyāṃ putrānā dhehi patimekādaśaṃ kṛdhi ||

translations.english: Indra, showerer, make her the mother of sons, plural asing (to her husband); give her ten sons, make herhusband the eleventh.

mantras.sanskrit: सम्राज्ञी श्वशुरे भव सम्राज्ञी श्वश्र्वां भव । ननान्दरि सम्राज्ञी भव सम्राज्ञी अधि देवृषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: samrājñī śvaśure bhava samrājñī śvaśrvāṃ bhava | nanāndari samrājñī bhava samrājñī adhi devṛṣu ||

translations.english: Be a queen to your father-in-law, be a queen to your mother-in-law, be a queen to your husband'ssister, be a queen to your husband's brother.

mantras.sanskrit: समञ्जन्तु विश्वे देवाः समापो हृदयानि नौ । सं मातरिश्वा सं धाता समु देष्ट्री दधातु नौ ॥
mantras.transliteration: samañjantu viśve devāḥ samāpo hṛdayāni nau | saṃ mātariśvā saṃ dhātā samu deṣṭrī dadhātu nau ||

translations.english: May the universal gods unite both our hearts; may the waters unite them; may Mātariśvan, Dhātāand the bountiful (Sarasvatī) unite both our hearts.

mantras.sanskrit: वि हि सोतोरसृक्षत नेन्द्रं देवममंसत । यत्रामदद्वृषाकपिरर्यः पुष्टेषु मत्सखा विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi hi sotorasṛkṣata nendraṃ devamamaṃsata | yatrāmadadvṛṣākapiraryaḥ puṣṭeṣu matsakhā viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: परा हीन्द्र धावसि वृषाकपेरति व्यथिः । नो अह प्र विन्दस्यन्यत्र सोमपीतये विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: parā hīndra dhāvasi vṛṣākaperati vyathiḥ | no aha pra vindasyanyatra somapītaye viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||

translations.english: Indrāṇī speaks: You, Indra, much annoyed, hasten towards Vṛṣākapi; and yet you find no otherplace to drink the Soma; Indra is above all (the world).

mantras.sanskrit: किमयं त्वां वृषाकपिश्चकार हरितो मृगः । यस्मा इरस्यसीदु न्वर्यो वा पुष्टिमद्वसु विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kimayaṃ tvāṃ vṛṣākapiścakāra harito mṛgaḥ | yasmā irasyasīdu nvaryo vā puṣṭimadvasu viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||

translations.english: What (favour) has this tawny deer Vṛṣākapi done to you that you should like a liberal (benefactor)bestow upon him wealth and nourish me; Indra is above all (the world).

mantras.sanskrit: यमिमं त्वं वृषाकपिं प्रियमिन्द्राभिरक्षसि । श्वा न्वस्य जम्भिषदपि कर्णे वराहयुर्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yamimaṃ tvaṃ vṛṣākapiṃ priyamindrābhirakṣasi | śvā nvasya jambhiṣadapi karṇe varāhayurviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||

translations.english: This Vṛṣākapi whom you, Indra, cherish as your dear (son)-- may the dog which chases the boar(seize) him by the ear (and) devour him; Indra is above all (the world).

mantras.sanskrit: प्रिया तष्टानि मे कपिर्व्यक्ता व्यदूदुषत् । शिरो न्वस्य राविषं न सुगं दुष्कृते भुवं विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: priyā taṣṭāni me kapirvyaktā vyadūduṣat | śiro nvasya rāviṣaṃ na sugaṃ duṣkṛte bhuvaṃ viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||

translations.english: The ape has spoiled the beloved ghī-adorned (oblations) made to me (by worshippers); let mequickly cut off his head, let me not be the giver of happiness to one who works evil; Indra is above all (the world).

mantras.sanskrit: न मत्स्त्री सुभसत्तरा न सुयाशुतरा भुवत् । न मत्प्रतिच्यवीयसी न सक्थ्युद्यमीयसी विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: na matstrī subhasattarā na suyāśutarā bhuvat | na matpraticyavīyasī na sakthyudyamīyasī viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||

translations.english: There is no woman more amiable than I am, not one who bears fairer sons than I; nor one moretractable not one more ardent; Indra is above all (the world).

mantras.sanskrit: उवे अम्ब सुलाभिके यथेवाङ्ग भविष्यति । भसन्मे अम्ब सक्थि मे शिरो मे वीव हृष्यति विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uve amba sulābhike yathevāṅga bhaviṣyati | bhasanme amba sakthi me śiro me vīva hṛṣyati viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||

translations.english: [Vṛṣākapi speaks]: O mother, who are easy of access, it will quickly be as (you have said); may my(father) and you, mother, be united; may it delight my (father) and your head like a bird; Indra is above all (theworld).

mantras.sanskrit: किं सुबाहो स्वङ्गुरे पृथुष्टो पृथुजाघने । किं शूरपत्नि नस्त्वमभ्यमीषि वृषाकपिं विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kiṃ subāho svaṅgure pṛthuṣṭo pṛthujāghane | kiṃ śūrapatni nastvamabhyamīṣi vṛṣākapiṃ viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||

translations.english: [Indra speaks]: You who have beautiful arms, who have beautiful fingers, long-haired, broad-hipped,why are you angry with our Vṛṣākapi, O you wife of a hero; Indra is above all (the world).

mantras.sanskrit: अवीरामिव मामयं शरारुरभि मन्यते । उताहमस्मि वीरिणीन्द्रपत्नी मरुत्सखा विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: avīrāmiva māmayaṃ śarārurabhi manyate | utāhamasmi vīriṇīndrapatnī marutsakhā viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||

translations.english: [Indrāṇī speaks]: This savage beast (Vṛṣākapi) despises me as one who has no male (protector),and yet I am the mother of male offspring, the wife of Indra, the friend of the Maruts; Indra is above all (the world).

mantras.sanskrit: संहोत्रं स्म पुरा नारी समनं वाव गच्छति । वेधा ऋतस्य वीरिणीन्द्रपत्नी महीयते विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃhotraṃ sma purā nārī samanaṃ vāva gacchati | vedhā ṛtasya vīriṇīndrapatnī mahīyate viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||

translations.english: The mother who is the instrumental tutress of the ceremony, the mother of male offspring, the wife of Indra,goes first to the united sacrifice to battle, (and) is honoured (by the praisers); Indra is above all (the world).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राणीमासु नारिषु सुभगामहमश्रवम् । नह्यस्या अपरं चन जरसा मरते पतिर्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāṇīmāsu nāriṣu subhagāmahamaśravam | nahyasyā aparaṃ cana jarasā marate patirviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||

translations.english: (Indra speaks]: I have heard that Indrāṇī is the most fortunate among these women, for her lordIndra, who is above all (the world), does ot die of old age like other (men).

mantras.sanskrit: नाहमिन्द्राणि रारण सख्युर्वृषाकपेॠते । यस्येदमप्यं हविः प्रियं देवेषु गच्छति विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nāhamindrāṇi rāraṇa sakhyurvṛṣākapeṝte | yasyedamapyaṃ haviḥ priyaṃ deveṣu gacchati viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||

translations.english: I am not happy, Indrāṇi, without my friend Vṛṣākapi; whose acceptable oblation here, purified withwater, proceeds to the gods; Indra is above all (the world).

mantras.sanskrit: वृषाकपायि रेवति सुपुत्र आदु सुस्नुषे । घसत्त इन्द्र उक्षणः प्रियं काचित्करं हविर्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣākapāyi revati suputra ādu susnuṣe | ghasatta indra ukṣaṇaḥ priyaṃ kācitkaraṃ havirviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||

translations.english: [Vṛṣākapi speaks]: O mother of Vṛṣākapi, wealthy, possessing excellent sons, possessingexcellent daughters-in-law, let Indra eat your bulls, (give him) the beloved and most delightful ghī, Indra is aboveall (the world).

mantras.sanskrit: उक्ष्णो हि मे पञ्चदश साकं पचन्ति विंशतिम् । उताहमद्मि पीव इदुभा कुक्षी पृणन्ति मे विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ukṣṇo hi me pañcadaśa sākaṃ pacanti viṃśatim | utāhamadmi pīva idubhā kukṣī pṛṇanti me viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||

translations.english: [Indra speaks]: The worshippers dress for me fifteen (and) twenty bulls; I eat them and (become) fat,they fill both sides of my belly; Indra is above all (the world).

mantras.sanskrit: वृषभो न तिग्मशृङ्गोऽन्तर्यूथेषु रोरुवत् । मन्थस्त इन्द्र शं हृदे यं ते सुनोति भावयुर्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣabho na tigmaśṛṅgo'ntaryūtheṣu roruvat | manthasta indra śaṃ hṛde yaṃ te sunoti bhāvayurviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||

translations.english: [Indrāṇī speaks]: Like a sharp-horned bull roaring among the herds, so may your libation plural aseworld).

mantras.sanskrit: न सेशे यस्य रम्बतेऽन्तरा सक्थ्या कपृत् । सेदीशे यस्य रोमशं निषेदुषो विजृम्भते विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: na seśe yasya rambate'ntarā sakthyā kapṛt | sedīśe yasya romaśaṃ niṣeduṣo vijṛmbhate viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||

translations.english: The man who is impotent begets not progeny, but he who is endowed with vigour; Indra is above all(the world).

mantras.sanskrit: न सेशे यस्य रोमशं निषेदुषो विजृम्भते । सेदीशे यस्य रम्बतेऽन्तरा सक्थ्या कपृद्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: na seśe yasya romaśaṃ niṣeduṣo vijṛmbhate | sedīśe yasya rambate'ntarā sakthyā kapṛdviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||

translations.english: [Indra speaks]: He who is endowed with vigour begets not progeny, but he who is impotent; Indra isabove all (the world).

mantras.sanskrit: अयमिन्द्र वृषाकपिः परस्वन्तं हतं विदत् । असिं सूनां नवं चरुमादेधस्यान आचितं विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayamindra vṛṣākapiḥ parasvantaṃ hataṃ vidat | asiṃ sūnāṃ navaṃ carumādedhasyāna ācitaṃ viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||

translations.english: [Indrāṇī speaks]: Let this Vṛṣākapi, Indra, take a dead wild ass, (let him take) a knife (to cut it up),a fire-plural ce (to cook it), a new saucepan, and a cart full of fuel; Indra is above all (the world).

mantras.sanskrit: अयमेमि विचाकशद्विचिन्वन्दासमार्यम् । पिबामि पाकसुत्वनोऽभि धीरमचाकशं विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayamemi vicākaśadvicinvandāsamāryam | pibāmi pākasutvano'bhi dhīramacākaśaṃ viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||

translations.english: [Indra speaks]: Here I come to the (sacrifice) looking upon (the worshippers), distinguishing the Dāsaand the Ārya; I drink (the Soma) of the (worshipper), who effuses (the Soma) with mature (mind); I look upon theintelligent (sacrificer); Indra is above all (the world).

mantras.sanskrit: धन्व च यत्कृन्तत्रं च कति स्वित्ता वि योजना । नेदीयसो वृषाकपेऽस्तमेहि गृहाँ उप विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhanva ca yatkṛntatraṃ ca kati svittā vi yojanā | nedīyaso vṛṣākape'stamehi gṛhā~ upa viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||

translations.english: Go home, Vṣs.ākapi, to the halls of sacrifice (from the lurking- plural ce of the enemy), which is desertand forest (how many leagues are there from there?) and from the nearest (lurking-plural ce); Indra is above all (theworld).

mantras.sanskrit: पुनरेहि वृषाकपे सुविता कल्पयावहै । य एष स्वप्ननंशनोऽस्तमेषि पथा पुनर्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: punarehi vṛṣākape suvitā kalpayāvahai | ya eṣa svapnanaṃśano'stameṣi pathā punarviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||

translations.english: Come back, Vṛṣākapi, that we may do what is agreeable to you; you, who are the destroyer ofsleep, come home again by the road; Indra is above all (the world).

mantras.sanskrit: यदुदञ्चो वृषाकपे गृहमिन्द्राजगन्तन । क्व स्य पुल्वघो मृगः कमगञ्जनयोपनो विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadudañco vṛṣākape gṛhamindrājagantana | kva sya pulvagho mṛgaḥ kamagañjanayopano viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||

translations.english: Rise up and come home, Vṛṣākapi and Indra; where is that destructive beast, to what (region) has(that beast), the exhilarator of men, gone? Indra is above all (the world).

mantras.sanskrit: पर्शुर्ह नाम मानवी साकं ससूव विंशतिम् । भद्रं भल त्यस्या अभूद्यस्या उदरमामयद्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: parśurha nāma mānavī sākaṃ sasūva viṃśatim | bhadraṃ bhala tyasyā abhūdyasyā udaramāmayadviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||

translations.english: The daughter of Manu, Parśu by name, bore twenty children at once; may good fortune, O arrow ofIndra, befall her whose belly was so prolific; Indra is above all (the world).

mantras.sanskrit: रक्षोहणं वाजिनमा जिघर्मि मित्रं प्रथिष्ठमुप यामि शर्म । शिशानो अग्निः क्रतुभिः समिद्धः स नो दिवा स रिषः पातु नक्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: rakṣohaṇaṃ vājinamā jigharmi mitraṃ prathiṣṭhamupa yāmi śarma | śiśāno agniḥ kratubhiḥ samiddhaḥ sa no divā sa riṣaḥ pātu naktam ||

translations.english: I offer clarified butter to the powerful Agni, the slayer of rākṣasas, I approach the most spaciousdwelling, the friend (of worshippers); Agni sharpening (his flames) is kindled by pious men; may he guard us frommalignant spirits by day and by night.

mantras.sanskrit: अयोदंष्ट्रो अर्चिषा यातुधानानुप स्पृश जातवेदः समिद्धः । आ जिह्वया मूरदेवान्रभस्व क्रव्यादो वृक्त्व्यपि धत्स्वासन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayodaṃṣṭro arciṣā yātudhānānupa spṛśa jātavedaḥ samiddhaḥ | ā jihvayā mūradevānrabhasva kravyādo vṛktvyapi dhatsvāsan ||

translations.english: Jātavedas, who have teeth of iron, consume the Yātudhānas' flame when kindled, destroy thedestructive (spirits) with your tongue, cut up the eaters of flesh, and put them in your mouth.

mantras.sanskrit: उभोभयाविन्नुप धेहि दंष्ट्रा हिंस्रः शिशानोऽवरं परं च । उतान्तरिक्षे परि याहि राजञ्जम्भैः सं धेह्यभि यातुधानान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ubhobhayāvinnupa dhehi daṃṣṭrā hiṃsraḥ śiśāno'varaṃ paraṃ ca | utāntarikṣe pari yāhi rājañjambhaiḥ saṃ dhehyabhi yātudhānān ||

translations.english: Agni, the destroyer (of the rākṣasas), who have two (rows of teeth), sharpening them both, applythem to (the rākṣasas, and preserve) both the upper and the lower (world); and march, radiant (Agni, againstthe rākṣasas) in the firmament, seize the yātudhānas with your jaws.

mantras.sanskrit: यज्ञैरिषूः संनममानो अग्ने वाचा शल्याँ अशनिभिर्दिहानः । ताभिर्विध्य हृदये यातुधानान्प्रतीचो बाहून्प्रति भङ्ध्येषाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajñairiṣūḥ saṃnamamāno agne vācā śalyā~ aśanibhirdihānaḥ | tābhirvidhya hṛdaye yātudhānānpratīco bāhūnprati bhaṅdhyeṣām ||

translations.english: Agni, do you, bending your arrows by means on your sacrifices and praise, and sharpening thejavelins with your splendours, pierce with them the yātudhānas to the heart, break their arms when raisedagainst you.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने त्वचं यातुधानस्य भिन्धि हिंस्राशनिर्हरसा हन्त्वेनम् । प्र पर्वाणि जातवेदः शृणीहि क्रव्यात्क्रविष्णुर्वि चिनोतु वृक्णम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne tvacaṃ yātudhānasya bhindhi hiṃsrāśanirharasā hantvenam | pra parvāṇi jātavedaḥ śṛṇīhi kravyātkraviṣṇurvi cinotu vṛkṇam ||

translations.english: Agni Jātavedas, cut through the skin of the yātudhānas, let your destructive thunderbolt destroyhim with its fire; sever his joints, may the flesh-desiring flesh-eater devour his mutilated body.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्रेदानीं पश्यसि जातवेदस्तिष्ठन्तमग्न उत वा चरन्तम् । यद्वान्तरिक्षे पथिभिः पतन्तं तमस्ता विध्य शर्वा शिशानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatredānīṃ paśyasi jātavedastiṣṭhantamagna uta vā carantam | yadvāntarikṣe pathibhiḥ patantaṃ tamastā vidhya śarvā śiśānaḥ ||

translations.english: Wherever you now behold him, Agni Jātavedas, whether standing or moving, or passing along thepaths in the firmament, do you, O shooter sharpening (your arrows), transfix him with your shaft.

mantras.sanskrit: उतालब्धं स्पृणुहि जातवेद आलेभानादृष्टिभिर्यातुधानात् । अग्ने पूर्वो नि जहि शोशुचान आमादः क्ष्विङ्कास्तमदन्त्वेनीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: utālabdhaṃ spṛṇuhi jātaveda ālebhānādṛṣṭibhiryātudhānāt | agne pūrvo ni jahi śośucāna āmādaḥ kṣviṅkāstamadantvenīḥ ||

translations.english: And defend me, Jātavedas, with your darts when I am seized, (defend me) from the Yātudhānaswho has seized me; anticipating him, do you, Agni, blazing fiercely, slay him; may the swift-flying vultures, theflesh-eaters, devour him.

mantras.sanskrit: इह प्र ब्रूहि यतमः सो अग्ने यो यातुधानो य इदं कृणोति । तमा रभस्व समिधा यविष्ठ नृचक्षसश्चक्षुषे रन्धयैनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: iha pra brūhi yatamaḥ so agne yo yātudhāno ya idaṃ kṛṇoti | tamā rabhasva samidhā yaviṣṭha nṛcakṣasaścakṣuṣe randhayainam ||

translations.english: Agni, youngest of the gods, announce (to me present) at this (your sacrifice), which is yourYātudhāna who does this; destroy him with your kindled flame; beholder of men, consume him with yourbrilliance.

mantras.sanskrit: तीक्ष्णेनाग्ने चक्षुषा रक्ष यज्ञं प्राञ्चं वसुभ्यः प्र णय प्रचेतः । हिंस्रं रक्षांस्यभि शोशुचानं मा त्वा दभन्यातुधाना नृचक्षः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tīkṣṇenāgne cakṣuṣā rakṣa yajñaṃ prāñcaṃ vasubhyaḥ pra ṇaya pracetaḥ | hiṃsraṃ rakṣāṃsyabhi śośucānaṃ mā tvā dabhanyātudhānā nṛcakṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Protect this sacrifice, Agni, with your sharp glance; lead it sage (Agni) forward to (the acquisition of)riches; let not the Yātudhānas harm you, beholder of men, the destroyer of rākṣasas blazing fiercely.

mantras.sanskrit: नृचक्षा रक्षः परि पश्य विक्षु तस्य त्रीणि प्रति शृणीह्यग्रा । तस्याग्ने पृष्टीर्हरसा शृणीहि त्रेधा मूलं यातुधानस्य वृश्च ॥
mantras.transliteration: nṛcakṣā rakṣaḥ pari paśya vikṣu tasya trīṇi prati śṛṇīhyagrā | tasyāgne pṛṣṭīrharasā śṛṇīhi tredhā mūlaṃ yātudhānasya vṛśca ||

translations.english: Regard, beholder of men, the rākṣasas among the people; cut off his three heads; cut off his flankswith your might; cut off the triple foot of the Yātudhāna.
