mantras.sanskrit: त्रिर्यातुधानः प्रसितिं त एत्वृतं यो अग्ने अनृतेन हन्ति । तमर्चिषा स्फूर्जयञ्जातवेदः समक्षमेनं गृणते नि वृङ्धि ॥
mantras.transliteration: triryātudhānaḥ prasitiṃ ta etvṛtaṃ yo agne anṛtena hanti | tamarciṣā sphūrjayañjātavedaḥ samakṣamenaṃ gṛṇate ni vṛṅdhi ||

translations.english: Agni Jātavedas, let the Yātudhāna, who defeats your truth with falsehood, come thrice into the

mantras.sanskrit: तदग्ने चक्षुः प्रति धेहि रेभे शफारुजं येन पश्यसि यातुधानम् । अथर्ववज्ज्योतिषा दैव्येन सत्यं धूर्वन्तमचितं न्योष ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadagne cakṣuḥ prati dhehi rebhe śaphārujaṃ yena paśyasi yātudhānam | atharvavajjyotiṣā daivyena satyaṃ dhūrvantamacitaṃ nyoṣa ||

translations.english: Cast, Agni, upon the two roaring (rākṣasas) that eye wherewith you behold the Yātudhāna strikingwith his hoof; like Atharvan with celestial radiance burn down the ignorant (rākṣasas), who assails truth withfalsehood.

mantras.sanskrit: यदग्ने अद्य मिथुना शपातो यद्वाचस्तृष्टं जनयन्त रेभाः । मन्योर्मनसः शरव्या जायते या तया विध्य हृदये यातुधानान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadagne adya mithunā śapāto yadvācastṛṣṭaṃ janayanta rebhāḥ | manyormanasaḥ śaravyā jāyate yā tayā vidhya hṛdaye yātudhānān ||

translations.english: Today, Agni, when the married pair curse each other, then the praisers produce bitter words (in angeragainst each other), do you pierce the Yātudhānas through the heart with your arrow, which is genitive rated fromyour wrathful mind.

mantras.sanskrit: परा शृणीहि तपसा यातुधानान्पराग्ने रक्षो हरसा शृणीहि । परार्चिषा मूरदेवाञ्छृणीहि परासुतृपो अभि शोशुचानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: parā śṛṇīhi tapasā yātudhānānparāgne rakṣo harasā śṛṇīhi | parārciṣā mūradevāñchṛṇīhi parāsutṛpo abhi śośucānaḥ ||

translations.english: Destroy the Yātudhānas with your scorching fire; destroy the rākṣasas, Agni, with your heat;destroy with your radiance those who believe in vaid gods, fiercely blazing, destroy the insatiable.

mantras.sanskrit: पराद्य देवा वृजिनं शृणन्तु प्रत्यगेनं शपथा यन्तु तृष्टाः । वाचास्तेनं शरव ऋच्छन्तु मर्मन्विश्वस्यैतु प्रसितिं यातुधानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: parādya devā vṛjinaṃ śṛṇantu pratyagenaṃ śapathā yantu tṛṣṭāḥ | vācāstenaṃ śarava ṛcchantu marmanviśvasyaitu prasitiṃ yātudhānaḥ ||

translations.english: Let all the gods today destroy the murderous (Yātudhāna); let our sharp imprecations encounterhim; may the arrows hit the speaker of falsehood in a vital part; may the Yātudhāna go into the bondage of theall-pervading Agni.

mantras.sanskrit: यः पौरुषेयेण क्रविषा समङ्क्ते यो अश्व्येन पशुना यातुधानः । यो अघ्न्याया भरति क्षीरमग्ने तेषां शीर्षाणि हरसापि वृश्च ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ pauruṣeyeṇa kraviṣā samaṅkte yo aśvyena paśunā yātudhānaḥ | yo aghnyāyā bharati kṣīramagne teṣāṃ śīrṣāṇi harasāpi vṛśca ||

translations.english: The Yātudhāna, who fills himself with the flesh of man, and he who fills himself with the flesh ofhorses or of other animals, and he who steals the milk of the cow-- cut off their heads with your flame.

mantras.sanskrit: संवत्सरीणं पय उस्रियायास्तस्य माशीद्यातुधानो नृचक्षः । पीयूषमग्ने यतमस्तितृप्सात्तं प्रत्यञ्चमर्चिषा विध्य मर्मन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃvatsarīṇaṃ paya usriyāyāstasya māśīdyātudhāno nṛcakṣaḥ | pīyūṣamagne yatamastitṛpsāttaṃ pratyañcamarciṣā vidhya marman ||

translations.english: The milk of the cow is annually produced, let not the Yātudhāna consume it, O beholder of men;whichever of them would like to satiate himself with the ambrosia, do you, Agni, pierce that contending(rākṣasa) with your flame in a vital part.

mantras.sanskrit: विषं गवां यातुधानाः पिबन्त्वा वृश्च्यन्तामदितये दुरेवाः । परैनान्देवः सविता ददातु परा भागमोषधीनां जयन्ताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: viṣaṃ gavāṃ yātudhānāḥ pibantvā vṛścyantāmaditaye durevāḥ | paraināndevaḥ savitā dadātu parā bhāgamoṣadhīnāṃ jayantām ||

translations.english: Let the Yātudhāna drink poison from the cattle; let the (rākṣasas) hard to overcome be cut topieces for the sake of Aditi; may the divine Savitā give them over (to destruction), may they be deprived of thefood of herbs.

mantras.sanskrit: सनादग्ने मृणसि यातुधानान्न त्वा रक्षांसि पृतनासु जिग्युः । अनु दह सहमूरान्क्रव्यादो मा ते हेत्या मुक्षत दैव्यायाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sanādagne mṛṇasi yātudhānānna tvā rakṣāṃsi pṛtanāsu jigyuḥ | anu daha sahamūrānkravyādo mā te hetyā mukṣata daivyāyāḥ ||

translations.english: You, Agni, have from old time opposed the Yātudhāna; the rākṣasas have never overcome you inbattles; burn murderous flesh-eating (rākṣasas) one by one; let them not escape your divine weapon

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं नो अग्ने अधरादुदक्तात्त्वं पश्चादुत रक्षा पुरस्तात् । प्रति ते ते अजरासस्तपिष्ठा अघशंसं शोशुचतो दहन्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ no agne adharādudaktāttvaṃ paścāduta rakṣā purastāt | prati te te ajarāsastapiṣṭhā aghaśaṃsaṃ śośucato dahantu ||

translations.english: Do you, Agni, protect us on the south, on the north, on the west, and on the east; may these, yourundecaying, scorching, blazing (flames), consume the perpetrator of wickedness.

mantras.sanskrit: पश्चात्पुरस्तादधरादुदक्तात्कविः काव्येन परि पाहि राजन् । सखे सखायमजरो जरिम्णेऽग्ने मर्ताँ अमर्त्यस्त्वं नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: paścātpurastādadharādudaktātkaviḥ kāvyena pari pāhi rājan | sakhe sakhāyamajaro jarimṇe'gne martā~ amartyastvaṃ naḥ ||

translations.english: Royal Agni, who are a sage, protect us by your wisdom on the west, on the east, on the south, on thenorth; do you, O friend, who are undecaying, (preserve me), your friend, to old age; do you who are immortal,(protect) us who are mortal.

mantras.sanskrit: परि त्वाग्ने पुरं वयं विप्रं सहस्य धीमहि । धृषद्वर्णं दिवेदिवे हन्तारं भङ्गुरावताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pari tvāgne puraṃ vayaṃ vipraṃ sahasya dhīmahi | dhṛṣadvarṇaṃ divedive hantāraṃ bhaṅgurāvatām ||

translations.english: We meditate, strength-born Agni, on you, the accomplisher (of rites), the sage, of fearful form, thedestroyer of the treacherous day by day.

mantras.sanskrit: विषेण भङ्गुरावतः प्रति ष्म रक्षसो दह । अग्ने तिग्मेन शोचिषा तपुरग्राभिॠष्टिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viṣeṇa bhaṅgurāvataḥ prati ṣma rakṣaso daha | agne tigmena śociṣā tapuragrābhiṝṣṭibhiḥ ||

translations.english: Consume, Agni, the treacherous rākṣasas with your all-pervading sharp flame, with yourflame-pointed darts.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रत्यग्ने मिथुना दह यातुधाना किमीदिना । सं त्वा शिशामि जागृह्यदब्धं विप्र मन्मभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pratyagne mithunā daha yātudhānā kimīdinā | saṃ tvā śiśāmi jāgṛhyadabdhaṃ vipra manmabhiḥ ||

translations.english: Consume, Agni, these pairs of Yātudhānas and Kimīdins; I whet you, O sage, the invincible one,with my praises; wake up.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रत्यग्ने हरसा हरः शृणीहि विश्वतः प्रति । यातुधानस्य रक्षसो बलं वि रुज वीर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pratyagne harasā haraḥ śṛṇīhi viśvataḥ prati | yātudhānasya rakṣaso balaṃ vi ruja vīryam ||

translations.english: Destroy, Agni, with your flame, the impetuous might of the Yātudhāna; break the strength of therākṣasa.

mantras.sanskrit: हविष्पान्तमजरं स्वर्विदि दिविस्पृश्याहुतं जुष्टमग्नौ । तस्य भर्मणे भुवनाय देवा धर्मणे कं स्वधया पप्रथन्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: haviṣpāntamajaraṃ svarvidi divispṛśyāhutaṃ juṣṭamagnau | tasya bharmaṇe bhuvanāya devā dharmaṇe kaṃ svadhayā paprathanta ||

translations.english: The Soma oblation, undecaying and agreeable to the gods, which is offered to Agni, who is cognizantof heaven, who touches the sky-- for its nourishment, existence and support, the gods supply (Agni) the giver ofhappiness with food.

mantras.sanskrit: गीर्णं भुवनं तमसापगूळ्हमाविः स्वरभवज्जाते अग्नौ । तस्य देवाः पृथिवी द्यौरुतापोऽरणयन्नोषधीः सख्ये अस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: gīrṇaṃ bhuvanaṃ tamasāpagūḷhamāviḥ svarabhavajjāte agnau | tasya devāḥ pṛthivī dyaurutāpo'raṇayannoṣadhīḥ sakhye asya ||

translations.english: The whole world swallowed up, hidden in darkness, was made manifest when Agni was born; thegods, heaven and earth, the waters and the plural nts rejoiced in his friendship.

mantras.sanskrit: देवेभिर्न्विषितो यज्ञियेभिरग्निं स्तोषाण्यजरं बृहन्तम् । यो भानुना पृथिवीं द्यामुतेमामाततान रोदसी अन्तरिक्षम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: devebhirnviṣito yajñiyebhiragniṃ stoṣāṇyajaraṃ bṛhantam | yo bhānunā pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāmātatāna rodasī antarikṣam ||

translations.english: Sent by adorable gods I praise the undecaying and mighty Agni, who by his radiance has spread forththe earth and this heaven, the two worlds and the firmament.

mantras.sanskrit: यो होतासीत्प्रथमो देवजुष्टो यं समाञ्जन्नाज्येना वृणानाः । स पतत्रीत्वरं स्था जगद्यच्छ्वात्रमग्निरकृणोज्जातवेदाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo hotāsītprathamo devajuṣṭo yaṃ samāñjannājyenā vṛṇānāḥ | sa patatrītvaraṃ sthā jagadyacchvātramagnirakṛṇojjātavedāḥ ||

translations.english: Who propitiated by the gods was the first offerer of oblations, whom his worshippers anoint withclarified butter-- he, Agni Jātavedas, quickly made that which can fly, that which can walk, that which isstationary, that which is moveable.

mantras.sanskrit: यज्जातवेदो भुवनस्य मूर्धन्नतिष्ठो अग्ने सह रोचनेन । तं त्वाहेम मतिभिर्गीर्भिरुक्थैः स यज्ञियो अभवो रोदसिप्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajjātavedo bhuvanasya mūrdhannatiṣṭho agne saha rocanena | taṃ tvāhema matibhirgīrbhirukthaiḥ sa yajñiyo abhavo rodasiprāḥ ||

translations.english: Inasmuch as you abide, Agni Jātavedas, on the brow of the universe, together with the sun, we havecome to you with praises, with hymns, with prayers; you are adorable, the satisfier of heaven and earth.

mantras.sanskrit: मूर्धा भुवो भवति नक्तमग्निस्ततः सूर्यो जायते प्रातरुद्यन् । मायामू तु यज्ञियानामेतामपो यत्तूर्णिश्चरति प्रजानन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mūrdhā bhuvo bhavati naktamagnistataḥ sūryo jāyate prātarudyan | māyāmū tu yajñiyānāmetāmapo yattūrṇiścarati prajānan ||

translations.english: Agni is the head of all beings by night; then the sun rising early is born; (the wise know) this to be thewisdom of the adorable gods, that the swift- moving sun being intelligent moves through the firmameṇṭ

mantras.sanskrit: दृशेन्यो यो महिना समिद्धोऽरोचत दिवियोनिर्विभावा । तस्मिन्नग्नौ सूक्तवाकेन देवा हविर्विश्व आजुहवुस्तनूपाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dṛśenyo yo mahinā samiddho'rocata diviyonirvibhāvā | tasminnagnau sūktavākena devā havirviśva ājuhavustanūpāḥ ||

translations.english: He who shines visible to all through his greatness radiant, having his station in the sky, resplendentinhim, Agni, the unversal gods, the guardians of men's bodies, have presented an oblation with the voice of

mantras.sanskrit: सूक्तवाकं प्रथममादिदग्निमादिद्धविरजनयन्त देवाः । स एषां यज्ञो अभवत्तनूपास्तं द्यौर्वेद तं पृथिवी तमापः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sūktavākaṃ prathamamādidagnimādiddhavirajanayanta devāḥ | sa eṣāṃ yajño abhavattanūpāstaṃ dyaurveda taṃ pṛthivī tamāpaḥ ||

translations.english: The gods first genitive rated the words of the hymn, then Agni, then the oblation; he is the (object of the)sacrifice of these deities, the protector of the body; him the heaven knows, him the earth and the waters, know.

mantras.sanskrit: यं देवासोऽजनयन्ताग्निं यस्मिन्नाजुहवुर्भुवनानि विश्वा । सो अर्चिषा पृथिवीं द्यामुतेमामृजूयमानो अतपन्महित्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ devāso'janayantāgniṃ yasminnājuhavurbhuvanāni viśvā | so arciṣā pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāmṛjūyamāno atapanmahitvā ||

translations.english: Agni whom the gods genitive rated, in whom all beings have offered oblations-- he, the straight-going, haswarmed by his \radiance, by his might, the earth and his heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तोमेन हि दिवि देवासो अग्निमजीजनञ्छक्तिभी रोदसिप्राम् । तमू अकृण्वन्त्रेधा भुवे कं स ओषधीः पचति विश्वरूपाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: stomena hi divi devāso agnimajījanañchaktibhī rodasiprām | tamū akṛṇvantredhā bhuve kaṃ sa oṣadhīḥ pacati viśvarūpāḥ ||

translations.english: The gods have by praise engendered Agni in the sky, who fills heaven and earth by his functions, theyappointed the joy-bestowing Agni to his three- fold condition, he brings the manifold plural nts to maturity.

mantras.sanskrit: यदेदेनमदधुर्यज्ञियासो दिवि देवाः सूर्यमादितेयम् । यदा चरिष्णू मिथुनावभूतामादित्प्रापश्यन्भुवनानि विश्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadedenamadadhuryajñiyāso divi devāḥ sūryamāditeyam | yadā cariṣṇū mithunāvabhūtāmāditprāpaśyanbhuvanāni viśvā ||

translations.english: When the adorable gods, plural ced him and Sūrya, the son of Aditi, in heaven; when the swift-movingpair (Agni and Vaiśvānara) appeared, then all beings beheld them.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वस्मा अग्निं भुवनाय देवा वैश्वानरं केतुमह्नामकृण्वन् । आ यस्ततानोषसो विभातीरपो ऊर्णोति तमो अर्चिषा यन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvasmā agniṃ bhuvanāya devā vaiśvānaraṃ ketumahnāmakṛṇvan | ā yastatānoṣaso vibhātīrapo ūrṇoti tamo arciṣā yan ||

translations.english: The gods made Agni Vaiśvānara, the indicator of days, for the sake of the whole world, whostretched out the radiant dawns, and as he moves along scatters the darkness with his light.

mantras.sanskrit: वैश्वानरं कवयो यज्ञियासोऽग्निं देवा अजनयन्नजुर्यम् । नक्षत्रं प्रत्नममिनच्चरिष्णु यक्षस्याध्यक्षं तविषं बृहन्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vaiśvānaraṃ kavayo yajñiyāso'gniṃ devā ajanayannajuryam | nakṣatraṃ pratnamaminaccariṣṇu yakṣasyādhyakṣaṃ taviṣaṃ bṛhantam ||

translations.english: The wise and adorable gods engendered the imperishable Agni Vaiśvānara; he overcame (with hislight) the ancient swift-moving Nakṣatra, the overseer of the adorable (deity), mighty and great.

mantras.sanskrit: वैश्वानरं विश्वहा दीदिवांसं मन्त्रैरग्निं कविमच्छा वदामः । यो महिम्ना परिबभूवोर्वी उतावस्तादुत देवः परस्तात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vaiśvānaraṃ viśvahā dīdivāṃsaṃ mantrairagniṃ kavimacchā vadāmaḥ | yo mahimnā paribabhūvorvī utāvastāduta devaḥ parastāt ||

translations.english: We glorify daily with praises the brilliant and sage Agni Vaiśvānara, the god who overcomes by hismight both heaven and earth, (burning) both below and above.

mantras.sanskrit: द्वे स्रुती अशृणवं पितॄणामहं देवानामुत मर्त्यानाम् । ताभ्यामिदं विश्वमेजत्समेति यदन्तरा पितरं मातरं च ॥
mantras.transliteration: dve srutī aśṛṇavaṃ pitṝṇāmahaṃ devānāmuta martyānām | tābhyāmidaṃ viśvamejatsameti yadantarā pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca ||

translations.english: I have heard that there are two paths for Pitṛs, gods and mortals; all this universe which is betweenthe paternal (heaven) and the maternal (earth) proceeds on its way by these two (paths).

mantras.sanskrit: द्वे समीची बिभृतश्चरन्तं शीर्षतो जातं मनसा विमृष्टम् । स प्रत्यङ्विश्वा भुवनानि तस्थावप्रयुच्छन्तरणिर्भ्राजमानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dve samīcī bibhṛtaścarantaṃ śīrṣato jātaṃ manasā vimṛṣṭam | sa pratyaṅviśvā bhuvanāni tasthāvaprayucchantaraṇirbhrājamānaḥ ||

translations.english: The associated two (heaven and earth) support (Agni) moving, born from the head, sanctified bypraise; diligent, rapid, radiant, he appears in the presence of all beings.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्रा वदेते अवरः परश्च यज्ञन्योः कतरो नौ वि वेद । आ शेकुरित्सधमादं सखायो नक्षन्त यज्ञं क इदं वि वोचत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatrā vadete avaraḥ paraśca yajñanyoḥ kataro nau vi veda | ā śekuritsadhamādaṃ sakhāyo nakṣanta yajñaṃ ka idaṃ vi vocat ||

translations.english: When the lower and upper (fire) disputed "which of us twain leaders of sacrifice knows the work best?"then the friends (the priests) were competent (to offer) sacrifice, they came to the sacrifice; who declares this?

mantras.sanskrit: कत्यग्नयः कति सूर्यासः कत्युषासः कत्यु स्विदापः । नोपस्पिजं वः पितरो वदामि पृच्छामि वः कवयो विद्मने कम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: katyagnayaḥ kati sūryāsaḥ katyuṣāsaḥ katyu svidāpaḥ | nopaspijaṃ vaḥ pitaro vadāmi pṛcchāmi vaḥ kavayo vidmane kam ||

translations.english: How many fires are there, how many suns, how many dawns, how many waters? I address you, OPitṛs, not in rivalry, I ask you, sages, in order to know (the truth).

mantras.sanskrit: यावन्मात्रमुषसो न प्रतीकं सुपर्ण्यो वसते मातरिश्वः । तावद्दधात्युप यज्ञमायन्ब्राह्मणो होतुरवरो निषीदन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yāvanmātramuṣaso na pratīkaṃ suparṇyo vasate mātariśvaḥ | tāvaddadhātyupa yajñamāyanbrāhmaṇo hoturavaro niṣīdan ||

translations.english: As long, Mātariśvan, as the swiftly-moving (nights) cover the face of the dawn, (so long) theBrahman, the inferior sitting down (to perform the work) of the Hotā, approaching the sacrifice supports (theceremony).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रं स्तवा नृतमं यस्य मह्ना विबबाधे रोचना वि ज्मो अन्तान् । आ यः पप्रौ चर्षणीधृद्वरोभिः प्र सिन्धुभ्यो रिरिचानो महित्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraṃ stavā nṛtamaṃ yasya mahnā vibabādhe rocanā vi jmo antān | ā yaḥ paprau carṣaṇīdhṛdvarobhiḥ pra sindhubhyo riricāno mahitvā ||

translations.english: Praise Indra, the chief leadere (of rites), whose glory surpasses the lustre (of others), and the ends ofthe earth; the sustainer of man, who exceeding the ocean in magnitude, fills (heaven and earth) with radiance.

mantras.sanskrit: स सूर्यः पर्युरू वरांस्येन्द्रो ववृत्याद्रथ्येव चक्रा । अतिष्ठन्तमपस्यं न सर्गं कृष्णा तमांसि त्विष्या जघान ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa sūryaḥ paryurū varāṃsyendro vavṛtyādrathyeva cakrā | atiṣṭhantamapasyaṃ na sargaṃ kṛṣṇā tamāṃsi tviṣyā jaghāna ||

translations.english: The heroic Indra causes numerous rays of light revolve as a charioteer (effects the rotation of) thewheels of the chariot; he destroys by his radiance the black darkness like a restless active horse.

mantras.sanskrit: समानमस्मा अनपावृदर्च क्ष्मया दिवो असमं ब्रह्म नव्यम् । वि यः पृष्ठेव जनिमान्यर्य इन्द्रश्चिकाय न सखायमीषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: samānamasmā anapāvṛdarca kṣmayā divo asamaṃ brahma navyam | vi yaḥ pṛṣṭheva janimānyarya indraścikāya na sakhāyamīṣe ||

translations.english: Sing along with me a new song, unceasing, surpassing heaven and earth, to him who like the pṛṣṭha(praises), born at sacrifices, overcomes his enemies, Indra who desires no friend.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्राय गिरो अनिशितसर्गा अपः प्रेरयं सगरस्य बुध्नात् । यो अक्षेणेव चक्रिया शचीभिर्विष्वक्तस्तम्भ पृथिवीमुत द्याम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrāya giro aniśitasargā apaḥ prerayaṃ sagarasya budhnāt | yo akṣeṇeva cakriyā śacībhirviṣvaktastambha pṛthivīmuta dyām ||

translations.english: I will utter praises to Indra in unceasing flow, (I will send) waters from the depth of the firmament (tohim) who has fixed heaven and earth on both sides by his acts as the wheels of a chariot (are fixed) by the axle.

mantras.sanskrit: आपान्तमन्युस्तृपलप्रभर्मा धुनिः शिमीवाञ्छरुमाँ ऋजीषी । सोमो विश्वान्यतसा वनानि नार्वागिन्द्रं प्रतिमानानि देभुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: āpāntamanyustṛpalaprabharmā dhuniḥ śimīvāñcharumā~ ṛjīṣī | somo viśvānyatasā vanāni nārvāgindraṃ pratimānāni debhuḥ ||

translations.english: Appeasing wrath, striking quickly, intimidating foes, doer of great deeds, armed with weapons,possessing the stale residue, Soma nourishes all the Atasa woods, they oppose no impediments against Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: न यस्य द्यावापृथिवी न धन्व नान्तरिक्षं नाद्रयः सोमो अक्षाः । यदस्य मन्युरधिनीयमानः शृणाति वीळु रुजति स्थिराणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: na yasya dyāvāpṛthivī na dhanva nāntarikṣaṃ nādrayaḥ somo akṣāḥ | yadasya manyuradhinīyamānaḥ śṛṇāti vīḷu rujati sthirāṇi ||

translations.english: Of whom neither heaven and earth, nor the water, nor the firmament, nor the mountains (are theobstructions) for him doth the Soma exude, when his wrath reaching his enemies destroys the strong and breaksthe firm.

mantras.sanskrit: जघान वृत्रं स्वधितिर्वनेव रुरोज पुरो अरदन्न सिन्धून् । बिभेद गिरिं नवमिन्न कुम्भमा गा इन्द्रो अकृणुत स्वयुग्भिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: jaghāna vṛtraṃ svadhitirvaneva ruroja puro aradanna sindhūn | bibheda giriṃ navaminna kumbhamā gā indro akṛṇuta svayugbhiḥ ||

translations.english: (Indra) slew Vṛtra as an axe (cuts down) a tree; he demolished the cities (of the foes), he dug out therivers; he shattered the cloud like a new pitcher; with his allies (the Maruts) he recovered the cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं ह त्यदृणया इन्द्र धीरोऽसिर्न पर्व वृजिना शृणासि । प्र ये मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धाम युजं न जना मिनन्ति मित्रम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ ha tyadṛṇayā indra dhīro'sirna parva vṛjinā śṛṇāsi | pra ye mitrasya varuṇasya dhāma yujaṃ na janā minanti mitram ||

translations.english: You, Indra, who are wise, punish the guilt (of worshippers); you cut off their sins as a sword (cuts off)the limbs (of victims); (you cut off) the people who (ignorantly) injure the supporting (function) of Mitra, andVaruṇa, (which is) as it were their close friend.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ये मित्रं प्रार्यमणं दुरेवाः प्र संगिरः प्र वरुणं मिनन्ति । न्यमित्रेषु वधमिन्द्र तुम्रं वृषन्वृषाणमरुषं शिशीहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra ye mitraṃ prāryamaṇaṃ durevāḥ pra saṃgiraḥ pra varuṇaṃ minanti | nyamitreṣu vadhamindra tumraṃ vṛṣanvṛṣāṇamaruṣaṃ śiśīhi ||

translations.english: Against those who sinfully offend against Mitra, Aryaman, your companons (the Maruts) and Varuṇa,against these your enemies sharpen, Indra, showerer (of benefits), your rapid showering radiant thunderbolt.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रो दिव इन्द्र ईशे पृथिव्या इन्द्रो अपामिन्द्र इत्पर्वतानाम् । इन्द्रो वृधामिन्द्र इन्मेधिराणामिन्द्रः क्षेमे योगे हव्य इन्द्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indro diva indra īśe pṛthivyā indro apāmindra itparvatānām | indro vṛdhāmindra inmedhirāṇāmindraḥ kṣeme yoge havya indraḥ ||

translations.english: Indra rules over heaven, Indra rules over earth, over the waters, and over the clouds; Indra rules overthe great and over the wise; Indra is to be invoked for the acquisition and preservation (of wealth).

mantras.sanskrit: प्राक्तुभ्य इन्द्रः प्र वृधो अहभ्यः प्रान्तरिक्षात्प्र समुद्रस्य धासेः । प्र वातस्य प्रथसः प्र ज्मो अन्तात्प्र सिन्धुभ्यो रिरिचे प्र क्षितिभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prāktubhya indraḥ pra vṛdho ahabhyaḥ prāntarikṣātpra samudrasya dhāseḥ | pra vātasya prathasaḥ pra jmo antātpra sindhubhyo ririce pra kṣitibhyaḥ ||

translations.english: Indra is vaster than the nights, vaster than the days, vaster than the firmament or the receptacle of theocean, vaster than the wind, or space or the ends of the earth; Indra exceeds the rivers and mankind.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र शोशुचत्या उषसो न केतुरसिन्वा ते वर्ततामिन्द्र हेतिः । अश्मेव विध्य दिव आ सृजानस्तपिष्ठेन हेषसा द्रोघमित्रान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra śośucatyā uṣaso na keturasinvā te vartatāmindra hetiḥ | aśmeva vidhya diva ā sṛjānastapiṣṭhena heṣasā droghamitrān ||

translations.english: May your unbroken weapon, Indra, proceed (against your foes), like the banner of the shining dawn,like a stone cast down from heaven, pierce those whose friendship is deceitful with your consumingloud-sounding (weapon).

mantras.sanskrit: अन्वह मासा अन्विद्वनान्यन्वोषधीरनु पर्वतासः । अन्विन्द्रं रोदसी वावशाने अन्वापो अजिहत जायमानम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: anvaha māsā anvidvanānyanvoṣadhīranu parvatāsaḥ | anvindraṃ rodasī vāvaśāne anvāpo ajihata jāyamānam ||

translations.english: The months attend upon Indra as soon as born, the forests attend upon him, the plural nts, themountains, the affectionate heaven and earth, and the waters (attend upon) him.

mantras.sanskrit: कर्हि स्वित्सा त इन्द्र चेत्यासदघस्य यद्भिनदो रक्ष एषत् । मित्रक्रुवो यच्छसने न गावः पृथिव्या आपृगमुया शयन्ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: karhi svitsā ta indra cetyāsadaghasya yadbhinado rakṣa eṣat | mitrakruvo yacchasane na gāvaḥ pṛthivyā āpṛgamuyā śayante ||

translations.english: Where was your (shaft) Indra, (which ought) to be hurled (against your enemies) when you did cleavethe rākṣasas hastening to war, and when the Mitrakru lay on the ground there in confusion like cattle at theplace of immolation?

mantras.sanskrit: शत्रूयन्तो अभि ये नस्ततस्रे महि व्राधन्त ओगणास इन्द्र । अन्धेनामित्रास्तमसा सचन्तां सुज्योतिषो अक्तवस्ताँ अभि ष्युः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śatrūyanto abhi ye nastatasre mahi vrādhanta ogaṇāsa indra | andhenāmitrāstamasā sacantāṃ sujyotiṣo aktavastā~ abhi ṣyuḥ ||

translations.english: May those adversaries, Indra, who press upon us, fiercely opposing us, and assembled in numbers,be overwhelmed with thick darkness, and may the bright (days) and nights overpower them. hymn you, and disregarding all other worshippers, come to us with your protection.

mantras.sanskrit: पुरूणि हि त्वा सवना जनानां ब्रह्माणि मन्दन्गृणतामृषीणाम् । इमामाघोषन्नवसा सहूतिं तिरो विश्वाँ अर्चतो याह्यर्वाङ् ॥
mantras.transliteration: purūṇi hi tvā savanā janānāṃ brahmāṇi mandangṛṇatāmṛṣīṇām | imāmāghoṣannavasā sahūtiṃ tiro viśvā~ arcato yāhyarvāṅ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: एवा ते वयमिन्द्र भुञ्जतीनां विद्याम सुमतीनां नवानाम् । विद्याम वस्तोरवसा गृणन्तो विश्वामित्रा उत त इन्द्र नूनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā te vayamindra bhuñjatīnāṃ vidyāma sumatīnāṃ navānām | vidyāma vastoravasā gṛṇanto viśvāmitrā uta ta indra nūnam ||

translations.english: May we, the descendants of Viśvāmitra, sincerely praising you, Indra,by day for your protection,obtain your protecting (favours), may we obtain your recent (favours).

mantras.sanskrit: शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन्भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ । शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नन्तं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau | śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||

translations.english: We invoke in this conflict for our protection the pure, the opulent Indra, the most heroic in the fight,

mantras.sanskrit: सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषः सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात् । स भूमिं विश्वतो वृत्वात्यतिष्ठद्दशाङ्गुलम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt | sa bhūmiṃ viśvato vṛtvātyatiṣṭhaddaśāṅgulam ||

translations.english: Puruṣa, who has a thousand heads, a thousand eyes, a thousand feet, investing the earth in alldirections, exceeds (it by a space) measuring ten fingers.

mantras.sanskrit: पुरुष एवेदं सर्वं यद्भूतं यच्च भव्यम् । उतामृतत्वस्येशानो यदन्नेनातिरोहति ॥
mantras.transliteration: puruṣa evedaṃ sarvaṃ yadbhūtaṃ yacca bhavyam | utāmṛtatvasyeśāno yadannenātirohati ||

translations.english: Puruṣa is verily all this (visible world), all that is, and all that is to be; he is also the lord of immortality;for he mounts beyond (his own condition) for the food (of living beings).

mantras.sanskrit: एतावानस्य महिमातो ज्यायाँश्च पूरुषः । पादोऽस्य विश्वा भूतानि त्रिपादस्यामृतं दिवि ॥
mantras.transliteration: etāvānasya mahimāto jyāyā~śca pūruṣaḥ | pādo'sya viśvā bhūtāni tripādasyāmṛtaṃ divi ||

translations.english: Such is his greatness; and Puruṣa is greater even than this; all beings are one-fourth of him; his otherthree-fourths, (being) immortal, (abide) in heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिपादूर्ध्व उदैत्पुरुषः पादोऽस्येहाभवत्पुनः । ततो विष्वङ्व्यक्रामत्साशनानशने अभि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tripādūrdhva udaitpuruṣaḥ pādo'syehābhavatpunaḥ | tato viṣvaṅvyakrāmatsāśanānaśane abhi ||

translations.english: Three-fourths of Puruṣa ascended; the other fourth that remained in this world proceeds repeatedly,and, diversified in various forms, went to all animate and inanimate creation.

mantras.sanskrit: तस्माद्विराळजायत विराजो अधि पूरुषः । स जातो अत्यरिच्यत पश्चाद्भूमिमथो पुरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tasmādvirāḷajāyata virājo adhi pūruṣaḥ | sa jāto atyaricyata paścādbhūmimatho puraḥ ||

translations.english: From him was born Virāt. and from Virāt. Puruṣa; he, as soon as born, became manifested, andafterwards (created) the earth (and) then corporeal forms.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्पुरुषेण हविषा देवा यज्ञमतन्वत । वसन्तो अस्यासीदाज्यं ग्रीष्म इध्मः शरद्धविः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatpuruṣeṇa haviṣā devā yajñamatanvata | vasanto asyāsīdājyaṃ grīṣma idhmaḥ śaraddhaviḥ ||

translations.english: When the gods performed the sacrifice with Puruṣa as the offering, then Spring was its ghī, Summerthe fuel, and Autumn the oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: तं यज्ञं बर्हिषि प्रौक्षन्पुरुषं जातमग्रतः । तेन देवा अयजन्त साध्या ऋषयश्च ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ yajñaṃ barhiṣi praukṣanpuruṣaṃ jātamagrataḥ | tena devā ayajanta sādhyā ṛṣayaśca ye ||

translations.english: They immolated as the victim upon the sacred grass Puruṣa, born before (creation); with him thedeities who were Sādhyas and those who were Ṛṣis sacrificed.

mantras.sanskrit: तस्माद्यज्ञात्सर्वहुतः सम्भृतं पृषदाज्यम् । पशून्ताँश्चक्रे वायव्यानारण्यान्ग्राम्याश्च ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: tasmādyajñātsarvahutaḥ sambhṛtaṃ pṛṣadājyam | paśūntā~ścakre vāyavyānāraṇyāngrāmyāśca ye ||

translations.english: From that victim, in whom the universal oblation was offered, the mixture of curds and butter wasproduced, (then) he made those animals over whom Vāyu presides, those that are wild, and those that aretame.

mantras.sanskrit: तस्माद्यज्ञात्सर्वहुत ऋचः सामानि जज्ञिरे । छन्दांसि जज्ञिरे तस्माद्यजुस्तस्मादजायत ॥
mantras.transliteration: tasmādyajñātsarvahuta ṛcaḥ sāmāni jajñire | chandāṃsi jajñire tasmādyajustasmādajāyata ||

translations.english: From that victim, in whom the universal oblation was offered, the ṛccas and sāmans were produced;from him the metres were born; from him the yajus. was born.

mantras.sanskrit: तस्मादश्वा अजायन्त ये के चोभयादतः । गावो ह जज्ञिरे तस्मात्तस्माज्जाता अजावयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tasmādaśvā ajāyanta ye ke cobhayādataḥ | gāvo ha jajñire tasmāttasmājjātā ajāvayaḥ ||

mantras.sanskrit: यत्पुरुषं व्यदधुः कतिधा व्यकल्पयन् । मुखं किमस्य कौ बाहू का ऊरू पादा उच्येते ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatpuruṣaṃ vyadadhuḥ katidhā vyakalpayan | mukhaṃ kimasya kau bāhū kā ūrū pādā ucyete ||

translations.english: When they immolated Puruṣa, into how many portions did they divide him? What was his mouth called, what his arms, what his thighs, what were his feet called?

mantras.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणोऽस्य मुखमासीद्बाहू राजन्यः कृतः । ऊरू तदस्य यद्वैश्यः पद्भ्यां शूद्रो अजायत ॥
mantras.transliteration: brāhmaṇo'sya mukhamāsīdbāhū rājanyaḥ kṛtaḥ | ūrū tadasya yadvaiśyaḥ padbhyāṃ śūdro ajāyata ||

translations.english: His mouth became the Brāhmaṇa, his arms became the Rājanya, his thighs became the Vaiśya;the Śūdra was born from his feet.

mantras.sanskrit: चन्द्रमा मनसो जातश्चक्षोः सूर्यो अजायत । मुखादिन्द्रश्चाग्निश्च प्राणाद्वायुरजायत ॥
mantras.transliteration: candramā manaso jātaścakṣoḥ sūryo ajāyata | mukhādindraścāgniśca prāṇādvāyurajāyata ||

translations.english: The moon was born from his mind; the sun was born from his eye; Indra and Agni were born from his mouth, Vāyu from his breath.

mantras.sanskrit: नाभ्या आसीदन्तरिक्षं शीर्ष्णो द्यौः समवर्तत । पद्भ्यां भूमिर्दिशः श्रोत्रात्तथा लोकाँ अकल्पयन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nābhyā āsīdantarikṣaṃ śīrṣṇo dyauḥ samavartata | padbhyāṃ bhūmirdiśaḥ śrotrāttathā lokā~ akalpayan ||

translations.english: From his navel came the firmament, from his head the heaven was produced, the earth from his feet,the quarters of space from his ear, so they constituted the world.

mantras.sanskrit: सप्तास्यासन्परिधयस्त्रिः सप्त समिधः कृताः । देवा यद्यज्ञं तन्वाना अबध्नन्पुरुषं पशुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: saptāsyāsanparidhayastriḥ sapta samidhaḥ kṛtāḥ | devā yadyajñaṃ tanvānā abadhnanpuruṣaṃ paśum ||

translations.english: Seven were the enclosures of the sacrifice, thrice seven logs of fuel were prepared, when the gods,celebrating the rite, bound Puruṣa as the victim.

mantras.sanskrit: यज्ञेन यज्ञमयजन्त देवास्तानि धर्माणि प्रथमान्यासन् । ते ह नाकं महिमानः सचन्त यत्र पूर्वे साध्याः सन्ति देवाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajñena yajñamayajanta devāstāni dharmāṇi prathamānyāsan | te ha nākaṃ mahimānaḥ sacanta yatra pūrve sādhyāḥ santi devāḥ ||

translations.english: By sacrifice the gods worshipped (him who is also) the sacrifice; those were the first duties. Thosegreat ones became partakers of the heaven where the ancient deities the Sādhyas abide. 10.091.01 Damūnas, being glorified by his diligent (worshippers), desiring food upon the footmark of Iḷā, iskindled in the chamber (of sacrifice), the offerer of every oblation, the object of veneration, the lord, theresplendent, to him who desires his friendship.

mantras.sanskrit: सं जागृवद्भिर्जरमाण इध्यते दमे दमूना इषयन्निळस्पदे । विश्वस्य होता हविषो वरेण्यो विभुर्विभावा सुषखा सखीयते ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ jāgṛvadbhirjaramāṇa idhyate dame damūnā iṣayanniḷaspade | viśvasya hotā haviṣo vareṇyo vibhurvibhāvā suṣakhā sakhīyate ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: स दर्शतश्रीरतिथिर्गृहेगृहे वनेवने शिश्रिये तक्ववीरिव । जनंजनं जन्यो नाति मन्यते विश आ क्षेति विश्यो विशंविशम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa darśataśrīratithirgṛhegṛhe vanevane śiśriye takvavīriva | janaṃjanaṃ janyo nāti manyate viśa ā kṣeti viśyo viśaṃviśam ||

translations.english: Of manifest glory, he resorts as a guest to every house (of his worshippers) to every forest; friendly toman, like one going to all men, he disregards them not; kind to all, he dwells among all men, (he presides ove4r

mantras.sanskrit: सुदक्षो दक्षैः क्रतुनासि सुक्रतुरग्ने कविः काव्येनासि विश्ववित् । वसुर्वसूनां क्षयसि त्वमेक इद्द्यावा च यानि पृथिवी च पुष्यतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sudakṣo dakṣaiḥ kratunāsi sukraturagne kaviḥ kāvyenāsi viśvavit | vasurvasūnāṃ kṣayasi tvameka iddyāvā ca yāni pṛthivī ca puṣyataḥ ||

translations.english: You, Agni, are vigorous with vigour, you are active with acts (of piety), you are wise with wisdom, knowing all things. You are the dispenser of wealth, you abide alone, you are lord of the treasures of heaven and earth.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रजानन्नग्ने तव योनिमृत्वियमिळायास्पदे घृतवन्तमासदः । आ ते चिकित्र उषसामिवेतयोऽरेपसः सूर्यस्येव रश्मयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prajānannagne tava yonimṛtviyamiḷāyāspade ghṛtavantamāsadaḥ | ā te cikitra uṣasāmivetayo'repasaḥ sūryasyeva raśmayaḥ ||

translations.english: Sagacious Agni, you sit at your station suited to the sacrifice and anointed with butter at the foot-markof Iḷā. your quick-moving rays are manifested like those of the dawns, beautiful as those of the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: तव श्रियो वर्ष्यस्येव विद्युतश्चित्राश्चिकित्र उषसां न केतवः । यदोषधीरभिसृष्टो वनानि च परि स्वयं चिनुषे अन्नमास्ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava śriyo varṣyasyeva vidyutaścitrāścikitra uṣasāṃ na ketavaḥ | yadoṣadhīrabhisṛṣṭo vanāni ca pari svayaṃ cinuṣe annamāsye ||

translations.english: Your glories, Agni, like the lightnings of the rain-cloud are manifested many-tinted, like themanifestations of the dawn, when quitting the plural nts and the forests, you gather on all sides food for your mouth.

mantras.sanskrit: तमोषधीर्दधिरे गर्भमृत्वियं तमापो अग्निं जनयन्त मातरः । तमित्समानं वनिनश्च वीरुधोऽन्तर्वतीश्च सुवते च विश्वहा ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamoṣadhīrdadhire garbhamṛtviyaṃ tamāpo agniṃ janayanta mātaraḥ | tamitsamānaṃ vaninaśca vīrudho'ntarvatīśca suvate ca viśvahā ||

translations.english: The plural nts bear him as the embryo (conceived) in due season; the maternal waters bring forth Agni;yes, the trees and the pregnant creepers bring him forth daily like themselves.

mantras.sanskrit: वातोपधूत इषितो वशाँ अनु तृषु यदन्ना वेविषद्वितिष्ठसे । आ ते यतन्ते रथ्यो यथा पृथक्छर्धांस्यग्ने अजराणि धक्षतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vātopadhūta iṣito vaśā~ anu tṛṣu yadannā veviṣadvitiṣṭhase | ā te yatante rathyo yathā pṛthakchardhāṃsyagne ajarāṇi dhakṣataḥ ||

translations.english: When, agitated by the wind and quickly moving through the beloved (trees), you spread aboutdevouring the food, the imperishable energies of you, Agni, the devourer, rush forth like charioteers.

mantras.sanskrit: मेधाकारं विदथस्य प्रसाधनमग्निं होतारं परिभूतमं मतिम् । तमिदर्भे हविष्या समानमित्तमिन्महे वृणते नान्यं त्वत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: medhākāraṃ vidathasya prasādhanamagniṃ hotāraṃ paribhūtamaṃ matim | tamidarbhe haviṣyā samānamittaminmahe vṛṇate nānyaṃ tvat ||

translations.english: (The priest) selects you, (Agni), the giver of intelligence, the accomplisher of the sacrifice, the invokerof the gods, the chief overcomer of foes, the councillor, alike verily at the lesser and at the greater oblation andnone other than you.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामिदत्र वृणते त्वायवो होतारमग्ने विदथेषु वेधसः । यद्देवयन्तो दधति प्रयांसि ते हविष्मन्तो मनवो वृक्तबर्हिषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmidatra vṛṇate tvāyavo hotāramagne vidatheṣu vedhasaḥ | yaddevayanto dadhati prayāṃsi te haviṣmanto manavo vṛktabarhiṣaḥ ||

translations.english: The performers of sacred rites, devoted to Agni, to you, select you as the ministrant priest at sacrificesin this world, when the devout worshippers bearing oblations and strewing the clipped sacred grass offer youfood.

mantras.sanskrit: तवाग्ने होत्रं तव पोत्रमृत्वियं तव नेष्ट्रं त्वमग्निदृतायतः । तव प्रशास्त्रं त्वमध्वरीयसि ब्रह्मा चासि गृहपतिश्च नो दमे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tavāgne hotraṃ tava potramṛtviyaṃ tava neṣṭraṃ tvamagnidṛtāyataḥ | tava praśāstraṃ tvamadhvarīyasi brahmā cāsi gṛhapatiśca no dame ||

translations.english: Yours, Agni, is the function of the Hotā, yours the duly-performed function of the Potā, yours thefunction of the Neṣṭā, you are the Agni of the sacrificer, yours is the office of the Praśāstā, you act asAdhvaryu, and you are the Brahmā and the lord of the mansion in our abode.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्तुभ्यमग्ने अमृताय मर्त्यः समिधा दाशदुत वा हविष्कृति । तस्य होता भवसि यासि दूत्यमुप ब्रूषे यजस्यध्वरीयसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yastubhyamagne amṛtāya martyaḥ samidhā dāśaduta vā haviṣkṛti | tasya hotā bhavasi yāsi dūtyamupa brūṣe yajasyadhvarīyasi ||

translations.english: The mortal, Agni, who presents to you, the immortal, fuel at the offering of the oblation-- you are hisHotā, you go on his errant (to the gods), you direct (the ceremonial), you offer the sacrifice, you act as theofficiating priest.

mantras.sanskrit: इमा अस्मै मतयो वाचो अस्मदाँ ऋचो गिरः सुष्टुतयः समग्मत । वसूयवो वसवे जातवेदसे वृद्धासु चिद्वर्धनो यासु चाकनत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: imā asmai matayo vāco asmadā~ ṛco giraḥ suṣṭutayaḥ samagmata | vasūyavo vasave jātavedase vṛddhāsu cidvardhano yāsu cākanat ||

translations.english: May these laudatory words, these eulogistic verses, these voices (proceeding) from us, reach him thegiver of wealth, Jātavedas; these wealth- desiring (words) in which when they are perfected, the perfecterdelights.

mantras.sanskrit: इमां प्रत्नाय सुष्टुतिं नवीयसीं वोचेयमस्मा उशते शृणोतु नः । भूया अन्तरा हृद्यस्य निस्पृशे जायेव पत्य उशती सुवासाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imāṃ pratnāya suṣṭutiṃ navīyasīṃ voceyamasmā uśate śṛṇotu naḥ | bhūyā antarā hṛdyasya nispṛśe jāyeva patya uśatī suvāsāḥ ||

translations.english: I will address this new laudatory hymn to the ancient Agni, who is gratified (by praise). May he hear uṣMay I be in the centre of his heart, to touch it, like a loving well-attired wife (in the heart) of her husband.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्मिन्नश्वास ऋषभास उक्षणो वशा मेषा अवसृष्टास आहुताः । कीलालपे सोमपृष्ठाय वेधसे हृदा मतिं जनये चारुमग्नये ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasminnaśvāsa ṛṣabhāsa ukṣaṇo vaśā meṣā avasṛṣṭāsa āhutāḥ | kīlālape somapṛṣṭhāya vedhase hṛdā matiṃ janaye cārumagnaye ||

translations.english: I offer graceful praise with all my heart to Agni, the drinker of water, whose back is sprinkled withSoma, the ordainer (of the rite), to whom vigorous horses and bulls and barren cows and sheep are consignedas burnt offerings.

mantras.sanskrit: अहाव्यग्ने हविरास्ये ते स्रुचीव घृतं चम्वीव सोमः । वाजसनिं रयिमस्मे सुवीरं प्रशस्तं धेहि यशसं बृहन्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahāvyagne havirāsye te srucīva ghṛtaṃ camvīva somaḥ | vājasaniṃ rayimasme suvīraṃ praśastaṃ dhehi yaśasaṃ bṛhantam ||

translations.english: The oblation has been poured, Agni, into your mouth, like butter into the ladle, like Soma into thespoon. Bestow upon us riches conferring food, (comprehending) male progeny, excellent renowned andabundant.

mantras.sanskrit: यज्ञस्य वो रथ्यं विश्पतिं विशां होतारमक्तोरतिथिं विभावसुम् । शोचञ्छुष्कासु हरिणीषु जर्भुरद्वृषा केतुर्यजतो द्यामशायत ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajñasya vo rathyaṃ viśpatiṃ viśāṃ hotāramaktoratithiṃ vibhāvasum | śocañchuṣkāsu hariṇīṣu jarbhuradvṛṣā keturyajato dyāmaśāyata ||

translations.english: You (gods, adore) the charioteer of the sacrifice, the lord of men, the invoker of the gods, the guest ofnight, the resplendent (Agni). Blazing amid the dry (bushes) preying upon the green, the showerer of desires, thebanner (of light), the adorable, he reposes in heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: इममञ्जस्पामुभये अकृण्वत धर्माणमग्निं विदथस्य साधनम् । अक्तुं न यह्वमुषसः पुरोहितं तनूनपातमरुषस्य निंसते ॥
mantras.transliteration: imamañjaspāmubhaye akṛṇvata dharmāṇamagniṃ vidathasya sādhanam | aktuṃ na yahvamuṣasaḥ purohitaṃ tanūnapātamaruṣasya niṃsate ||

translations.english: Both (men and gods) have made Agni the speedy protector, the upholder of duty, the accomplisher ofthe sacrifice; they have recourse to him (who is) vast as the sun, the precursor of the dawn, the son of thebrilliant (Vāyu).

mantras.sanskrit: बळस्य नीथा वि पणेश्च मन्महे वया अस्य प्रहुता आसुरत्तवे । यदा घोरासो अमृतत्वमाशतादिज्जनस्य दैव्यस्य चर्किरन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: baḷasya nīthā vi paṇeśca manmahe vayā asya prahutā āsurattave | yadā ghorāso amṛtatvamāśatādijjanasya daivyasya carkiran ||

translations.english: We desire that our notion of that adorable (Agni) may be true, and that our oblations may be to him forfood. When his formidable (flames) attain immortality, then may our priests scatter (oblations for the benefit) ofthe divine being.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतस्य हि प्रसितिर्द्यौरुरु व्यचो नमो मह्यरमतिः पनीयसी । इन्द्रो मित्रो वरुणः सं चिकित्रिरेऽथो भगः सविता पूतदक्षसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtasya hi prasitirdyaururu vyaco namo mahyaramatiḥ panīyasī | indro mitro varuṇaḥ saṃ cikitrire'tho bhagaḥ savitā pūtadakṣasaḥ ||

translations.english: The vast heavven, the spacious firmament, the glorious unbounded earth, (do) homage (to the Agni)of the sacrifice; and Indra, Mitra, Varuṇa, Bhaga, and Savitā, whose strength is purified, unite to recognize (hisexcellence). the circumambient (Indra) sweeping over a wide space, roaring in the belly (of the firmament), sprinkles the wholeworld.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र रुद्रेण ययिना यन्ति सिन्धवस्तिरो महीमरमतिं दधन्विरे । येभिः परिज्मा परियन्नुरु ज्रयो वि रोरुवज्जठरे विश्वमुक्षते ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra rudreṇa yayinā yanti sindhavastiro mahīmaramatiṃ dadhanvire | yebhiḥ parijmā pariyannuru jrayo vi roruvajjaṭhare viśvamukṣate ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: क्राणा रुद्रा मरुतो विश्वकृष्टयो दिवः श्येनासो असुरस्य नीळयः । तेभिश्चष्टे वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमेन्द्रो देवेभिरर्वशेभिरर्वशः ॥
mantras.transliteration: krāṇā rudrā maruto viśvakṛṣṭayo divaḥ śyenāso asurasya nīḷayaḥ | tebhiścaṣṭe varuṇo mitro aryamendro devebhirarvaśebhirarvaśaḥ ||

translations.english: The Maruts, the sons of Rudra, mixing with men, the hawks of the sky, the inhabitants of the cloud,(are) performing (their functions); with those horse-owing deities, Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman, and Indra, the lord ofhorses contemplates (the rite).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रे भुजं शशमानास आशत सूरो दृशीके वृषणश्च पौंस्ये । प्र ये न्वस्यार्हणा ततक्षिरे युजं वज्रं नृषदनेषु कारवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indre bhujaṃ śaśamānāsa āśata sūro dṛśīke vṛṣaṇaśca pauṃsye | pra ye nvasyārhaṇā tatakṣire yujaṃ vajraṃ nṛṣadaneṣu kāravaḥ ||

translations.english: Those who praise him find protection in Indra; (those who praise him find) universal vision in the sun;(those who praise him find) manly vigour in the vigorous (Indra); those worshippers who diligently offer adorationto Indra (acquire) the thunderbolt as their ally in the dwellings of men.

mantras.sanskrit: सूरश्चिदा हरितो अस्य रीरमदिन्द्रादा कश्चिद्भयते तवीयसः । भीमस्य वृष्णो जठरादभिश्वसो दिवेदिवे सहुरिः स्तन्नबाधितः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sūraścidā harito asya rīramadindrādā kaścidbhayate tavīyasaḥ | bhīmasya vṛṣṇo jaṭharādabhiśvaso divedive sahuriḥ stannabādhitaḥ ||

translations.english: The sun urging his steeds (in obedience to) his (commands) delights (in his presence); every (god) isin fear of the powerful Indra; from the belly of the formidable sighing showerer (of benefits) the all-enduringirresistible (deity) thunders day by day.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तोमं वो अद्य रुद्राय शिक्वसे क्षयद्वीराय नमसा दिदिष्टन । येभिः शिवः स्ववाँ एवयावभिर्दिवः सिषक्ति स्वयशा निकामभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: stomaṃ vo adya rudrāya śikvase kṣayadvīrāya namasā didiṣṭana | yebhiḥ śivaḥ svavā~ evayāvabhirdivaḥ siṣakti svayaśā nikāmabhiḥ ||

translations.english: Address praise today with reverence to Rudra the powerful destroyer of the heroes, (who isaccompanied) by the mounted (Maruts), the granters of wishes, together with whom he, propitious, possessingkinsmen, besprinkles (the worshippers) from heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: ते हि प्रजाया अभरन्त वि श्रवो बृहस्पतिर्वृषभः सोमजामयः । यज्ञैरथर्वा प्रथमो वि धारयद्देवा दक्षैर्भृगवः सं चिकित्रिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: te hi prajāyā abharanta vi śravo bṛhaspatirvṛṣabhaḥ somajāmayaḥ | yajñairatharvā prathamo vi dhārayaddevā dakṣairbhṛgavaḥ saṃ cikitrire ||

translations.english: Inasmuch as Bṛhaspati, the showerer (of benefits) and the kindred of Soma (the Visvedevās),bestow food (for the support) of people, Atharvan was the first to invigorate (the gods) with sacrifices; withstrength the gods and Bhṛgus discovered (the cattle).

mantras.sanskrit: ते हि द्यावापृथिवी भूरिरेतसा नराशंसश्चतुरङ्गो यमोऽदितिः । देवस्त्वष्टा द्रविणोदा ऋभुक्षणः प्र रोदसी मरुतो विष्णुरर्हिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: te hi dyāvāpṛthivī bhūriretasā narāśaṃsaścaturaṅgo yamo'ditiḥ | devastvaṣṭā draviṇodā ṛbhukṣaṇaḥ pra rodasī maruto viṣṇurarhire ||

translations.english: They the heaven and earth, abounding with waters, the Narāśaṃsa rite with its four fires, Yama,Aditi, the divine Tvaṣṭā, (Agni) the giver of wealth, the Ṛbhus, Rodasī, the Maruts, and Viṣṇu areworshipped (by us).

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्य न उशिजामुर्विया कविरहिः शृणोतु बुध्न्यो हवीमनि । सूर्यामासा विचरन्ता दिविक्षिता धिया शमीनहुषी अस्य बोधतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta sya na uśijāmurviyā kavirahiḥ śṛṇotu budhnyo havīmani | sūryāmāsā vicarantā divikṣitā dhiyā śamīnahuṣī asya bodhatam ||

translations.english: And may the wise Ahi of the firmament hear the copious (pulse) of us eager (worshippers) at theoffering of oblations. May the revolving sun and moon dwelling in heaven, the earth and sky, comprehend bytheir intelligence (the purport) of this (our praise).

mantras.sanskrit: प्र नः पूषा चरथं विश्वदेव्योऽपां नपादवतु वायुरिष्टये । आत्मानं वस्यो अभि वातमर्चत तदश्विना सुहवा यामनि श्रुतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra naḥ pūṣā carathaṃ viśvadevyo'pāṃ napādavatu vāyuriṣṭaye | ātmānaṃ vasyo abhi vātamarcata tadaśvinā suhavā yāmani śrutam ||

translations.english: May Pūṣan protect all our moveable (property); may Vāyu, the friend of the Viśvedevās, thegrandson of the waters, preserve us for the celebration of the sacrifice. Worship the wind, the soul of all, (toobtain) excellent (food); Aśvins, who are worthy to be invoked, hear us on your way.

mantras.sanskrit: विशामासामभयानामधिक्षितं गीर्भिरु स्वयशसं गृणीमसि । ग्नाभिर्विश्वाभिरदितिमनर्वणमक्तोर्युवानं नृमणा अधा पतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśāmāsāmabhayānāmadhikṣitaṃ gīrbhiru svayaśasaṃ gṛṇīmasi | gnābhirviśvābhiraditimanarvaṇamaktoryuvānaṃ nṛmaṇā adhā patim ||

translations.english: We glorify with praises Agni, the self-famous, who dwells among these fearless beings; we praise theirresistible Aditi, together with all the wives (of the gods); we praise the young (lord) of night (the moon), wepraise the friend of man (the sun), we praise (Indra) the lord (of all).

mantras.sanskrit: रेभदत्र जनुषा पूर्वो अङ्गिरा ग्रावाण ऊर्ध्वा अभि चक्षुरध्वरम् । येभिर्विहाया अभवद्विचक्षणः पाथः सुमेकं स्वधितिर्वनन्वति ॥
mantras.transliteration: rebhadatra januṣā pūrvo aṅgirā grāvāṇa ūrdhvā abhi cakṣuradhvaram | yebhirvihāyā abhavadvicakṣaṇaḥ pāthaḥ sumekaṃ svadhitirvananvati ||

translations.english: Aṅgirasa, the prior in birth, praises (the gods, here); the uplifted stones behold (the Soma of) thesacrifice, through which (stones) the sage Indra has been exalted, (and his) thunderbolt brings forth excellentwater, (producing) food on watery way.

mantras.sanskrit: महि द्यावापृथिवी भूतमुर्वी नारी यह्वी न रोदसी सदं नः । तेभिर्नः पातं सह्यस एभिर्नः पातं शूषणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahi dyāvāpṛthivī bhūtamurvī nārī yahvī na rodasī sadaṃ naḥ | tebhirnaḥ pātaṃ sahyasa ebhirnaḥ pātaṃ śūṣaṇi ||

translations.english: Heaven and earth, be great and spacious; mighty Rodasī, be ever with us like wives; with these (yourprotections), protect us from (the foe who is) stronger (than we), with these protect us in the might (of ourenemies).

mantras.sanskrit: यज्ञेयज्ञे स मर्त्यो देवान्त्सपर्यति । यः सुम्नैर्दीर्घश्रुत्तम आविवासत्येनान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajñeyajñe sa martyo devāntsaparyati | yaḥ sumnairdīrghaśruttama āvivāsatyenān ||

translations.english: That man plural ases the gods at every sacrifice who, being most versed in protracted texts, worshipsthem with gratifying (oblations).

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वेषामिरज्यवो देवानां वार्महः । विश्वे हि विश्वमहसो विश्वे यज्ञेषु यज्ञियाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśveṣāmirajyavo devānāṃ vārmahaḥ | viśve hi viśvamahaso viśve yajñeṣu yajñiyāḥ ||

translations.english: Lords of all worlds, (give us) the abundant wealth of the gods; for (you) all are endowed with greatglory (you) all are to be worshipped at the sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: ते घा राजानो अमृतस्य मन्द्रा अर्यमा मित्रो वरुणः परिज्मा । कद्रुद्रो नृणां स्तुतो मरुतः पूषणो भगः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te ghā rājāno amṛtasya mandrā aryamā mitro varuṇaḥ parijmā | kadrudro nṛṇāṃ stuto marutaḥ pūṣaṇo bhagaḥ ||

translations.english: They are the lords of the ambrosia, adorable, Aryaman, Mitra, the circumambient Varuṇa, Rudra, whois hymned by the priests, the Maruts, Pūṣan, Bhaga.

mantras.sanskrit: उत नो नक्तमपां वृषण्वसू सूर्यामासा सदनाय सधन्या । सचा यत्साद्येषामहिर्बुध्नेषु बुध्न्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta no naktamapāṃ vṛṣaṇvasū sūryāmāsā sadanāya sadhanyā | sacā yatsādyeṣāmahirbudhneṣu budhnyaḥ ||

translations.english: And (you two Aśvins) showering wealth, (you) sun and moon, (lords) of the waters, equally rich,(come) by night to our abode, when Ahirbudhnya sits down in their company in the firmamental (clouds).

mantras.sanskrit: उत नो देवावश्विना शुभस्पती धामभिर्मित्रावरुणा उरुष्यताम् । महः स राय एषतेऽति धन्वेव दुरिता ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta no devāvaśvinā śubhaspatī dhāmabhirmitrāvaruṇā uruṣyatām | mahaḥ sa rāya eṣate'ti dhanveva duritā ||

translations.english: And may the divine Aśvins, the lords of pure (water), and Mitra and Varuṇa protect us with theirbodies; he (whom they protect) acquires ample riches, (and passes) through misfortunes as (a traveller through)a desert.

mantras.sanskrit: उत नो रुद्रा चिन्मृळतामश्विना विश्वे देवासो रथस्पतिर्भगः । ऋभुर्वाज ऋभुक्षणः परिज्मा विश्ववेदसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta no rudrā cinmṛḷatāmaśvinā viśve devāso rathaspatirbhagaḥ | ṛbhurvāja ṛbhukṣaṇaḥ parijmā viśvavedasaḥ ||

translations.english: And may the Rudras, the Aśvins, make us happy, (may) the universal gods, the lord of chariots,Bhaga, Ṛbhu, Vāja, Ribhukṣaṇa, the circumambient (Vāyu) and the omniscient (deities make us happy).

mantras.sanskrit: ऋभुॠभुक्षा ऋभुर्विधतो मद आ ते हरी जूजुवानस्य वाजिना । दुष्टरं यस्य साम चिदृधग्यज्ञो न मानुषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛbhuṝbhukṣā ṛbhurvidhato mada ā te harī jūjuvānasya vājinā | duṣṭaraṃ yasya sāma cidṛdhagyajño na mānuṣaḥ ||

translations.english: The mighty (Indra) is resplendent (through the sacrifice), the joy of the worshipper is resplendent;vigorous are the two horses of you rapidly approaching, whose hymn is unassailable (by the rākṣasas); (this)sacrifice is apart, not human.

mantras.sanskrit: कृधी नो अह्रयो देव सवितः स च स्तुषे मघोनाम् । सहो न इन्द्रो वह्निभिर्न्येषां चर्षणीनां चक्रं रश्मिं न योयुवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: kṛdhī no ahrayo deva savitaḥ sa ca stuṣe maghonām | saho na indro vahnibhirnyeṣāṃ carṣaṇīnāṃ cakraṃ raśmiṃ na yoyuve ||

translations.english: Make us, divine Savitā, free from shame; you are praised (by the priests) of the opulent; may Indra,accompanied by the bearers (of water), unite the strength of us men here, like the chariot-wheel and reinṣ

mantras.sanskrit: ऐषु द्यावापृथिवी धातं महदस्मे वीरेषु विश्वचर्षणि श्रवः । पृक्षं वाजस्य सातये पृक्षं रायोत तुर्वणे ॥
mantras.transliteration: aiṣu dyāvāpṛthivī dhātaṃ mahadasme vīreṣu viśvacarṣaṇi śravaḥ | pṛkṣaṃ vājasya sātaye pṛkṣaṃ rāyota turvaṇe ||

translations.english: Heaven and earth, grant to these our sons great renown, extending over all mankind; grantsustenance for the acquisition of strength, sustenance together with wealth for the overthrow (of enemies).

mantras.sanskrit: एतं शंसमिन्द्रास्मयुष्ट्वं कूचित्सन्तं सहसावन्नभिष्टये । सदा पाह्यभिष्टये मेदतां वेदता वसो ॥
mantras.transliteration: etaṃ śaṃsamindrāsmayuṣṭvaṃ kūcitsantaṃ sahasāvannabhiṣṭaye | sadā pāhyabhiṣṭaye medatāṃ vedatā vaso ||

translations.english: Mighty Indra, do you, who are well affected towards us, ever protect this worshipper wherever he maybe, so that he may attain his desire; instrumental uct me, Vasu, by your wisdom.

mantras.sanskrit: एतं मे स्तोमं तना न सूर्ये द्युतद्यामानं वावृधन्त नृणाम् । संवननं नाश्व्यं तष्टेवानपच्युतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: etaṃ me stomaṃ tanā na sūrye dyutadyāmānaṃ vāvṛdhanta nṛṇām | saṃvananaṃ nāśvyaṃ taṣṭevānapacyutam ||

translations.english: May (the priests) strengthen this my hymn, the destroyer of the enemies (of the gods), of brilliant pathlike, the rays in the sun, as the carpenter (sends forth) the upright car.

mantras.sanskrit: वावर्त येषां राया युक्तैषां हिरण्ययी । नेमधिता न पौंस्या वृथेव विष्टान्ता ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāvarta yeṣāṃ rāyā yuktaiṣāṃ hiraṇyayī | nemadhitā na pauṃsyā vṛtheva viṣṭāntā ||

translations.english: Those whose (praise) arrives, accompanied by wealth, of them it is (as) a golden (ornament), likemanly powers in battle reaching the conclusion as it were, without an effort.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र तद्दुःशीमे पृथवाने वेने प्र रामे वोचमसुरे मघवत्सु । ये युक्त्वाय पञ्च शतास्मयु पथा विश्राव्येषाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra tadduḥśīme pṛthavāne vene pra rāme vocamasure maghavatsu | ye yuktvāya pañca śatāsmayu pathā viśrāvyeṣām ||

translations.english: This I proclaim in the presence of Duśīma, Pṛthavāna, Vena, the mighty Rāma, and (other)opulent (princes); those who (come), having yoked five hundred (chariots), their affection for us is renowned onthe road.

mantras.sanskrit: अधीन्न्वत्र सप्ततिं च सप्त च । सद्यो दिदिष्ट तान्वः सद्यो दिदिष्ट पार्थ्यः सद्यो दिदिष्ट मायवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhīnnvatra saptatiṃ ca sapta ca | sadyo didiṣṭa tānvaḥ sadyo didiṣṭa pārthyaḥ sadyo didiṣṭa māyavaḥ ||

translations.english: Strongest of them Tānva promptly demanded seven and seventy (cows), Pārthya demandedall three names may refer to the same person n].

mantras.sanskrit: प्रैते वदन्तु प्र वयं वदाम ग्रावभ्यो वाचं वदता वदद्भ्यः । यदद्रयः पर्वताः साकमाशवः श्लोकं घोषं भरथेन्द्राय सोमिनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: praite vadantu pra vayaṃ vadāma grāvabhyo vācaṃ vadatā vadadbhyaḥ | yadadrayaḥ parvatāḥ sākamāśavaḥ ślokaṃ ghoṣaṃ bharathendrāya sominaḥ ||

translations.english: Let these (stones) speak; let us reply to the speaking stones, and do you (priests) utter (praise); when,you solid, quick-moving stones, you utter the noise of praise together to Indra, (then you become) full of theSoma.

mantras.sanskrit: एते वदन्ति शतवत्सहस्रवदभि क्रन्दन्ति हरितेभिरासभिः । विष्ट्वी ग्रावाणः सुकृतः सुकृत्यया होतुश्चित्पूर्वे हविरद्यमाशत ॥
mantras.transliteration: ete vadanti śatavatsahasravadabhi krandanti haritebhirāsabhiḥ | viṣṭvī grāvāṇaḥ sukṛtaḥ sukṛtyayā hotuścitpūrve haviradyamāśata ||

translations.english: They roar like a hundred, like a thousand (men); they cry aloud with green-tinted faces; obtaining thesacrifice, the pious stones through their piety partake of the sacrificial food, even before (Agni), the invoker (ofthe gods).

mantras.sanskrit: एते वदन्त्यविदन्नना मधु न्यूङ्खयन्ते अधि पक्व आमिषि । वृक्षस्य शाखामरुणस्य बप्सतस्ते सूभर्वा वृषभाः प्रेमराविषुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ete vadantyavidannanā madhu nyūṅkhayante adhi pakva āmiṣi | vṛkṣasya śākhāmaruṇasya bapsataste sūbharvā vṛṣabhāḥ premarāviṣuḥ ||

translations.english: They speak, they received into their mouth the sweet (Soma), they roar (like the eaters of flesh) overthe roasted meat; chewing the branch of the purplle tree, the voracious bulls have bellowed.

mantras.sanskrit: बृहद्वदन्ति मदिरेण मन्दिनेन्द्रं क्रोशन्तोऽविदन्नना मधु । संरभ्या धीराः स्वसृभिरनर्तिषुराघोषयन्तः पृथिवीमुपब्दिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhadvadanti madireṇa mandinendraṃ krośanto'vidannanā madhu | saṃrabhyā dhīrāḥ svasṛbhiranartiṣurāghoṣayantaḥ pṛthivīmupabdibhiḥ ||

translations.english: They cry aloud calling upon Indra with the intoxicating effused (Soma), they took the sweet Soma intotheir mouth, seized by the sister (fingers) the bold stones danced, filling the earth with shouts.

mantras.sanskrit: सुपर्णा वाचमक्रतोप द्यव्याखरे कृष्णा इषिरा अनर्तिषुः । न्यङ्नि यन्त्युपरस्य निष्कृतं पुरू रेतो दधिरे सूर्यश्वितः ॥
mantras.transliteration: suparṇā vācamakratopa dyavyākhare kṛṣṇā iṣirā anartiṣuḥ | nyaṅni yantyuparasya niṣkṛtaṃ purū reto dadhire sūryaśvitaḥ ||

translations.english: The well-gliding stones made a noise in the firmament; they danced (like) the black deer in the stall;they exude down from the upper stone the expressed (Soma); white as the sun they yield abundant moisture.

mantras.sanskrit: उग्रा इव प्रवहन्तः समायमुः साकं युक्ता वृषणो बिभ्रतो धुरः । यच्छ्वसन्तो जग्रसाना अराविषुः शृण्व एषां प्रोथथो अर्वतामिव ॥
mantras.transliteration: ugrā iva pravahantaḥ samāyamuḥ sākaṃ yuktā vṛṣaṇo bibhrato dhuraḥ | yacchvasanto jagrasānā arāviṣuḥ śṛṇva eṣāṃ prothatho arvatāmiva ||

translations.english: Bearing the burden of the sacrifice, yoked with (the Soma), they extend themselves like spiritedhorses; when panting and extracting (the Soma), they cried aloud, their snoring is heard like that of horses.

mantras.sanskrit: दशावनिभ्यो दशकक्ष्येभ्यो दशयोक्त्रेभ्यो दशयोजनेभ्यः । दशाभीशुभ्यो अर्चताजरेभ्यो दश धुरो दश युक्ता वहद्भ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: daśāvanibhyo daśakakṣyebhyo daśayoktrebhyo daśayojanebhyaḥ | daśābhīśubhyo arcatājarebhyo daśa dhuro daśa yuktā vahadbhyaḥ ||

translations.english: Worship (priests), those imperishable (stones) which have ten workers, ten girths, ten yokes, tenagents, ten encompassers, which are possessed of ten burdens, which bear (the sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: ते अद्रयो दशयन्त्रास आशवस्तेषामाधानं पर्येति हर्यतम् । त ऊ सुतस्य सोम्यस्यान्धस्ॐऽशोः पीयूषं प्रथमस्य भेजिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: te adrayo daśayantrāsa āśavasteṣāmādhānaṃ paryeti haryatam | ta ū sutasya somyasyāndhasoṃ'śoḥ pīyūṣaṃ prathamasya bhejire ||

translations.english: These stones, having ten reins, swiftly moving, their delightful whirling goes round; they first tasted theambrosia of the fragment of food of the expressed Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: ते सोमादो हरी इन्द्रस्य निंसतेंऽशुं दुहन्तो अध्यासते गवि । तेभिर्दुग्धं पपिवान्त्सोम्यं मध्विन्द्रो वर्धते प्रथते वृषायते ॥
mantras.transliteration: te somādo harī indrasya niṃsateṃ'śuṃ duhanto adhyāsate gavi | tebhirdugdhaṃ papivāntsomyaṃ madhvindro vardhate prathate vṛṣāyate ||

translations.english: These devourers of Soma kiss Indra's horses, milking forth the juice they repose upon the cow, Indrahaving quaffed the sweet Soma milked forth by them increases, waxes broad, grows vigour.

mantras.sanskrit: वृषा वो अंशुर्न किला रिषाथनेळावन्तः सदमित्स्थनाशिताः । रैवत्येव महसा चारवः स्थन यस्य ग्रावाणो अजुषध्वमध्वरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣā vo aṃśurna kilā riṣāthaneḷāvantaḥ sadamitsthanāśitāḥ | raivatyeva mahasā cāravaḥ sthana yasya grāvāṇo ajuṣadhvamadhvaram ||

translations.english: The Soma is your showerer (at the sacrifice); you are unharmed, (like those) abounding in food, youare constantly feeding; like the wealthy (possessed) of splendour, you, O stones, are beautiful (at the sacrifice ofhim) whose sacrifice you delighted in.

mantras.sanskrit: तृदिला अतृदिलासो अद्रयोऽश्रमणा अशृथिता अमृत्यवः । अनातुरा अजराः स्थामविष्णवः सुपीवसो अतृषिता अतृष्णजः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tṛdilā atṛdilāso adrayo'śramaṇā aśṛthitā amṛtyavaḥ | anāturā ajarāḥ sthāmaviṣṇavaḥ supīvaso atṛṣitā atṛṣṇajaḥ ||

translations.english: Splitting, but unsplit, you, O stones, are untiring, unrelaxing, immortal, free from disease, undecaying,rising and falling, powerful, unthirsting, not genitive rating thirst.

mantras.sanskrit: ध्रुवा एव वः पितरो युगेयुगे क्षेमकामासः सदसो न युञ्जते । अजुर्यासो हरिषाचो हरिद्रव आ द्यां रवेण पृथिवीमशुश्रवुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhruvā eva vaḥ pitaro yugeyuge kṣemakāmāsaḥ sadaso na yuñjate | ajuryāso hariṣāco haridrava ā dyāṃ raveṇa pṛthivīmaśuśravuḥ ||

translations.english: Your progenitors (the mountains), stable from age to age, desirous of repose, seek not to mix with(religious) assemblies; exempt from decay, enjoying the Soma, flowing green (with Soma), they made heavenand earth resound with their clamour.

mantras.sanskrit: तदिद्वदन्त्यद्रयो विमोचने यामन्नञ्जस्पा इव घेदुपब्दिभिः । वपन्तो बीजमिव धान्याकृतः पृञ्चन्ति सोमं न मिनन्ति बप्सतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadidvadantyadrayo vimocane yāmannañjaspā iva ghedupabdibhiḥ | vapanto bījamiva dhānyākṛtaḥ pṛñcanti somaṃ na minanti bapsataḥ ||

translations.english: The stones proclaim it with their clamour at the issue of the Soma, like the quick-protecting (chariots)on the road; like cultivators sowing the seed, they, devouring the Soma, mix it, and do not hurt it.

mantras.sanskrit: सुते अध्वरे अधि वाचमक्रता क्रीळयो न मातरं तुदन्तः । वि षू मुञ्चा सुषुवुषो मनीषां वि वर्तन्तामद्रयश्चायमानाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sute adhvare adhi vācamakratā krīḷayo na mātaraṃ tudantaḥ | vi ṣū muñcā suṣuvuṣo manīṣāṃ vi vartantāmadrayaścāyamānāḥ ||

translations.english: (The Soma) being effused at the sacrifice, they made a noise like (children) at plural y, striking theirmother. Proclaim the praise of (the stone), which has effused (the Soma), let the honoured stones revolve.

mantras.sanskrit: हये जाये मनसा तिष्ठ घोरे वचांसि मिश्रा कृणवावहै नु । न नौ मन्त्रा अनुदितास एते मयस्करन्परतरे चनाहन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: haye jāye manasā tiṣṭha ghore vacāṃsi miśrā kṛṇavāvahai nu | na nau mantrā anuditāsa ete mayaskaranparatare canāhan ||

translations.english: (Purūravā) speaks). How indignant wife, with mind (relenting), stay awhile, let us now interchangediscourse. These, our secret thoughts, while unspoken, did not yield us happiness even at the last day.

mantras.sanskrit: किमेता वाचा कृणवा तवाहं प्राक्रमिषमुषसामग्रियेव । पुरूरवः पुनरस्तं परेहि दुरापना वात इवाहमस्मि ॥
mantras.transliteration: kimetā vācā kṛṇavā tavāhaṃ prākramiṣamuṣasāmagriyeva | purūravaḥ punarastaṃ parehi durāpanā vāta ivāhamasmi ||

translations.english: (Ūrvaśī. What can we accomplish through such discourse? I have passed away from you like thefirst of the dawns. Return Purūravā, to your dwelling; I am as hard to catch as the wind.

mantras.sanskrit: इषुर्न श्रिय इषुधेरसना गोषाः शतसा न रंहिः । अवीरे क्रतौ वि दविद्युतन्नोरा न मायुं चितयन्त धुनयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: iṣurna śriya iṣudherasanā goṣāḥ śatasā na raṃhiḥ | avīre kratau vi davidyutannorā na māyuṃ citayanta dhunayaḥ ||

translations.english: (Purūravā). The arrow is not to be cast from the quiver for glory. I am no longer the impetuousdespoiler of the cattle (of the enemy), nor of their hundred-fold (riches). My prowess having lost its strength, (mymight) no longer flashes forth; (my warriors) the terrifiers (of the foe) hear not my shout in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: सा वसु दधती श्वशुराय वय उषो यदि वष्ट्यन्तिगृहात् । अस्तं ननक्षे यस्मिञ्चाकन्दिवा नक्तं श्नथिता वैतसेन ॥
mantras.transliteration: sā vasu dadhatī śvaśurāya vaya uṣo yadi vaṣṭyantigṛhāt | astaṃ nanakṣe yasmiñcākandivā naktaṃ śnathitā vaitasena ||

translations.english: (Ūrvaśi). If, Uṣas, this Ūrvaśī, offering food and wealth to her father-in-law, loves (her husband),she has gone from the neighbouring house to her husband's home, where she loved (her lord), being delightednight and day by his embraces.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिः स्म माह्नः श्नथयो वैतसेनोत स्म मेऽव्यत्यै पृणासि । पुरूरवोऽनु ते केतमायं राजा मे वीर तन्वस्तदासीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: triḥ sma māhnaḥ śnathayo vaitasenota sma me'vyatyai pṛṇāsi | purūravo'nu te ketamāyaṃ rājā me vīra tanvastadāsīḥ ||

translations.english: Thrice a day, Purūravā, have you embraced me, you have loved me without a rival; I have followed(you) to your dwelling, you, hero, have been the sovereign of my person n.

mantras.sanskrit: या सुजूर्णिः श्रेणिः सुम्नआपिर्ह्रदेचक्षुर्न ग्रन्थिनी चरण्युः । ता अञ्जयोऽरुणयो न सस्रुः श्रिये गावो न धेनवोऽनवन्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā sujūrṇiḥ śreṇiḥ sumnaāpirhradecakṣurna granthinī caraṇyuḥ | tā añjayo'ruṇayo na sasruḥ śriye gāvo na dhenavo'navanta ||

translations.english: (Purūravā). Sujūraṇi, Śreṇi, Sumna-āpi, Hradecakṣus, Granthinī, and the swift-moving(Ūrvaśi who arrived) they, decorated and purple-tinted, did not go first, they lowed like kine for protection.

mantras.sanskrit: समस्मिञ्जायमान आसत ग्ना उतेमवर्धन्नद्यः स्वगूर्ताः । महे यत्त्वा पुरूरवो रणायावर्धयन्दस्युहत्याय देवाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samasmiñjāyamāna āsata gnā utemavardhannadyaḥ svagūrtāḥ | mahe yattvā purūravo raṇāyāvardhayandasyuhatyāya devāḥ ||

translations.english: (Ūrvaśī). As soon as he was born the wives (of the gods) surrounded him, the spontaneouslyflowing rivers nourished him, for the gods reared you, Purūravā, for a mighty conflict, for the slaughter of theDasyus. (Nirukta, 3.47).

mantras.sanskrit: सचा यदासु जहतीष्वत्कममानुषीषु मानुषो निषेवे । अप स्म मत्तरसन्ती न भुज्युस्ता अत्रसन्रथस्पृशो नाश्वाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sacā yadāsu jahatīṣvatkamamānuṣīṣu mānuṣo niṣeve | apa sma mattarasantī na bhujyustā atrasanrathaspṛśo nāśvāḥ ||

translations.english: (Purūravā). When, becoming their companion, (Purūravā) the mortal associated with theseimmortal (nymphs) who had abandoned their bodies, they fled from me like a timid doe, like horses harnessed toa chariot.

mantras.sanskrit: यदासु मर्तो अमृतासु निस्पृक्सं क्षोणीभिः क्रतुभिर्न पृङ्क्ते । ता आतयो न तन्वः शुम्भत स्वा अश्वासो न क्रीळयो दन्दशानाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadāsu marto amṛtāsu nispṛksaṃ kṣoṇībhiḥ kratubhirna pṛṅkte | tā ātayo na tanvaḥ śumbhata svā aśvāso na krīḷayo dandaśānāḥ ||

translations.english: When a mortal mixing with these immortal nymphs has conversed with them with words and actions,they (becoming) ducks do not show their bodies, like plural yful horses champing (the bit).

mantras.sanskrit: विद्युन्न या पतन्ती दविद्योद्भरन्ती मे अप्या काम्यानि । जनिष्टो अपो नर्यः सुजातः प्रोर्वशी तिरत दीर्घमायुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vidyunna yā patantī davidyodbharantī me apyā kāmyāni | janiṣṭo apo naryaḥ sujātaḥ prorvaśī tirata dīrghamāyuḥ ||

translations.english: (Ūrvaśī) who shone like flashing lightning, bringing me the desirable dews (of heaven, hasappeared); a son able in act and friendly to man has been born; Ūrvaśī has prolonged my lengthenedexistence.

mantras.sanskrit: जज्ञिष इत्था गोपीथ्याय हि दधाथ तत्पुरूरवो म ओजः । अशासं त्वा विदुषी सस्मिन्नहन्न म आशृणोः किमभुग्वदासि ॥
mantras.transliteration: jajñiṣa itthā gopīthyāya hi dadhātha tatpurūravo ma ojaḥ | aśāsaṃ tvā viduṣī sasminnahanna ma āśṛṇoḥ kimabhugvadāsi ||

translations.english: (Ūrvaśī). you have been born thus to protect the earth; you have deposited this vigour in me;knowing (the future) I have instrumental ucted you (what to do) every day; you have not listened to me; why do you nowaddress me, neglectful (of my instrumental uction)?

mantras.sanskrit: कदा सूनुः पितरं जात इच्छाच्चक्रन्नाश्रु वर्तयद्विजानन् । को दम्पती समनसा वि यूयोदध यदग्निः श्वशुरेषु दीदयत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kadā sūnuḥ pitaraṃ jāta icchāccakrannāśru vartayadvijānan | ko dampatī samanasā vi yūyodadha yadagniḥ śvaśureṣu dīdayat ||

translations.english: (Purūravā). When shall a son (born of you) claim me as a father, and crying, shed a tear onrecognizing (me)? What son shall sever husband and wife who are of one mind, now that the fire shines uponyour husband's parents?

mantras.sanskrit: प्रति ब्रवाणि वर्तयते अश्रु चक्रन्न क्रन्ददाध्ये शिवायै । प्र तत्ते हिनवा यत्ते अस्मे परेह्यस्तं नहि मूर मापः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prati bravāṇi vartayate aśru cakranna krandadādhye śivāyai | pra tatte hinavā yatte asme parehyastaṃ nahi mūra māpaḥ ||

translations.english: (Ūrvaśī). Let me reply. (Your son) will shed tears, crying out and calling aloud when the expectedauspicious time arrives; I will send you that (child) which is yours in me, depart to your house, you cannot,simpleton, detain me.

mantras.sanskrit: सुदेवो अद्य प्रपतेदनावृत्परावतं परमां गन्तवा उ । अधा शयीत निॠतेरुपस्थेऽधैनं वृका रभसासो अद्युः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sudevo adya prapatedanāvṛtparāvataṃ paramāṃ gantavā u | adhā śayīta niṝterupasthe'dhainaṃ vṛkā rabhasāso adyuḥ ||

translations.english: (Purūravā). (Your husband) who sports with you may now depart, never to return, (depart) toproceed to a distant region. Either let him sleep upon the lap of Nirṛti, or let the swift-moving wolves devour hiṃ

mantras.sanskrit: पुरूरवो मा मृथा मा प्र पप्तो मा त्वा वृकासो अशिवास उ क्षन् । न वै स्त्रैणानि सख्यानि सन्ति सालावृकाणां हृदयान्येता ॥
mantras.transliteration: purūravo mā mṛthā mā pra papto mā tvā vṛkāso aśivāsa u kṣan | na vai straiṇāni sakhyāni santi sālāvṛkāṇāṃ hṛdayānyetā ||

translations.english: (Ūrvaśi). Die not, Purūravā, fall not, let not the hideous wolves devour you. feminine le friendships donot exist, their hearts are the hearts of jackals.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्विरूपाचरं मर्त्येष्ववसं रात्रीः शरदश्चतस्रः । घृतस्य स्तोकं सकृदह्न आश्नां तादेवेदं तातृपाणा चरामि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadvirūpācaraṃ martyeṣvavasaṃ rātrīḥ śaradaścatasraḥ | ghṛtasya stokaṃ sakṛdahna āśnāṃ tādevedaṃ tātṛpāṇā carāmi ||

translations.english: When changed in form I wandered among mortals. I dwelt (with them) four delightful years. I ate oncea day a small quantity of butter; satisfied with that I now depart.

mantras.sanskrit: अन्तरिक्षप्रां रजसो विमानीमुप शिक्षाम्युर्वशीं वसिष्ठः । उप त्वा रातिः सुकृतस्य तिष्ठान्नि वर्तस्व हृदयं तप्यते मे ॥
mantras.transliteration: antarikṣaprāṃ rajaso vimānīmupa śikṣāmyurvaśīṃ vasiṣṭhaḥ | upa tvā rātiḥ sukṛtasya tiṣṭhānni vartasva hṛdayaṃ tapyate me ||

translations.english: (Purūravā). I, Vasiṣṭha, bring under subjection Ūrvaśī who fills the firmament (with lustre) andmeasures out the rain. May (Purūravā), the bestower of the auspicious rite, abide near you; come back-- myheart is burning.

mantras.sanskrit: इति त्वा देवा इम आहुरैळ यथेमेतद्भवसि मृत्युबन्धुः । प्रजा ते देवान्हविषा यजाति स्वर्ग उ त्वमपि मादयासे ॥
mantras.transliteration: iti tvā devā ima āhuraiḷa yathemetadbhavasi mṛtyubandhuḥ | prajā te devānhaviṣā yajāti svarga u tvamapi mādayāse ||

translations.english: (Ūrvaśī). These gods said to you, Aiḷa, since you are indeed subject to death, let your progenypropitiate your gods with oblations, you shall rejoice (with me) in heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ते महे विदथे शंसिषं हरी प्र ते वन्वे वनुषो हर्यतं मदम् । घृतं न यो हरिभिश्चारु सेचत आ त्वा विशन्तु हरिवर्पसं गिरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra te mahe vidathe śaṃsiṣaṃ harī pra te vanve vanuṣo haryataṃ madam | ghṛtaṃ na yo haribhiścāru secata ā tvā viśantu harivarpasaṃ giraḥ ||

translations.english: I glorified your bay horses, Indra, at the great sacrifice. I solicit the agreeable exhilaration of you, thedestroyer. May my praises attain to you, whose form is yellow, who, with your horses, shower (water) likebeautiful butter.

mantras.sanskrit: हरिं हि योनिमभि ये समस्वरन्हिन्वन्तो हरी दिव्यं यथा सदः । आ यं पृणन्ति हरिभिर्न धेनव इन्द्राय शूषं हरिवन्तमर्चत ॥
mantras.transliteration: hariṃ hi yonimabhi ye samasvaranhinvanto harī divyaṃ yathā sadaḥ | ā yaṃ pṛṇanti haribhirna dhenava indrāya śūṣaṃ harivantamarcata ||

translations.english: You, who have praised the horse, the seat of Indra, urging the horses so that (Indra may reach) thedivine assembly, do you worship the horse- possessing might of Indra, whom men delight with the golden-tintedSoma as kine (with their milk).

mantras.sanskrit: सो अस्य वज्रो हरितो य आयसो हरिर्निकामो हरिरा गभस्त्योः । द्युम्नी सुशिप्रो हरिमन्युसायक इन्द्रे नि रूपा हरिता मिमिक्षिरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: so asya vajro harito ya āyaso harirnikāmo harirā gabhastyoḥ | dyumnī suśipro harimanyusāyaka indre ni rūpā haritā mimikṣire ||

translations.english: That is his thunderbolt, yellow, made of iron, the destroyer (of foes), desirable, the destroyer (of foes),it is in his hands; he is) possessed of riches, handsome jawed, possessed of a shaft and anger which deestroys(his foes)-- many golden-tinted forms are mixed in Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवि न केतुरधि धायि हर्यतो विव्यचद्वज्रो हरितो न रंह्या । तुददहिं हरिशिप्रो य आयसः सहस्रशोका अभवद्धरिम्भरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: divi na keturadhi dhāyi haryato vivyacadvajro harito na raṃhyā | tudadahiṃ hariśipro ya āyasaḥ sahasraśokā abhavaddharimbharaḥ ||

translations.english: He has been plural ced (by his worshippers) in the sky, like the banner (of light, the sun). His desirablebolt reaches (the foe) as the bay horses (of the sun reach their aim) through speed. The iron (thunderbolt), withyellow jaws, which smote Ahi, (he, Indra), lord of horses, shone with a thousand lustres.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वंत्वमहर्यथा उपस्तुतः पूर्वेभिरिन्द्र हरिकेश यज्वभिः । त्वं हर्यसि तव विश्वमुक्थ्यमसामि राधो हरिजात हर्यतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃtvamaharyathā upastutaḥ pūrvebhirindra harikeśa yajvabhiḥ | tvaṃ haryasi tava viśvamukthyamasāmi rādho harijāta haryatam ||

translations.english: Indra, with yellow locks, when praised by ancient worshippers, you did desire the oblation; you whoare manifested of a golden hue desire your universal praise, your peculiar and delightful (sacrificial) food.

mantras.sanskrit: ता वज्रिणं मन्दिनं स्तोम्यं मद इन्द्रं रथे वहतो हर्यता हरी । पुरूण्यस्मै सवनानि हर्यत इन्द्राय सोमा हरयो दधन्विरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā vajriṇaṃ mandinaṃ stomyaṃ mada indraṃ rathe vahato haryatā harī | purūṇyasmai savanāni haryata indrāya somā harayo dadhanvire ||

translations.english: These two delightful bay horses bring the thunderer, the rejoicing and laudable Indra, in his car to theexhilaration (of the Soma); for him the beloved one many libations of the yellow-tinted Soma are stored up.

mantras.sanskrit: अरं कामाय हरयो दधन्विरे स्थिराय हिन्वन्हरयो हरी तुरा । अर्वद्भिर्यो हरिभिर्जोषमीयते सो अस्य कामं हरिवन्तमानशे ॥
mantras.transliteration: araṃ kāmāya harayo dadhanvire sthirāya hinvanharayo harī turā | arvadbhiryo haribhirjoṣamīyate so asya kāmaṃ harivantamānaśe ||

translations.english: Yellow-tinted (Soma) is stored up sufficient to whet his desires, the yellow-tinted Soma urges his twoswift bay horses for the salwart (Indra). His (chariot) which rushes with spirited bay horses to the conflict, hasreached his desire (the sacrifice) in which the Soma is presented.

mantras.sanskrit: हरिश्मशारुर्हरिकेश आयसस्तुरस्पेये यो हरिपा अवर्धत । अर्वद्भिर्यो हरिभिर्वाजिनीवसुरति विश्वा दुरिता पारिषद्धरी ॥
mantras.transliteration: hariśmaśārurharikeśa āyasasturaspeye yo haripā avardhata | arvadbhiryo haribhirvājinīvasurati viśvā duritā pāriṣaddharī ||

translations.english: The yellow-bearded, yellow-haired, iron-hearted Indra, the drinker of the yellow (Soma), who has beeninvigorated by the Soma which has to be quickly quaffed, who is rich in sacrificial food through his swift bayhorses, may he drive his two bay horses safe through all difficulties.

mantras.sanskrit: स्रुवेव यस्य हरिणी विपेततुः शिप्रे वाजाय हरिणी दविध्वतः । प्र यत्कृते चमसे मर्मृजद्धरी पीत्वा मदस्य हर्यतस्यान्धसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sruveva yasya hariṇī vipetatuḥ śipre vājāya hariṇī davidhvataḥ | pra yatkṛte camase marmṛjaddharī pītvā madasya haryatasyāndhasaḥ ||

translations.english: He whose bay horses alight (upon the Soma) like two ladies, whose yellow jaws tremble (witheagerness) for the sacrificial food, (is praised) when having drunk of the delicious exhilarating Soma in theprepared cup, he rubs down his bay horses.

mantras.sanskrit: उत स्म सद्म हर्यतस्य पस्त्योरत्यो न वाजं हरिवाँ अचिक्रदत् । मही चिद्धि धिषणाहर्यदोजसा बृहद्वयो दधिषे हर्यतश्चिदा ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta sma sadma haryatasya pastyoratyo na vājaṃ harivā~ acikradat | mahī ciddhi dhiṣaṇāharyadojasā bṛhadvayo dadhiṣe haryataścidā ||

translations.english: The dwelling of the gracious (Indra) is in heaven and earth; exhilarated by the Soma he rushesimpetuously as a charger to battle. The earnest prayer desires (Indra endowed) with might; you bestow amplefood on the devout (worshipper).

mantras.sanskrit: आ रोदसी हर्यमाणो महित्वा नव्यंनव्यं हर्यसि मन्म नु प्रियम् । प्र पस्त्यमसुर हर्यतं गोराविष्कृधि हरये सूर्याय ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā rodasī haryamāṇo mahitvā navyaṃnavyaṃ haryasi manma nu priyam | pra pastyamasura haryataṃ gorāviṣkṛdhi haraye sūryāya ||

translations.english: You (Indra) who are the object of desire (fill) heaven and earth with your greatness, you desire gratefulpraise ever new and new; O powerful one, make manifest the desirable dwelling of the water to the

mantras.sanskrit: आ त्वा हर्यन्तं प्रयुजो जनानां रथे वहन्तु हरिशिप्रमिन्द्र । पिबा यथा प्रतिभृतस्य मध्वो हर्यन्यज्ञं सधमादे दशोणिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tvā haryantaṃ prayujo janānāṃ rathe vahantu hariśipramindra | pibā yathā pratibhṛtasya madhvo haryanyajñaṃ sadhamāde daśoṇim ||

translations.english: Let your horses yoked to the chariot bring you, Indra, the yellow- jawed, desiring (the sacrifice), to (thevicinity) of the worshippers; when you, desiring the sacrifice, prepared by the ten fingers, drink of the collectedsweet-flavoured Soma, (let them bring you) to the battle.

mantras.sanskrit: अपाः पूर्वेषां हरिवः सुतानामथो इदं सवनं केवलं ते । ममद्धि सोमं मधुमन्तमिन्द्र सत्रा वृषञ्जठर आ वृषस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: apāḥ pūrveṣāṃ harivaḥ sutānāmatho idaṃ savanaṃ kevalaṃ te | mamaddhi somaṃ madhumantamindra satrā vṛṣañjaṭhara ā vṛṣasva ||

translations.english: Lord of horses, you did drink of previous libations, this sacrifice is for you alone; exhilarate yourself.Indra with the sweet Soma; showerer of copious rain, shower it into your belly.

mantras.sanskrit: या ओषधीः पूर्वा जाता देवेभ्यस्त्रियुगं पुरा । मनै नु बभ्रूणामहं शतं धामानि सप्त च ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā oṣadhīḥ pūrvā jātā devebhyastriyugaṃ purā | manai nu babhrūṇāmahaṃ śataṃ dhāmāni sapta ca ||

translations.english: I think of the hundred and seven applications of the brown-tinted plural nts, which are ancient, beinggenerated for the gods before the three ages.

mantras.sanskrit: शतं वो अम्ब धामानि सहस्रमुत वो रुहः । अधा शतक्रत्वो यूयमिमं मे अगदं कृत ॥
mantras.transliteration: śataṃ vo amba dhāmāni sahasramuta vo ruhaḥ | adhā śatakratvo yūyamimaṃ me agadaṃ kṛta ||

translations.english: Mothers (of mankind) a hundred are your applications, a thousandfold is your growth; do you who fulfila hundred functions, make this my (people) free from disease.

mantras.sanskrit: ओषधीः प्रति मोदध्वं पुष्पवतीः प्रसूवरीः । अश्वा इव सजित्वरीर्वीरुधः पारयिष्ण्वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: oṣadhīḥ prati modadhvaṃ puṣpavatīḥ prasūvarīḥ | aśvā iva sajitvarīrvīrudhaḥ pārayiṣṇvaḥ ||

translations.english: Rejoice, plural nts, bearing abundant flowers and fruit, triumphing together (over disease) like (victorious)horses, sprouting forth, bearing (men safe) beyond (disease).

mantras.sanskrit: ओषधीरिति मातरस्तद्वो देवीरुप ब्रुवे । सनेयमश्वं गां वास आत्मानं तव पूरुष ॥
mantras.transliteration: oṣadhīriti mātarastadvo devīrupa bruve | saneyamaśvaṃ gāṃ vāsa ātmānaṃ tava pūruṣa ||

translations.english: "plural nts!" thus I hail you, the divine mothers (of mankind). I will give to you, oḥ physician, a horse, acow, a garment-- yes, even myself.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्वत्थे वो निषदनं पर्णे वो वसतिष्कृता । गोभाज इत्किलासथ यत्सनवथ पूरुषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvatthe vo niṣadanaṃ parṇe vo vasatiṣkṛtā | gobhāja itkilāsatha yatsanavatha pūruṣam ||
