translations.english: Your abode is in the Aśvattha, your dwelling is established in the Palāśa, you are assuredly thedistributer of cattle, inasmuch as you bestow them on the physician.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्रौषधीः समग्मत राजानः समिताविव । विप्रः स उच्यते भिषग्रक्षोहामीवचातनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatrauṣadhīḥ samagmata rājānaḥ samitāviva | vipraḥ sa ucyate bhiṣagrakṣohāmīvacātanaḥ ||

translations.english: Where, plural nts, you are congregated like princes (assembled) in battle, there the sage is designated aphysician, the destroyer of evil spirits, the extirpator of disease.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्वावतीं सोमावतीमूर्जयन्तीमुदोजसम् । आवित्सि सर्वा ओषधीरस्मा अरिष्टतातये ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvāvatīṃ somāvatīmūrjayantīmudojasam | āvitsi sarvā oṣadhīrasmā ariṣṭatātaye ||

translations.english: The Aśvāvatī, the Somāvatī, the Urjayantī, the Udojasā)-- all these plural nts I praise for thepurpose of overcoming this disease.

mantras.sanskrit: उच्छुष्मा ओषधीनां गावो गोष्ठादिवेरते । धनं सनिष्यन्तीनामात्मानं तव पूरुष ॥
mantras.transliteration: ucchuṣmā oṣadhīnāṃ gāvo goṣṭhādiverate | dhanaṃ saniṣyantīnāmātmānaṃ tava pūruṣa ||

translations.english: The virtues of the plural nts which are desirous of bestowing wealth issue from them, man, (towards) yourbody like cattle from the pen.

mantras.sanskrit: इष्कृतिर्नाम वो माताथो यूयं स्थ निष्कृतीः । सीराः पतत्रिणीः स्थन यदामयति निष्कृथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: iṣkṛtirnāma vo mātātho yūyaṃ stha niṣkṛtīḥ | sīrāḥ patatriṇīḥ sthana yadāmayati niṣkṛtha ||

translations.english: Verily Iṣkṛti is your mother, therefore are you (also) Niṣkṛtis; you are flying streams; if (a man) is illyou cure him.

mantras.sanskrit: अति विश्वाः परिष्ठा स्तेन इव व्रजमक्रमुः । ओषधीः प्राचुच्यवुर्यत्किं च तन्वो रपः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ati viśvāḥ pariṣṭhā stena iva vrajamakramuḥ | oṣadhīḥ prācucyavuryatkiṃ ca tanvo rapaḥ ||

translations.english: The universal all-pervading plural nts assail (diseases) as a thief (attacks) a cow-shed; they drive outwhatever infirmity of body there may be.

mantras.sanskrit: यदिमा वाजयन्नहमोषधीर्हस्त आदधे । आत्मा यक्ष्मस्य नश्यति पुरा जीवगृभो यथा ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadimā vājayannahamoṣadhīrhasta ādadhe | ātmā yakṣmasya naśyati purā jīvagṛbho yathā ||

translations.english: As soon as I take these plural nts in my hand making (the sick man) strong, the soul of the maladyperishes before (their application) as (life is driven away from the presence) of the seizer of life.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्यौषधीः प्रसर्पथाङ्गमङ्गं परुष्परुः । ततो यक्ष्मं वि बाधध्व उग्रो मध्यमशीरिव ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasyauṣadhīḥ prasarpathāṅgamaṅgaṃ paruṣparuḥ | tato yakṣmaṃ vi bādhadhva ugro madhyamaśīriva ||

translations.english: From him, oḥ plural nts, in whom you creep from limb to limb, from joint to joint, you drive away diseaselike a mighty (prince) stationed in the midst of his host.

mantras.sanskrit: साकं यक्ष्म प्र पत चाषेण किकिदीविना । साकं वातस्य ध्राज्या साकं नश्य निहाकया ॥
mantras.transliteration: sākaṃ yakṣma pra pata cāṣeṇa kikidīvinā | sākaṃ vātasya dhrājyā sākaṃ naśya nihākayā ||

translations.english: Fly forth, sickness, with the jay, with the blue jay, with the velocity of the wind, perish along with theiguana.

mantras.sanskrit: अन्या वो अन्यामवत्वन्यान्यस्या उपावत । ताः सर्वाः संविदाना इदं मे प्रावता वचः ॥
mantras.transliteration: anyā vo anyāmavatvanyānyasyā upāvata | tāḥ sarvāḥ saṃvidānā idaṃ me prāvatā vacaḥ ||

translations.english: Let each of you, plural nts, go to the other, approach the one (to the vicinity) of the other; thus being allmutually joined together, attend to this my speech.

mantras.sanskrit: याः फलिनीर्या अफला अपुष्पा याश्च पुष्पिणीः । बृहस्पतिप्रसूतास्ता नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yāḥ phalinīryā aphalā apuṣpā yāśca puṣpiṇīḥ | bṛhaspatiprasūtāstā no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ ||

translations.english: Whether bearing fruit or barren, whether flowering or flowerless, may they, the progeny of Bṛhaspati,liberate us from sin.

mantras.sanskrit: मुञ्चन्तु मा शपथ्यादथो वरुण्यादुत । अथो यमस्य पड्बीशात्सर्वस्माद्देवकिल्बिषात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: muñcantu mā śapathyādatho varuṇyāduta | atho yamasya paḍbīśātsarvasmāddevakilbiṣāt ||

translations.english: May they liberate me from the sin produced by curse, from the sin caused by Varuṇa, from the fettersO Yama, from all guilt caused by the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: अवपतन्तीरवदन्दिव ओषधयस्परि । यं जीवमश्नवामहै न स रिष्याति पूरुषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: avapatantīravadandiva oṣadhayaspari | yaṃ jīvamaśnavāmahai na sa riṣyāti pūruṣaḥ ||

translations.english: The plural nts, falling from heaven, said, "The man, whom living we pervade, will not perish".

mantras.sanskrit: या ओषधीः सोमराज्ञीर्बह्वीः शतविचक्षणाः । तासां त्वमस्युत्तमारं कामाय शं हृदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā oṣadhīḥ somarājñīrbahvīḥ śatavicakṣaṇāḥ | tāsāṃ tvamasyuttamāraṃ kāmāya śaṃ hṛde ||

translations.english: The which have the Soma for their king, and are numerous and all- seeking of them you (O Soma) arethe best; be very bountiful to the affectionate heart.

mantras.sanskrit: या ओषधीः सोमराज्ञीर्विष्ठिताः पृथिवीमनु । बृहस्पतिप्रसूता अस्यै सं दत्त वीर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā oṣadhīḥ somarājñīrviṣṭhitāḥ pṛthivīmanu | bṛhaspatiprasūtā asyai saṃ datta vīryam ||

translations.english: plural nts, which have the Soma for your king, who are scattered over the earth, the offspring ofBṛhaspati, give vigour to this (infirm body).

mantras.sanskrit: मा वो रिषत्खनिता यस्मै चाहं खनामि वः । द्विपच्चतुष्पदस्माकं सर्वमस्त्वनातुरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā vo riṣatkhanitā yasmai cāhaṃ khanāmi vaḥ | dvipaccatuṣpadasmākaṃ sarvamastvanāturam ||

translations.english: Let not the digger hurt you, not (the sick person n) for whom I dig you up; may all my bipeds andquadrupeds be free from disease.

mantras.sanskrit: याश्चेदमुपशृण्वन्ति याश्च दूरं परागताः । सर्वाः संगत्य वीरुधोऽस्यै सं दत्त वीर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yāścedamupaśṛṇvanti yāśca dūraṃ parāgatāḥ | sarvāḥ saṃgatya vīrudho'syai saṃ datta vīryam ||

translations.english: Both the plural nts that I hear this (prayer), and those which are removed far off, all coming together,give vigour to this (infirm body).

mantras.sanskrit: ओषधयः सं वदन्ते सोमेन सह राज्ञा । यस्मै कृणोति ब्राह्मणस्तं राजन्पारयामसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: oṣadhayaḥ saṃ vadante somena saha rājñā | yasmai kṛṇoti brāhmaṇastaṃ rājanpārayāmasi ||

translations.english: All the plural nts, together with Soma their king, declare, "We save him, O king, to whom the Brāhmaṇaadministers (us)".

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमुत्तमास्योषधे तव वृक्षा उपस्तयः । उपस्तिरस्तु सोऽस्माकं यो अस्माँ अभिदासति ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamuttamāsyoṣadhe tava vṛkṣā upastayaḥ | upastirastu so'smākaṃ yo asmā~ abhidāsati ||

translations.english: You (Soma) are the best of the plural nts, to you (all) trees are prostrate; may he be prostrate to us, whoattacks us.

mantras.sanskrit: बृहस्पते प्रति मे देवतामिहि मित्रो वा यद्वरुणो वासि पूषा । आदित्यैर्वा यद्वसुभिर्मरुत्वान्त्स पर्जन्यं शंतनवे वृषाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhaspate prati me devatāmihi mitro vā yadvaruṇo vāsi pūṣā | ādityairvā yadvasubhirmarutvāntsa parjanyaṃ śaṃtanave vṛṣāya ||

translations.english: : Go, Bṛhaspati, on my behalf to the gods, whether you are Mitra, or Varuṇa, or Pūṣan, orassociated with the Ādityas, the Vasus, or the Maruts-- do you cause Parjanya to send down rain for Śantanu.

mantras.sanskrit: आ देवो दूतो अजिरश्चिकित्वान्त्वद्देवापे अभि मामगच्छत् । प्रतीचीनः प्रति मामा ववृत्स्व दधामि ते द्युमतीं वाचमासन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā devo dūto ajiraścikitvāntvaddevāpe abhi māmagacchat | pratīcīnaḥ prati māmā vavṛtsva dadhāmi te dyumatīṃ vācamāsan ||

translations.english: Let a divine messenger quick and intelligent sent, Devāpi, by you come to me. Come, Bṛhaspati, tome, turning towards me; I have in my mouth a brilliant eulogium for you.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मे धेहि द्युमतीं वाचमासन्बृहस्पते अनमीवामिषिराम् । यया वृष्टिं शंतनवे वनाव दिवो द्रप्सो मधुमाँ आ विवेश ॥
mantras.transliteration: asme dhehi dyumatīṃ vācamāsanbṛhaspate anamīvāmiṣirām | yayā vṛṣṭiṃ śaṃtanave vanāva divo drapso madhumā~ ā viveśa ||

translations.english: Put, Bṛhaspati, in my mouth a brilliant eulogium, prompt and free from defect, by which we two mayobtain rain from heaven for Śantanu, the sweet drop (sent by you) has entered (our voice).

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो द्रप्सा मधुमन्तो विशन्त्विन्द्र देह्यधिरथं सहस्रम् । नि षीद होत्रमृतुथा यजस्व देवान्देवापे हविषा सपर्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no drapsā madhumanto viśantvindra dehyadhirathaṃ sahasram | ni ṣīda hotramṛtuthā yajasva devāndevāpe haviṣā saparya ||

translations.english: May the sweet drops of rain fall upon us; grant us, Indra, a thousand chariot-loads. Sit down, Devāpi,to your duties as Hotā; in due season sacrifice to the gods, worship them with oblations. functions as Hotā. He has brought down from the upper to the lower ocean the rain waters of heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: आर्ष्टिषेणो होत्रमृषिर्निषीदन्देवापिर्देवसुमतिं चिकित्वान् । स उत्तरस्मादधरं समुद्रमपो दिव्या असृजद्वर्ष्या अभि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ārṣṭiṣeṇo hotramṛṣirniṣīdandevāpirdevasumatiṃ cikitvān | sa uttarasmādadharaṃ samudramapo divyā asṛjadvarṣyā abhi ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मिन्त्समुद्रे अध्युत्तरस्मिन्नापो देवेभिर्निवृता अतिष्ठन् । ता अद्रवन्नार्ष्टिषेणेन सृष्टा देवापिना प्रेषिता मृक्षिणीषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmintsamudre adhyuttarasminnāpo devebhirnivṛtā atiṣṭhan | tā adravannārṣṭiṣeṇena sṛṣṭā devāpinā preṣitā mṛkṣiṇīṣu ||

translations.english: In this upper ocean the waters stood dammed up by the gods; set free by Devāpi, the son ofṚṣṭiṣeṇa, they were sent forth over the plural ins.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्देवापिः शंतनवे पुरोहितो होत्राय वृतः कृपयन्नदीधेत् । देवश्रुतं वृष्टिवनिं रराणो बृहस्पतिर्वाचमस्मा अयच्छत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaddevāpiḥ śaṃtanave purohito hotrāya vṛtaḥ kṛpayannadīdhet | devaśrutaṃ vṛṣṭivaniṃ rarāṇo bṛhaspatirvācamasmā ayacchat ||

translations.english: When Devāpi, the Purohita for Śantanu, engaged in his functions of Hotā, compassionating (him),slicited Bṛhaspati, to whom the gods listen, who begs for rain, (Bṛhaspati) being plural ased gave him a voice.

mantras.sanskrit: यं त्वा देवापिः शुशुचानो अग्न आर्ष्टिषेणो मनुष्यः समीधे । विश्वेभिर्देवैरनुमद्यमानः प्र पर्जन्यमीरया वृष्टिमन्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ tvā devāpiḥ śuśucāno agna ārṣṭiṣeṇo manuṣyaḥ samīdhe | viśvebhirdevairanumadyamānaḥ pra parjanyamīrayā vṛṣṭimantam ||

translations.english: Agni, whom the mortal Devāpi, the son of Ṛṣṭiseṇa, lighting you, has kindled, do you, beingpropitiated with all the gods, send down the rain- laden cloud.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वां पूर्व ऋषयो गीर्भिरायन्त्वामध्वरेषु पुरुहूत विश्वे । सहस्राण्यधिरथान्यस्मे आ नो यज्ञं रोहिदश्वोप याहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāṃ pūrva ṛṣayo gīrbhirāyantvāmadhvareṣu puruhūta viśve | sahasrāṇyadhirathānyasme ā no yajñaṃ rohidaśvopa yāhi ||

translations.english: You have ancient sages approached, with hymns; you, O invoked of many, all worshippers (address)at sacrifice; (give) us thousands of chariot-loads, come to our sacrifice, lord of red horses.

mantras.sanskrit: एतान्यग्ने नवतिर्नव त्वे आहुतान्यधिरथा सहस्रा । तेभिर्वर्धस्व तन्वः शूर पूर्वीर्दिवो नो वृष्टिमिषितो रिरीहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: etānyagne navatirnava tve āhutānyadhirathā sahasrā | tebhirvardhasva tanvaḥ śūra pūrvīrdivo no vṛṣṭimiṣito rirīhi ||

translations.english: These ninety-and-nine thousands of chariot-lords have been offered, Agni, to you; with them, O hero,nourish your many bodies; and thus solicited sends us rain from heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: एतान्यग्ने नवतिं सहस्रा सं प्र यच्छ वृष्ण इन्द्राय भागम् । विद्वान्पथ ऋतुशो देवयानानप्यौलानं दिवि देवेषु धेहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: etānyagne navatiṃ sahasrā saṃ pra yaccha vṛṣṇa indrāya bhāgam | vidvānpatha ṛtuśo devayānānapyaulānaṃ divi deveṣu dhehi ||

translations.english: Give, Agni, these ninety thousands to the showerer, Indra, as his share; knowing the paths traversedby the gods in due season plural ce the Aulāna (Śantanu), in heaven among the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने बाधस्व वि मृधो वि दुर्गहापामीवामप रक्षांसि सेध । अस्मात्समुद्राद्बृहतो दिवो नोऽपां भूमानमुप नः सृजेह ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne bādhasva vi mṛdho vi durgahāpāmīvāmapa rakṣāṃsi sedha | asmātsamudrādbṛhato divo no'pāṃ bhūmānamupa naḥ sṛjeha ||

translations.english: Demolish, Agni, our enemies, demolish their strongholds, drive away disease, drive away therākṣasas from this ocean, from vast heaven send own upon us here abundance of rain.

mantras.sanskrit: कं नश्चित्रमिषण्यसि चिकित्वान्पृथुग्मानं वाश्रं वावृधध्यै । कत्तस्य दातु शवसो व्युष्टौ तक्षद्वज्रं वृत्रतुरमपिन्वत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kaṃ naścitramiṣaṇyasi cikitvānpṛthugmānaṃ vāśraṃ vāvṛdhadhyai | kattasya dātu śavaso vyuṣṭau takṣadvajraṃ vṛtraturamapinvat ||

translations.english: What marvellous (wealth), comprehensive and laudable, do you, Indra, knowing (what is needed),bestow upon us for our advantage? What gift (has been made to us) upon the development of his strength? Hefabricated the Vṛtra- slaying thunderbolt, and let the waters flow.

mantras.sanskrit: स हि द्युता विद्युता वेति साम पृथुं योनिमसुरत्वा ससाद । स सनीळेभिः प्रसहानो अस्य भ्रातुर्न ऋते सप्तथस्य मायाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa hi dyutā vidyutā veti sāma pṛthuṃ yonimasuratvā sasāda | sa sanīḷebhiḥ prasahāno asya bhrāturna ṛte saptathasya māyāḥ ||

translations.english: Armed with the bright lightning he goes to the (scene of) adoration; endowed with might he has seatedhimself on the spacious plural ce (of sacrifice); he (is) triumphant with his companions (the Maruts); the wiles of hisseventh brother do not (prevail) at the rite.

mantras.sanskrit: स वाजं यातापदुष्पदा यन्त्स्वर्षाता परि षदत्सनिष्यन् । अनर्वा यच्छतदुरस्य वेदो घ्नञ्छिश्नदेवाँ अभि वर्पसा भूत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa vājaṃ yātāpaduṣpadā yantsvarṣātā pari ṣadatsaniṣyan | anarvā yacchatadurasya vedo ghnañchiśnadevā~ abhi varpasā bhūt ||

translations.english: Going to the battle, marching with easy gait, desiring the spoil, he set himself to the acquisition of all(wealth). Invincible, destroying the phallus-worshippers, he won by his prowess whatever wealth (was concealedin the city) with the hundred gates.

mantras.sanskrit: स यह्व्योऽवनीर्गोष्वर्वा जुहोति प्रधन्यासु सस्रिः । अपादो यत्र युज्यासोऽरथा द्रोण्यश्वास ईरते घृतं वाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa yahvyo'vanīrgoṣvarvā juhoti pradhanyāsu sasriḥ | apādo yatra yujyāso'rathā droṇyaśvāsa īrate ghṛtaṃ vāḥ ||

translations.english: The victorious Indra, coming among the clouds, quickly moving, offers the abundant waters on the rich(plural ins) where his associates (the rivers) footless, and without conveyances, having pitchers for horses, pour outwater like ghī.

mantras.sanskrit: स रुद्रेभिरशस्तवार ऋभ्वा हित्वी गयमारेअवद्य आगात् । वम्रस्य मन्ये मिथुना विवव्री अन्नमभीत्यारोदयन्मुषायन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa rudrebhiraśastavāra ṛbhvā hitvī gayamāreavadya āgāt | vamrasya manye mithunā vivavrī annamabhītyārodayanmuṣāyan ||

translations.english: May he, our unsolicited benefactor, the mighty one, from whom blame is far removed, come with theRudras, having quit his dwelling. I think of the two (parents) of Vamra, who are free from fever. Having obtained(the enemy's) food, he called aloud while stealing it.

mantras.sanskrit: स इद्दासं तुवीरवं पतिर्दन्षळक्षं त्रिशीर्षाणं दमन्यत् । अस्य त्रितो न्वोजसा वृधानो विपा वराहमयोअग्रया हन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa iddāsaṃ tuvīravaṃ patirdanṣaḷakṣaṃ triśīrṣāṇaṃ damanyat | asya trito nvojasā vṛdhāno vipā varāhamayoagrayā han ||

translations.english: The sovereign Indra attacking him overcame the loud-shouting, six- eyed, three-headed Dāsa, andTrita, invigorated by his strength, smote the water-laden (cloud) with his iron-tipped finger.

mantras.sanskrit: स द्रुह्वणे मनुष ऊर्ध्वसान आ साविषदर्शसानाय शरुम् । स नृतमो नहुषोऽस्मत्सुजातः पुरोऽभिनदर्हन्दस्युहत्ये ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa druhvaṇe manuṣa ūrdhvasāna ā sāviṣadarśasānāya śarum | sa nṛtamo nahuṣo'smatsujātaḥ puro'bhinadarhandasyuhatye ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: सो अभ्रियो न यवस उदन्यन्क्षयाय गातुं विदन्नो अस्मे । उप यत्सीददिन्दुं शरीरैः श्येनोऽयोपाष्टिर्हन्ति दस्यून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: so abhriyo na yavasa udanyankṣayāya gātuṃ vidanno asme | upa yatsīdadinduṃ śarīraiḥ śyeno'yopāṣṭirhanti dasyūn ||

translations.english: Like the aggregated cloud desiring to pour water on the pasturage, he found the way to our dwellingwhen he approached the Soma with his limbs, like a hawk with heel of metal he smites the Dasyus.

mantras.sanskrit: स व्राधतः शवसानेभिरस्य कुत्साय शुष्णं कृपणे परादात् । अयं कविमनयच्छस्यमानमत्कं यो अस्य सनितोत नृणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa vrādhataḥ śavasānebhirasya kutsāya śuṣṇaṃ kṛpaṇe parādāt | ayaṃ kavimanayacchasyamānamatkaṃ yo asya sanitota nṛṇām ||

translations.english: Let him overthrow the mighty with powerful (weapons); he destroyed Śuṣṇa for the sake of the liberalKutsa; he humiliated Kavi, who praised him, who was the giver of form to Indra and his men.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं दशस्यन्नर्येभिरस्य दस्मो देवेभिर्वरुणो न मायी । अयं कनीन ऋतुपा अवेद्यमिमीताररुं यश्चतुष्पात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ daśasyannaryebhirasya dasmo devebhirvaruṇo na māyī | ayaṃ kanīna ṛtupā avedyamimītāraruṃ yaścatuṣpāt ||

translations.english: Bountiful (to his worshippers) with his (Maruts) friendly to men, wonderful with brilliancies, havingmagical power like Varuṇa, he was known as desirable, protecting the seasons, he destroyed, Araru, who wasfour-footed.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य स्तोमेभिरौशिज ऋजिश्वा व्रजं दरयद्वृषभेण पिप्रोः । सुत्वा यद्यजतो दीदयद्गीः पुर इयानो अभि वर्पसा भूत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya stomebhirauśija ṛjiśvā vrajaṃ darayadvṛṣabheṇa piproḥ | sutvā yadyajato dīdayadgīḥ pura iyāno abhi varpasā bhūt ||

translations.english: Ṛjiśvā, the son of Uśija with Indra's praises shattered the cow pen of Pipru with the thunderbolt;when having expressed (the Soma), the venerable sage recited his praises, (Indra) proceeding against the cities(of the enemy) triumphed with his body.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा महो असुर वक्षथाय वम्रकः पड्भिरुप सर्पदिन्द्रम् । स इयानः करति स्वस्तिमस्मा इषमूर्जं सुक्षितिं विश्वमाभाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā maho asura vakṣathāya vamrakaḥ paḍbhirupa sarpadindram | sa iyānaḥ karati svastimasmā iṣamūrjaṃ sukṣitiṃ viśvamābhāḥ ||

translations.english: In this manner, O mighty (Indra), Vamraka approached Indra on foot, to bring an ample oblation. Mayhe, being approached, grant us prosperity, may he bring us food, drink, a secure dwelling and all (good things).

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र दृह्य मघवन्त्वावदिद्भुज इह स्तुतः सुतपा बोधि नो वृधे । देवेभिर्नः सविता प्रावतु श्रुतमा सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra dṛhya maghavantvāvadidbhuja iha stutaḥ sutapā bodhi no vṛdhe | devebhirnaḥ savitā prāvatu śrutamā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: Consume, afluent Indra, (the foe that is) like you (in might); praised on this occasion, do you who arethe drinker of the libation be favourable to our advancement. May Savitā, with the gods, defend our sacrifice;we long for the universal Aditi.

mantras.sanskrit: भराय सु भरत भागमृत्वियं प्र वायवे शुचिपे क्रन्ददिष्टये । गौरस्य यः पयसः पीतिमानश आ सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: bharāya su bharata bhāgamṛtviyaṃ pra vāyave śucipe krandadiṣṭaye | gaurasya yaḥ payasaḥ pītimānaśa ā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: Offer to (Indra) the cherisher (of all) the share suited to the season; (offer it) to Vāyu, the drinker ofthe pure (Soma), who clamours as he travels, who obtains a draught of white milk; we long for the universal Aditi.

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो देवः सविता साविषद्वय ऋजूयते यजमानाय सुन्वते । यथा देवान्प्रतिभूषेम पाकवदा सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no devaḥ savitā sāviṣadvaya ṛjūyate yajamānāya sunvate | yathā devānpratibhūṣema pākavadā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: May the divine Savitā genitive rate well-dressed food for our sincere yajamāna as he offers the libation,so that we may be in good favour with the gods; we long for the universal Aditi.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रो अस्मे सुमना अस्तु विश्वहा राजा सोमः सुवितस्याध्येतु नः । यथायथा मित्रधितानि संदधुरा सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: indro asme sumanā astu viśvahā rājā somaḥ suvitasyādhyetu naḥ | yathāyathā mitradhitāni saṃdadhurā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: May Indra be favourably disposed towards us every day, may the royal Soma accept our praise, sothat they may bestow upon us friendly treasures; we long for the universal Aditi.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र उक्थेन शवसा परुर्दधे बृहस्पते प्रतरीतास्यायुषः । यज्ञो मनुः प्रमतिर्नः पिता हि कमा सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra ukthena śavasā parurdadhe bṛhaspate pratarītāsyāyuṣaḥ | yajño manuḥ pramatirnaḥ pitā hi kamā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: By his laudable strength Indra supports my limb; you, Bṛhaspati, are the prolonger of my life. May thesacrifice, the sage Manu, (being) our protector, (grant) us happiness. We long for the universal Aditi.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य नु सुकृतं दैव्यं सहोऽग्निर्गृहे जरिता मेधिरः कविः । यज्ञश्च भूद्विदथे चारुरन्तम आ सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrasya nu sukṛtaṃ daivyaṃ saho'gnirgṛhe jaritā medhiraḥ kaviḥ | yajñaśca bhūdvidathe cārurantama ā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: The divine force of Indra is well constructed; Agni (abides) in our dwelling, the praiser of the gods, thereceiver of oblations, the sage, and is worthy of sacrifice at the altar, beautiful and most near (to us). We long forthe universal Aditi.

mantras.sanskrit: न वो गुहा चकृम भूरि दुष्कृतं नाविष्ट्यं वसवो देवहेळनम् । माकिर्नो देवा अनृतस्य वर्पस आ सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: na vo guhā cakṛma bhūri duṣkṛtaṃ nāviṣṭyaṃ vasavo devaheḷanam | mākirno devā anṛtasya varpasa ā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: We have not done any great evil in secret from you, nor any open (action) causing the anger of thegods, O you givers of wealth; let not, O gods, (the possession) of an unreal form be our (lot). We long for theuniversal Aditi.

mantras.sanskrit: अपामीवां सविता साविषन्न्यग्वरीय इदप सेधन्त्वद्रयः । ग्रावा यत्र मधुषुदुच्यते बृहदा सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: apāmīvāṃ savitā sāviṣannyagvarīya idapa sedhantvadrayaḥ | grāvā yatra madhuṣuducyate bṛhadā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: May Savitā drive away (our) disease, may the mountains keep off our most heinous (sin), where thestone( the effuser) of the sweet Soma is abundantly praised. We long for the universal Aditi.

mantras.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वो ग्रावा वसवोऽस्तु सोतरि विश्वा द्वेषांसि सनुतर्युयोत । स नो देवः सविता पायुरीड्य आ सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūrdhvo grāvā vasavo'stu sotari viśvā dveṣāṃsi sanutaryuyota | sa no devaḥ savitā pāyurīḍya ā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: May the stone be uplifted, gods, when I make the libation; disperse all my secret adversaries; the godSavitā is our adorable protector. We long for the universal Aditi.

mantras.sanskrit: ऊर्जं गावो यवसे पीवो अत्तन ऋतस्य याः सदने कोशे अङ्ग्ध्वे । तनूरेव तन्वो अस्तु भेषजमा सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūrjaṃ gāvo yavase pīvo attana ṛtasya yāḥ sadane kośe aṅgdhve | tanūreva tanvo astu bheṣajamā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: Eat abundant fodder in the pasture, O cows, who are anointed in the hall of sacrifice in the cow-stall;may (your) body be the remedy for (our) body. We long for the universal Aditi.

mantras.sanskrit: क्रतुप्रावा जरिता शश्वतामव इन्द्र इद्भद्रा प्रमतिः सुतावताम् । पूर्णमूधर्दिव्यं यस्य सिक्तय आ सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: kratuprāvā jaritā śaśvatāmava indra idbhadrā pramatiḥ sutāvatām | pūrṇamūdhardivyaṃ yasya siktaya ā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe ||

translations.english: Indra is the fulfiller of pious acts, the glorifier of all, the guardian of the offerers of libations, theauspicious forethought, for his libation the divine pitcher is filled (with Soma). We long for the universal Aditi.

mantras.sanskrit: चित्रस्ते भानुः क्रतुप्रा अभिष्टिः सन्ति स्पृधो जरणिप्रा अधृष्टाः । रजिष्ठया रज्या पश्व आ गोस्तूतूर्षति पर्यग्रं दुवस्युः ॥
mantras.transliteration: citraste bhānuḥ kratuprā abhiṣṭiḥ santi spṛdho jaraṇiprā adhṛṣṭāḥ | rajiṣṭhayā rajyā paśva ā gostūtūrṣati paryagraṃ duvasyuḥ ||

translations.english: Your splendour, Indra, is wonderful, fulfilling our pious acts, desirable; your efforts replenishing thewealth of your worshippers are irresistible; (therefore) Duvasyu hastens in front of the victim cow, (leading it) witha straight cord.

mantras.sanskrit: उद्बुध्यध्वं समनसः सखायः समग्निमिन्ध्वं बहवः सनीळाः । दधिक्रामग्निमुषसं च देवीमिन्द्रावतोऽवसे नि ह्वये वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: udbudhyadhvaṃ samanasaḥ sakhāyaḥ samagnimindhvaṃ bahavaḥ sanīḷāḥ | dadhikrāmagnimuṣasaṃ ca devīmindrāvato'vase ni hvaye vaḥ ||

translations.english: Awake, friends, being all agreed; many in number, abiding in one dwelling, kindle Agni. I invoke you,Dadhikra, Agni, and the divine Uṣas, who are associated with Indra, for our protection.

mantras.sanskrit: मन्द्रा कृणुध्वं धिय आ तनुध्वं नावमरित्रपरणीं कृणुध्वम् । इष्कृणुध्वमायुधारं कृणुध्वं प्राञ्चं यज्ञं प्र णयता सखायः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mandrā kṛṇudhvaṃ dhiya ā tanudhvaṃ nāvamaritraparaṇīṃ kṛṇudhvam | iṣkṛṇudhvamāyudhāraṃ kṛṇudhvaṃ prāñcaṃ yajñaṃ pra ṇayatā sakhāyaḥ ||

translations.english: Construct exhilarating (hymns), spread forth praises, construct the ship which is propelled by oars,prepare your weapons, make ready, lead forth, O friends, the herald, the adorable (Agni).

mantras.sanskrit: युनक्त सीरा वि युगा तनुध्वं कृते योनौ वपतेह बीजम् । गिरा च श्रुष्टिः सभरा असन्नो नेदीय इत्सृण्यः पक्वमेयात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yunakta sīrā vi yugā tanudhvaṃ kṛte yonau vapateha bījam | girā ca śruṣṭiḥ sabharā asanno nedīya itsṛṇyaḥ pakvameyāt ||

translations.english: Harness the plural ughs, fit on the yokes, now that the womb of earth is ready, sow the seed therein, andthrough our praise may there be abundant food; may (the grain) fall ripe towards the sickle.

mantras.sanskrit: सीरा युञ्जन्ति कवयो युगा वि तन्वते पृथक् । धीरा देवेषु सुम्नया ॥
mantras.transliteration: sīrā yuñjanti kavayo yugā vi tanvate pṛthak | dhīrā deveṣu sumnayā ||

translations.english: The wise (priests) harness the plural ughs, they lay the yokes apart, firmly devoted through the desire ofhappiness.

mantras.sanskrit: निराहावान्कृणोतन सं वरत्रा दधातन । सिञ्चामहा अवतमुद्रिणं वयं सुषेकमनुपक्षितम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nirāhāvānkṛṇotana saṃ varatrā dadhātana | siñcāmahā avatamudriṇaṃ vayaṃ suṣekamanupakṣitam ||

translations.english: Set up the cattle-troughs, bind the straps to it; let us pour out (the water of) the well, which is full ofwater, fit to be poured out, and not easily exhausted.

mantras.sanskrit: इष्कृताहावमवतं सुवरत्रं सुषेचनम् । उद्रिणं सिञ्चे अक्षितम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: iṣkṛtāhāvamavataṃ suvaratraṃ suṣecanam | udriṇaṃ siñce akṣitam ||

translations.english: I pour out (the water of) the well, whose cattle troughs are prepared, well fitted with straps, fit to bepoured out, full of water, inexhaustible.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रीणीताश्वान्हितं जयाथ स्वस्तिवाहं रथमित्कृणुध्वम् । द्रोणाहावमवतमश्मचक्रमंसत्रकोशं सिञ्चता नृपाणम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: prīṇītāśvānhitaṃ jayātha svastivāhaṃ rathamitkṛṇudhvam | droṇāhāvamavatamaśmacakramaṃsatrakośaṃ siñcatā nṛpāṇam ||

translations.english: Satisfy the horses, accomplish the good work (of plural ughing), equip a car laden with good fortune, pourout (the water of) the well, having wooden cattle-troughs having a stone rim, having a receptable like armour, fitfor the drinking of men.

mantras.sanskrit: व्रजं कृणुध्वं स हि वो नृपाणो वर्म सीव्यध्वं बहुला पृथूनि । पुरः कृणुध्वमायसीरधृष्टा मा वः सुस्रोच्चमसो दृंहता तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vrajaṃ kṛṇudhvaṃ sa hi vo nṛpāṇo varma sīvyadhvaṃ bahulā pṛthūni | puraḥ kṛṇudhvamāyasīradhṛṣṭā mā vaḥ susroccamaso dṛṃhatā tam ||

translations.english: Construct the cow-stall, for that is the drinking plural ce of your leaders (the gods), fabricate armour,manifold and ample; make cities of metal and impregnable; let not the ladle leak, make it strong.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वो धियं यज्ञियां वर्त ऊतये देवा देवीं यजतां यज्ञियामिह । सा नो दुहीयद्यवसेव गत्वी सहस्रधारा पयसा मही गौः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vo dhiyaṃ yajñiyāṃ varta ūtaye devā devīṃ yajatāṃ yajñiyāmiha | sā no duhīyadyavaseva gatvī sahasradhārā payasā mahī gauḥ ||

translations.english: I attract, O gods, for my protection, your adorable, divine mine, which is deserving of sacrifice andworship here; may it milk forth for us, like a large cow with milk, giving a thousand strreams, (having eaten)fodder and returned.

mantras.sanskrit: आ तू षिञ्च हरिमीं द्रोरुपस्थे वाशीभिस्तक्षताश्मन्मयीभिः । परि ष्वजध्वं दश कक्ष्याभिरुभे धुरौ प्रति वह्निं युनक्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tū ṣiñca harimīṃ drorupasthe vāśībhistakṣatāśmanmayībhiḥ | pari ṣvajadhvaṃ daśa kakṣyābhirubhe dhurau prati vahniṃ yunakta ||

translations.english: Pour out the golden-tinted Soma into the bowl of the wooden cup, fabricate it with the stone axes, girdit with ten bands, harness the beast of burden to the two poles (of the cart).

mantras.sanskrit: उभे धुरौ वह्निरापिब्दमानोऽन्तर्योनेव चरति द्विजानिः । वनस्पतिं वन आस्थापयध्वं नि षू दधिध्वमखनन्त उत्सम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ubhe dhurau vahnirāpibdamāno'ntaryoneva carati dvijāniḥ | vanaspatiṃ vana āsthāpayadhvaṃ ni ṣū dadhidhvamakhananta utsam ||

translations.english: The beast of burden pressed with the two cart-poles, moves as if on the womb of sacrifice having twowives. plural ce the chariot in the wood, without digging store up the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: कपृन्नरः कपृथमुद्दधातन चोदयत खुदत वाजसातये । निष्टिग्र्यः पुत्रमा च्यावयोतय इन्द्रं सबाध इह सोमपीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: kapṛnnaraḥ kapṛthamuddadhātana codayata khudata vājasātaye | niṣṭigryaḥ putramā cyāvayotaya indraṃ sabādha iha somapītaye ||

translations.english: Indra, you leaders, is the giver of happiness; excite the giver of happiness, stimulate him, sport withhim for the acquisition of food, bring down here, O priests, Indra, the son of Niṣṭigrī, to drink the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ते रथं मिथूकृतमिन्द्रोऽवतु धृष्णुया । अस्मिन्नाजौ पुरुहूत श्रवाय्ये धनभक्षेषु नोऽव ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra te rathaṃ mithūkṛtamindro'vatu dhṛṣṇuyā | asminnājau puruhūta śravāyye dhanabhakṣeṣu no'va ||

translations.english: May (Indra) by his prowess protect your cart (mudgala) that has no companion, defend us, O invokedof many, in this memorable conflict in the recovery of our wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: उत्स्म वातो वहति वासोऽस्या अधिरथं यदजयत्सहस्रम् । रथीरभून्मुद्गलानी गविष्टौ भरे कृतं व्यचेदिन्द्रसेना ॥
mantras.transliteration: utsma vāto vahati vāso'syā adhirathaṃ yadajayatsahasram | rathīrabhūnmudgalānī gaviṣṭau bhare kṛtaṃ vyacedindrasenā ||

translations.english: The wind raised her vesture when she won a thousand cart-loads. Mudgalānī was the charioteer inthe quest of the cattle, the army of Indra recovered (the spoil) taken in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: अन्तर्यच्छ जिघांसतो वज्रमिन्द्राभिदासतः । दासस्य वा मघवन्नार्यस्य वा सनुतर्यवया वधम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: antaryaccha jighāṃsato vajramindrābhidāsataḥ | dāsasya vā maghavannāryasya vā sanutaryavayā vadham ||

translations.english: Restrain, Indra, the thunderbolt of the malignant threatening (foe); ward off, Maghavan, the secretweapon (of our foe), be he Dāsa or Ārya.

mantras.sanskrit: उद्नो ह्रदमपिबज्जर्हृषाणः कूटं स्म तृंहदभिमातिमेति । प्र मुष्कभारः श्रव इच्छमानोऽजिरं बाहू अभरत्सिषासन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: udno hradamapibajjarhṛṣāṇaḥ kūṭaṃ sma tṛṃhadabhimātimeti | pra muṣkabhāraḥ śrava icchamāno'jiraṃ bāhū abharatsiṣāsan ||

translations.english: Rejoicing, he drank up the pool of water, he cleft the mountain peak, he went against the enemy;endowed with vigour, eager for fame, assailing the quick-moving (foe), he seized him with his two arms.

mantras.sanskrit: न्यक्रन्दयन्नुपयन्त एनममेहयन्वृषभं मध्य आजेः । तेन सूभर्वं शतवत्सहस्रं गवां मुद्गलः प्रधने जिगाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: nyakrandayannupayanta enamamehayanvṛṣabhaṃ madhya ājeḥ | tena sūbharvaṃ śatavatsahasraṃ gavāṃ mudgalaḥ pradhane jigāya ||

translations.english: Approaching the bull, they made him roar in the midst of the battle. I, Mudgala, have thereby gained inwar hundreds and thousands of cattle well- pastured.

mantras.sanskrit: ककर्दवे वृषभो युक्त आसीदवावचीत्सारथिरस्य केशी । दुधेर्युक्तस्य द्रवतः सहानस ऋच्छन्ति ष्मा निष्पदो मुद्गलानीम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kakardave vṛṣabho yukta āsīdavāvacītsārathirasya keśī | dudheryuktasya dravataḥ sahānasa ṛcchanti ṣmā niṣpado mudgalānīm ||

translations.english: The bull has been yoked for the destruction of the enemy; his long- haired yoke-fellow made him roar;

mantras.sanskrit: उत प्रधिमुदहन्नस्य विद्वानुपायुनग्वंसगमत्र शिक्षन् । इन्द्र उदावत्पतिमघ्न्यानामरंहत पद्याभिः ककुद्मान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta pradhimudahannasya vidvānupāyunagvaṃsagamatra śikṣan | indra udāvatpatimaghnyānāmaraṃhata padyābhiḥ kakudmān ||

translations.english: The sage (Mudgala) has fitted up the frame of the cart, he has harnessed the bull, training him to hiswork; Indra protected the lord of the inviolable (cows), the buffalo rushed along with speed.

mantras.sanskrit: शुनमष्ट्राव्यचरत्कपर्दी वरत्रायां दार्वानह्यमानः । नृम्णानि कृण्वन्बहवे जनाय गाः पस्पशानस्तविषीरधत्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: śunamaṣṭrāvyacaratkapardī varatrāyāṃ dārvānahyamānaḥ | nṛmṇāni kṛṇvanbahave janāya gāḥ paspaśānastaviṣīradhatta ||

translations.english: Wielding the goad (Indra) with the braided hair proceeded happily, fastening the strap to the wood (ofwon hundreds and thousands of cattle in war.

mantras.sanskrit: इमं तं पश्य वृषभस्य युञ्जं काष्ठाया मध्ये द्रुघणं शयानम् । येन जिगाय शतवत्सहस्रं गवां मुद्गलः पृतनाज्येषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: imaṃ taṃ paśya vṛṣabhasya yuñjaṃ kāṣṭhāyā madhye drughaṇaṃ śayānam | yena jigāya śatavatsahasraṃ gavāṃ mudgalaḥ pṛtanājyeṣu ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: आरे अघा को न्वित्था ददर्श यं युञ्जन्ति तम्वा स्थापयन्ति । नास्मै तृणं नोदकमा भरन्त्युत्तरो धुरो वहति प्रदेदिशत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: āre aghā ko nvitthā dadarśa yaṃ yuñjanti tamvā sthāpayanti | nāsmai tṛṇaṃ nodakamā bharantyuttaro dhuro vahati pradediśat ||

translations.english: Who has thus beheld the evils near at hand? The (bull) which they yoke, they stop; to him they bringneither fodder nor water. Being above (the bull) he bears the chariot-pole announcing (victory to his lord).

mantras.sanskrit: परिवृक्तेव पतिविद्यमानट् पीप्याना कूचक्रेणेव सिञ्चन् । एषैष्या चिद्रथ्या जयेम सुमङ्गलं सिनवदस्तु सातम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: parivṛkteva patividyamānaṭ pīpyānā kūcakreṇeva siñcan | eṣaiṣyā cidrathyā jayema sumaṅgalaṃ sinavadastu sātam ||

translations.english: As a wife who has been abandoned rejoices to find her husband, as a cloud expanding when pouringforth rain with the aid of the earth's disc; with her eager (to recover the cattle) for our charioteer, may we win (theprize), may good fortune, together with food, be given to us.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं विश्वस्य जगतश्चक्षुरिन्द्रासि चक्षुषः । वृषा यदाजिं वृषणा सिषाससि चोदयन्वध्रिणा युजा ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ viśvasya jagataścakṣurindrāsi cakṣuṣaḥ | vṛṣā yadājiṃ vṛṣaṇā siṣāsasi codayanvadhriṇā yujā ||

translations.english: You, Indra, are the eye of the whole world, when, showerer (of benefits), urging on your two vigoroussteeds, harnessed to the car, you engage in battle.

mantras.sanskrit: आशुः शिशानो वृषभो न भीमो घनाघनः क्षोभणश्चर्षणीनाम् । संक्रन्दनोऽनिमिष एकवीरः शतं सेना अजयत्साकमिन्द्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: āśuḥ śiśāno vṛṣabho na bhīmo ghanāghanaḥ kṣobhaṇaścarṣaṇīnām | saṃkrandano'nimiṣa ekavīraḥ śataṃ senā ajayatsākamindraḥ ||

translations.english: The fleet-going Indra, like a formidable bull sharpening (his horns), the slayer of foes, the exciter ofmen, loud-shouting, ever-vigilant, the chief of heroes overthrew at once a hundred hosts.

mantras.sanskrit: संक्रन्दनेनानिमिषेण जिष्णुना युत्कारेण दुश्च्यवनेन धृष्णुना । तदिन्द्रेण जयत तत्सहध्वं युधो नर इषुहस्तेन वृष्णा ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃkrandanenānimiṣeṇa jiṣṇunā yutkāreṇa duścyavanena dhṛṣṇunā | tadindreṇa jayata tatsahadhvaṃ yudho nara iṣuhastena vṛṣṇā ||

translations.english: With Indra the loud-shouting, the vigilant, the vigtorious, the warlike, the unconquerable, the daring,the hurler of arrows, the showerer, (as your ally) conquer you warriors, you leaders, that (hostile host) andovercome it.

mantras.sanskrit: स इषुहस्तैः स निषङ्गिभिर्वशी संस्रष्टा स युध इन्द्रो गणेन । संसृष्टजित्सोमपा बाहुशर्ध्युग्रधन्वा प्रतिहिताभिरस्ता ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa iṣuhastaiḥ sa niṣaṅgibhirvaśī saṃsraṣṭā sa yudha indro gaṇena | saṃsṛṣṭajitsomapā bāhuśardhyugradhanvā pratihitābhirastā ||

translations.english: Indra, with the arrow-bearing (maruts), armed with swords, the subduer, the warrior, who encountershim, the drinker of the Soma, the strong- armed, having a powerful bow, who shoots with well-aimed arrows(conquer with his help).

mantras.sanskrit: बृहस्पते परि दीया रथेन रक्षोहामित्राँ अपबाधमानः । प्रभञ्जन्त्सेनाः प्रमृणो युधा जयन्नस्माकमेध्यविता रथानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhaspate pari dīyā rathena rakṣohāmitrā~ apabādhamānaḥ | prabhañjantsenāḥ pramṛṇo yudhā jayannasmākamedhyavitā rathānām ||

translations.english: Come with your chariot, Bṛhaspati, who are the slayer of Rākṣasas, discomfiting your enemies,

mantras.sanskrit: बलविज्ञायः स्थविरः प्रवीरः सहस्वान्वाजी सहमान उग्रः । अभिवीरो अभिसत्वा सहोजा जैत्रमिन्द्र रथमा तिष्ठ गोवित् ॥
mantras.transliteration: balavijñāyaḥ sthaviraḥ pravīraḥ sahasvānvājī sahamāna ugraḥ | abhivīro abhisatvā sahojā jaitramindra rathamā tiṣṭha govit ||

translations.english: Known by his strength mighty, heroic, overpowering, vigorous, enduring, fierce, attended by heroes,attended by mighty men, the offspring of strength, the possessor of water, do you, Indra, ascend your triumphantchariot.

mantras.sanskrit: गोत्रभिदं गोविदं वज्रबाहुं जयन्तमज्म प्रमृणन्तमोजसा । इमं सजाता अनु वीरयध्वमिन्द्रं सखायो अनु सं रभध्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: gotrabhidaṃ govidaṃ vajrabāhuṃ jayantamajma pramṛṇantamojasā | imaṃ sajātā anu vīrayadhvamindraṃ sakhāyo anu saṃ rabhadhvam ||

translations.english: Imitate in heroism, you kindred warriors, follow, friends, in prowess this Indra, who is the breaker ofmountains, the acquirer of water, armed with the thunderbolt, conquering the swift (foe), destroying (the enemy)by his might.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि गोत्राणि सहसा गाहमानोऽदयो वीरः शतमन्युरिन्द्रः । दुश्च्यवनः पृतनाषाळयुध्योऽस्माकं सेना अवतु प्र युत्सु ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi gotrāṇi sahasā gāhamāno'dayo vīraḥ śatamanyurindraḥ | duścyavanaḥ pṛtanāṣāḷayudhyo'smākaṃ senā avatu pra yutsu ||

translations.english: May Indra, bursting open the clouds with force; pitiless, heroic, with hundredfold anger, invincible, theoverthrower of armies, irresistible, protect our armies in battles.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र आसां नेता बृहस्पतिर्दक्षिणा यज्ञः पुर एतु सोमः । देवसेनानामभिभञ्जतीनां जयन्तीनां मरुतो यन्त्वग्रम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra āsāṃ netā bṛhaspatirdakṣiṇā yajñaḥ pura etu somaḥ | devasenānāmabhibhañjatīnāṃ jayantīnāṃ maruto yantvagram ||

translations.english: May Indra be the leader of these (hosts), may Bṛhaspati, Dakṣiṇā, Yajña, and Soma go before, letthe Maruts march in the van of the destroying and victorious armies of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य वृष्णो वरुणस्य राज्ञ आदित्यानां मरुतां शर्ध उग्रम् । महामनसां भुवनच्यवानां घोषो देवानां जयतामुदस्थात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrasya vṛṣṇo varuṇasya rājña ādityānāṃ marutāṃ śardha ugram | mahāmanasāṃ bhuvanacyavānāṃ ghoṣo devānāṃ jayatāmudasthāt ||

translations.english: (May) the mighty force of the showerer Indra, of the royal Varuṇa, of the Ādityas and Maruts (beours). The shout of the magnanimous and victorious deities, the subverters of the worlds, has arisen.

mantras.sanskrit: उद्धर्षय मघवन्नायुधान्युत्सत्वनां मामकानां मनांसि । उद्वृत्रहन्वाजिनां वाजिनान्युद्रथानां जयतां यन्तु घोषाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uddharṣaya maghavannāyudhānyutsatvanāṃ māmakānāṃ manāṃsi | udvṛtrahanvājināṃ vājinānyudrathānāṃ jayatāṃ yantu ghoṣāḥ ||

translations.english: Excite, Maghavan, my weapons, (excite) the spirits of my heroes; slayer of Vṛtra, let the speed of thehorses be accelerated, let the noises of the chariots be increased.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्माकमिन्द्रः समृतेषु ध्वजेष्वस्माकं या इषवस्ता जयन्तु । अस्माकं वीरा उत्तरे भवन्त्वस्माँ उ देवा अवता हवेषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmākamindraḥ samṛteṣu dhvajeṣvasmākaṃ yā iṣavastā jayantu | asmākaṃ vīrā uttare bhavantvasmā~ u devā avatā haveṣu ||

translations.english: When the banners are intermingled, may Indra be our (defender), may those arrows which are ours bevictorious may our warriors be triumphant; gods, protect us in battles.

mantras.sanskrit: अमीषां चित्तं प्रतिलोभयन्ती गृहाणाङ्गान्यप्वे परेहि । अभि प्रेहि निर्दह हृत्सु शोकैरन्धेनामित्रास्तमसा सचन्ताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: amīṣāṃ cittaṃ pratilobhayantī gṛhāṇāṅgānyapve parehi | abhi prehi nirdaha hṛtsu śokairandhenāmitrāstamasā sacantām ||

translations.english: Bewildering the mind of our foes, Apva, seize their limbs and depart, proceed against them, burn intheir hearts with sorrow, let our enemies be covered with thick darkness.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रेता जयता नर इन्द्रो वः शर्म यच्छतु । उग्रा वः सन्तु बाहवोऽनाधृष्या यथासथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: pretā jayatā nara indro vaḥ śarma yacchatu | ugrā vaḥ santu bāhavo'nādhṛṣyā yathāsatha ||

translations.english: Advance, warriors, and conquer; may Indra grant you happiness, may your arms be strong, so that youmay be invincible.

mantras.sanskrit: असावि सोमः पुरुहूत तुभ्यं हरिभ्यां यज्ञमुप याहि तूयम् । तुभ्यं गिरो विप्रवीरा इयाना दधन्विर इन्द्र पिबा सुतस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: asāvi somaḥ puruhūta tubhyaṃ haribhyāṃ yajñamupa yāhi tūyam | tubhyaṃ giro vipravīrā iyānā dadhanvira indra pibā sutasya ||

translations.english: The Soma has been effused for you, (Indra), the invoked of many, come quickly to the sacrifice withyour two bay horses; our praises recited by the wise, moving quickly, are addressed to you; drink, Indra, of thelibation.

mantras.sanskrit: अप्सु धूतस्य हरिवः पिबेह नृभिः सुतस्य जठरं पृणस्व । मिमिक्षुर्यमद्रय इन्द्र तुभ्यं तेभिर्वर्धस्व मदमुक्थवाहः ॥
mantras.transliteration: apsu dhūtasya harivaḥ pibeha nṛbhiḥ sutasya jaṭharaṃ pṛṇasva | mimikṣuryamadraya indra tubhyaṃ tebhirvardhasva madamukthavāhaḥ ||

translations.english: Lord of bay steeds, drink at this ceremony of the Soma that has been shaken up with the water, fillyour belly with the libation offered by the priests, which the grinding-stones desired to express for you, Indra; doyou who are carried by hymns enhance your exhilaration with these (hymns).

mantras.sanskrit: प्रोग्रां पीतिं वृष्ण इयर्मि सत्यां प्रयै सुतस्य हर्यश्व तुभ्यम् । इन्द्र धेनाभिरिह मादयस्व धीभिर्विश्वाभिः शच्या गृणानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: progrāṃ pītiṃ vṛṣṇa iyarmi satyāṃ prayai sutasya haryaśva tubhyam | indra dhenābhiriha mādayasva dhībhirviśvābhiḥ śacyā gṛṇānaḥ ||

translations.english: Lord of bay steeds, showerer (of benefits), I send you strong good drink that you may proceed; Indra,who are glorified for your prowess, be exhilarated at this (ceremony) with praises, with all rites.

mantras.sanskrit: ऊती शचीवस्तव वीर्येण वयो दधाना उशिज ऋतज्ञाः । प्रजावदिन्द्र मनुषो दुरोणे तस्थुर्गृणन्तः सधमाद्यासः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūtī śacīvastava vīryeṇa vayo dadhānā uśija ṛtajñāḥ | prajāvadindra manuṣo duroṇe tasthurgṛṇantaḥ sadhamādyāsaḥ ||

translations.english: Powerful Indra, they stood in the dwelling of the man (who instrumental tuted the rite), enjoying food togetherwith the offspring, through your protection and prowess, desiring you, knowing the ceremonies, glorifying you,and partaking of the exhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रणीतिभिष्टे हर्यश्व सुष्टोः सुषुम्नस्य पुरुरुचो जनासः । मंहिष्ठामूतिं वितिरे दधाना स्तोतार इन्द्र तव सूनृताभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: praṇītibhiṣṭe haryaśva suṣṭoḥ suṣumnasya pururuco janāsaḥ | maṃhiṣṭhāmūtiṃ vitire dadhānā stotāra indra tava sūnṛtābhiḥ ||

translations.english: Lord of bay horses, by the right guidance of you who are deservedly praised, the bestower ofhappiness the illustrious, the men your praisers, O Indra, have acquired your most gracious assistance forexcelling (other suppliants) through your favours.

mantras.sanskrit: उप ब्रह्माणि हरिवो हरिभ्यां सोमस्य याहि पीतये सुतस्य । इन्द्र त्वा यज्ञः क्षममाणमानड्दाश्वाँ अस्यध्वरस्य प्रकेतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa brahmāṇi harivo haribhyāṃ somasya yāhi pītaye sutasya | indra tvā yajñaḥ kṣamamāṇamānaḍdāśvā~ asyadhvarasya praketaḥ ||

translations.english: Lord of bay horses, come with your two bays to our adorations to drink of the effused Soma; thesacrifice, Indra, reaches to you who are enduring; cognizant of the sacrifice, you are the donor of the reward.

mantras.sanskrit: सहस्रवाजमभिमातिषाहं सुतेरणं मघवानं सुवृक्तिम् । उप भूषन्ति गिरो अप्रतीतमिन्द्रं नमस्या जरितुः पनन्त ॥
mantras.transliteration: sahasravājamabhimātiṣāhaṃ suteraṇaṃ maghavānaṃ suvṛktim | upa bhūṣanti giro apratītamindraṃ namasyā jarituḥ pananta ||

translations.english: Our praises celebrate the irresistible Indra, the dispenser of abundant food, the overcomer of enemies,the delighter in the libation, the possessor of opulence, the well-praised; the adorations of the worshipper glorify(him).

mantras.sanskrit: सप्तापो देवीः सुरणा अमृक्ता याभिः सिन्धुमतर इन्द्र पूर्भित् । नवतिं स्रोत्या नव च स्रवन्तीर्देवेभ्यो गातुं मनुषे च विन्दः ॥
mantras.transliteration: saptāpo devīḥ suraṇā amṛktā yābhiḥ sindhumatara indra pūrbhit | navatiṃ srotyā nava ca sravantīrdevebhyo gātuṃ manuṣe ca vindaḥ ||

translations.english: The seven divine meandering rivers with which you, Indra, the destroyer of cities, replenished theocean, flow unimpeded; you did discover the nine-and-ninety flowing rivers (and their) path for gods and men.

mantras.sanskrit: अपो महीरभिशस्तेरमुञ्चोऽजागरास्वधि देव एकः । इन्द्र यास्त्वं वृत्रतूर्ये चकर्थ ताभिर्विश्वायुस्तन्वं पुपुष्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: apo mahīrabhiśasteramuñco'jāgarāsvadhi deva ekaḥ | indra yāstvaṃ vṛtratūrye cakartha tābhirviśvāyustanvaṃ pupuṣyāḥ ||

translations.english: You did release the great waters from the malignant (obstructer), you were the only god who watchedover them; with those waters which you have employed for the destruction of Vṛtra, may you, all vivifying Indra,cherish your own person n.

mantras.sanskrit: वीरेण्यः क्रतुरिन्द्रः सुशस्तिरुतापि धेना पुरुहूतमीट्टे । आर्दयद्वृत्रमकृणोदु लोकं ससाहे शक्रः पृतना अभिष्टिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vīreṇyaḥ kraturindraḥ suśastirutāpi dhenā puruhūtamīṭṭe | ārdayadvṛtramakṛṇodu lokaṃ sasāhe śakraḥ pṛtanā abhiṣṭiḥ ||

translations.english: Indra is the chief of heroes, the doer of great deeds, to whom praise is well offered; yes, and the voiceof praise lauds him the invoked of many. He slew Vṛtra, he created light; Śakra, the conqueror, has overcome(hostile) hosts.

mantras.sanskrit: शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन्भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ । शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नन्तं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau | śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||

translations.english: We invoke for our protection the opulent Indra, distinguished in this combat; the leader in thefood-bestowing strife, hearing (our praises), terrible in battles the destroyer of foes, the conqueror of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: कदा वसो स्तोत्रं हर्यत आव श्मशा रुधद्वाः । दीर्घं सुतं वाताप्याय ॥
mantras.transliteration: kadā vaso stotraṃ haryata āva śmaśā rudhadvāḥ | dīrghaṃ sutaṃ vātāpyāya ||

translations.english: When, Vasu, (will our) praise (reach) you desiring it? (when) will he, (like) a dam, obstruct and letloose the long-protracted for the sake of wind- driven (rain)?

mantras.sanskrit: हरी यस्य सुयुजा विव्रता वेरर्वन्तानु शेपा । उभा रजी न केशिना पतिर्दन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: harī yasya suyujā vivratā verarvantānu śepā | ubhā rajī na keśinā patirdan ||

translations.english: (O Indra), to whom belong the two bay horses, well-trained, active, swift, courageous, brilliant as thetwo worlds, do you, who are lord (of bay horses), bestowing (wealth upon us), desire (our praises).

mantras.sanskrit: अप योरिन्द्रः पापज आ मर्तो न शश्रमाणो बिभीवान् । शुभे यद्युयुजे तविषीवान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: apa yorindraḥ pāpaja ā marto na śaśramāṇo bibhīvān | śubhe yadyuyuje taviṣīvān ||

translations.english: Indra repelled (him), being like a mortal tired and frightened in (the combat with) the offspring ofiniquity (Vṛtra), when being associated with the forces (of the Maruts), he has been prepared for splendour.

mantras.sanskrit: सचायोरिन्द्रश्चर्कृष आँ उपानसः सपर्यन् । नदयोर्विव्रतयोः शूर इन्द्रः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sacāyorindraścarkṛṣa ā~ upānasaḥ saparyan | nadayorvivratayoḥ śūra indraḥ ||

translations.english: Indra, the friend of man, for his exhilaration, comes mounted in his chariot, granting him favour, thehero Indra, (the driver) of the two neighing and prancing (steeds).

mantras.sanskrit: अधि यस्तस्थौ केशवन्ता व्यचस्वन्ता न पुष्ट्यै । वनोति शिप्राभ्यां शिप्रिणीवान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhi yastasthau keśavantā vyacasvantā na puṣṭyai | vanoti śiprābhyāṃ śipriṇīvān ||

translations.english: He who has mounted the two long-maned and all pervading steeds for the nourishment (of thesacrificer) asks (for the Soma) with his two jaws, possessing mighty jaws.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रास्तौदृष्वौजा ऋष्वेभिस्ततक्ष शूरः शवसा । ऋभुर्न क्रतुभिर्मातरिश्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: prāstaudṛṣvaujā ṛṣvebhistatakṣa śūraḥ śavasā | ṛbhurna kratubhirmātariśvā ||

translations.english: Of glorious strength (associated) with the glorious (maruts) he was renowned; the hero abiding in thefirmament wrought with his strength as the Ṛbhus with their wonderful works.

mantras.sanskrit: वज्रं यश्चक्रे सुहनाय दस्यवे हिरीमशो हिरीमान् । अरुतहनुरद्भुतं न रजः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vajraṃ yaścakre suhanāya dasyave hirīmaśo hirīmān | arutahanuradbhutaṃ na rajaḥ ||

translations.english: The golden-bearded (Indra), lord of bay horses, who made the thunderbolt for the easy destruction ofthe Dasyu, who has irresistible jaws like the vast firmament.

mantras.sanskrit: अव नो वृजिना शिशीह्यृचा वनेमानृचः । नाब्रह्मा यज्ञ ऋधग्जोषति त्वे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ava no vṛjinā śiśīhyṛcā vanemānṛcaḥ | nābrahmā yajña ṛdhagjoṣati tve ||

translations.english: Mitigate, Indra, our iniquities, may we, by our hymns, extermiante those who offer no hymns. Thesacrifice, unaccompanied by prayer, distinct (from that which is performed with prayer), is not grateful to you. in the hall of sacrifice, accompanied by the sacrifice, you, the friend of man, (ascend) the vessel of your glory.

mantras.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वा यत्ते त्रेतिनी भूद्यज्ञस्य धूर्षु सद्मन् । सजूर्नावं स्वयशसं सचायोः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūrdhvā yatte tretinī bhūdyajñasya dhūrṣu sadman | sajūrnāvaṃ svayaśasaṃ sacāyoḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: श्रिये ते पृश्निरुपसेचनी भूच्छ्रिये दर्विररेपाः । यया स्वे पात्रे सिञ्चस उत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śriye te pṛśnirupasecanī bhūcchriye darvirarepāḥ | yayā sve pātre siñcasa ut ||

translations.english: May the spotted cow yield milk for mixing with your (Soma), may the ladle for the mixture wherewithyou pour it into your own vessel be free from defect.

mantras.sanskrit: शतं वा यदसुर्य प्रति त्वा सुमित्र इत्थास्तौद्दुर्मित्र इत्थास्तौत् । आवो यद्दस्युहत्ये कुत्सपुत्रं प्रावो यद्दस्युहत्ये कुत्सवत्सम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śataṃ vā yadasurya prati tvā sumitra itthāstauddurmitra itthāstaut | āvo yaddasyuhatye kutsaputraṃ prāvo yaddasyuhatye kutsavatsam ||

translations.english: When, you, mighty (Indra, gave) hundredfold (riches), Sumitra praised you thus, Durmitra praised youthus, when at the slaughter of the Dasyus you did protect Kutsa's son, when at the slaughter of the Dasyus youprotected Kutsa's darling.

mantras.sanskrit: उभा उ नूनं तदिदर्थयेथे वि तन्वाथे धियो वस्त्रापसेव । सध्रीचीना यातवे प्रेमजीगः सुदिनेव पृक्ष आ तंसयेथे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ubhā u nūnaṃ tadidarthayethe vi tanvāthe dhiyo vastrāpaseva | sadhrīcīnā yātave premajīgaḥ sudineva pṛkṣa ā taṃsayethe ||

translations.english: You both demand the oblation (Aśvins), you spread out the ceremonials as two weavers (strentch)cloths; (the instrumental tutor of the rite) praised you associated together to attain (his desires); like two fortunate daysyou bestow food.

mantras.sanskrit: उष्टारेव फर्वरेषु श्रयेथे प्रायोगेव श्वात्र्या शासुरेथः । दूतेव हि ष्ठो यशसा जनेषु माप स्थातं महिषेवावपानात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uṣṭāreva pharvareṣu śrayethe prāyogeva śvātryā śāsurethaḥ | dūteva hi ṣṭho yaśasā janeṣu māpa sthātaṃ mahiṣevāvapānāt ||

translations.english: Like two longing oxen (to the pastures), you have recourse to those who fill you (with oblations); youapproach like two horses prepared for the fray; employed to bring treasure; you are like two (royal) messengersrenowned among the people; turn not away (from our oblation) like two buffaloes from the drinking-trough.

mantras.sanskrit: साकंयुजा शकुनस्येव पक्षा पश्वेव चित्रा यजुरा गमिष्टम् । अग्निरिव देवयोर्दीदिवांसा परिज्मानेव यजथः पुरुत्रा ॥
mantras.transliteration: sākaṃyujā śakunasyeva pakṣā paśveva citrā yajurā gamiṣṭam | agniriva devayordīdivāṃsā parijmāneva yajathaḥ purutrā ||

translations.english: Connected toegether like the two wings of a bird, you came to the sacrifice like two choice animals;radiant as Agni (at the offering) of the devout (worshipper), like two perambulating priests you celebrate worshipin many plural ces.

mantras.sanskrit: आपी वो अस्मे पितरेव पुत्रोग्रेव रुचा नृपतीव तुर्यै । इर्येव पुष्ट्यै किरणेव भुज्यै श्रुष्टीवानेव हवमा गमिष्टम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: āpī vo asme pitareva putrogreva rucā nṛpatīva turyai | iryeva puṣṭyai kiraṇeva bhujyai śruṣṭīvāneva havamā gamiṣṭam ||

translations.english: You are kinsmen to us, like parents (to) sons, like two fierce shining fires, like two princes hastening togive protection, like two bestowers of food are you for the nourishment of men, like two luminaries for theenjoyment (of our worshippers), like two quick horses you came to our invocation.

mantras.sanskrit: वंसगेव पूषर्या शिम्बाता मित्रेव ऋता शतरा शातपन्ता । वाजेवोच्चा वयसा घर्म्येष्ठा मेषेवेषा सपर्या पुरीषा ॥
mantras.transliteration: vaṃsageva pūṣaryā śimbātā mitreva ṛtā śatarā śātapantā | vājevoccā vayasā gharmyeṣṭhā meṣeveṣā saparyā purīṣā ||

translations.english: You are like two plural asantly moving well-fed (hills) like Mitra and Varuṇa, the two bestowers of felicity,veracious, possessors of infinite wealth, happy, like two horses plural mp with fodder, abiding in the firmament, liketwo rams (are you) to be nourished with sacrificial food, to be cherished (with oblations).

mantras.sanskrit: सृण्येव जर्भरी तुर्फरीतू नैतोशेव तुर्फरी पर्फरीका । उदन्यजेव जेमना मदेरू ता मे जराय्वजरं मरायु ॥
mantras.transliteration: sṛṇyeva jarbharī turpharītū naitośeva turpharī parpharīkā | udanyajeva jemanā maderū tā me jarāyvajaraṃ marāyu ||

translations.english: You are like two mad elephants bending their forequarters and smiting the foe, like the two sons ofare victorious, (render) my decaying mortal body free from decay.

mantras.sanskrit: पज्रेव चर्चरं जारं मरायु क्षद्मेवार्थेषु तर्तरीथ उग्रा । ऋभू नापत्खरमज्रा खरज्रुर्वायुर्न पर्फरत्क्षयद्रयीणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pajreva carcaraṃ jāraṃ marāyu kṣadmevārtheṣu tartarītha ugrā | ṛbhū nāpatkharamajrā kharajrurvāyurna parpharatkṣayadrayīṇām ||

translations.english: Fierce (Aśvins), like two powerful (heroes), you enable this moving, perishable mortal (frame) to crossover to the objects (of its destination) as over water; extremely strong, like the Ṛbhus, your chariot attained itsdestination swift as the wind, it pervaded (everywhere), it dispensed riches.

mantras.sanskrit: घर्मेव मधु जठरे सनेरू भगेविता तुर्फरी फारिवारम् । पतरेव चचरा चन्द्रनिर्णिङ्मनऋङ्गा मनन्या न जग्मी ॥
mantras.transliteration: gharmeva madhu jaṭhare sanerū bhagevitā turpharī phārivāram | patareva cacarā candranirṇiṅmanaṛṅgā mananyā na jagmī ||

translations.english: With your bellies full of the Soma, like two saucepans, preservers of wealth, destroyers of enemies,(you are), armed with hatchets, moving like two flying (birds) with forms like the moon, attaining success throughthe mind, like two laudable beings, (you are) approaching (the sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: बृहन्तेव गम्भरेषु प्रतिष्ठां पादेव गाधं तरते विदाथः । कर्णेव शासुरनु हि स्मराथ्ॐऽशेव नो भजतं चित्रमप्नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhanteva gambhareṣu pratiṣṭhāṃ pādeva gādhaṃ tarate vidāthaḥ | karṇeva śāsuranu hi smarāthoṃ'śeva no bhajataṃ citramapnaḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: आरङ्गरेव मध्वेरयेथे सारघेव गवि नीचीनबारे । कीनारेव स्वेदमासिष्विदाना क्षामेवोर्जा सूयवसात्सचेथे ॥
mantras.transliteration: āraṅgareva madhverayethe sāragheva gavi nīcīnabāre | kīnāreva svedamāsiṣvidānā kṣāmevorjā sūyavasātsacethe ||

translations.english: Like two loud-sounding (clouds), you send forth the sweet (Soma); like two bees (you deposit milk) in(the udder of) the cow which has its opening turned downwards; like two labourers you are dripping withperspiration, like a tired cow eating sweet herbage, you attend.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋध्याम स्तोमं सनुयाम वाजमा नो मन्त्रं सरथेहोप यातम् । यशो न पक्वं मधु गोष्वन्तरा भूतांशो अश्विनोः काममप्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛdhyāma stomaṃ sanuyāma vājamā no mantraṃ sarathehopa yātam | yaśo na pakvaṃ madhu goṣvantarā bhūtāṃśo aśvinoḥ kāmamaprāḥ ||

translations.english: May we increase our praise, ( Aśvins), may we offer you food, come hither in the same chariot to ourworship; and accept the sweet food prepared from within the cows. Bhūtāṃs;a has fulfilled the desires of thelearned.

mantras.sanskrit: आविरभून्महि माघोनमेषां विश्वं जीवं तमसो निरमोचि । महि ज्योतिः पितृभिर्दत्तमागादुरुः पन्था दक्षिणाया अदर्शि ॥
mantras.transliteration: āvirabhūnmahi māghonameṣāṃ viśvaṃ jīvaṃ tamaso niramoci | mahi jyotiḥ pitṛbhirdattamāgāduruḥ panthā dakṣiṇāyā adarśi ||

translations.english: The great (splendour) of Maghavan has becomemanifest (for the rites) of these (worshippers); all lifehas been extricated from darkness, the vast light bestowed by the progenitors has arrived, a spacious path forthe dakṣiṇā has been displayed. (I Maghavan: Mqaghavan = the sun, at whose rising and at midday thedakṣiṇā is to be given, not at sunset; cf. RV. 5.77.2].

mantras.sanskrit: उच्चा दिवि दक्षिणावन्तो अस्थुर्ये अश्वदाः सह ते सूर्येण । हिरण्यदा अमृतत्वं भजन्ते वासोदाः सोम प्र तिरन्त आयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uccā divi dakṣiṇāvanto asthurye aśvadāḥ saha te sūryeṇa | hiraṇyadā amṛtatvaṃ bhajante vāsodāḥ soma pra tiranta āyuḥ ||

translations.english: (Saramā). I come, the appointed messenger of Indra, desiring, Paṇis, your great hidden treasures;through fear of being crossed the (water) helped us, thus I passed over the waters of the Rasā.

mantras.sanskrit: दैवी पूर्तिर्दक्षिणा देवयज्या न कवारिभ्यो नहि ते पृणन्ति । अथा नरः प्रयतदक्षिणासोऽवद्यभिया बहवः पृणन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: daivī pūrtirdakṣiṇā devayajyā na kavāribhyo nahi te pṛṇanti | athā naraḥ prayatadakṣiṇāso'vadyabhiyā bahavaḥ pṛṇanti ||

translations.english: (The Paṇis). What is Indra like, O Saramā? What is the appearance of him as whose messenger youhave come to this plural ce from afar? (They then say to one another:) Let her approach; let us make friends withher, and let her be the lord of our cattle.

mantras.sanskrit: शतधारं वायुमर्कं स्वर्विदं नृचक्षसस्ते अभि चक्षते हविः । ये पृणन्ति प्र च यच्छन्ति संगमे ते दक्षिणां दुहते सप्तमातरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śatadhāraṃ vāyumarkaṃ svarvidaṃ nṛcakṣasaste abhi cakṣate haviḥ | ye pṛṇanti pra ca yacchanti saṃgame te dakṣiṇāṃ duhate saptamātaram ||

translations.english: (Saramā). I do not believe that he can be subdued; he as whose messenger I have come to thisplace from afar subdues (his enemies). The deep rivers do not conceal him; you, Paṇis, slain by Indra, will sleep(in death).

mantras.sanskrit: दक्षिणावान्प्रथमो हूत एति दक्षिणावान्ग्रामणीरग्रमेति । तमेव मन्ये नृपतिं जनानां यः प्रथमो दक्षिणामाविवाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: dakṣiṇāvānprathamo hūta eti dakṣiṇāvāngrāmaṇīragrameti | tameva manye nṛpatiṃ janānāṃ yaḥ prathamo dakṣiṇāmāvivāya ||

translations.english: (The Paṇis). These are the cows which you, auspicious Saramā, coming to the extremities of thesky, demand. Who will give them up to you without a combat? And our weapons are sharp.

mantras.sanskrit: तमेव ऋषिं तमु ब्रह्माणमाहुर्यज्ञन्यं सामगामुक्थशासम् । स शुक्रस्य तन्वो वेद तिस्रो यः प्रथमो दक्षिणया रराध ॥
mantras.transliteration: tameva ṛṣiṃ tamu brahmāṇamāhuryajñanyaṃ sāmagāmukthaśāsam | sa śukrasya tanvo veda tisro yaḥ prathamo dakṣiṇayā rarādha ||

translations.english: (Saramā). Your words, Paṇis, are not in the plural ce of armies; your sinful bodies will not be equal toarrows. Let your path be difficult to follow, let Bṛhaspati show no favour to either (your words or your person ns).

mantras.sanskrit: दक्षिणाश्वं दक्षिणा गां ददाति दक्षिणा चन्द्रमुत यद्धिरण्यम् । दक्षिणान्नं वनुते यो न आत्मा दक्षिणां वर्म कृणुते विजानन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dakṣiṇāśvaṃ dakṣiṇā gāṃ dadāti dakṣiṇā candramuta yaddhiraṇyam | dakṣiṇānnaṃ vanute yo na ātmā dakṣiṇāṃ varma kṛṇute vijānan ||

translations.english: (The Paṇis). This treasure, Saramā, secured in the mountain is composed of cows, horses andriches; the Paṇis protect it who are good watchers; you have come to this lonely spot in vain.

mantras.sanskrit: न भोजा मम्रुर्न न्यर्थमीयुर्न रिष्यन्ति न व्यथन्ते ह भोजाः । इदं यद्विश्वं भुवनं स्वश्चैतत्सर्वं दक्षिणैभ्यो ददाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: na bhojā mamrurna nyarthamīyurna riṣyanti na vyathante ha bhojāḥ | idaṃ yadviśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ svaścaitatsarvaṃ dakṣiṇaibhyo dadāti ||

translations.english: (Saramā). Excited by the Soma, the Ṛṣis, the Aṅgirasas of the nine months' rite, headed by Ayasya,will come here; they will partition this herd of cattle, then the Paṇis will retract their words.

mantras.sanskrit: भोजा जिग्युः सुरभिं योनिमग्रे भोजा जिग्युर्वध्वं या सुवासाः । भोजा जिग्युरन्तःपेयं सुराया भोजा जिग्युर्ये अहूताः प्रयन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhojā jigyuḥ surabhiṃ yonimagre bhojā jigyurvadhvaṃ yā suvāsāḥ | bhojā jigyurantaḥpeyaṃ surāyā bhojā jigyurye ahūtāḥ prayanti ||

translations.english: (The Paṇis). You have indeed come here, Saramā, constrained by divine power; we will make youour sister, do not return, we will share the cattle with you auspicious one.

mantras.sanskrit: भोजायाश्वं सं मृजन्त्याशुं भोजायास्ते कन्या शुम्भमाना । भोजस्येदं पुष्करिणीव वेश्म परिष्कृतं देवमानेव चित्रम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhojāyāśvaṃ saṃ mṛjantyāśuṃ bhojāyāste kanyā śumbhamānā | bhojasyedaṃ puṣkariṇīva veśma pariṣkṛtaṃ devamāneva citram ||

translations.english: (Saramā). I recognize not fraternity nor sisterhood; Indra and the terrible Aṅgirasas know (mykindred); my (masters) desiring the cattle overshadowed (yoru habitation) when I came; depart hence, Paṇis to adistant (spot).

mantras.sanskrit: भोजमश्वाः सुष्ठुवाहो वहन्ति सुवृद्रथो वर्तते दक्षिणायाः । भोजं देवासोऽवता भरेषु भोजः शत्रून्त्समनीकेषु जेता ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhojamaśvāḥ suṣṭhuvāho vahanti suvṛdratho vartate dakṣiṇāyāḥ | bhojaṃ devāso'vatā bhareṣu bhojaḥ śatrūntsamanīkeṣu jetā ||

translations.english: Go hence, Paṇis, to a far-off distant (spot), let the cattle come forth in due order bursting through (thedoor) the concealed cattle which Bṛhaspati, the Soma, the grinding stones and the wise Ṛṣis have found.

mantras.sanskrit: किमिच्छन्ती सरमा प्रेदमानड्दूरे ह्यध्वा जगुरिः पराचैः । कास्मेहितिः का परितक्म्यासीत्कथं रसाया अतरः पयांसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: kimicchantī saramā predamānaḍdūre hyadhvā jaguriḥ parācaiḥ | kāsmehitiḥ kā paritakmyāsītkathaṃ rasāyā ataraḥ payāṃsi ||

translations.english: (The Paṇis). With what intention has Saramā come to this plural ce? Verily the way is long and difficultto be traversed by the person vering. What is the motive of your coming to us? What sort of wandering was yours?How have you crossed the waters of the Rasā?

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य दूतीरिषिता चरामि मह इच्छन्ती पणयो निधीन्वः । अतिष्कदो भियसा तन्न आवत्तथा रसाया अतरं पयांसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrasya dūtīriṣitā carāmi maha icchantī paṇayo nidhīnvaḥ | atiṣkado bhiyasā tanna āvattathā rasāyā ataraṃ payāṃsi ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: कीदृङ्ङिन्द्रः सरमे का दृशीका यस्येदं दूतीरसरः पराकात् । आ च गच्छान्मित्रमेना दधामाथा गवां गोपतिर्नो भवाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: kīdṛṅṅindraḥ sarame kā dṛśīkā yasyedaṃ dūtīrasaraḥ parākāt | ā ca gacchānmitramenā dadhāmāthā gavāṃ gopatirno bhavāti ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: नाहं तं वेद दभ्यं दभत्स यस्येदं दूतीरसरं पराकात् । न तं गूहन्ति स्रवतो गभीरा हता इन्द्रेण पणयः शयध्वे ॥
mantras.transliteration: nāhaṃ taṃ veda dabhyaṃ dabhatsa yasyedaṃ dūtīrasaraṃ parākāt | na taṃ gūhanti sravato gabhīrā hatā indreṇa paṇayaḥ śayadhve ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: इमा गावः सरमे या ऐच्छः परि दिवो अन्तान्त्सुभगे पतन्ती । कस्त एना अव सृजादयुध्व्युतास्माकमायुधा सन्ति तिग्मा ॥
mantras.transliteration: imā gāvaḥ sarame yā aicchaḥ pari divo antāntsubhage patantī | kasta enā ava sṛjādayudhvyutāsmākamāyudhā santi tigmā ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: असेन्या वः पणयो वचांस्यनिषव्यास्तन्वः सन्तु पापीः । अधृष्टो व एतवा अस्तु पन्था बृहस्पतिर्व उभया न मृळात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asenyā vaḥ paṇayo vacāṃsyaniṣavyāstanvaḥ santu pāpīḥ | adhṛṣṭo va etavā astu panthā bṛhaspatirva ubhayā na mṛḷāt ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: अयं निधिः सरमे अद्रिबुध्नो गोभिरश्वेभिर्वसुभिर्न्यृष्टः । रक्षन्ति तं पणयो ये सुगोपा रेकु पदमलकमा जगन्थ ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ nidhiḥ sarame adribudhno gobhiraśvebhirvasubhirnyṛṣṭaḥ | rakṣanti taṃ paṇayo ye sugopā reku padamalakamā jagantha ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: एह गमन्नृषयः सोमशिता अयास्यो अङ्गिरसो नवग्वाः । त एतमूर्वं वि भजन्त गोनामथैतद्वचः पणयो वमन्नित् ॥
mantras.transliteration: eha gamannṛṣayaḥ somaśitā ayāsyo aṅgiraso navagvāḥ | ta etamūrvaṃ vi bhajanta gonāmathaitadvacaḥ paṇayo vamannit ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: एवा च त्वं सरम आजगन्थ प्रबाधिता सहसा दैव्येन । स्वसारं त्वा कृणवै मा पुनर्गा अप ते गवां सुभगे भजाम ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā ca tvaṃ sarama ājagantha prabādhitā sahasā daivyena | svasāraṃ tvā kṛṇavai mā punargā apa te gavāṃ subhage bhajāma ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: नाहं वेद भ्रातृत्वं नो स्वसृत्वमिन्द्रो विदुरङ्गिरसश्च घोराः । गोकामा मे अच्छदयन्यदायमपात इत पणयो वरीयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nāhaṃ veda bhrātṛtvaṃ no svasṛtvamindro viduraṅgirasaśca ghorāḥ | gokāmā me acchadayanyadāyamapāta ita paṇayo varīyaḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: दूरमित पणयो वरीय उद्गावो यन्तु मिनतीॠतेन । बृहस्पतिर्या अविन्दन्निगूळ्हाः सोमो ग्रावाण ऋषयश्च विप्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dūramita paṇayo varīya udgāvo yantu minatīṝtena | bṛhaspatiryā avindannigūḷhāḥ somo grāvāṇa ṛṣayaśca viprāḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: तेऽवदन्प्रथमा ब्रह्मकिल्बिषेऽकूपारः सलिलो मातरिश्वा । वीळुहरास्तप उग्रो मयोभूरापो देवीः प्रथमजा ऋतेन ॥
mantras.transliteration: te'vadanprathamā brahmakilbiṣe'kūpāraḥ salilo mātariśvā | vīḷuharāstapa ugro mayobhūrāpo devīḥ prathamajā ṛtena ||

translations.english: These spoke first about Brahmā's sin, the boundless (sun), the water- god (Varuṇa), the wind-god(Vāyu), the fierce, wide-consuming fire, the source of happiness, (Soma), the divine waters, the first-born sonsof the truthful (Brahmā).

mantras.sanskrit: सोमो राजा प्रथमो ब्रह्मजायां पुनः प्रायच्छदहृणीयमानः । अन्वर्तिता वरुणो मित्र आसीदग्निर्होता हस्तगृह्या निनाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: somo rājā prathamo brahmajāyāṃ punaḥ prāyacchadahṛṇīyamānaḥ | anvartitā varuṇo mitra āsīdagnirhotā hastagṛhyā nināya ||

translations.english: First, the royal Soma, without being ashamed, restored Brahmā's wife (to Bṛhaspati), Varuṇa wasthe inviter, and Mitra, Agni as the ministrant priest taking her by the hand, led her (to her husband).

mantras.sanskrit: हस्तेनैव ग्राह्य आधिरस्या ब्रह्मजायेयमिति चेदवोचन् । न दूताय प्रह्ये तस्थ एषा तथा राष्ट्रं गुपितं क्षत्रियस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: hastenaiva grāhya ādhirasyā brahmajāyeyamiti cedavocan | na dūtāya prahye tastha eṣā tathā rāṣṭraṃ gupitaṃ kṣatriyasya ||

translations.english: And (the gods) said (to Bṛhaspati), "This plural dge of hers is to be taken by the hand, this is the wife ofBrahmā; she has not made herself known to the messenger sent (to seek her), so is the kingdom of a kṣatriyaprotected".

mantras.sanskrit: देवा एतस्यामवदन्त पूर्वे सप्तऋषयस्तपसे ये निषेदुः । भीमा जाया ब्राह्मणस्योपनीता दुर्धां दधाति परमे व्योमन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: devā etasyāmavadanta pūrve saptaṛṣayastapase ye niṣeduḥ | bhīmā jāyā brāhmaṇasyopanītā durdhāṃ dadhāti parame vyoman ||

translations.english: The ancient deities spoke about her, the seven Ṛṣis who were engaged in penance. The terrible wifeof Brahma has been brought back (to her husband); (penance) elevates into the highest heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचारी चरति वेविषद्विषः स देवानां भवत्येकमङ्गम् । तेन जायामन्वविन्दद्बृहस्पतिः सोमेन नीतां जुह्वं न देवाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: brahmacārī carati veviṣadviṣaḥ sa devānāṃ bhavatyekamaṅgam | tena jāyāmanvavindadbṛhaspatiḥ somena nītāṃ juhvaṃ na devāḥ ||

translations.english: He leads the life of a Brahmacārin, even adoring all the gods; he becomes a portion of the gods;therefore, Bṛhaspati obtained his wife (formerly) brought him by Soma, as the gods receive an offering.

mantras.sanskrit: पुनर्वै देवा अददुः पुनर्मनुष्या उत । राजानः सत्यं कृण्वाना ब्रह्मजायां पुनर्ददुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: punarvai devā adaduḥ punarmanuṣyā uta | rājānaḥ satyaṃ kṛṇvānā brahmajāyāṃ punardaduḥ ||

translations.english: The gods gave her back again, men also gave her back, and kings confirming (the gift) gaveBrahmā's wife back again.

mantras.sanskrit: पुनर्दाय ब्रह्मजायां कृत्वी देवैर्निकिल्बिषम् । ऊर्जं पृथिव्या भक्त्वायोरुगायमुपासते ॥
mantras.transliteration: punardāya brahmajāyāṃ kṛtvī devairnikilbiṣam | ūrjaṃ pṛthivyā bhaktvāyorugāyamupāsate ||

translations.english: The gods having given back Brahmā's wife, and made her free from sin, having partaken of the foodof the earth, sat down to (the sacrifice of) the widely hymned Bṛhaspati.

mantras.sanskrit: समिद्धो अद्य मनुषो दुरोणे देवो देवान्यजसि जातवेदः । आ च वह मित्रमहश्चिकित्वान्त्वं दूतः कविरसि प्रचेताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samiddho adya manuṣo duroṇe devo devānyajasi jātavedaḥ | ā ca vaha mitramahaścikitvāntvaṃ dūtaḥ kavirasi pracetāḥ ||

translations.english: Kindled today, Jātavedas, in the dwelling of the worshipper, you who are divine, sacrifice to the godṣBear (the oblation), you who respect your friends, who are intelligent; you are the wise, far-seeing messenger (ofthe gods).

mantras.sanskrit: तनूनपात्पथ ऋतस्य यानान्मध्वा समञ्जन्त्स्वदया सुजिह्व । मन्मानि धीभिरुत यज्ञमृन्धन्देवत्रा च कृणुह्यध्वरं नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tanūnapātpatha ṛtasya yānānmadhvā samañjantsvadayā sujihva | manmāni dhībhiruta yajñamṛndhandevatrā ca kṛṇuhyadhvaraṃ naḥ ||

translations.english: Pure-tongued Tanūnapāt, flavour the paths of the sacrifice which lead (to success), moisteningthem with the sweet (Soma); elevating our praises and our rite by understanding, convey our sacrifice to thegods.

mantras.sanskrit: आजुह्वान ईड्यो वन्द्यश्चा याह्यग्ने वसुभिः सजोषाः । त्वं देवानामसि यह्व होता स एनान्यक्षीषितो यजीयान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ājuhvāna īḍyo vandyaścā yāhyagne vasubhiḥ sajoṣāḥ | tvaṃ devānāmasi yahva hotā sa enānyakṣīṣito yajīyān ||

translations.english: Agni, who are the invoker (of the gods), and are to be solicited and praised, come, being propitiated,along with the Vasus; you, O mighty (Agni), are the invoker of the gods; do you, who are most entitled to worship,solicited by us, offer them adoration.

mantras.sanskrit: प्राचीनं बर्हिः प्रदिशा पृथिव्या वस्तोरस्या वृज्यते अग्रे अह्नाम् । व्यु प्रथते वितरं वरीयो देवेभ्यो अदितये स्योनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: prācīnaṃ barhiḥ pradiśā pṛthivyā vastorasyā vṛjyate agre ahnām | vyu prathate vitaraṃ varīyo devebhyo aditaye syonam ||

translations.english: In the beginning of the day the sacred grass, pointing eastwards, is strewn with the prescribed (text)as a covering for the earth (of the altar); they spread it out far and wide as a plural asant (seat) for the gods andAditi.

mantras.sanskrit: व्यचस्वतीरुर्विया वि श्रयन्तां पतिभ्यो न जनयः शुम्भमानाः । देवीर्द्वारो बृहतीर्विश्वमिन्वा देवेभ्यो भवत सुप्रायणाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vyacasvatīrurviyā vi śrayantāṃ patibhyo na janayaḥ śumbhamānāḥ | devīrdvāro bṛhatīrviśvaminvā devebhyo bhavata suprāyaṇāḥ ||

translations.english: Expanding wide, let the doors give access as gracefully decorated wives give access to theirhusbands, divine doors, spacious and admitting all, be easy of entry for the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: आ सुष्वयन्ती यजते उपाके उषासानक्ता सदतां नि योनौ । दिव्ये योषणे बृहती सुरुक्मे अधि श्रियं शुक्रपिशं दधाने ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā suṣvayantī yajate upāke uṣāsānaktā sadatāṃ ni yonau | divye yoṣaṇe bṛhatī surukme adhi śriyaṃ śukrapiśaṃ dadhāne ||

translations.english: May the adorable Day and Night, the givers of sound repose, having approached, sit down in theplace (of sacrifice), two divine feminine les, majestic and richly ornamented, bearing beauty of a bright form.

mantras.sanskrit: दैव्या होतारा प्रथमा सुवाचा मिमाना यज्ञं मनुषो यजध्यै । प्रचोदयन्ता विदथेषु कारू प्राचीनं ज्योतिः प्रदिशा दिशन्ता ॥
mantras.transliteration: daivyā hotārā prathamā suvācā mimānā yajñaṃ manuṣo yajadhyai | pracodayantā vidatheṣu kārū prācīnaṃ jyotiḥ pradiśā diśantā ||

translations.english: Divine ministers, prior (to those of earth), repeaters of pious praise, instrumental tuting the sacrifice at whichmen are to worship, (sit down) stimulating (the priests) at the sacrifices, makers (of praises), indicating theeastern fire with the prescribed (text).

mantras.sanskrit: आ नो यज्ञं भारती तूयमेत्विळा मनुष्वदिह चेतयन्ती । तिस्रो देवीर्बर्हिरेदं स्योनं सरस्वती स्वपसः सदन्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā no yajñaṃ bhāratī tūyametviḷā manuṣvadiha cetayantī | tisro devīrbarhiredaṃ syonaṃ sarasvatī svapasaḥ sadantu ||

translations.english: May Bhāratī come quickly to our sacrifice, and Iḷā thinking (of what she has to do), like a humanbeing; may Sarasvatī also-- the three gracious goddesses, sit down upon this plural asant sacred grass.

mantras.sanskrit: य इमे द्यावापृथिवी जनित्री रूपैरपिंशद्भुवनानि विश्वा । तमद्य होतरिषितो यजीयान्देवं त्वष्टारमिह यक्षि विद्वान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya ime dyāvāpṛthivī janitrī rūpairapiṃśadbhuvanāni viśvā | tamadya hotariṣito yajīyāndevaṃ tvaṣṭāramiha yakṣi vidvān ||

translations.english: To the divine Tvaṣṭā, who decked the parental heaven and earth and all the worlds with livingforms, to him, O priest, who are venerable and wise, being solicited byu us, offer oblation here today.

mantras.sanskrit: उपावसृज त्मन्या समञ्जन्देवानां पाथ ऋतुथा हवींषि । वनस्पतिः शमिता देवो अग्निः स्वदन्तु हव्यं मधुना घृतेन ॥
mantras.transliteration: upāvasṛja tmanyā samañjandevānāṃ pātha ṛtuthā havīṃṣi | vanaspatiḥ śamitā devo agniḥ svadantu havyaṃ madhunā ghṛtena ||

translations.english: Offer of your own will in due season the food (and other) oblations of the gods besmearing it. LetVanaspati, Śamitā, the divine Agni, sweeten the oblation with honey and butter.

mantras.sanskrit: सद्यो जातो व्यमिमीत यज्ञमग्निर्देवानामभवत्पुरोगाः । अस्य होतुः प्रदिश्यृतस्य वाचि स्वाहाकृतं हविरदन्तु देवाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sadyo jāto vyamimīta yajñamagnirdevānāmabhavatpurogāḥ | asya hotuḥ pradiśyṛtasya vāci svāhākṛtaṃ haviradantu devāḥ ||

translations.english: As soon as he was born, Agni constructed a sacrifice, he was the preceder of the gods; may the godspartake of the oblation presented with the svāhā through the voice of him the hotā of the sacrifice at theeastern station.

mantras.sanskrit: मनीषिणः प्र भरध्वं मनीषां यथायथा मतयः सन्ति नृणाम् । इन्द्रं सत्यैरेरयामा कृतेभिः स हि वीरो गिर्वणस्युर्विदानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: manīṣiṇaḥ pra bharadhvaṃ manīṣāṃ yathāyathā matayaḥ santi nṛṇām | indraṃ satyairerayāmā kṛtebhiḥ sa hi vīro girvaṇasyurvidānaḥ ||

translations.english: Offer, worshippers, to Indra praise agreeable to the thoughts of men; let us incite Indra hither withsincere adoration, for he, the hero, capable (of granting our wishes, is desirous of laudation.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतस्य हि सदसो धीतिरद्यौत्सं गार्ष्टेयो वृषभो गोभिरानट् । उदतिष्ठत्तविषेणा रवेण महान्ति चित्सं विव्याचा रजांसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtasya hi sadaso dhītiradyautsaṃ gārṣṭeyo vṛṣabho gobhirānaṭ | udatiṣṭhattaviṣeṇā raveṇa mahānti citsaṃ vivyācā rajāṃsi ||

translations.english: Sustainer of the abode of the water, (the firmament), he shone brightly; the bull, the offspring of a cowwhich has only borne once, met the cows, with a loud roar he sprung up, he pervaded the vast worlds.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रः किल श्रुत्या अस्य वेद स हि जिष्णुः पथिकृत्सूर्याय । आन्मेनां कृण्वन्नच्युतो भुवद्गोः पतिर्दिवः सनजा अप्रतीतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraḥ kila śrutyā asya veda sa hi jiṣṇuḥ pathikṛtsūryāya | ānmenāṃ kṛṇvannacyuto bhuvadgoḥ patirdivaḥ sanajā apratītaḥ ||

translations.english: On hearing our praise Indra knows our wishes; victorious, he opens a path for the sun; making himselfMenā, he came (to the sacrifice), he was unassailable, the lord of cattle, (the lord) of heaven, eternal,unsurpassed.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रो मह्ना महतो अर्णवस्य व्रतामिनादङ्गिरोभिर्गृणानः । पुरूणि चिन्नि तताना रजांसि दाधार यो धरुणं सत्यताता ॥
mantras.transliteration: indro mahnā mahato arṇavasya vratāminādaṅgirobhirgṛṇānaḥ | purūṇi cinni tatānā rajāṃsi dādhāra yo dharuṇaṃ satyatātā ||

translations.english: Praised by the Aṅgirasas, Indra has by his might injured the functions of the mighty cloud; he has sentdown abundant rains, he who (at other times) has supported the supporting (cloud) in heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रो दिवः प्रतिमानं पृथिव्या विश्वा वेद सवना हन्ति शुष्णम् । महीं चिद्द्यामातनोत्सूर्येण चास्कम्भ चित्कम्भनेन स्कभीयान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indro divaḥ pratimānaṃ pṛthivyā viśvā veda savanā hanti śuṣṇam | mahīṃ ciddyāmātanotsūryeṇa cāskambha citkambhanena skabhīyān ||

translations.english: Indra, the counterpart of heaven and earth, is cognizant of all sacrifices, he is the slayer of Śuṣṇa; hespread out the spacious heaven with the sun (to light it up); best of proppers, he propped up (the heaven) with aprop.

mantras.sanskrit: वज्रेण हि वृत्रहा वृत्रमस्तरदेवस्य शूशुवानस्य मायाः । वि धृष्णो अत्र धृषता जघन्थाथाभवो मघवन्बाह्वोजाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vajreṇa hi vṛtrahā vṛtramastaradevasya śūśuvānasya māyāḥ | vi dhṛṣṇo atra dhṛṣatā jaghanthāthābhavo maghavanbāhvojāḥ ||

translations.english: The slayer of Vṛtra, you have laid him low with the thunderbolt; resolute Indra, you have nowovercome by your powerful (bolt), the devices of the impious (asura), confiding in his own strength; you,Maghavan, were strong-armed.

mantras.sanskrit: सचन्त यदुषसः सूर्येण चित्रामस्य केतवो रामविन्दन् । आ यन्नक्षत्रं ददृशे दिवो न पुनर्यतो नकिरद्धा नु वेद ॥
mantras.transliteration: sacanta yaduṣasaḥ sūryeṇa citrāmasya ketavo rāmavindan | ā yannakṣatraṃ dadṛśe divo na punaryato nakiraddhā nu veda ||
