translations.english: When the dawns are associated with the sun, his rays acquire wonderful beauty; but when theconstellation of heaven is not seen, no one really knows (his rays) as he moves.

mantras.sanskrit: दूरं किल प्रथमा जग्मुरासामिन्द्रस्य याः प्रसवे सस्रुरापः । क्व स्विदग्रं क्व बुध्न आसामापो मध्यं क्व वो नूनमन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dūraṃ kila prathamā jagmurāsāmindrasya yāḥ prasave sasrurāpaḥ | kva svidagraṃ kva budhna āsāmāpo madhyaṃ kva vo nūnamantaḥ ||

translations.english: The first of those waters, which issued forth at Indra's sending, went very far. Where, waters, is yourbeginning, where your root, where is your centre, where indeed is your termination?

mantras.sanskrit: सृजः सिन्धूँरहिना जग्रसानाँ आदिदेताः प्र विविज्रे जवेन । मुमुक्षमाणा उत या मुमुच्रेऽधेदेता न रमन्ते नितिक्ताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sṛjaḥ sindhū~rahinā jagrasānā~ ādidetāḥ pra vivijre javena | mumukṣamāṇā uta yā mumucre'dhedetā na ramante nitiktāḥ ||

translations.english: You have set at liberty the streams which had been swallowed by Ahi; they rushed forth with rapidity;the waters which longed to be liberated were set free and now the pure (streams) never stop.

mantras.sanskrit: सध्रीचीः सिन्धुमुशतीरिवायन्त्सनाज्जार आरितः पूर्भिदासाम् । अस्तमा ते पार्थिवा वसून्यस्मे जग्मुः सूनृता इन्द्र पूर्वीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sadhrīcīḥ sindhumuśatīrivāyantsanājjāra āritaḥ pūrbhidāsām | astamā te pārthivā vasūnyasme jagmuḥ sūnṛtā indra pūrvīḥ ||

translations.english: They hasten associated together to the ocean, like loving wives (to a husband); (Indra), the witherer offoes, the demolisher of cities, is their impeller of old; may our oblations, the treasures of earth, and our copiouspraises, proceed, Indra, to your dwelling.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र पिब प्रतिकामं सुतस्य प्रातःसावस्तव हि पूर्वपीतिः । हर्षस्व हन्तवे शूर शत्रूनुक्थेभिष्टे वीर्या प्र ब्रवाम ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra piba pratikāmaṃ sutasya prātaḥsāvastava hi pūrvapītiḥ | harṣasva hantave śūra śatrūnukthebhiṣṭe vīryā pra bravāma ||

translations.english: Drink, Indra, at will of the effused libation, for it is poured out at the morning sacrifice, and is first drunkby you; exult, hero, in slaying your foes, we will glorify your heroic exploits with hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्ते रथो मनसो जवीयानेन्द्र तेन सोमपेयाय याहि । तूयमा ते हरयः प्र द्रवन्तु येभिर्यासि वृषभिर्मन्दमानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaste ratho manaso javīyānendra tena somapeyāya yāhi | tūyamā te harayaḥ pra dravantu yebhiryāsi vṛṣabhirmandamānaḥ ||

translations.english: Come, Indra, to the Soma-drinking with your chariot, which is swifter than thought; let your bays, thevigorous steeds with which you go along rejoicing quickly, hasten hither.

mantras.sanskrit: हरित्वता वर्चसा सूर्यस्य श्रेष्ठै रूपैस्तन्वं स्पर्शयस्व । अस्माभिरिन्द्र सखिभिर्हुवानः सध्रीचीनो मादयस्वा निषद्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: haritvatā varcasā sūryasya śreṣṭhai rūpaistanvaṃ sparśayasva | asmābhirindra sakhibhirhuvānaḥ sadhrīcīno mādayasvā niṣadya ||

translations.english: Decorate your person n with most beautiful forms with the golden radiance of the sun; invoked by usyour friends, Indra, sit down and be exhilarated, accompanied by the Maruts.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य त्यत्ते महिमानं मदेष्विमे मही रोदसी नाविविक्ताम् । तदोक आ हरिभिरिन्द्र युक्तैः प्रियेभिर्याहि प्रियमन्नमच्छ ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya tyatte mahimānaṃ madeṣvime mahī rodasī nāviviktām | tadoka ā haribhirindra yuktaiḥ priyebhiryāhi priyamannamaccha ||

translations.english: You whose greatness (manifested) in your exhilarations the vast heaven and earth, do not separate;come, Indra, with your beloved bay horses harnessed to your chariot, come to our dwelling to (partake of) the(sacrificial) food that is agreeable to you.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्य शश्वत्पपिवाँ इन्द्र शत्रूननानुकृत्या रण्या चकर्थ । स ते पुरंधिं तविषीमियर्ति स ते मदाय सुत इन्द्र सोमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasya śaśvatpapivā~ indra śatrūnanānukṛtyā raṇyā cakartha | sa te puraṃdhiṃ taviṣīmiyarti sa te madāya suta indra somaḥ ||

translations.english: That Soma, drinking constantly of which, Indra you have destroyed the enemies (of the worshipper)with an inimitable weapon-- that Soma prompts your powerful, abundant (laudation), it is effused Indra, for yourexhilaration.

mantras.sanskrit: इदं ते पात्रं सनवित्तमिन्द्र पिबा सोममेना शतक्रतो । पूर्ण आहावो मदिरस्य मध्वो यं विश्व इदभिहर्यन्ति देवाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: idaṃ te pātraṃ sanavittamindra pibā somamenā śatakrato | pūrṇa āhāvo madirasya madhvo yaṃ viśva idabhiharyanti devāḥ ||

translations.english: This your cup, Indra, has been long since provided by us, drink the Soma from it, Śatakratu; thegoblet is full of the sweet Soma, which all the gods desire.

mantras.sanskrit: वि हि त्वामिन्द्र पुरुधा जनासो हितप्रयसो वृषभ ह्वयन्ते । अस्माकं ते मधुमत्तमानीमा भुवन्त्सवना तेषु हर्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi hi tvāmindra purudhā janāso hitaprayaso vṛṣabha hvayante | asmākaṃ te madhumattamānīmā bhuvantsavanā teṣu harya ||

translations.english: Indra, showerer of benefits, men in several plural ces, offering acceptable food, invoke you; these oursacrifices to you are most full of the sweet (Soma); take plural asure in them.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र त इन्द्र पूर्व्याणि प्र नूनं वीर्या वोचं प्रथमा कृतानि । सतीनमन्युरश्रथायो अद्रिं सुवेदनामकृणोर्ब्रह्मणे गाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra ta indra pūrvyāṇi pra nūnaṃ vīryā vocaṃ prathamā kṛtāni | satīnamanyuraśrathāyo adriṃ suvedanāmakṛṇorbrahmaṇe gām ||

translations.english: I will proclaim now, Indra, your ancient first-achieved exploits; resolved to sent rain, you did cleave thecloud, you made the cow easily discoverable for the Brāhmaṇa

mantras.sanskrit: नि षु सीद गणपते गणेषु त्वामाहुर्विप्रतमं कवीनाम् । न ऋते त्वत्क्रियते किं चनारे महामर्कं मघवञ्चित्रमर्च ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni ṣu sīda gaṇapate gaṇeṣu tvāmāhurvipratamaṃ kavīnām | na ṛte tvatkriyate kiṃ canāre mahāmarkaṃ maghavañcitramarca ||

translations.english: Lord of the companies (of the Maruts), sit down among the companies (of the worshippers), they callyou the most sage of sages; without you nothing is done in the distance; have in honour, Maghavan, our greatand various adoration. of wealth, (the wishes of) your friends; make war (for us), you warrior endowed with real strength, give us a sharein the undivided riches.

mantras.sanskrit: अभिख्या नो मघवन्नाधमानान्त्सखे बोधि वसुपते सखीनाम् । रणं कृधि रणकृत्सत्यशुष्माभक्ते चिदा भजा राये अस्मान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhikhyā no maghavannādhamānāntsakhe bodhi vasupate sakhīnām | raṇaṃ kṛdhi raṇakṛtsatyaśuṣmābhakte cidā bhajā rāye asmān ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: तमस्य द्यावापृथिवी सचेतसा विश्वेभिर्देवैरनु शुष्ममावताम् । यदैत्कृण्वानो महिमानमिन्द्रियं पीत्वी सोमस्य क्रतुमाँ अवर्धत ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamasya dyāvāpṛthivī sacetasā viśvebhirdevairanu śuṣmamāvatām | yadaitkṛṇvāno mahimānamindriyaṃ pītvī somasya kratumā~ avardhata ||

translations.english: May the concurring heaven and earth, together with all the gods, preserve that strength of Indra,where by achieving (great deeds), he obtained the greatness that is appropriate to him, and having drunk theSoma, he, eminent for his prowess, increased (in strength).

mantras.sanskrit: तमस्य विष्णुर्महिमानमोजसांशुं दधन्वान्मधुनो वि रप्शते । देवेभिरिन्द्रो मघवा सयावभिर्वृत्रं जघन्वाँ अभवद्वरेण्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tamasya viṣṇurmahimānamojasāṃśuṃ dadhanvānmadhuno vi rapśate | devebhirindro maghavā sayāvabhirvṛtraṃ jaghanvā~ abhavadvareṇyaḥ ||

translations.english: Viṣṇu offering the portion of the Soma, glorified by his own vigour that greatness of his. Indra, thelord of wealth, with the associated gods having slain Vṛtra, became deserving of honour.

mantras.sanskrit: वृत्रेण यदहिना बिभ्रदायुधा समस्थिथा युधये शंसमाविदे । विश्वे ते अत्र मरुतः सह त्मनावर्धन्नुग्र महिमानमिन्द्रियम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛtreṇa yadahinā bibhradāyudhā samasthithā yudhaye śaṃsamāvide | viśve te atra marutaḥ saha tmanāvardhannugra mahimānamindriyam ||

translations.english: When you did encounter the indestructible Vṛtra, wielding your weapons for combat, you acquirerenown; all the associated Maruts of their own accord magnified your great might appropriate to Indra.

mantras.sanskrit: जज्ञान एव व्यबाधत स्पृधः प्रापश्यद्वीरो अभि पौंस्यं रणम् । अवृश्चदद्रिमव सस्यदः सृजदस्तभ्नान्नाकं स्वपस्यया पृथुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: jajñāna eva vyabādhata spṛdhaḥ prāpaśyadvīro abhi pauṃsyaṃ raṇam | avṛścadadrimava sasyadaḥ sṛjadastabhnānnākaṃ svapasyayā pṛthum ||

translations.english: As soon as born he discomfited his assailants; the hero contemplated his own manly prowess in war;he divided the cloud, sent forth the flowing waters, and with the determination to do a good deed, upheld the vastheaven.

mantras.sanskrit: आदिन्द्रः सत्रा तविषीरपत्यत वरीयो द्यावापृथिवी अबाधत । अवाभरद्धृषितो वज्रमायसं शेवं मित्राय वरुणाय दाशुषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ādindraḥ satrā taviṣīrapatyata varīyo dyāvāpṛthivī abādhata | avābharaddhṛṣito vajramāyasaṃ śevaṃ mitrāya varuṇāya dāśuṣe ||

translations.english: Indra advanced with vast (armies); he overcame with his might (his foed stationed between) heavenand earth; confident, he wielded his metal thunderbolt (to do) good to Mitra, Varuṇa, and the donor (of theoblation). when fierce he cut Vṛtra to pieces by his strength-- (Vṛtra who) obstructed the waters, and was encompassed bydarkness.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्यात्र तविषीभ्यो विरप्शिन ऋघायतो अरंहयन्त मन्यवे । वृत्रं यदुग्रो व्यवृश्चदोजसापो बिभ्रतं तमसा परीवृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrasyātra taviṣībhyo virapśina ṛghāyato araṃhayanta manyave | vṛtraṃ yadugro vyavṛścadojasāpo bibhrataṃ tamasā parīvṛtam ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: या वीर्याणि प्रथमानि कर्त्वा महित्वेभिर्यतमानौ समीयतुः । ध्वान्तं तमोऽव दध्वसे हत इन्द्रो मह्ना पूर्वहूतावपत्यत ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā vīryāṇi prathamāni kartvā mahitvebhiryatamānau samīyatuḥ | dhvāntaṃ tamo'va dadhvase hata indro mahnā pūrvahūtāvapatyata ||

translations.english: (In the midst of) the first exploits to be performed by them which (Indra and Vṛtra) achieved strivingwith their utmost might, Vṛtra being slain, the thick darkness was destroyed, and Indra in his might came at thefirst challenge.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वे देवासो अध वृष्ण्यानि तेऽवर्धयन्त्सोमवत्या वचस्यया । रद्धं वृत्रमहिमिन्द्रस्य हन्मनाग्निर्न जम्भैस्तृष्वन्नमावयत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśve devāso adha vṛṣṇyāni te'vardhayantsomavatyā vacasyayā | raddhaṃ vṛtramahimindrasya hanmanāgnirna jambhaistṛṣvannamāvayat ||

translations.english: Then all the gods magnified your exploits with praise, accompanied with libations of Soma; (andpeople) quickly devoured Vṛtra, the obstructer of water, wounded by Indra's slaughtering (weapon), as Agnidevours food with his teeth.

mantras.sanskrit: भूरि दक्षेभिर्वचनेभिॠक्वभिः सख्येभिः सख्यानि प्र वोचत । इन्द्रो धुनिं च चुमुरिं च दम्भयञ्छ्रद्धामनस्या शृणुते दभीतये ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhūri dakṣebhirvacanebhiṝkvabhiḥ sakhyebhiḥ sakhyāni pra vocata | indro dhuniṃ ca cumuriṃ ca dambhayañchraddhāmanasyā śṛṇute dabhītaye ||

translations.english: Celebrate the numerous benevolent (acts of Indra) with clever affectionate praises, together with texts;for adoration.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं पुरूण्या भरा स्वश्व्या येभिर्मंसै निवचनानि शंसन् । सुगेभिर्विश्वा दुरिता तरेम विदो षु ण उर्विया गाधमद्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ purūṇyā bharā svaśvyā yebhirmaṃsai nivacanāni śaṃsan | sugebhirviśvā duritā tarema vido ṣu ṇa urviyā gādhamadya ||

translations.english: Do you, Indra, grant me ample riches and excellent horses with which I may honour (the gods)proffering praises; with well-acquired (riches) let us cross over all iniquity, accept our praise today with the mighṭto cross over with ease].

mantras.sanskrit: घर्मा समन्ता त्रिवृतं व्यापतुस्तयोर्जुष्टिं मातरिश्वा जगाम । दिवस्पयो दिधिषाणा अवेषन्विदुर्देवाः सहसामानमर्कम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: gharmā samantā trivṛtaṃ vyāpatustayorjuṣṭiṃ mātariśvā jagāma | divaspayo didhiṣāṇā aveṣanvidurdevāḥ sahasāmānamarkam ||

translations.english: The two sources of heat (Agni and Āditya) spreading to the limit (of the horizon), have pervaded thethreefold (universe); Mātariśvan has come to give them plural asure; (when) the shining (rays) reached theadorable (sun), having the brilliancy of the Sāman, sustaining (the universe), they attained the water of heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: तिस्रो देष्ट्राय निॠतीरुपासते दीर्घश्रुतो वि हि जानन्ति वह्नयः । तासां नि चिक्युः कवयो निदानं परेषु या गुह्येषु व्रतेषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: tisro deṣṭrāya niṝtīrupāsate dīrghaśruto vi hi jānanti vahnayaḥ | tāsāṃ ni cikyuḥ kavayo nidānaṃ pareṣu yā guhyeṣu vrateṣu ||

translations.english: The three Nirṛtis do obeisance for the gist (of oblations), for (the gods), the far-famed sustainers (ofthe universe), know (their obeisance); the wise have ascertained the primary cause of these (divinities) who(exist) in the conspicuous (or) in the hidden observances.

mantras.sanskrit: चतुष्कपर्दा युवतिः सुपेशा घृतप्रतीका वयुनानि वस्ते । तस्यां सुपर्णा वृषणा नि षेदतुर्यत्र देवा दधिरे भागधेयम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: catuṣkapardā yuvatiḥ supeśā ghṛtapratīkā vayunāni vaste | tasyāṃ suparṇā vṛṣaṇā ni ṣedaturyatra devā dadhire bhāgadheyam ||

translations.english: The quadrangular (altar) youthful, handsomely decorated, bright with oblation, clothes herself in piousrites; the two birds, the showerers of oblations, have sat down thereon where the gods receive their share.

mantras.sanskrit: एकः सुपर्णः स समुद्रमा विवेश स इदं विश्वं भुवनं वि चष्टे । तं पाकेन मनसापश्यमन्तितस्तं माता रेळ्हि स उ रेळ्हि मातरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ekaḥ suparṇaḥ sa samudramā viveśa sa idaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ vi caṣṭe | taṃ pākena manasāpaśyamantitastaṃ mātā reḷhi sa u reḷhi mātaram ||

translations.english: One of the birds has entered the firmament; he contemplates this whole world; with mind mature Ibeheld him night at hand; him the mother licks, he licks themother.

mantras.sanskrit: सुपर्णं विप्राः कवयो वचोभिरेकं सन्तं बहुधा कल्पयन्ति । छन्दांसि च दधतो अध्वरेषु ग्रहान्त्सोमस्य मिमते द्वादश ॥
mantras.transliteration: suparṇaṃ viprāḥ kavayo vacobhirekaṃ santaṃ bahudhā kalpayanti | chandāṃsi ca dadhato adhvareṣu grahāntsomasya mimate dvādaśa ||

translations.english: The wise seers through their praise make into many forms the bird which is (only) one; and holding the(seven) metres at the sacrifices, they measure twelve bowls of Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: षट्त्रिंशाँश्च चतुरः कल्पयन्तश्छन्दांसि च दधत आद्वादशम् । यज्ञं विमाय कवयो मनीष ऋक्सामाभ्यां प्र रथं वर्तयन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṣaṭtriṃśā~śca caturaḥ kalpayantaśchandāṃsi ca dadhata ādvādaśam | yajñaṃ vimāya kavayo manīṣa ṛksāmābhyāṃ pra rathaṃ vartayanti ||

translations.english: Filling thirty-six and four vessels, and holding the metres as far as twelve, measuring out the rite bytheir intelligence, the sages complete the sacrifice with the ṛk and the sāman.

mantras.sanskrit: चतुर्दशान्ये महिमानो अस्य तं धीरा वाचा प्र णयन्ति सप्त । आप्नानं तीर्थं क इह प्र वोचद्येन पथा प्रपिबन्ते सुतस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: caturdaśānye mahimāno asya taṃ dhīrā vācā pra ṇayanti sapta | āpnānaṃ tīrthaṃ ka iha pra vocadyena pathā prapibante sutasya ||

translations.english: There are fourteen other great developments of him, seven sages conduct him by prayer; who maydeclare the expanded plural ce of sanctity at this (rite), the path by which they drink of the libation.

mantras.sanskrit: सहस्रधा पञ्चदशान्युक्था यावद्द्यावापृथिवी तावदित्तत् । सहस्रधा महिमानः सहस्रं यावद्ब्रह्म विष्ठितं तावती वाक् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sahasradhā pañcadaśānyukthā yāvaddyāvāpṛthivī tāvadittat | sahasradhā mahimānaḥ sahasraṃ yāvadbrahma viṣṭhitaṃ tāvatī vāk ||

translations.english: The fifteen chief forms (are found) in a thousand plural ces; as heaven and earth are, so verily in that; thethousand great (functions) are in a thousand plural ces; as Brahmā is variably developed, so is Speech.

mantras.sanskrit: कश्छन्दसां योगमा वेद धीरः को धिष्ण्यां प्रति वाचं पपाद । कमृत्विजामष्टमं शूरमाहुर्हरी इन्द्रस्य नि चिकाय कः स्वित् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kaśchandasāṃ yogamā veda dhīraḥ ko dhiṣṇyāṃ prati vācaṃ papāda | kamṛtvijāmaṣṭamaṃ śūramāhurharī indrasya ni cikāya kaḥ svit ||

translations.english: What grave person n knows the application of the metres? Who utters the words appropriate to thefunctions (of the) different priests? Whom do they call the eighth of the priests, the independent? Who has donehonour to the two bay horses of Indra?

mantras.sanskrit: भूम्या अन्तं पर्येके चरन्ति रथस्य धूर्षु युक्तासो अस्थुः । श्रमस्य दायं वि भजन्त्येभ्यो यदा यमो भवति हर्म्ये हितः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhūmyā antaṃ paryeke caranti rathasya dhūrṣu yuktāso asthuḥ | śramasya dāyaṃ vi bhajantyebhyo yadā yamo bhavati harmye hitaḥ ||

translations.english: Some (horses) proceed to the limit of the earth; they stand still harnessed to the yoke of the chariot;(the gods) apportion among them the alleviation of fatigue, when the charioteer is plural ced (ready to drive them) totheir dwelling.

mantras.sanskrit: चित्र इच्छिशोस्तरुणस्य वक्षथो न यो मातरावप्येति धातवे । अनूधा यदि जीजनदधा च नु ववक्ष सद्यो महि दूत्यं चरन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: citra icchiśostaruṇasya vakṣatho na yo mātarāvapyeti dhātave | anūdhā yadi jījanadadhā ca nu vavakṣa sadyo mahi dūtyaṃ caran ||

translations.english: Wonderful is the conveyance of (the oblation by) the tender infant, who does not come to his parentsto drink, although the udderless (world) gave him birth; he immediately bears (the oblation to the gods) fulfillingthe important office of their messenger.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निर्ह नाम धायि दन्नपस्तमः सं यो वना युवते भस्मना दता । अभिप्रमुरा जुह्वा स्वध्वर इनो न प्रोथमानो यवसे वृषा ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirha nāma dhāyi dannapastamaḥ saṃ yo vanā yuvate bhasmanā datā | abhipramurā juhvā svadhvara ino na prothamāno yavase vṛṣā ||

translations.english: The most active Agni, the giver of wealth, is nourished with ghī (by the worshippers), he who withflaming tooth devours the forests; devoutly worshipped with the uplifted goblet (he is, nourished) like a lordlywell-fed bull amidst (fresh) pasture.

mantras.sanskrit: तं वो विं न द्रुषदं देवमन्धस इन्दुं प्रोथन्तं प्रवपन्तमर्णवम् । आसा वह्निं न शोचिषा विरप्शिनं महिव्रतं न सरजन्तमध्वनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ vo viṃ na druṣadaṃ devamandhasa induṃ prothantaṃ pravapantamarṇavam | āsā vahniṃ na śociṣā virapśinaṃ mahivrataṃ na sarajantamadhvanaḥ ||

translations.english: (Glorify) him, (worshippers), the divine, like a bird seated upon a tree, demanding sacrificial food,clamorous, wood-consuming, water-shedding, like one bearing (the oblation) in his mouth, mighty with radiance,simultaneously illuminating the paths, like the great functionary (the sun).

mantras.sanskrit: वि यस्य ते ज्रयसानस्याजर धक्षोर्न वाताः परि सन्त्यच्युताः । आ रण्वासो युयुधयो न सत्वनं त्रितं नशन्त प्र शिषन्त इष्टये ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi yasya te jrayasānasyājara dhakṣorna vātāḥ pari santyacyutāḥ | ā raṇvāso yuyudhayo na satvanaṃ tritaṃ naśanta pra śiṣanta iṣṭaye ||

translations.english: O imperishable Agni, the invincible winds spread around you (who are) rapid in movement, anddesirous of consuming (the forest), like combatants( the priests) calling aloud, anxious to bestow (the oblation),glorify you, the mighty, stationed in the three (altars).

mantras.sanskrit: स इदग्निः कण्वतमः कण्वसखार्यः परस्यान्तरस्य तरुषः । अग्निः पातु गृणतो अग्निः सूरीनग्निर्ददातु तेषामवो नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa idagniḥ kaṇvatamaḥ kaṇvasakhāryaḥ parasyāntarasya taruṣaḥ | agniḥ pātu gṛṇato agniḥ sūrīnagnirdadātu teṣāmavo naḥ ||

translations.english: Agni, the most earnest of eulogists, the friend of those who praise the lord, the destroyer of enemies,whether far off or near, may Agni protect those who adore him, may Agni (protect) those who offer oblation, mayAgni give to us who are both these protection.

mantras.sanskrit: वाजिन्तमाय सह्यसे सुपित्र्य तृषु च्यवानो अनु जातवेदसे । अनुद्रे चिद्यो धृषता वरं सते महिन्तमाय धन्वनेदविष्यते ॥
mantras.transliteration: vājintamāya sahyase supitrya tṛṣu cyavāno anu jātavedase | anudre cidyo dhṛṣatā varaṃ sate mahintamāya dhanvanedaviṣyate ||

translations.english: O Agni, who has fair ancestors, (I have) arrived quickly to (praise) you, the most bountiful bestower offood, the overcomer (of foes), the Jātavedas, (I who offer) the best to you, the most mighty being, the protectorin calamity, with your capable (bow).

mantras.sanskrit: एवाग्निर्मर्तैः सह सूरिभिर्वसुः ष्टवे सहसः सूनरो नृभिः । मित्रासो न ये सुधिता ऋतायवो द्यावो न द्युम्नैरभि सन्ति मानुषान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: evāgnirmartaiḥ saha sūribhirvasuḥ ṣṭave sahasaḥ sūnaro nṛbhiḥ | mitrāso na ye sudhitā ṛtāyavo dyāvo na dyumnairabhi santi mānuṣān ||

translations.english: In this manner, Agni, the son of strength, is glorified by (us his) worshippers, together with piousmortals, for the sake of wealth-- (his worshippers) who, like delighted friends, desiring the sacrifice, like shining(ones), overcome (hostile) men through his might.

mantras.sanskrit: ऊर्जो नपात्सहसावन्निति त्वोपस्तुतस्य वन्दते वृषा वाक् । त्वां स्तोषाम त्वया सुवीरा द्राघीय आयुः प्रतरं दधानाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūrjo napātsahasāvanniti tvopastutasya vandate vṛṣā vāk | tvāṃ stoṣāma tvayā suvīrā drāghīya āyuḥ prataraṃ dadhānāḥ ||

translations.english: "Offspring of food! vigorous (Agni)", thus the praise of Upastuta, showering forth oblations, glorifiesyou. "Let us praise you; through you let us obtain excellent male progeny, enjoying long protracted life". them and the pious, worshippers. With uplifted faces, calling out vaṣaṭ! vaṣaṭ! they reached you; with upliftedfaces they reached you, calling out namas! namas!

mantras.sanskrit: इति त्वाग्ने वृष्टिहव्यस्य पुत्रा उपस्तुतास ऋषयोऽवोचन् । ताँश्च पाहि गृणतश्च सूरीन्वषड्वषळित्यूर्ध्वासो अनक्षन्नमो नम इत्यूर्ध्वासो अनक्षन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: iti tvāgne vṛṣṭihavyasya putrā upastutāsa ṛṣayo'vocan | tā~śca pāhi gṛṇataśca sūrīnvaṣaḍvaṣaḷityūrdhvāso anakṣannamo nama ityūrdhvāso anakṣan ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: पिबा सोमं महत इन्द्रियाय पिबा वृत्राय हन्तवे शविष्ठ । पिब राये शवसे हूयमानः पिब मध्वस्तृपदिन्द्रा वृषस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: pibā somaṃ mahata indriyāya pibā vṛtrāya hantave śaviṣṭha | piba rāye śavase hūyamānaḥ piba madhvastṛpadindrā vṛṣasva ||

translations.english: Drink (Indra) the Soma for the invigoration of your organs, drink, most mighhty one, for the death ofVṛtra; drink when invoked for wealth, for strength; drink of the exhilarating Soma, and being satisfied, Indra,shower down (blessings).

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य पिब क्षुमतः प्रस्थितस्येन्द्र सोमस्य वरमा सुतस्य । स्वस्तिदा मनसा मादयस्वार्वाचीनो रेवते सौभगाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya piba kṣumataḥ prasthitasyendra somasya varamā sutasya | svastidā manasā mādayasvārvācīno revate saubhagāya ||

translations.english: Drink, Indra, your excellent portion of this renowned Soma effused and poured forth; the giver ofprosperity, be delighted in your mind, (be) turned towards us to bestow riches and happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: ममत्तु त्वा दिव्यः सोम इन्द्र ममत्तु यः सूयते पार्थिवेषु । ममत्तु येन वरिवश्चकर्थ ममत्तु येन निरिणासि शत्रून् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mamattu tvā divyaḥ soma indra mamattu yaḥ sūyate pārthiveṣu | mamattu yena varivaścakartha mamattu yena niriṇāsi śatrūn ||

translations.english: May the celestial Soma exhilarate you, Indra; may that which is effused at terrestrial rites exhilarateyou; may that exhilarate you through the influence of which you have bestowed wealth; may that exhilarate youwhereby you scatter foes.

mantras.sanskrit: आ द्विबर्हा अमिनो यात्विन्द्रो वृषा हरिभ्यां परिषिक्तमन्धः । गव्या सुतस्य प्रभृतस्य मध्वः सत्रा खेदामरुशहा वृषस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā dvibarhā amino yātvindro vṛṣā haribhyāṃ pariṣiktamandhaḥ | gavyā sutasya prabhṛtasya madhvaḥ satrā khedāmaruśahā vṛṣasva ||

translations.english: May Indra, who deserves the twofold adoration, (of praise and prayer), who goes everywhere, theshowerer of benefits, come to the offered sacrificial food with his two bay horses; O slayer of enemies,(exhilarated) at our sacrifice (by drinking) of the Soma effused upon the cow-hide and poured (into the cups),rush like a bull upon the dispirited (foes).

mantras.sanskrit: नि तिग्मानि भ्राशयन्भ्राश्यान्यव स्थिरा तनुहि यातुजूनाम् । उग्राय ते सहो बलं ददामि प्रतीत्या शत्रून्विगदेषु वृश्च ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni tigmāni bhrāśayanbhrāśyānyava sthirā tanuhi yātujūnām | ugrāya te saho balaṃ dadāmi pratītyā śatrūnvigadeṣu vṛśca ||

translations.english: Brandishing your sharp, shining weapons, pierce the solid bodies of the evil spirits. I give to you whoare fierce, foe-subduing strength; having assailed the enemies, cut them to pieces in the midst of their clamour.

mantras.sanskrit: व्यर्य इन्द्र तनुहि श्रवांस्योजः स्थिरेव धन्वनोऽभिमातीः । अस्मद्र्यग्वावृधानः सहोभिरनिभृष्टस्तन्वं वावृधस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: vyarya indra tanuhi śravāṃsyojaḥ sthireva dhanvano'bhimātīḥ | asmadryagvāvṛdhānaḥ sahobhiranibhṛṣṭastanvaṃ vāvṛdhasva ||

translations.english: Stretch out for us, lord Indra, varied food, (stretch out) your strength like strong bows against ourenemies; mighty in our presence by your vigour and irresistible still augment your form.

mantras.sanskrit: इदं हविर्मघवन्तुभ्यं रातं प्रति सम्राळहृणानो गृभाय । तुभ्यं सुतो मघवन्तुभ्यं पक्वोऽद्धीन्द्र पिब च प्रस्थितस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: idaṃ havirmaghavantubhyaṃ rātaṃ prati samrāḷahṛṇāno gṛbhāya | tubhyaṃ suto maghavantubhyaṃ pakvo'ddhīndra piba ca prasthitasya ||

translations.english: Imperial Maghavan, to you this oblation is offered; accept it, not displeased; for you, Maghavan, thelibation is effused, for you (the cake is) toasted; eat it, Indra, and drink the libation poured (upon the altar).

mantras.sanskrit: अद्धीदिन्द्र प्रस्थितेमा हवींषि चनो दधिष्व पचतोत सोमम् । प्रयस्वन्तः प्रति हर्यामसि त्वा सत्याः सन्तु यजमानस्य कामाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: addhīdindra prasthitemā havīṃṣi cano dadhiṣva pacatota somam | prayasvantaḥ prati haryāmasi tvā satyāḥ santu yajamānasya kāmāḥ ||

translations.english: Eat, Indra, these oblations plural ced (upon the altar); accept the food, the toasted (cakes), and theSoma. Provided with sacrificial viands we delight you; let the desires of the instrumental tutor of the rite be fulfilled.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रेन्द्राग्निभ्यां सुवचस्यामियर्मि सिन्धाविव प्रेरयं नावमर्कैः । अया इव परि चरन्ति देवा ये अस्मभ्यं धनदा उद्भिदश्च ॥
mantras.transliteration: prendrāgnibhyāṃ suvacasyāmiyarmi sindhāviva prerayaṃ nāvamarkaiḥ | ayā iva pari caranti devā ye asmabhyaṃ dhanadā udbhidaśca ||

translations.english: I direct my eulogy of Indra and Agni; with sacred prayers I directed (my praise) like a vessel (launched)upon the ocean; like holy priests, the gods themselves reverence us, being the donors (to us) of wealth and theextirpators (of our foes).

mantras.sanskrit: न वा उ देवाः क्षुधमिद्वधं ददुरुताशितमुप गच्छन्ति मृत्यवः । उतो रयिः पृणतो नोप दस्यत्युतापृणन्मर्डितारं न विन्दते ॥
mantras.transliteration: na vā u devāḥ kṣudhamidvadhaṃ dadurutāśitamupa gacchanti mṛtyavaḥ | uto rayiḥ pṛṇato nopa dasyatyutāpṛṇanmarḍitāraṃ na vindate ||

translations.english: The gods have not assigned hunger as (the cause of) death, for deaths approach the man who haseaten; the riches of one who gives do not diminish, he who gives not finds no consoler.

mantras.sanskrit: य आध्राय चकमानाय पित्वोऽन्नवान्त्सन्रफितायोपजग्मुषे । स्थिरं मनः कृणुते सेवते पुरोतो चित्स मर्डितारं न विन्दते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya ādhrāya cakamānāya pitvo'nnavāntsanraphitāyopajagmuṣe | sthiraṃ manaḥ kṛṇute sevate puroto citsa marḍitāraṃ na vindate ||

translations.english: He who, possessed of food, hardens his heart against the feeble man craving nourishment, againstthe sufferer coming to him (for help), and pursues (his won enjoyment even) before him, that man finds noconsoler.

mantras.sanskrit: स इद्भोजो यो गृहवे ददात्यन्नकामाय चरते कृशाय । अरमस्मै भवति यामहूता उतापरीषु कृणुते सखायम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa idbhojo yo gṛhave dadātyannakāmāya carate kṛśāya | aramasmai bhavati yāmahūtā utāparīṣu kṛṇute sakhāyam ||

translations.english: He is liberal who gives to the suppliant desiring food, wandering about distressed; to him there is anample (recompense), and he contracts friendship with his adversaries.

mantras.sanskrit: न स सखा यो न ददाति सख्ये सचाभुवे सचमानाय पित्वः । अपास्मात्प्रेयान्न तदोको अस्ति पृणन्तमन्यमरणं चिदिच्छेत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: na sa sakhā yo na dadāti sakhye sacābhuve sacamānāya pitvaḥ | apāsmātpreyānna tadoko asti pṛṇantamanyamaraṇaṃ cidicchet ||

translations.english: He is not a friend who gives not food to a friend, to an associate, to a companion; let him turn awayfrom him, that is not a (fitting) dwelling; let him seek another more liberal lord.

mantras.sanskrit: पृणीयादिन्नाधमानाय तव्यान्द्राघीयांसमनु पश्येत पन्थाम् । ओ हि वर्तन्ते रथ्येव चक्रान्यमन्यमुप तिष्ठन्त रायः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pṛṇīyādinnādhamānāya tavyāndrāghīyāṃsamanu paśyeta panthām | o hi vartante rathyeva cakrānyamanyamupa tiṣṭhanta rāyaḥ ||

translations.english: Let the very rich man satisfy his suitor, let him look forward to a more protracted route, for richesrevolve from one man to another, as the wheels of a chariot turn round.

mantras.sanskrit: मोघमन्नं विन्दते अप्रचेताः सत्यं ब्रवीमि वध इत्स तस्य । नार्यमणं पुष्यति नो सखायं केवलाघो भवति केवलादी ॥
mantras.transliteration: moghamannaṃ vindate apracetāḥ satyaṃ bravīmi vadha itsa tasya | nāryamaṇaṃ puṣyati no sakhāyaṃ kevalāgho bhavati kevalādī ||

translations.english: The inhospitable man acquires food in vain. I speak the truth-- it verily is his death. He cherishes notAryaman nor a friend; he who eats alone is nothing but a sinner.

mantras.sanskrit: कृषन्नित्फाल आशितं कृणोति यन्नध्वानमप वृङ्क्ते चरित्रैः । वदन्ब्रह्मावदतो वनीयान्पृणन्नापिरपृणन्तमभि ष्यात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kṛṣannitphāla āśitaṃ kṛṇoti yannadhvānamapa vṛṅkte caritraiḥ | vadanbrahmāvadato vanīyānpṛṇannāpirapṛṇantamabhi ṣyāt ||

translations.english: The plural ughshare furrowing (the field) provides food (for the plural ughman); a man travelling along a roadacquires (wealth for his master) by his movements; a Brāhmaṇa expounding (the Veda) is better than one notexpounding it; (so) let the man who gives become a kinsman to the man who gives not.

mantras.sanskrit: एकपाद्भूयो द्विपदो वि चक्रमे द्विपात्त्रिपादमभ्येति पश्चात् । चतुष्पादेति द्विपदामभिस्वरे सम्पश्यन्पङ्क्तीरुपतिष्ठमानः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ekapādbhūyo dvipado vi cakrame dvipāttripādamabhyeti paścāt | catuṣpādeti dvipadāmabhisvare sampaśyanpaṅktīrupatiṣṭhamānaḥ ||

translations.english: He who has but one foot takes a longer time on a journey than he who has two; he who has two feetcomes after him who has three; he who has four feet comes up overtaking the two-footed (and three-footed),beholding their traces as he passes by.

mantras.sanskrit: समौ चिद्धस्तौ न समं विविष्टः सम्मातरा चिन्न समं दुहाते । यमयोश्चिन्न समा वीर्याणि ज्ञाती चित्सन्तौ न समं पृणीतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samau ciddhastau na samaṃ viviṣṭaḥ sammātarā cinna samaṃ duhāte | yamayościnna samā vīryāṇi jñātī citsantau na samaṃ pṛṇītaḥ ||

translations.english: The two hands are alike, but they do not perform the same work; two cows calving at the same timedo not yield the same milk; two twins have not the same strength; two person ns of the same family do not displayequal liberality.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने हंसि न्यत्रिणं दीद्यन्मर्त्येष्वा । स्वे क्षये शुचिव्रत ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne haṃsi nyatriṇaṃ dīdyanmartyeṣvā | sve kṣaye śucivrata ||

translations.english: Agni, observer of purity, you destroy the devouring (gloom), shining among men in your won dwelling.

mantras.sanskrit: उत्तिष्ठसि स्वाहुतो घृतानि प्रति मोदसे । यत्त्वा स्रुचः समस्थिरन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: uttiṣṭhasi svāhuto ghṛtāni prati modase | yattvā srucaḥ samasthiran ||

translations.english: You spring up when piously invoked, you delight in the oblations when the ladles are brought nearyou.

mantras.sanskrit: स आहुतो वि रोचतेऽग्निरीळेन्यो गिरा । स्रुचा प्रतीकमज्यते ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa āhuto vi rocate'gnirīḷenyo girā | srucā pratīkamajyate ||

translations.english: Agni, who is to be glorified with the voice (of praise), blazes up when invoked, he is sprinkled with theladle before (the other gods).

mantras.sanskrit: घृतेनाग्निः समज्यते मधुप्रतीक आहुतः । रोचमानो विभावसुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ghṛtenāgniḥ samajyate madhupratīka āhutaḥ | rocamāno vibhāvasuḥ ||

translations.english: Agni is anointed with butter, having a face of honey, invoked, radiant, irradiating all.

mantras.sanskrit: जरमाणः समिध्यसे देवेभ्यो हव्यवाहन । तं त्वा हवन्त मर्त्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: jaramāṇaḥ samidhyase devebhyo havyavāhana | taṃ tvā havanta martyāḥ ||

translations.english: Bearer of oblations, glorified by the worshippers, you are kindled for the gods; as such do mortalsinvoke you.

mantras.sanskrit: तं मर्ता अमर्त्यं घृतेनाग्निं सपर्यत । अदाभ्यं गृहपतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ martā amartyaṃ ghṛtenāgniṃ saparyata | adābhyaṃ gṛhapatim ||

translations.english: Mortals, worship with ghī the immortal Agni, the indestructible, the master of the mansion.

mantras.sanskrit: अदाभ्येन शोचिषाग्ने रक्षस्त्वं दह । गोपा ऋतस्य दीदिहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: adābhyena śociṣāgne rakṣastvaṃ daha | gopā ṛtasya dīdihi ||

translations.english: With your indestructible flame, Agni, do you consume the Rākṣasas; shine, the defender of thesacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: स त्वमग्ने प्रतीकेन प्रत्योष यातुधान्यः । उरुक्षयेषु दीद्यत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa tvamagne pratīkena pratyoṣa yātudhānyaḥ | urukṣayeṣu dīdyat ||

translations.english: Do you, Agni, with your brightness, consume the feminine le fiends, shining in your outspread dwelllingṣurukṣayaḥ = occupying many mansions, i.e. the yajamānas].

mantras.sanskrit: तं त्वा गीर्भिरुरुक्षया हव्यवाहं समीधिरे । यजिष्ठं मानुषे जने ॥
mantras.transliteration: taṃ tvā gīrbhirurukṣayā havyavāhaṃ samīdhire | yajiṣṭhaṃ mānuṣe jane ||

translations.english: The masters of many mansions have, by their praises, kindled you, Agni, the bearer of oblations, whoare most adorable among human beings.

mantras.sanskrit: इति वा इति मे मनो गामश्वं सनुयामिति । कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति ॥
mantras.transliteration: iti vā iti me mano gāmaśvaṃ sanuyāmiti | kuvitsomasyāpāmiti ||

translations.english: Thus, indeed, thus my mind (resolved): " I will give cows and horses to my worshippers", for I haveoften drunk of the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वाता इव दोधत उन्मा पीता अयंसत । कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vātā iva dodhata unmā pītā ayaṃsata | kuvitsomasyāpāmiti ||

translations.english: Like the winds violently shaking (the trees), the draughts (of Soma) have lifted me up, for I have oftendrunk of the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: उन्मा पीता अयंसत रथमश्वा इवाशवः । कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति ॥
mantras.transliteration: unmā pītā ayaṃsata rathamaśvā ivāśavaḥ | kuvitsomasyāpāmiti ||

translations.english: The draughts (of Soma) have lifted me up like swift horses (drawing) a chariot, for I have often drunkof the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: उप मा मतिरस्थित वाश्रा पुत्रमिव प्रियम् । कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa mā matirasthita vāśrā putramiva priyam | kuvitsomasyāpāmiti ||

translations.english: The Praise (of the pious) has come to me like a lowing cow to her beloved calf, for I have often drunkof the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: अहं तष्टेव वन्धुरं पर्यचामि हृदा मतिम् । कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ taṣṭeva vandhuraṃ paryacāmi hṛdā matim | kuvitsomasyāpāmiti ||

translations.english: I revolve the song of praise in my heart as a carpenter (making) a charioteer's seat, for I have oftendrunk of the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: नहि मे अक्षिपच्चनाच्छान्त्सुः पञ्च कृष्टयः । कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahi me akṣipaccanācchāntsuḥ pañca kṛṣṭayaḥ | kuvitsomasyāpāmiti ||

translations.english: The five castes have not eluded the gloance of my eye, for I have often drunk of the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: नहि मे रोदसी उभे अन्यं पक्षं चन प्रति । कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahi me rodasī ubhe anyaṃ pakṣaṃ cana prati | kuvitsomasyāpāmiti ||

translations.english: Both heaven and earth (are) not equal to one half of me, for I have often drunk of the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि द्यां महिना भुवमभीमां पृथिवीं महीम् । कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi dyāṃ mahinā bhuvamabhīmāṃ pṛthivīṃ mahīm | kuvitsomasyāpāmiti ||

translations.english: I excel the sky in greatness, (I excel) this great earth, for I have often drunk of the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: हन्ताहं पृथिवीमिमां नि दधानीह वेह वा । कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति ॥
mantras.transliteration: hantāhaṃ pṛthivīmimāṃ ni dadhānīha veha vā | kuvitsomasyāpāmiti ||

translations.english: Lo! I will plural ce this earth (where I will), either here or there, for I have often drunk of the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: ओषमित्पृथिवीमहं जङ्घनानीह वेह वा । कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति ॥
mantras.transliteration: oṣamitpṛthivīmahaṃ jaṅghanānīha veha vā | kuvitsomasyāpāmiti ||

translations.english: I will drive the scorching (sun) either here or there, for I have often drunk of the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: दिवि मे अन्यः पक्षोऽधो अन्यमचीकृषम् । कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति ॥
mantras.transliteration: divi me anyaḥ pakṣo'dho anyamacīkṛṣam | kuvitsomasyāpāmiti ||

translations.english: One of my wings is in the sky; the other I dragged below, for I have often drunk of the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: अहमस्मि महामहोऽभिनभ्यमुदीषितः । कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahamasmi mahāmaho'bhinabhyamudīṣitaḥ | kuvitsomasyāpāmiti ||

translations.english: I am (the sun), the greatest of the great, raised to the firmament, for I have often drunk of the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: गृहो याम्यरंकृतो देवेभ्यो हव्यवाहनः । कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति ॥
mantras.transliteration: gṛho yāmyaraṃkṛto devebhyo havyavāhanaḥ | kuvitsomasyāpāmiti ||

translations.english: Receiving the offering I go, graced (by the worshippers), bearing the oblation to the gods, for I haveoften drunk of the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: तदिदास भुवनेषु ज्येष्ठं यतो जज्ञ उग्रस्त्वेषनृम्णः । सद्यो जज्ञानो नि रिणाति शत्रूननु यं विश्वे मदन्त्यूमाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tadidāsa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭhaṃ yato jajña ugrastveṣanṛmṇaḥ | sadyo jajñāno ni riṇāti śatrūnanu yaṃ viśve madantyūmāḥ ||

translations.english: That was the chiefest in all worlds, from whence the fierce one, the rich in radiance, was born; assoon as born, he destroys the foes, he in whom all living beings delight.

mantras.sanskrit: वावृधानः शवसा भूर्योजाः शत्रुर्दासाय भियसं दधाति । अव्यनच्च व्यनच्च सस्नि सं ते नवन्त प्रभृता मदेषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāvṛdhānaḥ śavasā bhūryojāḥ śatrurdāsāya bhiyasaṃ dadhāti | avyanacca vyanacca sasni saṃ te navanta prabhṛtā madeṣu ||

translations.english: Waxing in strength, the very powerful, destructive (Indra), implants fear in the Dāsa; both theinanimate and the animate (world) is purified by him. Nourished in your exhilaration (all creatures) are assembled.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वे क्रतुमपि वृञ्जन्ति विश्वे द्विर्यदेते त्रिर्भवन्त्यूमाः । स्वादोः स्वादीयः स्वादुना सृजा समदः सु मधु मधुनाभि योधीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tve kratumapi vṛñjanti viśve dviryadete trirbhavantyūmāḥ | svādoḥ svādīyaḥ svādunā sṛjā samadaḥ su madhu madhunābhi yodhīḥ ||

translations.english: To you all (worshippers) offer adoration, whether those propitiators be two or three. Combine thatwhich is sweeter than the sweet with sweetness, unite that honey with honey.

mantras.sanskrit: इति चिद्धि त्वा धना जयन्तं मदेमदे अनुमदन्ति विप्राः । ओजीयो धृष्णो स्थिरमा तनुष्व मा त्वा दभन्यातुधाना दुरेवाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: iti ciddhi tvā dhanā jayantaṃ mademade anumadanti viprāḥ | ojīyo dhṛṣṇo sthiramā tanuṣva mā tvā dabhanyātudhānā durevāḥ ||

translations.english: Verily the pious praise you, (Indra), the giver of wealth in your repeated exhilaration; spread out for usresolute Indra, great and durable (affluence); may the malignant yātudhānas never harm you.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वया वयं शाशद्महे रणेषु प्रपश्यन्तो युधेन्यानि भूरि । चोदयामि त आयुधा वचोभिः सं ते शिशामि ब्रह्मणा वयांसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvayā vayaṃ śāśadmahe raṇeṣu prapaśyanto yudhenyāni bhūri | codayāmi ta āyudhā vacobhiḥ saṃ te śiśāmi brahmaṇā vayāṃsi ||

translations.english: Through you we destroy (our foes) in battles, beholding the numerous (hosts) which we have to fight; Iurge your weapons with words (of praise), I prepare your viands with a sacred verse.

mantras.sanskrit: स्तुषेय्यं पुरुवर्पसमृभ्वमिनतममाप्त्यमाप्त्यानाम् । आ दर्षते शवसा सप्त दानून्प्र साक्षते प्रतिमानानि भूरि ॥
mantras.transliteration: stuṣeyyaṃ puruvarpasamṛbhvaminatamamāptyamāptyānām | ā darṣate śavasā sapta dānūnpra sākṣate pratimānāni bhūri ||

translations.english: I praise (Indra) who is worthy of praise, multiform vast, supreme, most accessible of the accessible; heassails with might the seven Dānavas, he overpowers many opposing hosts.

mantras.sanskrit: नि तद्दधिषेऽवरं परं च यस्मिन्नाविथावसा दुरोणे । आ मातरा स्थापयसे जिगत्नू अत इनोषि कर्वरा पुरूणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni taddadhiṣe'varaṃ paraṃ ca yasminnāvithāvasā duroṇe | ā mātarā sthāpayase jigatnū ata inoṣi karvarā purūṇi ||

translations.english: You deposit the lesser and the greater wealth in the mansion in which you are satisfied with food; youfix the two wandering mothers, you accomplish many works.

mantras.sanskrit: इमा ब्रह्म बृहद्दिवो विवक्तीन्द्राय शूषमग्रियः स्वर्षाः । महो गोत्रस्य क्षयति स्वराजो दुरश्च विश्वा अवृणोदप स्वाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imā brahma bṛhaddivo vivaktīndrāya śūṣamagriyaḥ svarṣāḥ | maho gotrasya kṣayati svarājo duraśca viśvā avṛṇodapa svāḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: एवा महान्बृहद्दिवो अथर्वावोचत्स्वां तन्वमिन्द्रमेव । स्वसारो मातरिभ्वरीररिप्रा हिन्वन्ति च शवसा वर्धयन्ति च ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā mahānbṛhaddivo atharvāvocatsvāṃ tanvamindrameva | svasāro mātaribhvarīrariprā hinvanti ca śavasā vardhayanti ca ||

translations.english: Thus the great Bṛhaddiva, son of Atharvan, repeated his diffused (praise) to Indra. The unsulliedsiister (streams) abiding in the mother (earth), to Indra, and augment him with strength.

mantras.sanskrit: हिरण्यगर्भः समवर्तताग्रे भूतस्य जातः पतिरेक आसीत् । स दाधार पृथिवीं द्यामुतेमां कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre bhūtasya jātaḥ patireka āsīt | sa dādhāra pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāṃ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||

translations.english: Hiraṇyagarbha was present at the beginning; when born, he was the sole lord of created beings; heupheld this earth and heaven-- let us offer worship with an oblation to the divine Ka.

mantras.sanskrit: य आत्मदा बलदा यस्य विश्व उपासते प्रशिषं यस्य देवाः । यस्य छायामृतं यस्य मृत्युः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya ātmadā baladā yasya viśva upāsate praśiṣaṃ yasya devāḥ | yasya chāyāmṛtaṃ yasya mṛtyuḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||

translations.english: (To him) who is the giver of soul, the giver of strength, whose commands all (beings), even the godsobey, whose shadow is immortality, whose (shadow) is death-- let us offer worship with an oblation to the divineKa.

mantras.sanskrit: यः प्राणतो निमिषतो महित्वैक इद्राजा जगतो बभूव । य ईशे अस्य द्विपदश्चतुष्पदः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ prāṇato nimiṣato mahitvaika idrājā jagato babhūva | ya īśe asya dvipadaścatuṣpadaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||

translations.english: (To him) who, by his greatness, has verily become the sole king of the breathing and seeing world,who rules over this aggregate of two-footed and four- footed beings -- let us offer worship with an oblation to thedivine Ka.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्येमे हिमवन्तो महित्वा यस्य समुद्रं रसया सहाहुः । यस्येमाः प्रदिशो यस्य बाहू कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasyeme himavanto mahitvā yasya samudraṃ rasayā sahāhuḥ | yasyemāḥ pradiśo yasya bāhū kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||

translations.english: Through whose greatness these snow-clad (mountains exist), whose property men call the ocean withthe rivers, whose are these quarters of space, who are the two arms -- let us offer worship with an oblation to thedivine Ka.

mantras.sanskrit: येन द्यौरुग्रा पृथिवी च दृळ्हा येन स्व स्तभितं येन नाकः । यो अन्तरिक्षे रजसो विमानः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: yena dyaurugrā pṛthivī ca dṛḷhā yena sva stabhitaṃ yena nākaḥ | yo antarikṣe rajaso vimānaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||

translations.english: By whom the sky was made profound and the earth solid, by whom heaven and the solar sphere werefixed, who was the measure of the water in the firmament -- let us offer worship with an oblation to the divine Ka.

mantras.sanskrit: यं क्रन्दसी अवसा तस्तभाने अभ्यैक्षेतां मनसा रेजमाने । यत्राधि सूर उदितो विभाति कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ krandasī avasā tastabhāne abhyaikṣetāṃ manasā rejamāne | yatrādhi sūra udito vibhāti kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||

translations.english: Whom heaven and earth established by his protection, and shining brightly, regarded with their mind,in whom the risen sun shines forth -- let us offer worship with an oblation to the divine Ka.

mantras.sanskrit: आपो ह यद्बृहतीर्विश्वमायन्गर्भं दधाना जनयन्तीरग्निम् । ततो देवानां समवर्ततासुरेकः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: āpo ha yadbṛhatīrviśvamāyangarbhaṃ dadhānā janayantīragnim | tato devānāṃ samavartatāsurekaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||

translations.english: When the vast waters overspread the universe containing the germ and giving birth to Agni, then wasproduced the one breath of the gods -- let us offer worship with an oblation to the divine Ka.

mantras.sanskrit: यश्चिदापो महिना पर्यपश्यद्दक्षं दधाना जनयन्तीर्यज्ञम् । यो देवेष्वधि देव एक आसीत्कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaścidāpo mahinā paryapaśyaddakṣaṃ dadhānā janayantīryajñam | yo deveṣvadhi deva eka āsītkasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||

translations.english: He who by his might beheld the waters all around containing the creative power and giving birth tosacrifice, he who among the gods was the one supreme god -- let us offer worship with an oblation to the divineKa.

mantras.sanskrit: मा नो हिंसीज्जनिता यः पृथिव्या यो वा दिवं सत्यधर्मा जजान । यश्चापश्चन्द्रा बृहतीर्जजान कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: mā no hiṃsījjanitā yaḥ pṛthivyā yo vā divaṃ satyadharmā jajāna | yaścāpaścandrā bṛhatīrjajāna kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||

translations.english: May he do us no harm who is the parent of the earth, or who the unerring support (of the world) begatthe heaven, and who genitive rated the vast and delightful waters -- let us offer worship with an oblation to the divineKa.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रजापते न त्वदेतान्यन्यो विश्वा जातानि परि ता बभूव । यत्कामास्ते जुहुमस्तन्नो अस्तु वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: prajāpate na tvadetānyanyo viśvā jātāni pari tā babhūva | yatkāmāste juhumastanno astu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||

translations.english: No other than you, Prajāpati, has given existence to all these beings; may that object of our desiresfor which we sacrifice to you be ours, may we be the possessors of riches.

mantras.sanskrit: वसुं न चित्रमहसं गृणीषे वामं शेवमतिथिमद्विषेण्यम् । स रासते शुरुधो विश्वधायसोऽग्निर्होता गृहपतिः सुवीर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vasuṃ na citramahasaṃ gṛṇīṣe vāmaṃ śevamatithimadviṣeṇyam | sa rāsate śurudho viśvadhāyaso'gnirhotā gṛhapatiḥ suvīryam ||

translations.english: I glorify him who is of wonderful radiance like the sun, the desirable, the giver of happiness, the guest(of man), the benevolent. He bestows vigour (upon the worshippers); Agni, the remover of sorrow, the sustaineerof all, the invoker (of the gods), the lord of the mansion.

mantras.sanskrit: जुषाणो अग्ने प्रति हर्य मे वचो विश्वानि विद्वान्वयुनानि सुक्रतो । घृतनिर्णिग्ब्रह्मणे गातुमेरय तव देवा अजनयन्ननु व्रतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: juṣāṇo agne prati harya me vaco viśvāni vidvānvayunāni sukrato | ghṛtanirṇigbrahmaṇe gātumeraya tava devā ajanayannanu vratam ||

translations.english: Accept, Agni, being well plural ased, my praises, author of great deeds, (you are) cognizant of all objectsof knowledge; anointed with butter, stimulate the movements of the Brāhmaṇa; the gods produce (rewards)after your worship.

mantras.sanskrit: सप्त धामानि परियन्नमर्त्यो दाशद्दाशुषे सुकृते मामहस्व । सुवीरेण रयिणाग्ने स्वाभुवा यस्त आनट् समिधा तं जुषस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: sapta dhāmāni pariyannamartyo dāśaddāśuṣe sukṛte māmahasva | suvīreṇa rayiṇāgne svābhuvā yasta ānaṭ samidhā taṃ juṣasva ||

translations.english: Traversing the seven regions (of the universe), immortal Agni, bestow wealth, giving liberally to thepious liberal giver. Gratify with easily obtainable riches, together with fair offspring, him who feeds you with fueḷ

mantras.sanskrit: यज्ञस्य केतुं प्रथमं पुरोहितं हविष्मन्त ईळते सप्त वाजिनम् । शृण्वन्तमग्निं घृतपृष्ठमुक्षणं पृणन्तं देवं पृणते सुवीर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajñasya ketuṃ prathamaṃ purohitaṃ haviṣmanta īḷate sapta vājinam | śṛṇvantamagniṃ ghṛtapṛṣṭhamukṣaṇaṃ pṛṇantaṃ devaṃ pṛṇate suvīryam ||

translations.english: The seven (priests) bearing oblations worship Agni, the emblem of sacrifice, the first of the gods, thefamily priest, the possessor of food, the hearer (of our prayers), the anointed with butter, the shedder of moisture,propitiating the worshipper who propitiates him, divine, endowed with excellent might.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं दूतः प्रथमो वरेण्यः स हूयमानो अमृताय मत्स्व । त्वां मर्जयन्मरुतो दाशुषो गृहे त्वां स्तोमेभिर्भृगवो वि रुरुचुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ dūtaḥ prathamo vareṇyaḥ sa hūyamāno amṛtāya matsva | tvāṃ marjayanmaruto dāśuṣo gṛhe tvāṃ stomebhirbhṛgavo vi rurucuḥ ||

translations.english: You are the chief and most excellent messenger; do you, invoked by us to partake of the ambrosia,become exhilarated; the Maruts decorated you in the dwelling of the donor of the oblation; the Bhṛgus haveglorified you with hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: इषं दुहन्त्सुदुघां विश्वधायसं यज्ञप्रिये यजमानाय सुक्रतो । अग्ने घृतस्नुस्त्रिॠतानि दीद्यद्वर्तिर्यज्ञं परियन्त्सुक्रतूयसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: iṣaṃ duhantsudughāṃ viśvadhāyasaṃ yajñapriye yajamānāya sukrato | agne ghṛtasnustriṝtāni dīdyadvartiryajñaṃ pariyantsukratūyase ||

translations.english: Milking the easily milked cow (of sacrifice) of her all-sustaining food, for the benefit of the piousinstitutor of the rite, O Agni, doer of good deeds, anointed with butter, illumining the three regions, presiding(over the hall of sacrifice), going round the sacrifice, you accomplish each holy rite.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामिदस्या उषसो व्युष्टिषु दूतं कृण्वाना अयजन्त मानुषाः । त्वां देवा महयाय्याय वावृधुराज्यमग्ने निमृजन्तो अध्वरे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmidasyā uṣaso vyuṣṭiṣu dūtaṃ kṛṇvānā ayajanta mānuṣāḥ | tvāṃ devā mahayāyyāya vāvṛdhurājyamagne nimṛjanto adhvare ||

translations.english: Men worshipped you, Agni, at the opening of the present dawn, appointing you their messenger to thegods; the gods have magnified you for their adoration, sprinkling butter upon you at the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: नि त्वा वसिष्ठा अह्वन्त वाजिनं गृणन्तो अग्ने विदथेषु वेधसः । रायस्पोषं यजमानेषु धारय यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni tvā vasiṣṭhā ahvanta vājinaṃ gṛṇanto agne vidatheṣu vedhasaḥ | rāyaspoṣaṃ yajamāneṣu dhāraya yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

translations.english: The pious Vasiṣṭha invoked you, Agni, at the sacrificial meetings, praising you, the mighty one;continue the sustenance of riches among the instrumental tutors of the rite, and do you (gods) ever cherish us withblessings.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं वेनश्चोदयत्पृश्निगर्भा ज्योतिर्जरायू रजसो विमाने । इममपां संगमे सूर्यस्य शिशुं न विप्रा मतिभी रिहन्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ venaścodayatpṛśnigarbhā jyotirjarāyū rajaso vimāne | imamapāṃ saṃgame sūryasya śiśuṃ na viprā matibhī rihanti ||

translations.english: This Vena, enfolded in the membrane of light, urges on (the waters) the germs of the Sun in thefirmament of the water; the sages cherish him at the confluence of the waters, and the sun with endearments likea child.

mantras.sanskrit: समुद्रादूर्मिमुदियर्ति वेनो नभोजाः पृष्ठं हर्यतस्य दर्शि । ऋतस्य सानावधि विष्टपि भ्राट् समानं योनिमभ्यनूषत व्राः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samudrādūrmimudiyarti veno nabhojāḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ haryatasya darśi | ṛtasya sānāvadhi viṣṭapi bhrāṭ samānaṃ yonimabhyanūṣata vrāḥ ||

translations.english: The cloud-born Vena send the water from the firmament; the back of the azure (sky) is beheld. Heshone on the summit of the water in heaven; the troops praised their common abode.

mantras.sanskrit: समानं पूर्वीरभि वावशानास्तिष्ठन्वत्सस्य मातरः सनीळाः । ऋतस्य सानावधि चक्रमाणा रिहन्ति मध्वो अमृतस्य वाणीः ॥
mantras.transliteration: samānaṃ pūrvīrabhi vāvaśānāstiṣṭhanvatsasya mātaraḥ sanīḷāḥ | ṛtasya sānāvadhi cakramāṇā rihanti madhvo amṛtasya vāṇīḥ ||

translations.english: The many waters occupy a common station, clamouring around like the assembled mothers of the calf;wandering above the summit of the water they utter the praises of the sweet-flavoured ambrosia.

mantras.sanskrit: जानन्तो रूपमकृपन्त विप्रा मृगस्य घोषं महिषस्य हि ग्मन् । ऋतेन यन्तो अधि सिन्धुमस्थुर्विदद्गन्धर्वो अमृतानि नाम ॥
mantras.transliteration: jānanto rūpamakṛpanta viprā mṛgasya ghoṣaṃ mahiṣasya hi gman | ṛtena yanto adhi sindhumasthurvidadgandharvo amṛtāni nāma ||

translations.english: The pious, knowing his form, praised him, for they followed the city of the great deer; approaching hmwith sacrifice, they reached the flowing (water), for the sustainer of the waters knows the ambrosial (fluids).

mantras.sanskrit: अप्सरा जारमुपसिष्मियाणा योषा बिभर्ति परमे व्योमन् । चरत्प्रियस्य योनिषु प्रियः सन्त्सीदत्पक्षे हिरण्यये स वेनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: apsarā jāramupasiṣmiyāṇā yoṣā bibharti parame vyoman | caratpriyasya yoniṣu priyaḥ santsīdatpakṣe hiraṇyaye sa venaḥ ||

translations.english: The Apsaras, smiling affectionately like a wife at her lover, cherishes him in the highest heaven; shewanders in the abodes of her beloved; he, Vena, being loved, sits, down on his golden wing.

mantras.sanskrit: नाके सुपर्णमुप यत्पतन्तं हृदा वेनन्तो अभ्यचक्षत त्वा । हिरण्यपक्षं वरुणस्य दूतं यमस्य योनौ शकुनं भुरण्युम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nāke suparṇamupa yatpatantaṃ hṛdā venanto abhyacakṣata tvā | hiraṇyapakṣaṃ varuṇasya dūtaṃ yamasya yonau śakunaṃ bhuraṇyum ||

translations.english: Those desiring you in their hearts contemplated you travelling as a strong-winged bird in the sky, thegolden-winged messenger of Varuṇa, the bird which nourishes (the world) in Yama's dwelling.

mantras.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वो गन्धर्वो अधि नाके अस्थात्प्रत्यङ्चित्रा बिभ्रदस्यायुधानि । वसानो अत्कं सुरभिं दृशे कं स्वर्ण नाम जनत प्रियाणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūrdhvo gandharvo adhi nāke asthātpratyaṅcitrā bibhradasyāyudhāni | vasāno atkaṃ surabhiṃ dṛśe kaṃ svarṇa nāma janata priyāṇi ||

translations.english: The Gandharvā stood erect upon the firmament, brandishing towards us his wonderful weapons,investing all in his beautiful diffusive (form), they make them visible, like the sun he genitive rated the precious(rains).

mantras.sanskrit: द्रप्सः समुद्रमभि यज्जिगाति पश्यन्गृध्रस्य चक्षसा विधर्मन् । भानुः शुक्रेण शोचिषा चकानस्तृतीये चक्रे रजसि प्रियाणि ॥
mantras.transliteration: drapsaḥ samudramabhi yajjigāti paśyangṛdhrasya cakṣasā vidharman | bhānuḥ śukreṇa śociṣā cakānastṛtīye cakre rajasi priyāṇi ||

translations.english: When (Vena as) the drop of rain approaches the firmament, contemplating (all things) with the eye ofthe hawk in the supporting (firmament), then the sun, shining with brilliant radiance, makes the precious(showers) in the third sphere.

mantras.sanskrit: इमं नो अग्न उप यज्ञमेहि पञ्चयामं त्रिवृतं सप्ततन्तुम् । असो हव्यवाळुत नः पुरोगा ज्योगेव दीर्घं तम आशयिष्ठाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imaṃ no agna upa yajñamehi pañcayāmaṃ trivṛtaṃ saptatantum | aso havyavāḷuta naḥ purogā jyogeva dīrghaṃ tama āśayiṣṭhāḥ ||

translations.english: Come, Agni, to this our sacrifice, which has five oblations, three- fold, spread out by seven (priests); bethe bearer of our oblations, be our preceder, you have long been sleeping in profound darkness.

mantras.sanskrit: अदेवाद्देवः प्रचता गुहा यन्प्रपश्यमानो अमृतत्वमेमि । शिवं यत्सन्तमशिवो जहामि स्वात्सख्यादरणीं नाभिमेमि ॥
mantras.transliteration: adevāddevaḥ pracatā guhā yanprapaśyamāno amṛtatvamemi | śivaṃ yatsantamaśivo jahāmi svātsakhyādaraṇīṃ nābhimemi ||

translations.english: (Agni speaks). From being no divinity I issue a divninty from the cave at the solicitation (of the gods),and being manifest I attain immortality; when being inauspicious I abandon the sacrifice as it becomesauspicious, through my (old) friendship I come to the binding touch-wood.

mantras.sanskrit: पश्यन्नन्यस्या अतिथिं वयाया ऋतस्य धाम वि मिमे पुरूणि । शंसामि पित्रे असुराय शेवमयज्ञियाद्यज्ञियं भागमेमि ॥
mantras.transliteration: paśyannanyasyā atithiṃ vayāyā ṛtasya dhāma vi mime purūṇi | śaṃsāmi pitre asurāya śevamayajñiyādyajñiyaṃ bhāgamemi ||

translations.english: Beholding the guest of another family, I have created the manifold abodes of sacrifice; I repeatpraises, (wishing) good luck to the paternal foe- destroying (race of deities), I pass from a plural ce unfit for sacrificeto a plural ce where sacrifice can be offered.

mantras.sanskrit: बह्वीः समा अकरमन्तरस्मिन्निन्द्रं वृणानः पितरं जहामि । अग्निः सोमो वरुणस्ते च्यवन्ते पर्यावर्द्राष्ट्रं तदवाम्यायन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: bahvīḥ samā akaramantarasminnindraṃ vṛṇānaḥ pitaraṃ jahāmi | agniḥ somo varuṇaste cyavante paryāvardrāṣṭraṃ tadavāmyāyan ||

translations.english: I spent many years within this (altar), preferring Indra I abandon the progenitor; Agni, Soma, Varuṇa,fall (from their power); returning, I protect that kingdom which awaits me.

mantras.sanskrit: निर्माया उ त्ये असुरा अभूवन्त्वं च मा वरुण कामयासे । ऋतेन राजन्ननृतं विविञ्चन्मम राष्ट्रस्याधिपत्यमेहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: nirmāyā u tye asurā abhūvantvaṃ ca mā varuṇa kāmayāse | ṛtena rājannanṛtaṃ viviñcanmama rāṣṭrasyādhipatyamehi ||

translations.english: These asuras were deprived of their magical power; if you, Varuṇa, desire me, (then), O king,separating truth from falsehood, come and enjoy sovereignty over my realm.

mantras.sanskrit: इदं स्वरिदमिदास वाममयं प्रकाश उर्वन्तरिक्षम् । हनाव वृत्रं निरेहि सोम हविष्ट्वा सन्तं हविषा यजाम ॥
mantras.transliteration: idaṃ svaridamidāsa vāmamayaṃ prakāśa urvantarikṣam | hanāva vṛtraṃ nirehi soma haviṣṭvā santaṃ haviṣā yajāma ||

translations.english: (Agni or Varuṇa speak). This, O Soma, is heaven; this verily was beautiful this (was) the light, thebroad firmament; let us together slay Vṛtra; come forth; we worship with an oblation you who are yourselfoblation.

mantras.sanskrit: कविः कवित्वा दिवि रूपमासजदप्रभूती वरुणो निरपः सृजत् । क्षेमं कृण्वाना जनयो न सिन्धवस्ता अस्य वर्णं शुचयो भरिभ्रति ॥
mantras.transliteration: kaviḥ kavitvā divi rūpamāsajadaprabhūtī varuṇo nirapaḥ sṛjat | kṣemaṃ kṛṇvānā janayo na sindhavastā asya varṇaṃ śucayo bharibhrati ||

translations.english: The sage (Mitra) by his wisdom fixed his body in the sky; Varuṇa with but a wslight effort let loose thewaters, conferring happiness, like wives, the pure rivers assume his (white) tint.

mantras.sanskrit: ता अस्य ज्येष्ठमिन्द्रियं सचन्ते ता ईमा क्षेति स्वधया मदन्तीः । ता ईं विशो न राजानं वृणाना बीभत्सुवो अप वृत्रादतिष्ठन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā asya jyeṣṭhamindriyaṃ sacante tā īmā kṣeti svadhayā madantīḥ | tā īṃ viśo na rājānaṃ vṛṇānā bībhatsuvo apa vṛtrādatiṣṭhan ||

translations.english: They sustain his most excellent energy, he approaches them delighting him with (sacrificial) food; likesubject choosing a king, they, smitten with fear fled from Vṛtra.

mantras.sanskrit: बीभत्सूनां सयुजं हंसमाहुरपां दिव्यानां सख्ये चरन्तम् । अनुष्टुभमनु चर्चूर्यमाणमिन्द्रं नि चिक्युः कवयो मनीषा ॥
mantras.transliteration: bībhatsūnāṃ sayujaṃ haṃsamāhurapāṃ divyānāṃ sakhye carantam | anuṣṭubhamanu carcūryamāṇamindraṃ ni cikyuḥ kavayo manīṣā ||

translations.english: The sage called the sun the ally of those who are frightened, abiding in the friendship of the waters ofheaven; the wise have honoured with their praise Indra, who ceaselessly moves after the Anuṣṭup.

mantras.sanskrit: अहं रुद्रेभिर्वसुभिश्चराम्यहमादित्यैरुत विश्वदेवैः । अहं मित्रावरुणोभा बिभर्म्यहमिन्द्राग्नी अहमश्विनोभा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ rudrebhirvasubhiścarāmyahamādityairuta viśvadevaiḥ | ahaṃ mitrāvaruṇobhā bibharmyahamindrāgnī ahamaśvinobhā ||

translations.english: I proceed with the Rudras, with the Vasus, with the Ādityas, and with the Viśvedevās; I support bothMitra and Varuṇa, Agni and Indra, and the two Aśvinṣ

mantras.sanskrit: अहं सोममाहनसं बिभर्म्यहं त्वष्टारमुत पूषणं भगम् । अहं दधामि द्रविणं हविष्मते सुप्राव्ये यजमानाय सुन्वते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ somamāhanasaṃ bibharmyahaṃ tvaṣṭāramuta pūṣaṇaṃ bhagam | ahaṃ dadhāmi draviṇaṃ haviṣmate suprāvye yajamānāya sunvate ||

translations.english: I support the foe-destroying Soma, Tvaṣṭā, Pūṣan and Bhaga; I bestow wealth upon the instrumental tutorof the rite offering the oblation, deserving of careful protection, pouring forth the libation.

mantras.sanskrit: अहं राष्ट्री संगमनी वसूनां चिकितुषी प्रथमा यज्ञियानाम् । तां मा देवा व्यदधुः पुरुत्रा भूरिस्थात्रां भूर्यावेशयन्तीम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ rāṣṭrī saṃgamanī vasūnāṃ cikituṣī prathamā yajñiyānām | tāṃ mā devā vyadadhuḥ purutrā bhūristhātrāṃ bhūryāveśayantīm ||

translations.english: I am the sovereign queen, the collectress of treasures, cognizant (of the Supreme Being), the chief ofobjects of worship; as such the gods have put me in many plural ces, abiding in manifold conditions, entering intonumerous (forms.

mantras.sanskrit: मया सो अन्नमत्ति यो विपश्यति यः प्राणिति य ईं शृणोत्युक्तम् । अमन्तवो मां त उप क्षियन्ति श्रुधि श्रुत श्रद्धिवं ते वदामि ॥
mantras.transliteration: mayā so annamatti yo vipaśyati yaḥ prāṇiti ya īṃ śṛṇotyuktam | amantavo māṃ ta upa kṣiyanti śrudhi śruta śraddhivaṃ te vadāmi ||

translations.english: He who eats food (eats) through me; he who sees, who breathes, who hears what is spoken, does sothrough me; those who are ignorant of me perish; hear you who have hearing, I tell that which is deserving ofbelief.

mantras.sanskrit: अहमेव स्वयमिदं वदामि जुष्टं देवेभिरुत मानुषेभिः । यं कामये तंतमुग्रं कृणोमि तं ब्रह्माणं तमृषिं तं सुमेधाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahameva svayamidaṃ vadāmi juṣṭaṃ devebhiruta mānuṣebhiḥ | yaṃ kāmaye taṃtamugraṃ kṛṇomi taṃ brahmāṇaṃ tamṛṣiṃ taṃ sumedhām ||

translations.english: I verily of myself declare this which is approved of by both gods and men; whomsoever I will, I render

mantras.sanskrit: अहं रुद्राय धनुरा तनोमि ब्रह्मद्विषे शरवे हन्तवा उ । अहं जनाय समदं कृणोम्यहं द्यावापृथिवी आ विवेश ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ rudrāya dhanurā tanomi brahmadviṣe śarave hantavā u | ahaṃ janāya samadaṃ kṛṇomyahaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī ā viveśa ||

translations.english: I bend the bow of Rudra, to slay the destructive enemy of the Brāhmaṇas, I wage war with (hostile)men. I pervade heaven and earth.

mantras.sanskrit: अहं सुवे पितरमस्य मूर्धन्मम योनिरप्स्वन्तः समुद्रे । ततो वि तिष्ठे भुवनानु विश्वोतामूं द्यां वर्ष्मणोप स्पृशामि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ suve pitaramasya mūrdhanmama yonirapsvantaḥ samudre | tato vi tiṣṭhe bhuvanānu viśvotāmūṃ dyāṃ varṣmaṇopa spṛśāmi ||

translations.english: I bring forth the paternal (heaven) upon the brow of this (Supreme Being), my birthplace is in the midstof the waters; from thence I spread through all beings, and touch this heaven with my body.

mantras.sanskrit: अहमेव वात इव प्र वाम्यारभमाणा भुवनानि विश्वा । परो दिवा पर एना पृथिव्यैतावती महिना सं बभूव ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahameva vāta iva pra vāmyārabhamāṇā bhuvanāni viśvā | paro divā para enā pṛthivyaitāvatī mahinā saṃ babhūva ||

translations.english: I breathe forth like the wind giving form to all created worlds; beyond the heaven, beyond this earth(am I), so vast am I in greatness.

mantras.sanskrit: न तमंहो न दुरितं देवासो अष्ट मर्त्यम् । सजोषसो यमर्यमा मित्रो नयन्ति वरुणो अति द्विषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: na tamaṃho na duritaṃ devāso aṣṭa martyam | sajoṣaso yamaryamā mitro nayanti varuṇo ati dviṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Neither sin nor sorrow, O gods, affect the man whom Aryaman, Mitra and Varuṇa, being alike plural asedby him, conduct beyond (the reach of) his enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: तद्धि वयं वृणीमहे वरुण मित्रार्यमन् । येना निरंहसो यूयं पाथ नेथा च मर्त्यमति द्विषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: taddhi vayaṃ vṛṇīmahe varuṇa mitrāryaman | yenā niraṃhaso yūyaṃ pātha nethā ca martyamati dviṣaḥ ||

translations.english: We implore that (protection) of yours, Varuṇa, Mitra, and Aryaman, whereby you preserve a man fromsin, and lead him beyond (the reach of) his enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: ते नूनं नोऽयमूतये वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । नयिष्ठा उ नो नेषणि पर्षिष्ठा उ नः पर्षण्यति द्विषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: te nūnaṃ no'yamūtaye varuṇo mitro aryamā | nayiṣṭhā u no neṣaṇi parṣiṣṭhā u naḥ parṣaṇyati dviṣaḥ ||

translations.english: May this Varuṇa and Mitra and Aryaman be our protection, may they lead us to the spot to which weshould be led, and make us cross over to the spot to which we should cross over beyond (the reach of) ourenemies.

mantras.sanskrit: यूयं विश्वं परि पाथ वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । युष्माकं शर्मणि प्रिये स्याम सुप्रणीतयोऽति द्विषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yūyaṃ viśvaṃ pari pātha varuṇo mitro aryamā | yuṣmākaṃ śarmaṇi priye syāma supraṇītayo'ti dviṣaḥ ||

translations.english: You, Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman, protect the universe; may we abide in your blessed felicity, O excellentleaders, beyond (the reach of) our enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: आदित्यासो अति स्रिधो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । उग्रं मरुद्भी रुद्रं हुवेमेन्द्रमग्निं स्वस्तयेऽति द्विषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ādityāso ati sridho varuṇo mitro aryamā | ugraṃ marudbhī rudraṃ huvemendramagniṃ svastaye'ti dviṣaḥ ||

translations.english: May the Ādityas, Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman, (lead us) beyond (the reach of) the malignant; let usinvoke the fierce Rudra with the Maruts, and Indra and Agni for our welfare, (that they may plural ce us) beyond (thereach of) our enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: नेतार ऊ षु णस्तिरो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । अति विश्वानि दुरिता राजानश्चर्षणीनामति द्विषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: netāra ū ṣu ṇastiro varuṇo mitro aryamā | ati viśvāni duritā rājānaścarṣaṇīnāmati dviṣaḥ ||

translations.english: May the leaders Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman, (lead) us apart (from wickedness), may the kings of menlead us beyond all calamities, beyond (the reach of) our enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: शुनमस्मभ्यमूतये वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । शर्म यच्छन्तु सप्रथ आदित्यासो यदीमहे अति द्विषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śunamasmabhyamūtaye varuṇo mitro aryamā | śarma yacchantu sapratha ādityāso yadīmahe ati dviṣaḥ ||

translations.english: May Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman (bestow) upon us felicity for our protection; may the Ādityas grant usthat abundant happiness which we solicit, (and lead us) beyond (the reach of) our enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: यथा ह त्यद्वसवो गौर्यं चित्पदि षिताममुञ्चता यजत्राः । एवो ष्वस्मन्मुञ्चता व्यंहः प्र तार्यग्ने प्रतरं न आयुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathā ha tyadvasavo gauryaṃ citpadi ṣitāmamuñcatā yajatrāḥ | evo ṣvasmanmuñcatā vyaṃhaḥ pra tāryagne prataraṃ na āyuḥ ||

translations.english: As you, adorable Vasus, set free the cow fastened by her foot, even so remove sin away from us, andprolong, Agni, our protracted life.

mantras.sanskrit: रात्री व्यख्यदायती पुरुत्रा देव्यक्षभिः । विश्वा अधि श्रियोऽधित ॥
mantras.transliteration: rātrī vyakhyadāyatī purutrā devyakṣabhiḥ | viśvā adhi śriyo'dhita ||

translations.english: The divine Night approaching looked upon many plural ces with her eyes, she has assumed all beautieṣ

mantras.sanskrit: ओर्वप्रा अमर्त्या निवतो देव्युद्वतः । ज्योतिषा बाधते तमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: orvaprā amartyā nivato devyudvataḥ | jyotiṣā bādhate tamaḥ ||

translations.english: The immortal goddess has filled the expandeed (formament), the low plural ces and the high plural ces, shefights the darkness with lustre.

mantras.sanskrit: निरु स्वसारमस्कृतोषसं देव्यायती । अपेदु हासते तमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: niru svasāramaskṛtoṣasaṃ devyāyatī | apedu hāsate tamaḥ ||

translations.english: The advancing goddess prepared (the way for) her sister Dawn, and then the darkness departs.

mantras.sanskrit: सा नो अद्य यस्या वयं नि ते यामन्नविक्ष्महि । वृक्षे न वसतिं वयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sā no adya yasyā vayaṃ ni te yāmannavikṣmahi | vṛkṣe na vasatiṃ vayaḥ ||

translations.english: May she be favourable to us today upon whose approach we re-enter (our dwellings), as birds(re-enter) their nest upon the tree.

mantras.sanskrit: नि ग्रामासो अविक्षत नि पद्वन्तो नि पक्षिणः । नि श्येनासश्चिदर्थिनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ni grāmāso avikṣata ni padvanto ni pakṣiṇaḥ | ni śyenāsaścidarthinaḥ ||

translations.english: Men have re-entered (their dwellings), and beasts and birds and the swift hawks.

mantras.sanskrit: यावया वृक्यं वृकं यवय स्तेनमूर्म्ये । अथा नः सुतरा भव ॥
mantras.transliteration: yāvayā vṛkyaṃ vṛkaṃ yavaya stenamūrmye | athā naḥ sutarā bhava ||

translations.english: Keep off, O Ūrmya, the she-wolf, keep off the wolf and the robber, and be safely passed by us.

mantras.sanskrit: उप मा पेपिशत्तमः कृष्णं व्यक्तमस्थित । उष ऋणेव यातय ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa mā pepiśattamaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ vyaktamasthita | uṣa ṛṇeva yātaya ||

translations.english: The all-embracing black diffused darkness has approached me, discharge it, Uṣas, as if it were adebt.

mantras.sanskrit: उप ते गा इवाकरं वृणीष्व दुहितर्दिवः । रात्रि स्तोमं न जिग्युषे ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa te gā ivākaraṃ vṛṇīṣva duhitardivaḥ | rātri stomaṃ na jigyuṣe ||

translations.english: I have brought (these verses) before you like kine; accept, O Night, daughter of the sky, (my oblation)as the eulogy of one about to conquer.

mantras.sanskrit: ममाग्ने वर्चो विहवेष्वस्तु वयं त्वेन्धानास्तन्वं पुषेम । मह्यं नमन्तां प्रदिशश्चतस्रस्त्वयाध्यक्षेण पृतना जयेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: mamāgne varco vihaveṣvastu vayaṃ tvendhānāstanvaṃ puṣema | mahyaṃ namantāṃ pradiśaścatasrastvayādhyakṣeṇa pṛtanā jayema ||

translations.english: May glory Agni, be mine in battle, may we, kindling you, cherish your person n, may the (inhabitants ofthe) four quarters bow down before me, may we with you for our leader overcome (hostile) armies.

mantras.sanskrit: मम देवा विहवे सन्तु सर्व इन्द्रवन्तो मरुतो विष्णुरग्निः । ममान्तरिक्षमुरुलोकमस्तु मह्यं वातः पवतां कामे अस्मिन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: mama devā vihave santu sarva indravanto maruto viṣṇuragniḥ | mamāntarikṣamurulokamastu mahyaṃ vātaḥ pavatāṃ kāme asmin ||

translations.english: May all the gods be on my side in battle, the Maruts with Indra, Viṣṇu and Agni; may the expandedfirmament be mine, may the wind blow (propitiously) to this my desire.

mantras.sanskrit: मयि देवा द्रविणमा यजन्तां मय्याशीरस्तु मयि देवहूतिः । दैव्या होतारो वनुषन्त पूर्वेऽरिष्टाः स्याम तन्वा सुवीराः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mayi devā draviṇamā yajantāṃ mayyāśīrastu mayi devahūtiḥ | daivyā hotāro vanuṣanta pūrve'riṣṭāḥ syāma tanvā suvīrāḥ ||

translations.english: May the gods bestow wealth upon me, may (their) blessing be upon me, may the sacrifice in which thegods are invoked be (beneficial) to me, may my invokers of the gods be the first to propitiate them; may we beunharmed in body and blessed with male offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: मह्यं यजन्तु मम यानि हव्याकूतिः सत्या मनसो मे अस्तु । एनो मा नि गां कतमच्चनाहं विश्वे देवासो अधि वोचता नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahyaṃ yajantu mama yāni havyākūtiḥ satyā manaso me astu | eno mā ni gāṃ katamaccanāhaṃ viśve devāso adhi vocatā naḥ ||

translations.english: May (my priests) offer for me whatever oblations of mine (there may be); may the purpose of my mindbe sincere; may I not fall into any kind of sin; universal gods, bless us.

mantras.sanskrit: देवीः षळुर्वीरुरु नः कृणोत विश्वे देवास इह वीरयध्वम् । मा हास्महि प्रजया मा तनूभिर्मा रधाम द्विषते सोम राजन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: devīḥ ṣaḷurvīruru naḥ kṛṇota viśve devāsa iha vīrayadhvam | mā hāsmahi prajayā mā tanūbhirmā radhāma dviṣate soma rājan ||

translations.english: You six mighty goddesses, bestow upon us ample (wealth); universal gods, display prowess here; letus not be bereft of our offspring, or be harmed in our bodies, may we not become subject to our enemy, royalSoma.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने मन्युं प्रतिनुदन्परेषामदब्धो गोपाः परि पाहि नस्त्वम् । प्रत्यञ्चो यन्तु निगुतः पुनस्तेऽमैषां चित्तं प्रबुधां वि नेशत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne manyuṃ pratinudanpareṣāmadabdho gopāḥ pari pāhi nastvam | pratyañco yantu nigutaḥ punaste'maiṣāṃ cittaṃ prabudhāṃ vi neśat ||

translations.english: Agni, who are an invincible protector, do you defend us, baffling the wrath of our enemies; let themreturn grumbling to their homes, may the intelligence of those watchful (foes) be at once destroyed.

mantras.sanskrit: धाता धातॄणां भुवनस्य यस्पतिर्देवं त्रातारमभिमातिषाहम् । इमं यज्ञमश्विनोभा बृहस्पतिर्देवाः पान्तु यजमानं न्यर्थात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhātā dhātṝṇāṃ bhuvanasya yaspatirdevaṃ trātāramabhimātiṣāham | imaṃ yajñamaśvinobhā bṛhaspatirdevāḥ pāntu yajamānaṃ nyarthāt ||

translations.english: The creator of creators, he who is the protector of the universe, (him I praise), the divine defender, thedestroyer of enemies; may the two Aśvins, Bṛhaspati, and the gods, protect this sacrifice, and save the sacrificerfrom disappointment.

mantras.sanskrit: उरुव्यचा नो महिषः शर्म यंसदस्मिन्हवे पुरुहूतः पुरुक्षुः । स नः प्रजायै हर्यश्व मृळयेन्द्र मा नो रीरिषो मा परा दाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uruvyacā no mahiṣaḥ śarma yaṃsadasminhave puruhūtaḥ purukṣuḥ | sa naḥ prajāyai haryaśva mṛḷayendra mā no rīriṣo mā parā dāḥ ||

translations.english: May the omnipresent (Indra), the mighty one, who is invoked by many, and lauded by many, bestow ablessing on this our sacrifice; be gracious to our offspring, Indra, lord of bay horses; harm us not, desert us not.

mantras.sanskrit: ये नः सपत्ना अप ते भवन्त्विन्द्राग्निभ्यामव बाधामहे तान् । वसवो रुद्रा आदित्या उपरिस्पृशं मोग्रं चेत्तारमधिराजमक्रन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye naḥ sapatnā apa te bhavantvindrāgnibhyāmava bādhāmahe tān | vasavo rudrā ādityā uparispṛśaṃ mograṃ cettāramadhirājamakran ||

translations.english: May those who are our foes be driven off; may we through Indra and Agni destroy them; may theVasus, the Rudras, and the Ādityas make me the high- reaching, fierce, intelligent, supreme ruler.

mantras.sanskrit: नासदासीन्नो सदासीत्तदानीं नासीद्रजो नो व्योमा परो यत् । किमावरीवः कुह कस्य शर्मन्नम्भः किमासीद्गहनं गभीरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nāsadāsīnno sadāsīttadānīṃ nāsīdrajo no vyomā paro yat | kimāvarīvaḥ kuha kasya śarmannambhaḥ kimāsīdgahanaṃ gabhīram ||

translations.english: The non-existent was not, the existent was not; then the world was not, not the firmament, nor thatwhich is above (the firmament). How could there by any investing envelope, and where? Of what (could there be)felicity? How (could there be) the deep unfathomable water?

mantras.sanskrit: न मृत्युरासीदमृतं न तर्हि न रात्र्या अह्न आसीत्प्रकेतः । आनीदवातं स्वधया तदेकं तस्माद्धान्यन्न परः किं चनास ॥
mantras.transliteration: na mṛtyurāsīdamṛtaṃ na tarhi na rātryā ahna āsītpraketaḥ | ānīdavātaṃ svadhayā tadekaṃ tasmāddhānyanna paraḥ kiṃ canāsa ||

translations.english: Death was not nor at that period immortality, there was no indication of day, of night; That Oneunbreathed upon breathed of his own strength, other than That there was nothing else whatever.

mantras.sanskrit: तम आसीत्तमसा गूळ्हमग्रेऽप्रकेतं सलिलं सर्वमा इदम् । तुच्छ्येनाभ्वपिहितं यदासीत्तपसस्तन्महिनाजायतैकम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tama āsīttamasā gūḷhamagre'praketaṃ salilaṃ sarvamā idam | tucchyenābhvapihitaṃ yadāsīttapasastanmahinājāyataikam ||

translations.english: There was darkness covered by darkness in the beginning, all this (world) was undistinguishablewater; that empty united (world) which was covered by a mere nothing, was produced through the power ofausterity.

mantras.sanskrit: कामस्तदग्रे समवर्तताधि मनसो रेतः प्रथमं यदासीत् । सतो बन्धुमसति निरविन्दन्हृदि प्रतीष्या कवयो मनीषा ॥
mantras.transliteration: kāmastadagre samavartatādhi manaso retaḥ prathamaṃ yadāsīt | sato bandhumasati niravindanhṛdi pratīṣyā kavayo manīṣā ||

translations.english: In the beginning there was desire, which was the first seed of mind; sages having meditated in theirhearts have discovered by their wisdom the connexion of the existent with te non-existent.

mantras.sanskrit: तिरश्चीनो विततो रश्मिरेषामधः स्विदासी३दुपरि स्विदासी३त् । रेतोधा आसन्महिमान आसन्त्स्वधा अवस्तात्प्रयतिः परस्तात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tiraścīno vitato raśmireṣāmadhaḥ svidāsī3dupari svidāsī3t | retodhā āsanmahimāna āsantsvadhā avastātprayatiḥ parastāt ||

translations.english: Their ray was stretched out, whether across, or below, or above; (some) were shedders of seed,(others) were mighty; food was inferior; the eater was superior.

mantras.sanskrit: को अद्धा वेद क इह प्र वोचत्कुत आजाता कुत इयं विसृष्टिः । अर्वाग्देवा अस्य विसर्जनेनाथा को वेद यत आबभूव ॥
mantras.transliteration: ko addhā veda ka iha pra vocatkuta ājātā kuta iyaṃ visṛṣṭiḥ | arvāgdevā asya visarjanenāthā ko veda yata ābabhūva ||

translations.english: Who really knows? Who in this world may declare it! whence was this creation, whence was itengendered? The gods (were) subsequent to the (world's) creation; so who knows whence it arose?

mantras.sanskrit: इयं विसृष्टिर्यत आबभूव यदि वा दधे यदि वा न । यो अस्याध्यक्षः परमे व्योमन्त्सो अङ्ग वेद यदि वा न वेद ॥
mantras.transliteration: iyaṃ visṛṣṭiryata ābabhūva yadi vā dadhe yadi vā na | yo asyādhyakṣaḥ parame vyomantso aṅga veda yadi vā na veda ||

translations.english: He from whom this creation arose, he may uphold it, or he may not (no one else can); he who is itssuperintendent in the highest heaven, he assuredly knows, or if he knows not (no one else does).

mantras.sanskrit: यो यज्ञो विश्वतस्तन्तुभिस्तत एकशतं देवकर्मेभिरायतः । इमे वयन्ति पितरो य आययुः प्र वयाप वयेत्यासते तते ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo yajño viśvatastantubhistata ekaśataṃ devakarmebhirāyataḥ | ime vayanti pitaro ya āyayuḥ pra vayāpa vayetyāsate tate ||

translations.english: The sacrifice which is extended on every side by the threads (of created things) spread out by theworship of the gods for a hundred and one (years), these our progenitors, who have preceded us, weave it,weaving forwards, weaving backwards, they worship (Prajāpati) when (the world) is woven.

mantras.sanskrit: पुमाँ एनं तनुत उत्कृणत्ति पुमान्वि तत्ने अधि नाके अस्मिन् । इमे मयूखा उप सेदुरू सदः सामानि चक्रुस्तसराण्योतवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pumā~ enaṃ tanuta utkṛṇatti pumānvi tatne adhi nāke asmin | ime mayūkhā upa sedurū sadaḥ sāmāni cakrustasarāṇyotave ||

translations.english: The first man spreads out this (web), the first man rolls it up, he spread it above in this heaven; thesehis rays have sat down on the seat (of sacrifice), they have made the prayers serve as shuttles for weaving.

mantras.sanskrit: कासीत्प्रमा प्रतिमा किं निदानमाज्यं किमासीत्परिधिः क आसीत् । छन्दः किमासीत्प्रौगं किमुक्थं यद्देवा देवमयजन्त विश्वे ॥
mantras.transliteration: kāsītpramā pratimā kiṃ nidānamājyaṃ kimāsītparidhiḥ ka āsīt | chandaḥ kimāsītpraugaṃ kimukthaṃ yaddevā devamayajanta viśve ||

translations.english: What was the authority (of the sacrifice), what was thelimitation, what was the first cause, what wasthe clarified butter, what was the enclosure, what was the metre, what was pra-uga text, when the universal godsoffered worship to the gods?
