mantras.sanskrit: अग्नेर्गायत्र्यभवत्सयुग्वोष्णिहया सविता सं बभूव । अनुष्टुभा सोम उक्थैर्महस्वान्बृहस्पतेर्बृहती वाचमावत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnergāyatryabhavatsayugvoṣṇihayā savitā saṃ babhūva | anuṣṭubhā soma ukthairmahasvānbṛhaspaterbṛhatī vācamāvat ||

translations.english: Gāyatrī became the associate of Agni, Savitā became combined with Uṣṇik, Soma radiant withsacred praises (was united) with Anuṣṭup, Bṛhatī gave efficacy to the words of Bṛhaspati.

mantras.sanskrit: विराण्मित्रावरुणयोरभिश्रीरिन्द्रस्य त्रिष्टुबिह भागो अह्नः । विश्वान्देवाञ्जगत्या विवेश तेन चाकॢप्र ऋषयो मनुष्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: virāṇmitrāvaruṇayorabhiśrīrindrasya triṣṭubiha bhāgo ahnaḥ | viśvāndevāñjagatyā viveśa tena cākḷpra ṛṣayo manuṣyāḥ ||

translations.english: Virāt. was the glory of Mitra and Varuṇa; Triṣṭubh was Indra's portion of the midday (oblation) atand 5 answer the question, what was the metre? Two of the other questions- those relating to the butter (ājya)and the enclosure (paridhi)-- have been answered, in the Puruṣa sūkta, 10.90; cf. Taittirīya Brāhmaṇa3.12.9]. beholding them with the eye of the mind, I glorify those who of old celebrated this sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: चाकॢप्रे तेन ऋषयो मनुष्या यज्ञे जाते पितरो नः पुराणे । पश्यन्मन्ये मनसा चक्षसा तान्य इमं यज्ञमयजन्त पूर्वे ॥
mantras.transliteration: cākḷpre tena ṛṣayo manuṣyā yajñe jāte pitaro naḥ purāṇe | paśyanmanye manasā cakṣasā tānya imaṃ yajñamayajanta pūrve ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: सहस्तोमाः सहछन्दस आवृतः सहप्रमा ऋषयः सप्त दैव्याः । पूर्वेषां पन्थामनुदृश्य धीरा अन्वालेभिरे रथ्यो न रश्मीन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sahastomāḥ sahachandasa āvṛtaḥ sahapramā ṛṣayaḥ sapta daivyāḥ | pūrveṣāṃ panthāmanudṛśya dhīrā anvālebhire rathyo na raśmīn ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: अप प्राच इन्द्र विश्वाँ अमित्रानपापाचो अभिभूते नुदस्व । अपोदीचो अप शूराधराच उरौ यथा तव शर्मन्मदेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: apa prāca indra viśvā~ amitrānapāpāco abhibhūte nudasva | apodīco apa śūrādharāca urau yathā tava śarmanmadema ||

translations.english: Victorious Indra, drive off all our foes, those who dwell in the east, and those who dwell in the west,(drive) off, O hero, those who dwell in the north, and those who dwell in the south, that we may rejoice in yourexceeding felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: कुविदङ्ग यवमन्तो यवं चिद्यथा दान्त्यनुपूर्वं वियूय । इहेहैषां कृणुहि भोजनानि ये बर्हिषो नमोवृक्तिं न जग्मुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: kuvidaṅga yavamanto yavaṃ cidyathā dāntyanupūrvaṃ viyūya | ihehaiṣāṃ kṛṇuhi bhojanāni ye barhiṣo namovṛktiṃ na jagmuḥ ||

translations.english: As the growers of barley often cut the barley, separating it uin due order, so do you, (O Indra), bestowhere and there nourishment upon those who have not neglected the performance of the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: नहि स्थूर्यृतुथा यातमस्ति नोत श्रवो विविदे संगमेषु । गव्यन्त इन्द्रं सख्याय विप्रा अश्वायन्तो वृषणं वाजयन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahi sthūryṛtuthā yātamasti nota śravo vivide saṃgameṣu | gavyanta indraṃ sakhyāya viprā aśvāyanto vṛṣaṇaṃ vājayantaḥ ||

translations.english: The cart has not arrived in due season, nor does he acquire fame in battles, (let us), the sages,desiring cattle, desiring horses, desiring food, (solicit) Indra, the showerer, for his friendship.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं सुराममश्विना नमुचावासुरे सचा । विपिपाना शुभस्पती इन्द्रं कर्मस्वावतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ surāmamaśvinā namucāvāsure sacā | vipipānā śubhaspatī indraṃ karmasvāvatam ||

translations.english: You, O Aśvins, lords of light, having drunk the grateful (libation), jointly preserved Indra in battleagainst the Asura Namuci.

mantras.sanskrit: पुत्रमिव पितरावश्विनोभेन्द्रावथुः काव्यैर्दंसनाभिः । यत्सुरामं व्यपिबः शचीभिः सरस्वती त्वा मघवन्नभिष्णक् ॥
mantras.transliteration: putramiva pitarāvaśvinobhendrāvathuḥ kāvyairdaṃsanābhiḥ | yatsurāmaṃ vyapibaḥ śacībhiḥ sarasvatī tvā maghavannabhiṣṇak ||

translations.english: Both the Aśvins defended (you), Indra, like two fathers (defending) a son with glorious exploits; when(triumphing) through the deeds of valour, you drank the grateful libation, Sarasvatī approached you, OMaghavat.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रः सुत्रामा स्ववाँ अवोभिः सुमृळीको भवतु विश्ववेदाः । बाधतां द्वेषो अभयं कृणोतु सुवीर्यस्य पतयः स्याम ॥
mantras.transliteration: indraḥ sutrāmā svavā~ avobhiḥ sumṛḷīko bhavatu viśvavedāḥ | bādhatāṃ dveṣo abhayaṃ kṛṇotu suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma ||

translations.english: May Indra, the protector, the possessor of treat wealth, the all- knowing, be favourable (to us) with hisprotections; may he confound our enemies, may he make us free from fear, may we be the parents of excellentmale offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: तस्य वयं सुमतौ यज्ञियस्यापि भद्रे सौमनसे स्याम । स सुत्रामा स्ववाँ इन्द्रो अस्मे आराच्चिद्द्वेषः सनुतर्युयोतु ॥
mantras.transliteration: tasya vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyasyāpi bhadre saumanase syāma | sa sutrāmā svavā~ indro asme ārācciddveṣaḥ sanutaryuyotu ||

translations.english: May we be ever in (the enjoyment of) the favour of that adorable divinity (retained) in his favourablethoughts, and may the protecting and opulent Indra drive away far off us those who hate us.

mantras.sanskrit: ईजानमिद्द्यौर्गूर्तावसुरीजानं भूमिरभि प्रभूषणि । ईजानं देवावश्विनावभि सुम्नैरवर्धताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ījānamiddyaurgūrtāvasurījānaṃ bhūmirabhi prabhūṣaṇi | ījānaṃ devāvaśvināvabhi sumnairavardhatām ||

translations.english: The Heaven liberal of treasure (prospers) the sacrificer, the Earth (prospers) the sacrificer because ofthe ornament, the divine Aśvins prospered the sacrificer with blessings.

mantras.sanskrit: ता वां मित्रावरुणा धारयत्क्षिती सुषुम्नेषितत्वता यजामसि । युवोः क्राणाय सख्यैरभि ष्याम रक्षसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tā vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā dhārayatkṣitī suṣumneṣitatvatā yajāmasi | yuvoḥ krāṇāya sakhyairabhi ṣyāma rakṣasaḥ ||

translations.english: Mitra and Varuṇa, who sustain the earth, we worship you, the givers of felicity, for the sake ofattaining our desires; may we, through your favour for the performer (of the sacrifice), overcome the rākṣasas.

mantras.sanskrit: अधा चिन्नु यद्दिधिषामहे वामभि प्रियं रेक्णः पत्यमानाः । दद्वाँ वा यत्पुष्यति रेक्णः सम्वारन्नकिरस्य मघानि ॥
mantras.transliteration: adhā cinnu yaddidhiṣāmahe vāmabhi priyaṃ rekṇaḥ patyamānāḥ | dadvā~ vā yatpuṣyati rekṇaḥ samvārannakirasya maghāni ||

translations.english: May we, when we present to you (oblations), quickly alight upon desirable wealth, and the genitive rousman who fosters his wealth, may his riches not depart from him.

mantras.sanskrit: असावन्यो असुर सूयत द्यौस्त्वं विश्वेषां वरुणासि राजा । मूर्धा रथस्य चाकन्नैतावतैनसान्तकध्रुक् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asāvanyo asura sūyata dyaustvaṃ viśveṣāṃ varuṇāsi rājā | mūrdhā rathasya cākannaitāvatainasāntakadhruk ||

translations.english: (Mitra), scatterer of darkness, the Heaven gave birth to you the other; you, Varuṇa, are sovereignover all. The head of (your) chariot desired (this sacrifice); opposing the destroyer, (the rite) is not (vitiated) bythe smallest defect.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मिन्त्स्वेतच्छकपूत एनो हिते मित्रे निगतान्हन्ति वीरान् । अवोर्वा यद्धात्तनूष्ववः प्रियासु यज्ञियास्वर्वा ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmintsvetacchakapūta eno hite mitre nigatānhanti vīrān | avorvā yaddhāttanūṣvavaḥ priyāsu yajñiyāsvarvā ||

translations.english: This iniquity (found) in this Śakapūta, when Mitra is propitious, destroys opposing heroes, when thei.e., Mitra or Varuṇa; avaḥ = food; when the approaching Mitra (or Varuṇa) gives protection to the sacrificial ritesand bodies of the worshipper who delights him with oblations].

mantras.sanskrit: युवोर्हि मातादितिर्विचेतसा द्यौर्न भूमिः पयसा पुपूतनि । अव प्रिया दिदिष्टन सूरो निनिक्त रश्मिभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvorhi mātāditirvicetasā dyaurna bhūmiḥ payasā pupūtani | ava priyā didiṣṭana sūro ninikta raśmibhiḥ ||

translations.english: O (Mitra and Varuṇa), endowed with various wisdom, your mother Aditi, the earth, (is) for thepurification (of all things) by its libations, as the heaven (purifies by its rain); you display before us precious(treasures), and wash us with the sun's rays.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं ह्यप्नराजावसीदतं तिष्ठद्रथं न धूर्षदं वनर्षदम् । ता नः कणूकयन्तीर्नृमेधस्तत्रे अंहसः सुमेधस्तत्रे अंहसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ hyapnarājāvasīdataṃ tiṣṭhadrathaṃ na dhūrṣadaṃ vanarṣadam | tā naḥ kaṇūkayantīrnṛmedhastatre aṃhasaḥ sumedhastatre aṃhasaḥ ||

translations.english: For you, brilliant through your functions, have sat down; now mount, (each of you, his) chariot, whichrests on the yoke, which abides in the forests, (to overcome) those (people) who clamour against us; Nṛmedhawas preserved (by you) from sin, the pious worshipper was preserved from sin.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रो ष्वस्मै पुरोरथमिन्द्राय शूषमर्चत । अभीके चिदु लोककृत्संगे समत्सु वृत्रहास्माकं बोधि चोदिता नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु ॥
mantras.transliteration: pro ṣvasmai purorathamindrāya śūṣamarcata | abhīke cidu lokakṛtsaṃge samatsu vṛtrahāsmākaṃ bodhi coditā nabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu ||

translations.english: Adore fervently the might of that Indra which goes before his chariot; he who makes room for us in the(the adoration paid by us); may the bowstrings on the bows of our enemies be destroyed.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं सिन्धूँरवासृजोऽधराचो अहन्नहिम् । अशत्रुरिन्द्र जज्ञिषे विश्वं पुष्यसि वार्यं तं त्वा परि ष्वजामहे नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ sindhū~ravāsṛjo'dharāco ahannahim | aśatrurindra jajñiṣe viśvaṃ puṣyasi vāryaṃ taṃ tvā pari ṣvajāmahe nabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu ||

translations.english: You have sent the rivers away downwards, you have slain Ahi; you are born, Indra, without an enemy,you grant all that is desirable, as such we embrace you; may the bowstrings on the bows of our enemies bedestroyed.

mantras.sanskrit: वि षु विश्वा अरातयोऽर्यो नशन्त नो धियः । अस्तासि शत्रवे वधं यो न इन्द्र जिघांसति या ते रातिर्ददिर्वसु नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi ṣu viśvā arātayo'ryo naśanta no dhiyaḥ | astāsi śatrave vadhaṃ yo na indra jighāṃsati yā te rātirdadirvasu nabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu ||

translations.english: May all our assailants, who make no offerings, quickly perish, may our praises (be successful); you,Indra, hurl the weapon at the foe who seeks to slay us, may that liberal (hand) of yours be the giver of wealth (tous); may the bowstrings on the bows of our enemies be destroyed.

mantras.sanskrit: यो न इन्द्राभितो जनो वृकायुरादिदेशति । अधस्पदं तमीं कृधि विबाधो असि सासहिर्नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo na indrābhito jano vṛkāyurādideśati | adhaspadaṃ tamīṃ kṛdhi vibādho asi sāsahirnabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu ||

translations.english: The man who, like a wolf, prowls around us, O Indra, cast him beneath our feet, for you are theresister, the overcomer (of foes); may the bowstrings on the bows of our enemies be destroyed.

mantras.sanskrit: यो न इन्द्राभिदासति सनाभिर्यश्च निष्ट्यः । अव तस्य बलं तिर महीव द्यौरध त्मना नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo na indrābhidāsati sanābhiryaśca niṣṭyaḥ | ava tasya balaṃ tira mahīva dyauradha tmanā nabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu ||

translations.english: He who assails us, Indra, whether he be of the same caste or of degraded caste-- scatter of yourselfhis host, (though it be vast) as the wide heaven; may the bowstrings on the bows of our enemies be destroyed.

mantras.sanskrit: वयमिन्द्र त्वायवः सखित्वमा रभामहे । ऋतस्य नः पथा नयाति विश्वानि दुरिता नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु ॥
mantras.transliteration: vayamindra tvāyavaḥ sakhitvamā rabhāmahe | ṛtasya naḥ pathā nayāti viśvāni duritā nabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu ||

translations.english: Devoted to you, Indra, we strive after your friendship; lea\d us by the path of sacrifice beyond all evils;may the bowstrings on the bows of our enemies be destroyed.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्मभ्यं सु त्वमिन्द्र तां शिक्ष या दोहते प्रति वरं जरित्रे । अच्छिद्रोध्नी पीपयद्यथा नः सहस्रधारा पयसा मही गौः ॥
mantras.transliteration: asmabhyaṃ su tvamindra tāṃ śikṣa yā dohate prati varaṃ jaritre | acchidrodhnī pīpayadyathā naḥ sahasradhārā payasā mahī gauḥ ||

translations.english: Give to us, Indra, (the cow) who gives milk to the worshipper according to his desire, so that themighty cow, possessed of an unfailing udder, the shedder of a thousand streams, may supply us plural ntifully withmilk.

mantras.sanskrit: उभे यदिन्द्र रोदसी आपप्राथोषा इव । महान्तं त्वा महीनां सम्राजं चर्षणीनां देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ubhe yadindra rodasī āpaprāthoṣā iva | mahāntaṃ tvā mahīnāṃ samrājaṃ carṣaṇīnāṃ devī janitryajījanadbhadrā janitryajījanat ||

translations.english: You, Indra, who will both heaven and earth (with light) like the dawn- - the divine progenitress hasgiven birth to you, the mighty (gods), the sovereign of man; the auspicious progenitress has given you birth.

mantras.sanskrit: अव स्म दुर्हणायतो मर्तस्य तनुहि स्थिरम् । अधस्पदं तमीं कृधि यो अस्माँ आदिदेशति देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ava sma durhaṇāyato martasya tanuhi sthiram | adhaspadaṃ tamīṃ kṛdhi yo asmā~ ādideśati devī janitryajījanadbhadrā janitryajījanat ||

translations.english: Enfeeble the strength of the malicious man, cast under foot him who tries to kill us; the divineprogenitress has given you birth, the auspicious progenitress has given you birth.

mantras.sanskrit: अव त्या बृहतीरिषो विश्वश्चन्द्रा अमित्रहन् । शचीभिः शक्र धूनुहीन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिर्देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ava tyā bṛhatīriṣo viśvaścandrā amitrahan | śacībhiḥ śakra dhūnuhīndra viśvābhirūtibhirdevī janitryajījanadbhadrā janitryajījanat ||

translations.english: Destroyer of enemies, Indra, Śakra, shake down upon us by your exploits those abundant, all-shiningviands, (accompanied) with all your protections; the divine progenitress has given you birth, the auspiciousprogrenitress has given you birth.

mantras.sanskrit: अव यत्त्वं शतक्रतविन्द्र विश्वानि धूनुषे । रयिं न सुन्वते सचा सहस्रिणीभिरूतिभिर्देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ava yattvaṃ śatakratavindra viśvāni dhūnuṣe | rayiṃ na sunvate sacā sahasriṇībhirūtibhirdevī janitryajījanadbhadrā janitryajījanat ||

translations.english: When you, Indra, Śatakratu, shake down (upon us) all blessings, (then bestow) upon the offerer of thelibation wealth also, together with your thousandfold protections; the divine progenitress has given you birth, theauspicious progrenitress has given you birth.

mantras.sanskrit: अव स्वेदा इवाभितो विष्वक्पतन्तु दिद्यवः । दूर्वाया इव तन्तवो व्यस्मदेतु दुर्मतिर्देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ava svedā ivābhito viṣvakpatantu didyavaḥ | dūrvāyā iva tantavo vyasmadetu durmatirdevī janitryajījanadbhadrā janitryajījanat ||

translations.english: Let your radiant (weapons) fall down everywhere round about like drops of person iration; let the enemydepart from us like the stems of the dūrva grass; the divine progenitress has given you birth, the auspiciousprogrenitress has given you birth.

mantras.sanskrit: दीर्घं ह्यङ्कुशं यथा शक्तिं बिभर्षि मन्तुमः । पूर्वेण मघवन्पदाजो वयां यथा यमो देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dīrghaṃ hyaṅkuśaṃ yathā śaktiṃ bibharṣi mantumaḥ | pūrveṇa maghavanpadājo vayāṃ yathā yamo devī janitryajījanadbhadrā janitryajījanat ||

translations.english: For you, sapient (Indra), wield your might like a long hook; you drag (your foes), Maghavan, as a goatwith its fore-foot (drags) a branch; the divine progenitress has given you birth, the auspicious progrenitress hasgiven you birth.

mantras.sanskrit: नकिर्देवा मिनीमसि नकिरा योपयामसि मन्त्रश्रुत्यं चरामसि । पक्षेभिरपिकक्षेभिरत्राभि सं रभामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: nakirdevā minīmasi nakirā yopayāmasi mantraśrutyaṃ carāmasi | pakṣebhirapikakṣebhiratrābhi saṃ rabhāmahe ||

translations.english: O gods, we never injure (you), we never inflict annoyance (on you), we follow the teaching of themantra; we take hold of you at this (sacrifice) with wings and arms.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्मिन्वृक्षे सुपलाशे देवैः सम्पिबते यमः । अत्रा नो विश्पतिः पिता पुराणाँ अनु वेनति ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasminvṛkṣe supalāśe devaiḥ sampibate yamaḥ | atrā no viśpatiḥ pitā purāṇā~ anu venati ||

translations.english: In that leafy tree where Yama drinks with the gods, there the progenitor, the lord of the house, invitesus to join themen of old.

mantras.sanskrit: पुराणाँ अनुवेनन्तं चरन्तं पापयामुया । असूयन्नभ्यचाकशं तस्मा अस्पृहयं पुनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: purāṇā~ anuvenantaṃ carantaṃ pāpayāmuyā | asūyannabhyacākaśaṃ tasmā aspṛhayaṃ punaḥ ||

translations.english: (At first) I beheld him with anguish inviting me to join the men of olden times, and walking with that felldesign; but afterwards I longed for him.

mantras.sanskrit: यं कुमार नवं रथमचक्रं मनसाकृणोः । एकेषं विश्वतः प्राञ्चमपश्यन्नधि तिष्ठसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ kumāra navaṃ rathamacakraṃ manasākṛṇoḥ | ekeṣaṃ viśvataḥ prāñcamapaśyannadhi tiṣṭhasi ||

translations.english: The new chariot, wheelless, single-poled, but turning everywhere, which you, my child, mentallyformed-- you stand thereon though you see it not.

mantras.sanskrit: यं कुमार प्रावर्तयो रथं विप्रेभ्यस्परि । तं सामानु प्रावर्तत समितो नाव्याहितम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ kumāra prāvartayo rathaṃ viprebhyaspari | taṃ sāmānu prāvartata samito nāvyāhitam ||

translations.english: The chariot which you, my child, have driven down to me from the sages above, the Sāman hasdriven it back again from hence plural ced on a ship. made?

mantras.sanskrit: कः कुमारमजनयद्रथं को निरवर्तयत् । कः स्वित्तदद्य नो ब्रूयादनुदेयी यथाभवत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: kaḥ kumāramajanayadrathaṃ ko niravartayat | kaḥ svittadadya no brūyādanudeyī yathābhavat ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: यथाभवदनुदेयी ततो अग्रमजायत । पुरस्ताद्बुध्न आततः पश्चान्निरयणं कृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathābhavadanudeyī tato agramajāyata | purastādbudhna ātataḥ paścānnirayaṇaṃ kṛtam ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: इदं यमस्य सादनं देवमानं यदुच्यते । इयमस्य धम्यते नाळीरयं गीर्भिः परिष्कृतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: idaṃ yamasya sādanaṃ devamānaṃ yaducyate | iyamasya dhamyate nāḷīrayaṃ gīrbhiḥ pariṣkṛtaḥ ||

translations.english: This is the dwelling of Yama, which is called the fabric of the gods; this pipe is sounded for his(gratification), he is propitiated by hymns.

mantras.sanskrit: केश्यग्निं केशी विषं केशी बिभर्ति रोदसी । केशी विश्वं स्वर्दृशे केशीदं ज्योतिरुच्यते ॥
mantras.transliteration: keśyagniṃ keśī viṣaṃ keśī bibharti rodasī | keśī viśvaṃ svardṛśe keśīdaṃ jyotirucyate ||

translations.english: The radiant (Sun supports) Agni, the radiant one (supports) water, the radiant one supports theheaven and earth, the radiant one is for the visibility of the whole diffused (universe)-- this light is called theradiant one.

mantras.sanskrit: मुनयो वातरशनाः पिशङ्गा वसते मला । वातस्यानु ध्राजिं यन्ति यद्देवासो अविक्षत ॥
mantras.transliteration: munayo vātaraśanāḥ piśaṅgā vasate malā | vātasyānu dhrājiṃ yanti yaddevāso avikṣata ||

translations.english: The Munis, the sons of Vātaraśana, wear the yellow dirty (vestments of bark), they follow the courseof the wind, when they have assumed the (power of) gods.

mantras.sanskrit: उन्मदिता मौनेयेन वाताँ आ तस्थिमा वयम् । शरीरेदस्माकं यूयं मर्तासो अभि पश्यथ ॥
mantras.transliteration: unmaditā mauneyena vātā~ ā tasthimā vayam | śarīredasmākaṃ yūyaṃ martāso abhi paśyatha ||

translations.english: Exhilarated by the sanctity of the Muni we have mounted upon the winds; behold, mortals, (in them)our forms!

mantras.sanskrit: अन्तरिक्षेण पतति विश्वा रूपावचाकशत् । मुनिर्देवस्यदेवस्य सौकृत्याय सखा हितः ॥
mantras.transliteration: antarikṣeṇa patati viśvā rūpāvacākaśat | munirdevasyadevasya saukṛtyāya sakhā hitaḥ ||

translations.english: The Muni flies through the firmament, illumining all objects, the friend of each deity, appointed forpious works.

mantras.sanskrit: वातस्याश्वो वायोः सखाथो देवेषितो मुनिः । उभौ समुद्रावा क्षेति यश्च पूर्व उतापरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vātasyāśvo vāyoḥ sakhātho deveṣito muniḥ | ubhau samudrāvā kṣeti yaśca pūrva utāparaḥ ||

translations.english: The steed of the wind, the friend of Vāyu, the Muni, who is instrumental gated by the deity, repairs to bothoceans, the eastern and the western.

mantras.sanskrit: अप्सरसां गन्धर्वाणां मृगाणां चरणे चरन् । केशी केतस्य विद्वान्त्सखा स्वादुर्मदिन्तमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: apsarasāṃ gandharvāṇāṃ mṛgāṇāṃ caraṇe caran | keśī ketasya vidvāntsakhā svādurmadintamaḥ ||

translations.english: Wandering in the track of the Apsarasas and the Gandharvas, and the wild beasts, the radiant (Sun),cognizant of all that is knowable, (is my) sweet and most delightful friend.

mantras.sanskrit: वायुरस्मा उपामन्थत्पिनष्टि स्मा कुनन्नमा । केशी विषस्य पात्रेण यद्रुद्रेणापिबत्सह ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāyurasmā upāmanthatpinaṣṭi smā kunannamā | keśī viṣasya pātreṇa yadrudreṇāpibatsaha ||

translations.english: Vāyu churned for him, the inflexible (thunder) ground it when the radiant (Sun), along with Rudra,drank the water with his cup.

mantras.sanskrit: उत देवा अवहितं देवा उन्नयथा पुनः । उतागश्चक्रुषं देवा देवा जीवयथा पुनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta devā avahitaṃ devā unnayathā punaḥ | utāgaścakruṣaṃ devā devā jīvayathā punaḥ ||

translations.english: O gods, raise again the man, O gods, who has sunk; O gods, give life again to the man, O gods, who

mantras.sanskrit: द्वाविमौ वातौ वात आ सिन्धोरा परावतः । दक्षं ते अन्य आ वातु परान्यो वातु यद्रपः ॥
mantras.transliteration: dvāvimau vātau vāta ā sindhorā parāvataḥ | dakṣaṃ te anya ā vātu parānyo vātu yadrapaḥ ||

translations.english: These two winds blow to the regions which are far beyond the ocean; may the one bring you vigour,may the other blow away all evil.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वात वाहि भेषजं वि वात वाहि यद्रपः । त्वं हि विश्वभेषजो देवानां दूत ईयसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāta vāhi bheṣajaṃ vi vāta vāhi yadrapaḥ | tvaṃ hi viśvabheṣajo devānāṃ dūta īyase ||

translations.english: Breathe, wind, medicinal balm; blow away, wind, all evil; for you are the universal medicine, you moveas the messenger of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: आ त्वागमं शंतातिभिरथो अरिष्टतातिभिः । दक्षं ते भद्रमाभार्षं परा यक्ष्मं सुवामि ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tvāgamaṃ śaṃtātibhiratho ariṣṭatātibhiḥ | dakṣaṃ te bhadramābhārṣaṃ parā yakṣmaṃ suvāmi te ||

translations.english: (The wind speaks). I have come to you with plural asures and with protections; I have brought youfortunate vigour, I drive away your disease.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रायन्तामिह देवास्त्रायतां मरुतां गणः । त्रायन्तां विश्वा भूतानि यथायमरपा असत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: trāyantāmiha devāstrāyatāṃ marutāṃ gaṇaḥ | trāyantāṃ viśvā bhūtāni yathāyamarapā asat ||

translations.english: May the gods give (us) protection in this world, may the company of the Maruts protect us, may allbeings grant protection so that this (person n) may be free from sin.

mantras.sanskrit: आप इद्वा उ भेषजीरापो अमीवचातनीः । आपः सर्वस्य भेषजीस्तास्ते कृण्वन्तु भेषजम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: āpa idvā u bheṣajīrāpo amīvacātanīḥ | āpaḥ sarvasya bheṣajīstāste kṛṇvantu bheṣajam ||

translations.english: Waters verily are medicinal; waters are the dissipators of disease; waters are the medicines foreverything; may they act as medicine to you.

mantras.sanskrit: हस्ताभ्यां दशशाखाभ्यां जिह्वा वाचः पुरोगवी । अनामयित्नुभ्यां त्वा ताभ्यां त्वोप स्पृशामसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: hastābhyāṃ daśaśākhābhyāṃ jihvā vācaḥ purogavī | anāmayitnubhyāṃ tvā tābhyāṃ tvopa spṛśāmasi ||

translations.english: The tongue (being cleansed) by the ten-branched hands (of Prajāpati is) the forerunner of speech;with those (hands) the removers of disease we touch you.

mantras.sanskrit: तव त्य इन्द्र सख्येषु वह्नय ऋतं मन्वाना व्यदर्दिरुर्वलम् । यत्रा दशस्यन्नुषसो रिणन्नपः कुत्साय मन्मन्नह्यश्च दंसयः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tava tya indra sakhyeṣu vahnaya ṛtaṃ manvānā vyadardirurvalam | yatrā daśasyannuṣaso riṇannapaḥ kutsāya manmannahyaśca daṃsayaḥ ||

translations.english: The bearers of oblations (the Aṅgirasas), Indra honouring the sacrifice, have through your friendshiptorn Vala to pieces, when praise (being offered) desiring to give the dawns to Kutsa (you were engaged in)freeing the waters, and Ahi's exploits (were foiled).

mantras.sanskrit: अवासृजः प्रस्वः श्वञ्चयो गिरीनुदाज उस्रा अपिबो मधु प्रियम् । अवर्धयो वनिनो अस्य दंससा शुशोच सूर्य ऋतजातया गिरा ॥
mantras.transliteration: avāsṛjaḥ prasvaḥ śvañcayo girīnudāja usrā apibo madhu priyam | avardhayo vanino asya daṃsasā śuśoca sūrya ṛtajātayā girā ||

translations.english: You have sent forth the genitive rative (waters), you have cleft the mountains, you have fetched forth thecows, you have quaffed the delicious Soma, you have caused the trees of the forest to grow; through his exploitsby means of the voice produced for the sacrifice the sun has shone bright.

mantras.sanskrit: वि सूर्यो मध्ये अमुचद्रथं दिवो विदद्दासाय प्रतिमानमार्यः । दृळ्हानि पिप्रोरसुरस्य मायिन इन्द्रो व्यास्यच्चकृवाँ ऋजिश्वना ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi sūryo madhye amucadrathaṃ divo vidaddāsāya pratimānamāryaḥ | dṛḷhāni piprorasurasya māyina indro vyāsyaccakṛvā~ ṛjiśvanā ||

translations.english: The sun unyoked his chariot in the midst of the sky, (when) the Ārya (Indra) encountered the Dāsaassociated with Ṛjiśvan, Indra destroyed the stronghold of the guileful asura, Pipru.

mantras.sanskrit: अनाधृष्टानि धृषितो व्यास्यन्निधीँरदेवाँ अमृणदयास्यः । मासेव सूर्यो वसु पुर्यमा ददे गृणानः शत्रूँरशृणाद्विरुक्मता ॥
mantras.transliteration: anādhṛṣṭāni dhṛṣito vyāsyannidhī~radevā~ amṛṇadayāsyaḥ | māseva sūryo vasu puryamā dade gṛṇānaḥ śatrū~raśṛṇādvirukmatā ||

translations.english: Bold (Indra) has annihilated the (hitherto) unbaffled (hosts of the asura), the objects of Ayasya'sadoration has despoiled the impious of their treasures; the sun as if with the (aid of the) moon has seized uponthe wealth of the cities (of the asuras), glorified (by his worshippers), he has demolished the foe with his blazing(thunderbolt).

mantras.sanskrit: अयुद्धसेनो विभ्वा विभिन्दता दाशद्वृत्रहा तुज्यानि तेजते । इन्द्रस्य वज्रादबिभेदभिश्नथः प्राक्रामच्छुन्ध्यूरजहादुषा अनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayuddhaseno vibhvā vibhindatā dāśadvṛtrahā tujyāni tejate | indrasya vajrādabibhedabhiśnathaḥ prākrāmacchundhyūrajahāduṣā anaḥ ||

translations.english: (Indra), leading an irresistible army, slaying Vṛtra with the pervading piercing (bolt), gives (wealth tohis worshippers), thins the (hosts of the asuras) which have to be attacked; (the whole host of the enemy) wasafraid of Indra's wide-destroying thunderbolt, the purifying (sun) came forth, Uṣas left her cart.

mantras.sanskrit: एता त्या ते श्रुत्यानि केवला यदेक एकमकृणोरयज्ञम् । मासां विधानमदधा अधि द्यवि त्वया विभिन्नं भरति प्रधिं पिता ॥
mantras.transliteration: etā tyā te śrutyāni kevalā yadeka ekamakṛṇorayajñam | māsāṃ vidhānamadadhā adhi dyavi tvayā vibhinnaṃ bharati pradhiṃ pitā ||

translations.english: These wondrous exploits are yours alone, in that you unaided have injured the chief neglector ofsacrifice; you have plural ced in the sky the regulator of the months through your aid the paternal (heaven) upholdsthe circumference of the wheel (of the Sun's car) which has been shattered (by Vṛtra).

mantras.sanskrit: सूर्यरश्मिर्हरिकेशः पुरस्तात्सविता ज्योतिरुदयाँ अजस्रम् । तस्य पूषा प्रसवे याति विद्वान्त्सम्पश्यन्विश्वा भुवनानि गोपाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sūryaraśmirharikeśaḥ purastātsavitā jyotirudayā~ ajasram | tasya pūṣā prasave yāti vidvāntsampaśyanviśvā bhuvanāni gopāḥ ||

translations.english: Savitā, the solar-rayed, the yellow-haired, sent up the undying light from the east; at his commandthe wise Pūṣan, the preserver, follows, looking upon all creatures.

mantras.sanskrit: नृचक्षा एष दिवो मध्य आस्त आपप्रिवान्रोदसी अन्तरिक्षम् । स विश्वाचीरभि चष्टे घृताचीरन्तरा पूर्वमपरं च केतुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: nṛcakṣā eṣa divo madhya āsta āpaprivānrodasī antarikṣam | sa viśvācīrabhi caṣṭe ghṛtācīrantarā pūrvamaparaṃ ca ketum ||

translations.english: Beholding mankind he sits in the midst of the sky, filling (with light) the heaven and earth and thefirmament; he illumines the all-pervading (quarters of space), the bright-pervading (intermediate points), and thehindmost, the foremost, and the hindmost mark.

mantras.sanskrit: रायो बुध्नः संगमनो वसूनां विश्वा रूपाभि चष्टे शचीभिः । देव इव सविता सत्यधर्मेन्द्रो न तस्थौ समरे धनानाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: rāyo budhnaḥ saṃgamano vasūnāṃ viśvā rūpābhi caṣṭe śacībhiḥ | deva iva savitā satyadharmendro na tasthau samare dhanānām ||

translations.english: The root of riches, the acquirer of treasure illumines by his functions all (visible) forms; Savitā, like agod, whose attribute is truth, stands like Indra in the battle for riches.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वावसुं सोम गन्धर्वमापो ददृशुषीस्तदृतेना व्यायन् । तदन्ववैदिन्द्रो रारहाण आसां परि सूर्यस्य परिधीँरपश्यत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvāvasuṃ soma gandharvamāpo dadṛśuṣīstadṛtenā vyāyan | tadanvavaidindro rārahāṇa āsāṃ pari sūryasya paridhī~rapaśyat ||

translations.english: Beholding Soma, the Gandharva Viśvāvasu, the waters have come forth by means of the sacrifice;Indra impelling them knew of this (their approach), and looked round the rims of the sun.

mantras.sanskrit: विश्वावसुरभि तन्नो गृणातु दिव्यो गन्धर्वो रजसो विमानः । यद्वा घा सत्यमुत यन्न विद्म धियो हिन्वानो धिय इन्नो अव्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: viśvāvasurabhi tanno gṛṇātu divyo gandharvo rajaso vimānaḥ | yadvā ghā satyamuta yanna vidma dhiyo hinvāno dhiya inno avyāḥ ||

translations.english: May the celestial Gandharva Viśvāvasu, the measurer of the water, declare to us that which is thetruth, and that which we do not know; accepting our praises. (Viśvāvasu), protect our sacrifices.

mantras.sanskrit: सस्निमविन्दच्चरणे नदीनामपावृणोद्दुरो अश्मव्रजानाम् । प्रासां गन्धर्वो अमृतानि वोचदिन्द्रो दक्षं परि जानादहीनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sasnimavindaccaraṇe nadīnāmapāvṛṇodduro aśmavrajānām | prāsāṃ gandharvo amṛtāni vocadindro dakṣaṃ pari jānādahīnām ||

translations.english: (Indra) discovered the cloud in the region of the rivers, he set open the portals of (the waters) whosedwelling is in the clouds; Indra, (in the form of) the Gandharva (viśvāvasu), proclaimed the ambrosial (waters),he knew the strength of the dragons.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने तव श्रवो वयो महि भ्राजन्ते अर्चयो विभावसो । बृहद्भानो शवसा वाजमुक्थ्यं दधासि दाशुषे कवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne tava śravo vayo mahi bhrājante arcayo vibhāvaso | bṛhadbhāno śavasā vājamukthyaṃ dadhāsi dāśuṣe kave ||

translations.english: Your, Agni, is the most excellent sacrificial food; your flames, O opulent in radiance, blaze fiercely;wise and widely luminous (Agni), you bestow upon the donor (of the oblation) the choicest food with strength.

mantras.sanskrit: पावकवर्चाः शुक्रवर्चा अनूनवर्चा उदियर्षि भानुना । पुत्रो मातरा विचरन्नुपावसि पृणक्षि रोदसी उभे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pāvakavarcāḥ śukravarcā anūnavarcā udiyarṣi bhānunā | putro mātarā vicarannupāvasi pṛṇakṣi rodasī ubhe ||

translations.english: Agni, who are of purifying radiance, of unsullied lustre, of full brightness, you issue forth withsplendour; visiting your parents (like) a son, you protect (the worshippers), you unite both heaven and earth.

mantras.sanskrit: ऊर्जो नपाज्जातवेदः सुशस्तिभिर्मन्दस्व धीतिभिर्हितः । त्वे इषः सं दधुर्भूरिवर्पसश्चित्रोतयो वामजाताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūrjo napājjātavedaḥ suśastibhirmandasva dhītibhirhitaḥ | tve iṣaḥ saṃ dadhurbhūrivarpasaścitrotayo vāmajātāḥ ||

translations.english: Son of strength, Jātavedas, rejoice in our adorations, (be) satisfied by our offerings, (theworshippers) have plural ced before you viands of many sorts of wonderful efficacy, of excellent origin. {Son ofstrength: ūrjo napāt = grandson of waters; or, non-injurer; or, food].

mantras.sanskrit: इरज्यन्नग्ने प्रथयस्व जन्तुभिरस्मे रायो अमर्त्य । स दर्शतस्य वपुषो वि राजसि पृणक्षि सानसिं क्रतुम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: irajyannagne prathayasva jantubhirasme rāyo amartya | sa darśatasya vapuṣo vi rājasi pṛṇakṣi sānasiṃ kratum ||

translations.english: Contending with enemies, bestow upon us, immortal Agni, riches; you shine with a graceful person n,you fulfil (the purpose of) the enjoyable rite.

mantras.sanskrit: इष्कर्तारमध्वरस्य प्रचेतसं क्षयन्तं राधसो महः । रातिं वामस्य सुभगां महीमिषं दधासि सानसिं रयिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: iṣkartāramadhvarasya pracetasaṃ kṣayantaṃ rādhaso mahaḥ | rātiṃ vāmasya subhagāṃ mahīmiṣaṃ dadhāsi sānasiṃ rayim ||

translations.english: (We praise you), the perfecter of the sacrifice, the sage, the lord of great wealth, the giver of what isdesirable; you bestow auspicious and abundant food, and enjoyable riches.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतावानं महिषं विश्वदर्शतमग्निं सुम्नाय दधिरे पुरो जनाः । श्रुत्कर्णं सप्रथस्तमं त्वा गिरा दैव्यं मानुषा युगा ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtāvānaṃ mahiṣaṃ viśvadarśatamagniṃ sumnāya dadhire puro janāḥ | śrutkarṇaṃ saprathastamaṃ tvā girā daivyaṃ mānuṣā yugā ||

translations.english: Men for the sake of happiness plural ce before them Agni, the speaker of truth, the mighty, thecontemplator of all; the posterity of Manu in pairs (propitiate) with praises you, whose ears are open (to praises)who are most renowned, and the (minister) of the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने अच्छा वदेह नः प्रत्यङ्नः सुमना भव । प्र नो यच्छ विशस्पते धनदा असि नस्त्वम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne acchā vadeha naḥ pratyaṅnaḥ sumanā bhava | pra no yaccha viśaspate dhanadā asi nastvam ||

translations.english: Agni, speak to us here, be favourably disposed towards us; bestow upon us (riches), lord of men, foryou are the giver of wealth to us.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र नो यच्छत्वर्यमा प्र भगः प्र बृहस्पतिः । प्र देवाः प्रोत सूनृता रायो देवी ददातु नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra no yacchatvaryamā pra bhagaḥ pra bṛhaspatiḥ | pra devāḥ prota sūnṛtā rāyo devī dadātu naḥ ||

translations.english: May Aryaman, may Bhaga, may Bṛhaspati, may the gods give liberally to us; may the truth-speakinggoddess (Sarasvatī) bestow riches upon us.

mantras.sanskrit: सोमं राजानमवसेऽग्निं गीर्भिर्हवामहे । आदित्यान्विष्णुं सूर्यं ब्रह्माणं च बृहस्पतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: somaṃ rājānamavase'gniṃ gīrbhirhavāmahe | ādityānviṣṇuṃ sūryaṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca bṛhaspatim ||

translations.english: We invoke for our protection the royal Soma, (we invoke) Agni with praises, (we invoke) the Ādityas,Viṣṇu, Sūrya, Brahmā and Bṛhaspati.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रवायू बृहस्पतिं सुहवेह हवामहे । यथा नः सर्व इज्जनः संगत्यां सुमना असत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indravāyū bṛhaspatiṃ suhaveha havāmahe | yathā naḥ sarva ijjanaḥ saṃgatyāṃ sumanā asat ||

translations.english: We invoke the adorable Indra and Vāyu and Bṛhaspati on this occasion, that all our race may befavourably inclined to us in the acquisition (of wealth).

mantras.sanskrit: अर्यमणं बृहस्पतिमिन्द्रं दानाय चोदय । वातं विष्णुं सरस्वतीं सवितारं च वाजिनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: aryamaṇaṃ bṛhaspatimindraṃ dānāya codaya | vātaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarasvatīṃ savitāraṃ ca vājinam ||

translations.english: Stimulate to liberality Aryaman, Bṛhaspati, Indra, Vāta, Viṣṇu, Sarasvatī, and the food-bestowingSavitā.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं नो अग्ने अग्निभिर्ब्रह्म यज्ञं च वर्धय । त्वं नो देवतातये रायो दानाय चोदय ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ no agne agnibhirbrahma yajñaṃ ca vardhaya | tvaṃ no devatātaye rāyo dānāya codaya ||

translations.english: Augment our prayer and sacrifice, Agni, with your fires; do you at our sacrifice stimulate (the gods) togive us wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: अयमग्ने जरिता त्वे अभूदपि सहसः सूनो नह्यन्यदस्त्याप्यम् । भद्रं हि शर्म त्रिवरूथमस्ति त आरे हिंसानामप दिद्युमा कृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayamagne jaritā tve abhūdapi sahasaḥ sūno nahyanyadastyāpyam | bhadraṃ hi śarma trivarūthamasti ta āre hiṃsānāmapa didyumā kṛdhi ||

translations.english: This person n, Agni, was your praiser, for there is nothing else attainable, O son of strength; holy is thehappiness derived from you, a triple defence; remove far from us, who are susceptible of harm, your scorchingflame.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रवत्ते अग्ने जनिमा पितूयतः साचीव विश्वा भुवना न्यृञ्जसे । प्र सप्तयः प्र सनिषन्त नो धियः पुरश्चरन्ति पशुपा इव त्मना ॥
mantras.transliteration: pravatte agne janimā pitūyataḥ sācīva viśvā bhuvanā nyṛñjase | pra saptayaḥ pra saniṣanta no dhiyaḥ puraścaranti paśupā iva tmanā ||

translations.english: Exalted is the birth of you, Agni, who are desirous of (sacrificial) food; you preside like a councillorover all created beings; our praises flowing smoothly proceed to you, as herdsmen of their own will (go slowly)before (their flocks).

mantras.sanskrit: उत वा उ परि वृणक्षि बप्सद्बहोरग्न उलपस्य स्वधावः । उत खिल्या उर्वराणां भवन्ति मा ते हेतिं तविषीं चुक्रुधाम ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta vā u pari vṛṇakṣi bapsadbahoragna ulapasya svadhāvaḥ | uta khilyā urvarāṇāṃ bhavanti mā te hetiṃ taviṣīṃ cukrudhāma ||

translations.english: Blazing Agni, you destroy many a shrub, as you burn; and (the sites) of the tilled fields are laid waste,may we never rouse to anger your terrible flame.

mantras.sanskrit: यदुद्वतो निवतो यासि बप्सत्पृथगेषि प्रगर्धिनीव सेना । यदा ते वातो अनुवाति शोचिर्वप्तेव श्मश्रु वपसि प्र भूम ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadudvato nivato yāsi bapsatpṛthageṣi pragardhinīva senā | yadā te vāto anuvāti śocirvapteva śmaśru vapasi pra bhūma ||

translations.english: When you move burning above and burning below, you scatter yourself like a devastating host; whenthe wind fans your flame, you shave the earth as a barber shaves a beard.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रत्यस्य श्रेणयो ददृश्र एकं नियानं बहवो रथासः । बाहू यदग्ने अनुमर्मृजानो न्यङ्ङुत्तानामन्वेषि भूमिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pratyasya śreṇayo dadṛśra ekaṃ niyānaṃ bahavo rathāsaḥ | bāhū yadagne anumarmṛjāno nyaṅṅuttānāmanveṣi bhūmim ||

translations.english: His lines (of flame) are visible, like one array of many chariots, when clearing away (the forests) withyour arms (of flame) you march, Agni, over the prostrate earth.

mantras.sanskrit: उत्ते शुष्मा जिहतामुत्ते अर्चिरुत्ते अग्ने शशमानस्य वाजाः । उच्छ्वञ्चस्व नि नम वर्धमान आ त्वाद्य विश्वे वसवः सदन्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: utte śuṣmā jihatāmutte arcirutte agne śaśamānasya vājāḥ | ucchvañcasva ni nama vardhamāna ā tvādya viśve vasavaḥ sadantu ||

translations.english: May your withering flames, Agni, arise; may your light (arise), and the swift movements of you whenyou are praised; rise up, stoop down, increasing in might; may all the Vasus this day attend upon you.

mantras.sanskrit: अपामिदं न्ययनं समुद्रस्य निवेशनम् । अन्यं कृणुष्वेतः पन्थां तेन याहि वशाँ अनु ॥
mantras.transliteration: apāmidaṃ nyayanaṃ samudrasya niveśanam | anyaṃ kṛṇuṣvetaḥ panthāṃ tena yāhi vaśā~ anu ||

translations.english: This is the abode of the waters, the dwelling of the ocean; pursue, Agni, a different path from this; goby this (path) according to your plural asure.

mantras.sanskrit: आयने ते परायणे दूर्वा रोहन्तु पुष्पिणीः । ह्रदाश्च पुण्डरीकाणि समुद्रस्य गृहा इमे ॥
mantras.transliteration: āyane te parāyaṇe dūrvā rohantu puṣpiṇīḥ | hradāśca puṇḍarīkāṇi samudrasya gṛhā ime ||

translations.english: Both at your arrival, Agni, and at your departure, may the flowering dūrva grasses spring up; maylakes (be formed) and lotuses (therein); may these be the dwellings of the ocean.

mantras.sanskrit: त्यं चिदत्रिमृतजुरमर्थमश्वं न यातवे । कक्षीवन्तं यदी पुना रथं न कृणुथो नवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tyaṃ cidatrimṛtajuramarthamaśvaṃ na yātave | kakṣīvantaṃ yadī punā rathaṃ na kṛṇutho navam ||

translations.english: You made this Atri, ever diligent in worship, (swift) to run to the goal like a horse, and you renewedKakṣīvat as (a wheelwright renews) a car.

mantras.sanskrit: त्यं चिदश्वं न वाजिनमरेणवो यमत्नत । दृळ्हं ग्रन्थिं न वि ष्यतमत्रिं यविष्ठमा रजः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tyaṃ cidaśvaṃ na vājinamareṇavo yamatnata | dṛḷhaṃ granthiṃ na vi ṣyatamatriṃ yaviṣṭhamā rajaḥ ||

translations.english: This Atri, whom the irresistible (asuras) dragged bound like a swift horse, you unloosed like a strongknot, (setting him) the youngest born upon the earth.

mantras.sanskrit: नरा दंसिष्ठावत्रये शुभ्रा सिषासतं धियः । अथा हि वां दिवो नरा पुन स्तोमो न विशसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: narā daṃsiṣṭhāvatraye śubhrā siṣāsataṃ dhiyaḥ | athā hi vāṃ divo narā puna stomo na viśase ||

translations.english: Leaders (of rites), of goodly aspect and radiant, design to accept Atri's praises, and so the praise ofyour worshipper (is) to be sung again to you leaders (of rites).

mantras.sanskrit: चिते तद्वां सुराधसा रातिः सुमतिरश्विना । आ यन्नः सदने पृथौ समने पर्षथो नरा ॥
mantras.transliteration: cite tadvāṃ surādhasā rātiḥ sumatiraśvinā | ā yannaḥ sadane pṛthau samane parṣatho narā ||

translations.english: Munificent Aśvins, my offering and praise (is) for your recognition, because, leaders (of rites), youprotect us at the sacrifice in the spacious sacrificial hall.

mantras.sanskrit: युवं भुज्युं समुद्र आ रजसः पार ईङ्खितम् । यातमच्छा पतत्रिभिर्नासत्या सातये कृतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yuvaṃ bhujyuṃ samudra ā rajasaḥ pāra īṅkhitam | yātamacchā patatribhirnāsatyā sātaye kṛtam ||

translations.english: You came with winged (steeds) to Bhujyu (immersed) in the ocean, at the world's end, perturbed; and,leaders, of truth, you restored him to your worship.

mantras.sanskrit: आ वां सुम्नैः शंयू इव मंहिष्ठा विश्ववेदसा । समस्मे भूषतं नरोत्सं न पिप्युषीरिषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā vāṃ sumnaiḥ śaṃyū iva maṃhiṣṭhā viśvavedasā | samasme bhūṣataṃ narotsaṃ na pipyuṣīriṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Prosperous,, most adorable, all-knowing, come to us and decorate us with blessings, as a (cow's)udder is adorned with abundant food.

mantras.sanskrit: अयं हि ते अमर्त्य इन्दुरत्यो न पत्यते । दक्षो विश्वायुर्वेधसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayaṃ hi te amartya induratyo na patyate | dakṣo viśvāyurvedhase ||

translations.english: This immortal Soma, the giver of strength, the giver of long life to all, hastens like a swift horse to you(Indra), the creator.

mantras.sanskrit: अयमस्मासु काव्य ऋभुर्वज्रो दास्वते । अयं बिभर्त्यूर्ध्वकृशनं मदमृभुर्न कृत्व्यं मदम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayamasmāsu kāvya ṛbhurvajro dāsvate | ayaṃ bibhartyūrdhvakṛśanaṃ madamṛbhurna kṛtvyaṃ madam ||

translations.english: This (Indra), adorable among us and brilliant, is a thunderbolt for the donor (of the oblation against hisfoes); he cherishes the exhilarating (worshipper) ūrdhvakṛśana, as Ṛbhu (cherishes) the exhilaratingcelebrator of holy rites.

mantras.sanskrit: घृषुः श्येनाय कृत्वन आसु स्वासु वंसगः । अव दीधेदहीशुवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ghṛṣuḥ śyenāya kṛtvana āsu svāsu vaṃsagaḥ | ava dīdhedahīśuvaḥ ||

translations.english: May the brilliant, (Indra), who is a benefactor among thwese his own (people), for the sake ofthe hymn; Suparṇa, the son of the Tārk.sya. ahiśuvaḥ = name of an asura; the subject of the verb may beSoma and not Indra].

mantras.sanskrit: यं सुपर्णः परावतः श्येनस्य पुत्र आभरत् । शतचक्रं योऽह्यो वर्तनिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ suparṇaḥ parāvataḥ śyenasya putra ābharat | śatacakraṃ yo'hyo vartaniḥ ||

translations.english: The som whom Suparṇa, the son of the falcon, brought from afar, the bestower of many boons, whois the stimulator of Ahi.

mantras.sanskrit: यं ते श्येनश्चारुमवृकं पदाभरदरुणं मानमन्धसः । एना वयो वि तार्यायुर्जीवस एना जागार बन्धुता ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaṃ te śyenaścārumavṛkaṃ padābharadaruṇaṃ mānamandhasaḥ | enā vayo vi tāryāyurjīvasa enā jāgāra bandhutā ||

translations.english: Whom the falcon brought to you (Indra) with his claw, beautiful, unassailable, purple-tinted, themeasurer of food-- by it, food and old age was prolonged for living, by it affinity was awakened.

mantras.sanskrit: एवा तदिन्द्र इन्दुना देवेषु चिद्धारयाते महि त्यजः । क्रत्वा वयो वि तार्यायुः सुक्रतो क्रत्वायमस्मदा सुतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: evā tadindra indunā deveṣu ciddhārayāte mahi tyajaḥ | kratvā vayo vi tāryāyuḥ sukrato kratvāyamasmadā sutaḥ ||

translations.english: So then by Indu, Indra obtains among the gods great brilliancy; by your sacrifice, O doer of gooddeeds, food and old age is prolonged, by our sacrifice this (Soma) is poured out by us.

mantras.sanskrit: इमां खनाम्योषधिं वीरुधं बलवत्तमाम् । यया सपत्नीं बाधते यया संविन्दते पतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: imāṃ khanāmyoṣadhiṃ vīrudhaṃ balavattamām | yayā sapatnīṃ bādhate yayā saṃvindate patim ||

translations.english: I dig up this most potent medicinal creeper, by which (a wife) destroys a rival wife, by which shesecures to herself her husband.

mantras.sanskrit: उत्तानपर्णे सुभगे देवजूते सहस्वति । सपत्नीं मे परा धम पतिं मे केवलं कुरु ॥
mantras.transliteration: uttānaparṇe subhage devajūte sahasvati | sapatnīṃ me parā dhama patiṃ me kevalaṃ kuru ||

translations.english: O (plural nt) with upturned leaves, auspicious, sent by the gods, powerful, remove my rival and make myhusband mine alone.

mantras.sanskrit: उत्तराहमुत्तर उत्तरेदुत्तराभ्यः । अथा सपत्नी या ममाधरा साधराभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: uttarāhamuttara uttareduttarābhyaḥ | athā sapatnī yā mamādharā sādharābhyaḥ ||

translations.english: Excellent (plural nt), may I too be excellent, excellent among the excellent, and may she who is my rival bevile among the vile.

mantras.sanskrit: नह्यस्या नाम गृभ्णामि नो अस्मिन्रमते जने । परामेव परावतं सपत्नीं गमयामसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahyasyā nāma gṛbhṇāmi no asminramate jane | parāmeva parāvataṃ sapatnīṃ gamayāmasi ||

translations.english: I will not even utter her name, no (woman) takes plural asure in that person n; may we remove the otherrival wife to a distance.

mantras.sanskrit: अहमस्मि सहमानाथ त्वमसि सासहिः । उभे सहस्वती भूत्वी सपत्नीं मे सहावहै ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahamasmi sahamānātha tvamasi sāsahiḥ | ubhe sahasvatī bhūtvī sapatnīṃ me sahāvahai ||

translations.english: I am triumphing, you are triumphant; we two being powerful will triumph over my rival.

mantras.sanskrit: उप तेऽधां सहमानामभि त्वाधां सहीयसा । मामनु प्र ते मनो वत्सं गौरिव धावतु पथा वारिव धावतु ॥
mantras.transliteration: upa te'dhāṃ sahamānāmabhi tvādhāṃ sahīyasā | māmanu pra te mano vatsaṃ gauriva dhāvatu pathā vāriva dhāvatu ||

translations.english: I make you the triumphant (herb) my pillow, I support you with that more triumphant (pillow); let yourmind hasten to me as a cow to her calf, let it speed on its way like water. not fear assail you?

mantras.sanskrit: अरण्यान्यरण्यान्यसौ या प्रेव नश्यसि । कथा ग्रामं न पृच्छसि न त्वा भीरिव विन्दती३ँ ॥
mantras.transliteration: araṇyānyaraṇyānyasau yā preva naśyasi | kathā grāmaṃ na pṛcchasi na tvā bhīriva vindatī3~ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: वृषारवाय वदते यदुपावति चिच्चिकः । आघाटिभिरिव धावयन्नरण्यानिर्महीयते ॥
mantras.transliteration: vṛṣāravāya vadate yadupāvati ciccikaḥ | āghāṭibhiriva dhāvayannaraṇyānirmahīyate ||

translations.english: When the ciccika replies to the crying vṛṣārava, Araṇyāni is exalted, resonant, as with cymbalṣ

mantras.sanskrit: उत गाव इवादन्त्युत वेश्मेव दृश्यते । उतो अरण्यानिः सायं शकटीरिव सर्जति ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta gāva ivādantyuta veśmeva dṛśyate | uto araṇyāniḥ sāyaṃ śakaṭīriva sarjati ||

translations.english: It is as if cows are grazing, and it looks like a dwelling, and Aranyāni at eventide, indeed, dismissedthe carts.

mantras.sanskrit: गामङ्गैष आ ह्वयति दार्वङ्गैषो अपावधीत् । वसन्नरण्यान्यां सायमक्रुक्षदिति मन्यते ॥
mantras.transliteration: gāmaṅgaiṣa ā hvayati dārvaṅgaiṣo apāvadhīt | vasannaraṇyānyāṃ sāyamakrukṣaditi manyate ||

translations.english: This man calls his cow, another cuts down the timber; tarrying in the forest eventide, one thinks thereis a cry.

mantras.sanskrit: न वा अरण्यानिर्हन्त्यन्यश्चेन्नाभिगच्छति । स्वादोः फलस्य जग्ध्वाय यथाकामं नि पद्यते ॥
mantras.transliteration: na vā araṇyānirhantyanyaścennābhigacchati | svādoḥ phalasya jagdhvāya yathākāmaṃ ni padyate ||

translations.english: But Araṇyāni injures no one unless some other assail him; feeding upon the sweet fruit, hepenetrates at will.

mantras.sanskrit: आञ्जनगन्धिं सुरभिं बह्वन्नामकृषीवलाम् । प्राहं मृगाणां मातरमरण्यानिमशंसिषम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: āñjanagandhiṃ surabhiṃ bahvannāmakṛṣīvalām | prāhaṃ mṛgāṇāṃ mātaramaraṇyānimaśaṃsiṣam ||

translations.english: I praise the musk-scented, fragrant, fertile, uncultivated Araṇyāni, the mother of wild animals.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रत्ते दधामि प्रथमाय मन्यवेऽहन्यद्वृत्रं नर्यं विवेरपः । उभे यत्त्वा भवतो रोदसी अनु रेजते शुष्मात्पृथिवी चिदद्रिवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śratte dadhāmi prathamāya manyave'hanyadvṛtraṃ naryaṃ viverapaḥ | ubhe yattvā bhavato rodasī anu rejate śuṣmātpṛthivī cidadrivaḥ ||

translations.english: I have faith, Indra, in your first wrath, whereby you did slay Vṛtra, and did undertake a work friendly toman; when both heaven and earth were inferior to you, the firmament trembled at your might, O wielder of thethunderbolt.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं मायाभिरनवद्य मायिनं श्रवस्यता मनसा वृत्रमर्दयः । त्वामिन्नरो वृणते गविष्टिषु त्वां विश्वासु हव्यास्विष्टिषु ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ māyābhiranavadya māyinaṃ śravasyatā manasā vṛtramardayaḥ | tvāminnaro vṛṇate gaviṣṭiṣu tvāṃ viśvāsu havyāsviṣṭiṣu ||

translations.english: Irreproachable Indra, with mind intent on glory you have your deceptions slain the deceptive Vṛtra.The worshipper chooses you when he seeks for his (stolen) cattle, and in all sacrifices accompanied withinvocations.

mantras.sanskrit: ऐषु चाकन्धि पुरुहूत सूरिषु वृधासो ये मघवन्नानशुर्मघम् । अर्चन्ति तोके तनये परिष्टिषु मेधसाता वाजिनमह्रये धने ॥
mantras.transliteration: aiṣu cākandhi puruhūta sūriṣu vṛdhāso ye maghavannānaśurmagham | arcanti toke tanaye pariṣṭiṣu medhasātā vājinamahraye dhane ||

translations.english: Indra, the invoked of many, be gracious to these Suris, who thereby prospering attain, O Maghavan, toopulence; (who) adore the powerful one at the sacrifice for (the sake of obtaining) a son, a grandson, thefulfilment of their desires, and honourable wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: स इन्नु रायः सुभृतस्य चाकनन्मदं यो अस्य रंह्यं चिकेतति । त्वावृधो मघवन्दाश्वध्वरो मक्षू स वाजं भरते धना नृभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sa innu rāyaḥ subhṛtasya cākananmadaṃ yo asya raṃhyaṃ ciketati | tvāvṛdho maghavandāśvadhvaro makṣū sa vājaṃ bharate dhanā nṛbhiḥ ||

translations.english: He obtains well-procured riches, who studies to promote Indra's rapid exhilaration. Exalted by (yourfavour), O Maghavan, (the worshipper), celebrating the sacrifice, speedily obtains through the officiating priestsfood and wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं शर्धाय महिना गृणान उरु कृधि मघवञ्छग्धि रायः । त्वं नो मित्रो वरुणो न मायी पित्वो न दस्म दयसे विभक्ता ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ śardhāya mahinā gṛṇāna uru kṛdhi maghavañchagdhi rāyaḥ | tvaṃ no mitro varuṇo na māyī pitvo na dasma dayase vibhaktā ||

translations.english: Glorified by great (praise), Maghavan, spread forth your might, bestow riches (upon us); beautifulIndra who are wise like Mitra and Varuṇa the distributer (of riches), you give us food now.

mantras.sanskrit: सुष्वाणास इन्द्र स्तुमसि त्वा ससवांसश्च तुविनृम्ण वाजम् । आ नो भर सुवितं यस्य चाकन्त्मना तना सनुयाम त्वोताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: suṣvāṇāsa indra stumasi tvā sasavāṃsaśca tuvinṛmṇa vājam | ā no bhara suvitaṃ yasya cākantmanā tanā sanuyāma tvotāḥ ||

translations.english: Having poured out the libation, we praise you, Indra; having presented the sacrificial food, we (praiseyou), granter of abundant wealth; bring us the wealth which one longs for; protected by you may we acquireriches through yourself alone.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋष्वस्त्वमिन्द्र शूर जातो दासीर्विशः सूर्येण सह्याः । गुहा हितं गुह्यं गूळ्हमप्सु बिभृमसि प्रस्रवणे न सोमम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛṣvastvamindra śūra jāto dāsīrviśaḥ sūryeṇa sahyāḥ | guhā hitaṃ guhyaṃ gūḷhamapsu bibhṛmasi prasravaṇe na somam ||

translations.english: Hero Indra, who are mighty, may you as soon as you are born overcome with Sūrya the races of theDāsas, and the fugitive (Vala) lurking in secrecy, hidden in the waters; we now present to you the Soma in acopious stream. your praisers; may we be of those who gratify (you) with Soma libations; to you, O car-borne indra, these(praises are offered) with sacrificial viands.

mantras.sanskrit: अर्यो वा गिरो अभ्यर्च विद्वानृषीणां विप्रः सुमतिं चकानः । ते स्याम ये रणयन्त सोमैरेनोत तुभ्यं रथोळ्ह भक्षैः ॥
mantras.transliteration: aryo vā giro abhyarca vidvānṛṣīṇāṃ vipraḥ sumatiṃ cakānaḥ | te syāma ye raṇayanta somairenota tubhyaṃ rathoḷha bhakṣaiḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: इमा ब्रह्मेन्द्र तुभ्यं शंसि दा नृभ्यो नृणां शूर शवः । तेभिर्भव सक्रतुर्येषु चाकन्नुत त्रायस्व गृणत उत स्तीन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: imā brahmendra tubhyaṃ śaṃsi dā nṛbhyo nṛṇāṃ śūra śavaḥ | tebhirbhava sakraturyeṣu cākannuta trāyasva gṛṇata uta stīn ||

translations.english: To you, Indra, have these prayers been addressed grant, O hero, strength to the leaders of men; be ofone mind with those in whom you delight, and protect those who praise you, and the worshippers who standround about.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रुधी हवमिन्द्र शूर पृथ्या उत स्तवसे वेन्यस्यार्कैः । आ यस्ते योनिं घृतवन्तमस्वारूर्मिर्न निम्नैर्द्रवयन्त वक्वाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śrudhī havamindra śūra pṛthyā uta stavase venyasyārkaiḥ | ā yaste yoniṃ ghṛtavantamasvārūrmirna nimnairdravayanta vakvāḥ ||

translations.english: Hear, hero Indra, the invocation of Pṛthu; you are glorified by the praises of the son of Vena, whocelebrated your hall of sacrifice, full of ghī; your praisers rush to you like a torrent through precipitous banks.

mantras.sanskrit: सविता यन्त्रैः पृथिवीमरम्णादस्कम्भने सविता द्यामदृंहत् । अश्वमिवाधुक्षद्धुनिमन्तरिक्षमतूर्ते बद्धं सविता समुद्रम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: savitā yantraiḥ pṛthivīmaramṇādaskambhane savitā dyāmadṛṃhat | aśvamivādhukṣaddhunimantarikṣamatūrte baddhaṃ savitā samudram ||

translations.english: Savitā has fixed the earth with fetters; Savitā has made the heaven firm in a plural ce where there wasno support; Savitā has milked the cloud of the firmament bound to the indestructible (ether) like a tremblinghorse.

mantras.sanskrit: यत्रा समुद्रः स्कभितो व्यौनदपां नपात्सविता तस्य वेद । अतो भूरत आ उत्थितं रजोऽतो द्यावापृथिवी अप्रथेताम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yatrā samudraḥ skabhito vyaunadapāṃ napātsavitā tasya veda | ato bhūrata ā utthitaṃ rajo'to dyāvāpṛthivī aprathetām ||

translations.english: Where the cloud thus arrested shed moisture (on the earth) Savitā, O grandson of the waters, knewthat (plural ce); from thence proceeded the earth, thence arose the firmament, thence the heaven and earth werespread out.

mantras.sanskrit: पश्चेदमन्यदभवद्यजत्रममर्त्यस्य भुवनस्य भूना । सुपर्णो अङ्ग सवितुर्गरुत्मान्पूर्वो जातः स उ अस्यानु धर्म ॥
mantras.transliteration: paścedamanyadabhavadyajatramamartyasya bhuvanasya bhūnā | suparṇo aṅga saviturgarutmānpūrvo jātaḥ sa u asyānu dharma ||

translations.english: Afterwards arose this other adorable (deity), together with the host of the immortal world, thebrightwinged Garutmat, born before Savitā obeyed his law.

mantras.sanskrit: गाव इव ग्रामं यूयुधिरिवाश्वान्वाश्रेव वत्सं सुमना दुहाना । पतिरिव जायामभि नो न्येतु धर्ता दिवः सविता विश्ववारः ॥
mantras.transliteration: gāva iva grāmaṃ yūyudhirivāśvānvāśreva vatsaṃ sumanā duhānā | patiriva jāyāmabhi no nyetu dhartā divaḥ savitā viśvavāraḥ ||

translations.english: As cattle hasten to the village, as the warrior to his horses, as affectionate milk-giving cows to the calf,as a husband to his wife, so may Savitā, the upholder of the sky, the desired of all, hasten to us.

mantras.sanskrit: हिरण्यस्तूपः सवितर्यथा त्वाङ्गिरसो जुह्वे वाजे अस्मिन् । एवा त्वार्चन्नवसे वन्दमानः सोमस्येवांशुं प्रति जागराहम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: hiraṇyastūpaḥ savitaryathā tvāṅgiraso juhve vāje asmin | evā tvārcannavase vandamānaḥ somasyevāṃśuṃ prati jāgarāham ||

translations.english: As Hiraṇyastūpa, the Aṅgirasa, summoned you to this food, so I, praising you for your protection,watch before you as (worshippers) watch before the filament of the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: समिद्धश्चित्समिध्यसे देवेभ्यो हव्यवाहन । आदित्यै रुद्रैर्वसुभिर्न आ गहि मृळीकाय न आ गहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: samiddhaścitsamidhyase devebhyo havyavāhana | ādityai rudrairvasubhirna ā gahi mṛḷīkāya na ā gahi ||

translations.english: Bearer of oblations, being kindled you burn for the gods; come to us with the Ādityas, the Rudras, the

mantras.sanskrit: इमं यज्ञमिदं वचो जुजुषाण उपागहि । मर्तासस्त्वा समिधान हवामहे मृळीकाय हवामहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: imaṃ yajñamidaṃ vaco jujuṣāṇa upāgahi | martāsastvā samidhāna havāmahe mṛḷīkāya havāmahe ||

translations.english: Being gratified by this sacrifice, this praise, approach; we mortals invoke you, blazing (Agni), weinvoke you for felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वामु जातवेदसं विश्ववारं गृणे धिया । अग्ने देवाँ आ वह नः प्रियव्रतान्मृळीकाय प्रियव्रतान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvāmu jātavedasaṃ viśvavāraṃ gṛṇe dhiyā | agne devā~ ā vaha naḥ priyavratānmṛḷīkāya priyavratān ||

translations.english: I glorify with my praise you, Jātavedas, desired by akll; bring hither, Agni, to us the gods who aregratified by offerings, (bring) those gratified by offerings for our felicity. invoke Agni for the acquisition of abundant wealth, (may he make me) happy for the acquisition of wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निर्देवो देवानामभवत्पुरोहितोऽग्निं मनुष्या ऋषयः समीधिरे । अग्निं महो धनसातावहं हुवे मृळीकं धनसातये ॥
mantras.transliteration: agnirdevo devānāmabhavatpurohito'gniṃ manuṣyā ṛṣayaḥ samīdhire | agniṃ maho dhanasātāvahaṃ huve mṛḷīkaṃ dhanasātaye ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निरत्रिं भरद्वाजं गविष्ठिरं प्रावन्नः कण्वं त्रसदस्युमाहवे । अग्निं वसिष्ठो हवते पुरोहितो मृळीकाय पुरोहितः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniratriṃ bharadvājaṃ gaviṣṭhiraṃ prāvannaḥ kaṇvaṃ trasadasyumāhave | agniṃ vasiṣṭho havate purohito mṛḷīkāya purohitaḥ ||

translations.english: May Agni protect in war Atri, Bhāradvāja, Gaviṣṭhira, ourselves, Kaṇva, and Trasadasyu;Vasiṣṭha as the purohita invokes Agni, the Purohita for our felicity.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रद्धयाग्निः समिध्यते श्रद्धया हूयते हविः । श्रद्धां भगस्य मूर्धनि वचसा वेदयामसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: śraddhayāgniḥ samidhyate śraddhayā hūyate haviḥ | śraddhāṃ bhagasya mūrdhani vacasā vedayāmasi ||

translations.english: Agni is kindled by Śraddhā, by Śraddhā is the oblation offered; with our praise we glorifyFaith, of the family of Love; cf. Nirukta 9.31].

mantras.sanskrit: प्रियं श्रद्धे ददतः प्रियं श्रद्धे दिदासतः । प्रियं भोजेषु यज्वस्विदं म उदितं कृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: priyaṃ śraddhe dadataḥ priyaṃ śraddhe didāsataḥ | priyaṃ bhojeṣu yajvasvidaṃ ma uditaṃ kṛdhi ||

translations.english: O Śraddhā_, grant the desire of the donor (of the oblation), grant, O Śraddhā, the desire of himwho wishes to give, grant this boon which I have mentioned to my sacrificers who solicit happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: यथा देवा असुरेषु श्रद्धामुग्रेषु चक्रिरे । एवं भोजेषु यज्वस्वस्माकमुदितं कृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yathā devā asureṣu śraddhāmugreṣu cakrire | evaṃ bhojeṣu yajvasvasmākamuditaṃ kṛdhi ||

translations.english: As the gods had faith in (their fight with) the Asuras, so grant the boon which has been asked for toour sacrificers who solicit happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रद्धां देवा यजमाना वायुगोपा उपासते । श्रद्धां हृदय्ययाकूत्या श्रद्धया विन्दते वसु ॥
mantras.transliteration: śraddhāṃ devā yajamānā vāyugopā upāsate | śraddhāṃ hṛdayyayākūtyā śraddhayā vindate vasu ||

translations.english: Gods, worshippers, and those who are protected by Vāyu, solicit Śraddhā, (they cherish) Śraddhāwith heartfelt desire, through Śraddhā a man acquires wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रद्धां प्रातर्हवामहे श्रद्धां मध्यंदिनं परि । श्रद्धां सूर्यस्य निम्रुचि श्रद्धे श्रद्धापयेह नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śraddhāṃ prātarhavāmahe śraddhāṃ madhyaṃdinaṃ pari | śraddhāṃ sūryasya nimruci śraddhe śraddhāpayeha naḥ ||

translations.english: We invoke Śraddhā at dawn, and again at midday, and also at the setting of the sun; inspire us inthis world, Śraddhā, with faith.

mantras.sanskrit: शास इत्था महाँ अस्यमित्रखादो अद्भुतः । न यस्य हन्यते सखा न जीयते कदा चन ॥
mantras.transliteration: śāsa itthā mahā~ asyamitrakhādo adbhutaḥ | na yasya hanyate sakhā na jīyate kadā cana ||

translations.english: Śāsa thus (praise Indra); you are mighty, the destroyer of foes, the wonderful, (he) whose friend isnot killed nor ever overpowered.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वस्तिदा विशस्पतिर्वृत्रहा विमृधो वशी । वृषेन्द्रः पुर एतु नः सोमपा अभयंकरः ॥
mantras.transliteration: svastidā viśaspatirvṛtrahā vimṛdho vaśī | vṛṣendraḥ pura etu naḥ somapā abhayaṃkaraḥ ||

translations.english: May Indra, the granter of prosperity, the lord of men, the slayer of Vṛtra, the warrior, the subduer, theshowerer, the drinker of the Soma, the assurer of safety, come to our presence.

mantras.sanskrit: वि रक्षो वि मृधो जहि वि वृत्रस्य हनू रुज । वि मन्युमिन्द्र वृत्रहन्नमित्रस्याभिदासतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi rakṣo vi mṛdho jahi vi vṛtrasya hanū ruja | vi manyumindra vṛtrahannamitrasyābhidāsataḥ ||

translations.english: Destroy, Indra, the rākṣasas, the enemies; fracture the jaws of Vṛtra; baffle, indra, slayer of Vṛtra,the wrath of (our) menacing foe.

mantras.sanskrit: वि न इन्द्र मृधो जहि नीचा यच्छ पृतन्यतः । यो अस्माँ अभिदासत्यधरं गमया तमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: vi na indra mṛdho jahi nīcā yaccha pṛtanyataḥ | yo asmā~ abhidāsatyadharaṃ gamayā tamaḥ ||

translations.english: Destroy, Indra, our enemies; hunt down those who are in array against us; consign to lower darknesshim who seeks to harm us.

mantras.sanskrit: अपेन्द्र द्विषतो मनोऽप जिज्यासतो वधम् । वि मन्योः शर्म यच्छ वरीयो यवया वधम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: apendra dviṣato mano'pa jijyāsato vadham | vi manyoḥ śarma yaccha varīyo yavayā vadham ||

translations.english: Frustrate the purpose of him who hates us, (baffle) the weapon of him who seeks to overpower us,grant us entire security from his wrath of (his) weapon.

mantras.sanskrit: ईङ्खयन्तीरपस्युव इन्द्रं जातमुपासते । भेजानासः सुवीर्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: īṅkhayantīrapasyuva indraṃ jātamupāsate | bhejānāsaḥ suvīryam ||

translations.english: Desirous of fulfilling their functions (the mothers of Indra) approaching, worship him as soon as born,and enjoy (affluence) together with male progeny.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमिन्द्र बलादधि सहसो जात ओजसः । त्वं वृषन्वृषेदसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamindra balādadhi sahaso jāta ojasaḥ | tvaṃ vṛṣanvṛṣedasi ||

translations.english: You, Indra, were born from overpowering strength and energy; you, O showerer, are indeed ashowerer (of blessings).

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमिन्द्रासि वृत्रहा व्यन्तरिक्षमतिरः । उद्द्यामस्तभ्ना ओजसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamindrāsi vṛtrahā vyantarikṣamatiraḥ | uddyāmastabhnā ojasā ||

translations.english: You, Indra, are the slayer of Vṛtra, you have spread out the firmament; you have upheld the heavenby your power.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमिन्द्र सजोषसमर्कं बिभर्षि बाह्वोः । वज्रं शिशान ओजसा ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamindra sajoṣasamarkaṃ bibharṣi bāhvoḥ | vajraṃ śiśāna ojasā ||

translations.english: You, Indra, bear your well-beloved and adorable thunderbolt in your arms, sharpening it with yourmight.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वमिन्द्राभिभूरसि विश्वा जातान्योजसा । स विश्वा भुव आभवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvamindrābhibhūrasi viśvā jātānyojasā | sa viśvā bhuva ābhavaḥ ||

translations.english: You, Indra, overpower all beings by your might, you have reached all worlds.

mantras.sanskrit: सोम एकेभ्यः पवते घृतमेक उपासते । येभ्यो मधु प्रधावति ताँश्चिदेवापि गच्छतात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: soma ekebhyaḥ pavate ghṛtameka upāsate | yebhyo madhu pradhāvati tā~ścidevāpi gacchatāt ||

translations.english: Soma is filtered for some (of the Pitrṣ), others accept clarified butter; go (O dead one) to those towhom the honey flows.

mantras.sanskrit: तपसा ये अनाधृष्यास्तपसा ये स्वर्ययुः । तपो ये चक्रिरे महस्ताँश्चिदेवापि गच्छतात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tapasā ye anādhṛṣyāstapasā ye svaryayuḥ | tapo ye cakrire mahastā~ścidevāpi gacchatāt ||

translations.english: To those who through penance are unassailable (by sin), to those who through penance have gone toheaven, to those who have performed abundant penance, do you (O dead one) go.

mantras.sanskrit: ये युध्यन्ते प्रधनेषु शूरासो ये तनूत्यजः । ये वा सहस्रदक्षिणास्ताँश्चिदेवापि गच्छतात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye yudhyante pradhaneṣu śūrāso ye tanūtyajaḥ | ye vā sahasradakṣiṇāstā~ścidevāpi gacchatāt ||

translations.english: To those who engage in battles, heroes who have given up their lives, or who have presentedthousands of offerings, to them (O dead one) go.

mantras.sanskrit: ये चित्पूर्व ऋतसाप ऋतावान ऋतावृधः । पितॄन्तपस्वतो यम ताँश्चिदेवापि गच्छतात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ye citpūrva ṛtasāpa ṛtāvāna ṛtāvṛdhaḥ | pitṝntapasvato yama tā~ścidevāpi gacchatāt ||

translations.english: Go, Yama, to those ascetic Pitaras, who are ancient, obsevers of truth, speakers of truth, andaugmenters of truth.

mantras.sanskrit: सहस्रणीथाः कवयो ये गोपायन्ति सूर्यम् । ऋषीन्तपस्वतो यम तपोजाँ अपि गच्छतात् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sahasraṇīthāḥ kavayo ye gopāyanti sūryam | ṛṣīntapasvato yama tapojā~ api gacchatāt ||

translations.english: Go, Yama, to those ascetic Ṛṣis, the sons of penance, who protect the sun, being leaders ofthousands, and intelligent.

mantras.sanskrit: अरायि काणे विकटे गिरिं गच्छ सदान्वे । शिरिम्बिठस्य सत्वभिस्तेभिष्ट्वा चातयामसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: arāyi kāṇe vikaṭe giriṃ gaccha sadānve | śirimbiṭhasya satvabhistebhiṣṭvā cātayāmasi ||

translations.english: Miserable, ill-favoured, deformed, ever-railing (goddess), go to your mountain; with these exploits ofŚirimbiṭha we scare you away.

mantras.sanskrit: चत्तो इतश्चत्तामुतः सर्वा भ्रूणान्यारुषी । अराय्यं ब्रह्मणस्पते तीक्ष्णशृण्गोदृषन्निहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: catto itaścattāmutaḥ sarvā bhrūṇānyāruṣī | arāyyaṃ brahmaṇaspate tīkṣṇaśṛṇgodṛṣannihi ||

translations.english: May she be scared away from this (world), scared away from the next (world), the destructress ofembryos; sharp-horned Bṛhaspati approach, driving away distress.

mantras.sanskrit: अदो यद्दारु प्लवते सिन्धोः पारे अपूरुषम् । तदा रभस्व दुर्हणो तेन गच्छ परस्तरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ado yaddāru plavate sindhoḥ pāre apūruṣam | tadā rabhasva durhaṇo tena gaccha parastaram ||

translations.english: The wood which floats be the sea-shore far off, remote from man, seize that, (O goddess), hard todestroy, and therewith go to a distant shore.

mantras.sanskrit: यद्ध प्राचीरजगन्तोरो मण्डूरधाणिकीः । हता इन्द्रस्य शत्रवः सर्वे बुद्बुदयाशवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaddha prācīrajagantoro maṇḍūradhāṇikīḥ | hatā indrasya śatravaḥ sarve budbudayāśavaḥ ||

translations.english: Utterers of discordant sounds, when swiftly moving you departed, all the enemies of Indra were slain,disappearing like bubbles.

mantras.sanskrit: परीमे गामनेषत पर्यग्निमहृषत । देवेष्वक्रत श्रवः क इमाँ आ दधर्षति ॥
mantras.transliteration: parīme gāmaneṣata paryagnimahṛṣata | deveṣvakrata śravaḥ ka imā~ ā dadharṣati ||

translations.english: These (Viśvedevās) have brought back the (stolen) cattle; they have built up the fire; they haveprovided food for the gods. Who will overcome them?

mantras.sanskrit: अग्निं हिन्वन्तु नो धियः सप्तिमाशुमिवाजिषु । तेन जेष्म धनंधनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agniṃ hinvantu no dhiyaḥ saptimāśumivājiṣu | tena jeṣma dhanaṃdhanam ||

translations.english: May our rites bring Agni here like a swift charger in battle, may we through him acquire all wealth.

mantras.sanskrit: यया गा आकरामहे सेनयाग्ने तवोत्या । तां नो हिन्व मघत्तये ॥
mantras.transliteration: yayā gā ākarāmahe senayāgne tavotyā | tāṃ no hinva maghattaye ||

translations.english: Send us, Agni, for the acquisition of wealth, that army with which we may acquire cattle through yourprotection

mantras.sanskrit: आग्ने स्थूरं रयिं भर पृथुं गोमन्तमश्विनम् । अङ्धि खं वर्तया पणिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: āgne sthūraṃ rayiṃ bhara pṛthuṃ gomantamaśvinam | aṅdhi khaṃ vartayā paṇim ||

translations.english: Bring us, Agni, substantial and extensive wealth, consisting of cattle and horses, sprinkle the sky (withrain), expel Paṇi.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने नक्षत्रमजरमा सूर्यं रोहयो दिवि । दधज्ज्योतिर्जनेभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne nakṣatramajaramā sūryaṃ rohayo divi | dadhajjyotirjanebhyaḥ ||

translations.english: You, Agni, have elevated the imperishable plural net, the Sun, in the firmament, giving light to the people.

mantras.sanskrit: अग्ने केतुर्विशामसि प्रेष्ठः श्रेष्ठ उपस्थसत् । बोधा स्तोत्रे वयो दधत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: agne keturviśāmasi preṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭha upasthasat | bodhā stotre vayo dadhat ||

translations.english: You, Agni, are the best beloved and most excellent banner of the people; understand (our praise)giving food to the praiser.

mantras.sanskrit: इमा नु कं भुवना सीषधामेन्द्रश्च विश्वे च देवाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imā nu kaṃ bhuvanā sīṣadhāmendraśca viśve ca devāḥ ||

translations.english: May we, along with Indra and the universal gods, possess all these worlds.

mantras.sanskrit: यज्ञं च नस्तन्वं च प्रजां चादित्यैरिन्द्रः सह चीकॢपाति ॥
mantras.transliteration: yajñaṃ ca nastanvaṃ ca prajāṃ cādityairindraḥ saha cīkḷpāti ||

translations.english: May Indra with the Ādityas perfect our sacrifice and our bodies and our offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: आदित्यैरिन्द्रः सगणो मरुद्भिरस्माकं भूत्वविता तनूनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ādityairindraḥ sagaṇo marudbhirasmākaṃ bhūtvavitā tanūnām ||

translations.english: May Indra with the Ādityas, and attended by the Maruts, be the protector of our bodies.

mantras.sanskrit: हत्वाय देवा असुरान्यदायन्देवा देवत्वमभिरक्षमाणाः ॥
mantras.transliteration: hatvāya devā asurānyadāyandevā devatvamabhirakṣamāṇāḥ ||

translations.english: When the gods returned (home), after slaying the asuras, (then were) the deities protecting theirdivinity.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रत्यञ्चमर्कमनयञ्छचीभिरादित्स्वधामिषिरां पर्यपश्यन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pratyañcamarkamanayañchacībhirāditsvadhāmiṣirāṃ paryapaśyan ||

translations.english: When (the worshippers) with their pious acts offered praise in honour (of the gods), then (men) beheldaround them the swift descending rain.

mantras.sanskrit: सूर्यो नो दिवस्पातु वातो अन्तरिक्षात् । अग्निर्नः पार्थिवेभ्यः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sūryo no divaspātu vāto antarikṣāt | agnirnaḥ pārthivebhyaḥ ||

translations.english: May Sūrya protect us from (foes dwelling in) heaven, Vāyu from (those dwelling in) the firmament,and Agni from those upon earth.

mantras.sanskrit: जोषा सवितर्यस्य ते हरः शतं सवाँ अर्हति । पाहि नो दिद्युतः पतन्त्याः ॥
mantras.transliteration: joṣā savitaryasya te haraḥ śataṃ savā~ arhati | pāhi no didyutaḥ patantyāḥ ||

translations.english: Savitā, whose radiance merits a hundred acknowledgments, be propitiated (by our praises); protectus from the falling bolts (of our enemies).

mantras.sanskrit: चक्षुर्नो देवः सविता चक्षुर्न उत पर्वतः । चक्षुर्धाता दधातु नः ॥
mantras.transliteration: cakṣurno devaḥ savitā cakṣurna uta parvataḥ | cakṣurdhātā dadhātu naḥ ||

translations.english: May the divine Savitā grant us sight, may Parvata (grant) us sight; may Dhātā (grant) us sight.

mantras.sanskrit: चक्षुर्नो धेहि चक्षुषे चक्षुर्विख्यै तनूभ्यः । सं चेदं वि च पश्येम ॥
mantras.transliteration: cakṣurno dhehi cakṣuṣe cakṣurvikhyai tanūbhyaḥ | saṃ cedaṃ vi ca paśyema ||

translations.english: Give sight, Sūrya, to our eyes, (bestow) sight for the illumination of our bodies, so that we may lookupon and into this (world).

mantras.sanskrit: सुसंदृशं त्वा वयं प्रति पश्येम सूर्य । वि पश्येम नृचक्षसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: susaṃdṛśaṃ tvā vayaṃ prati paśyema sūrya | vi paśyema nṛcakṣasaḥ ||

translations.english: May we look upon you, Sūrya, the bright beholder (of all), may we look into the things which arevisible to mankind.

mantras.sanskrit: उदसौ सूर्यो अगादुदयं मामको भगः । अहं तद्विद्वला पतिमभ्यसाक्षि विषासहिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: udasau sūryo agādudayaṃ māmako bhagaḥ | ahaṃ tadvidvalā patimabhyasākṣi viṣāsahiḥ ||

translations.english: The sun has risen; my good fortune has dawned; I, knowing this, have obtained my husbandtriumphing (over my rivals).

mantras.sanskrit: अहं केतुरहं मूर्धाहमुग्रा विवाचनी । ममेदनु क्रतुं पतिः सेहानाया उपाचरेत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ keturahaṃ mūrdhāhamugrā vivācanī | mamedanu kratuṃ patiḥ sehānāyā upācaret ||

translations.english: I am the banner, I am the head, I am exalted, soothing (my lord); my husband must conform to my will,as I am victorious over my rivals.

mantras.sanskrit: मम पुत्राः शत्रुहणोऽथो मे दुहिता विराट् । उताहमस्मि संजया पत्यौ मे श्लोक उत्तमः ॥
mantras.transliteration: mama putrāḥ śatruhaṇo'tho me duhitā virāṭ | utāhamasmi saṃjayā patyau me śloka uttamaḥ ||

translations.english: My sons are the destroyers of my enemies, my daughter is an empress; and I am victorious, my fameis most precious to my husband.

mantras.sanskrit: येनेन्द्रो हविषा कृत्व्यभवद्द्युम्न्युत्तमः । इदं तदक्रि देवा असपत्ना किलाभुवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yenendro haviṣā kṛtvyabhavaddyumnyuttamaḥ | idaṃ tadakri devā asapatnā kilābhuvam ||

translations.english: That oblation, O gods, has been offered by which Indra offering it has become renowned and mostpowerful; I freed myself from my rival wives.

mantras.sanskrit: असपत्ना सपत्नघ्नी जयन्त्यभिभूवरी । आवृक्षमन्यासां वर्चो राधो अस्थेयसामिव ॥
mantras.transliteration: asapatnā sapatnaghnī jayantyabhibhūvarī | āvṛkṣamanyāsāṃ varco rādho astheyasāmiva ||

translations.english: Free from rivals, the destructress of rivals, victorious, triumphant, I cut up the brilliance and wealth ofthe other (wives of Indra) as if it were the wealth of (enemies) who do not endure long.

mantras.sanskrit: समजैषमिमा अहं सपत्नीरभिभूवरी । यथाहमस्य वीरस्य विराजानि जनस्य च ॥
mantras.transliteration: samajaiṣamimā ahaṃ sapatnīrabhibhūvarī | yathāhamasya vīrasya virājāni janasya ca ||

translations.english: Triumphant, I conquered these my rivals so that I might rule this hero and his people.

mantras.sanskrit: तीव्रस्याभिवयसो अस्य पाहि सर्वरथा वि हरी इह मुञ्च । इन्द्र मा त्वा यजमानासो अन्ये नि रीरमन्तुभ्यमिमे सुतासः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tīvrasyābhivayaso asya pāhi sarvarathā vi harī iha muñca | indra mā tvā yajamānāso anye ni rīramantubhyamime sutāsaḥ ||

translations.english: Drink, Indra, of this sharp (Soma, which is) combined with sacrificial food, unyoke here your bay

mantras.sanskrit: तुभ्यं सुतास्तुभ्यमु सोत्वासस्त्वां गिरः श्वात्र्या आ ह्वयन्ति । इन्द्रेदमद्य सवनं जुषाणो विश्वस्य विद्वाँ इह पाहि सोमम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tubhyaṃ sutāstubhyamu sotvāsastvāṃ giraḥ śvātryā ā hvayanti | indredamadya savanaṃ juṣāṇo viśvasya vidvā~ iha pāhi somam ||

translations.english: For you are the libations that have been poured out, for you are those which are to be poured out; youdo our quickly uttered praises invoke; Indra, who are cognizant of all things, taking plural asure in this presentsacrifice, drink the Soma here.

mantras.sanskrit: य उशता मनसा सोममस्मै सर्वहृदा देवकामः सुनोति । न गा इन्द्रस्तस्य परा ददाति प्रशस्तमिच्चारुमस्मै कृणोति ॥
mantras.transliteration: ya uśatā manasā somamasmai sarvahṛdā devakāmaḥ sunoti | na gā indrastasya parā dadāti praśastamiccārumasmai kṛṇoti ||

translations.english: He who devoted to the deity with a willing mind offers the Soma to him with all his heart, Indra, doesnot destroy his cattloe, but gives him beautiful excellent (wealth).

mantras.sanskrit: अनुस्पष्टो भवत्येषो अस्य यो अस्मै रेवान्न सुनोति सोमम् । निररत्नौ मघवा तं दधाति ब्रह्मद्विषो हन्त्यनानुदिष्टः ॥
mantras.transliteration: anuspaṣṭo bhavatyeṣo asya yo asmai revānna sunoti somam | niraratnau maghavā taṃ dadhāti brahmadviṣo hantyanānudiṣṭaḥ ||

translations.english: He is mindful of him who, as a rich man, offers Soma to him; possessed of riches (Indra) holds him inhis hand, and unsolicited destroys (his enemies) who hate the Brāhmaṇa.

mantras.sanskrit: अश्वायन्तो गव्यन्तो वाजयन्तो हवामहे त्वोपगन्तवा उ । आभूषन्तस्ते सुमतौ नवायां वयमिन्द्र त्वा शुनं हुवेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: aśvāyanto gavyanto vājayanto havāmahe tvopagantavā u | ābhūṣantaste sumatau navāyāṃ vayamindra tvā śunaṃ huvema ||

translations.english: Wishing for horses, for cattle, for food, we invoke you, Indra, that you may come; abiding within yournew favour we invoke you, Indra, the giver of happiness.

mantras.sanskrit: मुञ्चामि त्वा हविषा जीवनाय कमज्ञातयक्ष्मादुत राजयक्ष्मात् । ग्राहिर्जग्राह यदि वैतदेनं तस्या इन्द्राग्नी प्र मुमुक्तमेनम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: muñcāmi tvā haviṣā jīvanāya kamajñātayakṣmāduta rājayakṣmāt | grāhirjagrāha yadi vaitadenaṃ tasyā indrāgnī pra mumuktamenam ||

translations.english: By means of the oblation I set you free to live safe from undeveloped consumption and from royalonsumption; and if the seizer has already seized him, then to you, Indra, and Agni, set him free.

mantras.sanskrit: यदि क्षितायुर्यदि वा परेतो यदि मृत्योरन्तिकं नीत एव । तमा हरामि निॠतेरुपस्थादस्पार्षमेनं शतशारदाय ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadi kṣitāyuryadi vā pareto yadi mṛtyorantikaṃ nīta eva | tamā harāmi niṝterupasthādaspārṣamenaṃ śataśāradāya ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: सहस्राक्षेण शतशारदेन शतायुषा हविषाहार्षमेनम् । शतं यथेमं शरदो नयातीन्द्रो विश्वस्य दुरितस्य पारम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sahasrākṣeṇa śataśāradena śatāyuṣā haviṣāhārṣamenam | śataṃ yathemaṃ śarado nayātīndro viśvasya duritasya pāram ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: शतं जीव शरदो वर्धमानः शतं हेमन्ताञ्छतमु वसन्तान् । शतमिन्द्राग्नी सविता बृहस्पतिः शतायुषा हविषेमं पुनर्दुः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śataṃ jīva śarado vardhamānaḥ śataṃ hemantāñchatamu vasantān | śatamindrāgnī savitā bṛhaspatiḥ śatāyuṣā haviṣemaṃ punarduḥ ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: आहार्षं त्वाविदं त्वा पुनरागाः पुनर्नव । सर्वाङ्ग सर्वं ते चक्षुः सर्वमायुश्च तेऽविदम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: āhārṣaṃ tvāvidaṃ tvā punarāgāḥ punarnava | sarvāṅga sarvaṃ te cakṣuḥ sarvamāyuśca te'vidam ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणाग्निः संविदानो रक्षोहा बाधतामितः । अमीवा यस्ते गर्भं दुर्णामा योनिमाशये ॥
mantras.transliteration: brahmaṇāgniḥ saṃvidāno rakṣohā bādhatāmitaḥ | amīvā yaste garbhaṃ durṇāmā yonimāśaye ||

translations.english: May Agni, the destroyer of the rākṣasas, consenting to our prayer, drive hence (the evil spirit) who(in the form of) sickness assails your embryo, who, as the disease durṇāman, assails your womb.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्ते गर्भममीवा दुर्णामा योनिमाशये । अग्निष्टं ब्रह्मणा सह निष्क्रव्यादमनीनशत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaste garbhamamīvā durṇāmā yonimāśaye | agniṣṭaṃ brahmaṇā saha niṣkravyādamanīnaśat ||

translations.english: May Agni, concurring in our prayer, destroy the cannibal who, as sickness, assails your embryo, who,as the disease durṇāman, assails your womb.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्ते हन्ति पतयन्तं निषत्स्नुं यः सरीसृपम् । जातं यस्ते जिघांसति तमितो नाशयामसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaste hanti patayantaṃ niṣatsnuṃ yaḥ sarīsṛpam | jātaṃ yaste jighāṃsati tamito nāśayāmasi ||

translations.english: May we exterminate from hence (the evil spirit) who destroys the impregnating energy, the germ as itsettles, the moving embryo, who seeks to destroy (the babe) when born.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्त ऊरू विहरत्यन्तरा दम्पती शये । योनिं यो अन्तरारेळ्हि तमितो नाशयामसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasta ūrū viharatyantarā dampatī śaye | yoniṃ yo antarāreḷhi tamito nāśayāmasi ||

translations.english: May we exterminate from hence (the evil spirit)l who separates your things, who lies betweenhusband and wife, who, entering your womb, devours (the seed).

mantras.sanskrit: यस्त्वा भ्राता पतिर्भूत्वा जारो भूत्वा निपद्यते । प्रजां यस्ते जिघांसति तमितो नाशयामसि ॥
