mantras.transliteration: yastvā bhrātā patirbhūtvā jāro bhūtvā nipadyate | prajāṃ yaste jighāṃsati tamito nāśayāmasi ||

translations.english: May we exterminate from hence (the evil spirit), who in the form of brother, husband, or paramour,approaches you, and seeks to destroy your offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्त्वा स्वप्नेन तमसा मोहयित्वा निपद्यते । प्रजां यस्ते जिघांसति तमितो नाशयामसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yastvā svapnena tamasā mohayitvā nipadyate | prajāṃ yaste jighāṃsati tamito nāśayāmasi ||

translations.english: May we exterminate from hence (the evil spirit), who, having beguiled you by sleep or darkness,approaches you, and seeks to destroy your offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: अक्षीभ्यां ते नासिकाभ्यां कर्णाभ्यां छुबुकादधि । यक्ष्मं शीर्षण्यं मस्तिष्काज्जिह्वाया वि वृहामि ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: akṣībhyāṃ te nāsikābhyāṃ karṇābhyāṃ chubukādadhi | yakṣmaṃ śīrṣaṇyaṃ mastiṣkājjihvāyā vi vṛhāmi te ||

translations.english: I banish from your eyes, from your nose, from your ears, from your chin, from your head, from yourbrain, from your tongue.

mantras.sanskrit: ग्रीवाभ्यस्त उष्णिहाभ्यः कीकसाभ्यो अनूक्यात् । यक्ष्मं दोषण्यमंसाभ्यां बाहुभ्यां वि वृहामि ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: grīvābhyasta uṣṇihābhyaḥ kīkasābhyo anūkyāt | yakṣmaṃ doṣaṇyamaṃsābhyāṃ bāhubhyāṃ vi vṛhāmi te ||

translations.english: I banish disease from your neck, from your sinews, from your bones, from your joints, from your upperarms, from your shoulders, and from your fore- arms.

mantras.sanskrit: आन्त्रेभ्यस्ते गुदाभ्यो वनिष्ठोर्हृदयादधि । यक्ष्मं मतस्नाभ्यां यक्नः प्लाशिभ्यो वि वृहामि ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: āntrebhyaste gudābhyo vaniṣṭhorhṛdayādadhi | yakṣmaṃ matasnābhyāṃ yaknaḥ plāśibhyo vi vṛhāmi te ||

translations.english: I banish disease from your entrails, from your anus, from your abdomen, and from your heart, fromyour kidneys, from your liver, from your (other) viscera.

mantras.sanskrit: ऊरुभ्यां ते अष्ठीवद्भ्यां पार्ष्णिभ्यां प्रपदाभ्याम् । यक्ष्मं श्रोणिभ्यां भासदाद्भंससो वि वृहामि ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: ūrubhyāṃ te aṣṭhīvadbhyāṃ pārṣṇibhyāṃ prapadābhyām | yakṣmaṃ śroṇibhyāṃ bhāsadādbhaṃsaso vi vṛhāmi te ||

translations.english: I banish disease from your thighs, from your knees, from your heels, from your toes, from your loins,from your buttocks, from your private parts.

mantras.sanskrit: मेहनाद्वनंकरणाल्लोमभ्यस्ते नखेभ्यः । यक्ष्मं सर्वस्मादात्मनस्तमिदं वि वृहामि ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: mehanādvanaṃkaraṇāllomabhyaste nakhebhyaḥ | yakṣmaṃ sarvasmādātmanastamidaṃ vi vṛhāmi te ||

translations.english: I banish disease from your urethra, from your bladder, from your hair, from your nails, from your wholeperson.

mantras.sanskrit: अङ्गादङ्गाल्लोम्नोलोम्नो जातं पर्वणिपर्वणि । यक्ष्मं सर्वस्मादात्मनस्तमिदं वि वृहामि ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: aṅgādaṅgāllomnolomno jātaṃ parvaṇiparvaṇi | yakṣmaṃ sarvasmādātmanastamidaṃ vi vṛhāmi te ||

translations.english: I banish disease from each limb, from each hair, from each joint where it is genitive rated, from your wholeperson.

mantras.sanskrit: अपेहि मनसस्पतेऽप क्राम परश्चर । परो निॠत्या आ चक्ष्व बहुधा जीवतो मनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: apehi manasaspate'pa krāma paraścara | paro niṝtyā ā cakṣva bahudhā jīvato manaḥ ||

translations.english: Lord of the mind, begone, depart, proceed to a distance; look at Nirṛti far off; the mind of a living beingis manifold.

mantras.sanskrit: भद्रं वै वरं वृणते भद्रं युञ्जन्ति दक्षिणम् । भद्रं वैवस्वते चक्षुर्बहुत्रा जीवतो मनः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bhadraṃ vai varaṃ vṛṇate bhadraṃ yuñjanti dakṣiṇam | bhadraṃ vaivasvate cakṣurbahutrā jīvato manaḥ ||

translations.english: Men solicit the boon of good fortune, they acquire abundant good fortune, (I desire) the auspicioussight of Vaivasvat; the mind of a living being is variously (directed).

mantras.sanskrit: यदाशसा निःशसाभिशसोपारिम जाग्रतो यत्स्वपन्तः । अग्निर्विश्वान्यप दुष्कृतान्यजुष्टान्यारे अस्मद्दधातु ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadāśasā niḥśasābhiśasopārima jāgrato yatsvapantaḥ | agnirviśvānyapa duṣkṛtānyajuṣṭānyāre asmaddadhātu ||

translations.english: Whatever sin we have committed by speaking to (others), speaking against (others), speaking (evil)about (others), whether walking or sleeping, may Agni remove all such hateful sins far from us.

mantras.sanskrit: यदिन्द्र ब्रह्मणस्पतेऽभिद्रोहं चरामसि । प्रचेता न आङ्गिरसो द्विषतां पात्वंहसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadindra brahmaṇaspate'bhidrohaṃ carāmasi | pracetā na āṅgiraso dviṣatāṃ pātvaṃhasaḥ ||

translations.english: O Indra, O Brahmaṇaspati, whatever sin we run into, (save us thereform), and may Pracetas of theAṅgirasas protect us from the malignity of our enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: अजैष्माद्यासनाम चाभूमानागसो वयम् । जाग्रत्स्वप्नः संकल्पः पापो यं द्विष्मस्तं स ऋच्छतु यो नो द्वेष्टि तमृच्छतु ॥
mantras.transliteration: ajaiṣmādyāsanāma cābhūmānāgaso vayam | jāgratsvapnaḥ saṃkalpaḥ pāpo yaṃ dviṣmastaṃ sa ṛcchatu yo no dveṣṭi tamṛcchatu ||

translations.english: We have triumphed today, we have won, we have become free from guilt; may evil designs formed inwaking or sleep be transferred to him whom we hate, be transferred to him who hates us.

mantras.sanskrit: देवाः कपोत इषितो यदिच्छन्दूतो निॠत्या इदमाजगाम । तस्मा अर्चाम कृणवाम निष्कृतिं शं नो अस्तु द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: devāḥ kapota iṣito yadicchandūto niṝtyā idamājagāma | tasmā arcāma kṛṇavāma niṣkṛtiṃ śaṃ no astu dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade ||

translations.english: O gods, let us worship for that, desiring which the pigeon sent as Nirṛti's messenger, has come to this(ceremony); let us make atonement, may prosperity be given to our bipeds and quadrupeds.

mantras.sanskrit: शिवः कपोत इषितो नो अस्त्वनागा देवाः शकुनो गृहेषु । अग्निर्हि विप्रो जुषतां हविर्नः परि हेतिः पक्षिणी नो वृणक्तु ॥
mantras.transliteration: śivaḥ kapota iṣito no astvanāgā devāḥ śakuno gṛheṣu | agnirhi vipro juṣatāṃ havirnaḥ pari hetiḥ pakṣiṇī no vṛṇaktu ||

translations.english: May the bird sent to our dwellings, the pigeon, be auspicious, O gods, and void of offence, so that thewise Agni may approve of our oblation, and the winged weapon (of mischief) depart from us.

mantras.sanskrit: हेतिः पक्षिणी न दभात्यस्मानाष्ट्र्यां पदं कृणुते अग्निधाने । शं नो गोभ्यश्च पुरुषेभ्यश्चास्तु मा नो हिंसीदिह देवाः कपोतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: hetiḥ pakṣiṇī na dabhātyasmānāṣṭryāṃ padaṃ kṛṇute agnidhāne | śaṃ no gobhyaśca puruṣebhyaścāstu mā no hiṃsīdiha devāḥ kapotaḥ ||

translations.english: May the winged weapon (of mischief) do us no harm; he takes his plural ce upon the touchwood, the seatof Agni; may prosperity attend our cattle and our people, let not the pigeon, gods, do us harm in this (dwelling).

mantras.sanskrit: यदुलूको वदति मोघमेतद्यत्कपोतः पदमग्नौ कृणोति । यस्य दूतः प्रहित एष एतत्तस्मै यमाय नमो अस्तु मृत्यवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadulūko vadati moghametadyatkapotaḥ padamagnau kṛṇoti | yasya dūtaḥ prahita eṣa etattasmai yamāya namo astu mṛtyave ||

translations.english: May that which the owl shrieks be in vain, (and may it be in vain) that the pigeon takes his plural ce uponthe fire; may this reverence be paid to Yama, (the god of) Death, as whose messenger he is sent.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋचा कपोतं नुदत प्रणोदमिषं मदन्तः परि गां नयध्वम् । संयोपयन्तो दुरितानि विश्वा हित्वा न ऊर्जं प्र पतात्पतिष्ठः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛcā kapotaṃ nudata praṇodamiṣaṃ madantaḥ pari gāṃ nayadhvam | saṃyopayanto duritāni viśvā hitvā na ūrjaṃ pra patātpatiṣṭhaḥ ||

translations.english: (Praised) by our hymn, O gods, drive out the pigeon, who deserves to be driven out, exhilarated (byour oblation), bring us food and cattle, dissipating all our misfortunes; abandoning our food, may the swift(pigeon) fly away.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋषभं मा समानानां सपत्नानां विषासहिम् । हन्तारं शत्रूणां कृधि विराजं गोपतिं गवाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛṣabhaṃ mā samānānāṃ sapatnānāṃ viṣāsahim | hantāraṃ śatrūṇāṃ kṛdhi virājaṃ gopatiṃ gavām ||

translations.english: Make me, Indra, (renowned like) a bull among my equals, victor over my rivals, the slayer of my

mantras.sanskrit: अहमस्मि सपत्नहेन्द्र इवारिष्टो अक्षतः । अधः सपत्ना मे पदोरिमे सर्वे अभिष्ठिताः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahamasmi sapatnahendra ivāriṣṭo akṣataḥ | adhaḥ sapatnā me padorime sarve abhiṣṭhitāḥ ||

translations.english: I am the destroyer of my enemies, like Indra, unharmed and unwounded; may all these my foes be castdown under my feet.

mantras.sanskrit: अत्रैव वोऽपि नह्याम्युभे आर्त्नी इव ज्यया । वाचस्पते नि षेधेमान्यथा मदधरं वदान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: atraiva vo'pi nahyāmyubhe ārtnī iva jyayā | vācaspate ni ṣedhemānyathā madadharaṃ vadān ||

translations.english: I bind you here, like the two extremities of the bow the bowstring; restrain them, lord of speech, thatthey may speak humbly to me.

mantras.sanskrit: अभिभूरहमागमं विश्वकर्मेण धाम्ना । आ वश्चित्तमा वो व्रतमा वोऽहं समितिं ददे ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhibhūrahamāgamaṃ viśvakarmeṇa dhāmnā | ā vaścittamā vo vratamā vo'haṃ samitiṃ dade ||

translations.english: I have come triumphant with power, equal to any exploit; I seize upon minds, your pious observances,your prowess in war.

mantras.sanskrit: योगक्षेमं व आदायाहं भूयासमुत्तम आ वो मूर्धानमक्रमीम् । अधस्पदान्म उद्वदत मण्डूका इवोदकान्मण्डूका उदकादिव ॥
mantras.transliteration: yogakṣemaṃ va ādāyāhaṃ bhūyāsamuttama ā vo mūrdhānamakramīm | adhaspadānma udvadata maṇḍūkā ivodakānmaṇḍūkā udakādiva ||

translations.english: Seizing upon your goods and chattels, may I victorious; I walk upon your heads; cry aloud frombeneath my feet, like frogs from (below) the water, like frogs from (below) the water.

mantras.sanskrit: तुभ्येदमिन्द्र परि षिच्यते मधु त्वं सुतस्य कलशस्य राजसि । त्वं रयिं पुरुवीरामु नस्कृधि त्वं तपः परितप्याजयः स्वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tubhyedamindra pari ṣicyate madhu tvaṃ sutasya kalaśasya rājasi | tvaṃ rayiṃ puruvīrāmu naskṛdhi tvaṃ tapaḥ paritapyājayaḥ svaḥ ||

translations.english: For you, Indra, is this Soma poured forth, you rule over the effused (Soma of) the jar; do you bestowupon us riches with numerous sons, you did win heaven, performing arduous penance.

mantras.sanskrit: स्वर्जितं महि मन्दानमन्धसो हवामहे परि शक्रं सुताँ उप । इमं नो यज्ञमिह बोध्या गहि स्पृधो जयन्तं मघवानमीमहे ॥
mantras.transliteration: svarjitaṃ mahi mandānamandhaso havāmahe pari śakraṃ sutā~ upa | imaṃ no yajñamiha bodhyā gahi spṛdho jayantaṃ maghavānamīmahe ||

translations.english: We summon to the libations the mighty Śukra, the conqueror of heaven, exhilarated by sacrificialfood; take notice of this our sacrifice here and come; we solicit (for wealth) Maghavan, victorious over his foes.

mantras.sanskrit: सोमस्य राज्ञो वरुणस्य धर्मणि बृहस्पतेरनुमत्या उ शर्मणि । तवाहमद्य मघवन्नुपस्तुतौ धातर्विधातः कलशाँ अभक्षयम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: somasya rājño varuṇasya dharmaṇi bṛhaspateranumatyā u śarmaṇi | tavāhamadya maghavannupastutau dhātarvidhātaḥ kalaśā~ abhakṣayam ||

translations.english: (Engaged) in the worship of the royal Soma and of Varuṇa, (present) in the protecting (dwelling) ofBṛhaspati and Anumati, (I am assiduous) in your praise, Maghavan; Dhātā and Vidhātā, I have fed on thepitcher.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रसूतो भक्षमकरं चरावपि स्तोमं चेमं प्रथमः सूरिरुन्मृजे । सुते सातेन यद्यागमं वां प्रति विश्वामित्रजमदग्नी दमे ॥
mantras.transliteration: prasūto bhakṣamakaraṃ carāvapi stomaṃ cemaṃ prathamaḥ sūrirunmṛje | sute sātena yadyāgamaṃ vāṃ prati viśvāmitrajamadagnī dame ||

translations.english: Enjoined by you, I have prepared the food at the (sacrifice) about to be performed, and as chiefworshipper I complete this hymn of praise. (Indra speaks): The Soma being poured out in your respectivedwellings, O Viśvāmitra and Jamadagni, (offer praise) when I come with (the wealth) which I am going todistribute.

mantras.sanskrit: वातस्य नु महिमानं रथस्य रुजन्नेति स्तनयन्नस्य घोषः । दिविस्पृग्यात्यरुणानि कृण्वन्नुतो एति पृथिव्या रेणुमस्यन् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vātasya nu mahimānaṃ rathasya rujanneti stanayannasya ghoṣaḥ | divispṛgyātyaruṇāni kṛṇvannuto eti pṛthivyā reṇumasyan ||

translations.english: (I proclaim) the greatness of the impetuous Vāyu, his voice spread thundering around; he movesalong sweeping the sky, tinting purple (the quarters of the horizon), he advances, raising the dust of the earth.

mantras.sanskrit: सं प्रेरते अनु वातस्य विष्ठा ऐनं गच्छन्ति समनं न योषाः । ताभिः सयुक्सरथं देव ईयतेऽस्य विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजा ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ prerate anu vātasya viṣṭhā ainaṃ gacchanti samanaṃ na yoṣāḥ | tābhiḥ sayuksarathaṃ deva īyate'sya viśvasya bhuvanasya rājā ||

translations.english: Solid masses advance to meet the wind; the mares come to him as to battle; associated with themandin the same car the divinity proceeds, the sovereign of all this world.

mantras.sanskrit: अन्तरिक्षे पथिभिरीयमानो न नि विशते कतमच्चनाहः । अपां सखा प्रथमजा ऋतावा क्व स्विज्जातः कुत आ बभूव ॥
mantras.transliteration: antarikṣe pathibhirīyamāno na ni viśate katamaccanāhaḥ | apāṃ sakhā prathamajā ṛtāvā kva svijjātaḥ kuta ā babhūva ||

translations.english: Traversing the firmament by its paths, (Vāyu) rests not for a single day; the friend of the waters, thefirst-born, the utterer of truth-- where has he been genitive rated, whence was he manifested?

mantras.sanskrit: आत्मा देवानां भुवनस्य गर्भो यथावशं चरति देव एषः । घोषा इदस्य शृण्विरे न रूपं तस्मै वाताय हविषा विधेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: ātmā devānāṃ bhuvanasya garbho yathāvaśaṃ carati deva eṣaḥ | ghoṣā idasya śṛṇvire na rūpaṃ tasmai vātāya haviṣā vidhema ||

translations.english: The soul of the gods, the germ of the world, this divinity moves according to his plural asure; his voicesare heard, his form is not (seen); let us worship that Vāta with oblations. nutritious life-sustaining (waters); Rudra, have compassion upon the food which has feet.

mantras.sanskrit: मयोभूर्वातो अभि वातूस्रा ऊर्जस्वतीरोषधीरा रिशन्ताम् । पीवस्वतीर्जीवधन्याः पिबन्त्ववसाय पद्वते रुद्र मृळ ॥
mantras.transliteration: mayobhūrvāto abhi vātūsrā ūrjasvatīroṣadhīrā riśantām | pīvasvatīrjīvadhanyāḥ pibantvavasāya padvate rudra mṛḷa ||

translations.english: Details:

mantras.sanskrit: याः सरूपा विरूपा एकरूपा यासामग्निरिष्ट्या नामानि वेद । या अङ्गिरसस्तपसेह चक्रुस्ताभ्यः पर्जन्य महि शर्म यच्छ ॥
mantras.transliteration: yāḥ sarūpā virūpā ekarūpā yāsāmagniriṣṭyā nāmāni veda | yā aṅgirasastapaseha cakrustābhyaḥ parjanya mahi śarma yaccha ||

translations.english: Grant great felicity, Parjanya, to those cows who are of similar forms, of different forms, or of singleforms, whose names Agni knows through the sacrifice, or those whom the Aṅgirasas created in this world bypenance.

mantras.sanskrit: या देवेषु तन्वमैरयन्त यासां सोमो विश्वा रूपाणि वेद । ता अस्मभ्यं पयसा पिन्वमानाः प्रजावतीरिन्द्र गोष्ठे रिरीहि ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā deveṣu tanvamairayanta yāsāṃ somo viśvā rūpāṇi veda | tā asmabhyaṃ payasā pinvamānāḥ prajāvatīrindra goṣṭhe rirīhi ||

translations.english: Bring, Indra, to the cow-house (the cows) who offer their bodies to the gods, those of whom Somaknows all the properties, those that nourish us with their milk, and those that have calves.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रजापतिर्मह्यमेता रराणो विश्वैर्देवैः पितृभिः संविदानः । शिवाः सतीरुप नो गोष्ठमाकस्तासां वयं प्रजया सं सदेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: prajāpatirmahyametā rarāṇo viśvairdevaiḥ pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidānaḥ | śivāḥ satīrupa no goṣṭhamākastāsāṃ vayaṃ prajayā saṃ sadema ||

translations.english: May Prajāpati bestowing these (Cows) upon me concurring with the universal gods and the Pitara,bring the auspicious cattle to our cow-pen, may we be in possession of their progeny.

mantras.sanskrit: विभ्राड्बृहत्पिबतु सोम्यं मध्वायुर्दधद्यज्ञपतावविह्रुतम् । वातजूतो यो अभिरक्षति त्मना प्रजाः पुपोष पुरुधा वि राजति ॥
mantras.transliteration: vibhrāḍbṛhatpibatu somyaṃ madhvāyurdadhadyajñapatāvavihrutam | vātajūto yo abhirakṣati tmanā prajāḥ pupoṣa purudhā vi rājati ||

translations.english: Let the radiant (Sūrya) drink much sweet Soma, bestowing unbroken life upon the lord of thesacrifice; (Sūrya), who impelled by the wind protects his people of his own accord, nourishes them and shinesin various plural ces.

mantras.sanskrit: विभ्राड्बृहत्सुभृतं वाजसातमं धर्मन्दिवो धरुणे सत्यमर्पितम् । अमित्रहा वृत्रहा दस्युहन्तमं ज्योतिर्जज्ञे असुरहा सपत्नहा ॥
mantras.transliteration: vibhrāḍbṛhatsubhṛtaṃ vājasātamaṃ dharmandivo dharuṇe satyamarpitam | amitrahā vṛtrahā dasyuhantamaṃ jyotirjajñe asurahā sapatnahā ||

translations.english: The radiant light is born mighty, well-cherished, the abundant bestower of food, eternal, deposited inthe supporting sustainer of the sky, the slayer of adversaries, the slayer of the Vṛtras, abundantly slaying theDasyus, the slayer of the Asuras, the slayer of rivals.

mantras.sanskrit: इदं श्रेष्ठं ज्योतिषां ज्योतिरुत्तमं विश्वजिद्धनजिदुच्यते बृहत् । विश्वभ्राड्भ्राजो महि सूर्यो दृश उरु पप्रथे सह ओजो अच्युतम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: idaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotiruttamaṃ viśvajiddhanajiducyate bṛhat | viśvabhrāḍbhrājo mahi sūryo dṛśa uru paprathe saha ojo acyutam ||

translations.english: This light, the best of lights, the most excellent, is called the conqueror of all, the conqueror of wealth,mighty, all-illumining, radiant, mighty, Sūrya displays to view his vast power, his unfailing lustre.

mantras.sanskrit: विभ्राजञ्ज्योतिषा स्वरगच्छो रोचनं दिवः । येनेमा विश्वा भुवनान्याभृता विश्वकर्मणा विश्वदेव्यावता ॥
mantras.transliteration: vibhrājañjyotiṣā svaragaccho rocanaṃ divaḥ | yenemā viśvā bhuvanānyābhṛtā viśvakarmaṇā viśvadevyāvatā ||

translations.english: Illumining the whole (world) with your radiance, you have attained (Sūrya) the luminous region ofheaven, by which (radiance) animating all pious acts and addressed to the universal gods, all living beings arecherished.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं त्यमिटतो रथमिन्द्र प्रावः सुतावतः । अशृणोः सोमिनो हवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ tyamiṭato rathamindra prāvaḥ sutāvataḥ | aśṛṇoḥ somino havam ||

translations.english: You have protected, Indra, this chariot of Iḷā, who offered libations; hear the invocation of thepresenter of the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं मखस्य दोधतः शिरोऽव त्वचो भरः । अगच्छः सोमिनो गृहम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ makhasya dodhataḥ śiro'va tvaco bharaḥ | agacchaḥ somino gṛham ||

translations.english: You have carried off the head of the trmbling sacrifice from his skin; come to the dwelling of thepresenter of the Soma.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं त्यमिन्द्र मर्त्यमास्त्रबुध्नाय वेन्यम् । मुहुः श्रथ्ना मनस्यवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ tyamindra martyamāstrabudhnāya venyam | muhuḥ śrathnā manasyave ||

translations.english: You have often, Indra, let loose the mortal Venya, against Manasyu, the son of Astrabudhna.

mantras.sanskrit: त्वं त्यमिन्द्र सूर्यं पश्चा सन्तं पुरस्कृधि । देवानां चित्तिरो वशम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: tvaṃ tyamindra sūryaṃ paścā santaṃ puraskṛdhi | devānāṃ cittiro vaśam ||

translations.english: Bring forward that Sūrya, Indra, who is lingering behind, the beloved of the gods, (awhile) concealedfrom them.

mantras.sanskrit: आ याहि वनसा सह गावः सचन्त वर्तनिं यदूधभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yāhi vanasā saha gāvaḥ sacanta vartaniṃ yadūdhabhiḥ ||

translations.english: Come, (Uṣas), with the desirable (radiance); let the cows who are of full udders accompany yourchariot.

mantras.sanskrit: आ याहि वस्व्या धिया मंहिष्ठो जारयन्मखः सुदानुभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā yāhi vasvyā dhiyā maṃhiṣṭho jārayanmakhaḥ sudānubhiḥ ||

translations.english: Come, (Uṣas), with kindly thoughts; (it is the season) most honoured by the genitive rous, and whichbrings the sacrifice to completion.

mantras.sanskrit: पितुभृतो न तन्तुमित्सुदानवः प्रति दध्मो यजामसि ॥
mantras.transliteration: pitubhṛto na tantumitsudānavaḥ prati dadhmo yajāmasi ||

translations.english: Like bearers of food, liberal in our gifts, we spread the thread (of sacrifice before the dawn), andworship (her).

mantras.sanskrit: उषा अप स्वसुस्तमः सं वर्तयति वर्तनिं सुजातता ॥
mantras.transliteration: uṣā apa svasustamaḥ saṃ vartayati vartaniṃ sujātatā ||

translations.english: Uṣas drives away the darkness of her sister (night); her genitive rative benevolence (harnesses) herchariot.

mantras.sanskrit: आ त्वाहार्षमन्तरेधि ध्रुवस्तिष्ठाविचाचलिः । विशस्त्वा सर्वा वाञ्छन्तु मा त्वद्राष्ट्रमधि भ्रशत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ā tvāhārṣamantaredhi dhruvastiṣṭhāvicācaliḥ | viśastvā sarvā vāñchantu mā tvadrāṣṭramadhi bhraśat ||

translations.english: I have consecrated you, (Rasa); come among us, be steady and unvacillating, may all your subjectsdesire you (for their king), may the kingdom never fall from you.

mantras.sanskrit: इहैवैधि माप च्योष्ठाः पर्वत इवाविचाचलिः । इन्द्र इवेह ध्रुवस्तिष्ठेह राष्ट्रमु धारय ॥
mantras.transliteration: ihaivaidhi māpa cyoṣṭhāḥ parvata ivāvicācaliḥ | indra iveha dhruvastiṣṭheha rāṣṭramu dhāraya ||

translations.english: Come into this (kingdom), may you never be deposed, unvacillating as a mountain; stand firm here likeIndra; establish your kingdom in this world.

mantras.sanskrit: इममिन्द्रो अदीधरद्ध्रुवं ध्रुवेण हविषा । तस्मै सोमो अधि ब्रवत्तस्मा उ ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: imamindro adīdharaddhruvaṃ dhruveṇa haviṣā | tasmai somo adhi bravattasmā u brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||

translations.english: May Indra, gratified by the perpetual oblation, firmly establish this (prince); may Soma, mayBrahmaṇaspati address him (as their votary).

mantras.sanskrit: ध्रुवा द्यौर्ध्रुवा पृथिवी ध्रुवासः पर्वता इमे । ध्रुवं विश्वमिदं जगद्ध्रुवो राजा विशामयम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhruvā dyaurdhruvā pṛthivī dhruvāsaḥ parvatā ime | dhruvaṃ viśvamidaṃ jagaddhruvo rājā viśāmayam ||

translations.english: Firm is the heaven, firm is the earth, firm are these mountains, firm is this entire world, so may this kingof men be firm.

mantras.sanskrit: ध्रुवं ते राजा वरुणो ध्रुवं देवो बृहस्पतिः । ध्रुवं त इन्द्रश्चाग्निश्च राष्ट्रं धारयतां ध्रुवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhruvaṃ te rājā varuṇo dhruvaṃ devo bṛhaspatiḥ | dhruvaṃ ta indraścāgniśca rāṣṭraṃ dhārayatāṃ dhruvam ||

translations.english: May the royal Varuṇa, the divine Bṛhaspati, may Indra and Agni ever give stability to your kingdom.

mantras.sanskrit: ध्रुवं ध्रुवेण हविषाभि सोमं मृशामसि । अथो त इन्द्रः केवलीर्विशो बलिहृतस्करत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: dhruvaṃ dhruveṇa haviṣābhi somaṃ mṛśāmasi | atho ta indraḥ kevalīrviśo balihṛtaskarat ||

translations.english: With a constant oblation we handle the constant Soma; therefore, may Indra render your subjectpeople their prayers.

mantras.sanskrit: अभीवर्तेन हविषा येनेन्द्रो अभिवावृते । तेनास्मान्ब्रह्मणस्पतेऽभि राष्ट्राय वर्तय ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhīvartena haviṣā yenendro abhivāvṛte | tenāsmānbrahmaṇaspate'bhi rāṣṭrāya vartaya ||

translations.english: By the abhivarta oblation, whereby Indra has conquered (everything), do you, O Brahmaṇaspati, bringname is suggested by the repetition of the derivatives of abhivṛti].

mantras.sanskrit: अभिवृत्य सपत्नानभि या नो अरातयः । अभि पृतन्यन्तं तिष्ठाभि यो न इरस्यति ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhivṛtya sapatnānabhi yā no arātayaḥ | abhi pṛtanyantaṃ tiṣṭhābhi yo na irasyati ||

translations.english: Having overcome our rivals, and those who are our enemies, do you attack him who assails us, andhim who behaves insolently towards us.

mantras.sanskrit: अभि त्वा देवः सविताभि सोमो अवीवृतत् । अभि त्वा विश्वा भूतान्यभीवर्तो यथाससि ॥
mantras.transliteration: abhi tvā devaḥ savitābhi somo avīvṛtat | abhi tvā viśvā bhūtānyabhīvarto yathāsasi ||

translations.english: May te divine Savitā, may Soma establish you, (rājā), may all beings establish you, so that youmay be supreme.

mantras.sanskrit: येनेन्द्रो हविषा कृत्व्यभवद्द्युम्न्युत्तमः । इदं तदक्रि देवा असपत्नः किलाभुवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yenendro haviṣā kṛtvyabhavaddyumnyuttamaḥ | idaṃ tadakri devā asapatnaḥ kilābhuvam ||

translations.english: That oblation whereby Indra became heroic, renowned and eminent, I have offered, O gods, (to you),may I become freed from my rivals.

mantras.sanskrit: असपत्नः सपत्नहाभिराष्ट्रो विषासहिः । यथाहमेषां भूतानां विराजानि जनस्य च ॥
mantras.transliteration: asapatnaḥ sapatnahābhirāṣṭro viṣāsahiḥ | yathāhameṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ virājāni janasya ca ||

translations.english: May I become without a rival, the destroyer of my rivals, obtaining the sovereignty, overcoming (myfoes) so that I may reign over these beings and over my people.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र वो ग्रावाणः सविता देवः सुवतु धर्मणा । धूर्षु युज्यध्वं सुनुत ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra vo grāvāṇaḥ savitā devaḥ suvatu dharmaṇā | dhūrṣu yujyadhvaṃ sunuta ||

translations.english: May the divine Savitā urge you, stones, by his sustaining (action), be yoked to the chariot-poles,express (the Soma).

mantras.sanskrit: ग्रावाणो अप दुच्छुनामप सेधत दुर्मतिम् । उस्राः कर्तन भेषजम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: grāvāṇo apa ducchunāmapa sedhata durmatim | usrāḥ kartana bheṣajam ||

translations.english: Drive away, stones, the malevolent (folk), drive away evil intention, make our cattle a remedy (againstdistress).

mantras.sanskrit: ग्रावाण उपरेष्वा महीयन्ते सजोषसः । वृष्णे दधतो वृष्ण्यम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: grāvāṇa upareṣvā mahīyante sajoṣasaḥ | vṛṣṇe dadhato vṛṣṇyam ||

translations.english: The stones consentient with the central pivot are honoured, giving energy to the sprinkling (Soma).

mantras.sanskrit: ग्रावाणः सविता नु वो देवः सुवतु धर्मणा । यजमानाय सुन्वते ॥
mantras.transliteration: grāvāṇaḥ savitā nu vo devaḥ suvatu dharmaṇā | yajamānāya sunvate ||

translations.english: May the divine Savitā quickly urge you, stones, by his sustaining (action) for the sake of theworshipper, who makes the libation.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र सूनव ऋभूणां बृहन्नवन्त वृजना । क्षामा ये विश्वधायसोऽश्नन्धेनुं न मातरम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra sūnava ṛbhūṇāṃ bṛhannavanta vṛjanā | kṣāmā ye viśvadhāyaso'śnandhenuṃ na mātaram ||

translations.english: The Sunus, (the sons) of the Ṛbhus, advance boldly to battle; supporters of all, they have spreadover the earth as (a calf) over the mother cow.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र देवं देव्या धिया भरता जातवेदसम् । हव्या नो वक्षदानुषक् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra devaṃ devyā dhiyā bharatā jātavedasam | havyā no vakṣadānuṣak ||

translations.english: Bring forward the divine Jātavedas by means of divine wisdom; may he bear our oblations (to thegods) in succession.

mantras.sanskrit: अयमु ष्य प्र देवयुर्होता यज्ञाय नीयते । रथो न योरभीवृतो घृणीवाञ्चेतति त्मना ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayamu ṣya pra devayurhotā yajñāya nīyate | ratho na yorabhīvṛto ghṛṇīvāñcetati tmanā ||

translations.english: This ministrant priest devoted to the gods is brought (here) for the sacrifice; radiant as theswift-moving sun, uniting (the oblation and the gods) surrounded (by the priests, Agni) knows of himself (how toworship the gods).

mantras.sanskrit: अयमग्निरुरुष्यत्यमृतादिव जन्मनः । सहसश्चित्सहीयान्देवो जीवातवे कृतः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ayamagniruruṣyatyamṛtādiva janmanaḥ | sahasaścitsahīyāndevo jīvātave kṛtaḥ ||

translations.english: This Agni saves from peril caused by man as (well as) from peril caused by the immortals, a godstronger than strength, created for life-producing (sacrifice).

mantras.sanskrit: पतंगमक्तमसुरस्य मायया हृदा पश्यन्ति मनसा विपश्चितः । समुद्रे अन्तः कवयो वि चक्षते मरीचीनां पदमिच्छन्ति वेधसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: pataṃgamaktamasurasya māyayā hṛdā paśyanti manasā vipaścitaḥ | samudre antaḥ kavayo vi cakṣate marīcīnāṃ padamicchanti vedhasaḥ ||

translations.english: The wise behold their mind; (seated) in their heart the Sun made manifest by the illusion of the asura;the sages look into the solar orb, the ordainers (of solar worship) desire the region of his rays.

mantras.sanskrit: पतंगो वाचं मनसा बिभर्ति तां गन्धर्वोऽवदद्गर्भे अन्तः । तां द्योतमानां स्वर्यं मनीषामृतस्य पदे कवयो नि पान्ति ॥
mantras.transliteration: pataṃgo vācaṃ manasā bibharti tāṃ gandharvo'vadadgarbhe antaḥ | tāṃ dyotamānāṃ svaryaṃ manīṣāmṛtasya pade kavayo ni pānti ||

translations.english: The Sun bears the (sacred) word in his mind the Gandharva has spoken it, (abiding) within the womb;sages cherish it in the plural ce of sacrifice, brilliant, heavenly ruling the mind.

mantras.sanskrit: अपश्यं गोपामनिपद्यमानमा च परा च पथिभिश्चरन्तम् । स सध्रीचीः स विषूचीर्वसान आ वरीवर्ति भुवनेष्वन्तः ॥
mantras.transliteration: apaśyaṃ gopāmanipadyamānamā ca parā ca pathibhiścarantam | sa sadhrīcīḥ sa viṣūcīrvasāna ā varīvarti bhuvaneṣvantaḥ ||

translations.english: I beheld the protector (the Sun), never descending, going by his paths to the east and to the west;clothing (with light) the (four) quarters of heaven and the intermediate spaces, he constantly revolves in the midstof the worlds.

mantras.sanskrit: त्यमू षु वाजिनं देवजूतं सहावानं तरुतारं रथानाम् । अरिष्टनेमिं पृतनाजमाशुं स्वस्तये तार्क्ष्यमिहा हुवेम ॥
mantras.transliteration: tyamū ṣu vājinaṃ devajūtaṃ sahāvānaṃ tarutāraṃ rathānām | ariṣṭanemiṃ pṛtanājamāśuṃ svastaye tārkṣyamihā huvema ||

translations.english: Let us invoke here for our welfare that Tārkṣya, who is mighty, the commissioned of the gods, thevictorious, the outstripper of chariots, of irresistible car, the overthrower of hosts, the swift.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्येव रातिमाजोहुवानाः स्वस्तये नावमिवा रुहेम । उर्वी न पृथ्वी बहुले गभीरे मा वामेतौ मा परेतौ रिषाम ॥
mantras.transliteration: indrasyeva rātimājohuvānāḥ svastaye nāvamivā ruhema | urvī na pṛthvī bahule gabhīre mā vāmetau mā paretau riṣāma ||

translations.english: Repeatedly invoking the liberality (of Tārkṣya), as (we do that) of Indra, let us mount upon it for ourwelfare as upon a ship; O heaven and earth, vast, expanded, manifold, profound, may we not suffer harm nowfrom (Tārkṣya's) coming to or departing from you.

mantras.sanskrit: सद्यश्चिद्यः शवसा पञ्च कृष्टीः सूर्य इव ज्योतिषापस्ततान । सहस्रसाः शतसा अस्य रंहिर्न स्मा वरन्ते युवतिं न शर्याम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: sadyaścidyaḥ śavasā pañca kṛṣṭīḥ sūrya iva jyotiṣāpastatāna | sahasrasāḥ śatasā asya raṃhirna smā varante yuvatiṃ na śaryām ||

translations.english: He who has by his strength rapidly spread out the waters for the five castes like the sun by his light--thousand-yielding, hundred-bestowing is his course, like an unfailing arrow, none can stop it.

mantras.sanskrit: उत्तिष्ठताव पश्यतेन्द्रस्य भागमृत्वियम् । यदि श्रातो जुहोतन यद्यश्रातो ममत्तन ॥
mantras.transliteration: uttiṣṭhatāva paśyatendrasya bhāgamṛtviyam | yadi śrāto juhotana yadyaśrāto mamattana ||

translations.english: Rise up, look to the portion of Indra suitable to the season; if it be cooked, offer it; if uncooked, gratifyhim (by praise).

mantras.sanskrit: श्रातं हविरो ष्विन्द्र प्र याहि जगाम सूरो अध्वनो विमध्यम् । परि त्वासते निधिभिः सखायः कुलपा न व्राजपतिं चरन्तम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: śrātaṃ haviro ṣvindra pra yāhi jagāma sūro adhvano vimadhyam | pari tvāsate nidhibhiḥ sakhāyaḥ kulapā na vrājapatiṃ carantam ||

translations.english: Go, Indra, quickly to the oblation which is cooked, the sun is advanced nearly to the middle of hisroad; your friends sit around you with their offerings as the protectors of a family (attend upon) the migrating lordof the mansion.

mantras.sanskrit: श्रातं मन्य ऊधनि श्रातमग्नौ सुश्रातं मन्ये तदृतं नवीयः । माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य दध्नः पिबेन्द्र वज्रिन्पुरुकृज्जुषाणः ॥
mantras.transliteration: śrātaṃ manya ūdhani śrātamagnau suśrātaṃ manye tadṛtaṃ navīyaḥ | mādhyaṃdinasya savanasya dadhnaḥ pibendra vajrinpurukṛjjuṣāṇaḥ ||

translations.english: I consider (the oblation) as cooked in the udder (of the cow), I consider it cooked in the fire, I considerthis pure and fresh (oblation) well- cooked; Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, doer of many deeds, drink wellpleased of the curd of the noon-day sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र ससाहिषे पुरुहूत शत्रूञ्ज्येष्ठस्ते शुष्म इह रातिरस्तु । इन्द्रा भर दक्षिणेना वसूनि पतिः सिन्धूनामसि रेवतीनाम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra sasāhiṣe puruhūta śatrūñjyeṣṭhaste śuṣma iha rātirastu | indrā bhara dakṣiṇenā vasūni patiḥ sindhūnāmasi revatīnām ||

translations.english: Indra, invoked of many, you triumph over your enemies; pre-eminent is your strength, may yourgenerosity be shown on this occasion; bring treasures with your right hand; you are the lord of thewealth-conveying rivers.

mantras.sanskrit: मृगो न भीमः कुचरो गिरिष्ठाः परावत आ जगन्था परस्याः । सृकं संशाय पविमिन्द्र तिग्मं वि शत्रून्ताळ्हि वि मृधो नुदस्व ॥
mantras.transliteration: mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ parāvata ā jaganthā parasyāḥ | sṛkaṃ saṃśāya pavimindra tigmaṃ vi śatrūntāḷhi vi mṛdho nudasva ||

translations.english: Terrible are you as a wandering lion who dwells in the mountains; come from a far-off, distant (world);having whetted your rapid and sharp bolt, destroy our enemies, Indra, put to flight our opponents.

mantras.sanskrit: इन्द्र क्षत्रमभि वाममोजोऽजायथा वृषभ चर्षणीनाम् । अपानुदो जनममित्रयन्तमुरुं देवेभ्यो अकृणोरु लोकम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: indra kṣatramabhi vāmamojo'jāyathā vṛṣabha carṣaṇīnām | apānudo janamamitrayantamuruṃ devebhyo akṛṇoru lokam ||

translations.english: You have been born, Indra, endowed with protecting and desirable vigour; benefactor of mankind, youdid drive away the man who was unfriendly(to us), you prepared a spacious region for the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: प्रथश्च यस्य सप्रथश्च नामानुष्टुभस्य हविषो हविर्यत् । धातुर्द्युतानात्सवितुश्च विष्णो रथंतरमा जभारा वसिष्ठः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prathaśca yasya saprathaśca nāmānuṣṭubhasya haviṣo haviryat | dhāturdyutānātsavituśca viṣṇo rathaṃtaramā jabhārā vasiṣṭhaḥ ||

translations.english: Vasiṣṭha, whos (son) is Pratha by name, and whose (son) is Sapratha, has (with them) borne awayfrom Dhāta, and from the radiant Savitā, and from Viṣṇu, the rathantara portion of the oblation which isoffered with the anuṣṭup verse.

mantras.sanskrit: अविन्दन्ते अतिहितं यदासीद्यज्ञस्य धाम परमं गुहा यत् । धातुर्द्युतानात्सवितुश्च विष्णोर्भरद्वाजो बृहदा चक्रे अग्नेः ॥
mantras.transliteration: avindante atihitaṃ yadāsīdyajñasya dhāma paramaṃ guhā yat | dhāturdyutānātsavituśca viṣṇorbharadvājo bṛhadā cakre agneḥ ||

translations.english: They discovered (the Bṛhat) which has been put away, the most excellent substance of the sacrificewhich was hidden; Bharadvāja took the Bṛhat from Dhātā, the radiant Savitā, Viṣṇu, and Agni.

mantras.sanskrit: तेऽविन्दन्मनसा दीध्याना यजुः ष्कन्नं प्रथमं देवयानम् । धातुर्द्युतानात्सवितुश्च विष्णोरा सूर्यादभरन्घर्ममेते ॥
mantras.transliteration: te'vindanmanasā dīdhyānā yajuḥ ṣkannaṃ prathamaṃ devayānam | dhāturdyutānātsavituśca viṣṇorā sūryādabharangharmamete ||

translations.english: Those brilliant deities discovered by their intelligence the principal means of sacrifice which has to beeffused, whichleads to the gods; these (priests) have taken the Gharma from Dhātā, the radiant Savitā andViṣṇu.

mantras.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिर्नयतु दुर्गहा तिरः पुनर्नेषदघशंसाय मन्म । क्षिपदशस्तिमप दुर्मतिं हन्नथा करद्यजमानाय शं योः ॥
mantras.transliteration: bṛhaspatirnayatu durgahā tiraḥ punarneṣadaghaśaṃsāya manma | kṣipadaśastimapa durmatiṃ hannathā karadyajamānāya śaṃ yoḥ ||

translations.english: Let Bṛhaspati, the overcomer of difficulties, put aside (all sins), let him thrust aside the weapon of thecalumniator; may he hurl down the inglorious (enemy), may he baffle the malevolent, and bestow upon thesacrificer health and prosperity.

mantras.sanskrit: नराशंसो नोऽवतु प्रयाजे शं नो अस्त्वनुयाजो हवेषु । क्षिपदशस्तिमप दुर्मतिं हन्नथा करद्यजमानाय शं योः ॥
mantras.transliteration: narāśaṃso no'vatu prayāje śaṃ no astvanuyājo haveṣu | kṣipadaśastimapa durmatiṃ hannathā karadyajamānāya śaṃ yoḥ ||

translations.english: May Narāśaṃsa protect us at the Prayāja rite; may he be (the giver of) felicity to us as theAnuyāja (divinity) at oblations; may Bṛhaspati hurl down the inglorious (enemy), may he baffle the malevolent,and bestow upon the sacrificer health and prosperity.

mantras.sanskrit: तपुर्मूर्धा तपतु रक्षसो ये ब्रह्मद्विषः शरवे हन्तवा उ । क्षिपदशस्तिमप दुर्मतिं हन्नथा करद्यजमानाय शं योः ॥
mantras.transliteration: tapurmūrdhā tapatu rakṣaso ye brahmadviṣaḥ śarave hantavā u | kṣipadaśastimapa durmatiṃ hannathā karadyajamānāya śaṃ yoḥ ||

translations.english: May Tapurmūrdhā consume the rākṣasas, who are the enemies of the Brāhmaṇas, (and thenproceed) to slay (their) malignant (chief); may Bṛhaspati hurl down the inglorious (enemy), may he baffle themalevolent, and bestow upon the sacrificer health and prosperity.

mantras.sanskrit: अपश्यं त्वा मनसा चेकितानं तपसो जातं तपसो विभूतम् । इह प्रजामिह रयिं रराणः प्र जायस्व प्रजया पुत्रकाम ॥
mantras.transliteration: apaśyaṃ tvā manasā cekitānaṃ tapaso jātaṃ tapaso vibhūtam | iha prajāmiha rayiṃ rarāṇaḥ pra jāyasva prajayā putrakāma ||

translations.english: (The wife speaks). I beheld you in my mind conversant (with sacred rites), born of penance, renownedfor penance; enjoying in this world progeny and riches, do you who are desirous of offspring beget offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: अपश्यं त्वा मनसा दीध्यानां स्वायां तनू ऋत्व्ये नाधमानाम् । उप मामुच्चा युवतिर्बभूयाः प्र जायस्व प्रजया पुत्रकामे ॥
mantras.transliteration: apaśyaṃ tvā manasā dīdhyānāṃ svāyāṃ tanū ṛtvye nādhamānām | upa māmuccā yuvatirbabhūyāḥ pra jāyasva prajayā putrakāme ||

translations.english: (The Yajamāna speaks). I behold you in my mind radiant (with beauty), beseeching (your husband'sapproach) to your body at due season; may you, who are youthful, come up to me; bear offspring, you who aredesirous of offspring.

mantras.sanskrit: अहं गर्भमदधामोषधीष्वहं विश्वेषु भुवनेष्वन्तः । अहं प्रजा अजनयं पृथिव्यामहं जनिभ्यो अपरीषु पुत्रान् ॥
mantras.transliteration: ahaṃ garbhamadadhāmoṣadhīṣvahaṃ viśveṣu bhuvaneṣvantaḥ | ahaṃ prajā ajanayaṃ pṛthivyāmahaṃ janibhyo aparīṣu putrān ||

translations.english: (The hotā speaks). I implant the seed in vegetables, the germ in all living beings; I engender progenyupon the earth; I beget children on other women.

mantras.sanskrit: विष्णुर्योनिं कल्पयतु त्वष्टा रूपाणि पिंशतु । आ सिञ्चतु प्रजापतिर्धाता गर्भं दधातु ते ॥
mantras.transliteration: viṣṇuryoniṃ kalpayatu tvaṣṭā rūpāṇi piṃśatu | ā siñcatu prajāpatirdhātā garbhaṃ dadhātu te ||

translations.english: May Viṣṇu construct the womb, may Tvaṣṭā fabricate the members, may Prajāpati sprinkle (theseed), may Dhātā cherish your embryo.

mantras.sanskrit: गर्भं धेहि सिनीवालि गर्भं धेहि सरस्वति । गर्भं ते अश्विनौ देवावा धत्तां पुष्करस्रजा ॥
mantras.transliteration: garbhaṃ dhehi sinīvāli garbhaṃ dhehi sarasvati | garbhaṃ te aśvinau devāvā dhattāṃ puṣkarasrajā ||

translations.english: Sustain the embryo, Sinīvāli, sustain the embryo, Sarasvatī, may the divine Aśvins, garlanded withlotuses, sustain your embryo.

mantras.sanskrit: हिरण्ययी अरणी यं निर्मन्थतो अश्विना । तं ते गर्भं हवामहे दशमे मासि सूतवे ॥
mantras.transliteration: hiraṇyayī araṇī yaṃ nirmanthato aśvinā | taṃ te garbhaṃ havāmahe daśame māsi sūtave ||

translations.english: We invoke your embryo which the A'vins have churned with the golden pieces of touchwood, that youmay bring it forth in the tenth month.

mantras.sanskrit: महि त्रीणामवोऽस्तु द्युक्षं मित्रस्यार्यम्णः । दुराधर्षं वरुणस्य ॥
mantras.transliteration: mahi trīṇāmavo'stu dyukṣaṃ mitrasyāryamṇaḥ | durādharṣaṃ varuṇasya ||

translations.english: May the great, brilliant, unassailable protection of the three (deities), Mitra, Aryaman, and Varuṇa, be(granted to me).

mantras.sanskrit: नहि तेषाममा चन नाध्वसु वारणेषु । ईशे रिपुरघशंसः ॥
mantras.transliteration: nahi teṣāmamā cana nādhvasu vāraṇeṣu | īśe ripuraghaśaṃsaḥ ||

translations.english: Let not their malignant enemy have power over dwellings, or roads, or enclosures.

mantras.sanskrit: यस्मै पुत्रासो अदितेः प्र जीवसे मर्त्याय । ज्योतिर्यच्छन्त्यजस्रम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: yasmai putrāso aditeḥ pra jīvase martyāya | jyotiryacchantyajasram ||

translations.english: (Nor the enemy of) the mortal upon whom the sons of Aditi bestow the eternal light (of life) that he maylive.

mantras.sanskrit: वात आ वातु भेषजं शम्भु मयोभु नो हृदे । प्र ण आयूंषि तारिषत् ॥
mantras.transliteration: vāta ā vātu bheṣajaṃ śambhu mayobhu no hṛde | pra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣat ||

translations.english: May Vāta breath into our hearts a healinv balm, bringing happiness; may he prolong our lives.

mantras.sanskrit: उत वात पितासि न उत भ्रातोत नः सखा । स नो जीवातवे कृधि ॥
mantras.transliteration: uta vāta pitāsi na uta bhrātota naḥ sakhā | sa no jīvātave kṛdhi ||

translations.english: You, Vāta, are both our father and our brother and our friend; cause us to live.

mantras.sanskrit: यददो वात ते गृहेऽमृतस्य निधिर्हितः । ततो नो देहि जीवसे ॥
mantras.transliteration: yadado vāta te gṛhe'mṛtasya nidhirhitaḥ | tato no dehi jīvase ||

translations.english: The store of ambrosia, Vāta, which is plural ced in your house, give us of it that we may live.

mantras.sanskrit: प्राग्नये वाचमीरय वृषभाय क्षितीनाम् । स नः पर्षदति द्विषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: prāgnaye vācamīraya vṛṣabhāya kṣitīnām | sa naḥ parṣadati dviṣaḥ ||

translations.english: Raise the hymn to Agni, the benefactor of mankind; may he bear us (safe) beyond (the reach of) thosewho hate us.

mantras.sanskrit: यः परस्याः परावतस्तिरो धन्वातिरोचते । स नः पर्षदति द्विषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yaḥ parasyāḥ parāvatastiro dhanvātirocate | sa naḥ parṣadati dviṣaḥ ||

translations.english: May (Agni), who from a great distance shines fiercely upon the desert tract that he has attained, bearus (safe) beyond (the reach of) those who hate us.

mantras.sanskrit: यो रक्षांसि निजूर्वति वृषा शुक्रेण शोचिषा । स नः पर्षदति द्विषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo rakṣāṃsi nijūrvati vṛṣā śukreṇa śociṣā | sa naḥ parṣadati dviṣaḥ ||

translations.english: May (Agni), the showerer of benefits, who, his pure radiance destroys the rākṣasas, bear us (safe)beyond (the reach of) those who hate us.

mantras.sanskrit: यो विश्वाभि विपश्यति भुवना सं च पश्यति । स नः पर्षदति द्विषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo viśvābhi vipaśyati bhuvanā saṃ ca paśyati | sa naḥ parṣadati dviṣaḥ ||

translations.english: The Agni that glances at all the lokas, should protect us from the ill-will of enemies.

mantras.sanskrit: यो अस्य पारे रजसः शुक्रो अग्निरजायत । स नः पर्षदति द्विषः ॥
mantras.transliteration: yo asya pāre rajasaḥ śukro agnirajāyata | sa naḥ parṣadati dviṣaḥ ||

translations.english: The Agni that appears in the celestial sphere above us in the form of illumined light, should protect usfrom all kinds of sorrows and troubles.

mantras.sanskrit: प्र नूनं जातवेदसमश्वं हिनोत वाजिनम् । इदं नो बर्हिरासदे ॥
mantras.transliteration: pra nūnaṃ jātavedasamaśvaṃ hinota vājinam | idaṃ no barhirāsade ||

translations.english: Urge the food-giver, Jātavedas, (as) a horse, to sit down upon this our sacred grass.

mantras.sanskrit: अस्य प्र जातवेदसो विप्रवीरस्य मीळ्हुषः । महीमियर्मि सुष्टुतिम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: asya pra jātavedaso vipravīrasya mīḷhuṣaḥ | mahīmiyarmi suṣṭutim ||

translations.english: I offer earnest and ample praise to this Ja-tavedas, the showerer (of benefits), whose sons areintelligent (worshippers).

mantras.sanskrit: या रुचो जातवेदसो देवत्रा हव्यवाहनीः । ताभिर्नो यज्ञमिन्वतु ॥
mantras.transliteration: yā ruco jātavedaso devatrā havyavāhanīḥ | tābhirno yajñaminvatu ||

translations.english: May he invest our sacrifice with those bright (flames) of Jātavedas, that are the bearers of theoblation to the gods.

mantras.sanskrit: आयं गौः पृश्निरक्रमीदसदन्मातरं पुरः । पितरं च प्रयन्त्स्वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: āyaṃ gauḥ pṛśnirakramīdasadanmātaraṃ puraḥ | pitaraṃ ca prayantsvaḥ ||

translations.english: This moving many-coloured (Sun) has arrived, he has sat down before his mother (earth) in the east,and advances to his father heaven.

mantras.sanskrit: अन्तश्चरति रोचनास्य प्राणादपानती । व्यख्यन्महिषो दिवम् ॥
mantras.transliteration: antaścarati rocanāsya prāṇādapānatī | vyakhyanmahiṣo divam ||

translations.english: His radiance penetrates internally, drawing (the air) down (through the lungs) after having sent it up,the mighty one beholds the sky.

mantras.sanskrit: त्रिंशद्धाम वि राजति वाक्पतंगाय धीयते । प्रति वस्तोरह द्युभिः ॥
mantras.transliteration: triṃśaddhāma vi rājati vākpataṃgāya dhīyate | prati vastoraha dyubhiḥ ||

translations.english: The thirty stations of the day and night shine with (the sun's) rays, the gvoice (of praise) is addressedto the Sun.

mantras.sanskrit: ऋतं च सत्यं चाभीद्धात्तपसोऽध्यजायत । ततो रात्र्यजायत ततः समुद्रो अर्णवः ॥
mantras.transliteration: ṛtaṃ ca satyaṃ cābhīddhāttapaso'dhyajāyata | tato rātryajāyata tataḥ samudro arṇavaḥ ||

translations.english: Truth (of thought) and truthfulness (of speech) were born of arduous penance, thence was nightgenerated, thence also the watery ocean.

mantras.sanskrit: समुद्रादर्णवादधि संवत्सरो अजायत । अहोरात्राणि विदधद्विश्वस्य मिषतो वशी ॥
mantras.transliteration: samudrādarṇavādadhi saṃvatsaro ajāyata | ahorātrāṇi vidadhadviśvasya miṣato vaśī ||

translations.english: From the watery ocean was the year afterwards produced, ordaining nights and days, the ruler ofevery moment.

mantras.sanskrit: सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ धाता यथापूर्वमकल्पयत् । दिवं च पृथिवीं चान्तरिक्षमथो स्वः ॥
mantras.transliteration: sūryācandramasau dhātā yathāpūrvamakalpayat | divaṃ ca pṛthivīṃ cāntarikṣamatho svaḥ ||

translations.english: Dhātā in the beginning created the sun and moved the heaven, the earth, the firmament, and thehappy (sky).

mantras.sanskrit: संसमिद्युवसे वृषन्नग्ने विश्वान्यर्य आ । इळस्पदे समिध्यसे स नो वसून्या भर ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃsamidyuvase vṛṣannagne viśvānyarya ā | iḷaspade samidhyase sa no vasūnyā bhara ||

translations.english: Agni, showerer (of benefits), you who are the lord, you verily combine with all creatures, you are kindled upon the footmark of Iḷā (the altar); bring unto us riches.

mantras.sanskrit: सं गच्छध्वं सं वदध्वं सं वो मनांसि जानताम् । देवा भागं यथा पूर्वे संजानाना उपासते ॥
mantras.transliteration: saṃ gacchadhvaṃ saṃ vadadhvaṃ saṃ vo manāṃsi jānatām | devā bhāgaṃ yathā pūrve saṃjānānā upāsate ||

translations.english: Meet together, talk together, let your minds apprehend alike; in like manner as the ancient godsconcurring accepted their portion of the sacrifice.

mantras.sanskrit: समानो मन्त्रः समितिः समानी समानं मनः सह चित्तमेषाम् । समानं मन्त्रमभि मन्त्रये वः समानेन वो हविषा जुहोमि ॥
mantras.transliteration: samāno mantraḥ samitiḥ samānī samānaṃ manaḥ saha cittameṣām | samānaṃ mantramabhi mantraye vaḥ samānena vo haviṣā juhomi ||

translations.english: Common be the prayer of these (assembled worshippers), common be the acquisition, common thepurpose, associated be the desire. I repeat for you a common prayer, I offer for you with a common oblation.

mantras.sanskrit: समानी व आकूतिः समाना हृदयानि वः । समानमस्तु वो मनो यथा वः सुसहासति ॥
mantras.transliteration: samānī va ākūtiḥ samānā hṛdayāni vaḥ | samānamastu vo mano yathā vaḥ susahāsati ||

translations.english: Common, (worshipppers), be your intention; common be (the wishes of) your hearts; common be yourthoughts, so that there may be thorough union among you.
